english: Hello.
Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴이네. 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 우리 배에 탄 거야?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 주겠다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 그래? 내 눈엔 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 안 보이는데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 그럼 미안하지만 들을 시간이 없네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인 듯 프레메닉 아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 출산이 아주 고통스러웠대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 굳이 알고 싶지 않은 얘기까지 고마워요!

english: ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 정말이에요! 초대받아서 온 거라고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 영락없는 밀항자처럼 보인다는 건 인정해야 할걸.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 쪽은 얼마나 추운지, 말을 하면 그 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그건 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 과장했어. 그래도 엄청, 엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있더라고.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 괜찮아. 약탈할 수 있는 grog(그로그)랑 전리품은 전부 우리 거고, 치과까지 포함한 의료 혜택도 빵빵하지.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중에 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 다 나을 때까지 안 놓아주는 거지.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 전문적인 치료에 얼마나 큰 동기 부여가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호에는 무슨 일로 탄 거야?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아가려던 참인데, 배가 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그렇지, 정말 미인이야! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호는 폭풍우가 치나 해가 쨍쨍하나 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었고, 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳에 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 멋진 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 같은 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 그런 말투 좀 쓰지 마. 엄청 거슬리거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지 좀 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 넌... 몰라, 네가 먹고사는 그 일이 뭐든, 그걸로 사는 건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 죽이거나, 사람들 부탁으로 온 세상에 물건을 배달해요.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 지금은 안 돼. 밀항자랑 노닥거리다 걸리면 선장님이 내 창자를 뽑아 버릴 거야.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 알았어, [guy/lady]. 네가 누구든 상관없이 난 혼날 거라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적으로 산다는 게 실제로 뭘 하는 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 글쎄, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 뜬금없는 질문 받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탔다고요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했어요! 그 사람한테 물어봐요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 걸리지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: What are you cooking?
My speciality! What else could I be cooking?
translation: 내 특제 요리지! 그거 말고 뭘 요리하겠어?

english: Ok, and your speciality is...?
Boiled shark guts with a hint of rosemary and a dash of squid ink.
translation: 삶은 상어 내장에 로즈메리를 살짝, 오징어 먹물을 한 방울.

english: I think I'll stick to making my own food.
translation: 전 그냥 제 음식은 제가 해 먹을게요.

english: Your loss!
Hello.
Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?

So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.

english: So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 출산이 아주 고통스러웠대.

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...

english: Okay then...
Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 같은 리치 놈아!

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
I feel a little sea-sick from this travelling.
translation: 이번 항해 때문에 뱃멀미가 좀 나네요.

english: Well there's a good remedy for that.
There is?
Yes.
What?
Swim.
Oh HA HA. Thanks for the help!
My pleasure.
I was being sarcastic.
I know. So was I.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 여긴 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행) 지점이야. 여러 마을에 지점이 있지.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 네 물건이랑 돈을 대신 맡아 주지. 귀중품을 안전하게 지키고 싶으면 우리한테 맡겨.

english: Hi.
How's Cyrisus? Where is he?
He's fine now. Back to full health.
Good, I'm pleased.
No problem.
Don't think that this means I like you now!
translation: 그렇다고 내가 이제 널 좋아하게 된 줄 알지 마!

english: Look at my face.
Yes? What about it.
Does it look like I care?
Not really.
Well, there you go.
Using the bank
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
What is this place?
Cyrisus in the mine
What's going on?
Ah, we be building this 'ere tower. Lookin' good ain't it?
translation: 아, 우리가 이 탑을 짓고 있지. 근사하지 않냐?

english: It does look pretty impressive, but what are you doing hanging around?
translation: 꽤 멋져 보이긴 하는데, 왜 여기서 빈둥거리고 있어요?

english: Tea break, naturally.
Naturally. Not sure why I asked.
Fancy some?
Tea? Sure.
You'll find a kettle in the box to the-
translation: kettle(주전자)는 상자 안에 있을 거야, 저쪽으로 가서-

english: Erm...yeah...no...sorry...gotta go.
Say, that's a nice helmet.
Thank you - just as nice as the one in your bank!
translation: 고마워. 네 은행에 있는 거만큼 멋지지!

english: This is quite the tower.
Yeah, it cost a fair bit.
How much?
Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.
translation: 글쎄, 이걸 지으려고 동료 연금술사들 물건을 꽤 많이 '알캐'해야 했지.

english: I bet they love you for that.
Everyone loves someone that can create money.
translation: 돈을 만들어 낼 줄 아는 사람은 누구나 좋아하는 법이지.

english: I don't.
What do you do for fun on this ship? You know, when you're not doing pirate stuff.
translation: 이 배에선 재미로 뭘 해요? 그러니까, 해적 일 안 할 때요.

english: All sorts! Hide and seek, pin the patch on the pirate, walk the plank!
translation: 별거 다 하지! 숨바꼭질, 눈 가리고 해적한테 안대 붙이기, 판자 걷기!

english: What a life! Wait a minute. 'Walk the plank'? Surely that's a bit dangerous?
translation: 끝내주는 인생이네요! 잠깐만요. '판자 걷기'요? 그거 좀 위험하지 않아요?

english: Well of course, but where's the fun without a few deaths?
translation: 당연하지. 근데 몇 명은 죽어 나가야 재밌지 않겠어?

english: I think I'll stick to Runelink.
What are you up to?
Rock, Paper, Scissors. Can't you tell?
It was more of a rhetorical question.
Rhetora-what?
Shouldn't you be working?
We are. It's team building.
Why, hello there!
What do you want?
Clothing.
Nope. Need mine.
translation: 안 돼. 내 건 내가 입어야지.

english: Ah, come on. You know you want to give me free stuff.
translation: 에이, 왜 그래요. 공짜로 뭐 주고 싶은 거 다 알아요.

english: Stop bothering me, can't you see I'm busy!
translation: 귀찮게 좀 하지 마, 바쁜 거 안 보여?

english: Yes, VERY busy I'm sure.
Okay, okay.
The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.
translation: 며칠 전에 바닷가 빨랫줄에 옷을 말리고 있었거든. 폭풍이 몰아쳐서 옷 몇 벌이 없어졌어.

english: Likely story. Sure you weren't skinny dipping?
translation: 퍽이나요. 알몸으로 수영하다 잃어버린 거 아니고요?

english: Just go look and leave me be! Search around the tower and you may find them.
translation: 그냥 가서 찾아보고 날 좀 내버려 둬! 탑 주변을 뒤져 보면 찾을 수 있을 거야.

english: You winning?
It's a draw at the moment. First it was best of three, then it was best of five.
translation: 지금은 비기고 있어. 처음엔 삼판이승이었다가, 그다음엔 오판삼승이었지.

english: And now?
Best of a hundred and one.
Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 넌... 몰라, 네가 먹고사는 그 일이 뭐든, 그걸로 사는 건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 죽이거나, 사람들 부탁으로 온 세상에 물건을 배달해요.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 출산이 아주 고통스러웠대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 굳이 알고 싶지 않은 얘기까지 고마워요!

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 알았어, [guy/lady]. 네가 누구든 상관없이 난 혼날 거라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적으로 산다는 게 실제로 뭘 하는 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탔다고요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했어요! 그 사람한테 물어봐요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 걸리지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴이네. 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 우리 배에 탄 거야?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 그래? 내 눈엔 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 안 보이는데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a- fremennik!
translation: 그럼 미안하지만 들을 시간이 없네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인 듯 프레메닉 아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 쪽은 얼마나 추운지, 말을 하면 그 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그건 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 과장했어. 그래도 엄청, 엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 같은 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 그런 말투 좀 쓰지 마. 엄청 거슬리거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지 좀 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.

translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 정말이에요! 초대받아서 온 거라고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.

Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있더라고.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.

Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.

english: Wooden fingers?

That's not possible, how could you move them?
translation: 말도 안 돼요. 그걸 어떻게 움직여요?

english: Magic wood.
Yes, well I think I'd better be going now.

english: Nope, not at all. I'd best be going. Have a nice day. Bye!
