translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탔다고요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했어요! 그 사람한테 물어봐요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 걸리지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴이네. 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 우리 배에 탄 거야?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 주겠다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 그래? 내 눈엔 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 안 보이는데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 그럼 미안하지만 들을 시간이 없네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인 듯 프레메닉 아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 쪽은 얼마나 추운지, 말을 하면 그 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그건 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 과장했어. 그래도 엄청, 엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 같은 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 그런 말투 좀 쓰지 마. 엄청 거슬리거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지 좀 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 정말이에요! 초대받아서 온 거라고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 영락없는 밀항자처럼 보인다는 건 인정해야 할걸.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있더라고.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 괜찮아. 약탈할 수 있는 grog(그로그)랑 전리품은 전부 우리 거고, 치과까지 포함한 의료 혜택도 빵빵하지.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중에 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 다 나을 때까지 안 놓아주는 거지.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 전문적인 치료에 얼마나 큰 동기 부여가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호에는 무슨 일로 탄 거야?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아가려던 참인데, 배가 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그렇지, 정말 미인이야! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호는 폭풍우가 치나 해가 쨍쨍하나 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었고, 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳에 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 멋진 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Wow, that looks pretty heavy.
Umpf! Yeah, mate...argghh...this is...umpf...hard work...
What would happen if I were to say...
translation: 제가 만약 이렇게 말하면 어떻게 될까요...

english: Stop! Stop! Humpf...I'll beat you to...urghh...a pulp!
translation: 그만! 그만! 흐읍...너 아주...으윽...곤죽을 만들어 줄 테다!

english: Okay, okay! Don't cry!
Why, I oughta...
What do you do when you're not lifting logs above your head?
translation: 머리 위로 logs(통나무)를 안 들어 올릴 땐 뭐 해요?

english: In my free time?
Yes.
All sorts. I like...hummff...a good kebab and a cold beer down...urrghh...the pub. And for those quiet evenings...hurrr...
translation: 이것저것. 난...흐읍...술집에서...으윽...맛있는 kebab(케밥)이랑 시원한 beer(맥주)를 즐기지. 그리고 조용한 저녁에는...흐으...

english: A bit of needlepoint is always welcome.
translation: 자수를 좀 놓는 것도 언제나 좋지.

english: I can honestly say you're a very original guy.
[xxxx]
Huh?
Bah
Start again!
Hi there. What is this place?
Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?
translation: 아, 여기가 바로 Tower of Life(생명의 탑)다! 아름답지 않아?

english: I prefer ordinary houses.
Pah, you have no taste.
Hello?
Hello?
Hey, I started the conversation!
No you didn't. Get out of my spell!
No! Get out of my spell!
Cry-baby.
What! I'm no cry-baby, you cry-baby!
translation: 뭐! 난 울보 아니거든, 네가 울보야!

english: I'm reporting you!
Oh, how scary!
Idiot.
Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
translation: Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 1대1 토너먼트에 관심 있으세요? 여기서는 랭크 토너먼트를 주최하고 있고, 아니면 직접 비랭크 토너먼트를 열 수도 있어요.

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?

A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
translation: 참가자들을 두 명씩 짝지어 각자 상대와 싸우게 해요. 이긴 사람들은 다음 라운드로 올라가서 다시 짝을 지어 새 상대와 싸우고요.

english: The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
translation: 매번 살아남는 사람이 절반으로 줄다가, 결국 한 사람만 남게 돼요. 그 사람이 토너먼트 우승자예요.

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: 모든 사람에게는 랭크가 있어요. 다른 사람들과 비교해서 얼마나 잘 싸우는지를 나타내는 거죠.

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
translation: 랭크전에서는 이긴 사람은 랭크가 오르고 진 사람은 랭크가 내려가요. 랭크 토너먼트마다 누가 싸울지는 경기장 직원들이 정해서 초대장을 보내 드려요.

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
translation: 하지만 그냥 가볍게 즐기고 싶으시다면, 아무도 랭크가 오르거나 내리지 않는 비랭크 토너먼트를 하시면 돼요. 비랭크 토너먼트는 직접 열고, 누가 싸울지도 직접 정할 수 있어요.

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: 경기장의 다른 보상은 랭크전에서만 받을 수 있어요.

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: 적당한 참가자가 모이기까지 시간이 좀 걸릴 수 있으니, 토너먼트가 시작되길 기다리는 동안에는 하던 모험을 계속하셔도 돼요.

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
translation: 여기 있는 제 모집 게시판에서 모집 그룹을 만드시면 돼요. 그룹을 만들고 나면 다른 참가자들이 들어오길 기다리세요.

english: Okay, goodbye.
I'm okay, thanks.
What's a 1v1 Tournament?
Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
How do I get invited into a Tournament?
I want to organise my own Tournament.
Okay, goodbye.
I'm okay, thanks.
Are you all right?
Who goes there?
Arr! A landlubber!
Begone afore I take my cutlass to ye! I've been charged with guardin' this gate and no noodle-armed landlubbers will make it past me alive!
translation: 내 커틀러스 맛을 보기 전에 썩 꺼져라! 난 이 문을 지키라는 명을 받았다. 국수 가락 같은 팔을 한 뭍놈은 하나도 살아서 못 지나간다!

english: That's not a cutlass.
I think it's a twig.
Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
translation: 이런 건방진 놈! 손가락으로 삿대질한 거다!

english: All right...
Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
translation: 아르... 몸뚱이 절반이 나무라고 해서 심장도 없는 줄 아냐.

english: I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?
translation: 심장이라면 여기 한 자루 가득 있다고. 볼래?

english: I think I'll pass.
What happened to you?
That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
translation: 그건 말이다, 너보다 훨씬 튼튼한 사내 열댓 명의 심장을 쥐어짜 낸 가슴 찢어지는 이야기다!

english: A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
translation: 돌덩이 같은 심장이 아니고서야 듣고 나서 애절한 눈물 한 방울 안 흘릴 수 없는 비통한 이야기지...

english: And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
translation: 그리고 난 절대 말 안 한다. 네가 반지 같은, 정신 조종 힘이 깃든 아이템을 끼고 와도 말이다!

english: What if I said please?
Hmmmm...well alright...
Wait, no!
Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!
translation: 뭍놈아, 이 가시 박힌 나무발로 엉덩이 걷어차이기 전에 썩 꺼져!

english: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: 흠, 너라면 이런 이야기쯤은 감당할 만한 [lad/lass] 같구나... 그럼 들려주지...

english: Well, it all starts with this albatross...
translation: 흠, 모든 건 이 앨버트로스 한 마리에서 시작됐지...

english: Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
Are you sure?
I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: 그래야 한다, [lad/lass]. 그걸 말했다간 Cap'n Donnie(도니 선장)이 얼마 안 남은 내 몸뚱이마저 껍질을 벗길 거다.

english: But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
translation: 아무튼, 난 이 앨버트로스와 얽힌 말 못 할 사건으로 다른 선원들과 함께 좀비 해적단에 끌려 들어갔지.

english: We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
translation: 우린 즐겁게 항해 중이었고, 난 망대에서 '럼'을 살짝 즐기고 있었다.

english: Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
translation: 그런데 엄청 거친 파도에 맞았는지, 아니면 바위에 부딪혔는지.

english: Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
translation: 그땐 이미 완전히 취해 있어서 뭐였는지 분간이 안 되더라고!

english: Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.
translation: 아무튼 난 망대에서 굴러떨어져 물에 빠졌다.

english: Is that how you got so badly injured?
No [lad/lass]!
What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
translation: 그다음에 난 아무도 몰랐던, 딱딱하고 뾰족한 산호로 된 새 암초를 발견했지.

english: I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
translation: 그 위치를 머릿속에 잘 새겨 뒀고, 그 암초는 지금도 우리 함대 해도에 Lukes Reef(루크 암초)라고 표시돼 있다.

english: I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
translation: 머리 위로 지나가던 우리 배, the Inebriated(만취호)를 간신히 붙잡았지.

english: And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
translation: 그런데 그다음엔 더 높고, 더 뾰족하고, 훨씬 날카롭고 아픈 산호로 된 암초를 또 발견했다.

english: To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
translation: 그 암초는 지금도 우리 함대 해도에 The Other 50% Reef(나머지 50% 암초)라고 표시돼 있지.

english: Owwwwwwwww...
It gets worse...
When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
translation: 선원들이 내 남은 몸뚱이를 갑판으로 끌어 올리더니, 날 어떻게 할지 정하는 동안 바닥에 내팽개쳐 뒀지.

english: Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
translation: 잘 생각해 봐라, 유령선이었다고. 그 배 판자에선 썩은 물이랑... 순 소금 결정이 걸쭉하게 섞인 게 배어 나온다.

english: Oh...my...god...
But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
translation: 그래도 좋은 점도 있었지. 내가 하도 몸부림치고 비명을 질러 대니 선장도 마음을 정했고, 배 목수를 시켜 자기 Witchwood Planks(마녀나무 판자)로 내 몸 절반을 깎아 만들어 줬다.

english: Witchwood? What's that?
Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
translation: 지금은 멸종한 나무에서 나는 특별한 마법 나무다.

english: Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
translation: 못으로 다 박아 고정하고 나니, 이게 꼭 내 몸의 일부처럼 움직이더라고.

english: The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!
translation: 게다가 부러져도 다시 자라난다. 아주 죽여주게 편하지!

english: Wow, that stuff must be very valuable!
Arr! That it be!
So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
translation: 자, 이게 내가 몸을 딱 50% 잃게 된 이야기다.

english: There there.
So how flammable are you?
What kind of a question is that?
A rather rude, personal one?
Ye've got that right!
I'll soon have you out of the way! Burn!
Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!
translation: 날 화나게 하지 마라! 내가 화나면 너도 좋을 거 없다!

english: Let that be a lesson to ye!
My world is an ocean of paaaain!
So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 그래서 여기서 대체 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: Ye expect me to talk?
No Mr. Luke, I expect you to die!
translation: 아뇨, Luke(루크) 씨. 당신이 죽어 주길 기대하죠!

english: Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!
translation: 하! 그건 내가 이미 한발 앞서 해 뒀지!

english: Egad, outsmarted by the man with the wooden brain.
translation: 이런, 나무 대가리한테 한 방 먹다니.

english: But seriously, what is going on here?
translation: 아니 진짜로, 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
translation: 그랬다간 선장이 날 깎아서 이쑤시개로 만들어 버릴 거다.

english: Well if you can't tell me, perhaps you could show me through the medium of Interpretive Dance?
translation: 말로 못 하겠으면, 현대 무용으로 표현해 줄 수는 있어요?

english: No. Just...no.
Mime?
Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: 이봐, [lad/lass]. 난 아무것도 말 안 한다! 그러니 아직 기회 있을 때 썩 꺼져!

english: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!
translation: 아르! 도망치려고? 흥, 날 몰래 지나갈 순 없을 거다. 난 이 선원들 중 최고의 망꾼이라고!

english: Who's that making faces behind you?
translation: 당신 뒤에서 누가 우스꽝스러운 표정 짓고 있는 거예요?

english: That is the most amazing thing I have ever seen!
translation: 와, 저렇게 놀라운 건 처음 봐요!

english: Is that your distraction?
Who is that behind you?
Hey you! Look over there!
Oh my! Is that a genuine 3rd Age Diversion?
translation: 세상에! 저거 진품 3rd Age(제3시대) 주의 끌기용품이에요?

english: Where?
Hey! What are you doing out there?
Nothing.
Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
translation: 흠, Cap'n Donnie(도니 선장)이 살아 있는 뭍놈은 아무도 이 구역 밖으로 못 나간다고 했다.

english: So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
translation: 그러니 냉큼 이리 돌아와라. 안 그러면 혼쭐날 줄 알아!

english: What happened to you?
How flammable are you?
So what is going on here anyway?
translation: 그래서 여기서 대체 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 절대 안 돼요, 짐만 싸면 바로 여기서 나갈 거예요!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 네, 많이 봐요. 다행히 거의 무슨 부상이든 감당할 수 있어요. Jaraah(자라)는 정말 훌륭한 외과의예요. 방식이 좀 별나긴 해도 확실히 고쳐 놓거든요.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 이런 말 하면 안 되는데, 그분 별명이 '도살자'예요.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Do you come here often?
Greetings traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Ok.
Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.
translation: Abbot Langley(랭글리 수도원장)이 당신 머리에 손을 얹는다. 몸이 조금 나아진 느낌이다.

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 여기는 좀 외진 곳에 지어진 것 아닌가요?

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: 사실 저희는 그게 좋습니다! 방해받을 일이 적으니까요. 그런데도 안식처와 치유를 찾아 이곳에 오는 여행자가 꽤 많답니다!

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 수도원 안쪽으로 더 들어가려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.
translation: 죄송하지만 수도원 2층에는 저희 수도회 회원만 들어갈 수 있습니다.

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 그럼 제가 수도회에 들어갈 수 있을까요?

english: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
translation: 아니요. 죄송하지만 당신은 아직 신앙심이 충분하지 않은 듯합니다.

english: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.
translation: 수도회에 들어오려면 Prayer(기도) 레벨이 31 이상이어야 합니다.

english: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.
translation: 좋습니다, 당신은 저희 수도회에 걸맞은 분이군요. 들어오셔도 좋습니다.

english: Oh, sorry.
I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
translation: 어쩌면 도와드릴 수 있겠군요... 무엇을 생각하고 계십니까?

english: Can you remove the sigils from my spirit shields?
translation: 제 spirit shield(영혼 방패)에서 sigil(인장)을 떼어 내 주실 수 있나요?

english: I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
translation: 그 정도는 할 수 있을 것 같습니다. 다만 그러려면 축복받은 방패 자체는 부숴야 하니, 돌려받으시는 건 인장뿐입니다.

english: I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
translation: 원하신다면 지금 소지품에 있는 방패를 전부 분해해 드릴 수 있습니다.

english: Not right now.
Only members of our order can go up there.
translation: 저 위에는 저희 수도회 회원만 올라갈 수 있습니다.

english: Oh, sorry.
Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
translation: 아, 당신이 오실 거라고 들었습니다. 감사의 뜻으로 이것을 받아 주십시오!

english: Congratulations, traveller!
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 저, 드릴 것이 있는데 당신 소지품에 자리가 없군요!

english: Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: clue scroll(단서 두루마리)의 찢어진 조각을 건네받았다.

english: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.
translation: 솔직히 말씀드리자면, 당신이 골라 입은 장비가 몹시 못마땅합니다.

english: I've got a message for you from your friend in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 있는 친구분이 보낸 메시지를 가져왔어요.

english: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!
translation: 이런, 이 외딴 수도원까지 메시지를 전해 주시다니 참으로 친절하시군요!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 보답을 드리고 싶지만 소지품에 자리가 없어 보이는군요. 자리가 생기면 다시 오십시오.

english: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 제 작은 양배추 밭에서 약초를 조금 기르고 있습니다. 감사의 표시로 좀 받아 주십시오.

english: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 여기는 좀 외진 곳에 지어진 것 아닌가요?

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 수도원 안쪽으로 더 들어가려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: 그럼 제가 수도회에 들어갈 수 있을까요?

english: Can you help with spirit shields?
translation: spirit shield(영혼 방패) 일로 도와주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes.
No.
Herbs
Coins
Runes
Seeds
Prayer experience
Grr ... Get out of my way...
What can I help you with, dear?
Who are you and what are you doing?
I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
translation: 난 Morytania(모리타니아)에서 온 Abigaila(아비가일라)예요. 거긴 끔찍한 곳이에요. 뱀파이어들이 다스리는데, 마을마다 찾아와서 사람들 피를 먹이로 거둬 가요!

english: I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
translation: 아들 Suro(수로)와 함께 Misthalin(미스탈린)에서 더 나은 삶을 살려고 몇 년 동안 탈출하려 애썼죠. 돈을 겨우 긁어모아 뱃사공을 매수해서 빠져나올 수 있었어요.

english: The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
translation: 가는 길은 험했어요. 분홍 두건을 쓴 남자들이 우리 배를 공격하면서, 너희가 있던 곳으로 돌아가라고, 자기네 나라에 들어오지 말라고 소리쳤어요. 실랑이 끝에 배가 뒤집혔죠.

english: It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
translation: 어두웠고, 물속에서 Suro(수로)를 찾을 수가 없었어요. 폐가 터질 것 같을 때까지 최대한 깊이 헤엄쳐 들어갔지만 끝내 못 찾았어요. 그 애는 헤엄을 잘 못 쳤거든요.

english: Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
translation: 결국 난 겨우 물가까지 나왔어요. 해가 뜨고 있었는데, 거기서 Suro(수로)를 찾았어요. 물살이 그 애의... 시신을 내던져 놓은 물가에서요.

english: *sob*
I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
translation: Misthalin(미스탈린)에서는 그럭저럭 잘 지낸 것 같아요. 마법을 조금 아는데, 이 지역 귀족들이 내 점술 솜씨에 돈을 잘 쳐줘요. Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지) 거래로 이윤을 남기는 데도 꽤 소질이 있고요.

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: 아무튼 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 방 한 칸을 빌리고 먹을 것도 살 수 있어요. 누구에게도 짐이 되지 않고, 내 피를 노리고 찾아오는 뱀파이어도 없죠.

english: I am free!
But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
translation: 하지만 동쪽에 있는 우리 사람들을 잊은 건 아니에요. 거기엔 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)이라는 곳을 운영하는 뱀파이어가 하나 있는데, 자기 경기장에서 인간들에게 괴물과 맞서 보라고 도전장을 내밀죠.

english: My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
translation: 내 남편도 그 경기장에서 살아남아 피 징수꾼들에게서 자유를 얻겠다고 거기 갔는데, 끝내 돌아오지 못했어요. 돌아온 사람은 아무도 없어요.

english: So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.
translation: 그래서 요즘은 남는 시간에 점술로 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)을 들여다보면서 거기 있는 모험가들을 지켜봐요. 원하면 한번 봐도 돼요.

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
I'm afraid I can't let you use my scrying ball now, dear. Clear out everything you're carrying, and make sure you're not sick or poisoned.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 내 점술 구슬을 쓰게 해 줄 수 없어요, 젊은이. 가진 걸 전부 비우고, 병에 걸리거나 중독된 상태가 아닌지 확인하고 와요.

english: I'll leave you be.
Who are you and what are you doing?
I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
Observe a specific party
Observe recent party
Cancel
I'll leave you be.
Help! Help!
What has happened here?
We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: 여기서 멀지 않은 섬의 저택 파티에 초대받았어요... 뭔가 다 이상하다는 느낌이 들었는데도 그냥 갔어요...

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: 저택은 꽤 으스스했지만, 다 순조로웠고 모두 즐겁게 지내고 있었어요...

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
I... I tried to save her...
Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: Hewey(휴이)가 시간을 벌어 준 덕분에 낡은 배를 찾을 수 있었어요. 그를 데리러 돌아갔지만 너무 늦었어요. 그가 살아남지 못할까 봐 무서워요.

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: 뭐라도 해 주셔야 해요... 그놈들이 이대로 빠져나가게 둘 순 없어요!

english: What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved in this!
That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: 그 미치광이가 아직 밖에 있어요. 당신이 꼭 심판을 받게 해 줘야 해요.

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: 우리가 타고 도망친 배가 바로 저기 있어요. 그걸 타면 섬까지 갈 수 있어요.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 알았어요, 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.
translation: 제발, 그놈이 이대로 빠져나가지 못하게 해 주세요! 저기 있는 배를 타면 우리가 도망쳐 나온 섬까지 갈 수 있어요.

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 네가 꾸민 게임에서 네가 진 거야. 이제 그 가면 밑에 누가 있는지 볼 차례다!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 플레이어가 살인마의 가면을 벗기자, 범인은 Abigale(애비게일)이었다.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 안 돼! 너였어!? 대체 왜!? 도대체 왜 친구들을 전부 죽인 거야!? 왜 나한테 와서 그들을 도와 달라고 빌었던 거야!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 잘난 척은. 모든 게 늘 너 중심인 게 익숙하지. 네가 세상을 구하는 게.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 모험가들! 너희는 다 똑같아. 모든 게 언제나 너희 중심이어야 하지.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 그렇겠지! 넌 너 자신밖에 못 보니까!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 믿기 힘들겠지만... 나도 예전엔 너 같았어.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 곤경에 빠진 아가씨 소식을 들으면 도우러 갔지. 나만의 순간을 갖기 위해서. 딱 한 번만이라도 내가 영웅이 되려고.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 그런데 너! 너랑 다른 망할 모험가들 전부! 내가 도우러 갈 때마다 늘 이미 늦어 있었어. 위기는 해결됐고, 재앙은 막아졌고, 보상은 챙겨 갔지. 매번 너랑 다른 모험가들이 내 순간을 훔쳐 갔다고!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 이번엔 전부 나에 관한 거야! 내가 이 쇼의 주인공이라고! 나 나 나 나 나!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 글쎄, 그것도 이제 끝이야. 쇼는 막을 내렸고, 커튼콜은 없어.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 문 근처 벽장에서 또 다른 살인마가 나온다.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 당연하지. 좋은 쇼에는 좋은 조연이 필요한 법이거든. 자, 가면을 벗어, 자기. 인사해. 그럴 자격 있잖아.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 살인마가 스스로 가면을 벗자, 범인은 Hewey(휴이)였다.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 너였어!? 어떻게!? 내가 봤을 땐 거의 죽어 가고 있었잖아! 상처까지 봤다고!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 아니, 네가 본 건 우리가 보여 주고 싶었던 것뿐이야. 내가 말하긴 좀 그렇지만, 완벽한 연기였지.

english: But what is in this for you?
Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 누구나 스포트라이트를 좋아하지. 그걸 함께 나눌 상대로 내 사랑 Abigale(애비게일)보다 나은 사람이 어디 있겠어.

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 그랬을지도 모르지. 하지만 스포트라이트를 받아 마땅한 내가 다시 그늘 속으로 밀려날 이유도 없었어!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)는 오늘 밤과 내가 여기서 한 일을 영원히 기억할 거야.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 조용히 해, Hewey(휴이)! 지금은 내 순간이야!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 아니, 이건 우리의 순간이어야 해! 너만을 위한 것도 아니라고! 우린 함께 이 일을 했잖아!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 망치지 마, Hewey(휴이)! 이걸 위해 얼마나 애썼는데, 네가 빼앗아 가게 두지 않을 거야!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 나도 밀려나진 않을 거야. 우린 둘 다 동등하게 이 일을 했어!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 우린 한 번도 동등했던 적 없어! 네가 어떻게 감히 나랑 비교가 돼!?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
translation: 안 돼.... 안 돼... 내가 무슨 짓을 한 거야!?

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 이렇게 될 게 아니었는데... 네가 내 순간을 끝까지 허락하지 않았잖아. 왜, Hewey(휴이), 왜!? 사랑했는데...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
The player stabs Abigale.
Well thank Saradomin that's over! I should get out of here.
You'll never escape me!
In the background, Mandy gets up.
You dare try and ruin my moment!
Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: Mandy(맨디)가 탁자 위의 Bandos godsword(반도스 갓소드)를 향해 걸어간다.

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: Mandy(맨디)가 반도스 갓소드를 집어 들고 벽장으로 들어간다.

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
You're not killing anyone else!
Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
translation: Mandy(맨디)가 Abigale(애비게일)에게 검의 특수 공격을 사용한다.

english: No....this can't be it....
translation: 안 돼.... 이렇게 끝날 순 없어....

english: Abigale dies.
Wow, that was close!
Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
translation: Mandy(맨디), 어떻게 살아 있는 거예요!? 심장을 찔리는 걸 봤는데요!

english: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
translation: 찔리긴 했죠. 그런데 전 Dextrocardia(우심증)이라는 희귀한 증상을 갖고 태어났거든요.

english: Dextrowhat?
Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
translation: 우심증이요. 심장이 대부분의 사람들처럼 왼쪽이 아니라 가슴 오른쪽에 있다는 뜻이에요.

english: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
translation: 그러니까 살인마는 심장을 찔렀다고 생각했지만, 사실은 빗나간 거군요?

english: Well, missed the heart yes.
I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
translation: 그래도 찔린 건 찔린 거라서, 사실 지금 꽤 어지러워요...

english: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
translation: 아, 네, 맞다! 얼른 가서 치료받으세요!

english: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
translation: 이 찔린 상처를 치료하고 나서 저택 밖에서 기다릴게요. 거기서 저랑 얘기해요.

english: What has happened here?
What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved.
[House owner] killed an abyssal demon! Cool!
translation: [House owner] 님이 abyssal demon(심연의 악마)를 잡았네요! 멋지네요!

english: Cool for [him/her] maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: [him/her]한테나 멋지겠지. 너라면 벽에 박혀 있는 게 좋겠냐?

english: Have you considered visitingTHE ABYSS?
translation: THE ABYSS(심연)에 가 볼 생각은 해 봤나?

english: I visit the abyss all the time!
I bet you just rush through it though. Everyone there is in such a rush. No one stops to appreciate the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 어차피 서둘러 지나가기만 하겠지. 거기 있는 놈들은 다들 그렇게 바쁘더군. 아무도 멈춰 서서 THE ABYSS(심연)의 아름다움을 음미하지 않아.

english: I have to run through it quickly or I'll die!
Death is a small thing compared to the beauty ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: THE ABYSS(심연)의 아름다움에 비하면 죽음 따위는 사소한 거다.

english: The abyss looks pretty ugly to me.
Poor deluded fool. There is no hope for you at all.
translation: 가엾고 어리석은 놈. 너한테는 아무런 희망이 없구나.

english: It's too scary for me!
But does not the fear contribute to your appreciation ofTHE ABYSS?
translation: 하지만 그 공포야말로 THE ABYSS(심연)을 음미하는 데 한몫하는 것 아니겠느냐?

english: No, it's just scary.
Poor human. You must not judgeTHE ABYSSby the standards of this world. You must learn to embrace your fear as part of the experience ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 가엾은 인간이여. THE ABYSS(심연)을 이 세상의 잣대로 판단해선 안 된다. 공포를 심연 체험의 일부로 받아들이는 법을 배워야 해.

english: I suppose fear does heighten the senses.
translation: 공포가 감각을 날카롭게 해 주긴 하죠.

english: Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go toTHE ABYSSyou should take all your most valuable items with you.
translation: 그렇다면 판돈을 올려 감각을 더 끌어올려야지. 다음에 THE ABYSS(심연)에 갈 때는 가장 귀한 물건을 전부 챙겨 가거라.

english: Could I get an abyssal whip?
translation: abyssal whip(심연의 채찍)을 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: You must take all your gold and all your most valued items, and take them intoTHE ABYSSwithout weapons or armour.
translation: 골드와 가장 아끼는 물건을 전부 챙기고, 무기도 갑옷도 없이 THE ABYSS(심연)으로 들어가거라.

english: And then will I get an abyssal whip?
translation: 그럼 심연의 채찍을 얻을 수 있는 거예요?

english: You'll get anABYSSAL WHIPPING!
That pun was abyssmal.
I visit the abyss all the time
I have to run through quickly or I'll die
The abyss looks pretty ugly to me
It's too scary for me
No, it's just scary
I suppose fear does heighten the senses
translation: 공포가 감각을 날카롭게 해 주긴 하죠

english: Could I get an abyssal whip?
translation: abyssal whip(심연의 채찍)을 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: You killed my father.
Yeah, don't take it personally.
translation: 응, 너무 마음에 담아 두지 마.

english: In his dying moment, my father poured his last ounce of strength into my creation. My being is formed from his remains.
translation: 아버지는 숨을 거두는 순간, 마지막 남은 힘을 쏟아 나를 만들었다. 내 존재는 아버지의 잔해로 빚어졌다.

english: When your own body is consumed to nourish the Nexus, and an army of scions arises from your corpse, I trust you will not take it personally either.
translation: 언젠가 네 몸이 Nexus(넥서스)의 양분으로 삼켜지고 네 시체에서 후예의 군대가 일어날 때, 너 역시 마음에 담아 두지 않으리라 믿는다.

english: No, I am your father.
No, you are not.
*chitter*
Krsss!
Scscs!
Sgss!
Yeah, don't take it personally.
translation: 응, 너무 마음에 담아 두지 마.

english: No, I am your father.
Do you know what happens when you stare into the Abyss?
What?
It stares back!
Right...
We don't spend enough time in the Abyss!
translation: 우린 Abyss(심연)에서 보내는 시간이 너무 적어!

english: Well how much time do you think we should be spending there?
translation: 그럼 거기서 얼마나 시간을 보내야 한다고 생각하는데?

english: All the time! Eternal time in the eternal Abyss!
Yeah... I don't think that's going to work.
translation: 그래... 그건 좀 무리일 것 같아.

english: *chitter*
Krsss!
Scscs!
Sgss!
Hello there.
Nilsal! Welcome to the Grand Museum.
translation: Nilsal(닐살)! Grand Museum(대박물관)에 오신 걸 환영해요.

english: Hello there! Hope you're enjoying the museum.
Sorry, I'd love to stop and talk, but I have some studying to do.
translation: 죄송해요, 저도 이야기 나누고 싶지만 공부할 게 좀 있어서요.

english: Have you seen the new Old One display? Fascinating stuff!
translation: 새로 생긴 Old One(고대의 존재) 전시 보셨어요? 정말 흥미로워요!

english: Isn't this place wonderful? There's just so much knowledge to be found!
translation: 여기 정말 멋지지 않아요? 알아낼 지식이 정말 끝도 없어요!

english: Hello. Who are you?
I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
translation: 저는 Account Guide(계정 안내원)예요. 계정에 대해 알려 드리려고 여기 있어요.

english: What's an account?
Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
translation: 당신의 캐릭터가 바로 계정이에요! 지금 게임을 하는 데 쓰고 있는 그거요. 여기 있는 모두가 하나씩 갖고 있고, 여러 개를 가진 사람도 있어요!

english: There’s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let’s take a look at it now.
translation: 계정으로 할 수 있는 일이 여러 가지 있는데, 그럴 때 계정 관리 메뉴를 쓰면 돼요. 지금 한번 살펴볼까요?

english: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: 보시다시피 계정으로 할 수 있는 일이 몇 가지 있어요.

english: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
translation: 먼저 멤버십이 있어요. 모든 계정은 기본적으로 무료로 플레이할 수 있지만, 원하면 멤버십을 구매해서 멤버 월드를 열 수 있어요. 멤버 월드에서는 추가 스킬, 지역, 퀘스트 등을 즐길 수 있어요!

english: What's a world?

A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
translation: 월드는 게임을 플레이하는 곳이에요. 대부분의 월드에는 최대 2000명이 들어갈 수 있어요. 크게 무료 월드와 멤버 월드 두 종류로 나뉘고, 로그아웃 메뉴의 월드 전환기로 월드를 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members’ world and enjoy all of the benefits, you’ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 지금은 무료 월드에 있어요. 멤버 월드로 옮겨서 모든 혜택을 누리고 싶다면 멤버십을 구매해야 해요. 계정 관리 메뉴의 상점에서 살 수 있어요.

english: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
translation: 지금은 멤버 월드에 있으니 멤버가 누릴 수 있는 건 이미 다 이용할 수 있어요. 즐기세요!

english: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
translation: Bonds(본드)도 알아 두면 좋아요. 계정 관리 메뉴의 상점에서 본드를 살 수 있고, 본드가 생기면 멤버십으로 바꿀 수 있어요!

english: But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
translation: 그냥 멤버십을 사면 되는데 왜 Bond(본드)를 써야 하죠?

english: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
translation: 멤버십과 달리 Bonds(본드)는 다른 플레이어와 거래할 수 있어요. 본드를 사서 다른 플레이어에게 골드를 받고 팔 수도 있고, 반대로 골드로 다른 플레이어에게서 본드를 살 수도 있죠!

english: So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
translation: 그럼 제 골드로 다른 플레이어에게서 Bond(본드)를 사면, 현금을 한 푼도 안 쓰고 멤버십을 얻을 수 있다는 거예요?

english: Exactly!
Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you’ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 다음은 받은편지함과 이름 변경이에요. 받은편지함으로는 계정과 게임에 관련된 중요한 소식이 와요. 꼭 자주 확인하세요.

english: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
translation: 이름 변경으로는 지금 표시 이름이 마음에 들지 않을 때 바꿀 수 있어요. 다만 멤버십이 있는 계정만 쓸 수 있다는 점은 알아 두세요.

english: Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
translation: 마지막으로 메뉴 아래쪽에 쓸모 있는 링크가 몇 개 있어요. 언젠가 꼭 한번 둘러보세요.

english: Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
translation: 좋네요. 계정에 대해 더 알아야 할 게 있나요?

english: Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
translation: 계정은 아주 소중하니까 잘 지키는 게 중요해요. 은행 PIN이나 2단계 인증 같은 여러 도구가 도움이 될 거예요.

english: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: 계정 보안에 대한 자세한 내용은 고객 지원 웹페이지에서 볼 수 있어요. 계정 관리 메뉴의 유용한 링크 항목에서 바로 갈 수 있어요.

english: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
translation: 어쨌든 계정에 대해 알려 드릴 건 이게 전부예요. 다시 듣고 싶으면 말씀하시고, 아니면 다음 교관에게 가 보세요.

english: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
translation: 안녕하세요. 계정 이야기를 다시 들어 볼래요?

english: Yes!
Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: 좋아요. 계정으로 할 수 있는 일이 몇 가지 있어요.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: 지금은 무료 월드에 있어요. 멤버 월드로 옮겨서 모든 혜택을 누리고 싶다면 멤버십을 구매해야 해요. 계정 관리 메뉴의 상점에서 살 수 있어요.

english: Next up, you have your inbox. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 다음은 받은편지함이에요. 받은편지함으로는 계정과 게임에 관련된 중요한 소식이 와요. 꼭 자주 확인하세요.

english: Finally, you have your display name. Every account has a unique display name. If you don't like your current one, you can change it with the name changer.
translation: 마지막으로 표시 이름이 있어요. 모든 계정에는 저마다 다른 표시 이름이 있어요. 지금 이름이 마음에 들지 않으면 이름 변경으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: Anyway, that's everything. I hope that has helped you out.
translation: 어쨌든 이게 전부예요. 도움이 됐길 바라요.

english: Yes!
No thanks.
Hello there.
Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
translation: 어서 와요, 모험가님. 저는 Gordon(고든), 계정 보안 교사예요. 계정 보안에 관한 거라면 뭐든 도와드릴 수 있어요. 궁금한 게 있나요?

english: How can I keep my account secure?
translation: 제 계정을 안전하게 지키려면 어떻게 해야 하죠?

english: There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
translation: 계정 보안을 강화하는 방법은 여러 가지가 있어요. 어떤 걸 더 들어 보고 싶나요?

english: Tell me about passwords.
Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
translation: 비밀번호는 계정을 안전하게 지키는 첫 번째 방어선이에요.

english: When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
translation: 비밀번호를 정할 때는 남들과 겹치지 않게 만들어야 해요. 글자와 숫자를 섞어 쓰면 되죠. 비밀번호 중간에 숫자를 넣어도 좋아요.

english: For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
translation: 보안을 더 강화하려면 계정과 이메일에 서로 다른 비밀번호를 써야 해요.

english: You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
translation: 비밀번호는 안전하게 보관하고 아무에게도 알려 주지 마세요. 친구나 가족에게도요.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
Tell me about securing my email.
Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
translation: 이메일 계정에는 따로 비밀번호를 쓰세요. 그러면 보안이 강해져서 해커가 계정을 훔쳐 가기 어려워져요.

english: You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
translation: 이메일이 지원한다면 이메일 계정에 2단계 인증도 켜 두세요.

english: This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
translation: 이메일 제공 업체에서 제공하는 인증 앱으로 할 수도 있고, 휴대폰 번호로 할 수도 있어요.

english: The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
translation: 인증 방식은 제공 업체마다 다르지만, 켜 두기만 하면 해커가 계정에 접근하기 어려워요. 그리고 백업 코드를 받았다면 안전하게 보관하세요.

english: Tell me about the authenticator.
The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
translation: RuneScape(룬스케이프) 인증기는 계정을 훔치려는 해커로부터 계정을 지켜 주는 보안 장치를 한 겹 더해 줘요.

english: As well as requiring a password to enter your account, you will also need a randomly generated number from the authenticator app to login.
translation: 계정에 들어갈 때 비밀번호뿐 아니라 인증 앱에서 무작위로 만들어진 숫자도 입력해야 로그인할 수 있어요.

english: You can enable the authenticator by checking your account page on the official RuneScape website.
translation: 인증기는 RuneScape(룬스케이프) 공식 웹사이트의 계정 페이지에서 켤 수 있어요.

english: If you like, I can take you to a useful web page about the RuneScape authenticator.
translation: 원한다면 RuneScape(룬스케이프) 인증기에 관한 유용한 웹 페이지로 안내해 드릴게요.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about securing my bank.
If someone does get into your account, you should make sure your bank is secure.
translation: 누군가 계정에 들어오더라도 은행만큼은 안전하게 지켜야 해요.

english: To keep your bank secure, you should make sure to set a bank pin. A bank pin is a 4 digit code you will need to put in to access your bank.
translation: 은행을 안전하게 지키려면 은행 PIN을 설정하세요. 은행 PIN은 은행을 이용할 때 입력해야 하는 4자리 코드예요.

english: It seems I don't have one setup. How do I gotabout setting up a bank pin?
translation: 저는 아직 설정을 안 한 것 같네요. 은행 PIN은 어떻게 설정하나요?

english: To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
translation: 은행 PIN을 설정하려면 banker(은행원)이 있는 은행에 가서, 은행원에게 은행 PIN 설정에 대해 물어보면 돼요.

english: After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.
translation: 은행 PIN을 설정한 뒤에는 PIN이 적용될 때까지 며칠 기다려야 해요.

english: Thanks, I should go speak to a banker right away.
Good thing I already have one set.
Good on you [lad/lass]! Great work.
Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: Stronghold of Security(보안 요새)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: The Stronghold of Security can be found in the Barbarian Village, west of Varrock.
translation: Stronghold of Security(보안 요새)는 Varrock(바록) 서쪽의 Barbarian Village(야만인 마을)에 있어요.

english: Here you will be tested on your knowledge of account security. You will need to make your way to the bottom floor while answering question on account security and fighting monsters.
translation: 그곳에서는 계정 보안 지식을 시험받게 돼요. 계정 보안 문제에 답하고 몬스터와 싸우면서 맨 아래층까지 내려가야 하죠.

english: Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
translation: 조심하세요. 요새 깊이 내려갈수록 몬스터가 강해져요. 그러니 가장 좋은 장비와 음식을 꼭 챙겨 가세요.

english: If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
translation: 각 층의 끝까지 가는 데 성공하면 상자를 열어 전리품을 얻을 수 있어요. 단, 층마다 한 번씩만이에요.

english: If you decide to kill the monsters, you might find they drop some skull sceptre pieces.
translation: 몬스터를 처치하다 보면 skull sceptre(해골 셉터) 조각을 떨어뜨리기도 해요.

english: Interesting, thanks for the information.
Can I have a Security book?
translation: Security book(보안 수칙서)를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Sure thing, here you go.
The Account security tutor hands you a Security book.
translation: Account security tutor(계정 보안 교사)가 Security book(보안 수칙서)를 건넨다.

english: Use it well.
You already have one, maybe you should read that one instead.
translation: 이미 하나 가지고 있네요. 그걸 먼저 읽어 보는 게 어때요?

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
translation: 우리 어디서 본 적 있지 않나요?

english: Ah, you're probably talking about my twin brother who works at the Port Sarim prison.
translation: 아, 아마 Port Sarim(포트 사림) 감옥에서 일하는 제 쌍둥이 형을 말하는 걸 거예요.

english: He spends all his time giving out security books when he could tell you about security instead.
translation: 형은 보안에 대해 설명해 줄 수도 있는데 맨날 security books(보안 수칙서)만 나눠 준다니까요.

english: But don't you give out security books too?
translation: 그런데 당신도 보안 수칙서를 나눠 주잖아요?

english: Well yes, but at least I tell you about account security as well.
translation: 뭐, 그렇긴 하죠. 하지만 저는 최소한 계정 보안에 대해 설명도 해 드리잖아요.

english: That's true. Maybe I shouldn't be too quick to judge.
translation: 그건 그렇네요. 너무 섣불리 판단하면 안 되겠어요.

english: No, thank you.
Come back any time you need any more information on account security.
translation: 계정 보안에 대해 더 알고 싶은 게 생기면 언제든 다시 찾아오세요.

english: How can I keep my account secure?
translation: 제 계정을 안전하게 지키려면 어떻게 해야 하죠?

english: Tell me about passwords.
Tell me about securing my email.
Tell me about the authenticator.
Take me to the web page.
No thanks.
Tell me about securing my bank.
Tell me about the Stronghold of Security.
translation: Stronghold of Security(보안 요새)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Can I have a Security book?
translation: Security book(보안 수칙서)를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Don't I know you from somewhere?
translation: 우리 어디서 본 적 있지 않나요?

english: No, thank you.
Greetings. Welcome to the Heroes' Guild.
translation: 안녕하십니까. Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Only the greatest heroes of this land may gain entrance to this guild.
translation: 이 땅에서 가장 위대한 영웅만이 이 길드에 들어올 수 있습니다.

english: I'm a hero - may I apply to join?
translation: 저도 영웅인데, 가입 신청을 해도 될까요?

english: You're a hero? I've never heard of YOU. You are required to possess at least 55 quest points to file an application.
translation: 당신이 영웅이라고요? 당신 이름은 들어 본 적도 없습니다만. 신청서를 내려면 퀘스트 점수가 최소 55점은 있어야 합니다.

english: Additionally you must have completed the Shield of Arrav, Lost City, Merlin's Crystal and Dragon Slayer I quests.
translation: 게다가 Shield of Arrav(아라브의 방패), Lost City(잃어버린 도시), Merlin's Crystal(멀린의 수정), Dragon Slayer I(드래곤 슬레이어 I) 퀘스트도 완료해야 합니다.

english: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.
translation: 이 땅 최고의 영웅들에게 딱 어울리는 곳이네요.

english: Yes. Yes it is.
How goes thy quest adventurer?
I have all the required items.
I see that you have. Well done; Now, to complete the quest, and gain entry to the Heroes' Guild in your final task all that you have to do is...
translation: 그렇군요. 잘하셨습니다. 이제 퀘스트를 완료하고 Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드)에 들어오기 위한 마지막 과제로 당신이 해야 할 일은...

english: W-what? What do you mean? There's MORE???
translation: 뭐, 뭐라고요? 무슨 말이에요? 아직 더 남았어요???

english: I'm sorry, I was just having a little fun with you. Just a little Heroes' Guild humour there. What I really meant was
translation: 미안합니다, 잠깐 장난 좀 쳐 봤습니다. Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드)식 유머랄까요. 사실 제가 하려던 말은

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Heroes' Guild entry requirements! You will find the door now open for you! Enter, Hero! And take this reward!
translation: 축하합니다! Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드) 입회 조건을 모두 충족했습니다! 이제 문이 열려 있을 겁니다! 들어오십시오, 영웅이여! 그리고 이 보상을 받으십시오!

english: I'm a hero, may I apply to join?
translation: 저도 영웅인데, 가입 신청을 해도 될까요?

english: Good for the foremost heroes of the land.
translation: 이 땅 최고의 영웅들에게 딱 어울리는 곳이네요.

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Vannaka under Edgeville to assign you a task?
translation: 당신은 사실 아주 강한걸요. Edgeville(에지빌) 지하에 있는 Vannaka(바나카)한테 임무를 받는 게 낫지 않겠어요?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.
translation: 아, 그럼 Vannaka(바나카)에게 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어요! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 와요.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [task monster] 사냥이 끝나지 않았네요. [amount]마리 남았어요. 임무를 끝내면 다시 오세요.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신에게 맞지 않는 것 같네요. 취소해 줄까요? 연속 임무 기록은 사라지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 다양하게 팔고 있어요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기 좀 해요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 거예요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하니까, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 거예요.

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
Indeed I am. It's been a while since he last asked me to step in, but it's good to get out and see the sights, to meet mortals and to generally socialise.
translation: 그렇답니다. 그가 마지막으로 대신 맡아 달라고 한 지 꽤 됐지만, 밖에 나와서 구경도 하고, 필멸자들도 만나고, 이런저런 사람들과 어울리니 좋네요.

english: So do you know Mazchna well?
Oh, yes, he's such a mine of information. He hears what's going on at the pub, listens to the gossip of passing adventurers, and now he's off on a great adventure himself.
translation: 그럼요, 그는 정말 걸어 다니는 정보통이에요. 술집에서 오가는 소식을 듣고, 지나가는 모험가들의 소문에 귀 기울이더니, 이제는 자기가 직접 대모험을 떠났죠.

english: Though, of course, you know that already. Sorry to babble on. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.
translation: 아, 물론 이미 알고 있겠죠. 수다를 떨어서 미안해요. 할 일이 산더미일 텐데요.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Vannaka.
translation: 아, 그럼 Vannaka(바나카)에게 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기 좀 해요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: So you're filling in for Mazchna?
Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Don't mind me, but if you're looking for something to do, this man here needs a hand.
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요. 그런데 할 일을 찾고 있다면, 여기 이 남자가 도움이 필요하대요.

english: You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we're part of something bigger than ourselves.
translation: 솔직히 처음엔 들어올지 말지 잘 몰랐어요. 그런데 친구가 설득했죠. 여기서 우리는 우리 자신보다 더 큰 무언가의 일부가 되거든요.

english: Who do you worship?
I've never been one for proper worship, but I believe in the teachings of Ralos and Ranul. I hope those teachings guide me through whatever is to come.
translation: 제대로 신을 섬기는 편은 아니었지만, Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)의 가르침은 믿어요. 앞으로 무슨 일이 닥치든 그 가르침이 저를 이끌어 주길 바라요.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but the Twilight Emissaries have embraced it, so I have as well.
translation: 다들 Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)은 피할 수 없다고 해요. 우리가 벗어날 수 없는 종말이래요. 무서운 생각이지만, Twilight Emissaries(황혼의 사절단)이 받아들였으니 저도 받아들였어요.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 반갑소, 친구! 나는 악을 처단하고 놈들의 전리품을 챙기고 싶소! 나를 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 데려다 주시오!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 거기 있는 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 됐나요?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 그런 것 같소? 적어도 내 가슴은 용기를 알고 있으니, 당분간은 그거면 충분할 거요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 쓸 만한 보급품을 살 수 있을 거라 생각하오.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 그런데 Morytania(모리타니아)의 vampyres(뱀파이어)는 은이 아니면 아무것도 통하지 않는다는 건 알아요?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 어... 그런 얘기는 들어 본 적 없소만, Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 알맞은 무기를 마련해 주시리라 믿소.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 당신이 놈들을 피하게 도와줄 거라 믿소. 당신은 길잡이잖소, 안 그렇소? 어쨌든 당신은 제 몸 하나는 지킬 줄 아는 사람처럼 보이오. 그런 괴물과 싸워서 이겨 본 적도 있겠구려? 그게 어려워 봐야 얼마나 어렵겠소?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 사실 꽤 어려울 수 있어요. 그래도 맞는 말이에요. 제가 길잡이니까 상황은 제가 감당할 수 있을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 왜 가려는 거예요?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 거기 가서 뱀파이어 놈들에게 본때를 보여 주려고 하오. 그곳 사정이 끔찍하다고 들었는데, 내가 그걸 끝장낼 생각이오.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있겠어요?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 이 정도만 말해 두겠소. 나는 경험이 꽤 있는 편이고, 내 몫의 적은 기꺼이 상대할 거요. 그건 걱정 마시오.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴게요.

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 녀석이 있는 것 같구려. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 모르겠소. 그 녀석을 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발합시다.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 오, 정말이오? 그거 잘됐소! 목적지에 도착하면 작게나마 보상을 드리리다.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott Ramble(버그 드 로트 원정) 시작

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 나한테 보급품을 주겠다는 거요? 배낭 좀 열어 보겠소.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 여긴 좀 음침하구려. 사람들이 어떻게 여기서 사는 거요?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 자주 오시오? 길을 잘 아는 것 같구려.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 언제 도착하는 거요?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 온종일 서서 수다나 떨 시간은 없소. 어서 갑시다. 챙길 전리품이 있단 말이오.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 아, 이 여정은 정말 싫지만, 우리 같은 모험가들에게 억지로 주어지는 호화로운 생활보다는 낫소. 진흙탕에 눈까지 푹 빠져서 한바탕 싸우는 게 훨씬 좋소!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런 세상에! 아무래도 Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야겠소. 저 다리는 못 건너겠소!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 이거 망했구려... 이 늪은 못 건널 것 같소. Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야겠소.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
translation: 이야... 대단하오... 정말 잘했소... 당신을 따라가겠소.

english: Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와하! 끝내줬소! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 하오.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런 세상에! 저 괴물 좀 보시오! 저건 당신 혼자 처리해야겠소!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 무사히 데려다 줘서 정말 고맙소. 여기 보상이오.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 거기 있는 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 됐나요?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 왜 가려는 거예요?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있겠어요...?

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴게요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello [player name], what can I do for you?
What are Adventure Paths?
A long time ago, I was a newbie just like you who didn't know what to do and I would be more than happy to pass on my experience.
translation: 오래전에는 저도 당신처럼 뭘 해야 할지 모르는 초보였어요. 그래서 제 경험을 기꺼이 전해 드리고 싶어요.

english: I've created some Adventure Paths which I recommend you to start off with. An Adventure Path is a list of tasks which you can complete in any order.
translation: 처음 시작할 때 추천하는 모험의 길을 몇 가지 만들어 뒀어요. 모험의 길은 원하는 순서대로 완료할 수 있는 과제 목록이에요.

english: To help you get started on your Adventure Path, I'll also give you a starter kit with some useful items.
translation: 모험의 길을 시작하는 데 도움이 되도록 유용한 아이템이 든 시작 키트도 드릴게요.

english: Once you've completed an Adventure Path task, come back to me and I'll give you a reward.
translation: 모험의 길 과제를 완료하면 저에게 다시 오세요. 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 저한테 줄 모험의 길 시작 키트가 있나요?

english: Adventurer Jon gives you a Combat path starter kit
translation: Adventurer Jon(모험가 존)이 Combat path starter kit(전투의 길 시작 키트)를 건넨다

english: Here are all of the starter kits you have left to claim.
translation: 아직 받지 않은 시작 키트는 이게 전부예요.

english: You seem to have already claimed all of your starter kits.
translation: 이미 시작 키트를 전부 받은 것 같네요.

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
I have no rewards to give you at the moment.
I have no rewards to give you at the moment. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 지금은 드릴 보상이 없어요. 하지만 멤버 보상이 아직 남아 있으니, 멤버 월드에서 저를 찾아오면 받을 수 있어요.

english: You should make sure you have space before asking for rewards.
translation: 보상을 받기 전에 공간이 있는지 확인하세요.

english: That is the last of the rewards you have currently earned. But I do have some members rewards left to give you, visit me on a members world to receive them.
translation: 지금까지 얻은 보상은 이게 마지막이에요. 하지만 멤버 보상이 아직 남아 있으니, 멤버 월드에서 저를 찾아오면 받을 수 있어요.

english: That is the last of your rewards which you have earned.
I can't give you any more rewards until you come back with more inventory space.
translation: 소지품 공간을 더 비워 오기 전에는 보상을 더 드릴 수 없어요.

english: Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 모험의 길을 보여 줄 수 있나요?

english: Of course, here you go.
Opting out of Adventure Paths will hide the interface and you will no longer receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back into Adventure Paths
translation: 모험의 길을 끄면 인터페이스가 숨겨지고 과제와 길 알림을 더 이상 받지 않아요. Adventurer Jon(모험가 존)에게 말을 걸면 다시 모험의 길을 켤 수 있어요

english: You have now opted out of Adventure Paths.
You are currently not participating in Adventure Paths. Would you like to join back in?
translation: 지금은 모험의 길에 참여하고 있지 않아요. 다시 참여할래요?

english: Yes please.
Opting into Adventure Paths will allow you to see the interface and you will be able to receive task and path notifications. You can talk to Adventurer Jon to opt back out of Adventure Paths
translation: 모험의 길을 켜면 인터페이스가 보이고 과제와 길 알림을 받을 수 있어요. Adventurer Jon(모험가 존)에게 말을 걸면 다시 모험의 길을 끌 수 있어요

english: You have opted back into Adventure Paths.
No thanks.
Who are you?
I am simply an adventurer like yourself taking a break on my journey.
translation: 저는 그저 당신 같은 모험가예요. 여행 중에 잠깐 쉬어 가는 중이죠.

english: I wish you luck on your next adventure.
And I to you.
Hey [player name]! Come over here.
You look new around here, welcome to the world of Gielinor!
translation: 여기 처음 온 것 같네요. Gielinor(길리노르)의 세계에 온 걸 환영해요!

english: Thanks, it's my first time here and I'm not sure where to start.
translation: 고마워요. 여기 처음이라 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요.

english: Well, lucky for you, that is exactly why I am here.
translation: 운이 좋네요. 제가 바로 그 일 때문에 여기 있거든요.

english: Start by opening your quest panel and then selecting the flashing yellow star.
translation: 먼저 퀘스트 패널을 열고 깜빡이는 노란 별을 선택하세요.

english: What are Adventure Paths?
Do you have any Adventure Path starter kits for me?
translation: 저한테 줄 모험의 길 시작 키트가 있나요?

english: I'd like to claim my Adventure Path rewards.
Can you show me some Adventure Paths?
translation: 모험의 길을 보여 줄 수 있나요?

english: Disable Adventure Paths.
Yes
No
Yes please.
No thanks.
Greetings, [Sir/Madam].
The King needs someone to take over the rule of the Kingdom. If I were you, I should consider the position.
translation: 국왕께서 왕국의 통치를 맡아 줄 사람을 찾고 계십니다. 제가 당신이라면 그 자리를 고려해 보겠습니다.

english: Greetings, Your Royal Highness.
Your Royal Highness, I should tell you right away that killing the people of this Kingdom will not make you popular with anyone.
translation: 전하, 지금 바로 말씀드려야겠습니다. 이 왕국의 백성을 죽이시면 누구에게도 인기를 얻지 못하실 겁니다.

english: How is the Kingdom faring?
Your subjects are worried about the possibility of war, but they are still happy to work for you.
translation: 백성들은 전쟁이 일어날까 걱정하고 있지만, 여전히 기꺼이 전하를 위해 일하고 있습니다.

english: What am I meant to be doing again?
Dealing with all the little troubles that come up from time to time, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 이따금 생기는 자잘한 문제들을 처리하시는 겁니다, 전하.

english: Such as the predicament we are now in.
translation: 지금 저희가 처한 곤경 같은 것 말입니다.

english: What do you mean?
Has anything been happening in the kingdom recently?
Interesting that you should ask that, Your Royal Highness.
You see, the people are worried that war will break out again.
translation: 실은 백성들이 다시 전쟁이 일어날까 걱정하고 있습니다.

english: King Vargas has found himself with little to do now that you are the regent. He intended, at first, to return to adventuring.
translation: King Vargas(바르가스 왕)께서는 전하께서 섭정이 되신 뒤로 할 일이 거의 없어지셨습니다. 처음에는 다시 모험을 떠나실 생각이셨지요.

english: Unfortunately, we still have not had the doors to the throne room enlarged so that he can leave...
translation: 안타깝게도 아직 throne room(왕좌실) 문을 넓히지 못해서 나가실 수가 없었습니다...

english: So, what has he been doing?
He has been trying to rule once more, in your absence. However, he has once again quarrelled with the Queen of Etceteria.
translation: 전하께서 안 계신 동안 다시 통치를 해 보려 하셨습니다. 그런데 또다시 Etceteria(엣세테리아) 여왕과 다투셨습니다.

english: The two of them have been writing letters to each other, threatening to raise armies and declare war on each other once more!
translation: 두 분이 서로 편지를 주고받으며, 다시 군대를 일으켜 전쟁을 선포하겠다고 위협하고 계십니다!

english: I see.
Your Royal Highness, I suggest that you deal with this matter and reconcile the two of them again. Such a quarrel is not good for Miscellania.
translation: 전하, 이 문제를 처리하시어 두 분을 다시 화해시키시길 권합니다. 이런 다툼은 Miscellania(미셀라니아)에 좋지 않습니다.

english: No, I don't have the time at the moment.
You are the regent of this kingdom, Your Royal Highness. I would urge you to reconsider.
translation: 전하께서는 이 왕국의 섭정이십니다. 다시 생각해 주시길 간청드립니다.

english: However, you are also a busy hero, and thus I understand your reluctance.
translation: 하지만 전하께서는 바쁜 영웅이시기도 하니, 망설이시는 마음은 이해합니다.

english: Greetings, Thane [Fremennik name].
Your subjects are content, your Highness.
Your subjects are content, Thane [Fremennik name].
Your current approval rating is [number]%. I'm afraid your subjects have not yet collected anything.
translation: 현재 지지율은 [number]%입니다. 안타깝게도 백성들이 아직 아무것도 모으지 못했습니다.

english: Your current approval rating is [number]%. Would you like to collect the resources gathered by your subjects?
translation: 현재 지지율은 [number]%입니다. 백성들이 모은 자원을 거두시겠습니까?

english: Yes, please.
Let me check if you have made enough space in your bank, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 은행에 공간을 충분히 비워 두셨는지 확인해 보겠습니다, 전하.

english: I'm afraid you will need [amount] more free space[s] in your bank to hold all the items your subjects have collected.
translation: 송구하오나 백성들이 모은 물건을 모두 보관하시려면 은행에 빈 공간이 [amount]칸[s] 더 필요합니다.

english: Here is a list of what your subjects have collected.
I shall tell your subjects to deliver your resources to your storage right away, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 백성들에게 전하의 자원을 즉시 창고로 보내라고 전하겠습니다, 전하.

english: I shall tell your subjects to deliver your resources to your storage right away, Thane [Fremennik name].
translation: 백성들에게 영주님의 자원을 즉시 창고로 보내라고 전하겠습니다, [Fremennik name] 영주님.

english: This is how your subjects are distributing their effort.
No, thank you.
Very well, Your Royal Highness.
Very well, Thane [Fremennik name].
How do I manage the kingdom?

Your loyal subjects work hard to collect resources for you. Every day they bring what they have collected to the castle. The resources which they collect are coal from the rocks to the north, maple logs from the trees
translation: 충성스러운 백성들이 전하를 위해 열심히 자원을 모읍니다. 백성들은 매일 모은 것을 성으로 가져옵니다. 백성들이 모으는 자원은 북쪽 바위의 coal(석탄), 동쪽 나무의 maple logs(단풍나무 통나무),

english: to the east, herbs from the garden just outside the castle, and tuna and swordfish fished at the port to the south. Etceteria has also pledged you teak and mahogany logs from their trees to the north, and seeds
translation: 성 바로 밖 정원의 herbs(약초), 남쪽 항구에서 잡는 tuna(참치)와 swordfish(황새치)입니다. Etceteria(엣세테리아)도 북쪽 나무에서 벤 teak(티크)와 mahogany logs(마호가니 통나무), 그리고 남쪽 농장의 seeds(씨앗)을

english: from their farm to the south. They are paid from the money in the coffers; each day, one-tenth of the money in the coffers is distributed to them. A maximum of 75k is paid to your subjects and the Etceterians, and the
translation: 바치기로 약속했습니다. 일꾼들은 금고의 돈으로 품삯을 받는데, 매일 금고에 든 돈의 10분의 1이 그들에게 나누어집니다. 백성들과 엣세테리아 사람들에게 지급되는 품삯은 최대 75k이며,

english: coffers can store up to 7.5 million gp. Another thing which affects the amounts of resources collected is your approval rating. The more your subjects love you, the more they will be motivated to work hard. King Vargas
translation: 금고에는 최대 750만 gp까지 보관할 수 있습니다. 모이는 자원의 양에 영향을 주는 또 한 가지는 전하의 지지율입니다. 백성들이 전하를 사랑할수록 더 열심히 일할 마음이 생기지요. King Vargas(바르가스 왕)께서는

english: would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it. Finally, you can choose how much of their efforts your subjects devote to each resource; of
translation: 그럴 수 있으셨던 시절 백성들의 일상 업무를 자주 거들어 주셨고, 백성들은 그런 그분을 무척 사랑했습니다. 마지막으로, 백성들이 각 자원에 노력을 얼마나 쏟을지 정하실 수 있습니다.

english: course, the harder they work at collecting one, the less time they have to spend collecting the others.
translation: 물론 한 가지를 열심히 모을수록 다른 것을 모을 시간은 줄어듭니다.
