What stick?
Come on, get round that course - I need something to chew!
translation: 어서, 코스 한 바퀴 돌고 와 - 씹을 게 필요하단 말이다!

english: You need to take your headgear off before you try the Deathslide, otherwise you won't be able to get a good enough grip with your teeth.
translation: Deathslide(죽음의 활강로)를 타기 전에 머리 장비를 벗어. 안 그러면 이빨로 제대로 물 수가 없어.

english: Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: 크르르 - 여긴 네가 올 곳이 아니다, 인간!

english: That headgear won't help you here, human! Take it off!
translation: 그 머리 장비는 여기선 쓸모없다, 인간! 벗어!

english: Remember - a slow wolf is a hungry wolf!!
Get on with it - you need your whiskers perking!!!!
translation: 어서 해 - 수염이 바짝 서게 기운 좀 내!!!!

english: Claws first - think later.
Imagine the smell of blood in your nostrils!!!
translation: 콧구멍에 피 냄새가 확 들어온다고 상상해 봐!!!

english: I never really wanted to be an agility trainer...
translation: 난 사실 민첩 훈련사 같은 건 되고 싶지 않았는데...

english: It'll be worth it when you hunt!!
translation: 사냥할 때 다 보람이 있을 거다!!

english: Let's see those powerful backlegs at work!!
translation: 그 튼튼한 뒷다리 좀 써 봐라!!

english: Let the bloodlust take you!!
You're the slowest wolf I've ever had the misfortune to witness!!
translation: 내 불운한 눈으로 본 늑대 중에 네가 제일 느리다!!

english: When you're done there's a human with your name on it!!
translation: 다 끝나면 네 몫으로 잡아 둔 인간 한 마리가 기다린다!!

english: You idiot - you've forgotten the stick!!!!
Give my regards to the ground...
WAAAAAARRRGGGHHHH!!!!!!
Don't let the spikes or the blood put you off...
Now for a true test of teeth...
You shouldn't even be here, human!
translation: 넌 여기 있어서도 안 돼, 인간!

english: Let's see how strong human teeth are...
Remember - no stick, no agility bonus!
translation: 명심해 - 막대기 없으면 민첩 보너스도 없다!

english: Bring me the stick when you've finished the course!
Don't forget to give me the stick when you're done!
translation: 다 끝나면 막대기 주는 거 잊지 마!

english: Oh no, not another human... what do you want then?
translation: 아이고, 또 인간이네... 그래서 뭘 원하는데요?

english: Oh, do you get humans here often?
Not that often, no, but sometimes.
Of course, since you people are too big for dwarven clothes, they typically don't stay very long.
translation: 물론 당신네들은 드워프 옷을 입기엔 너무 커서 보통 오래 머물진 않죠.

english: Why don't you make bigger clothes then?
translation: 그럼 더 큰 옷을 만들면 되잖아요?

english: What'd be the point? Besides, I don't make these clothes myself.
translation: 그래서 뭐 하게요? 게다가 이 옷은 제가 직접 만드는 것도 아니에요.

english: Who makes these clothes then?
Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
translation: 아, 제 동생이요. Keldagrim-East(동부 켈다그림)에 살아요. Kelda(켈다) 강 건너편에 작은 노점을 하고 있죠.

english: If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.
translation: 걔가 저처럼 조금만 더 열심히 일했으면 도시 하수구에서 살 필요도 없었을 텐데. 참 안됐죠.

english: The sewers? Your sister lives in the sewers?
Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.
translation: Keldagrim-East(동부 켈다그림)은 정말 끔찍한 곳이에요. 우리 서부처럼 교양 있고 예의 바르고 깨끗하지가 않거든요.

english: Uh-huh.
So do you have any quests for me?
Quests? Why would I have any quests?
translation: 퀘스트요? 제가 왜 퀘스트를 갖고 있겠어요?

english: Oh, just anything to do would be fine.
translation: 아, 그냥 할 일이면 아무거나 괜찮아요.

english: No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.
translation: 아뇨, 지금은 없어요... 나중엔 시킬 일이 생길지도 모르지만, 지금은 아무것도 없어요.

english: Who makes these clothes then?
I still want to buy your clothes.
So do you have any quests for me?
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장에게 가시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 의심하고 있어서, 물건을 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 내게 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 얘기나 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하다면 내 문은 언제나 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 만난 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 것을 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 여기서 지체할 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 원하는 게 있던 것도 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 어떻게 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 모든 일이 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 한 것이오, [Fremennik name]?

english: Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크) 말이냐? 그 녀석은 밖에 있다. 볼에 스치는 바람이 좋다나.

english: Thanks.
Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 거기 하루 종일 앉아 있을 거예요?

english: Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
translation: 그래, 그럴 거다. 난 걸을 수가 없거든.

english: What's stopping you from walking?
Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.
translation: 아르르, 난 다리가 하나뿐이야! 지난번 내 배가 가라앉을 때 다른 한 짝을 잃었지.

english: But I can see both your legs!
translation: 하지만 다리 두 개가 다 보이는데요!

english: Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
translation: 아니지, 젊은 [laddie/lassie], 이건 의족이야. 몇 년 동안은 튼튼한 나무 의족을 달고 다녔는데, 지금은 이 앙증맞은 녀석을 차고 있지.

english: Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
translation: 그 나무 의족이 자꾸 마룻바닥 틈에 끼더라고.

english: Right...
Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.
translation: [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie], 너라면 날 좀 도와주지 않겠냐? 내 원수를 사냥하러 갈 배가 하나 더 필요하거든.

english: Well, I do have a ship that I'm not using. It's the Lady Lumbridge.
translation: 음, 안 쓰는 배가 하나 있긴 해요. Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)라는 배예요.

english: Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
translation: 아르르! 그 배라면 잘 알지. 아주 멋진 아가씨지.

english: I suppose she might be...
So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?
translation: 그럼 그 배를 몰고 바다에 나가게 해 주겠냐?

english: I had to pay 2000 gp for that ship. Have you got that much?
translation: 그 배 사느라 2000gp나 냈어요. 그만한 돈 있어요?

english: Hmmm. And can you afford another ship?
translation: 흐음. 그럼 다른 배를 살 돈은 있어요?

english: Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.
translation: 아니, 난 땡전 한 푼 없다. 가진 건 전부 옛 배랑 같이 가라앉았거든.

english: So you're actually asking me to give you a free ship.
Arrr! Would ye be so kind?
No I jolly well wouldn't!
Arrr.
Do you have anything for trade?
Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
translation: 지금은 없어. 하긴 요즘 세관원 놈들이 잔뜩 독이 올라 있거든.

english: Oi matey, leave my beer alone!
translation: 어이 친구, 내 맥주에 손대지 마!

english: Sorry!
Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
translation: 어이 친구, 내 맥주에 마법 걸지 마!

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: Arrr!
Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: 거기 하루 종일 앉아 있을 거예요?

english: Do you want to trade?
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Gratias tibi ago!
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 안녕하세요. 은행권을 교환해 드릴까요? 은행권 한 장당 5코인만 받아요.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Aisles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 저는 Aisles(아일스)예요. 은행권을 실제 아이템으로 바꿔 드려요. 바꿔 드릴 은행권 있으세요?

english: No thanks.
I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
translation: 저는 은행권을 실제 아이템으로 바꿔 드려요. 그건 은행권이 아니에요.

english: I charge 5 coins for exchanging each banknote.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
Exchange [item name]: 5 coins
Exchange All: [number of banknotes x 5] coins
Cancel
Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.
translation: 반갑습니다, 동료 전사여. 저는 Ajjat(아자트), 전직 black knight(흑기사)이자 지금은 이곳 warrior guild(전사 길드)의 훈련 교관입니다.

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?

Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
translation: Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 Capes of Accomplishment(성취의 망토)라고도 하며, 정예 중의 정예만을 위한 것입니다. 스킬을 진정으로 통달한 사람만 살 수 있으며, 그마저도 스킬 망토는

english: recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
translation: 그 스킬에서 이 땅 최고의 실력자로 인정받는 이에게서만 살 수 있습니다.

english: I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 저는 영광스럽게도 Skillcape of Attack(공격 스킬 망토)를 관리하고 있습니다. 이 망토가 있으면 Kamfreena(캄프리나)가 알아보고 길드 토큰 없이도 그녀가 관리하는 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)에게 갈 수 있게 해 줄 겁니다.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: Black Knight(흑기사)였다고요? 그런데 왜 여기 있어요?

english: Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.
translation: 그렇습니다. 하지만 그들의... 방식이... 제 이상과 맞지 않았지요.. 그래서 떠났습니다. Harrallak(하랄락)이 제 전사로서의 재능을 알아보고 받아 주며 이곳 일자리를 주었습니다.

english: Hmm... well if Harrallak trusts you, I guess I can.
translation: 흠... Harrallak(하랄락)이 당신을 믿는다면 저도 믿어 볼게요.

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: Dummy Room(허수아비 방)은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
translation: 아, 허수아비 말이군요. 고귀한 드워프 Gamfred(감프레드)의 또 다른 기발한 발명품입니다. 기계식이라 바닥에서 튀어나오지요. 다시 사라지기 전에 알맞은 공격 방식으로 쳐야 합니다.

english: So how do I tell which one is which?
translation: 그럼 어느 게 어느 건지 어떻게 구별해요?

english: There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
translation: 방법은 두 가지입니다. 하나는 색깔이고, 다른 하나는 자세와 들고 있는 무기입니다. 예를 들어 단검을 든 허수아비는 찌르기 공격으로 쳐야 합니다.

english: In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
translation: 방 안 벽에 포스터가 있으니, 허수아비를 하나하나 구별하는 데 도움이 될 겁니다.

english: That sounds ingenious!
Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
translation: 그렇습니다. 매번 성공하려면 무기가 여러 개 필요할 수도 있지만, 계속 도전해 보십시오. 위층 무기 상점이 도움이 될 겁니다.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 아직 얻은 토큰이 없는 것 같습니다. 길드 곳곳의 활동에 참여해 토큰을 모아 보십시오.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Bye!
Farewell warrior. Stay away from the dark side.
translation: 잘 가십시오, 전사여. 어둠의 편에는 가까이 가지 마십시오.

english: Ah, but I can see you are already a master in the fine art of attacking, perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Attack, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 아, 그런데 보아하니 이미 공격술에 통달하셨군요. 혹시 Cape of Attack(공격 망토)를 사서 이 까다로운 스킬을 통달한 소수 정예에 합류하려고 오신 겁니까?

english: When wearing this cape, Kamfreena will recognize your ability and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
translation: 이 망토를 걸치고 있으면 Kamfreena(캄프리나)가 당신의 실력을 알아보고 길드 토큰 없이도 그녀가 관리하는 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)에게 갈 수 있게 해 줄 겁니다.

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: Skillcape of Attack(공격 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly; unfortunately being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for the princely sum of 99000 gold!
translation: 물론입니다. 다만 아주 귀한 물건이라 그만큼 비쌉니다. 무려 99000골드를 받아야겠습니다!

english: 99000! Are you mad?
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 물론 제정신입니다. 이렇게 귀한 물건을 살 기회를 반길 모험가는 얼마든지 있습니다. 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 찾아오십시오.

english: I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 멋진 망토를 위해서라면 그 정도 푼돈은 기꺼이 내죠.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 지금 가진 돈이 부족해요.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토에는 두건이 무료로 딸려 나갑니다. 스킬 판촉 행사라서요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 아시죠? 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주십시오.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭합니다! 자부심을 갖고 그 망토를 걸치십시오, 친구여.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Ajjat hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Ajjat(아자트)가 스킬 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 건넨다.

english: Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
Black Knight? Why are you here?
translation: Black Knight(흑기사)였다고요? 그런데 왜 여기 있어요?

english: What's the Dummy Room all about?
translation: Dummy Room(허수아비 방)은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
translation: Skillcape of Attack(공격 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
translation: 멋진 망토를 위해서라면 그 정도 푼돈은 기꺼이 내죠.

english: Skillcape
Hood
Thank you for the translation manual, Ak-Haranu - it may save many souls before long.
translation: translation manual(번역 안내서) 고마워요, Ak-Haranu(아크-하라누). 머지않아 많은 영혼을 구할지도 몰라요.

english: And Ak-Haranu thanks you for kind gift of longbow.
translation: 그리고 Ak-Haranu(아크-하라누)도 longbow(긴 활) 선물, 감사합니다.

english: Hi there!
Why, helloooo!
A camel?
Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
translation: 이거 참 근사한 일이네요, 젊은 양반. 이렇게 알게 되어 정말 반가워요!

english: Thank you. Nice to meet you too.
Wait a minute. How am I talking to you without a Camulet?
translation: 잠깐만요. Camulet(카뮬렛)도 없는데 제가 어떻게 당신이랑 말하고 있죠?

english: My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
translation: 젊은 양반, 전 낙타인걸요. 제가 그걸 어떻게 알겠어요?

english: Hmmm. I suppose this spell must tap directly into your mind. So, there's no need for language to get in the way.
translation: 흐음. 아마 이 주문이 당신 마음에 직접 연결되는 모양이에요. 그러니 언어가 방해할 일도 없는 거죠.

english: I think I am somewhat confused.
May one ask how you contacted me?
I'm just using one of the Lunar spells.
translation: 그냥 Lunar(루나) 주문을 하나 쓰고 있는 거예요.

english: Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
translation: 세상에, 세상에. 요즘 젊은이들은 별 희한한 신식 물건을 다 쓴다니까요!

english: Hello Effendi!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads.
translation: 나는 Al Shabim(알 샤빔)이오. Bedabin(베다빈) 유목민을 대표해 인사하오.

english: Who are you?
I am Al Shabim Effendi! I am the leader of the Bedabin peoples!
translation: 나는 Al Shabim(알 샤빔)이오, 에펜디! Bedabin(베다빈) 부족의 족장이라오!

english: Okay Thanks!
Good day Effendi!
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 있나요?

english: Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
translation: 글쎄, 우리는 대개 파인애플을 돌보느라 무척 바쁘다오. 가장 귀한 보물을 도둑들이 털어 가지 못하도록 비밀 장소에서 기르고 있소.

english: What is this place?
This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
translation: 이곳은 Bedabin(베다빈)의 터전이오. 우리는 사막에 사는 평화로운 부족이지. 어떤 멍청이들은 우리를 '텐티'라고 부르는데, 무지에서 나온 유치한 이름이오.

english: We're renowned for surviving in the harshest desert climate. We also grow the 'Bedabin ambrosia.'... A pineapple of such delicious sumptiousness that it defies description.
translation: 우리는 가장 혹독한 사막 기후에서도 살아남는 것으로 이름나 있소. 또 'Bedabin ambrosia(베다빈 암브로시아)'도 기르지... 말로 다 할 수 없을 만큼 감미롭고 호사스러운 파인애플이라오.

english: Take a look around our camp if you like!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads. Now... what can I do for you?
translation: 나는 Al Shabim(알 샤빔)이오. Bedabin(베다빈) 유목민을 대표해 인사하오. 자... 무엇을 도와드리면 되겠소?

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
translation: 오, 그렇소? 흥미롭구려. 우리의 달콤한 파인애플은 Kharid(카리드) 전역에 이름나 있소! 내 부탁을 하나 들어준다면 하나 주겠소만?

english: Oh yes?
Captain Siad at the mining camp is holding some secret information. It is very important to us and we would like you to get it for us. It gives details of an interesting, yet ancient weapon.
translation: 채굴 야영지의 Captain Siad(시아드 대장)이 비밀 정보를 쥐고 있소. 우리에게 아주 중요한 것이라 그대가 그걸 가져와 주었으면 하오. 흥미로우면서도 아주 오래된 무기에 관한 세부 내용이 담겨 있다오.

english: We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
translation: 그 정보는 기꺼이 그대와 나누겠소. 그대는 위층에 있는 그의 개인실에 들어가기만 하면 되오. 그 정보가 든 chest(상자)의 열쇠는 우리가 갖고 있소. 이 거래, 관심 있소?

english: Yes, I'm interested.
That's great Effendi!
Here is a copy of the key that should give you access to the chest.
translation: 여기 chest(상자)를 열 수 있는 key(열쇠)를 복제한 것이오.

english: Bring us back the plans inside the chest, they should be sealed. All haste to you Effendi!
translation: 상자 안에 든 설계도를 가져다주시오. 봉인되어 있을 것이오. 서두르시오, 에펜디!

english: Not at the moment.
Very well Effendi!
What is this place?
Who are you?
How are things going Effendi?
I've lost the key!
How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
translation: 참으로 조심성이 없구려! 여기 열쇠를 하나 더 주겠소. 이번엔 잃어버리지 마시오!

english: Goodbye!
Very well, good day Effendi!
Aha! I see you have the plans. This is great! However, these plans do indeed look very technical. My people have further need of your skills.
translation: 아하! 설계도를 가져왔구려. 훌륭하오! 하지만 이 설계도는 정말이지 꽤 전문적으로 보이는구려. 우리 부족은 그대의 솜씨가 더 필요하오.

english: If you can help us to manufacture this item, we will share its secret with you. Does this deal interest you effendi?
translation: 이 물건을 만드는 걸 도와준다면 그 비밀을 그대와 나누겠소. 이 거래, 마음에 드시오, 에펜디?

english: Yes, I'm very interested.
Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze, 10 feathers and a hammer. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 좋소, 필요한 물건은 이렇소. 순수한 bronze bar(청동 주괴) 하나, feathers(깃털) 10개, 그리고 hammer(망치) 하나. 가져오면 물건 만드는 일을 이어 가겠소.

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze and 10 feathers. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 좋소, 필요한 물건은 이렇소. 순수한 bronze bar(청동 주괴) 하나와 feathers(깃털) 10개. 가져오면 물건 만드는 일을 이어 가겠소.

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 좋소, bronze bar(청동 주괴)를 가지고 있구려. 이제 계속하려면 feathers(깃털)과 hammer(망치)만 있으면 되오.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 좋소, feathers(깃털)을 가지고 있구려. 이제 계속하려면 bronze bar(청동 주괴)와 hammer(망치)만 있으면 되오.

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers before we can continue.
translation: 좋소, bronze bar(청동 주괴)를 가지고 있구려. 이제 계속하려면 feathers(깃털)만 있으면 되오.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze before we can continue.
translation: 좋소, feathers(깃털)을 가지고 있구려. 이제 계속하려면 bronze bar(청동 주괴)만 있으면 되오.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers and a bar of Bronze, but you just need a hammer now.
translation: 좋소, feathers(깃털)과 Bronze bar(청동 주괴)를 가지고 있구려. 이제 hammer(망치)만 있으면 되오.

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers, a bar of Bronze and a hammer. Are you still willing to help make the weapon?
translation: 좋소, feathers(깃털)과 Bronze bar(청동 주괴), hammer(망치)까지 모두 가지고 있구려. 아직 무기 만드는 걸 도와줄 생각이 있소?

english: Yes, I'm kind of curious.
Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this...  There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
translation: 좋소, 에펜디. 설계도대로 해야 하오. 이 일엔 특별한 도구가 좀 필요하지... 다른 tent(천막)에 anvil(모루)가 있소. 써도 좋다고 허락하겠지만, guard(경비병)에게 설계도를 보여 주시오.

english: You have the plans and all the items needed. You should be able to complete the item on your own. Please bring me the item when it is finished.
translation: 설계도와 필요한 물건은 다 갖췄구려. 혼자서도 물건을 완성할 수 있을 것이오. 다 만들면 내게 가져다주시오.

english: No, sorry.
As you wish Effendi!
Come back if you change your mind!
Wonderful, I see you have made the new weapon!
This is truly fantastic Effendi!
But we will need the technical plans from you Effendi. If we are going to perfect this weapon.
translation: 하지만 에펜디, 기술 설계도도 우리에게 넘겨주어야 하오. 이 무기를 완벽하게 다듬으려면 말이오.

english: We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
translation: 무기의 technical plans(기술 설계도)도 함께 가져가겠소.

english: We are forever grateful for this gift. My advisors have discovered some secrets which we will share with you.
translation: 이 선물에 영원히 감사하겠소. 내 조언자들이 몇 가지 비밀을 알아냈는데, 그대에게도 알려 주겠소.

english: Al Shabim's advisors show you some advanced techniques for making the new weapon.
translation: Al Shabim(알 샤빔)의 조언자들이 새 무기를 만드는 고급 기술을 보여 준다.

english: Please accept this selection of six bronze throwing darts as a token of our appreciation.
translation: 감사의 표시로 bronze dart(청동 다트) 여섯 개를 받아 주시오.

english: I'll take that key off your hands as well effendi! Many thanks!
translation: 그 열쇠도 내가 받아 가겠소, 에펜디! 정말 고맙소!

english: Oh, and here is your pineapple!
Many thanks with your help previously Effendi!
I am looking for a pineapple.
Here is another pineapple, try not to lose this one.
translation: 여기 파인애플을 하나 더 주겠소. 이번엔 잃어버리지 않도록 하시오.

english: Okay thanks!
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 있나요?

english: Okay Thanks!
Yes, I'm interested.
Not at the moment.
I've lost the key!
Goodbye!
Yes, I'm very interested.
Yes, I'm kind of curious.
No, sorry.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 미안한데요, 똥을 조금만 나눠 줄 수 있을까요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 썩 마음에 들지 않은 모양이다.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 가까이 갔다간 손을 물어뜯길 것 같아요.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 kebab(케밥)을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 일단 눈부터 감아요. 누가 보는 앞에서는 절대 안 할 거예요!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
Sorry, were you saying something to me?
No, er, nothing important.
Never mind, it is unimportant when I have such important matters weighing on my soul.
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요. 제 영혼을 짓누르는 중대한 문제에 비하면 하찮은 일이니까요.

english: How important can a camel's problems be?
translation: 낙타 고민이 중대해 봤자 얼마나 중대하겠어요?

english: Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
translation: 그게, 있잖아요, Elly(엘리)라는 낙타가 있어요. 금실을 자은 듯한 가죽에 오아시스처럼 반짝이는 이빨을 가진, 아름답고 경이로운 낙타죠.

english: ...I see.
I've written many poems describing her beauty. Would you like to hear one?
translation: 그녀의 아름다움을 노래한 시를 많이 썼어요. 하나 들어 볼래요?

english: It's all right, I'm...
Shall I compare thee to a desert's day? Thou art drier and more rough-skinned.
translation: 그대를 사막의 하루에 비할까? 그대는 더 메마르고 살결은 더 거칠도다.

english: Rough sandstorms shake the cactuses away And summer's heat defers to autumn wind.
translation: 거센 모래 폭풍은 선인장을 흔들어 날리고, 여름의 열기는 가을바람에 자리를 내주네.

english: Look, I don't really have the time to...
translation: 저기, 제가 그럴 시간이 별로 없어서...

english: Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
translation: 때로 하늘의 눈은 너무 뜨겁게 빛나고, Guthix(구식스)의 황금빛 얼굴은 자주 흐려지며;

english: And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or desert's changing course untrimmed...
translation: 아름다운 것은 모두 언젠가 그 아름다움을 잃나니, 우연으로, 혹은 사막의 변덕스러운 흐름으로 다듬어지지 않은 채...

english: Please, stop.
But I've only got six lines left!
translation: 하지만 이제 여섯 줄밖에 안 남았는데요!

english: That's six too many. If I really want to hear your poetry, I'll tell you, okay?
translation: 여섯 줄도 너무 많아요. 정말 당신 시가 듣고 싶어지면 제가 말할게요, 알았죠?

english: Very well. Come back and talk to me if you want to hear more.
translation: 알겠어요. 더 듣고 싶으면 다시 와서 말 걸어 줘요.

english: Oh, it's you again. Have you come back to listen to my poems?
translation: 아, 또 당신이군요. 제 시를 들으러 다시 온 거예요?

english: I'd love to!
That's so kind of you. Which one would you like to hear?
translation: 정말 친절하시네요. 어떤 시를 듣고 싶어요?

english: 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
translation: '그대를 사막의 하루에 비할까'가 지금까지 쓴 것 중 최고지만, 다른 시도 지었어요.

english: That's my favourite poem. Ahem...
But thine eternal desert shall not fade Nor lose possession of that sand thou owest;
translation: 허나 그대의 영원한 사막은 바래지 않으리, 그대가 지닌 그 모래도 잃지 않으리;

english: Nor Zamorak brag thou art in his shades, When in eternal lines to sand thou growest,
translation: Zamorak(자모락)도 그대가 제 그늘 속을 헤맨다 뽐내지 못하리, 영원한 시구 속에서 그대가 모래로 자라날 때,

english: So long as camels breathe or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
translation: 낙타가 숨 쉬고 눈이 볼 수 있는 한, 이 시는 살아 남아 그대에게 생명을 주리라.

english: Ah, Elly, how beautiful you are.
translation: 아, Elly(엘리), 당신은 어쩜 그리 아름다운지.

english: What does Elly think of your poems?
She's never heard them.
Why not?
I suspect she loves another - Ollie, another camel who roams with her to the north.
translation: 그녀는 다른 이를 사랑하는 것 같아요. 북쪽에서 그녀와 함께 돌아다니는 Ollie(올리)라는 낙타요.

english: So I shall stay here and compose poems for her.
translation: 그래서 저는 여기 남아 그녀를 위한 시를 지을 거예요.

english: Why not tell her how you feel?
She seems happy enough as she is, and I have my poems to comfort me.
translation: 그녀는 지금 그대로도 충분히 행복해 보이고, 제겐 위로가 되어 줄 시가 있으니까요.

english: Well, best of luck with that.
If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
translation: 제 시를 다시 듣고 싶으면 또 와 줘요.

english: I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
translation: 이 시는 오아시스에 나무를 뜯어 먹으러 갔다가 Elly(엘리)가 먹을 걸 하나도 안 남겨 둔 걸 깨닫고 쓴 거예요. 정말 괴로웠죠.

english: This Is Just To Say
I have nibbled the cacti that were by the oasis,
translation: 오아시스 곁에 있던 선인장을 내가 뜯어 먹었어,

english: and which you were probably saving for lunch.
translation: 아마 네가 점심으로 아껴 두었을 그것을.

english: Forgive me, they were delicious, so crunchy and so cold.
translation: 용서해 줘, 정말 맛있었어, 그렇게 아삭하고 그렇게 차가웠어.

english: I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.
translation: 간식을 먹어 버린 걸 그녀가 용서해 줬을까요.

english: No, thank you.
Ah, well. I shall return to writing poems to Elly's beauty.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그럼 Elly(엘리)의 아름다움을 노래하는 시나 다시 써야겠어요.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 전 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: I'd love to!
Listen to 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day'.
Why not tell her how you feel?
Well, best of luck with that.
Listen to 'This Is Just To Say'.
No, thank you.
Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 제 작물을 돌봐 주실 수 있나요?

english: I might - which patch were you thinking of?
translation: 그럴 수도 있죠. 어느 밭 말이에요?

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭엔 씨앗이 하나도 안 심겨 있잖아요. 뭘 좀 심으면 돌봐 줄 수도 있어요.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 그 밭은 병들었어요. 저한테 맡기기 전에 먼저 치료부터 하세요!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 그 밭은 죽었어요. 이제 와서 제가 해 줄 수 있는 게 없네요.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 이미 다 자랐잖아요! 저더러 뭘 하라는 건지 모르겠네요!

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 그 밭은 이미 제가 돌봐 드리고 있어요.

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 흠, 공짜로 시간 낭비할 생각은 없어요.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 그거면 충분해요, [sir/madam]. 저한테 맡겨 두세요. 그 밭이 잘 자라도록 확실히 챙길게요.

english: No, that's too much.
Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: Poison ivy(독담쟁이) 덤불은 병에 걸리지 않으니 굳이 보호를 맡기실 필요 없어요.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 채소 자루에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 열 개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 넣을 수는 없어요.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 과일 바구니에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 다섯 개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 넣을 수는 없어요.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어요. 상점은 텃밭 근처에 있고요.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 plantpot(화분)을 채울 수 있어요.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 흙을 담은 plantpot(화분)에 심어 sapling(묘목)으로 키운 다음, tree patch(나무 밭)에 옮겨 다 자랄 때까지 키워야 해요.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: 자루나 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶으면 Falador(팔라도르)의 농사 상점 근처에 있는 loom(베틀)을 써야 해요. 물론 [craftswoman/craftsman] 솜씨가 충분하다면 말이죠.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: plantpot(화분)을 전부 살 필요는 없어요. 도자기 물레로 직접 만들 수도 있거든요. 물론 [craftswoman/craftsman] 솜씨가 충분하다면 말이죠.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭을 갈퀴질한 다음 나온 weeds(잡초)를 그냥 버리지 마세요. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만드세요.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 compost(퇴비)를 주면 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라, 수확할 작물도 더 많아져요.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 보통 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만 만드는 데 돈이 더 들어요. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든요. 아이템을 보여 주시면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 드릴게요.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 계속 물을 줘야 해요. 제 조언을 무시하면 머지않아 죽어 버린 농사 밭을 갖게 될 거예요.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 덤불이나 나무의 병을 고치는 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 것뿐이에요. 다른 작물엔 그냥 plant-cure(식물 치료제)를 뿌리면 돼요.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
translation: 이런 Farming(농사) 구역은 여기 말고도 다섯 군데가 더 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단타에라) 구역, Ardougne(아르둔) 근처의 Kragen(크라겐) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, 그리고

english: in Prifddinas.
If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 과일나무를 키우고 싶으면 몇 군데 가 볼 만해요. Catherby(캐서비), Brimhaven(브림헤이븐), Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새), Farming Guild(농사 길드)에 모두 과일나무 밭이 있어요.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일을 빚기에 좋아요. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다고 알고 있고, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 그런 데엔 좋았다는 소문을 들었어요. 물론 거기 사람들이 다 죽기 전 얘기지만요.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 키울 수 있어요. 그곳 땅이 유난히 축축해서 독버섯 키우기에 딱이거든요.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 키우는 특별한 밭도 있어요. Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처 어딘가였던 것 같은데, 거기 땅이 좀 '축복받지 못한' 곳이거든요.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 제가 팔 만한 게 있느냐에 달렸죠. 찾으시는 게 뭔데요?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: plant cure(식물 치료제)라고요? 제가 쓰려고 따로 챙겨 둔 게 좀 있을 거예요. 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 25 코인에 팔게요.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 아뇨, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있어요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: bucket of compost(퇴비 양동이)라고요? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 35 코인에 팔게요.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: rake(갈퀴)라고요? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 15 코인에 팔게요.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 에, plant pot(화분) 하나쯤은 내줄 수 있겠지만, 40 코인은 받아야겠어요.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: watering can(물뿌리개)라고요? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 25 코인에 팔게요.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)이라고요? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 15 코인에 팔게요.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: seed dibber(씨앗 구멍 막대)라고요? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠. 원하시면 15 코인에 팔게요.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 됐어요, 제가 필요한 건 하나도 없네요.

english: I'll come back another time.
Which patch would you like to pay protection for?
I want [payment] for that.
Would you look after my crops for me?
translation: 제 작물을 돌봐 주실 수 있나요?

english: The Cactus Patch
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.

Some plant cure.

No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.

Nilsal, iknami! Do you need help with anything?
translation: 닐살, 이크나미! 뭐 도와드릴 일 있나요?

english: What do you do around here?
I spend a lot of my time researching new product formulas for the lab. Just over here we have a batch of something new that I've dubbed 'Earworm'.
translation: 전 대부분의 시간을 연구소의 새 제품 제조법 연구에 쓰고 있어요. 바로 여기 있는 게 새로 만든 건데, 'Earworm(귀벌레)'이라고 이름 붙였죠.

english: Ear... Worm...?
Indeed! Its effects produce musical auditory hallucinations! Soon, people will be able to listen to music while on the go. It'll sell like hotcakes!
translation: 그렇죠! 이걸 쓰면 음악 환청이 들려요! 머지않아 사람들이 돌아다니면서도 음악을 들을 수 있게 될 거예요. 불티나게 팔릴 거라고요!

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
Our main focus is the advancement of Herblore through scientific study.
translation: 저희의 주된 목표는 과학적 연구를 통한 Herblore(약초학)의 발전이에요.

english: As for an end goal... that information is only for senior members.
translation: 최종 목표에 대해서는... 고참 회원들만 알 수 있는 정보예요.

english: Perhaps in time, you will learn of it!
Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What are the goals of the Alchemical Society?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Roaaaaaaaaaaar!
Hi.
Greetings young one. What wisdom do you seek?
What do I have to do in this room?

In this room you will see various cupboards. It is your task to search the cupboards to find items to turn into gold using your low or high alchemy spells. You can deposit the money in the receptacle at the end of the
translation: 이 방에는 여러 찬장이 보일 걸세. 자네가 할 일은 찬장을 뒤져 아이템을 찾고, 로우 알케미나 하이 알케미 주문으로 그것을 금으로 바꾸는 것이네. 번 돈은 이 홀 끝에 있는

english: hall in order to receive your Alchemist Pizazz Points. This money is used for the upkeep of the training arena as well as magic shops all around Gielinor. Keep an eye on the costs of each item as these will change
translation: 보관함에 넣으면 Alchemist Pizazz Points(연금술사 피자즈 포인트)를 받을 수 있지. 이 돈은 훈련 경기장과 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳의 마법 상점을 유지하는 데 쓰인다네. 아이템마다 가격을 잘 살피게. 가격은

english: from time-to-time, as will the location of the items. Occasionally one of the items will be indicated as costing no runestones to convert to money.
translation: 이따금 바뀌고, 아이템이 있는 위치도 마찬가지일세. 가끔은 룬 없이도 돈으로 바꿀 수 있다고 표시되는 아이템이 나오기도 하네.

english: How will I be rewarded?

You will get magic experience from casting the alchemist spells, as well as 1 Alchemist Pizazz Point for every 100 coins you deposit, and 10% of the coins you deposit will be given to you as you leave. Keep in mind that you
translation: 연금술 주문을 쓰면 마법 경험치를 얻고, 넣은 코인 100개마다 Alchemist Pizazz Point(연금술사 피자즈 포인트)를 1점씩 받으며, 떠날 때 넣은 코인의 10%를 돌려받게 되네. 다만 명심하게,

english: will not be able to take more than 1000 coins back out with you.
translation: 가지고 나갈 수 있는 돈은 1000 코인을 넘을 수 없다네.

english: Got any tips that may help me?

You must remember to keep an eye on the various costs of the items. If you watch the movements of the other players, you might be able to guess which are the best places to visit. You will get 1 Pizazz Point for
translation: 아이템마다 가격을 잘 살펴야 한다는 걸 잊지 말게. 다른 플레이어들의 움직임을 지켜보면 어디로 가는 게 가장 좋은지 짐작할 수 있을지도 모르지. Pizazz Point(피자즈 포인트)는

english: every 100 coins, so if you have 190 coins, why not get an extra 10?
translation: 코인 100개마다 1점이니, 190 코인을 가지고 있다면 10개를 더 모으는 게 어떻겠나?

english: I see.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed, but the gold
translation: 아, 그리고 경고 하나 하지. 출구 포털이 아닌 다른 방법으로 이 방을 떠나면 입구로 순간이동되고 방에서 주운 아이템은 모두 사라지네. 하지만 그동안 번

english: coins and Pizazz points you earned will be granted.
translation: 코인과 Pizazz points(피자즈 포인트)는 그대로 지급될 걸세.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
How will I be rewarded?
Got any tips that may help me?
Thanks, bye!
Greetings, adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.
translation: 반갑습니다, 모험가님. Myths' Guild(신화 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Tell me about the guild.
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of these lands to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
translation: Myths' Guild(신화 길드)는 이 세계의 잃어버린 비밀을 밝혀내고자 하는 이들의 보금자리입니다. 저희는 이 땅의 신화를 조사해 그 속에 숨은 사실이 있는지 살핍니다.

english: Here, we discover things that others only dream of. However, the cost of entry is not insignificant. Only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: 이곳에서 저희는 남들이 꿈으로만 꾸는 것들을 발견합니다. 다만 입회의 대가가 결코 가볍지 않습니다. 가장 자격 있는 자만이 저희의 비밀을 함께 나눌 수 있습니다.

english: Am I worthy?
Not yet. However, that could well change.
translation: 아직은 아닙니다. 하지만 충분히 달라질 수 있습니다.

english: For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands, but despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
translation: 역사가 기억하는 한 오래전부터 드래곤들은 이 땅을 누벼 왔습니다. 하지만 그토록 오래 이곳에 있었음에도 그들의 역사는 대부분 감춰져 있습니다.

english: There are tales of course, but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
translation: 물론 전해지는 이야기는 있지만, 이야기만으로는 부족합니다. 저희는 당신이 진실을 밝혀내기를 바랍니다. 드래곤은 어디서 왔는가? 왜 이곳에 있는가? 누구를 섬기는가?

english: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the guild and you will reap the rewards within.
translation: 이 질문들에 답해 주십시오. 저희 Library of Knowledge(지식의 서고)를 채우는 일을 도와주십시오. 그 대가로 길드 출입을 허락하고, 안에서 보상을 누리게 해 드리겠습니다.

english: So, do you feel up for the challenge?
translation: 자, 이 도전에 나설 준비가 되셨습니까?

english: Yes. Where should I begin?
Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to start.
translation: Musa Point(무사 포인트)에 있는 Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers(카람자 와인, 증류주, 맥주)로 가십시오. 그곳에 Dallas Jones(댈러스 존스)가 있을 겁니다. 그가 Crandor(크랜도)의 파괴를 조사하고 있다고 들었습니다. 시작하기에 좋은 곳일 겁니다.

english: Good luck.
No. This is too much for me.
As you wish. If you change your mind, you know where we are.
translation: 뜻대로 하십시오. 마음이 바뀌면 저희가 어디 있는지 아시겠지요.

english: Absolutely. You've proven your worth to the guild and may enter whenever you please.
translation: 물론입니다. 길드에 자격을 증명하셨으니 언제든 원하실 때 들어오셔도 됩니다.

english: How can I gain access to the guild?
Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you wish to enter, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: 가장 자격 있는 자만이 Myths' Guild(신화 길드)에 들어올 수 있습니다. 들어오고 싶으시다면 스스로를 증명하셔야 합니다.

english: How can I do that?
As time passes, that which was once fact, becomes myth. Some tales are just that, tales. However, some tales are something more.
translation: 시간이 흐르면 한때 사실이었던 것도 신화가 됩니다. 어떤 이야기는 그저 이야기일 뿐입니다. 하지만 어떤 이야기는 그 이상이지요.

english: Here at the Myths' Guild, we live to tell the difference between the two. If you wish to join us, you must do the same.
translation: 이곳 Myths' Guild(신화 길드)에서 저희는 그 둘을 가려내기 위해 삽니다. 저희와 함께하고 싶으시다면 당신도 똑같이 하셔야 합니다.

english: So what myth would you like me to investigate?
translation: 그럼 제가 어떤 신화를 조사하면 될까요?

english: Let's talk about my quest.
How are things progressing?
I'm yet to discover anything.
Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
translation: 그렇다면 무언가 알아내는 대로 돌아오십시오. Library of Knowledge(지식의 서고)를 채우는 일을 도와주신다면 길드 출입을 허락해 드리겠습니다.

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island but they're locked. I'm trying to find the key.
translation: Elvarg(엘바르그)의 기원을 조사하고 있어요. 폐허가 된 섬에서 오래된 문들을 찾았는데 잠겨 있어요. 열쇠를 찾는 중이에요.

english: Well keep at it. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: 계속 힘써 주십시오. Library of Knowledge(지식의 서고)를 채우는 일을 도와주신다면 길드 출입을 허락해 드리겠습니다.

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island but they're locked. I think something important lies behind them.
translation: Elvarg(엘바르그)의 기원을 조사하고 있어요. 폐허가 된 섬에서 오래된 문들을 찾았는데 잠겨 있어요. 그 뒤에 뭔가 중요한 게 있는 것 같아요.

english: I was investigating the origin of Elvarg but I accidently released a dragonkin.
translation: Elvarg(엘바르그)의 기원을 조사하다가 실수로 dragonkin(드래곤킨)을 풀어 줘 버렸어요.

english: Well that can't be good. You'd better sort that out.
translation: 그건 좋지 않군요. 어서 해결하시는 게 좋겠습니다.

english: I'm working on it.
Goodbye.
Farewell, adventurer.
Greetings adventurer. Welcome to the Myths' Guild.
translation: 반갑습니다, 모험가님. Myths' Guild(신화 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Tell me about the Guild.
The Myths' Guild is home to those who wish to uncover the lost secrets of this world. We investigate the myths of this land to see if any facts may be hidden within them.
translation: Myths' Guild(신화 길드)는 이 세계의 잃어버린 비밀을 밝혀내고자 하는 이들의 보금자리입니다. 저희는 이 땅의 신화를 조사해 그 속에 숨은 사실이 있는지 살핍니다.

english: We discover things here that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: 저희는 이곳에서 남들이 꿈으로만 꾸는 것들을 발견합니다. 다만 입회의 대가가 결코 가볍지 않아, 가장 자격 있는 자만이 저희의 비밀을 함께 나눌 수 있습니다.

english: Here you will discover things that others only dream of. The cost of entry is not insignificant though, only the most worthy may share in our secrets.
translation: 이곳에서 당신은 남들이 꿈으로만 꾸는 것들을 발견하게 될 겁니다. 다만 입회의 대가가 결코 가볍지 않아, 가장 자격 있는 자만이 저희의 비밀을 함께 나눌 수 있습니다.

english: Not yet. However, that could well change. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: 아직은 아닙니다. 하지만 충분히 달라질 수 있습니다. 나가서 실력을 갈고닦은 뒤 다시 찾아오십시오.

english: I'm afraid not. Perhaps that will change one day.
For as long as history remembers, dragons have roamed these lands. But despite how long they've been here, much of their history remains hidden.
translation: 역사가 기억하는 한 오래전부터 드래곤들은 이 땅을 누벼 왔습니다. 하지만 그토록 오래 이곳에 있었음에도 그들의 역사는 대부분 감춰져 있습니다.

english: There are tales of course but tales are not enough for us. We want you to discover the truth. Where did the dragons come from? Why are they here? Who do they serve?
translation: 물론 전해지는 이야기는 있지만, 이야기만으로는 부족합니다. 저희는 당신이 진실을 밝혀내기를 바랍니다. 드래곤은 어디서 왔는가? 왜 이곳에 있는가? 누구를 섬기는가?

english: Answer these questions for us. Help us fill our Library of Knowledge. In return, we will grant you access to the Guild and you will reap the rewards within.
translation: 이 질문들에 답해 주십시오. 저희 Library of Knowledge(지식의 서고)를 채우는 일을 도와주십시오. 그 대가로 길드 출입을 허락하고, 안에서 보상을 누리게 해 드리겠습니다.

english: So do you feel up for the challenge?
translation: 자, 이 도전에 나설 준비가 되셨습니까?

english: Head to Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers at Musa Point. There you'll find Dallas Jones. We've heard that he is investigating the destruction of Crandor. This seems like a good place to begin.
translation: Musa Point(무사 포인트)에 있는 Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers(카람자 와인, 증류주, 맥주)로 가십시오. 그곳에 Dallas Jones(댈러스 존스)가 있을 겁니다. 그가 Crandor(크랜도)의 파괴를 조사하고 있다고 들었습니다. 시작하기에 좋은 곳일 겁니다.

english: Not yet. However, you are on the right path. Complete the task we've assigned you and we will allow you entry into the Guild.
translation: 아직은 아닙니다. 하지만 올바른 길을 걷고 계십니다. 저희가 맡긴 임무를 완수하시면 길드 출입을 허락해 드리겠습니다.

english: I'm afraid the Guild is not currently accepting new members. However, we will soon be opening our doors again.
translation: 유감이지만 지금 길드는 신입 회원을 받지 않고 있습니다. 하지만 곧 다시 문을 열 겁니다.

english: When we do, you should return here. We may well have a place for you.
translation: 그때가 되면 다시 찾아오십시오. 당신을 위한 자리가 있을지도 모릅니다.

english: How can I gain access to the Guild?
Only the most worthy may access our Guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills then return to us.
translation: 가장 자격 있는 자만이 저희 길드에 들어올 수 있는데, 유감이지만 당신은 아직 거기에 미치지 못합니다. 나가서 실력을 갈고닦은 뒤 다시 찾아오십시오.

english: You do not meet all the requirements to start the Dragon Slayer II quest.
translation: Dragon Slayer II(드래곤 슬레이어 II) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 조건을 모두 충족하지 못했습니다.

english: Only the most worthy are allowed access into the Myths' Guild. If you want entry, you'll need to prove yourself.
translation: 가장 자격 있는 자만이 Myths' Guild(신화 길드)에 들어올 수 있습니다. 들어오고 싶으시다면 스스로를 증명하셔야 합니다.

english: Well return to us once you do. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the Guild.
translation: 그렇다면 무언가 알아내는 대로 돌아오십시오. Library of Knowledge(지식의 서고)를 채우는 일을 도와주신다면 길드 출입을 허락해 드리겠습니다.

english: Farewell adventurer.
Tell me about the guild.
Yes.
No.
How can I gain access to the guild?
Let's talk about my quest.
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Guild.
How can I gain access to the Guild?
Hello.
Hello, hello, and a most warm welcome to my Hunter Emporium. We have everything the discerning Hunter could need.
translation: 어서 오세요, 어서 오세요, 저희 Hunter Emporium(사냥 용품점)에 오신 걸 진심으로 환영합니다. 안목 있는 사냥꾼에게 필요한 건 전부 갖추고 있지요.

english: Would you like me to show you our range of equipment? Or was there something specific you were after?
translation: 저희 장비들을 한번 보여 드릴까요? 아니면 특별히 찾으시는 거라도 있으세요?

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
I'm not interested, thanks.
Well, if you do ever find yourself in need of the finest Hunter equipment available, then you know where to come.
translation: 뭐, 언제든 최고급 사냥 장비가 필요해지시면 어디로 오셔야 할지 아시겠죠.

english: Who's that guy over there?
Him? I think he might be crazy. Either that or he's seeking attention.
translation: 저 사람요? 제 생각엔 좀 미친 것 같아요. 아니면 관심을 끌고 싶어서 저러는 거겠죠.

english: He keeps trying to sell me these barmy looking weapons he's invented. I can't see them working, personally.
translation: 자기가 발명했다는 해괴하게 생긴 무기를 자꾸 저한테 팔려고 해요. 제가 보기엔 그게 제대로 작동할 것 같지 않네요.

english: Ok, let's see what you've got!
I'm not interested, thanks.
Who's that guy over there?
Who are you?
[Vampyre name].
Not the one I'm expecting. Move along.
translation: 내가 기다리는 자가 아니군. 썩 꺼져라.

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간이로군! 경비병을 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가라!

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지 않아요, 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 탐험할 완전히 새로운 대륙이라니... 정말 살맛 나는

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있다고 누가 그러는 걸 들었어요, 조심하세요!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭에는 묘목이 심겨 있지 않잖아요. 하나 심으시면 돌봐 드릴지도 모르죠.

english: If you like, but I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
translation: 원하신다면요. 하지만 그 대가로 dragonfruit(용과) 6개는 받아야겠어요.

english: Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 그거면 됐어요, 손님. 저한테 맡겨 두세요. 그 밭이 잘 자라도록 확실히 챙길게요.

english: No, that's too much.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 흥, 공짜로 시간 낭비할 생각은 없어요.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 이미 다 자랐잖아요! 저더러 뭘 하라는 건지 모르겠네요!

english: These take ages to clear! If you pay me 2000 Coins I'll chop it down for you.
translation: 이건 베어 내는 데 한참 걸린다고요! 2000 Coins(코인)을 주시면 베어 드릴게요.

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 여기 2000 Coins(코인)이요. 제 나무 좀 베어 주세요.

english: Alexandra sets to work...
I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
I don't have 2000 Coins I'm afraid.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 과일 바구니에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 최대 다섯 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 수는 없어요.

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 주요 농사 지역은 일곱 곳이에요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단태라) 구역, Ardougne(아르둔) 근처의 Kragen(크라겐) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역, 그리고

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 일반 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만 만드는 데 돈이 더 들어요. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든요. 아이템을 보여 주시면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 드릴게요.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 꾸준히 물을 줘야 해요. 제 조언을 무시하면 머지않아 죽어 버린 농사 밭을 보게 될 거예요.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 기르는 특별한 밭이 있어요. 땅이 좀 '부정 탄' Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처 어딘가였던 것 같아요.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일을 빚기에 좋아요. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다고 들었고, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 그런 데 좋았다는 소문이 있더라고요. 물론 다들 죽기 전 얘기지만요.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 기를 수 있어요. 그곳 땅은 유난히 눅눅해서 독버섯을 기르기에 딱 맞거든요.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어요. 상점은 텃밭 가까이에 있고요.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 흙을 채운 plantpot(화분)에서 묘목으로 키운 다음, 나무 밭에 옮겨 심어서 다 자랄 때까지 키워야 해요.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 덤불이나 나무의 병을 고치는 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 것뿐이에요. 다른 작물에는 그냥 plant-cure(식물 치료제)를 뿌리면 돼요.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 화분을 채울 수 있어요.

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 무슨 이유로든 과일나무를 없애고 싶다면 베어 낸 다음 그루터기를 파내기만 하면 돼요.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭을 갈퀴질하고 나온 잡초를 그냥 버리지 마세요. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만드세요.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 퇴비를 주면 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라 수확량도 늘어나요.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 자루나 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶다면 Falador(팔라도르) 농사 상점 근처에 있는 베틀을 써야 해요. 솜씨 좋은 장인이라면 말이죠.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: 화분을 전부 살 필요는 없어요. 도자기 물레로 직접 만들 수도 있거든요. 솜씨 좋은 장인이라면 말이죠.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 채소 자루에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 최대 열 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 수는 없어요.

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있나요?

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 그건 제가 팔 물건이 있느냐에 달렸죠. 뭘 찾으시는데요?

english: I'll come back another time.
I want 6 dragonfruit for that.
I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 그 밭은 이미 제가 돌봐 드리고 있어요.

english: I'll want 2000 Coins to chop down your redwood. These take ages!
translation: redwood(레드우드)를 베어 드리려면 2000 Coins(코인)은 받아야겠어요. 이건 한참 걸리거든요!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Okay, it's a deal and don't ask again.
translation: 좋아요, 그렇게 하죠. 다음부턴 묻지 마세요.

english: Would you chop my redwood tree down for me?
translation: 제 redwood tree(레드우드 나무) 좀 베어 주실래요?

english: Here's 2000 Coins - chop my tree down please.
translation: 여기 2000 Coins(코인)이요. 제 나무 좀 베어 주세요.

english: I don't want to pay that much, sorry.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'll come back another time.
Yes.
No.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼다면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀었을 거다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니 날 내버려 둬라, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑 말 섞을 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 우울하기 짝이 없는 날이야... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 엄-청 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛을 제대로 즐길 줄 아는 녀석 같아 보이는군.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누구 살점이 좀 꼈거든...

english: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, madam?
translation: Shrimp and Parrot(새우와 앵무새)에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 주문하시겠습니까, 손님?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Where do you get your Karambwan from?
We buy directly off Lubufu, a local fisherman. He seems to have a monopoly over Karambwan sale.
translation: 이 지역 어부인 Lubufu(루부푸)에게서 직접 사들입니다. 그 사람이 카람브완 판매를 독점하고 있는 것 같더군요.

english: Where can I find Lubufu?
He is usually working just to the south of the town.
translation: 보통 마을 바로 남쪽에서 일하고 있습니다.

english: Thanks.
How does he manage a monopoly?
translation: 그 사람은 어떻게 독점을 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Simple - nobody else knows how to catch Karambwan. It is a closely guarded secret.
translation: 간단합니다. 카람브완 잡는 법을 아는 사람이 그 사람 말고는 아무도 없거든요. 철저히 지켜지는 비밀이지요.

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Where do you get your Karambwan from?
Where can I find Lubufu?
How does he manage a monopoly?
translation: 그 사람은 어떻게 독점을 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Hello [player name]. How's the adventuring going?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 모험은 잘돼 가나요?

english: Hi Ali. Not bad. How are you?
translation: 안녕하세요, Ali(알리). 나쁘지 않아요. 잘 지내세요?

english: Still selling.
Hang on a second while I get my stock of blackjacks out.
Hang on a second while I get the garments.
Hang on a second.
Well at the moment I don't exactly have a selection of runes.
translation: 음, 지금은 룬이 그리 다양하게 있지는 않아요.

english: You don't?
Those boxes from your friend Aubury have a very odd locking mechanism.
translation: 당신 친구 Aubury(오버리)가 보낸 상자들은 잠금장치가 아주 이상하거든요.

english: You have managed to get them off?
Not exactly.
What do you mean by 'not exactly'?
What I mean by 'not exactly' is 'no, I haven't managed to get the lock off'.
translation: '꼭 그렇진 않다'는 건 '아뇨, 자물쇠를 못 열었어요'라는 뜻이에요.

english: Oh.

I was kind of hoping that you would have a look at them. There are two distinctive types of caskets one with a simple locking mechanism and another, which ummm... looks a little tricky to say the least.
translation: 당신이 좀 봐 줬으면 하고 내심 기대하고 있었어요. 상자는 확연히 다른 두 종류가 있는데, 하나는 잠금장치가 단순하고, 다른 하나는 음... 아무리 좋게 말해도 좀 까다로워 보여요.

english: I think I'll have a go at opening a small casket of runes.
translation: 룬이 든 작은 상자를 한번 열어 볼게요.

english: Your arms tire from the exertions of trying to open the casket...
translation: 상자를 열려고 애쓰느라 팔이 지쳐 버렸다...

english: You fail to open the chest.
You fail to pick the lock - your fingers get numb from fumbling with the lock.
translation: 자물쇠를 따는 데 실패했다. 자물쇠를 만지작거리느라 손가락이 저려 온다.

english: I'm feeling lucky, let's have a look at opening one of those large caskets.
translation: 운이 좋을 것 같은 느낌이에요. 큰 상자 하나를 열어 볼게요.

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to prise open.
translation: 흠... 이 자물쇠는 억지로 비틀어 여는 건 불가능해 보여요.

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to pick open.
translation: 흠... 이 자물쇠는 따서 여는 건 불가능해 보여요.

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 룬은 딱히 필요 없을 것 같아요.

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
Oh! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday!
translation: 아! 안타깝게도 그거 어제로 기한이 끝난 것 같네요!

english: But I only just got it from Ali the Leaflet dropper!
translation: 하지만 방금 Ali the Leaflet dropper(전단지 돌리는 알리)한테서 받은 건데요!

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 미안하지만 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 게 없어요.

english: But you're the one that had them printed!
translation: 하지만 그걸 찍어 낸 사람이 당신이잖아요!

english: Look, I had those printed to win over the local traders. They weren't too pleased with the money off voucher, but I promised them I would repay their losses.
translation: 이봐요, 그건 이 지역 상인들 마음을 얻으려고 찍은 거예요. 상인들이 할인 쿠폰을 그리 달가워하지 않았지만, 손실은 제가 메워 주겠다고 약속했죠.

english: So that would be why they're all out of date then?
translation: 그래서 쿠폰이 전부 기한이 지난 거군요?

english: I don't know what you mean...
Anyway, it would be a shame for you to leave without looking at my wares.
translation: 어쨌든 제 물건도 안 보고 그냥 가시면 섭섭하죠.

english: Anything interesting?
For you, always. As a matter of fact I have just acquired a fleet of magic carpets, which operate throughout the Kharidian desert.
translation: 당신에게는 언제나 있죠. 실은 마침 Kharidian desert(카리디안 사막) 전역을 오가는 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 운송단을 통째로 손에 넣었거든요.

english: Wow that sounds great, how about your stall?
Trade is good, but I would like to expand and diversify, but it's proving a little more difficult than I initially thought.
translation: 장사는 잘되지만 사업을 확장하고 다각화하고 싶거든요. 그런데 생각했던 것보다 좀 어렵네요.

english: How so?
I think the other merchants are conspiring against me.
translation: 다른 상인들이 짜고 저를 따돌리는 것 같아요.

english: Oh come on! You're just being paranoid now.
translation: 에이, 왜 이래요! 그건 그냥 피해망상이에요.

english: Well maybe I can't get any new suppliers then because I'm Pollnivnian.
translation: 그럼 제가 Pollnivnian(폴니브니치안)이라서 새 공급자를 못 구하는 건지도 모르죠.

english: You're what?
From Pollnivneach.
Maybe I could help you then?
translation: 그럼 제가 도와드릴 수 있지 않을까요?

english: Perhaps you could.
My friend in Sophanem... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
translation: Sophanem(소파넴)에 있는 제 친구가... 아, 그 친구는 됐어요. 그 사람은 다음에 한번 알아보도록 하죠.

english: Is there anyone else you want me to talk to on your behalf?
translation: 제가 대신 이야기해 줬으면 하는 다른 사람은 없어요?

english: There's a blackjack seller in Pollnivneach, a cautious type of guy, not the usual entrepreneurial sort that I would normally deal with, but...
translation: Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)에 곤봉 장수가 하나 있어요. 조심성 많은 친구라 제가 평소 거래하는 사업가 기질 있는 부류는 아니지만...

english: I think that he has a product with real potential...
translation: 진짜 가능성 있는 상품을 갖고 있는 것 같거든요...

english: What? .... Blackjacks?
Yes, but at the moment the product isn't polished enough, if you could convince him to create a larger variety of weapon I would gladly stock his products.
translation: 네, 하지만 지금은 상품이 좀 덜 다듬어졌어요. 그 사람을 설득해서 무기 종류를 더 다양하게 만들게 해 준다면 기꺼이 그 사람 상품을 들여놓을게요.

english: What's in this for me?
I thought you wanted to help.
Of course, but everyone seems to be benefiting here but me.
translation: 물론이죠. 그런데 다들 이득을 보는데 저만 빠진 것 같아서요.

english: What do you mean?
Well the trader gets their product sold, you get your cut, but what do I get?
translation: 상인은 물건을 팔고, 당신은 몫을 챙기는데, 저는 뭘 얻죠?

english: You get access to more products. Is that not reward enough?
translation: 더 많은 상품을 접할 수 있게 되잖아요. 그걸로는 보상이 안 되나요?

english: Hmmm... Perhaps not.
Didn't we also agree that you would get discounted travel on my magic carpet network?
translation: 제 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 운송망을 할인된 가격에 이용하게 해 주기로 하지 않았던가요?

english: Oh ya, I forgot.
So what's your problem then?
I don't have one I guess.
Good, that's what I like to hear. Now where were we?
translation: 좋아요, 그런 말을 듣고 싶었어요. 자, 어디까지 얘기했더라?

english: Ok I'll get on to it.
I have an old friend - a cloth merchant Siamun, who lives in Sophanem - Do you know the place?
translation: 옛 친구 중에 Sophanem(소파넴)에 사는 Siamun(시아문)이라는 옷감 상인이 있어요. 거기 아세요?

english: Umm..... Images of cats and priests come to mind. Ah yes! There we go, it's the city of the dead South of Pollnivneach isn't it?
translation: 음..... 고양이랑 사제들이 떠오르네요. 아, 맞다! Pollnivneach(폴니브니치) 남쪽에 있는 죽은 자들의 도시 맞죠?

english: That's the one, well if you could convince him to supply me with some of his merchandise, I would be more than willing to sell them to the masses ...... for a small percentage of course.
translation: 바로 거기예요. 그 사람을 설득해서 저한테 물건을 좀 대 주게 해 준다면, 기꺼이 대중에게 팔아 드릴게요...... 물론 약간의 수수료는 받고요.

english: Siamun's clothes seem to have really struck a chord with the locals in Al Kharid. Menaphite culture seems to be taking off here, rumour has it that one of Prince Ali's servants bought him one of Siamun's robes.
translation: Siamun(시아문)의 옷이 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 사람들 마음을 제대로 사로잡은 것 같아요. 여기서 Menaphite(메나파이트) 문화가 유행을 타는 모양이에요. 소문에는 Prince Ali(알리 왕자)의 하인 하나가 왕자에게 시아문의 로브를 사다 바쳤다더군요.

english: Wow, that sounds positive.
Quite, if I don't say so myself. But in order to keep things fresh, the next time you're in Sophanem, could you ask that cranky old so-and-so Siamun to produce a new line of clothing?
translation: 그렇죠, 제가 생각해도요. 하지만 신선함을 유지하려면... 다음에 Sophanem(소파넴)에 가거든 그 까다로운 영감 Siamun(시아문)에게 새 옷 라인을 만들어 달라고 해 줄래요?

english: Sure, why not. The Sultan himself might even buy some of the new range.
translation: 그럼요, 안 될 거 없죠. 어쩌면 술탄께서 직접 새 상품을 사실지도 몰라요.

english: That would be the day.
Who did you want me to talk to again?
Could you talk to your friend Aubury in Varrock about supplying me with runes?
translation: Varrock(바록)에 있는 당신 친구 Aubury(오버리)에게 룬을 공급해 달라고 이야기해 줄래요?

english: Hmm, that could work out quite well. Varrock is always quite busy, so I might try to get a couple of other things done while I'm there.
translation: 음, 그거 꽤 잘될 것 같네요. Varrock(바록)은 늘 붐비니까 거기 있는 동안 다른 일도 몇 가지 처리해 볼게요.

english: Don't tarry there too long, I'm quite anxious to get a rune store open before anyone else in this area.
translation: 거기서 너무 오래 꾸물거리진 마세요. 이 근방에서 누구보다 먼저 룬 가게를 열고 싶어서 애가 타거든요.

english: I'll get to it right away.
I'll tell you what then, how about I let you have discounted flights on my magic carpet rides?
translation: 그럼 이렇게 하죠. 제 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 이용 요금을 할인해 드리면 어때요?

english: Wow that would be great.
Fair enough, so we have a win, win, win situation on our hands then.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 셋 다 이득을 보는 윈-윈-윈 상황이네요.

english: I think I need just one more product type, something, magical ... now what could I stock that's magical, has large demand and a pretty good profit margin...
translation: 상품 종류가 딱 하나만 더 있으면 될 것 같아요. 뭔가, 마법적인 거... 마법적이면서 수요도 많고 이윤도 꽤 남는 걸 뭘 들여놓을 수 있을까...

english: How about runes?
Yes, that would be perfect, but who could I get that would supply? There really seems to be a gap in the market in the desert but I don't know anyone in that line of business.
translation: 네, 그거라면 완벽하겠네요. 그런데 누구한테 공급받죠? 사막에는 확실히 시장에 빈틈이 있는데, 그쪽 업계에 아는 사람이 없어요.

english: Hang on, I know somebody called Aubury, decent fella. I helped him out a while back. Perhaps I could approach him about the idea.
translation: 잠깐만요, 제가 Aubury(오버리)라는 사람을 알아요. 괜찮은 친구예요. 얼마 전에 도와준 적이 있거든요. 그 사람한테 이 얘기를 꺼내 볼 수도 있겠네요.

english: Oh yes, the rune seller from Varrock. That would be perfect. He's far enough away that he wouldn't end up competing with himself.
translation: 아, 그래요, Varrock(바록)의 룬 상인 말이죠. 그거 완벽하네요. 충분히 멀리 있으니 자기 자신과 경쟁하게 되진 않을 거예요.

english: What do you mean?
Well the rune market is a limited one, if I were to sell his runes from a location nearby his shop, then I would take part of his market share so he would in fact not benefit from me selling runes.
translation: 음, 룬 시장은 한정돼 있거든요. 제가 그 사람 가게 근처에서 그 사람 룬을 팔면 그 사람 시장 점유율 일부를 가져가게 되니, 결국 제가 룬을 팔아도 그 사람한텐 이득이 없는 거죠.

english: Ah ha, I think I know where this is going. So because you're located far enough away from him you will take up someone else's share in the market and Aubury will make more money as a result.
translation: 아하, 무슨 얘긴지 알겠네요. 당신이 충분히 멀리 있으니까 다른 누군가의 시장 몫을 가져오게 되고, 결과적으로 Aubury(오버리)는 돈을 더 벌게 된다는 거군요.

english: Very well anticipated.
Well you had better get going, you've a fair bit of travelling ahead of you. Unless you want to make a small purchase from me first?
translation: 자, 이제 가 보시는 게 좋겠어요. 갈 길이 꽤 멀거든요. 아니면 먼저 저한테서 뭘 좀 사 가시겠어요?

english: No, I'm really too busy.
Okay.
Good job on getting the rune stone shipments sorted. I'm just receiving the first of them. Though there seems to be a funny sort of locking mechanism on them, which I haven't completely figured out.
translation: 룬 스톤 운송 건을 잘 해결해 줬네요. 마침 첫 물량을 받고 있어요. 그런데 상자에 이상한 잠금장치가 달려 있어서 아직 완전히 알아내진 못했어요.

english: No problem. I might have a look at it later.
[player name], I would like to commend you on all the selfless help you have given me.
translation: [player name] 님, 그동안 저를 사심 없이 도와준 것에 찬사를 보내고 싶어요.

english: It was nothing, really.
I think you underestimate your efforts. Anyway, as a token of my gratitude I have told all my magic carpet attendants to allow you to travel on the carpets at a discounted rate.
translation: 자신의 노고를 과소평가하시는군요. 어쨌든 감사의 표시로 제 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 안내원들에게 당신은 할인된 요금으로 양탄자를 탈 수 있게 해 주라고 일러 뒀어요.

english: Really, Ali, there is no need.
I insist.
I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
Of course, my friend. Any good salesman ought to take the opportunities that present themselves.
translation: 물론이죠, 친구. 훌륭한 장사꾼이라면 눈앞에 온 기회는 잡아야 하는 법이죠.

english: But your men are threatening the other shopkeepers!
translation: 하지만 당신 부하들이 다른 가게 주인들을 협박하고 있잖아요!

english: That is regrettable, I'm afraid.
And the gnomes don't sound very happy about your magic carpet business.
translation: 그리고 노움들은 당신의 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 사업을 별로 반기지 않는 것 같던데요.

english: A good businessman looks for all the opportunities he can.
translation: 훌륭한 사업가는 잡을 수 있는 기회는 모두 노리는 법이죠.

english: Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 부하들한테 어떻게 좀 하지 않을 거예요?

english: Well, these associates of my nephew can be somewhat... overenthusiastic.
translation: 음, 제 조카와 어울리는 그 친구들이 좀... 의욕이 넘칠 때가 있어서요.

english: I'm sure they'll settle down soon.
But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 하지만 가게 주인들이 협조하지 않으면 해치겠다고 협박하고 있다고요!

english: Well, there's a simple solution there, don't you agree?
translation: 음, 그렇다면 간단한 해결책이 있잖아요, 안 그래요?

english: Are you planning to take over all of Al Kharid's shops?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 가게를 전부 차지할 생각이에요?

english: It's a step in the right direction.
Now, would you like to have a look at my wares?
What will you do about the gnomes?
They can continue running their gliders into trees, and I'll keep my business going. Sooner or later it'll all work out in my favour.
translation: 그들은 계속 글라이더를 나무에 처박으면 되고, 저는 제 사업을 계속하면 돼요. 머지않아 모든 게 제게 유리하게 풀릴 거예요.

english: I suppose so...
Anyway, before you go, take a look at my wares.
translation: 어쨌든 가기 전에 제 물건 좀 보세요.

english: Well, good luck with your business.
Before you go, have a look at my wares.
translation: 가기 전에 제 물건 좀 보세요.

english: I would like to have a look at your selection of blackjacks.
I would like to have a look at your selection of clothes.
I would like to have a look at your selection of runes.
Try opening a small casket of runes
translation: 룬이 든 작은 상자 열어 보기

english: Force box.
Buy all the runes for [amount].
Find out what the runes are.
Pick lock.
Examine lock.
Try opening a large casket of runes
translation: 룬이 든 큰 상자 열어 보기

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any runes.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 룬은 딱히 필요 없을 것 같아요.

english: I would like to have a look at your general stock.
So what's in this for me?
Ok I'll get on to it.
Who did you want me to talk to again?
No I'm really too busy.
Ok
I hear you're planning to expand your business here...
Aren't you going to do anything about your men?
translation: 부하들한테 어떻게 좀 하지 않을 거예요?

english: But they're threatening to hurt the shopkeepers if they don't cooperate!
translation: 하지만 가게 주인들이 협조하지 않으면 해치겠다고 협박하고 있다고요!

english: No, I'm really too busy.
Okay.
Well, good luck with your business.
What will you do about the gnomes?
Hello there.
Good day. Can I help you with anything?
Yes, I'd like a drink please.
What's going on in town?
Nothing much really. About what you'd expect from a sleepy little town like ours.
translation: 별일 없어요. 저희 같은 한적한 작은 마을이야 뭐, 다 그렇죠.

english: What about those two gangs? That seems exciting.
They're paying customers, so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
translation: 그 사람들도 돈 내는 손님이니까, 괜찮으시다면 저는 괜히 평지풍파 일으키지 않을게요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
No thanks, I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 시간 내 주셔서 고마워요.

english: I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
He was just here! Look, he's even left his drink on the table by those barrels. Must have nipped out to go to the toilet.
translation: 방금 여기 있었는데요! 보세요, 저기 통들 옆 탁자에 마시던 술까지 두고 갔잖아요. 화장실 가려고 잠깐 나간 게 분명해요.

english: He might be gone a while though. The nearest outhouse is all the way over on Fossil Island.
translation: 그래도 한참 걸릴지도 몰라요. 제일 가까운 뒷간이 저 멀리 Fossil Island(화석 섬)에 있거든요.

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
Well, I'm called Ali and I'm from here. Are you looking for me?
translation: 음, 제 이름이 Ali(알리)고 여기 출신인데요. 저를 찾으시는 건가요?

english: Do you have an uncle called Ali?
Yes! All my uncles are called Ali!
translation: 네! 제 삼촌들은 전부 이름이 Ali(알리)예요!

english: Oh dear. Well do any of your uncles have a stall in the Bazaar in Al Kharid?
translation: 이런. 그럼 삼촌 중에 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 시장에 노점을 낸 분이 있나요?

english: Um... no.
Well do you know if anyone here does?
translation: 그럼 여기 누구든 그런 사람이 있는지 아세요?

english: That's a difficult question to answer. I don't know anyone else's uncles.
translation: 대답하기 어려운 질문이네요. 다른 사람 삼촌은 잘 몰라서요.

english: The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: 'Asp and Snake(독사와 뱀)'요? 술집 이름치고 참 이상하네요.

english: Maybe around these parts. Were you expecting it to have 'Ali' in the name?
translation: 이 근방에선 그럴지도요. 이름에 'Ali(알리)'가 들어갈 줄 아셨어요?

english: I did think about calling it 'Ali's', but then it'd get confused with the Camel Shop, the Kebab House, the Mayor's residence...
translation: 'Ali's(알리네)'라고 지을까도 생각했는데, 그러면 낙타 상점, 케밥 가게, 시장 관저랑 헷갈릴 테니까요...

english: Yes, I get your point. It's a perfectly fine name.
translation: 네, 무슨 말인지 알겠어요. 아주 괜찮은 이름이네요.

english: Yes, I'd like a drink please.
What's going on in town?
No thanks, I'm ok.
Yes, I'd like to talk about something else.
I'm looking for Traitorous Ali.
I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
The 'Asp and Snake'? What a strange name for a bar.
translation: 'Asp and Snake(독사와 뱀)'요? 술집 이름치고 참 이상하네요.

english: That beast would probably bite my fingers off if I tried to pet it.
translation: 저 짐승은 쓰다듬으려 했다간 내 손가락을 물어뜯을 거야.

english: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it!
translation: 손가락 물어뜯기고 싶으면 아주 제대로 하고 있는 거야!

english: I'm not going to pet that! It will probably bite my hand off, that filthy beast.
translation: 저걸 쓰다듬을 생각 없어! 손을 물어뜯길 게 뻔해, 저 더러운 짐승.

english: Watch who you're calling a filthy beast, human.
Mmmm... you'd make a tasty kebab.
And you'd make an excellent spit bucket! Pchoo!
translation: 그럼 넌 아주 훌륭한 침받이가 되겠군! 퉤!

english: I'm not going to pet that nasty creature! I might get fleas... or worse!
translation: 저 고약한 녀석을 쓰다듬을 생각 없어! 벼룩이 옮을지도 몰라... 아니면 더 심한 거라도!

english: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. When was the last time you took a shower?
translation: 너도 꽤 고약하거든, 인간. 마지막으로 샤워한 게 언제야?

english: Welcome to my discount camel store. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 제 할인 낙타 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 뭐 도와드릴 거라도 있나요?

english: A discount camel store?
Yes - it's my great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel of their very own! They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!
translation: 그래요. 제가 생각해 낸 기막힌 아이디어죠. 낙타를 할인가에 팔아서 평범한 사람들도 자기만의 낙타를 갖는 기쁨을 누릴 수 있게 하는 거예요! 낙타는 그냥 케밥 고기가 아니라고요!

english: So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 그럼 낙타 한 마리 살 수 있어요? 배고프거든요!

english: I would never sell one to the likes of you! They are beautiful, majestic creatures, not food! Get out of my shop.
translation: 당신 같은 사람한텐 절대 안 팔아요! 낙타는 아름답고 위풍당당한 동물이지, 음식이 아니라고요! 당장 제 가게에서 나가요.

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
Ah, wondrous camels! Best of all Saradomin's creations. Ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. Truly, they are a man's best friend.
translation: 아, 경이로운 낙타여! Saradomin(사라도민)께서 만드신 피조물 중 으뜸이지요. 사막의 배라고요, 말이나 당나귀보다 훨씬 쓸모 있죠. 정말이지 사람의 가장 좋은 친구라니까요.

english: Perhaps you'd like a camel of your own? You're in the right place, if so...
translation: 혹시 당신만의 낙타를 갖고 싶으신가요? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요...

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 그 밖에 또 도와드릴 일이 있나요?

english: No but thanks for your time.
Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 낙타가 왜 필요하겠어요? 하는 거라곤 침 뱉고...

english: Pah! I've seen mummies with more brains than you! If you treat camels badly then of course they're going to spit at you. May your robes never be clean again!
translation: 흥! 당신보다 머리 좋은 미라도 본 적 있어요! 낙타를 함부로 대하니까 당연히 침을 뱉는 거죠. 당신 옷이 두 번 다시 깨끗해지지 않기를!

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 사실 전생에 제가 낙타였던 것 같아요.

english: You're teasing me now! You rogue!
translation: 지금 절 놀리는 거죠! 이 못된 사람 같으니!

english: Everyone laughs at the poor Discount Camel Seller.
translation: 다들 불쌍한 할인 낙타 장수를 비웃는다니까요.

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
Business is booming! Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
translation: 장사가 아주 대박이에요! Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)에 이렇게 많은 손님이 온 건 처음이라니까요.

english: In fact I'm thinking of expanding and trying to break into the camel hire market.
