translation: 사실 사업을 넓혀서 낙타 대여 시장에도 뛰어들어 볼까 생각 중이에요.

english: If only I could figure out how to get people to return the camels...
translation: 사람들이 낙타를 돌려주게 할 방법만 알아낼 수 있다면...

english: Tell me about this town.
Well, Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it'd be nice and quiet.
translation: 글쎄요, Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)는 좀 묘한 곳이에요. 작은 마을이니 조용하고 평화로울 것 같잖아요.

english: But those Menaphites and bandits are making the place quite unbearable.
translation: 그런데 저 Menaphite(메나파이트)들과 산적들 때문에 도저히 견딜 수가 없어요.

english: In what way?
Well, one group is as bad as the other! They steal, they fight, they cause trouble with us locals. Just yesterday one of those bandits came looking for protection money!
translation: 글쎄요, 그놈이 그놈이에요! 훔치고, 싸우고, 우리 주민들한테 말썽을 일으키죠. 바로 어제도 산적 하나가 보호비를 뜯으러 왔다니까요!

english: Why don't the authorities stop this?
translation: 관리들은 왜 이걸 안 막는 거죠?

english: We're a small town. We don't have the resources to keep the gangs off our backs! Menaphos and Al Kharid are no help either.
translation: 우린 작은 마을이에요. 패거리들을 떼어 낼 여력이 없어요! Menaphos(메나포스)도 Al Kharid(알 카리드)도 도움이 안 되고요.

english: To tell the truth we live in hope that an outsider, someone with no ties to either group, could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
translation: 솔직히 말하면, 양쪽 어디와도 얽히지 않은 외지인이 나서서 그들 사이의 싸움을 멈추게 해 주길 바라며 살고 있어요.

english: Hmm...
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 약자는 언제나 짓밟히기 마련이죠. 왜 맞서지 않는 거예요?

english: That's a little unfair, my friend. We can't all be brave adventurers. If we were, where would you purchase quality camels at discounted prices?
translation: 그건 좀 불공평한 말이네요, 친구. 모두가 용감한 모험가일 수는 없잖아요. 다들 그랬다면 당신은 어디서 질 좋은 낙타를 할인가에 사겠어요?

english: You might think about that. Anyway, isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to protect the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
translation: 한번 생각해 보세요. 그나저나, 약하고 죄 없는 사람들을 악과 위험에서 지키는 게 용감한 모험가가 할 일 아닌가요?

english: Perhaps I could help.
Yes, perhaps you could.
You know the politics better than I do. What do you recommend?
translation: 이 동네 정세는 저보다 잘 아시잖아요. 어떻게 하면 좋을까요?

english: Me?! I am but a humble discount camel seller. You're the adventurer, don't you know what to do?
translation: 저요?! 저는 그저 보잘것없는 할인 낙타 장수일 뿐이에요. 모험가는 당신이잖아요, 어떻게 해야 할지 모르세요?

english: Of course I know what to do! I was just testing you!
translation: 당연히 알죠! 그냥 시험해 본 거예요!

english: That is reassuring to hear. Too often one meets brainless adventurers whose solution to every problem is to hack, maim and murder.
translation: 그 말을 들으니 안심이 되네요. 무슨 문제든 베고, 상처 입히고, 죽이는 걸로만 해결하려는 머리 빈 모험가들을 너무 자주 만나거든요.

english: I'm glad to know you're not of that ilk.
Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 제가 알아야 하는 게 맞겠지만, 해 주는 조언은 마다하지 않는 법이죠.

english: The state of adventurers today. They need everything spelled out for them.
translation: 요즘 모험가들이란. 뭐든 하나하나 다 짚어 줘야 한다니까요.

english: What, you want me to put a little note in your quest journal?
translation: 뭐예요, 퀘스트 일지에 쪽지라도 하나 끼워 드릴까요?

english: But fine, I'll give you a hint. Try and see if you can get the gangs to agree to a truce by offering them each a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
translation: 하지만 좋아요, 힌트를 드리죠. 화해의 표시로 양쪽 패거리에게 각각 작은 선물을 주고 휴전에 동의하게 할 수 있는지 해 보세요.

english: If that fails to work, you must consider trying to influence the gangs from within.
translation: 그게 안 통하면, 패거리 안으로 들어가 내부에서 손을 쓰는 방법을 생각해 봐야 할 거예요.

english: Lovely day isn't it?
It's a beautiful day today, but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
translation: 오늘은 화창하지만, 내일은 비가 온다는 소문이 있어요.

english: Really?
No! When have you ever known it to rain here in Gielinor?
translation: 아뇨! 여기 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 비 오는 걸 본 적이나 있어요?

english: Oh. Anyway...
Those two camels around the side are already sold.
translation: 옆쪽에 있는 낙타 두 마리는 이미 팔렸어요.

english: But you are in luck - I have another two beautiful camels arriving in soon from the best stable in all of Al Kharid.
translation: 그래도 운이 좋으시네요. Al Kharid(알 카리드) 최고의 마구간에서 아름다운 낙타 두 마리가 곧 더 들어올 거거든요.

english: Camels, beautiful? I worry about you.
Can you tell me a little about them?
translation: 그 낙타들에 대해 조금 알려 주실래요?

english: Well Sandy, the female camel is a placid beast, and is 20 years of age and comes from a prestigious family whose mother was the part of the Sultan's baggage train.
translation: 음, 암컷인 Sandy(샌디)는 온순한 녀석인데, 스무 살이고 명문가 출신이에요. 어미가 술탄의 짐 운반 행렬에 속해 있었거든요.

english: Lumps, on the other hand is a 15 year old male, a bit surly and prone to bouts of stubbornness. However he more than makes up for this failing with his immense strength and stamina.
translation: 반면 Lumps(럼프스)는 열다섯 살 수컷인데, 좀 퉁명스럽고 툭하면 고집을 부려요. 하지만 엄청난 힘과 지구력으로 그 단점을 메우고도 남죠.

english: Both of them are of the 'Camelus Horribleus' family, a breed peculiar only to this area of Gielinor. It is....
translation: 둘 다 'Camelus Horribleus(카멜루스 호리블레우스)' 계통인데, Gielinor(길리노르)에서도 이 지역에만 있는 특이한 품종이에요. 이 품종은....

english: Ok, ok, that's enough! So they're camels then!
translation: 알았어요, 알았어요, 그만하면 됐어요! 결국 낙타라는 거잖아요!

english: What price do you want for both of them?
translation: 두 마리 다 해서 얼마를 원하세요?

english: One cannot put a price on life, they are precious beyond the worth of the crass value of gold coins!
translation: 생명에는 값을 매길 수 없어요. 그 아이들은 천박한 금화 따위로는 따질 수 없을 만큼 소중하다고요!

english: So can I have them for free then?
Are you trying to be funny?
Perhaps I could make another offer?
Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
Pah! That might buy you a mangy flea infested sheep if you're lucky. Don't insult me.
translation: 흥! 그 돈이면 운 좋으면 벼룩 들끓는 비루먹은 양 한 마리나 살 수 있을걸요. 절 모욕하지 마세요.

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
You don't even have that much money do you? Come back when you're able to make a proper offer and stop wasting my time.
translation: 그만한 돈도 없잖아요? 제대로 된 값을 부를 수 있을 때 다시 와서 시간 낭비 그만 시켜요.

english: I would consider giving them to you if you were able to look after them. But it is abundantly clear that you've got your hands full at the moment.
translation: 당신이 그 아이들을 돌볼 수 있다면 넘겨줄 생각도 있어요. 하지만 지금은 손이 꽉 차 있는 게 뻔히 보이네요.

english: I suppose I can silence my moral objections for that.
translation: 그 정도라면 도덕적인 반대는 접어 둘 수 있겠네요.

english: Ali the discount camel seller gives you a receipt for the camels in return for 500 gold coins.
translation: 할인 낙타 장수 Ali(알리)가 500골드를 받고 낙타 receipt(영수증)을 건네준다.

english: Here are the receipts for the camels so that you can pick them up as soon as I get them in.
translation: 낙타가 들어오는 대로 바로 데려가실 수 있게 낙타 영수증을 드릴게요.

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
You are too generous, I would have sold for half of that!
translation: 너무 후하시네요. 그 절반에도 팔았을 텐데!

english: Hello! Welcome back to my discount camel store. How are those camels getting along?
translation: 안녕하세요! 할인 낙타 가게에 다시 오신 걸 환영해요. 낙타들은 잘 지내고 있나요?

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt can I have another?
translation: 그 낙타 말인데요, 영수증을 잃어버렸어요. 하나 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: I think you're trying to con me into giving you an extra receipt.
translation: 영수증을 하나 더 받아 내려고 절 속이려는 것 같은데요.

english: No problem, There you go.
I decided to get rid of the camels.
Why? did they not please you?
No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 네, 마음에 안 들어서 케밥 고기로 팔아 버렸어요!

english: Not Sandy and Lumps! You beast! Get out of my shop now!
translation: Sandy(샌디)랑 Lumps(럼프스)를! 이 짐승 같은 사람! 당장 내 가게에서 나가요!

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 제가 낙타랑은 잘 안 맞아서 더 좋은 주인에게 줬어요.

english: Didn't I warn you that a camel is not like a puppy or a kitten, fun for a few days and then a tasty snack? They're more than that, they're for life!
translation: 낙타는 며칠 재밌게 데리고 놀다가 맛있는 간식이 되는 강아지나 새끼 고양이 같은 게 아니라고 경고했잖아요? 그 이상의 존재라고요, 평생 함께하는 거예요!

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 그 낙타들로 두 패거리 사이의 싸움을 끝내 보려고 했어요.

english: A noble purpose for two noble beasts! Did you succeed?
translation: 고귀한 두 동물을 위한 고귀한 목적이군요! 성공했나요?

english: Still working on that, I'm afraid.
Good luck with that.
Hey Ali!
Hello adventurer.
Any news?
Not much really, I just want to thank you for what you have done for this village, I can now get on with business.
translation: 별건 없어요. 그냥 이 마을을 위해 해 주신 일에 감사드리고 싶어요. 덕분에 이제 마음 놓고 장사할 수 있게 됐거든요.

english: Any grand plans?
Well I've been debating whether I should diversify. I might move into camel rental although I do have all these cages lying around which I could put to some use.
translation: 음, 사업을 다각화할지 고민 중이에요. 낙타 대여 쪽으로 옮겨 갈 수도 있고, 여기 굴러다니는 철창도 잔뜩 있으니 어디 쓸 데가 있을 것 같기도 하고요.

english: Well good luck to you in whatever venture you do decide to go ahead with.
translation: 무슨 사업을 하기로 하든 잘되길 바라요.

english: Thank you.
A discount camel store?
So can I buy a camel then? I'm hungry!
translation: 그럼 낙타 한 마리 살 수 있어요? 배고프거든요!

english: Yes, camels are beautiful creatures.
Well yes actually I'd like to ask about something else.
translation: 네, 사실 다른 걸 물어보고 싶어요.

english: No but thanks for your time.
Why would I want a camel? All they do is spit and...
translation: 낙타가 왜 필요하겠어요? 하는 거라곤 침 뱉고...

english: Actually, I think I was a camel in a previous life.
translation: 사실 전생에 제가 낙타였던 것 같아요.

english: So is the discount camel business good then?
Tell me about this town.
In what way?
Well the weak will always be trodden on. Why not stand up to them?
translation: 약자는 언제나 짓밟히기 마련이죠. 왜 맞서지 않는 거예요?

english: Perhaps I could help.
Indeed I should know, and indeed I do! I was just testing you!
translation: 당연히 알아야죠, 그리고 물론 알고 있어요! 그냥 시험해 본 거예요!

english: Perhaps I should know, but offered advice should never be shunned.
translation: 제가 알아야 하는 게 맞겠지만, 해 주는 조언은 마다하지 않는 법이죠.

english: Lovely day isn't it?
Are those camels around the side for sale?
Can you tell me a little about them?
translation: 그 낙타들에 대해 조금 알려 주실래요?

english: What price do you want for both of them?
translation: 두 마리 다 해서 얼마를 원하세요?

english: So can I have them for free then?
Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
About those camels, I've lost the receipt. Can I have another?
translation: 그 낙타 말인데요, 영수증을 잃어버렸어요. 하나 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: I decided to get rid of the camels.
No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 네, 마음에 안 들어서 Kebab(케밥) 고기로 팔아 버렸어요!

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 제가 낙타랑은 잘 안 맞아서 더 좋은 주인에게 줬어요.

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 그 낙타들로 두 패거리 사이의 싸움을 끝내 보려고 했어요.

english: I'm looking for Ali from Pollnivneach.
You look glum.
Business here really seems to have dried up. I had a good thing going here and you spoiled it.
translation: 여기 장사가 완전히 말라 버렸어. 잘나가고 있었는데 네가 다 망쳐 놨지.

english: Well it serves you right really. Taking advantage of people like that.
translation: 뭐, 자업자득이죠. 사람들 그렇게 등쳐 먹더니.

english: So want to buy some water?
How much?
To you 1000 coins for a waterskin!
You don't have 1000 coins to buy the water with.
You buy a full waterskin for 1000 coins!
I think I'll give it a miss.
If you want water you need to buy it off me.
Ok, I feel sorry for you.
I think I'll give it a miss.
Hello there!
Oh, er, hello. What do you want?
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: There's not much farming land around here. Only that little patch outside.
translation: 이 근처엔 농사지을 땅이 별로 없어요. 바깥에 있는 작은 밭뿐이죠.

english: Can you give me any advice on farming here in the desert?
translation: 여기 사막에서 농사짓는 요령 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Like I said, I only know about cactuses...
Just tell me about cactuses, then.
First you have to weed the patch using a rake.
translation: 먼저 rake(갈퀴)로 밭의 잡초를 뽑아야 해요.

english: Can you give me any other advice?
Not really. I've not done much farming recently.
translation: 별로요. 요즘은 농사를 거의 안 했거든요.

english: Well, can you at least sell me any gardening tools or seeds?
translation: 그럼 원예 도구나 씨앗이라도 좀 파실 수 있어요?

english: Sorry. They haven't been delivered yet.
So, what do you do here?
I'm going to set up a shop selling farming implements. That patch out there may be small, but it's all we've got.
translation: 농기구 파는 가게를 차릴 거예요. 저 밖에 있는 밭이 작긴 해도 우리한텐 그게 전부거든요.

english: I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yes, he bought these tents and had them put up for us. He says he'll also get our goods in so we can start selling them soon.
translation: 네, 그분이 이 천막들을 사서 우리를 위해 세워 줬어요. 물건도 들여와 줄 테니 곧 장사를 시작할 수 있을 거래요.

english: I only know how to farm cactuses, so this spot is perfect.
translation: 전 선인장 농사밖에 모르니까 여기가 딱이에요.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 물론이죠. 그분은 사업 파트너가 될 만한 사람이라면 언제든 반갑게 이야기해요.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Now why would you think that?
One of the shopkeepers told they were threatened by a man with a rake...
translation: 가게 주인 한 명이 rake(갈퀴)를 든 남자한테 협박당했다고 하던데요...

english: Those people just don't want us to succeed. Don't listen to them!
translation: 그 사람들은 우리가 잘되는 게 싫은 거예요. 그 말 듣지 마세요!

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Hello there!
I'm working. What do you have to say that's so urgent?
translation: 근무 중이야. 뭐가 그리 급해서 말을 거는 거지?

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: There's a lot of space here. More open space than back home.
translation: 여긴 공간이 넓어. 고향보다 탁 트인 땅이 많지.

english: So where is back home?
Pollnivneach. It's a town to the south of the Shantay Pass.
translation: Pollnivneach(폴니브니치). Shantay Pass(샨테이 통행로) 남쪽에 있는 마을이야.

english: So, what do you do here?
I'm on guard duty. Making sure nobody tries to steal anything from the house and tents in the middle of town.
translation: 경비 근무 중이지. 마을 한가운데 있는 집이랑 천막에서 누가 뭘 훔쳐 가지 않게 지키는 거야.

english: Why are you only guarding those buildings?
That's all I've been hired to guard.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yeah, he hired me. He owns this house and these two tents, too.
translation: 그래, 그 사람이 날 고용했어. 이 집이랑 천막 두 개도 그 사람 거야.

english: Is the work good?
It pays better than back home.
Why, what did you do back home?
Never you mind.
But Ali Morrisane pays us well, at least.
translation: 그래도 Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)은 돈 하나는 잘 쳐줘.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Why not? He always likes to meet potential business partners.
translation: 그러든가. 그 사람은 사업 파트너가 될 만한 사람 만나는 걸 늘 좋아하니까.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
So? They talk too much.
You're not going to deny it?
Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
translation: 뭐 하러? 어차피 그놈들 중에 덤빌 수 있는 놈도 없는데.

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Good day old hag.
Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
Does it happen to be... Ali?
Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
translation: 아, 사실은 Alisha(알리샤)란다. 그래도 날 여기 들어와 살게 해 줬지. 요즘은 마귀할멈이 귀하거든. 찬밥 더운밥 가릴 처지가 아니잖니!

english: So can I call you Al?
Only if I can call you Betty!
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 그래, Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)의 마귀할멈한테 뭘 원하느냐? 주술? 저주? 영원한 젊음? 독약? 말만 하려무나, 뭐든 달여 주마.

english: Actually I don't want any of that stuff, I'm new in town and I wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 사실 그런 건 하나도 필요 없어요. 마을에 처음 와서 주민들이랑 친해지고 싶었을 뿐이에요.

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 난 물약을 달이느라 바쁘니, 또 쓸데없이 귀찮게 하면 개구리로 만들어 버릴 테다!

english: Sorry! I won't let it happen again.
Good day, Hag.
Good day to you too, Blockhead.
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
translation: 그래, Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)의 마귀할멈한테 뭘 원하느냐? 주술? 저주? 영원한 젊음? 독약? 말만 하려무나, 뭐든 달여 주마.

english: I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
translation: 난 물약을 달이느라 바쁘니, 또 쓸데없이 귀찮게 하면 개구리로 만들어 버릴 테다!

english: Hello.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I don't know, what can you do for me?
Well, that depends.
Depends on what?
It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
Why is that?
Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.
translation: 제가 케밥 건설업에 몸담고 있다 보니, 주로 케밥이 필요한 사람들을 돕거든요.

english: Well then, what kind of kebabs do you, er, construct?

I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
translation: 케밥은 두 종류가 있어요. Gielinor(길리노르) 어디서나 볼 수 있고 술 취한 드워프들이 즐겨 먹는 평범하기 그지없는 일반 케밥, 그리고 제 특제품인 아주 매운 케밥이죠. 자, 어느 걸로 하시겠어요?

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
That will be three gold coins.
Here you go.
Thanks.
No thanks, I'm good.
Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
translation: 또 오세요. 손님이 좀 더 있으면 좋겠거든요.

english: I seem to be short on coins. Sorry.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
Could I have one of those crazy hot kebabs of yours?
translation: 그 엄청 매운 케밥 하나 주실 수 있어요?

english: One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
translation: Super kebab(슈퍼 케밥) 하나 나갑니다! 조심하세요, 정말 소문만큼 맵거든요.

english: Sure, sure.
Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 그 특제 케밥 소스 한 병 파실 수 있어요?

english: Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
translation: 음, 그건 경우에 따라 다르죠. 그걸로 뭘 하시려고요?

english: Don't worry, I've no intention of setting up a rival kebab shop.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 경쟁 케밥 가게를 차릴 생각은 없어요.

english: But then what do you want it for?
I don't know, but I think I could have a little bit of fun with it.
translation: 모르겠어요. 그래도 그걸로 좀 재밌는 일을 벌일 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
translation: 설마 Drunken Ali(술 취한 알리)의 술에 타려는 건 아니죠? 지난번에 누구한테 소스를 줬을 때 그런 일이 있었거든요.

english: No, that would be a bit cliché. I think I'll come up with something more original.
translation: 아뇨, 그건 좀 진부하죠. 더 독창적인 걸 생각해 볼게요.

english: Actually, I might get back to you on the sauce. I'm a bit overburdened as it is.
translation: 사실, 소스는 나중에 다시 얘기할게요. 지금 짐이 좀 많아서요.

english: Just be careful with it, it's potent enough to give a camel the runs.
translation: 조심해서 쓰세요. 낙타도 배탈 나게 할 만큼 독하거든요.

english: Thank you very much.
What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 일반 케밥이랑 아주 매운 케밥은 뭐가 달라요?

english: If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
translation: 그걸 알려 드리면 당신을 죽여야 해요. 케밥 건설업은 피 튀기는 업계거든요. 아주 매운 케밥이 제 경쟁력인데, 지나가는 모험가마다 비법을 다 털어놓았다간

english: soon be out of business.
So there's no difference except the sauce you use?
translation: 그럼 쓰는 소스 말고는 다른 게 없다는 거예요?

english: Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.
translation: 쉿! 목소리 낮춰요. 조합에서 나왔다고 진작 말씀하시지.

english: Listen, I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 저기, 이만 가 봐야겠어요. 나중에 봬요.

english: I need some information.

If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
translation: 정보가 필요하시다면 저보다 훨씬 도움이 될 사람이 많아요. 마을 부랑아들이나 동네 술꾼한테 물어보세요. 사람에 따라 저를 두고 이런저런 말을 하겠지만,

english: gossip I am not.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Ali the Kebab seller has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Ali the Kebab seller(케밥 장수 알리)가 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 건네줬다!

english: Please give me your answer!
Nope, not correct!
Spot on!
Ali the Kebab seller has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: Ali the Kebab seller(케밥 장수 알리)가 [another clue scroll/a casket]을(를) 건네줬다!

english: I want a standard kebab, please.
Yes, actually.
Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
translation: 아주 매운 케밥 하나 주실 수 있어요?

english: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
translation: 그 특제 케밥 소스 한 병 파실 수 있어요?

english: What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
translation: 일반 케밥이랑 아주 매운 케밥은 뭐가 달라요?

english: I want a kebab, please.
Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
translation: 저기, 이만 가 봐야겠어요. 나중에 봬요.

english: I need some information.
I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
translation: 지금 얘기할 시간 없어! Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)이 이 flyer(전단지) 돌리라고 돈 주거든.

english: Who is Ali Morrisane?
Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
translation: Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)은 동방 최고의 상인이야!

english: Were you paid to say that?
Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
translation: 당연하지! 마을 북쪽 끝에 가면 만날 수 있어.

english: What are the flyers for?
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
translation: 음, Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)은 Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 다른 상인들한테 인기가 별로 없어. 주로 Pollnivneach(폴니브니치) 출신이라서지. 자기네 마을에서 장사할 자격이 없다고 생각하거든.

english: I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
translation: 내 생각엔 그냥 그 사람이 자기들보다 돈을 잘 벌어서 배 아픈 것 같아.

english: The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
translation: 이 전단지엔 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 찾을 수 있는 여러 가게가 광고돼 있어.

english: It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
translation: 그리고 여기 실린 가게 어디서든 다음에 살 때 할인도 받을 수 있지. Ali(알리) 나름대로 상인들 환심을 사려는 거야.

english: Which shops?
Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
translation: 자! 하나 가져가고 나 일 좀 하게 해 줘.

english: I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
translation: 아직 돌려야 할 전단지가 수백 장인데, 몰래 어디다 버려도 사장님이 눈치챌까?

english: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
translation: 장난하는 거야, 아니면 나이 먹어서 머리가 죽이 된 거야? 이미 갖고 있는 전단지나 봐!

english: I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
translation: 전단지를 주고 싶은데 손이 꽉 찼네. 내 전단지 받을 자리 만들어서 다시 와.

english: What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 얘야, 이 근처엔 뭐 할 게 있니?

english: I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
translation: 나 엄청 바쁘니까 잘 들어! 딱 한 번만 말할 거야.

english: Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
translation: 남쪽 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에는 북적이고 멋진 시장이 있고, 남동쪽에는 다른 플레이어에게 결투를 신청할 수 있는 Emir's Arena(에미르의 투기장)이 있어.

english: If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
translation: 돈을 벌러 왔다면 남쪽에 광산이 있어.

english: Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
translation: 그래도 전갈은 조심해. 너무 가까이 가면 덤벼들 거야. 피하려면 남쪽으로 갈 때 서쪽 울타리를 따라가면 돼.

english: If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
translation: 좀 쉬면서 여유를 즐기고 싶으면 마을 남쪽에 괜찮은 낚시터가 몇 군데 있어.

english: Thanks for the help!
I don't want this! It's out of date!
Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
translation: 그럼 내가 왜 갖고 싶겠어? 얼른 가. 이 전단지 다 돌려야 돈 받는단 말이야.

english: Ali's Discount Wares...
The finest store in the world!
Dommik's crafting store...
The place for all your crafting needs.
Ellis' Tannery...
The prices are better than the smell!
Run your enemies through in style...
with a Scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars!
translation: Zeke's Superior Scimitars(지크의 고급 시미터 상점)의 Scimitar(시미터)로!

english: Visit Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar...
translation: Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar(루이의 다리 갑옷 시장)을 방문하세요...

english: Number one for clanky trousers!
Visit Ranael's Super Skirt Store ..
translation: Ranael's Super Skirt Store(라나엘의 슈퍼 치마 가게)를 방문하세요 ..

english: for the most stylish protection money can buy!
translation: 돈으로 살 수 있는 가장 멋진 방어구가 여기에!

english: Keep west as you travel south ...
translation: 남쪽으로 갈 때는 서쪽으로 붙어 가세요 ...

english: to avoid the killer scorpions!
Who is Ali Morrisane?
What are the flyers for?
What is there to do round here, boy?
translation: 얘야, 이 근처엔 뭐 할 게 있니?

english: Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
translation: 어서 오십시오, 모험가님. 이곳은 Menaphos(메나포스)와 Al Kharid(알 카리드)로 통하는 관문, Pollnivneach(폴니브니치) 마을입니다. 제 이름은 Ali(알리), 이 마을의 시장입니다. 즐겁게 머무시길 바랍니다.

english: Thank you. That is one of the warmest welcomes I've ever had! People generally treat travelling adventurers with suspicion.
translation: 감사합니다. 이렇게 따뜻한 환영은 처음 받아 봐요! 다들 떠돌이 모험가를 의심의 눈초리로 보거든요.

english: All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
translation: 이곳은 누구든 환영합니다. 요즘은 더욱 그렇지요.

english: What do you mean by that?
There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
translation: 마을에 문제가 생겨서 많은 주민이 떠났습니다. 상황이 아주 좋지 않습니다.

english: Hello good sir.
What do you want?
I'm new in town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 마을에 처음 와서 주민들이랑 친해지고 싶었어요.

english: What do you want to know?
Tell me about yourself.
That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
translation: 그 정보는 알 필요가 있는 사람만 알 수 있어. 그리고 지금 넌 알 필요가 없지.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 마을의 다른 사람들에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
translation: 양 떼지. 도살 준비가 다 된... 아, 잠깐. 이건 말하면 안 되는데. 내가 한 말은 그냥 잊어버려.

english: I'm looking for Ali.
You will have to be a lot more specific if you want help finding him. Everyone here is called Ali.
translation: 그 사람을 찾는 걸 도와주길 바란다면 훨씬 더 구체적으로 말해야 할 거야. 여기 사람들은 전부 이름이 Ali(알리)거든.

english: I've discovered that. Well he has an uncle called Ali Morrisane, a market vendor in Al Kharid and that's all I really know about him.
translation: 그건 저도 알았어요. 음, 그 애한텐 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 노점을 하는 Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)이라는 삼촌이 있어요. 제가 아는 건 그게 전부예요.

english: Say no more. I too am looking for him. The little tyke robbed me too, if we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
translation: 더 말할 필요 없어. 나도 그 녀석을 찾고 있거든. 그 꼬마 놈이 나한테서도 훔쳐 갔어. 우리가 힘을 합치면 그놈을 잡아서 혼쭐을 내 줄 수 있을 거야.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
translation: 마을의 다른 사람들에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: I'm looking for Ali.
Hello there! Who is this?
Ali.
Any particular Ali?
Only the best there is! I'm Ali the Sandsweeper.
translation: 최고의 알리지! 난 Ali the Sandsweeper(모래 청소부 알리)야.

english: You sweep sand?
Certainly do!  I'm the best darn sandsweeper this side of the Lum.
translation: 그렇고말고! Lum(럼 강) 이쪽에선 내가 최고의 모래 청소부라고.

english: There's more of you?
We have a union, mate! There's always sand to sweep.
translation: 우린 조합도 있다고, 친구! 쓸어야 할 모래는 언제나 있거든.

english: Indeed. Um, I have to go.
Hello there!
You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?
translation: 꽤 기분이 좋아 보이시네요. 뭐 찾는 거라도 있어요?

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Well, it's hot and full of sand.
Anything else?
Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
translation: 저한테 묻지 마세요, 전 이 동네 사람이 아니거든요.

english: So where are you from?
A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: Shantay Pass(샨테이 통행로) 남쪽에 있는 Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)라는 마을이요.

english: So, what do you do here?
Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
translation: 지금은 별로 하는 게 없어요. 대장간을 차리려고 남쪽에서 올라왔는데...

english: ...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
translation: 네, 그분이 우리더러 여기로 오라고 설득했어요.

english: He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
translation: 가게만 열면 손님이 많을 거라고 했고, 바라는 건 수익의 일부뿐이래요.

english: Maybe I should talk to him...
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
translation: 물론이죠. 그분은 사업 파트너가 될 만한 사람이라면 언제든 반갑게 이야기해요.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
What? Who's spreading that rumour?
Well, one of the shopkeepers told me a man with a large hammer came to threaten them.
translation: 음, 가게 주인 한 명이 큰 hammer(망치)를 든 남자가 와서 협박했다고 하더라고요.

english: Don't pay any attention to those people.
translation: 그런 사람들 말은 신경 쓰지 마세요.

english: They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
translation: 우리가 가게를 열면 돈을 잃을까 봐 걱정하는 것뿐이에요.

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 와, 뱀 부리는 사람이다! 저도 한번 해 봐도 돼요? 해 봐도 돼요? 네?

english: The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
translation: 뱀 부리는 사람은 연주에 정신이 팔려 당신을 알아채지 못하는 것 같다.

english: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.
translation: 뱀 부리는 사람이 무아지경에서 깨어나 당신에게 온 신경을 집중한다.

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
translation: 그걸로 날 좀 내버려 둔다면 기꺼이 내 뱀 부리기 슈퍼 입문 세트를 주지. flute(플루트)랑 basket(바구니)까지 몽땅 들어 있어. 그런데 보아하니 짐이 이미 넘쳐나는군.

english: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
translation: 아, basket(바구니)를 잃어버렸구먼. 여기 있다, 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬! 공연 다 망치잖아.

english: Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.
translation: 아, snake charming flute(뱀 부리기 플루트)를 잃어버렸구먼. 여기 있다, 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬! 내 봉들... 어, 아니, 관객들 정신 사납잖아.

english: If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
translation: 그렇게까지 해 보고 싶다면 내 특허받은 뱀 부리기 입문 세트를 가져가. 특제 snake charming flute(뱀 부리기 플루트)랑 홀린 뱀을 담아 둘 basket(바구니)가 들어 있지. 자, 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬!

english: The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
translation: 뱀 부리는 사람이 snake charming flute(뱀 부리기 플루트)와 basket(바구니)를 건네준다.

english: I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.
translation: 누가 말린대? 너도 snake charming flute(뱀 부리기 플루트) 있잖아.

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
I've lost some of the gear you gave me.
What do you need?
I've lost the music.
There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.
translation: 자, 받아. 이제 괜찮다면 난 여기 이 뱀을 홀리느라 바쁘거든.

english: Hello.
Yes?
Can you teach me any more about animal charming.
translation: 동물 부리기에 대해 더 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
translation: 아니, 글쎄다. 네 재능은 다른 데 있는 것 같은데.

english: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
translation: 와, 뱀 부리는 사람이다! 저도 한번 해 봐도 돼요? 해 봐도 돼요? 네?

english: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
Hello there!
I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Oh, it has wonderful weather.
Wonderful? It's hot and dry all the time!
Not quite as hot as back home.
Where's home, then?
Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.
translation: 아, 통행로 남쪽에 있는 Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)라는 마을이에요.

english: So, what do you do here?
If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
translation: 천이랑 옷본이랑 손님만 있으면 재단사겠죠. 지금은 할 일 없는 재단사고요.

english: The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!
translation: silk merchant(비단 상인)은 절 못 믿겠다면서 비단을 하나도 안 팔아요!

english: Anything I can do to help?
No, no, it's all being dealt with.
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
translation: 물론이죠. 제가 여기 가게를 차릴 수 있게 천이랑 옷본을 구해 줄 분이 바로 그분이에요.

english: And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
translation: 게다가 자리도 이렇게 좋고요. 고향처럼 외진 데가 아니잖아요.

english: The customers will soon pour in!
Maybe I should talk to him...
Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.
translation: 그러세요. 그분은 잠재적 사업 파트너라면 언제든 반갑게 얘기하시거든요.

english: I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Me, threaten people?
One of the shopkeepers did say they were threatened by a man with large scissors...
translation: 가게 주인 중 한 명이 커다란 가위를 든 남자한테 협박당했다던데요...

english: Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
translation: 아, 그 사람들이요. 신경 쓰지 마세요. 우리 가게들이 생기면 어떻게 될지 걱정돼서 그러는 거예요.

english: For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
translation: 어쩌면 우리 가게가 문을 열면 자기네 물건이 비교돼서 싸구려에 초라해 보일지도 모르니까요!

english: What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Hello.
Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?
translation: 어서 오세요! 저는 Ali(알리)고, 여긴 제 찻집이에요! 오늘 뭐 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

english: Hmm... Could I get some tea?
translation: 음... 차 좀 마실 수 있을까요?

english: Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 물론이죠! 당장 물을 끓일게요. 기다리시는 동안 또 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

english: How's the tea coming along?
Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
translation: 아! 네, 물이 끓고 있어요. 잠깐만 기다려 주세요!

english: I'm so thirsty.
I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!
translation: 알죠, 사막은 늘 더우니까요. 여기선 뭘 해도 목이 타죠!

english: How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 장사는 어때요? 꽤 외진 곳 같은데요.

english: Hmm...
Not good?
It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
translation: 그게 아니라요. 요즘 도둑 몇 놈 때문에 골치가 아파서요. 정확히는 네 놈이요!

english: They've been stealing your tea?
There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.
translation: 몇 번 털렸어요. 얼마 전엔 Karamja(카람자)에서 들여온 물건을 통째로 도둑맞았지 뭐예요! 제가 구해 본 것 중에 최상급이었는데.

english: That's awful. If I see any shifty characters, I'll be sure to teach them a lesson.
translation: 정말 너무하네요. 수상한 놈들이 보이면 제가 꼭 혼쭐을 내 줄게요.

english: Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.
translation: 하! 참 용감하시네요, 모험가님! 그 도둑들은 덩치도 크고 난폭해요. 끝내지도 못할 일은 시작하지 않는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: I'm pretty tough. I think I can handle them.
translation: 저 꽤 강해요. 감당할 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: If you say so.
I'd best be heading off.
You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!
I've been waiting quite a while. Perhaps another time.
Well you never actually made me that tea...
translation: 그런데 결국 차를 안 끓여 주셨잖아요...

english: Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
translation: 아, 맞다! 당장 물을 끓일게요. 기다리시는 동안 또 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

english: How's the tea coming along?
How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
translation: 장사는 어때요? 꽤 외진 곳 같은데요.

english: I'd best be heading off.
Wow! lookat this place, it's so colourful.
translation: 와! 여기 좀 봐요, 정말 알록달록하네요.

english: Why thank you. Can I help you with anything?
I take it by the clothes you are wearing and this room that you are in the dye trade?
translation: 입고 계신 옷이랑 이 방을 보니 염색 일을 하시는 것 같은데, 맞죠?

english: How observant of you.
Can you make dyes for me please?
translation: 염료 좀 만들어 주실 수 있나요?

english: What colour dye do you want? I can make you blue, red or yellow dyes for you. If you bring me the correct raw materials.
translation: 무슨 색 염료를 원하세요? 파란색, 빨간색, 노란색 염료를 만들어 드릴 수 있어요. 알맞은 재료를 가져오시면요.

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: red dye(빨간 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Hmm.... 3 lots of redberries should do the trick and 25 coins should cover any other costs.
translation: 음.... redberries(레드베리) 3개면 될 거고, 나머지 비용은 coins(코인) 25개면 충분할 거예요.

english: You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
translation: red dye(빨간 염료)를 만들기엔 베리가 모자라요.

english: You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
Ok make me some red dye please.
translation: 좋아요, red dye(빨간 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: You hand the redberries and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a red bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: redberries(레드베리)와 coins(코인) 약간을 Rana(라나)에게 건네자, 그녀는 선반을 이리저리 뒤지다가 마침내 빨간 병을 찾아 당신에게 건네준다.

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 아직 재료를 다 못 모은 것 같아요.

english: You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.
translation: 뭐가 필요한지 아시니까 다 구하면 다시 오세요. 그럼 다음에 봐요.

english: I can do without dye at that price.
Fair enough, I still think that the price is fairly reasonable considering that I'm the only source of dye this side of the Shantay pass.
translation: 그러세요. 그래도 Shantay pass(샨테이 통행로) 이쪽에서 염료를 구할 데가 저밖에 없는 걸 생각하면 꽤 합리적인 값인데요.

english: Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: redberry bush(레드베리 덤불)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.
translation: 직접 길러 보셔도 돼요. 기르기 그렇게 어렵지 않을 거예요.

english: If I didn't care to grow my own, where else could I get some?
translation: 직접 기르기 싫으면 또 어디서 구할 수 있을까요?

english: Well I know for sure that the desert climate wouldn't suit them. I have mine picked for me in the woods south of Varrock.
translation: 사막 기후가 안 맞는 건 확실해요. 저는 Varrock(바록) 남쪽 숲에서 따다 달라고 부탁하고 있어요.

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: yellow dye(노란 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Yellow is an awkward colour to recreate, I guess if you got me 2 onions I could use their skins to make a warm yellow dye for you. Oh yes and lest I forget I'll need 25 coins to cover the cost of the glass ware and
translation: 노란색은 재현하기 까다로운 색이에요. onions(양파) 2개를 가져다주시면 그 껍질로 따뜻한 노란 염료를 만들어 드릴 수 있을 것 같아요. 아 맞다, 잊기 전에 말씀드리면 유리 그릇 값과

english: my wages.
You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
translation: yellow dye(노란 염료)를 만들기엔 onions(양파)가 모자라요.

english: Ok make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 좋아요, yellow dye(노란 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: You hand two onions to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a yellow bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: onions(양파) 두 개를 Rana(라나)에게 건네자, 그녀는 선반을 이리저리 뒤지다가 마침내 노란 병을 찾아 당신에게 건네준다.

english: Where could I find some onions?
Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.
translation: 양파야 보통 채소밭에 있죠, 참 엉뚱하시네.

english: Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?
translation: 알았어요, 제가 졌어요. 그래도 이 근처에 양파를 구할 만한 데가 있을까요?

english: I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.
translation: 글쎄요, 잘 모르겠어요. 제 친구 하나가 Draynor village(드레이너 마을) 근처 농장에서 기르긴 하는데, 여기서 가기엔 좀 멀죠.

english: What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: blue dye(파란 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.
translation: blue dye(파란 염료) 한 병을 만들려면 woad leaves(대청 잎) 2장이랑 coins(코인) 25개가 필요해요.

english: You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
translation: blue dye(파란 염료)를 만들기엔 woad leaves(대청 잎)이 모자라요.

english: Ok make me some blue dye please.
translation: 좋아요, blue dye(파란 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: You hand the woad leaves and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a blue bottle, which she then hands to you.
translation: woad leaves(대청 잎)과 coins(코인) 약간을 Rana(라나)에게 건네자, 그녀는 선반을 이리저리 뒤지다가 마침내 파란 병을 찾아 당신에게 건네준다.

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: woad leaves(대청 잎)은 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.
translation: 대청 잎은 꽤 귀해요. 다른 손님들 말로는 Falador(팔라도르)에 그걸 기르는 gardener(정원사)가 있대요.

english: On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 지금은 염료가 필요 없을 것 같아요.

english: How did you get into the colour business?
Well, it's quite simple really my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
translation: 아주 간단해요. 저희 어머니가 건염상이셨는데, 어머니한테 일을 배웠거든요.

english: Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?
translation: 음, 건염상이 뭐예요? 무슨 병 이름은 아니죠?

english: No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.
translation: 아니에요, 엉뚱하시긴. 방부제랑 염료를 다루는 사람이에요. 저는 방부제 쪽은 별로 재미가 없어서 염색만 하기로 했어요.

english: So how's business then?
It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.
translation: 물 먹는 장사죠! 염색집이라 물을 들이니까요... 어머, 미안해요, 정말 끔찍한 농담이었네요.

english: Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.
translation: 음 그러게요, 적어도 오늘 들은 것 중엔 최악이네요.

english: Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?
translation: 고마워요. 근데 진짜로 이 근처에선 장사가 썩 좋지 않아요. 이 마을 사람들은 거의 다 흰옷만 입어서, 장사가 잘된다고는 못 하겠네요. 자, 뭐 필요한 거 있으세요?

english: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
Could you make some dye for me please?
translation: 염료 좀 만들어 주실 수 있나요?

english: What do you need to make red dye?
translation: red dye(빨간 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Okay, make me some red dye please.
translation: 좋아요, red dye(빨간 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
translation: 아직 재료를 다 못 모은 것 같아요.

english: I can do without dye at that price.
Where would I find a redberry bush?
translation: redberry bush(레드베리 덤불)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: What do you need to make yellow dye?
translation: yellow dye(노란 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.
translation: 좋아요, yellow dye(노란 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: Where could I find some onions?
What do you need to make blue dye?
translation: blue dye(파란 염료)를 만들려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Okay, make me some blue dye please.
translation: 좋아요, blue dye(파란 염료) 좀 만들어 주세요.

english: Where can I get some woad leaves?
translation: woad leaves(대청 잎)은 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: On second thoughts I don't really need any dye.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 염료는 딱히 필요 없을 것 같아요.

english: How did you get into the colour business?
No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사)에 대해 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사)에 대해 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'm okay, thank you.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 죄송한데, dung(똥)을 조금만 나눠 주실 수 있을까요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 썩 달갑지 않은 모양이다.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 근처에 갔다간 손이 물어뜯기고 말 거야.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 kebab(케밥)을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 먼저 눈부터 감아요. 누가 보고 있는데 그런 걸 할 순 없잖아요!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What did you say?
Nothing, nothing.
Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
translation: 그럼 방해하지 마요. 나 할 일 있거든요.

english: Really? What sort of work?
I'm participating in the construction of a shopping and sales extravaganza!
translation: 초대형 쇼핑 및 판매 대축제를 짓는 데 참여하고 있답니다!

english: ...What?
My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
translation: 주인님들이 상자를 나르라고 시키거든요. 하지만 지금은 할 일이 별로 없어요.

english: Are your masters those men called Ali?
Yes, that's them. They're traders working for Ali Morrisane.
translation: 네, 그분들이에요. Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인) 밑에서 일하는 상인들이죠.

english: So, what's it like working for your masters?
translation: 그래서, 주인님들 밑에서 일하는 건 어때요?

english: It's hard work sometimes, but it could be worse.
translation: 가끔 고되긴 해도 이만하면 괜찮은 편이죠.

english: I heard about a pair of camels back in Pollnivneach who were poisoned!
translation: Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)에서 낙타 두 마리가 독에 당했다는 얘기를 들었거든요!

english: They say someone put spicy sauce in their food.
translation: 누가 먹이에 spicy sauce(매운 소스)를 넣었대요.

english: Really? That's very cruel of whoever did it.
I sincerely hope whoever did it was punished. Do they have no compassion for camels?
translation: 그런 짓을 한 사람이 꼭 벌을 받았으면 좋겠어요. 낙타를 불쌍히 여기는 마음도 없는 걸까요?

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 전 예의 바른 사람이니까요.

english: Greetings and welcome to my farming equipment shop. Would you like to buy some equipment?
translation: 안녕하세요, 저희 농사 장비 가게에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 장비를 좀 사시겠어요?

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Hello.
Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요. 오랜만에 외지 사람을 보니 반갑네요. 바쁘세요? 고민이 하나 있어서요.

english: How can I help?
It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
translation: 제 아들 Hudon(후돈) 말이에요, 늘 사고만 쳐요. 강에 숨겨진 보물이 있다고 굳게 믿고 있는데, 그 불쌍한 녀석은 수영도 못 해서 혹시 다칠까 봐 걱정이에요.

english: I could go and take a look for you if you like?
Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.
translation: 그래 주시겠어요? 정말 친절하시네요. 뒤쪽에 있는 작은 raft(뗏목)을 쓰셔도 돼요. 하류 쪽 물살이 아주 세니까 꼭 조심하세요.

english: I'm afraid I'm in a rush.
Oh okay, never mind.
Hello Almera.
Hello adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
I'm afraid not, but I'm sure he hasn't gone far.
translation: 아직이요. 그래도 멀리 가진 않았을 거예요.

english: I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.
translation: 그러면 좋겠네요. 요즘은 아무리 조심해도 지나치지 않으니까요.

english: Hello again.
Well hello, you're still around then.
I saw Hudon by the river but he refused to come back with me.
translation: 강가에서 Hudon(후돈)을 봤는데 저랑 같이 돌아오지 않겠대요.

english: Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.
translation: 네, 그 애가 말했어요. 그 바보 같은 녀석이 흠뻑 젖어서 들어왔더라고요. 폭포에 빠졌다지 뭐예요, 죽지 않은 게 천만다행이에요! 이제 남은 여름 내내 방에만 있어야 할 거예요.

english: Any ideas what I could do while I'm here?
translation: 여기 있는 동안 뭘 하면 좋을까요?

english: Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?
translation: 폭포 남쪽에 있는 관광 안내소에 가 보시는 건 어때요?

english: Hello again Almera.
Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?
translation: 어머, 또 오셨네요, 용감한 모험가님. 이 동네의 고즈넉한 풍경은 즐기고 계세요?

english: Yes, very relaxing.
Well I'm glad to hear itThe authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
translation: 그렇다니 다행이에요. 당국에서 광산을 만들겠다고 이 일대를 다 파헤치려 했는데, 여기 사는 몇 안 되는 주민들이 꿈쩍도 안 해서 결국 포기했답니다.

english: Good for you.
Good for all of us!
Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?
Oh, I'm just sight seeing.
No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not to crash it this time!
translation: 그냥 구경하려고 이렇게 오래 머무는 모험가는 없어요. 하지만 볼일이야 각자 알아서 할 일이죠. raft(뗏목)이 필요하면 쓰세요. 다만 이번엔 제발 부수지 말아 주세요!

english: Thank Almera.
Yes.
No.
Hello again.
You have crossed my path too many times intruder. Leave or face my wrath.
translation: 자네는 내 앞길을 너무 자주 가로막았네, 침입자여. 떠나게, 그렇지 않으면 내 분노를 맛보게 될 걸세.

english: Yeah, whatever.
Hello, Alomone.
Welcome, adventurer. Know that as a friend to Hazeel, you are always welcome here.
translation: 어서 오게, 모험가. Hazeel(헤이즐)의 벗인 자네는 이곳에서 언제나 환영받을 걸세.

english: Hello Madam.
Oh, hello there.
Are you ok?
Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...
translation: 그럭저럭요... 그냥 마음에 걸리는 일이 좀 있어서요...

english: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.
translation: 안녕하세요, Edmond(에드먼드) 씨가 따님 찾는 걸 도와 달라고 부탁하셨어요.

english: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
translation: 네, 그이가 말해 줬어요. 당신에게 줄 특별한 gas mask(방독면)을 만들기 시작했는데, 마무리하려면 dwellberries(드웰베리)가 좀 필요해요.

english: I'll try to get some.
The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.
translation: McGrubor's Wood(맥그루버의 숲)에서 찾아보는 게 제일 좋아요. Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 바로 서쪽이에요.

english: Yes I've got some here.
There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
translation: 자, 다 됐어요. West Ardougne(서아르둔)에 있는 동안엔 항상 이걸 쓰고 있어야 해요. 안 그러면 역병에 걸릴 수도 있어요.

english: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.
translation: 혹시 잃어버릴 때를 대비해서 여분 방독면도 하나 만들어 둘게요. mourners(애도자)가 찾으러 올지도 모르니 cupboard(찬장)에 숨겨 둘게요.

english: Hello darling, I think Edmond had a good idea of how to get into West Ardougne, you should hear his idea.
translation: 어서 와요. Edmond(에드먼드)가 West Ardougne(서아르둔)에 들어갈 좋은 방법을 생각해 둔 것 같아요. 그이 생각을 한번 들어 봐요.

english: Alright, I'll go and see him now.
Hello Alrena.
Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?
translation: 어서 와요. 땅굴은 어떻게 돼 가요?

english: I just need to soften the soil and then we'll start digging.
translation: 흙만 좀 부드럽게 만들면 바로 파기 시작할 거예요.

english: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.
I just need to soften the soil a little more and then we'll start digging.
translation: 흙만 조금 더 부드럽게 만들면 바로 파기 시작할 거예요.

english: Hello again Alrena.
How's the tunnel going?
I'm getting there.
One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
translation: mourners(애도자) 중 하나가 당신이랑 Edmond(에드먼드)에 대해 캐묻고 다니고 있어요. 그 사람을 조심하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.
translation: 그리고 여분 gas mask(방독면) 필요하면 잊지 말고 쓰세요. cupboard(찬장)에 숨겨 뒀어요.

english: Great, thanks Alrena!
Okay, thanks for the warning.
Hello, any word on Elena?
Not yet I'm afraid.
Is there anything else I can do to help?
It's alright, I'll get her back soon.
That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.
translation: 그래요, 바로 그 마음이에요. 필요하면 cupboard(찬장)에 여분 gas mask(방독면)이 있다는 거 잊지 말고요.

english: That's the spirit, dear.
Do you have a picture of Elena?
Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 네. 집 안 어딘가에 하나 있을 거예요. 또 필요한 게 있으면 말해요.

english: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!
translation: 우리 딸을 구해 줘서 고마워요! 역병에 오염됐을지도 모르는 집에 용감하게 들어갔다고 Elena(엘레나)가 다 말해 줬어요. 정말 뭐라고 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: They've taken her...
Who?
Elena! They came and took her away!
translation: Elena(엘레나)요! 그들이 와서 그 애를 끌고 갔어요!

english: Oh no! Is there anything I can do?
translation: 이런! 제가 할 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
translation: 잘 모르겠어요... Edmond(에드먼드)한테 얘기해 봐요. 그 애가 끌려갈 때 그이가 거기 있었어요.

english: Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.
translation: Elena(엘레나)를 도와줘서 정말 고마워요. Edmond(에드먼드)와 저에게 정말 큰 의미예요.

english: I need another tabard.
Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.
translation: 문제없어요. 하나 더 만들 재료가 아직 남아 있거든요. 여기 있어요.

english: It'a not a problem.
I need another tabard.
It's not a problem.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello there.
What brings you to these parts, stranger?
translation: 이런 데까진 무슨 일로 왔어요, 낯선 양반?

english: What is this place?
I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
translation: 당신 같은 부류가 익숙한 곳이랑은 좀 다르긴 하겠죠...

english: This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
translation: 여긴 제 소박한 은신처예요! 믿음직한 cormorant(가마우지) 덕분에 저 같은 사람 하나 먹고살 물고기는 넉넉하답니다.

english: A bird helps you to fish?
Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!
translation: 그럼요! 낚싯대 안 쓴 지 몇 년 됐어요. 그냥 물가로 내보내기만 하면 이 녀석이 알아서 다 해 줘요!

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 그 새로 저도 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
translation: 글쎄요, 당신 같은 부류가 해낼 수 있을지 모르겠는데...

english: But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!
translation: 그래도 꽤 볼만한 구경거리가 되겠네요. 해 봐요!

english: I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!
translation: 제가 지켜보면서 이 녀석 때문에 너무 고생하지 않게 봐 줄게요!

english: You're going to need to free up your hands first, though. Nothing in or on your hands.
translation: 그래도 먼저 손부터 비워야 해요. 손에 아무것도 들거나 끼고 있으면 안 돼요.

english: I don't think that's for me... I'll leave that to you.
translation: 저랑은 안 맞는 것 같아요... 그건 그쪽한테 맡길게요.

english: No surprises there! Your type never have been cut out for it.
translation: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 당신 같은 부류는 원래 이 일에 소질이 없거든요.

english: What's in the sack?
Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!
translation: 아, 이거요? 제 믿음직한 오랜 fish sack(생선 자루)예요!

english: Fish sack?
Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.
translation: 그래요, 생선 자루! 이 근처에서 진주를 좀 찾았으면 하나 팔 수도 있어요.

english: No thanks.
I found this big fish...
Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
translation: 이거 진짜 대물이네! 이 녀석이 어떻게 이런 걸 낚았는지 도통 모르겠네요.

english: If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!
translation: 필요 없으면 진주 몇 개 받고 제가 가져가 줄 수도 있어요!

english: I'm interested... How many pearls are we talking?
translation: 관심 있어요... 진주 몇 개 얘기하시는 거예요?

english: I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?
On seconds thoughts, I'd rather keep it.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 그냥 갖고 있을래요.

english: As you wish.
It's a deal.
Pleasure doing business with you!
Well, let me know if you change your mind.
Hello again.
Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
It certainly is a challenge...
Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?
translation: 그래요, 당신 같은 부류는 늘 이걸 얕보더라고요! 이제 그만할래요?

english: Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
Just come back and let me know when you get tired!
I'll try again another time.
What is this place?
Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 그 새로 저도 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: I don't think that's for me.
What's in the sack?
Let's take a look.
No thanks.
I found this big fish...
It's a deal.
No, keep the tench.
Yes, exchange the golden tench.
Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
Yeah, I'll try again another time.
Hello!
He seems to be in deep concentration.
translation: 그는 깊이 집중하고 있는 것 같다.

english: ...I'll leave you to it.
Hello.
Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
translation: 어서 와요. 배고프신가요? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아왔어요. 초록을 먹자, 노움 요리를 먹자! 웨이터가 기꺼이 주문을 받아 줄 거예요.

english: Thanks.
On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.
translation: 반대로, 노움 요리를 배워 보고 싶다면 여기가 딱 맞는 곳이기도 해요. 제 아들 Lufty(러프티)가 지금 일손을 구하고 있거든요.

english: No thank, I'm no cook.
In that case, please eat and enjoy.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
translation: 그거 잘됐네요. 저는 이 식당 주인 Aluft Gianne(알루프트 지안)이에요. 당신은...?

english: Most people call me [player name].
Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
translation: 정말요? 미안해요, 제가 실례했네요. 인간들의 그 우스운 이름에 익숙해지려면 시간이 좀 걸리거든요.

english: Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
translation: 물론 저랑 일하려면 먼저 실력을 좀 봐야겠죠. 자, 우리 메뉴를 한번 보세요.

english: Aluft hands you a cook book.
When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
translation: 책을 다 보고 나면 여기로 다시 와요. 요리 몇 가지를 만들어 보게 해 줄게요.

english: Ok then.
Hi Mr. Gianne.
Hello [player name]. So what did you think of the book?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 그래, 책은 어땠어요?

english: I'm not too sure about toad's legs.
translation: toad's legs(두꺼비 다리)는 좀 내키지 않는데요.

english: They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
translation: 노움들의 진미예요, 아주 맛있죠. 닭고기가 두꺼비 다리 맛이랑 똑같다니까요. 분명 좋아하게 될 거예요. 재료를 주면 Toad Crunchies(두꺼비 크런치)를 좀 만들어 줄 수 있겠어요?

english: I'll give it a go.
Aluft gives you two pairs of toad's legs, some gnome spice, some equa leaves, some dough and a crunchy tray.
translation: Aluft(알루프트)가 toad's legs(두꺼비 다리) 두 쌍, gnome spice(노움 향신료) 약간, equa leaves(에쿠아 잎) 약간, dough(반죽) 약간, 그리고 crunchy tray(크런치 쟁반)을 준다.

english: The dough is made according to a secret family recipe. If you need any more, I suggest you speak to Hudo the grocer. He's very reliable.
translation: 반죽은 집안 대대로 내려오는 비밀 요리법으로 만든 거예요. 더 필요하면 식료품상 Hudo(후도)에게 가 보세요. 아주 믿을 만한 친구예요.

english: Let me know how you get on.
Hi Mr Gianne.
So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 그래, toad crunchies(두꺼비 크런치)는 잘 만들었어요?

english: I think I've got one.
That looks identical to the crunchies I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 그거 제가 5분도 안 된 사이에 만든 크런치랑 똑같아 보이는데요. 제 추천을 받고 싶다면 직접 만들 수 있다는 걸 증명해야 해요.

english: Erm, I've not quite finished it yet.
Ok, let me know when you have.
I'm afraid I've lost the crunchie tray you gave to me.
translation: 죄송한데 주신 crunchie tray(크런치 쟁반)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: Ok, I'll give you another one. Obviously I can't expect you to cook without the proper utensils.
translation: 괜찮아요, 하나 더 줄게요. 제대로 된 도구도 없이 요리하라고 할 수는 없으니까요.

english: I've not finished yet.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.
Call me Aluft. So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
translation: 그냥 Aluft(알루프트)라고 불러요. 그래, toad crunchies(두꺼비 크런치)는 잘 만들었어요?

english: No problem, it was easy.
You give Aluft the toad crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft(알루프트)에게 toad crunchies(두꺼비 크런치)를 건넨다. 그가 한 입 베어 문다...

english: Not bad, not bad at all.

Ok, now for something you might prefer. Try making some chocolate chip crunchies for me. They're my favourite. Here's everything you need. You can re-use the spice from the last recipe - one tin goes a long way.
translation: 좋아요, 이번엔 더 마음에 들 만한 걸 해 봐요. chocolate chip crunchies(초콜릿 칩 크런치)를 만들어 줘요. 제가 제일 좋아하는 거예요. 필요한 건 여기 다 있어요. 향신료는 지난번 요리법에서 쓴 걸 다시 써도 돼요. 한 통이면 꽤 오래 가거든요.

english: Aluft gives you two bars of chocolate, some chocolate dust, and some dough.
translation: Aluft(알루프트)가 초콜릿 바 두 개, chocolate dust(초콜릿 가루) 약간, dough(반죽) 약간을 준다.

english: Ok Aluft, I'll be back soon.
Hello Aluft.
Hello there, how did you get on.
I haven't made it yet.
It's one trayful of chocolate chip crunchies that I need. Just follow the instructions carefully.
translation: 제가 필요한 건 chocolate chip crunchies(초콜릿 칩 크런치) 한 쟁반이에요. 설명대로 꼼꼼하게만 따라 하면 돼요.

english: Here you go.
You give Aluft the chocolate crunchies. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft(알루프트)에게 chocolate crunchies(초콜릿 크런치)를 건넨다. 그가 한 입 베어 문다...

english: Yes, yes, yes, that's superb. I'm really impressed.
translation: 그래, 그래, 그래요, 훌륭해요. 정말 감탄했어요.

english: Ok then, can you make me a toad batta?  Here's what you need.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 toad batta(두꺼비 바타)를 만들어 줄래요? 필요한 건 여기 있어요.

english: Aluft gives you some cheese, some dough, some equa leaves, a pair of toad's legs and some more gnome spice.
translation: Aluft(알루프트)가 cheese(치즈) 약간, dough(반죽) 약간, equa leaves(에쿠아 잎) 약간, toad's legs(두꺼비 다리) 한 쌍, 그리고 gnome spice(노움 향신료)를 조금 더 준다.

english: Let me know when the batta is ready.
Aluft.
Sorry, Aluft.
So where's my toad batta?
translation: 그래, 제 toad batta(두꺼비 바타)는 어디 있죠?

english: That looks identical to the toad batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 그거 제가 5분도 안 된 사이에 만든 두꺼비 바타랑 똑같아 보이는데요. 제 추천을 받고 싶다면 직접 만들 수 있다는 걸 증명해야 해요.

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 죄송한데 주신 batta tin(바타 틀)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
translation: 죄송한데 주신 batta tin(바타 틀)을 잃어버렸어요.

Here you go, that was no problem.
You give Aluft the toad batta. He takes a bite...
translation: Aluft(알루프트)에게 toad batta(두꺼비 바타)를 건넨다. 그가 한 입 베어 문다...

english: Ooh, that's some good toad. Very nice.
translation: 오, 두꺼비 맛 좋네요. 아주 훌륭해요.

english: Let's see if you can make a cheese and tomato batta next.
translation: 다음엔 cheese and tomato batta(치즈 토마토 바타)를 만들 수 있는지 볼까요.

english: Hello again Aluft.
Hello [player name] have you made my Cheese and tomato Batta?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 제 Cheese and tomato Batta(치즈 토마토 바타)는 만들었어요?

english: That looks identical to the cheese and tomato batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
translation: 그거 제가 5분도 안 된 사이에 만든 치즈 토마토 바타랑 똑같아 보이는데요. 제 추천을 받고 싶다면 직접 만들 수 있다는 걸 증명해야 해요.

english: Here, see what you think.
You give Aluft the batta. He sniffs it then takes a bite...
translation: Aluft(알루프트)에게 바타를 건넨다. 그가 냄새를 맡더니 한 입 베어 문다...

english: Hmm, that's actually really good.
How about this? Hmmm. I think you may well be ready for real cooking. Well I'm happy to give you my recommendation to Jnr, if that's what you want.
translation: 이 정도면 어때요? 흐음. 이제 진짜 요리를 할 준비가 된 것 같네요. 원한다면 Jnr(주니어)에게 기꺼이 추천해 줄게요.

english: Great thanks.
Well your training with me is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: 자, [player name] 님, 저와의 수련은 끝났어요. 일 좀 해 볼 생각 있어요?

english: I may be...

I think you're almost ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery.  There's good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods -
translation: 이제 제 아들 Aluft Gianne Jnr(알루프트 지안 주니어)의 일을 도울 준비가 거의 된 것 같아요. 그 애가 우리 집안의 새 사업인 Gnome Food Delivery(노움 음식 배달)을 맡고 있거든요. 노움 음식을 만들어 배달하면 팁도 쏠쏠하게 벌 수 있어요 -

english: though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: 다만 다른 주문 중 일부는 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 돌아다니며 처리해야 할 수도 있어요...

english: However, some of the orders Aluft aloft gets are for gnome cocktails, so if you want to work for Lufty, you'll need to undergo some basic cocktail making training. Go and have a chat with him. He's not that
translation: 그런데 Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)에 들어오는 주문 중에는 노움 칵테일도 있어서, Lufty(러프티) 밑에서 일하려면 기본적인 칵테일 만들기 수련도 받아야 해요. 가서 그 애랑 얘기해 봐요. 그렇게

english: scary...
Thanks for your help!
Oh, one last thing. My special dough, can be occasionally tricky to get hold of. I wouldn't want to stop you from cooking gnome delicacies for want of dough!
translation: 아, 마지막으로 하나 더요. 제 특제 반죽은 가끔 구하기 어려울 때가 있어요. 반죽이 없어서 노움 별미를 못 만드는 일은 없었으면 해요!

english: That should last you for a small while eh? That's all the free dough I'm going to give you so don't waste it!
translation: 이 정도면 한동안은 버티겠죠? 공짜 반죽은 이게 전부니까 낭비하지 말아요!

english: Thanks!

Blurberry tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery.  There's good
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)가 그러는데 그 친구한테서 수련을 다 마쳤다면서요. 그러니 이제 제 아들 Aluft Gianne Jnr(알루프트 지안 주니어)의 일을 도울 준비가 된 것 같아요. 그 애가 우리 집안의 새 사업인 Gnome Food Delivery(노움 음식 배달)을 맡고 있거든요. 노움 음식을 만들어

english: tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: 배달하면 팁도 쏠쏠하게 벌 수 있어요. 다만 다른 주문 중 일부는 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 돌아다니며 처리해야 할 수도 있어요...

english: Sounds interesting....
Go and have a chat with my son Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: 제 아들 Lufty Jnr.(러프티 주니어)에게 가서 얘기해 봐요. 자세한 건 그 애가 알려 줄 거예요.

english: No thanks, I'm no cook.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
I'm afraid I've lost the crunchy tray you gave to me.
translation: 죄송한데 주신 crunchy tray(크런치 쟁반)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: I've not finished yet.
Good day, [sir/madam].
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting for my shift. I'm supposed to be digging once the others have finished.
translation: 제 교대 차례를 기다리는 중이에요. 다른 사람들이 끝나면 제가 땅을 파기로 했거든요.

english: I don't like the sound of these monsters, though.
translation: 그런데 그 괴물들 얘기는 영 마음에 안 들어요.

english: Monsters?
I heard that Donal went exploring in the caves, and saw a huge monster.
translation: Donal(도널)이 동굴을 탐험하다가 거대한 괴물을 봤다고 들었어요.

english: If you want to know more about it, ask Thorodin - he's working on the excavation right now.
translation: 더 알고 싶으면 Thorodin(소로딘)에게 물어보세요. 지금 발굴 작업을 하고 있거든요.

english: I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
translation: 당연히 교대 차례를 기다리고 있죠. 계속 땅만 팔 수는 없잖아요.

english: I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
translation: 그리고 Fremennik(프레메닉)과 드워프 사이의 연관성도 연구하고 있어요.

english: I've found that we have some mythology in common.
translation: 우리에게 공통된 신화가 있다는 걸 알아냈죠.

english: Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
translation: 안녕하세요. Gielinor Housing Agency(길리노르 주택 중개소)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Can you move my house please?
translation: 제 집 좀 옮겨 주실 수 있나요?

english: Where would you like it moved to?
To Rimmington please!
Your house is already there!
Hmph. Come back when you have 5,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rimmington.
To Taverley please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 10.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 10이 필요해요.

english: Your house has been moved to Taverley.
To Pollnivneach please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 20.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 20이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 7,500 coins.
Your house has been moved to Pollnivneach.
To Hosidius please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 25.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 25가 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 8,750 coins.
Absolutely. Hand me your blueprints and I'll make it happen! I'll keep the blueprints, so you'll always be able to switch back to this style in future, for a small fee.
translation: 물론이죠. 설계도를 주시면 바로 해 드릴게요! 설계도는 제가 보관해 둘 테니, 나중에 약간의 수수료만 내면 언제든 이 양식으로 되돌릴 수 있어요.

english: Your house has been moved to Hosidius.
To Rellekka please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 30.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 30이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 10,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rellekka.
To Brimhaven please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 40.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 40이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 15,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Brimhaven.
To Yanille please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 50.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 50이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 25,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Yanille.
To Prifddinas please!
Where? Never heard of it.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 70.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 70이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 50,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Prifddinas.
Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: 제 집을 새로 꾸며 주실 수 있나요?

english: Certainly. My magic can rebuild the house in a completely new style! What style would you like?
translation: 물론이죠. 제 마법이면 집을 완전히 새로운 양식으로 다시 지을 수 있어요! 어떤 양식으로 해 드릴까요?

english: Basic wood
Your house is already in that style!
Your house has been redecorated.
I'm afraid you haven't unlocked that style.
translation: 죄송하지만 아직 그 양식을 잠금 해제하지 않으셨어요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 35,000 coins.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that. Maybe you can buy some by working for the contractors.
translation: 죄송하지만 그건 설계도가 있어야 해요. 건축업자들 일을 해 주면 살 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
translation: Construction guide book(건설 안내서) 한 권 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: You've already got one!
Not until you free up some inventory space.
Certainly.
Tell me about houses!
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: 다 마법사들의 실험에서 나온 거예요. 공간을 접는 방법을 알아내서, 수 에이커나 되는 땅을 폭이 한 자밖에 안 되는 곳에 쑤셔 넣을 수 있게 됐죠.

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: 마법사들은 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 접힌 공간 구역을 여러 개 만들었어요. 구역마다 사람들이 집을 지을 수 있는 작은 부지가 수백 개씩 있죠.

english: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
translation: 아, 그래서 모두가 집을 가져도 세상이 집으로 가득 차지 않는 거군요!

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 마법사들은 장사 쪽 일로 골치 썩이고 싶지 않아서 저를 고용해 집을 팔게 했어요.

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 집에 가구를 들이는 걸 도와줄 사람들이 여럿 있어요.

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
translation: 우선 sawmill operator(제재소 일꾼)에게서 판자를 사는 것부터 시작하세요. 제재소는 Varrock(바록) 북동쪽, Hosidius(호시디우스) 남서쪽의 Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드), 그리고 Prifddinas(프리프디나스) 북동쪽에 있어요.

english: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: 입고 계신 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
translation: 아실지도 모르지만, 스킬 망토는 한 스킬의 달인에게만 주어져요. 저는 평생 집을 지어 왔고 이제는 집을 파는 일을 하고 있죠! 제 실력의 증표로 이 Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 입고 있는 거예요.

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 언젠가 demonic throne(악마의 왕좌)를 만들 만한 실력이 되면 저한테 와서 말씀하세요. 저와 같은 스킬 망토를 팔아 드릴게요.

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: Cape of Construction(건설 망토)를 두르면 어느 집 포털로든, 심지어 집 안으로 곧장 원하는 만큼 순간이동할 수도 있어요!

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 저한테 파실 수 있나요?

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: 좋아요, 99000코인 되겠습니다. 어느 집 포털로든, 심지어 집 안으로 곧장 순간이동시켜 주는 이렇게 멋진 망토라면 싼 값이죠!

english: I'm not paying that!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 이걸 사고 싶어 안달 난 영웅들이 얼마든지 있으니까요. 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 찾아오세요.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토에는 무료 두건이 함께 딸려 나와요. 스킬 판촉 행사로 원 플러스 원이거든요. 그러니 팔아 드리기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 입으세요, 친구.

english: Can you move my house please?
translation: 제 집 좀 옮겨 주실 수 있나요?

translation: Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 저한테 파실 수 있나요?

english: I'm not paying that!
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Hello!
Hello, if you've something important to tell me, be out with it! I'm a busy woman.
translation: 그래, 중요한 할 말이 있으면 얼른 털어놔! 나 바쁜 사람이야.

english: Just making small talk.
How very nice of you. However, I'm sure there are less busy people who'd love to chat.
translation: 참 친절도 하네. 그런데 수다 떨어 줄 한가한 사람은 나 말고도 많을 거야.

english: Oh, okay.
Chin up love and go adventure, that's what you lot do right?
translation: 기운 내, 얘야. 가서 모험이나 해. 너희 같은 사람들이 하는 게 그거잖아?

english: I suppose we do, bye!
Who are you?
I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
translation: 난 가정부 Alyssa(앨리사)야. 이 성은 한시도 손을 놓을 수가 없어! 경비병들이 카펫을 엉망으로 만드는 것만으로도 골치 아픈데 너까지 보탤 필요는 없잖아.

english: Hmm, yeah sorry about that. Speaking of carpets, ever thought how strange that there are carpets beneath the stairs?
translation: 흠, 네, 그건 죄송해요. 카펫 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 계단 밑에 카펫이 깔려 있는 게 이상하다고 생각해 본 적 없으세요?

english: It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!
translation: 치수에 맞게 자른 거야! 그 질문 받을 때마다 금화 한 닢씩 받았으면 벌써 부자 됐겠다!

english: Sure... Cut to fit... Not an oversight at all.
translation: 그렇겠죠... 맞춰 잘랐다... 실수 같은 건 전혀 아니고요.

english: Alright, believe what you like. I've a castle to clean.
translation: 그래, 믿고 싶은 대로 믿어. 난 청소할 성이 있어서.

english: Bye.
Are you the Alyssa this entry mentions?
You show her 'A Dark Disposition'.
translation: 그녀에게 'A Dark Disposition(어두운 기질)'을 보여 준다.

english: Ah, I suppose I am.
Got anything to say about it?
Why should I tell you anything? There are private matters of a late royal family! It wouldn't be proper to divulge such information to an adventurer like you.
translation: 내가 왜 너한테 뭘 말해 줘야 하지? 이건 선대 왕실의 사적인 일이야! 너 같은 모험가한테 그런 걸 누설하는 건 도리가 아니지.

english: ...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. I guess you have a point though.
translation: ...대부분은 언제 입을 다물어야 할지 모르던데요. 그래도 일리 있는 말씀이네요.

english: Yes, I do indeed. Off with you, I've had my fair share of nosy adventurers for one day.
translation: 그래, 당연하지. 이제 가 봐. 오늘은 참견하기 좋아하는 모험가를 볼 만큼 봤으니까.

english: Alright, sorry for disturbing you. Bye.
Bye.
...Most people don't know when to stop sharing. It's probably worth mentioning that I've found all entries of this memoir.
translation: ...대부분은 언제 입을 다물어야 할지 모르던데요. 말씀드려야 할 것 같은데, 저 이 회고록의 글을 전부 찾았어요.

english: Yes, how did you come across this? I'm fairly certain it was destroyed... At least, I recall seeing a man removing the pages...
translation: 그래, 그걸 대체 어떻게 손에 넣은 거야? 분명 없애 버린 걸로 아는데... 적어도 어떤 남자가 페이지를 뜯어 가는 걸 본 기억이 있거든...

english: Honestly, I've never really questioned it. I do things for people and they give me things.
translation: 솔직히 깊이 생각해 본 적은 없어요. 사람들 일을 해 주면 사람들이 이것저것 주더라고요.

english: Well, I suppose if you've already nosily rifled through the princesses personal memoirs, I can tell you a little more.
translation: 뭐, 이미 공주님의 개인 회고록을 꼬치꼬치 다 뒤져 봤다면 조금 더 알려 줘도 되겠지.

english: Fantastic! I've got to say, there's some great little gems in this old book. I think I'm unravelling a great mystery!
translation: 좋아요! 이 낡은 책엔 진짜 보석 같은 내용이 꽤 있더라고요. 제가 엄청난 수수께끼를 풀어 가고 있는 것 같아요!

english: Well, if I were you I'd keep shush on the whole matter.
translation: 글쎄, 내가 너라면 이 일은 전부 입 꾹 다물고 있겠어.

english: How come?
You must be new here. When the king died, everyone assumed the princess would take the throne when she came of age.
translation: 여기 처음 왔나 보구나. 왕이 돌아가셨을 때, 다들 공주님이 성인이 되면 왕위에 오르실 거라고 생각했어.

english: But the council kept control...
translation: 그런데 의회가 계속 권력을 쥐고 있었죠...

english: Indeed, and poor young Rose was shipped off and labelled as crazy.
translation: 그래, 그리고 가엾은 어린 Rose(로즈) 공주님은 미쳤다는 딱지가 붙은 채 멀리 보내지셨지.

english: I do very much miss her, but one can't change the past.
translation: 정말 많이 보고 싶지만, 지나간 일은 되돌릴 수 없는 법이야.

english: What if I were to say she's still out there! Read this entry that I found hidden within a secret part of the memoir.
translation: 그분이 아직 살아 계신다고 하면요? 회고록의 비밀 공간에 숨겨져 있던 이 글을 읽어 보세요.

english: I'm sorry adventurer, but what does this prove exactly? For all you know someone else wrote this to mislead you.
translation: 미안하지만 모험가, 이게 대체 뭘 증명한다는 거야? 다른 누군가가 널 속이려고 이걸 썼을 수도 있잖아.

english: Ah, you do make a good point...
If she did write this I'm afraid to say she must be mad after all.
translation: 만약 그분이 정말 이걸 쓰신 거라면, 안타깝지만 결국 정말 미치신 거겠지.

english: What makes you say that?
Are all adventurers as dense as you? If you were in danger, do you really think leaving a hidden message in an old lost book for any stranger to pick up is the best way to get help?
translation: 모험가들은 다 너처럼 둔하니? 네가 위험에 처했다면, 아무나 주워 볼 수 있는 잃어버린 낡은 책에 숨겨진 메시지를 남기는 게 도움을 청하는 최선의 방법이라고 정말 생각하겠어?

english: It's certainly peculiar, but it should be investigated regardless. Y'know, just in case...
translation: 이상하긴 하지만 그래도 조사는 해 봐야죠. 그러니까, 혹시 모르잖아요...

english: Alright, spring the trap! Don't come crying to me when it all turns sour.
translation: 그래, 덫이든 뭐든 마음대로 건드려 봐! 일이 틀어져도 나한테 울면서 오지나 마.

english: Don't you worry! I'm a brave adventurer with a damsel in distress to rescue! This is my bread and butter.
translation: 걱정 마세요! 저는 곤경에 빠진 아가씨를 구하러 가는 용감한 모험가라고요! 이게 제 밥줄이에요.

english: Yes, yes, of course. Well, I'd be glad to hear of her being safe but perhaps you should heed the warning.
translation: 그래, 그래, 물론이지. 뭐, 그분이 무사하다는 소식을 들으면 기쁘겠지만, 경고는 새겨듣는 게 좋을 거야.

english: Which warning?
Tread carefully.
Oh, of course! Thanks for chatting with me Alyssa, I'll see you around.
translation: 아, 물론이죠! 얘기 나눠 주셔서 고마워요, Alyssa(앨리사). 또 봬요.

english: Farewell.
