I'm sorry, but I'm not paid to serve every lazy adventurer who walks their dirty feet through my halls!
translation: 미안하지만, 내 복도를 더러운 발로 휘젓고 다니는 게으른 모험가들 시중까지 들라고 돈 받는 건 아니거든!

english: Sorry, I'll be going.
Just making small talk.
Who are you?
You! I should have known this would be your doing!
translation: 너! 이게 네 짓일 줄 알았어야 했는데!

english: It's over, Amascut! Your plan has failed.
My plan has only just begun! Even with this setback, those pathetic fragments of my father have still given me ample power. My strength is absolute!
translation: 내 계획은 이제 막 시작됐을 뿐이다! 이런 차질이 있었어도, 내 아버지의 그 하찮은 파편들은 내게 충분한 힘을 주었지. 내 힘은 절대적이다!

english: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I've stopped every one of your schemes so far, and I'll stop the next one as well.
translation: 그럴지도 모르지만 상관없어. 지금까지 네 음모를 전부 막아 왔고, 다음 것도 막을 거야.

english: Really? You think you're leaving this place alive? I can promise you that won't be the case! My father's weapons have given me his power, and now they'll finally rid me of you!
translation: 그래? 네가 여기서 살아 나갈 수 있을 것 같으냐? 그렇게는 안 될 거라고 약속하지! 아버지의 무기들이 그 힘을 내게 주었으니, 이제 드디어 그 무기로 너를 없애 주마!

english: Amascut activates the obelisk and teleports away.
Yes.
No.
Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: Ur-tag(우르-타그) 촌장님, 이 철도 연결 공사를 기한 내에 끝내는 게 얼마나 중요한지 아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않습니다. 광산 회사들이 막대한 대출을 받아 놨단 말입니다...

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: 대사님의 걱정은 이해합니다만, 이번 발견들로 전체 일정이 바뀔 수밖에 없다는 걸 아셔야 합니다. 그것들을 서둘러 치워 버리는 건 지식에 대한 범죄일 겁니다.

english: What are you talking about?
It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: 우리 도시와 드워프의 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림) 사이에 새로 놓고 있는 지하 철도 이야기입니다.

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: 드워프 공학의 정점이 될 거예요! 낡은 증기식 광차에서 크게 도약하는 거죠! Consortium(컨소시엄)의 힘과 창의력을 보여 주는 기념비라고요!

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: 지금쯤이면 벌써 끝났을 공사인데, 저 사람들이 오래된 고블린 뼈를 발견하고는 그걸 파내겠다잖아요.

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: Dorgeshuun Civil War(도르게슌 내전) 때 묻힌 아주 중요한 유물들을 발굴했습니다. 우리 역사의 중요한 부분을 밝혀 줄 수도 있지요.

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
translation: [player name] 님, 혹시 고고학 경험이 있으십니까?

english: I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: 훌륭하군요! 우리는 몇 세대 동안 큰 고고학 사업을 해 본 적이 없으니, 도와주신다면 정말 감사하겠습니다.

english: I'd love to help!
Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: 좋습니다! 철도 터널로 가는 길은 도시 남서쪽에 있습니다.

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: 이제야 이 일을 빨리 끝내고 선로 까는 작업에 들어갈 수 있겠군요.

english: Do your own digging!
Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
translation: 뭐, 할 수 없지요. 우리 속도대로 계속하겠습니다.

english: What can I do in the city?
Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: 시장에 가 보시는 건 어떻습니까? 요즘 지상 음식이 꽤 유행이라고 들었으니, 거기서 뭔가 팔 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 도시 남쪽의 동굴에도 가 보시면 좋을 겁니다. 싸울 괴물이 많은데, Zanik(자닉)은 그 괴물들 머리 위로 건너가는 방법을 찾아냈다더군요!

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: 교역을 위해서, 그리고 종족 간의 우호를 다지기 위해서입니다! 분명 두 종족 모두에게 이로울 겁니다.

english: It's funny... whenever we dwarves have ventured onto the surface, we've found ourselves at war with the goblins there.
translation: 재미있는 일이에요... 우리 드워프가 지상으로 나갈 때마다 그곳 고블린들과 전쟁을 벌이게 됐거든요.

english: But now we meet these goblins underground, and they're no threat at all. Maybe this will herald a change in our relations with the surface goblins as well.
translation: 그런데 이제 지하에서 이 고블린들을 만나 보니 전혀 위협이 안 되네요. 어쩌면 이걸 계기로 지상 고블린들과의 관계도 달라질지 모르죠.

english: I can't stand these goblins sometimes! I come up with suggestions to make their city more efficient, and they just say it would spoil their precious way of life!
translation: 가끔은 이 고블린들 정말 못 참겠어요! 도시를 더 효율적으로 만들 방안을 내놓으면, 소중한 자기들 생활 방식을 망친다는 소리만 하니까요!

english: Trade with the goblins is going well at the moment. It's a pity they don't seem as interested in our beer as in your food, though!
translation: 요즘 고블린들과의 교역은 잘 되고 있어요. 다만 당신네 음식만큼 우리 맥주에는 관심이 없어 보여서 아쉽네요!

english: Thank you again for helping us complete the train link. Further delays would have cost the Consortium a lot of money.
translation: 철도 연결을 끝내도록 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요. 더 늦어졌으면 Consortium(컨소시엄)이 큰돈을 날릴 뻔했어요.

english: Oh, and I hear you saved someone's life as well. Well done on that count too.
translation: 아, 그리고 누군가의 목숨도 구했다면서요. 그 일도 정말 잘했어요.

english: I miss Keldagrim. This city is all very well, but no one makes an underground city like the dwarves!
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)이 그리워요. 이 도시도 좋긴 하지만, 지하 도시는 역시 드워프만큼 잘 짓는 이가 없죠!

english: Answer this, please.
Well done.
Yes.
No.
What are you arguing about?
What can I do in the city?
Why did you decide to open the city?
Hello Ambassador. Are you here visiting King Roald?
translation: 안녕하세요, 대사님. King Roald(로알드 왕)을 뵈러 오셨나요?

english: Well, in theory, but he always seems to be busy.
translation: 이론상으로는요. 그런데 늘 바쁘신 것 같더군요.

english: You don't seem that upset by that, though...
Oh no, I like travelling, and if you become a diplomat patience is a vital skill.
translation: 아뇨, 전혀요. 저는 여행을 좋아하고, 외교관이 되려면 인내심이 필수 덕목이거든요.

english: I'll try to remember that.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 제대로 된 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 가져와야 해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 되겠어요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Ambassador Ferrnook
Excellent. A taste of home.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 먼 길을 오셨겠군요. 여기, 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 포인트가 [number]점 있다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 포인트가 [number]점 있다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게 무료 배달 토큰을 받아 가는 걸 잊지 말자.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 다른 주문을 받자. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: I can't believe that I've been made to wait so long.
translation: 이렇게 오래 기다리게 하다니 믿을 수가 없군요.

english: What are you waiting for?
I have been waiting for an audience with the King for days!
translation: 며칠째 왕을 알현하려고 기다리고 있단 말이에요!

english: Well, he's clearly a busy man.
Bah! I think he's just trying to insult the gnome nation, by making me wait. The cheek of these humans. Just because they're vertically challenged they think they can ignore us.
translation: 흥! 이렇게 기다리게 해서 노움 민족을 모욕하려는 거라고요. 이 인간들 뻔뻔하기도 하지. 자기들 키가 쓸데없이 크다는 이유만으로 우리를 깔봐도 되는 줄 안다니까요.

english: I'm not ignoring you.
Hmm. I should be thankful for small mercies, I suppose.
Many thanks. This will help wile away the time whilst I'm waiting for an audience.
translation: 정말 고마워요. 알현을 기다리는 동안 시간 때우기에 딱 좋겠군요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 먼 길을 오셨겠군요. 여기, 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: It's all very bright round here, isn't it?
translation: 이 근처는 온통 너무 눈부시네요, 안 그래요?

english: Well, it is the White Knights' Castle.
translation: 뭐, 여긴 White Knights' Castle(백기사의 성)이니까요.

english: I think it would all look better in a nice dark green. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: 제 생각엔 전부 짙은 녹색으로 칠하면 훨씬 보기 좋을 것 같아요. 그럼 적어도 계속 눈을 찡그리고 있진 않아도 될 텐데요.

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Dark Green Knights. Doesn't really have the same ring to it.
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 그러면 백기사가 아니라 '짙은 녹색 기사'가 돼야 하잖아요. 어감이 영 안 사는데요.

english: Bah, humans have no sense of style...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오시진 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 얼로프트)의 손님께는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Ambassador Spanfipple
translation: Ambassador Spanfipple(스팬피플 대사)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넵니다.

english: Thank you kindly. I haven't got used to this human food and drink yet.
translation: 정말 고마워요. 인간 음식이랑 음료엔 아직 적응이 안 돼서요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져다주려고 먼 길을 오셨겠군요. 팁으로 약간 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없어요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: It's all very white round here, isn't it?
translation: 이 근처는 온통 새하얗네요, 안 그래요?

english: I think it would all look better in pink. At least then I wouldn't be squinting all the time.
translation: 제 생각엔 전부 분홍색으로 칠하면 훨씬 보기 좋을 것 같아요. 그럼 적어도 계속 눈을 찡그리고 있진 않아도 될 텐데요.

english: Yes, but then they'd have to become the Pink Knights. I think they'd have problems recruiting then.
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 그러면 기사들이 '분홍기사'가 돼야 하잖아요. 그럼 신입 모집이 꽤 힘들 것 같은데요.

english: You're probably right. Maybe brown, then.
translation: 그 말이 맞겠네요. 그럼 갈색은 어때요.

english: I think that may be worse...
Hello there.
Hello. Do you need something?
Nope. Just thought I'd say hi.
Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Not that I remember.
Well she was a great hero during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend before the war ended. I'm trying to find out more about her.
translation: 음, 그녀는 Dragonkin Conflicts(드래곤킨 분쟁) 때의 위대한 영웅이었어요. 전쟁이 끝나기 전에 Kourend(쿠렌드)로 건너간 것 같아요. 그녀에 대해 더 알아보는 중이에요.

english: Well Shayzien was founded by those fleeing the Dragonkin Conflicts. And the city has never been short of heroes. There's a good chance she was from Shayzien.
translation: 음, Shayzien(샤이지엔)은 드래곤킨 분쟁을 피해 도망친 사람들이 세운 곳이에요. 그리고 이 도시엔 영웅이 모자란 적이 없었죠. 그녀가 샤이지엔 출신일 가능성이 꽤 높아요.

english: But you've never heard of her?
No but that's not surprising. Most of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. There is somewhere you might find answers though.
translation: 네, 하지만 놀랄 일은 아니에요. 우리 역사 대부분이 Xeric(제릭)의 통치 기간에 사라져 버렸거든요. 그래도 답을 찾을 만한 곳이 하나 있긴 해요.

english: Where's that?
The Shayzien Crypts. They were built before the kingdom even existed. Some of the oldest Shayzien heroes are buried there.
translation: Shayzien Crypts(샤이지엔 지하 묘지)예요. 왕국이 생기기도 전에 지어진 곳이죠. 가장 오래된 샤이지엔 영웅들 몇몇이 거기 묻혀 있어요.

english: Let me guess. There's a catch isn't there?
translation: 맞혀 볼게요. 뭔가 문제가 있는 거죠?

english: I'm afraid so. For hundreds of years, the crypts have been overrun by the dead. We've tried clearing them out but they just come back again.
translation: 안타깝지만 그래요. 수백 년 동안 지하 묘지는 죽은 자들로 들끓었어요. 쓸어버리려고 해 봤지만 계속 다시 돌아오더라고요.

english: Well thankfully I'm afraid of no ghost. Where do I start?
translation: 다행히 저는 유령 따윈 하나도 안 무서워요. 어디서부터 시작하면 되죠?

english: They're zombies, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful.
translation: 유령이 아니라 좀비예요. 지하 묘지 입구는 우리 예배당 남쪽에 있는 Graveyard of Heroes(영웅의 묘지)에 있어요. 조심하세요.

english: Thank you for the help.
I'm sure we've already spoken about this.
translation: 이 얘긴 이미 나눈 것 같은데요.

english: We probably have. I'm very forgetful.
The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, south of our chapel. Be careful, it's filled with zombies.
translation: 답을 찾을 가능성이 가장 높은 곳은 Shayzien Crypts(샤이지엔 지하 묘지)예요. 입구는 우리 예배당 남쪽에 있는 Graveyard of Heroes(영웅의 묘지)에 있어요. 조심하세요, 좀비가 가득하거든요.

english: Thank you.
Greetings and welcome to my seed shop. Do you want to buy some seeds?
translation: 어서 오세요, 제 씨앗 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 씨앗 좀 사시겠어요?

english: No, thank you.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Euat! You are not welcome here!
Euat! This is not yet over!
Euat! We are not done yet!
Euat! I am not so easily destroyed!
translation: 에우앗! 나는 그리 쉽게 무너지지 않는다!

english: Hello there.
Adventurer.
What do you do?
I'm a trader of sorts, but only to those who don't ask too many questions.
translation: 일종의 상인이에요. 다만 질문을 너무 많이 하지 않는 사람하고만 거래하죠.

english: Interesting, what do you offer?
I can give you crystal shards in return for crystal seeds.
translation: crystal seeds(크리스탈 씨앗)을 주시면 crystal shards(크리스탈 조각)으로 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.

english: I'll pass, maybe another time.
Yes.
No.
Hey I'm Amy, how may I help you?
What do you do here?
I'm the founder of Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first Construction company!
translation: 저는 Gielinor(길리노르) 최초의 건설 회사, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)의 창립자예요!

english: We've currently got branches in Falador, Varrock, Hosidius and Ardougne.
translation: 지금은 Falador(팔라도르), Varrock(바록), Hosidius(호시디우스), Ardougne(아르둔)에 지점이 있어요.

english: So people contact you for help with their homes?
translation: 그럼 사람들이 집 문제로 도움이 필요할 때 연락하는 거예요?

english: Yep! They'll get in contact if they want assistance, whether it's fixing parts of their house or requesting nicer furniture, and then we will go and help them out.
translation: 맞아요! 집 일부를 고쳐야 하든 더 좋은 가구를 원하든, 도움이 필요하면 연락을 주고, 그럼 저희가 가서 도와드리는 거죠.

english: That sounds quite enjoyable and satisfying to do, are you hiring at all?
translation: 꽤 즐겁고 보람 있는 일 같네요. 혹시 사람 뽑으세요?

english: If you have the supplies, I can tell you where one of our clients is that needs some work doing.
translation: 재료만 갖고 계시면, 일손이 필요한 고객 한 분이 어디 계신지 알려 드릴 수 있어요.

english: I'll keep track of the work you do as well and give you some points for our company reward shop.
translation: 하신 일도 제가 기록해 두고, 저희 회사 보상 상점에서 쓸 포인트도 드릴게요.

english: Also there are assistants in Varrock, Ardougne, and Hosidius that can give you work, if Falador is inconvienent for you.
translation: 그리고 팔라도르가 불편하시면 바록, 아르둔, 호시디우스에도 일거리를 주는 직원들이 있어요.

english: The clients that I would offer you to go help could be in any of those cities, it might be a bit of a journey to get there!
translation: 제가 소개해 드리는 고객은 그 도시들 중 어디에나 있을 수 있어요. 가려면 좀 먼 길이 될 수도 있어요!

english: I'd like a construction contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have a beginner contract please?
Please could you go see[client][area][city], [location description] for us? You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.
translation: [client][area][city], [location description]에 가 봐 주시겠어요? [his/her] 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Could I have a novice contract please?
Could I have an adept contract please?
Could I have an expert contract please?
I'll pass actually.
Thanks for the information.
What's my current construction contract?
Go see[client][area][city], [location description]. You can get another job once you have furnished [his/her] home.
translation: [client][area][city], [location description]에 가 보세요. [his/her] 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: How is the company doing?
Pretty good, we've only opened up recently and already have 12 clients!
translation: 꽤 잘돼요. 문 연 지 얼마 안 됐는데 벌써 고객이 12명이나 돼요!

english: These clients are quite indecisive about what they want their houses to look like though, I'm not complaining.
translation: 다만 고객분들이 집을 어떻게 꾸밀지 좀처럼 정하질 못하시더라고요. 불평하는 건 아니에요.

english: Yeah I've noticed that they seem to keep breaking hatstands all the time too, I'm not sure how easy it is to break a hatstand...
translation: 맞아요, 그분들 모자걸이도 계속 부수는 것 같던데요. 모자걸이가 그렇게 쉽게 부서지는 물건인지 모르겠어요...

english: Very bizarre.
I'm glad you're doing well!
Thanks.
Why don't you have a construction cape if you're a master builder?
translation: 건설의 달인이시면서 왜 Construction cape(건설 망토)가 없으세요?

english: Well why do you have one?
The teleports on it are really handy.
translation: 망토에 달린 순간이동 기능이 정말 편하거든요.

english: Why would a cape for construction use magic? That seems a bit illogical doesn't it?
translation: 건설 망토가 왜 마법을 써야 하죠? 좀 앞뒤가 안 맞지 않아요?

english: We are people of hard work, not ones that rely on wizardry!
translation: 우리는 땀 흘려 일하는 사람들이지, 마법에 기대는 사람들이 아니라고요!

english: I suppose you're right.
Nothing, never mind.
Sorry, Mahogany Homes aren't giving out any contracts during this league.
translation: 죄송하지만, 이번 리그 동안 Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)는 계약을 내주지 않아요.

english: That's a plank, you'll need a lot of those.
translation: 그건 plank(판자)예요. 아주 많이 필요하실 거예요.

english: That's a sawIt's pretty useful.
That's a fascinating looking saw, it looks like it would break though.
translation: 정말 신기하게 생긴 saw(톱)네요. 그래도 금방 부러질 것 같아요.

english: Oh you have have one of my saws, I hope you enjoy it!
translation: 어머, 제 톱을 갖고 계시네요. 잘 쓰시길 바라요!

english: That's a hammer. It's pretty useful.
I'd like a construction contract.
Beginner Contract
Novice Contract (Requires 20 Construction)
Adept Contract (Requires 50 Construction)
Expert Contract (Requires 70 Construction)
I'll pass actually.
Thanks for the information.
What's my current contract?
Could I see the reward shop?
translation: 보상 상점 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: How is the company doing?
Why don't you have a construction cape?
Nothing, never mind.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 멋진 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.
You! Which god do you serve?
Err... What?
The war! What side do you fight on?
translation: 전쟁 말이다! 너는 어느 편에서 싸우느냐?

english: War? There's no war?
No war? But I was fighting earlier today.
translation: 전쟁이 없다고? 하지만 나는 오늘 낮까지도 싸우고 있었는데.

english: I hate to say it, but I don't think that's true. You're dead.
translation: 이런 말 하긴 싫지만, 그건 사실이 아닌 것 같아요. 당신은 죽었어요.

english: Dead? That can't be! I am a loyal warrior of...
translation: 죽었다고? 그럴 리가! 나는 충성스러운 전사다, 섬기는 분은...

english: Of?
I... I don't know. I can't remember.
translation: 나... 나는 모르겠다. 기억이 나지 않아.

english: We came here to fight. But I don't know who for. It's like it was moments ago, but also a lifetime in the past.
translation: 우리는 싸우러 이곳에 왔다. 하지만 누구를 위해서였는지 모르겠어. 방금 전 일 같으면서도, 아주 오래전 일 같기도 하다.

english: Do you know who you were fighting against?
No. We were here to claim something. To protect it. But everything else is unclear.
translation: 아니. 우리는 무언가를 차지하러 왔다. 그것을 지키러. 하지만 그 외에는 전부 흐릿하다.

english: I'm sorry, this is all so confusing. I need some time to try and understand.
translation: 미안하다, 모든 게 너무 혼란스럽군. 이해하려면 시간이 좀 필요하겠다.

english: Well I hope it all works out for you. Good luck.
translation: 음, 잘 해결되길 바랄게요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: Die puny chicken!
What? I'm not a chicken.
You wear cunning disguise. I see though. You flappy chicken! You die in name of Big High War God.
translation: 너 교활한 변장 했다. 그래도 나 안다. 너 퍼덕퍼덕 닭! 너 Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신) 이름으로 죽는다.

english: There's no Big High War God here.
translation: 여기에 위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신 같은 건 없어요.

english: Lies! Big High War God use the shiny to kill the chickens! Now we clear up the rest!
translation: 거짓말! 위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신, 반짝이로 닭들 죽였다! 이제 우리 나머지 치운다!

english: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think this 'shiny' might have killed you as well.
translation: 나쁜 소식 전해서 미안하지만, 그 '반짝이'가 당신도 죽인 것 같은데요.

english: Chicken play mind games, but I no fool. You die now!
translation: 닭, 머리 쓴다. 그래도 나 바보 아니다. 너 이제 죽는다!

english: You know there's normally not this much talking before dying.
translation: 보통은 죽기 전에 이렇게 말이 많지 않거든요.

english: Yes! No talking! Only die!
translation: 맞다! 말 안 한다! 죽기만 한다!

english: I'm waiting.
Arghhh!
I think I'll leave you to it.
Die!
For Zaros!
Perish in agony!
I'm coming for you!
What do you do here?
I'm helpin' ta protect the base camp. How about you, what are you doing here?
translation: 베이스캠프 지키는 걸 돕고 있지. 그러는 넌, 여기서 뭐 하냐?

english: Oh, I'm trying to help out around here.
translation: 아, 이 근처 일을 좀 도우려고요.

english: Good, we can always use extra help. Just make sure you don't go getting into any trouble or you'll have me to deal with!
translation: 좋아, 일손은 언제나 환영이지. 그냥 말썽만 일으키지 마. 안 그러면 나한테 혼날 줄 알아!

english: Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe? I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
Yes please.
Doesn't look like you have enough money. I charge 10,000 coins for the journey.
Where's Slepe?
It's a small village to the south of here. You can walk but the boat is safer and faster.
translation: 여기서 남쪽에 있는 작은 마을이에요. 걸어갈 수도 있지만 배가 더 안전하고 빨라요.

english: Is there anything to do there?
translation: 거기 가면 할 만한 게 있어요?

english: I guess that depends what interests you. The place is pretty quiet, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: 뭐에 관심 있으신지에 달렸죠. 아주 조용한 곳이긴 한데, 요즘 마을 지하에 거대한 악이 자리를 잡았다는 소문이 돌아요.

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza to the south, home to the Theatre of Blood. It's definitely worth having a look around, even if you don't intend to participate yourself.
translation: 남쪽엔 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)이 있는 Ver Sinhaza(베르 신하자)도 있어요. 직접 참가할 생각이 없더라도 한번 둘러볼 만한 곳이에요.

english: So, do you want to go to Slepe?
Why is it so expensive?
Not many people want to visit this part of the world so I have to keep the price high. If I didn't I wouldn't be able to keep my boat maintained.
translation: 이쪽으로 오려는 사람이 별로 없어서 값을 높게 받을 수밖에 없어요. 안 그러면 배를 관리할 수가 없거든요.

english: I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
1,000,000 coins! Are you serious?
No. I don't have that sort of money.
Oh, I see. So, do you want to go to Slepe?
Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
Thank you so much. Now, do you want to go to Slepe?
No. That's too much for me to spend.
No thank you.
Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe?
Hello there. Want to return to Port Phasmatys?
Andras transports the player to Port Phasmatys.
translation: Andras(안드라스)가 플레이어를 Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)로 데려다준다.

english: Is there anything to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Well you have Slepe just north of here. It's mostly a quiet place, though there's been rumours recently of a great evil making its home beneath the village.
translation: 음, 바로 북쪽에 Slepe(슬렙)이 있어요. 대체로 조용한 곳인데, 요즘 마을 지하에 거대한 악이 자리를 잡았다는 소문이 돌아요.

english: There's also Ver Sinhaza. You can find it south of here. There's a gap in the northern wall that you can get through.
translation: Ver Sinhaza(베르 신하자)도 있어요. 여기서 남쪽으로 가면 나와요. 북쪽 성벽에 지나갈 수 있는 틈이 있어요.

english: What's Ver Sinhaza?

It's a large vampyric castle, home to the Theatre of Blood. The vampyres claim that the Theatre is one of the greatest combat challenges around. Definitely worth a look even if you don't want to participate.
translation: Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)이 있는 거대한 뱀파이어 성이에요. 뱀파이어들은 그 극장이 손꼽히는 최고의 전투 시련이라고 주장하죠. 참가할 생각이 없더라도 한번 가 볼 만해요.

english: Anyway, did you want to return to Port Phasmatys?
Andras transports the player to Slepe.
Yes please.
Where's Slepe?
No thank you.
Why is it so expensive?
I'll give you 1,000,000 coins for permanent access.
Yes. Here's 1,000,000 coins.
No. That's too much for me to spend.
Is there anything to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지가 않아요. 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 탐험할 새로운 대륙이 통째로 있다니... 정말 살맛 나는

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있다고 누가 얘기하는 걸 들었어요. 조심하세요!

english: Well met, fellow adventurer.
Adventurer? I am no mere Adventurer, I am Andros Mai, brother of the Holy Order of Saradomin. You would do well to greet me with respect.
translation: 모험가? 나는 한낱 모험가가 아닐세. 나는 Holy Order of Saradomin(사라도민 신성 교단)의 수사, Andros Mai(안드로스 마이)일세. 예를 갖춰 인사하는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: Andros Mai? Sorry, but I can't say I've heard of you I'm afraid.
translation: 안드로스 마이요? 죄송하지만 들어 본 적이 없는 것 같네요.

english: I wouldn't have expected someone of your... stature to know of me.
translation: 자네 같은... 격의 사람이 나를 알 거라곤 기대하지도 않았네.

english: Tell me, what do you know of the vile Vet'ion?
translation: 말해 보게, 그 사악한 Vet'ion(베티온)에 대해 무엇을 알고 있나?

english: Nothing, but I have a feeling you're about to fill me in.
translation: 아무것도요. 그런데 왠지 지금부터 알려 주실 것 같네요.

english: We've crossed swords in the past, I can't say I'm too keen to do it again though.
translation: 예전에 칼을 맞대 본 적이 있어요. 솔직히 다시 하고 싶진 않네요.

english: You challenged him and came out unscathed? Impossible.
translation: 그자에게 도전하고도 멀쩡히 살아남았다고? 말도 안 되네.

english: I'm stronger than I look.
But why do you ask? What do you want with Vet'ion?
translation: 그런데 왜 물으세요? 베티온한테 무슨 볼일이 있으신데요?

english: Vet'ion was a devout follower of the heretical god Zamorak. It is the will of my order and my duty as a follower of the true god Saradomin to end his tyranny.
translation: 베티온은 이단의 신 Zamorak(자모락)의 독실한 추종자였네. 그자의 폭정을 끝내는 것은 우리 교단의 뜻이자, 참된 신 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르는 자로서 나의 의무일세.

english: After many years in my order's libraries, I stumbled upon an old tome which mentioned Vet'ion's final resting place, which I believe to be his source of power.
translation: 우리 교단의 서고에서 여러 해를 보낸 끝에, 베티온이 마지막으로 잠든 곳을 언급한 오래된 책을 우연히 발견했네. 나는 그곳이 그자의 힘의 원천이라고 믿고 있지.

english: His very existence is an insult to my lord Saradomin and I will not suffer it to exist any longer.
translation: 그자가 존재한다는 것 자체가 나의 주 사라도민에 대한 모욕일세. 더는 그 존재를 용납하지 않겠네.

english: Then why are you waiting here? Seems to me that you don't want to face Vet'ion.
translation: 그럼 왜 여기서 기다리고 계세요? 제가 보기엔 베티온이랑 맞서기 싫으신 것 같은데요.

english: I have no fear of Vet'ion!
I am merely meditating and preparing for the battle. I need to focus my mind before going out to find his resting place.
translation: 그저 명상하며 전투를 준비하고 있을 뿐일세. 그자가 잠든 곳을 찾아 나서기 전에 정신을 가다듬어야 하네.

english: It's okay, sometimes I pretend to be busy when there's something I don't want to do, too.
translation: 괜찮아요, 저도 하기 싫은 일이 있으면 가끔 바쁜 척하거든요.

english: This conversation is over! Leave me before I lose my temper.
translation: 대화는 여기까지일세! 내가 화를 내기 전에 썩 물러가게.

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 저기요. 이거에 대해 뭐 아시는 거 있어요?

english: By Saradomin! That's a Zamorakian made chainmace you have there!
translation: 사라도민이시여! 자네가 가진 그것은 자모락교도가 만든 사슬철퇴가 아닌가!

english: And? Do you know anything about it?
translation: 그래서요? 이거에 대해 뭐 아시는 거 있어요?

english: I know melee weapons in general. Well enough to know most of them can be upgraded.
translation: 근접 무기라면 대체로 알고 있네. 대부분 강화할 수 있다는 것쯤은 알 정도로 말일세.

english: Perhaps with something sharp to give it more impact as it swings around.
translation: 아마 날카로운 무언가를 달면 휘두를 때 더 큰 타격을 줄 수 있을 걸세.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: 흥미롭네요! 그런 강력한 강화 재료가 있는지 잘 찾아볼게요.

english: They look like powerful claws. You could probably attach them to a weapon to make the weapon stronger.
translation: 강력한 발톱처럼 보이는군. 무기에 달면 무기를 더 강하게 만들 수 있을 걸세.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
translation: 흥미롭네요! 그런 게 있는지 잘 찾아볼게요.

english: Perhaps I could use this?
Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: 그렇네. 그거라면 무기에 달 수 있을 것 같군.

english: Could you combine them?
While I could, I'd really not like to.
translation: 할 수는 있네만, 정말 하고 싶지 않네.

english: Surely you could consider it... For the right price?
translation: 한번 생각해 보실 수도 있잖아요... 값만 맞으면요?

english: Money has been tight lately...
And my supplies are running low...
Fine. But I want 500,000 coins for that. No less.
translation: 좋네. 하지만 그 대가로 500,000코인을 받아야겠네. 한 푼도 깎을 수 없네.

english: I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
No. I'm afraid not. They just look like fangs.
translation: 아니. 유감이지만 아닐세. 그냥 송곳니로 보이는군.

english: Fangs indeed. Rather useless it seems.
translation: 정말 송곳니네요. 별 쓸모는 없나 봐요.

english: Perhaps not. I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: 그렇지 않을지도 모르네. 저기 있는 Derse Venator(더스 베나토르)라는 친구가 비슷한 물건을 다루는 걸 본 적이 있네. 그 친구라면 더 알지도 모르지.

english: Thanks!
That's him! The vile Vet'Ion. I should like to smash this skull!
translation: 바로 그자일세! 사악한 Vet'Ion(베티온)! 이 해골을 박살 내 버리고 싶군!

english: Wait! It seems to still contain some magic. Surely we can use it?
translation: 잠깐만요! 아직 마력이 좀 남아 있는 것 같은데요. 분명 쓸 데가 있지 않을까요?

english: The only thing his skull would be useful for is Zamorakian heresy. I won't stand for it!
translation: 그자의 해골이 쓸모 있는 데라곤 자모락의 이단 행위뿐일세. 그런 건 용납 못 하네!

english: Is there really nothing you can do to help me with this?
translation: 정말 이걸로 저를 도와주실 방법이 없어요?

english: Do you see Phabelle over there? Despite her questionable morals, she's my friend.
translation: 저기 있는 Phabelle(파벨)이 보이나? 도덕관념은 좀 의심스럽지만, 내 친구일세.

english: She's good with magic and may know how to take advantage of the powers in that skull.
translation: 마법에 능하니 그 해골에 깃든 힘을 활용하는 법을 알지도 모르네.

english: No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 아. 더 잘 알 만한 사람은 없을까요?

english: Downstairs you can find Madam Sikaro. Though she's on the wrong path, perhaps she could assist you.
translation: 아래층에 가면 Madam Sikaro(시카로 부인)이 있네. 그릇된 길을 걷고 있긴 하지만, 어쩌면 자네를 도울 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: You look ready for combat.
Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
You look like somebody who could use a bit of armour. What do you say?
translation: 갑옷 좀 필요해 보이는 분이시네요. 어떠세요?

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Maybe I overestimated you. I suppose such fine equipment isn't for everyone.
translation: 제가 당신을 너무 높이 봤나 보네요. 이렇게 좋은 장비가 아무한테나 맞는 건 아니죠.

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Repair that item: [cost to repair single item] coins.
translation: 이 아이템 수리: [cost to repair single item]코인.

english: Repair all items: [cost to repair all items] coins.
translation: 모든 아이템 수리: [cost to repair all items]코인.

english: Cancel.
Hey, how can I help you?
What do you do here?
This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: 여긴 Gielinor(길리노르) 최초의 건설 회사, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)의 지점 중 하나예요.

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
translation: 와, 저도 참여하려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: Falador(팔라도르) 지점의 Amy(에이미)를 찾아가 보세요. 자세히 알려 줄 거예요. 사무실은 팔라도르 Estate Agent(부동산 중개인) 바로 동쪽에 있어요.

english: Nice, thank you.
I'd like a construction contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have an expert contract please?
Please could you go seeBarbara, south ofHosidius, near the mill for us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 남쪽, 방앗간 근처에 사는 Barbara(바바라)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그녀의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeBobin north-eastVarrock, opposite the church for us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Varrock(바록) 북동쪽, 교회 맞은편에 사는 Bob(밥)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeJess, upstairs of the building south of the church in EastArdougnefor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔)의 교회 남쪽 건물 위층에 사는 Jess(제스)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그녀의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeLarry, north of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Falador(팔라도르)의 분수 북쪽에 사는 Larry(래리)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeMariah, west of the estate agents inHosidiusfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)의 부동산 중개소 서쪽에 사는 Mariah(머라이어)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그녀의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeNoella, north of EastArdougne marketfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔) 시장 북쪽에 사는 Noella(노엘라)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그녀의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeNorman, south of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: Falador(팔라도르)의 분수 남쪽에 사는 Norman(노먼)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeRoss, north of the church in EastArdougnefor us? You can get another job once you have furnished his home.
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔)의 교회 북쪽에 사는 Ross(로스)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: Please could you go seeTau, south east of the fountain inFaladorfor us? You can get another job once you have furnished her home.
translation: Falador(팔라도르)의 분수 남동쪽에 사는 Tau(타우)에게 가 봐 주시겠어요? 그녀의 집에 가구를 다 들이면 다음 일을 받을 수 있어요.

english: I'll pass actually.
What's my current construction contract?
Beginner Contract
Novice Contract (Requires 20 Construction)
Adept Contract (Requires 50 Construction)
Expert Contract (Requires 70 Construction)
I'll pass actually.
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
I'm ALIVE!
Anita is busy cleaning.
Hi Anita.
I'm sorry about what happened to Glough, Anita.
translation: Glough(글로우) 일은 정말 유감이에요, 아니타 씨.

english: Glough was deeply troubled, [player name]. Fortunately Carado has helped me move on.
translation: 글로우는 마음의 병이 깊었어요, [player name] 님. 다행히 Carado(카라도) 덕분에 저는 털고 일어설 수 있었어요.

english: Hello.
Hello sir. What are you doing in my house?
translation: 안녕하세요, 손님. 저희 집에서 뭐 하시는 거예요?

english: I'm just wandering around.
Oh dear, are you lost?
Yes, I'm lost.
Okay, just walk north-east when you leave this house, and soon you'll reach the big city of Falador.
translation: 그럼 이 집에서 나가서 북동쪽으로 쭉 걸어가세요. 금방 큰 도시 Falador(팔라도르)가 나올 거예요.

english: Thanks a lot.
No, I know where I am.
Oh? Well, would you mind wandering somewhere else? This is my house.
translation: 네? 그럼 다른 데 가서 돌아다녀 주시겠어요? 여긴 저희 집이에요.

english: Meh!
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: 공짜로 뭐 좀 주시지 않을까 해서요.

english: Do you REALLY need it?
Er...
I don't have much on me...
I don't know...
(beg beg beg beg beg beg)
I promise I'll stop bothering you!
Pleeease!
Pwetty pleathe wiv thugar on top!
Oh, alright. Here you go.
Eeeek!
Aaaarrgh!
I'm just wandering around.
Yes, I'm lost.
No, I know where I am.
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
translation: 공짜로 뭐 좀 주시지 않을까 해서요.

english: I've come to kill you.
Hello.
The dwarf lady seems to be looking for someone.
translation: 드워프 여인이 누군가를 찾고 있는 것 같다.

english: Hello, I'm looking for my husband. Have you seen him?
translation: 안녕하세요, 남편을 찾고 있는데요. 혹시 보셨어요?

english: What does he look like?
Oh, to pot with this silly charade, I'm down here to try and win big on the moggies.
translation: 에잇, 이 바보 같은 연극은 집어치우죠. 사실 고양이 싸움에 크게 한탕 걸어 보려고 내려온 거예요.

english: Hang on, I thought you were looking for your husband.
translation: 잠깐만요, 남편을 찾고 계신 줄 알았는데요.

english: Um no, I was just pretending. It's frowned on a little to be seen in these parts.
translation: 음, 아뇨, 그냥 그런 척한 거예요. 이런 데서 눈에 띄면 좀 안 좋게들 보거든요.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 그래서 이 쥐 구덩이는 어떻게 돌아가는 거예요?

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 구덩이는 덩치 큰 고양이를 가진 사람들을 위한 곳이에요.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: overgrown cat(너무 자란 고양이)랑 코인 몇 닢만 있으면, 마찬가지로 너무 자란 고양이랑 여윳돈이 있는 다른 사람한테 도전할 수 있어요.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 그다음엔 내기 금액을 정해요. 소문으로는 자기 고양이랑 말이 통해서 전술을 알려 주는 쥐잡이들도 있다더라고요.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 막 그 얘길 하려던 참이에요. 도전자 양쪽의 고양이를 경기장 안에 넣고, 쥐 9마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이겨요.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 세상이 원래 잔인한 법이고, 구덩이도 예외는 아니죠.

english: Each to their own, I say.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
translation: 맞아요. 싸우다 죽은 고양이도 있다고 해요.

english: Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 세상에, 끔찍하네요. 고양이를 살릴 방법은 없어요?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 당연히 있죠. 조심하라고 지시해 두면, 위험하다 싶을 때 알아서 빠져나와요.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 음, 고양이가 죽거나 도망치면 지는 거예요.

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 그러니까 싸움에 오래 버틸수록 이길 확률이 높아지는 거죠.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 확실한 건 돈을 빨리 벌고 빨리 잃는 방법이라는 거예요.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 흠... 생각 좀 해 볼게요. 그런 일이 있었던 적은 없는 것 같은데, 아마 20,000일 거예요.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 흠, 고양이 싸움에 걸기엔 말도 안 되게 큰돈 같은데요.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 사람들이 얼마까지 걸려고 드는지 알면 놀라실걸요.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 아뇨, 지금은 안 돼요. 우린 외부인이랑은 내기를 잘 안 하거든요.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 하지만 전 외부인이 아닌데요. 지금 구덩이 안에 들어와 있잖아요?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 글쎄요, 제 신뢰를 얻을 만한 일을 하고 나면 모를까요.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 아뇨. 마을 사람들이 우릴 싫어하니까, 우리도 그 사람들이나 다른 누구도 안 믿게 된 거예요.

english: Thanks for your help.
That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
Can I challenge you and your cat?
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Ah. You must be [player name], right? I have a bronze pickaxe here for you!
translation: 아. [player name] 님 맞죠? 드릴 bronze pickaxe(청동 곡괭이)가 여기 있어요!

english: Thanks very much!
My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You will need something to help you get in there. The pickaxe I've given to you should help.
translation: 제 고용주이신 Surok Magis(수록 마기스) 님께서 당신이 터널을 쓰러 올지도 모른다고 전갈을 보내셨어요. 거기 들어가려면 도움이 될 만한 게 필요할 거예요. 제가 드린 곡괭이가 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Uh, thanks.
Okay, then. The tunnel awaits...
What tunnel?
Why, the Chaos Tunnel of course! I imagine Surok will have told you of it.
translation: 그야 물론 Chaos Tunnel(혼돈의 터널)이죠! Surok(수록) 님이 이미 말씀해 주셨을 텐데요.

english: Oh, I see. Well, what can you tell me about it?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그럼 그 터널에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel here under the statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: 음, 전해 오는 이야기와 소문에 따르면 Dagon'hai(다곤하이)가 이곳 statue of Saradomin(사라도민의 조각상) 아래에 터널을 만들었대요. Wilderness(황야)를 거치지 않고도 Chaos Altar(혼돈의 제단)에 갈 수 있도록요.

english: That's extremely handy!
Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: 네, 그렇죠. 아니, 적어도 그럴 거예요. 안타깝게도 저는 아직까지 거기 들어가지 못했거든요.

english: Why not?
The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill isn't high enough at all to do it myself. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: 누가 들어가든 먼저 터널 입구를 뚫어야 해요. 그런데 제 Mining(채광) 스킬로는 도저히 혼자 해낼 수가 없어요. 당신이 한번 해 보실래요?

english: Sorry, who are you?
My name is Louisiana Jones, although most people call me Anna. I'm an archaeologist.
translation: 제 이름은 Louisiana Jones(루이지애나 존스)예요. 다들 Anna(애나)라고 부르지만요. 고고학자랍니다.

english: Pleased to meet you.
Likewise!
Who does this statue represent?
That, my dear, is the statue of the great god Saradomin himself. Stand and admire in awe for you are in the presence of greatness!
translation: 이건 말이죠, 위대한 신 Saradomin(사라도민) 그분의 조각상이에요. 서서 경외심을 품고 감상하세요. 지금 위대함 앞에 서 계신 거니까요!

english: Consider me awed!
Indeed!
What are you doing here?
Well story and rumour has it that the Dagon'hai built a tunnel under this statue of Saradomin that would allow them to visit the Chaos Altar without having to go through the Wilderness.
translation: 음, 전해 오는 이야기와 소문에 따르면 Dagon'hai(다곤하이)가 이 statue of Saradomin(사라도민의 조각상) 아래에 터널을 만들었대요. Wilderness(황야)를 거치지 않고도 Chaos Altar(혼돈의 제단)에 갈 수 있도록요.

english: Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. I came to excavate the tunnel but, unfortunately,  I haven't been able to get in there so far.
translation: 네, 그렇죠. 아니, 적어도 그럴 거예요. 터널을 발굴하러 왔는데, 안타깝게도 아직까지 거기 들어가지 못했어요.

english: The tunnel entrance needs to be cleared before anyone can get in there. However, my Mining skill just isn't what it used to be. Perhaps you could have a go?
translation: 누가 들어가든 먼저 터널 입구를 뚫어야 해요. 그런데 제 Mining(채광) 실력이 예전 같지가 않네요. 당신이 한번 해 보실래요?

english: Maybe. I might do.
Okay, I'd better go.
Okay, then!
You did it! Oh, well done! How exciting!
translation: 해냈군요! 와, 정말 잘했어요! 너무 신나요!

english: Right, well, I better see what's down there, then.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 저 아래에 뭐가 있는지 봐야겠네요.

english: Aren't you going to go inside?
I'd better not. My orders were to open up the entrance and wait for Surok to arrive. When he gets here, we'll go in together. He promised me a lot of gold for this job!
translation: 안 들어가는 게 좋겠어요. 입구를 열어 두고 Surok(수록) 님이 오시길 기다리라는 지시를 받았거든요. 그분이 오시면 함께 들어갈 거예요. 이 일을 하면 골드를 잔뜩 주시겠다고 약속하셨어요!

english: Okay, then. I'm going in to have a look!
translation: 알겠어요, 그럼. 제가 들어가서 한번 살펴볼게요!

english: What tunnel?
Sorry, who are you?
Who does this statue represent?
What are you doing here?
Okay, I'd better go.
Hello visitor, how are you?
Better than expected. It's a lot...nicer...here than I was expecting. Everyone seems pretty happy.
translation: 생각보다 좋네요. 여기가 예상했던 것보다 훨씬...좋은...곳이네요. 다들 꽤 행복해 보이고요.

english: Of course, the Burgher is strong and wise, and looks after us well.
translation: 당연하죠. Burgher(촌장)님은 강하고 현명하셔서 저희를 잘 보살펴 주시니까요.

english: I think some of those Jatizso citizens have got the wrong idea about this place.
translation: Jatizso(자티조) 시민들 몇몇이 이곳을 오해하고 있는 것 같네요.

english: Can I help you with drift net storage, human?
translation: drift net(유망) 보관을 도와 드릴까요, 인간?

english: What do you do?
My aunt lets people come in here to catch the fish. Sometimes they have trouble carrying enough stuff, so I help by holding onto spare drift nets for them.
translation: 우리 이모가 사람들이 여기 들어와서 물고기를 잡게 해 줘요. 가끔 사람들이 짐을 넉넉히 들고 다니기 힘들어해서, 제가 여분의 유망을 맡아 주며 돕고 있어요.

english: It's a free service to help more of you humans use Ceto's cave; she's paying me, so you don't have to. So can I help you with your drift nets?
translation: 더 많은 인간들이 Ceto(세토)의 동굴을 이용하도록 돕는 무료 서비스예요. 이모가 저한테 돈을 주니까 당신은 낼 필요 없어요. 그래서, 유망 맡아 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What do you do?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Ha Ha Ha. Well if it isn't [player name], why do you dare enter my domain....
translation: 하하하. 이게 누구야, [player name] 아니냐. 감히 내 영역에 왜 발을 들였지....

english: Long time no see Anti-Santa, how's prison life been treating you?
translation: 오랜만이야, Anti-Santa(안티 산타). 감옥 생활은 어때?

english: It has been glorious, you may have thought me to be rotting inside these walls, but I've been coming up with plot to end Christmas once and for all!
translation: 더할 나위 없이 근사했지. 내가 이 벽 안에서 썩어 가는 줄 알았겠지만, 난 크리스마스를 영원히 끝장낼 음모를 꾸미고 있었다!

english: You may ofstopped me all those years ago, but you didn't stop my mind.
translation: 오래전 네가 날 막았을지는 몰라도, 내 머릿속까지 막지는 못했지.

english: Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
translation: 곧 이 벽을 벗어나면 날 막을 자는 아무도 없을 거다.

english: This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
translation: 이 한심한 명절은 끝장날 것이고, 난 그게 불타는 걸 보며 웃어 주마.

english: That red buffoon will not be able to stop me, nor you, nor that dumb cat!
translation: 그 빨간 멍청이도 날 막지 못할 거다. 너도, 그 멍청한 고양이도!

english: Anti-Santa, Santa told me all about you.
translation: Anti-Santa(안티 산타), Santa(산타)가 너에 대해 다 얘기해 줬어.

english: Don't mention his name to me, he's everything I hate about this repulsive holiday, I have always dreamed about tearing down this revolting time of year.
translation: 내 앞에서 그놈 이름 꺼내지 마라. 그놈은 이 역겨운 명절에서 내가 증오하는 모든 것이야. 난 언제나 이 끔찍한 연말을 무너뜨리는 꿈을 꿔 왔지.

english: Years ago I almost succeeded, but I was thwarted by that red buffoon and some dumb cat!
translation: 몇 년 전 거의 성공할 뻔했는데, 그 빨간 멍청이와 웬 멍청한 고양이 때문에 실패했지!

english: But in the years I've been locked away, I've been plotting and scheming. When I escape from this cell....
translation: 하지만 갇혀 있는 동안 난 계략을 짜고 음모를 꾸며 왔다. 이 감방에서 탈출하기만 하면....

english: Yes, Christmas will never be the same, children will be crying instead of laughing!
translation: 그래, 크리스마스는 다시는 예전 같지 않을 거다. 아이들은 웃는 대신 울게 되겠지!

english: The streets will be cold and lifeless.
I will stop Christmas once and for all!
And soon it will be the year of the Anti-Christmas!
translation: 그리고 곧 안티 크리스마스의 해가 올 것이다!

english: *Snores*
OI!
*Wakes up* Oh sorry! You were going on for a bit, I thought it'd never end.
translation: *깨어나며* 아, 미안! 하도 길게 떠들어서 영영 안 끝날 줄 알았어.

english: You've been moved to the top of my kill list [player name].
translation: 방금 넌 내 처단 명단 맨 위로 올라갔다, [player name].

english: Let's cut to the chase, I need your help Anti-Santa.
translation: 본론으로 들어가자. 네 도움이 필요해, Anti-Santa(안티 산타).

english: Oh, so you've come begging to me for help, what makes you think I would help you?
translation: 오호, 그래서 나한테 도와 달라고 빌러 왔다? 내가 왜 널 도와줄 거라고 생각하지?

english: What other choice do you have? It looks incredibly boring in this cell.
translation: 달리 무슨 선택지가 있는데? 이 감방, 엄청 지루해 보이는데.

english: Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
translation: 흠, 그건 맞다만, 널 돕느니 차라리 그게 낫지.

english: You're so over dramatic. Santa said he'd consider freeing you only if you help us.
translation: 유난 떨기는. Santa(산타)가 네가 우릴 도와줘야만 풀어 주는 걸 고려해 보겠대.

english: Oh did he... ...now might be my chance to escape this cell... you know what. I will help you.
translation: 오, 그랬단 말이지... ...이번이 이 감방을 탈출할 기회일지도... 좋아. 도와주지.

english: Finally, he needs you to deal with Jack Frost at a bakery in Varrock.
translation: 드디어. Santa(산타)가 Varrock(바록)의 빵집에 있는 Jack Frost(잭 프로스트)를 처리해 달래.

english: Is that it? Why can't he do it himself?
translation: 그게 다야? 그놈은 왜 직접 안 하는데?

english: He's testing a new parenting technique.
Really? How are we meant to get into this bakery?
translation: 정말이냐? 그 빵집엔 어떻게 들어가라는 거지?

english: He gave me this teleport tablet, it will take us right inside of the bakery.
translation: Santa(산타)가 이 순간이동 서판을 줬어. 우릴 빵집 안으로 바로 데려다줄 거야.

english: After all these years, he's still making adventurers do his dirty work. He's just as bad as me.
translation: 그 세월이 지났는데도 아직도 모험가들한테 궂은일을 떠넘기고 있군. 그놈도 나만큼이나 질이 나쁘다니까.

english: Trust me, I'm getting tired of it as well, we need to go before it's too late.
translation: 내 말 믿어, 나도 슬슬 지긋지긋하다고. 너무 늦기 전에 어서 가야 해.

english: Ha Ha Ha If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: 하하하, 이게 누구야, Jack Frost(잭 프로스트) 아니냐. 지난번에 봤을 때보다 더 작아 보이는구나.

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: 아-아-안티 산타!? 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: 네 아버지가 날 보냈다. 듣자 하니 올해 꽤 못된 짓을 했다더군.

english: I'm here to sort you out.
What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: 뭐? 우리 아빠가 널 보냈다고? 말도 안 돼, 아빠가 나한테 크리스마스를 맡겼단 말이야.

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: 맡기긴 했지. 그런데 네가 하도 엉망으로 해서 모두의 크리스마스를 망쳐 버렸다더군...

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: 가만 생각해 보니, 너 정말 내 아들이 아닌 거 확실하냐?

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: 넌 우리 아빠가 아니야, 그냥 흉측한 해골바가지일 뿐이지.

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: 네가 날 막게 두진 않을 거야. 이거나 먹어라!

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: 아, 이게 뭐야! 어떻게 하나도 안 아플 수가 있어?

english: You're weak just like your father.
I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: 날 쓰러뜨리려면 훨씬 더 지독한 게 필요할걸.

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
I learned this from an old friend of mine.
Ouch!
You cannot stop me Jack.
translation: 넌 날 막을 수 없다, Jack(잭).

english: I'm not finished yet.
Mummy!
I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
translation: 난 여기서 빠질래. 이럴 가치가 없어!

english: Uhh...
That didn't go as planned.
Ha Ha Ha. He won't get away that easily!
translation: 하하하. 그렇게 쉽게 도망치게 두진 않지!

english: I'll be back to deal with you soon [player name]....
Ahhh, hello there. How can I help?
Looks like you have a good selection of weapons around here...
translation: 여기 무기가 꽤 잘 갖춰져 있네요...

english: Indeed so, specially imported from the finest smiths around the lands, take a look at my wares.
translation: 그렇고말고요. 온 땅에서 가장 뛰어난 대장장이들에게서 특별히 들여온 것들이죠. 제 물건들 한번 구경해 보세요.

english: A fine selection of blades for you to peruse, come take a look!
translation: 찬찬히 둘러보실 만한 훌륭한 검들을 골고루 갖춰 뒀어요, 와서 구경하세요!

english: Armours and axes to suit your needs.
translation: 필요에 꼭 맞는 갑옷과 도끼가 있어요.

english: Imported weapons from the finest smithys around the lands!
translation: 온 땅의 가장 뛰어난 대장간에서 들여온 무기들이에요!

english: Ow my toe! That armour is heavy.
translation: 아야, 내 발가락! 저 갑옷 엄청 무겁네.

english: Hello there. Interested in sailing to the island of Aldarin? It's 20 coins for the journey.
Yes please.
Come back when you've got 20 coins for me.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
How about I pay you nothing at all...
translation: 아예 한 푼도 안 내는 건 어때요...

english: Sounds good to me. Hop aboard!
Hello there. Interested in sailing to Sunset Coast? It's 20 coins for the journey.
translation: 안녕하세요. Sunset Coast(선셋 해안)으로 항해하실래요? 뱃삯은 20코인이에요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
[Charm] How about I pay you nothing at all...
translation: [Charm] 아예 한 푼도 안 내는 건 어때요...

english: Welcome to the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, the oldest and largest producer of alcohol in all of Varlamore.
translation: Varlamore(바를라모어) 전역에서 가장 오래되고 가장 큰 주류 생산지, Moonrise Brewery and Winery(문라이즈 양조장)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Could I buy some wine?
Certainly!
Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course! The Moonrise Winery was originally opened over 400 years ago by Bracus Ramio.
translation: 물론이지요! Moonrise Winery(문라이즈 와이너리)는 400여 년 전 Bracus Ramio(브라쿠스 라미오)가 처음 문을 열었습니다.

english: While we originally started off as just a winery, the brewing side of the business was established by Bracus' grandson, Ludovic, when he created the now famous sunbeam ale!
translation: 처음에는 포도주만 빚던 곳이었지만, 맥주 양조 부문은 Bracus(브라쿠스)의 손자 Ludovic(루도빅)이 지금은 유명한 sunbeam ale(햇살 에일)을 만들면서 세워졌지요!

english: So it was a family business? Do the family still own it today?
translation: 그럼 가족 사업이었네요? 지금도 그 가문이 운영하나요?

english: Unfortunately not. Ludovic found himself in a tragic and unexpected wine-related incident before ever having children himself. After his death, the business was taken over by a collective.
translation: 안타깝게도 아닙니다. Ludovic(루도빅)은 자식을 두기도 전에 와인과 관련된 비극적이고 뜻밖의 사고를 당했지요. 그가 죽은 뒤 사업은 한 조합이 넘겨받았습니다.

english: A collective?
That's right. Some of the most influential people all across Varlamore have a stake in the Moonrise Brewery and Winery these days, though most prefer to stay anonymous.
translation: 그렇습니다. 요즘은 Varlamore(바를라모어) 전역에서 가장 영향력 있는 인사들 몇몇이 Moonrise Brewery and Winery(문라이즈 양조장)의 지분을 갖고 있지요. 다만 대부분은 익명으로 남기를 원합니다.

english: Anonymous? How come?
Ah, well their reasoning is something only they know.
translation: 아, 글쎄요. 그 이유는 그분들만 아시겠지요.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Not at all. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 별말씀을요. 자, 그 밖에 도와 드릴 일이 있으신가요?

english: I'd better be on my way.
Do come back soon!
Could I buy some wine?
Could you tell me more about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'd better be on my way.
I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.
translation: 전 비단을 사요. 비단을 팔고 싶으면 언제든 여기로 가져오세요.

english: Hello. I have some fine silk from far away to sell to you.
translation: 안녕하세요. 멀리서 온 좋은 비단이 있는데 팔고 싶어요.

english: Ah I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
translation: 아, 관심이 좀 가네요. 비단 한 필에 얼마쯤 생각하세요?

english: 20 coins.
Ok suits me.
80 coins.
80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
Done.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.
translation: 그렇게 많이는 절대 못 받으실걸요. 인심 써서 50 드릴게요.

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
You drive a hard bargain, but I guess that will have to do.
translation: 흥정이 세시네요. 그래도 그렇게 할 수밖에 없겠죠.

english: 200 coins.
Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.
translation: 말도 안 되는 소리 마세요! 너무 비싸요. 그런 가격을 부르다니 모욕적이네요.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 당신이 내 물건을 훔쳐 간 사람이군요!

english: Guards guards!
20 coins.
80 coins.
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
200 coins.
You did it! I wasn't sure I'd make it out of that one, but I'm glad you proved me wrong. Come, let's get out of here.
translation: 해냈군요! 이번엔 못 빠져나갈 줄 알았는데, 당신이 제가 틀렸다는 걸 보여 줘서 기뻐요. 자, 여기서 나가요.

english: Hi there. How are you doing?
Oh, you know, just getting over years of being controlled by a deranged family member. All part of the fun in a family like ours, I guess.
translation: 아, 뭐, 정신 나간 가족한테 몇 년이나 조종당했던 걸 털어 내는 중이에요. 우리 같은 집안에선 그것도 다 재미의 일부겠죠.

english: You seem quite jolly about it all.
Well as I always say, 'the real winner is the one smiling.' What Amascut has done is horrific, but it's not too late to stop her. I won't let her get me down, not while there's still hope.
translation: 음, 제가 늘 하는 말이 있잖아요. '진정한 승자는 웃는 자다.' Amascut(아마스컷)이 한 짓은 끔찍하지만, 그녀를 막기에 아직 늦지 않았어요. 희망이 남아 있는 한, 그녀 때문에 기죽지 않을 거예요.

english: Anyway, I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
translation: 그건 그렇고, 짜증 나게도 전 아직 너무 약해서 여기서 당신을 많이 돕지 못해요. 그래도 당신이 다른 이들을 풀어 주면 우리가 아래층으로 가는 길을 열어 줄 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: We've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
translation: 길을 열었어요! 저 아래에서도 도와주고 싶지만 아직 너무 약해요. 그래도 걱정 마세요, 당신은 해낼 수 있어요!

english: Here he is!
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 친구여, 자네는 극소수만이 이룬 일을 해냈네. Amascut(아마스컷)을 직접 꺾어 냈어! 그 광경을 내 눈으로 봤어야 했는데!

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 음, 저 혼자서는 못 했을 거예요. 그러고 보니, Scabaras(스카바라스)는 어디 있어요?

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)는 자신만의 길을 걷소. 그가 없다고 해서 모욕으로 여기지 마시오. 그게 그의 방식이오.

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 게다가 그는 우리 중 누구보다도 훨씬 오래 Amascut(아마스컷)의 지배를 받았다네. 그녀의 음모에서 자신이 맡았던 역할을 받아들이려면 시간이 걸릴 걸세.

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 괜찮아질 거예요. 늘 그랬으니까요.

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 더 나아가기 전에 말일세... 무덤 안에서는 이야기 나눌 시간이 별로 없었지. 분명 우리에게 묻고 싶은 게 있을 걸세.

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: Menaphite Pantheon(메나파이트 만신전)에서 당신은 어떤 역할을 맡고 있나요?

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 전 Tumeken(투메켄)의 우애의 화신이에요! 투메켄 님은 늘 좀 차갑다는 평을 들으셨는데, 생각해 보면 살짝 아이러니하죠.

english: A cold sun god?
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 바로 그거예요! 좀 이상하죠? 그래도 사교적인 면으로 유명한 분은 아니었지만, 그런 것의 중요성은 잘 아셨어요. 그래서 저를 만드신 거예요!

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 제 일은 모두가 우정의 소중함을 잊지 않게 하는 거예요. 결국 누구에게나 친구 한두 명, 아니 열 명, 아니 수백 명은 필요하잖아요! 원하는 만큼 사귀세요! 뭐라 안 할게요.

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 사막에는 왜 원숭이나 유인원이 더 많지 않나요?

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 아, 그건 Amascut(아마스컷) 덕분이에요. 사막엔 원래 수천 마리의 유인원과 원숭이가 살았는데, 그녀가 저를 노리려고 그들을 표적으로 삼았거든요.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 그러지 마세요! 이제 제가 돌아왔으니 분명 상황을 바꿀 수 있을 거예요!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Fair enough.
I'll be back soon.
We'll be here when you're ready.
I have a question for Crondis.
I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
Meaning?
Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 사막의 사람들이 사치에 빠져 살지 않도록 이끄는 것이 내 일이라는 뜻이오.

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 내가 없는 동안 사막의 많은 곳이 절제의 중요성을 잊었지만, Menaphos(메나포스)의 상황이 단연 가장 우려스럽소. 머지않아 바로잡히길 바라오.

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
Rude? How so.
Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 음, 제가 가까이 가기만 하면 늘 잡아먹으려고 하거든요.

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 악어의 삶은 결코 쉽지 않소. 먹이가 있는 곳이라면 어디서든 찾아 먹어야 하오.

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 게다가 그대가 진실을 다 말하는 것 같지는 않구려. 그대도 예전에 악어와 친구가 되지 않았소?

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: Roger(로저) 말씀이시군요! 그러고 보니 꽤 다정했어요.

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 그렇다면 악어가 그대 생각만큼 무례하진 않은 모양이오.

english: As you wish.
We will be here.
I have a question for Het.
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 나는 Tumeken(투메켄)의 건강의 화신일세. 몸과 마음 모두의 건강 말이지.

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 힘과 싸움 얘기를 많이 하시잖아요. 싸움이 건강에 좋을 리는 없을 텐데요.

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 글쎄, 건강에 있어서 힘이야말로 궁극의 목표 아니겠나? 가장 강한 자는 몸과 마음이 모두 건강한 자이고, 그 힘을 기리는 데 전투만 한 게 어디 있겠나!

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 음, 건강이란 혼자 움켜쥐고 있을 게 아니지 않나? 약점은 대부분 극복할 수 있고, 덜 가진 이들을 돕는 것이 강한 자의 의무일세.

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
Exactly!
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 인간의 모습을 하고 계시니까, 사람들에게 더 와닿지 않을까 싶어서요.

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 생각만큼은 아닐세. 믿기 어렵겠지만, 어떤 면에서 나는 오히려 좀 지루하다는 평을 듣는다네! 개코원숭이 신이 있는데 굳이 인간을 따르겠나?

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 게다가 그 개코원숭이 신이랑 같이 있으면 이렇게나 재밌잖아요!

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 물론, 애초에 사람들이 우리 중 하나만 따르는 건 의도한 바가 아니었네. 우리는 하나의 만신전이고, 저마다 맡은 역할이 있지.

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 이제 Amascut(아마스컷)이 꼬리를 내리고 도망쳤으니, 사람들에게 그 점을 다시 일깨워 줄 수 있을지도 모르겠군.

english: Very well.
We'll wait for you to return.
I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 그건 그녀에게 달렸지. 그녀가 태도를 바꾸지 않는다면 그 최후는 좋지 않을 걸세.

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 하지만 구원받기에 너무 늦은 때란 없어요. 그녀에게도 아직 희망이 있을지 몰라요.

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 그녀가 어떤 길을 택하든 우리는 준비되어 있을 것이오.

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 정말 그녀가 이제 와서 태도를 바꿀 거라고 생각하세요?

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 그럴 것 같진 않소만, 그걸 바꿀 수 있을지도 모르는 이가 하나 있소.

english: Who?
Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: Icthlarin(익스라린)이요! Amascut(아마스컷)이 다시 길을 찾도록 도울 수 있는 이가 있다면, 바로 그예요!

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 지금까지는 별로 도움을 주지 않은 것 같은데요.

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin(익스라린)이 할 수 있는 일에는 한계가 있네. 망자에 대한 그의 임무는 늘 신경을 써야 하는 일이거든.

english: Not to mention the pact!
Pact?
That is not for us to discuss.
Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 아, 맞다, 미안해요. 다른 얘기를 하는 게 좋겠네요.

english: Are you actually gods?
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 이 땅의 시민에게 묻는다면 아마 다들 그렇다고 할 걸세.

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 진정으로 옳은 말은 아니오.

english: How so?
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: Tumeken(투메켄) 님이 자신의 신성한 정수로 우리를 만드셨어요! 우리 하나하나가 그분의 일부예요!

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 하지만 그렇다고 우리가 신이 되는 건 아니오. 우리의 힘이 크긴 하나 진정한 신에 비하면 보잘것없소. 그래서 신들은 떠났고 우리는 남은 것이오.

english: So what are you really?
You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 우리를 Avatars of Tumeken(투메켄의 화신들)이라 부르는 이들도 있을 걸세. 우리는 그쪽이 더 걸맞은 칭호라고 여기네.

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 그 둘도 Tumeken(투메켄) 님이 만드셨어요. 차이가 있다면, 그 둘은 Elidinis(엘리디니스) 님의 신성한 정수도 지녀서 훨씬 강하다는 거죠!

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 하지만 거듭 말하지만, 그들도 진정한 신은 아니오.

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: Amascut(아마스컷)은 오늘 그걸 바꾸려 했지만, 자네가 그 계획을 보기 좋게 박살 내 줬지!

english: So what happens now?
We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 우리는 Avatars of Tumeken(투메켄의 화신들)이며, Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)은 너무 오랫동안 인도자 없이 지내 왔소. 이제 그것을 바로잡을 때요.

english: We're going to get started right away!
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 하지만 걱정 말게. Amascut(아마스컷)과의 싸움을 놓칠 생각은 없으니. 그날이 오면 자네도 우리 곁에 함께 서 주길 바라네.

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 허나 지금은 이것으로 작별이오. 다시 만납시다, 인간이여.

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
The avatars depart.
You're back!
If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: Menaphite Pantheon(메나파이트 만신전)에서 당신은 어떤 역할을 맡고 있나요?

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 사막에는 왜 원숭이나 유인원이 더 많지 않나요?

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'll be back soon.
I have a question for Crondis.
Why are crocodiles so rude?
I have a question for Het.
Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 다른 분들보다 따르는 사람이 더 많으신가요?

english: I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
Are you actually gods?
So what happens now?
I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?
translation: 저는 Apothecary(약제사)예요. 물약을 만들죠. 특별히 필요한 게 있나요?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 전투 Adventure Path(모험 경로)를 완료하고 받은 쿠폰이 있는데, 모험 경로 보상을 받으려면 당신에게 가 보라고 적혀 있어요.

english: Why yes, here are some energy potions.
translation: 아, 그럼요. 여기 energy potions(기력 물약) 몇 병 받으세요.

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 드릴 보상이 더 있긴 한데, 그걸 드리려면 멤버 월드에 있어야 해요. 다른 걸로 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: Can you make potions for me?
translation: 저를 위해 물약을 만들어 주실 수 있나요?

english: <missing other dialogue during the quest>
translation: <퀘스트 진행 중 나오는 다른 대사 누락>

english: Hello Apothecary, I've lost that hat you gave me.
translation: 안녕하세요, Apothecary(약제사) 님. 주셨던 모자를 잃어버렸어요.

english: No problem, I get plenty of these from Gielinor Hospital Supplies.
translation: 괜찮아요. Gielinor Hospital Supplies(길리노르 병원 용품)에서 이런 건 잔뜩 받거든요.

english: The Apothecary has given you a Nurse's Hat.
The Apothecary has given you a Doctor's Hat.
You wouldn't be able to make any other cat potions, would you?
translation: 혹시 다른 고양이 물약도 만들 수 있으세요?

english: I have no plans to branch out into cat potions at the moment, but if there was sufficient demand for them I might change my mind.
translation: 지금은 고양이 물약까지 사업을 넓힐 계획은 없지만, 찾는 사람이 충분히 많다면 생각이 바뀔지도 모르죠.

english: Have you got any decent gossip to share?
Well I hear young Romeo's having a little woman trouble but other than that all's quiet on the eastern front. Can I do something for you?
translation: 글쎄요, 젊은 Romeo(로미오)가 여자 문제로 좀 골치를 앓는다더군요. 그거 말고는 동부 전선 이상 없어요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Sad about that affair with young Romeo and Juliet...
translation: 젊은 Romeo(로미오)와 Juliet(줄리엣) 일은 참 안됐어요...

english: I hear every time Romeo sees Juliet now he runs away screaming something about ghosts and Juliet's cousin?
translation: 요즘 Romeo(로미오)는 Juliet(줄리엣)만 보면 유령이니 줄리엣 사촌이니 소리를 지르며 도망간다더군요.

english: Always did think he was a bit of a strange one...
translation: 원래부터 좀 이상한 녀석이라고 생각하긴 했지만요...

english: Anyway! Life goes on and so does business! Can I do something for you?
translation: 뭐 어쨌든! 삶은 계속되고 장사도 계속되죠! 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
I do indeed. I gave it to my mother. That's why I now live alone.
translation: 알다마다요. 우리 어머니께 드렸죠. 그래서 지금은 혼자 살아요.

english: But can I do something for you?
Have you got any good potions to give away?
translation: 공짜로 나눠 줄 좋은 물약 있어요?

english: Sorry, charity is not my strong point. Do you need anything else?
translation: 미안하지만 자선은 제 특기가 아니라서요. 다른 필요한 건 없나요?

english: No thanks.
Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.
translation: Apothecary(약제사) 님, Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이 보내서 왔어요. Romeo(로미오)와 Juliet(줄리엣)을 도우려면 Cadava potion(카다바 물약)이 필요해요.

english: Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.
translation: Cadava potion(카다바 물약)이라. 꽤 고약한 물건이죠. 만들기도 어렵고요.

english: Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.
translation: 쥐의 날개에 개구리 꼬리, 뱀의 귀에 개의 뿔.

english: I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.
translation: 그건 다 있는데, Cadava berries(카다바 열매)가 좀 필요해요.

english: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
translation: 제가 나머지를 준비하는 동안 그걸 구해 오셔야 해요. 구하면 여기로 가져오세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 고약한 놈들이거든요.

english: Conveniently, I have some here.
You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
translation: 열매를 건네자 Apothecary(약제사)가 이상한 액체가 든 약병에 넣고 흔든다.

english: Phew! Here is what you need.
The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
What do these berries look like?
They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
translation: 밝고 예쁜 분홍색에 잎은 초록색이고, 줄기는 옅은 갈색이에요... 못 알아볼 리가 없어요. 꽤 맛있어 보이지만 먹지는 않는 게 좋아요.

english: Where can I get these berries?
translation: 그 열매는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids
translation: 최근에 이 근처에서 본 것 같은데. 아, 맞다! 아이들이 Varrock(바록) 남동쪽 광산 구덩이에 견학 갔을 때 작은 소동이 있었거든요. 견학이 엉망이 됐는데, 아이들 몇이

english: had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!
translation: cadavaberry bushes(카다바베리 덤불)을 발견하고 따기 시작해서였죠. 견학은 아주 서둘러 끝났어요!

english: How are these berries dangerous?
Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!
translation: 음, 보통은 괜찮은데 잘못 다루면 좀 고약할 수 있어요. 그리고 그 물약을 마시는 건 절대 권하지 않아요!

english: Ok, thanks.
Keep searching for those Cadavaberries. They're needed for the potion.
translation: Cadavaberries(카다바베리)를 계속 찾아보세요. 물약에 꼭 필요하니까요.

english: Well done. You have the berries.
Thank you for the Cadava potion.
You're welcome. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 천만에요. 그 젊은 연인이 행복을 찾는 데 도움이 되면 좋겠네요.

english: I gave Juliet the Cadava potion.
Good, good. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 좋아요, 좋아. 그 젊은 연인이 행복을 찾는 데 도움이 되면 좋겠네요.

english: Urk!
Screen shakes back and forth then blacks out
Blimey... you've been out for hours! Are you ok? People were tripping over you as they walked into the shop.
translation: 세상에... 몇 시간이나 기절해 계셨어요! 괜찮으세요? 가게에 들어오던 사람들이 당신한테 걸려 넘어지고 그랬다고요.

english: Do you want to trade the diary yet? I'd like to pass the information on to the scientific community in Varrock.
translation: 이제 그 일기장 거래하실래요? 그 정보를 Varrock(바록)의 학계에 전하고 싶거든요.

english: Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
Great...
The apothecary trains you in herblore.
Ok, that's all I can teach you. Many thanks for the diary.
translation: 자, 제가 가르쳐 드릴 수 있는 건 여기까지예요. 일기장 정말 고마워요.

english: No thanks, I want to keep hold ifit a bit longer.
Oh, that's a shame... Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 아, 아쉽네요... 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.

english: Hmm, this is an interesting tome... But you've already sold me one, thanks!
translation: 흠, 흥미로운 책이네요... 그런데 이미 한 권 파셨잖아요, 고마워요!

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
Can you make potions for me?
translation: 저를 위해 물약을 만들어 주실 수 있나요?

english: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.
translation: A Tail of Two Cats(두 고양이 이야기)에 대해 이야기하기.

english: Nurse's Hat
Doctor's Hat
Talk about something else.
Talk about the Ratcatchers Quest.
Talk about Romeo & Juliet.
Have you got any decent gossip to share?
Do you know a potion to make hair fall out?
Have you got any good potions to give away?
translation: 공짜로 나눠 줄 좋은 물약 있어요?

english: No thanks.
What do these berries look like?
Where can I get these berries?
translation: 그 열매는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: How are these berries dangerous?
Ok, thanks.
Yes, I'll drink it all down.
No, I'm having second thoughts now.
Yes, I'll trade it for herblore training.
No thanks, I want to keep hold if it a bit longer.
Hello. What are you doing?
Cleaning, cleaning, always cleaning. This apprenticeship isn't all that it was cracked up to be.
translation: 청소요, 청소, 맨날 청소예요. 이 견습 생활, 듣던 것만큼 대단한 게 아니네요.

english: Whose apprentice are you?
Oh, Aadeela, the sorceress upstairs, said she'd teach me magic, she did. And here I am scrubbing floors without a spell to help me.
translation: 아, 위층에 계신 여마법사 Aadeela(아딜라) 님이요. 마법을 가르쳐 주겠다고 하셨거든요, 정말로요. 그런데 이렇게 주문 하나 없이 바닥이나 닦고 있죠.

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell to hurry things along if you'd like?
translation: Water Blast(워터 블라스트)나 Wind Blast(윈드 블라스트) 주문을 써서 빨리 끝내 드릴까요?

english: No, no, she'd kill me or worse if she knew I was using Magic to do chores. Her last apprentice - well I'd rather not say.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨, 집안일에 Magic(마법)을 썼다는 걸 아시면 절 죽이시거나 그보다 더한 짓을 하실 거예요. 그분의 전 견습생은... 음, 말 안 할래요.

english: Oh go on, what happened to them?
translation: 에이, 말해 봐요. 그 사람 어떻게 됐는데요?

english: They say she turned them into little spiders.
translation: 그분이 그 사람을 작은 거미로 만들어 버렸대요.

english: Oh, that's too bad. I had better leave you to it.
translation: 아, 그거 안됐네요. 일하시게 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: 그래도 이 일에 좋은 점도 있지 않겠어요?

english: Nope. Clean this, clean that. When I'm finished cleaning here I have to go help out in the garden.
translation: 없어요. 이거 청소, 저거 청소. 여기 청소가 끝나면 정원 일도 도우러 가야 해요.

english: What garden?
Oh, I shouldn't have told you.
You're right, you shouldn't have.
Well, if you don't mind then, I'm busy and have to get back to work.
translation: 음, 그럼 괜찮으시다면, 전 바빠서 일하러 돌아가야 해요.

english: Don't let me keep you.
Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: 아, 저한테 얘기해도 돼요. 오늘 힘든 날인 것 같네요.

english: You know you're right. Nobody listens to me.
translation: 그러게요, 맞아요. 아무도 제 말을 안 들어줘요.

english: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
translation: 그럴 만도 하죠, 맨날 징징대기만 하니까요.

english: The apprentice is clearly hurt and ignores you.
translation: 견습생은 상처받은 게 분명한 얼굴로 당신을 무시한다.

english: A sympathetic ear can do wonders.
translation: 들어주는 사람이 있으면 큰 힘이 되죠.

english: Yes, if I just let my frustrations out, I'd feel a lot better. Now what was I saying?
translation: 맞아요, 속에 쌓인 걸 털어놓으면 훨씬 나아질 거예요. 그런데 제가 무슨 말을 하고 있었죠?

english: I don't know. You were whining about something or other. To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: 몰라요. 뭔가에 대해 징징대고 있었잖아요. 솔직히 말하면 제대로 안 듣고 있었어요.

english: To tell you the truth, I wasn't really listening.
translation: 솔직히 말하면 제대로 안 듣고 있었어요.

english: You mentioned something about the garden.
Oh yeah, that dreadful garden of hers.
translation: 아 맞다, 그분의 그 끔찍한 정원이요.

english: Where is it?
Oh, it's nowhere.
What do you mean?
Well it's here, but not really. You see the sorceress is trying out some new type of compression magic.
translation: 그러니까 여기 있긴 한데, 진짜로 있는 건 아니에요. 여마법사님이 새로운 압축 마법을 시험하고 계시거든요.

english: Oh, that sounds interesting - so how does it work?
It would take too long to explain and, to be honest, I don't really understand how it works.
translation: 설명하자면 너무 길고, 솔직히 저도 어떻게 되는 건지 잘 몰라요.

english: Fair enough, but tell me, how do you get to the garden?
By magic! The sorceress did teach me one spell.
translation: 마법으로요! 여마법사님이 주문 하나는 가르쳐 주셨거든요.

english: Wow, cast the spell on me. It will be good Magic training for you.
translation: 우와, 저한테 그 주문을 걸어 봐요. 좋은 Magic(마법) 훈련이 될 거예요.

english: I can't do that now, I'm far too busy sweeping.
translation: 지금은 안 돼요, 비질하느라 너무 바빠요.

english: Oh you wouldn't mind?
Of course not. I'd be glad to help.
Okay, here goes! Remember, to return, just drink from the fountain.
translation: 좋아요, 갑니다! 돌아오려면 분수의 물을 마시면 된다는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Oh, that's nice. Well it's been great talking to you.
Hey apprentice, do you want to try out your teleport skills again?
translation: 견습생 씨, 순간이동 실력 또 한번 시험해 볼래요?

english: Okay, here goes - and remember, to return just drink from the fountain.
translation: 좋아요, 갑니다. 그리고 돌아오려면 분수의 물을 마시면 돼요, 잊지 마세요.

english: Seventior Disthinte Molesko!
Oh, I'm sorry, could you pick up your follower first? I'm really not sure that I could teleport the both of you.
translation: 아, 죄송한데 데리고 다니는 펫을 먼저 거둬 주시겠어요? 두 분을 같이 순간이동시킬 자신이 정말 없어서요.

english: I could cast a Water Blast or a Wind Blast spell?
translation: Water Blast(워터 블라스트)나 Wind Blast(윈드 블라스트) 주문을 써 드릴까요?

english: Surely there must be upsides to the task?
translation: 그래도 이 일에 좋은 점도 있지 않겠어요?

english: You're right, you shouldn't have.
Oh, you can talk to me. I can see you're having a bad day.
translation: 아, 저한테 얘기해도 돼요. 오늘 힘든 날인 것 같네요.

english: I can't blame them, all you do is whine.
