translation: 초보자 단서는 채광하다 나오는 정동 속에서도, 가끔 낚시로 건져 올리는 병 속에서도, 나무에서 떨어지는 둥지 속에서도 발견된다고 알려져 있어요.

english: Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
translation: 상위 단서와 달리, 초보자 단서를 완료해서 아주 값진 아이템을 얻으리라고 기대하지는 마세요.

english: What are more advanced clues?
Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
translation: 상위 단서에는 초급부터 마스터까지 여러 등급이 있어요.

english: You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.
translation: 상위 단서도 초보자 단서와 같은 방법으로 얻을 수 있어요. 하지만 더 높은 등급의 두루마리를 얻으려면 더 강한 적을 쓰러뜨려야 해요.

english: The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
translation: 정동, 병, 둥지에서 높은 등급의 단서를 얻을 확률은 등급이 높을수록 낮아요. 하지만 더 높은 레벨의 나무를 베면 단서가 든 둥지를 얻을 확률이 높아져요. 낚시와 채광도 마찬가지예요.

english: The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
translation: 마스터 단서는 casket(보상 상자)를 열 때 아주 낮은 확률로 나오거나, 초보자를 제외한 모든 등급의 단서를 하나씩 Hosidius(호시디우스)에 사는 Watson(왓슨)에게 가져다줘야만 얻을 수 있어요.

english: But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
translation: 하지만 단서 등급이 높을수록 더 좋은 전리품이 나와요.

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 Gielinor(길리노르) 어딘가에 있는 누군가와 대화하게 해요. 다만 단서가 정확히 누구와 대화해야 하는지는 알려 주지 않아요.

english: You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
translation: 서로 말이 될 수도 있고 안 될 수도 있는 단어 몇 개가 보일 거예요. 그 글자들을 재배열해서 대화해야 할 사람의 이름을 만들어야 해요.

english: This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 대화해야 할 사람이 내는 논리 문제를 풀어야 해요. 이런 도전은 중급, 상급, 엘리트 등급 단서에서만 나와요.

english: There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
translation: 특정한 사람을 위해 아이템을 모으거나 만들어야 하는 도전도 있어요.

english: This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 Gielinor(길리노르) 어딘가에 있는 누군가와 대화하게 해요. 다만 단서가 정확히 누구와 대화해야 하는지는 알려 주지 않아요. 이런 도전은 중급, 상급, 엘리트 등급 단서에서만 나와요.

english: A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
translation: 암호는 시프트 암호 방식으로 뒤섞인 글자들의 나열이에요.

english: An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
translation: 예를 들어 ZCZL을 한 글자씩 앞으로 밀면 Adam이 돼요.

english: This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 sextant(육분의), chart(해도), watch(시계)를 써서 파야 할 곳을 알아내게 해요. 이런 도전은 중급 등급 이상의 단서에서만 나와요.

english: After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
translation: 파야 할 곳을 찾으면 casket(보상 상자)나 다른 두루마리가 나올 수 있어요.

english: This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 지정된 사람과 대화하거나 지정된 장소의 crate(나무 상자)를 뒤지는 것처럼 간단할 수도 있어요.

english: But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
translation: 하지만 단서 등급이 높을수록 미리 해야 할 단계가 많아져요. 예를 들면 chest(상자)를 열기 전에 key(열쇠)를 찾아야 하는 식이죠.

english: This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 방문해야 할 장소와 함께 필요한 아이템 몇 가지를 알려 줘요.

english: At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
translation: 그 장소에서 가져온 아이템을 착용한 채로 감정 표현을 해야 해요.

english: Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
translation: 어떤 단서는 아무것도 입지 말라고 할 수도 있어요.

english: But please don't do that in public!
translation: 하지만 사람들 앞에서는 제발 그러지 마세요!

english: This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
translation: 이런 도전은 중급 등급 이상의 단서에서만 나와요.

english: Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 단서 등급에 따라 Varrock(바록)에 있는 Reldo(렐도)나 Tree Gnome Stronghold(나무 노움 요새) 남쪽에 있는 Jorral(조랄)에게서 strange device(이상한 장치)를 받아야 해요.

english: You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
translation: 그다음 이 장치를 써서 파야 할 곳을 찾아야 해요.

english: There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
translation: 단서를 풀다 보면 여러 가지 퍼즐을 만나게 돼요. 빛 상자부터 퍼즐 상자까지 다양해요.

english: Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
translation: 퍼즐 상자는 조각을 밀어 맞추는 퍼즐로, 다 맞추면 게임 속 그림 하나가 완성돼요.

english: Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
translation: 빛 상자는 5×5 칸에 불빛이 배열된 퍼즐인데, 일부는 켜져 있고 일부는 꺼져 있어요.

english: The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
translation: 아래 단추를 눌러 불빛 몇 개를 켜거나 끄면서, 최종적으로 모든 불빛을 켜는 게 목표예요.

english: This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 어떤 지역의 지도를 보여 줘요.

english: This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
translation: 이 지도는 어디를 파야 하는지, 또는 다음 단서를 얻으려면 무엇을 뒤져야 하는지 보여 줘요.

english: This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
translation: 이 종류의 단서는 파야 할 곳으로 가려면 어떤 fairy ring(요정의 고리) 코드를 써야 하는지 알려 줘요.

english: You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.
translation: 그다음 목적지에 도착하면 숫자를 이용해 어디를 파야 할지 알아내야 해요.

english: Hey Arthur, can I stop receiving clues from vessels? They're clogging up my backpack!
translation: Arthur(아서) 씨, 용기에 든 단서를 그만 받을 수 있을까요? 소지품만 꽉 차요!

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to stop receiving them?
translation: 용기란 채광 정동, 낚시 병, 단서 둥지를 말해요. 정말 그것들을 그만 받으시겠어요?

english: Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 네, 용기에 든 단서를 그만 받고 싶어요.

english: Very well, you'll no longer find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: 알겠어요, 이제 채광, 낚시, 벌목으로는 단서가 나오지 않을 거예요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Hey Arthur, can I start receiving clues from vessels?
translation: Arthur(아서) 씨, 용기에서 다시 단서가 나오게 할 수 있어요?

english: Vessel containers include mining geodes, fishing bottles and clue nests. Are you sure you want to start receiving them, again?
translation: 용기란 채광 정동, 낚시 병, 단서 둥지를 말해요. 정말 그것들을 다시 받으시겠어요?

english: Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 네, 용기에 든 단서를 다시 받고 싶어요.

english: Very well, you'll now find clues from mining, fishing and woodcutting.
translation: 알겠어요, 이제 채광, 낚시, 벌목으로 단서를 얻을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Goodbye.
So long and happy clue hunting!
translation: 잘 가요, 즐거운 단서 사냥 되세요!

english: I've got it!
I'm going to be rich!
Hmm.... What could this mean?
Why is this so hard...
Why did I not think of that before.
translation: 왜 진작 그 생각을 못 했을까.

english: Ask about beginner clues.
Ask about more advanced clues.
Ask about the types of clues.
Anagrams.
Challenge scrolls.
Cipher clues.
Coordinate clues.
Cryptic clues.
Emote clues.
Hot Cold clues.
Puzzle clues.
Map clues.
Fairy ring clues.
Toggle gaining vesseled clue scrolls.
Yes please, I want to stop receiving vesseled containers.
translation: 네, 용기에 든 단서를 그만 받고 싶어요.

english: Nevermind.
Yes please, I want to start receiving vesseled containers
translation: 네, 용기에 든 단서를 다시 받고 싶어요

english: Nilsal. Here to do some crafting? I've got some supplies that might help you if so.
translation: 닐살. 공예하러 오셨어요? 그렇다면 도움이 될 만한 재료가 좀 있어요.

english: What do you have?
Have a look.
Just passing through, thanks.
Well come back if you change your mind.
What do you have?
Just passing through, thanks.
Greetings, friend; my business here deals with Hunter related items. Is there anything in which I can interest you?
translation: 반갑습니다, 친구여. 저는 이곳에서 Hunter(사냥) 관련 물품을 취급하고 있습니다. 관심 가는 물건이 있으신가요?

english: What kinds of items do you stock?
Take a look for yourself.
I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: 지금은 사냥 장비가 필요 없어요, 고마워요.

english: Maybe another time, then.
What kinds of items do you stock?
I'm not in the market for Hunter equipment right now, thanks.
translation: 지금은 사냥 장비가 필요 없어요, 고마워요.

english: Hello again Artur.
Hello [player name]. Thanks for your help in recovering the Accord.
translation: 안녕하십니까, [player name] 님. Accord(협약)을 되찾는 데 도움을 주셔서 감사합니다.

english: No problem.
Why is the Accord important?
The signing of the Accord marked the start of a golden age. Once the Royal Lords replaced the Council of Elders, Kourend prospered like never before.
translation: Accord(협약)의 체결은 황금기의 시작을 알렸습니다. 왕실 영주들이 원로회를 대신하게 된 뒤로, Kourend(쿠렌드)는 그 어느 때보다 번영했지요.

english: But that was a long time ago. Why does it matter now?
translation: 하지만 그건 아주 오래전 일이잖아요. 지금 그게 왜 중요하죠?

english: Because I think it's time for another golden age. The Kourend Council, like the Council of Elders before them, have failed to do a good job in running this kingdom.
translation: 다시 한번 황금기가 올 때가 되었다고 생각하기 때문입니다. 쿠렌드 의회는 그 이전의 원로회처럼 이 왕국을 제대로 다스리지 못했습니다.

english: And you think the five houses would do a better job?
translation: 그래서 다섯 가문이 더 잘할 거라고 생각하시는 거예요?

english: Exactly.
What makes you say the Council have done a bad job?
More crime. Fewer homes. More illness. Loss of jobs. The list goes on.
translation: 늘어난 범죄. 줄어든 집. 늘어난 질병. 사라진 일자리. 끝도 없습니다.

english: But aren't the five houses partially to blame as well? They rule the cities.
translation: 하지만 다섯 가문에도 어느 정도 책임이 있지 않나요? 도시를 다스리는 건 가문들이잖아요.

english: The Council sets the laws and the Council sets the budgets. We have to do as they say, just like everyone else.
translation: 법을 정하는 것도 의회고, 예산을 정하는 것도 의회입니다. 저희도 다른 모든 이들처럼 의회의 말을 따라야 하지요.

english: Hmmm, fair enough. Anyway, we'd better get off.
translation: 흐음, 그렇군요. 아무튼, 저희는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Fair enough. See you later.
Goodbye.
Hello there Artur. Actually... I guess I should say Your Majesty now.
translation: 안녕하세요, Artur(아르투르). 아니... 이제는 폐하라고 불러야겠네요.

english: For you friend, Artur is fine.
You should not dispense formalities Artur. A king should command respect.
translation: 격식을 버려서는 안 된다, Artur(아르투르). 왕은 존경을 받을 줄 알아야 하는 법이야.

english: I can command respect without using fancy titles, mother.
translation: 거창한 칭호 없이도 존경받을 수 있습니다, 어머니.

english: So, how are you doing.
I have a lot of responsibility now. There's much to learn and not much time to learn it in. The loss of father still weighs heavily on me as well.
translation: 이제 짊어진 책임이 많습니다. 배울 것은 많은데 배울 시간은 별로 없군요. 아버지를 잃은 슬픔도 여전히 무겁게 남아 있습니다.

english: Still, I am well supported by those around me. I'm sure that with their help, I can be the ruler the people deserve.
translation: 그래도 주변 사람들이 든든하게 받쳐 주고 있습니다. 그들의 도움이 있다면, 백성들에게 걸맞은 통치자가 될 수 있으리라 믿습니다.

english: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with you work.
translation: 저도 당신이라면 그럴 수 있다고 믿어요. 아무튼, 하시던 일 계속하시게 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Until next time
Why is the Accord important?
What makes you say the council have done a bad job?
Fair enough. See you later.
Goodbye.
Good day traveller. You are far from home, what brings you here?
translation: 안녕하세요, 나그네님. 고향에서 멀리 오셨네요, 여긴 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: I am a wandering hero, I come here in search of adventure.
translation: 저는 떠돌이 영웅이에요. 모험을 찾아 여기 왔어요.

english: Sounds ghastly, I just want to live in peace.
translation: 끔찍하게 들리네요. 저는 그냥 평화롭게 살고 싶어요.

english: Unfortunately without people like me, peace doesn't last for long.
translation: 안타깝지만 저 같은 사람이 없으면 평화는 오래가지 않아요.

english: True, but then again most adventurers cause as much trouble as they put right.
translation: 맞는 말이에요, 하지만 또 생각해 보면 모험가들은 대부분 바로잡는 만큼 말썽도 일으키죠.

english: You've got a point there... Hmm...
Well, good day traveller. And always do the right thing.
translation: 그럼, 좋은 하루 보내세요, 나그네님. 그리고 늘 옳은 일을 하세요.

english: Good day traveller.
Hi there, how's it going?
Well we're still alive, after all that's happened, we should be thankful of that.
translation: 뭐, 그 모든 일을 겪고도 아직 살아 있으니, 그걸로 감사해야죠.

english: Hopefully this war is over soon.
Indeed, but how many more need to die before that happens?
translation: 그러게요, 하지만 그때까지 얼마나 더 많은 이가 죽어야 할까요?

english: What do you think you're doing?
Hello there.
He seems to be lost in his own thoughts...
translation: 그는 생각에 잠겨 있는 것 같다...

english: Howdy stranger. What brings you out to these parts?
translation: 여어, 낯선 친구. 이런 데까진 무슨 일로 왔어?

english: Nothing much - What are you doing here? It doesn't seem like there's much to do out here in the desert!
translation: 별일 없어요. 그쪽은 여기서 뭐 하세요? 사막에는 할 일이 별로 없어 보이는데요!

english: Well, that's where you'd be wrong. I work for the Archaeological Society of Varrock, and have been excavating around here recently.
translation: 그건 네가 틀렸어. 난 Archaeological Society of Varrock(바록 고고학회)에서 일하는데, 요즘 이 근처를 발굴하고 있거든.

english: Was there something you specifically wanted?
(shows other options)
Do you have any quests? Call it a hunch, but you look like the type of man who might...
translation: 혹시 퀘스트 있으세요? 그냥 감인데, 왠지 그런 걸 줄 것 같은 분이라서요...

english: Well, it's funny you should say that. I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you
translation: 거참, 마침 그 얘길 하다니 재밌네. 퀘스트라고까지 할 수 있을진 모르겠지만, 발굴하다가 고대 stone tablet(석판)을 하나 찾았거든. 네가 이걸

english: could go and take it back to the digsite for me and get it examined.
translation: 발굴지에 가져가서 감정을 받아 와 주면 정말 큰 도움이 될 거야.

english: It's very old, and I don't recognise any of the inscriptions on it.
translation: 아주 오래된 거라, 새겨진 글자를 하나도 못 알아보겠어.

english: Sure, I was heading that way anyway. Any particular person at the digsite you want me to talk to?
translation: 좋아요, 어차피 그쪽으로 가던 길이었어요. 발굴지에서 특별히 만나야 할 사람이 있나요?

english: His name's Terry Balando. Give it to nobody but him. I'm sorry, I can't entrust you with the actual tablet I found, it is far too valuable to give away, but I took these etchings - they should be enough for him to make
translation: 이름은 Terry Balando(테리 발란도)야. 그 사람 말고는 아무한테도 주지 마. 미안하지만 진짜 석판은 맡길 수 없어. 넘겨주기엔 너무 귀하거든. 대신 etchings(탁본)을 떠 왔으니, 그 정도면 그 친구가

english: a preliminary translation on. Come back and let me know what he says, I would hate to waste my time excavating anything that isn't worth my time as a world famous archaeologist!
translation: 1차 번역은 할 수 있을 거야. 그 사람이 뭐라는지 돌아와서 알려 줘. 세계적으로 유명한 고고학자인 내가 쓸모없는 걸 파느라 시간을 낭비할 순 없잖아!

english: No thanks. Playing delivery boy doesn't really sound much like fun to me.
translation: 됐어요. 배달부 노릇은 별로 재밌을 것 같지 않네요.

english: Well, okay. Can't say as I blame you for thinking that. I'll go take it there myself later I guess.
translation: 그래, 알았어. 그렇게 생각하는 것도 무리는 아니지. 나중에 내가 직접 가져가야겠군.

english: Who are you, anyway?
You don't recognise me??? I am the world famous Asgarnia Smith, Archaeologist extraordinaire!
translation: 날 몰라??? 내가 바로 세계적으로 유명한 Asgarnia Smith(아스가르니아 스미스), 비범한 고고학자라고!

english: I am the one who discovered the long forgotten Temple of Ikov! The one who unearthed the strange trap filled arena in Brimhaven!
translation: 오랫동안 잊혀 있던 Temple of Ikov(이코브 신전)을 발견한 게 바로 나야! Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에서 덫이 가득한 기묘한 경기장을 파낸 것도 나고!

english: I'm the leading archaeological expert of our time! I was voted archaeologist of the year four years running by the Varrock Herald! Are you REALLY sure you've never heard of me?
translation: 난 이 시대 최고의 고고학 전문가야! Varrock Herald(바록 헤럴드)에서 4년 연속 올해의 고고학자로 뽑혔다고! 정말 내 이름 들어 본 적 없어?

english: No, I really haven't.
Well then, I'm confused. Why did you come over and speak to me if you don't know who I am? What do you want?
translation: 거참, 그럼 이해가 안 되는데. 내가 누군지도 모르면서 왜 말을 건 거야? 원하는 게 뭔데?

english: Nothing really. I'm just wandering around for no good reason.
translation: 딱히 없어요. 그냥 이유 없이 돌아다니는 중이에요.

english: Uh-huh. Well, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot more work to do before I can bed down for the night.
translation: 그래그래. 그럼 실례할게. 오늘 밤 자기 전에 할 일이 아직 산더미거든.

english: So what did Terry Balando say about those etchings? Did he give you a translation for me?
translation: 그래서 Terry Balando(테리 발란도)가 그 탁본에 대해 뭐래? 번역문은 받아 왔어?

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of didn't go and speak to him yet...
translation: 음... 저기... 그게요... 사실 아직 그분한테 안 가 봤어요...

english: Well what are you waiting for? A written invitation? All I want you to do is take those etchings up to the digsite for me!
translation: 그럼 뭘 꾸물거려? 초대장이라도 써 줘야 해? 그 탁본을 발굴지에 갖다주기만 하면 된다니까!

english: Okay, I'll do that then.
Um... yeah... about that... I kind of lost those etchings you gave me...
translation: 음... 저기... 그게요... 주신 탁본을 잃어버렸어요...

english: Well how in the world did you do that? (sigh) Okay, I'll make another set, but try not to lose these ones this time!
translation: 대체 그걸 어떻게 잃어버려? (한숨) 알았어, 하나 더 만들어 줄게. 이번엔 잃어버리지 마!

english: Yeah, he did. But I don't have it with me.
translation: 네, 해 주셨어요. 그런데 지금 안 가지고 있어요.

english: I see.
Well could you go and get me that translation? It could be vital!
translation: 그럼 그 번역문 좀 가져다줄래? 엄청 중요한 걸 수도 있다고!

english: Yeah, he did. I have it here in this book.
translation: 네, 해 주셨어요. 여기 이 책에 있어요.

english: Did you take a read of this? It will do you good to understand how this profession works. Here, have a read.
translation: 이거 읽어 봤어? 이 일이 어떻게 돌아가는지 알아 두면 도움이 될 거야. 자, 읽어 봐.

english: (the book opens up)
Yeah, I did. Kind of boring really.
Excellent. Just give me a moment to read this, and talk to me again in a second.
translation: 훌륭해. 이거 읽을 동안 잠깐 기다렸다가 다시 말 걸어 줘.

english: Hmmm. Interesting. It seems to me like there's some kind of treasure hidden out in the desert.
translation: 흐음. 흥미롭군. 사막 어딘가에 보물 같은 게 숨겨져 있는 것 같은데.

english: So what do you say? Fancy being a treasure hunter like me?
translation: 어때? 나처럼 보물 사냥꾼이 돼 볼 생각 없어?

english: Uh... don't you mean archaeologist?
Yeeees... An archaeologist...
It's all this hot sun getting to me I think.
translation: 아무래도 뜨거운 햇볕 때문에 정신이 없나 봐.

english: Well anyway, let's just assume there is a treasure hidden in the desert somewhere, and let's just say for the sake of argument that maybe if I found a big stash of gold and treasure I wouldn't necessarily just hand it
translation: 아무튼, 사막 어딘가에 보물이 숨겨져 있다고 치자고. 그리고 그냥 가정이지만, 내가 금과 보물을 잔뜩 찾아낸다 해도 그걸 꼭 전부

english: all over to the Museum of Varrock.
translation: Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관)에 넘길 필요는 없다고 해 보자.

english: Let's also say, purely hypothetically, that if there were such a big stash of treasure and someone were to help me find it, then that hypothetical person might be entitled to, oh, let's say a purely for the sake of
translation: 또 순전히 가정으로, 그런 보물이 정말 있고 누가 그걸 찾는 걸 도와준다면, 그 가상의 인물은 음, 그러니까 순전히

english: argument thirty percent split...
translation: 가정상 30퍼센트 몫을 받을 자격이 있을 수도 있겠지...

english: Fifty percent.
That's right!
A purely for the sake of argument fifty-fifty split on this hypothetical treasure, should it exist...
translation: 순전히 가정상, 이 가상의 보물이 존재한다면 반반으로 나누는 거지...

english: Do you see where I'm going with this?

You want me to help you find some treasure for a fifty percent share, as long as I don't tell anybody, and your reputation as an esteemed archaeologist with the Museum of Varrock remains intact, and nobody
translation: 보물 찾는 걸 도와주면 50퍼센트를 주겠다, 대신 아무한테도 말하지 말고, Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관)에서 존경받는 고고학자라는 평판도 지켜 주고, 아무도

english: discovers you're actually just a treasure hunter?
translation: 그쪽이 사실 그냥 보물 사냥꾼이라는 걸 모르게 해 달라는 거죠?

english: Uh... yes, but the way you said it makes it sound like I'm doing something wrong...
translation: 어... 맞긴 한데, 그렇게 말하니까 꼭 내가 나쁜 짓 하는 것 같잖아...

english: So what do you say? Partners?
Well... I guess nobody is really going to lose out on anything, and we don't even know if there is any treasure...
translation: 음... 딱히 손해 보는 사람도 없고, 보물이 진짜 있는지도 모르니까요...

english: Aw, go on then. Count me in.
That's what I like to hear! Now, if we split up we'll be able to find treasure quicker.
translation: 바로 그 말이 듣고 싶었어! 자, 흩어져서 찾으면 보물을 더 빨리 찾을 수 있을 거야.

english: I'll continue searching around here in this Bedabin Camp, you head due South to the Bandit Village. If either of us find anything, we'll come find each other and say what, okay?
translation: 난 여기 Bedabin Camp(베다빈 야영지)를 계속 뒤질 테니, 넌 정남쪽 Bandit Village(산적 마을)로 가. 둘 중 누구든 뭔가 찾으면 서로 찾아가서 알려 주자고, 알았지?

english: You head due South, see what you can find out about this tablet.
translation: 정남쪽으로 가서 이 석판에 대해 뭐든 알아내 봐.

english: This all sounds very immoral, and I don't want any part of your seedy little schemes.
translation: 정말 비도덕적인 얘기네요. 그런 지저분한 꿍꿍이에는 끼고 싶지 않아요.

english: Aw, c'mon, cut me a break here! Look, nobody is really getting hurt, right? This treasure is either going to lie around in some underground ruin, or lie around in some museum for
translation: 에이, 좀 봐줘! 봐, 딱히 다치는 사람도 없잖아? 이 보물은 어차피 어느 지하 유적에 처박혀 있거나, 박물관에 놓여서

english: people to look at!
It makes sense for the people to go to all the risk to get a little payback for it, right? Besides, anything of real historical value we can hand over to the museum - we'll just keep the cash for
translation: 온갖 위험을 무릅쓴 사람이 보상을 좀 챙기는 게 당연하잖아? 게다가 역사적 가치가 있는 건 박물관에 넘기면 돼. 돈만

english: ourselves!
C'mon... what do you say? Partners?
(presumably the same as the previous help him text)
I don't trust anything about your little scheme, including you! I want nothing to do with this!
translation: 그쪽 꿍꿍이는 하나도 못 믿겠어요. 그쪽도요! 전 이 일에서 빠질래요!

english: Eh, you'll come running back when you realise just how much money we could be talking here.
translation: 흥, 우리가 얼마나 큰돈을 만질 수 있는지 깨달으면 허겁지겁 돌아올걸.

english: I'll see you again when you come crawling back, begging to be cut in on the deal.
translation: 한몫 끼워 달라고 기어 와서 빌 때 다시 보자고.

english: Hello again. You find any signs of that treasure yet?
Not yet...
Well, head south to that bandit camp. I bet if there's anything out here, they'll know about it.
translation: 그럼 남쪽 산적 야영지로 가 봐. 여기 뭔가 있다면 분명 그놈들이 알 거야.

english: Don't let on it might be valuable though! Those thieves will steal it as soon as look at you!
translation: 근데 값나가는 거일 수도 있다는 티는 내지 마! 그 도둑놈들은 눈 깜짝할 새에 훔쳐 갈 테니까!

english: Well... not as such, but I unleashed a powerful demon from its tomb in return for unbelievable magical power.
translation: 음... 그런 건 아니지만, 엄청난 마력을 얻는 대가로 강력한 악마를 무덤에서 풀어 줬어요.

english: So... no gold then?
Not as such, no. Sorry about that.
Aw... I was hoping to go abroad on holiday this year.
translation: 에이... 올해는 해외로 휴가 가려고 했는데.

english: Maybe I'll go check out Karamja next, I hear there's treasure to be found there...
translation: 다음엔 Karamja(카람자)나 가 볼까. 거기 보물이 있다던데...

english: I was wondering...
As you are a big famous archaeologist, maybe you could spare the time to tell me a couple of tales of your exploits?
translation: 유명한 대고고학자시니까, 시간 좀 내서 모험담 몇 개 들려주실 수 있을까요?

english: Hey, sure thing kid! Well, this one time I found this spooky old temple in the middle of the jungle.
translation: 그럼, 물론이지 젊은이! 자, 한번은 정글 한복판에서 으스스한 오래된 신전을 찾았지.

english: The entrance was hidden from sight by all these vines and stuff, and it was full of zombies and crazy tribesmen and stuff.
translation: 입구는 덩굴 같은 것들로 가려져 있었고, 안에는 좀비랑 미친 부족민 같은 것들이 득실댔어.

english: That wasn't the worst thing though! There were all these crazy traps that were hidden around the place too!
translation: 근데 그게 최악은 아니었어! 사방에 미친 덫들이 숨겨져 있었거든!

english: Well anyway, I found the secret entrance, fought my way in through the zombies and tribesmen, and came to a big pedestal with a statue of solid gold sat on top of it!
translation: 아무튼 난 비밀 입구를 찾아서 좀비와 부족민을 뚫고 들어갔지. 그랬더니 커다란 받침대 위에 순금 조각상이 놓여 있는 거야!

english: Solid gold, huh? Wow.
That's right! It was a cunning trap though! As soon as I picked up the statue, a trapdoor opened up underneath me, and I fell into a darkened room, full of
translation: 그렇지! 그런데 그게 교활한 덫이었어! 조각상을 집어 들자마자 발밑에서 바닥 문이 열리더니, 난 어두컴컴한 방으로 떨어졌어. 거긴

english: bones, and the biggest meanest tribesman you ever did see!
translation: 뼈가 가득했고, 네가 본 적도 없을 만큼 크고 사나운 부족민이 있었지!

english: Huge he was, and real ugly looking! He had this huge sword too, and he came running towards me screaming something in some language I didn't understand!
translation: 덩치가 엄청났고 생긴 것도 진짜 흉측했어! 커다란 칼까지 들고는, 알아들을 수 없는 말로 뭐라고 소리 지르면서 나한테 달려들었지!

english: What did you do?
Well, while he was screaming at me, and swinging his sword around in front of me, trying to intimidate me before attacking, I cooly and calmly...
translation: 음, 그놈이 덤비기 전에 겁을 주려고 내 앞에서 고함치며 칼을 휘두르는 동안, 난 침착하고 냉정하게...

english: Yes?
All the while, knowing that if I died in this spot nobody would even know where I was...
translation: 그러는 내내, 여기서 죽으면 내가 어디 있었는지 아무도 모르리라는 걸 알면서...

english: What then?
I knew, if this tribesman killed me, that would be the end of Asgarnia Smith, and all of his treasure hunting...
translation: 이 부족민한테 죽으면 Asgarnia Smith(아스가르니아 스미스)도, 그의 보물 사냥도 다 끝이라는 걸 알았지...

english: SO WHAT DID YOU DO?!?!
Well, while he was screaming and waving his sword around, I stood behind a nearby stalactite, then shot him with my shortbow.
translation: 음, 그놈이 고함치며 칼을 휘두르는 동안, 근처 종유석 뒤에 숨어서 shortbow(짧은 활)로 쏴 버렸지.

english: And that was how I recovered the Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh.
translation: 그렇게 해서 Golden Monkey of Tee-Ta-Toh(티타토의 황금 원숭이)를 되찾았다는 거야.

english: So... How exactly did you get into this line of work anyway?
translation: 그런데... 이 일은 대체 어떻게 시작하게 되셨어요?

english: It seems an odd choice of career for a man like yourself.
translation: 그쪽 같은 분이 택하기엔 좀 특이한 직업 같아서요.

english: Thinking of joining your pal Asgarnia in the wonderful world of treasure hun- um, archaeology, huh?
translation: 네 친구 Asgarnia(아스가르니아)를 따라 멋진 보물 사냥... 아니, 고고학의 세계에 들어오고 싶은 거야?

english: Well, it all started the day I was fishing in catherby, funnily enough.
translation: 그게 말이지, 재밌게도 catherby(캐서비)에서 낚시하던 날 모든 게 시작됐어.

english: Ah yes, I remember it well... I was just sat there, hoping to catch a bass or two, when I made the most amazing discovery!
translation: 아, 그래, 아직도 생생해... bass(농어)나 한두 마리 잡을까 하고 앉아 있었는데, 엄청난 발견을 한 거야!

english: In my fishing nets, I had found an ancient casket, marred and worn by centuries underwater!
translation: 낚시 그물에 ancient casket(고대 상자)가 걸려 있었어. 수백 년 동안 물속에 있어서 흠집투성이에 닳아 있었지!

english: With trembling hands, I slowly and cautiously opened it, wondering what ancient secret may have been kept inside...
translation: 떨리는 손으로 천천히, 조심스럽게 열면서 생각했지. 이 안에 어떤 고대의 비밀이 담겨 있을까...

english: What valuable heirloom may have been dredged up by my nets that had not decayed underwater long ago...
translation: 오래전에 물속에 가라앉고도 썩지 않은 채 내 그물에 걸려 올라온 귀한 가보는 무엇일까...

english: And you know what I found inside?
No, what?
I found 320 coins! Just like that! Just by fishing I had found 320 coins! 320 coins! Can you believe it?
translation: 320코인을 찾았어! 그냥 그렇게! 낚시만 했는데 320코인을 찾은 거야! 320코인! 믿어져?

english: Um... Yes, yes I can.
Well, it might not seem much to us now kid, but back then, it was a revelation!
translation: 지금 우리한텐 별거 아닌 것 같아도, 젊은이, 그땐 눈이 번쩍 뜨이는 일이었다고!

english: Why waste my time fishing when there were secret treasures from long ago hidden around the world?
translation: 세상 곳곳에 오래된 비밀 보물이 숨겨져 있는데, 뭐 하러 낚시나 하며 시간을 버려?

english: I immediately applied to the Museum of Varrock as a field agent, and the rest is history!
translation: 난 바로 Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관)에 현장 요원으로 지원했고, 나머진 다들 아는 역사지!

english: Nice hat!
Hey, thanks kid. Looking snazzy is an important part of being a treasure hunter!
translation: 오, 고마워 젊은이. 멋지게 보이는 것도 보물 사냥꾼한테 중요한 부분이거든!

english: Well, I'll see you again sometime maybe. Sorry I couldn't get you any treasure...
translation: 그럼 언젠가 또 봬요. 보물을 못 찾아 드려서 죄송해요...

english: Ah, don't sweat it kid. I'll be honest with ya - I'm already rich many times over, and its more the kicks of being a treasure hunter I do it for than the actual cash!
translation: 아, 신경 쓰지 마, 젊은이. 솔직히 말할게. 난 이미 엄청난 부자라서, 돈보다는 보물 사냥의 짜릿함 때문에 하는 거야!

english: What are you doing here?
Do you have any quests?
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Nothing really.
Read book
Don't read book
Help him
Don't help him
Tell me of your adventures
Tell me how you became an Archaeologist
Nice hat!
See you later...
Dung cook human.
Ash eat human.
Dung will fry human.
Dung is wrong!
My brother in stronghold best cook.
translation: 요새 있는 내 형, 최고 요리사.

english: Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
translation: Ash(애시) 인간 푹 삶는다. 말랑해질 때까지.

english: Much more tasty.
Ash will not cook human!
Ash will boil!
Dung will boil Ash's head!
Boil better!
Fry better!
Boil!
Fry!
Ow!
Ugh!
Dung not hit Ash!
Ow!
Ouch!
Dung hate Ash!
Ash hate Dung!
Excuse me...
What is it?
Thank you for finding my tools for me. Did you find everyone's belongings?
translation: 제 도구를 찾아 주셔서 고마워요. 다른 사람들 물건도 다 찾으셨어요?

english: I did! Thank you for the reward.
You're more than welcome to it, for getting our belongings back.
translation: 저희 물건을 되찾아 주셨으니 당연히 받으셔야죠.

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 왕국 사람들이 저를 얼마나 지지하는지 알려 주실래요?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
Hello? Who are you? What is this place?
I'm... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. But I don't understand... How are you here?
translation: 저는... Ashuelot(애슈일럿)... Ashuelot Reis(애슈일럿 레이스)입니다. 하지만 모르겠군요... 어떻게 여기에 들어오신 겁니까?

english: Oh... Well I'm [player name], and I'm here because I was told there was a great treasure to be found.
translation: 아... 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 이곳에 엄청난 보물이 있다고 들어서 왔어요.

english: Treasure? I fear you have been misled. There is no treasure here, only our great mistake.
translation: 보물이라고요? 속으신 것 같군요. 여기에 보물은 없습니다. 오직 저희의 크나큰 실수가 있을 뿐입니다.

english: Mistake?
This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
translation: 이곳은 감옥입니다. 이해할 수 없을 만큼 강대한 존재가 여기에 봉인되어 있었지요. 저희가 어리석지만 않았다면 계속 그대로였을 겁니다.

english: What happened?
We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
translation: 저희는 옳은 일을 한다고 믿었지만, 그릇된 길로 이끌린 것이었습니다. 저희가 감옥을 열었고, 그 안의 공포를 풀어놓았지요.

english: But the door was locked until I came along.
translation: 하지만 제가 오기 전까지 문은 잠겨 있었는데요.

english: Yes... After our great mistake, four opposing armies united to contain the evil again. They managed to reseal the prison, but they were unable to repair the original enchantments.
translation: 그렇습니다... 저희의 크나큰 실수 이후, 서로 대립하던 네 군대가 힘을 합쳐 악을 다시 가두었습니다. 감옥을 다시 봉인하는 데는 성공했지만, 원래의 마법은 복구하지 못했지요.

english: This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
translation: 그 뒤로 이곳은 줄곧 취약한 상태였습니다.

english: And now I've opened it again.
translation: 그리고 이제 제가 또 열어 버렸네요.

english: If what you've told me is true, you were fooled just as we were. But I suppose that means little now. With the prison now open again, there isn't much to prevent the evil escaping once more.
translation: 말씀하신 게 사실이라면, 당신도 저희처럼 속은 겁니다. 하지만 이제 와서 그게 큰 의미는 없겠지요. 감옥이 다시 열렸으니, 악이 또다시 빠져나가는 걸 막을 방법이 별로 없습니다.

english: There must be something I can do to stop it.
translation: 그걸 막기 위해 제가 할 수 있는 일이 분명 있을 거예요.

english: There is only one thing you can do. You can fight.
translation: 당신이 할 수 있는 일은 단 하나입니다. 싸우는 것이죠.

english: Then that is what I will do.
Though, now that I think about it, I'm still not overly clear what this evil is.
translation: 그런데 생각해 보니, 그 악이 정확히 뭔지 아직 잘 모르겠어요.

english: She is a being of darkness. A servant of the Ruinous Powers. She is the Angel of Death. She is Nex.
translation: 그녀는 어둠의 존재입니다. Ruinous Powers(파멸의 힘)의 종이지요. 그녀는 Angel of Death(죽음의 천사)입니다. 그녀는 바로 Nex(넥스)입니다.

english: I'll stop her.
I hope so. Nex can be found in the inner section of the prison. Join me there. But be warned, Nex was not imprisoned alone. You'll need to fight through her followers to reach her.
translation: 그러길 바랍니다. Nex(넥스)는 감옥 안쪽 구역에 있습니다. 그곳에서 만나지요. 하지만 경고하겠습니다. 넥스는 혼자 갇힌 게 아닙니다. 그녀에게 닿으려면 추종자들을 뚫고 싸워 나가야 할 겁니다.

english: Good luck.
You made it?
You didn't think I would?
Nex's followers are capable of bringing down even the strongest of warriors. I did fear you might not make it past them.
translation: Nex(넥스)의 추종자들은 아무리 강한 전사라도 쓰러뜨릴 수 있습니다. 당신이 그들을 지나오지 못할까 봐 걱정했습니다.

english: Still, they are nothing compared to the Angel of Death herself.
translation: 그래도 그들은 Angel of Death(죽음의 천사) 그녀에 비하면 아무것도 아닙니다.

english: So how do I deal with her?
You will never be able to truly defeat her. The best you can do is to try and keep her contained. When you are ready to face her, just go through the barrier.
translation: 그녀를 완전히 물리칠 수는 결코 없을 겁니다. 최선은 그녀를 가둬 두는 것이지요. 그녀와 맞설 준비가 되면 장벽을 통과하십시오.

english: If it helps, while my magic is limited here, I should still be able to transfer items in and out of the prison for you. Let me know if you'd like me to do this before you enter.
translation: 도움이 될지 모르겠지만, 이곳에서 제 마법은 제한적이어도 감옥 안팎으로 물건을 옮겨 드리는 정도는 할 수 있을 겁니다. 들어가기 전에 원하시면 말씀하십시오.

english: Tell me more about Nex.
Long ago, these lands were dominated by a great empire, ruled over by an ancient god. The Empty Lord is what they often called him, but his true name was Zaros.
translation: 오래전, 이 땅은 고대의 신이 다스리는 거대한 제국의 지배를 받았습니다. 사람들은 흔히 그를 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)라 불렀지만, 그의 진짜 이름은 Zaros(자로스)였습니다.

english: Zaros? I've heard of him.
At the height of his power, Zaros seemed untouchable, but he was eventually defeated by those he trusted the most. With him gone, the empire collapsed. War broke out soon after.
translation: 권세가 절정에 달했을 때 Zaros(자로스)는 누구도 건드릴 수 없는 존재처럼 보였지만, 결국 가장 믿었던 자들에게 패했습니다. 그가 사라지자 제국은 무너졌고, 곧 전쟁이 터졌지요.

english: Although their god was gone, many Zarosians fought to keep his empire alive. Among them was Nex. She was Zaros' most powerful weapon, and she led a great army to try and restore his empire.
translation: 신은 사라졌지만, 많은 Zarosians(자로스파)가 그의 제국을 지키려 싸웠습니다. 그중 하나가 Nex(넥스)였습니다. 그녀는 Zaros(자로스)의 가장 강력한 무기였고, 그의 제국을 되살리려 대군을 이끌었지요.

english: Not that she needed an army of course. Nex alone was powerful enough to hold back hundreds of lesser beings.
translation: 물론 그녀에게 군대가 꼭 필요했던 건 아닙니다. Nex(넥스) 혼자서도 하찮은 존재 수백을 막아 낼 만큼 강했으니까요.

english: So how did she end up here?
translation: 그런데 어쩌다 여기 갇히게 된 거예요?

english: The forces of Saradomin knew that Nex needed to be dealt with. They were able to lure her into these caverns.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 군대는 Nex(넥스)를 처리해야 한다는 걸 알았습니다. 그들은 그녀를 이 동굴로 꾀어내는 데 성공했지요.

english: After great effort and sacrifice, they managed to place Nex and her followers into a frozen, enchanted sleep.
translation: 엄청난 노력과 희생 끝에, 그들은 Nex(넥스)와 추종자들을 마법에 걸린 얼어붙은 잠에 빠뜨렸습니다.

english: Once Nex was no longer an immediate threat, they built the Temple of Lost Ancients around her. Most of the temple has since fallen to ruin, but you can still see some of the remains.
translation: Nex(넥스)가 당장의 위협이 아니게 되자, 그들은 그녀 주위에 Temple of Lost Ancients(잃어버린 고대인의 신전)을 세웠습니다. 신전 대부분은 이제 폐허가 되었지만, 남은 흔적을 아직 볼 수 있습니다.

english: But she wasn't frozen forever, was she? You said you were fooled into freeing her.
translation: 하지만 영원히 얼어 있진 않았죠? 속아서 그녀를 풀어 줬다고 하셨잖아요.

english: Yes. Later in the war, a great battle broke out in the Temple of Lost Ancients. I was a Saradominist soldier at the time, and I was among those who fought for him in that battle.
translation: 그렇습니다. 전쟁 후반, Temple of Lost Ancients(잃어버린 고대인의 신전)에서 큰 전투가 벌어졌습니다. 당시 저는 Saradominist(사라도민파) 병사였고, 그 전투에서 그분을 위해 싸운 이들 중 하나였습니다.

english: By then, many of us had grown tired of war. One of our priests discovered this. He came to us and revealed that he felt the same way, and that he had secretly converted to Guthix. He encouraged us to join him.
translation: 그 무렵 저희 중 많은 이가 전쟁에 지쳐 있었습니다. 저희 사제 중 한 명이 그걸 알아챘지요. 그는 저희에게 와서 자신도 같은 마음이며, 몰래 Guthix(구식스)로 개종했다고 털어놓았습니다. 그리고 저희에게도 함께하자고 권했습니다.

english: We abandoned the cause of Saradomin and became followers of Guthix. Our new leader taught us the ways of the druids, including an ancient ritual that had the power to awaken Guthix himself.
translation: 저희는 Saradomin(사라도민)의 대의를 버리고 Guthix(구식스)의 추종자가 되었습니다. 새 지도자는 저희에게 드루이드의 방식을 가르쳤는데, 그중에는 구식스 본인을 깨울 힘이 있는 고대 의식도 있었습니다.

english: We believed this ritual to be the only way to end the war.
translation: 저희는 그 의식만이 전쟁을 끝낼 유일한 방법이라고 믿었습니다.

english: But I'm guessing that's not how things went?
translation: 그런데 일이 그렇게 흘러가진 않았나 보네요?

english: No... When our leader led us to perform the ritual, it was not Guthix we woke, but Nex and her forces. The ritual also destroyed the protective enchantments on their prison.
translation: 그렇습니다... 지도자가 저희를 이끌어 의식을 치렀을 때, 깨어난 것은 Guthix(구식스)가 아니라 Nex(넥스)와 그녀의 군대였습니다. 그 의식은 감옥을 지키던 보호 마법까지 파괴했지요.

english: And that was exactly what your leader wanted?
translation: 그리고 그게 바로 그 지도자가 원했던 거였고요?

english: It was. He had never been a follower of Guthix, or Saradomin. His real goal had always been to free Nex.
translation: 그렇습니다. 그는 애초에 Guthix(구식스)도, Saradomin(사라도민)도 따른 적이 없었습니다. 그의 진짜 목적은 언제나 Nex(넥스)를 풀어 주는 것이었지요.

english: The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temorarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
translation: 나머지는 이미 말씀드린 대로입니다. Nex(넥스)가 너무나 위험했기에 네 군대가 잠시 힘을 합쳐 그녀를 감옥으로 다시 몰아넣었습니다. 감옥은 다시 봉인했지만, 저희가 파괴한 마법은 고치지 못했지요.

english: As for me, I was one of the first to fall after Nex was freed, but I didn't truly die. Something about our ritual tied me to this place. I've been trapped here ever since. Not dead, but not really alive either.
translation: 저는 Nex(넥스)가 풀려난 뒤 가장 먼저 쓰러진 이들 중 하나였지만, 진짜로 죽지는 않았습니다. 저희 의식의 무언가가 저를 이곳에 묶어 버렸지요. 그 뒤로 줄곧 여기 갇혀 있습니다. 죽은 것도 아니고, 그렇다고 살아 있는 것도 아닌 채로.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be. This is the punishment for my sins.
translation: 그럴 것 없습니다. 이건 제 죄에 대한 벌이니까요.

english: What of the one that led the ritual. What came of him?
translation: 그 의식을 이끈 자는요? 그는 어떻게 됐나요?

english: He'd achieved his goal, so he left. I never saw him again.
translation: 그는 목적을 이루고 떠났습니다. 다시는 보지 못했지요.

english: But who was he really?
He never gave us his true name, but as Nex was freed, she spoke to him.
translation: 그는 저희에게 본명을 밝히지 않았지만, Nex(넥스)가 풀려날 때 그녀가 그에게 말을 걸었습니다.

english: She knew him?
It seemed that way. I heard little of what they said, but I did hear what she called him.
translation: 그런 것 같았습니다. 둘이 나눈 말은 거의 듣지 못했지만, 그녀가 그를 뭐라고 불렀는지는 똑똑히 들었습니다.

english: What was it?
Sliske.
Forgive me, but this conversation has brought back many memories. Let us speak no more of this.
translation: 죄송합니다만, 이 이야기를 하다 보니 많은 기억이 되살아나는군요. 이제 그만 이야기하지요.

english: Of course.
Can I access my bank?
Of course.
I'd like to collect some items.
I need to go.
Good luck out there.
Tell me more about Nex.
Can I access my bank?
I'd like to collect some items.
I need to go.
Hello there.
Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh? I'm not really supposed to talk to you.
translation: 어이, 친구. 외지인이구나? 원래 너랑 얘기하면 안 되는데.

english: Why not?
I dunno buddy. Some stupid tradition or other. We're always told not to talk to outerlanders unless the Chieftain has allowed it.
translation: 몰라, 친구. 무슨 바보 같은 전통인가 그래. Chieftain(족장)이 허락하기 전엔 외지인이랑 말 섞지 말라고 늘 그러거든.

english: The Chieftain? Who is that?
His names Brundt, buddy. He's a real boring guy. You can find him in the longhall there.
translation: 이름은 Brundt(브룬트)야, 친구. 진짜 따분한 아저씨지. 저기 longhall(롱홀)에 가면 있어.

english: Can you take me to see him?
Sorry buddy, I'm not allowed into the Longhall. Don't worry, he's easy to spot. He's the one in the fancy helmet. Oh, and he only has one eye.
translation: 미안, 친구. 난 Longhall(롱홀)에 못 들어가. 걱정 마, 금방 찾을 거야. 멋들어진 투구 쓴 사람이 그 아저씨야. 아, 그리고 눈이 하나뿐이야.

english: He's a cyclops?
Nah, nah, nah... He just wears an eyepatch! Well, see ya around buddy!
translation: 아냐, 아냐, 아냐... 그냥 안대를 하고 있을 뿐이야! 그럼, 또 보자, 친구!

english: Hey there, buddy. You're an outerlander, huh?
Didn't think old Jarvald would let an outerlander come kill dagger-mouths with him!
translation: Jarvald(야르발드) 영감이 외지인을 데리고 단검주둥이를 잡으러 올 줄은 몰랐네!

english: Well, obviously he did. So what are you doing up here?
translation: 뭐, 보다시피 데려왔죠. 그래서 여기서 뭐 하고 있어요?

english: Well buddy, let me tell you, killing those dagger-mouths is sure thirsty work!
translation: 있잖아, 친구, 단검주둥이 잡다 보면 진짜 목이 타거든!

english: If you got a keg of beer on you I'll buy it off ya for 500 gold coins, buddy!
translation: keg of beer(맥주 통) 갖고 있으면 내가 500골드 코인에 살게, 친구!

english: Or if you got any animal parts, I'll trade ya something for 'em!
translation: 아니면 동물 부산물이 있으면 그걸 다른 거랑 바꿔 줄게!

english: No... I don't have anything like that with me...
translation: 아뇨... 그런 건 지금 하나도 없어요...

english: Well, I'm not going back down there until I get a drink buddy! Come see me if you find me a keg, I pay good money!
translation: 흥, 한잔하기 전까진 저 아래로 다시 안 내려갈 거야, 친구! 맥주 통 찾으면 나한테 와. 돈은 두둑이 쳐줄게!

english: Wanna sell me ya kegs of beer for 500 gold coins each outerlander?
translation: 맥주 통 하나에 500골드 코인씩 쳐줄 테니 팔래, 외지인?

english: I don't know... Seems a little off to sell alcohol to a child...
translation: 글쎄요... 애한테 술을 파는 건 좀 아닌 것 같은데...

english: Hey, don't judge our customs outerlander! Now you want the cash or you want to bug me?
translation: 야, 우리 풍습 갖고 뭐라 하지 마, 외지인! 그래서 돈 받을 거야, 아니면 계속 귀찮게 할 거야?

english: You wanna sell me the lot buddy, or one at a time?
translation: 전부 팔래, 친구, 아니면 하나씩 팔래?

english: You sell Askeladden your Kegs of Beer.
translation: Askeladden(아스켈라덴)에게 Kegs of Beer(맥주 통)을 전부 판다.

english: You sell Askeladden a Keg of Beer.
translation: Askeladden(아스켈라덴)에게 Keg of Beer(맥주 통)을 하나 판다.

english: But I don't have any kegs of beer to sell...
translation: 근데 팔 맥주 통이 하나도 없는데요...

english: I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked tuna, ya interested outerlander?
translation: 동물 부산물을 cooked tuna(익힌 참치)랑 바꿔 줄게. 관심 있어, 외지인?

english: You wanna trade me the lot buddy, or just one type?
translation: 전부 바꿀래, 친구, 아니면 한 종류만 바꿀래?

english: You trade Askeladden your animal parts for food.
translation: Askeladden(아스켈라덴)에게 동물 부산물을 주고 음식으로 바꾼다.

english: What ya selling buddy?
You trade the parts for food.
No offence Askeladden, and it's not that I don't trust you... Er, actually it is that I don't trust you.
translation: 기분 나빠하지 마요, Askeladden(아스켈라덴). 못 믿어서 그러는 건 아닌데... 어, 사실 못 믿어서 그러는 거 맞아요.

english: Aw, buddy... What did I ever do to you?
translation: 에이, 친구... 내가 너한테 뭘 어쨌다고 그래?

english: Well, if ya change your mind, I'm gonna be here waiting for a drink, buddy!
translation: 뭐, 마음 바뀌면 와. 난 여기서 술 한잔 기다리고 있을 테니까, 친구!

english: Hey buddy, I'll trade ya that for some food! Ya interested?
translation: 어이 친구, 그거 음식이랑 바꿔 줄게! 관심 있어?

english: Okay buddy, suit yerself!
Hi. Are you a member of the council of elders?
Me? On the council? Ha ha ha ha! Sorry buddy, I'm not a 'real' Fremennik yet! Let me guess, you're trying to get some council members to vote for you?
translation: 나? 원로회? 하하하하! 미안, 친구, 난 아직 '진짜' Fremennik(프레메닉)이 아니거든! 맞혀 볼까, 원로회 의원들한테 너 찍어 달라고 하고 다니는 중이지?

english: That's right, to become a Fremennik.
You and me both buddy! We're both doing the same trials! This is my trial of manhood! How you finding it so far? Pretty easy, huh buddy?
translation: 나도 그래, 친구! 우리 둘 다 똑같은 시험을 치르는 중이야! 이게 내 성인 시험이거든! 지금까지 해 보니까 어때? 엄청 쉽지, 친구?

english: It's okay I guess...
Yeah, that's the spirit buddy! It's all real easy, I wouldn't worry yourself about it, you'll be quaffing beers in the longhall as a Fremennik in no time!
translation: 그래, 바로 그 정신이야, 친구! 전부 진짜 쉬워. 걱정할 거 하나도 없어. 금방 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 돼서 longhall(롱홀)에서 맥주를 들이켜고 있을 거야!

english: Hello there. I understand you managed to get some golden wool from Lalli?
translation: 안녕하세요. Lalli(랄리)한테서 golden wool(황금 털실)을 얻어 냈다면서요?

english: HAHAHA! Yeah, that Lalli... what a maroon!
translation: 하하하! 그래, 그 Lalli(랄리) 말이지... 완전 멍충이라니까!

english: So how did you manage to get the wool?
Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.
translation: 음, 알다시피 나도 성인 시험의 일부로 너랑 같은 시험을 치르는 중인데, 그 털실을 구할 수 있는 건 그 트롤뿐이거든.

english: You might have noticed he's kind of... messed in the head buddy! He's real paranoid about people stealing his golden apples, isn't he?
translation: 너도 눈치챘겠지만, 그 녀석 머리가 좀... 이상하잖아, 친구! 누가 자기 황금 사과를 훔쳐 갈까 봐 엄청 벌벌 떨잖아, 안 그래?

english: Indeed he is. So how did you manage to get some golden wool from him?
translation: 정말 그렇더라고요. 그래서 그 트롤한테서 황금 털실을 어떻게 얻어 냈어요?

english: It was easy buddy! I persuaded him he needed a pet to help him guard his apples. A pet that would never sleep! A pet that would never need food, or exercise!
translation: 쉬웠지, 친구! 사과를 지키려면 애완동물이 필요하다고 꼬드겼어. 절대 잠들지 않는 애완동물! 먹이도 운동도 절대 필요 없는 애완동물!

english: A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
translation: 자기... 그, 알잖아, 친구, 그걸 치워 줄 필요도 절대 없는 애완동물. 언제나 주인한테 충성하는 애완동물! 평생 함께할 충실한 동반자!

english: What pet is this then?
A pet ROCK!
Man, can you believe that stupid troll traded me some of his golden wool for a worthless ROCK?
translation: 와, 그 멍청한 트롤이 쓸모없는 돌멩이 하나에 황금 털실을 내줬다는 게 믿겨져?

english: Buddy, I hafta say; if brains were explosives, that troll wouldn't have enough to blow his nose!
translation: 친구, 이건 꼭 말해야겠어. 머리에 든 게 화약이었으면, 그 트롤은 코딱지 하나도 못 날려 버릴걸!

english: Do you have any spare rocks then?
Sure thing buddy, although I have to say, I doubt even that troll is stupid enough to fall for the SAME trick TWICE in a row! You can try anyway though!
translation: 물론이지, 친구. 근데 아무리 그 트롤이라도 똑같은 수법에 두 번 연속으로 넘어갈 만큼 멍청하진 않을 거야! 그래도 한번 해 봐!

english: So this is the exact same type of rock you managed to sell to Lalli as a pet?
translation: 그러니까 이게 Lalli(랄리)한테 애완동물이라고 팔아넘긴 거랑 똑같은 돌이라는 거죠?

english: Yup, sure is buddy! That Lalli is stupid, even by troll standards!
translation: 그렇지, 바로 그거야, 친구! 그 Lalli(랄리)는 트롤 기준으로 봐도 멍청하다니까!

english: Can I have another rock? I lost mine...
translation: 돌 하나 더 줄 수 있어요? 잃어버렸어요...

english: Sure thing buddy! I'd say take better care of this one, but it's just a rock! I have hundreds of them! Go wild!
translation: 물론이지, 친구! 이번 건 잘 챙기라고 하고 싶지만, 그냥 돌멩이인걸! 나한테 수백 개나 있어! 맘껏 가져가!

english: Sure thing, but you'd better free up some space first.
translation: 물론이지. 근데 먼저 자리부터 좀 비워.

english: Can I have another pet rock?
translation: pet rock(애완 돌) 하나 더 줄 수 있어요?

english: Sure, have as many as you like. I've plenty more!
translation: 물론이지, 얼마든지 가져가. 아직 잔뜩 있거든!

english: Your inventory is too full to accept another 'pet rock'.
translation: 소지품이 가득 차서 '애완 돌'을 더 받을 수 없다.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: 혹시 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이 Longhall(롱홀)에 들어가지 않겠다고 쓴 각서를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 알아요?

english: What? I can't believe she asked you to get a written promise from me to stay out!
translation: 뭐? 그 아줌마가 나한테 롱홀에 안 들어가겠다는 각서를 받아 오라고 시켰다고? 말도 안 돼!

english: Yup, she really did.
Awwwwwww.... but the longhall is just SO MUCH FUN! I'd live there if I could! I suppose you really need that promise to help become a Fremennik, huh?
translation: 으아아아아앙.... 근데 longhall(롱홀)은 진짜 너무너무 재밌단 말이야! 할 수만 있으면 거기서 살 거라고! 그 각서가 있어야 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 될 수 있는 거지, 그치?

english: Yeah, I really do...
Well I'll tell you what buddy; As it's you, I'll give you that written promise. All I ask in return for it is a measly 5000 gold. What do you say?
translation: 그럼 이렇게 하자, 친구. 너니까 특별히 그 각서를 써 줄게. 대신 받을 건 고작 5000골드뿐이야. 어때?

english: ...how embarrassing. I appear to be short...
Trying to scam me, huh buddy? Well it won't work! You come back with the cash, or don't come back at all!
translation: 날 속여 먹으려고, 친구? 어림없지! 돈 갖고 다시 오든가, 아니면 아예 오지 마!

english: Your inventory is too full to accept the written promise.
translation: 소지품이 가득 차서 각서를 받을 수 없다.

english: That's all you want in return? Sure thing. Here you go.
translation: 원하는 게 그게 다예요? 좋아요. 여기요.

english: Done, and done. Let me know if you got any more cash burning a hole in your pocket I can relieve you of, buddy.
translation: 거래 끝, 완료. 주머니에 돈이 남아돌아서 근질근질하면 언제든 말해. 내가 덜어 줄게, 친구.

english: I don't think so... That's really quite a lot of money...
Hey, suit yourself buddy. You change your mind, the bank of Askeladden is open for deposits 24 hours a day! Eh-heh-heh-heh-heh.
translation: 뭐, 맘대로 해, 친구. 마음 바뀌면 와. 아스켈라덴 은행은 하루 24시간 입금 받으니까! 에헤헤헤헤헤.

english: I thought you really liked the long hall?
translation: long hall(롱홀) 정말 좋아하는 줄 알았는데요?

english: I do!
Then why did you sign this guarantee that you will never enter it again?
translation: 그럼 다시는 안 들어가겠다는 이 각서엔 왜 서명했어요?

english: Aha! It is because I am cunning! That guarantee says that Askeladden will never enter the longhall again! But when I have completed my Fremennik trials,
translation: 아하! 내가 교활하니까! 그 각서엔 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이 다시는 longhall(롱홀)에 들어가지 않는다고 적혀 있지! 하지만 내가 Fremennik trials(프레메닉 시험)을 끝내고,

english: and passed my trial of manhood, I will be given a new name, as is our custom, and will therefore not be Askeladden anymore! That guarantee isn't worth the paper it's written on!!
translation: 성인 시험까지 통과하면 우리 풍습대로 새 이름을 받게 될 테니, 더는 아스켈라덴이 아니게 되는 거지! 그 각서는 종잇값만도 못하다고!!

english: You didn't think I would give up going to the longhall for only 5000 did you?
translation: 설마 고작 5000골드에 내가 longhall(롱홀) 가는 걸 포기할 줄 알았던 건 아니겠지?

english: Knowing you, I guess I didn't.
translation: 당신 성격을 아니까, 그렇게 생각하진 않았어요.

english: Hello again Askeladden.
Hey buddy! That ain't my name no more! My new Fremennik name is Larravak! What's yours?
translation: 어이 친구! 그건 이제 내 이름이 아니야! 내 새 Fremennik(프레메닉) 이름은 Larravak(라라박)이야! 넌 뭐야?

english: My Fremennik name is [Fremennik name].
Ha! Ain't as good as my name buddy! So what can I do ya for?
translation: 하! 내 이름만큼 멋있진 않네, 친구! 그래서 뭘 해 줄까?

english: So, Askeladd- sorry, Larravak; What is there to do around here now that we are both Fremenniks?
translation: 그럼, 아스켈라- 아, 미안해요, Larravak(라라박). 이제 우리 둘 다 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 됐으니 이 근처에서 뭘 하면 좋을까요?

english: I guess you could do a bit of shopping. We got fresh fish at the docks, and some armour and weapons at Skulgrimen's place.
translation: 쇼핑이나 좀 해 보든가. 부두에 신선한 생선이 있고, Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)네 가게엔 갑옷이랑 무기가 있어.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hi buddy! Or do ya want me to call ya [Fremennik name] now?
translation: 안녕, 친구! 아니면 이제 [Fremennik name](이)라고 불러 줄까?

english: Askeladden, what on Gielinor are you doing up here? And by the way, the name is [player name].
translation: Askeladden(아스켈라덴), 도대체 여기서 뭐 하는 거예요? 그리고 참고로 제 이름은 [player name](이)라고요.

english: Sure thing, buddy!
I was down in that cave killing dagger-mouths! It was fun! But then I got thirsty, so came up here for a bit of a rest...
translation: 저 동굴 아래에서 단검주둥이를 잡고 있었어! 재밌었지! 근데 목이 말라서 좀 쉬러 올라왔어...

english: Hey buddy, I'll tell you what, if you got any kegs of beer on ya, I'll buy them off ya for 700 gold coins each!
translation: 어이 친구, 이렇게 하자. 맥주 통 갖고 있으면 하나에 700골드 코인씩 쳐줄게!

english: If ya found any animal parts killing dagger-mouths I'll trade ya for them too!
translation: 단검주둥이 잡다가 동물 부산물을 얻었으면 그것도 바꿔 줄게!

english: Wanna sell me kegs of beer for 700 gold coins each buddy?
translation: 맥주 통 하나에 700골드 코인씩 쳐줄 테니 팔래, 친구?

english: Um... Aren't you a little... ...young to be drinking so much?
translation: 음... 술 마시기엔 좀... ...너무 어리지 않아요?

english: Hey, don't talk to me like that buddy! I've done all the trials you have and I'm just as mucha  Fremennik as you are!
translation: 야, 그런 식으로 말하지 마, 친구! 나도 너랑 똑같은 시험을 다 치렀다고. 나도 너만큼 어엿한 Fremennik(프레메닉)이야!

english: Now are ya gonna sell me some beer, or are you going to cry about it all day?
translation: 그래서 맥주를 팔 거야, 아니면 하루 종일 징징댈 거야?

english: I'll trade ya animal parts for cooked lobsters if ya interested buddy!
translation: 동물 부산물을 cooked lobsters(익힌 랍스터)랑 바꿔 줄게. 관심 있으면 말해, 친구!

english: Can I have another pet rock? I lost mine...
translation: pet rock(애완 돌) 하나 더 줄 수 있어요? 잃어버렸어요...

english: Well it's sure a weird place to ask for it buddy, but I have hundreds of them! Go wild!
translation: 하필 이런 데서 그걸 달라고 하다니 참 별나네, 친구. 뭐, 나한테 수백 개나 있으니까! 맘껏 가져가!

Sell all Kegs
Sell One Keg

And where do you come from, traveller?
From... out of town.
That I could have guessed.
We've been having more human visitors in the city recently, there is another one over there. Perhaps you'll want to talk to her.
translation: 요즘 이 도시에 인간 방문객이 부쩍 늘었어요. 저쪽에도 한 명 있죠. 그분하고 얘기해 보시는 게 좋겠네요.

english: Ssshhhh...
There is a lot of knowledge stored in this library, you know.
translation: 이 도서관엔 많은 지식이 보관되어 있답니다.

english: Oh, I'm sure.
What can I help you with?
Help? What kind of help do you mean?
Looking for a book? A manuscript? Knowledge?
Oh, nothing in specific really.
I'll leave you to your browsing, then.
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 열기구를 이용하시겠어요? 참고로 몇몇 장소는 특별한 통나무와 높은 Firemaking(불 피우기) 레벨이 필요해요.

english: No.
Yes.
No.
Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 열기구를 이용하시겠어요? 참고로 몇몇 장소는 특별한 통나무와 높은 Firemaking(불 피우기) 레벨이 필요해요.

english: Weapons are not allowed on Entrana. I must search you first.
translation: Entrana(엔트라나)에는 무기를 가져갈 수 없어요. 먼저 소지품을 검사해야 해요.

english: You are quickly searched.
I'm sorry, no weapons or armour may be worn to Entrana. Come back when you have laid them down.
translation: 죄송하지만 Entrana(엔트라나)에는 무기나 갑옷을 착용하고 갈 수 없어요. 내려놓고 다시 오세요.

english: The player rides the balloon to Entrana.
No.
Who are you?
I am Assistant Marrow. I'm working here part time while I study to be a doctor.
translation: 저는 Assistant Marrow(조수 매로)예요. 의사가 되려고 공부하면서 여기서 아르바이트를 하고 있어요.

english: Do you want to use the balloon?
Yes.
No.

Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 열기구를 이용하시겠어요? 참고로 몇몇 장소는 특별한 통나무와 높은 Firemaking(불 피우기) 레벨이 필요해요.

english: Weapons are not allowed on Entrana. I must search you first.
translation: Entrana(엔트라나)에는 무기를 가져갈 수 없어요. 먼저 소지품을 검사해야 해요.

english: You are quickly searched.
I'm sorry, no weapons or armour may be worn to Entrana. Come back when you have laid them down.
translation: 죄송하지만 Entrana(엔트라나)에는 무기나 갑옷을 착용하고 갈 수 없어요. 내려놓고 다시 오세요.

english: The player rides the balloon to Entrana.
No.
Who are you?
I am Stan. Auguste hired me to look after this balloon. I make sure people are prepared to fly.
translation: 저는 Stan(스탠)이에요. Auguste(오귀스트) 씨가 이 열기구를 관리하라고 절 고용했죠. 사람들이 비행할 준비가 됐는지 확인하는 게 제 일이에요.

english: Do you want to use the balloon?
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Hello Asteros. What brings you to the castle?
translation: 안녕하세요, Asteros(아스테로스) 님. 성에는 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: The King's late father asked for an advisor from Arceuus. He was keen for us to have a more central role than we did under the Council.
translation: 선왕께서 Arceuus(아르세우스)에 조언자를 청하셨습니다. 의회 시절보다 저희가 더 중심적인 역할을 맡기를 바라셨지요.

english: I see. I'm sure the King is glad to have you here.
translation: 그렇군요. 왕께서도 분명 반기고 계실 거예요.

english: He does seem willing to take on my advice, which is very welcoming. I hope he remains humble. It is a trait many leaders lack.
translation: 제 조언을 기꺼이 받아들여 주시니 참으로 고마운 일입니다. 부디 겸손함을 잃지 않으시길 바랍니다. 많은 지도자에게 부족한 덕목이지요.

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can offer you the ability to respawn at Kourend Castle upon death.
translation: 그럼, 제가 더 도와드릴 일이 있습니까? 원하신다면 사망 시 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)에서 부활할 수 있게 해 드리겠습니다.

english: Yes please.
Very well. From now on, you will respawn at Kourend Castle.
translation: 알겠습니다. 이제부터 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)에서 부활하시게 됩니다.

english: No thanks.
Let me know if you change your mind.
Hello Asteros.
Hello there. Would you like me to change your respawn point to Kourend Castle?
translation: 안녕하십니까. 부활 지점을 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)으로 바꿔 드릴까요?

english: Hello there. Would you like me to revert your respawn point to Lumbridge?
translation: 안녕하십니까. 부활 지점을 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 되돌려 드릴까요?

english: Very well. From now on, you will respawn in Lumbridge.
What brings you to the castle?
Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you're interested, I can change your respawn point to Kourend Castle.
translation: 그럼, 제가 더 도와드릴 일이 있습니까? 원하신다면 부활 지점을 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)으로 바꿔 드리겠습니다.

english: Now, is there something else I can do for you? If you want, I can revert your respawn point to Lumbridge.
translation: 그럼, 제가 더 도와드릴 일이 있습니까? 원하신다면 부활 지점을 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 되돌려 드리겠습니다.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What brings you to the castle?
Now you look like someone who goes to a lot of fancy dress parties.
translation: 가만 보니 가장 무도회에 꽤 자주 다니실 것 같은 분이군요.

english: Errr...what are you saying exactly?
I'm just saying that perhaps you would like to peruse my selection of garments.
translation: 그냥 제 의상들을 한번 둘러보시면 어떨까 해서요.

english: Or, if that doesn't interest you, then maybe you have something else to offer? I'm always on the look out for interesting or unusual new materials.
translation: 아니면, 그게 관심 없으시다면 혹시 다른 걸 내놓으실 수도 있겠죠? 전 늘 흥미롭거나 특이한 새 재료를 찾고 있거든요.

english: Okay, let's see what you've got then.
Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
Well I do sell them. I don't hand them out for free though. This is a shop not a charity.
translation: 팔긴 하죠. 그렇다고 공짜로 나눠 드리진 않아요. 여긴 가게지 자선 단체가 아니거든요.

english: Please! It's really important.
Well I suppose you can have this old one. It's not in good enough condition to sell.
translation: 뭐, 이 낡은 거라면 드려도 되겠네요. 팔기엔 상태가 별로라서요.

english: Thank you.
Could you make another eagle costume for me?
translation: 독수리 의상을 하나 더 만들어 줄 수 있어요?

english: Certainly, if you can supply the materials. I'll need appropriate feathers, swamp tar and some yellow dye. It'll also cost you 25 gold pieces.
translation: 물론이죠, 재료만 구해 오신다면요. 알맞은 feathers(깃털), swamp tar(늪 타르), 그리고 yellow dye(노란 염료)가 좀 필요해요. 비용은 25골드고요.

english: I'll see what I can do.
I think I might just leave the perusing for now, thanks.
Can you make clothing suitable for hunting?
translation: 사냥할 때 입기 좋은 옷도 만들 수 있어요?

english: Certainly. Take a look at my range of made-to-order items. If you can supply the furs, I'll gladly make any of these for you.
translation: 물론이죠. 제 주문 제작 품목을 한번 보세요. 모피만 가져오시면 이 중 어떤 것이든 기꺼이 만들어 드릴게요.

english: What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: 특이한 재료라면 어떤 걸 생각하고 계세요?

english: Well, some more colourful feathers might be useful. For some surreal reason, all I normally seem to get offered are large quantities of rather beaten-up looking chicken feathers.
translation: 글쎄요, 좀 더 화려한 깃털이 있으면 쓸모가 있겠네요. 무슨 영문인지, 다들 꼴이 엉망인 닭 깃털만 잔뜩 들고 와서 팔겠다고 하거든요.

english: People must have some very strange pastimes around these parts, that's all I can say.
translation: 이 동네 사람들은 참 별난 취미를 가졌나 봐요. 제가 할 수 있는 말은 그것뿐이네요.

english: Ok, let's see what you've got then.
Sorry, we're closed at the moment.
Okay, lets see what you've got then.
Do you have a spare Priest Gown?
Could you make another bird costume for me?
translation: 새 모양 의상을 하나 더 만들어 줄 수 있어요?

english: I think I might just leave the perusing for now thanks.
Can you make clothing suitable for hunting in?
translation: 사냥할 때 입기 좋은 옷도 만들 수 있어요?

english: What sort of unusual materials did you have in mind?
translation: 특이한 재료라면 어떤 걸 생각하고 계세요?

english: What do you want, little [man/woman]?
Nothing. Just though I'd try to strike up a conversation.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 말 좀 걸어 보려고요.

english: Not now little one, I'm busy.
Okay then.
Well done, little one. You've proven your worth.
Can I do it again?
What? Why?
It was fun, I'd like to do it again.
translation: 재밌었거든요. 한 번 더 하고 싶어요.

english: You're the first person to ask me that [player name]. I suppose I could train you again, but I will have to charge you the full 25,000 coins this time.
translation: 그런 걸 물어본 건 네가 처음이다, [player name]. 다시 훈련시켜 줄 수는 있지만, 이번엔 25,000코인을 전부 받아야겠다.

english: Let's do this, I'm ready.
It's not going to be any easier my friend!
translation: 이번이라고 더 쉽진 않을 거다, 친구!

english: Training session begins.
Training session ends.
Hold it there little one, you don't have enough money to pay for the lesson.
translation: 거기서 멈춰라, 꼬마야. 수업료를 낼 돈이 모자라는구나.

english: Oh, sorry I was too excited...
No worries friend, come back when you can afford the session.
translation: 괜찮다, 친구. 수업료를 낼 수 있게 되면 다시 오너라.

english: Back again I see, here for another workout?
translation: 또 왔구나. 한 번 더 운동하러 왔나?

english: Yes please.
You must take your training very seriously [player name]. This is the second time you'll have done this workout and paid full price!
translation: 훈련을 정말 진지하게 여기는구나, [player name]. 이 운동을 하는 게 벌써 두 번째인데, 그것도 제값을 다 내고 말이야!

english: You take your training very seriously [player name]. You know you've done this workout [times done] times, are you sure you want to do it again?
translation: 훈련을 정말 진지하게 여기는구나, [player name]. 너 이 운동을 벌써 [times done]번이나 했다. 정말 또 할 거냐?

english: Yes
No
Hello there, [player name]. What can I do for you?
How are things?
Now that the situation in the ruins is under control, things are nice and quiet, which is just what we need. That whole buisness down there got a lot of dwarves riled up.
translation: 폐허 쪽 상황이 진정된 뒤로는 조용하고 평화로워. 딱 우리한테 필요한 거지. 그 아래서 벌어진 일 때문에 드워프들이 꽤 많이 성나 있었거든.

english: Naturally, most blame you humans.
translation: 당연히 대부분은 너희 인간들 탓을 하지.

english: Of course. Have you tried explaining to them that we actually helped?
translation: 그렇겠죠. 사실은 저희가 도왔다고 설명은 해 봤어요?

english: Ha! Good one. You think I'm going to make a laughing stock of myself by daring to claim a human did something positive? Keep dreaming!
translation: 하! 좋은 농담이네. 인간이 뭔가 좋은 일을 했다고 감히 우기면서 내가 웃음거리가 될 것 같아? 꿈 깨!

english: So how long has Cam Torum been around?
translation: 그런데 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)은 생긴 지 얼마나 됐어요?

english: What am I, a historian?
No, but you're the only dwarf here that might be willing to share that sort of information with me.
translation: 아니죠. 하지만 여기서 그런 얘기를 저한테 해 줄 만한 드워프는 당신뿐이잖아요.

english: Hmph. Very well. The Varlamorians won't mention this, but we were the first to settle here. Our ancestors saw the writing on the wall when Xeric came to power in Kourend. They chose not to stick around.
translation: 흥. 좋아. Varlamorians(바를라모어인)은 절대 이 얘길 안 하겠지만, 여기 처음 정착한 건 우리였어. 우리 선조들은 Xeric(제릭)이 Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 권력을 잡았을 때 앞날이 뻔하다는 걸 알아챘지. 그래서 눌러앉지 않기로 했어.

english: Must have been a big thing for them, leaving their home.
Doubtful. My people are all too familiar with that sort of thing. The Lovakengj dwarves have mostly forgotten their history, but we Dwarves of Cam Torum remember it all too well.
translation: 글쎄. 우리 종족한텐 그런 일이 너무 익숙하거든. Lovakengj(로바켕기) 드워프들은 자기들 역사를 거의 잊어버렸지만, 우리 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)의 드워프들은 너무도 똑똑히 기억하고 있어.

english: Remember what?
Before Lovakengj, there was Imcandoria. Our ancestors there were forced to abandon their home, just as we were forced to leave Kourend.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기) 이전에 Imcandoria(임칸도리아)가 있었어. 거기 살던 우리 선조들도 고향을 버려야 했지. 우리가 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 떠나야 했던 것처럼.

english: If you humans had had your way, we might have had to abandon Cam Torum by now as well.
translation: 너희 인간들 뜻대로 됐으면, 우린 지금쯤 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)까지 버려야 했을지도 몰라.

english: You don't know that.
But I do know that. As I said, we remember our history, and we know that those who don't are doomed to repeat it.
translation: 아니, 알아. 말했잖아, 우린 우리 역사를 기억한다고. 그리고 역사를 잊은 자는 그걸 되풀이하게 된다는 것도 알지.

english: The Varlamorians nearly destroyed themselves in their War of Betrayal, but it was not them who were betrayed, it was us.
translation: Varlamorians(바를라모어인)은 War of Betrayal(배신의 전쟁)으로 스스로를 거의 멸망시킬 뻔했지만, 배신당한 건 그들이 아니라 우리였어.

english: I was a young dwarf when their war risked destroying our home. I saw the results of their pride. Meanwhile, they've all but forgotten it.
translation: 그들의 전쟁이 우리 터전을 망가뜨릴 뻔했을 때 난 젊은 드워프였지. 그들의 오만이 낳은 결과를 똑똑히 봤어. 그런데 정작 그들은 그걸 거의 잊어버렸다고.

english: Sorry. I didn't mean to dig up old wounds.
translation: 죄송해요. 아픈 기억을 들춰낼 생각은 없었어요.

english: Hmph. It's fine. Your intentions are good, [player name], which is more than can be said for most of your kind. Who knows, maybe one or two dwarves here might even grow to tolerate you.
translation: 흥. 괜찮아. 넌 뜻은 좋잖아, [player name]. 너희 종족 대부분한텐 할 수 없는 말이지. 누가 알아, 여기 드워프 한둘쯤은 언젠가 널 참아 줄 수 있게 될지도.

english: I'd better get going.
How are things?
So how long has Cam Torum been around?
translation: 그런데 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)은 생긴 지 얼마나 됐어요?

english: I'd better get going.
Hello again. Was Fox happy with the material?
translation: 또 오셨네요. Fox(여우)는 그 옷감 마음에 들어 했어요?

english: He was. You found the perfect match.
translation: 네, 좋아하더라고요. 딱 맞는 걸 찾아 주셨어요.

english: Wonderful!
I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: combat Adventure Path(전투 모험 경로)를 완료하고 받은 이 쿠폰이 있는데요, Adventure Path(모험 경로) 보상을 받으려면 당신을 찾아가라고 적혀 있어요.

english: Why yes, here are some air and mind runes.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 여기 air rune(에어 룬)과 mind rune(마인드 룬)을 드릴게요.

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 보상이 더 있긴 한데, 그걸 드리려면 멤버 월드에 있어야 해요. 다른 걸로 도와드릴 일이 있을지도 모르겠네요.

english: Do you want to buy some runes?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이죠! 스킬 망토는 성취의 상징이에요. 스킬을 완전히 익혀 99레벨에 도달한 사람만이 손에 넣어 그 혜택을 누릴 수 있죠.

english: The Cape of Runecrafting has been upgraded with each talisman, allowing you to access all Runecrafting altars. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Cape of Runecrafting(룬 제작 망토)는 모든 탈리스만의 힘으로 강화되어 있어서, 모든 Runecrafting(룬 제작) 제단에 들어갈 수 있게 해 줘요. 더 도와드릴 일이 있나요?

english: No thank you.
Well, if you find someone who does want runes, please send them my way.
translation: 그럼, 혹시 룬을 원하는 사람을 만나면 제게 보내 주세요.

english: Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 줄 수 있어요?

english: Senventior Disthine Molenko!
I have been sent here with a package for you.
A package? From who?
From Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower.
From Sedridor? But... surely he can't have? Please, let me have it. It must be extremely important for him to have sent a stranger.
translation: Sedridor(세드리도르) 님이요? 설마... 그분이 그랬을 리가? 어서 이리 주세요. 낯선 사람 편에 보낼 정도면 엄청나게 중요한 게 틀림없어요.

english: You hand Aubury the research package.
This... this is incredible.
My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.
translation: 이 research notes(연구 노트)를 가져다줘서 정말 고마워요, 모험가님. 덕분에 드디어 찾아낸 것 같아요.

english: You mean the incantation?
Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...
translation: 음, 제 연구에 이번 발견을 합치면, 어쩌면 우리가...

english: No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. The signs are promising, but let's not jump to any conclusions just yet.
translation: 아니, 아니, 제가 너무 앞서 나갔네요. 조짐은 좋지만 아직 섣불리 결론을 내리진 말죠.

english: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
translation: 자, 이 노트를 Sedridor(세드리도르) 님께 다시 가져가 주세요. 그분께 필요한 건 다 들어 있을 거예요.

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I kind of don't have it with me...
translation: 어... 네... 그게... 사실 지금 안 갖고 있어요...

english: What kind of person tells me they have a delivery for me, but not with them? Honestly.
translation: 배달할 게 있다고 해 놓고 가져오지 않는 사람이 어디 있어요? 정말이지.

english: Come back when you do.
Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: 제가 드린 소포에 쓸 만한 게 있었어요?

english: Well, let's have a look...
Hello. Did you take those notes back to Sedridor?
translation: 안녕하세요. 그 노트는 Sedridor(세드리도르) 님께 갖다드렸나요?

english: Sorry, but I lost them.
Well, luckily I have duplicates. It's a good thing they are written in code. I wouldn't want the wrong kind of person to get access to the information contained within.
translation: 음, 다행히 사본이 있어요. 암호로 적어 둬서 다행이죠. 엉뚱한 사람이 그 안에 담긴 정보를 손에 넣으면 곤란하니까요.

english: I'm still working on it.
Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for.
translation: 너무 오래 걸리진 마세요. 그분은 이게 정말 우리가 바라던 돌파구인지 어서 확인하고 싶어 하실 거예요.

english: Now, did you want to buy some runes?
Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: 실은 Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)의 사업 제안을 전하러 왔어요.

english: Ali who?
Ali Morrisane, a salesman of great repute based in Al Kharid.
translation: Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)이요. Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 장사하는, 꽤 이름난 상인이에요.

english: What is this proposal then?
He wants to set up a rune-selling franchise in the markets of Al Kharid and he wants you to supply him with the stock.
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드) 시장에 룬 판매 체인점을 차리고 싶은데, 당신이 물건을 대 줬으면 한대요.

english: Why doesn't he get his own runes and sell them?
translation: 왜 직접 룬을 구해서 팔지 않는대요?

english: His talents don't lie in that area. What he's good at is selling things, and lots of them.
translation: 그쪽엔 재주가 없거든요. 그 사람이 잘하는 건 물건을 파는 거예요. 그것도 아주 많이요.

english: Hmm, interesting... So let's get this straight, he wants me to supply him with runes, which he will sell, and send me the profits?
translation: 흠, 흥미롭네요... 그러니까 정리하자면, 제가 룬을 대 주면 그가 그걸 팔아서 수익을 저한테 보내 준다는 거죠?

english: Nearly. He will charge a small commission on the runes.
translation: 거의 맞아요. 룬 판매에 약간의 수수료를 뗄 거예요.

english: Do you think that it will work? Will people actually buy these runes off him?
translation: 그게 잘될 거라고 생각해요? 사람들이 정말 그 사람한테서 룬을 살까요?

english: I wouldn't be surprised. Supply and demand are his rune essence and ore.
translation: 아마 살걸요. 그 사람한텐 수요와 공급이 룬 정수이자 광석 같은 거니까요.

english: Now this is very important, is he trustworthy?
translation: 자, 이건 정말 중요한 건데요, 그 사람 믿을 만해요?

english: Yes, I believe so. Trust is a key part of commerce and something, which I doubt he would neglect.
translation: 네, 그렇다고 생각해요. 신뢰는 장사의 핵심이고, 그 사람이 그걸 소홀히 할 리는 없을 거예요.

english: Fair enough, I'll trust your judgement.
So you'll supply him with runes then?
translation: 그럼 그 사람한테 룬을 대 주시는 거죠?

english: Well if he's half as good a salesman as you suggest I should have no problem in funding my research and maybe even redecorating this place.
translation: 뭐, 그 사람이 당신 말의 반만큼만 장사를 잘해도 연구 자금은 문제없겠고, 어쩌면 이곳을 새로 꾸밀 수도 있겠네요.

english: Oh, sorry [player name], I didn't recognise you for a second, you're back again so soon. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet about the runes?
translation: 아, 죄송해요, [player name] 님. 잠깐 못 알아봤네요. 이렇게 빨리 다시 오시다니. Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)한테 룬 얘기는 해 보셨어요?

english: Umm... not yet, I'll try to get around to doing that soon.
Ya... about that, there's some crazy locking mechanism attached to each casket of runes, which he cannot figure out.
translation: 네... 그게 말이죠, 룬이 든 casket(작은 상자)마다 이상한 잠금 장치가 달려 있는데, 그 사람이 그걸 못 풀겠대요.

english: Oh, yes, the rune locks, they're a bit of a doozy, I've completely forgotten how they work, but I'm sure they shouldn't prove too much of a struggle to an intelligent adventurererlike you, [player name]. Eh?
translation: 아, 맞다, 룬 자물쇠요. 그거 좀 골치 아프죠. 작동 방식은 저도 완전히 잊어버렸지만, [player name] 님처럼 똑똑한 모험가한텐 그리 어렵지 않을 거예요. 그렇죠?

english: I wouldn't hold my breath.
Great! Now, do want to buy some runes?
Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 망토에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
Yes please!
Oh, it's a rune shop. No thank you, then.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 줄 수 있어요?

english: I have been sent here with a package for you.
Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: 제가 드린 소포에 쓸 만한 게 있었어요?

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: 실은 Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)의 사업 제안을 전하러 왔어요.

english: Gather round, one and all! It's time for the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 자, 모두 모이십시오, 여러분! Darkmeyer(다크마이어) 경매 시간입니다!

english: We've got quite the lineup for you today! So, let's get started!
translation: 오늘 준비한 매물이 아주 대단합니다! 자, 바로 시작하죠!

english: First up, a 37 year old male from sector four!
He's got plenty of blood in him, and he'll keep your home clean of any mess!
translation: 피가 아주 넉넉하고, 집안도 티끌 하나 없이 깨끗하게 치워 줄 겁니다!

english: Let's start the bidding at 1,000 coins! Do I have 1,000?
Here!
1,000 coins to the vyre at the back! Do I have 2,000?
I'll take it!
2,000 for the lady in red! Anyone for 3,000?
I have 3,000! But do I have 4,000?
Anyone for 4,000?
3,000 going once!
3,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre at the back!
Right then! Next we have a 22 year old female from sector six!
She's young and filled with optimism! Perfect for those who enjoy a taste of hope!
translation: 젊고 낙관으로 가득 차 있죠! 희망의 맛을 즐기시는 분께 딱입니다!

english: We'll start with 5,000 for this one! Do I have any takers!
translation: 이번 매물은 5,000부터 시작합니다! 응찰하실 분 있습니까!

english: Right here!
5,000 coins for the lady at the front! How about 6,000?
Give it to me!
I have 6,000! Who wants 7,000!
I'll take her for 10,000!
10,000! We have a bid of 10,000! You lot really want this one! Anyone up for 12,000?
translation: 10,000! 10,000 응찰 나왔습니다! 여러분 이번 매물이 정말 탐나시나 봅니다! 12,000 부르실 분?

english: Anyone for any more? 13,000?
12,000 going once!
12,000 going twice!
Sold for 12,000 coins! Enjoy!
Okay, finally we have a 41 year old male from sector three!
Careful! This one is feisty! In fact, we've had to put him in a cage!
translation: 조심하십시오! 이 녀석은 성질이 사납습니다! 사실 우리에 가둬 둬야 했을 정도죠!

english: If you can put him in his place though, you're in for a treat! His blood is the sweetest around!
translation: 하지만 이 녀석 버릇만 제대로 들여 놓으면 별미가 따로 없을 겁니다! 이 근방에서 피가 제일 달콤하거든요!

english: We'll begin with 4,000 coins!
I have 4,000! But do I have 5,000?
5,000 coins to the vyre in red! Do I have 6,000?
6,000 coins! Looks like we have a competition here! Let's take it to 7,000!
We're at 7,000! But will it go higher? 8,000 coins?
7,000 going once!
7,000 going twice!
Sold to the vyre in red!
Well there you have it! That's all for now from the Darkmeyer Auctions!
translation: 자, 이렇게 해서 오늘 Darkmeyer(다크마이어) 경매는 여기까지입니다!

english: Fear not though. We'll be back with more, very soon!
translation: 하지만 걱정 마십시오. 곧 더 많은 매물과 함께 돌아오겠습니다!

english: Oh, don't bother me human.
Why not? What's wrong?
You are wrong, human. Your attire is outrageous. Your presence is obnoxious.
translation: 문제는 너다, 인간. 옷차림은 꼴불견이고, 네 존재 자체가 불쾌하군.

english: What? What are you saying?
I'm saying you're in my way.
Greetings! Would you like to be my number one  accomplice? I mean, assistant?
translation: 안녕하세요! 제 일등 공범이... 아니, 조수가 되어 주시겠어요?

english: Who are you?
I am Auguste. I am going to be the first balloonist in all of Gielinor!
translation: 저는 Auguste(오귀스트)예요. Gielinor(길리노르) 최초의 열기구 비행사가 될 사람이죠!

english: Balloo-what? I thought only monks lived on Entrana.
translation: 열기구 뭐요? Entrana(엔트라나)에는 수도승들만 사는 줄 알았는데요.

english: Well, they do... I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
translation: 음, 그렇긴 해요... 저도 수도승이었거든요. 하지만 이 섬에서 사는 게 지긋지긋해요! 새로운 미지의 세계를 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: And go where no man has gone before?
translation: 그리고 아무도 가 본 적 없는 곳으로 가시려고요?

english: Maybe! That sounds good. I was thinking just over to Taverley, though.
translation: 그럴 수도 있죠! 멋진 말이네요. 전 그냥 Taverley(태벌리)까지만 건너갈 생각이었지만요.

english: Why not take the boat then?
Ugh! Ocean! Don't talk to me about the ocean...oh dear...I feel ill.
translation: 으윽! 바다! 바다 얘기는 꺼내지도 마세요... 아이고... 속이 메스꺼워요.

english: Whoa, ok, no ocean. How exactly are you going to get off the island, then?
translation: 워, 알았어요, 바다는 빼죠. 그럼 대체 섬을 어떻게 떠나실 건데요?

english: I have devised a new way to travel. But I need an assistant balloonist to help me build my design.
translation: 새로운 이동 수단을 고안했어요. 하지만 제 설계대로 만들려면 도와줄 보조 비행사가 필요해요.

english: Are you an experienced adventurer willing to help me?
Yes! Sign me up.
Wonderful! Let's get started.
Wait, I still don't know exactly what we're doing.
translation: 잠깐만요, 아직 정확히 뭘 하는 건지 모르겠는데요.

english: Of course, of course, how foolish of me. Well, we are going to make a balloon.
translation: 아, 그렇죠, 그렇죠. 제가 어리석었네요. 음, 우리는 열기구를 만들 거예요.

english: Which is what exactly?
Let me show you!
I don't think so.
Oh, never mind then.
Hello, [player name]. It is good to see you again. My enterprise has grown since we last met. I've expanded all over Gielinor!
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 다시 만나서 반가워요. 지난번 이후로 제 사업이 커졌답니다. 이제 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳으로 뻗어 나갔어요!

english: If you'd like to go to a new location, you will have to help fly the balloon again. Some of the routes are very dangerous!
translation: 새로운 곳에 가고 싶으면 다시 열기구 조종을 도와주셔야 해요. 몇몇 항로는 아주 위험하답니다!

english: But each route you complete will earn you Firemaking experience.
translation: 하지만 항로를 하나 완주할 때마다 Firemaking(불 피우기) 경험치를 얻을 수 있어요.

english: Once you've opened a route, it only costs 1 log of the corresponding type to travel there again, from any location you've already opened!
translation: 한번 항로를 열고 나면, 이미 열어 둔 어느 장소에서든 해당 종류의 통나무 1개만으로 다시 갈 수 있어요!

english: I have also hired assistants to watch over the balloons at each new location we go to. They will help you get where you want to go.
translation: 그리고 새로 가는 곳마다 열기구를 지킬 조수들도 고용해 뒀어요. 원하는 곳으로 가도록 도와줄 거예요.

english: Do you want to use the balloon? Just so you know, some locations require special logs and high Firemaking skills.
translation: 열기구를 이용하시겠어요? 참고로 몇몇 장소는 특별한 통나무와 높은 Firemaking(불 피우기) 스킬이 필요해요.

english: No.
Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: origami balloon(종이접기 풍선) 만드는 법 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

english: First, use the papyrus on the ball of wool. The papyrus is folded into an origami box and the yarn will support the heat source.
translation: 먼저 papyrus(파피루스)를 ball of wool(털실 뭉치)에 사용하세요. 파피루스는 종이접기 상자 모양으로 접히고, 실은 열원을 받쳐 줄 거예요.

english: Next, add the unlit candle to the balloon structure. It will act as the heat source.
translation: 다음으로 unlit candle(불 꺼진 양초)를 balloon structure(기구 골조)에 추가하세요. 그게 열원 역할을 할 거예요.

english: Now you have an origami balloon!
If you use your origami balloon with any dye, you can change the colour.
translation: origami balloon(종이접기 풍선)에 아무 염료나 사용하면 색을 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: You can release the balloon and watch it float in the air, just use a tinderbox on it.
translation: 풍선을 날려 보내서 하늘에 떠다니는 걸 구경할 수도 있어요. tinderbox(부싯깃 통)을 쓰기만 하면 돼요.

english: You don't have enough free space for your cap.
Here's your cap. Try to keep better track of it.
translation: 여기 모자요. 이번엔 잘 좀 챙기세요.

english: You don't need a new jacket; you still have your original one.
translation: 새 재킷은 필요 없어요. 원래 재킷을 아직 갖고 계시잖아요.

english: You don't have enough free space for your jacket.
Here's your jacket, to keep you warm during flight.
translation: 여기 재킷이요. 비행 중에 따뜻하게 해 줄 거예요.

english: There you go! You look like a true airship pilot now.
translation: 자, 됐어요! 이제 진짜 비행선 조종사 같아 보여요.

english: I can't combine them if you are wearing them.
translation: 착용하고 계시면 합쳐 드릴 수 없어요.

english: You don't have enough free space for the cap and goggles.
translation: cap and goggles(모자와 고글)을 받을 소지품 공간이 부족해요.

english: Yes.
No.
Could you tell me how to make an origami balloon?
translation: origami balloon(종이접기 풍선) 만드는 법 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Could you replace some items for me?
translation: 아이템 몇 개만 다시 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Could you combine my cap and goggles?
Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
