translation: 이야, 영웅님이시네요! Gadderanks(개더랭크스)에게서 저희를 구해 주셔서 정말 고마워요. 마을도 아주 근사해졌고요. 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Aurel the village store owner.
translation: 저는 이 마을 잡화점 주인 Aurel(아우렐)이에요.

english: Can you open the shop for me please?
How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 그야말로 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일은 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyre(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 근근이 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 여행할 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 요긴하고, 다들 당신께 무척 감사하고 있어요. 영웅을 실제로 보거나 알고 지낸 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저도 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
Hmm, how careless of you! However, you're in luck! Someone found it earlier and sold it to me.
translation: 흠, 덤벙대셨네요! 그래도 운이 좋으시네요! 아까 누가 그걸 주워서 저한테 팔았거든요.

english: Now I can pass the hammer back to you for the remarkably cheap price of 3000 gold coins. Deal?
translation: 이제 그 망치를 단돈 3000골드 코인이라는 놀랍도록 싼 값에 돌려 드릴 수 있어요. 어때요?

english: But I don't have 3000 coins on me?
So that means you can't have it then! Come back when you have 3000 coins.
translation: 그럼 못 가져가시는 거죠! 3000코인 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Oayk, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
A good deal and I'm sure of it!
No thanks, I'll leave it, 3000 coins is too much to pay.
Very good then! I'll have no guilty conscience in offering it to other adventurers that frequent my shop then. Many thanks for your time and good day to ya sir.
translation: 그럼 좋아요! 우리 가게에 자주 들르는 다른 모험가들한테 팔아도 양심에 거리낄 게 없겠네요. 시간 내 주셔서 정말 고맙고, 좋은 하루 보내세요, 손님.

english: Why does the hammer cost so much?
So much! That's cheap! The adventurer I bought it from wanted twice as much but I managed to knock him down to a reasonable price.
translation: 비싸다니요! 싼 거예요! 저한테 판 모험가는 두 배를 불렀는데, 제가 적당한 값으로 깎은 거라고요.

english: What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
I've lost Gadderanks' Warhammer.
Okay, I'll pay 3000 coins for the hammer.
No thanks, I'll leave it. 3000 coins is too much to pay.
Why does the hammer cost so much?
Okay, thanks.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 주변에 녹아드는 중이야. 여기를 염탐하고 있지.

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 그냥, 주머니 두둑한 부자들이 좀 돌아다닌다고만 해 둘게.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 요령 좀 알려 줄래? 나는 영 재미를 못 보고 있거든.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 난 꽤 교묘하거든. 가끔씩 사람들 시선을 끌어서 주머니에 신경을 덜 쓰게 만들지.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 그거 교묘하네. 네... 시선 끌기를 잘 지켜볼게.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬. 나 지금도 충분히 시선 끌고 있거든!

english: Hmmph. What do you want?
I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 그냥 저 계단 아래에 뭐가 있나 궁금해서요.

english: You can't go down there!
I didn't want to anyway.
Good. Because you can't.
Because I don't want to.
Because you can't. So that's fine.
Yes, it is.
Yes. Fine.
Absolutely.
Well then.
Why not?
This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a shortcut through your home?
translation: 여긴 Mountain Dwarves(산악 드워프)의 집이야. 누가 지름길 삼아 네 집을 지나가겠다고 하면 좋겠어?

english: Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
Well, it is a lot easier to go this way to get past White Wolf Mountain than through those wolf filled passes.
translation: 뭐, 늑대가 득실대는 고갯길보다는 이쪽으로 가는 게 White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)을 넘기에 훨씬 수월하지.

english: Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
Well, it is.
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
translation: 당신이 제 친구라면 저는 상관없을 텐데요.

english: Yes, but I don't even know you.
translation: 그래, 하지만 난 널 알지도 못하잖아.

english: Well, let's be friends!
I'd rather not, thank you.
This quest is not available on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: 이 퀘스트는 Speedrunning Worlds(스피드런 월드)에서 이용할 수 없습니다.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Fishing Contest quest.
translation: Fishing Contest(낚시 대회) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 조건을 모두 충족하지 못했습니다.

english: And how am I meant to do that?
translation: 그럼 제가 그걸 어떻게 하라는 거예요?

english: My, we are the persistent one aren't we?
Well, there's a certain gold artefact we're after. We dwarves are big fans of gold! This artefact is the first prize at the Hemenster fishing competition.
translation: 뭐, 우리가 노리는 금 유물이 하나 있어. 우리 드워프들은 금이라면 사족을 못 쓰거든! 그 유물이 Hemenster(헤멘스터) 낚시 대회 1등 상품이야.

english: Fortunately we have acquired a pass to enter that competition...
translation: 다행히 그 대회 참가권은 구해 놨는데...

english: Unfortunately Dwarves don't make good fishermen.
Fortunately I'm alright at fishing!
Okay. I entrust you with our competition pass. Don't forget to take some gold with you for the entrance fee.
translation: 좋아. 우리 대회 참가권을 맡기지. 참가비로 낼 골드 챙겨 가는 거 잊지 말고.

english: Go to Hemenster and do us proud!
translation: Hemenster(헤멘스터)에 가서 우리 체면 좀 세워 줘!

english: You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
Don't you know it.
I'm bigger than you. Let me by!
...stumpy.
Go away! You're not going to bully your way in HERE!
translation: 꺼져! 힘으로 밀고 들어올 생각은 꿈도 꾸지 마!

english: I was just stopping to say hello!
Hello then.
Do you have a brother?
What if I do! It's no business of yours.
translation: 있으면 뭐! 네가 상관할 일 아니야.

english: Have you won yet?
No, not yet.
Well don't give up! Maybe old Jack can give you a few tips.
translation: 포기하지 마! Jack(잭) 영감이 요령 좀 알려 줄지도 모르지.

english: Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.
translation: 어서 와라, 위대한 낚시 챔피언! 언제든 들러서 우리 터널을 써도 돼.

english: Thank you, I think I'll stop by for a beer one day.
I was wondering what was down those stairs?
translation: 그냥 저 계단 아래에 뭐가 있나 궁금해서요.

english: I didn't want to anyway.
Why not?
Ooh... is this a shortcut to somewhere?
Oh, sorry, I hadn't realised it was private.
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it.
translation: 당신이 제 친구라면 저는 상관없을 텐데요.

english: Well, let's be friends!
Yes.
No.
You're a grumpy little man aren't you?
I'm bigger than you. Let me by.
I was just stopping to say hello!
Do you have a brother?
Hello again. Are you after another device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
translation: 또 오셨네요. 장치를 더 원하세요, 정보를 원하세요, 아니면 제가 파는 물건을 보시겠어요?

english: Devices, please.
I'd like information, please.
Just a few bits of information before you run away to persecute rock crabs or cows.
translation: rock crab(바위 게)나 소를 괴롭히러 달려가기 전에 몇 가지만 알려 드릴게요.

english: Firstly, your new device won't work if you are wearing certain metallic chest armours.
translation: 첫째, 특정 금속 몸통 갑옷을 입고 있으면 새 장치가 작동하지 않아요.

english: The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equip page.
translation: 작동에 필요한 자기 인력이 간섭을 일으키기 때문에, 장치가 그런 호환되지 않는 아이템은 착용하지 못하게 막아요.

english: Secondly, although the device is calibrated to attract only arrow heads, there is a chance that other magnetically active items will be attracted.
translation: 둘째, 장치는 화살촉만 끌어당기도록 보정돼 있지만, 자성을 띤 다른 아이템도 끌려올 가능성이 있어요.

english: The arrow recovery function of the devices is slightly different and relies upon a harmonic bond between your arrows and the chicken's magnet. You'll thus only recover arrows which you have fired rather than those
translation: 장치의 화살 회수 기능은 조금 달라서, 화살과 닭의 자석 사이의 조화로운 결합에 의존해요. 그래서 직접 쏜 화살만 회수되고,

english: fired by nearby folks.
translation: 근처 사람들이 쏜 화살은 회수되지 않아요.

english: You'll also need to move about if you want to collect arrows since the gathering of long-lost arrowheads can't work otherwise.
translation: 그리고 화살을 모으려면 계속 돌아다녀야 해요. 그러지 않으면 오래전에 잃어버린 화살촉을 모으는 기능이 작동하지 않거든요.

english: Finally, the device will only work when worn. It automatically deactivates in other circumstances.
translation: 마지막으로, 장치는 착용했을 때만 작동해요. 다른 상황에서는 자동으로 꺼져요.

english: I was worried about what would happen if you were to place it in a bank in its active state, so I've made sure it only works when it's on your back.
translation: 작동 중인 상태로 은행에 넣으면 무슨 일이 생길지 걱정돼서, 등에 메고 있을 때만 작동하게 해 뒀어요.

english: Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: locator orb(탐지 구슬)을 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Ava gives you [another orb/[amount] orbs].
I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
Here's my shop.
I'll just head off, I think.
Thanks for the help with my bed; see you again.
translation: 침대 일 도와줘서 고마워요. 또 봐요.

english: Mind taking a look at this quiver for me?
Hmm...
That truly is a remarkable piece of equipment.
Bring me one of my devices. I might be able to link the two!
translation: 제 장치를 하나 가져와 보세요. 둘을 연결할 수 있을지도 몰라요!

english: Wow! Really? I better go and grab one.
If you've got the materials, I can make one now for you?
translation: 재료가 있으면 지금 하나 만들어 드릴까요?

english: Let me see...
Extraordinary...
That quiver has some of the finest leatherwork I've ever seen!
translation: 이 화살통 가죽 세공은 제가 본 것 중에 손꼽히게 훌륭해요!

english: I was wondering if you could maybe make it... better?
translation: 혹시 이걸... 더 좋게 만들어 주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Better? Let me see... I might be able to do something.
translation: 더 좋게요? 어디 보자... 뭔가 해 볼 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: I'll see if I can link it to the device you have with you.
translation: 지금 갖고 계신 장치랑 연결할 수 있는지 볼게요.

english: Ouch!
That's some tough material...
Move that here...
There we go! That's some of my finest work, if I do say so myself.
translation: 됐다! 제 입으로 말하긴 뭐하지만, 제 최고 작품 중 하나예요.

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
Looks like that quiver could be modified further. Come back to me with another device to modify it.
translation: 이 화살통은 더 개조할 수 있겠어요. 장치를 하나 더 가지고 오시면 개조해 드릴게요.

english: Fair enough.
Mind taking another look at that quiver I showed you before?
translation: 전에 보여 드린 화살통 한 번 더 봐 주실래요?

english: Hmm, interesting... It seems to lack the power you have in your other device there.
translation: 흠, 흥미롭네요... 지금 가지고 계신 다른 장치만큼의 힘이 없는 것 같아요.

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could help with that?
translation: 맞아요. 그 부분을 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: I'll give it a good go!
It seems like that quiver is as good as it's going to get!
translation: 이 화살통은 이제 더 이상 좋아질 수 없을 것 같아요!

english: I'm not sure what you are trying to do; are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?
translation: 뭘 하려는 건지 모르겠네요. 혹시 정신이 좀 이상해지신 거 아니에요?

english: Devices, please.
Ava's devices.
Dizana's Quiver.
I'd like information, please.
Can I have more locator orbs, please?
translation: locator orb(탐지 구슬)을 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I'd like to see your stuff for sale, please.
I'll just head off, I think.
What are you doing out here on your own?
I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: 혼자 아니거든! 나랑 내 친구들이 이 거리를 주름잡고 있어. 주머니 조심하는 게 좋을걸, 낯선 양반.

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
You see those fancy houses?
I think so?
We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: 우린 집주인들이 언제 나가고 들어오는지 망을 봐. 주인이 나가면 몰래 들어가서 물건을 몽땅 훔치는 거지!

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
translation: 그거 위험하지 않아? 사방에 경비병이 있잖아.

english: No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: 우리 같은 거리의 아이들은 아무도 의심 안 해. 등잔 밑이 어둡다는 말도 있잖아.

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: 원하면 어느 집이 비었는지 정보 좀 줄 수 있는데...

english: Sounds good.
You're new around here. Normally I'd charge 15 valuables for information, but I'm feeling generous.
translation: 여기 처음이지? 원래 정보값으로 valuables(귀중품) 15개는 받는데, 오늘은 기분이 좋으니까 봐줄게.

english: Looks like Victor isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: Victor(빅토르)가 지금 집에 없는 것 같아. 빨리 가!

english: Do you want me to point you in the right direction?
Yes please.
His house is south of here.
Sounds good.
Yes please.
I'll find my own way.
I'm alright for now.
What? Can't you see I'm busy?
Well, sooooorry...
I have received word from my father of your assistance to our family in this matter. You have my thanks for restoring our honour.
translation: 아버지께서 이번 일로 저희 가문을 도와주셨다는 소식을 전해 주셨습니다. 저희 가문의 명예를 되찾아 주셔서 감사드립니다.

english: Not a problem.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 그래요, 뭐... 제가 도와드릴 일이라도 있습니까?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿 좀 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
Great thanks!
Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them back to you.
translation: Avan(아반)이 건틀릿을 받아 작은 망치를 꺼내더니 두드려 모양을 살짝 바꾼 뒤 돌려준다.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 아버지께서 또 저희를 도와주셨다는 소식을 전해 주셨습니다! 하지만 어차피 해낼 때까지 포기하지 않으셨을 것 같군요.

english: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.
translation: 감사의 표시로, 원하시는 만큼 Goldsmith gauntlets(금세공 건틀릿)을 기꺼이 만들어 드리겠습니다.

english: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 이 건틀릿을 끼고 금을 제련하면 경험치를 얻는 속도가 훨씬 빨라질 겁니다.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿 좀 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Goldsmith gauntlets?
translation: Goldsmith gauntlets(금세공 건틀릿)을 한 켤레 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You're welcome.
Hey there.
Need something, iknami?
Not really. Just wondering what brings you out here?
translation: 아니요, 딱히요. 그냥 여기까지 무슨 일로 오셨나 해서요.

english: I'm here to trade with the dwarves here on behalf of Fortis. Stonecutter Outpost is the main supplier of the stone we use for building.
translation: Fortis(포르티스)를 대신해서 이곳 드워프들과 거래하러 왔어요. Stonecutter Outpost(석공 전초기지)는 우리가 건축에 쓰는 돌의 주요 공급처거든요.

english: And is the trading going well?
Well it's significantly better than dealing with the dwarves in Cam Torum, but they're still not the easiest to work with.
translation: 음, Cam Torum(캠 토룸) 드워프들이랑 거래하는 것보단 훨씬 낫지만, 그래도 함께 일하기 쉬운 상대는 아니에요.

english: Ah, well in that case, I'd better leave you to it.
translation: 아, 그렇다면 일하시게 저는 이만 가 볼게요.

english: You have brought peace between our kingdoms, [player name].
translation: 자네가 우리 두 왕국 사이에 평화를 가져왔네, [player name].

english: I've instructed my people to allow you full access to our Island, but beware I do not command the undead beneath us.
translation: 내 백성들에게 자네가 우리 섬을 마음껏 드나들 수 있도록 일러두었네. 하지만 조심하게. 우리 발밑의 언데드는 내 명령을 따르지 않는다네.

english: Now that's quite the banana. Where did you get it?
Far from here, deep in the Kharidian Desert.
translation: 여기서 먼 곳, Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막) 깊숙한 곳에서요.

english: Interesting... Continue.
You recount your experiences with the baboons in Osmumten's Tomb...
translation: Osmumten's Tomb(오스뭄텐의 무덤)에서 개코원숭이들과 겪은 일을 들려준다...

english: Well, that was a fascinating story. We have of course heard of various troops of our kind spread across the land, but this is the first I have heard of these ones.
translation: 참으로 흥미로운 이야기였네. 물론 우리 동족 무리가 세상 곳곳에 흩어져 있다는 얘기는 들었지만, 이들에 대해 듣는 건 처음일세.

english: Now that we know their story, you can rest assured that their memory will live on here.
translation: 이제 그들의 사연을 알았으니, 그들에 대한 기억은 이곳에서 계속 이어질 걸세. 안심하게.

english: Thank you.
Now, about that large banana...
Here you go.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
Spot on!
King Awowogei has given you another clue scroll/a casket!
translation: King Awowogei(아워워게이 왕)이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)/casket(작은 상자)를 또 하나 주었다!

english: Greetings, human.
I didn't realise monkeys could talk!
Some of us have learned to speak with your kind, yes. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed during this incident.
translation: 우리 중 몇몇은 자네들 종족과 말하는 법을 익혔지. 이번 일에서 내 추종자들이 아무도 다치지 않은 것에 감사하네.

english: Once again you have proven a friend to our kind, human. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed.
translation: 자네는 또 한 번 우리 종족의 친구임을 증명했네, 인간. 내 추종자들이 아무도 다치지 않아 고맙게 생각하네.

english: It was definitely more work than I thought it would be.
Yes, I'd imagine so. Our kind are much more nimble than yours. I still don't know why you insist on using only two of your four legs.
translation: 그렇겠지. 우리 종족은 자네들보다 훨씬 날렵하니까. 자네들이 왜 굳이 다리 네 개 중 두 개만 쓰겠다고 고집하는지 아직도 모르겠네.

english: I suppose I've never thought about it like that before.
translation: 그런 식으로는 생각해 본 적이 없네요.

english: Thank you kind madam. The town is saved and the water is flowing freely.
translation: 감사합니다, 친절하신 분. 마을이 구원받았고 물도 막힘없이 흐르고 있습니다.

english: You're welcome.
What's more when we now pray at the shrine we now feel rejuvenated and healthier than ever!
translation: 게다가 이제 shrine(성소)에서 기도하면 그 어느 때보다 기운이 나고 건강해지는 걸 느낍니다!

english: That's interesting to know.
What do you think you are doing?
Errm, I'm trying to remove your soul.
What, have you lost your mind?
It's for the good of the village. I met a genie down the crevice. He told me he would give me the statuette in exchange for your soul.
translation: 마을을 위해서예요. crevice(틈새) 아래에서 genie(지니)를 만났는데, 당신의 영혼을 주면 statuette(작은 조각상)을 주겠다고 했어요.

english: That's barbaric! We'll just have to find other ways to get the town a good supply of water. Keep your knife away from me please.
translation: 야만적이군요! 마을에 물을 넉넉히 댈 다른 방법을 찾아봐야겠습니다. 그 knife(칼)은 제게서 치워 주십시오.

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: 어서 와요, 그래 뭘 찾으러 왔어요?

english: I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 당신은 사실 아주 강한데, 정말 Zanaris(자나리스)에 있는 Chaeldar(카엘다르)에게 과제를 받지 않아도 괜찮겠어요?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 과제는 [task monster]을(를) [amount]마리 처치하는 거예요.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: 평소라면 내가 주지 않을 과제이긴 한데... 원한다면 새 과제를 줄 수도 있어요.

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
translation: 새 과제를 받으면 [task streak amount]회인 일반 과제 연속 기록이 초기화돼요. 괜찮겠어요? Wilderness(황야) 과제 연속 기록 [task streak amount]회에는 영향이 없어요.

english: No, thanks.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그건 당신에게 맞는 과제가 아닌 것 같네요. 취소해 줄까요? 과제 연속 기록은 지워지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 과제는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 과제를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건이 있나요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상도 꽤 많고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 아주 다양해요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 당신 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 과제든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 과제든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 좋아요, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 과제를 정할 때 당신 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니 너무 어려운 건 안 나올 거예요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 과제를 정할 때 당신 전투 레벨을 고려하니까 너무 어려운 건 안 나올 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 제 전투 레벨은 확인하지 마세요. 뭐든 할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 좋아요, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 당신 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에서 뭐든 줄 거예요.

english: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.
translation: 안녕하세요, blessed axe(축복받은 도끼) 일로 또 왔어요.

english: I suppose you want a new axe?
Actually, yes.
You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have an axe in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
translation: mithril axe(미스릴 도끼)와 holy symbol of Saradomin(사라도민의 신성한 상징)을 둘 다 줘야 해요. 가방에 도끼가 없으니 도와줄 수가 없네요.

english: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?
translation: 여기 새 거예요. 이번엔 좀 더 조심해서 쓰세요, 알았죠?

english: Not right now.
Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.
translation: 그럼 잘 가요. 새 도끼가 필요하면 물론 언제든 다시 와도 돼요.

english: You already have an axe in your bag but you want another?
translation: 가방에 이미 도끼가 있는데 하나 더 갖고 싶다고요?

english: So you're filling in for Turael?
That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.
translation: 맞아요. 이런 일을 해 본 지 꽤 오래됐지만, 동생이 마지막 모험을 한 번 더 하고 싶다고 해서 이렇게 와 있어요.

english: So you've done this before?
Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.
translation: 그럼요. 사실 동생보다 내가 먼저 했어요. 동생이 모험하러 다니던 시절에는 내가 여기서 사람들에게 기초를 가르쳤죠.

english: After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.
translation: Spria(스프리아)가 태어난 뒤로 동생은 짜릿함을 좇던 삶에서 은퇴했어요. 그때 내 일을 물려받았죠.

english: Interesting... I never knew that.
He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!
translation: 동생은 자기 모험 얘기를 잘 안 하지만, 한번 말문이 트이면 멈추게 할 수가 없을걸요!

english: About Turael...
You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.
translation: 위로의 말은 안 해도 돼요, 모험가님. 오래전부터 각오하고 있었으니까요.

english: You have?
My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.
translation: 동생은 평생 짜릿함을 좇던 사람이었어요. 은퇴한 뒤에도 언젠가 무언가가 동생을 다시 끌어들일 거라는 걸 늘 알고 있었죠.

english: And that something was me. I'm sorry...
Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.
translation: 그러지 말아요. 동생은 좋아하는 일을 하다가 영웅으로 죽었어요. 동생도 다른 방식은 원하지 않았을 거예요.

english: Er... Nothing...
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please cancel it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건이 있나요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 과제든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 제 전투 레벨은 확인하지 마세요. 뭐든 할 수 있어요!

english: I'm here about blessed axes again.
translation: blessed axe(축복받은 도끼) 일로 또 왔어요.

english: Actually, yes.
I can do without for now, thanks.
So you're filling in for Turael?
About Turael...
Er... Nothing...
Hello there.
Ah, a stranger to our island. How can I help?
translation: 아, 우리 섬에 낯선 이가 왔구나. 무엇을 도와줄까?

english: Ah! [player name], I'm glad to see you've returned. How can I help?
translation: 아! [player name], 다시 와 주니 반갑구나. 무엇을 도와줄까?

english: It's a very interesting house you have here. Does he have a name?
translation: 집이 참 흥미롭네요. 이 집도 이름이 있나요?

english: Why of course. It's Berty.
Berty? Berty the Chicken leg house?
Yes.
May I ask why?
It just has that certain ring to it, don't you think? Beeerteeee!
translation: 뭐랄까, 입에 착 붙는 맛이 있잖니? 버어티이이!

english: You're ins...
Insane? Very.
There's a lunar spell in my spell book that I can't use. Could you...?
translation: 제 주문서에 쓸 수 없는 루나 주문이 하나 있는데요. 혹시...?

english: Help you? Certainly. It's one I've just rediscovered! I can teach it to you if you like, but you have to listen to a story first.
translation: 도와 달라고? 물론이지. 내가 막 다시 찾아낸 주문이란다! 원하면 가르쳐 주마. 대신 먼저 이야기를 하나 들어야 해.

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing sto-
Wonderful!
Well, I was going through some ancient documents recently, expanding my knowledge of our great ancestors...
translation: 그래, 얼마 전에 고대 문서들을 살펴보고 있었단다. 위대한 우리 조상들에 대해 더 알아보려고 말이야...

english: Hmm, actually, I think I had better go further back, so you will understand.
translation: 흠, 아니다. 네가 이해하려면 좀 더 거슬러 올라가는 게 좋겠구나.

english: You know of our ancient war with the Fremennik that you recently healed?
translation: 얼마 전에 네가 끝내 준, Fremennik(프레메닉)과 우리 사이의 오랜 전쟁은 알고 있지?

english: Of course! I am a great diplomat, aren't I?
translation: 물론이죠! 제가 대단한 외교관이잖아요, 안 그래요?

english: Some diplomat. Did you even discover WHY we were at war for so long?
translation: 외교관은 무슨. 우리가 왜 그렇게 오래 싸웠는지는 알아내기나 했니?

english: Errr... You couldn't see eye to eye about magic, or something like that.
translation: 어... 마법에 대해 의견이 안 맞았다든가, 뭐 그런 거 아니었어요?

english: Not too far off; it goes deeper than that.
translation: 아주 틀린 말은 아니다만, 그보다 더 깊은 사연이 있단다.

english: The Fremennik were actually the first to discover how to make runes, but there was disagreement within the tribe about the implications of making such powerful objects.
translation: 사실 룬 만드는 법을 처음 알아낸 건 Fremennik(프레메닉)이었단다. 하지만 그토록 강력한 물건을 만드는 게 무슨 의미인지를 두고 부족 안에서 의견이 갈렸지.

english: Most Fremennik felt we were stealing power from the gods. They could not see past that to the great things we could do with such power, so we split from them and became the Moon Clan. Our ancient leader, who first
translation: 대부분의 Fremennik(프레메닉)은 우리가 신들의 힘을 훔친다고 여겼어. 그 힘으로 이룰 수 있는 위대한 일들은 보지 못했지. 그래서 우리는 그들과 갈라서 Moon Clan(달 부족)이 되었단다. 우리의 옛 지도자는 이곳

english: discovered the rune essence mine here on Lunar Isle, travelled far and wide searching for more places of power. He and his followers built altars all over Gielinor - which you use today to create runes - and at their
translation: Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 rune essence(룬 정수) 광산을 처음 찾아낸 분인데, 힘이 깃든 곳을 더 찾아 온 세상을 누볐단다. 그분과 추종자들은 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 제단을 세웠지. 오늘날 너희가 룬을 만들 때 쓰는 그 제단들 말이다. 그리고 전성기에는

english: height they made runes by the crateful. They had perfected the process and even advanced it, creating altars that could create any type of rune regardless of the crafter's ability. But the strife between the Moon
translation: 룬을 상자째로 만들어 냈단다. 그 과정을 완성하고 한층 더 발전시켜서, 만드는 이의 실력과 상관없이 어떤 룬이든 만들 수 있는 제단까지 세웠지. 하지만 Moon Clan(달 부족)과

english: Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown stong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we had lived ever since.
translation: Fremennik(프레메닉) 사이의 다툼은 점점 격해졌단다. 프레메닉은 몸이 강해졌고, 우리 부족은 정신이 강해졌지. 결국 그들이 우리를 힘으로 눌렀고, 우리는 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)으로 물러나 그 뒤로 줄곧 여기서 살아왔단다.

english: The Fremennik then swept over Gielinor destroying the altars we had made, in an attempt to remove all trace of magic from the land.
translation: 그 뒤 Fremennik(프레메닉)은 Gielinor(길리노르)를 휩쓸며 우리가 세운 제단들을 부숴 버렸지. 이 땅에서 마법의 흔적을 모조리 없애려고 말이야.

english: That's all very interesting, but what's it got to do with this spell?
translation: 다 흥미로운 얘기지만, 그게 그 주문이랑 무슨 상관이에요?

english: I'm getting to that!

The Fremennik were not as thorough as they thought. They destroyed only the entrances to the altars, for the altars themselves were on a different plane, but they were successful in wiping out our ability to create
translation: 하지만 Fremennik(프레메닉)은 생각만큼 철저하지 못했단다. 제단 자체는 다른 차원에 있었기에 그들이 부순 건 제단 입구뿐이었지. 그래도 우리가 룬을 만드는 능력을

english: runes. That ability has only recently been rediscovered on the mainland, so I hear.
translation: 없애는 데는 성공했단다. 그 능력은 최근에야 본토에서 다시 발견되었다고 들었구나.

english: Our people were left isolated on Lunar Isle but we used it to our advantage. Our control over Magic advanced beyond the need for runes and all knowledge of the altar locations passed from memory. Fortunately,
translation: 우리 부족은 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에 고립되었지만, 그걸 오히려 기회로 삼았단다. 우리의 Magic(마법) 실력은 룬이 필요 없는 경지에 이르렀고, 제단의 위치는 모두의 기억에서 사라졌지. 다행히도

english: some records survived... The manuscript I discovered contains the teleportation spell to an advanced altar called Ourania. It's an altar that allows the user, regardless of their Runecrafting ability, to craft any
translation: 기록 몇 개가 살아남았단다... 내가 찾은 필사본에는 Ourania(오라니아)라는 고급 제단으로 가는 순간이동 주문이 적혀 있었지. 그 제단에서는 Runecrafting(룬 제작) 실력과 상관없이 어떤 종류의

english: type of rune upon it. Ourania is a powerful altar indeed. What state it is in after so many millennia, I know not, but it's interesting all the same.
translation: 룬이든 만들 수 있단다. Ourania(오라니아)는 참으로 강력한 제단이지. 수천 년이 흐른 지금 어떤 상태일지는 나도 모르겠다만, 그래도 흥미롭지 않니.

english: So, will you teach me the spell?
translation: 그래서, 그 주문 가르쳐 주실 거예요?

english: Certainly.
*Baby Yaga whispers in your ear*
And now you know the teleportation spell, off with you! Go explore.
translation: 이제 순간이동 주문을 알았으니, 어서 가 보렴! 가서 탐험하거라.

english: I don't really have ti-
*Sigh* Very well. Another time, perhaps.
Why do you ask questions if you're going to read my mind anyway?
translation: 어차피 제 마음을 읽을 거면서 왜 물어보시는 거예요?

english: I was being polite, silly foreigner.
translation: 예의를 차린 거란다, 이 어리숙한 이방인아.

english: I'm good thanks, bye.
Ah, a stranger to our island. What brings you here?
translation: 아, 우리 섬에 낯선 이가 왔구나. 무슨 일로 왔니?

english: The Oneiromancer told me you may be able to help...
translation: Oneiromancer(꿈 점술사)가 당신이 도와줄 수도 있다고 했어요...

english: With a potion?
I don't think I'll ever get used to you people reading my mind. Yes, a potion of Waking Sleep? I need it to go to the...
translation: 당신네가 제 마음을 읽는 건 영영 적응이 안 될 것 같아요. 네, Waking Sleep(깨어 있는 잠) 물약요. 그게 있어야 갈 수 있거든요, 그...

english: Dreamland.
You know that's really quite rude!
Sorry. Carry on.
Well, I was hoping you could tell me how to make one?
translation: 음, 그 물약 만드는 법을 알려 주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Of course.
Are you sure you're ready to take on the dream land?
There's no harm in trying. Right...?
translation: 해 봐서 손해 볼 건 없잖아요. 그렇죠...?

english: Well, some people have gone mad from visiting their dreams.
translation: 글쎄다, 자기 꿈에 다녀왔다가 미쳐 버린 사람도 있단다.

english: You really know how to instil discomfort don't you!?! How do you make...
translation: 사람 불안하게 하는 데는 정말 선수시네요!?! 그래서 어떻게 만드는…

english: You'll need 1 guam leaf, 1 Marrentill leaf and a Suqah tooth ground using a pestle and mortar. Combine these in a vial and BAM! You've got your potion! You should be able to get the ingredients from the
translation: guam leaf(구암 잎) 1개, Marrentill leaf(마렌틸 잎) 1개, 그리고 pestle and mortar(막자와 막자사발)로 간 Suqah tooth(수카 이빨)이 필요하단다. 이걸 vial(약병)에 넣고 섞으면 짠! 물약 완성이지! 재료는

english: Suqah monsters.
translation: Suqah(수카) 괴물들에게서 구할 수 있을 게다.

english: You'll also need a special vial, I have one here.
translation: 특별한 약병도 필요할 텐데, 여기 하나 있단다.

english: Thanks.
Have you got anything to trade?
It's a very interesting house you have here.
There is a lunar spell I can't use in my spell book - can you help me?
translation: 제 주문서에 쓸 수 없는 루나 주문이 있는데, 도와주실 수 있나요?

english: Okay, I don't mind hearing stories.
I don't really have time right now.
I'm good, thanks, bye.
Hey, Mole. How is life above ground?
translation: 안녕, 두더지야. 땅 위 생활은 어때?

english: Well, the last time I was above ground, I was having to contend with people throwing snow at some weird yellow duck in my park.
translation: 글쎄, 마지막으로 땅 위에 올라갔을 땐 내 공원에서 웬 노란 오리한테 눈을 던지는 사람들 때문에 골치 아팠지.

english: Why were they doing that?
No idea, I didn't stop to ask as an angry mob was closing in on them pretty quickly.
translation: 몰라. 화난 군중이 그쪽으로 엄청 빨리 몰려들고 있어서 물어볼 새도 없었어.

english: Sounds awful.
Anyway, keep Molin'!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Squeak squeak!
Squeaka squeaka!
Squeee
Squeak
Hello Bailey.
Well, hello again, [player name]. What brings you back out here?
translation: 아, 또 만났네요, [player name]님. 무슨 일로 여기까지 다시 왔어요?

english: Just looking around.
Well, be very careful out there! Those dratted slugs have been joined by giant lobsters!
translation: 그럼 바깥에선 정말 조심해요! 그 망할 민달팽이들한테 거대 바닷가재까지 합세했다니까요!

english: Good day [Sir/Madame]. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: 안녕하십니까, [Sir/Madame]. 갓 구운 맛있는 빵 어떠십니까? 아니면 맛있는 케이크 한 조각은요?

english: No thank you.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 당신이 내 물건 훔쳐 간 그 사람이지!

english: Guardsguards!
Let's see what you have.
No thank you.
You've tried the rest, but how about the best? Our baked goods won't be beaten!
translation: 다른 데는 다 가 보셨다고요? 그럼 이제 최고를 맛보실 차례! 저희 빵은 어디에도 지지 않습니다!

english: Let's see what you have.
I'm good.
Hmph!
I'm good.
Humans!
Destroy them! Our king must be freed!
translation: 놈들을 쳐부숴라! 우리 왕을 풀어 드려야 한다!

english: It will be done.
With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!
translation: [Fremennik name], 나를 따르라! 이 더러운 짐승들을 쓸어버리자!

english: At long last, I have been granted freedom. You have done well Bakuna.
I exist to serve.
Good, for I have one final use of you. My long rest has weakened me, you will grant me strength.
translation: 좋다. 네게 마지막으로 쓸 데가 하나 남았으니. 긴 잠으로 나는 약해졌다. 네가 내게 힘을 바쳐라.

english: The Jormungand kills Bakuna in one hit
Power!
This isn't over yet [Fremennik name], the Jormungand is weak from his imprisonment! We can still stop him!
translation: 아직 끝나지 않았다, [Fremennik name]! the Jormungand(요르문간드)는 갇혀 있던 탓에 약해졌다! 아직 막을 수 있어!

english: Humans, you have been bestowed with a great honour, for you are about to become the first of your kind in millennia to feed my power!
translation: 인간들아, 너희는 크나큰 영광을 받았노라. 수천 년 만에 처음으로 너희 종족이 내 힘의 양분이 될 테니!

english: Rejoice with me, for your miserable lives are finally at an end!
translation: 나와 함께 기뻐하라. 너희의 비참한 삶이 마침내 끝나는 것이니!

english: You will not defeat us this day! Come [Fremennik name]!
translation: 오늘 우리는 지지 않는다! 가자, [Fremennik name]!

english: Get out of this village. You are not welcome here.
translation: 이 마을에서 꺼져. 여긴 너 같은 놈 반기는 데가 아니야.

english: So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you, kind [sir/lady]!
translation: 네가 Azzanadra(아자나드라)를 감옥에서 풀어 준 그 사람이냐? 고맙다, 친절한 [sir/lady]!

english: Time to die, Saradominist filth!
Prepare to suffer, Zamorakian scum!
You chose the wrong place to start trouble!
You dare steal from me?
Hello.
What do you want?
Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 별건 아니에요. 이 마을에 처음 와서 동네 사람들이랑 친해지고 싶었어요.

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: 잡담할 시간 없어. 우리랑 할 거래가 생기면 다시 와.

english: You dog! You killed our champion and for that you will die!
translation: 이 개자식! 우리 챔피언을 죽였으니 너도 죽어야겠다!

english: Hello.
Stuff for sale. You buying?
No? 'Bye then.
Yes
No
Gggggrrrrrrrrr!!!
Yes?
Who are you?
Banisoch.
Thanks, that was informative.
It leads to the caves beneath this part of the island. I think there's dragons at the other end; you can hear the noises and smell the smoke coming up the passage.
translation: 이 섬 이쪽 아래에 있는 동굴로 이어지지. 반대편 끝에 드래곤이 있는 것 같아. 통로로 소리도 들리고 연기 냄새도 올라오거든.

english: Can I go down?
Eh, I could sort something out for you. Thing is, my brother's got a job guarding the main entrance to the caves. I'd be undercutting him if I let people go down this hole.
translation: 음, 어떻게 해 줄 수는 있지. 문제는 내 형이 동굴 정문 지키는 일을 한다는 거야. 내가 이 구멍으로 사람들을 내려보내면 형 밥그릇을 뺏는 셈이지.

english: Oh, does this mean you won't let me go in?
translation: 아, 그럼 안 들여보내 주신다는 거예요?

english: No, it means I'd need something to assuage my conscience after betraying my brother. 5,000 trading sticks ought to cheer me up nicely.
translation: 아니, 형을 배신한 내 양심을 달래 줄 뭔가가 필요하다는 거지. trading sticks(교역 막대) 5,000개면 기분이 꽤 나아질 것 같은데.

english: Oh.
It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
Um, no thanks.
Never mind.
Never mind.
I'll leave you alone.
Can I climb down that hole now?
Yes, you've paid, you can climb down there whenever you like. Go, go.
translation: 그래, 돈 냈잖아. 내려가고 싶을 때 언제든 내려가. 가, 가.

english: Why are you waiting by this hole?
translation: 왜 이 구멍 옆에서 기다리고 있어요?

english: Ever seen a toilet around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 화장실 본 적 있어?

english: Actually, never mind.
Hey, I didn't say you could do that!
translation: 야, 그거 해도 된다고 한 적 없다!

english: Either go down it or don't go down it, but stop messing around with it!
translation: 내려가든지 말든지 하고, 그걸로 장난 좀 그만 쳐!

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this hole.
Can I go down?
It's a deal - here's 5,000 trading sticks.
Um, no thanks.
I'll leave you alone.
Can I climb down that hole now?
Why are you waiting by this hole?
translation: 왜 이 구멍 옆에서 기다리고 있어요?

english: Actually, never mind.
What are you doing here?
What does it look like I'm doing? I'm here to help cleanse the Devourer's corruption from this sacred place.
translation: 보면 모르겠나? 이 신성한 곳에서 Devourer(포식자)의 타락을 정화하는 일을 돕고 있지 않은가.

english: I didn't expect a camel to be capable of standing up to such a strong enemy. Aren't you worried for your safety?
translation: 낙타가 그렇게 강한 적에게 맞설 수 있을 줄은 몰랐어요. 안전이 걱정되지 않으세요?

english: Not particularly. We camels are known for our durability in harsh environments. I think you should be more concerned about yourself. You humans seem so much more fragile than many other species.
translation: 별로. 우리 낙타는 혹독한 환경에서도 잘 버티기로 유명하다네. 오히려 자네 걱정이나 하게. 자네들 인간은 다른 종족보다 훨씬 연약해 보이니 말일세.

english: I'm sure I'll be fine, but I appreciate your concern.
translation: 전 괜찮을 거예요. 그래도 걱정해 주셔서 고마워요.

english: How did you get all my stuff?
translation: 제 물건들을 다 어떻게 갖고 계신 거예요?

english: I don't have any of your stuff.
translation: 난 자네 물건 같은 건 하나도 갖고 있지 않네.

english: Oh yeah, I don't use a bank!
translation: 아, 맞다. 저 은행 안 쓰죠!

english: Good for you.
Don't you understand how banking works? I don't have all of your stuff, I have simply been trained to access the place where it is all stored.
translation: 은행이 어떻게 돌아가는지 모르는 겐가? 내가 자네 물건을 다 갖고 있는 게 아니라, 그게 전부 보관된 곳에 접근하는 훈련을 받았을 뿐일세.

english: But you're a camel. I didn't know camels could train to become bankers.
translation: 그래도 낙타잖아요. 낙타가 은행원이 되는 훈련을 받을 수 있는 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Well there are ghost bankers, gnome bankers, dwarf bankers, goblin bankers and more! Is it really all that surprising that camels can do it too?
translation: 유령 은행원, 노움 은행원, 드워프 은행원, 고블린 은행원 등등 얼마든지 있지 않은가! 낙타가 한다고 해서 그리 놀랄 일인가?

english: I suppose when you put it like that...
So, what do you make of all this?
translation: 그래서, 이 모든 일을 어떻게 생각하세요?

english: What do you mean?
I mean everything that's been going on here. It seems like a lot to take in.
translation: 여기서 벌어지고 있는 모든 일 말이에요. 한 번에 받아들이기엔 너무 많은 것 같아서요.

english: Well, it really was inevitable, which is a shame really. It saddens me to see what has happened to this tomb.
translation: 글쎄, 정말 피할 수 없는 일이었지. 그래서 더 안타깝고. 이 무덤이 이렇게 된 걸 보니 마음이 아프군.

english: Well at least we're fixing it now.
We? Are you sure about that? I find you adventurers often have ulterior motives.
translation: 우리? 정말 그런가? 내가 보기에 자네 같은 모험가들은 대개 속셈이 따로 있더군.

english: What do you mean by that?
You may say that you are here to fight the corruption. Indeed, there may be some truth to that. However, would you really be here if there wasn't something for you to gain?
translation: 자네는 타락과 싸우러 왔다고 하겠지. 실제로 어느 정도는 사실일 수도 있고. 하지만 얻을 게 없었다면 정말 여기 왔겠나?

english: I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: 맹세해요, 전 오직 Devourer(포식자)의 타락을 처리하러 온 거예요!

english: I hear you speak those words, but I feel no conviction behind them.
translation: 말은 들리네만, 그 말에서 확신은 느껴지지 않는군.

english: How can I prove it to you? What is it that you are looking for?
translation: 어떻게 증명하면 돼요? 원하시는 게 뭔데요?

english: Why do you care what opinions a camel has of you?
translation: 낙타 따위가 자네를 어떻게 보든 왜 신경 쓰나?

english: I want everyone to like me.
If your only goal in life is to be liked by all, then you'll probably spend the rest of it chasing the impossible.
translation: 모두에게 사랑받는 게 인생의 유일한 목표라면, 남은 인생 내내 불가능한 걸 좇게 될 걸세.

english: I want to prove you wrong.
So you only care because my words cut close to the bone? If you truly want to prove me wrong, then it's your outlook that should change.
translation: 그러니까 내 말이 정곡을 찔러서 신경 쓰인다는 건가? 정말 내가 틀렸다는 걸 증명하고 싶다면, 바뀌어야 할 건 자네의 시각일세.

english: It seems to be important to you.
You think so?
I do, so tell me, what can I do to show you that not all adventurers are the same?
translation: 네. 그러니까 말해 주세요. 모든 모험가가 다 똑같지 않다는 걸 보여 드리려면 제가 뭘 하면 될까요?

english: Hmm...
Every adventurer seems to destroy without any thought as to what they are doing, nor with any intent to restore what was lost.
translation: 모험가들은 하나같이 자기가 뭘 하는지 생각도 없이 부수기만 하고, 잃어버린 걸 되돌리려는 생각은 조금도 없더군.

english: If you can do that, then that would prove to me that you are infact different from the rest.
translation: 자네가 그걸 해낸다면, 자네가 정말 다른 이들과 다르다는 증거가 되겠지.

english: Restore what was lost? What do you mean by that?
translation: 잃어버린 걸 되돌린다고요? 그게 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: That's for you to figure out.
What did you ask me to do again?
So you want me to restore what was lost?
Indeed.
I believe I understand now.
Oh? Do tell.

Well, while us adventurers have been doing our best to fight against the Devourer's corruption, we've been neglecting what has been lost to achieve that goal. Namely, the four guardians we defeated along the way.
translation: 그러니까, 저희 모험가들은 Devourer(포식자)의 타락과 맞서 싸우느라 최선을 다했지만, 그 목표를 이루느라 잃어버린 것들은 외면하고 있었어요. 바로 저희가 도중에 쓰러뜨린 네 수호자들이요.

english: Ba-Ba was a proud baboon who wished for her troop to flourish. To honour her, I made sure that they won't be forgotten by telling their story to the monkeys of Ape Atoll.
translation: Ba-Ba(바바)는 자기 무리가 번성하길 바랐던 긍지 높은 개코원숭이였어요. 그녀를 기리기 위해, Ape Atoll(유인원 환초)의 원숭이들에게 그 무리의 이야기를 들려줘서 잊히지 않게 했어요.

english: Akkha was cruelly denied death by the Devourer, so I gave his ashes to the High Priest of Icthlarin to give him a proper send-off.
translation: Akkha(아카)는 Devourer(포식자) 때문에 잔인하게도 죽음조차 허락받지 못했어요. 그래서 그의 재를 High Priest of Icthlarin(익스라린의 대사제)에게 드려서 제대로 보내 드리게 했어요.

english: Zebak was fooled into leaving his home and confined within the tomb, so I took his fang and buried it on an island surrounded by crocodiles.
translation: Zebak(제박)은 속아서 고향을 떠나 무덤 안에 갇혔어요. 그래서 그의 송곳니를 가져다 악어로 둘러싸인 섬에 묻어 줬어요.

english: Kephri was promised a future for her race, but it was all a lie. I found a scarab egg within some of her dung, and I gave it to the High Priest of Scabaras to try and nurture it.
translation: Kephri(케프리)는 자기 종족의 미래를 약속받았지만, 다 거짓말이었어요. 그녀의 똥 속에서 스카라브 알을 찾아서, 키워 달라고 High Priest of Scabaras(스카바라스의 대사제)에게 드렸어요.

english: Well well, colour me impressed adventurer. It seems that you do care after all.
translation: 허허, 이거 감탄했네, 모험가. 자네도 정말 신경을 쓰고 있었군그래.

english: It's a shame that much of the damage cannot truly be undone, but I know that Het, Apmeken, Crondis and even Scabaras will be grateful for your actions.
translation: 입은 피해 대부분을 정말로 되돌릴 수는 없다는 게 안타깝지만, Het(헤트), Apmeken(앱메켄), Crondis(크론디스), 그리고 Scabaras(스카바라스)마저도 자네가 한 일에 고마워할 걸세.

english: I just wish there was more I could do.
translation: 제가 더 할 수 있는 게 있으면 좋을 텐데요.

english: We always do, but you have still done more than most.
translation: 누구나 그렇게 바라지. 그래도 자네는 대부분보다 많은 일을 해냈네.

english: Now, I have something for you. I've been looking for someone worthy enough to pass this on to.
translation: 자, 자네에게 줄 것이 있네. 이걸 물려줄 만한 자격 있는 이를 오래 찾고 있었지.

english: A key? What's this for?
I'll leave that as another puzzle for you to solve.
translation: 그건 자네가 풀어야 할 또 하나의 수수께끼로 남겨 두지.

english: Well thanks, I guess... You know, out of all the camels I've met, you're definitely the strangest one.
translation: 음, 고맙긴 한데요... 있잖아요, 제가 만나 본 낙타 중에 당신이 확실히 제일 별나요.

english: Well, it does take a special kind of camel to master the portal magic used for bank access.
translation: 뭐, 은행 접근에 쓰는 포털 마법을 익히려면 꽤 특별한 낙타여야 하니까 말일세.

english: I've lost that key you gave me.
And it conveniently found its way back to me. Try not to lose it this time.
translation: 그리고 마침 그게 내게 돌아왔지. 이번엔 잃어버리지 않도록 하게.

english: Do you have a name?
My name is my own, adventurer. It's hardly important right now.
translation: 내 이름은 내 것일세, 모험가. 지금 그게 중요한 건 아니지 않나.

english: I suppose you've earned the right to know. My name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 자네라면 알 자격이 있겠지. 내 이름은 Cam the Camel(낙타 캠)일세.

english: Well, nice to meet you, Cam the Camel. It'll be nice to call you something other than 'the bank camel' from now on.
translation: 그럼 반가워요, 낙타 캠. 이제 '은행 낙타' 말고 다른 이름으로 부를 수 있겠네요.

english: I'm glad I met a kind adventurer such as yourself. I look forward to seeing you continue your diligent work in cleansing this tomb of the Devourer's corruption.
translation: 자네처럼 친절한 모험가를 만나 기쁘네. 앞으로도 이 무덤에서 Devourer(포식자)의 타락을 성실히 씻어 내는 모습을 기대하겠네.

english: As I said, my name is Cam the Camel.
translation: 말했듯이, 내 이름은 Cam the Camel(낙타 캠)일세.

english: Can you follow me into the tomb?
translation: 무덤 안까지 따라와 주실 수 있어요?

english: Why would I want to do that?
It would be very helpful. Think of all the supplies I'd have access to if you came with me and followed me around like a portable bank.
translation: 그러면 정말 도움이 될 거예요. 당신이 걸어 다니는 은행처럼 저를 따라다녀 주면 쓸 수 있는 보급품이 얼마나 많을지 생각해 보세요.

english: But you don't even use a bank.
translation: 하지만 자네는 은행도 안 쓰지 않나.

english: Oh yeah! I forgot.
Right...
What do you take me for? Some kind of pack yak?
translation: 날 뭘로 보는 겐가? 짐 나르는 야크라도 되는 줄 아나?

english: Besides, if I leave this place then I won't be able to help any other adventurers with their banking needs.
translation: 게다가 내가 여길 떠나면 은행 일이 필요한 다른 모험가들을 도울 수가 없네.

english: I need to get going.
Suit yourself.
Bleh, this grain is disgusting! Do you think I am but a simple cow, adventurer?
translation: 퉤, 이 곡물은 역겹군! 내가 한낱 소인 줄 아는가, 모험가?

english: No, no, I was just...
This is why I eat the grain in that sack over there. It's specially grown out here in the desert. Once harvested, it goes through a preparation process of several years that...
translation: 그래서 내가 저기 저 sack(자루)에 든 곡물을 먹는 걸세. 여기 사막에서 특별히 키운 거지. 수확한 뒤에도 몇 년에 걸친 손질 과정을 거치는데...

english: The bank camel talks at length about the process of producing such fine grain...
translation: 은행 낙타가 이렇게 좋은 곡물을 만드는 과정에 대해 한참 동안 늘어놓는다...

english: ...and that's why this grain is so special. Not to mention so hard to come by.
translation: ...그래서 이 곡물이 특별하다는 걸세. 구하기 어렵다는 건 말할 것도 없고.

english: My, this is some good grain, adventurer! Great flavour profile, not too salty and with just a hint of sweetness. It almost reminds me of...
translation: 이야, 이거 좋은 곡물이군, 모험가! 풍미가 훌륭해. 너무 짜지도 않고 단맛이 살짝 감돌지. 꼭 그때가 떠오르는...

english: The bank camel looks at you for a moment as if lost in thought.
translation: 은행 낙타가 생각에 잠긴 듯 잠시 당신을 바라본다.

english: Erm, yes?
Oh, never mind, I was just thinking about something.
translation: 아, 아무것도 아닐세. 잠깐 생각할 게 있어서.

english: The bank camel stares at you in silence for an uncomfortably long time.
translation: 은행 낙타가 불편할 만큼 오랫동안 말없이 당신을 빤히 쳐다본다.

english: Well, I can't stand around here all day. I've got some things I need to take care of.
translation: 음, 여기 하루 종일 서 있을 순 없겠네요. 처리할 일이 좀 있어서요.

english: The bank camel looks at you with piqued interest, then rolls their eyes as they realise you can't understand them.
translation: 은행 낙타가 흥미롭다는 듯 당신을 보다가, 당신이 자기 말을 알아듣지 못한다는 걸 깨닫고는 눈을 굴린다.

english: Quite the banana you have there! Ba-Ba and her baboon troop were always known for finding the biggest of these. It's a shame that their memory will now disappear into history.
translation: banana(바나나)가 아주 훌륭하군! Ba-Ba(바바)와 그녀의 개코원숭이 무리는 늘 제일 큰 바나나를 찾아내기로 유명했지. 이제 그들에 대한 기억도 역사 속으로 사라지겠군, 안타까운 일이야.

english: Ah, the fang of the mighty Zebak. What a cruel fate to be consumed by ever-lasting hunger.
translation: 아, 위대한 Zebak(제박)의 fang(송곳니)이로군. 영원히 끝나지 않는 굶주림에 먹혀 버리다니, 참으로 잔인한 운명일세.

english: Ah, the ashes of Akkha, a great warrior. It's a shame that his soul never got to experience the release of death.
translation: 아, 위대한 전사 Akkha(아카)의 ashes(재)로군. 그의 영혼이 죽음의 안식을 끝내 누리지 못했다니 안타까운 일일세.

english: Faeces! How lovely. If I'm not mistaken, this dung is from Kephri herself, last of the dawn scarabs. It's a shame that her kind have long been lost to the world.
translation: 똥이로군! 이거 근사하구먼. 내 눈이 틀리지 않았다면, 이건 새벽 스카라브의 마지막 생존자인 Kephri(케프리)의 dung(똥)일세. 그녀의 종족이 세상에서 사라진 지 오래라니 안타깝군.

english: You go to search the sack, but the bank camel glares at you menacingly and spits in your direction.
translation: sack(자루)를 뒤져 보려 하자, 은행 낙타가 당신을 험악하게 노려보며 당신 쪽으로 침을 뱉는다.

english: Hey, get your hands off my food! Unless you'd like me to start eating the contents of your bank instead!
translation: 이봐, 내 먹이에서 손 떼게! 내가 자네 은행에 든 물건부터 먹어 치우길 바라는 게 아니라면 말일세!

english: Jokes on you! I don't have a bank!
translation: 그래 봤자 헛수고예요! 전 은행이 없거든요!

english: Well I hope you're very proud of yourself. Your arbitrary restrictions don't make you better than everyone else, you know.
translation: 그래, 참 자랑스럽겠군. 자네가 제멋대로 정한 제약 따위가 자네를 남들보다 나은 사람으로 만들어 주진 않는다네.

english: Wow, that's harsh.
Wow! A needle in a hay sack?
Wait, isn't it supposed to be a stack, not a sack?
translation: 잠깐, 원래는 건초 자루가 아니라 건초 더미 아니었나?

english: And now that I think about it, this sack is full of grain, not hay...
translation: 그러고 보니 이 자루엔 건초가 아니라 곡물이 들어 있잖아...

english: Ah well, never mind.
It's just grain...
Well, I'm not entirely sure what else I expected.
translation: 음, 딴 걸 기대한 내가 이상하지.

english: What are you doing here?
How did you get all my stuff?
translation: 제 물건들을 다 어떻게 갖고 계신 거예요?

english: So, what do you make of all this?
translation: 그래서, 이 모든 일을 어떻게 생각하세요?

english: I swear, I'm only here to deal with the Devourer's corruption!
translation: 맹세해요, 전 오직 Devourer(포식자)의 타락을 처리하러 온 거예요!

english: I want everyone to like me.
I want to prove you wrong.
It seems to be important to you.
What did you ask me to do again?
I believe I understand now.
I've lost that key you gave me.
Do you have a name?
Can you follow me into the tomb?
translation: 무덤 안까지 따라와 주실 수 있어요?

english: I need to get going.
Yes?
Hello. Can I deposit my stuff here?
translation: 안녕하세요. 여기에 제 물건을 맡길 수 있나요?

english: No. I'm a security guard, not a bank clerk.
translation: 아니요. 저는 경비원이지 은행 서기가 아니에요.

english: That wall doesn't look very good.
translation: 저 벽, 상태가 별로 안 좋아 보이네요.

english: No, it doesn't.
Are you going to tell me what happened?
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 주실 건가요?

english: I could do.
Ok, go on!
Someone smashed the wall when they were robbing the bank.
translation: 누군가 은행을 털면서 벽을 부숴 버렸어요.

english: Someone's robbed the bank?
Yes.
But... was anyone hurt? Did they get anything valuable?
translation: 그런데... 다친 사람은 있었나요? 값진 걸 가져갔나요?

english: Yes, but we were able to get more staff and mend the wall easily enough.
translation: 네, 하지만 직원을 더 뽑고 벽도 어렵지 않게 고쳤어요.

english: The Bank has already replaced all the stolen items that belonged to customers.
translation: 은행은 도난당한 고객 물건을 이미 전부 보상했어요.

english: Oh, good... but the bank staff got hurt?
translation: 아, 다행이네요... 그런데 은행 직원들이 다쳤다고요?

english: Yes, but the new ones are just as good.
translation: 네, 하지만 새로 온 직원들도 그만큼 쓸 만해요.

english: You're not very nice, are you?
No-one's expecting me to be nice.
translation: 저한테 친절을 기대하는 사람은 아무도 없어요.

english: Anyway... So, someone's robbed the bank?
Do you know who did it?
We are fairly sure we know who the robber was. The security recording was damaged in the attack, but it still shows his face clearly enough.
translation: 강도가 누군지는 꽤 확실히 알고 있어요. 습격 때 보안 기록이 손상됐지만, 그래도 얼굴은 충분히 똑똑히 보이거든요.

english: You've got a security recording?
Yes. Our insurers insisted that we install a magical scrying orb.
translation: 네. 보험사에서 마법 scrying orb(점술 오브)를 설치하라고 고집했거든요.

english: Can I see the recording?
I suppose so. But it's quite long.
That's ok, show me the recording.
Alright... The bank's magical playback device will feed the recorded images into your mind. Just shut your eyes.
translation: 알겠어요... 은행의 마법 재생 장치가 기록된 영상을 당신 머릿속에 보내 줄 거예요. 눈만 감으세요.

english: You close your eyes and watch the recording...
Bank robbery recording plays
translation: 은행 강도 사건 기록 재생 중

english: End of recording.
Thanks, maybe another day.
Ok.
So who was the robber?
I can't disclose that information.
translation: 그 정보는 알려 드릴 수 없어요.

english: Alright, I'll stop bothering you now.
Good day, [sir/ma'am].
Sorry, I don't want anything.
Do you have any idea who robbed the bank yet?
translation: 은행을 턴 사람이 누군지 이제 짐작 가는 데가 있나요?

english: The robber in the recording looked familiar.
Oh, you recognised him too?
Yes, and I can tell you where he lives.
translation: 네, 그리고 그 사람이 어디 사는지도 알려 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Thanks, but we already know where to find our suspect.
translation: 고맙지만, 용의자를 어디서 찾을지는 이미 알고 있어요.

english: Yes, and he's admitted that he did the robbery!
translation: 네, 그리고 그 사람이 자기가 은행을 털었다고 자백했어요!

english: The amount of evidence against him makes that almost unnecessary.
translation: 그 사람한테 불리한 증거가 워낙 많아서 자백은 거의 필요도 없어요.

english: So are you going to have him arrested?
We're certainly keeping an eye on him. I'm afraid I can't give you any more details about the case.
translation: 확실히 감시는 하고 있어요. 안타깝지만 사건에 대해 더 자세히 말씀드릴 수는 없어요.

english: Fair enough.
Can I see that recording again, please?
translation: 그 기록을 다시 볼 수 있을까요?

english: I'd like you to pay me 50 gp first.
I'm not carrying that much.
Oh well, maybe another day.
As a bank employee, I suppose I could take the money directly from your bank account.
translation: 저도 은행 직원이니까, 당신 은행 계좌에서 바로 돈을 가져갈 수도 있겠네요.

english: Ok, you can take 50 gp from my bank account.
translation: 좋아요, 제 은행 계좌에서 50 gp를 가져가세요.

english: Ok, here's 50 gp.
Can I deposit my stuff here?
translation: 여기에 제 물건을 맡길 수 있나요?

english: That wall doesn't look very good.
translation: 저 벽, 상태가 별로 안 좋아 보이네요.

english: Alright, I'll stop bothering you now.
Are you going to tell me what happened?
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 주실 건가요?

english: Can I see the recording?
That's ok, show me the recording.
Thanks, maybe another day.
So who was the robber?
Sorry, I don't want anything.
The robber in the recording looked familiar.
Can I see that recording again, please?
translation: 그 기록을 다시 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Ok, you can take 50 gp from my bank account.
translation: 좋아요, 제 은행 계좌에서 50 gp를 가져가세요.

english: Ok, here's 50 gp.
Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
translation: 은행 칸을 40칸 단위로 최대 [number]칸까지 추가로 팔아 드릴 수 있어요. 몇 칸을 사시겠어요?

english: [number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
translation: 은행 칸 [number]칸을 추가로 사시려면 [number]코인이 들어요. 이 구매는 되돌릴 수 없으니 주의하세요. 진행하시겠어요?

english: Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: 아... 그만한 돈이 없는 것 같네요. 됐어요.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'm afraid not! You've already got as much bank space as you can obtain without purchase.
translation: 안타깝지만 안 돼요! 구매 없이 얻을 수 있는 은행 공간은 이미 다 얻으셨어요.

english: I'm not supposed to tell you this, but you can obtain more bank space by [setting up a PIN], [setting up an Authenticator] [or] [upgrading to a Jagex Account].
translation: 원래 말씀드리면 안 되는 건데, [setting up a PIN], [setting up an Authenticator] [or] [upgrading to a Jagex Account] 중 하나를 하시면 은행 공간을 더 얻을 수 있어요.

english: What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 여기는 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)의 지점이에요. 여러 마을에 지점이 있답니다.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 고객님의 물건과 돈을 맡아 드려요. 귀중품을 안전하게 지키고 싶으시면 저희에게 맡기세요.

english: Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 파티 룸에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있어요!

english: Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 지금 파티 룸에 값비싼 아이템이 있어요!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
[number] slots ([number] coins):
Yes.
No.
Do I have any other options for extra bank space?
translation: 은행 공간을 늘릴 다른 방법은 없나요?

english: (Cancel)
What is this place?
Hello, surface dweller! How can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 지상에서 오신 분! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: This is the Bank of Dorgesh-Kaan! Since surface dwellers began coming into the city, we've made an arrangement with the Bank of Gielinor on the surface, so we can act as one of their branches.
translation: 여기는 Bank of Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸 은행)이에요! 지상 사람들이 이 도시에 오기 시작한 뒤로, 지상의 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)과 협약을 맺어서 그쪽 지점 역할도 하고 있어요.

english: Hi there, can I help you with anything?
Is this a bank?
Why yes, what else would it be?
Anything else?
Do you get many customers?
We’re the only bank on these two islands, so business is pretty good.
translation: 이 두 섬에 은행은 저희뿐이라서 장사가 꽤 잘돼요.

english: I’d like to access my account, please.
I'd like to collect items.
Is this a bank?
Do you get many customers?
I’d like to access my account, please.
This is a branch of the Bank of Glielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 여기는 Bank of Glielinor(길리노르 은행)의 지점이에요. 여러 마을에 지점이 있답니다.

english: Oh great, another customer. What do you want?
translation: 아, 좋네, 손님이 또 왔군. 뭘 원해?

english: What are you doing out here?
I used to work in the East Varrock branch. Then a request came in to set up a bank in this new town.
translation: 원래 East Varrock(바록 동부) 지점에서 일했지. 그러다 이 새 마을에 은행을 차리라는 요청이 들어왔어.

english: The other clerks and myself pulled straws and I was unlucky enough to be sent to this stinking death trap.
translation: 다른 서기들이랑 제비뽑기를 했는데, 운 나쁘게 내가 이 냄새나는 죽음의 함정으로 오게 됐지.

english: Now I'm stuck here, ferrying items back and forth to the bank's safe in Varrock for people like you.
translation: 그래서 이젠 여기 처박혀서, 너 같은 사람들을 위해 Varrock(바록)에 있는 은행 금고까지 물건을 날라대고 있다고.

english: That doesn't sound very fun, but you're doing a great service for us adventurers.
translation: 재미는 없겠네요. 그래도 저희 모험가들한테는 정말 큰 도움을 주고 계세요.

english: Tell that to my back and legs, I'm exhausted from carrying all this junk back and forth.
translation: 그 말은 내 허리랑 다리한테나 해. 이 잡동사니를 왔다 갔다 나르느라 녹초가 됐으니까.

english: Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.
translation: 은행권을 줘 봐. 아이템으로 바꿔 줄 수 있나 볼 테니까.

english: Yes
What are you doing out here?
No
Welcome to the Keldagrim bank! Anything I can help you with?
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 은행에 오신 걸 환영해요! 뭐 도와드릴 일 있나요?

english: Are you with the Bank of Gielinor?
Oh yes, we are a branch, but an independent branch.
translation: 아, 그럼요. 지점이긴 한데, 독립 지점이에요.

english: We have liaised with the Bank of Gielinor. It's healthy to keep a bit of trade going with the human population, you know.
translation: Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)과 협력하고 있죠. 인간들과 교역을 좀 유지해 두는 게 건전하잖아요.

english: Was there something else you wanted?
Business has always gone well here, but now more than ever. We are getting a constant supply of gold from the new gold mine south of the city.
translation: 여기는 늘 장사가 잘됐지만, 요즘은 그 어느 때보다 잘돼요. 도시 남쪽에 새로 연 금광에서 금이 끊임없이 들어오거든요.

english: Oh yes, I helped to open that up you know!
translation: 아, 그거요, 제가 그 금광 여는 걸 도왔다고요!

english: Sure, sure.
Was there anything else I can help you with?
I'd like to access my bank account please.
Of course.
Naturally.
I'd like to collect items please.
Are you with the Bank of Gielinor?
How is business?
I'd like to access my bank account please.
I'd like to collect items please.
Aye? Ye got some stuff te stash?
This be a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Ye may have heard of us.
translation: 여긴 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행) 지점이다. 들어 본 적 있을 거다.

english: We keep an eye on yer loot for ye. Leave yer valuables with us if ye want to keep 'em nice and safe.
translation: 네 노획물은 우리가 지켜 주지. 귀중품을 안전하게 두고 싶으면 우리한테 맡겨.

english: There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!
