Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 무슨 작업이 필요하세요?

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Mahogany table(마호가니 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
translation: Mahogany drawer(마호가니 서랍장)을 하나 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대)를 하나 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany chairs built.
translation: Mahogany chairs(마호가니 의자) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가시기 전에 차 한 잔 드실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 맛있는 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: No thanks, I better be off.
Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Wanna fight?
Ah, you come for fight, ja?
You look funny.
Grrr!
What you want?
Go Away!
Hello.
Hah! What you want with me, little city man?
translation: 하! 나한테 뭐 원해, 꼬마 도시 남자?

english: Ha ha ha! Little Player wants to buy me a drink, how sweet.
translation: 하하하! 꼬마 Player가 나한테 술 사겠다고 한다, 귀엽다.

english: Well... how about it?
You not talk like barbarian man. You certainly not smell like barbarian man! But I think I give you test anyway.
translation: 너 야만인 남자처럼 말 안 한다. 야만인 남자 냄새도 확실히 안 난다! 그래도 시험은 내 줄 거다.

english: What's the test?
Back in village to the west, we barbarians scream our defiance as we fight. We scream 'YYEEEEEAAARRRRGGHHHH!!!' Can you do this?
translation: 서쪽 마을에서 우리 야만인들 싸울 때 함성 지른다. 우리 '이야아아아아아아르르르르그흐흐흐!!!' 소리 지른다. 너 이거 할 수 있나?

english: YYEEEEEAAARRRRGGHHHH!!!
Yyeeeeeaaarrrrgghhhh!!!
Ha ha ha! Little Player cannot yell like barbarian. Also, I strong barbarian woman; I get my own drink. Run away now, little Player.
translation: 하하하! 꼬마 Player 야만인처럼 못 지른다. 그리고 나 강한 야만인 여자다. 내 술은 내가 산다. 이제 도망가라, 꼬마 Player.

english: Ha ha ha! We fight anytime you like.
Ha ha ha! I not interested in talking to soft city man who not know what he want.
translation: 하하하! 자기가 뭘 원하는지도 모르는 물렁한 도시 남자랑은 말 안 한다.

english: The barbarians probably don't like people messing with their barrels.
translation: 야만인들은 남이 자기 통을 건드리는 걸 좋아하지 않을 것 같다.

english: Oi - That's ours!
Can I buy you a drink?
Can I fight you?
Um...
Flee puny mortals!
Oh no!
Ahhhh!
I don't want to die!
Help!
No, please!
Not today!
Somebody help!
The patrons flee momentarily, and then calm down.
Yaaaay!
Woooooooo!
Boogie Woogie!
Paarrttyyyyyy!
The monastery is saved!
Well done [player name] and Iffie!
What a lovely pub this is!
Isn't it just.
Alfred's the name, Bartending's the game.
Pleasure.
Wait a minute, Bar. Alfred.
*Alfred chuckles*
Oh my, you're Alfred Grimhand?!
My barcrawl is still used to this day?
translation: 내 술집 순례가 아직도 쓰인단 말인가?

english: It's legendary.
Originally it was a funny prank back in the day for new recruits.
translation: 원래는 옛날에 신병들 골려 주려고 만든 장난이었다네.

english: They seem to take it very seriously now.
Ha Ha, amazing.
I do miss that bunch of barbs...
You see a tear come from Alfred's eye. Then he swiftly wipes it away.
translation: 알프레드의 눈에서 눈물 한 방울이 흐른다. 그는 재빨리 그것을 닦아 낸다.

english: Shall we have a drink?
Absolutely.
Light beer
Eggnog
Mulled pine
Have a splendid day [player name]!
Oi, whaddya want?
I want to come through this gate.
Barbarians only. Are you a barbarian? You don't look like one.
translation: 야만인만 들어갈 수 있어. 너 야만인이야? 그렇게는 안 보이는데.

english: Hmm, yep you've got me there.
Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian.
translation: 겉모습만 보고는 모르는 법이죠. 사실 저 야만인이에요.

english: If you're a barbarian you need to be able to drink like one. We barbarians like a good drink.
translation: 야만인이라면 야만인처럼 마실 줄 알아야지. 우리 야만인들은 술을 좋아하거든.

english: I have the perfect challenge for you... The Alfred Grimhand Barcrawl! First completed by Alfred Grimhand.
translation: 너한테 딱 맞는 도전이 있어... 바로 Alfred Grimhand Barcrawl(알프레드 그림핸드의 술집 순례)! 알프레드 그림핸드가 처음 완주했지.

english: The guard hands you a Barcrawl card.
translation: 경비병이 Barcrawl card(술집 순례 카드)를 건넨다.

english: Take that card to each of the bars named on it. The bartenders will know what it means. We're kinda well known.
translation: 그 카드를 들고 거기 적힌 술집을 전부 돌아. 바텐더들은 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알 거야. 우리가 좀 유명하거든.

english: They'll give you their strongest drink and sign your card. When you've done all that, we'll be happy to let you in.
translation: 제일 독한 술을 주고 카드에 서명해 줄 거야. 그걸 다 하고 나면 기꺼이 들여보내 주지.

english: I want some money.
Do I look like a bank to you?
So, how's the Barcrawl coming along?
I haven't finished it yet.
Well come back when you have, you lightweight.
translation: 그럼 다 하고 다시 와, 술도 약한 녀석아.

english: I've lost my barcrawl card...
What are you like? You're gonna have to start all over now.
translation: 너 대체 왜 그래? 이제 처음부터 다시 해야 돼.

english: I tink I jusht 'bout done dem all... but I losht count...
translation: 다 마신 거 가타요... 근데 몇 군데 갔는지 까머거써요...

english: Yep that seems fine, you can come in now. I never learned to read, but you look like you’ve drunk plenty. Also, one more thing…
translation: 그래, 괜찮아 보이네. 이제 들어와도 돼. 난 글을 읽을 줄 모르지만, 너 꽤 많이 마신 것 같거든. 그리고, 하나 더…

english: Since you drink like a barbarian, I can show you how to smash your vials when you finish them. Do you want to do that?
translation: 너도 야만인처럼 마시니까, 다 마신 약병을 깨부수는 법을 알려 줄 수 있어. 해 볼래?

english: Yes please, I want to smash my vials.
It’s all part of drinking like a barbarian! Okay, you will now smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: 그게 다 야만인처럼 마시는 법이지! 좋아, 이제부터 물약을 마시면 약병을 깨부수게 될 거야.

english: No thank you, I'd rather keep my vials.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 약병은 그냥 갖고 있을래요.

english: 'Ello friend. I see you're drinking like a barbarian - do you want to stop smashing your vials when you finish them?
translation: 어이, 친구. 보아하니 야만인처럼 마시고 있군 - 다 마신 약병을 그만 깨부수고 싶어?

english: Yes please, I want to stop smashing my vials.
translation: 네, 약병 깨부수는 걸 그만두고 싶어요.

english: You're a funny sort of barbarian! But okay, you will no longer smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: 너 참 별난 야만인이네! 뭐 좋아, 이제 물약을 마셔도 약병을 깨부수지 않을 거야.

english: No thank you, I like smashing them.
That's a proper barbarian spirit, that is.
'Ello friend. Do you want me to show you how to smash your vials when you finish drinking them?
translation: 어이, 친구. 다 마신 약병을 깨부수는 법 알려 줄까?

english: It's all part of drinking like a barbarian! Okay, you will now smash your vials as you drink your potions.
translation: 그게 다 야만인처럼 마시는 법이지! 좋아, 이제부터 물약을 마시면 약병을 깨부수게 될 거야.

english: I want to come through this gate.
Hmm, yep you've got me there.
Looks can be deceiving, I am in fact a barbarian.
translation: 겉모습만 보고는 모르는 법이죠. 사실 저 야만인이에요.

english: I want some money.
Yes please, I want to smash my vials.
No thank you, I’d rather keep my vials.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 약병은 그냥 갖고 있을래요.

english: Yes please, I want to stop smashing my vials.
translation: 네, 약병 깨부수는 걸 그만두고 싶어요.

english: No thank you, I like smashing them.
No thank you, I'd rather keep my vials.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 약병은 그냥 갖고 있을래요.

english: Hey there. What are you lot doing out here?
translation: 안녕하세요. 여러분은 여기서 뭘 하고 있어요?

english: We're from the College of Bards in Tempestus. We thought we'd set up camp here to do some performances for anyone travelling through the savannah.
translation: 저희는 Tempestus(템페스투스)의 College of Bards(음유시인 학교)에서 왔어요. 사바나를 지나는 여행자들에게 공연을 보여 주려고 여기 야영지를 차렸죠.

english: With the kingdom now open to tourists, we've had plenty of new fans!
translation: 왕국이 관광객에게 문을 연 뒤로 새 팬이 정말 많이 생겼어요!

english: Nice trumpet.
Thanks! I made it myself. The College of Bards insist that we all have the ability to create and maintain our own instruments. I'm quite proud of what I came up with!
translation: 고마워요! 제가 직접 만들었거든요. College of Bards(음유시인 학교)에서는 누구나 자기 악기를 직접 만들고 관리할 줄 알아야 한대요. 제가 만든 게 꽤 자랑스러워요!

english: Well I hope it serves you well.
Hey there.
Think you've got what it takes to join the College of Bards?
translation: College of Bards(음유시인 학교)에 들어올 자질이 있다고 생각해요?

english: I'm not sure.
Well it only takes a lifetime of practice, so maybe give it a go one day.
translation: 뭐, 평생 연습하면 되는 일이니까 언젠가 한번 도전해 봐요.

english: Ah! Outerlander! Do not interrupt me in my business! I must cull these fiends!
translation: 아! 외지인이로군! 내 일을 방해하지 마시오! 이 괴물들을 처단해야 하오!

english: What are you doing down here?
Only an outerlander would ask such a question! Is it not obvious what I am doing?
translation: 그런 질문은 외지인이나 하는 법이지! 내가 무엇을 하는지 보면 모르겠소?

english: I kill the daggermouths for glory and for sport! When I have had my fill, I move on to the daggermouths' lair!
translation: 나는 영광과 즐거움을 위해 단검주둥이들을 베고 있소! 실컷 베고 나면 단검주둥이들의 소굴로 쳐들어갈 것이오!

english: Erm... okay then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 어... 알겠어요. 그럼 하던 일 계속하세요.

english: I do not trust you outerlander, I will not accept your gifts, no matter what your intention...
translation: 외지인, 나는 그대를 믿지 않소. 그대의 의도가 무엇이든 그대의 선물은 받지 않겠소...

english: Hello there Bardur. How's it going?
I have been here all the long day, slaughtering the daggermouth spawns so that none may pass!
translation: 나는 종일 여기서 단검주둥이 새끼들을 베어 넘겨, 단 한 놈도 지나가지 못하게 막고 있었소!

english: My sword arm grows weary, and the blood of my foes hangs heavy upon my clothing!
translation: 검을 쥔 팔은 지쳐 가고, 적들의 피가 내 옷에 무겁게 배어 있소!

english: Can you tell me anything about the caves down here?
translation: 여기 아래 동굴에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Aye, that I can [Fremennik Name]! Yonder lies the lair of the daggermouth kings, the three beasts of legend!
translation: 물론이오, [Fremennik Name]! 저 너머에 단검주둥이 왕들, 전설 속 세 마리 괴수의 소굴이 있소!

english: I train my skills upon its foul brood, to prepare myself for the fight ahead!
translation: 나는 그 더러운 새끼들을 상대로 기술을 갈고닦으며 다가올 결전에 대비하고 있소!

english: Okay, thanks Bardur. Do you have any food with you?
translation: 알겠어요, 고마워요 Bardur(바르두르). 혹시 먹을 것 좀 갖고 계세요?

english: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik Name]?
translation: 아, 준비도 없이 왔단 말이오, [Fremennik Name]?

english: I have nothing to spare, but my equipment grows weaker under the onslaught of the dagger-mouth spawns!
translation: 내게도 남는 것은 없소. 게다가 단검주둥이 새끼들의 맹공에 내 장비도 점점 약해지고 있소!

english: I will trade you a finely cooked shark if you have a replacement for my helm, my shield or my blade...
translation: 내 투구나 방패, 검을 대신할 것을 가져온다면 잘 구운 shark(상어)와 바꿔 주겠소...

english: Give me any equipment you wish to trade, and I will pay you a shark for it.
translation: 바꾸고 싶은 장비를 아무거나 내게 주시오. 그 대가로 shark(상어)를 주겠소.

english: Ah, just what I was looking for! You wish to trade me that for a cooked shark?
translation: 아, 바로 내가 찾던 것이오! 그것을 구운 상어와 바꾸겠소?

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik Name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall! (Fremennik item gets replaced by a cooked shark.)
translation: 아, 이것은 예비용으로 요긴하게 쓰겠소! 고맙소, [Fremennik Name]. 언젠가 Rellekka(렐레카) 장회당에서 영광스러운 전투의 노래를 함께 부를 날이 오리라 믿소! (프레메닉 아이템이 구운 상어로 바뀐다.)

english: As you wish, [Fremennik Name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 원하는 대로 하시오, [Fremennik Name]. 내 무기는 지금껏 버텨 왔으니, 아직은 이것들을 믿겠소.

english: No [Fremennik Name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
translation: 아니오, [Fremennik Name]. 내 잘 구운 상어는 믿음직한 Fremennik blade(프레메닉 검)이나 튼튼한 Fremennik helm(프레메닉 투구), 혹은 강인한 Fremennik shield(프레메닉 방패)와만 바꾸겠소...

english: I have no interest in that... thing... you are trying to offload on me.
translation: 그대가 내게 떠넘기려는 그... 물건에는 관심 없소.

english: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!
translation: 아! 추방자로군! 이 새끼 괴물들과 같은 꼴을 당하기 전에 썩 꺼지시오!

english: Fine. I was going anyway.
Bardur, wait! I'm here with a task from the Chieftain.
translation: Bardur(바르두르), 잠깐만요! 족장님이 맡긴 일 때문에 왔어요.

english: I'm not too certain I should trust you! What is it you want?
translation: 그대를 믿어야 할지 잘 모르겠소! 원하는 게 무엇이오?

english: I'm looking to remake V's Shield, but I require a Fremennik Shield from a warrior. Where could I find one?
translation: V's Shield(V의 방패)를 다시 만들려고 하는데, 전사가 쓰던 Fremennik Shield(프레메닉 방패)가 필요해요. 어디서 구할 수 있을까요?

english: The daggermouths found in these caves should drop a few when slain. They take them from fallen warriors. I have a few myself, in fact. I wish to give them back to the families of the fallen.
translation: 이 동굴의 단검주둥이들을 처치하면 몇 개 떨어뜨릴 것이오. 놈들이 쓰러진 전사들에게서 빼앗아 간 것이지. 사실 나도 몇 개 갖고 있소. 쓰러진 이들의 가족에게 돌려주고 싶어서 말이오.

english: These fledgelings won't drop anything you're looking for, though. Search the caves for some matured daggermouths.
translation: 하지만 이 새끼들은 그대가 찾는 것을 떨어뜨리지 않소. 동굴을 뒤져 다 자란 단검주둥이들을 찾아보시오.

english: Thanks for your time, Bardur.
You're lucky I'm busy exile! Things might have been different if I wasn't...
translation: 내가 바빠서 운 좋은 줄 아시오, 추방자! 바쁘지 않았다면 사정이 달랐을 것이오...

english: Maybe I could buy one off you?
I don't have that much.
Be gone with you then!
Sounds good to me.
(player loses 150k, gains a fremennik shield)
Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.
translation: 내가 그대를 잘못 본 모양이오, 추방자. 그대의 모험에 행운이 함께하길 바라오.

english: That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: 너무 비싸요. 그 돈은 못 내요!

english: Well I wouldn't expect an exile like you to care about the fallen. Be gone with you!
translation: 하긴, 그대 같은 추방자가 쓰러진 이들을 신경 쓸 리 없지. 썩 꺼지시오!

english: Exile, has that shield served you well?
Yes, thank you.
All the best, exile.
I lost it.
Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!
translation: 물건을 그렇게 다룬다면 다시는 못 주오! 또 갖고 싶으면 단검주둥이들을 직접 베어야 할 것이오!

english: Okay...
Listen, [Fremennik Name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.
translation: 들으시오, [Fremennik Name]. 그대가 추방자였을 때 내가 했던 행동은 미안하오. 이 Bardur(바르두르)는 외지인 앞에서 날이 서는 편이라오.

english: Don't worry about it, I understand! All's well that ends well! How've you been?
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요, 이해해요! 끝이 좋으면 다 좋은 거죠! 그동안 어떻게 지내셨어요?

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik name] Dräpare, I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
translation: 아, 이것은 예비용으로 요긴하게 쓰겠소! 고맙소, [Fremennik name] Dräpare. 언젠가 Rellekka(렐레카) 장회당에서 영광스러운 전투의 노래를 함께 부를 날이 오리라 믿소!

english: As you wish, [Fremennik name] DräpareMy weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 원하는 대로 하시오, [Fremennik name] Dräpare. 내 무기는 지금껏 버텨 왔으니, 아직은 이것들을 믿겠소.

english: YES
NO
Thanks for your time, Bardur.
Maybe I could buy one off you?
Sounds good to me.
That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: 너무 비싸요. 그 돈은 못 내요!

english: Hello there.
Oh! Hello there.
Who are you?
My name is Ex Sea Captain Barfy Bill.
translation: 내 이름은 전직 선장 Barfy Bill(뱃멀미 빌)이오.

english: Ex sea captain?
Yeah, I bought a lovely ship and was planning to make a fortune running her as a merchant vessel.
translation: 그렇소, 근사한 배를 한 척 사서 상선으로 굴려 한밑천 잡을 생각이었지.

english: Why are you not still sailing?
Chronic sea sickness. My first, and only, voyage was spent dry heaving over the rails.
translation: 고질적인 뱃멀미 때문이지. 처음이자 마지막 항해 내내 난간에 매달려 헛구역질만 했다오.

english: If I had known about the sea sickness I could have saved myself a lot of money.
translation: 뱃멀미가 있는 줄 알았으면 돈을 엄청 아꼈을 텐데 말이오.

english: What are you up to now then?
Well my ship had a little fire related problem. Fortunately it was well insured.
translation: 글쎄, 내 배에 불이 좀 나는 문제가 생겼지 뭐요. 다행히 보험을 두둑이 들어 놨었지.

english: Anyway, I don't have to work anymore so I've taken to canoeing on the river.
translation: 아무튼 이제 일할 필요가 없어서 강에서 카누를 타며 지낸다오.

english: I don't get river sick!
Would you like to know how to make a canoe?
Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 글쎄, 보아하니 카누를 만들 실력은 안 되는 것 같구려.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 카누를 만들 수 있게 되면 강을 따라 훨씬 빨리 다닐 수 있지!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 정말 간단하오. 저기 강둑에 있는 나무로 걸어가서 베어 넘기기만 하면 되지.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 그다음 도끼로 통나무를 더 다듬으면 카누가 된다오.

english: Hah! I can tell just by looking that you lack talent in woodcutting.
translation: 하! 척 보니 벌목에는 영 재능이 없구려.

english: What do you mean?
No Callouses! No Splinters! No camp fires littering the trail behind you.
translation: 굳은살도 없고! 가시 박힌 데도 없고! 지나온 길에 모닥불 자국도 하나 없잖소.

english: Anyway, the only 'canoe' you can make is a log. You'll be able to travel 1 stop along the river with a log canoe.
translation: 아무튼 당신이 만들 수 있는 '카누'라곤 통나무뿐이오. 통나무 카누로는 강을 따라 한 정거장만 갈 수 있지.

english: With your skill in woodcutting you could make my favourite canoe, the Dugout. They might not be the best canoe on the river, but they get you where you're going.
translation: 당신 벌목 실력이면 내가 제일 좋아하는 카누, Dugout(통나무배)를 만들 수 있겠구려. 강에서 제일 좋은 카누는 아니어도 가고 싶은 곳엔 데려다주지.

english: How far will I be able to go in a Dugout canoe?
translation: Dugout(통나무배) 카누로는 얼마나 멀리 갈 수 있어요?

english: You will be able to travel 2 stops on the river.
translation: 강을 따라 두 정거장까지 갈 수 있소.

english: The best canoe you can make is a Stable Dugout, one step beyond a normal Dugout.
translation: 당신이 만들 수 있는 최고의 카누는 Stable Dugout(튼튼한 통나무배)이오. 보통 통나무배보다 한 단계 위지.

english: With a Stable Dugout you can travel to any place on the river.
translation: Stable Dugout(튼튼한 통나무배)이면 강 어디든 갈 수 있소.

english: Even into the Wilderness?
Not likely! I've heard tell of a man up near Edgeville who claims he can use a Waka to get up into the Wilderness.
translation: 그럴 리가! Edgeville(에지빌) 근처에 사는 어떤 사내가 Waka(와카 카누)를 타고 황야까지 올라갈 수 있다고 큰소리친다는 얘긴 들었소만.

english: I can't think why anyone would wish to venture into that hellish landscape though.
translation: 그런 지옥 같은 땅에 왜 굳이 가려는지 난 도통 모르겠구려.

english: Hoo! You look like you know which end of an axe is which!
translation: 호! 도끼 어느 쪽으로 찍는지는 아는 사람 같구려!

english: You can easily build one of those Wakas. Be careful if you travel into the Wilderness though.
translation: 당신이라면 그 Waka(와카 카누)도 쉽게 만들 수 있겠소. 그래도 황야로 갈 거라면 조심하시오.

english: I've heard tell of great evil in that blasted wasteland.
translation: 그 저주받은 황무지에는 엄청난 악이 도사린다고 들었소.

english: Thanks for the warning Bill.
No thanks, not right now.
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 카누 타기에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: What's going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: We're making the final preparations for our voyage to the distant lands to the North.
translation: 북쪽의 먼 땅으로 떠날 항해를 위해 마지막 준비를 하고 있어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
We could do with an extra pair of hands, but you're better off speaking to Curator Haig Halen at the Varrock museum if you'd like to get involved.
translation: 일손이 하나 더 있으면 좋긴 한데, 함께하고 싶다면 Varrock museum(바록 박물관)에 계신 Curator Haig Halen(큐레이터 헤이그 할렌)께 말씀드리는 게 나을 거예요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Good luck, bye.
Thanks for all your help, [player name].
Is there anything I can do to help?
Good luck, bye.
This work isn't going to do itself.
Is it lunch break yet?
Ouch! That was my finger!
Hey I'm working here, I'm working here.
translation: 어이, 나 일하는 중이야, 일하는 중이라고.

english: Wonder when I'll get paid.
Can't stop. Too busy.
You are looking for clothes, yes? You look at my products! I have very many nice clothes, yes?
translation: 옷 찾으시죠, 네? 내 물건 봐요! 좋은 옷 아주 많아요, 네?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Unfortunate for you, yes? Many bargains, won't find elsewhere!
translation: 손님 손해예요, 네? 싼 물건 많아요, 다른 데선 못 찾아요!

english: Here, have this.
Yes, please.
No thanks.
Bones!
What?
I don't have any bones!
Then how do you stand up?
What?
How do you stand up if you have no bones? Shouldn't you collapse into a gelatinous blob?
translation: 뼈가 없으면 어떻게 서 있냐고요. 흐물흐물한 젤리 덩어리처럼 무너져 내려야 하잖아요?

english: Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha!
Goodbye.
Goodbye.
What do you need bones for?
To stand up properly. Otherwise I'd collapse into a gelatinous blob!
translation: 똑바로 서려고요. 안 그러면 흐물흐물한 젤리 덩어리처럼 무너져 버릴 테니까요!

english: No, seriously, I need bones to use as a Construction material. We always need big bones to prop up the mine shafts and to make other temporary structures.
translation: 아뇨, 진지하게 말하면 Construction(건설) 재료로 쓸 뼈가 필요해요. 광산 갱도를 받치거나 임시 구조물을 만들려면 큰 뼈가 늘 필요하거든요.

english: Will you buy anything besides bones?
Well, I've had a few people bring me some interesting giant shells. They say they came from giant snails and giant tortoises.
translation: 음, 몇몇 사람이 흥미로운 거대한 껍데기를 가져온 적이 있어요. giant snail(거대 달팽이)와 거대 거북에게서 나온 거라더군요.

english: Of course, like the bones, some shells are better than others. I'll give you 250gp for ordinary shells, but what I really need are perfect shells. I'll pay double for them and give you a few tips about Crafting too.
translation: 물론 뼈처럼 껍데기도 좋은 게 있고 나쁜 게 있죠. 평범한 껍데기는 250gp를 쳐 드리지만, 제가 정말 원하는 건 완벽한 껍데기예요. 그건 두 배를 드리고 Crafting(공예) 요령도 좀 알려 드릴게요.

english: What kind of bones do you need?
Enormous bones, as big as you can get. Not just any big bones will do.
translation: 구할 수 있는 한 제일 큰, 엄청나게 큰 뼈요. 그냥 big bones(큰 뼈)로는 안 돼요.

english: Sometimes you might find a particularly long, straight bone. That's the kind of thing I need; I'll give you 1,000gp for one of them.
translation: 가끔 유난히 길고 곧은 뼈가 나올 때가 있어요. 바로 그런 게 필요해요. 하나에 1,000gp를 드릴게요.

english: Occasionally, you might find a long curved bone - these are especially valuable - I'll give you 2,000gp for them.
translation: 이따금 길고 굽은 뼈가 나오기도 하는데, 그건 특히 귀해서 2,000gp를 드릴게요.

english: I'll also teach you a bit about how we use the bones in Construction, if you like.
translation: 원한다면 우리가 Construction(건설)에 뼈를 어떻게 쓰는지도 좀 가르쳐 드릴게요.

english: Those bones! Those are exactly the sort of thing I need! Will you sell them?
translation: 그 뼈! 딱 제가 찾던 거예요! 파실래요?

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the bones you're carrying and for any you have in your bank.
translation: 가지고 있는 뼈와 은행에 있는 뼈를 모두 합쳐 [NUMBER]gp를 드릴게요.

english: I'll try to teach you something about Construction as well, but it's highly technical so you won't understand if you don't already have level 30 Construction.
translation: Construction(건설)에 대해서도 좀 가르쳐 드릴게요. 그런데 아주 전문적인 내용이라 건설 레벨이 30은 돼야 알아들을 거예요.

english: Okay.
Thanks! Now, let me explain...
No thanks.
That giant shell...what is it?
It's a giant snail shell!
Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them.
translation: 흠... 그걸로 뭔가 만들 수 있을 것 같은데요.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying.
Thanks. If you find any more shells like these, please bring them to me!
translation: 고마워요. 이런 껍데기를 더 찾으면 꼭 저한테 가져와요!

english: Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them, especially that perfect one.
translation: 흠... 그걸로 뭔가 만들 수 있을 것 같아요. 특히 그 완벽한 거로요.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shell you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 가지고 있는 달팽이 껍데기에 [NUMBER]gp를 드릴게요. 그러는 김에 Crafting(공예) 조언도 좀 해 드리죠.

english: Thanks! Now, I don't think I could use that for Construction, but maybe I could make something...
translation: 고마워요! 자, 이건 건설에는 못 쓸 것 같지만 뭔가 만들 수는 있겠어요...

english: Hmm... I think I might be able to make something out of them, especially those perfect ones.
translation: 흠... 그걸로 뭔가 만들 수 있을 것 같아요. 특히 그 완벽한 것들로요.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 가지고 있는 달팽이 껍데기들에 [NUMBER]gp를 드릴게요. 그러는 김에 Crafting(공예) 조언도 좀 해 드리죠.

english: It's a giant battle tortoise shell!
I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying.
That other giant shell...what is it?
translation: 그 다른 거대한 껍데기... 그건 뭐예요?

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shell you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 가지고 있는 거북 등딱지에 [NUMBER]gp를 드릴게요. 그러는 김에 Crafting(공예) 조언도 좀 해 드리죠.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 가지고 있는 거북 등딱지들에 [NUMBER]gp를 드릴게요. 그러는 김에 Crafting(공예) 조언도 좀 해 드리죠.

english: Then how do you stand up?
What do you need bones for?
What kind of bones do you need?
Will you buy anything besides bones?
Okay.
No. I'll keep the bones.
Welcome to the Laughing Miner pub, human traveller.
translation: Laughing Miner(웃는 광부) 주점에 오신 걸 환영해요, 인간 여행자님.

english: Who is that man walking around outside?
What man?
I mean the dwarf, the one with the sign.
translation: 저 드워프요, 표지판 들고 있는 사람이요.

english: Oh, him. Yes, we employ him to advertise our pub, he's the cheapest labour we could find. We don't have a lot of money to spare you know, we pay him in beer.
translation: 아, 그 사람이요. 네, 주점 홍보하라고 고용했어요. 구할 수 있는 일꾼 중에 제일 쌌거든요. 저희도 돈이 넉넉하지 않아서 품삯은 맥주로 줘요.

english: But what's wrong with him?
Well, he's drunk isn't he?
I told you, he's cheap. He couldn't get any other work since the Red Axe fired him. Been drinking ever since.
translation: 말했잖아요, 싸다고요. Red Axe(레드 액스)에서 잘린 뒤로 다른 일자리를 못 구했어요. 그 뒤로 계속 마셔 대고 있죠.

english: How did that happen?
I'm not quite sure, I think he kept wearing the wrong coloured cap all the time. They don't much like it if you don't wear your red uniform into work.
translation: 확실히는 모르겠는데, 맨날 엉뚱한 색 모자를 쓰고 다녔던 것 같아요. 그 회사는 빨간 제복을 안 입고 출근하는 걸 아주 싫어하거든요.

english: They fired him for that??
The Red Axe will fire you for just about anything if they want to.
translation: Red Axe(레드 액스)는 마음만 먹으면 무슨 이유로든 잘라요.

english: I'd like a beer please.
That'll be 2 gold coins.
Thanks for your custom.
Sorry, I don't have 2 coins on me.
Sorry, I changed my mind.
I'd like some food please.
I can make you a stew for 20 gold coins.
Sorry, I don't have 20 coins on me.
I'd like a Kelda stout please.
translation: Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트) 한 잔 주세요.

english: Sorry, we've stopped serving those. The seeds were too hard to get.
translation: 죄송해요, 그건 이제 안 팔아요. 씨앗을 구하기가 너무 힘들었거든요.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
They're quite hard to come by, and I believe you've already got one.
translation: 구하기 꽤 어려운데, 손님은 벌써 하나 갖고 계신 것 같네요.

english: Oh yes.
Here, I found a little left over Kelda stout, just enough for a glass. Take it.
translation: 자, 남은 Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트)를 조금 찾았어요. 딱 한 잔 분량이네요. 가져가세요.

english: Wow, for free?
I don't think I'll be able to sell it to anyone.
translation: 어차피 다른 손님한테 팔 수도 없을 것 같아서요.

english: So yes, go ahead.
I have to go.
Who is that man walking around outside?
I'd like a beer please.
Pay.
Don't pay.
I'd like some food please.
I'd like a Kelda stout please.
translation: Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I have to go.
Good day to you. What can I get you to drink?
translation: 어서 오세요. 마실 걸로 뭘 드릴까요?

english: What do you have.
Here, take a look at our menu.
Nothing thanks.
Ok, take it easy.
I was just wanting to buy a cocktail ingredient actually.
translation: 사실 칵테일 재료를 좀 사고 싶어서 왔어요.

english: Sure thing, what did you want?
A lemon.
You don't have enough room in your inventory to buy that.
translation: 소지품에 자리가 없어서 살 수 없어요.

english: 20 coins please.
You do not have enough money to buy that.
An orange.
A cocktail shaker.
Actually nothing thanks.
What do you have?
Nothing thanks.
Can I buy some ingredients?
A lemon
An orange.
A cocktail shaker.
And what will it be for you, fine [sir/madam]?
Yes? Can I help you with something?
A beer please.
That'll be 1 gold coin please.
I'm sorry, I seem to have run out of money.
translation: 죄송해요, 돈이 다 떨어진 것 같아요.

english: Here you go. One delicious pint of beer.
translation: 여기 있습니다. 맛있는 맥주 한 잔입니다.

english: Sorry, I changed my mind.
A dwarven stout please.
translation: Dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주세요.

english: It'll be yours for just 2 gold coins!
One dwarven stout, best in all of Keldagrim!
translation: 드워프 스타우트 한 잔입니다. Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 최고죠!

english: A fine wine please.
Ah, [sir/madam] has taste! A jug of wine will cost you 10 gold coins.
translation: 아, [sir/madam]께서 안목이 있으시군요! jug of wine(포도주 주전자)는 10골드입니다.

english: I hope [sir/madam] will enjoy it!
Nothing, thanks.
A beer please.
Pay.
Don't pay.
A dwarven stout please.
translation: Dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주세요.

english: A fine wine please.
Nothing, thanks.
Welcome traveller, can I get you a drink or some food?
translation: 어서 오세요, 여행자님. 마실 거나 먹을 걸 드릴까요?

english: I'd like a beer please.
That'll be 2 gold coins.
Thanks for your custom.
Sorry, I don't have 2 coins on me.
I'd like some food please.
I can make you a stew for 20 gold coins.
Sorry, I don't have 20 coins on me.
I have to go.
I'd like a beer please.
I'd like some food please.
I have to go
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게. 보아하니 자격을 갖췄군. 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 안녕하신가! 자네가 지구과학 시험 세 개를 얼마 전에 모두 통과한 그 학생이지? 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 반갑네, 친애하는 [sir/madam]. 우리 일손을 거들러 왔는가?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 먼저 장비부터 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 도구 선반에 있지. 지구과학 시험에서 배운 걸 떠올려 보게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 장화를 착용하고 있어야 하고, 거기에 더해

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔)을 갖고 있어야 하네.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 우리를 제대로 돕고 싶다면 출토품 세척을 좀 해 주게. 거의 다 된 것들이라 마무리 손질만 하면 되네. 인부들이 가져오는 더미에서 출토품을 하나 집어 저쪽 빈 탁자에서

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 세척하면 되네. 흥미로운 게 나오면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 우리가 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 흥미롭군... 그래... 그래... 흐음... 마법이 걸려 있는 것 같네.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 오, 그냥 무해한 순간이동 주문 같네. 고고학을 안 할 때는 마법도 좀 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 더 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있네. 그 시절에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍구먼.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠... 모든 정황을 보면 여기서 동쪽 어딘가인데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠네. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었는지도 모르지. 좀 더 자세히 살펴보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고 fire runes(화염 룬) 5개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 1개로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거죠.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 그래, 바로 그거네. 잘했네, 젊은이. 도와줘서 고맙네.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 세척했는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 오, 이런! 정말 멋진 발견이군! 내 생각이 맞다면 이걸로 Dig Site(발굴 현장) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠어.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여길 보게, 도시 이름도 적혀 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! 분명 Saradominist(사라도민파)가 점령하던 시절일 걸세. 정말 멋진 발견이야. 이걸 가져가서 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 전에도 보여 줬잖나. 그때 것이 상태가 더 좋았지. 그건 저기 진열장에 있네. 이건 저 구석에 있는 출토품 crate(나무 상자)에 넣으면 되네.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 동전을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이거 정말 흥미롭군... 동시에 당혹스럽기도 하고. 이 동전을 보면 우리가 Digsite(발굴 현장)에서 발굴 중인 도시 Saranthium(사란시움)에 훨씬, 훨씬 이전에 Zamorak(자모락) 추종자들이 살았다는 뜻이네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.

This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견일세. Saradominist(사라도민파)가 차지하기 전에 Zarosian(자로스파) 추종자들이 살았다는 증거는 이미 있지만, 자모락파 세력도 어떤 전투 중에 이곳을

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 썼던 모양이군. 그래도 이걸로 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 자모락을 따르다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르게 된 시기를 대략 알 수 있겠어. display case(진열장) 44번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 display case(진열장) 44번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 바스러질 것 같은 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아... 제단 장식 같군. 흠, 그래... 보아하니 초기 사라도민파 신도들의 것일세. 꽤 섬세하기도 하고. display case(진열장) 37번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 display case(진열장) 37번에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않나? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이군. 틀림없이 Saradominist(사라도민파) 도시의 것일세. display case(진열장) 36번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 display case(진열장) 36번에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 pottery(도자기) 조각을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 아... 오! 흠... 그래... 보아하니 Zaros(자로스) 숭배자들이 만든 것이군. 모양이 아름답네. display case(진열장) 22번에 잘 어울리겠어. 이 조각으로 이 도시에

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 사라도민파보다 먼저 자로스파가 살았다는 증거가 더 확실해지는군.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? 도자기는 display case(진열장) 22번에 넣었나?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오네. 중요한 건 아니야. 전시품에도 이미 몇 개 있고. 문 근처에 있는 출토품 crate(나무 상자)에 넣어 두게.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 상자에 이미 뭔가 들어 있으면 수고한 대가로 가져가도 좋네.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 흥미로운 발견이군... 자, 대신 이걸 주겠네.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병 말인가... 몇 개나 찾았는지 셀 수도 없네... 완전히 멀쩡한 건 이미 진열장에 하나 있고. 문 근처에 있는 출토품 crate(나무 상자)에 넣어 두게.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 애초에 갖고 있지도 않았던 것 같군, [lad/lass]!

english: No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
You're so cute!
I will devour everything you know and love!
translation: 네가 알고 사랑하는 모든 걸 집어삼켜 주마!

english: Well then.
You okay, Baron?
I must grow! I must eat!
Keep those little teeth away from me please. I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: 그 조그만 이빨 나한테서 좀 치워 줄래? 내 눈은 널 지켜보고 있어.

english: And I'm keeping all my eyes on you.
translation: 내 눈들도 전부 널 지켜보고 있지.

english: *gulp*
Bleugh!
Chomp!
Grrrr!
Oh no! What's broken?
What? Nothing's broken.
I'm sorry. I'm just a bit jumpy.
I'm in charge of all the metalworking of Dorgesh-Kaan. It's a big responsibility!
translation: 제가 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)의 금속 작업을 전부 맡고 있거든요. 책임이 막중해요!

english: If something metal breaks I have to fix it. And lots of things are made of metal!
translation: 금속으로 된 게 부서지면 제가 고쳐야 해요. 그런데 금속으로 된 게 정말 많거든요!

english: Don't worry, I'm sure you're up to the task!
translation: 걱정 마세요, 분명 잘 해내실 거예요!

english: I hope you're right.
Get away from that furnace!
Are you worried I'll break your furnace?
I'm worried the furnace will break you!
It's set up to make glass and jewellery at the moment. It's not safe to use it to smelt ore. What if you accidentally burn yourself?
translation: 지금은 유리랑 장신구를 만들도록 맞춰 놨어요. 광석을 제련하는 데 쓰면 위험해요. 실수로 화상이라도 입으면 어떡해요?

english: What if you accidentally burn yourself and the surface people see that you're burnt and use that as a pretext to attack us?
translation: 실수로 화상을 입었는데, 지상 사람들이 그걸 보고 그걸 핑계 삼아 우리를 공격하면 어떡해요?

english: We'd all be killed in our sleep! And it would be my fault!
translation: 다들 자다가 죽고 말 거예요! 그리고 그건 다 제 탓이 될 거고요!

english: No, no, no, no, no - I can't take the risk.
translation: 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼요. 그런 위험은 감수할 수 없어요.

english: Alright, calm down! I won't use your furnace. To smelt ore.
translation: 알았어요, 진정하세요! 용광로 안 쓸게요. 광석 제련에는요.

english: What do you think you're doing?
Um...may I use your tools?
Oh, no, no!
Those are highly technical tools. They're not like the tools you use on the surface.
translation: 이건 아주 전문적인 도구라고요. 지상에서 쓰는 도구랑은 달라요.

english: What if you hurt yourself with them? I could be held responsible!
translation: 이걸 쓰다가 다치기라도 하면요? 제가 책임지게 될 수도 있다고요!

english: No, I think it's best if I don't let anyone use the tools.
translation: 아뇨, 아무도 이 도구를 못 쓰게 하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Oh well.
Hullo there friend, what can I do you for?
Do you sell beer?
Aye, we do.
Could I get one?
Nope, sorry [laddie/lassie].
Why not?
The egg's order, I only have cabbage beer and I'm not allowed to sell it anymore.
translation: 달걀님의 명령이야. 나한텐 양배추 맥주밖에 없는데 그것도 이제 팔면 안 된대.

english: Can't you see by my lack of customers?
translation: 손님 하나 없는 거 안 보여?

english: I just thought no one wanted to come in.
translation: 그냥 아무도 오고 싶지 않은 줄 알았죠.

english: Get out me pub!
This is a nice pub you've got here.
Aye, it is.
How long has it been around?
Oh not too long, use to be a house, but I demolished it with me bare paws and rebuilt it as a pub.
translation: 아, 얼마 안 됐어. 원래는 집이었는데, 내가 이 맨 앞발로 때려 부수고 술집으로 다시 지었지.

english: You demolished the house? Was anyone living there?
translation: 집을 부쉈다고요? 거기 누가 살고 있었어요?

english: Nope, been empty for quite a while.
Oh... what an interesting story.
No thank you, I'm just browsing.
What do you mean browsing? This is a pub, not a carrot market.
translation: 구경이라니 무슨 소리야? 여긴 술집이지 당근 시장이 아니라고.

english: Sorry, I just wanted to have a look.
I've a half mind to bar you from me pub right now if you don't leave.
translation: 당장 안 나가면 우리 술집 출입 금지시켜 버릴까 보다.

english: Do you sell beer?
Nice pub you've got here.
Just browsing, thanks.
Welcome to Atlazora's Rest. If you're in need of a drink, then you're in the right place.
translation: Atlazora's Rest(아틀라조라의 안식처)에 어서 오세요. 한잔하고 싶으시다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요.

english: Show me what you have.
I'm good, thanks.
Fair enough.
Show me what you have.
I'm good, thanks.
What can I do yer for?
A glass of your finest ale please.
translation: 제일 좋은 에일로 한 잔 주세요.

english: No problemo. That'll be 2 coins.
You buy a pint of beer.
Oh dear. I don't seem to have enough money.
Can you recommend where an adventurer might make his fortune?
translation: 모험가가 한몫 잡을 만한 곳을 추천해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Ooh I don't know if I should be giving away information, makes the game too easy.
translation: 음, 정보를 막 알려 줘도 되나 모르겠네요. 게임이 너무 쉬워지잖아요.

english: Oh ah well...
Game? What are you talking about?
This world around us... is an online game... called Old School RuneScape.
translation: 우리 주변의 이 세계는... 온라인 게임이에요... Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프)라고 하죠.

english: Nope, still don't understand what you are talking about. What does 'online' mean?
translation: 아뇨, 여전히 무슨 말인지 모르겠어요. '온라인'이 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: It's a sort of connection between magic boxes across the world, big boxes on people's desktops and little ones people can carry. They can talk to each other to play games.
translation: 전 세계의 마법 상자들을 서로 잇는 일종의 연결이에요. 사람들 책상 위에 있는 큰 상자도 있고, 들고 다니는 작은 상자도 있죠. 그 상자들이 서로 대화하면서 게임을 해요.

english: I give up. You're obviously completely mad!
Just a small clue?
Go and talk to the bartender at the Jolly Boar Inn, he doesn't seem to mind giving away clues.
translation: Jolly Boar Inn(즐거운 멧돼지 여관)의 바텐더한테 가서 물어보세요. 그 사람은 단서 알려 주는 걸 별로 개의치 않는 것 같더라고요.

english: Do you know where I can get some good equipment?
translation: 좋은 장비를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Well, there's the sword shop across the road, or there's also all sorts of shops up around the market.
translation: 글쎄요, 길 건너편에 검 상점이 있고, 시장 쪽에 가면 온갖 상점이 다 있어요.

english: Nicely solved!
A glass of your finest ale please.
translation: 제일 좋은 에일로 한 잔 주세요.

english: Can you recommend where an adventurer might make his fortune?
translation: 모험가가 한몫 잡을 만한 곳을 추천해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Oh ah well...
Game? What are you talking about?
Just a small clue?
Do you know where I can get some good equipment
translation: 좋은 장비를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Hello.
Good day to you, brave adventurer. Can I get you a refreshing beer?
translation: 안녕하세요, 용감한 모험가님. 시원한 맥주 한 잔 드릴까요?

english: Yes please!
Ok then, that's two gold coins please.
Cheers!
Cheers!

Dragon Bitter and Greenman's Ale, oh and some cheap beer.
translation: Dragon Bitter(드래곤 비터)랑 Greenman's Ale(그린맨 에일), 아 그리고 싼 맥주도 있어요.

english: I'll give it a miss I think.
Come back when you're a little thirstier.
translation: 좀 더 목마를 때 다시 오세요.

english: I'll try the Dragon Bitter.
Ok, that'll be two coins.
You buy a pint of Dragon Bitter.
translation: Dragon Bitter(드래곤 비터) 한 잔을 샀다.

english: Can I have some Greenman's Ale?
Ok, that'll be ten coins.
You buy a pint of Greenman's Ale.
translation: Greenman's Ale(그린맨 에일) 한 잔을 샀다.

english: One cheap beer please!
That'll be 2 gold coins please!
Have a super day!

Beer!

translation: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl(알프레드 그림핸드의 술집 순례) 중이에요.

english: Fancy a bit of Heart Stopper then do you? It'll only be 8 coins.
translation: 그럼 Heart Stopper(심장 정지) 한 잔 하시겠다는 거죠? 8코인밖에 안 해요.

english: The bartender hands you a shot of Heart Stopper.
translation: 바텐더가 Heart Stopper(심장 정지) 한 잔을 건넨다.

english: You grimace and drink it.
You clutch your chest.
Through your tears you see the bartender...
signing your barcrawl card.

english: Sorry, I don't have 8 coins.
I'll have a beer then.
I'll not have anything then.

translation: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl(알프레드 그림핸드의 술집 순례) 중이에요.

english: Good morning, what would you like?
What do you have?
Well we have beer, or if you want some food, we have our home made stew and meat pies.
translation: 음, 맥주가 있고요, 식사를 원하시면 직접 만든 stew(스튜)랑 meat pie(고기 파이)가 있어요.

english: I'll try the meat pie.
Ok, that'll be 16 coins.
You buy a nice hot meat pie.
Could I have some stew please?
A bowl of stew, that'll be 20 coins please.
You buy a bowl of home made stew.
translation: 직접 만든 스튜 한 그릇을 샀다.

english: Beer please.
One beer coming up. Ok, that'll be two coins.
I don't really want anything thanks.

Beer please.
I'll try the meat pie.

Ok, that'll be two coins please.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
Any hints on where I can go adventuring?
translation: 모험하러 갈 만한 곳 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Ooh, now. Let me see...
Well there is the Varrock sewers. There are tales of untold horrors coming out at night and stealing babies from houses.
translation: 음, Varrock sewers(바록 하수도)가 있죠. 밤마다 말로 다 못 할 끔찍한 것들이 기어 나와서 집집마다 아기들을 훔쳐 간다는 이야기가 있어요.

english: Sounds perfect! Where's the entrance?
It's just to the east of the palace.
Heard any gossip?
I'm not that well up on the gossip out here. I've heard that the bartender in the Blue Moon Inn has gone a little crazy, he keeps claiming he is part of something called an online game.
translation: 전 이 동네 소문엔 그리 밝지 않아요. Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관)의 바텐더가 좀 이상해졌다는 얘기는 들었어요. 자기가 온라인 게임이라는 것의 일부라고 계속 우긴대요.

english: What that means, I don't know. That's probably old news by now though.
translation: 그게 무슨 뜻인지는 저도 몰라요. 아마 지금쯤이면 다 아는 얘기겠지만요.

english: I'll have a beer please.
Any hints where I can go adventuring?
translation: 모험하러 갈 만한 곳 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Heard any good gossip?
Could I buy a beer please?
translation: 맥주 한 잔 살 수 있을까요?

english: Sure, that will be 2 gold coins please.
I don't have enough coins.
Ok, here you go.
You buy a pint of beer!
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Well, there was a guy in here earlier saying the goblins up by the mountain are arguing again, about the colour of their armour of all things.
translation: 음, 아까 어떤 사람이 그러는데 산 위쪽 고블린들이 또 싸운대요. 하필이면 갑옷 색깔 때문에요.

english: Knowing the goblins it could easily turn into a full blown war, which wouldn't be good. Goblin wars make such a mess of the countryside.
translation: 고블린들 하는 짓을 보면 금세 전면전으로 번질 수도 있는데, 그럼 곤란하죠. 고블린 전쟁이 나면 시골이 엉망이 되거든요.

english: Well if I have the time I'll go and see if I can knock some sense into them.
translation: 시간 나면 가서 정신 좀 차리게 해 줘야겠네요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
I’m doing Alfred Grimhand’s Barcrawl.
translation: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl(알프레드 그림핸드의 술집 순례) 중이에요.

english: Are you sure? You look a bit skinny for that.
Just give me whatever I need to drink here.
translation: 여기서 마셔야 하는 걸로 아무거나 주세요.

english: Ok one Black Skull Ale coming up, 8 coins please.
translation: 좋아요, Black Skull Ale(검은 해골 에일) 한 잔 나갑니다. 8코인이에요.

english: Hiccup!
Congratulations! Here you go.
Could I buy a beer please?
translation: 맥주 한 잔 살 수 있을까요?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: I'm doing Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl
translation: Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl(알프레드 그림핸드의 술집 순례) 중이에요.

english: Don't get many humans in Stick Your Ore Inn. Are you here to drink?
translation: Stick Your Ore Inn(광석 참견 여관)엔 인간이 잘 안 오는데. 술 마시러 왔나?

english: Let's see what you have.
I'll be on my way then.
Well then I'm not really sure what we have for you. Perhaps you should be on your way.
translation: 그렇다면 너한테 내줄 게 있을지 모르겠군. 그냥 갈 길 가는 게 좋겠어.

english: What are you selling?
I'll be on my way then.
Welcome to Sunlight's Sanctum. What will it be?
translation: Sunlight's Sanctum(햇빛의 성소)에 어서 오세요. 뭘로 하시겠어요?

english: Nice place you have here.
Thank you. I like to think we have one of the nicest pubs in all of Varlamore, not that I can take much credit myself.
translation: 감사합니다. Varlamore(바를라모어) 전체에서 손꼽히게 좋은 술집이라고 생각해요. 그렇다고 제 공이 크다고 할 순 없지만요.

english: How come?
Well it's the Moonrise Brewery and Winery who own this place. It's only as nice as it is because of their continued investments.
translation: 이곳 주인은 Moonrise Brewery and Winery(문라이즈 양조장)거든요. 여기가 이만큼 좋은 건 다 그쪽에서 꾸준히 투자해 준 덕분이에요.

english: So I'm guessing they care a lot about this place?
translation: 그럼 그쪽에서 이곳을 꽤 아끼나 보네요?

english: Well I suppose it just makes sense for them. Keeping this pub in good condition keeps the locals happy, which is probably wise for a company that employs half of them.
translation: 뭐, 그쪽 입장에선 당연한 일이겠죠. 술집을 잘 관리하면 동네 사람들이 좋아하니까요. 동네 사람 절반을 고용한 회사라면 그러는 게 현명하겠죠.

english: We also make plenty of money from all the tourists. Even before Varlamore opened up, Aldarin was a top holiday destination. That's easy money for the owners to help fund all their other ventures.
translation: 관광객들한테서도 돈을 꽤 벌어요. Varlamore(바를라모어)가 개방되기 전부터 Aldarin(알다린)은 최고의 휴양지였거든요. 주인들 입장에선 다른 사업 자금을 대기 좋은 쉬운 돈벌이죠.

english: I suppose so.
And on that note, I'm guessing you came in for a drink? What will it be?
translation: 그 얘기가 나온 김에, 한잔하러 오신 거죠? 뭘로 하시겠어요?

english: Nothing, thanks.
Let's see what you have.
Nice place you have here.
Nothing, thanks.
Get out of here. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: 꺼져. 너 같은 놈한테 할 말 없어.

english: Get out of here, we don't like your sort in these parts.
translation: 꺼져, 이 동네에선 너 같은 부류 안 좋아해.

english: If you're not buying anything, I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 살 거 아니면 너한테 할 말 없어.

english: As I understand it there's some kind of hidden treasure in these parts...
translation: 듣자 하니 이 근처에 무슨 숨겨진 보물이 있다던데요...

english: Look around pal. Does it looks like there's any treasure near here?
translation: 주위를 둘러봐, 친구. 이 근처에 보물이 있을 것 같아 보여?

english: If I were you I'd get lost before someone takes a dislike to your face and removes it for you.
translation: 내가 너라면 누가 네 얼굴이 맘에 안 든다고 뜯어내기 전에 썩 꺼지겠다.

english: What's that? You wanna buy a beer? It'll cost ya 650 coins.
There you go. Now get out, we don't like your sort around here.
translation: 옜다. 이제 꺼져, 여기선 너 같은 부류 안 좋아해.

english: (the player receives Bandit's Brew.)
Get out of my bar then! We don't like your sort round here!
translation: 그럼 내 술집에서 나가! 여기선 너 같은 부류 안 좋아한다고!

english: Buy a beer
Don't buy anything
You've had your drink, now get out of here. I have nothing to say to the-
translation: 술 마셨으면 이제 꺼져. 너 같은 놈들한테는 할 말이-

english: No, Wait! Look, I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 아뇨, 잠깐만요! 저기, 전 Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관)의 고고학 탐사 때문에 온 거예요.

english: I am only here looking for artefacts...
Oh really? Our inheritance is only sand and death. What do you expect to find out here in this desert forsaken by the gods?
translation: 아, 그래? 우리가 물려받은 건 모래와 죽음뿐이야. 신들도 버린 이 사막에서 대체 뭘 찾겠다는 거지?

english: I heard a rumour about four diamonds or crystals...
translation: 다이아몬드인지 크리스탈인지, 네 개에 관한 소문을 들었어요...

english: The four diamonds of Azzanadra??? How came you to know of this?
translation: Azzanadra(아자나드라)의 네 다이아몬드??? 그걸 어떻게 알게 됐지?

english: You've heard of them then?
It's just a fairy tale for children. Maybe one of the village elders might know more, but it's not really something I care about.
translation: 그냥 애들한테 들려주는 동화야. 마을 원로라면 좀 더 알지도 모르지만, 난 별로 관심 없어.

english: Now get out of here, your sort isn't welcome in my bar.
translation: 이제 꺼져, 너 같은 부류는 내 술집에서 환영 못 받아.

english: Certain things have led me to believe there may be some kind of ruined fortress around here...
translation: 몇 가지 이유로, 이 근처 어딘가에 폐허가 된 요새가 있을지도 모른다고 생각하게 됐어요...

english: Doubt it. What in the world would someone need to guard against in the middle of this desert?
translation: 그럴 리가. 이 사막 한복판에서 대체 뭘 막으려고 요새를 짓겠어?

english: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track here, stranger.
translation: 모래 습격이라도 막으려고? 헛다리 짚은 것 같다, 이방인.

english: (above)
Tell me all you know about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: Diamonds of Azzanadra(아자나드라의 다이아몬드)에 대해 아는 걸 전부 말해 주세요.

english: Not that I think it's any of your business, but when I was a child I remember hearing the legend.
translation: 네가 상관할 일은 아닌 것 같다만, 어릴 때 그 전설을 들은 기억은 나.

english: I don't recall it particularly well, other than they are said to contain an incredible power.
translation: 엄청난 힘이 담겨 있다는 것 말고는 잘 기억이 안 나.

english: If you really want to hear more about it you'd be best off finding someone who cares about the past, and the history of this area, and stop bothering me.
translation: 정말 더 듣고 싶으면 과거나 이 지역 역사에 관심 있는 사람을 찾아가. 그리고 날 그만 귀찮게 해.

english: So you're the [fella/lass] that freed Azzanadra, huh? Fair play to ya. What will you have?
translation: 네가 Azzanadra(아자나드라)를 풀어 준 그 [fella/lass](이)란 말이지? 대단하네. 뭘로 할래?

english: Didn't feel like a drink after all, huh? Well, stop by anytime, hero.
translation: 결국 한잔할 생각이 없었나 보네? 뭐, 언제든 들러, 영웅 양반.

english: Ask about Desert Treasure I
translation: Desert Treasure I(사막의 보물 I)에 대해 묻는다

english: Buy a drink
I heard about treasure...
I heard about four diamonds...
I heard about a fortress...
I've heard of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: Diamonds of Azzanadra(아자나드라의 다이아몬드)에 대해 들었어요.

english: Welcome to The Flaming Arrow. What can I get for you?
translation: The Flaming Arrow(불타는 화살)에 어서 오세요. 뭘 드릴까요?

english: Nothing for me, thanks.
As you wish.
Nothing for me, thanks.
A human in The Lost Pickaxe? My old pa would be fuming. Still, business is business I guess. What can I get you?
translation: The Lost Pickaxe(잃어버린 곡괭이)에 인간이라니? 우리 아버지가 봤으면 길길이 날뛰었을 거야. 그래도 장사는 장사니까. 뭘 줄까?

english: Take a look.
Nothing thanks.
So you're just lurking here? Pa always said your kind were freaks.
translation: 그럼 그냥 여기서 어슬렁거리겠다는 거야? 아버지가 늘 너희 족속은 괴짜들이라고 했지.

english: Nothing thanks.
Welcome to the Sheared Ram. What can I do for you?
translation: Sheared Ram(털 깎인 숫양)에 어서 오세요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: I'll have a beer please.?
That'll be two coins please.
Heard any rumours recently?
translation: 요즘 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: One of the patrons here is looking for treasure apparently. A chap by the name of Veos.
translation: 여기 손님 중 한 분이 보물을 찾고 있대요. Veos(베오스)라는 사람이에요.

english: Heard any rumours recently?
translation: 요즘 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
Here you go.
You don't have enough room for it.
Welcome to the Windbreaker. We've got the best drinks around.
translation: Windbreaker(바람막이)에 어서 오세요. 이 근방에서 제일 좋은 술이 있어요.

english: What's with those big gates out there?
translation: 밖에 있는 저 큰 대문은 뭐예요?

english: I couldn't tell you to be honest. They've been here for a very long time. Apparently they came in quite useful during the war, and these days they do help stop any undesirable beasts wandering into town.
translation: 솔직히 저도 잘 몰라요. 아주 오래전부터 있었거든요. 전쟁 때 꽤 쓸모가 있었다던데, 요즘은 달갑지 않은 짐승들이 마을로 들어오는 걸 막아 주죠.

english: Anyway, did you want to buy a drink?
What's with those big gates out there?
translation: 밖에 있는 저 큰 대문은 뭐예요?

english: Hello again! Lovely day for it, isn't it?
I suppose it is.
Nothing like a good day in Lovakengj, that's what I always say!
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 화창한 하루만 한 게 없죠. 제가 늘 하는 말이에요!

english: Well I hope you keep enjoying it.
I'm sure I will!
Hello! Here to see the Burning Man?
translation: 안녕하세요! Burning Man(불타는 사람) 보러 오셨어요?

english: That's right.

Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!
translation: 딱 좋은 날 오셨네요! 아, 전 Barus(바루스)라고 해요. 여기서 역사학자로 일하고 있죠. Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들은 자기들이 다 안다고 생각하겠지만, 그 사람들도 미처 몰랐던 걸 제가 한두 가지는 알려 드릴 수 있을걸요!

english: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?
translation: 그럼 말 나온 김에, Burning Man(불타는 사람)에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thosands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.
translation: Burning Man(불타는 사람)은 Lovakengj(로바켕기) 역사의 위대한 승리를 기리는 기념비예요. 수천 년 전, Kourend(쿠렌드)가 왕국이 되기도 전의 일이죠! 안타깝게도 그래서 세부적인 내용은 세월 속에 좀 사라졌어요.

english: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!
translation: 확실한 건, 이곳에 처음 정착한 드워프들을 거대한 악이 위협했다는 거예요. 그 악이 이겼다면 Lovakengj(로바켕기)는 아예 존재하지 못했을지도 몰라요!

english: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.
translation: 다행히 용감한 지도자의 인도 덕분에 정착민들은 그 악을 이겨 낼 수 있었어요! Burning Man(불타는 사람)은 그걸 기억하기 위한 거예요.

english: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?
translation: 그럼 이 기념비는 그 악을 나타내는 건가요?

english: That's right!
But what was it, and where did it come from?
translation: 그런데 그게 뭐였고, 어디서 온 거예요?

english: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?
translation: 아, 그 부분은 좀 불분명해요. Stranglewood(스트랭글우드)라고 들어 보셨어요?

english: I don't think so.
Not too surprising. It's not a place you'd want to visit. Anyway, that's supposedly where this evil emerged from.
translation: 그럴 만하죠. 가고 싶은 곳은 아니거든요. 아무튼, 그 악이 거기서 나왔다고들 해요.

english: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?
translation: 그렇군요. Stranglewood(스트랭글우드)에 대해선 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: You'll find it on the border between the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. It's a cursed place. Few have ever entered, and of those that have, none have returned!
translation: Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)와 Kingdom of Varlamore(바를라모어 왕국)의 경계에 있어요. 저주받은 곳이죠. 들어간 사람도 거의 없고, 들어간 사람 중엔 아무도 돌아오지 못했어요!

english: You know, I heard some chap from Hosidius went missing not too long ago. They reckon he went exploring the Stranglewood. Poor guy.
translation: 그러고 보니 얼마 전에 Hosidius(호시디우스)에서 어떤 사람이 실종됐다고 들었어요. Stranglewood(스트랭글우드)를 탐험하러 갔다나 봐요. 불쌍한 사람.

english: Who was he?
Some botanist I think. His name escapes me, but I think he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.
translation: 식물학자였던 것 같아요. 이름은 기억이 안 나지만, Hosidius Estate Agent(호시디우스 부동산 중개인) 바로 남쪽에 살았을 거예요.

english: Interesting... Thanks for all the information.
Don't mention it!
What do you want?
Oh, er, nothing!
I want to mock you.
All right. Go on then.
You're a [boring/fat/hideous/puny/smelly/stupid] [beetle/chicken/egg/mud/slime/worm]-[brained/eating/like/loving/smelling/witted] [basilisk/idiot/lizard/mudworm/slimeball/weakling]!
I'm going back to sleep.
I want to apologise for killing you.
Go on then.
I'm, um, very sorry I killed you.
Really sorry?
No, not really!
I don't care.
Yes really!
Really really?
Yes, really really!
Fat lot of good that does, I'm still dead.
translation: 그래 봤자 무슨 소용이야, 난 여전히 죽었는데.

english: I'm not THAT sorry!
Will you forgive me?
Of course I'll forgive you!
Really?
No!
I promise not to do it again.
Of couseyou won't do it again, you can only kill me once.
translation: 당연히 다시는 못 그러지, 날 죽이는 건 한 번밖에 못 하니까.

english: That's why I won't do it again! There'd be no point!
translation: 그러니까 다시는 안 그런다는 거야! 해 봤자 의미가 없잖아!

english: But I won't do it to any other basilisks!
Really?
Yes, really!
All right then. Apology accepted. Now leave me alone.
translation: 좋아, 그럼. 사과 받아 줄게. 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬.

english: Don't start that again!
Leave me alone then.
Don't push it!
I don't care anyway.
I just wanted to check that you're okay.
Apart from being dead and stuffed and hanging on a wall, you mean?
translation: 죽어서 박제가 돼 벽에 걸려 있는 것만 빼면 말이지?

english: Uh... yeah, apart from that are you okay?
Actually there's something blocking my view of the far wall.
translation: 사실 뭐가 맞은편 벽을 가리고 있어.

english: I don't see anything.
Perhaps if you were to move to one side of me.
translation: 네가 내 옆으로 좀 비켜 주면 될 것 같은데.

english: I still don't see anything.
Oh, it's moved away. I can see now.
Nothing.
Leave me alone.
I want to mock you
I want to apologise for killing you
No, not really
Yes, really
Yes, really really
I'm not THAT sorry
But will you forgive me?
I promise not to do it again
That's why I won't do it again
But I won't do it to any other basilisks
Yes, really!
No, not really!
Don't start that again!
Don't push it
I just wanted to check that you're okay
Nothing
What can I do for you, traveller?
I'll have a pint.
That'll be 4 gold pieces.
I don't have enough coin.
I can't just be handing out free beers...
translation: 공짜 맥주를 막 나눠 줄 순 없어요...

english: Couldn't I just take one off those tables?
translation: 그럼 저 테이블에 있는 거 하나 가져가면 안 돼요?

english: ...I suppose, if that's the kind of person you are.
Thanks, Bast.
Sorry, you don't seem to have room to hold it.
translation: 죄송하지만 들 자리가 없으신 것 같네요.

english: Oops!
What is this place?
My pub's called The Legless Faun. It's where all the newcomers find themselves after the long voyage from the east. A good drink takes the edge off, y'know? So, fancy a pint?
translation: 제 술집 이름은 The Legless Faun(곤드레만드레 파우누스)예요. 동쪽에서 긴 항해를 마친 신입들이 다들 여기로 흘러들어 오죠. 좋은 술 한 잔이면 피로가 좀 풀리잖아요? 그래서, 한 잔 어때요?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Veos(베오스)가 무슨 일로 도움을 구하고 있대요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스) 부두 근처에 자주 있어요.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 문제가 생겼대요. 갱단들이 손을 잡았다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 아들 하나를 잃어버렸다더군요. 무사히 데려오면 Hosidius(호시디우스) 가문에서 사례를 두둑이 할지도 몰라요.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)가 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할 거예요.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 통치자들이 일거리를 갖고 있다더라고요. Lovakengj Assembly(로바켕기 의회)에 가 보면 만날 수 있어요.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 한복판에서 무슨 소동이 있었대요. 가 볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성) 밖의 시위가 점점 주목을 끌고 있어요. 한번 가 볼 만할 거예요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
Could I get something to eat?
Sure, we sell stew made at The Golden Field pub for 25 gold pieces.
translation: 그럼요, The Golden Field(황금 들판) 주점에서 만든 stew(스튜)를 25골드에 팔아요.

english: Would you like a bowl?
Yes please, sounds great.
Are you sure you have enough money?
Oh... You're right, I don't have enough money.
That's ok, come back when you have enough money.
No thanks.
Suit yourself. More delicious stew for everyone else.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 다른 사람들이 맛있는 스튜를 더 먹으면 되죠.

english: I'm afraid not as I've something to attend to.
A wise man once told me to never fear a drink... But perhaps I'm a little bias.
translation: 어떤 현명한 분이 술은 절대 두려워하지 말라고 하셨죠... 뭐, 제가 좀 편파적일 수도 있지만요.

english: I'll have a pint.
What is this place?
Sure, I'll have a pint.
I'm afraid not.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Could I get something to eat?
Yes please, sounds great.
No thanks.
Hail Saradomin!
Feel the wrath of Saradomin.
Hail Zamorak!
Feel the wrath of Zamorak.
Hail Guthix!
Feel the wrath of Guthix.
How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
translation: 우드척이 나무를 척척 던질 수 있다면, 우드척은 나무를 얼마나 척척 던질까?

english: Approximately 32,768 depending on his woodcutting level.
What did the oak tree drop?
What?
A-corny joke!
translation: 도토리... 가 아니라 참~ 썰렁한 농담!

english: Aaaaaaaan I, willow-ays love youuu.
Why do maple trees not try to explore new lands?
translation: 단풍나무가 새로운 땅을 탐험하지 않는 이유는?

english: Why?
They're afraid of treespassing.
Can we teak a break? My legs are tired.
translation: 우리 잠깐 티크타임 좀 가질까? 다리가 아파.

english: If you had a pet pig, you could call it ma-hog-eat-any.
translation: 애완 돼지를 키우면 이름은 '마호가니'로 지어. 마도, 호박도, 가지도, 니 밥도 다 먹을 테니까.

english: Is there anything I can't eat?
Yew are a great companion.
Yew are too kind, my furry little friend.
translation: 너야말로 주목받아 마땅하지, 털북숭이 꼬마 친구야.

english: I'm feeling blue today...
Anything I can do to cheer you up?
translation: 기운 나게 해 줄 방법 없을까?

english: A dam and some logs could be some fun....
translation: 댐이랑 통나무 좀 있으면 재밌을 텐데....

english: It sure is hard to cut the top off of a redwood tree... You can't take any short cuts!
translation: redwood tree(레드우드 나무) 꼭대기를 자르는 건 정말 힘들어... 지름길은 없고 자를 길만 있거든!

english: Why do I even try talking to you.
translation: 내가 왜 너랑 말을 섞으려고 하는 걸까.

english: I almost choked on a log! This is not a larching matter!
translation: 통나무에 목이 막힐 뻔했어! 이건 낙엽송... 아니, 낙관할 일이 아니라고!

english: ...maybe if we all made an underground village together...
translation: ...우리 다 같이 지하 마을을 만든다면 어쩌면...

english: What are you pondering, my furry friend?
Oh, just a grand plan to save all the wildlife from being hunted.
translation: 아, 그냥 모든 야생 동물을 사냥꾼들한테서 구할 원대한 계획이지.

english: That is quite fantastic, fox!
Hello fox, what do you say?
I do wish people would stop asking me that!
translation: 제발 다들 그 질문 좀 그만했으면 좋겠어!

english: I'm famished! Do you have any food?
I'm sure we could find you something.
translation: 분명 뭔가 찾을 수 있을 거야.

english: How about we visit a chicken coop to, uh, admire the scenery!
translation: 닭장에 가 보는 건 어때? 어, 경치 구경하러 말이야!

english: I better find you something to eat quickly.
You shake your tail feathers.
You look rather delicious today...
Ooh, don't mind if I do!
You feed the chicken to your fox.
*chomp* Delicious!
While I appreciate the offer, I won't eat any old thing!
translation: 마음은 고맙지만, 난 아무거나 먹진 않아!

english: I can't believe people try to eat us.
translation: 사람들이 우릴 먹으려 한다니 믿을 수가 없어.

english: What would you taste like? Chicken?
I'd taste fowl, you wouldn't like it at all...
translation: 난 닭살 돋는 맛일 거야. 넌 전혀 안 좋아할걸...

english: What's the Freaky Forester like?
You mean the odd fellow who recruits random adventurers to butcher an exorbitant amount of my kind daily in exchange for his spare clothing?
translation: 아무 모험가나 데려다가 자기 남는 옷을 대가로 매일 내 동족을 어마어마하게 도살시키는 그 괴상한 녀석 말이지?

english: Why yes, he's simply delightful...
You look a bit on edge. Are you okay?
I have the strangest urge to run infront of a fast moving adventurer...
translation: 빠르게 달리는 모험가 앞으로 뛰어들고 싶은 이상한 충동이 들어...

english: Redberries! Please and thank you!
You feed the berries to your pheasant.
*chomp* Scrummy!
Bwak! I am not some common fowl that will eat anything, I have standards!
translation: 꿩! 난 아무거나 먹는 흔한 새가 아니야, 나도 기준이 있다고!

english: Eww! What is that spell? Why would I want to chew on that? It stinks!
translation: 으웩! 이게 무슨 냄새야? 내가 왜 이걸 씹어야 해? 냄새 지독해!

english: What's this strange coating on the log?
translation: 통나무에 묻은 이 이상한 건 뭐야?

english: Olive oil blessed at an alter deep in Morytania. The oil helps with burning the shades in the area.
translation: Morytania(모리타니아) 깊은 곳의 제단에서 축복받은 올리브유야. 그 지역 셰이드를 태우는 데 도움이 되지.

english: ...and you want me to chew on it?
Well...
That's a hard pass from me.
There's something not quite right about this log.
What do you mean?
I'm not sure, it looks like it's in pain, maybe a little... achey?
translation: 잘 모르겠는데, 아파하는 것 같아. 혹시... 아치~ 아프지?

english: Sigh...
*sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These may look like logs but they stink of iron, what do I look like a rock golem?
translation: *킁킁* *킁킁* 사양할게. 통나무처럼 생겼는데 쇠 냄새가 진동해. 내가 rock golem(바위 골렘)으로 보여?

english: *sniff* *sniff* No thanks. These logs smell just a bit too botanical for my liking. More of a beer beaver myself.
translation: *킁킁* *킁킁* 사양할게. 이 통나무는 내 취향에 비해 풀 냄새가 너무 나. 난 맥주파 비버라고.

english: Wow, that was awesome! You've really opened my eyes to the different types of logs out there in the world. I'll happily take any others you have!
translation: 와, 정말 끝내줬어! 덕분에 세상에 얼마나 다양한 통나무가 있는지 눈을 뜨게 됐어. 다른 것도 있으면 얼마든지 받을게!

english: Your pet Beaver may enjoy this more.
translation: Beaver(비버) 펫이 이걸 더 좋아할지도 모른다.

english: What a splendid noise!
Feathers?! How novel!
You can change the colour of your pet Beaver by feeding it different types of logs.
translation: Beaver(비버) 펫에게 여러 종류의 통나무를 먹이면 색깔을 바꿀 수 있다.

english: You can unlock other forms for your pet Beaver by finding special items during Woodcutting events.
translation: Woodcutting(벌목) 이벤트 중 특별한 아이템을 찾으면 Beaver(비버) 펫의 다른 모습을 해금할 수 있다.

english: Your pet is already a Beaver.
Your pet is already a Fox.
Your pet is already a Pheasant.
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Grrrr!
Rowr!
Bwak!
Bwaak bwak!
*Peck*
Yes.
Yes, I'd like to treat my beaver.
No, it's fine as it is.
No.
Beaver
Fox
Pheasant
Cancel
Hello Effendi! How can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat. We can sell you very reasonably priced water...
translation: 이곳은 Bedabin(베다빈)의 야영지요. 우리 족장 Al Shabim(알 샤빔)과 이야기해 보시오, 기꺼이 이야기를 나눠 줄 거요. 우린 아주 적당한 값에 물도 팔고 있소...

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
It is North East of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip, can I interest you in a drink?
translation: 여기서 북동쪽이오, 에펜디. 길도 없는 사막을 건너야 하지. 목마른 여정이 될 텐데, 물 한잔 사 가지 않겠소?

english: Okay, thanks
What is this place?
Where is the Shantay Pass?
What do you have to sell?
Okay, thanks
Hello Effendi! How can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the camp of the Bedabin. Talk to our leader, Al Shabim, he'll be happy to chat.
translation: 이곳은 Bedabin(베다빈)의 야영지요. 우리 족장 Al Shabim(알 샤빔)과 이야기해 보시오, 기꺼이 이야기를 나눠 줄 거요.

english: Where is the Shantay Pass?
It is north-east of here effendi, across the trackless desert. It will be a thirsty trip!
translation: 여기서 북동쪽이오, 에펜디. 길도 없는 사막을 건너야 하지. 목마른 여정이 될 거요!

english: Okay, thanks
What is this place?
Where is the Shantay Pass?
Okay, thanks
Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. But thanks for all your help with the Bedabin people.
translation: 미안하지만 허락 없이는 천막을 쓸 수 없소. 그래도 Bedabin(베다빈) 사람들을 도와준 건 고맙소.

english: Sorry, but you can't use the tent without permission. Orders of Al Shabim.
translation: 미안하지만 허락 없이는 천막을 쓸 수 없소. Al Shabim(알 샤빔)의 명령이오.

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 너는 어떤데, 그... 뭐더라. 네가 먹고살려고 하는 그 일 말이야.

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 처치하거나, 사람들 부탁으로 세상 곳곳에 물건을 배달하는 거죠.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 어머니가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 아주 고통스러운 출산이었대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 한가하게 얘기할 틈이 없어. 밀항자랑 수다 떨면서 농땡이 치는 걸 선장님한테 들켰다간 내 창자를 뽑아 밧줄로 쓰실 거야.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 알았어 [guy/lady]. 네가 누구든 상관없이 혼나는 건 나라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적 생활이 실제로 어떤 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 글쎄, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 이것저것 질문받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탔다고요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했어요! 물어보세요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어 [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 들키지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 반가워 [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴인데, 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 배에 탔어?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 준다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 정말? 내가 보기엔 Fremennik(프레메닉) 같지 않은데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 미안, 그럼 들을 시간이 없겠네! 나중에 또 보자고, 프레메닉인-듯-프레메닉-아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 근처는 얼마나 추운지, 말을 하면 말이 눈앞에서 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 진짜는 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 부풀린 거야. 그래도 엄청나게 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 거기 서라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 제발 그렇게 말하지 마. 엄청 짜증 나거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지도 마. 그게 뭔지는 모르겠지만.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자가 탔다! 밀항자가 탔다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 진짜예요! 초대받아서 왔다고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 밀항자처럼 생긴 건 인정해야 할 거야.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 만나 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 급여 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있긴 하지.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 좋아. 약탈할 수 있는 그로그랑 전리품은 전부 우리 거고, 치과까지 포함된 의료 혜택도 완벽하거든.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 그런 건 아니고. 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 우리가 나을 때까지 안 놔주는 거지.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 얼마나 훌륭한 진료를 끌어내는 동기가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)에는 무슨 일로 탔어?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아갈 계획이었는데, 이 배 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그래, 정말 미인이지! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)는 폭풍 속에서도 땡볕 속에서도 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었어. 그리고 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳에 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 손꼽히게 멋진 배인 건 확실해요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
I'm sorry to bother you, [player name], but I need some help with a bee hive.
translation: 방해해서 미안해요, [player name]님. 그런데 벌집 일로 도움이 좀 필요해요.

english: Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
Player is teleported to a field of beehives
Buzz off!
Ah, [player name]. I'm sorry to drag you away like this, but I need some help building a new hive for my bees.
translation: 아, [player name]님. 이렇게 갑자기 끌고 와서 미안해요. 그런데 우리 벌들에게 새 벌집을 지어 주는 걸 좀 도와줬으면 해요.

english: What do you expect me to do?
All the parts of the beehive are jumbled up. You've got to put them in the correct order for building a hive.
translation: 벌집 부품이 전부 뒤죽박죽 섞여 버렸어요. 벌집을 지을 수 있게 부품을 올바른 순서로 맞춰야 해요.

english: Oh, very well. Let's take a look...
Ready to try again?
First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 먼저 제가 뭘 하는 건지 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
No, that doesn't look right. You have to put the parts in the right order, otherwise it'll be no good as a beehive.
translation: 아니요, 그건 아닌 것 같아요. 부품을 올바른 순서로 맞춰야 해요. 안 그러면 벌집으로 쓸 수가 없어요.

english: I'll let you have 5 more tries.
I'll let you have 4 more tries.
I'll let you have 3 more tries.
I'll let you have 2 more tries.
I'll let you have one more try.
Uh-oh, the bees are fed up with waiting for you to build them a home!
translation: 이런, 벌들이 집 지어 주기를 기다리다 지쳐 버렸어요!

english: Three bee swarms start stinging the player, while the player runs around for a while and attempts to defend themself helplessly.
translation: 벌 떼 세 무리가 플레이어를 쏘기 시작하고, 플레이어는 한동안 이리저리 뛰어다니며 속수무책으로 막아 보려 한다.

english: Aaaaargh - BEES!
Ooch!
Eek!
Beees!
Ow!
I'll help you!
The bee keeper starts casting a tele-other spell.
translation: 양봉가가 텔레 아더 주문을 외우기 시작한다.

english: The bee keeper obligingly teleports you away from the angry swarms.
translation: 양봉가가 친절하게도 성난 벌 떼에게서 당신을 순간이동시켜 빼내 준다.

english: Player is teleported back to their original location, with no reward and no losses.
translation: 플레이어가 원래 있던 곳으로 순간이동된다. 보상도 손실도 없다.

english: That's perfect! I'll get some bees moved in immediately.
Now, I'm sure I must have something to offer you for all your help...
translation: 자, 이렇게 도와줬으니 분명 뭔가 드릴 게 있을 텐데...

english: Player is teleported back to their original location
Sorry, you're not the person I need.
Goodbye.
Hello, [player name]?
Please help me, [player name].
I need your help, [player name]!
Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
Maybe later.
Ooh, a bee hive. I'll help you.
Buzz off!
First remind me of what I'm doing.
translation: 먼저 제가 뭘 하는 건지 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Yeah, let me get on with it.
Hello, what's going on?
Hello, it seems you've found a wild bee hive. I'll pay you to help me rehome them.
translation: 안녕하세요, 야생 벌집을 찾으셨나 보네요. 벌들을 새집으로 옮기는 걸 도와주시면 보수를 드릴게요.

english: Oh, well, if you ever want to find out how to help, just ask.
translation: 아, 그럼 나중에라도 어떻게 돕는지 알고 싶으면 언제든 물어보세요.

english: It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I create. Most common types of log work just fine.
translation: 간단해요. 제가 만드는 미완성 벌통에 통나무를 넣기만 하면 돼요. 흔한 통나무는 대부분 다 괜찮아요.

english: Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's see how many of these bees we can save.
translation: 벌통 하나가 완성되면 제가 새 벌통을 만들기 시작할게요. 벌을 얼마나 많이 구할 수 있는지 봐요.

english: Oh, Bees!
I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
translation: 저 벌들에게 멋진 새집을 찾아 줄게요.

english: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
translation: 이리 오렴, 꼬마 벌들아. 내가 지켜 줄게.

english: Another new hive.
Well, I must be getting on now.
I'm not interested.
How can I help?
Please kind [sir/lady]... my family and I are starving...
translation: 자비로우신 [sir/lady]님... 제 가족과 저는 굶주리고 있습니다...

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: 부디 자비를 베푸시어 bread(빵) 한 덩이만 나눠 주실 수 없겠습니까?

english: Yes certainly.
... except I don't have any bread on me at the moment...
translation: ... 그런데 지금은 빵을 갖고 있지 않네요...

english: Well if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 그럼 빵이 생기면, 어디로 오시면 되는지 아시지요.

english: Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
translation: 거지가 Lady of the Lake(호수의 여인)으로 변했다!

english: Well done. You have passed my test.
Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
translation: 여기 Excalibur(엑스칼리버)를 내리니, 잘 지키도록 하라.

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
Have you got any bread for me yet?
Yes, here you go.
