Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: 아, 제가 착각했어요. 아직 빵이 없네요. 미안해요.

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
The beggar isn't interested in talking.
Yes certainly.
No I don't have any bread with me.
Yes, here you go.
No, I still have none.
Well hello there sweetheart.
Hi!
What brings you down here?
I'm looking for the Easter Bunny.
Fancy that! You're in luck, he's in the next room.
translation: 어머나! 운이 좋네요, 그는 옆방에 있어요.

english: I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any suggestions?
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 기운을 북돋아 주려고 하는데, 좋은 생각 없어요?

english: Hmm, well, he's a sensible bunny, I'm sure he'd love to go carrot bowling!
translation: 흠, 글쎄요, 그는 분별 있는 토끼니까 분명 당근 볼링을 좋아할 거예요!

english: Bowling? Where can we do that?
It just so happens we have a carrot bowling alley right here in the Rabbit Hole!
translation: 마침 여기 Rabbit Hole(토끼굴) 안에 당근 볼링장이 있답니다!

english: Really? Wow! That's fortunate. Where is it?
translation: 정말요? 우와! 운이 좋네요. 어디에 있어요?

english: Through the door to the east, turn left, then it's on the right. You can't miss it!
translation: 동쪽 문으로 나가서 왼쪽으로 돈 다음, 오른쪽에 있어요. 못 찾을 리가 없어요!

english: Well, maybe you can. Depends on your navigational skills I suppose.
translation: 뭐, 못 찾을 수도 있겠네요. 길눈이 얼마나 밝은지에 달렸겠죠.

english: Anyway, talk to Bowley Moley when you get there, I'm sure he will be happy to help.
translation: 아무튼 거기 가면 Bowley Moley(볼리 몰리)에게 말을 걸어 봐요. 기꺼이 도와줄 거예요.

english: Alright, I'll have a look for this bowling alley and speak to Bowley Moley. Thanks!
translation: 좋아요, 그 볼링장을 찾아서 볼리 몰리랑 얘기해 볼게요. 고마워요!

english: Look who it is! I heard the Easter Bunny gave you a true thrashing on that alley.
translation: 이게 누구야! Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 볼링장에서 당신을 아주 박살 냈다면서요.

english: Oh yeah, I got outplayed fair and square!
It seems to have lifted his spirits somewhat, thanks for doing that.
translation: 덕분에 그의 기분이 좀 나아진 것 같아요. 그렇게 해 줘서 고마워요.

english: I'm just glad to cheer him up a bit.
Hey, [player name]. I thought it was really sweet of you to help cheer up that bunny.
translation: 저기, [player name]. 그 토끼를 기운 나게 도와준 거, 정말 다정했어요.

english: Maybe we could go bowling sometime and you could cheer me up too?
translation: 언젠가 우리 같이 볼링 치러 가서, 이번엔 나도 기운 나게 해 줄래요?

english: That would be fun, though I'm quite busy at the moment, and in the near future.
translation: 재밌겠네요. 그런데 지금은 꽤 바빠서요, 가까운 미래에도요.

english: What about the far future?
Oh the far future is looking very busy for me.
translation: 아, 먼 미래도 엄청 바빠 보여요.

english: But if I find the time, we could invite the Easter Bunny too! We'd all have a great game I'm sure.
translation: 그래도 시간이 나면 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)도 같이 부르면 되겠어요! 다 같이 정말 즐거운 게임이 될 거예요.

english: Oh, I see. Nevermind then, if you're so busy.
Hello puss.
Hiss!
Hello human.
Would you like a fish?
I don't want your fish. I hunt and eat what I need by myself.
translation: 네 물고기 따윈 필요 없어. 난 필요한 건 직접 사냥해서 먹으니까.

english: Hello human.
What do you do here?
This guild contains minerals that haven't been found anywhere else. I'm here to try and identify them.
translation: 이 길드에는 다른 어디에서도 발견된 적 없는 광물이 있어요. 저는 그걸 감정하려고 여기 있는 거예요.

english: If you come across any unusual minerals when mining here I'll take them off your hands. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 여기서 채광하다가 특이한 광물을 발견하면 제가 맡아 드릴게요. 걱정 마세요, 손해 보지 않게 해 드릴 테니까요.

english: I've also been digging out this cave recently. I found a bunch of amethyst in there.
translation: 최근에 이 동굴도 파내고 있었는데, 안에서 amethyst(자수정)을 잔뜩 찾았어요.

english: What can you offer me?
I have some gloves that will help you when Mining. When you wear these gloves you'll find that some rocks will instantly respawn.
translation: Mining(채광)할 때 도움이 되는 장갑이 있어요. 이 장갑을 끼면 일부 바위가 곧바로 다시 생겨나요.

english: How do they do that?
Magic!
Beyond that, I could consider letting you access this new cave. It seems to contain even more minerals.
translation: 그 밖에도 이 새 동굴에 들어가게 해 줄지 생각해 볼 수 있어요. 광물이 훨씬 더 많은 것 같거든요.

english: So, what would you like?
I'd like access to the cave.
Now hold on. There's a lot of minerals in there, and digging out the cave was hard work. Only a true friend of Falador would be allowed in there.
translation: 잠깐만요. 저 안에는 광물이 아주 많고, 동굴을 파내느라 정말 고생했어요. Falador(팔라도르)의 진정한 친구만 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: You don't seem like you're quite there yet. Come speak to me again once you have completed the Elite Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: 아직은 거기까지 못 된 것 같네요. Elite Falador Achievement Diary(팔라도르 엘리트 업적 일지)를 완료하고 나서 다시 말을 걸어 주세요.

english: And you truly are a friend of Falador. Well done on completing the Elite Falador Achievement Diary. Go on in, you may access the cave.
translation: 정말로 Falador(팔라도르)의 친구가 되셨군요. Elite Falador Achievement Diary(팔라도르 엘리트 업적 일지) 완료를 축하해요. 들어가세요, 동굴에 들어가도 좋아요.

english: That's all thank you.
Don't forget to come to me if you find any minerals.
translation: 광물을 찾으면 잊지 말고 저한테 가져오세요.

english: I don't want to receive minerals.
Very well. You'll no longer find any minerals when you mine here. If you change your mind just let me know.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제 여기서 채광해도 광물이 나오지 않을 거예요. 마음이 바뀌면 말해 주세요.

english: I'd like to receive minerals.
As you wish. You'll now find minerals when you mine here. Let me know if you want to change this.
translation: 원하시는 대로요. 이제 여기서 채광하면 광물이 나올 거예요. 바꾸고 싶으면 말해 주세요.

english: Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 제 mining gloves(채광 장갑)을 합쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: I guess I could combine some Mining gloves with some Superior mining gloves. These new gloves would require 70 Mining to equip.
translation: Mining gloves(채광 장갑)과 Superior mining gloves(고급 채광 장갑)을 합쳐 줄 수는 있겠네요. 새 장갑을 착용하려면 Mining(채광) 레벨 70이 필요해요.

english: It wouldn't be free though. I'd want 60 minerals in return.
translation: 그래도 공짜는 아니에요. 대가로 광물 60개를 받아야겠어요.

english: You don't have any gloves for me to combine. You'll need to bring me some Mining gloves and some Superior mining gloves.
translation: 합칠 장갑이 없네요. Mining gloves(채광 장갑)과 Superior mining gloves(고급 채광 장갑)을 가져와야 해요.

english: There you go. I've combined your gloves into some Expert mining gloves. Enjoy.
translation: 여기 있어요. 장갑을 합쳐서 Expert mining gloves(전문가용 채광 장갑)으로 만들었어요. 잘 쓰세요.

english: Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요. 마음이 바뀌면 저는 여기 있을게요.

english: Hey, you! You're not allowed in there! Come speak to me first.
translation: 이봐요, 거기! 거긴 들어가면 안 돼요! 먼저 저한테 와서 얘기하세요.

english: I'm sorry.
I have minerals to trade.
What can you offer me?
I'd like to view the shop.
I'd like access to the cave.
That's all thank you.
I don't want to receive minerals.
I'd like to receive minerals.
Can you combine my mining gloves?
translation: 제 mining gloves(채광 장갑)을 합쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: That's fine. Combine my gloves.
That's too much.
That's all.
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: vampyre(뱀파이어)가 되지 않게 구해 줘서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 certificate(증명서)를 받아 주세요. 미안하지만 보답으로 드릴 수 있는 게 이것뿐이에요.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 원래대로 돌려놔 줘서 고마워요. 분명 힘드셨을 거예요. 저는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Can I have a newspaper, please?
Certainly, Guv. That'll be 50 coins, please.
Maybe when I've got more money on me.
translation: 돈을 좀 더 갖고 있을 때 살게요.

english: Well, no cash, no paper. Live in ignorance.
translation: 거참, 돈 없으면 신문도 없죠. 모르는 채로 사시든가요.

english: Sure, here you go...
Okay, suit yourself. Plenty more fish in the sea.
translation: 네, 좋으실 대로. 손님이야 세상에 널리고 널렸으니까요.

english: How much does a paper cost?
Just 50 coins! An absolute bargain! Want one?
Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: Varrock Herald(바록 헤럴드)요? 처음 들어 보는데요.

english: For the illiterate amongst us, I shall elucidate. The Varrock Herald is a new newspaper. It is edited, printed and published by myself, Benny Gutenberg, and each edition promises to enthrall the reader with
translation: 글 모르시는 분들을 위해 친히 설명해 드리죠. Varrock Herald(바록 헤럴드)는 새로 나온 신문입니다. 바로 저, Benny Gutenberg(베니 구텐베르크)가 편집하고 인쇄하고 발행하며, 매호마다 독자를 사로잡을

english: captivating material! Now, can I interest you in buying one for a mere 50 coins?
translation: 흥미진진한 기사를 약속하죠! 자, 단돈 50코인에 한 부 사시겠어요?

english: Anything interesting in there?
Of course there is, mate. Packed full of thought provoking insights, contentious interviews and celebrity scandalmongering! An excellent read and all for just 50 coins! Want one?
translation: 당연하죠, 형씨. 생각할 거리를 던지는 통찰, 논란의 인터뷰, 유명인 스캔들까지 꽉꽉 들어찼다고요! 끝내주는 읽을거리가 단돈 50코인! 하나 사실래요?

english: Read all about it!
Extra! Extra! Read all about it!
Buy your Varrock Herald now!
Varrock Herald, now only 50 coins!
Get you Varrock Herald here!
Varrock Herald, on sale here!
Can I have a newspaper, please?
Sure, here you go...
No, thanks.
How much does a paper cost?
Varrock Herald? Never heard of it.
translation: Varrock Herald(바록 헤럴드)요? 처음 들어 보는데요.

english: Anything interesting in there?
Do you mind? You're in my home.
translation: 이봐, 지금 뭐 하는 거야? 여긴 내 집이라고.

english: I'm sorry, should I have knocked?
Very funny, human.
We can't all live in plush houses, you know. But that doesn't mean us mining dwarves don't work hard.
translation: 다들 호화로운 집에서 살 수는 없잖아. 그렇다고 우리 광부 드워프들이 열심히 일하지 않는다는 건 아니야.

english: Where do you do your mining?
Normally the coal mine to the north. We need a lot of coal to keep our steam engines going, you know.
translation: 보통은 북쪽 석탄 광산이지. 증기 기관을 계속 돌리려면 석탄이 엄청 필요하거든.

english: Can I do a bit of mining there as well?
translation: 저도 거기서 채광 좀 해도 돼요?

english: I'm not sure, but as long as no one notices I don't think anyone is going to care.
translation: 글쎄, 아무도 눈치채지만 않으면 딱히 신경 쓸 사람은 없을 거야.

english: How are your grapes coming along?
Marvellously, thanks to your help, [player name]!
Hello.
Good day, adventurer. If you have any questions, I'm sure Lars will be more than happy to answer them. He's in the building to the south.
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. 궁금한 게 있으면 Lars(라르스)가 기꺼이 대답해 줄 거예요. 남쪽 건물에 있어요.

english: Also don't forget to visit my sister's axe shop. She works in the same building as Lars.
translation: 제 여동생의 도끼 상점에도 꼭 들러 주세요. 라르스와 같은 건물에서 일해요.

english: Thanks!
Welcome to the Woodcutting Guild, adventurer.
translation: Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드)에 오신 걸 환영해요, 모험가님.

english: Bert! Good news!
Arrr...Good news be always handy.
They arrested Sandy for the murder of a wizard and the sand pit now refills itself!
translation: Sandy(샌디)가 wizard(마법사) 살인죄로 체포됐고, sand pit(모래 구덩이)도 이제 저절로 채워진대요!

english: ME JOB! I'VE LOSTED ME JOB! 'ow c'n yer say tha' be good news?? Me wife'll tear me limb fr'm limb!
translation: 내 일자리! 내 일자리를 잃어부렀당께! 그게 어째서 좋은 소식이여?? 우리 마누라가 내 사지를 갈기갈기 찢어 놓을 것이여!

english: Don't worry, the Wizardsare going to pay you a large pension so that you can retire...
translation: 걱정 마세요, Wizards(마법사단)이 은퇴할 수 있게 연금을 두둑이 준대요...

english: Bu' wha'll I be doin' wit' me day now! I be lovin' tha sand.
translation: 근디 인자 하루 종일 뭘 하고 산당가! 난 그 모래가 좋았단 말이여.

english: What will you do with your day? Well....You could build sand castles with your own two hands!
translation: 하루 종일 뭘 하냐고요? 음.... 직접 두 손으로 모래성을 쌓으면 되잖아요!

english: I din't think so... bu' iffen yer ever need someone ta haul buckets o'sand 'round, ye be lettin' me know [player name], I's can help yer!
translation: 그건 아닌 것 같은디... 근디 혹시 모래 양동이 날라 줄 사람이 필요하믄 나한테 말하랑께, [player name]. 내가 도와줄 수 있응께!

english: Wow! That would be great, buckets of sand direct to bank everdayyou say? That's great!
translation: 우와! 그거 정말 좋겠네요. 매일 모래 양동이를 은행으로 바로 보내 준다고요? 최고예요!

english: Once per day you may ask Bert to help you by carrying 84 buckets of sand to your bank. Just talk to him!
translation: 하루에 한 번 Bert(버트)에게 부탁하면 모래 양동이 84개를 은행으로 옮겨 준다. 그에게 말을 걸기만 하면 된다!

english: 'Ello there [player name]!
Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
translation: 모래 좀 제 은행으로 배달해 주실래요?

english: Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.
translation: 이이, 니 은행에 빈자리가 하나도 없구먼, [player name]. 생선이랑 장화 사이에 자리 좀 만들고 다시 오랑께.

english: Ok, I'll make some more space in my bank and come back!
translation: 알겠어요, 은행에 자리를 좀 만들고 다시 올게요!

english: I'll see you another time.
Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
translation: 모래 좀 제 은행으로 배달해 주실래요?

english: I'll see you another time.
Sorry I'm not into magic.
Well, if you see anyone who is into magic, please send them my way.
translation: 그래, 마법에 관심 있는 사람을 보거든 나한테 보내 주렴.

english: I heard from Zavistic what a good job you did. If you want some more pink dye, I have made up a batch and you can have some for 20 gold.
translation: Zavistic(자비스틱)한테서 네가 아주 잘해 냈다고 들었단다. pink dye(분홍 염료)가 더 필요하면, 내가 한 통 만들어 뒀으니 20골드에 주마.

english: Yes please!
You hand over 20 gold pieces in return for the dye
I've come from Yanille, the wizard says you can make Truth Serum?
translation: Yanille(야닐)에서 왔는데요, 마법사가 당신이 Truth Serum(자백제)를 만들 수 있다던데요?

english: This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
translation: 그렇단다, 얘야. empty vial(빈 약병)이 하나 필요하구나.

english: I have one here!
That's good, now you'll need to make a rose tinted lens. Pink dye can be made from red berries in this bottle to make redberry juice, then add white berries. Just use that on a bullseye lens.
translation: 좋아, 이제 장밋빛 렌즈를 만들어야 한단다. 이 병에 레드베리를 넣어 redberry juice(레드베리 주스)를 만들고, white berries(흰 열매)를 넣으면 pink dye(분홍 염료)가 된단다. 그걸 bullseye lens(불스아이 렌즈)에 쓰기만 하면 돼.

english: Hello deary! Have you managed to make that lens yet?
translation: 어서 오렴, 얘야! 그 렌즈는 만들었니?

english: I'm still working on it.
I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
Pink dye can be made from red berries in the bottle I gave you. Add white berries to make the pink dye and then you just need to use that on a bullseye lens. Good luck!
translation: 내가 준 병에 레드베리를 넣으면 돼. 거기에 white berries(흰 열매)를 넣어서 pink dye(분홍 염료)를 만든 다음, bullseye lens(불스아이 렌즈)에 쓰기만 하면 된단다. 행운을 빌마!

english: Wonderful deary. When you're ready, just stand in the open doorway and focus the light on the empty vial on my desk and I'll pour the serum into it.
translation: 잘했구나, 얘야. 준비가 되면 열린 문간에 서서 내 책상 위에 있는 빈 약병에 빛을 모으렴. 그러면 거기에 약을 부어 주마.

english: Ok, what does that do?
Why it makes the person who drinks it unable to hide in the shadow of lies. The light of truth will shine!
translation: 아니, 그걸 마신 사람은 거짓의 그림자 속에 숨을 수 없게 된단다. 진실의 빛이 환히 비출 테니까!

english: Ok, now the last ingredient, something personal from the person you need to tell the truth, else it won't work!
translation: 자, 이제 마지막 재료란다. 진실을 털어놓게 할 사람의 개인 물건이 필요해. 안 그러면 효과가 없거든!

english: What about this sand straight from his pocket?
translation: 그 사람 주머니에서 바로 꺼낸 이 sand(모래)는 어때요?

english: That's excellent deary!
Don't forget to dilute it in something like tea or coffee.
translation: 차나 커피 같은 데 타서 묽게 먹이는 걸 잊지 말거라.

english: Hello deary! How did the serum work?
translation: 어서 오렴, 얘야! 약은 효과가 있었니?

english: I haven't tried it yet.
Well don't forget to dilute it in a drink or something else bad things might happen.
translation: 그럼 잊지 말고 음료 같은 데 꼭 타서 묽게 쓰거라. 안 그러면 안 좋은 일이 생길지도 몰라.

english: Bad things?
Well.... bits might drop off.
translation: 글쎄.... 몸 어딘가가 떨어져 나갈지도 모르지.

english: Oh! I... see. I'll remember to dilute it then.
translation: 아! 그... 그렇군요. 꼭 묽게 쓸게요.

english: Good job. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 잘했구나. 너한테 알려 줄 새로운 소식이 있단다.

english: Can I see your wares?
Sorry I'm not into magic.
No thanks Betty
Yes please!
Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.
translation: Betty(베티)와 Hand in the Sand(모래 속의 손)에 대해 이야기하기.

english: Talk to Betty about her shop.
I'm still working on it.
I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 가게 아저씨가 우리 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 안 주고 혼자 다 가지려고 해.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 그건 좀 이상한데. 정말 그 사람이 그러는 거 맞아?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 당연하지, 그게 아니면 왜 하나도 안 주겠어?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 뭔가 이상해. Santa(산타)한테 가서 무슨 일인지 알아봐야겠다.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 맘대로 해, 난 진저브레드 노움이 갖고 싶다고!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 아직도 여기 있니? 내가 크리스마스를 구했으니까 이제 집에 가도 돼.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 아직 배달이 올 때까지 기다려야 하거든, 바보야.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
I have much tidying to do, so please be brief.
translation: 정리할 것이 많으니, 용건은 간단히 말씀해 주십시오.

english: I'm looking for a book:[book]
Try the [bottom/middle/top] floor, [central area/north-eastern bay/south-eastern bay/south-western bay/north-western bay].
translation: [bottom/middle/top] 층의 [central area/north-eastern bay/south-eastern bay/south-western bay/north-western bay] 쪽을 찾아보십시오.

english: Thank you.
What do you do here?
I assist the Chief Librarian, Logosia, in the running of the Library. There is always much tidying to be done.
translation: 저는 수석 사서이신 Logosia(로고시아) 님을 도와 도서관 운영을 맡고 있습니다. 정리할 것이 끝도 없지요.

english: Logosia is a truly great scholar, but her temperament may not be entirely suited to the duties of a librarian.
translation: 로고시아 님은 정말 위대한 학자이시지만, 그 기질이 사서 업무에 꼭 맞는다고는 하기 어렵습니다.

english: Okay, thanks.
I'll be off.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 찢어진 clue scroll(단서 두루마리) 조각을 건네받았다.

english: Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
translation: dark manuscript(어둠의 필사본) 같은 거 본 적 있어요?

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 저기요, 드릴 것이 있는데 소지품에 자리가 없으시군요!

english: I'm looking for a book...
What do you do here?
I'll be off.
Have you seen any dark manuscripts?
translation: dark manuscript(어둠의 필사본) 같은 거 본 적 있어요?

english: Why, hello there!
Tell me about yourself.
The name is Big Mo. I was a travelling salesman and businessman, passing through the towns to see what wares I could get my hands on.
translation: 내 이름은 Big Mo(빅 모)일세. 떠돌이 행상이자 사업가였지. 여러 마을을 돌며 손에 넣을 만한 물건이 있나 살펴보곤 했다네.

english: I do remember buying clue scrolls off you, long ago.
translation: 예전에 당신한테서 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 산 기억이 나요.

english: Yes, I was selling them to encourage people to explore. I'd only sell each person one clue scroll per day, of course.
translation: 그래, 사람들이 탐험을 하도록 북돋우려고 팔았지. 물론 한 사람당 하루에 단서 두루마리 하나씩만 팔았다네.

english: Goodbye.
Where were you from originally?
HA HA HA! I deliberately didn't tell people where I was from. Mostly they assumed me to be from Zeah.
translation: 하하하! 일부러 어디서 왔는지 아무한테도 말하지 않았지. 사람들은 대개 내가 Zeah(제아) 출신이라고 짐작하더군.

english: That may or may not be true, though - no-one else in Zeah looks much like me. I'll leave it as a mystery...
translation: 하지만 그게 사실일 수도, 아닐 수도 있지. 제아에는 나처럼 생긴 사람이 별로 없거든. 그냥 수수께끼로 남겨 두겠네...

english: Who are you?
The name is Big Mo. I'm a travelling salesman and businessman from overseas.
translation: 내 이름은 Big Mo(빅 모)일세. 바다 건너에서 온 떠돌이 행상이자 사업가지.

english: I drop by these parts every so often to see what wares I can get my hands on.
translation: 이따금 이 근방에 들러 손에 넣을 만한 물건이 있나 살펴본다네.

english: What do you mean by 'overseas'? Karamja?
Ha! It seems you've got a lot of the world left to explore. hey, maybe I could help you with that.
translation: 하! 자네는 아직 탐험할 세상이 한참 남은 것 같군. 그래, 내가 그걸 좀 도와줄 수도 있겠어.

english: Exploration? I'm listening...
When I buy stock, I buy almost everything I can get my hands on. I always end up finding clue scrolls mixed in with my stock.
translation: 나는 물건을 사들일 때 손에 잡히는 건 거의 전부 사들인다네. 그러다 보면 항상 물건 사이에 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)가 섞여 있더군.

english: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself? Wouldn't you make more money?
translation: 왜 단서 두루마리를 직접 풀지 않으세요? 그게 돈을 더 벌지 않아요?

english: HA! Sure, the guy in the 50,000,000 coin suit is going to run around all day digging holes. Come on! Now, do you want to buy one?
translation: 하! 퍽이나, 5천만 코인짜리 정장을 입은 사람이 온종일 뛰어다니며 구덩이를 파겠군. 이 사람 참! 자, 하나 사겠나?

english: Sounds good to me.
Okay, they're 50 coins each. How much of a challenge would you like? I'll take a look and see if I have a clue fitting for your experience.
translation: 좋아, 하나에 50코인일세. 어느 정도 난이도를 원하나? 자네 경험에 맞는 단서가 있는지 한번 보지.

english: The easier the better.
Perfect! I've got just the clue right here. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 딱 좋군! 마침 맞는 단서가 여기 있네. 거래해서 즐거웠네!

english: If you can track me down again another day I will do my best to have the perfect clue for you. Good luck.
translation: 다른 날 또 나를 찾아낸다면, 자네에게 꼭 맞는 단서를 준비해 두도록 하지. 행운을 비네.

english: Not too easy, not too hard.
I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: 도전이 좋아요. 머리 좀 쥐어짜게 하는 걸로 주세요.

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
translation: 구할 수 있는 것 중에 제일 어려운 단서를 주세요.

english: Forget it, I changed my mind.
No thanks.
Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: 탐험이요? 듣기만 해도 피곤하네요. 전 갈게요.

english: Why, hello there! Want to buy another clue scroll?
translation: 어이쿠, 반갑네! clue scroll(단서 두루마리) 하나 더 사겠나?

english: Why don't you do the cluue scrolls yourself?
translation: 왜 단서 두루마리를 직접 풀지 않으세요?

english: I'm afraid this is the best I can do right now. Pleasure doing business with you!
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 이게 최선일세. 거래해서 즐거웠네!

english: Tell me about yourself.
Where were you from originally?
Goodbye.
Exploration? I'm listening...
Sounds good to me.
The easier the better.
Not too easy, not too hard.
I like a challenge. Give me one to wrinkle my brain.
translation: 도전이 좋아요. 머리 좀 쥐어짜게 하는 걸로 주세요.

english: Give me the hardest clue you can get your hands on.
translation: 구할 수 있는 것 중에 제일 어려운 단서를 주세요.

english: Forget it, I changed my mind.
No thanks.
Exploration? Sounds exhausting. I'm off.
translation: 탐험이요? 듣기만 해도 피곤하네요. 전 갈게요.

english: Why don't you do the cluue scrolls yourself?
translation: 왜 단서 두루마리를 직접 풀지 않으세요?

english: Buy an easy clue.
Buy a medium clue.
Buy a hard clue.
Buy an elite clue.
Cancel
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 가게 아저씨가 우리 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 안 주고 혼자 다 가지려고 해.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 그건 좀 이상한데. 정말 그 사람이 그러는 거 맞아?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 당연하지, 그게 아니면 왜 하나도 안 주겠어?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 뭔가 이상해. Santa(산타)한테 가서 무슨 일인지 알아봐야겠다.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 맘대로 해, 난 진저브레드 노움이 갖고 싶다고!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 아직도 여기 있니? 내가 크리스마스를 구했으니까 이제 집에 가도 돼.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 아직 배달이 올 때까지 기다려야 하거든, 바보야.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
If yer after a lift go to the ship and I'll take ye where ye want to go.
translation: 얻어 타고 싶으면 배로 와라. 원하는 데 어디든 데려다주마.

english: I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right [lad/lass]?
translation: 여기 온 김에 배 좀 얻어 타고 싶겠지, 안 그러냐 [lad/lass]?

english: Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.
Ye'll notice I'm not fallin' to the floor in shock right now. Look, if I gives ye another copy will ye keep a better eye on it?
translation: 보다시피 난 놀라서 나자빠지지도 않는다. 이봐, 한 권 더 주면 이번엔 잘 간수할 테냐?

english: Aye Cap'n!
Then here, have this other copy I dug up.
translation: 그럼 옜다, 내가 찾아낸 다른 한 권이다.

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: 아니, 어차피 돌아가야 할 참이었다. 가자, [lad/lass], 출발이다.

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: 미루지 못할 일은 없지. 가자, [lad/lass], 출발이다.

english: No thanks, Cap'n.
Well, come see me if ye ever do.
Cap'n, I lost that book you gave me.
Yes Cap'n, I'd like a lift.
translation: 네, 선장님, 배 좀 태워 주세요.

english: No thanks, Cap'n.
Billy isn't interested in talking.
Hello there.
Hey! scheck it out! Itsh an outerlandub! Yer shud go shpeak to the chieftain!
translation: 헤이! 이거 바라! 외지잉이댜! 너 족짱한테 가서 얘기해 바!

english: The who?
That guy over there by that stuff! (hic) Yeh, abshoultely! He's da bosh!
translation: 저기 저 물건 옆에 있는 저 녀석! (딸꾹) 그래, 화실해! 그 녀석이 두모기야!

english: I know this is a bit of a long shot... but are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 혹시나 해서 묻는 건데요... 장로회 회원이세요?

english: I'm now a member of the counshil of eblars? Thanksh a lot buddy! (hic) Letsh have a drink to celebrate!
translation: 내가 이제 쟝노회 회원이라고? 고마어, 친구! (딸꾹) 축하주 한잔하쟈!

english: Uh... I'll take that as a no.
Hey! Itsh you again! Whatshyerfashe!
translation: 헤이! 또 너구먼! 거시기, 이름이 머더라!

english: [player name]?
Nah nah nah, not them, the other one, whatshyerfashe!
translation: 아니 아니 아니, 그거 말고, 다른 거, 거시기!

english: [Fremennik name]?
Thatsh what I said diddle I?
Um.... okay. I'll leave you to your drinking.
Thanksh pal! You're alright!
Obey the law!
Stay out of trouble!
Out of the way, human!
I'm keeping an eye on you!
The guard ignores you.
You! Human! Hands off!
Obey the law!
Stay out of trouble!
Out of the way, human!
I'm keeping an eye on you!
The guard ignores you.
I am the Black Knight Titan! You must pass through me before you can continue in this realm!
translation: 나는 Black Knight Titan(흑기사 거인)이다! 이 영역에서 더 나아가려면 나를 넘어서야 한다!

english: Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!
Puny mortal... You cannot defeat me...
translation: 하찮은 필멸자여... 너는 나를 이길 수 없다...

english: Maybe you need something more to beat the titan?
translation: 거인을 이기려면 뭔가가 더 필요할지도 모르겠다.

english: For Camelot!
Well done! You have defeated the Black Knight Titan!
translation: 잘했다! Black Knight Titan(흑기사 거인)을 물리쳤다!

english: Actually I think I'll run away!
Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!
Actually I think I'll run away!
Squeak!
Nilsal. Interested in buying some weapons or armour?
Yes please.
Do you make these yourself?
Of course, and you won't find anything finer than what I offer. I didn't become the official blacksmith to the Royal Family of Varlamore by producing subpar goods.
translation: 물론입니다. 제 물건보다 좋은 건 어디서도 찾을 수 없을 겁니다. 변변찮은 물건이나 만들어서 Varlamore(바를라모어) 왕실의 공식 대장장이가 된 게 아니니까요.

english: You're the official blacksmith? Does that mean you can sell me some armour like the knights around here wear?
translation: 공식 대장장이시라고요? 그럼 이 근처 기사들이 입는 갑옷도 파실 수 있나요?

english: Are you a Knight of Varlamore?
No.
Than I cannot. However, I still have plenty of other items that might interest you. Would you like to take a look?
translation: 그렇다면 안 됩니다. 하지만 관심 가실 만한 다른 물건도 많습니다. 한번 보시겠습니까?

english: Can you repair something for me?
translation: 뭐 좀 수리해 주실 수 있나요?

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
translation: 수리할 만한 물건을 갖고 계시지 않군요.

english: I'll need [x] coins to repair that.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
No thanks.
As you wish. You are always welcome to return if you change your mind.
translation: 원하시는 대로 하십시오. 마음이 바뀌시면 언제든 다시 오십시오.

english: Yes please.
Do you make these yourself?
Can you repair something for me?
translation: 뭐 좀 수리해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Repair that item: [x] coins.
Cancel.
No thanks.
A human? Either buy something or get out!
What do you have?
In a blacksmith? What do you think? Weapons!
I'll get going.
Good.
What do you have?
I'll get going.
Greetin's[player name], fine day today!
Please leave me alone, I'm busy trapping the pygmy shrews.
translation: 좀 내버려 두슈. pygmy shrews(피그미땃쥐) 덫 놓느라 바쁘니께.

english: Wunnerfulweather we're having today!
My stock is only for those trusted in Shayzien, sorry.
translation: 죄송하지만 제 물건은 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 신뢰받는 분들께만 팔아요.

english: Looking to buy some armour?
Show me what you've got.
I'm good thanks.
Show me what you've got.
I'm good thanks.
Hello, I wonder if you could help me on this whole brewing thing...
translation: 안녕하세요, 이 양조라는 거 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요...

english: I might be able to - what do you need to know?
translation: 도와드릴 수 있을 거예요. 뭘 알고 싶으세요?

english: How do I brew ales?
Well first off you need to fill the vat with water - two bucketfuls should do the trick. Then you'll need to put in two handfuls of barley malt - that's roasted barley by the way.
translation: 먼저 vat(발효통)에 물을 채워야 해요. 두 양동이면 충분할 거예요. 그다음 barley malt(보리 맥아)를 두 줌 넣으세요. 참고로 그건 볶은 보리예요.

english: After that you'll be putting your main ingredient in - this will decide which ale it is you're brewing. There should be some good guides around with recipes in.
translation: 그다음엔 주재료를 넣을 차례예요. 이게 어떤 에일을 양조할지 정하죠. 레시피가 담긴 괜찮은 안내서가 여기저기 있을 거예요.

english: Lastly you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 마지막으로 ale yeast(에일 효모)를 한 단지 가득 부으면 발효가 시작돼요. 그다음엔 좋은 술이 될 때까지 기다리기만 하면 돼요.

english: How do I brew cider?
First you'll need some apples. You'll need to crush them using this cider-press - four apples should make a full bucket of apple-mush. Take four buckets of mush and fill up the vat.
translation: 먼저 사과가 좀 필요해요. 여기 cider-press(사과 압착기)로 으깨야 하는데, 사과 네 개면 apple-mush(으깬 사과)가 한 양동이 가득 나와요. 으깬 사과 네 양동이로 vat(발효통)을 채우세요.

english: After that you pour a pot full of ale yeast in, which'll start it off fermenting. Then all you have to do is wait for the good stuff.
translation: 그다음 ale yeast(에일 효모)를 한 단지 가득 부으면 발효가 시작돼요. 그다음엔 좋은 술이 될 때까지 기다리기만 하면 돼요.

english: What do I do once my ale has matured?
Well, once you've got a full vat of the good stuff, just turn the valve and your barrel will fill up with eight pints of whatever your chosen tipple is. Mind it's an empty barrel, though.
translation: 음, vat(발효통)에 좋은 술이 가득 차면 valve(밸브)를 돌리기만 하세요. 그러면 barrel(통)에 고르신 술이 여덟 파인트 채워질 거예요. 단, 꼭 빈 통이어야 해요.

english: Do you have any spare ale yeast?

Well, as a matter of fact I do, although I wouldn't describe it as spare. This ale yeast I've got is the best money can buy, but if you've got a pot I'll fill it for you for 25GP - very cheap as it happens.
translation: 음, 사실 있긴 해요. 남는다고 하긴 좀 그렇지만요. 제 ale yeast(에일 효모)는 돈 주고 살 수 있는 것 중 최고급이에요. 그래도 pot(단지)를 가져오시면 25GP에 채워 드릴게요. 사실 아주 싼 거예요.

english: I don't have an empty pot, or enough money I'm afraid.
translation: 죄송하지만 empty pot(빈 단지)도 없고 돈도 부족해요.

english: I don't have an empty pot I'm afraid.
I don't have enough money I'm afraid.
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: 좋은 거래네요. 25GP에 제 pot(단지)에 ale yeast(에일 효모)를 채워 주세요.

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 알고 싶은 건 그게 다예요, 고마워요.

english: How do I brew ales?
How do I brew cider?
What do I do once my ale has matured?
Do you have any spare ale yeast?
That's a good deal - please fill my pot with ale yeast for 25GP.
translation: 좋은 거래네요. 25GP에 제 pot(단지)에 ale yeast(에일 효모)를 채워 주세요.

english: No, that's too much I'm afraid.
That's all I need to know, thanks.
translation: 알고 싶은 건 그게 다예요, 고마워요.

english: Good day.
Good day to you [sir/ma'am].
Hello!
Ho there! Who are you?
Only the most famous sculptor in all of Keldagrim.
translation: 별거 아닐세. Keldagrim(켈다그림)을 통틀어 가장 유명한 조각가일 뿐이지.

english: Does Keldagrim have a lot of sculptors then?
Well... I'm the best outside of Keldagrim too, I tell you! Especially here in the north.
translation: 음... 켈다그림 밖에서도 내가 최고일세, 정말이야! 특히 여기 북쪽에서는 말이지.

english: Yeah, maybe you should visit the mountain people topside of this mountain some time... all they have is a big lump of stone!
translation: 네, 언제 이 산 위에 사는 산사람들한테 가 보세요... 거기엔 커다란 돌덩이 하나밖에 없거든요!

english: Ah, the philistines!
But I'd rather not go up there, they don't like dwarves much.
translation: 하지만 그 위로는 별로 가고 싶지 않네. 그들은 드워프를 그다지 좋아하지 않거든.

english: Oh yes, good point.
Sure, sure, of course.
Excuse me, are you Blasidar, the famous sculptor?
Why, yes, yes, that I am!
translation: 오, 그래, 그래, 내가 바로 그 사람일세!

english: Oh, well, I'm [player name]. Veldaban of the Black Guard sent me to you, you see. Said you might need some help with the statue.
translation: 아, 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. Black Guard(검은 경비대)의 Veldaban(벨다반) 님이 보내셨어요. 조각상 일로 도움이 필요하실 거라고 하던데요.

english: Oh, I don't need an assistant sculptor, really, I can do just fine on my own.
translation: 오, 조수 조각가는 필요 없네, 정말로. 혼자서도 충분히 해낼 수 있어.

english: I'm not a sculptor.
And I've also got a model here, you see, to base my statue on.
translation: 게다가 조각상의 본보기로 삼을 모델도 여기 있다네.

english: I'm not a model!
But come to think of it, I do need some errands run. Yes, quite important errands too.
translation: 하지만 생각해 보니 심부름해 줄 사람은 필요하군. 그래, 꽤 중요한 심부름이지.

english: Yes, you will do just fine.
Ehm, right, okay.
So what did you need doing?
Well, see... the Consortium has commisionedme to rebuild the statue exactly the way it was.
translation: 그게 말일세... Consortium(컨소시엄)이 조각상을 예전 모습 그대로 다시 만들어 달라고 내게 의뢰했다네.

english: But the statue itself has broken into a million pieces... and we dwarves aren't very good painters, you know, so we don't have any paintings of it either.
translation: 그런데 조각상이 산산조각이 나 버렸고... 알다시피 우리 드워프들은 그림 솜씨가 별로라서, 그 조각상을 그린 그림도 없다네.

english: Not a very artistic race, then, are you?
translation: 그럼 별로 예술적인 종족은 아니신가 보네요?

english: No, that's not what I said, I said we're not very good painters.
translation: 아니, 그런 말이 아닐세. 그림을 잘 못 그린다고 했지.

english: We're excellent with, for example, stone. Oh yes, quite good if I say so myself.
translation: 예를 들어 돌은 아주 잘 다룬다네. 그래, 내 입으로 말하긴 뭣하지만 꽤 훌륭하지.

english: But I digress... simply speaking, I need some help with getting some items that I can base the new statue on.
translation: 얘기가 샜군... 간단히 말해, 새 조각상의 본보기로 삼을 물건 몇 가지를 구하는 데 도움이 필요하네.

english: Will you be able to help me with this, [player name]?
translation: 이 일을 도와줄 수 있겠나, [player name]?

english: No, I can't be bothered.
How rude is that? I don't think the Black Guard will be very pleased with you!
translation: 이런 무례할 데가! Black Guard(검은 경비대)가 자네를 곱게 보지 않을 걸세!

english: Yes, I will do this.
Excellent, excellent! Now what I need is the following...
translation: 훌륭해, 훌륭해! 자, 내게 필요한 건 다음과 같네...

english: I will need a pair of boots, the most exquisite boots you can find. The more they look like the original the better, but I don't think you'll be able to find an exact match.
translation: 장화 한 켤레가 필요하네. 자네가 찾을 수 있는 가장 exquisite boots(정교한 장화) 말일세. 원본과 비슷할수록 좋지만, 똑같은 걸 찾기는 힘들 걸세.

english: For the torso, I need clothes that look like King Alvis' clothes. I'm not sure where you would be able to find that, but I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: 몸통 부분에는 King Alvis(알비스 왕)의 옷처럼 보이는 옷이 필요하네. 어디서 구할 수 있을지는 모르겠지만 자네라면 해낼 걸세.

english: Also, I need a battleaxe. Now this is particularly important. You are in luck, however, as I believe King Alvis' original axe still survives.
translation: 그리고 전투 도끼도 필요하네. 이건 특히 중요하지. 그래도 자네는 운이 좋군. King Alvis(알비스 왕)의 원래 도끼가 아직 남아 있는 것 같거든.

english: Right, so I need a pair of boots, a piece of clothing and a battleaxe. Is that all?
translation: 그러니까 장화 한 켤레, 옷 한 벌, 전투 도끼가 필요하시다는 거죠. 그게 다예요?

english: For now, [player name], for now! I wish you good luck, and hurry back with the items!
translation: 지금은 그렇네, [player name], 지금은! 행운을 비네, 물건을 구해서 어서 돌아오게!

english: But... wait, wait, how am I supposed to find all this?
translation: 하지만... 잠깐, 잠깐만요, 이걸 다 어떻게 찾으라는 거예요?

english: I don't know! You're supposed to find that out for me!
translation: 내가 어찌 알겠나! 그걸 알아내는 게 자네 일이지!

english: But it's a beautiful city, Keldagrim is, I'm sure you'll see many things while you do these tasks!
translation: 그래도 Keldagrim(켈다그림)은 아름다운 도시라네. 일을 하다 보면 많은 걸 보게 될 걸세!

english: How are you getting along with those items, [player name]?
I don't have your boots yet.
What else?
I also don't have your clothes yet, I'm afraid.
And? The battleaxe?
Sorry, no, I'm still looking for it.
translation: 죄송해요, 그것도 아직이에요. 계속 찾고 있어요.

english: Look a little harder please!
The new statue looks beautiful, don't you agree?
Oh yes, quite.
My finest piece of work, without a doubt.
translation: 의심할 여지 없는 내 최고의 걸작일세.

english: Say, I was wondering, did you do the statues down in the mines as well?
translation: 그런데 궁금한 게 있는데요, 광산 아래쪽에 있는 조각상들도 만드셨어요?

english: What, out with the trolls?
If only! But no, they've been there for many thousands of years, actually. Been there before dwarven recorded history.
translation: 그랬다면 좋겠군! 하지만 아닐세. 사실 그것들은 수천 년 동안 거기 있었다네. 드워프의 역사 기록이 시작되기도 전부터 말이야.

english: No no, I'm sure they weren't there before!
translation: 아뇨 아뇨, 분명 전엔 거기 없었어요!

english: Of course they were, don't be silly!
Alright... my mistake then.
No, I can't be bothered.
Yes, I will do this.
You! Get to work!
What?
You are here to help work the blast furnace, aren't you?
translation: blast furnace(대형 용광로) 일을 도우러 온 거 아니었나?

english: What's the blast furnace?

The blast furnace is the pinnacle of dwarven metal- processing! Ore goes in the top and comes out as metal bars almost at once! And it's so efficient it only takes half as much coal to purify it as a regular furnace.
translation: blast furnace(대형 용광로)는 드워프 금속 가공 기술의 정점이지! 광석을 위에 넣으면 거의 바로 금속 주괴로 나온다고! 게다가 효율이 워낙 좋아서 일반 furnace(용광로)의 절반밖에 안 되는 coal(석탄)으로 제련할 수 있어.

english: But we've got a bit of a labour shortage at the moment, which is why I have to rely on immigrant workers to keep the furnace going. So, are you here to start work?
translation: 그런데 지금 일손이 좀 부족해서, furnace(용광로)를 계속 돌리려면 이민 노동자들한테 기댈 수밖에 없어. 그래서, 일하러 온 거냐?

english: How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: blast furnace(대형 용광로) 일을 어떻게 도우면 되나요?

english: The blast furnace will only work if there is a group of people keeping it going. Let me explain...
translation: blast furnace(대형 용광로)는 여러 사람이 함께 돌려야만 작동해. 설명해 주지...

english: Firstly, the stove needs to be kept filled with coal. If this runs out the furnace will not work.
translation: 첫째, stove(난로)에 coal(석탄)을 계속 채워 둬야 해. 이게 떨어지면 furnace(용광로)가 안 돌아가.

english: Secondly, someone needs to operate the pump that keeps the hot air blast circulating through the furnace.
translation: 둘째, 누군가는 furnace(용광로) 안으로 뜨거운 바람을 계속 돌게 하는 pump(펌프)를 작동시켜야 해.

english: Thirdly, someone needs to keep an eye on the temperature gauge. They should tell the pumper to start or stop so that the temperature stays in the right range.
translation: 셋째, 누군가는 temperature gauge(온도계)를 지켜봐야 해. 온도가 적정 범위를 유지하도록 펌프 담당한테 시작하거나 멈추라고 알려 줘야 하지.

english: Lastly, someone needs to be on the pedals to power the conveyor belt that puts ore into the furnace.
translation: 마지막으로, 누군가는 pedals(페달)을 밟아서 광석을 furnace(용광로)에 넣는 conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)를 움직여야 해.

english: Someone will also need to be on standby with a hammer in case the machine breaks!
translation: 그리고 machine(기계)가 고장 날 때를 대비해서 누군가는 hammer(망치)를 들고 대기해야 해!

english: While that's going, anyone else can put their ore on the conveyor belt to have it smelted.
translation: 그렇게 돌아가는 동안 다른 사람들은 conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 광석을 올려서 제련할 수 있지.

english: So what do I get out of it?
Keeping the furnace going is valuable experience in itself!
translation: furnace(용광로)를 돌리는 것 자체가 귀중한 경험이지!

english: Keeping the stove alight will train your Firemaking, working the pump will train your Strength, pedalling the conveyor belt will train your Agility and repairing the furnace will train Crafting.
translation: stove(난로) 불을 유지하면 Firemaking(불 피우기), pump(펌프)를 돌리면 Strength(힘), conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트) 페달을 밟으면 Agility(민첩), furnace(용광로)를 수리하면 Crafting(공예)를 훈련할 수 있어.

english: Plus, everyone working the furnace will get a bit of experience in Smithing whenever anyone smelts ore in it.
translation: 게다가 누가 furnace(용광로)에서 광석을 제련할 때마다, 일하는 사람 모두가 Smithing(대장일) 경험치를 조금씩 얻지.

english: So I don't actually get paid then?
translation: 그럼 실제로 돈은 안 주시는 거예요?

english: I offer you the privilege of working on the greatest example of dwarven engineering and you want to be PAID?
translation: 드워프 공학 최고의 걸작에서 일할 특권을 주겠다는데, 돈까지 받겠다고?

english: If you co-operate with a group of people you can all get your smelting done pretty quickly. Or perhaps some humans who need to do some smelting will pay you, since you humans are all so obsessed with money.
translation: 여러 사람이랑 협력하면 다들 금방 제련을 끝낼 수 있어. 아니면 제련할 게 있는 인간들이 너한테 돈을 줄지도 모르지. 너희 인간들은 다들 돈에 환장하니까.

english: No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: 일꾼들한테 돈을 안 주니까 일손이 부족하죠!

english: What would be the point of making money if I gave it all away to menial workers?
translation: 막일꾼들한테 다 나눠 줄 거면 돈은 뭐 하러 벌어?

english: I mean... Money isn't important! What about the greater glory of dwarven engineering? What about the satisfaction of helping others? What about the XP?
translation: 내 말은... 돈은 중요하지 않다는 거야! 드워프 공학의 위대한 영광은? 남을 돕는 보람은? 경험치는 어떻고?

english: Okay, I'll get to work.
Splendid!
Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
You can, although you'll need to find some people to work it for you as well. But the furnace is very delicate so I charge a fee for anyone who doesn't have level 60 smithing.
translation: 되지. 대신 돌려 줄 사람들도 구해야 해. 그리고 furnace(용광로)가 워낙 예민한 물건이라 smithing(대장일) 레벨 60이 안 되는 사람한테는 요금을 받아.

english: I have level 60!
A human has level 60 smithing? How extraordinary!
Feel free to use the furnace. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: furnace(용광로)를 마음껏 써. 기억해, 일반 용광로보다 coal(석탄)이 절반만 들어.

english: I don't have level 60.
Hmm, well, I'll let you use the furnace if you want, but you must pay a fee of 2,500 coins.
translation: 흠, 뭐, 원하면 furnace(용광로)를 쓰게 해 주지. 대신 요금으로 2,500코인을 내야 해.

english: Okay, here you are.
Where?
Actually I don't have enough money on me.
Well go get it then.
Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: 좋아, 10분 동안 furnace(용광로)를 써도 돼. 기억해, 일반 용광로보다 coal(석탄)이 절반만 들어.

english: How about I give you 1250 coins and I work extra hard?
translation: 1250코인을 드리고 제가 더 열심히 일하면 어때요?

english: You'll have to work hard enough for two humans if I agree...
translation: 내가 좋다고 하면 인간 두 명 몫은 일해야 할 거다...

english: Oh, three humans, easily!
Well, okay then - 1250GP it is.
Well why did you try and haggle with me then? You'd better go and get some - you're not using the blast furnace for free.
translation: 그럼 왜 흥정을 한 거야? 가서 돈이나 구해 와. blast furnace(대형 용광로)를 공짜로 쓰게 할 순 없어.

english: Okay, you can use the furnace for ten minutes. Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace. And I want to see you doing the work of four humans!
translation: 좋아, 10분 동안 furnace(용광로)를 써도 돼. 기억해, 일반 용광로보다 coal(석탄)이 절반만 들어. 그리고 인간 네 명 몫은 일하는 걸 보여 줘야 한다!

english: Maybe some other time.
Well if you're not here to work, go hang around somewhere else!
translation: 일하러 온 게 아니면 딴 데 가서 어슬렁거려!

english: I need to borrow your blast furnace.
You can have it a couple of hours for 170,000 coins.
What?
I'm trying to create an ingot of chromium, and I need your blast furnace to do so.
translation: ingot of chromium(크롬 주괴)를 만들려는데, 그러려면 blast furnace(대형 용광로)가 필요해요.

english: You have knowledge of how to make chromium?!
Well, I'm pretty sure it involves a blast furnace...
translation: 음, blast furnace(대형 용광로)가 필요하다는 건 꽤 확신해요...

english: I'm not going to close my shop for someone who is 'pretty sure'. Come back when you have a better idea.
translation: '꽤 확신하는' 녀석 때문에 가게 문을 닫을 순 없지. 제대로 알게 되면 다시 와.

english: You need level 85 smithing to make a Chromium ingot.
translation: Chromium ingot(크롬 주괴)를 만들려면 smithing(대장일) 레벨 85가 필요해.

english: I had to get sloshed to figure it out, but yes.
translation: 알아내려고 고주망태가 돼야 했지만, 네, 알아요.

english: That makes perfect sense. Okay then, you can have the furnace, but it's going to cost you.
translation: 그럼 말이 되지. 좋아, furnace(용광로)를 빌려주지. 대신 돈 좀 들 거다.

english: Yes.
Good enough for me. You can have the furnace but it's going to cost you.
translation: 그거면 됐어. furnace(용광로)를 빌려주지. 대신 돈 좀 들 거다.

english: Okay, I'll need a couple of hours for each chromium ingot. How much is that going to cost me?
translation: 좋아요, chromium ingot(크롬 주괴) 하나당 두어 시간이 필요해요. 얼마나 들까요?

english: Let's see. Cost of labour... Opportunity cost... Carry the four...
I don't have that much money on me.
Come back when you do.
I have the money right here.
I'll go get everything ready for you.
You pump air into the furnace, regulating the speed as you spot the silvery sheen.
translation: 은빛 광택이 보이자 속도를 조절하며 furnace(용광로)에 공기를 불어 넣는다.

english: That's a bit too pricey for me.
Come back if you change your mind.
Okay.
You are an experienced smith, you may use the furnace free of charge!
translation: 넌 숙련된 대장장이니까 furnace(용광로)를 공짜로 써도 돼!

english: Remember, you only need half as much coal as with a regular furnace.
translation: 기억해, 일반 furnace(용광로)보다 coal(석탄)이 절반만 들어.

english: What is this? The fee to use the furnace is 2,500 coins.
I don't have enough money on me.
Well go and get it then.
Somebody refuel the stove!
Somebody fix that pipe!
Somebody work the conveyer belt!
translation: 누가 conveyer belt(컨베이어 벨트) 좀 돌려!

english: Somebody fix the conveyer belt!
translation: 누가 conveyer belt(컨베이어 벨트) 좀 고쳐!

english: Somebody operate the pump!
Keep the temperature controlled.
That's it, keep it going!
Work faster!
You fools, you let it overheat!
What's the blast furnace?
How can I help work the blast furnace?
translation: blast furnace(대형 용광로) 일을 어떻게 도우면 되나요?

english: Can I use the furnace to smelt ore?
Maybe some other time.
So what do I get out of it?
So I don't actually get paid then?
translation: 그럼 실제로 돈은 안 주시는 거예요?

english: Okay, I'll get to work.
No wonder you have a labour shortage if you don't pay your workers!
translation: 일꾼들한테 돈을 안 주니까 일손이 부족하죠!

english: Okay I'll get to work.
I have level 60!
I don't have level 60.
Okay.
[Charm] How about I give you 1250 coins and I work extra hard?
translation: [Charm] 1250코인을 드리고 제가 더 열심히 일하면 어때요?

english: I need to borrow your blast furnace.
Yes.
No.
Yes
No
You manage to inflate a bloated toad with the swamp gas.
translation: 늪 가스로 bloated toad(부푼 두꺼비)를 부풀리는 데 성공했다.

english: You blow the bloated toad up into a balloon toad.
translation: bloated toad(부푼 두꺼비)를 불어서 balloon toad(풍선 두꺼비)로 만들었다.

english: Sqwark!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
How come I can talk to you without an amulet?
translation: 어떻게 amulet(아뮬렛) 없이도 너랑 말할 수 있는 거지?

english: *Woof woof bark!* Elementary, it's due to the influence of the -SQUIRREL-!
translation: *멍멍 왈!* 기초적인 추리지. 그건 -다람쥐-의 영향 때문이야!

english: Walkies!
Can you help me with this clue?
translation: 이 단서 좀 같이 풀어 줄래?

english: *Woof! Bark yip woof!* Sure! Eliminate the impossible first.
translation: *멍! 왈 깽 멍!* 물론이지! 먼저 불가능한 것부터 제거해.

english: And then?
*Bark! Woof bark bark.* Whatever is left, however improbable, must be the answer.
translation: *왈! 멍 왈 왈.* 남은 게 아무리 있을 법하지 않아도, 그게 바로 답이야.

english: So helpful.
I wonder if I could sell you to a vampyre to track down dinner.
translation: 너를 vampyre(뱀파이어)한테 팔면 저녁거리 추적용으로 쓰려나.

english: *Woof bark bark woof* I have teeth too you know, that joke was not funny.
translation: *멍 왈 왈 멍* 나도 이빨 있거든. 그 농담 하나도 안 웃겼어.

english: Hey boy, what's up?
*Woof! Bark bark woof!* You smell funny.
translation: *멍! 왈 왈 멍!* 너한테서 웃긴 냄새 나.

english: Err... funny strange or funny ha ha?
translation: 어... 이상하다는 뜻으로 웃긴 거야, 하하 하고 웃긴 거야?

english: *Bark bark woof!* You aren't funny.
translation: *왈 왈 멍!* 넌 하나도 안 웃겨.

english: Interesting!
I will eliminate the impossible.
Elementary!
Hey, monkey!
Eeek! Eeek! Ook!
I have no idea what you just said, but good luck with it anyway!
translation: 뭐라는지 하나도 모르겠지만, 아무튼 잘해 봐!

english: Hey monkey, your mother was an inedible seaweed sandwich!
translation: 어이 원숭이, 너희 엄마는 못 먹는 seaweed sandwich(해초 샌드위치)였다!

english: Oh man, oh, you did not just say that!
translation: 와, 와, 너 방금 그 말 진짜 한 거냐!

english: The second I get up that tree I am going to pelt you with bitternuts until you are neck deep in them!
translation: 저 나무에 올라가는 순간 bitternuts(쓴 견과)를 던져서 목까지 파묻어 주마!

english: Oh noes, my worst nightmare come true...
I'm sorry for insulting you. Is there anything I can do to make it up to you?
translation: 모욕해서 미안해. 사과의 뜻으로 내가 해 줄 수 있는 거 없을까?

english: Hmmmm...well, you seem sincere, how about you hurry up and use me on the tree and we'll call it even.
translation: 흐으음... 뭐, 진심인 것 같으니까, 얼른 날 나무에 사용해. 그럼 퉁쳐 줄게.

english: Yeah, ok, sounds fair.
Hey monkey, take your time getting the nut ok?
translation: 어이 원숭이, 견과 딸 때 천천히 해, 알았지?

english: Sure. If I see any monkeys around the top of the tree I'll be careful and try and get you the nut whatever happens.
translation: 그래. 나무 꼭대기에 다른 원숭이가 보이면 조심하면서, 무슨 일이 있어도 견과를 따다 줄게.

english: Great!
What? Can I come out of this bag now?
translation: 뭐야? 이제 이 자루에서 나가도 돼?

english: That depends, do you think you can reach those bitternuts for me?
translation: 그건 봐서. 저 bitternuts(쓴 견과)에 손 닿을 것 같아?

english: Sigh...yes. Just take me to the tree and I'll grab one for you.
translation: 하아... 응. 나무까지만 데려가 주면 하나 따 줄게.

english: Look, never mind about taking your time, I'm sure things will be ok.
translation: 저기, 천천히 하라던 건 잊어. 다 괜찮을 거야.

english: Well if you are sure. Ok, I'll get up there and pass you the nut then.
translation: 네가 그렇다면야. 좋아, 그럼 올라가서 견과를 건네줄게.

english: Cheers, I'll be nearby to catch it.
Taunt Monkey
Calm Monkey
Caution Monkey
Reassure Monkey
Hello.
Well hello there traveller. If you're looking for a cocktail the barman will happily make you one.
translation: 어서 와요, 여행자님. 칵테일을 찾는다면 바텐더가 기꺼이 만들어 줄 거예요.

english: Or if you're looking for some training in cocktail making, then I'm your gnome! Aluft Gianne jnr. is looking for gnome cooks, barmen and barwomen to help in his new venture, so it's a useful skill to have. I'm
translation: 아니면 칵테일 만드는 법을 배우고 싶다면, 제가 바로 딱 맞는 노움이죠! Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)가 새 사업을 도울 노움 요리사와 바텐더를 구하고 있으니, 배워 두면 쓸모 있는 기술이에요. 게다가

english: sure the human girls will like it as well.
No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: 아뇨, 전 바 이쪽에 앉아 있는 게 좋아요.

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
Excellent. It's not an easy job, I'll have to try you out first. I'm sure you'll be great though.
translation: 훌륭해요. 쉬운 일은 아니라서 먼저 실력을 좀 봐야겠어요. 그래도 분명 잘하실 거예요.

english: Here, take this cocktail guide. The book tells you how to make all the cocktails we serve. I'll tell you what I need and you can make them.
translation: 자, 이 cocktail guide(칵테일 안내서)를 받아요. 우리가 파는 칵테일 만드는 법이 전부 적혀 있어요. 제가 필요한 걸 말하면 그걸 만들어 주면 돼요.

english: Sounds easy enough.
Take a look at the book then come and talk to me.
translation: 책을 한번 훑어보고 나서 저한테 다시 말을 걸어요.

english: Hello Blurberry.
Hi, are you ready to make your first cocktail?
translation: 안녕하세요, 첫 칵테일 만들 준비 됐어요?

english: Absolutely.
Ok then, to start with make a Fruit Blast. Here, you'll need these ingredients, but I'm afraid I can't give you any more if you mess up.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 먼저 Fruit Blast(프루트 블라스트)를 만들어 봐요. 자, 필요한 재료예요. 근데 미안하지만 망치면 더 줄 수는 없어요.

english: Blurberry gives you two lemons, one orange, one pineapple, a cocktail shaker, a glass and a knife.
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)가 lemon(레몬) 두 개, orange(오렌지) 한 개, pineapple(파인애플) 한 개, cocktail shaker(칵테일 셰이커), glass(잔), knife(칼)을 건네준다.

english: So where's my Fruit Blast?
I think I've got one.
No, I need you to make the Fruit Blast yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 아뇨, Fruit Blast(프루트 블라스트)는 직접 만들어 와야 해요. 바에서 파는 음료를 바에 되파는 건 곤란하거든요.

english: I can see how that would make it hard to mix cocktails. I'll give you another one, but please try not lose any more.
translation: 그러면 칵테일 섞기가 어렵겠네요. 하나 더 드릴 테니까 이번엔 잃어버리지 않도록 해요.

english: I've not finished yet.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.
I don't know what you have there but it's no Fruit Blast!
translation: 거기 뭘 들고 있는지는 모르겠지만 Fruit Blast(프루트 블라스트)는 확실히 아니네요!

english: Here you go.
You give Blurberry the Fruit Blast. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)에게 Fruit Blast(프루트 블라스트)를 건넨다. 그가 한 모금 마신다...

english: Hmmm... not bad, not bad at all.
translation: 흐음... 나쁘지 않네요, 전혀 나쁘지 않아요.

english: Now can you make me a Pineapple Punch? I can give you what you need, but again I won't be able to give you any more if you make a mistake.
translation: 이번엔 Pineapple Punch(파인애플 펀치)를 만들어 줄래요? 필요한 건 드릴게요. 하지만 이번에도 실수하면 더 줄 수는 없어요.

english: Blurberry gives you three pineapples, a pair of oranges, a lemon and a lime.
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)가 pineapple(파인애플) 세 개, orange(오렌지) 두 개, lemon(레몬) 한 개, lime(라임) 한 개를 건네준다.

english: Let me know when it's done.
How are you faring with the Pineapple Punch?
No, I need you to make the Pineapple Punch yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 아뇨, Pineapple Punch(파인애플 펀치)는 직접 만들어 와야 해요. 바에서 파는 음료를 바에 되파는 건 곤란하거든요.

english: You give Blurberry the Pineapple Punch. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)에게 Pineapple Punch(파인애플 펀치)를 건넨다. 그가 한 모금 마신다...

english: Not bad, not bad at all.... I can certainly sell drinks of that quality.
translation: 나쁘지 않네요, 전혀 나쁘지 않아요.... 이 정도 품질이면 충분히 팔 수 있겠어요.

english: Okay then let's try something with some real booze in it! Make me a Wizard Blizzard.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 이번엔 진짜 술이 들어간 걸 만들어 봐요! Wizard Blizzard(위자드 블리자드)를 하나 만들어 줘요.

english: Blurberry gives you some vodka, gin, a lemon, a pineapple, a pair of limes and an orange.
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)가 vodka(보드카), gin(진), lemon(레몬) 한 개, pineapple(파인애플) 한 개, lime(라임) 두 개, orange(오렌지) 한 개를 건네준다.

english: Hello, how did it go with the Wizard Blizzard.
translation: 안녕하세요, Wizard Blizzard(위자드 블리자드)는 어떻게 됐어요?

english: No, I need you to make the Wizard Blizzard yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 아뇨, Wizard Blizzard(위자드 블리자드)는 직접 만들어 와야 해요. 바에서 파는 음료를 바에 되파는 건 곤란하거든요.

english: I haven't managed to make it yet.
Ok, it's one Wizard Blizzard I need.  Let me know when it's done.
translation: 그래요, Wizard Blizzard(위자드 블리자드) 한 잔이면 돼요.  다 되면 알려 줘요.

english: Here, try some.
You give Blurberry the Wizard Blizzard. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)에게 Wizard Blizzard(위자드 블리자드)를 건넨다. 그가 한 모금 마신다...

english: Well that is both Wizardy and Blizzardy. You're quite a bartender.
translation: 이거 참, 위자드답게 마법 같고 블리자드답게 짜릿하네요. 바텐더 소질이 대단한데요.

english: Okay, let's test you once more. Make me a SGG, then we'll see if you have what it takes.
translation: 좋아요, 마지막으로 한 번 더 시험해 볼게요. SGG를 만들어 와요. 그럼 자질이 있는지 알 수 있겠죠.

english: A what?
A Short Green Guy, and don't bring me a gnome. Here's all you need.
translation: Short Green Guy(쇼트 그린 가이) 말이에요. 작은 초록 친구라고 진짜 노움을 데려오진 말고요. 필요한 건 여기 다 있어요.

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
I'm sure you'll make a great barman.
Hi Blurberry.
So, have you got my Short Green Guy?
translation: 그래서, 제 Short Green Guy(쇼트 그린 가이)는 가져왔어요?

english: No, I need you to make the SGG yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.
translation: 아뇨, SGG는 직접 만들어 와야 해요. 바에서 파는 음료를 바에 되파는 건 곤란하거든요.

english: You give Blurberry the SGG. He takes a sip...
translation: Blurberry(블러베리)에게 SGG를 건넨다. 그가 한 모금 마신다...

english: Ooh, that's a frisky little number. Very tart, how it should be. Excellent. Well I'm happy to recommend you to the Giannes. You truly are a gnomish bartender now..
translation: 오, 이거 아주 짜릿한 녀석이네요. 아주 새콤해요, 딱 이래야죠. 훌륭해요. 기꺼이 Gianne(지안) 가족에게 추천해 드릴게요. 이제 진정한 노움 바텐더예요..

english: Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?
translation: 이제 수련은 끝났어요, [player name] 님. 일 좀 해 볼 생각 있어요?

english: I may be...

I think you're almost ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of a new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There are good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may
translation: Aluft Gianne Jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)의 일을 할 준비가 거의 된 것 같아요. 그 친구가 가족의 새 사업인 Gnome Food Delivery(노움 음식 배달)을 맡고 있거든요. 노움 음식을 만들어 배달하면 팁을 쏠쏠하게 벌 수 있어요. 다만

english: have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
translation: 다른 주문을 처리하려면 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 돌아다녀야 할 수도 있어요...

english: However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. Hel'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: 하지만 Lufty(러프티) 밑에서 일하려면 기본적인 노움 요리 수련부터 받아야 해요. 그 친구 아빠인 Aluft Gianne Snr.(알루프트 지안 시니어)를 찾아가 얘기해 봐요. 뭘 해야 하는지 알려 줄 거예요.

english: Thanks for your help!

Aluft Gianne Snr. tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of the new Gnome Food Delivery service. I've heard there are
translation: Aluft Gianne Snr.(알루프트 지안 시니어) 말로는 그분과의 수련을 다 마쳤다던데, 이제 Aluft Gianne Jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)의 일을 할 준비가 된 것 같아요. 그 친구가 새로 생긴 Gnome Food Delivery(노움 음식 배달)을 맡고 있거든요. 듣자 하니

english: good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfill some of the other orders...
translation: 노움 음식을 만들어 배달하면 팁을 쏠쏠하게 벌 수 있대요. 다만 다른 주문을 처리하려면 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 돌아다녀야 할 수도 있어요...

english: Sounds interesting....
Go and have a chat with my young Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
translation: 우리 꼬마 Lufty Jnr.(러프티 주니어)를 찾아가 얘기해 봐요. 자세한 건 그 친구가 알려 줄 거예요.

english: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.
translation: 아뇨, 전 바 이쪽에 앉아 있는 게 좋아요.

english: Ok then I'll give it a go.
I'm afraid I lost the cocktail shaker you gave to me.
I've not finished yet.
Why do you keep killing boars?
Because they drop bones which I am going to use to train my prayer. The meat is also a nice addition.
translation: 뼈를 떨어뜨리니까요. 그걸로 prayer(기도)를 올릴 거예요. 고기도 덤으로 쏠쏠하고요.

english: Wouldn't it be best to go steal cakes for food?
translation: 먹을 거라면 케이크를 훔치러 가는 게 낫지 않아요?

english: And then go to Wintertodt? I do that every time I make an Iron person account. About time I try something new.
translation: 그러고 나서 Wintertodt(윈터토트)에 가라고요? 아이언맨 계정을 새로 만들 때마다 그렇게 했어요. 이번엔 새로운 걸 해 볼 때도 됐죠.

english: Are you at least killing the boars on task?
translation: 적어도 과제로 받은 멧돼지를 잡는 건 맞죠?

english: No, maybe I should go get a slayer task now you mention it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: 아뇨, 말 나온 김에 slayer(슬레이어) 과제나 받으러 가야겠네요. 일깨워 줘서 고마워요.

english: You can only trade with people in your group.
translation: 같은 그룹에 속한 사람과만 거래할 수 있습니다.

english: Give me a quest!
Get yer own!
Have you anything to sell?
Yes! I buy and sell axes! Take your pick (or axe)!
translation: 있지! 도끼를 사고팔거든! 마음에 드는 걸로 콕 찍어 봐(도끼로 찍든가)!

english: Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 제 아이템 좀 수리해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Of course I'll repair it, though the materials may cost you. Just hand me the item and I'll have a look.
translation: 물론 고쳐 주지. 재료비는 좀 들 수 있어. 물건을 건네주면 한번 살펴볼게.

english: You don't have anything I can repair.
There you go, happy doing business with you!
Sorry friend, but I can't do anything with that.
translation: 미안하지만 친구, 그건 나도 어쩔 수가 없어.

english: Give me a quest!
Have you anything to sell?
Can you repair my items for me?
translation: 제 아이템 좀 수리해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Repair that item: [x] coins.
Cancel.
Miaoww
Erm, hello? Can you understand me?
I certainly can, I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: 당연히 알아듣지, Sophanem(소파넴)에서 얻은 이 아뮬렛을 차고 있거든!

english: Ah so you've met one of the local felines, wise and confusing , those Sphinges.
translation: 아하, 그럼 그 동네 고양이과 친구를 만났구나. 현명하지만 헷갈리는 녀석들이지, 그 Sphinges(스핑게스) 말이야.

english: Wow!!! You know the plural of Sphinx!!! What else do you know?
translation: 와!!! Sphinx(스핑크스)의 복수형까지 알다니!!! 또 뭘 알고 있어?

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels, want to hear one?
translation: 온갖 걸 다 알지! 돌아다니면서 이런저런 얘기를 끝도 없이 주워듣거든. 하나 들어 볼래?

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!
Hi, my name is Bob.
Hello Bob!
Do you two know each other?
I don't think so...
Yes you do. Dive deep, search your feelings.
translation: 아니, 알고 있어. 깊이 파고들어 봐. 네 마음을 들여다봐.

english: OK, I will try.
What's up puss?
If only you knew the power of Bob. Your master never told you who your real father was, did he?
translation: 네가 Bob(밥)의 힘을 알기만 한다면. 네 주인은 네 진짜 아버지가 누군지 말해 주지 않았지, 그렇지?

english: No, but what's that got to do with... no, nooooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: 응, 근데 그게 무슨 상관이... 아니, 안 돼애애애! 그럴 리 없어!!

english: Yes. I am your father!
That's impossible!!
You can destroy Zamorak. He has foreseen this. It is your destiny. Join me, and together we can rule this place as father and son.
translation: 넌 Zamorak(자모락)을 무너뜨릴 수 있다. 그분께서 이를 예견하셨지. 이것이 네 운명이다. 나와 함께하자. 함께 아버지와 아들로서 이곳을 다스리는 거다.

english: OK dad, maybe later, you're scaring me!
translation: 알았어 아빠, 나중에 생각해 볼게, 무섭단 말이야!

english: I think that's about enough of that. I'm off.
[player name], why do you keep your cat in the bank?
translation: [player name], 넌 왜 네 고양이를 은행에 넣어 두는 거야?

english: I thought it was too dangerous to bring it out with me.
translation: 데리고 다니기엔 너무 위험할 것 같아서.

english: Or, I could let the poor thing get butchered! Is that what you want?
translation: 아니면 불쌍한 녀석이 도살당하게 내버려 둘까! 그걸 바라는 거야?

english: Butchered!!! I think not. Cats are easily as tough as sheep. Cats were the second thing Guthix brought here, after sheep of course.
translation: 도살이라니!!! 천만에. 고양이는 양만큼이나 튼튼하다고. 고양이는 Guthix(구식스)가 이곳에 두 번째로 데려온 존재야. 물론 첫 번째는 양이고.

english: Weird. I thought Gnomes and the Dwarves were the first ones. Oh well back to school for me.
translation: 이상하네. 노움이랑 드워프가 처음인 줄 알았는데. 뭐, 학교로 돌아가 다시 공부해야겠다.

english: Do you like all the monsters around here?
No, not really. I'm actually signed up with all those HAM fanatics. Kill the whole lot of 'em!!
translation: 아니, 별로. 사실 난 그 HAM 광신도들 모임에 가입했거든. 싹 다 죽여 버려야 해!!

english: That's a bit cruel isn't it?
Yeah, that's one of my best qualities. Just behind sneaky and vicious. Besides, after a few doses of catnip, they all look like mice to me!
translation: 그래, 그게 내 최고의 장점 중 하나지. 교활함이랑 포악함 바로 다음이야. 게다가 캣닢을 몇 번 하고 나면 다들 생쥐로 보이거든!

english: Hey Bob. Got any wisdom to share?
translation: 안녕, Bob(밥). 나눠 줄 지혜 좀 있어?

english: If a player falls down in a forest and nobody is there, do they make any noise?
translation: 숲에서 플레이어가 쓰러졌는데 아무도 없다면, 그 플레이어는 소리를 낸 걸까?

english: Sorry, I am far too busy marking my territory.
Your territory? This place is ruled by the Grand Highmage Gower and his minions.
translation: 네 영역? 여긴 Grand Highmage Gower(대마도사 가워)와 그 부하들이 다스리는 곳이잖아.

english: I think not. They are my minions, and I let him think that he's in charge. I'm the real power behind the throne.
translation: 천만에. 그놈들은 내 부하고, 그 녀석은 자기가 대장인 줄 알게 내버려 둔 거야. 진짜 실세는 왕좌 뒤에 있는 나라고.

english: I knew it!!
Yeah, it keeps them happy that way, but don't tell anyone!
translation: 그래, 그래야 다들 행복하거든. 하지만 아무한테도 말하지 마!

english: Hee hee. OK Bob.
Dogs believe they are human. Cats believe they are Guthix!
translation: 개는 자기가 인간인 줄 알지. 고양이는 자기가 Guthix(구식스)인 줄 알고!

english: What do you believe, Bob?
Well, I don't believe much really since I know I am Zar... erm, well, no, I erm, meow?
translation: 글쎄, 난 별로 믿는 게 없어. 내가 자모... 어, 그러니까, 아니, 어... 야옹?

english: Don't get distracted so easily! See, I'm distracting you right now!
translation: 그렇게 쉽게 한눈팔지 마! 봐, 내가 지금 네 정신을 딴 데로 팔게 하고 있잖아!

english: Sorry, I'm far too busy calculating thermal vectors.
translation: 미안, 열역학 벡터를 계산하느라 너무 바빠.

english: Eh?
Oh, sorry... I meant, erm, meow?
translation: 아, 미안... 내 말은, 어... 야옹?

english: Nothing interesting happens.
Eh? That's hardly useful.
Ahh, but it is you see. It does all sorts of wonderous things.
translation: 아하, 그런데 쓸모가 있다니까. 온갖 놀라운 일을 해내거든.

english: Like what?
Well, it's more to do with what happens when you hear that being said. You see, something interesting happens somewhere else.
translation: 음, 그 말이 들릴 때 일어나는 일이 중요한 거야. 그러니까, 다른 어딘가에서 흥미로운 일이 일어난다는 거지.

english: So what you're saying is that if nothing interesting happens to me, then something interesting is happening for someone else somewhere that IS interesting?
translation: 그러니까 나한테 흥미로운 일이 아무것도 안 일어나면, 다른 어딘가의 누군가한테는 흥미로운 일이 일어나고 있다는 거야?

english: Yes, that's about it.
OK... I see.... I think.
Cats are rather delicate creatures and they are subject to a good many ailments, but I never heard of one who suffered from insomnia.
translation: 고양이는 꽤 섬세한 동물이라 온갖 병에 잘 걸리지만, 불면증에 걸린 고양이는 들어 본 적이 없어.

english: So, you want to know how us cats keep so clean all day?
translation: 그래서, 우리 고양이들이 어떻게 하루 종일 깨끗한지 알고 싶어?

english: Must be all that washing you do.
You would think so wouldn't you. But is being covered in spit really clean?
translation: 그렇게 생각하겠지? 그런데 온몸이 침투성이인 게 정말 깨끗한 걸까?

english: Eeeww. Gross.
Anything not nailed down is a cat toy.
translation: 못 박혀 있지 않은 건 전부 고양이 장난감이야.

english: If at first you don't succeed, take a short nap.
translation: 처음에 성공하지 못하면, 잠깐 낮잠을 자.

english: Yeah, I could tell you something really useful, but then I would have to '1-hit you' to death.
translation: 그래, 진짜 쓸모 있는 걸 알려 줄 수도 있지만, 그러면 널 '원킬'로 보내 버려야 하거든.

english: Bob, you couldn't 1-hit a noob.
translation: Bob(밥), 넌 뉴비도 원킬 못 낼걸.

english: Care to place a wager on that? Sorry, hang on, I've got no pockets. Maybe next time.
translation: 내기 한번 해 볼래? 아, 잠깐, 나 주머니가 없지. 다음에 하자.

english: I'll be waiting.
Dogs have owners, cats have staff.
translation: 개에겐 주인이 있고, 고양이에겐 집사가 있지.

english: I have studied many philosophers and many cats. The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior.
translation: 난 수많은 철학자와 수많은 고양이를 연구했어. 고양이의 지혜가 비교도 안 되게 뛰어나더라고.

english: There are many intelligent species in the universe. They are all owned by cats.
translation: 우주엔 지적인 종족이 많아. 그리고 전부 고양이의 소유지.

english: Cats and teleporting just don't mix well. That's why I walk everywhere. Messes my hair up terribly.
translation: 고양이와 순간이동은 정말 안 맞아. 그래서 난 어디든 걸어 다녀. 털이 엉망이 되거든.

english: Cats are smarter than dogs. You can't get eight cats to pull a sled through snow.
translation: 고양이가 개보다 똑똑해. 고양이 여덟 마리한테 눈밭에서 썰매를 끌게 할 순 없거든.

english: Sorry, no time for chat. Still got mouse bones stuck in my teeth. How awkward.
translation: 미안, 수다 떨 시간 없어. 아직 이빨에 쥐뼈가 끼어 있거든. 이거 참 곤란하네.

english: You know, cats are the first species to fully evolve. We're perfect.
translation: 있잖아, 고양이는 완전히 진화한 최초의 종이야. 우린 완벽하지.

english: Preserve nature. Pickle a dog!
translation: 자연을 보존하자. 개는 소금에 절여 보존하자!

english: Do you like dogs?
Yes!
Me too. Care to swap recipes? I have a rather unique hotdog sauce.
translation: 나도. 요리법 좀 교환할래? 나한테 꽤 독특한 핫도그 소스가 있거든.

english: Bob, you're a bit messed up really aren't you.
translation: Bob(밥), 너 좀 맛이 간 것 같지 않아?

english: No, I just know what I like. Besides, it was a joke.
translation: 아니, 그냥 내 취향이 확실한 거야. 게다가 농담이었어.

english: A joke? I doubt the dogs are laughing.
translation: 농담? 개들은 안 웃을 것 같은데.

english: What dogs? I have already rid this place of dogs. Have you ever seen one?
translation: 무슨 개? 이곳에서 개는 이미 다 몰아냈어. 한 마리라도 본 적 있어?

english: Yes actually. I heard there are a few wild dogs about here somewhere.
translation: 사실 있어. 이 근처 어딘가에 들개가 몇 마리 있다던데.

english: Right!! Fellow cats, prepare for war!!
Mmm. Maybe another time.
Cat Rule number 1: Always act afraid when near dogs, especially if you're near a human. They will pick you up and fuss you, then shout at the dog. Most amusing!
translation: 고양이 규칙 제1조: 개 근처에선 항상 무서운 척할 것. 특히 인간이 근처에 있을 때. 인간이 널 안아 들고 달래 주면서 개한테 소리를 지를 거야. 정말 웃기지!

english: Cat Rule number 2: When assisting a human at work, make sure you sit behind its right leg. You stand a much better chance of getting picked up and stroked. Also, it's very amusing
translation: 고양이 규칙 제2조: 인간이 일하는 걸 도와줄 땐 꼭 그 오른쪽 다리 뒤에 앉을 것. 그래야 안겨서 쓰다듬어질 확률이 훨씬 높아. 게다가 아주 웃기기도 하고

english: Cat Rule number 3: If you ever make a mistake, which is rare and probably involves a dog, make sure you wash yourself immediately. This will give everyone the impression that
translation: 고양이 규칙 제3조: 혹시 실수를 저질렀다면, 그럴 일은 드물고 아마 개랑 관련 있겠지만, 즉시 몸단장을 할 것. 그러면 다들 그게

english: it was done on purpose.
Cat Rule number 4: Beware the bag monster. These things live in small bags and under newspapers, sometimes even hidden in shoes if they are very clever. They will be very small and
translation: 고양이 규칙 제4조: 가방 괴물을 조심할 것. 이놈들은 작은 가방 속이나 신문 밑에 살고, 아주 영리한 놈은 신발 속에 숨기도 해. 크기는 아주 작고

english: take on the same colour as the hiding place. Attack these things on sight - stop at nothing. If you see a bag or shoe you have not inspected recently, pounce!!
translation: 숨어 있는 곳과 같은 색을 띠지. 보는 즉시 공격해. 무슨 일이 있어도 멈추지 마. 최근에 확인하지 않은 가방이나 신발이 보이면, 덮쳐!!

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 뭘 해 드리면 될까요?

translation: Wooden table(나무 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아~ 역시 따뜻한 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: No thanks, I better be off.
Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellry? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!
translation: 어이, 친구, 명품 장신구 하나 사 볼래? 저 멀리 Ardougne(아르둔)에서 온 물건이라고! 완전 진품이야!

english: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.
Okay, chum, would you like to show you the very latest potion prices?
translation: 알았어, 친구. 그럼 최신 물약 시세 좀 보여 줄까?

english: Who are you?
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!
translation: 아니, 나 Bob(밥)이잖아! 끝내주는 물건을 파는 친절한 장사꾼이지!

english: So what do you have to sell?
Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.
translation: 아, 지금은 별로 없어. 왜냐면, 그게 말이지, 장사가 워낙 잘되고 짭짤해서.

english: You don't really look like you're being so successful.
You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!
translation: 이런 맹추 같으니! 다 쇼라고, 쇼! 장사 잘된다고 소문나 봐, 다들 돈 좀 나눠 달라고 몰려올 거 아냐!

english: You conveniently have a response for everything.
translation: 참 편리하게도 무슨 말이든 다 받아치시네요.

english: That's the Ardougne way, my son.
Can you show me the prices for potions?
Lets see what you have...
You're a bit short of inventory space.
You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: 빈 용기나 돈이 좀 모자라는데. 빈 약병은 개당 5코인, 컵은 개당 8코인, 나머지는 전부 개당 5코인이야.

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost 5 coins each, cups 8 coins each, and anything else is 5 coins each.
translation: 자, 할 수 있는 만큼은 했는데, 빈 용기나 돈이 좀 모자라. 빈 약병은 개당 5코인, 컵은 개당 8코인, 나머지는 전부 개당 5코인이야.

english: There, all done.
Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...
translation: 이 더하기 이는 사, 하나 빼면 삼...

english: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.
translation: 네가 가진 것 중엔 내가 옮겨 담을 만한 게 없는 것 같은데.

english: Please, please, please work.
I'm in the money!
I could have sworn that would have worked.
Now what should I buy?
Hope this item sells well.
translation: 이 물건 잘 팔려야 할 텐데.

english: Who are you?
Can you show me the prices for potions?
I'll leave you to it.
Hello, how are you doing?
I'm good thank you, how can I help you today?
translation: 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 오늘은 뭘 도와줄까요?

english: What is this place?
This is our agility course, we use it to stay nimble and to keep our wits sharp. My name is Bobawu and I look after the course.
translation: 여긴 우리 민첩 코스예요. 몸을 날렵하게 하고 정신을 맑게 유지하려고 쓰죠. 제 이름은 Bobawu(보바우)고, 이 코스를 관리하고 있어요.

english: As a friend and fellow monkey, you're free to use it anytime, but you'll need to be as nimble as a ninja first!
translation: 친구이자 같은 원숭이니까 언제든 써도 돼요. 하지만 먼저 닌자처럼 날렵해져야 할 거예요!

english: Oh great, thank you.
Are there any rewards you can offer me?
translation: 혹시 저한테 줄 수 있는 보상이 있어요?

english: Could you tell me how many laps I've completed?
translation: 제가 몇 바퀴 돌았는지 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: I can't offer you anything for now, so I don't see much reason to count your laps either.
translation: 지금은 줄 수 있는 게 없어서, 바퀴 수를 셀 이유도 딱히 없네요.

english: You need to complete Monkey Madness 2 for Bobawu to offer rewards and to count your lap total
translation: Monkey Madness 2(원숭이 광란 2)를 완료해야 Bobawu(보바우)가 보상을 주고 총 바퀴 수를 세어 줍니다

english: Looks like you haven't completed any laps, but I'll be sure to keep track of them, when you do.
translation: 아직 한 바퀴도 안 돈 것 같네요. 하지만 돌기 시작하면 꼭 세어 둘게요.

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
translation: 물론이죠, 친구. 지금까지 1바퀴 돌았어요. 멈추지 말아요!

english: Sure thing my friend, so far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
translation: 물론이죠, 친구. 지금까지 [number]바퀴 돌았어요. 멈추지 말아요!

english: What can you offer me?
I see you have your own monkey friend, by completing laps here you can transform him into different monkeys!
translation: 원숭이 친구가 있네요. 여기서 바퀴를 돌면 그 친구를 다른 원숭이로 변신시킬 수 있어요!

english: That's neat, what can he turn into?
I've got the list here!
Bobawu pulls out a tattered piece of paper from his ninja costume.
translation: Bobawu(보바우)가 닌자 복장에서 너덜너덜한 종이 한 장을 꺼낸다.

english: Ahem, here we are, At 100 you'll unlock a Karamjan Monkey transformation.
translation: 에헴, 여기 있네요. 100바퀴를 돌면 Karamjan Monkey(카람자 원숭이) 변신이 해금돼요.

english: After completing 250 laps, you'll unlock a scary zombie monkey.
translation: 250바퀴를 돌면 무시무시한 zombie monkey(좀비 원숭이)가 해금되고요.

english: With 500 laps finished, you'll get a maniacal monkey.
translation: 500바퀴를 마치면 maniacal monkey(광기의 원숭이)를 얻게 돼요.

english: At 1000 laps, you'll be able transform him into a spooky skeleton monkey,
translation: 1000바퀴를 돌면 으스스한 skeleton monkey(해골 원숭이)로 변신시킬 수 있고,

english: 1500 laps for a little Kruk Jr monkey,
Finally at 2000 laps, he can transform to look like our King Awowogei.
translation: 마지막으로 2000바퀴를 돌면 우리 King Awowogei(아워워게이 왕)처럼 변신할 수 있어요.

english: On second thought, never mind.
That's okay my friend, come back anytime.
Hey there, how do you do my fellow monkey?
translation: 안녕하세요, 우리 원숭이 친구, 잘 지냈어요?

english: So far you've completed 1 lap, don't stop now!
So far you've completed [number] laps, don't stop now!
What is this place?
How many laps have I done?
What can you offer me?
Never mind.
Hello there friend! I'm Bobby the gnome child.
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구! 저는 노움 아이 Bobby(바비)예요.

english: Are you heading into The Nutcracker?
Oh yes. Me and Pa have been looking forward to this all year. Isn't that right Pa?
translation: 네! 저랑 아빠는 일 년 내내 이날만 기다렸어요. 그렇죠, 아빠?

english: Yes Bobby. There's no doubt we will be sipping mulled pine inside The Nutcracker in no time.
translation: 그럼, Bobby(바비). 금방 The Nutcracker(호두까기) 안에서 mulled pine(따뜻한 솔잎주)를 홀짝이고 있을 거야.

english: Mulled pine? Sounds very... Organic.
translation: 따뜻한 솔잎주요? 아주... 자연 친화적으로 들리네요.

english: It's delightful.
Wishing you happy holidays [player name].
You too Bobby.
Woah, you're very big for a Gnome.
And you're very rude for a human.
Don't listen to them Bobby. You're just a little different.
translation: 저 사람 말은 신경 쓰지 마라, Bobby(바비). 넌 그냥 조금 남다를 뿐이야.

english: Nice to meet you [player name]. Does somebody need a hug?
translation: 만나서 반가워요, [player name] 님. 누구 안아 줄 사람 필요해요?

english: Bobby stumbles and steps on his dad's foot while trying to hug you.
translation: Bobby(바비)가 당신을 안아 주려다 비틀거리며 아빠 발을 밟는다.

english: Son of a nutcracker!
Sorry Pa!
I'll walk it off.
Heading into The Nutcracker?
You're a gnome?
Hello there.
Hello stranger, new to these parts?
translation: 안녕하세요, 낯선 분. 이 근방은 처음이에요?

english: I'm Bolkoy by the way. I'm the village shopkeeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 아, 저는 Bolkoy(볼코이)라고 해요. 이 마을 상점 주인이죠. 뭐 좀 사실래요?

english: What have you got?
Take a look.
No thank you.
Ok, maybe later.
Hello.
Amazing, you recovered the orb.
Well I am impressed. Would you like to buy something?
Hi.
Oh, hello there. Have you heard? They took the other orbs, it's terrible. I suppose the show must go on.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 소식 들으셨어요? 놈들이 나머지 오브들을 가져갔어요, 끔찍한 일이에요. 그래도 장사는 계속해야겠죠.

english: Would you like to buy something?
Hello there. You're that hero who saved the orbs. Soon we will perform the ritual and the village will be safe again.
translation: 안녕하세요. 오브들을 구해 주신 그 영웅이시군요. 곧 의식을 치르면 마을이 다시 안전해질 거예요.

english: Anyway, would you like anything from my shop?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 우리 가게에서 뭐 필요한 거 있으세요?

english: Welcome, welcome. It's good to see you again. The village is much safer now you have returned the orbs.
translation: 어서 오세요, 어서 오세요. 다시 뵈니 반가워요. 오브들을 돌려주신 덕분에 마을이 훨씬 안전해졌어요.

english: By the way, I'm the village shop keeper. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 아, 그리고 저는 이 마을 상점 주인이에요. 뭐 좀 사실래요?

english: Hello! I take it you're here about the trail?
translation: 안녕하세요! 단서 추적 때문에 오신 거죠?

english: Yes, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: 네, 저한테 줄 도전 과제가 있나요?

english: Yes, right here!
Please enter the answer to the question.
What's the matter with you? Can't you count? Try harder!
translation: 대체 왜 그래요? 숫자도 못 세요? 좀 더 분발해 봐요!

english: Lucky for you, that's the right answer!
What have you got?
No thank you.
Yeah?
What is this place?
Granddad's fruit farm. It's a right dump. This whole corner of the city is a dump.
translation: 할아버지 과일 농장. 완전 쓰레기장이야. 이 도시 이쪽 구석은 통째로 쓰레기장이지.

english: So why are you here if it's a dump?
My cow of a sister kicked me out of her bar. Said I was getting the place a bad name. So I'm staying here until I'm old enough to get my own place.
translation: 마녀 같은 우리 언니가 자기 바에서 날 쫓아냈거든. 내가 가게 평판을 망친대나. 그래서 내 집 구할 나이가 될 때까지 여기서 지내는 거야.

english: I want to move to Arceuus. It's properly awesome up there. I'll do bartending or something until I can learn to be a necromancer.
translation: 난 Arceuus(아르세우스)로 이사 갈 거야. 거긴 진짜 끝내주거든. 강령술사가 되는 법을 배울 수 있을 때까지 바텐더 일 같은 거라도 하면서 지내야지.

english: Anyway, why are you here? Do you want something?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 넌 여기 왜 왔어? 뭐 원하는 거라도 있어?

english: Never mind.
Okay, thanks for the info.
Yeah, you're in the biggest dumpster of Dumpsterville. Now you know. Anyway, do you want something?
translation: 그래, 넌 지금 쓰레기 마을에서도 제일 큰 쓰레기통 안에 있는 거야. 이제 알았지. 그래서, 뭐 원하는 거 있어?

english: Tell me about yourself.
Yeah, alright...
I am Bologa Gricoller, seeker of forbidden wisdom, wanderer of the dark pathways, thinker of the unthinkable. I can do bartending too.
translation: 나는 Bologa Gricoller(볼로가 그리콜러). 금지된 지혜를 구하는 자, 어둠의 길을 떠도는 자, 생각할 수 없는 것을 생각하는 자. 바텐더 일도 할 줄 알고.

english: I used to work at The Golden Field. That's my sister's bar. It's mostly farmhands drinking there, but you get some interesting people as well.
translation: 예전엔 The Golden Field(황금 들판)에서 일했어. 우리 언니 바야. 주로 농장 일꾼들이 술 마시러 오는데, 가끔 흥미로운 사람들도 와.

english: See, most Hosidius people are Saradominists. My sister, she's always listening to Father Jean at the church with his goodie-goodie sermons.
translation: 있잖아, Hosidius(호시디우스) 사람들은 대부분 Saradomin(사라도민) 신자야. 우리 언니도 맨날 교회에서 Father Jean(장 신부)의 착한 척하는 설교나 듣고 있지.

english: But some of us in the bar thought we'd give Zamorak a try. Like, you gotta be open-minded, right? What did Saradomin ever do for us anyway?
translation: 근데 바에 있던 우리 몇 명은 Zamorak(자모락)을 한번 믿어 보기로 했어. 그러니까, 마음은 열려 있어야 하잖아, 안 그래? 사라도민이 우리한테 해 준 게 뭐가 있는데?

english: So we'd meet in the bar, sharing books that the Piscarilius smugglers would bring us, learning what the Saradominists don't want us to know.
translation: 그래서 우린 바에 모여서 Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) 밀수꾼들이 가져다준 책을 돌려 보면서, 사라도민 신자들이 우리가 몰랐으면 하는 것들을 배웠지.

english: Anyway, my sister - she's a right cow, by the way - she fired me and kicked me out. Said I was bringing bad sorts to her bar.
translation: 아무튼 우리 언니가, 참고로 완전 마녀야, 날 해고하고 쫓아냈어. 내가 질 나쁜 놈들을 바에 끌어들인대.

english: Bad sorts, she said! Like, morality is totally subjective, right? So who's she to call us bad sorts just 'cos we're not afraid to think differently?
translation: 질 나쁜 놈들이래! 아니, 도덕이란 건 완전히 주관적인 거잖아, 그치? 남들과 다르게 생각하는 걸 두려워하지 않는다는 이유만으로 우릴 질 나쁜 놈들이라고 부르다니, 언니가 뭔데?
