english: Anyway, I've learnt all this cool stuff about Zamorak, and being stuck in a fruit farm doesn't stop me being his loyal servant, right?
translation: 아무튼 난 Zamorak(자모락)에 대해 멋진 걸 잔뜩 배웠고, 과일 농장에 처박혀 있다고 해서 그분의 충실한 종이 못 되는 건 아니잖아, 그치?

english: In fact I've invented a Zamorakian blessing that works on fruit! You can use it to make Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 사실 난 과일에 쓰는 Zamorak(자모락)의 축복을 발명했어! 그걸 쓰면 Vinery(포도원)의 grapes(포도)로 Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주)를 만들 수 있어.

english: Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주) 만드는 걸 도와줄 수 있어요?

english: I'll let you have access to the Zamorakian blessing I invented, so you can invoke Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes... if I think you're up to it.
translation: 내가 발명한 Zamorak(자모락)의 축복을 쓰게 해 줄게. 그러면 포도에 자모락의 불경한 힘을 불어넣을 수 있지... 네가 그럴 만한 실력이 된다고 내가 생각하면 말이야.

english: I'll want 75,000 coins too.
And do you think I'm up to it?
translation: 그럼 제가 그럴 만한 실력이 된다고 생각해요?

english: Nah, I bet you couldn't even bless an unholy symbol - you're not going to get very far with my grape blessing.
translation: 아니. 넌 unholy symbol(불경한 상징) 하나도 축복 못 할걸. 그래서야 내 포도 축복을 써 봤자 얼마 못 가지.

english: You need a Prayer level of 50 to use Bologa's blessing.
translation: Bologa's blessing(볼로가의 축복)을 사용하려면 Prayer(기도) 레벨 50이 필요하다.

english: Not likely - I can see from your kit that you're supporting other gods. Dress Zamorakian if you want to impress me. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 어림없지. 네 차림새를 보니 다른 신들을 섬기고 있잖아. 나한테 잘 보이고 싶으면 Zamorak(자모락) 신자처럼 입고 와. 그리고 75,000코인은 그래도 받을 거야.

english: You don't look much like a Zamorakian to me. Dress Zamorakian if you want my help. And I'll still want 75,000 coins.
translation: 넌 별로 Zamorak(자모락) 신자 같아 보이지 않는데. 내 도움을 받고 싶으면 자모락 신자처럼 입고 와. 그리고 75,000코인은 그래도 받을 거야.

english: Yeah, I guess you'll do. But I want 75,000 coins. One day I'll need to buy my own house, y'know!
translation: 그래, 너 정도면 되겠다. 근데 75,000코인은 내야 해. 언젠간 나도 내 집을 사야 하거든, 알지?

english: Maybe another time.
Here's how it works... I'll write the blessing on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 방법은 이래... 내가 축복을 scrolls(두루마리)에 적어 줄게. 포도를 수확할 때 그 두루마리를 몇 장 갖고 있어야 해.

english: As each fruit is severed from its stem, it begins to die. That's the moment of vulnerability when Zamorak's unholy power can infest it.
translation: 과일은 줄기에서 잘려 나가는 순간부터 죽기 시작해. 그게 바로 Zamorak(자모락)의 불경한 힘이 스며들 수 있는 취약한 순간이야.

english: The power consumes the scroll on which the blessing is written, so you'll need one for each grape. I suggest you take a stack of blessings with you.
translation: 그 힘이 축복이 적힌 두루마리를 먹어 치우니까, 포도 한 알마다 한 장씩 필요해. 축복을 한 뭉치 챙겨 가는 게 좋을 거야.

english: By the way, Lord Zamorak's chaotic power is quite volatile. You'll likely get a smaller harvest from your vine if you're using these blessings.
translation: 아, 그리고 Zamorak(자모락) 님의 혼돈의 힘은 꽤 불안정해. 이 축복을 쓰면 포도 덩굴에서 수확량이 좀 줄어들 거야.

english: I'll give the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward if you work on his farm. Hey, it's a dump, but he's family. So, do you accept?
translation: 두루마리는 아래층 할아버지한테 맡겨 둘게. 할아버지 농장에서 일하면 보상으로 받을 수 있어. 뭐, 쓰레기장이긴 해도 가족이니까. 그래서, 할래?

english: You pay Bologa 75,000 coins. You can now claim her blessings from Farmer Gricoller as a reward for working on his farm.
translation: Bologa(볼로가)에게 75,000코인을 지불했다. 이제 Farmer Gricoller(농부 그리콜러)의 농장에서 일한 보상으로 그녀의 축복을 받을 수 있다.

english: Actually, no thanks.
Meh.
I'll leave you to it.
Hello again.
You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 포도로 Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주)를 만들 수 있다고 했죠.

english: Yeah, I've invented a blessing that invokes Zamorak's unholy power upon the grapes, so Zamorak's wine can be made from them.
translation: 응, 포도에 Zamorak(자모락)의 불경한 힘을 불어넣는 축복을 발명했거든. 그러면 그 포도로 자모락의 포도주를 만들 수 있어.

english: But I won't let you use it unless I think you're up to it. Also, I want 75,000 coins.
translation: 근데 네가 그럴 만한 실력이 된다고 생각하지 않으면 안 쓰게 해 줄 거야. 그리고 75,000코인도 받을 거고.

english: Tell me about yourself again.
It's really nice of you to take an interest...
translation: 나한테 관심을 가져 주다니 진짜 친절하네...

english: Hello again, [player name].
How do those blessings work again?
My blessing is written on scrolls. You need to carry some of the scrolls when you're harvesting grapes.
translation: 내 축복은 scrolls(두루마리)에 적혀 있어. 포도를 수확할 때 그 두루마리를 몇 장 갖고 있어야 해.

english: I've given the scrolls to Granddad downstairs. You can get them off him as a reward for working on his farm. The place may be a dump, but he's family.
translation: 두루마리는 아래층 할아버지한테 맡겨 뒀어. 할아버지 농장에서 일하면 보상으로 받을 수 있어. 여긴 쓰레기장일지 몰라도 할아버지는 가족이니까.

english: Thanks.
Tell me the story about yourself again.
Yeah, okay. It's nice of you to ask...
translation: 그래, 좋아. 물어봐 주니 기분 좋네...

english: So that's how I came to invent that Zamorakian blessing for making Zamorak's wine out of grapes from the Vinery.
translation: 그래서 내가 Vinery(포도원)의 포도로 Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주)를 만드는 자모락의 축복을 발명하게 된 거야.

english: What is this place?
So why are you here if it's a dump?
Tell me about yourself.
Never mind.
Okay, thanks for the info.
Can you help me to make Zamorak's wine?
translation: Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주) 만드는 걸 도와줄 수 있어요?

english: Pay 75,000 coins to access Bologa's blessings.
Decline.
I'll leave you to it.
You said you can make Zamorak's wine from grapes.
translation: 포도로 Zamorak's wine(자모락의 포도주)를 만들 수 있다고 했죠.

english: Tell me about yourself again.
How do those blessings work again?
Tell me the story about yourself again.
Hi there.
A'up, mate, how's it gowin'?
Not bad, thank you.
What are you building here?
Nowt at moment. We're on strike!
translation: 지금은 암것도 안 짓는다. 우린 파업 중이거든!

english: You're on strike? Whatever for?
Those strange alchemists are up ta somefin', best go ta one ov 'em.
translation: 저 이상한 연금술사들이 뭔 꿍꿍이가 있는 기라. 그 양반들 중 하나한테 가 보는 게 좋을 끼다.

english: Oh, okay.
You still hangin' around the tower?
Yeah, we need another job. But til then, we figured we may as well wait ta see what else would turns up.
translation: 그래, 다른 일거리가 필요하거든. 근데 그때까진 여서 뭐가 또 나오나 기다려 보는 게 낫겠다 싶었지.

english: Fair enough.
Who's a cute little kitty?
Jimmy doesn't like me talking to strangers.
translation: Jimmy(지미)는 내가 낯선 사람이랑 얘기하는 거 싫어해요.

english: Miaow!
It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?
I ... uh ... yes.
Right you are.
No thank you. Who are you by the way?
Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.
translation: 그건 신경 쓰지 마라, 얘야. 너는 네가 누구인지, 그리고 너를 이곳으로 몰아온 힘의 본질이 무엇인지나 걱정하거라.

english: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.
We WILL meet again, [player name].
translation: 우리는 반드시 다시 만날 것이다, [player name].

english: Ok...
Yes
No
Roll up, roll up!
Enter the great Hemenster fishing competition!
Only 5gp entrance fee!
I'll enter the competition please.
Marvelous!
You pay Bonzo 5 coins.
Ok, we've got all the fishermen. It's time to roll!
translation: 좋아요, 낚시꾼들이 다 모였어요. 이제 시작합니다!

english: Ok, nearly everyone is in their place already. You fish in the spot by the willow tree, and the Sinister Stranger, you fish by the pipes.
translation: 좋아요, 거의 다들 자리에 있네요. 당신은 willow tree(버드나무) 옆 자리에서 낚시하시고, Sinister Stranger(불길한 이방인), 당신은 pipes(파이프) 옆에서 낚시하세요.

english: No thanks; I'll just watch the fun.
Okay folks, time's up! Let's see who caught the biggest fish.
translation: 자, 여러분, 시간 끝! 누가 제일 큰 물고기를 잡았는지 볼까요.

english: You hand over your catch.
And the winner is... The stranger in black!
Hello champ!
So any hints on how to fish?
translation: 그래서 낚시 비법 좀 알려 줄래요?

english: I think I'll keep them to myself.
I'll enter the competition please.
No thanks, I'll just watch the fun.
Hello tall person.
Hello short person.
Why are you called Boot?
I'm called Boot, because when I was very young, I used to sleep, in a large boot.
translation: 제 이름이 Boot(부트)인 건, 아주 어렸을 때, 커다란 부츠 속에서, 잠을 자곤 했기 때문이에요.

english: Yeah, great, I didn't want your life story.
translation: 네, 대단하네요. 인생 이야기까지 듣고 싶진 않았는데.

english: Hello short person.
Why are you called boot?
Can I come through this gate?
You must pay a toll of 10 gold coins to pass.
No, thank you. I'll walk around.
Ok suit yourself.
Who does my money go to?
The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid.
translation: 그 돈은 Al-Kharid(알 카리드) 시로 가오.

english: Yes, ok.
You pay the guard.
Oh dear, I don't actually seem to have enough money.
You may pass for free, you are a friend of Al-Kharid.
translation: 그대는 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)의 친구이니 무료로 지나가도 좋소.

english: Can we come through this gate?
You may pass for free, for you are a friend of Al-Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: 그대는 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)의 친구이니 무료로 지나가도 좋소. 하지만 그대의 goblin(고블린) 친구는 이쪽에 남아야 하오.

english: Why?
Why do you think this gate is here, if not to keep the goblins out of Al Kharid?
translation: 고블린들을 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 들이지 않으려는 게 아니면 이 대문이 왜 여기 있겠소?

english: But Zanik isn't like the other goblins!
Nevermind, player name. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!
translation: 괜찮아요, player name. 어차피 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 갈 필요는 없을 것 같아요!

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both theMisthalinandKharidian Desertareas in this League.
translation: 이번 리그에서 Misthalin(미스탈린)과 Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막) 지역을 모두 해제하지 않았기 때문에 지나갈 수 없다.

english: No thank you, I'll walk around.
Who does my money go to?
Yes, ok.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 너처럼 못생겼으면 난 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 잡아먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 나한테 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 거 하나도 없으니까 날 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 아주 비참한 날이군... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무-지-하-게 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 피 맛을 꽤 즐길 줄 아는 녀석처럼 보이는군.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누구 조각이 좀 끼어서...

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장에게 가시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 경계하고 있어서 물건을 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만났구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 얘기나 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하면 내 문은 언제나 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 만난 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 것을 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 머물며 이야기할 틈이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 잘 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 그대에게 모든 일이 잘 풀리기를 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 그대를 보는 건 언제나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 하는 것이오, [Fremennik name]?

english: What you want, human? You not coming in. Weiss is troll town - humans not welcome.
translation: 뭐 원해, 인간? 너 못 들어와. Weiss(바이스)는 트롤 마을. 인간 환영 안 해.

english: My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: My Arm(마이 암)이 당신이랑 친구가 되려고 왔어요.

english: Boulder not sure exactly what you offering, human, but it not sound like something Boulder want to happen.
translation: Boulder(바위)는 인간이 뭘 내민다는 건지 잘 모르겠어. 근데 바위가 원하는 일 같지는 않아.

english: But My Arm's come a very long way for this, and he's very excited about what he can teach you.
translation: 하지만 My Arm(마이 암)은 이걸 위해 아주 먼 길을 왔고, 당신들한테 가르쳐 줄 걸 생각하며 엄청 들떠 있어요.

english: Boulder still not sure what you offering, human, but you definitely not doing it in here. Go away!
translation: Boulder(바위)는 아직도 인간이 뭘 내미는지 모르겠어. 근데 여기서는 절대 안 돼. 저리 가!

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: Wolfbone(늑대뼈)가 Troll Stronghold(트롤 요새)에서 My Arm(마이 암)을 보냈어요.

english: Human arm might taste good, maybe, so if Wolfbone sent your arm as a snack, we happy to take it an' eat it.
translation: 인간 팔 맛있을지도 몰라. 그러니까 Wolfbone(늑대뼈)가 간식으로 네 팔을 보낸 거면, 우리 기꺼이 받아서 먹을게.

english: I'm not letting you eat my arm.
translation: 제 팔은 못 먹게 할 거예요.

english: Urgh - human arm attached to human body with human mouth what keep talking an' talking. Shut up and' go away.
translation: 으억, 인간 팔이 인간 몸에 붙어 있고, 인간 입이 계속 떠들고 또 떠들어. 입 다물고 저리 가.

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: 저 말고 My Arm(마이 암)만 들여보내 주면 돼요.

english: Human sound confused about how body work. See, mortal body is intrinsic part of mortal being. It not like we got our souls floating up in da sky controlling bodies like puppets.
translation: 인간, 몸이 어떻게 돌아가는지 헷갈리는 것 같아. 봐, 필멸의 몸은 필멸의 존재에서 떼어 낼 수 없는 본질적인 부분이야. 우리 영혼이 하늘에 둥둥 떠서 꼭두각시처럼 몸 조종하는 거 아니야.

english: We mortal beings - troll, human, goat - we are our bodies, and our bodies are us. You human got dumb ideas 'bout mind/body dualism.
translation: 우리 필멸의 존재들, 트롤, 인간, 염소, 우리는 우리 몸이고, 우리 몸이 곧 우리야. 너 인간, 심신 이원론에 대해 멍청한 생각 갖고 있어.

english: Anyway, Boulder not here to talk ontological distinction between mind an' matter, especially with dumb human who not know what [his/her] arm is. So push off.
translation: 아무튼 Boulder(바위)는 정신과 물질의 존재론적 구분 얘기하러 여기 있는 거 아니야. 특히 [his/her] 팔이 뭔지도 모르는 멍청한 인간이랑은. 그러니까 꺼져.

english: I'll be back!
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Who are you?
We met at entry gate, remember? Boulder sent you away, 'cos we not trust humans here in Weiss, an' also you sound crazy. But you our friend now, an' you always welcome.
translation: 우리 입구 대문에서 만났잖아, 기억 안 나? Boulder(바위)가 너 돌려보냈어. 우리 여기 Weiss(바이스)에서 인간 안 믿고, 너 미친 소리 하는 것 같았으니까. 근데 이제 너 우리 친구. 언제든 환영이야.

english: Boulder used to guard entry gate, but now Snowflake trusted Boulder with important farming job. Much more fun.
translation: Boulder(바위) 예전엔 입구 대문 지켰어. 근데 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 바위한테 중요한 농사일 맡겼어. 훨씬 재밌어.

english: Boulder gotta grow goutweed for tribe, an' also make sure your herbs stay healthy. Snowflake's husband troll very strict on it.
translation: Boulder(바위)는 부족 위해 goutweed(구트위드) 키워야 해. 그리고 네 약초도 건강하게 잘 자라는지 봐야 해. Snowflake(눈송이) 남편 트롤이 그거 엄청 깐깐해.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스)야. 트롤들이 몇 년 전에 지었어. 더 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨난 다음에. 이제 바이스는 우리 집이야.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 지금 아주 좋아. Snowflake(눈송이)랑 남편 트롤이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬거든. 음식 훨씬 맛있어졌어.

english: Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠긴 한데 점점 나아지고 있어. Snowflake(눈송이), 걔가 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간, 구트위드 넣으면 다 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그러니까 그래, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이라 Weiss(바이스)는 살기 좋은 곳이야. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 걔 남편 트롤은 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: I'll be off.
My Arm has come to make friends with you.
translation: My Arm(마이 암)이 당신이랑 친구가 되려고 왔어요.

english: Wolfbone's sent My Arm from the Troll Stronghold.
translation: Wolfbone(늑대뼈)가 Troll Stronghold(트롤 요새)에서 My Arm(마이 암)을 보냈어요.

english: You only need to let My Arm in, not me.
translation: 저 말고 My Arm(마이 암)만 들여보내 주면 돼요.

english: I'll be back!
Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hi! What are you up to?
Watering the pretty flowers, you want to help?
translation: 예쁜 꽃들에 물 주고 있어. 너도 도와줄래?

english: I don't have time to water flowers, I have people to save!
translation: 꽃에 물 줄 시간 없어요, 구해야 할 사람들이 있거든요!

english: Pft, you should take time to enjoy the simple things.
translation: 흥, 단순한 것들을 즐길 시간도 좀 가져야지.

english: I'm not a simple person.
So it seems.
Hi, I...
What are you doing here, Fremennik?!
I have a seal of pass...
No you do not! Begone!
The player is teleported back to Rellekka
Ooops. Suppose I need a seal of passage when I'm walking around that island.
translation: 아차. 그 섬을 돌아다니려면 seal of passage(통행의 인장)이 있어야 하나 보네.

english: Hello.
A fair day, traveller. Would you like to see my wares?
translation: 좋은 날이오, 여행자여. 내 물건 좀 보겠소?

english: Yes please.
I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
Ahh crossbows. Not exactly what I'd call skilled ranging, but I guess dwarven engineering is good, what did you want to know?
translation: 아, 석궁이라. 내가 보기엔 숙련된 궁술이라 할 순 없지만, 드워프 공학 기술이 훌륭하긴 하지. 무엇이 알고 싶소?

english: The dwarves don't work with magic logs, I'm wondering if you know how to make a crossbow out of them?
translation: 드워프들은 magic logs(마법 통나무)를 다루지 않던데, 혹시 그걸로 석궁을 만드는 법을 아세요?

english: As it happens, a recent discovery of dragon limbs has allowed the creation of such a crossbow.
translation: 마침 최근에 dragon limbs(드래곤 활대)가 발견되면서 그런 석궁을 만들 수 있게 되었소.

english: That's fantastic!
No thanks.
Okay good day to you.
I don't... however I will look into it when I get spare time, for now you'll have to stick with the dwarven way of doing things.
translation: 모르오... 하지만 짬이 나면 알아보리다. 지금은 드워프 방식을 따를 수밖에 없겠소.

english: Ok, perhaps one day in the future I'll get to make magic crossbows!
translation: 좋아요, 언젠가는 저도 마법 석궁을 만들 수 있겠죠!

english: Yes please.
I'd like to ask you about magic crossbows.
No thanks.
Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
I should set up a moleyball court next, the king of all ball-based sports.
translation: 다음엔 몰리볼 코트를 차려야겠어. 공으로 하는 스포츠 중의 왕이지.

english: What was that?
Oh nothing. Just thinking out loud.
Alright I'll leave you to it then.
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 올해 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 너무 시무룩해 보여요.

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: 우리가 부활절의 혼을 좀 되살려 볼 수 있지 않을까요?

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: 강령술을 좀 하자고... 부활절 토끼 기운 내게 하려고?

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨! 그냥 말이 그렇다는 거예요.

english: I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: 그냥 우리가 도울 수 있는 게 없나 해서요.

english: Leave it to me boss.
I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: 마침 내가 알기로 E.B.가 볼링 광팬이거든. 사실 왕년엔 레인 위의 마법사였지. 챔피언이었다고!

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
translation: 그리고 마침 나한테 이런 능력도 있지...

english: ...Rig the game in his favour.
translation: ...게임을 그 녀석한테 유리하게 조작하는 능력 말이야.

english: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: 그게 쓸모가 있다니까. 요즘 그 녀석 실력이 영 녹슬었거든.

english: Won't he suspect something?
Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: 천만에! 봐, 바로 여기에 톱니바퀴들을 설치해 뒀거든.

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: 잠깐, 너 지금 내 영업 비밀 캐내려는 거지?

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: 저기요, 전 그냥 부활절을 다시 제자리로 돌려놓고 싶을 뿐이에요.

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 당신 장사는 계속하셔도 돼요. 전 그냥 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 돕고 싶은 거예요.

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: 아 알았어, 그 순둥이한테 신세 진 것도 있으니까. 하지만 내 수염이 널 지켜보고 있다고!

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: 그래서, 보여 주고 싶다는 게 뭐예요, [player name]?

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: 음, 여기 Bowley(보울리)가 당신 비밀을 알려 줬어요. 3년 연속 볼링 챔피언이었다면서요.

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: 아. 그땐 좋았죠. 근데 요즘은 한동안 안 했어요...

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: 달걀 일 때문에 통 깡충거릴 기운이 안 났거든요.

english: Well, here's your chance!
What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: 무슨 말이에요? 제대로 된 상대가 없으면 재미가 없는걸요.

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
translation: 그리고 여기 볼링을 딱히 좋아하는 사람도 없고요.

english: They what now?
I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: 이 자리 파내고 기계 장치 설치하느라 내가 얼마나 오래 고생했는데!

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: Long Ears Johnson(긴귀 존슨) 아니신가. 또 내 핀들 혼쭐내러 왔나?

english: We'll see about that.
Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
translation: 아, 그래. [player name] 님이 꽤 잘한다더라고.

english: It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: 실력 있는 상대랑 제대로 한 판 해 본 지 정말 오래됐어요.

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: 기운 내요, 친구. 제가 왔으니 이 레인을 지배하는 당신에게 도전할 준비가 됐다고요!

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: 뭐, 딱히 할 일도 없으니까요. 안 될 거 없죠?

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
A fine shot, but not quite enough!
Watch this!
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: 정신 차려야겠네요. 안 그러면 일방적인 경기가 되겠어요.

english: And that would be no fun at all.
The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
Ah, so you have some fight in you.
I could do this all day.
That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: 화면이 검게 변하며 "얼마 후..."라는 글자가 나타난다.

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: 당신 실력을 여태 못 들었다니 놀랍네요, [player name].

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: 아, 저 아시잖아요. Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제일 겸손한 모험가.

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
translation: 아, 이기고 있을 때 그만두는 게 좋겠네요.

english: But we should do this again.
Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: 그래, 또 해야지! 그리고 내 가게 소문 좀 내 주면 내가 돈을 쓸어 담을 거야!

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: 내 말은... The Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)도 손님이 많으면 좋아할 거라는 거지?

english: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: 아, 재미있었어요. 그래도 Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)에 좀 더 앉아 있을까 봐요.

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: 이만 가 봐야겠어. 언제나 즐거웠어, Bowley(보울리).

english: Aye, till next time.
This is the Rabbit Hole.
Who me? Nah I'm just a mole.
translation: 누구, 나? 에이, 난 그냥 두더지야.

english: Well that went well!
We may have gotten away with it!
translation: 우리 들키지 않고 넘어간 것 같아요!

english: Oi, not so loud.
Don't worry I'm sure those excessively large ears are just for show!
translation: 걱정 마요. 저 엄청나게 큰 귀는 분명 장식일 거예요!

english: Aye reyt.
He seems to have more of a spring in his step.
translation: 발걸음이 좀 더 깡충깡충해진 것 같아요.

english: But still not quite himself.
translation: 그래도 아직 완전히 예전 같진 않아요.

english: I'll see if anyone else around here can help.
translation: 이 근처에 도와줄 수 있는 사람이 또 있는지 알아볼게요.

english: With Long Ears Johnson looking a bit more chipper, hopefully we'll get the Egg deliveries finally.
translation: Long Ears Johnson(긴귀 존슨)이 좀 기운을 차렸으니, 이제 드디어 Egg(달걀) 배달이 되겠지.

english: Hello Bowley, I didn't expect you up here!
translation: 안녕하세요, Bowley(보울리). 여기 위에서 볼 줄은 몰랐어요!

english: And why would that be? I deserve an Egg too, look how much I'm helping out!
translation: 그게 왜? 나도 Egg(달걀) 하나 받을 자격 있다고. 내가 얼마나 돕고 있는지 보라고!

english: Oh it's just bright is all, we don't often get moles here on the surface.
translation: 아, 그냥 여긴 밝잖아요. 지상에서 두더지를 보는 일은 흔치 않거든요.

english: Hm yes, I could do with something to keep the sun out of my eyes.
translation: 흠, 그래. 햇빛 좀 가릴 만한 게 있으면 좋겠군.

english: A new machine perhaps that could lift a whole load of earth and hold it over my head!
translation: 흙을 한가득 들어 올려서 내 머리 위에 받쳐 줄 수 있는 새 기계라든가!

english: Well enjoy that thought!
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 올해 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 너무 시무룩해 보여요.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Talk about bowling.
Hello young man.
The boy sobs.
What's the matter?
I've kicked my ball over that hedge, into that garden! The old lady who lives there is scary... She's locked the ball in her wooden shed! Can you get my ball back for me please?
translation: 공을 차다가 저 산울타리 너머 정원으로 넘겨 버렸어요! 거기 사는 할머니가 무서운데... 그 할머니가 제 공을 나무 헛간에 가둬 버렸어요! 공 좀 찾아다 주실래요?

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
Thanks mister!
Get it back yourself.
You're a meany!
The boy starts crying again.
Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 대답 안 할 거면 난 간다.

english: The boy sniffs slightly.
Thank you for getting my ball back!
What's the matter?
Yes.
No.
Well if you're not going to answer, I'll go.
translation: 대답 안 할 거면 난 간다.

english: You're a long way from home, what are you doing here?
translation: 집에서 꽤 멀리 오셨네요. 여기서 뭐 하세요?

english: I'm on an expedition to try and extend the bounds of gnome knowledge. King Narnode has sent out a number of gnome explorers to map the furthest reaches of Gielinor.
translation: 노움의 지식이 닿는 범위를 넓히려고 탐험 중이에요. King Narnode(나노드 왕)께서 Gielinor(길리노르)의 가장 먼 곳까지 지도로 남기라고 노움 탐험가를 여럿 보내셨거든요.

english: Seems like a hard job.
Oh no, I enjoy it - I've always had itchy feet ever since I was a little gnome.
translation: 아뇨, 전 즐거워요. 꼬마 노움 시절부터 늘 발이 근질근질했거든요.

english: Still, you seem to have drawn the short straw here - there's nothing but snow...
translation: 그래도 여긴 운 나쁘게 걸리신 것 같은데요. 눈밖에 없잖아요...

english: Oh, I like it - very peaceful. Avoiding those Trolls can be tricky though.
translation: 아, 전 좋아요. 아주 평화롭거든요. 그래도 Trolls(트롤)을 피해 다니는 건 좀 까다로워요.

english: Tell me about it...
What does this mint cake do?
translation: 이 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 어디에 쓰는 거예요?

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: 노움식 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 노움 여행자에게 훌륭한 기운의 원천이에요. 기운이 다 떨어져 갈 때 힘을 한 번 더 쭉 끌어올려 주죠.

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: 오, 그거 꽤 쓸모 있겠네요. 남는 거 있어요?

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: 미안하지만 지금 가진 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 다 필요해요.

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 이 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)는 어디에 쓰는 거예요?

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: 아, Grand Tree(그랜드 트리)의 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)는 무척 흥미로운 정령 유물이에요. 아주 쓸모 있는 물건이지만 존중하는 마음으로 다뤄야 해요. 그랜드 트리는 자기 몸의 모든 부분과 연결돼 있거든요. 그 부분이 아무리

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?
translation: 멀리 떨어져 있더라도요. Spirit Trees(정령 나무)가 어떻게 작동한다고 생각해요?

english: If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: 머나먼 곳에서 그 씨앗을 날려 보내면 나무가 살아남도록 돕는 셈이에요. 그래서 grand tree(그랜드 트리)는 하늘에 표시를 남기는 씨앗 폭발 자체와 약간의 마법을 이용해 gnome glider(노움 글라이더) 조종사가 당신을 찾도록 도와주고, 고마움의 표시로 당신을

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: 집까지 데려다줘요. 새내기 농부라면 식물과의 교감도 전보다 살짝 나아진 걸 느낄 거예요.

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: 하지만 조종사가 당신을 찾으려면 시간이 걸려요. 정말 급할 때, 그러니까 진짜 비상시라면 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)를 그냥 으깨 버려도 돼요. Grand Tree(그랜드 트리)는 이걸 싫어하지만, 당신을 곧장

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: 집으로 끌어당겨 줄 거예요. 그래도 곧바로 식물을 다뤄야 한다면 이렇게 하지 마세요. 이런 식으로 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)를 쓰고 나면 한동안 농사 솜씨가 확 떨어지고, 이동하는 길도

english: very pleasant...
Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
I'm struggling with this, please help me solve it!
translation: 이거 너무 어려워요. 푸는 것 좀 도와주세요!

english: Brambrickle has given you a puzzle box!
Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Brambrickle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Brambrickle(브램비클)이 단서 두루마리를 하나 더 건넸다!

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Brambickle.
translation: Brambickle(브램비클)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Brrrr. This will warm me up, I'm bored of snow and Troll food.
translation: 으으, 추워. 이거 먹으면 몸이 좀 녹겠어요. 눈이랑 Troll(트롤) 음식은 이제 질렸거든요.

english: Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: 이제 제대로 된 음식이 생겼으니 이건 더 필요 없겠어요.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 자, 이 Grand Seed pods(그랜드 씨앗 꼬투리)를 받으세요. 비상시에 아주 쓸모 있어요!

english: I found this odd herb, maybe you can do something with it.
translation: 이상한 herb(약초)를 하나 찾았는데, 당신이라면 뭔가 써먹을 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 저한테 가져다주느라 먼 길을 오셨겠네요. 팁으로 약간 더 얹어 드릴게요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: You're a long way from home, what are you doing here?
translation: 집에서 꽤 멀리 오셨네요. 여기서 뭐 하세요?

english: What does this mint cake do?
translation: 이 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 어디에 쓰는 거예요?

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 이 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)는 어디에 쓰는 거예요?

english: Anywhere you want to go?
Home.
Maybe another day.
No, this feel like home.
Oh, I guess I could stay here a while...
translation: 아, 그럼 여기 좀 더 있어도 되겠네...

english: How is the weather down there?
Hot.
Ah, I'm sorry to hear that.
No, I like.
Oh right yeah, that makes sense.
If I get into a fight, are you going to help me?
translation: 내가 싸움에 휘말리면 너 도와줄 거야?

english: I follow.
I'll take that as a yes, then?
Just follow.
I'll take that as a no, then.
Yes.
Wait, yes? You'll fight?
No.
Cool.
What?
I squish!
You burn!
Home.
No, this feel like home.
Cold.
No, I like.
I follow.
Just follow.
Yes.
No.
Cool.
I squish!
You freeze!
Here I come!
You can't escape me!
Time to feel my strength!
Time to feel the strength of fire!
I'll crush you now!
No more running, face me now!
Time to meet your end!
The real battle begins now!
You'll regret provoking me!
translation: 나를 건드린 걸 후회하게 될 거다!

english: Let's end this fight!
Your time is up!
This is no game anymore!
Behold the power of fire!
Face the force of my fury!
Let's see how you handle this!
Time to face your doom!
Time to taste my wrath!
Can you withstand this power?
translation: 이 힘을 버텨 낼 수 있겠느냐?

english: Feel the heat of my wrath!
Prepare to be scorched!
Time to feel my flames!
Time to show you my full strength!
translation: 내 모든 힘을 보여 줄 때다!

english: Finally I can unleash my true power!
translation: 드디어 진정한 힘을 해방할 수 있겠구나!

english: Feel the full strength of my wrath now!
translation: 이제 내 분노의 모든 힘을 느껴라!

english: Now, there's nothing holding me back!
translation: 이제 날 막을 것은 아무것도 없다!

english: No more holding back! Prepare to feel my full strength!
translation: 더는 봐주지 않겠다! 내 모든 힘을 맛볼 각오를 해라!

english: Can I help you with anything today?
What are you selling?
No thanks.
Okay, well let me know if I can.
What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hello there!
Do I know you?
I don't think so.
Then I will have to ask you to move on.
But...
Here's a word of advice: Don't take things personally. I get a lot of wannabes bothering me and wanting to join my crew, but I'm not here to offer out cheap thrills.
translation: 충고 하나 하지. 기분 나쁘게 듣지 마라. 내 선원이 되겠다고 귀찮게 구는 풋내기들이 한둘이 아니거든. 하지만 난 싸구려 짜릿함이나 나눠 주려고 여기 있는 게 아니야.

english: So what are you here for?
To enjoy a drink and not be bothered. Now, if you'll excuse me...
translation: 방해받지 않고 술 한잔하러. 자, 그럼 이만...

english: Vegetate!
Die deliciously!
Rest in cabbage!
Grow up or leave.
Hey Bravek.
Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I've been left with a lot of work to do thanks to those mourners.
translation: 아, 어서 와요. 미안하지만 얘기할 틈이 없어요. 그 mourners(애도자)들 덕분에 일이 산더미처럼 남았거든요.

english: Go away, I'm busy! I'm... Umm... In a meeting!
translation: 저리 가요, 바쁘다고요! 저는... 음... 회의 중이에요!

english: My head hurts! I'll speak to you another day...
This is really important though!

I can't possibly speak to you with my head spinning like this... I went a bit heavy on the drink again last night. Curse my herbalist, she made the best hang over cures. Darn inconvenient of her catching the plague.
translation: 머리가 이렇게 빙빙 도는데 무슨 얘기를 해요... 어젯밤에 또 술을 좀 과하게 마셨거든요. 망할 약초사 같으니, 숙취 해소제는 정말 끝내주게 만들었는데. 하필 역병에 걸려 버리다니, 참 곤란하게 됐어요.

english: Okay, goodbye.
You shouldn't drink so much then!
translation: 그럼 술을 그렇게 많이 마시지 마셨어야죠!

english: Well positions of responsibility are hard, I need something to take my mind off things... Especially with the problems this place has.
translation: 책임 있는 자리라는 게 원래 힘든 법이에요. 잡생각을 떨칠 뭔가가 필요하다고요... 특히 이곳이 안고 있는 문제들을 생각하면요.

english: Do you know what's in the cure?
Hmmm let me think... Ouch! Thinking isn't clever. Ah here, she did scribble it down for me.
translation: 흐음, 생각해 보죠... 아야! 생각이란 건 할 짓이 못 되는군요. 아, 여기 있다. 그 사람이 저한테 적어 준 게 있었어요.

english: I don't think drink is the solution.
I don't feel well enough to have a philosophical discussion about it right now. My head hurts.
translation: 지금은 그런 철학적인 토론을 할 만한 몸 상태가 아니에요. 머리가 아프다고요.

english: Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
translation: 으윽! 아직도 머리가 너무 아파서 생각을 제대로 못 하겠어요. 아, Trudi(트루디)의 숙취 해소제 한 잔만 있었으면!

english: Try this.
Ooh that's much better! Thanks, that's the clearest my head has felt in a month. Ah now, what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: 오오, 훨씬 낫네요! 고마워요. 한 달 만에 머리가 이렇게 맑아진 건 처음이에요. 아, 그래서 나한테 뭘 해 달라고 했었죠?

english: I need to rescue a kidnap victim called Elena. She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: Elena(엘레나)라는 납치 피해자를 구해야 해요. 역병 걸린 집에 갇혀 있는데, 들어가려면 허가가 필요해요.

english: Well the mourners deal with that sort of thing...
Okay, I'll go speak to them.
translation: 알겠어요, 그 사람들한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Is that all anyone says around here?
translation: 여기 사람들은 다 그 말밖에 안 해요?

english: Well, they know best about plague issues.
translation: 뭐, 역병 문제는 그 사람들이 제일 잘 아니까요.

english: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?
translation: 이 일에 조금이라도 관심 가져 볼 생각은 없으세요?

english: Nope, I don't wish to take a deep interest in plagues. That stuff is too scary for me!
translation: 없어요. 역병 같은 데 깊이 관심 갖고 싶지 않아요. 그런 건 너무 무섭다고요!

english: I see why people say you're a weak leader.
translation: 사람들이 왜 당신을 무능한 지도자라고 하는지 알겠네요.

english: Bah, people always criticise their leaders but delegating is the only way to lead. I delegate all plague issues to the mourners.
translation: 흥, 사람들은 늘 지도자를 비판하기 마련이지만, 일을 맡기는 게 유일한 통치 방법이에요. 역병 문제는 전부 mourners(애도자)들한테 맡겼어요.

english: This whole city is a plague issue!
Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
They won't listen to me!
translation: 그 사람들은 제 말을 안 들어요!

english: They say I'm not properly equipped to go in the house, though I do have a very effective gas mask.
translation: 제가 그 집에 들어갈 장비를 제대로 갖추지 않았대요. 아주 효과 좋은 gas mask(방독면)도 있는데 말이에요.

english: Hmmm, well I guess they're not taking the issue of a kidnapping seriously enough. They do go a bit far sometimes.
translation: 흐음, 그 사람들이 납치 문제를 충분히 심각하게 받아들이지 않는 모양이군요. 가끔 좀 지나칠 때가 있어요.

english: I've heard of Elena, she has helped us a lot... Okay, I'll give you this warrant to enter the house.
translation: Elena(엘레나) 얘기는 들었어요. 우리를 많이 도와줬죠... 좋아요, 그 집에 들어갈 수 있게 이 warrant(영장)을 드릴게요.

english: Thanks again for the hangover cure.
Ah now what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: 아, 그래서 나한테 뭘 해 달라고 했었죠?

english: I need to rescue Elena. She's now a kidnap victim! She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: Elena(엘레나)를 구해야 해요. 이제 납치 피해자예요! 역병 걸린 집에 갇혀 있는데, 들어가려면 허가가 필요해요.

english: Not a problem, happy to help out.
I'm just having a little drop of whisky, then I'll feel really good.
translation: whisky(위스키) 한 모금만 살짝 마시고 나면 기분이 정말 좋아질 거예요.

english: This is really important though!
Okay, goodbye.
You shouldn't drink so much then!
translation: 그럼 술을 그렇게 많이 마시지 마셨어야죠!

english: Do you know what's in the cure?
I don't think drink is the solution.
Okay, I'll go speak to them.
translation: 알겠어요, 그 사람들한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Is that all anyone says around here?
translation: 여기 사람들은 다 그 말밖에 안 해요?

english: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?
translation: 이 일에 조금이라도 관심 가져 볼 생각은 없으세요?

english: I see why people say you're a weak leader.
translation: 사람들이 왜 당신을 무능한 지도자라고 하는지 알겠네요.

english: Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
They won't listen to me!
translation: 그 사람들은 제 말을 안 들어요!

english: *cough*whatcha want?*hack*
What is this place?
Smoke dungeon.*wheeze*Got smoke devils in it. For killing.*splutter*
translation: Smoke dungeon(연기 던전)이지.*쌕쌕*smoke devils(연기 악마)가 있어. 잡으라고.*켁켁*

english: My niece Nieve*hack hack*is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill.*cough*I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 내 조카딸 Nieve(니에브)가*캑 캑*그 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터) 중 하나야. 알지, 사람들한테 뭘 잡으라고 시키는 사람들.*콜록*난 그런 임무 받은 사람들을 위해 이 동굴을 관리하고 있어.

english: My nephew Steve*hack hack*is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill.*cough*I look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 내 조카 Steve(스티브)가*캑 캑*그 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터) 중 하나야. 알지, 사람들한테 뭘 잡으라고 시키는 사람들.*콜록*난 그런 임무 받은 사람들을 위해 이 동굴을 관리하고 있어.

english: Are you alright?
Of course I'm*wheeze*alright. I'm fed up with you young folk asking*cough cough*if I'm alright just because I like a bit of smoke*splutter*in my tubes.
translation: 당연히*쌕쌕*괜찮지. 요즘 젊은 것들은 내가 그저*콜록 콜록*기관지에 연기 좀 채우는 걸 좋아한다고*켁켁*괜찮냐고 물어 대니 아주 지긋지긋해.

english: Don't you come lecturing me on*cough*air quality, young man - I've breathed smoke all my life, man and boy and*euuurgh*and there's no*ghhuk*scientific evidence that it's harmful.
translation: 나한테*콜록*공기 질 가지고 훈계할 생각 마, 젊은이. 난 어려서부터 평생 연기를 마시며 살았는데*으어어억*그게 해롭다는*크흑*과학적 증거는 하나도 없다고.

english: I think I'll leave you alone.
*cough cough cough ghhuk*
Hey, you don't*cough*wanna go in there without*cough*some kind of protection from the smoke. Your lungs aren't as tough as*wheeze*mine.
translation: 이봐, 연기를 막을*콜록*보호 장비도 없이*콜록*저기 들어가면 안 돼. 네 폐는 내 것만큼*쌕쌕*튼튼하지 않다고.

english: *cough*that isn't your assignment*wheeze*
What is this place?
Are you alright?
I think I'll leave you alone.
Enter anyway.
Stay outside.
Hmm, interesting place this. It feels a little like Kelda, except without the good bits.
translation: 흠, 여기 재밌는 곳이네. Kelda(켈다)랑 좀 비슷한데, 좋은 건 쏙 빠졌어.

english: Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.
translation: 지루해, 지루해, 지루해. 이 Fremenniks(프레메닉) 놈들은 왜 이렇게 오래 걸려.

english: Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.
translation: 이봐요, 다들 최선을 다하고 있어요. 그쪽이 일찍 온 거잖아요.

english: Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.
translation: 어이, 우린 너희 대표들한테 말한 바로 그 시간에 왔어. 너희 쪽 계획이 엉망인 걸 내 쪽 비상사태로 만들지 마.

english: Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!
translation: 제발 누가 이분들 광석 좀 빨리 갖다 드려요. 섬에 있는 맛있는 음식은 죄다 먹어 치우면서 불평까지 한다고요!

english: I'd better get a move on!
Why are you still here?
Well it seemed rude not to finish the food they gave us.
translation: 뭐, 내준 음식을 남기는 건 실례 같아서 말이지.

english: Feel free to leave it. Please leave.
I'll just finish the roast off.
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)는 더 이상 우리를 지켜 주지 못해요!

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 곧 White Knights(백기사)가 이곳을 장악할 거예요!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 그래도 White Knights(백기사)가 장악하고 말 거예요.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 공격을 준비하고 있대요!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Who are you?
My name is Brew'ma. I'm here to assist adventurers like you with potion making.
translation: 내 이름은 Brew'ma(브루마)예요. 당신 같은 모험가들의 물약 만들기를 도와주려고 여기 있죠.

english: If you hand me a herb from the Bruma tree and one of the unfinished potions from the crate, I can combine the two if you lack the... talent to do so yourself.
translation: Bruma(브루마) 나무에서 딴 herb(약초)와 crate(나무 상자)에 있는 미완성 물약을 하나씩 주면, 당신이 직접 섞을... 재주가 없을 경우 내가 둘을 섞어 줄 수 있어요.

english: Thanks!
You don't have any unfinished potions on you. I can't use the herbs without them.
translation: 미완성 물약을 갖고 있지 않네요. 그게 없으면 약초를 쓸 수가 없어요.

english: You don't have any Bruma herbs on you. I need them to finish the potions.
translation: Bruma(브루마) 약초를 갖고 있지 않네요. 물약을 완성하려면 그게 필요해요.

english: Sorry, I can't do anything with that.
translation: 미안하지만 그걸로는 아무것도 할 수 없어요.

english: So, are you selling something?
Yep, take a look at these great axes!
translation: 그럼요, 이 멋진 axes(도끼)들 좀 보쇼!

english: 'Ello.
'Ello!
Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 축하해요! [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: So, are you selling something?
'Ello.
Would you like to buy some archery equipment?
No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: 괜찮아요, 활쏘기 장비는 필요한 만큼 다 있어요.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
No thanks, I've got all the archery equipment I need.
translation: 괜찮아요, 활쏘기 장비는 필요한 만큼 다 있어요.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
Hi there, looking for a challenge are you?
Yes actually, what've you got?
Shame, I don't think I have anything for you. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 아쉽네요. 당신한테 맞는 건 없는 것 같아요. Agility(민첩) 스킬을 최소 50까지 올리고 오면 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Aha, I have the perfect thing for you! See if you can get to the centre of my maze, the further you get the greater the rewards. There's even some special prizes if you make it right to the end.
translation: 아하, 당신한테 딱 맞는 게 있어요! 내 미로 한가운데까지 갈 수 있는지 한번 해 봐요. 멀리 갈수록 보상도 커져요. 끝까지 가면 특별한 상품도 있답니다.

english: Ok that sounds good!
Great! When you enter the maze, I'll give you a jewel - it'll allow you to get out of the maze at any time. However that's all you're allowed to take in with you, no cheating!
translation: 좋아요! 미로에 들어갈 때 보석을 하나 줄게요. 그걸로 언제든 미로에서 나올 수 있어요. 하지만 가지고 들어갈 수 있는 건 그것뿐이에요. 반칙은 안 돼요!

english: Oh one last thing, if you happen to see my harmonica I'd really like to have it back.
translation: 아, 마지막으로 하나 더. 혹시 내 하모니카를 보면 꼭 돌려받고 싶어요.

english: Actually I think I'll pass thanks.
What is this place?
Ah welcome to my humble home, well actually it belongs to mummsie but she's getting on a bit so I look after the place for her.
translation: 아, 내 누추한 집에 온 걸 환영해요. 뭐, 사실은 우리 엄마 집인데, 엄마가 연세가 좀 드셔서 내가 대신 집을 돌보고 있어요.

english: So are you interested in a challenge?
No thanks.
Hi again, what can I do for you?
I want to try the maze again!
Certainly, when you enter the maze I'll give you another jewel. Good luck!
translation: 물론이죠. 미로에 들어갈 때 보석을 하나 더 줄게요. 행운을 빌어요!

english: Nothing thanks.
And where do you think you're going? A little too eager I think. Come and talk to me before you go wandering around in there.
translation: 어딜 가는 거예요? 좀 성급하네요. 거기 돌아다니기 전에 먼저 나한테 와서 얘기해요.

english: Tut tut tut, now you know you're not allowed to take anything except that jewel in with you.
translation: 쯧쯧쯧, 그 보석 말고는 아무것도 가지고 들어가면 안 되는 거 알잖아요.

english: Sorry but I can't allow you to take your follower in there, never know what trouble they might cause.
translation: 미안하지만 따라다니는 동료는 데리고 들어갈 수 없어요. 무슨 말썽을 피울지 모르니까요.

english: Brian O'Richard gives you a jewel as you enter the maze.
translation: 미로에 들어서자 Brian O'Richard(브라이언 오리처드)가 보석을 건넨다.

english: Oh dear, you really didn't get very far did you?
Well you didn't do too badly, but you didn't make it nearly as far as others have.
translation: 뭐, 아주 못하진 않았지만 다른 사람들만큼 멀리 가진 못했네요.

english: You gained: [number] Thieving Experience. [number] Agility Experience.
Amazing, you made it so far!
Want to come out then? Giving up are you? You know there's no time limit here.
translation: 나오고 싶어요? 포기하는 거예요? 여긴 시간제한이 없는 거 알죠?

english: Yes I'd like to leave!
Right you are then, out you come.
The player exits the maze
No I'm fine thanks.
Yes actually, what've you got?
Ok that sounds good!
What is this place?
Actually I think I'll pass thanks.
No thanks.
I want to try the maze again!
Nothing thanks.
Yes I'd like to leave!
No I'm fine thanks.
What do you want? Weapons is what I got.
I'll take a look.
I don't need anything.
I'll take a look.
I don't need anything.
Hello adventurer, what can I do for you?
Hello, just wanted a chat..
translation: 안녕하세요, 그냥 이야기 좀 나누고 싶어서요..

english: It's always a pleasure to catch up with an another mage! Especially one who has helped me so much!
translation: 동료 마법사와 회포를 푸는 건 언제나 즐거운 일이지! 특히 나를 이렇게 많이 도와준 사람이라면 더더욱!

english: Oh, by the way, I found this odd thing lying around, does it belong to you?
translation: 아, 그런데 말일세. 이 이상한 물건이 굴러다니던데, 자네 것인가?

english: Oh, yes - I was wondering where that had gone...
You should look after your things more carefully you know...
translation: 자네 물건은 좀 더 잘 챙기게나...

english: Thanks!
How are your researches going?
Oh, not so bad. I'll let you know if I find anything I think you'll find interesting...
translation: 아, 그럭저럭요. 흥미로워하실 만한 걸 찾으면 알려 드릴게요...

english: Thanks! I'd appreciate that.
What's this seed do?
Fascinating ... a crystal seed. You should have a look at the crystal bowl in the other room, must be related...
translation: 흥미롭군... crystal seed(크리스탈 씨앗)로구먼. 다른 방에 있는 crystal bowl(크리스탈 그릇)을 한번 보게나. 분명 관련이 있을 걸세...

english: Thanks, I'll do that...
What's this crystal saw do?
translation: 이 crystal saw(크리스탈 톱)은 뭐에 쓰는 거예요?

english: I've no idea, it must have been Oaknock's, he liked talking to the elves.
translation: 나도 전혀 모르겠네. 아마 Oaknock(오크녹)의 것이었을 걸세. 그 친구는 엘프들과 이야기하는 걸 좋아했거든.

english: Where would I find out how the thing works?
translation: 이게 어떻게 작동하는지 어디서 알아볼 수 있을까요?

english: Errm, I'm not sure. Have a chat with Hazelmere, maybe he'll know. He was around when
translation: 으음, 잘 모르겠군. Hazelmere(헤이즐미어)와 이야기해 보게. 그라면 알지도 모르지. 그는

english: Oaknock was alive and might have seen him use it.
translation: Oaknock(오크녹)이 살아 있을 때 곁에 있었으니, 그게 쓰이는 걸 봤을지도 모르네.

english: Excellent idea, I'll do that. Thanks.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 주실 수 있어요?

english: Okay. Hold onto your hat!
Senventior Disthine Molenko!
Brimstail teleports the player to the rune essence mine.
translation: Brimstail(브림스테일)이 플레이어를 rune essence(룬 정수) 광산으로 순간이동시킨다.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요하네!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 되네. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리지.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Brimstail
translation: Brimstail(브림스테일)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넨다

english: You have my gratitude, young delivery person!
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있다네. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있지.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 걸 잊지 말게.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었네! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받게. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: Well done!
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Hello, just wanted a chat.
translation: 안녕하세요, 그냥 이야기 좀 나누고 싶어서요.

english: I need to mine some rune essence.
translation: rune essence(룬 정수)를 좀 캐야 해요.

english: *squeal*
*snuffle*
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
If you'd like to see someone fighting Zulrah, feel free to borrow my telescope.
translation: Zulrah(줄라)와 싸우는 사람을 구경하고 싶으면 내 telescope(망원경)을 마음껏 빌려 써요.

english: What do you mean?
Zulrah, the giant snake. Its lair is deep in the swamp, so I've set up a telescope so I can watch people fighting it.
translation: Zulrah(줄라), 거대한 뱀 말이에요. 그 소굴이 swamp(늪) 깊숙이 있어서, 사람들이 그놈과 싸우는 걸 구경하려고 telescope(망원경)을 설치해 뒀어요.

english: Thanks.
What do you mean?
Thanks.
Nilsal, traveller. I was injured while exploring down here. Could you spare me some cooked fish, meat or vegetables?
translation: Nilsal(닐살), 여행자여. 이 아래를 탐험하다가 다치고 말았습니다. 익힌 생선이나 고기, 채소를 조금 나누어 주실 수 있겠습니까?

english: It just so happens that I have some with me!
Oh, please hand it over if you can spare it.
I'm afraid that I don't have any of that type of food with me.
translation: 죄송하지만 그런 음식은 지금 가진 게 없어요.

english: Oh, well if you return with any I would greatly appreciate it.
translation: 오, 그렇다면 혹시 구해 오시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.

english: No thanks. I would rather eat fish, meat or vegetables.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮습니다. 저는 생선이나 고기, 채소 쪽이 좋겠습니다.

english: Thanks for helping me. Is there anything you'd like to know about this temple? If you find anything in here, show it to me and I'll tell you what I know about it.
translation: 도와주셔서 감사합니다. 이 사원에 대해 알고 싶은 것이 있으십니까? 이 안에서 무언가를 발견하시면 제게 보여 주십시오. 아는 만큼 말씀드리겠습니다.

english: What is this place?
This place probably had a name at some point but it has long since been forgotten. The Arceuus librarians refer to this place as the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: 이곳에도 한때는 이름이 있었겠지만, 오래전에 잊혔습니다. Arceuus(아르세우스)의 사서들은 이곳을 Forthos Dungeon(포르토스 던전)이라고 부릅니다.

english: It is rumoured that this place used to be of religious significance to druidic followers of both Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 소문에 따르면 이곳은 예전에 Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)을 함께 따르던 드루이드 신도들에게 종교적으로 중요한 장소였다고 합니다.

english: Who are Ralos and Ranul?
According to religious texts, Ralos is the god of the sun and Ranul, his brother, is the god of the moon.
translation: 종교 문헌에 따르면 Ralos(랄로스)는 태양의 신이고, 그의 형제인 Ranul(라눌)은 달의 신입니다.

english: If you find any artifacts or relics from within this temple, I would be very interested in seeing them.
translation: 이 사원 안에서 유물이나 성물을 발견하시면 꼭 보고 싶습니다.

english: I'll see what I find. Although, I've never heard of Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 뭐가 있는지 찾아볼게요. 그런데 Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)이라는 이름은 처음 들어 봐요.

english: You need only to look up and see their greatness above you when you return to the surface.
translation: 지상으로 돌아가시면 고개를 들어 보십시오. 그분들의 위대함이 머리 위에 있을 것입니다.

english: Who are you?
My name is Brother Aimeri, I am a travelling monk from the distant land of Varlamore on a journey to uncover the secrets of this temple.
translation: 제 이름은 Brother Aimeri(에메리 수사)입니다. 머나먼 땅 Varlamore(바를라모어)에서 온 떠돌이 수도승으로, 이 사원의 비밀을 밝히러 여행 중입니다.

english: I worship Ralos, a common practice where I am from. However, I found out that our order may have originated from this temple. If you find anything of interest, please let me know.
translation: 저는 Ralos(랄로스)를 섬깁니다. 제 고향에서는 흔한 일이지요. 그런데 저희 교단이 이 사원에서 비롯되었을지도 모른다는 사실을 알게 되었습니다. 흥미로운 것을 찾으시면 꼭 알려 주십시오.

english: I'll keep my eyes open.
You have my gratitude. Any information you do find would also be of interest to the Arceuus Library. I hope we can uncover the secrets of this place for the greater good.
translation: 감사합니다. 찾아내신 정보는 Arceuus Library(아르세우스 도서관)에서도 관심을 가질 겁니다. 더 큰 선을 위하여, 함께 이곳의 비밀을 밝혀낼 수 있기를 바랍니다.

english: The greater good.
How did you get injured?
I found out about this place from Logosia in the Arceuus Library. I came to investigate but was ambushed by the spiders in the room to the north.
translation: Arceuus Library(아르세우스 도서관)의 Logosia(로고시아)에게서 이곳 이야기를 들었습니다. 조사하러 왔다가 북쪽 방에 있던 거미들에게 습격을 당했지요.

english: I'm a scholar not a fighter. I didn't have time to think through my options so I did what came naturally and ran away.
translation: 저는 학자지 투사가 아닙니다. 이것저것 따져 볼 틈도 없어서, 몸이 시키는 대로 했습니다. 도망쳤지요.

english: Why didn't you decide to run back the way you came from instead of running further into the dungeon where there could be more dangerous creatures?
translation: 더 위험한 생물이 있을지도 모르는 던전 안쪽으로 도망치지 말고, 왔던 길로 돌아가지 그러셨어요?

english: See, the problem with that... Is that it is an excellent idea I wish I had thought of at the time.
translation: 그게 말입니다... 문제는, 그게 그때 떠올렸더라면 참 좋았을 아주 훌륭한 생각이라는 거지요.

english: You've been trapped here for a while! No wonder you were hungry!
translation: 여기 갇힌 지 꽤 되셨군요! 배고프실 만도 해요!

english: I found a strange creature possessing an adventurer within the dungeon and it has cursed one of the altars. Do you know how I can remove it?
translation: 던전 안에서 모험가에게 빙의한 이상한 생물을 발견했는데, 그게 제단 하나에 저주를 걸었어요. 어떻게 없앨 수 있을까요?

english: How strange. Tell me, what did the creature look like?
translation: 참으로 이상하군요. 말씀해 보십시오. 그 생물은 어떻게 생겼습니까?

english: It was a dark black creature with a white skull on its head and curved horns.
translation: 새카만 생물이었는데, 머리에 하얀 해골이 있고 굽은 뿔이 달려 있었어요.

english: Let me see... According to my notes that appears to have been a Shaeded Beast, a vile creature which posseses people and corrupts their minds.
translation: 어디 보자... 제 기록에 따르면 그건 Shaeded Beast(그늘진 야수)인 것 같습니다. 사람에게 빙의해 정신을 타락시키는 사악한 생물이지요.

english: Only the power of Ralos can remove such a curse. I suggest making an offering to Ralos somewhere within this temple.
translation: 그런 저주는 오직 Ralos(랄로스)의 힘으로만 걷어낼 수 있습니다. 이 사원 어딘가에서 Ralos(랄로스)께 제물을 바쳐 보시기 바랍니다.

english: What kind of sacrifice should I offer?
As Ralos is the sun god, any normal bone just won't do. I'd recommend the bones of any dragon.
translation: Ralos(랄로스)는 태양신이시니 평범한 뼈로는 안 됩니다. 드래곤 뼈라면 어떤 것이든 좋겠습니다.

english: I'd advise staying away from the altar in the mean time.
translation: 그동안에는 그 제단에 가까이 가지 않으시는 게 좋겠습니다.

english: Thanks. I'll have a look around.
I received a key from the bone burner but unfortunately I have lost it.
translation: 뼈 태우는 사람에게서 열쇠를 받았는데, 안타깝게도 잃어버렸어요.

english: The great Ralos foresaw this and presented me with the same key for safe-keeping should you lose it.
translation: 위대하신 Ralos(랄로스)께서 이 일을 내다보시고, 당신이 잃어버릴 때를 대비해 같은 열쇠를 제게 맡겨 두셨습니다.

english: That's awfully convenient!
I'm fine, thanks.
Disgusting! I don't know why you have that, I'd destroy them before they have a chance to hatch.
translation: 역겹군요! 그걸 왜 가지고 계신지 모르겠습니다. 저라면 부화하기 전에 없애 버리겠습니다.

english: Actually, I believe they're used as supplies in potion making, they might have some use.
translation: 사실 물약 제조 재료로 쓰인다고 들었어요. 쓸모가 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Do with it as you wish, just don't come crawling back to me if it comes back to bite you.
translation: 마음대로 하십시오. 다만 나중에 그게 화근이 되어 덥석 물리더라도 제게 엉금엉금 기어 오지는 마십시오.

english: I see what you did there.
Hmm, interesting. I recall seeing a chest to the west of here further down the passage with colouring similar to this key. Perhaps this key opens that chest?
translation: 흠, 흥미롭군요. 이 통로를 따라 서쪽으로 더 가면 이 열쇠와 색이 비슷한 상자를 본 기억이 납니다. 아마 이 열쇠로 그 상자를 열 수 있지 않을까요?

english: Thanks for your help!
My, you adventurer'sare a strange bunch. I suppose there is a reason why you have kept the creatureseyes in a jar?
translation: 이런, 모험가분들은 참 별난 무리입니다. 그 생물의 눈을 병에 담아 가지고 다니시는 데는 이유가 있겠지요?

english: I'm not sure myself, though I've heard some people like to display items like this in their house.
translation: 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 다만 이런 물건을 집에 전시하길 좋아하는 사람들이 있다고 들었어요.

english: As I said, you are a strange bunch indeed.
That looks like the legs of Sarachnis, bound together by her web. I suppose if anything, it looks heavy enough to crush your enemies.
translation: Sarachnis(사라크니스)의 다리를 그 거미 자신의 거미줄로 한데 묶어 놓은 것 같군요. 굳이 말하자면, 적을 짓뭉갤 만큼은 무거워 보입니다.

english: Hey, let go of me! What are you doing?
translation: 야, 이거 놔! 뭐 하는 거야?

english: It talks?
Yeah, I killed Sarachnis and she started following me, I think she's cute so I've decided to keep her around.
translation: 네, Sarachnis(사라크니스)를 잡았더니 저를 따라다니기 시작했어요. 귀여워서 데리고 다니기로 했어요.

english: Do as you wish. I've certainly seen people keep worse company than a spider.
translation: 마음대로 하십시오. 거미보다 못한 자들과 어울리는 사람도 분명 본 적이 있으니까요.

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ranul.
translation: 오, 아주 흥미롭군요. 이 쪽지는 Ranul(라눌)에 관해 이야기하는 경전에서 뜯어낸 것 같습니다.

english: This is very sad. To see such religious scripts desecrated, it's blasphemy!
translation: 참으로 슬픈 일입니다. 경전이 이렇게 훼손되다니, 신성모독입니다!

english: Perhaps the script still exists?
translation: 원래 경전이 아직 남아 있을지도 모르잖아요?

english: Yes, yes! I hope so. I would expect a temple of this nature to have a library of sorts within it. Maybe the original is somewhere within it.
translation: 그렇지요, 그렇고말고요! 그러길 바랍니다. 이런 사원이라면 안에 서고 같은 곳이 있을 겁니다. 원본도 그 안 어딘가에 있을지 모릅니다.

english: I'll have a look for it. Thanks for your help!
Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a religious script which speaks of Ralos.
translation: 오, 아주 흥미롭군요. 이 쪽지는 Ralos(랄로스)에 관해 이야기하는 경전에서 뜯어낸 것 같습니다.

english: Oh, very interesting. This page appears to be taken from a historical script about the temple itself.
translation: 오, 아주 흥미롭군요. 이 쪽지는 이 사원 자체에 관한 역사서에서 뜯어낸 것 같습니다.

english: This is very sad. To see such information desecrated in this way.
translation: 참으로 슬픈 일입니다. 이런 기록이 이렇게 훼손되다니요.

english: No! Keep that away from me! I can sense an ominous power coming from that coin. Where did you find it?
translation: 안 됩니다! 그걸 제게서 치우십시오! 그 동전에서 불길한 힘이 느껴집니다. 어디서 찾으셨습니까?

english: A fellow adventurer I met within the temple had it on him. What should I do with it?
translation: 사원 안에서 만난 동료 모험가가 지니고 있었어요. 이걸 어떻게 해야 하죠?

english: I'd find out where it came from and put it back immediately.
translation: 제가 당신이라면 그게 어디서 왔는지 알아내서 당장 제자리에 돌려놓겠습니다.

english: The markings on it resemble that of the cult of Ranul, I'd look around for something of religious significance to them.
translation: 새겨진 표식이 Ranul(라눌) 교단의 것과 닮았습니다. 그들에게 종교적으로 중요한 무언가를 찾아보시기 바랍니다.

english: Fascinating. I'm not quite sure what this is for, perhaps there are doors within the temple which this unlocks?
translation: 놀랍군요. 무엇에 쓰는 것인지는 잘 모르겠습니다만, 이것으로 열 수 있는 문이 사원 안에 있지 않을까요?

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ranul.
translation: 굉장합니다! 바로 제가 찾던 것입니다. 이 책에는 Ranul(라눌)의 종교에 관한 내용이 담겨 있습니다.

english: Oh, it appears that there are some pages missing from it. The missing information could prove valuable.
translation: 오, 몇 쪽이 빠져 있는 것 같군요. 빠진 내용이 귀중한 것일 수도 있습니다.

english: Where do you think the missing pages are?
translation: 빠진 쪽은 어디 있을 것 같으세요?

english: This Temple has been abandoned for some time. Maybe the creatures within have destroyed the tome while looking for food. You may have to kill them to recover the pages.
translation: 이 사원은 버려진 지 꽤 되었습니다. 안에 사는 생물들이 먹을 것을 찾다가 책을 망가뜨렸을지도 모릅니다. 빠진 쪽을 되찾으려면 그것들을 처치해야 할 겁니다.

english: The book seems to be intact! I'm sure Logosia in the Arceuus Library to the north would find this information valuable.
translation: 책이 온전한 것 같군요! 북쪽에 있는 Arceuus Library(아르세우스 도서관)의 Logosia(로고시아)라면 이 내용을 귀중하게 여길 겁니다.

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the religion of Ralos.
translation: 굉장합니다! 바로 제가 찾던 것입니다. 이 책에는 Ralos(랄로스)의 종교에 관한 내용이 담겨 있습니다.

english: Amazing! This is exactly what I was looking for. This tome contains information about the temple itself.
translation: 굉장합니다! 바로 제가 찾던 것입니다. 이 책에는 이 사원 자체에 관한 내용이 담겨 있습니다.

english: I'm afraid I don't know anything about that item.
translation: 죄송하지만 그 물건에 대해서는 아는 바가 없습니다.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
How did you get injured?
Ask about the cursed altar.
Ask about the Temple Key
I'm fine, thanks.
Very nice rosebushes you have here.
Yes, it has taken me many long hours in this garden to bring them to this state of near-perfection.
translation: 그렇습니다. 이 정원에서 오랜 시간을 들인 끝에 거의 완벽에 가까운 상태로 가꿀 수 있었지요.

english: Good day, brother.
Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.
translation: 안녕하십니까, 저는 Brother Brace(브레이스 수사)입니다. Prayer(기도)에 관한 모든 것을 알려 드리려고 이곳에 있지요.

english: You should open the indicated menu to continue.
This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 이것이 당신의 기도 목록입니다. 기도는 전투에서 큰 도움이 되지요. 쓰고 싶은 기도를 클릭하면 켜지고, 다시 클릭하면 꺼집니다.

english: Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.
translation: 켜 둔 기도는 Prayer Points(기도 점수)를 소모합니다. 제단이나 다른 성스러운 곳을 찾아 기도하면 다시 채울 수 있지요.

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by clicking them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: 보셨듯이 대부분의 적은 쓰러지면 bones(뼈)를 떨어뜨립니다. 소지품에서 뼈를 클릭해 묻으면 Prayer(기도) 경험치를 얻을 수 있지요.

english: I'm also the community officer 'round here, so it's my job to tell you about your friends and ignore lists.
translation: 저는 이 근방의 커뮤니티 담당이기도 해서, 친구 목록과 차단 목록에 대해 알려 드리는 것도 제 일입니다.

english: Right. Now I'll tell you a little about each list. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 자, 이제 각 목록에 대해 조금 설명하지요. 추가 버튼을 클릭하고 나타나는 칸에 이름을 입력하면 어느 목록에든 사람을 추가할 수 있습니다.

english: You remove people from the lists in the same way. If you add someone to your ignore list they will not be able to talk to you or send any form of message to you.
translation: 목록에서 지우는 방법도 같습니다. 차단 목록에 누군가를 추가하면 그 사람은 당신에게 말을 걸 수도, 어떤 메시지를 보낼 수도 없게 됩니다.

english: Your friends list shows the online status of your friends. Friends in red are offline, friends in green are online and on the same world and friends in yellow are online, but on a different world.
translation: 친구 목록에서는 친구들의 접속 상태를 볼 수 있습니다. 빨간색은 오프라인, 초록색은 같은 월드에 접속 중, 노란색은 접속 중이지만 다른 월드에 있는 친구입니다.

english: Okay, thanks, I'll bear that in mind.
Peace be with you, my child. Can I help you?
Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. Click on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and click it again to deactivate it.
translation: 아, 그렇지요, 기도 목록 말이군요. 기도는 전투에서 큰 도움이 되지요. 쓰고 싶은 기도를 클릭하면 켜지고, 다시 클릭하면 꺼집니다.

english: Do you need anything else?
Your friends and ignore lists, yes... I'll tell you a little about each. You can add people to either list by clicking the add button then typing their name into the box that appears.
translation: 친구 목록과 차단 목록이라... 각각 조금 설명하지요. 추가 버튼을 클릭하고 나타나는 칸에 이름을 입력하면 어느 목록에든 사람을 추가할 수 있습니다.

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Tell me about Prayers again.
Tell me about my friends list again.
translation: 친구 목록에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Hello.
Honey, money, woman and wine!
Are you ok?
Yesshh...hic up...beautiful!
Take care old monk.
La..di..da..hic..up!
Brother Cedric are you okay?
Yeesshhh, I'm very, very drunk..hic..up..
Brother Omad needs the wine for the party.
translation: Brother Omad(오마드 수사)님이 파티에 쓸 와인이 필요하대요.

english: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something!
translation: 이런, 이런, 뭔가 해야 할 일이 있다는 건 알았는데!

english: Are you okay?
Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.
translation: 딸꾹! 아이고 머리야! jug of water(물 주전자)가 필요해.

english: I'll see if I can get some.
Thanks! *hic*
Cedric! Here, drink! I have some water.
translation: Cedric(세드릭) 수사님! 자, 마셔요! 물 가져왔어요.

english: Good stuff, my head's spinning!
Aah! That's better!
Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.
translation: 이제 이 수레만 고치면 파티하러 갈 수 있어.

english: Could you help?
No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: 아니요, 오늘은 수사님들을 도울 만큼 도왔어요!

english: In that case i'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.
translation: 그렇다면 와인을 더 마셔야겠군! 그래야 머리가 잘 돌아가거든.

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
Excellent, I just need some wood.
OK, I'll see what I can find.
Did you manage to get some wood?
Not yet, I'm afraid.
Here you go!
Well done! Now I'll fix this cart. You head back to Brother Omad and tell him I'll be there soon.
translation: 잘했어! 이제 수레를 고칠게. 너는 Brother Omad(오마드 수사)한테 돌아가서 내가 곧 간다고 전해 줘.

english: Ok! I'll see you later!
Hello Cedric.
Hi, I'm almost done here. Could you tell Omad that I'll be back soon?
translation: 안녕, 거의 다 끝났어. Omad(오마드)한테 내가 곧 돌아간다고 전해 줄래?

english: Brother Omad sends you his thanks! He won't be in a fit state to thank you in person.
translation: Brother Omad(오마드 수사)가 고맙다고 전해 달래! 직접 인사할 상태가 아니라서 말이야.

english: No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: 아니요, 오늘은 수사님들을 도울 만큼 도왔어요!

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 저처럼 대담한 모험가를 위해 뭘 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: I can tell you about holy symbols or the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: holy symbol(신성한 상징)이나 Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)에 대해 알려 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: holy symbol(신성한 상징)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: If you have a silver star, which is the holy symbol of Saradomin, then I can bless it. Then if you are wearing it, it will help you when you are praying.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 신성한 상징인 은빛 별을 가지고 계시면 제가 축복해 드릴 수 있어요. 그걸 착용하면 기도할 때 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: The Skillcape of Prayer is the hardest of all the skillcapes to get; it requires much devotion to acquire but also imbues the wearer with the ability to briefly fly!
translation: Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)는 모든 스킬 망토 중에서 얻기가 가장 어려워요. 손에 넣으려면 깊은 신앙심이 필요하지만, 착용한 사람에게 잠깐 하늘을 나는 능력도 깃들게 해 주죠!

english: The Cape of Prayer also increases the amount of Prayer points restored from drinking potions when it is equipped. Is there something else I can do for you?
translation: 기도 망토를 장착하고 있으면 물약을 마실 때 회복되는 Prayer points(기도 점수)도 늘어나요. 그 밖에 제가 도와드릴 일이 있나요?

english: No thank you.
Well I can bless that star of Saradomin you have, or I could tell you about the Skillcape of Prayer!
translation: 그럼 가지고 계신 Saradomin(사라도민)의 별을 축복해 드리거나, Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)에 대해 알려 드릴 수 있어요!

english: Yes please.
You give Jered the symbol. Jered closes his eyes and places his hand on the symbol. He softly chants. Jered passes you the holy symbol.
translation: Jered(제레드)에게 상징을 건넨다. 제레드가 눈을 감고 상징 위에 손을 얹는다. 그가 나지막이 기도문을 읊는다. 제레드가 신성한 상징을 돌려준다.

english: Well, seeing as you are so devout in praising the gods, I could sell you a Skillcape of Prayer, which increases the amount of Prayer points restored when drinking potions.
translation: 음, 신들을 그토록 경건하게 찬양하시니 Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)를 팔아 드릴 수 있어요. 물약을 마실 때 회복되는 Prayer points(기도 점수)를 늘려 주는 망토예요.

english: Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 네, 부탁해요. Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)를 가진 사람은 정말 드물잖아요!

english: One as pious as you has certainly earned the right to wear one, but the monastery requires a donation of 99000 coins for the privilege.
translation: 당신처럼 경건한 분이라면 분명 입을 자격이 있죠. 다만 그 특권을 위해 수도원에 99000 코인을 기부하셔야 해요.

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그건 살 형편이 안 돼요.

english: I am sorry to hear that. If you should find yourself in wealthier times come back and see me.
I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 수도원 유지에 보탬이 된다면 언제든 기쁘게 기부할게요.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 지금 가진 돈이 모자라요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토는 무료 두건이 함께 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 아시죠? 그러니 제가 팔아 드리기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 입으세요, 친구.

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
Yes! Praise he who brings life to this world.
translation: 그래요! 이 세상에 생명을 주시는 그분을 찬양하라.

english: I'm here to help with Oziach!
That is great, thank you! Speak to me downstairs in my office though, I don't have the paperwork up here.
translation: 정말 잘됐네요, 고마워요! 그런데 아래층 제 사무실에서 이야기해요. 여기 위층에는 서류가 없거든요.

english: Hi Brother Jered!
I hear Oziach has been scared, thank you! And thank your friend too.
translation: Oziach(오지아크)가 겁을 먹었다고 들었어요, 고마워요! 친구분께도 고맙다고 전해 주세요.

english: Iffie? She helped a lot, I need to go and give her the reward I promised.
translation: Iffie(이피) 말씀이세요? 그분이 많이 도와주셨어요. 약속한 보상을 드리러 가야 해요.

english: You better go and do that then, thanks again!
translation: 그럼 어서 가서 그렇게 하세요. 다시 한번 고마워요!

english: Hey Brother Jered!
Iffie had something she wanted to give you, you should talk to her.
translation: Iffie(이피)가 당신에게 줄 게 있다던데, 가서 이야기해 보세요.

english: I will do that right away!
What can you do to help a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 저처럼 대담한 모험가를 위해 뭘 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Tell me about holy symbols.
translation: holy symbol(신성한 상징)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about the Skillcape of Prayer.
translation: Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Yes, what else can you do for a bold adventurer like myself?
translation: 네, 저처럼 대담한 모험가를 위해 또 뭘 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: No, thank you.
Bless star, please.
None of those, thanks.
Yes, please. So few people have Skillcapes of Prayer!
translation: 네, 부탁해요. Skillcape of Prayer(기도 스킬 망토)를 가진 사람은 정말 드물잖아요!

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
translation: 죄송하지만 그건 살 형편이 안 돼요.

english: I am always happy to contribute towards the monastery's upkeep.
translation: 수도원 유지에 보탬이 된다면 언제든 기쁘게 기부할게요.

english: No thanks, I can't afford one of those.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그건 살 형편이 안 돼요.

english: Praise be to Saradomin!
Talk about the Halloween event.
Hello Brother Jered, the monks in Varrock sent me. What is going on?
translation: 안녕하세요, Brother Jered(제레드 수사)님. Varrock(바록)의 수사님들이 보내서 왔어요. 무슨 일이에요?

english: Thank Saradomin that you came! We need help! Oziach is trying to buy the monastery!
translation: 와 주셔서 Saradomin(사라도민)께 감사드려요! 도움이 필요해요! Oziach(오지아크)가 수도원을 사들이려고 해요!

english: What can I do to help?
We've tried everything, there is nothing!
translation: 할 수 있는 건 다 해 봤어요, 방법이 없어요!

english: Unless...
Are you any good at climbing trees?
Pretty good, why?
Oziach is scared of ghosts! If you can climb a tree and make a scary noise, that might scare him off!
translation: Oziach(오지아크)는 유령을 무서워해요! 나무에 올라가서 무서운 소리를 내면 겁먹고 도망칠지도 몰라요!

english: I see, I can give that a go! What should I make the scary noise with?
translation: 그렇군요, 한번 해 볼게요! 무서운 소리는 뭘로 내면 될까요?

english: How about one of these wine bottles? I have loads!
translation: 이 와인병 중 하나는 어때요? 잔뜩 있거든요!

english: I'm sure there's a perfectly sane explanation why.
translation: 왜 그렇게 많은지 분명 아주 멀쩡한 이유가 있겠죠.

english: I might have looked for a solution in them... And I found one, too!
translation: 그 안에서 해결책을 찾아봤을지도 모르죠... 그리고 정말 찾았어요!

english: Take this wine bottle and climb the tree nearest Oziach, then blow on it to scare him!
translation: 이 와인병을 가지고 Oziach(오지아크)와 가장 가까운 나무에 올라간 다음, 병을 불어서 겁을 주세요!

english: Brother Jered now has said to take the wine bottle.
translation: 이제 제레드 수사가 와인병을 가져가라고 말한 상태다.

english: Not a lot from down here, sorry, I'm currently dealing with this mess! Come and see me upstairs and I can assist you with your question there.
translation: 여기 아래층에서는 별로 해 드릴 게 없어요, 미안해요. 지금 이 난리를 수습하는 중이거든요! 위층으로 오시면 그때 질문을 도와드릴게요.

english: I've lost the bottle, can I have another one please?
translation: 병을 잃어버렸어요. 하나 더 주실 수 있나요?

english: You don't have any space for the bottle! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 병을 넣을 자리가 없네요! 자리를 만든 다음에 다시 말 걸어 주세요.

english: There you go. You can blow into the top to make a spooky sound.
translation: 여기 있어요. 병 주둥이에 바람을 불어 넣으면 으스스한 소리가 나요.

english: Brother Jered now remembers the player has received his bottle at least once.
translation: 이제 제레드 수사는 플레이어가 병을 한 번 이상 받았다는 것을 기억한다.

english: If you're hiding up a tree when you do it, it should fool Oziach into thinking it's a ghost!
translation: 나무 위에 숨어서 그렇게 하면, Oziach(오지아크)는 유령인 줄 알고 속을 거예요!

english: Would you like to try that now?
There you go, try not to lose this one!
Would you like to try and scare Oziach now?
Brother Jered!
Hi [player name].
Could I have another wine bottle? I dropped the other one.
translation: 와인병 하나 더 주실 수 있나요? 저번 건 떨어뜨렸어요.

english: Sure, I have plenty.
Yes, let's scare Oziach!
Be careful, make sure you don't get too close to him, or take too long, he'll be sure to spot you!
translation: 조심하세요. 너무 가까이 가거나 너무 오래 끌면 분명 들킬 거예요!

english: Good luck!
The camera fades to a cutscene.
Not just yet.
Okay, come back and talk to me when you're ready to try scaring Oziach!
translation: 알겠어요, Oziach(오지아크)를 겁줄 준비가 되면 다시 와서 말 걸어 주세요!

english: It didn't work!
Scaring Oziach? He wasn't scared?
No! He said one ghost wasn't enough! But I have a plan...
translation: 네! 유령 하나로는 부족하대요! 그런데 저한테 계획이 있어요...

english: A plan?
Yes! ONE ghost wasn't enough. We need more than one ghost. We need TWO ghosts!
translation: 네! 유령 '하나'로는 부족했어요. 하나보다 많아야 해요. 유령 '둘'이 필요해요!

english: Will you be my accomplice and be the second ghost?
translation: 제 공범이 되어서 두 번째 유령을 맡아 주실래요?

english: I would, but I don't feel too well from all the stress.
translation: 그러고 싶지만, 스트레스 때문에 몸이 좀 안 좋아요.

english: Are you sure it's not all the wine and food?
translation: 와인이랑 음식 때문인 건 확실히 아니고요?

english: What?
Nothing! That's okay, I hope you feel better soon!
translation: 아무것도 아니에요! 괜찮아요, 얼른 나으시길 바라요!

english: I need to find an accomplice elsewhere, then. Do you have any ideas?
translation: 그럼 다른 데서 공범을 찾아야겠네요. 뭐 좋은 생각 있으세요?

english: The price to place an advert is 500,000 coins. I've always had good responses to my ads in the past.
translation: 광고를 내려면 500,000 코인이 들어요. 예전에 광고를 냈을 때 반응이 늘 좋았거든요.

english: 500,000 coins? That is quite a lot!
Ah yes, don't worry about that. I have this pre-paid ad coupon you can use.
translation: 아, 그건 걱정 마세요. 쓰실 수 있는 선불 ad coupon(광고 쿠폰)이 있어요.

english: I bought an ad spot in the paper the other week. I was going to place an ad for recruiting some new monks.
translation: 지난주에 신문 광고란을 하나 사 뒀거든요. 새 수사들을 모집하는 광고를 낼 생각이었어요.

english: However with everything going on right now, I think this is more important.
translation: 하지만 지금 이런 일이 벌어지고 있으니 이게 더 중요한 것 같아요.

english: You don't have any space for the coupon! Talk to me again once you have space.
translation: 쿠폰을 넣을 자리가 없네요! 자리를 만든 다음에 다시 말 걸어 주세요.

english: There's now a coupon waiting for the player.
translation: 이제 플레이어를 위한 쿠폰이 준비된 상태다.

english: Here you go.
The player can now talk to Benny about the Halloween event.
translation: 이제 플레이어가 Benny(베니)에게 핼러윈 이벤트에 대해 이야기할 수 있다.

english: Thank you! You had me worried there that I was going to have to find 500,000 coins. I'll go and place the advert.
translation: 고마워요! 500,000 코인을 구해야 하는 줄 알고 걱정했잖아요. 가서 광고를 낼게요.

english: Good luck, I hope you find a good accomplice!
translation: 행운을 빌어요, 좋은 공범을 찾으시길 바라요!

english: I've lost the coupon, can I have another one please?
translation: 쿠폰을 잃어버렸어요. 하나 더 주실 수 있나요?

english: Have you placed the advert in the Varrock Herald yet?
Not yet.
Don't wait too long, the purchase will go through soon!
translation: 너무 오래 기다리지 마세요, 수도원 매입이 곧 성사될 거예요!

english: You can find Benny in the Varrock Square. You should talk to him about the ad.
translation: Benny(베니)는 Varrock Square(바록 광장)에서 찾을 수 있어요. 광고에 대해 그 사람과 이야기해 보세요.

english: I'll go and do that now!
Could I have another coupon before I go? I lost the other one.
translation: 가기 전에 쿠폰 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요? 저번 건 잃어버렸어요.

english: You don't need a coupon anymore!
Here is a copy of it. I made it before I gave you the original, try not to lose this!
translation: 여기 사본이 있어요. 원본을 드리기 전에 만들어 둔 거예요. 이건 잃어버리지 마세요!

english: How is it going?
Well thanks, I've just placed the advert in the Herald.
translation: 잘되고 있어요, 고마워요. 방금 Herald(헤럴드)에 광고를 냈어요.

english: Lovely! Where are you meeting the candidates?
At the Blue Moon Inn, I'm going to head there now.
translation: Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관)에서요. 지금 그리로 가려고요.

english: Hello [player name]. I thank you for helping us, we've been running out of ideas!
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 도와주셔서 고마워요. 저희는 생각해 낼 방법이 다 떨어져 가던 참이었거든요!

english: Hello! I saw an old lady sneaking around in the trees south of the monastery, that wouldn't be anything to do with you, would it?
translation: 안녕하세요! 수도원 남쪽 나무들 사이에서 웬 할머니가 몰래 돌아다니는 걸 봤는데, 혹시 당신과 관련 있는 건 아니죠?

english: That sounds like Iffie, she is my accomplice! I'd be careful calling her an old lady!
translation: Iffie(이피)인 것 같네요, 제 공범이에요! 할머니라고 부르실 땐 조심하세요!

english: You found somebody! Great, good luck!
I'll make sure not to say that to her face if we meet!
translation: 혹시 만나게 되면 그분 앞에서는 절대 그렇게 말하지 않을게요!

english: Hello there!
Hello, Brother Jered!
