Hello! I was just passing by and saw you both in here.
translation: 안녕하세요! 지나가다가 두 분이 여기 계신 걸 봤어요.

english: I'd like to thank you Iffie, and you [player name]. You both saved the monastery.
translation: Iffie(이피), 그리고 [player name]님, 고맙다는 말씀을 드리고 싶어요. 두 분이 수도원을 구해 주셨어요.

english: That means more than you can imagine!
translation: 그게 저희에게 얼마나 큰 의미인지 상상도 못 하실 거예요!

english: It was really no problem, if anything, it was rather fun!
Yes, very fun! I haven't had such an adventure in years!
translation: 그럼요, 정말 재밌었어요! 이런 모험은 몇 년 만인지 몰라요!

english: Well, I am glad you both enjoyed it! I do have something for you, [player name]...
translation: 음, 두 분 다 즐거우셨다니 다행이네요! [player name]님께 드릴 게 있어요...

english: It's not a reward as such, but it is interesting. I've been tidying up my office since I don't need it anymore.
translation: 보상이라고 하긴 뭐하지만, 재미있는 물건이에요. 이제 사무실이 필요 없어져서 정리하고 있었거든요.

english: And in doing so, I found this old bottle.
Is that... a ghost, inside? It's haunted?!
translation: 그거... 안에 유령이 있는 거예요? 귀신 들린 병이에요?!

english: Yes! There is a ghost inside, it's trapped! Would have been handy to have earlier on, really. Would have been very scary for Oziach!
translation: 맞아요! 안에 유령이 갇혀 있어요! 진작 있었으면 좋았을 텐데요. Oziach(오지아크)가 아주 무서워했을 거예요!

english: But the monastery is saved, so I don't need it anymore. I'd like you to have it!
translation: 하지만 수도원은 구했으니 이제 저한테는 필요 없어요. 당신이 가지셨으면 해요!

english: Thank you. What do I do with it?
Not a lot really. I did shake it earlier and the ghost got pretty angry with me, so I'd probably avoid doing that too much.
translation: 딱히 할 건 없어요. 아까 흔들어 봤더니 유령이 꽤 화를 내더라고요. 너무 자주 흔들지는 않는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: It does seem quite chatty for a ghost, although it doesn't always make sense.
translation: 유령치고는 말이 꽤 많은 편이에요. 무슨 말인지 모를 때도 있지만요.

english: There you go. Now I'll be off, I've got a monastery to look after!
translation: 여기 있어요. 그럼 전 가 볼게요, 돌봐야 할 수도원이 있거든요!

english: See you later Brother Jered!
Ask for another bottle.
Yes, let's scare Oziach!
Not just yet.
Talk about something else.
Ask for another ad coupon.
translation: ad coupon(광고 쿠폰)을 하나 더 달라고 한다.

english: Hello monk.
Hello adventurer. My name is Brother Kojo. Do you happen to know the time?
translation: 안녕하신가, 모험가. 내 이름은 Brother Kojo(코조 수사)일세. 혹시 지금 몇 시인지 아나?

english: No, sorry, I don't.
Exactly! This clock tower has recently broken down, and without it nobody can tell the correct time. I must fix it before the town people become too angry!
translation: 바로 그걸세! 이 시계탑이 얼마 전에 고장 나서, 이게 없으니 아무도 정확한 시간을 알 수가 없다네. 마을 사람들이 너무 화나기 전에 고쳐야 하네!

english: I don't suppose you could assist me in the repairs? I'll pay you for your help.
translation: 혹시 수리를 좀 도와줄 수 있겠나? 도와주면 사례하겠네.

english: OK old monk, what can I do?
translation: 좋아요, 수사 어르신. 뭘 하면 돼요?

english: Oh, thank you kind [sir/madam]! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 오, 고맙네, 친절한 [sir/madam]! 아래 지하실에 가면 cog(톱니바퀴) 네 개가 있을 걸세. 나한테는 너무 무겁지만, 자네라면 한 번에 하나씩은 옮길 수 있을 거야.

english: I know one goes on each floor... but I can't exactly remember which goes where specifically. Oh well, I'm sure you can figure it out fairly easily.
translation: 층마다 하나씩 들어간다는 건 아는데... 정확히 어느 게 어디에 들어가는지는 기억이 안 나는구먼. 뭐, 자네라면 꽤 쉽게 알아낼 수 있을 걸세.

english: Well, I'll do my best.
Thank you again! And remember to be careful, the cellar is full of strange beasts!
translation: 다시 한번 고맙네! 그리고 조심하게, 지하실에는 이상한 짐승들이 득시글하다네!

english: Not now old monk.
OK then. Come back and let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠네. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 와서 알려 주게.

english: Hello again.
Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the four tower levels.
translation: 오, 어서 오게. 무슨 문제라도 있나? 톱니바퀴는 우리 아래 방 네 곳에 있네. 탑의 네 층마다 기둥에 톱니바퀴를 하나씩 끼우게.

english: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.
I've placed a cog!
That's great. Come see me when you've done the other three.
translation: 잘했네. 나머지 세 개도 끼우고 나서 다시 오게.

english: Two down!
Two to go.
One left.
I have replaced all the cogs!
Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!
translation: 정말인가..? 잠깐, 들어 보게! 잘했네, 잘했어! 그래 그래 그래, 해냈구먼! 자네 정말 똑똑하군!

english: The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as promised, here is your reward!
translation: 이제 마을 사람들 모두 정확한 시간을 알 수 있게 됐네! 도와줘서 정말 고맙네! 약속한 대로, 여기 자네 보상일세!

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Hello again Brother Kojo.
Oh hello there traveller. You've done a grand job with the clock. It's just like new.
translation: 오, 어서 오게, 여행자. 시계를 아주 훌륭하게 고쳐 줬구먼. 새것 같다네.

english: Hello.
Hello, traveller, how can I help?
I'm trying to learn how to be a navigator.
I don't know if I can help you there.
translation: 그 일이라면 내가 도와줄 수 있을지 모르겠군.

english: The professor from the Observatory says that I need a watch.
Ah, that I can help you with. I've been tinkering with this new idea of a watch and made a few. The problem is the villagers don't see the point as they have the Clock Tower!
translation: 아, 그거라면 도와줄 수 있지. 요즘 손목시계라는 새로운 발상을 가지고 이것저것 만지작거리다가 몇 개 만들었다네. 문제는 마을 사람들이 Clock Tower(시계탑)이 있으니 그게 왜 필요한지 모른다는 거지!

english: Can I have one?
You can have this one! It's the display model.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 어떻게 그럴 수가 있나? 다시 확인해 보게!

english: You really clocked that one!
Yes.
No.
Hello there, What's wrong?
*yawn*...oh, hello...*yawn* I'm sorry! I'm just so tired! I haven't slept in a week!
translation: *하암*... 아, 안녕하세요... *하암* 죄송해요! 너무 피곤해서요! 일주일째 한숨도 못 잤거든요!

english: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
It's brother Androe's son! With his constant: Waaaaaah! Waaaaaaaaah! Androe said it's natural, but it's so annoying!
translation: Brother Androe(안드로 수사)님 아들 때문이에요! 계속 "응애애애! 응애애애애애!" 하고 울어 대요! 안드로 수사님은 원래 그런 거라는데, 정말 미치겠어요!

english: I suppose that's what kids do.
He was fine, up until last week! Thieves broke in! They stole his favourite sleeping blanket!
translation: 지난주까지만 해도 괜찮았어요! 그런데 도둑들이 들어와서 아이가 제일 아끼는 담요를 훔쳐 갔지 뭐예요!

english: Now he won't rest until it's returned... ...and that means neither can I!
translation: 이제 그걸 돌려받기 전까진 잠을 안 자려고 해요... ...그러니 저도 못 자는 거죠!

english: Can I help at all?
Please do. We won't be able to help you as we are peaceful men but we would be grateful for your help!
translation: 부탁드려요. 저희는 평화를 사랑하는 사람들이라 직접 나설 수는 없지만, 도와주신다면 정말 감사하겠어요!

english: Where are they?
They hide in a secret cave in the forest. It's hidden under a ring of stones. Please, bring back the blanket!
translation: 숲속 비밀 동굴에 숨어 있어요. 입구는 둥글게 늘어선 돌들 아래에 감춰져 있죠. 제발 그 담요를 되찾아 주세요!

english: I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
translation: 죄송해요! 남의 고민 들어 줄 시간이 없어요!

english: Hello.
*yawn*...oh, hello again...*yawn*
Please tell me you have the blanket.
I'm afraid not.
I need some sleep!
Yes! I've recovered it from the clutches of the evil thieves!
translation: 네! 사악한 도둑들 손아귀에서 되찾아 왔어요!

english: Really, that's excellent, well done! Maybe now I will be able to get some rest.
translation: 정말요? 대단해요, 잘하셨어요! 이제야 좀 쉴 수 있겠네요.

english: *yawn*..I'm off to bed! Farewell brave traveller!
translation: *하암*.. 전 자러 갈게요! 안녕히 가세요, 용감한 여행자님!

english: Hello, how are you?
Much better now I'm sleeping well! Now I can organise the party.
translation: 이제 잠을 푹 자서 훨씬 좋아요! 이제 파티 준비를 할 수 있겠어요.

english: Ooh! What party?
The son of Brother Androe's birthday party. He's going to be one year old!
translation: Brother Androe(안드로 수사)님 아들 생일 파티요. 이제 돌이 된답니다!

english: That's sweet!
It's also a great excuse for a drink!
translation: 게다가 술 한잔하기 딱 좋은 핑계죠!

english: We just need Brother Cedric to return with the wine.
translation: 이제 Brother Cedric(세드릭 수사)님이 와인만 가지고 돌아오면 돼요.

english: Who's Brother Cedric?
Cedric is a member of the order too. We sent him out three days ago to collect wine. But he didn't return!
translation: 세드릭도 저희 수도회 수사예요. 사흘 전에 와인을 가지러 보냈는데 돌아오질 않았어요!

english: He most probably got drunk and lost in the forest!
translation: 아마 술에 취해서 숲속에서 길을 잃었을 거예요!

english: I've no time for that, sorry.
Okay traveller, take care.
Where should I look?
Oh, he won't be far. Probably out in the forest.
translation: 아, 멀리 가진 않았을 거예요. 아마 숲에 있겠죠.

english: Ok, I'll go and find him.
Can I come to the party?
Of course, but we need the wine first.
Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!
translation: 즐거운 파티 되세요! 곧 또 봬요!

english: Take care traveller.
Hello brother Omad.
Hello adventurer, have you found Brother Cedric?
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. Brother Cedric(세드릭 수사)님은 찾으셨어요?

english: Not yet.
Well, keep looking, we need that wine!
translation: 그럼 계속 찾아봐 주세요. 와인이 꼭 있어야 하거든요!

english: Hi Omad, Brother Cedric is on his way!
translation: 오마드 수사님, Brother Cedric(세드릭 수사)님이 지금 오고 있어요!

english: Good! Good! Now we can party!
translation: 좋아요! 좋아요! 이제 파티를 열 수 있겠어요!

english: I have little to repay you with but please! Take these Rune Stones.
translation: 보답할 게 별로 없지만, 부디 이 Rune Stones(룬석)을 받아 주세요.

english: Thanks Brother Omad!
OK, let's party!
Party!
Woop!
Yeah!
Let's boogie!
Oh baby!
GO!
Get down!
Feel the rhythm!
Dance!
Oh my!
Watch me go!
You go!
Dum dee do la la! *hiccup* That was some party!
translation: 둠 디 두 랄라! *딸꾹* 끝내주는 파티였어요!

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Brother Omad has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Brother Omad(오마드 수사)가 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 줬다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
Spot on!
Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?
Can I help at all?
I'm sorry to hear that! I hope you find his blanket.
Sorry! I'm too busy to hear your problems!
translation: 죄송해요! 남의 고민 들어 줄 시간이 없어요!

english: Who's Brother Cedric?
I've no time for that, sorry.
Where should I look?
Can I come to the party?
Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!
translation: 즐거운 파티 되세요! 곧 또 봬요!

english: How's your head feeling?
A lot better, thanks. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 덕분에 많이 나아졌습니다. 제가 도와드릴 일이라도 있습니까?

english: This washed up on the beach earlier. I thought you could get it fixed by Smithing Smith in Mos Le'Harmless. It could be valuable.
translation: 아까 이것이 해변에 떠밀려 왔습니다. Mos Le'Harmless(모스 르하믈레스)의 Smithing Smith(대장장이 스미스)에게 수리를 맡기시면 좋을 듯합니다. 값진 물건일지도 모릅니다.

english: Thanks.
Not really. I was just popping by to see how you were all getting on and possibly help cull some of the zombies.
translation: 별로 없어요. 그냥 다들 어떻게 지내시나 보러 들른 김에, 좀비도 좀 처치해 드릴까 해서요.

english: Your concern is most gratifying. Saradomin be with you.
translation: 마음 써 주시니 참으로 감사합니다. Saradomin(사라도민)께서 함께하시길.

english: Would you like me to take you to Harmony?
Yes, please.
The player is teleported to Harmony Island.
Not at the moment, thanks.
Do you want me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?
The player is teleported to Mos Le'Harmless.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 그럴 리가 있습니까? 다시 확인해 보십시오!

english: Spot on!
Yes, please.
Not at the moment, thanks.
I'm too important to talk to the likes of you, leave.
translation: 난 너 따위와 말을 섞기엔 너무 귀하신 몸이야. 나가.

english: My secretary will deal with any inquiries you have about the Brown Engine.
translation: Brown Engine(브라운 엔진)에 관한 문의는 내 비서가 처리할 거다.

english: My secretary is sitting just over there, thank you.
translation: 비서는 바로 저기 앉아 있어. 그럼 이만.

english: I'm busy, please leave.
Today is not a good day, can you come back tomorrow?
translation: 오늘은 때가 안 좋아. 내일 다시 와.

english: If you're looking for the market, it's downstairs.
Do you mind? You're blocking my view.
translation: 이봐, 좀 비켜. 앞이 안 보이잖아.

english: How did you get in here? I don't have time to talk to you!
translation: 여긴 어떻게 들어왔지? 너랑 얘기할 시간 없어!

english: I can't help you, go and see my secretary.
translation: 난 도와줄 수 없어. 가서 내 비서한테 물어봐.

english: Talk to my secretary, I don't have time to deal with you.
translation: 비서한테 말해. 너 따위를 상대할 시간 없으니까.

english: But...
I said go!
I told you to leave, human!
Hello, and welcome to the Grand Exchange! How can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: What is this place?
This is the Grand Exchange, the best trading spot in the land! People come from all across the country to buy and sell every item under the sun.
translation: 여긴 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지), 이 땅 최고의 거래소예요! 세상의 온갖 아이템을 사고팔려고 전국 각지에서 사람들이 찾아오죠.

english: When you want to buy or sell an item, talk to the clerks in the middle. They'll tell you how to set up a trade offer.
translation: 아이템을 사거나 팔고 싶으면 가운데에 있는 점원들에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 거래 주문을 어떻게 넣는지 알려 줄 거예요.

english: Now, is there something I can do for you?
Can you tell me the price of an item?
translation: 아이템 시세 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: What had you in mind?
Thank you.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
Can you tell me the price of an item?
translation: 아이템 시세 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Greetings outerlander!
What is this place?
What is this place?
This place? Why, this is Rellekka! Homeland of all Fremennik! I do not recognise your face outerlander; Where do you come from?
translation: 이곳 말이오? 이곳은 Rellekka(렐레카)요! 모든 Fremennik(프레메닉)의 고향이지! 처음 보는 얼굴이구려, 외지인. 어디서 왔소?

english: That's not important...
Hmmm... I will not press the issue then outerlander. How may my tribe and I help you?
translation: 흠... 그렇다면 더 캐묻지 않겠소, 외지인. 나와 내 부족이 무엇을 도와주면 되겠소?

english: Do you have any quests?
Quests, you say outerlander? Well, I would not call it a quest as such, but if you are brave of heart and strong of body, perhaps...
translation: 퀘스트라 했소, 외지인? 글쎄, 퀘스트라 부를 만한 것은 아니지만, 그대가 용감한 마음과 강인한 육체를 지녔다면 어쩌면...

english: No, you would not be interested. Forget I said anything, outerlander.
translation: 아니, 그대는 관심 없을 것이오. 내가 한 말은 잊으시오, 외지인.

english: Actually, I would be very interested to hear what you have to offer.
translation: 사실 무엇을 제안하시려는지 꼭 듣고 싶어요.

english: You would? These are unusual sentiments to hear from an outerlander! My suggestion was going to be that if you crave adventure and battle,
translation: 그렇소? 외지인에게서 듣기 드문 말이로군! 내가 하려던 제안은, 그대가 모험과 전투를 갈망하고

english: and your heart sings for glory, then perhaps you would be interested in joining our clan, and becoming a Fremennik yourself?
translation: 마음이 영광을 노래한다면, 우리 부족에 들어와 직접 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되어 보는 게 어떻겠냐는 것이었소.

english: What would that involve exactly?
Well, there are two ways to become a member of our clan and call yourself a Fremennik: be born a Fremennik, or be voted in by our council of elders.
translation: 글쎄, 우리 부족의 일원이 되어 Fremennik(프레메닉)을 자칭하는 길은 두 가지요. 프레메닉으로 태어나거나, 원로 의회의 투표로 받아들여지는 것이지.

english: Well, I think I've missed the first way, but how can I get the council of elders to vote to let me join your clan?
translation: 첫 번째 방법은 이미 놓친 것 같네요. 그럼 원로 의회가 제 가입에 찬성표를 던지게 하려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

english: Well, that I cannot answer myself. You will need to speak to each of them and see what they require of you as proof of your dedication.
translation: 글쎄, 그건 내가 직접 답해 줄 수 없소. 원로들을 한 명씩 찾아가 그대의 헌신을 증명하려면 무엇이 필요한지 들어 봐야 할 것이오.

english: There are twelve council members around this village; you will need to gain a majority vote of at least seven councillors in your favour.
translation: 이 마을 곳곳에 의회 의원 열두 명이 있소. 그중 과반인 최소 일곱 명의 찬성표를 얻어야 하오.

english: So what say you? Give me the word, and I will tell all of my tribe of your intentions, be they yea or nay.
translation: 자, 어찌하겠소? 말만 하시오. 그대의 뜻이 찬성이든 반대든 내 부족 모두에게 알리겠소.

english: I think I would enjoy the challenge of becoming an honorary Fremennik. Where and how do I start?
translation: 명예 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되는 도전, 재미있을 것 같아요. 어디서 어떻게 시작하면 되나요?

english: As I say outerlander, you must find and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders, and see what tasks they might set you.
translation: 말했듯이, 외지인, 원로 의회의 열두 의원을 찾아가 이야기를 나누고 그들이 어떤 과제를 내리는지 알아보시오.

english: If you can gain the support of seven of the twelve, then you will be accepted as one of us without question.
translation: 열두 명 중 일곱 명의 지지를 얻는다면, 그대는 의심의 여지 없이 우리의 일원으로 받아들여질 것이오.

english: No way do I want to become like YOU! Forget you, and forget your whole stupid town! You're a bunch of stupid primitives, from what I've seen!
translation: 내가 당신 같은 꼴이 되고 싶을 리가 없잖아! 당신도, 이 멍청한 마을도 다 집어치워! 내가 본 바로는 다들 멍청한 원시인들일 뿐이야!

english: I am sorry to say that I expected such a response from an outerlander. I thought perhaps you might have been different to all the others...
translation: 유감스럽게도 외지인에게서 이런 대답이 나올 줄은 알고 있었소. 그대는 다른 자들과 다를지도 모른다고 생각했건만...

english: You're right. I really couldn't care less.
translation: 맞아요. 전 정말 조금도 관심 없어요.

english: It is as I thought outerlander. Your kind care nothing for the Fremennik, and we feel the same about you. This is the way of the world.
translation: 역시 생각한 대로구려, 외지인. 그대 같은 자들은 Fremennik(프레메닉)에 아무 관심이 없고, 우리도 그대들에게 마찬가지요. 세상 이치가 그런 법이지.

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 왜 아무도 저와 얘기하려 하지 않죠?

english: Do not take it personally, outerlander! We are a simple people, and it is our experience that keeping ourselves to ourselves is best. This is why speaking to outerlanders is forbidden.
translation: 언짢게 여기지 마시오, 외지인! 우리는 소박한 민족이고, 우리끼리 지내는 것이 최선이라는 걸 경험으로 알고 있소. 그래서 외지인과 말을 섞는 것이 금지되어 있는 것이오.

english: We do not wish to enter war with the outerlanders and their strange magics, so we limit all unauthorised communication.
translation: 우리는 기묘한 마법을 부리는 외지인들과 전쟁을 벌이고 싶지 않소. 그래서 허가받지 않은 모든 접촉을 제한하는 것이오.

english: Then how come you're talking to me?
translation: 그럼 당신은 왜 저와 얘기하고 있는 거예요?

english: Ah, this is because I am the chieftain. I am the one who authorises contact. You will not find many of my tribe so forthcoming with you, as I.
translation: 아, 그건 내가 족장이기 때문이오. 접촉을 허가하는 자가 바로 나요. 내 부족 중에 나만큼 그대에게 터놓고 말해 줄 자는 많지 않을 것이오.

english: Is there a way for you to authorise your tribe to talk to me then?
translation: 그럼 부족 사람들이 저와 이야기해도 되도록 허가해 주실 방법은 없나요?

english: Well, there is one way... but I doubt it is of any interest to you.
translation: 글쎄, 방법이 하나 있긴 하오... 하지만 그대가 관심을 가질 것 같지는 않구려.

english: Yes.
No.
Why do you call me outerlander?
Do not take it as an insult, outerlander. For us, this town is the center of all. Anyone not born here, or that we do not know and trust is an outerlander.
translation: 모욕으로 받아들이지 마시오, 외지인. 우리에게 이 마을은 세상의 중심이오. 이곳에서 태어나지 않았거나, 우리가 알고 신뢰하지 않는 자는 모두 외지인이오.

english: So it basically means stranger?
Aye, but that is an outerlander word. We do not judge someones ways by their name. It simply means one from the outerlands, or one not from Rellekka.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 그건 외지인들의 말이오. 우리는 이름으로 남의 방식을 판단하지 않소. 그저 바깥 땅에서 온 자, 즉 Rellekka(렐레카) 출신이 아닌 자라는 뜻일 뿐이오.

english: I know our customs are foreign to you; perhaps you would like me to explain something else?
translation: 우리 관습이 그대에게 낯설다는 것은 아오. 혹시 다른 것도 설명이 필요하오?

english: (shows previous options)
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
We will have no part in the squabbles of outerlander tribes. Their magics are strange and deadly to us, as we learnt long ago.
translation: 우리는 외지인 부족들의 다툼에 끼어들지 않을 것이오. 그들의 마법은 기묘하고 우리에게 치명적이라는 걸 오래전에 배웠소.

english: If this is all that you came here for, then you have had a wasted journey. If you are looking for something else, then speak now for my patience dwindles.
translation: 그것만이 그대가 여기 온 이유라면 헛걸음한 셈이오. 다른 것을 찾고 있다면 지금 말하시오. 내 인내심이 바닥나고 있으니.

english: Who are the Fremennik?
It is the name we call ourselves. Outerlanders tend to call us 'Barbarian', but they do not understand our ways...
translation: 우리가 스스로를 부르는 이름이오. 외지인들은 우리를 'Barbarian(야만인)'이라 부르곤 하지만, 그들은 우리 방식을 이해하지 못하오...

english: Why will no-one talk to me?
translation: 왜 아무도 저와 얘기하려 하지 않죠?

english: (same as above)
Nice hat!
Do not mock me outerlander; this helm has saved my life more times than I care to recall right now.
translation: 날 조롱하지 마시오, 외지인. 이 투구는 지금 당장 다 떠올리기도 힘들 만큼 여러 번 내 목숨을 구해 주었소.

english: I don't have any votes yet.
I only have 1 vote so far.
Hmmm... well that is certainly a good start I would say. Keep up the good work!
translation: 흠... 그거면 확실히 좋은 출발이라 할 수 있겠소. 계속 잘해 보시오!

english: (continues below)
I only have [X] votes so far.
Hmmm... you are doing very well so far, outerlander. Keep up the good work!
translation: 흠... 지금까지 아주 잘하고 있소, 외지인. 계속 잘해 보시오!

english: Remember: You need to get at least seven council votes to be accepted as a member of the Fremennik.
translation: 명심하시오. Fremennik(프레메닉)의 일원으로 받아들여지려면 의회 표를 최소 일곱 표는 얻어야 하오.

english: Go and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders who live in this village. I am sure at least a few will be prepared to vote for you.
translation: 이 마을에 사는 원로 의회의 열두 의원을 찾아가 이야기해 보시오. 적어도 몇 명은 분명 그대에게 표를 던져 줄 것이오.

english: If you need any help with your trials, I suggest you speak to Askeladden. He is currently doing his own trials of manhood to become a true Fremennik.
translation: 시험에 도움이 필요하다면 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)에게 말을 걸어 보시오. 그 아이도 지금 진정한 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되기 위해 성인 시험을 치르는 중이오.

english: Greetings again outerlander! How goes your attempts to gain votes with the council of elders?
translation: 다시 반갑소, 외지인! 원로 의회의 표를 얻는 일은 잘되어 가오?

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: 혹시 판매세 감면 보증서를 어디서 구할 수 있을지 아시나요?

english: A reduction on sales taxes? Why, I am the only one in the Fremennik who may authorise such a thing. What does an outerlander want with that?
translation: 판매세 감면 말이오? 허, Fremennik(프레메닉)에서 그런 걸 허가할 수 있는 사람은 나뿐이오. 외지인이 그걸 어디에 쓰려는 것이오?

english: Actually, it's not for me. I need to get it as part of my trials.
translation: 사실 제가 쓰려는 게 아니에요. 시험의 일부로 구해야 하거든요.

english: Hmmm. Interesting. Your trials seem to be very different to those I took as a young lad. Well, I am not adverse in principle to giving a slight tax break to our shops.
translation: 흠. 흥미롭군. 그대의 시험은 내가 어릴 적 치른 시험과는 많이 다른 모양이오. 뭐, 우리 상점들의 세금을 조금 낮춰 주는 것에 원칙적으로 반대하지는 않소.

english: There will of course be a shortfall in the tribe's income, that will need to be made up for elsewhere, however.
translation: 다만 당연히 부족의 수입이 줄어들 테니, 그건 다른 데서 메워야 하오.

english: How about this. For many years Sigli has been the only one in the tribe who knows the locations of the best hunting grounds where game is easiest to catch.
translation: 이렇게 합시다. 오랜 세월 동안 사냥감을 가장 쉽게 잡을 수 있는 최고의 사냥터를 아는 사람은 부족에서 Sigli(시글리)뿐이었소.

english: If you can persuade him to let the entire tribe know these hunting grounds, then we can increase productivity within the tribe, and any shortfall caused
translation: 그를 설득해 부족 전체에 그 사냥터를 알려 주게 한다면, 부족의 생산성을 높일 수 있고, 판매세를 낮춰서

english: by lowering sales taxes will be covered. I think this is a more than fair arrangement to make, don't you?
translation: 생기는 부족분도 메울 수 있을 것이오. 이 정도면 충분히 공정한 거래라고 생각하는데, 그대는 어떻소?

english: Yeah, that sounds very fair.
Speak to Sigli then, and you may have my promise to reduce our sales taxes. And best of luck with the rest of your trials.
translation: 그럼 Sigli(시글리)와 이야기해 보시오. 그러면 판매세를 낮추겠다고 약속하리다. 남은 시험들도 행운을 비오.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: 혹시 손대지 않은 사냥터 지도를 어디서 구할 수 있을지 아시나요?

english: Ah, outerlander... if you wish to become a Fremennik you should try and pay more attention to what people tell you...
translation: 아, 외지인... Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되고 싶다면 사람들이 하는 말에 좀 더 귀를 기울여야 할 것이오...

english: Sigli the hunter is the only one who knows of such hunting grounds. Go and request his knowledge.
translation: 그런 사냥터를 아는 사람은 사냥꾼 Sigli(시글리)뿐이오. 그를 찾아가 그 지식을 청해 보시오.

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
I got Sigli's hunting map for you.
So cutting sales tax isn't going to ruin your economy here or anything?
translation: 그럼 판매세를 낮춰도 여기 경제가 망가지거나 하진 않는 거죠?

english: Not at all outerlander; now that we have Sigli's map we can increase the amount of hunts we run, and make up any shortfall that way.
translation: 전혀 그렇지 않소, 외지인. 이제 Sigli(시글리)의 지도가 있으니 사냥 횟수를 늘려 부족분을 메울 수 있소.

english: I have seven members of the council prepared to vote in my favour now!
translation: 이제 의회 의원 일곱 명이 제게 찬성표를 던지기로 했어요!

english: I know outerlander, for I have been closely monitoring your progress so far!
translation: 알고 있소, 외지인. 지금까지 그대의 진척을 유심히 지켜보고 있었으니!

english: Then let us put the formality aside, and let me personally welcome you into the Fremennik! May you bring us honour!
translation: 그렇다면 형식은 제쳐 두고, 내가 직접 그대를 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 맞이하겠소! 우리에게 명예를 가져다주길!

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
Hi there Brundt the Chieftain. Could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 안녕하세요, Brundt the Chieftain(브룬트 족장)님. Seal of Passage(통행의 인장) 좀 구할 수 있을까요?

english: A Seal of Passage? Whatever for?
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장) 말이오? 대체 무엇에 쓰려고?

english: Well, I've heard that there have been great troubles between your people and that of the Moon Clan. I was hoping to help. And so I need the Seal of Passage to show my intentions.
translation: 듣자 하니 이쪽 사람들과 Moon Clan(달 부족) 사이에 큰 분쟁이 있었다고 하더라고요. 돕고 싶어서요. 그래서 제 뜻을 보여 줄 Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)이 필요해요.

english: Ah [Fremennik name], many have tried, but The Moon Clan are by no means a sharing group of people. They do everything by magic, something we never use. But they are so secretive about it. If only they would share, we
translation: 아, [Fremennik name], 많은 이들이 시도했지만 Moon Clan(달 부족)은 결코 나눌 줄 아는 무리가 아니오. 그들은 모든 걸 마법으로 하는데, 우리는 절대 쓰지 않는 것이지. 그런데도 그걸 얼마나 꽁꽁 숨기는지. 그들이 나누기만 한다면, 우리가

english: wouldn't have to kill them all the time!
translation: 매번 그들을 죽이지 않아도 될 텐데!

english: I will see what I can do.
translation: 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: Can I have that seal then?
translation: 그럼 그 인장을 주실 수 있나요?

english: If you are to bring peace to our two warring clans, then perhaps it is best that you do...
translation: 그대가 우리 두 부족 사이에 평화를 가져오려 한다면, 그대가 가지는 게 나을지도 모르겠구려...

english: Hi there.
Yes?
I lost my Seal of Passage!
Then you had better take a replacement and be less careless in future.
translation: 그렇다면 새것을 가져가고, 앞으로는 좀 더 조심하시오.

english: Well if it isn't [Fremennik name]. I've heard of your exploits in the Lunar Isles!
translation: 이게 누군가, [Fremennik name] 아니오. Lunar Isles(루나 섬)에서 그대가 세운 공적을 들었소!

english: Already? News really does travel fast!
Thank you so very much, I think we can really make progress now.
translation: 정말 고맙소. 이제 정말로 진전을 볼 수 있을 것 같구려.

english: No worries. I am pleased I could help.
Oh, erm, could you help me out with a Seal of Passage?
translation: 아, 저기, Seal of Passage(통행의 인장) 좀 구할 수 있을까요?

english: Seal of Passage, well I suppose so.
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장) 말이오? 뭐, 그 정도야 괜찮소.

english: Ok, here you go.
Thanks!
So how did the meeting go?
It went surprisingly well! We are at least at the point where we will freely acknowledge each other's existence now.
translation: 놀라울 만큼 잘되었소! 적어도 이제는 서로의 존재를 기꺼이 인정하는 단계까지는 왔소.

english: You are definitely a great asset to the Fremennik, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 그대는 분명 Fremennik(프레메닉)의 큰 자산이오, [Fremennik name]!

english: I've lost V's Shield.
I don't think you have [Fremennik name]. I suggest you try looking for it again.
translation: 잃어버린 것 같지 않소, [Fremennik name]. 다시 찾아보시오.

english: You really should be more careful [Fremennik name]. Luckily for you I found it again but you'll have to pay to get it back.
translation: 좀 더 조심해야 하오, [Fremennik name]. 운 좋게도 내가 다시 찾아냈지만, 돌려받으려면 값을 치러야 하오.

english: How much?
50,000 coins. Consider it a lesson in looking after things better.
translation: 50,000코인이오. 물건을 더 잘 간수하라는 교훈으로 여기시오.

english: Sounds good to me.
Here you go [Fremennik name]. Use it well.
That's a bit too much I'm afraid.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠소. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오시오. 나는 여기 있을 테니.

english: I don't have that much.
Well come back when you do.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: 다시 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 그대의 여정이 부와 기쁨을 가져다주었길 바라오! 오늘은 무슨 일로 나를 찾아왔소?

english: I just came to say hello.
Well met, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 영광스러운 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 그대의 얼굴을 다시 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: Not at the moment [Fremennik name]. Rest assured, should your services to the Fremennik be required, I will call upon you.
translation: 지금은 없소, [Fremennik name]. 안심하시오. Fremennik(프레메닉)에 그대의 힘이 필요해지면 반드시 그대를 부르겠소.

english: Aye, that it is [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: 그렇소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 그대도 하나 갖고 싶다면 Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)의 상점에 가서 무엇이 있는지 보시오!

english: Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 당신네 민족의 역사를 들을 수 있을까요?

english: Why, of course [Fremennik name]! Do not say 'your people' like that, for you are now a Fremennik yourself! What did you want to hear of?
translation: 물론이오, [Fremennik name]! '당신네 민족'이라고 그렇게 말하지 마시오. 그대도 이제 Fremennik(프레메닉)이니! 무엇에 대해 듣고 싶소?

english: I'm interested in finding out about that mysterious warrior I fought as part of Thorvalds' combat trial. His name is Koschei I believe.
translation: Thorvald(소르발드)의 전투 시험에서 싸웠던 그 수수께끼의 전사에 대해 알고 싶어요. 이름이 Koschei(코셰이)였던 것 같아요.

english: Ah... the deathless one... We do not even know if Koschei is his name, when we found him he had no memory, he was simply repeating that single word.
translation: 아... 불사의 존재 말이구려... 우리는 Koschei(코셰이)가 그의 이름인지조차 모르오. 우리가 그를 발견했을 때 그는 기억이 없었고, 그저 그 한 단어만 되뇌고 있었소.

english: Whatever happened to him must have rattled his soul so hard that his memory ran away from him, and he has not yet found it's hiding place.
translation: 그에게 무슨 일이 있었든, 그 일이 영혼을 어찌나 세게 뒤흔들었는지 기억이 달아나 버렸고, 그는 아직 그 기억이 숨은 곳을 찾지 못했소.

english: So how exactly did you find him?
translation: 그럼 정확히 어떻게 그를 발견하신 거예요?

english: Well, it was a raiding party like any other. We had just struck one of the smaller northern islands to harvest supplies by combat, as our laws allow,
translation: 글쎄, 여느 때와 다름없는 약탈 원정이었소. 우리 법이 허락하는 대로, 북쪽의 작은 섬 하나를 쳐서 전투로 보급품을 거둬들인 참이었는데,

english: when we saw a figure in the iceywaters. As we were at least a 3 week sail from any port, and saw no other ships nearby, he must have been there some time.
translation: 얼음장 같은 바다에 웬 형체가 보이는 것이었소. 우리는 어느 항구에서든 적어도 3주는 항해해야 하는 곳에 있었고, 근처에 다른 배도 보이지 않았으니, 그는 꽤 오랫동안 거기 있었던 게 틀림없소.

english: We could not leave someone to the cold death of the ocean, even an outerlander, so we fished him aboard. He muttered continually, but his words made no sense.
translation: 비록 외지인이라 해도 차가운 바다에서 죽게 내버려 둘 수는 없었기에, 그를 건져 배에 태웠소. 그는 쉴 새 없이 중얼거렸지만, 그 말은 도무지 알아들을 수 없었소.

english: He had no clothes or possessions with him, and seemed to have been burnt somehow before he had landed in the water.
translation: 그는 옷도 소지품도 없었고, 물에 빠지기 전에 어쩐 일인지 불에 탄 듯했소.

english: I cannot help but wonder what burnt him, for as you may have seen, he is incredibly powerful and resistant to damage by any means I know of!
translation: 무엇이 그를 태웠는지 궁금하지 않을 수 없소. 그대도 보았겠지만 그는 엄청나게 강하고, 내가 아는 어떤 수단으로도 상처 입지 않으니 말이오!

english: Anyway, we decided to bring him back to Rellekka, for he did not seem of good health or sound mind, and simply repeated the word Koschei over and over.
translation: 아무튼, 우리는 그를 Rellekka(렐레카)로 데려오기로 했소. 몸도 성치 않고 정신도 온전치 않아 보였고, 그저 Koschei(코셰이)라는 말만 계속 되뇌었으니.

english: Yrsa tended to him for many weeks, until one day it was as though a new soul had entered his burnt and broken body.
translation: Yrsa(이르사)가 몇 주 동안 그를 돌봤는데, 어느 날 마치 새로운 영혼이 그의 불타고 망가진 몸에 들어간 것 같았소.

english: He suddenly left her house one day, fully healed, and able to speak to us as though nothing had happened to him.
translation: 그는 어느 날 갑자기 완전히 나은 몸으로 그녀의 집을 나섰고, 아무 일도 없었다는 듯 우리와 말을 나눌 수 있었소.

english: He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the iceyocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
translation: 그는 여전히 어떻게 얼음 바다에 빠지게 되었는지, 자신이 누구인지, 어디서 왔는지 기억하지 못했지만, 우리에게도 그에게도 그건 중요하지 않았소.

english: He took his trials of adulthood, as you did, and has been a boon to our clan ever since. Someday I fear he may regain his memory, and leave us for his past...
translation: 그도 그대처럼 성인 시험을 치렀고, 그 후로 줄곧 우리 부족에 큰 힘이 되어 주었소. 언젠가 그가 기억을 되찾아 과거를 좇아 우리를 떠날까 두렵소...

english: But I will always respect any decision he decides to make should that day ever come upon us. Until then, he is more than welcome to stay here.
translation: 하지만 그날이 정말 온다면, 나는 그가 내리는 어떤 결정이든 언제나 존중할 것이오. 그때까지는 그가 얼마든지 여기 머물러도 좋소.

english: So, [Fremennik name]. Was there anything more you wished to hear?
translation: 그래, [Fremennik name]. 더 듣고 싶은 것이 있소?

english: I would like to hear of the lands across the ocean to the North.
translation: 북쪽 바다 건너편의 땅에 대해 듣고 싶어요.

english: Well, I think the best thing for you would be to go to the docks and ask to join one of our longboats on a journey.
translation: 글쎄, 그대에게 가장 좋은 건 부두에 가서 우리 롱보트 중 하나에 태워 달라고 청하는 것일 거요.

english: My affairs are concentrated mostly on Rellekka, so my knowledge is not great, but I will happily share what I do know with you [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 일은 대부분 Rellekka(렐레카)에 집중되어 있어 아는 게 많지는 않지만, 아는 것은 기꺼이 알려 주겠소, [Fremennik name].

english: North of this town the atmosphere becomes bitterly cold. There are a number of small inhabited islands that we have sea routes with.
translation: 이 마을 북쪽으로 가면 날씨가 매섭게 추워지오. 사람이 사는 작은 섬이 여럿 있는데, 우리는 그 섬들과 뱃길로 오가고 있소.

english: The largest of these is possibly Miscellania, although I hear that there has been some recent incident with their monarch, but I don't know the details.
translation: 그중 가장 큰 곳은 아마 Miscellania(미셀라니아)일 것이오. 최근 그곳 군주에게 무슨 일이 있었다고 들었지만, 자세한 건 모르오.

english: There is also of course the island of the moon clan, who change with the tides. They are our bitterest enemies, and we are currently at war with them.
translation: 물론 조수와 함께 변하는 달 부족의 섬도 있소. 그들은 우리의 가장 지독한 적이고, 지금 우리는 그들과 전쟁 중이오.

english: They are an evil people, equally cursed and blessed by the magic in their blood. Beyond those islands, there is the large frozen wasteland we call Acheron.
translation: 그들은 사악한 민족으로, 핏속에 흐르는 마법으로 저주받은 동시에 축복받았소. 그 섬들 너머에는 우리가 Acheron(아케론)이라 부르는 거대한 얼어붙은 황무지가 있소.

english: It is an inhospitable land, and you will need an agile and sturdy body just to keep alive in it's perils.
translation: 사람이 살기 힘든 땅이라, 그 위험 속에서 살아남으려면 날렵하고 튼튼한 몸이 필요할 것이오.

english: As I say, my knowledge outside of this town is rather limited, and I know no more than this. Was there anything else you wished to hear tell of?
translation: 말했듯이, 이 마을 밖에 대한 내 지식은 꽤 한정되어 있어 이 이상은 모르오. 또 듣고 싶은 이야기가 있소?

english: I would like to hear a little of the history between the Fremenniks and the outerlanders.
translation: Fremenniks(프레메닉)과 외지인 사이의 역사를 조금 듣고 싶어요.

english: Ah, now that is something I know a great deal about. Believe it or not, all outerlanders were once orginally Fremenniks.
translation: 아, 그건 내가 아주 잘 아는 이야기요. 믿기 어렵겠지만, 모든 외지인은 원래 Fremenniks(프레메닉)이었소.

english: When first man came to these lands all were Fremenniks, and followed our ways. We lived a happy life, and never settled in one place for long.
translation: 최초의 인간이 이 땅에 왔을 때 모두가 Fremenniks(프레메닉)이었고, 우리 방식을 따랐소. 우리는 행복하게 살았고, 한곳에 오래 정착하는 법이 없었소.

english: We travelled by boat along the coastlines, never taking more from the land than could be regrown by the same time in the following year.
translation: 우리는 배를 타고 해안선을 따라 여행했고, 이듬해 같은 때까지 다시 자랄 수 있는 것 이상은 결코 땅에서 취하지 않았소.

english: However, many moons past, some of our tribesmen were weary of constantly travelling the lands, and decided to build themselves permanent homes.
translation: 그런데 아주 오래전, 우리 부족민 중 일부가 끊임없이 떠도는 데 지쳐 영구적인 집을 짓기로 했소.

english: Unfortunately, the other races that had also migrated here did not like this. They waged war against us at every opportunity.
translation: 불행히도, 마찬가지로 이곳에 이주해 온 다른 종족들은 이를 좋아하지 않았소. 그들은 기회가 있을 때마다 우리에게 전쟁을 걸어왔소.

english: We were driven mostly to the coastlines, where we could escape by boat when attacked. Remember, at this time we had no real way to defend against constant attack.
translation: 우리는 대부분 해안선으로 쫓겨났고, 그곳에서는 공격받으면 배로 달아날 수 있었소. 기억하시오, 그 시절 우리에겐 끊임없는 공격을 막아 낼 제대로 된 방법이 없었소.

english: Then one day one of our Seers, whose name has been lost in the telling of this tale, discovered a cave full of strange rocks.
translation: 그러던 어느 날, 이야기가 전해지며 이름은 잊혔지만, 우리 예언자 중 한 명이 기묘한 바위로 가득한 동굴을 발견했소.

english: This rock would never be consumed, no matter how much we took, and sparkled at its peak, and broke off in small and regular sized chunks when mined.
translation: 이 바위는 아무리 캐내도 결코 줄어들지 않았고, 꼭대기가 반짝였으며, 캐면 작고 고른 크기의 덩어리로 떨어져 나왔소.

english: Stranger than this, we found that these rocks would become filled with power when taken to certain places across this land!
translation: 더 기이한 건, 이 바위를 이 땅의 특정한 장소로 가져가면 힘으로 가득 찬다는 사실이었소!

english: There was a terrible argument in our tribe! Some said that we should take as many of these rocks as we could, and use them in defending against our enemies attacks!
translation: 부족 안에 끔찍한 논쟁이 벌어졌소! 어떤 이들은 이 바위를 최대한 많이 가져가 적의 공격을 막는 데 써야 한다고 했소!

english: Others said that we had found a place that belonged only to the gods, and that should we steal what was not ours we would find only torment and misery.
translation: 다른 이들은 우리가 오직 신들의 것인 장소를 찾아낸 것이며, 우리 것이 아닌 것을 훔친다면 고통과 비참함만 얻게 될 거라고 했소.

english: We voted on this, and decided that it was in the best interests of the tribe to leave these strange rocks where they lay, for the gods can be spiteful and cruel,
translation: 우리는 이를 두고 투표했고, 이 기묘한 바위를 있던 자리에 그대로 두는 것이 부족에게 가장 이롭다고 결정했소. 신들은 앙심 깊고 잔인할 수 있으니,

english: especially to those who do not treat them with the respect they desire. Some of our number refused to accept this ruling by our council however.
translation: 특히 그들이 바라는 만큼 존중하지 않는 자들에게는 더욱 그렇소. 그러나 우리 중 일부는 의회의 이 결정을 받아들이길 거부했소.

english: They began to mine these rocks, and set up transport systems to the various places of power that enchanted them.
translation: 그들은 이 바위를 캐기 시작했고, 바위에 마력을 불어넣는 여러 힘의 장소로 운반하는 체계를 만들었소.

english: They even created temples at each of these places! This was going too far! We had no choice, but to expel them from our tribe forever!
translation: 심지어 그 장소마다 신전까지 세웠소! 이건 도를 넘은 일이었소! 우리는 그들을 부족에서 영원히 추방할 수밖에 없었소!

english: We turned our backs upon them, and let them know they would never be welcome back to our tribes until they had released themselves from the rocks.
translation: 우리는 그들에게 등을 돌렸고, 그 바위에서 스스로 벗어나기 전까지는 결코 우리 부족으로 돌아올 수 없을 거라고 알렸소.

english: This is the tale of how the outerlanders came about; through stealing from the gods, and from betraying our ideals. This is why we show them no trust.
translation: 이것이 외지인이 생겨난 내력이오. 신들에게서 훔치고 우리의 이상을 배신한 결과지. 그래서 우리는 그들을 믿지 않는 것이오.

english: Was there something else you wished to hear?
Actually, history isn't really my thing.
Well let me know should you wish to hear our lore and histories. We value them highly.
translation: 그럼 우리의 전승과 역사를 듣고 싶어지면 말해 주시오. 우리는 그것을 아주 소중히 여기오.

english: As a matter of fact [Fremennik name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
translation: 실은 말이오, [Fremennik name], 그대에게 맡길 퀘스트가 하나 있소. 관심 있소?

english: I’m ready for adventure
Excellent, now-
So what will it be this time? Joining warring islands?
translation: 이번엔 뭔가요? 전쟁 중인 섬들을 화해시키는 건가요?

english: I’m a fan of you enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-
translation: 그 열의는 마음에 드오, [Fremennik name], 하지만-

english: Would you have me slay a mighty daggermouth? Or do you need my expertise in conquering untamed lands?
translation: 강력한 대거마우스를 처치하라는 건가요? 아니면 미개척지를 정복하는 데 제 전문 지식이 필요하신가요?

english: Nothing quite that fancy I’m afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.
translation: 유감스럽게도 그리 거창한 일은 아니오, [Fremennik name]. 사소한 소동을 조사해 줬으면 하오.

english: Oh.

Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut lat night and wanted an official to investigate. You’ve proven yourself more than worthy of our people’s trust.
translation: Freygerd(프레이게르드)와 Reeso(리소)가 여기서 조금 북쪽에 있는 모래 구덩이를 운영하고 있소. 어젯밤 오두막 근처에서 바스락거리는 소리를 들었다며 관리가 조사해 주길 바라더군. 그대는 우리 민족의 신뢰를 받기에 충분하다는 걸 증명했으니 말이오.

english: Well that doesn’t sound so bad. I’ll get right on it.
translation: 그 정도면 별로 어렵지 않겠네요. 바로 가 볼게요.

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name].
Not right now.
Very well. Return when you wish to help.
How goes the investigation, [Fremennik name]?
I’m still looking into it at the moment.
No rush, [Fremennik name]. I’m sure it’s nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you’re ready.
translation: 서두를 것 없소, [Fremennik name]. 별일 아닐 것이오. 준비되면 모래 구덩이에 있는 Freygerd(프레이게르드)와 Reeso(리소)에게 말을 걸어 보시오.

english: [Fremennik name], I’m glad you’ve returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
translation: [Fremennik name], 돌아와서 다행이오! 그대가 찾은 이 편지는 매우 걱정스럽고, 우리가 각별히 신경 써야 할 일이오.

english: I don’t understand. What does this letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?
translation: 이해가 안 돼요. 이 편지가 무슨 뜻이죠? Jormungand(요르문간드)는 누구고요? 그리고 바실리스크가 언제부터 읽고 쓸 줄 알았죠?

english: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home. The Joumungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other. If it hadn’t been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.
translation: 겉으로는 드러나지 않지만, 바실리스크는 보기보다 훨씬 영리하오. 오래전, 거대한 바실리스크 군대가 우리 민족을 노예로 삼고 우리 고향을 빼앗았소. 때로 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)이라고도 불리는 Jormungand(요르문간드)가 그 군대의 지도자였소. 세 장군 Typhor(티포르), Vritra(브리트라), Bakuna(바쿠나)와 함께 그는 이 땅에 유례없는 공포를 불러왔소. 위대한 영웅의 용기가 아니었다면, 우리는 결코 해방되지 못했을 것이오.

english: A hero?
Yes. He was known as V. He stood up to the Serpent King and confronted him on the Island of Stone. It is said that the two of them fought for days, but in the end, V stood victorious.
translation: 그렇소. 그는 V라고 알려졌소. 그는 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)에게 맞서 Island of Stone(돌의 섬)에서 그와 대결했소. 둘은 며칠 동안 싸웠다고 하는데, 결국 V가 승리했소.

english: What happened next?
Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V’s victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.
translation: 글쎄, 그건 누구에게 묻느냐에 따라 다르오. 음유시인들은 V의 승리를 노래한 위대한 곡을 지었소. 그들은 그것을 Ballad of the Basilisk(바실리스크의 발라드)라 불렀고, 그 노래에서는 V가 Jormungand(요르문간드)를 죽였다고 하오.

english: But...
Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.
translation: 글쎄... 음유시인들은 진실을 조금 비트는 걸로 유명하오. 특히 그래야 노래가 더 그럴듯해진다면 말이오. 실제로 V는 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)을 그 섬의 마법 감옥에 봉인했고, 그는 오늘날까지 그곳에 있소.

english: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn’t approve of magic?
translation: 마법 감옥이요? Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람들은 마법을 좋게 보지 않는다고 생각했는데요?

english: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with a single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.
translation: V는 달랐소. 전해지는 이야기에 따르면 그는 돌을 한 번 만지는 것만으로 마법의 잠재력을 깨웠다고 하오. 그 순간, 그는 한낱 인간 이상의 존재가 되었소.

english: A god?
It’s not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.
translation: 그건 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 딱히 신경 쓰는 구분이 아니오. 우리에게 그는 늘 숭배할 신이 아니라 존경할 영웅이었소. 그 역시 같은 생각이었다고 하오.

english: But he earned the right to use magic?
translation: 그래도 그는 마법을 쓸 자격을 얻은 거네요?

english: Exactly. Now the Moon Clan on the other hand, did not earn that right. Their use of magic is an insult to our people.
translation: 바로 그렇소. 반면 Moon Clan(달 부족)은 그 자격을 얻지 못했소. 그들이 마법을 쓰는 건 우리 민족에 대한 모욕이오.

english: So what can we do about the Jormungand?
translation: 그럼 Jormungand(요르문간드)에 대해 우리가 뭘 할 수 있죠?

english: We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We’ll... We’ll be doomed! Our army isn’t large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.
translation: 우리는 굳건히 버틸 것이오, [Fremennik name]. 우리는... 우리는 끝장이오! 우리 군대로는 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)의 군세를 막아 내기에 턱없이 부족하오.

english: I can help!
[Fremennik name], you’re strong. But you’re no army.
translation: [Fremennik name], 그대는 강하오. 하지만 그대 한 사람이 군대는 아니오.

english: You’re forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don’t know we’re aware of their attack. We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
translation: 잊으신 게 있어요, Brundt(브룬트) 족장님. 우리에겐 기습이라는 이점이 있어요! 그들은 우리가 공격을 눈치챘다는 걸 몰라요. 그들이 움직이기 전까지 며칠은 준비할 수 있을 거예요. 우리는...

english: A cutscene starts
Chieftain Brundt!
Agnar? What is it?
Chieftain Brundt! I’m here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We’ve heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
translation: Chieftain Brundt(브룬트 족장)님! 저는 Fremennik Council(프레메닉 의회)를 대표해 왔습니다! 마을에 바실리스크가 나타났다는 심상치 않은 소식을 들었습니다.

english: Well I won’t deny there’s been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.
translation: 작은 문제가 있었다는 건 부인하지 않겠소. 하지만 나와 [Fremennik name], 우리 둘이 곧 사태를 수습할 것이오.

english: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all our problems!
translation: [Fremennik name]? 이 외지인이 우리 모든 문제의 원인이라는 걸 대체 언제쯤 아시겠습니까!

english: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! He passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.
translation: [Fremennik name]더러 외지인이라니! 우리 시험을 통과했고, 그대나 나와 똑같은 Fremennik(프레메닉)이오.

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we’ve had nothing but trouble! And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
translation: 아무리 감추셔도, 저자는 외지인이고 앞으로도 영원히 외지인일 겁니다! 저자를 받아들인 뒤로 우리에겐 골칫거리만 생겼습니다! 게다가 이제는 바실리스크까지 마을을 돌아다닙니다. 의회는 더는 참을 수 없습니다!

english: What are you saying Agnar?
I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!
translation: 여기 열두 명의 의회 의원 중 일곱 명이 서명한 선언문이 있습니다. 우리는 이 외지인을 추방자로 선언합니다!

english: This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!
translation: 이건 말도 안 되오! 우리의 일원인 [Fremennik name]에게 이럴 순 없소!

english: Do not use the name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
translation: 그 이름을 부르지 마십시오! 의회의 결정은 최종입니다. 족장으로서 족장님은 명예를 걸고 이를 집행하셔야 합니다.

english: I see... Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their [brother/sister].
translation: 그렇군... 추방자여, 그대는 우리 땅을 떠나야 하오. 우리 민족은 더 이상 그대를 [brother/sister](으)로 여기지 않을 것이오.

english: Chieftain Brundt gestures his head towards the south east.
translation: Chieftain Brundt(브룬트 족장)이 고갯짓으로 남동쪽을 가리킨다.

english: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.
translation: 당장 떠나시오. 나와 내 백성 그 누구와도 엮이려 하지 마시오.

english: Begone exile, you are a Fremennik no more.
translation: 물러가시오, 추방자여. 그대는 더 이상 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 아니오.

english: Well that was awkward...
Indeed. I’m sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They’ve been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.
translation: 그러게 말이오. 미안하오, [Fremennik name]. 사실 의회의 많은 이들은 그대가 우리 일원이 된 걸 달갑게 여기지 않았소. 그대가 온 뒤로 줄곧 그대를 추방할 좋은 구실을 찾고 있었던 것이오.

english: But they’re the one that voted for me in the first place!
translation: 하지만 애초에 저한테 찬성표를 던진 게 그 사람들이잖아요!

english: Well… not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They’re the ones who’ve been pushing for your exile.
translation: 음… 꼭 그렇지만은 않네. 열두 명의 의회 의원 중 일곱은 자네에게 표를 주었지만, 나머지 다섯의 지지는 끝내 얻지 못했지. 자네의 추방을 밀어붙인 게 바로 그들일세.

english: I see. And they’ve used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.
translation: 그렇군요. 그리고 그 basilisk(바실리스크) 문제를 핑계로 다른 사람들까지 설득했고요.

english: It would seem so. Try not to judge them too harshly though, they only had what was best for the province in mind. This basilisk situation has a lot of people scared.
translation: 그런 것 같네. 그래도 너무 가혹하게 판단하지는 말게. 그들은 그저 이 지방에 가장 좋은 길을 생각했을 뿐이니. 이번 basilisk(바실리스크) 사태로 겁을 먹은 사람이 많다네.

english: I don’t understand though, they’re only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.
translation: 그래도 이해가 안 돼요. 고작 basilisk(바실리스크)잖아요. 우리 힘이면 충분히 물리칠 수 있을 텐데요.

english: Ah, I see you are not familiar with the End of Things.
translation: 아, 자네는 End of Things(만물의 종말)을 잘 모르는 모양이군.

english: The End of Things?
Many years ago, before the time of V, it was a foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.
translation: 아주 먼 옛날, V의 시대보다도 전에, 이 세상이 거대한 전투로 끝을 맞으리라는 예언이 있었네. 사람들은 그 전투를 Ragnarok(라그나로크), 혹은 흔히 만물의 종말이라 불렀지.

english: Well that doesn’t sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?
translation: 그거 좋은 얘기는 아니네요. 그런데 basilisk(바실리스크)는 거기서 어떤 역할을 하죠?

english: The prophecies say that the battle will begin after the Serpent King is freed. So you see, it is not the basilisks people fear, it is what comes after.
translation: 예언에 따르면 그 전투는 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)이 풀려난 뒤에 시작된다네. 그러니 알겠나, 사람들이 두려워하는 건 basilisk(바실리스크)가 아니라 그 뒤에 올 일일세.

english: Then we’d better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!
translation: 그럼 Jormungand(요르문간드)가 계속 감옥에 갇혀 있게 해야겠네요!

english: Well, [Fremennik name], that’s why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you’ll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
translation: 그래서 말일세, [Fremennik name], 자네를 이곳으로 부른 걸세. 이 위협을 막는 데 힘을 보태려면 의회의 신뢰를 되찾아야 하네. 그리고 그 방법을 내가 알 것 같네.

english: How?
I think the best possible way to those your worth to them is by being the person that restores V’s Shield.
translation: 자네의 가치를 그들에게 증명할 가장 좋은 방법은 V's Shield(V의 방패)를 복원하는 사람이 되는 것이라 생각하네.

english: V’s Shield?

The shield used by V when he seated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it. There’s a few things I know about the shield though other things are lost from stories past. I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the detail I don’t, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy. Keep in mind, now that you’ve been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.
translation: V가 Serpent King(뱀의 왕)을 봉인할 때 쓴 방패일세. 우리 민족 사이에서는 전설로 통하지. 이 위협을 막을 가능성이라도 있으려면 그 방패를 다시 만들어야 하네. 방패에 대해 내가 아는 것도 몇 가지 있지만, 나머지는 옛이야기 속에서 잊혀 버렸네. Moon Clan(달 부족) 중에 내가 모르는 세부 사항을 아는 이가 있을 테니, 자네의 외교 관계가 쓸모가 있을 걸세. 다만 명심하게. 자네는 이제 추방된 몸이니, 이 지방 사람 대부분은 자네와 말을 섞으려 하지 않을 걸세.

english: Fair enough. So where should I start?

Stories tell of how V’s Shield was made using for components. First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use. Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King’s gaze. Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring. Finally, V’s Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.
translation: 이야기에 따르면 V's Shield(V의 방패)는 네 가지 부품으로 만들어졌다네. 첫째는 방패의 바탕이 되는 전통적인 Fremennik Shield(프레메닉 방패)로, 우리 전사들이 쓰는 것과 같은 것일세. 다음은 Lunar Glass(루나 유리)일세. 위대한 Moon Clan(달 부족) 신비술사가 만든 것이라 하며, 뱀의 왕의 시선을 되비추는 데 쓰였지. 그리고 Polishing Rock(연마석)이 있네. 루나 유리를 닦아 빛내는 데 필요했던 돌로, 끓어오르는 온천에서 은근하게 데워졌다고 하네. 마지막은 V's Sigil(V의 인장)일세. 이 인장은 달 부족이 그들만 아는 특별한 금속으로 만든 것이지.

english: Sorry, but your trail is not over quite yet.
translation: 미안하네만, 자네의 여정은 아직 끝나지 않았네.

english: Great...
Find the answer to this question for me.
Brundt has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Perfect!
Brundt has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Do you have any quests?
Yes, I am interested.
No, I'm not interested.
Why do you call me outerlander?
I seek an army to destroy Asgarnia!
Who are the Fremennik?
Nice hat!
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Ask about a Seal of Passage.
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)에 대해 묻는다.

english: Ask about the mountain camp.
Ask about V's Shield.
Ask about anything else.
I just came to say hello.
Can I hear the history of your people?
translation: 당신 민족의 역사를 들려주실 수 있나요?

english: Tell me of the finding of Koschei
Tell me of the lands to the North
Tell me of the outerlanders
Don't tell me anything
Ask about a Seal of Passage
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)에 대해 묻는다

english: Ask for a quest.
What are you doing down here?
Could you explain this place to me again?
This here is the Gauntlet, the finest creation of the Amlodd clan. It was built years ago to help train Prifddinas' finest warriors and survivalists.
translation: 여기가 바로 Gauntlet(건틀릿), Amlodd(암로드) 가문의 최고 걸작이지. 오래전에 Prifddinas(프리프디나스) 최고의 전사와 생존 전문가들을 훈련시키려고 지어졌어.

english: Train?
That's right. The Gauntlet contains a range of deadly creatures formed from crystal. Defeating them is the key to victory, but it is no easy task.
translation: 그래. Gauntlet(건틀릿) 안에는 크리스탈로 이루어진 온갖 치명적인 생물들이 있어. 놈들을 쓰러뜨리는 게 승리의 열쇠지만, 결코 쉬운 일은 아니야.

english: This is because all participants start with nothing at hand beyond a few basic tools.
translation: 왜냐하면 참가자는 모두 기본 도구 몇 개 말고는 빈손으로 시작하거든.

english: But how do people fight without their gear?
Resources can be gathered throughout the dungeon. These can be used to create the weapons, armour, food and potions needed to survive.
translation: 던전 곳곳에서 자원을 모을 수 있어. 그걸로 살아남는 데 필요한 무기, 갑옷, 음식, 물약을 만들면 돼.

english: Without any armour, those crystalline creatures can be real nasty. Any armour that you make down there will greatly reduce the damage they do to you.
translation: 갑옷이 없으면 그 크리스탈 생물들은 정말 고약하게 굴 거야. 안에서 만든 갑옷은 뭐든 받는 피해를 크게 줄여 주지.

english: Okay, I think I follow... But I thought this was all about combat, not just gathering my own equipment.
translation: 네, 대충 알 것 같아요... 그런데 여긴 장비나 모으는 곳이 아니라 전투가 핵심인 줄 알았는데요.

english: That's right. Once you feel you're ready, or once we decide that you've spent long enough down there, you'll have to face the fearsome Crystalline Hunllef.
translation: 맞아. 준비가 됐다고 느끼거나, 네가 안에서 충분히 오래 버텼다고 우리가 판단하면, 무시무시한 Crystalline Hunllef(크리스탈 헌레프)와 맞서야 해.

english: And what makes it so dangerous, if it's just for training?
translation: 그냥 훈련일 뿐인데, 뭐가 그렇게 위험하다는 거예요?

english: Once you go down there, there are only two ways out... You can make a break for the exit, or if you're bested in combat we'll send someone in for you.
translation: 일단 내려가면 나오는 길은 딱 두 가지야... 출구로 냅다 달려 나오든가, 싸움에서 지면 우리가 사람을 보내서 데려오든가.

english: Things can be a little unstable down there at times, too... Everything gets corrupted, and it might be a little frightening, but it makes for a good challenge.
translation: 게다가 가끔은 안이 좀 불안정해지기도 해... 모든 게 타락해 버리지. 좀 무서울 수도 있지만, 그만큼 좋은 도전이 되거든.

english: The Corrupted Gauntlet can be accessed by rightclicking the entrance.
translation: Corrupted Gauntlet(타락한 건틀릿)은 입구를 우클릭해서 들어갈 수 있어.

english: I think that covers it... Everything else, you'll have to work out for yourself while you're in there.
translation: 이 정도면 다 설명한 것 같군... 나머지는 안에 들어가서 네가 직접 알아내야 해.

english: Okay... I think I've got it.
You can always come back and ask me to go over things again.
translation: 언제든 다시 와서 설명해 달라고 하면 돼.

english: I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
You? Attempting the Gauntlet? If you say so!
Just passing by.
Alright... Well be careful down here. I've got my eye on you.
translation: 그래... 여기선 조심해. 내가 지켜보고 있으니까.

english: Don't think you want to be heading down there without knowing what you're getting into! Come and see me, if you really want to go down there.
translation: 뭐가 기다리는지도 모르고 내려가겠다는 생각은 말라고! 정말 내려가고 싶으면 나한테 먼저 와.

english: Don't think you can be taking any plus ones down there with you.
translation: 거기엔 동행을 데려갈 수 없다는 거 알아 둬.

english: There's something in that there chest waiting for you. Don't leave it for too long.
translation: 저기 상자 안에 네 몫이 기다리고 있어. 너무 오래 내버려 두지 마.

english: Could you explain this place to me again?
I'm thinking of giving the Gauntlet a go.
What is this place?
Just passing by.
You's better talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky da chompy.
translation: 너 아빠한테 말해, 아빠 살금살금 chompy(촘피) 쫓아다녀.

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
A bug! Hahaha.
HAHAHAHAHA
...ahahaha
HA!
Ok... I'm done.
The bunny thinks you laughed at them and looks both angry and embarrassed.
translation: 토끼는 당신이 자기를 비웃었다고 생각하고는 화나면서도 부끄러운 표정을 짓는다.

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't mean to turn you into a... Hot cross bunny!
translation: 아, 미안. 너를 화가 '빵' 터진 토끼로 만들 생각은 없었어... 핫 크로스 버니!

english: It's a bit rude of 'em to take up the whole bridge with their conversation, isn't it, mate?
translation: 저 사람들, 다리를 통째로 막고 얘기하는 건 좀 무례하지 않아, 친구?

english: Aye, mate, but wouldn't it be just as rude for us to interrupt?
translation: 그렇지, 친구. 그런데 우리가 끼어드는 것도 똑같이 무례한 거 아닐까?

english: A good point well made, mate. Who are we to decide that the dig is more impor'ant than a personal disagreement between two people?
translation: 좋은 지적이야, 친구. 발굴 작업이 두 사람의 개인적인 의견 충돌보다 더 중요하다고 우리가 정할 자격이 있나?

english: You're not wrong, mate. We often place matters of industry above those of people, and it's chippin' away at our ability to relate to each other on a human level.
translation: 맞는 말이야, 친구. 우린 종종 사람의 일보다 산업의 일을 앞세우고, 그게 인간 대 인간으로 서로 공감하는 능력을 갉아먹고 있다고.

english: What's going on here?
We're part of a dig into some ruins beneath Cam Torum, but the way's blocked by these folks.
translation: 우린 Cam Torum(캠 토룸) 아래 폐허를 발굴하는 일행인데, 저 사람들이 길을 막고 있어.

english: Have you tried asking them to move?
We're considering the moral implications of doing exactly that, mate.
translation: 바로 그걸 해도 되는지, 그 도덕적 의미를 따져 보는 중이야, 친구.

english: Are you two philosophers?
No mate, builders.
But thinking, talking, discussing, it's what makes us human, mate.
translation: 그래도 생각하고, 말하고, 토론하는 것. 그게 우리를 인간답게 만드는 거라고, 친구.

english: It's not just humans that do those things.
translation: 그런 걸 하는 건 인간만이 아니잖아요.

english: Fair play, mate. I guess we're reflecting more on the condition of sen'ience in general then.
translation: 일리 있어, 친구. 그럼 우린 지각 있는 존재 전반의 조건에 대해 성찰하고 있는 셈이군.

english: Goodbye.
Have a good one, mate.
Thanks for that, mate. You should speak to Jess inside. She'll be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 고마워, 친구. 안에 들어가서 Jess(제스)랑 얘기해 봐. 도시 북쪽에 있을 거야. 너 같은 해결사가 꼭 필요할 거라고.

english: Who's Jess?
She's the archaeologist in charge of the dig into these ruins they've found. Discovering the mysteries of the past and that.
translation: 이 사람들이 찾아낸 폐허 발굴을 책임지는 고고학자야. 과거의 수수께끼를 밝혀내고 뭐 그런 일을 하지.

english: You should head inside, mate. Remember, Jess will be in the north of the city. She could use a problem solver like yourself.
translation: 안으로 들어가 봐, 친구. 잊지 마, Jess(제스)는 도시 북쪽에 있을 거야. 너 같은 해결사가 꼭 필요할 거라고.

english: To me!
To you!
Keep it down!
G'day, mate.
I'm surprised to see you both in such high spirits after walking past all those jeering dwarves.
translation: 야유하는 드워프들 사이를 지나왔는데도 두 분 다 기분이 좋아 보여서 놀랐어요.

english: Ah, well it's unfortunate, but no reason to be sad. It's them that ought to be sad.
translation: 아, 안타까운 일이긴 하지만 슬퍼할 이유는 없지. 슬퍼해야 할 건 저쪽이야.

english: Aye, mate. Livin' a life unable to connect with others because they look different must be miserable.
translation: 그래, 친구. 생김새가 다르다고 남들과 어울리지 못하고 사는 인생이라니, 분명 비참할 거야.

english: We wish 'em the best. Hopefully their paths to personal growth are near and smooth.
translation: 우린 그 친구들이 잘되길 바라. 저들이 성장하는 길이 가깝고 순탄했으면 좋겠어.

english: Thanks for taking care of those base camps, mate.
No problem. I hope there's no hard feelings over Jessamine asking me to do a part of your jobs.
translation: 별말씀을요. Jessamine(제서민)이 두 분 일의 일부를 저한테 맡긴 것 때문에 기분 상하신 건 아니면 좋겠네요.

english: That's no worries, mate, I've no issue admitting you're better cut out for building camps in dangerous dungeons than I am.
translation: 걱정 마, 친구. 위험한 던전에 캠프를 짓는 데는 네가 나보다 낫다는 거, 난 기꺼이 인정해.

english: We may not be mul'i-disciplined adventurers like you, but we don't need to be. The world needs more than just heroes, don't it?
translation: 우린 너처럼 다재다능한 모험가는 아니지만, 그럴 필요도 없어. 세상엔 영웅만 필요한 게 아니잖아, 안 그래?

english: Aye, mate, I'm content and proud to just be a hard working, decent builder.
translation: 그렇지, 친구. 난 그냥 성실하고 괜찮은 건축가인 게 만족스럽고 자랑스러워.

english: Besides, without us, building supplies wouldn't be there in the first place. Life's all about working together.
translation: 게다가 우리가 없으면 애초에 건축 자재가 거기 있지도 않았을 거라고. 인생은 함께 일하는 거지.

english: Glad to hear it. Keep up the good work then!
translation: 그렇다니 다행이에요. 그럼 계속 수고해 주세요!

english: You too, mate.
You seem remarkably calm considering everything that's going on.
translation: 이런 상황인데도 두 분은 놀랄 만큼 침착하시네요.

english: Life's unpredictable, mate. No sense stressin' over what's out of your control.
translation: 인생은 예측할 수 없는 거야, 친구. 내 힘으로 어쩔 수 없는 일에 스트레스 받아 봐야 소용없지.

english: It's not like we're not aware of the danger we're in, but worryin' about it ain't productive.
translation: 우리가 처한 위험을 모르는 건 아니지만, 걱정해 봐야 생산적이지 않거든.

english: Shouldn't you be getting out of here if you feel like you're in danger?
translation: 위험하다고 느끼면 여기서 빠져나가야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: We may not be in total control of our surroundings, but we can still impact them positively through our actions. Like bein' here to support you.
translation: 주변 상황을 다 통제할 순 없어도, 우리 행동으로 좋은 영향을 줄 순 있어. 여기서 너를 응원하는 것처럼 말이야.

english: Even if that's just emotionally. We believe in you, mate.
translation: 마음으로만 응원하는 거라도 말이지. 우린 널 믿어, 친구.

english: Thanks.
No worries, mate. Go get 'em.
translation: 별말을, 친구. 가서 혼쭐을 내 줘.

english: I am a fool...
Well... yes, a bit.
You meant well. You thought you were helpin'. Can't fault you for that part, mate.
translation: 좋은 뜻이었잖아. 돕는다고 생각했던 거고. 그 점은 탓할 수 없어, 친구.

english: You made a mistake. Coulda been any of us. Just gotta make sure we learn from our mistakes is all.
translation: 실수를 한 거지. 우리 중 누구라도 그럴 수 있었어. 실수에서 배우기만 하면 되는 거야.

english: And if yer genuinely sorry, best you can do is work to be better, not mope around. So keep your chin up, mate!
translation: 그리고 진심으로 미안하다면, 축 처져 있지 말고 더 나아지려고 노력하는 게 최선이야. 그러니 기운 내, 친구!

english: Thank you...
What did you do, anyway?
I saw sun and moon runes on that thing. Recalled something from Ranul's teachings, a rite he once performed...
translation: 그것에 해의 룬과 달의 룬이 새겨져 있는 걸 봤어요. Ranul(라눌)의 가르침에서 무언가가 떠올랐죠. 그분이 예전에 행했던 의식이요...

english: I tried to emulate it, and it worked. I thought I had freed his emissaries. But they weren't that at all...
translation: 그걸 흉내 냈더니 정말 됐어요. 그분의 사절들을 풀어 준 줄 알았는데... 전혀 그런 게 아니었어요...

english: Interesting. Maybe there was some sort of connection between Ranul and this place after all.
translation: 흥미롭네요. 어쩌면 Ranul(라눌)과 이곳 사이에 정말 어떤 연관이 있었는지도 몰라요.

english: Well, all's well that ends well.
translation: 뭐, 끝이 좋으면 다 좋은 거지.

english: We never had any doubts! Always knew you'd get it sorted, mate.
translation: 우린 한 번도 의심하지 않았어! 네가 해낼 줄 늘 알았다고, 친구.

english: No worries, mate.
Good to see you again, mate.
Good to see you both as well. How's things?
translation: 저도 두 분 다시 봬서 반가워요. 요즘 어떠세요?

english: Never better, mate. Never better. This here ruin was the find of the century!
translation: 더할 나위 없지, 친구. 더할 나위 없어. 이 폐허는 세기의 발견이었다고!

english: All credit to Jess, o'course, but we're glad to be doing our bit!
translation: 물론 공은 다 Jess(제스) 거지만, 우리도 한몫하게 돼서 기뻐!

english: Glad to hear it.
What's going on here?
Are you two philosophers?
Goodbye.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 충성 고객이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있습니다.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
How does it feel to be back home?
Ayyy ... *hiccup* ... Ish been sho long sinsh I've ... *hiccup* ... ad a deshent cocktail!
translation: 에이이 ... *딸꾹* ... 제대로 된 칵테일 마셔 본 지가 ... *딸꾹* ... 너무 오래됐쒀!

english: Glad to see you enjoying yourself... I guess.
Hello!
Hello sir, are you going to make a snowman?
Maybe, I'm not sure I'd be very good at it!
translation: 글쎄, 내가 잘 만들 수 있을지 모르겠는데!

english: I think you would be!
I want to make a snowman, but I can't reach high enough to stack the snowballs properly.
translation: 눈사람 만들고 싶은데, 손이 높이 안 닿아서 눈덩이를 제대로 못 쌓겠어요.

english: Hello Buoy and Gurl!
Hello sir!
How do you know our names?
I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 너희 아빠랑 얘기했거든. 아빠가 엄청 바쁘셔서, 나한테 너희 눈사람 만드는 걸 도와 달라고 하셨어!

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 그럼! 너희가 원하는 눈사람은 뭐든 만들어 줄게!

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 야호! 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: But I want it to be five tall!
Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 다섯은 나쁜 숫자야, 세 개 높이여야 해!

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 네가 나쁜 숫자야. 다섯이 훨씬 좋거든.

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 알았어, 알았어, 잠깐만. 서로 조금씩 양보하는 게 어때? 눈덩이 네 개 높이로 하면?

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
Yes, four tall is okay.
Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 좋아. 이제 층마다 눈덩이 크기를 골라야 해. 번갈아 가면서 정하는 게 어때? 한 사람당 두 개씩.

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
The next one should be big!
This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 잘 되고 있네, 벌써 반이나 왔어! 위쪽 두 개는 어떻게 할까?

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
No, it should be little!
But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 근데 작은 거여야 해, 조그만 건 이상해 보일 거야.

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 이상해 보이지 않거든. 장식하기엔 작은 게 더 좋아.

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 내 장식은 조그만 거에도 맞을 거야.

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 알았어, 알았어, 잠깐만. 이건 확실히 안 되겠다. 너희 둘이 싸우는 건 싫어. 크리스마스잖아, 다투면 안 돼!

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 내가 너희 둘한테 눈사람을 하나씩 만들어 주는 건 어때? 높이도 크기도 원하는 대로. 한 사람당 하나씩!

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 그럼 내 건 눈덩이 다섯 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 그럼 내 건 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 그래, 너희 둘 다 원하는 눈사람으로 만들어 줄게!

english: What would you both like?
I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 내 건 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해 주세요! 그리고 맨 아래는 작은 거, 가운데는 큰 거, 맨 위는 거대한 거로 해 주세요!

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 내 건 눈덩이 다섯 개 높이로 해 주세요! 맨 아래는 어마어마한 거, 그다음은 커다란 거, 그다음은 보통, 그다음은 큰 거, 그리고 맨 위는 조그만 거로 해 주세요!

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 완전히 다른 눈사람 두 개구나. 아까 왜 안 됐는지 알겠다!

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 이 크기들은 다 무슨 뜻이야? 어마어마한 거? 보통? 조그만 거? 그게 얼마나 큰데?

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 바보 같긴! 어마어마한 건 당연히 제일 큰 눈덩이죠!

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 보통은 눈덩이를 보통으로 만들면 나오는 보통 크기예요. 쉽죠!

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 그래, 알려 줘서 고마워. 어떻게든 해 볼게.

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 너희 둘은 장식을 뭘로 할 거야?

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 난 내 거 어떻게 꾸밀지 벌써 정했어요!

english: Me too!
Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 내가 눈사람을 만드는 동안 너희는 장식을 좀 찾아오는 게 어때? 다 만들면 그때 붙이면 되잖아.

english: Okay sir!
We will do that!
Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 음, 정리된 것 같네. Larry(래리)한테 다시 가서 눈사람 만드는 요령이 있는지 물어봐야겠다.

english: Hello there!
Have you started making the snowmen yet?
You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 도움이 필요하면 아빠한테 말해 보세요. 아빠는 눈사람 만들 줄 알아요!

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 맞아요, 아빠는 우리랑 늘 엄청 큰 눈사람을 만들어 줬어요!

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 아빠한테 가서 무슨 조언을 해 주시는지 들어 봐야겠다.

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 아빠는 더 낮게 만들라고 할 거예요, 그게 더 좋으니까!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: Larry(래리)한테 가 봐야겠다. 분명 쓸 만한 조언을 해 줄 거야!

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
They're done! They're so cool!
Yay! Can we decorate them now?
Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
Mine is perfect!
Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 내 것도요. 딱 내가 원하던 대로예요.

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 별거 아니었어. 둘 다 메리 크리스마스!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: Larry(래리)한테 가 봐야겠다. festive white wine(축제용 백포도주)를 준비해 뒀으면 좋겠는데.

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 맞아요, 엄청 오래 걸렸어요! 내 거 마음에 들어요?

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 내 건요? 내 것도 마음에 들어요?

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 네 것도 좋아. 둘 다 뭔가를 떠올리게 하네!

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 내 건 Thermy(써미)예요! 제일 좋아하는 괴물이에요! 엄청 크고 무서워서 우와 소리가 절로 나요!

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 내 건 Tempy(템피)예요! 제일 좋아하는 괴물이에요! 물속에 사는데, 화가 잔뜩 난 거대한 물덩어리예요!

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 둘 다 정말 대단하다! 너희가 이렇게 장식을 잘할 줄은 몰랐어.

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 아빠가 해마다 우리한테 꾸미게 해 줘요. 연습을 많이 했거든요!

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 작년엔 Fragment of Seren(세렌의 파편)이랑 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)으로 만들었어요!

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 뭐... 정말??? 그건 보고 싶었는데. 이번 둘보다 훨씬 어려웠겠다!

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 그런데 이 괴물들은 다 어떻게 아는 거야? 너희 아빠가 그런 데 근처에도 못 가게 하실 텐데!

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 아빠가 이야기를 많이 읽어 주시고, 모험가님처럼 지나가는 모험가들한테서도 들어요.

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
translation: 재미있고 멋진 모험가들을 많이 만나나 보구나!

english: Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 그래도 모험가님만큼 멋있진 않아요. 그 사람들은 아무도 눈사람 만드는 걸 안 도와줬거든요!

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 맞아요, 우리 눈사람 만드는 걸 도와준 건 모험가님이 처음이에요!

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 뭘, 천만에. 나도 정말 즐거웠어. 다 끝났으니 이제 뭐 할 거야?

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 놀러 갈 거예요! 축제에도 가 볼지 몰라요. 거기 오실 거예요?

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, have fun!
Hello.
Be vigilant, citizen.
Err, right.
Buy ush a drink.
I think you have had enough.
Pleash, buy ush a drink.
How you holding up Burntof? Must have had quite the fright when you woke that monster.
translation: Burntof(번토프), 괜찮아요? 그 괴물을 깨웠을 때 꽤 놀랐겠어요.

english: You're right [lad/lass]. It did give me a little fright.
But I saw some interesting things down in the ruins...
translation: 그래도 폐허 아래에서 흥미로운 걸 좀 봤다네...

english: What do you mean?
Some of the markings on the wall look very familiar to me. I've seen them before.
translation: 벽에 있던 표식 중 몇 개가 아주 낯익더군. 전에 본 적이 있다네.

english: Well, when I defeated the monster, an Imcando dwarf opened the barred door...
translation: 음, 제가 그 괴물을 물리쳤을 때 Imcando(임칸도) 드워프가 빗장 걸린 문을 열어 줬어요...

english: An Imcando dwarf! I thought they were all but extinct! You've found something truly amazing [player name]!
translation: Imcando(임칸도) 드워프라고! 거의 멸종한 줄 알았는데! 자네 정말 대단한 걸 찾아냈구먼, [player name]!

english: I wish I had a drink to celebrate, but this desert is bone dry.
translation: 축하주라도 한잔하고 싶네만, 이 사막은 뼛속까지 바싹 말랐구먼.

english: How's it going, Butch?
Ah... How could I forget... You don't have a head!
translation: 아... 내가 그걸 깜빡하다니... 너 머리가 없지!

english: Shall we head off on an adventure together?
translation: 우리 같이 머리 맞대고 모험 계획 좀 세워 볼까?

english: Sorry, poor choice of words.
Can you speak?
Yes...
Er... Who's speaking? Is this Butch, or something else?
translation: 어... 누가 말하는 거야? Butch(부치)야, 아니면 다른 뭔가야?

english: That's unsettling.
Good day, [sir/madam]. Would [sir/madam] care to hire a good butler for 5000 coins?
translation: 안녕하십니까, [sir/madam]. [sir/madam]께서는 5000코인에 훌륭한 집사를 고용하실 의향이 있으십니까?

english: What can you do?

I can fulfill all [sir/madam]'s domestic service needs with efficiency and impeccable manners. I hate to boast, but I can say with confidence that no mortal can make trips to the bank or sawmill faster than I!
translation: [sir/madam]의 모든 가사 수요를 효율적이고 흠잡을 데 없는 예의로 충족해 드릴 수 있습니다. 자랑하고 싶지는 않습니다만, 은행이나 제재소에 저보다 빨리 다녀올 수 있는 인간은 없다고 자신 있게 말씀드릴 수 있습니다!

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 전에 했던 일에 대해 말해 봐.

english: From a humble beginning as a dish-washer I have worked my way up through the ranks of domestic service in the households of nobles from Varrock and Ardougne. As a life-long servant I have naturally
translation: 저는 접시닦이라는 미천한 출발에서 시작하여, Varrock(바록)과 Ardougne(아르둔) 귀족 가문에서 가사 서비스의 계급을 차근차근 밟아 올라왔습니다. 평생을 하인으로 살아온 몸으로서 저는 자연스럽게

english: suppressed any personality of my own and trained myself never to use the second person when talking to a superior. I have usually worked in the large households of the aristocracy, but now that such a large
translation: 제 개성을 억누르고 윗분께 말씀드릴 때 결코 2인칭을 쓰지 않도록 스스로를 단련했습니다. 주로 귀족의 대저택에서 일해 왔습니다만, 이제는 아주 많은

english: number of private persons are building their own houses I decided to offer them my services.
translation: 개인들이 직접 집을 짓고 있기에 그분들께 제 서비스를 제공하기로 했습니다.

english: I must respectfully decline, [sir/madam]. I offer a very exclusive service and will only work for people with over level 40 Construction.
translation: 정중히 사양하겠습니다, [sir/madam]. 저는 매우 고급스러운 서비스를 제공하며, Construction(건설) 레벨이 40 이상인 분께만 봉사합니다.

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 하인이 잘 수 있도록 침대가 있는 두 번째 침실이 필요합니다.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 고용하지... 아, 지금 돈이 없는데 외상으로 해도 될까? 꼭 갚을게, 진짜야.

english: I regret that I cannot agree to begin my duties until I have been paid.
translation: 유감스럽게도 급여를 받기 전에는 업무를 시작할 수 없습니다.

english: Thank you, [sir/madam]. I can start work immediately.
translation: 감사합니다, [sir/madam]. 지금 바로 일을 시작할 수 있습니다.

english: You rang, [sir/madam]?
Yes, [sir/madam]?
Very good, [sir/madam]. [Sir/Madam]'s tea will be ready shortly.
The Butler prepares tea
Your tea, [sir/madam]. Does [sir/madam] take milk?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very good, [sir/madam].
I regret that I cannot make a meal unless [sir/madam] has a dining table for me to serve it on.
translation: 유감스럽게도 [sir/madam]께 식사를 차려 드릴 식탁이 없으면 식사를 준비할 수 없습니다.

english: Serve drinks please.
I cannot serve drinks unless you have a kitchen with an ale barrel, [sir/madam].
translation: 에일 통이 있는 부엌이 없으면 음료를 내올 수 없습니다, [sir/madam].

english: Can you fetch something from the bank for me?
Certainly, [sir/madam]. If [sir/madam] would simply tell me the items [he/she] requires?
translation: 물론입니다, [sir/madam]. [sir/madam]께서는 [he/she]께 필요하신 물품을 말씀만 해 주시겠습니까?

english: The Butler fetches the requested item(s)
Your goods, [sir/madam].
Certainly, [sir/madam]. If [sir/madam] would care to give me the logs?
Stay at the entrance and greet guests.
[Task]
If you do not pay me I will have to give you my notice, sir. My fee is 5000 coins.
translation: 급여를 주시지 않으면 사직을 고할 수밖에 없습니다, 주인님. 제 급여는 5000코인입니다.

english: Okay here's 5000 coins.
Thank you sir.
Your goods sir.
I'll pay you later.
You're fired!
Very well, sir.
Shall I take that to the bank, [sir/madam]?
The Butler takes the requested item(s) to the bank
No
Shall I take that to the bank or to the sawmill, [sir/madam]?
translation: 그것을 은행에 맡겨 드릴까요, 아니면 제재소로 가져갈까요, [sir/madam]?

english: The sawmill's fee would be [x], [sir/madam].
The Butler takes the requested log(s) to the sawmill
Never mind.
[player name] is entertaining in the [room]. Would [sir/madam] care to follow me?
translation: [player name]님께서 [room]에서 손님을 맞고 계십니다. [sir/madam]께서도 저를 따라오시겠습니까?

english: Butler transports the player to host
What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 전에 했던 일에 대해 말해 봐

english: You're hired!
Serve...
Tea
Yes please
No thanks
Actually I don't want any

Take something to the bank
Bring something from the bank
Wooden planks
Oak planks
Teak planks
Mahogany planks

Steel bar
Cloth

I'll pay you later.

Good day [sir/madam].
Hello. I'm helping Lord Hosidius find his missing son. I was wondering if you could help me.
translation: 안녕하세요. 실종된 아드님을 찾는 Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)를 돕고 있는데요, 혹시 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: I'm afraid I know not where Artur has gone. I do not speak to him much. He keeps himself to himself.
translation: 유감스럽게도 Artur(아르투르) 도련님이 어디로 가셨는지는 모릅니다. 도련님과는 대화를 많이 나누지 않습니다. 워낙 혼자 지내시는 분이라서요.

english: However, I've noticed him speaking to Olivia before. Maybe she can help.
translation: 다만 도련님이 Olivia(올리비아)와 이야기하시는 걸 본 적은 있습니다. 그분이라면 도움이 될지도 모릅니다.

english: Great, thanks.
Good day [sir/madam]. I hope your quest is going well.
translation: 안녕하십니까, [sir/madam]. 퀘스트가 순조롭게 진행되고 있기를 바랍니다.

english: Good day [sir/madam]. On behalf of the Hosidius family, I thank you for bringing Artur home.
translation: 안녕하십니까, [sir/madam]. Hosidius(호시디우스) 가문을 대신하여 Artur(아르투르) 도련님을 집으로 데려와 주신 데 감사드립니다.

english: Good day [sir/madam]. I'm afraid I can't stop to talk. The new Lord Hosidius has plenty of work for me.
translation: 안녕하십니까, [sir/madam]. 죄송하지만 이야기를 나눌 시간이 없습니다. 새 Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)께서 제게 맡기신 일이 많아서요.

english: Hello there.
Hello. How are you today?
Good thank you, and yourself?
Very well, thank you.
Hello stranger.
Why hello there.
I take it you're the new butler...?
That's right. I hear that they had some problems with the last one.
translation: 그렇습니다. 지난번 집사에게 문제가 좀 있었다고 들었습니다.

english: Yes, you could say that...
It's an honour to be in your presence again, adventurer. I hope things are well?
translation: 다시 뵙게 되어 영광입니다, 모험가님. 잘 지내고 계십니까?

english: Not bad, thanks. Yourself?
