Unfortunately, I am still forced to deal with this insufferable family. Many generations have passed, but they are still the enemy. As such, they must be kept a close eye on.
translation: 안타깝게도 저는 여전히 이 견딜 수 없는 가문을 상대해야 합니다. 여러 세대가 지났지만 이들은 여전히 적입니다. 그러니 눈을 떼지 말고 감시해야 하지요.

english: Still, I have no doubt that the time will soon come for me to leave this place. Our lord will certainly have need of me elsewhere once his current work is complete.
translation: 그래도 머지않아 이곳을 떠날 때가 오리라 믿어 의심치 않습니다. 우리 주인님께서 지금 하시는 일을 마치시면 분명 다른 곳에서 저를 필요로 하실 겁니다.

english: I see. Well good luck with it all.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: 별로 할 말 없어. 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨났을 때 다른 트롤이랑 같이 Weiss(바이스) 왔어. 근데 그땐 나 어린 트롤이었어.

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: 대부분 Weiss(바이스) 살면서 재밌게 지냈어. 여기 야생 동물 흥미롭거든.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기는 Weiss(바이스). 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨나고 트롤들이 몇 년 전에 지었어. 이제 바이스가 우리 집이야.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지냈어. 먹을 염소랑 늑대 많아. 오래 먹어서 이제 좀 질리는데, 다른 선택 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그거 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)이 구트위드 재배 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구트 뭐시기 풀? 그런 거 들어 본 적 없어. 근데 채소 같은 소리 나고, Mother(어머니)는 그런 거 먹는 거 안 좋아해. 그러니까 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해. 근데 걔 엄청 크고, 걔 대장이야. 그래서 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠어. 근데 우리 집이야. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)은 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 더 좋게 만들 수 있대. 근데 Mother(어머니)가 관심 없어서 이상한 버섯 그거 못 해.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 싸움 더 잘하게 해 주는 것만 신경 써. 걔 엄청 크고, 걔 대장이야. 그래서 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 진짜 좋아. 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 걔 남편 트롤이 우리한테 구트위드 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 맛있어졌어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠어. 근데 점점 좋아지고 있어. Snowflake(눈송이), 걔가 우리한테 구트위드 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으니까 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그래서 그래, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이라 바이스 살기 좋은 곳이야. 트롤 다 눈송이 좋아해. 걔 남편 트롤 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그거 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요.

english: Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I see.
Would you like some help?
Urgh, it just happened again! Every time I almost have it my hand slips.
translation: 으윽, 또 그랬어요! 거의 다 됐다 싶으면 꼭 손이 미끄러진다니까요.

english: Oh, that's unfortunate. Are you using a lockpick?
translation: 아, 안타깝네요. lockpick(자물쇠 따개)를 쓰고 있어요?

english: Yes. Well actually, I'm using a Strange old lockpick. I found it while looting one of these coffins and I typically have better luck with it.
translation: 네. 아, 정확히는 Strange old lockpick(이상한 낡은 자물쇠 따개)를 쓰고 있어요. 여기 관을 털다가 찾았는데, 보통 이걸 쓰면 운이 더 좋더라고요.

english: Oh, that's interesting. I'll keep my eyes out for one.
I've found a few of them while raiding this place. There appear to be more of them on this floor than the floors above.
translation: 여기를 털면서 몇 개 찾았어요. 위층들보다 이 층에 더 많은 것 같아요.

english: I see. If you don't mind me asking, you already have dark graceful so why are you still looking for hallowed marks?
translation: 그렇군요. 실례지만, 이미 dark graceful(어두운 기품 있는 세트)를 갖고 있는데 왜 아직도 Hallowed mark(신성한 표식)을 모으고 있어요?

english: Oh, it's because of this little fellow following me. I've heard that the Dark acorn sold by the guy upstairs will transform him into a Dark Squirrel.
translation: 아, 저를 따라다니는 이 꼬마 때문이에요. 위층에 있는 사람이 파는 Dark acorn(어두운 도토리)를 먹이면 이 녀석이 Dark Squirrel(어둠 다람쥐)로 변한다고 들었거든요.

english: Wow, I didn't know that! That sounds pretty cool.
Yeah, that's what I thought but that mysterious stranger is asking for 3,000 Hallowed marks for it.
translation: 네, 저도 그렇게 생각했는데 그 mysterious stranger(수수께끼의 이방인)이 그걸 Hallowed mark(신성한 표식) 3,000개에 팔겠대요.

english: 3,000? That sounds extortionate!
Yeah, that's what I thought. Feels like he set the price just to keep me down here for longer. Still, it's not like I have anything better to do.
translation: 네, 저도 그렇게 생각했어요. 저를 여기 더 오래 붙잡아 두려고 가격을 정한 것 같아요. 그래도 딱히 더 할 일이 있는 것도 아니고요.

english: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.
translation: 그렇군요, 행운을 빌어요. 목표를 이룰 때까지 살아남길 바랄게요.

english: I'm sure I'll be fine.
Yeah, I ended up buying one myself and fed it to my Giant Squirrel. It took a while but it was definitely worth it.
translation: 네, 저도 결국 하나 사서 제 Giant Squirrel(거대 다람쥐)한테 먹였어요. 시간은 좀 걸렸지만 확실히 그럴 만한 가치가 있었어요.

english: Wow, I'm impressed! How long did it take you to get the 3,000 marks?
translation: 와, 대단하네요! 표식 3,000개 모으는 데 얼마나 걸렸어요?

english: Long enough... Still, at least I feel much more agile now than when I started.
translation: 꽤 오래요... 그래도 처음 시작했을 때보다 훨씬 날렵해진 것 같긴 해요.

english: I don't think I'm going to get any more agile while looking for it myself. I'm glad you received some benefit from the grind though.
translation: 저는 직접 모으면서 더 날렵해질 것 같지는 않네요. 그래도 그 노가다에서 얻은 게 있다니 다행이에요.

english: You shouldn't feed someone's pet without their permission.
translation: 남의 펫한테 허락도 없이 먹이를 주면 안 돼요.

english: C'mon, almost got it...
Agh, thought I had it that time!
C'mon, almost got it...
Having problems?
Can't you see I'm busy?
Do you have a lockpick?
No and even if I did have one I wouldn't give it to you!
translation: 없어. 있다고 해도 너한텐 안 줘!

english: I already have one. I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 저는 이미 하나 있어요. 그냥 이 관을 열 때 자물쇠 따개가 있으면 도움이 된다고 알려 주려던 거예요. 꽤 애먹는 것 같아서요.

english: I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.
translation: 그냥 이 관을 열 때 lockpick(자물쇠 따개)가 있으면 도움이 된다고 알려 주려던 거예요. 꽤 애먹는 것 같아서요.

english: Wait, are you serious? The last adventurer I spoke to down here told me that lockpicks don't help!
translation: 잠깐, 진짜야? 지난번에 여기서 얘기한 모험가는 자물쇠 따개가 아무 도움도 안 된다고 했는데!

english: Yes I'm serious. Also that outfit you're wearing doesn't help you get more loot from these coffins either.
translation: 네, 진짜예요. 그리고 지금 입고 있는 그 옷도 이 관에서 전리품을 더 얻는 데 아무 도움이 안 돼요.

english: They lied about that too? I feel like a fool!
translation: 그것도 거짓말이었어? 완전 바보가 된 기분이네!

english: At least you look cool dressed like that though.
Who cares about that? If it doesn't work then I should just wear the full graceful outfit since that would be much more efficient.
translation: 그게 무슨 상관이야? 효과가 없으면 차라리 graceful(기품 있는) 세트를 풀로 입는 게 훨씬 효율적이잖아.

english: Each to their own I suppose.
Ahhh, harvest day!
I sure can't wait to feed my family with these hard-earned cabba-
translation: 어서 가족들한테 먹여 주고 싶어 못 참겠네, 이 힘들게 키운 양배-

english: No! What have you done?!
translation: 안 돼! 무슨 짓을 한 거야?!

english: The farmer performs the Cry emote.
Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 너무 아파서 대화할 수 없을 것 같다.

english: Hello again. Coming back to Corsair Cove?
translation: 또 오셨네요. Corsair Cove(코르세어 만)으로 돌아가실래요?

english: Yes please.
The ship sails to Corsair Cove...
Not just now, thanks.
The Captain's letting me command his boat now I'm fully recovered. Did you want to leave?
translation: 제가 완전히 회복해서 이제 선장님이 배를 맡겨 주셨어요. 떠나실래요?

english: Please take me back to Rimmington.
The ship sails to Rimmington...
I'll talk to you later.
Yes please.
Not just now, thanks.
Please take me back to Rimmington.
I'll talk to you later.
Hey.
Hey there. If you need something, you should speak to Veos. I'm just the cabin boy.
translation: 안녕하세요. 필요한 게 있으면 Veos(베오스)에게 말씀하세요. 저는 그냥 사환이에요.

english: Fair enough.
Hey. Veos left something for you. Here you go.
translation: 안녕하세요. Veos(베오스)가 뭘 남겨 두셨어요. 여기요.

english: Can you take me somewhere?
I'm afraid that you're not eligible to travel to Great Kourend at the moment. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금은 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)로 가실 자격이 없어요. 자격이 생기면 다시 오세요. 기꺼이 모셔다드릴게요.

english: Where would you like to go?
I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 알겠습니다. 뱃멀미 안 하셨으면 좋겠네요. 긴 항해거든요.

english: I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish.
I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
I'm good.
Hey there. Do you need something?
Can you take me somewhere?
Travel to Port Sarim.
Travel to Port Piscarilius.
Travel to Land's End.
Stay where you are.
I'm good.
Hi.
I bet you're after another lens!
How could you possibly know that?
Hey, I think I'm learning a thing or two from these Moon Clan ladies.
translation: 헤헤, 나 이 Moon Clan(달 부족) 아가씨들한테 이것저것 배우고 있는 것 같아.

english: Oi! I need another lens, boy.
translation: 야! 렌즈 하나 더 줘, 꼬마야.

english: But you don't have space.
Good point.
Huh, oh ok, I suppose I owe you one.
translation: 어, 아 그래. 내가 신세 진 게 있으니까.

english: I think I'll pass. But thanks..
So you've plucked up the courage to come and confront that girl!
translation: 드디어 용기 내서 그 여자애한테 따지러 왔구나!

english: That I did, that I did!
And?
She turned out to be really nice! She's joining us to become a pirate!
translation: 알고 보니 엄청 착하더라! 해적이 되려고 우리 패거리에 들어온대!

english: Really? And you're not sceptical about this? You know, after what she did last time?
translation: 진짜? 그런데 하나도 안 의심스러워? 그러니까, 지난번에 걔가 한 짓이 있는데?

english: She---has---no---spell---on---me.
Huh? Why are you talking like that?
Like what?
Like someone else was talking for you. Are you sure she hasn't put a spell on you again? Did she wave a watch in front of your face? You know, tell you to look deep into her eyes?
translation: 다른 누가 너 대신 말하는 것처럼. 진짜 걔가 또 주문 건 거 아니야? 네 얼굴 앞에서 watch(시계)를 흔들었어? 있잖아, 자기 눈을 깊이 들여다보라고 하고?

english: I think you've been hypnotised. I wonder what happens if I click my fingers?
translation: 너 최면에 걸린 것 같은데. 내가 손가락을 튕기면 어떻게 될까?

english: *click*
*Cluck* *cluck* *bwaarrk*
Oh dear. Oh well, I'm sure you'll learn one day.
Please
No thanks
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 안녕하신가. 자격을 갖춘 것 같군. 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 안녕하신가! 자네가 최근에 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 세 개를 모두 마친 그 학생이지? 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 먼저 장비를 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 tool rack(공구 선반)에 있지. Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험에서 배운 걸 활용하게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 장화를 착용하고,

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔)을 쓸 수 있어야 하네.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 정말 우리를 돕고 싶다면 발굴품 청소를 좀 해 주게. 거의 다 됐고 마무리 손질만 조금 남았네. 인부들이 가져오는 더미에서 발굴품을 하나 가져가서, 저기 빈 탁자에서

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 청소하면 되네. 흥미로운 게 나오면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 오, 그냥 무해한 순간이동 주문인 것 같네. 고고학을 안 할 땐 마법을 좀 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 더 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있네. 그 옛날에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍군.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠...여러 정황으로 보아 우리 동쪽 어딘가인 것 같은데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠네. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었는지도. 좀 더 자세히 보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고 fire runes(화염 룬) 다섯 개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 한 개로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거죠.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 그래, 바로 그거네. 잘했네, 젊은이. 도와줘서 고맙네.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 닦았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 오 이런! 정말 훌륭한 발견이야! 이게 내 생각대로라면 Dig Site(발굴지) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠네.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여길 보게, 도시 이름도 적혀 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! 사라도민파가 점령하던 시기의 것이 틀림없네. 정말 훌륭한 발견이야. 이걸 가져가서 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 이미 하나 보여 줬잖나. 그때 게 상태가 더 좋았지. 저기 진열장에 있네. 이건 저 구석에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두면 되네.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 동전을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이거 아주 흥미로우면서도 동시에 헷갈리는군... 이 동전은 우리가 Digsite(발굴지)에서 발굴 중인 도시 Saranthium(사란시움)에 훨씬, 훨씬 이전에 Zamorak(자모락) 추종자들이 살았다는 뜻이네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 그 당시 그 도시는 Senntisten(센티스텐)이라고 불렸지.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견이야. 사라도민파가 장악하기 전에 자로스파가 살았다는 다른 증거는 있지만, 자모락파 세력도 어떤 전투를 치르며

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 이 도시를 이용한 것 같네. 그래도 이걸로 이 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 Zamorak(자모락)을 따르다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르게 된 시기를 대략 알 수 있겠어. display case(진열장) 44번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 display case(진열장) 44번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 부서질 것 같은 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아아... 제단 장식물 같군. 흠, 그래...보아하니 초기 사라도민파 신도들의 것이야. 꽤 섬세하기도 하고. display case(진열장) 37번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 display case(진열장) 37번에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않은가? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이군. 틀림없이 사라도민파 도시의 것이야. display case(진열장) 36번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 display case(진열장) 36번에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 pottery(도자기) 조각을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 아아... 오! 흠...그래...보아하니 자로스 숭배자들이 만들었군. 모양이 아름다워. display case(진열장) 22번에 잘 어울리겠네. 이 조각은 이 도시에 사라도민파보다 먼저

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 자로스파가 살았다는 우리 증거를 뒷받침해 주네.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? pottery(도자기)는 display case(진열장) 22번에 넣었나?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오네. 중요한 건 아니야. 이미 전시품에도 몇 개 있지. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 상자에 이미 뭔가 들어 있으면 일한 보상으로 가져가도 좋네.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 흥미로운 발견이군... 자, 보답으로 이걸 주겠네.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병이라... 몇 개나 찾았는지 셀 수도 없네... 완전히 멀쩡한 건 이미 진열장에 하나 있지. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 애초에 가진 적도 없는 것 같구먼, [lad/lass]!

english: No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Are you interested in buying or selling spice?
No thanks.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 당신이 내 물건을 훔쳐 간 사람이군요!

english: Guards guards!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
translation: 아닐 거예요... 제가 좀 흔한 얼굴이라서요.

english: You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 지금 좀 바빠요. 보석 장을 정리해야 하거든요.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 절대 안 돼요! 내 보석 근처에 오지 말아요.

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 내 집 같은 집을 사는 데 관심 있어요?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 이런, 내 정신 좀 봐! 당신도 우리 같은 부자인 줄 알았네요.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 아뇨, 나리, 저는 도둑이에요. 남의 집을 털죠.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
translation: 흠... 내 생각엔 백과사전 외판원 같은데요?

english: Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 전혀 아니에요. 그냥 이 집을 싹 털고 싶을 뿐이에요. 정말로요.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I love the fresh air outside, don't you?
It is quite nice out here.
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 산책하기 딱 좋은 날이죠, 안 그래요?

english: It is!
I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 왠지 집에 돌아가 봐야 할 것 같은 기분이 드네요.

english: You don't say...
I do love being rich! I can take leisurely strolls whenever I want, without a care in the world!
translation: 부자인 게 정말 좋아요! 아무 걱정 없이 원할 때마다 느긋하게 산책할 수 있으니까요!

english: Enjoy it! Take as much time as you want!
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 내가 얼마나 부자인지 확인하러 가 볼까!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 집주인이 문을 잠가서 당신은 집 밖으로 쫓겨났다.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 밖에서 누군가 집주인이 돌아온다고 외치는 소리가 들린다!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
Who are you? What are you after?
Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef... Could you cook me something?
translation: 요리사이신가 봐요... 저한테 뭐 좀 요리해 주실 수 있어요?

english: I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknownas one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.
translation: 그러고 싶지만 아주 바빠요. 특별하고 독창적인 생선 샐러드를 만들어서 세계 최고의 요리사로서 명성을 높이려는 중이거든요.

english: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?
translation: Caleb(케일럽)! 모험가로서 무엇이든 도울 준비가 되어 있어요... 또다시요! 뭘 도와 드릴까요?

english: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.
translation: 당신은 이번엔 부잣집 가문이 어떤 보상을 줄지 잠시 공상에 잠긴다.

english: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?
translation: ... 그때 부러진 램프 막대를 발견한 거예요. 조사하는 걸 좀 도와줄 수 있을까요?

english: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.
translation: 죄송해요, 잘 못 들었어요. 정신이 좀... 딴 데 가 있어서요.

english: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!
translation: 문제를 들을 생각이 없다면 됐어요, 신경 쓰지 마요. 노련한 요리사가 혼자 해결 못 할 일은 없으니까요!

english: I'm sorry! Please let me help.
translation: 죄송해요! 제발 도와 드리게 해 주세요.

english: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!
translation: 아니요! 내 인생의 모든 문제를 모험가가 와서 해결해 줄 필요는 없어요. 난 행복하고 다른 문제도 없어요!

english: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...
translation: 알겠어요, 다른 형제분들한테 필요한 게 있는지 가 볼게요...

english: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.
translation: 다가올지도 모를 큰 보상의 달콤한 향기가 살짝 옅어진다.

english: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?
translation: 정말 제가 할 일이 없어요? 요리사라면 부엌에서 도움은 늘 필요하잖아요?

english: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.
translation: 난 아주 유능한 요리사예요! 당신 도움은 필요 없어요, [player name]. 그냥 내버려 둬요.

english: I hear you have brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
translation: 완성된 가문의 문장을 아버지께 가져다드렸다고 들었어요. 솔직히 정말 대단한 일이었어요.

english: It was easy really.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 네, 뭐... 제가 도와 드릴 일이 있나요?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿을 바꿔 줄 수 있어요?

english: Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions.
translation: 당신 건틀릿은 이미 내 물약으로 처리했어요.

english: You don't have any gauntlets I can imbue.
Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
Oh, right.
Great thanks!
Caleb takes the gauntlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you.
translation: Caleb(케일럽)이 당신에게서 건틀릿을 받아 약초와 양념을 뿌리고, range(레인지)에서 잠깐 구운 뒤 돌려준다.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 아버지께서 당신이 또 우리를 도와줬다고 전해 주셨어요! 어차피 도와줄 때까지 포기할 생각이 없었던 것 같지만요.

english: As thanks, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Cooking gauntlets as you wish.
translation: 감사의 뜻으로 Cooking gauntlets(요리 건틀릿)을 원하는 만큼 드릴게요.

english: You will find the rate you burn certain foods is much reduced whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 이 건틀릿을 끼고 있으면 특정 음식을 태우는 확률이 훨씬 줄어들 거예요.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Nothing, I will be on my way.
I see you are a chef, will you cook me anything?
translation: 요리사이신가 봐요, 저한테 뭐 요리해 주실래요?

english: Family Pest
Gauntlets
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿을 바꿔 줄 수 있어요?

english: Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Cooking gauntlets?
translation: Cooking gauntlets(요리 건틀릿) 한 켤레 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You're welcome.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 앗, Hero(영웅)님이다! 와! 정말 대단해요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 상대한 거예요? 마을도 멋져졌어요. 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Calin, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 저는 Calin(칼린)이에요. 이 불 옆에서 몸을 녹이고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
translation: 요즘 이 근처에 무슨 일 있어요?

english: Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있어요. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 기르면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 유용해요. 다들 당신에게 무척 고마워하고 있어요. 저는 영웅을 실제로 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만,

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들 눈에는 당신이 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
translation: 요즘 이 근처에 무슨 일 있어요?

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Can I help you?
What do you do here?
I'm just mining... Problem is, it's a struggle to get past all these fossil looking things.
translation: 그냥 채굴 중이야... 문제는 이 화석 같은 것들 때문에 뚫고 지나가기가 힘들다는 거지.

english: Can I help?
The others wouldn't like it if a human got involved... You lot tend to take too much from the rocks.
translation: 인간이 끼어들면 다른 녀석들이 싫어할 거야... 너희는 바위에서 너무 많이 가져가는 경향이 있거든.

english: But what if I were to sort out these fossil things you mentioned?
translation: 그 화석 같은 걸 제가 처리하면 어때요?

english: Hmm... I shouldn't... And yet...
Okay, I'll tell you what... If you mine through these calcified deposits, you can keep whatever you get from them.
translation: 좋아, 이렇게 하자... 이 석회화된 퇴적물을 캐서 뚫으면, 거기서 나온 건 네가 가져도 돼.

english: Are you sure?
Yeah, why not. I'm tired of getting sprayed with all the water that leaks from these walls anyway. Not to mention it just brings out lots of extra useless bits with it!
translation: 그래, 안 될 거 없지. 어차피 벽에서 새어 나오는 물 맞는 것도 지겨워. 게다가 쓸모없는 잡동사니까지 잔뜩 같이 딸려 나온다니까!

english: So the water makes the walls even more lucrative?
translation: 그러니까 물 덕분에 벽이 더 짭짤해진다는 거죠?

english: If you consider pointless fossils lucrative, then I suppose.
translation: 쓸모없는 화석이 짭짤하다고 생각한다면, 뭐 그렇겠지.

english: I see. I'll get to work then! See what I can do to help.
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 일하러 가 볼게요! 제가 뭘 도울 수 있는지 볼게요.

english: What are these weird chippings?
Bone shards! Totally pointless if you ask me, but I hear the humans up atop the mountain quite like them.
translation: 뼈 조각이야! 내가 보기엔 완전히 쓸모없지만, 산 꼭대기에 사는 인간들은 꽤 좋아한다더라.

english: Apparently they offer them up as some sort of sacrifice, but I'm not too sure on the specifics. It's not like I ever go up there myself.
translation: 듣자 하니 무슨 제물로 바친다던데, 자세한 건 잘 몰라. 나는 거기 올라가 본 적도 없거든.

english: Thanks!
Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: 이 바위 덩어리 좀 봐 줄래요?

english: That's quite the chunk indeed. It looks to be a big mass of calcified rock.
translation: 정말 큰 덩어리네. 석회화된 바위가 크게 뭉친 것 같아.

english: I reckon you'll be able to break it up on an anvil. Perhaps there might be something interesting inside...
translation: anvil(모루)에서 깨부술 수 있을 거야. 안에 뭔가 흥미로운 게 들어 있을지도 모르지...

english: Thanks! I'll go smash it open.
Smashing!
I found this weird moth.
Strange... I've never seen one of those before. That's quite the find.
translation: 이상하네... 그런 건 처음 봐. 대단한 걸 찾았는걸.

english: Of all the creatures to find stuck in a wall, I didn't expect a moth.
translation: 벽에 박혀 있는 생물 중에 나방이 나올 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Moths carry a lot of magical power within this mountain. You can probably crush it to consume whatever power is left inside.
translation: 이 산에서는 나방이 엄청난 마력을 품고 있어. 아마 으깨면 안에 남은 힘을 흡수할 수 있을 거야.

english: Is that safe?
Only one way to find out!
No, thanks.
I'd better get going.
What do you do here?
What are these weird chippings?
Can you have a look at this chunk of rock?
translation: 이 바위 덩어리 좀 봐 줄래요?

english: I found this weird moth.
No, thanks.
I'd better get going.
Why the grizzly face?
You're not funny...
You should get in the.... sun more.
translation: 너 좀 더... 곰살맞게 굴어 봐.

english: You're really not funny...
One second, let me take a picture of you with my.... kodiak camera.
translation: 잠깐, 네 모습을 사진에... 웅~담아 둘게.

english: Feeling.... blue.
If you don't stop, I'm going to leave some... brown... at your feet, human.
translation: 계속 그러면 네 발밑에... 갈색... 선물을 남겨 줄 거다, 인간.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 미안한데요, 혹시 dung(똥)을 조금만 나눠 줄 수 있어요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 썩 마음에 들지 않은 모양이다.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 옆에 갔다간 손을 물어뜯기고 말 거야.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 kebab(케밥)을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 일단 눈부터 감아. 누가 보고 있으면 난 안 해!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What was that?
Nothing important.
The weather's really hot, don't you think?
Not hot for camels, surely?
Are you joking? It's burning hot out here! Sitting by the oasis is the only way to stay cool.
translation: 농담하는 거야? 여기 완전 불타는 것 같다고! 오아시스 옆에 앉아 있는 게 시원하게 지내는 유일한 방법이야.

english: I thought camels carried their own water in their humps.
translation: 낙타는 혹 속에 물을 담고 다니는 줄 알았는데요.

english: It's never enough. And it's always far too hot to go anywhere in the desert.
translation: 그걸로는 절대 모자라. 게다가 사막은 늘 너무 더워서 어디 갈 엄두도 안 나.

english: Sometimes I wish I could go travelling in cooler places, like all those adventurers I see passing through here.
translation: 가끔은 여기를 지나가는 모험가들처럼 시원한 곳으로 여행을 가 봤으면 좋겠어.

english: Well, adventuring's thirsty work as well.
Oh, that's a pity.
In that case, I'll just stay by this nice cool oasis.
translation: 그렇다면 난 그냥 이 시원한 오아시스 옆에 있을래.

english: *makes camel noises*
*makes happier camel noises*
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 보상을 받았어요: [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 저는 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: Welcome my friend to the Old Nite! What can I do for you?
translation: Old Nite(올드 나이트)에 온 걸 환영해요, 친구! 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Got anything strong to drink?
Of course I do! I can offer you a big tasty beer, yours for only two coins.
translation: 물론이죠! 크고 맛있는 beer(맥주)가 있는데, 단돈 2코인이에요.

english: Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
No worries, there's a bank just around the corner if you want to grab some coin.
translation: 걱정 마요, 바로 모퉁이만 돌면 bank(은행)이 있으니 돈 좀 찾아와요.

english: Sure, I'll take a beer.
Your pub looks a bit rough.
It's all part of the aesthetic! Adventurers who've just returned from the fight of their lives don't want a fancy la-de-da establishment like you'd find down south.
translation: 이게 다 분위기라는 거예요! 목숨 걸고 싸우다 막 돌아온 모험가들은 남쪽에 있는 그런 고상한 척하는 가게를 원하지 않거든요.

english: They want somewhere to relax and have some hearty ale.
translation: 편히 쉬면서 든든한 에일 한 잔 할 곳을 원하죠.

english: And that's what you offer with your broken tables and glass covered floors?
translation: 그래서 부서진 탁자에 유리 조각 깔린 바닥을 내놓는 거예요?

english: Aye it is, because here at the Old Nite, your safety is our lowest priority!
translation: 그렇다니까요. 여기 Old Nite(올드 나이트)에서는 손님 안전이 가장 뒷전이거든요!

english: Just browsing...
Got anything strong to drink?
Your pub looks a bit rough.
Just browsing...
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 미안한데요, 혹시 dung(똥)을 조금만 나눠 줄 수 있어요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 썩 마음에 들지 않은 모양이다.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 kebab(케밥)을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 옆에 갔다간 손을 물어뜯기고 말 거야.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 낙타가 당신의 발을 밟으려 하지만, 당신은 재빨리 발을 뺀다.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 낙타가 당신에게 침을 뱉고, 당신은 황급히 뒤로 물러난다.

english: Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 일단 눈부터 감아. 누가 보고 있으면 난 안 해!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
How can you say such cruel things?
translation: 어떻게 그런 잔인한 말을 할 수 있어?

english: Yeah? Well, your mother was a jackal!
Hey! Be kinder to your four-legged neighbours.
translation: 야! 네 발 달린 이웃한테 좀 친절하게 대해.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 저는 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: I've heard about all the things you did for us!
translation: 당신이 우리를 위해 해 준 일들 다 들었어요!

english: I was happy to help.
And I'm happy that you helped us! Maybe now this place can be a bit more cheerful again!
translation: 저도 당신이 도와줘서 기뻐요! 이제 이곳도 다시 좀 밝아질지 모르겠네요!

english: I'd rather be left alone, outerlander.
Hello!
Hello.
Nice place you have here!
It is indeed.
Nice day, isn't it?
Yes.
Hi! Would you be interested in some of my fine candles?
translation: 안녕하세요! 제가 만든 좋은 candles(양초) 좀 보실래요?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Here, have this.
Yes Please.
No thank you.
Do you want a lit candle for 1000 gold?
Yes please.
But I don't have that kind of money on me.
Well then, no candle for you!
Here you go then.
I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there. You'd be better off making a lantern.
translation: 그런데 경고 하나 하지. 저 아래로 불꽃이 드러난 불을 들고 내려가는 건 위험할 수 있어. lantern(랜턴)을 만드는 게 나을 거야.

english: What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
Heh heh... You'll find out.
translation: 헤헤... 가 보면 알게 될 거야.

english: Thanks, bye.
One thousand gold?!
Look, you're not going to be able to survive down that hole without a light source.
translation: 이봐, 빛을 낼 만한 게 없으면 저 구멍 아래에선 살아남지 못해.

english: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply. You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.
translation: 그러니까 candle shop(양초 가게)에 가서 더 싸게 하나 살 수도 있지. 아니면 직접 랜턴을 만들 수도 있고. 그게 훨씬 낫긴 해.

english: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you? And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!
translation: 하지만 지금 당장 저 아래에 뭐가 있는지 알고 싶잖아, 안 그래? 그러니 그 값으로 나한테 1000골드만 내면 되는 거지!

english: All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
No way.
How do you make lanterns?
Out of glass.The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.
translation: 유리로 만들지. 더 고급 랜턴에는 금속 부품도 들어가고.

english: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.
translation: 먼저 유리로 간단한 candle lantern(양초 랜턴)을 만들 수 있어. 양초랑 똑같은데 불꽃이 드러나 있지 않아서 더 안전하지.

english: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.
translation: 다음으로 oil lamp(기름 램프)를 만들 수 있는데, 더 밝지만 불꽃이 드러나 있어. 그래도 철로 틀을 만들어 주면 oil lantern(기름 랜턴)으로 바꿀 수 있지.

english: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.
translation: 마지막으로 bullseye lantern(집광 랜턴)이 있어. 강철로 틀을 만들고 유리 렌즈를 달아야 해.

english: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.
translation: 램프나 랜턴을 만들었으면 거기 넣을 램프 기름도 만들어야 해. Rimmington(림밍턴) 근처에 있는 chemist(화학자)한테 그걸 만드는 기계가 있어.

english: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it. Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!
translation: 어떤 조명이든 불을 붙이려면 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)이 필요해. 불이 꺼질 때를 대비해서 부싯깃 통은 늘 가까이 챙겨 둬!

english: But if all that's too complicated, you can buy a candle right here for 1000 gold!
translation: 하지만 그게 다 너무 복잡하면, 여기서 1000골드에 양초를 사면 돼!

english: No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
Yes please.
What's so dangerous about a naked flame?
How do you make lanterns?
Thanks, bye.
One thousand gold?!
All right, you win, I'll buy a candle.
No way.
No thanks, I'd rather curse the darkness.
Player: Hello there.
Darling, who's this?
I don't know, darling. Why don't you ask them?
Yes, good idea!
Who are you?
I'm [Vampyre name].
Hello, [Vampyre name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.
translation: 반가워요, [Vampyre name] 님. 저는 Caninelle Draynar(카니넬 드레이나르)이고, 이쪽은 Pipistrelle Draynar(피피스트렐 드레이나르)예요.

english: Hello there!
Draynar? Any connection to Draynor?
Oh yes. The Draynar family has been around since before vampyres came to this world.
translation: 물론이죠. Draynar(드레이나르) 가문은 vampyres(뱀파이어)가 이 세계에 오기 전부터 있었답니다.

english: Over time, some people took the name and started pronouncing it differently. Hence Draynor.
translation: 세월이 흐르면서 어떤 이들이 그 이름을 가져다 다르게 발음하기 시작했죠. 그래서 Draynor(드레이너)가 된 거예요.

english: Draynor is more commonly used as a first name though, with Draynar as a last name.
translation: 하지만 Draynor(드레이너)는 주로 이름으로 쓰이고, Draynar(드레이나르)는 성으로 쓰이죠.

english: Thanks for the information. I wonder if there's a Draynor Draynar out there.
translation: 알려 주셔서 고마워요. 어딘가에 Draynor Draynar(드레이너 드레이나르)라는 사람도 있을까요?

english: Now that would be funny.
See you around.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병을 부르기 전에 당장 노예 우리로 돌아가라!

english: Arrr, what do ye want?
What are you doing here?
Arrr, it be a sad tale. I used to sail the seven seas, a- lootin' and a-plunderin' whatever took my fancy.
translation: 아르르, 슬픈 얘기지. 난 한때 일곱 바다를 누비며 눈에 띄는 건 죄다 털고 약탈했었어.

english: Then I got a conscience, so I stopped being a pirate, and travelled the world giving back some of the loot I'd taken.
translation: 그러다 양심이 생겨서 해적질을 그만두고, 훔친 물건을 좀 돌려주며 세상을 떠돌았지.

english: Seems people didn't appreciate me interruptin' their business to give 'em free stuff, so now I'm locked up for harassment.
translation: 그런데 장사하는 데 끼어들어서 공짜로 물건을 준다니까 사람들이 영 반기질 않더군. 그래서 지금은 괴롭힘죄로 갇혀 있는 거야.

english: Oh, I see.
Nothing, thanks.
Nothing, eh? Nothing be all I got, anyway.
translation: 아무것도 아니라고? 어차피 나한테 남은 것도 아무것도 없어.

english: What are you doing here?
Nothing, thanks.
Ahoy Cap'n!
Ahoy there!
Avast ye scurvy swabs!
translation: 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 갑판 청소부들아!

english: Huh?
Don't mind me parrot, he's Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup!
translation: 내 parrot(앵무새)는 신경 쓰지 마. 저놈은 금 간 찻잔처럼 머리에 금이 갔거든!

english: What is this place?
This, me hearty, is the entrance to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: 이보게 친구, 여기가 바로 Brimhaven Agility Arena(브림헤이븐 민첩 경기장)의 입구야!

english: I were diggin for buried treasure when I found it! Amazed I was! It was a sight to behold!
translation: 묻힌 보물을 파다가 이걸 찾아냈지! 얼마나 놀랐는지! 정말 장관이었어!

english: Buried treasure!
It were the biggest thing I'd ever seen! It must've been at least a league from side to side!
translation: 내 평생 본 것 중에 제일 컸어! 끝에서 끝까지 족히 십 리는 됐을 거야!

english: It made me list, I were that excited!
translation: 어찌나 흥분했던지 몸이 배처럼 한쪽으로 기우뚱 기울더라니까!

english: Get on with it!
I'd found a huge cave with all these platforms. I reckon it be an ancient civilisation that made it. I had to be mighty careful as there was these traps everywhere! Dangerous it was!
translation: 발판이 잔뜩 있는 거대한 동굴을 찾은 거야. 아마 고대 문명이 만든 거겠지. 사방에 함정이 깔려 있어서 엄청 조심해야 했어! 아주 위험했지!

english: Danger! Danger!
Entrance is only 200 coins!
What do I do in the arena?
Well, me hearty, it's simple. Ye can cross between two platforms by using the traps or obstacles strung across 'em. Try and make your way to the pillar that is indicated by the flashing arrow.
translation: 간단해, 친구. 두 발판 사이에 걸쳐 있는 함정이나 장애물을 이용해서 건너가면 돼. 깜빡이는 화살표가 가리키는 기둥까지 가 보라고.

english: Ye receive tickets for tagging more than one pillar in a row. So ye won't get a ticket from the first pillar but ye will for every platform ye tag in a row after that.
translation: 기둥을 연달아 두 개 이상 찍으면 티켓을 받아. 그러니까 첫 번째 기둥에선 티켓을 못 받지만, 그다음부터 연달아 찍는 발판마다 티켓을 받는 거지.

english: If ye miss a platform ye will miss out on the next ticket so try and get every platform you can! When ye be done, take the tickets to Jackie over there and she'll exchange them for more stuff!
translation: 발판 하나를 놓치면 다음 티켓도 놓치니까 최대한 모든 발판을 찍어 봐! 다 끝나면 저기 있는 Jackie(재키)한테 티켓을 가져가. 다른 물건으로 바꿔 줄 거야!

english: Tag when green light means tickets! Tag when red light means green light!
translation: 초록불일 때 찍으면 티켓! 빨간불일 때 찍으면 초록불!

english: Thanks!
I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
Aye, entrance be 200 coins.
Pieces of eight!
A word of warning me hearty! There are dangerous traps down there!
translation: 경고 하나 하지, 친구! 저 아래엔 위험한 함정들이 있어!

english: I don't have the money on me at the moment.
*squawk*
No coins, no entrance!
Okay, here's 200 coins.
You hand Cap'n Izzy 200 coins.
May the wind be in ye sails!
Never mind.
Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Skillcape of Agility(민첩 스킬 망토)에 대해 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Aye, to be sure! The Skillcape of Agility be the symbol of the master of dexterity! Providing weight reduction, one who wears it can climb like a cat, run like the wind and jump like...err, well, jump like a jumping thing!
translation: 그럼, 물론이지! Skillcape of Agility(민첩 스킬 망토)는 날렵함의 달인이라는 상징이야! 무게를 줄여 줘서, 이걸 걸친 사람은 고양이처럼 기어오르고, 바람처럼 달리고, 또... 어, 그러니까, 뛰는 뭔가처럼 뛸 수 있지!

english: Now, be there anything else ye'd like to know?
translation: 자, 또 알고 싶은 거 있어?

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Skillcape of Agility(민첩 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, having it equipped reduces your weight and I think it will really suit you. All that remains to be done is pay me 99000 gold!
translation: 물론이지, 이걸 장착하면 무게가 줄어들고, 너한테 정말 잘 어울릴 것 같아. 이제 나한테 99000골드만 내면 돼!

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
So sad, too bad. Go and pickpocket some wealthy people and come back here once you're richer.
translation: 안됐네, 아쉽게 됐어. 가서 부자들 주머니나 좀 털고 돈 좀 모이면 다시 와.

english: Certainly, here you go.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 무료 hood(두건)과 함께만 팔아. 스킬 판촉 행사라서 말이지, 하나 사면 하나 공짜인 거 알지? 그러니 하나 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 와.

english: Excellent! That cape really does suit you.
translation: 훌륭해! 그 망토 정말 잘 어울리는군.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 제 망토에 맞는 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Cap'n Izzy No-Beard hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Cap'n Izzy No-Beard(턱수염 없는 이지 선장)이 스킬 망토용 두건을 하나 더 건네준다.

english: See you later.
Can I help you with something?
Well, I'm here about a treasure trail...
translation: 음, treasure trail(보물 찾기) 때문에 왔는데요...

english: Ah, you'll be wanting to talk to him then.
translation: 아, 그럼 저 녀석이랑 얘기해야 할 거야.

english: Him?
Avast!
Answer this and I'll give you treasure!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Try again! Try again!
Squawk! Pieces of eight!
What is this place?
What do I do in the arena?
I'd like to use the Agility Arena, please.
Okay, here's 200 coins.
Never mind.
Can you tell me a bit about the Skillcape of Agility, please?
translation: Skillcape of Agility(민첩 스킬 망토)에 대해 좀 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Is it true you sell Skillcapes of Agility?
translation: Skillcapes of Agility(민첩 스킬 망토)를 판다는 게 사실인가요?

english: I'm afraid I can't afford that.
Certainly, here you go.
Skillcape
Hood
See you later.
[Ah, hello there, laddie/Ah, hello there, lassie/Ah, hello there]! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: [Ah, hello there, laddie/Ah, hello there, lassie/Ah, hello there]! 내 오래된 보물 상자를 방금 파냈다네.

english: Problem is, these old hands o'mine aren't as useful as they used t'be, and the lock on that chest is a little bit too fiddly for ol' Cap'n Arnav. Could you help me out?
translation: 문제는 이 늙은 손이 예전 같지 않아서, 저 상자 자물쇠가 이 늙은 Cap'n Arnav(아르나브 선장)한테는 좀 너무 까다롭다는 걸세. 좀 도와주겠나?

english: Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
There are three columns. What you need to do for me is to match up each picture with the word underneath the column, and then unlock the chest.
translation: 세로줄이 세 개 있네. 각 그림을 세로줄 아래 적힌 단어와 맞춘 다음 상자를 열어 주면 되네.

english: No, sorry.
Ah, well done matey, that's the right combination. Here, have a little somethin' for helpin' me out.
translation: 아, 잘했네, 친구. 그게 맞는 조합일세. 자, 도와준 답례로 작은 선물 하나 받게나.

english: Arrr! That be nowhere near close! Did ye not listen the first time around?
translation: 아르르! 근처에도 못 갔잖아! 처음에 내 말 안 들었나?

english: Sorry, I must have misunderstood your instructions. Could I hear them again please?
translation: 죄송해요, 설명을 잘못 이해했나 봐요. 다시 한번 들려주시겠어요?

english: Right, right. What you need to do is click on the arrows to roll the cylinders round to the different items.
translation: 그래, 그래. 화살표를 눌러서 원통을 돌리면 다른 물건으로 바뀐다네.

english: When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.
translation: 가운데 줄의 물건들이 전부 세로줄 아래 적힌 단어와 맞으면 자물쇠가 풀리는 걸세.

english: Is that a little clearer?
Certainly. Let me try again.
Arrr! I'd better find someone else.
Arrr, I'd better be off.
Arrr, you're not the person I be needin'.
translation: 아르르, 자넨 내가 찾는 사람이 아니군.

english: Avast there, [player name]!
Ahoy, [player name]!
Parley wi' me, my old fruit!
translation: 나랑 얘기 좀 하자고, 내 오랜 친구!

english: I needs yer help, [player name]!
I got treasure here, [player name]!
Shiver me' timbers, are you ignoring me?
translation: 이런 빌어먹을, 지금 날 무시하는 건가?

english: Will ye help an old pirate, [player name]?
I knows somethin' you should knows, [player name].
translation: 자네가 알아야 할 걸 내가 알고 있다네, [player name].

english: Maybe later.
Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
No, sorry.
What do you want, civilian?
What are you doing?
What does it look like I'm doing? I'm training this useless bunch of recruits!
translation: 보면 모르나? 이 쓸모없는 신병 놈들을 훈련시키는 중이다!

english: Oh yes, they look very fit.
translation: 아, 네, 다들 아주 튼튼해 보이네요.

english: They're nothing but a useless bunch of weaklings who won't survive an hour once they're out on patrol.
translation: 저놈들은 순찰 나가면 한 시간도 못 버틸 쓸모없는 약골 무리일 뿐이다.

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked fit! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: 정신 나갔나? 아까는 튼튼해 보인다며! 그냥 꺼지고 날 내버려 둬.

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
translation: 아, 네, 다들 아주 약해 보이네요.

english: Show some respect when you talk about my men, civilian!
translation: 내 부하들 얘기할 땐 예의를 갖춰라, 민간인!

english: Have you lost your mind? Earlier you said they looked weak! Just go away and leave me alone.
translation: 정신 나갔나? 아까는 약해 보인다며! 그냥 꺼지고 날 내버려 둬.

english: Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: 저도 당신 것 같은 갑옷을 가질 수 있을까요?

english: Only guards of Varrock can wear this armour.
translation: 이 갑옷은 Varrock(바록)의 경비병만 입을 수 있다.

english: Well, I could become a guard of Varrock.
translation: 음, 제가 Varrock(바록)의 경비병이 될 수도 있잖아요.

english: Oh yeah? I see you've got a Thieving level of [thieving level]. That must give you quite a long criminal record.
translation: 그래? 보아하니 Thieving(도둑질) 레벨이 [thieving level]이군. 전과 기록이 꽤 길겠어.

english: I could repent of my evil ways if you like.
translation: 원하시면 제 악행을 뉘우칠 수도 있어요.

english: So you really want to be a guard, huh?
translation: 그래서 정말 경비병이 되고 싶다, 이건가?

english: Yes, that's right.
Does it worry you that the life expectancy of a guard is about 30 seconds?
translation: 경비병의 기대 수명이 30초쯤이라는 게 걱정되지 않나?

english: No, that doesn't worry me.
Bah! You just failed the intelligence test. Go away, civilian.
translation: 흥! 방금 지능 테스트에서 떨어졌다. 꺼져라, 민간인.

english: Actually, forget it.
Go away, coward.
I want nothing.
Lucky you. Go away.
Make those dummies suffer!
Imagine it's your aunt!
You won't last 2 minutes in the real world!
Show some backbone!
Let's get some proper bloodlust here!
translation: 제대로 피 끓는 투지를 보여 봐!

english: Bah, why do I bother with you lot?
translation: 흥, 내가 왜 너희 같은 놈들한테 공을 들이는지 모르겠군.

english: Just hit the thing already!
Hit the dummy! Hit the dummy!
Useless! Utterly useless!
Hit the dummy before I come over there and hit you!
translation: 내가 거기 가서 너를 치기 전에 허수아비를 쳐라!

english: What are you doing?
Oh yes, they look very fit.
translation: 아, 네, 다들 아주 튼튼해 보이네요.

english: Can I have some armour like yours?
translation: 저도 당신 것 같은 갑옷을 가질 수 있을까요?

english: Oh yes, they look very weak.
translation: 아, 네, 다들 아주 약해 보이네요.

english: No, that doesn't worry me.
Actually, forget it.
I want nothing.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: 안녕하세요. 어디로 여행 가시겠어요? 30코인에 Rimmington(림밍턴)이나 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)으로 모셔다드릴 수 있어요.

english: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
Come back when you've got 30 coins for me.
I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
I'm good thanks.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Ardougne or Brimhaven for 30 coins.
translation: 안녕하세요. 어디로 여행 가시겠어요? 30코인에 Ardougne(아르둔)이나 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)으로 모셔다드릴 수 있어요.

english: I'd like to go to Ardougne.
Hello there. Would you like to travel somewhere? I can take you to Rimmington or Ardougne for 30 coins.
translation: 안녕하세요. 어디로 여행 가시겠어요? 30코인에 Rimmington(림밍턴)이나 Ardougne(아르둔)으로 모셔다드릴 수 있어요.

english: I'd like to go to Rimmington.
I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
I'm good thanks.
I'd like to go to Ardougne.
Can we head to Lunar Isle?
translation: Lunar Isle(루나 섬)으로 갈 수 있을까요?

english: Sure matey!
Hi.
And you're wanting what now?
Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
I'll take you as far as Pirates' Cove. You'll have to find the rest of the way back yourself.
translation: Pirates' Cove(해적의 만)까지는 데려다주겠네. 나머지 길은 자네가 알아서 찾아가야 하네.

english: So we're here?
Yep. You're free to explore the island. Be careful though, the Moon Clan are very powerful, it wouldn't be wise to wrong them.
translation: 그렇다네. 섬은 마음껏 둘러보게. 하지만 조심하게나. Moon Clan(달 부족)은 아주 강력해서 그들에게 밉보이는 건 현명하지 못한 일일세.

english: Thanks, I'll keep that seal of passage close.
translation: 고마워요, seal of passage(통행의 인장)은 꼭 지니고 있을게요.

english: Aye-aye cap'n!
Hmmmm? I don't recognise you as one of my men, what are you doing aboard my ship?
translation: 흐으음? 내 선원으로는 못 보던 얼굴인데, 내 배에서 뭘 하고 있는 겐가?

english: Stowaway! Stowaway! *Squark*
Oh, Lokar offered me a journey. He said you could take me to the island of the Moon Clan.
translation: 아, Lokar(로카르)가 여행을 제안했어요. 선장님이 저를 Moon Clan(달 부족)의 섬으로 데려다주실 수 있을 거라고 하더라고요.

english: Oh he DID, did he? (sigh) I sometimes regret ever allowing that vagabond to join the crew.
translation: 오, 그 녀석이 그랬단 말이지? (한숨) 그 부랑자를 선원으로 받아들인 게 가끔 후회된다네.

english: He has a very bad work ethic, and I have to say his attitude can be very confrontational.
translation: 일하는 태도가 아주 엉망인 데다, 솔직히 말해 툭하면 시비조로 나온다네.

english: Lokar's a loser! *Brakawk*!
So... You won't take me to Lunar Isle?
translation: 그럼... Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에는 안 데려다주시는 건가요?

english: Well now, I didn't say that.
We are returning there again soon anyway, as our last visit was most profitable.
translation: 어차피 곧 그곳으로 돌아갈 참이었네. 지난번에 들렀을 때 꽤 짭짤했거든.

english: In fact as soon as our boys are finished loading stocks we should be ready to depart!
translation: 사실 우리 애들이 보급품 싣는 것만 끝내면 바로 출항할 수 있을 걸세!

english: Now, as captain of this ship I feel I must play host, even if you aren't exactly a welcome guest, so was there anything you wished to know?
translation: 자, 이 배의 선장으로서 주인 노릇은 해야겠지. 자네가 딱히 반가운 손님은 아니지만 말일세. 그래, 뭐 알고 싶은 거라도 있나?

english: So... What can you tell me about this 'Moon Clan'? It all seems very mysterious I must say...
translation: 그럼... 이 'Moon Clan(달 부족)'에 대해 뭘 알려주실 수 있나요? 정말 수수께끼 같은 곳이네요...

english: The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.
translation: Moon Clan(달 부족) 말인가? 오, 아주 훌륭한 사람들이지. 손님 대접도 극진하고.

english: We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.
translation: 낯선 이를 몹시 경계하고 불쑥 섬에 찾아오는 걸 싫어한다고 들었네만, 우리가 상륙대를 보냈더니 다들 우리를 보고 무척 반가워하는 눈치였지.

english: Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!
translation: 글쎄, 우리를 위해 성대한 축제까지 열어 주더군!

english: Anyway, they had a large supply of items that we felt we could use on the high seas, so we made a few trades with them, and were on our way.
translation: 아무튼 그들에게 우리가 바다에서 쓸 만한 물건이 잔뜩 있어서, 몇 가지 거래를 하고 떠났다네.

english: What kinds of items?
Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.
translation: 자네가 그들에 대해 얼마나 들었는지는 모르겠네만, 그들은 마법의 달인들일세.

english: They sold us many rune-stones, as well as a few good luck charms and talismans and such to help us on our voyage.
translation: 룬석을 잔뜩 팔았고, 항해에 도움이 될 행운의 부적이며 탈리스만 같은 것도 몇 개 팔더군.

english: Yes, they might have been a little secretive about that strange temple, and the old lodge of theirs in town, and I must say they certainly have the strangest house I have ever seen in my life in their little village, but it was
translation: 그래, 그 기묘한 신전이나 마을의 오래된 오두막에 대해서는 좀 비밀스러웠던 것 같고, 그 작은 마을에 있는 집은 내 평생 본 것 중 가장 이상한 집이었지만, 그래도

english: a pleasant trip all round, and I look forward to trading there again in the future.
translation: 전체적으로 즐거운 여행이었고, 앞으로 또 그곳에서 거래하기를 고대하고 있다네.

english: After all, it's not everywhere that a pirate captain and his crew can rest ashore without having to worry about the authorities catching them, is it?
translation: 무엇보다 해적 선장과 선원들이 관헌에게 잡힐 걱정 없이 뭍에서 쉴 수 있는 곳이 어디 흔하겠나?

english: Fight the law! *Squawk*
No, I guess it isn't.
Was there anything else you wished to ask me about while I'm not busy?
translation: 한가한 김에 또 물어보고 싶은 게 있나?

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle anyway? I always thought pirates would be... You know. Out pirating.
translation: 그런데 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서는 뭘 하셨던 거예요? 해적이라면 늘... 그러니까, 해적질하러 다닐 줄 알았는데요.

english: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non-regulated merchants.
translation: 물론 실제 해적질도 우리 일정에서 큰 부분을 차지하네만, 우린 스스로를 '규제받지 않는 상인'이라 여기고 싶다네.

english: What is good plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?
translation: 쓸 데가 없다면 좋은 약탈품이 다 무슨 소용이겠나, 흐으음?

english: Likewise, I am a forward thinking captain, and endeavour to invest much of my plunder back into the ship and its crew, so that we can be a better and more efficient force for theft upon the seas.
translation: 마찬가지로 나는 앞을 내다보는 선장이라, 약탈품의 상당 부분을 배와 선원들에게 재투자하려 애쓰고 있지. 그래야 바다 위에서 한층 뛰어나고 효율적인 도둑질 집단이 될 수 있으니 말일세.

english: So you went to Lunar Isle for supplies?
translation: 그러니까 보급품을 구하러 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에 가셨던 거군요?

english: Well, obviously not initially. Obviously, our first thought was to show up, rob them blind, then take off again with the plunder spilling from our decks.
translation: 아니, 당연히 처음부터 그랬던 건 아니지. 당연히 처음엔 쳐들어가서 그들을 싹 털고, 갑판에서 약탈품이 흘러넘치도록 싣고 떠날 생각이었다네.

english: So what made you change your mind?
Well, firstly there were the monsters.
M-monsters?
Oh yes, hundreds of the things. The island's swarming with them you know.
translation: 오, 그렇고말고. 수백 마리나 되지. 섬에 그놈들이 득실거린다네.

english: Dirty smelly beasts, as big as a wolf! Yes, you'd certainly better be either handy with a blade or quick on your toes if you wanted to spend much time outside of their village with those things around
translation: 더럽고 냄새나는 짐승인데, 크기가 늑대만 하지! 그래, 마을 밖에서 오래 지내고 싶다면 칼을 잘 다루거나 발이 아주 빨라야 할 걸세. 그놈들이 정말

english: everywhere.
*Squawk* Run fer yer lives lads, it's a monster! *Squawk*
So you didn't attack the Moon Clan because you were worried you would yourself be attacked by these monsters trying to make your escape?
translation: 그러니까 탈출하다가 그 괴물들한테 공격당할까 봐 Moon Clan(달 부족)을 공격하지 않으셨다는 거예요?

english: Oh yes, absolutely. That and the next reason.
translation: 오, 그렇고말고. 그리고 다음 이유도 있었지.

english: The next reason?
Yes, the next reason being that the Moon Clan are quite stupendously powerful magicians.
translation: 그래, 다음 이유는 Moon Clan(달 부족)이 엄청나게 강력한 마법사들이라는 걸세.

english: You'll notice it as soon as you look at them, really quite, quite powerful indeed.
translation: 그들을 보기만 해도 바로 알 수 있을 걸세. 정말이지 아주, 아주 강력하다네.

english: As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.
translation: 그들을 보자마자 공격하거나 훔칠 생각이 싹 사라졌지.

english: Which as it turned out was very lucky for us.
translation: 그런데 알고 보니 그게 우리에겐 천만다행이었다네.

english: Bunch of blooming loonies! *Brakawk*
It was?
Oh yes. They can read minds, you see. If we'd shown up there thinking about robbing them they would have just killed us all on the spot.
translation: 오, 그렇다네. 그들은 마음을 읽을 수 있거든. 우리가 털 생각을 품고 나타났다면 그 자리에서 우릴 몰살시켰을 걸세.

english: I did mention that they are extraordinarily powerful magicians, didn't I?
translation: 그들이 어마어마하게 강력한 마법사라고 내가 말했던가?

english: Yes, yes you did.
Ah, I'm glad I did. Because they really, really are. And mind-readers.
translation: 아, 말했다니 다행이군. 정말, 정말로 그렇거든. 게다가 독심술사들이지.

english: Yes, all in all I'm glad we didn't try any funny business in the end after all.
translation: 그래, 결국 수작을 부리지 않은 게 여러모로 다행이었지.

english: Plus there's that other good reason.
translation: 게다가 또 하나 그럴듯한 이유가 있지.

english: That reason being?
Well, when you are a crew of successful pirates, it becomes more and more difficult to ever moor somewhere and spend your loot.
translation: 글쎄, 잘나가는 해적 무리가 되면 어딘가에 배를 대고 전리품을 쓰기가 점점 어려워진다네.

english: People are far too quick to call the guards on a troublemaker nowadays.
translation: 요즘 사람들은 말썽꾼을 보면 너무 쉽게 경비병을 부르거든.

english: So finding a village where people are more than happy to trade with you regardless of who you may have just stolen from and killed.
translation: 그러니 우리가 방금 누구를 털고 죽이고 왔든 상관없이 기꺼이 거래해 주는 마을을 찾았다는 건 말일세.

english: I like that non-judgemental attitude of theirs!
translation: 난 그들의 그 편견 없는 태도가 마음에 든다네!

english: Okay then...
Anything ese you wanted to know before we set sail?
translation: 출항하기 전에 또 알고 싶은 게 있나?

english: I was hoping you could tell me a little bit about your ship. I must say, it's really very impressive.
translation: 선장님 배에 대해 좀 알려주셨으면 해요. 정말 인상적인 배네요.

english: Ah, a connoisseur! Yes, she's name the Lady Zay, and may I say, is one of the finest ships to ever sail the seas!
translation: 아, 안목이 있구먼! 그래, 이 배의 이름은 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)라네. 감히 말하건대 바다를 누빈 배 중 가장 훌륭한 배 중 하나지!

english: It was a steal from the Karamjan shipyards.
And when I say it was a steal, I mean to say that myself and some of the lads broke in and stole it one night.
translation: 거저 얻었다는 건, 나랑 녀석들 몇이 어느 날 밤 몰래 숨어들어 훔쳐 왔다는 뜻일세.

english: I don't know who they were building these warships for, but whoever it was seemed to be a little on the short side.
translation: 누구를 위해 그 군함들을 만들고 있었는지는 모르겠지만, 그게 누구든 키가 좀 작은 모양이더군.

english: We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to
translation: 어딜 가든 몸을 웅크리고 다니지 않으려고 문과 선실을 조금 개조해야 했지만, 마침내 내가 원하는 대로 꾸며 놨다네. 갑판 아래엔 대포도 넉넉해서

english: bombard a small town I'd wager!
translation: 작은 마을 하나쯤은 거뜬히 포격할 수 있을 걸세!

english: *Brawwwwwwk* I want guns, lots of guns! I want guns, lots of guns!
translation: *꾸아아아악* 총이 필요해, 총이 잔뜩! 총이 필요해, 총이 잔뜩!

english: I used to own my own ship you know...
It was called the Lady Lumbridge if I remember correctly...
translation: 제 기억이 맞다면 Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)라는 이름이었는데...

english: I wonder whatever happened to it...
Interesting. You never struck me as being Captain material, but I guess there's a ship out there for everyone...
translation: 흥미롭군. 자네가 선장감으로 보이진 않았는데, 뭐 누구에게나 맞는 배가 어딘가 있겠지...

english: The Lady Zay is certainly a big step up from my last ship anyway.
translation: 아무튼 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)는 내 지난번 배보다 확실히 한 단계 나은 배일세.

english: Your last ship? Why, what was wrong with it?
Well, it just wasn't sturdy enough!
translation: 글쎄, 그냥 충분히 튼튼하지가 않았던 게지!

english: I was on a perfectly routine raiding expedition to the east of here, when we ran into a squall, that pushed us towards the rocky shore.
translation: 여기서 동쪽으로 아주 평범한 약탈 원정을 나갔다가 돌풍을 만났는데, 그게 우리를 바위 해안 쪽으로 밀어붙였지.

english: A few select men and myself managed to escape with our lives intact on a small row boat, but the rest of my crew were washed ashore as the ship was wrecked on those jagged rocks.
translation: 나와 엄선된 몇 명은 작은 노 젓는 배를 타고 간신히 목숨을 건졌지만, 나머지 선원들은 배가 그 뾰족한 바위에 부딪혀 난파되는 바람에 해안으로 떠밀려 갔다네.

english: Ah yes, it was a tragedy...
To lose such a fine ship in such an insulting manner...
translation: 그토록 훌륭한 배를 그토록 굴욕적으로 잃다니...

english: And of course the rest of your crew...
Who? Oh. Yes. The crew. Yes, it was a tragedy.
translation: 누구? 아. 그래. 선원들. 그래, 그것도 비극이었지.

english: I'd paid them in advance you know, I'll never see that money again!
translation: 그 녀석들한테 급료를 선불로 줬거든. 그 돈은 다시는 못 볼 걸세!

english: Um... no, I actually meant it was a shame that so many of your crew must have died in the shipwreck.
translation: 음... 아뇨, 제 말은 난파 사고로 그렇게 많은 선원이 죽었을 테니 안타깝다는 뜻이었어요.

english: Was it? Well, if you say so.
Actually, the last I had heard quite a few of them had survived, and had set up a little hideaway in the remains of the shipwreck.
translation: 사실 마지막으로 들은 바로는 꽤 많은 녀석이 살아남아서 난파선 잔해에 작은 은신처를 차렸다더군.

english: If you're particularly worried about the, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
translation: 그 녀석들이 정 걱정된다면 언제 한번 찾아가 보는 것도 좋겠지. 쉽게 옮길 수 있는 재물을 잔뜩 챙겨 가는 걸 잊지 말게나.

english: They love people visiting with easily transferable wealth.
translation: 그 녀석들은 쉽게 옮길 수 있는 재물을 들고 찾아오는 사람을 아주 좋아하거든.

english: Now, was there something you wished to talk to me about? Time is pressing on, and we really need to set sail soon if we want to make the most of the winds.
translation: 자, 나한테 할 얘기가 있었나? 시간이 촉박하네. 바람을 제대로 타려면 곧 출항해야 하거든.

english: *Squawk* Move it or lose it, move it or lose it.
translation: *꽤액* 빨리 안 오면 두고 간다, 빨리 안 오면 두고 간다.

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now? I must say, it all sounds very intriguing over there...
translation: 이제 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)으로 출항할 수 있나요? 정말 흥미로운 곳 같아요...

english: As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Femennik.
translation: 섬에 있는 동안 Seal Of Passage(통행의 인장)을 늘 지니고 있으면 괜찮을 걸세. 설령 자네가 Femennik(프레메닉)이라 해도 말이지.

english: I'm not kidding, they are a very dangerous people, and it would NOT be wise for you to travel there without your Seal Of Passage marking you as a diplomat.
translation: 농담이 아닐세. 그들은 아주 위험한 사람들이니, 자네가 외교관임을 증명하는 Seal Of Passage(통행의 인장) 없이 그곳에 가는 건 절대 현명하지 못한 일일세.

english: Okay, keep my Seal with me at all times, check. Can we go now?
translation: 알겠어요, 인장은 늘 지니고 다닐 것, 확인. 이제 가도 될까요?

english: Ah, yes indeed! The winds seem good, so let's make a move!
She's blowing a storm, cap'n! *Brarrrrrk*
Well... THAT was deuced strange!
Um... Way to sail a boat?
*Squawk* Way to sail a boat! Way to sail a boat! *Brarrrk*
translation: *꽤액* 항해 솜씨 끝내준다! 항해 솜씨 끝내준다! *꾸아악*

english: This... This is VERY strange!
Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.
translation: 글쎄, 기꺼이 데려다주고 싶네만, 안타깝게도 Moon Clan(달 부족)은 솔직히 말해 아주 무서운 사람들이라, 우리가 Fremennik(프레메닉)을 데려가면 좋게 보지 않을 걸세.

english: They are at war with them after all.
But I thought Lokar had already been there?
Yes. Yes he has. I'm talking about you.
translation: 그래. 그래, 갔었지. 내가 말하는 건 자네 얘길세.

english: Oh. Oh yeah, I'm a Fremennik aren't I?
Yes, yes you are.
I probably should have kept that Seal Of Passage Brundt the Chieftain gave me with me, shouldn't I?
translation: Brundt the Chieftain(족장 브룬트)가 준 Seal Of Passage(통행의 인장)을 가지고 있었어야 했나 봐요, 그렇죠?

english: Yes, yes you should have. Honestly, you're going to need it with you.
translation: 그래, 그랬어야지. 솔직히 그건 꼭 지니고 있어야 할 걸세.

english: I'm afraid I can't let you travel with us without it.
translation: 유감이지만 그것 없이는 우리와 함께 갈 수 없네.

english: *Brakawk* Don't drop quest items half way through a quest! *Squawk*
translation: *꾸아악* 퀘스트 도중에 퀘스트 아이템 버리지 마! *꽤액*

english: Okay, I'll go and get it again then.
You do that.
No, actually, I don't really want to know anything that you can tell me.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 선장님이 알려주실 만한 건 별로 알고 싶지 않아요.

english: In fact, I don't even know why I began talking to you in the first place!
translation: 애초에 왜 선장님한테 말을 걸었는지도 모르겠네요!

english: Hmmmm. You could perhaps be more grateful to someone offering you free transport, but then I suppose you are a friend of Lokar's, and a Fremennik, so I suppose the
translation: 흐으음. 공짜로 태워 주겠다는 사람에게 좀 더 고마워할 수도 있을 텐데, 하긴 자네는 Lokar(로카르)의 친구인 데다 Fremennik(프레메닉)이니, 그런

english: rudeness is natural.
Make sure you are ready for departure, I will be issuing orders to set sail shortly.
translation: 출발 준비를 해 두게. 곧 출항 명령을 내릴 걸세.

english: I... I don't understand... This is all very strange...
translation: 나... 나도 모르겠군... 이건 정말 이상한 일일세...

english: That was possibly the most pointless journey I have ever taken in my life.
translation: 제 평생 가장 쓸모없는 항해였던 것 같아요.

english: The course was plotted, we had a fair tailwind the whole journey...
translation: 항로도 정확히 짰고, 항해 내내 순풍이 불었는데...

english: BUT WE HAVEN'T BUDGED AN INCH!
translation: 그런데 우린 한 치도 움직이지 않았어!

english: I just don't understand it... Maybe you should speak with Jack.
translation: 도무지 이해가 안 되는군... 자네가 Jack(잭)과 얘기해 보는 게 좋겠네.

english: Who?
Our navigator. He's at the rear of the ship, one floor below deck. He's an old sea-dog with a brown pirate's hat.
translation: 우리 항해사일세. 배 뒤쪽, 갑판 한 층 아래에 있지. 갈색 pirate's hat(해적 모자)를 쓴 늙은 뱃사람이라네.

english: Below deck, below deck!
Can we try again?
Yes, you're right, perhaps it was just a freak wind. Off we go!
translation: 그래, 자네 말이 맞네. 어쩌면 그냥 괴상한 바람이었을지도 모르지. 출발하세!

english: The ship sails in a circle around Pirates' Cove a second time
translation: 배가 다시 한번 Pirates' Cove(해적의 만) 주위를 빙 돈다

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
So we're here?
Can you tell me something about the Moon Clan?
translation: Moon Clan(달 부족)에 대해 알려주실 수 있나요?

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle?
Can you tell me something about your ship?
translation: 선장님 배에 대해 알려주실 수 있나요?

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?
translation: 이제 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)으로 출항할 수 있나요?

english: Absolutely nothing at all.
Welcome to Gnome Air!
translation: Gnome Air(노움 항공)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: What's Gnome Air?
Gnome Air is the finest airline in Gielinor!
translation: Gnome Air(노움 항공)은 Gielinor(길리노르) 최고의 항공사죠!

english: Well...it's the only real airline in Gielinor.
translation: 음... 사실 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 유일한 진짜 항공사예요.

english: Ha!
What do you mean by real airline?
Well there's a dodgy magic carpet operation in the desert, I doubt it will ever take off... Ha!
translation: 사막에 수상한 마법 양탄자 사업이 있긴 한데, 그게 뜰 일은 없을 거예요... 하!

english: Where can you take me?
How much for one-way to Varrock?
I can't take you anywhere.
How come?
I would, but Glough has told me not to take humans on Gnome Air.
translation: 그러고 싶지만, Glough(글로우)가 Gnome Air(노움 항공)에 인간은 태우지 말라고 했거든요.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 나은 이유가 뭐예요?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 오, 저희는 노선망이 아주 넓거든요! 가기 힘든 곳에 갈 때 정말 좋아요.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 순간이동으로는 닿을 수 없는 곳이 정말 많거든요!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: 어떻게 이렇게 탄탄한 노선망을 갖추신 거예요?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
Sorry, I don't want anything now.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않으신 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Captain Bleemadge
Aahh, the smell of home, there's nothing like it. Thanks.
translation: 아아, 고향의 냄새, 이만한 게 없죠. 고마워요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 먼 길을 오셨겠네요. 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없어요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: You must complete this!
Please finish the puzzle for me!
Well done!
What's Gnome Air?
Where can you take me?
How much for one-way to Varrock?
I'll leave you to it.
Can you take me on the glider?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 나은 이유가 뭐예요?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
Fancy some 'rum', [lad/lass]? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: '럼' 한잔 어때, [lad/lass]? 아직 신선해. 뭐, 신선한 편이지...

english: No... I think I'll pass.
Hello there, I'm Captain Bruce. Do you want to serve in the Shayzien Army and defend our kingdom?
translation: 안녕하십니까, 저는 Captain Bruce(브루스 대장)입니다. Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)에 입대해 우리 왕국을 지키고 싶으십니까?

english: Yes, I'd love to join.
Wonderful! To get started, you need to answer a few questions.
translation: 훌륭합니다! 시작하려면 몇 가지 질문에 답하셔야 합니다.

english: Are you a resident of Kourend?
Errrr... Not really.
Ah. Then you cannot join I'm afraid.
translation: 아. 그렇다면 유감이지만 입대하실 수 없습니다.

english: How come?
It's in the rules I'm afraid. Only citizens of Kourend are allowed to join the Shayzien Army.
translation: 유감이지만 규정이 그렇습니다. Kourend(쿠렌드) 시민만 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)에 입대할 수 있습니다.

english: Is that not too restrictive?
Well at one time only citizens of Shayzien could join the army. It wasn't until the reign of King Byrne I that people from other parts of the kingdom were allowed to enlist.
translation: 한때는 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 시민만 군에 입대할 수 있었습니다. King Byrne I(번 1세 왕)의 치세에 와서야 왕국의 다른 지역 사람들도 입대할 수 있게 되었지요.

english: Of course, many people in Kourend still like to stick to tradition. After all, the five cities of Kourend have always had very defined roles within the kingdom.
translation: 물론 Kourend(쿠렌드)에는 아직도 전통을 고수하려는 사람이 많습니다. 어쨌거나 쿠렌드의 다섯 도시는 늘 왕국 안에서 매우 뚜렷한 역할을 맡아 왔으니까요.

english: Interesting. So most people in the army are still from Shayzien?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 그럼 군대에 있는 사람은 대부분 아직 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 출신인가요?

english: Indeed. While the Shayzien Army is by far the largest military force in Kourend, the other cities still have some form of militia, apart from Arceuus of course.
translation: 그렇습니다. Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)는 Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 단연 가장 큰 군사력이지만, 다른 도시들도 어느 정도 민병대를 두고 있습니다. 물론 Arceuus(아르세우스)는 예외지만요.

english: Even if someone from elsewhere in the kingdom wants to become a soldier, they're far more likely to join their local city force than come to us.
translation: 왕국의 다른 지역 사람이 군인이 되고 싶어 해도, 저희보다는 자기 지역 도시의 군대에 들어갈 가능성이 훨씬 높습니다.

english: Still, times are slowly changing. Every year we see more people from outside Shayzien enlist.
translation: 그래도 시대는 천천히 변하고 있습니다. 해마다 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 밖에서 입대하는 사람이 늘고 있지요.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
My pleasure.
No, I'm not interested.
That's alright. Come back if you change your mind.
Here, solve this.
Captain Bruce hands you a [light puzzle/puzzle] box.
translation: Captain Bruce(브루스 대장)이 [light puzzle/puzzle] 상자를 건넨다.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 아직 안 풀린 것 같습니다.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Yes, I'd love to join.
No, I'm not interested.
You'd best introduce yourself first!
Hello. What's this place?
Why you wretched Son-of-a-Big-Nosed-Warty-Smelly- Goblin! How dare you speak to a commanding officer like that?
translation: 이 비열한 왕코에 사마귀투성이 냄새나는 Goblin(고블린) 자식 같으니! 감히 지휘관한테 그따위로 말을 해?

english: I... err...
What?
Stand straight! Chest out, shoulders back!
translation: 똑바로 서! 가슴 펴고, 어깨 뒤로!

english: Okay, okay.
You'll address me as captain!
Yea... yes, captain!
Better. Now what is a low-life, pathetic excuse for a human being doing sniffing around my arena?
translation: 좀 낫군. 자, 한심한 인간 말종 같은 놈이 내 경기장에서 뭘 기웃거리고 있는 거지?

english: Exploring, captain. Looked like a chance for combat, sir!
translation: 탐험 중이었습니다, 대장님. 전투할 기회가 있어 보였습니다!

english: Very well, make the most of this because I don't suffer idiots easily! This is the Barbarian Assault arena. You want to sign up with us?
translation: 좋아, 난 멍청이를 쉽게 참아 주지 않으니 이번 기회를 잘 살려라! 여긴 Barbarian Assault(바바리안 어설트) 경기장이다. 우리와 함께하겠나?

english: Sir, yes sir!
Then listen closely.
Wait a minute! I'm not giving a tutorial to someone carrying that stuff. Use that bank chest over there first!
translation: 잠깐! 그런 걸 들고 다니는 녀석한테는 튜토리얼을 안 해 준다. 저기 있는 bank chest(은행 상자)부터 이용해라!

english: You can't enter the game with any food; the Healer will cure you.
translation: 음식은 가지고 게임에 들어갈 수 없다. Healer(치유사)가 치료해 줄 거다.

english: You can't enter the game with any brutal potions or ingredients; the Healer will cure you.
translation: 독한 물약이나 재료는 가지고 게임에 들어갈 수 없다. Healer(치유사)가 치료해 줄 거다.

english: There is no reason to take a phoenix necklace into the arena, as you won't lose any items if you die in the minigame.
translation: phoenix necklace(불사조 목걸이)를 경기장에 가져갈 필요는 없다. 이 미니게임에서는 죽어도 아이템을 잃지 않으니까.

english: You can't enter the game with any runes - there are free ones in there.
translation: 룬은 가지고 게임에 들어갈 수 없다. 안에 공짜 룬이 있다.

english: You can't take arrows into a game - there are free ones in there.
translation: 화살은 게임에 가져갈 수 없다. 안에 공짜 화살이 있다.

english: The barbarians don't want you to take your follower in.
translation: 야만인들은 네가 동행자를 데려가는 걸 원치 않는다.

english: You can't take your own logs with you - you have to use the ones the barbarians provide.
translation: 네 통나무는 가져갈 수 없다. 야만인들이 주는 걸 써야 한다.

english: The barbarians don't want you using artillery down there.
translation: 야만인들은 네가 저 아래에서 대포를 쓰는 걸 원치 않는다.

english: The barbarians don't trust whatever you may have stored in your looting bag. They won't let you in with it.
translation: 야만인들은 네 looting bag(약탈 가방)에 뭐가 들었는지 믿지 못한다. 그걸 가지고는 들여보내 주지 않을 거다.

english: The barbarians don't want you using Saradomin brews down there. You will have to restore your health as they intend.
translation: 야만인들은 네가 저 아래에서 Saradomin brew(사라도민 브루)를 쓰는 걸 원치 않는다. 그들이 의도한 방식대로 체력을 회복해야 한다.

english: Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
Really? You don't look like one. Very well, upon your own head be it, I'll let you skip the training. Come back and speak to me if you find you're not the know-it-all you believe yourself to be.
translation: 정말? 전혀 그렇게 안 보이는데. 좋아, 책임은 네가 져라. 훈련을 건너뛰게 해 주지. 네가 생각만큼 잘난 놈이 아니란 걸 깨달으면 다시 와서 말해라.

english: Nah, sounds boring.
'Boring'? You'll get nowhere with that kind of attitude! Drop and give me ten!
translation: '지루해'? 그런 태도로는 아무것도 못 한다! 엎드려서 팔굽혀펴기 열 개 실시!

english: Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: 다음에 할게요, 머리 감으러 가야 해서요.

english: You'll do as I say!
Arrrghhh. Okay, okay!
Good to see you've learned some respect, make it five
translation: 이제야 예의를 좀 배웠군. 다섯 개로 줄여 주지

english: Yes sir!
But I already did!
You did?
I don't trust you in the slightest. Do as I tell you!
translation: 난 널 눈곱만큼도 못 믿는다. 내가 시키는 대로 해!

english: Hi... I mean, [player name] reporting, sir!
Straighten that back when you talk to me! You want my help?
translation: 말할 땐 허리 똑바로 펴라! 내 도움이 필요한가?

english: Again? Very well. Listen closely this time!
Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
What? Finish with your training first, soldier!
Sir! Can we do some training?
translation: 대장님! 훈련 좀 할 수 있겠습니까?

english: What do you mean, you are on wave one!
Oh, of course, sorry.
Sir, yes sir!
Let's skip the training, I'm an expert already.
Nah, sounds boring.
Maybe next time, I need to go wash my hair.
translation: 다음에 할게요, 머리 감으러 가야 해서요.

english: But I already did...
Sir! Can we do some training?
translation: 대장님! 훈련 좀 할 수 있겠습니까?

english: Sir! Could I start at wave one again?
Hello there. What do you need?
What is this place?
This is one of the lairs of those foul Lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
translation: 여긴 그 더러운 Lizardmen(리자드맨)의 소굴 중 하나예요. 놈들이 도망가지 못하게 몰아넣었죠.

english: Who are you?
Cleive. Captain Cleive. Captain in the Shayzien Guard and renowned slayer.
translation: Cleive(클리브). 클리브 대장이에요. Shayzien Guard(샤이지엔 경비대)의 대장이자 이름난 슬레이어죠.

english: Renowned?
Absolutely. I'm part of a great family of slayers. You've probably met a few of them over on the mainland.
translation: 물론이죠. 전 위대한 슬레이어 가문 출신이에요. 본토에서 그중 몇 명은 만나 봤을걸요.

english: Why are you here?
We learnt of a group of Lizardman Shamans causing trouble on the surface. I led a taskforce out to drive them back into their lair.
translation: Lizardman Shaman(리자드맨 주술사) 무리가 지상에서 말썽을 일으킨다는 걸 알게 됐어요. 그래서 제가 특수부대를 이끌고 나가 놈들을 소굴로 몰아냈죠.

english: We suffered many losses but we've now managed to trap them in this cave.
