translation: 희생이 컸지만 이제 놈들을 이 동굴에 가둬 뒀어요.

english: We've lost too many men to be able to finish them off but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: 부하를 너무 많이 잃어서 놈들을 끝장낼 수는 없지만, 그 도전에 걸맞은 사람이라고 판단되면 다른 사람이 해치워도 괜찮아요.

english: Can I fight these Lizardmen?
Perhaps. I've lost too many men to be able to kill them myself but I'm happy for someone else to do it if I feel they're worthy of the challenge.
translation: 어쩌면요. 부하를 너무 많이 잃어서 직접 처치할 수는 없지만, 그 도전에 걸맞은 사람이라고 판단되면 다른 사람이 해도 괜찮아요.

english: What do you define as worthy?
You'll need to be favoured by the people of Shayzien. You'll also need to be on a Lizardman Slayer task.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 사람들의 신임을 얻어야 해요. 그리고 Lizardman(리자드맨) 슬레이어 과제를 받은 상태여야 하고요.

english: Can I use my slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: Shayzien helm(샤이지엔 투구) 대신 slayer helm(슬레이어 투구)를 써도 돼요?

english: Yes that is possible, however I only show the required technique to those who have proved themselves a friend to Kourend.
translation: 가능은 하지만, 필요한 기술은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 친구임을 증명한 사람에게만 알려 줘요.

english: How do I prove that I am a friend to Kourend?
translation: 제가 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 친구라는 걸 어떻게 증명하죠?

english: You'll need to complete the Hard tier of the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary and have earned the tier five Shayzien helm.
translation: Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary(쿠렌드 & 케보스 업적 일지)의 상급 단계를 완료하고, 5단계 Shayzien helm(샤이지엔 투구)를 얻어야 해요.

english: I don't meet those requirements. I'll be back when I do though.
translation: 전 그 조건을 못 갖췄네요. 갖추면 다시 올게요.

english: I have that completed! Can you show me the special technique now?
translation: 다 완료했어요! 이제 그 특별한 기술을 보여 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course!
Captain Clieve teaches you the secret technique. Any slayer helm will now offer the same protection against lizardman as a shayzien helm (5).
translation: Captain Clieve(클리브 대장)이 비밀 기술을 가르쳐 준다. 이제 모든 slayer helm(슬레이어 투구)가 lizardman(리자드맨)을 상대로 shayzien helm (5)(샤이지엔 투구 (5))와 같은 방어 효과를 낸다.

english: I have already shown you that secret technique.
translation: 그 비밀 기술은 이미 알려 드렸어요.

english: Hey! These lizardmen aren't just for anyone. Come back when you have the right Slayer task!
translation: 이봐요! 이 Lizardmen(리자드맨)은 아무나 상대하는 게 아니에요. 맞는 Slayer(슬레이어) 과제를 받으면 다시 오세요!

english: Captain Clieve wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: Captain Clieve(클리브 대장)은 당신이 Slayer(슬레이어) 과제에 충실하길 바란다.

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Can I fight these Lizardmen?
Can I use my Slayer helm instead of a Shayzien helm?
translation: Shayzien helm(샤이지엔 투구) 대신 Slayer helm(슬레이어 투구)를 써도 돼요?

english: Hello old chap.
What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?
translation: 여기서 뭐 하세요? 글라이더 돌보셔야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.
translation: 요즘은 거의 은퇴했다네, 친구. 시험 비행사 시절은 끝났지. 그냥 여기서 쉬면서 인간 대 인간의 원초적인 대결을 즐기고 있다네.

english: You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?
translation: 결투를 구경하시는 거군요. 직접 누군가에게 도전하실 거예요?

english: I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!
translation: 결투는 구경하기엔 재미있지만, 직접 끼어들면 훨씬 덜 재미있을 것 같네. 난 싸움보다는 사랑이 체질이라네!

english: Errm, I suppose you are.
You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Daerkin.
translation: Captain Daerkin(대르킨 대장)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Excellent. Just what I need whilst watching the duels.
translation: 훌륭하군. 결투를 구경하면서 딱 필요하던 걸세.

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: 남는 고글이 좀 있는데, 자네가 가져도 되겠군.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 먼 길을 왔겠군. 팁으로 조금 더 얹어 주겠네.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 글라이더 좀 태워 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course!
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Oh, he's always up to something. Like that magic carpet business.
translation: 아, 그 사람은 늘 뭔가 꾸미고 있죠. 그 마법 양탄자 사업처럼요.

english: What magic carpet business?
He said he was planning to set up a magic carpet network, like our gliders.
translation: 우리 글라이더처럼 마법 양탄자 운송망을 만들 계획이라고 하더라고요.

english: If he ever gets it set up, us gnomes won't be happy with him. Especially not King Narnode!
translation: 그걸 정말 만들어 버리면 우리 노움들은 가만있지 않을 거예요. 특히 King Narnode(나노드 왕)께서요!

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭔가요?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 아, 우리는 운송망이 아주 넓거든요! 가기 힘든 곳에 갈 때 정말 좋아요.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 순간이동으로는 갈 수 없는 곳이 정말 많잖아요!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
Sorry, I don't want anything now.
You have come to the right place. At the center I must go, 5 paces toward the circle of stone, then one more to the city of kings and find the treasure of my kins.
translation: 제대로 찾아오셨네요. 중심에서 출발해야 하니, 돌의 원을 향해 다섯 걸음, 그리고 왕들의 도시 쪽으로 한 걸음 더 가면 내 동족의 보물을 찾을 수 있으리라.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 글라이더 좀 태워 주실 수 있나요?

english: What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭔가요?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!
translation: 너야말로 할 말 없지! 그 사소한 충돌로 나도 톡톡히 대가를 치렀다고!

english: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!
translation: 눈 하나로 내 최고 부하 둘 값을 퉁칠 순 없지!

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: 그래? 그럼 Turtle Basin(거북 분지)에서 싸웠을 땐 뭐였는데?

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: 그건 도망친 게 아니야! 전술적 재배치였다고! 게다가 넌 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에서 있었던 일은 편하게도 잊어버렸구나!

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: 지루한 싸움이었지! 난 더 중요한 볼일이 있었다고.

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: 그럼 다음번엔 좀 더 재밌게 해 줘야겠구먼!

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
Indeed! Cheers!
Prepare yeself, we'll be off soon!
Aye aye!
What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 뭐가 필요하냐, 모험가? 싸울 전투가 기다리고 있다고!

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 배 위의 상자에서 harpoon(작살)을 하나 챙겨서 섬 주변에서 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 잡아 와. Tempoross(템포로스)한테 쏠 탄약으로 아주 그만이거든!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 좀 잡았으면, 더 센 한 방을 원할 땐 섬에 있는 제단에서 구워도 돼. 그다음 배로 돌아와서 대포 옆 탄약 상자에 넣어 주면 된다.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 우리 포수들이 작살고기를 Tempoross(템포로스)한테 쏴 댈 거야. 놈이 약해져서 기운을 회복하려고 물속에 잠기면, 배 옆 부두로 내려가서 영혼 웅덩이에서 낚시를 해.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 그래도 영혼 웅덩이 낚시는 빨리 해치워야 한다. 안 그러면 놈이 너무 강해져서 돌아오는 바람에 싸움을 포기해야 할 거야! 운이 좋으면 영혼 물고기들을 충분히 약하게 만들어서 Tempoross(템포로스)를 제압할 수 있겠지. 자, 이제 싸우러 가라, 선원!

english: What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 대포에 전기를 흘려서 발사를 막으면, 작살고기를 다른 탄약 상자에 넣어서 남은 대포들이 계속 쏘게 해.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 그리고 배의 상자에서 rope(밧줄)을 챙기고 큰 파도를 잘 지켜봐. 파도가 오면 우리가 소리쳐 줄 테니까, 그때 그 밧줄로 얼른 섬의 totem pole(토템 기둥)이나 배의 mast(돛대)에 몸을 묶어.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 파도에 토템 기둥이나 돛대가 부서지면, 배의 상자에서 hammer(망치)를 꺼내서 다음 큰 파도가 오기 전에 고쳐 놔.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 아, 그리고 번개 구름 때문에 불이 나는 것도 조심해. 배의 상자에서 bucket(양동이)를 꺼내서 pump(펌프)로 물을 채운 다음, 불이 번지기 전에 꺼 버려.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 파도나 불에 맞으면 모아 둔 물고기랑 도구를 잃어버려도 놀라지 마라. 자, 이제 싸우러 가라, 선원!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 정말이냐? 지금 떠나면 보상은 하나도 없다.

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 해냈다! Tempoross(템포로스)를 또 한 번 제압했어. 잘했다!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 푹 쉬어 둬. 하지만 너무 늘어지진 마라, 놈은 금방 기운을 되찾을 테니까!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: Unkah(운카)로 돌아가면 부두 근처에 잔해가 떠밀려 와 있을 때가 많아. 마음껏 둘러봐. 쓸 만한 게 나올지도 모르지!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 머지않아 Tempoross(템포로스)가 다시 말썽 부릴 만큼 기운을 되찾을 테고, 그럼 또 붙잡아 눌러야 해. 그때도 네가 도와주리라 믿는다!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Goodbye.
To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
Let's get underway!
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
The mast has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 대포 하나를 망가뜨렸다! 다른 대포로 옮겨라!

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Goodbye.
I don't think I can fix this. Looks like I'll be heading back by foot.
translation: 이건 못 고치겠네요. 걸어서 돌아가야 할 것 같아요.

english: Ah, how embarrassing.
What happened?
A bit of a technical hitch with the landing gear. I won't be able to fly you anywhere, sorry.
translation: 착륙 장치에 기술적인 문제가 좀 생겼어요. 죄송하지만 어디로도 태워 드릴 수가 없겠네요.

english: I'm busy here. Do you need something?
translation: 제가 지금 바쁩니다. 무슨 용건이라도 있으십니까?

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
translation: 지금 하시는 일에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Gangs. It's the gangs from the slums in the east. Those ruffians are always hatching schemes, whether it's smuggling or extortion or even plain street violence.
translation: 갱단입니다. 동쪽 빈민가에서 온 갱단들이죠. 그 불량배들은 밀수든 갈취든, 아니면 그냥 길거리 폭력이든 늘 무슨 계략을 꾸미고 있습니다.

english: I'm in charge of the investigations unit. Sometimes an informant will let us know when a gang is meeting. Then we can send in the troops and get them.
translation: 저는 수사대를 맡고 있습니다. 가끔 정보원이 갱단이 모인다는 소식을 알려 주면, 병력을 보내 일망타진하는 거죠.

english: Can I help?
That would be very welcome. Information about gang meetings is written on the notice board when it's received. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: 그래 주시면 무척 고맙겠습니다. 갱단 모임 정보가 들어오면 notice board(게시판)에 적어 둡니다. 거기에 모임 공지가 올라오면 가서 처리해 주십시오.

english: If they drop any documents, bring them to me for an extra reward.
translation: 놈들이 문서를 떨어뜨리면 저한테 가져오십시오. 추가 보상을 드리겠습니다.

english: You sound busy. I'll be off.
translation: 바쁘신 것 같네요. 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Hello again. Thanks for offering to help deal with the criminal gangs.
translation: 또 뵙는군요. 범죄 조직 소탕을 돕겠다고 나서 주셔서 감사합니다.

english: Do you know of any meetings now?
No, not at the moment. Keep checking the notice board - information is written there when we receive it.
translation: 아니요, 지금은 없습니다. 게시판을 계속 확인하십시오. 정보가 들어오는 대로 거기에 적어 둡니다.

english: We've received reports of a gang [in location]! They're meeting [in location].
translation: [in location] 갱단에 관한 보고가 들어왔습니다! 놈들은 [in location]에서 모이고 있습니다.

english: We believe the meeting is in progress now.
translation: 모임은 지금 진행 중인 것으로 보입니다.

english: We believe the meeting is about to start imminently.
We believe the meeting will start in about [number] minutes.
translation: 모임은 약 [number]분 뒤에 시작될 것으로 보입니다.

english: Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 이건 뭘 하면 되나요?

english: Gang meeting information is written on the notice board when it's received from the informants. When you see a meeting announced there, go and deal with 'em.
translation: 정보원에게서 갱단 모임 정보가 들어오면 notice board(게시판)에 적어 둡니다. 거기에 모임 공지가 올라오면 가서 처리해 주십시오.

english: I'll be off.
Come over here and talk to me before you mess around with that.
translation: 그걸 건드리기 전에 이리 와서 저와 먼저 이야기하십시오.

english: No thanks, I don't need that.
Thank you. This will help us track down more gang meetings in future.
translation: 감사합니다. 앞으로 갱단 모임을 더 찾아내는 데 도움이 될 겁니다.

english: I don't remember asking you to help, but... okay, thank you, whoever you are.
translation: 도와 달라고 부탁한 기억은 없지만... 뭐, 고맙습니다. 누구신지는 모르겠지만요.

english: Please leave. There is confidential information in here, and you are not authorised to view it.
translation: 나가 주십시오. 이곳에는 기밀 정보가 있으며, 당신은 열람 권한이 없습니다.

english: Please tell me about what you're doing.
translation: 지금 하시는 일에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Can I help?
Do you know of any meetings now?
I'll be off.
You sound busy. I'll be off.
translation: 바쁘신 것 같네요. 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Remind me, what do I do for this?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 이건 뭘 하면 되나요?

english: Sorry I can't take any more passengers today.
translation: 죄송하지만 오늘은 더 이상 승객을 태울 수 없어요.

english: Hello there.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Ignisia claims it's some kind of evil spirit.
You don't believe her?
Nah, I believe in things I can stab and kill. This is all just a storm in a teacup. I mean, how can wind and snow be evil? My toad is more of a threat!
translation: 안 믿지. 난 찌르고 죽일 수 있는 것만 믿거든. 이건 다 찻잔 속의 태풍이야. 아니, 바람이랑 눈이 어떻게 사악할 수가 있어? 내 두꺼비가 더 위협적이겠다!

english: Your... toad?
Yeah, just a bit of fun. I have a pet - he's around here somewhere, assuming that troublesome cat hasn't eaten him.
translation: 그래, 그냥 재미 삼아서. 애완동물을 키우거든. 이 근처 어딘가 있을 거야. 그 말썽꾸러기 고양이가 잡아먹지만 않았다면 말이지.

english: That's a bit weird, but okay.
No weirder than being scared of snow.
Tell me about yourself.
I'm Captain Kalt, proud member of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 난 Captain Kalt(칼트 대장), 자랑스러운 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 일원이지.

english: How long have you been a soldier?
Man and boy I've worn the uniform. Earned Captain a few years back and never looked back. Not too happy about babysitting delusional wizards though. But orders is orders.
translation: 꼬맹이 시절부터 지금까지 쭉 군복을 입어 왔지. 몇 년 전에 대장 계급을 달았고 한 번도 후회한 적 없어. 망상에 빠진 마법사들 뒤치다꺼리하는 건 썩 내키지 않지만. 그래도 명령은 명령이니까.

english: Tell me how I'm doing.
translation: 제가 얼마나 잘하고 있는지 알려 주세요.

english: Go play in the snow and come back when you've done something.
translation: 눈밭에서 놀다가 뭐라도 해내면 다시 와.

english: You appear to have tried a little.
You have subdued the Wintertodt [x] times. Your lifetime score: [x] Your highest score: [x]
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 [x]번 제압했다. 누적 점수: [x] 최고 점수: [x]

english: Ignisia appears to be quite happy with you.
translation: Ignisia(이그니시아)가 너를 꽤 마음에 들어 하는 것 같더군.

english: See you later.
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me how I'm doing.
translation: 제가 얼마나 잘하고 있는지 알려 주세요.

english: See you later.
I've got nothing to say to you.
You do not have enough Piscarilius favour. Current favour: [X]% - Required: 75.0%
translation: Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) 호감도가 부족하다. 현재 호감도: [X]% - 필요: 75.0%

english: Eh, what do you want?
What's your story?

Sea piracy just ain't what it used to be, so my crew and I have had to make do on land. We specialise in 'acquiring' valuable antiquities from around the city and shipping them to our friends overseas.
translation: 바다 해적질도 예전 같지가 않아서, 나랑 우리 선원들은 뭍에서 먹고살 길을 찾아야 했지. 우린 도시 곳곳에서 값나가는 골동품을 '입수'해서 바다 건너 친구들한테 실어 보내는 일을 전문으로 해.

english: And people just let you get away with this?
translation: 그런데 사람들이 그걸 그냥 내버려 둬요?

english: Of course they do, for the right price. That's just how things work around here, kid.
translation: 당연하지, 값만 맞으면. 여기선 원래 그렇게 돌아가는 거야, 꼬마.

english: Looking for any help?
Yeah, you look like you might be able to help me out. If you think you've got what it takes, I might have a job for you.
translation: 그래, 너 좀 쓸 만해 보이는데. 해낼 자신이 있다면 일거리를 하나 줄 수도 있지.

english: I have what it takes.
We'll see about that. (Khaled tells the player to obtain an artefact from a certain location.)
translation: 그건 두고 보면 알겠지. (Khaled(칼레드)가 플레이어에게 특정 장소에서 artefact(유물)을 가져오라고 한다.)

english: I'm not sure I have the time right now.
Perhaps some other time.
I'll be on my way.
What are you playing at? I've given you a job, get it done.
translation: 뭐 하는 짓이야? 일을 줬으면 해치워야지.

english: What am I supposed to be doing?
You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the [location].
translation: 나 대신 artefact(유물)을 하나 되찾아 와야 해. [location]에서 찾을 수 있을 거다.

english: Watch yourself, if the guards catch you carrying hot goods they'll throw you in the brig.
translation: 조심해. 장물 들고 다니다 경비병한테 걸리면 감방에 처넣을 테니까.

english: I'll get to it right away, boss.
I've lost the artefact...
Congratulations, you're a failure. Come back to me when you think you've got what it takes to get the job done.
translation: 축하한다, 넌 실패작이야. 일을 해낼 자신이 생기면 그때 다시 와.

english: This is exactly what our friends overseas were looking for. Here's your cut. Let me know when you're ready for more work.
translation: 바다 건너 친구들이 찾던 게 딱 이거야. 여기 네 몫이다. 일 더 할 준비 되면 말해.

english: (Captain Khaled takes the stolen item and hands the player some coins.)
translation: (Captain Khaled(칼레드 선장)이 훔친 물건을 받아 들고 플레이어에게 코인을 건넨다.)

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Captain Khaled has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Captain Khaled(칼레드 선장)에게서 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 받았습니다!

english: Please give me your answer!
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 그럴 리가 있나? 다시 확인해 봐!

english: Spot on!
Captain Khaled has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Captain Khaled(칼레드 선장)에게서 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 받았습니다!

english: What's your story?
Looking for any help?
I have what it takes.
I'm not sure I have the time right now.
I'll be on my way.
What am I supposed to be doing?
I'll get to it right away, boss.
Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 글라이더 좀 태워 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭔가요?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 아, 우리는 운송망이 아주 넓거든요! 가기 힘든 곳에 갈 때 정말 좋아요.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 순간이동으로는 갈 수 없는 곳이 정말 많잖아요!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
Sorry, I don't want anything now.
Is that some rum I see in your backpack?
translation: 배낭에 보이는 거, 혹시 rum(럼주) 아닌가요?

english: Yes, why do you ask?
No reason, I just...
Oh my! What is that thing over there?
Where?
Hmm, my mistake, it must have been an optical illusion.
translation: 흠, 제가 잘못 봤네요. 착시였나 봐요.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않으신 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 죄송하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손으로 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만 내놓을 수 있거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Captain Klemfoodle
translation: Captain Klemfoodle(클렘푸들 선장)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Very good, very good. Itsgood to taste real gnomish flavours.
translation: 아주 좋아요, 아주 좋아. 진짜 노움의 맛을 보니 참 좋네요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져다주느라 먼 길을 오셨겠어요. 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]점 있습니다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없습니다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]점 있습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: Can you take me on the glider?
translation: 글라이더 좀 태워 주실 수 있나요?

english: Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭔가요?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in [X] minutes, [X] seconds.
translation: 죄송하지만 그 주문에 걸려 있는 동안에는 모시고 갈 수가 없어요. [X]분 [X]초 뒤면 풀릴 거예요.

english: Hey! I'm not flying out this deep into the Wilderness. They don't pay me danger money, you know. I'm out of here.
translation: 이봐요! 이렇게 Wilderness(황야) 깊숙한 곳까지는 안 날아가요. 위험 수당도 안 준다고요. 전 갈래요.

english: I'm looking for [player name].
Glider for [player name]!
Hello, [player name]! Let's go!
Glider here for [player name].
Come on, [player name]!
Don't keep me waiting, [player name]!
Where's [player name]?
[player name]? Where are you?
Oh, I give up.
Hello.
Well hello there, how you doing?
Not bad, yourself?
I'm great now, those goblins can't get close with this cannon blasting at them!
translation: 지금은 아주 좋지. 이 대포가 쾅쾅 쏴 대니 고블린 놈들이 가까이 오질 못하거든!

english: Don't let any goblins through the breach in our fence!
translation: 울타리 틈으로 고블린 한 놈도 들여보내지 마라!

english: Keep an eye open for goblins!
translation: 고블린이 오는지 눈 똑바로 뜨고 지켜라!

english: Don't just do something! Stand there!
translation: 뭐라도 하고 있지만 말고! 가만히 좀 서 있어라!

english: Stop dawdling soldier! You're in the army now!
translation: 꾸물대지 마라, 병사! 넌 이제 군대에 있다!

english: Hurry up on that patrol route, trooper!
Hello! What can I do for you?
Where am I exactly?
This is the port of Land's End!
Can you tell me about the local area?
translation: 이 지역에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Certainly. We're on the southern edge of the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 물론이죠. 여기는 Kingdom of Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드 왕국)의 남쪽 끝이에요.

english: The kingdom is made up of five main cities. You'll find Shayzien and Lovakengj to the north, and the remaining cities to the north east.
translation: 왕국은 다섯 개의 주요 도시로 이루어져 있어요. 북쪽에는 Shayzien(샤이지엔)과 Lovakengj(로바켕기)가 있고, 나머지 도시들은 북동쪽에 있어요.

english: Thanks.
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish.
I'd like to travel to Port Sarim, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 원하시는 대로 하죠. 뱃멀미를 안 하셨으면 좋겠네요, 긴 항해거든요.

english: Nothing.
Where am I exactly?
Can you take me to Port Piscarilius please?
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)까지 데려다주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you take me to Port Sarim please?
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)까지 데려다주실 수 있나요?

english: Nothing.
Adventurer. The General warned us about you.
Warned?
Yes. He said you might show up here again. We're not to harm you, but make no mistake, we're keeping a close eye on you. You're not to be trusted.
translation: 그렇습니다. 당신이 다시 이곳에 나타날지도 모른다고 하셨습니다. 해치지는 말라고 하셨지만, 착각하지 마십시오. 우리는 당신을 예의 주시하고 있습니다. 당신은 믿을 수 없는 사람입니다.

english: Well I guess that's the best I can hope for. So how are things going here?
translation: 뭐, 그 정도면 바랄 수 있는 최선이겠네요. 그래서 여기 상황은 어때요?

english: We are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 우리는 잡담하러 온 게 아닙니다. 일하게 내버려 두십시오.

english: Hey, how's it going?
You again? As I told you before, we are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.
translation: 또 당신입니까? 전에도 말했듯이 우리는 잡담하러 온 게 아닙니다. 일하게 내버려 두십시오.

english: I already told you to stop bothering us. Please go away.
translation: 귀찮게 하지 말라고 이미 말씀드렸습니다. 이만 가 주십시오.

english: Hello, what are you doing here, so far from home?
translation: 안녕하세요, 집에서 이렇게 먼 곳에서 뭐 하고 계세요?

english: I'm enjoyn' the local hoschpitalieee. hee hee.
Looks like you've enjoyed more than your fair share of hospitality.
translation: 인심을 남들 몫보다 훨씬 더 즐기신 것 같은데요.

english: tee hee, I probblie schoodn' 'av anuva drinkie right now. But dis dwarven beer ish kind of moreish after the fiff pint.
translation: 히히, 지그믄 한 잔 더 하믄 안 대겐지... 근데 이 드워프 맥주는 다섯 번째 잔부터 자꾸 땡기거드은.

english: I'd go easy on the dwarven stout if I were you.
translation: 제가 당신이라면 dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트)는 좀 살살 마시겠어요.

english: I yousht to be a tesht pilot yoo know. I reeel hero.
translation: 나 원래 시험 비행사여써. 지인짜 여엉우웅이었다구.

english: But I loscht my bottle. Scho I now ffind scholiss in the bottle.
translation: 근데 간이 콩알만 해져써. 그래쉬 요즘은 간을 술에 절이구 이찌.

english: What happened? Did you have a glider crash or get attacked by huge flying birds or something?
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는데요? 글라이더가 추락했거나 커다란 새한테 공격이라도 당했나요?

english: Naaah, I realished I woz scared ov heightsh.
translation: 아니이, 알구 보니 내가 고소공포즈이 이떠라구.

english: Ah, I can see that would be a problem ... You should keep an eye on your drinking, though.
translation: 아, 그건 문제가 될 만하네요... 그래도 술 드시는 건 좀 눈여겨보셔야겠어요.

english: I'll try. Bofe eyez...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았는데 맞는 음식을 안 가져온 것 같네! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손으로 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만 내놓을 수 있거든.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Ninto.
translation: Captain Ninto(닌토 대장)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Aaa shomefing ter go wiv my beer. Thish dwarf beerz quite shtrong you know...
translation: 오오 매주랑 가치 머글 거시다. 이 드워프 매주 꽤 쎄거드은...

english: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.
translation: 자, 멋진 조종사 스카프 하나 가져.

english: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.
translation: 남는 고글이 있는데, 너 가져도 돼.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이거 갖다주느라 먼 길 왔겠네. 팁으로 조금 더 줄게.

english: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]점 있습니다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없습니다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]점 있습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마.

english: Hello, who are you?
Ahoy! I'm Cap'n Pudi, currently assisting the Spirit Anglers in their effort against Tempoross.
translation: 어이! 난 Cap'n Pudi(푸디 선장)야. 지금은 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)을 도와 Tempoross(템포로스)와 맞서 싸우고 있지.

english: Tempoross? Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)요? Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)이요? 그게 누군데요?

english: You 'aven't heard?! The freak storms? Sailors running into trouble? Ye really must be a landlubber!
translation: 못 들었다고?! 그 괴상한 폭풍 말이야! 곤경에 빠진 선원들은? 너 진짜 뭍사람이구나!

english: Tempoross is some kind o' great sea spirit that's been spookin' sailors and causing crazy storms!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)는 뭐랄까, 거대한 바다 영혼 같은 놈인데, 선원들을 겁주고 미친 폭풍을 일으키고 있어!

english: Taiman and his crew were one of the first t' run into it. Washed up outside Al Kharid amongst piles of debris, they did. 'Tis a troublin' time to be a cap'n!
translation: Taiman(타이만)이랑 그 선원들이 그놈이랑 맨 처음 맞닥뜨린 축이야. Al Kharid(알 카리드) 바깥에 잔해 더미랑 같이 떠밀려 왔다니까. 선장 노릇 하기 참 골치 아픈 시절이야!

english: Oh that doesn't sound good at all!
translation: 아, 그거 전혀 좋은 소리가 아니네요!

english: It isn't, but worry not. The Spirit Anglers 'ave been formed t' tackle this beastie! We're recruiting all skilled sailors and fisherfolk t' help us.
translation: 안 좋지. 그래도 걱정 마. 이 짐승 놈을 상대하려고 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)이 결성됐거든! 솜씨 좋은 선원이랑 어부라면 누구든 모집하고 있어.

english: Well I can definitely fish!
Are you sure? It's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 정말이야? 바다가 꽤 험한데, 넌 경험을 좀 더 쌓아야 할 것 같은데.

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)와 싸우려면 Fishing(낚시) 레벨이 35는 돼야 해.

english: Excellent!
The ships on the dock regularly embark to Tempoross Cove. Once there, you'll need to keep the cannons loaded with Harpoonfish t' weaken the Spirit. You can fish 'em on the island.
translation: 부두에 있는 배들이 정기적으로 Tempoross Cove(템포로스 만)으로 출항해. 거기 도착하면 cannon(대포)에 Harpoonfish(작살고기)를 계속 장전해서 그 영혼을 약하게 만들어야 해. 작살고기는 섬에서 낚을 수 있어.

english: When Tempoross submerges, get up close and clear the fish from its whirlpools; they're how it gets its energy.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 물속으로 잠기면 바짝 다가가서 소용돌이 속 물고기를 싹 잡아 버려. 그게 그놈의 힘의 원천이거든.

english: Well, that sounds easy enough!
Aye, that be the easy part!
The storm of Tempoross will rage around you, so you better be ready to deal with lightning strikes and avoid getting zapped when Tempoross attacks the cannons.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)의 폭풍이 주변에 몰아칠 테니까, 벼락에 대비하고 템포로스가 대포를 공격할 때 감전되지 않게 조심해.

english: Also, watch out for those mighty waves! You'll want t' tether yourself t' something solid so you don't find yourself lost in the deep blue when they come crashing down!
translation: 그리고 그 거센 파도도 조심해! 파도가 덮칠 때 깊고 푸른 바다로 휩쓸려 가지 않으려면 단단한 데에 몸을 묶어 둬야 할 거야!

english: Oh... Well, I suppose I can do that.
translation: 아... 음, 그 정도는 할 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: Will I need any special equipment?
Everythin' you need can be found on-board. Though if you have a favourite harpoon, you can always bring that!
translation: 필요한 건 전부 배에 있어. 그래도 아끼는 harpoon(작살)이 있으면 언제든 가져와도 돼!

english: The complete Spirit Anglers outfit also has an 'andy harness built-in, so you won't need a rope if you're wearin' it. You can speak t' Gita about getting one.
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼) 의상을 한 벌 다 갖추면 쓸 만한 harness(안전띠)가 달려 있어서, 입고 있으면 rope(밧줄)이 필요 없어. 하나 구하고 싶으면 Gita(기타)한테 말해 봐.

english: Ye can find Gita just east of 'ere, next t' some fishin' equipment.
translation: Gita(기타)는 여기서 바로 동쪽, 낚시 장비 옆에 있어.

english: When you're ready, just board the ship and we'll set sail soon!
translation: 준비되면 배에 타기만 해. 곧 출항할 거야!

english: Aye aye cap'n!
Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)을 도우면 좋은 점이 있나요?

english: Other than maintainin' safe passage and savin' lives?!
translation: 안전한 항로를 지키고 목숨을 구하는 거 말고 또?!

english: Well...
I'm just messin' with ye! Of course there are benefits!
We find all sorts washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual junk, we often find old chests from merchant supply ships, as well as the odd artefact here and there.
translation: 폭풍이 지나가면 온갖 게 떠밀려 와. 흔한 잡동사니 말고도 상선 보급선에서 나온 낡은 상자가 자주 나오고, 가끔 유물도 하나씩 나온다고.

english: If it's not needed for the Spirit Anglers' research, it's yours to keep!
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼) 연구에 필요한 게 아니면 네가 가져도 돼!

english: Some of the more resourceful Spirit Anglers also discovered a fishing use for the spirit energised scales shed by the fish within Tempoross. You're free t' keep any you find.
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼) 중에 수완 좋은 몇몇이 Tempoross(템포로스) 안에 사는 물고기가 떨군, 영혼의 기운이 깃든 비늘을 낚시에 쓰는 법을 알아냈어. 찾는 건 마음대로 가져가도 돼.

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 섬에서 뭘 해야 하는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)에 대해 더 알려 주실래요?

english: Well, as I mentioned before, Taiman and his fishing crew from Al Kharid 'ad a tussle with Tempoross. They barely made it back.
translation: 음, 아까 말했듯이 Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 Taiman(타이만)과 그 낚싯배 선원들이 Tempoross(템포로스)랑 한판 붙었어. 겨우 살아 돌아왔지.

english: I was sitting down by the shore enjoying one of Karim's kebabs at the time, when suddenly the crew washed up amongst a pile of debris. Looked like they'd just seen a ghost!
translation: 그때 난 해변에 앉아서 Karim(카림)네 케밥을 먹고 있었는데, 갑자기 그 선원들이 잔해 더미랑 같이 떠밀려 오더라고. 유령이라도 본 얼굴이었지!

english: As soon as they could talk sense they went to the Chancellor and within days more shockin' tales of the Sea Spirit's wrath came in.
translation: 정신을 차리고 말을 할 수 있게 되자마자 그 친구들은 Chancellor(재상)을 찾아갔고, 며칠 안 돼서 Sea Spirit(바다 영혼)의 분노에 관한 충격적인 이야기가 더 들어왔어.

english: The Chancellor called a meeting for all us local seafarin' folk and we agreed action must be taken!
translation: Chancellor(재상)이 이 근방 뱃사람들을 전부 불러 모아 회의를 열었고, 우린 뭔가 행동해야 한다고 뜻을 모았지!

english: Ain't nothin' goin' t' take the seas from me, even if it is a powerful spirit!
translation: 아무리 강한 영혼이라도 나한테서 바다를 빼앗아 갈 순 없어!

english: Anyway, it was decided that we'd setup a base 'ere amongst these ruins, and so the Spirit Anglers was formed!
translation: 아무튼, 이 폐허에 기지를 차리기로 했고, 그렇게 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)이 탄생한 거야!

english: Don't ask me what the ruins used to be. And it's not like Menaphos can 'ave a say!
translation: 이 폐허가 원래 뭐였는지는 묻지 마. 그렇다고 Menaphos(메나포스)가 이래라저래라 할 처지도 아니잖아!

english: Whatever they are, they make a fine base for the Spirit Anglers!
translation: 뭐였든 간에 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼) 기지로는 딱이야!

english: Since moving in, we've been recruiting fisherfolk from all over, and some of the readin' types 'ave been studyin' Tempoross durin' our trips to subdue it.
translation: 여기 자리 잡은 뒤로 사방에서 어부들을 모집하고 있고, 책 좀 읽는 친구들은 그놈을 진압하러 나갈 때마다 Tempoross(템포로스)를 연구하고 있어.

english: I like t' get stuck in, me-self; face off toe t' toe with the beastie. I'll be right by your side when you go out there!
translation: 난 직접 뛰어드는 게 좋아. 그 짐승이랑 정면으로 맞붙는 거지. 네가 나갈 때 바로 옆에 있어 줄게!

english: Well that's encouraging, I think...
I'm still 'ere, ain't I?
translation: 아직 이렇게 멀쩡히 살아 있잖아, 안 그래?

english: Anyway, there's plenty o' research going on, so maybe you can find some notes lyin' around if ye want to know more.
translation: 아무튼, 여기선 연구가 한창이라 더 알고 싶으면 여기저기 굴러다니는 notes(메모)를 찾아볼 수 있을 거야.

english: Goodbye.
Hello again!
Ahoy there! What can I 'elp ye with?
Sorry, it's pretty rough out there and you look like you could do with more experience.
translation: 미안하지만 바다가 꽤 험한데, 넌 경험을 좀 더 쌓아야 할 것 같아.

english: What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 뭐가 필요해, 모험가? 싸워야 할 전투가 있다고!

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 배에 있는 crate(나무 상자)에서 harpoon(작살)을 하나 챙기고, 섬 주변에서 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 낚아. Tempoross(템포로스)를 상대할 훌륭한 탄약이 되거든!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 좀 잡았으면 섬에 있는 제단에서 요리해도 돼. 그러면 한 방이 더 세지지. 그다음 배로 돌아와서 대포 옆에 있는 탄약 상자에 넣어.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 우리 포수들이 Tempoross(템포로스)에게 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 쏴 댈 거야. 그놈이 약해져서 힘을 회복하려고 물속으로 잠기면, 배 옆 부두로 내려가서 그 영혼 웅덩이를 낚아.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 그래도 영혼 웅덩이 낚시는 빨리 끝내야 해. 안 그러면 그놈이 너무 강해져서 돌아오는 바람에 싸움을 포기해야 할 거야! 운이 좋으면 영혼 물고기들을 충분히 약하게 만들어서 Tempoross(템포로스)를 진압할 수 있을 거야. 자, 어서 싸우러 가, 선원!

english: Aye aye!
What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 대포를 감전시켜서 못 쏘게 하면, 다른 탄약 상자에 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 넣어서 다른 대포들이 계속 쏘게 해.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 그리고 배에 있는 상자에서 rope(밧줄)을 꼭 챙기고 큰 파도를 잘 살펴. 파도가 오면 우리가 크게 외쳐 줄게. 그러면 얼른 그 밧줄로 섬의 totem pole(토템 기둥)이나 배의 mast(돛대)에 몸을 묶어.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 파도 때문에 totem pole(토템 기둥)이나 mast(돛대)가 부서지면, 배에 있는 상자에서 hammer(망치)를 꺼내서 다음 큰 파도가 오기 전에 고쳐 놔.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 아, 그리고 번개 구름 때문에 불이 나는지도 잘 봐. 배에 있는 상자에서 bucket(양동이)를 꺼내서 pump(펌프)에서 물을 채운 다음, 불이 번지기 전에 꺼.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 파도나 불에 맞으면 모아 둔 물고기랑 도구를 잃어버려도 놀라지 마. 자, 어서 싸우러 가, 선원!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 정말? 지금 나가면 보상은 하나도 없어.

english: Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 해냈다! Tempoross(템포로스)를 또 한 번 진압했어. 잘했어!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 푹 쉬어. 근데 너무 늘어지진 마. 그놈은 금방 다시 힘을 되찾을 테니까!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 보통 Unkah(운카) 부두 근처에 debris(잔해)가 좀 떠밀려 와. 마음껏 뒤져 봐. 쓸 만한 게 나올지도 몰라!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 머지않아 Tempoross(템포로스)가 다시 골칫거리가 될 만큼 힘을 되찾을 테고, 그럼 또 붙잡아 눌러야 해. 그때도 네가 도와줬으면 좋겠어!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Excellent work out there! The seas are safe for a little longer thanks to you!
translation: 저기서 정말 잘했어! 네 덕분에 바다가 조금 더 오래 안전하겠어!

english: We usually find some debris washed up near the docks. Feel free to have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 보통 부두 근처에 debris(잔해)가 좀 떠밀려 와. 마음껏 뒤져 봐. 쓸 만한 게 나올지도 몰라!

english: Thanks!
Argh, we let that storm grow too fierce... As soon as it's safe we'll 'ead straight back out!
translation: 젠장, 폭풍이 너무 거세지게 놔뒀어... 안전해지는 대로 바로 다시 나갈 거야!

english: Aye aye, Cap'n!
Join the Spirit Anglers!
Plenty of room for more adventurers!
Come and help us fight Tempoross!
It'll be worth your while...
To the boats! We'll set sail soon!
We'll set sail in the next [25/20/15/10/5] seconds.
Let's get underway!
Belay that! We'll try again later.
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 물을 빨아들이고 있어, 다들 준비해!

english: The mast has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has disabled a cannon! Switch to another!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 대포 하나를 못 쓰게 만들었어! 다른 걸로 바꿔!

english: Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 물속으로 잠겼다, 소용돌이에서 물고기를 낚아!

english: Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
Are there any benefits to helping the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)을 도우면 좋은 점이 있나요?

english: Can you remind me what to do on the island?
translation: 섬에서 뭘 해야 하는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Goodbye.
Can you tell me more about the Spirit Anglers?
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)에 대해 더 알려 주실래요?

english: How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Attention! Front and centre!
Yes ma'am!
I have to ask you to get back from here [sir/lady].
Why? What's going on here?
translation: 왜요? 여기서 무슨 일이 있는 건데요?

english: This is the Lizardman Canyon. The lizardmen from the west are desperately trying to invade Great Kourend.
translation: 이곳은 Lizardman Canyon(리자드맨 협곡)입니다. 서쪽의 lizardmen(리자드맨)이 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 침략하려고 필사적으로 덤비고 있습니다.

english: We were able to hold them back, so they've started tunnelling under the kingdom and into this canyon to bypass our defences.
translation: 저희가 놈들을 막아 내자, 놈들은 저희 방어선을 우회하려고 왕국 밑으로 굴을 파서 이 협곡으로 들어오기 시작했습니다.

english: Luckily, we were able to work out what they were doing and move to stop them. So far we've managed to keep them trapped within the canyon, but we need to constantly hold them at bay.
translation: 다행히 놈들의 수작을 알아채고 막으러 나설 수 있었습니다. 지금까지는 협곡 안에 가둬 두고 있지만, 쉬지 않고 저지해야 합니다.

english: I'm a very strong adventurer. Would I be able to help out in the battle?
translation: 저는 아주 강한 모험가예요. 전투를 도울 수 있을까요?

english: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake.
translation: 안 됩니다! 이렇게 중요한 전투를 낯선 사람에게 맡길 수는 없습니다! 걸려 있는 게 너무 많습니다.

english: You may. Head into the canyon and take the fight to those monsters!
translation: 좋습니다. 협곡으로 들어가 그 괴물들과 맞서 싸우십시오!

english: Beware the Chambers of Xeric, adventurer.
translation: Chambers of Xeric(제릭의 회랑)을 조심하십시오, 모험가여.

english: These dungeons and the perils within them are unique. You will encounter both dangerous and mysterious creatures here.
translation: 이 던전과 그 안의 위험은 다른 곳과 다릅니다. 이곳에서는 위험하고도 기이한 생물들을 만나게 될 것입니다.

english: Remember that you may be kicked out at any time - any items dropped on the ground will be lost inside.
translation: 언제든 쫓겨날 수 있다는 것을 명심하십시오. 바닥에 떨어뜨린 아이템은 안에서 사라집니다.

english: Do not allow your curiosity to get the better of you.
Thanks for the warning.
What are you doing up here? Only the palace guards are allowed up here.
translation: 여기서 뭐 하는 거야? 여긴 궁전 경비병만 올라올 수 있어.

english: I am one of the palace guards.
No, you're not! I know all the palace guards.
translation: 아니, 넌 아니야! 난 궁전 경비병을 전부 안다고.

english: I'm a new recruit.
I interview all the new recruits. I'd know if you were one of them.
translation: 신입은 내가 전부 면접을 봐. 네가 신입이었으면 내가 알았겠지.

english: That blows that story out of the water then.
Get out of my sight.
I've had extensive plastic surgery.
What sort of surgery is that? I've never heard of it. Besides, you look reasonably healthy.
translation: 그게 무슨 수술이야? 처음 듣는데. 게다가 넌 꽤 멀쩡해 보이는데.

english: Why is this relevant anyway? You still shouldn't be here.
translation: 그게 무슨 상관인데? 어쨌든 넌 여기 있으면 안 돼.

english: What about the King? Surely you'd let him up here.
translation: 왕은요? 왕이라면 당연히 올라오게 해 주겠죠.

english: Well, yes, I suppose we'd let him up. He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
translation: 뭐, 그래, 왕이라면 올라오시게 하겠지. 보통은 여기 올라오고 싶어 하지 않으시지만, 원하시면 올라오실 수 있어.

english: Anyway, you're not the King either. So get out of my sight.
translation: 아무튼 넌 왕도 아니잖아. 그러니까 썩 꺼져.

english: Yes, I know, but this is important.
translation: 네, 알아요. 하지만 이건 중요한 일이에요.

english: Ok, I'm listening. Tell me what's so important.
translation: 좋아, 들어 보지. 뭐가 그렇게 중요한지 말해 봐.

english: There's a demon who wants to invade the city.
Is it a powerful demon?
Not really.
Well, I'm sure the palace guards can deal with it, then. Thanks for the information.
translation: 그럼 궁전 경비병들이 처리할 수 있겠군. 알려 줘서 고마워.

english: Yes, very.
As good as the palace guards are, I don't know if they're up to taking on a very powerful demon.
translation: 궁전 경비병들이 아무리 뛰어나도, 아주 강한 악마를 상대할 수 있을지는 모르겠군.

english: Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
Yeah, they're--
Wait! How dare you insult the palace guards? Get out of my sight!
translation: 잠깐! 감히 궁전 경비병을 모욕해? 썩 꺼져!

english: It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: 악마와 싸울 건 그들이 아니라 저예요.

english: What, all by yourself? How are you going to do that?
I'm going to use the powerful sword Silverlight, which I believe you have one of the keys for?
translation: 강력한 검 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 쓸 거예요. 그 열쇠 중 하나를 갖고 계신다고 들었는데요?

english: Yes, I do. But why should I give it to you?
translation: 그래, 갖고 있지. 그런데 그걸 왜 너한테 줘야 하지?

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: 점쟁이 Aris(아리스)가 제가 악마를 죽일 운명이라고 했어요.

english: A fortune-teller? Destiny? I don't believe in that stuff. I got where I am today by hard work, not by destiny! Why should I care what that mad old fortune-teller says?
translation: 점쟁이? 운명? 난 그런 거 안 믿어. 난 운명이 아니라 노력으로 이 자리까지 왔다고! 그 미친 늙은 점쟁이가 하는 말을 내가 왜 신경 써야 해?

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: 안 그러면 악마가 도시를 파괴할 거예요!

english: You can't fool me! How do I know you haven't just made that story up to get my key?
translation: 날 속일 순 없어! 네가 내 열쇠를 얻으려고 그 이야기를 지어낸 게 아니라는 걸 내가 어떻게 알아?

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 열쇠를 주실 거라고 했어요.

english: Oh, he did, did he? Well I don't report to Sir Prysin, I report directly to the king!
translation: 오, 그 양반이 그랬다고? 난 Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)한테 보고하는 사람이 아니야. 난 왕께 직접 보고한다고!

english: I didn't work my way up through the ranks of the palace guards so I could take orders from an ill-bred moron who only has his job because his great- grandfather was a hero with a silly name!
translation: 내가 궁전 경비대에서 밑바닥부터 올라온 게, 증조할아버지가 이름이 우스꽝스러운 영웅이었다는 이유만으로 자리를 꿰찬 근본 없는 멍청이한테 명령이나 받으려고 그런 줄 알아!

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: 그럼 그분은 왜 열쇠 하나를 맡기신 거예요?

english: Only because the king ordered him to! The king couldn't get Sir Prysin to part with his precious ancestral sword, but he made him lock it up so he couldn't lose it.
translation: 왕께서 명령하셨으니까 그런 거지! 왕께서도 Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 그 소중한 가문 대대로의 검을 내놓게 하진 못하셨지만, 잃어버리지 못하게 잠가 두라고는 하셨거든.

english: I got one key and I think some wizard got another. Now what happened to the third one?
translation: 열쇠 하나는 내가 받았고, 또 하나는 웬 마법사가 받은 것 같아. 그런데 세 번째는 어떻게 됐지?

english: Sir Prysin dropped it down a drain!
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 그걸 drain(배수구)에 떨어뜨렸어요!

english: Ha ha ha! The idiot!
Okay, I'll give you the key, just so that it's you that kills the demon and not Sir Prysin!
translation: 좋아, 열쇠를 주지. Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 아니라 네가 악마를 죽이게 하려고 주는 거야!

english: Erm I forgot.
Well it can't be that important then.
How do you know?
Just go away.
The castle has just received its ale delivery.
Now that is important. However I'm the wrong person to speak to about it. Go talk to the kitchen staff.
translation: 그거야말로 중요한 일이지. 하지만 그건 나한테 말할 게 아니야. 부엌 사람들한테 가서 말해.

english: I am one of the palace guards.
I'm a new recruit.
I've had extensive plastic surgery.
What about the King?
Yes I know, but this is important.
translation: 네, 알아요. 하지만 이건 중요한 일이에요.

english: There's a demon who wants to invade this city.
Not really.
Yes, very.
Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: 악마와 싸울 건 그들이 아니라 저예요.

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: 점쟁이 Aris(아리스)가 제가 악마를 죽일 운명이라고 했어요.

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city
translation: 안 그러면 악마가 도시를 파괴할 거예요

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 열쇠를 주실 거라고 했어요

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: 안 그러면 악마가 도시를 파괴할 거예요!

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 열쇠를 주실 거라고 했어요.

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: 그럼 그분은 왜 열쇠 하나를 맡기신 거예요?

english: Erm I forgot.
The castle has just received its ale delivery.
What's going on here?
Beyond this wall you'll find the Kebos Lowlands. Most of the region is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
translation: 이 벽 너머가 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)일세. 그 지역 대부분이 lizardman(리자드맨)의 영역이지. 우리는 놈들이 Kourend(쿠렌드)에 들어오지 못하게 지키고 있네.

english: We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but then the fancy historians from the Arceuus Library wanted to go do some research out there.
translation: 예전엔 이 통로를 바리케이드로 단단히 막아 뒀었지. 그런데 Arceuus Library(아르세우스 도서관)의 잘난 역사학자 양반들이 저기 나가서 연구를 하겠다지 뭔가.

english: Soon the farmers joined them, and before you knew it, everyone wanted to go explore. Some of them have even started living out there.
translation: 곧 농부들까지 따라붙더니, 어느새 너도나도 탐험하러 나가겠다고 하더군. 아예 저기서 사는 자들까지 생겼네.

english: I can see it all ending badly, but that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
translation: 결국 끝이 안 좋을 게 뻔히 보이네만, 그게 지식인들의 문제야. 늘 자기들이 더 잘 안다고 생각하거든.

english: Anyway, maybe they'll all get themselves killed. Then we can put the barricade back up.
translation: 뭐, 어쩌면 다들 죽어 버릴지도 모르지. 그럼 barricade(바리케이드)를 다시 세울 수 있겠군.

english: If you go out there yourself, give the lizardmen a kicking from me. They've killed too many of my soldiers.
translation: 자네도 저기 나가거든 내 몫까지 리자드맨들을 혼쭐내 주게. 놈들 손에 내 병사가 너무 많이 죽었어.

english: Beyond these walls is a Lizardman settlement, we're defending against it.
translation: 이 벽 너머에 Lizardman(리자드맨) 정착지가 있네. 우리는 놈들을 막아 내고 있지.

english: Why do they hate humans?
Who knows, all I know is offence is the best type of defence, we will attack soon, will you help us, brave warrior?
translation: 누가 알겠나. 내가 아는 건 공격이 최선의 방어라는 것뿐일세. 곧 공격할 걸세. 우릴 도와주겠나, 용감한 전사여?

english: I don't know... Sounds dangerous.
Oh, the assault is not for a while, go train and prepare, for there will be all sorts of grand rewards from this expedition.
translation: 오, 공격은 한참 뒤일세. 가서 훈련하고 준비하게. 이번 원정에선 온갖 굉장한 보상이 있을 테니.

english: Rewards? I'm in! Hopefully some brand new armour or something.
translation: 보상이요? 할게요! 새 갑옷 같은 거면 좋겠네요.

english: Hmm...
Oh dear, this ship is in a terrible state. And I just can't get the items I need to repair it because Shilo village is overrun with zombies.
translation: 아이고, 이 배 꼴이 말이 아니군. 그런데 Shilo village(실로 마을)에 좀비가 들끓어서 수리에 필요한 물건을 구할 수가 없으니.

english: Hello there shipmate! I sail to Khazard Port and to Port Sarim. Where are you bound?
translation: 반갑네, 뱃동무! 난 Khazard Port(카자드 항구)와 Port Sarim(포트 사림)으로 항해하네. 자네는 어디로 가는 길인가?

english: I see you don't have a ticket for the ship, my colleague normally only sells them in Shilo village. But I could sell you one for a small additional charge. Shall we say [number] gold pieces
translation: 보아하니 배표가 없군. 내 동료는 보통 Shilo village(실로 마을)에서만 표를 파는데, 웃돈을 조금 얹어 주면 내가 한 장 팔 수 있네. [number]골드 정도면 어떤가

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
Sorry me old shipmate, but you seem to be  financially challenged at the moment. Come back when your coffers are full!
translation: 미안하네, 뱃동무. 지금은 주머니 사정이 좀 안 좋은 모양이군. 금고가 두둑해지면 다시 오게!

english: It's a good deal and no mistake. Here you go me old shipmate, here's your ticket.
translation: 이거 확실히 좋은 거래일세. 자, 여기 있네 뱃동무, 자네 표일세.

english: Ok, now you have your ticket, do you want to sail anywhere?
translation: 좋아, 이제 표가 생겼으니 어디 가고 싶은 데라도 있나?

english: Khazard Port please.
Very well then me old shipmate, I'll just take your ticket and then we'll set sail.
translation: 그럼 그러지, 뱃동무. 표만 받고 바로 출항하겠네.

english: You arrive safely in the quiet fishing port of Khazard.
Port Sarim please.
The ship arrives in busy Port Sarim.
translation: 배가 북적이는 Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 도착했다.

english: Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: 지금은 아무 데도 안 갈래요, 고마워요.

english: Very well then me old shipmate, Just let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 그럼 그러지, 뱃동무. 마음이 바뀌면 말만 하게.

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
Very well me old shipmate,  come back if you change your mind now.
translation: 알겠네, 뱃동무. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오게나.

english: Yes, I'll buy a ticket for the ship.
Khazard Port please.
Port Sarim please.
Nowhere just at the moment thanks.
translation: 지금은 아무 데도 안 갈래요, 고마워요.

english: No thanks, not just at the moment.
Can you take me on the glider?
Of course!
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭐예요?

english: Oh we have a whole network! It's wonderful for getting to hard to reach places.
translation: 오, 우리한텐 노선망이 통째로 있거든요! 가기 힘든 곳에 갈 때 정말 좋아요.

english: There are so many places where your teleports cannot reach!
translation: 순간이동으로는 닿을 수 없는 곳이 정말 많아요!

english: How did you all manage to build such an established network?
translation: 어떻게 그렇게 탄탄한 노선망을 만들 수 있었어요?

english: I think you'll find that is a gnome trade secret!
Sorry, I don't want anything now.
Can you take me on the glider?
Why are gliders better than other transport?
translation: 글라이더가 다른 교통수단보다 좋은 점이 뭐예요?

english: Sorry, I don't want anything now.
Do you want to go on a trip to Karamja?
The trip will cost you 30 coins.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
Yes please.
No, thank you.
I'd rather go to Crandor Isle.
translation: 차라리 Crandor Isle(크랜도 섬)으로 가고 싶은데요.

english: No I need to stay alive, I have a wife and family to support.
translation: 안 돼요, 전 살아야 해요. 먹여 살릴 아내와 가족이 있다고요.

english: Well done, matey! Here you go!
Yes please.
No, thank you.
Arrr, 'tis the young [lad/lass] who helped save my crew from that scoundrel, Ithoi! How be ye this fine day?
translation: 아르르, 그 악당 Ithoi(이토이)한테서 내 선원들을 구해 준 젊은 [lad/lass] 아니냐! 이 좋은 날 잘 지내냐?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Arrr, ye looks fine. Stiff in the spine, firm in the mind an' long in the leg. 'Tis good to see ye again.
translation: 아르르, 좋아 보이는구먼. 허리는 꼿꼿하고, 정신은 단단하고, 다리는 길쭉하고. 다시 보니 반갑다.

english: What is there to do here?
Well, ye could maybe explore the ogre caves. Arsen says the ogres be fearsome, though, so watch yer step. An' there be places for ye to train yer skills, over to the west.
translation: 글쎄, ogre(오우거) 동굴을 탐험해 볼 수도 있겠지. Arsen(아르센) 말로는 오우거들이 무시무시하다니까 발밑 조심하고. 그리고 서쪽으로 가면 스킬을 훈련할 곳들이 있어.

english: Thanks.
Eh, goodbye.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is there to do here?
Eh, goodbye.
Good day, Carado.
What are you doing here?
Well, I figured that with Glough being gone and all...
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 좋은 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 별의별 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello there!
Hello! You're not from around here, are you? It's exciting to see that even people from outside of Varlamore are looking to join the Emissaries!
translation: 안녕하세요! 이 근처 분이 아니시죠? Varlamore(바를라모어) 바깥 사람들까지 Emissaries(사절단)에 들어오려고 하다니, 정말 신나요!

english: Well after I heard about all the good work they were doing, I could hardly say no! What about you? What made you want to join them?
translation: 그 사람들이 하는 좋은 일들을 듣고 나니 도저히 거절할 수가 없더라고요! 당신은요? 왜 들어가고 싶었어요?

english: Well it's our duty of course! The Church of Ralos has become lost, but the Emissaries know the truth. Ximoua will not come to be unless we make it so!
translation: 그야 당연히 우리의 의무니까요! Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회)는 길을 잃었지만, Emissaries(사절단)은 진실을 알아요. 우리가 이뤄 내지 않으면 Ximoua(시무아)는 오지 않을 거예요!

english: So you're quite eager to see the end of the world then?
translation: 그러니까 세상의 종말을 꽤 고대하고 계신 거네요?

english: End? Ximoua is no end! It is the beginning! We will all come together as one and bring about a new world! I can't wait!
translation: 종말이요? Ximoua(시무아)는 끝이 아니에요! 시작이에요! 우리 모두 하나가 되어 새로운 세상을 열 거예요! 너무 기다려져요!

english: Well I'm glad to see you're so excited. Good luck with the tests.
translation: 그렇게 들떠 계시니 보기 좋네요. 시험 잘 보세요.

english: And you!
What ales are you serving?
We serve Crombwick's finest Bloody Bracer, that is all.
translation: Crombwick(크롬윅)의 최고급 Bloody Bracer(피 묻은 팔보호대)만 팝니다. 그게 다예요.

english: Sounds rough, how much?
99 of you finest coins.
Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: 좋아요, 그것밖에 없다면 Bloody Bracer(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I said 99 coins! You haven't got 99 coins!
Sorry, I'll come back another day.
Thanks, Carl.
99 coins? That's ridiculous!
What can I say? The ingredients are locally sourced so it's high quality, I promise.
translation: 어쩌겠어요? 재료를 현지에서 조달해서 품질이 좋아요. 정말이에요.

english: Well, I guess I shouldn't shoot the messenger.
translation: 뭐, 전하는 사람을 탓해 봐야 소용없겠죠.

english: So...
What can you tell me about this town?
translation: 이 마을에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: I've not been here long myself, so I'm afraid I may not be of much help.
translation: 저도 여기 온 지 얼마 안 돼서, 별로 도움이 못 될 것 같네요.

english: What happened to the previous barkeep?
Oh, he had to leave.
How come?
Scared of turning.
Turning?
Yes, into a sleeper.
Oh right! You see, for a second there I thought you were talking about vampyres.
translation: 아, 그렇구나! 있잖아요, 잠깐 뱀파이어 얘기를 하시는 줄 알았어요.

english: Ha ha! We, err, don't see many of those types around here. No, no, not at all.
translation: 하하! 저희는, 어, 그런 부류는 이 근처에서 별로 못 봐요. 아뇨, 아뇨, 전혀요.

english: If you say so.
I do. So...
Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
Oh, the red thirst will be upon you soon.
translation: 오, 곧 붉은 갈증이 찾아올 거예요.

english: Excuse me?
Just a jest, traveller.
Oh.
Alright, one Bloody Bracer, if that's all you have.
translation: 좋아요, 그것밖에 없다면 Bloody Bracer(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 주세요.

english: 99 coins? That's ridiculous!
What can you tell me about this town?
translation: 이 마을에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Actually, I'm no longer thirsty.
Hello.
Oh, hello.
You seem upset... What's wrong?
translation: 기분이 안 좋아 보이시네요... 무슨 일 있어요?

english: My son fell ill with the plague...
That's awful, I'm sorry.
It would be easier to cope with if I could have spent his last few days with him.
translation: 마지막 며칠만이라도 아들과 함께 보낼 수 있었다면 견디기가 좀 나았을 텐데요.

english: Why didn't you?
Those mourners came and whisked him away. He didn't even seem that ill, I thought it was a common cold... But the mourners said that he was infected and had to be taken away.
translation: 그 mourners(애도자)가 와서 아들을 데려가 버렸어요. 그렇게 아파 보이지도 않았어요. 그냥 감기인 줄 알았는데... 그런데 애도자들이 아들이 감염됐으니 데려가야 한다고 했어요.

english: Two days later the mourners returned and told me he had died.
translation: 이틀 뒤에 mourners(애도자)가 다시 와서 아들이 죽었다고 하더군요.

english: Again, I'm sorry. Life can be harsh.
translation: 다시 한번 유감이에요. 삶은 가혹할 때가 있죠.

english: Where did the plague come from?
It's down to King Tyras. He and his men brought the plague here from the west, and then left us to suffer. One day he'll pay for what he's done!
translation: 다 King Tyras(티라스 왕) 때문이에요. 그 사람과 부하들이 서쪽에서 역병을 들여와 놓고, 우리가 고통받게 내버려 두고 떠났어요. 언젠가 자기가 한 짓의 대가를 치르게 될 거예요!

english: Have there been many victims of the plague?
You could say that... I've heard reports that half of West Ardougne is infected! Many have lost friends and family...
translation: 그렇다고 할 수 있죠... West Ardougne(서 아르둔) 사람 절반이 감염됐다는 소문도 들었어요! 친구와 가족을 잃은 사람이 많아요...

english: It sounds an awful way to live.
People are very depressed and scared. I've never met anyone fully infected though. I suppose we should be grateful to the mourners for that.
translation: 사람들이 무척 우울해하고 겁에 질려 있어요. 그래도 완전히 감염된 사람은 아직 본 적이 없어요. 그 점은 mourners(애도자)에게 고마워해야겠죠.

english: I hope things get easier for you.
Me too...
Hey Carla, how are you doing?
I'm okay. The loss of my son is something that I'll never be over. At least no one else has to suffer at the hands of those mourners though.
translation: 괜찮아요. 아들을 잃은 건 평생 잊지 못하겠죠. 그래도 이제 그 mourners(애도자) 손에 고통받는 사람은 없잖아요.

english: Where did the plague come from?
Have there been many victims of the plague?
I hope things get easier for you.
Squeak!
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello there.
Is there any chance you could help me?
translation: 혹시 저 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?

english: What's wrong?
It's my husband, he works on a fishing platform. Once a month he takes our son, Kennith, out with him.
translation: 제 남편 때문이에요. 남편은 낚시 플랫폼에서 일하는데, 한 달에 한 번 우리 아들 Kennith(케니스)를 데리고 나가요.

english: They usually write to me regularly, but I've heard nothing all week. It's very strange.
translation: 평소엔 꼬박꼬박 편지를 보내 주는데, 이번 주 내내 아무 소식이 없어요. 정말 이상해요.

english: Maybe the post was lost!
Maybe, but no-one's heard from the other fishermen on the platform. Their families are becoming quite concerned.
translation: 그럴 수도 있지만, 플랫폼에 있는 다른 어부들 소식도 아무도 못 들었대요. 그 가족들도 꽤 걱정하고 있어요.

english: Is there any chance you could visit the platform and find out what's going on?
translation: 혹시 플랫폼에 가서 무슨 일인지 알아봐 주실 수 있을까요?

english: I suppose so, how do I get there?
That's very good of you [player]. My friend Holgart will take you there.
translation: 정말 친절하시네요, [player] 님. 제 친구 Holgart(홀가트)가 데려다줄 거예요.

english: Ok, I'll go and see if they're ok.
translation: 좋아요, 가서 다들 무사한지 보고 올게요.

english: I'll reward you for your time. It'll give me peace of mind to know Kennith and my husband, Kent, are safe.
translation: 수고하신 만큼 보답할게요. Kennith(케니스)와 제 남편 Kent(켄트)가 무사하다는 걸 알면 마음이 놓일 거예요.

english: I'm sorry, I'm too busy.
That's a shame.
Bye.
Bye.
Hello Caroline.
Brave [player], have you any news about my son and his father?
translation: 용감한 [player] 님, 제 아들과 남편 소식은 없나요?

english: I'm working on it now Caroline.
Please bring them back safe and sound.
translation: 부디 두 사람을 무사히 데려와 주세요.

english: I'll do my best.
Hello again.
Hello traveller, how are you?
Not bad thanks, yourself?
I'm good. Busy as always looking after Kent and Kennith but no complaints.
translation: 저도 잘 지내요. Kent(켄트)랑 Kennith(케니스) 챙기느라 늘 바쁘지만 불만은 없어요.

english: Yes.
No.
Hey there. How're you holding up?
Not too bad. Still, I hope we can get rid of these spots soon.
translation: 그럭저럭요. 그래도 이 반점들이 얼른 없어졌으면 좋겠어요.

english: The embalmer has been importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to stop the itching.
translation: embalmer(방부 처리사)가 Ali M(알리 M)이라는 상인한테서 진정 연고를 들여오고 있어요. 가려움을 멎게 해 준다나요.

english: Does it work?
Not even remotely, but it sure does keep the flies away.
translation: 전혀요. 그래도 파리는 확실히 쫓아 주더라고요.

english: Much better now that we've finally got rid of those spots.
translation: 반점이 드디어 싹 없어져서 훨씬 살 만해요.

english: That's great to hear! All the best.
What are you doing?
I thought this acne potion might help ease your spots.
translation: 이 여드름 물약이 반점을 좀 가라앉혀 줄까 해서요.

english: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. That won't work! I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away!
translation: 뭐? 이 참을 수 없는, 구제 불능 멍청이 같으니. 그게 될 리가 없잖아! 눈앞에서 꺼지라고 하고 싶지만 그 정도론 멀지도 않아!

english: I was just trying to help.
Clear off before I give you something to feel sorry about!
translation: 진짜 후회할 일 만들어 주기 전에 썩 꺼져!

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 kebab(케밥)을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: That camel looks vicious, it'll probably eat me if I go too near!
translation: 저 낙타 사나워 보이네. 너무 가까이 가면 날 잡아먹을지도 몰라!

english: I wonder if I can catch something from that camel?
You and whose army mate? You and whose army?
translation: 네가 뭘 어쩌게, 친구? 군대라도 끌고 오게?

english: Oooh, sorry, didn't realise you could hear me?
translation: 어, 미안해요. 제 말이 들리는 줄 몰랐어요.

english: Well I can, so watch what you say in future.
Righto!
Well, I have to say, I am pretty peckish, but thankfully, I don't eat humans... often.
translation: 뭐, 솔직히 꽤 출출하긴 한데, 다행히 난 인간은 안 먹어... 자주는.

english: You'll catch a stiff kick if you talk about me like that again!
translation: 또 나를 그런 식으로 말하면, 옮는 건 몰라도 발길질 한 방은 제대로 얻어맞을 거다!

english: Yes [sir/m'am]? Can I help you at all?
What is this place?
You're in the main waiting area of Keldagrim Carts- station.
translation: 여긴 Keldagrim Carts(켈다그림 광차) 역의 중앙 대합실이에요.

english: Cart-station? What goes on here then?
Keldagrim is the hub of all the traffic of the dwarven realm. Almost every dwarven outpost has railtracks leading to Keldagrim, connecting them all for easy travel and transportation of goods.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)은 드워프 왕국 모든 교통의 중심지예요. 거의 모든 드워프 전초기지에서 켈다그림까지 선로가 깔려 있어서, 편하게 오가고 물자도 실어 나를 수 있죠.

english: Amazing! And what powers the carts? Magic?
translation: 대단하네요! 그럼 광차는 뭘로 움직여요? 마법이요?

english: Oh, no no, we dwarves don't use magic. No, all of this is powered by steam engines, developed during the past few centuries after the Consortium came to power.
translation: 아, 아뇨 아뇨, 우리 드워프는 마법을 안 써요. 전부 증기 기관으로 움직이죠. Consortium(컨소시엄)이 권력을 잡은 뒤 지난 몇 세기 동안 개발된 거예요.

english: Thanks for the info.
Where can you take me?
Let's see, we could let you travel to Ice Mountain, or to the Grand Exchange.
translation: 어디 보자, Ice Mountain(얼음 산)이나 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)로 보내 드릴 수 있어요.

english: I could also let you go to White Wolf Mountain, since you've befriended our brothers there.
translation: White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)으로도 보내 드릴 수 있어요. 거기 있는 우리 형제들과 친해지셨으니까요.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket.
And where would you like to go?
I'd like to buy a ticket to the Grand Exchange.
translation: Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)행 표를 사고 싶어요.

english: Oh, that service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 아, 그건 무료예요. 3번 선로에서 광차에 올라타기만 하면 바로 출발이에요.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to Ice Mountain.
translation: Ice Mountain(얼음 산)행 표를 사고 싶어요.

english: That'll be 150 gold coins please.
I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
I'm sorry, [sir/madam], but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: 죄송하지만 [sir/madam], 표를 넣을 자리가 없으신 것 같네요.

english: Thanks, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 감사합니다. Ice Mountain(얼음 산)행 광차는 1번 선로에서 출발해요.

english: No thanks, I changed my mind.
You're alright, I suppose... I can let you go for 75 coins. And remember, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
translation: 뭐, 당신은 괜찮은 사람 같네요... 75코인에 보내 드릴게요. 그리고 잊지 마세요, Ice Mountain(얼음 산)행 광차는 1번 선로에서 출발해요.

english: I'd like to buy a ticket to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)행 표를 사고 싶어요.

english: That'll be 100 gold coins please.
Thanks. Go to track 4 for carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 감사합니다. White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)행 광차는 4번 선로로 가세요.

english: You're a decent human, I suppose... I can let you go for 50 coins. Go to track 4 for the carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 뭐, 당신은 괜찮은 인간 같네요... 50코인에 보내 드릴게요. White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)행 광차는 4번 선로로 가세요.

english: I have to go.
Just remember, wherever you go, you go there faster through Keldagrim Carts.
translation: 기억하세요, 어디를 가든 Keldagrim Carts(켈다그림 광차)로 가면 더 빨라요.

english: That service is free. Just hop on a cart on Track 3, and away you go.
translation: 그건 무료예요. 3번 선로에서 광차에 올라타기만 하면 바로 출발이에요.

english: Anything I can help you with?
This is the Keldagrim Carts-station, human.
translation: 여긴 Keldagrim Carts(켈다그림 광차) 역이에요, 인간.

english: Out of the way human!
Why, what's happening?
There's important traffic coming through here and I don't want any stray humans distracting me.
translation: 중요한 운행이 지나갈 거라서, 어슬렁대는 인간 따위한테 정신 팔리고 싶지 않거든.

english: Tickets, tickets, get your tickets here!
translation: 표 사세요, 표! 표는 여기서 사세요!

english: Wot you want?
Can't you see I'm 'aving a lil' break?
translation: 나 쪼끔 쉬고 있는 거 안 보여?

english: Now that you mention it, yes.
Then why did ya waste my time?
translation: 그럼 왜 내 시간을 낭비하게 한 거야?

english: Ahoy up there! Would you like to ride our minecart to Keldagrim? It's free.
translation: 어이, 거기 위에! Keldagrim(켈다그림)까지 광차 타고 갈래요? 공짜예요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Ahoy up there! You'd better pick up your follower before you come down here and ride the minecart.
translation: 어이, 거기 위에! 내려와서 광차 타기 전에 따라다니는 동료부터 거두세요.

english: Watch out, [sir/madam]! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: 조심하세요, [sir/madam]! 따라다니는 동료가 광차에 치이면 안 되잖아요!

english: Tickets! Tickets!
Buy your tickets here!
Selling tickets!
Ice Mountain carts departing from Track 1!
translation: Ice Mountain(얼음 산)행 광차, 1번 선로에서 출발합니다!

english: Grand Exchange carts departing from Track 3!
translation: Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)행 광차, 3번 선로에서 출발합니다!

english: White Wolf Mountain carts departing from Track 4!
translation: White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산)행 광차, 4번 선로에서 출발합니다!

english: Mind the cart!
What is this place?
Where can you take me?
I'd like to buy a ticket.
To the Grand Exchange.
To Ice Mountain.
Buy.
Don't buy.
[Charm] Only pay half.
To White Wolf Mountain.
Nowhere.
I have to go.
Grand Exchange (free)
Ice Mountain (150 coins)
White Wolf Mountain (100 coins)
Cancel
Ice Mountain (75 coins)
White Wolf Mountain (50 coins)
Yes please.
No thanks.
Who are you?
I'm an employee of Keldagrim Carts. I make sure the carts in this area run on time and that people pay their fares.
translation: 전 Keldagrim Carts(켈다그림 광차) 직원이에요. 이 구역 광차가 제시간에 다니는지, 승객들이 요금을 제대로 내는지 확인하죠.

english: I don't think I'm allowed to take you into the city of Keldagrim, human. Perhaps when you find another way into the city and talk to someone of importance there you will be allowed to.
translation: 당신을 Keldagrim(켈다그림) 시내로 데려가는 건 허락되지 않을 것 같네요, 인간. 다른 길로 도시에 들어가서 거기 높으신 분과 이야기를 나누고 나면 허락될지도 모르죠.

english: This track leads right up to Keldagrim. Only stop.
translation: 이 선로는 Keldagrim(켈다그림)까지 곧장 이어져요. 정차역은 거기 하나뿐이에요.

english: One ticket to Keldagrim, that's 150 coins then.
I'm sorry, sir, but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: 죄송하지만 손님, 표를 넣을 자리가 없으신 것 같네요.

english: Thanks for your custom!
This is only 75 coins, I can't let you have a ticket for that.
translation: 이건 75코인뿐이잖아요. 이걸로는 표를 드릴 수 없어요.

english: Oh, don't worry. I'll pay you another 75 coins for the next ticket I buy, alright?
translation: 아, 걱정 마세요. 다음에 표 살 때 75코인 더 드릴게요, 괜찮죠?

english: Well... I suppose so.
I can't take you anywhere at the moment.
I can't sell any more tickets right now, I'm afraid.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금은 표를 더 팔 수 없어요.

english: Who are you?
Keldagrim (150 coins)
Keldagrim (75 coins)
Whooooo? Meeeee? Oh, I make sure *hic* the cart traffic proceedsh *hic* in an orderly fishion. Fashion. Yes.
translation: 누우우구? 나아아? 아, 난 광차 운행이 *딸꾹* 질서 정연하게 돌아가도록 *딸꾹* 감독하쥐. 감독하지. 그래.

english: North, north, north *hic* north to Keldagrim!
One ticket to ehm... *hic* Keldagrim. That's 2... 3.... *hic* 100 glittering gold coins!
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)행 표 한 장... 어... *딸꾹* 그러니까 2... 3.... *딸꾹* 번쩍번쩍 골드 코인 100개다!

english: Thanksh a lot human! Remember to come back for more shtout whenever you want! *hic*
translation: 고마워어 인간! 흑맥주 더 마시고 시프면 언제든 또 와아! *딸꾹*

english: Waith a shecond... that'sh only 50 coinsh!
No it's not, you're seeing double from all that drinking, remember? So it's actually 100 coins.
translation: 아니에요, 술을 너무 마셔서 두 개로 보이는 거예요, 기억 안 나요? 그러니까 사실은 100코인이에요.

english: Errr... yesh, I shuppose you're right.
translation: 어어... 그러쿠나, 네 말이 맞는 거 가타.

english: Just remember, wherever you go... ehm... *hic* oh, forget it.
translation: 기억해, 어디를 가든... 어... *딸꾹* 에이, 됐다.

english: Keldagrim (100 coins)
Keldagrim (50 coins)
I buy and sell shields, do you want to trade?
No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello!
Greetings! I'm Cassim. Welcome to my home.
translation: 반가워요! 전 Cassim(카심)이에요. 저희 집에 오신 걸 환영해요.

english: That's a big barrel of wine!
Isn't it just! I'm a bit of a connoisseur.
translation: 그렇죠! 제가 와인에 좀 일가견이 있거든요.

english: Do you make it yourself?
I've dabbled, but this is all imported. I have a connection in the far west who has the best vineyards.
translation: 조금 해 보긴 했지만, 이건 전부 수입품이에요. 저 먼 서쪽에 최고의 포도밭을 가진 연줄이 있거든요.

english: In the west?
Yes! A fine Hosidius grape, strong hints of plum and blackberry, very sweet.
translation: 네! 최상급 Hosidius(호시디우스) 포도로, 자두와 블랙베리 향이 진하고 아주 달콤하죠.

english: Sounds lovely!
How's the tea here?
It's fantastic! Ali really knows how to brew a fine tea!
translation: 끝내줘요! Ali(알리)는 차를 정말 잘 우려요!

english: Which is your favourite?
Well I've supplied him with a small import of mine. I call the concoction 'Zamorak's Fire'.
translation: 음, 제가 직접 수입한 걸 그에게 조금 대 줬거든요. 그 혼합차를 'Zamorak's Fire(자모락의 불꽃)'라고 부르죠.

english: Sounds hot!
Yes, yes. It has a certain kick to it! Although, it'll keep you safe from fire for a short time after drinking!
translation: 네, 그렇죠. 확실히 톡 쏘는 맛이 있어요! 게다가 마시고 나면 잠깐 동안은 불로부터 몸을 지켜 줘요!

english: Great for when dragons attack!
Does that happen often here?
You never know... Dragons can be sneaky.
I'd best be off.
May the flames of Zamorak light your path.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)의 불꽃이 당신의 길을 밝혀 주기를.

english: Er... yeah...
Welcome back.
That's a big barrel of wine!
How's the tea here?
I'd best be off.
The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: 화면이 검게 페이드아웃된다. 컷신에서 Gregg(그레그)가 울타리 쳐진 목재소 안으로 깡충 뛰어든다.

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: 고양이가 가르랑거리는 소리가 들린다. 갈색 어른 고양이가 Gregg(그레그)의 오른쪽(동쪽)으로 두 칸 떨어진 벽 뒤에서 나온다.

english: Meow!
Aha! There we go!
A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
Meow.
Oh! A kitty cat!
Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: 대신 쓰다듬어 줄까? 쓰다듬기라면 자신 있어!

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 고양이를 쓰다듬으려고 다가간다. 고양이가 하악 소리를 크게 내며 그레그를 할퀸다.

english: Hissss!
Aaaah!
Nice kitty...?
The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: 고양이가 다시 하악 소리를 크게 내며 Gregg(그레그)를 할퀸다. 그레그가 왼쪽(서쪽)으로 도망치기 시작하고, 어른 고양이가 그 뒤를 쫓는다.

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
translation: 안 착한 야옹이! 안 착한 야옹이!

english: The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: 카메라가 오른쪽으로 이동하며 다시 검게 페이드아웃된다. 화면이 다시 밝아지면 목재소 앞, 플레이어와 Gregg(그레그)가 있는 장면으로 돌아온다.

english: You pet the cat...
The cat softly purrs between snores.
translation: 고양이가 코를 골다가 사이사이 부드럽게 가르랑거린다.

english: Hmm... Oh yes, that's purrfect.....
translation: 흐음... 아 그래, 거기 아주 완벽하다냥.....

english: Zzz
Miaoww!
What is this place?
It's a desolate, sad place... The peoples here seldom feed me - take me with you!
translation: 황량하고 슬픈 곳이야... 여기 사람들은 나한테 밥을 거의 안 줘. 나 좀 데려가 줘!

english: I'm sorry, I can't take you with me, but I will help if I can.
translation: 미안하지만 널 데려갈 순 없어. 그래도 할 수 있는 건 도와줄게.

english: How are you doing?
Not well, I have to ssssssay, but you look healthy. I wish I were healthy like you.
translation: 솔직히 말하자면 썩, 쓰으으으, 좋진 않아. 그래도 넌 건강해 보이네. 나도 너처럼 건강했으면 좋겠어.

english: What's that awful smell?
*Sniff, sniff* I don't think it's me. All I can smell is dirty vyrewatches tithing the poor humans.
translation: *킁킁* 나는 아닌 것 같은데. 내가 맡을 수 있는 건 불쌍한 인간들한테서 공물을 걷어 가는 더러운 vyrewatch(바이어워치)들 냄새뿐이야.

english: How long have you been here?
As long as I can remember. So far we've not found any way out of this place, and after all, we couldn't leave these poor humans to fend for themselves.
translation: 기억나는 한 계속. 지금까지 여기서 빠져나갈 길을 못 찾았고, 어쨌든 이 불쌍한 인간들을 내버려 두고 갈 수도 없었어.

english: Okay, thanks.
What is this place?
How are you doing?
What's that awful smell?
How long have you been here?
Okay, thanks.
Hello puss.
Want a mouse?
No thanks.
Want this half dead bird?
Errrr... no.
Want this crunched up spider?
Um... not really.
Oh well. Got any tuna?
No.
Hmmmph.
Why yes I do have some tuna.
Give! *purr*
Catch toad for me.
What? I think not...
Nah... my tuna.
Hissss...
Give a tuna to the cat.
Keep the tuna for yourself.
Good but could we go hunting again soon? One of my friends got a medal from Gertrude for catching lots of mice.
translation: 좋아. 그런데 우리 조만간 또 사냥하러 갈 수 있어? 내 친구 하나는 쥐를 잔뜩 잡아서 Gertrude(거트루드)한테 메달을 받았대.

english: How old are you now?
I'm not too old, and not too young. In fact I think I'm just right.
translation: 너무 늙지도, 너무 어리지도 않아. 사실 딱 좋은 나이인 것 같아.

english: Where do you want to go?
Can we go to Varrock sewers and chase some rats?
translation: Varrock(바록) 하수도에 가서 쥐 쫓으면 안 돼?

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to go chase things kill them and then eat them, purrr.
translation: 뭔가 쫓아가서 잡아 죽이고 먹고 싶어, 가르릉.

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 미안한데 인간, 그거 뭘 쓰고 있는 거야?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: cat ears(고양이 귀)를 맞췄어. 멋지지 않냐아아아아옹?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 고양이가 눈 한 번 깜박이지 않고 당신의 눈을 빤히 쳐다본다.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 하나도 안 그래. 당장 벗어, 인간. 내가 인간 귀 한 쌍 구해서 쓰기 전에.

english: How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
You are [player name]?
That's right.
The Great Guardian wants you to know that there has been a development in our fight against the Abyss.
translation: The Great Guardian(위대한 수호자)께서 Abyss(심연)와의 싸움에 진전이 있었음을 당신에게 알리라 하셨습니다.

english: What development?
A magical signal has been detected emerging from the rift. It is not of the Abyss.
translation: 균열에서 마력 신호가 흘러나오는 것이 감지되었습니다. Abyss(심연)의 것이 아닙니다.

english: Then what is it?
Unknown.
Hmm... I was actually hoping to enter the Scar myself. Perhaps I could investigate this signal while I'm in there.
translation: 흠... 사실 저도 Scar(흉터)에 직접 들어가 보고 싶었거든요. 들어가는 김에 그 신호를 조사해 볼 수도 있겠네요.

english: Nothing can survive the Scar. To enter would not be wise.
translation: Scar(흉터)에서는 그 무엇도 살아남을 수 없습니다. 들어가는 것은 현명하지 않습니다.

english: But how do you know nothing can survive? Has anyone actually confirmed that?
translation: 아무것도 살아남을 수 없다는 건 어떻게 알아요? 누가 실제로 확인해 본 적 있어요?

english: There are a few who have entered the Scar in the past. None have returned.
translation: 과거에 Scar(흉터)에 들어간 자는 몇 있었습니다. 아무도 돌아오지 않았습니다.

english: Well then give me a chance to be the first.
translation: 그럼 제가 처음으로 돌아오는 사람이 될 기회를 주세요.

english: If you wish to enter, it is not our place to stop you. In the likely event of your demise, you will be mourned.
translation: 들어가길 원한다면 우리가 막을 일은 아닙니다. 당신이 사망할 가능성이 높으나, 그 경우 애도하겠습니다.

english: Thanks... I think. Anything I should know before entering?
