translation: 고맙... 다고 해야 하나요. 들어가기 전에 알아 둬야 할 게 있을까요?

english: The rift is unpredictable. Normally, you would not be able to control its destination. However, the magical signal coming from within could be of benefit. It could act as a guide.
translation: 균열은 예측할 수 없습니다. 보통은 목적지를 조종할 수 없습니다. 하지만 내부에서 오는 마력 신호가 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 길잡이 역할을 할 수도 있습니다.

english: So you'd be able to send me right to the source?
translation: 그러니까 저를 그 근원으로 곧장 보낼 수 있다는 거죠?

english: Approximately.
Well I suppose that's the best I can ask for.
translation: 뭐, 그 정도면 바랄 수 있는 최선이겠네요.

english: Are you ready to enter the Scar?
Yes.
Then may your death come quick, human. Good luck.
translation: 그렇다면 죽음이 신속하기를, 인간. 행운을 빕니다.

english: No.
Then speak to me once you are.
translation: 그렇다면 준비가 되었을 때 다시 말을 거십시오.

english: Human... you survived the Scar?
I did.
How unexpected. The Great Guardian will need to be informed.
translation: 예상 밖입니다. The Great Guardian(위대한 수호자)께 보고해야겠습니다.

english: In the meantime, do you wish to return to the Scar?
Very well. Good luck.
Speak to me again if you do.
Do you wish to return to the Scar?
Yes.
No.
How can you see properly with such tiny little eyes?
translation: 그렇게 쪼그만 눈으로 어떻게 제대로 보는 거예요?

english: Ooh! Are you [player name]?
Yes.
Everyone's talking about how you helped Zanik save the city! You're a hero!
translation: 당신이 Zanik(자닉)을 도와 도시를 구했다고 다들 난리예요! 당신은 영웅이에요!

english: Have you visited the market? There are visitors selling foods from all over the surface there. It's so exotic!
translation: 시장엔 가 보셨어요? 지상 곳곳에서 온 상인들이 음식을 팔고 있어요. 정말 이국적이에요!

english: Well, I suppose it wouldn't be exotic for you, since you're from the surface.
translation: 아, 지상에서 오셨으니 당신한텐 이국적이지 않겠네요.

english: But you should check it out anyway. Maybe you could sell some of your food. Everyone's crazy about surface food at the moment.
translation: 그래도 한번 가 보세요. 당신 음식도 좀 팔 수 있을지 몰라요. 요즘 다들 지상 음식에 푹 빠져 있거든요.

english: So, what do you think of our city, surface-dweller?
translation: 그래서, 우리 도시 어때요, 지상인 씨?

english: I like it!
That, surface-dweller, was the right answer.
I think it's rubbish.
Well, it beats crawling around on the surface with nothing above your head!
translation: 흥, 그래도 머리 위에 아무것도 없는 지상을 기어 다니는 것보단 낫거든요!

english: What's it like on the surface? It sounds scary to me, having nothing above my head.
translation: 지상은 어때요? 머리 위에 아무것도 없다니, 전 무서울 것 같아요.

english: It's alright.
I'm still not sure it would be for me, though.
translation: 그래도 저한텐 안 맞을 것 같아요.

english: It's not all that great.
Never mind, you can stay down here now!
translation: 괜찮아요, 이제 여기 아래에서 지내면 되잖아요!

english: What do you think you're doing?
Stuns the player, dealing 1 damage.
Help! A thief!
I like it!
I think it's rubbish.
It's alright.
It's not all that great.
Oh dear, oh dear. I hope this dwarf train works properly!
translation: 아이고, 아이고. 이 드워프 기차가 제대로 굴러가야 할 텐데!

english: Look, everyone! It's [player name]!
Everyone's talking about how you rescued Zanik! You're the city's hero again!
translation: 당신이 Zanik(자닉)을 구해 냈다고 다들 난리예요! 또 한 번 도시의 영웅이 됐네요!

english: Visiting Keldagrim is so exciting! I never thought I'd be so far from Dorgesh-Kaan in my life!
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 구경은 정말 신나요! 살면서 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)에서 이렇게 멀리 와 볼 줄은 몰랐어요!

english: These dwarves have so much more advanced technology than us. Look at this train! We could never build something like this.
translation: 드워프들은 우리보다 기술이 훨씬 앞서 있어요. 이 기차 좀 봐요! 우린 절대 이런 걸 못 만들 거예요.

english: Keldagrim's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)은 구경하기엔 정말 좋지만, 거기서 살고 싶진 않아요.

english: Shh! Don't tell anyone!
Don't tell anyone what?
SHHH!
Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: [player name] 맞아? Zanik(자닉) 도와서 도시 구한 사람?

english: Yes, that was me!
When I'm older I'm going to be an adventurer, just like Zanik!
translation: 나도 크면 Zanik(자닉)처럼 모험가가 될 거야!

english: Are you a surface-dweller?
Yes...
Haha! You look funny! All tall and skinny with tiny eyes!
translation: 하하! 너 웃기게 생겼다! 키만 멀대같이 크고 비쩍 말랐는데 눈은 쪼그매!

english: Help! Help! The surface people are attacking!
translation: 살려 줘요! 살려 줘요! 지상 사람들이 쳐들어왔어요!

english: It's alright, I'm friendly!
Sorry, I'm not meant to talk to strangers.
translation: 미안, 모르는 사람이랑 얘기하면 안 된댔어.

english: Have a nice day!
I'm keeping an eye on you, surface-dweller.
Surface-dweller! You will never find your way into the city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 지상인! 너는 절대 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸) 시내로 들어가는 길을 찾지 못할 것이다!

english: Isn't it through that big door?
translation: 저 큰 문으로 들어가는 거 아니에요?

english: Well, yes, but you'll never find your way in!
translation: 뭐, 그렇긴 한데, 그래도 넌 절대 못 들어갈 거다!

english: Surface-dweller! You may not pass through that door!
translation: 지상인! 저 문은 통과할 수 없다!

english: But I thought I was allowed into the city now.
Oh yes, so you are. I'd better say something different.
translation: 아, 맞다, 그렇지. 다른 대사를 해야겠군.

english: *Ahem*
Surface-dweller! You will easily find your way into the city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 지상인! 너는 아주 쉽게 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸) 시내로 들어가는 길을 찾을 것이다!

english: How about that?
Yes, that's much more appropiate.
Hello.
How's the mining going?
I nearly got caught in a rockfall earlier!
Still, since humans started coming down here, the proportion of miners killed in rockfalls has fallen dramatically!
translation: 그래도 인간들이 여기 내려오기 시작한 뒤로 낙석에 죽는 광부 비율이 확 줄었어요!

english: Oh, you know, can't complain.
It's going well. I find repeatedly hitting a piece of rock very therapeutic.
translation: 잘돼 가요. 바위 조각을 계속 내리치다 보면 마음이 아주 편안해지더라고요.

english: Well, don't tell Mistag...
...but actually I wasn't working very hard!
We're a bit behind schedule. If you lent us a hand, Mistag would pay you for your work.
translation: 일정이 좀 밀렸어요. 일손을 좀 보태 주시면 Mistag(미스태그)가 품삯을 줄 거예요.

english: Where do you take all this ore?
To the town of Dorgesh-Kaan, deep in the caves.
translation: 동굴 깊숙한 곳에 있는 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸) 마을로요.

english: Why do you use bones to build with?
Well, our legends say that on the surface there was a substance called 'wood', which grew out of the ground in towers.
translation: 음, 전설에 따르면 지상에는 '나무'라는 물질이 있는데, 땅에서 탑처럼 자라났대요.

english: But we cannot get wood here, so we can only build with stone, bone, and iron.
translation: 하지만 여기선 나무를 구할 수 없어서, 돌이랑 뼈, 철로만 지을 수 있어요.

english: Oh, right.
Giant frogs aren't fearsome!
Perhaps not for a mighty adventurer like you, but we think they're terrifying!
translation: 당신 같은 대단한 모험가한텐 아닐지 몰라도, 우리한텐 정말 무시무시하다고요!

english: How's the mining going?
Where do you take all this ore?
Why do you use bones to build with?
Oh, right
Giant frogs aren't fearsome!
Be careful going in there! You are unarmed, and there is much evilness lurking down there! The evilness seems to block off our contact with our gods,
translation: 그곳에 들어가실 거라면 조심하십시오! 당신은 무장하지 않았고, 저 아래엔 사악한 기운이 도사리고 있습니다! 그 사악함이 우리와 신들 사이의 교감을 막는 듯하여,

english: so our prayers seem to have less effect down there. Oh, also, you won't be able to come back this way - This ladder only goes one way!
translation: 저 아래에서는 기도의 효과가 약해지는 것 같습니다. 아, 그리고 이 길로는 돌아올 수 없습니다. 이 사다리는 한쪽으로만 통하거든요!

english: The only exit from the caves below is a portal which leads only to the deepest wilderness!
translation: 아래 동굴에서 나가는 유일한 출구는 wilderness(황야) 가장 깊은 곳으로만 이어지는 포털입니다!

english: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
translation: 그럼 전 아직 들어갈 만큼 강하지 않은 것 같네요.

english: Well that is a risk I will have to take.
I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.
translation: 그럼 전 아직 들어갈 만큼 강하지 않은 것 같네요.

english: Well that is a risk I will have to take.
Be ye mad? There be Horrors in this cave!
translation: 자네 미쳤나? 이 동굴엔 호러들이 있다네!

english: What do you mean?
Have ye ever heard of the sort of evil, flesh-eatin' horrors that dwell in the darkest pits of the world?
translation: 세상에서 가장 어두운 구덩이에 사는, 살을 뜯어 먹는 사악한 호러들 얘기를 들어 본 적 있나?

english: The sort of dark, sanity-breakin' THINGS that cause the livin' to drop to their knees and weep for the fate of all creation?
translation: 산 자들을 무릎 꿇리고 온 세상의 운명을 위해 울부짖게 만드는, 정신을 박살 내는 그 시커먼 '것'들 말일세?

english: Well, have ye?
Yes, I think I've killed a few of them as well.
translation: 네, 몇 마리 잡아 본 것 같은데요.

english: Well, that's ok then.
But, ye'll need a Witchwood Icon from a slayer master if ye want te go in these caves and live.
translation: 그래도 이 동굴에 들어갔다가 살아 나오려면 slayer master(슬레이어 마스터)한테서 Witchwood Icon(마녀나무 성상)을 받아 와야 할 걸세.

english: Why?
Well, ye see them Jungle Horrors? Well down in the caves there be Cave Horrors.
translation: 자, 그 Jungle Horrors(정글 호러) 알지? 저 동굴 아래엔 Cave Horrors(동굴 호러)가 있다네.

english: They are bigger, badder, meaner, and have a howl that freezes the blood in yer veins.
translation: 놈들은 더 크고, 더 고약하고, 더 사납고, 핏줄 속 피까지 얼어붙게 하는 울음소리를 낸다네.

english: Wearin' earmuffs or a helmet won't work, cos them masks they wear make the sound magical. Only thing that works is wearin' a Witchwood Icon.
translation: earmuffs(귀마개)나 투구를 써도 소용없네. 놈들이 쓴 가면이 그 소리를 마법으로 만들거든. 통하는 건 Witchwood Icon(마녀나무 성상)을 거는 것뿐일세.

english: That is, o'course, if ye can see them, cos if ye don't have any light down there then yer likely te be picked te bones by the insects before the Horrors get ye.
translation: 물론, 놈들을 볼 수 있어야 얘기지. 저 아래에 불빛이 하나도 없으면 호러들이 덮치기도 전에 벌레들한테 뼈만 남게 뜯어 먹힐 테니까.

english: I see, thanks for the warning.
Yer welcome.
Be ye some form of simpleton? Do ye not hear the howlin' of the Horrors?
translation: 자네 혹시 바보인가? 호러들이 울부짖는 소리가 안 들리나?

english: Well, I can hear something now you mention it...
translation: 음, 그러고 보니 뭔가 들리긴 하네요...

english: That be them, howlin', always howlin'!
If ye value yer limbs ye'll put that Icon round yer neck, and hope they don't come out into the light!
translation: 팔다리가 소중하다면 그 Icon(성상)을 목에 걸고, 놈들이 밝은 데로 나오지 않기만 빌게나!

english: Err, all right, I'll get right on that.
Be ye here te deal with the Horrors?
I might well give it a shot.
Aye, well, keep yer Icon with ye if ye wants te walk out alive again.
translation: 그래, 살아서 걸어 나오고 싶으면 Icon(성상)을 꼭 지니고 다니게.

english: Don't worry, I will.
Greetings! Have you come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador's parkland?
translation: 안녕하세요! Falador(팔라도르) 공원의 자연미를 넋을 잃고 감상하러 오셨나요?

english: Um, yes, very nice. Lots of... trees and stuff.
translation: 음, 네, 아주 좋네요. 나무도 많고... 이것저것.

english: Trees! I do so love trees! And flowers! And squirrels!
translation: 나무! 전 나무가 정말 좋아요! 꽃도요! 다람쥐도요!

english: Sorry, I have a strange urge to be somewhere else.
translation: 죄송해요, 갑자기 다른 데 가 봐야 할 것 같은 기분이 드네요.

english: Player runs away from Cecilia
Come back to me soon and we can talk again about trees!
translation: 또 와서 나무 얘기 더 해요!

english: Greetings! If you have come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador’s parkland, then I have bad news.
translation: 안녕하세요! Falador(팔라도르) 공원의 자연미를 넋을 잃고 감상하러 오셨다면, 안 좋은 소식이 있어요.

english: Oh no! What happened?
We got some impromptu visitors to the park. They came out of nowhere and made an awful mess of the place.
translation: 공원에 불청객들이 찾아왔어요. 갑자기 어디선가 나타나더니 공원을 엉망으로 만들어 놨지 뭐예요.

english: They trampled the flowers, startled the ducks, dug new holes in the ground…
translation: 꽃을 짓밟고, 오리들을 놀라게 하고, 땅에 구멍까지 새로 팠어요…

english: That’s terrible. Who are these hooligans?
That’s not all! I had plans to decorate the park for Christmas, and they went and chewed some of the decorations.
translation: 그게 다가 아니에요! 크리스마스를 맞아 공원을 꾸밀 계획이었는데, 그 녀석들이 장식을 몇 개 씹어 놨어요.

english: How deplorable! Wait, did you say ‘chew’? What kind of visitors are you taking about?
translation: 정말 괘씸하네요! 잠깐, 지금 '씹었다'고 하셨어요? 대체 어떤 불청객 얘기예요?

english: Why, they’re dogs of course! I’m quite upset, yet they are so cute that I can’t stay mad. We can’t leave them here, however.
translation: 어머, 당연히 개들이죠! 정말 속상한데, 너무 귀여워서 화를 낼 수가 없어요. 그래도 여기 둘 수는 없어요.

english: I’m going to need some help to find them a place to be, and to clean up afterwards.
translation: 그 아이들이 지낼 곳을 찾아 주고, 뒷정리도 하려면 도움이 좀 필요해요.

english: And you’re about to ask me.
Quite right! So… Will you help?
Oh thank you!
I reached out to one of my acquaintances, Probita, and she confirmed to me that none of these five adorable little tykes have an owner.
translation: 지인인 Probita(프로비타)에게 연락해 봤는데, 이 사랑스러운 꼬맹이 다섯 마리 모두 주인이 없대요.

english: As cute as they are, they cannot just stay here.
translation: 아무리 귀여워도 여기 그냥 둘 순 없어요.

english: Maybe I could take them off your hands?
You can try, but I cannot promise that they wouldn’t attempt to ransack all of your belongings. You saw what happened to the park.
translation: 그래 보셔도 되지만, 그 아이들이 당신 소지품을 몽땅 헤집어 놓지 않는다고 장담은 못 해요. 공원 꼴 보셨잖아요.

english: Good point. I do prefer when my belongings stay in one piece.
translation: 좋은 지적이에요. 제 소지품은 멀쩡한 게 좋거든요.

english: I wonder if they caused so much havoc because they came in as a group.
translation: 그 아이들이 무리로 몰려와서 이렇게 난리를 친 건 아닐까 싶어요.

english: We should be able to manage this by getting each of them a different loving owner and some proper training.
translation: 한 마리씩 각자 다정한 주인을 찾아 주고 제대로 훈련을 시키면 해결될 거예요.

english: I’ve already got a few ideas for potential adopters. Hmm… What if we set up a refining event? An adoption drive!
translation: 입양해 줄 만한 사람도 몇 명 생각해 뒀어요. 음… 새 가족 찾기 행사를 열면 어떨까요? 입양 캠페인이요!

english: That could work!
We could have balloons and decorations, and maybe even nibbles.
translation: 풍선이랑 장식도 달고, 간식거리도 내놓을 수 있겠네요.

english: Wouldn’t the dogs eat the nibbles and chew the decorations?
translation: 개들이 간식은 먹어 치우고 장식은 씹어 놓지 않을까요?

english: You’re right, of course. Then… What if we dressed up the dogs to make them extra cute? Would that distract them enough?
translation: 맞아요, 그렇겠네요. 그럼… 개들을 더 귀여워 보이게 꾸며 주면요? 그러면 정신이 좀 팔리지 않을까요?

english: I don’t know. It might distract them from the decorations, but I don’t think anything could distract them from the nibbles.
translation: 글쎄요. 장식에선 관심을 돌릴 수 있겠지만, 간식에서 관심을 돌릴 수 있는 건 없을 것 같아요.

english: Yes, that is true. Let us not have the nibbles. Besides, the first step is to secure some costumes and a venue.
translation: 네, 그건 그래요. 간식은 빼기로 해요. 게다가 우선은 의상이랑 장소부터 마련해야 하고요.

english: While I try and figure out where the best place to host the event is, could you please check with Party Pete if he would have costumes to lend us? I will also start writing and decorating the invitations in the meantime.
translation: 제가 행사를 열기 가장 좋은 장소를 알아보는 동안, Party Pete(파티 피트)에게 빌려줄 의상이 있는지 물어봐 주시겠어요? 그동안 저도 초대장을 쓰고 꾸미기 시작할게요.

english: On it!
I’d love to, but I’m somewhat busy right now.
Then I will have to wrangle those dogs myself. We can’t leave the park in that state!
translation: 그럼 그 개들은 제가 직접 붙잡아야겠네요. 공원을 저 상태로 둘 순 없어요!

english: Have you come to play music to me?
Yes, I have.
Select the song I asked you to play, and speak to me again.
translation: 제가 연주해 달라고 한 곡을 선택하고 다시 말을 걸어 주세요.

english: No, I'm not interested in that.
Then you must have come to gaze in rapture at the natural beauty of Falador's parkland!
translation: 그럼 Falador(팔라도르) 공원의 자연미를 넋을 잃고 감상하러 오셨나 보군요!

Well hello again adventurer! It's good to see you again! If it wasn't for your quick thinking the treacherous Jones would have poisoned my family and me by now! We are in your debt.

english: Don't worry about it, a good deed is its own reward. And that 2000 gold didn't hurt either.
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요. 선행은 그 자체로 보상이니까요. 뭐, 2000골드도 나쁘진 않았고요.

english: Hello, Ceril.
Oh... I may be wrong... but ever since I asked for your help, things around here have gone from bad to worse...

english: I think you'd better keep out of my way. And for the last time, it's Sir Ceril! Sir! It's not that hard to blooming remember!
translation: 내 앞길을 막지 않는 게 좋을 걸세. 그리고 마지막으로 말하는데, 세릴 '경'일세! 경! 그게 그렇게 기억하기 어렵나, 젠장!

english: Maybe. I could just like swimming around.

english: Please stop.
Reely? And there I trout you were here to sea what you could sea and experience the opportunaty of a lifetime swimming with the fishes.
translation: '참'말이에요? 전 또 당신이 볼 거 다 '바다'보고, 물고기들과 헤엄치는 일생일대의 기회를 '낚으러' 온 줄 알았는데요.

english: Really. Really stop.
What's wrong, do you need a herring aid?
Nooooo....

translation: 에이, 그렇게 '게'거품 물지 마요. 세상 '물'정에도 좀 밝아야죠. 설마 말장난 싫어하는 건 아니죠, 친구?

english: A blenny for your thoughts?
translation: 무슨 생각 해요? '대구'라도 좀 해 봐요.

english: Make it stop.
Ahh, salty I sea. You provoked me into this and now you'll feel the wrasse of my tongue.
translation: 아하, 단단히 '꽁치'셨군요. 먼저 건드린 건 당신이니, 이제 제 혀끝의 '농어'움을 맛보세요.

english: *whimpers*
I'd like to enter a private instance please.
Sorry, but you're really not experienced enough to use my cavern.
translation: 미안하지만, 제 동굴을 쓰기엔 경험이 너무 부족해요.

english: You need level 47 Fishing and level 44 Hunter to enter the fishing cavern.
translation: 낚시 동굴에 들어가려면 Fishing(낚시) 레벨 47과 Hunter(사냥) 레벨 44가 필요해요.

translation: 그러죠, 뭐. numulite(누뮬라이트) 20,000개를 주면 앞으로 영원히 입장료를 안 받을게요.

english: Okay, here's 20,000 numulites.
Thanks - no more entry fees for you!
You've already paid for access for the rest of today. You can come and go all day.
translation: 오늘 하루치는 이미 냈잖아요. 오늘은 마음대로 드나들어도 돼요.

english: I understand. Thanks.
Who are you?
My name is Ceto. I used to be a carefree soul, but now that the twolegs are interested in these little bits of bone, I just keep my little fish farm going and the twolegs pay me a few squid.
translation: 제 이름은 Ceto(케토)예요. 예전엔 근심 걱정 없는 영혼이었는데, 두발족들이 이 작은 뼛조각들에 관심을 갖기 시작한 뒤로는 그냥 이 작은 양어장을 꾸리고 있어요. 두발족들이 '멸치' 몇 푼은 쳐주거든요.

english: Shouldn't you be with your people or something?
translation: 당신 종족이랑 같이 있어야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: Well, they said I was too young to swim with them, and I should be responsible and get a job. They're so old school.
translation: 글쎄, 다들 제가 같이 헤엄치기엔 너무 어리다면서, 철 좀 들고 일자리나 구하래요. 완전 '올드 스쿨'이라니까요.

english: How do I catch fish here?
Ahh well, I've set up a pretty good fish trap here, the terrain really lends itself to it. But you'll need a couple of drift nets.
translation: 아, 그게요, 제가 여기 꽤 괜찮은 물고기 덫을 설치해 뒀어요. 지형이 딱 그러기 좋거든요. 그래도 drift net(유망)이 두어 개 필요할 거예요.

english: How do I get those?
Well I weave mine from my sisters' hair, but you'll have to make do with some plant fibres I guess. I think the twolegs have ways to do that, right?
translation: 음, 전 언니들 머리카락으로 짜는데, 당신은 식물 섬유로 만족해야겠네요. 두발족들은 그걸 만드는 방법이 있죠?

english: Yes, usually we use jute on a loom.
translation: 네, 보통 jute(황마)를 loom(베틀)에 넣어 짜요.

english: Fintastic. You may also find something spikey helps to disturb the fish and make them panic.
translation: 끝내조개요. 그리고 뭔가 뾰족한 걸로 물고기를 휘저어서 겁먹게 하면 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Spikey?
Yes, something with lots of spikes, maybe like a trident.
translation: 네, 가시가 잔뜩 달린 거요. 삼지창 같은 거라든지.

translation: 들어가려면 numulite(누뮬라이트) 200개를 주세요. 그러면 오늘 하루 동안은 몇 번이든 들여보내 줄게요.

translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상도 꽤 많고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 아주 다양해요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.

translation: 쉬이이잇… 신들께서 말씀하고 계시오. 그분들의 속삭임이 들리오.

english: Can you hear them adventurer, they're calling you.
translation: 모험가여, 그대도 들리오? 그분들이 그대를 부르고 있소.

english: Erm... ok!
Go chant at the statue of the god you most wish to represent in this world, you will be rewarded.
translation: 이 세상에서 그대가 가장 대변하고 싶은 신의 조각상에 가서 기도문을 외우시오. 보상을 받게 될 것이오.

english: Once you are done, come back to me. I shall supply you with a mage staff ready for battle.
translation: 끝나면 내게 돌아오시오. 전투에 쓸 마법사 지팡이를 내어 주겠소.

english: Hi.
Hello adventurer, have you made your choice?
I have.
Good, good, I hope you have chosen well. I will now present you with a magic staff. This, along with the cape awarded to you by your chosen god, are all the weapons and armour you will need here.
translation: 좋소, 좋소. 현명하게 골랐기를 바라오. 이제 그대에게 magic staff(마법 지팡이)를 주겠소. 이것과 그대가 택한 신이 내린 망토만 있으면, 여기서 필요한 무기와 갑옷은 다 갖춘 셈이오.

english: Hello again.
Hello adventurer, are you looking for another staff?
translation: 어서 오시오, 모험가여. 지팡이가 하나 더 필요하오?

english: No thanks.
Well let me know if you need one.
Tell me what you know about the charge spell.
translation: charge(차지) 주문에 대해 아는 걸 알려 주세요.

english: We believe the spells are gifts from the gods. The charge spell draws even more power from the cosmos.
translation: 우리는 주문이 신들의 선물이라 믿소. charge(차지) 주문은 우주에서 훨씬 더 많은 힘을 끌어온다오.

english: While wearing a matching cape and staff it will add 50% more damage to that already caused by battle mage spells for several minutes.
translation: 짝이 맞는 망토와 지팡이를 착용하고 있으면, 몇 분 동안 battle mage(전투 마법사) 주문이 주는 피해에 50%를 더해 주오.

english: Good stuff.
What do you have to offer?
No thanks.
Tell me what you know about the charge spell.
translation: charge(차지) 주문에 대해 아는 걸 알려 주세요.

english: Greetings! I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al Kharid.
translation: 반갑습니다! 저는 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 에미르의 재상, Hassan(하산)입니다.

english: It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?
We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
translation: 저희 나름의 소박한 방식으로 견딥니다. 이곳은 부유한 마을이고 물도 있지요. 물은 많은 갈증을 풀어 주니까요.

english: Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?
Kill our warriors? I assume this is some sort of joke?
I'll take that as a no. Forget I asked.
translation: 안 된다는 뜻으로 알게요. 못 들은 걸로 해 주세요.

english: I'd better be off.
Thank you for being a friend to Al Kharid. You are always welcome here.
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 친구가 되어 주셔서 감사합니다. 이곳은 언제든 당신을 환영합니다.

english: Hey, do not treat the Emir's palace like a climbing frame for children, whoever you are!
translation: 여보십시오, 누구신지 모르겠지만 에미르의 궁전을 애들 놀이용 정글짐처럼 대하지 마십시오!

english: Hey, while you have our gratitude for saving the prince, you must earn our trust more fully before the Emir will tolerate you climbing through his windows like a thief!
translation: 여보십시오, 왕자님을 구해 주신 것에는 감사드리지만, 에미르께서 창문으로 도둑처럼 드나드는 걸 용납하시려면 먼저 저희의 신뢰를 더 얻으셔야 합니다!

english: Greetings I am Hassan, Chancellor to the Emir of Al- Kharid.
translation: 반갑습니다. 저는 Al- Kharid(알 카리드) 에미르의 재상, Hassan(하산)입니다.

english: We manage, in our humble way. We are a wealthy town and we have water. It cures many thirsts.
translation: 저희 나름의 소박한 방식으로 견딥니다. 이곳은 부유한 마을이고 물도 있지요. 물은 많은 갈증을 풀어 주니까요.

english: You are welcome. They are not expensive. We have them here to stop the elite guard being bothered. They are a little harder to kill.
translation: 얼마든지요. 그들은 값싼 자들이니까요. 정예 경비대가 성가신 일을 겪지 않도록 그곳에 두고 있지요. 정예 경비대는 죽이기가 조금 더 어렵습니다.

english: You are a friend of the town of Al-Kharid. If we have more tasks to complete, we will ask you. Please, keep in contact. Good employees are not easy to find.
translation: 당신은 Al-Kharid(알 카리드) 마을의 친구입니다. 맡길 일이 더 생기면 부탁드리겠습니다. 계속 연락하며 지내 주십시오. 좋은 일꾼은 구하기 쉽지 않으니까요.

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
It's just too hot here. How can you stand it?
Do you mind if I just kill your warriors?
I'd better be off.
Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.
translation: 도와드릴까요? 사막에서는 분명 도움이 필요하실 텐데요.

english: Hello! Playing solitaire?
Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck.
translation: 쉿, 덱 맨 밑장 빼기를 완벽하게 연습하는 중이야.

english: Hush - I'm trying to perfect the art of dealing off the bottom of the deck. Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: 쉿, 덱 맨 밑장 빼기를 완벽하게 연습하는 중이야. 무슨 용건이든 나중에 다시 와. 그때 얘기해 줄게.

english: Good morning.
Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies!
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬. 도박 친구들 찾는 중이라고!

english: Leave me alone. I'm trying to find my gambling buddies! Whatever you want, come back later and I'll speak to you then.
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬. 도박 친구들 찾는 중이라고! 무슨 용건이든 나중에 다시 와. 그때 얘기해 줄게.

english: Is it true a level 3 skiller caught one of your siblings?
translation: 레벨 3 스킬러가 네 형제 하나를 잡았다는 게 사실이야?

english: Yes, they killed my mummy, kidnapped my brother, smiled about it and went to sleep.
translation: 응, 그들은 우리 엄마를 죽이고, 내 동생을 납치하고, 웃으면서 잠들었어.

english: Aww, well you have me now! I shall call you Squishy and you shall be mine and you shall be my Squishy.
translation: 아이고, 그래도 이제 내가 있잖아! 널 말랑이라고 부를 거야. 넌 내 거고, 넌 내 말랑이야.

english: Come on, Squishy come on, little Squishy!
translation: 이리 와, 말랑아, 이리 와, 우리 귀여운 말랑이!

english: Ssss!
Glub glub!
Swshh!
Whhhhh!
Have you seen my wife Sarah? She's always wandering off...
translation: 제 아내 Sarah(사라)를 못 보셨나요? 늘 어딘가로 사라져 버린다니까요…

english: Very well done, take this.
You've found another clue!
Hello.
Who are you?
Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service [sir/madam]
translation: 자연사학자 Charlie Windar(찰리 윈다)라고 합니다. 무엇이든 말씀만 하세요, [sir/madam].

english: What do you do?

I study the marvelous creatures and plants that are here on this island. There appears to have been a much higher rate of evolution here than on the mainland. I suspect an outside influence from something.
translation: 이 섬에 사는 놀라운 생물과 식물들을 연구하고 있어요. 이곳은 본토보다 진화 속도가 훨씬 빨랐던 것 같아요. 뭔가 외부의 영향이 있었던 게 아닌가 싶네요.

english: We're exploring this island.
What have you found?
Several very interesting species of fungi and insects so far. But I haven't wandered much beyond the camp yet.
translation: 지금까지 아주 흥미로운 균류와 곤충 몇 종을 찾았어요. 하지만 아직 야영지 밖으로는 별로 나가 보지 못했어요.

english: Take the chance to explore!
Who are you?
What is going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: What should I do?
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 아르? 우리 해적 패거리에 한패로 들어오고 싶은 게냐?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 화약 나르는 꼬맹이 녀석이 독주에 취해 난동 부리다 뻗어 자고 있으니, 네 자리는 넉넉하다.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
I got fish, you got gold?
translation: 나한텐 생선이 있고, 너한텐 골드가 있지?

english: Yes.
Yes, but I don't want your fish.
Then what are ye doin' in a fish shop? Looking fer work?
translation: 그럼 생선 가게에서 뭘 하는 거냐? 일자리라도 찾냐?

english: Possibly, do you have any quests?
I dunno, I haven't gone through the last catch yet. What sort of a fish is it?
translation: 글쎄, 지난번 잡은 걸 아직 다 안 훑어봤는데. 그게 무슨 물고기냐?

english: A quest isn't a type of fish!
Then I don't have any, and yer wastin' my time!
translation: 그럼 없다. 내 시간 낭비하지 마라!

english: What happened to your legs?
Ye wanna know what happened to my legs?
translation: 내 다리가 어떻게 됐는지 알고 싶다고?

english: Yer too much of a lilly-livered, hat wearin' landlubber to know what happened to my legs!
translation: 넌 간이 콩알만 한 데다 모자나 쓰고 다니는 뭍쥐라서, 내 다리에 무슨 일이 있었는지 감당 못 해!

english: No I'm not! I've seen some freaky stuff! I can take it!
translation: 아니거든요! 저도 별 해괴한 꼴을 다 봤어요! 감당할 수 있어요!

english: All right, [lad/lass], since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
translation: 좋아, [lad/lass], 그렇게까지 졸라 대니 말해 주지.

english: See, I was clingin' onto a barrel, me ship havin' just had an encounter with this albatross.
translation: 그러니까 난 통에 매달려 있었지. 내 배가 막 그 앨버트로스란 놈이랑 한바탕 얽힌 참이었거든.

english: The sea was thrashin' and wild, but not so wild that I didn't see the fins of some sharks closin' in on me.
translation: 바다는 거칠게 날뛰었지만, 상어 몇 마리의 지느러미가 날 향해 다가오는 게 안 보일 만큼은 아니었지.

english: I managed to yank a sliver of wood from the barrel just as one of them grabbed me from below, but I slipped down the things throat by about two feet before I managed te kill it.
translation: 놈들 중 하나가 밑에서 날 덥석 문 순간, 통에서 나뭇조각 하나를 겨우 뜯어냈지. 하지만 그놈을 죽이기 전까지 놈의 목구멍 속으로 두 발쯤 미끄러져 들어갔다.

english: How did you survive?
A passin' ship saw the sharks and knew there would be survivors in the water. They sent a longboat and picked me up, but not before the sharks had taken off my legs.
translation: 지나가던 배 한 척이 상어 떼를 보고 물에 생존자가 있겠다 싶었던 거지. 보트를 내려 날 건져 냈는데, 그 전에 상어들이 내 다리를 뜯어 가 버렸지.

english: And that [lad/lass] is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: 그래서 말이다, [lad/lass], 다들 날 '두 발 찰리'라고 부르는 거다. 상어 목구멍 속 두 발 깊이에 처박혀 있는 날 찾아냈으니까.

english: I think I'm gonna be sick...
I knew ye couldn't handle the truth!
translation: 네가 진실을 감당 못 할 줄 알았지!

english: Yes.
Yes, but I don't want your fish.
What happened to your legs?
Hi!
Yes, er, welcome to the zoo! I'm afraid I'm kind of busy right now; what was it you wanted?
translation: 네, 어, 동물원에 오신 걸 환영해요! 죄송하지만 지금 좀 바빠서요. 무슨 일이시죠?

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 아, 퀘스트를 맡길 사람이 필요한 것 같은 말투네요!

english: Well... maybe. How much do you know about hunting?
translation: 음… 그럴지도요. 사냥에 대해선 얼마나 아세요?

english: Well I know a little bit...
No, I could do with some help, but I'm afraid I need somebody with a little more experience.
translation: 아뇨, 도움이 필요하긴 한데, 아무래도 경험이 좀 더 많은 사람이 필요해요.

english: Actually, now that you come to mention it, you might be able to help me.
translation: 사실, 그러고 보니 당신이 도와줄 수 있을지도 모르겠네요.

english: A few weeks ago we had a delivery of a northern ferret. They're funny little creatures. Turns out they're tricksy little blighters too.
translation: 몇 주 전에 북방 족제비 한 마리가 배달됐어요. 참 재미있는 녀석들이죠. 알고 보니 아주 교활한 말썽꾼이기도 하더라고요.

english: Whilst we were unloading him from the cart he managed to escape his cage. What's more he gave the driver a nasty nip on the way out too.
translation: 수레에서 내리는 사이에 녀석이 우리를 빠져나가 도망쳤어요. 게다가 나가면서 마부를 아주 세게 물기까지 했죠.

english: This was obviously a bit of a blow, you can't make a new attraction without any animals.
translation: 당연히 꽤 큰 타격이었죠. 동물 없이 새 볼거리를 만들 순 없으니까요.

english: We got in contact with one of our associates, a huntsman called Nickolaus, who agreed to capture us another.
translation: 그래서 거래처 중 한 분인 Nickolaus(니콜라우스)라는 사냥꾼에게 연락했더니, 한 마리 더 잡아 주겠다고 했어요.

english: Funny thing is we haven't heard from him for some time now. I don't suppose you'd mind having a look for him?
translation: 그런데 이상하게도 한동안 그분 소식이 없네요. 혹시 그분을 좀 찾아봐 주실 수 있을까요?

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
Well the northern ferret is mostly found around the mountains just west of the Gnome Stronghold, so that would probably be as good a place as any to start looking.
translation: 음, 북방 족제비는 주로 Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새) 바로 서쪽 산악 지대에 살아요. 그러니 거기서부터 찾아보는 게 제일 좋을 거예요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Sorry, I don't have the time.
Oh well, I'm sure he'll be okay out there on his own.
Where did you get the animals from?
We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: 온갖 곳에서 데려와요! 가장 희귀한 동물들은 탐험가들이 데려와서 저희한테 팔았죠.

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: 도대체 Gielinor(길리노르) 어디서 저렇게 무섭게 생긴 Cyclops(사이클롭스)를 데려오신 거예요?!

english: Yes he is scary looking!
He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: 아주 먼 나라에서 왔는데, 더 알아낼 수가 없었어요. 데려온 탐험가가 얼마 안 가 죽어 버렸거든요!

english: Hi, how are you getting on with that ferret?
Well he seems to be just as vicious as the one we lost, but we're still very grateful for your help in acquiring him.
translation: 음, 잃어버린 녀석만큼이나 사나운 것 같지만, 녀석을 구하는 걸 도와주셔서 여전히 정말 감사하고 있어요.

english: Hey, I've got another ferret if you're interested?
translation: 저기, 족제비가 한 마리 더 있는데 필요하세요?

english: Er, oh! Well that's very kind of you, but we don't really need another ferret at the moment, I'm afraid. We're having enough trouble taming the one we've got.
translation: 어, 오! 정말 친절하시네요. 그런데 죄송하지만 지금은 족제비가 더 필요하진 않아요. 있는 녀석 길들이는 것만으로도 벅차거든요.

english: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
translation: 아, 퀘스트를 맡길 사람이 필요한 것 같은 말투네요!

english: Sure. Any idea where I should start looking?
Sorry, I don't have the time.
Where did you get the animals from?
Hello! Who are you?
Hello! The name's Charlie Brown and I've just arrived in Kourend.
translation: 안녕하세요! 제 이름은 Charlie Brown(찰리 브라운)이고, 막 Kourend(쿠렌드)에 도착했어요.

english: Nice to meet you Charlie, my name is [player name]. What are you doing here?
translation: 반가워요, Charlie(찰리). 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 여기서 뭘 하고 계세요?

english: I've come to Kourend in search of luck, [player name]. I seek many fortunes and as you know you need luck to find fortune!
translation: 운을 찾아 Kourend(쿠렌드)에 왔어요, [player name]님. 전 큰 재물을 많이 찾고 있는데, 아시다시피 재물을 찾으려면 운이 따라야 하잖아요!

english: If you're searching for luck, why are you dressed as a monk?
translation: 운을 찾는다면서 왜 수도승 옷을 입고 있어요?

english: Ah these robes keeps me holy, I must remain holy when praying to the God of Luck, [player name].
translation: 아, 이 로브가 저를 경건하게 지켜 줘요. 행운의 신께 기도하려면 늘 경건해야 하거든요, [player name]님.

english: God of Luck? I don't think I've heard of such a God...
translation: 행운의 신이요? 그런 신은 들어 본 적이 없는데요…

english: Ah, would you perhaps allow me to enlighten you?
translation: 아, 제가 깨우침을 좀 드려도 될까요?

english: Sure.
Arengeesus, God of luck. We do not know much about her or where she comes from, we just know she is there looking over us.
translation: 행운의 신, Arengeesus(아렌지서스). 그분이 어떤 분인지, 어디서 오셨는지는 저희도 잘 몰라요. 그저 그분이 저희를 지켜보고 계신다는 것만 알 뿐이죠.

english: Those who praise Arengeesus enough to get her attention are rewarded. She will gaze down upon you providing you with luck on your adventures.
translation: Arengeesus(아렌지서스)의 관심을 끌 만큼 열심히 찬양하는 자는 보상을 받아요. 그분께서 내려다보시며 당신의 모험에 행운을 내려 주실 거예요.

english: That sounds a little farfetched to me, luck isn't a thing. Hard work is all you need.
translation: 저한텐 좀 억지스럽게 들리네요. 운 같은 건 없어요. 필요한 건 노력뿐이죠.

english: Perhaps working hard is merely a form of praise to the God of luck, [player name].
translation: 어쩌면 열심히 일하는 것 자체가 행운의 신을 찬양하는 한 방식일지도 모르죠, [player name]님.

english: Hmmm... well good luck Charlie. Good bye!
translation: 흠… 뭐, 행운을 빌어요, Charlie(찰리). 안녕히 계세요!

english: Farewell [player name], may Arengeesus shine down upon you.
translation: 잘 가요, [player name]님. Arengeesus(아렌지서스)께서 당신을 비춰 주시길.

english: And you!
Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 다음에 얘기해요. 이만 가 봐야 해서요.

english: Very well, farewell.
Sure.
Maybe another time, I must be going.
translation: 다음에 얘기해요. 이만 가 봐야 해서요.

english: Spare some change guv?
translation: 잔돈 좀 있으면 보태 줄래요, 나리?

english: Who are you?
Charles. Charles E. Trampin' at your service. Now, about that change you were going to give me...
translation: Charles(찰스)요. Charles E. Trampin'(찰스 E. 트램핀), 무엇이든 분부만 내리세요. 그나저나 나한테 주려던 그 잔돈 말인데요…

english: Sorry, I haven't got any.
Thanks anyway.
Go get a job!
You startin? I hope your nose falls off!
translation: 시비 거는 거요? 코나 확 떨어져 버려라!

english: Ok. Here you go.
Hey, thanks a lot!
No problem.
So...don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: 그래서… 이제 퀘스트 힌트 같은 거 안 주시는 거예요?

english: Huh? What do you mean? That wasn't why I asked you for money.
translation: 응? 무슨 소리예요? 그거 바라고 돈 달라고 한 거 아닌데.

english: I just need to eat...
Oh wait. I haven't got any, sorry.
translation: 아, 잠깐만요. 가진 게 없네요, 미안해요.

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
Funny you should mention that...there is actually.
translation: 마침 그 얘기를 하다니 재밌네요… 사실 있어요.

english: The ruthless and notorious criminal gang known as the Black Arm Gang have their headquarters down there.
translation: Black Arm Gang(검은 팔 갱단)이라고, 무자비하기로 악명 높은 범죄 조직의 본거지가 저 안에 있어요.

english: Thanks for the warning!
Don't worry about it.
Do you think they would let me join?
You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her.
translation: 그야 모르죠. 저 안에 가면 Katrine(카트린)이라는 여자가 있을 거예요. 그 여자한테 말해 봐요.

english: But don't upset her, she's pretty dangerous.
translation: 그래도 성질 건드리진 말아요. 꽤 위험한 여자니까.

english: I was under the impression you were already a member...
No. You're a collaborator with the Phoenix Gang. There's no way they'll let you join now.
translation: 아니요. 당신은 Phoenix Gang(피닉스 갱단)이랑 한패잖아요. 이제 저들이 당신을 받아 줄 리가 없죠.

english: How did YOU know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 제가 Phoenix Gang(피닉스 갱단)에 있는 걸 대체 '당신'이 어떻게 알았어요?

english: In my current profession I spend a lot of time on the streets and you hear these sorta things sometimes
translation: 지금 하는 일이 일이다 보니 거리에서 시간을 많이 보내거든요. 그러다 보면 이런 얘기도 가끔 들려요.

english: Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: 그럼 저 안에 들어갈 방법 없을까요?

english: Hmmm. I dunno.
Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Phoenix Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Black Arm Gang for you.
translation: 제일 좋은 방법은 다른 사람을 찾는 거겠죠… Phoenix Gang(피닉스 갱단) 조직원이 '아닌' 사람을 찾아서, 대신 Black Arm Gang(검은 팔 갱단)에 잠입시키는 거예요.

english: If you find someone like that, tell 'em to come to me first.
translation: 그런 사람을 찾으면 먼저 나한테 오라고 전해요.

english: Ok. Good plan!
I'm not just a pretty face!
Like who?
There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.
translation: 당신 말고도 모험가는 널렸어요. 그중 하나한테 잘 부탁하면 분명 도와줄 거예요.

english: Please [sir/madam], can you help me.
What can I do for you?
I really need a cooked trout.
I really need a cooked pike.
I really need a raw herring
I really need a raw trout.
I really need some leather chaps.
I really need a leather body.
I really need an iron dagger.
I really need a piece of iron ore.
translation: iron ore(철광석) 한 덩이가 정말 필요해요.

english: Sure, I'll be glad to help a person in need.
translation: 물론이죠, 어려운 분을 돕는 거라면 기꺼이요.

english: You give Charlie the [item].
Charlie gives you a [new clue/casket]!
Thank you so much [sir/madam].
Who are you?
Sorry, I haven't got any.
Go get a job!
Ok. Here you go.
No problem.
Don't I get some sort of quest hint or something now?
translation: 이제 퀘스트 힌트 같은 거 안 주시는 거예요?

english: Is there anything down this alleyway?
Thanks for the warning!
How did you know I was in the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 제가 Phoenix Gang(피닉스 갱단)에 있는 걸 어떻게 알았어요?

english: Ok. Good plan!
Like who?
Any ideas how I could get in there then?
translation: 그럼 저 안에 들어갈 방법 없을까요?

english: Do you think they would let me join?
Hello?
Hey! You haven't paid your Magic Training Arena Membership money!
translation: 야! 너 Magic Training Arena(마법 훈련 경기장) 회비 안 냈잖아!

english: You're lying. I can see right through you!
Oh, HA HA, very funny.
Can't you see I'm busy?
Well, I can't really see YOU.
Is there anybody there?
What do you think?
Wooo wooo! Be afraid for I'm a scary ghost. Wooo!
translation: 우우우 우우! 두려워해라, 나는 무시무시한 유령이다. 우우!

english: Er, whatever.
Checkal stares at you intensely.
You best not be here to start any trouble [sir/miss].
Wouldn't dream of it.
[player name], I am so glad to see you are safe.
translation: [player name]님, 무사한 걸 보니 정말 다행이에요.

english: Hello, Checkal. Why didn't you tell me about Willow?
translation: 안녕하세요, Checkal(체칼). Willow(윌로)에 대해선 왜 말 안 해 줬어요?

english: I thought we were friends...
I am sorry [player name]. I do respect you and your love for the muscle. But sadly I needed the money. These muscles don't pay the bills on their own.
translation: 미안해요, [player name]님. 전 정말 당신과 당신의 근육 사랑을 존중해요. 하지만 안타깝게도 돈이 필요했어요. 이 근육이 알아서 청구서를 내 주진 않으니까요.

english: Oh, I understand...
Please do not let this incident divert you from your path of becoming a strongman! I truly believe in you.
translation: 부디 이번 일 때문에 스트롱맨이 되는 길에서 벗어나지 말아요! 전 진심으로 당신을 믿어요.

english: GOAL
[Player name] Wins
Sorry, I can't stop to talk.
translation: 미안해요, 지금은 멈춰서 얘기할 틈이 없어요.

english: Thank you for bringing Artur home safe.
translation: Artur(아르투르)를 무사히 집에 데려와 줘서 고마워요.

english: Hello.
Hello there. It's sad not having Artur around anymore, not to mention the awful business with his father. I hope he's coping okay with that.
translation: 안녕하세요. Artur(아르투르)가 없으니 쓸쓸하네요. 그 애 아버지 일로 끔찍한 일까지 있었으니 말이에요. 그 애가 잘 견디고 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: I'm sure he'll be fine.
Hi, I need fuel for a lamp.
Hello there, the fuel you need is lamp oil, do you need help making it?
translation: 안녕하세요, 필요한 연료는 lamp oil(램프 기름)이에요. 만드는 걸 도와드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
It's really quite simple.  You use the small still in here.  It's all set up, so there's no fiddling around with dials...
translation: 정말 간단해요. 여기 있는 작은 증류기를 쓰면 돼요. 다 맞춰 놨으니까 다이얼을 이리저리 만질 필요도 없어요...

english: Just put ordinary swamp tar in, and then use a lantern or lamp to get the oil out.
translation: 평범한 swamp tar(늪 타르)를 넣고, lantern(랜턴)이나 lamp(등불)로 기름을 받아 내기만 하면 돼요.

english: Thanks.
No thanks.
Hello.
Oh.. hello, how's it going?
Good thanks.
Good to hear, sorry but I have a few things to do right now.
translation: 다행이네요. 미안하지만 지금 해야 할 일이 좀 있어서요.

english: Well I'd better let you get on then.
translation: 그럼 일 보시게 전 이만 갈게요.

english: I have a slightly odd question.
Jolly good, the odder the better. I like oddities.
translation: 아주 좋아요, 이상할수록 좋죠. 전 별난 걸 좋아하거든요.

english: Do you know how I might distil a mix of anchovy oil and flowers so that it forms a layer on the inside of a butterfly jar?
translation: anchovy oil(멸치 기름)과 꽃을 섞은 걸 증류해서 butterfly jar(나비 병) 안쪽에 막을 입히려면 어떻게 해야 하는지 아세요?

english: That is an odd question. I commend you for it. Why would you want to do that?
translation: 그거 참 이상한 질문이네요. 칭찬해 드리죠. 그런데 그건 왜 하려는 거예요?

english: Apparently, if I can make a jar like this it will be useful for storing implings in.
translation: 그런 병을 만들면 implings(임플링)을 담아 두기에 좋대요.

english: So, do you have any of this fish-and-flower flavoured oil and a butterfly jar then?
translation: 그래서, 그 생선이랑 꽃 향 나는 기름이랑 butterfly jar(나비 병)은 갖고 있어요?

english: As it happens, I do.
Well then. Hmmm. My lamp oil still may be able to do what you want. Give it a go and see if it works.
translation: 그렇다면야. 흐음. 제 lamp oil still(램프 기름 증류기)로 원하는 걸 할 수 있을지도 몰라요. 한번 해 보고 되는지 확인해 봐요.

english: Thanks!
Actually, no.
If you go and get them then I may be able to help you. I'm better at coming up with answers if the questions are in my hands.
translation: 가서 구해 오면 도와드릴 수 있을지도 몰라요. 전 질문을 손에 직접 쥐고 있어야 답이 더 잘 떠오르거든요.

english: So, how do you make anchovy oil?
translation: 그럼, anchovy oil(멸치 기름)은 어떻게 만들어요?

english: Anchovies are pretty oily fish. I'd have thought you could just grind them up and sieve out the bits. You'd probably want to remove any water first - Cooking should do that pretty well.
translation: Anchovies(멸치)는 꽤 기름진 생선이에요. 그냥 갈아서 체로 찌꺼기를 걸러 내면 될 것 같은데요. 그 전에 물기를 빼는 게 좋을 텐데, Cooking(요리)로 하면 꽤 잘 빠질 거예요.

english: Do you have a sieve I can use?
Errm, yes. But you already have one. Two sieves is a bit excessive, don't you think?
translation: 어, 있긴 한데요. 이미 하나 갖고 있잖아요. 체가 두 개면 좀 지나치지 않아요?

english: Are you sure you don't already have one?
translation: 정말 이미 하나 갖고 있지 않은 거 맞아요?

english: Errm, yes. Here, have this one. It's only been used for sieving dead rats out of sewer water.
translation: 어, 있어요. 자, 이거 가져가요. 하수도 물에서 죽은 쥐 건져 내는 데만 쓴 거예요.

english: Err, why? Actually, on second thoughts I don't want to know.
translation: 어, 왜요? 아니, 다시 생각해 보니 알고 싶지 않네요.

english: Well, it should be ideally suited to your task.
translation: 뭐, 지금 하려는 일엔 딱 맞을 거예요.

english: Fair enough.
I'd better go and get the repellent.
I think so.
Well done, have this.
Yes.
Yes please.
No thanks.
No.
No, I'm more interested in impling jars.
translation: 아뇨, 저는 impling jars(임플링 병)에 더 관심 있어요.

english: So how do you make anchovy oil?
translation: 그럼 anchovy oil(멸치 기름)은 어떻게 만들어요?

english: Do you have a sieve I can use?
I'd better go and get the repellent.
Hello, what are you doing here?
Hi there, my husband and I are adventurers, Captain Janaway brought us here.
translation: 안녕하세요, 저랑 남편은 모험가예요. Captain Janaway(재너웨이 선장)님이 여기로 데려다주셨어요.

english: What brings you to Great Kourend?
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에는 어쩐 일로 오셨어요?

english: New lands to explore of course! Isn't it exciting? A whole new world that we know nothing about just waiting for us to discover it!
translation: 당연히 새로운 땅을 탐험하러 왔죠! 정말 신나지 않아요? 우리가 아무것도 모르는 완전히 새로운 세상이 발견되기만을 기다리고 있다니까요!

english: What you want, skinny creature?
What is this place?
Dis our home. It comfy, though we thinking of maybe getting more space up on land, above. But silly Corsair men live up there an' think dey own whole place.
translation: 여기 우리 집. 아늑해. 근데 위에, 땅 위에 자리 더 얻을까 생각 중. 근데 멍청한 Corsair(코르세어) 인간들 거기 살면서 자기들이 다 주인인 줄 알아.

english: Maybe one day dat gonna change. Tess got plans.
translation: 언젠가 그거 바뀔지도. Tess(테스) 계획 있어.

english: Thanks.
I'll leave you alone, sorry.
What is this place?
I'll leave you alone, sorry.
Welcome to the Ardougne Domestic Service Agency!
translation: Ardougne Domestic Service Agency(아르둔 가사 도우미 소개소)에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

english: Tell me about servants.
Do you need help around your house? Our trained, efficient workers are ready to serve you.
translation: 집안일에 도움이 필요하십니까? 잘 훈련된 유능한 일꾼들이 손님을 모실 준비가 되어 있습니다.

english: They can cook meals for you and your friends, make tea, serve drinks, greet guests, and even take items to and from the bank for you.
translation: 손님과 친구분들을 위해 식사를 준비하고, 차를 끓이고, 음료를 내오고, 손님을 맞이하며, 은행에 물건을 맡기거나 찾아오는 일까지 해 드립니다.

english: The more expensive servants will be able to make trips to the bank more quickly. Some of them can also go to the sawmill to change logs to planks for you.
translation: 비싼 하인일수록 은행을 더 빨리 다녀옵니다. 일부는 제재소에 가서 통나무를 판자로 바꿔 오기도 합니다.

english: Remember, you'll need to keep paying your servant. You pay them once when you hire them, and then they'll periodically ask for wages. You can dismiss your servant at any time.
translation: 하인에게는 계속 급료를 지불하셔야 한다는 점을 기억해 주십시오. 고용하실 때 한 번 지불하시고, 그 뒤로는 하인이 주기적으로 급료를 요구할 것입니다. 하인은 언제든지 해고하실 수 있습니다.

english: I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.
Oh dear, are you sure?
Yes, I want to dismiss my servant.
Very well, you no longer have a servant.
No, I'll keep my servant for now.
Can I hire a servant?
Do you even own a house? These are strictly domestic servants; they won't follow you around the world!
translation: 애초에 집은 갖고 계십니까? 저희 하인들은 엄연히 가사 전문입니다. 세상 곳곳까지 손님을 따라다니지는 않습니다!

english: First you'll need to make sure you have a servant's room. A servant will automatically take the second-best bedroom, leaving the best for yourself, of course! So you will need to build two bedrooms in your house.
translation: 먼저 하인이 쓸 방이 있어야 합니다. 하인은 자동으로 두 번째로 좋은 침실을 쓰고, 가장 좋은 방은 당연히 손님께 남겨 둡니다! 그러니 집에 침실을 두 개 지으셔야 합니다.

english: According to our records, one of our people is already working for you. If you want to hire a different one you will have to dismiss them.
translation: 기록에 따르면 저희 직원 한 명이 이미 손님 댁에서 일하고 있습니다. 다른 하인을 고용하시려면 지금 하인을 해고하셔야 합니다.

english: Certainly! We have a number of servants here now looking for work. Why not have a chat to them and see which one you would like to hire?
translation: 물론입니다! 지금 여기에 일자리를 찾는 하인이 여럿 있습니다. 직접 이야기를 나눠 보시고 누구를 고용하실지 정해 보시는 게 어떻겠습니까?

english: Thank you.
Tell me about servants.
I'd like to dismiss my servant, please.
Yes, I want to dismiss my servant.
No, I'll keep my servant for now.
Can I hire a servant?
Thank you.
Hello there.
I'm not allowed to speak with strangers.
I'm not allowed to speak with Mourners.
Hello there. How's it going?
I don't know you.
I don't want to talk to you.
I shouldn't be talking to you.
I shouldn't speak with strangers.
I'm not allowed to talk to strangers.
translation: 모르는 사람이랑 얘기하면 안 된단 말이에요.

english: I shouldn't speak with humans.
I'm not allowed to talk to your kind.
Mummy said I should stay away from humans.
He-he-hello?
Hello, I wondered if I could have a chat.
translation: 안녕, 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까?

english: Well, I guess so.
Argghghhh!
Hey, don't be scared, I just want to talk to you.
translation: 얘, 무서워하지 마. 그냥 얘기 좀 하고 싶어서 그래.

english: Leave me alone!
Sorry but I need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: 미안하지만 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어.

english: Get off me! I haven't got anything!
Hey, calm down, I'm not going to hurt you. I just want to ask a few questions.
translation: 얘, 진정해. 해치려는 거 아니야. 그냥 몇 가지 물어보고 싶을 뿐이야.

english: What do you do here?
I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, and you sure are strange...
translation: 낯선 사람이랑 얘기하면 안 되는데, 당신은 진짜 낯설게 생겼네...

english: Nuffin'! I wasn't doin' nuffin'!
I 'elp wiv building fings an' da wall. But mainly I is hiding from da vyresies. I don't like dem vyresies.
translation: 건물 짓는 거랑 벽 쌓는 거 도와요. 근데 거의 맨날 바이어쟁이들한테서 숨어 있어요. 바이어쟁이들 싫어요.

english: I was playin', but den da flapsies came so I was hidin'. Don't want da flapsies to bit me.
translation: 놀고 있었는데, 펄럭이들이 와서 숨었어요. 펄럭이들한테 물리기 싫어요.

english: I'm lost, can you help me?
Urm, well I fink we're in sector [one/two/three/six]. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
translation: 음, 여기 [one/two/three/six]구역 같아요. 더는 뭐라고 해야 할지 모르겠어요. 난 그냥 애란 말이에요!

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, me dad says I'm not allowed to talk about that. Do you have any sweets?
translation: 어, 아빠가 그건 얘기하면 안 된댔어요. 사탕 있어요?

english: No, sorry, but please can you answer my questions?
translation: 아니, 미안. 그래도 내 질문에 대답해 줄래?

english: (whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Err, no! I'm not allowed to say any thingies about dem; but they're the good 'uns what can help us.
translation: 어, 몰라요! 그 사람들 얘기는 하나도 하면 안 돼요. 근데 그 사람들은 우리를 도와줄 수 있는 착한 사람들이에요.

english: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?
I'm lost, can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
(whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
Okay, thanks.
Hello.
Mother says I shouldn't speak with strangers.
Fair enough.
Squeak!
You'll need a weapon to try and attack this beast.
The Chompy Bird is too quick for your melee weapon.
translation: Chompy Bird(촘피 새)는 근접 무기로 잡기엔 너무 빠르다.

english: Magic simply won't affect this beast!
translation: 이 짐승에게는 마법이 전혀 통하지 않는다!

english: Your ranged weapon isn't powerful enough to hurt the Chompy bird.
translation: 원거리 무기가 약해서 Chompy bird(촘피 새)에게 피해를 줄 수 없다.

english: Sqwirk!
Screech!
Sqwark!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
Rawk!
*Chirp!*
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hmm... Such potential. Such a waste...
translation: 흠... 이토록 큰 잠재력이. 이토록 허비되다니...

english: That helmet... Don't think it protects you... Don't think it hides the truth...
translation: 그 투구... 그게 널 지켜 준다고 생각하지 마라... 진실을 가려 준다고도 생각하지 마라...

english: Hello, I've got some wares in you might have lost. Care to take a look?
translation: 안녕하세요, 잃어버렸을 만한 물건들을 좀 갖고 있는데요. 한번 보실래요?

english: Who are you and what do you sell?
I'm Chris, travelling repairman. If you need something repaired, I can do it for you if you've got the money for it.
translation: 전 Chris(크리스), 떠돌이 수리공이에요. 고칠 게 있으면 돈만 내시면 고쳐 드려요.

english: I've also got a collection of items people end up losing a lot. Nothing fancy, and certainly nothing you couldn't get elsewhere, maybe for free. Still, I charge a convenience fee for having it right here. Interested?
translation: 사람들이 자주 잃어버리는 물건들도 좀 모아 놨어요. 대단한 건 없고, 다른 데서 구할 수 있는 것들이죠. 공짜로 구할 수도 있을걸요. 그래도 바로 여기서 살 수 있으니 편의 수수료는 받아요. 관심 있어요?

english: Show me what you've got.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 다른 사람한테 죽었을 때 부서지는 아이템 말인데요...

english: Yeah, some things will break if you get killed in the Wilderness. And if you die deep in the Wilderness, they can vanish altogether.
translation: 네, Wilderness(황야)에서 죽으면 부서지는 물건들이 있어요. 그리고 황야 깊은 곳에서 죽으면 아예 사라져 버리기도 하고요.

english: Can you fix them?
For a fee, sure. Just show me the broken item.
translation: 돈만 내면 물론이죠. 부서진 물건을 보여 주기만 하세요.

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 사라지지 않게 할 수도 있나요?

english: Well, if you bring me a Trouver Parchment and some coins, I can enchant some items so they won't disappear if you end up losing them deep in the Wilderness.
translation: 음, Trouver Parchment(트루버 양피지)랑 코인을 좀 가져오면, Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 잃어버려도 사라지지 않게 물건에 마법을 걸어 줄게요.

english: If you need a Trouver Parchment, there's a mage up in Ferox Enclave called Justine who sells them. I've also heard rumours there's a cave in the Wilderness with creatures that sometimes carry them as well.
translation: Trouver Parchment(트루버 양피지)가 필요하면, Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)에 Justine(쥐스틴)이라는 마법사가 팔아요. Wilderness(황야)에 있는 어떤 동굴의 생물들이 가끔 그걸 갖고 다닌다는 소문도 들었고요.

english: Why would wild creatures be carrying magic parchments?
translation: 야생 생물이 왜 마법 양피지를 갖고 다니는데요?

english: Eh, some poor sap walks in carrying one, gets himself killed, and the creature just hangs on to it as a trophy? I can see it.
translation: 뭐, 어떤 불쌍한 얼간이가 하나 들고 들어갔다가 죽고, 그 생물이 전리품 삼아 계속 갖고 있는 거겠죠? 충분히 그럴 만해요.

english: No thanks.
Hey there. I can't offer my usual services right now, but if you're interested, I picked up a few bits that would let me change your appearance, if you're interested.
translation: 안녕하세요. 지금은 평소에 하던 일을 못 하는데, 관심 있으면 모습을 바꿔 줄 수 있는 물건을 좀 구해 놨어요.

english: Huh, I knew the Makeover Mage said that would work, but I didn't actually believe them!
translation: 허, Makeover Mage(변신 마법사)가 이게 될 거라고 하긴 했는데, 진짜로 믿진 않았거든요!

english: Actually, I could do with a haircut.
Not too shabby from some sheep shears, if I do say so myself!
translation: sheep shears(양털 가위)로 한 것치곤 꽤 괜찮죠, 제 입으로 말하긴 뭐하지만!

english: Are you looking for a haircut or a shave?
Are you wanting a new top or some new legwear?
translation: 새 윗옷을 원하세요, 새 바지를 원하세요?

english: Really? I got that out of a bin in Draynor! Well, if you're sure...
translation: 정말요? 그거 Draynor(드레이너)의 쓰레기통에서 주운 건데! 뭐, 정 그러시다면...

english: Well, they'll keep the sand off your feet at least...
translation: 뭐, 적어도 발에 모래는 안 묻겠네요...

english: Suit yourself. Literally, I guess.
translation: 좋을 대로 하세요. 아, 이번엔 '좋을 대로 입으세요'가 맞겠네요.

english: Hey, hands off my anvil!
But I just wanted to smith on it! It's right by a bank-
translation: 그냥 대장일 좀 하려던 건데요! 은행 바로 옆이라서-

english: Because I put it there, you fool! If you want an anvil by a bank, I suggest you find your own!
translation: 내가 거기 갖다 놨으니까 은행 옆이지, 이 멍청한 양반아! 은행 옆에 모루를 두고 싶으면 직접 하나 구하라고요!

english: Who are you and what do you sell?
Show me what you've got.
No thanks.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 다른 사람한테 죽었을 때 부서지는 아이템 말인데요...

english: Can you fix them?
Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 사라지지 않게 할 수도 있나요?

english: Can I get a body makeover?
translation: 몸 외형을 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: A haircut, please!
A shave, please!
Do you have any clothes?
A new top, please!
Some new legwear, please!
I'd really like a new pair of shoes.
translation: 새 신발 한 켤레가 정말 갖고 싶어요.

english: I'm good, thanks.
It's nice to meet you here, [player name].
Who were you?

I'm Chuck. I used to exchange logs for certificates, so people could trade them in bulk more conveniently. Certificates were what we used before banks automatically issued banknotes for most tradeable items.
translation: 전 Chuck(척)이에요. 예전엔 통나무를 증서로 바꿔 줬죠. 그래야 사람들이 대량으로 편하게 거래할 수 있었거든요. 증서는 은행이 거래 가능한 물건 대부분에 은행권을 자동으로 발행해 주기 전에 쓰던 거예요.

english: Even today, banknotes are sometimes referred to as 'certs', in memory of the certificates we used before.
translation: 지금도 은행권을 '증서'라고 부르는 사람들이 있어요. 예전에 쓰던 증서를 기억해서 그러는 거죠.

english: I had colleagues who'd exchange other items for certificates - Niles, Miles and Giles were the most famous of us. But those three found new jobs rather than retiring like I did.
translation: 다른 물건을 증서로 바꿔 주던 동료들도 있었어요. Niles(나일스), Miles(마일스), Giles(자일스)가 우리 중에 제일 유명했죠. 그런데 그 셋은 저처럼 은퇴하지 않고 새 일자리를 찾았어요.

english: Do you think you might leave the Realm?
No, I don't think so. The big high-street banks made my work useless, and I don't fancy joining Niles, Miles and Giles on their weird treks.
translation: 아뇨, 없어요. 큰 은행들이 생기면서 제 일은 쓸모없어졌고, Niles(나일스), Miles(마일스), Giles(자일스)를 따라 이상한 여행을 다니고 싶지도 않거든요.

english: No, I'll stay here and enjoy my retirement. It's nice of you to ask, though.
translation: 아뇨, 전 여기 남아서 은퇴 생활을 즐길래요. 그래도 물어봐 줘서 고마워요.

english: Thanks.
Who were you?
Do you think you might leave the Realm?
Thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 여러 가지예요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 참 좋죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello there. How's it going?
I'm very well, thank you.
Sorry, but I don't want to buy anything.
Not too bad thanks.
Hello!
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you.
Nilsal!
Another human? Do what you need to and then be gone from here.
translation: 또 인간이야? 볼일만 보고 썩 꺼져.

english: Every day they let more of your kind in.
translation: 날마다 너 같은 것들을 더 들여보낸다니까.

english: Hmph!
I don't talk to you lot.
Not interested!
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Why are you here? This isn't a place for humans.
translation: 여긴 왜 왔지? 여긴 인간이 올 곳이 아니야.

english: A human? Why don't you go back to where you came from?
translation: 인간이라고? 네가 온 데로 돌아가지 그래?

english: Grrrr, what business have you here ?
I am on an errand...
So what do you want with me ?
I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!
translation: 난 오우거 사냥꾼이다, 너희를 쓸어버리러 왔다!

english: I would like to see you try!
You are under attack!
I seek passage into the skavid caves
translation: skavid caves(스카비드 동굴)로 들어가는 길을 찾고 있어요

english: Is that so...
You humour me small thing, answer this riddle and I will help you... I want you to bring me an item
translation: 꼬맹이가 날 웃기는구나. 이 수수께끼를 풀면 도와주지... 물건 하나를 가져와라

english: I will give you all the letters of this item, you work out what it is...
translation: 그 물건의 글자를 전부 알려 주마, 뭔지는 네가 알아내라...

english: My first is in days, but not in years.  My second is in evil, and also in tears. My third is in all, but not in none
translation: 내 첫째 글자는 'days'에 있지만 'years'엔 없다. 둘째는 'evil'에도 'tears'에도 있다. 셋째는 'all'에 있지만 'none'엔 없다

english: My fourth is in hot, but not in sun. My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate. My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate.
translation: 넷째는 'hot'에 있지만 'sun'엔 없다. 다섯째는 'heaven'에도 'hate'에도 있다. 여섯째는 'fearing'에 있지만 'fate'엔 없다.

english: My seventh is in plush, but not in place. My eighth is in nine, but not in eight. My last is in earth, and also in in great
translation: 일곱째는 'plush'에 있지만 'place'엔 없다. 여덟째는 'nine'에 있지만 'eight'엔 없다. 마지막은 'earth'에도 'great'에도 있다

english: My whole is an object, that magic will make. It brings wrack and ruin to all in it's wake...
translation: 전부 합치면 마법이 만들어 내는 물건이다. 지나가는 곳마다 파멸과 폐허를 남긴다...

english: Now how long I wonder, will this riddle take?
translation: 자, 이 수수께끼 푸는 데 얼마나 걸리려나?

english: I worked it out!
Well well.. the imp has done it!
Thanks for the rune
This is what you be needing...
The guard gives you a map
What is it?
Do you have any other riddles for me?
Yes, what looks good on a plate with salad?
translation: 있지. 샐러드랑 같이 접시에 올리면 보기 좋은 게 뭐게?

english: I don't know...
You! Now go, and bother me no more.)
translation: 너다! 이제 가라, 더는 귀찮게 하지 마.)

english: A nice pizza?
Grr! Think you are a comedian, eh? Get lost!
translation: 크르르! 네가 웃긴 놈인 줄 아냐? 꺼져!

english: I have lost the map you gave me.
What's the point? Take this one and go away!
You imps always store things in places and forget. Go look for it.
translation: 너희 임프들은 항상 어디다 물건을 두고 까먹지. 가서 찾아봐라.

english: Are you blind? What is that you are carrying?
translation: 눈이 멀었냐? 네가 들고 있는 건 뭐냐?

english: Oh, that map...
I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!
translation: 난 오우거 사냥꾼이다, 너희를 쓸어버리러 왔다!

english: I seek passage into the skavid caves
translation: skavid caves(스카비드 동굴)로 들어가는 길을 찾고 있어요

english: Do you have any other riddles for me?
I don't know...
A nice pizza?
I have lost the map you gave me.
Hello there.
Oh hello, I'm sorry, I'm a bit worn out.
Busy day?
Oh, It's those mice! They're everywhere! What I really need is a cat. But they're hard to come by nowadays.
translation: 아, 그 쥐들 때문이에요! 사방에 쥐가 득실거려요! 정말 필요한 건 고양이인데, 요즘은 구하기가 힘들어요.

english: No, you're right, you don't see many around.
translation: 아뇨, 맞아요. 요즘 고양이 보기 힘들죠.

english: I have a cat that I could sell.
You don't say, is that it ?
Say hello to a real mouse killer!
Hmmm, not bad, not bad at all. Looks like it's a lively one.
translation: 흐음, 괜찮네요, 아주 괜찮아요. 꽤 팔팔한 녀석 같네요.

english: Erm...kind of...
I don't have much in the way of money. I do have these!
translation: 제가 돈은 별로 없어요. 그 대신 이게 있죠!

english: The peasant shows you a sack of Death Runes.
translation: 농민이 Death Runes(죽음 룬)이 든 자루를 보여 준다.

english: The dwarves bring them from the mine for us. Tell you what, I'll give you [100/200] Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 드워프들이 광산에서 이걸 가져다주거든요. 이렇게 하죠, 고양이를 주면 Death Runes(죽음 룬) [100/200]개를 드릴게요.

english: Nope, I'm not parting for that.
Well, I'm not giving you anymore!
Ok then, you've got a deal.
Great! Hand over the cat and I'll give you the runes.
Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
I have a cat...look!
Hmmm...doesn't look like it's seen daylight in years. That's not going to catch any mice!
translation: 흐음... 몇 년은 햇빛을 못 본 것 같은데요. 저래선 쥐 한 마리도 못 잡겠어요!

english: Hi there.
Good day to you traveller.
What are you up to?
Chasing mice as usual! It's all I seem to do nowadays.
translation: 늘 그렇듯 쥐 쫓고 있죠! 요즘은 이것밖에 안 하는 것 같아요.

english: You must waste a lot of time?
Yes, but what can you do? It's not like there's many cats around here!
translation: 그렇죠, 하지만 어쩌겠어요? 이 근처엔 고양이가 많지도 않은걸요!

english: I'm a bit busy to talk right now, sorry.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 좀 바빠서 얘기할 시간이 없어요.

english: Why? What are you doing?
Trying to kill these mice! What I really need is a cat!
translation: 이 쥐들을 잡으려고요! 정말 필요한 건 고양이라니까요!

english: You hand over the cat. You are given [100/200] Death Runes.
translation: 고양이를 건넨다. Death Runes(죽음 룬) [100/200]개를 받는다.

english: Great, thanks for that!
That's ok, take care.
I have a cat that I could sell.
Nope, I'm not parting for that.
Ok then, you've got a deal.
Nope, they're not easy to get hold of.
Welcome to the Alchemical Society. What can I help you with?
translation: Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: What is this place?
This is the main facility of the Alchemical Society. We're an organisation who fuse the forgotten teachings of the Old Ones with traditional Gielinorian Herblore practices.
translation: 여긴 Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)의 본부예요. 저희는 Old Ones(옛 존재들)의 잊힌 가르침을 Gielinor(길리노르)의 전통적인 Herblore(약초학) 기법과 결합하는 단체예요.

english: The lab under our feet allows us to fund our research by producing useful products for the kingdom.
translation: 저희 발밑에 있는 연구실에서 왕국에 쓸모 있는 제품을 생산해서 연구 자금을 마련하고 있어요.

english: So you do things differently to the druids of the mainland?
translation: 그럼 본토의 드루이드들과는 방식이 다른 건가요?

english: In a way, but we very much respect Herblore as a profession and recognise that whatever your druids do definitely works. Our goal is to advance the study of Herblore, not replace it.
translation: 어떤 면에선 그렇지만, 저희는 Herblore(약초학)을 하나의 전문 분야로서 깊이 존중하고, 그쪽 드루이드들이 하는 방식이 확실히 효과가 있다는 것도 인정해요. 저희 목표는 약초학 연구를 발전시키는 거지, 대체하는 게 아니에요.

english: Anyway, I'm a little busy at the moment, but I'm sure some of the other lab assistants would love to tell you more!
translation: 아무튼, 지금은 제가 좀 바빠서요. 그래도 다른 연구실 조수들이 기꺼이 더 알려 드릴 거예요!

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
When I'm not working in the lab, I'm normally somewhere around here researching or administrating our orders. There's an awful lot of paperwork to get through!
translation: 연구실에서 일하지 않을 땐 보통 이 근처에서 연구를 하거나 주문을 관리해요. 처리할 서류가 엄청나게 많거든요!

english: Can I buy some potions?
We're not really a shop, so our products are not available to buy directly. Everything we make gets shipped wholesale around the kingdom.
translation: 저희는 상점이 아니라서 제품을 직접 팔지는 않아요. 만드는 건 전부 왕국 곳곳에 도매로 보내져요.

english: You look like the adventuring type anyway. I can't imagine our products would be of much use to you.
translation: 어차피 모험가 타입으로 보이시는데요. 저희 제품이 그쪽한테 크게 쓸모 있을 것 같진 않네요.

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hey! Where do you think you're going?
I wanted to see what was down these stairs.
translation: 이 계단 아래에 뭐가 있는지 보고 싶었어요.

english: We are the Alchemical Society and those stairs lead to our lab and production facilities.
translation: 저희는 Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)이고, 그 계단은 저희 연구실과 생산 시설로 이어져요.

english: Oh... I think its best that I stay away then.
translation: 아... 그럼 가까이 안 가는 게 좋겠네요.

english: A Herblore level of 60 is required to enter the lab.
I'm actually quite skilled in Herblore. Would it be possible for me to join?
translation: 사실 저 Herblore(약초학)에 꽤 능숙해요. 저도 가입할 수 있을까요?

english: You are? Well, we're always looking for new members, provided they have the aptitude needed. In that case, head on in and talk to Supervisor Lalo. He'll show you how everything works.
translation: 그래요? 음, 필요한 소질만 있다면 저희는 언제나 새 회원을 찾고 있어요. 그렇다면 안으로 들어가서 Supervisor Lalo(감독관 랄로)님께 말을 걸어 보세요. 모든 걸 어떻게 하는지 알려 주실 거예요.

english: What is this place?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
Can I buy some potions?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hello there.
Sorry, can't stop to chat! You would be amazed at how many meals this family gets through daily!
translation: 미안해요, 얘기할 틈이 없어요! 이 집안이 하루에 식사를 얼마나 많이 해치우는지 알면 깜짝 놀랄 거예요!

english: Hiya.
Well hello there adventurer! Are we fit and well?
Yep, fine thanks.
Glad to hear it.
Hey.
Oh, hello there. Sorry, but I can't really talk right now. Things haven't been great here recently, and I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 미안하지만 지금은 얘기하기가 좀 어려워요. 요즘 여기 사정이 좋지 않아서 할 일이 많거든요.

english: Thank you for helping me. A golem can have no greater satisfaction than knowing that its task is complete.
translation: 도와주셔서 감사합니다. 골렘에게 자신의 임무를 완수했다는 것보다 더 큰 만족은 없습니다.

english: But the whole city is destroyed! Doesn't that bother you?
translation: 하지만 도시 전체가 무너졌잖아요! 그게 신경 쓰이지 않아요?

english: I was never programmed to appreciate the city. My only purpose was the destruction of the demon, and that is achieved!
translation: 저는 도시를 소중히 여기도록 만들어지지 않았습니다. 제 유일한 목적은 악마를 파괴하는 것이었고, 그 목적은 이루어졌습니다!

english: I regret that I could not assist you in the slaying of Agrith-Naar.
translation: Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 처치하는 데 도움이 되지 못해 유감입니다.

english: Don't worry, golem! You've done enough demon-slaying in your time.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 골렘! 그동안 악마는 충분히 처치했잖아요.

english: Hello, welcome to the Civic Office of West Ardougne. How can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, West Ardougne(서 아르둔) 시청에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Who is through that door?
The city warder Bravek is in there.
Can I go in?
He has asked not to be disturbed.
I'm just looking thanks.
I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: 역병이 도는 집에 들어갈 허가가 필요해요.

english: Rather you than me! The mourners normally deal with that stuff, you should speak to them. Their headquarters are right near the city gate.
translation: 저라면 사양하겠네요! 그런 일은 보통 mourners(애도자)들이 처리하니까 그쪽에 얘기해 보세요. 본부가 성문 바로 근처에 있어요.

english: I'll try asking them then.
Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: 설마 모든 걸 그 사람들한테 맡기는 건 아니겠죠?

english: Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.
translation: 뭐, 여기 일은 그 사람들이 잘 알거든요. 만약 그들이 일을 엉망으로 하기 시작하면 도시 감독관이신 Bravek(브라베크) 님이 그 결정을 뒤집을 권한이 있어요. 그럴 일은 없을 것 같지만요.

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: 그래도 Bravek(브라베크) 님과 얘기할 수 있을까요?

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
I'll see what I can do I suppose.
Mr Bravek, there's a man here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: Bravek(브라베크) 님, 꼭 뵙고 싶다는 남자분이 와 계세요.

english: I suppose they can come in then. If they keep it short.
Okay, I'll leave him alone.
Do you know when he will be available?
Oh I don't know, an hour or so maybe.
Bravek will see you now but keep it short!
translation: Bravek(브라베크) 님이 지금 만나 주신대요. 하지만 짧게 끝내세요!

english: Thanks, I won't take much of his time.
I suppose so.
Hello.
Sorry, I don't have time to talk. Bravek needs lots of help running the city.
translation: 죄송하지만 얘기할 시간이 없어요. Bravek(브라베크) 님이 도시를 운영하시는 데 도움이 많이 필요하거든요.

english: Who is through that door?
I'm just looking thanks.
I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: 역병이 도는 집에 들어갈 허가가 필요해요.

english: I'll try asking them then.
Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: 설마 모든 걸 그 사람들한테 맡기는 건 아니겠죠?

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: 그래도 Bravek(브라베크) 님과 얘기할 수 있을까요?

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
Okay, I'll leave him alone.
Do you know when he will be available?
Good day.
Who are you?
My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
translation: 제 이름은 Clerk(서기)예요. 사람들을 모아 이른바 클랜을 만드는 일을 하고 있죠.

english: What is a clan?
Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: 아, 클랜이요. 어디서부터 말씀드려야 할까요? 클랜은 여러 가지 이유로 모인 사람들의 집단이에요. 보통은 함께 즐기는 활동 같은 공통의 관심사가 있죠.

english: These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
translation: 그런 활동으로는 특정 스킬 올리기, 같은 몬스터와 싸우기, 심지어 다른 클랜과 싸우기도 있어요!

english: Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
translation: 그냥 마음 맞는 사람들과 어울리는 게 좋아서 모인 클랜도 있어요. 무언가 도움이 필요할 때 클랜 커뮤니티는 큰 힘이 될 수 있죠.

english: How do I join a clan?
You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
translation: 친구들과 직접 클랜을 만들 수도 있고, 이미 있는 클랜에 가입 신청을 할 수도 있어요.

english: Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
translation: 직접 클랜을 만들기로 한다면 함께할 친구 네 명이 필요하고, 먼저 이 세계에서 충분한 시간을 보내 보길 권해요. 리더 자리가 누구에게나 맞는 건 아니거든요.

english: However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
translation: 하지만 걱정 마세요. 흥미롭고 신나는 클랜이 잔뜩 있으니까요! clan recruitment board(클랜 모집 게시판)을 확인해서 지금 가입 신청을 받는 클랜이 어디인지 알아보세요.

english: What can a clan offer me?
Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
translation: 클랜에 들면 친구나 마음 맞는 사람들과 계급 구조를 갖춘 공식 모임을 가질 수 있어요.

english: In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
translation: 다시 말해, 본인과 친구들만의 전용 채팅 채널과 Clan Hall(클랜 홀)이 생기고, 멤버에게 계급을 부여할 수도 있어요.

english: Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
translation: 계급은 미리 만들어 둔 사용자 지정 설정에서 고를 수 있고, 그 계급에 따라 그 사람의 권한이 정해져요.

english: For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
translation: 예를 들어, 어떤 사람은 채팅에서 플레이어를 내보낼 수 있는 계급을, 다른 사람은 Clan Coffer(클랜 금고)에 접근할 수 있는 계급을 가질 수 있죠.

english: What is the Clan Coffer?
The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.
translation: Clan Coffer(클랜 금고)는 클랜 멤버들이 함께 쓰는 공용 코인 보관함이에요. 계급이 높은 멤버가 코인을 넣고 뺄 권한을 누구에게 줄지 정할 수 있어요.

english: What is a Clan Hall?

A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
translation: Clan Hall(클랜 홀)은 입장 권한이 있는 사람만 들어갈 수 있는 전용 공간이에요. 클랜의 높은 계급 멤버는 특정 계급만 들어오게 제한하거나, 손님까지 들어올 수 있게 열어 둘 수도 있어요.

english: Why would I need a Clan Hall? Can't I get a house instead?
translation: Clan Hall(클랜 홀)이 왜 필요하죠? 그냥 집을 마련하면 안 되나요?

english: The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
translation: 좋은 점은 둘 다 가질 수 있다는 거예요. 집은 개인 손님이나 혼자 쓰는 용도로 두고, 더 큰 무리를 만나고 싶을 땐 Clan Hall(클랜 홀)이 더 알맞을 수 있죠.

english: What do you do here?
My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
translation: 제 임무는 클랜을 관리하는 거예요. 클랜 결성을 돕고, 클랜에 대해 알아야 할 건 무엇이든 알려 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
translation: 그렇군요. 그런데 왜 하필 여기 계신 거예요?

english: Why does anyone go anywhere? As a gatherer of people, I go where people gather. The Grand Exchange is known to be a place where people come together. What better place to bring them even closer?
translation: 사람이 어딘가로 가는 데 이유가 있나요? 사람을 모으는 사람으로서, 저는 사람이 모이는 곳으로 가요. Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)는 사람들이 모이는 곳으로 유명하죠. 사람들을 더 가깝게 이어 주기에 이보다 좋은 곳이 있을까요?

english: I suppose this usually is a crowded place.
Very much so. I was lucky to find this charming corner to set up the clan hub.
translation: 정말 그래요. 클랜 허브를 차릴 이 아늑한 구석을 찾은 건 행운이었어요.

english: What's the clan hub?
The clan hub is what I call this area, my little corner of the Grand Exchange. This is where every clan is born, as well as the best place to look for new recruits.
translation: 클랜 허브는 이 구역, 그러니까 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)의 제 작은 구석을 제가 부르는 이름이에요. 모든 클랜이 여기서 탄생하고, 새 멤버를 찾기에도 가장 좋은 곳이죠.

english: If you're in a clan you can also access your Clan Hall from here.
translation: 클랜에 속해 있다면 여기서 Clan Hall(클랜 홀)로 갈 수도 있어요.

english: I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: 저 클랜에 들어 있어요. 뭐 주실 거 있나요?

english: I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan, but you don't have space to take any.
translation: 클랜 색깔을 드러낼 수 있는 망토와, 클랜에 사람을 더 모으는 데 도움이 되는 벡실라 깃발이 있는데, 받을 공간이 없으시네요.

english: I suppose I'd better free up some space.
Yes, you should! Now, did you want to ask me anything else while you're here?
translation: 네, 그러셔야죠! 그럼, 온 김에 더 물어보실 건 없나요?

english: Certainly. I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan.
translation: 물론이죠. 클랜 색깔을 드러낼 수 있는 망토와, 클랜에 사람을 더 모으는 데 도움이 되는 벡실라 깃발이 있어요.

english: Thanks!
Goodbye.
Goodbye. Come back any time.
Sorry, you'll have to come back another day. I'm not ready to serve you yet.
translation: 죄송하지만 다른 날 다시 오셔야겠어요. 아직 도와드릴 준비가 안 됐거든요.

english: Who are you?
What do you do here?
What is a clan?
How do I join a clan?
What can a clan offer me?
What is the Clan Coffer?
What is a Clan Hall?
Goodbye.
I'm in a clan. Can you give me anything?
translation: 저 클랜에 들어 있어요. 뭐 주실 거 있나요?

english: Sure, but why are you here specifically?
translation: 그렇군요. 그런데 왜 하필 여기 계신 거예요?

english: What's the clan hub?
The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have [number] buckets here, and [number] more in the bank. We require [number] buckets.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 사람들은 농장에 쓸 sulphurous fertiliser(유황 비료)가 필요해요. 여기 양동이 [number]개가 있고, 은행에 [number]개가 더 있네요. 저희는 [number]개가 필요해요.

english: Do you wish to donate your fertiliser? We'll take what we need directly from your bank.
translation: 비료를 기부하시겠어요? 필요한 만큼은 은행에서 바로 가져갈게요.

english: Thank you very much.
No, sorry.
The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. We currently require [number] buckets. Do come back if you every get any you'd be willing to donate.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 사람들은 농장에 쓸 sulphurous fertiliser(유황 비료)가 필요해요. 지금은 양동이 [number]개가 필요해요. 기부하실 만한 게 생기면 꼭 다시 와 주세요.

english: If you were planning to bring any fertiliser for the stores, please try again later. The stores are very full at present.
translation: 창고에 넣을 비료를 가져오실 생각이었다면 나중에 다시 와 주세요. 지금은 창고가 꽉 찼거든요.

english: That's alright, I haven't brought any.
Yes
No
Good day.
Hey there. What brings you here?
This is the dense essence mine. The essence we gather here is used across Arceuus, and indeed all of Kourend. If you wish, you are welcome to mine some yourself.
translation: 이곳은 dense essence mine(고밀도 정수 광산)입니다. 여기서 캐는 정수는 Arceuus(아르세우스)는 물론 Kourend(쿠렌드) 전역에서 쓰이지요. 원하신다면 직접 캐 가셔도 좋습니다.

english: I might do that. Thanks.
I have a question for you.
Clerris has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
[Clerris has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]
translation: [Clerris has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]

english: The mages of Arceuus seek dense essence for their experiments. I see you have [amount] blocks; we require [amount]. Donations will be marked with gratitude.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스)의 마법사들이 실험에 쓸 dense essence(고밀도 정수)를 구하고 있습니다. 블록 [amount]개를 가지고 계시군요. 저희는 [amount]개가 필요합니다. 기부해 주시면 감사히 기록해 두겠습니다.

english: Your donation has been gratefully recieved.
No, sorry, they can't have it.
We do not require any dense essence from you at present. Thank you for your support.
translation: 지금은 dense essence(고밀도 정수)가 필요하지 않습니다. 도와주셔서 감사합니다.

english: Yes
No
Hello there.
What do you want adventurer?
Just passing by.
You have no business here. Leave.... now.
translation: 여긴 네가 볼일 있는 곳이 아니다. 꺼져라.... 당장.

english: Hello.
You may have won this battle meddler, but the war rages on. Go bother some goblins or something for when Hazeel returns your destruction is assured.
translation: 이번 싸움은 네가 이겼을지 몰라도, 참견꾼아, 전쟁은 계속된다. 가서 고블린이나 괴롭혀라. Hazeel(헤이즐)께서 돌아오시면 네 파멸은 확실하니까.

english: It is good to see you once more, adventurer. Glory to Hazeel!
translation: 다시 만나 반갑군, 모험가. Hazeel(헤이즐)께 영광을!

english: *snap*
Click!
Click click!
Whirrr!
The little goblin appear to be fast asleep, and yet still fishing...
translation: 작은 고블린은 깊이 잠든 것 같은데, 그러면서도 낚시를 하고 있다...

english: I think I'd rather not wake him.
Zzzzz...
Huh, what? where?
Hello, what are you doing?
Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send a fairy to get little Freddiestooth!
translation: 미안하지만 한가하게 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 꼬마 Freddiestooth(프레디스투스)한테 요정을 보내야 하거든요!

english: Sorry, I don't have time to talk, I need to send a Tooth Fairy to visit Sarah-Jane!
translation: 미안하지만 얘기할 시간 없어요. Sarah-Jane(세라제인)한테 Tooth Fairy(이빨 요정)을 보내야 하거든요!

english: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to find a Winter Fairy to send to Trollheim!
translation: 미안하지만 한가하게 수다 떨 시간 없어요. Trollheim(트롤하임)에 보낼 Winter Fairy(겨울 요정)을 찾아야 하거든요!

english: Sorry, I don't have time to stop, I need to send a Weather Fairy off to Etceteria!
translation: 미안하지만 멈춰 있을 시간 없어요. Etceteria(에트세테리아)로 Weather Fairy(날씨 요정)을 보내야 하거든요!

english: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send an Autumn Fairy off to Burthorpe!
translation: 미안하지만 한가하게 수다 떨 시간 없어요. Burthorpe(버소프)로 Autumn Fairy(가을 요정)을 보내야 하거든요!

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 이 이상한 표시들이 무슨 뜻인지 아세요?

english: They look familiar, but I can't think where I've seen marks like that. Try asking around, maybe somebody else will recognise them.
translation: 낯이 익긴 한데, 그런 표시를 어디서 봤는지 생각이 안 나네요. 여기저기 물어보세요. 다른 누군가는 알아볼지도 몰라요.

english: Welcome to Cobado's Groceries. Feeling hungry?
Let's see what you have.
Why do you have an orange on your head?
Why don't you have an orange on your head?
translation: 그쪽은 왜 머리에 오렌지를 안 올리고 있어요?

english: Er... Because it's not an item of clothing?
Not for you perhaps, but it is for me.
Right...
So anyway, looking to buy some food.
I'm good.
Well come back when you're hungry.
Let's see what you have.
Why do you have an orange on your head?
I'm good.
Hey, a cockatrice!
[House owner] deaded me! That wasn't very nice!
translation: [House owner](이)가 날 주겨써! 그건 하나도 안 착했어!

english: You deaded me!
Well, yes.
What did you do that for?
A slayer master told me to.
Why do the slayer masters all pick on poor cockatrice?
translation: 왜 슬레이어 마스터들은 다 불쌍한 코카트리스만 괴롭혀?

english: They pick on lots of other creatures too.
Then mount one of them on your wall and let poor cockatrice rest in peace!
translation: 그럼 그중 하나를 벽에 걸고, 불쌍한 코카트리스는 편히 쉬게 해 줘!

english: So I could mount your head on my wall.
Another cockatrice falls victim to the dreaded mirror shield!
translation: 또 한 마리의 코카트리스가 무시무시한 mirror shield(거울 방패)에 희생되었도다!

english: Don't take it personally! You look good on my wall!
translation: 너무 기분 나빠하지 마! 내 벽에 걸려 있으니 멋져 보여!

english: I don't care! I think I looked better with a body!
