translation: 상관없어! 몸이 있을 때가 더 멋졌단 말이야!

english: I just wanted to.
You dirty rotten swine, you!
translation: 이 더럽고 썩어 빠진 돼지 같은 놈아!

english: Steady on...
I will kill you with my paralyzing-type magic eyes look!
translation: 내 마비형 마법 눈빛 노려보기로 널 죽일 거야!

english: Dots appear in air between eyes and victim. Dot! Dot! Dotty!
translation: 눈과 희생자 사이 공중에 점들 나타남. 점! 점! 점점점!

english: Er, nothing's happening...
Concentrates mental power. Eyes narrow beak clenches veins on head stand out.
translation: 정신력 집중. 눈 가늘어짐 부리 앙다묾 머리 핏줄 불끈.

english: Strain!
You're dead, cockatrice. Your eyes are glass beads. It won't work.
translation: 넌 죽었어, 코카트리스. 네 눈은 유리구슬이야. 안 통한다고.

english: STRA-A-AIN!
I think I'll leave you to it.
A slayer master told me to
So I could mount your head on my wall
I just wanted to
Who goes there? Friend or foe?
Friend.
Ok good to hear it.
Foe!
Oh righty...
Why is this town so heavily defended?
translation: 이 마을은 왜 이렇게 방비가 삼엄한가요?

english: Yanille is on the southwest border of Kandarin, Beyond here you go into the Feldip hills which is major Ogre territory. Our job is to defend Yanille from the ogres.
translation: Yanille(야닐)은 Kandarin(칸다린)의 남서쪽 국경에 있다. 여기서 더 가면 Feldip hills(펠딥 언덕)인데, 그곳은 Ogre(오우거)들의 주요 영역이지. 우리 임무는 오우거로부터 야닐을 지키는 것이다.

english: Friend
Foe!
Why is this town so heavily defended?
translation: 이 마을은 왜 이렇게 방비가 삼엄한가요?

english: Hello?
Sorry soldier, you don't have permission to speak with me yet. Go and talk to the Captain.
translation: 미안하네, 병사. 자넨 아직 나와 이야기할 자격이 없네. 가서 Captain(대장)과 이야기하게.

english: I believe you might be able to reward me for my progress in this arena?
translation: 이 경기장에서 제가 쌓은 성과에 대해 보상해 주실 수 있다고 들었습니다만?

english: Well, that depends upon your skill levels for each role.
translation: 글쎄, 그건 자네의 역할별 스킬 레벨에 달렸네.

english: What's your name, soldier?
[player name], Sir!
Okay. What exactly do you want to know, [player name]?
translation: 좋아. 정확히 뭘 알고 싶은가, [player name]?

english: Can I trade some of my points?
Of course.
What points do I have so far, sir?
translation: 지금까지 제 점수는 몇 점입니까, 사령관님?

english: Let me check...
You have absolutely no points, whatsoever. Best you get back into that arena!
translation: 점수가 단 한 점도 없군. 어서 경기장으로 돌아가게!

english: You have: [amount] Attacker Honour Points, [amount] Defender Honour Points, [amount] Collector Honour Points and [amount] Healer Honour Points.
translation: 자네 점수는 공격수 명예 점수 [amount]점, 방어수 명예 점수 [amount]점, 수집가 명예 점수 [amount]점, 치유사 명예 점수 [amount]점일세.

english: Could I have a Queen Help book?
translation: Queen Help book(여왕 공략서)를 한 권 받을 수 있습니까?

english: You already have one!
Oh yes, sorry.
Oh, no. Wait, I don't have enough space to carry one.
translation: 아, 아뇨. 잠깐만요, 들고 다닐 공간이 없습니다.

english: Well, you can come back and get one at any time from me.
translation: 뭐, 언제든 다시 와서 받아 가게.

english: By all means.
Could I have my current wave reset to one?
translation: 현재 웨이브를 1웨이브로 초기화해 주실 수 있습니까?

english: You do realise that you're already on wave one?
translation: 자넨 이미 1웨이브에 있다는 걸 알고 있나?

english: Ah. Yes. Sorry about that.
That is all, sir.
Very well, on your way.
Gamble, you say! Let me take something from my big bag of prizes!
translation: 도박이라고! 내 커다란 상품 자루에서 하나 꺼내 주지!

english: Lucky dip, you say! Let me take something from my big bag of prizes!
translation: 행운의 뽑기라고! 내 커다란 상품 자루에서 하나 꺼내 주지!

english: Let's see...
Got something!
You've won...
Okay, here we go...
I've got my hand on something!
Hmmm, not bad, it's...
What can I find?
Ah, found something!
You've got...
Can I trade some of my points?
What points do I have so far, sir?
translation: 지금까지 제 점수는 몇 점입니까, 사령관님?

english: Could I have a 'Queen Help' book?
translation: 'Queen Help' book(여왕 공략서)를 한 권 받을 수 있습니까?

english: Could I have my current wave reset to one?
translation: 현재 웨이브를 1웨이브로 초기화해 주실 수 있습니까?

english: That is all, sir.
Hello.
Good day.
Who are you?
I'm Commander Lydia Fullore, leader of the Kourend Royal Guard.
translation: 저는 Kourend Royal Guard(쿠렌드 왕실 근위대)를 이끄는 Lydia Fullore(리디아 풀로어) 사령관이에요.

english: What do you do here?
The Kourend Royal Guard protect and serve the ruler of Kourend. As their leader, I am responsible for ensuring that the Royal Guard are well trained and well supplied.
translation: Kourend Royal Guard(쿠렌드 왕실 근위대)는 쿠렌드의 통치자를 보호하고 섬겨요. 그 지휘관으로서, 저는 근위대가 훈련을 잘 받고 보급도 넉넉히 받도록 책임지고 있어요.

english: Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: Royal Guard(왕실 근위대)도 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 일부인가요?

english: No. Unlike the Shayzien Army, the Royal Guard serve the ruler of the kingdom directly.
translation: 아니요. Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)과 달리, 왕실 근위대는 왕국의 통치자를 직접 섬겨요.

english: The Royal Guard was established by King Byrne I. He felt that it was dangerous for Shayzien House to control the only military in the kingdom, so he decided to establish a small one of his own.
translation: Royal Guard(왕실 근위대)는 King Byrne I(바이른 1세)가 창설했어요. 그분은 왕국의 유일한 군대를 Shayzien House(샤이지엔 가문)이 쥐고 있는 게 위험하다고 여겨서, 직접 작은 군대를 하나 세우기로 하셨죠.

english: Ever since then, the Royal Guard have served Kourend's ruler.
translation: 그 뒤로 줄곧 왕실 근위대는 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 통치자를 섬겨 왔어요.

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
The current ruler, or rulers as I should say, are the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom for the past twenty years, ever since the last King died.
translation: 현재 통치자는, 아니 통치자들이라고 해야겠네요, Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)이에요. 마지막 왕이 돌아가신 뒤로 지난 20년 동안 왕국을 다스려 왔죠.

english: Goodbye.
Hey. I have something for you.
Hey Lydia. How are things here?
It's still early days for King Artur. He was raised to rule, but he lacks the experience his father had. Still, he can't be any worse than the Council.
translation: King Artur(아르투르 왕)께선 아직 즉위 초기세요. 통치자로 길러지긴 했지만, 아버님만큼의 경험은 없으시죠. 그래도 의회보다 나쁠 리는 없어요.

english: Any news on Xamphur or the killer?
Nothing yet. For all we know, they could be one and the same. Lord Arceuus is doing everything he can to learn more about Xamphur, and the Lovakengj smiths are inspecting the murder weapon.
translation: 아직 아무것도요. 어쩌면 둘이 동일 인물일 수도 있어요. Lord Arceuus(아르세우스 경)이 Xamphur(잠푸르)에 대해 더 알아내려고 온갖 노력을 하고 있고, Lovakengj(로바켕기) 대장장이들은 살인 무기를 조사하고 있어요.

english: I'll let you know once we have something on either of them.
translation: 둘 중 누구에 대해서든 뭔가 나오면 알려 드릴게요.

english: Thank you. I'll let you get on with your work.
Good luck out there. Don't be a stranger.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Are the Royal Guard part of the Shayzien Army?
translation: Royal Guard(왕실 근위대)도 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 일부인가요?

english: Who's the current ruler of Kourend?
Goodbye.
Hello.
I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here? If we can't hold back Khazard's men we're all doomed.
translation: 지금은 얘기할 수 없어요. 우리가 전투에서 이기려고 애쓰는 거 안 보여요? Khazard(카자드)의 병사들을 막지 못하면 우린 다 끝장이에요.

english: Hello traveller, are you here to help or just to watch?
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 도우러 온 건가요, 아니면 구경하러 온 건가요?

english: I've been sent by King Bolren to retrieve the orb of protection.
translation: King Bolren(볼렌 왕)의 명을 받고 orb of protection(보호의 오브)를 되찾으러 왔어요.

english: Excellent we need all the help we can get.
I'm commander Montai. The orb is in the Khazard stronghold to the north, but until we weaken their defences we can't get close.
translation: 저는 commander Montai(몬타이 사령관)예요. 오브는 북쪽의 Khazard(카자드) 요새에 있는데, 놈들의 방어를 약화시키기 전까진 가까이 갈 수도 없어요.

english: What can I do?
Firstly we need to strengthen our own defences. We desperately need wood to make more battlements, once the battlements are gone it's all over. Six loads of normal logs should do it.
translation: 먼저 우리 방어부터 강화해야 해요. 흉벽을 더 만들 나무가 절실히 필요해요. 흉벽이 무너지면 그걸로 끝이에요. 일반 logs(통나무) 여섯 묶음이면 될 거예요.

english: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
Please be as quick as you can, I don't know how much longer we can hold out.
translation: 최대한 서둘러 주세요. 우리가 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있을지 모르겠어요.

english: Sorry I no longer want to be involved.
That's a shame, we could have done with your help.
translation: 아쉽네요. 당신 도움이 있었으면 좋았을 텐데.

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier. We need six loads of normal logs.
translation: 또 왔군요. 병사님, 우린 여전히 나무가 절실해요. 일반 logs(통나무) 여섯 묶음이 필요해요.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Thank you.
Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier.
translation: 또 왔군요. 병사님, 우린 여전히 나무가 절실해요.

english: I have some here.(You give six loads of logs to the commander.)
translation: 여기 좀 있어요.(사령관에게 통나무 여섯 묶음을 건넨다.)

english: That's excellent, now we can make more defensive battlements. Give me a moment to organise the troops and then come speak to me. I'll inform you of our next phase of attack.
translation: 훌륭해요, 이제 방어용 흉벽을 더 만들 수 있겠어요. 부대를 정비할 동안 잠시 기다렸다가 다시 말을 걸어 주세요. 다음 공격 단계를 알려 드릴게요.

english: How are you doing Montai?
We're hanging in there soldier. For the next phase of our attack we need to breach their stronghold.
translation: 버티고 있어요, 병사님. 다음 공격 단계로는 놈들의 요새를 뚫어야 해요.

english: The ballista can break through the stronghold wall, and then we can advance and seize back the orb.
translation: ballista(발리스타)라면 요새 벽을 부술 수 있어요. 그러면 진격해서 오브를 되찾을 수 있죠.

english: So what's the problem?
From this distance we can't get an accurate enough shot. We need the correct coordinates of the stronghold for a direct hit. I've sent out three tracker gnomes to gather them.
translation: 이 거리에선 충분히 정확하게 쏠 수가 없어요. 정확히 맞히려면 요새의 정확한 좌표가 필요해요. 그래서 추적자 노움 셋을 보내 좌표를 알아 오게 했죠.

english: Have they returned?
I'm afraid not, and we're running out of time. I need you to go into the heart of the battlefield, find the trackers, and bring back the coordinates.
translation: 안타깝게도 아직이에요. 시간도 얼마 없고요. 전장 한복판으로 들어가서 추적자들을 찾아 좌표를 가져와 주세요.

english: Do you think you can do it?
No, I've had enough of your battle.
I understand, this isn't your fight.
I'll try my best.
Thank you, you're braver than most.
I don't know how long I will be able to hold out. Once you have the coordinates come back and fire the ballista right into those monsters.
translation: 제가 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있을지 모르겠어요. 좌표를 얻으면 돌아와서 ballista(발리스타)를 저 괴물들 한가운데로 쏴 주세요.

english: If you can retrieve the orb and bring safety back to my people, none of the blood spilled on this field will be in vain.
translation: 오브를 되찾아 우리 백성에게 평화를 돌려준다면, 이 전장에서 흘린 피는 하나도 헛되지 않을 거예요.

english: Hello warrior. We need the coordinates for a direct hit from the ballista. Once you have a direct hit you will be able to enter the stronghold and retrieve the orb.
translation: 안녕하세요, 전사님. ballista(발리스타)로 정확히 맞히려면 좌표가 필요해요. 정확히 명중시키면 요새에 들어가서 오브를 되찾을 수 있을 거예요.

english: I've breached the stronghold.
I saw, that was a beautiful sight. The Khazard troops didn't know what hit them.
translation: 봤어요, 정말 장관이었죠. Khazard(카자드) 병사들은 뭐에 맞았는지도 몰랐을 거예요.

english: Now is the time to retrieve the orb. It's all in your hands. I'll be praying for you.
translation: 이제 오브를 되찾을 때예요. 모든 게 당신 손에 달렸어요. 당신을 위해 기도할게요.

english: I have the orb of protection.
Incredible, for a human you really are something.
Thanks... I think!
I'll stay here with my troops and try and hold Khazard's men back. You return the orb to the gnome village. Go as quick as you can, the village is still unprotected.
translation: 저는 여기 부대와 남아서 Khazard(카자드)의 병사들을 막아 볼게요. 당신은 오브를 노움 마을로 돌려주세요. 최대한 서둘러요, 마을은 아직 무방비 상태예요.

english: Hello Montai, how are you?
I'm ok, this battle is going to take longer to win than I expected. The Khazard troops won't give up even without the orb.
translation: 괜찮아요. 이 전투는 생각보다 이기는 데 오래 걸리겠어요. Khazard(카자드) 병사들은 오브가 없는데도 포기하지 않네요.

english: Hang in there.
Ok, I'll gather some wood.
Sorry, I no longer want to be involved.
No, I've had enough of your battle.
I'll try my best.
Greetings, Zilyana.
Commander, if you don't mind.
I don't, Zilyana.
Bah, find me some more cake. oh and FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 흥, 케이크나 더 찾아와라. 아, 그리고 GODSWORD(갓소드)를 찾아내라!

english: I'll err... get some more cake alright?
translation: 어... 케이크나 더 구해 올게요, 됐죠?

english: All praise Saradomin!
Slay the evil ones!
Death to the enemies of the light!
Saradomin lend me strength!
Saradomin is with us!
Forward! Our allies are with us!
Good will always triumph!
May Saradomin be my sword!
In the name of Saradomin!
Attack! Find the Godsword!
Hello there.
Good day to you.
Who are you?
I'm Commissioner Anwar. I'm in charge of the Shayzien Constabulary. With Lord Shayzien currently busy with the war efforts, I'm also assisting him with his duties here in the city.
translation: 저는 Commissioner Anwar(안와르 국장)입니다. Shayzien Constabulary(샤이지엔 치안대)를 맡고 있지요. Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 경)께서 지금 전쟁 일로 바쁘셔서, 이 도시에서 그분의 업무도 돕고 있습니다.

english: What's the Shayzien Constabulary?

The Shayzien Army is split into six regiments plus the Shayzien Constabulary. While the six regiments are jointly responsible for protecting Kourend from external threats, we deal with issues closer to home.
translation: Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)은 여섯 개 연대와 Shayzien Constabulary(샤이지엔 치안대)로 나뉩니다. 여섯 연대가 함께 외부의 위협으로부터 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 지키는 동안, 저희는 좀 더 가까운 곳의 문제를 다룹니다.

english: What are the six regiments?

The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Corps, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
translation: Intelligence Corps(첩보대), Medical Corps(의무대), Engineering Corps(공병대), Logistics Corps(병참대), Rangers(레인저대), 그리고 물론 Infantry(보병대)입니다. 각 연대는 Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 경)께 직접 보고하는 장군이 이끕니다.

english: It feels like there must be a bit of overlap between the Constabulary and the regiments, especially the Intelligence Corps.
translation: 치안대와 연대 사이에, 특히 Intelligence Corps(첩보대)와는 겹치는 부분이 좀 있을 것 같네요.

english: On paper we're totally separate from the regiments. However, in reality you are correct. The distinction between internal and external threats grows murkier by the day.
translation: 서류상으로 저희는 연대와 완전히 별개입니다. 하지만 실제로는 말씀하신 대로입니다. 내부 위협과 외부 위협의 경계가 날이 갈수록 흐려지고 있지요.

english: More and more we find ourselves working alongside the Intelligence Corps and the other regiments. In particular, they've been supporting us in combating the rising gang threat in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 점점 더 Intelligence Corps(첩보대)를 비롯한 다른 연대들과 함께 일하게 됩니다. 특히 Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에서 커지고 있는 갱단 위협에 맞서는 데 그들이 저희를 지원해 주고 있습니다.

english: What is this place?
This is the Shayzien Administration. The city of Shayzien is run from here.
translation: 이곳은 Shayzien Administration(샤이지엔 행정청)입니다. 샤이지엔 시는 이곳에서 운영됩니다.

english: It seems very quiet.
A lot of focus right now is on the war with the lizardmen. Most senior members of the Shayzien Army, including Lord Shayzien himself, are working out of the Shayzien Encampment instead.
translation: 지금은 lizardmen(리자드맨)과의 전쟁에 관심이 많이 쏠려 있습니다. Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 경)을 비롯해 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 고위 인사 대부분은 Shayzien Encampment(샤이지엔 야영지)에서 일하고 있지요.

english: So the Shayzien Army are also responsible for running the city?
translation: 그럼 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)이 도시 운영도 맡고 있는 건가요?

english: Indeed. There's more of a separation between the city of Shayzien and the Shayzien Army now than there used to be, but this will likely always be a military settlement.
translation: 그렇습니다. 예전보다는 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 시와 샤이지엔 군이 더 분리되어 있지만, 이곳은 아마 언제까지나 군사 거점일 겁니다.

english: See you later.
Who are you?
What's the Shayzien Constabulary?
What is this place?
See you later.
Hello there, would you like to take part in the archery competition? It only costs 200 coins to enter.
translation: 안녕하세요, 궁술 대회에 참가해 보시겠어요? 참가비는 200코인밖에 안 해요.

english: Sure, I'll give it a go.
Great! That will be 200 coins then please.
Oops, I don't have enough coins on me...
Never mind, come back when you've got enough.
You pay the judge and he gives you 10 bronze arrows.
translation: 심판에게 돈을 내자 심판이 bronze arrows(청동 화살) 10개를 건넨다.

english: What are the rules?
The rules are very simple:
You're given 10 shots at the targets, for each hit you will receive points. At the end you'll be awarded 1 ticket for every 10 points.
translation: 과녁에 10발을 쏠 수 있고, 맞힐 때마다 점수를 받아요. 끝나면 10점마다 티켓 1장을 드려요.

english: The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Do you want to give it a go? Only 200 coins.
translation: 티켓은 저희 상점에서 물건으로 바꿀 수 있어요. 한번 해 보시겠어요? 200코인밖에 안 해요.

english: No thanks.
Hello again, do you need reminding of the rules?
translation: 또 오셨네요. 규칙을 다시 알려 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
The tickets can be exchanged for goods from our stores. Good luck!
translation: 티켓은 저희 상점에서 물건으로 바꿀 수 있어요. 행운을 빌어요!

english: No thanks, I've got it.
Glad to hear it, good luck!
How am I doing so far?
So far your score is: 0. You haven't started yet.
translation: 지금까지 점수는 0점이에요. 아직 시작도 안 하셨네요.

english: So far your score is: [number]. Not bad, keep going.
So far your score is: [number]. You're pretty good, keep it up.
translation: 지금까지 점수는 [number]점이에요. 꽤 잘하시네요, 계속 그렇게 하세요.

english: Well done. Your score is: [number]. For that score you will receive [number] Archery tickets. Would you like to try again for another 200 coins?
translation: 잘하셨어요. 점수는 [number]점이에요. 그 점수면 Archery ticket(궁술 티켓)을 [number]장 받으실 거예요. 200코인 더 내고 다시 도전해 보시겠어요?

english: I haven't got the money.
Sure, I'll give it a go.
What are the rules?
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks, I've got it.
How am I doing so far?
Hey there. Looking to buy or sell some jewellery?
Sure.
Good choice.
No thanks.
Well come back if you change your mind.
Sure.
No thanks.
Excuse me, you don't look very happy. What's wrong?
translation: 저기요, 표정이 별로 안 좋아 보이네요. 무슨 일 있어요?

english: There's an egg-shaped hole in my life.
translation: 내 인생에 달걀 모양 구멍이 뻥 뚫렸어.

english: What do you mean?
Usually Varrock is full of Easter merriment by now...
translation: 보통 이맘때면 Varrock(바록)은 부활절 분위기로 떠들썩하거든...

english: Wagons heaving with eggs being hauled up through the streets...
translation: 달걀을 잔뜩 실은 수레가 거리를 따라 끙끙대며 올라오고...

english: Giant rabbits hopping about, building stalls and putting up decorations...
translation: 거대한 토끼들이 깡충깡충 돌아다니면서 가판대를 세우고 장식을 달고...

english: That sounds nice.
It was a bloody racket to be honest, and dangerous!
translation: 솔직히 말하면 엄청 시끄럽고 위험하기까지 했지!

english: But I'd gladly stand on a rusty nail or take a plank to the face for one of them delicious chocolate eggs.
translation: 그래도 그 맛있는 초콜릿 달걀 하나만 먹을 수 있다면 녹슨 못을 밟든 판자에 얼굴을 얻어맞든 기꺼이 참겠어.

english: Fair enough. Now that you mention it, I would have expected the Easter Bunny to have turned up by now. You're sure you haven't seen him?
translation: 그렇군요. 말씀을 듣고 보니 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 벌써 왔어야 할 때인데요. 정말 못 보셨어요?

english: Nobody has, and yet the streets are full of old carrots. We don't usually have such a problem with vegetable waste unless him and his lot have turned up.
translation: 아무도 못 봤어. 그런데 거리에는 묵은 당근이 잔뜩 굴러다니지. 그 녀석이랑 패거리가 오지 않는 한 이렇게 채소 쓰레기가 넘칠 일은 없는데 말이야.

english: Vegetable waste, eh?
Aye. It wasn't so bad when it was just the crates lying around, but someone's been in them and scattered carrots all over the place.
translation: 그래. 상자만 굴러다닐 때는 그나마 나았는데, 누가 상자를 뒤져서 당근을 사방에 흩어 놨더라고.

english: Curious... I wonder...
It's not just Varrock mind, it's the woods to the south of here too!
translation: Varrock(바록)만 그런 게 아니야, 여기 남쪽 숲도 마찬가지라고!

english: Hmmmmmmm.......
Crates of carrots you say? Woods to the south?
Aye, proper suspicious if you ask me.
You wait right here sir, I've got a hunch...
translation: 아저씨, 여기서 기다리세요. 뭔가 감이 와요...

english: Oh lunch is it now eh? Can I have some?
translation: 감? 점심에 감이라도 먹을 셈이야? 나도 좀 줘.

english: No, a hunch. About the carrots.
translation: 아뇨, 먹는 감 말고요. 당근에 대해 감이 온다고요.

english: They're old and dirty, I don't want to eat those!
translation: 그 당근은 오래되고 더럽잖아, 그런 건 먹기 싫어!

english: No... Just... I'll be back later! I need to investigate some rotten vegetables.
translation: 아니... 그냥... 나중에 다시 올게요! 썩은 채소를 좀 조사해야 해서요.

english: They best not end up in my lunch!
translation: 그거 내 점심에 들어가기만 해 봐!

english: You should probably have a look around for a suspicious crate of carrots.
translation: 수상한 당근 상자가 있는지 주변을 좀 둘러보는 게 좋겠어.

english: Wait, what was I thinking about? Oh nevermind, it's gone. Can't have been that important I suppose.
translation: 잠깐, 내가 무슨 생각을 하고 있었더라? 아, 됐어요, 까먹었네. 별로 중요한 건 아니었나 봐요.

english: *sigh*
Fetch me lunch for me then eh, I'm right peckish!
translation: 그럼 점심이나 좀 갖다 줘, 배가 엄청 출출하거든!

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment.
Busy mucking about with carrots!
Yeah, where did you say that crate was again?
translation: 그래서, 그 상자가 어디 있다고 하셨죠?

english: It's in the woods just south of here. Carrots all over the place too!
translation: 여기서 바로 남쪽에 있는 숲이야. 당근도 사방에 널려 있고!

english: Oh yes, I remember. Thanks.
Mate, it took you so long to get me lunch the Easter Bunny showed up, I had some choccy eggs instead.
translation: 이봐, 네가 점심 가져오는 데 하도 오래 걸려서 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 와 버렸어. 대신 초코 달걀을 먹었지.

english: Great. That was all me you know.
translation: 잘됐네요. 그거 다 제가 한 거예요.

english: What are you talking about? It was definitely the Easter Bunny.
translation: 무슨 소리야? 그건 분명히 부활절 토끼였다고.

english: You know what?
I'm still too busy to talk to you.
translation: 저 아직 너무 바빠서 이야기할 시간이 없어요.

english: Alright, cheerio!
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Welcome, traveller.
Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: 크리스탈 노래에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course! We elves learned the art long ago, allowing us to form crystals in any way we would like, using just our voices.
translation: 물론이죠! 우리 엘프는 아주 오래전에 이 기술을 익혔답니다. 목소리만으로 크리스탈을 원하는 모양으로 빚어낼 수 있지요.

english: It's allowed us to make weapons, armour and tools using the finest crystals.
translation: 그 덕분에 가장 질 좋은 크리스탈로 무기와 갑옷, 도구를 만들 수 있었답니다.

english: Wow. Is there any way I could do it?
translation: 와. 저도 할 수 있는 방법이 있을까요?

english: You might be able to with the help of the crystal bowl over there. As long as you've got the right knowledge of what you're trying to craft.
translation: 저기 있는 크리스탈 그릇의 도움을 받으면 가능할지도 몰라요. 만들려는 물건에 대한 올바른 지식만 갖추고 있다면요.

english: Could you do it for me?
translation: 저 대신 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thanks!
Could you sing a song for me?
translation: 노래 한 곡 불러 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course! Would you like me to craft something for you? For some crystal shards, of course.
translation: 물론이죠! 무언가 만들어 드릴까요? 물론 crystal shards(크리스탈 조각)을 받고서요.

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그냥 노래를 듣고 싶어요.

english: Conwenna sings you a beautiful song of the elves.
translation: Conwenna(콘웬나)가 아름다운 엘프의 노래를 불러 준다.

english: Wow! Thank you.
You do not have all of the required materials and requirements to make anything.
translation: 무언가를 만드는 데 필요한 재료와 조건을 모두 갖추지 못하셨네요.

english: Could you tell me about crystal singing?
translation: 크리스탈 노래에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Could you do it for me?
translation: 저 대신 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thanks!
Could you sing a song for me?
translation: 노래 한 곡 불러 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes please.
No, thank you. I'd just like to hear you sing.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그냥 노래를 듣고 싶어요.

english: What do you want? I'm busy!
Can you sell me any food?
I suppose I could sell you some cabbage, if you're willing to pay for it. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 돈만 낸다면 양배추 정도는 팔 수 있지. 양배추는 몸에 좋아.

english: Oh, I haven't got any money.
Why are you asking me to sell you food if you haven't got any money? Go away!
translation: 돈도 없으면서 왜 음식을 팔라는 거야? 저리 가!

english: Oh, I haven't got enough space to carry it.
Why are you asking me to sell you food if you can't carry it? Go away!
translation: 들고 가지도 못하면서 왜 음식을 팔라는 거야? 저리 가!

english: Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
It's a deal. Now, make sure you eat it all up. Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 거래 성립이군. 자, 남기지 말고 다 먹어. 양배추는 몸에 좋아.

english: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
Bah! People these days only appreciate junk food.
translation: 쳇! 요즘 사람들은 불량 식품만 좋아한다니까.

english: Can you give me any free food?
translation: 공짜 음식 좀 줄 수 있어요?

english: Can you give me any free money?
translation: 너는 나한테 공짜 돈 좀 줄 수 있어?

english: Why should I give you free money?
translation: 제가 왜 공짜로 돈을 줘야 하죠?

english: Why should I give you free food?
translation: 그럼 나는 왜 공짜로 음식을 줘야 하는데?

english: Oh, forget it.
I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 이런 끔찍한 부엌에서 나온 건 아무것도 필요 없어요.

english: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
translation: 감히 그런 말을! 이 부엌을 깨끗하게 하려고 얼마나 애쓰는데. 매일 흘리는 내 땀과 피나는 노력으로 이 부엌이 깨끗한 거라고!

english: Ewww!
Oh, just leave me alone.
translation: 아, 그냥 날 좀 내버려 둬.

english: Very well done, take this.
Can you sell me any food?
Alright, I'll buy a cabbage.
No thanks, I don't like cabbage.
Can you give me any free food?
translation: 공짜 음식 좀 줄 수 있어요?

english: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.
translation: 이런 끔찍한 부엌에서 나온 건 아무것도 필요 없어요.

english: Hello...
I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
translation: 분명히 너, 이제 나한테 말 안 걸겠다고 했던 거 똑똑히 기억하는데. 그런데 또 와서 요리하는 사람 귓구멍에 대고 쉴 새 없이 떠들어 대는군! 이번엔 또 뭐야?

english: Can you cook me something?
translation: 저한테 요리 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: What? No! Go away.
Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?
translation: 아니, 요리사잖아요. 왜 저한테 요리를 못 해 준다는 거예요?

english: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.
translation: 하기 싫으니까 그렇지! 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬.

english: You're not a very nice man.
Yet you keep talking to me!
Good point. I should stop that.
Yes, do us both a favour.
Why do you work here?
Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
translation: Wilderness(황야) 바로 가장자리에, 거친 불한당들로 가득한 이 수상쩍은 여관에서 내가 왜 일하겠어? 일자리가 필요하니까 일하는 거지!

english: Do you like it?
Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
translation: 마음에 드냐고? 이 일 때문에 내 안의 따뜻함과 인간성은 다 빨려 나갔고, 이제 나는 분노와 비참함, 그리고 고급 요리법만 남은 텅 빈 껍데기가 됐어.

english: Oh.
What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?
translation: 무슨 대답을 기대했는데? 여기서 일하면 가장 어두운 곳에서도 희망을 찾는 법이나, 모든 것에서 좋은 점을 보는 법을 배울 수 있다는 감동적인 이야기라도 들려줄 줄 알았나?

english: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.
translation: 다른 여관으로 옮기는 걸 생각해 보는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.
translation: 흥! 이런 데 질 생각은 없어. 자, 요리에 집중 좀 하게 해 줘.

english: Okay.
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 재미있는 농담 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Ohhh, if you insist...
What did the half-wit say to the cook?
I don't know.
[He/She] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: [He/She]가 '재미있는 농담 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?' 하더라고. 속았지! 하하하하!

english: Whatever.
Can you cook me something?
translation: 저한테 요리 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Why do you work here?
Can you tell me any good jokes?
translation: 재미있는 농담 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: What am I to do?
What's wrong?
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: 아이고, 아이고, 이를 어째. 큰일 났어요! 오늘이 공작님 생신이라 크고 멋진 생일 케이크를 만들어 드려야 하거든요.

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. He'll sack me! What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: 그런데 재료 사는 걸 깜빡했지 뭐예요. 이제 와서는 도저히 제시간에 못 구해요. 공작님이 절 해고하실 거예요! 어쩌면 좋죠? 저한테는 돌봐야 할 아이 넷에 염소도 한 마리 있는데. 좀 도와주실래요? 네?

english: Yes, I'll help you.
Oh thank you, thank you. I need milk, an egg and flour. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: 아, 고마워요, 정말 고마워요. 우유랑 달걀 하나, 밀가루가 필요해요. 구해 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: I have all of those ingredients on me already!
translation: 그 재료라면 벌써 다 가지고 있어요!

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a cake too?
translation: 거참 신기한 우연이네요... 혹시 당신도 케이크를 만들 생각이었어요?

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: 꼭 그런 건 아니고요. 그냥 이 재료가 필요하실 것 같은 묘한 느낌이 들었어요. 요리사가 있으면 무슨 음식이든 만들 테니까요! 운 좋게 맞힌 거죠, 뭐.

english: Well thank you! Hand them over, please.
You've brought me everything I need! I am saved! Thank you!
translation: 필요한 걸 전부 가져다주셨네요! 이제 살았어요! 고마워요!

english: So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
translation: 그럼 저도 공작님 파티에 갈 수 있는 건가요?

english: I'm afraid not, only the big cheeses get to dine with the Duke.
translation: 아쉽지만 안 돼요. 공작님과 식사하는 건 높으신 분들만 가능하거든요.

english: Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
translation: 뭐, 언젠가는 저도 공작님 식탁에 앉을 만큼 중요한 사람이 되겠죠.

english: Maybe, but I won't be holding my breath.
translation: 그럴지도 모르죠. 하지만 너무 기대하진 않을래요.

english: So where do I find these ingredients then?
translation: 그럼 이 재료들은 어디서 구하면 되나요?

english: There is a Mill fairly close, go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: 꽤 가까운 곳에 방앗간이 있어요. 북쪽으로 갔다가 서쪽으로 가세요. Mill Lane Mill(밀 레인 방앗간)은 Draynor(드레이너)로 가는 길 바로 옆에 있어요. 저는 보통 거기서 밀가루를 사요.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, you've got one on you already.
translation: Millie(밀리)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 도와줄 거예요. 아주 사랑스러운 아가씨에다 솜씨 좋은 방앗간 주인이거든요. 다만 밀가루를 담을 단지는 꼭 챙겨 가세요. 지금 하나 가지고 계시네요.

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, there should be one on the table in here.
translation: Millie(밀리)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 도와줄 거예요. 아주 사랑스러운 아가씨에다 솜씨 좋은 방앗간 주인이거든요. 다만 밀가루를 담을 단지는 꼭 챙겨 가세요. 여기 식탁 위에 하나 있을 거예요.

english: There is a cattle field on the other side of the river, just across the road from the Groats' Farm.
translation: 강 건너편에 소 목장이 있어요. Groats' Farm(그로츠 농장)에서 길 하나만 건너면 바로예요.

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows - she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: Gillie Groats(길리 그로츠)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 젖소를 돌보는 사람이라 젖 짜는 법에 대해 알아야 할 건 다 알려 줄 거예요!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. I do see you've got a bucket with you already luckily!
translation: 우유를 담으려면 빈 양동이가 필요해요. 다행히 벌써 양동이를 가지고 계시네요!

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. The general store just north of the castle will sell you one for a couple of coins.
translation: 우유를 담으려면 빈 양동이가 필요해요. 성 바로 북쪽에 있는 general store(잡화점)에서 코인 몇 닢이면 하나 살 수 있어요.

english: I normally get my eggs from the Groats' farm, on the other side of the river.
translation: 저는 보통 강 건너편 Groats' farm(그로츠 농장)에서 달걀을 구해요.

english: But any chicken should lay eggs.
translation: 하지만 닭이라면 어느 닭이든 달걀을 낳을 거예요.

english: I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
No, I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous beasts. Go on your merry way!
translation: 그러세요. 모험가 족속들은 냉혈한이라는 거 진작 알고 있었어요. 갈 길이나 가세요!

english: You're a cook, why don't you bake me a cake?
translation: 요리사잖아요. 저한테 케이크 하나 구워 주지 그래요?

english: *sniff* Don't talk to me about cakes...
You don't look very happy.
No, I'm not. The world is caving in around me - I am overcome by dark feelings of impending doom.
translation: 네, 안 좋아요. 세상이 제 주위로 무너져 내리는 것 같아요. 다가오는 파멸에 대한 암울한 예감에 짓눌려 있어요.

english: I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
No, that's the worst thing I could do. I'd get in terrible trouble.
translation: 안 돼요, 그랬다간 최악이에요. 정말 큰일 나요.

english: Well maybe you need to take a holiday...
That would be nice, but the Duke doesn't allow holidays for core staff.
translation: 그러면 좋겠지만 공작님은 핵심 직원에게 휴가를 허락하지 않으세요.

english: Hmm, why not run away to the sea and start a new life as a Pirate?
translation: 흠, 그럼 바다로 도망가서 해적으로 새 인생을 시작하는 건 어때요?

english: My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches. I don't see it working myself.
translation: 제 아내는 뱃멀미를 하고, 저는 안대를 이유 없이 무서워해요. 제가 보기엔 잘 안 될 것 같아요.

english: I'm afraid I've run out of ideas.
translation: 죄송하지만 더 이상 생각나는 게 없네요.

english: I know I'm doomed.
Nice hat!
Err thank you. It's a pretty ordinary cooks hat really.
translation: 어, 고마워요. 그냥 아주 평범한 요리사 모자인데요.

english: Still, suits you. The trousers are pretty special too.
translation: 그래도 잘 어울려요. 바지도 꽤 특별하네요.

english: Its all standard cook's issue uniform...
The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you lookslike a real cook.
translation: 모자, 앞치마, 줄무늬 바지까지 한 벌로 맞춰 입으니까 딱 어울려요. 진짜 요리사처럼 보여요.

english: I am a real cook! I haven't got time to be chatting about Culinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: 저 진짜 요리사거든요! 요리 패션 얘기나 하고 있을 시간 없어요. 지금 도움이 절실하다고요!

english: How are you getting on with finding the ingredients?
I haven't got any of them yet, I'm still looking.
translation: 아직 하나도 못 구했어요. 계속 찾는 중이에요.

english: Please get the ingredients quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 제발 재료를 빨리 구해 주세요. 시간이 얼마 없어요! 공작님이 절 길바닥으로 내쫓으실 거예요!

english: I'll get right on it.
Here's a bucket of milk.
translation: 여기 bucket of milk(우유 양동이) 있어요.

english: Here's a pot of flour.
translation: 여기 pot of flour(밀가루 단지) 있어요.

english: Here's a fresh egg.
Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far. Please get the rest quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 지금까지 구해 주신 재료 고마워요. 나머지도 빨리 부탁해요. 시간이 얼마 없어요! 공작님이 절 길바닥으로 내쫓으실 거예요!

english: How is the adventuring going, my friend?
I don't have anything for you to do right now, sorry.
I am getting strong and mighty. Grrr
Glad to hear it.
I keep on dying.
Ah well, at least you keep coming back to life!
Can I use your range?
Go ahead - it's a very good range. It's easier to use than most other ranges.
translation: 그러세요. 아주 좋은 range(레인지)예요. 다른 레인지들보다 쓰기 쉽거든요.

english: Its called the Cook-o-matic 100. It uses a combination of state of the art temperature regulation and magic.
translation: 이름은 Cook-o-matic 100(쿡오매틱 100)이에요. 최첨단 온도 조절 기술과 마법을 결합해서 쓴대요.

english: Will it mean my food will burn less often?
translation: 그럼 음식을 덜 태우게 되는 건가요?

english: Well, that's what the salesman told us anyway...
Thanks?
Hey, who said you could use that?
translation: 이봐요, 누가 그거 써도 된다고 했어요?

english: Hello Cook. The Easter Bunny has run out of fuel for his egg making machine and has sent me to ask you for a favour.
translation: 안녕하세요, 요리사님. Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 달걀 만드는 기계의 연료가 떨어져서 저를 보내 부탁을 드리라고 했어요.

english: I am listening.
Do you by chance have any Hosidius milk? The Easter Bunny needs some to make the fuel.
translation: 혹시 Hosidius milk(호시디우스 우유) 있으세요? 부활절 토끼가 연료를 만드는 데 필요하대요.

english: I may have some lying around the kitchen, I would gladly give you some milk for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 부엌 어딘가에 좀 있을 거예요. 부활절 토끼를 위해서라면 기꺼이 우유를 드리죠.

english: But first you must answer a riddle. If you get it right, I will give you some Hosidius milk.
translation: 하지만 먼저 수수께끼를 풀어야 해요. 맞히면 Hosidius milk(호시디우스 우유)를 드릴게요.

english: I would be glad to answer a riddle for you.
Are you ready to answer my riddle?
Yes I am ready, crack out your riddle.
I leave my home only once a year, but do not give any Christmas cheer. Who am I?
translation: 나는 일 년에 딱 한 번 집을 나서지만, 크리스마스의 기쁨을 주지는 않아요. 나는 누구일까요?

english: I am sorry but that is not quite right.
Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: 다시 도전할 준비가 되면 말을 걸어 주세요.

english: Congratulations, that's the right answer.
Here is the Hosidius milk I promised.
You receive a bottle of Hosidius milk
translation: Hosidius milk(호시디우스 우유) 한 병을 받았다

english: Filling me with eggs is bad... but I'll make a case for it.
translation: 달걀을 전부 나한테 담지 말라고들 하지만... 그래도 담을 자리는 내가 마련해 드리죠.

english: When dark and bitter, drink me warm in the winter.
translation: 진하고 쌉싸름할 때는, 겨울에 나를 따뜻하게 마셔요.

english: I am round, yet not a perfect sphere. I can be cracked and not have anything inside. What am I?
translation: 나는 둥글지만 완벽한 구는 아니에요. 금이 갈 수 있고, 안이 텅 비어 있을 수도 있죠. 나는 무엇일까요?

english: Not just yet, maybe later.
You should probably go and give the milk to the Easter Bunny, hop to it. Don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting.
translation: 이제 그 우유를 부활절 토끼에게 가져다주는 게 좋겠어요. 깡충깡충 서둘러요. 부활절 토끼를 기다리게 하면 안 되죠.

english: I seem to have lost the milk, do you by any chance have any more?
translation: 우유를 잃어버린 것 같아요. 혹시 더 있으세요?

english: Of course I do, try not to spill it this time.
translation: 물론 있죠. 이번엔 흘리지 않게 조심하세요.

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!
translation: 획득: [found a new clue scroll/obtained a casket]!

english: I've always wondered how many cannons the castle has. Could you find out for me?
translation: 성에 대포가 몇 문이나 있는지 늘 궁금했어요. 좀 알아봐 주실래요?

english: The cook has given you a challenge scroll!
Please tell me how many cannons there are.
translation: 대포가 몇 문 있는지 알려 주세요.

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right.
Cheers!
The cook has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: 오, 귀여운 토끼잖아! 벌써 부활절인 줄 몰랐네요!

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: 귀여워?! 귀여운 맛 좀 보여 줄까! 내가 그냥...

english: *AHEM*
Sorry.
Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: 요리사님, 장식으로 쓸 멋진 달걀을 찾고 있어요. 혹시 뭐 없으세요?

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: 흠... 달걀이야 잔뜩 있지만 대부분 케이크 만들 때 쓰는 평범한 닭 달걀이에요.

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: 그런데 생각해 보니 뭔가 있을지도 모르겠네요...

english: Go on...
I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: 제가... '특별한' 달걀 수집품이 있거든요. 아주... '특별한' 날을 위해서... 그러니까... 찬장 깊숙한 곳에 보관해 두는 거요.

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: 그런데 이번이 그만큼 특별한 날인지는 잘 모르겠네요.

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: 요리사가 찬장 안쪽을 뒤져 알록달록한 달걀 몇 개를 꺼내 Gregg(그레그)에게 건넨다.

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it!
Seriously, don't mention it.
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: 자, 이제 달걀은 구했네요. 다음은 뭐예요?

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: 흠... 보송보송한 양털이 꽤 예쁠 것 같은데...

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: 여기서 북쪽으로 얼마 안 가면 양 우리가 있어요. 원하면 거기서 갓 깎은 양털을 구할 수 있을 거예요.

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: 네, 양 우리로 가세요. 그리고 제 부엌에서 나가 주세요...

english: Oh, you're still here.
Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
translation: 응! 그냥 시간 좀 때우는 중이야!

english: Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: 북쪽에 있는 양 우리로 간다고 하지 않았어요?

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: 급할 거 없어. 양들은 우리 안에 있으니까 어디 갈 데도 없잖아.

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: 그럼 아직 여기 있는 김에 하나 더 해 줄 일이 있어요.

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: 곧 공작님 생신인데 재료가 다 떨어져 가요.

english: As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
translation: Duke of Lumbridge(럼브리지 공작)님이 아무리 중요한 분이라도, 부활절을 위해서라면 조금 더 기다려 주실 거예요.

english: Wait... didn't the Duke just have his birthday?
translation: 잠깐만요... 공작님 생신 얼마 전에 지나지 않았어요?

english: Ahem... forget I said anything.
translation: 에헴... 제가 한 말은 잊어 주세요.

english: Cook, as fun as it is bringing you ingredients, don't you just burn all your cakes anyway?
translation: 요리사님, 재료 가져다드리는 것도 재미있긴 한데, 어차피 케이크는 다 태우시잖아요?

english: I... well yes, but how else am I supposed to train cooking?
translation: 저... 뭐, 그렇긴 한데, 그럼 요리 실력은 어떻게 키우라는 거예요?

english: You could try something simple like fish, perhaps?
translation: 생선처럼 간단한 걸로 해 보면 어때요?

english: And have the entire castle smelling like Port Sarim? No thank you!
translation: 그래서 성 전체에서 Port Sarim(포트 사림) 냄새가 나게 하라고요? 사양할게요!

english: The eggs you gave Gregg were just rotten ones, weren't they.
translation: Gregg(그레그)한테 준 달걀, 그냥 썩은 달걀이었죠?

english: Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
translation: 뭐, 그 친구가 이상하게 생긴 달걀을 원했잖아요. 제가 가진 것 중에 그게 제일 이상했어요.

english: Just be thankful he didn't ask for some fancy milk instead!
translation: 그 친구가 대신 '특별한' 우유를 달라고 하지 않은 걸 다행으로 아세요!

english: *sigh* Do you know where he went at least?
translation: *한숨* 그럼 그 친구가 어디 갔는지는 아세요?

english: I think he said he was going to the sheep pen north of here.
translation: 여기서 북쪽에 있는 양 우리로 간다고 했던 것 같아요.

english: How should I know? You should check in Draynor, maybe you'll find him there.
translation: 제가 어떻게 알아요? Draynor(드레이너)에 가 보세요. 거기 있을지도 몰라요.

english: What's wrong?
I'm always happy to help a cook in distress.
translation: 곤경에 처한 요리사라면 언제든 기꺼이 도와드리죠.

english: Where do I find some flour?
How about milk?
And eggs? Where are they found?
I've got all the information I need. Thanks.
Actually, I know where to find this stuff.
I can't right now, Maybe later.
Can you make me a cake?
translation: 케이크 하나 만들어 줄 수 있어요?

english: You don't look very happy.
I'd take the rest of the day off if I were you.
Nice hat!
I'll get right on it.
Can you remind me how to find these things again?
translation: 이걸 어디서 구하는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: Do you have any other quests for me?
I am getting strong and mighty.
I keep on dying.
Can I use your range?
Talk about Easter.
Yes.
Count Check.
Easter Bunny.
Father Aereck.
Bob.
Santa.
River Lum.
Sack.
Spider web.
Basket.
Bucket.
Lemon juice.
Beer.
Sewer water.
Butter.
Chocolate.
Easter Egg.
The Grand Exchange.
Cake.
Potato.
Choc-ice.
No.
Something else.
Ask about the Easter event.
Ask about something else.
You're not aristocracy but I suppose you'd do. Do you want a good cook for 3000 coins?
translation: 귀족은 아니지만 뭐, 그럭저럭 괜찮겠네요. 3000코인에 솜씨 좋은 요리사를 고용하시겠어요?

english: What can you do?
I am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 저는 Gielinor(길리노르) 최고의 요리사예요! 은행이나 제재소에도 꽤 빨리 다녀올 수 있고요.

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 예전에 하던 일에 대해 말해 줘요.

english: I used to be the cook for the old Duke of Lumbridge. Visiting dignitaries praised me for my fine banquets!
translation: 예전에는 선대 Duke of Lumbridge(럼브리지 공작)님의 요리사였어요. 찾아온 귀빈들이 제 훌륭한 연회 요리를 칭찬했죠!

english: But then someone found a rule that said that only one family could hold that post.
translation: 그런데 누가 그 자리는 한 가문만 맡을 수 있다는 규칙을 찾아냈지 뭐예요.

english: Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!
translation: 하룻밤 새 저는 해고되고, 남의 도움 없이는 케이크 하나 못 굽는 멍청이가 그 자리를 차지했어요!

english: Hmph! I don't work for just anyone, you know! I refuse to work for someone who's below level 30 Construction!
translation: 흥! 저는 아무 밑에서나 일하지 않아요! Construction(건설) 레벨 30 미만인 사람 밑에서는 일 안 해요!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 하인이 잘 수 있도록 침대가 있는 두 번째 침실이 필요해요.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 고용할게요... 그런데 지금 돈이 없는데 외상으로 해도 될까요? 꼭 갚을게요, 진짜로요.

english: Are you having a laugh? No cash up front, no cook.
You're hired!
[Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] I can start work immediately.
translation: [Alright, sir./Alright, madam./Alright.] 바로 일을 시작할 수 있어요.

english: What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 예전에 하던 일에 대해 말해 줘요

english: You're hired!
Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 요리의 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish.
translation: 가장 간단하게 요리할 수 있는 건 날고기나 생선이에요.

english: Fish can be caught, speak to the fishing tutor south of here in the swamp. Killing cows or chickens will yield raw meat to cook too.
translation: 생선은 직접 잡으면 돼요. 여기서 남쪽 늪에 있는 fishing tutor(낚시 교사)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. cows(소)나 chickens(닭)을 잡아도 요리할 날고기를 얻을 수 있어요.

english: You can use your own fire... but it's not as effective and you'll burn more. To build a fire use a tinderbox on logs.
translation: 직접 불을 피워서 써도 되지만... 효율이 떨어지고 음식을 더 많이 태우게 될 거예요. 불을 피우려면 logs(통나무)에 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)을 사용하세요.

english: Once you've found your range, click on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook.
translation: range(레인지)를 찾았으면 클릭하세요. 요리할 수 있는 음식 메뉴가 나타날 거예요.

english: If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: 퀘스트에 관심이 있다면, Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성)에 있는 제 친구 cook(요리사)가 일손이 필요하다고 들었어요. 그에게 말을 걸면 일을 맡겨 줄 거예요.

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 요리의 기초는 이미 알아요. 팁 같은 거 있나요?

english: Using a range cuts down the possibility of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
translation: range(레인지)를 쓰면 음식을 태울 확률이 줄어들어요. 사실 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성)에 있는 레인지는 몇몇 음식에 특히 좋다고 하더라고요.

english: Compare the skills you learn to the effort put into making the food and the health that it heals, find a good combination for you.
translation: 배우는 기술과 음식을 만드는 데 드는 수고, 그리고 음식이 회복해 주는 체력을 비교해서 자신에게 맞는 좋은 조합을 찾아보세요.

english: Any advice for an advanced chef?
As you get better and better you'll find that you can cook better food such as pizza! These are very good for healing you when fighting the big monsters.
translation: 실력이 점점 늘면 피자 같은 더 좋은 음식도 만들 수 있게 될 거예요! 피자는 큰 몬스터와 싸울 때 체력을 회복하기에 아주 좋아요.

english: How can I train my cooking?
It seems we have a real master chef in our mists. Maybe you should be the one giving me cooking advice.
translation: 우리 가운데 진정한 요리의 달인이 있었군요. 오히려 당신이 제게 요리 조언을 해 줘야겠는데요.

english: If you feel up to the task, you could try your hand at making pizza. A pizza is comprised of flour with water/ Put some tomato on there, sprinkle on some cheese then cook it. You might consider adding a topping too.
translation: 자신 있다면 피자 만들기에 도전해 보세요. 피자는 flour(밀가루)에 물을 섞어 만들어요. 그 위에 tomato(토마토)를 올리고 cheese(치즈)를 뿌린 다음 구우면 돼요. 토핑을 추가하는 것도 생각해 보세요.

english: Potatoes are another great food, but I won't go into much detail about those I'm afraid.
translation: 감자도 훌륭한 음식이지만, 아쉽게도 그건 자세히 설명하지 않을게요.

english: Of course, you can try making a curry or baked potato if you feel up to it.
translation: 물론 자신 있다면 curry(카레)나 baked potato(구운 감자)를 만들어 봐도 좋아요.

english: Tell me about different foods.
translation: 여러 가지 음식에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, expirement which one works for you.
translation: 생선과 고기는 대부분 불이나 range(레인지)에서 아주 간단히 요리할 수 있어요. 어느 쪽이 맞는지 직접 실험해 보세요.

english: You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys. Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)이나 Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)의 fermenting vats(발효 통)에서 맥주를 직접 빚을 수 있어요. buckets of water(물 양동이) 두 개, barley malt(보리 맥아) 두 줌, 원하는 hops(홉) 4개, pot of ale yeast(에일 효모 단지) 하나를 넣고

english: ferment for a few days!
Simply turn the tap and let the ale flow into the barrel next to the vat, then use empty beer glasses on the barrel.
translation: tap(수도꼭지)를 돌려서 에일이 발효 통 옆의 barrel(통)으로 흘러가게 한 다음, 빈 beer glasses(맥주잔)을 통에 사용하세요.

english: Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too! You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: Baked potatoes(구운 감자)는 훌륭한 음식이고 건강에도 좋아요! 교반기로 butter(버터)와 cheese(치즈)를 만들어야 해요. 미니맵에서 교반기 아이콘을 찾아보세요. Lumbridge(럼브리지) 북서쪽 농장 건물에 churn(교반기)가 하나 있어요.

english: The nearest dairy cow is north of the nearby water mill. Take buckets of milk with you to the churn and use the milk on the churn to make butter or cheese.
translation: 가장 가까운 dairy cow(젖소)는 근처 물레방앗간 북쪽에 있어요. buckets of milk(우유 양동이)를 churn(교반기)로 가져가서 우유를 교반기에 사용하면 버터나 치즈를 만들 수 있어요.

english: Use a pot of flour with a bucket of awter. You will then get an option to make bread dough, pitta bread dough, pastry dough, or pizza dough. Select pizza or pastry dough.
translation: pot of flour(밀가루 단지)를 bucket of water(물 양동이)와 함께 사용하세요. 그러면 bread dough(빵 반죽), pitta bread dough(피타 빵 반죽), pastry dough(페이스트리 반죽), pizza dough(피자 반죽) 중에서 고를 수 있어요. 피자 반죽이나 페이스트리 반죽을 선택하세요.

english: Use the pastry dough with a pie dish then add your filling such as apple or red berries.
translation: pastry dough(페이스트리 반죽)을 pie dish(파이 접시)에 사용한 다음, apple(사과)나 red berries(빨간 열매) 같은 속재료를 넣으세요.

english: Finally cook your pie by using the unbaked pie on a cooking range. Mmmm...pie.
translation: 마지막으로 굽지 않은 파이를 cooking range(요리용 레인지)에 사용해서 구우면 돼요. 음~ 파이.

english: There's pizza too! Find yourself some tomato and cheese, use on the Pizza dough. Cook the pizza on a range then add any other toppings you want, such as anchovies.
translation: 피자도 있어요! tomato(토마토)와 cheese(치즈)를 구해서 Pizza dough(피자 반죽)에 사용하세요. 피자를 range(레인지)에서 구운 다음 anchovies(멸치) 같은 원하는 토핑을 더 올리면 돼요.

english: Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello there! Are you interested in hearing all about cooking?
translation: 안녕하세요! 요리에 대해 이것저것 들어 볼래요?

english: The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish. Shrimp can be caught south of here, to the east of Lumbridge Swamp. You could ask the fishing tutor for a net if you have not got one.
translation: 가장 간단한 요리는 날고기나 생선이에요. Shrimp(새우)는 여기서 남쪽, Lumbridge Swamp(럼브리지 늪) 동쪽에서 잡을 수 있어요. net(그물)이 없다면 fishing tutor(낚시 교사)에게 달라고 해 보세요.

english: Alternatively, you could acquire some raw beef or chicken. You can find cows and chickens north of here. Go over the bridge then follow the path north, you can't miss them!
translation: 아니면 raw beef(날 소고기)나 닭고기를 구해도 돼요. 여기서 북쪽에 cows(소)와 chickens(닭)이 있어요. 다리를 건너서 길을 따라 북쪽으로 가면 금방 찾을 거예요!

english: You could use my range here if you like.
translation: 원한다면 여기 있는 제 range(레인지)를 써도 돼요.

english: If you wanted to, my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle has a range you could use. You might find you burn even less on that range as its top notch.
translation: 원한다면 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성)에 있는 제 친구 cook(요리사)의 range(레인지)를 써도 돼요. 그 레인지는 최고급이라 음식을 훨씬 덜 태울 거예요.

english: Alternatively, you can use your own fire, but it's not as effective and the food will burn more frequently. To make a fire, use a tinderbox on some logs.
translation: 아니면 직접 불을 피워도 되지만, 효율이 떨어지고 음식이 더 자주 타요. 불을 피우려면 logs(통나무)에 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)을 사용하세요.

english: Once you've found your range or fire, use your raw food on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook. Then select the food you want.
translation: range(레인지)나 불을 찾았으면 날음식을 거기에 사용하세요. 요리할 수 있는 음식 메뉴가 나타나면 원하는 음식을 고르면 돼요.

english: When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank.
translation: 소지품이 요리한 음식으로 가득 차면 쓸모없는 탄 음식은 버리고 bank(은행)을 찾아가세요.

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
translation: 그 밖에 알고 싶은 게 있나요?

english: What kinds of things can I cook?
Many things! You can cook anything from fish to poultry. You could try your hand at making baked potatoes or even brew some of the good stuff.
translation: 아주 많죠! 생선부터 가금류까지 뭐든 요리할 수 있어요. baked potatoes(구운 감자)를 만들어 보거나 좋은 술을 직접 빚어 볼 수도 있고요.

english: What would you like to hear about?
Tell me about Fish and Meat.
You might find that when killing monsters, they drop some raw meat for you to cook.
translation: 몬스터를 잡다 보면 요리할 날고기를 떨어뜨리기도 해요.

english: Some of them might have hidden properties. Such as anglerfish, but you will find it hard getting hold of any of them at this time.
translation: 그중 몇몇은 숨겨진 효과가 있을 수도 있어요. anglerfish(아귀) 같은 거요. 하지만 지금은 구하기 힘들 거예요.

english: Most of the time, cooking meat and fish requires nothing else but a range or fire. More complicated dishes might require specialized equipment.
translation: 대개 고기나 생선을 요리할 때는 range(레인지)나 불만 있으면 돼요. 더 복잡한 요리에는 특별한 도구가 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: Would you like to hear about anything else I mentioned?
translation: 제가 말한 것 중에 더 듣고 싶은 게 있나요?

english: Tell me about Brewing.
You might find it hard getting to these places but you can always buy beer at any pub. Some pubs sell unique beers too.
translation: 그런 곳까지 가기는 힘들겠지만, 맥주는 어느 술집에서나 살 수 있어요. 특별한 맥주를 파는 술집도 있고요.

english: Tell me about Vegetables.
They require many different ingredients to make, such as butter and vegetables, but you will find it hard to acquire the ingredients needed.
translation: 버터나 채소 같은 다양한 재료가 많이 필요한데, 필요한 재료를 구하기가 쉽지 않을 거예요.

english: Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
Next, we have pizza. You will first need to make yourself a pizza base, use a pot of flour with a bucket of water and make a pizza base.
translation: 다음은 피자예요. 먼저 pizza base(피자 도우)를 만들어야 하는데, pot of flour(밀가루 단지)를 bucket of water(물 양동이)와 함께 사용해서 피자 도우를 만들면 돼요.

english: If you want to, you could add yourself a topping to the pizza too. Why not try some anchovies?
translation: 원한다면 피자에 토핑을 올릴 수도 있어요. anchovies(멸치)는 어때요?

english: No, thank you.
Well, just come back any time you want to know how to cook up a storm!
translation: 그럼 요리 솜씨를 마음껏 뽐내고 싶을 때 언제든 다시 오세요!

english: Some foods have hidden properties. Anglerfish can provide you with an overheal effect where you have a few more hitpoints than your level. The higher your hitpoints the better the boost.
translation: 어떤 음식에는 숨겨진 효과가 있어요. Anglerfish(아귀)를 먹으면 체력이 레벨보다 조금 더 높아지는 초과 회복 효과를 얻을 수 있어요. 체력이 높을수록 효과도 커져요.

english: Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to ferment for a few days!
translation: buckets of water(물 양동이) 두 개, barley malt(보리 맥아) 두 줌, 원하는 hops(홉) 4개, pot of ale yeast(에일 효모 단지) 하나를 넣고 며칠 동안 발효시키면 돼요!

english: You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
translation: churn(교반기)로 버터와 치즈를 만들어야 해요. 미니맵에서 교반기 아이콘을 찾아보세요. Lumbridge(럼브리지) 북서쪽 농장 건물에 교반기가 하나 있어요.

english: Now you will need to pick your topping if you want one. Get yourself a boweland create the perfect topping. Then put the topping onto the potato.
translation: 이제 원한다면 토핑을 골라야 해요. bowl(그릇)을 구해서 완벽한 토핑을 만드세요. 그런 다음 토핑을 감자에 올리면 돼요.

english: Some pies might even be able to boost some of your skills, be it temporarily.
translation: 어떤 파이는 일시적이긴 해도 스킬을 올려 주기도 해요.

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
Hello there Zanik! How can I help?
What kind of foods do you eat up here on the surface?
All sorts of foods! There are lots of kinds of fish, and there are stews, pizzas, bread, baked potatoes...
translation: 온갖 음식을 먹죠! 생선 종류도 정말 많고, stews(스튜), 피자, bread(빵), baked potatoes(구운 감자)도 있어요...

english: This is so exciting! Perhaps later I'll come back and sample lots of different surface foods!
translation: 정말 신나요! 나중에 다시 와서 지상 음식을 이것저것 맛봐야겠어요!

english: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name] Can I help you?
translation: 분명 마음에 드실 거예요! [player name]님은요? 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Can you teach me the basics of cooking please?
translation: 요리의 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: I already know the basics of cooking. Got any tips?
translation: 요리의 기초는 이미 알아요. 팁 같은 거 있나요?

english: How can I train my cooking?
Any advice for an advanced chef?
Tell me about different food I can make.
translation: 제가 만들 수 있는 여러 음식에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Fish and Meat
Brewing
Vegetables
Pies and Pizza
Go back to teaching
Goodbye.
What kinds of things can I cook?
Tell me about Fish and Meat.
Tell me about Brewing.
Tell me about Vegetables.
Tell me about Pies and Pizzas.
No, thank you.
Get out of my way stinky! I've got stew to make!
translation: 비켜, 냄새쟁이! 스튜 끓여야 한단 말이야!

english: What do you want, stinky?
Hello to you too. You must be Weasel then.
Yes I am. Cooky Weasel to you. Finest cook this side of, well, pick an object - or a concept - or a location! I'm the best cook any side of anything what you can think of!
translation: 그래, 나다. 너한텐 Cooky Weasel(쿠키 위즐)님이다. 이쪽에서 제일가는 요리사지. 이쪽이 어디냐고? 아무거나 골라 봐 - 물건이든, 개념이든, 장소든! 네가 떠올릴 수 있는 그 무엇의 어느 쪽에서든 내가 최고의 요리사야!

english: Is that why you're down in this hole?
translation: 그래서 이런 구멍 속에 있는 거예요?

english: Hole?! This is a fine establishment. At least it was until you stank it up.
translation: 구멍?! 여긴 훌륭한 가게라고. 적어도 네가 와서 냄새로 망치기 전까진 그랬지.

english: Good grief, this is going to be a long day.
What was that?
I said Wheeler told me you might have some extra nice carrots I could use?
translation: Wheeler(휠러)가 당신한테 쓸 만한 좋은 carrots(당근)이 좀 있을 거라고 했다고요.

english: Wheeler sent you eh? Hmm... Why would I give you my good carrots? Thems for roasting with honey, not for stinking up with your grubby mitts.
translation: Wheeler(휠러)가 보냈다고? 흠... 내가 왜 너한테 귀한 당근을 줘야 하지? 그건 꿀 발라 구울 거라고. 네 더러운 손으로 냄새 묻히라고 있는 게 아니야.

english: I want to make some special carrot juice for the Easter Bunny, to try and cheer him up.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 위해 특별한 당근 주스를 만들어서 기운 좀 내게 해 주고 싶어요.

english: Oh! Well why didn't you say so? Smells like a good idea to me. If anyone deserves some good juice, it's him!
translation: 오! 그럼 진작 말하지 그랬어? 냄새를 맡아 보니 좋은 생각 같네. 좋은 주스를 마실 자격이 있는 녀석이 있다면, 바로 그 친구지!

english: Smells like you don't have space for these wonderful carrots. Clear some room and come back when you can handle the veggies!
translation: 냄새를 맡아 보니 이 멋진 당근을 넣을 공간이 없나 보군. 자리 좀 비우고, 채소를 감당할 수 있을 때 다시 와!

english: There's 3 fancy carrots for you, stinky. Now go and get that juice made before your stench rots 'em!
translation: 자, 고급 당근 3개다, 냄새쟁이. 이제 가서 그 주스나 만들어. 네 악취에 당근 썩기 전에!

english: Thanks!
You've managed to make carrot juice? Surprising, and it doesn't seem to stink. Almost unbelievable!
translation: 당근 주스를 만들었다고? 놀랍군, 게다가 냄새도 안 나는 것 같고. 믿기지가 않네!

english: Smells to me like you've already got enough of my fancy carrots. Go away!
translation: 냄새를 맡아 보니 내 고급 당근은 이미 충분히 가진 것 같은데. 저리 가!

english: What are you after now?
I need another carrot, I lost one.
translation: 당근이 하나 더 필요해요. 하나 잃어버렸어요.

english: I need more carrots, I lost some of them.
translation: 당근이 더 필요해요. 몇 개 잃어버렸어요.

english: I need more carrots, I lost them all.
You weren't nibbling at them were you? I bet you were thinking about it.
translation: 설마 몰래 갉아먹은 건 아니겠지? 먹을 생각은 했을 거라는 데 내 국자를 걸지.

english: Of course not.
Yeah right. Here, take 'em. Take all of my lovely carrots! Just make sure the Easter Bunny gets his juice this time.
translation: 퍽이나. 옜다, 가져가. 내 사랑스러운 당근 다 가져가라고! 이번엔 꼭 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)한테 주스가 가도록 해.

english: Thank you. Won't happen again.
translation: 고마워요. 다시는 이런 일 없을 거예요.

english: You've been eating the carrots! I can smell 'em on your breath! You big stinking piggy!
translation: 너 당근 먹었지! 입에서 당근 냄새가 난다고! 이 냄새나는 돼지야!

english: I'm sure I would remember eating such a delicous, sweet, crunchy, orange, juicy...
translation: 그렇게 맛있고, 달콤하고, 아삭하고, 주황빛에, 즙이 많은 걸 먹었다면 분명 기억할 텐데요...

english: What was the question?
Take these carrots and get out of my sight.
translation: 이 당근 가지고 내 눈앞에서 사라져.

english: You've got orange stains around your mouth!
translation: 입 주변에 주황색 얼룩이 묻어 있잖아!

english: Probably from the carrot juice.
YOU WHAT?!? You DRANK the juice that you made for the Easter Bunny?
translation: 뭐라고?!? Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 위해 만든 주스를 네가 마셨다고?

english: It was very good.
Oh for... Please use these carrots for their intended purpose.
translation: 아오 진짜... 제발 이 당근은 원래 목적대로 써 줘.

english: Not only that, I drank the juice!
YOU WHAT?!? You're a real piece of work. Do you think these carrots grow on trees?
translation: 뭐라고?!? 너 정말 대단한 녀석이구나. 이 당근이 나무에서 열리는 줄 알아?

english: Yes.
Well they don't. They grow underground. And they're expensive. So either help the Easter Bunny, or stop wasting my stock!
translation: 안 열려. 땅속에서 자란다고. 게다가 비싸! 그러니까 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 돕든지, 아니면 내 재고 그만 축내!

english: I'll do my best.
Good news! The Easter Bunny loved the juice I made with your fancy carrots!
translation: 좋은 소식이에요! Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 당신의 고급 당근으로 만든 주스를 아주 좋아했어요!

english: I'm glad to hear it.
Now clear off!
Keep your hands away from these lovely carrots, stinky!
translation: 이 사랑스러운 당근에서 손 떼, 냄새쟁이!

english: I wasn't anywhere near them!
I can smell you getting closer, stinky!
I don't want any carrots I'm just here for eggs!
translation: 당근은 필요 없어요. 전 eggs(달걀) 때문에 온 거예요!

english: Good, cause these carrots aren't for you, stinky!
translation: 잘됐네, 이 당근은 네 거 아니니까, 냄새쟁이!

english: Fine, I'm going!
Greetings human.
Hello, who are you?
Corkat quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: 나는 Corkat quo Sihar(코르카트 쿠오 시하르)라 하오. Kahlith(칼리스)의 신비술사 중 하나요. 그대는 균형을 섬기러 왔소?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)과 이야기하시오. 그녀가 그대를 인도할 것이오.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 아쉽군. 그대는 죽음을 가져오는 자이니, 균형에 큰 도움이 될 수 있을 텐데.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기해 보시오. 그가 길을 알려 줄 것이오.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Hey it's the hero! Thank you so much for saving us from Gadderanks. And the town is looking lovely as well. You've done a great job!
translation: 영웅님이시군요! Gadderanks(개더랭크스)에게서 저희를 구해 주셔서 정말 감사해요. 마을도 정말 보기 좋아졌어요. 정말 큰일을 해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Cornelius. I run the bank now.
translation: 저는 Cornelius(코르넬리우스)예요. 지금은 bank(은행)을 운영하고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect. Thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really. We're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 근근이 먹고살고 있죠.

english: Hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey across the Salve.
translation: 머지않아 Salve(살브 강)을 건너는 여정에 나설 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?
Not as far as I know. We have some basic amenities now which is so very useful and we're all incredibly grateful to you.
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 당신께 무척 감사하고 있어요.

english: I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 영웅을 실제로 보거나 알고 지낸 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 분명 영웅일 거예요! 저만 해도 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Okay, thanks.
Excuse me! This area is different than the rest of the Wilderness, are you sure you understand the rules?
translation: 잠깐만요! 이곳은 Wilderness(황야)의 다른 곳과는 달라요. 규칙은 제대로 알고 계신가요?

english: I can tell you everything you need to know, but if you're in a rush then be warned my overlords will NOT be happy if they find you to be fighting with no honour.
translation: 알아야 할 건 전부 알려 드릴 수 있지만, 바쁘시다면 경고해 두죠. 제 주인님들은 당신이 명예 없이 싸우는 걸 보면 절대 좋아하지 않을 거예요.

english: Just don't go doing anything silly like selling your soul to your opponent else there will be big trouble!
translation: 상대에게 영혼을 파는 것 같은 어리석은 짓만은 하지 마세요. 그랬다간 큰일 날 테니까요!

english: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?
translation: [How may I help you, sir/How may I help you, madam/How may I help you]?

english: I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: 이 경기장의 전투 규칙을 배우고 싶어요!

english: Sure. Which part do you want to learn?
Let's talk about Targets.
Sure. Upon entering the arena, you will be assigned a Target based on your combat level, and if you wish to adjust the range of potential Targets, you may do so by speaking with the Trader.
translation: 물론이죠. 경기장에 들어가면 전투 레벨에 따라 Target(표적)이 배정돼요. 배정될 수 있는 표적의 범위를 조정하고 싶다면 Trader(상인)과 이야기하면 돼요.

english: If you wish to change your Target, you may skip your current one, but please note that if you skip three skulled Targets within 30 minutes, you will not be able to receive a new Target for the next 30 minutes.
translation: Target(표적)을 바꾸고 싶다면 지금 표적을 건너뛸 수 있어요. 단, 30분 안에 해골 표시가 있는 표적을 세 번 건너뛰면 그 후 30분 동안은 새 표적을 받을 수 없으니 주의하세요.

english: Additionally, it's worth mentioning that killing a player who is not your Target will not reward you with any bonuses related to Emblem or Bounty Hunter Points.
translation: 덧붙이자면, 자신의 Target(표적)이 아닌 플레이어를 죽이면 Emblem(엠블럼)이나 Bounty Hunter Points(바운티 헌터 포인트)와 관련된 보너스를 받을 수 없어요.

english: Goodbye.
Tell me about Emblems.
After defeating your Target, you may come across a tier one Emblem. Defeating another Target will level up the Emblem; the higher its tier, the greater its value.
translation: Target(표적)을 쓰러뜨리면 1단계 Emblem(엠블럼)을 얻을 수도 있어요. 다른 표적을 쓰러뜨리면 엠블럼의 단계가 올라가고, 단계가 높을수록 가치도 커져요.

english: If you die while carrying an Emblem, its tier will be reduced by one. If you die with a Tier 1 emblem, you will lose the emblem.
translation: Emblem(엠블럼)을 지닌 채 죽으면 단계가 하나 내려가요. 1단계 엠블럼을 지닌 채 죽으면 엠블럼을 잃게 돼요.

english: You may use Bounty Hunter Points to purchase a tier one Emblem from the Trader, or sell your own Emblem to him for Bounty Hunter Points. You can only have one Emblem at a time.
translation: Bounty Hunter Points(바운티 헌터 포인트)로 Trader(상인)에게서 1단계 Emblem(엠블럼)을 살 수도 있고, 가진 엠블럼을 상인에게 팔아 바운티 헌터 포인트를 받을 수도 있어요. 엠블럼은 한 번에 하나만 가질 수 있어요.

english: Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: Bounty Hunter Points(바운티 헌터 포인트)에 대해 설명해 주실래요?

english: You can earn Bounty Hunter Points by defeating your target or selling Emblems to the Trader. Once you have Bounty Hunter Points, you may use them to purchase rewards from the reward shop.
translation: Bounty Hunter Points(바운티 헌터 포인트)는 표적을 쓰러뜨리거나 Trader(상인)에게 Emblem(엠블럼)을 팔아서 얻을 수 있어요. 포인트가 생기면 보상 상점에서 보상을 구매할 수 있어요.

english: What is the Coffer for?
To participate in Bounty Hunter, you must have a certain amount of coins in your Coffer, which varies based on your combat level. Currently you need at least [x] coins to participate.
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터)에 참여하려면 Coffer(금고)에 일정 금액의 coins(코인)이 있어야 하는데, 전투 레벨에 따라 달라요. 현재 참여하려면 최소 [x] 코인이 필요해요.

english: If you are unskulled and another person kills you in Bounty Hunter, [x] coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer.
translation: 해골 표시가 없는 상태에서 Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) 중에 다른 사람에게 죽으면, Coffer(금고)에서 [x] 코인이 차감되어 당신을 죽인 사람에게 넘어가요.

english: If you are skulled, 10,000 coins will be deducted from your Coffer and given to your killer. However, any surplus money in your Coffer will remain safe.
translation: 해골 표시가 있는 상태라면 Coffer(금고)에서 10,000 코인이 차감되어 당신을 죽인 사람에게 넘어가요. 하지만 금고에 남는 돈은 안전하게 보관돼요.

english: To manage your Coffer, talk to the Trader.
How do I get bounty crates?
Well, if you want crates, you'll need to be fighting a target in the arena while having a minimum value of risked items on you. Anything you can protect, we won't count.
translation: 음, 상자를 원한다면 일정 가치 이상의 위험 아이템을 지닌 채 경기장에서 표적과 싸우고 있어야 해요. 보호할 수 있는 아이템은 계산에 넣지 않아요.

english: If you meet these requirements, we'll keep track of how long you're in there for. We'll occasionally give you a bonus if you die as well.
translation: 이 조건을 충족하면 그 안에 얼마나 오래 있었는지 기록해 둘게요. 죽었을 때도 가끔 보너스를 드려요.

english: When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higer value crate.
translation: 표적을 처치했을 때 충분히 오래 있었다면 상자를 받게 돼요. 더 오래 있었다면 더 가치 높은 상자를 받고요.

english: The crates don't contain anything special; just coins and supplies to help cover what you'll use in the crater.
translation: 상자에 특별한 건 없어요. 분화구에서 쓴 것을 메울 수 있도록 코인과 보급품이 들어 있을 뿐이에요.

english: If you keep killing your target, you probably won't get many high value crates, but you'll certainly get a lot more points and Emblems instead.
translation: 표적을 계속 처치하면 가치 높은 상자는 많이 받지 못하겠지만, 대신 포인트와 Emblem(엠블럼)은 훨씬 많이 얻을 거예요.

english: Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
translation: 제 Ancient Warrior armour(고대 전사 갑옷)을 타락시켜 줄 수 있나요?

english: Do you know anything about Bounty Hunter hats?
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) 모자에 대해 아는 게 있나요?

english: Ah yes, you'll be able to collect them from me, once you've got some targeted kills that is.
translation: 아, 네. 표적 처치 기록이 좀 쌓이면 저한테서 받아 갈 수 있어요.

english: Ah yes! I've been told to hold onto some hats for you, for your uhm... deeds in the wilderness.
translation: 아, 네! 당신의 그... 황야에서의 업적을 기려 모자 몇 개를 맡아 두라는 지시를 받았어요.

english: Oh wonderful, can I take a look?
You need [number] target kills to claim this hat. You currently have [number].
translation: 이 모자를 받으려면 표적 처치 [number]회가 필요해요. 현재 [number]회예요.

english: I'm afraid you've already got one of those hats, I can't let you have another.
translation: 죄송하지만 그 모자는 이미 가지고 계시네요. 하나 더 드릴 순 없어요.

english: I'm afraid you've got nowhere to put a hat if I gave one to you.
translation: 죄송하지만 모자를 드려도 넣을 공간이 없으시네요.

english: Here you go, enjoy!
Can you tell me my current EP value?
translation: 제 현재 EP 수치를 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: What is this place?
Beyond this portal lies Daimon's Crater, a place where you'll fight other adventurers like yourself for glory and rewards.
translation: 이 portal(포털) 너머에는 Daimon's Crater(다이몬의 분화구)가 있어요. 당신 같은 다른 모험가들과 영광과 보상을 걸고 싸우는 곳이죠.

english: Sadly, I can't let you into Daimon's Crater right now.
translation: 안타깝지만 지금은 Daimon's Crater(다이몬의 분화구)에 들여보내 드릴 수 없어요.

english: Bounty Hunter is only available on specific Bounty Hunter worlds.
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터)는 전용 바운티 헌터 월드에서만 이용할 수 있어요.

english: If you step through this portal, you'll be taken to Daimon's Crater, where we've set up a lobby area for you to ready yourself for combat.
translation: 이 portal(포털)을 지나면 Daimon's Crater(다이몬의 분화구)로 가게 돼요. 그곳에 전투 준비를 할 수 있는 대기실을 마련해 뒀어요.

english: If you'd like, I can explain the rules of Bounty Hunter to you.
translation: 원하시면 Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) 규칙을 설명해 드릴게요.

english: Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
translation: 제 Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) coffer(금고)를 이용할 수 있나요?

english: Certainly. Would you like to add or remove coins from it?
Deposit coins.
Withdraw coins.
Yes, I acknowledge these rules.
No.
I'd like to learn the rules of combat in this arena!
translation: 이 경기장의 전투 규칙을 배우고 싶어요!

english: Let's talk about Targets.
Tell me about Emblems.
Can you explain Bounty Hunter Points to me?
translation: Bounty Hunter Points(바운티 헌터 포인트)에 대해 설명해 주실래요?

english: What is the Coffer for?
How do I get bounty crates?
Goodbye.
Tell me about the Emblems.
Can you corrupt my Ancient Warrior armour?
translation: 제 Ancient Warrior armour(고대 전사 갑옷)을 타락시켜 줄 수 있나요?

english: Ask about Bounty Hunter Hats.
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) 모자에 대해 묻기.

english: Ask about the EP value.
What is this place?
Can I access my Bounty Hunter coffer?
translation: 제 Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터) coffer(금고)를 이용할 수 있나요?

english: Hello there.
Salutations traveller! It is unusual for one of the creatures called 'humans' to visit this plane. How can I assist you?
translation: 반가워요, 여행자여! '인간'이라 불리는 존재가 이 차원을 찾아오다니 흔치 않은 일이네요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
I hope the beauty of my world brings you great joy.
translation: 제 세계의 아름다움이 당신에게 큰 기쁨이 되기를 바라요.

english: Who are you?
My name, in your language, would be Bubrezankaldargarez'jk, but you can just call me Bub. This small plane is my home, here I study and ponder the mysteries of existence.
translation: 당신들 말로 하면 제 이름은 Bubrezankaldargarez'jk(부브레잔칼다르가레즈크)지만, 그냥 Bub(부브)라고 불러도 돼요. 이 작은 차원이 제 집이에요. 여기서 저는 존재의 신비를 연구하고 사색하죠.

english: Mysteries of existence, eh? Like what?
I'm looking for a Star Flower.

Then you've come to the right place. Star Flower, which is much prized for its magical properties, only grows on this plane. It has a very short life-span; plants grow, flower and die in the space of minutes! If you search
translation: 그렇다면 제대로 찾아왔어요. 마법적 성질 덕분에 귀하게 여겨지는 Star Flower(별꽃)은 이 차원에서만 자라요. 수명이 아주 짧아서 몇 분 만에 자라고, 꽃 피우고, 시들어 버리죠! 주변을

english: around you might find some growing somewhere.
translation: 잘 찾아보면 어딘가에서 자라고 있는 걸 발견할 수 있을 거예요.

english: Where do flies go at night?
Have you ever flicked through a dictionary and afterwards felt really depressed by how much you don't know?
translation: 사전을 넘겨 보고 나서, 내가 모르는 게 이렇게 많구나 싶어 우울해진 적 있나요?

english: Do other birds speak pigeon pidgin?
translation: 다른 새들도 비둘기처럼 '구구'단을 외울 줄 알까요?

english: Political philosophy is an oxymoron.
Why are yawns contagious?
Do sick days include when you're sick of work?
translation: 몸이 아픈 날 말고, 일에 질려서 마음이 아픈 날도 병가로 쳐줄까요?

english: To be is to be the value of a variable.
translation: 존재한다는 것은 변수의 값이 된다는 것이에요.

english: How do you know when you've run out of invisible ink?
translation: 투명 잉크가 다 떨어졌다는 건 어떻게 알까요?

english: Where does a snake's tail begin?
How long do fish wait to swim after they eat?
translation: 물고기는 밥 먹고 얼마나 기다렸다가 수영할까요?

english: If you're halfway from here to there, which is which?
translation: 여기서 저기까지 반쯤 왔다면, 어느 쪽이 여기고 어느 쪽이 저기일까요?

english: I'm just looking around, thanks.
Who are you?
I'm looking for a Star Flower.
You were very brave for going on stage to confront a killer. Looks like you did well to get her to surrender without damaging her costume.
translation: 살인자에게 맞서려고 무대에 오르다니 정말 용감했어요. 그녀의 의상을 망가뜨리지 않고 항복시켰다니, 정말 잘했네요.

english: It was very well made. Makes the job of not damaging it much easier!
translation: 아주 잘 만든 의상이었어요. 덕분에 망가뜨리지 않기가 훨씬 쉬웠죠!

english: Why thank you! I credit my needles for the good work.
translation: 정말 고마워요! 다 제 needles(바늘) 덕분이에요.

english: Would I be able to get one of them for my own purposes?
translation: 저도 하나 얻어서 쓸 수 있을까요?

english: I suppose I could part with one... If you're careful not to lose it.
translation: 하나 정도는 내드릴 수 있을 것 같네요... 잃어버리지 않게 조심만 한다면요.

english: I'll be careful.
Have you still got that needle safe and secure?
translation: 그 needle(바늘)은 아직 잘 보관하고 있나요?

english: I have indeed.
Aww, what a cute cat! I better not wake it up.
translation: 와, 정말 귀여운 고양이다! 깨우지 않는 게 좋겠어.

english: I certainly wouldn't hand you over for any runes, you're too adorable.
translation: runes(룬)을 아무리 준다 해도 널 넘기진 않을 거야. 넌 너무 사랑스러우니까.

english: Hello.
How do. You planning on crossing this here bridge and heading up to Rellekka then?
translation: 안녕하신가. 이 다리 건너서 Rellekka(렐레카)로 올라갈 참인가?

english: Yes, actually I was.
Aye, 'tis a good thing we fixed this 'ere bridge, I reckon. You best be careful up there. Them Fremenniks are odd 'uns.
translation: 그래, 우리가 이 다리를 고쳐 놔서 다행이지 싶네. 거기 올라가면 조심하게. 그 Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람들은 좀 별난 녀석들이거든.

english: So you fixed this bridge yourself?
translation: 그럼 이 다리를 직접 고치신 거예요?

english: Aye, that I did. 'Twas real thirsty work too. If only some kind stranger would buy us a bit of beer to sup, eh?
translation: 그렇다네, 내가 고쳤지. 일이 고돼서 목이 바짝 타더구먼. 어디 친절한 나그네가 맥주라도 한잔 사 주면 좋을 텐데, 안 그런가?

english: What with that inn at seers so close by and all, eh?
translation: seers(시어스)에 있는 그 여관도 바로 코앞이겠다, 응?

english: The workman winks at you
Just make sure yer don't get me none of that non alcoholic rubbish from that poison salesman guy at the tavern!
translation: 대신 선술집에 있는 그 poison salesman(독약 판매원) 녀석한테서 무알코올 쓰레기 같은 건 사 오지 말게!

english: I wasn't planning on it, no.
Aye, that's what I told t'gaffer. Nobody wants to go up and hang out with a buncha dumb barbarians when there's a perfectly good inn to sup in, in t'seers village.
translation: 그래, 내가 반장한테도 그렇게 말했지. seers village(시어스 마을)에 술 마시기 딱 좋은 여관이 멀쩡히 있는데, 누가 저 위에 올라가서 멍청한 야만인 무리랑 어울리고 싶겠냐고.

english: Ain't much better in life than having a nice cold beer to sup on a hot day like this, eh? Better'n fixing bridges, eh?
translation: 이렇게 더운 날 시원한 맥주 한잔 들이켜는 것만큼 좋은 게 세상에 또 있겠나? 다리 고치는 것보단 훨씬 낫지, 안 그런가?

english: A bit early in the day fer that ain't it?
Ta very much, like. That'll hit the spot nicely. Here, you can have this. I picked it up as a souvenir on me last hols.
translation: 고맙구먼, 정말. 이거면 딱 좋겠어. 옜다, 이거 가지게. 지난번 휴가 때 기념품으로 주운 걸세.

english: What is it?
I dunno rightly, but if you use a tinderbox on it, it don't half make a loud noise!
translation: 나도 잘은 모르겠네만, tinderbox(부싯깃 통)을 거기에 쓰면 엄청나게 큰 소리가 난다네!

english: No ta, not my brand of beer.
translation: 아니, 됐네. 내가 좋아하는 맥주가 아니라서.

english: No ta, not a big wine fan, me.
translation: 아니, 됐네. 난 와인은 별로라서 말이야.

english: Yes
No
Hi there.
Good day to you.
Who are you?
My name is David Andrews. I'm the Head Councillor of the Kourend Council.
translation: 제 이름은 David Andrews(데이비드 앤드루스)입니다. Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)의 의장을 맡고 있습니다.

english: Tell me about the Kourend Council.
translation: Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Kourend's last King, Kharedst IV, had only one child when he died. She was too young to take the throne, so the Kourend Council was formed to look after things until she came of age.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)의 마지막 왕 Kharedst IV(카레드스트 4세)는 세상을 떠날 때 자식이 하나뿐이었습니다. 공주는 왕위에 오르기엔 너무 어렸기에, 공주가 성인이 될 때까지 나라를 돌보려고 쿠렌드 의회가 만들어졌지요.

english: Alas, she was very close to her father and his sudden death drove her to insanity. With no suitable ruler, the Kourend Council was made permanent.
translation: 안타깝게도 공주는 아버지와 무척 가까웠고, 아버지의 갑작스러운 죽음에 그만 정신을 놓고 말았습니다. 마땅한 통치자가 없으니 Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)가 영구 기구가 되었지요.

english: How is the Council structured?
The Kourend Council is made up of four councillors. Every four years there is an election for the people to decide who the councillors should be.
translation: Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)는 네 명의 의원으로 이루어져 있습니다. 4년마다 선거를 열어 백성들이 의원을 직접 뽑지요.

english: One of the councillors holds the position of Head Councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current Head Councillor.
translation: 의원 중 한 명이 의장직을 맡는데, 해마다 돌아가며 맡습니다. 지금은 제가 의장입니다.

english: The other councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson.
translation: 다른 의원으로는 Councillor Hughes(휴즈 의원), Councillor Unkar(운카르 의원), Councillor Orson(오슨 의원)이 있습니다.

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacentafter the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 다른 의원으로는 Councillor Unkar(운카르 의원)과 Councillor Orson(오슨 의원)이 있습니다. 네 번째 자리는 얼마 전 Councillor Hughes(휴즈 의원)이 체포된 뒤로 비어 있습니다.

english: So where do the five houses fit in?
translation: 그럼 다섯 가문은 이 구조에서 어떤 위치인가요?

english: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council, but can otherwise rule as they see fit.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)의 다섯 가문에는 저마다 자기 도시를 다스리는 지도자가 있습니다. 각 가문의 지도자는 쿠렌드 의회가 정한 법을 집행하고 따라야 하지만, 그 밖의 일은 뜻대로 다스릴 수 있습니다.

english: I hope that helps.
Yes, thank you.
Time for me to go.
Good day citizen.
There's been a death in Arceuus.
A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.
translation: 사람이 죽었다고요? 그건 이상한 일이군요. Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들은 그렇게 쉽게 죽지 않습니다. 죽을 수가 없지요.

english: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?
translation: 제 눈으로 직접 봤어요. Arceuus(아르세우스) 시민 한 명이 쓰러졌다고요. 어떻게 해야 하죠?

english: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.
translation: 글쎄요, 저희가 무엇을 할 수 있을지 잘 모르겠습니다. Arceuus(아르세우스) 가문은 자신들의 지식을 나머지 사람들에게 비밀로 해 왔습니다. 저희는 이 분야에 아무런 전문 지식이 없습니다.

english: So you'll do nothing?
If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.
translation: 할 수 있는 일이 있다면 하겠습니다. 하지만 유감스럽게도 이 일은 저희 손을 벗어났습니다.

english: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.
I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.
translation: 죄송하지만, 이미 말씀드렸듯이 저희는 도와드릴 수 없습니다.
