translation: 마침 얼마 전에 새로 들어왔어요. 하나 사실래요?

english: Sorry but you don't have enough to buy one, at the moment it costs 100000 gold coins.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 살 돈이 부족하시네요. 현재 가격은 100000코인이에요.

english: Here, have this!
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Do you have any Dragon Scimitars in stock?
So despite there being three kings, you're clearly the leader, right?
translation: 그러니까 왕이 셋이나 있어도 리더는 확실히 너지?

english: Definitely.
I'm glad I got you as a pet.
Ugh. Human, I'm not a pet.
Stop following me then.
I can't seem to stop.
Pet.
Definitely
You make a great pet.
So fight me then.
I can't seem to do it.
Grrrr!
Hissss!
Kssss!
Skrrr!
Do you have any berserker rings?
Nope.
You sure?
Yes.
So, if I tipped you upside down and shook you, you'd not drop any berserker rings?
translation: 그럼 너를 거꾸로 들고 흔들어도 berserker ring(광전사 반지)가 하나도 안 떨어진다는 거야?

english: What if I endlessly killed your father for weeks on end, would I get one then?
translation: 네 아버지를 몇 주 동안 끝도 없이 잡으면 그땐 하나 나올까?

english: Been done by someone, nope.
translation: 이미 누가 해 봤다. 안 나와.

english: Hey, so err... I kind of own you now.
translation: 저기, 그러니까... 이제 내가 널 가진 셈이야.

english: Tsssk. Next time you enter those caves, human, my father will be having words.
translation: 츠으읏. 다음에 그 동굴에 들어오면, 인간, 내 아버지가 가만두지 않을 거다.

english: Maybe next time I'll add your brothers to my collection.
translation: 다음엔 네 형제들도 내 수집품에 추가해 볼까.

english: Hey, so err... you're kind of a pet now.
translation: 저기, 그러니까... 이제 너 펫이 된 셈이야.

english: Tsssk. Next time my owner enters those caves, human, my father will be having words.
translation: 츠으읏. 다음에 내 주인이 그 동굴에 들어오면, 인간, 내 아버지가 가만두지 않을 거다.

english: Maybe next time your brothers will join the collection.
Grrrr!
Skrrr!
Kssss!
Hissss!
*slap*
Krrrrrrk
Chkhkhkhkhk
Krrrrrrssssssss
Sssssrrrkkkkk
Krkrkrkrkrkrkrkr
Tktktktktktkt
What are yooo interrupting me for? Can't you see I'm working here?
translation: 왜 날 방해하는 거음매? 나 일하는 거 안 보여?

english: Moo, what do yoooou think you're doing?
translation: 음~매, 너 지금 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Err... Nothing. Just checking that your cowbell was working. Don't want you to get lost!
translation: 어... 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 워낭이 잘 울리나 확인한 거예요. 길 잃으면 안 되잖아요!

english: How exactly am I going to get lost when I'm tied down? What were yooo really doing?
translation: 묶여 있는데 내가 어떻게 길을 잃어? 진짜로 뭘 하려던 거음매?

english: I don't think you'll believe me.
I'm a talking cow, I'll believe almost anything.
translation: 난 말하는 소야. 웬만한 건 다 믿어.

english: Fine. I need the bell to trick some penguins into helping me get into their secret lair.
translation: 좋아요. 펭귄들을 속여서 그들의 비밀 기지에 들어가려면 이 워낭이 필요해요.

english: Well why didn't you say so? I've got a ton of these things. Go ahead and take the bell.
translation: 진작 말하지 그랬어? 나 이런 거 잔뜩 있어. 그 워낭 가져가.

english: MOO
Hi there.
Hello, young one. What brings you to our humble dwelling?
translation: 반갑네, 젊은이. 우리의 누추한 거처에는 무슨 일로 왔나?

english: I was wondering what this place was?
These are the Tunnels of Chaos. They radiate with the energy of chaos magic. At the far end of the tunnel, you will find a portal to the Chaos Altar itself where chaos runes are crafted!
translation: 이곳은 Tunnels of Chaos(혼돈의 터널)일세. 혼돈 마법의 기운이 넘쳐흐르지. 터널 끝에 가면 혼돈 룬을 만드는 Chaos Altar(혼돈의 제단)으로 가는 포털이 있다네!

english: Why is the tunnel so short?
The nature of chaos magic itself is mysterious and hard to understand.
translation: 혼돈 마법의 본질 자체가 신비롭고 이해하기 어려운 것이라네.

english: What do you mean?
The tunnel is here, and yet it is not here. We also are here, where we should be, yet we are somewhere else. And so, the tunnel goes from one place to another, yet touches neither.
translation: 터널은 여기 있으면서 여기 있지 않네. 우리 또한 있어야 할 곳에 있으면서 다른 어딘가에 있지. 그리하여 터널은 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 이어지면서도 그 어느 곳에도 닿지 않는다네.

english: I really don't understand.
I told you you wouldn't. The best way to think of it is that the tunnel is like a gateway that allows you to travel from one place in the world to another in a more safe and convenient way.
translation: 모를 거라고 했잖나. 터널을 일종의 관문이라고 생각하면 가장 쉽다네. 세상의 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 더 안전하고 편리하게 오갈 수 있게 해 주는 관문 말일세.

english: Oh, I think I see. So it is like a magical alternate route?
translation: 아, 이제 좀 알 것 같아요. 그러니까 마법으로 된 지름길 같은 거군요?

english: Exactly! Well done! And at the end, there is a portal which will transport you to the Chaos Altar.
translation: 바로 그걸세! 잘했네! 그리고 끝에는 Chaos Altar(혼돈의 제단)으로 데려다주는 포털이 있지.

english: Oh, ok.
Why are there only three of you?
Our order is a secret one and those of us that remain and survive through the ages choose to hide ourselves away.
translation: 우리 교단은 비밀 교단이라네. 오랜 세월을 견디고 살아남은 이들은 스스로 몸을 숨기는 길을 택하지.

english: Where are the rest of you now?
We have built or found many tunnels such as these. This is not the only one. Rest assured, there are many more of us around.
translation: 우리는 이런 터널을 많이 만들거나 찾아냈네. 여기가 유일한 곳이 아니야. 안심하게, 우리 동료는 곳곳에 훨씬 더 많이 있다네.

english: Is the Wilderness above us?
Yes, I can understand you would expect it to be since the tunnel leads to the Chaos Altar. And yet, the tunnel does not enter the Wilderness, no.
translation: 그래, 터널이 Chaos Altar(혼돈의 제단)으로 이어지니 그렇게 생각할 만도 하지. 하지만 이 터널은 Wilderness(황야)로 들어가지 않는다네.

english: Rest assured, you are safe here and should not come to harm.
translation: 안심하게, 여기선 안전하니 해를 입을 일은 없을 걸세.

english: You seem quite nice for a Zamorakian.
History is written by the strong and the influential.
translation: 역사는 강하고 영향력 있는 자들이 쓰는 법이지.

english: What does that mean?
It means we cannot always believe what we are told to believe. You would do well to remember that.
translation: 믿으라고 하는 것을 언제나 믿을 수는 없다는 뜻일세. 그 점을 기억해 두는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: I will! Thank you!
Thanks for your time.
Why is the tunnel so short?
Why are there only three of you?
Is the Wilderness above us?
You seem quite nice for a Zamorakian.
Thanks for your time.
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 와. 장 보는 것보단 이게 훨씬 낫네요!

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 결투 끝날 때마다 뒷정리하는 불쌍한 사람은 되고 싶지 않네요.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
translation: 해골이 밥 먹기 전에 뭐라고 했게요?

english: I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
Put a little boogey in it.
Why did the skeleton burp?
translation: 해골은 왜 방귀 대신 트림을 했을까요?

english: 'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 방귀 뀔 배짱이 없어서요! 배가 없으니까!

english: My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 저 결투 구경하는 거 안 보여요?

english: I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 이곳이 제2시대부터 있었다는 얘기 들어 봤어요?!

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 네. 안내소에 있던 사람이 알려 줬어요.

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Salve(살브) 강가의 신전, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)까지 데려다줄 사람이 있을까 해서 여기서 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 근사한 신전이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)에 들어오는 길에 분명 지나쳤을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶어서요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있으세요?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 뭐, 저도 경험이 좀 있어서 나쁜 놈들은 제 몫만큼 기꺼이 상대할 수 있다고만 해 두죠. 그건 걱정 안 하셔도 돼요.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 동료가 있네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 그 동료를 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발하죠.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 정말요? 그럼 너무 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보답을 드릴게요.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 좀 주시려고요? 잠깐 제 배낭 좀 열게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 눌러앉아 있는 것보단 낫죠.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)에 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같네요.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야 할 것 같아요. 저 다리는 못 건너겠어요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건널 것 같아요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 에이, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와! 끝내줬어요! 그래도 이제 진짜 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자서 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 신전까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보답이에요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있으세요...?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Greetings, traveller. I'd love to stop and talk, but farming is a busy line of work. Perhaps another time?
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 이야기 나누고 싶지만 농사일이 워낙 바빠서요. 이야기는 다음에 나눌까요?

english: Greetings, traveller. I am the Chief Farmer of Hosidius. My wife and I manage the efforts of all of our farmers.
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 저는 Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Chief Farmer(농장장)이에요. 아내와 함께 이곳 농부들의 일을 모두 관리하고 있죠.

english: How's that going?
Quite well but we can always be doing more. Perhaps you could help?
translation: 꽤 잘 되고 있지만 늘 더 할 일이 있죠. 혹시 도와주실 수 있을까요?

english: How could I help?
We need to till the soil to prepare it for crops. Head outside and operate the ploughs along the fields.
translation: 작물을 심을 수 있게 흙을 갈아야 해요. 밖으로 나가서 밭을 따라 있는 plough(쟁기)를 써 주세요.

english: The ploughs are old and may become damaged after too much use, but I'm sure that won't be a problem for such a well trained adventurer like yourself.
translation: 쟁기들이 낡아서 너무 많이 쓰면 망가질 수도 있지만, 당신처럼 잘 훈련된 모험가라면 문제없을 거예요.

english: That sounds like hard work, what's in it for me?
translation: 힘든 일 같은데, 저한텐 뭐가 돌아오죠?

english: Well, by helping us you'll become more recognized and as that happens we can offer you many benefits.
translation: 음, 저희를 도와주시면 점점 이름이 알려질 거고, 그럴수록 저희가 여러 혜택을 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 알려 주셔서 고마워요. 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: Thank you, [player name]! Just find a plough to get started.
translation: 고마워요, [player name] 님! plough(쟁기)를 찾아서 시작하시면 돼요.

english: No thanks, goodbye!
If you change your mind just find a plough and use it.
translation: 마음이 바뀌면 plough(쟁기)를 찾아서 쓰시면 돼요.

english: How can I help?
Thanks for the information, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 알려 주셔서 고마워요. 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: No thanks, good bye!
No thanks, goodbye!
Ooh, lovely view, dear.
Yes dear.
I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
I'm sure it will be, dear.
Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: 방해해서 죄송하지만, 두 분은 여기서 뭐 하세요?

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: Perrdur(페르두르)랑 저는 근사하고 로맨틱한 저녁을 먹는 중이에요, 그렇죠 여보?

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: 우리 결혼기념일을 축하하는 중이에요, 그렇죠 여보?

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: 그리고 아주 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있죠, 그렇죠 여보?

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: 그래 보이네요. 그럼 두 분 오붓한 시간 계속 보내세요.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 얼로프트)의 손님께는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Dalila
translation: Dalila(달릴라)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넵니다.

english: Ah my order. At last....
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없어요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: Can I help you at all?
Why do you sell this stuff? The Crystal Bow is so much better.
translation: 이런 걸 왜 팔아요? Crystal Bow(크리스탈 활)이 훨씬 좋은데.

english: We keep all these old toys to train our children with, but if people will part with coins for them, then they are theirs!
translation: 이 낡은 장난감들은 아이들 훈련용으로 두는 거예요. 그래도 코인을 내고 사 가겠다는 분이 있으면 그분 거죠!

english: No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
Why do you sell this stuff?
No thanks.
You seem to really enjoy that painting.
translation: 그 그림이 정말 마음에 드시나 봐요.

english: Hello stranger.
*grunts*
Ah very friendly I see. What's that coffin on your back?
translation: 아주 친절하시네요. 등에 멘 그 관은 뭐예요?

english: For carryin' the dead.
Woah, don't tell me you have a body in there?
translation: 와, 설마 그 안에 시신이 들어 있는 건 아니죠?

english: No, remains.
Oh, you carry the remains of shades in it? Could you give me one?
translation: 아, 그 안에 shade(셰이드)의 유해를 담아 다니는 거예요? 하나 주실 수 있어요?

english: Dampe hands you a broken coffin.
It's broken? What am I supposeto do with a broken coffin?
translation: 부서졌잖아요? 부서진 관으로 뭘 하라는 거예요?

english: Bring me locks, find in the catacombs... I repair coffin with locks.
translation: 자물쇠 가져와, 지하 묘지에서 찾아... 자물쇠로 관 고쳐.

english: Right... Guess I should head into the catacombs then... see if I can find any of these 'locks'.
translation: 그렇군요... 지하 묘지로 가 봐야겠네요... 그 '자물쇠'라는 걸 찾을 수 있는지 봐야겠어요.

english: Hello again.
Ah, as cheerful as ever I see.
What d'ya want.
You gave me a broken coffin, what am I supposeto do with it?
translation: 부서진 관을 주셨잖아요. 그걸로 뭘 하라는 거예요?

english: Bring me locks, I fix coffin with locks...
Right... and where am I suppose to find such locks?
translation: 그렇군요... 그런데 그런 자물쇠는 어디서 찾으라는 거예요?

english: In catacombs... in chests...
Great, thanks for the information.
I found one of the locks you were talking about, I think.
translation: 말씀하신 자물쇠를 하나 찾은 것 같아요.

english: You show Dampe the lock you found and his cold eyes light up.
translation: 찾은 자물쇠를 Dampe(댐피)에게 보여 주자 그의 차가운 눈이 반짝입니다.

english: That is it, give to me now and I repair the coffin.
translation: 그거 맞아, 지금 줘, 관 고쳐 줄게.

english: You ain't got no broken coffin for me to fix. If you need one, just ask.
translation: 내가 고쳐 줄 부서진 관이 없잖아. 필요하면 말해.

english: You hand over the coffin and lock to Dampe.
You hear him clumsily attach the lock to the coffin.
translation: 그가 서툴게 관에 자물쇠를 다는 소리가 들립니다.

english: Finished, take it.
No thanks, I'm going to hang on to it for now.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 당분간은 그냥 갖고 있을게요.

english: Could I get another of those coffins?
translation: 그 관 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Get lost, you've already got a coffin, I ain't givin' you anotha.
translation: 꺼져, 너 벌써 관 있잖아, 하나 더 안 줘.

english: It's broken?
Where did you get those robes?
Given to me.
By who?
A dead friend of mine.
Oh... how did they die?
In the catacombs.
Sorry to hear that...
Nothing, I just wanted to chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요, 그냥 얘기나 하고 싶었어요.

english: Can you fix this for me?
translation: 이것 좀 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Depends, you got any locks for it?
No...
Yeah, well clear off them a go find one.
Hey, I found this lock in the catacombs? Can you do anything with it?
translation: 저기, 지하 묘지에서 이 자물쇠를 찾았는데요? 이걸로 뭘 할 수 있을까요?

english: *grunts* Lets 'ava look.
Ask about locks.
Yes
No
Ask for another coffin.
Ask about his robes.
Just wanted a chat.
Hiya! Do you want to buy me a drink?
translation: 안녕! 저한테 술 한잔 사 줄래요?

english: I think I'll pass on that.
Fine, I'm sure somebody else round here will know how to treat a woman...
translation: 됐어요, 여자를 어떻게 대해야 하는지 아는 사람이 이 근처에 분명 있겠죠...

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 얼로프트)의 손님께는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Damwin
translation: Damwin(담윈)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넵니다.

english: Ooh, thanks a lot dearie.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없어요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: Hello, who are you?
Greetings human. I am Darcor quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 반갑소, 인간이여. 나는 Darcor quo Narga(다르코르 쿠오 나르가), Kahlith(칼리스)의 수호자요. 그대는 균형을 섬기러 왔소?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)과 이야기하시오. 그녀가 그대를 이끌어 줄 것이오.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 안타깝군. 그대는 죽음을 불러오는 자이니, 균형에 큰 도움이 될 수 있을 터인데.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기하시오. 그가 길을 보여 줄 것이오.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Why do you interrupt me, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: 왜 날 방해하는가, 여행자? 나는 흑마법을 실험하는 중일세. 위험한 기술이라 방해받지 않는 편이 좋네.

english: I'm just looking around.
There's nothing to see here, just despair and death.
translation: 여기엔 볼 것 없네. 절망과 죽음뿐이지.

english: Can I help you with something, traveller? I am experimenting with dark magic; it is a dangerous craft, and I prefer not to be disturbed.
translation: 무슨 볼일인가, 여행자? 나는 흑마법을 실험하는 중일세. 위험한 기술이라 방해받지 않는 편이 좋네.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
translation: 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 충전해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Your staff is already as fully charged as it can go.
translation: 자네 지팡이는 이미 충전할 수 있는 만큼 꽉 차 있네.

english: I'll want 100,000 coins to recharge the Staff of Iban.
translation: Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 충전하려면 100,000코인을 받아야겠네.

english: The mage summons the power of Zamorak and recharges your Staff of Iban.
translation: 마법사가 Zamorak(자모락)의 힘을 불러내 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 충전합니다.

english: Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
translation: 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 강화해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 200,000 coins.
translation: 하! 그럼, 2500회 충전까지 담을 수 있게 강화해 줄 수 있지. 몬스터에게는 Iban(이반)의 마법을 2500번, 자네 같은 사람에게는 1250번 쓸 수 있는 양일세. 비용은 200,000코인이네.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
translation: 부러진 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: You show the mage your broken staff.
The Staff of Iban holds dangerous magic, traveller. I can fix it, but it will cost you - the process could kill me!
translation: Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)에는 위험한 마법이 깃들어 있네, 여행자. 고쳐 줄 수는 있지만 대가가 따르지. 자칫하면 내가 죽을 수도 있거든!

english: How much?
200,000 coins. That'll give it 120 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 120 times at monsters or 60 times at people like you.
translation: 200,000코인일세. 그러면 120회 충전이 되네. 몬스터에게는 Iban(이반)의 마법을 120번, 자네 같은 사람에게는 60번 쓸 수 있는 양이지.

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff...
You give the mage 200,000 coins and the staff... The mage fixes the staff and returns it to you.
translation: 마법사에게 200,000코인과 지팡이를 건넵니다... 마법사가 지팡이를 고쳐 돌려줍니다.

english: Thanks, I appreciate that.
You be careful with that thing!
Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
translation: 120회보다 더 많이 충전되게 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hah! Yes, I can upgrade it to hold 2500 charges, enough to cast Iban's magic 2500 times at monsters or 1250 times at people like you. That'll cost you 400,000 coins.
translation: 하! 그럼, 2500회 충전까지 담을 수 있게 강화해 줄 수 있지. 몬스터에게는 Iban(이반)의 마법을 2500번, 자네 같은 사람에게는 1250번 쓸 수 있는 양일세. 비용은 400,000코인이네.

english: Staaaaaaaaves!
Traveller, I have no idea what you are talking about. If you want my help with staves, perhaps you should show me one.
translation: 여행자, 무슨 소린지 전혀 모르겠군. 지팡이 일로 내 도움이 필요하면 하나 보여 주게나.

english: Can you recharge my Staff of Iban?
translation: 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 충전해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Pay 100,000 coins to recharge it.
Don't pay.
Can you upgrade my Staff of Iban?
translation: 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 강화해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
Can you repair my broken Staff of Iban?
translation: 부러진 제 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이)를 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Here's 200,000 coins. Please repair the staff.
Can you make it hold more than 120 charges?
translation: 120회보다 더 많이 충전되게 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Here's 400,000 coins. Please upgrade the staff.
I'll leave you to it.
Recharge your Staff of Iban
Upgrade your Staff of Iban
Repair your broken Staff of Iban
translation: 부러진 Staff of Iban(이반의 지팡이) 고치기

english: Hello there.
Quiet! You must not break my concentration!
translation: 조용히! 내 집중을 깨뜨리면 안 되네!

english: Why not?
Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this rift open, the results won't be pretty.
translation: 이 균열을 열어 두는 동안 내 집중이 깨지면 결과가 아주 끔찍할 걸세.

english: In what way?
If we are lucky, the heads of anyone within the Abyss will suddenly explode, including us.
translation: 운이 좋으면 Abyss(심연) 안에 있는 모든 이의 머리가 갑자기 터지겠지. 우리도 포함해서 말일세.

english: Err... And if we're unlucky?
If we are unlucky, then the entire universe will begin to fold in upon itself, and all reality as we know it will be annihilated in a single stroke.
translation: 운이 나쁘면 온 우주가 스스로 접혀 들어가기 시작하고, 우리가 아는 모든 현실이 단숨에 소멸하겠지.

english: So leave me alone!
What are you doing here?
Do you mean what am I doing here in the Abyss? Or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
translation: 내가 이 Abyss(심연)에서 뭘 하느냐는 건가? 아니면 우리가 인생이라 부르는 이 항해에서 내 궁극적인 역할이 무엇이라 여기느냐는 건가?

english: Err... The first one.
By remaining here and holding this rift open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension.
translation: 나는 여기 머물며 이 균열을 열어 둠으로써, 평범한 공간과 이 기묘한 차원 사이를 잇는 영구적인 통로를 만들고 있네.

english: As long as my spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into the Abyss.
translation: 내 주문이 유지되는 한, 우리는 Abyss(심연)으로 순간이동할 수 있지.

english: Now leave me be! I can afford no distraction in my task!
translation: 이제 날 내버려 두게! 지금 하는 일에선 한눈팔 여유가 없네!

english: I need your help with something.
What? Oh... very well. What did you want?
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Abyssal book(심연의 책)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Don't waste my time if you don't have enough free space to take it.
translation: 받을 자리도 없으면서 내 시간을 낭비하지 말게.

english: Here, take it. It is important to pool our research.
translation: 여기, 받게. 우리의 연구를 한데 모으는 건 중요하니까.

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: 새 essence pouch(정수 주머니)를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Here. Be more careful with your belongings in future.
translation: 여기 있네. 앞으로는 자기 물건을 좀 더 잘 챙기게.

english: You already have a Colossal Pouch. Are you aware of the dimensional turmoil you can cause by using too many pouches at the same time?
translation: 자네는 이미 Colossal Pouch(거대한 주머니)를 갖고 있지 않은가. 주머니를 한꺼번에 너무 많이 쓰면 차원에 얼마나 큰 혼란이 생길 수 있는지 알고는 있나?

english: Now stop wasting my time!
Can you repair my pouches?
translation: 제 주머니들 좀 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Fine. A simple transfiguration spell should resolve things for you.
translation: 알겠네. 간단한 변형 주문이면 해결될 걸세.

english: Thanks.
Now can you leave me alone? I can't keep affording these distractions!
translation: 이제 날 좀 내버려 두겠나? 이렇게 계속 방해받을 여유는 없네!

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
Then go away! Honestly, you have no idea of the pressure I am under. I can't afford any distractions!
translation: 그럼 가 버리게! 정말이지, 내가 얼마나 큰 압박을 받고 있는지 자네는 모를 걸세. 한눈팔 여유가 없단 말일세!

english: Sorry, I'll go.
Good. I'm attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will. Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
translation: 좋네. 나는 우주의 원소 체계를 내 뜻대로 굴복시키려는 중일세. 아무 바보나 와서 떠드는 실없는 소리는 아무 도움이 안 되네!

english: There, I have repaired your pouches. Now leave me alone. I'm concentrating!
translation: 자, 주머니를 고쳐 놨네. 이제 날 내버려 두게. 집중하는 중이란 말일세!

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair. Leave me alone!
translation: 고칠 주머니가 없는 것 같군. 날 내버려 두게!

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
The Dark mage has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Dark mage(어둠의 마법사)가 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 줬습니다!

english: Please answer the question.
Stop wasting my time! That is wrong!
Spot on!
The Dark mage has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: Dark mage(어둠의 마법사)가 [another clue scroll/a casket]을(를) 줬습니다!

english: Why not?
What are you doing here?
I need your help with something.
Can I have another Abyssal book?
translation: Abyssal book(심연의 책)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have a new essence pouch?
translation: 새 essence pouch(정수 주머니)를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can you repair my pouches?
translation: 제 주머니들 좀 고쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Actually, I don't need anything right now.
Sorry, I'll go.
The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: 플레이어가 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 들고 Varrock(바록) 남쪽의 돌 원 안으로 들어감

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: 일어나라, 오 위대한 Delrith(델리스)여! 이 무르고 나약한 도시에 파멸을 내려라!

english: Arise, Delrith!
Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: 하하하! 마침내 자유로워졌구나, 나의 악마 형제여! 지금은 쉬어라, 그리고 이 한심한 도시에 복수하라!

english: Who's that?
Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: 안 돼! Silverlight(실버라이트)라니! Delrith(델리스)는 아직 준비가 안 됐는데!

english: I've got to get out of here...
Hello! What are you doing here?
Hello, I am here to investigate rumours of a dark magical presence in these lands.
translation: 안녕하시오. 이 땅에 어둠의 마력이 깃들어 있다는 소문을 조사하러 왔소.

english: What rumours have you heard exactly?
I've heard there are hidden ruins in the mountains here with the power to re-animate beings from the dead. Zandar Horfyre sent me to study them.
translation: 이곳 산속에 죽은 자를 되살리는 힘을 지닌 숨겨진 폐허가 있다고 들었소. Zandar Horfyre(잔다르 호파이어)가 그걸 연구하라고 나를 보냈지.

english: Do you know where in the mountains these ruins are?
translation: 그 폐허가 산 어디쯤 있는지 아세요?

english: Sadly no but I will find them, I will begin looking for information in Arceeus, they seem like my kind of people.
translation: 안타깝게도 모르오. 하지만 반드시 찾아낼 거요. Arceeus(아르세우스)에서부터 정보를 찾아볼 생각이오. 나와 잘 맞는 사람들 같거든.

english: If you say so, good luck.
What are you doing here?
I'm working on combining the dark teleportation magic of these lands into physical form.
translation: 이 땅의 어둠의 순간이동 마법을 물리적인 형태로 담아내는 작업을 하고 있소.

english: Kind of like teleportation tablets?
Yes, but not made quite the same way.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 만드는 방식은 조금 다르오.

english: Can I do that?
If you must. That lectern over there contains the book I've been working on.
translation: 꼭 해야겠다면. 저기 lectern(독서대)에 내가 작업해 온 책이 있소.

english: What are you reading?
I am seeking to understand more about the dark powers present in these lands. Now leave me be, there is much to be learned.
translation: 이 땅에 깃든 어둠의 힘을 더 깊이 이해하려는 중이오. 이제 날 내버려 두시오. 배울 게 많으니.

english: C'mon, why won't this thing open?
translation: 아 좀, 이거 왜 안 열리는 거야?

english: Would you like me to give you a hand with that?
It's okay, I think I've got it... Agh, I thought I had it that time!
translation: 괜찮아요, 될 것 같아요... 아악, 이번엔 된 줄 알았는데!

english: Why are you searching this coffin?
I need to bring that mysterious stranger 100 Hallowed marks so that he can help me escape Darkmeyer.
translation: 그 수수께끼의 이방인한테 Hallowed mark(신성한 표식)을 100개 가져가야 해요. 그래야 Darkmeyer(다크마이어)에서 탈출하게 도와준대요.

english: 100 seems like a lot. How many do you have so far?
translation: 100개면 꽤 많네요. 지금까지 몇 개나 모았어요?

english: None.
I don't have 100 either.
That's okay. I'm sure I'll get this open eventually.
translation: 괜찮아요. 언젠가는 이걸 열 수 있겠죠.

english: I happen to have 100 Hallowed marks on me. I can give you some if you'd like?
translation: 마침 Hallowed mark(신성한 표식)이 100개 있는데요. 원하시면 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Wow! You'd do that for me?
translation: 와! 정말 그렇게 해 주실 거예요?

english: On second thoughts, I think I'll keep them for myself.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 그냥 제가 가질래요.

english: Oh... You didn't have to tease me like that.
Sure. I'll probably find more while I'm down here anyway.
translation: 그럼요. 어차피 여기 있다 보면 더 찾을 것 같아요.

english: I can't thank you enough! I can finally buy my freedom!
translation: 뭐라고 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요! 드디어 자유를 살 수 있겠어요!

english: You're welcome!
The slave departs as you hand him 100 Hallowed marks.
translation: Hallowed mark(신성한 표식) 100개를 건네주자 노예가 떠납니다.

english: It feels nice to do the right thing.
Wait, why are you still here? I gave you the 100 Hallowed marks you need to escape.
translation: 잠깐, 왜 아직 여기 있어요? 탈출하는 데 필요한 Hallowed mark(신성한 표식) 100개를 드렸잖아요.

english: I think you have me mistaken for someone else.
Now go away. I can't hear the locking mechanism with you breathing in my ear!
translation: 이제 좀 가 주세요. 귓가에서 숨소리가 들려서 잠금장치 소리가 안 들리잖아요!

english: C'mon, almost got it...
Agh, thought I had it that time!
Don't give him 100 Hallowed marks.
Give him 100 Hallowed marks.
How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
Hopefully I'll make it out of Darkmeyer one day.
Phew, I made it! Time for a break.
Thank Saradomin that mysterious stranger gave me this ring or I'd be toast!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)께 감사하게도 그 수수께끼의 이방인이 이 반지를 줬기에 망정이지, 아니었으면 끝장났을 거야!

english: That trap was harder than I thought! Perhaps I'm not cut out for this.
translation: 저 덫은 생각보다 어려웠어! 난 이런 일에 안 맞나 봐.

english: I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지 않아요. 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 탐험할 새로운 대륙이라니... 정말 살맛 나는 시대예요!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있다는 얘기를 엿들었어요. 조심하세요!

english: What's the device saying now?
I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
I'm not even sure it's working any more.
This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: 이건 완전 헛수고야! 세상 반대편까지 걸어왔는데 여기 아래엔 쓸모없는 고블린 떼밖에 없잖아!

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: 제 삼각측량 계산으로는 분명 힘의 근원이 대략 이 근처라고 나왔는데...

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: 실제로 동굴이 있는 곳을 가리켰다는 게 고무적이네요.

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: 이 동네는 온통 동굴투성이라고! 여기선 동굴에 안 걸리는 게 더 어려워! 혹시 고블린 등불 같은 멍청한 걸 잡아내는 거 아니야?

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: 마법사로서 제 실력을 좀 더 믿어 주세요! 이걸 몇 년 동안이나 연구해 왔는데-

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: 으! 엿듣는 놈이 있잖아! 꺼져, 모험가. 가서 고블린이랑 얘기나 하든가.

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: 바로 그런 게 보기 좋죠. 예의 바른 모험가라니! 자, 어디까지 했더라...

english: What are you looking for?
None of your business!
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 저기, 저도 당신들 편이에요! 이 펜던트 보이죠?

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: 너 어디서 왔어? 누가 보냈어? 이번 일에선 내가 마법사의 경호원이야. 다른 사람은 필요 없다고!

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Well stick your nose somewhere else!
I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 미안하지만 펜던트가 있든 없든 이건 비밀이에요. 이해해 주시리라 믿어요.

english: Lucien sent me.
He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
translation: 그럴 리 없어요! 그분이 보냈다면 제가 알고 있었을 거예요!

english: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
translation: 우리한테 거짓말할 생각 마! 이제 꺼져!

english: I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: 경호원으로는 당연히 저보다 훨씬 나으시겠지만, 혹시 경호 말고 다른 걸로 도와드릴 수 있지 않을까요?

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: 음, 이게 얼마나 큰지 모르니까요. 찾게 되면 옮기는 데 다른 사람 도움이 필요할 수도 있겠네요.

english: So, what are we looking for?
You're not very well briefed, are you?
translation: 설명을 제대로 못 듣고 오셨나 봐요?

english: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: 솔직히 나도 그건 아직 좀 헷갈려.

english: *sigh*
Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: Lucien(루시엔) 님께서 아주 특정한 종류의 에너지를 내뿜는 유물을 찾으라고 하셨어요. 수년간 연구한 끝에 드디어 거의 다 온 것 같아요.

english: You don't sound very sure.
Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: 에잇! 탐지 장치가 완전히 맛이 갔어요. 도무지 모르겠네요.

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: 지금은 이 근처에 머물지 않는 게 좋겠어요, 모험가님. 정확한 수치가 나오려면 한참 걸릴 수도 있거든요.

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
Okay, I won't bother you.
What are you looking for?
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 저기, 저도 당신들 편이에요! 이 펜던트 보이죠?

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
Lucien sent me.
(Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
What are you buying?
Show me what you have.
What do you do around here?
I'm responsible for organising and selling off any surplus ranging supplies.
translation: 남는 원거리 보급품을 정리해서 파는 일을 맡고 있어요.

english: Those fellows over in Lovakengj are an efficient bunch... They often produce far more than the army actually needs.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기) 친구들은 일 처리가 아주 효율적이거든요... 군대에 실제로 필요한 것보다 훨씬 많이 만들어 내곤 하죠.

english: I've got a wide selection of ranged weapons and ammo, if you wanted to take a look? Its all good stuff.
translation: 원거리 무기랑 탄약이 다양하게 있는데, 한번 보실래요? 다 좋은 물건이에요.

english: I don't think I need anything.
translation: 딱히 필요한 건 없는 것 같아요.

english: Hmph...
Show me what you have.
What do you do around here?
I don't think I need anything.
translation: 딱히 필요한 건 없는 것 같아요.

english: Today is a good day to be a frog!
translation: 오늘은 개구리로 살기 딱 좋은 날이야!

english: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
translation: 그렇고말고. 이제 평화가 왔으니 사는 게 최고야!

english: Hello!
'Ello [guv/miss].
Why are you not helping out the others?
translation: 왜 다른 사람들 안 돕고 있어요?

english: Well you see, [guv/miss], I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: 그게 말이죠, [guv/miss], 저한텐 흔들림 없는 종교적 신념이란 게 있거든요.

english: And those are?
Well, it's like this, see. I used to do a bit of the old priestin' on the side.
translation: 그러니까 이런 거예요. 제가 옛날에 부업으로 사제 노릇을 좀 했었거든요.

english: You know, collectin' for repairs to the church roof, passing the collection plate, jumble sales, nicking the lead off the temple roof so they needed repairing again.
translation: 왜 있잖아요, 교회 지붕 수리비 모금하고, 헌금 접시 돌리고, 바자회 열고, 신전 지붕에서 납을 슬쩍 떼어다가 또 수리하게 만들고.

english: Real holy stuff, you know.
That doesn't sound all that holy to me.
Well, that's because you're not a [man/woman] of the cloth are you?
translation: 그야 당신이 성직에 몸담은 [man/woman]도 아니니까 그렇죠, 안 그래요?

english: You are, in fact, what we refer to in layman's terms as a punter.
translation: 당신은 말하자면, 우리 쪽 속된 말로 '봉'이라고 하는 사람이에요.

english: But anyway, all that priestin' left me with an unshakable faith in three things.
translation: 아무튼, 그 사제 노릇 덕분에 저는 세 가지를 굳게 믿게 됐어요.

english: The power of good over evil.
The true glory of the human spirit.
And that I ain't goin out there with those things runnin' around.
translation: 그리고 저런 것들이 돌아다니는 바깥엔 절대 안 나간다는 것.

english: You used to be a priest, right?
I didn't nick anything, [guv/miss]. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: 전 아무것도 안 훔쳤어요, [guv/miss]. 제가 그때 딴 데 있었다고 맹세해 줄 사람이 스무 명이나 있다고요...

english: What?
Never mind. I need some help with the spirit in the brewing equipment.
translation: 됐어요. 양조 장비에 든 유령 때문에 도움이 좀 필요해요.

english: Well, I'll bless something for you if you need it, but just don't spread it around that I'm giving out freebies.
translation: 뭐, 필요하면 축복 하나쯤은 해 드리죠. 대신 제가 공짜로 퍼 준다고 소문내진 마세요.

english: Trust me, [guv/miss], lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: 믿으세요, [guv/miss]. 여기서 빚는 술에 홀리고 나면 도움 필요한 사람이 한둘이 아니라니까요.

english: Can you bless this wrench for me?
translation: 이 wrench(렌치)를 축복해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Nope.
Nope?
Nope. You don't strike me as being... devout, you know?
translation: 아뇨. 당신은... 별로 독실해 보이질 않거든요, 알죠?

english: Come again?
Your holy aura, it's a little shoddy, if you catch my drift.
translation: 당신의 거룩한 기운이 좀 허접하다, 이 말이에요.

english: You need a Prayer level of 47.
Oh!
Well why didn't you just say so?
I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem [guv/miss]. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: 제가 당신을 좀 과대평가했나 봐요, [guv/miss]. 다신 안 그럴 거예요.

english: I might well do. Remember, only the first one's free.
translation: 그럴 수도 있죠. 명심하세요, 공짜는 처음 한 번뿐이에요.

english: Dominoes Ad Nauseum, Romanes Eunt Domus.
translation: 도미노에스 아드 나우세움, 로마네스 에운트 도무스.

english: Sorted.
Is that it?
Oh, you want the full package deal.
All right. Brace yourself.
Groovy.
Thanks!
No problem, [guv/miss]. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: 별말씀을요, [guv/miss]. 그 자그마한 문제 잘 해결하시길.

english: You might find that little wrench worth hanging on to after you're done with the Spirit.
translation: 유령 일 끝나고 나서도 그 작은 wrench(렌치)는 계속 갖고 있는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: Really? I mean, it's holy and everything, but I don't think it looks all that useful.
translation: 정말요? 거룩하고 뭐 그렇긴 한데, 그렇게 쓸모 있어 보이진 않는데요.

english: Well, it may not look much, but you'll find that you might need a few less prayer potions if you have it in your pack, if you know what I mean.
translation: 뭐, 겉보기엔 별거 아니어도, 가방에 넣어 두면 기도 물약이 좀 덜 필요할 거예요. 무슨 말인지 알죠?

english: Well, no. I don't know what you mean, but I'm sure I'll find out!
translation: 음, 아뇨. 무슨 말인지 모르겠지만, 곧 알게 되겠죠!

english: You mean more help? I've already blessed one wrench for you, that should be enough.
translation: 도움이 더 필요하다고요? 벌써 wrench(렌치)를 하나 축복해 드렸잖아요. 그거면 충분해요.

english: Ello again [guv/miss]. How's things?
Good! Everything seems to have worked out ok.
translation: 좋아요! 다 잘 풀린 것 같아요.

english: I'm sure it'll stay that way so long as you don't know it's missing.
translation: 없어진 걸 모르는 동안은 계속 그럴 거예요.

english: Nothin' [guv/miss], you just have a nice day.
Ello again [guv/miss]. I take it you're here about the wrench?
translation: 또 보네요, [guv/miss]. wrench(렌치) 때문에 오신 거죠?

english: What? The Holy Wrench? But I lost it somewhere...
translation: 네? Holy Wrench(신성한 렌치)요? 그거 어디서 잃어버렸는데...

english: Well [guv/miss], maybe that's what I want you to think.
translation: 글쎄요, [guv/miss], 제가 그렇게 생각하게 만든 걸 수도 있죠.

english: As soon as you've got somewhere to put it I'll hand it over. I'll keep it nice and holy until then.
translation: 넣어 둘 자리만 생기면 바로 넘겨 드릴게요. 그때까지 잘 거룩하게 보관해 둘게요.

english: There you go. I've kept it nice and holy for you.
translation: 여기 있어요. 거룩하게 잘 보관해 뒀어요.

english: Thanks...
Build us a stove mate, I'm absolutely starvin!
translation: 이봐 친구, stove(화덕) 하나만 지어 줘. 배고파 죽겠다고!

english: You must be really tired from the journey, you did so much.
translation: 오는 길에 정말 피곤했겠어요. 엄청 많은 일을 했잖아요.

english: ...So my expertise were not required this time, a man's still gotta eat.
translation: ...그래, 이번엔 내 전문 지식이 필요 없었다 쳐도, 사람은 먹어야 살 거 아냐.

english: I guess I'll get building then...
translation: 그럼 전 뭘 좀 지으러 가 볼게요...

english: Cheers mate!
About these eggs… Odd colour, don't cha think?
translation: 그나저나 이 달걀들… 색깔이 좀 이상하지 않아?

english: The birds here are a little exotic, apparently.
Hmm, well, good effort, but I'll pass on the grub this time.
translation: 흠, 뭐, 애쓴 건 알겠는데, 이번 끼니는 사양할게.

english: What if I gave you a box?
I'm not sure that'll change my mind.
translation: 그런다고 마음이 바뀔 것 같진 않은데.

english: If not a box, then what about a fox?
Nope.
A mouse, a house? Would these change your mind?
translation: 생쥐가 먹여 줄까요? 집으로 배달해 줄까요? 이러면 마음이 바뀔까요?

english: For the love of Saradomin, please leave me be
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 이름으로 빌게, 제발 날 좀 내버려 둬

english: I will! I promise! Just try them and you'll see.
translation: 그럴게요! 약속해요! 딱 한 입만 먹어 보면 알 거예요.

english: Alright! Fine! I concede.
Thoughts?
Yeah, I guess they're nice
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Hello, young adventurer. What brings you to the Museum's paleontology floor?
translation: 안녕하세요, 젊은 모험가님. 박물관 고생물학 층에는 어쩐 일로 오셨나요?

english: What's paleontology?
I'm glad you asked! Paleontology is the study of prehistoric lifeforms in Gielinor through the examination of fossils.
translation: 물어봐 주셔서 기뻐요! 고생물학은 화석을 조사해서 Gielinor(길리노르)의 선사 시대 생물을 연구하는 학문이에요.

english: We use fossils to try determine several things: information about what fossil belonged to, what the environment was like, and try to uncover secrets of Gielinor's past.
translation: 화석으로는 여러 가지를 알아내려고 해요. 그 화석이 어떤 생물이었는지, 환경은 어땠는지, 그리고 길리노르 과거의 비밀을 밝혀내려 하죠.

english: What else would you like to know?
Where do these fossils come from?
Ah, brilliant question. Fossils of creatures are found in sedimentary rock, we use specialised tools to carefully remove the unwanted rock only leaving only the fossil behind.
translation: 아, 훌륭한 질문이에요. 생물의 화석은 퇴적암에서 발견되는데, 특수한 도구로 필요 없는 암석을 조심스럽게 걷어내서 화석만 남기는 거예요.

english: If you're looking for fossils yourself, I hear there is a voyage to a mysterious island to discover new types of fossil.
translation: 직접 화석을 찾아보고 싶으시다면, 새로운 종류의 화석을 찾으러 신비한 섬으로 떠나는 항해가 있다고 들었어요.

english: You should speak to the Curator as he knows more about it than I.
translation: Curator(큐레이터)님께 여쭤보세요. 저보다 그분이 더 잘 아시거든요.

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
What can I do with these fossils?
translation: 이 화석들로 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Any fossils you find can be added to the surrounding display cases.
translation: 찾으신 화석은 주변 진열장에 추가할 수 있어요.

english: If you manage to complete display case, the Museum will ensure you are rewarded for your efforts.
translation: 진열장 하나를 완성하시면 박물관에서 그 노고에 꼭 보상해 드릴 거예요.

english: Also, if you find any rare fossils on your travels, make sure you hold onto them. Something tells me they will be very valuable in the future...
translation: 그리고 여행 중에 희귀한 화석을 찾으시면 꼭 잘 간직해 두세요. 왠지 앞으로 아주 귀해질 것 같거든요...

english: Do you have any other questions?
What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
translation: 화석 전시물에 대해 좀 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: It looks like the Museum doesn't have any complete fossil displays yet. I could only speculate on what they will contain.
translation: 박물관에 아직 완성된 화석 전시물이 없는 것 같네요. 무엇이 들어갈지는 짐작만 할 뿐이에요.

english: Of course. Which display would you like to ask about?
The one that looks like a great leviathan.
The one that looks like a foot print of a mythical animal.
translation: 신화 속 동물의 발자국처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like an imprint of a posterior.
The one that looks like a zygomite.
The one that looks like a snake in the shape of a hoop.
translation: 고리 모양으로 몸을 만 뱀처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a clam shell.
The one that looks like a 'big' foot print.
The one that looks like a crab shell.
The one that looks like a cyclopse with two heads.
translation: 머리 둘 달린 사이클롭스처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like it could be used for fuel.
translation: 연료로 쓸 수 있을 것처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a tar creature.
The one that looks like a giant dragonfly.
The one that looks like an ancient cave painting.
The one that looks like a person with a fish tail.
translation: 물고기 꼬리가 달린 사람처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a lava creature.
The one that looks like a pufferfish.
The one that looks like a dragon skull.
The one that looks like a squirrel with huge teeth.
translation: 이빨이 엄청 큰 다람쥐처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a dragon egg.
The one that looks like a cross between a mushroom and kangaroo.
translation: 버섯과 캥거루를 섞어 놓은 것처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like an unusual lobster.
The one that looks like a creature with a giant skull and small body.
translation: 두개골은 거대하고 몸은 작은 생물처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a tree sized mushroom.
The one that looks like scary mushrooms.
The one that looks like a tortoise with a mushroom on its shell.
translation: 등딱지에 버섯이 난 거북처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a huge pitcher plant.
The one that looks like a cross between a dark beast and a shark.
translation: dark beast(어둠의 야수)와 상어를 섞어 놓은 것처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a merfish with legs.
translation: 다리 달린 인어 물고기처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a plant with a stack of mushrooms.
translation: 버섯이 층층이 쌓인 식물처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a big mushroom.
The one that looks like a toucan with two heads.
translation: 머리 둘 달린 투칸처럼 생긴 거요.

english: The one that looks like a bird with a snail shell on its back.
translation: 등에 달팽이 껍데기를 얹은 새처럼 생긴 거요.

english: Um... yes. It's an interesting specimen isn't it?
Do you know much about this display?
Um... yes, but I couldn't possibly share that information right now.
translation: 음... 네, 그런데 지금은 그 정보를 알려 드릴 수가 없어요.

english: It's an interesting specimen isn't it? It appears that the specimen is thousands of years old!
translation: 흥미로운 표본이죠? 이 표본은 수천 년 된 것 같아요!

english: Are you sure?
Well that's what the analysis from the fossil shows.
Aren't you going to tell me about the display?
translation: 전시물에 대해 알려 주시는 거 아니었어요?

english: What did you ask about again?
Nevermind.
What's paleontology?
Where do these fossils come from?
What can I do with these fossils?
translation: 이 화석들로 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: What can you tell me about some of the fossil displays?
translation: 화석 전시물에 대해 좀 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Nevermind
Pssst! Come here if you want to do some amulet trading.
translation: 쉬잇! 아뮬렛 거래할 생각 있으면 이리 와 봐요.

english: What do you mean pssst?
Errr, I was...I was clearing my throat.
translation: 어, 그게... 그냥 목을 좀 가다듬은 거예요.

english: Why don't you ever restock some types of amulets?
translation: 왜 어떤 아뮬렛은 재고를 다시 안 채워 놔요?

english: Some of these amulets are very hard to get. I have to wait until an adventurer supplies me.
translation: 어떤 아뮬렛은 구하기가 정말 어렵거든요. 모험가가 가져다줄 때까지 기다려야 해요.

english: What are you selling?
What do you mean pssst?
Why don't you ever restock some types of amulets?
translation: 왜 어떤 아뮬렛은 재고를 다시 안 채워 놔요?

english: I claim [player name] as my own!
Your time here is over, [player name].
There is no escape, [player name]...
Now is the time you die, [player name].
Beware mortals, [player name] now travels with me.
translation: 조심하게, 필멸자들이여. 이제 [player name]의 여정은 나와 함께일세.

english: I have come for you, [player name]!
[Player name] is mine!
Let me escort you to [respawn location], [player name].
Muhahahahaha!
Hello mortal. Have you come to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: 어서 오게, 필멸자여. 죽을 때 잃어버린 것을 되찾으러 왔나?

english: How does that work?
When you die, you often drop things you were carrying. In most cases, a gravestone appears near where you died, and your items can be retrieved there.
translation: 죽으면 지니고 있던 물건을 떨어뜨리는 경우가 많지. 대개는 죽은 곳 근처에 묘비가 나타나고, 거기서 물건을 되찾을 수 있네.

english: However, gravestones do not last for long. When your gravestone collapses, your items come here, to me. I can return them to you - though I charge a fee for my services.
translation: 하지만 묘비는 오래가지 않네. 묘비가 무너지면 자네 물건은 이곳, 내게로 오지. 돌려줄 수는 있네만, 수고비는 받겠네.

english: Aside from that, if you bring me your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer here, I'll count their value against any future fees I charge you.
translation: 그 밖에도, 필요 없는 소지품을 가져와 여기 있는 내 Coffer(금고)에 바치면, 그 값어치만큼 앞으로 내가 받을 수수료에서 빼 주지.

english: I don't accept just any junk, but I'll try to give you a good price for anything decent.
translation: 아무 잡동사니나 받지는 않네만, 쓸 만한 물건이면 값을 후하게 쳐 주겠네.

english: So do you need to retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: 그래서, 죽을 때 잃어버린 것을 되찾아야 하나?

english: What is this place?
As you should be able to see, I am Death. The Grim Reaper. The Inexorable One. The Inescapable Grasp of Mortal Destiny. And this is my little office. Nice, isn't it?
translation: 보면 알겠지만, 나는 Death(죽음)일세. 저승사자. 거스를 수 없는 자. 필멸의 운명을 움켜쥐는 피할 수 없는 손아귀. 그리고 여긴 내 작은 사무실이지. 근사하지 않나?

english: It's lovely.
Thank you. I feel the colour scheme suits my style. Now, can I help you retrieve something you lost when you died?
translation: 고맙네. 이 색 배합이 내 스타일에 어울리는 것 같거든. 자, 죽을 때 잃어버린 것을 되찾는 걸 도와줄까?

english: Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Sometimes it's hard to care for beauty when one's very existence is just seen as a curse upon the world. Now, do you actually want to retrieve something from me?
translation: 존재 자체가 세상에 내린 저주로 여겨지다 보면 아름다움을 신경 쓰기가 쉽지 않다네. 자, 정말로 내게서 되찾을 게 있는 건가?

english: Yes, have you got anything for me?
Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: 묘비를 다른 모양으로 고를 수 있어요?

english: You haven't got 200,000 coins to pay for that. I can take coins from your inventory, or from my Coffer.
translation: 꾸미는 데 200,000코인이 드는데, 자네는 그만큼 없군. 코인은 자네 소지품이나 내 Coffer(금고)에서 가져갈 수 있네.

english: Actually, never mind.
Most people won't see your grave, by the way. It appears to you, but it aims to be invisible to everyone else. Are you sure you want to buy a cosmetic override for it?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 자네 묘비는 대부분의 사람들 눈에 안 보일 걸세. 자네에게는 보이지만, 다른 이들에게는 보이지 않게 되어 있지. 정말 외형 변경을 사겠나?

english: Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: 네, 다른 사람들은 잘 못 본다는 거 알아요.

english: Your gravestone is now the Angel of Death.
translation: 자네 묘비는 이제 Angel of Death(죽음의 천사)일세.

english: It is not for me to judge how people spend their money.
translation: 사람들이 돈을 어디에 쓰든 내가 판단할 일은 아니지.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Do you really want to switch to the basic gravestone? I'm not offering to give back the fee you paid earlier.
translation: 정말 기본 묘비로 바꾸겠나? 전에 낸 비용은 돌려주지 않네.

english: Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
Your gravestone is now the basic type.
You've already got the basic gravestone.
translation: 자네는 이미 기본 묘비를 쓰고 있네.

english: Er... I suppose so.
How would you like to... die?
Not just now, thanks.
Really? There isn't much else for you to do here. But you know your business.
translation: 그런가? 여기선 달리 할 일도 별로 없을 텐데. 뭐, 자네 일은 자네가 알아서 하겠지.

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Ironmen. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: 어서 오게, 필멸자여. 죽을 때 잃어버린 것을 찾는다면, 미안하지만 나는 Ultimate Ironmen(얼티밋 아이언맨)은 상대하지 않네. 자네 물건은 죽은 자리 바닥에 떨어졌을 걸세.

english: Can I change how I die?
So, mortal... you have died, as all mortals do. As you have suffered the loss of some items on this occasion, I have brought you here to explain for you how that works.
translation: 자, 필멸자여... 모든 필멸자가 그렇듯 자네도 죽었네. 이번에 물건을 좀 잃었으니, 그게 어떻게 되는지 설명해 주려고 자네를 이리로 데려왔지.

english: I lost items? Can I get them back?
Let me explain... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: 설명해 주지... Gielinor(길리노르) 땅 대부분에서는, 죽으면 지니고 있던 물건 중 일부를 떨어뜨리게 되네.

english: I will look after such items,without a time limit. However, I do charge more for my services. It would be cheaper to retrieve them from the gravestone directly, if you can reach it in time.
translation: 그런 물건은 기한 없이 내가 맡아 두겠네. 다만 수고비는 더 비싸지. 시간 안에 묘비까지 갈 수 있다면 거기서 직접 되찾는 편이 더 싸게 먹힐 걸세.

english: Tell me about gravestones again.
Gladly... Across most of the land of Gielinor, when you die, some of the items you're carrying are dropped.
translation: 기꺼이... Gielinor(길리노르) 땅 대부분에서는, 죽으면 지니고 있던 물건 중 일부를 떨어뜨리게 되네.

english: How do I pay a gravestone fee?
Cash is always acceptable. Also, a gravestone can take it directly from you bank, in case you didn't have enough with you.
translation: 현금은 언제든 환영일세. 그리고 가진 돈이 모자랄 경우를 대비해, 묘비가 자네 은행에서 바로 가져갈 수도 있네.

english: Besides that, take a look at my Coffer here. You can bring your unwanted possessions, and sacrifice them into my Coffer. I'll count their value against any future gravestone fees you're charged.
translation: 그 밖에도, 여기 내 Coffer(금고)를 한번 보게. 필요 없는 소지품을 가져와 내 금고에 바칠 수 있네. 그 값어치만큼 앞으로 청구될 묘비 비용에서 빼 주지.

english: How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: 죽으면 제 물건이 어떻게 될지 어떻게 알 수 있어요?

english: There is a menu to predict these things for you. Take a look at your Worn Items side-panel...
translation: 그런 걸 예측해 주는 메뉴가 있네. 착용 장비 패널을 한번 보게...

english: I think I'm done here.
translation: 이제 볼일 다 본 것 같아요.

english: I'm afraid we have more topics to cover before you leave. Speak to me when you are ready to continue.
translation: 미안하지만 떠나기 전에 다룰 이야기가 더 남아 있네. 계속할 준비가 되면 다시 말을 걸게.

english: Very well. Once you pass through my portal, you will have 15 minutes to reach your gravestone.
translation: 좋네. 내 포털을 지나가면, 자네는 15분 안에 묘비에 도착해야 하네.

english: I believe I was explaining gravestones to you. We still have some more topics to cover.
translation: 묘비에 대해 설명하던 중이었던 것 같군. 아직 다룰 이야기가 더 남아 있네.

english: I haven't finished talking to you yet, [player name]. Please don't worry about your gravestone - it will wait until you leave this place.
translation: 아직 자네와 이야기가 안 끝났네, [player name]. 묘비 걱정은 말게. 자네가 이곳을 떠날 때까지 기다려 줄 걸세.

english: Would you like me to remind you about gravestones?
You haven't unlocked that. You can do so by reading a Trailblazer reloaded death scroll.
translation: 그건 아직 해금하지 않았군. Trailblazer reloaded death scroll(트레일블레이저 리로디드 죽음 두루마리)를 읽으면 해금할 수 있네.

english: Have you come to retrieve something you lost from a previous gravestone?
translation: 이전 묘비에서 잃어버린 것을 되찾으러 왔나?

english: You will now die like a Trailblazer.
translation: 이제 자네는 Trailblazer(트레일블레이저)처럼 죽게 될 걸세.

english: You are already using that.
You will now perish like most others in Gielinor.
translation: 이제 자네는 Gielinor(길리노르)의 여느 사람들처럼 죽게 될 걸세.

english: Hello mortal. If you're looking for something you lost when you died, I'm afraid I don't cater to Ultimate Iron [Men/Women]. Your items would have fallen on the ground where you died.
translation: 어서 오게, 필멸자여. 죽을 때 잃어버린 것을 찾는다면, 미안하지만 나는 Ultimate Iron [Men/Women](얼티밋 아이언맨)은 상대하지 않네. 자네 물건은 죽은 자리 바닥에 떨어졌을 걸세.

english: So what can I do here?
translation: 그럼 여기서 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing, really. Please leave when you are ready.
How does that work?
What is this place?
It's lovely.
Your decorations leave a bit to be desired.
Yes, have you got anything for me?
More options...
Can I choose a different-looking gravestone?
translation: 묘비를 다른 모양으로 고를 수 있어요?

english: Actually, never mind.
Yes, I understand other people won't often see it.
translation: 네, 다른 사람들은 잘 못 본다는 거 알아요.

english: No thanks, it's not worth it.
Yes, I want the basic gravestone.
Can I change how I die?
Not just now, thanks.
Previous options...
Tell me about gravestones again.
How do I pay a gravestone fee?
How long do I have to return to my gravestone?
How do I know what will happen to my items when I die?
translation: 죽으면 제 물건이 어떻게 될지 어떻게 알 수 있어요?

english: I think I'm done here.
translation: 이제 볼일 다 본 것 같아요.

english: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded.
translation: Leagues IV: Trailblazer Reloaded(리그 IV: 트레일블레이저 리로디드).

english: Default.
:Intruder!
:Protect the keystone!
:Stop them at all costs!
:Intruder!
:Protect the keystone!
:Stop them at all costs!
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 별로 확신이 없어 보이는데. 애들 근처에 감염자는 얼씬도 못 해. 썩 꺼져!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 뭘 팔러 왔는지 몰라도 우린 관심 없어!

english: But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: 아니, 그 아이템이랑 바꿔 줄 은행권은 없어.

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: 아니, 그런 건 은행권으로 바꿀 수가 없어.

english: That IS a banknote!
Hello, no-fur. What are you doing in my mistress's garden?
translation: 안녕, 털 없는 친구. 우리 주인님 정원에서 뭐 하고 있어?

english: Looking for sq'irks.
If it's sq'irks you're after then you've come to the right place. We've got four seasons' worth of them.
translation: 스쿼크를 찾는 거라면 제대로 찾아왔어. 여긴 사계절 치가 다 있거든.

english: I've a couple of questions.
I'd be happy to help a friend of the feline.
What do you mean?
The Sphinx gave you that amulet, so she must hold you in high regard.
translation: Sphinx(스핑크스)가 그 아뮬렛을 줬으니, 널 꽤 높이 사는 게 분명해.

english: If I remember correctly, it was the High Priest of Sophanem who gave it to me.
translation: 제 기억이 맞다면, 이건 Sophanem(소파넴)의 High Priest(대사제)가 준 건데요.

english: He and the Sphinx are as thick as thieves, but regardless, I think you've a bit of a cat feel about you.
translation: 대사제랑 스핑크스는 둘도 없는 단짝이야. 아무튼, 너한테선 고양이 같은 구석이 좀 느껴져.

english: Now what are these questions?
What are the creatures inside the gardens?
Oh, you mean the gardeners?
The strange, floaty creatures.
Yes, the gardeners. Don't let them see you or they'll teleport you out here. They're very protective of their crops.
translation: 응, 정원사들. 걔들한테 들키지 마. 들키면 이 바깥으로 순간이동시켜 버리거든. 자기네 작물을 엄청 아끼니까.

english: Thanks, I have another question though.
translation: 고마워요. 근데 물어볼 게 하나 더 있어요.

english: Thanks for your help.
How do you get into the seasonal gardens?
I get in through gaps in the hedge. You are a little too big to squeeze through. I think you'll have to use the gates.
translation: 난 산울타리 틈으로 들어가. 넌 비집고 들어가기엔 좀 크고. 대문으로 가야 할 거야.

english: I think the gates are locked, so you'll have to have good Thieving skills to get in.
translation: 대문은 잠겨 있을 테니까, 들어가려면 Thieving(도둑질) 스킬이 꽤 높아야 할걸.

english: How is it that the gardens are in different seasons?
translation: 정원들은 어떻게 계절이 다 다른 거예요?

english: How did you get here?
Magic?
Exactly. The Sorceress likes to have a good supply of in-season sq'irks and herbs at all times.
translation: 바로 그거야. Sorceress(여마법사)님은 제철 스쿼크랑 약초를 항상 넉넉히 갖춰 두는 걸 좋아하시거든.

english: How do I get out of here?
Take a drink from the fountain.
translation: 분수에서 물 한 모금 마시면 돼.

english: Talking to cats.
A noble and rewarding past-time.
How did you get here?
Every time I play with spiders in the Sorceress's house, her silly apprentice completely freaks out and teleports me here!
translation: Sorceress(여마법사)님 집에서 거미 가지고 놀 때마다, 그 멍청한 견습생이 완전 기겁해서 날 여기로 순간이동시켜 버려!

english: So you've been stuck here since?
translation: 그럼 그 뒤로 여기 갇혀 있는 거예요?

english: No, silly! I drink from the fountain whenever I want to leave.
translation: 아니, 바보야! 나가고 싶을 땐 언제든 분수 물을 마시면 돼.

english: What are you doing here?
I get this strange urge for sq'irks. It's quite peculiar. I think I may be addicted.
translation: 스쿼크가 이상하게 당긴단 말이지. 참 희한해. 아무래도 중독된 것 같아.

english: I think I know someone else who may be in a similar position.
translation: 비슷한 처지인 사람을 하나 알 것 같아요.

english: Don't tell me. Osman, right?
You know him too?
Oh, he used to come here all the time. Then one day, he just stopped.
translation: 아, 예전엔 여기 맨날 왔었지. 그러다 어느 날 딱 끊더라고.

english: Who are you?
Del-Monty the cat, at your service.
Are you a famous adventurer who was turned into a cat by a vindictive mage?
translation: 혹시 앙심 품은 마법사 때문에 고양이로 변한 유명한 모험가예요?

english: No; as I said, I'm Del-Monty the cat, connoisseur of exotic fruits.
translation: 아니. 말했잖아, 난 고양이 델몬티야. 이국 과일 감식가지.

english: In that case, can you tell me anything about sq'irks?
translation: 그럼 sq'irk(스쿼크)에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: But of course! Their juice is an excellent source of energy for runners, and in the riper varieties they are known to heighten one's Thieving abilities.
translation: 물론이지! 즙은 달리는 사람에게 훌륭한 기력 보충제고, 잘 익은 품종은 Thieving(도둑질) 능력을 높여 준다고 알려져 있어.

english: Nothing much.
Yawn! Nice talking to you then, no-fur.
translation: 하암! 그럼 즐거웠어, 털 없는 친구.

english: Hey kitty!
Hiss!
Looking for sq'irks.
What are the creatures inside the gardens?
Thanks, I have another question though.
translation: 고마워요. 근데 물어볼 게 하나 더 있어요.

english: Thanks for your help.
How do you get into the seasonal gardens?
How is it that the gardens are in different seasons?
translation: 정원들은 어떻게 계절이 다 다른 거예요?

english: How do I get out of here?
Talking to cats.
What are you doing here?
Who are you?
Nothing much.
Greetings! I am Alathazdrar, butler to the Demon Lords, and I offer thee my services for a mere 10000 coins!
translation: 반갑사옵니다! 저는 악마 군주들의 집사 Alathazdrar(알라타즈드라르)이옵니다. 단돈 10000코인에 그대를 모시겠나이다!

english: What can you do?

I have learned my trade under the leash of some of the harshest masters of the Demon Dimensions. I can cook to satisfy the most infernal stomachs, and fly on wings of flame to deposit thine items in the bank or bring
translation: 저는 Demon Dimensions(악마 차원)에서도 가장 혹독한 주인들의 목줄 아래서 일을 배웠사옵니다. 가장 지옥 같은 위장도 만족시킬 요리를 할 수 있고, 화염의 날개로 날아가 그대의 물건을 은행에 맡기거나 제재소에서

english: planks from the sawmill in seconds.
Tell me about your previous jobs.

For millennia I have served and waited on the mighty Demon Lords of the Infernal Dimensions. I began as a humble footman in the household of Lord Thammaron, and for several centuries I was the private valet to
translation: 수천 년 동안 저는 Infernal Dimensions(지옥 차원)의 강대한 악마 군주들을 섬기고 시중들었사옵니다. 타마론 경의 집안에서 미천한 하인으로 시작하여, 여러 세기 동안 개인 시종으로 모신 분은

english: Delrith. I have also worked in the Grim Underworld, escorting the souls of the dead to their final abodes. But the incessant shadows and hellfire weary me, so I have come to serve mortal masters in the realms of light.
translation: Delrith(델리스) 님이시옵니다. Grim Underworld(음울한 저승)에서 죽은 자의 영혼을 마지막 안식처로 인도한 적도 있사옵니다. 하오나 끝없는 그림자와 지옥불에 지쳐, 빛의 세계에서 필멸의 주인을 섬기고자 왔나이다.

english: You, a mere mortal with level [1-49] Construction, wish to employ ME, butler to Great Ones of the Outer Darkness? Ha ha ha! I refuse to work for anyone below level 50 Construction.
translation: 고작 Construction(건설) 레벨 [1-49]인 하찮은 필멸자가 Outer Darkness(바깥 어둠)의 위대한 존재들을 모시던 이 몸을 부리겠다고? 하하하! 나는 건설 레벨 50 미만인 자를 위해서는 일하지 않는다.

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 하인이 잘 수 있도록 침대가 있는 침실이 하나 더 필요하옵니다.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 고용할게요... 아, 지금 돈이 없는데, 외상으로 해도 돼요? 꼭 갚을게요, 진짜로요.

english: I regret, Master, that I must insist on payment up front.
translation: 송구하오나, 주인님, 보수는 선불로 받아야 하겠사옵니다.

english: You're hired!
I shall devote my every art to thy service, my Master.
translation: 저의 모든 재주를 바쳐 그대를 섬기겠나이다, 주인님.

english: Bones are a tool of prayer, and demonic magic prevents me from touching them, my Lord.
translation: Bones(뼈)는 기도의 도구라, 악마의 마법 때문에 저는 손댈 수가 없사옵니다, 주인님.

english: What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
You're hired!
Rhaaaaaaa!
So you wish to join us? You have made a wise choice. When we summon the demon Agrith-Naar, he will grant all our worldly desires.
translation: 그래, 우리와 함께하겠다고? 현명한 선택이다. 우리가 악마 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 소환하면, 그가 우리의 모든 세속적 욕망을 이루어 줄 것이다.

english: An abyssal whip, a dragon chain mail? To conjure these items is trivial for Agrith-Naar.
translation: abyssal whip(심연의 채찍)이든 dragon chain mail(드래곤 사슬 갑옷)이든, 아그리스나르에게 그런 물건을 불러내는 것쯤은 하찮은 일이지.

english: But you will not need such weapons or armour, for Agrith-Naar will grant you the power of life and death over all creatures!
translation: 하지만 그런 무기나 갑옷은 필요 없을 거다. 아그리스나르가 모든 생물의 생사를 좌우할 힘을 내려 줄 테니까!

english: You shall have every wish granted, and everyone who has ever wronged you will burn in a hell of your own devising!
translation: 모든 소원이 이루어지고, 너에게 잘못한 놈들은 모조리 네가 고안한 지옥에서 불타게 될 거다!

english: Isn't this, you know, wrong?
Right and wrong are for the weak! This is your chance to choose to be on the side of the strong, and have all your desires granted, while the weak are crushed beneath Agrith-Naar's demonic feet!
translation: 옳고 그름 따위는 약자들이나 따지는 거다! 지금이 강자의 편에 서서 모든 욕망을 이룰 기회다. 약자들은 아그리스나르의 악마 발굽 아래 짓밟히겠지!

english: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)가 우리를 위해 이 모든 걸 해 줄 거라는 걸 어떻게 알아요?

english: My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!
translation: 내 속박 주문이 아그리스나르를 내 노예로 만들 거다! 다시는 내 힘을 의심하지 않는 게 좋을 거다. 그 주문을 너한테 걸고 싶지 않다면 말이야!

english: Why did Josef run away?
Obviously he was a coward who did not have the strength to abandon his old-fashioned morality. I hope you will not be a similar disappointment.
translation: 뻔하지, 낡아빠진 도덕을 버릴 힘도 없는 겁쟁이였으니까. 너는 그놈처럼 실망시키지 않길 바란다.

english: What do I have to do?
When I have finished preparing the magic circle, we will all recite the incantation that will summon Agrith-Naar.
translation: 내가 magic circle(마법진) 준비를 마치면, 다 함께 아그리스나르를 소환할 주문을 외울 거다.

english: You must memorize the incantation carefully. It is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: 주문을 잘 외워 둬라. Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren(칼다르 아그리스나르 카메린툼 나후두 타렌)이다.

english: You will also need to make yourself a demonic sigil to act as a focus of power. One of the group has the mould you need to make it.
translation: 힘을 모아 줄 매개체로 demonic sigil(악마 인장)도 하나 만들어야 한다. 그걸 만드는 데 필요한 거푸집은 무리 중 한 명이 갖고 있다.

english: Now let me continue with my preparations!
translation: 이제 방해 말고 준비나 계속하게 해라!

english: Leave me alone! I am preparing for the summoning ritual. You should make yourself a demonic sigil and practice the incantation with the other wizards.
translation: 날 내버려 둬! 소환 의식을 준비하는 중이다. 너는 demonic sigil(악마 인장)을 만들고 다른 마법사들과 주문 연습이나 해라.

english: I forgot the incantation.
Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren.
translation: 무지렁이 같으니! 이런 간단한 일도 못 하나? 주문은 Caldar Agrith-Naar Camerinthum Nahudu Tarren(칼다르 아그리스나르 카메린툼 나후두 타렌)이다.

english: The player entered the stone circle south of Varrock with Silverlight
translation: 플레이어가 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 들고 Varrock(바록) 남쪽의 돌 원에 들어왔다

english: Arise, O mighty Delrith! Bring destruction to this soft, weak city!
translation: 일어나라, 오 강대한 Delrith(델리스)여! 이 나약하고 무른 도시에 파멸을 내려라!

english: Arise, Delrith!
Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitiful city!
translation: 하하하! 마침내 풀려났구나, 나의 악마 형제여! 지금은 쉬어라. 그리고 이 한심한 도시에 복수하는 거다!

english: Who's that?
Noo! Not Silverlight! Delrith is not ready yet!
translation: 안 돼! Silverlight(실버라이트)라니! 델리스는 아직 준비가 안 됐는데!

english: I've got to get out of here...
Isn't this, you know, wrong?
How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)가 우리를 위해 이 모든 걸 해 줄 거라는 걸 어떻게 알아요?

english: Why did Josef run away?
What do I have to do?
I forgot the incantation.
Hello!
Hello citizen, how can I help?
translation: 어서 오시오, 시민. 무엇을 도와드리면 되겠소?

english: Do you have any quests for me?
I don't know if you can help us!
translation: 그대가 우리를 도울 수 있을지 모르겠구려!

english: The trolls have taken up camp on Death Plateau! They are using it to launch raids at night on the village. We have tried to attack the camp but the main path is heavily guarded!
translation: 트롤들이 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)에 진을 쳤소! 그곳을 거점 삼아 밤마다 마을을 습격하고 있소. 진지를 공격해 보았지만 주 진입로의 경비가 너무 삼엄하오!

english: Perhaps there is a way you can sneak up at night?
translation: 밤에 몰래 올라갈 방법이 있지 않을까요?

english: If there is another way I do not know of it.
translation: 다른 길이 있다 해도 나는 모르오.

english: Do you know of such a path?
No but perhaps I could try and find one?
Citizen you would be well rewarded!
translation: 시민, 그렇게만 해 준다면 후히 보답하겠소!

english: If you go up to Death Plateau be very careful as the trolls will attack you on sight!
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)에 올라간다면 각별히 조심하시오. 트롤들은 보는 즉시 공격해 올 테니!

english: I'll be careful.
One other thing.
What's that?
All of our equipment is kept in the castle on the hill.
translation: 우리 장비는 전부 언덕 위 성에 보관되어 있소.

english: The stupid guard that was on duty last night lost the combination to the lock! I told the Prince that the Imperial Guard should've been in charge of security!
translation: 어젯밤 당번이던 멍청한 경비병이 자물쇠의 조합 번호를 잃어버렸소! 경비는 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 맡아야 한다고 왕자님께 그렇게 말씀드렸건만!

english: No problem, what does the combination look like?
The equipment room is unlocked when the stone balls are placed in the correct order on the stone mechanism outside it. The right order is written on a piece of paper the guard had.
translation: 장비실 밖에 있는 돌 장치에 돌 구슬들을 올바른 순서로 놓으면 장비실 문이 열리오. 올바른 순서는 그 경비병이 갖고 있던 종이 한 장에 적혀 있소.

english: A stone what...?!
Well citizen, the Prince is fond of puzzles. Why he couldn't just have a key is beyond me!
translation: 그게 말이오, 시민, 왕자님께서 퍼즐을 무척 좋아하시오. 왜 그냥 열쇠를 쓰지 않으시는지 나로서는 도통 모르겠소!

english: I'll get on it right away!
No, sorry.
Never mind citizen.
Can I assist you with anything else?
What is this place?
Welcome to Principality of Burthorpe!
We are the Imperial Guard for his Royal Highness Prince Anlaf of Burthorpe.
translation: 우리는 Burthorpe(버소프)의 Prince Anlaf(안라프 왕자) 전하를 모시는 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)요.

english: You can't, thanks.
Hello citizen, is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: 어서 오시오, 시민. 알고 싶은 것이라도 있소?

english: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
translation: 제가 하고 있는 퀘스트가 뭐였는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: You offered to see if you could find another way up Death Plateau. We could then use it to sneak up and attack the trolls by night.
translation: 그대는 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길을 찾아보겠다고 했소. 그 길로 밤에 몰래 올라가 트롤들을 칠 수 있도록 말이오.

english: Ah yes, and the guard hast lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?
translation: 아, 맞다. 그리고 경비병이 언덕 위 성에 있는 장비실의 조합 번호를 잃어버렸다고 하셨죠?

english: That's right citizen, you offered to recover the combination and unlock the door.
translation: 그렇소, 시민. 그대는 조합 번호를 되찾아 문을 열어 주겠다고 했소.

english: I've found a secret way up Death Plateau so I just need to find the combination and unlock the door.
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 비밀 길을 찾았으니, 이제 조합 번호를 찾아서 문만 열면 돼요.

english: Good work citizen!
Is there anything you'd like to know?
I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?
translation: Asgarnia(아스가르니아)는 White Knights(백기사단)이 장악하고 있는 줄 알았는데요?

english: You are right citizen. The White Knights have taken advantage of the old and weak king, they control most of Asgarnia, including Falador. However they do not control Burthorpe!
translation: 맞는 말이오, 시민. White Knights(백기사단)은 늙고 쇠약한 왕을 이용해 Falador(팔라도르)를 비롯한 Asgarnia(아스가르니아) 대부분을 장악했소. 하지만 Burthorpe(버소프)만은 그들 손에 넘어가지 않았소!

english: We are the prince's elite troops! We keep Burthorpe secure!
translation: 우리는 왕자님의 정예 부대요! Burthorpe(버소프)의 안전은 우리가 지키오!

english: The White Knights have overlooked us, until now! They are pouring money into their war against the Black Knights, they are looking for an excuse to stop our funding and I'm afraid they may have found it!
translation: 지금까지는 White Knights(백기사단)도 우리를 눈여겨보지 않았소! 그들은 Black Knights(흑기사단)과의 전쟁에 돈을 쏟아붓고 있어서 우리 자금줄을 끊을 구실을 찾고 있는데, 아무래도 그 구실을 찾아낸 것 같아 걱정이오!

english: If we can not destroy the troll camp on Death Plateau then the Imperial Guard will be disbanded and Burthorpe will come under control of the White Knights. We can not let this happen!
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)의 트롤 진지를 없애지 못하면 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)는 해산되고 Burthorpe(버소프)는 White Knights(백기사단)의 손에 넘어가게 되오. 그런 일이 일어나게 둘 수는 없소!

english: That's all, thanks.
God speed citizen.
Hello citizen, have you found another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 어서 오시오, 시민. Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길은 찾았소?

english: Yes, there is another way up Death Plateau!
translation: 네, Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길이 있어요!

english: We are saved!
There's one thing...
And what is that citizen?
There is a Sherpa who will only show me the secret way if I first get some spikes for his climbing boots. The smith will only do this for me if you sign up his son for the Imperial Guard!
translation: Sherpa(셰르파)가 자기 climbing boots(등반화)에 박을 징을 먼저 구해 오면 비밀 길을 알려 주겠대요. 그런데 대장장이는 자기 아들을 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)에 입대시켜 주셔야만 징을 만들어 주겠대요!

english: Hmm...this is very irregular.
Will you not do this?
I have heard of Dunstan's son, he is a very promising young man. For the sake of your mission we can make an exception!
translation: Dunstan(던스턴)의 아들 이야기는 들은 적이 있소. 장래가 아주 촉망되는 젊은이라오. 그대의 임무를 위해서라면 예외를 두겠소!

english: Denulth has given you a certificate.
This certificate proves that we have accepted Dunstan's son for training in the Imperial Guard!
translation: 이 증명서는 우리가 Dunstan(던스턴)의 아들을 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대) 훈련생으로 받아들였다는 증표요!

english: Thank you Denulth, I shall be back shortly!
Hello citizen, have you found the secret way up Death Plateau?
translation: 어서 오시오, 시민. Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 가는 비밀 길은 찾았소?

english: I'm working on it, I just need to give the certificate to Dunstan.
translation: 지금 하는 중이에요. Dunstan(던스턴)에게 증명서만 갖다주면 돼요.

english: I'm working on it but I've lost the certificate!
No problem, I have a duplicate.
Yes! There is a path that runs from Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.
translation: 네! Sherpa(셰르파)의 오두막에서 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원) 뒤편을 돌아가는 길이 있어요. 트롤들은 아직 그 길을 몰라요. 셰르파가 만들어 준 지도를 드릴게요.

english: I don't have the map on me.
You give Denulth the map of the secret way.
Excellent, this looks perfect. They will never see us coming.
translation: 훌륭하오, 완벽해 보이는구려. 놈들은 우리가 다가오는 걸 꿈에도 모를 거요.

english: Have you managed to open the equipment room?
I have opened the door but I don't have the combination on me.
translation: 문은 열었는데 지금 조합 번호를 안 갖고 있어요.

english: Yes! The door is open and here is the combination.
translation: 네! 문은 열렸고, 여기 조합 번호예요.

english: You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.
Well done citizen! We will reward you by training you in attack!
translation: 잘했소, 시민! 보답으로 그대에게 공격 훈련을 시켜 주겠소!

english: I shall present you with some steel fighting claws. In addition I shall show you the knowledge of creating the fighting claws for yourself.
translation: steel fighting claws(강철 격투 발톱)을 선물하겠소. 또한 격투 발톱을 직접 만드는 법도 가르쳐 주겠소.

english: You are now an honourary member of the Imperial Guard!
translation: 이제 그대는 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)의 명예 대원이오!

english: Quest complete!
Welcome back friend!
How goes your fight with the trolls?
I'm afraid I have bad news. We made our attack as planned, but we met unexpected resistance.
translation: 안타깝게도 나쁜 소식이 있소. 계획대로 공격했지만 예상치 못한 저항에 부딪혔소.

english: What happened?
We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request, we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
translation: 북쪽에서 내려온 트롤들에게 기습을 당했소. 그대의 부탁으로 입대시킨 Dunstan(던스턴)의 아들 Godric(고드릭)이 놈들에게 붙잡혔소. 뒤쫓아 보았지만 놈들의 요새 아래에서 격퇴당하고 말았소.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: The way tto the stronghold is treacherous, friend. Even if you manage to climb your way up, there will be many trolls defending the stronghold.
translation: 요새로 가는 길은 험난하오, 친구. 설령 기어 올라간다 해도 요새를 지키는 트롤이 수두룩할 거요.

english: I'll get Godric back!
God speed friend! I would send some of my me with you, but none of them are brave enough to follow.
translation: 무운을 비오, 친구! 부하들을 딸려 보내고 싶지만, 그대를 따라갈 만큼 용감한 자가 하나도 없구려.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
See you about Denulth!
God speed friend!
How are you getting on with rescuing Godric?
I haven't found a way to climb up yet.
Hurry, friend! Who knows what they'll do with Godric?
translation: 서두르시오, 친구! 놈들이 Godric(고드릭)에게 무슨 짓을 할지 누가 알겠소?

english: I've got some climbing boots.
Then hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 그럼 서두르시오, 친구! 아직 여기서 뭘 하고 있소?

english: I've found my way into the stronghold!
Hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 서두르시오, 친구! 아직 여기서 뭘 하고 있소?

english: I've found my way into the prison.
...and?
That's all.
Hurry, friend! Find a way to free Godric!
translation: 서두르시오, 친구! Godric(고드릭)을 풀어 줄 방법을 찾으시오!

english: I have freed Godric!
Oh, what great news! You should hurry to tell Dunstan, he will be overjoyed!
translation: 오, 정말 반가운 소식이오! 어서 Dunstan(던스턴)에게 알려 주시오. 무척 기뻐할 거요!
