english: We are busy preparing for an attack by night. Godric knows of a secret entrance to the stronghold. Once we destroy the stronghold Burthorpe will be safe! Friend, we are indebted to you!
translation: 우리는 야간 공격을 준비하느라 바쁘오. Godric(고드릭)이 요새로 들어가는 비밀 입구를 알고 있소. 요새만 무너뜨리면 Burthorpe(버소프)는 안전해질 거요! 친구, 우리는 그대에게 큰 빚을 졌소!

english: Good luck!
Do you have any quests for me?
Yes.
No.
What is this place?
You can't, thanks.
Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
translation: 제가 하고 있는 퀘스트가 뭐였는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: I thought the White Knights controlled Asgarnia?
translation: Asgarnia(아스가르니아)는 White Knights(백기사단)이 장악하고 있는 줄 알았는데요?

english: That's all, thanks.
How goes your fight with the trolls?
See you about Denulth!
Learn to Read!
Oh!
The plants! They're alive!
The doors won't stay closed forever!
translation: 문은 영원히 닫혀 있지 않을 거야!

english: They came from the ground! They came from the ground!!!
Round and round and round and round!
Time is running out! She will rise again!!!
translation: 시간이 얼마 없어! 그녀가 다시 깨어날 거야!!!

english: They're cheering! Why are they cheering?
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: 안 돼, 이 돌대가리야! 인간은 우리 친구라고!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: 친구라고까지 부르기엔 좀 그렇지... 물론 적도 아니지만.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: 막 뭘 하려는데 곡괭이 날이 무뎌진 걸 알았을 때만 빼면-

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: 그리고 난 Miodvetnir(미오드베트니르). 얘들은 내 형제들이야. 그러는 넌 누구지?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
translation: 거 참, 여기 아래서 인갼을 보는 건 진짜 드문 일인데!

english: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: 인간이라니까, 이 쇳대가리야! 정신 좀 차려!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: 저기, 드워프분들께 몇 가지 여쭤봐도 될까요?

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: 물론이지, 우린 질문에 대답하는 거 엄청 좋아해!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
translation: 우린 질문에 대답하는 데 아주 선수라고!

english: Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: 아니면 그냥 수다 떨러 들른 거야?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
translation: 이 강을 따라 내려가면 뭐가 있어요?

english: Oh, you don't know?
[He/she] doesn't know?
[He/she] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
translation: 저를 거기 데려가 주실 수 있어요?

english: Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: 늘 바쁘게 지내라, 우리 훌륭하신 아버지께서 늘 하시던 말씀이지.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: 게다가 요즘 도시에서 이상한 일이 좀 벌어지고 있어.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
translation: [him/her]한테 그런 말 하지 마! [his/her] 알 바 아니잖아!

english: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: [he/she] 도시에 가고 싶어 한다면 알려 주는 게 공평하지.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: 아, 그렇지. 지난번 그 자잘한 사건 뒤처리도 이제 막 끝났잖아.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: 그러니까 혹시라도 도시에 가게 되면 조심해! 이상한 일이 생길지도 모르니까!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 데 있어요?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
translation: 가만, 너 Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언) 아니야?

english: That must be why you were talking about fish then...
But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
translation: 그런데 여기 이 물은 말이야, 위에서 뚝뚝 떨어져 내려온 거라고.

english: Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: 아, 그건 물속에 사는 작고 꿈틀거리는 거야.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: 그런데 다 작은 건 아니야! 큰 놈도 있다고!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 그래도 [player name] 쪽이 훨씬 잘 알려 줄 수 있을걸! 뭐니 뭐니 해도 [he's/she's] Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언)이잖아!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 사실 이 광산은 채광 Consortium(컨소시엄)에 속한 8대 회사 중 한 곳의 영역이야.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 채광 회사요? 그 회사들은 어디에 있어요?

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 우린 물건을 전부 배로 도시까지 실어 나르거든.

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 그래도 강이 도시까지 곧장 이어져 있으니 이것도 똑같이 편해.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 광산 아래에 있는 이 바위 문제 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 절대 안 깨지는 것 같아요. 왜 그런지 알아야겠어요.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
translation: 그 절대 안 깨지는 커다란 바위?

english: That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: [he/she] 방금 그렇게 말했잖아? 정신 좀 차려!

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
translation: 오, 유감이지만 거긴 못 뚫을 거야.

english: It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: 거기 붙어 있은 지 얼마나 됐지, Miotvednir(미오드베트니르)?

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
translation: 18년이야, Derni(더니). 한 해도 모자람 없이 꽉 채운 18년!

english: That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
translation: 그런데 그래서 얻은 게 뭔지 봐.

english: Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 그 바위를 깨려면 어떤 재료가 필요할까요? 그 왜, 절대 안 뚫리는 거요.

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 음... rune pickaxe(룬 곡괭이)는 써 봤어?

english: An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 그런 건 다들 제일 먼저 해 봤을 거라는 생각 안 들어?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad(롤라드)라는 사람 아세요? 드워프 학자 같은 사람이요.

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 아, 인간 좀 그만 놀려, Dernu(더누)!

english: Do you know where he is right now?
No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 저를 cannon(대포)로 쏘아 보내고 싶대요!

english: Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 제가 정말로 바위를 뚫고 날아가서 반대편에 착지할 거라고 생각하나 봐요.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
translation: 내 생각엔 너 머리 다칠 거야.

english: Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸) 영감이 드디어 정신이 나갔나 봐.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있어요?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 난 사악한 악마랑 마주치면 도망칠 거야.

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 몰라, 사악한 악마는 만나 본 적이 없으니까.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 착한 악마는 한 번 만나 봤는데.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 오, 그래? 그 악마가 뭐라고 했는데?

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 나한테 퍼즐 상자를 하나 주더니 그냥 가 버렸어.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 너 dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트)를 너무 많이 마셨던 거 아니야?

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 그럴지도, 그럴지도. 하지만 누가 알겠어, 안 그래?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 한 번이라도 좀 정신 차려, Dernu(더누)! Dondakan(돈다칸)의 바위잖아!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 정말 인상적인데, Player. 어떻게 해낸 거야?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 당연히 [his/her/their] 엄청난 힘으로 해냈겠지!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 아니, 넌 레인저 쪽이잖아, 안 그래, Player?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 물론 오늘 밤에. 지금 말고. 지금은 근무 중이니까.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 그래... 그리고 그 바위가 깨졌으니 곧 여기 오가는 사람도 늘겠지.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 이 인간 앞에서 회사 일 얘기는 하지 마, Dernu(더누).

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 이 조각상 일로 도움이 좀 필요해요... 정확히는 King Alvis(알비스 왕)의 조각상이요.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 쓰러졌잖아, 기억 안 나? 조각이 우리 머리 위로 떨어질 뻔했잖아?

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 그 조각가가 저한테 물건을 잔뜩 찾아오라고 시켰거든요.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 나 예전에 퍼즐 상자를 받은 적이 있어, 알아?

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 그럼 됐어. 듣기 싫으면 입 다물게.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 음, 이제 조각가가 머리만 만들면 돼요. 그런데 그러려면 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 도움을 받아야 해요.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 이야, 너 드워프 세계에서 아주 출세하고 있구나, 응?

english: What do you need us for then?
We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 자자, Derni(더니), 그런 말은 할 필요 없잖아.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 제가 [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 당연히 진짜지! 아니면 Player가 그런 말을 했겠어? [he/she/they] 그럴 리 없잖아?

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 그리고 Blasidar(블라시다르)가 조각상 작업하는 거 못 봤어?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 아, 맞아. 꽤 오랫동안 저기 나가 있었지.

english: That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 우리 모두 그의 성실함과 집념을 본받아야 해.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 그러고 보니, 우리도 슬슬 일하러 가야 하지 않아?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 그렇지. 더 필요한 거 있어, Player?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 혹시 이 drunken dwarf(술 취한 드워프)에 대해 아세요...?

english: Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
translation: 그럼, 술 취한 드워프 하나 알지!

english: In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 그런데 진짜 짜증 나는 드워프가 하나 있는데, 가끔 이유도 없이 나한테 돌을 던져.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 제가 말하는 건 그 드워프의 친척인데, Keldagrim(켈다그림) 북동쪽에 살아요. 그 사람 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 네 말이 맞겠지. 음, 그 친구는 케밥 얘기를 엄청 하는 술 취한 드워프야.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 그리고 듣자 하니 아까 내가 말한 그 드워프의 친척이래.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 절대 잊을 수 없는 이야기가 있어요!

english: A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 그러니까, 예전에 내가 광산에서 spanner(스패너)를 잃어버린 적이 있는데...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 그래도 내 스패너 얘기... 진짜 재밌는 이야기라니까.

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 저기요, 제 이야기 들을 거예요, 말 거예요?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 그럼 그것도 금방 잊어버릴 만한 이야기였나 보네.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
translation: 이 강을 따라 내려가면 뭐가 있어요?

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 데 있어요?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 이 바위 문제 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 그 바위를 깨려면 어떤 재료가 필요할까요?

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 저를 cannon(대포)로 쏘아 보내고 싶대요!

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있어요?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
translation: 이 조각상 일로 도움이 좀 필요해요...

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: 제가 [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 혹시 이 drunken dwarf(술 취한 드워프)에 대해 아세요...?

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 절대 잊을 수 없는 이야기가 있어요!

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: 아니, 이 돌대가리야! 인간은 우리 친구라고!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: 친구라고까지 하긴 좀 그렇지... 물론 적도 아니지만.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: 곡괭이 날이 무뎌진 걸 알아차리는 것만 빼면 말이지, 그것도 하필 막-

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: 그리고 난 Miodvetnir(미오드베트니르)예요. 얘들은 내 형제들이고요. 그쪽은 누구신가요?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
translation: 이야, 이 아래서 인감을 보는 일은 흔치 않은데요!

english: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: 인간이야, 이 쇠대가리야! 정신 좀 똑바로 차려!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: 저, 드워프 분들께 몇 가지 여쭤봐도 될까요?

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: 물론이죠, 우린 질문에 답하는 걸 좋아해요!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: 아니면 그냥 수다 떨러 들른 거예요?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
translation: 이 강을 따라 내려가면 뭐가 있어요?

english: Oh, you don't know?
[He/She] doesn't know?
[He/She] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: 항상 바쁘게 살아라, 우리 아버지가 입버릇처럼 하시던 말씀이죠.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: 게다가 요즘 도시에서 이상한 일들이 좀 있었어요.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
translation: [him/her]한테 그런 말 하지 마! [his/her] 알 바 아니잖아!

english: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: [he/she]가 도시에 가고 싶다면 알려 주는 게 공평하지.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: 아 맞아요, 지난번 그 작은 사건 뒤처리를 겨우 끝냈다더라고요.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: 그러니 혹시 도시에 가게 되면 조심하세요! 이상한 일이 생길지도 몰라요!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 곳 있어요?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
translation: 가만, 그쪽이 Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언) 아니에요?

english: That must be why you were talking about fish then...
But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
translation: 그런데 여기 이 물은 말이죠, 위에서 똑똑 떨어져 내려오는 거예요.

english: Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: 아, 물속에 사는 작고 꼼지락거리는 녀석들이야.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: 그런데 다 작은 건 아니야! 큰 놈도 있다고!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 하지만 [player name]님이 다 알려 줄 수 있을 거야! 어쨌든 [he's/she's] Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언)이니까!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 사실 이 광산은 채광 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 8대 회사 중 한 곳의 구역이에요.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 광산 회사요? 그 회사들은 어디 있는데요?

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 우린 물건을 전부 배로 도시까지 실어 나르거든요.

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 그래도 강이 도시까지 곧장 이어져 있어서 이쪽도 그만큼 편해요.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 광산 아래에 있는 이 바위 말인데요, 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 절대 안 깨지는 것 같아요. 왜 그런지 알아야 해요.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 그 바위를 깨려면 어떤 재료가 필요할까요? 그 절대 안 뚫리는 바위 말이에요.

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 글쎄요... rune pickaxe(룬 곡괭이)는 써 봤어요?

english: An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 그런 건 제일 먼저 해 봤을 거라는 생각 안 들어?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad(롤라드)라는 분 아세요? 드워프 학자 같은 분이라던데요.

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 아휴, 인간 좀 그만 놀려, Dernu(더누)!

english: Do you know where he is right now?
No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 절 대포에 넣고 쏘려고 해요!

english: Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 제가 정말로 날아가서 바위 너머에 내려앉을 거라고 생각하나 봐요.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸) 영감이 드디어 정신이 나갔나 봐.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있을까요?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 난 사악한 악마랑 마주치면 도망칠 거예요.

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 몰라, 사악한 악마는 만나 본 적이 없거든.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 난 착한 악마는 한 번 만나 봤는데.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 오 그래, 그 악마가 뭐라고 했는데?

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 퍼즐 상자를 하나 주더니 그냥 가 버렸어.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 너 dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트)를 너무 많이 마셨던 거 아니야?

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 그럴 수도 있지, 그럴 수도. 그래도 누가 알겠어?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 이번엔 좀 집중해, Dernu(더누)! Dondakan(돈다칸)의 바위잖아!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 정말 인상적이네요, Player. 어떻게 해낸 거예요?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 그걸 질문이라고 해? 당연히 [his/her/their] 엄청난 힘으로지!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 아니야, 그쪽은 레인저에 더 가깝죠, Player?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 물론 오늘 밤에. 지금 말고. 지금은 근무 중이니까.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 그래... 그 바위가 깨졌으니 여기 오가는 사람도 곧 늘겠지.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 이 인간 앞에서 회사 일 얘기하지 마, Dernu(더누).

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 이 조각상 때문에 도움이 필요해요... 정확히 말하면 King Alvis(알비스 왕)의 조각상이요.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 그거 쓰러졌잖아, 기억 안 나? 조각이 우리 머리 위로 떨어질 뻔했잖아?

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 조각가가 저한테 이것저것 물건을 많이 구해 오라고 해서요.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 나 예전에 퍼즐 상자 하나 받은 적 있거든요?

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 그럼 됐어. 듣기 싫다면 입 다물게.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 이제 조각가가 머리만 만들면 돼요. 그런데 그러려면 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 도움을 받아야 해요.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
What do you need us for then?
We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 자자, Derni(더니), 그런 말은 할 필요 없잖아.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 당연히 정말이지! 그게 아니면 Player가 그런 말을 했겠어? [he/she/they]는 그런 사람이 아니잖아!

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 그리고 Blasidar(블라시다르)가 조각상 작업하는 거 못 봤어?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 아 맞다, 꽤 오랫동안 저기 나가 있었지.

english: That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 다들 그 성실함과 헌신을 본받아야 해.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 그 말 나온 김에, 우리도 이제 일하러 가야 하지 않아?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 그러게. 또 필요한 거 있어요, Player?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 이 술 취한 드워프에 대해 아세요...?

english: Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 근데 진짜 짜증 나는 드워프가 하나 있는데, 가끔 이유도 없이 나한테 돌을 던져요.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 제가 말하는 건 그 드워프의 친척인데, Keldagrim(켈다그림) 북동쪽에 살아요. 그 사람 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 그래, 네 말이 맞아. 음, 그 드워프는 케밥 얘기를 자주 하는 술꾼이에요.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 그리고 아까 내가 말한 그 드워프의 친척인 걸로 알아요.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 그러니까, 예전에 내가 광산에서 스패너를 잃어버렸을 때 말인데...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 하지만 내 스패너... 그거 정말 재밌는 이야기라고.

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 저기요, 제 이야기 들으실 거예요, 말 거예요?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 그럼 그것도 금방 잊어버릴 만한 얘기였나 보네요.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
translation: 이 강을 따라 내려가면 뭐가 있어요?

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 곳 있어요?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 이 바위 때문에 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 그 바위를 깨려면 어떤 재료가 필요할까요?

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 절 대포에 넣고 쏘려고 해요!

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있을까요?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 이 술 취한 드워프에 대해 아세요...?

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
Good day, Your Highness. Can I help you with anything?
Can I use your anvil?
Of course, Your Royal Highness.
Nothing, thanks.
Can I use your anvil?
Nothing, thanks.
You look ready for combat.
translation: 싸울 준비가 다 되신 것 같네요.

english: Aye, indeed I am.
What brings you to this place? I can't imagine anyone coming here by choice.
translation: 여긴 무슨 일로 오셨어요? 좋아서 여기 올 사람은 없을 것 같은데요.

english: You're right, I did not come here by choice. I came here for vengeance.
translation: 맞소, 좋아서 온 게 아니오. 복수하러 왔소.

english: Vengeance? Against whom? Did someone take your gardening equipment?
translation: 복수요? 누구한테요? 누가 원예 도구라도 훔쳐 갔어요?

english: My mission is not against another man and I will not have it mocked.
translation: 내 사명은 사람을 향한 것이 아니오. 그리고 그걸 조롱하는 건 용납하지 않겠소.

english: Okay, sorry, I was just trying to lighten the mood. Care to tell me what it is against then?
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 분위기 좀 풀어 보려던 거예요. 그럼 상대가 뭔지 말해 주실래요?

english: Callisto, the great bear of the wilderness.
Can't say I've come across it before.
I'm not surprised, you'd do well to avoid him. Callisto is a great bear, his strength and size enhanced by the corruption of the Wilderness.
translation: 그럴 테지. 그놈은 피하는 게 좋을 거요. Callisto(칼리스토)는 거대한 곰인데, Wilderness(황야)의 타락으로 힘과 덩치가 더 커졌소.

english: Ah, I've had a few run ins with him myself.
translation: 아, 저도 몇 번 마주친 적 있어요.

english: Then you'll know he's not something to mock. I'm surprised you survived your encounter with such a great and corrupted beast.
translation: 그렇다면 그놈이 우습게 볼 상대가 아니란 걸 알겠군. 그렇게 거대하고 타락한 짐승을 만나고도 살아남았다니 놀랍소.

english: I'm stronger than I look, I've seen my fair share of monsters.
translation: 보기보다 강하거든요. 괴물이라면 저도 볼 만큼 봤어요.

english: Why are you so intent on taking him down?
Callisto killed my father. After hearing of a great beast in the heart of the Wilderness, he took it upon himself to bring him down.
translation: Callisto(칼리스토)가 내 아버지를 죽였소. Wilderness(황야) 한복판에 거대한 짐승이 있다는 소문을 듣고, 아버지는 직접 그놈을 잡겠다고 나서셨소.

english: He left our family home in Hosidius to hunt it down and...
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)에 있는 우리 집을 떠나 그놈을 사냥하러 가셨는데...

english: ... I haven't seen my father since. I swore I would avenge him and have dedicated my whole life to training for that moment.
translation: ... 그 뒤로 아버지를 다시는 보지 못했소. 나는 복수를 맹세했고, 그날을 위해 평생을 수련에 바쳤소.

english: What happens after? When you do take Callisto down that is.
Oh... uh... I never thought about that...
translation: 아... 어... 그건 생각해 본 적이 없소...

english: My whole life has been spent preparing to avenge my father, I never thought about anything else...
translation: 평생을 아버지의 복수를 준비하는 데만 썼으니, 다른 건 생각해 본 적이 없었소...

english: You seem like you've got a lot to think about then. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 생각할 게 많아 보이시네요. 혼자 생각하시게 둘게요.

english: Hey. Do you know anything about this?
Ah, a fellow marksman. That's a unique bow you have there.
translation: 아, 동료 사수로군. 특이한 활을 가지고 있구려.

english: Do you know anything about it?
I've done my fair bit of fletching in my day. I'd say this bow can be improved upon.
translation: 나도 한때 활 제작을 꽤 했었소. 이 활은 더 개량할 수 있을 것 같군.

english: See those etches on it? You could put something sharp in there to improve the bow's strength.
translation: 여기 새겨진 홈들 보이시오? 저기에 날카로운 걸 끼우면 활의 위력을 높일 수 있을 거요.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a powerful enhancement like that.
translation: 흥미롭네요! 그런 강력한 강화 재료가 있는지 찾아볼게요.

english: Those look like strong fangs. You could probably attach them to a bow to make it stronger.
translation: 튼튼한 송곳니 같군. 활에 붙이면 더 강해질 것 같소.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for a suitable bow.
translation: 흥미롭네요! 쓸 만한 활이 있는지 찾아볼게요.

english: Perhaps I could use this?
Yes. Those look like they could be attached to the weapon.
translation: 그렇소. 그거라면 무기에 붙일 수 있을 것 같군.

english: Could you combine them?
Sure I can. For the right price.
translation: 물론 할 수 있소. 값만 맞는다면.

english: Sigh. How much?
500,000 coins would do nicely.
I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
Are those... Bear claws?
Yeah. I got them from a really big bear.
By the gods... This bear must be even bigger than I imagined.
translation: 맙소사... 그 곰은 내가 생각했던 것보다도 훨씬 크겠군.

english: So do you know if the claws would be useful at all?
translation: 그래서 이 발톱이 쓸모가 있을지 아세요?

english: I... have a lot to think about. Perhaps Andros Mai over there can help you while I think.
translation: 나는... 생각할 게 많아졌소. 내가 생각하는 동안 저기 있는 Andros Mai(안드로스 마이)가 도와줄 수 있을 거요.

english: Thanks!
That looks like any skull to me. Who's is it?
translation: 내가 보기엔 그냥 평범한 해골인데. 누구 거요?

english: It's mine. I picked it up.
I meant... Sigh. Never mind. What do you want with the skull?
translation: 내 말은... 하아. 됐소. 그 해골로 뭘 하려는 거요?

english: I'm trying to find out if it's useful.
Don't know much about skulls, myself. That mage over there might know.
translation: 나는 해골에 대해선 잘 모르오. 저기 있는 마법사라면 알지도 모르지.

english: She's into some weird stuff, that one. Think she said her name was Phabelle Bile.
translation: 그 여자, 좀 이상한 걸 파고드는 사람이오. 이름이 Phabelle Bile(파벨 바일)이라고 했던 것 같소.

english: No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 아. 더 잘 알 만한 사람은 없을까요?

english: Just earlier I saw this lady run down into the basement of this pub.
translation: 아까 웬 여자가 이 술집 지하실로 뛰어 내려가는 걸 봤소.

english: I don't know who she is, but she looks like a strange one.
translation: 누군지는 모르지만 좀 이상해 보이는 사람이었소.

english: Strange attracts strange, so I reckon she might know about your strange weapon piece.
translation: 이상한 건 이상한 걸 끌어당기는 법이니, 그 여자라면 당신의 이상한 무기 조각에 대해 알지도 모르오.

english: You look ready for combat.
translation: 싸울 준비가 다 되신 것 같네요.

english: Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
You're a long way from home, traveller! How about some food to keep you going?
translation: 집에서 먼 길을 오셨네요, 여행자님! 기운 내시게 음식 좀 드릴까요?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
I'll be here if you find yourself hungry!
translation: 배고프면 언제든 오세요, 전 여기 있을게요!

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Can I go in the Arboretum?
Yes. Now leave me alone.
translation: 그래. 이제 나 좀 내버려 둬.

english: Yes?
What are you serving?
Blood.
Is that it?
Yes, by the pint. Now, do you want one or not?
translation: 그래, 파인트 단위로. 자, 마실 거야 말 거야?

english: Sure.
Two coins.
Oh dear, I don't seem to have enough money.
Clear off then.
I'll pass.
What are you selling?
To you? Nothing.
Why?
You're new here. I don't sell to new blood. Make a name for yourself and maybe I'll reconsider.
translation: 넌 여기 새 피잖아. 난 새 피한텐 안 팔아. 이름 좀 알리고 오면 다시 생각해 보지.

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Sure.
I'll pass.
So can I go in now?
Yes! Now get out of my sight!
Good morning.
Sorry, but this is NOT a good morning!
Why, what's the matter?
I'm going to lose my job!
What have you done to deserve that?
Nothing! But the Piscatoris Fishing Colony is going to go out of business, and I'll have to go back to the east.
translation: 아무 짓도 안 했어요! 그런데 Piscatoris Fishing Colony(피스카토리스 어업 개척지)가 문을 닫게 생겨서, 저는 동쪽으로 돌아가야 할 판이에요.

english: Oh dear.
If you want to help, you can get Kathy to take you up to the Colony. Herman's looking for someone to run an important errand for him.
translation: 도와주고 싶으면 Kathy(캐시)한테 개척지까지 데려다 달라고 하세요. Herman(허먼)이 중요한 심부름을 해 줄 사람을 찾고 있거든요.

english: I'll bear it in mind.
Hello! What can I do for you?
How are things going for the Colony now the trolls have all gone away?
translation: 트롤들이 다 사라졌는데 개척지는 요즘 어때요?

english: Well, it's been fairly quiet around here, but there's always repair work to keep us busy.
translation: 음, 이 근처는 꽤 조용해졌어요. 그래도 수리할 일은 늘 있어서 바쁘게 지내요.

english: Catching plenty of fish?
Oh yes, lots of them. Their population's been swelling ever since you wiped out the trolls in the area. They've hardly got any natural predators now.
translation: 아, 그럼요, 엄청 많아요. 당신이 이 지역 트롤을 싹 쓸어버린 뒤로 물고기 수가 계속 늘고 있어요. 이제 천적이 거의 없거든요.

english: Oh... I suppose that's good...
I was just wondering what you're doing.
Franklin's got me fixing this wall. You did a pretty good patch-job, but it could do with some work.
translation: Franklin(프랭클린)이 이 벽을 고치라고 해서요. 당신이 땜질을 꽤 잘해 놓긴 했는데, 손 좀 더 봐야겠더라고요.

english: I'm not surprised - iron sheets won't last any time at all with all that salt water around.
translation: 그럴 만도 하죠. 사방이 바닷물이라 철판은 금방 못 쓰게 될 거예요.

english: Yes, that's right. I'll probably get Arnold to order some fancy protective paint from the dwarves.
translation: 맞아요. 아마 Arnold(아널드)한테 드워프들한테서 고급 방청 페인트를 주문해 달라고 할 것 같아요.

english: Good luck with that.
You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: 여기 문이 전부 열린 채로 안 닫히는 거 아세요?

english: Yes, the salt does terrible things to the hinges. I've been meaning to deal with them, but I never seem to get around to it.
translation: 네, 소금기 때문에 경첩이 엉망이 돼요. 손봐야지 하면서도 도무지 짬이 안 나네요.

english: Fair enough.
Nothing, I'm fine.
Enjoy your fishing.
How are things going for the Colony?
What are you doing?
You know all your doors get stuck open?
translation: 여기 문이 전부 열린 채로 안 닫히는 거 아세요?

english: Nothing, I'm fine.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우?  우우우 우우 우우우우우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우! 우우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데요, 진짜로: 저 엄청엄청 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 수는 없다고들 하잖아요. 그래도 가끔은 은행 계좌를 열어서 제가 가진 걸 전부 쭉 보면서 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋더라고요:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 자, 우리처럼 부자인 산 사람들은 당신 같은 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 시간 낭비할 여유가 없거든요. 전 너무너무 부자라서 이제 가 봐야 해요. 어쩌면 더 부자가 될지도 모르고요.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 네, 저도 그 얘기 들었어요, 하하하!

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
translation: 음, 재밌었어요. 언제 또 이렇게 놀아요.

english: Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 그게 늘 맞는 말이겠죠. 또 봐요, 이상한 투명 죽은 사람 씨!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘진 않은데 저는 익힌 닭고기가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도 모르지만, 집에서 구운 파이만 한 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 그래요? 전혀 몰랐네요. 음, 전 이만 가 봐야겠어요. 또 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너희들 살아남을 기회 없다 너희의 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
translation: 너희들의 기지는 모두 우리의 것이 되었다 이다.

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 저한테 그런 식으로 말해도 된다고 생각하지 마요!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 제가 당신을 해칠 방법을 못 찾을 거라 생각하지 마요, 유령 양반!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아뇨, 거긴 평생 가 본 적도 없고 갔을 때 뭘 훔친 적은 더더욱 없어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 지금 저를 거짓말쟁이라고 하는 거예요?!?! 전 평생 아무것도 훔친 적이 없어요. 그리고 제가 남이 힘들게 번

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 돈을 주머니에서 슬쩍할 만큼 도덕적으로 타락한 인간이라는 암시는 정말 불쾌하네요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 케이크도요. 모피도요. 몇 번이고. 한참 동안 계속.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나오신다면 이 일에 대해선 더 할 말이 없네요. 그럼 좋은 하루 되세요!

english: Hello Dhalak.
You see my form, hear my words, and know my name, yet your face I recognise not...
translation: 그대는 내 모습을 보고, 내 말을 듣고, 내 이름까지 아는데, 나는 그대의 얼굴을 알아보지 못하겠소...

english: Be you some mighty sorcerer to bind me so?
translation: 그대는 나를 이렇게 묶어 두는 강대한 마법사라도 되오?

english: Um... Well, not really...
Well, I don't mean to brag, but I guess I am with my level 99 magic...
translation: 음, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데, magic(마법) 레벨 99니까 그렇다고 할 수도 있겠네요...

english: But that is besides the point. It is not I who has trapped you here as a ghost.
translation: 하지만 그건 중요한 게 아니에요. 당신을 유령으로 여기 가둔 건 제가 아니에요.

english: Then how comes it to be that you know my name stranger?
translation: 그렇다면 어찌하여 그대가 내 이름을 아는 것이오, 낯선 이여?

english: Lennissa told me about you, and where to find you?
translation: Lennissa(레니사)가 당신에 대해, 그리고 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줬어요.

english: Lennissa? Oh that poor sweet girl... Has my foolishness cursed her as well as myself???
translation: Lennissa(레니사)? 오, 그 가엾고 착한 아이... 나의 어리석음이 나뿐 아니라 그 아이까지 저주에 빠뜨렸단 말이오???

english: Your foolishness?
The story shames me stranger, I wouldst rather keep it unto myself.
translation: 그 이야기는 부끄럽기 그지없소, 낯선 이여. 차라리 내 가슴속에 묻어 두고 싶소.

english: Look, I don't want to force you into telling me, but perhaps sharing it with someone might relieve your guilt?
translation: 억지로 말하게 하고 싶진 않지만, 누군가에게 털어놓으면 죄책감이 좀 덜어질지도 모르잖아요?

english: Aye... Perhaps it might at that.
So what has Lennissa told you of the events of the day this curse befell me?
translation: 그래, 이 저주가 내게 닥친 그날의 일에 대해 Lennissa(레니사)가 그대에게 무어라 하였소?

english: Well, she told me that she was working as an undercover agent of Saradomin amongst the followers of some 'Empty Lord', and when news of the theft of a god-weapon reached her, she passed the message on to
translation: 음, 그녀는 'Empty Lord(공허의 군주)'라는 자를 따르는 무리 속에서 Saradomin(사라도민)의 비밀 요원으로 일하고 있었는데, 신의 무기가 도난당했다는 소식을 듣자 그 소식을

english: you instead of taking it to Saradomin because she was scared her cover might be blown.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)에게 가져가는 대신 당신에게 넘겼다고 했어요. 정체가 탄로 날까 봐 두려워서요.

english: Aye, that is a fair account of events...
But I don't understand why you didn't take her message to Saradomin?
translation: 그런데 왜 당신은 그 소식을 Saradomin(사라도민)에게 전하지 않았는지 모르겠어요.

english: Stranger, my foolishness was a result of my respect for Saradomin, not as a result of any attempted treachery!
translation: 낯선 이여, 나의 어리석음은 Saradomin(사라도민)을 향한 공경에서 비롯된 것이지, 배신하려는 마음에서 나온 것이 아니오!

english: So why didn't you pass on Lennissa's message? As I understand it something happened with that staff that could have been avoided if you had passed her message on!
translation: 그럼 왜 Lennissa(레니사)의 소식을 전하지 않은 거예요? 제가 알기로는 당신이 소식을 전했더라면 그 지팡이와 관련된 무슨 일을 막을 수 있었다던데요!

english: (sigh) I know not what occurred with that god-weapon, but I have my suspicions...
translation: (한숨) 그 신의 무기에 무슨 일이 있었는지는 나도 모르오. 하지만 짚이는 바는 있소...

english: Let me explain myself. I was Lennissa's immediate superior, and I was often her contact for missions.
translation: 내 사정을 설명하겠소. 나는 Lennissa(레니사)의 직속 상관이었고, 임무에서 그 아이와 연락을 맡는 일이 잦았소.

english: Because of this role, I had access to a larger picture of what was happening than she herself did, and I was not only well aware that her presence amongst the enemy camp had been detected, but I was also well aware that
translation: 그 역할 덕분에 나는 그 아이보다 사정을 더 넓게 볼 수 있었소. 적진에 있는 그 아이의 존재가 이미 발각되었다는 것도 잘 알고 있었고, 또한

english: there was a growing faction amongst them who were plotting to overthrow their master.
translation: 그들 사이에서 주인을 무너뜨리려 음모를 꾸미는 세력이 커지고 있다는 것도 잘 알고 있었소.

english: Their master being...?
That I will not tell you. I will tempt the fates no more than I already have done.
translation: 그것만은 말할 수 없소. 이미 운명을 시험한 것으로 충분하오.

english: But anyway, it had come to my attention that the Mahjarrat who had been liberated from the control of Icthlarin did not much appreciate one form of slavery to another, and under the leadership of the mighty
translation: 아무튼, Icthlarin(익스라린)의 지배에서 풀려난 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)들이 한 노예 상태에서 다른 노예 상태로 옮겨 간 것을 그리 달가워하지 않는다는 사실을 알게 되었소. 그들은 강대한

english: Zamorak were making plans to overthrow their master and take his power for themselves.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)의 지휘 아래 주인을 무너뜨리고 그 힘을 차지할 계획을 세우고 있었소.

english: Now, as powerful, long-lived and evil as they were, they were still just mortal, and I made the decision that it would be of benefit to my Lord Saradomin for his mightiest rival to be distracted by such internal conflicts.
translation: 그들이 아무리 강하고, 오래 살고, 사악하다 해도 결국 필멸자에 불과했소. 그래서 나는 내 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)의 가장 강력한 맞수가 그런 내분에 정신이 팔리는 편이 주군께 이롭겠다고 판단했소.

english: So that is why you decided not to pass the report from Lennissa on?
translation: 그래서 Lennissa(레니사)의 보고를 전하지 않기로 한 거군요?

english: Yes, but my guilt is more than simply inaction...
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 내 죄는 그저 손을 놓고 있었던 것만이 아니오...

english: I knew that with such a weapon, Zamorak would be capable of launching an attack that could actually stand a chance of success, but I also knew that he would never be able to get a chance to use it in a battle for
translation: 그런 무기만 있으면 Zamorak(자모락)이 실제로 승산 있는 공격을 펼칠 수 있으리라는 걸 알았소. 하지만 그가 전투에서 그것을 쓸 기회는 결코 얻지 못하리라는 것도 알았소.

english: being a god-weapon its very presence would have sung out to their leader.
translation: 신의 무기인 이상 그 존재만으로도 그들의 지도자에게 제 위치를 알리고 말았을 테니 말이오.

english: I'm guessing you did something about that, then?
translation: 그래서 당신이 거기에 뭔가 손을 썼군요?

english: Indeed I did. To my eternal shame, I decided that I would assist Zamorak and his henchmen in their battle, by secretly casting a spell of concealment upon the staff so that
translation: 그렇소. 영원히 부끄러울 일이지만, 나는 Zamorak(자모락)과 그 수하들의 싸움을 돕기로 했소. 그 지팡이에 몰래 은폐 마법을 걸어서

english: they might use it secretly against their master.
translation: 그들이 주인에게 몰래 그것을 쓸 수 있도록 말이오.

english: So Zamorak knew about this?
No, nobody except myself, and now you, knew that I cast such a spell....
translation: 아니오. 내가 그런 주문을 걸었다는 건 나 말고는, 그리고 이제 그대 말고는 아무도 몰랐소....

english: Had I known what a threat to my Lord Saradomin Zamorak would later become, I wouldst have taken the message to Saradomin immediately! Alas, it is all too easy to see your mistakes after you
translation: Zamorak(자모락)이 훗날 내 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)께 얼마나 큰 위협이 될지 알았더라면, 즉시 그 소식을 주군께 전했을 것이오! 아아, 실수란

english: have made them...
translation: 저지르고 난 뒤에야 너무도 쉽게 보이는 법이구려...

english: I'm confused. What exactly happened with this staff anyway? And why have all these various random people been cursed because of it?
translation: 헷갈리네요. 그 지팡이에 대체 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요? 그리고 왜 온갖 사람들이 그것 때문에 저주를 받은 거예요?

english: I cannot answer your question with anything other than my own suppositions, but I do know of one who might be able to, and if any man deserved to be cursed for their actions that day, it was he!
translation: 그대의 질문에는 내 추측 말고는 답할 것이 없소. 하지만 답할 수 있을 만한 자를 하나 알고 있소. 그날의 행동으로 저주받아 마땅한 자가 있다면, 바로 그자요!

english: Who are you speaking of?
His name was Viggora. He was an evil man, brutal and vicious, and deadly with a blade.
translation: 그자의 이름은 Viggora(비고라)였소. 잔혹하고 포악한 악인이었고, 칼을 다루는 솜씨가 치명적이었소.

english: He was one of the few humans Zamorak allowed to rise to a position of power amongst his rebels, possibly because he imitated those same qualities of Zamorak.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)이 반란군 안에서 권력을 쥐도록 허락한 몇 안 되는 인간 중 하나였소. 아마도 자모락의 바로 그 기질을 닮았기 때문일 것이오.

english: If anyone knows what Zamorak did with that god- weapon to have caused this curse to have befallen us, it would have been he, for he would have been fighting on Zamorak's very right hand side in their rebellion.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)이 그 신의 무기로 무슨 짓을 했기에 이 저주가 우리에게 내렸는지 아는 자가 있다면, 그자일 것이오. 반란에서 자모락의 바로 오른편에서 싸웠을 테니 말이오.

english: Please, if this curse can be lifted, find Viggora and find out what he has wrought upon us! I have no wealth nor magic to aid you, but take my hood as reward;
translation: 부탁하오. 이 저주를 풀 수 있다면 Viggora(비고라)를 찾아 그자가 우리에게 무슨 짓을 했는지 알아내 주시오! 그대를 도울 재물도 마법도 없지만, 보답으로 내 두건을 받아 주시오.

english: it has served me well these centuries past, and may bring you luck.
translation: 지난 수백 년간 나를 잘 지켜 주었으니, 그대에게도 행운을 가져다줄지 모르오.

english: Where would you suggest I look for Viggora?
Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... A rogue like him would probably flock to his own kind.
translation: 아, 사악한 검객 Viggora(비고라)라... 그런 도적이라면 아마 제 부류를 찾아 모여 있을 것이오.

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Perhaps he has returned to his castle in the dark lands?
translation: 아, 사악한 검객 Viggora(비고라)라... 어쩌면 어둠의 땅에 있는 자기 성으로 돌아갔을지도 모르오.

english: Ah, the evil swordsman Viggora... Paddewwa was where he fought many battles, perhaps he has returned to one of his old haunts?
translation: 아, 사악한 검객 Viggora(비고라)라... Paddewwa(파데와)는 그자가 숱한 전투를 치른 곳이오. 어쩌면 옛 소굴 중 한 곳으로 돌아갔을지도 모르오.

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데 별로 관심이 없네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Dhalak, where can I find the swordsman Viggora?
translation: Dhalak(달락), 검객 Viggora(비고라)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 주셨던 그 유령 로브를 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 나를 이곳에 붙잡아 둔 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양이오... 어느 것을 원하오?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Viggora.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Hello there.
Now then. Looking to buy some weaponry?
Let's trade.
No thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Let's trade.
No thanks

translation: 안녕하쇼, 파트너! 내 회전 접시 구경할래요? 아니면 축제 아이템을 돌려받고 싶어요?

english: Spinning plates?
That's right. There's a funny story behind them, their shipment was held up by thieves.
translation: 그렇죠. 그거에 얽힌 웃긴 얘기가 있어요. 배송 중에 도둑들한테 털렸거든요.

english: The crate was marked 'Dragon Plates'. Apparently they thought it was some kind of armour, when really it's just a plate with a dragon on it!
translation: 상자에 'Dragon Plates(드래곤 플레이트)'라고 적혀 있었어요. 도둑들은 무슨 플레이트 갑옷인 줄 알았나 본데, 사실은 드래곤 그림이 그려진 접시, 그러니까 플레이트일 뿐이었죠!

english: I'd like to check holiday items please!
Sure thing, let me just see what you're missing.
What else are you selling?
I'm fine, thanks.
Howdy there partner! You came at just the right time! I've got something for ya!
translation: 안녕하쇼, 파트너! 마침 딱 좋을 때 왔네요! 줄 게 있어요!

english: Oh really? What is it?
Well, I did some rooting around in my house and found this really neat hat.
translation: 그게 말이죠, 집을 좀 뒤적거리다가 끝내주는 모자를 하나 찾았지 뭐예요.

english: A hat? What sort of hat...
A banana hat! Would you like it?
Sure, I'll take the hat.
Looks like you've got no space for it, I'll hold onto it till you do. Just come to me to claim it.
translation: 넣을 자리가 없어 보이네요. 자리가 생길 때까지 내가 맡아 둘게요. 찾으러 오기만 하면 돼요.

english: There you go amigo, enjoy!
So what else can I do for you partner? Want to see my spinning plates? Or did ya want a holiday item back?
translation: 그럼 또 뭘 도와줄까요, 파트너? 내 회전 접시 구경할래요? 아니면 축제 아이템을 돌려받고 싶어요?

english: No thanks, I don't want it right now.
No problem amigo, come back to me to claim it if you change your mind.
translation: 문제없어요, 아미고. 마음 바뀌면 찾으러 와요.

english: Oh wow, you did it! Well done!
Thank you!
I was wondering when someone would complete this. I've been holding on to the reward for a while.
translation: 누가 언제쯤 이걸 끝낼까 궁금했거든요. 보상을 꽤 오래 맡아 두고 있었어요.

english: The being who gave it to me was... rather strange.
translation: 그걸 나한테 준 존재는... 좀 이상했어요.

english: What was their name?
They didn't say. But they did give me some sage advice before they left.
translation: 말 안 해 줬어요. 그래도 떠나기 전에 지혜로운 조언을 하나 해 줬죠.

english: What was it?
I don't remember exactly. Something about making the most of your time...
translation: 정확히는 기억이 안 나요. 타임을 최대한 잘 활용하라는 뭐 그런 거였는데...

english: Thyme!
Where?! I don't see any!
I... don't worry. Thank you for the reward, see you around!
translation: 아... 신경 쓰지 마요. 보상 고마워요, 또 봐요!

english: See you!
Spinning plates?
I'd like to check holiday items please!
What else are you selling?
I'm fine, thanks.
Yes.
No.
Hello. My name is Dimintheis, of the noble family Fitzharmon.
translation: 안녕하신가. 나는 귀족 가문 Fitzharmon(피츠하몬)의 Dimintheis(디민테이스)일세.

english: Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?
translation: 귀족이 왜 이런 허름한 곳에 살아요?

english: The King has taken my estate from me until such time as I can show my family crest to him.
translation: 내가 가문 문장을 보여 드릴 때까지 국왕께서 내 영지를 거둬 가셨네.

english: Why would he do that?

Well, there is a long standing rule of chivalry amongst the Varrockian aristocracy, where each noble family is in possession of a unique crest, which signifies the honour and lineage of the family. More than this
translation: 음, Varrock(바록) 귀족 사회에는 오래된 기사도 규율이 있네. 귀족 가문마다 가문의 명예와 혈통을 나타내는 고유한 문장을 지니고 있지. 하지만 그뿐만이

english: however, it also represents the lawful rights of each family to prove their ownership of their wealth and lands. If the family crest is lost, then the family's estate is handed over to the current monarch until the crest is
translation: 아니라, 문장은 각 가문이 재산과 영지의 소유를 증명할 합법적 권리를 뜻하기도 하네. 가문 문장을 잃어버리면 그 가문의 영지는 문장을 되찾을 때까지 현 군주에게

english: restored.

This dates back to the times when there was much in- fighting amongst the noble families and their clans, and was introduced as a way of reducing the bloodshed that was devestating the ranks of the ruling classes at that
translation: 이 규율은 귀족 가문과 그 일족들 사이에 내분이 잦던 시절로 거슬러 올라가네. 그 시절 지배 계층을 휩쓸던 유혈 사태를 줄이려고

english: time. When you captured a rival family's clan, you also captured their lands and wealth.
translation: 도입된 것이지. 경쟁 가문의 일족을 사로잡으면 그들의 영지와 재산도 차지하게 되었다네.

english: So where is this crest?
Well, my three sons took it with them many years ago when they rode out to fight in the war against the undead necromancer and his army in the battle to save Varrock.
translation: 음, 여러 해 전 내 세 아들이 Varrock(바록)을 구하는 전투에서 언데드 강령술사와 그 군대에 맞서 싸우러 떠날 때 그걸 가지고 갔네.

english: For many years I had assumed them all dead, as I had heard no word from them, but recently I heard word that my son Caleb is alive and well, and trying to earn his fortune as a great chef in the lands beyond White
translation: 오랫동안 아무 소식이 없어서 다들 죽었으리라 여겼네. 그런데 최근에 내 아들 Caleb(케일럽)이 살아 있고, White Wolf Mountain(흰 늑대 산) 너머의 땅에서

english: Wolf Mountain, although I know not where.
translation: 위대한 요리사로 성공하려 애쓰고 있다는 소식을 들었네. 다만 정확히 어디인지는 모르네.

english: Ok, I will help you.
I thank you greatly adventurer! Also... if you find Caleb... please... let him know his father still loves him...
translation: 정말 고맙네, 모험가! 그리고... 혹시 Caleb(케일럽)을 찾거든... 부디... 아비가 아직도 그 아이를 사랑한다고 전해 주게...

english: I'm not interested in that adventure right now.
I realise it was a lot to ask of a stranger.
translation: 낯선 이에게 부탁하기엔 너무 큰일이었나 보군.

english: You're rich then? Can I have some money?
Gah! Lousy beggar! Your sort is what's ruining this great land! Why don't you just go and get a job if you need money so badly?
translation: 에잇! 형편없는 거지 같으니! 자네 같은 부류가 이 위대한 땅을 망치고 있는 걸세! 그렇게 돈이 궁하면 가서 일자리나 구하지 그러나?

english: Hi, I am a bold adventurer.
An adventurer hmmm? How lucky. I may have an adventure for you. I desperately need my family crest returning to me. It is of utmost importance.
translation: 모험가라, 흐음? 운이 좋군. 자네에게 맡길 모험이 있을지도 모르겠네. 내 가문 문장을 꼭 되찾아야 하네. 무엇보다 중요한 일일세.

english: Why are you so desperate for it?
Do you have any quests for me? I really want one. I really want to help out!
translation: 저한테 줄 퀘스트 있어요? 정말 하나 하고 싶어요. 정말 돕고 싶다고요!

english: You murmur under your breath something about how great the rewards were last time you did a quest for Dimintheis.
translation: 당신은 지난번 Dimintheis(디민테이스)의 퀘스트 보상이 얼마나 좋았는지 작게 중얼거린다.

english: My family consider what you did for us a great service. We couldn't possibly trouble you further.
translation: 우리 가문은 자네가 해 준 일을 큰 은혜로 여기고 있네. 더는 자네에게 폐를 끼칠 수 없지.

english: There must be SOMETHING you need help with. I am a great adventurer after all.
translation: 분명 도움이 필요한 게 뭔가 있을 거예요. 저 위대한 모험가잖아요.

english: There really isn't anything, I am very content with life right now.
translation: 정말 아무것도 없다네. 지금 삶에 아주 만족하고 있거든.

english: I guess money really does buy happiness.
translation: 역시 돈으로 행복을 살 수 있나 보네요.

english: What was that? I didn't quite catch that.
Nothing...
Oh come on, surely there's something I can help out with! I want to help, however menial it is.
translation: 에이, 그러지 말고요, 분명 제가 도울 일이 있을 거예요! 아무리 사소한 일이라도 돕고 싶어요.

english: Okay okay. Fine then. Whilst I don't have anything for you, how about you try my sons, they are always wanting something done.
translation: 알았네, 알았어. 좋네. 나한테는 맡길 일이 없지만 내 아들들에게 가 보는 건 어떤가. 그 녀석들은 늘 뭔가 해 줄 사람을 찾고 있거든.

english: Fantastic! I'll get straight to it!
You smell the sweet smell of the great rewards that may soon come.
translation: 곧 손에 들어올지도 모를 엄청난 보상의 달콤한 냄새가 풍겨 온다.

english: Hello again, adventurer. I hope that Shield of Arrav business marks the start of something big for my family. Maybe it will help me finally get out of this hole!
translation: 다시 왔군, 모험가. 그 Shield of Arrav(아라브의 방패) 일이 우리 가문에 큰일의 시작이 되면 좋겠네. 어쩌면 마침내 이 누추한 곳에서 벗어날 수 있을지도 모르지!

english: Do you have any gauntlets for me?
Yes, your [steel/goldsmithing/cooking/chaos] gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 그렇네, 자네의 [steel/goldsmithing/cooking/chaos] 건틀릿이 얼마 전 마법의 힘으로 내게 돌아왔네. 돌려받겠나?

english: Yes please.
Here you go.
Not right now.
Well, come back if you change your mind any time. I owe you for your trouble.
translation: 음, 마음이 바뀌면 언제든 다시 오게. 자네가 고생한 데 빚을 졌으니.

english: No, I don't think so. You must have them yourself somewhere.
translation: 아니, 그런 것 같지 않네. 자네가 어딘가에 갖고 있을 걸세.

english: Hello Dimintheis.
I will not forget what you did for my family [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.
translation: 자네가 우리 가문에 해 준 일은 잊지 않겠네, [player name]. 그 500,000 코인 덕분에 우리 식탁에 음식을 올릴 수 있었지.

english: That's no problem.
Anyway, I was wondering if I could get more of those gauntlets?
translation: 그런데, 그 건틀릿을 더 받을 수 있을까 해서요.

english: You may, but you'll have to ask my sons for them, unless you just want a pair of the Steel gauntlets.
translation: 그래도 되네. 하지만 내 아들들에게 부탁해야 할 걸세. Steel gauntlets(강철 건틀릿) 한 켤레만 원한다면 모를까.

english: Yes, I do want a pair of steel gauntlets please.
translation: 네, steel gauntlets(강철 건틀릿) 한 켤레 주세요.

english: No thanks Dimintheis.
I thought these gauntlets were a family heirloom, how come you have several of them?
translation: 이 건틀릿은 가문의 가보라고 생각했는데, 어떻게 여러 개나 갖고 계세요?

english: I'm sorry for lying to you [player name], it was just all part of the ploy to make our family seem wealthy.
translation: 거짓말해서 미안하네, [player name]. 우리 가문을 부유해 보이게 하려는 계략의 일부였을 뿐일세.

english: They're not heirlooms at all, we have crates full of the things hidden away in the basement.
translation: 가보 같은 건 전혀 아닐세. 지하실에 그런 게 상자째로 잔뜩 숨겨져 있다네.

english: And you still think that these are an acceptable reward for what I have done for your family?
translation: 그런데도 제가 이 가문을 위해 한 일에 이게 합당한 보상이라고 생각하세요?

english: It's all I have to give...
translation: 내가 줄 수 있는 건 이것뿐이라네...

english: Very well, I do admit, they are useful.
Why would a nobleman live in a dump like this?
translation: 귀족이 왜 이런 허름한 곳에 살아요?

english: Why would he do that?
Yes.
No.
So where is this crest?
You're rich then? Can I have some money?
Hi, I am a bold adventurer.
Why are you so desperate for it?
I'm not interested in that adventure right now.
Have you got any quests for me?
I guess money does buy happiness.
translation: 역시 돈으로 행복을 살 수 있나 보네요.

english: Oh come on, however menial, I want to help!
translation: 에이, 그러지 말고요, 아무리 사소해도 돕고 싶어요!

english: Other
Yes please.
Not right now.
Could I get another pair of gauntlets?
translation: 건틀릿을 한 켤레 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Yes please!
No thanks!
The gauntlets are a family heirloom?
Hello.
Who you?
Me [goblin name]. Who you?
Me Dipflip.
What you doing, Dipflip?
Me thinking.
What thinking?
Me have big idea for High Priest. It big goblin competition to see who best goblin. Only strongest goblin win. Me call it Goblin League.
translation: 나 High Priest(대사제)한테 낼 큰 생각 있어. 누가 제일 센 고블린인지 보는 큰 고블린 대회. 제일 센 고블린만 이겨. 나 그거 Goblin League(고블린 리그)라고 불러.

english: You have good idea, Dipflip.
You think so?
Yes. High Priest and others be stupid to not see value of Goblin League.
translation: 응. High Priest(대사제)랑 다른 놈들 Goblin League(고블린 리그) 가치 모르면 바보.

english: Yes. Goblin League good. Me know it.
translation: 응. Goblin League(고블린 리그) 좋아. 나 그거 알아.

english: I leave you to think.
You have bad idea, Dipflip.
You wrong. Goblin League good. Me know it.
translation: 너 틀렸어. Goblin League(고블린 리그) 좋아. 나 그거 알아.

english: You have good idea, Dipflip.
You have bad idea, Dipflip.
Hi.
An impostor... Die, scum!
The disciple of Iban attacks the player.
translation: Disciple of Iban(이반의 제자)가 플레이어를 공격한다.

english: Iban is our father, our guide. Soon he will rule all life.
translation: Iban(이반)은 우리의 아버지, 우리의 길잡이다. 머지않아 그분께서 모든 생명을 다스리시리라.

english: Som Molica Aniul Demonte.
Pardon?
Hail the great one, my lord Iban. I die for you again and again.
translation: 위대한 분, 나의 주인 Iban(이반)을 찬양하라. 나는 그분을 위해 몇 번이고 죽는다.

english: Is that possible?
Under Iban anything is possible. Death is only the beginning.
translation: Iban(이반) 아래에서는 무엇이든 가능하다. 죽음은 시작일 뿐이다.

english: Succumb to the might of Iban, the ruler of this world.
translation: 이 세계의 지배자, Iban(이반)의 힘에 굴복하라.

english: Hello!
Welcome. Have you come to give your soul to the Chasm?
translation: 어서 오세요. 영혼을 Chasm(협곡)에 바치러 오셨나요?

english: Uh, I believe I'm still using it.
translation: 어, 아직 쓰고 있는 것 같은데요.

english: For now. Have you came to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
translation: 지금은 그렇겠죠. Chasm(협곡) 안의 수많은 악마들과 싸워 실력을 증명하러 오셨나요?

english: ...Perhaps.
My master prefers that his minions be killed with purpose.
translation: 제 주인께서는 그분의 하수인들이 목적을 가지고 처치되기를 바라세요.

english: Purpose?
I ask no questions of my master, I just inform.
translation: 저는 주인께 아무것도 묻지 않아요. 그저 전할 뿐이죠.

english: I am not worthy to explain on his behalf. Descend the Chasm and speak with him yourself if you wish for further details.
translation: 제게는 그분을 대신해 설명할 자격이 없어요. 더 자세한 걸 알고 싶으시면 Chasm(협곡)으로 내려가 그분과 직접 이야기하세요.

english: As outlined in your contract, he wishes them slain in particular ways.
translation: 계약서에 적힌 대로, 그분께서는 하수인들이 특정한 방식으로 처치되기를 바라세요.

english: Could you remind me what ways those were?
translation: 그 방식이 뭐였는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound.
translation: 양손 근접 무기, 묵직한 원거리 무기, 마법 주문, 특수 공격으로 죽이는 것, 그리고 속박된 상태에서 처치하는 거예요.

english: Additionaly, he will request a specific method to be used. If you comply, your chances of obtaining a reward will be increased.
translation: 게다가 그분께서는 특정한 방법을 쓰라고 요구하실 거예요. 그 요구를 따르면 보상을 얻을 확률이 올라가요.

english: Currently, my master wishes for you to use spells to kill his minions.
translation: 지금 제 주인께서는 주문으로 그분의 하수인들을 죽이기를 바라세요.

english: Does that include powered staves?
No.
Currently, my master wishes for you to use special attacks to kill his minions.
translation: 지금 제 주인께서는 특수 공격으로 그분의 하수인들을 죽이기를 바라세요.

english: What kinds of rewards would I receive?
Special contracts, to be presented to my master for further discussion.
translation: 특별 계약서예요. 제 주인께 가져가서 더 상의하시면 돼요.

english: Interesting. Thank you.
You are most welcome.
Are you okay?
Oh yes! Just praying to my new master. It's hot down here, isn't it?
translation: 아, 그럼요! 그냥 새 주인께 기도하던 중이에요. 여기 아래는 덥죠, 그렇죠?

english: I guess so.
Your new master, that would be...?
Yama! I sold my soul you see, well, I guess that Ox-headed guy down there forcibly removed it.
translation: Yama(야마)님이요! 제가 영혼을 팔았거든요. 뭐, 저 아래 황소 머리를 한 양반이 억지로 뜯어 갔다고 하는 게 맞겠지만요.

english: That doesn't sound like a fair trade...
Oh, don't worry, I'm perfectly fine with the outcome. Sure, the loss of vision is a shame but it could be worse.
translation: 아, 걱정 마세요, 저는 결과에 완전히 만족해요. 물론 시력을 잃은 건 아쉽지만 더 나빴을 수도 있잖아요.

english: Could it?
Underground there are no tall buildings, I'm awfully afraid of heights, you see.
translation: 지하에는 높은 건물이 없잖아요. 제가 높은 곳을 엄청 무서워하거든요.

english: Perhaps it's a good thing you can't see...
translation: 차라리 못 보는 게 다행일지도 모르겠네요...

english: What was that?
Oh, nothing...
What happened to your eyes?
The ritual, there were some... adverse effects...
The ritual?
Oh yes! Pretty basic really, head of an Ox, bruma roots, lots of fire and of course the human sacrifice.
translation: 아, 네! 사실 아주 기본적인 거예요. 황소 머리, bruma roots(브루마 뿌리), 잔뜩 피운 불, 그리고 당연히 인간 제물이죠.

english: And at what point did that blind you?
translation: 그럼 어느 단계에서 눈이 먼 거예요?

english: The voice demanded that we stare into the fire until we saw enlightenment.
translation: 목소리가 깨달음을 볼 때까지 불을 응시하라고 요구했거든요.

english: I guess the fire was pretty bright.
Blindingly so.
Wait! Did you say human sacrifice?
Why, of course! We're Zamorakians, we're evil...
translation: 아니, 당연하죠! 우린 Zamorak(자모락) 신도잖아요, 사악하다고요...

english: Yeah, I guess that's true.
Well, I'll leave you to it.
So soon?
Yep, the demons won't slay themselves.
translation: 네, 악마들이 알아서 죽어 주진 않으니까요.

english: What demons?
For now. Have you come to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
translation: 지금은 그렇겠죠. Chasm(협곡) 안의 수많은 악마들과 싸워 실력을 증명하러 오셨나요?

english: My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: 제 주인께서는 아무 목적 없이 그분의 하수인들을 죽이지 않기를 바라세요. Chasm(협곡) 안에서는 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)에게 할당받은 것만 처치할 수 있어요.

english: That's an oddly specific reason.
My master wishes you not to kill his minions without an agenda. You may only slay within the Chasm that which you have been assigned by a Slayer Master.
translation: 제 주인께서는 아무 목적 없이 그분의 하수인들을 죽이지 않기를 바라세요. Chasm(협곡) 안에서는 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)에게 할당받은 것만 처치할 수 있어요.

english: Your new master, that would be...?
What happened to your eyes?
Well, I'll leave you to it.
Such a long voyage... maybe one day there will be a glider service out here.
translation: 정말 긴 항해였어... 언젠가 여기에도 글라이더 노선이 생기면 좋겠네.

english: We could always do with an extra pair of hands on the dock. See Frankie, the fresh fish trader, if you're looking for work.
translation: 부두에는 일손이 늘 더 필요해요. 일자리를 찾고 있다면 신선한 생선을 파는 상인 Frankie(프랭키)를 찾아가 보세요.

english: We can fix this faster if we work together!
translation: 같이 하면 더 빨리 고칠 수 있어요!

english: Blasted thing's broken again!
Can I get some assistance over here?
Great work, this crane should be good for a while!
translation: 잘했어요, 이 기중기는 한동안 괜찮을 거예요!

english: What can I do for you, [m'lady/sir]?
What do you do around here?
It's my job to keep track of operations on the docks.
translation: 부두 작업 현황을 관리하는 게 제 일이에요.

english: Is there anything I can help out with?
Thanks for the offer, but I'm afraid you need a higher crafting level before you can help me.
translation: 제안은 고맙지만, 저를 도우려면 crafting(공예) 레벨이 더 높아야 할 것 같아요.

english: You need a crafting level of 30 to assist the Piscarilius dockmaster.
translation: Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) dockmaster(부두 관리인)을 도우려면 crafting(공예) 레벨 30이 필요하다.

english: You look like you know a thing or two about crafting, perhaps you could help us maintain the fishing cranes around the docks.
translation: crafting(공예)를 좀 아시는 분 같네요. 부두 주변의 낚시용 기중기를 관리하는 일을 도와주실 수 있겠어요.

english: You'll need a hammer, some nails and a few wooden planks, 3 planks per broken crane should be enough.
translation: hammer(망치), nails(못), 그리고 나무 판자가 몇 장 필요해요. 고장 난 기중기 하나당 판자 3장이면 충분할 거예요.

english: I can't offer you any payment at the moment, but hard work doesn't go unnoticed around these parts.
translation: 지금은 보수를 드릴 수 없지만, 이 근방에서는 열심히 일하면 다들 알아준답니다.

english: Sure, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 좋아요, 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: I'll let you get back to work.
Sorry, I was just looking around.
Fair enough.
I have a question for you.
The Dockmaster has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Dockmaster(부두 관리인)이 당신에게 도전 두루마리를 주었다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
The Dockmaster has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Dockmaster(부두 관리인)이 당신에게 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: What do you do around here?
Is there anything I can help out with?
I'll let you get back to work.
Sorry, I was just looking around.
Hello.
How do you feel? No heavy flu, shivers, nausea or loss of appetite?
translation: 몸은 좀 어떤가요? 심한 독감이나 오한, 메스꺼움, 식욕 부진은 없고요?

english: Uh... no... I feel fine...
How about nightmares then? Are you experiencing any problems with especially scary nightmares?
translation: 그럼 악몽은요? 유난히 무서운 악몽 때문에 시달리고 있진 않나요?

english: No... not since I was young.
Good, good, I had to make sure. This plague really has an incredibly fast contagion rate. It spreads faster than the common cold!
translation: 좋아요, 좋아요. 확인을 해 둬야 해서요. 이 역병은 정말 무서울 정도로 빨리 옮거든요. 흔한 감기보다도 빨리 퍼진다니까요!

english: The plague? Tell me more.
It came from the west somewhere. It is extremely quick spreading, and utterly deadly.
translation: 서쪽 어딘가에서 왔어요. 퍼지는 속도가 엄청나게 빠르고, 걸리면 무조건 죽어요.

english: What are the symptoms?

It varies slightly from case to case, but usually abnormal nightmares and flu-like symptoms, progressing as you succumb more. Eventually, it results in the presence of a thick black tar-like substance secreted
translation: 사람마다 조금씩 다르지만, 보통은 이상한 악몽과 독감 같은 증상으로 시작해서 병이 깊어질수록 심해져요. 결국에는 걸쭉하고 시커먼 타르 같은 물질이

english: from the nose and eyes.
Okay, I'll be careful.
You do that adventurer. You do not want to become infected by the plague.
translation: 그래요, 모험가 양반. 역병에 걸리고 싶진 않을 테니까요.

english: Good day, you have my next payment? I don't keep this charade up for fun you know.
translation: 안녕하세요, 다음 대금은 가져왔나요? 내가 재미로 이런 연극을 하고 있는 게 아니라는 건 알죠?

english: Sorry I don't.
Well if you would mention it next time you see the Head Mourner, it would be appreciated.
translation: 그럼 다음에 Head Mourner(애도자 우두머리)를 만나면 그 얘기 좀 꺼내 줘요. 그래 주면 고맙겠어요.

english: I'll keep it in mind.
Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I'm very busy right now.
translation: 안녕하세요. 미안하지만 얘기할 시간이 없어요. 지금 아주 바쁘거든요.

english: Hello doctor. I need to acquire some protective clothing so that I can dispose of some diseased sheep.
translation: 안녕하세요, 의사 선생님. 병든 양을 처리하려는데 방호복이 좀 필요해요.

english: Protective clothing? I'm afraid I only have the one suit which I made myself to prevent infection from any contaminated patients I treat.
translation: 방호복이요? 미안하지만 딱 한 벌밖에 없어요. 내가 치료하는 환자들한테 옮지 않으려고 직접 만든 거예요.

english: I suppose I could sell you this one and make myself another, but it would cost you at least 100 gold so that I could afford a replacement.
translation: 이걸 팔고 새로 하나 만들 수는 있겠지만, 그러려면 대신 쓸 걸 마련해야 하니 적어도 100골드는 받아야겠어요.

english: Okay, I'll take it.
These should protect you from infection.
Sorry doc, that's too much.
I'm afraid it will cost me that much to replace. I cannot possibly sell it for less.
translation: 미안하지만 새로 만들려면 그만큼 들어요. 그보다 싸게는 도저히 못 팔아요.

english: The plague? Tell me more.
Okay, I'll be careful.
Okay, I'll take it.
Sorry doc, that's too much.
Psst! Got any Void kit you don't want? Spare robes, spare helms, that kind of thing?
translation: 쉿! 필요 없는 Void(보이드) 장비 있어? 남는 로브라든가, 남는 투구라든가, 그런 거 말이야.

english: What if I do?
Might be able to take it off your hands for you. Show me what you've got, and I'll see if I can get you some Commendation Points for it.
translation: 내가 대신 처리해 줄 수도 있지. 뭘 가졌는지 보여 줘 봐. Commendation Points(공훈 포인트)로 좀 쳐줄 수 있나 보자고.

english: Just so you know, you've got a lot of Commendation points already, so I can't pay you my usual rate.
translation: 미리 말해 두는데, 넌 이미 공훈 포인트가 꽤 많아서 평소 시세대로는 못 쳐줘.

english: Deal!
No, I don't.
Decline
That's not really the sort of stuff I want
What if I do?
Accept
No, I don't.
Lookin' fer Captain Tock?
Lookin' fer the Corsair cabin boy?
Who are you?
Arr, I can help ye with yer business wi'out ye needin' to known mine. So are ye seekin' him, or not?
translation: 아르르, 내 사정은 몰라도 네 볼일은 도와줄 수 있다. 그래서, 그놈을 찾는 거냐, 아니냐?

english: Yes, I am.
The Corsairs moor their ship away to the west, beyond yon village of Rimmington. Ye should look fer him there.
translation: Corsair(코르세어) 놈들은 저기 서쪽, Rimmington(림밍턴) 마을 너머에 배를 대 놓지. 거기 가서 찾아봐라.

english: West, beyond Rimmington? Thank you.
Why would I be looking for him?
Many come here seekin' him. They be all lost an 'confused. If ye be seekin' him now, maybe I can help ye.
translation: 그놈을 찾으러 여기 오는 놈들이 많거든. 다들 길을 잃고 헤매지. 지금 그놈을 찾는 거라면 내가 도와줄 수도 있다.

english: No, I'm not.
Arrr, I thought maybe ye were.
Who are you?
Yes, I am.
Why would I be looking for him?
No, I'm not.
Woof!
Welcome to the Nightmare Zone! Would you like me to create a dream for you?
translation: Nightmare Zone(나이트메어 존)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 꿈을 하나 만들어 드릴까요?

english: Who are you?
My name's Dominic Onion but you can call me Dom, or Mr Onion.
translation: 제 이름은 Dominic Onion(도미닉 어니언)이에요. 그냥 돔이나 어니언 씨라고 불러 주세요.

english: Mr Oni...Dom, how did you get that name?
translation: 어니언 씨... 아니, 돔. 어쩌다 그런 이름을 갖게 됐어요?

english: Well that's a long story...but I can tell you that it involved my parents, 3 blurberry specials, and a chinchompa.
translation: 음, 그건 얘기가 길어요... 그래도 이 정도는 말해 드릴 수 있죠. 우리 부모님이랑, blurberry special(블러베리 스페셜) 세 잔, 그리고 chinchompa(친촘파) 한 마리가 얽힌 일이었어요.

english: ...and a chinchompa?
Oh yes, Nigel played a crucial role in the whole debacle. It's all very amusing now that I think back to it.
translation: 아, 그럼요. 그 난리 통에서 Nigel(나이절)이 아주 결정적인 역할을 했죠. 지금 돌이켜 보면 다 참 웃긴 일이에요.

english: Right...
Good times...
What is this place?
This is the Nightmare Zone!
Wwwwhat?!
Don't worry, it's not as bad as it sounds...most of the time.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 이름만큼 나쁘진 않아요... 대부분은요.

english: That's comforting.
Truth be told, that name wasn't my first choice, it's what the local folk have been calling it and so it sort of stuck.
translation: 사실 그 이름은 제가 원래 붙이려던 이름이 아니었어요. 동네 사람들이 그렇게 부르다 보니 그냥 굳어 버렸죠.

english: My original plan came to me in a vivid dream when I was younger you see, I saw myself running a successful business from a great structure in a strange land.
translation: 원래 계획은 어릴 때 꾼 생생한 꿈에서 떠올랐어요. 낯선 땅의 거대한 건물에서 제가 성공한 사업을 운영하는 모습을 봤거든요.

english: Well, I say strange, but I'd never left Lunar Isle at the time and this place was very hot and dry, unlike anything I'd seen before.
translation: 뭐, 낯설다고 했지만 사실 그때 전 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)을 떠나 본 적이 없었거든요. 그곳은 아주 덥고 건조해서 전에 본 어떤 곳과도 달랐어요.

english: When I told my father about the dream he laughed and said I should become a banker like him and his father before him but in that moment I knew that it wasn't the life for me.
translation: 아버지께 그 꿈 얘기를 했더니 웃으시면서, 아버지와 할아버지처럼 은행원이 되라고 하셨죠. 그런데 그 순간 그건 제 삶이 아니라는 걸 알았어요.

english: I had to find out what this dream meant and if it was a vision of the future or not.
translation: 이 꿈이 무슨 뜻인지, 미래를 본 건지 아닌지 알아내야 했어요.

english: Growing up, I studied hard to find out more about magic, especially oneiromancy and the interpretation of dreams.
translation: 자라면서 마법, 특히 꿈 점술과 해몽을 열심히 공부했죠.

english: Having learned as much as I could on Lunar Isle I set out to find and learn from other great wizards I'd heard of in stories as a child.
translation: 루나 섬에서 배울 수 있는 건 다 배운 다음, 어릴 때 이야기로만 듣던 위대한 마법사들을 찾아가 배우려고 길을 떠났어요.

english: I set off to travel the world, discovering more about dreams to enable me to understand the dream I'd had as a child.
translation: 어릴 때 꾼 그 꿈을 이해하려고 세상을 돌아다니며 꿈에 대해 더 많은 걸 알아냈죠.

english: I needed to know what this dream meant and if it was truly a vision of the future.
translation: 이 꿈이 무슨 뜻인지, 정말로 미래를 본 건지 알아야 했거든요.

english: If so I knew I had to try and find this location and build the huge tower I saw.
translation: 만약 그렇다면 그곳을 찾아내서 꿈에서 본 거대한 탑을 지어야 한다는 걸 알았어요.

english: I was going to call it 'Dom Onion's Tower', but I've not found this strange place or gathered enough money to build it just yet.
translation: 'Dom Onion's Tower(돔 어니언의 탑)'이라고 부를 생각이었는데, 아직 그 낯선 곳을 찾지도 못했고 탑을 지을 돈도 다 모으지 못했어요.

english: That's why I've setup this small business venture in the mean time selling dreams to people. I just need a big enough crowd to kickstart my business.
translation: 그래서 그동안 사람들한테 꿈을 파는 이 작은 사업을 시작한 거예요. 사업을 띄우려면 손님만 충분히 모이면 돼요.

english: It's all part of my five year plan, and who knows, perhaps my dream will come true; I'll discover this place and build Dom Onion's Tower!
translation: 이것도 다 제 5개년 계획의 일부예요. 누가 알아요, 어쩌면 제 꿈이 이뤄져서 그곳을 찾아내고 돔 어니언의 탑을 짓게 될지도요!

english: Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: 꿈에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Certainly. I can delve into your memories and search for the key events that have affected you on your adventures.
translation: 물론이죠. 제가 당신의 기억 속을 들여다보고, 모험하면서 영향을 준 중요한 사건들을 찾아내요.

english: I then take the essence of these memories and put that in the vial you see on the plinth.
translation: 그다음 그 기억의 정수를 뽑아서 plinth(좌대) 위에 있는 vial(약병)에 담아요.

english: I imbue a bit of magic, then give the vial a bit of a shake, and when you drink it you'll be able to re-live an encounter close to the original.
translation: 마법을 살짝 불어넣고 약병을 좀 흔들어 주면, 그걸 마셨을 때 원래와 거의 똑같은 전투를 다시 겪을 수 있어요.

english: Don't worry though, when you're in a dream, you're perfectly safe even if it does seem very real.
translation: 그래도 걱정 마세요. 아무리 진짜 같아 보여도 꿈속에서는 완벽하게 안전하니까요.

english: If you sucessfullyovercome the dream or die trying, you'll leave the dream state and return to normal with your grey matter and appendages intact.
translation: 꿈을 이겨 내든 싸우다 죽든, 꿈에서 깨어나 뇌와 팔다리가 멀쩡한 채로 원래 상태로 돌아오게 돼요.

english: Are all dreams the same or are there different options?
translation: 꿈은 다 똑같나요, 아니면 여러 가지가 있나요?

english: Oh no, they can vary wildly! You can choose from one of three main options.
translation: 아이고, 아니죠, 천차만별이에요! 크게 세 가지 중에서 고를 수 있어요.

english: Firstly, I can create a one-on-one encounter with an adversary you've defeated in your adventures. People like to practice in these dreams.
translation: 첫째로, 모험하면서 쓰러뜨린 적과 일대일로 붙는 꿈을 만들 수 있어요. 사람들은 이런 꿈에서 연습하길 좋아하죠.

english: Then there's a sort of Endurance dream, where you face enemies in encounter after encounter, and try to survive to the end.
translation: 그다음은 일종의 Endurance(인듀어런스) 꿈인데, 적들과 연달아 싸우면서 끝까지 살아남아 보는 거예요.

english: And finally there's something I like to call a Rumble, where you face multiple adversaries at the same time. I imbue a bit more magic and shake the vial harder to create that one!
translation: 그리고 마지막으로 제가 Rumble(럼블)이라고 부르는 게 있는데, 여러 적과 한꺼번에 싸우는 거예요. 그건 마법을 좀 더 불어넣고 약병을 더 세게 흔들어야 만들어져요!

english: You can invite friends to fight alongside you in a Rumble dream. Once I've set up the dream for you, step into the enclosure and invite up to 4 friends.
translation: 럼블 꿈에서는 친구들을 불러 함께 싸울 수 있어요. 제가 꿈을 준비해 드리면 울타리 안으로 들어가서 친구를 4명까지 초대하세요.

english: For the Endurance and Rumble dreams, I charge a fee for my work. I don't like handling the money directly, so instead I've set up a secure coffer.
translation: 인듀어런스 꿈과 럼블 꿈은 수고비를 받아요. 돈을 직접 만지는 건 싫어서 대신 안전한 coffer(금고)를 마련해 뒀어요.

english: After you've asked me to set up a dream, put some money in my coffer. I'll deduct the fee from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 달라고 하신 다음 제 금고에 돈을 좀 넣어 두세요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 수고비를 빼 갈게요.

english: There's a red vial on the other plinth. Your friends can drink from it to enter your dream as a spectator to observe your progress.
translation: 다른 좌대 위에는 red vial(빨간 약병)이 있어요. 친구들이 그걸 마시면 관전자로 당신의 꿈에 들어가서 진행 상황을 지켜볼 수 있어요.

english: Finally here's one other option you get, and that's how difficult the encounters are. As well as the normal dreams, the bravest adventurers can choose a harder version*.
translation: 마지막으로 하나 더 고를 수 있는 게 있는데, 바로 전투의 난이도예요. 일반 꿈 말고도, 가장 용감한 모험가는 더 어려운 버전*을 고를 수 있어요.
