english: *Terms and conditions apply: Mr Onion, henceforth known as Dom, cannot be held liable for accidental loss of limbs (yours or otherwise) and or psychological damage as a result of entering the Nightmare Zone. Please note there is a strict no-refunds policy, and all dream purchases are final.
translation: *약관이 적용됩니다: 어니언 씨(이하 '돔')는 Nightmare Zone(나이트메어 존) 입장으로 인한 우발적인 팔다리 손실(본인 및 타인 포함) 및/또는 정신적 피해에 대해 책임지지 않습니다. 환불은 일절 불가하며, 모든 꿈 구매는 최종 확정임을 유의하시기 바랍니다.

english: Can I choose a dream?
Certainly. You can practice for free, but the larger dreams require more skill to imbue the potions and so there's a fee for those.
translation: 물론이죠. 연습은 공짜지만, 더 큰 꿈은 물약에 마법을 불어넣는 데 더 많은 기술이 필요해서 수고비가 있어요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 싸울 준비가 되면 울타리 안에 있는 약병을 마시세요.

english: For an Endurance dream, normal mode, I'll want 1,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 인듀어런스 꿈, 일반 모드는 1,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 1,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 싸울 준비가 되면 울타리 안에 있는 약병을 마시세요. 그때 금고에서 1,000코인을 빼 갈게요.

english: For an Endurance dream, hard mode, I'll want 5,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 인듀어런스 꿈, 어려움 모드는 5,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Drink from the vial in the enclosure when you're ready to fight. I'll deduct 5,000 coins from the coffer when you do.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 싸울 준비가 되면 울타리 안에 있는 약병을 마시세요. 그때 금고에서 5,000코인을 빼 갈게요.

english: For a Rumble dream, normal mode, I'll want 2,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 럼블 꿈, 일반 모드는 2,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 2,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 울타리 안으로 들어가서 플레이어를 4명까지 초대한 다음, 약병을 마시면 시작돼요. 모두 먼저 금고를 열고 2,000코인을 넣어 둬야 해요.

english: For a Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 6,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 럼블 꿈, 어려움 모드는 6,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 6,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 울타리 안으로 들어가서 플레이어를 4명까지 초대한 다음, 약병을 마시면 시작돼요. 모두 먼저 금고를 열고 6,000코인을 넣어 둬야 해요.

english: For a customisable Rumble dream, normal mode, I'll want 12,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 맞춤형 럼블 꿈, 일반 모드는 12,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 12,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 울타리 안으로 들어가서 플레이어를 4명까지 초대한 다음, 약병을 마시면 시작돼요. 모두 먼저 금고를 열고 12,000코인을 넣어 둬야 해요.

english: For a customisable Rumble dream, hard mode, I'll want 16,000 coins. I'll deduct the money from the coffer when you start the dream.
translation: 맞춤형 럼블 꿈, 어려움 모드는 16,000코인이에요. 꿈을 시작할 때 금고에서 돈을 빼 갈게요.

english: I've prepared your dream. Step into the enclosure, invite up to 4 players to join you, then drink from the vial to begin. Each of you will need to unlock the coffer and have 16,000 coins deposited first.
translation: 꿈을 준비해 뒀어요. 울타리 안으로 들어가서 플레이어를 4명까지 초대한 다음, 약병을 마시면 시작돼요. 모두 먼저 금고를 열고 16,000코인을 넣어 둬야 해요.

english: I'll come back another time.
You haven't started that dream I created for you. Can I help you with something?
translation: 제가 만들어 드린 꿈을 아직 시작 안 하셨네요. 뭐 도와드릴 일 있어요?

english: I want to change my dream.
Okay, I've emptied the vial. I have not taken any money from you for that dream, since you never started it.
translation: 좋아요, 약병을 비웠어요. 그 꿈은 시작하지 않으셨으니 돈은 한 푼도 안 받았어요.

english: Which dream would you like to experience?
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Here, have this.
Who are you?
What is this place?
Can you tell me about the dreams?
translation: 꿈에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Can I choose a dream?
Practice
Normal
Hard
Endurance
Yes
No
Rumble
Customisable - normal
Customisable - hard
Previous: [previous choice]
I'll come back another time.
I want to change my dream.
Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. Crafting(공예) 도구는 필요한 건 다 있어요.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
Hi! I have this money-off voucher!
So I see! Unfortunately, it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 그렇네요! 그런데 안타깝게도 어제로 기한이 끝난 것 같아요! 어쩔 수 없죠.

english: But I only just got it!
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 죄송해요, 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 게 없네요.

english: Goodbye.
What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: I know that one of his thugs has threatened to ruin my store if I don't cooperate with them!
translation: 그 사람 밑에 있는 깡패 하나가 협조 안 하면 내 가게를 망쳐 놓겠다고 협박했다는 건 알아요!

english: He said he was a tailor, but those scissors looked more like a weapon than something used for Crafting.
translation: 자기가 재단사라던데, 그 가위는 Crafting(공예)에 쓰는 물건이라기보다 무기처럼 보였어요.

english: What are you going to do, then?
As long as I have my store, I'll keep selling my Crafting equipment! Would you like to buy any?
translation: 가게가 있는 한 공예 도구는 계속 팔 거예요! 뭐 좀 사 가시겠어요?

english: No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. Crafting(공예) 도구는 필요한 건 다 있어요.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
What do you know about Ali Morrisane?
translation: Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 별로 확신이 없어 보이는데. 애들 근처에 감염자가 얼씬거리는 건 싫어. 썩 꺼져!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 뭘 팔러 왔든 우린 관심 없어!

english: But I'm not...
translation: 하지만 저는 뭘 팔러 온 게 아니...

english: Did you not hear me? Clear off!
...(Don't Know What silently lets you in.)
translation: ...(Don't Know What(뭔지 모를 것)이 조용히 당신을 들여보내 준다.)

english: Player enters Weiss
...(Don't Know What silently lets you out.)
translation: ...(Don't Know What(뭔지 모를 것)이 조용히 당신을 내보내 준다.)

english: Player exits Weiss
What do you want?
Just wondering if you were still here.
Of course I'm still here.
I'm not going near that crack in the wall again.
translation: 그 벽에 난 crack(갈라진 틈) 근처엔 다시는 안 갈 거예요.

english: Rock falls and so on are fine, but sea monsters in caves - never!
translation: 낙석 같은 건 괜찮아요. 하지만 동굴에 바다 괴물이라니, 그건 절대 안 돼요!

english: What are you doing down in these caves?
translation: 이 동굴 아래에서 뭐 하고 계세요?

english: I'm waiting to work on the excavations...
...though I don't really want to start digging again.
translation: ...사실 다시 땅 파는 건 별로 하고 싶지 않지만요.

english: Why not? I thought digging was something dwarves were good at.
translation: 왜요? 땅 파는 건 드워프들 특기인 줄 알았는데요.

english: Not with monsters like that one in those caves.
translation: 저 동굴에 그런 괴물이 있으면 얘기가 다르죠.

english: It had huge teeth and flaming red eyes, and was almost the size of the tunnel!
translation: 이빨은 엄청나게 크고 눈은 시뻘겋게 불타는 데다, 덩치가 거의 터널만 했다고요!

english: If it attacks the town...
Are you an adventurer, by any chance?
Adventurer and Regent of Miscellania.
In that case, could you go and deal with that monster?
translation: 그렇다면 그 괴물 좀 처리해 주실 수 있어요?

english: I don't want to have to face it again if it attacks the town.
translation: 그게 마을을 덮치면 또 그놈이랑 맞닥뜨리고 싶지 않거든요.

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
You'll need to get into the other caves first, of course.
translation: 물론 먼저 다른 동굴로 들어가야 해요.

english: There's a crack in the wall where the others are digging, but the rocks are loose, and can fall on you if you're not careful.
translation: 다른 사람들이 땅을 파는 곳의 벽에 갈라진 틈이 있는데, 바위가 헐거워서 조심하지 않으면 머리 위로 떨어질 수 있어요.

english: I can give you a mining prop to keep them from falling, if you give me a minute to find it...
translation: 잠깐만 시간을 주시면 바위가 떨어지지 않게 받쳐 줄 mining prop(갱도 버팀목)을 찾아 드릴게요...

english: Okay, so all I have to do is get through that wall?
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 그 벽만 통과하면 되는 거예요?

english: No, after that the only way you can get further is climbing up onto a high ledge, then crawling through a tunnel.
translation: 아뇨, 그다음엔 높은 ledge(바위 턱)에 올라가서 터널을 기어서 지나가는 수밖에 없어요.

english: But the walls are slippery...
...and I think I might have broken the lift when I fell off it on my way back.
translation: ...그리고 돌아오는 길에 lift(승강기)에서 떨어지면서 그걸 망가뜨린 것 같아요.

english: You'll probably need to fix the lift - I doubt you'd be able to climb.
translation: 아마 승강기를 고쳐야 할 거예요. 기어 올라가기는 힘들 것 같거든요.

english: And the monster's behind that tunnel?
translation: 그럼 괴물은 그 터널 너머에 있는 거예요?

english: Somewhere behind it. I couldn't get very far, what with the flooding in the tunnel.
translation: 그 너머 어딘가에요. 터널이 물에 잠겨 있어서 저도 멀리 가 보진 못했어요.

english: There's some rope and some planks near the broken lift - those would probably come in handy.
translation: 망가진 승강기 근처에 rope(밧줄)이랑 planks(판자)가 좀 있어요. 아마 쓸모가 있을 거예요.

english: Ah, here's that mining prop. I knew I had it somewhere.
translation: 아, 여기 갱도 버팀목 있네요. 어딘가에 있을 줄 알았어요.

english: Here you go. Good luck with fighting that monster.
translation: 여기요. 그 괴물이랑 싸우는 거 행운을 빌게요.

english: Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 굳이 왜요? 단단한 바위를 뚫고 나올 수는 없잖아요.

english: That's what I thought, until I saw the sheer size of it. This thing probably MADE the tunnels!
translation: 저도 그렇게 생각했어요, 그 덩치를 보기 전까진요. 터널을 그놈이 직접 팠을지도 몰라요!

english: And you're sending me in to deal with it alone?
translation: 그런데 저 혼자 그걸 처리하러 보내시겠다고요?

english: I've heard stories from the Miscellanians. If you're the Regent, you must be quite a strong hero.
translation: Miscellanians(미셀라니아 사람들)한테서 이야기를 들었어요. 섭정이시라면 엄청 강한 영웅이실 텐데요.

english: So what are you worried about? You probably eat monsters like that for breakfast!
translation: 그럼 뭘 걱정하세요? 그런 괴물쯤은 아침밥으로 드실 것 같은데!

english: I wouldn't put it quite like that...
But I'll help you after all. Now, how do I find this monster?
translation: 그래도 도와드릴게요. 자, 그 괴물은 어떻게 찾으면 되죠?

english: Of course. Dealing with monsters is what I do best!
Why bother? It can't get through solid rock.
translation: 굳이 왜요? 단단한 바위를 뚫고 나올 수는 없잖아요.

english: How are you doing, Dondakan?
Oh, just fine, just fine! This gold is certainly creating a steady flow of income for me! After the company takes some of the cut, of course.
translation: 아, 잘 지내지, 잘 지내고말고! 이 금 덕분에 꼬박꼬박 돈이 들어오고 있다네! 물론 회사가 몫을 좀 떼어 간 다음이지만.

english: Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 저를 다시 바위 속으로 쏴 줄 수 있어요?

english: You need to wear that golden helmet... unless you want to crack open your skull on the rock.
translation: 그 황금 투구를 써야 하네... 바위에 부딪혀서 머리통이 깨지고 싶은 게 아니라면 말일세.

english: Of course, just a second, let me adjust my cannon again.
translation: 물론이지, 잠깐만 기다리게. cannon(대포)를 다시 조정해야 하니까.

english: Say, are you selling those boots of yours?
translation: 저기, 그 장화 파실 생각 있어요?

english: What, you mean these granite boots?
translation: 뭐, 이 granite boots(화강암 장화) 말인가?

english: Yes, I'd be happy to pay quite some money for them!
Haha, I bet you would, I bet you would!
But I no longer need the money, this rock is generating plenty!
translation: 하지만 난 이제 돈이 필요 없네. 이 바위에서 돈이 넘치도록 나오거든!

english: Besides, I'm rather fond of them now... best boots I ever had!
translation: 게다가 이젠 꽤 정이 들었다네... 내 평생 최고의 장화야!

english: Oh please...
No, I won't sell them.
Pretty please?
No!
Oh come on!!!
Well...
Yes?
How much gold would you be willing to pay for it? Not that I'm selling my boots, mind, I'm just curious.
translation: 자네라면 이걸 얼마에 사겠나? 그렇다고 팔겠다는 건 아닐세. 그냥 궁금해서 말이야.

english: What, are you trying to scam old Dondakan? You want me to sell these boots for a measly [number] coins?
translation: 뭐야, 이 늙은 돈다칸을 등쳐 먹으려는 겐가? 고작 [number]코인에 이 장화를 팔라고?

english: I'm not selling them anyway.
You're so poor, you don't even have that much gold on you...
translation: 자네는 너무 가난해서 그만한 금도 안 갖고 있잖나...

english: If I were selling my granite boots, which I'm clearly not, I would certainly not accept a mere [number] coins for them.
translation: 내가 granite boots(화강암 장화)를 판다고 해도, 물론 안 팔지만, 고작 [number]코인에는 절대 안 넘길 걸세.

english: That's quite a sum of money, which I notice you don't even have on you.
translation: 꽤 큰돈이구먼. 그런데 보아하니 자네 수중엔 그만한 돈도 없군.

english: Haha, nice try [player name]!
Pity I'm not selling my boots, not for any price or any item.
translation: 아쉽게도 난 이 장화를 안 판다네. 얼마를 주든, 무슨 물건을 주든 말일세.

english: I just wanted to see how high you would go!
translation: 자네가 얼마나 높이 부르나 보고 싶었을 뿐이야!

english: Bah, thanks a lot.
Hey, that's quite a bit of money. Which you don't have on you. Oh well, I wasn't selling my boots anyway.
translation: 이야, 꽤 큰돈이구먼. 자네한테 없는 돈이지만. 뭐 어쨌든, 난 원래 장화를 팔 생각이 없었다네.

english: Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
Great, because I don't want to sell them.
Okay.
Right.
Check these out.
Where'd you get those from? Did you make your own?
translation: 그건 어디서 났나? 직접 만든 건가?

english: Not quite, they were retrieved from the corpse of a wyvern.
You killed a wyvern? Last I heard they were all dead.
translation: 와이번을 죽였다고? 내가 듣기로는 다 죽고 없다던데.

english: I never said I killed it! But perhaps I did, I am a grand adventureafter all!
translation: 제가 죽였다고는 안 했어요! 그래도 어쩌면 제가 죽였을지도 모르죠. 저는 위대한 모험가니까요!

english: Oh dear, oh dear. It seems firing you head first into a rock was perhaps not the best idea, you've gone absolutely loony.
translation: 이런, 이런. 자네를 머리부터 바위에 쏘아 박은 게 그리 좋은 생각은 아니었나 보군. 완전히 실성해 버렸어.

english: Hmm, well you do have a point...
It's alright Laddie, I'm just joking.
That's great, but I have to go now.
translation: 좋네요. 그런데 이제 가 봐야 해요.

english: Come back any time!
I don't want anything from you right now.
Can you shoot me into the rock again?
translation: 저를 다시 바위 속으로 쏴 줄 수 있어요?

english: Are you selling those boots of yours?
Oh please...
Never mind, I don't want them anymore.
That's great, but I have to go.
translation: 좋네요. 그런데 이제 가 봐야 해요.

english: Hello there, can I help you?
Where am I?
This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
How are you today?
Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: 음, 나쁘지 않아요, 고마워요. 오늘따라 Gielinor(길리노르) 날씨가 참 좋네요.

english: Weather?
Yes weather, you know.
The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: 특정 시간과 장소에서 기온, 습도, 풍속, 기압 같은 변수를 기준으로 본 대기의 상태 또는 조건 말이에요.

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 제가 할 만한 퀘스트 아는 거 있어요?

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: 흠.. 위험한 거라고요? 어떤 괴물이랑 싸우고 싶은데요?

english: Big scary demons!
You are a brave soul indeed.
Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: 말이 나와서 말인데, Varrock(바록)에 있는 점쟁이가 무슨 거대한 악에 대해 횡설수설하고 다닌다는 소문을 들었어요.. 제가 보기엔 악마 얘기 같던데요.

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: 말한 만큼 용감하다면 한번 가 보는 게 어때요?

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: 악마 Delrith(델리스)는 이미 해치웠어요. 제가 끝장냈을 땐 제 칼에 묻은 얼룩에 불과했죠!

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: 잘했어요! 그래도 세상을 돌아다니다 보면 더 상대하기 벅찬 적들이 있을 거예요.

english: Vampyres!
Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: 하하. 저는 그런 거 안 믿어요. 그런데 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 뱀파이어 얘기로 마을 사람들을 겁주고 다니는 남자가 있어요.

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: 이름은 Morgan(모건)이고, 마을 집들 중 한 곳에 있을 거예요. 무슨 일인지 한번 알아봐 줄래요?

english: Thanks for the tip.
Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: 아, 그 끔찍한 흡혈 뱀파이어는 벌써 해치웠어요. 이제 Draynor(드레이너)는 안전할 거예요.

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: 네, 네, 그러셨겠죠. 뱀파이어가 진짜가 아니라는 건 다들 아는데....

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: 뭐라고요! 저 진짜 그 야수를 해치웠어요.. 정말이라고요.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ..허.. 하지만... 아니! 진짜 했는데... 믿고 싶은 대로 믿으세요.

english: Small.. something small would be good.
Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: 작은 거요? 작은 건 별로 위험하지 않잖아요?

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: 위험할 수 있어요! 사악한 닭부터 독거미까지 뭐든 나올 수 있다고요. 걔들은 떼로 덤빈단 말이에요!

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: 네, 알았어요, 인정할게요. 작은 괴물 얘기가 나와서 말인데, wizards' tower(마법사의 탑)에 사는 늙은 Wizard Mizgog(마법사 미즈고그)가 장난꾸러기 임프 무리한테 구슬을 몽땅 털렸다더라고요.

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: 당신한테 딱 맞는 퀘스트 같지 않아요?

english: Thanks for your help.
Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: 네, Mizgog(미즈고그)는 알아요. 임프 문제는 벌써 도와줬어요. 그 구슬 찾느라 한참 걸렸다고요!

english: Imps will be imps!
Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 쉬운 걸로 부탁해요, 여기 처음 왔거든요.

english: I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: 작고 쉬운 일이라면 잔뜩 알려 줄 수 있죠.

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 요리사가 곤란한 일을 겪고 있고, 공작님은 이상한 부적 때문에 골머리를 앓고 있고, 게다가 Varrock(바록)에 사는 불쌍한 청년 Romeo(로미오)는 여자 친구 문제로 고민 중이에요.

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 요리사 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: 참 웃긴 얘기죠. 그 요리사는 머리가 목에 붙어 있지 않았으면 머리까지 어디 두고 다녔을 사람이에요. 이번엔 Duke(공작)님 생일 케이크 재료를 사 오는 걸 깜빡했대요.

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 좀 도와줄래요? Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 부엌에 가면 아마 있을 거예요.

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 공작님의 이상한 부적 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Duke of Lumbridge(럼브리지 공작)님이 아무도 정체를 모르는 이상한 부적을 발견했대요. 좀 도와줄래요? 아마 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 위층에 계실 거예요.

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: 신비롭네요. 한번 가 볼지도 모르겠어요. 고마워요.

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
translation: 네, Rune mysteries(룬의 비밀)은 벌써 풀었어요.

english: Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: Romeo(로미오)랑 그 여자 친구 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: Varrock(바록)에 있는 Romeo(로미오)가 사랑하는 Juliet(줄리엣)을 찾는 데 도움이 필요하대요. 당신이 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: 물론 당신이 Juliet(줄리엣)을 먼저 찾는다면, 그땐 그녀가 Romeo(로미오)를 잃어버린 셈이겠지만요.

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: 네, 못 찾을 리가 없어요. 광장에서 정처 없이 헤매고 있거든요.

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: 아, 네, Romeo(로미오)는 제가 할 수 있는 최선의 방법으로 벌써 도와줬어요...

english: Really?
Yup.
...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
translation: 그 사람, Juliet(줄리엣)이 죽은 줄 알아요...

english: Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: 저는 싸움보다는 생각하는 쪽이에요. 스킬 관련된 거 없어요?

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)에서 지식을 넓혀 가려면 스킬이 아주 중요해요. 시작하기 좋은 스킬 관련 퀘스트를 몇 개 알고 있어요.

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: 누군가의 crafting(공예) 솜씨가 필요한 Fred the farmer(농부 프레드)를 도와줄 수도 있고요.

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: 아니면 심부름꾼이 필요한 Doric the dwarf(드워프 도릭)도 있죠.

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: Fred the farmer(농부 프레드) 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: Fred(프레드)는 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 양 목장 옆에 있어요. 가서 얘기해 보는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: Fred the farmer(농부 프레드)는 벌써 도와줬어요. 양털을 깎아서 balls of wool(양털 뭉치)를 20개 만들어 줬죠.

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
translation: 그 사람이 안 볼 때까지 기다려야 할 거예요.

english: Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
translation: Doric the dwarf(드워프 도릭) 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: Doric the dwarf(드워프 도릭)은 Falador(팔라도르) 북쪽에 있어요. smithing(대장일)을 도와줄 수 있을 거예요. 가서 얘기해 봐요. 자기 anvils(모루)를 쓰게 해 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: 네, Doric(도릭)한테는 벌써 다녀왔어요. 간단한 심부름을 해 줬더니 기꺼이 모루를 쓰게 해 주더라고요.

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 이것저것 다 해 보고 싶은데, 그런 거 아는 거 있어요?

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: 당연하죠. Gielinor(길리노르)는 엄청 넓은 곳이잖아요. 어디 보자...

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: Rimmington(림밍턴)에 있는 Hetty the witch(마녀 헤티)라면 마법 능력 쪽으로 도움을 줄 수 있을 거예요..

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: 그리고 지금 Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 해적들이 정박해 있어요. 해적이 있는 곳엔 보물도 멀지 않은 법이죠...

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: 아니면 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택)에서 길을 잃은 Ernest(어니스트)를 도와줄 수도 있어요. 거기 으스스한 곳이에요.

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.
translation: Hetty the witch(마녀 헤티) 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: Hetty the witch(마녀 헤티)는 Falador(팔라도르) 남쪽 Rimmington(림밍턴)에 있어요. 지금 새 물약을 연구하고 있대요. 좀 거들어 주는 게 어때요? 마법 능력에 도움을 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: 알겠어요, 고마워요. 저를 감자 같은 걸로 바꿔 버리지 않기만 바라야겠네요..

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: 네, Hetty(헤티)한테는 벌써 다녀왔어요. 물약 만드는 걸 도와줬더니 초우주적인 힘을 줬다고요! 생각 하나만으로 당신을 날려 버릴 수도 있을걸요!

english: Did she really?
No not really...
Right.....
Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
translation: Pirate's Treasure(해적의 보물) 얘기 좀 해 주세요.

english: RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 술집 Rusty Anchor(녹슨 닻)에 있는 RedBeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)가 Gielinor(길리노르) 어딘가에 묻혀 있다는 보물 소문을 알려 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: 모험다운 얘기네요, 한번 가 봐야겠어요. 고마워요.

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: 야르, 그렇고말고요, 친구. 아주 훌륭한 발견이에요.

english: Yarr!
Yarrr!
YARRR!
Right, that's enough of that!
..Sorry.
Tell me about Ernest please.
The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 대문 앞에서 시작하는 게 제일 좋을 거예요. 거기 있는 Veronica(베로니카)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 거예요.

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
translation: 거긴 조심해서 다니는 게 좋아요. 귀신이 나오거든요.

english: Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: 재밌겠네요. 유령의 저택은 한 번도 안 가 봤어요.

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: 네, Ernest(어니스트)는 벌써 찾았어요. Professor Oddenstein(오든스타인 교수)가 그를 닭으로 만들어 놨더라고요!

english: A chicken!?
Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: 네, 닭이요. 그래도 더 나빴을 수도 있었죠.

english: Very true, poor guy.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 머리는 어디서 하면 돼요?

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
translation: 그러게요, 미용사한테 좀 가 봐야 할 것 같긴 하네요.

english: Oh thanks!
No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: 천만에요. Falador(팔라도르)에 있는 미용사라면 해결해 줄 거예요.

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: 길을 모르겠으면 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 잡화점에서 파는 지도가 쓸 만해요.

english: What's up?
I assume the sky is up..
You assume?
Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: 네, 안타깝게도 제가 고개를 못 드는 것 같아서요.

english: Can I buy your stick?
It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: 막대기 아니거든요! 이래 봬도 아주 강력한 지팡이라고요!

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: 정말요? 어떤 힘이 있는지 보여 줘요!

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
It's a stick isn't it?
...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...네, 막대기예요.. 하지만 지팡이 살 돈을 모을 때까지만이에요. Varrock square(바록 광장)의 Zaff(자프)가 자기 가게에서 팔거든요.

english: Well good luck with that.
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 저한테 줄 만한 값나가는 물건 있어요?

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
Well... er... yes.
No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: 아뇨, 줄 수 있는 건 하나도 없어요. 값나가는 게 있다 해도 남한테 주고 싶진 않을 거고요.

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
No it's not!
No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
Fool! Leave me alone!
Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 성 지하실에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아요?

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: 벽이 무너졌다나 뭐라나 들었어요. 이유는 몰라요. 당신이 이 수수께끼의 밑바닥까지 파헤쳐 보면 어때요!

english: Where am I?
How are you today?
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 제가 할 만한 퀘스트 아는 거 있어요?

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
Are there any quests I can do here?
I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: 싸움 좀 해 보고 싶은데, 위험한 거 없어요?

english: Big scary demons!
Vampyres!
Small.. something small would be good.
Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
translation: 쉬운 걸로 부탁해요, 여기 처음 왔거든요.

english: The Lumbridge cook.
The Duke's strange talisman.
Romeo and his girlfriend.
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: 저는 싸움보다는 생각하는 쪽이에요. 스킬 관련된 거 없어요?

english: Fred the farmer.
Doric the dwarf.
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 이것저것 다 해 보고 싶은데, 그런 거 아는 거 있어요?

english: Hetty the Witch.
Pirate's treasure.
Ernest and Draynor Manor.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 머리는 어디서 하면 돼요?

english: What's up?
Can I buy your stick?
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 저한테 줄 만한 값나가는 물건 있어요?

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 성 지하실에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아요?

english: Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 살인 사건 해결을 도와주셔서 정말 감사합니다.

english: Here you go.
Donovan has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Dooooom!
Where?
All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
translation: 우리 사방에요! 공기 중에서 느껴지고, 바람결에 들리고, 냄새도 나요... 그것도 공기 중에서요!

english: Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 이 파멸을 막으려면 우리가 뭘 할 수 있을까요?

english: There is nothing you need to do my friend! I am the Doomsayer, although my real title could be something like the Danger Tutor.
translation: 당신은 아무것도 안 해도 돼요, 친구! 난 Doomsayer(파멸의 예언자)예요. 진짜 직함은 위험 교사쯤 되려나요.

english: Danger Tutor?
Yes! I roam the world sensing danger.
translation: 그래요! 난 세상을 떠돌며 위험을 감지하죠.

english: If you see the signs often enough, then you can turn them off; by that time you likely know what the area has in store for you.
translation: 경고문을 충분히 자주 봤다면 꺼 버려도 돼요. 그쯤이면 그 지역에 뭐가 기다리는지 이미 알고 있을 테니까요.

english: If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
translation: 위험한 지역을 발견하면 그곳이 왜 위험한지 알려 주는 경고문을 세워 두죠.

english: But what if I want to see the warnings again?
translation: 그런데 경고문을 다시 보고 싶으면 어떡하죠?

english: That's why I'm waiting here!
translation: 그래서 내가 여기서 기다리고 있는 거예요!

english: If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
translation: 경고 메시지를 다시 보고 싶으면 내가 다시 켜 줄 수 있어요.

english: Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning messages.
translation: 고마워요, 경고 메시지가 보이면 기억해 둘게요.

english: You're welcome!
Do you need to turn on any warnings right now?
Yes, I do.
Not right now.
Ok, keep an eye out for the messages though!
I will.
You got lucky this time, next time doom will be upon you.
translation: 이번엔 운이 좋았군요. 다음번엔 파멸이 당신을 덮칠 거예요.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Try again!
translation: 어떻게 그럴 수가? 다시 해 봐요!

english: Spot on!
I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
That way doom lies, I cannot comply. Your protection will be finished in less than 5 minutes.
translation: 그 길엔 파멸뿐, 들어줄 수 없어요. 보호는 5분 안에 끝날 거예요.

english: Are you sure? Much doom lies that way and it can not be undone!
translation: 정말이에요? 그 길엔 엄청난 파멸이 기다리고, 되돌릴 수도 없어요!

english: Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 네, 지금 바로 PvP 보호를 해제해 주세요.

english: On your head be it!
Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 네, PvP 보호가 1분 뒤에 끝나게 해 주세요.

english: Much doom be with you.
You have 1 minute of PvP protection left.
On second thoughts, leave it.
Yes, I do.
Not right now.
Is there anything we can do about this doom?
translation: 이 파멸을 막으려면 우리가 뭘 할 수 있을까요?

english: I'd like to remove my PvP protection.
Yes, remove my PvP protection right now.
translation: 네, 지금 바로 PvP 보호를 해제해 주세요.

english: Yes, arrange for my PvP protection to end in 1 minute.
translation: 네, PvP 보호가 1분 뒤에 끝나게 해 주세요.

english: On second thoughts, leave it.
Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?
translation: 어서 오게, 여행자. 내 소박한 대장간엔 무슨 일로 왔나?

english: I wanted to use your anvils.
My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work. If you could get me some more materials, then I could let you use them.
translation: 내 anvils(모루)는 나 혼자 쓰기에도 바쁘다네. 난 곡괭이를 만드는데, 그게 아주 고된 일이거든. 재료를 좀 더 구해 준다면 쓰게 해 줄 수도 있네.

english: Yes, I will get you the materials.

Clay is what I use more than anything, to make casts. Could you get me 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore, please? I could pay a little, and let you use my anvils. Take this pickaxe with you just in case you need it.
translation: 주물 틀을 만들 때 무엇보다 많이 쓰는 게 clay(점토)라네. 점토 6개, copper ore(구리 광석) 4개, iron ore(철광석) 2개를 구해 주겠나? 약간의 보수도 주고 모루도 쓰게 해 주지. 혹시 필요할지 모르니 이 pickaxe(곡괭이)를 가져가게.

english: Where can I find those?
You'll be able to find all those ores in the rocks just inside the Dwarven Mine. Head east from here and you'll find the entrance in the side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 그 광석들은 전부 Dwarven Mine(드워프 광산) 안쪽 바위에서 찾을 수 있을 걸세. 여기서 동쪽으로 가면 Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 비탈에 입구가 있네.

english: Certainly, I'll be right back!
You know, it's funny you should require those exact things!
translation: 그런데요, 딱 그 물건들이 필요하시다니 참 신기하네요!

english: What do you mean?
I can usually fit 28 things in my backpack and in a world full of quite literally limitless possibilities, a complete coincidence has occurred!
translation: 제 배낭엔 보통 28개가 들어가는데, 말 그대로 무한한 가능성으로 가득 찬 세상에서 완벽한 우연이 일어났지 뭐예요!

english: I don't quite understand what you're saying?
translation: 자네가 무슨 말을 하는지 잘 모르겠네만?

english: Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!
translation: 그러니까, 순전히 우연으로, 뭘 부탁하실지 전혀 몰랐는데도, 마침 딱 그 물건들을 들고 있었다니까요!

english: In fact, in the exact quantities too!
Oh my, that is a coincidence! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
translation: 이런, 정말 우연이로군! 이리 건네주게. 수고비로 코인을 좀 주겠네. 그리고 내 모루는 언제든 마음껏 쓰게나.

english: Quest complete!
No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 아뇨, 바위 두들기는 건 지루한 사람들이나 하는 거예요, 죄송해요.

english: That is your choice. Nice to meet you anyway.
translation: 그건 자네 선택이지. 어쨌든 만나서 반가웠네.

english: I wanted to use your whetstone.
The whetstone is for more advanced smithing, but I could let you use it as well as my anvils if you could get me some more materials.
translation: whetstone(숫돌)은 좀 더 고급 대장일에 쓰는 거라네. 하지만 재료를 좀 더 구해 준다면 모루와 함께 그것도 쓰게 해 주지.

english: Mind your own business, shortstuff!
How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners. Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!
translation: 이렇게 예의 바른 사람을 만나다니 참 반갑구먼. 자네보다 작은 사람한테 소리 지르고 싶을 땐 언제든 또 오게!

english: I was just checking out the landscape.
Hope you like it. I do enjoy the solitude of my little home. If you get time, please say hi to my friends in the Dwarven Mine.
translation: 마음에 들면 좋겠군. 난 이 작은 집의 고요함이 참 좋다네. 시간이 나면 Dwarven Mine(드워프 광산)에 있는 내 친구들한테 안부 좀 전해 주게.

english: Dwarven Mine?
Yep, the entrance is in the side of Ice Mountain just to the east of here. They're a friendly bunch. Stop in at Nurmof's store and buy one of my pickaxes!
translation: 그래, 여기서 바로 동쪽 Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 비탈에 입구가 있네. 다들 친절한 친구들이지. Nurmof(누르모프)의 가게에 들러서 내가 만든 곡괭이 하나 사 가게!

english: Will do!
What do you make here?
I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor.
translation: 곡괭이를 만들지. Gielinor(길리노르)를 통틀어 내가 최고의 곡괭이 장인일세.

english: Do you have any to sell?
Who's Nurmof?
Nurmof has a store over in the Dwarven Mine. You can find the entrance on the side of Ice Mountain to the east of here.
translation: Nurmof(누르모프)는 Dwarven Mine(드워프 광산)에서 가게를 하고 있네. 여기서 동쪽 Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 비탈에서 입구를 찾을 수 있을 걸세.

english: Ah, fair enough.
Hey, who said you could use that? My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work.
translation: 이보게, 누가 그걸 써도 된다고 했나? 내 모루는 나 혼자 쓰기에도 바쁘다네. 난 곡괭이를 만드는데, 그게 아주 고된 일이거든.

english: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
If you could get me some more materials then I could let you use them.
translation: 재료를 좀 더 구해 준다면 쓰게 해 줄 수도 있네.

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
That is your choice.
Hello traveller, how is your metalworking coming along?
translation: 어서 오게, 여행자. 금속 다루는 일은 잘돼 가나?

english: Not too bad, Doric.
Good, the love of metal is a thing close to my heart.
translation: 좋아, 금속을 사랑하는 마음은 내 가슴 깊이 간직한 것이라네.

english: Well done.
So, you've come to the right place?
I wanted to use your anvils.
Yes.
Where can I find those?
Certainly, I'll be right back!
No.
I want to use your whetstone.
Mind your own business, shortstuff!
I was just checking out the landscape.
Dwarven Mine?
Will do!
What do you make here?
Who's Nurmof?
Ah, fair enough.
Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?
Yes, I will get you materials.
No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
translation: 아뇨, 바위 두들기는 건 지루한 사람들이나 하는 거예요, 죄송해요.

english: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.
Hello again dearie. How are you doing?
Pretty good!
That's good to hear.
Not too good actually!
Oh well.
What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: wilderness(황야) 바로 옆에 사는 건 어때요?

english: Oh, it's not all that bad. It was a bit scary at first but as long as I don't go past the warning signs I'm all right.
translation: 어머, 생각만큼 나쁘진 않아요. 처음엔 좀 무서웠지만 경고 표지판만 안 넘어가면 괜찮답니다.

english: It's actually pretty quiet here. I used to live in Lumbridge and, let me tell you, that's the dangerous place for people like me.
translation: 여긴 오히려 꽤 조용해요. 예전엔 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 살았는데, 내 말 좀 들어 봐요, 나 같은 사람한텐 거기가 진짜 위험한 곳이었어요.

english: Thieves were picking people's pockets with impunity, and killing them on the streets in broad daylight!
translation: 도둑들이 대놓고 사람들 주머니를 털고, 대낮에 길거리에서 사람을 죽이기까지 했다니까요!

english: And there weren't even any guards to protect us! Not that the guards in the other cities do much good to protect people from what I've heard.
translation: 게다가 우릴 지켜 줄 경비병도 하나 없었어요! 듣자 하니 다른 도시 경비병들도 사람들을 지키는 데 별 도움이 안 된다지만요.

english: I just thank goodness I haven't got an Attack option any more! I wouldn't last five minutes!
translation: 이젠 나한테 공격 옵션이 없어서 정말 다행이에요! 그랬다간 5분도 못 버텼을 거예요!

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
Oh, I don't know really. He's always been evil, I think. Maybe growing up so close to the wilderness has affected him in some way.
translation: 글쎄, 나도 잘 모르겠어요. 원래부터 늘 사악했던 것 같아요. wilderness(황야) 근처에서 자라서 뭔가 영향을 받았나 봐요.

english: When he was little he used to want to go into Edgeville dungeon. You know how kids are, always wanting to be dungeon adventurers! But he didn't want to be a hero, he wanted to be a monster!
translation: 어릴 땐 Edgeville dungeon(에지빌 던전)에 들어가고 싶어 했어요. 애들이 다 그렇잖아요, 던전 모험가가 되고 싶어 하고! 근데 그 애는 영웅이 아니라 괴물이 되고 싶어 했어요!

english: And then he spent all summer building a tree-house. Except it wasn't a tree-house, of course, it was his Tower of Fear!
translation: 그러더니 여름 내내 나무집을 지었죠. 물론 나무집이 아니라 자기 Tower of Fear(공포의 탑)였지만요!

english: Of course I was hoping he'd have grown out of it by now and maybe even left home. But at least it keeps him happy.
translation: 지금쯤이면 철이 들어서 독립이라도 했으면 했는데 말이에요. 그래도 그게 그 애를 행복하게 해 주니까요.

english: Hello again.
May I use your spices for making stew?
translation: 스튜 만드는 데 향신료 좀 써도 될까요?

english: You can if you can find them. Dave's hell-rats stole them all!
translation: 찾을 수만 있다면 써도 돼요. Dave(데이브)의 hell-rats(지옥 쥐)가 몽땅 훔쳐 갔거든요!

english: I'd better go and kill some hell-rats then.
translation: 그럼 가서 hell-rats(지옥 쥐)를 좀 잡아야겠네요.

english: Hello again. Did you make your stew?
I haven't been able to make any stew that Dave likes yet.
translation: 아직 Dave(데이브) 입맛에 맞는 스튜를 못 만들었어요.

english: Oh, he's terribly hard to please, isn't he? I never know how to make food evil enough for him, I just have to try different things and see what he likes.
translation: 어휴, 그 애 비위 맞추기가 정말 힘들죠? 나도 음식을 얼마나 사악하게 만들어야 하는지 도통 모르겠어요. 이것저것 해 보고 그 애가 뭘 좋아하는지 보는 수밖에요.

english: What's happened to my cat?
Oh, poor thing. The hell-rats do that, you know. I think a nice drink of milk would sort it out. Shall I give it one?
translation: 어머, 가엾어라. hell-rats(지옥 쥐)들이 그렇게 만든답니다. 우유 한 모금이면 괜찮아질 것 같은데. 내가 좀 줄까요?

english: Yes please!
Here puss...
Your hell-cat transforms into an ordinary cat.
translation: 당신의 hell-cat(지옥 고양이)가 평범한 고양이로 변했다.

english: No, I like it this way.
Well, I suppose as long as the cat is all right, it doesn't matter what it looks like.
You've found another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
Pretty good!
Not too good actually
What's it like living so close to the wilderness?
translation: wilderness(황야) 바로 옆에 사는 건 어때요?

english: How did Dave come to be evil?
I haven't been able to make some stew that Dave likes yet.
translation: 아직 Dave(데이브) 입맛에 맞는 스튜를 못 만들었어요.

english: What's happened to my cat?
Yes please!
No, I like it this way.
I expect you to die!
Can't talk now, pies to make! Bread to bake! Breaks to take!
translation: 지금 얘기할 틈 없어요, 파이도 굽고! 빵도 굽고! 쉬는 시간도 챙기고!

english: You seem a bit stressed.
Far from it, just busy busy busy! Best way to be!
translation: 전혀요, 그냥 바쁘고 바쁘고 바쁠 뿐이에요! 그게 최고죠!

english: Oi!
I've got to go!
Hello, I need some yeastier dough, do you have any?
translation: 안녕하세요, yeastier dough(이스터 반죽)이 좀 필요한데, 있나요?

english: Yeastier dough? I don't know.
What is that?
I think it's just particularly yeasty dough.
translation: 그냥 이스트가 유난히 많이 든 반죽 아닐까요.

english: And why would I give you any of my lovely dough?
translation: 그리고 내 소중한 반죽을 왜 줘야 하죠?

english: I'm making some Easter Buns to cheer up the Easter Bunny.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 기운 좀 북돋아 주려고 Easter Buns(부활절 빵)을 만들고 있거든요.

english: Oh that silly Eggrabbit! Anything for him.
translation: 아, 그 엉뚱한 Eggrabbit(달걀토끼)! 그 녀석을 위해서라면 뭐든지요.

english: Of course you'll need space to carry the dough, come back when you can handle it.
translation: 물론 반죽을 들고 갈 자리가 있어야겠죠. 들 수 있을 때 다시 와요.

english: Alright.
Here you go, yeastier dough.
It's potent stuff!
Thank you, that's very kind of you.
Hello!
You again! What is it now?
Thanks for the dough.
You're welcome!
I need to get back to work now.
Okay, I'll talk to you later. Bye!
translation: 알겠어요, 나중에 또 얘기해요. 안녕히 계세요!

english: Quick quick, only a moment to spare, what's up?
translation: 빨리빨리, 잠깐밖에 시간 없어요, 무슨 일이에요?

english: I need more of that yeastier dough.
translation: 그 yeastier dough(이스터 반죽)이 더 필요해요.

english: Though thinking about it, I don't have enough space at the moment. I'll come back.
translation: 그런데 생각해 보니 지금 자리가 부족하네요. 다시 올게요.

english: Yes yes, come back. Very good.
Alright, alright, here you go. Please keep in mind I'm not made of dough.
translation: 알았어요, 알았어, 여기요. 내가 반죽으로 만들어진 것도 아니라는 거 좀 알아줘요.

english: You look like you are, all covered in flour.
Occupational hazard! You get used to it.
I hope you put that dough to good use.
Oh I did indeed.
theyrecomingtogetme theyrecomingtogetme...
It is all you deserve. Lord Rologarth is master of this castle once more. Let him protect you - if he wants to.
translation: 넌 그런 꼴을 당해도 싸. Lord Rologarth(롤로가스 경)이 다시 이 성의 주인이 됐어. 그분한테 지켜 달라고 해 봐 - 그분이 원한다면 말이지.

english: What, what do you want?
Why are you out here on your own?
I was drawn here... I use to be a traveling doctor, until I arrived in Al Kharid.
translation: 이끌려 왔지... 난 원래 떠돌이 의사였어, Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 오기 전까진.

english: Then I heard it call to me... I immediately gave up my profession and set up here.
translation: 그러다 그게 날 부르는 소리를 들었지... 그 즉시 의사 일을 그만두고 여기 자리를 잡았어.

english: I'm happy here... the voices tell me I'm happy here. I can continue my work.
translation: 난 여기서 행복해... 목소리들이 내가 여기서 행복하다고 말해 주거든. 연구를 계속할 수 있어.

english: Uhh... what voices? There is no one else here.
translation: 어... 무슨 목소리요? 여긴 아무도 없는데요.

english: Of course there isn't, the hole you idiot, the hole speaks to me and I listen... It says I will do great things, only if I listen...
translation: 당연히 없지, 구멍 말이야, 이 멍청아. 구멍이 나한테 말을 걸고 난 그걸 듣는 거야... 내가 귀를 기울이기만 하면 위대한 일을 해낼 거래...

english: Well... alright then, I think I'm just going to go and leave then.
translation: 음... 알겠어요, 그럼 전 그냥 가 볼게요.

english: Hello. What brings you to my surgery today?
Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.
translation: 자, 이건 저보다 당신이 더 아플 거예요.

english: You look healthy to me!
What did you do before you worked here?
Oh, I used to be a travelling surgeon. Whenever I saw someone have an accident, I'd be there to check for concussion and offer treatment.
translation: 아, 예전엔 떠돌이 외과 의사였어요. 누가 사고를 당하는 걸 보면 바로 달려가서 뇌진탕은 없는지 살피고 치료해 줬죠.

english: It was a worthy cause, but I didn't feel properly appreciated, so I retired. Then I got bored, so I came to work here.
translation: 보람 있는 일이었지만 제대로 인정받는 느낌이 안 들어서 은퇴했어요. 그러다 심심해져서 여기 일하러 왔죠.

english: So can I help you with something?
Nothing, I'm fine.
Can you heal me?
translation: 저 좀 치료해 주실 수 있나요?

english: What did you do before you worked here?
Nothing, I'm fine.
Buy me a drrink pleassh...
I think you've had enough.
Have you got any guam leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a guam leaf.
translation: guam leaf(구암 잎) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 구암 잎이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: I don't have any.
Fair enough. Here, have a spare potion, and thanks for your time.
translation: 그렇군요. 자, 남는 물약 하나 드릴게요. 시간 내 주셔서 고마워요.

english: Have you got any torstol? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a torstol.
translation: torstol(토르스톨) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 토르스톨이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Here you are.
Thank you so much! Here, take this potion in return.
translation: 정말 고마워요! 자, 보답으로 이 물약을 받으세요.

english: No, I need it myself.
Have you got any dwarf weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a dwarf weed.
translation: dwarf weed(드워프 풀) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 드워프 풀이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any lantadyme? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a lantadyme.
translation: lantadyme(란타다임) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 란타다임이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any cadantine? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a cadantine.
translation: cadantine(카단틴) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 카단틴이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any snapdragon? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a snapdragon.
translation: snapdragon(금어초) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 금어초가 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any kwuarm? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a kwuarm.
translation: kwuarm(크와암) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 크와암이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any avantoe? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with aavantoe.
translation: avantoe(아반토) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 아반토가 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any irit leaf? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with airit leaf.
translation: irit leaf(이리트 잎) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 이리트 잎이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any toadflax? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a toadflax.
translation: toadflax(해란초) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 해란초가 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any ranarr weed? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a ranarr weed.
translation: ranarr weed(라나르 풀) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 라나르 풀이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any harralander? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a harralander.
translation: harralander(하랄랜더) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 하랄랜더가 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any tarromin? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a tarromin.
translation: tarromin(타로민) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 타로민이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Have you got any marrentill? I've fixed my Hyde problem, so it's not urgent, but I could do with a marrentill.
translation: marrentill(마렌틸) 있으세요? Hyde(하이드) 문제는 해결해서 급한 건 아니지만, 마렌틸이 하나 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: I'll be off now.
Excuse me, I must be off now.
Sorry, I'm trying to get a herb from [player name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 죄송해요, [player name]님한테 약초를 좀 받으려는데, [he/she]는 절 못 본 척하는 것 같네요.

english: Hello, [player name]. I need a herb.
Hey, [player name]!
Excuse me, [player name]?
Can you hear me, [player name]?
I just need a herb, [player name]!
I'll give you a free potion, [player name]!
Maybe later.
Here you are.
No, I need it myself.
Quack!
Looking to trade?
What have you got?
Take a look.
No thanks.
Then we have nothing more to discuss.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병을 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: What have you got?
No thanks.
What are you doing in my house...why the impertinence...the sheer cheek...how dare you violate my personal lodgings....
translation: 내 집에서 뭘 하는 거냐... 이 무례함이라니... 이 뻔뻔함이라니... 감히 내 개인 거처를 침범하다니....

english: I..I was just looking around....
Well get out! Get out....this is my house....and don't go near my daughter Juliet...she's grounded in her room to keep her away from that good for nothing Romeo.
translation: 그럼 썩 나가! 나가라고....여긴 내 집이야....그리고 내 딸 Juliet(줄리엣) 근처엔 얼씬도 마라...그 쓸모없는 Romeo(로미오) 놈한테서 떼어 놓으려고 방에 가둬 뒀으니까.

english: Yes....sir....
What are you doing here? Snooping around...
translation: 여기서 뭘 하는 거냐? 기웃거리기나 하고...

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
What...what...Romeo! Why that good for nothing swine...he's always trying to get the affections of my daughter..that soppy, half brained nincompoop won't ever have the heart of my daughter.
translation: 뭐...뭐라고...Romeo(로미오)! 그 쓸모없는 돼지 같은 놈...그놈은 맨날 내 딸 환심을 사려고 안달이지..그 물러 터진 반푼이 멍청이는 절대 내 딸 마음을 얻지 못할 거다.

english: She deserves someone of character, wit and repose.
translation: 내 딸에겐 인품 있고, 재치 있고, 차분한 사람이 어울려.

english: What's so wrong about Romeo?
Wrong! What's wrong with him...have you actually talked to him? He's nothing but a dim witted upperclass twit, totally useless.
translation: 문제! 그놈 문제가 뭐냐고...너 그놈이랑 얘기는 해 봤냐? 그냥 머리 텅 빈 상류층 얼간이야, 완전히 쓸모없지.

english: If he threw a stone at the ground, he'd probably miss! He's totally invisible when it's raining because he's so wet!
translation: 그놈은 땅에 대고 돌을 던져도 아마 빗나갈 거다! 비 오는 날엔 아예 보이지도 않아, 워낙 물러 터져서 빗물이랑 구분이 안 되거든!

english: If you started with what's right with him, you'd have much less to consider!
translation: 차라리 그놈의 괜찮은 점부터 꼽아 봐라, 그게 훨씬 금방 끝날 테니!

english: Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...
translation: 뭐, 인정해요. 머리가 썩 날카로운 편은 아니긴 하죠...

english: Sharp? I've seen keener wit in root vegetables. Anyway, stop changing the subject. Get out of here and don't think you can sneak up those stairs to see Juliet, because I'll catch you and then you'll be for it!
translation: 날카로워? 뿌리채소도 그놈보단 예리하겠다. 아무튼 말 돌리지 마라. 당장 나가고, 계단으로 몰래 올라가서 Juliet(줄리엣)을 만날 생각은 꿈도 꾸지 마. 내가 잡으면 넌 끝장이야!

english: That seems a bit harsh....
Harsh but fair I think you'll find...now get OUT!
I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: 그냥 Juliet(줄리엣)이랑 얘기 좀 하러 왔어요.

english: What on earth about? I hope you're not in cahoots with that good for nothing Romeo!
translation: 대체 무슨 얘기? 설마 그 쓸모없는 Romeo(로미오) 놈이랑 한패는 아니겠지!

english: Err..no of course not....why would I be?

He's been trying to wooo my daughter for an age. Up until now she's had the good sense to just ignore him. I just don't know what's gotten into her recently so that she would give him the time of day.
translation: 그놈은 오래전부터 내 딸한테 수작을 걸어 왔어. 지금까진 딸애가 현명하게 그냥 무시했는데. 요즘 딸애가 무슨 바람이 들어서 그놈을 상대해 주는지 모르겠다.

english: Well, love is mysterious! Perhaps one day someone may even learn to love you!
translation: 뭐, 사랑은 원래 신비로운 거잖아요! 언젠가 누군가 어르신을 사랑하게 될지도 모르죠!

english: What! Someone may fall in love with me...what are you trying to insinuate?
translation: 뭐라고! 누가 나를 사랑하게 될지도 모른다고...지금 무슨 소리를 하려는 거냐?

english: Err...Nothing....I guess I'd better be going now...
translation: 어...아무것도 아니에요....전 이만 가 보는 게 좋겠네요...

english: Oh...just looking around...
Just looking around! This is MY house! You might have at least 'ASKED' to view my considerably well appointed abode...but no, you've just burst in with all the elegance of a Troll at a tea party.
translation: 그냥 둘러보고 있었다고! 여긴 내 집이야! 이 꽤나 훌륭하게 꾸민 내 거처를 구경하고 싶으면 적어도 '물어보기'라도 했어야지...그런데 넌 다과회에 난입한 Troll(트롤)만큼이나 우아하게 쳐들어왔구나.

english: I can see that you're busy ranting so I'll just nip off and investigate a bit.
translation: 한창 열변을 토하시느라 바쁘신 것 같으니, 전 슬쩍 가서 좀 조사해 볼게요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What are you doing in my house? Up to no good I shouldn't wonder!
translation: 내 집에서 뭘 하는 거냐? 분명 수상한 짓을 꾸미고 있겠지!

english: Just a small chore for Juliet, you do have a lovely daughter in her sir.
translation: Juliet(줄리엣) 심부름을 좀 하는 중이에요. 정말 사랑스러운 따님을 두셨네요, 어르신.

english: Oh...why, thank you...I've always tried to my best...
translation: 오...아니, 고맙구나...나도 늘 최선을 다하려고 했지...

english: ...Hang on! Enough of that smiley talk. I have a daughter and I know what she's like. Don't even think of carrying on anything behind my back, I have the eyes of a hawk, nothing gets past me!
translation: ...잠깐! 그런 아부는 그만둬. 내 딸이 어떤 애인지는 내가 잘 알아. 내 뒤에서 무슨 짓을 꾸밀 생각은 하지도 마라, 나는 매의 눈을 가졌으니 아무것도 내 눈을 못 피해!

english: Hey! What's that in your hands...looks like a message to me...with Juliet's barely legible scrawl on it...
translation: 이봐! 손에 든 그건 뭐냐...내가 보기엔 쪽지 같은데...Juliet(줄리엣)의 알아보기도 힘든 글씨가 휘갈겨져 있고...

english: Yes, yes, that's probably why I can't read it!
translation: 네, 네, 그래서 제가 못 읽는 거군요!

english: Sorry, I mean, that's right sir. I'm just popping to the shops to get some groceries for Juliet.
translation: 죄송해요, 그러니까, 맞아요 어르신. Juliet(줄리엣) 대신 장 좀 보러 가게에 잠깐 다녀오려고요.

english: Right, have to be off now...thanks...
Groceries!
Groceries!...at a time like this, does that girl know what she's putting me through!
translation: 장을 본다고!...이런 때에, 그 애는 내가 얼마나 속을 끓이는지 알기나 하는 거냐!

english: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be like that freeloading Romeo!
translation: 너 여기 사냐? 그렇다면 집세로 몇백 골드 정도 보태는 게 어떠냐? 제 몫은 내야지...그 빈대 같은 Romeo(로미오) 놈처럼 되고 싶진 않겠지!

english: Hey , what are you doing here?
Nothing much sir...I promise...I'm just an innocent friend of Juliet's...doing her a few favours...as a friend.
translation: 별거 아니에요 어르신...정말이에요...전 그냥 Juliet(줄리엣)의 순수한 친구예요...친구로서 부탁 몇 가지 들어주는 것뿐이에요.

english: Well, just make sure there's no funny business going on that's all I can say. Do you know why?
translation: 흠, 수상한 짓만 안 벌어지면 된다. 내가 할 말은 그것뿐이야. 왜 그런지 아냐?

english: I think I can guess sir...
There's no need to guess! You can see it in my hawk like eyes, in my cat like ears and my dog like nose...
translation: 짐작할 필요도 없지! 내 매 같은 눈, 고양이 같은 귀, 사냥개 같은 코를 보면 알 수 있을 거다...

english: Are you saying that you look like an animal sir?
NO! Not look like an animal! I have the keen 'SENSES' of an animal and I don't miss a thing. Don't even think about trying anything!
translation: 아니! 동물처럼 생겼다는 게 아니야! 동물처럼 예리한 '감각'을 가졌다는 거다, 난 아무것도 놓치지 않아. 허튼짓은 생각도 하지 마라!

english: Hey! What's that in your hands? Looks like some sort of potion to me!
translation: 이봐! 손에 든 그건 뭐냐? 무슨 물약 같은데!

english: Err...no! Nope! Not a potion! Some medicine...I have a terrible cough ...cough...cough....see?
translation: 어...아뇨! 아니에요! 물약 아니에요! 그냥 약이에요...기침이 너무 심해서요 ...콜록...콜록....보이시죠?

english: >Except, I can't drink too much or else it makes me feel 'really' tired. One sip of this and the lights go out...I mean, I'm asleep in a minute.
translation: >다만, 너무 많이 마시면 '정말' 피곤해져요. 한 모금만 마셔도 불이 꺼지듯...아니, 금방 잠들어 버리거든요.

english: Sleep!
Sleep...! How can you even think of such a thing at a time like this? And I hope you have no intentions of sleeping in my house!
translation: 잠이라니...! 이런 때에 어떻게 그런 생각을 할 수가 있냐? 그리고 내 집에서 잘 생각은 꿈에도 하지 마라!

english: You'll get a bill for rent if I catch you dozing off around here!
translation: 여기서 꾸벅꾸벅 조는 걸 내가 보면 집세 청구서를 받게 될 줄 알아!

english: My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!
translation: 불쌍한 내 Juliet(줄리엣)....죽었어...죽었다고! 그렇게 모질게 대하는 게 아니었는데...내 사랑스러운 딸이었는데. 으허엉 허엉 허어엉!

english: I suppose you're quite pleased with yourself now...
My house is going to be ruined, why did I agree to throwing this blasted party?
translation: 내 집이 엉망이 되겠군, 내가 왜 이 망할 파티를 열자고 했을까?

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: 그냥 Juliet(줄리엣)이랑 얘기 좀 하러 왔어요.

english: Oh...just looking around...
Ok, thanks.
Ask about the birthday party.
Something else.
Hey there, what can I do for ya?
My name is Drew and I man this here grinding machine. I call her Sandstorm!
translation: 내 이름은 Drew(드루), 여기 이 분쇄기를 맡고 있지. 난 이 녀석을 Sandstorm(샌드스톰)이라고 불러!

english: I can also look after any buckets ya want me to.
translation: 원하면 양동이도 맡아 줄 수 있어.

english: Me and Sandstorm go way back, we started off back in the desert mining camp, I was a slave and I had the honour of looking after Sandstorm.
translation: 나랑 Sandstorm(샌드스톰)은 오랜 사이야. 처음엔 사막 광산 캠프에 있었지. 난 노예였는데, 영광스럽게도 샌드스톰을 돌보는 일을 맡았어.

english: How did you and Sandstorm get out of the mining camp?
translation: 당신이랑 Sandstorm(샌드스톰)은 광산 캠프에서 어떻게 빠져나왔어요?

english: Well, because I was in charge of looking after Sandstorm, I was able to look at the inner workings.
translation: 음, 내가 Sandstorm(샌드스톰)을 돌보는 담당이었으니까, 속 구조를 들여다볼 수 있었거든.

english: While the guards weren't looking, I would take apart Sandstorm piece by piece and place the pieces in boxes and barrels, when Sandstorms inners were all gutted, I tricked the cart driver by telling him cart jokes.
translation: 경비병들이 안 볼 때 Sandstorm(샌드스톰)을 한 조각씩 분해해서 상자랑 통에 나눠 담았지. 샌드스톰의 속을 싹 비우고 나서는, 수레꾼한테 수레 개그를 늘어놔서 정신을 쏙 빼놨어.

english: So, he didn't bother to check his cargo and I was able to board as he was driving off.
translation: 그래서 그 사람은 짐을 확인하지도 않았고, 난 수레가 떠날 때 몰래 올라탈 수 있었지.

english: Anyway, that's all in the past. Can I help ya with anything else?
translation: 아무튼 다 지난 일이야. 또 도와줄 거 있어?

english: You haven't got any buckets for me to hold.
Ya don't have any buckets of sand to withdraw. Ya need to give me empty buckets, and grind sandstone in my grinder, then I'll sell ya buckets of sand.
translation: 찾아갈 buckets of sand(모래 양동이)가 없어. 빈 양동이를 나한테 맡기고, 내 분쇄기에 sandstone(사암)을 갈아. 그러면 모래 양동이를 팔아 줄게.

english: I have [number] of your buckets and you've ground enough sandstone for [number] buckets of sand.
translation: 네 양동이를 [number]개 갖고 있고, 네가 간 sandstone(사암)은 bucket of sand(모래 양동이) [number]개 분량이야.

english: Nothing sorry. I have to be going now.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요, 죄송해요. 이만 가 봐야 해요.

english: Oh, bye then.
Tell me about yourself.
Deposit buckets.
Withdraw buckets of sand.
Check my buckets and sand.
Nothing.
Greetings again adventurer. How go your travels in Morytania? Is it as evil as I have heard?
translation: 다시 만나 반갑습니다, 모험가여. Morytania(모리타니아) 여행은 어떻습니까? 듣던 대로 사악한 곳입니까?

english: I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
Yes, I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time.
translation: 예, 알고 있습니다! 운 좋게도 아까 Salve(살브) 강둑에 떠밀려 왔더군요! 자, 다시 받으십시오. 이번엔 부디 좀 더 조심해 주십시오.

english: It's a family heirloom after all!
Thanks for that!
I've lost my library key.
Ok, here's another one for you.
Do you know of anything I can do in Morytania?
translation: Morytania(모리타니아)에서 제가 할 만한 일이 있을까요?

english: Well... I don't think so. There's not much to do in that place.
translation: 글쎄요... 없는 것 같습니다. 그곳엔 할 일이 별로 없지요.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.
translation: Nature Spirit(자연의 정령) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 조건을 모두 갖추지 못했습니다.

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 그래서, 무슨 일이에요? 제가 도울 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: There's a man called Filliman who lives in Mort Myre. He comes by the temple from time to time but I haven't seen him recently. I was wondering if you could check in on him?
translation: Mort Myre(모트 마이어)에 Filliman(필리먼)이라는 사람이 삽니다. 가끔 신전에 들르곤 했는데 최근엔 통 보이질 않는군요. 그 사람이 괜찮은지 좀 살펴봐 주실 수 있겠습니까?

english: I must warn you though, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!
translation: 다만 경고해 두겠습니다, 위험할 수도 있습니다. Mort Myre(모트 마이어)엔 ghast(가스트)가 득실거리거든요!

english: Yes, I'll go look for him.
That's great! Many thanks!
Now, please be aware of the ghasts, you cannot attack them, only Filliman knew how to take them on. Just run from them if you can. If you get lost, try to make your way back to the temple.
translation: 그럼, 가스트를 부디 조심하십시오. 가스트는 공격할 수 없습니다. 그것들을 상대할 줄 아는 사람은 Filliman(필리먼)뿐이었지요. 가능하면 그냥 도망치십시오. 길을 잃으면 신전으로 돌아오도록 하십시오.

english: Drezel hands you some food.
Please take this food to Filliman, he'll likely appreciate it. His home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.
translation: 이 음식을 Filliman(필리먼)에게 가져다주십시오. 아마 고마워할 겁니다. 그의 집은 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 남쪽 끝 어딘가에 있습니다. 정확한 위치는 저도 모르겠군요.

english: Don't worry, if he's there and he's still alive, I'll find him.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 그분이 거기 있고 아직 살아 있다면, 제가 꼭 찾을게요.

english: Sorry, I don't think I can help.
translation: 죄송해요, 제가 도울 수 없을 것 같아요.

english: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.
translation: 괜찮습니다. 곧 도와줄 수 있는 다른 분이 오시겠지요. 그럼 실례하겠습니다, 저도 처리할 일이 좀 있어서요.

english: Sorry, not interested.
Well, I understand. You must be busy.
Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?
Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.
translation: 기대만큼 좋진 않아요, Drezel(드레젤). 아직 Myreque(미레크)와 함께 일하고 있어요. 그 Drakan(드라칸) 일족을 물리칠 방법을 찾을 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!
translation: 분명 아주 많은 사람이 똑같은 것을 바라고 있을 겁니다, [player name]님. 행운을 빕니다. 미레크에게 승리를!

english: Myreque prevail, Drezel.
How's everything going, [player name]?
We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!
translation: 뱀파이어와 싸울 새로운 무기를 만들어 냈어요. 그걸로 Ranis Drakan(라니스 드라칸)을 처치했어요!

english: This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
translation: 정말 놀라운 소식이군요, [player name]님. 미레크에게 승리를!

english: [player name]. How are things?
As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.
translation: 이런 상황치고는 그럭저럭이에요. 우린 모든 걸 잃었어요, Drezel(드레젤).

english: Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
translation: 전부는 아닙니다. 아직 당신과 저, 그리고 Ivan(이반)이 있지요. Veliaf(벨리아프)도 어딘가에 있을 겁니다. 많지는 않지만, 감사할 만한 일입니다.

english: I suppose.
Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.
translation: Morytania(모리타니아)가 이토록 어두웠던 적은 없었습니다. Saradomin(사라도민)을 믿으십시오, 친구여. 우리가 이 어둠을 견뎌 낼 가능성은 아직 남아 있습니다.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to help me with this.
Drezel has given you a challenge scroll!
Please give me your answer!
Nope, not correct!
Correct!
Drezel has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Drezel(드레젤)이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: Well, what is it, I may be able to help?
translation: 그래서, 무슨 일이에요? 제가 도울 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Yes.
No.
Sorry, not interested.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 그냥 경비. 몰래 들어온 인간들 허락 없이 여기 오면, 내가 돌 던져서 기절시키고 Weiss(바이스) 밖으로 던져 버려.

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤들이 옛날에 만들었어, 남쪽에 있는 동굴에서 쫓겨나고 나서. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지냈어. 먹을 goat(염소)랑 wolf(늑대) 많아. 너무 오래 먹어서 맛 좀 심심한데, 다른 거 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그걸 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)은 그걸 기르는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구트 뭐시기 풀 같은 거 못 들어 봤어. 근데 채소 같은 소리야, 그리고 Mother(어머니) 그런 거 먹는 거 안 좋아해. 그래서 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니) 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해. 근데 그 녀석 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 그 녀석 말 들어.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠어. 그래도 우리 집. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)이 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 여기 더 좋게 만들 수 있대. 근데 Mother(어머니) 관심 없어서, 이상한 버섯 그거 하면 안 돼.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 자기 더 잘 싸우게 도와주는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 그 녀석 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 그 녀석 말 들어.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 그냥 경비. 몰래 들어온 인간 허락 없이 여기 오면, 내가 돌 던져서 기절시키고 Weiss(바이스) 밖으로 던져 버려.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 아주 좋아. 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 트롤 남편이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 맛있어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠어. 근데 점점 좋아져. Snowflake(눈송이), 걔가 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으면 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그래서 응, Weiss(바이스) 이제 살기 좋은 곳이야, Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이니까. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 그 트롤 남편 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그걸 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
wooo wooo
Please, leave me alone.
Your loss!
Hello, are you Droalak?
Wow. I haven't spoken to the living for... for... I don't remember how long.
translation: 와. 산 사람과 이야기해 본 게... 얼마 만인지... 기억도 안 나네요.

english: So your name IS Droalak?
translation: 그러니까 당신 이름이 Droalak(드로알락) 맞는 거죠?

english: Sorry, yes I am he.
Great. Do you know anything about the outpost North of Ardougne?
translation: 좋아요. Ardougne(아르둔) 북쪽에 있는 전초기지에 대해 아는 게 있나요?

english: I don't really like to talk about it, but I died there.
translation: 별로 얘기하고 싶진 않지만, 전 거기서 죽었어요.

english: Oh dear.
I do have a scroll which might interest you that describes the timeline of the outpost. But first I wonder if I could ask you to tie up a problem?
translation: 전초기지의 연표가 적힌 두루마리가 있는데, 관심이 있으실 거예요. 그런데 그 전에 문제 하나만 해결해 달라고 부탁해도 될까요?

english: Like what?
Well, I left to go to the outpost against the wishes of my wife. I promised I would return to her, but obviously I did not as I died there. She's a ghost nearby, but won't listen to my apologies.
translation: 음, 전 아내가 말리는데도 전초기지로 떠났어요. 아내에게 꼭 돌아오겠다고 약속했지만, 보다시피 거기서 죽는 바람에 돌아가지 못했죠. 아내도 근처에서 유령이 되어 떠돌고 있는데, 제 사과를 들으려 하지 않아요.

english: You want me to patch things up?
Yes, how'd you guess?
Call it 'traveller's intuition'.
Okay, well perhaps you could give her a strung sapphire amulet, because this is what I gave her the day I left. Her name is Melina by the way.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 아내에게 끈을 꿴 sapphire amulet(사파이어 아뮬렛)을 주면 어떨까요. 제가 떠나던 날 아내에게 준 게 바로 그거였거든요. 아, 아내 이름은 Melina(멜리나)예요.

english: No problem.
What do you want me to do again?
Make a strung sapphire amulet and give it to Melina!
translation: 끈을 꿴 sapphire amulet(사파이어 아뮬렛)을 만들어서 Melina(멜리나)에게 주세요!

english: Ok. Ok.
I have a sapphire amulet!
Good work. Just give it to Melina, who's wandering somewhere nearby.
translation: 잘했어요. 이제 근처 어딘가를 떠돌고 있는 Melina(멜리나)에게 주기만 하면 돼요.

english: I've given her the amulet. She was very pleased and said she just wanted to know you still cared.
translation: 아내분께 아뮬렛을 드렸어요. 정말 기뻐하면서, 그저 당신이 아직 자기를 아끼는지 알고 싶었을 뿐이래요.

english: Excellent! I am so glad she believes me. I can finally rest in peace.
translation: 훌륭해요! 아내가 제 말을 믿어 줘서 정말 기뻐요. 이제야 편히 잠들 수 있겠어요.

english: Could I have that scroll you mentioned first?
translation: 그 전에 말씀하신 두루마리 좀 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Of course. Let me know if it was of any use and then I can be forever free.
translation: 물론이죠. 도움이 됐는지 알려 주세요. 그러면 전 영원히 자유로워질 수 있어요.

english: Thank you.
Take that scroll to Jorral in the outpost.
translation: 그 두루마리를 전초기지에 있는 Jorral(조랄)에게 가져가세요.

english: Thank's for the scroll, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: 두루마리 고마웠는데, 그만 잃어버린 것 같아요.

english: It's a good job I stuck around then isn't it! Have another copy.
translation: 제가 여기 남아 있길 잘했네요! 사본 하나 더 드릴게요.

english: I have delivered the scroll, you can rest in peace now.
translation: 두루마리를 전해 줬어요. 이제 편히 쉬셔도 돼요.

english: Thanks for telling me! I've been waiting for ages!
translation: 알려 줘서 고마워요! 정말 오래 기다렸어요!

english: Good bye.
Bye!
'Ello, welcome to my Mining shop, friend!
translation: 안녕하신가, 내 Mining(채광) 상점에 온 걸 환영하네, 친구!

english: Do you want to trade?
Hello, shorty.
I may be short, but at least I've got manners.
translation: 내가 키는 작아도 최소한 예의는 있다네.

english: Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: 왜 광석이랑 주괴는 다시 채워 놓지 않아요?

english: The only ores and bars I sell are those sold to me.
translation: 내가 파는 광석과 주괴는 다 남들이 나한테 판 것뿐이라네.

english: Do you want to trade?
Hello, shorty.
Why don't you ever restock ores and bars?
translation: 왜 광석이랑 주괴는 다시 채워 놓지 않아요?

english: Someone stole my beautiful boots... I had to buy some crummy replicas, the real boots were one of a kind.
translation: 누가 내 멋진 부츠를 훔쳐 갔어... 할 수 없이 형편없는 모조품을 샀지, 진짜 부츠는 세상에 하나뿐인 물건이었는데.

english: Don't worry, if I find out who did it I'll take care of them.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 누가 그랬는지 알아내면 제가 혼내 줄게요.

english: What do you want?
I didn't know dwarves kept cats.
And why wouldn't they?
Friend of mine lives at the palace, actually. Well, I say friend. Used to be a friend.
translation: 사실 내 친구 하나가 궁전에 살아. 뭐, 친구라고 하긴 했는데. 예전엔 친구였지.

english: What happened?
He got adopted by Hreidmar. The director of the Red Axe.
translation: Red Axe(레드 액스)의 대표인 Hreidmar(흐레이드마르)한테 입양됐거든.

english: Oh?
I don't like the Red Axe! They stomp around everywhere, got to be careful of your tail with those people around.
translation: 난 레드 액스가 싫어! 그 녀석들은 사방을 쿵쿵거리고 다니니까, 근처에 있을 땐 꼬리를 조심해야 해.

english: Get your hands off that, you dirty human!
translation: 거기 손대지 마, 이 더러운 인간아!

english: Stay away from there! Who do you think you are, coming into my house like that?
translation: 거기서 떨어져! 대체 네가 뭔데 남의 집에 그렇게 함부로 들어와?

english: You don't think you'll be able to get close to this boot without the old dwarf noticing you, what with his cat guarding.
translation: 고양이가 지키고 있으니, 저 늙은 드워프 몰래 이 부츠에 다가가긴 어려울 것 같다.

english: I know what you did, [player name]!
translation: 네가 무슨 짓을 했는지 다 알아, [player name]!

english: What did I do?
You stole a boot from my master.
translation: 우리 주인님 부츠 한 짝을 훔쳤잖아.

english: All for a greater good.
Hiss.
Meow!
Excuse me..
Leave me or I'll destroy you!
translation: 꺼져라, 안 그러면 박살 내 주마!

english: Excuse me.
Look, I don't have time for weaklings, if you want a conversation, talk to my brother Blanin!
translation: 이봐, 난 약골이랑 놀아 줄 시간 없다. 이야기가 하고 싶으면 내 형제 Blanin(블라닌)한테 가!

english: I need to talk to you.
Why should I?
Erm, sorry I didn't mean to cause offence.
translation: 어, 죄송해요. 기분 상하게 할 생각은 없었어요.

english: Don't waste my time!
Please don't hurt me.
Leave me alone!
I'm after important answers.
But how do you know me?
I just talked to your brother.
Don't talk of my brother. He's not on my good side at the moment.
translation: 내 형제 얘긴 꺼내지 마. 지금 그 녀석이랑 사이가 안 좋으니까.

english: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!
translation: 아니, 당신은 그 유명한 전사 Dron(드론)이잖아요!

english: If so, what weapon do I use?
Wrong, wrong, wrong!
An iron mace.
When do I like to eat rats?
translation: 난 쥐를 언제 먹는 걸 좋아하지?

english: Breakfast.
When are kittens best devoured?
translation: 새끼 고양이는 언제 먹어야 제일 맛있지?

english: You know nothing!
Lunch.
What do I usually eat for tea?
Bunnies.
What colour spider blood tastes the best?
translation: 거미 피는 무슨 색이 제일 맛있지?

english: Red.
How many years old am I?
and months?
What are the most interesting ages for battles?
Fifth and Fourth.
And my house is situated where?
North East side of town.
What is my brother's name?
Blanin.
And my pet cat is called?
Fluffy.
What's 5 plus 7?
12, but what does that have to do with anything?
Everything! Besides, it's 13!
Er, I think you'll find it's 12.
Very well, you seem to know me quite well, I'll answer your questions best I can.
translation: 좋아, 날 꽤 잘 아는 것 같으니, 네 질문에 최대한 대답해 주지.

english: Phew!
Well, what are they then?
I'm trying to find out the history of the outpost near Ardougne. I was hoping you could help me.

english: What's a Duel?
Two fighters are placed in a combat arena together, to battle to the death. The survivor wins the Duel.
translation: 두 전사가 한 전투장에 들어가 죽을 때까지 싸워요. 살아남은 쪽이 결투에서 이기는 거죠.

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?

translation: 난 도무지 이해가 안 가는데. 평생을 여기서 보냈거든.

english: Here, solve this.
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 자리 좀 비워 줘. 줄 게 있어.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
Greetings. Welcome to my castle.
translation: 안녕하십니까. 제 성에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: 드래곤 숨결을 막아 줄 방패를 찾고 있어요.

english: A knight going on a dragon quest, hmm? What dragon do you intend to slay?
translation: 드래곤을 잡으러 가는 기사로군요? 어떤 드래곤을 처치할 생각이십니까?

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
Elvarg? Are you sure?
Yes.
Well, you're a braver [man/woman] than I!
Why is everyone so scared of this dragon?
translation: 다들 왜 이 드래곤을 그렇게 무서워하는 거예요?

english: Back in my father's day, Crandor was an important city-state. Politically it was as important as Falador and Varrock and its ships traded with every port.
translation: 제 아버지 시절만 해도 Crandor(크랜도)는 중요한 도시 국가였습니다. 정치적으로 Falador(팔라도르)나 Varrock(바록)만큼 중요했고, 그곳의 배들은 모든 항구와 교역했지요.

english: But, one day, when I was little, all contact was lost. The trading ships and the diplomatic envoys just stopped coming.
translation: 그런데 제가 어렸을 때, 어느 날 연락이 완전히 끊겼습니다. 무역선도, 외교 사절도 더는 오지 않았지요.

english: I remember my father being very scared. He posted lookouts on the roof to warn if the dragon was approaching. All the city rulers worried that Elvarg would devastate the whole continent.
translation: 아버지께서 몹시 두려워하시던 기억이 납니다. 드래곤이 다가오면 알리도록 지붕에 망꾼을 세우셨지요. 모든 도시의 통치자들이 Elvarg(엘바르그)가 대륙 전체를 쑥대밭으로 만들까 봐 걱정했습니다.

english: I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: 그 드래곤은 건드리지 않는 게 좋겠네요.

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in [his/her] prime.
translation: 다행입니다. 이렇게 장래가 촉망되는 모험가가 [his/her] 한창때에 쓰러지는 꼴은 보고 싶지 않으니까요.

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: 그래서, 방패를 주실 건가요, 말 건가요?

english: If you really think you're up to it then perhaps you are the one who can kill this dragon.
translation: 정말 해낼 수 있다고 생각하신다면, 어쩌면 당신이야말로 이 드래곤을 죽일 수 있는 사람일지도 모르겠군요.

english: The Duke hands you a heavy orange shield.
Take care out there. If you kill it...
If you kill it, for Saradomin's sake make sure it's really dead!
translation: 만약 그놈을 죽인다면, 제발 Saradomin(사라도민)의 이름으로, 확실히 죽었는지 꼭 확인하십시오!

english: Very wise. There are some monsters that are best left alone.
translation: 현명하십니다. 건드리지 않는 편이 나은 괴물도 있는 법이지요.

english: Oh, no dragon in particular. I just feel like killing a dragon.
translation: 아, 딱히 정해 둔 드래곤은 없어요. 그냥 드래곤을 잡고 싶어서요.

english: I don't have an infinite supply of these shields, you know. I'll only give one for a truly worthy cause.
translation: 이 방패가 끝도 없이 있는 게 아닙니다. 정말 가치 있는 목적을 위해서만 드릴 겁니다.

english: Of course. Now you've slain Elvarg, you've earned the right to call the shield your own!
translation: 물론이지요. 엘바르그를 처치하셨으니 이 방패를 당신 것이라 부를 자격이 충분합니다!

english: The Duke hands you the shield.
Have you any quests for me?
Well, it's not really a quest but I recently discovered this strange talisman.
translation: 글쎄요, 퀘스트라고 하기엔 뭣하지만 최근에 이상한 부적을 하나 발견했습니다.

english: It seems to be mystical and I have never seen anything like it before. Would you take it to the head wizard at
translation: 신비한 힘이 깃든 것 같은데, 이런 것은 처음 봅니다. 이것을 저 대신

english: the Wizards' Tower for me? It's just south-west of here and should not take you very long at all. I would be awfully grateful.
translation: Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑)의 수석 마법사에게 가져다주시겠습니까? 여기서 바로 남서쪽이니 그리 오래 걸리지 않을 겁니다. 그래 주시면 정말 감사하겠습니다.

english: Sure, no problem.
Thank you very much, stranger. I am sure the head wizard will reward you for such an interesting find.
translation: 정말 고맙습니다, 낯선 이여. 이렇게 흥미로운 발견이라면 수석 마법사가 분명 보답해 줄 겁니다.

english: Not right now.
As you wish, stranger, although I have this strange feeling that it is important. Unfortunately, I cannot leave my castle unattended.
translation: 뜻대로 하십시오, 낯선 이여. 다만 이게 중요한 물건이라는 묘한 느낌이 드는군요. 안타깝게도 저는 성을 비워 둘 수가 없습니다.

english: The only task remotely approaching a quest is the delivery of that talisman I gave you to the head wizard of the Wizards' Tower,
translation: 퀘스트라 할 만한 일이라고는 제가 드린 그 부적을 여기서 남서쪽에 있는

english: south-west of here. I suggest you deliver it to him as soon as possible. I have the oddest feeling that it is important...
translation: Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑)의 수석 마법사에게 전하는 일뿐입니다. 되도록 빨리 전해 주십시오. 아무래도 중요한 물건이라는 느낌이 들어서요...

english: Did you speak to the head wizard for me yet, adventurer?
No, I lost that air talisman that you gave me.
translation: 아뇨, 주신 air talisman(공기 부적)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: Ah, that would explain it. One of my servants found this outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that more than one strange
translation: 아, 그래서였군요. 하인 하나가 밖에서 이걸 주웠는데, 이렇게 짧은 기간에 이상한 물건이

english: object would appear on my land in such a short period of time. Please take this to the head wizard at the Wizards' Tower, south-west of here, and don't lose it this time.
translation: 제 땅에 여러 개 나타나다니 우연치고는 너무 공교롭다 싶었습니다. 이것을 여기서 남서쪽에 있는 Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑)의 수석 마법사에게 가져가 주십시오. 이번에는 잃어버리지 마시고요.

english: The only job I had was the delivery of that talisman, so I'm afraid not.
translation: 제가 맡긴 일은 그 부적 전달뿐이었으니, 유감이지만 없습니다.

english: No, all is well for me.
Where can I find money?
I've heard that the blacksmiths are prosperous amongst the peasantry. Maybe you could try your hand at that?
translation: 평민들 사이에서는 대장장이가 벌이가 좋다고 들었습니다. 그 일에 한번 손을 대 보시는 건 어떻습니까?

english: Hello there, welcome to Lumbridge.
What's with all the snow?
A particularly harsh winter for Lumbridge this year. Still, we make the best of it. I hope all our new visitors aren't getting too cold.
translation: 올해 Lumbridge(럼브리지)는 겨울이 유난히 혹독하군요. 그래도 다들 그런대로 잘 지내고 있지요. 새로 오신 손님들이 너무 춥지 않으셨으면 좋겠는데요.

english: I'm not new!
Oh yes, I know that.
Who cares about them?
Well... I do.
What do you need?
Ah...
I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: 전 괜찮아요. 이 동네에 새로 오긴 했지만요.

english: Then doubly welcome you are to Lumbridge.
translation: 그렇다면 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 오신 것을 두 배로 환영합니다.

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
Well... I may be able to help there.
translation: 음... 그거라면 제가 도와드릴 수 있을지도 모르겠군요.

english: Who are you calling new?
I haven't seen you around much before, that's all.
translation: 전에 이 근처에서 별로 뵌 적이 없어서 그랬을 뿐입니다.

english: I wonder if you might help me with a little project of mine?
