translation: 혹시 제 작은 계획 하나를 도와주실 수 있겠습니까?

english: Yes, I can help.
Great! Thank you!
So, I have seen how much extra work the Lumbridge citizens are putting in recently, what with so many new adventurers in town. I'd like to give them something back.
translation: 그러니까, 요즘 새로운 모험가들이 마을에 잔뜩 몰려오면서 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 주민들이 얼마나 일을 더 하고 있는지 보았습니다. 그들에게 뭔가 보답을 하고 싶습니다.

english: And here comes the but...
How did you know? But... I have to stay here in my room as I have so much paperwork to do.
translation: 어떻게 아셨습니까? 그런데... 저는 처리할 서류가 너무 많아서 이 방에 있어야 합니다.

english: So I'm delivering the presents? I get to be Santa?
translation: 그러니까 제가 선물을 배달하는 거예요? 제가 산타가 되는 건가요?

english: Um. Not quite, but nearly!
What do you mean... not quite?
Well, I don't want them to see you deliver it.
translation: 음, 당신이 배달하는 모습을 그들이 보지 않았으면 합니다.

english: What? Why? How?
Well it kind of looks lazy on my part doesn't it. I'd like you to disguise yourself... as a tree.
translation: 그게, 제가 게을러 보이지 않겠습니까. 변장을 해 주셨으면 합니다... 나무로요.

english: A TREE?
Yes, a festive tree, as if I'd planted the tree near them and it's holding a present for them... isn't that a wonderful idea?
translation: 네, 축제용 나무 말입니다. 마치 제가 그들 곁에 나무를 심었고, 그 나무가 선물을 들고 있는 것처럼요... 멋진 생각 아닙니까?

english: If by wonderful you mean awful... I suppose you want me to cut bits off trees and stick them to myself and decorate it with something shiny?
translation: 멋지다는 게 끔찍하다는 뜻이라면요... 나무에서 가지를 잘라 제 몸에 붙이고 반짝이는 걸로 장식하라는 거죠?

english: How did you know?
I'm leaving now.
Oh very good... leaving... well done.
The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should use some of their branches to decorate them.
translation: 밖에 있는 눈 덮인 나무들이 나무랄 데 없이 축제 분위기니, 그 가지를 좀 가져다 장식하시면 됩니다.

english: What about a decoration on top, I don't want to be involved with creepy dolls again.
translation: 꼭대기 장식은요? 오싹한 인형 같은 건 다시는 엮이고 싶지 않아요.

english: Oh no, no, no. I think you'll be able to find something star like to put on your head, maybe from the church?
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨, 그럴 리가요. 머리에 얹을 별 같은 걸 찾으실 수 있을 겁니다. 교회에 가 보시면 어떨까요?

english: Where do I get the tree branches from?

The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should just use some of their branches, but leave the big one alone. Just take something sharp to them. A knife or some shears should do the job.
translation: 밖에 있는 눈 덮인 나무들이 나무랄 데 없이 축제 분위기니, 그 가지를 좀 쓰시면 됩니다. 다만 큰 나무는 건드리지 마십시오. 날붙이만 있으면 됩니다. knife(칼)이나 shears(양털 가위)면 충분할 겁니다.

english: I don't think I can take anymore puns.
Stick with it, it'll soon be over.
translation: 가지 말고 조금만 버티십시오. 곧 끝납니다.

english: Where do I get the decoration?
Well, not out of my crown! Get it? Crown?
translation: 제 왕관에서 떼어 가시면 안 됩니다! 아시겠습니까? 나무 꼭대기도 수관(樹冠)이라고 하잖습니까!

english: Must not react to pun...
OH ok, have it your way. I noticed a barrel of old waste material near the furnace. You should be able to find some there. Oh, and don't forget you can probably borrow a star from the church.
translation: 아이고, 알겠습니다, 마음대로 하십시오. furnace(용광로) 근처에 낡은 폐자재가 든 barrel(통)이 있더군요. 거기서 찾을 수 있을 겁니다. 아, 교회에서 별을 빌릴 수 있다는 것도 잊지 마십시오.

english: How do I put it all together?
Well, thread is too light and rope is too heavy for this job... You could try some wool?
translation: 글쎄요, 이 일에는 thread(실)은 너무 가볍고 rope(밧줄)은 너무 무겁지요... wool(양털)을 써 보시는 건 어떻습니까?

english: Why do I need it again?
To deliver my presents of course!
Oh yeah... you're too busy to do it yourself and don't want them to know that I did it. Pretty poor excuse.
translation: 아, 맞다... 직접 하기엔 너무 바쁘고, 제가 했다는 걸 사람들이 몰랐으면 하신다고요. 꽤 궁색한 핑계네요.

english: Hey, I have a town to run, it's not all it's cracked up to be you know.
translation: 이봐요, 저도 다스릴 마을이 있습니다. 겉보기와 달리 깨지는 일투성이라고요.

english: That was an egg pun, wrong holiday.
translation: 그건 달걀 말장난이잖아요. 명절을 잘못 찾으셨네요.

english: How very pithy of you. It wasn't meant to be a pun!
No thanks, bye.
I see you've got your disguise sorted out, you really should wear it for it to be effective though.
translation: 변장은 다 준비하셨군요. 하지만 효과를 보려면 직접 입고 계셔야지요.

english: Is that tree talking to me? I must be ill.
translation: 나무가 저한테 말을 거는 겁니까? 제가 병이 났나 봅니다.

english: It's me, Player!
And there was me thinking that yew wouldn't have made something that convincing.
translation: 이렇게 그럴듯하게 만드실 줄은 몰랐는데, 정말 주목(朱木)할 만하군요.

english: So what do I have to do?
Here, I've written it all down for you.
Duke Horacio hands you a neatly written list.
translation: Duke Horacio(호레이시오 공작)이 깔끔하게 쓴 목록을 건넨다.

english: How goes the job of Santa?
I've made some progress. But I have some questions.
translation: 조금 진행했어요. 그런데 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Ah Hans, loyal to a fault. He walks the castle grounds all day, everyday. He really could do with a sit down, don't you think? Take my chair, just over there.
translation: 아, Hans(한스) 말입니까. 지나치게 충직한 친구지요. 매일 하루 종일 성 안을 걸어 다닙니다. 좀 앉아서 쉬어야 할 텐데, 그렇지 않습니까? 바로 저기 있는 제 chair(의자)를 가져가십시오.

english: Count Check... he's a bit of an odd one isn't he? He's obsesedwith counting. He loves counting, especially shiny things. The other day I was chatting to him and he was completely unable to take his eyes off the golden rings on my fingers. Perhaps he'd like some of those. However, they're not normal gold rings, like you would make. These I get specially from the apprentice near the furnace.
translation: Count Check(체크 백작) 말입니까... 좀 별난 사람이지요? 세는 데 집착합니다. 세는 걸 정말 좋아하지요, 특히 반짝이는 물건을요. 요전에 이야기를 나누는데 제 손가락에 낀 금반지에서 눈을 떼지 못하더군요. 그런 걸 좋아할지도 모르겠습니다. 다만 그건 당신이 만드는 평범한 금반지가 아닙니다. 용광로 근처에 있는 견습생에게서 특별히 받는 것이지요.

english: The lovely Gillie. Such pure white milk she brings us daily. But she is so run off her feet. She often suggests that we should find a magic spell to duplicate her! What a notion. I'm surprised we don't hear the same complaints from Bob.
translation: 사랑스러운 Gillie(길리) 말이군요. 날마다 정말 새하얀 우유를 가져다주지요. 하지만 너무 바빠서 쉴 틈이 없습니다. 자신을 복제할 마법 주문을 찾아야 한다는 말을 자주 하지요! 별생각을 다 합니다. Bob(밥)에게서 같은 불평을 듣지 못하는 게 놀라울 따름입니다.

english: Fred? Such a wholesome farmer. He does his job with the chickens and cows well. However, it wasn't his first choice of profession. He wanted to grow fruit trees you know. The one planted in the castle grounds sure did catch his eye.
translation: Fred(프레드) 말입니까? 참 건실한 농부지요. 닭과 소를 돌보는 일을 잘해 냅니다. 하지만 원래 원하던 직업은 아니었습니다. 과일나무를 기르고 싶어 했다지요. 성 마당에 심어진 나무가 그의 눈길을 단단히 끌었던 모양입니다.

english: He's so gloomy, everything is doom doom doom. He needs some light entertainment. I heard he used to be a friend of Party Pete, in Falador, maybe ask him.
translation: 그 사람은 너무 우울해서 입만 열면 파멸, 파멸, 파멸입니다. 가벼운 즐길 거리가 좀 필요하지요. 예전에 Falador(팔라도르)에 있는 Party Pete(파티 피트)와 친구였다고 들었으니, 그에게 물어보십시오.

english: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
translation: 드래곤 숨결을 막아 줄 방패를 찾고 있어요.

english: Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
Yes.
I'd better leave that dragon alone.
translation: 그 드래곤은 건드리지 않는 게 좋겠네요.

english: So, are you going to give me the shield or not?
translation: 그래서, 방패를 주실 건가요, 말 건가요?

english: No.
Oh, no dragon in particular
translation: 아, 딱히 정해 둔 드래곤은 없어요

english: Have you any quests for me?
Where can I find money?
Talk about Lumbridge holiday event.
I'm not new!
Who cares about them?
What do you need?
I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: 전 괜찮아요. 이 동네에 새로 오긴 했지만요.

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
Who are you calling new?
Yes, I can help.
Talk about something else.
Where do I get the tree branches from?
Where do I get the decoration?
How do I put it all together?
Why do I need it again?
No thanks, bye.
Present for Hans.
Present for Count Check.
Present for Gillie.
Present for Farmer Fred.
Present for Doom Sayer.
Nothing.
[player name]! So glad you could make it. I really do appreciate you rounding up all those monkeys for us.
translation: [player name] 님! 와 주셔서 정말 기쁩니다. 그 원숭이들을 전부 잡아들여 주셔서 정말 감사합니다.

english: No problem.
I am grateful for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you.
translation: 도와주셔서 감사합니다, [player name] 님. 소지품에 빈칸을 하나 만들어 주시면 보답을 해 드리겠습니다.

english: I am grateful for your help, [player name]. As proof of my gratitude, I have arranged a reward for you!
translation: 도와주셔서 감사합니다, [player name] 님. 감사의 표시로 보상을 마련해 두었습니다!

english: Also, King Awowogei brought gifts from Ape Atoll as an apology for the trouble they caused. But I think you should receive them instead.
translation: 그리고 King Awowogei(아워워게이 왕)이 소동을 일으킨 데 대한 사과로 Ape Atoll(에이프 아톨)에서 선물을 가져왔습니다. 하지만 그건 당신이 받아야 할 것 같군요.

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 공작이 Cursed banana(저주받은 바나나)를 수여한다.8주년을 축하합니다!

english: On a members-only world you'd have also received a Banana Cape. If you purchase membership you can reclaim it at any time from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: 멤버 월드였다면 Banana Cape(바나나 망토)도 받으셨을 겁니다. 멤버십을 구매하시면 언제든 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Diango(디앙고)에게서 다시 받을 수 있습니다.

english: The Duke awards you a Cursed banana and a Banana cape.Happy 8th Birthday!
translation: 공작이 Cursed banana(저주받은 바나나)와 Banana cape(바나나 망토)를 수여한다.8주년을 축하합니다!

english: Ah, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying the party?
translation: 아, [player name] 님. 파티는 즐기고 계십니까?

english: What is going to happen with the monkeys?
Funny you should ask, actually.
It turns out that on the way to King Awowogei, Postie Pete was called off for an urgent request for Molly. Her evil twin had escaped again and she was looking for an adventurer to help.
translation: 알고 보니 King Awowogei(아워워게이 왕)에게 가던 길에 Postie Pete(집배원 피트)가 Molly(몰리)의 급한 부탁을 받고 불려 갔다더군요. 그녀의 사악한 쌍둥이가 또 탈출해서 도와줄 모험가를 찾고 있었답니다.

english: In the process of teleporting, he left the letter behind and these monkeys found it.
translation: 순간이동하는 와중에 그가 편지를 두고 갔고, 이 원숭이들이 그걸 발견한 겁니다.

english: They couldn't understand the letter so they took it to one of their elders, Mizaru, to translate. But 'Monster' didn't translate, so they assumed it said 'Monkey'.
translation: 원숭이들은 편지를 이해하지 못해 원로 중 하나인 Mizaru(미자루)에게 번역을 맡겼습니다. 그런데 'Monster(괴물)'라는 단어가 번역되지 않자 'Monkey(원숭이)'라고 짐작했던 거지요.

english: So instead of a party invitation they interpreted it as a threat from an organisation called Humans Against Monkeys! They stole some amulets of humanspeak, then decided to come here and put an end to it!
translation: 그래서 파티 초대장을 Humans Against Monkeys(원숭이 반대 인간 연합)라는 단체의 협박으로 받아들인 겁니다! 그들은 amulet of humanspeak(인간 언어 아뮬렛)을 몇 개 훔치고는, 여기 와서 끝장을 내기로 한 거지요!

english: That explains what happened, I suppose. How did you find all of this out?
translation: 그래서 그렇게 된 거군요. 이걸 다 어떻게 알아내셨어요?

english: Another elder, Kikazaru, found the letter. And once he understood the situation, he went straight to King Awowogei himself. The King is over in the corner if you want to speak to him.
translation: 다른 원로인 Kikazaru(키카자루)가 그 편지를 찾았습니다. 그는 상황을 이해하자마자 곧장 King Awowogei(아워워게이 왕)을 찾아갔지요. 왕께서는 저쪽 구석에 계시니 이야기해 보셔도 됩니다.

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 보상 아이템을 더 주실 수 있나요?

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: 드릴 것은 그게 전부인 것 같습니다.

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 들고 가실 수 있는 만큼은 드렸습니다. 나머지 보상은 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Diango(디앙고)를 찾아가시면 더 편하게 받으실 수 있을 겁니다.

english: I have nothing more for you.
What is going to happen with the monkeys?
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 보상 아이템을 더 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thanks. I'll go enjoy the party now.
Can you give me more rewards?
Uh hey, are you the Duke?
Shh shh, now is not your time to speak.
translation: 쉿, 쉿. 지금은 네가 말할 때가 아니다.

english: Uhh...
Oh Great One, do I have to have broccoli for dinner?
translation: 오, 위대하신 분이시여, 저녁으로 브로콜리를 꼭 먹어야 하옵니까?

english: Yes, Definitely.
I hatesbroccoli, why must it torture me.
translation: 브로콜리 싫어. 어찌하여 그것이 나를 이리 괴롭히는가.

english: Why are they here, you didn't command it.
translation: 저자는 어찌하여 여기 있는 것이옵니까? 명하신 적도 없사온데.

english: What do you mean? I was told to come here.
translation: 무슨 말씀이세요? 여기로 오라고 해서 왔는데요.

english: We're not talking to you.
Great round one, should I rid us of this intruder?
translation: 위대하고 둥그신 분이시여, 이 침입자를 처리해 버려도 되겠사옵니까?

english: Ask again later.
What is going on here, why are you talking to an egg?
translation: 이게 다 무슨 일이에요? 왜 알한테 말을 거세요?

english: The Omlettesiah feels generous today, what do you want and why are you here?
translation: 오믈렛시아께서 오늘은 너그러우시구나. 원하는 게 무엇이며 왜 여기 왔느냐?

english: I'm not sure, I was told to come here when I stepped out of the portal.
translation: 저도 잘 모르겠어요. 포털에서 걸어 나오니까 여기로 가 보라고 하더라고요.

english: WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
Uuh, I mean, I was told to come here... after I hopped out of the portal.
translation: 어, 그러니까... 포털에서 깡충 뛰어나오니까 여기로 가 보라고 하더라고요.

english: YOU CAME BACK? THE EGG DIDN'T COMMAND IT.
We need to punish them, but you have commanded me to wait...
Who are you talking to?
Our wise ruler, the divine egg. It is our great leader.
translation: 우리의 현명한 통치자, 신성한 알이시다. 우리의 위대한 지도자이시지.

english: It appeared to me one night when I was down by the coast, I have been its loyal servant ever since.
translation: 어느 날 밤 해안가에 내려갔을 때 내 앞에 나타나셨고, 그 뒤로 나는 줄곧 그분의 충직한 종이었다.

english: I am its voice, I give action to its words, it serves a greater good than we can understand.
translation: 나는 그분의 목소리이며, 그분의 말씀을 행동으로 옮긴다. 그분은 우리가 이해할 수 없는 더 큰 선을 위해 일하신다.

english: Are you talking about that egg on the table?
translation: 저기 탁자 위에 있는 알 말씀이세요?

english: YOU'RE TALKING TO A POWER YOU CANNOT COMPREHEND.
translation: 너는 지금 네가 이해할 수조차 없는 권능께 말을 걸고 있는 것이다.

english: Wow... well then.
Maybe there's someone more reasonable I can talk to.
translation: 좀 더 말이 통하는 누군가랑 얘기해 봐야겠어.

english: Great round one, will Jessica Rabbit ever love me?
translation: 위대하고 둥그신 분이시여, Jessica Rabbit(제시카 래빗)이 언젠가 저를 사랑해 줄까요?

english: Outlook not so good.
The almighty egg, will my kingdom ever fall?
translation: 전능하신 알이시여, 제 왕국이 언젠가 무너지겠사옵니까?

english: Concentrate and ask again.
My mighty yolk, do you think I'd look good in a top hat?
translation: 위대하신 노른자님이시여, 제가 실크해트를 쓰면 잘 어울리겠사옵니까?

english: As I see it, yes.
Oh wise one, is there a wiser ruler than I?
translation: 오, 현명하신 분이시여, 저보다 현명한 통치자가 있사옵니까?

english: My sources say no.
Great golden one, will I gain incredible riches this year?
translation: 위대한 황금빛 분이시여, 올해 제가 엄청난 부를 얻게 되겠사옵니까?

english: Better not tell you now.
translation: 지금은 말해 주지 않는 편이 낫겠다.

english: Maybe there's someone more sane I can talk to.
translation: 좀 더 제정신인 누군가랑 얘기해 봐야겠어.

english: Paws is probably the best person to talk to right now.
translation: 지금은 Paws(포즈)랑 얘기해 보는 게 제일 좋겠어.

english: Your Dukeness, I've discovered a revelation!
What do they want, why can't they leave us?
translation: 저자가 무엇을 원하는 것이옵니까? 어찌하여 우리를 내버려 두지 않는 것이옵니까?

english: That egg on the table... it is a fake!
Don't be so foolish, of course it's real.
How do you know? Someone could have easily swapped it out for a fake one.
translation: 어떻게 아세요? 누가 가짜랑 슬쩍 바꿔 놨을 수도 있잖아요.

english: That doesn't make sense, if this is a fake, how did you find the original?
translation: 말이 안 되는구나. 이게 가짜라면 너는 진짜를 어떻게 찾았단 말이냐?

english: Oh, I uh, found it in a burrow underneath the castle.
translation: 아, 그게, 어... 성 밑에 있는 굴에서 찾았어요.

english: Unlikely story. Since I found it, I've been watching it like a falcon.
translation: 믿기 어려운 이야기로구나. 내가 그분을 찾은 뒤로 매처럼 눈을 떼지 않고 지켜보았거늘.

english: If you don't trust me, why don't you ask that egg?
translation: 제 말을 못 믿으시겠으면 저 알한테 물어보시는 건 어때요?

english: Fine, but if you're trying to trick us, we'll dispose of you.
translation: 좋다. 하지만 우리를 속이려는 것이라면 너를 처리해 버리겠다.

english: Your magical eggness: Are you a fake version and does this coney hold the real one?
translation: 마법의 알님이시여, 당신은 가짜이시며, 진짜는 이 토끼가 갖고 있사옵니까?

english: -Sweating profusely- ...
Without a doubt.
What the flying carrot!
Phew... see, I told you it's fake.
I can't believe it, how long have I been made a fool of?
translation: 믿을 수가 없구나. 대체 얼마나 오랫동안 바보 취급을 당한 것이냐?

english: Give me the real one, we need to rid ourselves of this imposter.
translation: 진짜를 내놓아라. 이 사기꾼을 없애 버려야겠다.

english: Duke Rabbacio takes the fake egg off you and swaps it with the real one.
translation: Duke Rabbacio(라바시오 공작)이 가짜 알을 받아 가고 진짜 알로 바꿔 놓는다.

english: I'm glad we got that sorted, feel free to ensure it works properly.
translation: 잘 해결돼서 다행이에요. 제대로 작동하는지 확인해 보세요.

english: I'll uh, dispose of this one for you.
Wise one: Do I have to have broccoli with my carrots tonight?
translation: 현명하신 분이시여, 오늘 밤 당근에 브로콜리도 곁들여 먹어야 하옵니까?

english: [chosen negative option]
Yes! Just what I wanted to hear, thank you for your help.
translation: 그래! 바로 듣고 싶던 말이다. 도와줘서 고맙구나.

english: I will let you ask but one question to the great supreme.
translation: 위대한 지존께 딱 한 가지만 질문하도록 허락해 주마.

english: Oh, ghee thanks, I'm not sure what to ask, maybe...
translation: 어, 에그... 고마워요. 뭘 물어봐야 할지 모르겠는데, 음...

english: Egg: Should rabbits keep jumping through the strange portal that no one knows where it leads to?
translation: 알님: 토끼들이 어디로 이어지는지 아무도 모르는 이상한 포털로 계속 뛰어들어야 할까요?

english: Well, that settles it, I'll send the order for all rabbits to cease jumping through the portal at once.
translation: 자, 결론이 났구나. 모든 토끼에게 당장 포털로 뛰어드는 것을 멈추라는 명령을 내리겠다.

english: You may leave me, keep that fake egg and dispose of it.
translation: 이제 물러가도 좋다. 그 가짜 알은 가져가서 처리하거라.

english: I'll also let everyone know you're a good rabbit, so if they need a paw, don't hesitate to help out.
translation: 네가 착한 토끼라고 모두에게 알려 두마. 그러니 누가 앞발을 빌려 달라고 하면 주저 말고 도와주거라.

english: Great! I should return to Gelt to let him know what has happened.
translation: 좋아요! Gelt(겔트)에게 돌아가서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알려야겠어요.

english: Leave me, I have many questions to ask the mythical one.
translation: 물러가거라. 신비로우신 분께 여쭐 것이 아주 많다.

english: The Duke brushes you off, returning his focus to the egg.
translation: 공작은 손을 휘저어 쫓아내고는 다시 알에 정신을 집중한다.

english: What are you doing?! Step away from it.
Sorry Duke...
Big Egg, will I ever...
None can talk to it except me!
translation: 나 말고는 아무도 그분께 말을 걸 수 없다!

english: What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 광석을 conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 올려놓으면 제련해 줄 거야. 보일러에 불 때는 거랑 나머지 기계 돌리는 건 우리가 다 해 주지.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 대신 pipe(파이프)가 터질 때마다 용광로 수리는 거들어 줘야 해. 그냥 hammer(망치)로 두드리면 돼. 보통은 그걸로 고쳐지거든.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 우리 일삯은 coffer(금고)에 돈을 넣어서 내야 해. 한 시간에 72,000코인이고, 네가 이 방에 우리랑 같이 있는 동안 계속 빠져나가.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 나랑 형제들은 성장에 영향을 주는 희귀한 유전 질환이 있어. 괴물 취급하는 대신, 덕분에 우리가 기계를 다룰 수 있다는 게 얼마나 쓸모 있는지 좀 알아줬으면 좋겠군.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 괜찮아, 인간. 그 얘기 한 게 네가 처음도 아니니까. 그래서, 뭐 필요한 거 있어? 난 여기서 할 일이 있거든.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ... 이봐, 도움이 필요한 거야, 아니면 그냥 무례하게 굴려고 온 거야? 난 할 일이 있다고.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
Hey, [player name], the teacher wants you to come to school for a test.
translation: 야, [player name], 선생님이 시험 보러 학교로 오래!

english: Sure, I fancy an exam.
translation: 좋아, 시험 한번 쳐 보지 뭐.

english: I don't want to.
Nope, you're not the one the teacher wanted me to find!
translation: 아니네, 선생님이 찾아오라던 사람은 네가 아니야!

english: Surprise exam, [player name]!
Come to school, [player name]!
You're getting tested, [player name]!
The teacher wants you, [player name]!
Teacher gets angry when he's kept waiting, [player name]!
Maybe later.
Hello!
Star yet?
Yes, yes you are.
STAR!
Sure, I fancy an exam.
translation: 좋아, 시험 한번 쳐 보지 뭐.

english: I don't want to.
Dung cook human.
Ash eat human.
Dung will fry human.
Dung is wrong!
My brother in stronghold best cook.
Ash will boil human 'till it tender.
translation: Ash(재) 인간 푹 삶는다, 부드러워질 때까지.

english: Much more tasty.
Ash will not cook human!
Ash will boil!
Dung will boil Ash's head!
Boil better!
Fry better!
Boil!
Fry!
Ow!
Ugh!
Dung not hit Ash!
Ow!
Ouch!
Dung hate Ash!
Ash hate Dung!
Well, if it isn't our very own sledder! What can I do for you today?
translation: 이거, 우리 썰매꾼 아닌가! 오늘은 뭘 도와주면 되겠나?

english: Can I have another law talisman?
translation: law talisman(법칙 부적) 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Well, I've got one here you can have for 1,000 coins if you'd like it?
translation: 그래, 여기 하나 있는데 1,000코인에 주겠네. 가져가겠나?

english: Yes, I'll take it.
Looks like you don't have enough money to afford it just now, come back when you do.
translation: 지금은 돈이 모자란 것 같군. 돈이 생기면 다시 오게.

english: Looks like you don't have any room to carry it just now, come back when you do.
translation: 지금은 들고 갈 자리가 없는 것 같군. 자리가 생기면 다시 오게.

english: You hand over the coins... and receive a law talisman.
translation: 코인을 건네고... law talisman(법칙 부적)을 받았다.

english: Thanks.
No thanks...
Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
translation: 제 Climbing boots(등반화)에 징 좀 박아 주실 수 있어요?

english: For you, no problem.
Do you realise that you can only use the Climbing boots right now? The Spiked boots can only be used in the Icelands but no onesbeen able to get there for years!
translation: 지금 쓸 수 있는 건 Climbing boots(등반화)뿐이라는 걸 알고 있나? Spiked boots(징 박힌 장화)는 Icelands(얼음 땅)에서나 쓸 수 있는데, 거긴 몇 년째 아무도 못 가 봤다네!

english: Yes, but I still want them.
Sorry, I'll need an Ironbar to make the spikes.
translation: 미안하지만, 징을 만들려면 Ironbar(철 주괴)가 하나 있어야 하네.

english: Anything else before I get on with my work?
translation: 내가 일 계속하기 전에 또 필요한 거 있나?

english: Oh OK, I'll leave them thanks.
translation: 아, 알겠어요. 그럼 그냥 둘게요, 고마워요.

english: Can you make me another sled?
translation: 썰매 하나 더 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yeah sure, have you got the maple or yew logs, an iron bar and some rope?
translation: 그럼, 물론이지. maple(단풍나무) 통나무나 yew logs(주목 통나무), iron bar(철 주괴), 그리고 rope(밧줄)은 가져왔나?

english: No, I haven't got everything yet.
Well, unfortunately I can't make the sled without all the materials.
translation: 그렇다면 안타깝지만 재료가 다 없으면 썰매를 만들 수가 없네.

english: What do I need for the sled wax again?
You will need some wax and some swamp tar.
translation: wax(밀랍) 약간과 swamp tar(늪 타르) 약간이 필요하네.

english: Where can I get wax from?
I don't know. I'm a smith! But maybe you should look for some bees.
translation: 나야 모르지. 난 대장장이라고! 그래도 벌을 찾아보는 게 좋을 것 같군.

english: Where can I get swamp tar from?
translation: swamp tar(늪 타르)는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: The swamp of course! It's south of Lumbridge.
What else do I need?
You will also need a cake tin to store the wax in.
translation: wax(밀랍)을 담아 둘 cake tin(케이크 틀)도 하나 필요하네.

english: See you!
Thank you, come again.
Nothing, thanks.
How is your son getting on?
He is getting on fine! He has just been promoted to Sergeant! I'm really proud of him!
translation: 잘 지내고 있지! 막 병장으로 진급했다네! 정말 자랑스러워!

english: I'm happy for you!
He is getting on fine! He has just started his basic training and has already been promoted to corporal! I'm really proud of him!
translation: 잘 지내고 있지! 이제 막 기초 훈련을 시작했는데 벌써 상병으로 진급했다네! 정말 자랑스러워!

english: He was captured by those blasted trolls! I don't know what to do. Even the imperial guard are too afraid to go rescue him.
translation: 그 망할 트롤 놈들한테 붙잡혀 갔네! 어찌해야 할지 모르겠어. Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)조차 겁이 나서 구하러 가질 못하고 있네.

english: What happened?
Talk to Denulth, he can tell you all about it. Anything else before I get on with my work?
translation: Denulth(데눌스)한테 가서 얘기해 보게, 그가 다 말해 줄 걸세. 내가 일 계속하기 전에 또 필요한 거 있나?

english: Is it OK if I use your anvil?
So you're a smithy are you?
I dabble.
A fellow smith is welcome to use my anvil!
translation: 동료 대장장이라면 내 anvil(모루)를 얼마든지 써도 좋네!

english: Thanks!
Hi!
Hi! How can I help?
Tenzing has asked me to bring you his climbing boots, he needs to have spikes put on them.
translation: Tenzing(텐징)이 자기 climbing boots(등반화)를 가져다드리라고 했어요. 징을 박아야 한대요.

english: He does, does he? Well I won't do it till he pays for the last set I made for him!
translation: 그래? 그 친구, 지난번에 만들어 준 것부터 값을 치르기 전엔 안 해 줄 걸세!

english: This is really important!
How so?
Well, I need the Sherpa to show me a secret way up Death Plateau so that the Imperial Guard can destroy the troll camp! He won't help me till I've got the spikes!
translation: Sherpa(셰르파)가 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 비밀 길을 알려 줘야 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 트롤 야영지를 쳐부술 수 있거든요! 그런데 징을 박아 오기 전엔 도와주지 않겠대요!

english: Hmm. That's different!
Tell you what, I'll make them for you on one condition.
translation: 이렇게 하세. 조건 하나만 들어주면 만들어 주겠네.

english: *sigh* What's the condition?
My son has just turned 16 and I'd very much like him to join the Imperial Guard. The Prince's elite forces are invite only so it's very unlikely he'll get in. If you can arrange that you have a deal!
translation: 내 아들이 막 열여섯이 됐는데, Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)에 꼭 들어갔으면 하네. 왕자님의 정예 부대는 초대받은 사람만 들어갈 수 있어서 우리 애가 들어가긴 어려울 거야. 자네가 그걸 주선해 줄 수 있다면 거래 성사일세!

english: That won't be a problem as I'm helping out the Imperial Guard!
translation: 그건 문제없어요. 제가 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대) 일을 돕고 있거든요!

english: Excellent! You'll need to bring an Iron bar for the spikes!
translation: 훌륭하군! 징을 만들려면 Iron bar(철 주괴)를 가져와야 하네!

english: Have you managed to get my son signed up for the Imperial Guard?
translation: 내 아들을 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)에 넣어 주는 일은 어떻게 됐나?

english: Not yet! I just need to speak to Denulth!
I have but I don't have the entrance certificate on me.
translation: 넣어 드리긴 했는데, 입대 증명서를 지금 안 갖고 있어요.

english: Good but I need to have the certificate.
translation: 잘했네. 하지만 증명서가 내 손에 있어야 하네.

english: You give Dunstan the certificate.
Thank you!
Now to keep my end of the bargain. Give me the boots and an iron bar and I'll put on the spikes.
translation: 이제 내 쪽 약속을 지킬 차례로군. 장화랑 iron bar(철 주괴)를 주면 징을 박아 주겠네.

english: I don't have the iron bar or the climbing boots.
translation: iron bar(철 주괴)도 climbing boots(등반화)도 없어요.

english: I don't have the iron bar.
I don't have the climbing boots.
You give Dunstan an iron bar and the climbing boots.
translation: Dunstan(던스턴)에게 iron bar(철 주괴)와 climbing boots(등반화)를 건넸다.

english: Dunstan has given you the spiked boots.
translation: Dunstan(던스턴)이 spiked boots(징 박힌 장화)를 건네주었다.

english: Thank you!
No problem.
Hi!
I see you've got the spiked boots. Are you going to take them to the Sherpa?
translation: spiked boots(징 박힌 장화)를 구했군. Sherpa(셰르파)한테 가져다줄 건가?

english: I will do shortly.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Talk about a quest.
Can I have another law talisman?
translation: law talisman(법칙 부적) 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Yes, I'll take it.
No thanks...
Can you put some spikes on my Climbing boots?
translation: 제 Climbing boots(등반화)에 징 좀 박아 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, but I still want them.
Oh OK, I'll leave them thanks.
translation: 아, 알겠어요. 그럼 그냥 둘게요, 고마워요.

english: Can you make me another sled?
translation: 썰매 하나 더 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: What do I need for the sled wax again?
Where can I get wax from?
Where can I get swamp tar from?
translation: swamp tar(늪 타르)는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: What else do I need?
See you!
Nothing, thanks.
Talk about something else.
How is your son getting on?
Is it OK if I use your anvil?
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어요! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 와요.

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [monster] 사냥 중이네요. [amount]마리 남았어요. 임무를 마치면 다시 와요.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신한테 맞지 않는 것 같네요. 취소할까요? 임무 연속 기록은 초기화되지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, 다양한 슬레이어 장비도 팔고 있어요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠어요, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거예요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하니까 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요 - 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠어요, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 거예요.

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.

This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
translation: 이건 Slayer's Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)예요. 진정한 슬레이어 마스터만 입을 수 있고, 그런 업적을 인정하는 의미로 슬레이어 마스터들이 같은 임무를 연달아 고를 수 있게 해 주기도 해요.

english: You need more training before you earn that honour, though.
translation: 하지만 그걸 얻으려면 훈련을 더 해야 해요.

english: May I buy a Slayer's Skillcape, please?
translation: Slayer's Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
translation: 학생으로서 아주 잘해 왔어요. 이제 이렇게 명예로운 망토를 입을 자격이 있다고 봐요. 슬레이어 마스터들이 이 망토를 알아보고 같은 임무를 두 번 연달아 줄 수도 있어요.

english: That will be 99000 coins, please.
I've changed my mind; I don't want it.
Okay. Well, if you change it back again, I will be waiting.
translation: 알겠어요. 혹시 마음이 다시 바뀌면 기다리고 있을게요.

english: Great, I've always wanted one!
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝지만 모든 스킬 망토에는 무료 두건이 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알죠? 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 와야 해요.

english: Good hunting, [player name].
Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 마법으로 당신과 연락하고 있어요.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요 - 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
Can you sell me a Slayer Skillcape?
translation: Slayer Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)를 팔 수 있어요?

english: I've changed my mind, I don't want it.
Great; I've always wanted one!
Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Burgers!
Hot frogburgers!
Frogburgers!
Frog in a bun!
Tasty frogburgers!
Eyup. Not too often we get visitors down here.
translation: 어이. 여기까지 손님이 오는 일은 별로 없는데.

english: What is this place?
Beats me. All I know is, there's dust devils in here, and I'm here to make sure only people with permission can kill 'em.
translation: 나도 몰라. 내가 아는 건, 여기 dust devils(먼지 악마)가 있고, 허락받은 사람만 그놈들을 잡게 하는 게 내 일이라는 것뿐이야.

english: Can I kill them?
You got a Slayer task for it, so sure, be my guest.
translation: 그놈들 슬레이어 임무를 받았으니, 그럼. 마음대로 해.

english: Not without a Slayer task. Go talk to a Slayer Master about it.
translation: 슬레이어 임무 없이는 안 돼. Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)한테 가서 얘기해 봐.

english: Who are you?
The name's Dusty Aliv. I guard this place for the Slayer Masters.
translation: 내 이름은 Dusty Aliv(더스티 알리브). Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들을 위해 여길 지키고 있지.

english: That doesn't sound like a great job.
Eh, it has its perks. Plus it beats flying around Gielinor after numbskulls like you trying to deliver mail like some people I know.
translation: 에이, 나름 좋은 점도 있어. 게다가 내가 아는 누구처럼 Gielinor(길리노르)를 날아다니며 너 같은 멍청이들 쫓아다니면서 편지 배달하는 것보단 낫지.

english: Nice sword.
Thanks. Probably shouldn't tell you about the previous owner though.
translation: 고마워. 전 주인 얘기는 안 하는 게 좋겠지만.

english: What happened to them?
Let's just say the heat got to them.
Goodbye.
See ya.
Oi! Only people with a Slayer task can slay in here!
translation: 어이! 여기서는 슬레이어 임무가 있는 사람만 사냥할 수 있어!

english: What is this place?
Who are you?
Nice sword.
Goodbye.
Hello human.
Hello. What do you do here?
I'm Dusuri. I specialise in unique minerals that can't be found on Gielinor.
translation: 전 Dusuri(두수리)예요. Gielinor(길리노르)에서는 찾을 수 없는 특별한 광물을 전문으로 다루고 있어요.

english: Can't be found on Gielinor? Where do they come from then?
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)에서 찾을 수 없다고요? 그럼 어디서 오는 건데요?

english: To be honest, we don't fully know. All we know is that they can be found within shooting stars.
translation: 솔직히 우리도 잘 몰라요. 아는 건 별똥별 안에서 찾을 수 있다는 것뿐이에요.

english: Shooting stars?
That's right. They fall from the sky from time to time. They can be mined for the unique minerals that I specialise in.
translation: 맞아요. 가끔 하늘에서 떨어지거든요. 그걸 캐면 제가 전문으로 다루는 특별한 광물을 얻을 수 있어요.

english: If you ever come across one, I'd be happy to trade you for any stardust you find.
translation: 혹시 하나라도 발견하면, 찾은 stardust(별가루)를 기꺼이 거래해 드릴게요.

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Good luck out there.
Oh yes. I've seen those before.
translation: 아, 네. 전에 본 적 있어요.

english: Wonderful. If you ever get any stardust from them, I'd be happy to trade you for it.
translation: 멋지네요. 거기서 stardust(별가루)를 얻게 되면 기꺼이 거래해 드릴게요.

english: I have some here. Can we trade?
translation: 여기 좀 있어요. 거래할 수 있을까요?

english: Not now, I'm afraid. Maybe another time.
translation: 지금은 안 될 것 같아요. 다음에 해요.

english: Of course.
Can we trade?
What do you sell?
I have packs of gems and soft clay if they take your fancy. I also have some interesting star fragments that seem to be able to recolour certain metals.
translation: 마음에 드신다면 보석 꾸러미와 soft clay(부드러운 점토)가 있어요. 특정 금속의 색을 바꿀 수 있는 것 같은 흥미로운 별 조각도 있고요.

english: Most notably, I have a unique ring that we found embedded within a star once. It seems to have magical properties that we don't fully understand. What we do know is that it can improve your skill while mining.
translation: 무엇보다도, 예전에 별 안에 박혀 있던 걸 찾아낸 특별한 반지가 있어요. 우리가 다 이해하지 못한 마법적 성질이 있는 것 같아요. 확실한 건 채광할 때 실력을 높여 준다는 거예요.

english: What can you tell me about shooting stars?
translation: 별똥별에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Not a lot really. All I know is that they fall from the sky from time to time and that you can mine them.
translation: 사실 많지는 않아요. 아는 건 가끔 하늘에서 떨어진다는 것과 캘 수 있다는 것뿐이에요.

english: If you want to know more, there's an observatory near Ardougne that you might want to visit. They've done some research into them.
translation: 더 알고 싶다면 Ardougne(아르둔) 근처에 천문대가 있으니 가 보세요. 거기서 별똥별을 연구해 왔거든요.

english: I'm off.
I have some here. Can we trade?
translation: 여기 좀 있어요. 거래할 수 있을까요?

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Can we trade?
What do you sell?
What can you tell me about shooting stars?
translation: 별똥별에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: I'm off.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please, what are you selling?
No thanks.
Hello there. How's it going?
Hello. Who are you?
I'm an adventurer.
Really? How interesting...
Not too bad, thanks. How about you?
I'm good, thank you.
Sorry, but I have work to do right now.
Hello there! I'm very well, thank you.
Sorry, I'm busy right now.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Mining Guild(채광 길드)에 온 걸 환영해요. 뭐 도와드릴 거 있어요?

english: What have you got in the guild?
All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! coal rocks(석탄 바위)가 잔뜩 있고, iron(철), mithril(미스릴), adamantite(아다만타이트)도 좀 있어요.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: 길드 더 깊숙한 곳엔 runite(루나이트)를 포함해서 바위가 더 많아요! 그래도 제일 좋은 건 이 땅에 하나뿐인 amethyst(자수정) 광산이죠!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
translation: 이보다 나은 채광 장소는 어디에도 없어요!

english: What do you dwarves do with the ore you mind?
What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: 뭘 할 것 같아요? 제련해서 주괴로 만들고, 그 금속을 두드려서 갑옷과 무기를 만든 다음, 물건이나 서비스와 교환하죠.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: 여기서는 갑옷이나 무기를 파는 드워프가 별로 안 보이던데요.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: 네, 여긴 그냥 채광 전초기지일 뿐이에요. 우리 드워프들은 인간 도시에 정착하는 걸 별로 안 좋아하거든요. 광석은 대부분 위대한 드워프 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림)으로 실려 가요. 거기엔 특별한 blast furnace(대형 용광로)가 있어서

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 광석 제련이 훨씬 쉬워요. Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 일하는 드워프 상인도 많아요. 어쨌든, 또 도와드릴 거 있어요?

english: No thanks, I'm fine.
Sorry, but you're not experienced enough to go in there.
You need a Mining level of 60 to access the Mining Guild.
translation: Mining Guild(채광 길드)에 들어가려면 Mining(채광) 레벨 60이 필요해요.

english: What have you got in the Guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
No thanks, I'm fine.
Hello there. Do you need anything?
What's through this cave?
This cave leads to the Mining Guild, home to the finest mining site around. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 이 동굴은 이 근방 최고의 채광 장소인 Mining Guild(채광 길드)로 이어져요. 또 도와드릴 거 있어요?

english: I hope the goblins are properly maintaining their stretch of track! I'd hate to see them spoil good Dwarven workmanship.
translation: 고블린들이 자기네 구간 선로를 제대로 관리하고 있으면 좋겠네요! 훌륭한 드워프 솜씨를 망쳐 놓는 꼴은 보고 싶지 않거든요.

english: You're [player name], aren't you? It's a good job you did helping to get this train link open.
translation: [player name] 맞죠? 이 열차 노선을 여는 데 정말 큰 도움을 줬어요.

english: Y'know, at first I didn't like the idea of visiting a goblin city, but these cave goblins are alright.
translation: 있잖아요, 처음엔 고블린 도시에 간다는 게 별로 내키지 않았는데, 이 동굴 고블린들은 꽤 괜찮더라고요.

english: These goblins have so much more advanced technology than us. Take a look at their magical lights! We could never create something like them.
translation: 이 고블린들은 우리보다 기술이 훨씬 발전했어요. 저 마법 조명 좀 봐요! 우린 저런 건 절대 못 만들 거예요.

english: Dorgesh-Kaan's very nice to visit, but I don't think I'd want to live there.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)은 구경하기엔 정말 좋은데, 거기서 살고 싶지는 않네요.

english: Ho there, human!
[player name].
Ho there, [player name]! Want to take a ride with me?
translation: 어이, [player name]! 나랑 배 타고 갈래?

english: Where are you going? Across the river?
No no, that's what the ferryman is for! I'm going to Keldagrim, my home!
translation: 아니 아니, 그건 뱃사공이 할 일이지! 난 Keldagrim(켈다그림)에 가. 내 고향이거든!

english: How much will that cost me then?
For a human like you, I can do it for free!
translation: 너 같은 인간이라면 공짜로 태워 주지!

english: That's a deal!
Excellent! I'm just waiting for my ship to arrive and then we can go.
translation: 좋았어! 내 배가 도착하기만 기다리는 중이니까 오면 바로 출발하자고.

english: Mind, this trip could take a few minutes! Are you sure you're ready to go as well?
translation: 그런데 이번 여행은 몇 분 걸릴 수도 있어! 너도 갈 준비 다 된 거 맞지?

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that one or more of your skill levels are lower than what is required to fully complete it.
translation: 이 퀘스트를 시작하기 전에 알아 두세요. 스킬 레벨 중 하나 이상이 퀘스트를 완전히 끝내는 데 필요한 레벨보다 낮습니다.

english: Yes, I'm ready and don't mind it taking a few minutes.
translation: 네, 준비됐어요. 몇 분 걸려도 괜찮아요.

english: Well, let's not waste any more time then!
translation: 좋아, 그럼 더 시간 낭비하지 말자고!

english: No, I don't have time right now, I'll be back later.
translation: 아뇨, 지금은 시간이 없어요. 나중에 다시 올게요.

english: Sure, sure! Come back when you need to!
translation: 그래, 그래! 필요할 때 다시 와!

english: I prefer the mines to the city.
Well, suit yourself then!
Hello again, [player name]! Want to go back to Keldagrim?
Yes, please take me.
What, on your ship? No way.
translation: 뭐요, 그쪽 배를 타라고요? 절대 싫어요.

english: Hey, it was only a little accident! Calm down!
translation: 이봐, 그건 그냥 작은 사고였다고! 진정해!

english: Want me to take you back to the mines?
What, on your ship? No thanks! I don't want to crash into any more things!
translation: 뭐요, 그쪽 배를 타라고요? 사양할게요! 또 뭔가에 들이받고 싶지 않거든요!

english: Hey now, it was only a slight accident!
translation: 이봐 이봐, 그건 그냥 살짝 난 사고였다니까!

english: A slight accident?? Have you any idea how much time I spent rebuilding that statue?
translation: 살짝 난 사고요?? 제가 그 조각상 다시 세우느라 시간을 얼마나 들였는지 알기나 해요?

english: Calm down, calm down! You got what you paid for the trip, didn't you?
translation: 진정해, 진정해! 뱃삯 낸 만큼은 받았잖아, 안 그래?

english: That's a deal!
Yes.
No.
I prefer the mines to the city.
Yes, please take me.
What, on your ship? No way.
translation: 뭐요, 그쪽 배를 타라고요? 절대 싫어요.

english: What, on your ship! No thanks!
Do you have any gold ore that you want me to take to the bank in the city?
translation: 도시 은행에 맡겨 줬으면 하는 gold ore(금광석) 있어?

english: I don't have any, I'm afraid.
Well, I have this one piece of ore...
translation: 음, 광석이 딱 한 개 있긴 한데요...

english: That wouldn't do you much good, I'm afraid. My minimum fee is one piece of gold ore, there wouldn't be anything left for you.
translation: 그래 봤자 별 도움이 안 될 거야. 내 최소 수수료가 금광석 한 개라서, 너한테 남는 게 없거든.

english: Yes, please take my gold to the city. I've got [number] pieces of ore right here.
translation: 네, 제 금을 도시로 가져다주세요. 여기 광석이 [number]개 있어요.

english: Are you sure you have enough space in your bank account for that?
translation: 그만큼 넣을 자리가 네 은행 계좌에 충분한 거 확실해?

english: No, you're right actually, I don't.
Let's see, if I take that to the bank for you, I'd keep [number] for myself and bring [number] to the bank for you. Does that sound fair?
translation: 어디 보자, 내가 그걸 은행에 가져다주면 [number]개는 내가 갖고 [number]개를 네 은행에 넣어 주는 거야. 공평하지?

english: Yes, it does.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you! I'll take these to the city with my next shipment.
translation: 좋았어, 거래하기 즐거웠어! 다음 운송 때 이것들을 도시로 가져갈게.

english: No, that's far too expensive for me.
No, I'll hang on to these myself, thanks.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 제가 갖고 있을게요. 고마워요.

english: It all seems a bit expensive, really.
I don't know... it's just what Dondakan told me, if someone wanted me to ship their gold.
translation: 글쎄... 누가 금을 실어 달라고 하면 그렇게 받으라고 Dondakan(돈다칸)이 말해 준 것뿐인데.

english: There's plenty of gold coming from that rock now, surely you can lower the price somewhat?
translation: 요즘 저 바위에서 금이 엄청 나오잖아요. 값을 좀 깎아 줄 수 있지 않아요?

english: Alright. Tell you what, I'll only keep [number] for myself and bring [number] ores to the bank for you. Deal?
translation: 알았어. 그럼 이렇게 하자. [number]개만 내가 갖고 [number]개를 네 은행에 넣어 줄게. 어때?

english: Yes, much appreciated.
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you!
Yes, please take my gold to the city.
No, I'll hang on to these myself.
[Charm] It all seems a bit expensive, really.
I wish you'd just leave me alone.
translation: 그냥 날 좀 내버려 뒀으면 좋겠는데.

english: Why, what's wrong?
I was a great engineer once. Still am actually.
translation: 나도 한때는 대단한 기술자였어. 사실 지금도 그렇고.

english: They just don't let me do the work I do best anymore.
translation: 그런데 이제는 내가 제일 잘하는 일을 못 하게 한단 말이지.

english: What do you do then?
I'm an assistant in this shop. I get all the lousy jobs too.
translation: 이 가게 조수야. 시시한 일은 죄다 내 차지고.

english: Well, I'm sorry to hear that.
Hello there, want a ride?
A ride, where to?
Across the river, across the river! It's just a short ride!
translation: 강 건너, 강 건너지! 금방 가는 거리야!

english: How much will that cost me?
Haha, you understand us dwarves well, human!
translation: 하하, 넌 우리 드워프들을 잘 아는구나, 인간!

english: It's just 2 gold pieces! Want to go?
I'd like to go further downstream.
translation: 강 하류 쪽으로 더 가고 싶은데요.

english: You mean to the city of Keldagrim?
Ehm, yes, I think so.
Sorry, I'm just a simple ferryman, I only go across.
translation: 미안하지만 난 그냥 평범한 뱃사공이라 강만 건너 줘.

english: But talk to my friend here, he sometimes goes to the city in his ship.
translation: 대신 여기 내 친구한테 말해 봐. 그 친구는 가끔 자기 배로 도시에 가거든.

english: Thanks.
You don't even have 2 gold coins, humans!
Come back later.
No thanks.
You don't even have 2 gold coins, human!
But... that means I'm stuck here.
Hmm. I suppose I could make an exception for you this time.
translation: 흠. 이번만은 특별히 봐줄 수도 있지.

english: Thanks a lot!
I'd like to go further downstream.
translation: 강 하류 쪽으로 더 가고 싶은데요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Out of the way!
Coming through!
Make way, make way!
[20-40] ores of [copper/tin/iron/mithril/silver/gold] coming in!
[20-40] pieces of coal coming in!
Here, [20-40] ores of [copper/tin/iron/mithril/silver/gold].
Here, [20-40] pieces of coal.
What's cooking?
The stew for the servant's main meal.
Oh... Fair enough. See you later.
Bye.
Hi!
Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! Happiness in a bowl!
translation: Mad Eadgar's(미치광이 이드가네)에 온 걸 환영하네! 그릇에 담긴 행복일세!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! You'll never want to leave!
translation: Mad Eadgar's(미치광이 이드가네)에 온 걸 환영하네! 한번 오면 떠나기 싫을 걸세!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! We don't serve trolls!
translation: Mad Eadgar's(미치광이 이드가네)에 온 걸 환영하네! 트롤은 안 받네!

english: Welcome to Mad Eadgar's! Serving all day, every day!
translation: Mad Eadgar's(미치광이 이드가네)에 온 걸 환영하네! 하루 종일, 매일매일 영업하네!

english: Would you care to sample our delicious home cooking?
translation: 우리 집의 맛있는 가정식 요리를 맛보겠나?

english: Why do you live so close to the trolls? Isn't it dangerous?
translation: 왜 트롤들 사는 곳 바로 옆에 사세요? 위험하지 않아요?

english: Well, I suppose I do keep getting captured by the trolls and thrown in prison...But they always release me in the end, I'm far too old and skinny for their tastes.
translation: 글쎄, 트롤들한테 자꾸 붙잡혀서 감옥에 갇히긴 하지... 하지만 결국엔 늘 풀어 주더군. 트롤 입맛에 맞기엔 내가 너무 늙고 비쩍 말랐거든.

english: In any case, this is my home, and I'm not leaving it. And this area has the tastiest goats!
translation: 어쨌든 여기가 내 집이니 떠날 생각은 없네. 게다가 이 동네 염소가 제일 맛있거든!

english: What do you have to offer?
The chef's recommendation for today is mountain goat stew. I'll give some stew in exchange for logs for my fire. They're hard to come by around here.
translation: 오늘의 추천 요리는 mountain goat stew(산양 스튜)일세. 불 땔 logs(통나무)를 가져오면 스튜와 바꿔 주지. 이 근처에선 통나무 구하기가 어렵거든.

english: I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.
You don't have any logs! I may be mad, but I'm not stupid!
translation: 통나무가 없잖나! 내가 미치긴 했어도 바보는 아닐세!

english: Here you go! Enjoy!
You get a bowl of mountain goat stew.
You eat the mountain goat stew.
It heals some health.
No thanks, Eadgar.
Your loss!
Why do you live so close to the trolls?
translation: 왜 트롤들 사는 곳 바로 옆에 사세요?

english: What do you have to offer?
I'd like some mountain goat stew, please.
No thanks, Eadgar.
Gratias tibi ago!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 여러 가지예요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 날이 참 좋네요, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 할 거야 많죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Oh no, why today of all days?
What's wrong Mr Rabbit?
I'm having an eggceptionally bad day. But if you must know, my Egg making machine is shell dry and the next shipment of fuel will not be here for a while!
translation: 오늘은 정말 알궂은 하루예요. 굳이 알고 싶다면 말해 줄게요. 제 달걀 제조 기계가 껍데기처럼 바싹 말라 버렸는데, 다음 연료는 한참 뒤에나 도착한대요!

english: I would love it if a cracking adventurer, such as yourself, would help a Bunny in need.
translation: 당신처럼 알토란 같은 모험가가 곤경에 빠진 토끼를 도와준다면 정말 좋을 텐데요.

english: I would love to help you mix up some more fuel.
translation: 연료를 더 만드는 걸 기꺼이 도울게요.

english: Thanks for eggreeing to help me.
There are three ingredients that are needed to make the fuel.
translation: 연료를 만들려면 재료가 세 가지 필요해요.

english: The first ingredient is Dried cocoa. During any other time of year this ingredient would be eggceptionally hard to get.
translation: 첫 번째 재료는 Dried cocoa(말린 코코아)예요. 다른 때 같으면 이 재료는 구하기가 알아주게 어려워요.

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should be a merchant rolling into Al Kharid soon. He should sell you some.
translation: 그래도 제 정보가 정확하다면 곧 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 상인이 하나 들어올 거예요. 그 상인이 팔 거예요.

english: Try not to bring me camel dung, they do look similar.
translation: 낙타 똥은 가져오지 마세요. 생긴 게 비슷하거든요.

english: The second ingredient is really high quality milk.
translation: 두 번째 재료는 아주 질 좋은 우유예요.

english: The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook can help you out.
translation: 이 근방에서 제일 알짜배기 우유라면 단연 Hosidius(호시디우스) 우유죠. Duke Horacio(호라시오 공작)의 요리사가 도와줄 수 있을 거예요.

english: The third ingredient is some cracking spices, very special ones. Can't go into detail, trade secret and all.
translation: 세 번째 재료는 아주 특별하고 알싸한 향신료예요. 자세히는 말 못 해요, 영업 비밀이거든요.

english: I'm sure if you talk to Martin in Draynor, he'll be a good egg and help you out if you ask for Special spices.
translation: Draynor(드레이너)에 있는 Martin(마틴)에게 Special spices(특제 향신료)를 달라고 하면, 알아서 잘 도와줄 거예요.

english: Since you're doing errands for me. Feel Free to use my tunnels to get around.
translation: 제 심부름을 해 주는 거니까 돌아다닐 때 제 터널을 마음껏 써도 돼요.

english: But don't make a yolk out of it, you may only use each tunnel once. Can't have you interrupting my workers any more than that.
translation: 하지만 알뜰하게 써야 해요. 터널마다 한 번씩만 쓸 수 있거든요. 그 이상 제 일꾼들을 방해하게 둘 순 없어요.

english: Also, if you ever forget what you need, there will be a worker nearby who can remind you.
translation: 그리고 뭐가 필요한지 잊어버리면 근처에 있는 일꾼이 알려 줄 거예요.

english: I'll get right on it. Be back soon.
See you soon!
Get stuffed.
I'll have you know this is no yolking matter.
Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
During any other time of year this ingredient would be a nightmare to get.
translation: 다른 때 같으면 이 재료는 구하기가 악몽 같았을 거예요.

english: But if I'm spot on with my information, there should bea merchant making his way from the Kharidian Desert to Al Kharid.
translation: 그래도 제 정보가 정확하다면 Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)에서 Al Kharid(알 카리드)로 오는 상인이 있을 거예요.

english: I'd suggest checking the Shantay Pass.
Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
translation: bottle of Hosidius milk(호시디우스 우유 한 병)은 어디서 구해요?

english: The most eggceptional milk around has got to be milk from Hosidius, I'm sure Duke Horacio's cook in Lumbridge castle can help you out.
translation: 이 근방에서 제일 알짜배기 우유라면 단연 Hosidius(호시디우스) 우유죠. Lumbridge castle(럼브리지 성)에 있는 Duke Horacio(호라시오 공작)의 요리사가 도와줄 수 있을 거예요.

english: Where do I get the Special spices?
He should get the hint.
Goodbye.
Keep on rolling my friend!
Easter Bunny! I knew I would find you here.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)! 여기 있을 줄 알았어요.

english: Easter Bunny... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a long time...
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)... 정말 오랜만에 듣는 이름이네요...

english: How long exactly?
Oh, almost a year.
What have people been calling you instead?
I go by many names.
Some call me 'Eggrabbit'.
Others call me 'Long Ears Johnson'.
Mhmm?
Many times have I walked past Varrock West Bank and been called 'Sellin lobbies 200gp'.
translation: Varrock West Bank(바록 서쪽 은행) 앞을 지나가다가 '랍스터 팝니다 200gp'라고 불린 적도 여러 번이에요.

english: I don't really understand that one.
Do you think perhaps they weren't talking to you?
translation: 혹시 그 사람들, 당신한테 하는 말이 아니었던 거 아닐까요?

english: Who could blame them? I'm a failure!
translation: 누가 그 사람들을 탓하겠어요? 저는 실패작인걸요!

english: Oh come on now, what do you mean?
You call me the Easter Bunny? What right do I have to that name?
translation: 저를 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)라고 부르는 거예요? 제가 무슨 자격으로 그 이름을 쓰겠어요?

english: I don't feel the spirit of Easter within me.
translation: 제 안에서 부활절의 정신이 전혀 느껴지지 않아요.

english: *sniff*
I'm just a big dumb rabbit!
translation: 저는 그냥 덩치만 크고 멍청한 토끼일 뿐이에요!

english: Aww, that's... come on!
I've ruined Easter for everyone!
Aww...
WAHHHH!
The Easter Bunny is clearly very upset and needs cheering up. Perhaps the other people in the Rabbit Hole have some ideas?
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)는 무척 속상해 보이고 기운을 북돋아 줄 필요가 있다. Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)에 있는 다른 이들이 좋은 생각을 갖고 있을지도 모른다.

english: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you feeling?
translation: 안녕하세요, Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 씨. 기분은 좀 어때요?

english: Maybe I'll make my way through this sorry old world as a clown...
translation: 이 서글픈 세상, 차라리 광대로 살아갈까 봐요...

english: Hello! Have you come to take part in the festivities?
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 올해는 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 너무 시무룩해 보여요.

english: Perhaps we can help raise the Easter spirits?
translation: 우리가 부활절의 혼을 좀 되살려 줄 수 없을까요?

english: You want to do some necromancy... To cheer up the Easter Bunny?
translation: 혼을 되살린다고? 강령술이라도 해서... Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 기운을 북돋겠다는 거야?

english: No no no! It's just a figure of speech.
I just wonder if we could do anything to help.
translation: 그냥 우리가 도울 수 있는 게 있을까 해서요.

english: Leave it to me boss.
I happen to know the E.B. is a big fan of bowling. In fact, he used to be a wizard on the lanes. A champion!
translation: 내가 알기로 E.B.가 볼링을 엄청 좋아하거든. 사실 옛날엔 레인 위의 마법사였지. 챔피언이었다고!

english: I also happen to have the ability to...
...Rig the game in his favour.
translation: ...판을 그 녀석한테 유리하게 조작하는 능력 말이야.

english: Which is handy, he's very out of practise nowadays.
translation: 쓸모 있지. 요즘 그 녀석 실력이 엄청 녹슬었거든.

english: Won't he suspect something?
Oh no! You see, I have these gears set up just here.
translation: 천만에! 봐, 바로 여기 톱니바퀴들을 설치해 뒀거든.

english: Wait, are you just trying to get my trade secrets?
translation: 잠깐, 너 지금 내 영업 비밀 캐내려는 거지?

english: This is strictly a humanitarian effort!
Bun-itarian..?
Look, I just want to get Easter back on track.
translation: 저기요, 전 그냥 부활절을 제자리로 돌려놓고 싶을 뿐이에요.

english: You can keep your hustle going, I just want to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 그쪽 장사는 계속하셔도 돼요. 전 그냥 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 돕고 싶은 거예요.

english: Oh alright, since I do owe the big softie. But I've got my whiskers on you!
translation: 에이 알았어, 저 덩치 큰 순둥이한테 신세 진 것도 있으니까. 그래도 내 수염은 너한테서 안 뗄 거다!

english: So, what is it you wanted to show me, [player name]?
translation: 그래서, 저한테 보여 주고 싶은 게 뭐예요, [player name] 님?

english: Well, Bowley here let me in on your secret. Bowling champion three years in a row.
translation: 음, Bowley(보울리)가 당신 비밀을 알려 줬어요. 3년 연속 볼링 챔피언이었다면서요.

english: Oh. Those were the days, I haven't partaken for while now though...
translation: 아. 그땐 좋았죠. 요즘은 한동안 안 했지만요...

english: I just haven't had the spring in my step with my egg responsibilities.
translation: 달걀 일 때문에 요즘은 봄날처럼 들뜬 기분이 영 안 났거든요.

english: Well, here's your chance!
What do you mean? It's hardly fun without decent competition.
translation: 무슨 말이에요? 제대로 된 상대가 없으면 재미가 없잖아요.

english: And nobody here quite likes bowling.
translation: 게다가 여기 있는 누구도 볼링을 딱히 좋아하지 않아요.

english: They what now?
I've only just gone and spent ages digging out this place and installing the machinery!
translation: 이 굴 파고 기계 장치 설치하느라 내가 얼마나 오래 걸렸는데!

english: Nothing to worry about I'm sure!
Ah Bowley, it is good to see you again.
Long Ears Johnson. Come to terrorise me pins again?
translation: Long Ears Johnson(긴귀 존슨). 또 내 핀들 괴롭히러 왔냐?

english: We'll see about that.
Oh yes, [player name] is apparently quite good.
It's been so long since I've had a decent set with a worthy opponent.
translation: 제대로 된 상대와 제대로 한판 붙어 본 게 정말 오래됐어요.

english: Chin up bucko, I'm here and ready to challenge your rule of these alleys!
translation: 기운 내요, 친구. 이 레인의 왕좌에 도전하러 제가 왔으니까요!

english: Well, I suppose I'm not doing anything else. Why not?
translation: 뭐, 딱히 할 일도 없으니까요. 안 될 거 없죠?

english: The player bowls down 3 carrot pins.
A fine shot, but not quite enough!
Watch this!
The Easter Bunny bowls a strike.
A lucky strike?
I'd better shape up or this will be quite one sided.
translation: 정신 바짝 차려야겠네. 안 그러면 일방적인 경기가 되겠어.

english: And that would be no fun at all.
The player bowls down the middle 6 pins.
Ah, so you have some fight in you.
I could do this all day.
That's exactly what I wanted to hear!
The screen fades black with the text "Some time later..."
translation: 화면이 검게 변하며 "얼마 후..."라는 글자가 나타난다.

english: I'm surprised I hadn't heard about your prowess before, [player name].
translation: 그렇게 실력이 좋은데 여태 소문도 못 들었다니 놀랍네요, [player name] 님.

english: Ah you know me, the most modest adventurer in Gielinor.
translation: 아시잖아요, 제가 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제일 겸손한 모험가라는 거.

english: Ah, well I suppose I should pack it in while I'm ahead.
translation: 아, 그럼 이기고 있을 때 그만두는 게 좋겠네요.

english: But we should do this again.
Aye we should! Also if you could get the word out about my establishment, I'll be raking it in!
translation: 그래, 또 하자고! 그리고 내 가게 소문 좀 내 주면 돈 좀 쓸어 담겠는데!

english: I mean... The Rabbit Hole will enjoy all the visitors?
translation: 아니 그러니까... Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)도 손님이 많아지면 좋아할 거란 말이지?

english: Well, anyway...
It was a close match. How are you feeling now?
Oh it was fun but I think I'm just going to sit in the Rabbit Hole a bit longer.
translation: 아, 재밌었어요. 그래도 Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)에 조금 더 앉아 있을래요.

english: I should be off. Always a pleasure, Bowley.
translation: 저는 이만 가 볼게요. 언제나 즐거웠어요, Bowley(보울리).

english: Aye, till next time.
I feel less horrible I suppose...
Well, that's a start!
Hey Bunny, would you like a fancy carrot?
Not really, I've eaten a lot of carrots recently.
translation: 별로요. 요즘 당근을 너무 많이 먹었거든요.

english: They're really good.
I'm alright, thank you though.
Oh, hello again, [player name].
Hello! I have a surprise for you.
Oh? A surprise? It's not something horrible I hope.
translation: 네? 깜짝 선물이요? 끔찍한 건 아니었으면 좋겠네요.

english: Oh no, it's something quite delicious actually.
Delicious?
A lovely mug of carrot juice!
Oh please no more!
Don't worry, this is fancy carrot juice. I made it myself with some fantastic carrots.
translation: 걱정 마요, 이건 고급 당근 주스예요. 끝내주는 당근으로 제가 직접 만들었어요.

english: You made it? Well in that case I suppose I might give it a try. As long as Wheeler hasn't been near it.
translation: 직접 만들었다고요? 그렇다면 한번 마셔 볼게요. Wheeler(휠러)가 근처에 오지만 않았다면요.

english: I made sure of that. Go on!
Here we go then...
Oh...
Oh my...
Wow!
That was delicious, nothing like the usual slop.
translation: 정말 맛있어요. 늘 먹던 꿀꿀이죽이랑은 차원이 달라요.

english: Thank you, [player name], I really needed that.
translation: 고마워요, [player name] 님. 정말 필요했던 거예요.

english: You're welcome!
How are you feeling now? Any better?
Hmm... I'm feeling a bit more hopeful. Like spring is about to, well, spring! But I'm not sure if Easter is really my thing any more.
translation: 흠... 조금 희망이 생겼어요. 봄이 오듯, 음, 마음에도 봄바람이 부는 것 같아요! 그래도 부활절이 아직 제 일인지는 잘 모르겠어요.

english: I'm sure I can help you remember how wonderful it is.
translation: 부활절이 얼마나 멋진지 다시 떠올리게 도와드릴게요.

english: Hmmm... I should check in with Eggus before I give one of these buns to the Easter Bunny. Quality control or something.
translation: 흠... 이 빵을 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)에게 주기 전에 Eggus(에거스)한테 먼저 확인받아야겠어. 품질 관리 같은 거지.

english: Hello...
Hi! I'm back with an Easter treat, just for you.
translation: 안녕하세요! 당신만을 위한 부활절 간식을 가지고 왔어요.

english: Huh?
It's something special.
Special eh? Why would you give me something special?
translation: 특별한 거라고요? 왜 저한테 특별한 걸 주는 거예요?

english: Because you deserve it.
I don't know if I deserve anything.
translation: 제가 뭘 받을 자격이 있는지 모르겠어요.

english: Of course you do!
Here, it's an Easter bun. Fresh out of the oven.
translation: 자, Easter bun(부활절 빵)이에요. 오븐에서 막 꺼낸 거예요.

english: An Easter bun? I like those!
Yum! That was lovely. Thanks, [player name].
translation: 냠! 정말 맛있었어요. 고마워요, [player name] 님.

english: You're a good friend.
You are most welcome. Do you feel a bit more Easter- ey now?
translation: 천만에요. 이제 좀 더 부활절다운 기분이 들어요?

english: Oh, I'm starting to remember now! Easter is great! But I just... Hmm, I don't know...
translation: 아, 이제 기억이 나기 시작해요! 부활절은 정말 멋져요! 그런데 저는 그냥... 흠, 잘 모르겠어요...

english: I feel like I need one more little treat before I do anything to help with Easter.
translation: 부활절 일을 돕기 전에 작은 간식이 하나만 더 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Oh for goodness sake...
Alright, let me think of something.
Excuse me, [player name], I believe I can help you.
translation: 실례합니다, [player name] 님. 제가 도와드릴 수 있을 것 같군요.

english: Oh?
Come here!
I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 기운을 북돋아 주려 하신다는 얘기를 우연히 듣게 됐는데, 제게 좋은 생각이 있어요.

english: Well that's sort of nosey, but go on.
translation: 좀 오지랖이긴 한데, 계속 말해 보세요.

english: Let's put on a performance! that will cheer him up.
translation: 공연을 하는 거예요! 그러면 기운이 날 거예요.

english: A performance?
Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.
translation: 네! 그분은 늘 멋진 공연을 즐겼거든요.

english: Well I suppose that could work...
I have some classic material we can try if that sounds appropriate?
translation: 제게 고전 레퍼토리가 몇 가지 있는데, 괜찮으시다면 그걸 해 볼까요?

english: I don't see why not.
Excellent! I've already talked to some of the other fellows in here about it too. They seem keen!
translation: 훌륭해요! 여기 있는 다른 친구들한테도 벌써 얘기해 뒀어요. 다들 의욕이 넘치더군요!

english: I wonder how Fry is getting on with that performance...
What was that?
Oh, nothing. I just need to talk to Fry about something.
translation: 아, 아무것도 아니에요. Fry(프라이)한테 할 얘기가 좀 있어서요.

english: Oh, see you later then.
One more treat and I'll be ready to work on Easter again.
translation: 간식 하나만 더 먹으면 다시 부활절 일을 할 준비가 될 거예요.

english: ANOTHER treat?
The last one!
It better be.
That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: 그 춤 정말 대단했어요! 정말 잘했어요. 기운이 막... 샘솟아요!

english: Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: 이런! 시간 좀 봐, 달걀 준비하러 Varrock(바록)으로 돌아가야겠어요!

english: See you up there!
You need [1-5] free inventory [slots/slot] to receive your Easter event rewards.
translation: 부활절 이벤트 보상을 받으려면 소지품에 빈칸이 [1-5]개([slots/slot]) 필요해요.

english: I have something fun for you, [player name]!
Come back when you have more space.
Thanks for saving our bacon and eggs again, [player name]!
translation: 이번에도 우리 밥줄이랑 달걀을 다 구해 줘서 고마워요, [player name] 님!

english: You've completed the Easter event: One glum bunny
translation: 부활절 이벤트를 완료했습니다: One glum bunny(시무룩한 토끼)

english: Oh it's always my pleasure to get these delicious eggs!
translation: 아, 이 맛있는 달걀을 받는 건 언제나 즐거운 일이죠!

english: I mean... to help out a friend in need!
translation: 그러니까 제 말은... 곤경에 빠진 친구를 돕는 게요!

english: Isn't it strange something always happens around this time of year that needs me to come and save the day?
translation: 이상하지 않아요? 매년 이맘때면 꼭 제가 와서 구해 줘야 하는 일이 생기잖아요.

english: Oh really? I don't keep track, so much to do around now.
translation: 그래요? 저는 날짜를 따로 안 세서요. 요즘 할 일이 너무 많거든요.

english: Oh well, I expect I'll be seeing you again next year.
Yes, till neggxt year!
Would you please stop [player name], I'tsvery hard to rush back here so fast.
translation: [player name] 님, 그만 좀 해 줄래요? 여기까지 그렇게 급하게 달려오는 거 정말 힘들어요.

english: You're coming back here, whenever I do?
translation: 제가 올 때마다 여기로 돌아오는 거예요?

english: Precisely, so we'd all appreciate it if you didn't.
translation: 맞아요. 그러니까 안 그래 주면 다들 고마워할 거예요.

english: But why?
Who knows what you'd get up to down here on your own.
translation: 혼자 여기 내려와서 무슨 짓을 할지 누가 알아요.

english: Yes.
No.
Where do I get the Dried cocoa?
Where do I get the bottle of Hosidius milk?
translation: bottle of Hosidius milk(호시디우스 우유 한 병)은 어디서 구해요?

english: Where do I get the Special spices?
Goodbye.
The Easter Bunny is looking awfully glum this year.
translation: 올해는 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 너무 시무룩해 보여요.

english: Happy Easter!
And to you!
Thanks for your help!  You should have a break now.  Come back in [number] minutes if you want to hand out more eggs.
translation: 도와줘서 고마워요! 이제 좀 쉬세요. 달걀을 더 나눠 주고 싶으면 [number]분 뒤에 다시 오세요.

english: But I'm afraid I've left things a bit late this year.  I'm going to need some help to get all these eggs delivered!  Would you help me, [player name]?
translation: 그런데 올해는 준비가 좀 늦어 버렸어요. 이 달걀들을 다 나눠 주려면 도움이 필요해요! [player name] 님, 도와줄래요?

english: Yes, of course.
Oh dear, you don't have any free inventory space.  Talk to me again when you have.
translation: 이런, 소지품에 빈칸이 하나도 없네요. 빈칸이 생기면 다시 말 걸어 주세요.

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: 좋아요, 좋아요! 여기 달걀 바구니예요. 달걀이 사라지기 전에 최대한 많이 나눠 주고 저한테 돌아오세요. 시간은 2분밖에 없어요!

english: Splendid, splendid!  Here's a basket of eggs.  Hand out as many as you can before they disappear and then come back to me for your reward.  You've only got two minutes!
translation: 좋아요, 좋아요! 여기 달걀 바구니예요. 달걀이 사라지기 전에 최대한 많이 나눠 주고 저한테 돌아와서 보상을 받으세요. 시간은 2분밖에 없어요!

english: No.
Oh dear oh dear!  I've got to hurry!
Quickly, [player name]!  Hand out those eggs before they vanish!
translation: 서둘러요, [player name] 님! 달걀이 사라지기 전에 나눠 주세요!

english: Oh dear, [player name]. You didn't hand out any eggs at all! Do you want to try again?
translation: 이런, [player name] 님. 달걀을 하나도 안 나눠 줬네요! 다시 해 볼래요?

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!
translation: 고마워요, [player name] 님! 달걀을 [number]개 나눠 줬네요!

english: Thank you, [player name]!  You handed out [number] eggs!  Here is your Easter reward!
translation: 고마워요, [player name] 님! 달걀을 [number]개 나눠 줬네요! 여기 부활절 보상이에요!

english: If you lose it, you can get another one from Diango in Draynor.
translation: 잃어버리면 Draynor(드레이너)에 있는 Diango(디앙고)한테서 하나 더 받을 수 있어요.

english: Yes, of course
No
Leave us to our fate. We care nothing for the world that betrayed us, or those that come from it.
translation: 우리 운명은 우리에게 맡기고 떠나시오. 우리를 배신한 세상에도, 그 세상에서 온 자들에게도 우린 아무 관심 없소.

english: Hello. I represent the Museum of Varrock, and I have reason to believe there may be some kinds of artefacts of historical significance in the nearby area...
translation: 안녕하세요. 저는 Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관)을 대표해서 왔는데요, 이 근처에 역사적으로 중요한 유물이 있을지도 모른다고 볼 근거가 있어서요...

english: Ah yes. The only time people care about our existence is when they think they have something to gain from us.
translation: 아, 그렇군. 사람들이 우리의 존재를 신경 쓰는 건 우리한테서 뭔가 얻어 갈 게 있다고 생각할 때뿐이지.

english: I have nothing to say to you. You and your kind are not welcome here.
translation: 그대에게 할 말은 없소. 그대와 그대 같은 족속은 이곳에서 환영받지 못하오.

english: Please, if I can just have a few minutes of your time to ask some questions...?
translation: 제발요, 몇 가지만 여쭤볼 시간을 잠깐만 내주시면...?

english: (sigh) I suppose I can spare you that. What do you wish to know about?
translation: (한숨) 그 정도 시간은 내줄 수 있겠지. 무엇이 알고 싶소?

english: Why are all of the people here so hostile? You would think I was asking you for money instead of just for answers to a few questions...
translation: 여기 사람들은 왜 다들 이렇게 적대적이에요? 질문 몇 개 했을 뿐인데 무슨 돈이라도 달라고 한 줄 알겠어요...

english: It is a long story, and I doubt you have much interest in hearing it. Your sort never are, you just take what you can of ours, and then abandon us once more to the desert.
translation: 긴 이야기요. 그대가 들을 생각이 있을지 의심스럽군. 그대 같은 자들은 늘 그랬지. 우리 것을 챙길 만큼 챙기고는 우리를 다시 사막에 버려두고 떠나 버리니.

english: Actually, I'd be quite interested to hear what it is you have to say to excuse the attitude everybody in this village seems to have.
translation: 사실 이 마을 사람들 모두가 보이는 그 태도를 어떻게 변명하시는지 꽤 듣고 싶은데요.

english: Ah, it all begun many generations ago, when our ancestors were the proud rulers of these lands...
translation: 아, 모든 건 여러 세대 전, 우리 선조들이 이 땅의 당당한 지배자였던 시절에 시작되었소...

english: My ancestors lived far to the North of here, and our lands stretched from the sea in the East to the river Lum, and the mountain of ice. From coast to coast, North to South, our domain was absolute.
translation: 내 선조들은 이곳에서 멀리 북쪽에 살았소. 우리 땅은 동쪽 바다에서 river Lum(럼 강)과 얼음산까지 뻗어 있었지. 해안에서 해안까지, 북쪽에서 남쪽까지, 우리의 지배는 절대적이었소.

english: Our god was kind to us, and blessed us with prosperity and happiness, and in return we were merciless to his enemies wherever we found them.
translation: 우리 신께서는 우리에게 자비로우셨고 번영과 행복을 내려 주셨소. 그 보답으로 우리는 그분의 적이라면 어디서 만나든 무자비하게 처단했지.

english: Then came the betrayal.
Our god was banished, leaving us helpless to our fates.
translation: 우리 신께서 추방당하시고, 우리는 무력하게 운명에 내던져졌소.

english: Without his protection, we were forced to fend for ourselves once more, against the enemies that sought to destroy us through their petty jealousies.
translation: 그분의 보호를 잃은 우리는 하찮은 시기심으로 우리를 멸하려 드는 적들에 맞서 다시 스스로를 지켜야 했소.

english: But we did not succumb without fighting! The spiteful Saradomin and pathetic Zamorak warred with each other, but the hatred they had for each other was as nothing to the hatred they held towards us!
translation: 하지만 우리는 싸우지도 않고 굴복하지는 않았소! 악의에 찬 Saradomin(사라도민)과 한심한 Zamorak(자모락)은 서로 전쟁을 벌였지만, 그들이 서로에게 품은 증오는 우리를 향한 증오에 비하면 아무것도 아니었소!

english: With each battle they waged, we lost more and more land, unable to fight on all fronts, and were pushed further and further South into this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 그들이 전투를 벌일 때마다 우리는 사방의 전선을 다 감당하지 못해 점점 더 많은 땅을 잃었고, 점점 더 남쪽으로 밀려나 결국 신에게 버림받은 이 사막까지 오게 되었소.

english: Our greatest hero, Azzanadra, was finally trapped in a strange stone structure to the South of here, and bound within by terrible powers...
translation: 우리의 가장 위대한 영웅 Azzanadra(아자나드라)께서는 결국 이곳 남쪽의 기이한 돌 구조물에 갇히시어, 끔찍한 힘에 묶여 버리셨소...

english: And with that our lands, our homes, our very lives were stolen from us! Too weak to reclaim what was rightfully ours, we made our homes here, knowing that someday Azzanadra will
translation: 그렇게 우리의 땅도, 집도, 삶 그 자체도 빼앗기고 말았소! 정당히 우리 것이었던 것을 되찾기엔 너무 약했던 우리는 이곳에 터를 잡았지. 언젠가 아자나드라께서

english: return with his magnificent power, and bring us back to our former glory...
translation: 그 위대한 힘을 지니고 돌아오시어 우리를 옛 영광으로 이끌어 주시리라 믿으며...

english: So you're upset because of something that happened hundreds of years ago?
translation: 그러니까 몇백 년 전에 일어난 일 때문에 화가 나 있다는 거예요?

english: Seems to me like maybe you should find some closure, and let the past go...
translation: 제가 보기엔 이제 마음을 정리하고 과거는 흘려보내셔야 할 것 같은데요...

english: The insults heaped upon my race will never be forgotten, will never be forgiven and will never again be overlooked.
translation: 우리 종족에게 쏟아진 모욕은 결코 잊히지 않을 것이고, 결코 용서받지 못할 것이며, 다시는 묵과되지 않을 것이오.

english: Someday, a harsh wind will blow upon this land, uncovering the wrongs of the past, and we will get back what is rightfully ours. Until such a day we will bide our time here, and will
translation: 언젠가 거센 바람이 이 땅에 불어와 과거의 잘못을 드러낼 것이고, 그때 우리는 정당히 우리 것이었던 것을 되찾을 것이오. 그날이 올 때까지 우리는 이곳에서 때를 기다리며,

english: always be ready with our blades for our righteous vengeance.
translation: 정의로운 복수를 위해 언제나 칼을 갈고 있을 것이오.

english: I don't really care what your story is to be honest, there is no excuse for such rudeness or hostility.
translation: 솔직히 당신네 사연엔 관심 없어요. 무슨 이유가 있든 이렇게 무례하고 적대적인 건 변명이 안 돼요.

english: I have done nothing wrong to you, but everybody here treats me like I have committed some great crime against the village.
translation: 전 당신들한테 아무 잘못도 안 했는데, 여기 사람들은 다들 제가 마을에 무슨 큰 죄라도 지은 것처럼 대한다고요.

english: That is because, from our point of view, you have.
translation: 그건 우리 입장에서 보면 그대가 실제로 죄를 지었기 때문이오.

english: What? Just because I entered your village?
translation: 뭐라고요? 제가 이 마을에 들어왔다는 이유만으로요?

english: You have no right to be here! You have no right to the life you have, for it was taken at our expense!
translation: 그대에겐 이곳에 있을 권리가 없소! 그대가 누리는 삶을 누릴 권리도 없소. 그 삶은 우리에게서 빼앗아 얻은 것이니까!

english: Whatever... No wonder all you loonies live out here in the desert by yourselves.
translation: 그러시든가요... 당신 같은 미치광이들이 왜 다 이런 사막에 자기들끼리 모여 사는지 알겠네요.

english: I was wondering if you knew anything about some treasure somewhere around here?
translation: 혹시 이 근처 어딘가에 있는 보물에 대해 아는 거 있으세요?

english: I have some evidence that there might be some kind of treasure hidden very close to this village...
translation: 이 마을 바로 근처에 어떤 보물이 숨겨져 있을지도 모른다는 증거가 좀 있거든요...

english: If I knew of any treasure I would not choose to spend my life in this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 내가 보물을 알았다면 신에게 버림받은 이 사막에서 평생을 보낼 리가 없지 않겠소.

english: Do you know anything about some kind of fortress nearby? I have reason to believe there is, or at least used to be, some kind of fortress very close to here...
translation: 이 근처에 있는 요새 같은 거에 대해 아는 거 있으세요? 이 근처에 요새가 있다고, 아니면 적어도 예전에 있었다고 볼 근거가 있거든요...

english: Nobody would build anything in this wasteland unless they were forced to, to survive.
translation: 살아남기 위해 어쩔 수 없는 게 아니라면, 누구도 이런 황무지에 뭔가를 짓지 않소.

english: I know of no fortress, I know of no reason why anyone would ever bother doing anything out here in the desert.
translation: 요새 같은 건 모르오. 이 사막에서 누군가 뭔가를 하려고 애쓸 이유가 있다는 것도 모르겠고.

english: Actually, there was nothing I really wanted to ask you about.
translation: 사실 딱히 여쭤보고 싶은 건 없었어요.

english: Yes, it is exactly like your sort to waste my time in such a way.
translation: 그래, 그런 식으로 내 시간을 낭비하는 게 딱 그대 같은 자들다운 짓이지.

english: (above)
So tell me... Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?
translation: 그럼 말씀해 보세요... 혹시 Diamonds of Azzanadra(아자나드라의 다이아몬드)라는 걸 들어 보신 적 있나요?

english: This is the treasure which you seek???
Please accept my apologies! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,
translation: 부디 내 사과를 받아 주시오! 그대가 우리에게 남은 유산마저 훔치려는 기회주의 도둑에 불과한 줄 알았소! 이제 보니 그대는 우리에게 옛 영광을 되찾아 주려는

english: looking to restore our glories back upon us!
Uh... yeah... So anyway, you have heard of them?
translation: 어... 네... 아무튼, 들어 보신 적은 있는 거죠?

english: Heard of them? Of course I have heard of them! They are the legacy of the great Mahjarrat hero, Azzanadra!
translation: 들어 봤냐고? 물론 들어 봤소! 그것은 위대한 Mahjarrat(마하자랏) 영웅, Azzanadra(아자나드라)께서 남기신 유산이오!

english: So... do you have any idea where they might be? I have a feeling they will be very valuable.
translation: 그럼... 그게 어디 있을지 짐작 가는 데라도 있으세요? 왠지 엄청 값어치가 있을 것 같거든요.

english: Uh, valuable as historical artefacts I mean, obviously.
translation: 어, 역사적 유물로서 값어치가 있다는 뜻이에요, 당연히.

english: They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.
translation: 그것들은 여러 세대 전 거짓 신 Zamorak(자모락)의 전사들이 훔쳐 갔소. 그 전사들을 찾으면 다이아몬드도 찾게 될 것이오.

english: I suspect they will not willingly part with such objects of power however.
translation: 다만 그자들이 그런 힘을 지닌 물건을 순순히 내놓지는 않을 것이오.

english: Beware too, for these warriors are very powerful; they have taken the powers of the diamonds into themselves!
translation: 그리고 조심하시오. 그 전사들은 매우 강하오. 다이아몬드의 힘을 제 몸에 받아들였으니까!

english: How do you mean?
Each diamond has an elemental quality...
translation: 각 다이아몬드에는 원소의 성질이 깃들어 있소...

english: There is the Diamond of Blood, the Diamond of Ice, the Diamond of Smoke and the Diamond of Shadow.
translation: Diamond of Blood(피의 다이아몬드), Diamond of Ice(얼음의 다이아몬드), Diamond of Smoke(연기의 다이아몬드), 그리고 Diamond of Shadow(그림자의 다이아몬드)가 있지.

english: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...
translation: 그 전사들은 이 다이아몬드들의 성질 일부를 자기 것으로 삼았을 거라 생각해야 하오...

english: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?
translation: 그럼 그 전사들을 어떻게든 추적할 방법이 있을까요?

english: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.
translation: 그런 힘을 엿볼 수 있는 고대 주문을 하나 알고 있소... 하지만 그 주문을 쓰려면 재료가 몇 가지 필요하오.

english: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the
translation: 그대가 이 재료들을 구해 준다면, 전사들이 각각 몸을 숨긴 대략적인 지역을 찾아낼 수 있을 것이오. 주문이 정확하진 않지만, 그대가 수색을

english: right track in your search.
translation: 제대로 시작하는 데는 도움이 될 것이오.

english: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?
translation: 우리의 자유를 바라는 그대의 마음이 충분히 굳건하오? 이 주문에 쓸 재료를 모아 주겠소?

english: Sure, what do you need?
For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.
translation: 이 주문을 쓰려면 점술 유리를 몇 개 만들어야 하오. 이 세상 전체를 볼 수 있을 만큼 충분히 있어야 하지.

english: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 마법을 부여하면, 점술 유리로 Diamonds of Azzanadra(아자나드라의 다이아몬드)의 영향을 받은 곳이라면 어디든 볼 수 있게 될 것이오.

english: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?
translation: 네, 그런데 이 주문에 정확히 뭐가 필요하신 거예요?

english: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten
translation: 음, 점술 유리는 여섯 개면 충분할 것이오. 점술 유리 하나마다 magic logs(마법 통나무) 두 개, steel bar(강철 주괴) 하나, 그리고 molten glass(녹은 유리)가 약간 필요하오. 모두 합치면 마법 통나무 12개, 녹은 유리

english: glass, and 6 steel bars.
In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.
translation: 거기에 더해, 유리에 마법을 부여하는 실제 주문에는 평범한 bones(뼈) 하나, ash(재) 약간, charcoal(숯) 약간, 그리고 blood rune(피 룬) 하나가 필요하오.

english: Do you understand me, adventurer?
Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?
translation: 잠깐 질문이요. 뼈는 어떤 종류가 필요하세요?

english: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.
translation: 평범한 뼈요. 다른 종류의 뼈는 이 주문에 아무 쓸모가 없소.
