english: Yes, I will go get those for you.
Before I can complete the spell I will still need the following items;
translation: 주문을 완성하려면 아직 다음 물품들이 필요하오.

english: 12 magic logs 6 steel bars 6 molten glass
translation: magic logs(마법 통나무) 12개, steel bars(강철 주괴) 6개, molten glass(녹은 유리) 6개

english: 1 bones, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal and 1 blood rune.
translation: bones(뼈) 1개, ashes(재) 1개, charcoal(숯) 1개, blood rune(피 룬) 1개.

english: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.
translation: 사실 지금은 당신 대신 장 보러 다닐 기분이 아니에요.

english: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...
translation: 좋을 대로 하시오. 저주받은 우리의 긴 삶이 곧 끝날지도 모른다는 기대 따위는 품지 말았어야 했는데...

english: So have you spoken to my Lord Azzanadra yet?
translation: 그래, 내 주군 Azzanadra(아자나드라)님과는 이야기를 나눠 보았소?

english: Yes I have.
And what words did he have for his followers?
Er.... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.
translation: 어.... 당신들 얘기는 딱히 안 하셨는데, 멋진 새 마법 주문을 몇 개 가르쳐 주셨어요.

english: It is understandable perhaps... His poor mind must be addled after all of those years of confinement, he would not willingly ignore his followers...
translation: 그럴 만도 하지... 그토록 오랜 세월 갇혀 계셨으니 그분의 가엾은 정신이 흐려지셨을 것이오. 그분께서 일부러 추종자들을 외면하실 리는 없소...

english: Anyway, if he has taught you our ancient magics, you may be interested in purchasing an ancient heirloom that was passed down to me. My ancestor fought in the ancient battles using the
translation: 아무튼, 그분께서 그대에게 우리의 고대 마법을 가르치셨다면, 내게 대대로 전해진 고대 가보를 사는 데 관심이 있을지도 모르겠군. 내 선조께서는 우리 신의

english: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell- casting.
translation: 마법으로 고대의 전투에서 싸우셨소. 이 가보는 그대의 주문 시전 속도를 높여 줄 것이오.

english: Normally I could not bear to part with such a priceless relic, but for your help in freeing my Lord Azzanadra, I will be prepared to sell it to you for a mere 80,000 gold.
translation: 원래라면 이토록 귀한 유물은 차마 내놓지 못하겠지만, 내 주군 Azzanadra(아자나드라)를 풀어 드리는 데 힘써 준 그대에게라면 고작 80,000골드에 팔 용의가 있소.

english: Are you interested?
Yes please.
Stranger... Do not abuse my generosity... I cannot possibly sell it for less than 80,000 gold.
translation: 이방인이여... 내 호의를 악용하지 마시오... 80,000골드보다 싸게는 도저히 팔 수 없소.

english: Come back and see me when you have the necessary funds to buy.

Take care of it, it is the only heirloom from those times I possess, although rumour has it many of our ancient warriors were buried with identical weapons so that they could continue to fight for my Lord in their deaths.
translation: 잘 간수하시오. 그 시절의 가보로는 내가 가진 유일한 물건이니. 다만 소문에 따르면 우리의 고대 전사들 중 상당수가 죽어서도 내 주군을 위해 계속 싸울 수 있도록 똑같은 무기와 함께 묻혔다고 하오.

english: No thanks.
As you wish. Bear my offer in mind should you ever change your decision, I will remain here.
translation: 좋을 대로 하시오. 혹시 마음이 바뀌거든 내 제안을 떠올리시오. 나는 여기 있을 테니.

english: Hello again.
Greetings!
I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: 이상한 icon(성상)을 찾았는데요. 이게 뭔지 아세요?

english: Fascinating... I've never seen anything like this before, but the magic contained within is unmistakable. I wonder...
translation: 놀랍군... 이런 건 처음 보지만, 안에 깃든 마법만큼은 틀림없소. 혹시...

english: Wonder what?
Stranger, if you were to bring me an Ancient staff, I believe it would be possible to combine it with this icon to create a powerful new weapon.
translation: 이방인이여, 그대가 Ancient staff(고대 지팡이)를 가져온다면, 이 성상과 합쳐 강력한 새 무기를 만들 수 있을 것 같소.

english: That sounds pretty neat.
Then return to me when you have the staff.
I see you have the staff with you. Would you like me to combine your Ancient staff with the icon to create an Ancient sceptre? You won't be able to separate them once this is done.
translation: 지팡이를 가져왔군. 그대의 Ancient staff(고대 지팡이)를 성상과 합쳐 Ancient sceptre(고대 셉터)를 만들어 주겠소? 한번 합치면 다시는 분리할 수 없소.

english: Yes, please!
There you go. Wield its power responsibly, stranger...
translation: 자, 다 됐소. 그 힘을 책임감 있게 휘두르시오, 이방인이여...

english: No, thanks.
Suit yourself.
Have you got any symbols of your god?
translation: 섬기시는 신의 상징물 같은 거 있으세요?

english: I'll leave you to it.
Why is this village so hostile?
No, I want to hear this story.
I don't care about your story.
Do you know anything about treasure near here?
translation: 이 근처에 있는 보물에 대해 아는 거 있으세요?

english: Do you know anything about a fortress near here?
translation: 이 근처에 있는 요새에 대해 아는 거 있으세요?

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra
translation: Azzanadra(아자나드라)의 네 다이아몬드에 대해 알려 주세요

english: Yes
No, please repeat those ingredients.
No
Yes please.
No thanks.
Have you got any symbols of your god?
translation: 섬기시는 신의 상징물 같은 거 있으세요?

english: I found this weird icon. Do you know what it is?
translation: 이상한 icon(성상)을 찾았는데요. 이게 뭔지 아세요?

english: Yes, please!
No, thanks.
I'll leave you to it.
Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining.
Your echo boots have [number] charges remaining. They are currently inactive.
translation: echo boots(에코 장화)의 충전량이 [number]회 남았다. 현재 비활성화 상태다.

english: You activate your echo boots.
You deactivate your echo boots.
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Hello friend.
What are you doing here?
I'm looking for a helmet. I know it's buried somewhere.
translation: 투구를 찾고 있어. 어딘가에 묻혀 있는 건 확실하거든.

english: And you think that somewhere is here?
I don't know. I've tried everywhere else so it might be.
translation: 모르겠어. 다른 데는 다 찾아봤으니 여기일 수도 있지.

english: Maybe you're missing something important.
translation: 뭔가 중요한 걸 놓치고 계신 걸지도 몰라요.

english: Maybe you're right. I just don't know anymore.
translation: 네 말이 맞을지도 몰라. 이젠 정말 모르겠다.

english: That's a nice outfit.
Thank you. I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
translation: 고마워. 여기에 어울리는 투구만 있으면 좋겠는데.

english: Hey your hair is on fire!
Get out of it!
Goodbye.
See you later.
That helmet! Where did you get it?
I found it.
Where?
I can't tell you that. It would ruin the fun. You'll have to work it out for yourself.
translation: 그건 말 못 해요. 재미없어지잖아요. 직접 알아내 보세요.

english: Arhhh!
Hello again friend.
What are you doing all the way over here?
translation: 이렇게 먼 데까지 와서 뭐 하세요?

english: I gave up on the last one. Who cares about that one, anyway?
translation: 저번 건 포기했어. 그딴 거 누가 신경 쓴대?

english: I guess...
That's a nice set of armour.
So much nicer than the garb I had before, right?
translation: 예전에 입던 옷보다 훨씬 낫지, 그렇지?

english: I just wish I had the helmet to go with it.
Agh, not again!
What are you doing here?
That's a nice outfit.
Hey your hair is on fire!
Goodbye.
What are you doing all the way over here?
translation: 이렇게 먼 데까지 와서 뭐 하세요?

english: That's a nice set of armour.
Can't stop. Too busy.
Wonder when I'll get paid.
Is it lunch break yet?
Hey I'm working here. I'm working here.
translation: 이봐, 나 일하는 중이야. 일하는 중이라고.

english: This work isn't going to do itself.
Ouch! That was my finger!
I'll be charging overtime, then!
Hello old man.
Sorry, I can't stop to talk...
Why, what's wrong?
I've got to find my daughter. I pray that she is still alive...
translation: 딸을 찾아야 해요. 부디 아직 살아 있기를...

english: What's happened to her?
Elena's a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.
translation: Elena(엘레나)는 치유사예요. 3주 전에 그 애가 장벽을 넘어 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)에 들어갔어요. 역병을 퍼뜨릴까 봐 아무도 장벽을 넘지 못하게 되어 있는데 말이에요.

english: Plague?
Not that long ago, West Ardougne was hit by a deadly plague. They had the wall built to try and keep it contained. No one is allowed to enter the city now apart from the mourners.
translation: 얼마 전 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)에 끔찍한 역병이 돌았어요. 그걸 막아 두려고 장벽을 세웠죠. 이제는 mourners(애도자)를 빼면 아무도 그 도시에 들어갈 수 없어요.

english: They say the plague is a horrible way to go... That's why Elena felt she had to go help. She said she'd be gone for a few days but we've heard nothing since.
translation: 역병으로 죽는 건 끔찍하다고들 하죠... 그래서 엘레나가 가서 도와야겠다고 한 거예요. 며칠이면 돌아온다고 했는데 그 뒤로 아무 소식이 없어요.

english: Maybe I could help find her?
Really, would you? I've been working on a plan to get into West Ardougne, but I'm too old and tired to carry it through. But you on the other hand, you should have no problem.
translation: 정말요, 그래 주시겠어요? West Ardougne(서 아르둔)에 들어갈 계획을 세워 두긴 했는데, 제가 너무 늙고 지쳐서 해낼 수가 없어요. 하지만 당신이라면 문제없을 거예요.

english: Where should I start?
If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.
translation: West Ardougne(서 아르둔)에 들어가려면 역병을 막을 보호 장비가 필요해요. 제 아내가 엘레나를 위해 dwellberries(드웰베리)를 문질러 바른 특별한 gas mask(방독면)을 만들어 줬어요.

english: They help to repel the plague apparently. We need some more though...
translation: 그게 역병을 막아 주는 모양이에요. 그런데 좀 더 필요해요...

english: Where can I find these dwellberries?
translation: 그 dwellberries(드웰베리)는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: The only place I know of is McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 제가 아는 곳은 McGrubor's Wood(맥그루버의 숲)뿐이에요. Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 바로 서쪽이죠. 열매가 밝은 파란색이라 금방 눈에 띌 거예요.

english: Okay, I'll go and get some.
The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.
translation: 산지기들이 그 숲을 철저히 지키고 있지만, 뒤쪽으로 들어가는 길이 있어요.

english: On second thoughts, I'd better not.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니 안 하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Well if you hear anything about Elena please tell me.
translation: 그럼 엘레나 소식을 듣게 되면 꼭 알려 주세요.

english: I will. Goodbye.
Well, good luck finding her.
Hello Edmond.
Have you got the dwellberries yet?
Sorry, I'm afraid not.
You'll probably find them in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 아마 McGrubor's Wood(맥그루버의 숲)에 있을 거예요. Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 바로 서쪽이죠. 열매가 밝은 파란색이라 금방 눈에 띌 거예요.

english: Yes I've got some here.
Take them to my wife Alrena, she's inside.
translation: 그걸 제 아내 Alrena(알레나)한테 가져다주세요. 안에 있어요.

english: Hi Edmond, I've got the gas mask now.
translation: Edmond(에드먼드) 씨, gas mask(방독면)을 받아 왔어요.

english: Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to access to West Ardougne.
translation: 잘됐네요, 이제 땅을 팔 차례예요. 우리 발밑에 Ardougne(아르둔) 하수도가 있어요. 제가 좀 조사해 봤는데, 그걸 통해 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)으로 들어갈 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: I've already tried digging down to them but the soil is rock hard. You'll need to pour on several buckets of water to soften it up. I reckon four buckets should do it.
translation: 제가 직접 거기까지 파 내려가 보려 했는데 흙이 돌처럼 딱딱해요. buckets of water(물 양동이)를 몇 번 부어서 흙을 무르게 해야 할 거예요. 네 양동이면 될 것 같아요.

english: How's it going?
I still need to pour four more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 아직 흙에 물 양동이를 네 번 더 부어야 해요.

english: I still need to pour three more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 아직 흙에 물 양동이를 세 번 더 부어야 해요.

english: I still need to pour two more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 아직 흙에 물 양동이를 두 번 더 부어야 해요.

english: Player: I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
translation: 아직 흙에 물 양동이를 한 번 더 부어야 해요.

english: I've soaked the soil with water.
That's great, it should be soft enough to dig through now. There should be a spade nearby that you can use.
translation: 잘했어요, 이제 파고 들어갈 만큼 물러졌을 거예요. 근처에 쓸 만한 spade(삽)이 있을 거예요.

english: I think it's the pipe to the south that comes up in West Ardougne.
translation: 남쪽에 있는 pipe(파이프)가 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)으로 이어지는 것 같아요.

english: Alright I'll check it out.
Edmond, I can't get through to West Ardougne! There's an iron grill blocking my way, I can't pull it off alone.
translation: Edmond(에드먼드) 씨, West Ardougne(서 아르둔)으로 못 들어가겠어요! 쇠창살이 길을 막고 있는데, 혼자서는 뜯어낼 수가 없어요.

english: If you get some rope you could tie to the grill, then we could both pull it at the same time.
translation: rope(밧줄)을 구해서 창살에 묶으면 우리 둘이 동시에 당길 수 있을 거예요.

english: I've tied a rope to the grill over there, will you help me pull it off?
translation: 저기 창살에 rope(밧줄)을 묶어 놨어요. 뜯어내는 것 좀 도와주시겠어요?

english: Alright, let's get to it...
The player and Edmond pull on the rope, opening the grill on the pipe.
translation: 당신과 Edmond(에드먼드)가 밧줄을 당겨 pipe(파이프)의 창살을 뜯어낸다.

english: Once you're in the city look for a man called Jethick. He's an old friend of the family. Hopefully he can help you.
translation: 도시에 들어가면 Jethick(제식)이라는 남자를 찾아보세요. 우리 집안의 오랜 친구예요. 그 사람이 도와줄 수 있으면 좋겠네요.

english: Alright, thanks I will.
I can't let you enter the city without your gas mask on.
translation: gas mask(방독면)을 쓰지 않으면 도시에 들어가게 할 수 없어요.

english: Hello.
Have you found Elena yet?
Not yet, it's a big city over there.
I hope it's not too late.
Not yet, it's a big city over there. Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: 아직이요. 그쪽 도시가 워낙 커서요. 혹시 엘레나 picture(그림) 있으세요?

english: There should be a picture of Elena in the house. Please find her quickly, I hope it's not too late.
translation: 집 안에 엘레나 그림이 있을 거예요. 부디 빨리 찾아 주세요. 너무 늦지 않았기를 바랄 뿐이에요.

english: Thank you, thank you! Elena beat you back by minutes. Now I said I'd give you a reward. What can I give you as a reward I wonder? Here take this magic scroll, I have little use for it but it may help you.
translation: 고마워요, 정말 고마워요! 엘레나가 당신보다 몇 분 먼저 돌아왔어요. 자, 보상을 드리겠다고 했었죠. 뭘 보상으로 드려야 할까... 자, 이 마법 scroll(두루마리)를 받으세요. 저한테는 별 쓸모가 없지만 당신에겐 도움이 될지도 몰라요.

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Now I'd recommend you go and see Elena. She'll want to thank you herself. She lives in the house opposite ours.
translation: 이제 엘레나를 만나 보세요. 직접 고맙다고 하고 싶어 할 거예요. 우리 집 맞은편 집에 살아요.

english: Hello there.
Ah hello. Thank you again for rescuing my daughter.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 제 딸을 구해 줘서 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: No problem.
Hello there friend. I hope you're looking after Elena out there.
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구. 밖에서 엘레나를 잘 돌봐 주고 있겠죠?

english: I think she might be the one looking after me.
translation: 오히려 엘레나가 저를 돌봐 주고 있는 것 같은데요.

english: Ha. That's my Elena.
Can I help you?
Possibly, do you have a challenge for me?
translation: 아마도요. 저한테 줄 도전 과제가 있나요?

english: Yes, I do as a matter of fact.
Edmond has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Is that your final answer? Because it sounds unlikely to me.
translation: 그게 최종 답이에요? 제가 듣기엔 아닌 것 같은데요.

english: Sounds good!
Edmond has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Edmond(에드먼드)가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 줬다!

english: What's happened to her?
Yes.
No.
Well, good luck finding her.
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보시겠어요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 이 망토를 두르면 같은 망토를 두른 사람을 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고, 다른 사람은 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있지요. 게다가 같은 망토를 두른 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 쉽게 구별할 수 있어요. wilderness(황야)에 친구들이나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람들과 함께 나갈 때 아주 유용하답니다.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 여러 가지예요. 안녕하세요, 안녕, 안녕하신가요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 먹고 와서 그런 거예요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너처럼 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 얘기하고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 너 발이 정말 근사할 것 같은데.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 아주 비참한 날이야, 정말... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무우우척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너도 피 맛을 꽤 즐길 줄 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보시겠어요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 이 망토를 두르면 같은 망토를 두른 사람을 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고, 다른 사람은 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있지요. 게다가 같은 망토를 두른 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 쉽게 구별할 수 있어요. wilderness(황야)에 친구들이나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람들과 함께 나갈 때 아주 유용하답니다.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
Here, solve this.
Edward hands you a puzzlebox.
That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 아직 안 풀린 것 같은데요.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
I bet you're a mighty hero!
[player name]! Hero-of-the-humans!
You are a mighty hero, aren't you? I bet you've slain dragons and all sorts of stuff.
translation: 넌 엄청난 영웅 맞지? 분명 드래곤도 무찌르고 별별 일을 다 해 봤을 거야.

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
I could be your sidekick! [player name] and Eek! We could have all sorts of adventures together!
translation: 내가 네 조수가 되어 줄 수 있어! [player name]하고 Eek(이크)! 우리 같이 온갖 모험을 할 수 있을 거야!

english: Yes!
Yay! [player name] and Eek! We'll travel all over the world fighting for justice! And freedom! And things like that!
translation: 야호! [player name]하고 Eek(이크)! 우리 온 세상을 누비면서 정의를 위해 싸우는 거야! 자유를 위해서도! 뭐 그런 것들을 위해서!

english: Come on, [player name]! Let's have an adventure!
No. It's too dangerous.
Aww.
You know best, though. You're so BRAVE putting yourself in danger all by yourself!
translation: 그래도 네가 제일 잘 알겠지. 혼자서 위험을 무릅쓰다니 넌 정말 용감해!

english: I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: 난 대단한 영웅이 아니야. 그냥 평범한 사람이야.

english: Aww. I bet you'll be a mighty hero someday, though.
translation: 에잉. 그래도 넌 언젠가 분명 엄청난 영웅이 될 거야.

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
Brilliant! You can do it! Come on, let's have an adventure!
translation: 멋지다! 넌 할 수 있어! 자, 모험을 떠나자!

english: I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
Aww...well...never mind.
Hey, you've only got four legs. How do you manage? Don't you fall over?
translation: 야, 너 다리가 네 개밖에 없잖아. 그걸로 어떻게 다녀? 안 넘어져?

english: Actually, I've only got two legs.
Someone has stolen your legs! This is a DISASTER!
translation: 누가 네 다리를 훔쳐 갔구나! 이건 대재앙이야!

english: We've got to catch the leg thief!
No one stole my legs.
You gave your legs away?
translation: 네 다리를 남한테 줘 버린 거야?

english: That is so heroic...giving your legs away to someone without legs.
translation: 정말 영웅적이다... 다리 없는 누군가에게 네 다리를 내주다니.

english: You're my hero!
They're probably long gone by now.
You're right. They probably used the machine to give themselves really long running-away type legs. We'll never catch them now.
translation: 맞아. 아마 기계를 써서 도망치기 딱 좋은 엄청 긴 다리를 달았을 거야. 이제 절대 못 잡겠다.

english: Oh, it's not so bad.
Then again, your legs are much longer than mine.
translation: 하긴, 네 다리는 내 다리보다 훨씬 기니까.

english: How's you get such long legs? Do you have some kind of leg-extending machine?
translation: 어떻게 그렇게 다리가 길어? 다리 늘리는 기계 같은 거라도 있는 거야?

english: Where is the leg-extending machine? I want to use it!
translation: 다리 늘리는 기계 어디 있어? 나도 써 볼래!

english: There is no leg-extending machine.
translation: 다리 늘리는 기계 같은 건 없어.

english: You would say that! You want to keep it for yourself!
translation: 그렇게 말할 줄 알았어! 혼자만 쓰고 싶은 거지!

english: Well that's okay. Maybe I don't even need your leg-extending machine!
translation: 뭐, 괜찮아. 어쩌면 네 다리 늘리는 기계 따윈 필요 없을지도 몰라!

english: I can do special leg-stretching exercises! Make my legs longer naturally! No artificial legs for me!
translation: 특별한 다리 스트레칭 운동을 하면 돼! 자연스럽게 다리를 길게 만드는 거야! 기계로 늘린 다리 따윈 사양이야!

english: You just wait! Soon I'll have the best legs ever!
translation: 두고 봐! 곧 세상에서 제일 멋진 다리를 갖게 될 테니까!

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
Oh! I wouldn't want to use it if it's broken.
translation: 앗! 고장 났으면 쓰고 싶지 않아.

english: It might malfunction and give me tiny, tiny legs! Like a slug, only with tiny legs!
translation: 오작동해서 다리가 쪼끄맣게 될지도 몰라! 민달팽이처럼, 근데 쪼끄만 다리가 달린!

english: Or it might make some legs longer than others so I wouldn't be able to walk and I'd fall over!
translation: 아니면 어떤 다리만 길어져서 못 걷고 넘어질지도 몰라!

english: That would be TERRIBLE!
I'd better keep away from that machine!
Hey, are you scared of spiders?
Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
Oh no! I'm sorry!
I've got to try not to be scary.
You should just pretend I'm not a spider! Like, maybe I'm an eight-legged mouse!
translation: 내가 거미가 아니라고 생각하면 돼! 예를 들면, 다리 여덟 개 달린 생쥐라든가!

english: Hello, I'm an eight legged mouse! Squeak squeak squeak, I like cheese, cats are bad, I'm definitely not a spider.
translation: 안녕, 난 다리 여덟 개 달린 생쥐야! 찍찍찍, 난 치즈가 좋아, 고양이는 나빠, 난 절대 거미가 아니야.

english: Is that better?
You still look like a spider.
A spider? Oh no! I'm scared of spiders!
That's much better.
Yay! I'll be an eight-legged mouse forever until I forget.
translation: 야호! 까먹을 때까지 영원히 다리 여덟 개 달린 생쥐로 살 거야.

english: You know what? It's great being a spider.
translation: 있잖아? 거미로 사는 거 진짜 좋아.

english: No, I'm not scared of spiders.
Not even a bit?
I bet I can make you scared of spiders!
translation: 내가 너도 거미를 무서워하게 만들어 주지!

english: Boo! Raaar! I'm a scary spider!
Next time you go to sleep I'm going to crawl on your face and EAT YOUR EYEBALLS!
translation: 다음에 네가 잠들면 얼굴 위로 기어 올라가서 네 눈알을 먹어 버릴 거야!

english: I'm still not scared.
Oh, wow! Even I was scared of me when I said that!
translation: 우와! 그 말 하면서 나도 내가 무서웠어!

english: You're so brave! I bet you're not scared of anything!
translation: 넌 정말 용감하구나! 분명 세상에 무서운 게 하나도 없을 거야!

english: That was a bit scary.
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! I made you scared of me! I made you scared of me!
translation: 하하하하하하하! 내가 너 겁줬다! 내가 너 겁줬다!

english: It's okay, I'm not really going to eat your eyeballs. Spiders don't do that.
translation: 괜찮아, 진짜로 네 눈알을 먹진 않을 거야. 거미는 그런 짓 안 해.

english: Well...I don't think they do.
I'm going to learn how to fly! I'm going to be a flying spider!
translation: 나 나는 법을 배울 거야! 날아다니는 거미가 될 거야!

english: How are you going to fly?
I'm going to spin webs between my legs to make wings! Then I can fly!
translation: 다리 사이에 거미줄을 쳐서 날개를 만들 거야! 그럼 날 수 있어!

english: Let's try it now!
Um...okay! I'll spin the webs...and then you throw me in the air.
translation: 어... 좋아! 내가 거미줄을 칠 테니까... 네가 날 공중으로 던져.

english: Okay. Three...
Two...
One...
Wait! I'm not ready!
I don't think I've got the webs right. I'm not ready yet. We'll do it another time.
translation: 거미줄을 제대로 못 친 것 같아. 아직 준비가 안 됐어. 다음에 하자.

english: Sounds dangerous.
It's not dangerous! What's the worst that could happen?
translation: 안 위험해! 최악이라 해 봤자 뭐겠어?

english: The worst that can happen is, like, the wings fail and I fall to my death.
translation: 최악이라면, 음, 날개가 안 먹혀서 떨어져 죽는 거?

english: Or I get eaten by a bird.
I'm going to rethink this.
Spiders can't fly!
Some spiders can fly! They use web strands to float in the air!
translation: 나는 거미도 있어! 거미줄 가닥을 써서 공중에 둥둥 떠다닌다고!

english: I think I know more about spiders than you, seeing how I am one!
translation: 거미에 대해선 내가 너보다 더 잘 알걸, 내가 거미잖아!

english: I'm sorry, Eek.
That's okay.
I don't want to fly now. I'm not in the mood.
translation: 이제 날고 싶지 않아. 그럴 기분 아니야.

english: I don't believe you.
I don't care. I'm not talking to you any more.
translation: 상관없어. 이제 너랑 말 안 해.

english: Hey...there are so many humans in your world.
translation: 있잖아... 너희 세상엔 인간이 정말 많다.

english: Back in my old web there are only spiders.
Suppose I was bitten by a magically-irradiated man?
translation: 만약에 내가 마법 방사능을 쬔 사람한테 물리면 어떻게 될까?

english: I might become the Man-Spider! I'd gain all the powers of a man! Like um...
translation: 맨스파이더가 될지도 몰라! 사람의 능력을 전부 얻게 되는 거야! 그러니까 음...

english: Um...what can humans do that's special?
translation: 음... 인간만 할 수 있는 특별한 게 뭐야?

english: Walk on two legs.
Walk on two legs! Yes! Then I could use my other six legs to FIGHT CRIME!
translation: 두 다리로 걷기! 그래! 그럼 남은 다리 여섯 개로 범죄와 싸울 수 있어!

english: Use tools.
Yes! I could have all sorts of gadgets! Like a gadget that spins webs!
translation: 그래! 온갖 장비를 가질 수 있겠다! 거미줄 치는 장비 같은 거!

english: Wait...I can already spin webs.
translation: 잠깐... 나 이미 거미줄 칠 수 있잖아.

english: Never mind!
Project heat-rays from our eyes.
Oh! I didn't know humans could do that!
translation: 앗! 인간이 그런 걸 할 수 있는 줄 몰랐어!

english: Please don't fry me with your heat rays!
translation: 제발 그 열광선으로 날 튀기지 마!

english: I'm too young to fry!
Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
Aww, don't say that. Everyone is special!
translation: 에잉, 그런 말 하지 마. 누구나 특별해!

english: That's right. I'm awesome!
Yes!
No. It's too dangerous.
I'm not a great hero. I'm just an ordinary person.
translation: 난 대단한 영웅이 아니야. 그냥 평범한 사람이야.

english: Yes, I'm trying to advance myself.
I don't know. I'm not very ambitious.
Actually, I've only got two legs.
No one stole my legs.
They're probably long gone by now.
Oh, it's not so bad.
There is no leg-extending machine.
translation: 다리 늘리는 기계 같은 건 없어.

english: You can't use it. It's broken.
Yes, I'm scared of spiders.
You still look like a spider.
That's much better.
No, I'm not scared of spiders.
I'm still not scared.
That was a bit scary.
How are you going to fly?
Let's try it now!
Sounds dangerous.
Spiders can't fly!
I'm sorry, Eek.
I don't believe you.
Walk on two legs.
Use tools.
Project heat-rays from our eyes.
Nothing, really. Humans are pretty ordinary.
Welcome to my store. Are you in search of any runes?
translation: 제 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 룬을 찾으시나요?

english: Can I see your wares?
No thanks.
Come back any time. I've always got something for anybody.
translation: 언제든 또 오세요. 누구에게든 필요한 물건이 늘 있으니까요.

english: Can I see your wares?
No thanks.
Hi. Interesting building you have here.
What's it for?
You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design made just for my fellow alchemists and I!
translation: 마음에 드나? 정말 근사하지 않은가? 나와 동료 연금술사들만을 위해 지은, 현대 설계의 진정한 걸작이라네!

english: I see some builders over there. So I assume it's not yet finished.
translation: 저기 인부들이 보이네요. 그럼 아직 완공은 안 된 거죠?

english: What a keen eye this chap has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: 이 친구 눈썰미가 대단하군! 하지만 상상해 보게. 전문가가 설계한 거대한 원기둥에, 기발한 나선형 내부 통로가 경이로운 여러 거주 층을 잇는 모습을!

english: So, it's a tower.
Oh, no, no, no, no.
It's going to have a use that will change this world!
translation: 이 건물은 세상을 바꿀 용도로 쓰일 걸세!

english: Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished.
translation: 아니, 적어도 완공만 할 수 있다면 그럴 걸세.

english: See those builders?
They don't seem to be building much.
Exactly.
They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
translation: 탑이 너무 괴상하다느니 하는 하찮은 이유로 파업에 들어갔다네. 저 사람들은 정말 이해가 안 되는군.

english: Shame.
Hey! Maybe you could talk to them?
translation: 이보게! 자네가 저들과 얘기해 보면 어떻겠나?

english: You look like a sturdy chap.
Maybe you could finish the work?
translation: 어쩌면 자네가 공사를 마무리할 수 있지 않겠나?

english: Me?
Come on! This is the chance of a lifetime!
Sure, why not.
That's fantastic! Oh, I'm so pleased.
Calm down. I'm not making any promises.
Oh, I have a good feeling about this.
Right.
Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
translation: 건축 반장인 Bonafido(보나피도)와 얘기해 보게. 그 친구가 엉덩이 좀 떼고 일하게 만들 수 있나 보라고. 아, 그리고 나는 Effigy(에피지)일세.

english: Nice to meet you Effigy, I'm [player name]. Hold on and I'll see what I can do!
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Effigy(에피지) 씨. 전 [player name](이)라고 해요. 잠깐만 기다려 주세요, 제가 뭘 할 수 있는지 알아볼게요!

english: Wait a minute.
Don't I recognise you from somewhere?
translation: 내가 자네를 어디서 본 것 같은데?

english: Erm, do you?
Do you know the outpost north of Ardougne?
Ah, yes, it's now a small museum. Jorral's looking after it. He's really making history with that place.
translation: 아, 네, 지금은 작은 박물관이 됐죠. Jorral(조랄)이 관리하고 있어요. 그곳에서 말 그대로 역사를 만들고 있죠.

english: Well, the King was going to make that into an alchemy lab for us, but some fool ruined our plans!
translation: 흠, 원래 국왕께서 그곳을 우리 연금술 연구소로 만들어 주시려 했는데, 어떤 바보가 우리 계획을 망쳐 버렸다네!

english: Ah, yes. Shame. Got to go. Bye.
translation: 아, 네. 안타깝네요. 가 봐야겠어요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hey, wait up!
Best I go sort out this tower. Bye.
translation: 이 탑 문제나 해결하러 가는 게 좋겠어요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Sorry, feeling a bit ill today.
translation: 죄송해요, 오늘 몸이 좀 안 좋아서요.

english: A bit ill?
That's a weak excuse for a very feeble personality.
translation: 아주 나약한 성격에 걸맞은 궁색한 변명이로군.

english: Yes.
No.
You need to get the milk from the cook. He's the one with the white chef's hat, hop to it now!
translation: 요리사한테서 우유를 받아 와야 해요. 하얀 요리사 모자를 쓴 사람이에요, 어서 깡충깡충 다녀와요!

english: Hello, Eggus!
Why hello there, [player name]!
Have you seen the Easter Bunny lately?
translation: 요즘 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 본 적 있어요?

english: Indeed I have, he's here! Though he's not his usual self. That's why I'm here actually. It would seem that he has strayed from the path of Easter.
translation: 물론이죠, 여기 있어요! 다만 평소 같지가 않아요. 사실 그래서 제가 여기 온 거예요. 아무래도 그가 부활절의 길에서 벗어난 것 같아요.

english: That's not good.
No, not good at all. Especially for those of us who walk the golden-yolked path. As soon as I found out, I set out to track him down.
translation: 네, 전혀 좋지 않아요. 황금빛 노른자의 길을 걷는 우리 같은 이들에겐 더더욱요. 그 사실을 알자마자 그를 찾아 나섰죠.

english: That's nice of you. How did you find him?
Well as luck would have it, I met a pair of hardy hunters who were up to the task. Glanton and Rinder are their names, and what a help they have been!
translation: 운 좋게도 이 일에 딱 맞는 강인한 사냥꾼 두 명을 만났어요. 이름은 Glanton(글랜턴)과 Rinder(린더)인데, 얼마나 큰 도움이 됐는지 몰라요!

english: Very capable, though they've yet to tell me what it is they usually hunt.
translation: 아주 유능한데, 평소에 뭘 사냥하는지는 아직 말해 주지 않았어요.

english: Hopefully not rabbits!
Don't even think it! They have been nothing but utmost gentlemen. We've been trying to cheer up that poor bunny together.
translation: 그런 생각은 하지도 마세요! 그 둘은 그야말로 최고의 신사들이었다고요. 우린 함께 그 불쌍한 토끼의 기운을 북돋아 주려고 애쓰고 있어요.

english: How has that been going?
Not well. I've tried everything I can think of! Reading our holy Easter books to him, reciting eggy poetry, nothing has worked.
translation: 별로예요. 생각나는 건 다 해 봤어요! 신성한 부활절 경전을 읽어 주고, 달걀 시도 낭송해 주고... 아무것도 소용없었어요.

english: Is that really everything you can think of?
I also considered egg juggling, but every time I do that I make a big mess.
translation: 달걀 저글링도 생각해 봤는데, 할 때마다 엉망진창이 돼서요.

english: Best leave that to the professionals.
Indeed.
He's in the next room if you want to talk to him, hopefully you can improve his mood.
translation: 그는 옆방에 있으니 얘기해 보고 싶으면 가 보세요. 당신이 기분을 좀 풀어 주면 좋겠네요.

english: I hope so too. Talk to you later!
translation: 저도 그러길 바라요. 나중에 또 얘기해요!

english: What is this place? Seems a bit... unsavoury.
translation: 여긴 어디예요? 좀... 수상쩍은 곳 같은데요.

english: This my friend is the Rabbit Hole. A miserable pit for the most part, though I'm told it was previously much more pleasant.
translation: 친구여, 여기가 바로 Rabbit Hole(토끼굴)이에요. 지금은 대체로 비참한 구덩이지만, 예전엔 훨씬 즐거운 곳이었다고 들었어요.

english: A home to all Easter-adjacent beings and their friends! Great feasts, parties, and performances were held here.
translation: 부활절과 관련된 모든 존재와 그 친구들의 보금자리였죠! 성대한 잔치와 파티, 공연이 여기서 열렸어요.

english: All to celebrate Easter! You see, most people would tire of Easter-based activities after a while. But not the denizens of the Rabbit hole.
translation: 모두 부활절을 기념하기 위해서였죠! 보통 사람들은 부활절 행사를 한동안 하다 보면 질리기 마련이거든요. 하지만 Rabbit hole(토끼굴)의 주민들은 달랐어요.

english: Interesting, so if you felt a particularly eggy urge, you could come here and let loose?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 그러니까 유난히 달걀스러운 충동이 들면 여기 와서 마음껏 즐길 수 있었다는 거죠?

english: Precisely! Though now those days are gone, and what Easter joy was once present has all but run out.
translation: 바로 그거예요! 하지만 이제 그런 날들은 지나갔고, 한때 여기 있던 부활절의 기쁨도 거의 다 바닥났어요.

english: Only a few devoted stragglers remain. Though what exactly they are devoted to is up for debate.
translation: 헌신적인 낙오자 몇몇만 남아 있죠. 정확히 무엇에 헌신하는지는 논란의 여지가 있지만요.

english: Certainly not eggs.
That's a shame.
It is a great shame. Still, there is hope!
translation: 정말 안타까운 일이죠. 그래도 희망은 있어요!

english: I agree. I'll have a look around and see what's going on, perhaps I can help restore some egg-nergy.
translation: 동감이에요. 주변을 둘러보고 무슨 일인지 알아볼게요. 어쩌면 에그너지를 되살리는 데 도움이 될지도 모르죠.

english: Oh you! I hope so, let me know if I can help!
translation: 이런, 당신도 참! 그러길 바라요. 도울 일이 있으면 말해 줘요!

english: Where are all the other egg priests?
translation: 다른 달걀 사제들은 다 어디 있어요?

english: A fine question!
They're all very busy scribbling scrolls, rebinding books, replacing plaques, and fiddling with frescoes.
translation: 다들 두루마리를 끄적이고, 책을 다시 제본하고, 명판을 바꾸고, 벽화를 손보느라 아주 바빠요.

english: Once we were informed that our beloved 'Ayaster' was actually 'Easter', it became clear that we had a lot of corrections to sort out.
translation: 우리가 사랑하는 'Ayaster(아야스터)'가 사실은 '이스터', 즉 부활절이었다는 소식을 듣고 나니, 고칠 게 한두 개가 아니라는 게 분명해졌거든요.

english: So they're all making important changes, and there's quite a number to get through!
translation: 그래서 다들 중요한 수정 작업을 하고 있는데, 해치워야 할 게 꽤 많아요!

english: Wow, I don't envy them.
Nor do I! Thank goodness the Easter Bunny is so upset, it's handy excuse to be elsewhere.
translation: 저도요! Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 저렇게 상심해 있어서 다행이에요. 다른 데 가 있을 핑계로 딱이거든요.

english: ...That sounded horrible, I didn't mean it like that.
I should hope not.
Actually, nevermind.
I need some help cheering up the Easter Bunny, what is your favourite part of Easter?
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 기운을 북돋아 주는 데 도움이 필요해요. 부활절에서 제일 좋아하는 게 뭐예요?

english: I couldn't possibly choose!
Oh fantastic! That's not useful at all! What if you HAD to choose? To help the Easter Bunny?
translation: 오, 훌륭하네요! 전혀 도움이 안 되잖아요! 꼭 하나 골라야 한다면요? Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 돕기 위해서라면요?

english: Well if I had to choose for his sake, I suppose it would be the Easter Buns.
translation: 그를 위해 꼭 골라야 한다면, 아마 Easter Buns(부활절 빵)일 거예요.

english: Easter Buns, eh?
Ohhhh yes, you know, Easter Buns! Delicious, sticky, spicy, Easter Buns!
translation: 오오오 그럼요, 아시잖아요, Easter Buns(부활절 빵)! 맛있고, 끈적하고, 향신료 향 가득한 부활절 빵!

english: They're really that good?
Oh my, you've.... you've really never had one?
translation: 세상에, 설마... 설마 한 번도 안 먹어 봤어요?

english: We'll have to change that!
I have the recipe right here. I implore you to make some and try them. I don't have any ingredients with me but I'm sure you could ask around in here.
translation: 요리법이 바로 여기 있어요. 부디 직접 만들어서 먹어 봐요. 재료는 갖고 있지 않지만, 여기 안에서 수소문해 보면 구할 수 있을 거예요.

english: If anything is going to make the Easter Bunny happy, it's these Easter Buns.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 기쁘게 해 줄 게 있다면, 바로 이 Easter Buns(부활절 빵)일 거예요.

english: Okay, I'll give it a go!
Please bring me one too! Heeheehee!
Have you read that recipe yet?
Not yet, I lost it.
You look burdened enough as it is, come back when you have room for it!
translation: 짐이 이미 한가득이네요. 자리가 생기면 다시 와요!

english: Oh really? Let me jot it down for you again quickly...
translation: 오, 정말요? 금방 다시 적어 줄게요...

english: Here you go!
Not yet, I'm waiting for the opportune moment!
Well don't wait too long, I want some Easter Buns!
translation: 너무 오래 기다리진 마요, 저도 Easter Buns(부활절 빵) 먹고 싶단 말이에요!

english: YOU want some Easter Buns?
To uh... Give to the Easter Bunny!
translation: 그... 그러니까 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)한테 주려고요!

english: Right...
I need another copy of that recipe.
translation: 그 요리법 한 장 더 필요해요.

english: I need some yeastier dough to make the Easter Buns, do you have any?
translation: Easter Buns(부활절 빵)을 만들려면 이스트가 더 든 반죽이 필요한데, 혹시 있어요?

english: Do I look like a baker to you? I'm afraid I don't carry raw dough around with me. Maybe ask in the kitchen?
translation: 제가 제빵사처럼 보여요? 아쉽지만 날반죽을 들고 다니진 않아요. 부엌에 가서 물어보는 게 어때요?

english: The kitchen eh? Good idea.
One thing I can tell you, about Eastery dough...
translation: 이스터 반죽에 대해 한 가지 알려 줄 수 있는 건...

english: Yeastier dough?
Yes that's what I said, yeastery dough! What I can tell you about yeasteryear dough is that it is very yeasty!
translation: 그래요, 제 말이 그거예요, 이스터 반죽! 이스트-이스터 반죽에 대해 알려 줄 수 있는 건, 이스트가 아주 많이 들었다는 거예요!

english: Oh really? Wow! Thanks for the education, Eggus.
translation: 오, 정말요? 우와! 가르쳐 줘서 고마워요, Eggus(에구스).

english: It is my duty to teach those less knowledgeable than myself.
translation: 저보다 지식이 부족한 이들을 가르치는 건 제 의무랍니다.

english: I'll see you later.
The recipe says I need a special egg. Do you have any special eggs?
translation: 요리법에 특별한 달걀이 필요하다고 적혀 있어요. 특별한 달걀 있어요?

english: Well I do have some special eggs, but they're my personal supply I'm afraid. I couldn't possibly give them away.
translation: 특별한 달걀이 있긴 한데, 아쉽게도 제 개인 비축분이에요. 도저히 줄 수 없어요.

english: Of course. Where else could I get one then?
translation: 물론이죠. 그럼 어디서 구할 수 있을까요?

english: Perhaps you should ask a chicken?
No, really, there's one around here somewhere!
translation: 아니, 진짜로요, 이 근처 어딘가에 한 마리 있어요!

english: I do recall seeing a chicken in here actually.
translation: 그러고 보니 여기서 닭을 본 기억이 나네요.

english: Well there you go! Eggs-a-plenty!
And remember child, all eggs are special.
translation: 그리고 기억하세요, 아이여. 모든 달걀은 특별하답니다.

english: I'll keep that in mind.
Do you know where I might find Easter spices?
translation: 부활절 향신료는 어디서 구할 수 있을까요?

english: Oh, yes I do. The lass behind the bar, what's her name, Rider? Winkle? Erm... In any case ask her, she puts it in drinks to give them a kick!
translation: 아, 알아요. 바 뒤에 있는 아가씨, 이름이 뭐였더라, 라이더? 윙클? 음... 아무튼 그 아가씨한테 물어봐요. 음료에 그걸 넣어서 톡 쏘는 맛을 내거든요!

english: Okay, thanks.
I need raisins. I also need to know what raisins are. What and where are raisins?
translation: 건포도가 필요해요. 그리고 건포도가 뭔지도 알아야 해요. 건포도는 뭐고 어디 있어요?

english: Raisins! Little tasty morsels! Rich and sweet and goopy! Not as good as eggs though, no no no. You should get some eggs!
translation: 건포도! 작고 맛있는 한 입거리! 진하고 달콤하고 끈적끈적하죠! 그래도 달걀만큼은 아니에요, 아니고말고요. 달걀을 구해 봐요!

english: But I need raisins...
Hmmm, that Glanton fellow mentioned raisins, or was it racing? Something about hydration in any case. Yes, ask him about your eggs. My eggs are off limits.
translation: 흐음, 그 Glanton(글랜턴)이라는 친구가 건포도 얘길 했던가, 아니면 건조하다는 얘기였던가? 아무튼 수분 보충에 관한 얘기였어요. 그래요, 그 친구한테 당신 달걀에 대해 물어봐요. 제 달걀은 안 돼요.

english: I need raisins!!!
Oh my child, you think you need raisins, but you need only embrace the runny yolk of a fine egg to be happy!
translation: 오, 아이여. 당신은 건포도가 필요하다고 생각하겠지만, 행복해지려면 그저 훌륭한 달걀의 흐르는 노른자를 받아들이기만 하면 된답니다!

english: Urgh... Bye.
Easter Buns! Eggy funs! Tasty wasty winky wuns! Oh bunny good and nunny noo..
translation: 부활절 빵! 달걀 놀이! 냠냠 짭짭 반짝 빵빵! 오 토끼 좋아 토니 토니 뿅..

english: Oh hello! I didn't see you there. Off in my own little world I was. How go the buns?
translation: 오, 안녕하세요! 거기 있는 줄 몰랐네요. 잠깐 저만의 작은 세상에 빠져 있었어요. 빵은 어떻게 돼 가요?

english: I've made them, I just need to cook them.
Chop chop then! I can't stop thinking about them.
translation: 그럼 어서어서 해요! 자꾸 그 빵 생각만 나요.

english: All in good time.
Do my senses decieve me? Can I smell... Easter Buns?!
translation: 제 감각이 절 속이는 건가요? 이건... Easter Buns(부활절 빵) 냄새?!

english: Indeed you can.
Wonderful! Have you tried one yet?
I have! They are fantastic. Great recipe.
Why, thank you [player name]! How kind!
translation: 이런, 고마워요, [player name] 님! 친절하기도 하지!

english: Not yet.
How could you resist such a wonder?
translation: 어떻게 이런 경이로움을 참을 수 있죠?

english: I'm not very hungry I suppose.
Let's not delay any longer, get one of these to the Easter Bunny pronto!
translation: 더 지체하지 말고, 이걸 하나 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)한테 당장 가져다줘요!

english: And I would love one too, of course.
Naturally, here you are.
Oh, I'm going to enjoy this!
Simply wonderful! These buns have the Eggus Manus seal of approval.
translation: 정말 훌륭해요! 이 빵은 Eggus Manus(에구스 마누스) 인증 마크를 받았어요.

english: Good! I'll take one to the Easter Bunny now.
translation: 좋아요! 지금 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)한테 하나 가져갈게요.

english: Hello again, Eggus.
Hello!
The Easter Bunny seems happier.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 좀 더 행복해진 것 같아요.

english: Indeed he does! Wonderful, isn't it?
It is, I think we've nearly got him back on track.
translation: 그러게요. 거의 다시 제자리로 돌려놓은 것 같아요.

english: The rehearsal didn't go very well.
No it did not. That Glanton has no respect for musicals.
translation: 그랬죠. 그 Glanton(글랜턴)은 뮤지컬을 전혀 존중하지 않아요.

english: You didn't read the script beforehand either though, did you?
translation: 그래도 당신도 미리 대본을 안 읽었잖아요, 안 그래요?

english: True, true. Though that is because I am familiar with the material.
translation: 맞아요, 맞아. 하지만 그건 제가 그 작품을 잘 알기 때문이에요.

english: Is that right?
Oh yes! Why I could burst into a rendition of 'Oh, is there not one maiden egg' at a moments notice!
translation: 그럼요! '오, 처녀 달걀 하나 없단 말인가'쯤은 언제든 바로 불러 젖힐 수 있다고요!

english: Go on then.
I can't right now, there's no ensemble. Plus, I don't have my singing socks on.
translation: 지금은 안 돼요, 합창단이 없잖아요. 게다가 노래할 때 신는 양말도 안 신었고요.

english: Well you'd better get them, we've got to perform for the Easter Bunny soon.
translation: 그럼 얼른 가서 신고 오는 게 좋겠어요. 곧 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 앞에서 공연해야 하니까요.

english: Hi, Eggus.
Oh hello, [player name]!
Good job with the performance, the Easter Bunny loved it.
translation: 공연 잘하셨어요. Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 정말 좋아했어요.

english: I was impressed with your dancing, you're a natural!
I love a good dance. It's great eggs-ercise!
translation: 전 춤추는 걸 정말 좋아해요. 아주 알찬 운동이거든요!

english: In fact, the show has re-eggnited my love for the stage.
translation: 사실, 이번 공연 덕분에 무대에 대한 제 사랑이 다시 부화했어요.

english: That's great, what are you thinking of doing?
Stand-up comedy! I've been writing jokes. Well, a joke.
translation: 스탠드업 코미디요! 농담을 쓰고 있었어요. 음, 농담 하나요.

english: I think you'll need more than one, Eggus. Still, can I hear it?
translation: 하나보다는 더 필요할 것 같은데요, Eggus(에구스). 그래도 들어 봐도 돼요?

english: Absolutely!
What's big and small at the same time?
I dread to think.
A big egg!
Ohohohoho!
I'm glad that you're enjoying yourself.
I'm having a blast! I think I'll try and write another egg joke soon.
translation: 너무 신나요! 조만간 달걀 농담을 하나 더 써 봐야겠어요.

english: You crack on, Eggus! Good luck with it all.
translation: 계속 껍질을 깨고 나아가세요, Eggus(에구스)! 다 잘되길 빌어요.

english: Thanks.
Hurrah! you've done it again, [player name]! Ayaster is saved again.
translation: 만세! 또 해냈군요, [player name] 님! Ayaster(아야스터)가 또다시 구원받았어요.

english: Ayaster you say?
Oh, I mean Easter of course.
Have you seen the Easter Bunny?
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼) 본 적 있어요?

english: What is this place?
Where are the rest of the egg priests?
Nevermind.
Talk about helping the Easter Bunny.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 돕는 일에 대해 이야기한다.

english: Discuss something else.
Ask about yeastier dough.
translation: 이스트가 더 든 반죽에 대해 묻는다.

english: Ask about a special egg.
Ask about Easter spices.
Ask about raisins.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Welcome to the Hefin Inn! What can I getcha?
translation: Hefin Inn(헤핀 여관)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 뭘 드릴까요?

english: Just a beer.
I can get you a Beer for 2 coins.
Here you go!
Actually, maybe not.
I don't have that much on me... Maybe later.
translation: 지금 그만큼 갖고 있지 않네요... 나중에요.

english: Something a bit fruity.
I can get you a Cider for 2 coins.
Something to eat.
I can get you a Stew for 20 coins.
Some kind of local specialty.
I can get you an Elven dawn for 6 coins.
Nothing. Maybe later!
Just a beer.
Here you go!
Actually, maybe not.
Something a bit fruity.
Something to eat.
Some kind of local specialty.
Nothing.
Hello. Who are you?
Hi there. I'm Ektheme, an expert on the Xerician era.
translation: 안녕하세요. 저는 Ektheme(엑테메)라고 해요. Xerician(제리시안) 시대 전문가죠.

english: Who was Xeric?
Xeric was a dark mage who ruled Great Kourend for at least ten decades. A time period that is sometimes known as the Age of Strife.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 적어도 백 년 동안 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 다스린 어둠의 마법사예요. 그 시기를 Age of Strife(투쟁의 시대)라고 부르기도 하죠.

english: At least? Do you not know how long he was in power for?
translation: 적어도요? 그가 얼마나 오래 권력을 쥐었는지 모르시는 거예요?

english: We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
translation: 물론 기록은 있어요. 하지만 Xeric(제릭)이 37번째부터 47번째 10년기까지 왕국의 통치자였던 건 분명해도, 실제로는 더 오래 다스렸다고 믿는 사람들도 있어요.

english: How come?
It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecessor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
translation: Xeric(제릭)과 그의 전임자인 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)이 사실은 같은 인물이었다는 추측이 자주 나와요.

english: How could that be?
Like Xeric, King Shayzien VII was fascinated with the Dark Altar.
translation: Xeric(제릭)처럼 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)도 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에 매료되어 있었거든요.

english: The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
translation: 왕은 37번째 10년기에 Battle of the Concourse(광장 전투)에서 전사했어요. 이에 대한 기록은 많지만, 그의 시신은 끝내 발견되지 않았죠.

english: Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the King.
translation: 그가 죽고 겨우 며칠 뒤에 Xeric(제릭)이 처음으로 기록에 등장해요. 왕을 닮은, 엄청나게 강력한 마법사였죠.

english: It is written that Xeric killed the rulers of Kourend's five cities and claimed the kingdom as his own.
translation: 기록에 따르면 Xeric(제릭)은 Kourend(쿠렌드) 다섯 도시의 통치자들을 죽이고 왕국을 자기 것으로 차지했다고 해요.

english: So King Shayzien VII was resurrected as Xeric using the Dark Altar?
translation: 그러니까 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)이 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘으로 Xeric(제릭)이 되어 되살아났다는 건가요?

english: It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life. It's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
translation: 가능성은 있어요. 저는 강령술 전문가는 아니지만, Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에 짐승을 되살리는 힘이 있다는 건 알려져 있어요. 수명을 늘릴 수 있다는 것도요. Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들이 불멸인 것도 그 덕분이죠.

english: King Shayzien VII may have found a way to combine these powers.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)이 그 힘들을 합치는 방법을 찾아냈을지도 몰라요.

english: How did Xeric have so much power?
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 어떻게 그렇게 강한 힘을 가졌나요?

english: Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar, but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 힘의 상당 부분을 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에서 얻었지만, 통치자로서의 권위는 자신의 사병인 생명체들, 즉 lizardmen(리자드맨)을 통해 세웠어요.

english: Xeric created the lizardmen!?
Sadly so, though we're not exactly sure how he did so. Xeric used the citizens of Kourend for many experiments, as well as for his own sadistic pleasures.
translation: 안타깝게도 그래요. 정확히 어떻게 만들었는지는 모르지만요. Xeric(제릭)은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 시민들을 수많은 실험에 이용했고, 자신의 가학적인 쾌락을 위해서도 이용했어요.

english: We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
translation: 실험에 대한 기록은 거의 남아 있지 않지만, 그 실험들이 lizardmen(리자드맨)의 탄생으로 이어졌을 거라고 보고 있어요.

english: Do you know why he created the lizardmen?
Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieressuggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: 원래는 Xeric(제릭)이 lizardmen(리자드맨)을 만들었다고 믿었어요. 하지만 최근 발견에 따르면 사실 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕) 시대에 만들어졌을 가능성이 있어요.

english: Do you know why Xeric needed the lizardmen?
Xeric was undoubtedly powerful, but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 분명 강력했지만, 혼자서 백성을 다스릴 수는 없었고 인간 밀고자들을 믿을 수도 없었어요. 자기가 통제할 수 있는 군대가 필요했죠.

english: Lizardmen are loyal creatures and would do as he commanded without question. With them at his disposal, the people were powerless to resist his authority.
translation: Lizardmen(리자드맨)은 충성스러운 생명체라서 그가 명령하면 무엇이든 군말 없이 따랐어요. 그들을 손에 쥔 그에게 백성들은 저항할 힘이 없었죠.

english: What happened to the lizardmen after Xeric's reign?
translation: Xeric(제릭)의 통치가 끝난 뒤 lizardmen(리자드맨)은 어떻게 됐나요?

english: They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom, as you may have seen.
translation: 여전히 Xeric(제릭)에게 충성하고 있어요. 보셨을지도 모르지만, 지금도 계속 왕국을 공격하고 있죠.

english: Fortunately, the Shayzien Army keeps them under control.
translation: 다행히 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)가 그들을 억누르고 있어요.

english: Why do they keep fighting? Surely after a thousand years they must know Xeric is gone?
translation: 왜 계속 싸우는 거죠? 천 년이나 지났으면 Xeric(제릭)이 사라졌다는 걸 알 텐데요?

english: Without examining their minds, we will never know for sure. However, we assume Xeric genetically altered them to enforce that their duty is to serve him.
translation: 그들의 정신을 조사해 보지 않는 한 확실히는 알 수 없을 거예요. 다만 Xeric(제릭)이 그들을 유전적으로 바꿔서 자신을 섬기는 것을 의무로 여기게 만들었다고 추정하고 있어요.

english: But if they are serving Xeric, why do they attack the kingdom?
translation: 그런데 Xeric(제릭)을 섬기고 있다면, 왜 왕국을 공격하는 거죠?

english: A good question. One that I'm afraid I do not know the answer to.
translation: 좋은 질문이에요. 유감스럽게도 저도 답을 모르는 질문이네요.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: 그 밖에 알고 싶은 게 있으세요?

english: What happened to Xeric?
During the 47th decade, after ten decades of oppression, the people revolted against Xeric and his army of lizardmen.
translation: 47번째 10년기, 백 년에 걸친 압제 끝에 백성들이 Xeric(제릭)과 그의 lizardmen(리자드맨) 군대에 맞서 봉기했어요.

english: Why did the people suffer for so long?
The events were triggered through the courage of one man, Byrne. He was not a man of particular stature of nobility, though he did proceed to become king.
translation: 그 사건은 Byrne(번)이라는 한 남자의 용기에서 시작됐어요. 그는 특별히 지위가 높거나 귀족 출신인 사람은 아니었지만, 훗날 왕이 되었죠.

english: What happened?
'Twas the 312th day of decade 47. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 때는 47번째 10년기의 312번째 날이었어요. 농부였던 Byrne(번)은 자기 농장에서 일하다가 lizardman(리자드맨) 경비병이 아이를 살해하는 장면을 목격했다고 해요.

english: Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne grabbed his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.
translation: 방금 본 광경에 격분한 Byrne(번)은 쇠스랑을 움켜쥐고 경비병을 향해 달려갔어요.

english: Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all around.
translation: 분노에 눈이 먼 Byrne(번)은 경비병을 공격했고, 모두가 보는 앞에서 그 lizardman(리자드맨)을 베어 죽였어요.

english: Legend has it Byrne then gave a galvanizing speech, standing over the butchered guard with his bloodied pitchfork held aloft in the air, urging the people to fight back.
translation: 전설에 따르면 Byrne(번)은 쓰러진 경비병 위에 서서 피 묻은 쇠스랑을 높이 치켜든 채, 백성들에게 맞서 싸우자고 외치는 열띤 연설을 했다고 해요.

english: Do you know what he said?
Sadly no. While we have many witness accounts, they all differ, so we can not verify it at all.
translation: 안타깝게도 몰라요. 목격자 증언은 많지만 전부 내용이 달라서, 전혀 확인할 수가 없거든요.

english: Ah, so what happened next?
Whatever Byrne said, the people responded. Together, the citizens of Kourend revolted, grabbing whatever they could use as a weapon. They fought the lizardmen.
translation: Byrne(번)이 무슨 말을 했든, 백성들은 응답했어요. Kourend(쿠렌드)의 시민들은 무기로 쓸 수 있는 건 뭐든 집어 들고 함께 봉기했죠. 그리고 lizardmen(리자드맨)과 싸웠어요.

english: The lizardmen, while strong and powerful, were simply outnumbered. In a matter of days, they had been driven back into the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Lizardmen(리자드맨)은 강하고 힘셌지만, 수적으로 너무 열세였어요. 며칠 만에 그들은 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)로 쫓겨났죠.

english: So what happened to Xeric?
During the battle, the temple surrounding the Dark Altar was destroyed, weakening Xeric's power. We believe he fled to Quidamortem.
translation: 전투 중에 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)을 둘러싼 신전이 파괴되면서 Xeric(제릭)의 힘이 약해졌어요. 저희는 그가 Quidamortem(퀴다모르템)으로 달아났다고 보고 있어요.

english: Some say Xeric was actually killed during the revolt, but we have no record of his remains being discovered.
translation: Xeric(제릭)이 사실 봉기 중에 죽었다고 말하는 사람들도 있지만, 그의 유해가 발견됐다는 기록은 없어요.

english: So no one knows what really happened to him?
translation: 그러니까 그에게 실제로 무슨 일이 있었는지 아무도 모르는 거네요?

english: Xeric was incredibly powerful but we can reasonably assume that he soon perished. Without the power of the Dark Altar, Xeric would have become mortal.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 엄청나게 강력했지만, 머지않아 죽었다고 보는 게 합리적이에요. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘이 없었다면 제릭도 필멸자가 되었을 테니까요.

english: Good riddance by the sounds of it.
translation: 듣고 보니 사라져서 속이 다 시원하네요.

english: Indeed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 그렇죠. 그 밖에 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: No thanks.
Xeric was incredibly powerful, but without the Dark Altar, he would have soon become mortal and perished.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 엄청나게 강력했지만, Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)이 없었다면 머지않아 필멸자가 되어 죽었을 거예요.

english: However, recent discoveries suggest that he may have found a way to amplify the power of the altar. This may have allowed him to live far longer than previously believed.
translation: 하지만 최근 발견에 따르면 그가 제단의 힘을 증폭하는 방법을 찾아냈을지도 몰라요. 그랬다면 지금까지 알려진 것보다 훨씬 오래 살았을 수도 있죠.

english: Hmmm, interesting.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Goodbye.
Who was Xeric?
How did Xeric have so much power?
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 어떻게 그렇게 강한 힘을 가졌나요?

english: What happened to the lizardmen after Xeric's reign?
translation: Xeric(제릭)의 통치가 끝난 뒤 lizardmen(리자드맨)은 어떻게 됐나요?

english: What happened to Xeric?
Goodbye.
No thanks.
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: 정말 멋지지 않아요? 책이 이렇게나 많다니, 흡수할 지식이 이렇게나 많다니!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...

translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 봐야 할 멋진 볼거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있나요?

english: Nothing.
You! Time for some questions.
Why did you join the Emissaries?
I wished to see my god in mortal form and serve his will. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 저는 제 신을 필멸의 모습으로 뵙고 그분의 뜻을 받들기를 바랐습니다. 제가 봉사하는 대가로, Emissaries(사절단)은 그 소원을 이뤄 줄 수 있다고 약속했습니다.

english: I wished to see my god in mortal form and be granted eternity in Mictl. In return for my service, the Emissaries promised me they could grant that wish.
translation: 저는 제 신을 필멸의 모습으로 뵙고 Mictl(믹틀)에서 영원을 허락받기를 바랐습니다. 제가 봉사하는 대가로, Emissaries(사절단)은 그 소원을 이뤄 줄 수 있다고 약속했습니다.

english: Who do you worship?
I am a humble servant of Ranul. It has always been my hope to stand before him and be judged as worthy.
translation: 저는 Ranul(라눌)의 미천한 종입니다. 그분 앞에 서서 합당한 자로 심판받는 것이 언제나 제 소망이었습니다.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 말해 봐.

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared as he and Ralos guide us into forming a new world.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)은 Ranul(라눌)의 뜻입니다. 그분과 Ralos(랄로스)께서 저희를 이끌어 새로운 세상을 이루실 때, 죽음이 전혀 두려워할 것이 아님을 모두에게 보여 주실 겁니다.

english: The Final Dawn is the will of Ranul. He will show us all that death is nothing to be feared. He and Ralos will lead us into forming a new world before then guiding us to Mictl.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)은 Ranul(라눌)의 뜻입니다. 그분은 죽음이 전혀 두려워할 것이 아님을 모두에게 보여 주실 겁니다. 그분과 Ralos(랄로스)께서 저희를 이끌어 새로운 세상을 이루신 뒤, Mictl(믹틀)로 인도하실 겁니다.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 말해 봐.

english: Hello.
Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 인간이군! Tyras(티라스)의 부하가 분명하오. 산적이나 무법자에게 내줄 시간은 없소.

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
No, I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
translation: 아니에요, 제 이름은 [player name]입니다! Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)께서 당신이 저를 도와줄 수 있을 거라고 하셨어요.

english: And you have something to prove this?
Well... Err... No.
As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 아까 말했듯이... 산적이나 무법자에게 내줄 시간은 없소.

english: You show the tracker the crystal pendant.
translation: 추적자에게 crystal pendant(크리스탈 펜던트)를 보여 준다.

english: That is Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
translation: Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)의 펜던트로군. 당신을 무척 신뢰하시는 모양이오. 자, 무엇을 도와주면 되겠소?

english: I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?
translation: Tyras(티라스)를 찾아서 죽여야 해요. 그의 야영지가 어디 있는지 아세요?

english: Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.
translation: 여기가 그의 옛 야영지였소. 며칠 전 전투 이후로 그들은 자리를 옮겼고, 아직 다시 찾아내지 못했소.

english: Can I help at all?
As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethen instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
translation: 사실 지금은 그들을 추적하고 있지 않소. 대신 배신한 우리 동족들의 흔적을 쫓는 중이오. 여기 이게 지금까지 찾은 것 중 가장 좋은 단서요.

english: What is?
Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.
I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.
translation: 이렇게 합시다. 이왕 왔으니 나도 좀 도와주겠소. 나는 여기 동쪽을 살필 테니, 당신은 야영지 서쪽 끝을 확인해 보시오. 뭔가 찾으면 알려 주시오.

english: I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.
translation: 서쪽으로 이어지는 흔적을 찾았어요. 그런데 나무들 사이로 흔적이 끊겨요. 그 너머로는 따라갈 수가 없어요.

english: These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
translation: 이 숲은 생각만큼 늘 빽빽하지는 않소. 자세히 보면 지나갈 길이 보일지도 모르오. 그 점을 염두에 두고, 다시 한번 해 보는 게 어떻겠소?

english: Thanks... I'll see what I can find.
translation: 고마워요... 뭘 찾을 수 있는지 볼게요.

english: How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?
translation: 그 산적 야영지 찾는 일은 어떻게 되어 가오?

english: Getting there.
I found it a short distance west of here.
translation: 여기서 서쪽으로 조금 떨어진 곳에서 찾았어요.

english: I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.
translation: Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)께서 들으면 기뻐하실 거요. 그분께 알려 드리시오.

english: Welcome, adventurer. Are you in need of a staff?
What do you have?
No thanks.
Don't be a stranger. Come on by any time you need anything.
translation: 언제든 편하게 들러 주세요. 필요한 게 있으면 아무 때나 오세요.

english: What do you have?
No thanks.
Hello there.
Good day to you.
What brings you here?
The eternal quest for knowledge, of course! The name's Elias White. I'm something of an explorer.
translation: 물론 지식을 향한 영원한 탐구죠! 저는 Elias White(엘리아스 화이트)라고 해요. 일종의 탐험가랍니다.

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So you're searching for knowledge in an inn?
translation: 만나서 반가워요. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 그런데 여관에서 지식을 찾고 계신 거예요?

english: Not exactly. In fact, I was previously hunting down information on an ancient race deep within the desert.
translation: 꼭 그렇지는 않아요. 사실 전에는 사막 깊은 곳에서 고대 종족에 관한 정보를 쫓고 있었거든요.

english: However, I received an interesting yet concerning tip- off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 그런데 지인에게서 제 연구와 관련해 흥미로우면서도 걱정스러운 제보를 받았어요. 그래서 직접 조사하려고 여기 온 거예요.

english: Oh, hello there. You look familiar. Have we met before?
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 낯이 익은데요. 우리 전에 만난 적 있던가요?

english: I think so. The name's [player name]. You're Elias, right? You had a camp out near Uzer.
translation: 그런 것 같아요. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. Elias(엘리아스) 씨 맞죠? Uzer(우저) 근처에 야영지를 차리셨던.

english: Ah, of course. You offered to help with my work, didn't you? I'm still very keen to take you up on that offer at some point, but a more pressing matter has delayed that somewhat.
translation: 아, 그렇죠. 제 일을 도와주겠다고 하셨죠? 언젠가 꼭 그 제안을 받아들이고 싶은데, 더 급한 일이 생겨서 좀 미뤄졌어요.

english: Is that what's brought you here?
translation: 그 일 때문에 여기 오신 거예요?

english: Indeed. I recived an interesting yet concerning tip-off from a contact of mine regarding some of my research. I came here to investigate for myself.
translation: 맞아요. 지인에게서 제 연구와 관련해 흥미로우면서도 걱정스러운 제보를 받았어요. 그래서 직접 조사하려고 여기 온 거예요.

english: Anything I can help with?
How kind of you to offer. I'm not in need of any extra help right now though.
translation: 제안해 주셔서 고마워요. 그래도 지금은 따로 도움이 필요하지 않아요.

english: How kind of you to offer. I definitely wouldn't complain about some extra support, if you're sure you're interested?
translation: 제안해 주셔서 고마워요. 정말 관심이 있으시다면 도와주시는 걸 마다할 이유가 없죠.

english: Absolutely! So what was this tip-off you received?
Actually, I think I'll pass.
Very well. If you change your mind, I'll be here.
translation: 알겠어요. 마음이 바뀌면 찾아오세요. 전 여기 있을게요.

english: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 다시 보니 반갑네요.

english: And you, Elias. So you're back out here again?
translation: 저도요, Elias(엘리아스) 씨. 또 여기까지 나오신 거예요?

english: Indeed. Turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: 맞아요. 알고 보니 Arrav(아라브)와 그의 심장에 대한 연구를 시작하기엔 사막이 가장 좋은 곳이더라고요. 이곳의 매장 풍습을 생각하면 그리 놀랄 일도 아니지만요.

english: In fact, as you might recall, I was here before to look into that old mastaba up on the plateau.
translation: 사실 기억하시겠지만, 전에도 고원 위에 있는 오래된 mastaba(마스타바)를 조사하러 여기 왔었죠.

english: Yes, I remember. You said it might contain important information on the Mahjarrat.
translation: 네, 기억해요. 거기에 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)에 관한 중요한 정보가 있을지도 모른다고 하셨잖아요.

english: Indeed I did. And I reckon it might also contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
translation: 그랬죠. 그리고 우리 Arrav(아라브) 씨를 도울 지식도 거기 있을지 모른다고 생각해요.

english: Excellent!
Now, I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before we consider heading inside, but once that's done, I'll be in touch.
translation: 아직 안에 들어가 볼지 정하기 전에 해 둘 준비 작업이 꽤 남았어요. 그게 끝나면 연락할게요.

english: Sounds good. I'd best leave you to your work.
Until next time.
What brings you all the way out here?
Are you searching for something here?
Of course. As I said, my search is for knowledge.
translation: 물론이죠. 말했듯이 제가 찾는 건 지식이에요.

english: What kind of knowledge?
Information lost to the ages. Specifically, information on an ancient race.
translation: 세월 속에 잊힌 정보요. 정확히는 어느 고대 종족에 관한 정보죠.

english: And you expect to find something here?
translation: 그걸 여기서 찾을 수 있을 거라 보세요?

english: Not quite here, but up on the plateau. There's an old mastaba up there that I believe dates from a time when the race resided in these lands.
translation: 바로 여기는 아니고, 고원 위에서요. 그 종족이 이 땅에 살던 시절에 지어진 것으로 보이는 오래된 mastaba(마스타바)가 거기 있거든요.

english: Well if you ever need help raiding an ancient tomb, I reckon I can be of service.
translation: 고대 무덤을 털 때 도움이 필요하면 말씀하세요. 제가 쓸모가 있을 거예요.

english: A generous offer! I still have quite a bit of preparatory work to do before I dare head inside, but once that's done, maybe we can work something out.
translation: 고마운 제안이네요! 안에 들어갈 엄두를 내기 전에 해 둘 준비 작업이 아직 꽤 남았지만, 그게 끝나면 함께 뭔가 해 볼 수 있겠네요.

english: Where do you call home?
Ah, I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess Varrock would be the closest answer.
translation: 아, 오랜 세월 여러 곳에서 살아 봤지만 딱히 고향이라 할 곳은 없어요. 굳이 꼽자면 Varrock(바록)이 제일 가깝겠네요.

english: Sounds like you have quite the history.
Oh yes! If nothing else, I've definitely lived a varied life.
translation: 그럼요! 다른 건 몰라도 정말 다채롭게 살아온 건 확실해요.

english: So you weren't always an explorer?
Not at all. I've done all sorts of things in my time. In fact, at one point I was an adventurer like you!
translation: 전혀요. 이것저것 안 해 본 일이 없죠. 사실 한때는 당신 같은 모험가였답니다!

english: What happened? Some sort of life-changing injury?
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는데요? 인생이 바뀔 만한 부상이라도 입으셨어요?

english: Thankfully not. I just found that when it came to my work, it was the history I discovered that interested me more than the treasure.
translation: 다행히 그건 아니에요. 일을 하다 보니 보물보다 제가 발견한 역사가 더 흥미롭더라고요.

english: I'd better get going.
Hello again.
Yes.
No.
Are you searching for something here?
Where do you call home?
I'd better get going.
Hello. Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 안녕하세요. 농사에 대해 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can't you see I'm busy?
Oh, sorry. I thought you might be able to help me with farming like other gardeners.
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 다른 정원사들처럼 농사를 도와주실 수 있을 줄 알았어요.

english: Well, I'm not the type of gardener you think I am. Just leave me alone please.
translation: 저는 당신이 생각하는 그런 정원사가 아니에요. 그냥 좀 내버려 둬요.

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어머, 영웅님이시네요! 와! 정말 대단하세요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘에 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)까지 상대하신 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요. 큰일 해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Elisabeta the village leader.
How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 너무 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일은 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 알기로는 없어요. 이제 기본적인 시설도 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고, 다들 당신께 너무나 감사하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 본 적도, 알고 지낸 적도 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Can I have another Rada's blessing?
translation: Rada's blessing(라다의 축복)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Not unless you free up some space.
translation: 소지품 공간을 좀 비우기 전엔 안 돼요.

english: Who are you?
I'm Elise, the taskmaster for the Kourend & Kebos Achievement Diary.
translation: 저는 Elise(엘리즈)예요. Kourend & Kebos(쿠렌드 & 케보스) 업적 일지의 과제 담당자죠.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Great Kourend and the Kebos Lowlands, it can help you discover some quite useful things.
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록하도록 도와주는 일지예요. Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)와 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)에서는 꽤 유용한 것들을 발견하는 데 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Eventually, with enough exploration, you'll be rewarded.
translation: 충분히 탐험하고 나면 결국 보상을 받게 될 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 업적 일지에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different blessings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too...
translation: 음, 축복은 네 가지인데, 네 단계의 난이도에 맞춰져 있어요. 각 축복은 이전 단계의 보상을 모두 포함하고, 추가 혜택도 있답니다...

english: which tier of rewards would you like to know more about?
translation: 어느 단계의 보상에 대해 더 알고 싶으세요?

english: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please.
