What are you selling?
A selection of fun items for the best of adventurers! That said, be aware that I have little interest in the usual currencies...
translation: 최고의 모험가를 위한 재미있는 물건들이요! 그런데 미리 말씀드리자면, 흔한 화폐에는 별 관심이 없어요...

english: Right...
You can only purchase items from the Speedrunning Rewards Shop using Speedrun Points. Speedrun Points can only be earned on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: Speedrunning Rewards Shop(스피드런 보상 상점)의 물건은 스피드런 점수로만 살 수 있어요. 스피드런 점수는 스피드런 월드에서만 얻을 수 있고요.

english: So, looking to buy?
Yes please.
I'd like to claim some trophies.
I'm afraid you don't have any trophies to claim.
translation: 아쉽지만 받을 수 있는 트로피가 없네요.

english: A Speedrun Trophy can only be claimed on your main profile if you have earned that trophy for every quest available on Speedrunning Worlds.
translation: 스피드런 트로피는 스피드런 월드에서 할 수 있는 모든 퀘스트의 트로피를 얻어야 본 프로필에서 받을 수 있어요.

english: I'll pass.
Fair enough.
Hey there! Sorry, I'd love to talk, but I'm very busy right now.
translation: 안녕하세요! 미안해요, 얘기하고 싶은데 지금 너무 바빠서요.

english: Hey there. I'm afraid I don't have anything for sale at the moment. Maybe another time?
translation: 안녕하세요. 아쉽지만 지금은 파는 물건이 없어요. 다음에 다시 들러 주시겠어요?

english: You can only purchase items from the Speedrunning Rewards Shop while on your main profile.
translation: Speedrunning Rewards Shop(스피드런 보상 상점)의 물건은 본 프로필에서만 살 수 있어요.

english: Sorry, I'm still getting things set up here. You'll have to come back later.
translation: 미안해요, 아직 여기 준비 중이에요. 나중에 다시 와 주세요.

english: The Speedrunning Rewards Shop will open on the 28th September 2022.
translation: Speedrunning Rewards Shop(스피드런 보상 상점)은 2022년 9월 28일에 문을 열어요.

english: Yes please.
I'd like to claim some trophies.
I'll pass.
What are you selling?
I'm here to help the guards with their investigation.
What's so important you need to bother me with then?
translation: 그래서 뭐가 그렇게 중요하길래 날 귀찮게 하는 거지?

english: Who do you think was responsible?
Could have been anyone. The old man was an idiot. He's been asking for it for years.
translation: 누구든 될 수 있지. 그 영감은 바보였어. 몇 년째 화를 자초하고 다녔다고.

english: Where were you when the murder happened?
I was out.
Care to be any more specific?
Not really. I don't have to justify myself to the likes of you, you know. I know the King personally you know. Now are we finished here?
translation: 별로. 너 같은 것한테 일일이 해명할 필요 없거든. 난 왕과도 개인적으로 아는 사이라고. 이제 끝났지?

english: Do you recognise this thread?
Looks like Blue thread to me. If you can't work that out for yourself I don't hold much hope of you solving this crime.
translation: Blue thread(파란 실) 같네. 그것도 혼자 못 알아보면 네가 이 사건을 해결할 거란 기대는 안 할래.

english: It looks a lot like the material your trousers are made of doesn't it?
translation: 당신 바지 옷감이랑 아주 비슷해 보이지 않아요?

english: I suppose it does. So what?
It's some thread. You're not very good at this whole investigation thing are you?
translation: 그냥 실이잖아. 너 이런 수사 같은 거엔 영 소질이 없구나?

english: Why'd you buy poison the other day?
There was a nest of mosquitos under the fountain in the garden, which I killed with poison the other day. You can see for yourself if you're capable of managing that, which I somehow doubt.
translation: 정원 분수 밑에 모기 둥지가 있어서 요전에 독으로 죽였어. 네가 그 정도는 할 줄 안다면 직접 가서 확인해 봐. 별로 그럴 것 같진 않지만.

english: I hate mosquitos!
Doesn't everyone?
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Who do you think was responsible?
Where were you when the murder happened?
Do you recognise this thread?
Why'd you buy poison the other day?
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지가 않아요. 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 탐험할 새로운 대륙이라니... 정말 신나는 시대예요!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 누가 그러는데 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있대요. 조심하세요!

english: Hello there.
Hello, welcome to our maze. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 안녕하세요, 우리 미로에 오신 걸 환영해요. 저는 나무 노움 Elkoy(엘코이)예요.

english: I haven't heard of your sort
There's not many of us left. Once you could find tree gnomes anywhere in the world, now we hide in small groups to avoid capture.
translation: 이제 남은 수가 많지 않거든요. 예전엔 세상 어디서나 나무 노움을 볼 수 있었는데, 지금은 잡히지 않으려고 작은 무리로 숨어 지내요.

english: Capture by whom?
Tree gnomes have been hunted for so called 'fun' since as long as I can remember.
translation: 제가 기억하는 한 아주 오래전부터 나무 노움은 소위 '재미'로 사냥당해 왔어요.

english: Our main threat nowadays are General Khazard's troops. They know no mercy, but are also very dense. They'll never find their way through our maze.
translation: 요즘 가장 큰 위협은 General Khazard(카자드 장군)의 군대예요. 자비라곤 없지만 머리도 아주 둔하죠. 그 녀석들은 절대 우리 미로를 통과하지 못할 거예요.

english: Have fun.
I would be glad to help.
Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: 고맙소. 전장은 미로 북쪽에 있소. Commander Montai(몬타이 사령관)이 현재 상황을 알려 줄 것이오.

english: That is if he's still alive.
My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: 내 조수가 밖으로 안내할 것이오. 행운을 비오, 친구여. 부디 orb(오브)를 되찾아 주시오.

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 이제 미로를 빠져나왔어요. 서둘러 주세요. 우리가 살아남으려면 그 orb(오브)가 꼭 있어야 해요.

english: Hello Elkoy.
Oh my! Oh my!
What's wrong?
The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 그놈들이 orb(오브)를, 오브를 가져갔어요. 우린 이제 끝장이에요. 미로를 지나가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
Please help us get our orb back.
Not now, thanks.
The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you back to the village?
translation: 그놈들이 orb(오브)를, 오브를 가져갔어요. 우린 이제 끝장이에요. 마을로 돌아가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: 플레이어가 Tree Gnome Village(나무 노움 마을)의 입구인 loose railing(헐거운 난간)으로 이동한다.

english: Hello.
You must retrieve the orb, or the gnome village is doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: orb(오브)를 되찾아 오지 않으면 노움 마을은 끝장이에요. 미로를 지나가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: You're back! And the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 제발요, 우리가 살아남으려면 orb(오브)가 꼭 있어야 해요. 미로를 지나가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: Hello Elkoy. I have the orb.
Take it to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: King Bolren(볼렌 왕)께 가져가세요. 분명 반가워하실 거예요.

english: Can you show me out of the village?
translation: 마을 밖으로 안내해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Please return with our orb soon.
translation: 어서 우리 오브를 가지고 돌아와 주세요.

english: Okay.
I have it here.
You're our saviour. Please return it to the village and we are all saved. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 당신은 우리의 구원자예요. 그걸 마을에 돌려주시면 우린 모두 살 수 있어요. 마을로 가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: Here we are. Take the orb to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: 다 왔어요. orb(오브)를 King Bolren(볼렌 왕)께 가져가세요. 분명 반가워하실 거예요.

english: No thanks Elkoy.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 제발요, 우리가 살아남으려면 orb(오브)가 꼭 있어야 해요.

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: 그대는 용감하구려. 하지만 이번 임무는 그대에게도 험난할 것이오. 행운을 비오. 다시 한번, 그대가 우리의 유일한 희망이오.

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: 나는 이 orb(오브)를 지키며 그대가 무사히 돌아오기를 기도하겠소. 내 조수가 밖으로 안내할 것이오.

english: Good luck friend.
Did you hear?
Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?
translation: Khazard(카자드)의 부하들이 마을을 약탈했어요! 많은 이들을 죽이고, 우리를 미로 밖으로 꾀어내려고 나머지 오브들을 가져갔어요. 이 비극은 대체 언제 끝날까요?

english: Please help us find the orbs.
I'm very sorry.
Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
Here we are. Despite what has happened here, I hope you feel welcome.
translation: 다 왔어요. 이런 일이 있었지만, 그래도 편히 지내다 가셨으면 해요.

english: Ok then, take care.
You truly are a hero.
Thanks.
You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well. Would you like me to show you through the maze?
translation: orbs of protection(보호의 오브)를 모두 되찾아 주셔서 우리가 살았어요. 감사한 마음뿐이에요. 앞날에 행운이 가득하길 빌게요. 미로를 지나가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: Here we are. Have a safe journey.
You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well.
translation: orbs of protection(보호의 오브)를 모두 되찾아 주셔서 우리가 살았어요. 감사한 마음뿐이에요. 앞날에 행운이 가득하길 빌게요.

english: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.
Hello, welcome to our village. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.
translation: 안녕하세요, 우리 마을에 오신 걸 환영해요. 저는 나무 노움 Elkoy(엘코이)예요.

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 안녕하세요, 잘 지내고 계시죠? 마을로 가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way out of the village?
translation: 안녕하세요, 잘 지내고 계시죠? 마을 밖으로 나가는 길을 안내해 드릴까요?

english: I would be glad to help.
Yes please.
Not now, thanks.
Can you show me out of the village?
translation: 마을 밖으로 안내해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Okay.
No thanks Elkoy.
I'm very sorry.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 좋은 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello. Interested in honing your skills?
Yes please.
Ellen helps you improve your (selected skill) skill.
translation: Ellen(엘런)이 당신의 (선택한 스킬) 스킬 향상을 도와준다.

english: That's all the training I can give you. I hope you find it useful.
translation: 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 훈련은 여기까지예요. 도움이 됐으면 좋겠네요.

english: (Combat Training interface re-opens.)
I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음이 바뀌면 찾아오세요. 전 여기 있을게요.

english: No thanks.
Hello again. I'm afraid I've given you all the training I can.
translation: 또 만났네요. 아쉽지만 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 훈련은 다 해 드렸어요.

english: Yes please.
Yes.
No.
No thanks.
Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭에는 묘목이 심겨 있지 않네요. 하나 심고 오면 돌봐 드릴지 생각해 볼게요.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: fruit basket(과일 바구니)에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 다섯 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없어요.

english: There are seven main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 주요 Farming(농사) 지역은 일곱 곳이에요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처 Elstan(엘스탄)의 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처 Dantaera(단타에라)의 구역, Ardougne(아르둔) 근처 Kragen(크라겐)의 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역, 그리고

english: Oswallt's area in Prifddinas.
Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 일반 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만, 만들기가 더 비싸요. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든요. 아이템을 보여 주시면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 드릴게요.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 늘 물을 줘야 해요. 제 조언을 무시하면 머지않아 밭 하나를 통째로 말려 죽이게 될 거예요.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 키우는 특별한 밭이 있어요. 아마 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처일 거예요. 그쪽 땅이 좀 '축복받지 못한' 곳이거든요.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일을 빚는 데 좋아요. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다고 들었고, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 그런 걸로 유명했다는 소문이 있어요. 물론 거기 사람들이 다 죽기 전 얘기지만요.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 키울 수 있어요. 그곳 땅은 유난히 축축해서 독버섯을 키우기에 딱 좋거든요.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어요. 상점은 텃밭 가까이에 있어요.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 먼저 흙을 담은 plantpot(화분)에서 sapling(묘목)으로 키운 다음, tree patch(나무 밭)으로 옮겨 심어 다 자랄 때까지 키워야 해요.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: bush(덤불)이나 나무의 병을 고치는 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 것뿐이에요. 다른 작물은 그냥 식물 치료제를 뿌리면 돼요.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 plantpot(화분)을 채울 수 있어요.

english: If you need to be rid of your fruit trees for any reason, all you have to do is chop them down and then dig up the stump.
translation: 과일나무를 없애야 할 일이 생기면, 베어 낸 다음 stump(그루터기)를 파내기만 하면 돼요.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭을 갈퀴질하고 나온 weeds(잡초)를 그냥 버리지 마세요. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만드세요.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 compost(퇴비)를 주면 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라, 수확량도 늘어나요.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: sacks(자루)와 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶다면 Falador(팔라도르)의 농사 상점 근처에 있는 loom(베틀)을 써야 해요. 솜씨가 충분히 좋은 장인이라면 말이죠.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftsman, that is.
translation: plantpot(화분)을 전부 살 필요는 없어요. 물레로 직접 만들 수도 있거든요. 솜씨가 충분히 좋은 장인이라면 말이죠.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: vegetable sack(채소 자루)에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 열 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없어요.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 제가 팔 물건이 있느냐에 달렸죠. 뭘 찾고 계세요?

english: I'll come back another time.
You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 아직 안 끝났어요! 이것 좀 해 주세요!

english: My produce can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 제 농작물도 그것보단 퍼즐을 잘 풀겠네요!

english: Excellent work!
Would you look after my crops for me?
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: Can you sell me something?
I'll come back another time.
Hey, how can I help you?
What do you do here?
This is one of the branches for Mahogany Homes, Gielinor's first construction company.
translation: 여기는 Gielinor(길리노르) 최초의 건설 회사, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)의 지점 중 하나예요.

english: Oh wow, how can I get involved?
translation: 우와, 저도 참여하려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: If you go see Amy in the Falador branch, she'll fill you in. Her office is just east of the Estate Agent in Falador.
translation: Falador(팔라도르) 지점에 있는 Amy(에이미)를 찾아가면 자세히 알려 줄 거예요. 사무실은 팔라도르의 Estate Agent(부동산 중개인) 바로 동쪽에 있어요.

english: Nice, thank you.
Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 반갑습니다, 친구. 저는 가죽을 만드는 사람입니다.

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 그럼 가죽을 좀 살 수 있나요?

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 저는 동물 가죽을 무두질해서 가죽을 만듭니다. cowhides(소가죽)과 한 장당 1코인을 가져오시면 부드러운 가죽으로 무두질해 드리지요.

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 일반 leather(가죽)은 꽤 약할지 몰라도 아주 쌉니다. 소가죽 한 장당 고작 1gp에 만들어 드리고, 다루기도 쉬워서 누구나 가공할 수 있지요.

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 아니면 hard leather(경화 가죽)을 써 보셔도 됩니다. 가공하기는 그리 쉽지 않지만, 소가죽 한 장당 3gp만 받고 손질해 드리고, 훨씬 튼튼한 갑옷이 됩니다.

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 뱀 가죽과 드래곤 가죽도 무두질할 수 있습니다. 궁수들을 위한 최고급 갑옷을 만들기에 알맞지요.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
translation: 가죽을 한 장 가져오셨군요. 무두질해 드릴까요?

english: I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 가죽을 몇 장 가져오셨군요. 무두질해 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 그럼 가죽을 좀 살 수 있나요?

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Yes please.
No thanks.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 죄송한데요, 똥 좀 조금만 나눠 주실 수 있을까요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 영 마음에 들지 않은 모양이다.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 근처에 갔다간 손을 물어뜯길 것 같아.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 케밥을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 일단 눈부터 감아. 누가 보는 앞에서는 안 할 거야!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
Did you say something?
No, er, nothing important.
Well, it's nice to have someone to talk to.
Ollie is so remote, and I can't get up the courage to talk to him...
translation: Ollie(올리)는 너무 무뚝뚝해서, 말을 걸 용기가 안 나...

english: Who's Ollie?
He's the camel wandering around near that glider.
Isn't he so strong-looking and handsome?
Er... he just looks like any other camel to me.
translation: 어... 제 눈엔 그냥 평범한 낙타로 보이는데요.

english: How can you not see how wonderful he is?
translation: 어떻게 저렇게 멋진 걸 못 알아볼 수가 있어?

english: Why, he can cross the Kharidian Desert in three bounds, and he's so strong that he could haul the brick for the Emir's Arena in only a day!
translation: 아니 글쎄, Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)을 세 걸음 만에 건너고, 힘도 얼마나 센지 Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)에 쓸 벽돌을 하루 만에 다 날라 버릴 수 있다니까!

english: You're a camel, I'm not. Maybe you can see these things better.
translation: 당신은 낙타고 저는 아니잖아요. 당신이 이런 걸 더 잘 알아보나 보죠.

english: For someone who understands camel speech, you're not good at these things.
translation: 낙타 말을 알아듣는 사람치고는 이런 쪽으론 영 꽝이네.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 저는 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 단골 고객이시니까, 이건 받으셔도 돼요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What's a gnome doing here?
translation: 노움이 여기서 뭘 하고 있는 거예요?

english: I'm an investigator. I'm watching the implings.
Why would you want to do that?
My client has asked me to find out where certain missing items have been going.
translation: 제 의뢰인이 사라진 물건들이 어디로 가는지 알아봐 달라고 부탁했습니다.

english: Who is this client?
I'm not at liberty to discuss that. Investigator-client confidentiality don't you know.
translation: 그건 말씀드릴 수 없습니다. 조사관과 의뢰인 사이의 비밀 유지 의무라는 게 있지 않습니까.

english: Where is this place?
The fairies call it Puro-Puro. It seems to be the home plane of the implings.
translation: 요정들은 이곳을 Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)라고 부릅니다. 임플링들의 고향 차원인 듯하더군요.

english: I don't think these creatures have a name for it. As you can see there isn't a lot else here other than wheat.
translation: 이 녀석들은 이곳을 따로 부르는 이름이 없는 것 같습니다. 보시다시피 여기엔 밀 말고는 별것이 없지요.

english: How did you get here?
The same way you did, I suspect. Through a portal in a wheat field. I followed one back.
translation: 아마 당신과 같은 방법이었을 겁니다. 밀밭에 있는 포털을 통해서 말이지요. 저는 임플링 한 마리를 따라 들어왔습니다.

english: I haven't noticed them do that.
That's why I'm the investigator and you're the adventurer.
translation: 그러니까 제가 조사관이고 당신이 모험가인 거지요.

english: So, what are these implings?
That's a very interesting question. My best guess is that they are relatives to imps, which is why there are imps here as well.
translation: 아주 흥미로운 질문입니다. 제 추측으로는 임프의 친척인 듯합니다. 그래서 이곳에 임프들도 있는 것이고요.

english: Implings do appear to like collecting objects and, as my clients have noted, have no concept of ownership. However, I do not sense any malicious intent.
translation: 임플링들은 물건을 모으는 걸 좋아하는 것 같고, 제 의뢰인들이 지적했듯이 소유라는 개념이 없습니다. 하지만 악의는 느껴지지 않더군요.

english: It is my observation that they collect things that other creatures want, rather than they want them themselves. It seems to provide them with sustenance.
translation: 제가 관찰한 바로는, 녀석들은 자기가 원해서가 아니라 다른 생물들이 원하는 물건을 모읍니다. 그게 녀석들에게 양분이 되는 듯합니다.

english: So they feed off our desire for things?
translation: 그러니까 우리가 뭔가를 갖고 싶어 하는 마음을 먹고 산다는 거예요?

english: Possibly. Either way, it seems that they almost exclusively collect things that people want, except their younglings who I infer haven't learnt the best things to collect yet.
translation: 그럴지도 모르지요. 어느 쪽이든 녀석들은 거의 예외 없이 사람들이 원하는 물건만 모읍니다. 새끼들은 예외인데, 아직 뭘 모아야 좋은지 배우지 못한 것으로 보입니다.

english: So the more experienced implings have the more desirable items?
translation: 그럼 경험 많은 임플링일수록 더 탐나는 물건을 갖고 있겠네요?

english: That is my observation. Yes.
Can I catch these implings, then?
Indeed you may. In fact I encourage it. You will, however, require some equipment.
translation: 물론입니다. 오히려 권장하는 바입니다. 다만 장비가 좀 필요할 겁니다.

english: Firstly you will need a butterfly net in which to catch them and at least one special impling jar to store an impling.
translation: 먼저 녀석들을 잡을 butterfly net(나비 그물)이 있어야 하고, 임플링을 담아 둘 특수한 impling jar(임플링 병)도 최소한 하나는 있어야 합니다.

english: You will also require some experience as a Hunter since these creatures are elusive. The more immature implings require less experience, but some of the rarer implings are extraordinarily hard to find and catch.
translation: 녀석들은 워낙 잘 숨기 때문에 Hunter(사냥) 경험도 어느 정도 필요합니다. 덜 자란 임플링은 경험이 덜 필요하지만, 희귀한 임플링 중에는 찾기도 잡기도 엄청나게 어려운 녀석들이 있습니다.

english: Once you have caught one, you may break the jar open and obtain the object the impling is carrying. Alternatively, you may exchange certain combinations of jars with me. I will return the jars to my clients. In
translation: 한 마리를 잡으면 병을 깨서 임플링이 들고 있던 물건을 얻을 수 있습니다. 아니면 특정한 조합의 병들을 저와 교환할 수도 있지요. 그 병들은 제가 의뢰인들에게 돌려줄 겁니다.

english: exchange I will be able to provide you with some equipment that may help you hunt butterflies more effectively.
translation: 그 대가로 나비를 더 효과적으로 잡는 데 도움이 될 만한 장비를 드릴 수 있습니다.

english: Also, beware. Those imps walking around the maze do not like the fact that their kindred spirits are being captured and will attempt to steal any full jars you have on you, setting the implings free.
translation: 그리고 조심하십시오. 미로를 돌아다니는 저 임프들은 자기 동족이 잡혀가는 걸 싫어해서, 당신이 가진 꽉 찬 병을 훔쳐 임플링을 풀어 주려 할 겁니다.

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에서 드래곤 장비를 찾을 수도 있다고 들었어요.

english: Have you indeed? Well, that may well be true, though bear in mind that implings are quite small so they are unlikely to be lugging a sizeable shield around with them. However, since it seems that dragon items are
translation: 그러셨습니까? 뭐, 사실일 수도 있습니다. 다만 임플링은 꽤 작아서 커다란 shield(방패) 같은 걸 끌고 다닐 것 같지는 않다는 점은 염두에 두십시오. 그래도 드래곤 아이템은

english: very desirable to humans then it certainly is possible that the most expert implings may try to obtain such equipment.
translation: 인간들이 무척 탐내는 물건인 듯하니, 가장 노련한 임플링이라면 그런 장비를 손에 넣으려 할 가능성은 분명 있습니다.

english: So, it's true then? Cool!
I should warn you, though, if the impling is strong enough to collect dragon equipment, then you will have to be very skilled at hunting implings in order to catch them.
translation: 하지만 경고해 두지요. 드래곤 장비를 모을 만큼 강한 임플링이라면, 그걸 잡기 위해 당신도 임플링 사냥에 아주 능숙해야 할 겁니다.

english: Ah, good day, it's you again. What can I do for you?
translation: 아, 안녕하십니까, 또 오셨군요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Ah, I notice you don't own an impling collector's scroll.
translation: 아, 임플링 수집가의 scroll(두루마리)를 갖고 있지 않으시군요.

english: Elnock gives you a scroll. If you check it whilst in the maze, you will see how many of each impling you have captured.
translation: Elnock(엘녹)이 두루마리를 건넨다. 미로 안에서 확인하면 임플링을 종류별로 몇 마리 잡았는지 볼 수 있다.

english: No thanks.
Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
translation: 임플링 잡는 법을 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Certainly.

You cannot use an ordinary butterfly jar as a container as the implings will escape from them with ease. However, I have done some investigation and have come up with a solution - if a butterfly jar is coated
translation: 평범한 butterfly jar(나비 병)은 임플링이 쉽게 빠져나가 버리니 용기로 쓸 수 없습니다. 하지만 제가 조사를 좀 해서 해결책을 찾아냈지요. 나비 병에

english: with a thin layer of a substance noxious to them they become incapable of escape.
translation: 녀석들에게 해로운 물질을 얇게 바르면 빠져나가지 못하게 됩니다.

english: What substance is that, then?
I have tried a few experiments with the help of a friend back home, and it turns out that a combination of anchovy oil and flowers - marigolds, rosemary or nasturtiums - will work.
translation: 고향에 있는 친구의 도움으로 몇 가지 실험을 해 봤는데, anchovy oil(멸치 기름)과 꽃, 그러니까 marigolds(금잔화), rosemary(로즈메리), nasturtiums(한련화) 중 하나를 섞으면 효과가 있더군요.

english: How do you make anchovy oil then?
I'd grind up some cooked anchovies and pass them through a sieve.
translation: 저라면 익힌 anchovies(멸치)를 갈아서 sieve(체)에 거르겠습니다.

english: Where do I make these jars?
Well, I believe there is a chemist in Rimmington that has a small still that you could use.
translation: 글쎄요, Rimmington(림밍턴)에 있는 chemist(화학자)에게 쓸 만한 작은 증류기가 있을 겁니다.

english: Is there anywhere I can buy these jars?
translation: 그 병을 살 수 있는 곳이 있나요?

english: Well I may be able to let you have a few - if it means you will start hunting these implings - although I do not have an infinite supply.
translation: 뭐, 몇 개 정도는 드릴 수 있을지도 모르겠습니다. 그걸로 임플링 사냥을 시작하신다면 말이지요. 다만 무한정 있는 건 아닙니다.

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: 그 도둑 임프들에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Imps and implings appear to be related, and the imps here are quite protective of their smaller relations. If you allow them to get too close then they will attempt to steal jarred implings from your pack, if you have them.
translation: 임프와 임플링은 서로 친척인 듯하고, 이곳 임프들은 작은 친척들을 꽤 감싸고 돕니다. 너무 가까이 다가오게 두면, 소지품에 병에 담긴 임플링이 있을 경우 그걸 훔치려 들 겁니다.

english: They will then set them free, dropping your jar on the floor. So, if you're quick, you may be able to catch it again.
translation: 그러고는 임플링을 풀어 주고 병은 바닥에 떨어뜨리지요. 그러니 재빠르다면 다시 잡을 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

english: I have some impling deterrent which I may trade if you prove that you can catch implings well.
translation: 임플링을 잘 잡는다는 걸 증명하시면 교환해 드릴 수 있는 임프 퇴치제가 좀 있습니다.

english: So what's this equipment you can give me, then?
translation: 그럼 저한테 줄 수 있다는 장비가 뭔데요?

english: I have been given permission by my clients to give three pieces of equipment to able hunters.
translation: 의뢰인들로부터 유능한 사냥꾼에게 장비 세 가지를 줘도 된다는 허락을 받았습니다.

english: Firstly, I have some imp deterrent. If you bring me three baby implings, two young implings and one gourmet impling already jarred, I will give you a vial. Imps don't like the smell, so they will be less likely to
translation: 첫째는 임프 퇴치제입니다. 병에 담은 baby impling(아기 임플링) 세 마리, young impling(어린 임플링) 두 마리, gourmet impling(미식가 임플링) 한 마리를 가져오시면 vial(약병)을 하나 드리지요. 임프들이 그 냄새를 싫어해서

english: steal jarred implings from you.
translation: 당신에게서 병에 담긴 임플링을 훔쳐 갈 가능성이 줄어듭니다.

english: Secondly, I have magical butterfly nets. If you bring me three gourmet implings, two earth implings and one essence impling I will give you a new net. It will help you catch both implings and butterflies.
translation: 둘째는 마법 나비 그물입니다. gourmet impling(미식가 임플링) 세 마리, earth impling(대지 임플링) 두 마리, essence impling(정수 임플링) 한 마리를 가져오시면 새 그물을 드리지요. 임플링과 나비를 둘 다 잡는 데 도움이 될 겁니다.

english: Lastly, I have magical jar generators. If you bring me three essence implings, two eclectic implings and one nature impling I will give you a jar generator. This object will create either butterfly or impling jars (up to
translation: 마지막으로 마법 jar generator(병 생성기)가 있습니다. essence impling(정수 임플링) 세 마리, eclectic impling(잡동사니 임플링) 두 마리, nature impling(자연 임플링) 한 마리를 가져오시면 병 생성기를 드리지요. 이 물건은 나비 병이나 임플링 병을 만들어 내므로

english: a limited number of charges) without having to carry a pack full of them.
translation: (정해진 충전 횟수까지만 가능하지만) 병을 꾸러미 가득 들고 다닐 필요가 없어집니다.

english: Yes! I have some spare equipment for you.
translation: 그럼요! 드릴 여분의 장비가 좀 있습니다.

english: There you go. You have everything you need now.
translation: 여기 있습니다. 이제 필요한 건 다 갖추셨습니다.

english: I have already given you some equipment.
If you are ready to start hunting implings, then enter the main part of the maze.
translation: 임플링 사냥을 시작할 준비가 되셨다면 미로의 중심부로 들어가십시오.

english: Just push through the wheat that surrounds the centre of the maze and get catching!
translation: 미로 중앙을 둘러싼 밀을 헤치고 들어가서 잡기 시작하시면 됩니다!

english: Could you store some equipment for me?
translation: 장비 좀 맡아 주실 수 있나요?

english: I suppose I could keep hold of a net and a few empty jars for you. Just give me what you want me to hold.
translation: 그물 하나와 빈 병 몇 개 정도는 맡아 드릴 수 있겠지요. 맡기고 싶은 걸 주시기만 하면 됩니다.

english: Can you tell me about the wheat?

The wheat here can be hard to push through and pushing through it definitely makes you stronger. I found it easier to push through it for about half an hour just after coming through a temporary crop circle.
translation: 이곳의 밀은 헤치고 나아가기가 힘들 수 있는데, 헤치고 나아가다 보면 확실히 힘이 세집니다. 임시로 생긴 crop circle(미스터리 서클)을 통과해 온 직후 30분쯤은 밀을 헤치고 나아가기가 더 쉬웠습니다.

english: I call it the Farmer's Affinity.
What if I didn't want to become stronger pushing through the wheat?
translation: 밀을 헤치고 다니면서 힘이 세지고 싶지 않으면요?

english: I could give you oil to rub on you to reduce friction. Still as hard to push but you don't get stronger.
translation: 마찰을 줄이도록 몸에 바르는 기름을 드릴 수 있습니다. 헤치고 나아가기 힘든 건 똑같지만 힘은 세지지 않지요.

english: You gave me oil to stop me getting stronger. What if I changed my mind?
translation: 힘이 세지지 않게 기름을 주셨잖아요. 제가 마음을 바꾸면요?

english: I could lend you a cloth to wipe it off. That should let you become strong while pushing through the wheat.
translation: 그걸 닦아 낼 cloth(천)을 빌려 드릴 수 있습니다. 그러면 밀을 헤치고 나아가면서 다시 힘이 세질 겁니다.

english: Turn wheat Strengh XP ON?
translation: 밀을 헤칠 때 Strength(힘) 경험치를 받도록 켤까요?

english: Can I buy a few impling jars?
translation: 임플링 병을 몇 개 살 수 있을까요?

english: You've already purchased 10 jars today, that's enough. Please come back tomorrow if you'd like to buy more.
translation: 오늘 이미 병을 10개 사셨으니, 그만하면 됐습니다. 더 사고 싶으시면 내일 다시 오십시오.

english: I usually prefer trading these jars for implings, but if you desperately need them I'm willing to sell you up to 10 jars per day.
translation: 저는 보통 이 병을 임플링과 교환하는 쪽을 선호하지만, 정말 급하시다면 하루에 10개까지는 팔아 드리겠습니다.

english: I will sell these jars for 2,000 coins each. How many would you like to purchase?
My time is valuable, please give me a serious offer next time.
translation: 제 시간은 귀중합니다. 다음에는 진지한 제안을 해 주십시오.

english: So you would like to purchase [number] [jar/jars], costing you a total of [number] coins. Is that correct?
You don't seem to have brought enough coins, please come back with [number] coins if you'd like to buy the jars.
translation: 코인이 부족하신 것 같군요. 병을 사고 싶으시면 [number]코인을 가지고 다시 오십시오.

english: Here you go. You can come back if you need more and tomorrow I will have another 10 jars ready for purchase.
translation: 여기 있습니다. 더 필요하시면 다시 오셔도 되고, 내일은 구매하실 수 있는 병을 10개 더 준비해 두겠습니다.

english: Here you go. If you need some more I'll have 10 new jars ready for purchase tomorrow.
translation: 여기 있습니다. 더 필요하시면 내일 새 병 10개를 준비해 두겠습니다.

english: That's too many, I can let you purchase a maximum of [number] jars for a total of [number] coins today.
translation: 너무 많습니다. 오늘은 최대 [number]개, 총 [number]코인까지만 구매하실 수 있습니다.

english: Where is this place?
So what are these implings?
Can I catch these implings then?
I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에서 드래곤 장비를 찾을 수도 있다고 들었어요.

english: Yes, please
No, thanks.
Can you remind me how to catch implings again?
translation: 임플링 잡는 법을 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Tell me more about these jars.
translation: 그 병에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me more about these thieving imps.
translation: 그 도둑 임프들에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: So what's this equipment you can give me then?
translation: 그럼 저한테 줄 수 있다는 장비가 뭔데요?

english: Do you have some spare equipment I can use?
translation: 제가 쓸 만한 여분의 장비가 있나요?

english: Can I trade some jarred implings please?
translation: 병에 담긴 임플링을 교환할 수 있을까요?

english: Could you store some equipment for me?
translation: 장비 좀 맡아 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you tell me about the wheat?
Yes
No
Can I buy a few impling jars?
translation: 임플링 병을 몇 개 살 수 있을까요?

english: Hello dearie! What can old Elsie do for you?
translation: 어서 오렴, 아가! 이 늙은 Elsie(엘시)가 뭘 해 주면 좋겠니?

english: What are you making?
I'm knitting a new stole for Father Lawrence downstairs. He could do with something to keep his neck warm, standing in that draughty old church all day.
translation: 아래층에 계신 Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님께 드릴 새 목도리를 뜨고 있단다. 그 외풍 심한 낡은 교회에 하루 종일 서 계시니, 목을 따뜻하게 해 줄 게 있으면 좋을 것 같아서 말이야.

english: Can you tell me a story?
Maybe I could tell you a story if you'd fetch me a nice cup of tea.
translation: 따뜻한 cup of tea(차 한 잔)을 가져다주면 이야기를 하나 해 줄 수도 있지.

english: I'll think about it.
Can you tell me how to get rich?
translation: 부자가 되는 법 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Well, dearie, I'm probably not the best person to ask about money, but I think the best thing would be for you to get a good trade. If you've got a trade you can earn your way, that's what my old father told me,
translation: 글쎄다, 아가야, 돈 얘기라면 나보다 잘 아는 사람이 많겠지만, 제일 좋은 건 번듯한 기술을 하나 익히는 거라고 생각한단다. 기술만 있으면 제 밥벌이는 할 수 있다고, 돌아가신 우리 아버지가 그러셨지.

english: Saradomin rest his soul. I hear people try to get rich by fighting in the Wilderness north of here, but that's no way for honest folks to earn a living! So get yourself a good trade, and keep
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)이시여, 그분의 영혼을 편히 쉬게 하소서. 여기 북쪽 Wilderness(황야)에서 싸워 부자가 되려는 사람들도 있다던데, 그건 정직한 사람이 먹고살 방법이 못 돼! 그러니 좋은 기술을 익혀서 꾸준히

english: working at it. There's always folks wanting to buy ore and food around here.
translation: 갈고닦으렴. 이 근처엔 광석이랑 음식을 사려는 사람들이 늘 있거든.

english: Thanks, old woman.
Ooh - that looks like a lovely cup of tea, dearie. Is it for me?
translation: 어머 - 맛있어 보이는 차 한 잔이구나, 아가. 나 주려고 가져온 거니?

english: Well, maybe I could tell you a story if you'd give me that lovely cup of tea you've got there.
translation: 글쎄, 네가 들고 있는 그 맛있는 차 한 잔을 나한테 주면 이야기를 하나 해 줄 수도 있지.

english: Yes, you can have it.
Ahh, there's nothing like a nice cuppa tea. I know what, I'll tell you a story to thank you for the lovely tea...
translation: 아, 따뜻한 차 한 잔만 한 게 없지. 그래, 맛있는 차를 준 보답으로 이야기를 하나 해 주마...

english: A long time ago, when I was a little girl, there was a handsome young man living in Varrock. I saw him here in the church quite often. Everyone said he was going to become a priest, and we girls were so sad about that.
translation: 옛날 옛적, 내가 어린 소녀였을 때 Varrock(바록)에 잘생긴 청년이 하나 살았단다. 여기 교회에서 그 사람을 자주 봤지. 다들 그 청년이 사제가 될 거라고 했고, 우리 여자애들은 그게 얼마나 슬펐는지 몰라.

english: But young Dissy - that was the young man's nickname - he was a wild young thing. One night he gathered some lads together, and after the evening prayer- meeting they all put on masks and sneaked down to the
translation: 그런데 젊은 Dissy(디시)는, 그게 그 청년 별명이었는데, 아주 혈기 왕성한 녀석이었어. 어느 날 밤 사내애들을 모아서는 저녁 기도회가 끝난 뒤 다 같이 가면을 쓰고 몰래

english: evil temple in the south of the city, the evil one. The next day, there was quite a hubbub. The guards told us that someone had painted 'Saradomin pwns' on the wall of the Zamorakian temple!
translation: 도시 남쪽에 있는 사악한 신전, 그 못된 곳으로 내려갔지. 다음 날 아주 난리가 났어. 경비병들 말로는 누가 Zamorakian(자모락파) 신전 벽에 '사라도민 짱'이라고 칠해 놨다는 거야!

english: Now, we'd always been taught to keep well away from that dreadful place, but it really did us all good to see someone wasn't afraid of the scum who live at that end of town. Old Father Packett was furious, but Dissy just
translation: 우리는 늘 그 끔찍한 곳에는 얼씬도 말라고 배웠지만, 동네 그쪽 끝에 사는 쓰레기 같은 놈들을 겁내지 않는 사람이 있다는 걸 보니 다들 속이 다 후련했단다. 늙은 Father Packett(패킷 신부)님은 노발대발하셨지만, Dissy(디시)는 그냥

english: laughed it off.
Dissy left town after that, saying he wanted to see the world. It was such a shame, he had the most handsome shoulders...
translation: 그 일이 있고 나서 Dissy(디시)는 세상을 보고 싶다며 마을을 떠났어. 정말 아쉬웠지, 어깨가 얼마나 멋졌는데...

english: A young man came here looking for stories about Dissy - of course, that's not his proper name, but his friends called him Dissy - and I told him that one. He said Dissy had become a really famous man and there was
translation: 어떤 젊은이가 Dissy(디시) 이야기를 찾아 여기 왔길래, 물론 그게 본명은 아니고 친구들이 디시라고 불렀던 거지만, 그 이야기를 해 줬단다. 그 젊은이 말로는 디시가 아주 유명한 사람이 됐고

english: going to be a book about him. Well, that's all good, but I do wish Dissy had just come back to Varrock. I did miss him so much... well, until I met my Freddie and we got married, but that's another story.
translation: 그 사람에 대한 책도 나올 거라더구나. 뭐, 그것도 좋지만, Dissy(디시)가 그냥 Varrock(바록)으로 돌아왔으면 좋았을 텐데. 얼마나 보고 싶었는지 몰라... 뭐, 우리 Freddie(프레디)를 만나서 결혼하기 전까지는 말이야. 하지만 그건 또 다른 이야기란다.

english: Thank you. I'll leave you to your knitting now.
No, keep your hands off my tea.
Aww. Maybe another time. Anyway, what can old Elsie do for you?
translation: 아이고. 다음에 주렴. 그나저나, 이 늙은 Elsie(엘시)가 뭘 해 주면 좋겠니?

english: What are you making?
Can you tell me a story?
Can you tell me how to get rich?
translation: 부자가 되는 법 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Yes, you can have it.
No, keep your hands off my tea.
Hello!
Hello, what an exquisite day.
It's lovely round here.
I simply can't wait to enter The Nutcracker.
translation: The Nutcracker(호두까기)에 나갈 날만 손꼽아 기다리고 있어요.

english: I've been training for quite some time.
Oh yeah?
Indeed.
In fact, I haven't slept for twelve days. HA.
A... are you okay?
Better than ever!
Who's your little friend?
This is Gizmo, a dear friend of mine.
What a lovely name, he sure is handsome.
No u.
Ooooo Ah Ah oooOOO.
What did he say?
He said...
Let me think here...
Okay Oo is Aah, and OOO is oh...
I think he just said hello.
Oh he's awesome.
Before I go, I think I heard Santa saying you aren't allowed things on your back in the games.
translation: 가기 전에 말인데요, 경기에서는 등에 아무것도 메면 안 된다고 Santa(산타)가 하는 말을 들은 것 같아요.

english: Don't worry about us [player name]. We are sneaky.
translation: 저희 걱정은 마세요, [player name]님. 저희는 잘 안 들키거든요.

english: Good luck and Happy holidays!
Hey [player name], good to see you.
And you Eluned.
You don't seem to have any crystals I can enchant. Return when you do.
translation: 마법을 걸어 드릴 크리스탈이 없으신 것 같네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Hey [player name], do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님. teleport crystal(순간이동 크리스탈)에 마법을 다시 걸어 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
I ask [charge price] coins to cover my costs.
Thank you.
No thanks.
Yes please.
Yes - [charge price] coins.
They'll be in Prifddinas of course. With the city restored there's not much reason for them to come out here.
translation: 당연히 Prifddinas(프리프디나스)에 있겠죠. 도시가 복구됐으니 굳이 여기까지 나올 이유가 별로 없거든요.

english: They'll be in the Underground Pass, preparing for the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: Underground Pass(지하 통로)에서 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)와의 싸움을 준비하고 있을 거예요.

english: But I need someone to re-enchant my teleport crystal.
translation: 그래도 teleport crystal(순간이동 크리스탈)에 마법을 다시 걸어 줄 사람이 필요한데요.

english: Well I can do that if you want.
translation: 원하시면 제가 해 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Yes please.
I ask [charge price] coins to cover my costs.
Thank you.
No thanks.
Yes please.
Yes - [charge price] coins.
No thanks.
Hi.
Hello again. Do you need something?
translation: 또 오셨네요. 뭐 필요한 거 있어요?

english: No thanks.
Well I'm afraid I can't stop to talk right now. Lots to do.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 얘기할 틈이 없어요. 할 일이 산더미거든요.

english: Could I buy something?
Of course.
What are you doing?
I have this potion which I thought might help ease your itching.
translation: 가려움을 좀 덜어 줄 것 같은 potion(물약)을 가져왔어요.

english: If I thought that these spots could be cured by some potion, I would have mixed up one for myself before now.
translation: 이 반점이 물약 따위로 나을 거였으면, 진작에 제가 하나 만들어 먹었겠죠.

english: Sorry... I was just trying to help.
Could I buy something?
No thanks.
Don't suppose you've come across any strange emblems or artefacts along your journey? Ancient artefacts?
translation: 혹시 여행하다가 이상한 emblem(엠블럼)이나 artefact(유물)을 본 적 없나요? 고대 유물 말이에요.

english: Nothing to report now.
If you find any, please bring them to me. I am happy to offer rewards for such items.
translation: 혹시 찾게 되면 저한테 가져와 주세요. 그런 물건이라면 기꺼이 보상을 드리죠.

english: Let's trade for rewards.
I don't carry rewards out here, it is far too dangerous.
translation: 이런 바깥에는 보상을 들고 다니지 않아요. 너무 위험하거든요.

english: Meet me in Daimon's Crater if you would like to buy rewards.
translation: 보상을 사고 싶으면 Daimon's Crater(다이몬의 분화구)에서 만나요.

english: Can I have a PK skull, please?
translation: PK skull(PK 해골)을 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I'll leave you alone.
Hello, wanderer. How may I help you?
What is this place?

This is Daimon's Crater. Once, it was home to a group of demons who set up a fortress inside this dormant volcano to mine rare minerals. However, their activity reactivated the volcano, resulting in their demise.
translation: 여기는 Daimon's Crater(다이몬의 분화구)예요. 옛날에 한 무리의 악마들이 희귀한 광물을 캐려고 이 휴화산 안에 요새를 세웠죠. 그런데 그 채굴 작업 때문에 화산이 다시 깨어났고, 결국 그들은 최후를 맞았어요.

english: Years later, humans settled in the ruins. Convinced that they were the descendants of the demons, they began to hunt each other for fun.
translation: 몇 년 뒤, 인간들이 그 폐허에 자리를 잡았어요. 자기들이 그 악마들의 후손이라고 믿게 된 그들은 재미 삼아 서로를 사냥하기 시작했죠.

english: Today, the crater is home to Bounty Hunter, a magnificent battle arena where you can engage in combat and test your mettle against skilled opponents.
translation: 오늘날 이 분화구에는 Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터)가 있어요. 실력 있는 상대들과 맞붙어 자신의 기량을 시험해 볼 수 있는 웅장한 전투 경기장이죠.

english: How do I play Bounty Hunter?
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터)는 어떻게 하는 거예요?

english: Before entering the arena, ensure that you have enough coins in your Coffer to participate. Upon entering, you will be assigned a Target to fight.
translation: 경기장에 들어가기 전에 Coffer(금고)에 참가할 만큼 코인이 충분히 있는지 확인하세요. 들어가면 싸울 Target(표적)이 정해질 거예요.

english: Locate your Targets and engage them in combat, defeating them to claim your reward.
translation: Target(표적)을 찾아 전투를 벌이고, 쓰러뜨려서 보상을 받으세요.

english: That sounds easy enough.
If you require further information about the Bounty Hunter, feel free to ask the Corrupted Warrior. They will be able to answer any questions you may have.
translation: Bounty Hunter(바운티 헌터)에 대해 더 알고 싶으면 Corrupted Warrior(타락한 전사)에게 편하게 물어보세요. 궁금한 건 뭐든 답해 줄 거예요.

translation: 어느 레벨의 Target(표적)이 정해질 수 있나요?

translation: 당신보다 최대 [value]레벨 높은 Target(표적)이 정해질 수 있어요.

Not that it makes much difference but my name's Emilia. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 별로 중요한 건 아니지만 제 이름은 Emilia(에밀리아)예요. 여기 있는 다른 생존자들처럼 저도 그냥 근근이 버티면서 하루하루 살아가고 있어요.

It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 너무 고마워요.

Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyre(뱀파이어)들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일) 한 잔 주세요.

Thanks, Emily.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.

english: Can I have a Dwarven Stout?

english: I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: 관심 있으면 코인 두어 개에 사 줄게요.

english: Okay, sure.
There you go.
Thanks!
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
I've got these beer glasses...
Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 오, 관심 있으면 우리가 사 줄게요. 한 잔에 2코인이에요.

Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: 소식 들었어요? 누가 큰 파티를 열려고 한대요!

Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!

translation: 안녕하세요. 바로 본론으로 가죠. 저한테는 가위가 있고, 당신한테는 머리카락이 있어요. 해 볼래요?

english: I'd like a haircut please.

english: Who are you?
My name is Emma. I LOVE hair! There are so many cool things you can do with it.
translation: 제 이름은 Emma(에마)예요. 저는 머리카락이 너무 좋아요! 머리카락으로 할 수 있는 멋진 게 정말 많거든요.

translation: 받게 된다네. 이 포인트로 위층에 있는 내 동료 수호자에게서 여러 가지 아이템을 받을 수 있지.

english: How do you record the points I have earned?
You really are full of questions! You will need a special Pizazz Progress Hat! I can give you one if you so wish to train here.
translation: 자네는 정말 궁금한 게 많구먼! 특별한 Pizazz Progress Hat(피자즈 진행 모자)가 있어야 하네! 여기서 훈련하고 싶다면 하나 주겠네.

english: Yes please!
Ah, I'm afraid I can't give it to you as you don't have room to carry it!
translation: 아, 미안하지만 자네 소지품에 자리가 없어서 줄 수가 없겠네!

english: Here you go. Talk to the hat to find out your current Pizazz Point totals.
translation: 여기 있네. 모자에게 말을 걸면 지금까지 모은 Pizazz Point(피자즈 포인트) 합계를 알 수 있다네.

english: Talk to it?
Well of course, it's a magic Pizazz Progress Hat! Mind your manners though, hats have feelings too!
translation: 물론이지, 마법의 Pizazz Progress Hat(피자즈 진행 모자)니까! 그래도 예의는 지키게. 모자도 감정이 있다네!

english: Er... if you insist.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave the rooms by any method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 아, 그리고 주의할 게 하나 있네. 출구 포털이 아닌 다른 방법으로 방을 떠나면 입구로 순간이동되고, 그 방에서 주운 아이템은 모두 사라진다네.

english: Can you explain the different portals?
They lead to four areas to train your magic: The Telekinetic Theatre, The Alchemists' Playground, The Enchanting Chamber, and The Creature Graveyard.
translation: 마법을 훈련할 수 있는 네 구역으로 이어지네. Telekinetic Theatre(염력 극장), Alchemists' Playground(연금술사의 놀이터), Enchanting Chamber(마법 부여실), 그리고 Creature Graveyard(생물 묘지)일세.

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
In there you can earn Telekinetic Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 그곳에선 위층에서 거래할 수 있는 Telekinetic Pizazz Points(염력 피자즈 포인트)를 모을 수 있네.

english: What will I be doing in there?

That depends on how much of a time-waster you are! You are required to use the Telekinetic Grab spell in order to move a statue through a maze. Casting the spell will move the statue towards you until it reaches
translation: 그거야 자네가 얼마나 시간을 허비하느냐에 달렸지! Telekinetic Grab(텔레키네틱 그랩) 주문을 써서 조각상을 미로 속에서 옮겨야 하네. 주문을 걸면 조각상이 자네 쪽으로 움직이는데,

english: a wall. So by standing on the different sides of the maze you can move the statue North, East, South or West. You will be rewarded Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved.
translation: 벽에 닿을 때까지 움직이지. 그러니 미로의 여러 방향에 서서 조각상을 북, 동, 남, 서쪽으로 옮길 수 있네. 미로를 하나 풀 때마다 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 받게 될 걸세.

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. There's a book you can buy from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 가 보면 더 분명해질 거네. 포털 너머에 있는 Guardian(수호자)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 걸세. 위층의 Rewards Guardian(보상 수호자)에게서 모든 걸 설명해 주는 책도 살 수 있네.

english: What's the Alchemists' Playground?
In the playground you can earn Alchemist Pizazz Points for trading with the rewards guardian upstairs.
translation: 그 놀이터에선 위층의 보상 수호자와 거래할 수 있는 Alchemist Pizazz Points(연금술사 피자즈 포인트)를 모을 수 있네.

english: What's in there?

You'll find eight cupboards containing items you can turn to gold using the low and high alchemy spells. The money you earn will be taken from you upon leaving the playground to pay for the upkeep of this training
translation: 찬장이 여덟 개 있는데, 그 안의 아이템을 low alchemy(로우 알케미)와 high alchemy(하이 알케미) 주문으로 골드로 바꿀 수 있네. 번 돈은 놀이터를 떠날 때 거둬들여서 이 훈련

english: arena and to help fund magic shops around Gielinor. You will be rewarded with 1 Pizazz Point for every 100 coins deposited and a percentage of the money you create. Keep in mind that you will not be able to take
translation: 경기장을 유지하고 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳의 마법 상점을 지원하는 데 쓴다네. 맡긴 돈 100코인마다 Pizazz Point(피자즈 포인트) 1점과 만든 돈의 일부를 받게 되지. 명심하게, 가지고 나갈 수 있는 돈은

english: more than 1000 coins back out with you.
Sounds simple.
I am afraid not, for the cost of the items varies, as does their locations in the cupboards. You'll see a list of item costs that will help you decide what you should be converting to gold.
translation: 안타깝지만 그렇지 않네. 아이템 가격도 바뀌고, 찬장 속 위치도 바뀌거든. 아이템 가격 목록이 보일 테니 무엇을 골드로 바꿀지 정하는 데 도움이 될 걸세.

english: Fear not, it will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 걱정 말게, 가 보면 더 분명해질 거네. 포털 너머에 있는 Guardian(수호자)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 걸세. 위층의 Rewards Guardian(보상 수호자)에게서 모든 걸 설명해 주는 책도 살 수 있네.

english: What's the Enchanting Chamber?
In here you will be able to earn Enchantment Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 그곳에선 위층에서 거래할 수 있는 Enchantment Pizazz Points(마법 부여 피자즈 포인트)를 모을 수 있네.

english: What will I have to do?

You will find yourself amongst various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and use one of your enchanting spells upon it to morph it into an orb. You'll also see a hole in the centre of the room; put the orbs
translation: 여러 가지 도형 더미 사이에 서게 될 걸세. 그 도형을 주워서 마법 부여 주문을 걸면 오브로 바뀌지. 방 한가운데에 구멍도 하나 보일 텐데, 오브를

english: in here and for every 20 we will credit you with a gift. You will get Pizazz Points for every 10 shapes that you convert and the amount of points depends on the spell you use.
translation: 거기에 넣으면 20개마다 선물을 주겠네. 도형을 10개 바꿀 때마다 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 받는데, 포인트 양은 쓰는 주문에 따라 다르다네.

english: What's the difference between the shapes?

Ah, you will be notified of a different shape that will give you a bonus Pizazz Point when you convert that shape. You should also look out for dragon stones, as these will give you more Pizazz Points when you
translation: 아, 보너스 Pizazz Point(피자즈 포인트)를 주는 도형은 그때그때 바뀌는데, 어떤 도형인지는 알려 줄 걸세. dragon stones(드래곤스톤)도 눈여겨보게. 그걸

english: convert them.
translation: 바꾸면 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 더 많이 받는다네.

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and there's a Guardian through the portal that will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 가 보면 더 분명해질 거네. 포털 너머에 있는 Guardian(수호자)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 걸세. 위층의 Rewards Guardian(보상 수호자)에게서 모든 걸 설명해 주는 책도 살 수 있네.

english: What's the Creature Graveyard?
In here you will be able to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points for trade upstairs.
translation: 그곳에선 위층에서 거래할 수 있는 Graveyard Pizazz Points(묘지 피자즈 포인트)를 모을 수 있네.

english: But what do I have to do in there?

Patience young one. A great many creatures die in this world and much of their remains can cause clutter. We have taken it upon ourselves to teleport many bones from these creatures into this graveyard for a
translation: 진득하게 기다리게, 젊은이. 이 세상에선 수많은 생물이 죽고, 그 유해가 여기저기 어지럽게 쌓이곤 하지. 그래서 우리가 그런 생물들의 뼈를 잔뜩 이 묘지로 순간이동시켜 오기로 했다네. 쓸 데가 있거든.

english: use. It's up to you to practice your bones to bananas spell in order to put these bones into immediate use - nutritious food for monsters! Just convert the bones and put them in the holes in the walls. There is a
translation: bones to bananas(본즈 투 바나나스) 주문을 연습해서 이 뼈들을 당장 쓸모 있게 만드는 건 자네 몫일세. 몬스터를 위한 영양 만점 음식이지! 뼈를 바꿔서 벽에 난 구멍에 넣기만 하면 되네. 다만

english: drawback to this room however, the bones often fall on people so you may want to eat some of those bananas to stay alive. When people die we confiscate Pizazz Points for the effort of teleporting incompetent mages.
translation: 이 방엔 단점이 하나 있지. 뼈가 사람들 위로 자주 떨어지니, 살아남으려면 바나나를 좀 먹어 두는 게 좋을 걸세. 누가 죽으면 무능한 마법사를 순간이동시킨 수고비로 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 몰수한다네.

english: What else do I get from this besides bruises?
translation: 멍드는 것 말고 거기서 또 뭘 얻을 수 있어요?

english: As well as the Pizazz Points for giving us the bananas, you will be credited with runestones for your efforts, and you may be able to save up for a new kind of spell to use in the graveyard!
translation: 바나나를 넘겨준 대가로 받는 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)뿐 아니라 수고비로 룬스톤도 받게 되네. 포인트를 모으면 묘지에서 쓸 새로운 주문도 얻을 수 있을 걸세!

english: It will be clearer when you arrive and one of my fellow guardians through the portal will be able to tell you more. You can also buy a book from the Rewards Guardian upstairs that will explain it all.
translation: 가 보면 더 분명해질 거네. 포털 너머에 있는 내 동료 수호자가 더 자세히 알려 줄 걸세. 위층의 Rewards Guardian(보상 수호자)에게서 모든 걸 설명해 주는 책도 살 수 있네.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you have learned.
None, I don't really care.
You won't gain with that attitude.
translation: 그런 태도로는 얻는 게 없을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me about this place again?

Very well. You have entered the magic training arena. It was built at the start of the Fifth Age, when runestones were first discovered. It was built to put an end to many pointless accidents involving inexperienced
translation: 좋네. 자네는 Magic Training Arena(마법 훈련 경기장)에 들어왔네. 이곳은 룬스톤이 처음 발견된 Fifth Age(제5시대) 초에 세워졌지. 미숙한

english: You may train up your skill in the magic arts by travelling through one of the portals at the back of this building. By training up in one of these areas you will be awarded Pizazz Points unique to each room. With
translation: 이 건물 뒤편에 있는 포털 중 하나를 지나가면 마법 기술을 단련할 수 있네. 그 구역들 중 한 곳에서 훈련하면 방마다 고유한 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 받게 된다네.

english: these points you may claim a variety of items from my fellow guardian up the stairs.
translation: 이 포인트로 위층에 있는 내 동료 수호자에게서 여러 가지 아이템을 받을 수 있지.

english: How do you record the Pizazz Points I have earned?
translation: 제가 얻은 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)는 어떻게 기록하나요?

english: With the Pizazz Progress Hat I gave you, of course.
translation: 물론 내가 준 Pizazz Progress Hat(피자즈 진행 모자)로 하지.

english: OK.
Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to log out whilst in any of the rooms in the arena, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 아, 그리고 주의할 게 하나 있네. 경기장 안의 방에 있는 동안 로그아웃하면 입구로 순간이동되고, 그 방에서 주운 아이템은 모두 사라진다네.

english: You want another one don't you.
Sorry, can I?
translation: 죄송해요, 하나 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes. What's it for?
translation: 네. 그런데 그건 어디에 쓰는 거예요?

english: Collect Pizazz Points from the various areas and the hat will remember your totals. Talk to the hat at any time to find out what points you have. Go upstairs and talk to the Rewards Guardian to claim items for the
translation: 여러 구역에서 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 모으면 모자가 합계를 기억해 둔다네. 언제든 모자에게 말을 걸면 포인트를 확인할 수 있지. 위층으로 올라가 Rewards Guardian(보상 수호자)에게 말을 걸면 포인트로

english: points.
I'm new to this place. Where am I?
translation: 여기 처음 와 봐요. 여기가 어디예요?

english: What's the Telekinetic Theatre?
What's the Alchemists' Playground?
What's the Enchanting Chamber?
What's the Creature Graveyard?
Thanks, bye!
None, I don't really care.
Can you tell me about this place again?
Can you explain the different portals?
About the progress hat...
Hello, thanks for rescuing me. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 구해 주셔서 고마워요. 제가 뭐 해 드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: How did you end up down here?

I travelled down here with my friend Olbertus in search for treasure. When we didn't find anything except his strange structure, he decided to prise off a coin from the stone relief in the other room. Before I knew it the entrance had closed and I was stuck down here.
translation: 친구 Olbertus(올베르투스)랑 보물을 찾으러 여기까지 내려왔어요. 이 이상한 구조물 말고는 아무것도 못 찾자, 그 친구가 옆방의 stone relief(돌 부조)에서 코인을 하나 떼어 내기로 했죠. 정신을 차려 보니 입구가 닫혀서 여기 갇혀 버렸어요.

english: I tried calling out to Olbertus but he must not have heard me. I don't know what would've happened if you hadn't shown up and saved me.
translation: Olbertus(올베르투스)를 불러 봤는데 못 들었나 봐요. 당신이 나타나서 구해 주지 않았으면 어떻게 됐을지 모르겠어요.

english: Well, it turns out Olbertus was corrupted by the coin he stole, I managed to get the coin from him and returned it to the relief, he should be fine now.
translation: 알고 보니 Olbertus(올베르투스)는 자기가 훔친 코인 때문에 타락했던 거였어요. 제가 그에게서 코인을 되찾아 부조에 돌려놨으니 이제 괜찮을 거예요.

english: That's good news at least.
I am quite the proficient tanner, for helping me escape I will offer to tan hides for you. However, they'll be at a slightly higher cost for the convenience of being closer to the source.
translation: 제가 꽤 솜씨 좋은 무두장이거든요. 탈출을 도와주셨으니 가죽을 무두질해 드릴게요. 다만 가죽이 나오는 곳 가까이 있는 편리함 값으로 가격은 조금 더 받을게요.

english: Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
To be honest, I tried to set up a Tannery on the surface but business was poor, there aren't a lot of dragons in Kourend.
translation: 솔직히 말하면 지상에 무두질 가게를 차려 봤는데 장사가 안됐어요. Kourend(쿠렌드)엔 드래곤이 별로 없거든요.

english: I even heard a rumour that people have learned to tan hides with magic. It's always the same! Magic users stealing jobs from honest tradesman!
translation: 심지어 사람들이 마법으로 가죽을 무두질하는 법을 익혔다는 소문까지 들었어요. 늘 이런 식이라니까요! 마법 쓰는 사람들이 정직한 장인들 일자리를 빼앗는다고요!

english: Erm... Yeah! Those magic users...
Oh, wow! I can see why that wouldn't help business.
translation: 와, 그럼 장사에 도움이 안 되겠네요.

english: Anyway, I figured if I was closer to the source of the hides then I might get more business. So I'll try setting up shop down here for a while.
translation: 아무튼, 가죽이 나오는 곳 가까이 있으면 손님이 더 올 것 같아서요. 그래서 당분간은 여기 아래에 가게를 차려 보려고요.

english: How did you end up down here?
Now that you're free, why don't you leave?
Can you tan some hides for me?
I'm good thanks.
Hi!
Hi, can I help?
Welcome to Burthorpe Castle! Home to his Royal Highness the Prince of Burthorpe, Heir to the Throne of Asgarnia!
translation: Burthorpe Castle(버소프 성)에 오신 것을 환영합니다! Asgarnia(아스가르니아)의 왕위 계승자이신 버소프의 왕자 전하께서 머무시는 곳이지요!

english: Wow!
Anything else I can help you with?
Where is the prince?
We do not disclose his majesty's business.
Do you have any quests for me?
Yes actually I do, we need another servant.
translation: 네, 마침 있습니다. 하인이 한 명 더 필요하거든요.

english: Does this noble quest have a name?
Yes, it's the... er... Empty the Cesspit Quest!
translation: 네, 그건... 어... 오물 구덩이 비우기 퀘스트입니다!

english: I'll give it a miss!
No, I'm just looking around.
I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
There was only one guard on last night. Harold. He's a nice lad, if a little dim.
translation: 어젯밤 근무한 경비병은 한 명뿐이었습니다. Harold(해럴드)라고, 좀 둔하긴 해도 착한 친구예요.

english: Do you know where he is staying?
translation: 그 사람이 어디 묵고 있는지 아세요?

english: Harold is staying at the Toad and Chicken.
translation: Harold(해럴드)는 Toad and Chicken(두꺼비와 닭)에 묵고 있습니다.

english: Thanks!
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길을 아세요?

english: No, sorry. I wouldn't want to go north-east from here, it's very rocky and barren.
translation: 아뇨, 죄송합니다. 저라면 여기서 북동쪽으로는 가지 않겠어요. 바위투성이에 황량한 곳이거든요.

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: 어젯밤에 근무한 경비병은 어디 묵고 있어요?

english: Harold is staying at the local inn, the Toad and Chicken.
translation: Harold(해럴드)는 이 동네 여관인 Toad and Chicken(두꺼비와 닭)에 묵고 있습니다.

english: I found Harold but he won't talk to me!
translation: Harold(해럴드)를 찾았는데 저랑 말을 안 하려고 해요!

english: Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?
translation: 흠. Harold(해럴드)는 술이랑 도박 때문에 몇 번 말썽을 일으킨 적이 있지요. 한잔 들어가면 입을 열지 않을까요?

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
You said Harold had a weakness?
Yes, if you buy Harold a beer he might talk to you. I also know he has a weakness for gambling. Hope that helps!
translation: 네, Harold(해럴드)에게 beer(맥주)를 한 잔 사 주면 말을 할지도 모릅니다. 도박에도 사족을 못 쓰는 걸로 알고 있고요. 도움이 되면 좋겠네요!

english: Thanks for the help!
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
What is this castle?
Where is the prince?
Do you have any quests for me?
No, I'm just looking around.
I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길을 아세요?

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: 어젯밤에 근무한 경비병은 어디 묵고 있어요?

english: Hello.
Sorry, I cannot stop or Iona will catch me, we are playing tag!
translation: 미안해요, 멈추면 Iona(아이오나)한테 잡혀요. 우리 술래잡기 하는 중이거든요!

english: Thank you for saving me. Mummy says you're a hero after what you did.
translation: 구해 줘서 고마워요. 엄마가 그러는데, 그런 일을 했으니 영웅이래요.

english: Hello.
Good day. What can I help you with?
I would like to buy some equipment.
Who are you?
Well, you must be a new arrival. I am Erdan, a descendant of Uhld.
translation: 흠, 자네 새로 왔나 보군. 나는 Uhld(울드)의 후손인 Erdan(에르단)일세.

english: Uhld? I've seen that inscribed on that big old statue down below. What's that about?
translation: Uhld(울드)요? 저 아래 커다란 낡은 조각상에 새겨진 걸 봤어요. 그게 뭐예요?

english: It's also on the fountain in the dungeon below, it displays their emblem.
translation: 아래 던전에 있는 분수에도 새겨져 있지. 그들의 문장이 그려져 있다네.

english: Whose emblem?
The Sect of Uhld, the founders of this here guild. I may not have gained entrance to this guild in the usual fashion, but I'd expect that they'd at least inform new members of this guild's history.
translation: Sect of Uhld(울드 교단), 바로 이 길드를 세운 이들일세. 나야 보통 방식으로 이 길드에 들어온 건 아니지만, 적어도 새 회원들에게 길드의 역사 정도는 알려 줄 줄 알았는데 말이야.

english: Perhaps they expected you, a descendant of Uhld, to fill me in on the matter.
translation: Uhld(울드)의 후손인 당신이 저한테 설명해 줄 거라고 생각했나 보죠.

english: Aye, that may well be the case.
Look, I'm awfully busy, what with the recent influx of members, so I'll give you the short version for now.
translation: 이보게, 요즘 회원이 부쩍 늘어서 내가 무척 바쁘니 일단은 짧게 말해 주겠네.

english: Fair enough.
The story my father told me was of a war on magic. Of god fearing men who believed nothing good would come of wielding a power that was never meant for them.
translation: 아버지께 들은 이야기는 마법을 상대로 한 전쟁이었지. 신을 두려워하는 사람들이, 애초에 자기들 몫이 아니었던 힘을 휘둘러 봤자 좋을 게 없다고 믿었다네.

english: And so the rune temples that man had created were under threat. Before long, all were destroyed and thus forgotten.
translation: 그래서 사람들이 만든 룬 신전들이 위협을 받았지. 머지않아 모두 파괴되어 잊히고 말았다네.

english: But the wrath that these Gunnites embraced rippled through the pocket dimensions. Supposedly, a new altar of power was discovered.
translation: 하지만 이 Gunnites(군나이트)들이 품은 분노가 포켓 차원들까지 퍼져 나갔지. 듣자 하니 그때 새로운 힘의 제단이 발견되었다고 하더군.

english: The wrath altar?
Indeed. The temple was destroyed just as construction had finished, and a nearby nomadic group called the Sect of Uhld were not pleased with the brutality they witnessed.
translation: 그렇지. 그 신전은 건설이 막 끝났을 때 파괴되었고, 근처의 유목민 무리인 Sect of Uhld(울드 교단)은 자기들이 목격한 잔혹함을 못마땅하게 여겼다네.

english: They quickly established this guild with information preservation as their core goal, for men are recorders of history and magic is key for this to last.
translation: 그들은 서둘러 이 길드를 세웠고, 정보 보존을 핵심 목표로 삼았지. 사람은 역사를 기록하는 존재이고, 그 기록이 오래 남으려면 마법이 꼭 필요하니까.

english: Did the... er, Gunnites, return?
Of course they did, but the Sect of Uhld had used the information gained from the wrath altar, and with a spell of their own making, they destroyed the southern runecrafting crusade with much ease.
translation: 물론 돌아왔지. 하지만 Sect of Uhld(울드 교단)은 분노의 제단에서 얻은 지식을 활용해, 직접 만든 주문으로 남쪽에서 온 룬 제작 토벌군을 손쉽게 무찔렀다네.

english: Huh, that's fascinating.
Indeed it is, but I best get back to work, so unless you wish to trade, that is all.
translation: 그렇고말고. 하지만 이제 일하러 돌아가야겠네. 거래할 게 아니라면 이야기는 여기까지일세.

english: Thanks for the history lesson, Erdan.
No problem!
I'll be off.
Just passing by.
As you wish.
I would like to buy some equipment.
Who are you?
I'll be off.
Just passing by.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 날씨가 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hello, I'm the tax collector. Got any windows I can tax?
translation: 안녕하세요, 세금 징수원이에요. 세금 매길 창문 있어요?

english: I dream of windows.
Hello, I'm the tax collector. I'm taxing beards and I can't help noticing you have a beard.
translation: 안녕하세요, 세금 징수원이에요. 수염에 세금을 매기고 있는데 수염이 있으시네요.

english: What? I'm a beggar. Do I look as if I have any money? Look, take everything I own why don't you?
translation: 뭐? 난 거지야. 내가 돈 있는 사람처럼 보여? 그래, 아예 내 전 재산을 다 가져가지 그래?

english: Err, thanks. Maybe I don't need to tax you.
translation: 어, 고마워요. 당신한테는 세금 안 매겨도 되겠네요.

english: No, take it!
I don't care any more.
Spare us a few coppers [mister/miss]
No, go away!
Ooh, I'm all dizzy...
Why's that?
Well, watching that wheel go round and round and round...
translation: 그게, 저 물레가 돌고 돌고 또 도는 걸 보고 있었더니...

english: and round and round and round...
Looks like you need a bit of a rest.
and round and round and round again...
See you around!
Very funny.
Ahhh. Thank you, I'll take few minutes from spinning to enjoy this.
translation: 아아. 고마워요, 물레 돌리는 건 잠깐 쉬고 이걸 즐겨야겠어요.

english: Here you go, you solved it!
Thank you [sir/m'lady]. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 감사합니다, [sir/m'lady]. 닭으로 지내는 건 정말 지긋지긋했습니다. 이 은혜를 어떻게 갚아야 할까요?

english: Well a cash reward is always nice...
Of course, of course.
Hello there.
Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: 꺼져! 술 좀 조용히 마시게 놔둬!

english: Okay then.
Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
translation: 안녕하세요. Gielinor Housing Agency(길리노르 주택 중개소)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: How can I get a house?
I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for 1000 coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated in other styles.
translation: Rimmington(림밍턴)에 있는 초보자용 집을 1000코인에 팔아 드릴 수 있어요. 건설 스킬이 오르면 집을 다른 지역으로 옮기고 다른 양식으로 새로 꾸밀 수도 있어요.

english: Do you want to buy a starter house?
Yes please!
I haven't got 1,000 coins on me.
Well come back when you have it then.
Thank you. Go through the Rimmington house portal and you will find your house ready for you to start building in it.
translation: 감사합니다. Rimmington(림밍턴)의 집 포털로 들어가시면 바로 건설을 시작할 수 있게 집이 준비되어 있을 거예요.

english: This book will help you to start building your house.
translation: 이 책이 집 짓기를 시작하는 데 도움이 될 거예요.

english: No thanks.
Well enjoy your player-owned cardboard box or wherever you're going to sleep tonight!
translation: 그럼 플레이어 소유 골판지 상자든 어디든, 오늘 밤 주무실 곳에서 즐거운 시간 보내세요!

english: It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
translation: 다 마법사들의 실험에서 나온 거예요. 공간을 접는 방법을 알아내서, 수 에이커나 되는 땅을 폭이 한 자밖에 안 되는 곳에 쑤셔 넣을 수 있게 됐죠.

english: They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
translation: 마법사들은 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 접힌 공간 구역을 여러 개 만들었어요. 구역마다 사람들이 집을 지을 수 있는 작은 부지가 수백 개씩 있죠.

english: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!
translation: 아, 그래서 모두가 집을 가져도 세상이 집으로 가득 차지 않는 거군요!

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 마법사들은 장사 쪽 일로 골치 썩이고 싶지 않아서 저를 고용해 집을 팔게 했어요.

english: There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 집에 가구를 들이는 걸 도와줄 사람들이 여럿 있어요.

english: You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.
translation: 우선 sawmill operator(제재소 일꾼)에게서 판자를 사는 것부터 시작하세요. 제재소는 Varrock(바록) 북동쪽, Hosidius(호시디우스) 남서쪽의 Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드), 그리고 Prifddinas(프리프디나스) 북동쪽에 있어요.

english: Can you move my house please?
translation: 제 집 좀 옮겨 주실 수 있나요?

english: Where would you like it moved to?
To Rimmington please!
Your house is already there!
Hmph. Come back when you have 5,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rimmington.
To Taverley please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 10.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 10이 필요해요.

english: Your house has been moved to Taverley.
To Pollnivneach please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 20.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 20이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 7,500 coins.
Your house has been moved to Pollnivneach.
To Hosidius please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 25.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 25가 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 8,750 coins.
Your house has been moved to Hosidius.
To Rellekka please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 30.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 30이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 10,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rellekka.
To Brimhaven please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 40.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 40이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 15,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Brimhaven.
To Yanille please!
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 50.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 50이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 25,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Yanille.
To Prifddinas please!
Where? Never heard of it.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 70.
translation: 죄송하지만 그곳으로 옮기기엔 Construction(건설) 레벨이 부족해요. 레벨 70이 필요해요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 50,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Prifddinas.
Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: 제 집을 새로 꾸며 주실 수 있나요?

english: Certainly. My magic can rebuild the house in a completely new style! What style would you like?
translation: 물론이죠. 제 마법이면 집을 완전히 새로운 양식으로 다시 지을 수 있어요! 어떤 양식으로 해 드릴까요?

english: Basic wood
Your house is already in that style!
Your house has been redecorated.
I'm afraid you haven't unlocked that style.
translation: 죄송하지만 아직 그 양식을 잠금 해제하지 않으셨어요.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 35,000 coins.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that. Maybe you can buy some by working for the contractors.
translation: 죄송하지만 그건 설계도가 있어야 해요. 건축업자들 일을 해 주면 살 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Absolutely. Hand me your blueprints and I'll make it happen! I'll keep the blueprints, so you'll always be able to switch back to this style in future, for a small fee.
translation: 물론이죠. 설계도를 주시면 바로 해 드릴게요! 설계도는 제가 보관해 둘 테니, 나중에 약간의 수수료만 내면 언제든 이 양식으로 되돌릴 수 있어요.

english: Could I have a Construction guide book?
translation: Construction guide book(건설 안내서) 한 권 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: You've already got one!
Not until you free up some inventory space.
Certainly.
Tell me about houses!
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: 입고 계신 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
translation: 아실지도 모르지만, 스킬 망토는 한 스킬의 달인에게만 주어져요. 저는 평생 집을 지어 왔고 이제는 집을 파는 일을 하고 있죠! 제 실력의 증표로 이 Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 입고 있는 거예요.

english: If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 언젠가 demonic throne(악마의 왕좌)를 만들 만한 실력이 되면 저한테 와서 말씀하세요. 저와 같은 스킬 망토를 팔아 드릴게요.

english: The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
translation: Cape of Construction(건설 망토)를 두르면 어느 집 포털로든, 심지어 집 안으로 곧장 원하는 만큼 순간이동할 수도 있어요!

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 저한테 파실 수 있나요?

english: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
translation: 좋아요, 99000코인 되겠습니다. 어느 집 포털로든, 심지어 집 안으로 곧장 순간이동시켜 주는 이렇게 멋진 망토라면 싼 값이죠!

english: I'm not paying that!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 이걸 사고 싶어 안달 난 영웅들이 얼마든지 있으니까요. 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 찾아오세요.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토에는 무료 두건이 함께 딸려 나와요. 스킬 판촉 행사로 원 플러스 원이거든요. 그러니 팔아 드리기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 입으세요, 친구.

english: How can I get a house?
Yes please!
No thanks
Tell me about houses!
Can you move my house please?
translation: 제 집 좀 옮겨 주실 수 있나요?

english: Rimmington
Taverley
Pollnivneach
Hosidius
Rellekka
Brimhaven
Yanille
Prifddinas
Can you redecorate my house please?
translation: 제 집을 새로 꾸며 주실 수 있나요?

english: Basic stone
Whitewashed stone
Fremennik-style wood
Tropical wood
Fancy stone
Deathly mansion
Twisted theme
Hosidius house
Yes
No
Cosy cabin
Cancel
Could I have a Construction guide book?
translation: Construction guide book(건설 안내서) 한 권 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
translation: 입고 계신 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
translation: Skillcape of Construction(건설 스킬 망토)를 저한테 파실 수 있나요?

english: I'm not paying that!
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Is this place haunted?
I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: 아닐 거예요. 귀신이 나오면 문제가 되나요?

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: 글쎄, 얼마나 나오느냐에 달렸지. 난 유령이라면 질색이거든.

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
translation: 그럼 귀신이 안 나오길 빌어 보죠!

english: Have you thought about painting the building?
translation: 건물에 페인트칠을 할 생각은 해 보셨어요?

english: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: dragon armour(드래곤 갑옷)처럼 강렬한 빨간색이 좋을 것 같은데.

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: 아니면 초록색도 좋겠군. 아주 지독한 드래곤이었던 Elvarg(엘바르그)를 기리는 뜻에서 말이야.

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: 초록색이 정말 잘 어울릴 것 같아요. 주변 풍경하고도 맞고요!

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: 그 rune platebodies(룬 판금 갑옷) 하나 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: 글쎄, 원래는 드래곤부터 한 마리 잡아 와야 내가 파는 건데...

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...여기로 이사 오고 나면 예외로 해 줄 수도 있지.

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: 도와준 데 대한 작은 감사 표시로 말이야!

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: 그럼 정말 좋죠! 어서 이 거래를 마무리해요.

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: 거의 다 됐어요, Oziach(오지아크) 씨. 조금만 더 기다리세요.

english: Do you have any plans for it?
I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: 몇 가지 있지. 꼭대기 층을 술집으로 바꿀까 해!

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: 내가 아는 드래곤 슬레이어들을 위한 곳이야. 우리 같은 사람이 꽤 많거든!

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: 이렇게 아름다운 건물을 참 흥미롭게 쓰시네요!

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
Ah!! Why did you do that?
That scared me!
I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
translation: 죄송해요! 그냥 유령 흉내를 내 본 거예요.

english: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
Hello.
Sorry [player name], I'm talking to Oziach right now.
translation: 죄송해요, [player name]님. 지금 Oziach(오지아크) 씨와 이야기 중이에요.

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: 그래, 나중에 보자고. 빨리 이사 오고 싶군!

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: 그렇죠, 정말 멋진 곳이에요! 또 봬요!

english: The estate agent leaves.
Ahhh... soon to be mine.
The cutscene ends.
A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: 컷신이 시작된다. 부동산 중개인이 도착해 Oziach(오지아크)에게 다가간다.

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
translation: Oziach(오지아크) 씨! 괜찮으세요? 비명 소리가 들렸어요!

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: 왔군! 영 좋지 않아. 여기 유령이 엄청 많아!

english: That's not good at all!
Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: 당연하지! 유령이 둘이나 있는 건 무섭지만, 그렇게까지 무섭진 않아!

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: 요즘 어디서나 보이는 그 슬레이어들 중 한 명을 고용할 거야.

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
translation: 그 사람이 유령 문제를 해결해 줄 거야!

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: 휴, 정말 다행이네요! 거래가 다 물 건너간 줄 알았어요.

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: 저는 사무실로 돌아갈게요. 곧 거기서 뵈어요.

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
Are you here to fight the cold?
Umm... I guess?
Great! Ask me anything you like about the Bruma tree, I'm an expert.
