translation: 잘됐네요! Bruma tree(브루마 나무)에 대해서라면 뭐든 물어보세요. 제가 전문가거든요.

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Some would say that ice preserves while fire destroys, but no amount of fire is destroying the Wintertodt. That's a cold that will freeze the air in your lungs.
translation: 얼음은 보존하고 불은 파괴한다고들 하지만, 아무리 많은 불로도 Wintertodt(윈터토트)는 없앨 수 없어요. 폐 속의 공기마저 얼려 버리는 추위니까요.

english: Even the heat generated from burning the Bruma roots only weakens it, and that doesn't last very long nowadays.
translation: Bruma roots(브루마 뿌리)를 태워서 나오는 열기조차 그걸 약하게 만들 뿐이고, 요즘은 그 효과도 오래가지 않아요.

english: Looks like an angry snow storm to me...
translation: 제가 보기엔 그냥 성난 눈보라 같은데요...

english: What you see in that pit is not the Wintertodt at full strength. It never will be while the Bruma tree still burns and the Doors of Dinh remain closed.
translation: 저 구덩이 속에 보이는 건 온전한 힘을 가진 Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 아니에요. Bruma tree(브루마 나무)가 계속 타오르고 Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)이 닫혀 있는 한 절대 그렇게 되지 않을 거예요.

english: Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: Bruma tree(브루마 나무)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: The Bruma tree is what keeps the Wintertodt weak. The prison was built here by Dinh because of its usefulness against the Wintertodt.
translation: Bruma tree(브루마 나무)는 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 약하게 붙잡아 두는 존재예요. Dinh(딘)이 이곳에 감옥을 지은 것도 이 나무가 윈터토트에 맞서는 데 쓸모가 있었기 때문이죠.

english: Some legends say that Xeric is the cause for the Doors weakening, or maybe he made the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: 어떤 전설에서는 Xeric(제릭)이 그 문이 약해진 원인이라고 해요. 아니면 그가 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 더 강하게 만든 걸까요?

english: Is Xeric really such a bad guy?
It's a known fact that he was interested in the Bruma tree. For what purpose... there are only rumours.
translation: 그가 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)에 관심이 있었다는 건 잘 알려진 사실이에요. 무슨 목적이었는지는... 소문만 무성할 뿐이죠.

english: Regardless, the Bruma tree definitely contains powerful magic. I've been studying the sap for years and it has truly astounding properties.
translation: 어쨌든 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)에 강력한 마법이 깃들어 있는 건 확실해요. 저는 몇 년째 수액을 연구하고 있는데, 정말 놀라운 성질을 지녔어요.

english: There's not many fires that burn green now, are there?
translation: 요즘 초록색으로 타는 불은 별로 없잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: What about gnomish fire lighters?
Tell me about yourself.
Me? I'm a member of the Woodcutting Guild. More of a researcher though... I'm currently tasked with growing a new Bruma tree.
translation: 저요? 저는 Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드) 회원이에요. 그래도 연구원에 더 가깝죠... 지금은 새 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)를 키우는 일을 맡고 있어요.

english: How's that going?
Poorly. I believe the Bruma tree can only be grown in a freezing cold climate.
translation: 영 시원찮아요. Bruma tree(브루마 나무)는 얼어붙을 듯 추운 기후에서만 자랄 수 있는 것 같아요.

english: Well, isn't that here?
translation: 음, 여기가 바로 그런 곳 아닌가요?

english: It's just an idea really. For all I know, it could be magic way beyond me, beyond even the Pyromancers.
translation: 그냥 생각일 뿐이에요. 어쩌면 제 능력을 한참 넘어서는 마법일지도 몰라요. Pyromancers(화염술사)조차 감당 못 할 마법일 수도 있고요.

english: See you later.
Goodbye!
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Bruma tree.
translation: Bruma tree(브루마 나무)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about yourself.
See you later.
This looks like an interesting island.
Oh it is.
Fancy a race!?!
What? That's a bit sudden. What kind of race?
I bet I can beat you to the other end of this island, I'll take the left route and you can take the right.
translation: 내가 너보다 먼저 이 섬 반대편 끝에 도착한다에 걸지. 난 왼쪽 길로 갈 테니까 넌 오른쪽 길로 가.

english: That doesn't seem fair - mine's all curvy and yours is straight.
translation: 그건 불공평한 것 같은데요. 제 쪽은 온통 구불구불하고 그쪽은 쭉 뻗어 있잖아요.

english: Well, that's life I'm afraid, it's never as easy as you would like, you have to take the path that's dealt!
translation: 뭐, 인생이 원래 그래. 바라는 만큼 쉬운 법이 없지. 길은 주어진 대로 가는 거야!

english: If you insist.
You'll see, so how about it?
On your marks!
Get set!
Go !!!
No thanks.
Have it your way.
You beat me.
Woo hoo! Ha ha! You can try again if you want, but you'll never beat me, I'm far too fast!
translation: 우후! 하하! 원하면 다시 도전해도 되지만, 넌 절대 날 못 이겨. 난 엄청 빠르거든!

english: Eat my dust!
You're right, I'm far too slow.
You give up too easily, but have it your way.
translation: 너무 쉽게 포기하는구나. 뭐, 마음대로 해.

english: Oh, hello? Looks like you'll probably want to start again.
translation: 어, 안녕? 처음부터 다시 하고 싶은 모양이네.

english: I won!
Noooo! How could you beat me?
translation: 안 돼애애! 어떻게 날 이길 수가 있지?

english: Very well.
I'm just making the most of the abilities I worked hard to develop. That's all!
translation: 열심히 갈고닦은 능력을 최대한 활용했을 뿐이에요. 그게 다예요!

english: True. A very important thing to remember! Now be gone!
translation: 맞는 말이야. 꼭 기억해 둬야 할 중요한 거지! 이제 썩 가 버려!

english: Ok.
No thanks.
Eat my dust!
You're right, I'm far too slow.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
What is it you want?
Can I kill the dragons up here?
I suppose that's okay since you've got a Slayer assignment. But when you've finished it, leave the rest for me!
translation: Slayer(슬레이어) 과제를 받았으니 그건 괜찮겠지. 하지만 과제 끝나면 나머지는 나한테 남겨 둬!

english: Don't even think about it - these dragons up here are for me!
translation: 꿈도 꾸지 마. 여기 드래곤들은 내 거야!

english: There's a Slayer Master in my family, so I don't stop people doing their Slayer assignments, but otherwise these dragons are for me, not you.
translation: 우리 집안에 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 있어서 슬레이어 과제를 하는 사람은 막지 않지만, 그게 아니면 이 드래곤들은 네 게 아니라 내 거야.

english: What are you here for?
Dragon-slaying, of course. Do I look like one of those serfs who wanders around scavenging scales off the floor? I'm just having a rest now, before I get back to the fight.
translation: 드래곤 사냥이지, 당연히. 내가 바닥에서 비늘이나 주워 모으며 어슬렁거리는 농노 같아 보여? 다시 싸우러 가기 전에 잠깐 쉬는 중이야.

english: My cousin Slieve built the access routes through this blue dragon lair. But she's only really interested in black dragons, not blue ones, so she said I could have this area for myself.
translation: 내 사촌 Slieve(슬리브)가 이 blue dragon(블루 드래곤) 소굴을 지나는 통로를 만들었어. 그런데 걔는 블루 드래곤 말고 black dragons(블랙 드래곤)에만 관심이 있어서, 이 구역은 나 혼자 써도 된다고 했지.

english: Why are you dressed like that?
It's hot in here with all the dragonfire.
Don't you need armour, though?
I've got wizard boots on, see? What more would I want?
translation: wizard boots(마법사 장화) 신었잖아, 안 보여? 뭐가 더 필요해?

english: Well, maybe you'd want something to help you fight the dragons? Wizard boots don't sound very useful.
translation: 음, 드래곤이랑 싸우는 데 도움 되는 게 필요하지 않을까요? Wizard boots(마법사 장화)는 별로 쓸모 있어 보이지 않는데요.

english: They're useful enough for what I'm doing. Anyway, moving on...
translation: 내가 하는 일엔 충분히 쓸모 있어. 아무튼, 다음 얘기...

english: Never mind.
Off you go.
Oi, find yourself some other dragons - these are mine!
translation: 어이, 다른 드래곤이나 찾아 봐. 얘네는 내 거야!

english: Can I kill the dragons up here?
What are you here for?
Why are you dressed like that?
Never mind.
Hey Eve!
[player name]! You're back! Here to party some more?
translation: [player name]! 다시 왔구나! 더 놀러 온 거야?

english: You never get sick of partying, do you?
Well, you see, I spend the rest of the year in the afterlife. And that is quite boring.
translation: 음, 있잖아, 난 일 년 중 나머지는 저승에서 보내거든. 그게 꽤 지루해.

english: The afterlife?
Yes. You know, where you go when you die. Anyway, that's boring stuff. Coming back here is fun!
translation: 응. 왜, 죽으면 가는 곳 말이야. 아무튼 그건 지루한 얘기고. 여기 돌아오는 게 재밌어!

english: How do you come back?
Magic, my friend!
What kind of magic?
You wouldn't understand. If you're so interested, talk to the other people around here. They've returned from the afterlife as well!
translation: 말해 줘도 모를 거야. 그렇게 궁금하면 여기 있는 다른 사람들한테 물어봐. 다들 저승에서 돌아온 사람들이거든!

english: Have they? Interesting.
Goodbye.
Come back soon!
What kind of magic?
Goodbye.
Do you wanna meet my pet? His name's Pete. Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 내 애완동물 만나 볼래? 이름은 Pete(피트)야. 아니면 이 amulet of humanspeak(인간 언어 아뮬렛)이 또 고장 났나?

english: Player is teleported to ScapeRune prison
You leave the cat alone, and the cat leaves you alone.
translation: 고양이를 내버려 두면, 고양이도 당신을 내버려 둔다.

english: Hey, [player name], come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 어이, [player name], 낚시 좋아하면 따라와! 아니면 이 amulet of humanspeak(인간 언어 아뮬렛)이 또 고장 났나?

english: Player is teleported to Evil Bob's Island
translation: 플레이어가 Evil Bob's Island(사악한 밥의 섬)으로 순간이동된다

english: Evil Bob doesn't seem interested in you.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)은 당신에게 관심이 없어 보인다.

english: Evil Bob is no longer interested in you.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)은 더 이상 당신에게 관심이 없다.

english: So you've been captured too?
Captured?
Yes, Evil Bob captured me and stuck me in this prison.
translation: 네, Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 저를 붙잡아서 이 감옥에 가뒀어요.

english: How do I get out of here? I can't be held captive by a cat!
translation: 여기서 어떻게 나가요? 고양이한테 붙잡혀 있을 순 없어요!

english: Some of these balloon animals have keys in them, and if you pull the big lever it tells you which shape animal contains the correct key, but I can never find it.
translation: 이 풍선 동물 중 몇 개 안에 열쇠가 들어 있어요. 저 큰 레버를 당기면 어떤 모양의 동물에 맞는 열쇠가 들었는지 알려 주는데, 저는 도무지 못 찾겠더라고요.

english: You need to pull the lever to find out which shape animal contains the key, then pop that sort of animal to get the key.
translation: 레버를 당겨서 어떤 모양의 동물에 열쇠가 들었는지 알아낸 다음, 그 동물을 터뜨려서 열쇠를 얻으면 돼요.

english: Bring me any keys you get and I'll try them on the doors.
translation: 열쇠를 얻으면 저한테 가져다주세요. 제가 문에 맞춰 볼게요.

english: Okay.
But I wan't to leave now.
Oh. Well I guess you can leave but I'll still be stuck here.
translation: 아. 뭐, 나가셔도 되긴 하는데 저는 계속 여기 갇혀 있겠네요.

english: What is this place?
Don't you remember? This is ScapeRune's prison. Evil Bob caught you and brought you here.
translation: 기억 안 나세요? 여긴 ScapeRune(스케이프룬)의 감옥이에요. Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 당신을 잡아서 여기로 데려왔어요.

english: What gives him the right to lock me up? I demand to see a lawyer! I know my rights!
translation: 무슨 권리로 저를 가둔 거죠? 변호사를 불러 주세요! 저도 제 권리는 알아요!

english: Evil Bob doesn't care about people's rights. He's cruel and utterly merciless. He's a cat.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)은 사람의 권리 따위 신경 안 써요. 잔인하고 피도 눈물도 없죠. 고양이거든요.

english: Come on, we should leave before Evil Bob comes back! You go first; I'll follow along.
translation: 어서요, Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 돌아오기 전에 나가야 해요! 먼저 가세요, 제가 따라갈게요.

english: Oi! we'll be using the exit that's over here.
You're meant to pull the lever to find out which sort of animal to pop!
translation: 레버를 당겨서 어떤 동물을 터뜨려야 하는지 알아내야 한다니까요!

english: That's right, pull it. Then remember what kind of animal shape you see. That's the animal that contains the right key.
translation: 그래요, 당기세요. 그리고 보이는 동물 모양을 기억해 두세요. 그 동물 안에 맞는 열쇠가 들어 있어요.

english: Great, now you've got a key! Bring it to me so I can try it on the doors.
translation: 좋아요, 열쇠를 얻었네요! 문에 맞춰 볼 수 있게 저한테 가져다주세요.

english: The player walks to Prison Pete
Ooh, thanks! I'll see if it's the right one...
Aww, that was the wrong key! You must have popped the wrong sort of animal. Try the big lever again - it'll tell you which animal to pop.
translation: 아, 틀린 열쇠였어요! 엉뚱한 동물을 터뜨리셨나 봐요. 큰 레버를 다시 당겨 보세요. 어떤 동물을 터뜨려야 하는지 알려 줄 거예요.

english: Hooray, you got the right one! Now pull the lever again and let's get the next portal unlocked!
translation: 만세, 맞는 열쇠예요! 이제 레버를 다시 당겨서 다음 포털을 열어요!

english: You did it, you got all the keys right! Thank you! You're my friend FOREVER!
translation: 해냈어요, 열쇠를 전부 맞혔어요! 고마워요! 당신은 영원한 제 친구예요!

english: Let's get out of here before that cat notices.
translation: 그 고양이가 눈치채기 전에 여기서 나가요.

english: Hey, bring me that key you've got! I wanna get out of here!
translation: 저기요, 그 열쇠 저한테 가져다주세요! 저도 여기서 나가고 싶어요!

english: Player is teleported back to their original spot
Thanks a lot for your help! Here, have a present:
translation: 도와줘서 정말 고마워요! 자, 선물 받으세요:

english: Thanks! See you around!
Don't mind me, I was just leaving...
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요, 막 나가려던 참이었어요...

english: Huh?
Where am I?
On my island.
Take me to your leader!
I am your leader, you are but a slave!
translation: 내가 네 대장이다. 넌 한낱 노예일 뿐이고!

english: I am not a slave, I am a free person!
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Let me out of here!
I will never let you go, [player name]!
Why not?
Uhm...
Because I say so! And because I can never have enough servants!
translation: 내가 그렇다면 그런 거니까! 그리고 하인은 아무리 많아도 모자라거든!

english: Now catch me some fish, I'm hungry.
What fish, where?
Talk to my other servants, and hurry it up!
What's it all about?
Sit down and I'll tell you. It's a question of servant shortage.
translation: 앉아 봐, 얘기해 주지. 하인 부족 문제다.

english: Go on.
You are a skilled worker. A human like you is worth a great deal as a slave.
translation: 넌 숙련된 일꾼이야. 너 같은 인간은 노예로서 아주 값어치가 높지.

english: A slave?? I will have nothing to do with you. Is that clear? Absolutely nothing.
translation: 노예라고?? 너랑은 아무것도 엮이지 않을 거야. 알아들어? 절대 아무것도.

english: Now be reasonable little human. It's just a matter of time before you will do everything I ask you to. Play along and this can be a very nice place.
translation: 자, 이성적으로 굴어라, 꼬마 인간. 결국 넌 내가 시키는 건 뭐든 하게 될 거야. 시간문제지. 장단 맞춰 주면 여기도 아주 살기 좋은 곳이 될 수 있다고.

english: I will not make any deals with you. I'm a human. I will not be pushed, numbered, meowed at, teleported or enslaved. My life is my own.
translation: 너랑은 어떤 거래도 안 해. 난 인간이야. 떠밀리지도, 번호 매겨지지도, 야옹 소리를 듣지도, 순간이동당하지도, 노예가 되지도 않을 거야. 내 인생은 내 거야.

english: Is it?
Yes. You won't hold me.
translation: 그래. 넌 날 붙잡아 둘 수 없어.

english: Won't I?
Let me assure you there's no way out.
translation: 분명히 말해 두지만, 나갈 방법은 없어.

english: Just ask my servants!
How is it possible that you're talking?
translation: 너 어떻게 말을 할 수 있는 거야?

english: How is it possible that you're not meowing?
translation: 넌 어떻게 야옹거리지 않을 수 있지?

english: Meowing?? Why would I be meowing?
Most humans do, that's why I'm wearing this amulet of Man speak... but I do try to train my staff in civilised speech.
translation: 인간은 대부분 그러거든. 그래서 내가 이 amulet of Man speak(인간 언어 아뮬렛)을 차고 있는 거고... 그래도 내 하인들한테는 교양 있는 말을 가르치려고 애쓰고 있지.

english: Ah, but I suppose things are slightly different in your world... what a dreadful place that must be.
translation: 아, 하지만 네 세계에서는 사정이 좀 다르겠지... 정말 끔찍한 곳이겠군.

english: I think I'm getting a headache...
What did you do to Bob?
Bob? I am Bob!
Oh, you mean the Bob in your world? Nothing. I am an incarnation of Bob here on ScapeRune.
translation: 아, 네 세계의 Bob(밥) 말이야? 아무 짓도 안 했어. 난 여기 ScapeRune(스케이프룬)에 있는 밥의 화신이다.

english: What, you mean this is... like some kind of mirror land?
translation: 뭐, 그럼 여기가... 무슨 거울 나라 같은 거야?

english: Something like that... somewhere in ScapeRune there must be a human servant called [player name].
translation: 뭐 그런 셈이지... ScapeRune(스케이프룬) 어딘가에 [player name](이)라는 인간 하인이 있을 거다.

english: But you work just as well for me! Now get to work, human! Fish for me!
translation: 하지만 너도 나한테는 똑같이 쓸모 있지! 자, 일하러 가, 인간! 물고기를 잡아 와!

english: It looks vile and smells even worse. You're not eating that!
translation: 보기에도 역겹고 냄새는 더 고약하군. 그걸 먹을 생각은 마!

english: What, are you giving me cooked fish? What am I going to do with that? Uncook it first!
translation: 뭐야, 익힌 물고기를 주는 거야? 그걸로 뭘 하라고? 먼저 날것으로 되돌려 와!

english: Errr... Uncook it?
You heard me! There's the cold fire, by the trees, now get uncooking!
translation: 들었잖아! 나무들 옆에 차가운 불이 있으니까, 어서 가서 날것으로 되돌려!

english: What was this? That was absolutely disgusting!
Don't you know what kind of fish I like? Talk to my other servants for some advice.
translation: 내가 어떤 물고기를 좋아하는지도 몰라? 다른 하인들한테 조언 좀 구해 봐.

english: Evil Bob seems more attentive of you.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 당신에게 좀 더 관심을 보이는 것 같다.

english: Mmm, mmm... that's... mmm... delicious...
Now, let me take... a little... catnap...
ZZZzzz
Mmm, mmm... that's delicious.
Now get me another one, you no good human!
translation: 자, 하나 더 가져와, 이 쓸모없는 인간아!

english: Evil Bob Seems slightly less attentive of you.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 당신에게 관심을 조금 덜 보이는 것 같다.

english: What am I to do with that? Catch me some fish, puny human!
translation: 그걸로 뭘 하라고? 물고기나 잡아 와, 하찮은 인간아!

english: Evil Bob appears to be sleeping, best not to wake him up.
translation: Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 자고 있는 것 같다. 깨우지 않는 게 좋겠다.

english: Mew!
Yowl!
Meeeow!
Meeeeow!
Meeeeowby laaaater…
Yes, that seems like a good idea.
No, leave the cat alone.
Okay.
But I want to leave now.
Yes.
No.
What is this place?
But I want to leave now..
How do I get out of here?
Okay..
Why not?
What's it all about?
How is it possible that you're talking?
translation: 너 어떻게 말을 할 수 있는 거야?

english: What did you do to Bob?
Bwaaaaaauk bwuk bwuk
Bwuk
Bwuk bwuk bwuk
Flee from me, [player name]!
Begone, [player name]!
MUAHAHAHAHAAA!
How dare you invade my lair! DIE INTRUDER!
translation: 감히 내 소굴에 침입하다니! 죽어라, 침입자여!

english: What do you want?
I want to go through the portal.
Go away! This is OUR portal now!
translation: 저리 가! 이제 이건 우리 포털이야!

english: I want to join your group.
Well we do need one more person now, since... um.
translation: 음, 지금 한 명이 더 필요하긴 해. 왜냐면... 어.

english: But we're an evil group! To join, you have to be evil!
translation: 하지만 우린 사악한 무리라고! 들어오려면 사악해야 해!

english: I'm evil!
Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!
translation: 응, 딱 보니까 알겠다. 그 옷 완전 사악한데!

english: And I love that evil black sword!
translation: 그리고 그 사악한 새까만 검도 진짜 마음에 들어!

english: Okay, I'll take you through to see Denath.
Evil Dave escorts you into the demonic throne room.
translation: Evil Dave(사악한 데이브)가 당신을 악마의 왕좌실로 안내한다.

english: Master! This person wants to join us!
translation: 주인님! 이 사람이 우리랑 함께하고 싶대요!

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for him?
translation: 그런가? Josef(조셉)이 도망친 뒤로 마법사가 하나 모자라긴 하지. 이자를 보증할 수 있겠느냐?

english: Yeah! He's totally evil!
Thank you, Dave.
Never mind, I'm not evil.
Well get out of our evil temple then!
Oh, nothing.
Go away then!
Where did you get those robes?
Yeah, evil, aren't they? One of the group made them. He said he found some mushrooms in the ruins that could dye things really black.
translation: 그치, 사악하지? 우리 무리 중 하나가 만들었어. 폐허에서 뭐든 새까맣게 물들이는 버섯을 찾았대.

english: Eric's dead! Agrith-Naar killed him! That's EVIL!
translation: Eric(에릭)이 죽었어! Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)가 죽였다고! 완전 사악해!

english: I mean, it's bad! In a BAD way!
translation: 아, 그러니까 나쁘다고! 나쁜 쪽으로 나쁘다고!

english: What happened?
The ceiling collapsed without warning! When I moved towards the staircase the walls started to shake.
translation: 천장이 아무 예고도 없이 무너졌어! 내가 계단 쪽으로 가니까 벽이 흔들리기 시작했고.

english: I'm scared of what will happen to me if I try to leave!
translation: 나가려고 하면 나한테 무슨 일이 생길지 무서워!

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise you have left yourself without a word to describe real evil!
translation: '사악하다'를 칭찬으로 써 버리니까 진짜 사악한 걸 표현할 말이 없어졌잖아요!

english: There's no time for that! Eric's DEAD!
translation: 지금 그럴 때가 아니야! Eric(에릭)이 죽었다고!

english: You've got to get back to the throne room!
But the portal is closing! We'll be trapped!
translation: 근데 포털이 닫히고 있어! 우리 갇힌다고!

english: Our only hope is to summon Agrith-Naar again so I can kill him! But I need eight people.
translation: 유일한 희망은 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 다시 소환해서 제가 처치하는 거예요! 그런데 여덟 명이 필요해요.

english: You can kill him?
You'd better take this then. It was Eric's sigil. Everyone in the ritual will need one!
translation: 그럼 이거 가져가. Eric(에릭)의 sigil(인장)이었어. 의식에 참여하는 사람은 다 하나씩 있어야 해!

english: Welcome to my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
translation: 나의 파멸의 지하실에 온 걸 환영한다!

english: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
Hey, the council meeting! They wanted me to be their evil representative! That proves I'm a great dark wizard! Right?
translation: 아, 그 회의! 다들 나보고 사악한 대표를 맡아 달라고 했지! 이게 바로 내가 위대한 어둠의 마법사라는 증거야! 그치?

english: Right...
But anyway, why do you want to know what I ate?
translation: 근데 아무튼, 내가 뭘 먹었는지는 왜 알고 싶은데?

english: I need to make that exact food in order to save you from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: culinomancer(요리술사)의 주문에서 당신을 구하려면 그 음식을 똑같이 만들어야 하거든요.

english: What? But that was last week! You've already saved me!
translation: 뭐? 그건 지난주 일이잖아! 넌 이미 날 구했다고!

english: Sort of, it's complicated. It works like this...
translation: 뭐, 그렇긴 한데 복잡해요. 이게 어떻게 되냐면...

english: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: 당신은 여기 있지만, 동시에 아직 시간이 멈춘 곳에도 있어요.

english: What?
I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?
translation: 그러니까, culinomancer(요리술사)가 주문을 건 순간 방 전체의 시간이 멈췄잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: What? I didn't notice anything.
Of course you didn't! You were frozen!
translation: 당연히 못 느꼈죠! 당신도 시간이 멈춰 있었으니까요!

english: So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?
translation: 그럼 내가 어떻게 거기에도 있고 여기에도 있어? 어느 쪽이 나야?

english: I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?
translation: 그러니까, 난 내가 나 같은데, 만약 내가 내가 아니면 어떡해?

english: That would be terrible!
They're both you!
How does that work?
From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: '당신' 입장에서는 제가 이미 구한 거지만, '제' 입장에서는 아직 안 구한 거예요.

english: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!
translation: 뭐, 그럼 됐네. 내 입장에서 구해졌으면 됐지!

english: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!
translation: 하지만 제가 구해야 해요. 안 그러면 당신은 구해지지 않는다고요!

english: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!
translation: 근데 내가 여기 있으니까 넌 이미 날 구한 거잖아!

english: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!
translation: 제 말이 그거예요. 당신 입장에서는 제가 구했지만 제 입장에서는 아직 안 구했다고요!

english: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: 그 음식을 들고 과거로 가서 당신한테 줘야 해요.

english: Why?
Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: 안 그러면 culinomancer(요리술사)의 주문에서 구해지지 않으니까요.

english: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!
Exactly! That's why I know I have to go back and save you!
translation: 바로 그거예요! 그래서 제가 돌아가서 당신을 구해야 한다는 걸 아는 거예요!

english: What will happen if you don't?
I can't not, because I already have!
translation: 안 할 수가 없어요. 이미 했으니까요!

english: The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!
translation: 당신이 여기 있다는 건 제가 이미 당신을 구했다는 뜻이고, 그러니 당신은 저한테 정확한 요리법을 알려 줘야 해요. 안 알려 주는 건 논리적으로 불가능해요!

english: I don't understand this at all.
There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: 시간 역설이 생겨서 우주가 붕괴할 거예요!

english: Oh no! That would be bad, and not even in an evil way!
translation: 안 돼! 그건 나쁘잖아. 사악한 쪽으로 나쁜 것도 아니고!

english: Exactly! So you've got to tell me the recipe!
translation: 바로 그거예요! 그러니까 요리법을 알려 줘야 해요!

english: But I still don't understand why you need the recipe when you've already saved me!
translation: 근데 이미 날 구했는데 왜 요리법이 필요한지 아직도 모르겠어!

english: I don't know.
That's not very helpful. I don't even understand why you need the recipe anyway.
translation: 그건 별 도움이 안 되네. 애초에 왜 요리법이 필요한지도 모르겠고.

english: All right! Now that makes perfect sense!
So what was it?
What was what?
The food you ate at the council meeting.
It was, like, this totally evil stew!
Evil stew? How was it evil?
Well, it kind of tasted evil, you know? You know, how you taste something and you think, that's really EVIL?
translation: 음, 맛이 좀 사악했달까? 그런 거 있잖아, 뭘 먹어 보고 '와, 이거 진짜 사악하다!' 싶은 거?

english: I think you're mixing up 'good' and 'evil' again!
What? Well, I'm evil, and I only like evil stuff, and I liked that, so it must be evil. Right?
translation: 뭐? 그러니까, 난 사악하고, 난 사악한 것만 좋아하는데, 그게 좋았으니까, 그건 사악한 거야. 그치?

english: I suppose that makes some kind of sense. But I need to reproduce this stew, so can you describe it in more detail?
translation: 뭐, 나름 말은 되네요. 그런데 그 스튜를 똑같이 만들어야 하니까 좀 더 자세히 설명해 줄래요?

english: Well it tasted like the stews my mum makes. She puts these spices in them. But it was like she'd got the amounts totally right this time.
translation: 음, 우리 엄마가 만드는 스튜 같은 맛이었어. 엄마는 스튜에 향신료를 넣거든. 근데 이번엔 엄마가 양을 완벽하게 맞춘 것 같은 맛이었어.

english: Okay, I'd better talk to your mum.
Oh, never mind.
That's nothing like the stew I tasted. All the spices are wrong.
translation: 내가 먹은 스튜랑은 전혀 달라. 향신료가 전부 틀렸어.

english: Hmm... I think you've got the amount of one spice right, but the others are wrong.
translation: 흠... 향신료 하나는 양이 맞는 것 같은데, 나머지는 틀렸어.

english: That stew is pretty evil! But I think one of the spices is still a bit wrong.
translation: 그 스튜 꽤 사악한데! 근데 향신료 하나가 아직 좀 틀린 것 같아.

english: You've got the amount of two of the spices right, but two of them are wrong.
translation: 향신료 두 개는 양이 맞는데, 두 개는 틀렸어.

english: TOTALLY EVIL! That's EXACTLY how the stew tasted!
translation: 완전 사악해! 내가 먹은 스튜가 딱 이 맛이었어!

english: Don't eat it all!
Now I just have to go back in time and give it to your earlier self!
translation: 이제 과거로 가서 과거의 당신한테 주기만 하면 돼요!

english: What? Why can't I eat it?
You've already eaten it! This is the stew that you remember tasting in the first place!
translation: 이미 먹었잖아요! 이게 바로 당신이 처음에 먹었다고 기억하는 그 스튜라고요!

english: So confused...
Woah, what happened?
I've just saved you from a buffet worse than death!
translation: 방금 죽음보다 끔찍한 뷔페에서 당신을 구했어요!

english: Hey, this is pretty evil stew!
Yes. Now it's very important you remember what the stew tasted like!
translation: 네. 이제 이 스튜 맛을 꼭 기억해 두는 게 아주 중요해요!

english: Because... it just is!
Okay.
Nice basement!
Nice?!
I mean, evil!
Yeah! I'm going to use it to summon DEMONS to DO MY BIDDING, or raise an ARMY OF THE UNDEAD! And then I'm going to totally, like, take over the world!
translation: 그렇지! 여기서 내 명령을 따를 악마들을 소환하거나, 언데드 군단을 일으킬 거야! 그리고 막, 완전 세상을 정복할 거라고!

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!
So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...
translation: 음, 작은 것부터 시작해야겠다 싶어서 Wizard Grayzag(마법사 그레이자그)한테 imp(임프) 소환하는 걸 좀 도와 달라고 했지...

english: And did you manage to summon any?
Well, not imps, exactly. It turns out they're not the lowest form of demon after all. I got these hell-rats.
translation: 음, 정확히는 임프가 아니었어. 알고 보니 임프가 제일 하급 악마는 아니더라고. 이 hell-rat(지옥 쥐)들이 나왔어.

english: They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!
translation: 하나도 안 사악해! 그냥 평범한 쥐랑 똑같은데 유황 냄새가 살짝 날 뿐이야!

english: See you later!
If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!
translation: 그 전에 내 어둠의 군단이 널 잡지 않는다면 말이지!

english: Soon you will return to bow before my EVIL THRONE!
translation: 넌 곧 돌아와서 나의 사악한 왕좌 앞에 무릎 꿇게 될 것이다!

english: If you can find your way out of my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
translation: 나의 파멸의 지하실에서 빠져나갈 수 있다면 말이지!

english: And together we will lead Gielinor into a NEW DARK AGE!
translation: 그리고 우리는 함께 Gielinor(길리노르)를 새로운 암흑시대로 이끌 것이다!

english: Of course you will return! There is no escape from my DARK POWER!
translation: 물론 넌 돌아오게 될 거다! 나의 어둠의 힘에서는 벗어날 수 없으니까!

english: Weren't you going to give up evil?
Yeah, well...
I did try. I wore this bright red jumper and I got up in the morning and spent the day outside in the sunshine...
translation: 해 보긴 했어. 새빨간 스웨터도 입어 보고, 아침에 일어나서 하루 종일 밖에서 햇볕도 쬐어 보고...

english: *Dave shudders*
But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?
translation: 근데 계속은 못 하겠더라. 착한 건 뭘 해도 별로 재미가 없었거든, 알지?

english: Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.
translation: 가끔은 사악한 짓의 결과가 걱정되긴 해. Denath(데나스) 때처럼 누가 다치는 건 정말 싫거든.

english: But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!
translation: 하지만 사악하지 않을 수가 없어! 그게 바로 나니까!

english: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
translation: 시간 여행 얘기를 다시 설명해 볼게요...

english: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancercast his spell, right?
translation: 그러니까, culinomancer(요리술사)가 주문을 건 순간 방 전체의 시간이 멈췄잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer'sspell.
translation: 안 그러면 culinomancer(요리술사)의 주문에서 구해지지 않으니까요.

english: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: 마법이 그걸 요구하니까 알려 줘야 해요!

english: That's what you said before! Honestly, why make it more complicated than it needs to be?
translation: 아까도 그렇게 말했잖아! 진짜, 왜 쓸데없이 복잡하게 만드는 건데?

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Evil Dave has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Evil Dave(사악한 데이브)가 도전 두루마리를 건넸다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
That is not the evil answer I requested!
translation: 그건 내가 원한 사악한 답이 아니야!

english: Spot on!
Evil Dave has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: Evil Dave(사악한 데이브)가 [another clue scroll/a casket]을(를) 건넸다!

english: I want to go through the portal.
I want to join your group.
I'm evil!
Never mind, I'm not evil.
Oh, nothing.
Where did you get those robes?
What happened?
By using 'evil' as a term of praise...
You've got to get back to the throne room!
What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.
translation: 당신은 여기 있지만, 동시에 아직 시간이 멈춘 곳에도 있어요.

english: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.
translation: '당신' 입장에서는 제가 이미 구한 거지만, '제' 입장에서는 아직 안 구한 거예요.

english: I've got to take the food back in time to give it to you.
translation: 그 음식을 들고 과거로 가서 당신한테 줘야 해요.

english: I can't not, I already have!
translation: 안 할 수가 없어요, 이미 했으니까요!

english: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!
translation: 시간 역설이 생겨서 우주가 붕괴할 거예요!

english: I don't know
You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!
translation: 마법이 그걸 요구하니까 알려 줘야 해요!

english: Oh, never mind.
Nice basement!
So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?
Weren't you going to give up evil?
See you later.
Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...
translation: 시간 여행 얘기를 다시 설명해 볼게요...

english: Are you a cook? I need more staff.
What's going on here?
This is the Hosidius Mess. It was set up to help feed the soldiers from the Shayzien Encampment. Much better than anything they can cook over there.
translation: 여긴 Hosidius Mess(호시디우스 식당)이야. Shayzien Encampment(샤이지엔 야영지) 병사들 밥 먹이려고 차린 곳이지. 저쪽에서 자기들끼리 해 먹는 것보단 훨씬 낫다고.

english: How come it's so far from Hosidius?
The solders do enough hard work, so it seemed only right not to make them walk all the way across Kourend for a bit of food.
translation: 병사들은 안 그래도 고생이 많잖아. 밥 한 끼 먹자고 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 가로질러 걷게 하는 건 도리가 아니지.

english: Anyway, enough chatting. Are you a cook?
Yeah, I can do some cooking. Well, my level's [number<20], anyway.
translation: 네, 요리 좀 해요. 뭐, 레벨이 [number<20]이긴 하지만요.

english: Hah! You'll need a level of 20 to cook anything for these soldiers. They're picky about what they eat.
translation: 하! 이 병사들한테 뭘 해 주려면 레벨 20은 돼야 해. 먹는 거 하나는 엄청 까다롭거든.

english: Yeah, I can do some cooking.
Good. When you've got more Hosidius favour, come back and I'll have plenty for you to do.
translation: 좋아. Hosidius(호시디우스) 호감도를 더 쌓으면 다시 와. 시킬 일이 산더미니까.

english: Good. The soldiers like stew, meat pies and pineapple pizza. You'll find ingredients in the cupboards.
translation: 좋아. 병사들은 stew(스튜), meat pie(고기 파이), pineapple pizza(파인애플 피자)를 좋아해. 재료는 찬장에 있어.

english: When you've made something, put it on the buffet tables, and you'll gain experience based on how much the soldiers appreciate them.
translation: 뭘 만들었으면 뷔페 테이블에 올려놔. 병사들이 얼마나 맛있게 먹느냐에 따라 경험치를 얻을 거야.

english: No, I'm off.
You're not authorised to work in my kitchen.
translation: 넌 내 부엌에서 일할 자격이 없어.

english: They're not going to eat anything you've got there. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: 네가 들고 있는 건 아무도 안 먹을 거야. meat pie(고기 파이)나 stew(스튜), pineapple pizza(파인애플 피자)를 만들어.

english: Hey, that's not for you!
They're not going to eat that. Use the ingredients provided here.
translation: 그건 안 먹을 거야. 여기 있는 재료를 써.

english: They're not going to eat that. Make them meat pies, stew or pineapple pizza.
translation: 그건 안 먹을 거야. meat pie(고기 파이)나 stew(스튜), pineapple pizza(파인애플 피자)를 만들어.

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 야, 너 줄 게 있는데 소지품에 자리가 없잖아!

english: What's going on here?
Yeah, I can do some cooking.
No, I'm off.
Hello.
Ah hello there! I am the resident lecturer on antiquities and artefacts. I also set the Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 아, 어서 와요! 나는 이곳에 상주하는 고대 유물 강사예요. Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 출제도 맡고 있죠.

english: Earth Sciences?
That is right dear, the world of Gielinor holds many wonders beneath its surface. Students come to me to take exams so that they may join in on the archaeological dig going on just north of here.
translation: 그래요, 학생. Gielinor(길리노르) 세계의 땅 밑에는 경이로운 것들이 잔뜩 있어요. 학생들은 바로 북쪽에서 진행 중인 고고학 발굴에 참여하려고 나한테 시험을 보러 오죠.

english: So if they don't pass the exams they can't dig at all?
translation: 그럼 시험에 통과 못 하면 아예 발굴을 못 해요?

english: That's right! We have to make sure that students know enough to be able to dig safely and not damage the artefacts.
translation: 그렇죠! 학생들이 안전하게 발굴하고 유물을 훼손하지 않을 만큼 충분히 알고 있는지 확인해야 하거든요.

english: Can I take an exam?
You can if you get this letter stamped by the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: 이 편지에 Varrock(바록) 박물관 Curator(큐레이터)의 도장을 받아 오면 볼 수 있어요.

english: Why's that then?
Because he is a very knowledgeable man and employs our archaeological expert. I'm sure he knows a lot about your exploits and can judge whether you'd make a good archaeologist or not.
translation: 그분은 아주 박식한 분이고, 우리 고고학 전문가를 고용하고 계시거든요. 학생의 활약도 많이 알고 계실 테니, 좋은 고고학자가 될 재목인지 판단해 주실 거예요.

english: Besides, the museum contributes funds to the dig.
translation: 게다가 박물관이 발굴 자금도 대고 있고요.

english: But why are you writing the letter? Shouldn't he?
translation: 그런데 왜 선생님이 편지를 써요? 그분이 써야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: He's also a very busy man, so I write the letters and he justs stamps them if he approves.
translation: 그분은 무척 바쁜 분이라서, 내가 편지를 쓰면 그분은 승인하실 때 도장만 찍어 주시는 거예요.

english: Oh, I see. I'll ask him if he'll approve me, and bring my stamped letter back here. Thanks.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 허락해 주실지 여쭤보고 도장 받은 편지를 가지고 다시 올게요. 고마워요.

english: Interesting...
You could gain much with an understanding of the world below.
translation: 땅 밑 세계를 이해하면 얻을 게 아주 많을 거예요.

english: Hello again.
I am still waiting for your letter of recommendation.
I have lost the letter you gave me.
Oh now come on. You have it with you!
translation: 아이참, 왜 그래요. 지금 가지고 있잖아요!

english: You already have the letter in your bank.
That was foolish. Take this one and don't lose it!
translation: 조심성이 없었네요. 이걸 가져가고 이번엔 잃어버리지 말아요!

english: Alright, I'll try and get it.
I am sure you won't get any problems. Speak to the Curator of Varrock's Museum.
translation: 별 문제 없을 거예요. Varrock(바록) 박물관의 Curator(큐레이터)님께 말씀드려 봐요.

english: Hello again. Are you ready for another shot at the exam?
translation: 또 왔군요. 다시 시험에 도전할 준비가 됐나요?

english: Yes I certainly am.
You'll need at least two spaces free in your inventory before taking this exam, else you can not be rewarded if you pass!
translation: 시험을 보기 전에 소지품에 빈칸이 최소 두 개는 있어야 해요. 안 그러면 합격해도 보상을 줄 수 없거든요!

english: Okay, we will start with the first exam: Earth Sciences level 1 - Beginner.
translation: 좋아요, 첫 번째 시험부터 시작하죠. Earth Sciences(지구과학) 1단계 - 초급이에요.

english: Question 1 - Earth Sciences overview. Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is?
translation: 1번 문제 - Earth Sciences(지구과학) 개요. 지구과학이 무엇인지 말해 볼래요?

english: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
translation: 땅과 그 속에 있는 것, 그리고 그 역사를 연구하는 학문이요.

english: The study of planets and the history of worlds.
The combination of archaeology and vegetarianism.
The study of gardening, planting and fruiting vegetation.
translation: 원예, 식재, 열매 맺는 식물을 연구하는 학문이요.

english: Okay, next question...
Earth Sciences level 1, question 2 - Eligibility. Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite?
translation: Earth Sciences(지구과학) 1단계, 2번 문제 - 자격. 발굴지를 이용할 수 있는 사람은 누구인지 말해 볼래요?

english: Professors, students and workmen only.
Local residents, contractors and small pink fish.
translation: 지역 주민, 도급업자, 그리고 작은 분홍색 물고기요.

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 해당 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험에 합격한 모든 사람이요.

english: Magic users, miners and their escorts.
Earth Sciences level 1, question 3 - Health and safety. Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite?
translation: Earth Sciences(지구과학) 1단계, 3번 문제 - 보건 및 안전. 발굴지에서 작업할 때 지켜야 할 안전 수칙을 말해 볼래요?

english: Rubber chickens to be worn on the head at all times.
translation: 고무 닭을 항상 머리에 쓰고 있어야 한다.

english: Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: 장갑과 장화를 항상 착용하고, 알맞은 도구를 사용해야 한다.

english: Protective clothing to be worn; tools kept away from site.
translation: 보호복을 입고, 도구는 현장에서 멀리 둔다.

english: Heat-resistant clothing to be worn at all times.
That concludes the exam for Earth Sciences level 1.
Let's see how you did...
You got all the questions correct. Well done!
Hey! Excellent!

You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 1 general exam. Here is your certificate to prove it. You also get a decent trowel to dig with. Of course, you'll want to get studying for your next exam now!
translation: 이제 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 1단계 일반 시험에 합격했어요. 여기 그걸 증명하는 증명서예요. 발굴할 때 쓸 괜찮은 trowel(모종삽)도 줄게요. 물론 이제 다음 시험 공부를 시작해야겠죠!

english: You got 2 questions correct. Not bad, just a little more revision needed.
translation: 두 문제 맞혔어요. 나쁘지 않네요, 복습만 조금 더 하면 돼요.

english: Oh well...
Get out and explore the digsite, talk to people and learn!
translation: 발굴지를 둘러보고, 사람들하고 얘기도 나누면서 배워 봐요!

english: You got 1 question correct. Better luck next time.
translation: 한 문제 맞혔어요. 다음엔 더 잘될 거예요.

english: Oh bother!
Do some more research. I'm sure other students could help you out.
translation: 조사를 좀 더 해 봐요. 다른 학생들이 분명 도와줄 거예요.

english: Oh deary me! This is appalling, none correct at all! I suggest you go and study properly.
translation: 아이고, 세상에! 이건 너무 심하네요, 하나도 못 맞혔어요! 제대로 공부하고 오세요.

english: Oh dear...
Why don't you use the resources here? There are books and the researchers, and you could even ask other students who are also studying for these exams.
translation: 여기 있는 자료를 활용해 보지 그래요? 책도 있고 연구원들도 있고, 같은 시험을 준비하는 다른 학생들한테 물어볼 수도 있어요.

english: No, not at the moment.
Okay, take your time if you wish.
Hello there! My colleague tells me you helped to uncover a hidden altar to the god Zaros.
translation: 어서 와요! 동료한테 들었는데, 학생이 Zaros(자로스) 신의 숨겨진 제단을 찾아내는 걸 도왔다면서요.

english: A great scholar and archaeologist indeed! Good health and prosperity to you.
translation: 정말 위대한 학자이자 고고학자네요! 건강과 번영이 함께하길 빌어요.

english: Thanks.
I have lost my trowel.
Deary me... That was a good one as well. It's a good job I have another. Here you go...
translation: 아이고 저런... 좋은 물건이었는데. 하나 더 있어서 다행이네요. 여기요...

english: Really? Look in your backpack and make sure first.
translation: 정말요? 먼저 배낭을 잘 확인해 봐요.

english: Hi! Please complete this.
I'm afraid you have not finished the puzzle.
Correct! Well done!
Can I take an exam?
Interesting...
I have lost the letter you gave me.
Alright I'll try and get it.
Yes, I certainly am.
The study of the earth, its contents and history.
translation: 땅과 그 속에 있는 것, 그리고 그 역사를 연구하는 학문이요.

english: The study of planets, and the history of worlds.
The combination of archaeology and vegetarianism.
The study of gardening, planting and fruiting vegetation.
translation: 원예, 식재, 열매 맺는 식물을 연구하는 학문이요.

english: The study of planets and the history of worlds.
Professors, students and workmen only.
Local residents, contractors and small pink fish.
translation: 지역 주민, 도급업자, 그리고 작은 분홍색 물고기요.

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 해당 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험에 합격한 모든 사람이요.

english: Magic users, miners and their escorts.
Rubber chickens to be worn on the head at all times.
translation: 고무 닭을 항상 머리에 쓰고 있어야 한다.

english: Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: 장갑과 장화를 항상 착용하고, 알맞은 도구를 사용해야 한다.

english: Protective clothing to be worn; tools kept away from site.
translation: 보호복을 입고, 도구는 현장에서 멀리 둔다.

english: Heat-resistant clothing to be worn at all times.
No, not at the moment.
Thanks.
I have lost my trowel.
I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: Blue Moon(푸른 달)과 싸우다가 무기를 잃어버렸어요. 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: Here you go, iknil.
Eyatalli returns your lost weapon to you.
I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: lesser nagua(하급 나구아)와 싸우다가 essence(정수)를 좀 찾았어요.

english: Thank you, iknil. I shall use it to reinforce the seal.
translation: 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). 봉인을 강화하는 데 쓰겠습니다.

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
No.
Care to explain further?
Does the stream tire of eroding the earth? Does the earth tire of forming the mountain?
translation: 개울이 땅을 깎아 내는 데 지치던가요? 땅이 산을 이루는 데 지치던가요?

english: Not that I can tell.
I have more in common with them than I do with most of your kind, iknil. Think of me as you do them.
translation: 저는 당신네 종족 대부분보다 그들과 더 닮았습니다, iknil(이크닐). 그들을 대하듯 저를 대하십시오.

english: This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
It is a prison. Everything around us serves that purpose.
translation: 감옥이 맞습니다. 우리 주변의 모든 것이 그 목적을 위해 존재합니다.

english: Even the plants and the streams?
I am a nagua of earth and stream. Being close to both empowers me to do my task.
translation: 저는 땅과 개울의 nagua(나구아)입니다. 둘 다 가까이 있어야 제 임무를 해낼 힘을 얻습니다.

english: Just as being far from moonlight weakens the Moons of Peril.
translation: 달빛에서 멀어지면 Moons of Peril(위험의 달들)이 약해지는 것처럼 말입니다.

english: Goodbye.
Congratulations on your reward, iknil. That is a treasure from ages past.
translation: 보상을 받으신 것을 축하합니다, iknil(이크닐). 먼 옛날의 보물입니다.

english: Yeah, about that... I don't really like this one. Could I have a different one?
translation: 네, 그게 말인데요... 이건 좀 별로예요. 다른 걸로 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Was that rude?
I was just... Processing. I suppose I could allow you another chance to obtain a piece of equipment, but it won't be guaranteed.
translation: 그저... 생각을 정리하던 중이었습니다. 장비를 얻을 기회를 한 번 더 드릴 수는 있겠지만, 장담은 못 합니다.

english: Yes, that sounds good.
You're certain, Iknil? You could end up with nothing.
translation: 확실합니까, Iknil(이크닐)? 아무것도 못 얻을 수도 있습니다.

english: Very well.
No luck this time, iknil.
Oh... Can I have it back?
Congratulations, iknil. Enjoy your new equipment.
Congratulations, ik-
This is the same thing I just gave you!
So it seems. You're welcome to try again.
translation: 그런 것 같군요. 얼마든지 다시 시도하셔도 됩니다.

english: Actually, I don't dislike it that much. I think I'll keep it.
translation: 사실 그렇게까지 싫진 않아요. 그냥 가질게요.

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth...
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리)의 목소리가 주변 땅을 타고 울려 퍼진다...

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리): 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Eclipse Moon(일식의 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리): 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Blue Moon(푸른 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리): 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Blood Moon(피의 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Eyatlalli: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리): 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). 달들의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 보상을 받으러 제게 돌아오십시오.

english: Eyatlalli's voice echoes through the surrounding earth.
translation: Eyatlalli(에야틀랄리)의 목소리가 주변 땅을 타고 울려 퍼진다.

english: Thank you, iknil. The Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Eclipse Moon(일식의 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blue Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Blue Moon(푸른 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Thank you, iknil. The Blood Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). Blood Moon(피의 달)의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 이제 다음 달로 가십시오.

english: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. Return to me for your reward.
translation: 고맙습니다, iknil(이크닐). 달들의 주의가 충분히 흐트러졌습니다. 보상을 받으러 제게 돌아오십시오.

english: I lost my weapon fighting the Blue Moon. Could I have it back?
translation: Blue Moon(푸른 달)과 싸우다가 무기를 잃어버렸어요. 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: I found some essence whilst fighting the lesser nagua.
translation: lesser nagua(하급 나구아)와 싸우다가 essence(정수)를 좀 찾았어요.

english: Do you ever get tired of guarding this place?
This place is beautiful. I thought it was supposed to be a prison?
Goodbye.
Yes.
Hello!
Nilsal. I'm afraid I must ask not to be disturbed. There are many things that one in my position must contemplate. If you seek conversation, I'm sure my companion would be willing.
translation: Nilsal(닐살). 미안하지만 방해하지 말아 주십시오. 저 같은 자리에 있는 사람은 숙고해야 할 일이 많습니다. 대화를 원하신다면 제 동료가 기꺼이 응해 줄 겁니다.

english: Okay, thanks.
Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay awhile.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 우리 작은 마을에 잘 오셨어요. 부디 잠시 머물다 가세요.

english: You know, you sound just like the mayor?
Really? That's the nicest thing anyone has ever said.
translation: 정말요? 지금까지 들어 본 말 중에 제일 기분 좋은 말이에요.

english: I admire him a great deal. He works so hard for this town.
translation: 전 그분을 정말 존경해요. 이 마을을 위해 정말 열심히 일하시거든요.

english: You look like him as well?
Hmm, I don't think I do.
translation: 흠, 전 안 닮은 것 같은데요.

english: No really, what with the unhealthy skin tone and bulging eyes. The resemblance is uncanny.
translation: 아니, 진짜로요. 그 칙칙한 피부색이랑 툭 튀어나온 눈이요. 소름 끼칠 정도로 닮았어요.

english: Well, I haven't spoken to him in a while.  I don't get out much.
translation: 음, 그분이랑 얘기 안 한 지 좀 됐어요. 제가 밖에 잘 안 나가거든요.

english: I can see why.
Maybe the Mayor has finally seen how much I admire him and has grown to admire me?
translation: 혹시 촌장님이 제가 얼마나 존경하는지 마침내 아시고, 그분도 저를 존경하게 되신 걸까요?

english: Anything's possible I suppose. Wait a minute, you mean you've always looked that odd?
translation: 뭐, 무슨 일이든 가능하겠죠. 잠깐만요, 그럼 원래부터 그렇게 이상하게 생겼다는 거예요?

english: Hey, I resent that!
I'm sorry, it's just...  Nevermind.
What do you do here?
I supply the local fishermen with the tools and bait they need to do their job.
translation: 이 동네 어부들한테 일하는 데 필요한 도구랑 미끼를 대 주고 있어요.

english: Interesting. Have you been doing it long?
Why yes, all of my life.  I took over from my father, who inherited the business from his father and so on.
translation: 그럼요, 평생 했죠. 아버지한테서 물려받았는데, 아버지도 할아버지한테서 가게를 물려받으셨고, 그런 식으로 쭉 이어져 왔어요.

english: In fact, there have been Lovecraft's selling bait for over ten generations.
translation: 사실 Lovecraft(러브크래프트) 가문은 열 세대 넘게 미끼를 팔아 왔어요.

english: Wow, that's some lineage.
Oh yes, we have a long and interesting family history. For one reason or another the Lovecraft's have always been bait sellers or writers.
translation: 그럼요, 우리 집안 역사는 길고도 흥미진진하답니다. 어찌 된 일인지 Lovecraft(러브크래프트) 사람들은 늘 미끼 장수 아니면 작가였어요.

english: Hmm, yes well. I'm sure it's all fascinating, but I...
translation: 흠, 네, 뭐. 분명 아주 흥미롭겠지만, 전...

english: Oh very, very fascinating, for instance my great grandfather Howard...
translation: 아, 아주아주 흥미롭죠. 예를 들면 우리 증조할아버지 Howard(하워드)는...

english: Yawn. Oh, I'm sorry but I really must be getting on. I think my giraffe needs feeding.
translation: 하암. 아, 미안하지만 정말 가 봐야겠어요. 우리 기린 밥 줄 시간이라서요.

english: Your?
Giraffe. Sorry, but he gets cranky without enough sugar. Bye now!
translation: 기린이요. 미안해요, 설탕을 충분히 안 주면 성질을 부리거든요. 그럼 이만 가 볼게요!

english: Oh right, goodbye.
Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 낚시 용품 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 저한텐 좀 많이 이상한 분이네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Sniff. Yes, everyone says that.
You know, you sound just like the mayor?
What do you do here?
Can I buy some fishing supplies please?
translation: 낚시 용품 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: You are a bit too strange for me. Bye.
translation: 저한텐 좀 많이 이상한 분이네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hello there, traveller.
What's going on here? Where is everyone?
translation: 여기 무슨 일이에요? 다들 어디 갔어요?

english: Most are in the city. As for the rest, hopefully somewhere nicer than this place.
translation: 대부분은 도시에 있어요. 나머지는... 부디 여기보다는 나은 곳에 있길 바랄 뿐이죠.

english: In the city?
Yes. When we heard they were going to lock Menaphos down and shut the gates, most people here decided they'd be better off behind the walls than outside them.
translation: 네. Menaphos(메나포스)를 봉쇄하고 성문을 닫는다는 소식을 듣고, 여기 사람들 대부분이 성벽 밖보다는 안에 있는 게 낫겠다고 판단했거든요.

english: But you stayed?
We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
translation: 미리 알려 준 시간이 별로 없었어요. 다들 챙길 수 있는 걸 허겁지겁 챙겨야 했죠. 두고 갈 수밖에 없는 것들도 있었고, 사람들도 좀...

english: That's horrible!
It could have been worse. Had we been in Sophanem, we'd have had no warning at all. I just hope it won't be long before things are back to normal.
translation: 더 나빴을 수도 있어요. Sophanem(소파넴)에 있었다면 아무 예고도 못 받았을 테니까요. 그저 하루빨리 모든 게 원래대로 돌아오길 바랄 뿐이에요.

english: I hope so too.
Thank you, traveller. Stay safe out there. These are troubling times.
translation: 고마워요, 여행자님. 밖에서는 조심하세요. 지금은 뒤숭숭한 시기니까요.

english: Don't bother me, can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 귀찮게 하지 마. 나 바쁜 거 안 보여?

english: No, I can't... can I go into the factory?
translation: 아뇨, 안 보이는데요... 공장에 들어가도 돼요?

english: You can go in. The Consortium, in their infinite wisdom, has decided to open up the factory to all and sundry.
translation: 들어가도 돼. 그 잘나신 Consortium(컨소시엄)께서 공장을 아무나 다 드나들게 열어 주기로 하셨거든.

english: How come?
We've built a new blast furnace and always have a shortage of people to work on it.
translation: 새로 blast furnace(대형 용광로)를 지었는데, 거기서 일할 사람이 늘 모자라거든.

english: I'll have a look, thanks.
Just don't go causing any trouble, I still run this factory!
translation: 말썽만 부리지 마. 이 공장은 아직 내가 운영한다고!

english: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?
translation: 실례지만, blast furnace(대형 용광로)를 찾고 있는데요?

english: Do I look like a guide to you?
No, you look like a hard-working dwarf, but can you please tell me where the blast furnace is?
translation: 아뇨, 열심히 일하는 dwarf(드워프)로 보여요. 그래도 대형 용광로가 어디 있는지 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Alright, just head down the stairs, it's easy to find.
translation: 알았다, 계단 따라 내려가기만 해. 찾기 쉬워.

english: Thanks.
Are you okay?
Don't I look okay?
If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
translation: 키가 조금만 더 작았으면 아예 안 보일 것 같아서요.

english: Very funny, human.
What are you dwarves doing in this factory?
translation: 드워프들은 이 공장에서 뭘 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Working of course, can't you see that?
But working on what?
Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
translation: 당연히 공장으로 들어오는 광석을 제련하는 거지.

english: And what does that mean?
It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!
translation: 질문 그만하고 너도 가서 일이나 하라는 뜻이다!

english: Who owns this factory?
The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.
But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?
translation: 근데 어느 회사요? 회사가 여러 개 있는 줄 알았는데요?

english: Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.
translation: 아, 그래. 큰 회사들이 다 같이 이 공장을 소유하고 있지. 회사 하나 손에 맡기기엔 너무 중요한 곳이거든.

english: And what exactly are you doing here?
translation: 그럼 여기서 정확히 뭘 하시는 거예요?

english: I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!
translation: 이런 질문은 지겹다. 일하러 가게 좀 놔둬!

english: What?
What do you do?
You can store your stuff here if you want. You can dump anything you don't want to carry whilst you're fighting duels and then pick it up again on the way out.
translation: 원하면 여기다 물건을 맡겨 둬도 돼. 결투하는 동안 들고 다니기 싫은 건 뭐든 맡겨 두고 나갈 때 다시 찾아가면 되지.

english: To be honest I'm wasted here.
translation: 솔직히 여기선 내 재능이 썩고 있다고.

english: I should be winning duels in an arena! I'm the best warrior in Al Kharid!
translation: 난 경기장에서 결투를 이기고 있어야 한다고! 내가 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 제일가는 전사란 말이야!

english: Easy, tiger!
What is this place?
Isn't it obvious?
This is the Emir's Arena...duh!
translation: 여긴 Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)잖아... 그것도 몰라?

english: I'd like to access my bank, please.
Sure.
I'd like to collect items.
Yeah, okay.
Do you watch any matches?
Sure, I'll buy some rotten fruit.
No, I'm not giving you money for rotten fruit.
translation: 아뇨, 썩은 과일에 돈을 쓸 생각은 없어요.

english: Suit yourself.
Goodbye, Fadli.
What do you do?
What is this place?
I'd like to access my bank, please.
I'd like to collect items.
Do you watch any matches?
Have you got any idea where Burthorpe is? The co- ordinator says I need to go there and paint all the leaves yellow, but I've never heard of that place!
translation: Burthorpe(버소프)가 어딘지 혹시 아세요? co-ordinator(조정관)이 거기 가서 나뭇잎을 전부 노랗게 칠하라는데, 전 그런 곳은 들어 본 적도 없어요!

english: Be careful when you pick mushrooms near the strange ruins to the south. Some of them will try to eat you!
translation: 남쪽에 있는 이상한 폐허 근처에서 버섯을 딸 땐 조심하세요. 어떤 건 당신을 잡아먹으려고 하거든요!

english: Err, hello. Do you have any idea what a Winter Fairy actually does?
translation: 어, 안녕하세요. 혹시 Winter Fairy(겨울 요정)이 실제로 무슨 일을 하는지 아세요?

english: No, no idea at all.
Oh, pity. Neither do I, but I'm supposed to be one this week.
translation: 아, 아쉽네요. 저도 몰라요. 근데 이번 주엔 제가 그걸 해야 한대요.

english: Sorry, I can't talk I'm looking for Sarah-Jane!
translation: 미안해요, 지금 얘기할 시간이 없어요. Sarah-Jane(세라제인)을 찾고 있거든요!

english: Is your name Freddie, and are you loosing your teeth?
translation: 혹시 이름이 Freddie(프레디)고, 이가 빠지고 있나요?

english: Err, no. I'm afraid not.
Oh, right.
You don't have any idea where I can find him do you?
translation: 그 아이를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 혹시 모르시죠?

english: No, I don't know that either.
Oh, ok then. If you do find out please let me know. The co-ordinator has sent me to find him.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 혹시 알게 되면 꼭 알려 주세요. co-ordinator(조정관)이 그 아이를 찾아오라고 보냈거든요.

english: I'm afraid I can't stop to chat. I've just been told to get ready to go to Etceteria for some reason or other!
translation: 미안하지만 멈춰서 얘기할 시간이 없어요. 무슨 이유에선지 Etceteria(에트세테리아)로 갈 준비를 하라는 말을 방금 들었거든요!

english: Picking mushrooms near the forge will probably end quite badly for you.
translation: forge(대장간) 근처에서 버섯을 따면 아마 험한 꼴을 당하게 될 거예요.

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris! We shall over- throw the tyrant!
translation: 여왕님이야말로 Zanaris(자나리스)의 진정한 통치자예요! 우리가 그 폭군을 몰아낼 거예요!

english: Is the council finished yet?
Once the council of war is finished we shall go and get rid of the Godfather.
translation: 작전 회의가 끝나면 우리가 가서 Godfather(대부)를 쫓아낼 거예요.

english: I'm so looking forward to going back home!
Thank you for waking our queen.
Now that the Queen is awake everything will be alright.
translation: 이제 여왕님이 깨어나셨으니 다 괜찮아질 거예요.

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al-Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: 이 fairy ring(요정의 고리)는 Zanaris(자나리스) 밖으로 나가는 길이에요. 당신들 세계에서 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)라고 부르는 곳으로 이어지지요. 한 번 지나가면 이 길로는 돌아올 수 없어요.

english: Before leaving make sure that you have fully sampled the delights of our marketplace.
translation: 떠나기 전에 우리 시장의 즐길 거리를 빠짐없이 둘러보고 가세요.

english: I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
As you wish.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.
I think I'll stay down here a bit longer.
Yes, I'm ready to leave.
Hello, my name is [player name]. Who are you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 당신은 누구세요?

english: Oh hello [player name]. I'm Aeryka. Aery for short.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 저는 Aeryka(에어리카)예요. 줄여서 Aery(에어리)라고 불러요.

english: Airy Fairy?
That's right. What can I do for you?
What's that crop circle thing doing here?
translation: 저 crop circle(미스터리 서클) 같은 건 왜 여기 있는 거예요?

english: Crop circle? Oh, you mean the Puromantic portal?
translation: 미스터리 서클이요? 아, Puromantic portal(푸로맨틱 포털) 말씀이시군요?

english: The pyromanic what?
The Puromantic portal. At least that's what we call them. It's the way the implings travel from Puro-Puro to other planes.
translation: 푸로맨틱 포털이요. 적어도 우리는 그렇게 불러요. implings(임플링)이 Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에서 다른 세계로 건너갈 때 쓰는 길이에요.

english: Puro-Puro?
The impling home. We call it Puro-Puro. The implings just call it home, I think.
translation: 임플링들의 고향이요. 우리는 Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)라고 불러요. 임플링들은 그냥 집이라고 부르는 것 같지만요.

english: It's still here.
Pardon?
It's still here. The crop circle is still here.
translation: 아직 여기 있다고요. 미스터리 서클이 아직 그대로 있어요.

english: Oh yes, thanks Aery. It didn't go anywhere in the meantime, then?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 고마워요, Aery(에어리). 그동안 어디 가진 않았나 보네요?

english: Nope. It just sat there.
Jolly good. I can come back and visit Puro-Puro whenever I want then. Brilliant!
translation: 잘됐네요. 그럼 언제든지 다시 와서 Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에 갈 수 있겠어요. 멋져요!

english: What's in Puro-Puro?
Implings...and wheat.
Erm, anything else?
Not really. Though I have noticed quite a lot of you humans travelling through the portal recently. I suppose you must like wheat.
translation: 딱히 없어요. 그런데 요즘 당신네 인간들이 꽤 많이 포털을 지나가더라고요. 다들 밀을 좋아하나 봐요.

english: Well, most of us prefer lobsters to be perfectly honest, but there must be something interesting there.
translation: 음, 솔직히 대부분은 밀보다 바닷가재를 더 좋아하지만, 거기에 뭔가 흥미로운 게 있는 게 분명해요.

english: Oh, I did notice a very serious-looking gnome go into the portal. Maybe he knows what's going on.
translation: 아, 엄청 심각해 보이는 gnome(노움) 하나가 포털로 들어가는 걸 봤어요. 그 노움이라면 무슨 일인지 알지도 몰라요.

english: Do you remember what his name was?
Errm, Egg-nog, or something like that.
translation: 음, 에그녹이었나, 뭐 그 비슷한 이름이었어요.

english: Right, thanks! I'll have a chat with him when I go. Maybe he'll know what's going on.
translation: 알겠어요, 고마워요! 거기 가면 그 노움이랑 얘기해 볼게요. 무슨 일인지 알고 있을지도 모르니까요.

english: So what are these implings then?
Well, no-one knows for sure. The mischievous little creatures are probably related to imps. And they fly as well.
translation: 글쎄요, 확실히 아는 사람은 없어요. 그 장난꾸러기 꼬마들은 아마 imps(임프)랑 친척일 거예요. 날아다니기도 하고요.

english: Also, like imps, they love collecting things. I'm not sure why, though. They also seem to like being chased.
translation: 그리고 임프처럼 물건 모으는 걸 엄청 좋아해요. 왜 그런지는 저도 모르겠지만요. 쫓기는 것도 좋아하는 것 같아요.

english: So how would I get hold of what they are carrying, then?
translation: 그럼 걔들이 들고 다니는 걸 어떻게 손에 넣을 수 있죠?

english: Catch them, I suppose. I don't know really. Why would you want to?
translation: 잡으면 되겠죠, 아마도. 사실 저도 잘 몰라요. 근데 그걸 왜 갖고 싶은데요?

english: Well, if they were carrying something useful. Maybe I could catch them with a big net - like butterflies.
translation: 음, 쓸 만한 걸 들고 다닐 수도 있잖아요. 나비 잡듯이 큰 그물로 잡으면 되겠네요.

english: Sounds a bit cruel to me, but I suppose that's possible.
translation: 좀 잔인한 것 같지만, 뭐 가능은 하겠네요.

english: I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에서 dragon equipment(드래곤 장비)를 찾을 수 있다고 들었어요.

english: Really? You humans like that stuff a lot, don't you? I don't like really old stuff myself.
translation: 정말요? 당신네 인간들은 그런 걸 엄청 좋아하더라고요? 저는 아주 오래된 물건은 별로예요.

english: Old?
Yes, dragon stuff feels really old.
translation: 네, 드래곤 물건은 아주 오래된 느낌이 나요.

english: How can you tell that?
From its magical aura, obviously. Oh, I forget you humans can't feel auras.
translation: 당연히 마법 기운으로 알죠. 아, 인간들은 기운을 못 느낀다는 걸 깜빡했네요.

english: How old is old?
Really, really, old.
Can you be any more precise?
translation: 좀 더 정확하게 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Not really. Time doesn't really mean a lot round here. Hundreds, maybe thousands of your human lifespans, I suppose. Anyway, it would have to be old since it all comes from the Necrosyrtes.
translation: 딱히요. 여기선 시간이 별 의미가 없거든요. 인간 수명의 수백 배, 어쩌면 수천 배는 될걸요. 어쨌든 전부 Necrosyrtes(네크로시르테스)한테서 나온 거니까 오래될 수밖에 없죠.

english: Necrosyrtes? Who are they?
Old and powerful creatures. I don't think there have been any around here for aeons. I haven't seen one. I don't think they are very nice. Not like me. Anyway, this is all ancient history. Boooring!
translation: 오래되고 강력한 존재들이요. 이 근처엔 아주 오랫동안 하나도 없었을 거예요. 저도 본 적은 없어요. 별로 착한 애들은 아닐 거예요. 저랑은 다르게요. 아무튼 이건 다 옛날 옛적 이야기예요. 지루해!

english: While I'm on the subject do you have any dragon stuff I can have?
translation: 말 나온 김에, 혹시 저 줄 드래곤 물건 있어요?

english: Oh, I did have loads, but I threw it away.
What?
Only joking.

No, sorry, I can't help you there. You'll have to look for it yourself. Although, maybe if you find Necrosyrtes then they'll give you some. I heard they give dragon stuff away to people they like. Not fairies. We're too
translation: 아뇨, 미안하지만 그건 못 도와드려요. 직접 찾아보셔야 해요. 그래도 Necrosyrtes(네크로시르테스)를 찾으면 좀 줄지도 몰라요. 마음에 드는 사람한테 드래곤 물건을 나눠 준다고 들었거든요. 요정한텐 안 줘요. 우리는 너무

english: nice.
No, bye!
See you around!
What's in Puro-Puro?
So what are these implings then?
I've heard I may find dragon equipment in Puro-Puro.
translation: Puro-Puro(푸로푸로)에서 dragon equipment(드래곤 장비)를 찾을 수 있다고 들었어요.

english: No, bye!
What is it, human? Busy busy busy!
Why are you carrying that toolbox?
translation: 그 공구 상자는 왜 들고 다니세요?

english: It's the fizgog! It's picking up cable again!
translation: 피즈고그 때문이야! 또 케이블 방송이 잡힌다고!

english: Uh, right. So is it safe to use the fairy rings then?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그럼 fairy rings(요정의 고리)는 써도 안전한가요?

english: Sure, as long as you have been given permission to use them. You should just be aware that using the fairy rings sometimes has strange results, the locations that you have been to may affect the locations you are
translation: 그럼, 사용 허가만 받았다면야. 다만 요정의 고리를 쓰면 가끔 이상한 결과가 나온다는 건 알아 둬. 네가 가 본 곳들이 네가 가려는

english: trying to reach. I could fix it by replacing the fizgog and the whosprangit, I've put in a request for some new parts but they're pretty hard to get hold of, it seems.
translation: 곳에 영향을 줄 수 있거든. 피즈고그랑 후스프랭잇을 갈면 고칠 수 있는데, 새 부품을 요청해 놨지만 구하기가 꽤 어려운가 봐.

english: I'm okay, thanks.
Pssst! Human! I've got something for you.
translation: 쉿! 인간! 너한테 줄 게 있어.

english: What have you got for me?
They said you'd helped cure our Queen. I haven't got a lot of rewards to offer, but my enchantment scrolls might help if you're working with fairy rings in your home.
translation: 네가 우리 여왕님을 치료하는 걸 도왔다며. 줄 수 있는 보상이 많진 않지만, 집에서 fairy rings(요정의 고리)를 다룬다면 내 enchantment scrolls(마법 부여 두루마리)가 도움이 될 거야.

english: Not interested, thanks.
Why are you carrying that toolbox?
translation: 그 공구 상자는 왜 들고 다니세요?

english: I'm okay, thanks.
What have you got for me?
Not interested, thanks.
Who are you? Where's the Fairy Queen? What's going on here? Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
translation: 당신은 누구예요? Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)은 어디 있죠? 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요? 요정 여왕의 throne(왕좌)는 어디로 갔어요?

english: Ciao esploratore! So many questions. Whicha one would you hava me answer first?
translation: 차오, 에스플로라토레! 질문이 참 많구먼. 어느 것부터 대답해 주길 바라나?

english: Who are you?
Me?! I am-a da Fairy Godfather.
translation: 나?! 내가 바로 Fairy Godfather(요정 대부)라네.

english: I see-a by your face dat you have-a not-a heard of-a me. Irrespettoso, eet iz no eemportance. You weesh-a to know sometheeng else or no?
translation: 얼굴을 보아하니 나에 대해 들어 본 적이 없나 보구먼. 이레스페토소, 무례하긴. 뭐, 중요한 건 아니지. 또 알고 싶은 게 있나, 없나?

english: Where's the Fairy Queen?
Ah, eet iz a trageec-a tale. Da Queen Bee she iz-a, how-you-say, seek?
translation: 아, 그건 비극적인 이야기라네. 여왕벌이, 그러니까 뭐라더라, 아푸다?

english: You mean sick. What happened?
Ah, a tragedy to be-a struck-a down so young.
translation: 아, 그렇게 젊은 나이에 쓰러지다니 참으로 비극이지.

english: How-a much do ya know about-a fairy folk, my beeg friend?
translation: 요정족에 대해선 얼마나 알고 있나, 내 덩치 큰 친구?

english: Not actually a whole deal, I'm afraid.
Well, let-a me enlighten yous. Zanaris iz-a nexus of-a da worlds. Da Queen Bee, she iz-a da guardian of-a all da folk dat live-a in Zanaris.
translation: 그럼 내가 알려 주지. Zanaris(자나리스)는 여러 세계가 이어지는 중심지라네. 여왕벌은 자나리스에 사는 모든 족속의 수호자이지.

english: So when-a thees Tanglefoot arrives, da Queen Bee she-a goes to da Cosmic Temple area to kill-a eet, but someting goes-a wrong. Da Queen Bee, she gets-a hurt and is-a now inna da magic sleep.
translation: 그런데 이 Tanglefoot(탱글풋)이 나타나자 여왕벌이 그걸 죽이러 Cosmic Temple(우주 신전) 쪽으로 갔는데, 뭔가 잘못됐지. 여왕벌은 다쳐서 지금은 마법의 잠에 빠져 있다네.

english: She is-a being cared for by-a Fairy Nuff, who lives-a just north of-a da bank.
translation: 지금은 은행 바로 북쪽에 사는 Fairy Nuff(요정 너프)가 돌보고 있지.

english: Thanks, I'll go see her then. Goodbye.
translation: 고마워요, 그럼 그분을 만나러 가 볼게요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Ciao. Oh, and [player name]...
Yes?
A word-a of advice. You be-a careful not to cause da trouble for da folk while you are in Zanaris. Ciao.
translation: 충고 하나 하지. Zanaris(자나리스)에 있는 동안 우리 족속들한테 말썽 일으키지 않게 조심하게나. 차오.

english: Da Boss is a busy fairy! He don' have time to talk to yous humans. Vamoose!
translation: 보스는 바쁘신 요정이다! 너 같은 인간들이랑 떠들 시간 없으셔. 썩 꺼져!

english: Ciao [player name]. I am-a glad to see-a yous back! I was-a worried that the Tanglefoot would-a kill-a you too.
translation: 차오, [player name]. 자네가 돌아와서 기쁘구먼! Tanglefoot(탱글풋)이 자네까지 죽일까 봐 걱정했다네.

english: You needn't have worried I managed to kill it!
Ben fatto, my friend! Da folk-a dey owe yous a great-a deal! So did-a yous getta back da Queen Bee's magic power?
translation: 벤 파토, 내 친구! 우리 족속들이 자네한테 큰 빚을 졌구먼! 그래서 여왕벌의 마법 힘은 되찾아 왔나?

english: I don't have the Fairy Queen's secateurs with me.
translation: Fairy Queen's secateurs(요정 여왕의 전지가위)를 안 가지고 왔어요.

english: Ah, [player name]. I can-a do nutting to help-a da Queen Bee without-a da secateurs. Please, bring-a dem to me as soon as-a you can!
translation: 아, [player name]. secateurs(전지가위)가 없으면 내가 여왕벌을 도울 방법이 전혀 없다네. 제발 최대한 빨리 그걸 가져다주게!

english: I obtained this pair of Enchanted secateurs, I think they must contain the Queen's missing magic.
translation: 이 Enchanted secateurs(마법이 깃든 전지가위)를 얻었어요. 여기에 여왕님이 잃어버린 마법이 들어 있는 것 같아요.

english: Grazie infinite! I will give-a dem to da healing fairy. Da Queen Bee, she will-a soon be strong again!
translation: 그라치에 인피니테! 이걸 치유 요정한테 주겠네. 여왕벌은 곧 다시 기운을 차릴 거라네!

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
The Godfather is ignoring you.
Godfather! Where is the Fairy Queen?
translation: 대부님! Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)은 어디 있어요?

english: Whata are you-a talking about?
I've just been to Fairy Nuff's cave and when I got there I found it ransacked! Everything has been broken and the Fairy Queen and Fairy Nuff are missing!
translation: 방금 Fairy Nuff(요정 너프)의 동굴에 갔는데, 가 보니 다 엉망으로 털려 있었어요! 전부 부서져 있고 요정 여왕이랑 요정 너프가 사라졌어요!

english: Essere nel panico! You-a say datta Queen Bee, she izza meesing? Theez izza terreeble! Who could-a have done such a theeng? We musta find her! I weel organise a search-a party right-a-way!
translation: 에세레 넬 파니코! 여왕벌이 사라졌다고? 이건 끔찍한 일이구먼! 누가 감히 그런 짓을 했단 말인가? 반드시 찾아야 하네! 당장 수색대를 꾸리겠네!

english: Calm down! Let's think this through carefully.
Do you have any idea who could have done this?
translation: 누가 이런 짓을 했는지 짐작 가는 데 있으세요?

english: Errm...no! None atta all! Da Queen Bee, she izza well liked by-a everyone.
translation: 어음... 없네! 전혀 없어! 여왕벌은 모두에게 사랑받는 분이라네.

english: That's not very helpful.
Where could she have been taken to?
Ze keednapper must-a have taken her through-a da fairyreengs. Dey weel-a be long gone by-a now.
translation: 납치범이 분명 fairyrings(요정의 고리)를 통해 데려갔을 거라네. 지금쯤이면 멀리 가 버렸겠지.

english: We must go after them!
Yes! We must-a, but most-a of da folk are away from Zanaris atta the momento.
translation: 그렇지! 그래야 하네. 그런데 지금은 우리 족속 대부분이 Zanaris(자나리스)를 떠나 있다네.

english: Well tell me what to do and I'll go myself.
translation: 그럼 어떻게 하면 되는지 알려 주세요. 제가 직접 갈게요.

english: Ye-es, dat izza good idea. Hokay, you may use-a da fairyreengs. Talk-a to da co-ordinator, she will-a explain-a to you how to use-a da reengs, but you must-a promees me dat you weel come-a back-a here, eef you
translation: 그-래, 그거 좋은 생각이구먼. 좋아, 요정의 고리를 써도 되네. co-ordinator(조정관)한테 가서 얘기하게. 조정관이 고리 쓰는 법을 알려 줄 걸세. 하지만 약속해야 하네, 만약 자네가

english: find-a her. Whoever keednapped her must-a be very powerful. You find-a da Queen Bee and den-a yous come right back here and we will-a rescue her together. Hokay?
translation: 그분을 찾으면 꼭 여기로 돌아오겠다고. 그분을 납치한 놈은 아주 강한 자가 분명하네. 여왕벌을 찾거든 곧장 여기로 돌아오게. 그럼 우리가 함께 구출하는 걸세. 알겠나?

english: No, I'll rescue her myself.
Oh no, dat eet eez no good. Yous wanna to be da hero, but what-a about me? She izza my queen! No, no. You cannot-a use-a da fairyreengs
translation: 오, 안 되지, 그건 안 되네. 자네는 영웅이 되고 싶겠지만, 그럼 나는 어쩌라고? 그분은 나의 여왕이란 말일세! 안 돼, 안 돼. 자네는 요정의 고리를 쓸 수 없네

english: Where have all the fairies gone?
Da people are mostly out-a and about-a tryeeng to keep-a theengs working. Eet izza not easy weeth da Queen Bee notta here!
translation: 다들 일이 돌아가게 하느라 밖에 나가 있다네. 여왕벌이 없으니 쉽지가 않구먼!

english: Ah, [player name], yous hassa changed your mind? Yous weel-a come and getta me before yous rescue da Queen Bee? Only den can-a I geev yous permission to use-a da reengs.
translation: 아, [player name], 마음이 바뀌었나? 여왕벌을 구하기 전에 날 데리러 오겠다는 겐가? 그래야만 고리를 쓰도록 허락해 줄 수 있다네.

english: Oh, okay then.
Good, I knew-a you would change-a your mind. Now I just-a need you to sign-a dis scroll before I geev-a yous da permission to use-a da fairyreengs.
translation: 좋아, 마음을 바꿀 줄 알았지. 이제 요정의 고리를 쓰도록 허락하기 전에 이 두루마리에 서명만 해 주면 되네.

english: I am not signing this! It says I am indebted to you until you release me!
translation: 이건 서명 못 해요! 당신이 풀어 줄 때까지 제가 당신한테 빚을 진다고 적혀 있잖아요!

english: Eet does? Oh, sorry, must-a geeven yous da wrong-a scroll. Tell-a yous what, yous hazza da honest face, so I'll trust-a yous. Go ahead, use-a da fairyreengs, but just-a make sure dat yous come-a back here and tell-a
translation: 그렇게 적혀 있나? 아, 미안하네, 엉뚱한 두루마리를 줬나 보구먼. 이렇게 하지, 자네는 정직한 얼굴을 하고 있으니 믿어 주겠네. 어서 요정의 고리를 쓰게. 대신 꼭 여기로 돌아와서

english: me when-a yous finda da Queen Bee, like-a yous promised. Now go-a and talk-a to da co-ordinator. She-a weel tell-a yous how da fairyreengs work.
translation: 여왕벌을 찾으면 약속대로 나한테 말해 줘야 하네. 이제 co-ordinator(조정관)한테 가서 얘기하게. 요정의 고리가 어떻게 작동하는지 알려 줄 걸세.

english: No, there's no chance of that happening.
translation: 아뇨, 그럴 일은 절대 없을 거예요.

english: Yous weel change-a your mind. Come and talk-a to me me yous do.
translation: 자네 마음은 바뀔 걸세. 마음이 바뀌면 나한테 와서 얘기하게.

english: [player name], you are-a back! Have-a you found da Queen Bee?
Err, no, not yet.
Den whatta are you doing-a back here? Go and-a search for her!
translation: 그럼 여기 돌아와서 뭘 하고 있나? 어서 가서 찾아보게!

english: Err, Godfather, I can't help noticing that there seems to be Orcs wandering around Zanaris.
translation: 저기, 대부님, Zanaris(자나리스)에 Orcs(오크)가 돌아다니는 게 자꾸 눈에 띄는데요.

english: Yous just-a better keep-a your nose outa my business. I's da Godfather and I's da one who's inna charge here.
translation: 자네는 내 일에 코 들이밀지 않는 게 좋을 걸세. 내가 대부고, 여기 책임자도 바로 나라네.

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 이 이상한 표시들이 무슨 뜻인지 아세요?

english: For why you show-a me dat? Eez very nice to see yous learning to draw! Bravo!
translation: 그걸 왜 나한테 보여 주나? 자네가 그림 그리는 걸 배우다니 참 보기 좋구먼! 브라보!

english: Ah, iz-a you. I make-a you an offer, eh? Iz-a good offer. You can't-a refuse it.
translation: 아, 자네로구먼. 내가 제안을 하나 하지, 응? 좋은 제안이라네. 거절할 수 없을 걸세.

english: What?
You tell-a me ze answer to dis, si?
translation: 이 문제의 답을 말해 보게, 카피시?

english: You tell-a me your answer, si?
Iz-a no good.
Grazie infinite!
Who are you?
Where's the Fairy Queen?
What's going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
translation: Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)의 throne(왕좌)는 어디로 갔어요?

english: Where is the Fairy Queen?
Do you have any idea who could have done this?
translation: 누가 이런 짓을 했는지 짐작 가는 데 있으세요?

english: Where could she have been taken to?
Yes, okay.
No, I'll rescue her myself.
Where have all the fairies gone?
Oh, okay then.
No, there's no chance of that happening.
translation: 아뇨, 그럴 일은 절대 없을 거예요.

english: Why aren't you in the war room with the Fairy Queen and her advisors?
translation: 왜 Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)과 조언자들이랑 같이 작전실에 안 계세요?

english: I don't like war! I don't believe that violence is ever justified, that's why I became a healer.
translation: 전 전쟁이 싫어요! 폭력은 어떤 경우에도 정당화될 수 없다고 믿거든요. 그래서 치유사가 된 거예요.

english: How do crops and such survive down here? Surely they need a bit of sunlight?
translation: 여기 아래에서 작물 같은 건 어떻게 살아남아요? 햇빛이 조금은 필요할 텐데요?

english: Clearly you come from a plane dependent on sunlight. Down here, the plants grow in the aura of faerie.
translation: 그대는 햇빛에 의존하는 세계에서 왔군요. 이 아래에서는 식물이 요정계의 기운 속에서 자란답니다.

english: What's so good about this place?
Zanaris is a meeting point of cultures. Those from many worlds converge here to exchange knowledge and goods.
translation: Zanaris(자나리스)는 여러 문화가 만나는 곳이에요. 수많은 세계의 이들이 이곳에 모여 지식과 물건을 나누지요.

english: Have you managed to work out a plan yet?
Not yet, [player name], but it looks like we'll need to ask you for your help again, I'm afraid. I'll be able to tell you more once we have finished making our battle plans.
translation: 아직이에요, [player name]. 하지만 안타깝게도 또 그대의 도움을 청해야 할 것 같군요. 작전 계획을 다 세우고 나면 더 자세히 말해 줄 수 있을 거예요.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 이걸 좀 풀어 주세요. 나는 생각해야 할 다른 일들이 있답니다.

english: The Fairy Queen has given you a puzzle box!
translation: Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)이 퍼즐 상자를 주었다!

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
The Fairy Queen has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: How do crops and such survive down here?
translation: 여기 아래에서 작물 같은 건 어떻게 살아남아요?

english: What's so good about this place?
How goes the council of war?
Slowly, I'm afraid. We're still trying to come up with a reasonable plan.
translation: 안타깝게도 더디다네. 아직 쓸 만한 계획을 짜내려고 애쓰는 중일세.

english: 'Ello, sugar. I'm afraid I can't gossip right now, I've got a cake in the oven.
translation: 어머, 얘야. 미안하지만 지금은 수다 떨 시간이 없어. 오븐에 케이크를 넣어 놨거든.

english: Oi you! Did you think I didn't see that? That's my chocolate bar, that is!
translation: 야, 너! 내가 못 본 줄 알았니? 그거 내 chocolate bar(초콜릿 바)란 말이야!

english: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise it belonged to anybody.
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 주인이 있는 줄 몰랐어요.

english: That's alright, honey. You look a bit thin anyway. Take it if you need it.
translation: 괜찮아, 얘야. 그러고 보니 좀 말라 보이네. 필요하면 가져가렴.

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 이 이상한 표시들이 무슨 뜻인지 아세요?

english: Sorry dearie, no, but I have seen a sign with similar marks near the mysterious ruins. You know, the ones that lead you to the Cosmic Rune Altar.
translation: 미안하구나, 아가. 모르겠어. 그래도 mysterious ruins(신비한 폐허) 근처에서 비슷한 표시가 있는 표지판을 본 적은 있단다. 왜, Cosmic Rune Altar(우주 룬 제단)으로 이어지는 그 폐허 말이야.

english: Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi there [player name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 저는 bard(음유시인) Falo(팔로)예요! Rellekka(렐레카)에 사는 제 형 Olaf(올라프)처럼 저도 음악을 써요.

english: (continues below)
Hi there [Fremennik name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 안녕하세요, [Fremennik name] 님. 저는 bard(음유시인) Falo(팔로)예요! Rellekka(렐레카)에 사는 제 형 Olaf(올라프)처럼 저도 음악을 써요.

english: Do you write about anything in particular?
Oh most certainly! I write about all the objects in the lands. From weapons and armour to palm trees and sands. That's why I wander far from Rellekka to seek inspiration.
translation: 물론이죠! 저는 이 땅의 온갖 물건에 대해 써요. 무기와 갑옷에서부터 야자수와 모래까지요. 그래서 영감을 찾아 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 멀리 떠돌아다니는 거예요.

english: I have one problem though. I am very forgetful, I can never remember which particular object a song was about.
translation: 그런데 문제가 하나 있어요. 제가 건망증이 아주 심해서, 어떤 노래가 무슨 물건에 대한 건지 도무지 기억을 못 해요.

english: Surely the lyrics for such a song would be enough to help you remember?
translation: 그런 노래라면 가사만 들어도 기억이 나지 않을까요?

english: I am afraid not. It saddens me deeply, so I often send out messages to adventurers to help me discreetly.
translation: 안타깝게도 그렇지가 않아요. 그게 너무 슬퍼서, 모험가들에게 몰래 도와 달라는 전갈을 자주 보낸답니다.

english: I'll keep a look out for them! Goodbye Falo.
Hi there! Who are you?
Get away! I do not speak to outlanders.
translation: 저리 가세요! 저는 이방인과는 이야기하지 않아요.

english: Thank you for coming [Fremennik name], I need your help.
translation: 와 주셔서 고마워요, [Fremennik name] 님. 당신의 도움이 필요해요.

english: I have one of my old songs stuck in my head, but I cannot remember what the object it refers to is. I am so forgetful. I'll sing it to you.
translation: 제 옛 노래 하나가 머릿속에서 맴도는데, 그 노래가 무슨 물건에 대한 건지 기억이 안 나요. 제가 건망증이 너무 심해서요. 불러 드릴게요.

english: What a beautiful song!
You have very kind words. I would be extremely grateful if you could remind me which object the song was about.
translation: 친절한 말씀 고마워요. 그 노래가 무슨 물건에 대한 건지 알려 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: I really hope you can help me. Please show me the object my song is about!
translation: 꼭 도와주셨으면 좋겠어요. 제 노래가 말하는 그 물건을 보여 주세요!

english: Can you sing me the song again?
translation: 그 노래 한 번 더 불러 줄 수 있어요?

english: Okay, here goes... [random song]
You show your object to Falo.
Falo's eyes light up.
Yes yes yes! That is it, thank you so much [Fremennik name]. The memories have come flooding back. I get why the lyrics are what they are now.
translation: 맞아요, 맞아, 바로 그거예요! 정말 고마워요, [Fremennik name] 님. 기억이 물밀듯이 돌아왔어요. 이제야 가사가 왜 그런지 알겠네요.

english: I'm glad to have helped, hopefully you'll never forget again!
translation: 도움이 됐다니 기뻐요. 다시는 안 잊으시길 바라요!

english: Falo's eyes fail to light up.
No no no! That's not it. Please have another think about it, [Fremennik name].
translation: 아니, 아니, 아니에요! 그게 아니에요. 다시 한번 생각해 봐 주세요, [Fremennik name] 님.

english: Arr!
Is there something I can help ye with?
I would like to join your crew.
Of course you would!
However, I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: 그런데 말이야, 모자나 투구를 쓴 녀석은 우리 팀에 안 받아.

english: You can go and store it in the deposit box next to Jimmy's stall.
translation: Jimmy(지미)의 노점 옆에 있는 예치함에 넣어 두고 와.

english: Why not?
Well, in order to tell my crew from San Fan's I will need to give you a hat like mine.
translation: 음, 내 선원이랑 San Fan(샌 팬)네 선원을 구별하려면 내 것 같은 모자를 줘야 하거든.

english: If you are wearing a hat it might get lost when I give you my crew's hat.
translation: 네가 모자를 쓰고 있으면 우리 선원 모자를 줄 때 그게 없어질 수도 있다고.

english: You wouldn't want that would you?
No, that sounds very reasonable in fact.
Well, I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: 자, 배에 태워 주는 건 좋은데, 먼저 장비를 전부 맡기고 와야 해.

english: What do you mean?
Well, you will need all of your inventory space for the ingredients, and all of the other things I'll need you to haul about.
translation: 음, 재료며 이것저것 내가 날라 달라고 할 물건을 담으려면 소지품 칸이 전부 필요하거든.

english: There is a bank deposit box next to Jimmy's stall if you need it. Come and see me when you have a fully empty inventory.
translation: 필요하면 Jimmy(지미)의 노점 옆에 bank deposit box(은행 예치함)이 있어. 소지품을 완전히 비운 다음에 날 찾아와.

english: Sadly for you however, I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: 그런데 안됐군, 내 선원은 이미 차고 넘쳐.

english: Oh, all right.
Is that...thing yours?
You mean my cat?
Yes, I mean your cat! I HATE cats! Get it out of here!
translation: 그래, 네 고양이 말이야! 난 고양이가 정말 싫어! 당장 치워!

english: Filthy things, no better than the rats that they catch.
translation: 더러운 것들, 저것들이 잡는 쥐새끼나 다를 바 없다고.

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 따라다니는 동물은 게임에 데려갈 수 없어.

english: Arr, well we'll get you sorted out with a team hat right away.
translation: 아르, 좋아. 바로 팀 모자를 챙겨 주지.

english: Go wait in the waiting room, I'll call you when we are ready to begin.
translation: 대기실에 가서 기다려. 시작할 준비가 되면 부르지.

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
Arrharrharr!
Do you not recognise me? I am the famous dandy pirate 'Fancy' Dan!
translation: 날 못 알아보는 거냐? 내가 바로 그 유명한 댄디 해적, 'Fancy' Dan('멋쟁이' 댄)이시다!

english: Yes, of course, any pirate knows who you are.
translation: 네, 물론이죠. 해적이라면 다 당신을 알죠.

english: But of course.
As for what this place is, it is my glorious still, producing the best quality 'rum' this side of Braindeath Island.
translation: 여기가 어디냐 하면, 바로 나의 영광스러운 증류소지. Braindeath Island(브레인데스 섬) 이쪽 바다에서는 최고 품질의 'rum'(럼주)를 만드는 곳이야.

english: Oh, and the run-down swill-producing ditch that San Fan over there calls a still.
translation: 아, 그리고 저기 San Fan(샌 팬)이 증류소라고 부르는, 구정물이나 만드는 다 쓰러져 가는 도랑도 있지.
