english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
Well we would do, if that hatchet-faced harridan wouldn't keep trying to torch the place!
translation: 그랬겠지, 저 뾰족한 낯짝의 사나운 여편네가 자꾸 여기 불을 지르려고만 안 하면 말이야!

english: I say!
A little while ago we had some real problems getting rum to the island, hence the two stills.
translation: 얼마 전에 섬으로 럼주를 들여오는 데 큰 문제가 있었어. 그래서 증류소를 두 개 만든 거지.

english: However, after a little misunderstanding involving San's still and a barrel of gunpowder our relationship seems to have become a little strained.
translation: 그런데 San(샌)의 증류소랑 화약 한 통이 얽힌 작은 오해가 있은 뒤로, 우리 사이가 좀 껄끄러워진 모양이야.

english: Apparently it is perfectly within the pirate code to burn each others stills, so long as nobody directly attacks the other person's crew, so rum production has taken a slight dip of late.
translation: 듣자 하니 상대 선원을 직접 공격하지만 않으면 서로 증류소를 불태우는 건 해적 규약에 전혀 어긋나지 않는다더군. 그래서 요즘 럼주 생산량이 살짝 줄었어.

english: Can I help out?
Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 그래, 아마도. 할 만하다 싶으면 맡길 일이 잔뜩 있어.

english: What would you like to know about?
How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 음, 여기 차려 놓은 증류소는 Braindeath island(브레인데스 섬)에 있는 걸 본뜬 거야... 뭐, 대충 그렇다는 거지.

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 넌 hopper(호퍼)에 재료 넣는 걸 돕고 보일러 불만 계속 꺼지지 않게 하면 돼.

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 호퍼에 재료를 충분히 넣으면, 럼주가 다 빚어졌을 때 한 병을 가져갈 수 있어.

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 그러니까 물 양동이 5개를 호퍼에 넣으면 한 병을 가져갈 수 있어. 색물 그릇 3개를 넣어도 한 병, 그 밖의 재료는 하나만 넣어도 한 병이야.

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 이건 누적돼. 예를 들어 물 양동이 10개, sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레) 3개, 색물 그릇 6개를 넣으면 팀을 위해 럼주 7병을 모을 기회가 생기는 거지.

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 보일러는 식은 죽 먹기야. logs(통나무)를 넣고 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)으로 불을 붙인 다음, 충분히 뜨거워질 때까지 통나무를 계속 넣으면 돼.

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 통나무 세 개면 될 거야. 그래도 혹시 모르니 계속 쌓아 넣는 게 좋아.

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 재료는 이래. Bitternuts(쓴 견과), Scrapey Tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질, Sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레), 물 양동이, 그리고 색물 약간.

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 이 담장 안쪽에 Bitternut(쓴 견과) 나무가 많이 있어. 문제는 사람이 오르기엔 나무가 너무 까다롭다는 거지.

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 원숭이를 잡아서 나무 위로 올려 보내 열매를 따 오게 해야 해.

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 나무 위로 올려 보낸다고요? 그게 어떻게 되는데요?

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 음, 네가 원숭이인데 웬 낯선 놈이 널 붙잡아 털에 염료를 들이붓고 나무 위로 떠밀면, 너도 제일 가까운 무거운 걸 그놈한테 집어 던지겠지.

english: Wait a second, dye?
Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 그래, 색물 한 그릇을 구해서 원숭이한테 부어야 해. 안 그러면 그 원숭이가 어느 팀 건지 알 수가 없거든.

english: That makes sense...I think...
Anything else?
Can I ask about something else?
Ok, what else?
So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: 그럼... 적의 증류소는 어떻게 망가뜨리면 돼요?

english: Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: Scrapey tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질은 어디서 구해요... 그리고 왜 대답이 마음에 안 들 것 같은 기분이 들죠?

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 이 담장 안쪽에 Scrapey tree(스크레이피 나무)가 몇 그루 있어. 크고 병든 것처럼 생긴 나무라 못 보고 지나칠 수가 없지.

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 간단히 말해, 나무를 베고 knife(칼)로 껍질을 벗겨 내면 돼.

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends somake people feel kind offill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 꽤 간단해. 다만 수액이 몸에 묻으면 좀 속이 안 좋아지는 경향이 있지.

english: How ill?
Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 걱정 마. 죽을 만큼 아프다거나 그런 건 아니니까.

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 그냥 한동안 꽤 어지럽고 힘이 빠지는 정도야.

english: Joy...
Sweetgrubs? What are they?
Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 음, 이 근방엔 sluglings(새끼 민달팽이)가 없어서 대신 Sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레)라는 작은 애벌레를 넣어. 구역질 나는 뒷맛만 무시하면 꽤 달달하다고.

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 어... 어떻게 이런 걸 마실 수가 있어요?

english: Quite easily!
Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 해적이 괜히 터프하기로 유명한 게 아니라고.

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 음, 저 안에 sweetgrub(단맛 애벌레) 둔덕이 몇 개 있어. 쥐고기가 한 줌 있으니 그걸 둔덕에 쓰면 애벌레가 땅 위로 기어 나와.

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 그래도 손가락 조심해. 아주 게걸스러운 녀석들이거든.

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: Braindeath 'Rum'(브레인데스 '럼주')보다 역겨운 건 없을 줄 알았는데 말이죠.

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 아르, 그게 바로 네 착각이란다, [lad/lass]. 새롭게 개선된 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic(브레인데스 '럼주' 클래식)은 이제 선두 경쟁 제품보다 200% 더 역겹거든!

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 법적 고지: 새로운 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic(브레인데스 '럼주' 클래식)의 위험한 수준의 역겨움은 임산부, 당나귀, 그리고 성이 일곱 글자를 넘는 사람에게는 너무 과할 수 있음.

english: What was that?
What was what?
Is there anything else?
How do I get...
Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 아니, 잠깐만요. 이 질문은 제가 뭘 하는지 전혀 모르는 사람처럼 들리겠네요.

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 여기저기 몇 개 굴러다녀. 마음대로 써.

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 증류소 안에 pump(펌프)가 있어. 그게 돌아가기만 하면 물은 거의 무한정 쓸 수 있을 거야.

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 잠깐만요, 물을 붓기 전에 역겹거나 치명적일 수도 있는 뭔가를 섞어야 하는 건 아니죠?

english: Perish the thought!
Ok, just checking.
What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 색물이라는 게 어떤 걸 말하는 거예요?

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 음, 저쪽 증류소에 꽃이 자라는 황무지가 있어. 거기서 꽃을 한 송이 뽑아다 kettle(주전자)에 쑤셔 넣으면 끓는 물에 색이 우러나와.

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 그 색으로 우리 럼주를 쉽게 알아보게 하는 거지.

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 그럼 주전자를 그냥 호퍼에 비우면 되는 거죠?

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 아니, 아니. 빈 그릇을 가져가서 주전자 물을 담아야 해.

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 그래야 필요할 때 그걸 원숭이한테 쓸 수 있잖아.

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
How do I repair the still?
Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 음, 그 비열한 개자식들이 어딘가에 불을 붙이는 데 성공했다면, 고치기 전에 먼저 물 양동이를 부어야 해.

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
How can I repair hoppers?
Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 음, 불이 붙은 게 아니라면 무거운 목재 덧판을 쓰기만 하면 돼. 웬만한 구멍은 다 덮을 만큼 크거든.

english: Will I need a hammer?
No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 아니, 그냥 제자리에 밀어 넣고 딱 맞을 때까지 두들기면 돼.

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 음, 망가진 부분에 pipe section(파이프 토막)을 쓰면 쉽게 갈아 끼울 수 있을 거야.

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 아니, 아마 낡은 걸 두들겨서 빼내고 새 걸 손으로 끼워 넣기만 하면 될 거야.

english: How do I repair bridges?
Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 음, 다리 수리에 쓸 수 있는 편리한 다리 부품이 있어.

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 진짜 문제는 말이야, 증류소는 조금 망가져도 계속 돌아가는데, 다리는 살짝만 망가져도 완전히 못 쓰게 된다는 거야.

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: 그게 문제가 될까요? 그냥 뛰어서 건널 수 있을 것 같은데요.

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: 그러지 마! 변호사들 말로는 불탄 다리를 뛰어넘다 다친 건 보상이 안 된대.

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: 진심이야, 다리가 고쳐질 때까지 다리엔 얼씬도 하지 마.

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
translation: 그런데 이 물건들은 다 어디서 구해요?

english: We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: 증류소 안 탁자에 이미 물건을 잔뜩 올려놨어. 통나무를 좀 구해 오면 새로 만들 수도 있고.

english: How does that work?
We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: 증류소 안에 work table(작업 탁자)를 차려 놨어. 거기에 통나무를 쓰면 증류소 부품을 대신할 쓸 만한 걸 만들 수 있지.

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: 맞을지는 걱정 마. 그 물건들은 이제 못이랑 교체 부품이랑 그을음으로 겨우 붙어 있는 거니까.

english: Well...how sanitary...
Ok, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 좋아요, 이 정도면 충분히 들은 것 같아요.

english: Fine. Glad I could help.
Ok, here's what you need to do.
The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: 이 근처 나무는 바싹 말라서 불이 잘 붙어. 그러니 횃불 하나를 집어서 불을 붙인 다음, 그걸로 적의 증류소를 공격해.

english: That's it?
Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: 저쪽 증류소는 대부분 '알코올'에 흠뻑 젖어 있고 바싹 마른 나무로 만들어졌거든.

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: 한마디로, 우리 게 아니면 횃불을 갖다 대 보고 어떻게 되나 봐.

english: Ok, I get you.
So what will you give me for helping out?
Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: 하하하하! 돈부터 밝히는 녀석이로군! 넌 여기서 잘 해낼 거야.

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: 음, 너희 팀이 럼주를 한 병 만들 때마다 piece of eight(8레알 은화)를 하나씩 주지.

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: 뭔가에 불을 지르는 데 성공하면 하나 더 얹어 주고, 증류소를 고쳐도 마찬가지야.

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: 이 pieces of eight(8레알 은화)는 어디에 쓸 수 있어요?

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: 저기 Honest Jimmy(정직한 지미) 보이지? 그걸 주면 꽤 괜찮은 물건이랑 바꿔 줄 거야.

english: Great!
I don't let anyone on the team if they are wearing a hat or a helmet.
translation: 모자나 투구를 쓴 녀석은 우리 팀에 안 받아.

english: I'll be glad to have you aboard, but you will need to go and store all of your gear first.
translation: 배에 태워 주는 건 좋은데, 먼저 장비를 전부 맡기고 와야 해.

english: Sadly for you I have more than enough people on my crew.
translation: 안됐지만 내 선원은 이미 차고 넘쳐.

english: Is that... thing yours?
This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 이 미니게임은 이 월드에서 이용할 수 없어.

english: So, how well can you cook?
Well, I can, err, cook a bit...
Well 'a bit' doesn't cut it in here. Come back when you have a cooking level of 40.
translation: 여기선 '조금'으론 어림없어. Cooking(요리) 레벨 40이 되면 다시 와.

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
Come join me crew!
Don't join them, join us!
Free(ish) rum fer all!
Join the winnin' team now!
Need pirates fer brewin'!
Recruiting!
Roll up, roll up!
We have dental!
I would like to join your crew.
Who are you, and what is this place?
Brewing 'Rum'
Where can I get Bitternuts?
Can I ask about something else?
Repairing the Still
Sabotaging the Still
What will you pay me?
Ok, I think I've heard enough
translation: 좋아요, 이 정도면 충분히 들은 것 같아요

english: Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
translation: Scrapey Tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질은 어디서 구해요?

english: Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
Where can I get buckets of water?
Where can I get coloured water?
How do I repair Hoppers?
How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
How do I repair Bridges?
How do I get repair items?
How Do I repair Hoppers?
How do I get repair items
Sabotaging San's Still
Ha, well I'm retired now, but in my heyday I was quite the expert fisherman! These days I just help out around the village where I can, my old bones don't allow me to do any more than that.
translation: 하, 이제는 은퇴했지만 한창때는 꽤 알아주는 낚시 고수였답니다! 요즘은 그냥 마을에서 할 수 있는 일을 거들 뿐이에요. 늙은 뼈가 그 이상은 허락하질 않거든요.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 뭐 재미있는 할 일 없어요?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 브와나, 오늘 누가 또 그걸 물어보면 저 폭발해 버릴 거예요! 다른 사람한테 가서 물어보세요!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 제가 알기로는 없어요. 그냥 편히 앉아서 햇볕이나 즐기세요, 브와나!

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 음, 할 일이 좀 있을 것 같은데요... Murcaily(머케일리)가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요. 그 사람은 보통 Trufitus(트루피투스)의 오두막 동쪽에 있는 경목 숲을 돌봐요.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 여기는 그냥 평범한 마을 생활이에요, 브와나. 열심히 찾아보면 시간 보낼 재미있는 일이 늘 있답니다.

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 미안해요, 브와나. 전 지금 바빠요. Murcaily(머케일리)한테 가서 얘기해 보는 게 어때요! 마을 어딘가에 있을 거예요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hello there...thanks for helping out Trufitus commune with the gods Bwana. We've been able to return to the village thanks to your help.
translation: 안녕하세요... Trufitus(트루피투스)가 신들과 교감할 수 있게 도와줘서 고마워요, 브와나. 덕분에 저희가 마을로 돌아올 수 있었어요.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 그래요, 이 근방에서 좋은 일을 많이 해 주셨죠. 시간과 수고에 대한 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)는 이미 드렸고, 지금은 가진 게 더 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 얘기해 보고 기부를 좀 받아 보는 게 어때요?

english: Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 뭐가 문제죠....아, 이 크고 무서운 가면을 쓰고 있었구나! 원주민들한테 말 걸기 전에 벗는 게 좋겠어.

english: Ahhhhhhhh!
Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 으아아아앙! - 내 영혼을 잡아먹으러 온 사악한 broodoo(브루두) 짐승이다!

english: What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 여기 뭐 재미있는 할 일 없어요?

english: Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
Hello, little boy.
I would prefer it if you didn't speak to me in such a manner. I'll have you know I'm an accomplished merchant.
translation: 그런 식으로 말하지 말아 주셨으면 좋겠군요. 말씀드리지만 저는 뛰어난 상인이라고요.

english: Calm down, junior.
Don't tell me to calm down! And don't call me 'junior'.
translation: 진정하라고 하지 마세요! 그리고 '꼬맹이'라고 부르지 마세요.

english: I'll have you know I am Farid Morrisane, son of Ali Morrisane, the world's greatest merchant!
translation: 말씀드리지만 저는 Farid Morrisane(파리드 모리세인), 세계 최고의 상인 Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)의 아들이라고요!

english: Then why are you here and not him?
translation: 그럼 왜 아버지 말고 네가 여기 있는 건데?

english: My dad has given me the responsibility of expanding our business here.
translation: 아버지께서 여기서 사업을 넓히는 책임을 저한테 맡기셨어요.

english: And you're up to the task? What a grown up boy you are! Mummy and daddy must be very pleased!
translation: 그래서 그 일을 감당할 수 있다고? 아이고, 다 컸네! 엄마 아빠가 정말 기뻐하시겠다!

english: Look, [mate/darling] - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: 이봐요, [mate/darling] - 저는 어릴지도, 키가 작을지도 모르지만 이 동네에선 존경받는 상인이라 당신 같은 멍청이를 상대할 시간이 없어요.

english: Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 광석이랑 주괴 가격 좀 보여 줄래?

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 나랑 키가 비슷한 사람하고 얘기하러 가는 게 낫겠다.

english: Then I shall not stop you, [mister/miss]. I've too much work to do.
translation: 그럼 말리지 않겠어요, [mister/miss]. 저는 할 일이 너무 많거든요.

english: My father shall be so pleased.
Hmm. If divide by 20 and take off 50%...
Woo hoo! What a sale!
What shall I trade next...
I can make so much money here!
translation: 여기선 돈을 엄청 벌 수 있겠어!

english: Calm down, junior.
Can you show me the prices of ores and bars?
translation: 광석이랑 주괴 가격 좀 보여 줄래?

english: I best go and speak with someone more my height.
translation: 나랑 키가 비슷한 사람하고 얘기하러 가는 게 낫겠다.

english: Oi! Leave my wheat alone!
Hello stranger.
You look like a farmer. Don't see many farmers around here.
translation: 농부처럼 보이시네요. 이 근처엔 농부가 별로 없던데.

english: Aye, that you don't. I'm from Hosidius, y'see. I just come here to drink.
translation: 그렇소, 별로 없을 거요. 난 Hosidius(호시디우스) 출신이라오. 여기엔 그냥 술 마시러 오는 거요.

english: You travel all the way out to Shayzien just for a few beers? Don't you have a pub back home?
translation: 맥주 몇 잔 마시려고 Shayzien(샤이지엔)까지 그 먼 길을 오신다고요? 고향엔 술집이 없어요?

english: Indeed we do... But I can't stand the place for more than a few minutes.
translation: 있긴 있소... 하지만 거기선 몇 분도 못 버티겠소.

english: Have you ever been in there? Such a rowdy crowd... people shouting across the bar about 'Farming this', 'Farming that'... can barely hear myself think half the time.
translation: 거기 가 본 적 있소? 어찌나 시끄러운 무리들인지... 바 저쪽 끝까지 '농사가 어쩌고', '농사가 저쩌고' 소리를 질러 대니... 정신이 하나도 없소.

english: No, no... Can't be doin' with it. That's why I make the trip out here for a nice quiet one.
translation: 아니, 아니... 도저히 못 견디겠소. 그래서 조용히 한잔하려고 여기까지 오는 거요.

english: Well I'd better leave you to it then!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout the biggest bull I ever raised.
translation: 실례지마안... 지금 내 아주우우 좋은 친구들한테 내가 키워 본 제일 큰 황소 얘기를 하는 중이라고.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 실례지마안... 난 지금 내 좋은 친구 얘기 듣는 중이라구우.

english: Mean pair of horns he'd got.
Got enough leather off 'im for a new carpet.
translation: 그놈한테서 벗긴 가죽으로 카펫을 새로 깔았다니까.

english: Grew to the size of a cart, I swear!
It's not like that these days.
'E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: 그놈이 밤새 음매 음매 음매 울어 댔지.

english: Never had a year like that since.
translation: 그 뒤로 그런 해는 다시 없었어.

english: That prize should've been mine!
Ol' Hosidius thought we'd need a bigger barn.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 영감은 헛간을 더 크게 지어야겠다고 했지.

english: Best bull I ever 'ad.
I've got a brand new plough!
No-one got so much corn out of one field before.
translation: 밭 하나에서 그렇게 많은 옥수수를 거둔 사람은 전에 없었지.

english: Sacks and sacks of grain like you've never seen!
translation: 살면서 본 적 없을 만큼 곡물이 몇 자루나 쌓였다고!

english: Hosidius says we gotta optimise land use. Bleah!
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)가 땅을 효율적으로 써야 한대. 퉤!

english: Them dwarves won't pay a decent price anymore.
translation: 그 드워프 놈들은 이제 제값을 쳐주질 않아.

english: Best harvest we'd ever 'ad.
'Course, the weather were better back then.
Fed the kids for a year off 'is beef.
translation: 그놈 고기로 애들을 일 년 동안 먹였다니까.

english: Could 'ave passed for a mammoth.
Ain't no-one ever tipped that bull.
translation: 그 황소를 넘어뜨린 놈은 하나도 없었지.

english: You've never seen a bull like 'im.
Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 일이 잘 풀리고 있어서 아주 좋아요, 고마워요.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal(닐살)! 꽤 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 햇볕 아래 밖에 있는 건 언제나 좋네요.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: 안녕하세요! 요즘 날씨가 참 좋네요. 바깥에서 하루 보내기 딱 좋아요!

english: Hello there.
I have all the bad luck. My sheep all run off somewhere, and then those mourners tell me they're infected!
translation: 난 운이 정말 없어요. 양들은 전부 어디론가 달아나 버리고, 그 애도자들은 양들이 감염됐다고 하고!

english: Well, I hope things start to look up for you.
translation: 음, 앞으로는 일이 잘 풀리시면 좋겠네요.

english: Hello there. Sorry about your sheep...
That's okay, it had to be done for the sake of the town.
translation: 괜찮아요, 마을을 위해서 어쩔 수 없었으니까요.

english: That's okay, you are not to blame. I'm just glad the truth behind the plague was eventually revealed.
translation: 괜찮아요, 당신 탓이 아니에요. 역병 뒤에 숨은 진실이 결국 밝혀져서 다행일 뿐이에요.

english: Good day. What are you doing?
I'm tending to these farming patches. They need a little more work before I can plant anything.
translation: 이 밭들을 돌보고 있어요. 뭘 심으려면 손을 좀 더 봐야 하거든요.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, [Fremennik name].
What's wrong with the patches?
The centre patch is full of weeds, and as soon as I clear them they grow back. The south patch is always far too dry. And the soil in the north patch is terrible; it needs a good dose of compost.
translation: 가운데 밭은 잡초투성이인데 뽑자마자 다시 자라요. 남쪽 밭은 늘 너무 말라 있고요. 그리고 북쪽 밭은 흙이 형편없어서 compost(퇴비)를 듬뿍 줘야 해요.

english: Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 왕국 사람들이 저를 얼마나 지지하는지 알려 줄래요?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
Kingdom? Etceteria is ruled by a Queen and we don't approve of you.
translation: 왕국이요? Etceteria(에트세테리아)는 여왕께서 다스리시고, 우린 당신을 지지하지 않아요.

english: Don't trouble yourself further, Your Highness, you've already done so much!
translation: 더는 신경 쓰지 마십시오, 전하. 이미 너무나 많은 일을 해 주셨습니다!

english: Hey! This is the Queen's farm. You'll need her approval to make use of it.
translation: 이봐요! 여긴 여왕님의 농장이에요. 쓰려면 여왕님의 허락이 필요해요.

english: The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 창고가 가득 찼습니다, 전하. Advisor Ghrim(그림 고문)께 말씀하셔서 저희가 모아 둔 것을 받아 가십시오.

english: Good luck with that.
What's wrong with the patches?
Hello, young [sir/lady]. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: 안녕하세요, 젊은 [sir/lady]. 내 농장에서 일해 보고 싶은 거예요?

english: Tell me about your farm.
I grow fruit here. Special fruit. It grows very fast, but it needs a lot of tending, otherwise it gets the blight and dies.
translation: 여기선 과일을 길러요. 특별한 과일이죠. 아주 빨리 자라지만 손이 많이 가요. 안 그러면 마름병에 걸려 죽어 버리거든요.

english: These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.
translation: 요즘은 내가 늙고 굼떠져서요. 내가 기르려다 실패한 죽은 식물들이 다 보일 거예요.

english: Life here seems rather peaceful.
It is most of the time. Something very strange did happen recently though.
translation: 대부분은 그래요. 그런데 얼마 전에 아주 이상한 일이 있었어요.

english: Oh yeah? What happened?
Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
translation: 음, 그게 말이죠... 얼마 전에 두건을 쓴 수상한 사람 둘이 농장을 찾아왔어요. 이상한 냄새가 났고 얼굴을 계속 가리고 있었죠.

english: They said they represented some client from the far east and that they wanted to inspect the farm. They had a good look around but seemed rather disappointed when they left.
translation: 먼 동쪽에서 온 어떤 의뢰인의 대리인이라면서 농장을 살펴보고 싶다고 했어요. 한참 둘러보더니 꽤 실망한 얼굴로 떠났죠.

english: Oh... I'm sure it was nothing.
Tell me about yourself.
I'm a fruit farmer. But now I'm a bit too old for that. Maybe I should try writing books again, like I did when I was younger.
translation: 난 과일 농부예요. 그런데 이젠 그 일을 하기엔 좀 늙었죠. 젊었을 때처럼 다시 책이나 써 볼까 봐요.

english: I'd like to work on your farm.
Well, I'm afraid you're not really suitable.
translation: 음, 미안하지만 당신은 그다지 적합하지 않은 것 같네요.

english: You do not have enough Hosidius favour. Current favour: [number]% - Required: 100.0%
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 호감도가 부족해요. 현재 호감도: [number]% - 필요: 100.0%

english: Alright. Take a handful of seeds from the table, and head into the farm. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
translation: 좋아요. 탁자에서 씨앗을 한 줌 집어서 농장으로 들어가요. 과일을 수확하면 바로 자루에 넣어 줘요.

english: Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
translation: 기억해요, 단계마다 식물에 물을 줘야 해요. 안 그러면 마름병으로 죽어요. 비료를 주면 더 빨리 자라요... 물을 안 주면 더 빨리 죽고요.

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully.
translation: 과일을 충분히 잘 기르면 경험치를 조금 더 얻을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Have you any rewards?
I need to go.
What on earth are you wearing?
I'm here to do some tithing. Blood tithing.
translation: 십일조를 좀 거두러 왔어요. 피의 십일조요.

english: Well this is not that kind of farm! I only let normal people work here, so get lost!
translation: 여긴 그런 농장이 아니에요! 정상적인 사람만 일하게 하니까 썩 꺼져요!

english: You show the book to Farmer Gricoller.
translation: Farmer Gricoller(농부 그리콜러)에게 책을 보여 준다.

english: Oh, yes, I remember writing that a long time ago. I told the publisher it should be in the public domain, so that everyone could share the knowledge.
translation: 오, 그래요. 오래전에 그걸 쓴 기억이 나요. 모두가 지식을 나눌 수 있게 공유 저작물로 해 달라고 출판사에 말했었죠.

english: Of course, that was before I got so old and found I couldn't afford to hire workers for my farm. Oh well, I hope it helped someone. It wasn't much use to anyone around here.
translation: 물론 그건 내가 이렇게 늙어서 농장 일꾼을 고용할 형편도 안 된다는 걸 알기 전이었지만요. 뭐, 누군가에게 도움이 됐길 바라요. 이 근처 사람들한텐 별 쓸모가 없었거든요.

english: Are you the 'Gric' this entry mentions?

translation: 그에게 'Lunch by the Lancalliums(란칼리움 곁의 점심)'을 보여 준다.

english: Yes, I was friends with the last king, it was very sad when he died. The accusations aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
translation: 그래요, 난 선왕과 친구였어요. 그분이 돌아가셨을 때 정말 슬펐죠. 가엾은 꼬마 Rose(로즈)에게 쏟아진 비난은 말도 안 되는 거였어요.

english: Accusations?

translation: 다 헛소리였어요. 왕께서는 자연사하셨어요! 연세도 많으셨고, 적어도 40년은 왕좌에 계셨으니까요.

english: Interesting, so he must have waited a while before having children?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 그럼 아이를 갖기까지 꽤 오래 기다리셨겠네요?

english: Indeed, he married late and his wife... Unfortunately didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.
translation: 맞아요. 늦게 결혼하셨는데, 왕비께서는... 안타깝게도 Rose(로즈)를 낳다가 돌아가셨어요.

english: Oh right, have you seen Rose recently?
translation: 아 그렇군요, 최근에 Rose(로즈)를 본 적 있어요?

english: No... After the incident she was locked away. Most have forgotten about her now.
translation: 아뇨... 그 사건 이후로 갇혀 버렸어요. 이젠 대부분 그 아이를 잊어버렸죠.

english: Thanks for the information, Gric. Perhaps it'll all make sense once I've found the other pages.
translation: 알려 줘서 고마워요, Gric(그릭). 다른 페이지들을 찾으면 다 이해가 될지도 모르겠네요.

english: Perhaps.

translation: 아, 비료로군요. 나도 많이 쓰지만, 내 건 Hosidius(호시디우스)에서 받아요. 당신 걸 그쪽에 주고 싶으면 은행 근처에 있는 그쪽 창고로 가 봐요.

english: I'll give you 60 of my reward points for that.
translation: 그 대가로 내 보상 포인트 60점을 줄게요.

english: Thank you.

english: No thanks.

translation: 탁자에서 씨앗을 좀 가져가요. 안 그러면 저 안에서 농사를 지을 수가 없어요!

english: Grow those seeds in the patches. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.

english: You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully. So, are you ready to start?

english: Anyway, I'd better get back to my research.

english: I had to flee the kingdom of Misthalin! The bandits give me refuge here as long as I cook for them.
translation: Misthalin(미스탈린) 왕국에서 도망쳐야 했다고! 내가 요리를 해 주는 동안은 산적들이 여기 숨겨 주거든.

english: Can I have some pizza too?

translation: 음, 이 피자는 사실 산적들 몫이야. 피자 도우 정도는 팔아 줄 수 있겠지만

translation: 성스러운 Saradomin(사라도민)의 교회에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Who's Saradomin?
Surely you have heard of the god, Saradomin?
translation: 설마 Saradomin(사라도민) 신에 대해 들어 보지 못하셨단 말입니까?

english: He who creates the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
translation: 이 세상에 선함과 순수의 힘을 창조하시는 분 말입니다! 어찌 그리 무지하실 수 있습니까!

english: This is the god with more followers than any other! ...At least in this part of the world.
translation: 다른 어떤 신보다도 많은 신도를 거느리신 분입니다! ...적어도 이 지역에서는 말입니다.

english: He who created this world along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
translation: 형제이신 Guthix(구식스), Zamorak(자모락)과 함께 이 세상을 창조하신 분 말입니다.

english: Oh, THAT Saradomin...
There... is only one Saradomin...
Yeah... I, uh, thought you said something else.
translation: 네... 저, 어, 다른 걸 말씀하신 줄 알았어요.

english: Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 전 이 세상 사람이 아니거든요.

english: That's... strange.
I thought things not from this world were all... You know. Slime and tentacles.

Never mind.

translation: 지금은 Lumbridge swamp(럼브리지 늪)에서 은둔자로 살고 있을 겁니다. 늪 저 서쪽 끝에 작은 오두막이 있습니다.

translation: 그건 그렇고, 제 이름은 Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)입니다. 만나서 반갑습니다.

translation: 늪을 지나실 때 조심하십시오. 꽤 위험한 곳이라고 들었습니다.

english: Thank you for getting rid of that awful ghost for me! May Saradomin always smile upon you!

english: Sounds like you have a restless goat problem!
Now is not the time for jokes, are you going to help me or not?
translation: 지금은 농담할 때가 아닙니다. 도와주실 겁니까, 말 겁니까?

english: Yeah might as well, I'll go take a look.
Thank you friend, be safe out there.
Sorry, I don't have time right now.
Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your paws, come back and talk to me.
translation: 그렇군요. 혹시 앞발이 한가해지시면 다시 찾아와 말씀 나누시지요.

english: What did you ask me to do again?
I need you to rid me of the ghost goat that is haunting my graveyard.
translation: 제 묘지에 출몰하는 유령 염소를 없애 주십시오.

english: Got it, I'll get back to it.
Church of the egg?
Oh, THAT egg...
Oh, sorry. I'm not from this world.
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 전 이 세상 사람이 아니거든요.

english: You don't understand. This is an online game!
translation: 이해를 못 하시네요. 이건 온라인 게임이라고요!

english: I am - do you like my disguise?
translation: 사실 저도 그렇거든요. 제 변장 마음에 드세요?

english: Nice place you've got here.
I'm looking for a quest!
Ok, let me help then.
Sorry, I don't have time right now
Ask about the ghost.
I'm looking for a quest!
In this holy place I can only offer you calm and peace.
translation: 이 성스러운 곳에서 제가 드릴 수 있는 것은 고요와 평화뿐입니다.

english: Calm and Peace? Sounds like the quest for me! How should I start?
translation: 고요와 평화요? 딱 제 퀘스트네요! 어떻게 시작하면 되죠?

english: Yes, calm and peace. Just stay here with me and you will feel it eventually.
translation: 예, 고요와 평화입니다. 그저 여기 저와 함께 머무르십시오. 그러면 언젠가 느끼시게 될 겁니다.

english: Oh... well... thank you.
Sorry, there will be no sermon today, but you may offer a prayer to Saradomin yourself.
translation: 죄송하지만 오늘은 설교가 없습니다. 하지만 직접 Saradomin(사라도민)께 기도를 올리셔도 됩니다.

english: Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
Of course! Even before our forefathers founded Kourend, under King Rada I, they remembered the tumult of the times when the armies of the gods laid waste to the lands.
translation: 물론입니다! King Rada I(라다 1세 왕) 치하에서 우리 선조들이 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 세우기 전부터도, 그들은 신들의 군대가 땅을 황폐하게 만들던 혼란의 시대를 기억하고 있었습니다.

english: We thank Saradomin for the end of that violent Age, and pray that he will continue to defend us from the evil other gods.
translation: 우리는 그 폭력의 시대를 끝내 주신 Saradomin(사라도민)께 감사드리며, 그분께서 사악한 다른 신들로부터 계속 우리를 지켜 주시기를 기도합니다.

english: Okay, thanks.
That's nice.
Most impressive, have this!
You've obtained a casket!
Do the people here mostly worship Saradomin?
That's nice.
Hello adventurer, do you seek a quest?
translation: 어서 오게, 모험가 양반. 퀘스트를 찾고 있나?

english: I am always looking for a quest.
Well, I see poor Romeo wandering around the square. I think he may need help.
translation: 음, 불쌍한 Romeo(로미오)가 광장을 헤매는 걸 봤네. 도움이 필요할지도 모르겠어.

english: I was helping him and Juliet to meet, but it became impossible.
translation: 그 친구와 Juliet(줄리엣)이 만날 수 있게 돕고 있었는데, 그게 불가능해졌다네.

english: I am sure he can use some help.
No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: 아뇨, 전 그냥 뭔가 죽이는 게 좋아요.

english: That's a fine career in these lands. There is more that needs killing every day.
translation: 이 땅에선 그것도 훌륭한 직업이지. 죽여야 할 것들이 날마다 늘어나니 말일세.

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
Drinking will be the death of you.
translation: 술이 자네 목숨을 앗아 갈 걸세.

english: But the Blue Moon in the city is cheap enough.
translation: 그래도 도시에 있는 Blue Moon(푸른 달)이 꽤 싸지.

english: And providing you buy one drink an hour they let you stay all night.
translation: 게다가 한 시간에 한 잔씩만 시키면 밤새 있게 해 준다네.

english: Ok, thanks
Oh to be a father in the times of whiskey.
translation: 아, 위스키의 시대에 신부로 산다는 것이란.

english: I sing and I drink and I wake up in gutters.
Top of the morning to you.
To err is human, to forgive, quite difficult.
translation: 실수는 인간의 일이요, 용서는... 꽤 어려운 일이지.

english: I need a think I drink.
translation: 생각 한잔이 필요하네... 아니, 한잔 생각이 나는군.

english: Can't you see that I'm in the middle of a Sermon?!
translation: 내가 설교하는 중인 게 안 보이나?!

english: But Romeo sent me!
But I'm busy delivering a sermon to my congregation!
translation: 하지만 난 신도들에게 설교하느라 바쁘단 말일세!

english: Zzzzzzzzz
Yes, well, it certainly seems like you have a captive audience!
translation: 네, 뭐, 청중들이 아주 푹 빠져 있는 것 같네요!

english: Ok, ok...what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?
translation: 알았네, 알았어... 원하는 게 뭔가? 얼른 자넬 보내고 설교를 계속해야겠네.

english: Romeo sent me. He says you may be able to help.
translation: Romeo(로미오)가 저를 보냈어요. 신부님이 도와주실 수 있을 거래요.

english: Ah Romeo, yes. A fine lad, but a little bit confused.
translation: 아, Romeo(로미오) 말이군. 좋은 청년이지만 좀 갈팡질팡하는 녀석이지.

english: Yes, very confused....Anyway, Romeo wishes to be married to Juliet! She must be rescued from her father's control!
translation: 네, 아주 갈팡질팡하죠.... 아무튼, Romeo(로미오)는 Juliet(줄리엣)과 결혼하고 싶어 해요! 줄리엣을 아버지의 손아귀에서 구해 내야 해요!

english: I agree, and I think I have an idea! A potion to make her appear dead...
translation: 동감일세. 그리고 좋은 생각이 있네! 그녀가 죽은 것처럼 보이게 하는 물약이...

english: Dead! Sounds a bit creepy to me...but please, continue.
translation: 죽은 것처럼이라니요! 좀 으스스한데요... 아무튼, 계속하세요.

english: The potion will only make Juliet 'appear' dead...then she'll be taken to the crypt...
translation: 그 물약은 Juliet(줄리엣)이 죽은 것처럼 '보이게'만 할 걸세... 그러면 그녀는 지하 묘지로 옮겨지겠지...

english: Crypt! Again...very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.
translation: 지하 묘지라니요! 또... 정말 으스스하네요! 취미가 좀 독특하신가 봐요.

english: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothecary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.
translation: 그러면 Romeo(로미오)가 지하 묘지에서 그녀를 데려가면 되지! Apothecary(약제사)에게 가서 내가 보냈다고 하고, 'Cadava(카다바)' 물약이 필요하다고 말하게.

english: Apart from the strong overtones of death, this is turning out to be a real love story.
translation: 짙게 깔린 죽음의 기운만 빼면, 이거 진짜 사랑 이야기가 되어 가네요.

english: Ah, have you found the Apothecary yet? Remember, Cadava potion, for Juliet.
translation: 아, Apothecary(약제사)는 찾았나? 기억하게, Juliet(줄리엣)에게 줄 Cadava potion(카다바 물약)일세.

english: Did you find the Apothecary?
I've got the cadava potion.
Good! Good work! Ok, take it to Juliet, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.
translation: 좋아! 잘했네! 자, 그걸 Juliet(줄리엣)에게 가져가게. 그녀가 자넬 기다리고 있네. 난 Romeo(로미오)에게 무엇을 해야 할지 확실히 일러두겠네.

english: The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message about your drinking habits!
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 신부님 음주 습관에 대해 이 메시지를 보냈어요!

english: mssge? wha messsge?
oh, msesesge for me.
Oh dear, he doesn't look like he's going to be able to read the message!
translation: 이런, 이 사람은 메시지를 읽을 수 있을 것 같지 않네요!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 보상을 주고 싶네만, 자네는 받을 공간이 없어 보이는군. 공간이 생기면 다시 오게.

english: in nomine saradomini, blah blah blah...
Whee! Mmmgic power, kazamm...
I am always looking for a quest.
No, I prefer just to kill things.
translation: 아뇨, 전 그냥 뭔가 죽이는 게 좋아요.

english: Can you recommend a good bar?
Ok, thanks
Go away! I'm meditating!
Well, that's friendly.
I SAID go AWAY.
Okay, okay... sheesh, what a grouch.
I've come to repossess your house.
Under what grounds???
Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
translation: 주택 담보 대출 상환을 계속 연체하셨잖아요.

english: What?
But... I don't have a mortgage! I built this house myself!
translation: 하지만... 난 담보 대출 같은 거 없어! 이 집은 내가 직접 지었다고!

english: Sorry. I must have got the wrong address. All the houses look the same around here.
translation: 죄송해요. 주소를 잘못 찾았나 봐요. 이 동네 집들이 다 똑같이 생겨서요.

english: What? What houses? What ARE you talking about???
translation: 뭐? 무슨 집들? 대체 무슨 소리를 하는 거야???

english: Never mind.
I don't know. I just wanted this house...
translation: 모르겠어요. 그냥 이 집이 갖고 싶었어요...

english: Oh... go away and stop wasting my time!
translation: 아... 저리 가고 내 시간 그만 낭비해!

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)님이 당신과 얘기해 보라고 보내셨어요.

english: I suppose I'd better talk to you then. What problems has he got himself into this time?
translation: 그럼 얘기는 들어 줘야겠군. 이번엔 또 무슨 문제에 휘말렸대?

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
Oh, the silly fool.
I leave town for just five months, and ALREADY he can't manage.
translation: 고작 다섯 달 마을을 비웠을 뿐인데 '벌써' 감당을 못 하다니.

english: (sigh)
Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
translation: 글쎄, 내가 돌아가서 퇴마를 해 줄 순 없다. 이곳을 떠나지 않겠다고 맹세했거든. 꼬박 2년 동안 기도와 명상을 마칠 때까지는.

english: Tell you what I can do though; take this amulet.
translation: 대신 이렇게는 해 줄 수 있지. 이 아뮬렛을 가져가라.

english: Father Urhney hands you an amulet.
It is an Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: 이건 Amulet of Ghostspeak(유령 언어 아뮬렛)이다.

english: So called, because when you wear it you can speak to ghosts. A lot of ghosts are doomed to be ghosts because they have left some important task uncompleted.
translation: 이걸 차면 유령과 말할 수 있어서 그렇게 불리지. 많은 유령은 중요한 일을 끝내지 못하고 남겨 둔 탓에 유령으로 떠돌 운명이 된 거다.

english: Maybe if you know what this task is, you can get rid of the ghost. I'm not making any guarantees mind you, but it is the best I can do right now.
translation: 그 일이 뭔지 알아내면 유령을 없앨 수 있을지도 모르지. 장담은 못 한다만, 지금 내가 해 줄 수 있는 건 이게 최선이야.

english: Thank you. I'll give it a try!
You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
Yeah. For example, when we were trainee priests he kept on getting stuck up bell ropes.
translation: 그래. 예를 들면 우리가 수련 사제였을 때 그 친구는 툭하면 종 줄에 매달려 꼼짝 못 했지.

english: Anyway. I don't have time for chitchat. What's his problem THIS time?
translation: 아무튼. 잡담할 시간 없다. '이번엔' 또 뭐가 문제야?

english: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: Amulet of Ghostspeak(유령 언어 아뮬렛)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: What are you talking about? I can see you've got it with you!
translation: 무슨 소리야? 지금 가지고 있는 게 다 보이는데!

english: You come here wasting my time... Has it even occurred to you that you've got it stored somewhere? Now GO AWAY!
translation: 여기까지 와서 내 시간이나 낭비하고... 어딘가에 넣어 뒀을 거란 생각은 안 해 봤나? 이제 '저리 가'!

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! Now clear some space in your inventory and I'll give you another one.
translation: 어쩜 그렇게 덜렁댈 수가 있어? 그거 구하기 쉬운 물건이 아니라고! 이제 소지품에 자리를 좀 비우면 하나 더 주지.

english: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! It's a good job I've got a spare.
translation: 어쩜 그렇게 덜렁댈 수가 있어? 그거 구하기 쉬운 물건이 아니라고! 내가 여분을 갖고 있어서 다행인 줄 알아.

english: Be more careful this time.
Okay, I'll try to be.
Hello?
At last! The voice of Saradomin! My years of meditation have paid off!
translation: 드디어! Saradomin(사라도민)의 목소리다! 수년간의 명상이 결실을 맺었구나!

english: Um...
O mighty Saradomin! What is your message to me?
translation: 오, 위대하신 Saradomin(사라도민)이시여! 제게 무슨 말씀을 내리시렵니까?

english: Stop sitting around in a house in a swamp and go and do something useful!
translation: 늪 속 집에 틀어박혀 앉아만 있지 말고 나가서 뭔가 쓸모 있는 일을 하거라!

english: Oh, thank you Saradomin! I will meditate on what this message means!
translation: 오, 감사합니다, Saradomin(사라도민)이시여! 이 말씀이 무슨 뜻인지 명상해 보겠습니다!

english: Well, that's friendly.
I've come to repossess your house.
Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.
translation: 주택 담보 대출 상환을 계속 연체하셨잖아요.

english: I don't know, I just wanted this house.
translation: 모르겠어요, 그냥 이 집이 갖고 싶었어요.

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)님이 당신과 얘기해 보라고 보내셨어요.

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: Amulet of Ghostspeak(유령 언어 아뮬렛)을 잃어버렸어요.

english: Nilsal. Interested in buying some of Aldarin's finest fruit and veg?
translation: Nilsal(닐살). Aldarin(알다린) 최고의 과일과 채소를 좀 사 보시겠어요?

english: Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 오늘 크리스탈 도시는 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello tall person.
Hello short person.
What's this patch for?
This is an Anima patch, the only one of its kind. Here, you can grow Iasor, Kronos and Attas plants.
translation: 이건 Anima patch(아니마 밭)이에요. 세상에 하나뿐인 밭이죠. 여기서는 Iasor(이아소르), Kronos(크로노스), Attas(아타스) 식물을 기를 수 있어요.

english: What are they?
Three unique plants with a special affinity to the Anima Mundi, the life force of our world.
translation: 우리 세계의 생명력인 Anima Mundi(아니마 문디)와 특별한 친화력을 지닌 세 가지 독특한 식물이에요.

english: When planted, all three of these plants have a unique impact on the Anima Mundi. Their effects will likely be very useful to you when farming.
translation: 이 세 식물은 심으면 모두 Anima Mundi(아니마 문디)에 저마다 독특한 영향을 줘요. 그 효과는 농사지을 때 아주 유용할 거예요.

english: What are the effects?
Iasor plants will reduce the chance of your other crops becoming diseased, Kronos plants will increase the speed at which they grow and Attas plants will improve the yield when harvesting.
translation: Iasor(이아소르) 식물은 다른 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률을 줄여 주고, Kronos(크로노스) 식물은 작물이 자라는 속도를 높여 주고, Attas(아타스) 식물은 수확할 때 수확량을 늘려 줘요.

english: Choose wisely though, as you can only have one of them at a time.
translation: 하지만 한 번에 하나만 심을 수 있으니 잘 고르세요.

english: Eventually, they'll start to wither and die as their impact on the Anima Mundi is limited. You'll have to plant another when they do.
translation: Anima Mundi(아니마 문디)에 미치는 영향에는 한계가 있어서, 결국엔 시들어 죽기 시작해요. 그러면 새로 하나 심어야 해요.

english: Awesome! Thanks for the information.
See you later.
What's this patch for?
See you later.
Hello!
Leave me be. I am not here to make friends.
translation: 날 내버려 둬. 친구 사귀러 온 게 아니니까.

english: Fair enough.
Hello, The Face said you wanted to speak with me.
translation: 안녕하세요. The Face(얼굴)이 그러는데, 저와 이야기하고 싶어 하신다면서요.

english: Ah, we meet at last. My fellow ratcatchers tell me you're quite the talent.
translation: 아, 드디어 만나는군. 동료 쥐잡이들 말로는 자네가 꽤 재능이 있다더군.

english: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.
translation: 뭐, 제 공으로만 돌릴 순 없죠. 제 고양이 도움을 꽤 많이 받았거든요.

english: Ah, modesty. A trait seldom displayed by adventurers like yourself.
translation: 아, 겸손이라. 자네 같은 모험가들에게선 좀처럼 보기 힘든 미덕이지.

english: Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.
translation: 자네 같은 사람이 더 많아지면 내 일감이 절반은 날아가겠군.

english: Why's that?
Epic poems aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 수줍고 얌전한 사람들은 서사시를 의뢰하지 않거든.

english: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.
translation: Smokin' Joe(골초 조)가 그러는데 wily cats(영리한 고양이) 훈련에 대해 잘 아신다면서요.

english: I do indeed. In fact, that's why I wanted to talk to you.
translation: 그렇다네. 사실 그 때문에 자네와 이야기하고 싶었지.

english: So you'll show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 그럼 제 고양이를 wily cat(영리한 고양이)로 만드는 법을 알려 주시는 건가요?

english: Ah, ah, ah - not so fast.
translation: 아, 아, 아, 그렇게 서두르지 말게.

english: Let me guess... you want me to catch some rats for you first?
translation: 맞혀 볼게요... 먼저 쥐를 좀 잡아 달라는 거죠?

english: Bingo.
Alright then, what's the job?
Nothing too difficult. Just rid the port of every single rat... at once.
translation: 별로 어렵지 않네. 항구의 쥐를 한 마리도 빠짐없이 없애 주게... 한 번에.

english: At once?!
Yep. I expect to see all the rats in Port Sarim dead in one, decisive action.
translation: 그렇지. Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 모든 쥐가 단 한 번의 결정적인 행동으로 죽는 걸 보고 싶네.

english: Are you serious?
Deadly!
So why do you want all the rats wiped out at once?
translation: 그런데 왜 쥐를 한꺼번에 없애길 원하시는 거예요?

english: I want to write a new poem.
About me?! How flattering.
No, silly. A poem about the art of ratcatching.
translation: 아니, 이 사람아. 쥐잡이 기술에 관한 시일세.

english: Poetry might be my bread and butter, but catching rats is my real passion.
translation: 시가 내 밥벌이이긴 하지만, 진짜 열정은 쥐잡이에 있다네.

english: Couldn't you just use some 'creative license' instead?
translation: 그냥 '시적 허용'을 좀 쓰시면 안 돼요?

english: Not to disappoint you, but this task might be beyond my capabilities...
translation: 실망시켜 드리고 싶진 않지만, 이 일은 제 능력 밖일지도 몰라요...

english: Don't be so hard on yourself!
Besides, it's not difficult. I myself performed the very same feat just a few years ago.
translation: 게다가 어렵지도 않아. 나도 불과 몇 년 전에 똑같은 위업을 해냈다네.

english: You did? How?
Ha! Nice try. You'll have to figure that out for yourself.
translation: 하! 어림없네. 그건 자네가 직접 알아내야 하네.

english: It was worth a shot...
Any luck killing all the rats yet?
translation: 쥐를 전부 없애는 일은 잘 되어 가나?

english: What do I have to do again?
Kill all the rats in Port Sarim in one, swift action.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 모든 쥐를 단번에, 재빨리 처치하는 걸세.

english: Right. I'd better figure out how I'm going to do that...
I think I know how to carry out your task.
translation: 맡기신 일을 어떻게 해낼지 알 것 같아요.

english: Oh yes? Has The Face been telling tales again?
translation: 오, 그래? The Face(얼굴)이 또 입을 놀렸나?

english: Oh no, she didn't say a word.
Really, she didn't.
Ha! I did it. Did you see?
I did indeed! A performance for the ages.
Now that you're a real ratcatcher, I'd be happy to train that cat of yours.
translation: 이제 자네도 진정한 쥐잡이가 되었으니, 기꺼이 자네 고양이를 훈련시켜 주겠네.

english: Can you train my cat to be a wily cat?
translation: 제 고양이를 wily cat(영리한 고양이)로 훈련시켜 주실 수 있나요?

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wily cats.
translation: 나는 overgrown cats(다 자란 고양이)만 wily cats(영리한 고양이)로 훈련시킬 수 있다네.

english: Can you rename my cat?
translation: 제 고양이 이름을 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Hey [player name], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 이봐, [player name]. 드디어 내 이름을 지어 줬구나.

english: Sorry I took so long, [cat name], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 늦어서 미안해, [cat name]. 네 이름을 생각해 내느라 시간이 좀 걸렸어.

english: Miaaow!
Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: wily cats(영리한 고양이)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'll only help you name wily or lazy cats. Bring me one and I'll help you out.
translation: 나는 wily cats(영리한 고양이)나 lazy cats(게으른 고양이)의 이름만 지어 주네. 한 마리 데려오면 도와주지.

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 구덩이에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 자, 이걸 받게. 쓸모가 있을 걸세.

english: What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 저랑 제 고양이한테 줄 조언이 있나요?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Amulet of Catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 착용하게. 고양이와 전술을 짤 수 있을 걸세.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 그럼 어떤 전술을 쓰는 게 가장 좋을까요?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 그건 자네 생각에 달렸지. 고양이 목숨을 걸 각오가 되어 있는지, 그리고 고양이가 얼마나 방어적이거나 공격적이길 바라는지에 따라 다르다네.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 극도로 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 고양이의 체력과 방어력이 올라가지만 더 빨리 도망치게 되지.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 아니면 덜 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 그러면 고양이가 구덩이에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있지.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '그냥 몸조심해, 고양아.'

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '최대한 오래 버텨.'

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 이길 확률이 높아진다면 고양이 목숨을 걸겠어요.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 전면 공격을 택할 수 있네. 고양이의 공격력과 힘이 올라가는 대신 방어는 약해지지.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 아니면 덜 공격적인 태세를 취할 수 있네. 고양이의 힘과 공격력이 조금 덜 오르지만 방어에 불이익은 없다네.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '용기 없이는 영광도 없다!'

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 구덩이에서 훈련하면 제 고양이한테 어떤 이점이 있나요?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Port Sarim pits, your cat will become happier and fitter after fighting.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림) 구덩이에서는 싸우고 나면 고양이가 더 행복해지고 튼튼해지지.

english: No thanks.
Can you tell me more about Wily cats?
translation: Wily cats(영리한 고양이)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course!
They're tougher, stronger and faster than other kinds of cats. They have superior hunting skills and can even catch butterflies and kalphite larvae.
translation: 다른 고양이보다 더 강인하고, 힘세고, 빠르다네. 사냥 실력이 뛰어나서 나비나 kalphite larvae(칼파이트 유충)까지 잡을 수 있지.

english: So are there any drawbacks to owning them?
Wily cats need lots more exercise, otherwise they'll get fat and lazy.
translation: Wily cats(영리한 고양이)는 운동을 훨씬 많이 해야 하네. 안 그러면 살찌고 게을러지지.

english: What's the best way to exercise them?
Bring it hunting or take it to the Rat Pits regularly.
translation: 사냥에 데려가거나 Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)에 정기적으로 데려가게.

english: Try and keep it happy too,wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 기분도 좋게 해 주게. wily cats(영리한 고양이)는 심통이 나면 좀 사나워질 수 있거든.

english: What happens if I neglect my cat? Not that I would!
translation: 제가 고양이를 소홀히 하면 어떻게 되죠? 그럴 일은 없겠지만요!

english: It'll get fat and lazy and become much worse at hunting. Plus, everyone will know you're a bad cat trainer.
translation: 살찌고 게을러져서 사냥 실력이 훨씬 떨어지지. 게다가 자네가 형편없는 고양이 조련사라는 걸 모두가 알게 될 걸세.

english: Can I retrain my lazy cat?
translation: 제 lazy cat(게으른 고양이)를 다시 훈련시킬 수 있나요?

english: Yes, you can get your lazy cat back in shape with lots of rat catching. But you really shouldn't let things get that bad.
translation: 그렇다네. 쥐를 많이 잡게 하면 lazy cat(게으른 고양이)도 다시 몸매를 되찾을 수 있지. 하지만 애초에 그 지경까지 가게 두면 안 되네.

english: How's the poem going?
Ah yes, the poem... your performance was incredibly inspiring. I think it'll be a real masterpiece...
translation: 아, 그래, 그 시 말이지... 자네의 활약은 엄청난 영감을 주었네. 진정한 걸작이 될 것 같군...

english: Just as soon as I get around to writing it all down.
translation: 내가 짬을 내서 그걸 다 써 내려가기만 하면 말일세.

english: Hello, the facesaid that you were looking to talk with me.
translation: 안녕하세요. the face(얼굴)이 그러는데, 저와 이야기하고 싶어 하신다면서요.

english: Indeed, word has gotten to me from our other ratcatcher chapters that you are quite a talent.
translation: 그렇다네. 다른 쥐잡이 지부에서 자네가 꽤 재능 있다는 소식이 들려왔지.

english: Modesty, a trait seldom displayed by adventurers these days.
translation: 겸손이라, 요즘 모험가들에게선 좀처럼 보기 힘든 미덕이지.

english: Why is that?
Epic poems of bravery and heroics aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 용맹과 영웅담을 노래하는 서사시는 보통 수줍고 얌전한 사람들이 의뢰하지 않거든.

english: Indeed I do. It's for this very reason that I requested to talk to you.
translation: 그렇다네. 바로 그 이유로 자네와 이야기하자고 한 걸세.

english: So you will show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 그럼 제 고양이를 wily cat(영리한 고양이)로 만드는 법을 알려 주시는 거예요?

english: No, not yet.
*Sighs.*
No I need you to carry out just one task for me.
translation: 아니, 날 위해 딱 한 가지 일만 해 주게.

english: Well experience has taught me to expect as much, what must I do?
translation: 뭐, 경험상 그럴 줄 알았어요. 뭘 하면 되죠?

english: Nothing too difficult, just rid the port of every single rat, with just one action.
translation: 별로 어렵지 않네. 단 한 번의 행동으로 항구의 쥐를 한 마리도 빠짐없이 없애 주게.

english: What?
Deadly.
But why? Why one stroke, why not a slow eradication?
translation: 하지만 왜요? 왜 한 번에요? 천천히 박멸하면 안 되나요?

english: But...
I am touched that you want to write an epic poem about me, but why can't you write the poem about seagulls or daffodils or something?
translation: 저에 대한 서사시를 쓰고 싶어 하시는 건 감동이지만, 갈매기나 수선화 같은 걸로 쓰시면 안 돼요?

english: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ... uhm.... flighty.
translation: 글쎄, 갈매기는 주인공감이 못 되네. 좀... 음... 너무 붕 떠 있거든.

english: Besides the poem is about me not you.
translation: 게다가 그 시는 자네가 아니라 나에 관한 걸세.

english: Sorry I don't follow.
I myself carried out the very same feat once upon a time.
translation: 나 자신도 옛날에 똑같은 위업을 해낸 적이 있지.

english: So why do you need me to repeat your most heroic of feats?
translation: 그런데 왜 제가 선생님의 가장 영웅적인 위업을 되풀이해야 하죠?

english: It's all about objectivity and integrity. I need to be utterly divorced from the process.
translation: 객관성과 공정성 때문일세. 나는 그 과정에서 완전히 떨어져 있어야 하거든.

english: Umm... ok, I suppose.
So can you tell me how you went about achieving this?
translation: 그럼 그걸 어떻게 해내셨는지 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: No. Therein lies the challenge.
*Sigh* Why does it always have to be like this?
You haven't completed the task yet.
Rid the port of all its rats with one action.
translation: 단 한 번의 행동으로 항구의 쥐를 전부 없애게.

english: I'd better get to it then.
I think I know how to carry out the task.
translation: 그 일을 어떻게 해낼지 알 것 같아요.

english: Has the facebeingtelling tall tales again?
Really she didn't.
Ha! I did it. Did you see me?
Yes I saw that, now what can I do for you? Don't keep me overly long, I'm trying to complete my poem.
translation: 그래, 봤네. 이제 무얼 도와줄까? 너무 오래 붙잡지는 말게, 시를 마무리하는 중이니.

english: Can you show me how to train my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 제 고양이를 wily cat(영리한 고양이)로 훈련시키는 법을 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: I can only train overgrown cats into wilycats.
translation: 나는 overgrown cats(다 자란 고양이)만 wilycats(영리한 고양이)로 훈련시킬 수 있다네.

english: You already have a mature cat, look after that first.
translation: 자네는 이미 다 자란 고양이가 있잖나. 그 녀석부터 돌보게.

english: You should really name your cat.
Hey [username], you finally got around to naming me.
translation: 이봐, [username]. 드디어 내 이름을 지어 줬구나.

english: Sorry I took so long, [catname], it took a while to come up with a name for you.
translation: 늦어서 미안해, [catname]. 네 이름을 생각해 내느라 시간이 좀 걸렸어.

english: Here take this, you might find it useful
translation: 자, 이걸 받게. 쓸모가 있을 걸세

english: Well what do you want to know?
You should wear an amulet of catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 착용하게. 고양이와 전술을 짤 수 있을 걸세.

english: Well if that's the case then yourare left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence, the drawback to this is that your cat will flee sooner.
translation: 극도로 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 고양이의 체력과 방어력이 올라가지만, 대신 더 빨리 도망친다는 단점이 있지.

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 다른 방법은 덜 방어적인 전략인데, 그러면 고양이가 구덩이에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있다네.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '그냥 몸조심해, 고양아.'

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '최대한 오래 버텨.'

english: You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it
translation: 전면 공격을 택할 수 있네. 고양이의 공격력과 힘이 올라가는 대신 방어는 약해지지

english: or go for a less aggressive stance which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 아니면 덜 공격적인 태세를 취할 수도 있네. 고양이의 힘과 공격력이 조금 덜 오르지만 방어에 불이익은 없지.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말해 주게. '용기 없이는 영광도 없다!'

english: Of course, of course, they're the highest form of cat that I know of.
translation: 물론, 물론이지. 내가 아는 한 고양이 중에서 가장 높은 경지에 오른 녀석들이라네.

english: They're tougher, stronger and faster than other variations of cat, they can catch butterflies and kalphite larva and are far superior to any other type of cat at hunting.
translation: 다른 종류의 고양이보다 더 강인하고, 힘세고, 빠르지. 나비나 kalphite larva(칼파이트 유충)도 잡을 수 있고, 사냥 실력은 어떤 고양이도 따라오지 못한다네.

english: So is there any drawbacks to owning them?
Wily cats need looking after or else they get fat and lazy.
translation: Wily cats(영리한 고양이)는 잘 돌봐 주지 않으면 살찌고 게을러진다네.

english: So how do I look after them then?
The key is to keep it active, bring it hunting or to the ratpits regularly.
translation: 핵심은 계속 움직이게 하는 걸세. 사냥에 데려가거나 ratpits(쥐 구덩이)에 정기적으로 데려가게.

english: Try keep it happy too, they can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 기분도 좋게 해 주게. 심통이 나면 좀 사나워질 수 있거든.

english: What happens if I neglect my cat.. not that I would or anything?
translation: 제가 고양이를 소홀히 하면 어떻게 되죠... 물론 그럴 일은 없지만요?

english: They would get fat and lazy, be much worse at hunting and would show you up as a really poor cat trainer.
translation: 살찌고 게을러지고, 사냥 실력도 훨씬 떨어질 걸세. 자네가 정말 형편없는 고양이 조련사라는 게 들통나겠지.

english: Yes you can get your lazy cat back in shape with a lot of rat catching, but you really shouldn't let it get into that state in the first place.
translation: 그렇다네. 쥐를 많이 잡게 하면 lazy cat(게으른 고양이)도 다시 몸매를 되찾을 수 있지. 하지만 애초에 그런 상태가 되게 두면 안 되네.

english: Can you train my cat for me?
translation: 제 고양이를 훈련시켜 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you rename my cat?
translation: 제 고양이 이름을 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 구덩이에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 저랑 제 고양이한테 줄 조언이 있나요?

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
I think I would adopt an ultra defensive strategy.
I'd like to ask you...
No thanks
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
I am willing to risk my cat if it improves my chances.
translation: 이길 확률이 높아진다면 고양이 목숨을 걸겠어요.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 구덩이에서 훈련하면 제 고양이한테 어떤 이점이 있나요?

english: Can you tell me more about wily cats?
translation: wily cats(영리한 고양이)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: How's the poem going?
I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy.
Hey leave me alone, can't you see that I'm busy?
translation: 이봐, 날 좀 내버려 둬. 나 바쁜 거 안 보여?

english: Oohh, my arms.
Work, work, work, that's all I ever do.
translation: 일, 일, 일, 맨날 일만 해.

english: I feel so weak, I could faint.
translation: 너무 기운이 없어서 쓰러질 것 같아.

english: I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: 너무 피곤해서 서서도 잘 수 있겠어.

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: 하룻밤만이라도 푹 잘 수 있다면 뭐든 줄 텐데.

english: Ooh, my back.
I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
I can't think straight I'm so tired.
I'm sick of this place.
Hello there.
Hi!
Could you help me lift these boxes? They are really heavy!
translation: 이 상자들 드는 것 좀 도와주실래요? 정말 무거워요!

english: Sorry, I'm a bit busy.
Oh, okay, I'll do it myself.
OK then.
Thanks traveller!
Thanks again friend!
The little gnome is too busy to talk.
translation: 꼬마 노움은 너무 바빠서 이야기할 틈이 없습니다.

english: I can't believe they won't let me in!
translation: 날 안 들여보내 주다니 믿을 수가 없네요!

english: I don't believe all this rubbish about an invasion. If mankind wanted to, they could have invaded before now.
translation: 침공이니 뭐니 하는 헛소리는 안 믿어요. 인간들이 마음만 먹었으면 진작 쳐들어왔겠죠.

english: I really need to see King Narnode. Could you help me sneak in?
translation: King Narnode(나노드 왕)을 꼭 만나야 해요. 몰래 들어가게 도와주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, as you helped me I suppose I could. We'll have to be careful. If I get caught I'll be in the cage!
translation: 음, 저를 도와주셨으니 그래 드릴 수는 있겠네요. 조심해야 해요. 들키면 전 우리에 갇힐 거예요!

english: OK, what should I do?
Jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: 수레 뒤에 타세요. 식량 배달이니까 괜찮을 거예요.

english: Why should I help you, you wouldn’t help me!
translation: 제가 왜 도와드려야 하죠? 당신은 저를 안 도와줬잖아요!

english: Erm I know, but this is an emergency!
So was lifting that barrel! Tell you what, call it a round 1000 gold pieces.
translation: 그 통 드는 것도 급한 일이었거든요! 이렇게 하죠, 깔끔하게 1000골드로 해요.

english: 1000 gold pieces!
That’s right, 1000 and I’ll sneak you in.
No chance!
OK then, here you go.
You give Femi 1000 coins.
Alright, jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: 좋아요, 수레 뒤에 타세요. 식량 배달이니까 괜찮을 거예요.

english: Femi sneaks the Player inside the Grand Tree
translation: Femi(페미)가 플레이어를 Grand Tree(거대 나무) 안으로 몰래 들여보냅니다

english: OK traveller, you'd better get going.
translation: 자, 여행자님, 이제 어서 가 보세요.

english: Thanks again!
That's OK, all the best.
Now, to get this lot to the Grand Tree!
translation: 자, 이걸 Grand Tree(거대 나무)까지 옮겨야지!

english: Can I help?
No, I'm OK traveller. I can manage from here.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요, 여행자님. 여기서부턴 저 혼자 할 수 있어요.

english: I'd better get going!
Well done!
Sorry, I'm a bit busy.
Okay then.
No chance!
Ok then, here you go.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 충성 고객이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
translation: 이미 여기 와 계시잖아요, 인간 양반.

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
Shoring up the walls.
What does that do?
Stops them falling down.
Oh, I see.
Aye.
If you want to chatter, you'd better talk to Thorodin over there. I'm working.
translation: 수다를 떨고 싶으면 저기 있는 Thorodin(소로딘)한테 가 보시오. 난 일하는 중이오.

english: Okay then.
Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Welcome to Fernahei's Fishing Shop Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: Fernahei(페르나헤이)의 낚시 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요, 나리! 물건 좀 보시겠어요?

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
That's fine and thanks for your interest.
I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 전 여길 떠날 거예요, 나리. 여긴 좀비가 들끓어요.

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
Welcome wanderer.
What is this place?
You're surrounded by a relic of a long lost kingdom.
translation: 그대를 둘러싼 이곳은 오래전에 사라진 왕국의 유적이오.

english: What happened here?
Oh, I couldn't really tell you that.
translation: 오, 그건 내가 뭐라 말해 주기 어렵소.

english: This place has sat in ruin for an age, slowly destroyed by the harsh climate of the Wilderness.
translation: 이곳은 오랜 세월 폐허로 남아, Wilderness(황야)의 혹독한 기후에 서서히 무너져 왔소.

english: If it's a ruin, what's the point in being here?
I search for knowledge. I want to know what happened to this part of the world.
translation: 나는 지식을 찾고 있소. 이 땅에 대체 무슨 일이 있었는지 알고 싶소.

english: Whilst looking for answers, I slowly turned this broken town into a safe haven for travellers. Welcome to Ferox Enclave.
translation: 답을 찾는 동안, 이 무너진 마을을 조금씩 여행자들을 위한 안식처로 바꿔 놓았소. Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)에 온 것을 환영하오.

english: Quite a dangerous place for a town, don't you think?
translation: 마을을 세우기엔 꽤 위험한 곳 아닌가요?

english: It is, but that's why it's needed! Look around, you can see how many others share my opinion.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 그래서 더 필요한 것이오! 둘러보시오, 내 생각에 동의하는 이가 얼마나 많은지 알 수 있을 것이오.

english: You'll find yourself quite safe inside my enclave - the protective barriers should keep any troublemakers out.
translation: 내 거주지 안에서는 꽤 안전할 것이오. 보호 결계가 말썽꾼들을 막아 줄 테니.

english: I will warn you though, if you've had Teleblock cast upon you, I will not allow you back into the Enclave. You'd be a danger to the others gathered here.
translation: 다만 경고하겠소. 그대에게 Teleblock(텔레블록)이 걸려 있다면 거주지 안으로 다시 들이지 않겠소. 이곳에 모인 다른 이들에게 위험이 될 테니.

english: Thanks for the information! I'll take a look around.
Tread carefully my friend.
What can you do for me?
translation: 저를 위해 뭘 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, if you'd like, I can make it so you respawn in our Enclave. It'll put you right in the heart of all the chaos that surrounds us.
translation: 원한다면, 그대가 우리 거주지에서 부활하게 해 줄 수 있소. 우리를 둘러싼 혼돈의 한복판에 바로 서게 될 것이오.

english: Tell me more.
This is how it'll work: When you die, you'll respawn right here in Ferox Enclave, just outside the pub we've set up. You will lose your items as normal of course.
translation: 방식은 이렇소. 그대가 죽으면 이곳 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지), 우리가 차린 주점 바로 바깥에서 부활하게 되오. 물론 아이템은 평소처럼 잃게 되오.

english: I won't be able to do anything if you die somewhere like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; they have their own magic to keep you safe.
translation: Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)나 Emir's Arena(에미르의 투기장) 같은 곳에서 죽는다면 나도 어쩔 수 없소. 그곳들은 그대를 지켜 주는 고유의 마법이 있으니.

english: It'll cost you though! Transporting you here is no easy task. 5 million coins should do it, that'd be a one time fee of course.
translation: 하지만 대가가 따르오! 그대를 이곳으로 옮기는 건 쉬운 일이 아니오. 500만 코인이면 될 것이오. 물론 한 번만 내면 되오.

english: I don't have that much money on me.
Understandable, you'd have to be a brave [man/woman] to be carrying that much gold out here.
translation: 이해하오. 이런 곳에서 그만한 금을 들고 다니려면 꽤 용감한 [man/woman](이)어야 할 테니.

english: Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.
translation: 좋아요, 제 부활 지점을 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Thank you, you'll respawn in the Enclave from here on out.
translation: 고맙소. 이제부터 그대는 거주지에서 부활하게 될 것이오.

english: I'm not interested.
Can't say I blame you, this wouldn't be my choice either.
translation: 탓할 수 없구려. 나라도 이건 고르지 않을 테니.

english: That doesn't interest me.
Come find me if you change your mind.
Never mind, I'm just looking around.
So be it.
Can I talk to you about my respawn location?
translation: 제 부활 지점에 대해 이야기할 수 있을까요?

english: Would you like to respawn back in Ferox Enclave again?
translation: 다시 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)에서 부활하고 싶소?

english: Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.
translation: 제 부활 지점을 다시 거주지로 바꿔 주세요.

english: The Wilderness takes a toll on a [man's/woman's] soul. Are you sure you can handle it?
translation: Wilderness(황야)는 [man's/woman's] 영혼을 갉아먹는 법이오. 정말 감당할 수 있겠소?

english: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.
translation: 네, 제 부활 지점을 거주지로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Fair enough, it has been done.
No, maybe another time.
Understandable.
No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave.
How are you finding our sanctuary?
Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.
translation: 제 부활 지점을 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Can't say I blame you, the Wilderness starts to wear down the soul after a while.
translation: 탓할 수 없구려. Wilderness(황야)에 오래 있으면 영혼이 닳기 시작하니.

english: But are you sure? Come and see me if you want to respawn in our Enclave again; I won't need any more money from you.
translation: 하지만 확실하오? 다시 우리 거주지에서 부활하고 싶다면 찾아오시오. 돈은 더 받지 않겠소.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.
translation: 네, 제 부활 지점을 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Done.
No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.
Fine.
It's working for me so far, thanks.
What is this place?
What can you do for me?
translation: 저를 위해 뭘 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'll be heading off then.
Tell me more.
Okay, switch my respawn to Ferox Enclave.
translation: 좋아요, 제 부활 지점을 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: I'm not interested.
That doesn't interest me.
Nevermind.
Ask about your respawn point.
Please switch my respawn back to the Enclave.
translation: 제 부활 지점을 다시 거주지로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to the Enclave.
translation: 네, 제 부활 지점을 거주지로 바꿔 주세요.

english: No, maybe another time.
No, I don't want to respawn in the Enclave
Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.
translation: 제 부활 지점을 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.
translation: 네, 제 부활 지점을 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: No, I'll keep the Enclave respawn.
It's working for me so far, thanks.
Hello, where does your ferry go?
I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off?
translation: 떠나고 싶으면 Al Kharid(알 카리드)까지 태워다 주지, 어때?

english: Want t' continue the fight against Tempoross, eh? Good stuff!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)랑 계속 싸우고 싶다고? 좋아, 좋아!

english: Yes
No
Hello there.
Ahoy!
What are you doing here?
I ferry skilled sailors and fisherfolk south t' the Spirit Anglers' base in the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 솜씨 좋은 선원이랑 어부들을 남쪽 Ruins of Unkah(운카 폐허)에 있는 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼) 기지까지 태워다 주고 있지.

english: The Spirit Anglers? Who are they?
Why, they're a group of sea-faring folk researchin' and fightin' against Tempoross, the crazed spirit that's terrorising the seas! I'm surprised you haven't heard!
translation: 아니, 바다를 공포에 떨게 하는 미친 영혼 Tempoross(템포로스)를 연구하고 맞서 싸우는 뱃사람 무리잖아! 못 들어 봤다니 놀랍구먼!

english: That sounds important! Can I help?
translation: 중요한 일 같네요! 제가 도울 수 있을까요?

english: It's rough out there against Tempoross. We really need fisherfolk who've experienced more of the world.
translation: 바다에서 Tempoross(템포로스)랑 싸우는 건 험한 일이야. 세상 경험이 더 많은 어부가 정말 필요하거든.

english: I can ferry ye down t' the Spirit Anglers, though they're looking for people with more fishing experience t' face Tempoross.
translation: Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)한테 태워다 줄 순 있는데, 거기선 Tempoross(템포로스)랑 맞설 만큼 낚시 경험이 많은 사람을 찾고 있어.

english: You need a Fishing level of 35 to fight Tempoross.
Of course! I can ferry ye down there when ye be ready. Ye'll want t' speak to Captain Pudi when ye arrive!
translation: 물론이지! 준비되면 그리로 태워다 주마. 도착하면 Captain Pudi(푸디 선장)한테 말을 걸어 봐!

english: Do I have to pay for the ferry?
'Course not. Don't even 'ave t' fix a price!
translation: 당연히 공짜지! 값을 매길 필요도 없다고!

english: The player travels to the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 플레이어가 Ruins of Unkah(운카 폐허)로 이동합니다.

english: You ride the little boat south to the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: 작은 배를 타고 남쪽 Ruins of Unkah(운카 폐허)로 갑니다.

english: Maybe next time, eh?
Captain Pudi mentioned you'd stopped by.
translation: Captain Pudi(푸디 선장) 말로는 네가 들렀다더군.

english: I certainly did! How is the fight against Tempoross going?
translation: 그럼요! Tempoross(템포로스)와의 싸움은 어떻게 돼 가요?

english: Well, that crazed spirit still terrorises the seas but wit' the 'elp of people like yeself, the Spirit Anglers are puttin' up a good fight!
translation: 음, 그 미친 영혼은 아직도 바다를 휘젓고 있지만, 너 같은 사람들 덕분에 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)이 잘 버티고 있어!

translation: 배에 있는 crate(나무 상자)에서 harpoon(작살)을 하나 챙겨서, 섬 주변에서 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 좀 낚아 와. 그게 Tempoross(템포로스)한테 쏠 탄약으로 아주 그만이거든!

english: Once ye caught some, ye can cook 'em at the shrines on the island if ye want 'em to pack more of a punch. Then come back t' the ship an' load 'em in the ammunition crates next to the cannons.
translation: 좀 잡았으면, 더 세게 한 방 먹이고 싶을 땐 섬에 있는 제단에서 구워도 돼. 그다음 배로 돌아와서 대포 옆에 있는 탄약 상자에 넣으라고.

english: Our cannoneers will get t' firin' the harpoonfish at Tempoross. When it's weak an' submerges to recover its energy, get down to the jetty next t' the ship an' fish those spirit pools.
translation: 우리 포수들이 작살고기를 Tempoross(템포로스)한테 쏴 댈 거야. 놈이 약해져서 기운을 회복하려고 물속에 가라앉으면, 배 옆 부두로 내려가서 영혼 웅덩이에서 낚시를 해.

english: Be quick with fishin' those spirit pools though, or it'll come back so strong we'll have to abandon the fight! With any luck, we'll weaken those spirit fish enough t' subdue Tempoross. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 근데 영혼 웅덩이 낚시는 서둘러야 해. 안 그러면 놈이 엄청 세져서 돌아오는 바람에 싸움을 포기해야 할 거라고! 운만 좋으면 영혼 물고기를 충분히 약하게 만들어서 Tempoross(템포로스)를 제압할 수 있을 거야. 자, 이제 싸우러 가, 선원!

english: Aye aye!
What should I watch out for?
If Tempoross electrocutes a cannon t' stop it from firin', ya better load your harpoonfish into the other ammunition crates t' keep them cannons firin' instead.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 대포를 못 쏘게 하려고 전기를 먹이면, 작살고기를 다른 탄약 상자에 넣어서 남은 대포들이 계속 쏘게 해야 해.

english: Also, make sure t' grab a rope from the ship crates an' keep an eye out for big waves. We'll make sure t' shout about them. Then ye best quickly tether yerself t' an island totem pole or ship mast with that rope.
translation: 그리고 배에 있는 상자에서 rope(밧줄)을 꼭 챙기고 큰 파도를 잘 살펴. 파도가 오면 우리가 꼭 소리쳐 줄게. 그러면 그 밧줄로 섬의 totem pole(토템 기둥)이나 배의 mast(돛대)에 얼른 몸을 묶어.

english: If the waves break the totem pole or ship mast, ye can grab a hammer from the ship crates t' fix 'em up before the next big wave hits.
translation: 파도에 토템 기둥이나 돛대가 부서지면, 배에 있는 상자에서 hammer(망치)를 꺼내서 다음 큰 파도가 오기 전에 고쳐 놔.

english: Oh, an' keep an eye out for lightnin' clouds causin' fires. Get a bucket from the ship crates, fill it with water at a pump, and get t' puttin it out before it spreads.
translation: 아, 그리고 번개 구름 때문에 불이 나는지도 잘 지켜봐. 배에 있는 상자에서 bucket(양동이)를 꺼내서 pump(펌프)에서 물을 채운 다음, 불이 번지기 전에 꺼 버려.

english: If ye get hit by the waves or fire, don't be surprised when ye lose those fish an' tools ye gathered. Now get t' the fight, sailor!
translation: 파도나 불에 맞으면 모아 둔 물고기랑 도구를 잃어버려도 놀라지 마. 자, 이제 싸우러 가, 선원!

english: I want to leave.
Really? You will receive no reward if you do.
translation: 정말? 그러면 보상은 하나도 못 받아.

english: I'll get on with the fighting.
We did it! Tempoross has been sudbued once again. Well done!
translation: 해냈다! Tempoross(템포로스)를 또 한 번 제압했어. 잘했어!

english: Take a well deserved rest but don't get too comfy, it'll regain its energy soon enough!
translation: 푹 쉬어도 되지만 너무 늘어지진 마. 놈은 금방 다시 기운을 차릴 테니까!

english: What should I do now?
We usually find some debris washed up near the docks back at Unkah. Feel free t' have a look. Ya might find somethin' useful!
translation: 보통 Unkah(운카)로 돌아가면 부두 근처에 debris(잔해)가 떠밀려 와 있거든. 마음껏 뒤져 봐. 쓸 만한 게 나올지도 몰라!

english: It won't be long before Tempoross regains enough energy to be a problem and we'll have to wrangle it again. Hopefully we can count on you to 'elp!
translation: 머지않아 Tempoross(템포로스)가 다시 말썽 피울 만큼 기운을 차리면 또 붙잡아 눌러야 할 거야. 그때도 네가 도와줄 거라고 믿을게!

english: I'm ready to leave.
Aye aye!
Goodbye.
Tempoross will surface soon, prepare yourselves!
More fish!
Load those cannons!
Keep an eye on the waves!
Tempoross is drawing in water, prepare yourselves!
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)가 물을 빨아들이고 있다, 다들 준비해!

english: The totem pole has been damaged!
Storm clouds are rolling in, get your buckets ready!
Tempoross has submerged, fish from the whirlpools!
Tempoross has surfaced, keep those cannons firing!
Tempoross has retreated to the depths!
Tempoross has gathered too much energy!
The storm has grown too strong, we must retreat!
How do I help?
What should I watch out for?
I want to leave.
Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Goodbye.
What do you need, adventurer? There is a battle to fight!
translation: 무슨 일이야, 모험가? 싸워야 할 전투가 있다고!

english: How do I help?
Get yerself a harpoon from the crate on the ship, then go fish around the island t' catch some harpoonfish. They make fer fine ammo against Tempoross!
translation: 배에 있는 crate(나무 상자)에서 harpoon(작살)을 하나 챙겨서, 섬 주변에서 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 좀 낚아 와. 그게 Tempoross(템포로스)한테 쏠 탄약으로 아주 그만이거든!

Yes, I really want to leave.
No, I don't want to leave.
I'll get on with the fighting.
What should I do now?
I'm ready to leave.
Goodbye.
Hey, how you doing?
It is customary when stowing away on a vessel to not introduce yourself to the Captains First Mate, oh foolish one.
translation: 배에 몰래 탄 주제에 선장의 일등 항해사한테 자기소개를 하지 않는 게 관례란다, 이 멍청한 친구야.

english: Hey! I'm not a stowaway!
That Lokar guy invited me aboard...
I see. Well, don't distract me as I'm making preparations for departure.
translation: 그렇군. 그럼 출항 준비 중이니까 방해하지 마.

english: Try not to distract any of the crew either, Zamorak knows it's hard enough to get them to do any work around here without strangers wandering round the ship asking them inane questions.
translation: 선원들도 방해하지 말고. 안 그래도 여기 녀석들한테 일 좀 시키기가 얼마나 힘든지는 Zamorak(자모락)도 아실 텐데, 낯선 놈까지 배를 돌아다니며 쓸데없는 질문을 해 대면 곤란하거든.

english: What does it take to become first mate on a ship?
translation: 배의 일등 항해사가 되려면 뭐가 필요해요?

english: Good question. We have a diplomatic consessionat the turn of the financial year. Said pirate is chosen should the existing mate be absent without leave.
translation: 좋은 질문이야. 회계연도가 바뀔 때마다 외교적 양허 회의를 열지. 기존 항해사가 무단 이탈한 경우에 한해 해당 해적이 선출되는 거야.

english: I had no idea. I always figured it was all about popularity.
translation: 전혀 몰랐어요. 저는 다 인기투표인 줄 알았거든요.

english: It is. I'm just pulling your leg.
I don't sell to outerlanders.
Only Fremenniks may purchase fish here.
translation: 여기서 생선은 Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람만 살 수 있소.

english: Hello there [Fremennik name]. Looking for fresh fish?
translation: 어서 오시오, [Fremennik name]. 신선한 생선을 찾으시오?

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
It is [Fremennik name] the thief!
Guardsguards!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 내 물건을 훔쳐 간 게 바로 당신이로군!

english: Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Some questions are best left unanswered.
translation: 어떤 질문은 대답하지 않는 편이 나은 법이오.

english: Err...
So would you like to buy some fish?
I'll pass.
Suit yourself.
Could I buy some fish?
Where do you get your fish from?
Yes please.
I'll pass.
Good fish. Just keep swimming...swimming...swimming...
The fish swims. It is clearly an obedient fish.
translation: 물고기가 헤엄친다. 확실히 말 잘 듣는 물고기다.

english: Jump! Come on fishy, jump!
The fish bumps into the side of the fishbowl. Then it swims some more.
translation: 물고기가 fishbowl(어항) 벽에 부딪힌다. 그러고는 다시 헤엄친다.

english: Good fish...
Hello there. How's it going?
Hello! Nice day for fishing!
Well given how good today's catch was, I'd say it's going pretty well!
translation: 오늘 잡은 걸 보면, 아주 잘 지내고 있다고 해야겠네요!

english: Nilsal! It's going well, thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
