Very well, thank you.
Not too bad thanks.
Hello there.
His eyes are staring vacantly into space.
translation: 그의 눈은 허공을 멍하니 바라보고 있다.

english: You are not part of our family...
Umm. Not last time I checked.
Soon you will be... Soon you will...
translation: 곧 너도 그렇게 될 거야... 곧 너도...

english: Lost to us.. She is Lost to us...
Who is lost?
Trapped by the light... Lost and trapped...
Ermm... So you don't want to tell me then?
translation: 어음... 그러니까 말해 주기 싫다는 거죠?

english: Trapped... In stone and darkness...
Must find family...
What?
Soon we will all be together...
translation: 곧 우리 모두 함께하게 될 거야...

english: Are you ok?
Must find family... They are all under the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: 가족을 찾아야 해... 다들 푸른 물 아래에 있어... 깊고 깊은 푸른 물 아래에...

english: Ermm... I'll leave you to it then.
Free of the deep blue we are...
We must find...
Yes?
a new home...
We must leave this place...
Where will you go?
Away.. Away to her...
Riiight.
Below the deep, deep blue she waits...
translation: 깊고 깊은 푸른 물 아래에서 그녀가 기다려...

english: Who waits?
They came to her with fire and faith...
translation: 그들은 불과 믿음을 들고 그녀에게 왔어...

english: Who? Who came to who?
Too many... Too many...
Too many what? Make sense!
translation: 뭐가 너무 많은데요? 말 좀 알아듣게 해요!

english: Locked away for all eternity...
You'd better start making sense Sonny Jim or I'll...
translation: 말 좀 알아듣게 하시는 게 좋을 거예요, 아저씨. 안 그러면 제가...

english: Free... Soon to be free...
Must escape the blue.. Deep deep blue
translation: 푸른 물에서 벗어나야 해.. 깊고 깊은 푸른 물에서

english: Pardon?
Family... Under the blue... Must escape the blue...
translation: 가족... 푸른 물 아래에... 푸른 물에서 벗어나야 해...

english: What do you want, outsider?
What are you doing out here?
Port Piscarilius have given me permission to catch anglerfish, this is the only place you can find them!
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에서 anglerfish(아귀)를 잡아도 된다고 허락받았어요. 아귀는 여기서만 잡히거든요!

english: How can I catch anglerfish?
Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to know such things, I'm afraid.
translation: 미안하지만, 그런 건 포트 피스카릴리우스의 친구들만 알 수 있어요.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider, however, you will need to train your fishing skill before catching these.
translation: 외부인, 당신에 대해 좋은 얘기를 들었어요. 하지만 이걸 잡으려면 낚시 실력을 더 키워야 할 거예요.

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider. You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait, if you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: 외부인, 당신에 대해 좋은 얘기를 들었어요. fishing rod(낚싯대)랑 미끼로 쓸 sandworms(모래벌레)가 필요해요. 보급품이 필요하면 Tynan(타이넌)의 바닷가 가게에 가 보세요.

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to fishing.
I'll let you get back to it.
What are you doing out here?
How can I catch anglerfish?
I'll let you get back to it.
Don't talk to me outerlander. Anything you have to say to me, you can say to the Chieftain. Goodbye.
translation: 외지인과는 말하지 않소. 내게 할 말이 있으면 족장에게 하시오. 잘 가시오.

english: Are you a member of the Fremmenik council?
Indeed I am, outerlander. Why do you ask?
Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
translation: 음, Brundt(브룬트)가 그러는데, 원로 의회 일원 일곱 명에게서 찬성표를 받으면 명예 Fremmenik(프레메닉)으로 부족에 들어갈 수 있다고 해서요.

english: Aye, that is indeed true.
So can I have your vote?
translation: 그럼 제게 한 표 주실 수 있나요?

english: You can have my vote on the day the skies turn red, the waters turn pink, the rocks turn yellow and the sun turns black.
translation: 하늘이 붉어지고, 바다가 분홍빛이 되고, 바위가 노래지고, 해가 검게 변하는 날에 내 표를 주겠소.

english: Um... do you have any estimate on when that is?
translation: 음... 그게 대충 언제쯤일지 짐작 가세요?

english: I'm telling you I will never vote for you, you stupid outlander.
translation: 절대로 당신한테 표를 주지 않겠다는 말이오, 이 멍청한 외지인 같으니.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 혹시 바다 건너에서 온 flower(꽃)을 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: I never saw anything like that in my store before.
translation: 내 가게에서 그런 건 본 적이 없소.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: 혹시 이국적이고 엄청나게 희귀한 fish(물고기)를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Ah, so even outerlanders have heard of my amazing catch the other day!
translation: 아, 외지인들까지 요전 날 내가 낚은 굉장한 놈 얘기를 들었나 보군!

english: You have it? Can I trade you something for it?
translation: 그걸 갖고 계세요? 뭔가랑 바꿀 수 있을까요?

english: As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
translation: 생긴 건 이국적이어도 먹기엔 형편없소. 항해사가 숨겨 둔 최고의 낚시터 비밀 map(지도)를 찾아다 주면 기꺼이 바꿔 주겠소.

english: Is that all?
Indeed it is, outerlander. The only reason I sit out here in the cold all day long is so I don't have to pay his outrageous prices.
translation: 그렇소, 외지인. 내가 하루 종일 추운 데 앉아 있는 건 오로지 그자의 터무니없는 값을 치르기 싫어서요.

english: By getting me his copy of that map, I will finally be self sufficient. I might even make a profit!
translation: 그자가 가진 그 지도를 구해 주면 마침내 자급자족할 수 있소. 어쩌면 이문을 남길 수도 있겠지!

english: I'll see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: 혹시 심해 낚시터 map(지도)를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: You should pay attention when I speak! I already told you, that rip off navigator has it, and I want it!
translation: 내가 말할 때 좀 잘 들으시오! 이미 말했잖소, 그 날강도 같은 항해사가 갖고 있고, 난 그걸 원한다고!

english: Here. I got you your map.
Great work outerlander! With this, I can finally catch enough fish to make an honest living from it! Here, have the stupid rare fish.
translation: 잘했소, 외지인! 이거면 마침내 물고기를 충분히 잡아서 정직하게 먹고살 수 있겠소! 자, 그 빌어먹을 희귀한 물고기는 가져가시오.

english: I don't see what's so special about this so called rare fish.
translation: 이 희귀하다는 물고기가 뭐가 그렇게 특별한지 모르겠어요.

english: Me neither, outerlander. That is why I gave it to you.
translation: 나도 모르겠소, 외지인. 그러니까 당신한테 준 거요.

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: 다시 왔구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 마지막으로 이야기한 지 너무 오래됐소! 오늘은 물고기가 아주 잘 무는구려!

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: 낚시 기초를 좀 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Ah, you've lost your net have you? Have another!
translation: 아, 그물을 잃어버렸다고? 하나 더 가져가!

english: I see you already have a net.
Ahoy, to fish, you click on the shrimp fishin' spot while ye'r carrying a net.
translation: 어이, 낚시를 하려면 그물을 들고 shrimp(새우) 낚시터를 클릭하면 돼.

english: I see... is that it?
There's far more as you progress - not just shrimps. You get more equipment, bigger fish and other things too...
translation: 실력이 늘면 할 게 훨씬 많지 - 새우만 있는 게 아니라고. 장비도 더 생기고, 물고기도 더 커지고, 다른 것들도 많아...

english: When you have a full inventory, you can cook it or take it to the bank. You can find a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge and a cookin' range in the castle kitchen.
translation: 소지품이 꽉 차면 요리를 하든지 은행에 맡기든지 해. 은행은 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 옥상에 있고, 요리용 레인지는 성 부엌에 있지.

english: Arrr.. if yer lookin' fer quests you should head over to the Mountain Dwarf who lies north-west of Taverley and have a chat with him, I'm sure he can point you in the right direction.
translation: 아르르.. 퀘스트를 찾고 있으면 Taverley(태벌리) 북서쪽에 사는 Mountain Dwarf(산악 드워프)한테 가서 얘기해 봐. 분명 갈 길을 알려 줄 거야.

english: I can show ye on that map of yours if ya like?
translation: 원하면 네 지도에 표시해 줄 수도 있는데?

english: I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: 낚시 기초는 이미 알아요. 뭐 요령 같은 거 없나요?

english: Arrr, chose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.
translation: 아르르, 어디서 뭘 낚을지 잘 골라. 이 땅 곳곳마다 잡히는 물고기가 다르거든.

english: Make sure you hang on to your fish, don't throw them away as you can get valuable cooking experience from them, gar! Look out for other things too...
translation: 잡은 물고기는 꼭 챙겨 둬. 버리지 말라고, 그걸로 귀한 요리 경험치를 얻을 수 있으니까, 가르르! 다른 것들도 잘 살펴보고...

english: Then of course there is always the trawler...

If you venture to Port Khazard north of Yanille and speaks to me cabin boy Murphy, he can let you and a bunch of friends use his trawler to fish with... Just make sure you take a bailing bucket or two.
translation: Yanille(야닐) 북쪽 Port Khazard(포트 카자드)에 가서 내 사환 Murphy(머피)한테 말을 걸면, 너랑 친구들이 그 녀석 트롤선으로 고기를 잡게 해 줄 거야... 물 퍼내는 양동이를 한두 개 꼭 챙겨 가고.

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish for things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
translation: 그래, 실력이 점점 늘면 Tuna(참치)나 Swordfish(황새치) 같은 것도 낚을 수 있게 될 거야. 이것들은 전투할 때 아주 쓸 만하지.

english: Of course, after that you will get Shark, and if you venture out onto the Trawler from Port Khazard, you can then get Manta Ray or Sea Turtle, very good eatin' on one of them.
translation: 물론 그다음엔 Shark(상어)를 잡게 되고, Port Khazard(포트 카자드)에서 트롤선을 타고 나가면 Manta Ray(쥐가오리)나 Sea Turtle(바다거북)도 잡을 수 있어. 둘 다 먹기엔 그만이지.

english: You can also use a fishing potion if you can get your hands on one and just need that little edge.. ask someone who is familiar with herblore.
translation: 낚시 물약을 구할 수 있으면 그것도 써 봐. 딱 그 한 끗이 아쉬울 때 말이야.. 약초학을 잘 아는 사람한테 물어보라고.

english: Now.. quests...
Head over to south of the Legends Guild and East of Ardougne and find Caroline. This will have you investigating some strange happenings on the fishing platform.
translation: Legends Guild(전설의 길드) 남쪽, Ardougne(아르둔) 동쪽으로 가서 Caroline(캐롤라인)을 찾아. fishing platform(낚시 플랫폼)에서 벌어지는 이상한 일들을 조사하게 될 거야.

english: Head over to Tai Bwo Wannai Village on the Isle of Karamja and speak to Timfraku to solve a strange mystery.
translation: Isle of Karamja(카람자 섬)의 Tai Bwo Wannai Village(타이 보 와나이 마을)로 가서 Timfraku(팀프라쿠)한테 말을 걸고 수상한 수수께끼를 풀어 봐.

english: Can't rightly say's there's any I know of that you could handle at the moment, but come back when you're a bit more experienced and I'm sure I can give you a clue.
translation: 지금 네가 감당할 만한 건 딱히 모르겠는데, 경험을 좀 더 쌓고 다시 오면 분명 실마리를 줄 수 있을 거야.

english: Tell me about different fish.
Some rich rewards for big net fishin', make sure you be using a big net fishing spot though...
translation: 큰 그물 낚시엔 짭짤한 보상이 있지. 큰 그물 낚시터에서 하는 것만 잊지 마...

english: Is that all?
Ahoy, there's also the fishin' guild if ya skilled enough, you can find it south west of Seers' Village.
translation: 어이, 실력만 되면 낚시 길드도 있어. Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 남서쪽에 있지.

english: Where and what should I fish?
A young and enthusiastic fisher. Try south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja to fish for Shrimp at level 1 or Sardines at level 5. Aye, me parrot concurs.
translation: 젊고 열정 넘치는 어부로군. Draynor Village(드레이너 마을) 남쪽이나 Karamja(카람자) 섬 부두에서 레벨 1엔 Shrimp(새우)를, 레벨 5엔 Sardines(정어리)를 낚아 봐. 그래, 내 앵무새도 그렇다는군.

english: What parrot?
Me parrot Percy on me shoulder thar! Arr!
translation: 내 어깨 위에 있는 내 앵무새 Percy(퍼시) 말이야! 아르르!

english: Oookay...sure, a parrot, on your shoulder.
Arrr!
Herrin' can be fished from south of Draynor Village or the pier on the island of Karamja when you reach level 10.
translation: 레벨 10이 되면 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을) 남쪽이나 Karamja(카람자) 섬 부두에서 Herrin'(청어)를 낚을 수 있어.

english: You can use your small net to catch Anchovies from south of Draynor when you reach level 15.
translation: 레벨 15가 되면 Draynor(드레이너) 남쪽에서 작은 그물로 Anchovies(멸치)를 잡을 수 있지.

english: You can practice your fly fishin' in the Lumbridge river to catch Trout at level 20.
translation: 레벨 20이면 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 강에서 플라이 낚시를 연습해서 Trout(송어)를 잡을 수 있어.

english: Pike can be fished from Lumbridge river using your fishing rod and some bait with at least level 25 fishing.
translation: 낚시 레벨이 25 이상이면 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 강에서 낚싯대와 미끼로 Pike(강꼬치고기)를 낚을 수 있지.

english: Use your harpoon and see if you can catch yourself a few Tuna from the pier on the island of Karamja at level 35.
translation: 레벨 35면 작살을 들고 Karamja(카람자) 섬 부두에서 Tuna(참치)를 몇 마리 잡을 수 있나 해 봐.

english: You can use that Lobster pot from the pier on the island of Karamja to get yourself a whole bunch of the little critters once you reach level 40.
translation: 레벨 40이 되면 Karamja(카람자) 섬 부두에서 Lobster pot(바닷가재 통발)로 그 꼬맹이들을 한가득 잡을 수 있어.

english: Congratulations, you can now harpoon Swordfish after level 50. Try the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: 축하해, 레벨 50이 넘었으니 이제 작살로 Swordfish(황새치)를 잡을 수 있어. Karamja(카람자) 섬 부두에서 해 봐.

english: Herrin' can be fished from Catherby and some other places when you reach level 10.
translation: 레벨 10이 되면 Catherby(캐서비)랑 다른 몇몇 곳에서 Herrin'(청어)를 낚을 수 있어.

english: You can use a big net to catch Mackerel from Catherby when you reach level 16.
translation: 레벨 16이 되면 Catherby(캐서비)에서 큰 그물로 Mackerel(고등어)를 잡을 수 있지.

english: Cod can be fished from Catherby and some other places once you reach level 23.
translation: 레벨 23이 되면 Catherby(캐서비)랑 다른 몇몇 곳에서 Cod(대구)를 낚을 수 있어.

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Slimy Eel in the swamps at level 28.
translation: 레벨 28이면 늪에서 낚싯대와 미끼로 Slimy Eel(끈적한 장어)를 잡을 수 있지.

english: You can use your fishin' rod and some bait to catch Cave Eel in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp at level 38.
translation: 레벨 38이면 Lumbridge Swamp(럼브리지 늪) 아래 동굴에서 낚싯대와 미끼로 Cave Eel(동굴 장어)를 잡을 수 있어.

english: Bass can be caught at level 46 in your big net if you wander along to Catherby.
translation: Catherby(캐서비)까지 걸어가면 레벨 46에 큰 그물로 Bass(농어)를 잡을 수 있지.

english: Tuna and Swordfish can be harpooned - if you're good enough - from the thrivin' fishing village of Catherby, or if you can get in try the Fishin' Guild. Level 35 for Tuna and 50 for Swordfish.
translation: Tuna(참치)랑 Swordfish(황새치)는 - 실력만 되면 - 북적이는 어촌 Catherby(캐서비)에서 작살로 잡을 수 있고, 들어갈 수 있으면 낚시 길드에서도 해 봐. 참치는 레벨 35, 황새치는 50이야.

english: You can also go talk to Murphy and see if you can use his trawler to catch Manta Ray and Sea Turtle if you're really good... Gar!
translation: 실력이 정말 좋다면 Murphy(머피)한테 가서 트롤선으로 Manta Ray(쥐가오리)랑 Sea Turtle(바다거북)을 잡을 수 있는지 물어봐도 돼... 가르르!

english: Goodbye.
Can you teach me the basics of fishing please?
translation: 낚시 기초를 좀 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
I already know about the basics of fishing, got any tips?
translation: 낚시 기초는 이미 알아요. 뭐 요령 같은 거 없나요?

english: Any advice for an advanced fisher?
Tell me about different fish.
Small Net Fish
Big Net Fish
Rod and Fly Fishing
Lobster pot
Harpoon Fish
Tell me about...
Where and what should I fish?
Goodbye.
Greetings, Your Royal Highness. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 안녕하십니까, 전하. 신선한 생선 여기 있습니다!

english: I've heard that the Etceterian fish is stored in a cow shed.
translation: Etceterian(에트세테리아) 생선은 외양간에 보관돼 있다고 들었습니다.

english: Wow, are you okay? What happendto you?
Ugh... Well met, adventurer. I wouldn't go down there if I were you. That trap is an absolute nightmare! The one who created it must be a sadist. I don't know of anyone who has cleared it.
translation: 으윽... 반가워요, 모험가 양반. 나라면 저 아래로는 안 가겠어요. 저 함정은 완전 악몽이에요! 만든 사람은 분명 가학 성향이 있을 거예요. 저걸 통과한 사람은 본 적이 없어요.

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
Oh? Are you pulling my leg, adventurer?
translation: 네? 지금 사람 놀리는 거예요, 모험가 양반?

english: I'm fairly certain that if I did that, it would fall off!
translation: 놀리다니요, 그 몸을 잘못 건드렸다간 정말 어디 하나 떨어져 나갈 것 같은데요!

english: No need to add salt in the wound.
Although I am curious, how did you beat the trap?
translation: 그래도 궁금하긴 하네요. 함정을 어떻게 통과했어요?

english: I just made sure to prioritise looking out for the arrows. The fire was fairly easy to get through if I just made sure to take one step at a time.
translation: 화살을 살피는 걸 제일 우선으로 했어요. 불은 한 칸씩 차근차근 움직이기만 하면 꽤 쉽게 지나갈 수 있었고요.

english: I see, you're clearly more skillful than I. I'm not sure if I'd be agile enough to do that. Do tell, what was on the next floor?
translation: 그렇군요, 확실히 나보다 실력이 좋네요. 난 그렇게 할 만큼 날렵하지 못할 것 같아요. 말해 줘요, 다음 층엔 뭐가 있었어요?

english: The place looked magnificent, gold lion statues, coffins untouched by anyone else and plenty of Hallowed marks compared to these floors. Although, the traps were significantly harder than the one below.
translation: 정말 굉장했어요. 금빛 사자 조각상, 아무도 손대지 않은 관들, 그리고 이 층들보다 Hallowed mark(신성한 증표)도 훨씬 많았어요. 대신 함정은 아래층보다 훨씬 어려웠고요.

english: I see. Well, I guess I'd better brush up on my skills if I want to see it for myself. Nothing worth having in life comes easy right?
translation: 그렇군요. 직접 보고 싶으면 실력을 더 갈고닦아야겠네요. 인생에서 가질 가치가 있는 건 쉽게 오지 않는 법이잖아요?

english: That's very true, I wish you the best of luck!
No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 아무도 통과 못 했다고요? 그게 얼마나 어렵다고요?

english: Well, unlike the rest of the traps I've seen so far, you have to deal with both an arrow trap and a fire trap at the same time.
translation: 음, 지금까지 본 다른 함정들과 달리 화살 함정이랑 화염 함정을 동시에 상대해야 해요.

english: Wow, that does sound hard. Do you have any tips for me?
translation: 와, 정말 어렵겠네요. 요령 좀 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well, individually they aren't that hard to do. The fires are always swapping between on and off. I think that if you run to where the fire just was you should be safe.
translation: 음, 하나씩 놓고 보면 그렇게 어렵진 않아요. 불은 항상 켜졌다 꺼졌다 해요. 방금 불이 있던 자리로 달려가면 안전할 거예요.

english: The hardest part for me is the arrows. You have to look forward to watch the fire trap whilst also looking over your shoulder to see where the arrows are.
translation: 제일 힘든 건 화살이에요. 앞을 보면서 화염 함정을 살피는 동시에 어깨 너머로 화살이 어디서 오는지도 봐야 하거든요.

english: I certainly wish there was a way to see both at once. Perhaps it would help if a fellow adventurer was looking down from above to call out where the arrows are.
translation: 둘 다 한 번에 볼 방법이 있으면 정말 좋겠어요. 동료 모험가가 위에서 내려다보면서 화살 위치를 불러 주면 도움이 될지도 모르겠네요.

english: Yeah... I'd imagine having an aerial view of the situation would be pretty helpful.
translation: 그러게요... 상황을 위에서 내려다볼 수 있으면 꽤 도움이 되겠네요.

english: Of course, but we both know that's impossible for one person! Ouch! Sorry, it hurts to laugh. I wish you luck adventurer!
translation: 물론이죠, 하지만 혼자서는 불가능하다는 거 우리 둘 다 알잖아요! 아야! 미안해요, 웃으니까 아프네요. 행운을 빌어요, 모험가 양반!

english: Oh? I've cleared it.
No one has cleared it? How hard can it be?
translation: 아무도 통과 못 했다고요? 그게 얼마나 어렵다고요?

english: Hello. I'm the flax keeper. I tend to the flax fields, keeping the yield and continued flax harvest healthy.
translation: 안녕하세요. 저는 아마 관리인이에요. 아마 밭을 돌보면서 수확량과 꾸준한 아마 수확이 잘 유지되도록 관리하고 있죠.

english: Ooh! Great work!
Thank you. I must get back to work. You never know when a great flax harvest will begin!
translation: 고마워요. 이제 일하러 돌아가야겠어요. 언제 아마 대풍년이 시작될지 모르니까요!

english: Hello. Do you want to exchange some flax banknotes for bowstrings? I'll exchange [amount] for you today, and you can come back tomorrow for more.
translation: 안녕하세요. 아마 교환권을 활시위로 바꾸고 싶으세요? 오늘은 [amount]장까지 바꿔 드릴 수 있고, 내일 다시 오시면 더 바꿔 드릴게요.

english: I didn't actually bring [amount] flax banknotes with me.
Oh. Well, if you fetch that many flax banknotes, I'll swap them for bowstrings for you.
translation: 아. 그럼 그만큼 아마 교환권을 가져오시면 활시위로 바꿔 드릴게요.

english: Um... Actually, you seem to have so much stuff that you can't hold the bowstrings.
translation: 음... 그런데 짐이 너무 많아서 활시위를 들 수가 없겠는데요.

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I won't be able to exchange any more flax for bowstrings today. Try me again tomorrow.
translation: 또 오셨네요. 죄송하지만 오늘은 아마를 활시위로 더 바꿔 드릴 수가 없어요. 내일 다시 오세요.

english: Today I can exchange [amount] flax banknotes for bowstrings, if you bring me enough flax banknotes.
translation: 아마 교환권을 충분히 가져오시면 오늘은 [amount]장을 활시위로 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Sorry, your inventory's too full of stuff.
translation: 죄송해요, 소지품에 짐이 너무 꽉 찼네요.

english: I have a question for you.
The Flax keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Flax keeper(아마 관리인)이 도전 두루마리를 주었다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
You've obtained a casket!
Agree
Decline
You want play game of pinball, [player name]?
translation: 너 핀볼 게임 하고 싶어, [player name]?

english: Yes, pinball is fun.
No thanks.
Going away now.
Nope, you wrong person.
Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
You gotta poke dem pillars.
translation: 너 저 기둥들 쿡 찔러야 돼.

english: What? All of them?
No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: 아니, 아니. 반짝반짝 고리 없는 기둥 찌르면, 그거 나빠.

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: 그러니까 반짝이는 기둥을 찔러야 한다는 거죠?

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: 응. 그거 열 번 하면, 너 상 받아.

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: 응, 가. 우리 이제 쉬는 시간.

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
Come play game, [player name]!
We got good game, [player name]!
You want play game, [player name]!
You like hitting things, [player name]?
translation: 너 뭐 때리는 거 좋아해, [player name]?

english: Maybe later.
Yes, pinball is fun.
No thanks.
You pet the dog...
Woof woof!
You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.
translation: 개에게 맛있는 고기 한 조각을 주었다. 개가 허겁지겁 먹어 치운다.

english: Grrrr!
That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: 역겨워라 - 그런 걸 불쌍한 개한테 줄 순 없어!

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
translation: 개는 그것에 관심이 없는 것 같다.

english: Hi there. Looking for something new to wear? You've come to the right place if so.
translation: 안녕하세요. 새로 입을 옷을 찾으세요? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요.

english: Let's see what you have.
I'm good, thank you.
No worries.
Let's see what you have.
I'm good, thank you.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 이야, Hero(영웅)님이다! 와! 정말 대단해요, 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 상대한 거예요? 마을도 정말 근사해졌어요, 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Florin, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: 반가워요! 제 이름은 Florin(플로린)이에요. 이것저것 조금씩 해요. 그냥 살아남으려는 거죠, 우리가 할 수 있는 게 그것밖에 없거든요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 딱 완벽해요, 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 키울 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고 있고, 다들 당신께 너무나 감사하고 있어요. 저는 영웅을 실제로 보거나 알아본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Oh, hello again. Want some fish?
translation: 아, 또 왔구먼. 생선 좀 사겠나?

english: Yes, show me the fish.
Not right now.
Yes, show me the fish.
Not right now.
Hello.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm selling flowers, 15gp for three. Would you like some?
translation: 꽃을 팔고 있어요, 세 송이에 15gp예요. 좀 사실래요?

english: I don't have enough money.
Yes, please.
Thank you! Here you go.
No, thank you.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
I'm selling flowers, 15gp for three. Would you like some, Your Highness?
translation: 꽃을 팔고 있어요, 세 송이에 15gp예요. 좀 사시겠어요, 전하?

english: Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Bees are very active on this bush and there are pollen-rich flowers. You carefully collect some Strange pollen.
translation: 이 덤불에는 벌들이 활발히 움직이고 꽃가루가 풍부한 꽃들이 피어 있다. Strange pollen(이상한 꽃가루)를 조심스럽게 모았다.

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] anima-infused bark.
translation: anima-infused bark(아니마가 깃든 나무껍질)을 [1 or 2]개 받았다.

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are unpollinated flowers. You carefully apply it with the help of some nearby bees then extract some from the bush.
translation: 이 덤불에는 벌들이 활발히 움직이고 아직 수분되지 않은 꽃들이 있다. 근처 벌들의 도움을 받아 꽃가루를 조심스럽게 묻힌 뒤 덤불에서 조금 채취했다.

english: You've been awarded [1 or 2] Anima-infused bark.
translation: Anima-infused bark(아니마가 깃든 나무껍질)을 [1 or 2]개 받았다.

english: There are no open, unpollinated flowers on this bush yet.
translation: 이 덤불에는 아직 피어 있는 수분 안 된 꽃이 없다.

english: You took the pollen from this bush and should apply it to a bush with unpollinated flowers.
translation: 이 덤불에서 꽃가루를 채취했다. 수분되지 않은 꽃이 있는 덤불에 묻혀야 한다.

english: A bush as started producing fruit, well done!
The bushes become dormant and the bees move on. You've helped make the forest a more diverse and beautiful place!
translation: 덤불들이 휴면에 들어가고 벌들은 떠나간다. 덕분에 숲이 더 다양하고 아름다운 곳이 되었다!

english: You've been awarded [number] Anima-based bark.
You discard your left over pollen.
Hello. Do you want to buy or sell any maces?
No thanks.
No thanks.
Well, I'll have a look, at least.
We seed the hidden truths of this world! Ranul rewards all of us who are willing to find them!
translation: 우리는 이 세상의 숨겨진 진리를 찾는 자들입니다! Ranul(라눌)께서는 그것을 찾고자 하는 우리 모두에게 보답하십니다!

english: Ralos and Ranul are the twin guardians of our fate! Trust in them, for they will lead us to our destinies!
translation: Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)은 우리 운명을 지키는 쌍둥이 수호자이십니다! 그분들을 믿으십시오. 그분들께서 우리를 운명으로 이끄실 것입니다!

english: Do not fear the dark of night! Embrace it, for it is a gift from Ranul!
translation: 밤의 어둠을 두려워하지 마십시오! 그것을 받아들이십시오. 그것은 Ranul(라눌)께서 내리신 선물이니!

english: In times of sorrow, we look to Ralos and Ranul. They guide us through day and night.
translation: 슬픔의 때에 우리는 Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)을 바라봅니다. 그분들께서 낮과 밤 내내 우리를 인도하십니다.

english: Be bold in the day, but reflect in the night! Let the teachings of both Ralos and Ranul guide you equally!
translation: 낮에는 담대하고, 밤에는 성찰하십시오! Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌), 두 분의 가르침이 똑같이 그대를 인도하게 하십시오!

english: Ralos teaches us to be brave! To be bold! Let his warmth in, and it will burn away all doubts!
translation: Ralos(랄로스)께서는 우리에게 용감하라고! 담대하라고 가르치십니다! 그분의 온기를 받아들이십시오. 그 온기가 모든 의심을 불태워 없앨 것입니다!

english: Ralos shines upon us who are brave! If we show the courage to act, he will reward us!
translation: Ralos(랄로스)께서는 용감한 우리를 비추십니다! 행동할 용기를 보인다면 그분께서 보답하실 것입니다!

english: Hey! You can't come through here! This is private land!
translation: 이봐요! 여긴 지나갈 수 없어요! 사유지라고요!

english: You will need to find another way in.
Nice weather we're having today.
It's so peaceful here, don't you agree?
There's plenty of trees around, couldn't you go to another spot?
translation: 주변에 나무가 이렇게 많은데, 다른 데로 가 주면 안 될까요?

english: Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구. 나는 악을 처단하고 녀석들의 전리품을 챙기고 싶어요! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 데려가 줘요!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 저 아래 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 되셨어요?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 그런 것 같은데요? 적어도 내 마음은 용기를 알고 있으니 당분간은 그걸로 충분할 거예요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 쓸 만한 보급품을 살 수 있겠죠.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 그런데 Morytania(모리타니아)의 뱀파이어는 은 말고는 아무것도 안 통한다는 거 알고 계세요?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 어...음, 그런 얘긴 못 들어 봤지만, Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 쓸 만한 무기를 마련해 주실 거라 믿어요.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 그건 당신이 피하게 도와줄 거라 믿어요. 어쨌든 당신이 안내인이잖아요, 안 그래요? 게다가 몸 좀 쓸 줄 아는 사람처럼 보이는데요. 그런 놈들이랑 싸워서 이겨 본 적 있겠죠? 그게 얼마나 어렵겠어요?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 사실 꽤 어려울 수 있어요. 그래도 맞는 말이에요, 제가 안내인이니까 상황은 제가 감당할 수 있을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 왜 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 가고 싶으세요?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 거기 내려가서 그 뱀파이어 놈들한테 따끔하게 한두 수 가르쳐 줄 거예요. 거기 사정이 끔찍하다고 들었거든요. 내가 끝장을 낼 생각이에요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로 지킬 수 있으세요?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 경험은 좀 있다고만 해 두죠. 적도 내 몫만큼은 기꺼이 상대할 거예요. 그건 걱정 안 해도 돼요.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 제가 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 동료가 있네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 그 동료를 안전한 곳에 두고 출발하죠.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 정말요? 그럼 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott Ramble(버그 드 로트 램블) 시작

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 주려는 거예요? 잠깐만요, 배낭 좀 열게요.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 여긴 좀 음침하네요. 사람들이 어떻게 여기서 살죠?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 자주 가요? 길을 잘 아는 것 같은데요.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)엔 언제쯤 도착해요?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가죠. 챙길 전리품이 있다고요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 우리 같은 모험가들한테 강요되는 호화로운 생활보단 낫죠! 차라리 눈까지 진흙에 파묻혀서 한판 제대로 싸우는 게 훨씬 좋아요!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야겠는데요. 저 다리는 못 건너겠어요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 이거 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야겠네요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 지나갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와아! 끝내줬어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 당신 혼자 처리해야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 무사히 데려다줘서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보상이에요.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 저 아래 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 되셨어요?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 왜 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 가고 싶으세요?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로 지킬 수 있으세요...?

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 제가 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 뱀파이어가 되는 걸 막아 줘서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 증명서 받아 줘요. 미안하지만 보상으로 드릴 수 있는 게 이것뿐이에요.

english: Human.
Hello there. Who are you?
Fornek quo Maten. I am a hunter for the Kahlith. Do you wish to serve the balance?
translation: Fornek quo Maten(포르넥 쿠오 마텐). Kahlith(칼리스)의 사냥꾼이다. 균형을 섬기겠는가?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)에게 가 보아라. 그녀가 인도해 줄 것이다.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 아쉽군. 그대는 죽음을 불러오는 자이니, 균형에 크게 쓸모가 있을 텐데.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기해 보아라. 그가 길을 보여 줄 것이다.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Can I help you at all?
Oh...you've come back.
Please...I havent got any more vinegar. Give me some time I beg you.
translation: 제발...식초는 더 없습니다. 시간을 좀 주세요, 부탁드립니다.

english: I wasn't after vinegar today.
translation: 오늘은 식초 때문에 온 게 아니에요.

english: Oh, wonderful.
I will have some in soon, if he needs it.
In the meantime, can I interest you in something?
translation: 그동안 뭔가 관심 가는 물건은 없으신가요?

english: Yes, what are you selling?
No.
Well, I'll put something special to one side for you.
translation: 그럼 손님 몫으로 특별한 걸 따로 챙겨 두겠습니다.

english: Thanks.
Not at the moment.
Then move along, you filthy ragamuffin, I have customers to serve!
translation: 그럼 썩 꺼져, 이 더러운 거지 녀석아. 나는 상대할 손님들이 있다고!

english: Have you got any vinegar?
Vinegar?
Vinegar!
The very idea! My wines are the finest in the district!
translation: 말도 안 되는 소리! 내 포도주는 이 구역에서 최고급이라고요!

english: Sorry! I was told to come and speak with a wine merchant about getting some vinegar, I must have the wrong person.
translation: 죄송해요! 식초를 구하려면 포도주 상인과 얘기해 보라고 들어서요. 제가 사람을 잘못 찾아왔나 봐요.

english: Wait...did HE send you?
If by HE you mean the old man with the sack of bones, then yes.
translation: 그분이 뼈 자루를 든 노인을 말하는 거라면, 네.

english: Aaaah...say no more sir, I have some in specially.
translation: 아아...더 말씀하실 필요 없습니다, 손님. 특별히 좀 들여놓은 게 있습니다.

english: Ah! Good afternoon your lordship. I take it you have come for a refill?
translation: 아! 안녕하십니까, 나리. 다시 채우러 오신 거지요?

english: Yes.
Not today.
Well, just remember I have some in stock for you when you want it.
translation: 그럼 원하실 때 언제든 드릴 물건이 준비돼 있다는 것만 기억해 주십시오.

english: Well done.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the thief who stole from me!
translation: 너 나한테서 훔쳐 간 그 도둑이구나!

english: Guardsguards!
Yes.
No.
Yes, what are you selling?
Not at the moment
Yes
Not today
What can I do for you?
translation: 그대를 위해 무엇을 해 주면 되겠소?

english: I hear that I can present you with an offering and you will enchant my lyre for me.
translation: 제물을 바치면 제 리라에 마법을 걸어 주신다고 들었어요.

english: This is true. For a simple enchantment, you may place an offering on my Altar. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 사실이오. 간단한 마법이라면 내 Altar(제단)에 제물을 올리면 되오. 또 도울 일이 있소?

english: You do not have a raw shark to offer.
You do not have a raw manta ray to offer.
translation: 그대에게는 바칠 raw manta ray(날쥐가오리)가 없구려.

english: You do not have a raw sea turtle to offer.
translation: 그대에게는 바칠 raw sea turtle(날바다거북)이 없구려.

english: You do not have a raw bass to offer.
Can you enchant my lyre so that the enchantment will never fade?
translation: 제 리라에 영원히 사라지지 않는 마법을 걸어 주실 수 있나요?

english: If the offering is great enough, I would be happy to offer you such a powerful enchantment.
translation: 제물이 충분히 훌륭하다면 그처럼 강력한 마법도 기꺼이 걸어 주겠소.

english: Depending on your familiarity of the area, I will require less of an offering.
translation: 그대가 이 지역과 얼마나 친숙한지에 따라 제물은 덜 요구하겠소.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 1000 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 허나 그대에게는 raw shark(날상어), raw manta ray(날쥐가오리), raw sea turtle(날바다거북), raw bass(날농어)를 1000마리씩 바치라 하겠소.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 800 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 허나 그대에게는 raw shark(날상어), raw manta ray(날쥐가오리), raw sea turtle(날바다거북), raw bass(날농어)를 800마리씩 바치라 하겠소.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 600 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik hard diary, it would have been 400.
translation: 허나 그대에게는 raw shark(날상어), raw manta ray(날쥐가오리), raw sea turtle(날바다거북), raw bass(날농어)를 600마리씩 바치라 하겠소. 다만 Fremennik hard diary(프레메닉 상급 일지)를 완료했다면 400마리였을 것이오.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 400 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass. But if you had completed the Fremennik elite diary, it would have been 200.
translation: 허나 그대에게는 raw shark(날상어), raw manta ray(날쥐가오리), raw sea turtle(날바다거북), raw bass(날농어)를 400마리씩 바치라 하겠소. 다만 Fremennik elite diary(프레메닉 엘리트 일지)를 완료했다면 200마리였을 것이오.

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 200 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 허나 그대에게는 raw shark(날상어), raw manta ray(날쥐가오리), raw sea turtle(날바다거북), raw bass(날농어)를 200마리씩 바치라 하겠소.

english: You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.
translation: 그대는 아직 raw shark(날상어) [number]마리, raw manta ray(날쥐가오리) [number]마리, raw sea turtle(날바다거북) [number]마리, raw bass(날농어) [number]마리를 더 바쳐야 하오.

english: You present your offering.
While I appreciate the thought of offering me fish, I am afraid I am unable to use the air you have offered me.
translation: 물고기를 바치려는 마음은 고맙지만, 그대가 바친 공기는 내게 아무 쓸모가 없소.

english: Many thanks for your offering. You still need to offer me [number] raw shark, [number] raw manta ray, [number] raw sea turtle and [number] raw bass.
translation: 제물에 깊이 감사하오. 그대는 아직 raw shark(날상어) [number]마리, raw manta ray(날쥐가오리) [number]마리, raw sea turtle(날바다거북) [number]마리, raw bass(날농어) [number]마리를 더 바쳐야 하오.

english: You have given me a worthy offering, and I will bestow my enchantment whenever you bring me a suitable lyre. I regret I cannot return any of your fish in future, even if you become closer to the Fremenniks.
translation: 그대는 합당한 제물을 바쳤으니, 알맞은 리라를 가져올 때마다 내 마법을 내려 주겠소. 다만 앞으로 그대가 프레메닉 사람들과 더 가까워진다 해도 물고기는 돌려줄 수 없으니 양해하시오.

english: I offer you this enchantment as you have earned my favour.
translation: 그대가 내 호의를 얻었으니 이 마법을 내려 주겠소.

english: I will come back when I have an offering worthy of this power. Goodbye.
translation: 이 힘에 걸맞은 제물이 마련되면 다시 올게요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Farewell then.
Nothing, sorry.
Do not summon me for idle conversation! Come back when you have an offering.
translation: 한가한 잡담이나 하자고 나를 부르지 마시오! 제물이 마련되면 다시 오시오.

english: You do not have a lyre with you that I can enchant. It must have been strung, but it cannot bear any existing enchantment.
translation: 그대에게는 내가 마법을 걸 수 있는 리라가 없소. 줄이 매여 있어야 하고, 이미 걸린 마법이 없어야 하오.

english: Present offering of a single fish.
Raw shark.
Raw manta ray.
Raw sea turtle.
Raw bass.
Ask about a permanent lyre enchantment.
Present offering.
Goodbye.
Nothing.
Hello!
Hello there. Do you have any fossils for me?
I'm Mary. In the tent you'll find Tray, my dog. He's quite friendly and doesn't bite. I'm here for the fossils. I'll go anywhere for fossils!
translation: 저는 Mary(메리)예요. 천막 안에 있는 건 제 개 Tray(트레이)예요. 꽤 순하고 물지 않아요. 저는 화석 때문에 여기 왔어요. 화석이라면 어디든 갈 거예요!

english: Why are you here?
What fossils would you like to trade?
All done. Would you like to trade in any more fossils?
It looks like you don't have any fossils to trade.
You don't have space for that.
Of course, you left it here and I kept it for you.
translation: 물론이죠, 여기 두고 가셨길래 제가 보관해 뒀어요.

english: Goodbye.
Who are you?
I'd like to trade some fossils.
Small fossils.
Yes please.
Goodbye.
Medium fossils.
Large fossils.
Rare fossils.
I've lost my notebook.
Apparently you aren't as stupid as you look.
Welcome to Frankie's Fish Emporium, what can I do for you mate?
translation: Frankie's Fish Emporium(프랭키의 생선 상회)에 어서 와요. 뭘 도와줄까요, 친구?

english: What have you got for sale?
We serve the finest fresh fish Piscarilius has to offer.
translation: Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스)에서 제일 좋은 신선한 생선을 팔아요.

english: What do you do around here?

I trade the finest fish in Piscarilius. In this city you get two choices, fishing or thuggery. I've kept afloat without resorting to the latter, not something which can be said by many of the folk around here.
translation: Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스)에서 제일 좋은 생선을 거래해요. 이 도시에선 선택지가 두 개뿐이에요. 고기잡이냐, 깡패 짓이냐. 난 깡패 짓 없이 버텨 왔는데, 이 동네 사람 중에 그렇게 말할 수 있는 사람은 많지 않죠.

english: I'll be on my way.
What have you got for sale?
What do you do around here?
I'll be on my way
Hello again, [player name].
Hello. How's the repair work going?
translation: 안녕하세요. 수리 작업은 잘 돼 가요?

english: I'm working on it. I can always do with more iron sheets, so if you've got any more, I'll give you 20 gp per sheet.
translation: 하고 있어요. iron sheets(철판)은 많을수록 좋으니까, 더 있으면 한 장에 20 gp씩 쳐 드릴게요.

english: Thanks, I'll remember that.
Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me that iron sheet? I'd give you 20 gp for it.
translation: 다시 만났네요, [player name] 님. 그 iron sheet(철판) 저한테 파시려고요? 20 gp 드릴게요.

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you [amount] gp.
translation: 다시 만났네요, [player name] 님. 그 iron sheets(철판) 저한테 파시려고요? [amount] gp 드릴게요.

english: Yes, that'll do nicely.
No, I'd rather not.
That's ok.
Yes, that'll do nicely.
No, I'd rather not.
Hey, [player name], can you come and help me with some pheasants?
translation: 이봐요, [player name] 님, 꿩 일 좀 도와줄 수 있어요?

english: Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Hey there, [player name]. Could you kill a pheasant with [two/three/four] tails, please? Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 꼬리가 [two/three/four]개 달린 pheasant(꿩)을 잡아 줄래요? 다 잡으면 raw pheasant(날꿩고기)를 가져다줘요.

english: Hey there, [player name]. Can you kill the [2/3/4]-tailed pheasant please. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 꼬리가 [2/3/4]개인 pheasant(꿩)을 잡아 줄래요? 다 잡으면 raw pheasant(날꿩고기)를 가져다줘요.

english: Hey there, [player name]. I need you to kill a pheasant that has [2/3/4] tails. Bring me the raw pheasant when you're done.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 꼬리가 [2/3/4]개 달린 pheasant(꿩)을 잡아 줘야겠어요. 다 잡으면 raw pheasant(날꿩고기)를 가져다줘요.

english: Goodbye.
Now bring me the raw pheasant.
Thanks, [player name], you may use the portal to leave the area now.
translation: 고마워요, [player name] 님. 이제 portal(포털)로 이곳을 나가도 돼요.

english: Okay, [player name], you can leave the area now.
translation: 좋아요, [player name] 님. 이제 이곳을 나가도 돼요.

english: You don't need to attack any more pheasants. You're allowed to leave.
translation: 꿩은 더 잡지 않아도 돼요. 이제 나가도 좋아요.

english: I don't need any more of those. You are free to exit the area now.
translation: 그건 더 필요 없어요. 이제 이곳에서 나가도 돼요.

english: You get a lederhosen [hat/top/shorts] for your help, many thanks!
translation: 도와준 보답으로 lederhosen(레더호젠) [hat/top/shorts]을 드릴게요. 정말 고마워요!

english: You get a lamp for your help, many thanks!
translation: 도와준 보답으로 lamp(등불)을 드릴게요. 정말 고마워요!

english: I'm looking for [player name].
[player name]!
Hello? [player name]?
Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 나랑 얘기 좀 해요, [player name] 님!

english: [player name]? Are you there?!
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: 얘기 좀 하고 싶어요, [player name] 님!

english: Maybe later.
Okay, I'll help with your pheasants.
Sorry, I'm busy.
Hello, what's going on?
Hey, [player name], can you help me with some pheasants?
translation: 이봐요, [player name] 님, 꿩 일 좀 도와줄래요?

english: Collect the eggs from the uninhabited nests and bring them to me, and I'll reward you.
translation: 빈 둥지에서 eggs(알)을 모아서 가져다주면 보상을 줄게요.

english: Well, come back if you change your mind.
I have an egg for you.
These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.
translation: 이 꿩들은 곧 새 둥지 터를 찾게 될 거예요.

english: Sure, how can I help?
Greetings traveller. What brings you to my residence?
translation: 어서 오시오, 여행자여. 무슨 일로 내 거처에 왔소?

english: You keep a pet bat? That's a bit odd.
Squeak!
Yes traveller, this is not out of the ordinary for us. The bats respond well to the powers of the dark altar after being drawn here by the river of blood.
translation: 그렇소, 여행자여. 우리에겐 별난 일이 아니오. 박쥐들은 river of blood(피의 강)에 이끌려 이곳에 온 뒤로 dark altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘에 잘 반응한다오.

english: Well I hope he keeps you 'mused.
What are you doing on my land?
I'm looking for something to kill.
What, on my land? Leave my livestock alone you scoundrel!
translation: 뭐, 내 땅에서? 내 가축들 건드리지 마, 이 못된 놈아!

english: I'm lost.
How can you be lost? Just follow the road east and south. You'll end up in Lumbridge fairly quickly.
translation: 길을 잃긴 어떻게 잃어? 길 따라 동쪽으로, 그다음 남쪽으로 가기만 하면 돼. 금방 Lumbridge(럼브리지)가 나올 거야.

english: Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
translation: Fred(프레드)! Fred! 제가 The Thing(그것)을 봤어요!

english: You ... you actually saw it?
translation: 너... 너 정말 그걸 봤단 말이야?

english: Run for the hills! [player name] grab as many chickens as you can! We have to ...
translation: 언덕으로 도망쳐! [player name], 닭을 최대한 많이 챙겨! 우린 어서...

english: Fred!
... flee! Oh, woe is me! The shapeshifter is coming! We're all ...
translation: ...도망쳐야 해! 아아, 이 내 신세야! 변신 괴물이 오고 있어! 우린 모두...

english: FRED!
... doomed. What!
It's not a shapeshifter or any other kind of monster!
translation: 그건 변신 괴물도 아니고 무슨 괴물도 아니에요!

english: Well then what is it boy?
translation: 그럼 대체 뭐란 말이냐, 이 녀석아?

english: Well ... it's just two Penguins; Penguins disguised as a sheep.
translation: 그게... 그냥 Penguins(펭귄) 두 마리예요. 양으로 변장한 펭귄이요.

english: Have you been out in the sun too long?
translation: 너 햇볕을 너무 오래 쬔 거 아니냐?

english: What are you doing on my land? You're not the one who keeps leaving all my gates open and letting out all my sheep, are you?
translation: 내 땅에서 뭐 하는 거야? 설마 내 gates(대문)을 자꾸 열어 놔서 양들을 다 내보내는 놈이 너는 아니겠지?

english: I'm looking for a quest.
You're after a quest, you say? Actually, I could do with a bit of help.
translation: 퀘스트를 찾는다고? 실은 나도 도움이 좀 필요하던 참이야.

english: My sheep are getting mighty woolly. I'd be much obliged if you could shear them. And while you're at it, spin the wool for me too.
translation: 우리 양들 털이 아주 수북해졌거든. 털을 좀 깎아 주면 정말 고맙겠어. 하는 김에 그 양털로 실도 좀 자아 주고.

english: Yes, that's it. Bring me 20 balls of wool. And I'm sure I could sort out some sort of payment. Of course, there's the small matter of The Thing.
translation: 그래, 바로 그거야. balls of wool(양털 뭉치) 20개를 가져와. 그러면 보수도 좀 챙겨 줄 수 있을 거야. 물론, The Thing(그것) 문제가 좀 있긴 하지만.

english: What do you mean, The Thing?
Well now, no one has ever seen The Thing. That's why we call it The Thing, 'cos we don't know what it is.
translation: 음, 그러니까 The Thing(그것)을 본 사람은 아무도 없어. 그래서 '그것'이라고 부르는 거지. 그게 뭔지 모르니까.

english: Some say it's a black hearted shapeshifter, hungering for the souls of hard working decent folk like me. Others say it's just a sheep.
translation: 누구는 성실하고 착하게 사는 나 같은 사람들의 영혼을 노리는 시커먼 변신 괴물이라고 하고, 누구는 그냥 양이라고 하더군.

english: Well I don't have all day to stand around and gossip. Are you going to shear my sheep or what!
translation: 아무튼 하루 종일 서서 수다나 떨 시간 없어. 내 양털을 깎아 줄 거야, 말 거야!

english: Yes, okay. I can do that.
Good! Now one more thing, do you actually know how to shear a sheep?
translation: 좋아! 그럼 하나만 더. 양털 깎는 법은 알긴 하냐?

english: Err. No, I don't know actually.
Well, first things first, you need a pair of shears. I've got some here you can use.
translation: 음, 우선 shears(양털 가위)가 있어야 해. 여기 쓸 만한 게 있으니까 가져가.

english: You just need to go and use them on the sheep out in my field.
translation: 그걸 들고 내 밭에 있는 양한테 쓰기만 하면 돼.

english: Sounds easy!
That's what they all say!
Some of the sheep don't like it too much... Persistence is the key.
translation: 양 중에는 털 깎이는 걸 꽤 싫어하는 놈들도 있어... 끈기가 비결이야.

english: Once you've collected some wool you can spin it into balls.
translation: 양털을 좀 모으면 그걸 자아서 뭉치로 만들면 돼.

english: Do you know how to spin wool?
I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
Don't worry, it's quite simple!
The nearest Spinning Wheel can be found on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 제일 가까운 Spinning Wheel(물레)는 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 2층에 있어.

english: To get to Lumbridge Castle just follow the road east.
translation: Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성)에 가려면 길을 따라 동쪽으로 가기만 하면 돼.

english: Thank you!
No, I'll give it a miss.
Suit yourself.
I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: 양털 깎는 일로 할 얘기가 있어요!

english: Oh. How are you doing getting those balls of wool?
translation: 오. balls of wool(양털 뭉치)는 잘 모으고 있어?

english: How many more do I need to give you?
You need to collect 20 more balls of wool.
translation: balls of wool(양털 뭉치)를 20개 더 모아 와야 해.

english: I haven't got any at the moment.
Ah well at least you haven't been eaten. You know what you're doing, right?
translation: 뭐, 적어도 잡아먹히진 않았구먼. 뭘 해야 하는지는 알지?

english: How do I shear sheep, again?
Well, you're half way there already! You have a set of shears in your inventory. Just use those on a Sheep to shear it.
translation: 음, 벌써 반은 온 셈이야! 소지품에 shears(양털 가위)가 있잖아. 그걸 Sheep(양)한테 쓰면 털을 깎을 수 있어.

english: That's all I have to do?
Well once you've collected some wool you'll need to spin it into balls.
translation: 음, 양털을 좀 모으면 그걸 자아서 뭉치로 만들어야 해.

english: Yes, I know how to spin wool.
Great!
Remind me how to spin wool.
translation: 양털 잣는 법 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Yeah, I think so.
You can get to it, then!
I've got some wool. I've not managed to make it into a ball though.
translation: 양털은 좀 있어요. 근데 아직 뭉치로 만들진 못했어요.

english: Well go find a spinning wheel then. You can find one on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle, just walk east on the road outside my house and you'll find Lumbridge.
translation: 그럼 가서 spinning wheel(물레)를 찾아. Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 2층에 하나 있어. 우리 집 앞 길로 동쪽으로 쭉 걸어가면 Lumbridge(럼브리지)가 나와.

english: I have some.
Give 'em here then.
That's all I've got so far.
I need [1..19] more before I can pay you.
Ok I'll work on it.
I need [#] more before I can pay you.
That's the last of them.
I guess I'd better pay you then.
Quest complete!
I'm looking for something to kill.
I'm lost.
Fred! Fred! I've seen The Thing!
translation: Fred(프레드)! Fred! 제가 The Thing(그것)을 봤어요!

english: I'm looking for a quest.
Yes.
No.
How do I shear sheep, again?
Yes, I know how to spin wool.
I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
Remind me how to spin wool.
translation: 양털 잣는 법 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Yeah, I think so.
I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: 양털 깎는 일로 할 얘기가 있어요!

english: I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장님께 가 보시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 경계하고 있어서 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만났구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 날 믿고 의지해도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도요. 그냥 얘기가 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하면 내 문은 언제든 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 본 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 걸 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 머물 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 원하는 게 있었던 건 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 잘 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 모든 일이 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 그대를 보는 건 언제나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 한 거요, [Fremennik name]?

english: Hello!
Well met, adventurer.
Who are you?
I'm Freja, the Kyattess of the Fremennik Province. Who are you?
translation: 나는 Freja(프레야), Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)의 Kyattess(카이에테스)예요. 당신은 누구죠?

english: Oh me? I'm [player name], an adventurer... I guess.
translation: 아, 저요? 전 [player name](이)라고 해요. 모험가... 인 것 같아요.

english: You must have done something impressive to gain entry here.
translation: 여기 들어온 걸 보면 꽤 대단한 일을 했나 보네요.

english: I may have killed some dragons.
Ah, fantastic! I've yet to face one myself, but I look forward to the challenge.
translation: 아, 멋져요! 난 아직 한 마리도 상대해 본 적이 없지만, 그 도전이 기대되네요.

english: What grand feats are you known for?
Much like you, I have a book or two detailing such things, but it seems to have gone walkabouts.
translation: 당신처럼 나도 그런 일을 적은 책이 한두 권 있는데, 어디론가 사라져 버린 것 같아요.

english: Anything particularly interesting?
All of it is incredibly interesting! I slew the great Smolodin Kyatt that plagued the province for many years!
translation: 전부 엄청나게 흥미롭죠! 오랜 세월 이 지방을 괴롭히던 거대한 Smolodin Kyatt(스몰로딘 카이엇)을 처치했어요!

english: I retrieved the crown of many heads from the bottomless snake pit! I hunted the silver stag of the western provinces!
translation: 바닥없는 snake pit(뱀 구덩이)에서 crown of many heads(여러 머리의 왕관)을 되찾아 왔고요! 서쪽 지방의 silver stag(은빛 수사슴)도 사냥했죠!

english: None of that sounds at all boring. I look forward to finding your book.
translation: 하나도 지루할 것 같지 않은데요. 그 책, 꼭 찾아봐야 되지 않겠어요?

english: Funny you should mention boars. I'm currently hunting one... well, I was...
translation: 돼지요? 마침 멧돼지 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 지금 한 마리를 사냥하는 중이거든요... 아니, 중이었죠...

english: Why are you here?
My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous boar. As big as a hut, so the songs say.
translation: 이번 원정에서 그 유명한 boar(멧돼지)를 찾아 지독하게 추운 북쪽 땅 Acheron(아케론)까지 갔어요. 노래에 따르면 오두막만 하다더군요.

english: Anyway, my companions all met a rather grizzly end, so I guess I'm looking for new ones.
translation: 아무튼 동료들이 다 곰곰이 떠올리기도 싫은 최후를 맞아서, 새 동료를 찾고 있는 셈이에요.

english: Take me! I'm great.
Ha! You're very new here. You've certainly proved you are a worthy hero, but I'd rather someone with a few more years behind them.
translation: 하! 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐잖아요. 훌륭한 영웅이라는 건 확실히 증명했지만, 난 경험이 몇 년은 더 쌓인 사람이 좋아요.

english: What? I've literally defeated a group of dragons that threatened to kill everyone, I think I'm ready for a boar hunt.
translation: 네? 전 모두를 죽이려던 드래곤 무리를 말 그대로 물리쳤다고요. 멧돼지 사냥쯤은 할 준비가 됐다고 생각해요.

english: Hmm... When it comes time for me to venture back to the Isle of Garmr, I'll consider inviting you.
translation: 흠... Isle of Garmr(가름 섬)으로 다시 떠날 때가 되면, 당신을 부를지 생각해 볼게요.

english: Bye!
I'll see you around.
Ah, so you've found my latest donation to the guild. What do you think? Spooky, isn't it?
translation: 아, 내가 길드에 최근 기증한 걸 찾았군요. 어때요? 으스스하죠?

english: Just a bit. Is this the original text? It doesn't look that old...
translation: 조금요. 이게 원본 글이에요? 그렇게 오래돼 보이진 않는데...

english: Oh Guthix, no! These texts were inscribed in rock paper in a tome even I struggled to lift. The writer left it there as a warning, and I assume they didn't want it to be moved.
translation: 오, Guthix(구식스)시여, 아니에요! 원래 글은 나조차 들기 힘들었던 큰 책 속 바위 종이에 새겨져 있었어요. 글쓴이는 경고로 그걸 거기 남겨 뒀고, 옮겨지길 원하지 않았던 것 같아요.

english: Did you translate it?
I certainly tried... Perhaps there are some date inconsistencies and a few words I had to guess at. I'd found a lot of scrolls detailing trade with early Fremennik tribes too, which certainly helped.
translation: 해 보긴 했죠... 날짜가 좀 안 맞는 데도 있고, 짐작으로 채운 단어도 몇 개 있을 거예요. 초기 Fremennik(프레메닉) 부족과의 교역을 적은 scrolls(두루마리)를 많이 찾아낸 게 확실히 도움이 됐어요.

english: Imcandoria... Do you think that's where the Imcando dwarves originate?
translation: Imcandoria(임칸도리아)... 거기가 Imcando(임칸도) 드워프의 기원이라고 생각하세요?

english: It certainly seems reasonable.
Interesting...
Who are you?
What grand feats are you known for?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Would you like to buy some cooking equipment?
No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장님께 가 보시오!

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만났구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 날 믿고 의지해도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도요. 그냥 얘기가 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하면 내 문은 언제든 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 본 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 걸 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 머물 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 원하는 게 있었던 건 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 잘 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 모든 일이 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 그대를 보는 건 언제나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].

english: How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 그렇게 좋아요? 여기 사람들은 다들 좀 우울해 보이네요.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 한숨 쉬시는 거 방해하지 않을게요. 한숨 쉴 일이 아주 많아 보이네요.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 한동안 지내다 보면 기분이 가라앉는다오. 회색에도 273가지 색조가 있다던데, 여기엔 그게 다 있소.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 그 농담 때문에 더 우울해졌소. 날 좀 내버려 두시오.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 그렇소, 왜 있잖소. 소작농, 천민, 짓밟힌 자들 말이오. 그는 우리를 자기 개인 소유물처럼 다루오.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 떠날 돈을 모으려고 계속 애쓰는데, 왕이 자꾸 세금을 걷어 가오! 남은 돈이 한 푼도 없소.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 기운 내세요! 세상이 끝나는 것도 아니잖아요.

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 차라리 끝났으면 좋겠소. 그러면 당신처럼 실없이 행복한 사람과 말하지 않아도 될 테니.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
translation: 와! 바깥 구경 좀 더 하셔야겠네요.

english: Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 있잖아, 난 사실 그 구절이 꽤 마음에 들었어...

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 은근히 귀에 감기네. 짜증 나는데. 그래도 귀에 감겨.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 야, 나도 그 퀘스트 해 봤어!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 네 노래는 하나도 말이 안 돼, 외지인!

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?
translation: 좋은 부분은 대체 언제 나오는 거야?

english: would torture us so, outerlander?
Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 정말이지, 이건 내 평생 들어 본 최악의 소리야!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 제발 그게 마지막 구절이라고 말해 줘...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 내 귀가 이토록 모욕당한 적은 없었다!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 신들이시여, 제발! 저것 좀 멈추게 해 주소서!

english: If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 죽어 가는 내 전우들의 비명이 더 듣기 좋겠다!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
translation: 우리 할머니가 해도 이보단 낫겠다, 돌아가셨는데도!

english: I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 그 정도 업적은 아침 먹기 전에 해치운다고!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 네 노래는 무슨 외지인 무기라도 되는 거냐?

english: Congratulations, Champion [Fremennik name]. Thank you for defeating the Troll King.
translation: 축하하오, 용사 [Fremennik name]. Troll King(트롤 왕)을 물리쳐 줘서 고맙소.

english: Hello there.
Greetings! Have you come to talk forestry?
Forestry? Don't you look after pheasants as well?
In a way, though I find them a little freaky!
translation: 어떻게 보면요. 근데 난 걔들이 좀 기괴하더라고요!

english: You see, the forests have woken up and we need those trained in the way of the forester now more than ever!
translation: 있잖아요, 숲이 깨어났어요. 그래서 그 어느 때보다도 산림관의 길을 익힌 사람들이 필요해요!

english: Way of the forester? What do you mean?
You know, tending to the woodland with your fellow foresters so it may flourish!
translation: 왜, 동료 산림관들과 함께 숲을 돌봐서 숲이 무성해지게 하는 거예요!

english: And, of course, drinking plenty of tea to fuel yourself!
translation: 그리고 물론, 힘을 내려면 차를 듬뿍 마셔야죠!

english: Sounds interesting, how can I get started?
I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey.
translation: 임업의 길을 떠나기 전에 숲에서 좀 더 시간을 보내 보길 권해요.

english: Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!
translation: 거대한 oak(참나무)를 벨 수 있게 되면 다시 와요!

english: I'll bear that in mind. Thanks for the information.
Good luck out there!
You seem like you know your way around the forests.
translation: 숲에 대해 꽤 잘 아는 것 같네요.

english: To get started with forestry, I can sell you a Forestry kit for a reasonable price.
translation: 임업을 시작하려면, 제가 Forestry kit(임업 키트)를 적당한 가격에 팔게요.

english: Need to make sure our foresters are committed, you know?
translation: 우리 산림관들이 진심인지 확인해야 하거든요, 알죠?

english: Then all you need to do is chop some trees while you have the kit on you and the woodland will do the rest!
translation: 그다음엔 키트를 지닌 채로 나무를 베기만 하면 나머지는 숲이 알아서 해 줄 거예요!

english: Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you.
translation: 아, 그리고 숲을 돌보다가 anima-infused bark(아니마가 깃든 나무껍질)을 찾으면 기꺼이 교환해 줄게요.

english: I'll have a look at your shop, thanks.
Good luck on your adventure!
I'll happily buy those off you in my shop.
translation: 그건 제 상점에서 기꺼이 사 줄게요.

english: Hello, how can I help you?
You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 못 도와주실 거예요. 전 이미 구제불능이거든요.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
You can't; I'm beyond help.
translation: 못 도와주실 거예요. 전 이미 구제불능이거든요.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
Hello adventurer, welcome to the Entrana furnace.
translation: 어서 오게, 모험가. Entrana furnace(엔트라나 용광로)에 온 걸 환영하네.

english: Would you like me to explain my craft to you?
Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.
translation: 네, 부탁드려요. 무슨 일을 하시는지 정말 듣고 싶어요.

english: I'm extremely pleased to hear that! I've always wanted an apprentice. Let me talk you through the secrets of glassblowing.
translation: 그 말을 들으니 정말 기쁘군! 늘 견습생을 하나 두고 싶었거든. 유리 불기의 비법을 하나하나 알려 주지.

english: Glass is made from soda ash and silica. We get our soda ash by collecting seaweed from the rocks - the prevailing currents make the north-west corner of the island the best place to find it, it can also be found in
translation: 유리는 soda ash(소다회)와 규사로 만드네. 소다회는 바위에서 seaweed(해초)를 모아서 얻지. 이 섬은 해류 때문에 북서쪽 구석이 해초를 찾기에 가장 좋은 곳이라네. 해초는

english: your nets sometimes when you're fishing, on Karamja island or at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony in the nets there. To turn seaweed into soda ash, all you need to do is burn it on a fire. Feel free to use the range in
translation: 가끔 낚시할 때 그물에 걸리기도 하고, Karamja(카람자) 섬이나 Piscatoris Fishing Colony(피스카토리스 어촌)의 그물에서도 얻을 수 있네. 해초를 소다회로 만들려면 불에 태우기만 하면 돼. 그럴 땐

english: Fritz the Glassblower: my house for that; it's the one directly west of here. Next we collect sand from the sandpit that you'll also find just west of here, there are others located in Yanille and Shilo Village.
translation: Fritz the Glassblower(유리공 프리츠): 우리 집 range(레인지)를 마음껏 써도 되네. 여기서 바로 서쪽에 있는 집이야. 다음으로 역시 여기서 바로 서쪽에 있는 sandpit(모래 구덩이)에서 sand(모래)를 모으게. Yanille(야닐)과 Shilo Village(실로 마을)에도 모래 구덩이가 있네.

english: You'll need a bucket to carry it in. Tell you what, you can have this old one of mine.
translation: 모래를 담으려면 bucket(양동이)가 필요할 걸세. 그래, 내 헌 양동이를 가져가게.

english: Bring the sand and the soda ash back here and melt them together in the furnace, and there you have it - molten glass!
translation: 모래와 소다회를 여기로 가져와서 furnace(용광로)에서 함께 녹이면, 짠 - molten glass(녹은 유리) 완성일세!

english: There are many things you can use the molten glass for once you have made it. Depending on how talented you are, you could try turning it into something, like a fishbowl, for example. If you'd like to try your hand at
translation: 녹은 유리를 만들고 나면 쓸 데가 많지. 솜씨에 따라 fishbowl(어항) 같은 걸 만들어 볼 수도 있네. 유리 불기라는 섬세한 기술에

english: the fine art of glassblowing you can use my spare glassblowing pipe. I think I left it on the chest of drawers in my house this morning.
translation: 손을 대 보고 싶다면 내 여분의 glassblowing pipe(유리 부는 관)을 써도 되네. 오늘 아침에 우리 집 chest of drawers(서랍장) 위에 두고 온 것 같군.

english: Alternatively I am always happy to buy the molten glass from you, saves me running about making it for myself.
translation: 아니면 녹은 유리를 언제든 기꺼이 사 주겠네. 내가 직접 만들러 뛰어다니는 수고를 덜 수 있으니까.

english: That sounds good. How much will you pay me?
Tell you what, because you've been interested in my art, I'll pay you the premium price of 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you bring me
translation: 이렇게 하지. 자네가 내 기술에 관심을 보여 줬으니, 가져오는 molten glass(녹은 유리) 하나당 20골드라는 특별 가격을 쳐 주겠네

english: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 제가 유리 불기에 손댈 일은 없을 것 같아요.

english: Ok, suit yourself. Nobody seems to be interested in the skilled crafts these days.
translation: 그래, 마음대로 하게. 요즘은 숙련된 공예에 관심 있는 사람이 없는 것 같군.

english: If you should change your mind, come back and talk to me.
translation: 혹시 마음이 바뀌면 다시 와서 말해 주게.

english: Ah [player name], have you come to sell me some molten glass?
translation: 아, [player name]. molten glass(녹은 유리)를 팔러 왔나?

english: Yes.
Fantastic! Let's see, for that much glass I could pay you ...
translation: 훌륭하군! 어디 보자, 그만큼의 유리라면 줄 수 있는 건...

english: ... [amount] gold pieces!
Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.
translation: 제정신이세요? 이 유리 만들려고 섬을 온통 뛰어다녔다고요.

english: Pity. Well you can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 아쉽군. 뭐, 마음이 바뀌면 여기서 날 찾게.

english: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.
Here you are then.
Thanks very much, [player name]. I'll buy any more that you bring.
translation: 정말 고맙네, [player name]. 더 가져오면 얼마든지 사 주겠네.

english: Umm, not much point me trying to pay you for glass you don't have, is there?
translation: 음, 자네한테 없는 유리 값을 내가 치를 수는 없지 않겠나?

english: Well, actually, if you don't mind... question then.
I'll make it simple for you. You bring glass, me pay shiny gold coins.
translation: 쉽게 말해 주지. 자네 유리 가져옴, 나 반짝반짝 금화 줌.

english: No.
Oh.
...errr, well should you get any I'm quite happy to pay for it. Remember, I'll pay you 20 gold pieces for each piece of molten glass you get for me.
translation: ...어, 음, 혹시 유리가 생기면 기꺼이 사 주겠네. 기억하게, molten glass(녹은 유리) 하나당 20골드를 쳐 주겠네.

english: So what did you want to talk to me about then?
translation: 그래서 나한테 무슨 얘기를 하고 싶었나?

english: Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?
translation: molten glass(녹은 유리) 만드는 법을 다시 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Well, I am very busy at the moment, but I guess I can take 5 minutes off for my favourite student.
translation: 음, 지금 몹시 바쁘지만, 제일 아끼는 제자를 위해서라면 5분쯤은 내줄 수 있지.

english: You can use the bucket I gave you earlier.
translation: 전에 내가 준 bucket(양동이)를 쓰면 되네.

english: I'm afraid I don't have that bucket with me. Could you give me another one, please?
translation: 죄송하지만 그 양동이를 안 가져왔어요. 하나 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: Do I look like I'm made of buckets? You'll just have to buy another from a general store.
translation: 내가 양동이로 만들어진 사람처럼 보이나? 잡화점에서 하나 더 사야 할 걸세.

english: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.
Hello then. I'm afraid I don't have any time to chat though. The druids of Taverley have placed a huge order for glass vials, so I'm very busy.
translation: 그래, 반갑네. 하지만 미안하게도 수다 떨 시간이 없네. Taverley(태벌리)의 드루이드들이 glass vials(유리 약병)을 엄청나게 주문해서 아주 바쁘거든.

english: Yes please. I'd be fascinated to hear what you do.
translation: 네, 부탁드려요. 무슨 일을 하시는지 정말 듣고 싶어요.

english: No thanks, I doubt I'll ever turn my hand to glassblowing.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 제가 유리 불기에 손댈 일은 없을 것 같아요.

english: Yes
Are you mad? I've run all over the island to make this glass.
translation: 제정신이세요? 이 유리 만들려고 섬을 온통 뛰어다녔다고요.

english: Sure, that sounds like a fair price.
No
Could you tell me how to make molten glass again, please?
translation: molten glass(녹은 유리) 만드는 법을 다시 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: I just thought I'd drop in and say hello.
Hurrah for the frog [prince/princess]!
Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!
translation: 나한테 말 걸지 마! 개구리 [prince/princess]한테 말해!

english: ​The frogs do not need your help right now.
translation: 개구리들은 지금 네 도움이 필요 없어.

english: Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: 날 보지 마, 난 그냥 개구리야. 개굴! 개굴!

english: Hello, [player name]
[player name], the frog [prince/princess] desires your attention!
If you kiss [him/her], [player name], [he/she] will turn into a human!
But if you ignore [him/her], [player name], we will turn you into a frog!
translation: 하지만 [him/her]를 무시하면, [player name], 우리가 널 개구리로 만들어 버릴 거야!

english: That's IT, [player name] you're a frog!
Err, excuse me?
Why? Am I in your way?
That was just plain weird!
Pretty Trees!
Having fun?
I'm just looking at the magic trees. I think they're cool.
translation: magic trees(마법 나무)를 구경하는 중이야. 진짜 멋진 것 같아.

english: Well, they are magical. Valuable as well...
When I grow up I want to chop down trees and make magic bows. Then I'd be rich.
translation: 난 크면 나무를 베어서 magic bows(마법 활)을 만들 거야. 그럼 부자가 되겠지.

english: Well, that does seem to be a common career around here.
translation: 음, 이 동네에선 흔한 직업 같긴 하네요.

english: Hello.
Hello!
Who are you?
I am Fry, master of dramatics. Player of plays, singer of songs!
translation: 나는 Fry(프라이), 연극의 대가! 극을 올리고 노래를 부르는 자랍니다!

english: A creative type eh?
Yes indeed.
Why are you here?
I put on shows to entertain our patrons.
translation: 손님들을 즐겁게 해 드리려고 공연을 올리지요.

english: At least, I used to. We don't get many punters these days.
translation: 적어도 예전엔 그랬답니다. 요즘은 손님이 통 없어서요.

english: Why is that?
I don't know, Easter isn't as big as it used to be I suppose.
translation: 글쎄요, Easter(부활절)이 예전만큼 큰 행사가 아니라서 그런가 봐요.

english: Well I had to crawl in here through a hole, do you think that's a factor?
translation: 저는 구멍으로 기어서 들어와야 했는데, 그것도 이유 아닐까요?

english: It wasn't before, but I suppose it could be putting people off...
translation: 예전엔 아니었는데, 그것 때문에 사람들이 발길을 돌리는지도 모르겠군요...

english: Hmm... Maybe we need a door...
Maybe!
Hello! I'm trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, do you have any ideas?
translation: 안녕하세요! Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 기운을 북돋아 주려는데, 좋은 생각 있으세요?

english: Hmm, I have noticed his recent sour mood. Let me think for a moment...
translation: 흠, 요즘 그분이 시무룩하신 건 저도 눈치챘지요. 잠깐 생각해 볼게요...

english: Aha! I have it! Let's put on a performance! That will cheer him up.
translation: 아하! 떠올랐어요! 공연을 올리는 거예요! 그러면 기운이 나실 거예요.

english: A performance?
Yes! He's always enjoyed a good show.
translation: 그렇지요! 그분은 늘 멋진 공연을 즐기셨거든요.

english: Well I suppose that could work...
Could you perform something soon?
Well, I'll need some time to find something appropriate to perform.
translation: 음, 알맞은 작품을 찾으려면 시간이 좀 필요해요.

english: Okay, I'll come back later when you've worked something out.
translation: 알겠어요, 뭔가 정해지면 나중에 다시 올게요.

english: Of course, I'll need some performers.
Surely you don't mean me?
You do mean me.
Naturally! I'll talk to some other people too and get a good troupe together!
translation: 당연하지요! 다른 사람들에게도 말해서 멋진 극단을 꾸려 볼게요!

english: Well, as long as it's not just me.
Of course not, you don't look deserving of a solo to me! Now run along, I shall begin my creative process.
translation: 물론이지요, 당신은 독무대를 맡을 감은 아닌 것 같거든요! 자, 어서 가 보세요. 나는 창작의 시간에 들어가겠어요.

english: See you later then.
Hello again Fry, are you proceeding with the performance planning?
translation: 다시 왔어요, Fry(프라이). 공연 준비는 잘되고 있어요?

english: Oh yes, I'm perusing potential performances and am planning which parts will be picked.
translation: 그럼요, 공연 후보를 골라 가며 곰곰이 고민하고, 고를 배역도 골똘히 궁리하는 중이지요.

english: Perfect!
Ah, hello [player name]! I've a fantastic performance for us all to practise, if you are ready for a rehearsal?
translation: 아, [player name] 님 안녕하세요! 다 같이 연습할 끝내주는 작품을 골랐어요. 리허설할 준비 됐나요?

english: Yes, we'd better have a go!
Alright then, let's assemble the troupe!
Oh hang on, we don't want to ruin the surprise.
translation: 아, 잠깐만요. 깜짝 공연을 망치면 안 되지요.

english: Easter Bunny! There's more fancy carrot juice at the bar!
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)님! 바에 고급 당근 주스가 더 있어요!

english: Ooooh! Outta my way!
Rightio then, let's get to it.
Glanton! Rinder! Eggus! It's time!
Time fer what?
Time for the rehearsal! For the performance!
I didn't think ye were serious about that!
Well I am, so hurry along. You've all had a chance to familiarise yourselves with my script, yes?
translation: 진심이니까 어서 서둘러요. 다들 내 대본은 충분히 익혀 뒀겠지요?

english: Oh yeah of course, I know it by heart. Hah!
translation: 아, 그럼 그럼, 아주 달달 외웠지. 하!

english: Perfect! Rinder?
What he said.
I also did not read it.
Oh you jokers, come on then! To the stage!
translation: 이런 장난꾸러기들 같으니, 자, 갑시다! 무대로!

english: See you there in a moment.
Rinder, Eggus Manus, Glanton, and the player arrive on the stage.
translation: Rinder(린더), Eggus Manus(에구스 마누스), Glanton(글랜턴), 그리고 플레이어가 무대에 오른다.

english: Wonderful, we're all here!
Let's see what you've got then.
This should be interesting.
You first, Glanton!
Aw heck.
From the top! First verse! And a one two three!
Oh lordy, uh..
When the foeman bares his.. peels?
translation: 적군이 칼을 뽑아 들면.. 당근을 뽑아 들면?

english: TARANTA-RA TARANTA-RA!
We, dun dun dun, er...
I don't know this! I do not know this one!
For goodness sake.
That wasn't very Easter-ey.
No, it wasn't.
Oh come on, it's an old standard!
I don't even know what a foeman is!
Could we try something else?
translation: 다른 걸 해 보면 안 될까요?

english: Well I don't have anything to hand, but you're welcome to have a look backstage.
translation: 지금 당장은 가진 게 없지만, 무대 뒤를 한번 둘러봐도 좋아요.

english: Backstage eh? Alright.
Rinder, Eggus Manus, and Glanton leave the stage.
translation: Rinder(린더), Eggus Manus(에구스 마누스), Glanton(글랜턴)이 무대를 떠난다.

english: You should have a look backstage to see if there's anything that could help with the performance.
translation: 무대 뒤를 둘러보고 공연에 도움이 될 만한 게 있는지 찾아보세요.

english: Have you found anything useful backstage yet?
translation: 무대 뒤에서 쓸 만한 건 찾았나요?

english: Not yet.
Well get to it then!
In my own time.
I found some old costumes we can use.
translation: 쓸 만한 낡은 의상을 좀 찾았어요.

english: Oh that's great, but we'll need more than just costumes to wow the audience.
translation: 오, 잘됐네요. 하지만 관객을 사로잡으려면 의상만으로는 부족해요.

english: We need some material to perform!
True, I'll have another look.
I've found an old script, but I haven't read it yet.
translation: 낡은 대본을 찾았는데, 아직 읽어 보진 않았어요.

english: Well perhaps you should read it?
translation: 그럼 한번 읽어 보는 게 어때요?

english: I suppose I should.
I've found an old script and some carrot costumes!
An old script eh? Is it any good?
I would show you but I seem to have misplaced it, I'll go and find it again.
translation: 보여 드리고 싶은데 어디 뒀는지 모르겠네요. 다시 찾아올게요.

english: You silly sausage!
You tell me, here have a look. It seems like it's all out of order.
translation: 직접 보세요, 여기요. 순서가 완전히 뒤죽박죽인 것 같아요.

english: Well this is very interesting! Though I'm not sure how it would have been put together originally.
translation: 이거 아주 흥미롭군요! 원래 어떻게 짜여 있었는지는 잘 모르겠지만요.

english: In any case, it's definitely got the spirit of Easter written into it. Carrot costumes should suit this well.
translation: 어쨌든 Easter(부활절)의 정신이 확실히 담겨 있어요. 당근 의상이 딱 어울리겠어요.

english: I think we can use this, though the page order will need reviewing. Can you work out something good?
translation: 이걸 쓰면 되겠어요. 다만 쪽 순서는 다시 맞춰야겠네요. 잘 정리해 줄 수 있겠어요?

english: I can give it a go if you wash those disgusting carrot costumes.
translation: 그 역겨운 당근 의상을 빨아 준다면 한번 해 볼게요.

english: Wonderful, bring it to me once you're done and we shall get cracking! In the meantime, I'll get those costumes cleaned.
translation: 좋아요, 다 되면 가져와요. 바로 시작하자고요! 그동안 나는 의상을 깨끗이 빨아 둘게요.

english: How is that script looking? Have you sorted it out yet?
It looks good to me, let's put on the performance!
Wonderful! I shall inform our colleagues, and fetch the Easter Bunny.
translation: 훌륭해요! 동료들에게 알리고 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)님을 모셔 올게요.

english: See you after the show.
Cutscene: "Dance time."
That was amazing!
So much Easter energy! Wow!
The cutscene ends.
That dance was amazing! Well done. I feel so... Invigorated!
translation: 그 춤 정말 대단했어! 잘했어. 기분이 아주... 힘이 솟아!

english: How could I ever lose my Easter spirit?
translation: 내가 어떻게 Easter(부활절) 정신을 잃어버릴 수 있었지?

english: Sometimes you just need a break.
translation: 가끔은 쉬어 갈 때도 필요한 법이죠.

english: That's true. Thanks, [player name].
I'm glad you're feeling better.
Lawks! Look at the time, I should get back to Varrock to set up the Eggs!
translation: 이런! 시간 좀 봐, Varrock(바록)으로 돌아가서 Eggs(달걀)을 준비해야 해!

english: See you up there!
I'm not finished yet.
Good job putting that script in order, I think that went well!
translation: 대본 순서를 잘 맞춰 줬어요. 공연이 잘된 것 같네요!

english: I couldn't help overhearing that you're trying to cheer up the Easter Bunny, and I have an idea.
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 기운을 북돋아 주려 한다는 얘기를 우연히 들었는데, 내게 좋은 생각이 있어요.

english: We are the Easter carrots! Carrots!
Orange and full of the joys of spring!
Easter is here, it's time to frolic!
Watch us carrots do our thing!
Woo!
Orange, rooty, nice and juicy!
Pop out of the ground and then we sing!
Whilst sun is warm we dance about!
Easter joy we hope to bring!
I'm finished with the script.
The script isn't ready yet.
What can I do for you, traveller?
Let's see what you've got.
I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
translation: 제 취향에 대해서는 얘기하고 싶지 않아요.

english: Ah, you sound like a human who's not been drinking yet. Would you like to start now?
translation: 아, 아직 한 잔도 안 걸친 인간 같은 말투네요. 지금 시작해 볼래요?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?
