english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Veos(베오스)가 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있대요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스) 부두 근처를 서성인다더군요.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 문제가 생겼대요. 갱단들이 손을 잡았다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 아들 하나를 잃어버렸대요. 무사히 데려오면 호시디우스 가문에서 꽤 후하게 사례할지도 몰라요.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)가 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있다나 봐요. 조사해 볼 만할 거예요.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 지배자들한테 일거리가 있대요. Lovakengj Assembly(로바켕기 의회)에 가면 만날 수 있어요.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 한복판에서 무슨 소동이 있었다나 봐요. 가 볼 만할 거예요.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성) 밖에서 하는 시위가 점점 주목을 끌고 있어요. 한번 살펴볼 만할 거예요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
I'm alright, thank you.
Let's see what you've got.
I don't want to talk about my pleasure.
translation: 제 취향에 대해서는 얘기하고 싶지 않아요.

english: I'm alright, thank you.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
translation: 당연히 제 근무 차례를 기다리고 있지요. 하루 종일 땅만 팔 수는 없잖아요.

english: I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
translation: Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람들과 드워프 사이의 연관성도 연구하고 있어요.

english: I've found that we have some mythology in common.
translation: 두 민족 사이에 공통된 신화가 있다는 걸 알아냈지요.

english: Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hey there.
Yes please! How many do you have?
How many what?
I'll take the lot!
Right...
Hello! I've had a few to drink!
I haven't had that many, have I?
'Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: '옛날 옛적 Tonalo(토날로)라는 드워프가 있었지! 버팔로한테 싸움을 걸었지!'

english: What?
'He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: '차고 때리고 아주 볼만했지! 그런데 돌부리에 걸려 발가락을 찧었지!'

english: What? I didn't even do it!
Hello there. Want to trade some furs?
Yes please.
What furs do you have?
I have a selection of both rare and common furs from all across the kingdom. Also, if you happen to have any furs you've brought from the east, I'd be pretty keen to buy some.
translation: 왕국 곳곳에서 들여온 희귀한 모피부터 흔한 모피까지 두루 갖췄지요. 그리고 혹시 동쪽에서 가져온 모피가 있다면 꼭 좀 사고 싶어요.

english: So, want to trade?
No thanks.
Tetamo! If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
translation: Tetamo(테타모)! 마음이 바뀌면 어디서 날 찾을지 알죠?

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
translation: 당신이 내 물건을 훔쳐 간 놈이군! 경비병! 경비병!

english: Yes please.
What furs do you have?
No thanks.
Would you like to trade in fur?
No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
I don't sell to outerlanders.
Only Fremenniks may purchase furs here.
translation: 여기서 모피는 Fremennik(프레메닉)만 살 수 있다.

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name]! Have you seen the furs I have today?
translation: 돌아왔군, [Fremennik name]! 오늘 들여온 모피 봤나?

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You think me stupid [Fremennik name]?
Guardsguards!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 내 물건 훔쳐 간 게 너로구나!

english: You's better talk to Dad, We not talk to wierdly 'umans.
translation: 너 아빠한테 말해. 우리 이상한 인간이랑 말 안 해.

english: Thanks for da chompy, it was deloverly!
Human done good!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Salve(살브) 강가의 사원인 Paterdomus(파테르도무스)까지 누가 안내해 주길 바라며 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 웅장한 사원이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)로 들어오는 길에 분명 지나치셨을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶거든요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스) 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로 몸을 지킬 수 있겠어요?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 뭐, 나름 경험이 좀 있어서 나쁜 놈들은 제 몫만큼 기꺼이 상대할 수 있다고만 해 둘게요. 그건 걱정 안 하셔도 돼요.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 동행하는 펫이 있으시네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을 것 같아요. 펫을 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 정말요? 그럼 너무 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 좀 주시려고요? 제 배낭 좀 열어 볼게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫지만 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 머무는 것보단 나아요.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 하루 종일 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)에 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같아서요.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요. 저 다리는 못 건너요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아이고 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와아! 정말 굉장했어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자서 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 사원까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보상이에요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 적을 만나면 스스로 몸을 지킬 수 있겠어요...?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Get out of my office! We WILL have our revenge, human!
translation: 내 사무실에서 나가! 우린 반드시 복수할 거다, 인간!

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았는데 맞는 음식을 안 가져온 것 같군! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요하다고!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 된다. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만 내놓을 수 있지.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to G.L.O. Caranock
Just hand over the order human.
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 꽤 먼 길을 왔겠군. 팁으로 조금 더 얹어 주지.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number]크레딧이 쌓였다. 아직은 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없어.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number]크레딧이 쌓였다. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있지.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)한테서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)한테 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받아 와. 배달 상자가 더는 필요 없어서 버린다.

english: Welcome to GPDT!
Thank you very much.
So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: 그래서, 이 나무 상자는 언제 배달해 주실 거예요?

english: Well... I guess we could do it now...
Thank you, it's interesting in here.
We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
translation: 저희는 Gielinor(길리노르) 전체에서 최고의 배달 업체랍니다!

english: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: 그래서, 이 나무 상자는 언제 배달해 주실 거예요?

english: Thank you, it's interesting in here.
What do you do here?
Not much really... I run a local shop which earns me a few trading sticks, but that's about it. I keep myself to myself really.
translation: 별건 없어요... 작은 가게를 하나 운영해서 trading sticks(교역 막대)를 조금 벌긴 하는데, 그게 다예요. 조용히 혼자 지내는 편이죠.

english: What are trading sticks?
They're the local currency Bwana, it's used in Tai Bwo Wannai, there's usually some odd jobs that need doing around the village which you could do to earn some trading sticks.
translation: 이 동네 화폐예요, Bwana(브와나). Tai Bwo Wannai(타이 보 와나이)에서 쓰이죠. 마을 곳곳에 보통 자잘한 일거리가 있으니 그걸 해서 교역 막대를 벌 수 있어요.

english: Or, if you have something which the local villagers might like, you could sell it to me and I'll pay you for it in trading sticks.
translation: 아니면 마을 사람들이 좋아할 만한 물건이 있으면 저한테 파세요. 교역 막대로 값을 쳐 드릴게요.

english: What sort of things do the local villagers like?

Gnome cocktails! It's amazing but we all just love them! Luckily I've managed to get stocks of the gnome made cocktails and I supply those to my favourite customers. However, many of the customers really like the cocktails
translation: Gnome cocktails(노움 칵테일)요! 신기하게도 다들 엄청 좋아해요. 다행히 노움이 만든 칵테일을 꽤 들여 놔서 단골손님들한테 대 주고 있어요. 그런데 손님들 상당수는

english: made by the adventurers passing through this way. If you ever happen to have any, bring them my way! I'll give you a good deal on it that's for sure!
translation: 이곳을 지나가는 모험가들이 만든 칵테일을 정말 좋아해요. 혹시 가진 게 있으면 저한테 가져오세요! 확실히 좋은 값에 사 드릴게요!

english: How did the villagers ever get to try any gnome cocktails?
translation: 마을 사람들은 어쩌다 노움 칵테일을 맛보게 된 거예요?

english: I think it was that gnome pilot who crashed his glider, perhaps he had a little mini-bar on board? Come to think about it, you'd expect the little guy to get his stuff together and move on out of here wouldn't you? He
translation: 아마 glider(글라이더)를 추락시킨 그 노움 조종사 때문인 것 같아요. 기체 안에 작은 미니바라도 있었던 걸까요? 생각해 보면, 그 꼬마 양반이 짐을 챙겨서 여길 떠날 법도 한데 말이죠, 안 그래요?

english: must love the jungle to have stayed here so long!
translation: 정글이 아주 좋은가 봐요, 이렇게 오래 머무는 걸 보면!

english: You run a shop?
Yes, it's the Tai Bwo cooperative... catchy name huh! We sell a few local village trinkets and tools. Also, there are a few items that we're actually looking to stock for the locals' sake.
translation: 네, Tai Bwo(타이 보) 협동조합이에요... 이름 기억하기 쉽죠! 마을 장신구와 도구를 조금 팔고 있어요. 그리고 마을 사람들을 위해 들여놓으려는 물건도 몇 가지 있어요.

english: If you happen across any of them please bring them to me, I'll pay a good price for them. I'm sure you'll find the prices very reasonable.
translation: 혹시 그런 걸 보게 되면 저한테 가져와 주세요. 좋은 값을 쳐 드릴게요. 가격도 아주 합리적이라고 느끼실 거예요.

english: Can I take a look at what you have to sell?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Sure you can...which shop would you like to see? The Cooperative or Drinks store?
translation: 물론이죠... 어느 가게를 보시겠어요? 협동조합이요, 아니면 음료 가게요?

english: None thanks...
Why do you only take one sort of Gnome cocktail?
translation: 왜 Gnome cocktail(노움 칵테일)은 한 종류만 받으세요?

english: It's funny that actually. I've managed to get a good deal with the pilot of that gnome glider. He can supply me directly now. However, it's really interesting that the local villagers really like the gnome cocktails made by the
translation: 그게 참 재밌어요. 그 Gnome Glider(노움 글라이더) 조종사랑 좋은 거래를 텄거든요. 이제 그 사람이 직접 물건을 대 줄 수 있어요. 그런데 정말 신기한 건 마을 사람들은 노움 칵테일 중에서도

english: adventurers passing through this way.
translation: 이곳을 지나가는 모험가들이 만든 걸 정말 좋아한다는 거예요.

english: Why, what's the difference?

I think it may just be that they're made fresher, or there is a slight twist in the flavour of the drink, you know, a little more of this, a little less of that, it all adds up and makes for an interesting tipple!
translation: 아마 더 신선하게 만들어서거나, 맛에 살짝 특별한 비법이 있어서겠죠. 이건 조금 더, 저건 조금 덜, 그런 게 다 모여서 흥미로운 한 잔이 되는 거예요!

english: I want to ask another question.
Sure, what do you want to ask?
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 재밌는 할 일 있어요?

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 미안해요, Bwana(브와나). 제가 지금 바빠서요. Murcaily(머케일리)한테 가서 얘기해 보는 게 어때요! 마을 어딘가에 있을 거예요.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 그래요, 이 근처에서 좋은 일을 많이 해 주셨죠. 시간과 수고에 대한 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대) [amount]개를 받는다. 남은 호감도는 [amount]%이다.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 이미 교역 막대를 드렸고, 지금은 가진 게 더 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 좀 보태 달라고 해 보는 게 어때요?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey there. If you can solve a question for me then you can move on.
translation: 안녕하세요. 제 질문에 답하시면 다음으로 넘어갈 수 있어요.

english: What is the question?
Here, I wrote it down for you.
Gabooty has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Sounds right!
Gabooty has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Gabooty(가부티)가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 건넸다!

english: Can you open the shop please?
What do you do here?
What are trading sticks?
What sort of things do the local villagers like?
You run a shop?
I want to ask another question.
Ok, thanks.
Can I take a look at what you have to sell?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: The Cooperative
The Drinks Store
None thanks...
Why do you only take one sort of Gnome cocktail?
translation: 왜 Gnome cocktail(노움 칵테일)은 한 종류만 받으세요?

english: Ok, thanks
Is there anything interesting to do here?
I've been doing some work around the village.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어머, 영웅님이시네요! 와! 정말 대단하세요. 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 상대하신 거예요? 마을도 너무 예뻐졌어요, 정말 수고 많으셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Gabriela, I'm looking after my husband who isn't feeling too well!
translation: 저는 Gabriela(가브리엘라)예요. 몸이 좀 안 좋은 남편을 돌보고 있어요!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 너무 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 기르면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 알기론 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 무척 감사하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알았던 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만,

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 아마 대부분의 사람들 눈에는 당신이 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Welcome to the Mining Guild. My name's Gadrin and I'm the Guildmaster. Can I help you with anything?
translation: Mining Guild(채광 길드)에 온 걸 환영하네. 내 이름은 Gadrin(가드린), 이곳의 Guildmaster(길드 마스터)일세. 뭐 도와줄 일이라도 있나?

english: All sorts of things! There's plenty of coal rocks along with some iron, mithril and adamantite as well.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있지! coal rocks(석탄 바위)가 잔뜩 있고, 철, 미스릴, 아다만타이트도 좀 있다네.

english: Deeper in the guild you'll find even more rocks including some runite! The best bit though is our amethyst mine, the only one in the land!
translation: 길드 안쪽으로 더 들어가면 runite(루나이트)까지 포함해 바위가 더 많지! 그래도 최고는 이 땅에 단 하나뿐인 amethyst(자수정) 광산일세!

english: There's no better mining site anywhere!
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
What do you think? We smelt it into bars, smith the metal to make armour and weapons, then we exchange them for goods and services.
translation: 뭘 할 것 같나? 녹여서 주괴로 만들고, 그 금속을 두드려 갑옷과 무기를 만든 다음, 물건이나 일손과 바꾸지.

english: I don't see many dwarves selling armour or weapons here.
translation: 여기서 갑옷이나 무기를 파는 드워프는 별로 못 봤는데요.

english: No, this is only a mining outpost. We dwarves don't much like to settle in human cities. Most of the ore is carted off to Keldagrim, the great dwarven city. They've got a special blast furnace up there - it makes
translation: 그렇지, 여긴 채광 전초기지일 뿐이네. 우리 드워프는 인간 도시에 눌러사는 걸 별로 좋아하지 않거든. 광석 대부분은 위대한 드워프 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림)으로 실려 간다네. 거기엔 특별한 blast furnace(대형 용광로)가 있어서

english: smelting the ore so much easier. There are plenty of dwarven traders working in Keldagrim. Anyway, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 광석 제련이 훨씬 수월하지. Keldagrim(켈다그림)에는 드워프 상인도 많다네. 아무튼, 또 도와줄 일이 있나?

english: Can you tell me about your skillcape?
translation: 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: Sure, this is a Skillcape of Mining. It shows my stature as a master miner! It has all sorts of uses including a skill boost to my Mining skill and a chance of mining extra ores. When you get to level 99 come and talk to
translation: 그러지, 이건 Skillcape of Mining(채광 스킬 망토)일세. 내가 채광의 달인이라는 증표지! 쓰임새도 많아서 Mining(채광) 스킬이 오르고 광석을 더 캘 확률도 생긴다네. 자네도 레벨 99가 되면

english: me and I'll sell you one.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
I believe I can buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?
translation: 당신에게서 Skillcape of Mining(채광 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있다고 들었는데요?

english: You believe right, miner. You have earned the right to wear one and when you do you'll have a small chance of finding an extra ore, but I'll need 99000 coins from you first.
translation: 제대로 들었네, 광부 양반. 자네는 그걸 입을 자격을 얻었지. 입으면 광석을 하나 더 찾을 확률이 조금 생긴다네. 다만 먼저 99000코인을 받아야겠네.

english: Sorry, that's overpriced.
I'm sorry you feel that way; come back if you change your mind.
translation: 그렇게 생각한다니 아쉽군. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오게.

english: Okay then.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 돈을 충분히 안 가져왔어요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 모든 스킬 망토는 두건이 무료로 딸려 나가네. 스킬 판촉 행사라서 말이지, 하나 사면 하나 더 주는 거야. 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주게.

english: Thanks very much, master miner.
No thanks, I'm fine.
What have you got in the guild?
What do you dwarves do with the ore you mine?
No thanks, I'm fine.
Can you tell me about your skillcape?
translation: 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Mining from you?
translation: Skillcape of Mining(채광 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Sorry, that's overpriced.
Okay then.
Welcome to my two-handed sword shop.
translation: 제 양손검 가게에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Thanks, but not today.
Very well, but do please call again.
translation: 알겠습니다. 하지만 꼭 다시 들러 주십시오.

english: Here you go.
Let's trade.
Thanks, but not today.
Welcome to my home. It's rare for me to have guests! Would you like a cup of tea? I'll just put the kettle on.
translation: 내 집에 온 걸 환영해요. 손님이 오는 일은 드물거든요! 차 한잔 하겠어요? 주전자를 올려놓을게요.

english: Brother Galahad hangs a kettle over the fire.
translation: Brother Galahad(갤러해드 수사)가 불 위에 주전자를 건다.

english: Are you any relation to Sir Galahad?
translation: 혹시 Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)과 관계가 있으세요?

english: I AM Sir Galahad.
Although I've retired as a Knight, and now live as a solitary monk. Also, I prefer to be known as brother rather than sir now. Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: 비록 기사직에서 물러나 지금은 홀로 사는 수도승이지만요. 그리고 이제는 경보다는 수사라고 불리는 편이 좋아요. 잠깐만요, 차가 다 됐군요.

english: Sir Galahad gives you a cup of tea.
translation: Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)이 차 한 잔을 건넨다.

english: Do you get lonely out here on your own?
Sometimes I do, yes. Still not many people to share my solidarity with, as most of the religious men around here are worshippers of Saradomin. Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: 가끔은 그래요. 이곳 성직자들은 대부분 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬기다 보니, 내 고독을 함께 나눌 사람이 많지 않거든요. 잠깐만요, 차가 다 됐군요.

english: Are you any relation to Sir Galahad?
translation: 혹시 Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)과 관계가 있으세요?

english: Do you get lonely here on your own?
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시의 오늘 하루, 정말 멋지죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 뭐든지요! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너만큼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴 들고 다닐 엄두도 못 냈을 거야!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 저리 가, 거지 녀석아.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너처럼 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 얘기하고 싶은 마음이 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 넌 분명 앞발이 멋질 것 같아.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 이래저래 참 비참한 날이군... 이런 날은 있을 때 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 여기서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무~척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너도 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누가 좀 끼어서...

english: Welcome to the vinery, young [man/lady]. Can I help you?
translation: 포도원에 온 걸 환영해요, 젊은 [man/lady]. 뭘 도와줄까요?

english: How do I farm here?
I'm afraid you aren't allowed, dear.
Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 자, 다른 건 뭐 도와줄 게 있나요?

english: Let's see... First, you'll need to treat the soil with saltpetre. Dig it into the patch with a trowel. The minerals are good for the fruit.
translation: 어디 보자... 먼저 흙을 saltpetre(초석)으로 손봐야 해요. trowel(모종삽)으로 밭에 파서 섞어 넣으면 돼요. 그 광물이 열매에 좋거든요.

english: Then plant a grape seed, and just let it grow. I'll look after it, so it won't get diseased.
translation: 그다음엔 grape seed(포도 씨앗)을 심고 그냥 자라게 두면 돼요. 내가 돌봐 줄 테니 병들 일은 없을 거예요.

english: When your grapes are ready, pick them and clear the patch so you can grow a new vine.
translation: grapes(포도)가 다 익으면 따고 나서 밭을 정리해요. 그래야 새 포도나무를 키울 수 있으니까요.

english: Does that seem clear, or would you like help with something else?
translation: 이해가 됐나요, 아니면 다른 걸 도와줄까요?

english: What do you do?
I'm the vintner. I helped Lord Hosidius to develop this land as a vinery, and now it's complete he's put me in charge of production while he works on a new project.
translation: 난 포도주 양조가예요. Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)님을 도와 이 땅을 포도원으로 일궜는데, 다 완성되자 그분이 새 일을 하시는 동안 생산을 나한테 맡기셨죠.

english: His son, young Pandur, works here too. Pandur checks the wine I produce. But if you've got any questions about the farming, don't ask Pandur. Ask me instead. He checks the wine too much.
translation: 그분 아드님인 젊은 Pandur(판두르)도 여기서 일해요. 판두르는 내가 만든 포도주를 검사하죠. 하지만 농사에 관해 궁금한 게 있으면 판두르 말고 나한테 물어요. 그 애는 포도주를 너무 많이 검사하거든요.

english: So can I help you with anything?
Why are you called Gallow?
It's short for 'Gallows'. When I was young, a boy made some improper suggestions to me, so I grabbed him by his neck and held him in the air until he learnt some manners.
translation: 'Gallows(교수대)'를 줄인 거예요. 어렸을 때 어떤 남자애가 나한테 버릇없는 수작을 걸길래, 그 애 목을 잡고 예의를 배울 때까지 공중에 들어 올려 줬거든요.

english: Now, dear, do you need help with the vinery? I'm enjoying the chat, but I have work to do.
translation: 자, 젊은이, 포도원 일로 도움이 필요한가요? 수다 떠는 것도 즐겁지만 난 할 일이 있어서요.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
I have a question for you.
Gallow has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Gallow has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Gallow(갤로)가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 줬다!

english: You've obtained a casket!
How do I farm here?
What do you do?
Why are you called Gallow?
I'm fine, thanks.
Good day.
What's so good about it?
What's eating you.
I'm ruined, all because of that stupid cat! It has ruined me.
translation: 난 망했어, 전부 그 멍청한 고양이 때문이야! 그놈이 날 망쳐 놨다고.

english: Why did it have to get itself killed? Why?
translation: 왜 하필 죽어 버린 거냐고? 왜?

english: *Aside* I think I should leave him alone. He seems a little upset right now.
translation: *혼잣말* 혼자 있게 두는 게 좋겠어. 지금 좀 속상한 것 같아.

english: Hello!
What are you doing here?
Trying to win my shirt back. I lost it last night in a silly bet.
translation: 셔츠를 되찾으려는 중이야. 어젯밤 멍청한 내기를 하다가 잃었거든.

english: Well I hope your luck improves. I doubt it can get any worse.
translation: 운이 좀 풀리길 바랄게요. 이보다 더 나빠질 수는 없을 것 같으니까요.

english: Well I've little left to lose, maybe some more hair and my trousers.
translation: 뭐, 이제 잃을 것도 별로 없어. 머리카락이랑 바지 정도나 남았지.

english: I really think you should try hold on to them.
translation: 그건 꼭 지키셔야 할 것 같아요.

english: Hello.
What do you want?
I was just wondering what you were doing here?
I ask myself the same question often.
What am I doing down here in these pits along with these filthy dregs of society?
translation: 내가 이 구덩이 밑바닥에서 이 더러운 인간 말종들이랑 뭘 하고 있는 걸까?

english: And do you ever come up with an answer?
Always.
I'm here taking their money, that's what.
translation: 저놈들 돈을 따고 있는 거지, 그게 답이야.

english: Hello! What's going on here?
Just a bit of drinking, a bit of fighting and a few people trying to win big.
translation: 술 좀 마시고, 싸움 좀 하고, 몇몇은 한탕 크게 따 보려는 거지.

english: Nothing but good clean family fun.
What are you doing?
Nothing much. Just keeping myself occupied, placing a couple of wagers here and there.
translation: 별거 없어. 그냥 시간 때우는 중이야. 여기저기 내기 몇 판 걸면서.

english: Are you winning?
Yes in the sense that I'm not as bored as I was and no in terms of the number of coins in my purse.
translation: 지루함이 덜해졌다는 점에선 그렇고, 지갑 속 coins(코인) 개수로 따지면 아니지.

english: What are you up to?
Trying to win back some money.
Is it going well?
In every bet there is a fool and a thief and I'm beginning to think that I'm not much of a thief.
translation: 내기판엔 늘 바보 하나와 도둑 하나가 있다는데, 아무래도 난 도둑 쪽은 아닌 것 같아.

english: Having fun. It's such a blast I've already won 5 thousand gold coins today, my cat just keeps winning.
translation: 재밌게 놀고 있지. 완전 신나. 오늘만 벌써 5천 골드나 땄어, 우리 고양이가 계속 이기거든.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 그럼 이 쥐 구덩이는 어떻게 돌아가는 거예요?

english: Things work simply in the Ardougne ratpits.
If you have a kitten and at least 100 coins you can challenge someone else who also has a kitten and some spare change.
translation: kitten(새끼 고양이)랑 최소 100코인이 있으면, 마찬가지로 새끼 고양이랑 여윳돈이 있는 다른 사람한테 도전할 수 있어.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 그다음에 판돈을 정해. 소문에는 몇몇 쥐잡이들은 자기 고양이랑 말이 통해서 작전을 일러 준다더라.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 5 rats first wins.
translation: 지금 그 얘기 하려던 참이야. 두 도전자의 고양이를 arena(경기장)에 넣고, 쥐 5마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이겨.

english: It's simple.
In Varrock if you have a grown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has a grown cat and some spare change.
translation: Varrock(바록)에선 다 큰 고양이랑 코인 몇 닢만 있으면, 마찬가지로 다 큰 고양이랑 여윳돈이 있는 다른 사람한테 도전할 수 있어.

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 7 rats first wins.
translation: 지금 그 얘기 하려던 참이야. 두 도전자의 고양이를 arena(경기장)에 넣고, 쥐 7마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이겨.

english: The Port Sarim pits are quite fussy, no lazy cats allowed in here.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림) 구덩이는 꽤 까다로워. 게으른 고양이는 못 들어와.

english: Lazy cats?
You know if you neglect a wily cat, it gets fat and lazy? Well, they're not allowed to fight in here, only wily cats.
translation: wily cat(영리한 고양이)를 내버려 두면 살찌고 게을러지는 거 알지? 그런 놈들은 여기서 못 싸워. 영리한 고양이만 돼.

english: I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 11 rats first wins.
translation: 지금 그 얘기 하려던 참이야. 두 도전자의 고양이를 arena(경기장)에 넣고, 쥐 11마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이겨.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 세상은 잔인한 곳이고, 이 구덩이도 예외는 아니야.

english: Each to their own, I say.
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 아, 끔찍해라. 고양이를 구할 방법은 없어요?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 당연히 있지. 조심하라고 지시하면 위험하다 싶을 때 알아서 빠져나와.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 그러니까 오래 버틸수록 이길 확률이 높아지는 거지.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 하나 확실한 건, 돈을 빨리 벌기도 하고 빨리 잃기도 한다는 거야.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 돈에 한도가 있어요?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 흠... 생각 좀 해 보자. 그럴 일이 있었던 적은 없는 것 같은데, 아마 20,000일 거야.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 흠, 고양이 싸움에 걸기엔 말도 안 되는 금액이네요.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 사람들이 얼마나 걸려고 드는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 아니, 지금은 안 돼. 우린 바깥사람이랑은 잘 안 걸어.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 바깥사람이라뇨, 지금 이렇게 구덩이 안에 들어와 있잖아요?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 글쎄, 네가 내 신뢰를 얻을 만한 일을 하면 모를까.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 아니. 마을 사람들은 우릴 싫어하고, 그래서 우리도 그 사람들이랑 다른 누구든 못 믿는 거야.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 돈에 한도가 있어요?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
Ello there. I'm Gamfred, the engineer in this here guild. Have you seen my catapult?
translation: 어이 거기. 난 Gamfred(감프레드), 이 길드의 기술자지. 내 catapult(투석기) 봤나?

english: That's not a catapult, it's a large crossbow.
WHAT!? I'll have you know that is the finest piece of dwarven engineering for miles around! How DARE you insult my work!
translation: 뭐라고!? 이건 이 근방 수십 리 안에서 제일 훌륭한 드워프 공학 작품이란 말이다! 감히 내 작품을 모욕해!

english: Yes, beautiful piece of engineering.
Nice to meet someone who appreciates fine work, have you tried it out yet?
translation: 훌륭한 솜씨를 알아보는 사람을 만나니 반갑군. 벌써 한번 해 봤나?

english: Yes.
What did you think?
It was ok I guess.
Well I guess not everyone will like it.
It was fun!
Glad ta hear it. Try it again sometime. We have more tests to run.
translation: 그 말 들으니 기쁘군. 언제 또 해 봐. 아직 할 시험이 더 있거든.

english: I didn't like it.
Well I guess not everyone will like it. But give it another chance before you go.
translation: 뭐, 모두가 좋아할 순 없겠지. 그래도 가기 전에 한 번만 더 기회를 줘 봐.

english: May I have a shield please?
Silly muffin, you have one already!
translation: 이 맹꽁이 같으니, 벌써 하나 있잖아!

english: I'd be happy ta give you a shield but you've no space for it.
translation: 방패를 주고는 싶은데 넣을 공간이 없구먼.

english: Of course!
The dwarf hands you a large shield.
No, how do I do that?
Well ye take the big defence shield in both hands and watch the catapult. My assistant will fire different things at you and you need to defend against them.
translation: 그러니까 큰 방어용 방패를 두 손으로 들고 투석기를 지켜보는 거야. 내 assistant(조수)가 여러 가지를 쏠 테니 그걸 막아 내면 돼.

english: Sounds boring.
Your loss...
No, where is it?
Are ye blind [lad/lass]? Tis over there in the next room with me assistant working it!
translation: 눈이 멀었나, [lad/lass]? 저기 옆방에서 내 조수가 돌리고 있잖아!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 아직 번 토큰이 하나도 없는 것 같은데. 길드 여기저기서 활동을 해 보면 벌 수 있을 거야.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Bye!
Come back soon! My catapult needs more test subjects.
translation: 또 와! 내 투석기엔 실험 대상이 더 필요하거든.

english: Watch out! You'll need to equip the shield as soon as you're on the target spot else you could get hit! Speak to me to get one, and make sure both your hands are free to equip it.
translation: 조심해! target(과녁) 자리에 서자마자 방패를 장착해야 해, 안 그러면 맞을 수 있어! 방패는 나한테 말 걸면 줄 테니까, 두 손을 다 비워 놔야 장착할 수 있다는 거 잊지 마.

english: That's not a catapult, it's a large crossbow.
Yes, beautiful piece of engineering.
Yes.
It was ok I guess.
It was fun!
I didn't like it.
May I have a shield please?
No, how do I do that?
Sounds boring.
No, where is it?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
Bring some of the heavy squad to carry the crates.
translation: 힘쓰는 놈들 좀 데려와서 상자 나르게 해.

english: Get this right and I'll see you're well paid.
translation: 이번 일 제대로 하면 두둑이 챙겨 주마.

english: Handle the explosives carefully.
If the shopkeeper won't cooperate, kill his wife.
translation: 상점 주인이 협조 안 하면 그놈 마누라를 죽여.

english: If the soldiers try to interfere, kill them.
Make sure the captain knows not to talk.
translation: 선장한테 입 다물라고 확실히 해 둬.

english: Our ship is due with the evening tide.
translation: 우리 배는 저녁 밀물 때 들어온다.

english: Pay attention or I'll rip your throat out.
translation: 정신 똑바로 차려, 안 그러면 목을 뜯어 버린다.

english: The boxes marked with a cross are ours.
translation: 십자 표시가 된 상자들이 우리 거다.

english: Weigh the gold carefully in case he double-crosses us.
translation: 금은 꼼꼼히 달아 봐, 그놈이 뒤통수칠지도 모르니까.

english: We're done here.
Die, Shayzien scum!
Got it, boss.
Okay, boss.
Sure thing, boss.
We're on it, boss.
Yes, boss.
You're the boss.
To crime!
Good day to you.
And a good day to you too.
Hi, I am trying to find the cause of the curse on your town.
translation: 안녕하세요, 이 마을에 내린 저주의 원인을 찾고 있어요.

english: What curse is that?
Don't you know? The curse that has stopped your fountain working and made all the water dry up when you bring it back from the river?
translation: 모르세요? fountain(분수)를 멈추게 하고, river(강)에서 길어 온 물을 다 말라 버리게 하는 저주 말이에요.

english: Ohh that's because of a curse? I didn't think of that.
translation: 아아, 그게 저주 때문이었어요? 그건 생각도 못 했네요.

english: So any ideas about the cause of the curse?
translation: 그럼 저주의 원인에 대해 짚이는 거라도 있어요?

english: Absolutely none.
I heard the people of Nardah threw their statue of Elidinis away.
translation: Nardah(나르다) 사람들이 Elidinis(엘리디니스) 조각상을 내다 버렸다고 들었어요.

english: Did they? What did they want to go and do a thing like that for?
translation: 그랬어요? 대체 왜 그런 짓을 했대요?

english: A Saradominist priest who was staying here told them too.
translation: 여기 머물던 사라도민파 priest(사제)가 그러라고 했대요.

english: There was a Saradominist priest here?
You don't seem to notice much. Do you even live here?
translation: 주변 일을 정말 모르시네요. 여기 살긴 하세요?

english: Yes, I just don't get out that much.
translation: 네, 그냥 밖에 잘 안 나가서요.

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
It's been lifted? I hadn't realised. I've still been buying water from Ali the Carter!
translation: 풀렸다고요? 몰랐네요. 아직도 Ali the Carter(마부 알리)한테서 물을 사 먹고 있었는데!

english: Be warned human. The Wyrms here are under my protection. I will not let you kill them unless you have permission.
translation: 경고하마, 인간. 이곳의 Wyrm(웜)들은 내 보호 아래 있다. 허가가 없다면 놈들을 죽이게 두지 않겠다.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: 인간! 이 생물들을 공격하는 건 균형을 위협하는 일이다. 허가받은 자만이 놈들과 싸울 수 있다!

english: Do you want to buy some garden plants?
Yes please!
What are these plants for?
For planting in your house's garden, of course!
How do I do that?
The same way you make furniture. You'll find plant hotspots in your garden and you just need to have one of my bagged saplings with you when you build at them.
translation: 가구 만드는 거랑 똑같아요. 정원에 식물 설치 지점이 있는데, 거기서 건설할 때 제가 파는 자루에 담긴 묘목을 하나 가지고 있으면 돼요.

english: Ah, I see.
So do you want to look at my stock?
No thanks.
Yes please!
What are these plants for?
No thanks
Hello.
Oi'm busy. If tha' wants owt, tha' can go find Wyson. He's ta boss 'round here. And KEEP YER TRAMPIN' FEET ORFF MA' FLOWERS!
translation: 내 바쁘다 안 카나. 뭐 필요하믄 Wyson(와이슨) 찾아가 보래이. 그 양반이 여 대장이다. 그라고 내 꽃밭에서 그 쿵쾅대는 발 좀 치아라!

english: Right...
First moles, now this! Take this, vandal!
translation: 두더지도 모자라서 인자 이기라! 이거나 무라, 이 망나니야!

english: How are you?
The Headless Gardener's neck twitches at you, but the lack of any head prevents him from speaking.
translation: 머리 없는 정원사의 목이 당신을 향해 움찔거리지만, 머리가 없어서 말을 하지 못한다.

english: Same as ever, mate, just getting' on with it regardless.
translation: 늘 똑같지 뭐, 친구. 그래도 그냥저냥 하던 일 하는 거야.

english: Good for you...err...mate.
Hello there.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm weeding this herb garden. It's hard work! I also sell a few gardening supplies.
translation: 이 herb(약초) 밭의 잡초를 뽑고 있습니다. 힘든 일이지요! 정원 용품도 몇 가지 팔고 있습니다.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
What do you have for sale?
At the moment I'm selling garden rakes and iron sickles. If you'd like one, Your Royal Highness,
translation: 지금은 정원용 rakes(갈퀴)와 iron sickles(철 낫)을 팔고 있습니다. 하나 원하시면, 전하,

english: I'd like a rake, please.
Thank you! Here you go.
I'd like an iron sickle, please.
What are iron sickles for?
I can't think of anything just now. But you can buy one if you like, Your Highness!
translation: 지금 당장은 딱히 떠오르는 게 없습니다. 하지만 원하시면 하나 사셔도 됩니다, 전하!

english: No, thank you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 창고가 가득 찼습니다, 전하. Advisor Ghrim(고문 그림)께 말씀하셔서 그동안 모은 것을 받아 가십시오.

english: Good luck with that.
What do you have for sale?
I'd like a rake, please.
I'd like an iron sickle, please.
What are iron sickles for?
No, thank you.
Hello.
Go away. Busy.
Busy doing what?
Gardening.
Do you need a hand?
No.
Alright, I was just trying to be helpful. Why are you so angry?
translation: 알았어요, 그냥 도와드리려던 거예요. 왜 그렇게 화가 나 있어요?

english: Too much talk. Flowers don't talk. Flowers good.
translation: 말이 너무 많아. 꽃은 말 안 해. 꽃 좋아.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Yous creature doesn't stick mee's chompy, else mee's squeeze creature till yous a deadun!
translation: 너 생물, 내 chompy(촘피) 찌르지 마, 안 그럼 나 너 꽉 짜서 죽은 놈 만들 거야!

english: Yous creatures too weedy for da ogre stabby chucker, yous best stick wiv da cluks-cluks.
translation: 너 생물들 너무 비실비실해서 오우거 찌르기 던지개 못 써, 너 꼬꼬들이나 찔러.

english: Chompy is bestest yumms...
Me'se can't wait for da chompy yumms...I's dribbling all down me's for da tasty chompy.
translation: 나 촘피 냠냠 너무 기다려져... 맛난 촘피 생각에 침이 질질 흘러.

english: Da fatsy toadies geddin' all messy...
Me's gonna ged da pridy chompy hatsies...an looks like a good-un wiv da laydies.
translation: 나 이쁜 촘피 모자 얻을 거야... 그럼 여자들한테 멋져 보일 거야.

english: Mee's scared of Jiggig and da zogries, deyz is not da right dead-uns.
translation: 나 Jiggig(지기그)랑 zogre(조그르)들 무서워, 걔네 제대로 된 죽은 놈들 아니야.

english: Mee's got no stabbers no more...gonna go home wiv no chompy...
translation: 나 찌르개 이제 없어... 촘피 없이 집에 가야 해...

english: I's stickin' da chompy...
De'se stabbers are worser dan a dead dog....
translation: 이 찌르개들 죽은 개보다 더 구려....

english: Hello?
A fine day you have chosen to visit this hellish island, human.
translation: 지옥 같은 이 섬을 찾아오기에 참 좋은 날을 골랐군, 인간.

english: Good day to you too Sergeant. I've been sent by your King Narnode to -
translation: 당신도 좋은 하루 보내세요, Sergeant(상사)님. 당신네 King Narnode(나노드 왕)께서 저를 보내셔서...

english: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious disappearance of my squad. Yes, I know.
translation: 내 분대가 수수께끼처럼 사라진 사건의 경위를 조사하라고 하셨겠지. 그래, 알고 있네.

english: How did you know that?
The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.
translation: 폐하와 나는 띄엄띄엄이긴 해도 아직 연락을 주고받고 있네. 나를 도울 자네 같은 역량의 인간이 필요하다고 판단했지. 아직 살아 있는 걸 보니 기쁘군.

english: Why do you need a human?
There is more going on than meets your eye, human. Did you not find it strange that an entire squad be sent to decommission a shipyard?
translation: 자네 눈에 보이는 것보다 더 많은 일이 벌어지고 있네, 인간. 조선소 하나 폐쇄하는 데 분대 전체를 보냈다는 게 이상하지 않았나?

english: Well -
Indeed. But there are more pressing matters at hand. Three of my squad have been captured and placed in the jail. They are watched over by somewhat overpowering guards.
translation: 그렇지. 하지만 지금은 더 급한 문제가 있네. 내 분대원 셋이 붙잡혀 감옥에 갇혔어. 꽤나 버거운 경비병들이 그들을 지키고 있지.

english: Before we can resume our original mission we must rescue them.
translation: 원래 임무를 재개하기 전에 그들을 구출해야 하네.

english: I know about the guards - I had to sneak out between the change of shifts.
translation: 경비병들은 알아요. 저도 교대 시간 틈에 몰래 빠져나와야 했거든요.

english: Trust me; we too have considered this, but whilst it is possible for one, it is near impossible for three.
translation: 믿게나, 우리도 그건 고려해 봤네. 하지만 한 명이라면 가능해도 세 명은 거의 불가능하지.

english: We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My,  assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.
translation: 우린 여러 가지를 고려했네. 지금 우리 밑에서는 내 분대 마법사와 공병들이 작업 중이야. 내 암살자 Karam(카람)은 마을 안에서 활동하고 있고.

english: I remain here so that I may overhear Awowogei's plans.
translation: 나는 Awowogei(아워워게이)의 계획을 엿듣기 위해 여기 남아 있는 걸세.

english: Awowogei?
The self-proclaimed ruler of the island. I have been listening to him for some time now. I believe we will incur a minimum of casualties if we have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: 이 섬의 지배자를 자처하는 자일세. 한동안 그의 말을 엿듣고 있었지. 내부자, 즉 우리를 위해 일할 원숭이가 하나 있다면 희생을 최소한으로 줄일 수 있을 거라 생각하네.

english: Have you seen these monkeys? You could never convince them to work for you!
translation: 그 원숭이들 보셨어요? 그놈들이 당신을 위해 일하게 설득하는 건 절대 불가능해요!

english: I wasn't suggesting convincing them, human, but you.
translation: 그들을 설득하자는 게 아니었네, 인간. 자네 말일세.

english: Don't be ridiculous! I'm a human - not a monkey!
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 저는 인간이지 원숭이가 아니라고요!

english: Do not be so sceptical ... you humans are considered to be quite closely related to monkeys.
translation: 그렇게 의심할 것 없네... 자네들 인간은 원숭이와 꽤 가까운 친척으로 여겨지니까.

english: Yes, but -
Go and see my squad mage, Zooknock. Tell him I have asked you to be 'disguised' as a monkey so that you may infiltrate the village. As you will see, he is something of an expert on the subject.
translation: 내 분대 마법사 Zooknock(주크녹)을 찾아가게. 마을에 잠입할 수 있도록 자네를 원숭이로 '변장'시켜 달라고 내가 부탁했다고 전하게. 보면 알겠지만, 그 친구는 이 분야에 일가견이 있지.

english: I can't even communicate with the monkeys!
Just go and find my squad mage, human.
translation: 그냥 내 분대 마법사를 찾아가게, 인간.

english: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?
translation: 주크녹과 원숭이 변장에 대해 이야기해 봤나?

english: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.
translation: 네. 원숭이 말을 할 수 있는 amulet(아뮬렛)이랑 원숭이 greegree(그리그리)를 만들었어요.

english: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.
translation: 아주 좋군. 잠시 후에 원숭이 변장을 한 채로 내게 말을 걸어 보게. 얼마나 잘됐는지 판단해 보겠네.

english: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
translation: 이런, 이번엔 주크녹이 솜씨를 제대로 발휘했군. 자네 정말 원숭이처럼 보이네, 알고 있나?

english: I know.
And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.
translation: 게다가 운 좋게도 딱 알맞은 종류의 원숭이로 보이는군.

english: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.
translation: 이제 자네가 Awowogei(아워워게이)를 알현해야 하네. Karamja(카람자) 원숭이들의 사절로서 동맹을 청하러 왔다고 하게.

english: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.
translation: 우리가 성공하려면 자네가 그의 신뢰를 얻어야 하네.

english: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.
translation: Awowogei(아워워게이)의 신뢰를 얻다니 잘했네. 여기서 전부 엿들었지.

english: However, your efforts may be in vain...
translation: 하지만 자네의 노력이 헛수고가 될지도 모르겠네...

english: What do you mean?
Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.
translation: 동굴 작업이 더디게 진행되고 있네. 자네가 Ardougne(아르둔)에 가 있는 동안, Bunkwicket(벙크위킷)과 Waymottin(웨이모틴)이 조금 불안한 대화를 엿들었다네.

english: Who was speaking? What was said?
Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
translation: 내가 자세한 내용을 들려줄 테니 잘 듣게...

english: What shall we do?
Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.
What kind of a plan?
I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.
translation: 잘 들었길 바라네. 그들이 마련한 순간이동 주문은 우리가 어디에 있든 10분대 전원을 순간이동시키지.

english: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.
translation: 결국 그 주문이 Lumo(루모), Bunkdo(벙크도), Carado(카라도)를 감옥에서 빼내 주는 셈이네.

english: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!
translation: 하지만 그럼 당신들은 놈들이 준비해 둔 함정 한가운데로 바로 순간이동되는 거잖아요!

english: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.
translation: 그렇지. 바로 여기서 자네가 필요한 걸세. 우리가 Royal Guard(왕실 근위대) 10분대이고, 우리 몸 하나쯤은 충분히 지킬 수 있다는 걸 잊지 말게.

english: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.
translation: 자네가 도와준다면 무엇이 덤벼들든 물리칠 수 있을 걸세.

english: But how will I join you?
Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.
translation: 간단하네. 자네가 사실 우리 분대원이라고 순간이동 주문을 속이는 거지.

english: What?
Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes that spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.
translation: 주크녹은 Glough(글로우)의 마법 실력을 잘 알고 있네. 그 주문이 우리 분대원 모두가 지닌 sigils(인장)과 연결되어 있다고 보더군.

english: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
translation: 우리를 분대원으로 식별해 주는 게 바로 이 인장들이지.

english: Garkor hands you some kind of medallion.
Welcome to the 10th squad, [player name].
What is it?
It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.
translation: Waymottin(웨이모틴)이 우리 분대 인장을 본떠 만든 복제품일세. 주문이 시전될 때 그걸 착용하고 있으면 자네도 우리와 함께 소환될 걸세.

english: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.
translation: 준비하게. 마음을 가다듬고 소지품을 챙긴 다음 인장을 착용하게. 서두르게, 인간. 자네 없이 이 싸움에 뛰어들고 싶지는 않으니.

english: All I have to do is wear this sigil?
Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.
translation: 그렇네. 하지만 준비가 될 때까지는 착용하지 말게.

english: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
Stop talking and start fighting!
Well done, human! That was a most impressive display of skill.
Thank you.
You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.
translation: 즉시 King Narnode(나노드 왕)께 보고하게. 10분대가 아직 건재하며 희생자는 한 명도 없다고 전하게.

english: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?
translation: 걱정 마세요, 꼭 그렇게 할게요. 여기서 어떻게 나가요?

english: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.
translation: Zooknock(주크녹)에게 말하게. 그가 자네가 떠날 수 있게 준비해 줄 걸세.

english: Greetings, [player name].
Hey Garkor, how's it going?
Very well. Since the 10th squad were recalled from Ape Atoll, King Narnode has named me new Grand Tree Guardian.
translation: 아주 잘 지내네. 10분대가 Ape Atoll(에이프 아톨)에서 철수한 뒤, King Narnode(나노드 왕)께서 나를 새 Grand Tree Guardian(그랜드 트리 수호자)로 임명하셨지.

english: I believe I speak on behalf of everyone in the Stronghold when I say thank you for stopping Glough. Who knows what would've happened if you weren't there to foil his schemes.
translation: Stronghold(요새)의 모두를 대신해 Glough(글로우)를 막아 준 데 감사하네. 자네가 그자의 음모를 저지하지 않았다면 무슨 일이 벌어졌을지 누가 알겠나.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 된다네. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리지.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Garkor
translation: [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 배달품을 Garkor(가르코르)에게 건넨다.

english: Always good to see you again, [player name].
I guess you didn't travel far, but since it's you... Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 멀리 온 건 아닌 것 같지만, 자네니까... 여기 팁으로 조금 더 얹어 주지.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 token(토큰)까지 [number]크레딧을 모았습니다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없습니다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 token(토큰)까지 [number]크레딧을 모았습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받는 걸 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었습니다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 다른 주문을 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: Hello there. Don't see many people around here. The name's Garl.
translation: 안녕하세요. 이 근처엔 사람이 잘 안 보이던데. 제 이름은 Garl(갈)이에요.

english: Hey. What are you doing here?
Exploring. Until that Nomad chap opened things up, this island was abandoned. Who knows what could be hiding here.
translation: 탐험이요. 그 Nomad(노마드)라는 친구가 길을 열기 전까지 이 섬은 버려져 있었거든요. 여기 뭐가 숨어 있을지 누가 알겠어요.

english: Found anything good so far?
Well there's a dungeon on the east side of the island. I haven't gone too far in though. There's also a tower to the north west, near my camp.
translation: 음, 섬 동쪽에 던전이 하나 있어요. 아직 깊이 들어가 보진 않았지만요. 북서쪽에는 tower(탑)도 있는데, 제 야영지 근처예요.

english: There's no shortage of resources either. Though there's not really any way to process them. I tried to build a spinning wheel and a pottery wheel myself, but they broke.
translation: 자원도 넘쳐나요. 다만 가공할 방법이 마땅치 않아요. spinning wheel(물레)랑 도자기 물레를 직접 만들어 보려 했는데 망가져 버렸어요.

english: You could really live off the land here. I can think of worse places to do so.
translation: 여기선 정말 자급자족하며 살 수 있겠네요. 이보다 나쁜 곳도 얼마든지 있을 거고요.

english: Indeed. It's all very peaceful. And yet...
translation: 그렇죠. 모든 게 아주 평화로워요. 그런데도...

english: What is it?
I don't know. Something just seems amiss. There's something sinister about this place. I just don't really know what.
translation: 모르겠어요. 그냥 뭔가 이상해요. 이곳엔 뭔가 불길한 게 있어요. 그게 뭔지는 정말 모르겠지만요.

english: I'm sure it's nothing.
You're probably right. Anyway, I'll let you get on. All the best.
translation: 아마 그렇겠죠. 아무튼, 이만 가 보세요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: Hello there.
Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: 이 성에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: It's called Ver Sinhaza. They say it was once the home of a Saradominist queen. Now it belongs to Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble.
translation: Ver Sinhaza(베르 신하자)라고 해요. 한때 사라도민을 섬기던 여왕이 살던 곳이라고들 하죠. 지금은 뱀파이어 귀족인 Verzik Vitur(버지크 비투르)의 것이에요.

english: Beneath the castle you'll find the Theatre of Blood. Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch take on various challenges set up by Verzik, all the provide entertainment for the vampyres.
translation: 성 아래에는 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)이 있어요. 매일 Meiyerditch(메이어디치) 시민들이 버지크가 마련한 온갖 시련에 도전하는데, 전부 뱀파이어들을 즐겁게 해 주기 위한 거예요.

english: The citizens don't need to be forced though. Anyone who survives the Theatre is promised freedom from the vampyres. It provides a little bit of hope in this dark place.
translation: 그렇다고 시민들이 억지로 끌려가는 건 아니에요. 극장에서 살아남는 사람은 누구든 뱀파이어로부터 자유를 얻는다고 약속받거든요. 이 어두운 곳에서 그게 작은 희망이 되죠.

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
I do. I'd rather not talk about them though. Those kinds of conversations get you in trouble.
translation: 알긴 알아요. 그래도 그 얘기는 안 하고 싶네요. 그런 얘기를 하다간 곤란해지거든요.

english: Old Man Ral might be willing to talk to you about them though. He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly west of here.
translation: 그래도 Old Man Ral(랄 노인)이라면 그 얘기를 해 줄지도 몰라요. 여기서 바로 서쪽, 메이어디치 1구역에 살아요.

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti(산귀네스티) 지역에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Yep, that's where wee are at the moment. The region is split into two cities, Meiyerditch in the south and Darkmeyer in the north.
translation: 네, 우리가 지금 있는 곳이 바로 거기예요. 이 지역은 두 도시로 나뉘는데, 남쪽은 Meiyerditch(메이어디치), 북쪽은 Darkmeyer(다크마이어)예요.

english: Meiyerditch is just one large ghetto. The city is split into sectors so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill everyone off in one go.
translation: 메이어디치는 그냥 커다란 빈민가예요. 도시가 여러 구역으로 나뉘어 있어서 뱀파이어들이 돌아가며 피의 십일조를 걷어 가요. 그래야 한 번에 모두를 죽여 버리지 않으니까요.

english: Darkmeyer is the vampyre capital. Humans aren't allowed there unless they're a personal slave of some lord or lady. They say the vampyres there live very luxurious lifestyles.
translation: Darkmeyer(다크마이어)는 뱀파이어들의 수도예요. 인간은 어느 영주나 귀부인의 개인 노예가 아니면 들어갈 수 없어요. 거기 뱀파이어들은 아주 호화롭게 산다고들 하더군요.

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
Not much really. There seems to be three main types, juveniles, juvinates and vy*res.
translation: 사실 별로 몰라요. 크게 세 종류가 있는 것 같아요. juveniles(주버나일), juvinates(주비네이트), 그리고 vy*res(바*어)요.

english: Juveniles seem to be the lowest form of the vampyre. No one around here knows for sure but the general consensus is that they're former humans who've been converted in some way.
translation: 주버나일은 뱀파이어 중에서 가장 낮은 계급인 것 같아요. 이 근방에 확실히 아는 사람은 없지만, 어떤 식으로든 변해 버린 옛 인간들이라는 게 대체적인 생각이에요.

english: Juvinates are initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to gain some powers.
translation: 주비네이트는 입문한 주버나일인데, 훈련을 좀 받아서 힘을 얻기 시작한 녀석들이에요.

english: Then you have the vyres. Very nasty and very powerful. I wouldn't get on the wrong side of one if I were you.
translation: 그리고 vyres(바이어)가 있죠. 아주 고약하고 아주 강해요. 제가 당신이라면 절대 그놈들 눈 밖에 나지 않을 거예요.

english: What do you know about Drakan?
Vanescula?
Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: 아니, 제 말은 진짜 드라칸, 그러니까 Morytania(모리타니아)의 지배자 말이에요.

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. You can occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but not too often.
translation: 흠, 그 사람은 벌써 몇 년째 아무도 못 봤어요. 바네스쿨라가 날아다니는 건 가끔 보이지만, 그것도 자주는 아니에요.

english: Can you tell me about this castle?
translation: 이 성에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Do you know anything about the Myreque?
Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
translation: Sanguinesti(산귀네스티) 지역에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: What do you know about the vampyres?
What do you know about Drakan?
Hello. What do you want?
I want for nothing!
You're one of a very lucky few then.
translation: 그럼 넌 정말 몇 안 되는 운 좋은 놈이로군.

english: Look who it is!
Hello again. How are things going?
Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: 최고야! 하루 종일 먹기만 해도 돈을 받는데, 그 돈이 또 음식이라니까. 이렇게 좋았던 적이 없어!

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: 그러게 말이야, Gary(개리)! 파업할 때보다 훨씬 낫다니까!

english: Glad to hear it.
What happened to the old man who used to be the doorman?
translation: 예전에 문지기 하시던 노인분은 어떻게 되셨어요?

english: You mean my father? He went into retirement, I've taken over the family business instead.
translation: 제 아버지 말씀이세요? 은퇴하셨어요. 가업은 제가 대신 물려받았고요.

english: Your father! But you don't look anything like him!
No, fortunately for me I inherited my good looks from my mother.
translation: 네, 다행히도 잘생긴 외모는 어머니한테 물려받았거든요.

english: Sorry, we cannot allow you to bring those sacks into the market for security reason.
translation: 죄송하지만 보안상의 이유로 그 자루들을 시장 안에 가지고 들어가실 수 없어요.

english: You may not pass through this door without paying the trading tax.
translation: 거래세를 내지 않으면 이 문을 통과하실 수 없어요.

english: So how much is the tax?
The cost is one diamond.
Okay...
I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
No tax, no entry.
A diamond? Are you crazy?
Not at all. Those are the rules.
What do you do with all the diamonds you get?

Ever heard of fairylights? Well how do you think we make 'em? First we collect a pile of gems and then we get a spider to spin 'em into a long web, we light the jewels by imbuing each one with a little bit of magic.
translation: 요정 전구라고 들어 보셨어요? 그걸 어떻게 만드는 것 같아요? 먼저 보석을 한 무더기 모은 다음 거미한테 그걸 길게 엮어 거미줄을 치게 하고, 보석마다 마법을 살짝 불어넣어 불을 밝히는 거예요.

english: So you're telling me fairylights are made out of gems?
translation: 그러니까 요정 전구가 보석으로 만든 거란 말이에요?

english: That's right, how else could we make 'em twinkle so beautifully?
translation: 맞아요, 안 그러면 어떻게 그렇게 아름답게 반짝이겠어요?

english: Do you know what these strange marks mean?
translation: 이 이상한 표시가 무슨 뜻인지 알아요?

english: No I don't and I'm trying to work here. Please stop distracting me!
translation: 아뇨, 몰라요. 그리고 저 지금 일하는 중이거든요. 제발 방해 좀 하지 마세요!

english: What are you doing all the way over here? Shouldn't you be at the market door?
translation: 여기까지 와서 뭐 하는 거예요? 시장 문에 있어야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: Yes, that's my usual spot, but the Godfather said I should be here, so here I am.
translation: 네, 원래 제 자리는 거기지만 대부님이 여기 있으라고 하셨거든요. 그래서 여기 있는 거예요.

english: Hello, did you just come from the market gates? Are my brothers doing their job well? I do worry that they'll start letting people into the market for free without me being there to supervise them!
translation: 안녕하세요, 방금 시장 대문 쪽에서 오셨어요? 제 형제들이 일은 잘하고 있던가요? 제가 감독하러 옆에 없으면 사람들을 공짜로 시장에 들여보내기 시작할까 봐 걱정이에요!

english: I'm afraid nobody is allowed in there, orders from the boss.
translation: 죄송하지만 저 안에는 아무도 들어갈 수 없어요. 두목님 명령이에요.

english: I've received orders to let you through if you want. Good luck.
translation: 원하시면 들여보내 드리라는 명령을 받았어요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: You squeeze past the thorny vines into a small tunnel.
translation: 가시 돋친 덩굴 사이를 비집고 작은 터널로 들어간다.

english: Be careful in there, there are still some of those baby Tanglefootii around.
translation: 안에서 조심하세요. 새끼 Tanglefootii(탱글풋)이 아직 좀 남아 있거든요.

english: You find the Queen's secateurs!
Okay...
A diamond? Are you crazy?
I haven't brought my diamonds with me.
What do you do with all the diamonds you get?
I say, I say, a toast to this fine human!
translation: 이보게, 이보게, 이 훌륭한 인간을 위해 건배하세!

english: What? I mean, err... why?
Why not!
I don't have anything suitable to toast with.
Then go get something from the bar!
translation: 그럼 술집 카운터에서 뭐라도 받아 오게!

english: Hello there, can I help you?
Where am I?
This is the town of Lumbridge my friend.
How are you today?
Aye, not too bad thank you. Lovely weather in Gielinor this fine day.
translation: 네, 나쁘지 않아요, 고마워요. 오늘 Gielinor(길리노르)는 날씨가 참 좋네요.

english: Weather?
Yes weather, you know.
The state or condition of the atmosphere at a time and place, with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
translation: 특정 시간과 장소에서 기온, 습도, 풍속, 기압 같은 변수에 따른 대기의 상태나 조건 말이에요.

english: Not just a pretty face eh? Ha ha ha.
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 제가 할 만한 퀘스트 아는 거 있어요?

english: What kind of quest are you looking for?
Hmm.. dangerous you say? What sort of creatures are you looking to fight?
translation: 흠.. 위험한 거라고요? 어떤 괴물이랑 싸우고 싶은데요?

english: Big scary demons!
You are a brave soul indeed.
Now that you mention it, I heard a rumour about a fortune-teller in Varrock who is rambling about some kind of greater evil.. sounds demon-like if you ask me.
translation: 말이 나와서 말인데, Varrock(바록)에 있는 점쟁이가 무슨 거대한 악에 대해 횡설수설한다는 소문을 들었어요.. 제가 보기엔 악마 얘기 같던데요.

english: Perhaps you could check it out if you are as brave as you say?
translation: 말씀하신 만큼 용감하시다면 한번 알아보시는 게 어때요?

english: Thanks for the tip, perhaps I will.
translation: 알려 줘서 고마워요, 한번 가 볼지도 몰라요.

english: I've already killed the demon Delrith. He was merely a stain on my sword when I was finished with him!
translation: 악마 Delrith(델리스)는 이미 해치웠어요. 제가 끝장을 냈을 땐 제 검에 묻은 얼룩에 불과했죠!

english: Well done! However I'm sure if you search around the world you will find more challenging foes to slay.
translation: 잘하셨어요! 그래도 세상을 돌아다니다 보면 분명 더 상대하기 벅찬 적들을 만나게 될 거예요.

english: Vampyres!
Ha ha. I personally don't believe in such things. However, there is a man in Draynor Village who has been scaring the village folk with stories of vampyres.
translation: 하하. 저는 그런 거 안 믿어요. 그런데 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 뱀파이어 이야기로 마을 사람들을 겁주는 남자가 있어요.

english: He's named Morgan and can be found in one of the village houses. Perhaps you could see what the matter is?
translation: 이름은 Morgan(모건)이고 마을 집들 중 한 곳에 있을 거예요. 무슨 일인지 한번 알아보시는 게 어때요?

english: Thanks for the tip.
Oh I have already killed that nasty blood-sucking vampyre. Draynor will be safe now.
translation: 아, 그 피를 빨아 대는 고약한 뱀파이어는 이미 해치웠어요. 이제 Draynor(드레이너)는 안전할 거예요.

english: Yeah, yeah of course you did. Everyone knows vampyres are not real....
translation: 네, 네, 그러셨겠죠. 뱀파이어가 진짜가 아니라는 건 다들 아는데요....

english: What! I did slay the beast..I really did.
translation: 뭐라고요! 진짜로 그 괴물을 처치했어요.. 정말이라니까요.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
..Huh.. But... Hey! I did... believe what you like.
translation: ..허.. 그게... 아니! 진짜로... 믿고 싶은 대로 믿으세요.

english: Small.. something small would be good.
Small? Small isn't really that dangerous though is it?
translation: 작은 거요? 작은 건 별로 안 위험하지 않아요?

english: Yes it can be! There could be anything from an evil chicken to a poisonous spider. They attack in numbers you know!
translation: 위험할 수 있어요! evil chicken(사악한 닭)부터 독거미까지 뭐든 있을 수 있다고요. 떼로 덤빈다니까요!

english: Yes ok, point taken. Speaking of small monsters, I hear old Wizard Mizgog in the wizards' tower has just had all his beads taken by a gang of mischievous imps.
translation: 네, 알았어요, 무슨 말인지 알겠어요. 작은 괴물 얘기가 나와서 말인데, wizards' tower(마법사의 탑)에 있는 Wizard Mizgog(마법사 미즈고그) 영감님이 장난꾸러기 imps(임프) 무리한테 구슬을 몽땅 빼앗겼대요.

english: Sounds like it could be a quest for you?
translation: 당신한테 딱 맞는 퀘스트 같지 않아요?

english: Thanks for your help.
Yes I know of Mizgog and have already helped him with his imp problem. It took me ages to find those beads!
translation: 네, 미즈고그라면 알아요. 임프 문제는 이미 해결해 드렸어요. 그 구슬 찾느라 한참 걸렸다고요!

english: Imps will be imps!
translation: 임프가 임프 짓 하는 거죠, 뭐!

english: Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
I can tell you about plenty of small easy tasks.
translation: 작고 쉬운 일이라면 잔뜩 알려 드릴 수 있어요.

english: The Lumbridge cook has been having problems, the Duke is confused over some strange talisman and on top of all that, poor lad Romeo in Varrock has girlfriend problems.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 요리사가 곤란한 일을 겪고 있고, Duke(공작)님은 이상한 부적 때문에 골머리를 앓고 계시고, 거기다 Varrock(바록)의 불쌍한 청년 Romeo(로미오)는 여자 친구 문제가 있대요.

english: Tell me about the Lumbridge cook.
It's funny really, the cook would forget his head if it wasn't screwed on. This time he forgot to get ingredients for the Duke's birthday cake.
translation: 진짜 웃긴 게, 그 요리사는 머리가 몸에 붙어 있지 않았으면 머리도 잊어버리고 다닐 사람이에요. 이번엔 Duke(공작)님 생일 케이크 재료 구해 오는 걸 깜빡했대요.

english: Perhaps you could help him? You will probably find him in the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 가서 도와주시는 게 어때요? 아마 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 부엌에 있을 거예요.

english: Thank you. I shall go speak with him.
I have already helped the cook in Lumbridge.
Oh yes, so you have. I am sure the Duke will be pleased.
translation: 아, 그랬죠. 공작님이 분명 기뻐하실 거예요.

english: Tell me about the Duke's strange talisman.
translation: 공작님의 이상한 부적 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: Well the Duke of Lumbridge has found a strange talisman that no one seems to understand. Perhaps you could help him? You can probably find him upstairs in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: Duke of Lumbridge(럼브리지 공작)님이 아무도 이해하지 못하는 이상한 부적을 발견하셨대요. 가서 도와드리는 게 어때요? 아마 Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 위층에 계실 거예요.

english: Sounds mysterious. I may just do that. Thanks.
translation: 신비로운데요. 한번 가 볼지도 몰라요. 고마워요.

english: Yes, I have already solved the Rune mysteries.
translation: 네, Rune mysteries(룬의 비밀)은 이미 풀었어요.

english: Ah excellent. Thank you very much adventurer.
Tell me about Romeo and his girlfriend please.
translation: Romeo(로미오)랑 여자 친구 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: Romeo in Varrock needs help with finding his beloved Juliet, you may be able to help him out.
translation: Varrock(바록)의 Romeo(로미오)가 사랑하는 Juliet(줄리엣)을 찾는 데 도움이 필요하대요, 당신이 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Unless of course you manage to find Juliet first in which case she has probably lost Romeo.
translation: 물론 당신이 줄리엣을 먼저 찾아낸다면, 그땐 아마 줄리엣이 로미오를 잃어버린 거겠지만요.

english: Right, ok. Romeo is in Varrock?
Yes you can't miss him, he's wandering aimlessly in the square.
translation: 네, 못 찾을 리가 없어요. 광장에서 정처 없이 헤매고 있거든요.

english: Oh yes, I've already helped Romeo in the best possible way I can...
translation: 아, 네, 로미오는 제가 할 수 있는 최선의 방법으로 이미 도와줬어요...

english: Really?
Yup.
...How?
He thinks Juliet is dead...
Well.. ok.. well done... I think...
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill orientated?
translation: 저는 싸우는 쪽보단 생각하는 쪽이라서요, 스킬 관련된 건 없어요?

english: Skills play a big part when you want to progress in knowledge throughout Gielinor. I know of a few skill- related quests that can get you started.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)에서 지식을 쌓아 가려면 스킬이 큰 역할을 하죠. 시작하기 좋은 스킬 관련 퀘스트를 몇 개 알아요.

english: You may be able to help out Fred the farmer who is in need of someones crafting expertise.
translation: Fred the farmer(농부 프레드)를 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요. 누군가의 crafting(공예) 솜씨가 필요하대요.

english: Or, there's always Doric the dwarf who needs an errand running for him?
translation: 아니면 Doric(도릭)이라는 드워프도 있어요. 심부름해 줄 사람이 필요하대요.

english: Tell me about Fred the farmer please.
translation: Fred the farmer(농부 프레드) 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: You can find Fred next to the field of sheep in Lumbridge. Perhaps you should go and speak with him.
translation: 프레드는 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 있는 양 목장 옆에서 찾을 수 있어요. 가서 이야기해 보시는 게 어때요?

english: Thanks, maybe I will.
I have already helped Fred the farmer. I sheared his sheep and made 20 balls of wool for him.
translation: Fred the farmer(농부 프레드)는 이미 도와줬어요. 양털을 깎아서 balls of wool(양털 뭉치) 20개를 만들어 드렸죠.

english: He wouldn't let me kill his chickens though.
Lumbridge chickens do make good target practice.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 닭은 표적 연습용으로 딱 좋긴 하죠.

english: You will have to wait until he isn't looking.
translation: 그 사람이 안 볼 때까지 기다려야 할 거예요.

english: Tell me about Doric the dwarf.
Doric the dwarf is located north of Falador. He might be able to help you with smithing. You should speak to him. He may let you use his anvils.
translation: Doric(도릭)이라는 드워프는 Falador(팔라도르) 북쪽에 있어요. smithing(대장일)을 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요. 가서 이야기해 보세요. 그의 anvils(모루)를 쓰게 해 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Yes, I've been to see Doric already. He was happy to let me use his anvils after I ran a small errand for him.
translation: 네, 도릭은 이미 만나 봤어요. 간단한 심부름을 해 드렸더니 기꺼이 모루를 쓰게 해 주셨어요.

english: Oh good, Thank you [player name]!
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 이것저것 다 해 보고 싶은데, 그런 거 아는 거 있어요?

english: Of course I do. Gielinor is a huge place you know, now let me think...
translation: 물론 알죠. Gielinor(길리노르)는 엄청 넓은 곳이잖아요, 자, 생각 좀 해 볼게요...

english: Hetty the witch in Rimmington might be able to offer help in the ways of magical abilities..
translation: Rimmington(림밍턴)에 사는 마녀 Hetty(헤티)라면 마법 능력 쪽으로 도움을 줄지도 몰라요..

english: Also, pirates are currently docked in Port Sarim, Where pirates are, treasure is never far away...
translation: 그리고 지금 Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 해적들이 정박해 있어요. 해적이 있는 곳엔 보물도 멀지 않은 법이죠...

english: Or you could go help out Ernest who got lost in Draynor Manor, spooky place that.
translation: 아니면 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택)에서 길을 잃은 Ernest(어니스트)를 도와줄 수도 있어요. 으스스한 곳이죠, 거기.

english: Tell me about Hetty the witch.

Hetty the witch can be found in Rimmington, south of Falador. She's currently working on some new potions. Perhaps you could give her a hand? She might be able to offer help with your magical abilities.
translation: 마녀 Hetty(헤티)는 Falador(팔라도르) 남쪽의 Rimmington(림밍턴)에 있어요. 지금 새 potions(물약)을 연구하고 있대요. 좀 도와주시는 게 어때요? 그녀가 당신의 마법 능력에 도움을 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Ok thanks, let's hope she doesn't turn me into a potato or something..
translation: 알았어요, 고마워요. 저를 감자 같은 걸로 바꿔 버리지 않기를 바라야겠네요..

english: Yes, I have already been to see Hetty, she gave me super cosmic powers after I helped out with her potion! I could probably destroy you with a single thought!
translation: 네, 헤티는 이미 만나 봤어요. 물약 만드는 걸 도와줬더니 초우주적인 힘을 주셨죠! 생각 하나만으로도 당신을 날려 버릴 수 있을걸요!

english: Did she really?
No not really...
Right.....
Tell me about Pirate's Treasure.
translation: Pirate's Treasure(해적의 보물) 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: RedBeard Frank in Port Sarim's bar, the Rusty Anchor, might be able to tell you about the rumored treasure that is buried somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 술집 Rusty Anchor(녹슨 닻)에 있는 RedBeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)라면 Gielinor(길리노르) 어딘가에 묻혀 있다는 소문의 보물에 대해 알려 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Sounds adventurous, I may have to check that out. Thank you.
translation: 모험 냄새가 나네요, 한번 알아봐야겠어요. 고마워요.

english: Yarr! I already found the booty!
Yarr indeed my friend. A most excellent find.
translation: 그야말로 야르네요, 친구. 정말 대단한 발견이에요.

english: Yarr!
Yarrr!
YARRR!
Right, that's enough of that!
..Sorry.
Tell me about Ernest please.
The best place to start would be at the gate to Draynor Manor. There you will find Veronica who will be able to tell you more.
translation: Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 대문에서 시작하는 게 제일 좋을 거예요. 거기 가면 Veronica(베로니카)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 거예요.

english: I suggest you tread carefully in that place; it's haunted.
Sounds like fun. I've never been to a Haunted Manor before.
translation: 재밌겠네요. 유령 나오는 저택엔 한 번도 안 가 봤어요.

english: Yeah, I found Ernest already. Professor Oddenstein had turned him into a chicken!
translation: 네, 어니스트는 이미 찾았어요. Professor Oddenstein(오든스타인 교수)가 그를 닭으로 바꿔 놨더라고요!

english: A chicken!?
Yeah a chicken. It could have been worse though.
translation: 네, 닭이요. 그래도 더 나빴을 수도 있었죠.

english: Very true, poor guy.
translation: 맞는 말이에요. 참 안됐네요, 그 사람.

english: Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 머리 스타일은 어디서 할 수 있어요?

english: Yes, it does look like you need a hairdresser.
Oh thanks!
No problem. The hairdresser in Falador will probably be able to sort you out.
translation: 천만에요. Falador(팔라도르)에 있는 미용사라면 아마 해결해 줄 거예요.

english: The Lumbridge general store sells useful maps if you don't know the way.
translation: 길을 모르면 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 잡화점에서 쓸 만한 지도를 팔아요.

english: What's up?
I assume the sky is up..
translation: 별이요? 하늘에 떠 있을 것 같은데요..

english: You assume?
Yeah, unfortunately I don't seem to be able to look up.
translation: 네, 안타깝게도 제가 위를 올려다볼 수가 없거든요.

english: Can I buy your stick?
It's not a stick! I'll have you know it's a very powerful staff!
translation: 막대기가 아니에요! 이건 아주 강력한 지팡이라고요!

english: Really? Show me what it can do!
translation: 정말요? 뭘 할 수 있는지 보여 주세요!

english: Um..It's a bit low on power at the moment..
It's a stick isn't it?
...Ok it's a stick.. But only while I save up for a staff. Zaff in Varrock square sells them in his shop.
translation: ...네, 막대기예요.. 하지만 지팡이 살 돈을 모을 때까지만이에요. Varrock(바록) 광장에 있는 Zaff(자프)네 가게에서 팔거든요.

english: Well good luck with that.
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 저한테 줄 만한 값진 물건 있어요?

english: Are you asking for free stuff?
Well... er... yes.
No I do not have anything I can give you. If I did have anything of value I wouldn't want to give it away.
translation: 아뇨, 드릴 수 있는 건 아무것도 없어요. 값진 게 있다 해도 남한테 주고 싶진 않을 거예요.

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
No it's not!
No you're right. I have nothing to back that up.
Fool! Leave me alone!
Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 성 지하실에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아요?

english: I heard the wall collapsed or something. I don't know why. Perhaps you could get to the bottom of this mystery!
translation: 벽이 무너졌다든가 그런 얘기를 들었어요. 이유는 몰라요. 당신이 이 수수께끼의 진상을 파헤쳐 보는 건 어때요!

english: Where am I?
How are you today?
Do you know of any quests I can do?
translation: 제가 할 만한 퀘스트 아는 거 있어요?

english: Your shoe lace is untied.
Are there any quests I can do here?
I fancy a bit of a fight, anything dangerous?
translation: 좀 싸워 보고 싶은데, 위험한 거 없어요?

english: Big scary demons!
Vampyres!
Small.. something small would be good.
Maybe another time.
Something easy please, I'm new here.
The Lumbridge cook.
The Duke's strange talisman.
Romeo and his girlfriend.
I'm a thinker rather than fighter, anything skill oriented?
translation: 저는 싸우는 쪽보단 생각하는 쪽이라서요, 스킬 관련된 건 없어요?

english: Fred the farmer.
Doric the dwarf.
I want to do all kinds of things, do you know of anything like that?
translation: 이것저것 다 해 보고 싶은데, 그런 거 아는 거 있어요?

english: Hetty the Witch.
Pirate's treasure.
Ernest and Draynor Manor.
Where can I get a haircut like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 머리 스타일은 어디서 할 수 있어요?

english: What's up?
Can I buy your stick?
Do you have anything of value which I can have?
translation: 저한테 줄 만한 값진 물건 있어요?

english: Do you know what happened in the castle cellar?
translation: 성 지하실에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아요?

english: I insured your Hitpoints XP up to level [level]. But now there's no more need for that, would you like a refund? It's [amount] coins.
translation: 손님의 Hitpoints(체력) 경험치를 레벨 [level]까지 보험으로 보장해 드렸지요. 하지만 이제 그럴 필요가 없어졌으니, 환불해 드릴까요? [amount] 코인입니다.

english: Yes, give me back my [amount] coins
No, you can hold onto that for me.
Alright. I don't pay interest, though!
I used to sell life insurance, protecting people's Hitpoints XP when they died. Now there's no more need for that, so I'm just giving refunds now. But I don't think I owe you anything.
translation: 예전에는 생명 보험을 팔았습니다. 사람들이 죽을 때 Hitpoints(체력) 경험치를 지켜 주는 보험이었지요. 이제는 그럴 필요가 없어서 환불만 해 드리고 있습니다. 하지만 손님께 드릴 돈은 없는 것 같군요.

english: Death is everywhere! At any moment, a band of brigands might rush in and kill you, or your closest friend might stab you in the back. Welcome to Gelin's Life Insurance Brokerage.
translation: 죽음은 어디에나 있습니다! 언제라도 산적 떼가 들이닥쳐 당신을 죽일 수도, 가장 가까운 친구가 등에 칼을 꽂을 수도 있지요. Gelin(겔린) 생명 보험 중개소에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.
translation: 죽으면 Hitpoints(체력) 경험치를 잃어 체력 레벨이 떨어질 수 있습니다. 저는 체력 레벨이 일정 레벨 아래로 떨어지지 않도록 막아 주는 보험 서비스를 제공합니다.

english: I see you're insured up to level 25 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 25.
translation: 보아하니 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 25까지 보험에 드셨군요. 죽어서 체력 경험치를 잃더라도 레벨 25 아래로는 절대 떨어지지 않습니다.

english: I see you're insured up to level 50 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 50.
translation: 보아하니 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 50까지 보험에 드셨군요. 죽어서 체력 경험치를 잃더라도 레벨 50 아래로는 절대 떨어지지 않습니다.

english: I see you're insured up to level 75 Hitpoints - if you lose Hitpoints XP on death, you will never drop below level 75. That's the highest level of insurance I offer.
translation: 보아하니 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 75까지 보험에 드셨군요. 죽어서 체력 경험치를 잃더라도 레벨 75 아래로는 절대 떨어지지 않습니다. 제가 제공하는 가장 높은 등급의 보험입니다.

english: Can I buy life insurance?
You must have a Hitpoints level of 25 before you may insure yourself.
translation: 보험에 가입하시려면 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨이 25는 되어야 합니다.

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 50 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: 그 레벨까지 보험에 가입하시려면 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨이 50은 되어야 합니다.

english: You must have a Hitpoints level of 75 before you may insure yourself to that level.
translation: 그 레벨까지 보험에 가입하시려면 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨이 75는 되어야 합니다.

english: I can insure you up to level 75 Hitpoints, so that your Hitpoints level will never decrease below that. This service costs 1,000,000 coins.
translation: Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 75까지 보험을 들어 드릴 수 있습니다. 그러면 체력 레벨이 절대 그 아래로 떨어지지 않지요. 이 서비스는 1,000,000 코인입니다.

english: Alternatively, I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints. That service costs only 100,000 coins.
translation: 아니면 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 50까지 보험을 들어 드릴 수도 있습니다. 이 서비스는 100,000 코인밖에 안 합니다.

english: Finally, I can insure you up to level 25 Hitpoints. That service costs only 25,000 coins.
translation: 마지막으로, Hitpoints(체력) 레벨 25까지 보험을 들어 드릴 수 있습니다. 이 서비스는 25,000 코인밖에 안 합니다.

english: I can't afford any of those options.
translation: 어느 쪽도 감당할 형편이 안 돼요.

english: Insure me to level 75 for 1,000,000 coins.
Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 75 when you are defeated in future.
translation: 감사합니다. 앞으로 쓰러지셔도 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨이 75 아래로 떨어지는 일은 절대 없을 겁니다.

english: Insure me to level 25 for 25,000 coins.
Thank you. Your Hitpoints level will never decrease below 25 when you are defeated in future.
translation: 감사합니다. 앞으로 쓰러지셔도 Hitpoints(체력) 레벨이 25 아래로 떨어지는 일은 절대 없을 겁니다.

english: Not now, thank you.
