english: Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
translation: 자, 이제 첫 번째 교관을 만나러 갈 시간이에요!

english: Welcome back. You have already learnt the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
translation: 다시 오셨군요. 이 세계에서 성공하는 데 필요한 첫 번째는 벌써 배우셨어요. 바로 다른 사람과 이야기하는 거죠!

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By clicking on them, you can talk to them.
translation: 이 세계의 많은 주민들이 쓸모 있는 이야기를 해 줄 거예요. 그 사람들을 클릭하면 대화할 수 있어요.

english: To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!
translation: 튜토리얼을 계속하려면 저기 저 문으로 나가서 첫 번째 교관과 이야기해 보세요!

english: I've played in the past, but not recently.
translation: 예전에 해 봤지만 최근엔 안 했어요.

english: I am an experienced player.
I am brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 완전 처음이에요! 여기 처음 와 봐요.

english: Hello, Gilbert!
Hey, [player name]!
Can I have a flower crown?
translation: flower crown(꽃 왕관) 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Of course you can. I'll even give you a lovely rainbow scarf to go with it!
translation: 물론이죠. 거기에 어울리는 예쁜 rainbow scarf(무지개 스카프)도 드릴게요!

english: There you go.
Thank you, I'll wear them with Pride!
Can I have a rainbow jumper?
translation: rainbow jumper(무지개 점퍼) 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Of course you can. There's a couple of extra gifts that I can tell Diango to prepare for you too.
translation: 물론이죠. Diango(디앙고)에게 당신 몫으로 준비해 달라고 할 수 있는 선물이 두어 개 더 있어요.

english: Can't you give me them all here?
Unfortunately Love is a bit... Precious about how I handle her things.
translation: 안타깝게도 Love(러브)는 자기 물건을 제가 다루는 데 좀... 깐깐하거든요.

english: Thank you, I'll wear it with Pride!
The meadow is looking lovely!
I know! It didn't always look like this though. It used to be dull and grey!
translation: 그렇죠! 그런데 처음부터 이랬던 건 아니에요. 예전엔 칙칙한 잿빛이었거든요!

english: Dull and grey? How did it become so colourful?
An adventurer came along and helped me out. We cast a magic spell using flower seeds, and it created this lovely sunburst!
translation: 어떤 모험가가 와서 저를 도와줬어요. 꽃 씨앗으로 마법을 걸었더니 이렇게 예쁜 햇살 무늬가 생겨났죠!

english: Oh, I'd have liked to have seen that spell. It sounds impressive!
translation: 아, 그 주문 저도 보고 싶었어요. 정말 굉장했겠네요!

english: It was! The news travelled far. I've been getting lots of visitors. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 굉장했죠! 소문이 멀리까지 퍼져서 손님이 정말 많이 오고 있어요. 온 나라의 꽃 상인들이 이 초원을 찾아왔답니다.

english: I know! Thank you again for your help with it. It fills me with happiness to see so much colour.
translation: 그렇죠! 그때 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요. 이렇게 많은 색을 보면 행복이 가득 차오른답니다.

english: I've been getting lots of visitors too. Many flower traders from across the lands have paid the meadow a visit.
translation: 손님도 정말 많이 오고 있어요. 온 나라의 꽃 상인들이 이 초원을 찾아왔답니다.

english: I've even traded with a few for some new flower seeds with different colours!
translation: 몇몇 상인과는 색깔이 다른 새 꽃 씨앗을 교환하기도 했어요!

english: That's really cool. What do you do with all the flowers?
translation: 정말 멋지네요. 그 꽃들은 다 어디에 쓰세요?

english: I make flower crowns in many different colours. I'm wearing one right now!
translation: 여러 가지 색깔의 꽃 왕관을 만들어요. 지금 저도 하나 쓰고 있죠!

english: Sounds very colourful!
You're welcome to have one if you'd like, just come back and ask me, anytime!
translation: 원한다면 하나 가져가도 돼요. 언제든 다시 와서 말만 하세요!

english: Thank you. I might do just that!
New flower seeds? What types?
Well as you may have noticed, you can change the colours of the flowers on your flower crown now!
translation: 음, 눈치챘을지도 모르지만, 이제 flower crown(꽃 왕관)의 꽃 색깔을 바꿀 수 있어요!

english: Turns out the spell we cast was more powerful than we first thought.
translation: 알고 보니 우리가 건 주문이 생각했던 것보다 훨씬 강력했더라고요.

english: So powerful that it made eight new colourations, all as beautiful as the first!
translation: 얼마나 강력했는지 새로운 색 조합이 여덟 가지나 생겼어요. 하나같이 처음 것만큼 아름답죠!

english: That's amazing! And all because we wanted a little splash of colour.
translation: 정말 놀랍네요! 그것도 그저 색깔 한 방울을 바랐을 뿐인데요.

english: Don't underestimate the power of a little splash of colour!
translation: 색깔 한 방울의 힘을 얕보면 안 돼요!

english: I'll make sure not too!
Anything happening around here?
Lots of things! It's been pretty busy. There was even a huge colourful parade with thousands of people, and they chose this meadow as the starting place!
translation: 많죠! 꽤 바빴어요. 수천 명이 참가한 거대하고 화려한 퍼레이드도 있었는데, 그 출발점으로 이 초원을 골랐지 뭐예요!

english: I know, I was there!
You were? I didn't see you!
It was super crowded. I was the one in the colourful outfit.
translation: 엄청 붐볐으니까요. 저는 알록달록한 옷을 입고 있던 사람이었어요.

english: The one in the colourful outfit...?
Ah, yes, like everybody else. I forgot, we were all in colourful outfits!
translation: 아, 맞다, 다른 사람들도 다 그랬죠. 깜빡했네요, 우리 모두 알록달록한 옷을 입고 있었죠!

english: Yes! Did you have a good time?
I did thank you. It was really nice to see so many adventurers coming together to bring a splash of colour to Gielinor.
translation: 네, 고마워요. 그렇게 많은 모험가가 모여서 Gielinor(길리노르)에 색깔 한 방울을 더하는 걸 보니 정말 좋았어요.

english: It truly was, and so many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 정말 그랬죠. 꽃 왕관도 엄청 많았고요! 잔뜩 만들어 둔 게 남아돌까 봐 좀 걱정했는데, 결국 거의 동날 뻔했어요!

english: Sounds like a nice problem to have! Will you be making more for the next parade they do?
translation: 그런 문제라면 행복한 고민이네요! 다음 퍼레이드 때 쓸 것도 더 만드실 거예요?

english: The next parade?
Yes, I'm sure they'll do another one. If so many people turned up, it must have been a great success. Why wouldn't they want to do it again?
translation: 네, 분명 또 할 거예요. 그렇게 많은 사람이 왔으면 대성공이었을 테니까요. 다시 안 할 이유가 없잖아요?

english: That is a good point. I'll get to making some more right away.
translation: 좋은 지적이네요. 당장 더 만들기 시작해야겠어요.

english: Maybe it'll become a yearly thing. A chance to show off some colour, and of course your fancy flower crowns, to all of Gielinor!
translation: 어쩌면 매년 하는 행사가 될지도 몰라요. Gielinor(길리노르) 모두에게 색깔을, 그리고 물론 당신의 멋진 꽃 왕관을 뽐낼 기회죠!

english: Sounds good to me, gives me time to get lots made in advance.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 미리 잔뜩 만들어 둘 시간도 생기겠네요.

english: Right, well I clearly have work to be getting on with. See you soon!
translation: 자, 그럼 저는 이만 일을 시작해야겠네요. 또 봐요!

english: See you!
Really? That's cool! What made it colourful?
Everyone turned up in colourful outfits, it was like a sea of rainbows.
translation: 다들 알록달록한 옷을 입고 와서 무지개 바다 같았어요.

english: So many flower crowns too! I was a bit worried the large pile I'd made of them would go to waste, but in the end I almost ran out!
translation: 꽃 왕관도 엄청 많았고요! 잔뜩 만들어 둔 게 남아돌까 봐 좀 걱정했는데, 결국 거의 동날 뻔했어요!

english: Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 제가 받을 수 있는 무지개 아이템이 있나요?

english: Absolutely! I have a jumper, flower crown, and scarf for you. Which would you like?
translation: 물론이죠! 점퍼, 꽃 왕관, 스카프가 있어요. 어떤 걸로 할래요?

english: Oh, you appear to already have one of those.
translation: 아, 그건 이미 하나 갖고 있는 것 같네요.

english: You should have all of the previous rainbow items now!
translation: 이제 이전 무지개 아이템은 전부 갖고 있을 거예요!

english: Can I have a flower crown?
translation: flower crown(꽃 왕관) 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have a rainbow jumper?
translation: rainbow jumper(무지개 점퍼) 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: The meadow is looking lovely!
Sounds very colourful!
Anything happening around here?
I know, I was there!
Really? That is cool!
Do you have any rainbow items I can claim?
translation: 제가 받을 수 있는 무지개 아이템이 있나요?

english: Jumper
Flower Crown
Scarf
All of them
Hello, chap! Gilbert's the name. How may I help?
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구! 제 이름은 Gilbert(길버트)예요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Hey Gilbert, I'm [player name]! I couldn't help but notice that rainbow near you. Where did it come from?
translation: 안녕하세요 Gilbert(길버트), 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요! 근처에 있는 저 무지개가 눈에 띄어서요. 저건 어디서 온 거예요?

english: 'Tis strange, isn't it [player name]? They appear almost anywhere in the world, I couldn't say where it came from... That being said, rainbows certainly are beautiful and aren't afraid to show their colours to the world! They fill me with such pride.
translation: 참 신기하죠, [player name]님? 무지개는 세상 거의 어디에나 나타나서, 어디서 왔는지는 저도 모르겠어요... 그래도 무지개는 정말 아름답고, 자기 색깔을 세상에 드러내길 두려워하지 않죠! 그걸 보면 가슴이 자부심으로 벅차올라요.

english: 'Tis upsetting though. I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need... All of my clothing is plain.
translation: 그래도 속상하긴 해요. 저도 늘 무지개처럼 제 색깔을 드러내고 싶었는데, 필요한 재료를 도무지 구할 수가 없거든요... 제 옷은 전부 수수하기만 해요.

english: You know, I've never thought about it like that!
Maybe I could help in some way?
translation: 제가 어떻게든 도울 수 있지 않을까요?

english: I'm not sure how much you know about rainbows, but they have a lot of colours to show! They also have a lot of colours to share.
translation: 무지개에 대해 얼마나 아는지 모르겠지만, 무지개는 보여 줄 색깔이 정말 많아요! 나눠 줄 색깔도 많고요.

english: Sadly, some of those colours are in short supply so I'd feel bad asking you to take those.
translation: 안타깝게도 그중 몇몇 색깔은 귀해서, 그걸 가져와 달라고 부탁하기는 미안해요.

english: There's six colours that are in higher supply though: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
translation: 그래도 비교적 넉넉한 색깔이 여섯 가지 있어요. 빨강, 주황, 노랑, 초록, 파랑, 보라예요.

english: I can sense where rainbows are with extra strands of each of these colours...
translation: 저는 이 색깔들의 여분 실이 있는 무지개가 어디 있는지 느낄 수 있어요...

english: Could you find them for me, and take some of their spare colour?
translation: 그 무지개들을 찾아서 남는 색깔을 좀 가져다줄 수 있어요?

english: Sounds fun!
Now then, [player name] - Have you got any questions for me?
translation: 자, [player name]님 - 저한테 궁금한 거 있어요?

english: What am I doing, again?
Well, I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need myself.
translation: 음, 저는 늘 무지개처럼 제 색깔을 드러내고 싶었는데, 필요한 재료를 저 혼자서는 도무지 구할 수가 없거든요.

english: I'm able to sense the location of these rainbows in my mind, but it's always a little hazy. Feel free to ask me to sense a rainbow with extra strands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue or purple!
translation: 저는 마음속으로 이 무지개들의 위치를 느낄 수 있지만, 늘 조금 흐릿해요. 빨강, 주황, 노랑, 초록, 파랑, 보라 중 여분 실이 있는 무지개를 느껴 달라고 언제든 부탁하세요!

english: Why am I only gathering six colours?
translation: 왜 여섯 가지 색깔만 모으는 거예요?

english: Well we don't want to take all of the colour from the rainbows! Some have extra strands of certain colours, and those are the ones I'll direct you towards...
translation: 음, 무지개에서 색깔을 전부 빼앗고 싶진 않으니까요! 어떤 무지개는 특정 색깔의 실이 남아도는데, 제가 안내할 건 바로 그런 무지개들이에요...

english: But rainbows have so many colours! Surely there's some with other colours spare?
translation: 하지만 무지개는 색깔이 정말 많잖아요! 다른 색깔이 남아도는 무지개도 분명 있을 텐데요?

english: Some colours are in such short supply for every rainbow. Besides, it's the thought that counts! Even displaying a small selection of colours to others makes them feel comfortable showing theirs!
translation: 어떤 색깔은 어느 무지개에서나 정말 귀하거든요. 게다가 중요한 건 마음이잖아요! 몇 가지 색깔만 보여 줘도 다른 사람들이 자기 색깔을 편하게 드러낼 수 있게 돼요!

english: I never thought of it like that... Thanks Gilbert!
translation: 그렇게는 생각 못 했어요... 고마워요 Gilbert(길버트)!

english: Anytime, [player name]! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 언제든지요, [player name]님! 자, 또 도와드릴 일 있어요?

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra red strands?
translation: 빨간 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: I can see it...
South of my magical location, I see life! New adventurers and baldness rife.
translation: 내 마법 같은 자리 남쪽에, 생명이 보이네! 새내기 모험가와 대머리가 넘쳐나는 곳이네.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra orange strands?
translation: 주황 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: Beside me now, a person of healing. Those who test their luck, find this place appealing.
translation: 지금 내 곁에는, 치유하는 이가 있네. 운을 시험하는 이들이, 이곳을 좋아하네.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra yellow strands?
translation: 노란 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: On my face; shining sunlight. South of a dwarf whom redberries delight.
translation: 내 얼굴엔, 햇살이 비치네. redberries(레드베리)를 즐기는 드워프의 남쪽이라네.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra green strands?
translation: 초록 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: Lush nature and trees are to the east. The Green strand... no orange! No, blue! No, red! Green! Argh! There's so much bickering in this area it's hard to pinpoint its location... Sorry, [player name]!
translation: 울창한 자연과 나무가 동쪽에 있네. 초록 실은... 아니, 주황! 아니, 파랑! 아니, 빨강! 초록! 으악! 이 동네는 말다툼이 너무 심해서 위치를 콕 짚기가 어려워요... 미안해요, [player name]님!

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra blue strands?
translation: 파란 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: In this area, there's a silent and artistic harmony... Ironically, north west, wizards kill newcomers effortlessly.
translation: 이 지역엔, 고요하고 예술적인 하모니가 있네... 아이러니하게도 북서쪽에선, 마법사들이 새내기를 손쉽게 쓰러뜨리네.

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra purple strands?
translation: 보라 실이 남는 무지개를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: The knights in this area, are full of Saradomin's spirit. On the top of this fortress, when I yell - all hear it!
translation: 이 지역의 기사들은, Saradomin(사라도민)의 정신으로 가득하네. 이 요새 꼭대기에서 내가 외치면 - 모두가 듣네!

english: I'm not someone who needs to show my colours...
translation: 저는 굳이 제 색깔을 드러낼 필요가 없는 사람이라서요...

english: Oh, that is most upsetting.
Sometimes just showing your own colours makes other people comfortable showing theirs, you know?
translation: 가끔은 자기 색깔을 드러내는 것만으로도 다른 사람들이 편하게 자기 색깔을 드러낼 수 있게 되거든요, 알죠?

english: This rainbow has no spare colour to take. Gilbert may know where to find one with spare colour strands.
translation: 이 무지개에는 가져갈 여분의 색깔이 없다. Gilbert(길버트)가 여분 색깔 실이 있는 무지개를 알지도 모른다.

english: You take a spare Red strand from the rainbow.
You take a spare Orange strand from the rainbow.
You take a spare Yellow strand from the rainbow.
You take a spare Green strand from the rainbow.
You take a spare Blue strand from the rainbow.
You already have an Blue strand from this rainbow. Perhaps give Gilbert the strand, or look for the other rainbows?
translation: 이 무지개에서 이미 파란 실을 가져갔다. Gilbert(길버트)에게 실을 주거나, 다른 무지개를 찾아보는 게 어떨까?

english: You take a spare Purple strand from the rainbow.
I still need to give Gilbert a red rainbow strand.
translation: 아직 Gilbert(길버트)에게 red rainbow strand(빨간 무지개 실)을 줘야 해.

english: I still need to give Gilbert an orange rainbow strand.
translation: 아직 Gilbert(길버트)에게 orange rainbow strand(주황 무지개 실)을 줘야 해.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a Green rainbow strand.
translation: 아직 Gilbert(길버트)에게 Green rainbow strand(초록 무지개 실)을 줘야 해.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a blue rainbow strand.
translation: 아직 Gilbert(길버트)에게 blue rainbow strand(파란 무지개 실)을 줘야 해.

english: I still need to give Gilbert a purple rainbow strand.
translation: 아직 Gilbert(길버트)에게 purple rainbow strand(보라 무지개 실)을 줘야 해.

english: [Player name], that's all of them! All six rainbow strands!
translation: [Player name]님, 이걸로 전부예요! 무지개 실 여섯 가닥 전부요!

english: I can't thank you enough!
No problem at all, Gilbert! Always happy to help. What exactly are you going to make with all those strands, anyway?
translation: 천만에요, Gilbert(길버트)! 도울 수 있어서 언제나 기뻐요. 그런데 그 실들로 정확히 뭘 만들 거예요?

english: You know, [player name]. All this time I've been wanting to show my colours like a rainbow and you've made me realise something...
translation: 있잖아요, [player name]님. 저는 지금까지 무지개처럼 제 색깔을 드러내고 싶어 했는데, 당신 덕분에 깨달은 게 있어요...

english: What you've made me realise, [player name], is that people like yourself who are willing to support those who wish to show their own colours proudly...
translation: [player name]님이 깨닫게 해 준 건요, 자기 색깔을 당당하게 드러내고 싶어 하는 이들을 기꺼이 응원해 주는 당신 같은 사람들이...

english: You're the reason I feel confident showing my colours! I want you to have this - you deserve it.
translation: 제가 자신 있게 제 색깔을 드러낼 수 있는 이유라는 거예요! 이걸 받아 줬으면 해요 - 당신은 받을 자격이 있어요.

english: Thank you so much for the scarf, Gilbert. It's wonderful!
translation: 스카프 정말 고마워요, Gilbert(길버트). 정말 멋져요!

english: It's no problem at all, [player name]. I added a little heart on the item to show my personal thanks. Thank you for your help! Wear it with pride, and let everyone know to show their own colours proudly!
translation: 별말씀을요, [player name]님. 제 마음을 담아 아이템에 작은 하트를 달아 뒀어요. 도와줘서 고마워요! 자부심을 갖고 두르세요, 그리고 모두에게 자기 색깔을 당당히 드러내라고 알려 주세요!

english: I will! Take care.
yellow
Say nothing.
I've never thought about it like that!
Maybe I could help in some way?
translation: 제가 어떻게든 도울 수 있지 않을까요?

english: Sounds fun!
What am I doing, again?
Why am I only gathering six colours?
translation: 왜 여섯 가지 색깔만 모으는 거예요?

english: Red rainbow strand hint.
translation: Red rainbow strand(빨간 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Orange rainbow strand hint.
translation: Orange rainbow strand(주황 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Other hints.
Yellow rainbow strand hint.
translation: Yellow rainbow strand(노란 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Green rainbow strand hint.
translation: Green rainbow strand(초록 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Blue rainbow strand hint.
translation: Blue rainbow strand(파란 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Purple rainbow strand hint.
translation: Purple rainbow strand(보라 무지개 실) 힌트.

english: Previous hints.
Not right now.
I'm not someone who needs to show my colours...
translation: 저는 굳이 제 색깔을 드러낼 필요가 없는 사람이라서요...

english: Sorry, let me think about it first.
translation: 미안해요, 먼저 생각 좀 해 볼게요.

english: I must be leaving now.
Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 미안하지만 [other player's display name]님과 얘기하려는데, [he/she] 저를 무시하는 것 같아요.

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
Talk to me, [player name]!
Hello, [player name], are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: 에헴... 안녕하세요 [player name]님, 저랑 얘기 좀 해 주세요!

english: Maybe later.
Hello, I'm Gillie the Milkmaid. What can I do for you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 저는 우유 짜는 아가씨 Gillie(길리)예요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Who are you?
My name is Gillie Groats. My father is a farmer and I milk the cows for him.
translation: 제 이름은 Gillie Groats(길리 그로츠)예요. 아버지가 농부라서 제가 아버지 대신 소젖을 짜고 있어요.

english: Do you have any buckets of milk spare?
translation: 남는 buckets of milk(우유 양동이) 있어요?

english: I'm afraid not. We need all of our milk to sell to market, but you can milk the cow yourself if you need the milk.
translation: 아쉽지만 없어요. 우유는 전부 시장에 내다 팔아야 하거든요. 그래도 우유가 필요하면 직접 소젖을 짜도 돼요.

english: Thanks.
So how do you milk a cow then?
It's very easy. First you need an empty bucket to hold the milk.
translation: 아주 쉬워요. 먼저 우유를 담을 empty bucket(빈 양동이)가 필요해요.

english: Then find a dairy cow to milk - you can't milk just any cow.
translation: 그다음 젖을 짤 dairy cow(젖소)를 찾으세요 - 아무 소에서나 젖을 짤 수 있는 건 아니거든요.

english: How do I find a dairy cow?
They are easy to spot - they are dark brown and white, unlike beef cows, which are light brown and white. We also tether them to a post to stop them wandering around all over the place.
translation: 쉽게 알아볼 수 있어요 - 젖소는 짙은 갈색과 흰색이고, 고기소는 연한 갈색과 흰색이에요. 그리고 여기저기 돌아다니지 못하게 말뚝에 묶어 두기도 하고요.

english: There are a couple very near, in this field.
translation: 바로 이 들판에 두어 마리 있어요.

english: Then just milk the cow and your bucket will fill with tasty, nutritious milk.
translation: 그다음 소젖을 짜기만 하면 양동이가 맛있고 영양 많은 우유로 가득 찰 거예요.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Tee hee! You've never milked a cow before, have you?
translation: 히히! 소젖 짜 본 적 한 번도 없죠?

english: Erm... No. How could you tell?
Because you're spilling milk all over the floor. What a waste! You need something to hold the milk.
translation: 우유를 바닥에 다 흘리고 있으니까요. 아까워라! 우유를 담을 게 필요해요.

english: Ah yes, I really should have guessed that one, shouldn't I?
translation: 아 그렇죠, 그건 진작 알았어야 했는데, 그렇죠?

english: You're from the city, aren't you... Try it again with an empty bucket.
translation: 도시에서 왔죠... empty bucket(빈 양동이)를 가지고 다시 해 보세요.

english: Right, I'll do that.
I should probably go somewhere that Gillie might actually see me.
translation: Gillie(길리)가 날 볼 수 있는 곳으로 가야겠어.

english: You hang the amulet on one of your branches and wait for Gillie to notice you...
translation: 당신은 자기 가지 하나에 amulet(아뮬렛)을 걸고 Gillie(길리)가 알아채기를 기다린다...

english: Oh my! That Christmas tree certainly did grow quickly.
translation: 어머나! 저 크리스마스 트리 정말 빨리도 자랐네.

english: And that necklace hanging on it! Is that...
translation: 게다가 저기 걸린 목걸이! 저건 설마...

english: Gillie gleefully takes the amulet off of the branch and hangs it around her own neck as a clone of her appears before your very eyes.
translation: Gillie(길리)는 신이 나서 나뭇가지에서 amulet(아뮬렛)을 벗겨 자기 목에 건다. 그러자 눈앞에 그녀의 분신이 나타난다.

english: Hey... You look just like me!
You are me! This is perfect!
Well, Gillie seems happy with that!
Who are you?
Can you tell me how to milk a cow?
translation: 소젖 짜는 법 좀 알려 줄래요?

english: Player: I'm fine, thanks.
Have ye come for an outfit like mine? Or else whatcha want?
translation: 내 것 같은 옷을 얻으러 왔나? 아니면 뭘 원하는 거지?

english: Who are you?
Don't ye recognise the greatest angler in all the land? Never mind Grandpa Jack an' Big Dave, or that jack- of-all-trades Mac - I'm Gita Prymes!
translation: 이 땅 최고의 낚시꾼도 몰라보는 거야? Grandpa Jack(잭 할아버지)나 Big Dave(빅 데이브), 그 만물박사 Mac(맥) 따윈 잊어 - 내가 바로 Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)다!

english: Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
translation: Hemenster(헤멘스터) 낚시 대회에서 우승한 적 있어요?

english: Um...
Keep yer triflin' talk of poxy contests - Gita Prymes has bigger fish to catch! And I am Gita Prymes.
translation: 시시한 대회 얘긴 집어치워 - Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)는 더 큰 물고기를 낚아야 한다고! 그리고 내가 기타 프라임스다.

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
That I be! Now, are ye here for an outfit like mine?
translation: 그렇고말고! 자, 내 것 같은 옷을 얻으러 온 거야?

english: Let's talk about outfits.
Aye. See, a lot of anglers wear ugly green stuff. It 'elps them wi' the fishing, to be sure, but they look so rotten in it. So Gita Prymes invented something better- looking.
translation: 그래. 봐, 낚시꾼들 대부분은 흉측한 초록색 옷을 입지. 낚시엔 도움이 되긴 해, 그건 확실해. 근데 입으면 영 볼품이 없단 말이야. 그래서 Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)가 더 근사한 걸 만들어 냈지.

english: It'll cost ye some spirit flakes but Gita Prymes can change yer Spirit Angler back to normal Angler for free if ye want it. Which ever suits ye.
translation: spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기)가 좀 들 거야. 그래도 원하면 Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)가 Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 옷을 일반 Angler(낚시꾼) 옷으로 공짜로 되돌려 주지. 마음에 드는 대로 해.

english: Can you turn my Angler outfit into the Spirit Angler outfit?
translation: 제 Angler(낚시꾼) 옷을 Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 옷으로 바꿔 줄 수 있어요?

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the regular Angler kit. I'll want 1,200 spirit flakes for a hat, the top for 1,200 spirit flakes, the leggings for 1,200 spirit flakes and the footwear for 1,200 spirit flakes.
translation: 물론이지, 일반 Angler(낚시꾼) 장비를 하나 건네줘. 모자는 spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기) 1,200개, 상의도 1,200개, 바지도 1,200개, 신발도 1,200개 받겠어.

english: Actually, I don't have any Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 사실 지금은 Angler(낚시꾼) 장비를 안 갖고 있어요, 미안해요.

english: Can you turn my Spirit Angler outfit back into the regular Angler outfit?
translation: 제 Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 옷을 다시 일반 Angler(낚시꾼) 옷으로 바꿔 줄 수 있어요?

english: Sure, hand me a piece of the Spirit Angler kit an' I'll convert it back for free.
translation: 물론이지, Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 장비를 하나 건네주면 공짜로 되돌려 주지.

english: Actually, I don't have any Spirit Angler kit on me at the moment, sorry.
translation: 사실 지금은 Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 장비를 안 갖고 있어요, 미안해요.

english: Gita Prymes can exchange your Spirit Angler kit for regular Angler kit, but will not return your spirit flakes. You can convert it back to the Spirit Angler version for free.
translation: Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)는 Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 장비를 일반 Angler(낚시꾼) 장비로 바꿔 주지만, spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기)는 돌려주지 않는다. 다시 영혼 낚시꾼 버전으로는 무료로 바꿀 수 있다.

english: I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 당신한테 필요한 건 없는 것 같아요.

english: Nay, Gita Prymes won't take that.
translation: 어림없지, Gita Prymes(기타 프라임스)는 그런 말 안 받아들여.

english: Who are you?
Have you won the Hemenster Fishing Competition?
translation: Hemenster(헤멘스터) 낚시 대회에서 우승한 적 있어요?

english: Okay, you're Gita Prymes.
Let's talk about outfits.
Ask about the Spirit Angler outfit.
translation: Spirit Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 옷에 대해 묻는다.

english: Cancel
Proceed
Ask about the regular Angler outfit.
I don't think I need anything from you.
translation: 당신한테 필요한 건 없는 것 같아요.

english: Hi.
What brings you down here, Rookie?
I heard all the grunting and metal clanging. I wanted to see what was going on.
translation: 끙끙대는 소리랑 쇠 부딪히는 소리가 들려서요. 무슨 일인지 보러 왔어요.

english: What do you think of our training area?
Well... It smells a bit.
That is the smell of courage.
Hello there.
Greetings, Rookie.
You lot sure look busy down here.
translation: 여기 계신 분들 다 엄청 바빠 보이네요.

english: We strive to become the best.
Well best of luck!
Hello.
Hello, Rookie. You'll have to excuse me. I'm keeping an eye on the other contenders.
translation: 안녕, 신참. 미안하지만 난 다른 도전자들을 지켜보는 중이라서.

english: May the odds be ever in your favour.
What a nice thing to say.
You're not tired of doing that all day?
I'm going to slay anything in my path!
translation: 내 앞을 막는 건 뭐든 베어 버릴 거다!

english: You certainly are determined!
Hi there.
Stand back, Rookie. I need to concentrate.
You seemed to have that weapon mastered.
translation: 그 무기는 완전히 손에 익으신 것 같네요.

english: Kill...
No...
... survivors!
That's impressive. I'll leave you to it.
Can't talk... I've got 100 more to do.
translation: 말 못 해... 아직 100개 더 남았다.

english: Good luck.
Hel-
Can't you see I'm busy here?
Of course... Enjoy your floor pushing.
translation: 물론 보이죠... 바닥 밀기 즐겁게 하세요.

english: Well met stranger, how do you come to be in this place?
translation: 반갑군, 낯선 양반. 어쩌다 이런 데까지 오게 됐지?

english: I'm a friend of the Easter Bunny, I've been looking for him.
translation: 저는 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)의 친구예요. 그를 찾고 있었어요.

english: Is that so? Well that makes you my friend too. Me and Rinder here helped that crazy priest track him down.
translation: 그래? 그럼 너도 내 친구로군. 나랑 여기 Rinder(린더)가 그 정신 나간 사제를 도와서 그 녀석을 찾아냈거든.

english: That we did.
I see, that was good of you.
I won't lie, it was no selfless act. We've been promised grand rewards.
translation: 거짓말은 안 하마, 순수한 선의로 한 일은 아니야. 큰 보상을 약속받았거든.

english: Eggs! Big chocolate eggs!
It always comes down to eggs!
I'd like to make some Easter Buns, I don't suppose you have any raisins?
translation: Easter Buns(부활절 빵)을 만들고 싶은데, 혹시 건포도 있으세요?

english: And why would you think a man like me would have any raisins?
translation: 나 같은 사내가 건포도를 갖고 있을 거라고 왜 생각했지?

english: I'm not sure, I don't actually know what raisins are to be honest.
translation: 잘 모르겠어요. 솔직히 건포도가 뭔지도 사실 몰라요.

english: Well I'll be! Kid, raisins are dried-up grapes.
translation: 허 참! 꼬마야, 건포도는 말린 포도란다.

english: Oh, well do you have any of those?
Not yet.
Not yet?
That's what I said.
As it happens I have a sackful of grapes in my possession.
translation: 마침 내가 포도를 한 자루 갖고 있거든.

english: How convenient, dare I ask why?
There are great and terrible beasts in this world kid. We'd been hunting them, and believe me when I tell ye, some of 'em had an awful lot of grapes on their person.
translation: 이 세상엔 크고 무시무시한 짐승들이 있단다, 꼬마야. 우린 그놈들을 사냥하고 다녔는데, 믿기 어렵겠지만 그중 몇 놈은 몸에 포도를 엄청나게 지니고 있더라고.

english: The slaughter was feverish. We'd cut 'em down and they'd rise up, again and again.
translation: 살육은 그야말로 광란이었지. 쓰러뜨리면 다시 일어나고, 또 일어나고, 또 일어났어.

english: Before we knew it, we'd collected a whole sackful o' grapes!
translation: 정신을 차리고 보니 포도가 한 자루 가득 모여 있더라고!

english: Seems to me we could make those into raisins, should that align with your intentions.
translation: 내 보기엔 그걸로 건포도를 만들 수 있을 것 같은데, 네 뜻과도 맞는다면 말이지.

english: What luck! Shall we then?
Well alright, it'll be a long journey though.
translation: 좋아, 그런데 먼 여정이 될 거야.

english: Rinder!
What say ye, Glanton?
Our friend here needs some raisins, let's head to the desert!
translation: 우리 친구가 건포도가 필요하대. 사막으로 가자고!

english: Pack yer grapes, then. Let's go.
Cutscene starts: "After a long walk, you reach the desert."
Here we are.
Here? This big rock?
This big rock is perfect fer makin' raisins, kid. It's real warm.
translation: 이 커다란 바위가 건포도 만들기엔 딱이란다, 꼬마야. 아주 따뜻하거든.

english: It's as he says kid, real warm.
translation: 이 친구 말대로야, 꼬마. 아주 따뜻해.

english: We'll leave the grapes here in good clean heat, give 'em time to think about their transgressions.
translation: 포도를 여기 깨끗한 열기 속에 놔두고, 저지른 죄를 반성할 시간을 주자고.

english: I don't remember this rock being here before.
translation: 전에는 여기 이 바위가 없었던 것 같은데요.

english: This rock was always here, before man was, even.
translation: 이 바위는 늘 여기 있었어. 인간이 나타나기도 전부터 말이지.

english: That you ain't noticed it speaks to yer purview of the world.
translation: 네가 눈치 못 챘다는 건 네 세상 보는 눈이 그만큼 좁다는 뜻이지.

english: I'm almost certain this is new.
translation: 이거 새로 생긴 게 거의 확실한데요.

english: Perhaps more things in this world exist without yer knowledge than with it. Did ye consider that?
translation: 어쩌면 이 세상엔 네가 아는 것보다 모르는 채로 존재하는 게 더 많을지도 몰라. 그런 생각은 해 봤나?

english: Well no, it's just a rock.
Alright alright already! Let's get these grapes going.
translation: 됐어, 됐어, 그만들 해! 이 포도 작업이나 시작하자고.

english: We'd best I suppose. Lay them down and see to their transformation.
Hmm, let's see...
I judge these grapes to be...
...Plump and juicy! But not fer long!
translation: ...통통하고 즙이 많군! 하지만 그것도 오래 못 가지!

english: We'll see them desiccated soon enough.
It is their destiny. A curse on these grapes!
[player name], You've gotta make the grapes feel bad or they won't shrivel up.
translation: [player name], 포도가 기분 나빠하게 만들어야 쪼그라든다고.

english: Oh I see, um, curse those grapes! Suffer you foolish berries! Ha!
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 어, 저주받아라, 포도들아! 고통받아라, 어리석은 베리들아! 하!

english: Now yer gettin' it!
Insufferable fruits! Rank orbs of low repute!
translation: 참을 수 없는 과일 놈들! 평판도 형편없는 썩은 구슬들!

english: You tell 'em what for!
Cutscene: "A long while later..."
Well look at these! Perfect!
They're a fine example of raisins I'll say.
Great! let's get back to the Rabbit Hole then.
Player is returned to the Rabbit Hole
Well that was interesting.
Yes it was, come back when ye have some space and I'll give ye yer share of raisins.
translation: 그래, 재미있었지. 소지품에 자리가 생기면 다시 와. 네 몫의 건포도를 줄 테니.

english: Yes it was. Here's some raisins for yer troubles.
translation: 그래, 재미있었지. 수고한 대가로 건포도 좀 받아라.

english: Thank you!
Can I have some raisins please?
I think ye have enough raisins at the moment.
Make some space for them and ye can have some more.
Of course, we've plenty to spare after that trip.
translation: 물론이지. 그 여행 덕분에 남아도는 게 건포도야.

english: Thanks!
Thanks for taking me to make raisins.
I was plenty happy to educate ye.
translation: 가르쳐 줄 수 있어서 나야말로 기뻤다.

english: I used those raisins to make some Easter Buns, and the Easter Bunny really enjoyed them!
translation: 그 건포도로 Easter Buns(부활절 빵)을 만들었는데, Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)가 정말 좋아했어요!

english: Well that's great, kid.
Thanks again for the help.
Any time. You owe me one.
Oh, I uh, suppose I do.
It won't catch on, Glanton.
translation: 그 말 유행 안 탈 거야, Glanton(글랜턴).

english: Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 에이, 그러지 마, Rinder(린더). 해 보기 전엔 모르는 거잖아?

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 자, 두 분, 여기서 뭐 하고 계세요?

english: I've had this great idea see.
Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 혹시 또 사막을 한참 걸어야 하는 일인가요?

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 음, 바로 그게 이 계획의 묘미지.

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 포도를 말리는 것보다 초콜릿을 녹이는 게 훨씬 쉽거든.

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 바로 그거야! 봐, Rinder(린더), [player name] 이 친구는 아직 반도 안 들었는데 벌써 끼고 싶어 하잖아!

english: It still seems terribly messy.
Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 자, 그러니까 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)와의 인맥을 이용해서 초콜릿을 잔뜩 구하는 거야.

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 그리고 부활절을 지켜 낸 제 엄청난 공로를 기려서 그걸 저한테 주는 거죠?

english: No.
And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 그리고 그걸 몽땅 녹여서 분수에 붓는 거지.

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 그럼 그걸 제가 다 먹어도 되는 거죠?

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 아니, 그다음엔 사람들한테 작은 과일 몇 개를 분수에 찍어 먹을 권리를 파는 거야!

english: That sounds delicious!
Yes.
But I can get some for free?
translation: 그래도 저는 공짜로 먹을 수 있죠?

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 봐 봐, 사람들이 초콜릿 한 입 맛보려고 내는 돈이 우리가 그걸 잔뜩 구하는 데 드는 돈보다 훨씬 많다니까.

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 음, 돈 내야 하면 전 관심 없어요.

english: I saved Easter...
... Again!
I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)한테 달걀이 더 있는지 가 봐야겠어요...

english: Be seeing you!
Here, look at my lovely gems.
translation: 여기 와서 제 아름다운 보석들 좀 보세요.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 나한테서 뭘 훔쳐 간 게 바로 너구나!

english: Guards guards!
Glod smash!
Glod bash!
Grind your bones!
Stupid clouds make Glod angry!
You wouldn't like Glod when Glod angry!
translation: 화난 Glod(글로드), 너 안 좋아할 거다!

english: Why everyone attack Glod?
Gods, give Glod strength!
Glod appears to have more Strength and Attack power than before!
translation: Glod(글로드)의 Strength(힘)과 Attack(공격) 능력이 전보다 강해진 것 같습니다!

english: Glod not die so easily!
Glod heals himself slightly.
GLOD SMASH!
Your prayer is drained by Glod's attack!
Flee, pesky mortal!
At Glod's cry you are forced to run away!
translation: Glod(글로드)의 고함에 어쩔 수 없이 달아납니다!

english: You puny human. Come to Glod!
You are enraged by Glod's taunts and forced to charge towards him to fight!
translation: Glod(글로드)의 도발에 격분해 어쩔 수 없이 그에게 달려들어 싸우게 됩니다!

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래 봤자 하나로밖에 안 쳐 줘요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 멋진 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 뭐든지요! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 풍경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello!
Hello there, [rank].
I've not seen you round these parts before.
Well I'm still fairly new here.
translation: 네, 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐어요.

english: [Rank]?
You heard correct.
The name's Gloria. Nice to meet you.
You too. I'm [player name]. What are you doing hanging round the Colosseum?
translation: 저도요. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. Colosseum(콜로세움) 근처에서 뭘 하고 계세요?

english: I've become quite fond of keeping an eye on the contenders and sharing news of their progress to those around the city.
translation: 도전자들을 지켜보다가 그들의 활약 소식을 도시 사람들에게 전하는 게 꽤 좋아졌거든요.

english: You see, inside the Colosseum you'll earn what's called Glory.
translation: 있잖아요, Colosseum(콜로세움) 안에서는 Glory(영광)이라는 걸 얻게 돼요.

english: What's Glory?
Glory will improve your status and reputation around the city. You might even get some rewards.
translation: Glory(영광)은 도시에서 당신의 지위와 평판을 높여 줘요. 보상도 받을 수 있을지 몰라요.

english: How does Glory work?
It's simple really, you get Glory from participating in the Colosseum! You'll get more Glory the better you perform.
translation: 정말 간단해요. Colosseum(콜로세움)에 참가하면 Glory(영광)을 얻어요! 성적이 좋을수록 영광도 더 많이 얻고요.

english: Performance is measured by a few things. For example, how many hits you take or how quickly you complete the challenges.
translation: 성적은 몇 가지로 평가해요. 예를 들면 공격을 몇 번 맞았는지, 도전을 얼마나 빨리 끝냈는지 같은 거요.

english: Sounds good to me. Have you earned any Glory yourself?
translation: 좋네요. 당신도 Glory(영광)을 얻어 본 적 있어요?

english: Ha! No. But I do have this fancy armour which is pretty glorious! You may be lucky enough to get some of your own from within the Colosseum.
translation: 하! 아뇨. 그래도 이 멋진 갑옷은 꽤 영광스럽죠! 운이 좋으면 Colosseum(콜로세움)에서 당신 것도 얻을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: 그 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: But of course! People all accross Varlamore will hear of your Glory.
translation: 물론이죠! Varlamore(바를라모어) 곳곳의 사람들이 당신의 Glory(영광)에 대해 듣게 될 거예요.

english: You'll get a range of benefits depending on your status.
translation: 지위에 따라 다양한 혜택을 받게 돼요.

english: How do I improve my status?
Earn more Glory of course. The more you earn, the better your standing in the city.
translation: 당연히 Glory(영광)을 더 얻어야죠. 많이 얻을수록 도시에서 위상이 높아져요.

english: You can check your status on that board over there. I keep it up to date.
translation: 지위는 저기 있는 게시판에서 확인할 수 있어요. 제가 늘 최신으로 고쳐 두거든요.

english: What exactly are the benefits?
Well...
Reaching Brawler status will give you access to the bank within the Colosseum.
translation: Brawler(싸움꾼) 지위에 오르면 Colosseum(콜로세움) 안의 은행을 이용할 수 있어요.

english: Reaching Challenger status will allow you to respawn in Civitas illa Fortis if you so desire.
translation: Challenger(도전자) 지위에 오르면 원할 경우 Civitas illa Fortis(시비타스 일라 포르티스)에서 다시 살아날 수 있어요.

english: Reaching Gladiator status might persuade some of the more shady folk around the city to give you more money for... Let's just say illicit valuables.
translation: Gladiator(검투사) 지위에 오르면 도시의 수상쩍은 사람들 몇몇이... 뭐, 불법적인 귀중품이라고만 해 두죠. 그런 걸 더 비싸게 사 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Reaching Hero status will allow you to travel to the Colosseum via the Ring of Dueling.
translation: Hero(영웅) 지위에 오르면 Ring of Dueling(결투의 반지)로 Colosseum(콜로세움)에 이동할 수 있어요.

english: Reaching Champion status will grant you free herb patch protection just west of the city.
translation: Champion(챔피언) 지위에 오르면 도시 바로 서쪽의 약초 밭을 무료로 보호받을 수 있어요.

english: And reaching Grand Champion status will unlock you the Fortis Salute emote.
translation: 그리고 Grand Champion(그랜드 챔피언) 지위에 오르면 Fortis Salute(포르티스 경례) 감정 표현이 해제돼요.

english: Do you know how much Glory I need for each status?
You'll have to figure that out on your journey to becoming a Grand Champion.
translation: 그건 Grand Champion(그랜드 챔피언)이 되는 여정에서 직접 알아내셔야 해요.

english: Fair enough.
Do you know my Glory status?
That I do, [player name].
It seems as though you are still a Rookie to the people of Fortis.
translation: Fortis(포르티스) 사람들에게 당신은 아직 Rookie(신참)인 것 같네요.

english: You'll make a name of yourself in no time, [player name].
translation: 금방 이름을 떨치게 될 거예요, [player name] 님.

english: I'll do my very best.
You are a Brawler!
Thanks!
You are a Grand Champion!
You can check that board over there to see any details of your Glory. I try to update it regularly.
translation: Glory(영광)에 대한 자세한 내용은 저기 게시판에서 확인할 수 있어요. 자주 고쳐 두려고 하거든요.

english: I'd better get going.
I see you've been trying to conquer the Colosseum, eh?
I have indeed, and I will become a champion!
translation: 맞아요, 전 꼭 챔피언이 될 거예요!

english: That's it, positive thoughts.
I was watching when you became Grand Champion of the Colosseum. It was truly something to behold.
translation: 당신이 Colosseum(콜로세움)의 Grand Champion(그랜드 챔피언)이 되던 순간을 지켜봤어요. 정말 장관이었죠.

english: What brings you over to me today?
I was wondering if we could talk about Glory?
translation: Glory(영광)에 대해 얘기할 수 있을까 해서요.

english: But of course. What do you wish to know?
Actually, I'm good.
Hello there, Grand Champion.
Grand Champion?
How does Glory work?
Are there any rewards?
Do you know my Glory status?
I'd better get going.
Tell me more about these rewards.
translation: 그 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Actually, I'm good.
Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 너무 아파 보여서 대화할 수 없다.

english: I'm really grateful to you for clearing up what Ithoi did to us. The rest of the Corsairs will appreciate my cooking even more now!
translation: Ithoi(이토이)가 우리한테 한 짓을 해결해 줘서 정말 고마워요. 이제 다른 Corsairs(코르세어)도 제 요리를 더 좋아해 줄 거예요!

english: That's good for you!
Hello.
Can't stop sorry! Busy, busy, busy!
translation: 미안해요, 멈출 수가 없어요! 바빠요, 바빠, 바빠!

english: The gnome is too busy to talk.
translation: 노움은 너무 바빠서 대화할 수 없다.

english: Hello traveller. Are you enjoying your stay?
It's a nice place.
Yes, we try to keep it that way.
translation: 네, 계속 그렇게 유지하려고 애쓰고 있어요.

english: Are you OK?
The gnome seems a little drunk.
Youssh go gesshh em.
Pardon?
Gessh ush a cosshtail.
A what?
Blurssh berry.
I think he's had enough!
I don't think I can take much more!
What's wrong?
It's just the wife, she won't stop moaning!
translation: 그냥 마누라 때문이에요. 바가지 긁는 걸 멈출 줄을 몰라요!

english: Maybe you should give her less to moan about.
translation: 바가지 긁을 거리를 좀 덜 주시면 되잖아요.

english: She'll always find something.
How's life treating you?
Not bad, not bad at all.
It's good to see a human with a positive attitude.
You're the human that dealt with those mourners aren't you? Thanks for that, they were really bothersome.
translation: 그 mourners(애도자)들을 처리한 인간이 당신이죠? 고마워요, 정말 성가셨거든요.

english: No problem. Why are you still here anyway?
translation: 별말씀을요. 그런데 왜 아직 여기 계세요?

english: The mourners left plenty of stuff behind, thought I'd see if there was anything useful.
translation: mourners(애도자)들이 물건을 잔뜩 두고 갔길래, 쓸 만한 게 있나 보려고요.

english: Fair enough, have fun.
Argh!
Hello again, [player name].
Tell me about this place.
Over time, many people have come into the world and left it again. One such is Thrander, who used to perform armour conversion services in Varrock. Another is Chuck, the wood certificate trader.
translation: 오랜 세월 동안 많은 이들이 이 세상에 왔다가 떠나갔습니다. 한때 Varrock(바록)에서 갑옷 개조 일을 하던 Thrander(스랜더)가 그중 하나이고, 목재 증명서 상인 Chuck(척)도 그렇지요.

english: When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 그들의 일이 더는 필요 없어지자 그들은 떠나갔지만, 모두가 잊힌 것은 아닙니다. 몇몇은 아직 Realm of Memories(기억의 영역)에 머물러 있지요.

english: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.
translation: 이 영역에서 우리는 세상이 어떻게 변해 가는지 지켜봅니다. 행복한 순간도, 슬픈 시절도, 운 좋은 일도, 지독한 불운도 보지요. 참으로 경이로운 존재 방식입니다.

english: Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 보상 아이템을 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: You cannot hold any more items from me now. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 지금은 제게서 아이템을 더 받을 수 없습니다. Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Diango(디앙고)를 찾아가면 더 편하게 보상을 받을 수 있을 겁니다.

english: I have given you what you can hold. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 들 수 있는 만큼 드렸습니다. Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Diango(디앙고)를 찾아가면 더 편하게 보상을 받을 수 있을 겁니다.

english: I think that is everything I have for you.
translation: 드릴 것은 그게 다인 것 같군요.

english: I have nothing more for you.
Who are the people here?
Like me, they dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.
translation: 저처럼 그들도 옛 모습의 세상, 여러 다른 시대에 살았던 이들입니다. 그런 이들 대부분은 시간의 안개 속으로 사라졌지만, 운 좋은 몇몇은 기억되고 있지요.

english: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
translation: 그들도 분명 당신을 만나면 반가워할 겁니다.

english: Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: 당신 시대의 물건을 더 볼 수 있어요?

english: I would have dearly loved that. However we are limited to this hall, where the more aggressive creatures can play in safety.
translation: 저도 정말 그러고 싶었습니다. 하지만 우리는 이 홀에만 머물 수 있지요. 이곳에서는 더 사나운 생물들도 안전하게 놀 수 있으니까요.

english: Furthermore, the dimensional shifts would not allow it - a two-dimensional entity would be incomprehensible to your three-dimensional mind.
translation: 게다가 차원의 변화가 그것을 허락하지 않을 겁니다. 2차원의 존재는 당신의 3차원 정신으로는 이해할 수 없을 테니까요.

english: No, some things must be left to the memory, even here in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 아니요, 어떤 것들은 기억 속에 남겨 두어야 합니다. 이곳 Realm of Memories(기억의 영역)에서조차도요.

english: Tell me about this place.
Can you give me more reward items?
translation: 보상 아이템을 더 주실 수 있어요?

english: Who are the people here?
Can I see more stuff from your era?
translation: 당신 시대의 물건을 더 볼 수 있어요?

english: Run faster! Faster!
Excuse me?
Oh, sorry, I didn't notice you there.
translation: 아, 미안. 거기 있는 줄 몰랐네.

english: I take it you're a coach?
That I am. Now get to the point, I'm very busy!
translation: 그렇지. 자, 본론만 말해. 나 무지 바쁘거든!

english: What's the history of Gnome ball?
Be more precise, stranger.
How did it all start?
Strangely enough, by accident.
Accident?
Don't interrupt!
Sorry.
A great many years ago, before I was even born, there were two young Gnomes. Brothers to be exact.
translation: 아주 오래전, 내가 태어나기도 전에, 젊은 노움 둘이 있었어. 정확히는 형제였지.

english: They were always arguing with each other over the most trivial things - who was the faster runner or who was the tallest.
translation: 둘은 아주 사소한 걸로 늘 티격태격했어. 누가 더 빨리 달리나, 누가 더 키가 크냐 하는 걸로.

english: One day they were up at the swamp throwing stones at the toads.
translation: 어느 날 둘이 늪에 올라가서 두꺼비한테 돌을 던지고 있었지.

english: As you do.
Yep. You know nothing tastes better than toasted toad?
translation: 그렇지. 구운 두꺼비만큼 맛있는 게 없다는 거 알아?

english: Oh, I'm sure
Anyway, they decided to compete to see who could kill the most toads. This gradually became a daily game, to which they invited friends and family to join in.
translation: 아무튼, 둘은 누가 두꺼비를 더 많이 잡나 겨루기로 했어. 이게 점점 매일 하는 놀이가 됐고, 친구랑 가족들까지 불러서 같이 하게 됐지.

english: It all evolved from there. Creating a playing arena, making up teams and leagues.
translation: 거기서부터 다 발전한 거야. 경기장을 만들고, 팀이랑 리그를 꾸리고.

english: Interesting.
Anything else?
What is the ball made from?
Toads of course
Toads?
What with the swamp nearby, and their robust skin, there is nothing better to stretch over some common sand.
translation: 근처에 늪도 있겠다, 가죽도 질기겠다, 모래 뭉치를 감싸기엔 그만한 게 없지.

english: I'd never have guessed.
Well, of course. You humans know nothing!
translation: 그야 그렇겠지. 너희 인간들은 아는 게 하나도 없으니까!

english: Those nets are strange.
Ah, made from the finest thread in all the land.
translation: 아, 이 땅에서 가장 좋은 실로 만든 거야.

english: And that is?
Gnome hair.
You're kidding, right?
I have no time for jokes. It's a serious matter, we go through plenty of nets every day.
translation: 농담할 시간 없어. 이건 진지한 문제야. 매일 그물을 엄청 갈아 치우거든.

english: So that's why you don't see many Gnomes with long hair?
translation: 그래서 머리 긴 노움이 별로 없는 거군요?

english: Exactly.
The world makes sense at last.
Are there any special tactics?
Well of course, like what?
How about passing?
There's the good old one-two tactic.
You don't know anything do you? You pass the ball onto a team mate, giving him all the attention of your opposition, and giving you the chance to run further ahead.
translation: 너 진짜 아무것도 모르는구나? 공을 동료한테 패스하면 상대 팀 관심이 전부 그 녀석한테 쏠리고, 그 틈에 넌 더 앞으로 달려 나갈 수 있는 거야.

english: Then what?
Well, he passes back to you and you've made an advantage. It's useful in a variety of situations!
translation: 그럼 그 녀석이 너한테 다시 패스하고, 넌 유리한 위치를 잡은 거지. 여러 상황에서 쓸모가 있다고!

english: I'll remember that one.
How about teamwork?
Well, don't forget that you can block the opposition whilst a team mate has the ball. Very useful if you want to stop or slow down anyone approaching him.
translation: 음, 동료가 공을 갖고 있을 때 상대를 막을 수 있다는 걸 잊지 마. 그 녀석한테 다가오는 놈을 멈추거나 늦추고 싶을 때 아주 쓸모 있지.

english: Block for team mates. Got it.
What about my personal physique?
You'd look better if you were shorter.
translation: 키가 좀 더 작으면 보기 좋겠네.

english: I meant in regards to scoring more goals!
translation: 골을 더 많이 넣는 쪽으로 물어본 거예요!

english: I see. Your agility is important if you want to avoid being tackled, so that would be a good attribute to improve. Also many Gnomes say that being able to attack well with a ranged weapon makes you better at
translation: 아하. 태클을 피하려면 Agility(민첩)이 중요하니까 키워 두면 좋은 능력이지. 그리고 많은 노움들 말로는, 원거리 무기로 공격을 잘할수록

english: scoring goals.
I suppose I should go away and work on those skills.

Yes, although playing the game itself will improve these skills too. Also you should remember that your distance from the goal affects your chance of scoring, so get close enough and your ranged ability won't matter as
translation: 그래, 경기를 하는 것만으로도 그 스킬들이 늘긴 해. 그리고 골대와의 거리가 득점 확률에 영향을 준다는 것도 기억해. 충분히 가까이 가면 원거리 실력은 그렇게

english: much.
Any information would be appreciated!
Hmm, some general facts?
Please!
OK. Have you noticed the different colour clothes for your opposing Gnomes?
translation: 좋아. 상대 노움들이 입은 옷 색깔이 다르다는 거 눈치챘어?

english: Nope.

The colours correspond to their skill level. The red ones are the professionals. They've been playing since before you were born! The orange ones are in the middle of their careers, whereas the yellow players know very
translation: 색깔은 실력 수준을 나타내. 빨간 녀석들은 프로야. 네가 태어나기도 전부터 경기를 해 왔지! 주황색은 경력 중반쯤 된 녀석들이고, 노란 녀석들은 아는 게 거의

english: little. Just like you!
Thanks... Anything else?
It's always good to get a group of friends to play with you. That way you can score goals more easily, and if you take it in turns to score the goals you'll all reap the rewards.
translation: 친구들을 모아서 같이 하는 게 늘 좋아. 그러면 골을 더 쉽게 넣을 수 있고, 돌아가면서 골을 넣으면 다 같이 보상을 챙길 수 있지.

english: Does the game bring fame?
translation: 이 경기를 하면 유명해질 수 있어요?

english: You mean you've never heard of Speedy Sam The Striker or Norda 'Steal Arms' van Druman?
translation: 설마 Speedy Sam The Striker(날쌘돌이 스트라이커 샘)이나 Norda 'Steal Arms' van Druman(노르다 '강탈손' 반 드루만)도 못 들어 봤단 말이야?

english: Afraid not.
Not even Great Thunder Legs MacKnee?
translation: Great Thunder Legs MacKnee(위대한 천둥다리 맥니)도?

english: Well, they're all richer than you'll ever be!
translation: 흥, 그 녀석들은 다 네가 평생 벌 것보다 부자라고!

english: Good for them.
Indeed, anything else?
Yawn.
I beg your pardon?
Erm... thanks, catch you later.
Take him out you wuss
One-Two, One-Two!
Hey human, get moving!
Run faster! Don't be so lazy!
translation: 더 빨리 뛰어! 게으름 피우지 마!

english: Pass to your left! Pass now!
There are others to pass to you know
translation: 패스할 데가 거기만 있는 게 아니거든

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오시진 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 얼로프트)의 손님께는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Coach
translation: 코치에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넵니다.

english: Ah, sustenance! Thanks.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없어요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 크레딧이 [number]점 있어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버립니다.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 그럴 리가 있나? 다시 확인해 봐!

english: Spot on!
What's the History of Gnome ball?
How did it all start?
What is the ball made from?
Those nets are strange.
Are there any special tactics?
How about in passing?
How about teamwork?
What about my personal physique?
Any information would be appreciated!
Does the game bring fame?
translation: 이 경기를 하면 유명해질 수 있어요?

english: Yawn
Nooooo! Dobbie's dead!
Tortoise Murderer!
You Beast!
This is for Dobbie!
Attack the infidel!
Hello.
Hello [sir/madam], can I tempt you with any of the dishes on our new menu?
translation: 안녕하세요, [sir/madam]. 저희 새 메뉴의 요리 중에 마음에 드시는 게 있으실까요?

english: I'll take a look.

I hope you like what you see. Although all these premade dishes are good to eat - they were made by the last human assistant chef. He wasn't up to Chef's exacting standards - and you may find that they will
translation: 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠네요. 이 미리 만들어 둔 요리들은 다 먹기엔 좋지만, 전에 있던 인간 보조 요리사가 만든 거예요. 그 사람은 주방장님의 까다로운 기준을 맞추지 못했죠. 그래서

english: not be accepted by some people as the 'real' thing.
translation: 어떤 분들은 이걸 '진짜' 요리로 쳐 주지 않을 수도 있어요.

english: Not really.
That's your choice [sir/madam], enjoy your stay.
I'll take a look.
Not really.
Actually I'd like to sell some dishes.

Mr Gianne is the one to talk to if you want to sell any dishes you've made yourself. He is the owner and head chef of this establishment. If on the other hand you are more interested in making food to deliver, which can
translation: 직접 만든 요리를 팔고 싶으시면 Mr Gianne(지안 사장님)께 말씀하세요. 이 가게 주인이자 주방장이시거든요. 반대로 배달할 음식을 만드는 데 더 관심이 있으시면, 그쪽도

english: be quite lucrative, you should talk to Mr Giannes son Aluft Gianne jnr. Just don't call him Lufty, he doesn't like it.
translation: 꽤 짭짤한데요, 사장님 아드님인 Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)와 얘기해 보세요. 다만 '러프티'라고는 부르지 마세요. 그렇게 불리는 걸 싫어하거든요.

english: Thank you.
Actually I'd like to sell some dishes.
Hi, welcome to Gnomeball. It's pretty simple really: You take the ball from me, charge at the gnome defence and try to throw the ball through the net using your ranged skill.
translation: 안녕하세요, Gnomeball(노움볼)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 정말 간단해요. 저한테서 공을 받아서 노움 수비진을 향해 돌진한 다음, 원거리 스킬로 공을 그물 안에 던져 넣으면 돼요.

english: It's a rough game but great fun. It's also great for improving agility. So do you fancy a game?
translation: 거친 경기지만 정말 재밌어요. Agility(민첩)을 키우기에도 아주 좋고요. 그래서, 한 판 해 보실래요?

english: Looks too dangerous for me!
Okay then, I'll have a go.
Great stuff! There are few rules to Gnomeball, so it can get a bit rough.
translation: 좋아요! Gnomeball(노움볼)은 규칙이 거의 없어서 좀 거칠어질 수 있어요.

english: You can pass to the green winger gnomes. Then you can make a run and they'll pass back. Otherwise, if you're feeling brave, you can just charge and dodge.
translation: 초록색 윙어 노움들한테 패스할 수 있어요. 그다음 앞으로 달려 나가면 다시 패스해 줄 거예요. 아니면 용기가 있다면 그냥 돌진하면서 피해도 되고요.

english: Sounds easy enough.
The main aim is to leave with no broken limbs. I think you should be fine.
translation: 가장 중요한 목표는 팔다리 안 부러지고 나가는 거예요. 당신은 괜찮을 것 같네요.

english: Peeeeeeeeep
Hi, welcome back to Gnomeball. Would you like to hear the rules again?
translation: 안녕하세요, Gnomeball(노움볼)에 다시 오신 걸 환영해요. 규칙을 다시 들어 보실래요?

english: It's pretty simple really: You take the ball from me, charge at the gnome defence and try to throw the ball through the net using your ranged skill.
translation: 정말 간단해요. 저한테서 공을 받아서 노움 수비진을 향해 돌진한 다음, 원거리 스킬로 공을 그물 안에 던져 넣으면 돼요.

english: It's a rough game but great fun. It's also great for improving agility.
translation: 거친 경기지만 정말 재밌어요. Agility(민첩)을 키우기에도 아주 좋고요.

english: Ahh I see you have your own ball. We can't play with that; I'll give it back when you leave.
translation: 아, 자기 공을 갖고 오셨네요. 그걸로는 경기할 수 없어요. 나가실 때 돌려드릴게요.

english: I just want to play
Okay... Let's play GNOMEBALL!
No, I don't want to play.
Okay, never mind. Maybe next time...
You have a ball in play. Do you need to hear the rules again?
translation: 경기 중인 공을 갖고 계시네요. 규칙을 다시 들려드릴까요?

english: The ball you have in your hand is fine to play with... Game on.
translation: 지금 손에 든 공으로 경기해도 괜찮아요... 경기 시작!

english: No thanks.
Okay, good luck.
Have a new ball!
Right, you haven't finished quite yet.
translation: 자, 아직 다 끝난 게 아니에요.

english: Ugh.
Answer this for me.
The ref has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong answer!
Well done!
The ref has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 심판이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 줍니다!

english: Looks too dangerous for me!
Okay then, I'll have a go.
Yes please.
I just want to play.
No, I don't want to play.
No thanks.
Good day, how may I help you?
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
translation: 추가 은행 칸은 40칸 단위로 최대 [number]칸까지 판매해 드릴 수 있습니다. 몇 칸을 구매하시겠습니까?

english: [number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
translation: 추가 은행 칸 [number]칸을 구매하시려면 [number]코인이 듭니다. 이 구매는 되돌릴 수 없으니 유의하십시오. 진행하시겠습니까?

english: Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: 아... 돈이 모자라는 것 같네요. 그럼 됐어요.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
What is this place?
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 이곳은 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)의 지점입니다. 여러 마을에 지점이 있습니다.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 손님의 아이템과 돈을 맡아 드립니다. 귀중품을 안전하게 지키고 싶으시면 저희에게 맡겨 주십시오.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Yes.
No.
Hello.
I have a riddle for you.
OK.
A tree which is planted on Monday and doubles in size each day is fully grown on the following Sunday. On what day is it half grown?
translation: 월요일에 심은 나무가 하루에 두 배씩 자라서 그다음 일요일에 다 자랐어. 그럼 절반만큼 자란 건 무슨 요일이게?

english: Erm... I'm not sure.
Saturday. You big folk really aren't the quickest!
translation: 토요일이지. 덩치 큰 너희들은 정말 머리가 느리다니까!

english: To be or not to be.
Hey I know that. Where's it from?
translation: 어, 그거 알아요. 어디서 나온 말이죠?

english: Existentialism for insects.
My mum says: A friendly look, a kindly smile one good act, and life's worthwhile!
translation: 우리 엄마가 그러는데, 다정한 눈빛, 친절한 미소, 착한 일 하나면 인생은 살 만하대!

english: Sweet.
I wrote a few children's books.
Really.
Yep... but not on purpose!
The human mind is a tremendous thing.
Bla bla bla!
What?
Rude little gnome!
Real generosity is doing something nice for someone who will never find it out.
translation: 진정한 너그러움이란, 결코 알아채지 못할 사람에게 좋은 일을 해 주는 거야.

english: Thanks for the quote.
Nice weather we're having today.
But then it doesn't tend to rain much around here.
translation: 하긴 이 근처엔 원래 비가 잘 안 오지만.

english: Hardy, ha ha! Hee, hee hee!
Are you OK?
I'm a little tree gnome. That is me!
translation: 나는야 꼬마 나무 노움. 그게 바로 나!

english: I've heard better.
translation: 더 잘 부르는 것도 들어 봤어요.

english: I am the beginning of eternity and the end of time and space. I am the beginning of every end and the end of every place. What am I?
translation: 나는 영원의 시작이자 시공의 끝이야. 모든 엔딩의 시작이자 모든 광장의 끝이지. 나는 뭘까?

english: Err...?
Erm...not sure...annoying.
I'm 'e'! Hee hee! Do you get it?
I worship Guthix, the god of balance.
He really does have exceptional co-ordination.
Hello, are you alright?
Not really, I just saw a man with a wooden leg.
translation: 별로. 방금 나무 의족을 한 남자를 봤거든.

english: So?!
He had a real foot!
What are you doing?
I'm making wine out of raisins.
Why?
So I don't have to wait for it to age.
translation: 그래야 숙성될 때까지 안 기다려도 되니까.

english: Hee hee!
Hi.
She loves me!
She does I tell you. She really loves me!
translation: 진짜라니까. 그 애는 날 정말 사랑해!

english: Hello.
Are you alright?
I just want something to happen!
Like what?
Something, anything, I don't know what!
A little inaccuracy sometimes saves tons of explanation!
translation: 약간의 부정확함이 때론 수많은 설명을 덜어 주지!

english: True.
Hello. Why are you so tall?
translation: 안녕. 넌 왜 그렇게 키가 커?

english: Um... I've always been this height.
Maybe you should eat more worms.
translation: 벌레를 좀 더 먹어 보지 그래.

english: Low.
When?
Cheeky!
The gnome is praying.
Guthix's angels fly so high as to be beyond our sight but they are always looking down upon us.
translation: Guthix(구식스)의 천사들은 너무 높이 날아서 우리 눈에 보이지 않지만, 언제나 우리를 내려다보고 있어.

english: Hello, would you like a worm?
Erm... OK.
Thanks.
In the gnome village those who are needy receive what they need, and those who are able give what they can.
translation: 노움 마을에서는 필요한 이는 필요한 만큼 받고, 할 수 있는 이는 할 수 있는 만큼 내놓아.

english: Dimensionality is a function of consciousness.
That's all you need to know.
I've been thinking.
Surely, if you're scared to die...
...you're not living, right?
Maybe!
How are you?
A warning traveller! The new world will rise from the underground!
translation: 경고할게, 여행자! 새로운 세계가 땅속에서 솟아오를 거야!

english: What do you mean, underground?
Just a warning!
Some advice traveller. We can walk, run, row or fly but never lose sight of the reason for the journey or miss the chance to see a rainbow on the way.
translation: 충고 하나 할게, 여행자. 우린 걷고, 뛰고, 노 젓고, 날 수도 있지만, 여행의 이유를 잊지 말고 가는 길에 무지개를 볼 기회도 놓치지 마.

english: I like that.
You look happy.
I'm always at peace with myself.
How do you manage that?
I know, therefore I am.
The gnome appears to be singing.
Oh baby, oh my sweet.
Are you talking to me?
No, I'm just singing.
I'm gonna sweep you off your feet.
Hi there.
Hey big man, watch where you're standing.
translation: 어이 덩치, 서 있는 데 조심해.

english: I wouldn't want to make a mess of your shoes.
Have you seen our big tree?
Yes I have!
It's not small!
You are the contained centre of an O.
Pardon?
While me, I'm much more. I am the pyramidic containment of an A.
translation: 그에 비해 난 훨씬 대단하지. 난 A를 품은 피라미드거든.

english: You're strange.
I'm trying to make a comeback!
Really?
It's hard when you haven't been anywhere.
translation: 어디 가 본 적도 없으니 돌아오기가 힘들어.

english: Aaaaarrggghh... humans! Run for your lives!
Hello brave adventurer. A warrior like you should go a long way.
translation: 안녕, 용감한 모험가. 너 같은 전사라면 멀리 갈 거야.

english: The further, the better! Hee hee!
Es ataris eto meriz ip prit es gutus!
translation: 에스 아타리스 에토 메리즈 입 프릿 에스 구투스!

english: Oh hello.
Not great, it's just... well... people just don't seem to take me seriously!
translation: 별로야, 그냥... 음... 다들 날 진지하게 받아 주질 않아!

english: How are you?
I'm fine thanks.
Why don't you make like a tree...
...and leave!
Funny!
Top of the morning to you.
And bottom of the afternoon.
The only thing that is constant...
...is change!
In the depths she has sealed them. Their power becomes hers.
translation: 깊은 곳에 그녀가 그들을 봉인했다. 그들의 힘은 그녀의 것이 된다.

english: The father lives on. Alas, he's not the man he once was.
translation: 아버지는 살아 있다. 아아, 그러나 그는 예전의 그가 아니다.

english: A door will finally open. A body lies within.
translation: 마침내 문이 열릴 것이다. 그 안에는 시신이 누워 있다.

english: The fate of the future, it lies in the past. He will save us all.
translation: 미래의 운명은 과거에 있다. 그가 우리 모두를 구하리라.

english: A new evil rises in an unlikely place. But the rhythm will be her undoing.
translation: 뜻밖의 곳에서 새로운 악이 일어난다. 하지만 리듬이 그녀를 파멸시키리라.

english: Before sacrificing to the mighty Zulrah, comes the dawn.
translation: 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)에게 제물을 바치기 전에, 새벽이 온다.

english: When they say you're going off the rails, they're jealous that you can fly.
translation: 그들이 네가 탈선한다고 말하는 건, 네가 날 수 있음을 질투하기 때문이다.

english: So many symbols, so many signs. What do they mean? The answer is written in blood.
translation: 수많은 상징, 수많은 표식. 그것들은 무엇을 뜻하는가? 답은 피로 쓰여 있다.

english: The city of gold they call it. Alas, the gold is that of fools.
translation: 사람들은 그곳을 황금의 도시라 부른다. 아아, 그 황금은 바보의 황금이다.

english: Long he has waited. At last, the most loyal servant will make his move.
translation: 오래도 기다렸다. 마침내 가장 충직한 하인이 움직이리라.

english: A horn was hidden in the sand, sealed away by the forgotten four.
translation: 모래 속에 뿔피리가 숨겨져 있었다. 잊힌 넷이 봉인한 채로.

english: Those things which I am saying now may be obscure, yet they will be made clearer in the proper place.
translation: 지금 내가 하는 말은 모호할지라도, 알맞은 곳에서 더 분명해질 것이다.

english: Hello!
Greetings.
What do you think of the party?
It is as beauteous as the sheen of scales on a butterfly's wing and as odious as a worm's armpit.
translation: 나비 날개의 비늘처럼 아름답고, 벌레 겨드랑이만큼 역겨워.

english: Who have we got here...?
H... Hello.
So you think you're good enough to win this game, eh?
translation: 그래서 이 게임에서 이길 실력이 된다고 생각하는 거예요?

english: I'm counting on it.
We shall see about that!
So how does this game work?
translation: 그래서 이 게임은 어떻게 하는 거예요?

english: The aim of the game is to reach 250 points as fast as you can.
translation: 게임의 목표는 최대한 빨리 250점을 모으는 거예요.

english: To earn points you simply have to put the gingerbread in your hopper.
translation: 점수를 얻으려면 gingerbread(진저브레드)를 당신 hopper(호퍼)에 넣기만 하면 돼요.

english: Of course, there's a catch. Each gingerbread has different qualities, thus different point values. I'll let you figure out which one is best.
translation: 물론 함정이 있죠. 진저브레드마다 품질이 달라서 점수도 달라요. 어떤 게 제일 좋은지는 직접 알아내 보세요.

english: Here's a hint: don't put any red and crumbled gingerbread into your hopper. It will give you negative points.
translation: 힌트 하나 줄게요. 빨갛고 부스러진 진저브레드는 당신 호퍼에 넣지 마세요. 점수가 깎이거든요.

english: You can be cheeky and put those inside other competitor's hoppers, as a saboteur.
translation: 짓궂게 그걸 다른 참가자의 호퍼에 넣어서 방해 공작을 펼칠 수도 있어요.

english: I expect only the highest quality of gingerbread in my establishment.
translation: 내 업소에선 최고 품질의 진저브레드만 받아요.

english: Keep one eye on the other players as they might try to slow you down.
translation: 다른 참가자들을 계속 주시하세요. 당신을 방해하려 할지도 모르니까요.

english: I think I want to have a look around first.
I'll be waiting!
Be careful, you've got some awful gingerbread with you... I wouldn't put them in your hopper, maybe another player's?
translation: 조심해요, 형편없는 진저브레드를 갖고 있네요... 나라면 당신 호퍼에는 안 넣겠어요. 다른 참가자 호퍼라면 몰라도?

english: You must now answer the hardest riddle known to gnomekind, in order to proceed to the final!
translation: 결승에 나가려면 이제 노움 역사상 가장 어려운 수수께끼를 풀어야 해요!

english: I'm ready.
I am tall when I am young, and I am short when I am old.
translation: 나는 젊을 땐 키가 크고, 늙으면 키가 작아요.

english: A Gnome?
Well yes, I am a gnome, but the riddle wasn't about me!
translation: 음, 내가 노움이긴 하지만, 수수께끼는 내 얘기가 아니었어요!

english: Gosh what I wouldn't give to be tall when I was young.
translation: 세상에, 젊을 때 키가 클 수만 있었다면 뭐든 내줬을 텐데.

english: Have another go.
That's not quite right, have another go.
A Human! Ha, I've got it.
Sadly not correct [player name].
You seem very old, you've been round here a while. You're not shorter than me though.
translation: 당신 꽤 나이 들어 보이네요, 여기 꽤 오래 있었잖아요. 그래도 나보다 작진 않네요.

english: Well, that's not hard.
Don't be cheeky [player name]! Now quickly solve this riddle.
translation: 까불지 마요, [player name]님! 자, 얼른 수수께끼나 풀어요.

english: A candle?
That's correct!
Good luck in the final [player name]. You're going to need it.
translation: 결승에서 행운을 빌어요, [player name]님. 아마 꼭 필요할 테니까요.

english: How's it going [player name]?
I'm pine thanks, I still have crumbs in places I didn't know I had.
translation: 솔~직히 잘 지내요. 있는 줄도 몰랐던 곳에 아직 빵가루가 묻어 있지만요.

english: Icy what you did there.
Do you enjoy it here?
Absolutely, I've had some of the best times in my life doing all this quality control.
translation: 물론이죠, 이 품질 관리 일을 하면서 인생 최고의 시간을 보냈어요.

english: I wouldn't be the gnome I am today without it.
translation: 이 일이 없었다면 지금의 나는 없었을 거예요.

english: That sounds lovely.
So what's your story?
Good question, where do I begin...
I used to be a Head Chef at the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 나는 원래 Tree Gnome Stronghold(나무 노움 요새)의 Head Chef(주방장)였어요.

english: Oh yeah?
I was the best of the best.
WHERE'S THE FROG SAUCE! I used to shout.
translation: 개구리 소스 어디 있어! 하고 늘 소리쳤죠.

english: Great times.
Then you ended up in Santa's Nutcracker Pub?
translation: 그러다 Santa's Nutcracker Pub(산타의 호두까기 펍)에 오게 된 거예요?

english: You know it. Apparently Santa was getting complaints about the quality of his gingerbread gnomes.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 듣자 하니 Santa(산타)가 진저브레드 노움 품질 때문에 불만을 듣고 있었대요.

english: So he asked me to step in. Free ticket onto his Nice List too.
translation: 그래서 나한테 맡아 달라고 했죠. 덤으로 Nice List(착한 아이 명단)에도 공짜로 올려 줬고요.

english: I mean just look at this place. It's amazing!
translation: 아니, 여기 좀 봐요. 정말 끝내주잖아요!

english: It is indeed.
Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
Yes.
No.
Gnome.
Flower.
Human.
Candle.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
What's your story?
Happy Holidays!
Hello how are you?
I'm amazed by how much humans chat. The sign over there says training area, not pointless conversation area.
translation: 인간들이 이렇게 수다스러울 줄이야. 저기 표지판에 적힌 건 훈련장이지, 쓸데없는 잡담 구역이 아니다.

english: Hello, what is this place?
This, my friend, is where we train. Here we improve our agility. It's an essential skill.
translation: 친구, 여기가 바로 우리가 훈련하는 곳이다. 여기서 민첩성을 기르지. 꼭 필요한 스킬이다.

english: It looks easy enough.
If you complete the course in order from the slippery log to the end, your agility will increase much faster than by repeating just one obstacle.
translation: 미끄러운 통나무부터 끝까지 순서대로 코스를 완주하면, 장애물 하나만 반복하는 것보다 민첩 스킬이 훨씬 빨리 오른다.

english: This is fun!
This is training soldier. If you want fun go make some cocktails.
translation: 이건 훈련이다, 병사. 재미를 원하면 가서 칵테일이나 만들어.

english: Hello there.
This isn't a grannies' tea party, let's see some sweat human. Go! Go! Go!
translation: 할머니들 다과회가 아니다. 땀 좀 흘려 봐라, 인간. 가! 가! 가!

english: Okay get over that log, quick quick!
Move it, move it, move it!
That's it - straight up
Come on scaredy cat, get across that rope!
My Granny can move faster than you.
You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 아직 안 끝났다! 이것도 해 봐!

english: My baby sister can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 내 막내 여동생도 그것보단 퍼즐을 잘 풀겠다!

english: Excellent work!
Hi.
Draw your sword warrior, and fight along side us.
translation: 검을 뽑아라, 전사여. 우리와 함께 싸우자.

english: Hello.
Death to Khazard, and all who serve him.
translation: Khazard(카자드)에게, 그리고 그를 섬기는 모든 자에게 죽음을!

english: I can't talk now, can't you see we're trying to win a battle here.
translation: 지금은 얘기할 수 없다. 우리가 전투에서 이기려고 애쓰는 게 안 보이나?

english: You won't take us without a fight!
translation: 싸우지 않고는 우리를 꺾을 수 없다!

english: Get out of our lands!
Tally ho!
Hello, how's the work going?
Getting there now, thanks to your help!
translation: 이제 거의 다 돼 가요, 당신이 도와준 덕분이에요!

english: Can I take a flight in the glider?
Sure, go ahead.
Have a nice day.
You too, human.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어진 요리로는 안 될 것 같네요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울려요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Gnormadium Avlafrim
Oh my! I've had nothing to eat or drink but chompy birds and smelly water for days. Thank you.
translation: 세상에! 며칠 동안 chompy birds(촘피 새)랑 냄새나는 물밖에 못 먹었어요. 고마워요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 갖다주려고 먼 길을 오셨겠네요. 여기 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]개 있습니다. 아직은 노움 음식을 배달받을 수 없습니다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]개 있습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었습니다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받으세요. 배달 상자는 더 필요 없으니 버렸습니다.

english: Hello, how's the work going?
Can I take a flight in the glider?
Have a nice day.
Hello. What do you do here?
My name is Gnosi. I am here to assist the Varrock Museum in their research.
translation: 제 이름은 Gnosi(노시)예요. Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)의 연구를 돕기 위해 여기 와 있어요.

english: I didn't know the Varrock Museum was familiar with this continent. What research are you conducting?
translation: Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)이 이 대륙에 대해 알고 있는 줄 몰랐네요. 무슨 연구를 하고 계세요?

english: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
translation: 이 지역의 역사와 lizardmen(리자드맨)의 기원, 그리고 그 모든 것이 Xeric(제릭)과 어떻게 이어지는지 연구하고 있어요.

english: We've wanted to study this place for a while, but haven't been able to explore due to lizardmen blocking the way.
translation: 이곳을 오래전부터 연구하고 싶었지만, lizardmen(리자드맨)이 길을 막고 있어서 탐사를 할 수 없었어요.

english: But now that the Shayzien Army have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: 하지만 이제 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)이 길을 뚫으면서 Chambers of Xeric(제릭의 회랑)까지 발견했으니, 탐사할 게 아주 많아요!

english: Who is Xeric?
Xeric was an incredibly powerful dark mage. He ruled Great Kourend for ten decades.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 엄청나게 강력한 어둠의 마법사였어요. 백 년 동안 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 통치했죠.

english: If you'd like to find out more you should visit the Historical Archive at the Grand Library.
translation: 더 알고 싶으시면 Grand Library(대도서관)의 Historical Archive(역사 기록 보관소)에 가 보세요.

english: What are the Chambers of Xeric?
At the summit of this mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves that we believe were formed by Xeric and his followers.
translation: 이 산 정상에서 고대 신전과 거대한 동굴망을 발견했는데, Xeric(제릭)과 그 추종자들이 만든 것으로 보고 있어요.

english: The discovery of the Chambers tells us Xeric invested significant time and resources here, yet it was never documented.
translation: Chambers(회랑)이 발견됐다는 건 Xeric(제릭)이 이곳에 상당한 시간과 자원을 들였다는 뜻인데, 그런 기록은 전혀 없었어요.

english: While much of Kourend's history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously undiscovered to us.
translation: Xeric(제릭) 치하의 Kourend(쿠렌드) 역사는 아직 많은 부분이 밝혀지지 않았지만, 이렇게 거대한 곳이 지금까지 알려지지 않았다니 정말 놀라워요.

english: Can I explore the Chambers?
Of course, though be careful. The dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.
translation: 물론이죠, 하지만 조심하세요. Chambers of Xeric(제릭의 회랑)에 어떤 위험이 있는지는 아직 몰라요. 강한 동료들과 함께 가는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: What do you think Xeric used this area for?
When he ruled Kourend, we know Xeric performed experiments on the living, using power drawn from the Dark Altar. After he was overthrown, he would have needed a new source of power.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)를 통치하던 시절, Xeric(제릭)이 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에서 끌어낸 힘으로 산 자들을 실험했다는 건 알려져 있어요. 권좌에서 쫓겨난 뒤에는 새로운 힘의 원천이 필요했을 거예요.

english: We believe he came here to seek it. Xeric would also have required a source of many creatures for these experiments, and the Chambers certainly contain many of those!
translation: 그걸 찾으러 여기 왔다고 보고 있어요. Xeric(제릭)은 실험을 위해 수많은 생물도 필요했을 텐데, Chambers(회랑)에는 확실히 그런 생물이 가득하죠!

english: He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the temple unnoticed.
translation: 신전에 들키지 않고 오려면 어떤 형태의 순간이동 수단도 갖고 있었을 거예요.

english: With time and careful study we will uncover these secrets and be able to answer these questions.
translation: 시간을 들여 신중히 연구하면 이 비밀들을 밝혀내고 이런 질문들에 답할 수 있을 거예요.

english: We believe this altar is that source. It seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
translation: 이 altar(제단)이 바로 그 원천이라고 보고 있어요. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 증폭기 역할을 하는 것 같아요.

english: As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers. Maybe he used them in his experiments.
translation: Chambers(회랑)을 뭐에 썼는지는 아직 몰라요. 회랑에는 생물이 많으니, 아마 실험에 썼을지도 모르죠.

english: Goodbye.
Hello. How's it going?
The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
translation: 이 동굴의 발견으로 모든 게 바뀔 수도 있어요. 마침내 lizardmen(리자드맨)과 Chambers of Xeric(제릭의 회랑), 그리고 Xeric(제릭) 본인 사이의 연관성을 밝혀낼 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Who is Xeric?
What are the Chambers of Xeric?
Can I explore the Chambers?
What do you think Xeric used this area for?
Goodbye
Goodbye.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
My name is Goat Poo. But human not allowed to make big deal of it, 'cos it mean to tease people 'bout silly name.
translation: 내 이름 Goat Poo(염소 똥). 근데 인간 그거 갖고 난리 치면 안 돼, 이상한 이름 갖고 놀리는 거 못된 짓이니까.

english: Why are you called Goat Poo?
Look, trolls are named after first thing they try to eat, when they little kids. That is troll tradition.
translation: 봐, 트롤은 꼬맹이 때 처음 먹으려던 거 따서 이름 붙어. 그게 트롤 전통.

english: So the first thing you ate was goat poo?
translation: 그럼 처음 먹은 게 염소 똥이었어요?

english: It my parents' fault - they should have been paying proper attention an' stopped me. But no, they just named me after it.
translation: 우리 부모 잘못이야 - 제대로 보고 있다가 말렸어야지. 근데 안 그러고, 그냥 그걸로 이름 붙였어.

english: Still, it coulda been worse. Could have been called Yellow Snow. He got a really dumb name.
translation: 그래도 더 나쁠 수도 있었어. Yellow Snow(노란 눈)일 수도 있었잖아. 걔 이름 진짜 바보 같아.

english: Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: 알았어요, 왜 이름이 Goat Poo(염소 똥)인지 안 물어볼게요.

english: Most people do eventually. Over an' over again.
translation: 다들 결국 물어봐. 계속, 또 계속.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤들이 몇 년 전에 지었어, 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨난 다음에. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 살아. 먹을 염소랑 늑대 많아 - 이젠 좀 질린 맛인데, 다른 선택지 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그걸 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알아요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)이 그거 키우는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구트 머시기 풀 처음 들어, 응. 근데 채소 같은 소리 나, 그리고 Mother(어머니) 채소 먹는 거 안 좋아해, 그러니까 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니) 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해, 근데 걔 엄청 크고, 걔가 대장이라, 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠지만, 우리 집이야. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)이 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 여기 더 좋게 만들 수 있대, 근데 Mother(어머니) 그거 관심 없어, 그래서 이상한 버섯 그거 하면 안 돼.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 자기 더 잘 싸우게 돕는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 걔 엄청 크고, 걔가 대장이라, 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 지금 최고야, Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 트롤 남편이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 나아졌어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠지만, 나아지고 있어. Snowflake(눈송이), 걔가 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으면 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그래서 응, Weiss(바이스) 살기 좋은 곳이야, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이니까. 트롤 다 눈송이 좋아해. 걔 트롤 남편 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아냐.

english: You t'ink I want that? It not even from goat!
translation: 너 내가 그거 원한다고 생각해? 염소한테서 나온 것도 아니잖아!

english: Look, human, it were one time. Just once. Let a troll move on, okay?
