translation: 봐, 인간, 딱 한 번이었어. 딱 한 번. 트롤도 좀 잊고 살게 해 줘, 알았어?

english: Look, human, this not funny. You need goat poo in bucket, go find goat pen!
translation: 봐, 인간, 이거 하나도 안 웃겨. 양동이에 염소 똥 필요하면, 가서 염소 우리 찾아!

english: Who are you?
Why are you called Goat Poo?
Okay, I won't ask why you're called Goat Poo.
translation: 알았어요, 왜 이름이 Goat Poo(염소 똥)인지 안 물어볼게요.

english: Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
I kill you human!
Go away smelly human!
What you doing here?
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
translation: 너희 고블린 놈들 전부 죽이러 왔다!

english: I kill you!
I'm just looking around.
Me not sure that allowed. You have to check with generals.
translation: 그거 되는 건지 나 몰라. 장군들한테 물어봐야 해.

english: Happy goblin new century!
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Goblin century mark year of big battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: 고블린 세기는 Plain of Mud(진흙 평원)에서 큰 전투 있던 해 기념. 그때 Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이 우리한테 계명 줬어.

english: Who is the Big High War God?
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이 누군데?

english: Big High War God take goblins and make them strong! Without him, we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God, we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이 고블린 데려가서 강하게 만들어! 그분 없으면, 우리 작고 약하고 멍청해. 근데 위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신 덕분에, 우리 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제일 강한 종족!

english: Umm... you're clearly not the most powerful race in Gielinor.
translation: 음... 너희는 누가 봐도 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제일 강한 종족은 아닌데.

english: Not to doubt word of Big High War God! I kill you!
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신) 말씀 의심하지 마! 나 너 죽인다!

english: What are the goblin commandments?
Slay enemies of Big High War God! Not show mercy! Not run from battle! Not doubt word of Big High War God!
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)의 적 죽여라! 자비 보이지 마라! 전투에서 도망치지 마라! 위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신 말씀 의심하지 마라!

english: Without commandments we not know right from wrong. We be like other races who not know war is good!
translation: 계명 없으면 우리 옳고 그른 거 몰라. 전쟁 좋은 거 모르는 다른 종족들처럼 돼!

english: Where is the Plain of Mud?
translation: Plain of Mud(진흙 평원)은 어디 있는데?

english: That goblin secret! No human ever find Plain of Mud!
translation: 그거 고블린 비밀! 인간 절대 Plain of Mud(진흙 평원) 못 찾아!

english: I need to go.
Brown armour best!
Why is brown best?
General Wartface and General Bentnoze both say it is. And normally they never agree!
translation: General Wartface(워트페이스 장군)이랑 General Bentnoze(벤트노즈 장군) 둘 다 그렇대. 원래 둘은 절대 의견 안 맞는데!

english: But you're still wearing green armour!
translation: 근데 너 초록 갑옷 입고 있잖아!

english: Um... my brown armour getting wash.
translation: 음... 내 갈색 갑옷 빨래 중.

english: But you're still wearing red armour!
translation: 근데 너 빨간 갑옷 입고 있잖아!

english: It not red, it just red-ish brown!
translation: 이거 빨강 아니야, 그냥 빨강 비슷한 갈색!

english: Err, okay.
I'm here to kill all you goblins!
translation: 너희 고블린 놈들 전부 죽이러 왔다!

english: I'm just looking around.
Happy new century!
What is the goblin new century?
Who is the Big High War God?
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이 누군데?

english: What are the goblin commandments?
Where is the Plain of Mud?
translation: Plain of Mud(진흙 평원)은 어디 있는데?

english: I need to go.
Why is brown best?
But you're still wearing green!
But you're still wearing red!
Err, okay.
Which way should I go?
These dungeons are such a maze.
I've been wandering around down here for hours.
How can I get back to the village?
I hate being so lost!
Where am I? I'm so lost.
I know the exit is around here, somewhere.
translation: 출구가 이 근처 어딘가에 있을 텐데.

english: Where's the exit?!?
This is the fifth time this week! I'm lost!
translation: 이번 주에만 다섯 번째야! 길을 잃었어!

english: How could I be so disoriented?
translation: 어쩌다 이렇게 방향 감각을 잃은 거지?

english: Hmm? Oh, hello, surface-dweller!
What are you doing?
I'm writing the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan!
Actually, I wonder if you could help me...
translation: 그런데 혹시 저 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요...

english: I know the ruler of Lumbridge is called Horacio, but I don't know what his title is. Can you tell me?
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 통치자 이름이 Horacio(호레이시오)라는 건 아는데, 칭호가 뭔지 모르겠어요. 알려 주실래요?

english: He's a duke.
Duke Horacio. Thank you.
He's a general.
General Horacio. Thank you.
He's a king.
King Horacio. Thank you.
He's a lord.
Lord Horacio. Thank you.
You've talked to the goblins on the surface, haven't you? Do you know the name of the god that the surface goblins worship?
translation: 지상의 고블린들이랑 얘기해 보셨죠? 지상 고블린들이 섬기는 신의 이름을 아세요?

english: Nobody knows.
Oh well. Thanks anyway.
It's just called the Big High War God.
translation: 그냥 Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이라고 불려요.

english: Ah, thank you.
It was Zamorak.
It was Guthix.
It was Saradomin.
It was [player name].
[player name]? What a terrible, fear-inducing name!
I'm writing about the great war between the gods that happened thousands of years ago. Do you know the reason for this war?
translation: 수천 년 전에 있었던 신들의 대전쟁에 대해 쓰고 있어요. 그 전쟁이 왜 일어났는지 아세요?

english: It was for the gods' own entertainment.
Just as I'd thought. Thank you.
Zamorak attacked the other gods.
Really? Thank you for the information.
The other gods attacked Zaros.
Thanks.
Guthix wanted to preserve balance so he made the other gods fight.
translation: Guthix(구식스)가 균형을 지키려고 다른 신들끼리 싸우게 만들었어요.

english: A strange idea of balance! Thank you.
translation: 균형에 대한 생각이 참 독특하네요! 고마워요.

english: What's the name of the group of surface-people that tried to destroy Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 파괴하려 했던 지상 사람들 무리의 이름이 뭐죠?

english: H.A.M.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for?
It stands for Humans Against Monsters.
translation: Humans Against Monsters(괴물에 맞서는 인간들)의 약자예요.

english: So we're monsters, are we? Thanks for telling me!
translation: 그러니까 우리가 괴물이라는 거군요? 알려 줘서 고마워요!

english: B.A.C.O.N.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for. Thank you.
P.O.R.K.
Hmm, I wonder what that stands for? Thank you.
B.E.E.F.
What species are you, if you don't mind my asking? I know there are many different races living on the surface, but I don't know which one you are.
translation: 실례가 안 된다면, 어떤 종족이신지 여쭤봐도 될까요? 지상에 여러 종족이 산다는 건 아는데, 당신이 어느 쪽인지는 모르겠어요.

english: I'm a human!
Ah, good, that's what I thought.
A human, hmm? Thank you.
That's a relief! I thought you were some kind of horrible ogre!
translation: 휴, 다행이에요! 무시무시한 오우거인 줄 알았거든요!

english: Ah, of course. I thought you looked a little tall for a dwarf.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 드워프치고는 키가 좀 크다 싶었어요.

english: Oh! I thought you were an elf. Surface species are confusing!
translation: 어라! 엘프인 줄 알았어요. 지상 종족들은 헷갈려요!

english: I'm an ogre. Raah!
Eek! An ogre! I had thought you were human!
An ogre, hmm? Thank you.
Ah, that's what I thought!
And I thought you were an elf! What a silly mistake!
translation: 엘프인 줄 알았는데! 이런 바보 같은 실수를!

english: I'm a dwarf!
Oh? I thought dwarves were shorter. I thought you were human!
translation: 어? 드워프는 키가 더 작은 줄 알았어요. 인간인 줄 알았는데!

english: A dwarf, hmm? Thank you.
Ah, yes, of course, you said.
I'm an elf!
Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were human!
translation: 어? 엘프는 더 우아한 줄 알았어요. 인간인 줄 알았는데!

english: An elf, hmm? Thank you.
Oh? I thought elves were more graceful. I thought you were a dwarf!
translation: 어? 엘프는 더 우아한 줄 알았어요. 드워프인 줄 알았는데!

english: Ah yes, that's what I thought.
What is this building?
This is the Dorgeshuun Council chamber!
Whenever a decision needs to be made, the seven members of the Dorgeshuun Council meet here. The last meeting was when they decided to open up the city to surface-dwellers.
translation: 결정할 일이 생길 때마다 Dorgeshuun Council(도르게슌 의회)의 의원 일곱 명이 여기 모여요. 지난 회의에서는 도시를 지상 주민들에게 개방하기로 결정했죠.

english: In between meetings, I work here writing up the minutes of the meetings and working on the definitive history of Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 회의가 없을 때는 여기서 회의록을 정리하고 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)의 결정판 역사서를 쓰고 있어요.

english: Can you tell me about the history of the city?
translation: 이 도시의 역사에 대해 얘기해 주실래요?

english: Of course! I've gone through all of my predecessors' notes and compiled the definitive history of the Dorgeshuun! What would you like to hear about?
translation: 물론이죠! 선배 서기들이 남긴 기록을 전부 살펴보고 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)의 결정판 역사를 정리했어요! 어떤 이야기를 듣고 싶으세요?

english: Can you tell me about the founding of Dorgesh-Kaan?
Of course!  *Ahem*
Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god whose name has been forgotten.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 이름이 잊힌 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

english: The gods became bored and decided to make the mortal races fight for their amusement. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 신들은 따분해진 나머지 자기들 재미를 위해 필멸의 종족들을 싸우게 하기로 했어요. 고블린들은 서로, 그리고 다른 종족들과 수많은 피비린내 나는 전투를 치러야 했죠.

english: The war lasted for thousands of years, and millions of goblins died. Eventually, the evil god sent the Dorgeshuun tribe to fight a battle that they could not win.
translation: 전쟁은 수천 년 동안 이어졌고, 고블린 수백만이 죽었어요. 결국 사악한 신은 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 부족을 도저히 이길 수 없는 전투에 내보냈어요.

english: But General Bloodfist of the Dorgeshuun refused to fight in this battle. Instead, he commanded the Dorgeshuun army to march down into a fissure in the ground.
translation: 하지만 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)의 General Bloodfist(블러드피스트 장군)은 그 전투에 나서기를 거부했어요. 그 대신 도르게슌 군대에게 땅속 균열 아래로 행군하라고 명령했죠.

english: General Bloodfist stood at the mouth of the fissure and defied the might of the evil god.
translation: General Bloodfist(블러드피스트 장군)은 균열 입구에 버티고 서서 사악한 신의 힘에 맞섰어요.

english: The evil god smote him with a mighty blast that shook the earth, but that blast also closed the fissure, sealing the Dorgeshuun away from the reach of the gods.
translation: 사악한 신은 땅을 뒤흔드는 강력한 일격으로 그를 내리쳤지만, 그 일격에 균열마저 닫혀 버려 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 신들의 손길이 닿지 않는 곳에 봉인되었어요.

english: Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh- Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 이제 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)의 지도자가 된 Lieutenant Strongaxe(스트롱액스 중위)는 부족을 이끌고 동굴 더 깊은 곳으로 내려갔어요. 그들은 이 동굴을 발견했고, 여기에 도르게슌의 도시 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 세웠답니다.

english: The god Zamorak attacked the other gods, starting a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Zamorak(자모락) 신이 다른 신들을 공격하면서 대전쟁이 시작됐어요. 고블린들은 서로, 그리고 다른 종족들과 수많은 피비린내 나는 전투를 치러야 했죠.

english: The other gods decided to remove the great god Zaros from power, and started a great war. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: 다른 신들이 위대한 신 Zaros(자로스)를 권좌에서 끌어내리기로 하면서 대전쟁이 시작됐어요. 고블린들은 서로, 그리고 다른 종족들과 수많은 피비린내 나는 전투를 치러야 했죠.

english: In order to preserve balance, the god Guthix made the other gods fight against one another. The goblins were sent to fight in many bloody battles against each other and other races.
translation: Guthix(구식스) 신이 균형을 지키기 위해 다른 신들끼리 서로 싸우게 만들었어요. 고블린들은 서로, 그리고 다른 종족들과 수많은 피비린내 나는 전투를 치러야 했죠.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Big High War God.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신)이라는 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Zamorak.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 Zamorak(자모락)이라는 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 Guthix(구식스)라는 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called Saradomin.
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 Saradomin(사라도민)이라는 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

english: Before Dorgesh-Kaan, the Dorgeshuun lived on the surface with many other goblin tribes. All goblins were ruled over by an evil god called [player name].
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)이 생기기 전, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 다른 여러 고블린 부족과 함께 지상에서 살았어요. 모든 고블린은 [player name](이)라는 사악한 신의 지배를 받았죠.

english: Can you tell me about the Dorgeshuun civil war?
Certainly!  *Ahem*
At first, Dorgesh-Kaan was ruled over by generals, just as the tribe had been when it was on the surface. Each general succeeded the last by defeating him in combat.
translation: 처음에 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)은 부족이 지상에 있던 시절처럼 장군들이 다스렸어요. 새 장군은 전임 장군을 결투로 쓰러뜨려야 자리를 이을 수 있었죠.

english: The generals were advised by a council of elders, but the Dorgeshuun were no longer an army, and many of the people felt that the Council should have authority.
translation: 장군들은 원로 회의의 조언을 받았지만, Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 더 이상 군대가 아니었기에 많은 이들이 의회가 권한을 가져야 한다고 생각했어요.

english: The people voted to become a republic, but General Bonehelm refused to give up power, and so the Dorgeshuun Civil War began.
translation: 백성들은 공화국이 되기로 투표했지만, General Bonehelm(본헬름 장군)이 권력을 내놓기를 거부하면서 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 내전이 시작됐어요.

english: The republican faction was larger, but the military faction contained most of the trained warriors and controlled the magical equipment that the tribe had brought from the surface.
translation: 공화파가 수는 더 많았지만, 군부파에는 훈련된 전사 대부분이 있었고 부족이 지상에서 가져온 마법 장비도 그들이 쥐고 있었어요.

english: General Bonehelm was driven from the city, but dug his own base out of the caves nearby.
translation: General Bonehelm(본헬름 장군)은 도시에서 쫓겨났지만, 근처 동굴을 파서 자기만의 기지를 만들었어요.

english: General Bonehelm's army attacked the city using archers mounted on giant frogs. There was a bloody battle, and General Bonehelm was driven back again into his base.
translation: General Bonehelm(본헬름 장군)의 군대는 거대 개구리를 탄 궁수들을 앞세워 도시를 공격했어요. 피비린내 나는 전투 끝에 본헬름 장군은 다시 기지로 쫓겨났죠.

english: But General Bonehelm's mining had weakened the stone around his base, and the retreating army's footsteps caused the roof to collapse, crushing his army.
translation: 하지만 General Bonehelm(본헬름 장군)이 굴을 파느라 기지 주변의 암반이 약해져 있었고, 퇴각하는 군대의 발걸음에 천장이 무너져 그의 군대는 깔려 버렸어요.

english: That was the last time one Dorgeshuun has raised arms against another. Since then, the city has been ruled peacefully by an elected council.
translation: 그 뒤로 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)끼리 무기를 겨눈 일은 한 번도 없었어요. 그때부터 도시는 선출된 의회가 평화롭게 다스리고 있죠.

english: Can you tell me about recent years?
translation: 최근 몇 년 동안의 일을 얘기해 주실래요?

english: Ah, this is where you come in!  *Ahem*

In the twenty-ninth century since the founding of the city, one of the miners broke through a wall into the cellar of a surface dwelling. The miners blocked up the tunnel and went back into their mines.
translation: 도시가 세워진 지 29세기째 되던 때, 광부 하나가 벽을 뚫다가 어느 지상 가옥의 지하실로 들어가 버렸어요. 광부들은 터널을 막아 버리고 다시 광산으로 돌아갔죠.

english: However, a human named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 그런데 [player name](이)라는 인간이 [his/her] 힘으로 동굴을 헤치고 와서 광부들과 접촉했어요.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with Duke Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: 의회의 수장 Ur-tag(우르-타그)는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 광산 위 마을의 통치자인 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 Duke Horacio(호레이시오 공작)과 평화 조약을 맺었어요.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called H.A.M. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 하지만 지상 주민이 모두 우호적이지는 않았어요. H.A.M.이라는 세력이 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)을 멸망시키려 했죠.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the H.A.M. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a H.A.M. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.[confirmation needed]
translation: 의회는 H.A.M. 일당이 무슨 음모를 꾸미는지 알아보려고 Zanik(자닉)을 지상으로 보냈어요. [player name]의 도움으로 자닉은 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 물에 잠기게 하려던 H.A.M.의 음모를 막아 냈죠.[confirmation needed]

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface- dwellers.[confirmation needed]
translation: 많은 시민들이 꺼렸지만, 의회는 결국 4 대 3으로 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 지상 주민들에게 개방하기로 의결했어요.[confirmation needed]

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called B.A.C.O.N. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 하지만 지상 주민이 모두 우호적이지는 않았어요. B.A.C.O.N.이라는 세력이 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)을 멸망시키려 했죠.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.A.C.O.N. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a B.A.C.O.N. plot to flood Dorgesh- Kaan.[confirmation needed]
translation: 의회는 B.A.C.O.N. 일당이 무슨 음모를 꾸미는지 알아보려고 Zanik(자닉)을 지상으로 보냈어요. [player name]의 도움으로 자닉은 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 물에 잠기게 하려던 B.A.C.O.N.의 음모를 막아 냈죠.[confirmation needed]

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called P.O.R.K. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 하지만 지상 주민이 모두 우호적이지는 않았어요. P.O.R.K.라는 세력이 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)을 멸망시키려 했죠.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the P.O.R.K. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a P.O.R.K. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 의회는 P.O.R.K. 일당이 무슨 음모를 꾸미는지 알아보려고 Zanik(자닉)을 지상으로 보냈어요. [player name]의 도움으로 자닉은 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 물에 잠기게 하려던 P.O.R.K.의 음모를 막아 냈죠.

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface- dwellers.
translation: 많은 시민들이 꺼렸지만, 의회는 결국 4 대 3으로 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 지상 주민들에게 개방하기로 의결했어요.

english: But not all surface-dwellers were friendly, and a faction called B.E.E.F. attempted to destroy the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 하지만 지상 주민이 모두 우호적이지는 않았어요. B.E.E.F.라는 세력이 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)을 멸망시키려 했죠.

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.E.E.F. group was plotting anything. With %USERNAME%'s help, Zanik defeated a B.E.E.F. plot to flood Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 의회는 B.E.E.F. 일당이 무슨 음모를 꾸미는지 알아보려고 Zanik(자닉)을 지상으로 보냈어요. %USERNAME%의 도움으로 자닉은 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)을 물에 잠기게 하려던 B.E.E.F.의 음모를 막아 냈죠.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with General Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: 의회의 수장 Ur-tag(우르-타그)는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 광산 위 마을의 통치자인 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 General Horacio(호레이시오 장군)과 평화 조약을 맺었어요.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with King Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: 의회의 수장 Ur-tag(우르-타그)는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 광산 위 마을의 통치자인 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 King Horacio(호레이시오 왕)과 평화 조약을 맺었어요.

english: Ur-tag, head of the Council, signed a peace treaty with Lord Horacio of Lumbridge, ruler of the town above the Dorgeshuuns' mine.
translation: 의회의 수장 Ur-tag(우르-타그)는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 광산 위 마을의 통치자인 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 Lord Horacio(호레이시오 영주)와 평화 조약을 맺었어요.

english: However, an ogre named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 그런데 [player name](이)라는 오우거가 [his/her] 힘으로 동굴을 헤치고 와서 광부들과 접촉했어요.

english: However, a dwarf named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 그런데 [player name](이)라는 드워프가 [his/her] 힘으로 동굴을 헤치고 와서 광부들과 접촉했어요.

english: However, an elf named [player name] found [his/her] way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 그런데 [player name](이)라는 엘프가 [his/her] 힘으로 동굴을 헤치고 와서 광부들과 접촉했어요.

english: Ah, hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is the dig going?
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, Zanik(자닉). 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 발굴은 잘돼 가요?

english: [player name] helped us to finish the dig! Look what [he/she] dug up!
translation: [player name] 덕분에 발굴을 끝냈어요! [he/she]가 파낸 것 좀 보세요!

english: Hmm... that is interesting. What do you think it is?
It's a mace.
[player name] says that's a kind of weapon.
I can see how. I certainly wouldn't want to be hit with it!
translation: 그래 보이네요. 저런 걸로 얻어맞고 싶진 않네요!

english: We think it's a magical weapon from the surface. Can you decipher the symbols on it?
translation: 지상에서 온 마법 무기 같아요. 여기 새겨진 기호를 해독할 수 있겠어요?

english: Hmm...
No, I'm afraid not. Our written language has developed so much since then that it's totally indecipherable to me.
translation: 아뇨, 안타깝지만 못 하겠어요. 그 뒤로 우리 문자가 너무 많이 바뀌어서 저로서는 전혀 알아볼 수가 없네요.

english: Oh well.
Wait a moment. [player name], didn't you say you talked to some surface goblins when you were trying to find your way through our mines?
translation: 잠깐만요. [player name]님, 우리 광산을 지나는 길을 찾을 때 지상 고블린들이랑 얘기해 봤다고 하지 않으셨어요?

english: Yes, I talked to the generals in the Goblin Village.
translation: 네, Goblin Village(고블린 마을)의 장군들과 얘기했어요.

english: Perhaps you could talk to them again. They might know more about weapons than we do.
translation: 그들한테 다시 가서 물어보는 건 어때요? 무기라면 우리보다 더 잘 알지도 몰라요.

english: Good idea!
Hello, Zanik. Have you found out about that mace yet?
translation: 안녕하세요, Zanik(자닉). 그 철퇴에 대해 뭐 좀 알아냈어요?

english: Not yet. Come on, [player name]! We should go and ask the goblin generals about it!
translation: 아직이요. 가요, [player name]! 고블린 장군들한테 물어보러 가야 해요!

english: Tell me again about the surface. You said the cavern ceiling was how high?
translation: 지상 얘기 좀 다시 해 줘요. 동굴 천장이 얼마나 높다고 했죠?

english: No, there was no cavern ceiling. Just a great expanse of blue sky!
translation: 아뇨, 동굴 천장 같은 건 없었어요. 그냥 파란 하늘이 끝없이 펼쳐져 있었다니까요!

english: You couldn't see how high the ceiling was because the sky was in the way. I see.
translation: 하늘이 가로막고 있어서 천장이 얼마나 높은지 볼 수 없었다는 거군요. 알겠어요.

english: No, you don't understand. There was NO ceiling. The surface is right on top of the world! There's no more rock above it!
translation: 아뇨, 그게 아니라니까요. 천장이 아예 없어요. 지상은 세상의 맨 꼭대기에 있어요! 그 위엔 바위가 더 없다고요!

english: I'm still having trouble getting my head around this 'surface' idea.
translation: 이 '지상'이라는 개념은 아직도 도무지 머리에 안 들어오네요.

english: Perhaps I should take you to see it?
Oh, no, no, no. I think I'd rather stay here and write about it.
translation: 아, 아뇨, 아뇨, 아뇨. 저는 그냥 여기 남아서 글로 쓰는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Alright. Hello, %USERNAME%.
Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
translation: 안녕하세요, Zanik(자닉)! 그동안 뭐 하고 지냈어요?

english: What are you doing?
He's a duke.
He's a general.
He's a king.
He's a lord.
Nobody knows.
Big High War God.
translation: Big High War God(위대하고 높은 전쟁의 신).

english: Zamorak.
More...
It was Guthix.
It was Saradomin.
It was [player name]
It was for the gods' own entertainment.
Zamorak attacked the other gods.
The other gods attacked Zaros.
Guthix wanted to preserve balance.
H.A.M.
B.A.C.O.N.
P.O.R.K.
B.E.E.F.
I'm human!
I'm an ogre.
I'm a dwarf.
I'm an elf.
What is this building?
Can you tell me about the history of the city?
translation: 이 도시의 역사에 대해 얘기해 주실래요?

english: The founding of Dorgesh-Kaan.
The Dorgeshuun civil war.
Recent years.
What can I get you?
What are you serving?
Can you tell me where I am?
You're in The Golden Field. There's a bank to the south and my grandfather's fruit farm is south-east near the beach. Fancy a drink now?
translation: 여긴 The Golden Field(황금 들판)이에요. 남쪽에 은행이 있고, 우리 할아버지 과일 농장은 남동쪽 해변 근처에 있어요. 이제 한잔하실래요?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: 듣자 하니 Veos(베오스)가 뭔가 도와줄 사람을 찾고 있대요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스) 부두 근처에 자주 있어요.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 문제가 생겼대요. 갱단들이 손을 잡았다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 아들 하나를 잃어버렸대요. 무사히 데려다주면 호시디우스 가문에서 사례를 두둑이 할지도 몰라요.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)가 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 뭔가 도와줄 사람을 찾고 있다던데요. 알아볼 만할 거예요.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 통치자들한테 일거리가 있대요. Lovakengj Assembly(로바켕기 의회)에 가면 만날 수 있어요.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 한복판에서 무슨 소동이 있었대요. 한번 가 볼 만할 거예요.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성) 밖에서 벌어지는 시위가 슬슬 관심을 끌고 있어요. 한번 가 보는 것도 좋겠네요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
I'm okay, thanks.
With some of these drinks inside you, you could be far more than merely okay!
translation: 여기 술 몇 잔 들어가면 그냥 괜찮은 정도가 아니라 훨씬 더 좋아질 텐데요!

english: What are you serving?
Can you tell me where I am?
I'm okay, thanks.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: What are you doing down here? Leave before you get yourself into trouble.
translation: 여기서 뭐 하는 거예요? 험한 꼴 당하기 전에 얼른 나가요.

english: Hello, are you okay?
It's just those blasted hob-gobs. I locked myself in here for protection. But I've left the key somewhere and now I'm stuck.
translation: 그 망할 홉고블린 놈들 때문이에요. 몸을 지키려고 스스로 여기 들어와 잠갔는데, 열쇠를 어디다 뒀는지 잊어버려서 이제 꼼짝도 못 해요.

english: Okay... I'll have a look for a key.
Hello, who are you?
I am Golrie, I've been stuck here for ages, those hob-gobs are trying to steal my family's heirlooms. My grandad gave me all sorts of old junk.
translation: 전 Golrie(골리)예요. 여기 갇힌 지 한참 됐어요. 저 홉고블린 놈들이 우리 집안 가보를 훔치려고 해요. 할아버지가 온갖 오래된 잡동사니를 물려주셨거든요.

english: Do you mind if I have a look?
No, of course not.
You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble.
translation: 바닥의 잡동사니를 뒤지다가 Glarial's pebble(글라리알의 조약돌)을 찾았다.

english: Could I take this old pebble?
Oh that, yes have it, it's just some old elven junk I believe.
translation: 아, 그거요. 가져가요. 그냥 엘프가 쓰던 오래된 잡동사니일 거예요.

english: Thanks for the key traveller. I think I'll wait in here until those hob-gobs get bored and leave.
translation: 열쇠 고마워요, 여행자 양반. 저 홉고블린 놈들이 지겨워서 떠날 때까지 여기서 기다릴래요.

english: Okay, take care Golrie.
Hello Golrie.
Hello again.
Do you mind if I have another look through this stuff?
translation: 이 물건들 다시 좀 둘러봐도 될까요?

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor but find nothing of interest.
translation: 바닥의 잡동사니를 뒤져 보았지만 쓸 만한 건 없었다.

english: Hello, Golrie. How's it going?
Better now I'm on the right side of these bars.
translation: 이 창살 바깥쪽에 있으니 이제 좀 살 것 같아요.

english: Found anything interesting recently?
It just so happens I have. Take a look at this book.
translation: 마침 찾았죠. 이 책 좀 보세요.

english: Thanks.
I managed to find that device.
Wonderful! Though you know, I don't think you ever actually mentioned what the device does.
translation: 잘됐네요! 그런데 생각해 보니 그 장치가 뭘 하는 건지 말해 준 적이 없잖아요.

english: It counteracts illusion magic in the surrounding area. This one should cover the whole of the Tree Gnome Village. It might be useful for someone to remember that in case it's needed again.
translation: 주변 지역의 환영 마법을 무력화해요. 이건 Tree Gnome Village(나무 노움 마을) 전체를 덮을 거예요. 혹시 다시 필요할 때를 대비해서 누군가 기억해 두면 좋을 거예요.

english: Oh, well I'll be sure to keep that in mind.
I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: Bolrie(볼리)의 일기장을 찾았어요. 이것에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Of course! Bolrie is my grandfather... assuming he's still alive, at least.
translation: 당연하죠! Bolrie(볼리)는 우리 할아버지예요... 아직 살아 계신다면 말이죠.

english: Bolrie... Golrie... I should have guessed. You seem to like giving your children similar names, just to be confusing.
translation: Bolrie(볼리)... Golrie(골리)... 진작 눈치챘어야 했는데. 일부러 헷갈리라고 자식들한테 비슷한 이름을 붙이나 봐요.

english: Certainly, in our family that's true. King Bolren is also Bolrie's younger brother, in case you didn't know.
translation: 우리 집안은 확실히 그래요. 그리고 혹시 모르셨다면, King Bolren(볼렌 왕)은 Bolrie(볼리)의 남동생이에요.

english: So that means you're King Bolren's grand-nephew, right?
translation: 그럼 당신은 King Bolren(볼렌 왕)의 조카손자인 거네요?

english: That's right.
Does that mean that you're in line for the throne?
translation: 그럼 왕위 계승 서열에도 들어 있는 거예요?

english: Gnomes don't have a hereditary monarchy. We have a democratic monarchy. We vote for our kings.
translation: 노움은 세습 군주제가 아니에요. 민주 군주제죠. 왕을 투표로 뽑아요.

english: Oh, that's unusual. So you've never thought about being the King?
translation: 아, 특이하네요. 그럼 왕이 되겠다는 생각은 해 본 적 없어요?

english: That might be fun. I wouldn't want to be like gramps though. He liked wars a bit too much. I do sometimes discuss the Khazard War with the hobgobbos, but they don't have a particularly sharp political sense.
translation: 그것도 재밌겠네요. 그래도 할아버지처럼 되고 싶진 않아요. 할아버지는 전쟁을 너무 좋아하셨거든요. 가끔 홉고블린 녀석들이랑 Khazard War(카자드 전쟁) 얘기를 하는데, 걔들은 정치 감각이 그리 날카롭지 않아요.

english: Personally, I don't think we should fight his troops head- on. We're smarter than that. We should come up with some ingenious method of defeating Khazard, like they did at the Battle of Atarisundri!
translation: 개인적으로는 그 군대와 정면으로 맞붙으면 안 된다고 봐요. 우린 그보다 똑똑하잖아요. Battle of Atarisundri(아타리선드리 전투) 때처럼 Khazard(카자드)를 무찌를 기발한 방법을 생각해 내야 해요!

english: You're very well informed for a gnome in a cave. Most gnomes I've talked to have forgotten most of their own history.
translation: 동굴에 사는 노움치고는 정말 박식하네요. 제가 만나 본 노움들은 대부분 자기네 역사를 거의 다 잊어버렸던데요.

english: Gnomes don't tend to dwell on the past, but I suppose I'm not a typical gnome. I get lots of time to think and read in here.
translation: 노움들은 원래 과거에 연연하지 않지만, 전 평범한 노움은 아닌가 봐요. 여기선 생각하고 책 읽을 시간이 많거든요.

english: So have you heard from Bolrie recently?
translation: 그럼 최근에 Bolrie(볼리)한테서 소식 들은 거 있어요?

english: No, the parcels stopped arriving a few years ago. I guess he's either found what he was looking for, or has died in the attempt.
translation: 아뇨, 몇 년 전부터 소포가 끊겼어요. 찾던 걸 찾으셨거나, 아니면 찾다가 돌아가셨겠죠.

english: What was he looking for?
I'm not sure. He was definitely obsessed with finding out as much as he could about elven magic. He also seemed to have a bit of a grudge against Glouphrie.
translation: 잘 모르겠어요. 엘프 마법에 대해 알아낼 수 있는 건 다 알아내려고 단단히 집착하셨던 건 확실해요. Glouphrie(글루프리)한테 원한도 좀 있으셨던 것 같고요.

english: Maybe he's looking for Glouphrie.
translation: 어쩌면 Glouphrie(글루프리)를 찾고 계신 걸지도 몰라요.

english: Who knows, eh? Who knows?
Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 저 crystal bowl(크리스탈 그릇)은 어디서 난 거예요?

english: A huge battle tortoise arrived a while back carrying a crate with it in. Sent by gramps, of course. It looks pretty, doesn't it? Would probably look great with some plants in it.
translation: 얼마 전에 커다란 전투 거북이 나무 상자를 싣고 왔는데, 그 안에 들어 있었어요. 당연히 할아버지가 보낸 거죠. 예쁘지 않아요? 식물 좀 심어 두면 아주 근사할 것 같아요.

english: I don't think it's meant to be used as a plant pot.
translation: 그건 화분으로 쓰라고 만든 물건이 아닌 것 같아요.

english: Well, what's it for then?
It's a singing bowl. You can use it to shape elven crystal.
translation: 그건 singing bowl(노래하는 그릇)이에요. 엘프 크리스탈을 다듬는 데 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Ohh... How exciting!
I'd better get going.
See you later.
I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 당신 창고에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: I lost that pebble.
Not to worry. It turned up here again.
translation: 걱정 마요. 여기 다시 굴러들어 왔더라고요.

english: Can I use your key?
If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs, that's your business.
translation: 그 홉고블린 놈들이랑 같이 들어가고 싶으면 맘대로 해요.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Yes, lots to do. Them hob-gobs left my stuff out here in a right mess. Until next time.
translation: 네, 할 일이 산더미예요. 홉고블린 놈들이 밖에다 내 물건을 엉망으로 어질러 놨거든요. 다음에 또 봐요.

english: Found anything interesting recently?
I managed to find that device.
I found Bolrie's diary. Do you know anything about it?
translation: Bolrie(볼리)의 일기장을 찾았어요. 이것에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Where did that crystal bowl come from?
translation: 저 crystal bowl(크리스탈 그릇)은 어디서 난 거예요?

english: I'd better get going.
I have a question about your storeroom.
translation: 당신 창고에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: I lost that pebble.
Can I use your key?
I'll leave you to it.
*HONK*
Of course, you honk. I don't know what I was expecting.
translation: 그래, 당연히 꽥 하겠지. 내가 뭘 기대한 건지.

english: That is one large, loud chicken.
I take it that stealth is not your speciality.
The goose looks at you knowingly. It remembers all of your Christmas Achievements!
translation: 거위가 다 안다는 듯이 당신을 바라본다. 당신의 크리스마스 업적을 전부 기억하고 있다!

english: ...Six Geese a-laying...
That's a loud honk.
Ha, HONK right back at you.
What would a goose want with a pub?
Looking closer at the Goose's hat. It's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 거위의 모자를 자세히 보니 'Wolfy(울피)'라는 이름이 적혀 있다.

english: You're actually pretty cute with that little hat.
translation: 그 작은 모자 쓰니까 꽤 귀엽네.

english: Looking closer at the goose's hat, it's got the name 'Wolfy' written on it.
translation: 거위의 모자를 자세히 보니 'Wolfy(울피)'라는 이름이 적혀 있다.

english: I wonder where you came from?
Hello. Who are you?
The name's Gordon. Good day to you.
It's a nice farm you've got here.
Thank you. We built it ourselves.
Really? So you haven't been here long?
translation: 정말요? 그럼 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐어요?

english: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. But then some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was.
translation: 네. 얼마 전까지만 해도 이 근방은 안전하게 다닐 수가 없었어요. lizardmen(리자드맨)이 너무 많았거든요. 그런데 Hosidius(호시디우스) 탐험가들이 이 땅이 얼마나 비옥한지 알아냈죠.

english: Lord Hosidius made a deal with Lord Shayzien and the lizardmen were cleared out to make room for the Farming Guild.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 영주)와 협정을 맺었고, Farming Guild(농사 길드)를 지을 자리를 마련하려고 리자드맨들을 몰아냈어요.

english: When we heard, we decided to come up here and start up our own farm.
translation: 그 소식을 듣고 우리도 여기 올라와서 농장을 차리기로 했죠.

english: Need a hand with anything?
Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
Thank you friend. See you later.
Hello again. How are things?
Hello there. Not too bad, thanks.
Great to hear. All the best.
Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast.
translation: 또 오셨군요. 그 짐승을 처리해 줘서 고마워요.

english: Hello again. Thank you for dealing with that beast. As promised, here's your reward.
translation: 또 오셨군요. 그 짐승을 처리해 줘서 고마워요. 약속대로 보상이에요.

english: It's my pleasure.
Need a hand with anything?
Very nice. Well I hope it goes well for you.
Great to hear. All the best.
Hello.
Good day, can I help you?
No thanks I'm just watching the world go by.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 그냥 세상 돌아가는 걸 구경하고 있어요.

english: Well I can think of no better place to do it, it is beautiful here is it not?
translation: 그러기에 이보다 좋은 곳은 없을 것이오. 이곳은 참 아름답지 않소?

english: Indeed it is.
Well this was once the best place to do it, it used to be beautiful here.
translation: 예전엔 그러기에 가장 좋은 곳이었소. 한때는 이곳도 아름다웠다오.

english: Will you repair the damage?
In time, once the war is over, assuming we survive it.
translation: 때가 되면 하겠소. 전쟁이 끝나면 말이오. 우리가 살아남는다면.

english: Here, solve this.
Goreu hands you a [light/puzzle] box.
That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 내가 보기엔 다 푼 것 같지 않소.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
What do you think you're doing?
Greetings human.
Hello. What is this place?
This is one of your human banks. We set it up here to help your kind serve the balance with us.
translation: 이곳은 너희 인간들의 은행이오. 너희 같은 자들이 우리와 함께 균형을 섬길 수 있도록 여기 세웠소.

english: Do you not use it yourself?
No. We have no need for it. We have no possessions. We only have our cause.
translation: 그렇소. 우리에겐 필요 없소. 우리는 가진 것이 없소. 오직 우리의 대의뿐이오.

english: To serve the balance?
To serve the balance.

Well, this has certainly been exciting! The Sinclairs under house arrest, Morgan Le Faye attempting yet again to interfere with King Arthur and Merlin, and even the Black Knights sticking their noses into it.
translation: 어머, 정말 흥미진진했지 뭐예요! Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문 사람들은 가택 연금을 당하고, Morgan Le Faye(모건 르 페이)는 또다시 King Arthur(아서 왕)과 Merlin(멀린)의 일에 끼어들려 하고, 거기다 Black Knights(흑기사)까지 코를 들이밀었잖아요.

english: How do you know all that? It only just happened, and you weren't there!
translation: 그걸 어떻게 다 아세요? 방금 일어난 일인 데다, 그 자리에 계시지도 않았잖아요!

english: I have my sources. No secret is safe as long as I'm around!
translation: 나한테도 정보원이 있거든요. 내가 있는 한 비밀은 절대 지켜지지 않아요!

english: Could I ask you about the Sinclair family again?
translation: Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문에 대해 다시 여쭤봐도 될까요?

english: Well, I'm not one to gossip, but as it's for your investigation... What would you like to know?
translation: 뭐, 내가 남 얘기 하는 사람은 아니지만, 수사를 위한 거라니까... 뭐가 알고 싶어요?

english: Tell me about the family.
I've heard plenty about each of them...but I'll try to keep it as short as I can.
translation: 한 사람 한 사람에 대해 들은 얘기가 아주 많지만... 최대한 짧게 해 볼게요.

english: Old Lord Sinclair was a well respected man this side of White Wolf. He was great friends with King Ulthas and did many good works for the kingdom.
translation: 돌아가신 Lord Sinclair(싱클레어 경)은 White Wolf(흰 늑대 산) 이쪽에서 아주 존경받던 분이었어요. King Ulthas(울타스 왕)과 절친한 사이였고, 왕국을 위해 좋은 일도 많이 하셨죠.

english: His children on the other hand were spoiled and horrid. They cared for no one but themselves and gave themselves such aires. Each had their own vice, but I didn't expect any of them would be driven to murder!
translation: 그런데 자식들은 버릇없고 끔찍했어요. 자기들밖에 몰랐고 어찌나 잘난 척을 하던지. 저마다 나쁜 버릇이 하나씩 있었지만, 그중 누가 살인까지 저지를 줄은 몰랐다니까요!

english: What have they been up to since the arrest of their sibling?
translation: 형제가 체포된 뒤로 그 사람들은 어떻게 지내고 있나요?

english: They've been living very quietly, a nice change from the norm. But almost too quietly. I always thought they'd get into more trouble. No good will come from them, let me tell you!
translation: 아주 조용히 지내고 있어요. 평소랑 달라서 좋긴 한데, 좀 지나치게 조용하달까. 난 늘 그 사람들이 사고를 더 칠 줄 알았거든요. 그 사람들한테선 좋은 일이 하나도 안 나올 거예요, 내 말 믿어요!

english: Tell me about the mansion.
The mansion? The mansion is quite new. Originally, the Sinclair family lived in Camelot, although it went under a different name then.
translation: 저택이요? 저택은 꽤 새 건물이에요. 원래 Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문은 Camelot(카멜롯)에서 살았어요. 그때는 이름이 달랐지만요.

english: But when King Arthur and his knights appeared, old Lord Sinclair agreed with King Ulthas that the knights had greater need for the castle than the Sinclair family.
translation: 그런데 King Arthur(아서 왕)과 기사들이 나타나자, 돌아가신 Lord Sinclair(싱클레어 경)께서는 King Ulthas(울타스 왕)과 뜻을 같이해 Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문보다 기사들에게 그 성이 더 필요하다고 하셨죠.

english: So, Lord Sinclair had the mansion built, packed his family up and vacated. His children were furious with him for doing it.
translation: 그래서 Lord Sinclair(싱클레어 경)은 저택을 짓고 가족들을 데리고 성을 비워 주셨어요. 자식들은 그 일로 아버지한테 몹시 화를 냈고요.

english: They felt themselves far better than the knights and felt insulted at having to live in a stuffy mansion.
translation: 자기들이 기사들보다 훨씬 잘났다고 생각했으니, 답답한 저택에서 살아야 한다는 게 모욕으로 느껴졌던 거죠.

english: What happened next?
Well, you should know best... Anna killed her father. Poor man.
translation: 글쎄요, 그건 당신이 제일 잘 알 텐데... Anna(애나)가 자기 아버지를 죽였잖아요. 불쌍한 양반.

english: Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
translation: Anna Sinclair(애나 싱클레어)에 대해 말해 주세요.

english: Anna? The guards are keeping her in the jail in the courthouse in Seers' Village. I hear she's been acting like a royal pain.
translation: Anna(애나)요? 경비병들이 Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 법원 감옥에 가둬 두고 있어요. 듣자 하니 공주님이라도 되는 양 아주 골치를 썩인다나 봐요.

english: But what is she like? Can she be reasoned with?
translation: 그런데 그 사람은 어떤 사람이에요? 말이 통하는 사람인가요?

english: Reasoned with? She killed her own father!
translation: 말이 통하냐고요? 자기 아버지를 죽인 사람이에요!

english: I hear she's being so unreasonable that no lawyer in Gielinor will represent her. She's going to get a guilty verdict for sure.
translation: 어찌나 막무가내인지 Gielinor(길리노르)의 어떤 변호사도 그 사람 변호를 안 맡으려 한대요. 틀림없이 유죄 판결을 받을 거예요.

english: Still, I go and visit her at the Seers' Village courthouse sometimes to try and keep her spirits up.
translation: 그래도 난 가끔 Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 법원에 면회 가서 기운 좀 내라고 해 줘요.

english: Never mind.
Where is Anna Sinclair being held?
translation: Anna Sinclair(애나 싱클레어)는 어디에 갇혀 있나요?

english: At the Seers' Village courthouse.
Tell me about the family.
Tell me about the mansion.
Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
translation: Anna Sinclair(애나 싱클레어)에 대해 말해 주세요.

english: Never mind.
Tell me where Anna Sinclair is being held.
translation: Anna Sinclair(애나 싱클레어)가 어디에 갇혀 있는지 알려 주세요.

english: What can I do for you?
I don't know. What can you do for me?
translation: 글쎄요. 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있는데요?

english: A good question indeed! I'm selling special clothing for Agility enthusiasts.
translation: 정말 좋은 질문이에요! 저는 Agility(민첩)을 즐기는 분들을 위한 특별한 옷을 팔고 있어요.

english: Sometimes, when you're exploring the hidden rooftops of our cities, you'll find one of my Marks.
translation: 도시의 숨겨진 지붕 위를 누비다 보면 가끔 제 Marks(증표)를 발견하게 될 거예요.

english: Once you've got enough Marks, I'll exchange them for my Graceful clothing. So, does that interest you?
translation: Marks(증표)를 충분히 모으면 제 Graceful(기품 있는) 옷으로 바꿔 드릴게요. 어때요, 관심 있으세요?

english: Can I see what you're selling?
translation: 파시는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Can I see how many laps I've completed?
translation: 제가 몇 바퀴나 돌았는지 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Can I toggle my lap counter?
translation: 바퀴 수 카운터를 켜고 끌 수 있을까요?

english: Sure, I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.
translation: 그럼요, 바퀴 수 카운터 메시지를 꺼 드렸어요. 다시 켜서 한 바퀴를 마칠 때마다 총 바퀴 수를 보고 싶으시면 저한테 다시 말을 걸어 주세요.

english: Sure, I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a rooftop course. To help you keep track.
translation: 그럼요, 바퀴 수 카운터를 켜 드렸어요. 지붕 코스를 한 바퀴 돌 때마다 메시지가 나올 거예요. 기록을 확인하는 데 도움이 될 거예요.

english: I'm alright, thanks.
I don't know. What can you do for me?
translation: 글쎄요. 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있는데요?

english: Can I see what you're selling?
translation: 파시는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: I'm alright, thanks.
Can I see how many laps I've completed?
translation: 제가 몇 바퀴나 돌았는지 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Can I toggle my lap counter?
translation: 바퀴 수 카운터를 켜고 끌 수 있을까요?

english: Ting-a-ling-a-ling!
Welcome to the Grail castle. You should come inside, it's cold out here.
translation: Grail castle(성배의 성)에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 안으로 들어오시지요. 바깥은 춥답니다.

english: Somehow you are now inside the castle.
Welcome to the Grail castle.
translation: Grail castle(성배의 성)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Welcome to the Grand Exchange. Would you like to trade now, or exchange item sets?
translation: Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 지금 거래하시겠습니까, 아니면 아이템 세트를 교환하시겠습니까?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: combat Adventure Path(전투 모험 경로)를 완료하고 받은 이 교환권이 있는데요, Adventure Path(모험 경로) 보상을 받으려면 여기 와서 말씀드리라고 적혀 있어요.

english: Why yes, here is your reward.
If you wanted to, you could store the coins in the bank next to me.
translation: 원하시면 제 옆에 있는 은행에 코인을 보관하실 수 있습니다.

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 그 밖에 더 도와드릴 일이 있으십니까?

english: How do I use the Grand Exchange?
My colleague and I can let you set up trade offers. You can offer to Sell items or Buy items.
translation: 저와 제 동료가 거래 제안을 등록해 드립니다. 아이템 판매나 아이템 구매를 제안하실 수 있습니다.

english: When you want to sell something, you give us the items and tell us how much money you want for them.
translation: 무언가를 팔고 싶으시면 저희에게 아이템을 맡기시고 얼마를 받고 싶은지 말씀해 주십시오.

english: We'll look for someone who wants to buy those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the cash here, or at any bank.
translation: 저희가 그 가격에 해당 아이템을 사려는 사람을 찾아 거래를 진행해 드립니다. 대금은 이곳이나 아무 은행에서나 수령하실 수 있습니다.

english: When you want to buy something, you tell us what you want, and give us the cash you're willing to spend on it.
translation: 무언가를 사고 싶으시면 원하시는 물건을 말씀하시고, 그 물건에 쓰실 금액을 저희에게 맡겨 주십시오.

english: We'll look for someone who's selling those items at your price, and we'll perform the trade. You can then collect the items here, or at any bank, along with any left-over cash.
translation: 저희가 그 가격에 해당 아이템을 파는 사람을 찾아 거래를 진행해 드립니다. 아이템은 남은 돈과 함께 이곳이나 아무 은행에서나 수령하실 수 있습니다.

english: Sometimes it takes a while to find a matching trade offer. If you change your mind, we'll let you cancel your trade offer, and we'll return your unused items and cash.
translation: 맞는 거래 제안을 찾는 데 시간이 좀 걸릴 때도 있습니다. 마음이 바뀌시면 거래 제안을 취소하실 수 있으며, 쓰이지 않은 아이템과 돈은 돌려 드립니다.

english: That's all the essential information you need to get started. Would you like to trade now, or exchange item sets?
translation: 시작하시는 데 꼭 필요한 정보는 이게 전부입니다. 지금 거래하시겠습니까, 아니면 아이템 세트를 교환하시겠습니까?

english: I'd like to set up trade offers please.
Can you help me with item sets?
translation: 아이템 세트 좀 도와주실 수 있나요?

english: I'd like Exchange collection reminders on login, please.
translation: 로그인할 때 거래소 수령 알림을 받고 싶어요.

english: Okay, when you log in, we'll send you a message about any items that are waiting for you to collect them.
translation: 알겠습니다. 로그인하시면 수령을 기다리는 아이템이 있을 때 메시지를 보내 드리겠습니다.

english: Thank you.
I don't want Exchange collection reminders on login.
translation: 로그인할 때 거래소 수령 알림은 받고 싶지 않아요.

english: Okay, when you log in, you will no longer be reminded about items waiting to be collected, unless the items only arrived after you logged out.
translation: 알겠습니다. 이제 로그인하셔도 수령을 기다리는 아이템을 알려 드리지 않습니다. 단, 로그아웃하신 뒤에 도착한 아이템은 예외입니다.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
How do I use the Grand Exchange?
I'd like to set up trade offers please.
Can you help me with item sets?
translation: 아이템 세트 좀 도와주실 수 있나요?

english: I'd like Exchange collection reminders on login, please.
translation: 로그인할 때 거래소 수령 알림을 받고 싶어요.

english: I don't want Exchange collection reminders on login.
translation: 로그인할 때 거래소 수령 알림은 받고 싶지 않아요.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Thank you.
Hello young [man/lady]!  Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
translation: 어이구, 젊은 [man/lady]! Grandpa Jack(잭 할아버지)를 보러 왔누? 이야기라면 얼마든지 들려줄 수 있지. 내가 왕년엔 이 근방에서 제일가는 어부였단다!

english: Tell me a story then.
Well, when I were a young man we used to take fishing trips over to Catherby; The fishing over there - now that was something!
translation: 그래, 내가 젊었을 적엔 Catherby(캐서비)로 낚시 여행을 다니곤 했지. 거기 낚시는 말이야, 정말 대단했단다!

english: Anyway, we decided to do a bit of fishing with our nets, I wasn't having the best of days turning up nothing but old boots and bits of seaweed. Then my net suddenly got really heavy!
translation: 아무튼, 우리는 그물로 낚시를 좀 해 보기로 했는데, 그날은 운이 영 없어서 낡은 장화랑 해초 쪼가리만 줄줄이 올라오더구나. 그러다 갑자기 그물이 엄청나게 무거워지는 게 아니겠니!

english: I pulled it up...
To my amazement I'd caught this little chest thing!
translation: 세상에, 웬 작은 상자 같은 게 걸려 있지 뭐냐!

english: Even more amazing was when I opened it it contained a diamond the size of a radish! That's the best catch I've ever had!
translation: 더 놀라운 건 그걸 열어 봤더니 무만 한 다이아몬드가 들어 있었다는 거야! 내 평생 그만한 대어는 없었지!

english: Sorry, I don't have time now.
Sigh...
Young people - always in such a rush.
translation: 요즘 젊은것들은 - 하여간 늘 그렇게 바쁘다니까.

english: Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
translation: 할아버지 낚싯대 하나 살 수 있을까요?

english: Of course you can young man. Let's see now...I think 5 gold is a fair price for a rod which has won the Fishing contest before eh?
translation: 물론이지, 젊은이. 어디 보자... Fishing(낚시) 대회에서 우승까지 한 낚싯대니까 5골드면 적당한 값이겠지, 안 그러냐?

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'll go get some and come back.
translation: 돈이 모자라네요. 가서 좀 구해 올게요.

english: Right you are. I'll be here.
Very fair, I'll buy that rod!
Excellent choice!
Only problem is, I don't have any space to carry one right now. Let me get back to you on that.
translation: 그런데 문제는 지금 들고 다닐 공간이 없어요. 나중에 다시 올게요.

english: Thanks!
You're welcome young 'un.
That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.
If you're sure.... passing up an opportunity of a lifetime you are.
translation: 정 그렇다면야.... 평생 한 번 올까 말까 한 기회를 놓치는 게야.

english: I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?
translation: 낚시하는 법을 잊어버렸어요. 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Of course! Let me see now...You'll need a rod and bait. You can fish with a net too, but not in the competition.
translation: 물론이지! 어디 보자... 낚싯대랑 미끼가 있어야 한다. 그물로도 낚시할 수 있지만, 대회에선 안 돼.

english: Ok... I think I can get those at Catherby.
translation: 알겠어요... 그건 Catherby(캐서비)에서 구할 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: Then simply find yourself a fishing spot, either in the competition near here, or wherever you can - I recommend net fishing in Catherby. Net or Lure the fish in the fishing spot by clicking on it and then be
translation: 그다음엔 낚시터를 찾으면 된다. 이 근처 대회장이든 어디든 말이야. 난 Catherby(캐서비)에서 그물 낚시를 추천하마. 낚시터를 클릭해서 그물을 던지거나 미끼를 드리운 다음

english: patient...
It's that simple?
Yep! Go get em tiger.
translation: 그렇고말고! 자, 가서 실컷 낚아 보거라.

english: Tell me a story then.
Sorry, I don't have time now.
Can I buy one of your fishing rods?
translation: 할아버지 낚싯대 하나 살 수 있을까요?

english: Very fair, I'll buy that rod!
That's too rich for me, I'll go to Catherby.
I've forgotten how to fish, can you remind me?
translation: 낚시하는 법을 잊어버렸어요. 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Wooo wooo wooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 죄송해요, 전 유령 말을 못 해요.

english: Woo woo?
Nope, still don't understand you.
WOOOOOOOOO!
Never mind.
Mmmm, should I be writing this down?
Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
I'll come back later.
Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 우우우우우우 우우! 우우우우 우우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우 우우우. 우우우우 우우 우우? 우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우!

english: How's it going?
I'm dead.
Maybe you should try looking on the bright side of...
Oh, yeah. Nevermind.
Ok.
Are you the grave digger this entry mentions?
translation: 이 기록에 나오는 무덤 파는 사람이 당신인가요?

english: It seems likely, but I've no recollection of this conversation.
translation: 아마 그렇겠지요. 하지만 이런 대화를 나눈 기억은 없어요.

english: That's odd. Did you forget a lot when you...
translation: 이상하네요. 그럼 그때 많은 걸 잊어버리셨나요, 그러니까...

english: Died? I guess some memories have faded, but my death still lingers within me.
translation: 죽었을 때요? 몇몇 기억은 흐려진 것 같지만, 제 죽음만큼은 아직도 제 안에 남아 있어요.

english: How did it happen?
I was minding my own business while digging a grave when suddenly there was a loud metallic sound.
translation: 무덤을 파면서 제 일에만 신경 쓰고 있었는데, 갑자기 쨍그랑 하는 쇳소리가 크게 났어요.

english: And then?
I was dead... I recall seeing a man a few yards from me, speaking out loud, yet nobody else was around...
translation: 전 죽어 있었죠... 몇 걸음 떨어진 곳에 웬 남자가 소리 내어 말하고 있던 게 기억나요. 주위엔 아무도 없었는데 말이에요...

english: And?
I thought I could hear a woman's voice respond, but it was likely just the wind.
translation: 여자 목소리가 대답하는 걸 들은 것 같은데, 아마 바람 소리였을 거예요.

english: That's very peculiar.
I wouldn't think on it too long. I'd just died, my emotions were unbearable.
translation: 너무 깊이 생각하지 않는 게 좋을 거예요. 막 죽은 참이라 감정이 걷잡을 수 없었거든요.

english: I'll let you know if I figure anything out. What's your name?
translation: 뭔가 알아내면 알려 드릴게요. 성함이 어떻게 되세요?

english: Please do. My name? It's um... Sander.
translation: 꼭 그래 주세요. 제 이름이요? 그게, 음... Sander(샌더)예요.

english: Pleased to meet you Sander, I'll see you around.
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 죄송해요, 전 유령 말을 못 해요.

english: Mmmm, should I be writing this down?
I'll come back later.
Hello.
Greetings young one. What knowledge do you seek?
What do I have to do in this room?

Have you noticed all the bones around the room? These are teleported here from all over Gielinor to help clean up the landscape of countless bones left behind from combat. What better use for these bones than to convert them to nutritious fruit to be eaten by you mortals? You have to use your Bones to Bananas spell to convert the bones and then place them in the holes on the walls to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points. Unluckily for you, your health will constantly decrease from getting hit by these dropping bones so you will probably want to eat some of the bananas yourself to increase your stay here.
translation: 방 곳곳에 뼈가 널린 게 보이나? 전투 뒤에 남겨진 수많은 뼈를 치워 풍경을 깨끗이 하려고 Gielinor(길리노르) 각지에서 이리로 순간이동시켜 온 것들이지. 이 뼈를 자네들 필멸자가 먹을 영양 가득한 과일로 바꾸는 것보다 더 좋은 쓰임새가 있겠나? Bones to Bananas(본즈 투 바나나스) 주문으로 뼈를 바꾼 다음, 벽에 난 구멍에 넣으면 Graveyard Pizazz Points(묘지 피자즈 포인트)를 얻을 수 있네. 안됐지만 떨어지는 뼈에 계속 맞아서 체력이 꾸준히 줄어들 테니, 여기 더 오래 머물려면 바나나를 직접 몇 개 먹어 두는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: What are the rewards?

You will get experience from casting your bones to bananas spell and you will get Graveyard Pizazz Points when you put the bananas through the wall. Occasionally you will also be credited with a runestone to help you in your future spell casting.
translation: 본즈 투 바나나스 주문을 시전하면 경험치를 얻고, 바나나를 벽에 넣으면 Graveyard Pizazz Points(묘지 피자즈 포인트)를 얻게 되네. 가끔은 앞으로 주문을 시전할 때 도움이 되도록 룬스톤도 지급받을 걸세.

english: Got any tips that may help me?

Different bones will provide you with different numbers of bananas, so try to find the best type. Collect enough points and you will be able to buy a 'Bones to Peaches' spell from my fellow guardian above the entrance hall. This spell can be used here just like the bones to bananas spell, except this spell will give you even more experience and the peaches will restore more health!
translation: 뼈 종류에 따라 나오는 바나나 수가 다르니, 가장 좋은 종류를 찾아보게. 포인트를 충분히 모으면 입구 홀 위층에 있는 내 동료 수호자에게서 'Bones to Peaches(본즈 투 피치스)' 주문을 살 수 있네. 이 주문도 본즈 투 바나나스 주문처럼 여기서 쓸 수 있는데, 경험치를 더 많이 주고 복숭아가 체력도 더 많이 회복시켜 준다네!

english: I see.

Oh, and a word of warning: should you decide to leave this room by a method other than the exit portals, you will be teleported to the entrance and have any items that you picked up in the room removed.
translation: 아, 그리고 한 가지 경고하지. 출구 포털이 아닌 다른 방법으로 이 방을 떠나면 입구로 순간이동되고, 방에서 주운 아이템은 모두 압수될 걸세.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
What are the rewards?
Got any tips that may help me?
Thanks, bye!
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
You cannot understand the ghost.
Why are you still protesting? I have commanded Necrovarus to let you and your friends do as you like! There's no need for this anymore!
translation: 왜 아직도 시위를 하세요? 제가 Necrovarus(네크로바루스)에게 당신과 친구분들 마음대로 하게 두라고 명령했잖아요! 이제 이럴 필요 없어요!

english: There's always a need for a healthy interest in politics.
translation: 정치에 건전한 관심을 갖는 건 언제나 필요한 법이라오.

english: Okay, suit yourself then.
Hello.
Shush! I'm concentrating.
Oh, sorry.
Cook, cook, cook!
I'm so hungry!
This is gonna taste sooo good
Welcome, [Sir/Madam]. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: 어서 오세요, [Sir/Madam]. 저희 가게엔 가장 좋고 싱싱한 채소만 있답니다!

english: Welcome, Your Royal Highness. I sell only the finest and freshest vegetables!
translation: 어서 오십시오, 전하. 저희 가게엔 가장 좋고 싱싱한 채소만 있답니다!

english: Hello [Fremennik name]. You've come to the right place for yer greens!
translation: 어서 와요, [Fremennik name]. 푸성귀라면 제대로 찾아왔수다!

english: *sigh* Hi there... Happy Easter... I guess...
Happy? You don't sound too happy about it?
translation: 잘 보내라고요? 별로 즐거워 보이지 않는데요?

english: I'm just tired of Easter, really.
Easter just seems to be about rabbits, so whenever a rabbit shows up all anyone can think of is 'Ooh look at the Easter Rabbit!'.
translation: 부활절 하면 다들 토끼만 떠올리거든. 그래서 토끼가 나타나기만 하면 다들 '어머, 부활절 토끼 좀 봐!' 소리밖에 안 해.

english: I want to go out and explore Gielinor, but nobody takes me seriously enough to let me travel.
translation: 난 밖에 나가서 Gielinor(길리노르)를 탐험하고 싶은데, 아무도 날 진지하게 봐주지 않아서 여행을 못 하게 해.

english: Meanwhile, all the other holidays have a bunch of cool stuff associated with them so nobody bats an eyelid when a zombie shambles through town.
translation: 그런데 다른 명절들은 멋진 게 잔뜩 딸려 있으니까, 좀비가 비틀거리며 마을을 지나가도 아무도 눈 하나 깜짝 안 하잖아.

english: The goblins even got to keep their stupid sled track from Christmas!
translation: 고블린들은 크리스마스 때 만든 멍청한 썰매 코스까지 그대로 두고 있다고!

english: That sledding course is pretty fun, actually.
translation: 그 썰매 코스, 사실 꽤 재밌던데요.

english: *sigh* I'm sure it is, human. I tried to go on it myself but the goblins kept mobbing me about Easter eggs.
translation: *한숨* 그렇겠지, 인간. 나도 타 보려고 했는데 고블린들이 부활절 달걀 내놓으라고 떼로 몰려들었어.

english: I told them they'd have to wait until Easter like everybody else, but they wouldn't have any of it!
translation: 다른 애들처럼 부활절까지 기다리라고 했는데, 도무지 듣질 않더라니까!

english: I dunno. I just feel like as long as I live, I'm gonna be an advertisement for Easter and nothing more.
translation: 몰라. 내가 살아 있는 한 그냥 부활절 광고판 노릇이나 하다 끝날 것 같아.

english: Poor guy. Can't be nice having life's doors slammed in your face all the time.
translation: 불쌍한 녀석. 인생의 문이 늘 눈앞에서 쾅 닫히는 건 괴로운 일이죠.

english: *sigh* Yeah...
... Wait a second...
Doors... Easter.... Doors... East... Doors... Eastdo-
translation: 문(도어)... 부활절(이스터).... 도어... 이스트... 도어... 이스트도-

english: Human! I've got it! Eastdoor!
... What?
Humans only care about rabbits for Easter decorations, right? Well, what if we give these people something else to celebrate with?
translation: 인간들은 부활절 장식이라고 하면 토끼만 신경 쓰잖아, 그렇지? 그럼 사람들한테 축하할 다른 걸 주면 어떨까?

english: Then you can have your Easter and I can be a rabbit!
translation: 그럼 너희는 부활절을 즐기고, 나는 그냥 토끼로 살 수 있잖아!

english: And you plan to do this with... doors?
Eastdoors!
Joke names aside, are you sure this will work?
translation: 말장난은 그렇다 치고, 정말 이게 될까요?

english: Well... no, not really.
But hey, anything that takes the spotlight off us rabbits can't hurt! Plus, it could be fun!
translation: 그래도 뭐, 우리 토끼들한테서 관심을 돌릴 수만 있다면 손해 볼 건 없잖아! 게다가 재밌을지도 몰라!

english: What do you say, human? Do you want to help?
... Oh. Well, I'll be here if you change your mind, I guess.
translation: ... 아. 뭐, 마음 바뀌면 난 여기 있을게. 아마도.

english: Have you changed your mind, human?
Eggcellent! This is going to be the best Easter ever! Now, where to start...
translation: 알찬 결정이야! 역대 최고의 부활절이 될 거야! 자, 어디서부터 시작할까...

english: Hmm... all these brown doors aren't particularly Eastery... We should probably start by painting them.
translation: 흠... 이 갈색 문들은 별로 부활절 같지가 않네... 일단 칠부터 하는 게 좋겠어.

english: I think I have all of my supplies on me... brushes... pallette... safety goggles...
translation: 필요한 건 다 챙겨 온 것 같은데... 붓... 팔레트... 보안경...

english: Oh, ghosh darn, I'm fresh out of paint!
translation: 아, 이런 젠장, 물감이 하나도 없잖아!

english: I think there's a witch nearby who makes dyes. Maybe she has some paint?
translation: 근처에 염료 만드는 마녀가 있는 것 같던데요. 그 마녀한테 물감이 있지 않을까요?

english: Couldn't hurt to ask, I guess. If I give you some flowers to use as ingredients, can you ask her for some paint?
translation: 물어봐서 손해 볼 건 없겠지. 재료로 쓸 꽃을 줄 테니까 그 마녀한테 물감 좀 달라고 해 줄래?

english: I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
translation: 제가 Aggie(애기)한테 말해 볼게요. 재료 주세요.

english: Hmm... Human, I don't think you have enough room in your pockets for more things.
translation: 흠... 인간, 주머니에 더 넣을 자리가 없는 것 같은데.

english: There's a Bank just south down the road. You can go there to drop off a few items if you want to make space.
translation: 길 따라 바로 남쪽에 Bank(은행)이 있어. 자리를 만들고 싶으면 거기 가서 물건 좀 맡기고 와.

english: Bank? I've never been so insulted in my entire life!
Gregg hands you a bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 파스텔 색 꽃다발과 5코인짜리 IOU(차용증)을 건넨다.

english: This is... a piece of paper?
It's an IOU. We rabbits don't usually carry cash on us, I'm afraid.
translation: 차용증이야. 우리 토끼들은 원래 현금을 안 들고 다니거든. 미안.

english: If you have the ingredients on you, why not go ask her yourself?
translation: 재료가 있으면 직접 가서 물어보면 되잖아요?

english: I... Human, I honestly don't think I could stomach going.
translation: 나... 인간, 솔직히 도저히 갈 엄두가 안 나.

english: Witches aren't that scary. I'm sure Aggie is lovely once you get to know her.
translation: 마녀가 그렇게 무섭진 않아요. Aggie(애기)도 알고 보면 분명 좋은 사람일 거예요.

english: It's not that, it's... I just don't want to be ridiculed for being an Easter bunny.
translation: 그게 아니라... 그냥 부활절 토끼라고 놀림받기 싫어서 그래.

english: I've put up with being the 'cute widdle wabbit' my whole life. I don't think I can take much more of it.
translation: 평생 '귀여운 토깽이'라는 소리를 참고 살았어. 이제 더는 못 버틸 것 같아.

english: Poor guy.
So, uh... what am I meant to be doing again?
translation: 그래서, 어... 제가 뭘 하기로 했었죠?

english: You've forgotten already? Silly human!
You were about to take some ingredients off me to give to the nice dye-making witch in exchange for some paint!
translation: 나한테서 재료를 받아서, 염료 만드는 친절한 마녀한테 주고 물감이랑 바꿔 오기로 했잖아!

english: You were about to take the ingredients from me to that nice dye-making witch in the house down that alley behind the wheelbarrow!
translation: 나한테서 재료를 받아서, 외바퀴 수레 뒤쪽 골목 안 집에 사는 염료 만드는 친절한 마녀한테 가져가기로 했잖아!

english: We were going to use it to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 그걸로 부활절 분위기 나게 문을 꾸며서 사람들이 부활절 하면 토끼를 덜 떠올리게 하려는 거였잖아!

english: This seems... awfully convoluted.
Yep!
Goodbye.
So long, human! I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 잘 가, 인간! 필요한 거 있으면 난 여기 있을게.

english: I do, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 있긴 한데, 먼저 주머니에 자리부터 만들어 와야 해.

english: I can give you more flowers, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 꽃을 더 줄 수는 있는데, 먼저 주머니에 자리부터 만들어 와야 해.

english: I can give you another IOU, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 차용증을 하나 더 줄 수는 있는데, 먼저 주머니에 자리부터 만들어 와야 해.

english: Gregg quickly scratches up a new IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 5코인짜리 차용증을 서둘러 새로 휘갈겨 쓴다.

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 파스텔 색 꽃다발을 하나 더 건넨다.

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 파스텔 색 꽃다발 하나와 5코인짜리 IOU(차용증)을 또 건넨다.

english: Try not to lose these ones. If people find my IOUs, I'm gonna have quite the bill to pay!
translation: 이번엔 잃어버리지 마. 사람들이 내 차용증을 주웠다간 갚아야 할 돈이 어마어마해질 거야!

english: Silly human! You have the ingredients on you already!
translation: 바보 인간! 재료는 벌써 갖고 있잖아!

english: You need to take them to the witch who makes dyes you mentioned. Aggie, I think her name.
translation: 네가 말한 염료 만드는 마녀한테 가져가야지. 이름이 Aggie(애기)였던 것 같은데.

english: I just thought you might like more than one load of paint.
translation: 물감이 한 통보다는 많은 게 좋을 것 같아서요.

english: Hmmm... maybe, but let's get one first and see how we get on.
translation: 흐음... 그럴지도 모르지만, 일단 하나 먼저 받아 보고 어떻게 되나 보자.

english: Silly human, you're meant to give that to the nice witch down the road, not me!
translation: 바보 인간, 그건 길 아래 친절한 마녀한테 줘야지, 나한테 주는 게 아니라고!

english: Could I have some coins instead?
Human, if I had coins to give you, I wouldn't have given you an IOU in the first place!
translation: 인간, 줄 코인이 있었으면 애초에 차용증을 주지도 않았겠지!

english: Which witch, sorry?
I think she's just down that street there, in the house with the wheelbarrow in front of it.
translation: 저기 길 바로 아래, 앞에 외바퀴 수레가 있는 집에 사는 것 같아.

english: Gregg, I have something we can use as paint!
translation: Gregg(그레그), 물감으로 쓸 만한 걸 구했어요!

english: Really? Let me see!
Wait... gah, I could have sworn I had it on me!
Maybe Aggie knows where it is? You should ask her.
translation: Aggie(애기)가 어디 있는지 알지도 몰라. 한번 물어봐.

english: You give Gregg the thickened dye.
Oh! Human, this is perfect!
Now we just need a door to paint...
There's one right there. Maybe we can use it?
translation: 바로 저기 하나 있네요. 저걸 쓰면 어때요?

english: Do you think the owner will mind?
I've worked with Ned in the past; he's a nice guy. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: Ned(네드)랑은 전에 같이 일해 본 적 있어요. 좋은 사람이에요. 분명 괜찮다고 할 거예요.

english: Aggie mentioned people in Draynor could use some cheer. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: Aggie(애기) 말로는 Draynor(드레이너) 사람들한테 기운 날 일이 좀 필요하대요. 분명 괜찮다고 할 거예요.

english: Let me get my brushes and...
The camera fades to black. Sounds of painting are heard. The camera fades back in, and Ned's house door is painted cyan.
translation: 화면이 검게 페이드아웃된다. 칠하는 소리가 들린다. 화면이 다시 밝아지면 Ned(네드)의 집 문이 청록색으로 칠해져 있다.

english: The Cook can now be asked about the Easter event.
translation: 이제 Cook(요리사)에게 부활절 이벤트에 대해 물어볼 수 있다.

english: I don't mean to be a critic, but I had imagined it looking more... inspired.
translation: 트집 잡으려는 건 아닌데, 좀 더... 개성 있을 줄 알았어요.

english: Maybe if I had more colours...
Well, Aggie only mentioned the one colour of dye so we're stuck there.
translation: 음, Aggie(애기)는 염료 색을 하나밖에 말 안 했으니 이걸로 버틸 수밖에 없어요.

english: Blast! Looks like there's only one thing for it, then.
What's that?
We'll just have to decorate it ourselves! But first, we need something to decorate it with.
translation: 우리가 직접 꾸미는 수밖에! 그런데 그러려면 먼저 꾸밀 재료가 있어야 해.

english: You humans like Easter eggs, don't you? Do you know where we could get some good eggs?
translation: 너희 인간들은 부활절 달걀 좋아하지? 좋은 달걀 구할 데 알아?

english: Hmm... I don't, but I think I might know someone who does.
translation: 흠... 저는 모르지만, 알 만한 사람은 알 것 같아요.

english: There's a Cook in Lumbridge that everyone gives eggs to. He's bound to have some fancy eggs for us.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 다들 달걀을 갖다주는 Cook(요리사)가 있어요. 그 사람이라면 분명 멋진 달걀을 갖고 있을 거예요.

english: Sounds great! I can either teleport us there now, or I can meet you there if you'd prefer.
translation: 좋아! 지금 바로 거기로 순간이동시켜 줄 수도 있고, 원하면 거기서 만나도 돼.

english: Gregg can now be found at the kitchen, and the Cook talks sense again.
translation: 이제 Gregg(그레그)를 부엌에서 찾을 수 있고, Cook(요리사)가 다시 제정신으로 말한다.

english: Ok! Hold on to your hat!
But I'm not wearing a...
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3214, 0).
translation: 플레이어가 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 뒤편으로 중단할 수 없는 자가 순간이동(토끼가 걸어 주는 타인 순간이동이 아님)을 시전한다(좌표 3201, 3214, 0 부근).

english: ... hat!
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3215, 0).
translation: 플레이어가 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 뒤편으로 중단할 수 없는 자가 순간이동(토끼가 걸어 주는 타인 순간이동이 아님)을 시전한다(좌표 3201, 3215, 0 부근).

english: Ok! I'm gonna hang around here for a little bit, so come talk to me if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 알았어! 난 여기서 잠깐 어슬렁거리고 있을 테니까 마음 바뀌면 말 걸어. 아니면 거기서 보자!

english: Have you changed your mind about teleporting to Lumbridge with me?
translation: 나랑 같이 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 순간이동할 마음 생겼어?

english: Wait, you're a rabbit. How can you even teleport?
translation: 잠깐, 당신은 토끼잖아요. 어떻게 순간이동을 해요?

english: Well, you're a human. How can you teleport?
translation: 그러는 넌 인간이잖아. 넌 어떻게 순간이동하는데?

english: I just use magic.
And rabbits can't use magic?
translation: 토끼는 마법 못 쓰는 줄 알았어?

english: I didn't know rabbits could use magic!
translation: 토끼가 마법을 쓸 줄 아는지 몰랐어요!

english: Of course we can! How else do you think we make Easter happen each year?
translation: 당연히 쓸 줄 알지! 안 그러면 매년 부활절을 어떻게 차려 내겠어?

english: You make a good point...
We were about to go to Lumbridge to speak to a Cook there who has a lot of eggs!
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 가서 달걀을 잔뜩 가진 요리사랑 얘기해 보기로 했잖아!

english: We were going to use them to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 그걸로 부활절 분위기 나게 문을 꾸며서 사람들이 부활절 하면 토끼를 덜 떠올리게 하려는 거였잖아!

english: So long, human! I'll be here a little while longer if you want a teleport. Otherwise I'll see you in Lumbridge!
translation: 잘 가, 인간! 순간이동하고 싶으면 난 여기 좀 더 있을게. 아니면 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에서 보자!

english: Hello human!
Wait, aren't I supposed to be meeting you somewhere else?
translation: 잠깐, 우리 다른 데서 만나기로 하지 않았어요?

english: Yep! But I'm taking a bit of a break, and it would appear you are too, human!
translation: 맞아! 근데 잠깐 쉬는 중이야. 보아하니 너도 그런 것 같은데, 인간!

english: Can you remind me where I'm meant to be meeting you?
translation: 어디서 만나기로 했는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: I think we were going to the Lumbridge Kitchens to talk to a cook about some eggs.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 부엌에 가서 요리사한테 달걀 얘기를 하기로 했던 것 같아.

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: 오, 귀여운 토끼네! 벌써 부활절인 줄 몰랐어요!

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: 귀여워?! 귀여운 맛 좀 보여 줄까! 내가 그냥...

english: *AHEM*
Sorry.
Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: 요리사님, 장식으로 쓸 멋진 달걀을 찾고 있어요. 혹시 뭐 없으세요?

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: 흠... 달걀이야 잔뜩 있지만 대부분 케이크 만들 때 쓰는 평범한 닭 달걀이에요.

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: 그런데 생각해 보니 뭔가 있을지도 모르겠네요...

english: Go on...
I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: 제가... '특별한' 달걀 수집품이 있거든요. 아주... '특별한' 날을 위해서... 그러니까... 찬장 깊숙한 곳에 보관해 두는 거요.

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: 그런데 이번이 그만큼 특별한 날인지는 잘 모르겠네요.

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: 요리사가 찬장 안쪽을 뒤져 알록달록한 달걀 몇 개를 꺼내 Gregg(그레그)에게 건넨다.

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
Don't mention it!
Seriously, don't mention it.
Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: 자, 이제 달걀은 구했네요. 다음은 뭐예요?

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: 흠... 보송보송한 양털이 꽤 예쁠 것 같은데...

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: 여기서 북쪽으로 얼마 안 가면 양 우리가 있어요. 원하면 거기서 갓 깎은 양털을 구할 수 있을 거예요.

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
Gregg can now be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 이제 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 북쪽 양 우리에서 Gregg(그레그)를 찾을 수 있다.

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: 네, 양 우리로 가세요. 그리고 제 부엌에서 나가 주세요...

english: Oh, you're still here.
Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
translation: 응! 그냥 시간 좀 때우는 중이야!

english: Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: 북쪽에 있는 양 우리로 간다고 하지 않았어요?

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: 급할 거 없어. 양들은 우리 안에 있으니까 어디 갈 데도 없잖아.

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: 그럼 아직 여기 있는 김에 하나 더 해 줄 일이 있어요.

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: 곧 공작님 생신인데 재료가 다 떨어져 가요.

english: I think we were going to the sheep pen north of Lumbridge to get some wool.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 북쪽 양 우리에 가서 양털을 구하기로 했던 것 같아.

english: Human, what is that?
Gregg can no longer be found at the kitchen.
translation: 이제 부엌에서 Gregg(그레그)를 찾을 수 없다.

english: That's a sheep.
I know what a sheep is, human!
But what is that thing doing in the middle of all of them?
translation: 근데 저 한가운데 있는 건 대체 뭐 하는 거냐고?

english: Hm?
That's clearly just two penguins in a sheep costume!
translation: 누가 봐도 양 탈을 쓴 펭귄 두 마리잖아!

english: Hmm... I'm not entirely sure why that's there.
translation: 흠... 저게 왜 저기 있는지는 저도 잘 모르겠어요.

english: Do you think the farmer knows about it?
I'd hope so, maybe I'll ask him about it later.
Oh, that's The Thing.
We've tried explaining this to Fred the Farmer, but he thinks it's some kind of chicken-eating shapeshifting demon.
translation: Fred the Farmer(농부 프레드)한테 설명해 보려고 했는데, 닭을 잡아먹는 변신 악마인 줄 알더라고요.

english: The man won't shear his own sheep!
translation: 그 사람, 자기 양털도 안 깎는다니까요!

english: Really? Who shears them for him?
translation: 정말? 그럼 누가 대신 깎아 주는데?

english: Whichever advernturerswalk by that he can talk into doing it.
translation: 지나가는 모험가 중에 설득에 넘어가는 사람 아무나요.

english: That would include you, I guess?
... Yes.
Those agents are still there...?
You know them?
They're KGP agents sent from the Iceberg to collect information on Farmer Fred and his sheep.
translation: Iceberg(빙산)에서 보낸 KGP 요원들인데, Farmer Fred(농부 프레드)랑 그 양들에 대한 정보를 모으고 있어요.

english: Why would penguins need to spy on sheep?
They thought the sheep were also secret agents placed to stop them taking over Gielinor.
translation: 양들도 자기들이 Gielinor(길리노르)를 정복하지 못하게 막으려고 심어 둔 비밀 요원인 줄 알았대요.

english: Penguins are trying to take over Gielinor?
Yeah, they have war machines built up and everything.
translation: 네, 전쟁 기계까지 다 만들어 놨어요.

english: ... Human, are you feeling alright?
Never felt better, actually.
Well, anyway, we need to get some wool. I think three pieces would be enough.
translation: 뭐, 아무튼 양털을 구해야 해. 세 뭉치면 충분할 것 같아.

english: I tried to get it myself but these shears aren't really designed with rabbits in mind.
translation: 나도 직접 깎아 보려 했는데, 이 양털 가위는 토끼가 쓰라고 만든 게 아니더라고.

english: I could shear the sheep for you if you'd like?
Oh, thank you so much human!
I'd give you these shears but you appear to be a little overloaded.
translation: 이 양털 가위를 주고 싶은데 너 짐이 좀 많아 보인다.

english: If you don't mind running back to Lumbridge Castle, there should be a Bank on the top floor for you to put your stuff away!
translation: Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성)까지 다시 뛰어갔다 와도 괜찮으면 꼭대기 층에 Bank(은행)이 있을 테니까 거기 짐 좀 맡기고 와!

english: I've gotten this far without those good-for-nothing bankers, thank you very much!
translation: 그 쓸모없는 은행원들 없이도 여기까지 잘 왔거든요, 됐어요!

english: Gregg hands you a pair of shears.
I see you brought your own shears. Wonderful!
translation: 양털 가위를 직접 챙겨 왔구나. 훌륭해!

english: You know how to shear sheep, right human? You just walk up to them and give them a good snip!
translation: 양털 깎는 법은 알지, 인간? 그냥 다가가서 싹둑 잘라 주면 돼!

english: Just be careful - I'm fairly sure there's a ram in here and he might not appreciate it so much.
translation: 그냥 조심해. 여기 ram(숫양)이 있는 것 같은데, 그 녀석은 별로 안 좋아할 수도 있거든.

english: Oh, you'll also want to make yourself some inventory space to keep the wool in. I think there's a Bank at the top of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 아, 양털 넣을 소지품 칸도 비워 둬야 할 거야. Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 꼭대기에 Bank(은행)이 있을 거야.

english: I'm very aware of the state of my inventory, thank you.
translation: 제 소지품 상태는 제가 아주 잘 알고 있거든요, 고마워요.

english: Could I have some shears, please?
Gregg hands you another pair of shears.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 양털 가위를 하나 더 건넨다.

english: It's a good thing I grabbed a bunch of these before I headed out!
translation: 나오기 전에 이걸 잔뜩 챙겨 오길 잘했네!

english: How are you doing?
Pretty good, human. How are you?
Not too bad, actually.
This isn't the best conversation ever, I have to say.
translation: 솔직히 말해서 썩 좋은 대화는 아니네.

english: I'm gonna go back to sheep shearing.
I think that's wise, human.
Your hint is; you had some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 힌트를 주자면, 넌 양털 가위를 갖고 있었고 우린 지금 양 우리 안에 서 있어.

english: So... I should be shearing some sheep?
Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need [3/2/1] more piece[s]!
translation: 맞아! 다 깎으면 양털 가져와! [3/2/1]뭉치[s] 더 필요해!

english: Your hint is; you have some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 힌트를 주자면, 넌 양털 가위를 갖고 있고 우린 지금 양 우리 안에 서 있어.

english: Speak to you soon, human!
Human, I don't think that wool is fresh.
translation: 인간, 그 양털은 갓 깎은 게 아닌 것 같은데.

english: Does it matter?
Of course it matters! Everybody knows fresh wool is softer and shinier!
translation: 당연히 중요하지! 갓 깎은 양털이 더 부드럽고 윤기 나는 건 누구나 아는 사실이라고!

english: I didn't know that!
Well, now you do! So now you can go and get some fresh wool!
translation: 그럼 이제 알았지! 그러니까 가서 갓 깎은 양털 좀 구해 와!

english: You hand Gregg [1/2/3] piece[s] of wool.
Thanks, human! But we still need [2/1] more wool!
translation: 고마워, 인간! 그래도 양털이 [2/1]뭉치 더 필요해!

english: That's all the wool we need! Thanks a lot, human! You're a big help.
translation: 양털은 이걸로 충분해! 정말 고마워, 인간! 큰 도움이 됐어.

english: And you're a small rabbit.
If you think I'm small, you should see the rabbits in Tirannwn. They're so small most people don't even look at them.
translation: 내가 작다고 생각하면 Tirannwn(티란윈)의 토끼들을 한번 봐 봐. 너무 작아서 사람들이 쳐다보지도 않거든.

english: Where...?
Anyway, we've got all the wool, so we should probably move on. What else do we need?
translation: 아무튼 양털은 다 모았으니 다음으로 넘어가자. 또 뭐가 필요하지?

english: Hmm... some ribbons might look nice.
translation: 흠... 리본 같은 게 예쁠 것 같은데요.

english: Ribbons would be perfect, human! Do you know where we could get some?
translation: 리본이면 완벽하지, 인간! 어디서 구할 수 있는지 알아?

english: Uh... not really. The only place I can think of that does any kind of fabrics is Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.
translation: 어... 잘 모르겠어요. 옷감 같은 걸 다루는 곳은 Varrock(바록)의 Thessalia's Fine Clothes(테살리아의 고급 의상실)밖에 생각이 안 나요.

english: Thanks, human, but I don't think we need any more wool.
translation: 고마워, 인간. 근데 양털은 더 필요 없을 것 같아.

english: Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's!
translation: 뭐, 없는 것보단 낫지! Thessalia(테살리아)네 가게로 가자!

english: Wait, aren't there scary dark mages at the front of Varrock? I should probably teleport in... Would you like me to take you along, human?
translation: 잠깐, Varrock(바록) 입구에 무서운 흑마법사들이 있지 않았나? 순간이동으로 들어가는 게 좋겠어... 같이 데려가 줄까, 인간?

english: Ok! Hold on to your boots!
But I'm not wearing any...

The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) between the Varrock general store and Thessalia's Fine Clothes store (location in proximity of 3212, 3416, 0).
translation: 플레이어가 Varrock(바록) 잡화점과 Thessalia's Fine Clothes(테살리아의 고급 의상실) 사이로 중단할 수 없는 자가 순간이동(토끼가 걸어 주는 타인 순간이동이 아님)을 시전한다(좌표 3212, 3416, 0 부근).

english: ... boots!
Gregg can no longer be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 이제 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 북쪽 양 우리에서 Gregg(그레그)를 찾을 수 없다.

english: Ok, human! I'll wait here for a little bit just in case you change your mind, or you can meet me there!
translation: 알았어, 인간! 혹시 마음 바뀔지도 모르니까 여기서 잠깐 기다릴게. 아니면 거기서 만나!

english: Are you ready to go to Varrock, human?
What do you know about the dark wizards?
Most of what I know is second hand knowledge, but none of it is good!
translation: 거의 다 남한테 들은 얘기지만, 좋은 얘기는 하나도 없어!

english: Last year one of my mates walked by too close and they nearly had him for rabbit stew!
translation: 작년에 내 친구 하나가 너무 가까이 지나가다가 하마터면 토끼 스튜가 될 뻔했다니까!

english: From what I've heard, they're trying to summon a demon to attack Varrock!
translation: 듣기로는 악마를 소환해서 Varrock(바록)을 공격하려고 한대!

english: A demon? Outside of Varrock? Surely the King should do something about that?
translation: 악마요? Varrock(바록) 바로 밖에서요? 왕이 뭐라도 해야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: You'd think so, but apparently he hasn't done a thing about anything going on outside his walls for years!
translation: 그렇게 생각하겠지만, 듣자 하니 왕은 몇 년째 성벽 밖에서 무슨 일이 벌어지든 손 하나 까딱 안 했대!

english: So what are we going to do about it?
Conventientlyignore the problem by teleporting around it!
translation: 순간이동으로 피해 가면서 편리하게 문제를 모른 척하는 거지!

english: That does sound like a good plan, to be fair.
They're still there? I thought they would have cleared off after I killed their demon...
translation: 걔들 아직도 저기 있어요? 제가 걔들 악마를 처치했으니 다 떠난 줄 알았는데...

english: Wait, they actually summoned a demon?! And you killed it?!
translation: 잠깐, 진짜로 악마를 소환했다고?! 그걸 네가 처치했다고?!

english: Yeah, I managed to banish him again with some help from the gypsy in town.
translation: 네, 마을 점쟁이 도움을 받아서 다시 봉인했어요.

english: Wow! Human, that's incredible!
I bet everyone knows you as one of the greatest heroes of all time!
translation: 다들 너를 역대 최고의 영웅 중 하나로 알고 있겠지!

english: Eh, most shopkeepers don't seem to care that you managed to save the world.
translation: 에이, 상점 주인들은 대부분 제가 세상을 구했든 말든 관심도 없던데요.

english: We were about to go to Thlessia's... Thasselio's... Thlessaloa's...
translation: 우리 테셀리아네... 타셀리오네... 틀레살로아네 가게에 가려던 참이었지...

english: Thessalia's Fine Clothes?
translation: Thessalia's Fine Clothes(테살리아의 고급 의상실) 말이에요?

english: Yes! Thessalia's shop in Varrock! We were going to get some nice ribbons for decorations!
translation: 맞아! Varrock(바록)에 있는 Thessalia(테살리아)네 가게! 장식으로 쓸 예쁜 리본을 구하러 가기로 했잖아!

english: Are you sure this is a good idea?
Why wouldn't it be?
Isn't she just going to make some Easter reference that you'll get upset about?
translation: 그 사람도 결국 부활절 얘기를 꺼내서 당신 기분 상하게 하지 않을까요?

english: ... Thanks for putting that thought into my head, human.
translation: ... 그런 생각을 머릿속에 심어 줘서 고맙다, 인간.

english: Hey, cheer up! At least you're making other people feel happy.
translation: 에이, 기운 내요! 적어도 당신 덕분에 다른 사람들은 행복해지잖아요.

english: What do you mean?
