You're an Easter bunny, so obviously you remind people of Easter, which is a great time for a lot of people.
translation: 당신은 부활절 토끼니까 사람들한테 부활절을 떠올리게 하잖아요. 많은 사람들한테 부활절은 아주 즐거운 때고요.

english: Even if you don't like it, you being around makes people think of festive times and is a surefire way to get smiles on faces.
translation: 당신은 싫겠지만, 당신이 곁에 있으면 사람들이 즐거운 명절을 떠올리고, 그러면 다들 틀림없이 미소 짓게 돼요.

english: ... Huh, I never thought of it like that.
translation: ... 흠, 그렇게는 생각해 본 적 없어.

english: Thanks a lot, human! I'm still not gonna like it, but I can at least put up with being a cute Easter bunny for the rest of the year!
translation: 정말 고마워, 인간! 여전히 맘에 들진 않겠지만, 적어도 남은 한 해 동안은 귀여운 부활절 토끼 노릇을 참고 해 볼게!

english: If you change your mind about wanting a teleport I'll be here. Otherwise, I'll see you in Varrock, human!
translation: 순간이동 마음 바뀌면 난 여기 있을게. 아니면 Varrock(바록)에서 보자, 인간!

english: I think we were going to the clothes shop in the middle of Varrock to get some ribbons.
translation: Varrock(바록) 한가운데 있는 옷 가게에 가서 리본을 구하기로 했던 것 같아.

english: Oh my, aren't you just the cutest little thing!
*grumble grumble grumble*
He doesn't seem too happy. What's wrong?
translation: 별로 기분이 안 좋아 보이네요. 무슨 일 있어요?

english: Oh, uh... I'm sure it's nothing.
Anyway, we were hoping you could help us with something.
translation: 그건 그렇고, 좀 도와주셨으면 하는 게 있어요.

english: Certainly, what can I do for you?
We were hoping you might have some ribbons that we could use as decorations.
translation: 장식으로 쓸 리본이 좀 있을까 해서요.

english: Oh yes. It's Easter soon, isn't it?
We don't have any ribbons as such, but we do have some offcuts you could make some out of.
translation: 리본 자체는 없지만, 리본을 만들 수 있는 자투리 천은 좀 있어요.

english: Excellent! I'm glad I brought my scissors along!
Didn't you just have trouble using shears?
translation: 아까 양털 가위 쓰는 것도 힘들어하지 않았어요?

english: Yep, but these are rabbit scissors!
Sounds like you have a plan, then. I'll get these offcuts together for you...
translation: 그럼 계획이 있으신 것 같네요. 자투리 천을 모아 올게요...

english: Thessalia starts gathering up several offcuts of fabric.
translation: Thessalia(테살리아)가 자투리 천을 이것저것 모으기 시작한다.

english: Wait a second... what's that?!
Gregg's attention is grabbed by an extremely silly hat.
translation: 엄청나게 우스꽝스러운 모자가 Gregg(그레그)의 눈길을 사로잡는다.

english: Oh yes... that hat.
*sigh* An intern made it a few months ago. We've been trying to sell it ever since, but nobody seems to want it on account of its... stupidity.
translation: *한숨* 몇 달 전에 견습생이 만든 거예요. 그 뒤로 계속 팔아 보려고 했는데, 너무... 바보 같아서 아무도 안 사더라고요.

english: It's so shoddily made, it doesn't even spin properly!
translation: 얼마나 대충 만들었는지 제대로 돌지도 않아요!

english: I love it! Can I have it!
Wait... you actually want that thing?
Yeah! Look how colourful it is! It's great!
Well, you're more than welcome to take it. It's not like we can sell it anyway.
translation: 음, 얼마든지 가져가세요. 어차피 팔리지도 않을 테니까요.

english: Yay! Just let me get this...
... over the ears and...
... hmph. Can't seem to get it on.
Well, it was designed for humans, not rabbits.
translation: 그거 토끼 말고 인간용으로 만든 거잖아요.

english: Ah well, I'll figure it out later.
Gregg puts the hat away.
Anyway, here are the offcuts.
Thessalia hands Gregg a box full of offcuts and spare fabric.
translation: Thessalia(테살리아)가 자투리 천과 여분의 천이 가득 든 상자를 Gregg(그레그)에게 건넨다.

english: This is perfect! Thanks a lot, miss!
No problem, I'm glad I could be of help.
So what do we do now?
Hmm... I think we have all the decorations we need, but I had an idea.
translation: 흠... 장식은 다 모은 것 같은데, 좋은 생각이 하나 났어.

english: It's going to be really annoying trying to put all these decorations on a door while it's still in a frame.
translation: 문이 틀에 끼워진 채로 장식을 다 붙이려면 엄청 귀찮을 거야.

english: So I was thinking - why not make a new door, decorate it, and simply swap the doors out!
translation: 그래서 생각해 봤는데, 새 문을 만들어서 꾸민 다음 문을 통째로 바꿔 끼우면 어때!

english: That doesn't sound too ridiculous, actually. What do we need?
I think if we had some planks, I have all the nails and fixings to make the thing...
translation: planks(판자)만 좀 있으면, 문 만들 못이랑 부품은 내가 다 갖고 있어...

english: If you want planks, your best bestis heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator.
translation: 판자가 필요하면 목재소에 가서 sawmill operator(제재소 일꾼)한테 얘기하는 게 제일 좋을 거예요.

english: Sounds like a plan, human! The lumberyard is to the north-east of here, I'll see you out in front of it!
translation: 좋은 생각이야, 인간! 목재소는 여기서 북동쪽에 있어. 그 앞에서 만나자!

english: Can I help you with anything else?
No thanks. We'll be on our way to the lumberyard in a bit.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 저희는 곧 목재소로 갈 거예요.

english: Thanks again for the hat!
I'm just glad someone actually likes it.
How could you not like it? It's so colorful!
translation: 이걸 어떻게 안 좋아할 수가 있어요? 이렇게 알록달록한데!

english: I think that's part of the problem.
I think we were going to the lumberyard to the north-east of Varrock to get some planks.
translation: Varrock(바록) 북동쪽 목재소에 가서 판자를 구하기로 했던 것 같아.

english: Hey, I got you this...
The sudden thought of XP waste prevents you from handing over the plank to Gregg.
translation: 문득 경험치 낭비라는 생각이 들어 Gregg(그레그)에게 plank(판자)를 건넬 수가 없다.

english: Are you alright, human? You appear to be in intense physical pain.
Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks.
translation: 자, 도착했네요. 이제 판자만 구하면 돼요.

english: Should be easy enough.
Wait... where's the sawmill operator?
translation: 잠깐... sawmill operator(제재소 일꾼)은 어디 있지?

english: Come to think of it, I've never actually seen anyone working in there...
translation: 생각해 보니, 저기서 누가 일하는 걸 한 번도 본 적이 없네요...

english: So how do you get your planks then?
I dunno, probably off the Grand Exchange.
translation: 글쎄요, 아마 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에서 사겠죠.

english: The Grand Exchange! I don't have that kind of money!
translation: 그랜드 익스체인지라니! 난 그런 돈 없어!

english: No, we need a better plan.
I was just going to run screaming into the Wilderness and hope for the best.
translation: 전 그냥 비명 지르면서 Wilderness(황야)로 뛰어들어서 잘되길 빌 생각이었어요.

english: That sounds awfully dangerous, human!
Eh, it beats hanging around the Grand Exchange all day.
translation: 에이, 하루 종일 그랜드 익스체인지에서 죽치고 있는 것보단 나아요.

english: Well, I'm not risking my hide running around the Wilderness! We need a better plan.
translation: 음, 난 황야를 뛰어다니면서 목숨 걸 생각은 없어! 더 좋은 방법이 필요해.

english: Huh... I could've sworn there was someone in there at some point.
translation: 흠... 분명 저 안에 누가 있었던 것 같은데.

english: Well, they're not in there now!
There might be a bell, have a look.
Are you kidding me? There's no bell to ring! No, we need a better plan.
translation: 장난해? 울릴 종 같은 건 없어! 아니, 더 좋은 방법이 필요해.

english: Wait... gosh darn it, I forgot to grab my piggy bank!
translation: 잠깐... 아이고 이런, 돼지 저금통 챙기는 걸 깜빡했다!

english: Human, would you mind buyi-
Do you know how expensive planks are? If I'm buying planks, they're exclusively for repairing the furniture I plan on breaking!
translation: 판자가 얼마나 비싼지 알아요? 제가 판자를 산다면, 그건 순전히 부술 계획인 가구를 고치는 데만 쓸 거예요!

english: ... What?
Well if you find a better way of constructiontraining, let me know.
translation: 건설 스킬 올리는 더 좋은 방법 찾으면 알려 줘요.

english: ... At any rate, it looks like we need a better plan...
translation: ... 어쨌든, 더 좋은 방법이 필요한 것 같아...

english: Oh wait, look! There's a break in the fence there!
translation: 앗, 잠깐, 저기 봐! 울타리에 구멍이 났어!

english: I bet I can just sneak right in and grab a few planks without anyone noticing!
translation: 살금살금 들어가서 아무도 모르게 판자 몇 개 슬쩍해 올 수 있을 것 같아!

english: Are you sure you don't want me to go?
No thank you, Human. You've done enough already. You sit back and relax. I'll be back in a moment!
translation: 괜찮아, 인간. 넌 할 만큼 했어. 편히 앉아서 쉬고 있어. 금방 돌아올게!

english: The camera fades to black. In a cutscene, Gregg is seen hopping inside the fenced lumberyard.
translation: 화면이 검게 페이드아웃된다. 컷신에서 Gregg(그레그)가 울타리 쳐진 목재소 안으로 깡충 뛰어든다.

english: Ok, let's find some planks...
A sound of a cat purring is heard. A brown adult cat comes from behind a wall two tiles right (east) of Gregg.
translation: 고양이가 가르랑거리는 소리가 들린다. 갈색 어른 고양이가 Gregg(그레그)의 오른쪽(동쪽)으로 두 칸 떨어진 벽 뒤에서 나온다.

english: Meow!
Aha! There we go!
A sound of the cat meowing is heard.
Meow.
Oh! A kitty cat!
Sorry, kitty, I don't have any treats.
Would you like pets instead? I can do pets!
translation: 대신 쓰다듬어 줄까? 쓰다듬기라면 자신 있어!

english: Gregg moves closer to pet the cat. The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 고양이를 쓰다듬으려고 다가간다. 고양이가 하악 소리를 크게 내며 그레그를 할퀸다.

english: Hissss!
Aaaah!
Nice kitty...?
The cat makes an audible hiss and scratches towards Gregg again. Gregg starts fleeing left (west), while the adult cat chases him.
translation: 고양이가 다시 하악 소리를 크게 내며 Gregg(그레그)를 할퀸다. 그레그가 왼쪽(서쪽)으로 도망치기 시작하고, 어른 고양이가 그 뒤를 쫓는다.

english: Not nice kitty! Not nice kitty!
The camera pans right and fades to black again. After a fade-out, the camera is set back to the world in front of the lumberyard with the player and Gregg.
translation: 카메라가 오른쪽으로 이동하며 다시 검게 페이드아웃된다. 화면이 다시 밝아지면 목재소 앞, 플레이어와 Gregg(그레그)가 있는 장면으로 돌아온다.

english: Woah, are you alright?
I'm fine, just... let me catch my breath...
translation: 난 괜찮아, 그냥... 숨 좀 돌리고...

english: I didn't know... that cats could be... so violent!
I didn't even know there were cats in there to begin with!
translation: 저는 저기에 고양이가 있는 줄도 몰랐어요!

english: I guess the lumberyard is a popular spot for cats...
translation: 목재소가 고양이들한테 인기 있는 곳인가 봐요...

english: ... Ok, I think I'm gonna be alright. I got the planks out, at the very least.
translation: ... 좋아, 이제 괜찮을 것 같아. 그래도 판자는 챙겨 나왔어.

english: So we can make the door now?
translation: 그럼 이제 문을 만들 수 있는 거죠?

english: Exactly! Now, hold this nail for me...
translation: 바로 그거야! 자, 이 못 좀 잡고 있어 줘...

english: Time passes...
The camera fades to black. Sounds of nails being hit with a hammer are heard.
translation: 화면이 검게 페이드아웃된다. 망치로 못 박는 소리가 들린다.

english: The camera fades back to view.
... And I think we're done!
Gregg shows off the completed door.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 완성된 문을 자랑스럽게 보여 준다.

english: That looks... surprisinggood, actually.
Well if you like it, it's bound to go down well! Let's head back to Draynor and get this put up!
translation: 네가 마음에 든다면 분명 반응이 좋을 거야! Draynor(드레이너)로 돌아가서 이걸 달자!

english: Draynor becomes decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: Draynor(드레이너) 곳곳이 바닥의 부활절 달걀, 축제용 장대, 알록달록한 문 일곱 개로 꾸며진다.

english: It's a bit of a trek. I'm going to teleport again. Would you like me to take you along?
translation: 꽤 먼 길이야. 나 또 순간이동할 건데, 같이 데려가 줄까?

english: Ok! Hold on to your ammo!
But that doesn't make any...
The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3105, 3262, 0).
translation: 플레이어가 중단할 수 없는 자기 순간이동을 시전하는 모습이 보인다(토끼가 걸어 주는 타인 순간이동이 아니다). 도착 위치는 Draynor(드레이너)의 Ned(네드)네 집 북동쪽(좌표 3105, 3262, 0 근처)이다.

english: ... sense!
Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. Thessalia can now instruct the player to look for Gregg at where the event started.
translation: 이제 목재소에서 Gregg(그레그)를 찾을 수 없다. Thessalia(테살리아)가 플레이어에게 이벤트가 시작된 곳에서 그레그를 찾아보라고 알려 줄 수 있게 된다.

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3104, 3263, 0).
translation: 플레이어가 중단할 수 없는 자기 순간이동을 시전하는 모습이 보인다(토끼가 걸어 주는 타인 순간이동이 아니다). 도착 위치는 Draynor(드레이너)의 Ned(네드)네 집 북동쪽(좌표 3104, 3263, 0 근처)이다.

english: Ok human! Let me know if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 알았어, 인간! 마음 바뀌면 말해 줘. 아니면 거기서 보자!

english: Hey human! Are you ready to go to Draynor?
translation: 안녕, 인간! Draynor(드레이너)로 갈 준비 됐어?

english: Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
I'll be fine, I didn't get scratched too badly. Plus at least I have a cool story to tell my friends.
translation: 괜찮을 거야, 그렇게 심하게 긁히진 않았어. 게다가 친구들한테 들려줄 멋진 이야깃거리도 생겼고.

english: I'm just sad I didn't get to pet the cute cat...
translation: 그 귀여운 고양이를 못 쓰다듬은 게 아쉬울 뿐이야...

english: Not so nice being called cute, is it...?
translation: 귀엽다는 소리 듣는 거, 별로 기분 좋지 않죠...?

english: Hey, everyone knows cats love being petted!
translation: 야, 고양이가 쓰다듬어 주는 거 좋아하는 건 다들 아는 사실이라고!

english: That one just seemed mad about something else... I wonder what.
translation: 그 녀석은 다른 일로 화가 난 것 같았어... 뭐 때문인지 궁금하네.

english: Hmm... Based on past experienced with cats in the lumberyard, I bet it's hungry, thristy or looking for its kitten.
translation: 음... 목재소 고양이들을 겪어 본 경험으로 보면, 분명 배가 고프거나 목이 마르거나 새끼 고양이를 찾고 있는 걸 거예요.

english: Aww, if I didn't feel mad at it for trying to scratch out my eyes, I'd want to go help it...
translation: 아아, 내 눈을 할퀴려고 한 게 괘씸하지만 않았으면 가서 도와주고 싶었을 텐데...

english: Well, we have the door completed, so now all that's left to do is to put it up in Draynor.
translation: 아무튼, 문은 완성했으니 이제 Draynor(드레이너)에 달기만 하면 돼.

english: How many doors are there in Draynor?
There's... six or seven, I think. Why?
translation: 음... 여섯 개나 일곱 개쯤? 왜?

english: We're not going to need to go through this six or seven times, are we?
translation: 설마 이걸 여섯 번, 일곱 번이나 반복해야 하는 건 아니죠?

english: Hah, silly human! No, I thought this through.
translation: 하, 바보 같은 인간! 아니야, 다 생각해 뒀어.

english: I got enough decorations for all of Draynor going around.
translation: Draynor(드레이너) 전체를 꾸밀 만큼 장식은 충분히 구해 놨거든.

english: The plan is, we swap out that first door we painted for this one. Then we decorate that first door, swap it out for another one, decorate, swap, repeat!
translation: 계획은 이래. 처음에 칠했던 문을 이걸로 바꿔 다는 거야. 그다음 그 첫 번째 문을 꾸며서 또 다른 문이랑 바꾸고, 꾸미고, 바꾸고, 반복!

english: That way I only need to lug one door all the way down to Draynor.
translation: 그러면 Draynor(드레이너)까지 문 하나만 낑낑대며 들고 가면 되잖아.

english: That's... actually pretty smart.
Yeah, when you do Easter decorations for a few years you get pretty good at logistics.
translation: 응, 부활절 장식을 몇 년 하다 보면 물류에 꽤 능숙해지거든.

english: See you in Draynor, human! Talk to me again if you want a teleport there!
translation: Draynor(드레이너)에서 보자, 인간! 거기로 순간이동하고 싶으면 또 말 걸어!

english: Draynor Village is decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)이 바닥의 부활절 달걀, 축제용 장대, 알록달록한 문 일곱 개로 꾸며져 있다.

english: Oh, I see you put the door in already.
Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. (Thessalia's beliefs about Gregg's presence in the lumberyard are not changed.)
translation: 이제 목재소에서 Gregg(그레그)를 찾을 수 없다. (목재소에 그레그가 있다는 Thessalia(테살리아)의 생각은 바뀌지 않는다.)

english: I... Human, I didn't do this..
translation: 나... 인간, 이거 내가 한 거 아니야..

english: Wait, someone else decorated this door?
translation: 잠깐, 누가 이 문을 꾸며 놨다고요?

english: The camera fades to black and a cutscene begins.
I have no idea. I just came back and this door's been fully decorated without us!
translation: 나도 전혀 모르겠어. 방금 돌아왔는데 우리 없이 이 문이 다 꾸며져 있더라고!

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking from his house to in front of the bank in the background.
translation: Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 자기 집에서 나와 뒤쪽 배경의 은행 앞으로 걸어간다.

english: Look around - it looks like the whole has been decorated too!
translation: 주위를 봐요 - 마을 전체가 다 꾸며진 것 같아요!

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking towards the crossroad.
translation: Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 교차로 쪽으로 걸어가기 시작한다.

english: I wonder who could have decorated an entire village so quickly...?
translation: 대체 누가 이렇게 빨리 마을 하나를 통째로 꾸민 걸까...?

english: Perhaps I can answer to that question.
translation: 그 질문에는 내가 답해 줄 수 있을 듯하네.

english: Wise Old Man leaves, walks back towards his house. The camera fades to black, and the cutscene ends.
translation: Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 자리를 떠나 자기 집 쪽으로 돌아간다. 화면이 검게 페이드아웃되며 컷신이 끝난다.

english: The player can now ask Wise Old Man more about the Easter event, while he's at home in his house.
translation: 이제 플레이어는 집에 있는 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)에게 부활절 이벤트에 대해 더 물어볼 수 있다.

english: I feel like he kind of glossed over the part where three people decorated an entire village in 10 minutes...
translation: 세 사람이 10분 만에 마을 하나를 통째로 꾸몄다는 부분은 좀 얼버무리고 넘어간 것 같은데요...

english: Human, did you hear that...?
The part where we trekked all across Misthalin for nothing?
translation: 우리가 Misthalin(미스탈린)을 헛걸음으로 다 돌아다녔다는 부분이요?

english: No, not that!
Though I suppose we did do that as well, didn't we...
But no, right at the end!
He called you a... strange rabbit?
translation: 그 사람이 당신을... 이상한 토끼라고 불렀던 거요?

english: Exactly! He didn't call me an Easter bunny or a cute rabbit or anything like that!
translation: 바로 그거야! 부활절 토끼라거나 귀여운 토끼라거나, 그런 식으로 안 불렀다고!

english: He was so focused on Eastdoor he didn't make the connection!
translation: Eastdoor(이스트도어)에 정신이 팔려서 눈치를 못 챈 거야!

english: So your plan... worked?
Yep! Though admittedly, not how I thought it would.
translation: 응! 솔직히 내가 생각한 방식은 아니었지만.

english: Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least.
translation: 그래도 조금이나마 도울 수 있어서 다행이에요.

english: Thanks for everything, human!
I'd like to give you a reward, but you don't have the space. Could you free up one space in your inventory?
translation: 보상을 주고 싶은데 자리가 없네. 소지품 한 칸만 비워 줄래?

english: I'll tell you what - seeing as we don't need it any more, how would you like to keep this door?
translation: 이렇게 하자 - 이제 필요 없으니까, 이 문 네가 가질래?

english: I'm... not entirely sure what I'm going to do with it, but thanks.
translation: 이걸로... 뭘 해야 할지는 잘 모르겠지만, 고마워요.

english: Any time! Oh, that reminds me - you can have the hat that nice lady gave to me as well!
translation: 언제든지! 아, 그러고 보니 - 그 친절한 분이 나한테 준 모자도 가져가!

english: Didn't you want it?
Well, yes, but I don't think I can actually wear it.
translation: 음, 그렇긴 한데, 나는 그걸 실제로 쓸 수가 없을 것 같아.

english: Gregg gives you the decorated door and his garish hat.
translation: Gregg(그레그)가 장식된 문과 요란한 모자를 건네준다.

english: Merry Easter, human!
Merry Easter, human! Did you want anything?
translation: 즐거운 부활절 보내, 인간! 뭐 필요한 거 있어?

english: What will you do now?
Hmmm... I haven't put too much thought into it, actually.
translation: 음... 사실 별로 생각 안 해 봤어.

english: I was meant to be helping the people of Draynor with Easter, but seeing as they helped themselves, I have some time on my hands!
translation: 원래는 Draynor(드레이너) 사람들의 부활절 준비를 도우려던 건데, 다들 알아서 해냈으니 나한테 시간이 좀 생겼네!

english: I might just use it to relax a little bit. It's not often rabbits get time off.
translation: 그냥 좀 쉬는 데 쓸까 봐. 토끼한테 휴가가 생기는 일은 흔치 않거든.

english: Time off? But I only see you around Easter!
translation: 휴가요? 하지만 당신은 부활절 때만 보이잖아요!

english: Oh, you don't know the half of it, human...
translation: 넌 아직 절반도 모르는 거야, 인간...

english: You know, it just occuredto me I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: 그러고 보니 이름을 한 번도 물어본 적이 없다는 게 방금 생각났어요.

english: My name is Gregg!
Greg?
No, with 3 gs.
Greggg?
Now you're just being silly, human.
Sorry.
I don't actually know your name, either. I've just been calling you human this whole time.
translation: 나도 사실 네 이름을 몰라. 지금까지 계속 인간이라고만 불렀잖아.

english: I'm [name].
[name]? I'm not a fan, honestly.
I'm going to keep calling you human, human!
Will you be around next year?
Hmm... I don't know, human. We don't usually start making plans for Easter until at least halfway through the year.
translation: 음... 잘 모르겠어, 인간. 우리는 보통 한 해의 절반은 지나야 부활절 계획을 세우기 시작하거든.

english: But if I am around, I hope I get to talk to you again!
translation: 그래도 내가 오게 된다면 너랑 또 얘기할 수 있으면 좋겠어!

english: So long, human!
Wow, human, that hat looks great on you!
translation: 와, 인간, 그 모자 너한테 정말 잘 어울린다!

english: Really? I thought it looked a bit silly.
translation: 정말요? 좀 우스꽝스러워 보이는 것 같은데.

english: Well, I think it looks amazing! Really suits you. Anyway, did you want anything?
translation: 글쎄, 난 끝내주게 멋지다고 생각해! 진짜 잘 어울려. 아무튼, 뭐 필요한 거 있어?

english: Yes
No
I'll speak to Aggie, give me the ingredients.
translation: 제가 Aggie(애기)한테 말해 볼게요. 재료를 주세요.

english: Why don't you go?
What am I meant to be doing again?
Goodbye.
Do you have more ingredients?
Yes, take me to Lumbridge.
Yes.
No.
How can you even teleport?
I need a new pair of shears.
How are you doing?
What am I meant to be doing?
Yes, teleport me to Varrock.
What do you know about the dark wizards?
translation: 흑마법사들에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Yes, take me to Draynor.
Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
What will you do now?
I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: 그러고 보니 이름을 한 번도 물어본 적이 없네요.

english: Will you be around next year?
What are you drinking?
Blood!
How are you getting drunk on blood?
They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: 공물로 바치는 인간 몇 놈을 늘 술에 절여 두고, 거기서 피를 뽑아 오는 거지.

english: How very creative.
I know right! Bloody brilliant!
translation: 그렇지! 아주 피가 되고 살이 되는 아이디어라니까!

english: Hello.
I'll have a pint please.
I don't work here.
Sure you do!
No, I really don't.
Well clear off then.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 앗, Hero(영웅)님이다! 와! 정말 대단해요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 상대한 거예요? 마을도 멋져졌어요. 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Grigore, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: 반가워요! 제 이름은 Grigore(그리고레)예요. 이것저것 조금씩 해요. 그냥 살아남으려고 애쓰는 거죠, 우리가 할 수 있는 건 그것 말고는 별로 없거든요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 근근이 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

english: Can I help you with anything else?
What is Individual Prestige?
Individual Prestige is automatically awarded to you the very first time you create a group. It is proof that you were one of the original members of that group.
translation: Individual Prestige(개인 프레스티지)는 처음으로 그룹을 만들 때 자동으로 주어져요. 그 그룹의 원년 멤버 중 한 명이라는 증거죠.

english: This proof is displayed as a gold star next to your name on the group sidepanel. Note that if you join an existing group, you will not be considered an original member.
translation: 이 증거는 그룹 사이드 패널의 이름 옆에 금색 별로 표시돼요. 이미 있는 그룹에 들어가면 원년 멤버로 인정되지 않는다는 점에 유의하세요.

english: The limits are gold and items worth up to 1,000,000 coins for the 1st week, 20,000,000 coins for the 2nd week, 50,000,000 coins for the 3rd week and 100,000,000 coins for the 4th week.
translation: 한도는 골드와 아이템 가치 기준으로 첫째 주 최대 1,000,000코인, 둘째 주 20,000,000코인, 셋째 주 50,000,000코인, 넷째 주 100,000,000코인이에요.

english: During these 5 weeks you will also have restrictions to what you can equip: certain items will require you to have killed the monster that drops them.
translation: 이 5주 동안은 장착할 수 있는 것에도 제한이 있어요. 특정 아이템은 그걸 떨어뜨리는 몬스터를 처치해 봐야 장착할 수 있어요.

english: What is Group Prestige?
Non-Hardcore groups can show their dedication to the group through Group Prestige. This status can be viewed on the group's sidepanel, just below the group's name.
translation: 하드코어가 아닌 그룹은 Group Prestige(그룹 프레스티지)로 그룹에 대한 헌신을 보여 줄 수 있어요. 이 상태는 그룹 사이드 패널의 그룹 이름 바로 아래에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: Group Prestige is lost upon inviting new members into the group, or upon doing certain activities with players outside of your group.
translation: Group Prestige(그룹 프레스티지)는 새 멤버를 그룹에 초대하거나, 그룹 밖의 플레이어와 특정 활동을 하면 사라져요.

english: What is a Hardcore Group Iron Man?
translation: Hardcore Group Iron Man(하드코어 그룹 아이언맨)이 뭐예요?

english: Hardcore Group Iron mode is a more challenging version of the regular mode, in which you have only a set number of lives for the entire group.
translation: Hardcore Group Iron(하드코어 그룹 아이언) 모드는 일반 모드보다 더 어려운 버전으로, 그룹 전체가 정해진 수의 목숨만 가지고 시작해요.

english: If you die in an unsafe area, you will lose one of your group's lives. When your shared lives hit 0, you will all be downgraded to regular Group Iron players.
translation: 안전하지 않은 지역에서 죽으면 그룹의 목숨이 하나 줄어요. 공유 목숨이 0이 되면 모두 일반 Group Iron(그룹 아이언) 플레이어로 강등돼요.

english: I'd like to manage my group status.
I'd like to leave the group.
We can start the process for you to leave. The process will take 7 days to complete.
translation: 탈퇴 절차를 시작해 드릴게요. 절차가 끝나기까지 7일이 걸려요.

english: Are you sure you want to leave your group?
No, I changed my mind.
I'm fine, thanks.
I'd like to change my group's name.
Only the group leader can do that.
translation: 그건 그룹 리더만 할 수 있어요.

You can leave your group by talking to me about group management. However, know that there will then be a 7 day grace period before it takes effect. In this time you can come back to cancel the request if you've
translation: 저한테 그룹 관리에 대해 말을 걸면 그룹을 떠날 수 있어요. 다만 적용되기까지 7일의 유예 기간이 있다는 걸 알아 두세요. 그동안 마음이

english: changed your mind.
translation: 바뀌었다면 다시 와서 요청을 취소할 수 있어요.

english: You could also be kicked from the group. If you are kicked from the group, you also have a 7 day grace period before you are removed. Only the leader of a group can kick other people. The leader must talk to me
translation: 그룹에서 추방당할 수도 있어요. 추방당하는 경우에도 제외되기까지 7일의 유예 기간이 있어요. 다른 사람을 추방할 수 있는 건 그룹 리더뿐이에요. 리더는 직접

english: in person about group management so I can confirm that they're really the leader before I let them kick anyone.
translation: 저를 찾아와 그룹 관리에 대해 말해야 해요. 그래야 누군가를 추방하게 해 주기 전에 정말 리더인지 확인할 수 있거든요.

english: The leader can come back to me at any point during those 7 days to cancel the request if they have changed their minds about kicking someone.
translation: 리더는 그 7일 동안 언제든 마음이 바뀌면 저를 다시 찾아와 추방 요청을 취소할 수 있어요.

english: Can I change my Group Iron mode?
translation: Group Iron(그룹 아이언) 모드를 바꿀 수 있나요?

english: Unfortunately, Group Iron players who are not new to the island can't change their Group Iron mode.
translation: 아쉽지만 섬에 처음 온 게 아닌 Group Iron(그룹 아이언) 플레이어는 그룹 아이언 모드를 바꿀 수 없어요.

english: There you go. Wear it with pride.
I think you've already got the whole set.
translation: 이미 세트를 전부 갖고 계신 것 같은데요.

english: You can only change your Group Iron mode if you haven't been to the mainland.
translation: Group Iron(그룹 아이언) 모드는 아직 본토에 가 본 적이 없을 때만 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: How do I use the group storage?
You can access the group storage via the button in the top-left of your bank interface. Only one member of the group may access the storage at one time.
translation: group storage(그룹 보관함)은 은행 화면 왼쪽 위에 있는 버튼으로 열 수 있어요. 보관함은 한 번에 그룹원 한 명만 이용할 수 있어요.

english: You will then be able to deposit and withdraw items from the group storage. You can't deposit untradeable items.
translation: 그러면 group storage(그룹 보관함)에 아이템을 넣고 뺄 수 있어요. 거래 불가 아이템은 넣을 수 없어요.

english: When you have finished, click the 'Save' button to confirm the transaction.
translation: 다 끝나면 '저장' 버튼을 눌러 거래를 확정하세요.

This bank is for new adventurers only, you cannot access it as you've already started your Group Ironman journey.

Grubfoot wear red armour! Grubfoot wear green armour!
translation: Grubfoot(그럽풋) 빨간 갑옷 입어! 그럽풋 초록 갑옷 입어!

english: Why they not make up their minds?
Shut up Grubfoot!
Me lonely.
Why?
Other goblins in village follow either General Wartface or General Bentnoze. Me try to follow both but then me get left out of both groups.
translation: 마을 다른 고블린들 General Wartface(워트페이스 장군) 아니면 General Bentnoze(벤트노즈 장군) 따라. 나 둘 다 따르려 했는데 그래서 둘 다한테 따돌림당해.

english: Don't talk to me!
Why not?
Me not allowed to talk. Generals will tell me to shut up whenever I talk.
translation: 나 말하면 안 돼. 내가 말할 때마다 장군들 닥치라고 해.

english: Grubfoot do this! Grubfoot do that! They always want different things and they never satisfied!
translation: 그럽풋 이거 해! 그럽풋 저거 해! 장군들 맨날 다른 거 원하고 절대 만족 안 해!

english: Me wish generals wouldn't tell me to shut up.
translation: 장군들 나한테 닥치라고 안 했으면 좋겠어.

english: Sometimes they tell me to shut up when me not even say anything!
translation: 가끔은 나 아무 말도 안 했는데 닥치라고 해!

english: Me wish me weren't so small. Other goblins all pick on me and make me do all hard work for generals.
translation: 나 이렇게 작지 않았으면 좋겠어. 다른 고블린들 다 나 괴롭히고 장군들 힘든 일 전부 나 시켜.

english: Hello Grubfoot. Merry Christmas!
Grubfoot like Christmas. Grubfoot think it different from human Christmas. Goblins call it Gobmas.
translation: 그럽풋 크리스마스 좋아. 그럽풋 생각엔 인간 크리스마스랑 달라. 고블린들은 고브마스라고 불러.

english: Talk about Christmas.
Talk about something else.
Ukk...I's dun fer...me's don't feel legsies anymore!
translation: 으윽... 나 끝났어... 나 다리 느낌 이제 없어!

english: Yous creature doesn't stick mee's chompy, else mee's squeeze creature till yous a deadun!
translation: 너 생물 내 chompy(촘피) 찌르지 마, 안 그럼 나 생물 꽉 짜서 죽은놈 만들 거야!

english: Yous creatures too weedy for da ogre stabby chucker, yous best stick wiv da cluks-cluks.
translation: 너네 생물 너무 비실비실해서 오우거 찌르개 던지개 못 써, 너네는 꼬꼬닭이나 잡아.

english: Chompy is bestest yumms...
Me'se can't wait for da chompy yumms...I's dribbling all down me's for da tasty chompy.
translation: 나 촘피 냠냠 못 기다려... 맛난 촘피 생각에 침 질질 흘려.

english: Da fatsy toadies geddin' all messy...
Me's gonna ged da pridy chompy hatsies...an looks like a good-un wiv da laydies.
translation: 나 이쁜 촘피 모자 얻을 거야... 그럼 여자들한테 멋져 보여.

english: Mee's scared of Jiggig and da zogries, deyz is not da right dead-uns.
translation: 나 Jiggig(지기그)랑 zogries(조그르들) 무서워, 걔네 제대로 된 죽은놈 아냐.

english: Mee's got no stabbers no more...gonna go home wiv no chompy...
translation: 나 찌르개 이제 없어... 촘피 없이 집 가야 돼...

english: I's stickin' da chompy...
De'se stabbers are worser dan a dead dog....
translation: 이 찌르개들 죽은 개보다 더 나빠....

english: Would you like to buy or sell some gold jewellery?
No, I'm not that rich.
Get out then! We don't want any riff-raff in here.
translation: 그럼 나가요! 여긴 잡것들 들이는 데가 아니에요.

english: Yes please.
No, I'm not that rich.
Bored, bored, bored. These Fremenniks are taking ages.
translation: 지루해, 지루해, 지루해. 이 Fremennik(프레메닉) 녀석들은 한세월이로군.

english: Hey, they're doing their best. You arrived early.
translation: 저기요, 다들 최선을 다하고 있어요. 일찍 도착하신 거잖아요.

english: Hey, we arrived precisely when we told your representatives. Lack of planning on your part does not constitute an emergency on my part.
translation: 이보게, 우린 자네네 대표들한테 말한 바로 그 시각에 도착했네. 자네 쪽 계획이 부족하다고 내 쪽이 급해지는 건 아닐세.

english: Please, someone get these guys their ore quickly. They are eating all the good food on the island, and complaining about it!
translation: 제발, 누가 이 사람들한테 광석 좀 빨리 갖다줘요. 섬에 있는 좋은 음식은 다 먹어 치우면서 불평까지 한다고요!

english: I'd better get a move on!
Ah, yes. Now that's what I call a meal.
translation: 아, 그래. 이 정도는 돼야 한 끼 식사라고 하지.

english: That's funny, I called it fourteen meals yesterday.
translation: 웃기네요, 어제는 그걸 열네 끼라고 했었는데.

english: Ho! Outlander.
What's down the scary-looking staircase?
translation: 저 무섭게 생긴 계단 아래엔 뭐가 있어요?

english: These are the stairs down to the mining caves. There are rich veins of many types down there, and miners too. Though be careful; some of the trolls occasionally sneak into the far end of the cave.
translation: 광산 동굴로 내려가는 계단일세. 저 아래엔 온갖 종류의 풍부한 광맥이 있고, 광부들도 있지. 하지만 조심하게. 가끔 트롤 몇 놈이 동굴 저 끝으로 몰래 들어오거든.

english: Thanks. I'll look out for them.
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
translation: party room(파티 룸)에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있어!

english: Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 지금 party room(파티 룸)에 값비싼 아이템이 있어!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
Woah, what's happened to me?!
translation: 으악, 나한테 무슨 일이 일어난 거지?!

english: Oi you! What are you doing on this side of the portal?
translation: 어이 너! 포털 이쪽에서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Go report to the Duke in the castle, the greater yolk didn't tell you to return.
translation: 성에 계신 Duke(공작)께 가서 보고해. 위대한 노른자께선 너한테 돌아오라고 하지 않으셨어.

english: Why are you talking to me, go report to the Duke in the castle, the egg will find a way to deal with you.
translation: 왜 나한테 말을 거는 거야? 성에 계신 Duke(공작)께 가서 보고해. 달걀님께서 너를 처리할 방법을 찾아내실 거다.

english: You're free to do as you wish, but I'll be keeping my ears on you.
translation: 마음대로 해도 좋다. 하지만 이 귀를 쫑긋 세우고 널 계속 지켜볼 거다.

english: Be on your way.
You don't want to mess with me, human.
translation: 나한테 까불지 않는 게 좋을 거다, 인간.

english: If you're thinking of trying anything, you'll quickly find yourself regretting it.
translation: 허튼짓할 생각이라면 금방 후회하게 될 거다.

english: I'm watching you, human.
Move along.
What do you think you're doing, human?
Oh... I was just going to check out the inside of this house.
translation: 아... 그냥 이 집 안을 좀 구경하려던 참이었어요.

english: This isn't a house, it's a... Actually, human, it's none of your business!
translation: 여긴 집이 아니라... 아니, 인간, 네가 알 바 아니다!

english: Well now you've just made me curious. What's in there?
translation: 그러니까 더 궁금해지잖아요. 안에 뭐가 있어요?

english: Go away!
Is it a really large anvil?
Final warning!
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
Why don't you ask me again?!
If you insist...
Ask me another question! I dare you!
translation: 질문 하나만 더 해 봐! 해 보라고!

english: Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Is it a dwarf with a really long beard?
If you insist...
Okay, okay! I'm leaving.
Hello.
Hello there. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire the Carnillean family home, I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
translation: 안녕하세요. 이 근처에선 처음 뵙는 분이군요. Carnillean(카닐리언) 가문의 저택을 구경하러 오셨다면, 소란을 피우지 말라고 경고해 둬야겠네요.

english: Due to recent criminal activities against such prominent Ardougnians, I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
translation: 최근 저명한 Ardougne(아르둔) 시민들을 노린 범죄가 일어나서, 카닐리언 가문의 안전을 지키라는 특별 경비 임무를 받고 여기 파견됐어요.

english: Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to jail so quickly that their feet won't even touch the floor!
translation: 카닐리언 가문 사람이나 그 소유물에 손대다 잡히는 자는 발이 땅에 닿기도 전에 감옥으로 끌려갈 거예요!

english: Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...
translation: 음, 저는 그런 짓을 할 생각이 전혀 없었는데요...

english: Glad to hear it.
Well well well... if it isn't our very own local hero. Good to see you managed to clear your name I always had faith in you!
translation: 이런 이런... 우리 동네 영웅 아니신가. 누명을 벗었다니 다행이에요. 전 늘 당신을 믿었다고요!

english: Hello there.
Hello, adventurer. It's a shame you never found that cult. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. 그 사교 집단을 끝내 못 찾으셨다니 아쉽네요. 또 도둑이 든 게 아닌가 하는 끔찍한 의심이 들어요.

english: That's worrying.
Yes, it is. The thing is, we can't even work out what they've taken! It's all very odd.
translation: 네, 그러게요. 문제는 뭘 훔쳐 갔는지조차 알 수가 없다는 거예요! 정말 이상한 일이에요.

english: Is there anything more I can do to help?
I don't think so. Sir Ceril says you've done enough.
translation: 없을 것 같아요. Sir Ceril(세릴 경)께서 할 만큼 하셨다고 하시더군요.

english: Don't you try anything, surface-dweller. I'm keeping an eye on you.
Welcome, surface-dweller, to the hidden city of Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 어서 오세요, 지상인. 숨겨진 도시 Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: Surface-dweller!
What?
Have a nice day!
I don't want to be unfriendly, but I can't help noticing that since surface-dwellers started coming into the city there has been an increase in CRIME!
translation: 불친절하게 굴고 싶진 않지만, 지상인들이 도시에 드나들기 시작한 뒤로 범죄가 늘어난 게 눈에 띄네요!

english: Surface-dweller! I don't know how you got into the city, but you will never escape!
translation: 지상인! 어떻게 도시에 들어왔는지는 몰라도, 절대 빠져나가지 못할 거예요!

english: But... I thought I was allowed into the city!
translation: 하지만... 저 도시에 들어와도 된다고 들었는데요!

english: You are. I just wanted to say that. And now that you're allowed into the city, I'll never be able to!
translation: 되죠. 그냥 그 말 한번 해 보고 싶었어요. 이제 당신이 도시에 들어올 수 있게 됐으니, 다신 그 말을 못 하겠네요!

english: Hello soldier.
I'm more of an adventurer really.
In this day and age we're all soldiers. No time to waste gassing, Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: 요즘 같은 시대엔 모두가 병사다. 수다 떨 시간 없다. 싸워라! 싸워라! 싸워라!

english: Well hello brave warrior. These ogres have been terrorising the area, they've eaten four children this week alone.
translation: 오, 안녕하세요, 용감한 전사님. 이 오우거들이 이 지역을 공포에 떨게 하고 있어요. 이번 주에만 아이를 넷이나 잡아먹었다고요.

english: Brutes!
So we decided to use them for target practice. A fair punishment.
translation: 그래서 녀석들을 과녁 연습에 쓰기로 했죠. 공정한 벌이에요.

english: Indeed.
What do you want? Leave us be!
Welcome to the Seers' Village courthouse. Court is not in session today, so you're not allowed downstairs.
translation: Seers' Village(시어스 마을) 법원에 오신 걸 환영해요. 오늘은 재판이 없어서 아래층엔 내려가실 수 없어요.

english: What is this place?
The Seers' Village courthouse. We give all criminals a fair trial, by a jury of their peers. Or whoever we can round up from the pub.
translation: 시어스 마을 법원이에요. 우리는 모든 범죄자에게 동료 시민으로 구성된 배심원단의 공정한 재판을 받게 해 줘요. 아니면 술집에서 긁어모을 수 있는 아무나요.

english: You're a long way out from the city.
I know. We guards usually stay by banks and shops, but I got sent all the way out here to keep an eye on the brigands loitering just south of here.
translation: 그러게요. 우리 경비병들은 보통 은행이나 상점 옆에 있는데, 저는 여기 바로 남쪽에서 어슬렁거리는 산적들을 감시하라고 이 먼 데까지 보내졌어요.

english: It sounds more exciting than standing around guarding banks and shops.
translation: 은행이나 상점 앞에 서 있는 것보다는 재밌을 것 같은데요.

english: It's not too bad. At least I don't get attacked so often out here. Guards in the cities get killed all the time.
translation: 나쁘지 않아요. 적어도 여기선 공격당하는 일이 적거든요. 도시 경비병들은 맨날 죽어 나가요.

english: Honestly, people these days just don't know how to behave!
Don't distract me while I'm on duty! This mine has to be protected!
translation: 근무 중에 방해하지 마세요! 이 광산은 지켜야 한다고요!

english: What's going to attack a mine?
Goblins! They wander everywhere, attacking anyone they think is small enough to be an easy victim. We need more cannons to fight them off properly.
translation: 고블린이요! 그놈들은 사방을 돌아다니면서 만만해 보이는 상대만 골라 공격해요. 제대로 막아 내려면 대포가 더 필요해요.

english: Cannons? Those sound expensive.

A new cannon can cost 750,000 coins, and the ammo isn't easy to get, but they do up to 30 hitpoints of damage with each shot. When you've got an important mine like this one to protect, it's worth the expense.
translation: 새 대포는 750,000 코인이나 하고 탄약도 구하기 쉽지 않지만, 한 방에 체력을 최대 30까지 깎아요. 이렇게 중요한 광산을 지켜야 한다면 그만한 값어치가 있죠.

english: Thanks for the information.
You're welcome. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 천만에요. 이제 경비 임무 좀 보게 해 주세요.

english: Well, I've done my bit to help with that.
translation: 음, 그 일이라면 저도 제 몫은 했어요.

english: Yes, I heard. Now please let me get on with my guard duties.
translation: 네, 들었어요. 이제 경비 임무 좀 보게 해 주세요.

english: Alright, I'll leave you alone now.
Please don't disturb me, I've got to keep any eye out for suspicious individuals.
translation: 방해하지 말아 주세요. 수상한 자들이 없는지 살펴야 하거든요.

english: I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
translation: 거기서 뼈 하나 안 부러지고 빠져나오다니 놀랍네요.

english: Still, the Queen says it should be safe, and I'm to let you go back down if you want.
translation: 그래도 여왕님께서 이제 안전할 거라고 하셨고, 원하시면 다시 내려가게 해 드리라고 하셨어요.

english: Stand back. This area is restricted.
What's so special about it?
That's none of your business.
I think I've left some of my loot in there. Can I get it quick?
translation: 저 안에 제 전리품을 좀 두고 온 것 같은데요. 얼른 가져와도 돼요?

english: Nice try, Rookie.
What if I share some of it with you?
I do not care for wealth. Now move along.
translation: 난 재물엔 관심 없다. 이제 썩 지나가라.

english: May I pass?
You shall not... *cough*
No one is allowed past I'm afraid.
How suspicious...
What do you think you're doing?
Welcome, [Fremennik name].
Are you all right? Leftie?
translation: 어이 Leftie(왼이), 너 바르게 서 있는 거 맞지?

english: No, I'm on the left.
Only from your perspective. Someone entering the gate should call you Rightie, right Leftie?
translation: 그건 네 쪽에서 볼 때나 그렇지. 문으로 들어오는 사람은 널 Rightie(오른이)라고 불러야지, 안 그래 Leftie(왼이)?

english: That's right Leftie, that's right.
No, Rightie's fine Leftie.
translation: 아니, 그냥 Rightie(오른이)라고 해도 돼, Leftie(왼이).

english: Aaagh! Enough! If either of you mention left or right in my presence I'll have to scream! Can I come through the gate?
translation: 으아악! 그만! 둘 중 누구든 내 앞에서 왼쪽이나 오른쪽 얘기를 한 번만 더 하면 비명 지를 거예요! 문 좀 지나가도 돼요?

english: Don't let us stop you.
Yes, head right on in, sir.
You said it! You said it! ARRRRRRRRGGH!
You're free to go into the dungeons, your Highness.
Try not to get eaten by those monsters.
Halt! Are you here to sabotage the Motherlode Mine?
translation: 멈춰요! Motherlode Mine(마더로드 광산)을 방해하러 온 거예요?

english: What's the Motherlode Mine?
Prospector Percy discovered unusual mineral veins in this cave. Now he's built a machine to let us extract useful ores.
translation: Prospector Percy(탐광꾼 퍼시)가 이 동굴에서 특이한 광맥을 발견했어요. 지금은 쓸 만한 광석을 캐낼 수 있는 기계까지 만들었죠.

english: Percy calls it the Motherlode. I don't know why, and I'm not asking - that's between him and his mother.
translation: Percy(퍼시)는 그걸 마더로드라고 불러요. 왜 하필 '마더(어머니)'인지 모르겠지만 묻진 않을 거예요. 그건 그 사람과 그 어머니 사이의 일이니까요.

english: Dwarves don't normally let humans claim areas of the mine like this, but Percy's machine is really useful, so we struck a deal.
translation: 드워프들은 원래 인간이 이렇게 광산 구역을 차지하게 두지 않는데, 퍼시의 기계가 워낙 쓸모 있어서 거래를 했죠.

english: No, I'm not.
That's a relief. Have a nice day.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
I'd ask you not to.
What's the Motherlode Mine?
No, I'm not.
What would you do if I said 'yes'?
You stay right there, outerlander.
Don't worry, I'm not an outerlander, I am [Fremennik name], a Fremennik!
translation: 걱정 마세요, 전 외지인이 아니에요. 전 [Fremennik name], Fremennik(프레메닉)이라고요!

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You are not welcome in our camp.
translation: 거기 있으라고 했다, 외지인! 우리 야영지는 널 반기지 않는다.

english: Why, what's beyond here?
Our camp, outerlander, and we don't want any trouble there.
translation: 우리 야영지다, 외지인. 그리고 우린 말썽은 원치 않아.

english: I suppose I might as well let you pass now, since I can't seem to stop you anyway.
translation: 어차피 막을 수도 없는 것 같으니 이제 그냥 지나가게 해 주지.

english: Just remember that I'm watching you.
Go, outerlander, and do not hurry back.
translation: 가라, 외지인. 그리고 서둘러 돌아오지 마라.

english: You may pass freely, outerlander.
Hey, how did you get here?
Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter -
translation: 와서 좀 도와줄 수 있어요? 족장님 따님이 -

english: No, outerlander, I'm guarding this mountain pass from trolls and inquisitive people like you.
translation: 안 돼, 외지인. 난 트롤이랑 너처럼 꼬치꼬치 캐묻는 놈들로부터 이 산길을 지키고 있다.

english: Doesn't look like you were very successful in the last regard.
translation: 후자 쪽은 별로 성공 못 하신 것 같은데요.

english: If the chieftain would let me, I would correct that oversight.
translation: 족장님만 허락하시면 그 실수는 당장 바로잡겠다.

english: You may pass freely.
Thanks... and try to lighten up a bit, alright?
translation: 고마워요... 그리고 긴장 좀 푸세요, 네?

english: Don't press your luck, outerlander.
Feel free to come in and see the highlight of our culture, outerlander.
translation: 들어와서 우리 문화의 정수를 마음껏 구경해라, 외지인.

english: HALT! Who goes there?
Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 말썽 피우려는 거 아니에요.

english: But you shouldn't be here - be off with you!
translation: 그래도 여긴 네가 있을 곳이 아니야. 썩 꺼져!

english: I was going anyway.
I am [player name] the Mighty!
Mighty? You look like another of those silly adventurers who thinks they're the bee's knees just because they've done a few lousy quests!
translation: 위대해? 퀘스트 몇 개 깼다고 자기가 대단한 줄 아는 멍청한 모험가 중 하나로밖에 안 보이는데!

english: Well it sounds better than sitting on this rooftop all day looking at trees!
translation: 그래도 하루 종일 지붕 위에 앉아서 나무만 쳐다보는 것보단 낫잖아요!

english: I'll have you know it's a very important job guarding this jail!
translation: 똑똑히 알아 둬라, 이 감옥을 지키는 건 아주 중요한 일이야!

english: If anyone comes sneaking in here to mess around with the prisoners, the lads downstairs will make mincemeat of them, and I'll be here to pick them off if they try to escape.
translation: 누가 몰래 숨어들어서 죄수들한테 수작을 부리면 아래층 녀석들이 묵사발을 내 버릴 거고, 죄수가 탈옥하려 들면 내가 여기서 하나씩 쏴 맞힐 거다.

english: You mean people aren't meant to be able to shoot the prisoners in the cells?
translation: 그러니까 감방 안에 있는 죄수를 쏘면 안 된다는 거예요?

english: Yes, that's right.
Okay, it's been nice talking to you.
No-one, there's no-one here.
What? I can see you!
No, you're just imagining it. Perhaps you've been up here in the sun for too long?
translation: 아니요, 착각하시는 거예요. 여기서 햇볕을 너무 오래 쬐신 거 아니에요?

english: So who am I talking to?
translation: 그럼 난 지금 누구랑 얘기하고 있는 건데?

english: Oh dear, you've started talking to yourself. That's a common sign that you're going mad!
translation: 이런, 혼잣말을 시작하셨네요. 그거 미쳐 가는 흔한 징조래요!

english: But... but... you're standing right there...
translation: 하지만... 하지만... 너 바로 거기 서 있잖아...

english: Maybe you should leave him alone now.
translation: 이제 그만 내버려 두는 게 좋겠다.

english: Don't worry, I'm not going to cause trouble.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 말썽 피우려는 거 아니에요.

english: I am [player name] the Mighty!
No-one, there's no-one here.
Guh... mwww... zzzzz...
Hmph... heh heh heh...
Mmmm... big pint of beer... kebab...
translation: 음... 맥주 한 잔 가득... 케밥...

english: Mmmmmm... donuts...
Maybe I should let him sleep.
Hello, can I go in?
I'm afraid not. The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: 유감이지만 안 돼요. 반란 엘프들이 처리될 때까지 도시는 봉쇄돼 있어요.

english: Please, I won't cause any trouble.
Rules are rules. No one enters until the criminals are gone.
translation: 규칙은 규칙이에요. 범죄자들이 사라질 때까지 아무도 못 들어가요.

english: Fine, doesn't look very exciting anyway, it's just an empty field.
translation: 됐어요. 어차피 별로 재밌어 보이지도 않네요. 그냥 텅 빈 들판이잖아요.

english: Mind your tongue human. Our great city may be lost to us but that doesn't give you an excuse to talk like that.
translation: 말조심하세요, 인간. 우리의 위대한 도시를 잃었다고 해서 그런 식으로 말해도 된다는 건 아니에요.

english: Welcome, adventurer.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Greetings, traveller. Enjoy your time at the Ranging Guild.
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. Ranging Guild(궁수 길드)에서 즐거운 시간 보내세요.

english: *Whistles*
Exciting new post he said.
Can't wait for the weekend.
Why me?
I'm so bored
I'd kill for a kebab.
translation: 케밥 하나만 먹을 수 있다면 뭐든 하겠다.

english: I need a new job.
10 green bottles sit..*Whistles*
translation: 벽 위에 초록 병 열 개가..*휘파람*

english: I miss Billy and Bob *sighs*
Dum dum dum de dum Hey!
translation: 둠 둠 둠 디 둠 어이!

english: Why isn't it 6 already?
These night shifts just go on and on.
I'm hungry.
*sings* If I had 3 wil....
Halt thief!
Hey! Get your hands off there!
The Sinclairs are under house arrest for crimes against a crown, and it's all thanks to you.
translation: Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문은 왕실에 대한 범죄로 가택 연금 중이에요. 전부 당신 덕분이죠.

english: It's more luxury than they deserve.
The guard stares at you suspiciously.
Excuse me...
I don' need a hand drinkin me beer, go 'way!
translation: 내 맥주 마시는 데 손 빌릴 필요 없어, 꺼져!

english: But...
Talk to tha' hand coz thish face ain't lishtnin'!
translation: 말은 이 손한테 해, 이 얼굴은 안 듣고 이쓰니까!

english: Yeeeuuuch! I hatesh that shtuff, jusht bring ush a beer! Mmmmm beer!
translation: 으웨에엑! 그거 시러, 맥주나 가져와! 으으음 맥주!

english: Need more beer...
Sir? I have some more beer for you...
Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?
translation: 아아... 딱 내가 원하던 거야. 그래, 뭘 알고 싶다고?

english: I've come to report that Bert, the sandman, found a hand in the sand pit.
translation: 모래꾼 Bert(버트)가 sand pit(모래 구덩이)에서 손을 하나 발견했다고 보고하러 왔어요.

english: Lucky for him, means he can get even more work done.
translation: 운 좋은 녀석이네. 손이 하나 더 생겼으니 일을 더 많이 하겠구먼.

english: But aren't you going to find out who it ... belonged to?
translation: 하지만 그게... 누구 손이었는지 알아보셔야 하지 않나요?

english: Oops, No 'arm done. S'prob'ly a wizard, i's always the wizards fault, go ask them, jus' ring the bell outshide the guild and talk to the first pointy hatted ninny you shee!
translation: 에구, 손해 볼 건 없지. 아마 마법사 짓일 거야, 맨날 마법사들 탓이지. 가서 물어봐. 길드 바깥에 있는 종 울리고 처음 보이는 뾰족모자 멍청이한테 말 걸어!

english: Err... ok, I'll go ring the bell and talk to a wizard then.
translation: 어... 알았어요. 그럼 가서 종을 울리고 마법사랑 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Hello Sir!
Go 'way! This pint'sh nearly finished! Unlessh you got more that ish....? Wizards, s'all the wizard's fault...prob'ly that Zavistic one, he'sh the worsht!
translation: 꺼져! 이 잔 거의 다 비웠어! 더 가져온 게 이따면 모를까...? 마법사들, 다 마법사들 탓이야... 아마 그 Zavistic(자비스틱)이라는 녀석일 거야, 그놈이 제일 고야캐!

english: E're, you left this 'and in me beer!
translation: 어이, 너 내 맥주에 이 손 두고 갔잖아!

english: The Guard Captain fished the hand out of his beer and hands it to you.
translation: Guard Captain(경비대장)이 맥주에서 손을 건져 당신에게 건넨다.

english: *HIC*
What are you doing here? You're not one of the guards.
translation: 여기서 뭐 하는 거예요? 경비병도 아니면서.

english: I was just exploring. Is that okay?
I suppose, but why would you want to explore down here?
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 왜 하필 이런 아래를 탐험하고 싶은 거예요?

english: Well why not?
It's cold for a start.
I'd say it's still pretty warm compared to some places I've been.
translation: 제가 가 본 몇몇 곳에 비하면 여긴 꽤 따뜻한 편인데요.

english: If you say so. Just don't go causing any trouble.
Good day. What are you up to?
My job is to ensure that everyone can use the bank safely. Shifty types always hang around banks, you know.
translation: 제 일은 모두가 은행을 안전하게 이용하도록 지키는 거예요. 수상한 녀석들은 늘 은행 주변을 어슬렁거리거든요.

english: You're not shifty, are you?
No, of course not.
Jolly good. Carry on then.
Please help me with this!
Woof! Woof! Woof!
Woof Woof Bark!
*sigh* Not another one.
Another what?
Another 'archaeologist'.
I'm not going to let you plunder my Master's tomb you know.
translation: 내 주인님의 무덤을 털게 둘 생각은 없네, 알겠나.

english: That's a shame, have you got anything else I could do while I'm here?
translation: 아쉽네요. 여기 있는 동안 제가 할 만한 다른 일은 없을까요?

english: If it will keep you out of mischief I suppose I could set something up for you...
translation: 그걸로 자네가 말썽을 안 부린다면야 뭔가 마련해 줄 수는 있지...

english: I have a few rooms full of some things you humans might consider valuable, do you want to give it a go?
translation: 자네 같은 인간들이 값지다고 여길 만한 물건으로 가득한 방이 몇 개 있네. 한번 해 보겠나?

english: What should I do?
You have five minutes to explore the treasure rooms and collect as many artefacts as you can.
translation: 자네에겐 5분이 주어지네. 그동안 보물 방을 탐색해서 유물을 최대한 많이 모으게.

english: The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi found in each room.
translation: 유물은 각 방에 있는 항아리, 상자, 석관 안에 있네.

english: There are eight treasure rooms, each subsequent room requires higher thieving skills to both enter the room and thieve from the urns and other containers.
translation: 보물 방은 모두 여덟 개고, 안쪽 방일수록 방에 들어가거나 항아리 같은 보관함을 털 때 더 높은 도둑질 레벨이 필요하네.

english: The rewards also become more lucrative the further into the tomb you go.
translation: 무덤 안쪽으로 들어갈수록 보상도 더 쏠쏠해지지.

english: You will also have to deactivate a trap in order to enter the main part of each room.
translation: 각 방의 중심부로 들어가려면 덫도 해제해야 하네.

english: When you want to move onto the next room you need to find the correct door first.
translation: 다음 방으로 가고 싶으면 먼저 올바른 문을 찾아야 하네.

english: There are four possible exits, you must open the door before finding out whether it is the exit or not.
translation: 출구일 수 있는 문은 네 개인데, 출구인지 아닌지는 문을 열어 봐야 알 수 있네.

english: Opening the doors require picking their locks. Having a lockpick will make this easier.
translation: 문을 열려면 자물쇠를 따야 하네. lockpick(자물쇠 따개)가 있으면 더 쉬울 걸세.

english: How do I leave the game?
If at any point you decide you need to leave just use a glowing door.
translation: 언제든 나가고 싶으면 빛나는 문을 이용하게.

english: The game will end and you will be taken out of the pyramid.
translation: 그러면 게임이 끝나고 피라미드 밖으로 나가게 될 걸세.

english: What about the chests and sarcophagi?
The artefacts are in the urns, chests and sarcophagi.
translation: 유물은 항아리, 상자, 석관 안에 있네.

english: Urns contain snakes that guard them.
translation: 항아리에는 그걸 지키는 뱀이 들어 있네.

english: The sarcophagi take some strength to open. They take a while to open.
translation: 석관은 여는 데 힘이 좀 필요하고, 시간도 꽤 걸리지.

english: Of course, Mummies have been known to take a nap in the sarcophagi, so beware.
translation: 물론 미라들이 석관 안에서 낮잠을 자기도 하니 조심하게.

english: The golden chests generally contain better artefacts, but are also trapped with scarabs!
translation: 황금 상자에는 대개 더 좋은 유물이 들어 있지만, 스카라베 함정도 걸려 있지!

english: Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: 이 유물들에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: There are a number of different artefacts, of three main types. The least valuable are the pottery statuettes and scarabs, and the ivory combs.
translation: 유물은 여러 가지가 있는데, 크게 세 종류로 나뉘네. 가장 값어치가 낮은 건 도자기 조각상과 스카라베, 그리고 상아 빗이지.

english: Next are the stone scarabs, statuettes and seals, and finally the gold versions of those artefacts.
translation: 그다음은 돌로 된 스카라베, 조각상, 인장이고, 마지막이 그것들의 금 버전일세.

english: They are not old, but are well made.
translation: 오래된 건 아니지만, 잘 만든 물건들이지.

english: What do I do with artefacts once I've collected them?
That Simon Simpleton, I mean Templeton, will probably give you some money for them.
translation: 그 Simon Simpleton(사이먼 멍청턴), 아니 Templeton(템플턴)이 아마 돈을 좀 쳐줄 걸세.

english: He couldn't spot a real artefact if it came up to him and bit him in the face.
translation: 그 친구는 진짜 유물이 다가와서 얼굴을 물어뜯어도 못 알아볼 위인이지.

english: He usually slinks about near the pyramid north-east of Sophanem. I expect he's trying to get some poor fools to steal things from that pyramid as well.
translation: 보통 Sophanem(소파넴) 북동쪽 피라미드 근처를 어슬렁거리네. 아마 불쌍한 바보들한테 그 피라미드에서도 물건을 훔쳐 오게 하려는 거겠지.

english: I expect he'll give you more gold for some than others.
translation: 유물에 따라 금을 더 많이 쳐주는 것도 있을 걸세.

english: What's this I've heard about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: Golden Sceptre(황금 셉터)에 대한 얘기를 들었는데요?

english: Where did you hear about that?
I couldn't possibly say.
It's the only genuinely valuable artefact in this place.
translation: 이곳에서 진짜로 값어치가 있는 유일한 유물일세.

english: It links all the great pyramids in the area, and can be used to travel between them.
translation: 이 지역의 위대한 피라미드들을 모두 잇고 있어서, 피라미드 사이를 오가는 데 쓸 수 있지.

english: It requires charging with offerings of fine craftsmanship, that's why we have so many spare artefacts lying around.
translation: 정교한 공예품을 바쳐야 충전되는데, 그래서 여기 남아도는 유물이 이렇게 많은 걸세.

english: Anyway, I won't let you get your grubby little hands on the sceptre.
translation: 어쨌든, 자네의 그 더러운 손이 sceptre(셉터)에 닿게 두지는 않을 걸세.

english: How do I get the artefacts?
What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame.
translation: 플레이어가 Pyramid Plunder(피라미드 약탈) 미니게임에 들어간다.

english: Not right now.
Well, get out of here then.
I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
Fine, I'll take you to the first room now...
Player is put in the Pyramid Plunder minigame
translation: 플레이어가 Pyramid Plunder(피라미드 약탈) 미니게임에 들어간다

english: I want to charge my sceptre.
What sceptre?
Er... I don't know.
Right...
You shouldn't have that thing in the first place, thief!
translation: 자넨 애초에 그걸 가지고 있어선 안 되네, 도둑 같으니!

english: Hmm... If I give you back some of the artefacts I've taken from the tomb, will you recharge the sceptre for me?
translation: 음... 무덤에서 가져간 유물을 좀 돌려드리면 sceptre(셉터)를 다시 충전해 주실래요?

english: No! Why would I waste the King's magic when it's already fully charged?
translation: 안 되네! 이미 가득 충전돼 있는데 왜 왕의 마법을 낭비하겠나?

english: *sigh* Oh alright, but this is such a waste of the King's magic...
translation: *한숨* 아, 알았네. 하지만 이건 왕의 마법을 낭비하는 짓이야...

english: You need to have 6 gold artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: sceptre(셉터)를 다시 충전하려면 금 유물 6개가 필요하네.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 자넨 이미 [x]회[s] 충전돼 있었고, 난 할인 같은 건 안 해주네. 그러니 유물 6개로 [y]회[s] 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: Right, 6 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 유물 6개로 [x]회 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: You need to have 12 stone artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: sceptre(셉터)를 다시 충전하려면 돌 유물 12개가 필요하네.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 12 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 자넨 이미 [x]회[s] 충전돼 있었고, 난 할인 같은 건 안 해주네. 그러니 유물 12개로 [y]회[s] 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: Right, 12 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 유물 12개로 [x]회 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: You need to have 24 pottery or ivory artefacts to recharge your sceptre.
translation: sceptre(셉터)를 다시 충전하려면 도자기나 상아 유물 24개가 필요하네.

english: Right, you already had [x] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 24 artefacts gives you [y] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 자넨 이미 [x]회[s] 충전돼 있었고, 난 할인 같은 건 안 해주네. 그러니 유물 24개로 [y]회[s] 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: Right, 24 artefacts gives you [x] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 유물 24개로 [x]회 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: You've had your five minutes of plundering. Now be off with you!
translation: 5분 동안 실컷 털었잖나. 이제 썩 물러가게!

english: Right, you already had [amount] charge[s], and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charge[s]. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 자넨 이미 [amount]회[s] 충전돼 있었고, 난 할인 같은 건 안 해주네. 그러니 유물 6개로 [amount]회[s] 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: Right, 6 artefacts gives you [amount] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 좋아, 유물 6개로 [amount]회 충전일세. 이제 갈 길 가게.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Then clear off!
Can you remind me what I am supposed to do with these?
translation: 이걸로 뭘 해야 하는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Thank you!
You have found my Master's Sceptre - You have been here long enough. Begone.
translation: 자네가 내 주인님의 Sceptre(셉터)를 찾았군. 여기 머문 지 충분히 오래됐네. 썩 물러가게.

english: Grrr! Someone has found the Pharaoh's sceptre!
translation: 으르르! 누군가 Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 찾아냈어!

english: Right! That's it. I'm clearing all the urns and refilling them now.
translation: 좋아! 이걸로 끝이다. 지금 당장 항아리를 전부 비우고 다시 채우겠다.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 아직 안 끝났네! 이것도 해 주게!

english: The guardian mummy has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 수호 미라가 당신에게 puzzle box(퍼즐 상자)를 주었다!

english: Scarabs can do puzzles better than that!
Excellent work!
The guardian mummy has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!
translation: 수호 미라가 당신에게 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!/casket(작은 상자)를 얻었다!

english: That sounds like fun, what do I do?
Not right now.
I know what I'm doing - let's get on with it.
I want to charge my sceptre.
What should I do?
How do I leave the game?
What about the chests and sarcophagi?
Tell me more about these artefacts.
translation: 이 유물들에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: I'm ready to give it a go now.
What's this I hear about a Golden Sceptre?
translation: Golden Sceptre(황금 셉터)에 대한 얘기를 들었는데요?

english: How do I get the artefacts?
What do I do with the artefacts I collect?
Gold artefacts.
Stone artefacts.
Pottery and ivory artefacts.
Actually, I'm more interested in plundering the tombs.
translation: 사실 저는 무덤을 터는 데 더 관심이 있어요.

english: Nothing.
Hello there. I have a message for you.
Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
[player name]?
Are you there [player name]?
[player name]? I have a message for you.
translation: [player name] 님? 전해 드릴 메시지가 있습니다.

english: [player name]? You've been sent a message.
Maybe another time.
Hello again Guidor. How are you doing?
I'm hanging in there.
Good for you.
I don't really want any visitors just now.
translation: 지금은 손님을 별로 맞고 싶지 않네.

english: Hunter Aco reporting for duty!
[Player name] reporting for... nothing in particular, really.
translation: [Player name], 보고합니다... 딱히 보고할 건 없지만요.

english: What can I do for you?
What do you do here?
Hunting, mostly.
Hmm, I probably could've guessed that.
translation: 흠, 그건 안 물어봐도 알 수 있었겠네요.

english: Perhaps you confused me for Teco over there? He's more into plants and all that.
translation: 혹시 저기 있는 Teco(테코)랑 헷갈린 거 아니에요? 그쪽은 식물 같은 데 더 관심이 많거든요.

english: What got you into hunting then?
Don't tell too many people, but it's much nicer here than wearing a uniform and marching around!
translation: 너무 여기저기 말하진 말아요. 근데 제복 입고 행진하는 것보다 여기가 훨씬 좋거든요!

english: I'm still not sure how I feel about having Teco around the whole time though. People confuse us too often for my liking.
translation: 그래도 Teco(테코)가 늘 옆에 붙어 있는 건 아직 좀 그래요. 사람들이 우리 둘을 너무 자주 헷갈리거든요.

english: See you later.
Can I get a rumour?
You're new here, aren't you? You might want to talk to Verity before you get started.
translation: 여기 처음이죠? 시작하기 전에 Verity(베리티)랑 먼저 얘기해 보는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 보고가 사실인지 좀 확인해 줄래요? 누가 [creature] 한 마리를 봤다고 하네요. 찾으면 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 줘요.

english: There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 희귀한 [creature]에 대한 소문이 들어왔어요. 찾으면 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 줘요.

english: We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 지역 [creature] 무리 중에 조금 다른 녀석이 있다는 보고가 들어왔어요. 찾으면 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 줘요.

english: Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 지역 [creature] 무리 중 독특한 표본에 대한 정보가 필요할 것 같아요. 찾으면 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 좀 가져와 줘요.

english: I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이상한 [creature]에 대한 소문을 들었는데, 한번 확인해 줄래요? 찾으면 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 줘요.

english: Thanks for doing that for me. Here's your reward.
Would you like another rumour?
Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: 고마워요. 그 보고는 처리한 걸로 표시해 둘게요. 소문 하나 더 들어 볼래요?

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 지금 제 일로 사냥 중이잖아요. 이번 소문은 [creature]에 관한 거였어요. 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 좀 가져와야 해요.

english: I hear you're hunting for [Guild Hunter]. Aren't you looking for a [creature] at the moment? You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: [Guild Hunter] 님 일로 사냥 중이라고 들었는데요. 지금 [creature] 찾는 중 아니에요? 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 좀 가져가야 할 거예요.

english: Unless you fancy hunting for me instead?
translation: 아니면 대신 제 사냥을 맡아 볼래요?

english: Now then... I asked you to hunt a [creature] for me and bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 자, 그럼... [creature] 사냥해서 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 달라고 부탁했었죠.

english: Heard we're having an intel reshuffle. You should probably focus on your current task for now.
translation: 정보 재정비가 있다고 들었어요. 지금은 하던 일에 집중하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Gilman said that you're doing some work for him right now. I won't interfere with that.
translation: Gilman(길먼) 말로는 지금 그 사람 일을 하고 있다면서요. 방해하지 않을게요.

english: We're all having a rest, but don't you have something to be getting on with?
translation: 다들 쉬는 중이긴 한데, 할 일이 있지 않아요?

english: Never mind.
What do you do here?
Can I get a rumour?
See you later.
Yes.
No.
Never mind.
Good day, hunter.
Good day.
What's brought you in here today?
Just looking for something to do.
Ah, that's the same thing that brought me here.
Are you not a hunter by trade?
Only by interest at the moment, although the gang here are trying their best to train me.
translation: 지금은 그냥 관심만 있는 정도예요. 여기 사람들이 열심히 가르쳐 주고는 있지만요.

english: Are you enjoying it?
Well it's less boring than what I've done before, so I can't complain!
translation: 음, 전에 하던 일보다는 덜 지루하니까 불만은 없어요!

english: What were you doing before this then?
translation: 그럼 이 일 전에는 뭘 했어요?

english: Well, my parents wanted me to go into the whole wine growing business, but farming was a bit too slow-paced for me.

english: Unless you fancy hunting for me instead?
translation: 아니면 대신 내 사냥을 맡아 볼래요?

english: If I'm remembering correctly, I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 내 기억이 맞다면, [creature] 사냥해서 그 녀석의 [rare parts] 좀 가져와 달라고 했었죠.

english: Heard we're having an intel reshuffle. You should probably focus on your current task for now.
translation: 정보 재정비가 있다고 들었어요. 지금은 하던 일에 집중하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Gilman said that you're doing some work for him right now. I won't interfere with that.
translation: Gilman(길먼) 말로는 지금 그 사람 일을 하고 있다면서요. 방해하지 않을게요.

english: We're all having a rest, but don't you have something to be getting on with?
translation: 다들 쉬는 중이긴 한데, 할 일이 있지 않아요?

english: There's an extra seat at this table. I suppose you'd be interested in claiming it one day?
translation: 이 탁자에 빈자리가 하나 있죠. 언젠가 그 자리를 차지하고 싶은 거겠죠?

english: You need 91 Hunter to take on tier 4 Hunters' Rumours.
translation: 4단계 Hunters' Rumours(사냥꾼의 소문)을 맡으려면 Hunter(사냥) 레벨 91이 필요하다.

english: Can we talk about Fox?
translation: Fox(폭스) 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: Can I get a rumour?
See you later.
If the rumour is for a moonlight antelope:
translation: 소문이 moonlight antelope(달빛 영양)에 관한 것이라면:

english: Yes.
No.
Never mind.
Oh, hello there newcomer. I'm Guild Scribe Verity. Do you need me to explain the work we do here?
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요, 신입이시네요. 저는 Guild Scribe Verity(길드 서기 베리티)예요. 여기서 하는 일을 설명해 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
So it's nice and simple. Just chat to any of the hunters in here to help them out. They're all following reports that I've split up amongst them.
translation: 아주 간단해요. 여기 있는 사냥꾼 누구에게나 말을 걸어서 일을 도와주시면 돼요. 다들 제가 나눠 준 보고를 쫓고 있거든요.

english: Reports?
Indeed. There are all sorts of interesting creatures to hunt out there. Sometimes we get reports of a particularly unique example. When that happens, one of the hunters will set out to find it.
translation: 맞아요. 바깥에는 사냥할 만한 흥미로운 생물이 아주 많아요. 가끔 특히 독특한 개체에 대한 보고가 들어오는데, 그러면 사냥꾼 중 한 명이 그걸 찾으러 나가요.

english: If you do decide to take a job from any of the hunters, they'll tell you what type of creature they're looking into. Hunt that creature until you encounter the unique specimen.
translation: 사냥꾼에게 일을 받기로 하면, 어떤 종류의 생물을 조사하는지 알려 줄 거예요. 그 독특한 표본을 만날 때까지 그 생물을 사냥하세요.

english: Once you've caught it, bring some proof back to the hunter that sent you out in the first place. I'm sure they'll reward you for your time.
translation: 잡고 나면 처음에 당신을 보낸 사냥꾼에게 증거를 가져가세요. 분명 수고에 대한 보상을 해 줄 거예요.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Nilsal, hunter. Anything to report?
Nothing abnormal today.
What does a scribe do?
I'm the primary record-keeper here. I organise all of our reports and write up anything important to be sent back to the city.
translation: 저는 이곳의 주 기록 담당이에요. 모든 보고를 정리하고, 중요한 건 글로 써서 도시로 보내요.

english: Do you go out on any hunts with the others?
I wouldn't know what to do with myself out there, so I like to stay back here with my scrolls.
translation: 밖에 나가면 뭘 해야 할지 모르겠어서, 여기 남아서 제 두루마리들이랑 지내는 게 좋아요.

english: How many rumours have I completed?
Our records suggest you've managed to complete [number of completed rumours] rumours for us!
translation: 기록에 따르면 지금까지 소문을 [number of completed rumours]개나 해결해 주셨네요!

english: I have this spare hunter gear, is there anything I can do with it?
translation: 남는 사냥꾼 장비가 있는데, 이걸로 할 수 있는 게 있을까요?

english: Spare, you say? Hmmm.... I'm sure one of the other hunters could benefit from it if you're sure. If you hand it over to me, I can give you some spare supplies in return.
translation: 남는다고요? 흐음.... 정말 괜찮다면 다른 사냥꾼 중 누군가가 요긴하게 쓸 거예요. 저한테 넘겨주시면 대신 남는 보급품을 좀 드릴게요.

english: I have to go.
Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little more than I am right now?
translation: 소문 정보를 지금보다 조금 더 걸러 드릴까요?

english: Would you like me to filter the rumour information a little less than I am right now?
translation: 소문 정보를 지금보다 조금 덜 걸러 드릴까요?

english: What does a scribe do?
How many rumours have I completed?
I have this spare hunter gear...
I have to go.
Yes
No
Yes please!
No thanks.
Greetings!
This is the Champions' Guild. Only adventurers who have proved themselves worthy by gaining influence from quests are allowed in here.
translation: 이곳은 Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)입니다. 퀘스트로 영향력을 쌓아 자격을 증명한 모험가만 들어올 수 있습니다.

english: Let me see what you've got there. Ah, yes, one of the champions. Just head downstairs and you'll find your challenge waiting in the arena. Hand that scroll to the doorman to get in.
translation: 가져오신 것을 한번 보지요. 아, 그렇군요, 챔피언 중 한 분이시군요. 아래층으로 내려가시면 경기장에서 도전이 기다리고 있을 겁니다. 들어가시려면 그 두루마리를 문지기에게 건네십시오.

english: Of course! Here you go.
I think you've already got a key. Maybe you should check your key ring.
translation: 이미 열쇠를 가지고 계신 것 같습니다. 열쇠고리를 확인해 보시지요.

english: I think you've already got a key somewhere.
translation: 이미 어딘가에 열쇠를 가지고 계신 것 같습니다.

english: You have not proved yourself worthy to enter here yet.
translation: 아직 이곳에 들어올 자격을 증명하지 못하셨습니다.

english: The door won't open - you need at least 32 Quest Points.
translation: 문이 열리지 않는다 - 퀘스트 포인트가 최소 32점 필요하다.

english: Greetings bold adventurer. Welcome to the guild of Champions.
translation: 어서 오십시오, 용감한 모험가여. Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: What is this place?
I've been given a challenge. What now?
translation: 도전 과제를 받았어요. 이제 어떻게 하죠?

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: Melzar's Maze(멜자르의 미로) 열쇠를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Oh, you're a new face around here, aren't you?
translation: 어머, 이 근처에선 처음 보는 얼굴이네요?

english: I am indeed. Just exploring the savannah.
Well, I'm Apatura. Let me welcome you to our small corner of Varlamore.
translation: 그럼, 저는 Apatura(아파투라)예요. Varlamore(바를라모어)의 이 작은 한구석에 온 걸 환영해요.

english: Nilsal, hunter.
Nilsal, Apatura.
I see you've been doing a lot of work for the guild of late. Would you like to learn a bit more about our history?
translation: 요즘 길드를 위해 일을 많이 해 줬더군요. 우리 역사에 대해 조금 더 알아보고 싶나요?

english: Absolutely.
Here's a little snippet about our original construction, from right back when we were first established.
translation: 우리 길드가 처음 세워지던 시절, 건물을 지었을 때 이야기를 조금 적어 둔 글이에요.

english: No, thank you.
Alright. You can grab it from my bookshelf upstairs whenever you want to read it.
translation: 알겠어요. 읽고 싶을 때 언제든 위층 제 책장에서 가져가요.

english: Your commitment to helping our guild is commendable, iknami.
translation: 우리 길드를 돕는 당신의 헌신은 정말 칭찬할 만해요, iknami(이크나미).

english: It's good to be helping, guildmaster.
If you want to learn about our history, I have a document here you can read if you'd like.
translation: 우리 역사에 대해 알고 싶다면, 여기 읽어 볼 만한 문서가 있어요.

english: That would be interesting.
You can take it from my shelves when you're ready to read it. Just head up that ladder over there.
translation: 읽을 준비가 되면 제 선반에서 가져가요. 저기 있는 사다리로 올라가면 돼요.

english: You have proven yourself a true ally of our guild, iknami.
translation: 당신은 우리 길드의 진정한 동지임을 증명했어요, iknami(이크나미).

english: As a personal reward for your help, you can have this key to open the chest on the floor above.
translation: 도와준 데 대한 제 개인적인 보답으로, 위층 상자를 열 수 있는 이 열쇠를 줄게요.

english: What do you do here?
We're mostly here to keep an eye on the local animal populations, and provide animal parts to the city.
translation: 우리는 주로 이 지역 동물 개체군을 살피고, 도시에 동물 부위를 공급하는 일을 해요.

english: As for me personally, I'm the current master of this guild.
translation: 저로 말하자면, 이 길드의 현 길드장이에요.

english: Current master?
A hunter's work is dangerous. We tend to go through members faster than other guilds. That said, I'm usually too busy with politics and paperwork to go out hunting these days.
translation: 사냥꾼 일은 위험하거든요. 다른 길드보다 사람이 빨리 바뀌는 편이에요. 그렇긴 해도 요즘 저는 정치랑 서류 일로 너무 바빠서 사냥하러 나갈 틈이 없어요.

english: I'd better be off.
Is that a skillcape you have with you?
translation: 지금 가지고 있는 그거 스킬 망토인가요?

english: It is.
Would you like me to enhance it with the ability to teleport directly to the guild?
translation: 길드로 곧장 순간이동하는 능력을 더해 줄까요?

english: Yes please.
Kuani! That should be done for you now.
No thanks.
Absolutely.
No, thank you.
That would be interesting.
What do you do here?
I'd better be off.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Welcome to the farming guild. How may I help you?
translation: Farming Guild(농사 길드)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Tell me about the guild.
After the Shayzien Army cleared out the lizardmen in this area, I founded this guild with some fellow Hosidius farmers.
translation: Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)가 이 지역의 lizardmen(리자드맨)을 몰아낸 뒤, 저는 Hosidius(호시디우스)의 동료 농부들과 함께 이 길드를 세웠어요.

english: Why here? Why not within the safety of Kourend?
translation: 왜 여기예요? 안전한 Kourend(쿠렌드) 안이 아니고요?

english: The heat of the volcano allows us to grow things here that would never survive in the climate of Kourend. The discoveries we have made are worth the extra risk.
translation: 화산의 열기 덕분에 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 기후에서는 절대 살아남지 못할 작물도 여기서는 키울 수 있거든요. 그동안 이뤄 낸 발견들을 생각하면 그 정도 위험은 감수할 만해요.

english: Fair enough, anything else I should know about the guild?
translation: 그렇군요. 길드에 대해 더 알아 둬야 할 게 있나요?

english: The guild is split into three tiers, with only advanced farmers being allowed access to the upper echelons.
translation: 길드는 세 단계로 나뉘어 있고, 숙련된 농부만 위쪽 단계에 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: Would you like to hear more about one of the tiers?
translation: 단계 중 하나에 대해 더 들어 보시겠어요?

english: Tell me about the beginner tier.
In the beginner tier you can access farming patches for cacti, allotments, bushes and flowers. You'll also find some shops with useful farming supplies.
translation: 초급 단계에서는 선인장, 텃밭 작물, 덤불, 꽃을 심는 농사 구역을 쓸 수 있어요. 쓸모 있는 농사 용품을 파는 가게도 몇 군데 있고요.

english: Would you like to hear more about another tier?
Tell me about the intermediate tier.
In the intermediate tier you can access farming patches for herbs and trees. You'll also find the anima and hespori patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: 중급 단계에서는 약초와 나무를 심는 농사 구역을 쓸 수 있어요. 이 길드에만 있는 anima(아니마) 구역과 hespori(헤스포리) 구역도 있답니다.

english: Tell me about the advanced tier.
In the advanced tier you can access farming patches for fruit trees and spirit trees. You'll also find the redwood and celastrus patches which are unique to this guild.
translation: 상급 단계에서는 과일나무와 정령 나무를 심는 농사 구역을 쓸 수 있어요. 이 길드에만 있는 redwood(레드우드) 구역과 celastrus(셀라스트루스) 구역도 있답니다.

english: No thanks.
Tell me about yourself.
My name is Jane, and I am the founder of the Farming Guild.
translation: 제 이름은 Jane(제인)이고, Farming Guild(농사 길드)를 세운 사람이에요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
That's all, thanks.
Do you have any jobs for me?
Well we always need to rotate the crops we're growing to stop the soil from tiring due to lack of nutrients. It would be great if you could help out with that.
translation: 음, 지력이 떨어지지 않도록 키우는 작물을 늘 돌려 심어야 하거든요. 그 일을 도와주시면 정말 좋겠어요.

english: What would I need to do?
If you're interested, I can give you a farming contract which tells you what to plant within the guild. Complete the contract, and I'll give you some seeds as a thank you.
translation: 관심 있으시면 길드 안에 무엇을 심을지 적힌 농사 계약서를 드릴게요. 계약을 완수하시면 감사의 뜻으로 씨앗을 좀 드릴게요.

english: Thanks for the information.
I'd like a farming contract.
What kind of contract would you like?
Could I have an easy contract please?
Please could you grow [a/some] [plant(s)] for us? I'll reward you once you have checked [its/their] health.
translation: 저희를 위해 [a/some] [plant(s)]을(를) 키워 주시겠어요? [its/their] 상태를 확인하시고 나면 보상해 드릴게요.

english: Please could you grow some [plant]s for us? I'll reward you once they have been fully harvested.
translation: 저희를 위해 [plant]s을(를) 좀 키워 주시겠어요? 다 수확하고 나면 보상해 드릴게요.

english: Could I have a medium contract please?
Could I have a hard contract please?
I've completed my farming contract.
You'll be wanting a reward then. Here's a seed pack.
translation: 그럼 보상을 받으셔야겠죠. 여기 seed pack(씨앗 꾸러미)이에요.

english: No.
Fair enough. Come back when you want another one.
translation: 알겠어요. 다른 계약이 필요하면 다시 오세요.

english: What's my current farming contract?
We need you to grow [a/some] [plant(s)]. I'll reward you once you have checked [its/their] health.
translation: [a/some] [plant(s)]을(를) 키워 주셔야 해요. [its/their] 상태를 확인하시고 나면 보상해 드릴게요.

english: We need you to grow some [plant]s. I'll reward you once they've been fully harvested.
translation: [plant]s을(를) 좀 키워 주셔야 해요. 다 수확하고 나면 보상해 드릴게요.

english: Do you have anything easier?
I suppose I could give you a different contract, if you're sure.
translation: 정 그러시다면 다른 계약을 드릴 수는 있어요.

english: Yes please.
Thank you.
How many farming contracts have I completed?
translation: 제가 농사 계약을 몇 번 완수했죠?

english: You've completed [amount] farming contracts.
Can I trade in some spirit seeds?
translation: spirit seed(정령 나무 씨앗)을 좀 교환할 수 있을까요?

english: Of course, I will also take potted spirit seeds and saplings. What would you like to trade in?
translation: 물론이죠. 화분에 심은 정령 나무 씨앗과 묘목도 받아요. 무엇을 교환하시겠어요?

english: I'm just passing by.
Sure, let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
translation: 그래요, 제가 도울 일이 있으면 말씀하세요.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seeds to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: 교환할 Spirit seed(정령 나무 씨앗)이 없으시네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seedlings to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: 교환할 Spirit seedling(정령 나무 싹)이 없으시네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit seedling(w)s to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: 교환할 Spirit seedling(w)(정령 나무 싹 (w))이 없으시네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: I'm afraid you have no Spirit saplings to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: 교환할 Spirit sapling(정령 나무 묘목)이 없으시네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: I'm afraid you have nothing to trade in, come back when you do.
translation: 교환할 게 하나도 없으시네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Hey! You need a Farming level of at least 65 to enter that area of the Farming Guild.
translation: 잠깐요! Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 그 구역에 들어가려면 Farming(농사) 레벨이 최소 65는 돼야 해요.

english: Hey! You need a Farming level of at least 85 to enter that area of the Farming Guild.
translation: 잠깐요! Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 그 구역에 들어가려면 Farming(농사) 레벨이 최소 85는 돼야 해요.

Tell me about the beginner tier.
Tell me about the intermediate tier.
Tell me about the advanced tier.

english: Can I trade in some spirit seeds?
translation: spirit seed(정령 나무 씨앗)을 좀 교환할 수 있을까요?
