Welcome to the woodcutting guild. How may I help you?
translation: Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드)에 온 걸 환영하네. 무엇을 도와줄까?

english: Tell me about the guild.

I founded the woodcutting guild when I retired from the Shayzien military. I spotted the ancient redwood trees in the hills many years ago from the Shayzien camp, and decided to construct the guild around them.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 군에서 은퇴하면서 이 Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드)를 세웠지. 오래전 샤이지엔 진영에서 언덕 위의 오래된 redwood(레드우드) 나무들을 보고는, 그 나무들을 중심으로 길드를 짓기로 했다네.

english: You can find them to the West, just follow the path.
translation: 서쪽에 있으니 길만 따라가면 될 걸세.

english: However, if you're skilled in combat, or simply afraid of heights, the ent cavern may be more suited for you. The ents dwell deep beneath the ancient redwoods, and can be accessed through the cave to the North-West.
translation: 하지만 전투에 능하거나 그냥 높은 곳이 무섭다면 ent(엔트) 동굴이 더 잘 맞을 걸세. 엔트들은 오래된 레드우드 아래 깊은 곳에 사는데, 북서쪽 동굴로 들어갈 수 있지.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
That's all, thanks.
Tell me about yourself.
My name is Lars, and I am the founder of the woodcutting guild. I originally grew up in a Shayzien camp, and was raised on the battlefield.
translation: 내 이름은 Lars(라르스)고, Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드)를 세운 사람이네. 원래 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 진영에서 자랐고, 전쟁터에서 컸지.

english: As I grew older, I found peace in Hosidius, and the joys of skilled labour. I turned in my battleaxe for a hatchet, and set up a guild for those also talented in the skill of woodcutting.
translation: 나이가 들면서 Hosidius(호시디우스)에서 평화를 찾았고, 손기술로 일하는 즐거움도 알게 됐네. 전투 도끼를 내려놓고 손도끼를 들었고, 나처럼 Woodcutting(벌목)에 재능 있는 이들을 위해 길드를 세웠지.

english: I'm just passing by.
Sure, let me know if there's anything I can do for you.
translation: 알겠네, 내가 도울 일이 있으면 말하게.

english: Here, solve this.
Guildmaster Lars hands you a [light /puzzle]box!
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 공간을 좀 비워 주게. 줄 게 있다네.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 내가 보기엔 아직 안 풀린 것 같군.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 보상: [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: Tell me about the guild.
Tell me about yourself.
That's all, thanks.
I'm just passing by.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 오늘 크리스탈 도시 날씨 정말 좋죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 이것저것 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 할 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
You look like you could use a little colour in your life! Can I interest you in any dyes?
translation: 삶에 색깔이 좀 필요해 보이시네요! 염료 좀 보시겠어요?

english: I could take a look.
No thanks.
Well, don't be afraid to come back any time!
I could take a look.
No thanks.
Finest silver in all of Keldagrim, come and see!
Right, what do you have?
Silver, what else!
No thanks.
That's my silver!
Halt, thief!
Guards, catch that thief!
Right, what do you have?
Not interested, thanks.
Hello.
Good day brave adventurer! Could I interest you in my fine selection of weapons?
translation: 안녕하세요, 용감한 모험가님! 제가 엄선한 훌륭한 무기들 좀 구경하시겠어요?

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Grrrr!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같다! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요하다!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Gulluck
translation: Gulluck(걸럭)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Thanks. Hmph.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 포인트가 [number]점 있다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격이 없다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 적립 포인트가 [number]점 있다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 받는 걸 잊지 말자.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 다른 주문을 받자. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Hello, what are you doing out here?
I'm a banker, the only one around these dangerous parts.
translation: 전 은행원이에요. 이 위험한 지역에 하나뿐인 은행원이죠.

english: Well, now I know.
Knowledge is power my friend.
Cool, I'd like to access my bank account please.
translation: 좋네요, 제 은행 계좌를 이용하고 싶어요.

english: Right, so can I check my PIN settings?
translation: 그럼 제 PIN 설정을 확인할 수 있을까요?

english: I'd like to collect items.
Well, now I know.
Spicy kebabs!
Bat kebabs!
Spicy bat kebabs!
Bat shish kebabs!
Kebabs!
Ah, isn't it a lovely day?
It's not bad. What puts you in such a good mood?
translation: 나쁘진 않네요. 뭐가 그렇게 기분이 좋으세요?

english: Oh, I just love my job. The smell of the sea breeze, the smell of the arctic pine sap, the smell of the yaks. I find it all so bracing.
translation: 아, 전 그냥 제 일이 정말 좋아요. 바닷바람 냄새, 북극 소나무 수액 냄새, 야크 냄새까지. 전부 정말 상쾌하거든요.

english: Bracing? Hmmm. I think I might have chosen a different word.
translation: 상쾌하다고요? 흐음. 저라면 다른 단어를 골랐을 것 같은데요.

english: Haha welcome to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
translation: 하하, 내 장애물 코스에 온 걸 환영한다. 즐겨라. 하지만 여긴 애들 놀이터가 아니라는 걸 명심해. 여기서 죽은 사람도 있으니까.

english: The best way to train, is to go round the course in a clockwise direction.
translation: 훈련하기 제일 좋은 방법은 코스를 시계 방향으로 도는 거다.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 이것 좀 풀어 줘. 난 생각할 게 따로 있거든.

english: Gunnjorn has given you a puzzle box!
Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
I don't have the puzzle box with me.
That's not much use is it, go and fetch it!
Thanks [player name]!
What can I interest you in? We have something of everything here!
translation: 뭘 보여 드릴까요? 여긴 없는 게 없답니다!

english: Oh good!
Nothing, thanks.
Oh good!
Nothing, thanks.
Ah, you've come for fight!
What do you want?
What are you offering?
A fight!
You look funny!
Wanna fight?
Grrr!
Go away!
Hello!
Hello sir, it's Christmas!
Merry Christmas!
Hello Buoy and Gurl!
Hello sir!
How do you know our names?
I had a chat with your dad. He's super busy, so he's asked me to help you build a snowman!
translation: 너희 아빠랑 얘기했어. 아빠가 엄청 바쁘셔서 나한테 너희 눈사람 만드는 걸 도와 달라고 부탁하셨거든!

english: Really? We get to make a snowman?
translation: 정말요? 우리 눈사람 만들 수 있어요?

english: Yes! And I'm going to build whatever snowman you want!
translation: 그럼! 너희가 원하는 눈사람이면 뭐든 만들어 줄게!

english: Yay! Can it be three snowballs tall?
translation: 야호! 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: But I want it to be five tall!
translation: 난 다섯 개 높이가 좋단 말이야!

english: Five is a bad number, it should be three tall!
translation: 다섯은 나쁜 숫자야, 세 개 높이로 해야 돼!

english: You're a bad number. Five is so much better.
translation: 너야말로 나쁜 숫자야. 다섯이 훨씬 좋아.

english: Okay, okay, wait a second. Why don't we meet in the middle. How about four snowballs tall?
translation: 자, 자, 잠깐만. 서로 조금씩 양보하는 게 어때? 눈덩이 네 개 높이로 하면 어떨까?

english: Fine, it can be four tall.
Yes, four tall is okay.
Great. Now, we need to pick what size snowballs we want for each tier. Why don't you take it in turns? You can do two each.
translation: 좋아. 이제 층마다 눈덩이 크기를 골라야 해. 번갈아 가면서 정하는 게 어때? 한 사람당 두 개씩.

english: The bottom one should be a huge snowball!
translation: 맨 아래는 거대한 눈덩이로 해야 돼요!

english: The next one should be big!
This is working nicely, we're half way! What about the top two parts?
translation: 잘 되고 있네, 벌써 반이나 왔어! 위쪽 두 개는 어떻게 할까?

english: The next one should be a small snowball!
No, it should be little!
But it needs to be small, little would look bad.
translation: 작은 걸로 해야 돼, 조그만 건 이상해 보일 거야.

english: It wouldn't look bad. Small is better for decorations.
translation: 안 이상해. 작은 게 장식하기엔 더 좋아.

english: My decorations will fit on a little one.
translation: 내 장식은 조그만 거에도 다 들어간단 말이야.

english: Why do you always ruin everything?
You ruin everything with your silly ideas!
translation: 너야말로 바보 같은 생각으로 다 망치잖아!

english: Okay, okay, wait. This clearly isn't working, and I don't want you two to fall out. It's Christmas, we shouldn't be arguing!
translation: 자, 자, 잠깐. 이건 영 안 되겠다. 너희 둘이 싸우는 건 싫어. 크리스마스인데 다투면 안 되지!

english: How about I make you both a snowman? It can be whatever height and size you like. One each!
translation: 내가 너희 둘한테 눈사람을 하나씩 만들어 주면 어때? 높이랑 크기는 원하는 대로 해 줄게. 한 사람에 하나씩!

english: So mine can be five snowballs tall?
translation: 그럼 내 건 눈덩이 다섯 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: And mine can be three snowballs tall?
translation: 그럼 내 건 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해도 돼요?

english: Yes, I'll make you both whatever snowman you like!
translation: 그럼! 둘 다 원하는 눈사람으로 만들어 줄게!

english: What would you both like?
I'd like mine to be three snowballs tall please! And I want the bottom one to be small, the middle one big, and the top one huge!
translation: 내 건 눈덩이 세 개 높이로 해 주세요! 맨 아래는 작은 거, 가운데는 큰 거, 맨 위는 거대한 거요!

english: I'd like mine to be five snowballs tall please! I want the bottom one to be humongous, then large, then normal, then big, and then a little one for the top!
translation: 내 건 눈덩이 다섯 개 높이로 해 주세요! 맨 아래는 어마어마한 거, 그다음은 커다란 거, 그다음은 보통 거, 그다음은 큰 거, 그리고 맨 위엔 조그만 거요!

english: That's two very different snowmen, I see why this didn't work before!
translation: 완전히 다른 눈사람 두 개구나. 아까 왜 안 됐는지 알겠다!

english: What do all these different sizes mean? Humongous? Normal? Little? How big are those?
translation: 이 크기들은 다 무슨 뜻이야? 어마어마한 거? 보통 거? 조그만 거? 그게 얼마나 큰 건데?

english: You silly billy! Humongous is the biggest snowball of course!
translation: 바보 같긴! 어마어마한 건 당연히 제일 큰 눈덩이죠!

english: Normal is the normal size that you get when you make a snowball normally. It's easy!
translation: 보통 거는 그냥 보통으로 눈덩이 만들면 나오는 보통 크기예요. 쉽죠!

english: Right, thank you for clearing that up. I'll figure something out.
translation: 그래, 알려 줘서 고마워. 어떻게든 해 볼게.

english: What are you two going to do for decorations?
translation: 너희 둘은 장식은 뭘로 할 거야?

english: I already know what I want mine to look like!
translation: 내 건 어떻게 생기게 할지 벌써 정했어요!

english: Me too!
Why don't you guys find some decorations while I build the snowmen? Then you can add them once I'm done.
translation: 내가 눈사람 만드는 동안 너희는 장식할 걸 좀 찾아오는 게 어때? 내가 다 만들면 그때 붙이면 되잖아.

english: Okay sir!
We will do that!
Well, that seems sorted. I should speak to Larry again, and see if he has any advice about building the snowmen.
translation: 음, 이건 정리된 것 같네. Larry(래리)한테 다시 가서 눈사람 만드는 요령이 있는지 물어봐야겠다.

english: Hello there!
Have you started making the snowmen yet?
You should talk to dad if you need some help, he knows how to make snowmen!
translation: 도움이 필요하면 아빠한테 물어보세요. 아빠는 눈사람 만드는 법을 알아요!

english: Yeah, he always used to make really big ones with us!
translation: 맞아요, 아빠는 우리랑 늘 엄청 큰 눈사람을 만들곤 했어요!

english: Maybe I'll go talk to him and see what advice he has.
translation: 아빠한테 가서 무슨 요령이 있는지 물어봐야겠다.

english: He'll say, make them really tall!
translation: 아빠는 엄청 높게 만들라고 할 거예요!

english: He'll say make them shorter, because that's better!
translation: 아빠는 더 낮게 만들라고 할 거예요, 그게 더 좋으니까요!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. I'm sure he has some handy advice for me!
translation: Larry(래리)한테 가서 얘기해 봐야겠다. 분명 쓸 만한 요령을 알려 줄 거야!

english: That looks good! It needs a [size] snowball next!
They're done! They're so cool!
Yay! Can we decorate them now?
Yes! Can we decorate them now please [player name]?
Of course you can. Are they what you wanted?
Mine is perfect!
Mine too. It's just how I wanted it.
translation: 내 것도요. 딱 내가 원하던 대로예요.

english: I am happy to hear that. It was harder work than I thought.
You did a good job. Thank you very much [sir/madam].
Yes, thank you [sir/madam]!
It was no problem. Merry Christmas to you both!
translation: 별것 아니야. 둘 다 메리 크리스마스!

english: I should go and speak to Larry. Hopefully he has that festive white wine ready for me.
translation: Larry(래리)한테 가서 얘기해 봐야겠다. festive white wine(축제용 백포도주)를 준비해 뒀으면 좋겠는데.

english: Those snowmen look amazing!
Thank you! Decorating them was quite hard!
Yeah, they took ages to do! Do you like mine?
translation: 맞아요, 엄청 오래 걸렸어요! 내 거 마음에 들어요?

english: It's really good! Reminds me of something actually.
translation: 정말 잘했다! 그러고 보니 뭔가 생각나는데.

english: What about mine? Do you like it?
translation: 내 건요? 내 것도 마음에 들어요?

english: I like yours too. They both remind me of something!
translation: 네 것도 좋아. 둘 다 뭔가 생각나게 하네!

english: Mine is Thermy! My favourite monster! She's so big and scary, makes me go woah!
translation: 내 건 Thermy(써미)예요! 제일 좋아하는 괴물이에요! 엄청 크고 무서워서 우와 소리가 절로 나요!

english: Mine is Tempy! My favourite monster! He lives in the water, a huge mass of angry wet!
translation: 내 건 Tempy(템피)예요! 제일 좋아하는 괴물이에요! 물속에 사는데, 화난 물이 엄청 크게 뭉쳐 있는 거예요!

english: They're both amazing! I didn't know you guys would be so good at decorating.
translation: 둘 다 정말 멋지다! 너희가 이렇게 장식을 잘할 줄은 몰랐어.

english: Dad lets us decorate every year. We get a lot of practice!
translation: 아빠가 해마다 장식하게 해 주거든요. 연습을 많이 했어요!

english: Last year we made them into the Fragment of Seren and the King Black Dragon!
translation: 작년엔 Fragment of Seren(세렌의 파편)이랑 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)으로 만들었어요!

english: What... really??? I'd like to have seen that. Those sound even more difficult than these two!
translation: 뭐... 정말??? 그건 나도 보고 싶었는데. 이번 두 개보다 훨씬 어려웠겠다!

english: How do you know all these monsters anyway? There is no way your dad would let you anywhere near them!
translation: 그런데 그 괴물들은 다 어떻게 아는 거야? 너희 아빠가 그런 데 근처에도 못 가게 하실 텐데!

english: Dad reads us lots of stories, and we hear about them from passing adventurers, like you.
translation: 아빠가 이야기를 많이 읽어 주시고, 지나가는 모험가들한테서도 들어요. 모험가님처럼요!

english: You must meet some interesting and cool adventurers!
Not as cool as you though; none of them helped us make our snowmen!
translation: 그래도 모험가님만큼 멋지진 않아요. 그 사람들 중엔 우리 눈사람 만드는 걸 도와준 사람이 없었거든요!

english: Yes, you're the first to help us make them!
translation: 맞아요, 우리 눈사람 만드는 걸 도와준 건 모험가님이 처음이에요!

english: Well, you're welcome. I really enjoyed it. What are you guys going to do now you're finished?
translation: 천만에. 나도 정말 재밌었어. 다 끝났으니 이제 뭐 할 거야?

english: We're going to go and play! And maybe visit the festival. Will you be there?
translation: 놀러 갈 거예요! 축제에도 가 볼지도 몰라요. 거기 올 거예요?

english: I sure will be. Maybe see you there!
Bye sir, Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, have fun!
There's not much time left.
Maybe I'll... No, stupid idea Guss!
translation: 혹시 내가... 아냐, 멍청한 생각이야, Guss(거스)!

english: What am I going to do?
Are you okay?
Hmm, I wonder... I could use a hand with something actually.
translation: 흠, 혹시... 사실 좀 도와줬으면 하는 일이 있는데.

english: Oh yeah? What exactly do you need help with?
translation: 그래요? 정확히 뭘 도와 달라는 거예요?

english: You're willing to help? Great stuff.
I didn't say y-
The name is Guss, Guss Mistletoad. You see that portal over there?
translation: 내 이름은 Guss(거스), Guss Mistletoad(거스 미슬토드)야. 저기 저 포털 보이지?

english: I see it.
That's the portal to The Nutcracker pub. It's been a dream of mine to get inside.
translation: 저게 The Nutcracker(호두까기) 술집으로 가는 포털이야. 저 안에 들어가는 게 내 꿈이었지.

english: I swear I didn't see that pub on my bar crawl card.
translation: 제 술집 순례 카드엔 저런 술집이 없었던 것 같은데요.

english: I've never seen this portal or heard of this pub before.
translation: 저런 포털은 처음 보고, 저런 술집은 들어 본 적도 없어요.

english: Why don't you just walk in?
Poor innocent Player, you can't just do that! It's Santa's prized pub, only a select few can enter.
translation: 순진한 Player 같으니, 그렇게는 안 돼! Santa(산타)가 아끼는 술집이라 선택받은 몇 명만 들어갈 수 있다고.

english: So what exactly are the criteria for entry?
You have to win the Festive Games of course. It's a series of games to determine who is the most festive in the land.
translation: 당연히 Festive Games(축제 게임)에서 이겨야지. 이 땅에서 누가 제일 축제 분위기에 어울리는지 가리는 게임들이야.

english: So you're familiar with these games?
translation: 그럼 이 게임들을 잘 아시는 거예요?

english: Yes! But I'm not good at them. I can never get past the final. That's where I'm hoping you can help! Let's rig it.
translation: 그럼! 근데 난 잘 못해. 결승을 한 번도 못 넘어 봤거든. 그래서 네가 도와줬으면 하는 거야! 판을 짜 보자고.

english: By 'rig the games' you mean I carry you through them?
translation: '판을 짠다'는 게 제가 당신을 캐리하라는 뜻이에요?

english: Absolutely.
Shall we begin?
Sure, as long as you'll bring me some beer from the pub when you win.
translation: 좋아요, 대신 이기면 술집에서 맥주 좀 가져다줘요.

english: If there's any left after I'm done!
translation: 내가 다 마시고 남는 게 있으면!

english: No
How do we enter these games then?
First off we need to nab ourselves some game times from Santa.
translation: 우선 Santa(산타)한테서 게임 참가 시간을 받아 내야 해.

english: You've got to do this Player, but be very vague as to why you need two entry times.
translation: 이건 네가 해 줘야 해, Player. 근데 참가 시간이 왜 두 개 필요한지는 최대한 얼버무려.

english: Why do I need to be vague?
As I mentioned before, I've taken part in these games many times before. Failing every single time.
translation: 아까 말했듯이 난 이 게임에 이미 여러 번 나갔어. 그리고 매번 떨어졌지.

english: Let's say I'm not exactly on the nice list at the moment.
translation: 지금 내가 착한 아이 명단에 올라 있진 않다고만 해 두자.

english: I'll do my best.
Thanks Player, I'm so excited for an all-I-can-drink beer-fest.
translation: 고마워, Player. 무제한 맥주 축제라니 벌써부터 신나는데.

english: Tell me a bit about yourself, Guss.
translation: 당신 이야기 좀 해 주세요, Guss(거스).

english: What a lovely person you are Player! I do love a backstory!
translation: 정말 친절하구나, Player! 난 사연 풀어놓는 거라면 사족을 못 쓰지!

english: Let's paint a picture for you...
It was a frosty morning in the month of Bennath, around twenty one years go...
translation: Bennath(베나스) 달의 어느 서리 낀 아침이었지, 한 스물한 해 전쯤...

english: I'd just left my friend Doric's house after 'borrowing' some ore to take back to the mines.
translation: 친구 Doric(도릭)네 집에서 광석을 좀 '빌려서' 광산으로 가져가던 길이었어.

english: Off to work I go.. Hi ho, h-
No that's not right.
Anyway, I went to work and as you can probably tell, I work in the Dwarven Mines.
translation: 아무튼 일하러 갔지. 보면 알겠지만 난 Dwarven Mines(드워프 광산)에서 일하거든.

english: One day I got really thirsty, I hadn't consumed an alcoholic beverage in over five minutes.
translation: 그러던 어느 날 목이 엄청 말랐어. 술을 한 모금도 못 마신 지 5분이 넘었거든.

english: I was getting reckless.
So I went out in search of the nearest pub.
translation: 그래서 제일 가까운 술집을 찾아 나섰어.

english: For some unknown reason I saw this portal, same as you see it today.
translation: 그런데 웬일인지 이 포털이 보이는 거야. 지금 네가 보는 그대로.

english: It's the middle of Bennath, why does it look so Christmassy? I thought to myself.
translation: 지금은 Bennath(베나스) 한가운데인데 왜 이렇게 크리스마스 같지? 하고 생각했지.

english: Turns out there'd been a mix up...
translation: 알고 보니 뭔가 착오가 있었던 거야...

english: Long story short, I got chatting to Santa and he told me about the games and the amazing Nutcracker pub.
translation: 짧게 말하면, Santa(산타)랑 수다를 떨다가 그 게임이랑 끝내주는 Nutcracker(호두까기) 술집 얘기를 들었지.

english: From that day on I was determined to gain access to this pub!
translation: 그날부터 난 이 술집에 들어가기로 마음먹었어!

english: So in a nutshell, you got thirsty and wanted to go to a pub?
translation: 그러니까 호두 까듯 까놓고 말하면, 목이 말라서 술집에 가고 싶었다는 거예요?

english: Yup.
You know there is a pub just south-west of here? In Falador?
translation: 여기서 남서쪽으로 가면 술집 있는 거 알아요? Falador(팔라도르)에요.

english: Oh, there's one finite detail I missed out.
translation: 아, 내가 빠뜨린 사소한 디테일이 하나 있어.

english: The Nutcracker has a FREE BAR!
Of course it has.
Some of the folk passing through felt a bit sorry for me after all these years, so they made me this cool jumper and hat to keep me warm.
translation: 오가던 사람들이 몇 년째 이러는 날 좀 딱하게 여겼는지, 따뜻하게 지내라고 이 멋진 스웨터랑 모자를 만들어 줬어.

english: They do look great.
So you've done these games before Guss?
translation: 그러니까 이 게임을 해 본 적이 있다는 거죠, Guss(거스)?

english: That's correct, yeah.
This will be easy then. You can just tell me how to win each game.
translation: 그럼 쉽겠네요. 게임마다 이기는 법을 알려 주면 되잖아요.

english: Annoyingly, the games change every year.
But I can tell you what I know.
Santa runs these games like a tournament. You win one, you move onto the next game.
translation: Santa(산타)는 이 게임을 토너먼트처럼 운영해. 하나 이기면 다음 게임으로 넘어가는 거지.

english: There are two games total, and then the final!
translation: 게임은 총 두 개고, 그다음이 결승이야!

english: What were the games like before? Were they hard?
For a small dwarf like me, the hardest thing I've ever played.
translation: 나처럼 조그만 드워프한텐 지금까지 해 본 것 중에 제일 어려웠지.

english: But for you it'll be a piece of cake!
translation: 하지만 너한텐 식은 죽 먹기일 거야!

english: Well, I hope so.
I better be off.
Bye Player!
Right, I've got two times for us.
translation: 좋아요, 우리 둘 참가 시간을 받아 왔어요.

english: Amazing, Santa didn't suspect a thing?
translation: 대단한데, Santa(산타)가 전혀 의심 안 했어?

english: No, but you may have to re-home a few kittens.
translation: 네, 근데 새끼 고양이 몇 마리를 입양 보내셔야 할지도 몰라요.

english: Uhhh, I'm not s-
But that's not important right now.
translation: 근데 지금 그게 중요한 건 아니고요.

english: Actually, there is a bit of a snag. Our times are different for entering the games.
translation: 사실 좀 문제가 있어요. 우리 둘의 참가 시간이 달라요.

english: Oh no, this can't be happening. That puts a right spanner in the works.
translation: 안 돼, 이럴 수가. 일이 완전히 꼬여 버렸잖아.

english: Well, by the sounds of it you said it's a tournament format right?
I did say that, yes.
So maybe everyone gets pulled in for one big final?
translation: 그럼 다들 마지막에 큰 결승 하나로 모이는 거 아닐까요?

english: Of course! How silly of me, you'd have thought I would remember that after twenty one years of playing these games.
translation: 그렇지! 내가 이렇게 멍청하다니. 스물한 해나 이 게임을 했으면 그 정도는 기억할 법도 한데.

english: How confident are you in getting to the final?
Oh it's impossible for me.
What?!
Silly [player name], I'll cheat of course. I gave up my festive games morals long ago.
translation: 바보 같긴, [player name]. 당연히 반칙을 할 거야. 축제 게임 양심 따윈 버린 지 오래거든.

english: Suit yourself.
Looks like my time is first, so I'll hopefully see you in the final!
translation: 제 시간이 먼저인 것 같으니, 잘되면 결승에서 봐요!

english: Good luck [player name] I've got snow doubts you'll do great!
translation: 행운을 빌어, [player name]. 네가 잘할 거라는 건 눈곱만큼도 의심 안 해!

english: Did you just-
Until we meet again!
So, this is the finale?
Yes indeed [player name].
Amazing job getting here so far by the way. I had absolute faith in you!
translation: 그건 그렇고 여기까지 온 거 정말 대단해. 난 널 완전히 믿었다고!

english: This last game is a blood bath.
translation: 이번 마지막 게임은 피 튀기는 싸움이야.

english: How do you know so much about the final game, you haven't even played it yet?
translation: 마지막 게임은 해 보지도 않았으면서 어떻게 그렇게 잘 알아요?

english: I may or may not have played all these games before, and just not told you.
translation: 내가 이 게임을 전부 다 해 봤을 수도, 아닐 수도 있지. 그냥 너한테 말을 안 했을 뿐.

english: Are you kidding me?
Nope. It might have put you off!
Ok, how does this game work then?
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 이 게임은 어떻게 하는 건데요?

english: The aim of the game is to eliminate all the other players.
translation: 게임의 목표는 다른 참가자를 전부 탈락시키는 거야.

english: Do you see those snowball piles scattered about?
translation: 저기 여기저기 흩어져 있는 눈덩이 더미 보이지?

english: Yeah, I think so.
Awesome, you'll want to stock up as many as you can. Then take no prisoners.
translation: 좋아, 최대한 많이 챙겨 둬. 그리고 자비는 없는 거야.

english: There will be two types of snowballs to gather. Both types do different damage.
translation: 모을 수 있는 눈덩이는 두 종류야. 종류마다 피해가 달라.

english: Is that yellow sn-
Last player standing is the winner, it's simple really.
Let you win... Hmm.
Let's do this.
No.
I think I want to have a look around first.
Be quick! I can already taste that sweet nectar of the gods.
translation: 빨리 해! 벌써 신들의 달콤한 넥타 맛이 느껴진다고.

english: We really sh'mashed that.
We did, but you did knock me out.
I knew they you in let.
translation: 들여보내 줄 너 알았지 그럴 줄.

english: Are you okay Guss? We only finished moments ago.
translation: 괜찮아요, Guss(거스)? 끝난 지 얼마 안 됐잖아요.

english: Abshofruitly...
Guss loses focus on you entirely...
Your little dwarf friend knows this is all alcohol-free beer right [player name]?
translation: 네 꼬마 드워프 친구는 이게 전부 무알코올 맥주라는 거 알고 있지, [player name]?

english: Oh Guss...
Air Guss heading your way!
Gosh I'm so good!
Yes
How do we enter the games?
Where did you come from?
Can you tell me about the games?
Goodbye.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Hi, can I help you with anything today?
Yes, please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Have a nice day.
Yes, please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi.
Hello! What can I do for you today?
Who are you?
I'm Gwerin.
It's nice to meet you Gwerin, I'm [player name].
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Gwerin(그웨린). 전 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
What do you do here?
I'm the village miller. I keep the wheat growing strong and turn it into flour.
translation: 전 마을 방앗간 주인이에요. 밀이 튼튼하게 자라도록 돌보고, 그걸 밀가루로 빻죠.

english: Wonderful! This sure is an impressive mill.
Thank you! I try to keep it clean. Feel free to use the mill whenever you please.
translation: 고마워요! 깨끗하게 관리하려고 애쓰고 있어요. 방앗간은 언제든 편하게 쓰세요.

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: 정말 멋지지 않아요? 이렇게 많은 책, 흡수할 지식이 이렇게나 많다니!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: 그 책을 어디서 봤더라? 멀리 있을 리가 없는데...

english: Uh... Hello?
I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
Okay... Maybe later...
What can I do for ya?
Got any good books to recommend?
I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Prifddinas' History(프리프디나스의 역사)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 The Journal of Randas(란다스의 일지)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Big Book of Bangs(쾅쾅 폭발 대백과)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 The Great Divide(대분열)이 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Ode to Eternity(영원에 바치는 송가)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: Thanks!
Nothing.
Got any good books to recommend?
Nothing.
Looking for a new pick? I've got the best you'll find around these parts!
translation: 새 곡괭이 찾아요? 이 근방에서 제일 좋은 물건은 다 저한테 있어요!

english: Sure.
I'm okay, thanks.
Well, let everyone know! You can always find me here.
translation: 그럼 다른 사람들한테도 알려 주세요! 저는 언제나 여기 있으니까요.

english: Sure.
I'm okay, thanks.
We are the righteous ones in his eyes alone.
translation: 그분의 눈에는 오직 우리만이 의로운 자들이로다.

english: Let them not infest our cities and towns...
translation: 그것들이 우리의 도시와 마을을 더럽히지 못하게 할지어다...

english: And lo, we become the power, indeed the force to stop these monsters in their tracks.
translation: 보라, 우리가 힘이 되리라. 진정 이 괴물들을 그 자리에서 멈춰 세울 힘이 되리라.

english: Verily I urge you, my friends to take up your spades and farm your farms to feed our people in this blessed sanctuary.
translation: 진실로 권하노니, 형제들이여, 삽을 들고 밭을 일구어 이 축복받은 성소의 우리 백성을 먹일지어다.

english: If thine monsters visage does frighten thee, then tear it off I say... tear it off!
translation: 괴물의 낯짝이 그대를 두렵게 하거든, 뜯어내라 하노라... 뜯어내라!

english: For Saradomin will guide our sword arms and smash the enemies of humans till their bones become dust.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)께서 우리 칼 든 팔을 이끄시어 인간의 적들을 쳐부수고 그 뼈가 먼지가 될 때까지 짓이기시리라.

english: And let us smite these monsters unto their deaths.
translation: 이 괴물들을 쳐서 죽음에 이르게 할지어다.

english: For they are not the chosen ones in Saradomin's eyes.
translation: 그것들은 Saradomin(사라도민)의 눈에 선택받은 자들이 아니니라.

english: Where do we go for safety from these monsters... here, with our brethren!
translation: 이 괴물들을 피해 어디로 가야 안전하겠는가... 바로 여기, 우리 형제들 곁이로다!

english: And let there be no cave or shelter for their spawn until the end of days.
translation: 세상 끝날까지 그것들의 새끼에게는 동굴도 피난처도 허락하지 말지어다.

english: Hello, [brother/sister/friend], you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 안녕하세요, [brother/sister/friend]. 이제 옷을 제대로 갖춰 입으니 훨씬 잘 어울리네요. 전에는 엄청 눈에 띄었거든요! 그래도 눈 크게 뜨고 다니세요. 우리 중에 도둑이 있다는 얘기를 들었어요!

english: What are all you people doing here?
translation: 여기 있는 사람들은 다 뭘 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Many of us disagree with the king about what freedoms the local monster population should have. We're taking a stand and mobilising our forces against the monstrous hordes.
translation: 우리 중 상당수는 이 지역 몬스터들에게 어디까지 자유를 줘야 하느냐를 두고 왕과 생각이 달라요. 그래서 들고일어나 괴물 무리에 맞서 세력을 모으고 있는 거죠.

english: I'm totally in awe of Johanhus, he really knows what's what. I know he keeps going on about monsters and it's clear there are too many of them, so hey, I agree with whatever Johanhus says.
translation: 전 Johanhus(요한후스) 님을 정말 존경해요. 그분은 뭐가 뭔지 확실히 아시거든요. 맨날 몬스터 얘기만 하시긴 하지만, 몬스터가 너무 많은 건 확실하니까, 뭐, 전 요한후스 님 말씀이면 다 찬성이에요.

english: We're against the monsters..like Johanhus says...we don't like them...you know.
translation: 우린 몬스터에 반대해요... 요한후스 님 말씀처럼요... 우린 걔들이 싫어요... 뭐, 그렇다고요.

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
I'm a strong believer in the non-monsters policy...we should really get rid of them...and if that means I have to live in a cave like a monster, so be it!
translation: 전 '몬스터 없는 세상' 정책을 굳게 믿어요... 정말로 몬스터를 다 없애야 해요... 그러려면 제가 몬스터처럼 동굴에서 살아야 한다 해도, 그러라죠 뭐!

english: What do you think you're going to achieve?
We want a world without monsters, to live in safety and without fear of being attacked by these ferocious beasts.
translation: 우린 몬스터 없는 세상을 원해요. 사나운 짐승들에게 공격당할 걱정 없이 안전하게 사는 세상이요.

english: But there aren't that many ferocious beasts in the towns and cities.
translation: 하지만 도시나 마을에는 사나운 짐승이 그렇게 많지 않잖아요.

english: That's not enough, we want to get rid of them totally, we want to enjoy the surrounding lands and not worry about our children playing in caves and so on.
translation: 그걸로는 부족해요. 우린 몬스터를 완전히 없애고 싶어요. 주변 땅도 마음껏 누리고, 아이들이 동굴 같은 데서 놀아도 걱정 안 하고 싶다고요.

english: Where did all you people come from?

Most of us came from small towns that had been attacked by monsters. We all got fed up with it and so decided to join this movement. We're hoping to return to the towns and cities when we've cleaned up the areas
translation: 우리 대부분은 몬스터에게 습격당한 작은 마을 출신이에요. 다들 넌더리가 나서 이 운동에 합류하기로 했죠. 이 몬스터들이 사는 곳을

english: that these monsters live in.
translation: 깨끗이 정리하고 나면 마을과 도시로 돌아갈 수 있길 바라고 있어요.

english: Ok, thanks.

You speak the truth brother...
Well said brother...

Meow!
One does not wish to be disturbed.
What?
Guard, who is this outlander?
This is [Fremennik name] your majesty.
Is this true? You are the outlander who has been given a Fremennik name?
translation: 그게 사실인가? 자네가 Fremennik(프레메닉) 이름을 받았다는 그 이방인인가?

english: Indeed I am.
Excellent.
How may I assist your Highness?
Behave Hrafn!
I have a task that requires your unique-
translation: 자네의 특별한 능력이 필요한 일이 하나 있-

english: Not now, Hrafn. Now where was I?
translation: 지금은 안 된다, Hrafn(흐라픈). 그래서, 내가 어디까지 말했더라?

english: You mentioned a task requiring my unique-
translation: 제 특별한 무언가가 필요한 일이 있다고 하셨어요-

english: Ah, yes. Your unique position among Fremennik-
translation: 아, 그래. Fremennik(프레메닉) 사이에서 자네가 지닌 특별한 위치-

english: Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright, I give in.
translation: Hrafn(흐라픈)! 아, 알았다, 알았어. 내가 졌다.

english: Look, could you fetch my cat some fish? Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
translation: 이보게, 내 고양이한테 생선 좀 갖다주겠나? 그래야 우리가 조용히 대화를 마칠 수 있겠어.

english: Yes, that's probably a good idea.
Thank you. Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
Will any raw tuna do?
Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from. If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
translation: 그래, 흐라픈이 까다롭긴 해도 참치가 어디서 왔는지는 신경 쓰지 않네. 아직 없다면 부두에서 잡을 수도 있고, 내 생선 장수 Flosi Dalksson(플로시 달크손)에게서 살 수도 있네.

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name]. Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
translation: 다시 왔군, [Fremennik name]. Hrafn(흐라픈)에게 줄 날참치는 가져왔나?

english: Yes, I have your pet's fish.
translation: 네, 전하의 고양이에게 줄 생선을 가져왔어요.

english: You feed Hrafn the tuna.
Thanks [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he learnt something today?
translation: 고맙네, [Fremennik name]. 수년 만에 처음으로 왕의 횡포에 맞선 사람이 바로 자네일세. 오늘 왕께서 뭔가 깨달으셨으려나?

english: We can but hope Thorkel.
Fare thee well brave warrior, fare thee well.
translation: 잘 가게, 용감한 전사여. 잘 가게.

english: Purrrrz! (One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for him to stay.)
translation: 그르릉! (짐은 참치를 바친 이방인의 안녕을 비노라. 짐은 그자가 남아 주기를 바라노라.)

english: Useless, disloyal cat.
Here you go, enjoy your fish.
What is the meaning of this serf? One specifically asked for RAW tuna, not fish defiled by human fire!
translation: 이게 무슨 짓이냐, 하인아? 짐은 분명히 '날'참치를 원했노라. 인간의 불에 더럽혀진 생선이 아니라!

english: Here you go. Enjoy your fish.
What is the meaning of this serf? How is one supposed to eat a piece of paper?
translation: 이게 무슨 짓이냐, 하인아? 짐더러 종이 쪼가리를 어찌 먹으라는 것이냐?

english: Here you go. enjoy your fish!
Purrrrrrrrrr (One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
translation: 그르르르르르릉 (짐은 참치의 신선함에 만족하노라. 인간들이 이번 일은 흡족하게 처리하였도다.)

english: Hopefully Hrafn won't disturb your discussion with the King now.
translation: 이제 Hrafn(흐라픈)이 왕과의 대화를 방해하지 않기를 바란다.

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 저주가 풀리고 나니 사는 건 좀 어때요?

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 당신 덕분에 훨씬 나아졌어요. 다들 정말 감탄하고 있답니다.

english: Hello there.

Well hello, come in, come in, my name's Hadley, I'm head of tourism here. There's some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor here. People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the
translation: 아, 어서 오세요, 들어오세요, 들어오세요. 제 이름은 Hadley(해들리), 이곳 관광 책임자예요. 여기엔 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 손꼽히게 때 묻지 않은 야생 자연과 풍경이 있답니다. 사람들이 맑은 호수에서 낚시를 하거나 아름다운

english: beautiful hillsides.
It is quite pretty.

Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath
translation: '예쁘다'는 말로는 한참 부족하지요, [sir/lady]. 아름답다, 놀랍다, 아니면 인생이 바뀔 만하다는 말이 더 어울려요. Baxtorian Falls(백스토리안 폭포)는 보셨나요? 그 아래에

english: them.
translation: 묻힌 엘프 왕의 이름을 딴 곳이에요.

english: What happened to the elven king?

Baxtorian? I guess he died a long long time ago, it's quite sad really. After leaving his kingdom to deal with invading forces, Baxtorian returned to find his wife Glarial had been captured by the enemy.
translation: Baxtorian(백스토리안)이요? 아주 아주 오래전에 죽었을 거예요. 정말 슬픈 이야기죠. 침략군을 상대하러 왕국을 떠났다가 돌아온 백스토리안은 아내 Glarial(글라리알)이 적에게 붙잡혀 갔다는 걸 알게 됐어요.

english: This destroyed Baxtorian, after years of searching he became a recluse. He went into the secret home he had made for Glarial under the waterfall and sealed himself in. To this day, no one has managed to enter.
translation: 그 일로 Baxtorian(백스토리안)은 무너지고 말았죠. 몇 년을 찾아 헤맨 끝에 그는 세상을 등졌어요. 폭포 아래에 글라리알을 위해 만들어 둔 비밀 거처에 들어가서 스스로를 봉인해 버렸죠. 지금까지 아무도 그곳에 들어가지 못했어요.

english: Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 이 근처에 또 가 볼 만한 곳이 있어요?

english: Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
translation: 음, 다양한 야생 동물이 있긴 한데, 안타깝게도 대부분 꽤 위험해요. 고블린한테 먹이는 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay.
There is a lovely spot for a picnic on the hill to the north east, there's a monument to the elven queen Glarial. It really is quite pretty.
translation: 북동쪽 언덕에 소풍하기 딱 좋은 곳이 있어요. 엘프 여왕 Glarial(글라리알)을 기리는 기념비가 있죠. 정말 꽤 예쁜 곳이에요.

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
That's just silly talk.
translation: 그런 바보 같은 소리가 어디 있어요.

english: Thanks, goodbye.
Enjoy your visit.
Are you on holiday? If so you've come to the right place. I'm Hadley the tourist guide, anything you need to know just ask me. We have some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor.
translation: 휴가 오셨나요? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요. 저는 관광 안내원 Hadley(해들리)예요. 알고 싶은 게 있으면 뭐든 물어보세요. 여기엔 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 손꼽히게 때 묻지 않은 야생 자연과 풍경이 있답니다.

english: People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the beautiful hillsides.
translation: 사람들이 맑은 호수에서 낚시를 하거나 아름다운 언덕을 거닐려고 먼 곳에서도 찾아오지요.

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: '예쁘다'는 말로는 한참 부족하지요, [sir/lady]. 아름답다, 놀랍다, 아니면 인생이 바뀔 만하다는 말이 더 어울려요. Baxtorian Falls(백스토리안 폭포)는 보셨나요? 그 아래에 묻힌 엘프 왕의 이름을 딴 곳이에요.

english: Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 엘프 왕에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Anyway, I believe we have a book on him upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 아무튼, 그에 대해 더 알고 싶으시면 위층에 그에 관한 책이 있을 거예요.

english: Who was Glarial?
Baxtorian's wife, the only other person who could also enter the waterfall apart from him. She was queen when this land was inhabited by elven kind.
translation: Baxtorian(백스토리안)의 아내예요. 그 사람 말고 폭포 안에 들어갈 수 있었던 유일한 사람이었죠. 이 땅에 엘프들이 살던 시절의 여왕이었어요.

english: Glarial was kidnapped while Baxtorian was away, but they eventually recovered her body and brought her home to rest.
translation: Glarial(글라리알)은 Baxtorian(백스토리안)이 자리를 비운 사이 납치당했지만, 결국 사람들이 그녀의 시신을 되찾아 고향에 안장했어요.

english: That's sad.
True, I believe we have a book on Baxtorian and Glarial upstairs if you want to learn more.
translation: 맞아요. 더 알고 싶으시면 위층에 Baxtorian(백스토리안)과 Glarial(글라리알)에 관한 책이 있을 거예요.

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
Ha ha... Another treasure hunter. Well if there is no one's been able to get to it. They've been searching that river for decades, all to no avail.
translation: 하하... 또 보물 사냥꾼이시군요. 글쎄요, 있다 해도 아직 아무도 거기까지 가 보지 못했어요. 사람들이 수십 년 동안 그 강을 뒤졌지만 다 허사였죠.

english: I don't suppose you know anything about some kind of diamond nearby here, do you?
translation: 혹시 이 근처에 있다는 다이아몬드 같은 것에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: I am afraid not [Sir/Madam]. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: 죄송하지만 모르겠네요, [Sir/Madam]. 그래도 우리 폭포 정말 예쁘지 않나요?

english: Um... yeah, I guess.
There was a very scruffy looking merchant in here the other day, perhaps he might have the item you are looking for?
translation: 며칠 전에 아주 꾀죄죄해 보이는 상인이 여기 왔었는데, 혹시 그 사람이 찾으시는 물건을 갖고 있지 않을까요?

english: I don't suppose you've ever heard of someone named Damis, have you?
translation: 혹시 Damis(다미스)라는 사람에 대해 들어 본 적 있어요?

english: I heard a rumour many years ago, that there was a warrior by that name who had a secret hideout somewhere in these parts, but I have never seen it myself.
translation: 오래전에 그런 이름의 전사가 이 근처 어딘가에 비밀 은신처를 두고 있다는 소문을 들은 적은 있어요. 하지만 직접 본 적은 없어요.

english: And why would you be looking for such a criminal element when you could be admiring the tranquil beauty of the waterfall, anyway?
translation: 그런데 폭포의 고요한 아름다움을 감상할 수도 있는데 왜 그런 범죄자 같은 사람을 찾으시는 거예요?

english: Tell me, I have reason to believe there is some kind of invisible hideout nearby... As a tourist guide, you might have heard someone mention it before...?
translation: 저기요, 이 근처 어딘가에 보이지 않는 은신처 같은 게 있다고 믿을 만한 이유가 있거든요... 관광 안내원이시니 누가 그런 얘기를 하는 걸 들어 보셨을지도 모르겠는데요...?

english: You're asking me if I've seen something invisible? How ridiculous.
translation: 지금 보이지 않는 걸 본 적 있냐고 물으시는 거예요? 말도 안 돼요.

english: Anything out of the ordinary then?
Hmmm... Well, we did have a report of a young couplespicnic being interrupted when a skeleton mysteriously appeared out of thin air...
translation: 흐음... 그러고 보니, 젊은 연인이 소풍을 즐기고 있는데 허공에서 해골이 불쑥 나타나서 소풍을 망쳤다는 신고가 있긴 했어요...

english: And where was this?
At the picnic tables just east of here. We investigated of course, this kind of thing is bad for tourism, but could find no evidence of their claims.
translation: 여기서 바로 동쪽에 있는 소풍 테이블이요. 물론 조사는 했죠. 이런 일은 관광에 안 좋으니까요. 하지만 그 사람들 주장을 뒷받침할 증거는 찾지 못했어요.

english: Thank you very much, you have been most helpful.
Did you find your mysterious invisible hideout then?
translation: 그래서 그 수수께끼의 보이지 않는 은신처는 찾으셨어요?

english: Yes, actually I did. Thanks for the help!
What happened to the elven king?
Where else is worth visiting around here?
translation: 이 근처에 또 가 볼 만한 곳이 있어요?

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
Thanks, goodbye.
Can you tell me what happened to the elven king?
translation: 엘프 왕에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Is there treasure under the waterfall?
Ask about Desert Treasure Quest
translation: Desert Treasure(사막의 보물) 퀘스트에 대해 묻기

english: What are you doing in our home?
I just came to ask you a question.
Hegir, why did you let this human into our home?
translation: Hegir(헤기르), 왜 이 인간을 우리 집에 들였어?

english: I didn't let him in, he let himself in!
translation: 내가 들인 게 아니라 자기가 알아서 들어왔다고!

english: Now what do you want, human? Speak up, speak up!
translation: 그래서 원하는 게 뭐야, 인간? 말해, 어서 말해 봐!

english: I ehm, just wanted some information.
translation: 저, 음, 그냥 정보를 좀 얻고 싶어서요.

english: Well go ask someone else instead of barging into people's homes!
translation: 그럼 남의 집에 쳐들어오지 말고 딴 사람한테 가서 물어봐!

english: There's no need to be rude to the human, Haera dear.
translation: 인간한테 그렇게 무례하게 굴 필요는 없잖아, Haera(해라), 여보.

english: Now don't you dear me. I'll do whatever I please.
translation: 여보는 무슨 여보야. 난 내 맘대로 할 거야.

english: I think this is my cue to leave...
translation: 이제 그만 가 봐야 할 것 같네요...

english: That's the last straw!
Do your chores!
Useless... completely useless.
Don't talk to me like that!
You're no good!
I'm warning you, Hegir!
I don't know what you think you are doing here human, but I do know that you will not live long enough to leave this place.
translation: 네가 여기서 무슨 짓을 하려는지는 모르겠다만, 인간아, 이곳을 살아서 나가지는 못할 게다.

english: Welcome to the temple of Marimbo, child. In less busy times I would bless you, but I have not the luxury of free time at the moment.
translation: Marimbo(마림보)의 신전에 온 것을 환영한다, 아이야. 덜 바쁜 때라면 축복을 내려 주겠다만, 지금은 그럴 여유가 없구나.

english: However, feel free to stay here as long as you need.
translation: 그래도 필요한 만큼 얼마든지 여기 머물러도 좋다.

english: Thank you.
Shaz berith an-gor f-
Hello!
Shaz berith an-gor fo gah-
Hey!
Shaz. Berith. An-
Can you hear me?
What?! What do you want?
I just wanted to say hello. I didn't expect to find anyone here.
translation: 그냥 인사하려고요. 여기서 누굴 만날 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Well, you found me. I'm here. And I was just in the middle of a very important conversation!
translation: 그래, 날 찾았네. 나 여기 있어. 그리고 난 지금 아주 중요한 대화를 하던 중이었다고!

english: With who? There's no one else here...
With Hagus.
Who's Hagus?
I'm Hagus!
Right...
Whoa, no need to be rude.
translation: 워, 그렇게 무례하게 굴 필요는 없잖아요.

english: You just interrupted a very important conversation!
translation: 네가 방금 아주 중요한 대화를 끊었잖아!

english: What is this place?
Why should I tell you? You could be one of them.
translation: 내가 왜 말해 줘야 하지? 너도 그놈들 중 하나일 수 있잖아.

english: One of them? What are you talking about?
An abyssal creature, of course!
Last time I checked I was not an abyssal creature.
translation: 제가 알기로 전 심연의 생물이 아닌데요.

english: Hmph. We'll see about that.
So will you tell me where we are?
translation: 그래서 여기가 어딘지 알려 줄 거예요?

english: This is the Abyss.
I know that. Though I've never been to this part of it before.
translation: 그건 알아요. 이쪽에는 와 본 적이 없어서 그래요.

english: Have you heard of the Scar?
Well yes, I just came through there-
Well then you know where we are.
What is that thing over there?
That's Ventriculus.
Ventriculus? That thing has a name?
Yes, it's my friend.
I... I can't tell if you're joking or not.
Ventriculus is an extractor. Feed it and you'll see.
translation: Ventriculus(벤트리큘루스)는 추출기야. 먹이를 줘 보면 알 거야.

english: Feed it?
Yes. Just put your arm in.
That doesn't sound safe.
It likes the tainted essence you can find in here.
translation: 여기서 찾을 수 있는 tainted essence(오염된 정수)를 좋아하거든.

english: A pickaxe can help you split off the essence from the amalgamations.
translation: pickaxe(곡괭이)가 있으면 amalgamations(융합체)에서 정수를 떼어 낼 수 있어.

english: Right... So I mine tainted essence from amalgamations, then feed it to this Ventriculus.
translation: 그러니까... 융합체에서 오염된 정수를 캐서 이 Ventriculus(벤트리큘루스)한테 먹이면 된다는 거죠.

english: But why should I do that?
Remember how I said it's an extractor?
translation: 내가 저게 추출기라고 했던 거 기억나?

english: Ventriculus will remove excess parts from the essence, chew it up a little, and spit out the rest.
translation: Ventriculus(벤트리큘루스)는 정수에서 쓸데없는 부분을 걸러 내고, 조금 씹은 다음, 나머지를 뱉어 내.

english: So you're saying it refines the essence?
Yes, it can refine it into pure essence. However, it can also give you extracts.
translation: 그래, pure essence(순수 정수)로 정제할 수 있어. 하지만 추출물을 줄 때도 있지.

english: What is an 'extract'?
Extracts are powerful, condensed runes. They function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: 추출물은 강력하게 응축된 룬이야. 룬을 더 만들어 내는 촉매 역할을 하지.

english: Make more runes? How exactly does that work?
translation: 룬을 더 만든다고요? 정확히 어떻게 되는 건데요?

english: If you bring an extract when you runecraft, it multiplies the amount of runes you make.
translation: 룬 제작을 할 때 추출물을 가져가면 만들어지는 룬의 양이 몇 배로 늘어나.

english: That's neat! I can make so much money from selling these runes!
translation: 멋지네요! 이 룬들을 팔면 돈을 엄청 벌 수 있겠어요!

english: Now hold on. I didn't say this was free.
Ah... I suppose that makes sense.
I don't care about pure essence. You can extract as much as you want of that.
translation: 순수 정수는 상관없어. 그건 원하는 만큼 뽑아 가.

english: But for extracts, you've got to pay up. There's a coffer over there. Leave some money and I'll charge you for the extract you want.
translation: 하지만 추출물은 돈을 내야 해. 저기 coffer(금고)가 있어. 돈을 넣어 두면 원하는 추출물 값을 거기서 받을게.

english: Can you explain the Ventriculus again?
Ventriculus is an extractor. You can feed it essence from the amalgamations here.
translation: Ventriculus(벤트리큘루스)는 추출기야. 여기 있는 amalgamations(융합체)에서 나온 정수를 먹이로 줄 수 있어.

english: Once fed, it churns away, picking apart the essence, leftover runes and flesh.
translation: 먹이를 받으면 정수, 남은 룬, 살점을 휘저어 가며 분해해.

english: The final product is either pure essence or dense rune extracts.
translation: 최종 결과물은 pure essence(순수 정수) 아니면 고밀도 룬 추출물이야.

english: And how do the extracts work?
Extracts function as catalysts to make more runes.
translation: 추출물은 룬을 더 만들어 내는 촉매 역할을 해.

english: However, extracts are valuable. I'll demand some payment for those.
translation: 하지만 추출물은 귀하거든. 그건 대가를 좀 받아야겠어.

english: Thanks for explaining.
What are you doing here?
I'm hanging out with my friend.
The... Ventriculus? It's really your friend?
It's helping me search for knowledge on powerful runes.
translation: 강력한 룬에 대한 지식을 찾는 걸 도와주고 있어.

english: I guess you could just... not answer my question.
translation: 그냥... 제 질문에 대답 안 하셔도 되긴 해요.

english: Hagus' eyes peer at the Ventriculus.
We heard rumours of a strong one... but the altar was nowhere to be found.
translation: 강력한 룬이 있다는 소문을 들었지... 하지만 제단은 어디에서도 찾을 수 없었어.

english: You're not really talking to me at all, are you.
Herbert, Finnigan and I... We were all assigned important missions. I must fulfill mine.
translation: Herbert(허버트), Finnigan(피니건), 그리고 나... 우린 모두 중요한 임무를 맡았어. 난 내 임무를 완수해야 해.

english: What mission? Who's Finnigan?
Hagus snaps out of it.
Ah, where were we. Did you feed Ventriculus yet? We need more-
translation: 아, 어디까지 얘기했더라. Ventriculus(벤트리큘루스)한테 먹이는 줬어? 우린 더 필요해-

english: I mean. I'm sure you'd like some extracts.
translation: 아니, 그러니까. 너도 추출물이 좀 갖고 싶을 거 아냐.

english: Can you tell me more about yourself?
translation: 당신에 대해 좀 더 얘기해 줄래요?

english: My name is Hagus.
Yes... So you've said. Where are you from?
My upbringing is none of your concern.
translation: 내가 어떻게 자랐는지는 네가 알 바 아니야.

english: I don't mean to pry. I just thought I'd get to know you a little bit.
translation: 캐물으려던 건 아니에요. 그냥 조금 친해지고 싶었을 뿐이에요.

english: How long have you been in here?
Many years. Years. Time... Yes, time. It's time I showed them. I need to find the rune.
translation: 여러 해. 몇 년이나. 시간... 그래, 시간. 이제 놈들에게 보여 줄 시간이야. 그 룬을 찾아야 해.

english: Rune? What rune?
Unless you're a member of the Institute, I cannot share that with you.
translation: 네가 Institute(연구소) 일원이 아니라면 그건 말해 줄 수 없어.

english: Never mind. Goodbye.
Hagus walks away, chanting to himself.
Leave me alone. I'm not interested in whatever you have to show me.
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬. 네가 뭘 보여 주든 관심 없으니까.

english: That's the one! Where did you find this?
Wrath runes? There are several sources, really. You can-
translation: Wrath rune(분노 룬)이요? 구할 데는 사실 여러 군데예요. 그러니까-

english: They exist! I knew it!
Now, tell me, where does it come from? Where's the altar?
translation: 자, 말해 봐. 이게 어디서 나오는 거지? 제단은 어디 있어?

english: I must have one. To study it. Can I have it?
translation: 하나 꼭 있어야 해. 연구하려고. 나 줄래?

english: Well...
Sure, here you go.
It's real! This changes everything!
Happy to help.
No, I think I'll keep it myself.
Hand it over! I need it.
No means no.
Grrr! Fine. But I urge you to reconsider.
translation: 으르르! 좋아. 하지만 다시 생각해 보라고.

english: Another wrath rune! Can I have it?
translation: 분노 룬이 또 있어! 나 줄래?

english: Sure. Here you go.
Another one! Haha! The others won't believe this!
translation: 또 하나다! 하하! 다른 놈들은 이걸 믿지 못할 거야!

english: You're welcome.
Yes! More. More wrath runes for my collection. Can I have it?
translation: 좋아! 더. 내 수집품에 넣을 분노 룬이 더 필요해. 나 줄래?

english: My spells will be so powerful now!
translation: 이제 내 주문이 엄청나게 강해질 거야!

english: Another wrath rune? For me? Don't mind if I do!
translation: 분노 룬이 또? 나 주는 거야? 사양하지 않지!

english: And they said it couldn't be done. That there was no such thing!
translation: 다들 불가능하다고 했지. 그런 건 없다고!

english: The power of these runes... It's drawing me in... And I love it! May I have it?
translation: 이 룬들의 힘... 날 끌어당기고 있어... 그리고 그게 너무 좋아! 나 줄래?

english: Go fetch more!
For me? You shouldn't have.
translation: 나 주는 거야? 뭘 이런 걸 다.

english: Unlimited power!
You know what? I don't need more wrath runes... Ah who am I kidding.
translation: 있잖아. 분노 룬은 이제 필요 없어... 아, 누굴 속이려고.

english: There's never enough wrath runes!
I can't hold more wrath runes.
translation: 분노 룬을 더는 가지고 있을 수가 없어.

english: I must thank you, friend. You've been a strong supporter of the cause.
translation: 고맙다, 친구. 넌 우리 대의를 든든히 지지해 줬어.

english: I can now return and take my rightful place.
translation: 이제 돌아가서 마땅히 내 것인 자리를 차지할 수 있겠어.

english: Happy to help! I think...
Shaz- Oh, what's this? Ah, yes. A powerful rune indeed.
translation: 샤즈- 오, 이건 뭐지? 아, 그래. 정말 강력한 룬이로군.

english: I'm not sure what you want me to do with that.
translation: 그걸로 나보고 뭘 하라는 건지 모르겠는데.

english: I just wanted to say hello. I didn't expect to find anyone here.
translation: 그냥 인사하려고요. 여기서 누굴 만날 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: What is this place?
Can you tell me more about yourself?
translation: 당신에 대해 좀 더 얘기해 줄래요?

english: Never mind. Goodbye.
Whoa, no need to be rude.
translation: 워, 그렇게 무례하게 굴 필요는 없잖아요.

english: What is that thing over there?
What is an 'extract'?
Can you explain the Ventriculus again?
What are you doing here?
Yes.
No.
Good afternoon. In need of a haircut are we? Currently we're offering this service for free!
translation: 어서 오세요. 머리 좀 자르시게요? 지금은 이 서비스를 무료로 해 드리고 있어요!

english: I'd like a haircut please.
Please select the hairstyle you would like from this brochure. I'll even throw in a free recolour.
translation: 이 안내 책자에서 원하시는 머리 모양을 골라 주세요. 염색도 무료로 해 드릴게요.

english: I'd like a shave please.
Please select the facial hair you would like from this brochure. I'll even throw in a free recolour.
translation: 이 안내 책자에서 원하시는 수염 모양을 골라 주세요. 염색도 무료로 해 드릴게요.

english: No thank you.
Very well. Come back if you change your mind.
Well done.
I'd like a haircut please.
I'd like a shave please.
No thank you.
We used to run cart trips down to Shilo Village in south Karamja. Since the troubles we had we've had to stop them though, too many people got killed.
translation: 예전에는 Karamja(카람자) 남쪽의 Shilo Village(실로 마을)까지 수레를 운행했어요. 그런데 그 사건들이 있고 나서는 운행을 멈춰야 했죠. 너무 많은 사람이 죽었거든요.

english: I am offering a cart ride to Shilo Village, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?
translation: 원하시면 Shilo Village(실로 마을)까지 수레로 모셔다드릴게요. [amount]코인인데, 괜찮으세요?

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Shilo Village.
translation: 네, Shilo Village(실로 마을)에 가고 싶어요.

english: You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Shilo Village.
translation: 수레에 올라타자 마부가 말을 몰기 시작한다. 정글을 지나는 고된 여정 끝에 Shilo Village(실로 마을)에 도착한다.

english: The player is transported to Shilo Village

You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Shilo Village. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: 수레에 올라타자 마부가 말을 몰기 시작한다. 정글을 지나는 고된 여정 끝에 Shilo Village(실로 마을)에 도착한다. 여정 때문에 피곤하지만, 그래도 그 먼 길을 걸어오지 않아도 됐다.

english: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
translation: 죄송하지만 돈이 부족하신 것 같네요. 요금만큼 돈이 생기면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: No thanks.
Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
I am offering a cart ride to Shilo Village, if you're interested. For you, it's free.
translation: 원하시면 Shilo Village(실로 마을)까지 수레로 모셔다드릴게요. 손님은 무료예요.

english: You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: 여정 때문에 피곤하지만, 그래도 그 먼 길을 걸어오지 않아도 됐다.

translation: 그걸론 턱도 없어. 할 얘기 없어.

english: I'd rather not waste time in conversation with someone who can't pay for information.
translation: 정보값도 못 내는 사람이랑 말 섞느라 시간 낭비하고 싶지 않아.

english: Who said I need information?
You travelling types, all you have is questions.
I guess I'm a little curious about your companion.
The jester? The journey has put him off performing, for the better, I'd say.
translation: 광대 말이야? 여행하다 공연할 맛을 잃었더라고. 내가 보기엔 잘된 일이지.

english: The thief takes a handful of coins from your pack.
translation: 도둑이 당신 짐에서 코인을 한 움큼 가져갑니다.

english: That was hardly worth it.
I never promised worthwhile information.
translation: 쓸모 있는 정보를 주겠다고 약속한 적은 없어.

english: Do you know much about the Painted One in the town center?
translation: 마을 중심에 있는 Painted One(색칠된 자)에 대해 잘 알아요?

english: Oh yes, he came with us. He tends to find himself in strange situations, but he can handle himself.
translation: 아, 그래. 그 녀석은 우리랑 같이 왔어. 이상한 상황에 곧잘 휘말리지만, 제 앞가림은 해.

english: Do you care more for gold than you do your friend?
Apparently.
I'm not giving you my money.
I guess I'm a little curious about your companion.
Do you know much about the Painted One in the town center?
translation: 마을 중심에 있는 Painted One(색칠된 자)에 대해 잘 알아요?

english: I'm not giving you my money.
Excuse me, Hannibal.
Hello, Hannibal.
Hello there, Hannibal.
Hi there, Hannibal.
He appears to be sleeping peacefully, so you decide to leave him be.
translation: 평화롭게 자고 있는 것 같아서, 그냥 두기로 합니다.

english: Hi [player name]. You woke me up, I was fast asleep!
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 저를 깨우셨네요, 푹 자고 있었는데!

english: I'm sorry, I didn't realise you were sleeping. I just wanted to say hello.
translation: 미안해요, 자고 있는 줄 몰랐어요. 그냥 인사하고 싶었어요.

english: Hello then. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 그럼 안녕하세요. 뭐 도와드릴 거라도 있나요?

english: No, that's it. You can go back to sleep, sorry to have disturbed you.
translation: 아뇨, 그게 다예요. 다시 주무세요, 방해해서 미안해요.

english: It's no problem.
Hannibal snuggles back down and is fast asleep in an instant.
translation: Hannibal(한니발)은 다시 몸을 웅크리더니 순식간에 곯아떨어집니다.

english: Hello [player name]. Did you need something?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 뭐 필요한 거라도 있으세요?

english: Nothing important. I'd like to ask you a question if that is okay?
translation: 중요한 건 아니에요. 괜찮다면 질문 하나 해도 될까요?

english: Ask away.
Why did you pick the kitchen as your spot to sleep? It must get quite noisy sometimes?
translation: 왜 하필 부엌을 잠자리로 골랐어요? 가끔 꽤 시끄러울 텐데요?

english: It does during meal times, but it's also lovely and warm near the fire, and look at all the food!
translation: 식사 시간엔 그렇죠. 그래도 불 옆이라 따뜻하고 좋고, 저 음식들 좀 보세요!

english: Good point. Now it seems like the best spot in the house!
translation: 일리 있네요. 이제 보니 집에서 제일 좋은 자리 같아요!

english: You catch on quickly, for a human! Now I am going to go back to sleep, unless there is something else I can help you with?
translation: 인간치고는 눈치가 빠르시네요! 이제 다시 잘게요, 제가 도와드릴 다른 일이 없다면요.

english: That was all I wanted to ask, thank you.
translation: 물어보고 싶었던 건 그게 다예요, 고마워요.

english: Hannibal curls up on the stool and goes back to sleep.
translation: Hannibal(한니발)은 걸상 위에 몸을 웅크리고 다시 잠듭니다.

english: Oh, hello [player name]. Did I hear a bark?
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, [player name]님. 방금 짖는 소리 들렸나요?

english: A bark? Is there a dog here?
There is, sometimes...
It always wakes me up with its barking.
translation: 매번 그 짖는 소리 때문에 잠에서 깨요.

english: It seems to come and go. I can't figure out why or how.
translation: 나타났다 사라졌다 하는 것 같아요. 왜, 어떻게 그런지는 모르겠어요.

english: That is indeed strange. I'll keep an eye out for it.
There it is again, did you hear it?
I can't say I did.
Maybe I'm imagining it.
Hannibal settles back down and is sleeping in moments.
translation: Hannibal(한니발)은 다시 자리를 잡더니 금세 잠이 듭니다.

english: Hi [player name].
How are you doing?
I'm okay, thank you. I've been enjoying the piano playing. Was it you playing earlier?
translation: 그럭저럭요, 고마워요. 피아노 연주를 즐겁게 듣고 있었어요. 아까 연주한 게 당신이었나요?

english: Oh, that wasn't me.
Must have been Gem then. She often plays the piano when she thinks nobody is listening.
translation: 그럼 Gem(젬)이었겠네요. 아무도 안 듣는다고 생각할 때 종종 피아노를 치거든요.

english: She's actually quite good.
I'll have to keep an ear out.
Hannibal stretches and goes back to sleep.
Hi there, [player name].
I have another question for you, if that is okay?
Go ahead.
Do you ever leave the hall? I've only ever seen you in here.
translation: 이 홀 밖으로 나가긴 해요? 여기서만 봤거든요.

english: I do sometimes. If I do go out, it's normally at night.
I much prefer it in here though. Nice and warm with good food. There is even a bank, if I ever needed a bank for anything.
translation: 그래도 여기가 훨씬 좋아요. 따뜻하고 음식도 맛있고요. 은행도 있어요, 혹시 은행 쓸 일이 생긴다면 말이죠.

english: That's fair enough. The world can be a pretty scary place out there anyway.
translation: 그럴 만하네요. 어차피 바깥세상은 꽤 무서운 곳이니까요.

english: Exactly. It's much nicer to relax here, even with the occasional adventurer disturbing me.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 가끔 모험가가 방해하긴 해도, 여기서 쉬는 게 훨씬 좋아요.

english: That'll be me! Sorry, I'll let you get back to sleep.
translation: 그게 저네요! 미안해요, 다시 주무시게 해 드릴게요.

english: Hannibal goes back to sleep, enjoying the warmth of the fire.
translation: Hannibal(한니발)은 불의 온기를 즐기며 다시 잠듭니다.

english: You pet Hannibal...
He lets out a quiet purr before going back to resting.
translation: 그는 작게 그르렁거리더니 다시 쉬기 시작합니다.

english: You scratch Hannibal behind the ears...
He purrs contentedly before going back to sleep.
I should give him some fish from my inventory!
Dialogue 1
Dialogue 2
Dialogue 3
Hannibal gobbles up the fish, then settles back down to rest.
translation: Hannibal(한니발)은 물고기를 덥석 먹어 치우고 다시 자리를 잡고 쉽니다.

english: Thank you [player name]. That's very tasty, though it would be even more tasty if it was cooked.
translation: 고마워요, [player name]님. 아주 맛있네요. 익힌 거였으면 더 맛있었겠지만요.

english: You prefer cooked food?
I do. Why do you think I'm in the kitchen? All this lovely food being cooked all the time!
translation: 그럼요. 제가 왜 부엌에 있겠어요? 맛있는 음식이 하루 종일 요리되잖아요!

english: That is a good point. I will see if I can find you something cooked.
I look forward to it. You know where to find me.
Hannibal settles back down to sleep.
Thank you [player name]. That was lovely! Do you have any more?
translation: 고마워요, [player name]님. 정말 맛있었어요! 더 있어요?

english: You just ate the entire thing, and you're still hungry?
translation: 방금 통째로 다 먹었는데 아직도 배고파요?

english: Sleeping is hungry work.
I do often wake up hungry, maybe you're on to something.
translation: 저도 자고 일어나면 배고플 때가 많은데, 일리 있는 말일지도요.

english: I'll see if I can find you something else.
Lovely, I'll be right here, working hard.
translation: 좋아요, 저는 여기서 열심히 일하고 있을게요.

english: Hello. What are you doing here?
I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
Who, the Duke? He's in his study, on the first floor.
I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
translation: 이 성에 있는 놈들을 전부 죽이러 왔다!

english: Hans runs away from the player screaming
Help! Help!
I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
You are in Lumbridge Castle.
Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: 제가 여기 온 지 얼마나 됐는지 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Ahh, I see all the newcomers arriving in Lumbridge, fresh-faced and eager for adventure. I remember you...
translation: 아, 저는 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 도착하는 신입들을 다 지켜봐요. 생기 넘치고 모험에 들뜬 얼굴들이죠. 당신도 기억나요...

english: You've spent [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
translation: 당신은 [amount]일 전에 도착한 뒤로 이 세계에서 [amount]일 [amount]시간 [amount]분을 보냈어요.

english: Nothing.
Hiya.
Oooh! Who are you?
I'm a brave knight! I am coming to kill anyone in the vicinity of Lumbridge Castle!
translation: 나는 용감한 기사다! Lumbridge Castle(럼브리지 성) 근처에 있는 놈은 누구든 죽이러 왔다!

english: Aaaaargh! Run away, run away!
Hehe. Fool!
Hans! Hans! You've been walking around this courtyard since we were two dimensional, have you seen the Gnome Child's hat? He has lost it.
translation: Hans(한스)! 한스! 우리가 2차원이던 시절부터 이 안뜰을 걸어 다녔잖아요. Gnome Child(노움 아이)의 모자 봤어요? 잃어버렸대요.

english: Ummm... a little green hat? Yes, a seagull picked it up and flew off.
translation: 음... 작은 초록색 모자 말이에요? 네, 갈매기가 물고 날아가 버렸어요.

english: Really? A seagull picked up a hat? Can they do that?
translation: 정말요? 갈매기가 모자를 물어 갔다고요? 그게 가능해요?

english: So it seems! I'm afraid I didn't happen to see which way it went.
translation: 그런가 봐요! 아쉽게도 어느 쪽으로 날아갔는지는 못 봤어요.

english: I should probably go somewhere that Hans might actually see me.
translation: Hans(한스) 눈에 실제로 띌 만한 곳으로 가야겠어요.

english: You place the chair on the ground and wait for Hans to notice you...
translation: 의자를 바닥에 놓고 Hans(한스)가 알아차리기를 기다립니다...

english: Oh my aching feet! A chair! Just what I've been needing! I'm going to go sit by the fountain, so pretty this time of year.
translation: 아이고 내 발이야! 의자다! 딱 필요하던 거예요! 분수 옆에 가서 앉아야겠어요, 이맘때 정말 예쁘거든요.

english: Hans takes the chair and teleports away with it.
I think he hasn't sat down for a while!
Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 당신은 [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: Well done, here you go.
Hey Hans, you look like you're enjoying the party!
translation: 이봐요 Hans(한스), 파티를 즐기고 있는 것 같네요!

english: Of course *hic* I love a good *hic* party.
translation: 당연하죠 *딸꾹* 저는 신나는 *딸꾹* 파티라면 사족을 못 써요.

english: I have a *hic* great party trick *hic*
Does it include guessing my age?
Exactly *burp* that!
You've probably spent *hic* [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
translation: 당신은 아마 *딸꾹* [amount]일 전에 도착한 뒤로 이 세계에서 [amount]일 [amount]시간 [amount]분을 보냈을 거예요.

english: I'm looking for whoever is in charge of this place.
I have come to kill everyone in this castle!
translation: 이 성에 있는 놈들을 전부 죽이러 왔다!

english: I don't know. I'm lost. Where am I?
Can you tell me how long I've been here?
translation: 제가 여기 온 지 얼마나 됐는지 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Gnomechild's missing hat.
Talk about something else.
Hello there.
Hello.
Who are you?
My name is Hari.
And what are you doing here Hari?
Like most people who come to Edgeville, I am here to seek adventure in the Wilderness.
translation: Edgeville(에지빌)에 오는 대부분의 사람들처럼, 저도 Wilderness(황야)에서 모험을 찾으러 왔어요.

english: I found a secret underground river that will take me quite a long way north.
translation: 꽤 멀리 북쪽까지 데려다줄 비밀 지하 강을 찾았어요.

english: Underground river? Where does it come out?
It comes out in a pond located deep in the Wilderness.
translation: Wilderness(황야) 깊숙한 곳에 있는 연못으로 나와요.

english: I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?
translation: 그런데 강을 거슬러 올라가려면 아주 특별한 종류의 카누가 필요했어요. 더 알고 싶어요?

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 글쎄요, 카누를 만들 실력은 없어 보이네요.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 카누를 만들 수 있게 되면 강을 따라 훨씬 빨리 이동할 수 있어요!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 정말 간단해요. 강둑에 있는 저 나무까지 걸어가서 베어 넘기기만 하면 돼요.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 그다음 도끼로 통나무를 더 다듬어서 카누를 만들면 돼요.

english: I can sense you're still a novice woodcutter, you will only be able to make a log canoe at present.
translation: 아직 초보 나무꾼이신 게 느껴지네요. 지금은 통나무 카누만 만들 수 있어요.

english: Is that good?
A log will take you one stop along the river. But you won't be able to travel into the Wilderness on it.
translation: 통나무 카누로는 강을 따라 한 정거장 갈 수 있어요. 하지만 그걸로 황야까지는 못 가요.

english: You are an average woodcutter. You should be able to make a Dugout canoe quite easily. It will take you 2 stops along the river.
translation: 평범한 나무꾼이시네요. Dugout canoe(마상이 카누)는 꽤 쉽게 만들 수 있을 거예요. 강을 따라 두 정거장 갈 수 있어요.

english: Can I take a dugout canoe to reach the Wilderness?
translation: dugout canoe(마상이 카누)로 황야까지 갈 수 있어요?

english: You would never make it there alive.
Best not to try then.
translation: 그럼 안 해 보는 게 낫겠네요.

english: You seem to be an accomplished woodcutter. You will easily be able to make a Stable Dugout
translation: 숙련된 나무꾼 같군요. Stable Dugout(튼튼한 마상이)는 쉽게 만들 수 있을 거예요

english: They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
translation: 강 어디든 갈 만큼 믿음직해요. 물론 황야만 빼고요.

english: Only a Waka can take you there.
A Waka? What's that?
Come and ask me when you have improved your skills as a woodcutter.
Your skills rival mine friend. You will certainly be able to build a Waka.
translation: 친구, 당신 실력은 저와 맞먹는군요. 분명 Waka(와카)를 만들 수 있을 거예요.

english: A Waka is an invention of my people, it's an incredible strong and fast canoe and will carry you safely to any destination on the river.
translation: Waka(와카)는 우리 부족이 발명한 거예요. 엄청나게 튼튼하고 빠른 카누라서 강 위 어떤 목적지든 안전하게 데려다줘요.

english: Any destination?
Yes, you can take a waka north through the underground portion of this river.
translation: 네, waka(와카)를 타고 이 강의 지하 구간을 지나 북쪽으로 갈 수 있어요.

english: It will bring you out at a pond in the heart of the Wilderness. Be careful up there, many have lost more than their lives in that dark and twisted place.
translation: 그러면 Wilderness(황야) 한복판의 연못으로 나오게 돼요. 거기선 조심하세요. 그 어둡고 뒤틀린 곳에서 목숨보다 더 많은 걸 잃은 사람이 많아요.

english: No thanks, not right now.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 카누 타기에 대해 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Welcome, Effendi!
Hello!
Can I go in?
Come now Effendi, to pass you must tell me a story, one of grand heroics!
translation: 자자, Effendi(나리). 지나가려면 이야기를 하나 들려주셔야 하오. 웅장한 영웅담으로!

english: You tell the tale of how you bested a goblin, it lacks heroics and sounds more like senseless murder.
translation: 고블린을 해치운 이야기를 들려줍니다. 영웅담이라기보단 무의미한 살육처럼 들립니다.

english: You thought that was a story of heroics?! Come back when you have something worth telling.
translation: 그게 영웅담이라고 생각했소?! 들려줄 만한 이야기가 생기면 다시 오시오.

english: To gain entrance to the resource area, you must first complete the quest 'Dragon Slayer'.
translation: 자원 구역에 들어가려면 먼저 'Dragon Slayer(드래곤 슬레이어)' 퀘스트를 완료해야 하오.

english: You tell the tale of how you bested the legendary dragon Elvarg in combat.
translation: 전설의 드래곤 Elvarg(엘바르그)를 전투에서 쓰러뜨린 이야기를 들려줍니다.

english: ...And then I cut her head off, so as to make sure she was dead!
translation: ...그리고 확실히 죽었는지 확인하려고 목을 베어 버렸죠!

english: Amazing! A story well worth telling! Please Effendi, enter at your leisure.
translation: 놀랍구려! 들려줄 가치가 충분한 이야기요! 자, Effendi(나리), 마음껏 들어가시오.

english: Of course Effendi! You have proved yourself worthy!
Who are you?
Me? I am Haris! Owner of the area north of here, it is has great resources, I assure you.
translation: 나? 나는 Haris(하리스)요! 이 북쪽 구역의 주인이지. 자원이 아주 풍부한 곳이라오, 장담하오.

english: You own the land? Who did you buy it from?
Buy? Oh no no no. Do you see this sword, Effendi?
translation: 샀냐고? 아니, 아니, 아니오. 이 검이 보이시오, Effendi(나리)?

english: I do.
Well then, that is why it is mine! Hahaha.
translation: 그렇다면 그게 바로 이 땅이 내 것인 이유요! 하하하.

english: Oh, so do I pay a toll? 10 coins should do, right?
translation: 아, 그럼 통행료를 내야 하나요? 10코인이면 되겠죠?

english: Not quite, while gold can get you to many places, I seek stories of heroics, for my land is only for the worthy.
translation: 그렇지 않소. 골드로 갈 수 있는 곳이야 많겠지만, 나는 영웅담을 원하오. 내 땅은 자격 있는 자만을 위한 곳이니.

english: Is the story behind your sword one of heroics?
I promise you, the monkey I took it from was big! Hahaha!
translation: 장담하는데, 내가 이걸 빼앗은 원숭이는 엄청 컸소! 하하하!

english: Bye!
Farewell, Effendi!
Hey! I didn't say you could go in there!
translation: 이보시오! 거기 들어가도 된다고 한 적 없소!

english: Can I go in?
Who are you?
Bye!
Hello there.
I'm rather busy right...
... Wait a minute... you're that adventurer that has been taking on the Colosseum!
translation: ...잠깐만요... 당신 Colosseum(콜로세움)에 도전하고 있는 그 모험가잖아요!

english: The Champion!
The Grand Champion!
That's me.
Wow, what are the chances you'd run into a simple farmer like me.
translation: 와, 저 같은 평범한 농부를 만날 확률이 얼마나 될까요.

english: Quite high actually...
I suppose you might be needing a reliable herb supply if you're planning to continue fighting in the Colosseum?
translation: Colosseum(콜로세움)에서 계속 싸울 생각이시면 믿을 만한 약초 공급처가 필요하지 않으세요?

english: I suppose so?
I'll keep an eye on any herbs you plant here. It's the least I can do for someone like you.
translation: 여기 심으시는 약초는 제가 잘 돌봐 드릴게요. 당신 같은 분께 이 정도는 해 드려야죠.

english: That's a really kind gesture, but aren't you meant to be focusing on growing your own food?
translation: 정말 고마운 제안이지만, 자기 먹을 작물 키우는 데 집중하셔야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: It's no trouble. The soil around here is very rich, so it won't need much attention at all. I might even get a reward from the palace for helping such a valiant contender!
translation: 전혀 문제없어요. 이 근처 흙이 아주 비옥해서 별로 손이 안 가거든요. 이렇게 용맹한 도전자를 도왔다고 궁전에서 상을 받을지도 몰라요!

english: That's very kind of you.
Best of luck on your journey, Champion!
Best of luck on your journey, Grand Champion!
Hello there.
Hi.
You're the guard that was on duty last night?
Yeah.
Denulth said that you lost the combination to the equipment room?
translation: Denulth(데눌스)가 그러는데 장비실 조합 번호를 잃어버렸다면서요?

english: I don't want to talk about it!
What?
I said I didn't want to talk about it!
Can I buy you a drink?
Now you're talking! An Asgarnian Ale please!
translation: 이제야 말이 통하네! Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일)로 부탁해!

english: I'll go and get you one.
You give Harold an Asgarnian ale.
Arrh. That hit the spot!
Where were you when you last had the combination?
translation: 마지막으로 조합 번호를 갖고 있었을 때 어디 있었어요?

english: I honestly don't know! I've looked everywhere. I've searched the castle and my room!
translation: 솔직히 모르겠어! 사방을 다 뒤졌다고. 성도 뒤지고 내 방도 뒤졌어!

english: Have you tried looking between here and the castle?
Yeah, I tried that.
I need another beer.
Would you like to gamble?
Good. Good. I have some dice. How much do you want to offer?
translation: 좋지. 좋아. 나한테 주사위가 있어. 얼마 걸 거야?

english: You have to offer some money.
Woah! Do you think I'm made of money? Max bet is 1000 gold.
translation: 워워! 내가 무슨 돈 찍어 내는 기계인 줄 알아? 최대 판돈은 1000골드야.

english: OK. I'll roll first!
Don't forget that once I start my roll you can't back out of the bet! If you do you lose your stake!
translation: 내가 굴리기 시작하면 판을 물릴 수 없다는 거 잊지 마! 물리면 건 돈은 날리는 거야!

english: Harold has given you your winnings!
You give Harold his winnings.
Sounds good! I normally drink Asgarnian Ale but you know what?
translation: 좋지! 평소엔 Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일)을 마시는데, 그거 알아?

english: What?
I really fancy one of those Blurberry Specials! I never get over to the Gnome Stronghold so I haven't had one for ages!
translation: Blurberry Special(블러베리 스페셜) 한 잔이 진짜 당겨! Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새)엔 갈 일이 없어서 못 마신 지 한참 됐거든!

english: You give Harold a Blurberry Special.
Wow.
Now THAT hit the spot!
'Ello matey!
Hmm...!
What wash the queshtion?
Shure!
Place your betsh pleashe!
*giggle*
Eashy tiger! Max bet ish 1000 coinsh.
Right...er...here goes...
*hic!*
Harold is so drunk he can hardly see, let alone count!
translation: Harold(해럴드)는 너무 취해서 앞도 잘 안 보이고, 숫자를 세는 건 더더욱 못 합니다!

english: *hic*
I didn't know you could ushe four dishe. Oh well.
translation: 주사이를 네 개나 쓸 수 이쓴 줄 몰랐네에. 뭐, 됐어.

english: Um... not enough money.
Heresh shome of it.
I owe you the resht!
Harold has given you an IOU scribbled on some paper.
translation: Harold(해럴드)가 종이에 휘갈겨 쓴 IOU(차용증)을 줍니다.

english: I fink I've had enough!
I've lost the IOU you gave me.
Oh dear.
I'm shure I had money, not anymore!
*burp*
You knock on the door.
Come in!
Where were you when you last had the combination?
translation: 마지막으로 조합 번호를 갖고 있었을 때 어디 있었어요?

english: Would you like to gamble?
Can I buy you a drink?
I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: 어떻게 되든, 오늘이 피의 십일조를 바치는 마지막 날이겠지.

english: It can't be that hard can it?
Soon I will be free!
I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
translation: 난 Theatre(피의 극장)에서 살아남을 거야! Serafina(세라피나)가 그랬던 것처럼!

english: Welcome to my humble guild [player name].
translation: 누추한 내 길드에 온 걸 환영하네, [player name].

english: Quite a place you've got here.
Indeed we do. Would you like to know more about it?
translation: 그렇고말고. 길드에 대해 더 알고 싶은가?

english: Tell me about the strength training area.

Ahh the mighty warrior Sloane guards the strength training area. This intriguing little area consists of two shotput lanes for different weights of shot. It's fairly simple, the Referee or Sloane can explain more. You
translation: 아, 그곳은 용맹한 전사 Sloane(슬론)이 지키고 있지. 무게가 다른 포환을 던지는 투포환 레인 두 개로 이루어진 흥미로운 곳이라네. 꽤 간단하니, Referee(심판)이나 슬론이 더 자세히 설명해 줄 걸세.

english: may find yourself panting for breath though.
translation: 다만 숨이 꽤 찰 수도 있을 걸세.

english: Oh? Why?
Well you see my dear [boy/lady], the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: 그게 말일세, 친애하는 [boy/lady], 거기 경기는 기력을 상당히 빼앗아 가거든. 은행 뒤 계단을 올라가면 바로 있다네.

english: Tell me about the attack training area.
Ahhh, dummies.
I'm no dummy, I just want to know what is there!
translation: 허수아비 취급하지 마세요, 전 그냥 거기 뭐가 있는지 알고 싶을 뿐이라고요!

english: Oh no my dear [man/lady], I did not mean you at all! The training area has mechanical dummies which pop up out of holes in the floor. The noble dwarf Gamfred invented the mechanism and Ajjat can explain more about what
translation: 오, 아닐세, 친애하는 [man/lady], 자네를 두고 한 말이 절대 아니야! 그 훈련장에는 바닥 구멍에서 튀어나오는 기계 허수아비들이 있다네. 고귀한 드워프 Gamfred(감프레드)가 그 장치를 발명했고, 거기서 무엇을

english: to do there.
translation: 해야 하는지는 Ajjat(아자트)가 더 자세히 알려 줄 걸세.

english: Oh, ok, I'll have to try it out!
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 꼭 한번 해 봐야겠어요!

english: You can find it just down the corridor and on your right.
Tell me about the defence training area.
To polish your defensive skills to the very highest level we've employed a most inventive dwarf and a catapult.
translation: 자네의 방어 기술을 최고 수준으로 갈고닦을 수 있도록, 아주 창의적인 드워프 한 명과 투석기를 들여놓았지.

english: You're going to throw dwarves at me?
Oh my no! I think Gamfred would object to that most strongly.
translation: 아니, 그럴 리가! Gamfred(감프레드)가 그건 아주 강하게 반대할 걸세.

english: He's an inventor you see and has built a marvellous contraption that can throw all sorts of things at you including magic missiles...
translation: 그 친구는 발명가라서, 자네에게 온갖 것을 던질 수 있는 놀라운 기계 장치를 만들었다네. 마법 미사일이라든가...

english: Mmmm?
....spiked iron balls.....
Err....
....spinning slashing blades....
Ummm...
... and even anvils.
ANVILS!?
No need to be afraid, it's all under very controlled conditions! You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: 겁낼 것 없네, 모두 철저히 통제된 상태에서 하는 거니까! 은행 뒤 계단을 올라가면 바로 있다네.

english: Tell me about the combat training area.
Ahh yes, our resident magician from foreign lands created a most amazing gadget which can turn your own armour against you! It's really quite intriguing.
translation: 아, 그렇지. 이국에서 온 우리 상주 마법사가 자네 갑옷을 자네에게 맞서게 만드는 아주 놀라운 장치를 만들었다네! 정말 흥미롭지.

english: That sounds dangerous. What if I'm wearing it at the time?
translation: 위험하게 들리네요. 제가 그 갑옷을 입고 있으면 어떡해요?

english: So far that's not happened. You need to speak to Shanomi about the specifics of the process, but as I understand it, putting a suit of armour in one of these devices will make it come to life some how. The better
translation: 아직까지 그런 일은 없었네. 과정에 대한 자세한 건 Shanomi(샤노미)에게 물어봐야 하지만, 내가 알기로는 갑옷 한 벌을 그 장치 중 하나에 넣으면 어찌어찌 살아 움직이게 된다네. 갑옷이 좋을수록

english: the armour, the harder it is to 'kill'.
Fighting my own armour, that sounds... weird. I could be killed by it...
translation: 제 갑옷이랑 싸운다니, 그거... 이상하네요. 그 갑옷한테 죽을 수도 있겠어요...

english: Indeed we have had a few fatalities from warriors over stretching themselves and not knowing their limits. Start small and work up is my motto! That and go see Lidio for some food if you need it.
translation: 실제로 자기 한계를 모르고 무리하다가 목숨을 잃은 전사들도 몇 있었지. 작게 시작해서 차근차근 올라가라, 그게 내 신조일세! 그리고 먹을 게 필요하면 Lidio(리디오)를 찾아가게.

english: Ok, thanks for the warning.
Tell me about tokens.

Ahh, yes, our token system is designed to allow you an appropriate amount of time with my discovery in the very top floor of the guild. I won't spoil the surprise as to what that is. Go up and see for yourself. Now, the
translation: 아, 그래. 우리 토큰 제도는 길드 맨 꼭대기 층에 있는 내 발견물과 적당한 시간을 보낼 수 있게 하려고 만든 거라네. 그게 뭔지는 말해 버리면 재미가 없으니 비밀일세. 직접 올라가서 보게나. 자,

english: amount of tokens you collect from the various activities around the guild will dictate how long Kamfreena will allow you in the enclosure on the very top floor. More tokens equals more time.
translation: 길드 곳곳의 활동에서 모은 토큰의 양에 따라 Kamfreena(캄프리나)가 꼭대기 층 울타리 안에 자네를 들여보내 주는 시간이 정해진다네. 토큰이 많을수록 시간도 길어지지.

english: So what's up there?
If I told you it would spoil the surprise!
translation: 말해 주면 깜짝 놀랄 재미가 없어지지 않나!

english: Ok ok... so how do I earn and claim these tokens?
translation: 알았어요, 알았어요... 그럼 그 토큰은 어떻게 얻고 받는 거예요?

english: You can earn them simply by using the training exercises around the guild, the staff will then enter this into a ledger as you play. You can claim them by simply asking any of the staff at the training areas, or
translation: 길드 곳곳의 훈련 활동을 하기만 하면 얻을 수 있다네. 자네가 활동하는 동안 직원들이 장부에 기록해 두지. 받을 때는 훈련장에 있는 직원 아무에게나 말하거나,

english: myself.
Sounds easy enough.
Tell me about the strength training area.
Tell me about the attack training area.
Tell me about the defence training area.
Tell me about the combat training area.
Tell me about tokens.
You any good with a sword?
Am I any good with....a sword... Have you any clue who I am?
translation: 내가 검을....좀 쓰냐고... 자네, 내가 누군지 알기나 하나?

english: Not really... no.
Why I could best any person alive in a rapier duel!
translation: 레이피어 결투라면 살아 있는 그 누구라도 이길 수 있는 몸일세!

english: Try me then!
