My dear [sir/lady], I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
translation: 친애하는 [sir/lady], 자네와 결투할 수는 없네. 자네를 다치게라도 하면 내 명성은 어떻게 되겠나! 게다가 난 이 훌륭한 길드를 운영해야 하거든. 우리 길드의 여러 활동을

english: have. You might even collect enough tokens to be allowed in to kill the strange beasts from the east!
translation: 둘러보는 게 어떻겠나. 토큰을 충분히 모으면 동방에서 온 기묘한 짐승들을 사냥하러 들어갈 수도 있을 걸세!

english: Bye!
Farewell [brave warrior/fair lady], I do hope you enjoy my guild.
translation: 잘 가게, [brave warrior/fair lady]. 내 길드를 즐겁게 이용하길 바라네.

english: How are you, Harrallak?
I've lost two of my dear friends, [player name]. This old place doesn't seem to be the same since they're gone.
translation: 소중한 친구를 둘이나 잃었네, [player name]. 그들이 떠난 뒤로 이 오래된 곳도 예전 같지가 않아.

english: I feel responsible.
Nonsense, my friend! They both died bravely fighting against a great evil! There is no blame on you for that.
translation: 무슨 소리! 두 사람 모두 거대한 악에 맞서 용감하게 싸우다 쓰러졌네! 자네 탓은 조금도 없어.

english: Remember them for who they were and what they stood for. Mourn their loss, but never bear the burden of their death, for that is not what they would want.
translation: 그들이 어떤 사람이었고 무엇을 위해 싸웠는지 기억하게. 그들의 죽음을 슬퍼하되, 그 죽음의 짐을 짊어지지는 말게. 그들도 그걸 바라지 않을 테니.

english: And what about vengeance?
Ah, now that is a topic we could debate for many moons, my friend. Still, regardless of the reason, know that when the time comes, I will fight beside you against Lucien once more.
translation: 아, 그건 몇 달이고 논쟁할 수 있는 주제로군, 친구. 그래도 이유가 무엇이든, 때가 오면 내가 다시 한번 자네 곁에서 Lucien(루시엔)에 맞서 싸우겠네.

english: Could you tell me more about the Guild?
Of course. What would you like to know about?
Quite a place you've got here.
You any good with a sword?
Bye!
How are you, Harrallak?
Could you tell me more about the Guild?
Welcome, you can buy fishing equipment at my store. We'll also give you a good price for any fish that you catch.
translation: 어서 오세요, 우리 가게에서 낚시 장비를 살 수 있어요. 잡은 물고기도 좋은 값에 사 드려요.

english: Can I get a fish for this bowl?
translation: 이 어항에 넣을 물고기를 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Sorry, you need to put some seaweed into the bowl first.
translation: 미안하지만, 먼저 어항에 seaweed(해초)를 좀 넣어야 해요.

english: Seaweed?
Yes, the fish seem to like it. Come and see me when you have put some in the bowl.
translation: 네, 물고기들이 해초를 좋아하거든요. 어항에 해초를 넣고 나서 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Yes you can!
I can see that you have a nicely filled fishbowl there to use, and you can catch a fish from my aquarium if you want.
translation: 보니까 쓸 만하게 잘 채운 fishbowl(어항)이 있네요. 원하면 제 aquarium(수족관)에서 물고기를 잡아 가도 돼요.

english: You will need a special net to do this though, and I sell them for 10 gold.
translation: 그런데 그러려면 특별한 net(그물)이 필요해요. 제가 10골드에 팔고 있죠.

english: I'll take it!
Here you go!
Well, I'll be happy to give you the net once you have the cash, but not before!
translation: 돈만 있으면 기꺼이 그물을 드릴게요. 하지만 돈이 생기기 전엔 안 돼요!

english: No thanks, later maybe.
Do you have any fishfood?
Sorry, I'm all out. I used up the last of it feeding the fish in the aquarium.
translation: 미안해요, 다 떨어졌어요. 수족관 물고기들한테 마지막 남은 걸 다 줘 버렸거든요.

english: I have some empty boxes though, they have the ingredients written on the back. I'm sure if you pick up a pestle and mortar you will be able to make your own.
translation: 그래도 empty boxes(빈 상자)는 좀 있어요. 뒷면에 재료가 적혀 있죠. pestle and mortar(막자와 막자사발)만 구하면 직접 만들 수 있을 거예요.

english: Here. I can hardly charge you for an empty box.
translation: 여기요. 빈 상자 하나로 돈을 받을 순 없죠.

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
Let's see what you've got then.
Can I get a fish for this bowl?
translation: 이 어항에 넣을 물고기를 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: I'll take it!
No thanks, later maybe
Do you have any fishfood?
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I don't have time to talk to an outerlander.
Good to see you [Fremennik name].
Good to see you [Fremennik name]. Wanting to go to the Island of Stone?
translation: 반갑소, [Fremennik name]. Island of Stone(돌의 섬)에 가려는 거요?

english: Player is transported to the Island of Stone
translation: 플레이어가 Island of Stone(돌의 섬)으로 이동한다

english: No thank you.
Good to see you [Fremennik name]. Do you wish to return to Rellekka?
Player is transported to Rellekka
Yes please.
No thank you.
Can I have another ring?
translation: 반지 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Hatius gives you another ring.
Who are you?
I am Hatius Cosaintus, the taskmaster for the Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary.
translation: 저는 Hatius Cosaintus(하티우스 코사인투스), Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary(럼브리지 & 드레이너 업적 일지)의 과제 감독관이에요.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Lumbridge and Draynor area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록해 두는 데 도움이 되는 일지예요. Lumbridge(럼브리지)와 Draynor(드레이너) 지역에서는 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 발견하게 해 주죠. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이

english: reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: 제 Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different Explorer's rings, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: 음, Explorer's rings(탐험가의 반지)는 네 가지가 있고, 네 단계의 난이도에 하나씩 대응해요. 각 반지는 이전 단계의 보상을 모두 갖고 있고 추가 혜택도 있어요... 어느 등급 보상에 대해

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Lumbridge and Draynor, your ring can recharge half of your run energy twice per day and cast low level alchemy without runes 30 times per day.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)와 Draynor(드레이너)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료하면, 반지로 하루 두 번 달리기 에너지를 절반 회복하고, 하루 30번 룬 없이 low level alchemy(로우 레벨 알케미)를 시전할 수 있어요.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 중급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your ring can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day, there's also a new shortcut available under the Draynor village wall.
translation: 초급 보상에 더해, 반지로 하루 세 번 달리기 에너지를 절반 회복하고 Draynor(드레이너) 양배추 밭으로 텔레포트할 수 있어요. 드레이너 마을 성벽 아래를 지나는 새 지름길도 열리고요.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the ring will have unlimited cabbage teleports and four charges to restore half your run energy. Collecting Tears of Guthix will provide increased experience and a shortcut
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, 반지로 양배추 밭 텔레포트를 무제한 쓸 수 있고 달리기 에너지 절반 회복은 4회가 돼요. Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물)에서 얻는 경험치가 늘어나고,

english: from Lumbridge swamp to the Desert becomes available.
translation: Lumbridge swamp(럼브리지 늪)에서 Desert(사막)으로 가는 지름길도 열려요.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 엘리트 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you can block an additional slayer target with slayer masters, recharge all of your run energy three times per day and cast high level alchemy thirty times per day. The
translation: 이전 등급의 보상에 더해, 슬레이어 마스터에게 슬레이어 과제를 하나 더 차단할 수 있고, 하루 세 번 달리기 에너지를 모두 회복하며, 하루 30번 high level alchemy(하이 레벨 알케미)를 시전할 수 있어요.

english: Culinaromancer's chest is 20% cheaper and you can use Fairy rings without needing a dramen or lunar staff.
translation: Culinaromancer's chest(요리술사의 상자)가 20% 저렴해지고, dramen(드라멘) 지팡이나 lunar staff(루나 지팡이) 없이도 Fairy rings(요정의 고리)를 쓸 수 있어요.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
One should complete the tasks in Lumbridge and Draynor so they're ticked off, then speak to me to be rewarded.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)와 Draynor(드레이너)의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면, 저한테 말을 걸어 보상을 받으시면 돼요.

english: Bye!
Toodles.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary!
translation: Lumbridge & Draynor Achievement Diary(럼브리지 & 드레이너 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: Quite... You'll be wanting a reward then.
Yes please!
This ring is a symbol of your exploration of Lumbridge and Draynor. It can recharge half of your run energy twice per day and cast low level alchemy without runes 30 times per day.
translation: 이 반지는 당신이 Lumbridge(럼브리지)와 Draynor(드레이너)를 탐험했다는 증표예요. 하루 두 번 달리기 에너지를 절반 회복하고, 하루 30번 룬 없이 low level alchemy(로우 레벨 알케미)를 시전할 수 있어요.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your ring, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: 반지를 잃어버리면 언제든 다시 찾아오세요. 새로 드릴게요.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Lumbridge & Draynor achievement diary!
translation: Lumbridge & Draynor achievement diary(럼브리지 & 드레이너 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Explorer's ring for you. It can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day.
translation: Explorer's ring(탐험가의 반지)를 업그레이드해 드렸어요. 하루 세 번 달리기 에너지를 절반 회복하고 Draynor(드레이너) 양배추 밭으로 텔레포트할 수 있어요.

english: Can I have another ring?
translation: 반지 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 제 Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 단골손님이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello.
It's the meddler! The one who blew Jones' cover! I don't know why you came to this place but it is here that you will die.
translation: 그 참견꾼이다! Jones(존스)의 정체를 들통나게 한 놈! 네가 왜 여기 왔는지는 모르겠지만, 여기가 바로 네 무덤이 될 거다.

english: The adventurer returns! Glory to you for your efforts in bringing about the return of Lord Hazeel!
translation: 모험가께서 돌아오셨군요! Hazeel(헤이즐) 군주님의 귀환을 이끌어 주신 당신의 노고에 영광을!

english: The mage starts to speak but all you hear is:
translation: 마법사가 말하기 시작하지만, 들리는 건 이것뿐이다:

english: Blah. Blah, blah, blah, blah...blah!
You feel very strange - as if Hazelmere has started poking around in your head.
translation: 기분이 무척 이상하다. 마치 Hazelmere(헤이즐미어)가 머릿속을 뒤적이기 시작한 것 같다.

english: Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human, but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - even if most gnomes won't recognise it.  You humans are not as stupid as I first thought...
translation: 흠, 인간에게 감탄하게 될 줄은 몰랐네만, 자네는 노움들을 위해 좋은 일을 했네. 대부분의 노움은 알아주지 않겠지만 말일세.  자네들 인간은 내가 처음 생각했던 것만큼 멍청하지는 않군...

english: So you want to know what your crystal seed does?
translation: 그러니까 자네 crystal seed(크리스탈 씨앗)이 무엇을 하는지 알고 싶다는 거로군?

english: How did you.. ? Oh I forgot about this mind meld thing.
translation: 어떻게 그걸.. ? 아, 이 정신 융합인가 뭔가를 깜빡했네요.

english: The seed is a piece of elven magic, all elven magic comes from the manipulation of seeds of crystal. The elves give it divine properties. Elves sing to their crystals and they form into the desired shape.
translation: 그 씨앗은 엘프 마법의 산물일세. 모든 엘프 마법은 크리스탈 씨앗을 다루는 데서 나오지. 엘프들은 거기에 신성한 성질을 불어넣는다네. 엘프들이 크리스탈에게 노래를 부르면 크리스탈이 원하는 모양으로 바뀌지.

english: So how do I turn it into something useful?
translation: 그럼 이걸 어떻게 쓸모 있는 걸로 바꿀 수 있어요?

english: Either talk to an elf or find some other way to sing the crystal. If this came from Oaknock, he must have found a way...
translation: 엘프에게 말해 보든지, 크리스탈에게 노래를 불러 줄 다른 방법을 찾아보게. 이게 Oaknock(오크녹)에게서 나온 거라면, 그 친구는 방법을 찾아냈던 게 분명하네...

english: Thanks, I'll have a look round Oaknock's old workshop. I can have a chat with Brimstail while I'm at it! Thanks!
translation: 고마워요, Oaknock(오크녹)의 옛 작업장을 둘러볼게요. 간 김에 Brimstail(브림스테일)이랑 이야기도 좀 하고요! 고마워요!

english: So you want to know what your crystal saw does?
translation: 그러니까 자네 crystal saw(크리스탈 톱)이 무엇을 하는지 알고 싶다는 거로군?

english: Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw. He said it allowed him to build devices more complicated that even he was capable of constructing. The device he built must have been very complicated indeed.
translation: 음, Oaknock(오크녹)이 그 톱을 쓰는 걸 본 기억이 나는군. 그 톱 덕분에 자기 실력으로도 만들 수 없을 만큼 복잡한 장치를 만들 수 있다고 했지. 그가 만든 장치는 정말 어마어마하게 복잡했을 걸세.

english: I'd say! Anyway, the saw looks like it could be pretty useful. Thanks.
translation: 그러게요! 아무튼, 이 톱은 꽤 쓸모 있을 것 같네요. 고마워요.

english: Hello, Hazelmere.
You're back. Come to disturb me, have you?
translation: 또 왔군. 날 귀찮게 하러 왔나?

english: Ah, good old Hazelmere. Glad to see you're back to your grumpy self.
translation: 아, 역시 Hazelmere(헤이즐미어)예요. 예전의 심술궂은 모습으로 돌아오셔서 다행이네요.

english: Do you actually want something from me, or are you simply making my life a misery again?
translation: 정말 나한테 볼일이 있는 건가, 아니면 또 내 삶을 괴롭게 하러 온 건가?

english: I just wanted to have a chat. You know, just check how you're doing.
translation: 그냥 이야기나 좀 하고 싶었어요. 잘 지내시나 궁금하기도 하고요.

english: Well I'm fine, thank you. Now leave me in peace.
translation: 그래, 잘 지내네, 고맙군. 이제 날 좀 조용히 내버려 두게.

english: You give the bark sample to Hazelmere.
(The bark sample is removed from the player's inventory)
The mage carefully studies the sample.
Blah, blah...Daconia...blah, blah.
Can you write this down and I'll try and translate it?
translation: 이걸 글로 적어 주실래요? 제가 해석해 볼게요.

english: Blah, blah?
You make a writing motion. The mage scribbles something down on a scroll.
translation: 글 쓰는 시늉을 한다. 마법사가 scroll(두루마리)에 무언가를 휘갈겨 적는다.

english: Hazelmere has given you the scroll.
You still can't understand Hazelmere. The mage wrote it down for you on a scroll.
translation: 여전히 Hazelmere(헤이즐미어)의 말을 알아들을 수 없다. 마법사가 두루마리에 적어 주었다.

english: Blah, blah, blah...blah!
What?
Blah, blah.
Hazelmere has given you a challenge scroll!
Blah!
Blah, blah, blah!
Hazelmere has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 알맞은 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같다! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요하다!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 아쉽지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 된다. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울린다.

english: You hand over your delivery of [item] to Hazelmere
*Hazelmere nods his thanks*
You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져오느라 먼 길을 왔겠군. 팁으로 조금 더 얹어 주지.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You are not eligible to get gnome food delivered to you yet.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number]크레딧을 모았다. 아직 노움 음식을 배달받을 자격은 없다.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number]크레딧을 모았다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 받는 걸 잊지 말자.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받자. 더는 필요 없는 배달 상자는 버렸다.

english: After all that, are you sure I can't convince you to join the union?
translation: 그 모든 일을 겪으셨는데도, 정말 노조에 가입하시도록 설득할 수는 없겠습니까?

english: Actually, I was wondering if...
Kuani! I'll need to run and grab my forms, but if you wait there just a moment...
translation: Kuani(쿠아니)! 얼른 가서 신청서를 가져와야겠군요. 잠시만 거기서 기다려 주시면...

english: I was going to ask if you had any spare equipment...
translation: 혹시 남는 장비가 있는지 여쭤보려던 거였어요...

english: Spare equipment?
I may have a need to mask my identity again in the future... or perhaps carry a tray around.
translation: 앞으로 또 정체를 숨겨야 할 일이 생길지도 몰라서요... 아니면 쟁반을 들고 다닐 일이라든가.

english: You're certain you don't want to join the union as well?
I'm sure.
I see. In that case, which equipment would you like?
The ram mask.
Thanks!
The wolf mask.
The bird mask.
The jaguar mask.
The snake mask.
The butler's tray.
None of them.
Very well.
Changed your mind about joining the union? Or are you just after more equipment?
translation: 노조 가입에 대해 마음이 바뀌셨습니까? 아니면 장비가 더 필요하신 겁니까?

english: Just the equipment please.
I see. In that case, what do you need?
The ram mask.
The wolf mask.
The bird mask.
The jaguar mask.
More options...
The snake mask.
The butler's tray.
None of them.
Previous options...
What do you think you're doing?
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here. Feel free to use any of our facilities.
translation: 안녕하세요, Cooking Guild(요리 길드)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 이곳엔 실력 있는 요리사만 들어올 수 있어요. 시설은 무엇이든 마음껏 쓰세요.

english: Nice cape, you're wearing!
Thank you! It's my most prized possession, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
translation: 고마워요! 제 가장 소중한 보물이에요. Skillcape of Cooking(요리 스킬 망토)인데, 요리 레벨 99를 달성한 이 땅 최고의 요리사 중 한 명이라는 증표죠!

english: If you ever achieve level 99 cookingyou'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
translation: 언젠가 요리 레벨 99를 달성하면 당신도 입을 수 있어요. 그러면 음식을 절대 태우지 않게 될 거예요!

english: Thanks, bye.
Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. It's always great to have such an accomplished chef visit us. Say, would you be interested in a Skillcape of Cooking? They're only available to master chefs.
translation: 안녕하세요, Cooking Guild(요리 길드)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 이렇게 뛰어난 요리사가 찾아 주시다니 언제나 반가워요. 그런데, Skillcape of Cooking(요리 스킬 망토)에 관심 있으세요? 요리의 달인만 얻을 수 있는 망토랍니다.

english: No thanks.
Okay, come back to me if you change your mind.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Cooking from you?
translation: Skillcape of Cooking(요리 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, by wearing this cape you'll never burn any food, I will have to ask for 99000 gold coins for such a privilege.
translation: 물론이죠. 이 망토를 입으면 음식을 절대 태우지 않게 돼요. 그런 특권이니 99000골드 코인을 받아야겠어요.

english: That's much too expensive.
I'm sorry you feel that way.
Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토는 무료 두건과 함께 드려요. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이거든요. 말하자면 원 플러스 원이죠. 그러니 제가 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Now you can use the title Master Chef.
translation: 이제 Master Chef(요리장) 칭호를 쓸 수 있어요.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 제 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
The head chef hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: head chef(주방장)이 스킬 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 건넨다.

english: You can't come in here unless you're wearing a chef's hat, or something like that.
translation: chef's hat(요리사 모자)나 그 비슷한 걸 쓰지 않으면 여기 들어올 수 없어요.

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32 and come back wearing a chef's hat.
translation: 미안해요. 최고의 요리사만 들어올 수 있어요. 요리 레벨을 32까지 올리고 chef's hat(요리사 모자)를 쓰고 다시 오세요.

english: Sorry. Only the finest chefs are allowed in here. Get your cooking level up to 32.
translation: 미안해요. 최고의 요리사만 들어올 수 있어요. 요리 레벨을 32까지 올려서 다시 오세요.

english: You have done well, [player name]!
Nice cape you're wearing!
Thanks, bye.
No thanks.
Yes please.
That's much too expensive.
Sure.
Skillcape
Hood
Hello there.
Good day to you my friend, a beautiful one at that. Would you like some groceries? I have all sorts. Alcohol also, if you're partial to a drink.
translation: 좋은 하루예요, 친구. 정말 화창한 날이네요. 식료품 좀 사실래요? 온갖 게 다 있어요. 한잔 좋아하시면 술도 있고요.

english: No thank you.
Ahh well, all the best to you.
translation: 아, 그래요. 그럼 좋은 하루 보내세요.

english: I'll have a look.
There's a good human.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 알맞은 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같다! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요하다!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 아쉽지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 된다. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울린다.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Heckel Funch
translation: Heckel Funch(헤클 펀치)에게 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 배달품을 건넸다

english: Hey! Thanks a lot mate. You're a diamond.
translation: 와! 정말 고마워요, 친구. 당신은 진짜 보석 같은 사람이에요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number]크레딧을 모았다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 받는 걸 잊지 말자.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받자. 더는 필요 없는 배달 상자는 버렸다.

english: Please do puzzle for me human!
translation: 인간, 제 퍼즐 좀 풀어 주세요!

english: No, that's wrong I'm afraid.
Well done, human!
No thank you.
I'll have a look.
Nilsal. Here to pay respects, or just here to appreciate the calmness of this crypt?
translation: Nilsal(닐살). 참배하러 오셨습니까, 아니면 이 지하 묘지의 고요함을 느끼러 오셨습니까?

english: Just looking around really.
Please do. Many find this a nice place to come from time to time. The bustle of the city can be overwhelming. Here you can contemplate many things in peace, watched over by Ranul himself.
translation: 그러십시오. 많은 이들이 때때로 이곳을 찾아오지요. 도시의 소란은 버거울 수 있으니까요. 이곳에서는 Ranul(라눌)께서 몸소 지켜보시는 가운데 평온히 여러 가지를 생각해 볼 수 있습니다.

english: Hello, can I ask you a question?
Oh yes, young fellow? Yes, what do you want?
translation: 오, 그래, 젊은이? 그래, 뭘 원하나?

english: Who's that you're talking to Hegir?
Let me see, he appears to be a human of some sort.
What was your name again, human?
[player name].
It's [player name]!
Well ask him what he wants then!
What do you want, human?
Errr... I don't know... A quest, maybe?
He says he's looking for his quest!
What makes him think he lost his quest in here?
What makes you think you lost your quest in here?
No no, I mean, do you have a task of some sort for me?
translation: 아뇨 아뇨, 제 말은, 저한테 맡길 일 같은 거 없냐는 거예요.

english: Now he says he wants a task!
Stop talking to that human and get back in here before I have a task for you!
translation: 그 인간이랑 그만 떠들고 당장 들어와, 안 그러면 내가 일거리를 줄 테니까!

english: No need to talk to me like that, Haera.
I'll talk to you in whatever way I like!
translation: 내가 말하고 싶은 대로 말할 거야!

english: I think I hear someone calling my name in the distance…
translation: 멀리서 누가 제 이름을 부르는 것 같은데요…

english: No need to shout!
Calm down dear.
I don't see why.
Yes you did!
I did not!
What did you do that for?
Welcome to the Heroes' Guild!
translation: Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: So do you sell anything good here?
Why yes! We DO run an exclusive shop for our members!
translation: 그럼요! 회원 전용 상점을 운영하고 있답니다!

english: So what can I do here?
translation: 그럼 여기서 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Look around... there are all sorts of things to keep our guild members entertained!
translation: 둘러보세요... 길드 회원들이 즐길 거리가 온갖 종류로 있답니다!

english: So do you sell anything here?
So what can I do here?
translation: 그럼 여기서 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 와, 영웅님이다! 우와! 정말 대단해요. 대체 어떻게 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치운 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요, 수고 많으셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Helena, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: 전 Helena(헬레나)예요. 그냥 꼬마지만, 한 방 먹여 줄 수도 있다고요! 그렇게 세 보이지도 않는데요!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있어요. 곧 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 알기론 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 당신한테 무척 고마워하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알았던 적은 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 그래도 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분 사람들 눈엔 당신이 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello there. Did you see that dwarf by the big forge? I think he wanted to talk to you.
translation: 안녕하세요. 큰 대장간 옆에 있는 드워프 보셨어요? 당신한테 할 말이 있는 것 같던데요.

english: Hello there.
Hello. Sorry, I'd love to stop and chat, but I have a new find that I need to work on. If you need anything, I'm sure Prescott can help.
translation: 안녕하세요. 미안하지만, 이야기 나누고 싶어도 새로 발견한 걸 연구해야 해서요. 필요한 게 있으면 Prescott(프레스콧)이 도와줄 거예요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Not a problem.
How are you doing?
Great. Ready to take on another of those pesky rats!
translation: 최고야. 그 성가신 쥐 놈들 또 잡으러 갈 준비 됐어!

english: How old are you now?
I'm [x] months old. (Month count differs based on kitten's current growth.)
translation: 난 [x]개월이야. (새끼 고양이의 현재 성장 정도에 따라 개월 수가 다릅니다.)

english: Where do you want to go?
Let's go steal some things from stalls. I do enjoy watching shopkeepers panic!
translation: 노점에서 물건이나 좀 훔치러 가자. 상점 주인들이 허둥대는 꼴 보는 게 재밌거든!

english: What do you want to do now?
I need to crunch something - lets go ratting!
translation: 뭘 좀 와작와작 씹어야겠어. 쥐 잡으러 가자!

english: Big, mean, and ready to rumble. Just the way I like it.
translation: 크고, 사납고, 한판 붙을 준비 완료. 딱 내 취향이지.

english: Practically perfect in every way. Ready for world domination.
translation: 모든 면에서 거의 완벽하지. 세계 정복할 준비도 끝났고.

english: Easy there tiger.
I fancy pointing and laughing at some demons. They always make me cackle.
translation: 악마들 손가락질하면서 비웃으러 가고 싶은데. 걔네 보면 늘 낄낄대게 되거든.

english: Why's that?
Well, have you never noticed how well ghouls and demons get on?
translation: 흠, 구울이랑 악마가 얼마나 죽이 잘 맞는지 눈치 못 챘어?

english: No... Can't say I have.
Yeah... Demons are a ghoul's best friend.
Hmm. I'm not sure I understand that. Is it some kind of joke?
translation: 음. 무슨 말인지 잘 모르겠는데. 무슨 농담 같은 거야?

english: Sigh. I think you're the only joke round here, no-fur.
translation: 하아. 여기서 농담거리는 너밖에 없는 것 같다, 털도 없는 녀석아.

english: Prey on the weak and injured. Let's try the wilderness!
translation: 약하고 다친 놈들을 노리는 거야. 황야로 가 보자!

english: Yawn. I'm too lazy to even bother answering you.
Do you mind? I'm trying to clean!
translation: 방해하지 말아 줄래? 털 손질 중이거든!

english: Oi kitty! I'm talking to you!
Go away!!
~From the look in its eyes you decide to leave alone for now.
translation: ~그 눈빛을 보아하니 지금은 내버려 두는 게 좋겠다.

english: Anywhere but here. I'm feeling lucky!
translation: 여기만 아니면 어디든. 오늘따라 운이 좋은 느낌이야!

english: Let's go to the Emir's Arena, near Al Kharid, and watch some fights!
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드) 근처에 있는 Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)에 가서 싸움 구경이나 하자!

english: Content. But a little more attention or rat hunting wouldn't go amiss.
translation: 만족해. 그래도 관심을 좀 더 주거나 쥐 사냥을 시켜 주면 마다하진 않을 거야.

english: We'll see what we can do.
Whoa-oa-oa! I feel good, I knew that I would now.. I feel nice!!
translation: 우워어어! 기분 좋아, 이럴 줄 알았지.. 기분 최고야!!

english: Let's go to the sewers of Varrock.
Anywhere dangerous is good with me!
Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 미안한데 인간, 너 지금 뭘 쓰고 있는 거야?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: 고양이 귀 하나 맞췄어. 어때, 끝내주지 않냐아아아아옹?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 고양이가 눈 한 번 깜빡이지 않고 당신을 빤히 노려본다.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 안 웃겨. 당장 벗어, 인간. 나도 인간 귀 한 쌍 구해다 쓰고 다니기 전에.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
How many souls have you devoured?
None.
Awww p-
Yet.
Oh.
What a cute puppy, how nice to meet you.
It'll be nice to meat you too...
Urk... nice doggy.
Grrrr....
Hell yeah! Such a cute puppy!
Silence mortal! Or I'll eat your soul.
translation: 조용히 해라, 필멸자여! 안 그러면 네 영혼을 먹어 버리겠다.

english: Would that go well with lemon?
Why were the hot dogs shivering?
Grrrrr...
Because they were served-
GRRRRRR...
-with... chilli?
I wonder if I need to invest in a trowel when I take you out for a walk.
translation: 너 데리고 산책 나갈 때 trowel(모종삽)을 하나 장만해야 하려나.

english: More like a shovel.
Grrr... cats.
Soulless object.
Cats smell
Rawr
Wooooof
Grrrrrr!
The spirit looks at you without saying a word. However, as you approach, he offers you some items.
translation: 정령은 아무 말 없이 당신을 바라본다. 그런데 당신이 다가가자, 그가 물건 몇 가지를 건넨다.

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You don't have enough room in your supply bag for what he's offering.
translation: 정령이 묘한 눈빛으로 당신을 본다. 그가 건네는 물건을 담기에는 보급품 가방에 자리가 부족하다.

english: The spirit gives you a strange look. You've clearly claimed all you can for now.
translation: 정령이 묘한 눈빛으로 당신을 본다. 지금 받을 수 있는 건 이미 다 받은 게 분명하다.

english: Hello?

You have reached the Lunar Communication Helpline. I'm sorry we can't answer your telekinetic question right now. Our opening times are carefully organised to coincide with you being busy. If you are having an emergency, you have our most profound apologies. Have a nice day. Good bye.
translation: Lunar Communication Helpline(루나 통신 상담소)에 연결되었습니다. 죄송하지만 지금은 고객님의 염동력 문의에 응답해 드릴 수 없습니다. 저희 운영 시간은 고객님께서 바쁘실 때와 정확히 겹치도록 세심하게 조정되어 있습니다. 긴급 상황이시라면 진심으로 깊은 사과의 말씀을 드립니다. 좋은 하루 보내십시오. 안녕히 계십시오.

english: Typical.
Hello!
You do not have an appointment.
Sorry, what?
Appointment for what?
An appointment to see the Queen.
How do you know that?
First, because it is my job. Second, because she is not in Fortis at the moment.
translation: 첫째, 그것이 제 일이기 때문입니다. 둘째, 여왕 폐하께서는 지금 Fortis(포르티스)에 계시지 않기 때문입니다.

english: Oh. Well where is she then?
She has important business elsewhere in the kingdom. Perhaps when she returns, you'll be able to see her, or perhaps you won't.
translation: 왕국의 다른 곳에서 중요한 용무를 보고 계십니다. 돌아오시면 알현하실 수 있을지도 모르고, 못 하실지도 모릅니다.

english: Yes, those generally are the two options.
translation: 네, 보통 선택지는 그 두 가지뿐이죠.

english: Now, if there's nothing else, please move along.
translation: 자, 다른 볼일이 없으시다면 이만 가 주십시오.

english: Hello there. Want to sample my catch of the day? Or maybe you'd prefer to do some fishing yourself? If so, I have all the supplies you'll need.
translation: 안녕하세요. 오늘 잡은 생선 맛 좀 보실래요? 아니면 직접 낚시를 해 보시겠어요? 그렇다면 필요한 용품은 제가 다 갖추고 있어요.

english: Let's see what you have.
Nothing for me, thanks.
As you wish.
Let's see what you have.
Nothing for me, thanks.
Hello there! If you have any ores to trade I'm always buying.
translation: 안녕하세요! 팔 광석이 있으면 언제든 사 드려요.

english: Why don't you ever restock your shop?
translation: 왜 가게 물건을 다시 안 채워 놓으세요?

english: The only ores I sell are the ones that are sold to me.
translation: 제가 파는 광석은 남들이 저한테 판 것들뿐이거든요.

english: Anything else?
See you later.
Until next time.
Let's trade.
Why don't you ever restock your shop?
translation: 왜 가게 물건을 다시 안 채워 놓으세요?

english: Goodbye.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 여러 가지예요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
I'm just wandering around.
You do realise you're wandering around in my house?
translation: 지금 돌아다니는 데가 내 집이라는 건 알고 있겠지?

english: Yep.
Well please get out!
Sheesh, keep your wig on!
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
No, I jolly well wouldn't! Get out of my house!
translation: 아니, 절대로 안 주지! 내 집에서 나가!

english: Meanie!
Aaaarrgh!
Eeeek!
I'm just wandering around.
I was hoping you'd give me some free stuff.
I've come to kill you.
Sorry, we don't talk to strangers.
translation: 미안하지만, 우린 모르는 사람이랑은 얘기 안 해요.

english: Thanks again for helping Uncle Eric. He thinks you're really really brave. I hope he'll visit again soon.
translation: Eric(에릭) 삼촌을 도와주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요. 삼촌이 그러는데 정말정말 용감한 분이래요. 삼촌이 곧 또 놀러 오시면 좋겠어요.

english: Hello.
Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home, please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요. Carnillean(카닐리언) 가문의 저택을 둘러보고 싶으시다면, 그 꾀죄죄한 손으로 아무것도 만지지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay...
Hello again adventurer! Since you dealt with those horrible hooligan cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!
translation: 다시 오셨군요, 모험가님! 그 끔찍한 불량배 광신도들을 처리해 주신 뒤로 이곳 형편이 몰라보게 좋아졌답니다!

english: My pleasure, Lady Henryeta.
Oh, it's you. I'm very disappointed that you never found those awful cultists. You're quite useless really, aren't you?
translation: 어머, 당신이군요. 그 끔찍한 광신도들을 끝내 찾지 못하셨다니 정말 실망이에요. 당신, 참 쓸모없는 사람이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Yup, I guess I am.
Are you hungry?
That depends, what have you got?
I'm sure I could knock you up a decent salad.
translation: 샐러드 정도는 근사하게 뚝딱 만들어 줄 수 있는데.

english: I'm actually an insectivore.
translation: 사실 난 곤충을 먹는 식충 동물이야.

english: Oh, but your name suggests that-
translation: 어, 근데 이름을 보면 꼭 초식 동물(herbivore) 같은데-

english: I think you'll find I didn't name myself, you humans and your silly puns.
translation: 내 이름을 내가 지은 게 아니란 건 알아 두라고. 너희 인간들이랑 그 실없는 말장난이란.

english: No need to PUNish us for our incredible wit.
translation: 말장난 좀 했다고 그렇게 장난 아니게 정색하지 마. 우리 재치가 워낙 뛰어나서 그래.

english: Please. Stop.
Have your herbs died?
These old things? I guess they've dried up... I'm getting old and I need caring for. I've chosen you to do that by the way.
translation: 이 낡은 것들? 다 말라 버렸나 보네... 나도 늙어서 돌봐 줄 사람이 필요해. 참고로 그 일은 네가 하는 걸로 정했어.

english: Oh fantastic! I spend all that time training the Farming skill, and now I'm supposed to care for your herbs as well?
translation: 아주 잘됐네! Farming(농사) 스킬 키우느라 그렇게 시간을 쏟았는데, 이제 네 약초까지 돌봐야 한다고?

english: I could try the next person if you'd prefer?
translation: 원하면 다음 사람한테 가 봐도 되고.

english: I'm just joking you old swine!
So you live in a hole? I would've thought Boars are surface dwelling mammals.
translation: 그러니까 구멍 속에 산다고? 멧돼지는 땅 위에 사는 포유류인 줄 알았는데.

english: Well, I'm special! I bore down a little so I'm nice and cosy with my herbs exposed to the sun, it's all very interesting.
translation: 흠, 난 특별하거든! 땅을 살짝 파고 들어가서 아늑하게 지내면서 약초는 햇볕을 쬐게 내놓는 거지. 아주 흥미로운 얘기야.

english: Sounds rather... Boring!
How very original...
Tell me... do you like Avacado?
I'm an insectivore, but even if I wasn't I'd hate Avacado!
translation: 난 식충 동물이지만, 설령 아니었대도 아보카도는 질색이야!

english: Why ever not? It's delicious!
I don't know why people like it so much... it tastes a likea ball of chewed up grass.
translation: 사람들이 그걸 왜 그렇게 좋아하는지 모르겠어... 씹다 만 풀 덩어리 같은 맛이 나는데.

english: Sometimes you can be such a bore...
translation: 가끔 보면 넌 시간 허비 그 자체라니까...

english: When I was a young HERBIBOAR!!
I'm standing right next to you, no need to shout...
translation: 나 바로 옆에 서 있잖아, 소리 지를 필요 없어...

english: I was trying to sing you a song...
translation: 노래 한 곡 불러 주려던 거였는데...

english: Ever tried a butterfly before?
I've never been able to catch one, they've always eluded me.
translation: 한 번도 못 잡아 봤어. 늘 요리조리 빠져나가더라고.

english: Herbi chomps excitedly on the butterfly, he seems pleased.
translation: Herbi(허비)가 신나게 나비를 우적우적 씹는다. 아주 만족한 것 같다.

english: Woah! You should try those, they're amazing.
translation: 우와! 너도 먹어 봐, 이거 끝내준다.

english: I got you some grubs!
My favorite!
Herbi munches happily on the grubs. It's rather gross.
translation: 허비가 행복하게 애벌레를 우물우물 먹는다. 꽤 역겹다.

english: How about some wyrms?
I assume you mean worms, not sure I could stomach a wyrm, far too big.
translation: worm(벌레) 말하는 거겠지. wyrm(웜)은 소화 못 시킬 것 같아, 너무 크잖아.

english: Oh yeah, those words don't even sound the same.
translation: 아 그래, 두 단어 발음이 하나도 안 비슷하네.

english: I don't judge you, now hand over those worms!
translation: 따지진 않을게, 그 벌레나 얼른 내놔!

english: Herbi hungrily devours the worms, you regret watching him do it.
translation: 허비가 게걸스럽게 벌레를 먹어 치운다. 지켜본 걸 후회하게 된다.

english: Slimy, yet satisfying.
I got you a spider carcass!
Not really an insect, but admittedly I'm not too fussy.
translation: 곤충은 아니지만, 솔직히 내가 그렇게 까다롭진 않지.

english: Herbi gobbles the spider down, several legs fall to the ground around him.
translation: 허비가 거미를 꿀꺽 삼키자, 다리 몇 개가 그 주변 땅에 떨어진다.

english: You missed a bit.
I'll save them for later.
Oink!
THEY CALL ME MR. PIIIG!
I'll show you a bacon salad!
translation: 베이컨 샐러드 맛 좀 보여 주마!

english: Hiya Hermie!
Ah, [player name]! How's the fishing going?
Still working on it. How's the Colony?
Flourishing, now that the colonists are coming back! Soon all the finest restaurants will be serving monkfish!
translation: 번창하고 있어요, 정착민들이 돌아오고 있으니까요! 머지않아 최고급 식당마다 monkfish(아귀) 요리를 내놓을 거예요!

english: It's a pity those skeletons you brought here haven't gone away again, though. They're in the dormitories, which is rather annoying! So please take a little time to kick 'em around a bit.
translation: 그런데 당신이 데려온 그 해골들이 아직도 안 사라졌다는 게 아쉬워요. 숙소에 눌러앉아 있어서 꽤 성가시거든요! 그러니 시간 좀 내서 그놈들 좀 실컷 걷어차 주세요.

english: Oh, and please don't call me Hermie.
translation: 아, 그리고 제발 허미라고 부르지 말아 주세요.

english: Whatever you like, Hermie!
Hop inside my mouth if you want to live!
I'm not falling for that... I'm not a fish! I've got more foresight than that.
translation: 그런 수에 안 넘어가... 난 물고기가 아니라고! 그것보단 내다보는 눈이 있어.

english: Got any Spirit flakes?
I think you may have a problem.
translation: 너 문제가 좀 있는 것 같은데.

english: I agree, you don't give me anywhere enough of those. So get to it.
translation: 동감이야, 넌 그걸 너무 쥐꼬리만큼 주잖아. 그러니까 얼른 가져와.

english: Right.
Those look tasty. But I'm looking for a proper feast. Come back to me with 3000 of them.
translation: 맛있어 보이네. 그런데 난 제대로 된 만찬을 원해. 3000개 가지고 다시 와.

english: 3000!? Are you insane?!
Not really, I'm just a little bit peckish.
translation: 아니, 그냥 뭐 좀 쪼아 먹고 싶을 뿐이야.

english: Good thing you have a beak then!
Touché.
No thanks. I'm craving a Spirit flake right now.
translation: 됐어. 지금은 Spirit flake(영혼 부스러기)가 당긴단 말이야.

english: You really love those things.
Yup. So get to it.
Righto.
Transmogrify your Heron?
Your pet Heron gobbles up a Spirit flake and turns royal blue.
translation: 애완 왜가리가 Spirit flake(영혼 부스러기)를 꿀꺽 삼키더니 짙은 파란색으로 변한다.

english: What's the big idea? If you're going to offer me a Spirit flake, at least have one to hand!
translation: 뭐 하자는 거야? Spirit flake(영혼 부스러기)를 줄 거면 최소한 손에 하나는 들고 있어야지!

english: You can unlock the pet Heron transmogrification for 3000 x Spirit flakes.
translation: Spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기) 3000개로 애완 Heron(왜가리) 변신을 해금할 수 있다.

english: Where's the fish? You don't have any!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Got any raw fish?
Haven't you already eaten enough Spirit flakes?
translation: Spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기)는 이미 실컷 먹지 않았어?

english: Yes, I have. That's why I'm asking you for raw fish.
translation: 응, 먹었지. 그러니까 날생선을 달라는 거잖아.

english: Sometimes I wonder whether getting stuck with you was my good luck or yours.
translation: 너랑 엮인 게 내 복인지 네 복인지 가끔 헷갈린다.

english: In a remarkable display of gluttony, your pet Heron consumes 3000 Spirit flakes. It turns blue in front of your very eyes.
translation: 놀라운 식탐을 보이며 애완 왜가리가 Spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기) 3000개를 먹어 치운다. 눈앞에서 몸이 파랗게 변한다.

english: That really hit the spot! Though I feel a little blue now that there are none left.
translation: 아주 속이 다 시원하네! 그런데 이제 하나도 안 남았다니 얼굴이 다 파랗게 질리네.

english: You offer your pet Heron a Spirit flake, which it quickly gobbles up.
translation: 애완 왜가리에게 Spirit flake(영혼 부스러기)를 주자, 순식간에 꿀꺽 삼킨다.

english: Oops! That was a mistake, you're already blue. If you give it back, I'll give you a raw fish?
translation: 앗! 실수했다, 넌 이미 파랗잖아. 그거 돌려주면 날생선 하나 줄까?

english: Sorry, no can do. They're just too tasty. You should try one sometime!
translation: 미안, 그건 안 돼. 너무 맛있거든. 너도 언제 한번 먹어 봐!

english: I'll pass.
Your pet Heron gobbles up your [fish name] and turns a magnificent white.
translation: 애완 왜가리가 [fish name]을(를) 꿀꺽 삼키더니 눈부신 흰색으로 변한다.

english: Are you trying to annoy me?
I put in a lot of effort cooking this for you.
translation: 너 주려고 이거 공들여서 요리한 건데.

english: Exactly, you've cooked it! You've ruined a fine delicacy, now go and uncook it!
translation: 바로 그거야, 익혔잖아! 귀한 별미를 망쳐 놨으니까, 가서 다시 날것으로 되돌려 놔!

english: Uncook? That's not even possible!
I once knew a cat who mastered uncooking. Nice guy, actually. Enough talk, go and get me some more raw fish!
translation: 예전에 날것 되돌리기를 터득한 고양이를 알았는데. 사실 괜찮은 녀석이었어. 잔말 말고, 가서 날생선이나 더 가져와!

english: What is wrong with you?
I'm giving you some fish..
And you think that I can do anything with something charred to the bone?
translation: 뼈까지 새까맣게 탄 걸로 내가 뭘 할 수 있을 것 같아?

english: In my culture, these well-cooked fish are considered pretty valuable.
translation: 우리 문화에선 이렇게 바싹 익힌 생선이 꽤 귀하게 여겨지거든.

english: It's burnt, you dancing donkey!
Dancing donkey...?
Sushi? Do I look like a commoner to you?
In Dorgeshuun culture, this is considered a delicacy.
In bird culture, this is considered an insult. Get it out of my face at once!
translation: 새의 문화에선 이게 모욕으로 통해. 당장 내 눈앞에서 치워!

english: How could a member of my own house say something so horrible?
translation: 어떻게 한집 식구가 그렇게 끔찍한 말을 할 수 있지?

english: Great blue heron - 1 x Spirit flakes
translation: Great blue heron(큰푸른왜가리) - Spirit flakes(영혼 부스러기) 1개

english: Heron - 1 x Raw fish
Not right now.
Yes, it could use a nice snack.
No, I'm not shelling that out for a snack.
translation: 아니, 간식 하나에 그만큼 쓸 순 없어.

english: Do you wish to trade?
Why yes, this a jewel shop after all.
Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
translation: 죄송한데, 사실 당신이랑 얘기하고 싶지 않아요.

english: Huh! Charming!
You've done it! Have this.
Do you wish to trade?
Sorry I don't want to talk to you actually.
translation: 죄송한데, 사실 당신이랑 얘기하고 싶지 않아요.

english: Greetings, human... can I interest you in some fine gems?
translation: 반갑네, 인간... 좋은 보석 좀 보지 않겠나?

english: Show me the wares!
No thanks.
Hello! I've got a little quest for you, are you interested?
translation: 안녕하신가! 자네한테 맡길 작은 퀘스트가 있는데, 관심 있나?

english: Yes, I love quests!
That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]. And I need them within [13—15] minutes as well.
translation: 그 기세일세! 자, 내가 필요한 건 [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] [3—5]개일세. 그것도 [13—15]분 안에 필요하네.

english: Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] in [13—15] minutes.
translation: 퀘스트라고 하기엔 좀 그렇지만, 할게요. [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] [3—5]개를 [13—15]분 안에 가져오면 되는 거죠.

english: No, quests are dull and boring.
Don't be so dismissive, you didn't even hear what I wanted to ask you!
translation: 그렇게 무시하지 말게, 내가 뭘 부탁하려는지 듣지도 않았잖나!

english: I don't want to! I just want to kill things!
translation: 듣기 싫어요! 전 그냥 뭔가 죽이고 싶을 뿐이에요!

english: Are my [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] arriving anytime soon?
translation: 내 [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] [3—5]개는 곧 도착하는 건가?

english: Not anytime soon. Or at all. I've given up on looking for them.
translation: 곧은 아니에요. 아예 안 올 수도 있고요. 찾는 거 포기했어요.

english: Couldn't you decide that in advance? You're certainly lacking in manners!
translation: 그런 건 미리 정할 수 없었나? 자넨 확실히 예의가 부족하군!

english: Soon, yes, I hope so.
Good, soon can't be soon enough for me!
Good news, I got you [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]!
translation: 좋은 소식이에요, [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] [3—5]개 가져왔어요!

english: And not a minute too late! Great!
Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you prefer me to teach you a bit about how you can mine more efficiently?
translation: 보수를 금화로 받겠나, 아니면 더 효율적으로 채광하는 요령을 좀 배우겠나?

english: I'd like the gold.
Please teach me that.
That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]. And I need them within [18—20] minutes as well.
translation: 그 기세일세! 자, 내가 필요한 건 [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] 주괴 [3—5]개일세. 그것도 [18—20]분 안에 필요하네.

english: Player: Not much of a quest, but I'll do it. Just [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] in [18—20] minutes.
translation: 플레이어: 퀘스트라고 하기엔 좀 그렇지만, 할게요. [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] 주괴 [3—5]개를 [18—20]분 안에 가져오면 되는 거죠.

english: Are my [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] arriving anytime soon?
Good news, I got you [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]!
Do you want me to pay you in gold or would you like me to show you some smithing tricks?
translation: 보수를 금화로 받겠나, 아니면 대장일 요령을 좀 보여 주길 바라나?

english: Hands off those gems!
You're the thief! Stop!
Guards, get this filthy human!
Show me the wares!
No thanks.
Yes, I love quests!
No, quests are dull and boring.
Not anytime soon. Or at all.
translation: 곧은 아니에요. 아예 안 올 수도 있고요.

english: Soon, yes, I hope so.
I'd like the gold.
Please teach me that.
Even with everything we're going through, I have to admit, that was an impressive fight to behold! I wish I could have joined you, friend. Now, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: 지금 이런 일을 겪고 있긴 하지만, 그건 정말 볼 만한 싸움이었다는 걸 인정해야겠군! 나도 함께 싸웠으면 좋았을 걸세, 친구. 자, 이제 Nexus(넥서스)로 돌아가세.

english: Amascut! She's always been a monster, but she's doing things now I never believed her to be capable of! Had I not let my guard down, she'd surely be regretting her choices by now.
translation: Amascut(아마스컷)! 원래부터 괴물 같은 자였지만, 이제는 그자가 할 수 있으리라곤 상상도 못 한 짓들을 벌이고 있네! 내가 방심만 하지 않았어도, 지금쯤 그자는 자기 선택을 후회하고 있었을 걸세.

english: I guess we're lucky you came along when you did, my friend. I think you might have just given us a fighting chance!
translation: 그때 자네가 와 준 게 우리에겐 행운이었던 것 같군, 친구. 자네 덕분에 우리도 싸워 볼 기회를 얻은 것 같네!

english: I'm glad to have helped, but it's not over yet.
translation: 도움이 돼서 기뻐요, 하지만 아직 끝난 게 아니에요.

english: Indeed. Were I not still weak, I would gladly deal with her myself, but I fear you will have to face Amascut without me.
translation: 그렇지. 내가 아직 약해져 있지만 않았어도 기꺼이 직접 그자를 상대했겠지만, 아무래도 자네 혼자서 Amascut(아마스컷)과 맞서야 할 것 같네.

english: You'll find her on the level below. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way for you.
translation: 그자는 아래층에 있을 걸세. 자네가 다른 이들을 풀어 줄 수 있다면, 우리가 길을 열어 줄 수 있을 거야.

english: We have opened the way for you, my friend. Any other day, I would have joined you in the fight against Amascut, but this one is up to you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
translation: 자네를 위해 길을 열었네, 친구. 다른 날이었다면 나도 함께 Amascut(아마스컷)과 싸웠겠지만, 이번만큼은 자네 몫일세. 어서 가서 그자에게 무엇이 잘못됐는지 똑똑히 보여 주게!

english: Here he is!
My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 친구, 자네는 극소수만이 이뤄 낸 일을 해냈네. Amascut(아마스컷) 그자를 쓰러뜨린 거야! 나도 그 자리에서 직접 봤으면 좋았을 텐데!

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 뭐, 혼자서는 해내지 못했을 거예요. 그 얘기가 나와서 말인데, Scabaras(스카바라스)는 어디 있어요?

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)는 자기만의 길을 걷소. 그가 없다고 해서 모욕으로 여기지 마시오. 그것이 그의 방식이오.

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 게다가 그는 우리 중 누구보다도 훨씬 오래 Amascut(아마스컷)에게 조종당했지. 그자의 음모에서 자기가 맡았던 역할을 받아들이려면 시간이 걸릴 걸세.

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 걱정 마요, 그는 괜찮을 거예요. 늘 그랬거든요.

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 더 이야기하기 전에... 무덤 안에서는 대화할 시간이 별로 없었지. 분명 우리한테 묻고 싶은 게 있을 텐데.

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: Menaphite Pantheon(메나파이트 만신전)에서 당신은 어떤 역할을 맡고 있어요?

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 저는 Tumeken(투메켄)의 우정의 화신이에요! 투메켄 님은 늘 좀 차갑다는 평을 들었는데, 생각해 보면 좀 아이러니하죠.

english: A cold sun god?
Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 바로 그거예요! 좀 이상하죠? 그래도 사교성으로 유명한 분은 아니었지만, 그런 것의 중요성은 잘 알고 계셨어요. 그래서 저를 만드신 거예요!

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 제 일은 모두가 우정의 소중함을 잊지 않게 하는 거예요. 어쨌든 누구에게나 친구 한두 명, 아니 열 명, 어쩌면 수백 명은 필요하잖아요! 원하는 만큼 많이 사귀세요! 뭐라고 안 할게요.

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 사막에는 왜 원숭이나 유인원이 더 많지 않아요?

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 아, 그건 Amascut(아마스컷) 덕분이죠. 사막엔 원래 원숭이와 유인원이 수천 마리나 살았는데, 그자가 저한테 닿으려고 걔들을 노렸거든요.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 그러지 마세요! 이제 제가 돌아왔으니, 분명 다시 되돌려 놓을 수 있어요!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
Fair enough.
I'll be back soon.
We'll be here when you're ready.
I have a question for Crondis.
I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
Meaning?
Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 사막의 백성들이 지나친 삶을 살지 않도록 이끄는 것이 내 소임이라는 뜻이오.

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: 그럼 Menaphos(메나포스)는 별로 마음에 안 드시겠네요?

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 내가 없는 사이 사막의 많은 곳이 검소함의 중요성을 잊어버렸지만, Menaphos(메나포스)의 상황이 단연 가장 우려스럽소. 머지않아 바로잡히기를 바랄 뿐이오.

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
Rude? How so.
Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 제가 가까이 가기만 하면 늘 절 잡아먹으려고 하잖아요.

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 악어의 삶은 결코 녹록지 않소. 먹이가 있는 곳이라면 어디든 찾아다녀야 하오.

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 게다가 그대가 모든 진실을 말하고 있지는 않은 것 같구려. 예전에 그대도 악어와 친구가 된 적이 있지 않소?

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 그렇다면 악어가 그대 생각만큼 무례하지는 않은 모양이오.

english: As you wish.
We will be here.
I have a question for Het.
I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 나는 Tumeken(투메켄)의 건강의 화신일세. 몸과 마음, 양쪽 모두의 건강이지.

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 힘이랑 싸움 얘기를 많이 하시잖아요. 싸움이 건강에 좋을 리는 없을 텐데요.

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 글쎄, 건강에 있어서 힘이야말로 궁극적인 목표 아니겠나? 가장 강한 자란 몸과 마음이 모두 건강한 자이고, 그 힘을 기리는 데 전투보다 나은 방법이 어디 있겠나!

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 글쎄, 건강이란 혼자 움켜쥐고 있을 게 아니지 않나? 대부분의 약점은 극복할 수 있고, 덜 가진 이들을 돕는 건 강한 자의 의무일세.

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: 그 사람들도 강하고 건강해질 수 있도록요?

english: Exactly!
An interesting question. Why do you ask?
Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 당신은 인간의 모습을 하고 있으니까, 사람들한테 더 공감을 얻을 것 같아서요.

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 생각만큼은 아니라네. 믿기 힘들겠지만, 어떤 면에서는 오히려 좀 따분한 쪽으로 여겨진다네! 개코원숭이 신이 있는데 굳이 인간을 따를 이유가 있겠나?

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 특히 그 개코원숭이 신이 같이 있으면 이렇게나 재밌는데 말이죠!

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 물론 애초에 사람들이 우리 중 하나만 따르게 하려던 건 아니었지. 우린 만신전이고, 저마다 맡은 역할이 있거든.

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 이제 Amascut(아마스컷)이 꼬리를 내리고 달아났으니, 어쩌면 사람들에게 그걸 다시 일깨워 줄 수 있을 걸세.

english: Very well.
We'll wait for you to return.
I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 그건 그자에게 달렸다고 보네. 행실을 고치지 않는다면, 그 끝은 좋지 않을 걸세.

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 하지만 구원받기에 너무 늦은 때란 없어요. 그녀에게도 아직 희망이 있을지 몰라요.

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 그자가 어떤 길을 택하든, 우리는 준비가 되어 있을 것이오.

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 지금 와서 그녀가 정말 마음을 고칠 거라고 생각해요?

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 가능성은 낮아 보이오만, 그걸 바꿀 수 있을지도 모르는 이가 하나 있소.

english: Who?
Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: Icthlarin(익스라린)이요! Amascut(아마스컷)이 다시 제 길을 찾도록 도울 수 있는 이가 있다면, 바로 그분이에요!

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 지금까지는 별로 도움이 된 것 같지 않은데요.

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: Icthlarin(익스라린)이 할 수 있는 일엔 한계가 있네. 망자를 돌보는 의무에 끊임없이 매달려야 하거든.

english: Not to mention the pact!
Pact?
That is not for us to discuss.
Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 아, 맞다, 미안해요. 다른 얘기를 하는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Are you actually gods?
If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 이 땅의 시민에게 묻는다면, 아마 그렇다고 대답하겠지.

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 그렇소, 하지만 그게 온전히 옳은 답은 아니오.

english: How so?
Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: Tumeken(투메켄) 님이 자신의 신성한 정수로 우리를 만드셨어요! 우리 하나하나가 그분의 일부인 셈이죠!

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 하지만 그렇다고 우리가 신이 되는 것은 아니오. 우리 힘이 크다고는 하나, 진정한 신에 비하면 보잘것없소. 그래서 신들은 떠났고, 우리는 남은 것이오.

english: So what are you really?
You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 우리를 Avatars of Tumeken(투메켄의 화신들)이라 부르는 이들도 있지. 우리도 그편이 더 어울리는 칭호라고 생각하네.

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 그 둘도 Tumeken(투메켄) 님이 만드셨어요. 다른 점이라면, 그 둘에게는 Elidinis(엘리디니스) 님의 신성한 정수도 깃들어 있어서 훨씬 더 강하다는 거예요!

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 하지만 다시 말하건대, 그들도 진정한 신은 아니오.

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: Amascut(아마스컷)은 오늘 그걸 바꾸길 바랐지만, 자네가 그 계획을 보기 좋게 박살 내 줬지!

english: So what happens now?
We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 우리는 Avatars of Tumeken(투메켄의 화신들)이오. Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)은 너무 오랫동안 인도자 없이 지내 왔소. 이제 그것을 바로잡을 때요.

english: We're going to get started right away!
But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 하지만 걱정 말게, Amascut(아마스컷)과의 싸움을 놓칠 생각은 없으니. 그날이 오면 자네도 우리 곁에 함께 서 주길 바라네.

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 허나 지금은 이것으로 작별이오. 다시 만납시다, 인간이여.

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
The avatars depart.
You're back!
If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
I have a question for Apmeken.
What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: Menaphite Pantheon(메나파이트 만신전)에서 당신은 어떤 역할을 맡고 있어요?

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 사막에는 왜 원숭이나 유인원이 더 많지 않아요?

english: Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'll be back soon.
I have a question for Crondis.
Why are crocodiles so rude?
I have a question for Het.
Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 다른 이들보다 따르는 신도가 더 많아요?

english: I have a question for all of you.
What will happen with Amascut?
Are you actually gods?
So what happens now?
How's your magic coming along?
I'm practicing and slowly getting better.
Good, good.
Help! Help!
What has happened here?
We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: 여기서 멀지 않은 섬에서 열리는 저택 파티에 초대받았어요... 뭔가 꺼림칙했지만 그래도 갔죠...

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: 저택은 꽤 으스스했지만 모든 게 순조로웠어요, 다들 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있었고요...

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
I... I tried to save her...
Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: Hewey(휴이)가 시간을 벌어 준 덕분에 낡은 boat(배)를 찾을 수 있었어요. 그를 데리러 돌아갔지만 이미 늦었죠. 그가 버티지 못할까 봐 무서워요.

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: 뭐라도 해 주세요... 그들이 이대로 빠져나가게 둘 순 없어요!

english: What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved in this!
That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: 그 미치광이가 아직 어딘가에서 활개 치고 있어요, 꼭 심판을 받게 해 주세요.

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: 저희가 타고 도망친 boat(배)가 바로 저기 있어요, 그걸 타고 섬으로 가면 돼요.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 좋아요, 제가 할 수 있는 걸 해 볼게요.

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 네 게임에서 네가 진 거다. 이제 그 가면 아래에 누가 있는지 볼 차례야!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 플레이어가 살인마의 가면을 벗기자, 범인은 Abigale(애비게일)로 드러난다.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 안 돼! 너였어!? 대체 왜!? 어떻게 친구들을 전부 죽일 수가 있어!? 그러면서 왜 나한테 그들을 도와 달라고 애원한 거야!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 잘난 척은. 늘 모든 게 너 중심으로 돌아가는 데 익숙하지. 네가 세상을 구하는 데 말이야.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 모험가들! 너흰 다 똑같아. 항상 모든 게 너희 중심이어야 하지.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 당연히 모르겠지! 넌 너 자신밖에 못 보니까!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 믿기 힘들겠지만... 나도 한때는 너 같았어.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 곤경에 빠진 아가씨 소문을 들으면 도우러 달려갔지. 내 순간을 갖기 위해서. 단 한 번이라도 내가 영웅이 되기 위해서.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 그런데 너! 너랑 그 빌어먹을 모험가 놈들 전부! 내가 도우러 갈 때마다 이미 늦어 있었어. 위기 해결. 재앙 모면. 보상 수령. 매번 너희 모험가들이 내 순간을 훔쳐 갔다고!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 이번엔 전부 내 거야! 내가 이 쇼의 주인공이라고! 나, 나, 나, 나, 나!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 그것도 이제 끝이야. 쇼는 막을 내렸고, 커튼콜은 없을 거다.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 문 근처 벽장에서 또 다른 살인마가 걸어 나온다.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 당연하지. 좋은 공연엔 좋은 조연이 필요한 법이니까. 자, 가면을 벗어, 자기야. 무대 인사를 해. 그럴 자격 있잖아.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 살인마가 스스로 가면을 벗자, 범인은 Hewey(휴이)로 드러난다.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 너였어!? 어떻게!? 내가 봤을 땐 거의 죽어 가고 있었잖아! 상처도 똑똑히 봤다고!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 아니, 네가 본 건 우리가 보여 주고 싶었던 것뿐이야. 내 입으로 말하긴 뭐하지만, 실로 명연기였지.

english: But what is in this for you?
Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 누구나 각광받는 걸 좋아하지. 그리고 그걸 나눌 상대로 내 사랑 Abigale(애비게일)보다 나은 사람이 어디 있겠어.

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 그럴지도 모르지. 하지만 나도 스포트라이트를 받아 마땅한데 다시 그늘 속으로 밀려날 이유는 없었어!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: 그래, 우리가 스포트라이트를 받아 마땅한데 말이야.

english: And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)는 오늘 밤과 내가 여기서 한 일을 영원히 기억할 거야.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 조용히 해, Hewey(휴이)! 지금은 내 순간이야!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 아니, 이건 우리의 순간이어야 해! 전부 너만을 위한 것도 아니라고! 우린 함께한 거잖아!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 다 망치지 마, Hewey(휴이)! 이걸 위해 얼마나 애썼는데, 네가 빼앗아 가게 두지 않을 거야!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 나도 밀려날 생각은 없어, 우린 동등한 입장으로 함께한 거라고!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 우린 동등했던 적 없어! 네가 어떻게 감히 나랑 비교가 돼!?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
translation: 안 돼...안 돼... 내가 무슨 짓을!?

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 이렇게 될 게 아니었는데... 네가 내 순간을 그냥 두지 못해서 그래. 왜 그랬어, Hewey(휴이), 왜!? 사랑했는데...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
What has happened here?
What do you want me to do?
I'm not getting involved.
Welcome to Hickton's Archery Store. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: Hickton's Archery Store(힉턴의 궁술 상점)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 제 물건들 좀 보시겠어요?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 그 망토에 대해 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이죠! Skillcape(스킬 망토)는 성취의 상징이에요. 스킬을 완전히 터득해 99레벨에 도달한 사람만이 손에 넣고 그 혜택을 누릴 수 있죠.

english: The Cape of Fletching can be searched for a mithril grapple and crossbow three times every day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Cape of Fletching(활 제작 망토)는 하루에 세 번 뒤져서 mithril grapple(미스릴 그래플)과 crossbow(석궁)을 얻을 수 있어요. 그 밖에 더 도와드릴 게 있나요?

english: No thank you.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 아뇨, 전 가까이서 두들겨 패는 쪽이 좋아요.

english: I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 그 망토에 대해 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
Yes, please.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 아뇨, 전 가까이서 두들겨 패는 쪽이 좋아요.

english: Hey, down there! What is it?
Why are you here?
For the dragons, of course! I've always wanted to slay dragons. I've found they're a bit tough, though, even with all this kit I've got, but I'll slay them one day.
translation: 당연히 드래곤 때문이죠! 늘 드래곤을 처치해 보고 싶었거든요. 장비를 이렇게 잔뜩 갖췄는데도 좀 버겁더라고요. 그래도 언젠간 처치하고 말 거예요.

english: My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: 제 사촌 동생이 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)거든요, 운도 좋은 애죠. 하지만 언젠가 저도 위대한 드래곤 사냥꾼이 되면, 그런 일자리를 저한테도 줄 거예요.

english: My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
translation: 제 남동생이 최근에 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 됐어요. 그 자리는 원래 제 거였어야 했는데 - 그 녀석은 꼬맹이 철부지라고요! 하지만 언젠가 저도 위대한 드래곤 사냥꾼이 되면, 그런 일자리를 저한테도 줄 거예요.

english: Can I kill the dragons in here?
Yes, certainly, since you've been assigned to do so.
No, you haven't got an assignment to slay these dragons. Go and train somewhere else.
translation: 아뇨, 이 드래곤들을 처치하라는 임무를 받지 않으셨잖아요. 다른 데 가서 수련하세요.

english: I'll be off.
I'm sure that's not what you're meant to be slaying.
translation: 그건 분명 당신이 처치해야 할 대상이 아닐 텐데요.

english: Why are you here?
Can I kill the dragons in here?
I'll be off.
Many greetings. Welcome to our fair island.
translation: 반갑습니다. 우리의 아름다운 섬에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!
translation: 즐겁게 머무르십시오. 영혼이 고양되는 시간이 되기를!

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)께서 보내신 메시지를 전하러 왔어요.

english: How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!
translation: 이 외딴 섬까지 메시지를 전해 주시다니 참으로 친절하시군요!

english: I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.
translation: 가진 재물은 많지 않습니다만, 수고하신 대가로 coins(코인)을 조금 드릴 수는 있습니다.

english: In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...
Here, let me give you some herbs.
The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 이 섬 아래에 사는 짐승들은 죽을 때 가끔 보석을 떨어뜨립니다. 제 감사의 표시로 이것을 받아 주십시오.

english: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?
translation: 안녕하세요, 혹시 이것 좀 얼른 축복해 주실 수 있나요?

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
translation: 조금 이상한 부탁이지만, 해가 될 것 같지는 않군요... 잠깐만요... 그거 피 아닙니까?

english: Erm... yes...
Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???
translation: 대체 왜 남의 피가 가득 든 pot(단지)를 축복해 달라는 겁니까???

english: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!
translation: 아, 걱정 마세요. '남의' 피가 아니라 제 피예요!

english: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.
translation: 그... 그렇군요... 뭐, 별난 일이긴 하지만 해가 될 것 같지는 않습니다. 이걸 받고, Saradomin(사라도민)과 함께 평화로이 걸으십시오.

english: If the player receives an uncut emerald:
translation: 플레이어가 uncut emerald(미가공 에메랄드)를 받은 경우:

english: If the player receives an uncut diamond:
translation: 플레이어가 uncut diamond(미가공 다이아몬드)를 받은 경우:

english: If the player receives an uncut red topaz:
translation: 플레이어가 uncut red topaz(미가공 붉은 토파즈)를 받은 경우:

english: If the player receives an uncut sapphire:
translation: 플레이어가 uncut sapphire(미가공 사파이어)를 받은 경우:

english: Hello again. How can I help you?
How are things going here?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: 죽은 자들의 도시에 조금씩 생기가 돌아오고 있습니다. Temple of the Lesser Gods(하급 신들의 신전) 아래의 bank(은행)이 복구되었고, 상인들도 여럿 다시 가판을 열었지요.

english: What about the plagues?
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: 진전이 있습니다. 시민들이 돌아온 덕분에 마침내 마을을 가득 메웠던 개구리와 메뚜기를 처리할 만큼 사람이 모였지요.

english: We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
translation: 다시 돌아올까 걱정했지만, 어쩌면 그것들을 보낸 신이 누구든 그 노여움을 달래는 데 성공했는지도 모릅니다.

english: The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: 병든 소들도 처리했습니다. 이제 남은 역병은 이 짜증스러운 부스럼뿐입니다. 그래도 전염되지 않는다는 게 다행이지요.

english: Any sign of Menaphos opening up again?
translation: Menaphos(메나포스)가 다시 문을 열 기미는 있나요?

english: They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
translation: 그들은 역병이 모두 사라질 때까지 도시를 닫아 두어야 한다고 완강합니다. 부스럼을 없애기 전까지는 그들이 우리에게도, 다른 누구에게도 성문을 열어 줄 것 같지 않군요.

english: Well at least things are moving in the right direction.
translation: 그래도 상황이 좋은 쪽으로 흘러가고 있네요.

english: Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 그렇습니다. 그럼, 제가 더 해 드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: Could I have another lamp?
translation: lamp(등불)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I'm afraid I only had the one.
No. I should get going.
Hello again.
Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
translation: 훌륭합니다! 죽은 자들의 도시가 완전히 되살아났습니다. 모두 당신 덕분입니다!

english: Well I'm happy to have helped. Any news from Menaphos?
translation: 도움이 됐다니 기뻐요. Menaphos(메나포스)에서 소식은 있나요?

english: They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
translation: 계속 준비 중이라고 합니다. 시간은 좀 걸리겠지만, 머지않아 도시가 다시 열릴 겁니다.

english: Great!
Could I have another circlet?
translation: circlet(서클릿)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
Here you go.
You don't seem to have enough money for it.
Oh...
That's too much.
Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
I should get going.
Until next time.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
translation: 이봐요, 이봐요, 이봐요! 맙소사, Icthlarin(익스라린)이시여, 지금 대체 뭘 하시는 겁니까?

english: I thought this acne potion might clear up your spots.
translation: 이 acne potion(여드름 물약)이면 뾰루지가 좀 가라앉을까 해서요.

english: All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
translation: 그 물약을 제게 부어 봤자 제 멋진 예복만 망칠 뿐입니다.

english: Sorry, I was just trying to help.
Hey there. I was wondering if you could do me a favour?
translation: 안녕하세요. 혹시 부탁 하나 들어주실 수 있나요?

english: Oh? What kind of favour?
I know cremation isn't your way, but is there anything you could do with these ashes?
translation: 화장이 이곳 방식이 아니라는 건 알지만, 이 ashes(재)로 뭔가 해 주실 수 있는 게 있을까요?

english: Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
translation: 말씀하신 대로 저희 방식은 아닙니다. 그래도 저희를 위해 해 주신 일을 생각하면 기꺼이 해 보겠습니다.

english: That's all I ask. Thank you.
Could I have another lamp?
translation: lamp(등불)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: No. I should get going.
How are things going here?
Could I have another circlet?
translation: circlet(서클릿)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Here you go.
That's too much.
I should get going.
Hello again.
Hello, adventurer. Thank you for freeing me from the Devourer. I would be alone now. Scabaras teaches us to remain isolated, and I have much to think about.
translation: 안녕하십니까, 모험가여. Devourer(포식자)에게서 저를 풀어 주셔서 감사합니다. 이제는 홀로 있고 싶습니다. Scabaras(스카바라스)께서는 홀로 지내라 가르치시며, 저는 생각할 것이 많습니다.

english: Adventurer... what is this? It looks like a scarab egg, but is unlike any I've seen before.
translation: 모험가여... 이것은 무엇입니까? scarab egg(스카라브 알)처럼 보이지만, 이제껏 본 어떤 알과도 다르군요.

english: To be honest, I'm not sure, but I think you should have it. It has more hope of hatching with you than with me.
translation: 솔직히 저도 잘 모르겠지만, 이건 당신이 가져야 할 것 같아요. 저보다는 당신에게 있을 때 부화할 가능성이 더 클 테니까요.

english: Thank you, adventurer. I know not what will come of this, but I feel you have done the right thing. May Scabaras continue to guide you.
translation: 고맙습니다, 모험가여. 이것이 어떤 결과를 낳을지는 모르나, 당신이 옳은 일을 했다고 느낍니다. Scabaras(스카바라스)께서 앞으로도 당신을 인도하시기를.

english: Intruder! You are not welcome here!
Fear not! I am here to rescue you!
Kill him!
Wait! Majaan, Manand...
Silence! Champion, protect your High Priest!
Fine. We'll do it your way.
Stay back!
Majaan, Manand, Almuk.
Argh!
What... What happened?
It's alright. You were being controlled by Amascut, but you're free now.
translation: 괜찮아요. Amascut(아마스컷)에게 조종당하고 있었지만, 이제 자유예요.

english: I... I don't remember.
I've been in your position. Don't worry, your memories will come back in time. Familiar places and objects can help them come back faster.
translation: 저도 그런 처지였던 적이 있어요. 걱정 마세요, 기억은 시간이 지나면 돌아올 거예요. 익숙한 장소나 물건이 기억을 더 빨리 되살려 줄 수 있어요.

english: This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...
translation: 이 방은 낯이 익군요... 둘러보니 무언가가 꿈틀대는 느낌이 듭니다...

english: Yes, I can see it now! There are a few gaps, but it's all coming back to me. Thank you, adventurer.
translation: 그래요, 이제 보입니다! 빈 곳이 조금 있긴 하지만, 모든 것이 되살아나고 있습니다. 고맙습니다, 모험가여.

english: There is much for me to set right. We have made some terrible mistakes.
translation: 제가 바로잡아야 할 일이 많습니다. 저희는 끔찍한 실수를 저질렀습니다.

english: I know the feeling. What did she have you do?
translation: 그 기분 알아요. 그녀가 당신에게 무슨 일을 시켰죠?

english: Many things. I have been under her control my whole life. It was the same for my predecessor, and her predecessor as well. We were all slaves to the Devourer, even our lord himself.
translation: 많은 일을요. 저는 평생 그녀의 지배를 받아 왔습니다. 제 전임자도, 그 전임자의 전임자도 마찬가지였지요. 저희 모두가 Devourer(포식자)의 노예였습니다. 저희가 섬기는 그분조차도요.

english: She controls Scabaras?
Yes. She used him as her puppet for centuries, but now she has a new plan for him.
translation: 그렇습니다. 그녀는 수 세기 동안 그분을 꼭두각시로 부렸지만, 이제는 그분을 두고 새로운 계획을 꾸미고 있습니다.

english: What new plan?
I don't know. She took him into some tomb, along with the others.
translation: 모르겠습니다. 그녀는 그분을 다른 이들과 함께 어느 무덤으로 데려갔습니다.

english: Osmumten's tomb. Who are these others you speak of?
translation: Osmumten(오스뭄텐)의 무덤이군요. 말씀하신 다른 이들은 누구죠?

english: Apmeken, Crondis and Het. The other avatars of Tumeken.
translation: Apmeken(앱메켄), Crondis(크론디스), 그리고 Het(헤트). Tumeken(투메켄)의 다른 화신들입니다.

english: She has them all?
She does. We helped her capture them. It took many lifetimes, but she was able to fool them all.
translation: 그렇습니다. 저희가 그들을 붙잡는 일을 도왔지요. 여러 생애가 걸렸지만, 그녀는 결국 그들 모두를 속여 넘겼습니다.

english: This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.
translation: 좋지 않네요. 그 무덤에는 존재들 사이에서 신성한 힘을 옮길 수 있는 무기들이 있어요. 그녀는 그걸 하급 신들에게 쓰려는 게 틀림없어요.

english: The four of them all came from Tumeken himself. Their power is his power. If she claims that power as her own, she will become a true goddess...
translation: 그 넷은 모두 Tumeken(투메켄) 그분에게서 나왔습니다. 그들의 힘이 곧 그분의 힘이지요. 그녀가 그 힘을 제 것으로 삼는다면, 진정한 여신이 될 것입니다...

english: Don't worry, I'll make sure that doesn't happen.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 그런 일은 없게 할게요.

english: How can you hope to withstand her power?
translation: 대체 어떻게 그녀의 힘을 견뎌 낼 생각이십니까?

english: I'll find a way. Do you have any other information that can help me?
translation: 방법을 찾을 거예요. 저를 도울 만한 다른 정보는 없나요?

english: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.
translation: Devourer(포식자)에게 넘어간 건 저희만이 아닙니다. 그녀는 Menaphos(메나포스)의 Pharaoh Kemesis(파라오 케메시스)도 지배하고 있습니다.

english: We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?
translation: 그럴까 봐 걱정했어요. 그녀가 그에게서 뭘 원하는지 아세요?

english: She needed control over the city, but she kept the reason a secret. She even had us release locusts and frogs into Sophanem so she could have Menaphos locked down.
translation: 그녀는 도시를 장악해야 했지만, 그 이유는 비밀로 했습니다. 심지어 Menaphos(메나포스)를 봉쇄시키려고 저희에게 Sophanem(소파넴)에 메뚜기와 개구리를 풀게 하기까지 했지요.

english: You caused the plagues? The cows and the pox as well?
We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.
translation: 소들에게 독을 푼 것도 저희가 맞습니다. 하지만 그 부스럼에 대해서는 아무것도 모릅니다.

english: Hmm... what will you do now?
I fear many of my people are forever lost, but I will save as many as I can. Together, we will reform the Sect of Scabaras, and right the wrongs of the Devourer.
translation: 제 동족 중 많은 이가 영영 돌아오지 못할까 두렵지만, 구할 수 있는 만큼은 구하겠습니다. 함께 Sect of Scabaras(스카바라스 교단)을 다시 세우고, Devourer(포식자)가 저지른 잘못을 바로잡을 것입니다.

english: So you'll help me fight her?
translation: 그럼 그녀와 싸우는 걸 도와주시는 건가요?

english: In our own way. Before the Devourer, we were an isolated people, just as Scabaras taught us to be. We will go back to that way of life.
translation: 저희 나름의 방식으로요. Devourer(포식자) 이전에 저희는 Scabaras(스카바라스)께서 가르치신 대로 세상과 떨어져 사는 민족이었습니다. 저희는 그 삶으로 돌아갈 것입니다.

english: We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.
translation: 눈에 띄지는 않겠지만, 저희는 그곳에 있을 것입니다. Devourer(포식자)의 세력이 나타나는 곳이라면 어디서든 맞서 싸우면서요.

english: Good to hear. Now, I'd better head over to Nardah. I have a friend there who needs to hear about all of this.
translation: 든든하네요. 그럼 전 Nardah(나르다)로 가 봐야겠어요. 그곳에 이 모든 걸 들어야 할 친구가 있거든요.

english: Good luck in your fight, adventurer. May Scabaras guide you.
translation: 싸움에 행운이 있기를, 모험가여. Scabaras(스카바라스)께서 당신을 인도하시기를.

english: You offered yourself to Zulrah as a sacrifice, yet here you stand before me. Did Zulrah reject you?
translation: 너는 스스로를 Zulrah(줄라)께 제물로 바쳤건만, 어찌 이렇게 내 앞에 서 있느냐. 줄라께서 너를 거부하셨느냐?

english: I kinda left the shrine.
Perhaps you should try offering yourself again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)께서 노하시기 전에 다시 스스로를 바쳐 보는 것이 좋겠구나.

english: I killed Zulrah.
Very funny, human, but I find that hard to believe. Go and offer yourself as a sacrifice again, before the mighty Zulrah grows impatient.
translation: 참 재미있구나, 인간. 하지만 믿기 어렵군. 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)께서 노하시기 전에 가서 다시 제물로 스스로를 바쳐라.

english: Have you any advice for surviving against Zulrah?
translation: Zulrah(줄라)를 상대로 살아남을 만한 요령이 있을까요?

english: I think you have misunderstood the nature of the sacrifice, human. Never mind, the mighty Zulrah will make the matter clear to you.
translation: 제물이라는 것의 본질을 오해한 모양이구나, 인간. 상관없다. 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)께서 몸소 깨우쳐 주실 테니.

english: Tell me about Zulrah.
Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homage.
