translation: 오, 또 오셨네요. 광석 좀 보실래요?

english: I'll have a look.
Not right now.
I'll have a look.
Not right now.
Caw!
Are you a bird?
Roar!
A dragon?
Hiss!
A snake?
Roar! Caw! Hiss!
A dragon snake bird?
*bird noises*
Aren't you a cute litle thing.
*screeches*
My ears!
Hello there traveller. Would you like some groceries? I have a large selection.
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 식료품 좀 사실래요? 물건이 아주 많아요.

english: No thank you.
No problem.
I'll have a look.
Great stuff.
No thank you.
I'll have a look.
Hudon can't hear you because of the noise of the waterfall. Perhaps the acoustics would be better from that island?
translation: 폭포 소리 때문에 Hudon(후돈)은 당신 말을 듣지 못한다. 저 섬에서라면 소리가 더 잘 들리지 않을까?

english: Hello son, are you okay? You need help?
It looks like you need the help.
Your mum sent me to find you.
translation: 너희 엄마가 너 찾아오라고 날 보내셨어.

english: Don't play nice with me, I know you're looking for the treasure too.
translation: 착한 척하지 마. 너도 보물 찾고 있는 거 다 알아.

english: Where is this treasure you talk of?
translation: 네가 말하는 그 보물은 어디 있는데?

english: Just because I'm small doesn't mean I'm dumb! If I told you, you would take it all for yourself.
translation: 내가 작다고 바보인 줄 알아! 말해 주면 너 혼자 다 가져갈 거잖아.

english: Maybe I could help.
I'm fine alone.
Hmm... I wonder what this treasure is.
So you're still here.
I'll find that treasure soon, just you wait and see.
translation: 곧 그 보물을 찾고 말 거야. 두고 봐.

english: Hello Hudon.
Oh it's you, trying to find my treasure again are you?
translation: 아, 너구나. 또 내 보물 찾으러 온 거지?

english: I didn't know it belonged to you.
It will do when I find it. I just need to get into this blasted waterfall I've been washed downstream three times already.
translation: 내가 찾으면 내 거야. 이 망할 폭포 안으로 들어가기만 하면 되는데, 벌써 세 번이나 하류로 떠내려갔어.

english: How are you doing, Hudon?
No luck yet I'm afraid.
Me neither, but I don't give up easily.
translation: 나도 아직이야. 하지만 난 쉽게 포기 안 해.

english: Hello again.
You stole my treasure. I saw you!
translation: 네가 내 보물 훔쳤지. 내가 다 봤어!

english: I'll make sure it goes to a good cause.
Hmmmm!
Got anymore *hic* wine?
Ummm... No, sorry. Looks like you've had enough anyway.
translation: 음... 아뇨, 미안해요. 어차피 이미 충분히 드신 것 같은데요.

english: Well, I *hic* ...disagree.
Why are you drinking so much? To forget?
translation: 왜 그렇게 많이 마셔요? 잊고 싶은 거라도 있어요?

english: Nope, tastes mighty fine! Any chance you *hic* know where Horses go?
translation: 아니, 맛이 끝내주거든! 혹시 *딸꾹* 말들이 어디로 갔는지 알아?

english: The what?
The Horses!
Ah, the 'Horses'... How unfortunate, the wine has made you delirious. I've no idea what a Horse is my friend.
translation: 아, '말'이요... 안됐네요, 포도주 때문에 정신이 혼미하신가 봐요. 말이 뭔지 저는 전혀 모르겠어요, 친구.

english: Oh.
You know this *hic* place was built twice?
translation: 이곳이 *딸꾹* 두 번 지어졌다는 거 알아?

english: Ummm... How come?
Storm swept in and erased it, had to be built again from scratch.
translation: 폭풍이 몰아쳐서 싹 쓸어 가 버렸지. 처음부터 다시 지어야 했어.

english: Huh, what a shame.
They did a better job second time round, but the builder sure was annoyed.
translation: 두 번째엔 더 잘 지었는데, 건축가가 아주 단단히 열받았더라고.

english: Who was the builder?
Some *hic* Westener.
Got any *hic* wine?
No, sorry. Do you know of any caves around here?
translation: 아뇨, 미안해요. 혹시 이 근처에 동굴 같은 거 아세요?

english: *hic* Crabclaw Caves?
Err maybe?
Big set of caves east *hic* of here.
That might be them. Thank you.
No *hic* problem. Got *hic* any wine?
Yes? Can I help you?
What do you have for sale?
Only the finest herbal supplies.
No thanks.
Move along then.
What do you have for sale?
No thanks.
Hello.
What are you doing in our village, outlander?
Nothing much.
Bah! Go down to the longhall, and there you will find excitement aplenty! Our finest warrior, Gunthor the Brave, will give you a rousing welcome!
translation: 흥! longhall(롱홀)로 내려가 보거라. 그곳에 가면 흥미진진한 일이 넘쳐날 것이다! 우리의 가장 뛰어난 전사, Gunthor the Brave(용감한 군토르)께서 너를 성대하게 맞아 주실 것이다!

english: I'll bear it in mind.
I'm exploring.
Bah! You cannot hope to learn anything of us just by strolling through our village! We are an ancient tribe, our ways date back to the time before Avarrocka was founded!
translation: 흥! 마을을 어슬렁거리기만 해서는 우리에 대해 아무것도 알 수 없다! 우리는 오랜 부족이다. 우리의 방식은 Avarrocka(아바로카)가 세워지기 전 시대까지 거슬러 올라간다!

english: Would you care to tell me more?
Oh? You are not so ignorant as I thought. Very well, I shall speak of our tribe...
translation: 오? 생각만큼 무지하지는 않구나. 좋다, 우리 부족에 대해 이야기해 주마...

english: Our elders remember that about a century ago we were living in the lands far to the west. We were a large nomadic mountain tribe, settling wherever there was food, moving on when it had run out. As the tribe
translation: 원로들의 기억으로는, 한 세기쯤 전 우리는 머나먼 서쪽 땅에 살았다. 우리는 거대한 산악 유목 부족이었고, 먹을 것이 있는 곳이면 어디든 자리를 잡았다가 바닥나면 떠났다. 부족이

english: grew larger, it was hard to find enough food for everyone, and we were forced to shift our camp more and more often. In time, a warrior called Gunnar took his friends and their families and left the larger tribe,
translation: 커질수록 모두가 먹을 만큼의 식량을 찾기가 어려워졌고, 우리는 점점 더 자주 야영지를 옮겨야 했다. 그러다 Gunnar(군나르)라는 전사가 친구들과 그 가족들을 데리고 큰 부족을 떠나

english: moving south in search of new places. They eventually settled here and built this village, finding that the old nomadic traditions were no longer needed.
translation: 새로운 터전을 찾아 남쪽으로 향했다. 그들은 마침내 이곳에 정착해 이 마을을 세웠고, 옛 유목 전통이 더는 필요 없다는 것을 깨달았다.

english: Our current chieftain, Gunthor the Brave, is a direct- line descendent of Gunnar.
translation: 지금의 족장, Gunthor the Brave(용감한 군토르)께서는 Gunnar(군나르)의 직계 후손이시다.

english: However, our ways have changed little in the last century. Although more and more people use magical powers, we do not believe it is wise to take upon oneself the power of the gods in this way. To this day, we fight
translation: 하지만 우리의 방식은 지난 한 세기 동안 거의 변하지 않았다. 마법의 힘을 쓰는 이들이 점점 늘고 있지만, 우리는 그렇게 신들의 힘을 제 것으로 삼는 것이 현명하다고 여기지 않는다. 오늘날까지도 우리는

english: with the mighty sword, the vicious axe and the swift arrow on the wind. Some of our young, wishing to try so-called 'civilisation' and the softness of city life, abandon the tribe and move to the cities. It is sad to
translation: 강력한 검, 사나운 도끼, 바람을 가르는 날랜 화살로 싸운다. 젊은이들 중에는 이른바 '문명'과 안락한 도시 생활을 맛보고 싶어 부족을 버리고 도시로 떠나는 이들도 있다. 그들이 떠나는 것을 보는 건

english: see them go, but we do not prevent them; we live here in our village because we love this life - we do not force it on those whom it does not suit.
translation: 슬프지만, 막지는 않는다. 우리가 이 마을에 사는 건 이 삶을 사랑하기 때문이다. 이 삶이 맞지 않는 이들에게까지 강요하지는 않는다.

english: There, I have said enough.
Thank you.
You look like a load of primitive savages.
And you look like an arrogant fool. And you smell like a raccoon's bottom.
translation: 그러는 너는 오만한 바보처럼 보이는구나. 게다가 너구리 엉덩이 냄새까지 나는군.

english: I'm bored.
I came to kill you all!
Ho ho! Brave words indeed from an outerlander! Go down to the longhall and try it!
translation: 하하! 이방인 주제에 참으로 용감한 말이로구나! longhall(롱홀)로 내려가서 어디 해 보거라!

english: Well done.
You've [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 축하한다! [found a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: Nothing much.
I'm exploring.
Tell me about your tribe.
You look like a load of primitive savages.
I'm bored.
I came to kill you all!
Whoah there, stranger, careful where you're walking. I almost clobbered you there; thought you were a larupia or something.
translation: 워워, 거기 낯선 양반, 발밑 조심해요. 하마터면 한 대 칠 뻔했잖아요. larupia(라루피아)나 뭐 그런 건 줄 알았지 뭐예요.

english: What are you doing here?
Me? Oh, I'm just having some fun, capturing wild animals, living on the edge, stuff like that.
translation: 나요? 아, 그냥 재미 좀 보는 중이에요. 야생 동물도 잡고, 아슬아슬하게 살고, 뭐 그런 거요.

english: Hey, want me to teach you how to catch the critters around here? Ain't come across anything yet that I couldn't capture.
translation: 있잖아요, 이 근처 짐승들 잡는 법 가르쳐 줄까요? 아직까지 내가 못 잡은 녀석은 하나도 없었거든요.

english: Ok, where's a good place to start?

Your easiest bet around here is probably to go for some of the birds. Go for the crimson swifts; they're the bright red ones that hang around near the coast. They're as obliging as can be, or maybe they're just
translation: 이 근처에서 제일 쉬운 건 아마 새일 거예요. crimson swift(진홍 칼새)를 노려 봐요. 해안 근처에 몰려다니는 새빨간 녀석들이에요. 그렇게 고분고분할 수가 없다니까요. 아니면 그냥

english: plain dumb, but either way they just seem to throw themselves into traps half the time.
translation: 멍청한 건지도 모르지만, 어느 쪽이든 절반은 제 발로 덫에 뛰어드는 것 같아요.

english: What sort of traps should I use?
Just use a standard bird snare and you'll be fine. You can get them in any decent shop that sells Hunter gear.
translation: 그냥 평범한 bird snare(새 올무)를 쓰면 돼요. Hunter(사냥) 장비를 파는 웬만한 가게라면 어디서든 구할 수 있어요.

english: How do they work, then?

Well, they're kind of sneaky, really. You've got a tall post with what appears to be a little perch sticking out the side. Now, the bird will see this as somewhere to sit, but the perch is actually rigged such that when the bird
translation: 음, 사실 좀 교활한 물건이에요. 높은 기둥에 작은 횃대처럼 보이는 게 옆으로 튀어나와 있거든요. 새는 그걸 앉을 자리로 보는데, 사실 그 횃대는 새가

english: lands on it, it'll drop away.
Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat huh?
translation: 게다가 횃대가 떨어지면서 올가미가 풀려 새 발을 조여서 붙잡아요. 기발하죠?

english: So, was there anything else you wanted to ask about?
translation: 자, 그 밖에 물어보고 싶은 거 있어요?

english: Thanks for your help.
Not a problem, any time.
What sort of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 이 근처에서는 뭘 잡을 수 있나요?

english: What're you interested in? You've got anything from birds for beginners up to larupias for the pros, not to mention weasels, butterflies, barb-tails and chinchompas.
translation: 뭐에 관심 있어요? 초보자용 새부터 고수용 larupia(라루피아)까지 다 있어요. 족제비, 나비, barb-tail(가시꼬리), chinchompa(친촘파)는 말할 것도 없고요.

english: How would I go about catching birds?
There are a couple of varieties that you can try your hand at catching around here, but the technique for both is essentially the same. You need to set up a bird snare.
translation: 이 근처에서 잡아 볼 만한 새가 몇 종류 있는데, 잡는 기술은 둘 다 거의 같아요. bird snare(새 올무)를 설치하면 돼요.

english: Further, as the perch drops, it releases a noose that tightens around the bird's feet and captures it. Neat, huh?
translation: 게다가 횃대가 떨어지면서 올가미가 풀려 새 발을 조여서 붙잡아요. 기발하죠?

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?

Not with large quantities of rice and treacle as many people would have you believe. Besides, the Feldip weasel isn't technically a weasel, but, as is typical with any sort of colloquial name, it's been called that often enough
translation: 사람들이 흔히 말하는 것처럼 쌀이랑 당밀을 잔뜩 쓰는 건 아니에요. 게다가 Feldip weasel(펠딥 족제비)는 엄밀히 말하면 족제비도 아니에요. 그런데 속칭이 다 그렇듯이, 하도 그렇게 불러 대다 보니

english: now that it's stuck.
Anyway, the Feldip weasel's main survival technique is in hiding; other than that, it's pretty stupid. So, if you can actually find one, then you've probably got a fairly good chance of catching one.
translation: 아무튼, Feldip weasel(펠딥 족제비)의 주된 생존 기술은 숨는 거예요. 그것 말고는 꽤 멍청하죠. 그러니까 일단 찾기만 하면 잡을 확률은 꽤 높을 거예요.

english: And how would I actually go about finding one?
The best place to start would probably be just south of here. You'll find lots of kebbit burrows there. Take a close look at some of them, follow the trails and you can't go far wrong.
translation: 아마 여기서 바로 남쪽부터 시작하는 게 제일 좋을 거예요. kebbit(케빗) 굴이 잔뜩 있거든요. 굴 몇 개를 자세히 살펴보고 흔적을 따라가면 크게 틀릴 일은 없어요.

english: Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 그런데 larupia(라루피아)를 그렇게 좋아하시는 것 같으니까...

english: Ah yes, yes, larupias are fun; just think of them as big kittens.
translation: 아, 맞아요, 맞아요, larupia(라루피아)는 재밌죠. 그냥 커다란 새끼 고양이라고 생각하면 돼요.

english: Uh huh, big kittens that just want to rip your throat out!
translation: 아, 네, 목을 물어뜯고 싶어 안달 난 커다란 새끼 고양이요!

english: Indeed, and you can use this to your advantage. If a larupia is keen to chase you then let it; that way you can happily lead it straight into your trap without any fuss or waiting around.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 그리고 그걸 역이용할 수 있어요. larupia(라루피아)가 쫓아오고 싶어 하면 그냥 쫓아오게 둬요. 그러면 괜히 애쓰거나 기다릴 필요 없이 덫으로 곧장 유인할 수 있거든요.

english: Into what sort of trap should I lead it?
A pit trap should do you. There are some appropriate pits to the east of here that you can use. Cover one with a few logs and branches, tease the kitty and then lead it to the pit. Simple.
translation: pit trap(함정 구덩이)이면 될 거예요. 여기서 동쪽에 쓸 만한 구덩이가 몇 개 있어요. 하나를 통나무와 나뭇가지로 덮고, 야옹이를 약 올린 다음 구덩이로 유인하면 돼요. 간단하죠.

english: Barb-tails sound interesting.

They do sound interesting, don't they? Unfortunately, they're actually just another type of kebbit; those things get everywhere. Still, the tails of these particular kebbits can be useful for fishing.
translation: 이름은 재밌게 들리죠? 안타깝게도 사실은 그냥 kebbit(케빗)의 한 종류예요. 그 녀석들은 어딜 가나 있다니까요. 그래도 이 케빗들 꼬리는 낚시에 쓸모가 있어요.

english: So, how would I go about catching one them?
Just squash them with a boulder, quick and simple.
translation: 그냥 큰 바위로 깔아뭉개면 돼요. 빠르고 간단하죠.

english: What, you mean just pick up some boulders and start throwing them at kebbits? That doesn't sound simple.
translation: 뭐라고요, 큰 바위를 들어서 kebbit(케빗)한테 던지라는 거예요? 전혀 간단하게 안 들리는데요.

english: No silly, you let the creature squash itself. Just use some sticks to hold a boulder in a nice precarious position, place some bait underneath and let the creature knock itself out.
translation: 에이, 그게 아니죠. 녀석이 스스로 깔리게 만드는 거예요. 막대기 몇 개로 큰 바위를 아슬아슬하게 받쳐 두고, 그 밑에 미끼를 놓은 다음, 녀석이 알아서 기절하게 두는 거죠.

english: What on earth is a chinchompa?
Awwww, chinchompas are great. They're highly volatile little balls of fluff. Cute as you like, but for some reason they do have this tendency to spontaneously combust.
translation: 아아, chinchompa(친촘파)는 정말 멋져요. 엄청 불안정한 조그만 털뭉치예요. 귀엽기 그지없는데, 웬일인지 저절로 펑 하고 불타 버리는 버릇이 있어요.

english: What? Why?
Probably something to do with the fact they'll eat anything and everything, especially spicy food.
translation: 아마 아무거나 닥치는 대로 먹어서 그런 걸 거예요. 특히 매운 음식을요.

english: Anyways, if you want to capture a chinchompa, I suggest using a box trap. That way, if the little fluffball does explode, then at least most of the blast will be contained within the box.
translation: 아무튼, chinchompa(친촘파)를 잡고 싶으면 box trap(상자 덫)을 추천해요. 그러면 그 작은 털뭉치가 터지더라도 폭발 대부분이 상자 안에서 끝나거든요.

english: Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 왠지 나비는 당신 취향이 아닐 것 같은데요.

english: Not really, but some people like them. The ones around here are at least vaguely interesting, though. The black ones are supposedly magical butterflies.
translation: 별로요. 그래도 좋아하는 사람들은 있죠. 그나마 이 근처 녀석들은 조금은 흥미로운 편이에요. 검은 녀석들은 마법 나비라고들 하거든요.

english: Doesn't that make them harder to catch?
Not particularly; you can still catch them using an ordinary butterfly net. Oh, and you'll probably need some butterfly jars in which to keep them as well.
translation: 딱히요. 평범한 butterfly net(나비 그물)으로도 잡을 수 있어요. 아, 그리고 잡은 나비를 담아 둘 butterfly jar(나비 병)도 몇 개 있어야 할 거예요.

english: How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 포획 확률을 높이려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

english: There are four key factors that will affect your chances: what bait you use, how close to the trap you are, your appearance and your smell.
translation: 확률에 영향을 주는 핵심 요소는 네 가지예요. 어떤 미끼를 쓰는지, 덫에 얼마나 가까이 있는지, 겉모습, 그리고 냄새요.

english: How does bait help?

Unfortunately, creatures don't just jump into traps for the fun of it nearly as often as we as Hunters might like. However, it is possible to improve those odds. If you can find the right bait to use on your trap,
translation: 안타깝게도 동물들은 우리 사냥꾼들 바람만큼 그렇게 자주 재미로 덫에 뛰어들어 주지 않아요. 그래도 확률을 높일 수는 있죠. 덫에 쓸 알맞은 미끼,

english: something your prey really craves, then hunger overrides fear and the creature is just that little bit more likely to bounce to its furry little doom.
translation: 그러니까 사냥감이 정말 좋아하는 걸 찾으면 배고픔이 두려움을 이겨서, 녀석이 그 복슬복슬한 몸으로 파멸을 향해 뛰어들 가능성이 조금 더 높아져요.

english: Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 제가 덫에 얼마나 가까이 있는지가 왜 중요한가요?

english: However well you might be blending in, if you're standing with your nose pressed right up against your own trap, the poor little critters ain't going to go anywhere near it. So, you need to make sure you put
translation: 아무리 잘 숨어 있어도, 자기 덫에 코를 바짝 들이대고 서 있으면 그 불쌍한 녀석들은 근처에도 안 와요. 그러니까 자기와 덫 사이에

english: a sensible distance - I'd say at least four strides - between yourself and your trap.
translation: 적당한 거리를 꼭 둬야 해요. 적어도 네 걸음은 떨어져야 한다고 봐요.

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 동물들이 왜 제 겉모습을 신경 쓰나요?

english: You're a human. From the point of view of a lot of creatures, you're big and scary. So, it'd be best if the furry little monsters didn't notice you. You need to blend in like the creatures themselves.
translation: 당신은 인간이잖아요. 많은 동물들 입장에서 보면 당신은 크고 무서운 존재예요. 그러니까 그 털북숭이 꼬마 괴물들이 당신을 못 알아채는 게 제일 좋죠. 동물들처럼 주변에 녹아들어야 해요.

english: And how do I do that?

Easy, dress up like one of them. Even easier, dress up using the furs of the creatures themselves; then you're bound to get the colour right. And, I suppose, if you don't fancy just slinging a dead fur over your
translation: 쉬워요, 녀석들처럼 차려입으면 돼요. 더 쉬운 방법은 그 동물들 모피로 차려입는 거예요. 그러면 색깔은 틀림없이 맞겠죠. 그리고 죽은 동물 모피를 그냥 어깨에

english: shoulders, you can probably get them made into something more appealing. I hear there are tailors in Varrock who are good at that sort of thing.
translation: 걸치는 게 내키지 않으면, 좀 더 보기 좋은 걸로 만들어 달라고 할 수도 있을 거예요. Varrock(바록)에 그런 일 잘하는 재단사들이 있다고 들었어요.

english: What's wrong with my smell!?

I'm sure there's nothing wrong with your smell...from a human point of view. But to your prey, any trap that you've set up will reek of human, and that's going to work against you if you don't do anything about it.
translation: 당신 냄새에 문제가 있는 건 아닐 거예요... 인간 기준으로는요. 하지만 사냥감한테는 당신이 설치한 덫마다 인간 냄새가 진동할 테고, 그걸 어떻게든 하지 않으면 불리해질 거예요.

english: So what should I do?

You need to mask that lovely human scent of yours with something else. Smoke works well. Take a lit torch and waft it around the trap a bit. You'll quickly overpower most of the other smells around the trap.
translation: 그 사랑스러운 인간 냄새를 다른 걸로 가려야 해요. 연기가 잘 먹혀요. lit torch(불붙은 횃불)을 들고 덫 주위에서 좀 흔들어 줘요. 덫 주변의 다른 냄새들도 금방 대부분 덮어 버릴 거예요.

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 옷이랑 장비는 어디서 구할 수 있나요?

english: Well, the equipment isn't too hard to get hold of. You've got specialist shops like Aleck's in Yanille that'll see you right. He's a bit pricey, mind, but it's pretty decent kit.
translation: 음, 장비는 그렇게 구하기 어렵지 않아요. Yanille(야닐)에 있는 Aleck(알렉)네 같은 전문점에 가면 잘 챙겨 줄 거예요. 값이 좀 비싸긴 한데, 물건은 꽤 괜찮아요.

english: The clothing is a tad trickier to get hold of, the materials required being rather difficult to seperate from their reluctant owners.
translation: 옷은 구하기가 좀 더 까다로워요. 필요한 재료를 순순히 내놓지 않으려는 원래 주인들한테서 떼어 내기가 꽤 어렵거든요.

english: But, if you can get the furs, there are shops like the tailor's in east Varrock that can help you.
translation: 그래도 모피만 구하면 Varrock(바록) 동쪽에 있는 재단사 가게 같은 데서 도와줄 거예요.

english: I think I'll give it a miss right now, thanks.
Suit yourself!
What's a larupia?
What's a larupia? You don't know? You mean you really don't recognise the significance of these clothes I'm wearing?
translation: larupia(라루피아)가 뭐냐고요? 몰라요? 내가 입고 있는 이 옷이 무슨 의미인지 정말 모르겠다는 거예요?

english: Well, they're certainly decorative...what about them?
Well, these are the furs from a larupia. Caught the creature myself I did, and these make me blend in better, see?
translation: 이게 바로 larupia(라루피아) 모피예요. 내가 직접 잡았다고요. 그리고 이걸 입으면 주변에 더 잘 녹아들 수 있어요, 알겠죠?

english: If you want to be successful as a hunter you've got to be as stealthy as a kyatt, as quiet as a mouse and blend in like a, well, like a larupia, I guess!
translation: 사냥꾼으로 성공하고 싶으면 kyatt(카이엇)처럼 은밀하고, 생쥐처럼 조용하고, 음, 그러니까 larupia(라루피아)처럼 주변에 녹아들어야 해요!

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 입고 계신 그 멋진 망토는 뭐예요?

english: This? It's a Hunter's Skillcape. It shows that I am a true master of the art of Hunting and provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. If you ever manage to train your
translation: 이거요? Hunter's Skillcape(사냥 스킬 망토)예요. 내가 진정한 사냥의 달인이라는 증표고, 하루에 다섯 번 Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕)이나 Wilderness(황야) 사냥터로 순간이동할 수 있어요. 언젠가 당신이

english: Hunter skill to its maximum level then I could sell you one.
translation: Hunter(사냥) 스킬을 최고 레벨까지 올리면 하나 팔 수 있어요.

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 아, 저 좀 내버려 둬요, 이 미친 살생꾼 같으니.

english: Heh, well I guess it's not everyone's thing.
translation: 헤헤, 뭐, 누구나 좋아하는 건 아니죠.

english: Can I buy a Hunter's Skillcape from you?
translation: Hunter's Skillcape(사냥 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: I would be delighted to recognise you as a master hunter, the cape provides five daily teleports to either the Feldip Hills or Wilderness Hunter areas. I will need 99000 coins to cover the expense of making such a
translation: 당신을 사냥의 달인으로 인정할 수 있다니 기쁘네요. 이 망토로 하루에 다섯 번 Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕)이나 Wilderness(황야) 사냥터로 순간이동할 수 있어요. 이렇게 비싼 물건을 만드는 비용을 대려면

english: costly item!
99000! That seems a bit expensive.
Actually it's quite reasonable; it's made from the fur of the nearly extinct Raharni wildcat. Well, if you change your mind you know where to find me.
translation: 사실 꽤 합리적인 가격이에요. 멸종 직전인 Raharni wildcat(라하르니 들고양이)의 털로 만든 거거든요. 뭐, 마음이 바뀌면 내가 어디 있는지 알죠?

english: Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
But it seems that I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 지금 돈이 모자란 것 같네요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 Skillcape(스킬 망토)는 두건이 무료로 딸려 나와요. 스킬 판촉 행사 중이거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알죠? 그러니까 하나 팔려면 먼저 소지품 공간을 좀 비워야 해요.

english: Now you look like a true hunter!
What are you doing here?
Okay, where's a good place to start?
What other sorts of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 잡을 수 있는 다른 건 뭐가 있나요?

english: Thanks for your help.
What sort of things are there to catch around here?
translation: 이 근처에서는 뭘 잡을 수 있나요?

english: How would I go about catching birds?
I'd like to ask about another creature...
How can I improve my chances of making a capture?
translation: 포획 확률을 높이려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

english: Where can I get clothes and equipment like yours?
translation: 당신 같은 옷이랑 장비는 어디서 구할 수 있나요?

english: How do I get hold of a weasel?
Well, seeing as you seem to like larupias so much...
translation: 그런데 larupia(라루피아)를 그렇게 좋아하시는 것 같으니까...

english: More...
Barb-tails sound interesting.
What on earth is a chinchompa?
Somehow butterflies don't strike me as your sort of thing.
translation: 왠지 나비는 당신 취향이 아닐 것 같은데요.

english: Back...
How does bait help?
Why is it important how close I am to the trap?
translation: 제가 덫에 얼마나 가까이 있는지가 왜 중요한가요?

english: Why would the creatures care about my appearance?
translation: 동물들이 왜 제 겉모습을 신경 쓰나요?

english: What's wrong with my smell!?
I think I'll give it a miss right now.
What's a larupia?
So, what's good to hunt around here?
translation: 그래서, 이 근처에선 뭘 사냥하면 좋아요?

english: What is that cool cape you're wearing?
translation: 입고 계신 그 멋진 망토는 뭐예요?

english: Ahh, leave me alone you crazy killing person.
translation: 아, 저 좀 내버려 둬요, 이 미친 살생꾼 같으니.

english: Skillcape of Hunter.
99000! That seems a bit expensive.
Certainly, I'm happy to pay that.
Hunting.
What is this cave here for?
translation: 여기 이 동굴은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: Ah, a few of the most hunted creatures around here have been captured and secured in this cave to allow the most esteemed hunters to catch them with ease.
translation: 아, 이 근처에서 가장 많이 사냥되는 동물 몇 종을 붙잡아 이 동굴에 가둬 두었어요. 가장 존경받는 사냥꾼들이 손쉽게 잡을 수 있도록요.

english: Can I use the cave?
Yes, you can. Head inside to hunt in peace.
translation: 네, 써도 돼요. 안으로 들어가서 편히 사냥하세요.

english: Unfortunately not. Only those who have completed the hard tier of the Western Provinces achievement diary may enter.
translation: 안타깝지만 안 돼요. Western Provinces(서부 지방) 업적 일지의 상급 단계를 완료한 사람만 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: Come back when you have and I shall allow you entry.
translation: 완료하고 나면 다시 와요. 그때 들여보내 줄게요.

english: Sorry, but only those who've completed the hard set of the Western Provinces tasks may enter my private hunting ground.
translation: 미안하지만, Western Provinces(서부 지방) 과제의 상급 단계를 완료한 사람만 내 전용 사냥터에 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: Ah, this is a wonderful area for a spot of hunting, don't you think?
translation: 아, 여기는 사냥 좀 하기에 정말 멋진 곳이에요. 그렇게 생각하지 않나요?

english: I don't know, is it?
Oh absolutely; there's a huge variety of creatures to catch around here. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those piques your interest?
translation: 그럼요, 이 근처에는 잡을 수 있는 동물이 정말 다양해요. 나비, polar kebbit(북극 케빗), sabre-toothed kebbit(검치 케빗), 새, 그리고 kyatt(카이엇)까지 있죠! 그중 하나쯤은 관심이 가지 않나요?

english: Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: polar kebbit(북극 케빗)은 어디서 찾을 수 있나요?

english: Funnily enough, you've just put your finger right on the problem. With polar kebbits, finding them is the hardest part! You'll have to track them down.
translation: 공교롭게도 방금 문제의 핵심을 정확히 짚으셨네요. polar kebbit(북극 케빗)은 찾는 게 제일 어려워요! 직접 추적해야 하거든요.

english: How would I go about doing that, then?

The easiest way to get started is by looking somewhere you can be sure a kebbit will have been and then working from there. You see the holes around here leading down into the ice? They're kebbit burrows!
translation: 가장 쉽게 시작하는 방법은 kebbit(케빗)이 확실히 들렀을 만한 곳을 살펴보고 거기서부터 추적하는 거예요. 이 근처에 얼음 아래로 이어지는 구멍들 보이죠? 그게 케빗 굴이에요!

english: You'll be hard pressed to catch a polar kebbit in its home, but if you search around the entrance to a burrow then you might be able to find a trail.
translation: polar kebbit(북극 케빗)을 굴 안에서 잡기는 무척 어렵겠지만, 굴 입구 주변을 뒤져 보면 흔적을 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Now, kebbit trails are usually fairly easy to follow once you've found them, but if the trail does peter out, you should try inspecting the surrounding scenery for clues as to where the creature may have gone.
translation: kebbit(케빗) 흔적은 일단 찾으면 보통 꽤 따라가기 쉬워요. 하지만 흔적이 중간에 끊기면 주변 지형을 살펴서 녀석이 어디로 갔는지 단서를 찾아보세요.

english: Good places to look for clues include hollow logs in which the kebbit may have hidden or vegetation which may have been chewed or damaged.
translation: 단서를 찾기 좋은 곳으로는 kebbit(케빗)이 숨었을 만한 속 빈 통나무나, 갉아 먹혔거나 상한 풀숲 같은 곳이 있어요.

english: There are also tunnels running through the ice here that the kebbits use, so you should check those out as well.
translation: 여기엔 kebbit(케빗)들이 다니는 얼음 터널도 있으니까 그것도 살펴보세요.

english: What's more, these tunnels can often help to shelter a trail from further snow, making it even easier for you to pick them up again.
translation: 게다가 이 터널들은 흔적이 눈에 더 덮이지 않게 막아 주는 경우가 많아서, 흔적을 다시 찾기가 훨씬 쉬워요.

english: Eventually, of course, the kebbit will have probably hidden somewhere. Polar kebbits don't hang about in the open for long for fear of their natural predators.
translation: 물론 결국에는 kebbit(케빗)이 어딘가에 숨어 있을 거예요. polar kebbit(북극 케빗)은 천적이 무서워서 탁 트인 곳에 오래 머물지 않거든요.

english: If you suspect a kebbit is close by, try looking around for signs of disturbed snow. Polar kebbits will often bury themselves in snow drifts as a means of hiding.
translation: kebbit(케빗)이 가까이 있는 것 같으면 주변에 눈이 흐트러진 흔적이 있는지 찾아보세요. polar kebbit(북극 케빗)은 숨으려고 쌓인 눈 속에 몸을 파묻는 경우가 많아요.

english: If you think you've found a kebbit, use a noose wand to haul the creature out from the snow.
translation: kebbit(케빗)을 찾은 것 같으면 noose wand(올가미 막대)로 눈 속에서 끌어내세요.

english: Wow, that's quite a lot to remember.
Don't worry; if you find yourself struggling to follow a trail, just come and ask me and I'll see if I can help.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 흔적을 따라가기 힘들면 언제든 저한테 와서 물어보세요. 제가 도와드릴 수 있는지 볼게요.

english: But remember, the best place to start is by searching around their burrows.
translation: 하지만 기억하세요, 가장 좋은 출발점은 녀석들 굴 주변을 뒤져 보는 거예요.

english: Great, thanks.
How do you hunt birds?
Ah, you can get cunning little bird snares for just that. You should be able to find them in specialist Hunter shops. Try to lay them in fairly open areas with lots of birds.
translation: 아, 바로 그걸 위한 교묘한 bird snare(새 올무)가 있어요. Hunter(사냥) 전문 상점에서 구할 수 있을 거예요. 새가 많은 꽤 탁 트인 곳에 설치해 보세요.

english: Do I need to place any bait on these traps?

No, that's not necessary. The idea is that the bird will see the trap as somewhere to perch. If the bird lands on the trigger stick, it should drop away and a small loop of wire should close around the bird's feet.
translation: 아니요, 그럴 필요 없어요. 새가 덫을 앉을 자리로 여기게 만드는 게 요점이에요. 새가 방아쇠 막대기에 앉으면 막대기가 떨어지면서 작은 철사 고리가 새 발을 조이게 되죠.

english: And remember, it's important to collect any captures from your traps fairly quickly; otherwise, you risk losing them to various wild scavengers.
translation: 그리고 기억하세요, 덫에 잡힌 건 꽤 빨리 거둬 가는 게 중요해요. 안 그러면 여러 야생 청소동물들한테 빼앗길 수 있어요.

english: How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 동물을 잡을 확률을 높이려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

english: Ah, the key there is concealment, both of yourself and your traps.
translation: 아, 거기서 핵심은 숨기는 거예요. 자기 자신도, 덫도요.

english: The most obvious point is to stay out of sight of your own traps. If possible, hide around a wall, hedge or similar. Failing that, make sure you're a good few feet away from your trap.
translation: 가장 기본은 자기 덫에서 보이지 않는 곳에 있는 거예요. 가능하면 벽이나 산울타리 같은 것 뒤에 숨으세요. 그게 안 되면 덫에서 몇 걸음은 충분히 떨어져 있도록 하세요.

english: You can hide yourself even better by wearing clothing appropriate to the area in which you are hunting.
translation: 사냥하는 지역에 맞는 옷을 입으면 훨씬 더 잘 숨을 수 있어요.

english: Your best bet is to use the skins of creatures native to the area. There is a very good tailor in east Varrock who may be able to help you with making clothing out of such skins.
translation: 가장 좋은 방법은 그 지역에 사는 동물의 가죽을 쓰는 거예요. Varrock(바록) 동쪽에 아주 솜씨 좋은 재단사가 있는데, 그런 가죽으로 옷을 만드는 걸 도와줄 수 있을 거예요.

english: Finally, a lot of creatures may avoid your traps if they can smell a human scent on them. This is where smoking a trap can be useful.
translation: 마지막으로, 많은 동물들은 덫에서 인간 냄새가 나면 피해 갈 수 있어요. 이럴 때 덫에 연기를 쐬는 게 유용하죠.

english: It takes a bit of practice, but by using the smoke from a torch, you can mask any other scents that may surround a trap.
translation: 요령이 좀 필요하긴 하지만, 횃불 연기를 쓰면 덫 주변의 다른 냄새를 가릴 수 있어요.

english: Wow, thanks for your help.
You're welcome, good luck with the hunting.
What's so special about butterflies?
That depends entirely on the butterfly.
I'll admit that the activities of many butterflies may be of no interest at all. However, we are lucky in having around here some fine examples of rare thaumic butterflies.
translation: 솔직히 많은 나비들의 활동은 전혀 흥미롭지 않을 수도 있어요. 하지만 운 좋게도 이 근처에는 희귀한 thaumic butterfly(마력 나비)의 훌륭한 표본들이 있죠.

english: These butterflies reputedly have magical powers that, when released, can make a person stronger or heal otherwise critical wounds.
translation: 이 나비들은 마법의 힘을 지녔다고 하는데, 그 힘이 풀려나면 사람을 더 강하게 만들거나 치명적인 상처도 치유할 수 있대요.

english: At this point, I should offer a note of caution, however: it is also said that these powers will not manifest themselves if the butterflies are captured for selfish purposes.
translation: 다만 여기서 한 가지 주의를 드려야겠어요. 나비를 이기적인 목적으로 잡으면 그 힘이 나타나지 않는다고도 하거든요.

english: Rather, they are gifts that must be used by one person to aid another. Of course, you'll have to catch them first.
translation: 오히려 그건 한 사람이 다른 사람을 돕는 데 써야 하는 선물이에요. 물론 일단 잡는 것부터 해야겠지만요.

english: Why, with a butterfly net of course! You should also carry some empty butterfly jars with you in which to keep the butterflies.
translation: 그야 물론 butterfly net(나비 그물)으로죠! 나비를 담아 둘 빈 butterfly jar(나비 병)도 몇 개 가지고 다니세요.

english: How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
Ah, now for these creatures I would recommend using a deadfall trap. Deadfalls are quite easy to set up, and yet you can catch some very reasonably sized creatures with them.
translation: 아, 이 녀석들한테는 deadfall trap(낙석 덫)을 추천해요. 설치하기도 꽤 쉬운데, 이걸로 상당히 큰 동물도 잡을 수 있어요.

english: Deadfall traps basically work by having a large dead weight, such as a boulder, positioned so as to be delicately balanced above some form of bait.
translation: deadfall trap(낙석 덫)은 기본적으로 큰 바위 같은 무거운 물체를 미끼 위에 아슬아슬하게 균형을 잡아 올려 두는 방식으로 작동해요.

english: You will need to make sure you have a knife and some wood with you to create appropriate supports and a trigger for this sort trap.
translation: 이런 덫에 쓸 받침대와 방아쇠를 만들려면 knife(칼)과 나무를 꼭 챙기세요.

english: In the case of sabre-toothed kebbits you should use some form of raw meat to bait your trap, but other animals may prefer other baits, such as fish or vegetables.
translation: sabre-toothed kebbit(검치 케빗)을 잡을 때는 날고기 같은 걸 미끼로 써야 하지만, 다른 동물들은 물고기나 채소 같은 다른 미끼를 더 좋아할 수도 있어요.

english: Oooh, kyatts soundsinteresting. I want to catch one of those.
translation: 우와, kyatt(카이엇)은 재미있을 것 같아요. 하나 잡아 보고 싶어요.

english: Well, you've set your sights high, kyatts are incredibly fearsome creatures, but with determination like that I'm sure you'll make it.
translation: 음, 목표를 높게 잡으셨네요. kyatt(카이엇)은 엄청나게 사나운 동물이지만, 그런 결단력이라면 분명 해낼 거예요.

english: Now, you're not going to be able to catch a kyatt with just a small box or a noose on a stick. You need a much bigger trap.
translation: 그런데 작은 상자나 막대기 끝에 단 올가미로는 kyatt(카이엇)을 잡을 수 없어요. 훨씬 더 큰 덫이 필요해요.

english: Pit traps are a good bet. You'd be best off finding a natural dip in the ground as the basis for your trap. If you dig a pit yourself, you risk creatures noticing the disturbed ground nearby.
translation: pit trap(함정 구덩이)가 괜찮아요. 덫의 기반으로는 땅이 자연스럽게 움푹 꺼진 곳을 찾는 게 제일 좋아요. 직접 구덩이를 파면 동물들이 근처의 파헤쳐진 땅을 알아챌 위험이 있거든요.

english: Once you've found an appropriate spot, you'll need some logs and a knife. The logs serve two purposes.
translation: 알맞은 자리를 찾았으면 logs(통나무) 몇 개와 knife(칼)이 필요해요. 통나무는 두 가지 용도로 써요.

english: Some can be carved into sharp skewers for the bottom of the pit; hopefully the kyatt will die when it falls onto these. Others can be used to conceal the trap.
translation: 일부는 깎아서 구덩이 바닥에 놓을 날카로운 꼬챙이로 만들 수 있어요. 운이 좋으면 kyatt(카이엇)이 그 위로 떨어져 죽겠죠. 나머지는 덫을 숨기는 데 쓰면 돼요.

english: Of course, even then the pit is going to look suspicious, so you're going to need to lure the kyatt onto the branches in some way. What actually tends to work best for this is, well, yourself!
translation: 물론 그래도 구덩이는 수상해 보일 테니, 어떻게든 kyatt(카이엇)을 나뭇가지 위로 유인해야 해요. 실제로 이럴 때 제일 잘 먹히는 건, 음, 바로 당신 자신이에요!

english: What? I don't like the sound of that.
translation: 네? 그건 별로 듣기 좋지 않은데요.

english: Yes, that's the normal response, but I kid you not. If you really want a kyatt to follow you over that pit then just give it a good poke!
translation: 네, 다들 그렇게 반응하지만, 농담이 아니에요. kyatt(카이엇)이 정말로 당신을 따라 그 구덩이 위로 오게 하고 싶으면 한 번 세게 찔러 주세요!

english: Of course, I suggest you use something long to poke it with. Poking a kyatt with your finger is likely to end in unfortunate limb loss.
translation: 물론 찌를 때는 긴 걸 쓰시길 권해요. 손가락으로 kyatt(카이엇)을 찔렀다가는 불행하게도 팔다리를 잃게 될 거예요.

english: Fortunately, you can get very good sticks for poking from most Hunter shops.
translation: 다행히 찌르기 딱 좋은 막대기는 대부분의 Hunter(사냥) 상점에서 구할 수 있어요.

english: Once you have...got the creature's attention, try to lead it to one of your traps. Make sure to jump the branches when you reach the trap yourself, of course; it would be embarrassing to fall into your own trap.
translation: 일단 녀석의... 관심을 끌었으면, 덫 중 하나로 유인해 보세요. 물론 덫에 도착하면 나뭇가지를 꼭 뛰어넘으세요. 자기가 놓은 덫에 빠지면 창피하잖아요.

english: Then, if the kyatt is giving you all of its attention, hopefully it won't notice the trap, and with any luck, it will stumble right into the pit.
translation: 그러면 kyatt(카이엇)이 온통 당신한테 정신이 팔려서 덫을 못 알아채고, 운이 좋으면 구덩이에 그대로 빠질 거예요.

english: That sounds a bit hit or miss, and kind of suicidal too!
translation: 그건 좀 운에 맡기는 것 같은데요. 게다가 자살 행위 같기도 하고요!

english: Well that's what makes it exciting, isn't it? But honestly, if you want to capture a kyatt, that's your best bet.
translation: 음, 그래서 짜릿한 거잖아요? 하지만 솔직히 kyatt(카이엇)을 잡고 싶다면 그게 최선이에요.

english: Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 사냥하는 법을 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Why certainly. I reached the peak of my abilities some time ago, but I'm more than happy to help newcomers to the field. Was there anything in particular you had in mind?
translation: 물론이죠. 저는 이미 오래전에 실력의 정점에 올랐지만, 이 분야에 새로 들어온 사람들을 돕는 건 언제나 기뻐요. 특별히 생각해 둔 게 있나요?

english: Where's the best place to start?
I always say a good starting point is to learn how to follow the creatures you want to capture. Around here, that means practicing on polar kebbits.
translation: 저는 늘 잡고 싶은 동물을 추적하는 법부터 배우는 게 좋은 출발점이라고 말해요. 이 근처라면 polar kebbit(북극 케빗)으로 연습하는 게 좋죠.

english: So how do I track them down, then?
What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 이 근처에서는 어떤 동물을 사냥할 수 있나요?

english: Well, there's pretty much anything you could want to hunt. You've got butterflies, polar kebbits, sabre-toothed kebbits, birds and even kyatts! Surely one of those interests you?
translation: 음, 사냥하고 싶은 건 거의 다 있어요. 나비, polar kebbit(북극 케빗), sabre-toothed kebbit(검치 케빗), 새, 그리고 kyatt(카이엇)까지 있죠! 그중 하나쯤은 관심이 가지 않나요?

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
Really? What a shame, you looked like someone who could have had some promise.
translation: 정말요? 아쉽네요. 꽤 가능성 있는 사람처럼 보였는데.

english: I don't know, is it?
Where would I find polar kebbits?
translation: polar kebbit(북극 케빗)은 어디서 찾을 수 있나요?

english: How do you hunt birds?
I'd like to ask about another creature.
How can I improve my chances of capturing a creature?
translation: 동물을 잡을 확률을 높이려면 어떻게 해야 하나요?

english: What's so special about butterflies?
How can I capture a sabre-toothed kebbit?
Oooh, kyatts sounds interesting.
Can you teach me how to hunt?
translation: 사냥하는 법을 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Where's the best place to start?
What sort of creatures are there to hunt around here?
translation: 이 근처에서는 어떤 동물을 사냥할 수 있나요?

english: Sorry, I'm not that keen on hunting.
Greetings, fellow hunter. How can I be of help?
What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
In terms of drinks, we've got a Trapper's Tipple, and for food, a simple hearty stew.
translation: 음료로는 Trapper's Tipple(덫사냥꾼의 술)이 있고, 음식으로는 소박하지만 든든한 스튜가 있어요.

english: But you don't have room to hold either of them, so you'll have to come back later.
translation: 그런데 둘 다 들 자리가 없으시네요. 나중에 다시 오세요.

english: Couldn't you just leave it on the ground for me?
translation: 그냥 바닥에 놔 주시면 안 돼요?

english: We don't tend to just... leave things like that around here.
translation: 여기선 물건을 그렇게... 아무 데나 두고 가진 않아요.

english: I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
translation: Trapper's Tipple(덫사냥꾼의 술) 한 잔 주세요!

english: That'll be three coins then.
Oh, I can't afford one right now.
Could I grab a stew?
Absolutely! They're 20 coins these days.
Oh, I can't afford that right now.
translation: 아, 지금은 그걸 살 돈이 없네요.

english: I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
translation: 소문에 대해 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: Looks like you could do with talking to Verity first, given you're new to this whole business.
translation: 이 일은 처음인 것 같으니 먼저 Verity(베리티)랑 얘기해 보는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Yes, yes. How can I help you on that front?
translation: 그래요, 그래요. 그 일이라면 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Do you have any new ones for me?
Could you check out the validity of this report for me? Someone thinks they've seen a [creature]. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 보고가 사실인지 확인해 줄래요? 누가 [creature]을(를) 봤다고 하네요. 찾으면 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 주세요.

english: There's been rumours of a rare [creature] coming in. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 희귀한 [creature]이(가) 나타났다는 소문이 있어요. 찾으면 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 주세요.

english: We've got reports of a slightly different [creature] in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 근방 무리 중에 조금 색다른 [creature]이(가) 있다는 보고가 들어왔어요. 찾으면 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 주세요.

english: Looks like we need some information on a unique specimen amongst the local [creature] population. Once you find it, bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 이 근방 [creature] 무리 중 독특한 표본 하나에 대한 정보가 필요해 보여요. 찾으면 그 [rare parts]을(를) 좀 가져와 주세요.

english: I've heard rumours of a strange [creature] that you could check out for me. Once you find it, bring back one of its [rare parts].
translation: 이상한 [creature]에 대한 소문을 들었는데, 한번 확인해 줄래요? 찾으면 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 주세요.

english: Another one done? You're really doing a lot for the guild.
translation: 벌써 또 하나 끝냈어요? 길드를 위해 정말 많은 일을 해 주시네요.

english: Are you up for another?
Thanks for that. I'll mark off that report for you. Would you like another rumour?
translation: 고마워요. 그 보고는 처리된 걸로 표시해 둘게요. 소문 하나 더 받아 갈래요?

english: Can you remind me which rumour I'm chasing right now?
translation: 지금 제가 쫓고 있는 소문이 뭐였는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: You're hunting for me at the moment. This rumour was about a [creature]. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 지금은 저를 위해 사냥하는 중이에요. [creature]에 관한 소문이었죠. 그 [rare parts]을(를) 좀 가져와야 해요.

english: I can see you're following [Guild Hunter]'s rumour looking for a [creature] at the moment. You'll need to bring back some of its [rare parts].
translation: 지금 [Guild Hunter]의 소문을 따라 [creature]을(를) 찾고 있군요. 그 [rare parts]을(를) 좀 가져와야 해요.

english: I seem to remember sending you off to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Would you prefer that one, or a new one entirely?
translation: 제가 [creature]을(를) 사냥해서 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져오라고 보냈던 것 같은데요. 그걸 계속할래요, 아니면 아예 새 소문을 받을래요?

english: That was it. I asked you to hunt a [creature] and bring back one of its [rare parts]. Best of luck.
translation: 맞아요. [creature]을(를) 사냥해서 그 [rare parts] 하나를 가져와 달라고 했죠. 행운을 빌어요.

english: I'm good, thanks.
What kinds of food and drink do you serve?
I'd love a Trapper's Tipple!
translation: Trapper's Tipple(덫사냥꾼의 술) 한 잔 주세요!

english: Could I grab a stew?
I'll pass, thanks.
Can we talk about rumours?
translation: 소문에 대해 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: Yes.
No.
Yes, go back to his old one.
Yes, but with a brand new one.
I'm good, thanks.
'Ello [player name].
Hello, what's that you've got there?
A crossbow. Every now and then I sell the bits to make them.
translation: crossbow(석궁)이야. 가끔 그걸 만드는 부품을 팔지.

english: But not now?
That's right.
Sorry, I don't have anything to sell to you.
A crossbow, are you interested?
Maybe, are they any good?
Are they any good?! They're dwarven engineering at its best!
How do I make one for myself?
Well, firstly you'll need to chop yourself some wood, then use a knife on the wood to whittle out a nice crossbow stock like these here.
translation: 음, 먼저 나무를 좀 베어 와. 그다음 나무에 knife(칼)을 써서 여기 있는 것처럼 근사한 석궁 개머리를 깎아 내는 거지.

english: Wood fletched into stock... check.

Then get yourself some metal and a hammer and smith yourself some limbs for the bow, mind that you use the right metals and woods though as some wood is too light to use with some metal and vice versa.
translation: 그다음 금속이랑 hammer(망치)를 구해서 활대를 벼려 내. 다만 금속이랑 나무 짝은 제대로 맞춰야 해. 어떤 나무는 어떤 금속이랑 쓰기엔 너무 가볍고, 그 반대도 있거든.

english: Which goes with which?
Wood and Bronze as they're basic materials, Oak and Blurite, Willow and Iron, Steel and Teak, Mithril and Maple, Adamantite and Mahogany and finally Runite and Yew.
translation: Wood(나무)와 Bronze(청동)은 기본 재료고, Oak(참나무)와 Blurite(블루라이트), Willow(버드나무)와 Iron(철), Steel(강철)과 Teak(티크), Mithril(미스릴)과 Maple(단풍나무), Adamantite(아다만타이트)와 Mahogany(마호가니), 마지막으로 Runite(루나이트)와 Yew(주목)야.

english: Ok, so I have my stock and a pair of limbs... what now?
translation: 좋아요, 개머리랑 활대 한 쌍이 생겼어요... 이제 뭐 하죠?

english: Simply take a hammer and smack the limbs firmly onto the stock. You'll then need a string, only they're not the same as normal bows. You'll need to dry some large animal's meat to get sinew, then spin that on a spinning
translation: 그냥 hammer(망치)로 활대를 개머리에 단단히 박아 넣으면 돼. 그다음엔 시위가 필요한데, 보통 활 시위랑은 달라. 큰 동물 고기를 말려서 sinew(힘줄)을 얻은 다음, 그걸 spinning wheel(물레)에

english: wheel, it's the only thing we've found to be strong enough for a crossbow.
translation: 자아내. 석궁에 쓸 만큼 질긴 건 그것뿐이더라고.

english: What about magic logs?

Well.. I don't rightly know... us dwarves don't work with magic, we prefer gold and rock. Much more stable. I guess you could ask the humans at the rangers guild to see if they can do something but I don't want
translation: 글쎄... 나도 잘 모르겠어... 우리 드워프들은 마법은 안 다뤄. 금이랑 바위가 좋지. 훨씬 안정적이거든. rangers guild(궁수 길드)에 있는 인간들한테 뭐 좀 해 줄 수 있는지 물어볼 수는 있겠지만, 난

english: anything to do with it!
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
Take care, straight shooting.
What about ammo?

You can smith yourself lots of different bolts, don't forget to flight them with feathers like you do arrows though. You can poison any untipped bolt but there's also the option of tipping them with gems then
translation: 여러 가지 볼트를 직접 벼려 낼 수 있어. 화살처럼 feathers(깃털)로 깃을 다는 것도 잊지 말고. 촉 없는 볼트엔 독을 바를 수 있고, 보석으로 촉을 단 다음

english: enchanting them with runes. This can have some pretty powerful effects.
translation: 룬으로 마법을 부여하는 방법도 있지. 꽤 강력한 효과가 나기도 해.

english: Oh my poor bank, how will I store all those?!
translation: 아이고 내 불쌍한 은행, 그걸 다 어떻게 보관하죠?!

english: Find Hirko in Keldagrim, he also sells crossbow parts and I'm sure he has something you can use to store bolts in.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)에 있는 Hirko(히르코)를 찾아가. 그 친구도 석궁 부품을 파는데, 볼트를 보관할 만한 물건도 분명 갖고 있을 거야.

english: Thanks for the info.
How do I make one for myself?
What about magic logs?
Thanks for telling me. Bye!
What about ammo?
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)는 더 이상 우릴 지켜 줄 수 없어요!

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 곧 White Knights(백기사단)이 다 장악할 거예요!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 그래도 White Knights(백기사단)이 결국 장악할 거예요.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 공격을 준비하고 있대요!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보실래요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 그게요, 같은 망토를 입은 사람은 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고, 다른 사람은 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있어요. 또 같은 망토를 입은 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 구별하기도 쉬워지죠. 친구나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람과 함께 wilderness(황야)에 나갈 때 정말 유용해요.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human!
translation: 흐흐흐! 이것 봐라, 비리비리한 살덩이 인간이잖아!

english: You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!
translation: 이 골짜기를 타고 부는 얼음 바람을 조심해라. 너 같은 살덩이는 꽁꽁 얼어 죽게 될 테니까!

english: I don't really care for humans in my shop, so you'd better be buying something.
translation: 내 가게에 인간이 오는 건 별로 반갑지 않아. 그러니 뭐라도 사 가는 게 좋을 거다.

english: What are you selling?
Shields.
I'll be on my way then.
Good.
What are you selling?
I'll be on my way then.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
Just a guard. If sneaky humans come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 그냥 경비. 허락 없이 몰래 들어오는 인간 있으면, 돌 던져서 기절시키고 Weiss(바이스) 밖으로 내던져.

english: I'm familiar with the idea, yeah.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤들 옛날에 여기 지었어, 더 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨난 다음에. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지냈어. 먹을 염소랑 늑대 많아 - 오래 먹어서 좀 심심한 맛이지만, 다른 거 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 봤어요? 그걸 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알아요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)은 그거 키우는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구티 풀때기? 그런 거 들어 본 적 없어. 근데 채소 같은 소리고, Mother(어머니)는 그런 거 먹는 거 안 좋아해. 그래서 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해. 근데 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 어머니 하라는 대로 해.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 음, 좀 험하지만 우리 집이야. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)은 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 여기 더 좋게 만들 수 있대. 근데 Mother(어머니)가 그런 거 관심 없어서, 이상한 버섯 그거 못 해.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 싸움 더 잘하게 해 주는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 어머니 하라는 대로 해.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Just a guard. If sneaky human come in here without permission, I chuck rocks at 'em, knock 'em out and chuck 'em out of Weiss.
translation: 그냥 경비. 허락 없이 몰래 들어오는 인간 있으면, 돌 던져서 기절시키고 Weiss(바이스) 밖으로 내던져.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 엄청 좋아, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 남편 트롤이 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬거든. 음식 훨씬 맛있어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 음, 좀 험하지만 점점 좋아지는 중. Snowflake(눈송이), 걔가 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으니까 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그러니까 응, Weiss(바이스)는 살기 좋은 곳이야, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이니까. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 눈송이 남편 트롤은 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 알 바 아니야.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 봤어요? 그걸 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알아요.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 정말 날이 좋죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Halt human! What are you doing here?
translation: 멈춰라, 인간! 여기서 뭘 하는 거냐?

english: Wait! What was that? What the...
Would you like to buy or sell anything?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Hello Iffie!
Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count. Talk to my sister instead; she likes to chat. You'll find her upstairs in the church.
translation: 미안하구나, 얘야, 수다 떨다 보면 세던 코를 잊어버린단다. 대신 우리 언니랑 얘기하렴. 걔는 수다 떠는 걸 좋아하거든. 위층 교회에 있을 게다.

english: Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
Me, forget? Never! I still hear the ringing in my head when I go to sleep sometimes!
translation: 내가 잊어? 절대! 지금도 가끔 잘 때면 머릿속에서 땡땡 울리는 소리가 들린단다!

english: From the rolling pin and saucepan?
Yes, it was surprisingly loud doing that.
I don't know if it is that surprising. You were banging a metal saucepan on your head!
translation: 그게 그렇게 놀랄 일인지는 모르겠어요. metal saucepan(쇠 냄비)를 머리에 대고 두드리셨잖아요!

english: Hello dearie, of course I remember it!
I dream about it sometimes, especially sneaking into the Blue Moon Inn kitchens for the rolling pin and saucepan!
translation: 가끔 꿈에도 나온단다. 특히 rolling pin(밀대)랑 saucepan(냄비)를 구하러 Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관) 부엌에 몰래 들어갔던 거!

english: Although probably best I don't do that again, I still feel bad for the chef.
translation: 그래도 다시는 안 하는 게 좋겠지. 아직도 그 요리사한테 미안하거든.

english: Yes, probably best we don't!
translation: 네, 다신 안 하는 게 좋겠어요!

english: I don't only remember it, I remember it fondly, I loved it!
translation: 기억만 하는 게 아니라, 아주 즐겁게 기억하고 있단다. 정말 좋았어!

english: It was a good adventure wasn't it!
Yes, very. I'm so happy that you picked me to help you.
translation: 그래, 정말. 날 골라서 도와 달라고 해 줘서 얼마나 기쁜지 몰라.

english: I couldn't have picked anyone else, you were the perfect accomplice!
translation: 다른 사람은 생각도 못 했어요. 완벽한 공범이셨는걸요!

english: Thank you, dearie!
Of course dearie! How could I ever forget it? I had such a great time.
translation: 당연하지, 얘야! 그걸 어떻게 잊겠니? 정말 즐거웠단다.

english: Are you still adventuring?
I am doing my best to adventure. There are just so many things to do!
translation: 열심히 모험하고 있어요. 할 게 너무 많아요!

english: Well keep it up, don't let an old lady like me distract you. I've had my fill of adventure now!
translation: 그래, 계속 힘내렴. 나 같은 노인네 때문에 한눈팔지 말고. 난 이제 모험이라면 실컷 했단다!

english: There is no way I could forget it. Thank you for letting me come on such an adventure!
translation: 그걸 어떻게 잊겠니. 그런 모험에 데려가 줘서 고맙구나!

english: It was my pleasure, maybe we could do it again some day!
translation: 저야말로 즐거웠어요. 언젠가 또 같이 해요!

english: That would be lovely dearie, but maybe we go on one that doesn't involve climbing trees?
translation: 그럼 좋겠구나, 얘야. 그래도 다음엔 나무 타기 없는 모험으로 하면 안 될까?

english: I'm getting a bit old for that!
translation: 나도 이제 그러기엔 나이가 좀 많아서 말이야!

english: How could I not? It was amazing! I see you're still wearing that jumper I knitted you.
translation: 어떻게 잊겠니? 정말 대단했지! 내가 떠 준 스웨터 아직 입고 있구나.

english: It's lovely, very versatile. Even keeps me warm in the coldest of places!
translation: 정말 예쁘고 쓸모도 많아요. 제일 추운 곳에서도 따뜻하게 해 줘요!

english: That is good to hear. Do you have a favourite way to wear it?
translation: 그 말 들으니 좋구나. 어떻게 입는 게 제일 좋니?

english: I like the orange version the best!
I like it too! It reminds me of pumpkins and spooky things, just like our adventure!
translation: 나도 그게 좋더라! 호박이랑 으스스한 것들이 생각나거든. 딱 우리 모험처럼!

english: I like the black version the best!
I like it too! It's pretty scary looking, just like how we saw Death in our adventure!
translation: 나도 그게 좋더라! 꽤 무서워 보이잖니. 딱 우리 모험에서 Death(사신)을 봤을 때처럼!

english: Sorry, dearie, if I stop to chat I'll lose count.
translation: 미안하구나, 얘야, 수다 떨다 보면 세던 코를 잊어버린단다.

english: Hello Iffie!
Hello Iffie, remember our adventure?
Orange.
Black.
Can I help you at all?
Who are you?
My name is Ignatius Vulcan. Once I was - like you - an adventurer, but that was before I realised the beauty and power of flame! Just look at this...
translation: 내 이름은 Ignatius Vulcan(이그나티우스 불칸)일세. 나도 한때는 - 자네처럼 - 모험가였지. 불꽃의 아름다움과 힘을 깨닫기 전까지는 말일세! 이걸 보게...

english: Yeeouch!

Stare into the flame and witness the purity and power of fire! As my attraction to flame grew, so did my skills at firelighting. I began to neglect my combat skills, my Mining skills and my questing. Who needs such
translation: 불꽃을 응시하며 불의 순수함과 힘을 목격하게! 불꽃에 끌릴수록 내 불 붙이는 솜씨도 늘었지. 난 전투 스킬도, Mining(채광) 스킬도, 퀘스트도 소홀히 하기 시작했네. 불의 힘을 다룰 수 있는데

english: mundane skills when one can harness the power of fire? After years of practice I am now the acknowledged Master of Flame! Everything must be purified by fire!
translation: 그런 시시한 스킬이 무슨 필요가 있겠나? 수년간 수련한 끝에 이제 나는 공인된 불꽃의 달인이 되었네! 모든 것은 불로 정화되어야 하네!

english: Okaaaay! Err, I'll be going now. Umm, get better soon.
translation: 그, 그러시군요! 어, 전 이만 가 볼게요. 음, 얼른 나으세요.

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Firemaking, so bright that wearing it lights up caves! I was given it in recognition of my skill as the greatest firemaker in the lands! I AM the Master of Flame!
translation: 이건 Skillcape of Firemaking(불 피우기 스킬 망토)일세. 어찌나 밝은지 입으면 동굴도 환해지지! 이 땅 최고의 불 피우기 장인으로 인정받아 받은 것이네! 내가 바로 불꽃의 달인이란 말일세!

english: Hmm, I'll be going now. Keep a sharp look out for those men with their white jackets!
translation: 흠, 전 이만 가 볼게요. 흰 가운 입은 사람들이 찾아올지 모르니 조심하세요!

english: No, thanks.
Okay, keep the fire burning.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: Skillcape of Firemaking(불 피우기 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Of course you can. You are already a master of fire, you just need the cape to prove it. The cape is so bright that wearing it will light up dark caves. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: 물론이지. 자네는 이미 불의 달인이니, 그걸 증명할 망토만 있으면 되네. 이 망토는 어찌나 밝은지 입으면 어두운 동굴도 환해진다네. 99000코인일세.

english: No thanks, that's too much.
Sorry to hear that, I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 아쉽군. 마음이 바뀌면 난 여기 있을 걸세.

english: Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 좋아요, 그 정도면 괜찮은 것 같네요.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데, 안타깝게도 지금 가진 돈이 부족하네요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 모든 Skillcape(스킬 망토)는 무료 두건과 함께만 판매한다네. 스킬 판촉 행사의 일환이지. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알지 않나. 그러니 내가 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비우게.

english: I'm sure you'll look hot in that cape.
translation: 그 망토를 입으면 자네 아주 핫해 보일 걸세.

english: Who are you?
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 제 망토에 쓸 두건 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 소지품에 공간이 부족한 것 같군. 공간이 생기면 다시 찾아오게.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
What is that cape you're wearing?
No, thanks.
Can I buy a Skillcape of Firemaking?
translation: Skillcape of Firemaking(불 피우기 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: No thanks, that's too much.
Okay, that seems reasonable.
translation: 좋아요, 그 정도면 괜찮은 것 같네요.

english: Skillcape
Hood
Welcome, [brother/sister/my child].
Er... Are we related?
We are all related, [brother/sister/my child], for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 우리는 모두 한 핏줄입니다, [brother/sister/my child]. 우리 모두 불꽃의 자녀이기 때문입니다.

english: Okayyy...
So what is this place?
You stand before the Doors of Dinh. Behind them lies the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 당신은 지금 Doors of Dinh(딘의 문) 앞에 서 있습니다. 그 너머에는 Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 감옥이 있습니다.

english: What's a Wintertodt?
We do not know what it is. All we know is that it threatens to snuff out every flame in this land and plunge the world into eternal darkness.
translation: 그것이 무엇인지는 저희도 모릅니다. 저희가 아는 것은 그것이 이 땅의 모든 불꽃을 꺼뜨리고 세상을 영원한 어둠에 빠뜨리려 한다는 것뿐입니다.

english: Oh dear... We should probably do something about that.

That is why we are here, [brother/sister/my child]. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 그래서 저희가 여기 있는 것입니다, [brother/sister/my child]. Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 갇힌 이래로, 흔히 Pyromancers(화염술사)라고 불리는 Order of the Sacred Flame(성화 교단)의 일원들이 이곳을 지켜 왔습니다.

english: But alas, despite our best efforts, the Wintertodt is growing in power again.
translation: 하지만 안타깝게도, 저희의 노력에도 불구하고 Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 힘이 다시 커지고 있습니다.

english: Well that's just no good. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 그거 정말 큰일이네요. 제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: Our order searches tirelessly for a way to defeat the Wintertodt. Until we discover it, the Wintertodt must be held at bay.
translation: 저희 교단은 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 물리칠 방법을 쉼 없이 찾고 있습니다. 그 방법을 찾을 때까지 윈터토트를 막아 두어야 합니다.

english: However, I fear your abilities are not great enough to withstand the cold of the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return to me.
translation: 하지만 당신의 능력으로는 Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 추위를 견디기 어려울 것 같습니다. 성스러운 불꽃의 길을 익힌 뒤 다시 찾아오십시오.

english: You require at least 50 Firemaking to take on the Wintertodt.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)에 맞서려면 Firemaking(불 피우기) 레벨이 최소 50이어야 합니다.

english: Pass through the Doors of Dinh to the prison within. You will find the finest of our order channeling the power of the sacred flame into the Wintertodt.
translation: Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)을 지나 안쪽 감옥으로 가십시오. 저희 교단 최고의 일원들이 성스러운 불꽃의 힘을 Wintertodt(윈터토트)에게 쏟아붓고 있을 것입니다.

english: Help them keep the holy fires lit so that they can keep the Wintertodt subdued.
translation: 그들이 신성한 불을 계속 지펴 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 억누를 수 있도록 도와주십시오.

english: How can I do that?
You will find the roots of the great Bruma tree have crept into the prison. Chop the roots and use them to keep the sacred flame alive.
translation: 거대한 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)의 뿌리가 감옥 안까지 뻗어 들어와 있을 것입니다. 그 뿌리를 베어 성스러운 불꽃이 꺼지지 않게 하십시오.

english: Anything else?
You can use the herbs of the Bruma tree to make Rejuvenation potions. Give these to any of our order who fall to the cold of the Wintertodt before they succumb to the darkness.
translation: Bruma tree(브루마 나무)의 약초로 Rejuvenation potions(원기 회복 물약)을 만들 수 있습니다. Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 추위에 쓰러진 교단원이 어둠에 굴복하기 전에 이것을 건네주십시오.

english: How else may I be of assistance?
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Do you feel the winds of winter as they lick across the land? This is the power of the Wintertodt. We know not what it is nor from where it came. Only that it wields the power of Winter itself.
translation: 대지를 핥고 지나가는 겨울바람이 느껴지십니까? 이것이 Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 힘입니다. 저희는 그것이 무엇인지, 어디서 왔는지 알지 못합니다. 다만 겨울 그 자체의 힘을 휘두른다는 것만 알 뿐입니다.

english: The ground on which we stand was once full of light, full of life. But then the Wintertodt came. Now the fires of these lands burn no more.
translation: 저희가 서 있는 이 땅은 한때 빛과 생명으로 가득했습니다. 그러나 Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 찾아왔고, 이제 이 땅의 불은 더 이상 타오르지 않습니다.

english: Tell me about the Pyromancers.
We are the Order of the Sacred Flame, formed over a thousand years ago when the Wintertodt first threatened Great Kourend.
translation: 저희는 Order of the Sacred Flame(성화 교단)으로, 천여 년 전 Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 처음 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 위협했을 때 결성되었습니다.

english: We fought against the Wintertodt until we managed to lure it behind Dinh's great Doors. Our task did not end there though, for we always knew that the Wintertodt would rise again.
translation: 저희는 Wintertodt(윈터토트)와 싸워 마침내 Dinh(딘)의 거대한 문 너머로 꾀어 들이는 데 성공했습니다. 하지만 저희의 임무는 거기서 끝나지 않았습니다. 윈터토트가 언젠가 다시 일어나리라는 것을 늘 알고 있었기 때문입니다.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I am Ignisia, Grand Master of the Order of the Sacred Flame. I have served our Order faithfully since I passed the Trials of Fire before the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 저는 Order of the Sacred Flame(성화 교단)의 교단장 Ignisia(이그니시아)입니다. Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천) 이전에 Trials of Fire(불의 시련)을 통과한 이래로 교단을 충실히 섬겨 왔습니다.

english: What can I do to help?
You are not currently strong enough to face the Wintertodt. Learn the ways of the sacred flame and then return here.
translation: 당신은 아직 Wintertodt(윈터토트)에 맞설 만큼 강하지 않습니다. 성스러운 불꽃의 길을 익힌 뒤 이곳으로 돌아오십시오.

english: We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 물리칠 방법을 찾을 때까지 그것을 막아 내야 합니다. 감옥으로 들어가 신성한 불을 계속 지펴, 저희 교단이 악을 막아 낼 수 있게 해 주십시오.

english: The Wintertodt is no longer growing in strength but it still needs to be held back. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 힘은 더 이상 커지지 않지만, 여전히 막아 둘 필요가 있습니다. 감옥으로 들어가 신성한 불을 계속 지펴, 저희 교단이 악을 막아 낼 수 있게 해 주십시오.

english: I'm fine thanks.
May the sacred flame guide you, [brother/sister/my child].
Welcome back, [brother/sister/my child]. How may I be of assistance?
I get hayfever. Please take those flowers away.
translation: 저는 꽃가루 알레르기가 있습니다. 그 꽃을 치워 주십시오.

english: I would not appreciate your traps near the bank. Please take them away.
translation: 은행 근처에 덫을 놓으시는 것은 달갑지 않습니다. 치워 주십시오.

english: Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Pyromancers.
Tell me about yourself.
What can I do to help?
I'm fine thanks.
So... you're alchemical; does that mean I can turn you into gold?
translation: 그러니까... 넌 연금술 히드라잖아. 그럼 너를 금으로 바꿀 수도 있어?

english: No, I like my form as it is.
But... I love gold.
I'll turn to gold when drakes fly.
translation: drakes(드레이크)가 하늘을 나는 날에나 금으로 변해 줄게.

english: How do you ever agree on what to do?
Well I’m in charge.
No, I am.
Nope, I say what we do.
translation: 아니거든, 우리가 뭘 할지는 내가 정해.

english: Really I control everything!
Ok then!
So how was that chemical bath?!
Nasty! I don't want to do that again
Which creature is cooler, Drakes, Hydras or Wyrms?
translation: Drakes(드레이크), Hydras(히드라), Wyrms(웜) 중에 누가 더 멋져?

english: I may be biased in this situation... bit silly to ask me isn't it?
translation: 이 상황에선 내가 좀 편파적일 수도 있는데... 나한테 묻는 건 좀 바보 같지 않아?

english: Alright alright... don't lose your head.
translation: 알았어, 알았어... 그렇다고 머리 뚜껑 열리진 마.

english: Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 와, Hero(영웅)다! 대단해요! 대체 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 어떻게 해치운 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요, 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Oh, my name's Ileana, I just help out around here, you know, look for food and so on.
translation: 아, 제 이름은 Ileana(일레아나)예요. 그냥 여기저기 일을 돕고 있어요, 그러니까 먹을 걸 찾는다든가 하는 거요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요, 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있어요. 머지않아 Salve(살브 강)에 있는 신전까지 갈 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 당신께 너무너무 감사하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기엔 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Good day, what are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 안녕하세요, 이렇게 먼 곳까지 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: I'm just wandering, it's a lovely day for a walk in the woods.
translation: 그냥 돌아다니는 중이에요. 숲속을 산책하기 좋은 날이네요.

english: It is that.
Well I shouldn't keep you, see you later.
translation: 너무 붙잡아 두면 안 되겠네요, 나중에 봬요.

english: Bye.
Do you remember Oaknock? He was a gnome inventor
Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him he was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: 물론이죠! 그 젊은 노움은 잘 지내나요? 꽤 마음에 들었어요. 좀 시끄럽긴 했지만 마음씨가 착했고, 엘프 마법에 관심이 아주 많았죠.

english: I think Oaknock died of old age some time ago. He must have visited you a few hundred years ago though...
translation: Oaknock(오크녹)은 꽤 오래전에 노환으로 세상을 떠난 것 같아요. 그래도 몇백 년 전에 당신을 찾아왔던 게 분명해요...

english: I keep forgetting, a hundred years is a long time for you. He was very interested in illusion magic, and how to prevent it. I gave him some advice and a few bits of equipment to help him.
translation: 자꾸 잊어버리네요, 당신들에겐 백 년이 긴 시간이죠. 그는 환영 마법과 그걸 막는 방법에 관심이 아주 많았어요. 조언을 좀 해 주고, 도움이 될 장비도 몇 가지 줬어요.

english: A seed?
Of course. It grew into an axe. I hope he found it useful.
translation: 물론이죠. 그게 자라서 axe(도끼)가 됐어요. 그가 유용하게 썼으면 좋겠네요.

english: I think he did! Thanks.
Ilfeen smiles serenely.
Hello.
Hey ya, you're the human that helped my friend Islwyn, aren't you? He told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.
translation: 안녕하세요, 당신이 제 친구 Islwyn(이슬윈)을 도와준 인간이죠? 당신한테 크리스탈 장비를 줬다고 하더라고요.

english: That's right, why?
When it reverts to seed, bring it to me and I'll chant it for you.
translation: 그게 씨앗으로 돌아가면 저한테 가져와요. 제가 주문을 읊어 다시 만들어 줄게요.

english: It just happens I have a seed here, what can you do with it?
translation: 마침 씨앗이 하나 있는데, 이걸로 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: I can only make shields and bows. I've been trying halberds but so far only Islwyn has succeeded.
translation: 저는 방패랑 활만 만들 수 있어요. 할버드도 시도해 봤는데 지금까지 성공한 건 Islwyn(이슬윈)뿐이에요.

english: How much for a shield?
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 750,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: 당신에게 처음 만들어 주는 거니까 750,000코인이에요. 당신의 공명에 익숙해지면 가격이 점점 내려갈 거예요.

english: I'll take it.
Ilfeen hands you a crystal shield.
Thanks.
If it helps I have a book here that will tell you about crystal chanting.
translation: 도움이 된다면, 크리스탈 주문에 대해 알려 주는 책이 여기 있어요.

english: I can't afford that.
How much is the bow?
As this is the first one I've made for you it will be 900,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: 당신에게 처음 만들어 주는 거니까 900,000코인이에요. 당신의 공명에 익숙해지면 가격이 점점 내려갈 거예요.

english: Ilfeen hands you a crystal bow.
Hello again.
Hey.
Are you still offering to chant seeds?
I am, but you'll need to supply the seed.
translation: 그럼요, 하지만 씨앗은 직접 가져오셔야 해요.

english: I see we have removed some defunct crystal equipment from you recently. I would be happy to replace them for you, unless you want to buy them of course.
translation: 최근에 당신에게서 못 쓰게 된 크리스탈 장비를 회수했군요. 원하면 새 걸로 바꿔 줄게요. 물론 사고 싶다면 사도 되고요.

english: I can replace for you [amount] crystal bow(s), [amount] crystal shield(s) and [amount] crystal halberd(s).
translation: crystal bow(크리스탈 활) [amount]개, crystal shield(크리스탈 방패) [amount]개, crystal halberd(크리스탈 할버드) [amount]개를 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Which crystal item would you like?
Siphon the ether into a Crystal bow please.
translation: Crystal bow(크리스탈 활)에 에테르를 흘려 넣어 주세요.

english: Siphon the ether into a Crystal halberd please.
translation: Crystal halberd(크리스탈 할버드)에 에테르를 흘려 넣어 주세요.

english: Siphon the ether into a Crystal shield please.
translation: Crystal shield(크리스탈 방패)에 에테르를 흘려 넣어 주세요.

english: While I'm here, I have a question for you.
Well ask away.
Do you remember Oaknock? He was a gnome inventor.
Of course! How is the young gnome? I rather liked him. He was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: 물론이죠! 그 젊은 노움은 잘 지내나요? 꽤 마음에 들었어요. 좀 시끄럽긴 했지만 마음씨가 착했고, 엘프 마법에 관심이 아주 많았죠.

english: Including a seed?
Of course. It grew into a saw. I hope he found it useful.
translation: 물론이죠. 그게 자라서 saw(톱)이 됐어요. 그가 유용하게 썼으면 좋겠네요.

english: That sounds great.
You are handed a book
Thanks, I'll read all about it.
Well, good luck.
See you later.
I don't need it, thanks.
How much for a shield?
I'll take it.
I can't afford that.
How much is the bow?
Crystal bow.
Crystal halberd.
Crystal shield.
Nothing.
That sounds great.
I don't need it, thanks.
Hi!
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 결투 끝나고 뒷정리하는 불쌍한 사람은 되고 싶지 않네요.

english: Me neither.
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Hmph.
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 여기가 제2시대부터 있던 곳이라는 거 알아요?!

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 네. 안내 부스에 있는 사람이 알려 줬어요.

english: Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 저 지금 결투 보고 있는 거 안 보여요?

english: I'm sorry!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 뭐, 장 보는 것보단 훨씬 낫죠!

english: Hi!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Why did the skeleton burp?
translation: 해골이 왜 방귀 대신 트림을 했게요?

english: I don't know?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 방귀 뀔 배짱이 없어서요! 배짱은커녕 배도 없거든요!

english: Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!.
Hello. What do you do here?
Hello. My name is Imerominia and I'm the library horologist.
translation: 안녕하십니까. 제 이름은 Imerominia(이메로미니아)이고, 이 도서관의 시간학자입니다.

english: Horologist? What does that mean?
Horology is the study and measurement of time. Specifically, I study how time and dates have been historically recorded.
translation: 시간학이란 시간을 연구하고 측정하는 학문입니다. 저는 특히 시간과 날짜가 역사적으로 어떻게 기록되어 왔는지를 연구하지요.

english: For example, the date convention in Great Kourend is to state the number of days and decades since the signing of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 예를 들어 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에서는 Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)이 체결된 이후 지난 날수와 십년기 수로 날짜를 나타내는 관례가 있습니다.

english: Days and decades? That's a bit confusing.
Yes, it's an interesting convention. Truth be told, most in the kingdom prefer to use the same date format as you'll find used elsewhere.
translation: 네, 흥미로운 관례이지요. 사실 왕국 사람들 대부분은 다른 곳에서 쓰는 것과 같은 날짜 형식을 더 좋아합니다.

english: However, as this is the Historical Archive, we stick to the dates used historically within Kourend.
translation: 하지만 이곳은 Historical Archive(역사 기록 보관소)이므로, 쿠렌드에서 역사적으로 써 온 날짜를 고수하고 있습니다.

english: Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the rulers of each of the houses 139 decades ago, following the great famine.
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)은 대기근 이후, 지금으로부터 139 십년기 전에 각 가문의 통치자들이 체결했습니다.

english: The Accord declared that each house will, in turn, rule the Kingdom of Great Kourend for one decade in rotation, based on lots drawn.
translation: 협정에 따라 각 가문은 제비뽑기로 정한 순서대로 돌아가며 Kingdom of Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드 왕국)을 십 년씩 통치하게 되었습니다.

english: You may find a book in the Grand Library with further information. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Grand Library(대도서관)에 가시면 더 자세한 내용이 담긴 책이 있을 겁니다. 그 밖에 더 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill honoured today?
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)은 지금도 지켜지고 있나요?

english: Our kingdom has advanced somewhat over the many decades since the Accord. Though some parts of the Accord remain intact, the Kourend Council now rules Great Kourend.
translation: 협정 이후 수많은 십년기를 거치며 우리 왕국은 어느 정도 발전했습니다. 협정의 일부는 아직 남아 있지만, 지금은 Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)가 그레이트 쿠렌드를 다스립니다.

english: Was the Accord ever breached?
Indeed it was. In the 13th decade, King Shayzien III seized control of Kourend using the military under his command.
translation: 네, 그렇습니다. 13번째 십년기에 King Shayzien III(샤이지엔 3세 왕)이 자신이 거느린 군대를 이용해 쿠렌드의 권력을 장악했습니다.

english: The full set of laws within the Accord haven't been followed since. However, some of them were reinstated in the 47th decade, by King Byrne I.
translation: 그 이후로 협정의 모든 법이 지켜진 적은 없습니다. 다만 47번째 십년기에 King Byrne I(번 1세 왕)이 그중 일부를 되살렸지요.

english: Fascinating. What happened during that time?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 그 사이에는 무슨 일이 있었나요?

english: During the 20th decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Four decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 20번째 십년기에 King Shayzien VI(샤이지엔 6세 왕)이 Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 경)의 딸과 혼인했습니다. 그리고 40년 뒤 그들의 아들이 왕위에 올랐습니다.

english: He took the name King Hosidius IV in an attempt to distance the family from the breaking of the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 그는 가문을 Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정) 파기의 오명에서 떼어 놓으려고 King Hosidius IV(호시디우스 4세 왕)라는 이름을 택했습니다.

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the 33rd decade.
translation: King Hosidius IV(호시디우스 4세 왕)과 그 아들 King Hosidius V(호시디우스 5세 왕)은 33번째 십년기 초까지 쿠렌드를 통치했습니다.

english: It was then that King Shayzien VII took control of the kingdom. His rule was a notably violent one.
translation: 그때 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)이 왕국을 장악했습니다. 그의 통치는 유난히 폭력적이었지요.

english: King Shayzien VII was killed some five decades later during the Battle of the Concourse. He was succeeded by the dark mage, Xeric.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)은 약 50년 뒤 Battle of the Concourse(광장 전투)에서 전사했습니다. 그 뒤를 이은 것이 어둠의 마법사 Xeric(제릭)이었습니다.

english: Xeric ruled Kourend for more than ten dark decades using an army of lizardmen. This time period was known as the Age of Strife.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 lizardmen(리자드맨) 군대를 거느리고 백 년이 넘는 암흑의 세월 동안 쿠렌드를 통치했습니다. 이 시기를 Age of Strife(투쟁의 시대)라고 부릅니다.

english: Xeric was eventually killed during the 47th decade and succeeded by King Byrne I.
translation: Xeric(제릭)은 결국 47번째 십년기에 죽임을 당했고, King Byrne I(번 1세 왕)이 그 뒤를 이었습니다.

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: Xeric(제릭)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Ah, I do not have much more information on him. You should speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 아, 그에 대해서는 저도 더 아는 바가 많지 않습니다. 저희 Xerician(제리시안) 전문가인 Ektheme(엑테메)에게 물어보시지요.

english: Thanks.
No thanks.

The Royal Accord of Twill no longer plays much part in the rulership of Kourend. It was breached in the 13th decade when King Shayzien III seized control of the kingdom. It hasn't been honoured since.
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)은 이제 쿠렌드 통치에 큰 영향을 미치지 않습니다. 13번째 십년기에 King Shayzien III(샤이지엔 3세 왕)이 왕국을 장악하면서 깨졌고, 그 이후로 지켜진 적이 없습니다.

english: That said, it was the basis for Rose's Accord, which sets out how the kingdom is currently ruled today. As decreed in Rose's Accord, the Hosidius family are now the royal family of Kourend.
translation: 그렇긴 해도, 이 협정은 오늘날 왕국의 통치 방식을 정한 Rose's Accord(로즈 협정)의 바탕이 되었습니다. 로즈 협정에 따라 지금은 Hosidius(호시디우스) 가문이 쿠렌드의 왕가입니다.

english: We have the original Royal Accord of Twill safely stored here. Although it's not available for public viewing, there are copies available within the Grand Library. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)의 원본은 이곳에 안전하게 보관하고 있습니다. 일반 공개는 하지 않지만, Grand Library(대도서관)에 사본이 있습니다. 그 밖에 더 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: So what is today's date?
I'm afraid I lose track of which day it is... but we are in the 141st decade.
translation: 죄송하지만 저는 오늘이 며칠인지 자꾸 잊어버립니다... 하지만 지금은 141번째 십년기입니다.

english: So that means the Accord was signed almost 1,410 years ago?
translation: 그럼 협정이 맺어진 게 거의 1,410년 전이라는 뜻이네요?

english: That is correct. You seem to have understood our time and date format well.
translation: 맞습니다. 저희 시간과 날짜 형식을 잘 이해하신 것 같군요.

english: What about the time before the Accord was signed?
Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to them as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
translation: 그 옛 시대에 대해서는 알려진 바가 거의 없지만, 저희는 그 시기를 'Before Accord(협정 이전)', 줄여서 'BA' 십년기라고 부릅니다.

english: Goodbye.
Hello, what do you do here?
Have you ever heard of Camorra?
translation: Camorra(카모라)에 대해 들어 본 적 있으세요?

english: I can't say I have. Who is she?
translation: 들어 본 적이 없군요. 그분이 누구입니까?

english: She's a hero from nearly two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.
translation: 거의 2천 년 전의 영웅이에요. Dragonkin Conflicts(드래곤킨 분쟁) 때 쿠렌드에 왔던 걸로 알고 있어요. 그녀에 대해 더 알고 싶어서요.

english: Two thousand years ago? That's long before the founding of Kourend. I'm afraid we have very few records from those times here.
translation: 2천 년 전이라고요? 쿠렌드가 세워지기 훨씬 전이군요. 유감이지만 이곳에는 그 시절 기록이 거의 없습니다.

english: Oh. So you can't help me?
translation: 아. 그럼 도와주실 수 없는 건가요?

english: I can't but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their house.
translation: 저는 어렵지만 도와줄 만한 사람은 있을 겁니다. 쿠렌드의 다섯 도시는 왕국보다 훨씬 먼저 세워졌습니다. 도시마다 역사가가 있으니, 각 가문의 초창기에 대해 더 많이 알고 있을지도 모릅니다.

english: Great. Is there a particular city you'd recommend?
