Hosidius and Shayzien were the two cities founded during the Dragonkin Conflicts. They might be the best ones to start with. The other cities were founded much earlier, during the God Wars.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)와 Shayzien(샤이지엔)은 드래곤킨 분쟁 때 세워진 두 도시입니다. 그 두 곳부터 시작하시는 게 가장 좋겠군요. 나머지 도시들은 그보다 훨씬 이른 God Wars(신들의 전쟁) 시기에 세워졌습니다.

english: Where can I find the Hosidius and Shayzien historians?
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)와 Shayzien(샤이지엔)의 역사가는 어디서 만날 수 있나요?

english: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Pub.
translation: Jonathan(조너선)이 호시디우스의 역사가입니다. Hosidius General Store(호시디우스 잡화점) 서쪽에 살지요. Amelia(아멜리아)는 샤이지엔의 역사가입니다. Shayzien Pub(샤이지엔 술집) 남서쪽에 삽니다.

english: Thanks for the help.
I have not. Did you try talking to the Hosidius and Shayzien historians about her.
translation: 들어 본 적이 없습니다. 그분에 대해 Hosidius(호시디우스)와 Shayzien(샤이지엔)의 역사가들에게 물어보셨습니까?

english: Where can I find them again?
translation: 그분들을 어디서 만날 수 있다고 하셨죠?

english: Horologist? What does that mean?
Tell me more about the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Is the Royal Accord of Twill still honoured today?
translation: Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)은 지금도 지켜지고 있나요?

english: Can you tell me more about Xeric?
translation: Xeric(제릭)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: So what is today's date?
Goodbye.
No thanks.
What about the time before the Accord was signed?
Have you ever heard of Camorra?
translation: Camorra(카모라)에 대해 들어 본 적 있으세요?

english: Hi there. How's it going?
What do you do here?
I keep the hunters well equipped! I can sell you hunting equipment at a reasonable price.
translation: 사냥꾼들이 장비를 잘 갖추도록 돕고 있어요! 사냥 장비를 적당한 가격에 팔아 드릴 수 있어요.

english: What have you got for sale?
Hunting supplies for every occasion.
translation: 어떤 상황에도 맞는 사냥 보급품이 다 있어요.

english: Never mind.
What do you do here?
What have you got for sale?
Never mind.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 한 가지로 치잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 별의별 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: Nothing.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 한 가지로 치잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 별의별 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: Nothing.
Hello. So, what is this place?
This is my home, mundane human! What do you have in your pockets? Something tasty?
translation: 여긴 내 집이야, 시시한 인간아! 주머니에 뭐가 들었어? 맛있는 거 있어?

english: Stay out of my pockets! I don't have anything that you want.
translation: 내 주머니에서 손 떼요! 당신이 원하는 건 하나도 없어요.

english: Ah, but do you have anything that *you* want?
translation: 아, 하지만 *네가* 원하는 건 있지 않아?

english: Of course I do!
Then you have something that implings want.
translation: 그럼 넌 임플링이 원하는 걸 가진 거야.

english: Eh?
We want things you people want. They are tasty to us! The more you want them, the tastier they are!
translation: 우린 너희 인간들이 원하는 걸 원해. 그게 우리한텐 맛있거든! 너희가 간절히 원할수록 더 맛있어!

english: So, you collect things that humans want? Interesting... So, what would happen if I caught an impling in a butterfly net?
translation: 그러니까 인간이 원하는 물건을 모은다는 거군요? 흥미롭네요... 그럼 butterfly net(나비 채집망)으로 impling(임플링)을 잡으면 어떻게 되나요?

english: Don't do that! That would be cruel. But chase us, yes! That is good. Implings are not easy to catch. Especially ones with really tasty food.
translation: 그러지 마! 그건 잔인하잖아. 하지만 쫓아다니는 건 좋아! 그건 괜찮아. 임플링은 잡기 쉽지 않아. 특히 정말 맛있는 걸 가진 녀석들은.

english: So, some of these implings have things that I will really want? Hmm, maybe it would be worth my while trying to catch some.
translation: 그러니까 어떤 임플링은 제가 정말 갖고 싶은 걸 갖고 있다는 거네요? 흠, 몇 마리 잡아 볼 만하겠는데요.

english: Going so soon?
Yes, get me out of here!
Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
translation: 아, 아니요. 조금 더 있다 갈게요.

english: Back where you came from, of course!
So not back to where the crop circle is now?
translation: 그럼 지금 crop circle(미스터리 서클)이 있는 곳으로 돌아가는 건 아니고요?

english: The aetheric thread connecting you to your own plane leads back to the wheat field where you came from. Obviously. So you will always go back to where you came from! Don't you humans know anything?
translation: 너를 네 차원과 이어 주는 에테르 실은 네가 왔던 밀밭으로 이어져 있어. 당연하잖아. 그러니까 넌 언제나 왔던 곳으로 돌아가는 거야! 너희 인간들은 아는 게 하나도 없어?

english: Evidently not.
You wanna leave?
Here, solve this.
That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 내가 보기엔 안 풀린 것 같은데.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Yes, get me out of here!
Ah, no I'll hang around a bit longer.
translation: 아, 아니요. 조금 더 있다 갈게요.

english: Where will I go if I leave?
Hey imp, can you hear me?
Of course I can hear ya, ya great big ape. You know, 'veres not even enuf space to swing Bob about in 'ere. How about a breather? You know, stretch me pins for a bit?
translation: 당연히 들리지, 이 커다란 원숭이 같은 놈아. 있잖냐, 여긴 Bob(밥)을 붙잡고 휘두를 공간두 없다고. 숨 좀 돌리게 해 주는 게 어때? 다리 좀 쭉 펴게 말이야?

english: No, I'm going to keep you in there. I might keep you as a pet.
translation: 아니, 넌 거기 계속 넣어 둘 거야. 애완동물로 키울지도 몰라.

english: Pet!! Nah mate. I fink you'd find dat you'd be my pet!! We is not makin good pets.
translation: 애완동물!! 됐거든, 친구. 내 생각엔 네가 내 애완동물이 될걸!! 우린 좋은 애완동물이 못 된다구.

english: Really? Why not?
Coz...errr...
We bite! Yeah we is biting and...and...er...
translation: 우린 문다! 그래, 우린 깨물고... 그리고... 어...

english: We is fire risk! Yeah dat's it! We be burning down your housey and stealin' all ya shiny gems. Oh, and da beads!! Mmmm, beads.
translation: 우린 불날 위험이 있다! 그래, 바로 그거야! 네 집을 홀랑 태워 먹고 반짝이는 보석을 죄다 훔쳐 갈 거라구. 아, 그리고 구슬!! 으음, 구슬.

english: Fire risk? How does that work?
Is those wizzies. Dey don't like de imps so dey make us go BOOOM!!
translation: 그 마법사 놈들 때문이지. 그놈들은 임프를 싫어해서 우릴 콰아앙!! 터지게 만든다구.

english: It's not that bad. You've got four big windows, charming company...er...
translation: 그렇게 나쁘진 않잖아. 커다란 창문이 네 개나 있고, 함께 있는 사람도 멋지고... 어...

english: Yeah, we's love tiny, crampt space. It be magical. But I is a busy imp, innit? Dragons needin' ticklin', shiny relics needin' stealin', you know how it goes.
translation: 그래, 우린 비좁고 답답한 데를 아주 좋아하지. 마법 같다니까. 근데 난 바쁜 임프라구, 안 그래? 간지럼 태워 줄 드래곤도 있고, 훔쳐 올 반짝이 유물도 있고, 뭐 다 알잖아.

english: So, if you's know whas good for ya, you'd be lettin' me go, right?
translation: 그러니까 뭐가 좋은지 알면, 날 풀어 주는 게 좋을걸, 안 그래?

english: Don't I get three wishes?
Nah, mate. Dunno what you're chirpin' about.
translation: 됐거든, 친구. 뭔 소릴 짹짹거리는지 모르겠네.

english: Well, you're a magical creature aren't you? Surely I get some wishes for capturing you, or releasing you, or something?
translation: 넌 마법 생물이잖아, 안 그래? 널 잡았든 풀어 주든 뭐든, 소원 몇 개쯤은 들어줘야 하는 거 아냐?

english: I'm finking dat you be a bit confoosed. I is an imp, not some namby-pamby genie or some kinda fairy. Ye can tell by the horns.
translation: 너 뭔가 단단히 헷갈리는 것 같은데. 난 임프지, 무슨 물러 터진 지니나 요정 같은 게 아니라구. 뿔을 보면 알잖아.

english: Sayin' dat, I don't fancy being cooped up like one of me uncle's pigeons. Tell you what, is there anything you need deliverin' to the bank? I may not be no cunjerer or sommink like dat, but I can get about nice
translation: 그건 그렇고, 우리 삼촌네 비둘기처럼 갇혀 지내는 건 영 내키지 않거든. 이러면 어때, 은행에 갖다 놓을 거 없어? 난 무슨 마법사 나부랭이 같은 건 아니지만, 이리저리 돌아다니는 건

english: an quick like. If you let me scarper, I'll take a couple of fings to the bank for ya. You game?
translation: 꽤 빠르다구. 날 내빼게 해 주면, 물건 두어 개를 은행에 갖다 줄게. 어때, 할래?

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
Surely it should be three items? Then it's one item per wish.
translation: 세 개여야 하는 거 아냐? 그래야 소원 하나에 물건 하나지.

english: I've already told ya, I ain't no bloomin' fairy. Besides, you know wot dey say, three's a crowd innit? I don't fink I can hop about carryin' more dan 2 fings.
translation: 내가 벌써 말했잖아, 난 망할 요정 따위가 아니라구. 게다가 셋은 너무 많다고들 하잖아, 안 그래? 두 개보다 많이 들고는 깡충깡충 못 다닐 것 같거든.

english: I've got nothing I need banking right now.
Great, just blinkin great, dat is. I'll just sit about countin' zombie sheep then. One...two...two and a bit...three and a bit more... I don't fink sheep 'ave dat many legs...
translation: 좋네, 아주 끝내주게 좋아. 그럼 난 그냥 앉아서 좀비 양이나 세고 있지 뭐. 하나... 둘... 둘 하고 조금... 셋 하고 조금 더... 양 다리가 그렇게 많진 않을 텐데...

english: Hey imp, are you still there?
An who's fault is that, eh? EH? I got betta fings to do dan sit ere waitin' for ya. 'Ave ya made up ya mind what else I'm luggin about?
translation: 그게 누구 탓인데, 엉? 엉? 난 여기 앉아서 너 기다리는 것보다 할 일이 많다구. 그래서 내가 또 뭘 낑낑 날라야 할지 정했냐?

english: Yes I have.
No, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
Dat's alright guv'nor. I'll get back to me luvverly dream about beads. Big shiny beads. Love it!
translation: 괜찮다구, 나리. 난 다시 구슬 나오는 근사한 꿈이나 꿀게. 크고 반짝이는 구슬. 너무 좋아!

english: Sorry, guv'nor, I seem to 'ave caught meself; I can't do nuffink right now.
translation: 미안하다, 나리. 내가 좀 걸려 있어서 말이야. 지금은 아무것도 못 해.

english: What use would that be in a bank? You'd be better off leaving it in yer house.
translation: 그런 걸 은행에 둬서 뭐 하게? 차라리 네 집에 두는 게 낫겠다.

english: Ow! That's hot! Put it in yer bank yerself!
translation: 앗! 뜨거! 은행엔 네가 직접 넣어!

english: No way, I can't bank your looting bag.
translation: 절대 안 돼, 네 looting bag(약탈 가방)은 은행에 못 넣어.

english: Nope, between me and you, that toad doesn't look stable.
translation: 싫어, 우리끼리 얘긴데, 그 두꺼비 상태가 좀 불안해 보여.

english: What good is banking that book? Just read it or throw it away!
translation: 그 책을 은행에 넣어서 뭐 해? 그냥 읽든가 버려!

english: I'm no expert, but when a mushroom glows that much, I'm guessing it's dangerous. Keep it away from me.
translation: 내가 잘 아는 건 아니지만, 버섯이 저렇게까지 빛나면 위험할 것 같은데. 나한테서 치워.

english: I'm not touching a gnome ball; that's a vicious game! I might die!
translation: gnome ball(노움 공)은 안 만질 거야. 그거 아주 험악한 경기라구! 죽을지도 몰라!

english: Don't you know? You can get into trouble for giving alcohol to minors, and I'm pretty small, it has to be said.
translation: 몰라? 미성년자한테 술을 주면 곤란해질 수 있다구. 솔직히 말해서 내가 꽤 작잖아.

english: There's something weird about those bones; I ain't touching them.
translation: 그 뼈 뭔가 이상해. 난 안 만질 거야.

english: It's a flipping stick; why bother banking that? You humans are crazy sometimes.
translation: 고작 망할 막대기잖아. 그걸 왜 은행에 넣어? 너희 인간들은 가끔 보면 미쳤어.

english: I know what lamps like that contain; I'm not touching it. I might get hurt.
translation: 저런 램프에 뭐가 들어 있는지 난 알지. 안 만질 거야. 다칠지도 모른다구.

english: The imp seems uneasy about teleporting that.
translation: 임프는 그것을 순간이동시키는 게 불안한 듯하다.

english: No, I'm going to keep you in there.
translation: 아니, 넌 거기 계속 넣어 둘 거야.

english: It's not that bad.
Don't I get three wishes?
Okay, that sounds fair.
Surely it should be three items?
I've got nothing I need banking right now.
Yes I have.
No, I'm afraid you're going to have to wait a bit longer.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 나한테 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: Down with rutabagas!
I may be a werewolf, but I do love the smell of frying onions.
translation: 내가 늑대인간이긴 해도, 양파 볶는 냄새는 정말 좋더라.

english: Onion skins very thin, mild winter coming in. Onion skins very tough, coming winter very rough.
translation: 양파 껍질 얇으면 포근한 겨울, 양파 껍질 질기면 혹독한 겨울.

english: Did you know the onion is of genus Allium and species cepa?
When you cut onions they release a gas that makes you cry.
translation: 양파를 썰면 눈물 나게 하는 가스가 나와.

english: Maybe I'll start an Onion Guild.
translation: Onion Guild(양파 길드)나 하나 차려 볼까.

english: People are like onions. They have lots of layers and sometimes smell quite pungent.
translation: 사람은 양파 같아. 겹겹이 층이 있고, 가끔 꽤 지독한 냄새가 나거든.

english: If you hear an onion ring, answer it!
Life is like an onion...well, sort of.
translation: 인생은 양파 같아... 뭐, 대충 그래.

english: I might try my hand at farming onions some time.
translation: 언제 한번 양파 농사나 지어 볼까 봐.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 한 가지로 치잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 별의별 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있나요?

english: Nothing.
Ohh, hello there, I see from our records that you've helped us out a bit, and I'd love to give you a bit of a reward for that.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 기록을 보니 저희를 꽤 도와주셨더라고요. 그 보답으로 작은 선물을 드리고 싶어요.

english: My father knew a lot about Prayer, Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer and Hunter, and I learnt some of his tricks... would you like me to share a little of my knowledge?
translation: 저희 아버지는 Prayer(기도), Mining(채광), Crafting(공예), Smithing(대장일), Slayer(슬레이어), Hunter(사냥)에 대해 많이 알고 계셨는데, 저도 그 요령을 좀 배웠거든요... 제 지식을 조금 나눠 드릴까요?

english: Yes, teach me something in those skills.
translation: 네, 그 스킬들에 대해 뭔가 가르쳐 주세요.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the Mining skill.
translation: Mining(채광) 스킬에 대한 지식이 늘어난 것 같다.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Mining and Crafting
translation: Mining(채광)과 Crafting(공예) 스킬에 대한 지식이 늘어난 것 같다

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: Crafting(공예), Smithing(대장일), Slayer(슬레이어), Prayer(기도), Hunter(사냥) 스킬에 대한 지식이 늘어난 것 같다.

english: You feel more knowledgeable in the skills Mining, Crafting, Smithing, Slayer, Prayer and Hunter.
translation: Mining(채광), Crafting(공예), Smithing(대장일), Slayer(슬레이어), Prayer(기도), Hunter(사냥) 스킬에 대한 지식이 늘어난 것 같다.

english: Wow, thanks.
You're most welcome. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 천만에요. 그럼, 더 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: No.
I'll come back later.
Okay!
Welcome to Varrock Museum. How can I help you today?
translation: Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 오늘은 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: You reach and take a map of the Museum.
translation: 손을 뻗어 박물관 안내 지도를 한 장 집었다.

english: Could you tell me about the Dig Site exhibit please?
translation: Dig Site(발굴 현장) 전시에 대해 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Of course. The Dig Site exhibit has several display cases of finds discovered on the Dig Site to the east of Varrock.
translation: 물론이죠. Dig Site(발굴 현장) 전시에는 바록 동쪽 발굴 현장에서 발견된 유물을 담은 진열장이 여러 개 있어요.

english: Unfortunately, you haven't passed your Earth Science exams, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested, visit the Education Centre on the Dig Site to the east and talk to the examiners there.
translation: 안타깝게도 아직 Earth Science(지구과학) 시험에 합격하지 않으셔서 발굴을 도와주실 자격이 없어요. 관심 있으시면 동쪽 발굴 현장의 Education Centre(교육 센터)에 가서 시험관들과 이야기해 보세요.

english: As you've passed your Earth Science exams at the Dig Site, you can go through into the cleaning area and clean off some finds. This will help our Dig Site display floor to give a more accurate view of life back in the
translation: 발굴 현장에서 Earth Science(지구과학) 시험에 합격하셨으니, 세척 구역에 들어가서 유물을 세척하실 수 있어요. 그러면 저희 발굴 현장 전시층이 제3시대와

english: 3rd and 4th Ages, as well as earning you Kudos. If you'd like to know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.
translation: 제4시대의 생활상을 더 정확하게 보여 줄 수 있고, Kudos(쿠도스)도 얻으실 수 있어요. 유물 세척에 대해 더 알고 싶으시면 고고학자들에게 물어보세요.

english: I see you've already helped out in the Dig Site exhibit. Our picture of life back in the 3rd and 4th Ages in that old city is really becoming clearer. There are still a few displays that need updating, though. If you'd like to
translation: 발굴 현장 전시를 이미 도와주셨군요. 그 옛 도시의 제3시대와 제4시대 생활상이 점점 뚜렷해지고 있어요. 그래도 아직 새로 채워야 할 전시가 몇 개 남아 있어요. 유물 세척에 대해

english: know more about cleaning finds, just ask the archaeologists.

You have really helped out a lot. I see all the nice clean finds with their information are in the once empty cases. I'm sure we'll get some more cases in soon for you to fill. For now, perhaps you should investigate the
translation: 정말 많이 도와주셨어요. 비어 있던 진열장마다 설명이 붙은 깨끗한 유물이 가득하네요. 곧 채워 주실 진열장이 더 들어올 거예요. 지금은 박물관의 나머지 부분을

english: rest of the Museum.
Bye.
Have a good day!
Could you tell me about the Timeline exhibit please?
Why, yes. The Timeline exhibit has lots of display cases showing things from the beginning of time right up to the present day.
translation: 그럼요. Timeline(연표) 전시에는 태초부터 지금까지의 물건을 보여 주는 진열장이 많이 있어요.

english: You could help out in the Timeline exhibit upstairs. By providing information you may have gathered on your travels around the world, you can help to make our displays more comprehensive and earn yourself Kudos
translation: 위층 Timeline(연표) 전시를 도와주실 수도 있어요. 세계 곳곳을 여행하며 모은 정보를 알려 주시면 전시를 더 알차게 만들 수 있고, Kudos(쿠도스)도

english: too.

I know you've helped out a bit in the Timeline exhibit upstairs, but I'm sure you can help more. When you're out on your travels being a brave adventurer, remember that you can come back to the Museum
translation: 위층 Timeline(연표) 전시를 조금 도와주신 건 알지만, 더 도와주실 수 있을 거예요. 용감한 모험가로서 여행을 다니시다가, 퀘스트를 마친 뒤에는 박물관에 돌아와서

english: after some quests to let us know important historical facts. This will help us to update the displays and make the Museum a more informative place! You'll earn yourself Kudos too.
translation: 중요한 역사적 사실을 알려 주세요. 그러면 전시를 새로 고쳐 박물관을 더 유익한 곳으로 만들 수 있어요! Kudos(쿠도스)도 얻으실 수 있고요.

english: I see you have filled up the display cases we have, and given us large amounts of information for the Timeline exhibit. At the moment, you have left us nothing to do ourselves, but I'm sure we'll be getting some new cases
translation: 저희가 가진 진열장을 다 채워 주시고, Timeline(연표) 전시에 엄청나게 많은 정보를 주셨네요. 지금은 저희가 할 일이 하나도 안 남았지만, 곧 새 진열장이

english: in soon for you to help us out with! For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: 들어올 테니 그때 또 도와주세요! 지금은 박물관의 나머지 부분을 둘러보시는 게 어떨까요.

english: Okay, thanks. One more question: why are the display numbers all out of sequence?
translation: 알겠어요, 고마워요. 하나만 더 물어볼게요. 전시 번호가 왜 다 뒤죽박죽이에요?

english: Ahh, that's due to the numbering being done as we were constructing the cases and putting the displays in them, then shuffling them into the right places. We thought rather than renumbering them all - such a
translation: 아아, 그건 진열장을 만들고 전시물을 넣으면서 번호를 매긴 다음, 제자리로 이리저리 옮겼기 때문이에요. 번호를 전부 다시 매길까도 했지만, 라벨 쓰는 일이 너무

english: boring job, writing labels - we'd leave it. They all have unique numbers and future displays would mess up the consecutive numbering anyway.
translation: 지루해서 그냥 두기로 했어요. 번호는 다 고유하고, 어차피 앞으로 전시가 추가되면 연속 번호는 엉망이 될 테니까요.

english: Ahhh, I see.
Could you tell me about the Natural History exhibit please?
translation: Natural History(자연사) 전시에 대해 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Why, yes. The Natural History exhibit has displays of various creatures you can find around Gielinor.
translation: 그럼요. Natural History(자연사) 전시에는 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 볼 수 있는 다양한 생물이 전시되어 있어요.

english: Downstairs, in the Natural History exhibit, you can answer quizzes about animals to show us your knowledge and earn Kudos at the same time. Talk to Orlando, I'm sure he'd appreciate your knowledge.
translation: 아래층 Natural History(자연사) 전시에서는 동물 퀴즈를 풀어 지식을 보여 주시고 동시에 Kudos(쿠도스)도 얻으실 수 있어요. Orlando(올랜도)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 분명 반가워할 거예요.

english: I see you have already demonstrated some of your knowledge of the natural world in the Natural History exhibit, so why not pop down and do some more quizzes with Orlando! You can earn Kudos at the same time.
translation: Natural History(자연사) 전시에서 자연에 대한 지식을 이미 어느 정도 보여 주셨군요. 아래층에 내려가서 Orlando(올랜도)와 퀴즈를 더 풀어 보시는 건 어때요! Kudos(쿠도스)도 함께 얻으실 수 있어요.

english: You really know your stuff when it comes to animals, don't you! Orlando tells me you have exceeded his teachings. For now, perhaps you should investigate the rest of the Museum.
translation: 동물에 대해서라면 정말 박사시네요! Orlando(올랜도) 말로는 가르칠 걸 이미 다 넘어서셨대요. 지금은 박물관의 나머지 부분을 둘러보시는 게 어떨까요.

english: But what's natural history got to do with existing animals?
translation: 그런데 자연사가 지금 살아 있는 동물이랑 무슨 상관이에요?

english: The study of natural history is simply the study of the history of the species. The species doesn't necessarily need to be an extinct one.
translation: 자연사 연구란 그냥 종의 역사를 연구하는 거예요. 꼭 멸종한 종일 필요는 없답니다.

english: What is Kudos?
Kudos is a measure of how much you've assisted the Museum. The more information you give us, Dig Site finds that you clean and quizzes you solve, the higher your Kudos.
translation: Kudos(쿠도스)는 박물관을 얼마나 도와주셨는지 나타내는 척도예요. 정보를 많이 주실수록, 발굴 현장 유물을 많이 세척하실수록, 퀴즈를 많이 푸실수록 쿠도스가 올라가요.

english: But what's it for?

Well, recently we found a rather interesting island to the north of Morytania. We believe that it may be of archaeological significance. I suspect we'll be looking for qualified archaeologists once we have constructed our
translation: 음, 최근에 Morytania(모리타니아) 북쪽에서 꽤 흥미로운 섬을 발견했어요. 고고학적으로 중요한 곳일지도 몰라요. 운하와 바지선을 다 만들고 나면

english: canal and barge. So, we're using Kudos as a measure of who is willing and able to help us here at the Museum, so they can then be invited on our dig on the new island.
translation: 자격 있는 고고학자들을 찾게 될 거예요. 그래서 박물관 일을 도울 의지와 능력이 있는 사람을 가리는 기준으로 Kudos(쿠도스)를 쓰고 있어요. 그런 분들을 새 섬 발굴에 초대하려고요.

english: Would I qualify, then?
Unfortunately, you haven't earned enough Kudos yet, so you aren't qualified to help us on the dig. If you're interested in helping us out and getting that Kudos, simply help out around the Museum.
translation: 안타깝게도 아직 Kudos(쿠도스)가 충분하지 않아서 발굴을 도와주실 자격이 없어요. 관심 있으시면 박물관 곳곳의 일을 도와 쿠도스를 모아 보세요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Why yes! You've helped us so much around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams you took. When the canal is ready, we'll let you know.
translation: 물론이죠! 박물관 일을 정말 많이 도와주셨고, Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 자격도 갖추셨으니까요. 운하가 완성되면 알려 드릴게요.

english: Thank you, I'll look forward to it!
Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 잘하셨어요! 알려 드릴 새로운 정보가 있어요.

english: Yes, teach me something in those skills.
translation: 네, 그 스킬들에 대해 뭔가 가르쳐 주세요.

english: No
Take a map of the Museum
Find out about the Dig Site exhibit.
translation: Dig Site(발굴 현장) 전시에 대해 알아보기.

english: Ask about something else.
Bye
Find out about the Timeline exhibit.
Find out about the Natural History exhibit.
But what's Natural History got to do with existing animals?
translation: 그런데 자연사가 지금 살아 있는 동물이랑 무슨 상관이에요?

english: Find out about Kudos.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장님께 가 보시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 의심하고 있어서, 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수가 없다.

english: Hello. I'm looking for a member of the council of elders who will support my application to become an honorary Fremennik.
translation: 안녕하세요. 제가 명예 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 될 수 있도록 지지해 주실 원로회 의원을 찾고 있어요.

english: I'm a council member.
So can I somehow persuade you to vote for me at the council of elders?
translation: 그럼 원로회에서 저에게 표를 주시도록 어떻게든 설득할 수 있을까요?

english: No. Frankly, I don't like you.
translation: 아니오. 솔직히 말해 난 당신이 싫소.

english: But you don't even know me!
You also smell bad. And have stupid hair. And bad breath. And you walk a bit funny.
translation: 게다가 냄새도 고약하고. 머리 모양도 멍청하고. 입 냄새도 나고. 걸음걸이도 좀 우스꽝스럽소.

english: I didn't come all the way up here just to be insulted!
translation: 모욕이나 들으려고 여기까지 올라온 게 아니에요!

english: No, I'm quite sure you could have found plenty of people to insult you wherever your home is.
translation: 그렇겠구려. 당신 고향 어디서든 당신을 모욕해 줄 사람은 얼마든지 찾을 수 있었을 테니 말이오.

english: You know what? Forget you, you stupid barbarian! I don't need your stupid vote!
translation: 있잖아요? 됐어요, 이 멍청한 야만인 같으니! 당신의 그 멍청한 표 따위 필요 없어요!

english: Tch, typical outerlander rudeness. I'm glad I didn't vote for you now.
translation: 쯧, 역시 무례한 외지인답군. 표를 주지 않길 잘했소.

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 왔구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 내게 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요, 고마워요. 그냥 얘기나 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하면 언제든 찾아오시오, [Fremennik name]. 내 문은 늘 열려 있소.

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 본 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 잘 돌아왔소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 당신을 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 당신과 여기서 노닥거릴 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 원하는 게 있었던 건 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 잘 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 당신에게 만사가 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
translation: 저는 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 당신은 어떠세요?

english: All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
translation: 안녕하시오. 내게 뭔가 볼일이 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어떻게 내 물건을 훔칠 수가 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 왜 내 물건을 훔치려 한 거요, [Fremennik name]?

english: I think the locals are taking a liking to us! One of them hasn't stopped wearing those clothes Arnkel sold her. Much better than those piddly little things she was wearing before!

english: As anIron[man/woman], you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.

translation: 이 섬을 떠나면 Lumbridge(럼브리지)에서 제 동료 Adam(애덤)을 만날 수 있어요. 하지만 그는 제한을 낮추는 것만 해 주고, 높이는 건 안 해 줘요.
