Hey there [Paul/Adam].
Hail, Iron[man/woman]! What can I do for you?

In addition to the standard restrictions,Hardcore Iron[man/woman]only haveone life. In the event of a dangerous death, yourHardcore Iron[man/woman]status will be downgraded to that of astandard Iron[man/woman], and your
translation: 기본 제한에 더해, Hardcore Iron[man/woman](하드코어 아이언맨)은 목숨이 하나뿐이에요. 위험한 죽음을 당하면 하드코어 Iron[man/woman] 상태가 standard Iron[man/woman](일반 아이언맨)으로 떨어지고,

english: stats will be frozen on theHardcore Iron[man/woman]hiscores.
translation: 능력치는 Hardcore Iron[man/woman](하드코어 아이언맨) 하이스코어에 그대로 멈춰요.

english: In addition to the standard restrictions,Ultimate Iron[man/woman]are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
translation: 기본 제한에 더해, Ultimate Iron[man/woman](얼티밋 아이언맨)은 은행을 쓸 수 없고, 죽으면 가진 아이템을 전부 떨어뜨려요.

english: While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being astandard Iron[man/woman], anUltimate Iron[man/woman], aHardcore Iron[man/woman]or a normal player.
translation: Tutorial Island(튜토리얼 섬)에 있는 동안에는 standard Iron[man/woman](일반 아이언맨), Ultimate Iron[man/woman](얼티밋 아이언맨), Hardcore Iron[man/woman](하드코어 아이언맨), 일반 플레이어 사이를 자유롭게 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: So he will letHardcore Iron[man/woman]orUltimate Iron[man/woman]downgrade tostandard Iron[man/woman], and he'll let all types ofIron[man/woman]become normal players.
translation: 그러니까 Hardcore Iron[man/woman](하드코어 아이언맨)이나 Ultimate Iron[man/woman](얼티밋 아이언맨)은 standard Iron[man/woman](일반 아이언맨)으로 낮출 수 있고, 모든 종류의 Iron[man/woman](아이언맨)은 일반 플레이어가 될 수 있어요.

english: You're astandard Iron[man/woman]. You can downgrade yourself to a normal player if you like.
translation: 당신은 standard Iron[man/woman](일반 아이언맨)이에요. 원하면 일반 플레이어로 낮출 수 있어요.

english: I'd like to review my Iron[man/woman] mode.
Have you any armour for me, please?
There you go. Wear it with pride.
Hello, [player name]. I'm the Iron[man/woman] tutor. What can I do for you?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 저는 Iron[man/woman] tutor(아이언맨 교사)예요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: You can choose to become anIron[man/woman]while you're on Tutorial Island. Although you can't do that on this account, you might like to bear it in mind for the future.
translation: Tutorial Island(튜토리얼 섬)에 있는 동안에는 Iron[man/woman](아이언맨)이 되기로 선택할 수 있어요. 이 계정에서는 할 수 없지만, 나중을 위해 기억해 두면 좋을 거예요.

english: You're not an Iron[man/woman]. This armour is only for them.
translation: 당신은 Iron[man/woman](아이언맨)이 아니에요. 이 갑옷은 아이언맨 전용이에요.

english: Sorry, Iron Man mode isn't available on Deadman worlds.
translation: 미안하지만 Deadman(데드맨) 월드에서는 Iron Man(아이언맨) 모드를 쓸 수 없어요.

english: Hello there, [player name]. Everyone taking part in the Leagues II - Trailblazer is under Iron [Men/Women] restrictions once they leave Tutorial Island.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. Leagues II - Trailblazer(리그 II - 트레일블레이저)에 참가하는 모두는 Tutorial Island(튜토리얼 섬)을 떠나면 Iron [Men/Women](아이언맨) 제한을 받아요.

english: I'd like to change my Iron Man mode.
If you're interested in the Fresh Start Worlds, you should know that you can't be an Iron Man on those.
translation: Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)에 관심이 있다면, 거기서는 Iron Man(아이언맨)이 될 수 없다는 걸 알아 두세요.

english: What are Fresh Start Worlds?
translation: Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)가 뭔가요?

english: Fresh Start Worlds are worlds that have a fresh economy to build and fresh hiscores to chase.
translation: Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)는 새로운 경제를 일구고 새로운 하이스코어를 노릴 수 있는 월드예요.

english: They're a way to experience Old School RuneScape as if it were new, today!
translation: Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프)를 지금 막 새로 나온 것처럼 경험하는 방법이죠!

english: They will last for 6 months, after which your account will be transferedto the main game and you can carry on playing as normal there.
translation: 6개월 동안 운영되고, 그 뒤에는 계정이 본 게임으로 옮겨져서 거기서 평소처럼 계속 플레이할 수 있어요.

english: There is a World First system, which are achievements only obtainable once on all worlds, so you can race against others for these!
translation: World First(월드 퍼스트) 시스템도 있어요. 모든 월드를 통틀어 단 한 번만 얻을 수 있는 업적이라, 다른 사람들과 경쟁할 수 있어요!

english: If a global race is a bit too much, then there is also an Achievement Point system. You can compete against your friends to get the most points.
translation: 전 세계 경쟁이 좀 부담스럽다면 Achievement Point(업적 점수) 시스템도 있어요. 친구들과 누가 점수를 더 많이 얻는지 겨룰 수 있어요.

english: Other than that, it's the same Old School experience you know and love, with all the same content as the main game.
translation: 그 밖에는 여러분이 알고 사랑하는 Old School(올드 스쿨) 그대로예요. 콘텐츠도 본 게임과 전부 같아요.

english: Do you still wish to proceed with selecting an Iron Man mode?
translation: 그래도 Iron Man(아이언맨) 모드 선택을 계속할래요?

english: Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 네, Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)에는 관심 없어요.

english: That's okay. If you change your mind you can find out more about Fresh Start Worlds by speaking to the Magic Instructor, assuming you're not an ironman.
translation: 괜찮아요. 마음이 바뀌면 Magic Instructor(마법 교관)에게 Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)에 대해 더 물어볼 수 있어요. 아이언맨이 아니라면요.

english: You'll have to remove any ironman status first by speaking to me.
translation: 그러려면 먼저 저한테 와서 아이언맨 상태를 없애야 해요.

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
translation: 아뇨, Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)가 딱 제 취향 같아요!

english: Lovely! You can talk to the Magic Instructor to find out more about Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 좋아요! Magic Instructor(마법 교관)과 이야기하면 Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)에 대해 더 알 수 있어요.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to help me with this.
Please give me your answer!
Correct - I despise snakes!
Nope, not correct!
Tell me about Iron[men/women].
I'd like to change my Iron[man/woman] mode.
I'm fine, thanks.
Have you any armour for me, please?
I'd like to review my Iron[man/woman] mode.
What are Fresh Start Worlds?
translation: Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)가 뭔가요?

english: That's fine, I'm not interested in those.
Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.
translation: 네, Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)에는 관심 없어요.

english: No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
translation: 아뇨, Fresh Start Worlds(새 출발 월드)가 딱 제 취향 같아요!

english: Hey, what do you do here?
I help the main man over there. He can get a bit cantankerous. Every now and then he'll just start attacking people without warning. I act as a sort of home help...
translation: 저기 계신 대장님을 도와드려요. 그분이 좀 괴팍하시거든요. 가끔 아무 예고도 없이 사람들을 공격하기 시작하세요. 저는 일종의 가사 도우미 같은 거예요...

english: How do you mean, home help?

Well, sometimes he'll fly right off the handle and just start, you know, 'raising the dead' to do his 'bidding'. That kind of activity is just so anti-social, so it tends to attract a lot of hero types, you know!
translation: 음, 가끔 그분이 버럭 화를 내시면서, 그러니까, 자기 '명령'을 따르게 하려고 '죽은 자를 일으키기' 시작하세요. 그런 짓은 너무 반사회적이라서, 영웅 같은 사람들이 많이 꼬이거든요!

english: Yes, yes, I know the sort...full of themselves aren't they.
translation: 네, 네, 어떤 부류인지 알아요... 다들 자기가 잘난 줄 알죠.

english: Exactly! They come in all, 'Have at thee! ' and 'Death to you evil one', it's all a bit too dramatic for me to be honest.
translation: 바로 그거예요! 다들 '덤벼라!'니 '죽어라, 사악한 자여'니 하면서 들어오는데, 솔직히 저한텐 좀 너무 과장스러워요.

english: Anyway, he'll often end up getting killed and nothing get's done around the house while he's awaiting his mortal return.
translation: 아무튼 그분은 결국 죽임을 당할 때가 많은데, 그분이 이승으로 돌아오길 기다리는 동안엔 집안일이 하나도 안 돼요.

english: Mortal return? Sounds interesting.
Well, it's kind of interesting the first few times, but it's like falling off a bike...
translation: 음, 처음 몇 번은 꽤 흥미롭지만, 자전거 타다 넘어지는 거랑 비슷해요...

english: What, you graze your knees a lot?
I was going to say that you soon get fed-up with it. I guess it's one of those perks of the job though, ability to raise yourself from the dead.
translation: 금방 질린다는 말을 하려던 거였어요. 뭐, 그것도 이 일의 특전 중 하나겠죠. 죽음에서 스스로 되살아나는 능력 말이에요.

english: You'd think he'd do better things with a gift like that, but all he tends to do is get angry at people who come into his house without being invited and then he's off again 'raising the dead'.
translation: 그런 재능이 있으면 더 좋은 일에 쓸 법도 한데, 그분이 하는 거라곤 초대도 안 했는데 집에 들어온 사람들한테 화내는 것뿐이고, 그러고 나면 또 '죽은 자를 일으키러' 가 버리세요.

english: I found this torn page, do you know anything about it?
translation: 이 torn page(찢어진 페이지)를 찾았는데, 이것에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Hey...I hope you didn't rip that page out of one of those books, they'll be trouble if it was.
translation: 저기요... 설마 그 책들 중 한 권에서 그 페이지를 찢어 낸 건 아니겠죠? 그랬다면 큰일 날 거예요.

english: No, it wasn't actually, I got it from somewhere else, do you recognise it?
translation: 아뇨, 사실 그건 아니에요. 다른 데서 구했어요. 혹시 알아보시겠어요?

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks like text from one of the books. Have you checked at the wizards' guild in Yanille? We sometime loan books to them.
translation: 흠, 확실히 그 책들 중 하나에 있던 글처럼 보이네요. Yanille(야닐)의 마법사 길드에는 가 보셨어요? 저희가 가끔 거기에 책을 빌려주거든요.

english: Hi, do you know anything about this book?
translation: 안녕하세요, 이 책에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Hey...that book has been loaned to the wizards' guild in Yanille, I hope you're not returning it in a damaged condition!
translation: 저기요... 그 책은 Yanille(야닐)의 마법사 길드에 빌려준 거예요. 설마 망가진 채로 돌려주러 온 건 아니겠죠!

english: Well, I was just wondering where the book came from actually and try to get some more information about it.
translation: 음, 사실 이 책이 어디서 왔는지 궁금해서 좀 더 알아보려던 참이었어요.

english: Well, that book looks as if it's been through the wars...you're not going to return it in that condition. You take it back to the wizards at Yanille, they borrowed it, so it's their responsibility.
translation: 음, 그 책은 전쟁이라도 치르고 온 것 같은 꼴이네요... 그런 상태로 돌려받을 순 없어요. Yanille(야닐)의 마법사들한테 도로 가져가세요. 그 사람들이 빌려 갔으니 그 사람들 책임이에요.

english: Be on your guard friend.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
The Wintertodt terrorised Great Kourend many centuries ago. It destroyed much of this northern land over many years before it was finally driven back into this prison.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)는 수백 년 전 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 공포에 떨게 했어요. 오랜 세월 이 북쪽 땅의 상당 부분을 파괴하다가 결국 이 감옥으로 다시 쫓겨 들어갔죠.

english: Why did it attack Kourend?
No one knows for sure but I have a theory...
translation: 확실히 아는 사람은 없지만, 제게 가설이 하나 있어요...

english: Which is?
The Dark Altar. It felt the altar's power and wanted to consume it for itself. It wouldn't be the first time...
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)예요. 그것이 제단의 힘을 느끼고 그 힘을 독차지해 집어삼키려 했던 거죠. 그런 일이 처음도 아니고요...

english: Interesting...
Tell me about yourself.
I'm Ish, one of the navigators of Piscarilius.
translation: 저는 Ish(이시)예요. Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스)의 항해사 중 한 명이죠.

english: What brings a navigator up here?
translation: 항해사가 이런 곳엔 무슨 일로 왔어요?

english: Lady Piscarilius has sent me here to keep an eye on the situation. She doesn't trust the other houses and believes something sinister is going on.
translation: Lady Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스 영주)님께서 상황을 지켜보라고 저를 여기 보내셨어요. 영주님은 다른 가문들을 믿지 않으시고, 뭔가 불길한 일이 벌어지고 있다고 생각하세요.

english: Like what?
I don't know, but I intend to find out.
What do you think of the Pyromancers?
I've heard stories about them and the things they have done over the years. Be careful, they can't be trusted.
translation: 그들에 대한 이야기와 그들이 오랜 세월 해 온 일들에 대해 들은 적이 있어요. 조심하세요, 그들은 믿을 수 없어요.

english: You seem a bit paranoid.
Better to be paranoid than a fool. Anyone with any sense knows that the Pyromancers are trouble. They say even Lord Arceuus doesn't trust them.
translation: 바보가 되느니 의심 많은 편이 낫죠. 생각이 있는 사람이라면 누구나 화염술사들이 골칫거리라는 걸 알아요. Lord Arceuus(아르세우스 영주)조차 그들을 믿지 않는다고들 하더군요.

english: I have to go.
Stay vigilant friend.
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about yourself.
What do you think of the Pyromancers?
I have to go.
Hello, what do you do around here?
The name's Ishmael. I sell fishing supplies, along with some of the local catch.
translation: 내 이름은 Ishmael(이스마엘)이지. 낚시 보급품이랑 이 근처에서 잡은 물고기를 좀 팔고 있어.

english: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Aye.
Why did you set up shop around here? It seems a little run down.
translation: 왜 이런 데에 가게를 차리셨어요? 좀 허름해 보이는데요.

english: Argh... run down it is! But since Tempoross showed up, seadogs from all across Gielinor have been coming to wrangle the beast. It only made sense to sell off our spare resources.
translation: 크... 허름하긴 하지! 하지만 Tempoross(템포로스)가 나타난 뒤로 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳의 뱃사람들이 그 괴물을 잡겠다고 몰려들고 있거든. 남는 물자를 내다 파는 게 당연한 일이었지.

english: I think that's everything. Goodbye.
translation: 이제 다 물어본 것 같아요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Safe travels.
Can I take a look at what you have in stock?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Why did you set up shop around here? Seems a little run down.
translation: 왜 이런 데에 가게를 차리셨어요? 좀 허름해 보이는데요.

english: Goodbye.
Welcome to the Grand Library Historical Archive.
translation: Grand Library Historical Archive(대도서관 역사 기록 보관소)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: What is this place?
This is the Library Historical Archive. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
translation: 이곳은 Library Historical Archive(도서관 역사 기록 보관소)입니다. 첫 번째 십년기까지 거슬러 올라가는, Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드) 역사의 모든 시대에 걸친 역사 문서와 문헌을 찾아보실 수 있습니다.

english: Are you looking for something in particular?
What information do you have on Xeric?
Ah, Xeric. Our most infamous ruler... We do have extensive records regarding Xeric. You can examine some of the texts here or speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 아, Xeric(제릭) 말씀이군요. 우리 역사상 가장 악명 높은 통치자죠... 제릭에 관해서는 방대한 기록을 보유하고 있습니다. 이곳의 문헌을 살펴보셔도 되고, 제릭 시대 전문가인 Ektheme(엑테메)와 이야기해 보셔도 됩니다.

english: Is there something else I can help you with?
What can you tell me about the Wintertodt?
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)에 대해 무엇을 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: The Wintertodt, or the Winter beast as it was often known at the time, terrorised northern Kourend for five decades.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)는, 당시에는 흔히 겨울 야수라고도 불렸는데, 50년 동안 Kourend(쿠렌드) 북부를 공포에 떨게 했습니다.

english: Logios is currently studying the Wintertodt Invasion, and we have various texts from that era.
translation: 현재 Logios(로기오스)가 Wintertodt(윈터토트) 침공을 연구하고 있으며, 그 시대의 다양한 문헌도 소장하고 있습니다.

english: What can you tell me about Mount Quidamortem?
translation: Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산)에 대해 무엇을 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Our first records of the mountain date back to the 36th decade where a Shayzien patrol discovered the mountain during a survey of the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 그 산에 대한 최초의 기록은 36번째 십년기로 거슬러 올라갑니다. Shayzien(샤이지엔)의 순찰대가 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)를 조사하던 중 그 산을 발견했지요.

english: King Shayzien VII was keen on conquering more land for Kourend and demanded his people explore suitable territories.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 영토를 넓히는 데 열을 올렸고, 백성들에게 적합한 땅을 탐사하라고 명령했습니다.

english: The mountain became known as Mount Quidamortem after it was realised venturing towards the summit resulted in certain death.
translation: 정상을 향해 나아가면 반드시 죽음을 맞는다는 사실이 알려진 뒤로, 그 산은 Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산)으로 불리게 되었습니다.

english: Gnosi is our expert on Mount Quidamortem, but I'm afraid she's currently on an expedition to the temple near the summit of the mountain. However, we do have some texts available detailing the great expedition.
translation: Gnosi(노시)가 Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산) 전문가이지만, 안타깝게도 지금은 산 정상 근처의 신전으로 탐사를 떠나 있습니다. 다만 대원정에 대해 자세히 다룬 문헌이 몇 권 있습니다.

english: No thanks.
What do you do here?
My name is Istoria. I'm the chief historian and curator of the Library Historical Archive.
translation: 제 이름은 Istoria(이스토리아)입니다. Library Historical Archive(도서관 역사 기록 보관소)의 수석 역사가이자 관장이지요.

english: How do I get out of here?
I can teleport you back to the Grand Library. Would you like to leave now?
translation: Grand Library(대도서관)으로 순간이동시켜 드릴 수 있습니다. 지금 나가시겠습니까?

english: Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: Well you've come to the right place. What would you like to know?
I'm searching for information on an expedition to Mount Quidamortem during his reign.
translation: 그분의 재위 기간에 있었던 Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산) 원정에 대한 정보를 찾고 있어요.

english: Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII's reign was quite a violent one according to the history books. The expedition to Quidamortem was part of his aggressive plans to expand Kourend's territory.
translation: 아, 네. 그 원정이라면 압니다. 역사서에 따르면 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)의 치세는 꽤나 폭력적이었습니다. Quidamortem(퀴다모르템) 원정은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 영토를 넓히려는 그의 공격적인 계획의 일부였지요.

english: Unfortunately, the expedition was a failure and the entire party was killed. The king himself died a few years later and was succeeded by the tyrant Xeric. No more expeditions were ordered under his rule.
translation: 안타깝게도 원정은 실패했고 원정대 전원이 목숨을 잃었습니다. 왕 자신도 몇 년 뒤 세상을 떠났고, 폭군 Xeric(제릭)이 뒤를 이었습니다. 제릭의 통치 아래에서는 더 이상 원정이 명령되지 않았습니다.

english: Does that help you?
No not really. I have reason to believe that not everyone was killed on that expedition.
translation: 아뇨, 별로요. 그 원정에서 모두가 죽은 건 아니라고 믿을 만한 이유가 있거든요.

english: I'm afraid I can't help you there, all the evidence we have tells us that the expedition had no survivors.
translation: 그 부분은 도와드릴 수 없을 것 같습니다. 저희가 가진 모든 증거는 그 원정에 생존자가 없었다고 말하고 있으니까요.

english: So I'm at a dead end?
It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the kings' additions to the Tower of Magic.
translation: 그런 것 같습니다. 하지만 King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)에 대해 더 알고 싶으시다면 Pagida(파기다)와 이야기해 보시는 것도 좋겠습니다. 그는 최근 Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)에 왕들이 증축한 부분을 조사하고 있습니다.

english: Okay, thanks.
Do you know anything about Camorra? She was a hero who lived around two thousand years ago.
translation: Camorra(카모라)에 대해 아는 게 있으세요? 약 2천 년 전에 살았던 영웅이에요.

english: I have heard that name, though we have very few records from before the founding of Kourend. Perhaps Imerominia could help you? She is the Horologist of the library; such ancient topics may fall within her purview.
translation: 들어 본 이름이지만, Kourend(쿠렌드) 건국 이전의 기록은 거의 없습니다. Imerominia(이메로미니아)라면 도와드릴 수 있지 않을까요? 그녀는 이 도서관의 시간학자라서, 그렇게 오래된 주제도 그녀의 소관일지 모릅니다.

english: Thanks.
What is this place?
What information do you have on Xeric?
What can you tell me about the Wintertodt?
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)에 대해 무엇을 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: What can you tell me about Mount Quidamortem?
translation: Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산)에 대해 무엇을 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: What do you do here?
How do I get out of here?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: Do you know anything about Camorra?
Urgh...
He looks too sick to chat.
translation: 너무 아파서 대화할 수 없을 것 같다.

english: Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 와, 영웅님이다! 대단해요! 대체 어떻게 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치운 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요. 진짜 대단한 일을 해내셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Ivan, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: 난 Ivan(이반)이에요. 그냥 꼬마지만, 한 방 먹일 수 있다고요! 그렇게 세 보이지도 않는데요!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 딱 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyre(뱀파이어)들을 피해 숨어 살면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우겨우 먹고살고 있어요. 곧 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강의 신전까지 갈 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 정말 고마워하고 있어요. 전 영웅을 직접 보거나 알았던 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기엔 영웅님이 진짜 영웅일 거예요! 저는 영웅님을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Is something new and exciting happening?
Maybe. Veliaf has asked me to do some work for him. Hopefully it will benefit you all.
translation: 아마도. Veliaf(벨리아프)가 나한테 일을 좀 부탁했거든. 너희 모두한테 도움이 됐으면 좋겠어.

english: [player name].
Hey Ivan.
How are you doing?
Fine.
Are you sure? You know I'm here if you need anything.
translation: 정말이야? 필요한 거 있으면 내가 여기 있다는 거 알지?

english: I'm fine. Did you need something?
Just checking in. I'll leave you be.
translation: 그냥 안부 물으러 왔어. 이만 혼자 있게 해 줄게.

english: I need another flail.
I have some here, along with a few other things. It will cost you though.
translation: 여기 몇 개 있어. 다른 물건도 좀 있고. 대신 돈은 내야 해.

english: I need another Drakan's Medallion.
translation: Drakan's Medallion(드라칸의 메달)이 하나 더 필요해.

english: Sure.
I'd better get going.
[player name]. I have a tome here that I think belongs to you.
translation: [player name]. 네 것 같은 책이 여기 하나 있어.

english: Thank you, Ivan.
How are you doing?
I need another flail.
I need another Drakan's Medallion.
translation: Drakan's Medallion(드라칸의 메달)이 하나 더 필요해.

english: Just checking in. I'll leave you be.
translation: 그냥 안부 물으러 왔어. 이만 혼자 있게 해 줄게.

english: I'd better get going.
You look like a man that could use a mace. Finest weapons around! Want to take a look?
translation: 철퇴가 필요해 보이는 분이시네요. 이 근방 최고의 무기예요! 한번 보실래요?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Your loss, I suppose. You won't find a weapon like a mace!
translation: 손해 보시는 거예요. 철퇴만 한 무기는 어디서도 못 찾으실걸요!

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
Can I help you?
What's up with him?
Another gift from the sea. Found him on the shore a few days ago.
translation: 바다가 준 또 하나의 선물이지. 며칠 전에 해안에서 발견했어.

english: The moon... His face was the moon...
Is he going to be okay?
Maybe. Maybe not. Only time will tell.
translation: 그럴 수도, 아닐 수도. 시간만이 알겠지.

english: Okay... What are you going to do with him?
translation: 그렇군요... 저 사람을 어떻게 하실 거예요?

english: He'll get the same offer they all do. We don't need mouths to feed if they won't contribute. Once he's up, he can either stick around or ship out, but if he's staying, he has to help.
translation: 다른 녀석들한테 하는 것과 똑같은 제안을 할 거야. 보탬이 안 될 입까지 먹여 살릴 여유는 없어. 일어나면 여기 남든지 배 타고 떠나든지 하면 되는데, 남겠다면 일을 거들어야 해.

english: Help with what?
Salvage of course. We don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. We have to make do with what we can find. Luckily for us, there's always plenty to be found thanks to all the wrecks.
translation: 당연히 인양이지. 여긴 Fortis(포르티스) 같은 사치는 없어. 찾아낸 걸로 어떻게든 버텨야 하지. 다행히 난파선이 많은 덕에 찾을 건 늘 넘쳐나.

english: I see. Well I hope he gets well soon.
translation: 그렇군요. 저 사람이 빨리 나았으면 좋겠네요.

english: You've returned. Can I help you?
Is he doing any better?
What do you think?
What happens if he doesn't recover?
The sea can have him back.
Harsh.
I told you before, we don't have the luxuries of Fortis out here. The dead are not useful, nor are they worth anything.
translation: 전에도 말했지, 여긴 Fortis(포르티스) 같은 사치는 없다고. 죽은 자는 쓸모도 없고 아무 가치도 없어.

english: If he does live, he will have an opportunity. If he desires, he can have a home here, provided he's willing to contribute.
translation: 살아난다면 기회를 얻게 되겠지. 본인이 원한다면 여기서 살 곳을 얻을 수도 있어. 보탬이 될 생각만 있다면 말이야.

english: Hi there. Would you like to buy a cape?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Suit yourself.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: 냄새나는 gublinch(구블린치)들한테서 구해 줘서 정말 고마워요. 걔네 진짜 끔찍했어요! Shanty(샨티)가 수고했다고 멋찐 거 줬으면 좋겠어요.

english: Ha Ha Ha  If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: 하 하 하, 이게 누구야, Jack Frost(잭 프로스트) 아니냐. 지난번에 봤을 때보다 작아 보이는구나.

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: 아-아-안티 산타!? 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: 네 아버지가 날 보냈다. 올해 네가 꽤나 말썽을 부렸다더군.

english: I'm here to sort you out.
What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: 뭐? 우리 아빠가 널 보냈다고? 말도 안 돼, 아빠는 나한테 크리스마스를 맡겼단 말이야.

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: 그랬지. 그런데 네가 일을 얼마나 엉망으로 했는지, 모두의 크리스마스를 망쳐 놨다더구나...

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: 생각해 보니, 너 정말 내 아들이 아닌 게 확실하냐?

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: 넌 우리 아빠가 아니야, 그냥 못생긴 뼈다귀 자루일 뿐이라고.

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: 날 막게 두진 않을 거야. 이거나 받아라!

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: 하 하 하. 그게 다냐, Jack(잭)?

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: 아, 말도 안 돼! 어떻게 저게 안 아플 수가 있어?

english: You're weak just like your father.
I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
translation: 따귀 한 대로 Lumbridge(럼브리지)까지 날려 보내 주마!

english: Argh!
You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: 날 쓰러뜨리려면 훨씬 더 센 게 필요할 거야.

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
I learned this from an old friend of mine.
translation: 이건 내 오랜 친구한테 배운 거다.

english: Ouch!
You cannot stop me Jack.
translation: 넌 날 막을 수 없다, Jack(잭).

english: I'm not finished yet.
Mummy!
I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
translation: 여기서 도망칠 거야. 이럴 가치가 없어!

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 너는... 뭐더라, 모르겠네. 하여간 네가 먹고사는 그 일로 사는 건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 처치하거나, 사람들 부탁으로 온 세상에 물건을 배달하는 일이에요.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 아주 고통스러운 출산이었대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 오래 얘기 못 해. 밀항자랑 노닥거리며 땡땡이치는 걸 선장님한테 들키면 날 산 채로 가죽을 벗길 거야.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래그래, [guy/lady], 네가 누구든 상관없어. 어쨌든 혼나는 건 나라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적의 삶이 실제로 어떤 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 음, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 이것저것 질문받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거예요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했다고요! 물어보세요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 들키지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 반가워, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴인데, 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 배에 탔어?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 준다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 정말? 내가 보기엔 Fremennik(프레메닉) 같지 않은데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 프레메닉이기도 하고, 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 미안하지만 그럼 들을 시간이 없겠네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인데-사실은-프레메닉이-아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 쪽에 가면 너무 추워서 말을 하면 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그럴 리가. 웃기려고 부풀린 거야. 그래도 엄청나게 추운 건 맞아!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 육지 촌뜨기 리치 녀석아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 제발 그렇게 말하지 마. 진짜 엄청 거슬려.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지도 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 진짜예요! 초대받아서 왔다고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 밀항자처럼 생긴 건 인정해야 할걸.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있더라고.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 좋아. 약탈할 수 있는 만큼의 grog(그로그)와 전리품에, 치과까지 포함한 의료 혜택도 빵빵하지.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 딱히 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중에 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 다 나을 때까지 안 놔줘.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 전문적인 치료에 얼마나 큰 동기가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래, Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호에는 무슨 일로 탔어?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아가려던 참이었는데, 배가 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그렇지, 아주 미인이지! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호는 폭풍 속에서도 햇볕 아래에서도 길고 힘든 몇 달 동안 내 집이었고, 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳까지 데려다줬어!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 훌륭한 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크) 말이냐? 그 친군 밖에 있지라. 뺨에 닿는 바람 느낌이 좋다더군.

english: Thanks.
What are you doing here?
Drinking.
Fair enough.
Have you got any quests I could do?
Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 없다. 하지만 이 근방 소식은 바텐더가 거의 다 듣지. 아니면 Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)도 묻힌 보물 얘기를 자주 하더군. 퀘스트는 그 둘한테 물어보는 게 좋을 거다.

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 없다. 하지만 Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)가 묻힌 보물 얘기를 자주 하더군. 퀘스트는 그 친구한테 물어보는 게 좋을 거다.

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 없다. 하지만 이 근방 소식은 바텐더가 거의 다 듣지. 퀘스트는 그 친구한테 물어보는 게 좋을 거다.

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 없다, 너한테 시킬 일은 없어. 하지만 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 늙은 육지 촌뜨기가 하나 있는데, 늘 부탁 들어줄 팔팔한 [lad/lass]를 찾는다더군.

english: Yo ho ho!
So are you pirates?
Aye [laddie/lassie], that we are.
Aye, that we be.
Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 에잉, 넌 맨날 틀리게 말하는구먼! ‘해적이다’라고 해야지, ‘해적이지라’가 아니라!

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 난 해적이지라, 빌어먹을 훈장 선생이 아니지라!

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
Now ye be saying 'be' too!
Arrr! Tis thy fault.
I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
translation: 두 분이 알아서 정리하시게 저는 그만 가 볼게요.

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: What are you doing here?
Have you got any quests I could do?
Have you had enough fun for now?
Let's play a game!
Everyone copy me!
[Player name] is the winner!
Goodbye!
Yes
No
Greetings warrior, how may I help you?
How long have you worked here?
Oh ever since the Guild opened. I like it here.
translation: 아, 길드가 문을 열 때부터 쭉요. 저는 여기가 좋아요.

english: Why's that?
Well.. what with all these warriors around, there's not much chance of my bank being robbed is there!
translation: 그게... 이렇게 전사들이 잔뜩 있으니, 제 은행이 털릴 일은 거의 없잖아요!

english: Bye!
Invest your time and money wisely.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
How long have you worked here?
Bye!
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 이야. 장 보러 가는 것보다 훨씬 낫네요!

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 결투 끝나고 뒷정리하는 불쌍한 사람은 되고 싶지 않아요.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
translation: 해골이 밥 먹기 전에 뭐라고 했게요?

english: I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
Put a little boogey in it.
translation: 코를 팽 풀어서 ‘흥’을 넣어 주면 돼요!

english: Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 방귀 뀔 배짱이 없어서요! 배가 없거든요!

english: My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 제가 결투 보고 있는 거 안 보여요?

english: I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 이곳이 제2시대까지 거슬러 올라간다고들 하는 거 알았어요?!

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 네. 안내 부스에 있는 사람이 말해 줬어요.

english: You got beaten up by a troll!
That monster? If it dares to come here again, I will be ready for it, and it shall taste my spear.
translation: 그 괴물 말이오? 감히 또 여기 오기만 하면, 준비하고 있다가 내 창 맛을 보여 주겠소.

english: You didn't look so tough when the troll knocked you down.
translation: 트롤한테 쓰러졌을 땐 별로 강해 보이지 않던데요.

english: Bwana, get knotted.
What do you do here?
Why, it should be clear to even the most ignorant of people that I am a fearless jungle hunter...out of my way you sanitised civilian!
translation: 아니, 아무리 무지한 사람이라도 내가 겁 없는 정글 사냥꾼이라는 건 딱 보면 알 텐데... 비키쇼, 이 곱게 자란 민간인 양반아!

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 뭐 재미있는 할 일 있어요?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 양반, 오늘 누구든 그 질문을 또 하면 난 폭발할 거요! 딴 사람한테 가서 물어보쇼!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 내가 아는 건 없소. 그냥 편히 앉아서 햇볕이나 즐기쇼, 양반!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 미안하오, 양반. 난 이미 바쁘오. Murcaily(머케일리)한테 가서 얘기해 보는 게 어떻소! 마을 어딘가에 있을 거요.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 음, 할 일이 좀 있을 것 같긴 하오... Murcaily(머케일리)가 도와줄 수 있을지도 모르겠소. 그 친구는 보통 Trufitus(트루피투스)의 오두막 동쪽에 있는 경목 숲을 돌보고 있소.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 여기선 평소처럼 마을 생활이 굴러갈 뿐이오, 양반. 잘 찾아보면 시간 보낼 재미있는 거리는 늘 있는 법이지.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 마을 여기저기서 일을 좀 하고 있어요.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 이미 trading sticks(교역 막대)를 좀 줬고, 지금은 더 가진 게 없소. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 얘기해 보고 좀 보태 달라고 하는 게 어떻소?

english: Ok, thanks.
You got beaten up by a troll!
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 이 근처에 뭐 재미있는 할 일 있어요?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 마을 여기저기서 일을 좀 하고 있어요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hi, who are you guarding here?
Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: 말할 수 없어요, 전부 극비라서요. 여기서 나가는 게 좋을 거예요. 경비 중엔 말하면 안 되거든요.

english: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble. I was just wondering what you do to relax.
translation: 이봐요, 진정해요. 문제 안 일으킬게요. 그냥 쉴 땐 뭐 하는지 궁금했을 뿐이에요.

english: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man.
translation: 이 사람들 밑에선 쉴 틈이 없어요. 그래도 젊은 남자한텐 괜찮은 직업이죠.

english: I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
translation: 그만 가 보는 게 낫겠네요. 문제 만들고 싶진 않아요.

english: Thanks, I appreciate that. Talking on duty can be punishable by having your mouth stitched up. These are tough people, no mistake.
translation: 고마워요, 그래 주시면 감사하죠. 근무 중에 잡담하면 입을 꿰매 버리는 벌을 받을 수도 있거든요. 진짜 독한 사람들이에요, 틀림없이.

english: Hey, chill out, I won't cause you trouble.
I had better leave, I don't want trouble.
translation: 그만 가 보는 게 낫겠네요. 문제 만들고 싶진 않아요.

english: Yo Nib, what's going on?
Nibnib? Kl-Rek Nib?
Jal-Nib-Rek nips you.
What'd you do that for?
Heh Nib get you.
What'd you have for dinner?
Nibblings!
Nibblings of what exactly?
Nib.
Oh no! That's horrible.
Can you speak like a human can Nib?
translation: 닙, 너 사람처럼 말할 수 있어?

english: No, I most definitely can not.
Aren't you speaking like a human right now...?
Jal-Nib-Rek Nib Kl-Jal, Zuk is mum.
Interesting.
Kl-NibNib!
Nib Jal!
What's up Zuk?
Feeling a bit down to be honest.
Why's that?
Well...
Not so long ago, I was a big fearsome boss, Now I'm just another pet.
translation: 얼마 전까지만 해도 나는 거대하고 무시무시한 보스였다. 그런데 지금은 그저 흔한 펫일 뿐이지.

english: Indeed, and you're going to follow me everywhere I go.
translation: 그렇지. 그리고 이제 내가 가는 곳마다 따라다닐 거고.

english: Why have you got lava around your feet?
Keeps me cool.
But... lava is hot?
No no, I wasn't referring to the temperature.
Ah...
You're a lot smaller now, I don't even need this shield.
translation: 너 이제 엄청 작아졌네. 이 방패도 필요 없겠어.

english: Mere mortal, you only survived my challenge because of that convenient pile of rock.
translation: 하찮은 필멸자여, 네가 내 시련에서 살아남은 건 그 편리한 돌무더기 덕분이었을 뿐이다.

english: Well, you couldn't even break that pile of rock to get at me!
translation: 글쎄, 넌 나한테 닿으려고 그 돌무더기 하나 못 부쉈잖아!

english: You're a lot smaller now, I don't even need a shield.
translation: 너 이제 엄청 작아졌네. 방패도 필요 없겠어.

english: That shield won't protect you forever mortal.
translation: 그 방패가 영원히 너를 지켜 주지는 못할 것이다, 필멸자여.

english: It might actually.
We shall see about that.
Ouch! What the...
He he.
Kal-Zuk!
Zukkkkkk!
Hey, who are you?
I'm James. It's my job to tell you all there is to know about Old School Bonds.
translation: 저는 James(제임스)예요. Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)에 대해 알아야 할 모든 걸 알려 드리는 게 제 일이죠.

english: An Old School Bond will allow you to buy membership for your account using in game gold pieces.
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)가 있으면 게임 속 골드로 계정 멤버십을 살 수 있어요.

english: My sources have also informed me that due to popular demand, they can now be redeemed for a free name change! Handy!
translation: 제 정보원 말로는 많은 요청에 힘입어 이제 무료 이름 변경으로도 교환할 수 있대요! 편리하죠!

english: You can get an Old School Bond from other players or from the Grand Exchange.
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)는 다른 플레이어나 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에서 구할 수 있어요.

english: Simply click the bond and choose the redeem option.
translation: 본드를 클릭하고 교환 옵션을 고르기만 하면 돼요.

english: You get 14 days membership from an Old School Bond.
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드) 하나로 멤버십 14일을 받아요.

english: At the moment Old School Bonds can only be redeemed for membership and for display name changes.
translation: 지금은 Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)를 멤버십과 표시 이름 변경으로만 교환할 수 있어요.

english: Click on the ‘buy a bond’ link on the main page and follow the instructions to buy a bond from our website. You can then give the bond to another player or sell it on the Grand Exchange.
translation: 메인 페이지의 ‘본드 구매’ 링크를 클릭하고 안내에 따라 저희 웹사이트에서 본드를 사세요. 그런 다음 그 본드를 다른 플레이어에게 주거나 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에서 팔 수 있어요.

english: What is an Old School Bond?
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)가 뭐예요?

english: How do I buy an Old School Bond in game?
translation: 게임 안에서 Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)를 어떻게 사요?

english: How do I turn an Old School Bond into membership?
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)를 어떻게 멤버십으로 바꿔요?

english: How much membership do I get from an Old School bond?
translation: Old School bond(올드 스쿨 본드) 하나로 멤버십을 얼마나 받아요?

english: Can I use an Old School Bond to pay for anything else?
translation: Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)로 다른 것도 결제할 수 있어요?

english: How do I buy an Old School Bond to give or sell to another player?
translation: 다른 플레이어에게 주거나 팔 Old School Bond(올드 스쿨 본드)는 어떻게 사요?

english: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares? I also have a special item in stock that I reckon you'll love!
translation: 안녕하세요. 제 물건 좀 사 보시겠어요? 마음에 쏙 드실 특별한 물건도 들여놨답니다!

english: Show me what you have.
Certainly!
What's this special item?
Oh it's fantastic! It's an exclusive item just for you! Consider it a thank you for all you've done for our city.
translation: 아, 정말 대단한 거예요! 오직 손님만을 위한 독점 상품이에요! 우리 도시를 위해 해 주신 모든 일에 대한 감사의 표시라고 생각해 주세요.

english: Yes.
No.
How is business?
Slow at the moment. Maybe time will make things better. Perhaps you'd like to help by buying something yourself?
translation: 지금은 좀 한산해요. 시간이 지나면 나아지겠죠. 손님이 뭐라도 사서 좀 도와주시는 건 어때요?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Come back soon!
Show me what you have.
What's this special item?
How is business?
I'm good, thanks.
Today is a good day to be a frog!
translation: 오늘은 개구리로 살기 딱 좋은 날이야!

english: It sure is. Now that we have peace, life is at an all time high!
translation: 정말 그래. 이제 평화가 찾아왔으니 사는 게 최고야!

english: Hi!
What? Can't you see I'm busy?!
translation: 뭐야? 나 바쁜 거 안 보여?!

english: Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 어림없지, 짐 다 싸는 대로 난 여기서 뜰 거야!

english: You look healthy to me!
Okay, this will hurt you more than it will me.
translation: 좋아, 이건 나보다 너한테 더 아플 거야.

english: You must see some gruesome things?
It's a gruesome business and with the tools they give me it gets more gruesome before it gets better!
translation: 끔찍한 일이지. 게다가 나한테 주는 도구로는 나아지기 전에 더 끔찍해지고!

english: Why do they call you 'The Butcher'?
'The Butcher'?
Ha!
Would you like me to demonstrate?
Er...I'll give it a miss, thanks.
Here! Now I have work to do!
translation: 자, 받아! 난 이제 할 일이 있다고!

english: Jaraah has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Jaraah(자라)가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: Can you heal me?
You must see some gruesome things?
Why do they call you 'The Butcher'?
Hello there.
Who are you?
I'm Jardric. Former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. I'm here with the Varrock Museum to explore this island and discover its secrets.
translation: 나는 Jardric(자드릭)일세. 예전엔 뱃사공이었고 지금은 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 연구원이지. Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)과 함께 이 섬을 탐사하고 그 비밀을 밝히러 왔다네.

english: From boatman to researcher? That's quite the change.
Aye that it is. I do miss it sometimes, but I get so many opportunities now that I never used to. Just look at us! We may well be the first to step foot on this island in centuries.
translation: 그렇고말고. 가끔 그립기도 하지만, 예전엔 없던 기회가 지금은 아주 많다네. 우리를 보게! 이 섬에 수백 년 만에 처음 발을 디딘 사람들일지도 모른다고.

english: If that isn't exciting, I don't know what is.
translation: 이게 신나는 일이 아니라면, 뭐가 신나는 일인지 모르겠군.

english: Very true. See you later.
Goodbye for now.
Hello. Wanting to go to Lithkren?
Yes please.
You board the boat and travel to Lithkren.
The player travels to Lithkren.
Not too bad. I've been working with the museum to investigate the dragonkin. After what happened they now consider me an expert.
translation: 그럭저럭 괜찮다네. 박물관과 함께 dragonkin(드래곤킨)을 조사하고 있지. 그 일이 있은 뒤로 다들 나를 전문가로 여긴다네.

english: Don't worry though. I've still got enough time to look after this boat for you.
translation: 그래도 걱정 말게. 자네를 위해 이 배를 돌볼 시간은 아직 충분하니까.

english: No thank you.
Hello. Wanting to go back to Fossil Island?
translation: 안녕하신가. Fossil Island(화석 섬)으로 돌아가려는 겐가?

english: You board the boat and travel to Fossil Island.
translation: 배에 올라 Fossil Island(화석 섬)으로 향한다.

english: The player travels to Fossil Island.
How are things with you?
I have a question for you.
Yes please.
How are things with you?
No thank you.
Good day, sir.
What are you doing down here?
I'm waiting to work on the digging.
It's the first excavation I've worked on, and I'm looking forward to it.
translation: 제가 참여하는 첫 발굴이라 무척 기대하고 있습니다.

english: Good day.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Hello!
Can I have another amulet?
translation: 아뮬렛 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Jarr gives you another amulet.
Who are you?
I'm Jarr, the taskmaster for the Kharidian Desert Achievement Diary.
translation: 저는 Jarr(자르)예요. Kharidian Desert Achievement Diary(카리디안 사막 업적 일지)를 담당하는 과제 감독관이죠.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Kharidian Desert it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 특정한 업적들을 기록해 두는 일지예요. Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)에서는 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 발견하는 데 도움이 될 거예요. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 이곳 주민들이 보상을 줄 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 옆 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different Desert amulets, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: 음, Desert amulet(사막 아뮬렛)은 네 가지가 있고, 네 단계의 난이도에 하나씩 맞춰져 있어요. 각각 이전 단계와 같은 보상에 추가 혜택도 있죠... 어느 단계의 보상에 대해

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Desert, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 10 charges, Simon Templeton will purchase artefacts in banknote form and Desert goat horns are dropped as notes.
translation: 사막의 초급 과제를 모두 완료하면 Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 10회 충전할 수 있고, Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴)이 유물을 지폐 형태로 사들이며, Desert goat horns(사막 염소 뿔)이 지폐 상태로 떨어져요.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 중급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 25 charges and the amulet will teleport you to Nardah once per day.
translation: 초급 보상에 더해, Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 25회 충전할 수 있고 아뮬렛으로 하루 한 번 Nardah(나르다)로 순간이동할 수 있어요.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 50 charges, you can adjust your Camulet to teleport you above the temple and the Nardah herbalist will create unfinished potions
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 50회 충전할 수 있고, Camulet(카뮬렛)을 조정해 신전 위로 순간이동할 수 있으며, Nardah(나르다)의 약초상이 미완성 물약을

english: for you, as well as cleaning noted herbs for the usual herb cleaning fee.
translation: 만들어 주고, 평소 약초 손질 비용만 받고 지폐 상태의 약초도 손질해 줘요.

english: All your rides on a magic carpet are free, and you can climb through the Al Kharid Palace southern window too, if your Agility level's up to it.
translation: magic carpet(마법 양탄자)는 전부 무료로 탈 수 있고, Agility(민첩) 레벨이 충분하면 Al Kharid Palace(알 카리드 궁전)의 남쪽 창문으로 넘어 들어갈 수도 있어요.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 엘리트 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you can charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 100 charges, the amulet will protect you from desert heat at all times, a shortcut opens up in the Kalphite hive and the amulet will
translation: 이전 단계 보상에 더해, Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 100회 충전할 수 있고, 아뮬렛이 항상 사막의 열기를 막아 주며, Kalphite hive(칼파이트 둥지)에 지름길이 열리고, 아뮬렛으로

english: teleport you to Nardah and the kalphite hive to the East of the Shantay Pass as much as you desire. You'll also get completely free passage through the Shantay passes here and at the Ruins of Unkah.
translation: Nardah(나르다)와 Shantay Pass(샨테이 통행로) 동쪽의 kalphite hive(칼파이트 둥지)로 원하는 만큼 순간이동할 수 있어요. 이곳과 Ruins of Unkah(운카 폐허)의 샨테이 통행로도 완전히 무료로 지나갈 수 있고요.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Desert so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: 사막의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면 저한테 와서 말을 걸어 보상을 받으세요.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Desert Achievement Diary!
translation: Desert Achievement Diary(사막 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
translation: 그렇네요, 잘했어요! 이제 보상을 받고 싶으시겠죠!

english: Yes please!

This amulet is a symbol of your exploration of the Kharidian Desert. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 10 charges, Simon Templeton will purchase artefacts in banknote form and Desert goat horns are
translation: 이 아뮬렛은 당신이 Kharidian Desert(카리디안 사막)을 탐험했다는 증표예요. 이제 Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 10회 충전할 수 있고, Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴)이 유물을 지폐 형태로 사들이며, Desert goat horns(사막 염소 뿔)이

english: dropped as notes.
Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your amulet, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: 아뮬렛을 잃어버리면 언제든 저한테 다시 받으러 오세요.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: Desert achievement diary(사막 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 25 charges and the amulet will teleport you to Nardah once per day.
translation: Desert amulet(사막 아뮬렛)을 업그레이드해 드렸어요. 이제 Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 25회 충전할 수 있고 아뮬렛으로 하루 한 번 Nardah(나르다)로 순간이동할 수 있어요.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Desert achievement diary!
translation: Desert achievement diary(사막 업적 일지)의 상급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Desert amulet for you. You can now charge a Pharaoh's sceptre with 50 charges, you can adjust your Camulet to teleport you above the temple and the Nardah herbalist will create unfinished
translation: Desert amulet(사막 아뮬렛)을 업그레이드해 드렸어요. 이제 Pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)를 50회 충전할 수 있고, Camulet(카뮬렛)을 조정해 신전 위로 순간이동할 수 있으며, Nardah(나르다)의 약초상이 미완성

english: potions for you.
All rides on a magic carpet are now free, and you can climb through the Al Kharid Palace southern window too, if your Agility level's up to it.
translation: 이제 magic carpet(마법 양탄자)는 전부 무료로 탈 수 있고, Agility(민첩) 레벨이 충분하면 Al Kharid Palace(알 카리드 궁전)의 남쪽 창문으로 넘어 들어갈 수도 있어요.

english: Can I have another amulet?
translation: 아뮬렛 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
What do you want from me outerlander? It is our policy not to associate with those not of our tribe.
translation: 무엇을 원하오, 외지인? 우리 부족이 아닌 자와는 어울리지 않는 것이 우리의 방침이오.

english: Where is your chieftain? I find it highly discriminatory to refuse to talk to someone on the grounds that they are not part of your tribe.
translation: 족장은 어디 있죠? 부족 사람이 아니라는 이유로 대화를 거부하다니, 이건 명백한 차별이에요.

english: I don't rightly understand your speech outerlander, but my loyalty is with Chieftain Brundt.
translation: 그대의 말은 잘 알아듣지 못하겠소, 외지인. 허나 내 충성은 Brundt(브룬트) 족장께 있소.

english: He resides in our longhall; it is the large building over there, you should speak to him for he speaks for us all.
translation: 족장께서는 우리 대회관에 계시오. 저기 보이는 큰 건물이오. 그분이 우리 모두를 대변하시니 그분과 이야기하시오.

english: So what are you doing here?
This should not concern you, outerlander. I am awaiting other Fremenniks to join me on an expedition to Waterbirth Island.
translation: 그대가 상관할 일이 아니오, 외지인. 나는 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)으로 원정을 함께 떠날 다른 Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람들을 기다리는 중이오.

english: It is a small crescent-shaped island just north-west of here, outerlander.
translation: 여기서 북서쪽에 있는 작은 초승달 모양의 섬이오, 외지인.

english: We have many legends about it, such as the tale of the broken sky, and the day of the green seas.
translation: 그 섬에 얽힌 전설이 많소. 부서진 하늘 이야기나, 초록 바다의 날 같은 것 말이오.

english: The reason I am travelling there is more serious Fremennik business, however. I doubt an outerlander would be interested.
translation: 허나 내가 그곳에 가는 이유는 그보다 중대한 Fremennik(프레메닉)의 일이오. 외지인이 관심을 가질 것 같지는 않소만.

english: Can I come?
An outerlander join us on an honoured hunt???
Well.... I guess... I might be able to allow you to join us, although it is a breach of many of our customs...
translation: 음.... 아마도... 함께하도록 허락할 수는 있겠소. 우리의 여러 관습을 어기는 일이긴 하지만...

english: Oh, pleeeeease? I really LOVE killing stuff!
translation: 오, 제바아아알요? 저 뭔가 죽이는 거 진짜 좋아한단 말이에요!

english: Well... I remain unconvinced that it would be wise to allow an outerlander to join us in such dangerous battle, but your enthusiasm seems genuine enough...
translation: 음... 외지인을 그토록 위험한 싸움에 데려가는 게 현명한지는 아직 확신이 서지 않소만, 그대의 열의만큼은 진심인 것 같구려...

english: I will allow you to escort us, but you must pay me a sum of money first.
translation: 우리를 호위하도록 허락하겠소. 단, 먼저 돈을 좀 내야 하오.

english: What? That's outrageous, why charge me money? And, uh, how much does it cost me?
translation: 뭐라고요? 말도 안 돼요, 왜 돈을 받아요? 그리고, 어, 얼마인데요?

english: Ah, the outerlanders have stolen from my people for many years, in this way you can help my community with a small amount of money...
translation: 아, 외지인들은 오랜 세월 우리 부족의 것을 훔쳐 왔소. 이렇게 약간의 돈을 내면 우리 공동체를 돕는 셈이 되오...

english: Let us say... 1,000 coins. Payable in advance, of course.
For this I will take you to Waterbirth Island on my boat, and will bring you back here when you have had your fill of the hunt. Assuming you are still alive to wish to leave, of course.
translation: 그 대가로 내 배에 태워 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)까지 데려다주고, 사냥을 실컷 하고 나면 여기로 다시 데려다주겠소. 물론 그때까지 살아 있어서 떠나고 싶어 한다면 말이오.

english: So do you have the 1,000 coins for my service, and are you ready to leave now?
translation: 그래서, 내 수고비 1,000코인은 있소? 지금 떠날 준비는 되었소?

english: The player sets sail for Waterbirth Island
I suggest you head to the cave with some urgency outerlander, the cold air out here might be too much for the likes of you…
translation: 서둘러 동굴로 가는 게 좋을 거요, 외지인. 바깥의 찬 공기는 그대 같은 이에게는 버거울지도 모르니…

english: No, actually I have some stuff to do here first.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 여기서 먼저 할 일이 좀 있어요.

english: As you wish. Come and see me when your bloodlust needs sating.
translation: 좋을 대로 하시오. 피에 대한 갈증을 채우고 싶어지면 나를 찾아오시오.

english: Hey, I have to say, that's a fine looking hat you are wearing there.
translation: 저기, 이 말은 꼭 해야겠는데, 쓰고 계신 그 모자 정말 멋지네요.

english: It is actually a helm, outerlander, but the sentiment is appreciated nonetheless.
translation: 사실 그건 투구요, 외지인. 그래도 마음만은 고맙게 받겠소.

english: Wow, you Fremenniks sure know how to party. Well, see ya around.
translation: 와, Fremennik(프레메닉) 사람들은 정말 놀 줄 아시네요. 그럼, 또 봐요.

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about…
translation: 사실, 딱히 드릴 말씀이 없는 것 같아요…

english: Ah, you live yet, outerlander!
Have you had your fill of the hunt and wish to return, or are you still feeling the joy of the cull?
translation: 사냥을 실컷 해서 이제 돌아가고 싶소, 아니면 아직도 사냥의 기쁨을 만끽하고 있소?

english: I wish to return to Rellekka.
Then let us away; There will be death to bring here another day!
translation: 그럼 떠납시다! 이곳에 죽음을 몰고 올 날은 또 있을 테니!

english: The player is sailed back to Rellekka
I want to stay here.
Ha Ha Ha! A true huntsman at heart!
I myself have killed over a hundred of the dagger- mouths, and did not think it too many!
translation: 나도 단검주둥이를 백 마리 넘게 잡았지만, 많다고 생각한 적은 없소!

english: Hi, I don't suppose you are a member of the council of elders are you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 혹시 장로 의회 일원은 아니시죠?

english: No, outerlander, I have never had the honour to be asked.
translation: 아니오, 외지인. 그런 청을 받는 영광은 누려 본 적이 없소.

english: I am but a lowly warrior, fighting for my people wherever threats may appear against us...
translation: 나는 그저 미천한 전사일 뿐이오. 우리 부족을 위협하는 것이 나타나면 어디서든 싸울 뿐이지...

english: So what do you want from me, outerlander?
(same as above)
Greetings, [Fremennik name]!
Ah, and what a glorious name that is! Worthy of only the finest warriors!
translation: 아, 참으로 영광스러운 이름이오! 최고의 전사에게만 어울리는 이름이지!

english: Heh. Yup, you're right there.
So what brings you back to fair Rellekka? It has been too long since you have drunk in the longhall with us and sang of your battles!
translation: 그래, 아름다운 Rellekka(렐레카)에는 무슨 일로 돌아왔소? 대회관에서 우리와 함께 술을 마시며 그대의 무용담을 노래한 지도 너무 오래되었소!

english: You have not heard, [Fremennik name]? I am leading an expedition to Waterbirth Island!
translation: 못 들었소, [Fremennik name]? 내가 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬) 원정을 이끌고 있소!

english: You have not ever travelled to Waterbirth Island, [Fremennik name]? I am surprised, it is a place of outstanding natural beauty.
translation: Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)에 한 번도 가 본 적이 없소, [Fremennik name]? 놀랍구려. 자연의 아름다움이 빼어난 곳인데.

english: Or at least it used to be! But things have now changed...
translation: 아니, 적어도 예전엔 그랬소! 허나 이제는 사정이 달라졌소...

english: Changed? How do you mean, changed?
It seems as though the sea-beasts known to us as the dagger-mouths have begun their hatching once again... And there may be others of their ilk there too.
translation: 우리가 단검주둥이라 부르는 바다 짐승들이 다시 알을 까기 시작한 것 같소... 그리고 그곳엔 그 동족들도 더 있을지 모르오.

english: Dagger-mouths?
Aye, the dagger-mouths! The vile creatures lived near here once, but we had thought them all driven back to the ocean depths many moons past.
translation: 그렇소, 단검주둥이! 그 흉측한 것들은 한때 이 근처에 살았지만, 오래전에 모두 깊은 바다로 쫓아냈다고 생각했소.

english: I can only imagine a dagger-mouth queen has nested somewhere nearby, and spawned her foul brood under the sea once more, and some of them have migrated to fair Waterbirth Island.
translation: 아마 단검주둥이 여왕이 근처 어딘가에 둥지를 틀고 다시 바닷속에서 그 더러운 새끼들을 낳았고, 그중 일부가 아름다운 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)으로 옮겨 간 모양이오.

english: So you're scared they might attack Rellekka?
translation: 그럼 그것들이 Rellekka(렐레카)를 공격할까 봐 무서운 거예요?

english: Scared? Ha ha ha!
You wound us with your questioning, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 그런 질문을 하다니 우리 마음이 상하오, [Fremennik name]!

english: We are glad the dagger-mouths have returned to these shores, for it means we will get the chance to hunt them once again as our ancestors did!
translation: 단검주둥이들이 이 해안으로 돌아와서 오히려 기쁘오. 조상들이 그랬듯 다시 그것들을 사냥할 기회가 생겼으니 말이오!

english: When treated in the correct manner, the creatures' remains can be used to make fine battleworthy armour!
translation: 제대로 손질하면 그 짐승들의 잔해로 전투에 쓸 만한 훌륭한 갑옷을 만들 수 있소!

english: Of course, [Fremennik name]! Your presence is more than welcome on this cull! You wish to leave now?
translation: 물론이오, [Fremennik name]! 이번 사냥에 그대라면 대환영이오! 지금 떠나겠소?

english: Player is transported to Waterbirth Island
Aye, that it is [Fremennik name]! Skulgrimen fashioned it for me from the carcass of one of the monsters on Waterbirth Island after our last hunt!
translation: 그렇소, [Fremennik name]! 지난 사냥이 끝나고 Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)이 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)에서 잡은 괴물의 사체로 만들어 준 것이오!

english: I hope to kill enough creatures to fashion some fine armour as well when next we leave!
translation: 다음에 떠날 때는 짐승을 충분히 잡아서 멋진 갑옷도 한 벌 만들고 싶소!

english: I picked up this, I was wondering if you could tell me about it...
translation: 이걸 주웠는데, 이게 뭔지 좀 알려 주실 수 있을까 해서요...

english: Ah yes... The dagger-mouths' skin makes a good basis for many types of armour!
translation: 아, 그렇지... 단검주둥이의 가죽은 여러 갑옷의 좋은 재료가 되오!

english: Skulgrimen has made many sturdy helms from shells like that!
translation: Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)은 그런 껍데기로 튼튼한 투구를 여럿 만들었소!

english: Skulgrimen once made a fine set of body armour from that kind of shell!
translation: Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)이 예전에 그런 껍데기로 멋진 몸 갑옷 한 벌을 만든 적이 있소!

english: Aha! That could be made into some fine leg armour by Skulgrimen, I'll wager!
translation: 오호! 장담컨대 Skulgrimen(스쿨그리멘)이라면 그걸로 멋진 다리 갑옷을 만들 수 있을 거요!

english: Hmmmm... I believe Peer could make a fine seers helm with that...
translation: 흐으음... Peer(페르)라면 그걸로 멋진 예언자 투구를 만들 수 있을 것 같소...

english: Many moons past, Peer had some fine bodyarmour made from just such bones.
translation: 오래전에 Peer(페르)가 바로 그런 뼈로 멋진 몸 갑옷을 만들어 입은 적이 있소.

english: Peer could use that to make some mighty robes, I'll wager.
translation: 장담컨대 Peer(페르)라면 그걸로 위력적인 로브를 만들 수 있을 거요.

english: Sigli might be able to make you some sturdy headgear with that!
translation: Sigli(시글리)라면 그걸로 튼튼한 머리 장비를 만들어 줄 수 있을 거요!

english: That could make a fine piece of hunting armour, if I know Sigli like I think I do.
translation: 내가 아는 Sigli(시글리)라면, 그걸로 훌륭한 사냥용 갑옷을 만들 수 있을 거요.

english: I'll wager Sigli can make that into some hunting legs for you.
translation: 장담컨대 Sigli(시글리)라면 그걸로 사냥용 다리 갑옷을 만들어 줄 거요.

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure [Fremennik name]! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 아, 언제나 반갑소, [Fremennik name]! 그래, 내게 또 원하는 것이 있소?

english: Actually, I don't think I have anything to speak to you about...

english: Ah, [Fremennik name]! Such glorious battle makes you feel glad of life, does it not?

english: So what say you, stay here for the hunt, or return home to sweet Rellekka to feast and drink with your tribe?

translation: Salve(살브) 강가의 사원인 Paterdomus(파테르도무스)까지 누가 안내해 주길 바라며 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 웅장한 사원이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)로 들어오는 길에 분명 지나치셨을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶거든요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: 문제가 생기면 어느 정도는 제 몸을 지킬 수 있어요... 네, 그래도 그런 일이 없길 바라자고요!

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 데리고 다니는 펫이 있네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 펫을 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 오, 정말요? 그럼 정말 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 주시려고요? 제 배낭 좀 열어 볼게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫지만 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 머무는 것보단 나아요.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 하루 종일 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)에 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같아서요.

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

translation: 아이고 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

translation: 아, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
