translation: Mahogany shelf(마호가니 선반)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
translation: Mahogany drawer(마호가니 서랍장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
translation: Mahogany dresser(마호가니 화장대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany chair built.
translation: Mahogany chair(마호가니 의자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아~ 역시 따뜻한 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Welcome to Jelly's Kurask cave.
translation: Jelly(젤리)의 Kurask(쿠라스크) 동굴에 온 거 환영해.

english: Who are you?
I am Jelly.
When Jelly was just a baby troll, parents left him in Slayer cave... But Jelly is strong, Jelly learn to survive in the cave, and one day Jelly will become great Slayer master!
translation: Jelly(젤리)가 아기 트롤일 때, 부모가 젤리를 Slayer(슬레이어) 동굴에 두고 갔어... 하지만 젤리는 강해. 젤리는 동굴에서 살아남는 법 배웠어. 그리고 언젠가 젤리는 위대한 슬레이어 마스터 될 거야!

english: Why is this area private?

When the Kurasks finded new treasures, many humans come to the Slayer cave to hunt them... No Kurasks left for Jelly to train on, so Jelly makes a private area just for training. These be Jelly's very own Kurask!
translation: Kurask(쿠라스크)들이 새 보물 찾아냈을 때, 인간 많이 Slayer(슬레이어) 동굴 와서 쿠라스크 사냥했어... Jelly(젤리)가 훈련할 쿠라스크 하나도 안 남았어. 그래서 젤리가 훈련만 하는 개인 구역 만들었어. 여기 있는 건 젤리만의 쿠라스크야!

english: Not just any human gets to train up here, you has to be on a Kurask Slayer task.
translation: 아무 인간이나 여기서 훈련 못 해. 너 Kurask(쿠라스크) Slayer(슬레이어) 임무 받은 거 있어야 해.

english: What kind of a name is Jelly?
Jelly grew up in this cave, there not much choice around for a hungry troll...
translation: Jelly(젤리)는 이 동굴에서 컸어. 배고픈 트롤이 먹을 만한 게 그거밖에 없었어...

english: Thanks, goodbye.
Naughty human! You not hunting the Kurask! Jelly's Kurasks only for people on Slayer tasks.
translation: 나쁜 인간! 너 Kurask(쿠라스크) 사냥 안 하잖아! Jelly(젤리)의 쿠라스크는 Slayer(슬레이어) 임무 받은 사람만이야.

english: Who are you?
Why is this area private?
What kind of a name is Jelly?
Thanks, goodbye.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장에게 가시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 경계하고 있어서 물건을 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만났구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 얘기나 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하면 내 문은 언제나 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 만난 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 것을 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 머물며 이야기할 틈이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 잘 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 그대에게 모든 일이 잘 풀리기를 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
translation: 그대를 보는 건 언제나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].

english: You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 하는 것이오, [Fremennik name]?

english: Huh.
What?
You don't understand.
Understand what?
Nobody understands.
What don't we understand?
translation: 우리가 뭘 이해 못 한다는 거예요?

english: Oh, it doesn't matter. You don't understand. Go away.
translation: 아, 됐어. 넌 이해 못 해. 저리 가.

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
He didn't understand!
No, I don't suppose he did.
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: demonic sigil mould(악마 인장 거푸집) 갖고 있어요?

english: Huh. So that's all you want. Here it is.
translation: 흥. 결국 원하는 게 그거였구나. 여기 있어.

english: Thanks!
What?
Understand what?
What don't we understand?
translation: 우리가 뭘 이해 못 한다는 거예요?

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: demonic sigil mould(악마 인장 거푸집) 갖고 있어요?

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
What're yer looking for, me luv'?
Let's trade.
Well me luv', I've got some special rations for the soldiers in the fields ou'there; courtesy of the mainland Void Knights. Take a looksie.
translation: 글쎄요 손님, 저 바깥 들판에 나가 있는 병사들한테 줄 특별 식량이 있어요. 본토의 Void Knights(보이드 기사들)이 보내 준 거죠. 한번 구경해 봐요.

english: I don't need anything right now.
Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 넌... 몰라, 네가 먹고사는 그 일이 뭐든, 그걸로 사는 건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 죽이거나, 사람들 부탁으로 온 세상에 물건을 배달해요.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 gnome(노움)이었거든. 듣자 하니 출산이 아주 고통스러웠대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
translation: 굳이 알고 싶지 않은 얘기까지 고마워요!

english: Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 지금은 안 돼. 밀항자랑 노닥거리다 걸리면 선장님이 내 창자를 뽑아 버릴 거야.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 알았어, [guy/lady]. 네가 누구든 상관없이 난 혼날 거라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적으로 산다는 게 실제로 뭘 하는 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 글쎄, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 뜬금없는 질문 받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탔다고요! Lokar(로카르)가 초대했어요! 그 사람한테 물어봐요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 걸리지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴이네. 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 우리 배에 탄 거야?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 주겠다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 그래? 내 눈엔 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 안 보이는데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 그럼 미안하지만 들을 시간이 없네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인 듯 프레메닉 아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 쪽은 얼마나 추운지, 말을 하면 그 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그건 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 과장했어. 그래도 엄청, 엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쥐 같은 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 그런 말투 좀 쓰지 마. 엄청 거슬리거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지 좀 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 정말이에요! 초대받아서 온 거라고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 영락없는 밀항자처럼 보인다는 건 인정해야 할걸.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있더라고.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 괜찮아. 약탈할 수 있는 grog(그로그)랑 전리품은 전부 우리 거고, 치과까지 포함한 의료 혜택도 빵빵하지.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중에 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 다 나을 때까지 안 놓아주는 거지.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 전문적인 치료에 얼마나 큰 동기 부여가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호에는 무슨 일로 탄 거야?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아가려던 참인데, 배가 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그렇지, 정말 미인이야! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호는 폭풍우가 치나 해가 쨍쨍하나 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었고, 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳에 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 멋진 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Hello.
How's it going?
Good thanks. Just passing by.
translation: 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 그냥 지나가던 길이에요.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 뭘 해 드리면 될까요?

english: I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: Wooden drawers(나무 서랍장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Wooden cabinets built.
translation: Wooden cabinets(나무 수납장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: Wooden bed(나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: Wooden table(나무 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like my bath fixed.
I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: Oak drawers(참나무 서랍장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Oak cabinets built.
translation: Oak cabinets(참나무 수납장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: Oak bed(참나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: Oak table(참나무 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: Teak drawers(티크 서랍장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Teak cabinets built.
translation: Teak cabinets(티크 수납장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Teak bed(티크 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: Teak table(티크 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: Mahogany drawers(마호가니 서랍장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany cabinets built.
translation: Mahogany cabinets(마호가니 수납장)을 두 개 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Mahogany table(마호가니 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아~ 역시 따뜻한 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Hey kid, what's all the shouting about?
Christmas is ruined!
Again? What's happened this time?
The man in the shop won't give us our Gingerbread Gnomes, he's keeping them for himself.
translation: 가게 아저씨가 우리 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 안 주고 혼자 다 가지려고 해.

english: That doesn't sound right, are you sure that's really what he's doing?
translation: 그건 좀 이상한데. 정말 그 사람이 그러는 거 맞아?

english: Of course he is, why else won't he give us any?
translation: 당연하지, 그게 아니면 왜 하나도 안 주겠어?

english: Something seems off, maybe I should go talk to Santa to find out what's happened.
translation: 뭔가 이상해. Santa(산타)한테 가서 무슨 일인지 알아봐야겠다.

english: Do whatever you want, I want my Gingerbread Gnomes!
translation: 맘대로 해, 난 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)이 갖고 싶다고!

english: Where are our Gingerbread Gnomes!
I'm working on it, I'm working on it.
Hurry up!
You've ruined Christmas!
Give us the Gnomes!
Why are you still here? I saved Christmas, you can go home.
translation: 아직도 여기 있니? 내가 크리스마스를 구했으니까 이제 집에 가도 돼.

english: We still have to wait for the delivery to come in, dummy.
translation: 아직 배달이 올 때까지 기다려야 하거든, 바보야.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Christmas is Saved!
Hurry up with the delivery!
Nilsal, [player name]. How are things going?
Pretty good, thanks. How about you? Made any more discoveries down here?
translation: 꽤 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 그쪽은요? 여기 아래에서 새로 발견한 거 더 있어요?

english: More than you can count! I've found so much new information on the Old Ones and naguanil. The museum are hoping to include it all in some new exhibits soon!
translation: 셀 수 없을 만큼 많죠! Old Ones(고대의 존재들)과 naguanil(나구아닐)에 대한 새로운 정보를 엄청나게 찾아냈어요. 박물관에서 조만간 새 전시에 전부 넣고 싶어 해요!

english: Sounds awesome! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for them. On that note, I'll let you get back to it.
translation: 멋지네요! 꼭 챙겨 볼게요. 그럼 이만 하던 일 계속하시게 둘게요.

english: Hello friend.
Hello, what are you doing here?
My name is Jessie. I help look after the forest.
translation: 제 이름은 Jessie(제시)예요. 숲 돌보는 일을 돕고 있어요.

english: Nice to meet you. You must know this area very well then.
translation: 반가워요. 그럼 이 일대를 아주 잘 아시겠네요.

english: I do. There're all sorts of interesting creatures around here. Be careful, some of them are not very friendly. A lot of travellers have become their victims.
translation: 그렇죠. 이 근처엔 온갖 신기한 동물들이 살아요. 조심하세요, 그중엔 별로 우호적이지 않은 녀석들도 있거든요. 여행자들이 많이 당했어요.

english: I see. Thanks for the warning.
No problem! Safe travels my friend.
Hello, I don't recognise you. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 안녕하세요, 처음 보는 얼굴이네요. 이 근처엔 새로 오는 사람이 별로 없거든요.

english: How come?
The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
translation: 당연히 역병 때문이죠. 이런 곳에 오고 싶어 하는 사람은 많지 않고, 그나마 오려는 사람들도 대개 mourners(애도자)한테 막히거든요.

english: All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.
translation: 지금 여기 있는 건 죽은 사람과 죽어 가는 사람뿐이에요. 우리 왕조차 우리를 버렸죠.

english: Your king?
Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.
translation: 네, West Ardougne(서 아르둔)의 King Tyras(티라스 왕)요. East Ardougne(동 아르둔)을 다스리는 King Lathas(라타스 왕)의 형제예요.

english: So where is the king?
Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.
translation: 음, 그분은 원래부터 탐험가 기질이 좀 있었어요. 서쪽의 미지의 땅으로 원정을 여러 번 이끌었죠.

english: The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
translation: 역병은 그분이 그런 원정 중 하나에서 돌아왔을 때 처음 시작됐어요. 그분 부하 몇 명이 거기서 병에 걸려 함께 들여왔다고 의심하는 사람이 적지 않죠.

english: The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.
translation: 그런데 왕은 신경도 안 썼어요. 그냥 또 서쪽으로 원정을 떠났고, 그 뒤로 아무도 그분을 못 봤죠. 도시 관리관 Bravek(브라베크)에게 맡기고 갔는데, 그 사람도 나을 게 없어요.

english: Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?
translation: 아무튼 왕 얘기나 하러 여기 온 건 아닐 테고요. 그래서, West Ardougne(서 아르둔)에는 무슨 일로 왔어요?

english: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔)에서 온 Elena(엘레나)라는 여자를 찾고 있어요.

english: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔) 여자라면 동 아르둔에서 찾는 게 더 쉽죠. West Ardougne(서 아르둔)까지 와서 찾는 사람은 별로 없을 텐데요. 그래도 이름은 낯이 익네요. 어떻게 생겼어요?

english: Um... brown hair... in her twenties...
Hmmm, that doesn't narrow it down a huge amount... I'll need to know more than that, or see a picture?
translation: 흠, 그걸로는 별로 좁혀지지가 않네요... 그것보다 더 알려 주든가, 아니면 그림이라도 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.
translation: 아, 맞다. 그 사람, 역병 환자들을 도우러 여기 왔어요. Rehnison(레니슨) 가족 집에 머물고 있을 거예요.

english: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.
translation: 마을 맨 북쪽에 있는 작은 목조 건물에 사는 사람들이에요. 다만 요즘 한동안은 그 사람을 못 봤지만요.

english: I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?
translation: 혹시 거기 가는 김에 심부름 하나 해 줄 수 있어요? 그 집에서 이 책을 빌렸는데, 대신 돌려줄래요?

english: Yes, I'll return it for you.
Jethick gives you a book
No, I don't have time for that.
Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 안녕하세요. 이 근처엔 새로 오는 사람이 별로 없거든요.

english: I'm surprised you're still here. Not many like to stick around this place if they have the choice.
translation: 아직도 여기 있다니 놀랍네요. 선택할 수만 있다면 이런 곳에 오래 머물고 싶어 하는 사람은 별로 없는데.

english: Good to see you friend.
Hey Jethick, how's things?
Not bad, the city is still a mess but we've finally got the chance to change that now the mourners have gone.
translation: 나쁘지 않아요. 도시는 아직 엉망이지만, mourners(애도자)가 떠났으니 이제야 그걸 바꿀 기회가 생겼거든요.

english: Good to hear, all the best.
Let's see if you have what it takes to answer this question.
translation: 이 질문에 답할 만한 실력이 있는지 한번 볼까요.

english: What question?
The one on this scroll.
Jethick has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Not even close!
Spot on!
Jethick has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Yes, I'll return it for you.
No, I don't have time for that.
Hello.
Hello there. Welcome to the Temple of the Lesser Gods.
translation: 안녕하십니까. Temple of the Lesser Gods(하급 신들의 신전)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 하급 신들에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course. The lesser gods, or avatars as some call them, were born from the dreams of Tumeken. They are Apmeken, Het, Crondis and Scabaras.
translation: 물론입니다. 하급 신들, 혹은 화신이라 부르는 이들도 있는데, 이분들은 Tumeken(투메켄)의 꿈에서 태어났습니다. Apmeken(앱메켄), Het(헤트), Crondis(크론디스), Scabaras(스카바라스)가 그분들이지요.

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: Apmeken(앱메켄)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Apmeken is the goddess of companionship. She is known to be the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. I'd say she's my personal favourite.
translation: Apmeken(앱메켄)은 우애의 여신입니다. 하급 신들 가운데 가장 장난스럽고, 쾌활하며, 예측할 수 없는 분으로 알려져 있지요. 개인적으로는 제가 가장 좋아하는 분입니다.

english: So I shouldn't trust you then?
Apmeken can appeal to the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
translation: Apmeken(앱메켄)은 가장 박식한 학자에게도, 가장 뻔뻔한 거짓말쟁이에게도 매력적인 분입니다. 저는 전자에 속한다고 여겨지고 싶군요.

english: I see. What does she look like?
She has the head of a monkey, or sometimes an ape. It changes depending upon what nature she is displaying. For example, the orangutan represents wisdom, while the baboon represents mischief.
translation: 원숭이 머리, 때로는 유인원의 머리를 하고 계십니다. 어떤 본성을 드러내느냐에 따라 달라지지요. 예를 들어 오랑우탄은 지혜를, 개코원숭이는 장난기를 나타냅니다.

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: Het(헤트)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Het is the least strange of our deities to foreign eyes, for he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by thieves like that infamous Templeton.
translation: Het(헤트)는 외지인의 눈에 우리 신들 중 가장 덜 낯선 분입니다. 우리와 똑같은 모습을 하고 계시니까요. 그래서 그분의 사당이 그 악명 높은 Templeton(템플턴) 같은 도둑들에게 유독 자주 털리는 게 아닌가 싶습니다.

english: What does he represent?
Het is the god of health, both in mind and body. He is quite popular amongst soldiers as a result, especially up in Al Kharid.
translation: Het(헤트)는 마음과 몸, 양쪽 모두의 건강을 다스리는 신입니다. 그래서 병사들 사이에서 꽤 인기가 있지요. 특히 저 위쪽 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서요.

english: Just soldiers?
Not at all! Like I said, the wellbeing of the mind is also key to Het. Many great orators also look to him for guidance. I imagine his teachings help with some of their strenuous speeches.
translation: 전혀 그렇지 않습니다! 말씀드렸듯이 마음의 안녕 또한 Het(헤트)에게는 중요하지요. 위대한 연설가들도 많이들 그분께 인도를 구합니다. 그분의 가르침이 그 고된 연설에 도움이 되는 모양입니다.

english: How did his followers react to the plagues here?
translation: 이곳에 역병이 돌았을 때 그분의 신도들은 어떻게 반응했나요?

english: With many arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het, or an affront to him. I stayed out of that debate.
translation: 말다툼이 많았지요. 그것이 Het(헤트)가 내린 벌인지, 아니면 그분에 대한 모욕인지 도무지 결론을 내지 못했습니다. 저는 그 논쟁에 끼지 않았습니다.

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: Crondis(크론디스)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Crondis is a ferocious lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
translation: Crondis(크론디스)는 위풍당당한 악어의 머리를 한 사나운 여신입니다.

english: That must be awkward when buying helmets.
Luckily for her, I don't think deities have much need for them.
translation: 다행히도 신들에게는 투구가 그다지 필요하지 않을 겁니다.

english: So what is she the goddess of?
Resourcefulness. A word which seems to be open to large interpretation.
translation: 자원 활용입니다. 해석의 여지가 꽤 넓은 말이지요.

english: How so?
Most consider her to be a teacher of modesty. They say we should be resourceful by only taking and using that which we absolutely need.
translation: 대부분은 그분을 절제의 스승으로 여깁니다. 꼭 필요한 것만 취하고 쓰는 것이 자원을 제대로 활용하는 길이라고들 하지요.

english: But there's others with a different interpretation?
translation: 그런데 다르게 해석하는 사람들도 있다는 거죠?

english: Some believe she is actually the goddess of pleasure. They claim that the idea of modesty came from a misinterpretation, and that to be resourceful is to take all that you can.
translation: 어떤 이들은 그분이 사실 쾌락의 여신이라고 믿습니다. 절제라는 개념은 잘못된 해석에서 나온 것이고, 자원을 활용한다는 건 취할 수 있는 건 모두 취하는 것이라고 주장하지요.

english: That doesn't sound right.
No. It is a more recent take that I suspect was born in Menaphos. There are many in that city with more wealth than they'll ever need. Modesty is not an ideal they'll ever embody.
translation: 그렇지요. 제가 보기엔 Menaphos(메나포스)에서 생겨난 비교적 최근의 해석 같습니다. 그 도시엔 평생 쓰고도 남을 재물을 가진 이들이 많으니까요. 절제는 그들이 결코 실천할 일 없는 이상이지요.

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: There are many opinions out there on Scabaras, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)에 대해서는 여러 의견이 있지만, 널리 알려진 이야기가 늘 가장 정확한 건 아닙니다.

english: Well what are the absolute facts then?
Scabaras is the god of isolation. He takes on the appearance of a man with the head of a scarab. Both he and his followers were driven into hiding long ago.
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)는 고립의 신입니다. 스카라베의 머리를 한 사내의 모습을 하고 계시지요. 그분과 그분의 신도들은 오래전에 숨어 지내도록 내몰렸습니다.

english: And?
And that's it. You asked for the absolute facts. Anything beyond that is just speculation.
translation: 그게 전부입니다. 확실한 사실을 물으셨지요. 그 이상은 그저 추측일 뿐입니다.

english: But there must be more. The High Priest told me that Scabaras tried to conquer these lands.
translation: 하지만 더 있을 거예요. High Priest(대사제)님 말로는 Scabaras(스카바라스)가 이 땅을 정복하려 했다던데요.

english: So it is said, but the written accounts that exist contain many inconsistencies when it comes to what role Scabaras actually played. Of course, most would not know that.
translation: 그렇게들 말하지요. 하지만 남아 있는 기록들을 보면 Scabaras(스카바라스)가 실제로 어떤 역할을 했는지에 대해 앞뒤가 맞지 않는 부분이 많습니다. 물론 대부분은 그걸 모르겠지만요.

english: How come?
Many of the writings are only available to us priests. That does of course include the new High Priest, but perhaps he is yet to read them. They are definitely... illuminating.
translation: 그 기록 중 상당수는 우리 사제들만 볼 수 있으니까요. 물론 새 High Priest(대사제)님도 포함되지만, 아직 읽지 않으셨을지도 모르지요. 그 기록들은 확실히... 많은 것을 깨우쳐 줍니다.

english: Interesting...
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'd better get going.
Hey! You don't have permission to go down there.
translation: 이보세요! 그 아래로 내려가실 권한은 없으십니다.

english: Hello Jex.
Hello again.
Could you tell me more about the lesser gods?
translation: 하급 신들에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Could you tell me more about Apmeken?
translation: Apmeken(앱메켄)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Could you tell me more about Het?
translation: Het(헤트)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Could you tell me more about Crondis?
translation: Crondis(크론디스)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Could you tell me more about Scabaras?
translation: Scabaras(스카바라스)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'd better get going.
Thanks so much for saving us from those stinky gublinch. They were awful! I hope Shanty gave you somefing cool for your efforts.
translation: 그 냄새나는 gublinch(구블린치)들한테서 구해 줘서 정말 고마워요. 걔네 진짜 끔찍했어요! Shanty(샨티)가 수고했다고 멋진 거 줬으면 좋겠다아.

english: Hello?
Ah... Another wayward traveller.
Excuse me?
You are not the first to make your way down here. Undoubtedly, you will not be the last.
translation: 여기까지 내려온 자는 그대가 처음이 아니오. 틀림없이 마지막도 아닐 테지.

english: Who are you?
My aeternal name, given to me long ago, is Jimp.
translation: 아득한 옛날 내게 주어진 영겁의 이름은 Jimp(짐프)라오.

english: Jimp the imp?
Yes, though my many centuries upon this realm have taught me that the newer tongues struggle with its pronounciation.
translation: 그렇소. 다만 이 세계에서 보낸 수많은 세기 동안 깨달았는데, 요즘 언어로는 그 발음을 하기가 어려운 모양이더군.

english: So you may call me Jim.
Okay...
I see you still have questions. Before I answer them, I will need you to swear to secrecy.
translation: 아직 물을 게 남은 얼굴이군. 대답하기 전에 비밀을 지키겠다고 맹세해 주어야겠소.

english: Hang on... why would I do that?
I believe you will find my cooperation helpful. Perhaps I shall find yours helpful one day too.
translation: 내 협조가 쓸모 있을 거라 믿소. 어쩌면 언젠가 그대의 협조가 내게 쓸모 있을지도 모르고.

english: I've already entered one dubious contract.
I'm not sure I should be signing any others.
translation: 다른 계약에 또 서명해도 될지 모르겠어요.

english: You will find the nature of my contracts refreshing, then. My terms are simple: do not endanger me or take what is mine, and I shall do what I can to help you.
translation: 그렇다면 내 계약은 산뜻하게 느껴질 거요. 조건은 간단하오. 나를 위험에 빠뜨리거나 내 것을 빼앗지 말 것. 그러면 나도 힘닿는 대로 그대를 돕겠소.

english: Okay then, why not.
Excellent. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, [player name].
Wait, how do you know my name? Was this a trick?
translation: 잠깐, 제 이름을 어떻게 아세요? 이거 속임수였어요?

english: No, friend, you signed it right here.
translation: 아니오, 친구여. 그대가 바로 여기에 서명했잖소.

english: Oh, right.
Who are you really?
I suppose since you already know my name, you are asking who I am in the context of history and society.
translation: 내 이름은 이미 알고 있으니, 역사와 사회라는 맥락에서 내가 누구인지 묻는 것이겠군.

english: Yes, let's go with that.
I am afraid other agreements bar me from telling you much of my past. Nowadays, I am a humble servant of Yama, existing only to do as he pleases.
translation: 유감이지만 다른 계약들 때문에 내 과거는 많이 말해 줄 수가 없소. 지금의 나는 Yama(야마)의 미천한 종으로, 오직 그분 뜻대로 움직이기 위해 존재할 뿐이오.

english: And what is that?
Mostly fetching records, and dying. When I am not doing that, I rest here. The features of this isle remind me of those I once knew.
translation: 주로 기록을 가져오는 일, 그리고 죽는 일이오. 그 일을 하지 않을 때는 여기서 쉬지. 이 섬의 모습이 내가 한때 알던 그것들을 떠올리게 하거든.

english: Who do you mean by 'those'?
I already skirt as closely as I can to what I am disallowed from sharing. I apologise, but I cannot answer further.
translation: 말해서는 안 되는 것의 경계에 이미 최대한 가까이 다가가 있소. 미안하지만 더는 대답할 수 없소.

english: What is this place?
This isle is a small wonder. The rock formations here bear a slight resemblance to those from my own realm.
translation: 이 섬은 작은 경이요. 이곳의 암석 지형은 내 세계의 것들과 조금 닮았소.

english: The rock looks like it's crumbling.
Yes, infernal shale is kept together largely by the pressure from above. Once a piece is broken off, it can easily be broken down with a hammer and chisel.
translation: 그렇소. infernal shale(지옥 혈암)은 주로 위에서 누르는 압력 덕분에 뭉쳐 있소. 한 조각이 떨어져 나오면 hammer(망치)와 chisel(끌)로 쉽게 부술 수 있지.

english: That's good to know. What about the smithy?
I can say nothing more than that it was not here when I arrived.
translation: 내가 왔을 때는 여기 없었다는 것 말고는 아무 말도 할 수 없소.

english: So you brought it here?
I cannot say.
It's rather hot here.
Yes, the unique composition of this chasm does create a warm environment.
translation: 그렇소. 이 협곡의 독특한 구성 때문에 따뜻한 환경이 만들어지지.

english: I can see my sweat turning to vapour as soon as it appears.
translation: 땀이 나자마자 증기로 변하는 게 보여요.

english: Yes, water is an ineffective coolant at this temperature. Perhaps I could offer an alternative.
translation: 그렇소. 이 온도에서는 물로 열을 식히기 어렵소. 대신 쓸 만한 것을 하나 내어 줄 수 있을지도 모르겠군.

english: That would be handy.
The liquid will only offer a brief respite from the heat, but I find it can help to apply it frequently between bursts of exertion.
translation: 이 액체는 열기를 아주 잠깐만 덜어 줄 뿐이오. 하지만 힘을 쏟는 사이사이에 자주 바르면 도움이 되더군.

english: I see, thanks. I'll give that a try.
I can see you eyeing the liquid. It is best you do not ask.
translation: 그 액체를 눈여겨보는 게 보이는군. 묻지 않는 편이 좋을 거요.

english: Have another cloth. Remember, it only offers a brief respite from the heat. You'll want to time bursts of exertion right after using it.
translation: 천을 하나 더 가져가시오. 명심하시오, 열기를 아주 잠깐만 덜어 줄 뿐이오. 쓰고 나서 바로 힘을 쏟는 게 좋을 거요.

english: Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: 여기 아래에 왜 대장간이 있는 거예요?

english: I cannot speak to the purpose the smithy has, but I might be able to shed some light on the purposes it could be given.
translation: 대장간이 무슨 목적으로 있는지는 말할 수 없지만, 어떤 목적으로 쓰일 수 있는지는 조금 밝혀 줄 수 있을 것 같소.

english: Go on.
The furnace is capable of extremely high temperatures. Whilst not very helpful for your ores, it can melt metal from our realm.
translation: 이 furnace(용광로)는 엄청나게 높은 온도를 낼 수 있소. 그대의 광석에는 별 쓸모가 없지만, 우리 세계의 금속은 녹일 수 있지.

english: Like the rocks on this isle?
Not quite, though they are necessary to power the furnace. Nobody but Yama has access to the kinds of ores it was designed for.
translation: 그렇진 않소. 다만 용광로를 가동하려면 그 바위가 필요하지. 이 용광로가 원래 다루도록 만들어진 광석은 Yama(야마) 말고는 아무도 손에 넣을 수 없소.

english: But if I were to get my hands on some, I could work them here?
translation: 하지만 제가 그걸 좀 손에 넣는다면, 여기서 다룰 수 있겠네요?

english: Yes. The process is quite involved. Smaller shards must be melted into nuggets for stability, and then combined into chunks.
translation: 그렇소. 과정이 꽤 복잡하오. 작은 파편을 녹여 안정된 덩이로 만들고, 그것들을 합쳐 큰 덩어리로 만들어야 하지.

english: I see. Maybe I can give that a go.
translation: 그렇군요. 한번 해 볼 수도 있겠네요.

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
I am not alone in this amongst my kind, but I understand that I am rare. I have my reasons for being this way.
translation: 내 동족 중에 이런 자가 나 하나뿐은 아니지만, 드물다는 건 알고 있소. 내가 이렇게 지내는 데는 나름의 이유가 있소.

english: Well, if there is anything I can do for you, let me know.
translation: 음, 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 게 있으면 말씀하세요.

english: Thank you. There is little I can ask of you given the nature of my other agreements, but watching you work on this isle does bring me some comfort.
translation: 고맙소. 다른 계약들 때문에 그대에게 부탁할 수 있는 건 거의 없지만, 그대가 이 섬에서 일하는 모습을 지켜보는 것만으로도 위안이 되오.

english: Goodbye.
Safe travels, [player name].
I've already entered one dubious contract.
Okay then, why not.
Who are you really?
What is this place?
It's rather hot here.
More options...
Why is there a smithy down here?
translation: 여기 아래에 왜 대장간이 있는 거예요?

english: You're very friendly for a demon.
Goodbye.
Welcome to the Jungle Store. Can I help you at all?
translation: Jungle Store(정글 상점)에 어서 오세요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling
No thanks.
'Ello there.
Tell me about this room?
Well... s'like thish...
Thish here'sh a shtore room right?
A store room you mean?
That'sh what I shaid! *HIC* A shtore room.... Now technic'ly shpeaking, I should be outshide guarding it...
translation: 내가 그러케 마랬잖아! *딸꾹* 챵고.... 그러니까 원칙적으로 말하자면, 난 바께서 여길 지키고 이써야 하는데...

english: But you just nipped in to have a quick drink?
Yep... and to practish.
Practish? I mean.. practise what?
Keg balancin. I'm the besht.
Tell me how to balance kegs?
translation: 통 균형 잡는 법 좀 알려 줄래요?

english: Yer very very shtrange. But.... you pick the keg up, and balance it on yer head, then you pick another keg up and put that on top. S'really very eashy.
translation: 너 차암 이상하다. 그래도.... 통을 들어서 머리 위에 올리고, 또 다른 통을 들어서 그 위에 올리는 거야. 지인짜 쉽쥐.

english: Eashy?
Yesh. Eashy.
But you couldn't ever balansh ash many ash meee!
translation: 근데 넌 절대 나마아안큼 마니 못 올릴걸!

english: That sounds like a challenge, I'll show you!
May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 제 토큰 좀 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Wha'? You ain't earnt any mate!
translation: 뭐어? 너 하나도 안 벌었잖아, 친구!

english: Well... err.. ish not offishal or anyfin... but I got the ledger of tokensh 'ere. I'll jus' err.. write it in!
translation: 음... 그게.. 공식적인 건 아니지마안... 토큰 장부가 여기 있으니까. 내가 그냥 어.. 적어 주지!

english: Won't they know?
Nah... hic.... I'm a wizsh at copyin' signaturesh! Jus' ashk an offishal mem'er of shtaff like Shloane fer yer tokensh.
translation: 아니... 딸꾹.... 내가 서명 베끼는 데는 도사거든! Shloane(슐론) 같은 공식 직원한테 가서 토큰 달라고 해애.

english: The rather drunk Jimmy scribbles the tokens you've earned from Keg Balancing in the Ledger so that you can claim them from an official member of training staff.
translation: 꽤 취한 Jimmy(지미)가 Keg Balancing(통 균형 잡기)로 번 토큰을 Ledger(장부)에 휘갈겨 적어 주어, 훈련 담당 공식 직원에게 받을 수 있게 되었다.

english: Bye!
Shure you wouldn't like an ickle drinkie fore yer go?
translation: 가기 저너 쬐끄만 한잔 안 할래?

english: No thanks, got things to do, people to see, tokens to earn...
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 할 일도 있고, 만날 사람도 있고, 벌 토큰도 있어서요...

english: Ya got no chance o' beatin' me [player name]!
translation: 넌 날 이길 가망이 업써, [player name]!

english: No one's stronger than me, 'speshly not [player name]!
translation: 나보다 쎈 놈은 업써, 특히 [player name] 너는 더더욱!

english: Wow! That'sh bery impr....imp...impresh.... good [player name]! Equalsh my record!
translation: 와! 그거 진짜 대다... 대단... 대다안.... 잘했어, [player name]! 내 기록이랑 똑같네!

english: Tell me about this room.
Tell me how to balance kegs.
translation: 통 균형 잡는 법 좀 알려 주세요.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
translation: 제 토큰 좀 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Bye!
Hello.
Ah, you must be [player name]. I've been expectorating you.
translation: 아, 자네가 그 [player name](이)로군. 자네를 학수고래하고 있었네.

english: You... have?
I have. The Sisters Grime told me you'd be dropping in.
translation: 그렇다네. Sisters Grime(그라임 자매)가 자네가 들를 거라고 하더군.

english: They said you could teach me a thing or two about ratcatching.
translation: 쥐잡이에 대해 이것저것 가르쳐 주실 수 있다고 하던데요.

english: Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.
translation: 뭐, 가르쳐 줄 수야 있지만, 그것만으론 동기가 좀 부족하군.

english: I didn't get this far by giving out help freely to every adventurer who came my way.
translation: 찾아오는 모험가마다 공짜로 도와줬다면 내가 여기까지 오지 못했을 걸세.

english: Maybe I could help you out with something then?
I am an adventurer after all.
Ah, that's mincemeat to my ears!
translation: 아, 그거 귀에 착 감기는 장조림 같은 소리로군!

english: Music?
No thank you! Your unrefined caterwauling would only draw attention.
translation: 사양하겠네! 자네의 그 고양이 울음 같은 촌스러운 노랫소리는 이목만 끌 걸세.

english: How about I test your ratcatching mettle instead?
translation: 대신 자네의 쥐잡이 근성을 시험해 보는 게 어떻겠나?

english: Take a good long look at this map.
A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.
translation: 내 고객 중에 꽤 이름난 상인이 하나 있는데, 연어회를 연다네.

english: A what?
A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.
translation: 연어... 연회 말일세, 근사한 파티. 다시는 내 말을 끊지 말게.

english: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.
translation: 그 고객에게 골칫거리가 하나 있는데, 작고 털이 복슬복슬한 녀석이지.

english: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.
translation: 그런 거라면 의사를 부르는 게 낫겠는데요.

english: No, you fool! A rat problem.
translation: 아니, 이 멍청한 친구야! 쥐 문제란 말일세.

english: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.
translation: 그러니까 그 사람 집에 가서 쥐를 좀 잡으라는 거죠? 쉬워 보이는데요.

english: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.
translation: 아, 그렇게 간단하지 않네. 첫 번째 교훈일세. 우리 쥐잡이들은 은밀해야 하네.

english: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.
translation: 부유한 고객들은 그 호화로운 저택에 해충이 들끓는다는 소문이라도 나면 끝장이거든.

english: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그러니까 몰래 해치워야 한다는 거죠?

english: Precisely!
Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carryout this task with some element of safety.
translation: 혹시 모르니, 자네가 이 일을 조금이나마 안전하게 해낼 수 있도록 주문을 하나 걸어 주겠네.

english: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.
translation: 투명 주문을 걸어 주시는 거예요? 그러면 쉽겠네요.

english: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.
translation: 그건 아닐세. 들키면 이 주문이 자네를 가까운 곳으로 순간이동시키고, 자네를 발견한 자의 마지막 몇 초 기억을 하얗게 지워 버릴 걸세.

english: That's really useful!
Jimmy waves his hands about and mutters something under his breath.
translation: Jimmy(지미)가 손을 휘저으며 뭔가를 낮게 중얼거린다.

english: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?
That's a trade secret, m'afraid.
Well, can you teach me?
translation: 그럼 저한테 가르쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?
translation: 오, 저런, 안 되지. Ardougne(아르둔)의 온갖 잡배들이 이걸 알게 된다고 상상해 보게.

english: We already have a serious crime problem.
translation: 안 그래도 범죄 문제가 심각한데 말일세.

english: Oh, I see.
But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.
translation: 하지만 쥐잡이에 대해서라면 가르쳐 줄 게 아직 많네... 내가 맡긴 일을 해낸다면 말이지.

english: Do you have any tips for me now?
Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.
translation: 물론 있지! 고양이를 써서 쥐를 잡게.

english: That's it?
Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!
You mean a gift horse?
I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!
translation: 떡은 무슨 떡! 그런 거 줄 생각 없네! 자, 어서 나가게!

english: Off I go then...
Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?
What am I meant to do again?
Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?
translation: 지도에 적힌 길 안내를 따라 저택으로 가게. 도착하면 보이는 쥐는 고양이로 모조리 없애고, 들키지 말고 내게 돌아오게. 알겠나?

english: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.
Good, good.
Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?
I am?
A job well done. Confabulations!
No, the job really is done!
What?
Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그럼 이제 쥐잡이에 대해 전부 가르쳐 주시는 거죠?

english: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.
translation: 물론이지! 쥐잡이를 배우고 싶다면 여기 Ardougne(아르둔)에 있는 Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)로 가게.

english: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!
translation: 새끼 고양이를 훈련시키기에 아주 좋은 곳이지. 여기 이 Bones(뼈다귀)를 보게!

english: I think of nothing but murder all day!
He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?
translation: 쥐는 잘 잡게 생겼네요. 그런데 나이 든 고양이는요?

english: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.
translation: 아, 그건 말일세. 내 좋은 친구 Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)이 다 알려 줄 걸세.

english: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.
translation: 그 친구는 내가 본 중에 가장 늙은 고양이를 키우지.

english: Where do I find this... Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 그... Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)은 어디서 찾을 수 있죠?

english: He hangs around in a rather unfashionable part of Varrock. He likes a good scrap, does Jack.
translation: Varrock(바록)에서도 좀 허름한 동네를 어슬렁거리지. 싸움을 꽤 좋아한다네, 잭은.

english: I'll tell him to look out for you.
translation: 자네를 눈여겨보라고 그 친구한테 말해 두겠네.

english: Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?
translation: Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: The pits lie below this very pub.
translation: 구덩이는 바로 이 술집 아래에 있다네.

english: See that ladder there? That's the way in.
What goes on in these pits then?
I'd have thought it was self-exploratory. Here, have a manual.
translation: 그 정도는 자명종한 일인 줄 알았는데. 자, 설명서를 하나 주지.

english: Here, take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 자, 이걸 받게. 쓸모가 있을 걸세.

english: Ah, [player name]. Back for more intonation?
translation: 아, [player name]. 또 전보를 캐러 왔나?

english: Can you tell me where I can find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: Phingspet(핑스펫)과 Grimesquit(그라임스킷)을 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: They live in the sewers below Varrock.
Please don't say hello from me.
Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)을 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?
translation: Smokin' Joe(골초 조)를 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim.
translation: 그 늙은 괴짜 영감의 폐가 아직 버티고 있다면 Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 찾을 수 있을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me where I might find 'The Face'?
Port Sarim is your best bet.
Can you tell me where I might find Felkrash?
The Boss?
You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the Rat Pits there.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 있을 걸세. 아마 거기 Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)에 있겠지.

english: She's your boss?
Well, sort of. She's the unofficial leader of the Ratcatchers.
translation: 뭐, 그런 셈이지. Ratcatchers(쥐잡이들)의 비공식 우두머리일세.

english: Nobody elected her or anything.
translation: 누가 뽑아 준 것도 아니지만 말일세.

english: Got it. She's the boss.
Can you tell me more about the pits?
translation: 구덩이에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 자, 이걸 받게. 쓸모가 있을 걸세.

english: What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 저랑 제 고양이한테 줄 조언이 있나요?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Amulet of Catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 착용하게. 고양이와 전술을 짤 수 있을 걸세.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
translation: 그럼 어떤 전술을 쓰는 게 가장 좋을까요?

english: Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 그건 자네 생각에 달렸지. 고양이 목숨을 걸 각오가 되어 있는지, 그리고 고양이가 얼마나 방어적이거나 공격적이길 바라는지에 따라 다르다네.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 극도로 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 고양이의 체력과 방어력이 올라가지만 더 빨리 도망치게 되지.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 아니면 덜 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 그러면 고양이가 구덩이에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있지.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '그냥 몸조심해, 고양아.'

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
No thanks.
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '최대한 오래 버텨.'

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 이길 확률이 높아진다면 고양이 목숨을 걸겠어요.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 전면 공격을 택할 수 있네. 고양이의 공격력과 힘이 올라가지만 대신 방어는 약해지지.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 아니면 덜 공격적인 태세를 취할 수 있네. 고양이의 힘과 공격력이 조금 덜 오르지만 방어에 불이익은 없다네.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '용기 없이는 영광도 없다!'

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 구덩이에서 훈련하면 제 고양이한테 어떤 이점이 있나요?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
In the Ardougne pits, your kitten will grow up faster whether it wins or loses.
translation: Ardougne(아르둔) 구덩이에서는 이기든 지든 새끼 고양이가 더 빨리 자란다네.

english: What if it wins then?
It will gain more experience, it'll be happier, and it'll be fed, too.
translation: 경험치도 더 얻고, 더 행복해지고, 먹이도 먹게 되지.

english: Can you show me to the Rat Pits?
translation: Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)로 안내해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thanks.
Good luck!
How do you spell your name again?
J-I-M-M-Y D-A-Z-Z-L-E-R.
Why?
Ever thought about putting a '1' in it?
translation: 이름에 '1'을 하나 넣어 볼 생각은 없으세요?

english: Why on Gielinor would I do that?
translation: Gielinor(길리노르) 천지에 내가 왜 그런 짓을 하겠나?

english: Might add a bit of pizzazz, that's all.
translation: 좀 더 멋이 날 것 같아서요. 그냥 그렇다고요.

english: Pizzazz, you say? I'll think about it.
What's your name and your business here?
My name is [player name], and I have a couple of questions for you.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 하는데, 몇 가지 여쭤볼 게 있어요.

english: No.
What do you mean by no?
That just isn't the ticket. I don't know you nor I will not answer any questions.Now get gone from here, you'll attract unwanted attention to me.
translation: 그건 영 딱이 아니로군. 나는 자네를 모르니 어떤 질문에도 대답하지 않겠네. 이제 썩 꺼지게, 괜히 나한테 이목이 쏠리겠어.

english: As if those 'clothes' you're wearing wouldn't do that already.
translation: 지금 입고 계신 그 '옷'이 이미 충분히 이목을 끌 텐데요.

english: Ah [player name] aren't you just the ticket?
Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: Phingspet(핑스펫)과 Grimesquit(그라임스킷)을 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: You can find those vile harpies in the sewers of Varrock.
translation: 그 끔찍한 마녀 같은 것들은 Varrock(바록) 하수도에 있다네.

english: ~Jimmy shudders when he thinks of them.
If you ask me it's too good a place for them.
Can you tell me where I could find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)을 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: He should be in the roughest area of Varrock knowing him. He likes a good scrap does Jack.
translation: 그 친구 성격이라면 Varrock(바록)에서 가장 험한 동네에 있을 걸세. 싸움을 꽤 좋아한다네, 잭은.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Smokin Joe?
translation: Smokin Joe(골초 조)를 어디서 찾을 수 있을까요?

english: You won't find him around here. They wouldn't let a filthy old dwarf like him into a civilised town like this.
translation: 여기선 못 찾을 걸세. 그런 지저분한 늙은 드워프를 이렇게 교양 있는 동네에 들여 줄 리가 없지.

english: Well if he's not here where would I find him?
translation: 여기 없으면 어디서 찾을 수 있는데요?

english: If the old rascal's lungs haven't given up yet, you should find him in Keldagrim, the city of Dwarves.
translation: 그 늙은 괴짜 영감의 폐가 아직 버티고 있다면, 드워프의 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 찾을 수 있을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me where I would find 'The Face'?
Old pugly, my oh my but did she ever get her comeuppance.
translation: 그 늙은 퍼그난이 말이군. 아이고, 그 여자 제대로 벌을 받았지.

english: Old pugly?
Pug ugly.
She's worse than that.
She is?
Her looks are the stuff of legend. She's so ugly she ...
translation: 그 얼굴은 전설감이지. 얼마나 못생겼냐면 말이야...

english: You guys are really nasty.
Believe me she deserves everything she gets!
translation: 정말이지, 그 여자는 무슨 일을 당해도 싸네!

english: What did she do?
I couldn't possibly tell you, but be careful around her.
translation: 차마 말할 수 없네. 하지만 그 여자 곁에선 조심하게.

english: Will you please tell me where I could find her?
translation: 그분을 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 제발 알려 주시겠어요?

english: She'll be in or around Port Sarim I reckon.
translation: 내 생각엔 Port Sarim(포트 사림)이나 그 근처에 있을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Felkrash?
You'll find her in Port Sarim, probably in the ratpits.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 있을 걸세. 아마 ratpits(쥐 구덩이)에 있겠지.

Well what do you want to know?

english: Your other option is to adopt a less defensive strategy which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 다른 방법은 덜 방어적인 전략인데, 그러면 고양이가 구덩이에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있다네.

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Just take care of yourself cat.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '그냥 몸조심해, 고양아.'

english: In that case you should tell your cat, 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말하게. '최대한 오래 버텨.'

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat, 'Go berserk!'
In that case you should tell this to your cat, 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이에게 이렇게 말해 주게. '용기 없이는 영광도 없다!'

english: In the Ardougne pits your kitten will grow up faster, whether it wins or loses.
translation: Ardougne(아르둔) 구덩이에서는 이기든 지든 새끼 고양이가 더 빨리 자란다네.

english: It will gain more experience and will become happier and will be fed.
translation: 경험치도 더 얻고, 더 행복해지고, 먹이도 먹게 되지.

english: Can you show me to the rat pits?
translation: 쥐 구덩이로 안내해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you tell me where I can find...
translation: 어디 가면 찾을 수 있는지 여쭤볼게요...

Hooknosed Jack
Smokin' Joe

Can you tell me where I would find...

Can you tell me more about the pits?

Can you show me to the rat pits?
translation: 쥐 구덩이로 안내해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Hey...who are you?
Oh, just passsing...What're you in for?
translation: 아, 그냥 지나가던 참이에요... 무슨 죄로 들어오셨어요?

english: We don't talk about why we're in here, we just contemplate the crime we commited...or ways to get out!
translation: 여기선 왜 들어왔는지 얘기 안 해. 그냥 저지른 죄를 곱씹을 뿐이지... 아니면 빠져나갈 궁리를 하거나!

english: Hello mate!
Did you see what happened to my friend?
translation: 제 친구한테 무슨 일이 있었는지 보셨어요?

english: There was a lot of commotion when they dragged you in here. There was someone else, she was struggling like anything. They said they'd take her outside. Dunno what happened to her then.
translation: 널 여기 끌고 들어올 때 꽤 소란스러웠지. 다른 사람도 하나 있었는데, 그 여자가 엄청 발버둥 쳤어. 밖으로 데려간다고 하더라고. 그 뒤로는 어떻게 됐는지 몰라.

english: Oh no! I've got to find her!
translation: 이런! 그 애를 꼭 찾아야 해요!

english: Hey who are you?
I'm Jimmy...Jimmy the Chisel...who are you?
translation: 난 Jimmy(지미)야... Jimmy the Chisel(끌잡이 지미)... 넌 누구야?

english: I'm [player name], and I've come to release you....Aggie sent me.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 하고, 당신을 풀어 주러 왔어요.... Aggie(애기)가 보냈어요.

english: So...are you gonna bust me out of here then...
translation: 그래서... 날 여기서 빼내 주겠다는 거야...

english: Jail break! Great, how exciting!
Well, I thought I'd try a more diplomatic solution first...do you know who I have to talk to?
translation: 음, 우선은 좀 더 외교적인 방법부터 써 보려고요... 누구랑 얘기해야 하는지 아세요?

english: Oh, pity...well, you could speak to Johanhus...I think he's the leader.
translation: 아, 아쉽네... 음, Johanhus(요한후스)한테 말해 봐... 그 사람이 우두머리인 것 같아.

english: Ok, I'll try that.
Hiya...you're Jimmy aren't you?
That's right.
I've made a deal with Johanhus...I need to go sort out some chickens to secure your release.
translation: Johanhus(요한후스)랑 거래를 했어요... 당신을 풀어 주려면 닭 몇 마리를 처리하고 와야 해요.

english: Blimey...the price of my neck for a few chickens...I'd say that was worth it...
translation: 세상에... 내 목숨값이 닭 몇 마리라니... 그 정도면 남는 장사지...

english: Yeah...me too...anyway, I'll be back as soon as I've got the deal sorted.
translation: 네... 저도 그렇게 생각해요... 아무튼 거래를 마무리하는 대로 돌아올게요.

english: Great...many thanks
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 어이? 네놈, 우리 해적 패거리랑 한배 타고 싶은 거냐?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 화약 꼬맹이 녀석이 럼주 퍼마시고 난동 부리다 뻗어서 쉬는 중이라, 네놈 자리는 넉넉하다고.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
translation: 저는 그냥 저쪽에 있을 테니 필요하면 부르세요.

english: Whadda ya want?
Whadda ya got?
We gots grog and we gots food. Here, take a look.
translation: grog(그로그)도 있고 먹을 것도 있지. 자, 구경해 봐.

english: Nothing! Honest!
Then stop takin' up me floor space!
translation: 그럼 내 바닥 차지하지 말고 꺼져!

english: I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: 그 작살 손을 어디서 얻으셨는지 알고 싶었어요.

english: Yer new in town aintcha?
Newish certainly.
Well, if ye wants te hear the story, here goes.
translation: 좋아, 그 얘기가 듣고 싶다면 들려주지.

english: See, I was walkin' along the docks one day, and this fierce storm blew up.
translation: 그러니까, 하루는 내가 부두를 걷고 있는데, 엄청난 폭풍이 몰아쳤지.

english: All of a sudden I turn an there, bearin' down on me is this albatross...
translation: 갑자기 돌아봤더니, 앨버트로스 한 마리가 나한테 덮쳐 오는 거야...

english: Sorry to interrupt, but I would just like to clear something up.
translation: 말씀 끊어서 죄송한데, 하나만 확실히 해 두고 싶어서요.

english: What? I was just gettin' to the good bit.
When I said 'I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand', I meant where did you get it made, or buy it from?
translation: 제가 '그 작살 손을 어디서 얻으셨는지 알고 싶었어요'라고 한 건, 어디서 만드셨는지, 아니면 어디서 사셨는지 물어본 거였어요.

english: If ye don't wants to hear the story then I ain't gonna tell ye!
translation: 이야기 듣기 싫으면 안 해 주면 그만이지!

english: Whadda ya got?
Nothing! Honest!
I wanted to know where you got that harpoon hand.
translation: 그 작살 손을 어디서 얻으셨는지 알고 싶었어요.

english: Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.
translation: 안녕, 난 Joe(조)야. Lady Keli(켈리 부인)의 문지기지.

english: Hi, who are you guarding here?
Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not supposed to talk while I guard.
translation: 말 못 해, 극비라서. 얼른 여기서 나가. 경비 서는 동안엔 말하면 안 되거든.

english: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?
Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구예요. 그냥 여기 좀 둘러보는 중이에요.

english: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
translation: 왕자가 도망쳤어. 난 큰일 났다고. 너랑 얘기 안 하는 게 좋겠어, 내가 취했었는지 아직 다들 확신을 못 하고 있거든.

english: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.
translation: 아무 말 안 할게요. 비밀은 지켜 드릴게요.

english: Hello there. Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
translation: 어서 오세요. 제가 파는 물건을 보시겠어요?

english: Yes please, Jofridr.
No thank you, Jofridr.
Fairthee well.
Why do you have so much wool in your store? I haven't seen any sheep anywhere.
translation: 가게에 양털이 왜 이렇게 많아요? 양은 어디서도 못 봤는데요.

english: Ah, I have contacts on the mainland. I have a sailor friend who brings me crates of wool on a regular basis.
translation: 아, 본토에 연줄이 있거든요. 선원 친구 하나가 정기적으로 양털을 상자째 가져다줘요.

english: What do you trade for it?
Rope of course! What else can we sell? Fish would go off before it got so far south.
translation: 당연히 밧줄이죠! 우리가 팔 게 그것 말고 뭐가 있겠어요? 생선은 그렇게 남쪽까지 가기 전에 상해 버리니까요.

english: Where does all this rope go?
Err, I don't remember the name of the place very well. Dreinna? Drennor? Something like that.
translation: 어, 그곳 이름이 잘 기억이 안 나네요. 드레이나? 드레노르? 뭐 그 비슷한 거였는데.

english: That's very interesting. Thanks Jofridr.
Would you like to see the goods I have for sale?
Yes please, Jofridr
No thank you, Jofridr
Why do you have so much wool in your store?

Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].
translation: 환영합니다, [Brother/Sister]... 우리 조직에 오신 것을... 우리의 싸움은 온갖 모습의 인류를 위한 것이며... 이 세상에 존재하는 괴물들을 인류에게서 몰아내기 위한 것입니다. 같은 [brother/sister]와는 다툴 이유가 없지요.

english: What kind of organisation is this?
We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.
translation: 우리는 문명화된 평범한 인간 사회에서 괴물을 몰아내기 위해 앞장서는 조직입니다. 이 땅에는 도무지 기개라는 게 없으니, 우리가 나서서 그 도전을 받아들이는 것이지요.

english: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!
translation: 흠, 어떻게 하실 건데요? 이 근처에선 매일 사람들이 고블린을 잡고 있잖아요!

english: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.
translation: 우리는 사람들을 모으고, 우리만의 사회를 세우고 있습니다... 한때 그 더러운 생물들이 살던 동굴을 깨끗이 쓸어 내고 지켜서, 다시는 열등한 종족이 숨어들지 못하게 할 겁니다.

english: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.
translation: 좀 이상하게 들리지만, 뭐 그쪽 선택이죠.

english: Who are you and what do you do here?
My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.
translation: 제 이름은 Johanhus(요한후스)이며, 'Humans against Monsters(괴물에 맞서는 인간들)'라는 용감한 사명 아래 이 영광스러운 사람들을 이끌고 있습니다. 우리 모두가 평화롭게 살 수 있도록 이 땅에서 괴물을 없애려는 것이지요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hey, I've found this, do you know anything about it?
Yes, in fact I do. I wrote many essays for this book, it was a great seller, many people are stirred by the words and feelings in such a tome.
translation: 그럼요, 압니다. 제가 그 책에 수많은 글을 썼지요. 아주 잘 팔린 책이었습니다. 많은 이들이 그 책에 담긴 글과 정서에 감화되었지요.

english: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: cave goblins(동굴 고블린)에 대해 뭔가 하실 생각이세요?

english: You should know, [brother/sister]...we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans...but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: 알아 두십시오, [brother/sister]... 우리는 평회원에게 모든 계획을 알려 주지 않습니다... 하지만 안심하십시오, 그 더러운 생물들은 곧 처리될 겁니다!

english: Can't you please tell me?
No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Ordinary members like you must learn to...trust your leaders.
translation: 안 됩니다! 그런 정보는... 고위 회원만을 위한 것입니다. 당신 같은 평회원은... 지도자를 믿는 법을 배워야 합니다.

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Why should I tell it to an...outsider?
translation: 안 됩니다! 그런 정보는... 고위 회원만을 위한 것입니다. 내가 왜 그걸... 외부인에게 말해야 합니까?

english: Is it really necessary?
How can you even...ask that? Right beneath Lumbridge is a whole cave system full of those creatures! They've got a passage leading right up into the castle kitchen!
translation: 어떻게 그런... 질문을 할 수 있습니까? Lumbridge(럼브리지) 바로 아래에 그 생물들로 가득한 동굴이 줄줄이 있단 말입니다! 성 부엌까지 곧장 이어지는 통로도 있고요!

english: And I've heard that there's a whole city of those things down there, not that anyone has ever seen it. What have they got in there? What are they planning?
translation: 게다가 저 아래에 그것들의 도시가 통째로 있다고 들었습니다. 본 사람은 아무도 없지만요. 거기에 뭘 숨겨 두었을까요? 무슨 꿍꿍이를 꾸미고 있을까요?

english: We've got to get them before they get us!
translation: 놈들이 우리를 덮치기 전에 우리가 먼저 쳐야 합니다!

english: That's good.
So, you got out of the cell? No matter...your goblin friend has already been dealt with...and Sigmund is on his way to deal with the rest of her foul brood!
translation: 그래, 감방에서 빠져나왔군? 상관없다... 네 고블린 친구는 이미 처리됐으니까... 그리고 Sigmund(지그문트)가 그 계집의 더러운 족속들을 마저 처리하러 가는 중이다!

english: I can't hear anything.
Shh! I can hear them.
Good news, brothers! Our tunnel from the water mill cellar has reached the cave goblin tunnels, and the last shipment of machinery is on its way from Keldagrim.
translation: 좋은 소식입니다, 형제들! 물레방앗간 지하실에서 판 우리 터널이 동굴 고블린 터널에 닿았고, 마지막 기계 장치 운송분도 Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 오는 중입니다.

english: Do we have to deal with the dwarves? They may not exactly be monsters but they're still not human.
translation: 꼭 드워프들과 거래해야 합니까? 괴물이라고까지 할 순 없지만, 그래도 인간은 아니지 않습니까.

english: If it wasn't for the King's tolerance of monsters, we humans would have a better industry than the dwarves!
translation: 왕께서 괴물들을 용인하지만 않으셨어도, 우리 인간의 산업이 드워프보다 나았을 겁니다!

english: Well said, brother!
I'll need to take some of the low-level members to help unload the machinery at the Lumbridge water mill.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지) 물레방앗간에서 기계 장치 내리는 걸 도우려면 하급 회원 몇 명을 데려가야겠습니다.

english: By all means. It's about time that lot made themselves useful.
translation: 얼마든지요. 그 무리도 이제 슬슬 쓸모가 있어야지요.

english: Soon the mighty River Lum will wash away those evil goblins forever!
translation: 머지않아 위대한 River Lum(럼 강)이 그 사악한 고블린들을 영원히 쓸어 버릴 겁니다!

english: Saradomin will surely bless us for destroying those abominations!
translation: 그 흉측한 것들을 멸하면 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 반드시 우리를 축복하실 겁니다!

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
What kind of organisation is this?
Who are you and what do you do here?
Ok, thanks.
Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: cave goblins(동굴 고블린)에 대해 뭔가 하실 생각이세요?

english: Can't you please tell me?
Is it really necessary?
That's good.
ZzzzZzzZZzzZZzz.
He's sleeping peacefully. Loudly, but peacefully.
translation: 곤히 자고 있네요. 시끄럽긴 해도 곤히요.

english: Hello there!
Who are you?
I'm John, I specialise in archaeology and there's some very interesting ruins in this area.
translation: 저는 John(존)이에요. 고고학을 전공하는데, 이 지역에 아주 흥미로운 폐허가 좀 있거든요.

english: Is that like fossils and stuff?
translation: 그럼 화석 같은 거 말씀하시는 거예요?

english: Oh my word no. Archaeology is the study of sentient races history through study of artefacts and ruins.
translation: 아이고, 전혀 아니에요. 고고학은 유물과 폐허를 통해 지성을 가진 종족들의 역사를 연구하는 학문이에요.

english: Weren't fossils sentient?
Well... we have no proof to suggest such.
translation: 글쎄요... 그렇다고 볼 만한 증거는 없어요.

english: What is going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: This is our base camp for exploration of this wonderful island.
translation: 이 멋진 섬을 탐사하기 위한 베이스캠프예요.

english: Anything I can do to help?
No, no. You've already helped admirably. Our lives are much more comfortable thank you.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨. 이미 훌륭하게 도와주셨어요. 덕분에 저희 생활이 훨씬 편해졌어요, 고마워요.

english: What should I do?
Explore! There's so much here we don't understand.
translation: 탐험하세요! 여긴 우리가 모르는 게 정말 많아요.

english: But where?
I've heard there's a pretty spectacular structure up near the mountain, but I haven't gone there yet.
translation: 산 근처에 꽤 장관인 구조물이 있다고 들었는데, 저는 아직 못 가 봤어요.

english: Who are you?
What is going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: What should I do?
I am so very tired... Leave me be... to rest...
translation: 너무나 피곤해요... 날 내버려 둬요... 쉬게...

english: Hello again. My family now considers you a hero.
translation: 다시 뵙네요. 우리 가족은 이제 당신을 영웅으로 여기고 있어요.

english: Maybe because... I am.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 네, 뭐... 제가 도와드릴 일이라도 있나요?

english: Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿을 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.
Great thanks!
Johnathon takes your gauntlets from you, and begins a low chant over them. You see them begin to glow and sparkle, before he returns them to you.
translation: Johnathon(조나선)이 건틀릿을 받아 들고 나지막이 주문을 읊조린다. 건틀릿이 빛나며 반짝이기 시작하더니, 그가 다시 돌려준다.

english: No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.
translation: 아버지께 당신이 또 우리를 도와주셨다는 소식을 들었어요! 아마 해낼 때까지 포기할 생각이 없으셨던 것 같네요.

english: If you want, I'll provide you with as many pairs of Chaos gauntlets as you wish to say thanks!
translation: 원하신다면 감사의 뜻으로 Chaos gauntlets(혼돈의 건틀릿)을 원하시는 만큼 드릴게요!

english: You will find the power of bolt spells increases substantially whilst wearing these gauntlets.
translation: 이 건틀릿을 끼고 있으면 볼트 주문의 위력이 크게 늘어날 거예요.

english: Thank you.
Here you go!
You're welcome.
Can you change my gauntlets for me?
translation: 제 건틀릿을 바꿔 주실 수 있나요?

english: Great thanks!
No that's okay thanks.
No thanks.
Could I have another pair of Chaos gauntlets?
translation: Chaos gauntlets(혼돈의 건틀릿)을 한 켤레 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You're welcome.
You are unusually helpful for an outerlander, Darkal Dräpare.
translation: 외지인치고는 보기 드물게 도움이 되는군, Darkal Dräpare(다르칼 드레파레).

english: Ehm, thanks... I guess.
This dish turned out horrendously.
How come?
It... tastes like nothing...
Jon shows you an empty bowl.
Isn't that bowl empty?
So nothing tastes the same cause nothing is never there?
translation: 그러니까 '없음'이 늘 같은 맛인 건, '없음'이 거기 있었던 적이 없어서인가요?

english: I'll be going...
That's probably for the best.
Hello there.
Hello, lovely day we're having.
Same as every day really, the weather is very consistent around here.
translation: 사실 매일 똑같죠. 이 근처는 날씨가 정말 한결같거든요.

english: Hello there. Have you heard of Camorra?
Who?
Camorra. She was a great hero who fought in the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend during the war. I'm trying to find out what happened to her.
translation: Camorra(카모라)요. Dragonkin Conflicts(드래곤킨 분쟁)에서 싸운 위대한 영웅이에요. 전쟁 중에 Kourend(쿠렌드)로 갔던 것 같아요. 그녀가 어떻게 됐는지 알아보는 중이에요.

english: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts, they'd have stayed away from people like her.
translation: 영웅이요? 음, 그렇다면 Hosidius(호시디우스)와는 별 관계가 없었을 거예요. 초기 호시디우스 정착민들은 모두 평화주의자였거든요. 그런 사람과는 거리를 뒀을 거예요.

english: Oh well. Thanks for the help.
Can't stop to talk human. Lady Lovakengj might need me.
translation: 얘기할 시간 없다, 인간. Lady Lovakengj(로바켕기 영주)께서 날 찾으실지도 몰라.

english: Hi there.
All is lost!
Sorry?
Don't bother, you're not experienced enough to help me!
translation: 신경 쓰지 마세요, 당신은 저를 도울 만큼 경험이 많지 않아요!

english: Just look around you! This great building will soon be in ruin.
translation: 주위를 둘러보세요! 이 위대한 건물이 곧 폐허가 될 거라고요.

english: Great building?
Of course! This building has a history spanning generations!
translation: 당연하죠! 이 건물에는 몇 세대에 걸친 역사가 있다고요!

english: Ah, I see, a great history. But why will it be in ruin?
translation: 아, 그렇군요, 위대한 역사라. 그런데 왜 폐허가 된다는 거죠?

english: It's to be ripped apart to make way for King Lathas' new alchemists' lab.
translation: King Lathas(라타스 왕)의 새 연금술사 연구소를 지으려고 이곳을 허물어 버린대요.

english: Does the king not respect the outpost's GREAT history?
translation: 왕께서는 이 전초기지의 '위대한' 역사를 존중하지 않으시나요?

english: Well, actually nobody knows what the history is. But there must be something.
translation: 음, 사실 그 역사가 뭔지는 아무도 몰라요. 하지만 분명 뭔가 있을 거예요.

english: Wait a minute. You could help me!
translation: 잠깐만요. 당신이 저를 도와줄 수 있겠어요!

english: Me?
Yes! Uncover the history of this building to convince King Lathas to leave it alone. Do you want to know more?
translation: 네! 이 건물의 역사를 밝혀내서 King Lathas(라타스 왕)께서 이곳을 그냥 두시도록 설득해 주세요. 더 알고 싶으세요?

english: Tell me more.
A cutscene appears.
With many occupants over the years...
translation: 수많은 이들이 세월을 거쳐 이곳에 머물렀고...

english: ...the building has seen much action.
It started life as an outpost...
... its sole purpose being to see invading armies...
... before they saw the city of Ardougne.
translation: ...Ardougne(아르둔) 시를 보기도 전에 먼저 발견해 내는 것이었다.

english: The cutscene disappears.
If all goes well, I hope to be able to turn it into a museum as a monument to the area's history. What do you think?
translation: 모든 게 잘 풀리면 이곳을 박물관으로 바꿔서 이 지역 역사의 기념물로 삼고 싶어요. 어떻게 생각하세요?

english: OK, I will make a stand for history!
Oh thank you so much, you really are my saviour!
translation: 오, 정말 고마워요, 당신은 제 구세주예요!

english: But where should I start?
What do I need to do now?
There are three people that may be able to help:
translation: 도움이 될 만한 사람이 세 명 있어요:

english: There is a silver trader in East Ardougne called Erin, who I believe can help.
translation: East Ardougne(동 아르둔)에 Erin(에린)이라는 은 상인이 있는데, 그 사람이 도와줄 수 있을 거예요.

english: In what way can he help?
translation: 그 사람이 어떻게 도와줄 수 있는데요?

english: His Great Grandfather lived in this outpost according to the records. He must know something!
translation: 기록에 따르면 그 사람의 증조할아버지가 이 전초기지에 살았대요. 분명 뭔가 알고 있을 거예요!

english: OK, I'll see what he has to say.
translation: 알겠어요, 무슨 말을 하는지 들어 볼게요.

english: I've been told that there's a ghost far off in Port Phasmatys that moans of losing his life to this place.
translation: 저 멀리 Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)에 유령이 하나 있는데, 이곳에서 목숨을 잃었다고 신음하고 있대요.

english: Sounds ominous. Does he have a name?
He does indeed. It's Droalak.
I'll track him down.
It might not be so simple! You'll need an amulet of ghostspeak to talk to him!
translation: 그렇게 간단하진 않을 거예요! 그와 대화하려면 amulet of ghostspeak(유령 언어 아뮬렛)이 필요해요!

english: I've conversed with the dead before, that shouldn't be too much of a problem.
translation: 죽은 자와는 전에도 대화해 봤으니, 큰 문제는 없을 거예요.

english: Up near the mountains, in Rellekka is a warrior called Dron whom I have spoken to in the past. He is always on the lookout for information that can improve his fighting and commanding skills.
translation: 산 근처 Rellekka(렐레카)에 Dron(드론)이라는 전사가 있는데, 예전에 이야기를 나눈 적이 있어요. 그는 늘 자신의 전투 실력과 지휘 능력을 키워 줄 정보를 찾아다니죠.

english: And how's he related to this outpost?
translation: 그 사람은 이 전초기지와 무슨 관계가 있는데요?

english: He isn't directly, but he's studied many wars, and as this used to be an outpost it should have been involved in some war.
translation: 직접적인 관계는 없지만, 많은 전쟁을 연구했거든요. 여기는 예전에 전초기지였으니 분명 어떤 전쟁에든 얽혀 있었을 거예요.

english: That sounds simple enough.
He isn't the easiest person to talk to, so you may need to speak to his brother, Blanin, first.
translation: 그는 대하기 쉬운 사람이 아니라서, 먼저 그의 형제인 Blanin(블라닌)과 이야기해야 할지도 몰라요.

english: What's the story so far?
What do you mean? You've discovered nothing!
translation: 무슨 소리예요? 당신은 아무것도 알아내지 못했잖아요!

english: Got to go, bye!
I don't care about some dusty building.
translation: 낡아 빠진 건물 따위엔 관심 없어요.

english: It's doomed. DOOMED!
Thanks for the help again. Feel free to browse the room next door!
translation: 다시 한번 도와줘서 고마워요. 옆방도 마음껏 둘러보세요!

english: Hello there, I have this master clue he...
translation: 안녕하세요, 마스터 단서가 하나 있는데 여...

english: Stop! I can't help you unless you help me out first.
translation: 잠깐! 먼저 저를 도와주지 않으면 저도 당신을 도울 수 없어요.

english: Okay then, moving on...
Hi Jorral, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 안녕하세요, Jorral(조랄) 씨. 부탁드릴 게 있어서 왔어요.

english: What can I do for you [Player name]?
Ah! Remember that enchanted key you had to use previously?
translation: 아! 전에 쓰셨던 enchanted key(마법이 걸린 열쇠) 기억나세요?

english: Yes, I do.
Well this should function much the same, the deeper magic of the key itself is stored within this strange device.
translation: 음, 이것도 거의 똑같이 작동할 거예요. 열쇠에 깃든 더 깊은 마력이 이 strange device(이상한 장치) 안에 담겨 있거든요.

english: You should feel it, and it will guide you to where you need to go.
translation: 만져 보면 가야 할 곳으로 안내해 줄 거예요.

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 드리기 전에 소지품에 자리를 좀 비워 두세요.

english: Be careful with it, the raw magic can damage you unexpectedly when you feel it.
translation: 조심하세요, 날것의 마력이라 만질 때 예기치 않게 다칠 수도 있어요.

english: No, I don't.
Ah, well the enchanted key can lead you to treasure. The magical nature of the key heats it up or cools it down, depending on your proximity to the treasure.
translation: 아, 그 enchanted key(마법이 걸린 열쇠)는 보물로 안내해 줘요. 열쇠의 마법적인 성질 때문에 보물과의 거리에 따라 뜨거워지거나 차가워지죠.

english: Hey Jorral, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: Jorral(조랄) 씨, 또 단서 두루마리가 생겼는데 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: 그 strange device(이상한 장치)가 열쇠처럼 길을 안내해 줄 거예요. 만져 보되, 아주 강력하니 조심하세요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: Tell me more.
Yes.
A trader in Ardougne
A ghost in Port Phasmatys
A warrior in Rellekka
What's the story so far?
What do I need to do now?
Got to go, bye!
No.
I don't care about some dusty building
translation: 낡아 빠진 건물 따위엔 관심 없어요

english: Yes, I do.
No, I don't.
Do you want to trade?
What are you selling?
The finest smiths from all over Gielinor come here to work, and I buy the fruit of their craft. Armour made from the higher metals!
translation: Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 최고의 대장장이들이 여기 와서 일하는데, 저는 그들의 솜씨가 낳은 결실을 사들이죠. 상급 금속으로 만든 갑옷이에요!

english: Let's have a look then.
No thanks.
You just don't appreciate the beauty of fine metalwork.
translation: 당신은 훌륭한 금속 세공의 아름다움을 모르는군요.

english: Only the top smiths are allowed in there!
translation: 저 안에는 최고의 대장장이만 들어갈 수 있어요!

english: What are you selling?
Let's have a look then.
No thanks.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너만큼 못생겼으면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 놈 잡아먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니 꺼져, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참한 날이군... 누릴 수 있을 때 실컷 누려 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무우우척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이 사이에 누구 한 조각이 끼어서...

english: I see you managed to escape from those monsters intact!
It seems I was not as injured as I thought I was after all! I must thank you again for all of your help! Now, about that casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: 생각보다 많이 다치지 않았나 봐요! 도와주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요! 그런데, 그 괴물 시체에서 찾으신 casket(작은 상자) 말인데요...

english: I have it here. You said you might be able to tell me something about it...
translation: 여기 가지고 있어요. 그것에 대해 뭔가 알려 주실 수 있을지도 모른다고 하셨죠...

english: I can indeed! Here, let me have a closer look... Yes! There is something written on it!
translation: 그럼요! 자, 좀 자세히 볼게요... 그래요! 뭔가 쓰여 있어요!

english: It is very faint, however... Can you read it?
translation: 그런데 아주 희미하네요... 읽을 수 있으시겠어요?

english: I think it says... Saradomin...
translation: 아마... Saradomin(사라도민)이라고 쓰여 있는 것 같아요...

english: Are you sure? I mean, are you REALLY sure? Maybe you'd better look again...
translation: 확실해요? 그러니까, 정말로 확실해요? 다시 한번 보시는 게 좋겠는데...

english: Nope, it definitely says Saradomin.
I think you're right! Hand it here, and let's see what's inside!
translation: 맞는 것 같네요! 이리 주세요, 안에 뭐가 들었는지 봅시다!

english: Wow! It's a Holy Book of Saradomin! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 와! Holy Book of Saradomin(사라도민의 신성한 책)이에요! 이런 건 전부 사라진 줄 알았는데! 자, 이제 당신 거예요. 소중히 여겨 주세요.

english: Nope, it definitely says Zamorak.
Wow! It's an Unholy Book of Zamorak! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 와! Unholy Book of Zamorak(자모락의 불경한 책)이에요! 이런 건 전부 사라진 줄 알았는데! 자, 이제 당신 거예요. 소중히 여겨 주세요.

english: Nope, it definitely says Guthix.
Wow! It's Guthix's Book of Balance! I thought these things had all vanished! Well, it's all yours, I hope you appreciate it.
translation: 와! Guthix(구식스)의 Book of Balance(균형의 책)예요! 이런 건 전부 사라진 줄 알았는데! 자, 이제 당신 거예요. 소중히 여겨 주세요.

english: I wish it were one of the other gods. I'd prefer my reward to be aligned to a different god, not Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix.
translation: 다른 신이었으면 좋겠어요. Saradomin(사라도민), Zamorak(자모락), Guthix(구식스) 말고 다른 신을 따르는 보상을 받고 싶거든요.

english: The sea's always washing up interesting stuff around my lighthouse. Perhaps I'll find something more suitable for you in future.
translation: 제 등대 주변에는 바다가 늘 흥미로운 물건들을 밀어 올려 줘요. 나중에 당신에게 더 어울리는 걸 찾게 될지도 모르겠네요.

english: For now, this casket definitely says Saradomin, Zamorak or Guthix. Which do you think it is?
translation: 일단 지금 이 casket(작은 상자)에는 분명 Saradomin(사라도민), Zamorak(자모락), Guthix(구식스) 중 하나가 쓰여 있어요. 어느 쪽인 것 같아요?

english: I think it says... Zamorak...
translation: 아마... Zamorak(자모락)이라고 쓰여 있는 것 같아요...

english: I think it says... Guthix...
translation: 아마... Guthix(구식스)라고 쓰여 있는 것 같아요...

english: Guthix
I never had any casket from that monster...?
translation: 그 괴물한테서 casket(작은 상자) 같은 건 얻은 적 없는데요...?

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! Now, free up some inventory space so we can see what's inside it.
translation: 아니, 당연히 얻으셨죠! 떨어뜨리신 걸 제가 주웠어요! 자, 안에 뭐가 들었는지 볼 수 있게 소지품에 자리를 좀 비워 주세요.

english: Why, of course you did! You dropped it and I picked it up! I have it right here!
translation: 아니, 당연히 얻으셨죠! 떨어뜨리신 걸 제가 주웠어요! 바로 여기 있어요!

english: Now let's have a look at it... There is some writing on it, but it is very faint... Can you make it out?
translation: 자, 한번 살펴볼까요... 뭔가 쓰여 있긴 한데 아주 희미하네요... 알아보시겠어요?

english: I have it stored safely.
Well, bring it here and let's take a look at it!
translation: 그럼 이리 가져와 보세요, 한번 살펴보죠!

english: Ah yes, I wanted to talk to you about the casket you found on that monster's corpse...
translation: 아, 그 괴물 시체에서 찾으신 casket(작은 상자) 얘기를 하고 싶었어요...

english: Hello again, adventurer. What brings you this way?
translation: 다시 오셨군요, 모험가님. 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: Can I see your wares?
Sure thing! I think you'll find my prices are remarkable!
Have you found any more prayerbooks?
Have you found any more prayerbooks?
It's amazing how things like that keep washing up on the shore in caskets. Take a look at what I've got...
translation: 그런 물건들이 상자에 담겨 계속 해안으로 밀려온다는 게 신기하다니까요. 제가 가진 걸 한번 보세요...

english: Nothing, really. Good bye.
Saradomin
Zamorak
I wish it were one of the other gods.
Can I see your wares?
Nothing, really. Good bye.
Hello there. What do you need?
What do you do around here?
I mostly look after the lab equipment and make sure things run as they should.
translation: 주로 연구소 장비를 돌보고 모든 게 제대로 돌아가는지 확인하죠.

english: These days, I'm not much into the production side of things... All that moving up and down, pulling levers, carrying vials... These old bones ain't what they used to be.
translation: 요즘은 생산 쪽 일은 잘 안 해요... 오르락내리락하고, 레버 당기고, 약병 나르고... 이 늙은 몸이 예전 같지가 않거든요.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: 연금술사분들은 안전 장비를 정말 많이 착용하시네요.

english: Of course! Some of the mixtures down here can get pretty nasty in their raw form. Safety first!
translation: 당연하죠! 여기 아래 있는 혼합물 중엔 날것 상태로는 꽤 고약한 것들도 있거든요. 안전이 제일이에요!

english: Although between you and me... I'm not sure if anything this lab produces can be considered truly safe for human consumption.
translation: 근데 우리끼리 얘긴데요... 이 연구소에서 만드는 것 중에 사람이 먹어도 정말 안전하다고 할 만한 게 있는지 잘 모르겠어요.

english: Yikes! I guess I'll not be trying anything then!
translation: 으악! 그럼 아무것도 안 먹어 봐야겠네요!

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
You alchemists sure wear a lot of safety gear.
translation: 연금술사분들은 안전 장비를 정말 많이 착용하시네요.

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
You'll need a weapon to try and attack this beast.
The Jubbly Bird is too quick for your melee weapon.
translation: Jubbly Bird(저블리 새)는 너무 빨라서 근접 무기로는 맞힐 수 없다.

english: Magic simply won't affect this beast!
translation: 마법은 이 짐승에게 전혀 통하지 않는다!

english: Your ranged weapon isn't powerful enough to hurt the Jubbly bird.
translation: 이 원거리 무기는 Jubbly bird(저블리 새)에게 상처를 입힐 만큼 강하지 않다.

english: Sqwark!
Screech!
!!Croak!!
Gobble!
Rawk!
Dragon swords! Here, Dragon swords! Straight from Frenaskrae!
