translation: Dragon swords(드래곤 검) 사세요! 여기요, 드래곤 검! Frenaskrae(프레나스크레)에서 바로 들여왔어요!

english: Yes please!
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
Yes please.
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 눈에 안 띄게 섞여 있는 중이야. 여기 좀 살펴보고 있지.

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 한탕 준비라도 하는 거야? 아직 꼬맹이잖아.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 그냥 이 근처에 주머니 두둑한 부자들이 좀 있다고만 해 두지.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 요령 좀 알려 줄래? 나는 영 운이 없거든.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 나 꽤 교활하거든. 가끔 사람들 시선을 끌어서 주머니를 덜 신경 쓰게 만들어.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
translation: 정말 교활하네. 네 그... 주의 돌리기를 잘 지켜볼게.

english: Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 이제 나 좀 내버려 둬. 너랑 얘기하는 것부터가 벌써 주의 돌리기라고!

english: Oh dear! Oh dear! I don't have time to chat!
translation: 어머나! 어머나! 지금 얘기할 시간이 없어요!

english: Please leave my husband alone. He's very sick, and I don't want anyone bothering him.
translation: 제 남편을 좀 내버려 두세요. 많이 아파서 아무도 그이를 귀찮게 하지 않았으면 해요.

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Is there anything I can do?
Thank you, but I just want him to see a priest.
translation: 고마워요, 하지만 저는 그저 그이가 사제님을 만나 봤으면 해요.

english: A priest? Hmmm...
Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Bold adventurer, have you seen Romeo on your travels? Skinny guy, a bit wishy washy, head full of poetry.
translation: Romeo(로미오), 로미오, 그대는 어찌하여 로미오인가요? 용감한 모험가님, 여행하시다가 로미오를 보셨나요? 비쩍 마르고, 좀 우유부단하고, 머릿속엔 시만 가득한 사람이에요.

english: Yes I've met him. He seemed a bit depressed.
translation: 네, 만난 적 있어요. 좀 우울해 보이던데요.

english: Yes, that sounds like Romeo. I'd be very grateful if you could deliver a message to him?
translation: 네, Romeo(로미오)가 맞는 것 같네요. 그이에게 쪽지를 전해 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
Many thanks! Oh, I'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.
translation: 정말 고마워요! 오, 너무너무 감사해요. 당신이 우리의 유일한 희망일지도 몰라요.

english: No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: 아니요, 저한텐 좀 너무 이상한 사람이었어요.

english: Oh dear, that will be the ruin of our love. Well, I will just stay here and worry. You unromantic soul.
translation: 오, 이런, 그러면 우리 사랑은 끝장이에요. 그럼 저는 그냥 여기서 걱정이나 하고 있을게요. 이 낭만 없는 사람 같으니.

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
Oh, well that's a shame, I was hoping that you might deliver a message to him for me.
translation: 오, 아쉽네요. 그이에게 제 쪽지를 전해 주실 수 있을까 했는데.

english: Sorry, but I don't even know what he looks like or where he is?
translation: 죄송하지만, 저는 그 사람이 어떻게 생겼는지도, 어디 있는지도 모르는데요?

english: Oh, he's so lovely...in his own soppy and confused way. You should spot him easily! He's usually fending off the advances of the Varrockian market women. Are you sure I couldn't persuade you to deliver my itsy bitsty
translation: 오, 그이는 정말 사랑스러워요... 나름 질척하고 갈팡질팡하는 식으로요. 금방 알아보실 거예요! 보통 Varrock(바록) 시장 아주머니들의 구애를 막아 내느라 바쁘거든요. 정말 제 쪼끄맣고

english: widdle message to my Romeo?
translation: 쪼그만 쪽지를 제 Romeo(로미오)에게 전해 주실 수 없을까요?

english: No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 아니요, 죄송해요, 더 중요한 일이 있어서요.

english: Then, I will not keep you from them. Goodbye.
I guess I could look for him for you.
translation: 제가 찾아봐 드릴 수는 있을 것 같아요.

english: Oh, that would be so wonderful of you! I'd be most grateful if you could please deliver a message to him?
translation: 오, 정말 친절하시네요! 그이에게 쪽지를 전해 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: I think you could do better than Romeo!
translation: Romeo(로미오)보다 더 나은 사람을 만날 수 있을 거예요!

english: He has his good points, he's not obsessed with fighting, magic and ranging at least.
translation: 그이에게도 장점은 있어요. 적어도 전투니 마법이니 원거리 공격 같은 데 집착하진 않거든요.

english: I sat in that cold crypt for ages waiting for Romeo.
translation: 그 차가운 crypt(지하 묘지)에서 Romeo(로미오)를 한참이나 기다렸어요.

english: That useless fool never showed up.
translation: 그 쓸모없는 바보는 끝내 나타나지 않았죠.

english: And all I got was indigestion. I am done with men like him.
translation: 제가 얻은 거라곤 소화불량뿐이에요. 그런 남자는 이제 지긋지긋해요.

english: Now go away before I call my father!
translation: 이제 가세요, 안 그러면 아버지를 부를 거예요!

english: Juliet, I come from Romeo. He begs me to tell you that he cares still.
translation: Juliet(줄리엣), Romeo(로미오)가 보내서 왔어요. 아직도 당신을 아낀다고 꼭 전해 달라고 하더군요.

english: Oh how my heart soars to hear this news! Please take this message to him with great haste.
translation: 오, 그 소식을 들으니 가슴이 벅차올라요! 이 쪽지를 서둘러 그이에게 전해 주세요.

english: Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.
translation: 음, 좋은 소식이면 좋겠네요... 제가 떠날 때 꽤 속상해하던데요.

english: He's quite often upset...the poor sensitive soul. But I don't think he's going to take this news very well, however, all is not lost.
translation: 그이는 자주 속상해해요... 가엾고 여린 사람이죠. 그이가 이 소식을 잘 받아들이진 못할 것 같지만, 그래도 모든 게 끝난 건 아니에요.

english: Everything is explained in the letter, would you be so kind and deliver it to him please?
translation: 모든 건 편지에 설명해 뒀어요. 그이에게 전해 주시겠어요?

english: Hello Juliet!
Hello there...have you delivered the message to Romeo yet? What news do you have from my loved one?
translation: 안녕하세요... Romeo(로미오)에게 쪽지는 전해 주셨나요? 제 사랑하는 그이에게서 무슨 소식이 있나요?

english: Oh, sorry, I've not had chance to deliver it yet!
translation: 아, 죄송해요, 아직 전할 기회가 없었어요!

english: Oh, that's a shame. I've been waiting so patiently to hear some word from him.
translation: 오, 아쉽네요. 그이의 소식을 꾹 참고 기다리고 있었는데.

english: Hmmm, that's the thing about messages...they're so easy to misplace...
translation: 흐음, 쪽지라는 게 참... 잃어버리기 쉽단 말이죠...

english: How could you lose that message? It was incredibly important...and it took me an age to write! I used joined up writing and everything!
translation: 어떻게 그 쪽지를 잃어버릴 수가 있어요? 엄청 중요한 거였는데... 쓰는 데 한참 걸렸다고요! 필기체로 이어 쓰기까지 했단 말이에요!

english: Please, take this new message to him, and please don't lose it.
translation: 제발 이 새 쪽지를 그이에게 전해 주세요. 이번엔 잃어버리지 마시고요.

english: Hi Juliet, I have passed your message on to Romeo..he's scared half out of his wits at the news that your father wants to kill him.
translation: 안녕하세요, Juliet(줄리엣). Romeo(로미오)에게 쪽지를 전했는데... 당신 아버지가 자기를 죽이려 한다는 소식에 혼비백산했어요.

english: Yes, unfortunately my father is quite the hunter, you may have seen some the animal head trophies on the wall. And it would be so awful to see Romeo's head up there with them!
translation: 네, 안타깝게도 저희 아버지는 대단한 사냥꾼이에요. 벽에 걸린 동물 머리 박제들 보셨을지도 모르겠네요. 거기에 Romeo(로미오)의 머리까지 걸리는 걸 보게 된다면 정말 끔찍할 거예요!

english: I know what you mean...
...his hair colour will clash terribly with the rest of the decoration.
translation: ...그 머리 색이 나머지 장식이랑 끔찍하게 안 어울릴 테니까요.

english: That's not what I was suggesting at all...
I know, I know...I was just kidding.
Anyway, don't worry because I'm on the case. I'm going to get some help from Father Lawrence.
translation: 아무튼 걱정 마세요, 제가 해결하고 있으니까요. Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님께 도움을 청할 거예요.

english: Oh yes, I'm sure that Father Lawrence will come up with a solution. I hope you find him soon.
translation: 오, 그래요, Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이라면 분명 해결책을 찾아 주실 거예요. 빨리 만나 뵙길 바라요.

english: Hi Juliet!
Hi [player name], how close am I to being with my true love Romeo?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 제 진정한 사랑 Romeo(로미오)와 함께하게 될 날이 얼마나 남았나요?

english: Sorry, I still have to get a special potion for you.
translation: 죄송해요, 아직 당신에게 줄 특별한 물약을 구해야 해요.

english: Oh, I hope it isn't a love potion because you would be wasting your time. My love for Romeo grows stronger every minute...
translation: 오, 사랑의 묘약이 아니었으면 좋겠네요. 그렇다면 시간 낭비일 테니까요. Romeo(로미오)를 향한 제 사랑은 매 순간 더 깊어지고 있거든요...

english: That must be because you're not with him...
translation: 그건 그 사람이랑 같이 있지 않아서일걸요...

english: Oh no! I long to be close to my true love Romeo!
translation: 오, 안 돼요! 저는 제 진정한 사랑 Romeo(로미오) 곁에 있고 싶다고요!

english: Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!
translation: 음, 그럼 알겠어요... 최대한 빨리 그 물약을 구해 올게요!

english: Fair luck to you, the end is close.
Hi Juliet! I have an interesting proposition for you...suggested by Father Lawrence. It may be the only way you'll be able to escape from this house and be with Romeo.
translation: 안녕하세요, Juliet(줄리엣)! Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이 제안한 흥미로운 계획이 있어요... 이 집에서 빠져나가 Romeo(로미오)와 함께할 수 있는 유일한 방법일지도 몰라요.

english: Go on....
I have a Cadava potion here, suggested by Father Lawrence. If you drink it, it will make you appear dead!
translation: Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이 권한 Cadava potion(카다바 물약)을 가져왔어요. 이걸 마시면 죽은 것처럼 보이게 돼요!

english: Yes...
And when you appear dead...your still and lifeless corpse will be removed to the crypt!
translation: 그리고 죽은 것처럼 보이면... 미동도 없는 당신의 시신이 crypt(지하 묘지)로 옮겨질 거예요!

english: Oooooh, a cold dark creepy crypt...
translation: 오오오, 차갑고 어둡고 으스스한 crypt(지하 묘지)라니...

english: ...sounds just peachy!
Then...Romeo can steal into the crypt and rescue you just as you wake up!
translation: 그러면... Romeo(로미오)가 crypt(지하 묘지)에 몰래 들어가서 당신이 깨어나는 순간 구해 낼 수 있어요!

english: ...and this is the great idea for getting me out of here?
translation: ...그래서 이게 저를 여기서 빼내 줄 대단한 생각이라는 거죠?

english: To be fair, I can't take all the credit...in fact...it was all Father Lawrence's suggestion...
translation: 솔직히 말하면, 다 제 공은 아니에요... 사실은... 전부 Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님 생각이었거든요...

english: Ok...if this is the best we can do...hand over the potion!
You pass the suspicious potion to Juliet.
Wonderful! I just hope Romeo can remember to get me from the crypt.
translation: 훌륭해요! Romeo(로미오)가 crypt(지하 묘지)로 저를 데리러 오는 걸 잊지 않길 바랄 뿐이에요.

english: Please go to Romeo and make sure he understands. Although I love his gormless, lovelorn soppy ways, he can be a bit dense sometimes and I don't want to wake up in that crypt on my own.
translation: Romeo(로미오)에게 가서 그이가 꼭 이해하도록 해 주세요. 그이의 얼빠지고, 상사병에 걸린 질척한 모습도 사랑하지만, 가끔 좀 둔할 때가 있어서요. 그 crypt(지하 묘지)에서 혼자 깨어나고 싶진 않거든요.

english: A cutscene starts
Oh, here's Phillipa, my cousin...she's in on the plot too!
translation: 오, Phillipa(필리파)가 왔네요, 제 사촌이에요... 그 애도 이 계획을 알고 있어요!

english: She's going to make it seem even more convincing!
translation: 그 애가 훨씬 더 그럴듯하게 만들어 줄 거예요!

english: Yes, I'm quite the actress! Good luck dear cousin!
translation: 그럼, 내가 연기 좀 하잖아! 행운을 빌어, 사랑하는 사촌!

english: Right...bottoms up!
Urk!
Oh no...Juliet has...died!
You might be more believable if you're not smiling when you say it...
translation: 웃으면서 말하지 않으면 좀 더 그럴듯할 것 같은데요...

english: Oh yeah...you might be right...ok, let's try again.
translation: 아, 그렇네요... 맞는 말씀일지도... 좋아요, 다시 해 볼게요.

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died?
Perhaps a bit louder, like you're upset...that your cousin has died!
translation: 좀 더 크게요, 마치 속상한 것처럼... 사촌이 죽었으니까요!

english: Right...yes...Ok, ok, I think I'm getting my motivation now. Ok, let's try this again!
translation: 그래요... 네... 좋아요, 좋아요, 이제 감정이 좀 잡히는 것 같아요. 좋아요, 다시 해 볼게요!

english: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Oooooohhhhhh....(sob), (sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!
translation: 오, 안 돼... JULIET(줄리엣)이... 죽었어?.... 흐어어어어엉....(흑흑), (흑흑). 줄리엣... 불쌍한 내 사촌이 죽다니!

english: What's all that screaming?
Oh no! My poor daughter...what has become of you?
translation: 오, 안 돼! 가엾은 내 딸아... 어쩌다 이렇게 되었느냐?

english: Poor Juliet...make preparations for her body to be placed in the Crypt...
translation: 가엾은 Juliet(줄리엣)... 그 애의 시신을 Crypt(지하 묘지)에 안치할 준비를 해 주세요...

english: A cutscene ends
Oh, I just can't be bothered.
What's the matter Juliet?
I've been told I have to throw the birthday party at my place this year, but I don't feel like it, my life is just tragic.
translation: 올해 생일 파티를 우리 집에서 열어야 한대요. 그런데 그럴 기분이 아니에요. 제 인생은 그냥 비극이거든요.

english: I don't care about this party.
Sometimes I think my life's nothing but a comedy, but I don't let it get me down. Why so glum chum?
translation: 저는 가끔 제 인생이 희극 같다고 생각하지만, 그렇다고 기죽진 않아요. 왜 그렇게 시무룩해요, 친구?

english: Romeo doesn't care for me anymore, the minute he saw Phillipa, he's been all over her. I have no one anymore.
translation: Romeo(로미오)는 더 이상 저를 신경 쓰지 않아요. Phillipa(필리파)를 보자마자 그 애한테 푹 빠져 버렸거든요. 이제 저한텐 아무도 없어요.

english: Oh come on, it can't be that bad. Is Romeo really worth getting this upset over? He's a bit empty headed if you ask me.
translation: 에이, 그렇게 나쁠 리가요. Romeo(로미오)가 이렇게 속상해할 만한 가치가 있는 사람이에요? 제가 보기엔 좀 머리가 비었던데요.

english: He was all I had, now the only thing keeping me going is the soft sounds of Gertrude's Cats.
translation: 그이가 제 전부였어요. 이제 저를 버티게 해 주는 건 Gertrude(거트루드)네 고양이들의 부드러운 소리뿐이에요.

english: I have no-one in my life, I can't be with my love, Romeo. There is nothing for me to wake up to each day, I feel like my life is a repeat of the same day over and over.
translation: 제 인생엔 아무도 없어요. 사랑하는 Romeo(로미오)와 함께할 수도 없고요. 매일 아침 눈을 뜰 이유가 없어요. 같은 하루가 계속 되풀이되는 것만 같아요.

english: You need to get out and enjoy life Juliet, slay some dragons and explore the world.
translation: 밖에 나가서 인생을 즐겨야 해요, Juliet(줄리엣). 드래곤도 좀 잡고 세상도 탐험하고요.

english: I wouldn't go that far! I'm just tired of being locked in this house with just my cousin, Phillipa.
translation: 거기까지는 좀 그렇고요! 그냥 사촌 Phillipa(필리파)랑 둘이서만 이 집에 갇혀 지내는 게 지겨울 뿐이에요.

english: The only thing that cheers me up is looking over to Gertrude's house and seeing her kittens playing.
translation: 저를 기운 나게 해 주는 건 Gertrude(거트루드)네 집을 건너다보면서 그녀의 새끼 고양이들이 노는 걸 구경하는 것뿐이에요.

english: Sounds like you need a new friend, would you like me to see if Gertrude will give you one of her kittens?
translation: 새 친구가 필요하신 것 같네요. Gertrude(거트루드)가 새끼 고양이 한 마리를 줄 수 있는지 제가 알아봐 드릴까요?

english: I've asked her before, but we aren't on good standing anymore, ever since I planted lilies in our garden.
translation: 전에 부탁해 봤는데, 우리 정원에 백합을 심은 뒤로 사이가 틀어졌어요.

english: Why would she be upset about lilies?
They're quite poisonous to cats, how was I supposed to know, I'm not a cat doctor...
translation: 백합이 고양이한테 꽤 독하대요. 제가 어떻게 알았겠어요, 고양이 의사도 아닌데...

english: Maybe getting you a pet isn't a good idea then, perhaps I should go talk to your cousin for some ideas.
translation: 그럼 반려동물을 구해 드리는 건 좋은 생각이 아니겠네요. 사촌분한테 가서 좋은 생각이 있는지 물어봐야겠어요.

english: I'll be here...alone, waiting for the next adventurer to come along and try to help.
translation: 저는 여기 있을게요... 혼자서, 다음 모험가가 와서 도와주려 하길 기다리면서요.

english: Did my heart love till now? Forswear it, sight! For I ne'er saw true beauty till this night.
translation: 내 마음이 지금껏 사랑을 했던가? 아니라고 맹세하라, 눈이여! 오늘 밤 전까지 참된 아름다움을 본 적이 없었으니.

english: All that glitters is not platinum.
All the world's a stage, And all the men and women merely players. They have their exits and their entrances. And one man in his time plays many parts,
translation: 온 세상은 무대요, 모든 남녀는 배우일 뿐. 저마다 퇴장도 하고 등장도 하며, 한 사람이 일생 동안 여러 역을 맡으니,

english: His acts being seven ages.
Doubt thou the stars are fire. Doubt that the sun doth move. Doubt truth to be a liar. But never doubt I love.
translation: 별이 불꽃임을 의심하고, 태양이 움직임을 의심하고, 진실이 거짓일까 의심할지라도, 나의 사랑만은 결코 의심하지 마오.

english: Double, double, toil and trouble. Fire burn, and cauldron bubble!
translation: 끓어라, 끓어라, 고생과 근심아. 불은 타오르고 가마솥은 부글부글!

english: Love's stories written in love's richest books. To fan the moonbeams from his sleeping eyes.
translation: 사랑의 이야기는 사랑의 가장 값진 책에 쓰여 있노라. 잠든 그의 눈가에서 달빛을 부채질해 걷어 내리라.

english: What are you mumbling to yourself Juliet?
Oh, I've just been reading a book, it helps me get through the day.
translation: 아, 그냥 책을 읽고 있었어요. 하루를 버티는 데 도움이 되거든요.

english: I need to find a way to cheer her up, Phillipa should be able to help, I just can't stand to see her like this.
translation: 그녀를 기운 나게 할 방법을 찾아야 해. Phillipa(필리파)라면 도와줄 수 있을 거야. 이런 모습은 차마 못 보겠어.

english: Hello again Juliet, I've got a surprise that might cheer you up.
translation: 다시 왔어요, Juliet(줄리엣). 기운 나게 해 줄 깜짝 선물이 있어요.

english: Where is it? I don't see anything?
Oh damn, where did I put them?
Come back when you have something for me...
translation: 저한테 줄 게 생기면 다시 오세요...

english: Juliet, I've got something for you.
Oh my! What's that on your head?
Since you can't have a cat, I thought I'd be one for you. Meeeeooow...
translation: 고양이를 못 키우시니까 제가 대신 고양이가 되어 드리려고요. 냐아아아옹...

english: Oh wonderful! Are you going to dance for me then?
translation: 어머 멋져요! 그럼 저를 위해 춤춰 주실 거예요?

english: Of course!
Wow...
Wow shred it dude!
Oh that's absolutely marvellous!
That's really impressive! You must oftrained very hard to pull that off.
translation: 정말 인상적이에요! 그렇게 해내려면 엄청 열심히 연습하셨겠어요.

english: That's cute, but sorry, you're not my type.
translation: 귀엽긴 한데, 미안해요, 제 취향은 아니에요.

english: Yawn, you just did that...
Don't do that.
Interesting.
Uhm...
You're so silly.
I love it!
Wonderful.
That's delightful.
Hehehe.
Why would you do that?
Please Stop.
That was weird.
Please don't do that again.
Wow, thanks [player name], I feel a lot better.
translation: 와, 고마워요, [player name] 님. 기분이 훨씬 나아졌어요.

english: Oh Saradomin, that was embarrassing
Don't be embarrassed, you've made me feel better. I'm going to throw a big party to say thanks.
translation: 창피해하지 마세요, 덕분에 기분이 나아졌는걸요. 고마움의 표시로 성대한 파티를 열 거예요.

english: Maybe I don't need Romeo after all.
translation: 어쩌면 저한테 Romeo(로미오)는 필요 없을지도 모르겠어요.

english: Head downstairs when you're ready. Oh, you can keep the ears as well.
translation: 준비되면 아래층으로 내려오세요. 아, 그 귀는 가지셔도 돼요.

english: Hi Juliet, why aren't you downstairs enjoying the party?
translation: 안녕하세요, Juliet(줄리엣). 왜 아래층에서 파티를 즐기지 않고 계세요?

english: It's a little too loud for me down there, I'd rather stay up here and relax.
translation: 아래는 저한텐 좀 시끄러워서요. 여기 위에서 쉬는 게 더 좋아요.

english: To each their own, you've thrown a truly amazing party this year.
translation: 사람마다 다른 거죠. 올해 파티는 정말 굉장했어요.

english: Yes I've met him.
Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
No, he was a little too weird for me.
translation: 아니요, 저한텐 좀 너무 이상한 사람이었어요.

english: No, I think I'd have remembered if I'd met him.
Certainly, I will do so straight away.
No, sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 아니요, 죄송해요, 더 중요한 일이 있어서요.

english: I guess I could look for him for you.
translation: 제가 찾아봐 드릴 수는 있을 것 같아요.

english: I think you could do better than Romeo!
translation: Romeo(로미오)보다 더 나은 사람을 만날 수 있을 거예요!

english: Ask about the birthday party.
Something else.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is the Marim branch of the Bank of Gielinor. Now that our people have more contact with the lands overseas, we have new business opportunities. Can I help you?
translation: 이곳은 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)의 Marim(마림) 지점입니다. 저희 종족이 바다 건너 땅과 교류가 늘면서 새로운 사업 기회가 생겼지요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Why? You don't use the bank.
Oh yeah... Never mind then.
I can sell you up to [number] additional bank slots in sets of 40. How many are you interested in buying?
translation: 추가 은행 칸은 40칸 단위로 최대 [number]칸까지 판매해 드릴 수 있습니다. 몇 칸을 구매하시겠습니까?

english: [number] slots please.
Buying [number] additional bank slots will cost [number] coins. Be warned, this purchase is not reversible. Are you happy to proceed?
translation: 추가 은행 칸 [number]칸을 구매하시면 [number]코인이 듭니다. 이 구매는 되돌릴 수 없으니 유의하십시오. 진행하시겠습니까?

english: Oh... I don't seem to have enough money for that. Never mind.
translation: 아... 돈이 모자란 것 같네요. 그럼 됐어요.

english: Yes, I'm happy with that.
Your additional bank slots have been added.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'd like to buy more bank slots.
Yes.
No.
I'm fine, thanks.
Tell me... a story...
Okay...
Perhaps you should empty your hands before you begin.
translation: 시작하기 전에 손을 비우는 게 좋겠네.

english: You tell Juna some stories of your adventures.
translation: Juna(주나)에게 모험 이야기를 몇 가지 들려준다.

english: Your story has entertained me. But it is a poor sort of adventurer who only tells stories of the past and does not find new stories to tell. I will not let you into the cave again until you have had more adventures!
translation: 자네 이야기는 즐거웠네. 하지만 지난 이야기만 늘어놓고 새 이야기를 찾아 나서지 않는 모험가는 변변치 못한 법이지. 모험을 더 하기 전에는 동굴에 다시 들여보내지 않겠네!

english: You cannot enter the cave again until you have gained either one quest point or [experience due] total XP.
translation: 퀘스트 점수 1점이나 총 경험치 [experience due]를 얻기 전에는 동굴에 다시 들어갈 수 없네.

english: It has not been long since your last visit. Come back [tomorrow/in [amount] days].
translation: 지난번에 온 지 얼마 되지 않았네. [tomorrow/in [amount] days] 다시 오게.

english: I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again when you have had more adventures.
translation: 자네에게는 새로 들려줄 이야기가 없을 듯하군. 모험을 더 하고 나서 다시 오게.

english: I fear you will have no new stories to tell me. Come again [tomorrow/in [amount] days] if you have had more adventures by then.
translation: 자네에게는 새로 들려줄 이야기가 없을 듯하군. 그때까지 모험을 더 했다면 [tomorrow/in [amount] days] 다시 오게.

english: Your stories have entertained me. I will let you into the cave for a short time.
translation: 자네 이야기들이 즐거웠네. 잠시 동안 동굴에 들여보내 주지.

english: Collect as much as you can from the blue streams. If you let in water from the green streams, it will take away from the blue. For Guthix is god of balance, and balance lies in the juxtaposition of opposites.
translation: 푸른 물줄기에서 최대한 많이 모으게. 초록 물줄기의 물을 받으면 푸른 물이 줄어들 걸세. Guthix(구식스)는 균형의 신이고, 균형은 서로 반대되는 것들이 나란히 놓이는 데 있기 때문이지.

english: The player enters the Tears of Guthix cave
translation: 플레이어가 Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물) 동굴로 들어간다

english: You tell me a story.
The Third Age of the world was a time of great conflict, of destruction never seen before or since, when all the gods save Guthix warred for control.
translation: 세상의 Third Age(제3시대)는 크나큰 분쟁의 시대였네. 전무후무한 파괴가 일어났고, Guthix(구식스)를 제외한 모든 신이 지배권을 두고 전쟁을 벌였지.

english: The colossal Wyrms, of whom today's dragons are a pale reflection, turned all the sky to fire, while on the ground armies of foot soldiers, goblins and trolls and humans, filled the valleys and plains with blood.
translation: 오늘날의 드래곤은 그 희미한 그림자에 불과한 거대한 Wyrms(웜)이 온 하늘을 불바다로 만들었고, 땅에서는 고블린과 트롤과 인간으로 이루어진 보병 군대가 골짜기와 평원을 피로 물들였네.

english: In time the noise of the conflict woke Guthix from His deep slumber, and He rose and stood in the centre of the battlefield so that the splendour of His wrath filled the world, and He called for the conflict to cease!
translation: 이윽고 전쟁의 소란이 깊은 잠에 빠져 있던 Guthix(구식스)를 깨웠고, 그분께서 일어나 전장 한가운데 서시니 그 진노의 위엄이 온 세상을 가득 채웠네. 그리고 그분께서 전쟁을 멈추라 외치셨지!

english: Silence fell, for the gods knew that none could challenge the power of the mighty Guthix -- for His power is that of nature itself, to which all other things are subject, in the end.
translation: 침묵이 내려앉았네. 위대한 Guthix(구식스)의 힘에 맞설 자가 없음을 신들은 알았으니까 -- 그분의 힘은 자연 그 자체의 힘이며, 결국 다른 모든 것은 그 힘 아래 놓이기 때문일세.

english: Guthix reclaimed that which had been stolen from Him, and went back underground to return to His sleep and continue to draw the world's power into Himself.
translation: Guthix(구식스)께서는 빼앗겼던 것을 되찾으신 뒤, 다시 잠들어 세상의 힘을 당신 안으로 끌어모으시려고 땅속으로 돌아가셨네.

english: But on His way into the depths of the earth He sat and rested in this cave; and, thinking of the battle-scarred desert that now stretched from one side of His world to the other, He wept.
translation: 그러나 땅 깊은 곳으로 가시던 길에 그분께서는 이 동굴에 앉아 쉬셨네. 그리고 전쟁의 상처로 뒤덮인 사막이 이제 세상 이쪽 끝에서 저쪽 끝까지 펼쳐진 것을 생각하시며 눈물을 흘리셨지.

english: And so great was His sorrow, and so great was His life- giving power, that the rocks themselves began to weep with Him.
translation: 그분의 슬픔이 너무나 컸고, 그분의 생명을 주는 힘 또한 너무나 컸기에, 바위들조차 그분과 함께 울기 시작했네.

english: Later, Guthix noticed that the rocks continued to weep, and that their tears were infused with a small part of His power.
translation: 훗날 Guthix(구식스)께서는 바위들이 계속 울고 있으며, 그 눈물에 당신의 힘이 조금 깃들어 있음을 알아차리셨네.

english: So He set me, His servant, to guard the cave, and He entrusted to me the task of judging who was and was not worthy to access the tears.
translation: 그래서 그분께서는 당신의 종인 나에게 이 동굴을 지키게 하시고, 누가 그 눈물에 다가갈 자격이 있는지 가려내는 일을 맡기셨네.

english: Tell me about the Tears of Guthix.
translation: Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: I will tell you the story of the light-creatures.
Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizationsof the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.
translation: 세상 초기 시대의 생명체와 문명은 수없이 많고 아름다웠네. Gielinor(길리노르)는 하나의 예술 작품이었지. Guthix(구식스)의 창조적인 정신이 수천 년에 걸쳐 애정을 담아 빚어낸 작품 말일세.

english: Only the sturdiest races survived the Godwars, and even then only by abandoning their high culture and gearing their societies towards war. Of the more delicate races there is now no trace, and almost no memory.
translation: Godwars(신들의 전쟁)에서 살아남은 것은 가장 강인한 종족들뿐이었고, 그마저도 고귀한 문화를 버리고 사회를 전쟁에 맞춰 바꾼 덕분이었네. 더 연약한 종족들은 이제 흔적도 없고, 기억조차 거의 남아 있지 않지.

english: One such race had bodies as fragile as snowflakes, yet they built crystal cities that stood for a thousand years.
translation: 그런 종족 가운데 하나는 눈송이처럼 연약한 몸을 지녔지만, 천 년 동안 무너지지 않은 크리스탈 도시들을 세웠네.

english: The wind would whisper through the spires and fill them with sweet harmonies, and the rising sun would shine through the precious gems that studded the towers and create inter plays of light as if rainbows were dancing.
translation: 바람은 첨탑 사이로 속삭이며 그 안을 달콤한 화음으로 채웠고, 떠오르는 해는 탑마다 박힌 귀한 보석들을 꿰뚫고 비추어 마치 무지개가 춤추듯 빛의 어울림을 만들어 냈네.

english: Indeed, so marvellous was this light-show at its height that the patterns of light themselves became alive, and great flocks of luminous creatures rode along the gem- cast beams, each drawn to its own colour.
translation: 실로, 이 빛의 향연이 절정에 이르렀을 때는 너무도 경이로운 나머지 빛의 무늬 자체가 살아 움직이게 되었고, 빛나는 생명체들이 거대한 무리를 지어 보석에서 뻗어 나온 빛줄기를 타고 다녔네. 저마다 제 색깔에 이끌려서 말일세.

english: The creatures you see floating in this chasm are the last sorry remnants of that age. I do not know how they made their way here and survived to this time, but I am grateful for their company.
translation: 이 협곡에 떠다니는 저 생명체들이 그 시대의 마지막 가련한 잔재일세. 어떻게 이곳까지 와서 지금껏 살아남았는지는 나도 모르지만, 그들이 곁에 있어 주니 고마울 따름이네.

english: Tell me about the light-creatures.

Not long after the start of my vigil a party of goblins happened on my cave. These were the ugly brutes of the gods' armies, but their armour bore a faded patch where the symbol of a god had been removed.
translation: 내가 파수를 시작한 지 얼마 안 되어 고블린 무리가 우연히 내 동굴에 들어왔네. 신들의 군대에 속한 추악한 짐승들이었지만, 그들의 갑옷에는 신의 상징을 떼어 낸 자리에 빛바랜 자국이 남아 있었지.

english: They looked around hesitantly, squinting in the light of crude torches, but as soon as they saw me they raised their spears and charged.
translation: 그들은 조잡한 횃불 빛에 눈을 찡그리며 머뭇머뭇 주위를 둘러보았지만, 나를 보자마자 창을 치켜들고 달려들었네.

english: No one may access the Tears of Guthix by force. I sent them tumbling into the chasm.
translation: 누구도 힘으로 Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물)에 다가갈 수는 없네. 나는 그들을 협곡 아래로 굴러떨어뜨렸지.

english: Two hundred years later another goblin found me. This one was unarmed, and although she was very wary I succeeded in engaging her in conversation.
translation: 이백 년 뒤 또 다른 고블린이 나를 찾아왔네. 이 고블린은 무기가 없었고, 몹시 경계하긴 했지만 나는 그녀와 대화를 나누는 데 성공했지.

english: Since then I have had many more visits from the descendants of those lost warriors, and over the centuries I have seen them change.
translation: 그 뒤로 길 잃은 그 전사들의 후손이 수없이 나를 찾아왔고, 여러 세기에 걸쳐 나는 그들이 변해 가는 것을 지켜보았네.

english: They have become timid rather than aggressive, and I have seen the light of intelligence grow in their bulging eyes.
translation: 그들은 사나움 대신 소심함을 갖게 되었고, 그 툭 튀어나온 눈에 지성의 빛이 자라나는 것을 나는 보았네.

english: Their stories are repetitive and grim, of scraping a living out of the harsh rock and through ingenuity and toil shaping it into a home.
translation: 그들의 이야기는 늘 비슷하고 암울하다네. 거친 바위에서 근근이 살아갈 거리를 긁어모으고, 재주와 수고로 그 바위를 다듬어 보금자리로 만드는 이야기지.

english: I have followed the progress of their race, but their individual stories hold little interest for me.
translation: 나는 그 종족이 발전해 온 과정을 지켜봐 왔지만, 개개인의 이야기에는 별 흥미가 없네.

english: Tell me about the Cave Goblins.
translation: Cave Goblins(동굴 고블린)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: 여기로 돌아오라는 알림 메시지를 받고 싶어요.

english: Very well, when you are eligible to drink from the Tears, you shall be reminded daily.
translation: 좋네. 자네가 눈물을 마실 자격이 생기면 매일 알려 주겠네.

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
translation: 여기로 돌아오라는 알림 메시지는 받고 싶지 않아요.

english: Very well, it will be up to you to remember when you can return. It is good that you are willing to take responsibility for yourself in this way.
translation: 좋네. 언제 돌아올 수 있는지는 자네가 직접 기억해야 할 걸세. 이렇게 스스로 책임지려 하다니 좋은 일이군.

english: Can you do something with this icon?
translation: 이 icon(성상)으로 뭘 좀 해 줄 수 있나요?

english: So many aeons have passed since these were made. So many mortals have been born, lived their lives, then died as Balancerequires. What stories they must have known!
translation: 이것이 만들어진 뒤로 참으로 영겁의 세월이 흘렀군. 수많은 필멸자가 태어나 삶을 살고, 균형이 요구하는 대로 죽어 갔지. 그들은 얼마나 많은 이야기를 알고 있었을까!

english: I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with your Staff of the Dead. Give the items to me, if you wish.
translation: 이런 icon(성상)을 자네의 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)와 합쳐 망자를 기리는 일이라면 기꺼이 하겠네. 원한다면 그 물건들을 내게 주게.

english: Okay, here you go...

I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your Staff of the Dead with your icon of my master, Guthix. But this cannot be undone; they will be bound forever.
translation: 자네의 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)를 내 주인 Guthix(구식스)의 icon(성상)과 합쳐, 망자와 그들이 알았을 모든 이야기를 기꺼이 기리겠네. 하지만 이건 되돌릴 수 없네. 영원히 하나로 묶이게 될 걸세.

english: Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
translation: 합쳐 주세요. 되돌릴 수 없다는 거 알아요.

english: Juna will offer to make multiple Staves of balance
translation: Juna(주나)가 Staves of balance(균형의 지팡이)를 여러 개 만들어 주겠다고 제안한다

english: No thanks.
Maybe another time.
I would be happy to honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: 자네가 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)를 가져온다면, 이런 icon(성상)과 합쳐 망자를 기리는 일을 기꺼이 하겠네.

english: My weapon is sort of like a Staff of the Dead, don't you think?
translation: 제 무기가 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)랑 좀 비슷하지 않아요?

english: It was, but I appear to have combined it with an icon already.
translation: 그랬지. 하지만 이미 icon(성상)과 합쳐 놓은 것 같군.

english: I cannot combine it with that.
I've got a weapon in my inventory that's sort of like a Staff of the Dead.
translation: 소지품에 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)랑 좀 비슷한 무기가 있어요.

english: It is not what I seek.
A Staff of the Dead, you say? Okay, thanks.
translation: Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이) 말이에요? 알겠어요, 고마워요.

english: Not now.
I will not permit you to be in the cave for long. Collect as many tears as you can.
translation: 동굴에 오래 머물게 하지는 않을 걸세. 눈물을 최대한 많이 모으게.

english: Okay.
I want to get out now.
The player leaves the Tears of Guthix cave
translation: 플레이어가 Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물) 동굴을 나간다

english: If you wish to tell me more stories, come out here first.
translation: 이야기를 더 들려주고 싶다면 먼저 이리 나오게.

english: A Staff of the Dead! I would happily honour the dead, and all the stories they must have known, by combining your staff with an icon of my master, Guthix.
translation: Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)로군! 자네의 지팡이를 내 주인 Guthix(구식스)의 icon(성상)과 합쳐, 망자와 그들이 알았을 모든 이야기를 기꺼이 기리겠네.

english: Perhaps you can find such an icon and bring it to me.
translation: 그런 icon(성상)을 찾아서 내게 가져와 보게.

english: I would happily honour the dead by combining such an icon with a Staff of the Dead, if you bring one to me.
translation: 자네가 Staff of the Dead(망자의 지팡이)를 가져온다면, 그런 icon(성상)과 합쳐 망자를 기리는 일을 기꺼이 하겠네.

english: I can do nothing more with that.
translation: 그것으로는 더 해 줄 수 있는 게 없네.

english: I cannot combine your icon with that weapon.
translation: 자네의 icon(성상)은 그 무기와 합칠 수 없네.

english: I do not need that from you.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 이보게, 자네에게 줄 것이 있는데 소지품에 자리가 없군!

english: Your dedication to balance is astounding adventurer.
translation: 균형을 향한 자네의 헌신이 놀랍군, 모험가여.

english: Here you go.
Okay...
You tell me a story.
Tell me about the Tears of Guthix
translation: Tears of Guthix(구식스의 눈물)에 대해 알려 주세요

english: Tell me a new story.
Tell me about the light-creatures
Tell me about the Cave Goblins
translation: Cave Goblins(동굴 고블린)에 대해 알려 주세요

english: I'd like to receive messages prompting me to return here.
translation: 여기로 돌아오라는 알림 메시지를 받고 싶어요.

english: I don't want any messages reminding me to return here.
translation: 여기로 돌아오라는 알림 메시지는 받고 싶지 않아요.

english: Can you do something with this icon?
translation: 이 icon(성상)으로 뭘 좀 해 줄 수 있나요?

english: Okay, here you go...
Combine them. I understand it can't be undone.
translation: 합쳐 주세요. 되돌릴 수 없다는 거 알아요.

english: No thanks.
Maybe another time.
Not now.
Okay.
I want to get out now.
Hello friend. You're a long way from Lumbridge!
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구. Lumbridge(럼브리지)에서 꽤 멀리 오셨네요!

english: How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
Well, I don't recommend just walking in! The last guy I saw try that barely escaped with his life.
translation: 글쎄요, 그냥 걸어 들어가는 건 추천하지 않아요! 마지막으로 그렇게 들어가려던 사람은 겨우 목숨만 건져서 나왔거든요.

english: Apparently he was on a mission to map the area. How foolish is that?
translation: 듣자 하니 그 지역 지도를 만드는 임무를 맡았다던데요. 참 어리석은 짓 아니에요?

english: Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
translation: 사실 저도 그 정글 지도를 만들 생각이에요.

english: Oh. Oops. Sorry if I sounded rude, it just seems like a really bad idea.
translation: 아. 이런. 무례하게 들렸다면 미안해요. 그냥 정말 안 좋은 생각 같아서요.

english: I mean it's a noble calling. Lots of people around here could use a proper map to navigate with. But, you know... there's something not quite right about that jungle.
translation: 그러니까, 고귀한 일이긴 하죠. 이 근처엔 제대로 된 지도가 있으면 좋을 사람이 많으니까요. 그런데, 있잖아요... 그 정글엔 뭔가 심상치 않은 게 있어요.

english: Best of luck though... Guthix knows, you'll need it.
translation: 그래도 행운을 빌어요... Guthix(구식스)께서도 아시겠지만, 행운이 꼭 필요할 거예요.

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: Kharazi Jungle(카라지 정글)에 대해 다른 조언은 없나요?

english: Not really. Just be careful - there's a lot of weird stuff going on in there lately.
translation: 딱히요. 그냥 조심하세요 - 요즘 그 안에서 이상한 일이 많이 벌어지고 있거든요.

english: Are you calling me foolish?
Er... maybe? I'll just be on my way...
translation: 어... 그럴지도요? 전 이만 가 볼게요...

english: What do you do here?
I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I haven't gone into the Kharazi myself, but I've found some interesting tree specimens out here.
translation: 전 산림관인데, 이국적인 목재가 전문이에요. Kharazi(카라지)에 직접 들어가 본 적은 없지만, 이 바깥에서도 흥미로운 나무 표본을 좀 찾았어요.

english: If you do find a safe path into the jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to have a nose around in there.
translation: 정글로 들어가는 안전한 길을 찾으면 꼭 알려 주세요. 저도 그 안을 좀 둘러보고 싶거든요.

english: Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: 정글에서 Kharazi(카라지) 부족민을 본 적 있어요?

english: Oh yes, I've met loads of them! Lovely lot. I haven't seen many about recently, though.
translation: 그럼요, 엄청 많이 만났죠! 다들 좋은 사람들이에요. 그런데 요즘은 별로 안 보이더라고요.

english: If you're looking to say hello, you'll need a Bullroarer. If you swing it above your head it makes a loud noise - that should attract someone's attention.
translation: 인사를 하고 싶으면 Bullroarer(불로러)가 필요할 거예요. 머리 위로 휘두르면 큰 소리가 나거든요 - 그러면 누군가 관심을 가질 거예요.

english: Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
I wish I did! But I just have the one, and I've grown fond of it. Besides, I might need it if I ever get lost in the jungle.
translation: 저도 있었으면 좋겠네요! 하지만 딱 하나뿐인 데다 정이 들어서요. 게다가 정글에서 길을 잃으면 필요할지도 모르고요.

english: Will you trade something for it?
Hmm, maybe. Tell you what, you show me something interesting and I'll see if it's worth my Bullroarer. How about that?
translation: 음, 어쩌면요. 이렇게 하죠. 흥미로운 걸 보여 주면 제 Bullroarer(불로러)랑 바꿀 만한지 볼게요. 어때요?

english: It's a deal!
Okay, thanks.
You're welcome! See you around...
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing any more. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.
translation: 미안하지만 이제 그런 일은 안 해요. 대신 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에 있는 Pirate Jackie(해적 재키)에게 가서 얘기해 보세요.

english: Ugh, it's still raw! You can't serve me that. Take it away!
translation: 윽, 아직 날것이잖아요! 이런 걸 내놓으면 안 되죠. 치워 주세요!

english: I lost my Bullroarer, can I swap this delicious wrap for yours?
translation: Bullroarer(불로러)를 잃어버렸는데, 이 맛있는 랩이랑 당신 걸 바꿔 줄래요?

english: Go on then. Forestry is hungry work.
translation: 그럼 그러죠. 산림관 일은 배가 고픈 법이거든요.

english: On second thoughts, I might get hungry.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니, 저도 배고파질 것 같네요.

english: Sorry, but I have no use for that.
How do I get into the Kharazi Jungle?
Actually, I plan to map the jungle myself.
translation: 사실 저도 그 정글 지도를 만들 생각이에요.

english: Do you have any other tips about the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: Kharazi Jungle(카라지 정글)에 대해 다른 조언은 없나요?

english: Have you seen any Kharazi Tribesmen in the jungle?
translation: 정글에서 Kharazi(카라지) 부족민을 본 적 있어요?

english: Ok thanks.
Are you calling me foolish?
What do you do here?
Have you seen any Kharazi tribespeople in the jungle?
translation: 정글에서 Kharazi(카라지) 부족민을 본 적 있어요?

english: Okay, thanks.
Do you have a Bullroarer I could borrow?
Will you trade something for it?
How do I get into the Kharazi jungle?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Yes
No
Hey, I'm Justine. I've got some rewards here for fighters who've done well in Lisa's Last Man Standing game. Wanna see?
translation: 안녕하세요, 전 Justine(저스틴)이에요. Lisa(리사)의 Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩) 게임에서 잘 싸운 전사들을 위한 보상이 여기 있어요. 구경할래요?

english: What have you got?
No thanks.
Sorry, I don't offer refunds on items that people can trade with each other.
translation: 미안하지만, 다른 사람과 거래할 수 있는 아이템은 환불해 드리지 않아요.

english: Hey, that door's for staff only!
Sorry, shop's closed.
What have you got?
No thanks.
C'mon, almost got it...
Having problems?
Agh! You scared me! Now I've lost my lockpick.
translation: 으악! 깜짝이야! 이제 lockpick(자물쇠 따개)를 잃어버렸잖아요.

english: Oh, sorry about that. Do you want one of mine?
translation: 아, 미안해요. 제 거 하나 드릴까요?

english: Oh, sorry about that. I'm afraid I don't have one for you.
Don't worry about it, I brought an extra just in case. Lockpicks really do help with disarming these traps.
translation: 신경 쓰지 마요, 혹시 몰라서 여분을 가져왔거든요. Lockpicks(자물쇠 따개)는 이런 함정을 해제할 때 정말 도움이 돼요.

english: Oh, that's good to know, thanks for the tip! Out of curiosity, what outfit is that?
translation: 아, 좋은 정보네요, 알려 줘서 고마워요! 그런데 궁금해서 그러는데, 그 옷은 뭐예요?

english: It's called the Rogue's outfit. I got it from the Rogue's Den in Burthorpe. I've found it helps me blend in when pickpocketing people, allowing me to steal more coins from them.
translation: Rogue's outfit(도적 복장)이라는 거예요. Burthorpe(버소프)에 있는 Rogue's Den(도적 소굴)에서 얻었죠. 소매치기할 때 사람들 틈에 섞이는 데 도움이 돼서, 코인을 더 많이 훔칠 수 있더라고요.

english: It looks cool. Does it also help here?
Ha ha ha, of course not! I don't think the coffin cares whether or not I blend in.
translation: 하하하, 그럴 리가요! 관이 제가 주변에 잘 섞여 드는지 신경 쓸 것 같진 않네요.

english: Good point. Why are you wearing it though if it doesn't help you get more loot?
translation: 맞는 말이네요. 그런데 전리품을 더 얻는 데 도움이 안 되면 왜 입고 있어요?

english: Honestly, I just really like how it looks. You've got to look your best while travelling right?
translation: 솔직히, 그냥 생긴 게 정말 마음에 들어서요. 여행할 땐 최대한 멋있어 보여야 하잖아요?

english: Each to their own I suppose. I'll be off. Best of luck down here.
translation: 사람마다 취향이 다른 거겠죠. 전 이만 가 볼게요. 여기서 행운을 빌어요.

english: And the same to you.
Agh, thought I had it that time!
The world begins to fade...
What happened? I rubbed that coin and everything went black!
translation: 무슨 일이죠? 그 동전을 문질렀더니 눈앞이 깜깜해졌어요!

english: Who are you? You're not the hero I gave my token to!
translation: 넌 누구야? 내가 token(토큰)을 준 영웅이 아니잖아!

english: How did you get that coin you used to summon me?
translation: 날 불러낸 그 동전은 어떻게 손에 넣은 거야?

english: I took it from the dead body of a black dragon.
I didn't realise what it would do if I rubbed it.
Who, or what, are you anyway?
translation: 그런데 당신은 대체 누구, 아니 뭐예요?

english: My name is K'klik. I am a Fairy Dragon.
translation: 내 이름은 K'klik(크클릭). Fairy Dragon(요정 드래곤)이지.

english: One of the last surviving members of my race, I fear.
translation: 아마 우리 종족의 얼마 남지 않은 생존자 중 하나일 거야.

english: Enough of that: you summoned me, so how can I help?
translation: 그 얘긴 그만하고, 네가 날 불렀으니 뭘 도와줄까?

english: I'm afraid I don't understand.
The person who holds my token can summon me by rubbing it.
translation: 내 token(토큰)을 가진 자는 그걸 문질러서 날 불러낼 수 있어.

english: They then have the right to request one thing of me before returning my token.
translation: 그러면 그 사람은 내 토큰을 돌려주기 전에 나한테 한 가지를 부탁할 권리가 생기지.

english: So I can ask one thing of you?
translation: 그러니까 제가 한 가지를 부탁할 수 있다는 거예요?

english: That's right. What do you want?
I'd like a horse, please.
No horses in Gielinor. Try again.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)엔 말이 없어. 다시 골라 봐.

english: Can I wish for some xp?
Sorry, can't help. You'll have to ask the genie for that.
translation: 미안, 그건 못 도와줘. 그건 genie(지니)한테 부탁해야 할걸.

english: Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: 정말 필요할 때를 위해 당신 token(토큰)을 그냥 갖고 있어도 될까요?

english: I suppose that seems fair. Alright, just call me when you need me.
translation: 뭐, 그 정도면 공평한 것 같네. 좋아, 필요할 때 불러.

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: 이 creme brulee(크렘 브륄레)를 플랑베해 주세요.

english: Sure, that's easy.
That brûlée needs some more work before it's ready for flambéing.
translation: 그 brûlée(브륄레)는 플랑베하기 전에 손을 좀 더 봐야겠는데.

english: Call me again when it's ready.
I'd like a horse, please.
Can I wish for some xp?
Could I just keep your token for when I really need it, please?
translation: 정말 필요할 때를 위해 당신 token(토큰)을 그냥 갖고 있어도 될까요?

english: Please flambe this creme brulee for me.
translation: 이 creme brulee(크렘 브륄레)를 플랑베해 주세요.

english: Human, I disconnected and lost my plastic plate of whatever food you call this. I want my items returned, now!
translation: 인간, 접속이 끊겨서 네놈들이 음식이라 부르는 뭔지 모를 것이 담긴 플라스틱 접시를 잃어버렸다. 내 아이템을 돌려 내라, 당장!

english: Woah hold on big fella' I can't do that.
translation: 워워, 진정해 덩치. 그건 못 해.

english: Well then, I'll just unsubscribe from the dungeon and stop playing all together. Hrmph....
translation: 그렇다면 던전 구독을 끊고 게임을 아예 그만두겠다. 흥....

english: Oh please, you were never really a popular boss anyway. You had to be given extra drops just to incentivise people to find you. Even then, I doubt anyone would notice if you disappeared.
translation: 참 나, 넌 원래 인기 있는 보스도 아니었잖아. 사람들이 찾아가게 하려고 드롭을 더 얹어 줘야 했을 정도였지. 그러고도 네가 사라지면 알아챌 사람이 있을지 모르겠다.

english: *growls* Enjoy the party... mortal.
Kill them, you cowards!
Zamorak curse them!
Death to Saradomin's dogs!
Rend them limb from limb!
Flay them all!
Attack them, you dogs!
Forward!
Attack!
The Dark One will have their souls!
No retreat!
YARRRRRRR!
How's life in the light?
Burns slightly.
You seem much nicer than your father. He's mean.
translation: 넌 네 아빠보다 훨씬 착한 것 같아. 아빠는 못됐잖아.

english: If you were stuck in a very dark cave for centuries you'd be pretty annoyed too.
translation: 너도 수백 년 동안 아주 어두운 동굴에 갇혀 있었으면 꽤 짜증 났을걸.

english: I guess.
He's actually quite mellow really.
Uh.... Yeah.
Cower before my evil might!
translation: 내 사악한 힘 앞에 무릎 꿇어라!

english: Zamorak will show you no mercy!
For Zamorak!
*slap*
What?
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: 더 강한 몬스터들에 대해서는 어떻게 생각해?

english: There are no monsters more powerful than us!
We're the top monster of all Gielinor!
No you're not. The Kalphite Queen is more powerful than you!
translation: 아니거든. Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)이 너희보다 더 강해!

english: Kalphite Queen? What's that?
She's a giant insect who lives in the desert.
An insect?
Ha ha ha ha!
No insect could be tougher than us! We're the best!
translation: 곤충 따위가 우리보다 셀 리가 없지! 우리가 최고다!

english: No, she's way tougher than you!
translation: 아니, 그 여왕이 너희보다 훨씬 세다니까!

english: I don't believe it!
And even if this Kalphite Queen is real, which I doubt, second best isn't bad, is it?
translation: 그리고 설령 그 Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)이 진짜 있다 해도, 그럴 리 없겠지만, 2등도 나쁘진 않잖아, 안 그래?

english: But it's not just the Kalphite Queen. What about the TzTok-Jad?
translation: 하지만 Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)만 있는 게 아니야. TzTok-Jad(츠톡-자드)는 어때?

english: Never heard of it!
Or the Dagannoth Rex?
You're making it up!
Or the Chaos Elemental?
Now then, how do you know you're not just making all these monsters up to demoralise us?
translation: 자, 그럼 네가 우리 사기를 꺾으려고 그 몬스터들을 다 지어내는 게 아니라는 걸 어떻게 알지?

english: All right then, what about me?
Puny human! You're not a fearsome monster!
translation: 하찮은 인간 같으니! 네가 무슨 무시무시한 몬스터냐!

english: I defeated you, didn't I? So I must be stronger than you!
translation: 내가 너희를 쓰러뜨렸잖아, 안 그래? 그러니까 내가 너희보다 강한 거지!

english: You got lucky! I'll get you next time!
translation: 운이 좋았을 뿐이다! 다음엔 내가 해치워 주마!

english: Now that you're a stuffed head? I don't think so!
translation: 이제 박제된 머리 신세인데? 그건 아닐 것 같은데!

english: Which of you heads is...
I am!
Shut up! I am!
Don't be silly! It's obvious that I am!
But you don't even know what I was going to say!
translation: 내가 무슨 말을 하려던 건지도 모르잖아!

english: It doesn't matter. I'm the strongest, cleverest, and most attractive. Whatever it is, I am the most of it!
translation: 상관없어. 내가 제일 강하고, 제일 똑똑하고, 제일 잘생겼으니까. 그게 뭐든, 제일은 나야!

english: Just a minute. What if it's something bad?
Good point. What is it you were going to say? Because if it's something good, I'm it, but if it's something bad then it's one of these two ugly mugs.
translation: 좋은 지적이다. 무슨 말을 하려던 거냐? 좋은 거라면 그건 나고, 나쁜 거라면 이 못생긴 두 놈 중 하나다.

english: I've forgotten what I was going to ask now.
Me! I am!
Sorry, just said that on reflex.
Hey, [House owner] killed the King Black Dragon!
translation: 이봐, [House owner] 님이 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)을 죽였대!

english: No [he/she] didn't!
What? Oh, ah, no, of course [he/she] didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: 뭐? 아, 어, 아니, 당연히 [he/she]는 안 죽였지. 사실 우리는 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)을 본뜬 인공 모형이다. 누구도 진짜 킹 블랙 드래곤을 죽일 수는 없어!

english: No! We're - I mean, it's - far too powerful!
translation: 아니지! 우리는... 아니, 그놈은... 너무나 강하다고!

english: What are you talking about? Of course we're the King Black Dragon!
translation: 무슨 소리야? 당연히 우리가 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)이지!

english: Shut up, you idiot!
How do you feel about all the more powerful monsters?
translation: 더 강한 몬스터들에 대해서는 어떻게 생각해?

english: Which of you heads is...
Anyone there?
INTRUDER! Red alert! Batten down the hatches! DIVE, DIVE, DIVE!
translation: 침입자다! 적색 경보! 해치를 닫아라! 잠수, 잠수, 잠수!

english: Err, maybe I'll call back later.
Hello.
The fish cannot ride the gravy train.
translation: 물고기는 그레이비 열차에 탈 수 없다.

english: Sorry?
The cyclops cannot see his inner walrus?
Is this code?
Waddle into a sunset of flaking mackerel?
translation: 고등어 비늘 흩날리는 석양 속으로 뒤뚱뒤뚱 걸어가는가?

english: I'm going now.
The sardine is leaving the tin?
There's been a breach! Red alert!
The KGP thinks you are a threat.
Phew, that was a close call.
Urrrrgh!
Human.
Leave us.
Your presence is not desired.
How friendly.
But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.
translation: 하지만 당신들 도움이 필요해요! Lord Trobin Arceuus(트로빈 아르세우스 경)의 아들 Asteros Arceuus(아스테로스 아르세우스)가 저를 보냈어요.

english: Arceuus.
We know that name.
The name of a liar.
Liar?
They came to us. Two of them.
The brother and the husband.
Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.
translation: 그녀의 시간이 다해 가고 있었다. 그들은 그녀에게 시간을 더 주고 싶어 했다.

english: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.
translation: 우리는 그들에게 지식을 내주었다. 그녀에게 시간을 더 주라고.

english: But they misused it. And the world suffered.
translation: 하지만 그들은 그것을 악용했다. 그리고 세상이 고통받았다.

english: This knowledge? You mean immortality?
In a way. But it was not meant for that.
translation: 어떤 의미로는. 하지만 그런 용도가 아니었다.

english: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.
translation: 그것은 시간을 위한 것이었다. 하지만 시간은 결국 다하는 법.

english: They put an end to time. They endagered the balance.
translation: 그들은 시간을 끝내 버렸다. 균형을 위태롭게 했다.

english: What balance?
For every death, there must be life.
For every life, there must be death.
Perfectly balanced.
As all things should be.
We serve this balance.
For without balance, the world burns.
You're very confusing, you know that right?
translation: 당신들 정말 헷갈리게 말하는 거, 알고는 있죠?

english: Perhaps.
Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.
translation: 어쩌면 우리의 지식이 네 이해를 넘어서는 것일지도.

english: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.
translation: 다행히 지식을 얻으러 온 건 아니에요. 도움을 받으러 왔죠. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)이 힘을 잃어 가고 있어서 Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들이 위험해요. 원인을 찾는 걸 도와주세요.

english: The people of Arceuus have had their time.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스)의 사람들은 이미 제 시간을 다 누렸다.

english: This will restore balance.
Why should we help them?
*sigh* It can never be easy can it.
Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.
translation: 좋아요. Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들을 구하는 걸 도와주면, 저도 당신들을 도울게요.

english: You assume we need help.
I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.
translation: 이런 일을 겪을 만큼 겪어 봐서 알아요. 누구나 원하는 건 있죠. 삶과 죽음의 주인이라 해도요.

english: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.
translation: 흥미롭군. 이 인간, 보기만큼 어리석지는 않은가 보다.

english: Well I've been known to have my moments.
Very well human.
We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.
Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.
translation: 그들이 영혼을 다루는 일은 균형을 유지하는 데 도움이 되어 왔다.

english: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.
translation: 그들을 돕겠다. 하지만 먼저, 네가 우리를 섬겨라.

english: Excellent. What do you need from me?
To the south lies a battlefront.
There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.
translation: 그곳에 무덤이 하나 있다. 그 안에 시체에 갇힌 영혼이 있다.

english: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.
translation: 그 영혼을 풀어 줘라. 그 대가로 우리가 돕겠다.

english: So you just want me to kill a zombie?
A zombie is soulless. An empty shell, reanimated by magic.
translation: 좀비에게는 영혼이 없다. 마법으로 되살아난 빈 껍데기일 뿐.

english: This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.
translation: 이것은 영혼이다. 진작 떠났어야 했건만, 이 세상에 갇혀 있는.

english: Its existence is an affront to the balance.
Seems pretty simple.
Which is why it falls to you.
Consider it a test.
If you pass.
We may have further use for you.
translation: 너를 더 쓸 데가 있을지도 모른다.

english: Hmmm. Very well, I'll go and free this soul.
translation: 흐음. 알겠어요, 가서 그 영혼을 풀어 줄게요.

english: The human returns.
I've dealt with the trapped soul.
You have done well.
The balance has been restored.
And now we shall help you.
While you were busy, so were we.
We have found the cause of your problem.
What is it?
You said the Altar was failing.
translation: 너는 Altar(제단)이 힘을 잃어 간다고 했다.

english: This is not correct.
The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.
translation: Altar(제단)은 멀쩡하다. 다만 그 힘이 다른 곳으로 빠져나가고 있다.

english: Redirected where?
To a construct built by a mortal.
Right next to the Altar.
Find it. Destroy it.
And Arceuus will be saved.
So I just have to go to the Dark Altar, find this device and then destroy it. Sounds easy enough.
translation: 그러니까 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에 가서 그 장치를 찾아 부수기만 하면 되는 거네요. 쉬워 보이네요.

english: Then you have what you need.
You can leave us.
Go and save your people.
The human returns.
Tell me about yourselves.
We are the Tasakaal.
We serve the balance.
Between life.
And death.
Balance? So you serve Guthix?
A pretender.
We serve another power.
A higher power.
What power?
One beyond your understanding.
Why do you serve this power?
The anima of this world, it is fed by life.
translation: 이 세계의 아니마는 생명을 먹고 자란다.

english: Without life, there is no anima.
But life can also destroy. It can endanger the anima.
translation: 하지만 생명은 파괴할 수도 있다. 아니마를 위태롭게 할 수도 있다.

english: So life must be kept in check.
This is our purpose.
And you were given this purpose?
Yes.
And no.
Our purpose was to wait. But we saw the world burn.
translation: 우리의 목적은 기다리는 것이었다. 하지만 우리는 세상이 불타는 것을 보았다.

english: We could not stand by and watch.
So we left our people. Left our home.
translation: 그래서 우리는 동족을 떠났다. 고향을 떠났다.

english: And took on a new purpose.
I'm still not sure I understand.
Maybe you never will.
Why did that soul need freeing?
translation: 그 영혼은 왜 풀어 줘야 했던 거예요?

english: Upon death, a soul should leave this world.
translation: 죽으면 영혼은 이 세상을 떠나야 한다.

english: And move to the one beyond.
translation: 그리고 저 너머의 세상으로 가야 한다.

english: This soul remained.
It endangered the balance.
Was it always there?
No.
The body was of one who died a long time ago.
translation: 그 몸은 오래전에 죽은 자의 것이었다.

english: But the soul was of one who died more recently.
translation: 하지만 영혼은 더 최근에 죽은 자의 것이었다.

english: It possessed this body.
translation: 그 영혼이 그 몸에 깃든 것이다.

english: We know not why.
Is this something that often happens?
No.
It is a concerning occurrence.
We believe a mortal to be involved.
Meddling.
Where one should not meddle.
Interesting...
You said you might have further use for me?
translation: 저를 더 쓸 데가 있을지도 모른다고 했죠?

english: We did.
What did you mean by that?
The task you performed.
It was a menial one.
Another could have filled your role.
But you showed promise.
So we tested you.
You passed.
You said it was an important task. Now you say it's a menial one. Which is it?
translation: 중요한 일이라고 하더니 이제는 하찮은 일이래요. 대체 어느 쪽이에요?

english: An important task can still be menial.
There is no contradiction here.
Hmmm... If you say so.
So why was it only a small task? Surely saving the Arceuus people was worth more than that.
translation: 그런데 왜 그렇게 작은 일이었어요? Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들을 구하는 건 그보다 훨씬 값진 일일 텐데요.

english: You assume it was a trade.
You assume wrong.
But you said I had to do it to save them?
translation: 하지만 그들을 구하려면 제가 그 일을 해야 한다고 했잖아요?

english: Incorrect.
We had already committed to saving Arceuus.
But we needed time to determine the problem.
While we worked, you needed purpose.
translation: 우리가 일하는 동안 너에게는 할 일이 필요했다.

english: So we gave you one.
I feel a little bit used.
Then you should have paid more attention.
So what is the further use you have for me?
translation: 그래서, 저를 어디에 더 쓰시겠다는 거예요?

english: None.
For now.
But we will call on you again.
translation: 하지만 우리는 다시 너를 부를 것이다.

english: That, we can guarantee.
Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
translation: 왜 Lord Arceuus(아르세우스 경)을 미워하는 거예요?

english: We granted them knowledge.
For a specific purpose.
But they misused it.
Them? Who else was there?
Another.
Another?
Another.
I can see we're not going to get anywhere here.
Goodbye.
Farewell human.
The human returns.
What do you know of Xeric?
That name.
It is not welcome here.
Right... sorry. What was it you called him? The great betrayer?
translation: 아... 죄송해요. 그를 뭐라고 불렀더라? 위대한 배신자였나요?

english: An apt description.
But why? What did he do?
Threatened the balance.
Plenty of people threaten the balance. Why was he especially bad?
translation: 균형을 위협하는 사람은 많잖아요. 그는 왜 유독 나쁜 거예요?

english: It is not your concern.
What are you hiding? You call him a betrayer... Did he betray you? Did you work with him?
translation: 뭘 숨기는 거예요? 그를 배신자라고 부르잖아요... 그가 당신들을 배신했나요? 그와 함께 일했던 거예요?

english: It is not your concern.
Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?
translation: 그 변절한 Pyromancer(화염술사)에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: They are one of many.
We can't determine which one.
translation: 어느 자인지는 우리도 알 수 없다.

english: So you know nothing of them?
translation: 그럼 그 사람에 대해 아무것도 모른다는 거예요?

english: They have a great strength.
More than many of the others.
They sound dangerous. What do you plan to do?
translation: 위험한 사람 같네요. 어떻게 할 생각이에요?

english: Nothing.
Nothing?
The Doors of Dinh are safe.
They can do no more harm.
translation: 그자는 더 이상 해를 끼칠 수 없다.

english: But whoever they are, they're working with Xamphur. Many lives could be at risk.
translation: 하지만 그게 누구든 Xamphur(잠푸르)와 손잡고 있어요. 수많은 목숨이 위험할 수도 있다고요.

english: Lives are always at risk.
But the balance is what matters.
Until it is threatened.
There is no need for action.
Tell me about yourselves.
Why did that soul need freeing?
translation: 그 영혼은 왜 풀어 줘야 했던 거예요?

english: You said you might have further use for me?
translation: 저를 더 쓸 데가 있을지도 모른다고 했죠?

english: Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
translation: 왜 Lord Arceuus(아르세우스 경)을 미워하는 거예요?

english: Goodbye.
What do you know of Xeric?
Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?
translation: 그 변절한 Pyromancer(화염술사)에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: Good day.
Good? It is not good at all. The vampyres increase their efforts to crush us underfoot. These are hard times indeed.
translation: 좋은 하루요? 전혀 좋지 않아요. 뱀파이어들이 우리를 짓밟으려고 점점 더 기를 쓰고 있어요. 정말 힘든 시절이에요.

english: Yesss?
You can speak!?
Of courssse, sssome of usss remember the high ssspeech out old massster ssspoke in.
translation: 물론이지스스. 우리 중 몇몇은 옛 주인님께서 쓰시던 고귀한 말을 기억하고 있지스스.

english: Hmm, I suppose I've never had a chance to speak with most Lizardmen, they're generally quite aggressive.
translation: 흠, 리자드맨 대부분과는 얘기해 볼 기회가 없었던 것 같네요. 대개 꽤 공격적이라서요.

english: Yesss, we ssspeak the language of war far better. It isss the only way we know of.
translation: 그렇지스스. 우리는 전쟁의 언어를 훨씬 잘 쓰지. 그것이 우리가 아는 유일한 방식이니까스스.

english: This master you speak of...
I know only what my eldersss passssed down. Very little.
translation: 나는 장로들이 전해 준 것만 알지스스. 아주 조금뿐이다.

english: How long ago since this master left you?
translation: 그 주인이 떠난 지 얼마나 됐어요?

english: Many generationsss have come and gone sssince he walked amongssst usss.
translation: 그분이 우리 사이를 거닐던 때로부터 수많은 세대가 오고 갔지스스.

english: Do you remember his name?
K'uhul ajaw isss the name we ssspeak. You manfolk ssspeak a different name.
translation: K'uhul ajaw(쿠훌 아하우), 그것이 우리가 부르는 이름이지스스. 너희 인간들은 다른 이름으로 부르지만.

english: Hmmm...
Why are you down here?
Thisss isss our temple, we don't usssually get many visssitorsss... We make sssacrifice, offeringsss to our massster.
translation: 여기는 우리의 신전이지스스. 찾아오는 이가 별로 없지... 우리는 주인님께 제물과 공물을 바치지스스.

english: What kind of... sacrifices?
Thisss and that. Whatever out massster desssiresss.
Nevermind, bye.
Ye niauh, human.
You can speak!?
Why are you down here?
Nevermind, bye.
Hello! Who are you?
Hi there, my name is Kai and I'm the keeper of this here ent habitat.
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 이름은 Kai(카이)예요. 여기 ent(엔트) 서식지를 관리하고 있죠.

english: What exactly is an ent?
Good question! Ents are ancient beings that resemble trees, we believe they draw their energy directly from nature.
translation: 좋은 질문이에요! 엔트는 나무를 닮은 고대 존재예요. 자연에서 직접 에너지를 끌어온다고 보고 있어요.

english: Where did they come from?
Another good question! We're not sure exactly, we just know they're a very old race.
translation: 이것도 좋은 질문이네요! 정확히는 몰라요. 아주 오래된 종족이라는 것만 알고 있죠.

english: I have heard of similar creatures roaming a desolate part of the eastern continent, though.
translation: 그래도 동쪽 대륙의 황량한 지역에 비슷한 생물이 돌아다닌다는 얘기는 들었어요.

english: Interesting... can I fight them?
Of course! There's no shortage of them residing within the dungeon, and they're a fantastic source of wood.
translation: 물론이죠! 던전 안에 엔트가 잔뜩 살고 있고, 나무를 얻기에도 아주 좋아요.

english: Thanks!
Thanks for the information, see you around.
That's nice, see you around.
What exactly is an ent?
Where did they come from?
Interesting... can I fight them?
Thanks for the information, see you around.
That's nice, see you around.
Hello, Bwana, what can I do for you today?
Can you tell me a bit about this place?
Of course, Bwana. You look like a traveler!
Yes, I am actually!
Well, I am a traveller myself, and I have set up this hostel for adventurers and travellers who are weary from their journey.
translation: 저도 여행자랍니다. 그래서 여정에 지친 모험가와 여행자를 위해 이 숙소를 열었지요.

english: There is a dormitory upstairs if you are tired. It costs 35 coins, which covers the costs of laundry and cleaning.
translation: 피곤하시면 위층에 공동 침실이 있어요. 35코인인데, 세탁비와 청소비가 포함돼 있답니다.

english: Have you anything for sale?
You buy a jug of wine for 1 coin.
You purchase a frothy glass of beer for 2 coins.
translation: 거품이 이는 맥주 한 잔을 2코인에 샀다.

english: You purchase a ticket to access the dormitory for 35 coins.
You purchase five tickets to access the dormitory for 175 coins.
translation: 공동 침실 이용권 다섯 장을 175코인에 샀다.

english: I'm afraid you do not have enough money for that, Bwana.
I'm fine, thanks.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Sorry, Bwana, I don't do that kind of thing anymore. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead. Can I help with anything else?
translation: 죄송해요, 브와나. 저는 이제 그런 일은 안 해요. 대신 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에 있는 Pirate Jackie(해적 재키)를 찾아가 보세요. 다른 건 도와드릴까요?

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 전 여길 떠날 거예요, 브와나. 이곳은 좀비 천지예요.

english: Can you tell me a bit about this place?
Have you anything for sale?
I'm fine, thanks.
Buy some wine: 1 coin
Buy some beer: 2 coins
Buy a night's rest: 35 coins
Buy a pack of 5 dorm tickets: 175 coins
Cancel
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Hello there.
I'm on duty, so you'll need to make this quick.
translation: 근무 중이라서요, 용건은 짧게 해 주세요.

english: What do you do around here?
I typically hang out in the lab and keep an eye the newbies. Someone needs to make sure no one breaks anything or loses an eye.
translation: 주로 실험실에 있으면서 신입들을 지켜봐요. 누군가는 아무것도 부수지 않고 아무도 눈을 잃지 않게 감시해야 하니까요.

english: Last week we had someone trying to churn butter in the agitator. They weren't around for long. I really wish they'd start properly vetting new society members.
translation: 지난주엔 어떤 사람이 agitator(교반기)로 버터를 만들려고 했어요. 그 사람은 오래 못 버텼죠. 협회 신입 회원들 좀 제대로 심사했으면 좋겠어요.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What's your favourite potion?
For me, its the Anti-leech lotion. I despise leeches.
translation: 저는 Anti-leech lotion(거머리 방지 로션)이요. 거머리가 정말 싫거든요.

english: Oh, that's surprising. I don't think I've seen many around here...
translation: 오, 의외네요. 이 근처에서 거머리를 많이 본 적은 없는 것 같은데요...

english: You've obviously never been swimming anywhere in the Tlati Rainforest...
translation: Tlati Rainforest(틀라티 열대우림)에서 수영해 본 적이 없으신가 보네요...

english: Nothing. I'll be going now.
What do you do around here?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What's your favourite potion?
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Hey there.
Yes please! How many do you have?
How many what?
I'll take the lot!
Right...
Hello! I've had a few to drink!
I haven't had that many, have I?
'Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: '옛날 옛적 드워프 Tonalo(토날로)가 살았다네! 버팔로한테 싸움을 걸었다네!'

english: What?
'He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: '발로 차고 주먹질하고, 아주 볼만했다네! 그러다 돌부리에 걸려 발가락을 찧었다네!'

english: What? I didn't even do it!
Checheche!
What is it with your kind and potato cactus?
translation: 너희 종족은 대체 potato cactus(감자 선인장)에 왜 그렇게 집착하는 거야?

english: Truthfully?
Yeah, please.
Soup. We make a fine soup with it.
Kalphites can cook?
Nah, we just collect it and put it there because we know fools like yourself will come down looking for it then inevitably be killed by my mother.
translation: 아니, 그냥 모아서 거기 둬. 너 같은 바보들이 그걸 찾으러 내려왔다가 결국 우리 엄마한테 죽을 걸 아니까.

english: Evidently not, that's how I got you!
translation: 꼭 그렇지도 않던데? 그래서 내가 널 얻은 거잖아!

english: Touché.
Hello.
Gotta find a way out. We built this maze for protection but I can't get used to it. I'm always getting lost.
translation: 나갈 길을 찾아야 해요. 보호하려고 이 미로를 만들었는데 도무지 익숙해지질 않네요. 맨날 길을 잃어요.

english: Hello, how are you?
Oh my. I'll never find my way back before Khazard's men come and hunt me down.
translation: 아이고. Khazard(카자드)의 부하들이 와서 날 사냥하기 전에 돌아갈 길을 절대 못 찾을 거예요.

english: Hello there.
Oh my, oh my, the village has been pillaged and I'm still lost. Oh dear.
translation: 아이고, 아이고, 마을은 약탈당했는데 난 아직도 길을 잃었네. 이를 어째.

english: Hello little man.
Hello. I hope they come out and find me soon. It's getting cold.
translation: 안녕하세요. 사람들이 빨리 나와서 날 찾아 줬으면 좋겠어요. 점점 추워지네요.

english: Hello there, you look lost.
Are you trying to be funny?
No.
Hmmm.
Hi there, you okay?
Ooooh, my head... I'm fried.
What's wrong?
Too much of this home brew my friend. We make it from plant roots, but it blows your head off.
translation: 이 집에서 담근 술을 너무 마셨거든, 친구. 식물 뿌리로 만드는데, 머리가 날아갈 만큼 독하다니까.

english: You don't wanna put it near any naked flames. I've got a barrel full of it here, want some?
translation: 불꽃 근처엔 절대 두면 안 돼. 여기 한 통 가득 있는데, 좀 마셔 볼래?

english: Okay then.
Here you go... Hic!
You take a sip of brew from Kamen's glass...
translation: Kamen(카멘)의 잔에 담긴 술을 한 모금 마신다...

english: ...it tastes horrific and burns your throat.
Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. Have a good meal. It may sober you up a bit.
translation: 하하! 독하다고 경고했잖아. 밥이나 든든히 먹어. 술이 좀 깰지도 몰라.

english: Thanks. Enjoy your brew.
Oh I will.
Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. A good meal may sober you up a bit. I could part with some food for a few coins.
translation: 하하! 독하다고 경고했잖아. 밥을 든든히 먹으면 술이 좀 깰지도 몰라. 코인 몇 닢만 주면 음식을 좀 나눠 줄 수 있는데.

english: 75 coins pleashe.
Oh dear, I haven't enough money...
Sorry, I can't just give it away to anyone that walks past.
translation: 미안하지만, 지나가는 사람한테 아무나 공짜로 줄 수는 없어.

english: No thanks.
Well come back any time.
Your losh... Hic!
Well maybe a good meal? I've got some spare.
translation: 그럼 밥이라도 먹을래? 남는 게 좀 있는데.

english: Well maybe a good meal? I could part with some food for a few coins.
translation: 그럼 밥이라도 먹을래? 코인 몇 닢만 주면 음식을 좀 나눠 줄 수 있는데.

english: Okay then.
No thanks.
Why hello there! I'm Kamfreena. Like the look of my pets? I think they're eyeing you up.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요! 저는 Kamfreena(캄프리나)예요. 제 애완동물들 어때요? 다들 외눈으로 당신한테 눈독 들이고 있는 것 같네요.

english: That was a really bad pun.
Sorry... I don't get to see the rest of the guild much, stuck up here. The Cyclopes don't talk much you see.
translation: 미안해요... 여기 위층에 붙박여 있다 보니 길드의 다른 사람들을 볼 일이 별로 없거든요. 보다시피 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)는 말수가 적어서요.

english: Shouldn't that be cyclopses?
Nope! Cyclopes is the plural of cyclops. One cyclops, many cyclopes.
translation: 아니죠! cyclops의 복수형은 cyclopses가 아니라 cyclopes예요. 하나면 사이클롭스, 여럿이면 사이클로페스죠.

english: Oh, right, thanks.
Where are they from?
They're from the far east lands.
How did they get here?
Ahh.. our guildmaster, Harrallak, went on an expedition there. He brought them back with him.
translation: 아, 우리 길드 마스터인 Harrallak(하랄락)이 그곳으로 원정을 갔었거든요. 돌아올 때 데려왔죠.

english: Why are they here?
For the warriors to train on of course! They also drop a rather nice blade.
translation: 당연히 전사들이 훈련하라고요! 게다가 꽤 괜찮은 칼날도 떨어뜨린답니다.

english: Oh? What would that be?
Defenders.
Err what are they?
It's a blade you can defend with using your shield hand, like I have.
translation: 저처럼 방패 드는 손에 쥐고 방어할 수 있는 칼날이에요.

english: Wow!

For every 10 tokens you collect around the guild, you can spend one minute in with my pets. As you get defenders you can show them to me to earn even better ones... but remember if you lose them you'll have
translation: 길드 곳곳에서 토큰을 10개 모을 때마다 제 애완동물들이 있는 곳에서 1분씩 보낼 수 있어요. 디펜더를 얻으면 저한테 보여 주세요. 더 좋은 걸 얻을 수 있게 해 드릴게요... 하지만 잃어버리면

english: to start at bronze again. I'd advise keeping a spare in your bank.
translation: 다시 청동부터 시작해야 한다는 걸 잊지 마세요. 은행에 여분을 하나 맡겨 두는 걸 추천해요.

english: Okay!
Oh, by the way, you'll need to earn 100 tokens before I'll let you in!
translation: 아, 그리고 들어가려면 먼저 토큰을 100개 모아야 해요!

english: Right, I'd better go play some games then!
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 가서 게임 좀 하고 와야겠네요!

english: Bye!
See you back here soon I hope!
Well, since you haven't shown me a defender to prove your prowess as a warrior,
translation: 음, 아직 전사로서의 실력을 증명할 디펜더를 보여 주지 않으셨으니,

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop bronze defenders for you to start off with, unless you show me another. Have fun in there.
translation: bronze defender(청동 디펜더)를 떨어뜨릴 수도 있는 사이클롭스를 풀어 드릴게요. 다른 걸 보여 주시면 또 모르고요. 재밌게 하세요.

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the defenders already! Well done.
translation: 아, 이미 디펜더를 하나 갖고 계시네요! 잘하셨어요.

english: I'll release some cyclopes which might drop the next defender for you. Have fun in there.
translation: 다음 디펜더를 떨어뜨릴 수도 있는 사이클롭스를 풀어 드릴게요. 재밌게 하세요.

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: 시간이 다 됐어요. 출구로 나가 주세요.

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: 다음엔 시간이 다 되면 바로 나와 주세요.

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: 이 구역에 머물려면 attack skillcape(공격 스킬 망토)나 max cape(맥스 망토)를 계속 착용하고 있어야 해요.

english: I remember you....
You don't have the defender you earned last time.
translation: 지난번에 얻은 디펜더를 갖고 있지 않으시네요.

english: Err... no, don't have it on me. I kind of... lost it.
translation: 어... 아뇨, 지금 안 갖고 있어요. 그게... 잃어버렸어요.

english: Sorry, but as you've lost any that you earned before I can only let you in to kill the cyclopes that drop the bronze defenders. Go on in when you're ready.
translation: 죄송하지만, 전에 얻은 걸 다 잃어버리셨으니 청동 디펜더를 떨어뜨리는 사이클롭스만 잡게 해 드릴 수 있어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: I have a Bronze defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Bronze defender(청동 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Bronze eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 청동이라고요? 다음 사이클롭스가 준비됐어요. 준비되면 슬슬 들어가세요.

english: I have a Iron defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Iron defender(철 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Wow, iron eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 우와, 철이라고요? 다음 사이클롭스가 준비됐어요. 준비되면 슬슬 들어가세요.

english: I have a Steel defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Steel defender(강철 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Strong as steel eh? The next cyclopes are ready, toddle in when you're ready.
translation: 강철처럼 단단하시다 이거죠? 다음 사이클롭스가 준비됐어요. 준비되면 슬슬 들어가세요.

english: I have a Black defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Black defender(흑철 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Black, hmmm, about half way to Rune then! Keep going! Cyclopes have been released. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 흑철이라, 흠, 그럼 룬까지 반쯤 왔네요! 계속 힘내세요! 사이클롭스를 풀어 놨어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: I have a Mithril defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Mithril defender(미스릴 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Mithril? Getting good at this aren't you! Okay, I've released those cyclopes that sometimes drop adamant defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 미스릴이요? 점점 잘하시네요! 좋아요, 가끔 adamant defender(아다만트 디펜더)를 떨어뜨리는 사이클롭스를 풀어 놨어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: I have an Adamant defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Adamant defender(아다만트 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: An adamant defender eh? Trying for the Rune defender I'm betting. Okay, I've released those cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 아다만트 디펜더라고요? 분명 Rune defender(룬 디펜더)를 노리시는 거겠죠. 좋아요, 그 사이클롭스를 풀어 놨어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: I have a Rune defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Rune defender(룬 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Well done, you truly are a brilliant warrior! You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement for an additional challenge.
translation: 잘하셨어요, 정말 뛰어난 전사시네요! 지하에 있는 제 견습생 Lorelai(로렐라이)에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 또 다른 도전이 기다리고 있을 거예요.

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 여기 위에 계시고 싶으면, 사이클롭스를 풀어 놨어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: Ahh I see that you've collected the highest defender I can offer you. Well done.
translation: 아, 제가 드릴 수 있는 최고의 디펜더를 이미 얻으셨네요. 잘하셨어요.

english: There's an old friend of mine named Lorelai in the guild basement. You should go visit her and maybe she'll let you search for a dragon defender.
translation: 길드 지하에 제 오랜 친구 Lorelai(로렐라이)가 있어요. 찾아가 보세요. 어쩌면 dragon defender(드래곤 디펜더)를 찾게 해 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Ahh I see that you have one of the rune defenders already! Well done.
translation: 아, 이미 rune defender(룬 디펜더)를 하나 갖고 계시네요! 잘하셨어요.

english: You should speak to my apprentice Lorelai in the basement and test yourself against even stronger Cyclopes!
translation: 지하에 있는 제 견습생 Lorelai(로렐라이)에게 말을 걸어서 더 강한 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 상대로 실력을 시험해 보세요!

english: The Cyclopes up here will continue to have a chance of dropping rune defenders. Have fun in there.
translation: 여기 위의 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)도 계속 룬 디펜더를 떨어뜨릴 수 있어요. 재밌게 하세요.

english: I have a Dragon defender, please let me in to kill some more Cyclopes!
translation: Dragon defender(드래곤 디펜더)가 있어요. 들어가서 Cyclopes(사이클롭스)를 더 잡게 해 주세요!

english: Well done! You can only get more Dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: 잘하셨어요! Dragon defender(드래곤 디펜더)는 지하에서만 더 얻을 수 있어요.

english: If you'd rather stay up here, I've released the cyclopes that can drop rune defenders. Enter when you're ready.
translation: 여기 위에 계시고 싶으면, 룬 디펜더를 떨어뜨릴 수 있는 사이클롭스를 풀어 놨어요. 준비되면 들어가세요.

english: I see you have one of the dragon defenders already! Well done, but you can only get more dragon defenders from the basement.
translation: 이미 dragon defender(드래곤 디펜더)를 하나 갖고 계시네요! 잘하셨어요. 하지만 드래곤 디펜더는 지하에서만 더 얻을 수 있어요.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 죄송하지만 아직 토큰을 하나도 얻지 못하셨어요. 길드 곳곳의 활동에 참여해서 모아 보세요.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 알겠어요, 가서 뭘 할 수 있나 볼게요.

english: Life isn't fair, that doesn't mean you can't win.
translation: 인생은 공평하지 않지만, 그렇다고 이길 수 없는 건 아니에요.

english: Be masterof your mind rather than master by your mind.
translation: 마음에 휘둘리지 말고 마음의 주인이 되세요.

english: A reflection on a pool of water does not reveal its depth.
translation: 물웅덩이에 비친 모습으로는 그 깊이를 알 수 없어요.

english: When you aim for perfection, you discover it's a moving target.
translation: 완벽을 목표로 삼으면, 그게 움직이는 과녁이라는 걸 알게 되죠.

english: He who speaks in anger makes his anger heard, but his words forgotten.
translation: 화를 내며 말하면 화는 전해져도 말은 잊히는 법이에요.

english: Patience and persistence can bring down the tallest trees.
translation: 인내와 끈기는 가장 큰 나무도 쓰러뜨릴 수 있어요.

english: I don't need that.
Here, have this.
Where are they from?
How did they get here?
Why are they here?
Bye!
Hello youngster!
The child is too busy playing to take any notice.
Hello. I Kangai Mau of the Rantuki tribe.
translation: 안녕. 나 Rantuki(란투키) 부족의 Kangai Mau(캉가이 마우).

english: I looking for someone brave to go on important mission for me. Someone skilled in thievery and sneaking about. I am told I can find such people in Brimhaven.
translation: 나 중요한 임무 갈 용감한 사람 찾는다. 도둑질이랑 몰래 다니는 거 잘하는 사람. 그런 사람 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에 있다고 들었다.

english: Tell me of this mission.
I need someone to go on a mission to the city of Ardougne. There you will find the house of Lord Handelmort. In his house he has our tribal totem.
translation: Ardougne(아르둔) 도시로 임무 갈 사람 필요하다. 거기 가면 Lord Handelmort(핸델모트 경)의 집 있다. 그 집에 우리 부족 토템 있다.

english: We need it back.
Why does he have it?
translation: 그 사람이 왜 그걸 갖고 있어요?

english: Lord Handelmort is an Ardougnese explorer which means he think he have the right to come to my tribal home, steal our stuff and put in his private museum.
translation: Lord Handelmort(핸델모트 경)은 Ardougnese(아르둔 사람) 탐험가. 그래서 자기가 우리 부족 땅 와서 우리 물건 훔치고 자기 개인 박물관에 넣을 권리 있다고 생각한다.

english: Ok, I will get it back.
Best of luck with that adventurer.
How can I find Handelmort's house? Ardougne is a big place...
translation: 핸델모트의 집은 어떻게 찾아요? 아르둔은 넓은 곳인데...

english: I don't know Ardougne. You tell me.
translation: 나 아르둔 모른다. 네가 나한테 알려 줘라.

english: Well good luck with that.
Let's hope I find some help soon.
I'm in search of adventure!
Adventure is something I may be able to give.
translation: 모험이라면 내가 줄 수 있을지도 모른다.

english: Who are the Rantuki tribe?
A proud and noble tribe of Karamja. But now we are few, as men come from across sea, steal our land, and settle on our hunting grounds.
translation: Karamja(카람자)의 자랑스럽고 고귀한 부족. 하지만 지금 우리 수가 적다. 바다 건너 사람들 와서 우리 땅 훔치고 우리 사냥터에 눌러앉았다.

english: And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
Have you got our totem back?
No, it's not that easy.
Bah, you no good.
Yes I have.
You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
translation: 찾아왔나??? 정말 고맙다, 용감한 모험가! 여기, 우리 부족이 특별히 잡아서 갓 요리한 Karamjan(카람자) 물고기 받아라.

english: You hand over the Tribal Totem.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
Many greetings esteemed thief.
Hey.
Congrats. Here!
And what are you doing in Brimhaven?
Yes.
No.
I'm in search of adventure!
Who are the Rantuki tribe?
Hello there.
What brings you to our holy monument?
translation: 우리의 신성한 기념비에는 무슨 일로 왔는가?

english: Who are you?
We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throughout these lands.
translation: 우리는 Guthix(구식스)의 드루이드라네. 이름난 돌의 원에서 우리 신을 섬기지. 그 원들은 이 땅 곳곳에서 찾아볼 수 있을 걸세.

english: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 어둠의 마법사들이 가득한 그 돌의 원은 뭐예요?

english: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.
translation: 그곳은 원래 '우리' 돌의 원이었다네. 안타깝게도 아주아주 오래전, 어둠의 마법사들이 그곳에 사악한 주문을 걸어 그 힘을 자기네 악한 목적에 쓰도록 타락시켰지.

english: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
translation: 그들이 의식을 위해 바위에 저주를 거는 바람에 우리와 우리 마법에는 쓸모가 없어졌다네. 우리는 Varrock(바록)의 원을 정화하는 퀘스트를 맡아 줄 용감한 모험가가 필요하네.

english: So what's so good about Guthix?
Guthix is the oldest and most powerful god in Gielinor. His existence is vital to this world. He is the god of balance, and nature; he is also a very part of this world.
translation: Guthix(구식스)는 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 가장 오래되고 가장 강한 신이라네. 그분의 존재는 이 세상에 꼭 필요하지. 균형과 자연의 신이며, 이 세상의 일부 그 자체이기도 하다네.

english: He exists in the trees, and the flowers, the water and the rocks. He is everywhere. His purpose is to ensure balance in everything in this world, and as such we worship him.
translation: 그분은 나무와 꽃, 물과 바위 속에 계시네. 어디에나 계시지. 그분의 뜻은 이 세상 모든 것의 균형을 지키는 것이고, 그래서 우리는 그분을 섬긴다네.

english: He sounds kind of boring...
Some day when your mind achieves enlightenment you will see the true beauty of his power.
translation: 언젠가 자네의 마음이 깨달음에 이르면 그분 힘의 참된 아름다움을 보게 될 걸세.

english: Well, I'll be on my way now.
Goodbye adventurer. I feel we shall meet again.
translation: 잘 가게, 모험가여. 우린 다시 만날 것 같군.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
Hmm. I think I may have a worthwhile quest for you actually. I don't know if you are familiar with the stone circle south of Varrock or not, but...
translation: 흠. 실은 자네에게 맡길 만한 보람 있는 퀘스트가 있을 것 같네. 자네가 Varrock(바록) 남쪽의 돌의 원을 아는지 모르겠네만...

english: Okay, I will try and help.
Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow druid, Sanfew, who is working on the purification ritual. He knows what is required to complete it.
translation: 훌륭하네. 여기서 남쪽 마을로 가서 정화 의식을 준비하고 있는 내 동료 드루이드 Sanfew(샌퓨)와 이야기하게. 의식을 마치려면 무엇이 필요한지 그가 알고 있다네.

english: Will do.
No, that doesn't sound very interesting.
translation: 아뇨, 별로 재미있을 것 같지 않아요.

english: I will not try and change your mind adventurer. Some day when you have matured you may reconsider your position. We will wait until then.
translation: 자네 마음을 돌리려 하지는 않겠네, 모험가여. 언젠가 자네가 더 성숙해지면 생각이 바뀔지도 모르지. 우리는 그때까지 기다리겠네.

english: Did you build this?
What, personally? No, of course I didn't. However, our forefathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.
translation: 뭐, 내가 직접? 아니, 당연히 아니지. 하지만 우리 선조들이 지었다네. 최초의 Guthix(구식스) 드루이드들이 800여 년 전에 이 땅 곳곳에 돌의 원을 많이 세웠지.

english: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining, and of those only one is usable by us anymore.
