translation: 안타깝게도 남아 있는 것으로 아는 건 두 곳뿐이고, 그중 우리가 아직 쓸 수 있는 건 한 곳뿐이라네.

english: Hello again. How is the Herblore going?
Very well, thank you.
That is good to hear.
I need more practice at it...
translation: 좀 더 연습해야 할 것 같아요...

english: Persistence is key to success.
Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 기초를 다시 설명해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Indeed I will...
Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.
translation: Herblore(약초학)은 약초와 다른 재료를 다뤄 쓸모 있는 물약과 독을 만드는 스킬이라네.

english: First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.
translation: 먼저 vial(약병)이 필요하네. 주워서 구할 수도 있고, crafting(공예) 스킬로 만들 수도 있지.

english: Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.
translation: 그다음엔 만들고 싶은 물약에 필요한 약초를 모아야 하네.

english: You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.
translation: 약병에 물을 채우고 필요한 재료를 넣게. 물약마다 보통 재료가 2가지씩 들어간다네.

english: Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.
translation: 명심하게, 약초는 쓰기 전에 먼저 하나하나 손질해야 하네.

english: You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.
translation: 어떤 재료는 쓰기 전에 빻아야 할 수도 있다네. 그러려면 pestle and mortar(막자와 막자사발)이 필요하지.

english: Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.
translation: 약초는 땅에서 찾을 수도 있고, 몬스터를 처치하면 떨어뜨리기도 한다네.

english: Let's try an example Attack potion: The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.
translation: Attack potion(공격 물약)을 예로 들어 보세: 첫 번째 재료는 Guam leaf(구암 잎)이고, 다음은 Eye of Newt(도롱뇽의 눈)일세.

english: Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.
translation: 이것들을 water-filled vial(물이 담긴 약병)에 섞으면 Attack potion(공격 물약)이 만들어진다네. 이 물약을 마시면 Attack(공격) 레벨이 오르지.

english: Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.
translation: 물약마다 만드는 데 필요한 Herblore(약초학) 레벨도 다르다네.

english: Good luck with your Herblore practices, and a good day to you.
translation: Herblore(약초학) 수련에 행운이 있기를. 좋은 하루 보내게.

english: Thanks for your help.
What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: Herblore(약초학) 스킬 망토를 두르려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: To earn the right to wear any skillcape you need to have mastered that skill to the highest level possible and it is no different for Herblore.
translation: 어떤 스킬 망토든 두를 자격을 얻으려면 그 스킬을 최고 레벨까지 완전히 익혀야 하네. Herblore(약초학)도 다르지 않지.

english: With the cape equipped the Nardah Herbalist will create unfinished potions for you and you may search the cape for a pestle and mortar. When you have achieved a level of 99, come back and talk to me again.
translation: 망토를 착용하면 Nardah Herbalist(나르다 약초상)이 미완성 물약을 만들어 주고, 망토를 뒤져 막자와 막자사발을 꺼낼 수도 있다네. 레벨 99를 달성하면 다시 찾아오게.

english: Most certainly; the Nardah Herbalist will recognize this cape and create unfinished potions for you and it may be searched for a pestle and mortar.
translation: 물론이지. Nardah Herbalist(나르다 약초상)이 이 망토를 알아보고 미완성 물약을 만들어 줄 걸세. 망토를 뒤져 pestle and mortar(막자와 막자사발)을 꺼낼 수도 있지.

english: It has been a pleasure to watch you grow as a herbalist. I am privileged to have been instrumental in your learning, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 자네가 약초사로 성장하는 모습을 지켜보는 건 즐거운 일이었네. 자네의 배움에 내가 보탬이 되어 영광이네만, 망토 비용으로 99,000코인의 기부를 부탁해야겠네.

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item. You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 괜찮네. 이렇게 명예로운 물건을 살 기회를 반길 모험가는 많으니까. 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 찾아오게.

english: Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
Good luck to you, [player name].
Most certainly, but I must ask for a donation of 99,000 coins to cover the expense of the cape.
translation: 물론이지. 하지만 망토 비용으로 99,000코인의 기부를 부탁해야겠네.

english: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood; it's part of a skill promotion deal - buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 스킬 망토는 전부 무료 두건과 세트로만 판다네. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이지. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알지? 그러니 내가 팔 수 있으려면 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 와야 하네.

english: Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 제 스킬 망토에 맞는 두건을 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 소지품에 공간이 부족한 것 같군. 공간이 생기면 다시 찾아오게.

english: Who are you?
What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
translation: 어둠의 마법사들이 가득한 그 돌의 원은 뭐예요?

english: Yes.
No.
So what's so good about Guthix?
Well, I'll be on my way now.
I'm in search of a quest.
Did you build this?
I'm in search of a quest
Very well, thank you.
I need more practice at it...
translation: 좀 더 연습해야 할 것 같아요...

english: Can you explain the fundamentals again?
translation: 기초를 다시 설명해 주실 수 있어요?

english: What must I do to wear a Herblore skillcape?
translation: Herblore(약초학) 스킬 망토를 두르려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: May I buy a Herblore skillcape, please
translation: Herblore(약초학) 스킬 망토를 살 수 있을까요

english: I'm afraid that's too much money for me.
Okay, here's 99,000 coins.
Can I get a hood for my skillcape, please?
translation: 제 스킬 망토에 맞는 두건을 받을 수 있을까요?

english: What do you do here?
Oh, I'm a fisherman by trade and I sometimes help out my father, Safta Doc.
translation: 아, 전 원래 어부인데 가끔 아버지 Safta Doc(사프타 독)을 돕기도 해요.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 재미있는 할 일이 있어요?

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: 브와나, 오늘 그 질문을 한 번만 더 들으면 저 폭발해 버릴 거예요! 다른 사람한테 가서 물어보세요!

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 제가 아는 건 없어요. 그냥 편히 앉아서 햇볕이나 즐기세요, 브와나!

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 미안해요, 브와나. 전 지금 바빠요. Murcaily(머케일리)한테 가서 얘기해 보는 건 어때요? 마을 어딘가에 있을 거예요.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 음, 할 일이 좀 있는 것 같은데... Murcaily(머케일리)가 도와줄 수도 있겠네요. 그는 보통 Trufitus(트루피투스)의 오두막 동쪽에 있는 경목 숲을 돌보고 있어요.

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 여긴 그냥 평범한 마을 생활이에요, 브와나. 잘 찾아보면 시간 보낼 재미있는 일은 언제나 있죠.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)는 이미 드렸고, 지금은 더 가진 게 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 좀 받아 보는 건 어때요?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 이봐요, 마을 여기저기서 일하시는 거 봤어요. 우리를 위해 좋은 일을 많이 해 주셨네요. 수고하신 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
I've been doing some work around the village.
Ok, thanks.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Would you like to buy a nice kebab? Only one gold.
I think I'll give it a miss.
Yes please.
Oops, I forgot to bring any money with me.
Come back when you have some.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
I don't like him. He makes all these claims about being the best salesman in Gielinor, and he even has some thugs that he's hired to threaten us.
translation: 전 그 사람 싫어요. Gielinor(길리노르) 최고의 장사꾼이라고 떠벌리고 다니고, 우리를 협박하려고 깡패까지 고용했다니까요.

english: One of them came round here and threatened to cut my head off if I didn't cooperate with them!
translation: 그중 한 놈이 여기 와서 협조 안 하면 제 머리를 베어 버리겠다고 협박했어요!

english: I've also heard some rumours about them from my friend Ali in Pollnivneach...
translation: Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)에 있는 제 친구 Ali(알리)한테서도 그놈들에 대한 소문을 좀 들었어요...

english: What sort of rumours?
Apparently he has men there as well, who have also been threatening people.
translation: 거기에도 그 사람 부하들이 있는데, 그놈들도 사람들을 협박하고 다닌대요.

english: And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al-Kharid himself!
translation: 게다가 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)의 통치자한테서까지 훔칠 작정이라는 말도 있어요!

english: Really?
That's what I've heard. Anyway, are you sure you wouldn't like a kebab?
translation: 제가 들은 건 그래요. 그나저나, 정말 kebab(케밥) 안 사실 거예요?

english: I've got a little problem for you to solve.
translation: 풀어 볼 작은 문제가 하나 있어요.

english: The salesman has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the riddle.
No that's not right, think again.
Correct!
The salesman has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 상인이 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: I think I'll give it a miss.
Yes please.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Hello there, human! Come in, come in!
translation: 어서 와요, 인간 양반! 들어와요, 들어와!

english: Hi, nice to see you!
Tell me, what brings you here?
translation: 말해 봐요, 여긴 무슨 일로 왔어요?

english: Well, first I came to this city just for the adventure and excitement, but then I knocked over this statue, you see. Well, I didn't really knock it over myself, I was on this boat.
translation: 음, 처음엔 그냥 모험이랑 재미를 찾아서 이 도시에 왔는데, 그러다 제가 이 조각상을 쓰러뜨렸거든요. 아니, 제가 직접 쓰러뜨린 건 아니고, 제가 배에 타고 있었는데요.

english: A boat! Fascinating, go on!
Yes, well, this boatman was a bit rubbish, or there was something wrong with the ship, I don't know. And then I got arrested by the Black Guard.
translation: 네, 그게, 그 뱃사공 실력이 좀 형편없었거나, 배에 뭔가 문제가 있었거나, 잘 모르겠어요. 그러고 나서 Black Guard(검은 경비대)한테 체포됐어요.

english: Not the Black Guard!
Yes, and they took me to this Veldaban person, who pretended to be really angry but actually he was really nice and he asked me for my help.
translation: 네, 그리고 그 사람들이 저를 Veldaban(벨다반)이라는 사람한테 데려갔는데, 그 사람은 엄청 화난 척했지만 사실 아주 친절했고 저한테 도움을 청했어요.

english: And after a whole lot of running around, I finally managed to get the statue to be rebuilt.
translation: 그리고 한참을 이리저리 뛰어다닌 끝에, 결국 조각상을 다시 세우게 만들었죠.

english: Such an interesting tale!
Now how did you come to be in Keldagrim again?
Never mind.
Well? Who are you?
I'm player, and you are?
I think you already know the answer to that.
Er... Do I?
Shaw. Kasonde Shaw. Don't go acting like you haven't been following me for some time now.
translation: 쇼. Kasonde Shaw(카손데 쇼)다. 한동안 날 따라다닌 적 없는 척하지 마.

english: Ah, of course. Those old ruins.
Exactly. Perhaps you took me for a fool, but I was on to you from the start. Considering what we learnt, I knew it was only a matter of time before you showed up.
translation: 바로 그거야. 날 바보로 봤는지 몰라도, 난 처음부터 네 정체를 눈치챘어. 우리가 알아낸 걸 생각하면, 네가 나타나는 건 시간문제였지.

english: You mean soul transference? Not actually something that interests me, to be honest.
translation: 영혼 전이 말하는 거예요? 솔직히 그건 별로 관심 없어요.

english: Don't take me for a fool! If you had no interest in the Old Ones' secrets, why would you have followed me to those ruins? And why would you have come here?
translation: 날 바보 취급하지 마! Old Ones(옛 존재들)의 비밀에 관심이 없었다면, 왜 그 폐허까지 날 따라왔지? 그리고 왜 여기까지 왔고?

english: To be honest, I didn't even know what an Old One was. I still don't really. I was just exploring when I found your camp.
translation: 솔직히 저는 Old One(옛 존재)가 뭔지도 몰랐어요. 지금도 잘 모르고요. 그냥 탐험하다가 당신 야영지를 발견한 거예요.

english: As for why I'm here, I'm looking for information about someone called Vardorvis.
translation: 제가 여기 온 이유는, Vardorvis(바르도르비스)라는 사람에 대한 정보를 찾고 있어서예요.

english: Really? You want me to believe that all of this is a coincidence?
translation: 정말? 이 모든 게 우연이라는 걸 나더러 믿으라고?

english: Well... yes.
You're lying! You're lying and...
Hang on... do you hear that?
Hear what?
The Strangled! Did you disturb any tendrils on your way in here?
translation: Strangled(목 졸린 자)들이야! 여기 들어오다가 tendrils(덩굴손) 건드렸어?

english: I may have...?
They'll be coming. We've got no chance up here. Head down below! Now!
translation: 놈들이 몰려올 거야. 위에선 승산이 없어. 아래로 내려가! 당장!

english: That's the lot of them. Let's head back up.
That was too close. You nearly got us both killed!
translation: 아슬아슬했어. 너 때문에 우리 둘 다 죽을 뻔했다고!

english: I don't understand... What are those things? Are they zombies?
translation: 이해가 안 돼요... 저것들은 뭐예요? 좀비인가요?

english: You really want me to believe that you don't know anything about this place?
translation: 정말 이곳에 대해 아무것도 모른다는 걸 나더러 믿으라는 거야?

english: I already told you, I wasn't lying.
Well I don't have any reason to trust that.
translation: 글쎄, 난 그걸 믿을 이유가 없는데.

english: With how dangerous this place is, do you really have a choice?
translation: 이곳이 이렇게 위험한데, 당신한테 정말 선택지가 있어요?

english: Hmm...
Alright, fine. But I have no desire to see you get us killed, so you'd better wisen up fast.
translation: 좋아, 알았어. 하지만 너 때문에 우리가 죽는 꼴은 보고 싶지 않으니, 빨리 정신 차리는 게 좋을 거야.

english: I'm listening.
It all starts with the Old Ones. They lived here long before humans came to these lands, and these ruins here were once their home.
translation: 모든 건 Old Ones(옛 존재들)에서 시작돼. 그들은 인간이 이 땅에 오기 훨씬 전부터 여기 살았고, 이 폐허는 한때 그들의 집이었지.

english: And these Old Ones discovered soul transference?
translation: 그럼 그 옛 존재들이 영혼 전이를 발견한 거예요?

english: They did, and they did so long before House Arceuus even existed. It was their final attempt to overcome their extinction, but they failed.
translation: 그래. 그것도 House Arceuus(아르세우스 가문)이 생기기도 훨씬 전에 말이야. 멸종을 이겨 내려는 그들의 마지막 시도였지만, 실패했어.

english: What you see around you is the result of their failure. It's known as the Strangler.
translation: 주위에 보이는 게 그 실패의 결과야. Strangler(교살자)라고 불리지.

english: The Strangler?
It's some sort of parasite. It was presumably meant to play a role in their transference rituals, but instead it destroyed them. It has remained here ever since.
translation: 일종의 기생충이야. 아마 원래는 전이 의식에서 어떤 역할을 할 예정이었겠지만, 오히려 그들을 파멸시켰어. 그 뒤로 줄곧 여기 남아 있지.

english: Hence the Strangled?
Exactly. Plenty of unwary fools have fallen victim to the Strangler. If you don't take care, you will share their fate.
translation: 바로 그거야. 조심성 없는 바보들이 수도 없이 교살자의 희생양이 됐지. 조심하지 않으면 너도 그들과 같은 운명이 될 거야.

english: So how do we deal with them?
The trick is to maintain your distance. They're relatively passive unless you get too close, but if you disturb one, the rest will quickly come running.
translation: 요령은 거리를 유지하는 거야. 너무 가까이 가지만 않으면 비교적 얌전하지만, 하나를 건드리면 나머지가 금세 몰려들어.

english: If you need to fight one, try to do it away from the rest!
translation: 싸워야 한다면, 다른 놈들과 떨어진 곳에서 싸우도록 해!

english: And stay off of the tendrils! You'll alert the lot of them to your location! It's like a network.
translation: 그리고 tendrils(덩굴손)을 밟지 마! 네 위치가 놈들 전부한테 알려질 거야! 그물망처럼 연결돼 있거든.

english: Keep my distance and stay off the tendrils. I can do that. So what's our next move?
translation: 거리를 유지하고 덩굴손을 밟지 말 것. 그건 할 수 있어요. 그럼 다음엔 뭘 하죠?

english: The fact that you're still alive tells me you broke into my home and stole some of the potion I made.
translation: 네가 아직 살아 있다는 건, 네가 내 집에 침입해서 내가 만든 물약을 좀 훔쳤다는 뜻이지.

english: 'Broke in' is maybe a bit strong...
Call it what you want, it's not important now. What is important is that I believe I can make a more powerful potion using ingredients found here.
translation: 뭐라고 부르든 상관없어, 지금은 중요하지 않아. 중요한 건, 여기서 찾을 수 있는 재료로 더 강력한 물약을 만들 수 있을 것 같다는 거야.

english: If all goes well, this potion will provide increased immunity against the Strangler. If either of us are to find what we want here, it will be essential.
translation: 일이 잘 풀리면, 이 물약이 교살자에 대한 면역력을 높여 줄 거야. 우리 중 누구든 여기서 원하는 걸 찾으려면 꼭 필요할 거다.

english: So what ingredients do we need?
As you've no doubt seen, the Strangler infects plant life as well. However, I've come across a small number of plants that seem to have developed immunity.
translation: 너도 봤겠지만, 교살자는 식물도 감염시켜. 하지만 면역이 생긴 것 같은 식물을 몇 개 찾아냈어.

english: First, there's a herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. Second, there are some berries in an old camp on the coast to the south west.
translation: 첫째, 신전 바로 북서쪽 절벽 꼭대기에 자라는 약초가 있어. 둘째, 남서쪽 해안의 오래된 야영지에 열매가 좀 있어.

english: Alright, I can gather those.
I need to gather some additional ingredients from within the temple. I will meet you back here once I'm done.
translation: 난 신전 안에서 추가 재료를 좀 모아야 해. 다 끝나면 여기서 다시 만나자.

english: Kasonde! Are you okay?
Damn it! Damn it! This can't happen! It can't!
translation: 젠장! 젠장! 이럴 순 없어! 이럴 순 없다고!

english: Kasonde?
Kasonde shows you his arm. There's a large bite from one of the Strangled.
translation: Kasonde(카손데)가 자기 팔을 보여 준다. Strangled(목 졸린 자)에게 크게 물린 자국이 있다.

english: Kasonde...
It's fine! This doesn't change anything.
But the infection...
The infection means nothing!
I was a dead man either way...
What are you on about?
Koreps Syndrome. Common among botanists apparently. You'd have thought we'd have put some effort into finding a cure, but I guess no one ever thinks they'll be the unlucky one.
translation: Koreps Syndrome(코렙스 증후군). 식물학자들 사이에선 흔하다더군. 치료법 찾는 데 좀 힘을 썼을 법도 한데, 다들 자기가 그 불운한 사람이 될 거라곤 생각 안 하나 봐.

english: Kasonde, I...
Don't. Whatever you have to say, I don't want to hear it. Do you know how many times I've heard the word 'sorry'? Do you know how many times people have told me they understand?
translation: 됐어. 무슨 말을 하려는 거든 듣고 싶지 않아. 내가 '미안하다'는 말을 몇 번이나 들었는지 알아? 사람들이 이해한다고 말한 게 몇 번인지 알아?

english: Well they don't. I spent every day working away, telling myself that one day I'd finally be able to live my life, but it was all a lie. That was my life, and it was all so... meaningless!
translation: 근데 아무도 이해 못 해. 난 언젠가는 마침내 내 인생을 살 수 있을 거라고 스스로 되뇌면서 매일 일만 했어. 그런데 전부 거짓말이었어. 그게 내 인생이었고, 전부 너무나... 무의미했어!

english: I tried everything. I went to every healer, ever mage, every priest.
translation: 안 해 본 게 없어. 치료사란 치료사, 마법사란 마법사, 사제란 사제는 다 찾아갔어.

english: I went to House Arceuus, and they turned me away! What gives them the right?!
translation: House Arceuus(아르세우스 가문)에도 갔는데, 날 문전박대하더군! 그놈들이 무슨 권리로?!

english: So no, this doesn't change anything. The Old Ones are my last hope. I either find their secrets, or...
translation: 그러니까 아니, 이걸로 달라지는 건 없어. Old Ones(옛 존재들)이 내 마지막 희망이야. 그들의 비밀을 찾아내든가, 아니면...

english: Look, we're wasting time here! There's a ritual site to the west. Presumably it's where the Strangler was unleashed. It's my best hope now, and it may well be where you'll find what you're after as well.
translation: 이봐, 여기서 시간 낭비하고 있잖아! 서쪽에 의식 장소가 있어. 아마 교살자가 풀려난 곳이겠지. 이제 내 최선의 희망은 거기고, 네가 찾는 것도 어쩌면 거기 있을 거야.

english: Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: 이 물약을 받아서 네가 모은 재료를 넣어. 교살자에 대한 면역력을 강화해 줄 거야. 이제 가!

english: Hello, you must be a traveller.
Well guessed, adventurer.
Are you from Lovakengj?
You are wrong this time, adventurer. I'm actually from Ice Mountain.
translation: 이번엔 틀리셨어요, 모험가님. 사실 전 Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 출신이에요.

english: I always wanted to visit Lovakengj to see the Blast Mine. This year I finally saved up enough to travel here.
translation: 전 늘 Lovakengj(로바켕기)에 가서 Blast Mine(폭파 광산)을 보고 싶었어요. 올해 드디어 여기까지 올 여비를 모았죠.

english: However, the war with the lizardmen means Lovakengj is dangerous to get to from here. I'll need to go the long way round.
translation: 그런데 리자드맨과의 전쟁 때문에 여기서 로바켕기로 가는 길이 위험해요. 먼 길로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: What do you think about this place?
To be honest, Shayzien is a bit boring for visitors. It's all about war and military things.
translation: 솔직히 Shayzien(샤이지엔)은 여행객한테는 좀 지루해요. 온통 전쟁이랑 군대 얘기뿐이거든요.

english: The only place I would recommend is the Cloak and Stagger. You'll find some pretty good drinks there.
translation: 제가 추천할 만한 곳은 Cloak and Stagger(망토와 비틀걸음)뿐이에요. 거기 가면 꽤 괜찮은 술이 있어요.

english: See you later.
Are you from Lovakengj?
How do you feel about this place?
See you later.
Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear...
Oh dear?
It's terrible!
What's terrible?
Oh, never mind, dearie. What can I do for you?
translation: 아, 신경 쓰지 마라, 얘야. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
Ooh, it's dangerous up there at the moment!
I'm not afraid - let's go!
It's dangerous up there for me too, dearie.
Would it help if I gave you some money?
Ooh, that's better! I'll take you up north for 50 shiny coins.
translation: 오호, 그럼 얘기가 다르지! 반짝이는 코인 50개면 북쪽까지 데려다주마.

english: Alright, I'll pay.
Kathy Corkat rows you down the river to the sea...
translation: Kathy Corkat(캐시 코캣)이 노를 저어 당신을 강 하류의 바다까지 데려다준다...

english: Not a chance!
Then you can find your own way north, dearie!
Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
I don't think I want anything, thanks.
Everybody wants something, dearie!
translation: 원하는 게 없는 사람은 없단다, 얘야!

english: Huh? Oh, forget it!
I'll be glad to get away from this place, dearie! Fancy a lift up the river?
translation: 여길 떠나게 되면 기쁘겠구나, 얘야! 강 위쪽까지 태워 줄까?

english: Yes please.
Kathy Corkat rows you up the river...
translation: Kathy Corkat(캐시 코캣)이 노를 저어 당신을 강 위쪽으로 데려다준다...

english: No thanks.
Hello dearie. Heading up north to the Fishing Colony, are we?
translation: 안녕, 얘야. 북쪽 Fishing Colony(어촌)으로 가는 길이니?

english: Are ye wantin' a lift up the river, dearie?
Why don't you row right into the Colony? It'd make it much easier to get in there.
translation: 어촌 안까지 바로 노 저어 가시는 건 어때요? 그러면 들어가기가 훨씬 쉬울 텐데요.

english: Oh, Franklin doesn't like it if I take my boat too close. He says I'll damage the nets and scare the fish. But were you wanting a lift up to the river?
translation: 아, Franklin(프랭클린)은 내가 배를 너무 가까이 대는 걸 싫어한단다. 그물이 망가지고 물고기가 놀란다나. 그건 그렇고, 강 위쪽까지 태워 줄까?

english: Can you take me downstream in your boat?
I'm not afraid - let's go!
Alright, I'll pay.
Not a chance!
Dangerous? Nah, forget it!
I don't think I want anything, thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Why don't you row right into the Colony?
translation: 어촌 안까지 바로 노 저어 가시는 건 어때요?

english: Heya! What can I get you?
What ales are you serving?
Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: 음, Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일), Wizard's Mind Bomb(마법사의 마인드 밤), Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트)가 있는데, 전부 단돈 3코인이에요.

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
Sorry, I'll come back another day.
Thanks, Kaylee.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주실래요?

english: I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
Okay, sure.
There you go.
Thanks!
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 전 빈 맥주잔이 좋거든요.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 오, 괜찮으시면 저희가 사 드릴게요. 잔당 2코인이에요.

english: What's this about the party room?
Have you heard? Someone's planning a big party!
translation: 소식 들으셨어요? 누가 성대한 파티를 열 계획이래요!

english: What do you mean?
Someone's put something very valuable into the party room drop chest! If you go to the party room and pull the lever you might have a chance to get it!
translation: 누가 파티 룸의 drop chest(드롭 상자)에 아주 값진 물건을 넣어 뒀대요! 파티 룸에 가서 lever(레버)를 당기면 그걸 얻을 기회가 생길지도 몰라요!

english: It could be your lucky day!
Thanks!
I have a question for you.
Kaylee has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Kaylee has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Kaylee(케일리)가 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
translation: 파티 룸에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있어요!

english: Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
translation: 파티 룸에서 무슨 일이 있는 거예요?

english: Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 지금 파티 룸에 값비싼 물건들이 있어요!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
What ales are you serving?
One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주실래요?

english: I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
Okay, sure.
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 전 빈 맥주잔이 좋거든요.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
What's this about the party room?
Can I help you at all?
No thanks.
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
You prove you are very strong, little human!
translation: 너 아주 강한 거 증명했다, 작은 인간!

english: What about our deal?
A deal is a deal. We will not be allies with the monkeys.
translation: 거래는 거래다. 우리 원숭이들이랑 동맹 안 한다.

english: I'm looking for the head of the city guard...
You found him! What do you want, little human?
translation: 그거 나다! 뭘 원하냐, 작은 인간?

english: I know about your deal with the monkeys. I'm here to persuade you not to join their alliance.
translation: 당신이 원숭이들이랑 거래한 거 알아요. 그 동맹에 끼지 말라고 설득하러 왔어요.

english: Hahaha! Monkeys offer us treasure, land and all the humans we can eat! What do you offer us?
translation: 하하하! 원숭이들 우리한테 보물, 땅, 먹고 싶은 만큼 인간 다 준다! 너는 뭘 주냐?

english: Perhaps I could offer you more?
translation: 제가 더 많이 드릴 수도 있지 않을까요?

english: I don't think human can offer me cities like the monkey king can!
translation: 인간이 원숭이 왕처럼 나한테 도시 줄 수 있을 리 없다!

english: Um... that's not going to work.
I offer to spare your life.
Little human is brave! I think I can offer you a deal...
translation: 작은 인간 용감하다! 너한테 거래 하나 제안할 수 있겠다...

english: If you can defeat me in battle, I will tell my men not to help the monkeys.
translation: 너 싸움에서 나 이기면, 내 부하들한테 원숭이들 돕지 말라고 하겠다.

english: I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
I'm looking for a fight!
Hahaha, human is funny! You will barely fill my stomach, stop wasting my time!
translation: 하하하, 인간 웃기다! 너로는 내 배 채우기도 모자란다, 시간 낭비하지 마라!

english: Nevermind.
Stop! Stop! You prove you are very strong, little human!
translation: 그만! 그만! 너 아주 강한 거 증명했다, 작은 인간!

english: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
Perhaps I could offer you more?
translation: 제가 더 많이 드릴 수도 있지 않을까요?

english: I offer to spare your life.
I accept your challenge.
Not right now.
Nevermind.
I'm looking for a fight!

Oh, hello stranger. If you're new to town you should speak with our ruler, King Gjuki Sorvott IV. He'll want to meet you - he always wants to have a chat with any strangers in town. They could be spies you know.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, 낯선 분. 이 마을이 처음이시면 우리 통치자 King Gjuki Sorvott IV(기우키 소르보트 4세 국왕)님을 만나 보세요. 만나고 싶어 하실 거예요. 마을에 낯선 사람이 오면 늘 이야기를 나누고 싶어 하시거든요. 첩자일 수도 있으니까요.

english: Spies?
Yes, spies from Neitiznot. They're everywhere. Apparently. That's what the King says anyway.
translation: 네, Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)에서 온 첩자요. 어디에나 있대요. 그렇다더라고요. 아무튼 왕께서는 그렇게 말씀하세요.

english: So what do you do here?
Me? I'm a cook. Fish dishes a speciality. I hate fish. But fish is about all we have. Except for yak. But we're not allowed to eat yak.
translation: 저요? 요리사예요. 생선 요리가 전문이죠. 전 생선이 싫어요. 그런데 여기 있는 거라곤 생선뿐이에요. 야크만 빼고요. 그런데 야크는 먹으면 안 돼요.

english: Why not, is yak meat bad for you?
translation: 왜요, 야크 고기가 몸에 안 좋아요?

english: Certainly not! Yak meat is both sweet and delicately flavoured. Yak is juicier than buffalo and elk - but never gamey. It goes wonderfully well with a glass of red wine, and it's healthy too!
translation: 절대 아니죠! 야크 고기는 달콤하고 풍미가 섬세해요. 버팔로나 엘크보다 육즙이 많은데 누린내는 전혀 없어요. 레드 와인 한 잔이랑 기막히게 어울리고, 몸에도 좋다고요!

english: So why aren't you allowed to eat it?
translation: 그럼 왜 못 먹게 하는 거예요?

english: King's orders. They breed and eat yaks on Neitiznot, so WE'RE not allowed to. It's unjust I tell you! I had a dream last night about a juicy fillet of yak, served on a bed of deep-fried seaweed and topped with a garnish
translation: 왕의 명령이에요. Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)에서 야크를 키우고 먹으니까 '우리'는 먹으면 안 된대요. 부당하다니까요! 어젯밤엔 바삭하게 튀긴 seaweed(해초) 위에 육즙 가득한 야크 안심을 올리고, 고명으로

english: of crumbly yak's cheese.
translation: 부슬부슬한 야크 치즈를 얹은 요리 꿈을 꿨어요.

english: That's a little sad. So do you have any cooked food I could buy?
translation: 좀 슬프네요. 그럼 제가 살 만한 익힌 음식 있어요?

english: No. It would only be fish anyway. Why would you want to eat fish?
translation: 없어요. 있어 봤자 생선뿐일 텐데요. 생선을 왜 먹고 싶어요?

english: Well, I wouldn't mind a few shark and swordfish steaks as back-up you know.
translation: 음, 비상용으로 shark(상어)랑 swordfish(황새치) 스테이크 몇 개쯤은 있어도 괜찮을 것 같아서요.

english: If you insist. Sorry the stock is so low, but I just can't be bothered to cook any more.
translation: 정 그러시다면. 재고가 너무 없어서 미안해요. 그냥 더는 요리할 의욕이 안 나요.

english: Go away and let me wallow in self loathing.
translation: 가세요, 혼자 자기혐오에 빠져 있게 놔둬요.

english: Do you want any help with that? I can loathyou as well.
translation: 도와드릴까요? 제가 같이 혐오해 드릴 수도 있는데요. 당신을요.

english: *sigh*
Hello. Who are you?
Hello there. The name's Keith. I'm the farmer here.
translation: 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 Keith(키스)예요. 여기서 농사를 짓고 있죠.

english: You're pretty far out of the way here. How come?
translation: 꽤 외진 곳에 계시네요. 어쩐 일이에요?

english: It's a peaceful life. Out here I can avoid the drama and politics of the big settlements.
translation: 평화로운 삶이거든요. 여기 있으면 큰 정착지의 소동이랑 정치에서 벗어날 수 있어요.

english: Aren't you worried about how close the lizardmen are though?
translation: 그래도 리자드맨이 가까이 있는 게 걱정되지 않으세요?

english: The Shayzien troops keep them busy. They've not tried coming up this way.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 병사들이 놈들을 바쁘게 붙잡아 두고 있어요. 이쪽으로 올라오려고 한 적은 없어요.

english: Fair enough. I'll leave you to it.
Hello.
Huh... Oh sorry, you made me jump. I was miles away, day dreaming.
translation: 어... 아, 미안해요. 깜짝 놀랐네요. 딴생각에 빠져서 공상하고 있었거든요.

english: About what may I ask?
I was thinking about the crystal spires of Prifddinas.
It must be beautiful, I've only seen the city walls.
translation: 정말 아름답겠네요. 전 도시 성벽밖에 못 봤어요.

english: I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that changes one day.
translation: 저도 본 적은 없어요. 아는 건 전해 들은 이야기뿐이죠. 언젠가는 달라졌으면 좋겠어요.

english: I have never seen it, all I know are the stories. I hope that once this war is over, I'll finally be able to.
translation: 저도 본 적은 없어요. 아는 건 전해 들은 이야기뿐이죠. 이 전쟁이 끝나면 마침내 볼 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Hey there [player name].
Hey there. How is it being the new Lady Ithell?
translation: 안녕하세요. 새 Lady Ithell(레이디 이셀)이 된 기분은 어때요?

english: It's a daunting job, but I have the knowledge of my predecessor to help me.
translation: 벅찬 일이지만, 전임자의 지식이 저를 도와주고 있어요.

english: It's still crazy how fast it all happened. One moment I was a daydreaming elf, who'd never even seen Prifddinas. Now I'm responsible for an entire elf clan.
translation: 모든 게 너무 빨리 일어나서 아직도 얼떨떨해요. 얼마 전까지만 해도 Prifddinas(프리프디나스)를 구경도 못 해 본 공상 많은 엘프였는데, 이제는 엘프 가문 하나를 통째로 책임지고 있다니까요.

english: Well don't worry, I'm sure you're doing great.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 분명 잘하고 계실 거예요.

english: Thank you [player name].
What do you think you're doing?
Good day!
She don't speak much, not since the incident.
translation: 저 여자는 말이 별로 없어. 그 일이 있고 나서부터는.

english: Oh, what happened? If you don't mind me asking.
translation: 아, 무슨 일이 있었는데요? 실례가 안 된다면요.

english: I'd prefer not to go into details, but I will say this...
translation: 자세히는 말하고 싶지 않지만, 이것만은 말해 주지...

english: ...Yeah?
...Demons!
Demons?
Killed 'er 'usband!
Oh, well that's certainly a shame.
Isn't it just.
What are you looking for, outsider?
Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Hello there, Kennith. How are you today?
Great mister! Thanks again for rescuing me.
translation: 좋아요, 아저씨! 구해 주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: It was my pleasure Kennith. You take care now.
translation: 내가 좋아서 한 일인걸, Kennith(케니스). 몸조심하렴.

english: Sure mister. Goodbye now.
Hello there, [player name]!
Hello again Kent.
I never did get the chance to thank you properly for saving Kennith and myself.
translation: Kennith(케니스)와 저를 구해 주셨는데 제대로 감사 인사를 드릴 기회가 없었네요.

english: Oh, don't be silly, it was nothing really.
Play it down if you will. It was a truly brave thing you did.
translation: 겸손하게 말씀하셔도 좋지만, 정말 용감한 일을 하신 거예요.

english: I only did what anyone would have done in my position. I have to go now, take care.
translation: 제 입장이었다면 누구라도 그렇게 했을 거예요. 이제 가 봐야겠어요. 잘 지내세요.

english: You too, [player name]. Goodbye.
Who goes there? This is no place for a human. You need to leave.
translation: 거기 누구냐? 여긴 인간이 올 곳이 아니다. 떠나라.

english: You're starting to scare me man...
I am no man! They changed me and cursed me to remain here...
translation: 난 사람이 아니다! 놈들이 날 바꿔 놓고 이곳에 머물도록 저주를 걸었지...

english: What do you mean they changed you?
I was once a free man, powerful and wealthy. I owned several apothecaries across Kourend and sold the tastiest potions in the land.
translation: 나도 한때는 자유로운 인간이었다. 힘 있고 부유했지. Kourend(쿠렌드) 곳곳에 약방을 여러 채 갖고 있었고, 이 땅에서 가장 맛있는 물약을 팔았다.

english: What happened?

One of my greatest inventions, it was going so well. I spent days finding the right herbs, I travelled across all of Kourend to find the most exotic weeds. Once I had gathered them all, I put them in a potion and mixed in
translation: 내 최고의 발명품 중 하나였지. 일은 아주 순조로웠다. 알맞은 약초를 찾느라 며칠을 보냈고, 가장 이국적인 풀을 찾아 Kourend(쿠렌드) 전역을 돌아다녔다. 전부 모은 뒤 물약에 넣고, 거기에

english: the final ingredient.
Kourend? Interesting...
Kourend? Oh yeah, I've been there.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)요? 아, 거기 가 본 적 있어요.

english: Yes, yes... The potion tasted delicious but it was missing a tiny something so I added Magic roots to the potion. It started to pulsate and glow! I took a sip and I felt like a million gold! A few seconds later my eye sight
translation: 그래, 그래... 물약은 맛있었지만 뭔가 아주 조금 부족했지. 그래서 Magic roots(마법 나무 뿌리)를 넣었다. 그러자 물약이 맥동하며 빛나기 시작하더군! 한 모금 마시자 백만 골드를 얻은 기분이었지! 그런데 몇 초 뒤 눈앞이

english: began to blur, my brain was throbbing. I fell and hit my head on my worktop, then it all went black.
translation: 흐려지기 시작했고, 머리가 지끈거렸다. 쓰러지면서 작업대에 머리를 부딪쳤고, 그러고는 모든 게 캄캄해졌지.

english: Ouch! But, you still haven't said who changed you?
translation: 아야! 그런데 누가 당신을 바꿔 놓았는지는 아직 말 안 했잖아요?

english: Will you let me finish?

I woke up screaming in pain. Blue foam streaming out of my mouth, my eye sight worse than before, the only things I could make out were 3 tall figures with green banners - they were of the Arceuus Elders. They
translation: 나는 고통에 비명을 지르며 깨어났다. 입에서는 푸른 거품이 흘러나왔고, 눈은 전보다 더 침침해서 겨우 알아볼 수 있는 건 초록 깃발을 든 키 큰 형체 셋뿐이었지. 바로 Arceuus Elders(아르세우스 원로들)였다. 몇 번이고 일어나려 애쓰는 동안 그들은

english: muttered to each other in Archaic Language after trying to get up several times. I lost hope and stared at the sky. I had given up when the tallest of the figures bent over and brought his face right to mine and spoke
translation: Archaic Language(고대어)로 서로 중얼거렸다. 나는 희망을 잃고 하늘만 바라봤지. 완전히 포기했을 때, 그중 가장 키 큰 자가 몸을 숙여 내 얼굴에 자기 얼굴을 바짝 대고는

english: very softly 'We can save you, but it will come at a cost'.
translation: 아주 나직하게 말했다. '널 살릴 수는 있다. 하지만 대가가 따를 것이다.'

english: So they saved you?
Yes of course they saved me but look at the cost! I have horns coming out of my head and I'm still blind and stuck here... forever alone.
translation: 그래, 물론 살려 줬지. 하지만 그 대가를 봐라! 머리에선 뿔이 솟아나고, 눈은 여전히 멀었고, 여기 갇혀 있지... 영원히 홀로.

english: What was the curse?
I have been charged to stay here to prevent the Monstrosity from escaping. Those gates and the winches that operate them are the only thing that stops it breaking free.
translation: 나는 이곳에 머물며 그 괴물이 탈출하지 못하게 막으라는 명을 받았다. 저 대문과 그걸 움직이는 윈치들만이 놈이 풀려나는 걸 막고 있지.

english: What monstrosity? What's behind those gates?
translation: 무슨 괴물이요? 저 대문 너머에 뭐가 있는데요?

english: You really do not want to know. Leave this place human.
translation: 정말 알고 싶지 않을 거다. 이곳을 떠나라, 인간.

english: Hey now, I'm no wimp. What's to stop me from just turning the winch to open the gate and going in?
translation: 이봐요, 전 겁쟁이가 아니에요. 제가 그냥 윈치를 돌려서 대문을 열고 들어가는 걸 뭐가 막는데요?

english: Me. And of course your quick demise at the mercy of Cerberus, guardian of the river of souls.
translation: 내가 막지. 그리고 물론, river of souls(영혼의 강)의 수호자 Cerberus(케르베로스) 앞에서 순식간에 맞이하게 될 네 최후도.

english: But I can do it!
You are obviously passionate at trying. But only those with great skill at slaying these types of beast may enter.
translation: 의욕만은 대단하군. 하지만 이런 짐승을 처치하는 데 뛰어난 솜씨를 가진 자만이 들어갈 수 있다.

english: THE VOICES! AAAHHHHH! Leave this place human!
I have been charged by the slayer masters to eliminate this type of threat.
translation: 전 slayer master(슬레이어 마스터)들에게서 이런 위협을 제거하라는 임무를 받았어요.

english: Then you may pass... may your soul not end up consumed and forever condemned to the-
translation: 그렇다면 지나가도 좋다... 네 영혼이 삼켜져 영원히 그—

english: Goodbye.
Aretha said you might be able to repair the soul bearer for me.
translation: Aretha(아레사)가 당신이라면 soul bearer(영혼 운반자)를 고쳐 줄 수 있을 거라고 했어요.

english: The soul bearer! You have the soul bearer! The voices speak of it often. It is from this place, yet it is not of this place.
translation: soul bearer(영혼 운반자)! 네가 영혼 운반자를 갖고 있구나! 목소리들이 그것에 대해 자주 이야기하지. 그것은 이곳에서 왔으나, 이곳의 것이 아니다.

english: Will you repair it?
The voices tell me I can. They speak to me!
translation: 목소리들이 내가 할 수 있다고 하는군. 그들이 내게 말을 건다!

english: The Key Master repairs your soul bearer.
translation: Key Master(열쇠지기)가 soul bearer(영혼 운반자)를 수리해 준다.

english: The voices say you must use it wisely.
Thanks, I will.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: clue scroll(단서 두루마리)의 찢어진 조각을 건네받았다.

english: What do you mean they changed you?
What was the curse?
Goodbye.
What voices?
Thanks, I will.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우?  우우우 우우 우우우우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우우 우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우우! 우우 우우우우 우우우우우 우우 우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데, 진심으로요: 저 지이이인짜 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 순 없다고들 하지만, 가끔은 은행 계좌를 열어서 제가 가진 걸 전부 쳐다보면서 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋더라고요:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 음, 우리처럼 살아 있는 부자들은 당신 같은 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 시간 낭비할 수 없거든요. 전 지이이인짜 부자라서 이제 가 봐야 해요. 어쩌면 돈을 더 벌러 갈지도 모르고요.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 그건 언제나 맞는 말이죠. 또 봐요, 이상한 투명 죽은 사람 씨!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘진 않은데 전 cooked chicken(익힌 닭고기)가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도요. 그래도 집에서 구운 파이만 한 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 정말요? 처음 알았네요. 음, 전 이만 가 봐야겠어요. 또 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너희는 살아남을 기회가 없다 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 나한테 그런 식으로 말해도 된다고 생각하지 마요!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 내가 당신을 혼내 줄 방법을 못 찾을 거라 생각하지 마요, 유령 씨!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아뇨, 전 평생 거기 가 본 적도 없고, 갔을 때 뭘 훔친 적은 절대로 없어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 지금 절 거짓말쟁이라고 하는 거예요?!?! 전 평생 뭘 훔쳐 본 적이 없어요. 그리고 제가 남이 피땀 흘려 번 돈을 그 사람 주머니에서 직접

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 훔쳐 갈 만큼 도덕적으로 타락한 인간이라는 암시는 정말 불쾌하다고요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 케이크도요. 모피도요. 몇 번이고. 한 번에 아주 오랫동안요.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나온다면 이 문제에 대해선 더 할 말이 없네요. 그럼 좋은 하루 보내세요!

english: Hello. So you must be Kharrim the messenger.
How do you know my name, stranger?
translation: 내 이름을 어떻게 아나, 낯선 이여?

english: Well now... I had a very interesting chat with Rennard the thief.
translation: 음... 도둑 Rennard(레너드)와 아주 흥미로운 대화를 나눴거든요.

english: It seems you redirected his message regarding a certain god-weapon for your own ends.
translation: 당신이 어떤 신의 무기에 관한 그의 메시지를 자기 목적에 맞게 빼돌렸다면서요.

english: So THAT is what this is about... I should have known the deal was too good to have no repercussions...
translation: 그래서 그 일 때문이었군... 그렇게 좋은 거래에 뒤탈이 없을 리 없다는 걸 알았어야 했는데...

english: It seems as though you might be responsible for this curse that has befallen you by not delivering Rennard's message to the correct person.
translation: Rennard(레너드)의 메시지를 제대로 된 사람에게 전하지 않아서 당신에게 이 저주가 내린 건지도 모르겠네요.

english: Ha! That is not a truthful assessment of the story... You might think differently if you had heard my side of events.
translation: 하! 그건 사실과 다른 판단일세... 내 쪽 이야기를 들었다면 생각이 달라졌을 걸세.

english: Please let me hear your side of the story then...
Well, if you have spoken to Rennard, then you will know that he had somehow managed to obtain a very valuable weapon, and was looking for buyers.
translation: 자네가 Rennard(레너드)와 이야기를 나눴다면, 그 친구가 어찌어찌 아주 귀한 무기를 손에 넣어 살 사람을 찾고 있었다는 건 알겠지.

english: What he probably didn't tell you, was that he met me in a drunken stupor in some smoke filled tavern, and I offered to arrange a purchaser for his item, in exchange for a small finders fee.
translation: 그 친구가 아마 말하지 않은 건, 연기 자욱한 어느 선술집에서 곤드레만드레 취한 채 나를 만났다는 걸세. 나는 약간의 중개료를 받는 대가로 그 물건을 살 사람을 주선해 주겠다고 했지.

english: So you knew what the staff was?
translation: 그럼 그 지팡이가 뭔지 알고 있었던 거예요?

english: The god-staff of Armadyl? Well, of course I did.
translation: Armadyl(아마딜)의 그 신성한 지팡이 말인가? 물론 알았지.

english: Honestly, you would have to be pretty slow-witted to not recognise a legendary artefact such as that.
translation: 솔직히, 그런 전설적인 유물을 못 알아보려면 머리가 꽤나 둔해야 할 걸세.

english: Wait, I don't understand, Rennard said that he had a buyer already in mind, and that you diverted his message to a General Zamorak instead?
translation: 잠깐, 이해가 안 돼요. Rennard(레너드)는 이미 점찍어 둔 구매자가 있었는데, 당신이 그 메시지를 General Zamorak(자모락 장군)에게 돌렸다던데요?

english: Ha! Here is a word of advice for you adventurer; Never trust the words of a drunk.
translation: 하! 모험가, 자네에게 충고 하나 하지. 술주정뱅이의 말은 절대 믿지 말게.

english: Whatever he might have thought he was doing with it, in the end all that happened was he left me to arrange a purchaser for the item.
translation: 그 친구가 무슨 생각이었든, 결국 일어난 일은 그 물건의 구매자를 찾는 일을 내게 맡겼다는 것뿐일세.

english: So you thought you would offer it to General Zamorak?
translation: 그래서 General Zamorak(자모락 장군)에게 팔 생각을 한 거예요?

english: Ah yes, Lord Zamorak. He was merely a mortal back then, you know?
translation: 아, 그렇지, Lord Zamorak(자모락 경). 그분은 그때만 해도 한낱 필멸자였네, 알고 있나?

english: Yet I could see great things in store for him even then. He had a kind of brilliant ruthlessness... And that special kind of vicious streak you see so rarely...
translation: 그래도 그때부터 이미 그분 앞에 위대한 일이 기다리고 있다는 게 보였지. 그분에겐 일종의 눈부신 무자비함이 있었네... 그리고 좀처럼 보기 힘든 특별한 잔혹함도...

english: Well anyway, when given the task of selling a weapon forged by the very gods themselves, I naturally thought of Zamorak as a potential buyer.
translation: 아무튼, 신들이 직접 벼려 낸 무기를 팔 일을 맡게 되자, 나는 자연스레 Zamorak(자모락)을 구매자로 떠올렸지.

english: I was a messenger in his employ anyway, so it was a mere trifle to find him and deliver the news, and I knew of his particular interest in armour and weaponry of all kinds.
translation: 어차피 나는 그분 밑에서 일하는 전령이었으니 그분을 찾아가 소식을 전하는 건 일도 아니었고, 그분이 온갖 갑옷과 무기에 각별한 관심이 있다는 것도 알고 있었네.

english: Yes, he was always quite the connoisseur when it came to weaponry...
translation: 그래, 그분은 무기에 관해서라면 언제나 대단한 감식가였지...

english: But I digress. I let Lord Zamorak know that there was some drunken fool with an artefact of incredible power that could probably be bought off with a few jewels and trinkets,
translation: 이야기가 샜군. 나는 Lord Zamorak(자모락 경)께 엄청난 힘을 지닌 유물을 가진 웬 술 취한 바보가 있는데, 보석과 장신구 몇 개면 아마 넘길 거라고 알려 드렸지.

english: and he escorted me to the tavern and made the purchase there and then.
translation: 그러자 그분은 나를 데리고 선술집으로 가서 그 자리에서 바로 사들이셨네.

english: It was a satisfactory deal all around, I got a share of the sale price from Rennard, and I greatly increased my prestige amongst Zamorak and his followers.
translation: 모두에게 만족스러운 거래였지. 나는 Rennard(레너드)에게서 판매 대금의 몫을 받았고, Zamorak(자모락)과 그 추종자들 사이에서 내 위신도 크게 높아졌으니.

english: But maybe... Perhaps the events that followed were responsible for my cursed state...
translation: 하지만 어쩌면... 어쩌면 그 뒤에 일어난 일들 때문에 내가 이렇게 저주받은 건지도 모르겠군...

english: Events that followed?
I can not tell you of them precisely, for I myself was not there to witness them.
translation: 정확히 말해 줄 수는 없네. 나 자신도 그 자리에서 직접 보지는 못했으니까.

english: I am after all, simply a messenger. When... 'it' happened, I was busy elsewhere delivering a message from Zamorak to the rest of his Mahjarrat ilk.
translation: 나는 어디까지나 일개 전령일 뿐이니까. '그 일'이 일어났을 때, 나는 Zamorak(자모락)의 메시지를 다른 Mahjarrat(마하자랏) 무리에게 전하느라 딴 곳에 가 있었지.

english: When 'it' happened? What was 'it'?
As I have explained, I was not there, and I do not know what Zamorak did with the staff, but whatever it was resulted in his banishment by the other gods for many years.
translation: 말했듯이 나는 그 자리에 없었고, Zamorak(자모락)이 그 지팡이로 무엇을 했는지는 모르네. 하지만 그게 무엇이었든, 그 때문에 그분은 다른 신들에게 여러 해 동안 추방당했지.

english: The very strange thing was that Saradomin must have known about it, whatever it was, before it even happened...
translation: 정말 이상한 건, Saradomin(사라도민)이 그게 뭐였든 그 일이 일어나기도 전에 이미 알고 있었던 게 틀림없다는 걸세...

english: Really? Why do you say that?
Well, it was the contents of the message I was returning to Zamorak;
translation: 음, 그건 내가 Zamorak(자모락)에게 가져가던 메시지의 내용 때문일세.

english: Lucien seemed quite certain that there was a spy for Saradomin somewhere amongst his followers named Lennissa.
translation: Lucien(루시엔)은 추종자들 사이 어딘가에 Lennissa(레니사)라는 Saradomin(사라도민)의 첩자가 있다고 꽤 확신하는 듯했네.

english: If whatever happened to the staff caused this curse to befall me, then it is certain that she too would have been afflicted, because she would have been in the very heart of the action.
translation: 그 지팡이에 일어난 일 때문에 내게 이 저주가 내린 거라면, 그 여자도 분명 저주를 받았을 걸세. 그 여자는 사건의 한복판에 있었을 테니까.

english: Hmmm....
You have given me much to think on adventurer. I would like to reward you with my sturdy messenger boots, may they aid you in your travels.
translation: 자네 덕분에 생각할 거리가 많아졌네, 모험가. 내 튼튼한 전령 장화를 보답으로 주고 싶군. 자네 여행에 도움이 되길 바라네.

english: But where can I find this Lennissa?
translation: 그런데 그 Lennissa(레니사)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Ah yes, the whereabouts of the treacherous Lennissa...
translation: 아, 그렇지. 배신자 Lennissa(레니사)의 행방 말이군...

english: Well, we knew little about her or she would have been caught and exposed as a traitor and a spy, but Lucien did mention that he had evidence that she was a great fan of ball games...
translation: 글쎄, 우리가 그 여자에 대해 아는 게 많았다면 진작 배신자이자 첩자로 붙잡혀 정체가 드러났겠지. 그래도 Lucien(루시엔)이 그 여자가 공놀이를 무척 좋아했다는 증거가 있다고 했었네...

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
translation: 좋아요, 그럼 제가 그 사람을 찾아볼게요.

english: Well, she was always sickeningly obedient to Saradomin, so I would expect her to have run to some great place of worship of him if she was affected by the curse to try and gain his blessing.
translation: 음, 그 여자는 언제나 역겨울 만큼 Saradomin(사라도민)에게 충직했으니, 저주를 받았다면 그분의 축복을 얻으려고 그분을 섬기는 큰 성소로 달려갔을 걸세.

english: According to Lucien's intelligence report, she had been uncovered as a spy by her constant use of ships to ferry information...
translation: Lucien(루시엔)의 첩보 보고서에 따르면, 그 여자는 정보를 실어 나르려고 배를 계속 이용하다가 첩자라는 게 들통났다더군...

english: It is entirely possible she would be located somewhere coastal to this day!
translation: 지금까지도 어느 해안가에 있을 가능성이 충분하네!

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데 별로 관심은 없네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hello again Kharrim.
Can you remind me where to find Lennissa?
translation: Lennissa(레니사)를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 전에 주신 ghostly robes(유령 로브)를 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 나를 이곳에 붙잡아 둔 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양일세... 어느 것을 원하나?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Lennissa.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: ghostly robes(유령 로브)를 더 달라고 한다.

english: Hello again. Do you need anything?
I'm good, thanks.
Well in that case, all the best.
Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!
translation: 망할 broav(브로아브) 녀석들! 이제 처음부터 다시 해야 하잖아!

english: Er... Hello?
Oh, sorry, I didn't see you come in.
translation: 아, 미안해요. 들어오시는 걸 못 봤어요.

english: Is something wrong?
Just the usual sort of nonsense you get around here. One of the guards bought some broavs for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by my laundry and making a mess of it!
translation: 이 동네에서 늘 있는 그런 말도 안 되는 일이죠. 경비병 하나가 추적용으로 broav(브로아브)를 몇 마리 사 왔는데, 이 녀석들이 자꾸 제 빨래에 정신이 팔려서 다 엉망으로 만들어 놓는다니까요!

english: Right... Anyway, you don't happen to know someone called Darve do you? Or maybe someone called Movario?
translation: 그렇군요... 그건 그렇고, 혹시 Darve(다브)라는 사람 알아요? 아니면 Movario(모바리오)라는 사람은요?

english: Movario? Oh yes I... Well, actually, I shouldn't really divulge client details. Times are tough enough as it is without me losing customers through gossiping!
translation: Movario(모바리오)요? 아, 네, 제가... 아니, 사실 손님 정보를 함부로 말하면 안 돼요. 안 그래도 먹고살기 힘든데, 수다 떨다가 손님까지 잃으면 큰일이거든요!

english: Would 500 coins change your mind?
Oh... well I suppose so.
Okay, I'll be back shortly with the money.
Now, what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 자, Movario(모바리오)에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.
translation: 음, 꽤 자주 오는 단골이에요. 사실 지금도 그 사람 옷이 여기 좀 있어요.

english: So does he live somewhere nearby?
I assume so, but I don't know where.
Hmm... I need some way of tracking him down...
translation: 흠... 그 사람을 추적할 방법이 필요한데...

english: Hang on... What was it you were saying earlier about those broavs?
translation: 잠깐만요... 아까 그 broav(브로아브)에 대해 뭐라고 하셨죠?

english: Broavs? Well one of the guards bought some for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by the laundry.
translation: broav(브로아브)요? 경비병 하나가 추적용으로 몇 마리 사 왔는데, 자꾸 빨래에 정신이 팔린다고요.

english: You don't think I'd be able to use one to track Movario, do you?
translation: 그걸 한 마리 써서 Movario(모바리오)를 추적할 수는 없을까요?

english: I guess so, but they track using smell, so you'd need something that smells like him.
translation: 될 것 같긴 한데, 녀석들은 냄새로 추적하니까 그 사람 냄새가 나는 게 필요할 거예요.

english: Like his dirty laundry, perhaps?
translation: 그 사람 더러운 빨랫감 같은 거요?

english: Oh, I see... I really shouldn't be giving out clothes belonging to customers.
translation: 아, 그런 거군요... 손님 옷을 함부로 내주면 정말 안 되는데.

english: Surely you have something he won't miss.
translation: 없어져도 모를 만한 게 분명 있을 거잖아요.

english: Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
translation: 음... 안 그래도 그 사람 셔츠 하나는 세탁하다가 못 버틸 것 같았거든요. 가져가셔도 되지만, Movario(모바리오)한테 절대 들키면 안 돼요!

english: Thanks. So how would I go about getting myself one of those broavs?
translation: 고마워요. 그럼 그 broav(브로아브)는 어떻게 하면 구할 수 있어요?

english: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.
translation: Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕)에서 왔다고 들었어요. 거기에 잡는 법을 아는 hunting expert(사냥 전문가)가 있다나 봐요.

english: Perfect! Thanks for all the help.
Okay, fair enough.
You can trust me.
Oh... yes, I suppose I can.
translation: 아... 네, 그래도 될 것 같네요.

english: Great! So what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 좋아요! 그럼 Movario(모바리오)에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Hello again. Could you remind me where I can get one of those broavs?
translation: 또 왔어요. broav(브로아브)를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: Perfect! Thanks for the help.
Would 500 coins change your mind?
Okay, fair enough.
[Charm] You can trust me.
What? How did you manage to get in here.
I've come for the orb.
I'll never let you take it.
Oi! You! Get out of there.
Get off me, ya little pest!
Argh, get the gnome!
You'll regret that!
Hello, how are you?
Don't speak to me you insignificant wretch! Die in the name of Khazard!
translation: 감히 내게 말을 걸지 마라, 하찮은 놈! Khazard(카자드)의 이름으로 죽어라!

english: Hello there.
You think you're so clever. You know nothing!
translation: 네가 꽤 똑똑한 줄 아나 보지. 넌 아무것도 몰라!

english: What?
I'll crush you and those pesky little green men!
translation: 너도, 그 성가신 초록 꼬맹이들도 다 짓밟아 주마!

english: You there, stop!
Go back to your pesky little green friends.
I've come for the orbs.
You're out of your depth traveller. These orbs are part of a much larger picture.
translation: 네 분수를 넘는 일이다, 여행자. 이 오브들은 훨씬 더 큰 그림의 일부지.

english: They're stolen goods, now give them here!
Ha, you really think you stand a chance? I'll crush you.
translation: 하, 정말 네가 이길 수 있을 것 같나? 짓밟아 주마.

english: I thought I killed you?
Fool, warriors blessed by Khazard don't die. You can't kill that which is already dead. However I can kill you!
translation: 어리석은 놈. Khazard(카자드)의 축복을 받은 전사는 죽지 않는다. 이미 죽은 자는 죽일 수 없지. 하지만 난 널 죽일 수 있다!

english: Hello there.
Ooooh, heeellooo! Anyshing a bright dwarf like me can help you with?
translation: 우우우, 안녀어엉! 나처럼 똑똑한 드워프가 뭐 도와줄 거라도 있쓰까?

english: The only thing you can help me with is finding the nearest place to get a drink, I think...
translation: 도와줄 수 있는 건 기껏해야 제일 가까운 술 마실 곳을 찾는 것뿐인 것 같은데요...

english: That ish shimple! Help yourshelf to the dwarvern shtout! I mean dwarfen! I mean...
translation: 그거야 쒸운 일이쥐! 저기 dwarvern shtout(드워븐 쓰타우트) 마음껏 마셔! 아니, 드워픈! 아니 그러니까...

english: I'm not shure what I mean.
I'm looking for schematics to modify the dwarven multicannon to fire a human. Can you help?
translation: 인간을 발사할 수 있게 dwarven multicannon(드워프 멀티캐논)을 개조할 schematic(설계도)를 찾고 있어요. 도와줄 수 있어요?

english: Haha, yesh, I have jusht the shing!
translation: 하하, 그래애, 딱 맞는 게 있쥐!

english: I've been working on thish deshign for quite a while now!
translation: 이 설께를 꽤 오래 붙잡고 있었거든!

english: Never got to test it, love to shee it shoot a real human!
translation: 시험은 한 번도 못 해 봤쥐. 진짜 인간을 쏘는 걸 꼭 보고 싶다고!

english: Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.
translation: 음, 그거 저한테 줄 수 있어요? 실험은 제가 해 볼 의향이 있어요.

english: Oooh, shure, shure... I've only got one part left, though, I gave all the other parts away.
translation: 오오, 물론이쥐, 물론... 근데 한 조각밖에 안 남았어. 나머진 다 남한테 줘 버렸거든.

english: Who did you give them to?
How should I know? I'm only a shimple dwarf.
translation: 내가 어떠케 알아? 난 그냥 단쑨한 드워프일 뿐인데.

english: Okay, okay, can I have that one schematic then?
translation: 알았어요, 알았다고요. 그럼 그 schematic(설계도) 한 장이라도 줄래요?

english: Of courshe!
Just give me a drink and I'll gladly help you.
translation: 술 한 잔만 갖다 주면 기꺼이 도와주쥐.

english: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!
translation: 싫어요, 남들한테 술 사다 주는 건 이제 지긋지긋해요!

english: It's always like this... Sure, I'll help you [player name], just as soon as you get me a drink!
translation: 맨날 이런 식이죠... "그래, 도와줄게, [player name]. 나한테 술 한 잔만 갖다 주면 바로!"

english: And more often than not they actually want a very special kind of drink that can only be gotten in the next town, or beyond.
translation: 게다가 십중팔구는 옆 마을이나 그보다 더 먼 곳에서만 구할 수 있는 아주 특별한 술을 원한다니까요.

english: And what is wrong with all you people anyway? Sometimes it seems as if half the population of Gielinor are alcoholics!
translation: 그리고 대체 다들 왜 그래요? 가끔은 Gielinor(길리노르) 인구 절반이 술꾼인 것 같다고요!

english: So, no, I won't do it anymore, you can get your own drink for once, and I'm just going to stay right here until you've done so!
translation: 그러니까 싫어요, 이제 안 해요. 이번만큼은 직접 술을 가져오세요. 그럴 때까지 전 여기서 꼼짝도 안 할 거예요!

english: Pffft, I only wanted a dwarven shtout from that table over there.
translation: 쳇, 난 그냥 저기 탁자에 있는 dwarven shtout(드워프 쓰타우트) 한 잔 원했을 뿐인데.

english: Here, have the shtupid schematic, I've gone right off my drink now.
translation: 옜다, 이 멍청한 schematic(설계도) 가져가. 술맛이 싹 달아났네.

english: Thanks for that schematic.
Sho have you been shot out of a cannon yet?
No, fortunately not.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
What? eh? Did you say something?
Who's there? Hello?
mmmmghmhhmh
Hello?
Who are you?
It doesn't look like this monkey can hear you.
translation: 이 원숭이는 당신 말을 듣지 못하는 것 같다.

english: Is there somebody there?
It doesn't look like this monkey can see you.
translation: 이 원숭이는 당신을 보지 못하는 것 같다.

english: mmmmghhh mhhhh
It doesn't look like this monkey can... you get the idea...
translation: 이 원숭이는... 대충 무슨 말인지 알 것이다...

english: There's something familiar about you guys...
I'm Mizaru - This is Iwazaru
mmhggmmmhh
He says hello, and this is Kikazaru
Oi, you, pay attention!
Mizaru gives Kikazaru a slap.
What? Oh, Hello who are you? I'm Kikazaru.
translation: 뭐? 아, 안녕, 넌 누구야? 난 Kikazaru(키카자루)야.

english: I've already said that.
What? Oh, This is Mizaru and Kikazaru.
Mizaru turns and stares at Kikazaru.
I'VE ALREADY SAID THAT.
Not very bright that one.
ggmmhhmm
Iwazaru waves his hands around at Kikazaru in a way that might be monkey sign language.
translation: Iwazaru(이와자루)가 Kikazaru(키카자루)에게 원숭이 수화인 듯한 손짓을 해 댄다.

english: (sarcastically) Yeah, while you're the clever monkey around here aren't you?
(Iwazaru waves his arms again. Whatever he said it wasn't very polite.)
translation: (Iwazaru(이와자루)가 다시 팔을 휘젓는다. 무슨 말인지는 몰라도 그리 공손한 말은 아니었다.)

english: Hee Hee Hee, you're so rude.
Grrr. Do you have any other questions?
That's all for the moment.
So What exactly are you doing here?
translation: 그래서 여기서 정확히 뭘 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Oh just monkeying around.
translation: 아, 그냥 원숭이 짓이나 하고 있지 뭐.

english: (Iwazaru slaps his forehead)
You look trustworthy, I'll tell you a secret.
translation: 너 믿을 만해 보이니까 비밀 하나 알려 줄게.

english: (whispers) We're on a top secret mission, given to us by the King...
translation: (속삭이며) 우린 왕께서 직접 내리신 일급 비밀 임무를 수행 중이야...

english: We are the exalted Guardians of one of the King's biggest secrets.
translation: 우리는 왕의 가장 큰 비밀 중 하나를 지키는 고귀한 수호자들이지.

english: Can't say any more than that or the King would go Ape on us.
translation: 더는 말 못 해. 그랬다간 왕께서 성난 유인원처럼 길길이 날뛰실걸.

english: Oh go on...
No. We will protect the recipe with our lives...
translation: 안 돼. 우린 목숨을 걸고 요리법을 지킬 거야...

english: grrmmh fffhmmm (Iwazaru looks disgruntled)
Yeah, I agree with Iwazaru. The king CURSED us!
translation: 맞아, 나도 Iwazaru(이와자루) 말에 동의해. 왕이 우리한테 저주를 걸었다고!

english: How did he curse you?
hmhmhhhh mmgghh
I know, I know, I'll tell him
NO!, I forbid you to tell this stranger anything!
translation: 안 돼! 이 낯선 놈한테 아무것도 말하지 마!

english: I can't hear you...
Yeah, well hear this gnome-brain! (He slaps Kikazaru)
translation: 그래, 그럼 이건 들리냐, 이 노움 대가리야! (그가 Kikazaru(키카자루)를 찰싹 때린다)

english: Ow! There was this recipe right.
translation: 아야! 그러니까 요리법이 하나 있었는데 말이야.

english: Stop it!
Mizaru slaps Iwazaru. Iwazaru slaps Mizaru back. They start to fight.
translation: Mizaru(미자루)가 Iwazaru(이와자루)를 때린다. 이와자루도 미자루를 맞받아 때린다. 둘이 싸우기 시작한다.

english: (Oof!) He liked it so much he married the cook! YEAH? Have some of this! (poke!)
translation: (윽!) 왕이 그 요리를 너무 좋아해서 요리사랑 결혼까지 했다니까! 그래? 이거나 먹어라! (콕!)

english: AARGH not in the eye! (kick)
(Oof!) The King thought it was magic and AAAIEEE! He got a priest to curse us to keep quiet. (headbutt!)
translation: (윽!) 왕은 그게 마법이라고 생각해서, 으아아악! 사제를 시켜서 우리가 입을 다물도록 저주를 걸었어. (박치기!)

english: Mizaru slumps to the floor and rolls about in pain.
translation: Mizaru(미자루)가 바닥에 쓰러져 아파하며 데굴데굴 구른다.

english: Ha! Serves you right! Anyway, The priest only had enough ingredients for one curse, so when he tried to keep us all from telling anyone the recipe, each of us only got part of the curse. That's why I can't hear anything now.
translation: 하! 꼴좋다! 아무튼, 사제한테는 저주 하나 걸 재료밖에 없었는데, 우리 셋 모두 아무한테도 요리법을 말하지 못하게 하려다 보니 저주가 조금씩 나뉘어 걸린 거야. 그래서 내가 지금 아무것도 못 듣는 거고.

english: mmmmghhh (he nods his head)
How do you know about that - It's top secret information you know.
translation: 그걸 어떻게 알았어? 그거 일급 비밀 정보라고.

english: Well, I am also on a top secret mission.
translation: 사실 저도 일급 비밀 임무를 수행 중이거든요.

english: Ah I see, can you tell me what the mission is?
translation: 아, 그렇구나. 무슨 임무인지 말해 줄 수 있어?

english: Well, it's on a strict need to know basis. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 음, 꼭 알아야 하는 자에게만 알려 주는 극비라서요. 이해하시죠?

english: Of course, of course.
However, I think I can trust you with sensitive material.
translation: 그래도 당신이라면 민감한 정보를 맡겨도 될 것 같네요.

english: (Iwazaru raises an eyebrow dubiously. You give him a wink.)
translation: (Iwazaru(이와자루)가 미심쩍다는 듯 한쪽 눈썹을 치켜올린다. 당신은 그에게 윙크를 보낸다.)

english: (You whisper in Mizaru's ear) I've been charged with organising a secret party to celebrate the king's birthday, keep it quiet though, don't let a single monkey know.
translation: (Mizaru(미자루)의 귀에 속삭인다) 왕의 생신을 축하하는 비밀 파티를 준비하라는 임무를 맡았어요. 그러니 비밀로 해 주세요. 원숭이 한 마리한테도 알리면 안 돼요.

english: Well, in that case, you definitely do need to know the recipe.
The king has a real soft spot for Roasted Giant Snake stuffed with sliced banana and monkey nut paste.
translation: 왕께서는 sliced banana(썬 바나나)랑 monkey nut paste(원숭이 땅콩 반죽)으로 속을 채운 Roasted Giant Snake(거대 뱀 구이)를 정말 좋아하시거든.

english: GGHHMM! (Iwazaru starts jumping up and down)
Yup, you need to find some bananas, and some monkey nuts and stuff a Giant snake with them. It's as simple as that. Stop hassling me Iwazaru.
translation: 응, bananas(바나나)랑 monkey nuts(원숭이 땅콩)을 좀 구해서 Giant snake(거대 뱀) 속에 채우면 돼. 그렇게 간단해. 귀찮게 좀 하지 마, Iwazaru(이와자루).

english: Where do I find this stuff then?
Every monkey knows where to get hold of nuts and bananas, but I believe that the snakes live on a nearby island. Never seen one myself.
translation: 땅콩이랑 바나나 구하는 곳이야 원숭이라면 다 알지. 근데 뱀은 근처 섬에 산다고 알고 있어. 나도 직접 본 적은 없지만.

english: This feels like the banana, this should do the job.
translation: 만져 보니 바나나가 맞네. 이거면 되겠어.

english: (Iwazaru Jumps up and down waving his arms and legs about wildly)
translation: (Iwazaru(이와자루)가 팔다리를 미친 듯이 휘저으며 펄쩍펄쩍 뛴다)

english: Quiet! Iwazaru.
(Iwazaru grabs you by the arm)
(He shakes his head vigourously)
I think your friend wants to tell me something.
translation: 친구분이 저한테 뭔가 말하고 싶은 것 같은데요.

english: Oh ignore him, he's clueless.
translation: 아, 신경 쓰지 마. 쟤는 아무것도 몰라.

english: GGGRRRMMHHGG!!
(Iwazaru makes what you suspect was a very rude gesture to Mizaru)
translation: (Iwazaru(이와자루)가 Mizaru(미자루)에게 아무래도 아주 무례한 손짓을 한 것 같다)

english: (Iwazaru starts gesturing at Kikazaru)
hmmm...
(Iwazaru gestures some more)
Really?
(Iwazaru waves his arms about yet more)
Oh that's very interesting.
Well....
(Iwazaru sighs. And points to you.)
What, eh, oh right.
Iwazaru says you have the wrong type of banana.
translation: Iwazaru(이와자루)가 그러는데 네가 바나나를 잘못 가져왔대.

english: You need a red one.
(sigh), I should have guessed that it wouldn't be that easy. A red banana. Don't all bananas taste the same?
translation: (한숨) 그렇게 쉬울 리가 없다는 걸 짐작했어야 했는데. red banana(빨간 바나나)라니. 바나나는 다 맛이 똑같지 않아요?

english: (Iwazaru looks shocked)
(Mizaru looks astounded)
(Kikazaru looks blankly over your shoulder)
How can a monkey say such a thing!
translation: 원숭이가 어떻게 그런 말을 할 수 있어!

english: Oh, you mean RED bananas, yes, of course, I've heard that they are the tastiest. Much tastier than blue bananas. How could I forget. Bah, only a fake monkey wouldn't know that. Ahem.
translation: 아, '빨간' 바나나 말이군요. 네, 당연하죠. 그게 제일 맛있다고 들었어요. 파란 바나나보다 훨씬 맛있다고요. 어떻게 그걸 잊었담. 쳇, 가짜 원숭이나 그걸 모르겠죠. 에헴.

english: Blue bananas? There's no such thing. Hey, wait a second where did you say you come from?
translation: 파란 바나나? 그런 건 없는데. 잠깐, 너 어디서 왔다고 했지?

english: Errm I'm not from round here, anyway, moving quickly on, is there a red banana tree nearby?
translation: 어음, 전 이 근처 출신이 아니라서요. 아무튼, 그 얘긴 넘어가고, 이 근처에 red banana tree(빨간 바나나 나무)가 있나요?

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points West)
Iwazaru says that there is a tree in the West of the Island.
translation: Iwazaru(이와자루) 말로는 섬 서쪽에 나무가 있대.

english: Right! I'd better start looking for a red banana tree.
translation: 좋아요! 얼른 red banana tree(빨간 바나나 나무)를 찾으러 가야겠네요.

english: Ah, monkey nuts. Good work
(Iwazaru is hysterically trying to get your attention)
translation: (Iwazaru(이와자루)가 당신의 관심을 끌려고 미친 듯이 애쓴다)

english: Stop playing around Iwazaru.
(Iwazaru shakes his head vigourously)
I think Iwazaru is trying to say something.
Oh ignore him.
mmmh!! (He quickly makes some signs at Kikazaru)
Ah, I see...
Iwazaru says that you have the wrong kind of monkey nuts. Ordinary Monkeys nuts just won't do.
translation: Iwazaru(이와자루)가 그러는데 monkey nuts(원숭이 땅콩) 종류가 틀렸대. 평범한 원숭이 땅콩으로는 안 된대.

english: There is a special type of monkey nut that grows on the island and has a subtle and distinctive flavour that is highly valued by all monkeys with a sophisticated palate.
translation: 이 섬에는 특별한 종류의 원숭이 땅콩이 자라는데, 은은하고 독특한 풍미가 있어서 입맛 까다로운 원숭이라면 누구나 귀하게 여긴대.

english: They are called Tchiki monkey nuts and require a very particular combination of soil and climate.
translation: 그건 Tchiki monkey nuts(치키 원숭이 땅콩)라고 하는데, 흙과 기후가 아주 특별하게 맞아떨어져야 자란대.

english: They need the minerals and dampness found in hill caves, but also cannot grow without sunlight.
translation: 언덕 동굴의 광물과 습기가 필요하지만, 햇빛 없이는 자랄 수도 없대.

english: Myth and Legend shrouds the History of the Tchiki Monkey Nut.
translation: Tchiki Monkey Nut(치키 원숭이 땅콩)의 역사는 신화와 전설에 싸여 있어.

english: Some say that it is the nut that gave monkeys their superior intelligence!
translation: 어떤 이들은 원숭이에게 뛰어난 지능을 준 게 바로 그 땅콩이라고 하지!

english: Others say Tchiki Monkey nuts are the food of the Monkey Gods.
translation: 또 어떤 이들은 Tchiki Monkey nuts(치키 원숭이 땅콩)이 원숭이 신들의 음식이라고 해.

english: Either way, you will have to find a path through treacherous undergrowth to harvest the Nut of Kings.
translation: 어느 쪽이든, '왕의 땅콩'을 수확하려면 험난한 덤불숲을 헤치고 길을 찾아야 할 거야.

english: ... He said all that?
Yup
I never realised monkey sign language was so... concise. Anywhere, where do I find this plant then?
translation: 원숭이 수화가 이렇게... 간결한 줄은 몰랐네요. 아무튼, 그 식물은 어디서 찾아요?

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points South)
Look to the hills, south of here.
Right! I'd better start looking for this Tchiki Monkey Nut Bush then...
translation: 좋아요! 그럼 얼른 Tchiki Monkey Nut Bush(치키 원숭이 땅콩 덤불)을 찾으러 가야겠네요...

english: So What exactly are you doing here?
translation: 그래서 여기서 정확히 뭘 하고 있는 거예요?

english: Do you know anything about Awowogei's favourite dish?
translation: Awowogei(아워워게이)가 가장 좋아하는 요리에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: What's... wrong with you?
That's all for the moment.
What are you doing here?
Do you know anything about the King's favourite dish?
translation: 왕이 가장 좋아하는 요리에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: Woo, party on bro!
The killer approaches Sid behind his back.
Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
translation: 우와, 방금 바람이 꼭 누가 내 목에 숨을 내쉬는 것 같았어!

english: The killer stabs Sid.
Whoah, not cool bro...
...urgh...
...I'm feeling woozy...
...gargh...
...I see the light...
...urrggghhh...
...it's not my time...glurgh
...gargle...urgh...
Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
translation: Sid(시드)가 비틀거리며 앞으로 고꾸라져 물통에 빠져 허우적댄다.

english: ...glargh...help...me...
...urgh...hergle...
...flergh.
Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.
translation: Sid(시드)가 구겨지듯 바닥에 털썩 쓰러진다. 그가 쓰러질 때 셔츠 주머니에서 반짝이는 무언가가 떨어져 물통 속으로 들어가는 것이 보인다.

english: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
translation: 세상에, 끔찍한 데다 정말 오래도 끄네!

english: Oh wow, he's still going...
I think he is actually dead this time.
Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
translation: 넌 누구야? 왜 이런 짓을 하는 거야!?

english: The killer walks away.
Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
translation: 젠장! 저 집에 들어갈 방법을 찾아서 이 미치광이를 막아야 해!

english: I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?
translation: 아까 저 통에 떨어진 건 뭐였을까?

english: The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: 살인마가 벽장에서 나타나 책을 읽고 있던 Tayten(테이튼)을 찌른다.

english: Gurgle...
Nooooo!
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: 살인마가 문 밑으로 쪽지를 밀어 넣고 벽장을 통해 달아난다.

english: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
Please, stop this, just let me go!
We're going to play a game. Do you like to play games?
translation: 우린 게임을 할 거야. 게임 좋아하나?

english: No...yes....whatever you say, just don't hurt me!
translation: 아니... 네.... 뭐든 시키는 대로 할게요, 제발 해치지만 말아요!

english: Whether you get hurt or not is entirely up to you. Your fate is in your own hands.
translation: 네가 다칠지 말지는 전적으로 너한테 달렸어. 네 운명은 네 손에 달려 있지.

english: What!? What do you mean!?
Leave her alone you monster!
Ah, [player name], how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: 아, [player name]. 이렇게 함께해 주다니 친절하기도 하지. 한 마디만 더 하면 이 여자를 당장 끝장내 주마!

english: Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, of course! The game!
translation: 미안, 어디까지 했더라? 아, 그렇지! 게임이었지!

english: Do you like quests, Lacey?
Ummm, sure, I like quests.
Do you like scary quests?
Uh-huh.
What's your favourite scary quest?
I don't know.
You have to have a favourite.
Umm.....the one with that vampyre in it who lives in a big house.
translation: 으음.....큰 저택에 사는 뱀파이어가 나오는 거요.

english: Good, good. And now for that game I spoke about.
translation: 좋아, 좋아. 그럼 아까 말한 게임을 시작하지.

english: I am going to ask you one question. Get it wrong and you die, but get it right and you live.
translation: 질문을 하나 하겠다. 틀리면 죽고, 맞히면 산다.

english: Oh Guthix please no, please don't, I don't want to die!
translation: 오 Guthix(구식스)시여, 제발, 제발 그러지 마요, 죽고 싶지 않아요!

english: Then think hard about your answer. You like vampyres so this should be easy for you. The question is this...
translation: 그럼 잘 생각해서 대답해. 뱀파이어를 좋아한다니 쉬울 거야. 질문은 이거다...

english: Who is the Vampyre that resides in South Misthalin?
translation: South Misthalin(남부 미스탈린)에 사는 Vampyre(뱀파이어)는 누구지?

english: Urm...
Count Draynor!
Count Check!
Lord Drakan!
This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
translation: 이 게임은 너랑 상관없었어, [player name]! 이제 이 여자의 죽음은 네 탓이다! 그 피는 네 손에 묻은 거야, 이 멍청한 놈아!

english: The killer stabs Lacey.
Gargle...urgh...
Oh yes, yes, I know it! Count Draynor!
translation: 아, 알아요, 알아요! Count Draynor(드레이너 백작)!

english: Ha, in your face you masked freak!
translation: 하, 꼴좋다, 이 가면 쓴 미친놈아!

english: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.
translation: 오, Lacey(레이시), 레이시, 레이시. 대답을 잘 생각하라고 했잖아.

english: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.
translation: Count Draynor(드레이너 백작)은 분명 뱀파이어고, Misthalin(미스탈린)에 있는 저택에 살고 있지.

english: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!
translation: 하지만 그 저택은 '서부' 미스탈린에 있어! 난 Count Check(체크 백작) 얘기를 한 거라고! 참가해 줘서 고마워!

english: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
translation: 아니, 아니, 속였잖아요! 이건 불공평해요, 다른 문제를 내 줘요...

english: Lacey dies.
The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.
translation: 살인마가 울타리 틈으로 쪽지를 밀어 넣고 걸어서 사라진다.

english: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.
translation: 저 괴물! 반드시 막아야 해! 새 쪽지에 뭐라고 적혀 있는지 보자.

english: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: 왜 맨날 나만 다른 사람들 뒤치다꺼리를 해야 하는 거야?

english: Hello? Anyone there?
Hello? Lacey? Sid?
Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: 흠, 가서 확인해 봐야겠다. 이렇게 잠긴 아늑한 방에 가만히 있을 필요가 뭐 있어, 으스스한 바깥 어둠 속으로 나갈 수 있는데.

english: Seriously!?
The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: 벽과 문이 너무 두꺼워서 Mandy(맨디)에게는 당신의 목소리가 들리지 않는 것 같다.

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: 아, 그리고 나를 지키려고 이 크고 번쩍이는 무기까지 챙겨 갈 필요는 없겠지. 어두운 밤에 집 밖으로 소리를 확인하러 나간 사람한테 나쁜 일이 생기는 법은 없으니까!

english: You have got to be kidding...
Ok, well, here I go!
Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
Hello, anyone out here?
Mandy looks around.
See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: 거봐, 아무 일도 없을 줄 알았어! 그냥 다람쥐 같은 게 뛰어다녔나 봐.

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
Oh well, back to the dishes.
Phew, that was lucky!
The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: 살인마가 출구 근처 벽장에서 나와 Mandy(맨디)를 찌른다.

english: No...why...me...
Mandy dies.
That psycho! He was just toying with her!
translation: 저 사이코! 처음부터 그냥 갖고 논 거잖아!

english: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: 또 쪽지군. 이 녀석, 게임을 어지간히 좋아하는 모양인데, 이번 게임만큼은 절대 못 이길 거다!

english: Show yourself you coward!
So we meet at last. I have to say, I'm impressed you worked out my riddles.
translation: 드디어 만났군. 내 수수께끼를 다 풀다니, 솔직히 감탄했어.

english: Well maybe you aren't as smart as you think you are.
translation: 글쎄, 넌 네 생각만큼 똑똑하지 않은 모양이지.

english: Oh really? All the dead bodies suggest otherwise. And what did you do to stop them?
translation: 오, 그래? 시체들을 보면 아닌 것 같은데. 그리고 그걸 막으려고 넌 뭘 했지?

english: NOTHING!
People think you are some big hero but you're not. All you adventurers are the same. Nothing but opportunists!
translation: 사람들은 네가 대단한 영웅인 줄 알지만, 넌 아니야. 모험가들은 다 똑같아. 기회주의자일 뿐이지!

english: What are you going on about?
Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.
translation: 거창한 연설을 준비하긴 했는데, 솔직히 너한테는 그걸 늘어놓을 수고를 들일 가치도 없는 것 같군.

english: So, this is the end of the line for you. It is time for the final act. The showdown. The finale. Let's see if you are up to the challenge!
translation: 그러니, 넌 여기서 끝이다. 마지막 막이 오를 시간이야. 결전. 피날레. 네가 감당할 수 있는지 보자고!

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 넌 네 게임에서 졌어. 이제 그 가면 아래 누가 있는지 볼 시간이다!

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 당신이 살인마의 가면을 벗기자, 범인이 Abigale(애비게일)이었음이 드러난다.

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 안 돼! 너였어!? 대체 왜!? 왜 친구들을 다 죽인 거야!? 왜 그들을 도와 달라고 나한테 애원한 거야!?

english: You just don't get it do you?
So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 잘난 척은. 모든 게 너 중심으로 돌아가는 데 너무 익숙하지. 네가 세상을 구하는 데 말이야.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
What do you mean?
Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 모험가들! 너희는 다 똑같아. 모든 게 늘 너희 중심이어야 하지.

english: I don't understand?
Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 당연히 모르겠지! 넌 너 자신밖에 못 보니까!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 믿기 어렵겠지만... 나도 예전엔 너 같았어.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 곤경에 빠진 아가씨 소식을 들으면 도우러 달려갔지. 나만의 순간을 맞으려고. 딱 한 번이라도 내가 영웅이 되려고.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 그런데 너! 너랑 다른 빌어먹을 모험가들 전부! 내가 도우러 갈 때마다 늘 한발 늦었지. 위기는 해결됐고. 재앙은 막아졌고. 보상은 이미 누가 챙겼고. 매번 너랑 다른 모험가들이 내 순간을 훔쳐 갔어!

english: But not this time!
This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 이번엔 모든 게 나를 위한 거야! 내가 이 쇼의 주인공이라고! 나! 나! 나! 나! 나!

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 그것도 이제 끝이야. 쇼는 끝났고, 커튼콜도 없을 거다.

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 문 근처 벽장에서 또 다른 살인마가 나온다.

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 당연하지. 좋은 쇼에는 좋은 조연이 필요한 법이거든. 자, 가면을 벗어, 자기야. 인사해. 그럴 자격이 있잖아.

english: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 살인마가 스스로 가면을 벗자, 범인이 Hewey(휴이)였음이 드러난다.

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 너였어!? 하지만 어떻게!? 내가 봤을 땐 거의 죽어 가고 있었잖아! 상처도 봤다고!

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 아니, 네가 본 건 우리가 보여 주고 싶었던 것뿐이야. 내 입으로 말하긴 뭣하지만 정말 훌륭한 연기였지.

english: But what is in this for you?
Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 누구나 각광받고 싶어 하잖아. 그리고 그걸 함께 나눌 사람으로 사랑하는 Abigale(애비게일)보다 나은 사람이 어디 있겠어.

english: But your friends?
They didn't deserve to die!
Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 그럴지도. 하지만 나도 스포트라이트를 받아야 마땅한데 다시 그늘로 밀려날 이유는 없었어!

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
And now I have my starring role!
OUR starring role.
Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)는 오늘 밤과 내가 여기서 한 일을 영원히 기억할 거야.

english: No, what WE have done!
Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 조용히 해, Hewey(휴이)! 지금은 내 순간이라고!

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 아니, 이건 우리의 순간이어야 해! 전부 너만을 위한 것도 아니라고! 우린 함께였잖아!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 망치지 마, Hewey(휴이)! 이걸 위해 얼마나 애썼는데, 네가 빼앗아 가게 두지 않을 거야!

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 나도 밀려날 생각은 없어. 우린 동등한 입장으로 이 일을 했잖아!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 우린 한 번도 동등했던 적 없어! 네가 감히 나랑 비교가 돼!?

english: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.
No...my love...
Hewey dies.
No....no...what have I done!?
It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 이렇게 될 게 아니었는데...네가 끝내 내 순간을 허락하지 않아서 그래. 왜, Hewey(휴이), 왜!? 사랑했는데...

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
*shuffle*
*rustle*
*scratch*
Count Draynor
Count Check
Lord Drakan
Say nothing
Hello there.
Hello.
How are you?
Busy.
Hello friend.
It was the bewk that told me ta come here.
translation: 그 채액이 날더러 여기 오라 캤지.

english: What book?
Circles within trees it is. And hopping too.
translation: 나무 속의 원이로다. 깡충깡충 뛰기도 하고.

english: Are you ok?
I'll find the light, that will see me through.
translation: 빛을 찾을 거야, 그 빛이 날 이끌어 줄 테니.

english: Oookay then, I'll just go explore then.
translation: 아아알겠어요, 그럼 전 그냥 둘러보러 갈게요.

english: Jelly shards in the dark.
I'm lost!
I'm lost too!
Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur of the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: 내 궁정에 온 것을 환영하오. 나는 Knights of the Round Table(원탁의 기사단)의 King Arthur(아서 왕)이오.

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: Knight of the Round Table(원탁의 기사)가 되고 싶습니다!
