english: Really? Well then you will need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy. My knights all appreciate a good quest.
translation: 그런가? 그렇다면 자격을 증명할 퀘스트에 나서야 하오. 내 기사들은 모두 훌륭한 퀘스트를 높이 평가하지.

english: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin. He recently got himself trapped in some sort of magical crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
translation: 안타깝게도 지금 우리의 퀘스트는 Merlin(멀린)을 구출하는 것이오. 얼마 전 그가 어떤 마법 크리스탈 속에 갇혀 버렸소. 그를 발견한 동굴에서 옮겨 와서 지금은 위층 그의 탑에 있소.

english: I will see what I can do then.
translation: 그럼 제가 할 수 있는 일을 알아보겠습니다.

english: Talk to my knights if you need any help.
translation: 도움이 필요하면 내 기사들과 이야기해 보시오.

english: I may come back and try that later.
Be sure that you come speak to me soon then.
translation: 그렇다면 곧 다시 와서 내게 말을 걸도록 하시오.

english: So what are you doing in Gielinor?
Well legend says we will return to Britain in its time of greatest need. But that's not for quite a while yet.
translation: 음, 전설에 따르면 우리는 Britain(브리튼)이 가장 큰 위기에 처했을 때 돌아간다고 하오. 하지만 그때가 오려면 아직 한참 남았지.

english: So we've moved the whole outfit here for now.
translation: 그래서 당분간은 일행 전체를 이리로 옮겨 왔소.

english: We're passing the time in Gielinor!
Thank you very much.
Now I am a knight of the round table, do you have any more quests for me?
translation: 이제 knight of the round table(원탁의 기사)가 되었으니, 제게 더 맡기실 퀘스트가 있습니까?

english: Aha! I'm glad you are here! I am sending out various knights on an important quest. I was wondering if you too would like to take up this quest?
translation: 아하! 마침 잘 왔소! 지금 여러 기사들을 중요한 퀘스트에 보내고 있는데, 그대도 이 퀘스트를 맡아 주겠소?

english: Tell me of this quest.
Well, we recently found out that the Holy Grail has passed into Gielinor.
translation: 음, 최근에 Holy Grail(성배)가 Gielinor(길리노르)로 넘어왔다는 사실을 알아냈소.

english: This is most fortuitous!
None of my knights ever did return with it last time. Now we have the opportunity to give it another go, maybe this time we will have more luck!
translation: 지난번에는 내 기사 중 누구도 성배를 가지고 돌아오지 못했소. 이제 다시 도전할 기회가 생겼으니, 이번에는 운이 따를지도 모르오!

english: Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 50.
translation: 이 퀘스트를 시작하기 전에, 그대의 전투 레벨이 권장 레벨인 50보다 낮다는 점을 알아 두시오.

english: I'd enjoy trying that.
Go speak to Merlin. He may be able to give a better clue as to where it is now you have freed him from that crystal.
translation: Merlin(멀린)과 이야기해 보시오. 그대가 그를 크리스탈에서 풀어 주었으니, 성배가 지금 어디 있는지 더 나은 단서를 줄 수 있을 것이오.

english: He has set up his workshop in the room next to the library.
I am weary of questing for the time being...
I am weary of questing for the time being...
Maybe later then?
Maybe so.
Welcome, brave knight. I am always happy to see you back at my court. Please feel free to roam the castle and make use of the training grounds.
translation: 어서 오시오, 용감한 기사여. 그대가 내 궁정에 돌아올 때면 언제나 반갑소. 성을 마음껏 둘러보고 훈련장도 자유롭게 이용하시오.

english: I want to become a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: Knight of the Round Table(원탁의 기사)가 되고 싶습니다!

english: Yes.
No.
So what are you doing in Gielinor?
Thank you very much.
Tell me of this quest.
Hello.
Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.
translation: 반갑소, 낯선 이여. 내 이름은 Bolren(볼렌), 나무 노움들의 왕이오.

english: I'm surprised you made it in, maybe I made the maze too easy.
translation: 여기까지 들어오다니 놀랍구려. 미로를 너무 쉽게 만들었나 보오.

english: Maybe.
I'm afraid I have more serious concerns at the moment. Very serious.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 더 심각한 걱정거리가 있소. 아주 심각한 일이오.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Ok, take care.
Can I help at all?
I'm glad you asked.
The truth is my people are in grave danger. We have always been protected by the Spirit Tree. No creature of dark can harm us while its three orbs are in place.
translation: 사실 우리 백성들이 큰 위험에 처해 있소. 우리는 언제나 Spirit Tree(정령 나무)의 보호를 받아 왔소. 세 개의 오브가 제자리에 있는 한 어떤 어둠의 존재도 우리를 해칠 수 없소.

english: We are not a violent race, but we fight when we must. Many gnomes have fallen battling the dark forces of Khazard to the North.
translation: 우리는 호전적인 종족이 아니지만, 싸워야 할 때는 싸우오. 북쪽에서 Khazard(카자드)의 어둠의 세력과 싸우다 수많은 노움들이 쓰러졌소.

english: We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.
translation: 궁지에 몰린 우리는 orb of protection(보호의 오브) 하나를 전장에 가져갔소. 어리석은 짓이었지.

english: Khazard troops seized the orb. Now we are completely defenceless.
translation: Khazard(카자드) 군대가 그 오브를 빼앗아 갔소. 이제 우리는 완전히 무방비 상태요.

english: How can I help?
You would be a huge benefit on the battlefield. If you would go there and try to retrieve the orb, my people and I will be forever grateful.
translation: 그대가 전장에 가 준다면 큰 힘이 될 것이오. 가서 오브를 되찾아 준다면 나와 내 백성들은 영원히 그대에게 감사할 것이오.

english: I would be glad to help.
Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: 고맙소. 전장은 미로 북쪽에 있소. Commander Montai(몬타이 사령관)이 현재 상황을 알려 줄 것이오.

english: That is if he's still alive.
My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb.
translation: 내 조수가 밖까지 안내할 것이오. 행운을 비오, 친구여. 부디 오브를 되찾아 주시오.

english: The player is placed at the entrance of the maze.
We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 이제 미로를 빠져나왔어요. 서둘러 주세요. 우리가 살아남으려면 그 오브가 꼭 있어야 해요.

english: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
Ok then, travel safe.
Hello Bolren.
Hello traveller, we must retrieve the orb. It's being held by Khazard troops north of here.
translation: 반갑소, 여행자여. 우리는 오브를 되찾아야 하오. 오브는 이곳 북쪽의 Khazard(카자드) 군대가 가지고 있소.

english: Ok, I'll try my best.
The orb is being held at the battlefield north of the maze.
translation: 오브는 미로 북쪽 전장에서 적들이 쥐고 있소.

english: Do you have the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 부탁하오. 우리가 살아남으려면 그 오브가 꼭 있어야 하오.

english: I have the orb.
Oh my... The misery, the horror!
translation: 오, 이럴 수가... 이 비참함, 이 참상이란!

english: King Bolren, are you OK?
Thank you traveller, but it's too late. We're all doomed.
translation: 고맙소, 여행자여. 하지만 너무 늦었소. 우리는 모두 끝장이오.

english: What happened?
They came in the night. I don't know how many, but enough.
translation: 그들이 밤에 쳐들어왔소. 몇이나 되는지는 모르겠지만, 충분히 많았소.

english: Who?
Khazard troops. They slaughtered anyone who got in their way. Women, children, my wife.
translation: Khazard(카자드) 군대 말이오. 앞을 가로막는 자는 모조리 학살했소. 여자도, 아이도, 내 아내까지도.

english: I'm sorry.
They took the other orbs, now we are defenceless.
translation: 그들이 나머지 오브들까지 가져갔소. 이제 우리는 무방비 상태요.

english: Where did they take them?
They headed north of the stronghold. A warlord carries the orbs.
translation: 요새 북쪽으로 향했소. 군벌 하나가 오브들을 가지고 있소.

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 제가 그 군벌을 찾아서 오브들을 되찾아 올게요.

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: 그대는 용감하구려. 하지만 이번 일은 그대에게도 버거울 것이오. 행운을 비오. 다시 한번 말하지만, 그대만이 우리의 유일한 희망이오.

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: 나는 이 오브를 지키며 그대가 무사히 돌아오기를 기도하겠소. 내 조수가 밖까지 안내할 것이오.

english: Good luck friend.
I'm sorry but I can't help.
I understand, this isn't your battle.
The orbs are gone, taken north of the battlefield by a Khazard warlord. We're all doomed.
translation: 오브들이 사라졌소. Khazard(카자드)의 군벌이 전장 북쪽으로 가져가 버렸소. 우리는 모두 끝장이오.

english: Bolren, I have returned.
You made it back! Do you have the orbs?
Please, we must have the orbs if we are to survive.
translation: 부탁하오. 우리가 살아남으려면 그 오브들이 꼭 있어야 하오.

english: I have them here.
Hooray, you're amazing. I didn't think it was possible but you've saved us.
translation: 만세, 그대는 정말 대단하구려. 불가능하리라 생각했는데 그대가 우리를 구했소.

english: Once the orbs are replaced we will be safe once more. We must begin the ceremony immediately.
translation: 오브들을 제자리에 돌려놓으면 우리는 다시 안전해질 것이오. 당장 의식을 시작해야 하오.

english: What does the ceremony involve?
The spirit tree has looked over us for centuries. Now we must pay our respects.
translation: spirit tree(정령 나무)는 수 세기 동안 우리를 지켜 주었소. 이제 우리가 경의를 표해야 하오.

english: The orbs appear above the spirit tree, while the local gnomes alternate paying their respects.
translation: 오브들이 정령 나무 위에 떠오르고, 이곳 노움들이 번갈아 가며 경의를 표한다.

english: Su tana.
En tania.
Now at last my people are safe once more. We can live in peace again.
translation: 마침내 내 백성들이 다시 안전해졌소. 이제 다시 평화롭게 살 수 있소.

english: I'm pleased I could help.
You are modest brave traveller.
Please, for your efforts take this amulet. It's made from the same sacred stone as the orbs of protection. It will help keep you safe on your journeys.
translation: 그대의 수고에 대한 답례로 이 아뮬렛을 받아 주시오. 보호의 오브와 같은 신성한 돌로 만든 것이오. 여행길에서 그대를 지켜 줄 것이오.

english: Thank you King Bolren.
The tree has many other powers, some of which I cannot reveal. As a friend of the gnome people, I can now allow you to use the tree's magic to teleport to other trees grown from related seeds.
translation: 이 나무에는 다른 힘도 많이 있소. 그중 일부는 밝힐 수 없소. 노움 일족의 친구가 된 그대에게, 이제 이 나무의 마법으로 같은 계통의 씨앗에서 자란 다른 나무들로 순간이동하는 것을 허락하겠소.

english: Congratulations! Quest complete!
Hello again Bolren.
Well hello, it's good to see you again.
I've lost my amulet.
Oh dear. Here, take another. We truly are indebted to you.
translation: 저런. 자, 하나 더 받으시오. 우리는 그대에게 진정 큰 빚을 졌으니.

english: Here, I think this belongs to you.
Hello there. Any luck in the quest for Arposandra?
translation: 반갑소. Arposandra(아르포산드라)를 찾는 일은 좀 진척이 있소?

english: Sort of. I think I've worked out where Arposandra is, but my attempt to enter didn't go well. There seems to be quite an extensive set of defences.
translation: 어느 정도는요. Arposandra(아르포산드라)가 어디 있는지는 알아낸 것 같은데, 들어가려다 잘 안 됐어요. 방어 시설이 꽤 광범위하게 깔려 있는 것 같아요.

english: Ah, that is a problem. I wish I could offer more help, but the Khazard Army already poses a major threat to us. We can't afford to split ourselves fighting two different enemies.
translation: 아, 그거 곤란하구려. 더 도와주고 싶지만, Khazard Army(카자드 군대)만으로도 우리에겐 큰 위협이오. 두 적과 싸우느라 힘을 나눌 여유가 없소.

english: So we do nothing?
For now, I'm afraid so. Glouphrie is a foe that must be dealt with one day, but that day is not today.
translation: 안타깝지만 지금은 그렇소. Glouphrie(글루프리)는 언젠가 처리해야 할 적이지만, 오늘은 그날이 아니오.

english: Hello again.
Hello there.
How are things here?
I fear the war against the Khazard Army is set to outlive us all. We keep making progress, but for every foe we defeat, Khazard sends two more.
translation: Khazard Army(카자드 군대)와의 전쟁은 우리 모두가 죽은 뒤에도 계속될 것 같아 걱정이오. 조금씩 나아가고는 있지만, 적 하나를 쓰러뜨리면 Khazard(카자드)는 둘을 더 보내오.

english: Still, we thankfully haven't had any more Glouphrie problems at least.
translation: 그래도 다행히 Glouphrie(글루프리) 문제는 더 생기지 않았소.

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
Congratulations, human!
The king has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 왕이 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Option: I'll leave you to it then.
Can I help at all?
I would be glad to help.
I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 제가 그 군벌을 찾아서 오브들을 되찾아 올게요.

english: I'm sorry but I can't help.
Good day.
What are you doing here? All Mourners should know that if they need to contact me, they need to use the proper channels!
translation: 여기서 뭘 하는 건가? Mourner(애도자)라면 누구나 나와 연락하려면 정식 경로를 거쳐야 한다는 걸 알 텐데!

english: Sorry, I'm a new recruit.
Well do not let it happen again.
Adventurer! It is good to see you again.
And you too, King. How fares the tree?
translation: 저도 반가워요, 왕이시여. 나무는 잘 있나요?

english: The tree? It is fine, as it has always been since we foiled Glough's plans.
translation: 나무 말이오? 무사하오. 우리가 Glough(글로우)의 계획을 막아 낸 뒤로 늘 그래 왔듯이.

english: Good. What ever did happen to Glough?
translation: 다행이네요. 그런데 Glough(글로우)는 대체 어떻게 됐어요?

english: Oh, I forced him to resign. I have now appointed a new Head Tree Guardian, Daero. He is learning quickly and serves me well.
translation: 아, 그자는 내가 사임하게 만들었소. 그리고 새로운 Head Tree Guardian(수석 나무 수호자)로 Daero(대로)를 임명했소. 빠르게 배우고 있고 나를 잘 보좌하고 있소.

english: King, you look worried. Is anything the matter?
translation: 왕이시여, 걱정이 있어 보이세요. 무슨 일 있으세요?

english: Nothing in particular ... Well actually, yes - there is.
What is it?
Well, do you remember Glough's ship building facilities in Karamja?
translation: 그래, Karamja(카람자)에 있던 Glough(글로우)의 조선 시설을 기억하오?

english: Yes, they were on the eastern coast. What of them?
translation: 네, 동쪽 해안에 있었죠. 그게 왜요?

english: After you defeated Glough's demon I sent an envoy of my Royal Guard, the 10th squad, to oversee the decommission of the shipyard. They were ordered to use force if necessary.
translation: 그대가 Glough(글로우)의 악마를 물리친 뒤, 나는 조선소 해체를 감독하라고 Royal Guard(왕실 근위병) 제10분대를 사절로 보냈소. 필요하다면 무력을 써도 좋다고 명령했지.

english: I see ... Were they successful?
I ... I don't know. I have heard nothing from them. I do not even know if they reached the shipyard!
translation: 나... 나도 모르오. 그들에게서 아무 소식도 듣지 못했소. 조선소에 도착했는지조차 모른단 말이오!

english: It is a long way...
But I need to know what happened. These are elite soldiers - their disappearance cannot simply be ignored. I cannot wait any longer.
translation: 하지만 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아야 하오. 그들은 정예 병사들이오. 그들이 사라진 것을 그냥 넘길 수는 없소. 더는 기다릴 수 없소.

english: And so I ask you: would you visit Glough's old shipyard in Karamja and find out if the 10th squad ever managed to reach?
translation: 그래서 그대에게 부탁하오. Karamja(카람자)에 있는 Glough(글로우)의 옛 조선소에 가서 제10분대가 그곳에 도착했는지 알아봐 주겠소?

english: Ok, I'll do it.
Thank you very much. You may need this Royal Seal to identify yourself as my envoy.
translation: 정말 고맙소. 내 사절임을 증명하려면 이 Royal Seal(왕실 인장)이 필요할 것이오.

english: Please report to me as soon as you have any information.
translation: 알아낸 것이 생기면 바로 나에게 보고해 주시오.

english: I'm afraid I am too busy right now.
As you wish. Return to me when you have the time.
translation: 뜻대로 하시오. 시간이 나면 다시 찾아오시오.

english: Are you ready to investigate the shipyard for me?
What do I have to do?
Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.
translation: Karamja(카람자) 동쪽 해안에 있는 Glough(글로우)의 옛 조선소로 가시오. 내 Royal Guard(왕실 근위병) 제10분대에게 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아내 주시오.

english: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.
translation: 말했듯이, 그들은 조선 시설 해체를 감독하러 갔는데 아무 소식이 없소.

english: Yes.
(same as above)
Welcome back, adventurer.
What am I meant to do?
(shows previous questions)
How did the 10th squad travel?
How did the 10th squad travel?
They would have each flown a Gnome Glider.
translation: 각자 Gnome Glider(노움 글라이더)를 타고 날아갔을 것이오.

english: (previous)
I've lost my copy of the Royal Seal...
translation: 제가 받은 Royal Seal(왕실 인장)을 잃어버렸어요...

english: I've lost my copy of the Royal Seal...
translation: 제가 받은 Royal Seal(왕실 인장)을 잃어버렸어요...

english: What?! Do you realise the consequences if it falls into the wrong hands?
translation: 뭐라고?! 그게 엉뚱한 자의 손에 들어가면 어떻게 될지 알기나 하오?

english: However, this mission is of paramount importance. I shall give you a spare in the meantime.
translation: 하지만 이번 임무는 무엇보다 중요하오. 일단 예비용을 하나 주겠소.

english: (other options)
I'll be back later.
I'll be back later.
Hello, King Narnode.
Good to see you again, [player name].
Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: Royal Seed Pod(왕실 씨앗 꼬투리)가 더 있나요?

english: How fares the kingdom today?
All is well in the Stronghold thanks to you, [player name].
translation: 그대 덕분에 Stronghold(요새)는 모두 평안하오, [player name].

english: No.
What am I meant to do?
Have you any more Royal Seed Pods?
translation: Royal Seed Pod(왕실 씨앗 꼬투리)가 더 있나요?

english: How fares the kingdom today?
Greetings, your majesty.
Do you have anything of importance to say?
...Not really.
You will have to excuse me, then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!
translation: 그렇다면 실례하겠소. 짐은 다스릴 왕국이 있어 아주 바쁘오!

english: Well hello there. What do you want?
Ah, it's you again. Hello there.
Is there a reason for you being here?
Well, I'm on a treasure trail...
Oh! Good, then you can answer this question for me!
translation: 오! 잘됐군, 그럼 짐의 질문에 답해 보시오!

english: King Roald has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: King Roald(로알드 왕)이 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
Err, that sounds a little wrong to me.
translation: 흠, 짐이 듣기엔 좀 틀린 것 같구려.

english: Correct!
King Roald has given you another clue scroll!
translation: King Roald(로알드 왕)이 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Hello there. Would you like to follow me for a minute?
Follow you?! I am the King! I am the followed, not the follower!!
translation: 따라오라고?! 짐은 왕이오! 짐은 남이 따르는 자이지, 남을 따르는 자가 아니란 말이오!!

english: Well, if you can't be bothered then neither can I.
Suit yourself.
No, you suit yourself.
You're quite argumentative for a peasant.
I'm not the one arguing, you are.
Then why do you keep answering me back?
translation: 그럼 왜 자꾸 말대꾸를 하는 것이오?

english: No, you're answering me back.
Well, stop talking and I'll stop answering.
translation: 그럼 그쪽이 말을 멈추면 저도 대꾸 안 할게요.

english: No, you stop talking.
I have stopped talking.
No you haven't, you're doing it now.
translation: 아니, 안 멈췄소. 지금도 하고 있지 않소.

english: No, I'm just answering what you're saying.
Okay, so if I don't say anything, you won't answer me back.
translation: 좋소, 그럼 짐이 아무 말도 안 하면 그대도 대꾸하지 않겠구려.

english: Suits me.
Go on, then.
No, you first.
King Roald doesn't say anything to you.
translation: King Roald(로알드 왕)은 당신에게 아무 말도 하지 않는다.

english: You don't say anything back.
See, that's better.
Yes, much better.
What were you saying about me following you somewhere?
translation: 그런데 짐더러 어딘가로 따라오라던 얘기는 뭐였소?

english: I can't remember, it was such a long time ago.
translation: 기억이 안 나요. 너무 오래전 일이라서요.

english: Ah, that's a shame - I could have done with a breath of fresh air.
translation: 아, 아쉽구려. 바람 좀 쐬면 좋았을 텐데.

english: Oh well.
Yes, never mind.
See you around.
Yes, see you later.
I thought you were going.
I was until you spoke to me again.
translation: 그쪽이 다시 말을 걸기 전까진 가려고 했죠.

english: I'm sorry, I'll stop speaking to you then.
translation: 미안하오, 그럼 이제 말을 걸지 않겠소.

english: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.
translation: Ardougne(아르둔)의 모든 이를 대신해 그대의 도움에 감사하오, 모험가여. 미안하지만 이야기할 시간이 없구려. 전임자가 남긴 일이 산더미라오.

english: Thank you for your work in bringing peace back to these islands, [Fremennik name].
translation: 이 섬들에 다시 평화를 가져다준 그대의 노고에 감사하오, [Fremennik name].

english: I hear that the Etceterians have also pledged to give you some of their resources, as thanks for preventing war once again.
translation: Etceterian(에트세테리아인)들도 또다시 전쟁을 막아 준 보답으로 그대에게 자원 일부를 내주기로 했다고 들었소.

english: How is the kingdom faring?
Everything is fine, your Majesty.
Remember, speak to Ghrim if you require assistance.
I think Prince Brand would make the best heir.
translation: Prince Brand(브란드 왕자)가 가장 훌륭한 후계자가 될 것 같습니다.

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my daughter? The Princess might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 내 딸과 시간을 보내 보고 내린 솔직한 의견이오? 공주가 이 소식을 차갑게 받아들일지도 모르오. 한번 깨진 신뢰는 회복하기 어려운 법이오.

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
As you wish. I will pay heed to your recommendation.
No, I changed my mind.
As you wish. I will keep this conversation between us.
translation: 뜻대로 하시오. 이 대화는 우리 둘만의 비밀로 하겠소.

english: I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: Princess Astrid(아스트리드 공주)가 가장 훌륭한 후계자가 될 것 같습니다.

english: Is that your honest opinion after having spent time with my son? The Prince might receive the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 내 아들과 시간을 보내 보고 내린 솔직한 의견이오? 왕자가 이 소식을 차갑게 받아들일지도 모르오. 한번 깨진 신뢰는 회복하기 어려운 법이오.

english: Never mind.
I think Prince Brand would make the best heir.
translation: Prince Brand(브란드 왕자)가 가장 훌륭한 후계자가 될 것 같습니다.

english: Yes, Your Majesty.
No, I changed my mind.
I think Princess Astrid would make the best heir.
translation: Princess Astrid(아스트리드 공주)가 가장 훌륭한 후계자가 될 것 같습니다.

english: Never mind.
I take it you are [player name]? King Lathas sent this message for you. He's not a man you'd want to keep waiting.
translation: [player name] 님이시죠? King Lathas(라타스 왕)께서 이 전갈을 보내셨어요. 기다리게 해서는 안 될 분이에요.

english: Please help me. I was transformed into a frog by a well-meaning but sadly frog-obsessed old wizard. Only your touch can turn me back. Will you help me?
translation: 제발 도와주세요. 선의는 있지만 안타깝게도 개구리에 집착하는 늙은 마법사 때문에 개구리로 변해 버렸어요. 당신의 손길만이 저를 되돌릴 수 있어요. 도와주실래요?

english: Okay.
Alright.
Sure, I will.
Yeah, okay.
I suppose so, sure.
All right.
Very well, if a touch is all you need, I'll do it.
translation: 좋아요, 만지기만 하면 된다면 해 드릴게요.

english: Yes, I will touch you.
Sure, I'll touch you.
No way, I'm not kissing you.
translation: 절대 싫어요, 당신한테 입 맞추진 않을 거예요.

english: I'd rather not.
Eww, no way!
I don't want to.
Leave me alone.
A kiss? Not a chance.
It looks better to be a frog. Make me one!
translation: 개구리가 더 좋아 보이네요. 저도 개구리로 만들어 줘요!

english: I'd rather become a frog too!
What if I want to be a frog like you?
I would prefer not to, sorry.
I'm sorry, I'd prefer not to do that.
How about if we kiss?
May I kiss you instead?
Would a kiss be acceptable?
Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
translation: 정말 고마워요, [player name] 님. 저는 동화 속 제 왕국으로 돌아가야 해요. 하지만 보답으로 이걸 받아 주세요. Varrock(바록) 옷 가게에서 의상으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: Player is transformed into a frog and teleported to Frogland
translation: 플레이어가 개구리로 변해 Frogland(개구리 나라)로 순간이동된다

english: Yes!
Thank you so much, [player name]. I must return to my fairytale kingdom. But take this as a reward. You can exchange it at the Varrock clothes store for a costume.
translation: 정말 고마워요, [player name] 님. 저는 동화 속 제 왕국으로 돌아가야 해요. 하지만 보답으로 이걸 받아 주세요. Varrock(바록) 옷 가게에서 의상으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: Hurrah for the frog [prince/princess]!
Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog [prince/princess]!
translation: 나한테 말 걸지 말고 개구리 [prince/princess]한테 말해요!

english: The frogs do not need your help right now.
translation: 개구리들은 지금 당신 도움이 필요 없어요.

english: Don't look at me, I'm just a frog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: 날 보지 마요, 난 그냥 개구리라고요. 개굴! 개굴!

english: Greetings from the [prince/princess], [player name]!
Talk to the frog [prince/princess], [player name]!
translation: 개구리 [prince/princess]께 말을 걸어 봐요, [player name] 님!

english: The frog [prince/princess] needs your help, [player name]!
translation: 개구리 [prince/princess]께서 당신 도움이 필요해요, [player name] 님!

english: Please respond to the frog [prince/princess], [player name]!
Maybe later.
Are you ready to leave now?
Yes, I'd like to leave now.
Player is transformed back and teleported to their initial spot
translation: 플레이어가 원래 모습으로 돌아와 처음 있던 곳으로 순간이동된다

english: No, I'd rather stay.
Okay.
Alright.
Sure, I will.
Yeah, okay.
I suppose so, sure.
All right.
Very well, if a touch is all you need, I'll do it.
translation: 좋아요, 만지기만 하면 된다면 해 드릴게요.

english: Yes, I will touch you.
Sure, I'll touch you.
No way, I'm not kissing you.
translation: 절대 싫어요, 당신한테 입 맞추진 않을 거예요.

english: I'd rather not.
Eww, no way!
I don't want to.
Leave me alone.
A kiss? Not a chance.
It looks better to be a frog. Make me one!
translation: 개구리가 더 좋아 보이네요. 저도 개구리로 만들어 줘요!

english: I'd rather become a frog too!
What if I want to be a frog like you?
I would prefer not to, sorry.
I'm sorry, I'd prefer not to do that.
How about if we kiss?
May I kiss you instead?
Would a kiss be acceptable?
Yes, I'd like to leave now.
No, I'd rather stay.
Hello, there!
Hello! The name's Kit. Sir Kit Breaker.
translation: 안녕하세요! 제 이름은 Kit(킷)이에요. Sir Kit Breaker(킷 브레이커 경)죠.

english: Sir Kit? That's a nice name!
translation: Sir Kit(킷 경)요? 이어 부르면 '서킷 브레이커'네요. 멋진 이름이에요!

english: Thank you! I chose it myself!
... Thinking about it, I chose mine as well. I'm [player name], by the way.
translation: ...생각해 보니 저도 제 이름을 직접 지었네요. 그나저나 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: Very nice to meet you!
What do you do around here?
I'm helping Gilbert with a project of his, on behalf of the White knights. It will take us a while but I can let you know when we're closer to completion!
translation: White knights(백기사단)을 대신해서 Gilbert(길버트) 님의 프로젝트를 돕고 있어요. 시간이 좀 걸리겠지만, 완성이 가까워지면 알려 드릴게요!

english: Sounds good!
Hi there, Sir Kit!
[player name], it's good to see you.
How are you getting on as a White Knight?
It's going well, thank you. Being on loan to Gilbert and the Glade project is giving me good purpose whilst I do all the basic training.
translation: 잘 지내고 있어요, 고마워요. 기초 훈련을 받는 동안 Gilbert(길버트) 님과 Glade(빈터) 프로젝트에 파견된 덕분에 보람 있게 지내고 있어요.

english: Gilbert's not working you too hard is he?
translation: Gilbert(길버트) 님이 너무 부려 먹진 않죠?

english: Not yet at least, until we get started on the land. For now it's mostly tending to the flowers and wandering... Patrolling around!
translation: 아직은요. 땅 작업을 시작하기 전까지는요. 지금은 주로 꽃을 돌보고 어슬렁... 아니, 순찰을 돌고 있어요!

english: I can't thank you enough, [player name]. I hope you'll pop by one day as the Glade project progresses. Don't be a stranger!
translation: [player name] 님, 정말 뭐라고 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요. Glade(빈터) 프로젝트가 진행되면 언젠가 들러 주세요. 자주 놀러 오세요!

english: Hey kitty. What's new?
Meow!
How are you doing?
Meeow I'm happy.
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
Can we go visit Gertrude, I'd like to see her again, she's very nice.
translation: Gertrude(거트루드) 아줌마 보러 가면 안 돼? 다시 보고 싶어, 아줌마는 정말 친절하거든.

english: Let's go to the ratpits in Ardougne. I think I fancy a fight!
translation: Ardougne(아르둔)의 쥐 투기장에 가자. 한판 싸우고 싶은 기분이야!

english: Can we stay here in the sewers and hunt rats? That would be fun.
translation: 여기 하수도에 남아서 쥐 사냥하면 안 돼? 재밌을 거야.

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to chase things.
I'm tired, I'd like to have a nap.
Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 미안한데 인간, 대체 뭘 쓰고 있는 거야?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: cat ears(고양이 귀)를 맞췄거든. 끝내주지 않냐아아아아옹?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 고양이가 눈 한 번 깜빡이지 않고 당신의 눈을 똑바로 쳐다본다.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 하나도 안 그래. 당장 벗어, 인간. 나도 인간 귀 한 쌍 구해서 쓰고 다니기 전에.

english: You softly stroke your cat.
Purr...purr...
That cat sure loves to be stroked.
translation: 저 녀석, 쓰다듬어 주는 걸 정말 좋아하네.

english: There aren't any vermin around.
I wonder how old you are...
Shoo cat!
Meeeooow!
The cat has run away.
You choose not to shoo away the cat.
Who's Gielinor's most ferocious kitten?
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제일 사나운 새끼 고양이는 누구지?

english: Me me~ Roar.(It sounds like more of a squeak)
translation: 나 나~ 어흥. (어흥이라기보다는 찍찍거리는 소리 같다)

english: Me! Me!~ Roar!
Aww! So squeaky!
I'm just fed up with you, you're so needy! Can't you just look after yourself for a bit?
translation: 너한테 정말 질렸어, 너무 손이 많이 가! 잠깐이라도 혼자 알아서 좀 지낼 수 없니?

english: Meeeeow, don't leave me master, I'm sorry, I'll be a good kitty from now on meoooww.
translation: 냐아아아옹, 떠나지 마 주인님, 미안해, 이제부터 착한 고양이가 될게 냐아앙.

english: No I've really had it with you, now scat!
translation: 아니, 정말 질렸어. 이제 저리 가!

english: Go on puss...kill that rat!
Your cat cannot get to its prey.
Meeooow!
Miaow!
I think it's hungry!
Your kitten is hungry.
I think it wants some attention.
Your kitten wants attention.
Meeeooow!
Your kitten has grown into a healthy cat that can hunt for itself.
translation: 새끼 고양이가 혼자서도 사냥할 수 있는 건강한 고양이로 자랐다.

english: The kitten gobbles up the fish.
translation: 새끼 고양이가 물고기를 허겁지겁 먹어 치운다.

english: Purr!
That kitten loves to play with that ball of wool. I think it is its favourite.
translation: 저 녀석, 털실 뭉치 가지고 노는 걸 정말 좋아하네. 제일 좋아하는 장난감인가 봐.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
Stroke
Chase Vermin
Guess age
Shoo away
Yes I am.
No I'm not.
Stroke (prior to August 2024)
Stroke (as of August 2024)
Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: 앞으로 오랫동안 '트롤 왕을 처치한 자'에 대한 노래를 듣게 되겠구나.

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
Kebabs! Get your kebabs here! One gold each!
translation: 케밥 사세요! 케밥 여기 있어요! 하나에 1골드!

english: Sure, one kebab please.
Yes? Are you going to give me that one gold coin then?
Sorry, I don't seem to have any money on me.
The bank is Keldagrim-West. Hurry back!
translation: 은행은 Keldagrim(켈다그림) 서쪽에 있어요. 얼른 다녀오세요!

english: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
Just go out in the streets, they can't be hard to find!
translation: 그냥 거리로 나가 보세요. 찾기 어렵지 않을걸요!

english: No, a specific drunken dwarf, he keeps harassing me.
translation: 아뇨, 특정한 술 취한 드워프요. 그 드워프가 자꾸 저를 귀찮게 해요.

english: That's still not very helpful. But let me see. There is one particularly drunken dwarf just to the northeast of here.
translation: 그래도 별 도움이 안 되는 설명이네요. 하지만 어디 보자. 여기서 북동쪽에 유난히 술에 취한 드워프가 하나 있긴 해요.

english: He's scaring away my customers, he says there's something wrong with my kebabs. Quite annoying fellow.
translation: 그 녀석이 우리 손님들을 쫓아내고 있어요. 내 케밥이 뭔가 잘못됐다나요. 꽤 성가신 녀석이에요.

english: I don't think that's who I mean.
translation: 제가 말하는 드워프는 아닌 것 같아요.

english: Well, he does have a relative who wanders all over Gielinor. Comes back from time to time to buy more kebabs. Don't see him very often though.
translation: 음, 그 녀석한테 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 떠도는 친척이 하나 있긴 해요. 가끔 케밥을 더 사러 돌아오죠. 자주 보진 못하지만요.

english: Do you think I'll have any chance of catching him here?
translation: 여기서 기다리면 그 드워프를 만날 수 있을까요?

english: I think he was back here quite recently, so I doubt he'll be back any time soon.
translation: 꽤 최근에 왔다 간 것 같아서, 당분간은 안 올 것 같은데요.

english: I thought you would know plenty!
How do you mean?
Oh come on! You in the Laughing Miner? The whole city knows about you and your dwarven drinking buddies!
translation: 아이, 왜 이래요! Laughing Miner(웃는 광부)에서 그렇게 노는 당신을요? 당신이랑 그 드워프 술친구들 얘기는 온 도시가 다 알아요!

english: Right, right.
Do you have any quests?
Not really! I have a steady supply of meat coming in through the carts and I don't really need anything else!
translation: 딱히요! 수레로 고기가 꾸준히 들어오니까 다른 건 별로 필요 없어요!

english: Sure, one kebab please.
I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.
Do you have any quests?
Hello my good man.
Good day to you outsider. You should be careful down here. We're the only ones that haven't yet turned.
translation: 좋은 하루일세, 이방인. 이 아래에서는 조심하게. 아직 변하지 않은 건 우리뿐이니.

english: If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!
translation: 조심하지 않으면 자네도 그들 중 하나가 될 걸세!

english: Who? Iban's followers?
They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...
translation: 그들은 추종자가 아닐세. 노예지. 영혼 없는 자들이라네...

english: What happened to them?
They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.
translation: 그들도 한때는 평범했다네. 모험가, 보물 사냥꾼들이었지. 하지만 인간은 나약해서 그 목소리들을 외면하지 못했어.

english: Now they all seem to think with one conscience... As if they're being controlled by one being...
translation: 이제 그들은 모두 하나의 의식으로 생각하는 것 같네... 마치 한 존재에게 조종당하는 것처럼...

english: Iban?
Maybe... maybe Zamorak himself. Those who try and fight it are locked in cages, until their minds are too weak to resist.
translation: 어쩌면... 어쩌면 Zamorak(자모락) 본인일지도 모르지. 맞서 싸우려는 자들은 정신이 약해져 저항하지 못하게 될 때까지 우리에 갇힌다네.

english: Eventually they all fall to his control...
translation: 결국엔 모두 그의 지배에 넘어가고 말지...

english: No wonder their breath is so bad!
You think this is funny... Eh?
Not really, just trying to lighten up the conversation.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 분위기 좀 풀어 보려고요.

english: Anyway, I have something that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 아무튼, 자네에게 도움이 될 만한 게 있네. 영혼 없는 자들의 이빨로부터 나를 지키려고 직접 만든 걸세. 그놈들은 무는 힘이 지독하거든.

english: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...
translation: 그놈들 턱을 견딜 수 있는 건 이것 말고는 본 적이 없다네...

english: Thank you.
No problem traveller. Good luck.
Hello Klank.
Hello again adventurer, so you're still around?
translation: 또 만났군, 모험가. 아직 여기 있었나?

english: Still here!
Have you any more gauntlets?
Well..yes, but they're not cheap to make. I'll have to sell you a pair...
translation: 음... 있긴 하네만, 만드는 데 돈이 많이 들어서 말이야. 한 켤레 팔아야겠네...

english: How much?
5,000 coins.
5,000, you must be joking!
We don't joke down here friend...
translation: 여기 아래에서는 농담 같은 거 안 하네, 친구...

english: Okay then, I'll take a pair.
There you go... I hope they help.
I'll see you around Klank.
Oh dear, I haven't got enough money...
Sorry, I can't sell them any cheaper than that.
Take care Klank.
You too adventurer...
What happened to them?
No wonder their breath is so bad!
Have you anymore gauntlets?
5,000, you must be joking!
Okay then, I'll take a pair.
Take care Klank.
So, are you interested in buying a ship? Now, I'll be straight with you: she's not quite seaworthy right now, but give her a bit of work and she'll be the nippiest ship this side of Port Khazard.
translation: 자, 배 사실 생각 있으세요? 솔직히 말씀드리면, 지금 당장은 바다에 띄우기 좀 어려워요. 하지만 손 좀 보면 Port Khazard(포트 카자드) 이쪽에서 제일 날쌘 배가 될 거예요.

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: 언제쯤 바다에 띄울 수 있을지 아세요?

english: No, not really. Port Sarim's shipbuilders aren't very efficient so it could be quite a while.
translation: 아뇨, 잘 몰라요. Port Sarim(포트 사림) 조선공들이 일을 영 느리게 해서 꽤 오래 걸릴 수도 있어요.

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
Crandor? You're joking, right?
Yes. Ha ha ha!
Crandor's not something we sailors joke about. You can't sail from here to Catherby, or Entrana, or Ardougne without going past that accursed island.
translation: Crandor(크랜도)는 우리 뱃사람들이 농담 삼아 꺼낼 곳이 아니에요. 여기서 Catherby(캐서비)든 Entrana(엔트라나)든 Ardougne(아르둔)든, 어디로 가든 그 저주받은 섬을 지나쳐야 하거든요.

english: You can't get close to it because of the reefs, but you can always see it.
translation: 암초 때문에 가까이 갈 수는 없지만, 섬은 언제나 보여요.

english: Sometimes you can see a dark shape in the sky, circling the island. That's when you have to sail on as quick as you can and pray it's not hungry. Every year, more ships are lost to that dragon.
translation: 가끔 하늘에 시커먼 형체가 섬 주위를 빙빙 도는 게 보일 때가 있어요. 그럴 땐 최대한 빨리 지나가면서 그놈이 배고프지 않기만 빌어야 해요. 해마다 그 드래곤한테 잃는 배가 늘고 있죠.

english: No. I want to go to Crandor.
Then you must be crazy.
That island is surrounded by reefs that would rip this ship to shreds. Even if you found a map, you'd need an experienced captain to stand a chance of getting through
translation: 그 섬은 이 배쯤은 갈기갈기 찢어 버릴 암초로 둘러싸여 있어요. 지도를 구하신다 해도, 거길 뚫고 지나갈 가망이라도 있으려면 노련한 선장이 필요할 거고요.

english: and, even if I could get to it, there's no way I'm going any closer to that dragon than I have to. They say it can destroy whole ships with one bite.
translation: 게다가, 설령 제가 거기까지 갈 수 있다 해도, 그 드래곤한테는 절대 필요 이상으로 다가가지 않을 거예요. 한 입에 배를 통째로 부숴 버린다던데요.

english: Why is she damaged?
Oh, there was no particular accident. It's just years of wear and tear.
translation: 아, 딱히 사고가 있었던 건 아니에요. 그냥 오랜 세월 낡은 거죠.

english: The Lady Lumbridge is an old Crandorian fishing ship - the last one of her kind, as far as I know. That kind of ship was always mightily maneuverable, but not too tough.
translation: Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)는 오래된 크랜도 어선이에요. 제가 알기로는 그 종류로는 마지막 남은 배죠. 그런 배는 늘 엄청나게 날렵했지만, 그다지 튼튼하진 않았어요.

english: She happened to be somewhere else when Crandor was destroyed, and she's had several owners since then. Not all of them have looked after her too well,
translation: 마침 Crandor(크랜도)가 멸망할 때 다른 곳에 가 있었던 덕에 살아남았고, 그 뒤로 주인이 여러 번 바뀌었어요. 그중엔 배를 잘 돌보지 않은 사람도 있었지만,

english: but once she's patched up, she'll be good as new!
translation: 수리만 끝나면 새 배나 다름없을 거예요!

english: I'd like to buy her.
Of course! I'm sure the work needed to do on it wouldn't be too expensive.
translation: 물론이죠! 수리하는 데 돈도 그렇게 많이 들지 않을 거예요.

english: How does 2,000 gold sound? I'll even throw in my cabin boy, Jenkins, for free! He'll swab the decks and splice the mainsails for you!
translation: 2,000골드 어떠세요? 제 사환 Jenkins(젠킨스)도 공짜로 얹어 드릴게요! 갑판 청소도 하고 돛 손질도 해 줄 거예요!

english: Yep, sounds good.
Okey dokey, she's all yours!
translation: 좋아요, 이제 이 배는 손님 거예요!

english: (Klarense takes 2000 gp from the player)
...except I don't have that kind of money on me...
I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: 고장 난 배에 그런 큰돈은 못 내요!

english: That's fair enough, I suppose.
Ah well, never mind.
Hello, captain! Here to inspect your new ship? Just a little work and she'll be seaworthy again.
translation: 안녕하세요, 선장님! 새 배 둘러보러 오셨어요? 조금만 손보면 다시 바다에 띄울 수 있을 거예요.

english: So, what needs fixing on this ship?
translation: 그래서, 이 배는 어디를 고쳐야 해요?

english: Well, the big gaping hole in the hold is the problem. You'll need a few wooden planks hammered in with steel nails to fix it.
translation: 음, 선창에 뻥 뚫린 큰 구멍이 문제예요. 나무 판자 몇 장을 steel nails(강철 못)으로 박아 넣어야 고칠 수 있을 거예요.

english: So would you like to sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: 그럼 저 대신 이 배를 몰고 Crandor(크랜도)까지 가 주실래요?

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
translation: 이제 배도 없는데 뭘 하실 거예요?

english: Oh, I'll be fine. I've got work as Port Sarim's first lifeguard!
translation: 아, 전 괜찮아요. Port Sarim(포트 사림) 최초의 인명 구조원으로 일하게 됐거든요!

english: Can I board the ship now?
Sure thing, she's all yours.
Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!
translation: 와! 운이 정말 좋으시네요! Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)가 저절로 떠밀려 와서 부두에 딱 닿았지 뭐예요!

english: She's pretty badly damaged, though...
Hey, that's my ship!
No, it's not. It may, to the untrained eye, at first appear to be the Lady Lumbridge, but it is definitely not. It's my new ship. It just happens to look slightly similar, is all.
translation: 아뇨, 아니에요. 잘 모르는 사람 눈에는 언뜻 Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)처럼 보일지도 모르지만, 절대 아니에요. 이건 제 새 배예요. 그냥 어쩌다 좀 닮았을 뿐이죠.

english: It has Lady Lumbridge painted out and 'Klarense's Cruiser' painted over it!
translation: Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)라는 이름을 지우고 그 위에 'Klarense's Cruiser(클라렌스 크루저)'라고 칠해 놨잖아요!

english: Nope, you're mistaken. It's my new boat.
translation: 아뇨, 잘못 보신 거예요. 이건 제 새 배라니까요.

english: Well will you at least take me to Crandor in it?
translation: 그럼 최소한 그 배로 Crandor(크랜도)까지 태워 주기라도 할래요?

english: Nope. I don't take passengers on my ship.
translation: 싫어요. 제 배엔 손님을 안 태워요.

english: Argh!
Hey, stay off my ship! That's private property!
translation: 이봐요, 제 배에서 내려요! 사유 재산이라고요!

english: Do you know when she will be seaworthy?
translation: 언제쯤 바다에 띄울 수 있을지 아세요?

english: Would you take me to Crandor when she's ready?
Yes. Ha ha ha!
No. I want to go to Crandor.
Why is she damaged?
I'd like to buy her.
Yep, sounds good.
I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: 고장 난 배에 그런 큰돈은 못 내요!

english: Ah well, never mind.
So, what needs fixing on the ship?
Would you sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: 저 대신 이 배를 몰고 Crandor(크랜도)까지 가 주실래요?

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
translation: 이제 배도 없는데 뭘 하실 거예요?

english: Can I board the ship now?
Thank you, adventurer. You have given my soul some respite.
translation: 고맙소, 모험가. 덕분에 내 영혼이 조금은 쉴 수 있게 되었소.

english: Wait! I want to ask you a question...
Klenter disappears before you can ask him anything.
translation: Klenter(클렌터)는 당신이 무언가 묻기도 전에 사라져 버린다.

english: He is too busy dancing to talk!
translation: 춤추느라 너무 바빠서 말할 겨를이 없다!

english: We're Knights of the Party Room
We dance round and round like a loon
translation: 정신 나간 듯 빙글빙글 춤추는 기사단

english: Quite often we like to sing
Unfortunately we make a din
Do you like our helmet plumes?
Everyone's happy now we can move
translation: 이제 움직일 수 있어 모두 신나

english: Like a party animal in the groove
The party room is a silly place!
Who are you? What are you doing here in the snow?
translation: 누구세요? 이 눈 속에서 뭘 하고 계신 거예요?

english: My name is...Sir Gerry. I am...a member of a secret...society of knights. My time is short and I need...your help.
translation: 내 이름은... Sir Gerry(제리 경)이오. 나는... 비밀... 기사단의 일원이오. 시간이 얼마 없으니... 그대의 도움이 필요하오.

english: A secret society of knights? What a surprise! Is there an old charter or decree that says if you're a knight you have to belong to a secret order?
translation: 비밀 기사단이요? 이거 참 놀랍네요! 기사라면 무조건 비밀 결사에 들어가야 한다는 옛 헌장이나 칙령이라도 있는 거예요?

english: I'm sorry, my friend... I do not understand your meaning. Please, time is short... Take this scroll to Sir Tiffy. You will find him in Falador park... You should not...read it... It contains information for his eyes only.
translation: 미안하오, 친구여... 무슨 뜻인지 모르겠소. 부탁이오, 시간이 없소... 이 두루마리를 Sir Tiffy(티피 경)에게 가져다주시오. Falador(팔라도르) 공원에 가면 만날 수 있을 거요... 절대... 읽어서는 안 되오... 그분만 보셔야 하는 내용이오.

english: A secret society of knights? You don't mean the Temple Knights, do you?
translation: 비밀 기사단이요? 설마 Temple Knights(신전 기사단)을 말씀하시는 건 아니죠?

english: Yes! Praise Saradomin! You...have been sent in...my hour of need. Please, take...this scroll to Sir Tiffy in Falador park... You should not...read it.
translation: 그렇소! Saradomin(사라도민)께 찬양을! 그대는... 내가 가장 절박할 때... 보내진 사람이구려. 부탁이오, 이... 두루마리를 Falador(팔라도르) 공원에 있는 Sir Tiffy(티피 경)에게 전해 주시오... 절대... 읽어서는 안 되오.

english: Cough... Hey, over here.
He's still alive, but in no condition to talk. He appears to be almost comatose.
translation: 아직 살아 있지만 말을 할 수 있는 상태가 아니다. 거의 혼수상태인 것 같다.

english: Good day.
Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?
What's down these stairs?
These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.
translation: 이 계단은 Ardougne Prison(아르둔 감옥)으로 이어집니다. 도둑, 살인자, 그리고 그 사이의 온갖 놈들이 모여 사는 곳이죠.

english: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?
I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.
translation: 유감이지만 안 됩니다, 시민. 감옥엔 Knights of Ardougne(아르둔의 기사)만 들어갈 수 있는데, 보아하니 당신은 기사가 아니군요.

english: Hello there fellow knight. Isn't today a wonderful day to be a Knight of Ardougne?
translation: 안녕하세요, 동료 기사님. 오늘 같은 날은 Knight of Ardougne(아르둔의 기사)로 살기 정말 멋진 날 아닌가요?

english: I mean it's okay I suppose. The constant fear of some random adventurer murdering you and the fact that people are constantly picking your pockets isn't great. But hey ho, at least the benefits are good.
translation: 뭐, 그럭저럭 괜찮은 것 같아요. 아무 모험가한테 언제 살해당할지 모른다는 공포에, 사람들이 계속 주머니를 털어 가는 건 별로지만요. 그래도 뭐, 복지 혜택은 좋잖아요.

english: That they are fellow knight, that they are.
Anyway, can I go down these stairs?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 이 계단으로 내려가도 될까요?

english: Of course you can! You're a Knight of Ardougne! There is no place where you can't go.
translation: 물론이죠! 당신은 Knight of Ardougne(아르둔의 기사)잖아요! 못 갈 곳이 어디 있겠어요.

english: Yeah... Thanks.
Good to see you [Tim/Sue].
Who's [Tim/Sue]?
You are?
Ah yes, I am [Tim/Sue].
Hmm... Is your head working okay today [Tim/Sue]?
Of course, my head has never been better.
translation: 그럼요, 머리가 이렇게 잘 돌아간 적이 없어요.

english: If you say so...
Ah, nilsal! Hello!
Ah, hello again!
Hello to you too!
Tell me about yourself.
I'm a Knight of Varlamore, the Kingdom of Sun. I venture to Kourend on a mission, one I can say very little of.
translation: 저는 태양의 왕국, Varlamore(바를라모어)의 기사예요. 어떤 임무로 Kourend(쿠렌드)에 왔는데, 그 임무에 대해선 말씀드릴 수 있는 게 거의 없어요.

english: How come?
I'm afraid you must accept my secrecy adventurer, for who knows what the future holds.
translation: 미안하지만 제 비밀은 이해해 주세요, 모험가님. 앞날이 어떻게 될지는 아무도 모르니까요.

english: I found an ancient sun temple.
Oh, pray tell, where is this temple?
translation: 오, 어서 말씀해 주세요. 그 신전이 어디 있죠?

english: In a place called the Forthos Ruin to the south-east. I was exploring and discovered symbology to an entity called Ralos.
translation: 남동쪽에 있는 Forthos Ruin(포르토스 유적)이라는 곳이에요. 탐험하다가 Ralos(랄로스)라는 존재를 나타내는 상징들을 발견했어요.

english: I see. I think I shall check out this Ruin. Thank you for letting me know adventurer.
translation: 그렇군요. 그 유적을 한번 살펴봐야겠어요. 알려 주셔서 고마워요, 모험가님.

english: No problem... Oh, I don't know your name.
translation: 별말씀을요... 아, 그러고 보니 이름을 모르네요.

english: Call me Astra! Now, I must see to this discovery as it may indeed help my mission. May the light shine upon you!
translation: Astra(아스트라)라고 불러 주세요! 자, 이 발견이 제 임무에 정말 도움이 될지도 모르니 가 봐야겠어요. 빛이 당신을 비추기를!

english: Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
To the south, beyond Mount Quidamortem. It's a glorious land where the sun forever shines.
translation: 남쪽으로, Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산) 너머에 있어요. 태양이 영원히 빛나는 영광스러운 땅이죠.

english: Sounds wonderful!
I have to go.
Stay vigilant, friend.
Oh... nilsal, adventurer.
Hello!
How are you, Astra?
Not great... Can you believe what they've done?
translation: 별로예요... 그놈들이 무슨 짓을 했는지 믿어지세요?

english: Done what?
Are you blind? Look what they've done to the altar of Ralos!
translation: 눈이 멀었어요? Ralos(랄로스)의 제단을 저렇게 만들어 놨잖아요!

english: Oh... I guess it has seen better days.
translation: 아... 예전보단 좀 상태가 안 좋긴 하네요.

english: It was those others! Those undead druids. Blind moon worshippers...
translation: 다 그놈들 짓이에요! 그 언데드 드루이드들. 눈먼 달 숭배자들...

english: Do you see what they've become? That's what turning your back on the light does. Even as I stand here in this desecrated temple, I feel the light fading from me.
translation: 그놈들이 어떻게 됐는지 보이세요? 빛에 등을 돌리면 저렇게 되는 거예요. 이 더럽혀진 신전에 서 있기만 해도 제 안의 빛이 희미해지는 게 느껴져요.

english: I suppose it is quite spooky down here.
So you feel it too? A shadow hangs over this place.
translation: 당신도 느껴지는군요? 이곳엔 그림자가 드리워져 있어요.

english: What will you do now?
My mission is still a secret, adventurer. Perhaps I'll share it with you one day.
translation: 제 임무는 여전히 비밀이에요, 모험가님. 언젠가는 당신에게 말해 줄지도 모르죠.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I found an ancient sun temple.
Where's the Kingdom of Varlamore?
I have to go.
How are you, Astra?
Who are you?
Woo wooo!
Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
translation: 모르는가? 나는 Justiciar of the Lion(사자의 저스티시아)를 섬기는 자랑스러운 Knight of the Lion(사자 기사)일세.

english: And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!
translation: 그리고 자네가 내 안식을 방해한 그 모험가로군!

english: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.
translation: 네... 딱히 그렇게 미안하진 않아요. Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)을 찾고 있었거든요. 그래도 일부러 방해하려던 건 아니었으니, 조금이나마 위로가 됐으면 해요.

english: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?
translation: Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)라고? 그 화폐는 오직 거룩한 Saradomin(사라도민)의 독실한 신도에게만 허락된 것일세. 자네는 신도인가, 모험가?

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?
translation: 그렇군! 그래, 적어도 그분의 상징이 새겨진 물건을 몇 개 지니고 있는 게 느껴지는군. 반갑네, 같은 신도여! 말해 보게, 요즘 Justiciar of the Lion(사자의 저스티시아)께서는 무얼 하고 계신가?

english: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.
translation: Justiciar of the Lion(사자의 저스티시아)요? 처음 들어 보는데요.

english: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)이시여, 자비를! 진심인가, 모험가? 그분의 영광을 들어 본 적이 없다고?

english: The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
translation: 남동쪽에 있는 조각상이 그분의 모습을 본뜬 것일세. 그분을 기리며 그 조각상을 세우던 날이 지금도 기억나는군.

english: The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
translation: Justiciar of the Lion(사자의 저스티시아)는 우리 기사단에서 가장 강력한 마법사에게 내려지는 칭호일세. 그분은 주문 하나로 Zamorakian(자모락파) 악마 군대 전체를 쓸어버릴 수 있었지!

english: I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.
translation: 살아생전 그분께 더 많이 배우지 못한 것이 한스럽지만, 그분을 따라 무덤까지 온 것은 단 한순간도 후회하지 않네.

english: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?
translation: 그렇군요, 정말 존경받을 만한 분 같네요. 그분을 어디서 만날 수 있는지 아세요?

english: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.
translation: 그건 내가 자네에게 묻고 싶었네. 마지막으로 듣기로는 여기 Hallowvale(할로베일)의 학당에 머물고 계셨다더군.

english: Oh dear...
Is something wrong adventurer?
Never mind, you don't want to know.
You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
translation: 거짓말을 하는군, 모험가. 자네 몸에서 거룩한 Saradomin(사라도민)의 물건이 단 하나도 느껴지지 않네.

english: To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!
translation: 우리 화폐가 비신도의 손에 넘어가다니. 이런 수치가 있나! 내가 죽은 몸만 아니었어도, 그 무례함의 대가로 자네를 그 자리에서 불태워 버렸을 걸세!

english: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!
translation: 흥, 당신은 이미 죽었고 화폐는 제가 가졌으니, 그냥 그러려니 하고... 살아가셔야겠네요!

english: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
translation: 자네의 그 우스갯소리는 전혀 반갑지 않네, 비신도여.

english: No, I follow another god.
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 감히 이 신성한 곳을 더럽히다니! 그 보물은 네 것이 아니다!

english: Yes, I follow Saradomin.
No, I follow another god.
Who are you?
Woo wooo?
Who indeed? I am a wise Knight of the Owl. I serve the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 누구냐고? 나는 지혜로운 Knight of the Owl(올빼미 기사)이오. Justiciar of the Owl(올빼미의 저스티시아)를 섬기고 있소.

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: Justiciar of the Owl(올빼미의 저스티시아)는 누군데요?

english: Saradomin's wisest of servants. It surprises me that you've not heard of his many feats.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 종들 가운데 가장 지혜로운 분이오. 그분의 수많은 업적을 들어 본 적이 없다니 놀랍구려.

english: Do you know any?
I know them all.
Care to share?
Of course. Do you see the foliage around you, adventurer?
Yes.
For it to be in such a state means that there is unimaginable evil nearby. These plants were grown personally by Zachariah, the Justiciar of the Owl.
translation: 초목이 저런 상태라는 건 근처에 상상도 못 할 악이 있다는 뜻이오. 이 식물들은 Justiciar of the Owl(올빼미의 저스티시아)이신 Zachariah(재커라이아)께서 손수 기르신 것이오.

english: Anything he plants blossoms with unimaginable vigour. You may have noticed that he has a love for lilies. Perhaps he knew they'd serve multiple purposes in a place like this.
translation: 그분이 심는 것은 무엇이든 상상도 못 할 기운으로 꽃을 피운다오. 그분이 백합을 아끼신다는 걸 눈치챘을지도 모르겠소. 어쩌면 이런 곳에서 백합이 여러 쓸모가 있으리란 걸 알고 계셨는지도 모르지.

english: Hmm. Hopefully I'll meet him one day.
translation: 흠. 언젠가 만나 뵐 수 있으면 좋겠네요.

english: If you do, send my regards.
translation: 만나게 된다면 내 안부를 전해 주시오.

english: Do you have a name?
I'm but a loyal watcher, that is all.
So, was there anything else?
Wait...
Your helmet looks familiar. I defeated a knight who wore one with a similar design.
translation: 그 투구 어디서 본 것 같아요. 비슷한 모양의 투구를 쓴 기사를 쓰러뜨린 적이 있거든요.

english: This helmet? It is based on the one worn by the Justiciar of the Owl. You mean to say you fought the great Zachariah and lived to tell the tale?
translation: 이 투구 말이오? 이건 Justiciar of the Owl(올빼미의 저스티시아)께서 쓰시던 투구를 본뜬 것이오. 그 위대한 Zachariah(재커라이아)와 싸우고도 살아남았다는 말이오?

english: Well, I suppose so.
This can't be... You killed the great Zachariah?
translation: 그럴 리가... 그 위대한 Zachariah(재커라이아)를 죽였단 말이오?

english: Hmm, he didn't really die. He just sort of faded away and left behind a glowing magical hand.
translation: 흠, 진짜 죽은 건 아니에요. 그냥 스르르 사라지더니 빛나는 마법의 손을 남기고 갔어요.

english: Strange, when I saw him last he had no magical hand to speak of... I suppose time has changed the world above beyond my recollection...
translation: 이상하군. 내가 마지막으로 뵈었을 땐 마법의 손 같은 건 없으셨는데... 세월이 흘러 지상의 세계가 내 기억과는 딴판으로 변한 모양이구려...

english: Yep, it probably has.
What's with the owls?
They are a symbol of the wise. You see, owls can see the light in the darkest of places. Their presence within the sepulchre is one of grave importance.
translation: 올빼미는 지혜의 상징이오. 알다시피 올빼미는 가장 어두운 곳에서도 빛을 볼 수 있소. 이 묘소에 올빼미들이 있는 것은 아주 중대한 의미가 있다오.

english: Yes, I saw some down there. They seemed incorporeal in some way, as if they were ghosts...
translation: 네, 아래에서 몇 마리 봤어요. 왠지 실체가 없는 것 같았어요. 마치 유령처럼요...

english: Indeed. These creatures have the blessing of Saradomin and the wisdom of ages long past. They are the watchers of the Hallowed Sepulchre. The last defence against unseen evils.
translation: 그렇소. 이 생명체들은 Saradomin(사라도민)의 축복과 먼 옛날의 지혜를 지니고 있소. 그들은 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)의 감시자들이오. 보이지 않는 악에 맞서는 마지막 방어선이지.

english: Err... past the wolves?
The third floor... Home.
Thank you for freeing me, adventurer. If the owls have already retreated that far back, it's best that I reside here. From this position I can more effectively watch for evil.
translation: 나를 풀어 줘서 고맙소, 모험가. 올빼미들이 벌써 그렇게까지 물러났다면, 내가 여기 머무는 게 최선이겠소. 이 자리에서라면 악을 더 잘 감시할 수 있으니.

english: Hmm... Perhaps I should steal from graves more often?
translation: 흠... 무덤을 좀 더 자주 털어야 하려나?

english: Excuse me?
Oh, nothing.
I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 전 이만 가 볼게요, 안녕히 계세요.

english: Stay watchful.
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 감히 이 신성한 곳을 더럽히다니! 그 보물은 네 것이 아니다!

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Owl?
translation: Justiciar of the Owl(올빼미의 저스티시아)는 누군데요?

english: What's with the owls?
I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 전 이만 가 볼게요, 안녕히 계세요.

english: Who are you?
Woo wooo!
I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 저는 거룩한 Knight of the Unicorn(유니콘 기사)입니다. 이곳의 대사제를 섬겼고, 그분께서는 Justiciar of the Unicorn(유니콘의 저스티시아)를 섬기셨습니다.

english: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?
translation: 기사처럼 안 보이는데요... 기사라면 판금 갑옷을 입고 검이랑 창 같은 걸 들고 다니지 않나요?

english: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
translation: 모험가님께는 기사라는 칭호가 다른 뜻으로 다가오는 모양입니다. 사실 저희 기사단의 기사들은 모두 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬기는 사제들입니다.

english: During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.
translation: 살아생전 저는 이곳에서 거룩한 Saradomin(사라도민)의 쓰러진 신도들을 축성하며 지냈습니다. 그들을 이곳에 안장하기 전에 마지막 의식을 치러 주곤 했지요.

english: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 여기엔 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르던 그 '기사'들의 시신만 있는 거예요?

english: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.
translation: 전혀 그렇지 않습니다. 저희는 Hallowvale(할로베일)의 모든 시민에게도 그 의식을 치러 드렸습니다. 그분들은 대부분 처음 두 층에 안장되었지요.

english: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 그럼 아까 말씀하신 Justiciar of the Unicorn(유니콘의 저스티시아)는 누구예요?

english: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
translation: Justiciar of the Unicorn(유니콘의 저스티시아) 말씀입니까? 그 칭호는 Saradomin(사라도민)의 사제 가운데 가장 거룩한 분께만 내려집니다.

english: The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
translation: 제가 따르던 저스티시아께서는 가시는 곳마다 Saradomin(사라도민)의 가르침을 전하며 수많은 이들을 저희 신앙으로 이끄셨습니다.

english: The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.
translation: 이 방 북동쪽에 있는 조각상은 이곳을 지을 때 그분의 모습을 본떠 만든 것입니다. 그런데 솔직히, 모험가님께서 그분과 그분의 업적을 이제야 처음 들으셨다니 마음이 쓰입니다.

english: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.
translation: 저스티시아라는 말은 분명 들어 봤는데, Justiciar of the Unicorn(유니콘의 저스티시아)에 대해선 전혀 몰라요.

english: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
translation: 그거 참으로 슬픈 일입니다. 그분께서 아직도 Saradomin(사라도민)의 뜻을 받들고 계시기를 바랄 뿐입니다.

english: Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 모험가님, 말씀해 주십시오. 무슨 일로 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 오셨습니까?

english: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretherenwere buried with.
translation: Darkmeyer(다크마이어)라는 도시 안에서 이곳을 찾았는데요, 저기 있는 수수께끼의 이방인이 당신과 당신 형제들이 함께 묻힌 Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)을 구해 달라고 부탁했어요.

english: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
translation: 그렇군요. Darkmeyer(다크마이어)라고 하셨습니까? 흥미로운 이름이군요. 이 지역은 이토록 밝고 생명력이 넘치는데 말입니다.

english: When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?
translation: 제가 살아 있을 때 이곳은 Hallowvale(할로베일)이라 불렸습니다. 여왕께서 왜 이름을 바꾸셨는지 아십니까?

english: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.
translation: 음, 간단히 말하면, 여긴 지금... 경영진이 바뀌었어요.

english: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.
translation: 흠, 흥미롭군요. 제 눈으로 직접 보고 싶지만, 안타깝게도 저는 이곳을 떠날 수 없습니다. 어쩌면 그 새로운 '경영진' 때문에 제 영혼이 저세상으로 가지 못한 것이 아닐까 싶습니다.

english: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.
translation: 그럴지도 몰라요. 그래도 여길 떠날 수 없는 게 오히려 나을 거예요. 밖에서 보게 될 걸 좋아하실 것 같진 않거든요.

english: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
translation: 아마 모험가님 말씀이 맞을 겁니다. 제가 마지막으로 받은 명령은 이곳 조각상들에 마법을 걸어 침입자로부터 이곳을 지키는 데 힘을 보태라는 것이었습니다.

english: I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.
translation: 고백하자면, 대체 누구로부터, 혹은 무엇으로부터 지키는 것인지는 감히 여쭤보지 못했습니다.

english: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
translation: 위로가 될지 모르겠지만, 당신들이 걸어 둔 마법 덕분에 그 '침입자'들은 정말 못 들어오고 있어요. 묘소에 들어오는 건 우리 같은 인간 모험가들뿐이에요.

english: Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.
translation: 물론 저희가 당신들 물건을 좀 훔쳐 가고 있긴 하지만요... 그건 죄송해요.

english: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.
translation: 어차피 이제 제게는 쓸모없는 물건들입니다. 고맙습니다, 모험가님. 모험가님 말씀 덕분에 영혼이 한결 가벼워졌습니다.

english: Aren't you all spirit?
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 감히 이 신성한 곳을 더럽히다니! 그 보물은 네 것이 아니다!

english: Who are you?
Woo wooo?
Me? I am a Knight of the Wolf. I serve the fierce Justiciar of the Wolf!
translation: 나? 나는 Knight of the Wolf(늑대 기사)다. 용맹한 Justiciar of the Wolf(늑대의 저스티시아)를 섬기지!

english: Of the Wolf?
Aye, the most loyal and fiercest of Saradomin's followers! We are the bastion against all that is evil.
translation: 그래, Saradomin(사라도민)의 추종자 중 가장 충성스럽고 가장 사나운 자들이지! 우리는 모든 악에 맞서는 보루다.

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: Justiciar of the Wolf(늑대의 저스티시아)는 누군데요?

english: You haven't heard of...
translation: 그분 얘기를 들어 본 적이 없다니...

english: What happened to her?

I was hoping you could tell me... Ah, the white wolf we called her... For she had the brightest hair you'd ever seen. A silver so bright it could blind. Some said she had icyene blood, but those close to her knew better.
translation: 그건 내가 묻고 싶은 거다... 아, 우린 그분을 white wolf(흰 늑대)라 불렀지... 누구보다 눈부신 머리카락을 가졌거든. 눈이 멀 만큼 빛나는 은빛이었지. icyene(아이시엔)의 피가 흐른다는 사람도 있었지만, 가까운 사람들은 사실이 아니란 걸 알았다.

english: I take it you were close?
Close enough. The white wolf was but a mere human, albeit with astounding prowess on the battlefield... She vied for Saradomin's attention the most out of all the justiciars.
translation: 그럭저럭. 흰 늑대는 전장에서 놀라운 기량을 보이긴 했어도 그저 인간일 뿐이었다... 모든 저스티시아 중에서 Saradomin(사라도민)의 관심을 가장 갈구한 분이었지.

english: Hmm... Why do you think that was?
Ah, well... She always wanted to be stronger and never seemed happy with what she had. There was always more.
translation: 아, 글쎄... 그분은 늘 더 강해지길 원했고, 가진 것에 만족하는 법이 없었어. 언제나 더 많은 걸 원했지.

english: Was there anything else you wanted?
Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 이야기해 줄 만한 큰 전투는 없어요?

english: There was this time a great evil swept over Hallowvale...
translation: 한번은 거대한 악이 Hallowvale(할로베일)을 휩쓴 적이 있었지...

english: Ah! The vampyres?
The what?
Y'know? The ones with the wings and all the blood sucking?
translation: 있잖아요? 날개 달리고 피 빨아 먹는 그거요.

english: No, don't be so ridiculous. As I was saying... A great evil...
translation: 아니, 말도 안 되는 소리 마라. 아무튼 내가 하던 말은... 거대한 악이...

english: The common folk called it the Egregore. They said it could shift and change shape at a moments notice into creatures from the deepest abyss...
translation: 평민들은 그걸 Egregore(에그리고어)라고 불렀다. 그놈은 순식간에 모습을 바꿔 가장 깊은 심연에서 온 괴물로 변할 수 있다고들 했지...

english: Sounds terrifying.
These folk, they tend to exaggerate. It wasn't until the nobles started spreading word of its ghoulish features, each more horrible than the last...
translation: 그 평민들은 과장이 심하거든. 그런데 귀족들까지 그놈의 소름 끼치는 생김새를 떠들고 다니기 시작하더군. 그것도 갈수록 더 끔찍하게 말이야...

english: That was when we took an interest in killing the thing. We are Knights of the Wolf after all! Our duty is to eradicate all evil.
translation: 그제야 우리도 그놈을 죽이는 데 관심을 갖게 됐지. 어쨌든 우린 Knights of the Wolf(늑대 기사)니까! 모든 악을 뿌리 뽑는 게 우리 의무다.

english: Woah! How does one vanquish such a foe?
translation: 와! 그런 적은 대체 어떻게 물리치는 거예요?

english: Well, we made short work of it. That is what we do.
translation: 뭐, 금방 해치웠지. 그게 우리가 하는 일이니까.

english: But, how?
With a big sword of course!
Ah... A favorite method of mine.
Ah... I prefer a carefully placed arrow myself. Each to their own though.
translation: 아... 저는 정확히 꽂아 넣는 화살 한 발이 더 좋던데요. 뭐, 사람마다 다르니까요.

english: It does the job! Once we had shown the head of the beast to the masses, talk of the Egregore soon died down. At least... for a while.
translation: 효과는 확실하지! 그 괴물의 머리를 사람들에게 보여 주고 나니, Egregore(에그리고어) 얘기는 금세 잠잠해졌다. 적어도... 한동안은.

english: It returned?
Yes. It was strange... As soon as the small folk had forgotten about the Egregore, rumours started to arise that it had returned. And so it had! That was the nature of this beast.
translation: 그래. 이상한 일이었지... 평민들이 Egregore(에그리고어)를 잊어버리자마자, 그놈이 돌아왔다는 소문이 돌기 시작했다. 그리고 정말로 돌아왔지! 그게 바로 그 괴물의 본성이었던 거다.

english: So it was truly undying?
translation: 그럼 정말로 죽지 않는 존재였던 거예요?

english: Does the Egregore still haunt these lands, human?
translation: Egregore(에그리고어)가 아직도 이 땅을 떠돌고 있나, 인간?

english: Hmm, I can't say I've seen it...
translation: 흠, 본 적은 없는 것 같은데요...

english: Then you must assume we were quite successful! At least by the time of my passing, the beast hadn't returned. Although, who knows? It could have taken any form by now.
translation: 그렇다면 우리가 꽤 성공했다고 봐야겠군! 적어도 내가 죽을 때까지 그 괴물은 돌아오지 않았으니. 하지만 누가 알겠나? 지금쯤이면 어떤 모습이든 하고 있을 수 있지.

english: Well I can't say for certain, but you look pretty old.
translation: 확실히는 모르겠지만, 당신 꽤 늙어 보이긴 하네요.

english: Your humour is wasted on me.
I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 전 이만 가 볼게요, 안녕히 계세요.

english: May the light of Saradomin guide you, adventurer.
Woo? Woo wooooooooo!
You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
translation: 감히 이 신성한 곳을 더럽히다니! 그 보물은 네 것이 아니다!

english: Who's this Justiciar of the Wolf?
translation: Justiciar of the Wolf(늑대의 저스티시아)는 누군데요?

english: Any great battles to speak of?
translation: 이야기해 줄 만한 큰 전투는 없어요?

english: I'm off now, goodbye.
translation: 전 이만 가 볼게요, 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hey, how's it go...
Sorry my friend, the Skipper has been grindin' me up the wrong way lately. If ye need anythin', talk t' Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 미안해, 친구. 요즘 Skipper(스키퍼) 녀석 때문에 속이 박박 긁히는 중이라. 뭐 필요한 게 있으면 저기 부두 옆에 있는 Cap'ain Pudi(푸디 선장)한테 말해 봐.

english: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?
translation: 배은망덕한 Skipper(스키퍼) 같으니. 그 난데없는 폭풍을 어떻게 나한테 뒤집어씌워?

english: Why are you angry at the Skipper?
It be a long story.
I've got time. I would love to hear it.
Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
translation: 한 보름쯤 전에, 우린 2주마다 나가는 고기잡이를 떠났지. 우리 어장까지는 내내 순항이었어.

english: Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
What's a snapper?
Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
translation: 아, 뭍사람인 걸 알아챘어야 했는데. 우리 배에선 집게쟁이라고 부르는데, 너희 뭍사람들은 바닷가재라고 하더군.

english: Anyway, back to me tale.
After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
translation: 며칠 지나서 닻을 올리고 Karamja(카람자) 해안 쪽으로 더 가까이 갔어. 거기 큰 놈들이 있거든.

english: What's a big'n?
You landlubbers... It be a shark.
Oh, how was I supposed to know?
CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
translation: 내 얘기 좀 그만 끊을 수 없겠냐고!

english: Ok...
Good, now where was I...
When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
translation: 어장에 도착했는데, Skipper(스키퍼)가 보니 물에 고기가 거의 없는 거야.

english: I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
translation: 내가 저 멀리 수평선을 보니 폭풍이 몰려오고 있길래, 그에 맞춰 항로를 바꿨지.

english: As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
translation: 그런데 마법이라도 부린 것처럼 바람이 불기 시작하더니 폭풍이 우리 쪽으로 다가오더라고.

english: Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
translation: 번개가 배에 떨어졌고, 돛을 받치던 나무 한 토막이 떨어져서 내 머리를 때렸지.

english: I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.
translation: 깨어나 보니 침대 위였는데, Skipper(스키퍼)가 대뜸 나한테 자기 배를 망가뜨렸으니 물어내라고 몰아붙이더라고.

english: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.
Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
translation: 아냐, 평소엔 좋은 사람이야. 배 때문에 속상해서 그런 거지, 뭐.

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
Watch out for the waves. If ye get hit by that you could end up lost at sea.
translation: 파도 조심해. 그거 맞으면 바다에서 길을 잃을 수도 있어.

english: Ye might find tying yourself t' somethin' using a rope t' be a life saver.
translation: rope(밧줄)로 몸을 어디에 묶어 두면 목숨을 건질 수도 있을 거야.

english: Or if ye manage to get yer hands on one of them there fancy Spirity Angler outfits, it comes with a built- in rope harness.
translation: 아니면 그 번지르르한 Spirity Angler(영혼 낚시꾼) 옷을 손에 넣으면, 밧줄 하네스가 붙어 있어.

english: I have to go.
Have a good'n. I know I won't.
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 이 힘든 시기에 알 하나 드실래요?

english: Oh, a damp egg! Yes, please!
translation: 오, damp egg(축축한 알)잖아! 그래, 줘!

english: Wait, really?
Aye, I'll add it t' me collection!
You know there's a crate of them you could just help yourself t'...
translation: 저기 그거 한 상자 있어서 그냥 마음대로 가져가셔도 되는데...

english: Hush! Don't let Timallus hear ye speak o' the damp egg crate. It'll set 'im off!
translation: 쉿! Timallus(티말루스)가 축축한 알 상자 얘기 듣게 하지 마. 또 난리 날 거야!

english: Just pass me the egg.
Thank ye kindly!
...You're welcome.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
Why are you angry at the Skipper?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
I have to go.
Hello. What are you up to?
Nothing exciting, just keeping an eye out.
translation: 별일 없어요. 그냥 주변을 살피는 중이에요.

english: Hello there, you must be Koftik.
That I am adventurer. King Lathas told me to expect you. I assume he has told you our goal?
translation: 그래요, 모험가 양반. King Lathas(라타스 왕)께서 당신이 올 거라고 하셨죠. 우리 목표는 이미 들으셨겠죠?

english: He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.
translation: Underground Pass(지하 통로)를 지나갈 길을 찾아야 한다고 하셨어요. 별로 어렵진 않을 거예요. 저도 그동안 동굴깨나 다녀 봤거든요.

english: These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...
translation: 이 동굴들은 달라요... 저 안에는 어디에도 없는 어둠이 있어요. 석순 사이를 굽이굽이 지나가다 보면 느껴질 거예요... 존재의 깊숙한 곳까지 스며드는 얼음 같은 한기가...

english: You've been in before?
I have. I didn't go far though, nor did I stay for long. People change in these caves...
translation: 있죠. 그렇게 깊이 들어가지도, 오래 머물지도 않았지만요. 이 동굴에 들어가면 사람이 변해요...

english: I'll take my chances.
Okay traveller, I'll catch up with you by the bridge.
Tell me more...
I remember one warrior. His name was Randas. He stood tall and proud like an elven king...
translation: 한 전사가 기억나요. 이름은 Randas(란다스)였죠. 엘프 왕처럼 꼿꼿하고 당당한 사람이었어요...

english: That same pride made him vulnerable. Randas' worthy desire to be a great and mighty warrior also made him corruptible.
translation: 그 자존심이 그를 약하게 만들었어요. 위대하고 강한 전사가 되고 싶다는 Randas(란다스)의 훌륭한 꿈이 그를 타락하기 쉽게 만들기도 했고요.

english: Within the cave, he heard the voice of Zamorak himself...
translation: 동굴 안에서 그는 Zamorak(자모락)의 목소리를 직접 들었어요...

english: Zamorak showed him a way to achieve his goals by appealing to that most base and dark nature... One that resides in all of us.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)은 가장 저열하고 어두운 본성을 자극해서 목표를 이룰 방법을 보여 줬죠... 우리 모두의 안에 있는 그 본성을요.

english: What happened to him?
No one knows...
Anyway, head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.
translation: 아무튼 준비되면 들어가세요. 곧 다리가 나올 거예요. 거기서 합류할게요.

english: Hi, Koftik.
Hello adventurer. We seem to have a bit of an issue ahead of us. The bridge is up and I can't see another way across.
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가 양반. 앞에 문제가 좀 생긴 것 같아요. 다리가 올라가 있는데 건너갈 다른 길이 안 보여요.

english: Do you know how to get the bridge down?
I'm afraid not. This is the furthest I've ever been. It does look like someone was here before us though, there's the remains of a camp.
translation: 유감이지만 몰라요. 저도 여기까지 와 본 건 처음이에요. 그래도 누가 우리보다 먼저 왔던 것 같아요. 야영지 흔적이 있거든요.

english: I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.
translation: 그 사람들 짐을 좀 뒤져 봤더니 cloth(천)이랑 까맣게 탄 화살 잔해가 나왔어요.

english: Charred arrows? They must have been trying to burn something. Or someone!
translation: 탄 화살이요? 뭔가를 불태우려고 했나 봐요. 아니면 누군가를요!

english: Koftik gives you some cloth. It's coated in an oil substance.
translation: Koftik(코프틱)이 cloth(천)을 건넨다. 기름 같은 것이 묻어 있다.

english: There's plenty more cloth by the fire. I also found the remains of a book...
translation: 불 옆에 cloth(천)이 더 많이 있어요. 그리고 book(책)의 잔해도 찾았어요...

english: Probably just litter.
Well... maybe?
What does it say?
It seems to be written by the adventurer Randas. Have a look.
translation: 모험가 Randas(란다스)가 쓴 것 같아요. 한번 보세요.

english: Hello Koftik.
Do you hear them? The voices tell me things.
translation: 들려요? 목소리들이 저한테 뭔가를 말해 줘요.

english: Are you OK?
The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquitiesof the selfish and the tyranny of evil men.
translation: 의로운 자의 길은 사방이 이기적인 자들의 죄악과 악한 자들의 폭정으로 둘러싸여 있어요.

english: Tyranny of the righteous? What?
So many paths to choose... Here we must all take our own path.
translation: 선택할 길이 너무 많아요... 여기서는 모두가 자기 길을 가야 해요.

english: The voices, they've been telling me things...
translation: 목소리들이요, 그 목소리들이 저한테 뭔가를 말해 주고 있어요...

english: Koftik, is everything okay? You're getting me worried.
translation: Koftik(코프틱) 씨, 정말 괜찮으세요? 걱정되기 시작하네요.

english: Don't be, friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?
translation: 걱정 마요, 친구. 그건 그렇고, 광기가 뭔지 알아요?

english: Err... what?
The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over, expecting things to change.
translation: 광기란 같은 일을 계속 되풀이하면서 뭔가 달라지길 기대하는 거예요.

english: I spent years doing the same thing, day in and day out. I always wanted more but I never got it. Now, I finally see why...
translation: 저는 몇 년이나 매일같이 똑같은 일을 했어요. 늘 더 많은 걸 원했지만 한 번도 얻지 못했죠. 이제야 겨우 그 이유를 알겠어요...

english: You see, once I was insane. But now... now I am finally free...
translation: 있잖아요, 예전의 저는 미쳐 있었어요. 하지만 지금은... 지금은 드디어 자유로워요...

english: Ah, you've arrived. We've been waiting for you.
translation: 아, 왔군요. 다들 당신을 기다리고 있었어요.

english: Koftik, you're still here? You should leave.
translation: Koftik(코프틱) 씨, 아직 여기 계셨어요? 떠나셔야 해요.

english: Leave? But this is my home now. Home with my lord. He talks to me, he's my friend.
translation: 떠나라고요? 여긴 이제 제 집인걸요. 우리 주인님과 함께하는 집이요. 그분은 저한테 말을 걸어 줘요. 제 친구예요.

english: Koftik, you really should leave these caverns.
translation: Koftik(코프틱) 씨, 정말로 이 동굴에서 나가셔야 해요.

english: Not now, we're all the same down here.  There's just you and those dwarves left.
translation: 지금은 안 돼요. 여기 아래에선 우리 모두 같아요. 남은 건 당신이랑 그 드워프들뿐이에요.

english: Dwarves?
Foolish dwarves, still believing that they can resist. No one resists Iban.
translation: 어리석은 드워프들. 아직도 저항할 수 있다고 믿다니. 아무도 Iban(이반)에게 저항할 수 없어요.

english: You could help! Deep down you know you want it! I know you already dealt with those Paladins. Now you just need to kill the dwarves!
translation: 당신이 도와줄 수 있잖아요! 마음속 깊은 곳에선 당신도 원하고 있다는 거 알아요! 그 Paladins(성기사)를 처리한 것도 알고 있어요. 이제 드워프들만 죽이면 돼요!

english: Head south and through the tunnel. You'll find the dwarves at the other end. Go slay them. Slay them for our lord!
translation: 남쪽으로 가서 터널을 지나가요. 반대편 끝에 드워프들이 있을 거예요. 가서 처단해요. 우리 주인님을 위해 처단해요!

english: Nice job killing those Paladins. You're much closer to his side now. Perhaps you could kill those dwarves as well. That would really please him.
translation: Paladins(성기사)를 죽인 건 잘했어요. 이제 그분 곁에 훨씬 가까워졌어요. 그 드워프들도 죽이면 어때요? 그분이 정말 기뻐하실 거예요.

english: Adventurer, where am I? I can't remember a thing!
translation: 모험가 양반, 여기가 어디죠? 아무것도 기억이 안 나요!

english: We were losing you to Iban's influence.
What? Of course, the voices... But they've stopped. What happened?
translation: 네? 맞다, 그 목소리들... 그런데 멈췄어요. 무슨 일이 있었던 거죠?

english: Iban's dead, I destroyed him.
You've done well! Thanks for saving me.
But what about you, adventurer? Did the voices not affect you?
translation: 그런데 당신은 어때요, 모험가 양반? 그 목소리들이 당신한텐 영향을 안 줬어요?

english: Your mind is filled with strange images. A unicorn. A boulder. Some paladins. They seem real... but were they?
translation: 당신 머릿속이 이상한 이미지로 가득하네요. 유니콘. 큰 바위. 성기사 몇 명. 진짜처럼 보이는데... 정말 그랬을까요?

english: I... I don't think so...
I see. We must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.
translation: 그렇군요. 이제 왕께 알려야 해요. 따라와요, 밖으로 안내할게요.

english: At last! I've had enough of these caves.
Koftik leads you back through the winding caverns to the entrance. But it feels like part of you has been left behind...
translation: Koftik(코프틱)이 굽이진 동굴을 지나 입구까지 당신을 안내한다. 하지만 당신의 일부가 그곳에 남겨진 것만 같다...

english: Thanks for showing me the way out Koftik.
translation: 밖으로 나가는 길을 안내해 줘서 고마워요, Koftik(코프틱) 씨.

english: Always a pleasure. Have you informed the king about Iban?
translation: 언제든지요. Iban(이반)에 대해 왕께 알려 드렸어요?

english: No, not yet.
This is no time to linger. The king must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical event for Ardougne.
translation: 꾸물거릴 때가 아니에요. 왕께서 Iban(이반)이 죽었다는 걸 아셔야 해요. 이건 Ardougne(아르둔) 역사에 남을 일이에요.

english: Hello adventurer, how's things?
Not bad, yourself?
I'm good... just keeping an eye out.
translation: 저야 잘 지내죠... 그냥 주변을 살피는 중이에요.

english: I found this by the way. I guess you'll be wanting it back.
translation: 그건 그렇고 이걸 찾았어요. 돌려받고 싶으시겠죠.

english: Thanks Koftik.
Hello [player name], how's things?
These traps don't get any easier. But I'm alright, thanks.
translation: 이 함정들은 해도 해도 쉬워지질 않네요. 그래도 전 괜찮아요, 고마워요.

english: Good to hear.
I'll take my chances.
Tell me more...
Probably just litter.
What does it say?
Hello there. What is this place?
Do not waste my time with trivial questions. I am the Great Kolodion, master of battle magic. I have an arena to run.
translation: 시시한 질문으로 내 시간을 낭비하지 말게. 나는 전투 마법의 대가, 위대한 Kolodion(콜로디온)일세. 나는 경기장을 운영해야 하네.

english: Can I enter?
Hah! A wizard of your level? Don't be absurd.
translation: 하! 자네 수준의 마법사가? 터무니없는 소리 말게.

english: I am the great Kolodion, master of battle magic, and this is my battle arena. Top wizards travel from all over Gielinor to fight here.
translation: 나는 전투 마법의 대가, 위대한 Kolodion(콜로디온)이고, 이곳은 나의 전투 경기장일세. Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 최고의 마법사들이 이곳에 싸우러 오지.

english: Can I fight here?
My arena is open to any high level wizard, but this is no game. Many wizards fall in this arena, never to rise again. The strongest mages have been destroyed.
translation: 내 경기장은 레벨 높은 마법사라면 누구에게나 열려 있네만, 장난이 아닐세. 수많은 마법사가 이 경기장에서 쓰러져 다시는 일어나지 못했지. 가장 강한 마법사들도 파멸했다네.

english: If you're sure you want in?
Yes indeedy.
Good, good. You have a healthy sense of competition.
translation: 좋아, 좋아. 자네는 건전한 경쟁심을 지녔군.

english: Remember, traveller - in my arena, hand-to-hand combat is useless. Your strength will diminish as you enter the arena, but the spells you can learn are amongst the most powerful in all of Gielinor.
translation: 명심하게, 여행자 - 내 경기장에서 맨손 격투는 쓸모가 없네. 경기장에 들어서면 자네의 힘은 약해지겠지만, 여기서 배울 수 있는 주문은 Gielinor(길리노르) 전체에서도 손꼽히게 강력하다네.

english: Before I can accept you in, we must duel.
translation: 자네를 받아들이기 전에 우리는 결투를 해야 하네.

english: Okay, let's fight.
I must first check that you are up to scratch.
You don't need to worry about that.
Not just any magician can enter - only the most powerful and most feared. Before you can use the power of this arena, you must prove yourself against me.
translation: 아무 마법사나 들어올 수 있는 게 아닐세 - 가장 강하고 가장 두려움을 사는 자만이 들어올 수 있지. 이 경기장의 힘을 쓰기 전에 나를 상대로 자네를 증명해야 하네.

english: The player is teleported to the Mage Arena to fight against Kolodion
translation: 플레이어가 Mage Arena(마법사 경기장)으로 순간이동해 Kolodion(콜로디온)과 싸운다

english: No thanks.
No I don't.
Your loss.
What's the point of that?
We learn how to use our magic to its fullest and how to channel the forces of the cosmos into our world...
translation: 우리는 마법을 최대한으로 쓰는 법과 우주의 힘을 우리 세계로 끌어오는 법을 배우지...

english: But mainly, I just like blasting people into dust.
translation: 하지만 사실 난 그냥 사람들을 날려 먼지로 만드는 게 좋다네.

english: That's barbaric!
Nope, it's magic. But I know what you mean. So do you want to join us?
translation: 아니, 마법일세. 하지만 무슨 말인지는 알겠네. 그래서, 우리와 함께하겠나?

english: You must prove yourself... now!
This is only the beginning; you can't beat me!
translation: 이건 시작에 불과하네. 자네는 날 이길 수 없어!

english: Foolish mortal; I am unstoppable.
translation: 어리석은 필멸자여. 누구도 날 막을 수 없다!

english: Now you feel it... The dark energy.
Aaaaaaaarrgghhhh! The power!
The player is teleported back to the safe zone after defeating Kolodion's final form
translation: Kolodion(콜로디온)의 마지막 형태를 쓰러뜨린 플레이어가 안전 구역으로 순간이동한다

english: Well done, young adventurer; you truly are a worthy battle mage.
translation: 잘했네, 젊은 모험가. 자네는 진정 훌륭한 전투 마법사일세.

english: What now?
Step into the magic pool. It will take you to a chamber. There, you must decide which god you will represent in the arena.
translation: 마법 웅덩이로 들어가게. 그러면 어떤 방으로 가게 될 걸세. 거기서 경기장에서 어느 신을 대표할지 정해야 하네.

english: Thanks, Kolodion.
That's what I'm here for.
Hello, Kolodion.
Hello, young mage. You're a tough one.
translation: 안녕하신가, 젊은 마법사. 자네 꽤 강하더군.

english: You're not allowed in there. Come downstairs if you want to enter my arena.
translation: 거기는 들어가면 안 되네. 내 경기장에 들어오고 싶으면 아래층으로 오게.

english: Can I fight here?
Yes indeedy.
Okay, let's fight.
No thanks.
No I don't.
What's the point of that?
That's barbaric!
I see we have a new arrival. A bringer of death. Tell me, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 새로 온 자가 있군요. 죽음을 가져오는 자여. 말해 보십시오. 균형을 섬기러 왔습니까?

english: Bringer of death, have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 죽음을 가져오는 자여, 균형을 섬기러 왔습니까?

english: I need another assignment.
You are to bring balance to [amount] [monster] in [area].
Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Can I cancel that task?
Your task has been cancelled.
Okay, great!
Once the balance has been served, return to me.
translation: 균형을 섬기는 일을 마쳤다면 제게 돌아오십시오.

english: Where is that area?
You're still bringing balance to [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you're finished.
translation: 아직 [task monster]에게 균형을 가져다주는 중이군요. [amount]마리 남았습니다. 다 마치면 돌아오십시오.
