english: You're still meant to be bringing balance to [monster] in [area], with [amount] to go.
Bringer of death, I do not feel you are ready for your current task. If you wish, I can cancel it. This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 죽음을 가져오는 자여, 아직 지금 임무를 감당할 준비가 되지 않은 것 같습니다. 원한다면 취소해 드리지요. 임무 연속 기록은 사라지지 않습니다.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Very well. If you still wish to maintain the balance, you can get a new assignment.
translation: 알겠습니다. 계속 균형을 지키고 싶다면 새 임무를 받으면 됩니다.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Then I wish you well, bringer of death.
translation: 그렇다면 행운을 빕니다, 죽음을 가져오는 자여.

english: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Those who serve the balance are always rewarded. I can grant these rewards. I can also grant you the equipment needed to serve the balance, for a price of course.
translation: 균형을 섬기는 자는 언제나 보상을 받습니다. 제가 그 보상을 드릴 수 있지요. 균형을 섬기는 데 필요한 장비도 드릴 수 있습니다. 물론 대가는 받습니다.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
When tasking you to serve the balance, I do not currently consider your combat level.
translation: 지금은 균형을 섬기는 임무를 맡길 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하지 않습니다.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: Your zeal is to be commended. Use it well when serving the balance.
translation: 그 열의는 칭찬받아 마땅합니다. 균형을 섬길 때 잘 쓰십시오.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: As you wish. From now on, your combat level will be taken into account when tasks are assigned.
translation: 원하는 대로 하지요. 이제부터 임무를 맡길 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하겠습니다.

english: When tasking you to serve the balance, I consider your combat level, so you shouldn't get anything too challenging.
translation: 균형을 섬기는 임무를 맡길 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하고 있으니, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 겁니다.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Then we will continue on our current path.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 제 전투 레벨은 그만 따지세요 - 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Your zeal is to be commended. From now on, your combat level will not be considered when tasks are assigned.
translation: 그 열의는 칭찬받아 마땅합니다. 이제부터 임무를 맡길 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하지 않겠습니다.

english: I'd rather not.
Who are you?
A guardian of life, and a bringer of death. There must always be a balance. My people and I serve this balance. You could serve the balance as well, but you'll need some practice first.
translation: 생명의 수호자이자 죽음을 가져오는 자입니다. 언제나 균형이 있어야 합니다. 저와 제 일족은 이 균형을 섬깁니다. 당신도 균형을 섬길 수 있지만, 먼저 연습이 좀 필요합니다.

english: There is a Slayer Master in Burthorpe, he goes by the name of Turael. Learn from him, and you will soon be ready to serve.
translation: Burthorpe(버소프)에 Turael(투라엘)이라는 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 있습니다. 그에게 배우십시오. 그러면 곧 균형을 섬길 준비가 될 겁니다.

english: A bringer of death calls from afar. What do you desire?
translation: 멀리서 죽음을 가져오는 자가 부르는군요. 무엇을 원합니까?

english: Err... Nothing...
Bringer of death, why do you insist on using such magic when I'm right next to you? Come and talk to me.
translation: 죽음을 가져오는 자여, 제가 바로 옆에 있는데 왜 굳이 그런 마법을 씁니까? 이리 와서 말을 거십시오.

english: How am I doing so far?
You're currently assigned to bring balance to [monster] in [area]; you have [amount] more to go. Your reward point tally is [amount].
translation: 지금 [area]에서 [monster]에게 균형을 가져다주는 임무를 맡고 있습니다. [amount]마리 더 남았습니다. 보상 점수는 [amount]점입니다.

english: I am Konar quo Maten. Like you, I am a bringer of death. Together, we can serve the balance.
translation: 저는 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)입니다. 당신처럼 저도 죽음을 가져오는 자입니다. 함께 균형을 섬길 수 있을 겁니다.

english: Where are you?
You'll find me on Mount Karuulm. I'll be here when you need a new purpose.
translation: Mount Karuulm(카룰름 산)에서 저를 찾을 수 있습니다. 새로운 목적이 필요할 때 이곳에 있겠습니다.

english: Nothing really.
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
Can I cancel that task? (30 Points)
Where is that area?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요 - 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 제 전투 레벨은 그만 따지세요 - 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: I'd rather not.
Who are you?
Err... Nothing...
How am I doing so far?
Where are you?
Nothing really.
More digging, less talking!
What's going on here?
I'm digging for saltpetre, of course. Got to have plenty of saltpetre for the farms. You should grab a spade and get to work too - they always need saltpetre.
translation: 보면 몰라? saltpetre(초석) 캐는 중이지. 농장에 쓰려면 초석이 많이 필요하거든. 너도 spade(삽) 하나 들고 일이나 해. 농장은 늘 초석이 모자라니까.

english: What can I do with saltpetre?
It's a critical ingredient in a special fertiliser used on the farms here. Just mix it with some compost - ordinary compost, not that super stuff - to make the fertiliser.
translation: 농장에서 쓰는 특수 비료의 핵심 재료야. compost(퇴비)랑 섞기만 하면 비료가 돼. 평범한 퇴비여야 해, 슈퍼 퇴비 말고.

english: Once you've got fertiliser, you can use it on Farmer Gricoller's fruit farm. Alternatively, Hosidius farmers always want some. You could sell it to them.
translation: 비료가 생기면 Farmer Gricoller(농부 그리콜러)의 과일 농장에 쓸 수 있어. 아니면 Hosidius(호시디우스) 농부들이 늘 찾으니까 그 사람들한테 팔아도 되고.

english: Have you got a spare spade?
Yes, but you've got no room for it.
translation: 있긴 한데, 넌 그거 넣을 자리가 없잖아.

english: Yes, but I can see you don't need it.
translation: 있긴 한데, 보니까 넌 필요 없겠네.

english: I'll leave you to work.
Very well done, now let me get back to digging!
translation: 그래, 그럼 됐어. 난 다시 땅이나 파야겠다!

english: You've obtained a casket!
What's going on here?
What can I do with saltpetre?
Have you got a spare spade?
I'll leave you to work.
Human. The Drakes through this tunnel are not to be killed without permission. To do so would be an affront to the balance.
translation: 인간이여. 이 터널 너머의 Drakes(드레이크)는 허락 없이 죽여서는 안 된다. 그렇게 하는 것은 균형에 대한 모독이다.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: 인간이여! 이 생물들을 공격하는 것은 균형을 위협하는 일이다. 허락받은 자만이 이들과 싸울 수 있다!

english: Hello there. You've come to the right place if you're looking for adventurer's equipment.
translation: 안녕하세요. 모험가 장비를 찾고 계신다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요.

english: Oh that sounds interesting.
No, sorry, I've come to the wrong place.
Hmph. Well, perhaps next time you'll need something from me?
translation: 흥. 뭐, 다음번엔 저한테 필요한 게 있으시겠죠?

english: Oh that sounds interesting.
No, sorry, I've come to the wrong place.
What human need help with?
Make[sword style]sword.
What's my current commission?
Go make[sword style]sword.
I'm not sure what something does.
translation: 뭐가 뭘 하는 건지 잘 모르겠어요.

english: What do not understand, little one?
How do I use the crucible?
Crucible just a big bucket... We put metal in and it melt it down to make swords.
translation: 도가니 그냥 큰 양동이... 우리 금속 넣으면 도가니가 녹여서 검 만들어.

english: Crucible let us add differing metals... and can store up to 28 metal bar worth, Kovac think.
translation: 도가니에 여러 금속 섞어 넣을 수 있어... 그리고 금속 주괴 28개만큼 담을 수 있어, Kovac(코바치) 생각에.

english: We can put other metal thing in too, like sword and armour.
translation: 다른 금속 물건도 넣을 수 있어, 검이나 갑옷 같은 거.

english: Need help with anything else?
What does the mould jig do?
Mould jig very handy... It let us make differing type of sword.
translation: 거푸집 지그 아주 쓸모 있어... 여러 종류 검 만들게 해 줘.

english: We want use mould parts to fit condi... commission... so when setting up mould, find parts that match.
translation: 거푸집 부품 조건... 의뢰... 맞게 써야 해... 그러니까 거푸집 세팅할 때 맞는 부품 찾아.

english: Some match commission better than other... so find best one for job.
translation: 어떤 건 다른 거보다 의뢰에 더 잘 맞아... 그러니까 일에 제일 좋은 거 찾아.

english: How do I control the preform's temperature?
That very easy... If preform too cold, dunk in lava... If preform too hot, hold to waterfall.
translation: 그거 아주 쉬워... 예비 성형물 너무 차가우면 lava(용암)에 담가... 너무 뜨거우면 waterfall(폭포)에 대.

english: Preform need to be right temperature to work with tool.
translation: 예비 성형물 온도 알맞아야 도구로 작업할 수 있어.

english: Trip hammer need preform to be hot... Grindstone need preform to be warm... Polishing wheel need preform to be cold.
translation: Trip hammer(기계 해머)는 예비 성형물 뜨거워야 해... Grindstone(숫돌)은 따뜻해야 해... Polishing wheel(연마 바퀴)는 차가워야 해.

english: When should I use a tool?
Hmm... Kovac think it a gut feeling thing...
translation: 흠... Kovac(코바치) 생각에 그거 감으로 하는 거...

english: That doesn't help me.
Hmm... that is true.
Progress on your sword can be tracked via the display on screen. You can track which tool you need to use via the completion bar.
translation: 검의 진행 상황은 화면 표시로 확인할 수 있어. 어떤 도구를 써야 하는지는 완성도 막대로 확인할 수 있어.

english: Actually, I'm okay for now.
Okay.
Can I scrap my current commission?
Why want that?
I don't think I'm really feeling it at the moment.
That okay, Kovac will give reward even if sword bad. Maybe you put in storage for working later, but Kovac no scrap swords.
translation: 괜찮아, 검 나빠도 Kovac(코바치) 보상 줘. 보관함에 넣었다가 나중에 작업하면 돼. 근데 코바치 검 버리기는 안 해.

english: I'd like to buy something.
Here's what Kovac have.
I'm okay for now.
Okay friend, Kovac here to help.
translation: 알았어 친구, Kovac(코바치) 도와주러 여기 있어.

english: You no sword to hand over. I give new commission if want?
translation: 넘겨줄 검 없어. 원하면 새 의뢰 줄까?

english: You no sword to hand over. Kovac give commission already. Go make me[sword style]sword.
translation: 넘겨줄 검 없어. Kovac(코바치) 의뢰 벌써 줬어. 가서 [sword style]검 만들어 와.

english: Hmm... sword not finished yet. Keep working.
translation: 흠... 검 아직 안 끝났어. 계속 작업해.

english: Hmm... sword look good. Hand over.

Sword completed in: [time] at quality: [quality]  Best completed in: [best time] at quality: [best quality]  You're awarded: [number] Smithing XP and [number] coins.  Total swords made in the Giants Foundry: [number]
translation: 검 완성 시간: [time], 품질: [quality]  최고 기록: [best time], 품질: [best quality]  보상: Smithing(대장일) 경험치 [number], 코인 [number]개.  Giants Foundry(거인의 주조소)에서 만든 검 총 개수: [number]

english: Sword no good. Give it here.
Sword completed in: [time] at quality: 0  Best completed in: [best time] at quality: [best quality]  You're awarded: 30 Smithing XP and 60 coins.  Total swords made in the Giants Foundry: [number]
translation: 검 완성 시간: [time], 품질: 0  최고 기록: [best time], 품질: [best quality]  보상: Smithing(대장일) 경험치 30, 코인 60개.  Giants Foundry(거인의 주조소)에서 만든 검 총 개수: [number]

english: Kovac give commission already. Go make me[sword style]sword.
translation: Kovac(코바치) 의뢰 벌써 줬어. 가서 [sword style]검 만들어 와.

english: Kovac does not want that back. Maybe the smith clothes would be good, if you got any.
translation: Kovac(코바치) 그거 돌려받기 싫어. smith clothes(대장장이 옷)라면 좋겠어, 있으면.

english: No, you keep that or give it to someone else.
translation: 아니, 그거 네가 가지거나 다른 사람 줘.

english: Can't you make an exception for me? I'm an Ironman by the way.
translation: 저한테만 예외로 해 주시면 안 돼요? 참고로 저 Ironman(아이언맨)이에요.

english: You get treated the same anyway.
You keep that.
Can I get a new commission?
What's my current commission?
I'm not sure what something does.
translation: 뭐가 뭘 하는 건지 잘 모르겠어요.

english: How do I use the crucible?
What does the mould jig do?
How do I control the preform's temperature?
When should I use a tool?
Actually, I'm okay for now.
I'm not sure what something does, can you help me?
translation: 뭐가 뭘 하는 건지 잘 모르겠어요. 도와줄 수 있어요?

english: Can I scrap my current commission?
I'd like to buy something.
I'm okay for now.
Yes.
No.
Accept
Decline
Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which one were you thinking of?
translation: 그럴 수도 있지. 어느 밭 말이야?

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭엔 씨앗이 하나도 안 심겨 있잖아. 뭐라도 심고 오면 돌봐 줄지 생각해 보지.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 벌써 다 자랐잖아! 나더러 대체 뭘 하라는 거야!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 그 밭은 죽었어. 이제 와서 내가 해 줄 수 있는 건 없다고.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 그 밭은 병들었잖아. 나한테 맡기기 전에 병부터 고쳐 와!

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 무슨 소리야? 그 밭은 이미 내가 돌봐 주고 있잖아.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
If you like, but I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 buckets of compost(퇴비 양동이) 2개는 받아야겠어.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 흥, 난 공짜로 시간 낭비 안 해.

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 그 정도면 됐어, [sir/madam]. 나한테 맡겨. 그 밭은 확실히 키워 줄 테니까.

english: No, that's too much.
If you like, but I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 sack of potatoes(감자 자루) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 sack of onions(양파 자루) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 sacks of cabbages(양배추 자루) 2개는 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want 10 jute fibres for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 jute fibres(황마 섬유) 10개는 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 basket of apples(사과 바구니) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 curry leaves(커리 잎) 10장은 받아야겠어.

english: If you like, but I want 5 jangerberries for that.
translation: 원한다면 해 주지. 대신 jangerberries(쟁거베리) 5개는 받아야겠어.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 덤불이나 나무의 병을 고치는 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 것뿐이야. 다른 작물은 그냥 plant-cure(식물 치료제)를 쓰면 돼.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 먼저 흙을 담은 plantpot(화분)에서 sapling(묘목)으로 키운 다음, tree patch(나무 밭)으로 옮겨 심어서 다 자랄 때까지 키워야 해.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 채소 자루에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 열 개까지 넣을 수 있어. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 넣을 순 없지.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어. 상점은 텃밭 근처에 있고.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 키울 수 있어. 거긴 땅이 유난히 축축해서 독버섯 키우기에 딱이거든.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 보통 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만 만드는 데 돈이 더 들어. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든. 아이템을 보여 주면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 주지.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 키우는 특별한 밭이 있어. 아마 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처 어딘가일 거야. 그 동네 땅이 좀 '부정'하거든.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 compost(퇴비)를 주면 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라, 수확할 작물도 더 많아져.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 과일나무를 키우고 싶으면 몇 군데 가 봐. Catherby(캐서비), Brimhaven(브림헤이븐), Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새), Farming Guild(농사 길드)에 전부 과일나무 밭이 있어.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 plantpot(화분)을 채울 수 있어.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일 빚는 데 좋아. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다던데, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 그런 걸로 유명했다는 소문을 들었지. 물론 거기 사람들이 다 죽기 전 얘기지만.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 계속 물을 줘야 해. 내 조언을 무시했다간 머지않아 죽어 버린 농사 밭을 떠안게 될 거야.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 과일 바구니에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 다섯 개까지 담을 수 있어. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없지.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭을 갈퀴질하고 나온 weeds(잡초)를 그냥 버리지 마. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만들라고.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 이런 Farming(농사) 구역은 여기 말고도 다섯 군데가 더 있어. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단타에라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역이지.

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 이런 Farming(농사) 구역은 여기 말고도 다섯 군데가 더 있어. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단타에라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역, 그리고 Oswallt(오스왈트)의

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 자루나 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶으면 Falador(팔라도르)의 농사 상점 근처에 있는 loom(베틀)을 써야 해. 물론 네가 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman](이)라면 말이지.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: plantpot(화분)을 전부 사서 쓸 필요는 없어. pottery wheel(도자기 물레)로 직접 만들 수도 있거든. 물론 네가 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman](이)라면 말이지.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 내가 팔 물건이 있느냐에 달렸지. 뭘 찾는데?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 식물 치료제라고? 내가 쓰려고 따로 챙겨 둔 게 좀 있을지도. 이렇게 하지. 원하면 식물 치료제를 25코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 사실, 그걸 들고 갈 자리가 없을 것 같아요.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있어요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: 퇴비 양동이라고? 남는 게 하나 있을지도... 이렇게 하지. 원하면 35코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 갈퀴라고? 남는 게 하나 있을지도... 이렇게 하지. 원하면 15코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 에휴, 화분 하나쯤은 내줄 수 있지. 대신 40코인은 받아야겠어.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: 물뿌리개라고? 남는 게 하나 있을지도... 이렇게 하지. 원하면 25코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 원예용 모종삽이라고? 남는 게 하나 있을지도... 이렇게 하지. 원하면 15코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: 씨앗 구멍 막대라고? 남는 게 하나 있을지도... 이렇게 하지. 원하면 15코인에 팔아 줄게.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 됐어요, 저한테 필요한 건 하나도 없네요.

english: I'll come back another time.
I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 그 밭은 이미 내가 돌봐 주고 있어.

english: I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: sack of potatoes(감자 자루) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: sack of onions(양파 자루) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
I want 10 jute fibres for that.
I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: basket of apples(사과 바구니) 하나는 받아야겠어.

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
I want 5 jangerberries for that.
That looks like something that you can make normal compost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of compost.
translation: 그건 보통 퇴비를 만들 수 있는 물건 같군. compost bin(퇴비통)을 그런 걸로 채우면 언젠가 퇴비통 한가득 퇴비가 생길 거야.

english: That looks like something that you can make supercompost out of. Fill up the compost bin with stuff like that, and you'll eventually have a bin full of supercompost.
translation: 그건 supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)를 만들 수 있는 물건 같군. compost bin(퇴비통)을 그런 걸로 채우면 언젠가 퇴비통 한가득 슈퍼 퇴비가 생길 거야.

english: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
translation: 남는 snowdrop seeds(스노드롭 씨앗) 좀 있어요?

english: No I don't, as it happens. Sorry.
But I was told that you did!
Well, you were told wrong then!
Goodbye!!
You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
Oh, you think so?!? And what concern is it of yours?
translation: 아, 그렇게 보여?!? 그게 너랑 무슨 상관인데?

english: I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: 상관하려는 건 아니고요, 그냥 snowdrop seeds(스노드롭 씨앗)을 좀 주셨으면 해서요.

english: Is that right?!? Well, I do actually have some snowdrop seeds, but you would be the last person I would give them to.
translation: 아, 그러셔?!? 그래, 사실 스노드롭 씨앗이 있긴 있어. 근데 너한테만큼은 절대 안 줄 거야.

english: I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: 같은 인간이 이렇게 속상해하는 걸 보고 있기가 힘들어서요.

english: I must say, you don't often meet people who show concern the way you have done.
translation: 이거 참, 너처럼 남 걱정해 주는 사람은 흔치 않은데.

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
translation: 더는 못 참겠어요. 그냥 씨앗이나 주세요.

english: And to think I listened to you! I was right after all - there is no kindness between human beings anymore.
translation: 너 같은 놈 말을 들어 준 내가 바보지! 역시 내 말이 맞았어. 이제 인간끼리 친절 같은 건 없다고.

english: So what ails you, my friend?
translation: 그래서 무슨 일로 속을 썩이세요, 친구?

english: All these people, asking me to look after their crops! And no-one ever asking me how I feel, or if there's something they can do for me!
translation: 다들 자기 작물 좀 돌봐 달라고만 하잖아! 내 기분이 어떤지, 나한테 뭐 해 줄 건 없는지 물어보는 사람은 아무도 없다고!

english: Oh stop whining, it's not like you do it for free.
translation: 아, 징징대지 좀 마세요. 공짜로 해 주는 것도 아니면서.

english: Well, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 그럼, 제가 뭐 해 드릴 일은 없어요?

english: Oh, that's very kind of you! And there I was, thinking of giving it all up and heading off across the seas to find my fortune!
translation: 아, 정말 친절하구나! 난 다 때려치우고 바다 건너 한몫 잡으러 떠날까 생각하던 참이었는데!

english: Don't let me stop you, there are plenty of ships missing cabin boys.
translation: 말리지 않을게요. 사환 자리 비어 있는 배는 널렸으니까요.

english: If you carry on speaking to me like that I might just put this spade to good use, and I'm not talking about digging!
translation: 계속 그딴 식으로 말하면 이 spade(삽)을 제대로 써 줄 수도 있어. 땅 파는 데 쓰겠다는 소리가 아니야!

english: So what can I do for you?
translation: 그래서 제가 뭘 해 드리면 될까요?

english: I'd like just for once for somebody to grow something for me. Just something simple; some vegetables would be nice.
translation: 딱 한 번만이라도 누가 날 위해 뭘 좀 키워 줬으면 좋겠어. 간단한 거면 돼. 채소 같은 거면 좋겠군.

english: How about some potatoes?
Nah, there's a whole field of them over to the west. I don't have any particular use for onions, so how about cabbages, then?
translation: 됐어, 그건 서쪽에 밭 하나 가득 있어. 양파는 딱히 쓸 데가 없고... 그럼 양배추는 어때?

english: Cabbages? Sounds good to me. Where do you want me to grow them?
Oh, in one of these allotments here. Plant them from seed, and when they're ready for harvesting let me know, I'll give you your seeds.
translation: 아, 여기 텃밭 중 아무 데나. 씨앗부터 심어서 수확할 때가 되면 알려 줘. 그럼 네가 원하는 씨앗을 줄게.

english: That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
translation: 좋아요, 거래하죠. 양배추가 다 자라면 알려 드릴게요.

english: I'm not wasting my time growing cabbages.
And I'm not wasting my seeds on an upstart like you!
translation: 나도 너 같은 건방진 녀석한테 씨앗을 낭비하긴 싫거든!

english: Aarrrrrghhhh! I hate cabbages!!!! Give me the seeds!!!!!
Give ... you ... the ...
... yes I should ...
... no I won't ...
Not after speaking to me like that you upstart!!! Is it a deal or not?!?
translation: 그런 식으로 말해 놓고 어림없지, 이 건방진 녀석아!!! 할 거야, 말 거야?!?

english: What did you ask me to do?
You said that you would grow me some cabbages in one of these allotments. When they're ready for harvest come and talk to me, and I'll give you those snowdrop seeds that you're after.
translation: 여기 텃밭 중 하나에 양배추를 키워 주겠다고 했잖아. 수확할 때가 되면 와서 말해. 그럼 네가 찾는 스노드롭 씨앗을 줄게.

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some cabbages for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: 지금 그걸 나한테 부탁하는 거야? 나는 날 위해 양배추를 키워 달라고 했지, 네 양배추를 나더러 돌봐 달라고 한 게 아니야! 싫어, 안 돌봐 줘!

english: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.
Yes, I saw - what fine farming prowess! Nobody has ever done anything like that for me before; here you go, these are the seeds you were after I believe.
translation: 그래, 봤어. 대단한 농사 솜씨더군! 날 위해 이런 걸 해 준 사람은 네가 처음이야. 자, 여기 네가 찾던 씨앗이야.

english: I would give you some, but you don't appear to have room to carry them.
translation: 좀 주고 싶은데, 넌 들고 갈 자리가 없어 보이는군.

english: Yes, here you go - I hope they grow for you.
translation: 그래, 여기 있어. 잘 자라면 좋겠군.

english: Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Group of Advanced Gardeners(고급 정원사 모임)의 회원이세요?

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: Martin(마틴) 씨가 작물이 다 시드는 이유를 조사해 달라고 부탁했어요.

english: I've already told you everything I suspect.
translation: 내가 의심하는 건 이미 다 말해 줬잖아.

english: Ah, Martin sent you, why didn't you say so? I personally think that our problems are all down to the fact that we haven't had enough rain of late. It's plain to see - just look at the levels of the rivers.
translation: 아, Martin(마틴)이 보냈다고? 진작 말하지 그랬어? 내 생각엔 요즘 비가 충분히 안 와서 이 모든 문제가 생긴 거야. 딱 보면 알지. 강 수위만 봐도 말이야.

english: We need more rain. I don't suppose you can do anything about that?
translation: 비가 더 와야 해. 설마 네가 그걸 어떻게 할 수 있는 건 아니겠지?

english: No, I'm afraid not.
translation: 네, 그건 안 될 것 같아요.

english: Well there you go then. Until you find out how to make it rain you're going to have a hard time solving our problems.
translation: 그것 봐. 비를 내리게 하는 방법을 알아내기 전까진 우리 문제를 해결하기 힘들 거다.

english: Insects! That's what you can tell him! Insects! Stop the insects from eating so many of our crops and we'd get maximum yield, I tell you!
translation: 벌레야! 그 사람한테 그렇게 전해! 벌레라고! 벌레들이 우리 작물을 그렇게 먹어 치우는 것만 막으면 수확량이 최대로 나올 거라니까!

english: How can you ask such a thing? It's obvious! It's all you adventurers. Every time I get a crop planted, some adventurer comes along and digs it up and plants crops of their own, as if they owned my farming patch!
translation: 어떻게 그런 걸 물어? 뻔하잖아! 다 너희 모험가들 때문이야. 작물을 심기만 하면 웬 모험가가 와서 다 파내고 자기 작물을 심는다고. 내 농사 밭이 자기 거라도 되는 것처럼!

english: It's really annoying! You should speak to your friends about their rude behaviour!
translation: 정말 짜증 난다고! 네 친구들한테 그 무례한 짓 좀 그만하라고 말해!

english: But...but...they're not my friends! I've never even spoken to most of them!
translation: 그, 그치만... 걔네는 제 친구가 아니에요! 대부분은 말 한마디 해 본 적도 없다고요!

english: Don't give me that! You're an adventurer, they're all adventurers. I bet you have some sort of secret guild and you gather there and say things like 'let's annoy the gardeners this week', don't you?
translation: 거짓말 마! 넌 모험가고, 걔네도 다 모험가잖아. 분명 너희끼리 비밀 길드 같은 게 있어서, 거기 모여서 '이번 주엔 정원사들을 괴롭혀 보자' 같은 소리나 하겠지, 안 그래?

english: No, I mean yes. There is a heroes guild, but ...!
translation: 아뇨, 아니 그러니까 네. heroes guild(영웅의 길드)가 있긴 한데, 그게...!

english: Aha, so you admit it then! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
translation: 아하, 그럼 인정하는 거지! 부끄러운 줄 알아!

english: Oh, I give up!
Well obviously it's the seasons. They all seem to be out- of-wack these days. Summer comes earlier and earlier each year, but then it simply rushes by!
translation: 뻔하지, 계절 때문이야. 요즘 계절이 죄다 뒤죽박죽이라고. 여름이 해마다 점점 빨리 오는데, 또 금방 휙 지나가 버리잖아!

english: If you find out what is upsetting the seasons you'll find out what is causing the harvest to fail.
translation: 뭐가 계절을 어지럽히는지 알아내면 수확이 망하는 원인도 알게 될 거야.

english: I don't suppose you have any ideas about what could cause the seasons to be mixed up?
translation: 계절을 뒤섞어 놓을 만한 게 뭔지 짚이는 거라도 없으세요?

english: No, sorry, but find that out and you'll get to the root of our problems.
translation: 아니, 미안하지만 없어. 그래도 그걸 알아내면 우리 문제의 뿌리까지 파고들 수 있을 거야.

english: Well I can tell by the look on your face that I'm not the first person you've asked. Why don't you tell me what you've heard from other members of the group so far?
translation: 얼굴 표정을 보니 나한테 처음 묻는 건 아닌가 보군. 지금까지 모임의 다른 회원들한테 들은 얘기를 말해 보는 게 어때?

english: Why not? They all seem to be a bunch of loonies anyway.
translation: 안 될 거 없죠. 어차피 다들 좀 정신 나간 사람들 같으니까요.

english: I've been told that it's the lack of rain, plagues of insects and recently I was told that the entire order of seasons is confused!
translation: 비가 부족하다는 얘기도 들었고, 벌레 떼 얘기도 들었고, 최근엔 계절 순서가 통째로 엉망이 됐다는 얘기도 들었어요!

english: I have no idea what to do about any of it. I'm an adventurer, not a weather controller!
translation: 그걸 다 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요. 저는 모험가지 날씨 조종사가 아니라고요!

english: Did you ever consider that all those theories might be correct?
translation: 그 이론들이 전부 맞을 수도 있다는 생각은 안 해 봤어?

english: But they're all different, how could they all be correct?
translation: 하지만 다 제각각인데, 어떻게 전부 맞을 수가 있어요?

english: I'll let you into a little secret that'll explain it all to you. In a word - fairies!
translation: 다 설명해 줄 작은 비밀을 하나 알려 주지. 한마디로 말하면, 요정이야!

english: Oh no! Not another crack-pot theory!
translation: 아, 안 돼! 또 황당한 이론이잖아요!

english: I'm serious!
Think it through. There are fairies who control everything natural from the weather to the seasons.
translation: 잘 생각해 봐. 날씨부터 계절까지 자연의 모든 걸 다스리는 요정들이 있잖아.

english: Surely if all of those things have been mentioned as catalysts to our problems it stands to reason that the fairies are actually the cause?
translation: 그 모든 게 우리 문제의 원인으로 꼽혔다면, 사실은 요정들이 원인이라고 보는 게 당연한 이치 아니겠어?

english: Right, well thanks for your input. I'll think over what you said.
translation: 네, 의견 감사해요. 말씀하신 거 잘 생각해 볼게요.

english: I don't think the crops ARE failing, now leave me alone, I have work to do.
translation: 작물이 시들고 있다는 생각은 전혀 안 드는데. 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬, 할 일이 있으니까.

english: Hello. Could you help me with a quest, please?
translation: 안녕하세요. 퀘스트 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, certainly. I'll help if I can. Which quest would you like help with?
translation: 그래, 물론이지. 내가 할 수 있는 거라면 도와줄게. 어떤 퀘스트를 도와줄까?

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
The northern allotment
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
The southern allotment
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can you sell me something?
Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있어요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.
(See more items)
A watering can.
A gardening trowel.
A seed dibber.
(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Yes.
No.
Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
translation: 남는 snowdrop seeds(스노드롭 씨앗) 좀 있어요?

english: But I was told that you did!
[Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: 상관하려는 건 아니고요, 그냥 snowdrop seeds(스노드롭 씨앗)을 좀 주셨으면 해서요.

english: [Charm] I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: [Charm] 같은 인간이 이렇게 속상해하는 걸 보고 있기가 힘들어서요.

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
translation: 더는 못 참겠어요. 그냥 씨앗이나 주세요.

english: [Charm] So what ails you, my friend?
translation: [Charm] 그래서 무슨 일로 속을 썩이세요, 친구?

english: Oh stop whining, it's not like you do it for free.
translation: 아, 징징대지 좀 마세요. 공짜로 해 주는 것도 아니면서.

english: [Charm] Well, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: [Charm] 그럼, 제가 뭐 해 드릴 일은 없어요?

english: Don't let me stop you, there are plenty of ships missing cabin boys.
translation: 말리지 않을게요. 사환 자리 비어 있는 배는 널렸으니까요.

english: [Charm] So what can I do for you?
translation: [Charm] 그래서 제가 뭘 해 드리면 될까요?

english: That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
translation: 좋아요, 거래하죠. 양배추가 다 자라면 알려 드릴게요.

english: I'm not wasting my time growing cabbages.
[Charm] Aarrrrrghhhh! I hate cabbages!!!! Give me the seeds!!!!!
What did you ask me to do?
Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.
Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Group of Advanced Gardeners(고급 정원사 모임)의 회원이세요?

english: Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains
translation: Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains(요정 이야기 1부 - 성장통)

english: Garden of Tranquility
What's Kraken?
Not heard that one before.
How are you actually walking on land?
translation: 너 대체 땅 위에서 어떻게 걷는 거야?

english: We have another leg, just below the center of our body that we use to move across solid surfaces.
translation: 우리 몸 한가운데 바로 아래에 다리가 하나 더 있어. 단단한 땅 위를 다닐 땐 그걸 쓰지.

english: That's.... interesting.
*splash*
Glug glug glug!
Slosh!
Splishy splishy!
Hello, how can I help you?
Who are you?
My name is Krato. I'm an assistant librarian for the Historical Archive.
translation: 제 이름은 Krato(크라토)예요. Historical Archive(역사 기록 보관소)의 보조 사서랍니다.

english: Goodbye.
What is this place?
This is the Library Historical Archive. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
translation: 여기는 Library Historical Archive(도서관 역사 기록 보관소)예요. Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드) 역사의 모든 시대에 걸친 역사 문서와 기록이 있어요. 저 멀리 역사의 첫 10년까지 거슬러 올라가죠.

english: If you're looking for something specific you should speak to Istoria.
translation: 찾으시는 게 따로 있다면 Istoria(이스토리아)에게 물어보세요.

english: Great, thanks!
Who are you?
What is this place?
Goodbye.
Skreeee!
Kraaaw!
Huh... that's odd... I thought that would be big news.
translation: 어라... 이상하네... 엄청난 뉴스가 될 줄 알았는데.

english: You thought what would be big news?
translation: 뭐가 엄청난 뉴스가 될 줄 알았다는 거야?

english: Well there seems to be an absence of a certain ornithological piece: a headline regarding mass awareness of a certain avian variety.
translation: 음, 조류학적인 소식 하나가 쏙 빠져 있는 것 같아서 말이야. 어떤 새 한 종을 온 세상이 다 알게 됐다는 헤드라인 말이지.

english: What are you talking about?
Oh have you not heard? It was my understanding that everyone had heard....
translation: 어, 못 들었어? 다들 들은 줄 알았는데....

english: Heard wha...... OH NO!!!!?!?!!?!
translation: 뭘 들었다는 거... 으아아악 안 돼!!!!?!?!!?!

english: OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD. OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD.
translation: 오 그래 새, 새, 새, 새, 새가 대세야. 오 그래 새, 새, 새, 새, 새가 대세야.

english: There's a slight pause as Kree'Arra Jr. goes stiff.
translation: Kree'Arra Jr.(크리아라 주니어)가 뻣뻣하게 굳고, 잠시 정적이 흐른다.

english: Armadyl's law rules!
The bird's the word!
For Armadyl!
SQUAWK!
Hell-
Don't distract me! This formula is highly volatile!
translation: 방해하지 마! 이 혼합물은 굉장히 불안정하단 말이야!

english: Cool, what are you making?
Ugh, look around you, what does it look like?
translation: 하, 주위를 좀 둘러봐. 뭐 같아 보이는데?

english: A magic potion?! Can I have some?
No, human. This isn't designed for your race, it could have unforeseen consequences.
translation: 안 돼, 인간. 이건 너희 종족용으로 만든 게 아니야. 무슨 부작용이 생길지 몰라.

english: I can deal with them, I promise.
You can deal with death?
Hmm, perhaps a rain check?
Wise choice. Now please, I'm working a deadline here.
translation: 현명한 선택이야. 이제 좀 가 줘. 마감이 코앞이라고.

english: See you around!
Doubtful.
Yeah? What do you want?
I need another assignment.
Before I assign you anything, I want to make something clear. My tasks have to be done in the Wilderness. Only kills inside the Wilderness will count.
translation: 임무를 주기 전에 확실히 해 둘 게 있어. 내 임무는 Wilderness(황야)에서 해야 해. 황야 안에서 잡은 것만 인정돼.

english: I don't check combat levels when choosing tasks, either. So even if other masters won't assign you 'tough' monsters, I'll pick anything for which you have the Slayer level, provided you can physically get to it.
translation: 그리고 난 임무를 고를 때 전투 레벨도 안 따져. 다른 마스터들이 '센' 몬스터를 안 맡기더라도, 난 네 Slayer(슬레이어) 레벨로 잡을 수 있고 직접 찾아갈 수만 있으면 뭐든 골라 줄 거야.

english: If you don't like my tasks, go and see Aya in Burthorpe, and ask her to assign you something else. She won't argue.
translation: 내 임무가 마음에 안 들면 Burthorpe(버소프)에 있는 Aya(아야)한테 가서 다른 걸 달라고 해. 걔는 군말 안 할 거야.

english: You might get a few unusual loot drops while you're on my assignments, if you're lucky. So, do you want me to assign you something?
translation: 운이 좋으면 내 임무를 하는 동안 특이한 전리품이 떨어질 수도 있어. 그래서, 임무 줄까?

english: Your new task is to kill [number] [monster].
Got any tips for me?
translation: 조언 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: You've got to do the task in the Wilderness.
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 와.

english: No thanks, I don't want tasks from you.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 당신한테 임무는 안 받을래요.

english: You're still meant to be slaying [monster] in the Wilderness; you have [number] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 넌 아직 Wilderness(황야)에서 [monster]을(를) 잡아야 해. [number]마리 남았어. 임무 끝나면 다시 와.

english: You've already been assigned something.
You're still hunting [monster]; you have [number] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [monster] 사냥 중이잖아. [number]마리 남았어. 임무 끝나면 다시 와.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그건 너한테 맞는 임무가 아닌 것 같은데. 취소해 줄까? 연속 임무 기록은 안 날아가.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아, 임무는 취소된 걸로 해. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 네가 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 있고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 다양해.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: All the Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 네 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어.

english: Other Slayer Masters take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so they won't set you anything too hard. But I don't do that - if you get a task from me, it could be anything for which you
translation: 다른 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)은 임무를 고를 때 네 전투 레벨을 따져서 너무 어려운 건 안 줘. 하지만 난 그런 거 안 해. 나한테 받는 임무는 네가

english: have the Slayer level, provided you can physically get to it.
translation: Slayer(슬레이어) 레벨로 잡을 수 있고 직접 찾아갈 수만 있으면 뭐든 될 수 있어.

english: What can you do apart from Slayer Master stuff?
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 일 말고 할 줄 아는 게 있어요?

english: Quite a lot! Those stupid guards think they've trapped me here for causing trouble, but I can get back out to the Wilderness for some fun anytime I like.
translation: 꽤 많지! 멍청한 경비병들은 말썽 피운 날 여기 가둬 놨다고 생각하지만, 난 내킬 때면 언제든 Wilderness(황야)로 놀러 나갈 수 있어.

english: Well, normally, I can fix it so that you respawn in Edgeville whenever you die. However, I don't seem to be able to do so right now...
translation: 음, 보통은 네가 죽을 때마다 Edgeville(에지빌)에서 부활하게 해 줄 수 있는데. 지금은 그게 안 되네...

english: This feature is not currently available on a Leagues world.
translation: 이 기능은 현재 리그 월드에서 이용할 수 없습니다.

english: Hey, perhaps you'd like me to fix it so that you respawn in Edgeville whenever you die. If you love the Wilderness as much as I do, you might enjoy that.
translation: 이봐, 죽을 때마다 Edgeville(에지빌)에서 부활하게 해 줄까? 너도 나만큼 Wilderness(황야)를 좋아한다면 마음에 들 거야.

english: Tell me more.
Alright, here's the deal: Whenever you drop dead, I'll try to make you reappear in Edgeville, down by the southern ruins. You'll lose your items as normal.
translation: 좋아, 조건은 이래. 네가 뻗을 때마다 Edgeville(에지빌) 남쪽 폐허 근처에서 다시 나타나게 해 볼게. 아이템은 평소처럼 잃어.

english: My magic won't affect you if you die in some fancy place like Castle Wars or the Emir's Arena; those places have their own magic trying to make you 'safe'.
translation: Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)나 Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장) 같은 고상한 곳에서 죽으면 내 마법은 안 통해. 그런 데는 너를 '안전'하게 지키려는 자체 마법이 있거든.

english: This will apply on members' worlds and non-members' worlds alike.
translation: 멤버 월드든 무료 월드든 똑같이 적용돼.

english: I'll want a one-off payment of 5 million coins. If you get your respawn changed later, and then need me to set it back to Edgeville, I won't bill you again.
translation: 비용은 딱 한 번, 500만 코인이야. 나중에 부활 장소를 바꿨다가 다시 Edgeville(에지빌)로 돌려 달라고 해도 돈은 또 안 받아.

english: I'm not carrying that much money.
translation: 그렇게 많은 돈은 안 갖고 있어요.

english: Scared of dropping it? Hah!
Okay, switch my spawn to Edgeville.
translation: 좋아요, 제 부활 장소를 Edgeville(에지빌)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: That doesn't interest me.
Maybe you just can't handle Edgeville!
translation: 넌 Edgeville(에지빌)을 감당 못 하는 거겠지!

english: So do you want to respawn in Edgeville infuture?
Please switch my respawn back to Edgeville.
translation: 제 부활 장소를 다시 Edgeville(에지빌)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Couldn't handle Ferox Enclave? Do you really think you could handle Edgeville?
translation: Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)도 감당 못 했으면서? 정말 Edgeville(에지빌)은 감당할 수 있을 것 같아?

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Edgeville.
translation: 네, 부활 장소를 Edgeville(에지빌)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: Done.
No, maybe another time.
Boring!
Sounds like you're looking for some fun! Are you sure you can handle it?
translation: 재미를 찾는 것 같네! 정말 감당할 수 있겠어?

english: No, I don't want to respawn in Edgeville.
So how's that Edgeville respawn working for you?
Please switch my respawn back to Lumbridge.
translation: 제 부활 장소를 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: You really want to respawn in that dead-end slum? Are you sure? Come and see me if you want to respawn in Edgeville again; I won't ask for more money.
translation: 정말 그 꽉 막힌 빈민가에서 부활하고 싶어? 확실해? Edgeville(에지빌)에서 다시 부활하고 싶으면 찾아와. 돈은 더 안 받을게.

english: Yes, switch my respawn to Lumbridge.
translation: 네, 부활 장소를 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꿔 주세요.

english: No, I'll keep the Edgeville respawn.
Good choice.
It's fine, thanks.
I love the hat! Where did you get it from?
Thank you. I actually made it myself!
translation: 고마워. 사실 내가 직접 만든 거야!

english: Oh, I didn't know you enjoyed arts and crafts?
Oh yes, I put the craft in witchcraft! I have plenty of spare time outside of assigning tasks so I've been making comics and stuffed toys.
translation: 당연하지, witchcraft(마녀술)에 craft(공예)가 괜히 들어가 있는 게 아니라고! 임무 주는 거 말고는 시간이 남아돌아서 만화도 그리고 봉제 인형도 만들고 있어.

english: That's so sweet! I didn't realise Slayer Masters had so much spare time.
translation: 정말 귀엽네요! Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 이렇게 한가한 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Perhaps I have a little too much spare time! I've made so many things that I'm running out of room.
translation: 시간이 좀 너무 많은 걸지도 몰라! 만든 게 너무 많아서 둘 데가 없어지고 있어.

english: Have you thought about giving them to other people?
translation: 다른 사람들한테 나눠 줄 생각은 해 봤어요?

english: I tried handing out stuffed chinchompas, but the guards mistook them for the real thing and arrested me for smuggling explosives out of my cell.
translation: chinchompas(친촘파) 봉제 인형을 나눠 줬더니, 경비병들이 진짜인 줄 알고 내가 감방에서 폭발물을 밀반출한다며 날 체포했지 뭐야.

english: Oh dear. Don't you have any less... dangerous crafts?
translation: 이런... 좀 덜... 위험한 공예품은 없어요?

english: Well, I do make hats too.
That's perfect! People love hats.
Er... Nothing...
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 마법으로 당신과 대화하고 있어요.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
translation: 별일이네. 좋아, 그래서 원하는 게 뭐야?

english: I need another assignment.
Yes, I understand I must kill it in the Wilderness.
translation: 네, Wilderness(황야)에서 처치해야 한다는 거 알아요.

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 조언 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Okay, great!
No thanks, I don't want tasks from you.
translation: 아뇨, 됐어요. 당신한테 임무는 안 받을래요.

translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 일 말고 할 줄 아는 게 있어요?

english: Tell me more.
That doesn't interest me.

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 잡아먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 줄 거 없으니까 날 내버려 둬, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑 얘기할 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말 비참한 하루야... 즐길 수 있을 때 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 여기서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 엄~청 배고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석처럼 보이는데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

english: Got any tips for me?
translation: 조언 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어요! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 오세요.

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [monster] 사냥 중이시네요. [amount]마리 남았어요. 임무를 끝내면 다시 오세요.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그건 당신한테 맞는 임무가 아닌 것 같네요. 취소해 드릴까요? 연속 임무 기록은 사라지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 있고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 다양해요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 건 받지 않을 거예요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하니까, 너무 어려운 건 받지 않을 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요. 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 전투 레벨 확인하지 마세요. 뭐든 할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 무엇이든 줄 거예요.

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
translation: 당신의 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: This is a Slayer's Skillcape. Only a true Slayer master is permitted to wear one and in recognition of such an achievement, Slayer masters may be persuaded to allow you to select the same assignment in a row.
translation: 이건 Slayer's Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)예요. 진정한 Slayer(슬레이어)의 달인만이 입을 수 있죠. 그런 업적을 인정받아서, 슬레이어 마스터들을 잘 설득하면 같은 임무를 연달아 받게 해 줄 수도 있어요.

english: You need more training before you earn that honour, though.
translation: 하지만 그 영예를 얻으려면 훈련이 더 필요해요.

english: May I buy a Slayer's Skillcape, please?
translation: Slayer's Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Well you have performed well as a student. I guess you have earned the right to wear such a prestigious cape now. The Slayer masters will recognize this cape and may offer you the same assignment twice in a row.
translation: 학생으로서 정말 잘해 냈어요. 이제 이렇게 명예로운 망토를 입을 자격이 있다고 생각해요. Slayer masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 이 망토를 알아보고 같은 임무를 두 번 연달아 줄 수도 있어요.

english: That will be 99000 coins, please.
I've changed my mind; I don't want it.
Okay. Well, if you change it back again, I will be waiting.
translation: 알겠어요. 다시 마음이 바뀌면 기다리고 있을게요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 모든 Skillcapes(스킬 망토)에는 후드가 공짜로 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사거든요, 원 플러스 원 말이에요. 그러니 제가 하나 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Good hunting, [player name].
About Duradel...
Are you here with news on Lucien?
I'm afraid not.
The moment you find him, you must come to me. I will ensure my father is avenged!
translation: 그를 찾는 즉시 저한테 와야 해요. 반드시 아버지의 원수를 갚을 거예요!

english: He wouldn't want you to get yourself killed as well!
translation: 아버님은 당신까지 목숨을 잃는 걸 원하지 않으실 거예요!

english: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. I intend to be prepared. For a start, I have been researching my father's notes to find weaknesses in Lucien's demonic thralls.
translation: 아버지와 같은 운명을 맞진 않을 거예요. 준비를 단단히 할 생각이에요. 우선 아버지의 메모를 연구해서 Lucien(루시엔)의 악마 하수인들의 약점을 찾고 있어요.

english: Those sound interesting. May I see them?
Of course. If we expect to defeat Lucien, we must work together.
translation: 물론이죠. Lucien(루시엔)을 물리치려면 힘을 합쳐야 해요.

english: I will not suffer the same fate as my father. That fate is reserved for Lucien!
translation: 아버지와 같은 운명을 맞진 않을 거예요. 그 운명은 Lucien(루시엔)의 몫이에요!

english: I hope you're right...
Speaking of those notes, I seem to have misplaced them. Do you happen to have another copy?
translation: 그 메모 말인데요, 제가 잃어버린 것 같아요. 혹시 사본이 더 있나요?

english: Luckily for you, I made many.
Return to me when you have space to carry them.
translation: 들고 갈 공간이 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Tell me about your skillcape, please.
translation: 당신의 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Can you sell me a Slayer Skillcape?
translation: Slayer Skillcape(슬레이어 스킬 망토)를 팔 수 있나요?

english: I've changed my mind, I don't want it.
Great; I've always wanted one!
About Duradel...
Er... Nothing...
I KILL YOU!!!
No, [House owner] kill you!
No, I kill you!
UUUHRG! Now I kill you!
How are you going to do that? You're just a head on a wall!
translation: 그걸 어떻게 하려고? 넌 벽에 걸린 머리통일 뿐이잖아!

english: Uhhhhrrr...
Why are you so violent?
You kill me! Uuurgh! That make me angry!
translation: 너 나 죽였다! 우우르그! 그래서 화난다!

english: You seemed pretty angry before I killed you!
translation: 내가 죽이기 전부터 꽤 화나 있던 것 같은데!

english: I like angry!
I'm sorry I killed you.
I hate sorry! Makes me more angry! WANT TO KILL YOU!
translation: 미안 싫다! 더 화난다! 너 죽이고 싶다!

english: Please try to calm down!
Hate calm! Smash it! Hur hur hur!
I'm not really sorry!
That make me more angry! Uuuurgh!
Is there anything that doesn't make you angry?
translation: 너를 화나게 하지 않는 건 뭐 없어?

english: No! I like angry! Hur hur hur!
translation: 없다! 나 화나는 거 좋다! 흐흐흐!

english: I killed you really easily!
Yeah! I could kill you again in my sleep! I think I might go off and kill some other kurask!
translation: 그래! 자면서도 또 죽일 수 있어! 가서 다른 kurask(쿠라스크)나 죽여 볼까!

english: Uuuurrrrh! Hate you!
What are you going to do about it? Eh? I totally owned you!
translation: 그래서 어쩔 건데? 응? 내가 완전 박살 냈잖아!

english: Hate you hate you hate you!!!
translation: 너 싫다 너 싫다 너 싫다!!!

english: What do you think about up there?
Think?
You know, what goes through your tiny stuffed head?
translation: 그러니까, 그 쪼끄만 박제 머리통 속에 무슨 생각이 드냐고.

english: Little bugs...
You have bugs living in you? Eww!
Little bugs! Stomp and crush and stomp!
Yeah! Stomp the bugs!
Stomp crush splat!
Smash! Destroy! Crunch break tear destroy splunch! Hurt wound kill hit punch stab slash kill!
translation: 부숴! 파괴! 우직 깨 찢어 파괴 퍽철썩! 아파 상처 죽여 때려 주먹 찔러 베어 죽여!

english: 'Splunch'? That is not a word!
I HATE WORDS! Kill all words!
You said 'kill' twice!
I like kill! Hur hur hur hur!
Yeah! Kill smash destroy!
Kill smash destroy! Hur hur hur!
What have the bugs done to you?
Skitter skitter through head noise in ears behind eyes.
translation: 사각사각 머릿속 기어다닌다 귓속 소리 눈 뒤에.

english: HATE THEM! Kill kill kill!
You can't, you've got no feet!
No feet...
Hate lack of feet! Stomp lack of feet! Kill crush destroy smash!
translation: 발 없는 거 싫다! 발 없는 거 밟는다! 죽여 으깨 파괴 부숴!

english: That makes no sense! You can't destroy the absence of something!
translation: 말도 안 돼! 없는 걸 어떻게 파괴해!

english: Hate requirement to make sense! Smash it kill it destroy kill kill!
translation: 말 되는 거 싫다! 부숴 죽여 파괴 죽여 죽여!

english: You can't physically destroy an abstract concept! It's impossible!
translation: 추상적인 개념은 물리적으로 파괴할 수 없어! 불가능하다고!

english: Hate abstract concepts! Hate impossible! Kill kill kill destroy smash!
translation: 추상적 개념 싫다! 불가능 싫다! 죽여 죽여 죽여 파괴 부숴!

english: This is getting both surreal and repetitive.
translation: 점점 초현실적인 데다 같은 말만 반복되네.

english: Why are you so violent?
You seemed pretty angry before I killed you
translation: 내가 죽이기 전부터 꽤 화나 있던 것 같은데
