You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have a sapling planted in that patch. Plant one and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭에는 sapling(묘목)이 심겨 있지 않은데요. 하나 심으면 돌봐 드릴지도 몰라요.

english: Alright, I'll pay.
That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that tree grows up good and strong.
translation: 그 정도면 충분해요, 손님. 저한테 맡겨 두세요. 그 나무가 튼튼하고 건강하게 자라도록 잘 돌볼게요.

english: What the heck do you want with THAT?
They're for eating, silly! What else can you do with a monkey bar?
translation: 먹으려고 그러죠, 이 바보 같은 사람아! monkey bar(원숭이 바)를 먹는 것 말고 달리 뭘 하겠어요?

english: And the Suqah tooth?
Lots of gnomes like a bit of ground-up Suqah tooth. Just don't tell anyone about this, okay?
translation: Suqah(수카) 이빨 간 걸 조금 먹는 걸 좋아하는 노움이 꽤 많거든요. 그냥 아무한테도 말하지 마세요, 알았죠?

english: Maybe some other time.
That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 벌써 다 자랐어요! 저보고 뭘 하라는 건지 모르겠네요!

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: fruit basket(과일 바구니)에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 다섯 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 하지만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 수는 없어요.

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있어요?

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 제가 팔 물건이 있느냐에 달렸죠. 뭘 찾고 계세요?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: plant cure(식물 치료제) 말이죠? 제가 쓰려고 따로 챙겨 둔 게 좀 있을 거예요. 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 식물 치료제를 25코인에 팔게요.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
Latlink Fastbell hands over your purchase
translation: Latlink Fastbell(래트링크 패스트벨)이 구입한 물건을 건넨다

english: No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 괜찮아요, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있거든요.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: bucket of compost(퇴비 양동이) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 35코인에 팔게요.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: rake(갈퀴) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔게요.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 에, 화분 하나쯤은 내드릴 수 있겠네요. 하지만 40코인은 받아야겠어요.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: watering can(물뿌리개) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 25코인에 팔게요.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔게요.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you
translation: seed dibber(씨앗 구멍 막대) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 됐어요, 제가 필요한 건 하나도 없네요.

english: I'll come back another time.
Would you look after my crops for me?
Alright, I'll pay.
What the heck do you want with THAT?
Maybe some other time
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있어요?

english: Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 괜찮아요, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있거든요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.
(See more items)
A watering can.
A gardening trowel.
A seed dibber.
(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Hey, what are yo...
Sorry, can't talk to ye right now. Busy with paperwork. If ye need anythin', talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 미안, 지금은 얘기할 틈이 없어. 서류 일로 바쁘거든. 뭐 필요한 거 있으면 부두 쪽에 있는 Captain Pudi(푸디 선장)한테 가 봐.

english: What can I do for ye? I be quite busy with paperwork.
translation: 뭘 도와줄까? 난 서류 일로 꽤 바쁘다고.

english: I heard about your ship. Can you tell me what happened?
translation: 배 얘기 들었어요. 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Aye, I can tell ye what happened.
translation: 그래, 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 주지.

english: We be out on our fortnightly fishin' trip, I was doin' me normal work. Setting up the nets, swabbing the deck and the like.
translation: 우린 두 주에 한 번 나가는 고기잡이 중이었어. 난 늘 하던 일을 하고 있었지. 그물 치고, 갑판 닦고, 뭐 그런 거.

english: 'Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
translation: 처음엔 수확이 좋았어. manta ray(쥐가오리)랑 도미가 잔뜩 잡혔지. 그래도 다음 날엔 심해 어장으로 옮길 참이었어.

english: 'Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.
translation: Karamja(카람자) 근처 심해 어장까지는 순풍에 돛 단 듯 순조로웠어. 그런데 가는 길에 바다에 잔해가 평소보다 많이 떠 있는 게 보이더라고.

english: What kind of debris? Was it ship debris?
Aye, 'twas. Most of the time, it be nets or items people throw off ships that they don't need. This had me worried a bit.
translation: 그래, 그랬지. 보통은 그물이나 사람들이 배에서 내다 버린 쓸모없는 물건들이거든. 그래서 좀 걱정이 되더라고.

english: There was a lack of fish in the water, 'twas kind of... eerie.
translation: 바다에 물고기도 별로 없었어. 뭐랄까... 으스스했지.

english: The next day, Koanee changed the ship's course, but that be because of a storm on the horizon.
translation: 다음 날 Koanee(코아니)가 배의 항로를 바꿨어. 수평선에 폭풍이 보였거든.

english: But the storm seemed t' be... following us. As if it had a mind of its own.
translation: 그런데 그 폭풍이... 우릴 따라오는 것 같았어. 마치 제 생각이 있는 것처럼.

english: The wind started a blowin' and the fog started a showin', huge waves crashing against the boat.
translation: 바람은 휘몰아치고 안개는 몰려들고, 거대한 파도가 배를 때려 댔지.

english: The ship started fallin' apart. I rushed to the cook's quarters and found 'im layin' on the floor with a plank over 'im.
translation: 배가 부서지기 시작했어. 요리사 선실로 달려갔더니 요리사가 판자에 깔린 채 바닥에 쓰러져 있더라고.

english: I brought 'im up to the top deck and tied 'im to a piece of loose wood. I did the same t' the Skipper and Navigator.
translation: 그 친구를 위쪽 갑판으로 끌고 올라가서 떨어져 나온 나뭇조각에 묶어 줬지. 선장이랑 항해사한테도 똑같이 해 줬고.

english: Oh my, that's awful! You're very lucky you didn't get hit.
translation: 세상에, 끔찍하네요! 안 다친 게 정말 다행이에요.

english: Aye, it be lucky indeed. But that not be the end of it. As the ship finished sinking, I balanced out the wood so we did not slip.
translation: 그래, 운이 좋았지. 그런데 그게 끝이 아니었어. 배가 완전히 가라앉을 때 우리가 미끄러지지 않게 나뭇조각 균형을 잡았지.

english: In the distance I saw glowing eyes and a large monster sorta thing in the fog movin' t'wards us.
translation: 저 멀리 안개 속에서 빛나는 눈이랑 커다란 괴물 같은 게 우리 쪽으로 다가오는 게 보였어.

english: But all of a sudden, it vanished. I then had to keep us afloat 'till we made it t' shore by Al Kharid.
translation: 그런데 갑자기 그게 사라졌어. 그다음엔 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 해안에 닿을 때까지 우리가 가라앉지 않게 버텨야 했지.

english: Pudi gathered us up and we went t' the Chancellor as soon as we could stand.
translation: Pudi(푸디)가 우릴 모았고, 다들 일어설 수 있게 되자마자 Chancellor(재상)을 찾아갔어.

english: These ruins turned out t' be a great base to research the beast from undisturbed! Bit close to Menaphos though, aye?
translation: 알고 보니 이 폐허가 방해받지 않고 그 야수를 연구하기에 딱 좋은 기지더라고! 근데 Menaphos(메나포스)랑 좀 가깝긴 하지, 안 그래?

english: That be the end of me story. Can I help ye with anything else?
translation: 내 얘기는 여기까지야. 또 도와줄 거 있어?

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 해적이 서류 일을 하다니, 처음 보네요.

english: Let me guess, ye thought we be doin' nothing but pluderin' and pillagin'?
translation: 맞혀 볼까? 우리가 약탈이랑 노략질밖에 안 하는 줄 알았지?

english: Is that not what pirates do?
translation: 해적이 원래 그런 거 하는 거 아니에요?

english: Ye be a funny one.
Glad you can still smile after what happened.
translation: 그런 일을 겪고도 아직 웃을 수 있다니 다행이에요.

english: I'm not goin' t' let one bit of bad luck keep me down.
translation: 운 나쁜 일 한 번 때문에 기죽어 있을 생각은 없어.

english: Can I help ye with anything else?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)와 싸울 때 팁 같은 거 있어요?

english: Tempoross can summon clouds that shoot lightnin'. They can cause fires that will block ye from movin' about as freely.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)는 번개를 쏘는 구름을 불러낼 수 있어. 그 번개 때문에 불이 나면 마음대로 돌아다니기 힘들어지지.

english: Ye best be ready to grab a bucket and douse the fire before it spreads!
translation: 불이 번지기 전에 양동이를 들고 끌 준비를 해 두는 게 좋을 거야!

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
I have to go.
Stay safe, ye hear?
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 이 힘든 시기에 달걀 하나 드릴까요?

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 음... 아니, 네 축축한 달걀은 됐어, 고마워...

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 그럼 제 달걀은 다른 데 가져갈게요.

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
I heard about your ship, can you tell me what happened?
translation: 배 얘기 들었어요. 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: A pirate doing paperwork, that's new.
translation: 해적이 서류 일을 하다니, 처음 보네요.

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)와 싸울 때 팁 같은 거 있어요?

english: I have to go.
Have I seen you before?
I don't think so... I've just got one of those faces.
You're probably right.
I'm rather busy at the moment. I've got to organise my cupboards of jewels.
translation: 지금은 좀 바빠요. 보석 장식장을 정리해야 하거든요.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 절대 안 돼요! 제 보석 근처에는 얼씬도 하지 마세요.

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 제 집 같은 집을 살 생각 있으세요?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 어머, 제 정신 좀 봐! 당신도 우리 같은 부자인 줄 알았지 뭐예요.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, madam, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 아뇨, 부인. 저는 도둑이에요. 남의 집을 털죠.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 전혀 아니에요. 그냥 이 집을 싹 털고 싶을 뿐이에요. 정말로요.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I've just spent so much money!
Good for you.
Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: 미안하지만 수다 떨 시간이 없어요. 중요한 볼일이 있거든요.

english: I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 왠지 집에 돌아가 봐야 할 것 같은 느낌이 드네요.

english: You don't say...
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 산책하기 딱 좋은 날이죠, 안 그래요?

english: It is!
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 내가 얼마나 부자인지 확인하러 가 볼까!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
Time to see what's at the bazaar!
translation: bazaar(시장)에 뭐가 있나 보러 가 볼까!

english: You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 집주인이 문을 잠가 버려서 집 밖으로 끌려 나왔다.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 밖에서 누군가 집주인이 돌아오는 걸 봤다고 외치는 소리가 들린다!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
What do you do here?
Oh, I just walk around a bit...I have to help my Mum and Dad a lot though because I'm still only young. I'd love to visit the mainland one day though and get out of this boring village.
translation: 아, 그냥 이리저리 돌아다녀요... 아직 어려서 엄마 아빠 일을 많이 도와야 하지만요. 그래도 언젠가 본토에 가 보고 싶어요. 이 지루한 마을을 벗어나고 싶거든요.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 뭐 재미있는 거 할 만한 게 있어요?

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 제가 아는 건 없어요. 그냥 편히 앉아서 햇볕이나 쬐세요, 브와나!

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 마을 여기저기서 일을 좀 하고 있어요.

english: Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 네, 이 근처에서 좋은 일을 많이 해 주셨죠. 수고하신 데 대한 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: You get [amount] trading sticks. You are left with [amount]% favour.
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)를 [amount]개 받았다. 호감도가 [amount]% 남았다.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)는 이미 드렸고, 지금은 더 가진 게 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테도 가서 얘기해 보고 좀 받아 보는 게 어때요?

english: Ok, thanks.
Ahhhhhhhh - Get away from me you beast!
What's the problem....oh, I'm wearing this big scary mask! I'd better take it off before I start talking to the natives.
translation: 왜 그러는... 아, 이 크고 무서운 가면을 쓰고 있었지! 원주민들과 얘기하기 전에 벗어야겠다.

english: Waahhhhh! - It's da evil broodoo beast come ta eat my very soul!
translation: 으아아앙! - 사악한 broodoo(브루두) 괴물이 내 영혼을 먹으러 왔어!

english: Ahhhhhhhh - It's a monster!
Ahhhhhhhh!!
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 여기 뭐 재미있는 거 할 만한 게 있어요?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
translation: 마을 여기저기서 일을 좀 하고 있어요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Well, thank you, adventurer. You've just deprived me of a wonderful chance to learn from one of Zamorak's first followers.
translation: 참 고맙구나, 모험가. 덕분에 Zamorak(자모락)의 최초의 추종자 중 하나에게서 배울 절호의 기회를 날려 버렸어.

english: What? What about that treasure you were looking for?
You utter imbecile! Did you think I was looking for gold?
translation: 이 한심한 멍청이 같으니! 내가 금이나 찾는 줄 알았나?

english: Um... sorry.
'Sorry' won't bring those Mahjarrat back.
*sigh*I might as well stay to study this temple. It has some interesting magical properties.
translation: *한숨* 이왕 이렇게 된 거 남아서 이 신전이나 연구해야겠군. 흥미로운 마법적 성질이 있으니까.

english: Ooh, you're a mage? Can you teach me any spells?
translation: 오, 마법사예요? 주문 좀 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well...
If you really want to learn my spells, you'll have to dedicate yourself to Zamorak.
translation: 정말 내 주문을 배우고 싶다면 Zamorak(자모락)에게 너 자신을 바쳐야 해.

english: I couldn't do that!
Then you won't be learning any of my spells.
translation: 그럼 내 주문은 하나도 못 배우겠군.

english: Ha ha ha ha!
You're not very nice, are you?
What did you expect from a Zamorakian mage?
Sure, sign me up!
You really thought I would teach you my secrets just like that? Ha ha ha! You are a naive fool.
translation: 정말 내가 그렇게 쉽게 비밀을 가르쳐 줄 거라 생각했나? 하하하! 순진한 바보로군.

english: That's not very nice of you.
I'm a mage of Zamorak, after all. What else do you expect?
translation: 난 어디까지나 Zamorak(자모락)의 마법사야. 뭘 더 기대하나?

english: How are you and your defective brain doing nowadays, adventurer?
translation: 요즘 너랑 네 고장 난 뇌는 잘 지내나, 모험가?

english: I've lost the amulet that Akthanakos gave me.
You really are an idiot, aren't you? You dropped it in here when you left. Try not to lose it next time.
translation: 넌 정말 멍청이로군, 안 그래? 나갈 때 여기다 떨어뜨렸잖아. 다음엔 잃어버리지 않도록 해.

english: Hey! That's not very nice.
I'm not very nice. If you want to see who ruined all of my plans, adventurer, just look in a mirror.
translation: 난 원래 착하지 않아. 내 계획을 전부 망친 놈이 누군지 보고 싶다면, 모험가, 거울이나 들여다봐.

english: Suit yourself. At least I got a nice amulet for my trouble.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 그래도 고생한 덕에 좋은 아뮬렛은 하나 얻었으니까요.

english: About that amulet - I might be able to improve it for you, for a fee. Have you got it with you?
translation: 그 아뮬렛 말인데, 돈을 내면 내가 더 좋게 만들어 줄 수도 있어. 지금 가지고 있나?

english: Yes, I've got it here.
Yes, it's what I thought. This amulet will run out of charges all the time, if you keep using it. For one million coins I can give it unlimited charges.
translation: 역시 생각한 대로군. 이 아뮬렛은 계속 쓰면 충전이 금방금방 바닥날 거야. 백만 코인을 내면 무제한으로 충전되게 해 주지.

english: Why do you need so much money for it?
Three reasons. Firstly, I'm a Zamorakian mage - we're not big on charity work. Secondly, I want the money. Finally, in case you need reminding, I hate you.
translation: 이유는 세 가지다. 첫째, 난 Zamorakian(자모락파) 마법사다. 우린 자선 활동엔 관심 없어. 둘째, 난 돈이 갖고 싶어. 마지막으로, 잊었을까 봐 다시 말해 주는데, 난 네가 싫어.

english: Right. Well, I haven't got that kind of money on me.
translation: 그렇군요. 음, 지금 그만한 돈은 없어요.

english: Okay, here's one million coins.
I'm not interested.
Your loss.
Maybe another time.
And don't forget who gave it unlimited charges for you!
translation: 그리고 누가 무제한 충전을 해 줬는지 잊지 마라!

english: I couldn't do that!
Sure, sign me up!
Why do you need so much money for it?
Okay, here's one million coins.
I'm not interested.
Maybe another time.
How are you doing?
I'm happy.
Really?
Really.
Really, really?
Really, really.
Really, really rea....
Stop right there.
Where?
There.
Here?
No there.
Agghhh!! Now you're at it.
At what?
It.
What's it?
You know... it...
Stop, stop, stop! Right we're going to play a little game now.
translation: 그만, 그만, 그만! 좋아, 이제 우리 작은 게임을 하나 할 거야.

english: Is it going to be fun? Is it? Is it? Is it?
It's called give the cat some peace.
How do you play?
You gently stroke your cat, then pick it up and finally leave it for an extended snooze in your backpack.
translation: 네 고양이를 살살 쓰다듬고, 들어 올린 다음, 마지막으로 배낭 속에서 아주 오래 낮잠 자게 놔두는 거야.

english: That doesn't sound like much fun. I'd rather spend quality time annoying you.
translation: 별로 재미없을 것 같은데. 차라리 널 귀찮게 하면서 알찬 시간을 보낼래.

english: I'd never have guessed. Well in that case I would be really annoyed if you took me hunting rats.
translation: 그럴 줄은 꿈에도 몰랐네. 그럼 말이지, 날 쥐 사냥에 데려가면 난 정말 짜증 날 거야.

english: AGHHHHH!!!!
How old are you now?
I thought I asked you your age not how you were?
translation: 난 기분이 어떠냐고 물은 게 아니라 나이를 물은 것 같은데?

english: Oh! My fault, well then to answer your question, I'd like to go to the Varrock sewers.
translation: 아! 내 실수. 그럼 질문에 답하자면, 난 Varrock sewers(바록 하수도)에 가 보고 싶어.

english: What? Are you listening to me?
It's a quarter past tuesday.
Are you trying to dodge the question?
I think your amulet might be on the blink. Meoow, Miiiaaoow!
translation: 네 아뮬렛이 고장 났나 봐. 야옹, 미이이야옹!

english: You examine the amulet of catspeak checking the centre gem for any flaws.
translation: amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)의 가운데 보석에 흠이 있는지 살펴본다.

english: Strange, it looks ok to me.
Hiss's'sss's.
~Your cat tries to hold in a snigger, but fails miserably.
translation: ~고양이가 킥킥 웃음을 참으려 하지만, 처참하게 실패한다.

english: Where do you want to go?
Well one place I don't want to go is the ratpits.
translation: 음, 절대 가기 싫은 곳 하나는 ratpits(쥐 구덩이)야.

english: Why's that?
All the other cats will make fun of me, I'm so badly out of shape. Take me hunting.
translation: 다른 고양이들이 다 날 놀릴 거야. 몸이 엉망이 됐거든. 사냥하러 데려가 줘.

english: Don't worry cat, I'll get you back in shape.
translation: 걱정 마, 고양아. 내가 다시 몸 만들어 줄게.

english: What do you want to do now?
I'm happy just pottering around.
Do you fancy a bit of hunting?
To be perfectly honest, I'd rather just lay about and groom myself. Looking at the state of your get up I reckon you would do well to follow suit.
translation: 솔직히 말하면, 그냥 뒹굴뒹굴하면서 털 고르기나 하고 싶어. 네 꼬락서니를 보니 너도 몸단장 좀 하는 게 좋겠던데.

english: There's nothing wrong with how I'm dressed.
That dragon armour you're wearing is so like last year.
translation: 네가 입은 그 dragon armour(드래곤 갑옷), 완전 작년 스타일이야.

english: That thing you're wearing is so like last year.
translation: 네가 입은 그거, 완전 작년 스타일이야.

english: I refuse to take fashion advice from a cat, a fat lazy one to boot!
translation: 고양이한테 패션 조언은 안 들어. 그것도 뚱뚱하고 게으른 고양이한테는!

english: Meeoow! I think someone is a bit touchy todaySSS.
translation: 야아옹! 오늘 누가 좀 예민하신가 봐아스스스.

english: That's the last time I ask you what you want to do.
translation: 너한테 뭐 하고 싶냐고 묻는 것도 이번이 마지막이야.

english: I'm content. A little more action might be good, but then again you might ruffle up my fur and then I'd have to groom all over again.
translation: 난 만족해. 좀 더 움직이는 것도 좋겠지만, 그러다 네가 내 털을 헝클어 놓으면 또 처음부터 털을 골라야 하잖아.

english: Pah! You're the laziest old bag of fluff I've ever met.
translation: 흥! 넌 내가 만나 본 중에 제일 게으른 늙다리 털 뭉치야.

english: A little older than I was before and not as old as I will be in another bit.
translation: 전보다는 조금 더 늙었고, 조금 있으면 될 나이보다는 아직 덜 늙었지.

english: What kind of answer is that?
Well your idea of time and mine are too different for either of us to understand the other.
translation: 음, 네 시간 개념과 내 시간 개념은 너무 달라서 우리 둘 다 서로를 이해할 수 없어.

english: Umm.. I don't really understand.
Well for one I don't count the time I spend in your bank - which is horribly boring nor in your bag.
translation: 우선 난 네 은행에서 보내는 시간은 안 세. 끔찍하게 지루하거든. 가방 속에서 보내는 시간도 안 세고.

english: Well that's not too complicated.
I'm just getting started. Now there is also a difference in cat years and human years. To approximate time in cat years you take a value in years subtract 1 multiply it by 4 and then add 16.
translation: 이제 시작이야. 그리고 고양이 나이와 사람 나이도 달라. 고양이 나이를 대략 구하려면, 햇수에서 1을 빼고 4를 곱한 다음 16을 더하면 돼.

english: Ummm... so if... a cat is newly born it's already 12 cat years old?
translation: 으음... 그러면... 갓 태어난 고양이는 벌써 고양이 나이로 12살이라는 거야?

english: I said approximate not calculate. Anyway it only works once the cat is 1 year old. Anyway the last complication is the discrepancy of rune years and earth years, which to date nobody has worked out.
translation: 난 '대략'이라고 했지 '계산'하라곤 안 했어. 어쨌든 그건 고양이가 1살이 된 다음부터만 맞아. 아무튼 마지막 문제는 룬 세계의 1년과 지구의 1년이 다르다는 건데, 그건 지금까지 아무도 계산해 내지 못했어.

english: Umm... anyway back to the question, how old are you in cat years then?
translation: 음... 어쨌든 질문으로 돌아가서, 그럼 넌 고양이 나이로 몇 살인데?

english: Uh.. I don't know. I must be so old now that I've forgotten what age I am.
translation: 어.. 몰라. 너무 늙어서 내 나이도 까먹었나 봐.

english: Hmph!
Somewhere nice and quiet. I'm a bit behind in my snoozing schedule.
translation: 어디 조용하고 좋은 데. 낮잠 일정이 좀 밀렸거든.

english: Sleep.
How am I going to get you back in shape if all you want to do is sleep?
translation: 네가 잠만 자려고 하면 내가 어떻게 네 몸을 다시 만들어 주겠어?

english: Surgery. That's the answer to all our problems.
translation: 수술. 그게 우리 모든 문제의 해답이야.

english: Well smarty pants, where am I going to find a cosmetic surgeon who's willing to perform liposuction on a cat around here?
translation: 잘났어 정말. 이 근처 어디서 고양이 지방흡입을 해 줄 성형외과 의사를 찾으라는 거야?

english: I don't know. Have you tried looking yet?
Aghh!! This is ridiculous, I'm not talking to you again until you start acting sensible.
translation: 으악!! 말도 안 돼. 네가 철 좀 들 때까지 다시는 너랑 말 안 해.

english: Hiss! What would you care?
Oh come on, you're not going to have a hissy fit with me now are you?
translation: 에이, 설마 지금 나한테 하악질하면서 성질부리는 건 아니지?

english: Hiss!!
Oh dear.
I rather not say.
Oh come on tell me.
Ok I'm very old and fat! Are you happy now? Do you feel good, having a laugh at my expense?
translation: 그래, 나 엄청 늙고 뚱뚱해! 이제 됐어? 날 놀리면서 웃으니까 기분 좋아?

english: Oh puss, I'm sorry. I didn't mean it like that. How can I make it up to you?
translation: 아, 야옹아, 미안해. 그런 뜻이 아니었어. 어떻게 하면 풀어 줄래?

english: Well maybe if you stroked me the odd time, or played with me.
translation: 음, 가끔 쓰다듬어 주거나 같이 놀아 주면 몰라도.

english: Back to the pits. I want to tell the catchers what a rotten master you've been.
translation: 쥐 구덩이로 돌아갈래. 쥐잡이들한테 네가 얼마나 형편없는 주인이었는지 다 일러바칠 거야.

english: What? You wouldn't do that would you?
If you paid me a little more attention I wouldn't, but I must admit I have been tempted to that for quite a while.
translation: 네가 나한테 조금만 더 신경 써 주면 안 그러겠지만, 솔직히 꽤 오래전부터 그러고 싶긴 했어.

english: Look cat, I promise I'll try to be a better to you from now on.
translation: 있잖아 고양아, 앞으로 너한테 더 잘하도록 노력할게. 약속해.

english: I'll believe it when I see it.
I'd like to go hunting, but since you've been neglecting me I'm too fat to do that properly anymore.
translation: 사냥하러 가고 싶지만, 네가 날 내버려 둬서 너무 뚱뚱해지는 바람에 이젠 제대로 사냥을 못 해.

english: Oh come on! I'm sure you're not that bad at hunting.
translation: 에이! 네가 그렇게 사냥을 못하진 않을 거야.

english: You're having a laugh! I couldn't even catch a cold if I tried.
translation: 웃기고 있네! 지금 난 쥐는커녕 감도 못 잡아.

english: Hmm.. I think we may have to work on your self esteem first, with an attitude like yours it's no wonder you can't catch rats.
translation: 흠.. 아무래도 네 자존감부터 키워야겠다. 그런 태도니까 쥐를 못 잡지.

english: Hisss. No the reason I can't catch any is because you neglect me, leaving me in the bank or in your bags for extended periods does not help.
translation: 하악. 아니, 내가 하나도 못 잡는 건 네가 날 방치해서야. 날 은행이나 가방 속에 오랫동안 처박아 두는 게 도움이 될 리가 없잖아.

english: Ummmm..... sorry?
Hmph!
Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 미안하지만 인간, 너 지금 뭘 쓰고 있는 거냐?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: cat ears(고양이 귀)를 맞춰 왔어. 완전 멋지지 않냐아아아아옹?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 고양이가 눈 한 번 깜박이지 않고 당신을 빤히 쳐다본다.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 전혀 아니다. 당장 벗어라, 인간. 내가 인간 귀 한 쌍 구해다 쓰고 다니기 전에.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
Hello, welcome to Morytania!
Can I have another set of Morytania legs?
translation: Morytania legs(모리타니아 다리 보호구)를 한 벌 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Le Sabre gives you another set of Morytania legs.
translation: Le Sabre(르 사브르)가 Morytania legs(모리타니아 다리 보호구)를 한 벌 더 준다.

english: Who are you?
My name is Le Sabre and I'm the task master for the Morytania Achievement Diary.
translation: 제 이름은 Le Sabre(르 사브르)이고, Morytania Achievement Diary(모리타니아 업적 일지)의 과제 담당자예요.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. Here in Morytania it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록하는 데 도움을 주는 일지예요. 여기 Morytania(모리타니아)에서는 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 발견하는 데 도움이 될 거예요. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이 보상을 줄 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: 제 Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different pairs of Morytania platelegs, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of
translation: 음, Morytania(모리타니아) 다리 보호구는 네 가지가 있는데, 네 단계의 난이도에 각각 대응해요. 각 보호구는 이전 단계의 보상을 모두 가지고 있고 추가 혜택도 있죠... 어느 단계의

english: rewards would you like to know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Morytania, your legs can teleport to the Slime pit beneath the Ectofuntus twice a day, there's a chance Ghasts will ignore you in the swamp, and you'll receive a 2.5%
translation: Morytania(모리타니아)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료하면, 다리 보호구로 하루에 두 번 Ectofuntus(엑토펀투스) 아래의 Slime pit(슬라임 구덩이)로 순간이동할 수 있고, 늪에서 Ghast(가스트)가 당신을 건드리지 않고 지나갈 때도 있으며, Slayer Tower(슬레이어 탑)에서 과제를 수행할 때

english: increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower too.
Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 중급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, you get 5 daily slime pit teleports and a built-in ghostspeak amulet. Robin in Port Phasmatys will exchange some bonemeal for bones for you, and you'll receive a 5% increase in Slayer
translation: 초급 보상에 더해, 하루 5번 슬라임 구덩이 순간이동과 ghostspeak amulet(유령 언어 아뮬렛) 내장 기능이 생겨요. Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)의 Robin(로빈)이 bones(뼈)를 bonemeal(뼛가루)로 바꿔 줄 거고, Slayer Tower(슬레이어 탑)에서 과제를 수행할 때

english: XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower too.
Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you can pick double Mort Myre Fungi in the swamp, get more experience from burning shades, access a shortcut on Mos Le`Harmless, receive more runes from Barrows,
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, 늪에서 Mort Myre Fungi(모트 마이어 버섯)을 두 배로 딸 수 있고, shades(셰이드)를 태울 때 경험치를 더 얻고, Mos Le`Harmless(모스 르하믈레스)의 지름길을 쓸 수 있고, Barrows(배로우즈)에서 룬을 더 받고,

english: Robin will exchange more bonemeal for bones each day and you'll receive a 7.5% increase in Slayer XP when on assignment in the Slayer Tower. The disciples at the Ectofuntus will give you a bonecrusher too!

english: What's a League?
Leagues are time-limited challenges that provide a unique twist on the world you know and love.
translation: Leagues(리그)는 기간 한정 도전으로, 익히 알고 사랑하던 세계에 독특한 변화를 더해요.

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the League.
translation: League(리그)마다 처음부터 새로 시작하고, 정해진 시간 안에 리그를 진행해 나가야 해요.

translation: 포인트가 많을수록 더 높은 League Rank(리그 등급)을 받게 돼요.

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off your accomplishments.

translation: League(리그)마다 고유한 규칙과 특징이 있어요. 익숙하던 세계와는 아주 다른 세계죠.

translation: League Trophies(리그 트로피)는 특정 League(리그)에서 얼마나 잘했는지를 나타내요. 성적은 얻은 League Points(리그 포인트)의 양으로 평가해요.
