translation: 그리고 리그 내내 Iron Man(아이언맨)으로 참가해야 해요. 모든 걸 혼자 힘으로 해결해야 하고 다른 참가자와 거래할 수 없다는 뜻이죠.

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect!
translation: 그게 다가 아니에요. 리그 중에 스킬을 훈련하면 평소보다 훨씬 많은 경험치를 얻어요!

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: 마지막으로, 일부 퀘스트는 자동으로 완료돼 있어요. 관련 지역을 해금하면 더 많은 퀘스트가 완료될 거예요.

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to see some more in-depth information?
translation: 기본은 이 정도면 될 것 같아요. 좀 더 자세한 정보를 보시겠어요?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Fair enough. Is there anything else I can help you with?
How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 모든 리그에는 완료해야 할 과제가 여럿 있어요. 과제마다 난이도가 있는데, 초급, 중급, 상급, 엘리트, 마스터예요.

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks completed, the more areas available to unlock.
translation: 과제를 완료하면 새 지역에 들어갈 수 있어요. 완료한 과제가 많을수록 해금할 수 있는 지역도 늘어나요.

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 그뿐 아니라 과제를 완료하면 League Points(리그 포인트)도 얻어요. 얻는 포인트는 과제 난이도에 따라 달라요.

english: What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic! These are powerful artefacts to help you in the League.
translation: 리그 포인트를 일정량 모으면 새 Relic(유물)을 해금할 수 있어요! 리그에서 도움이 되는 강력한 아이템이죠.

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 리그 포인트로 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 보상을 살 수도 있어요.

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: 지금은 리그 프로필로 플레이하고 계세요. Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)은 본 프로필에서만 열 수 있어요.

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 일반 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 월드 아무 데로나 옮기면 본 프로필로 접속할 수 있어요. 월드 전환은 로그아웃 메뉴의 월드 전환기에서 할 수 있어요.

english: So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. With so many to choose from, it's up to you which ones you go for.
translation: 아마 다 끝내지는 못할 만큼 많을 거예요. 고를 게 워낙 많으니, 어떤 걸 할지는 직접 정하시면 돼요.

english: Thanks!
Not a problem. Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
translation: 별말씀을요. 그럼 이번 리그의 과제를 한번 보시겠어요?

english: How does the area system work?
In this League, you are initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: 이번 리그에서는 처음엔 Kingdom of Misthalin(미스탈린 왕국)과 Karamja(카람자) 섬에만 갈 수 있어요. 하지만 진행하다 보면 더 많은 지역을 해금할 수 있죠.

english: There are nine different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including Misthalin and Karamja, so choose wisely.
translation: 지역은 모두 아홉 곳이에요. 하지만 Misthalin(미스탈린)과 Karamja(카람자)를 포함해 최대 다섯 곳까지만 해금할 수 있으니 신중하게 고르세요.

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. However, the other three unlocks are unavailable to begin with.
translation: 처음 두 번의 지역 해금은 모두에게 주어져요. 하지만 나머지 세 번은 처음엔 쓸 수 없어요.

english: You can access these additional area unlocks by completing tasks. The more tasks you've completed, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: 과제를 완료하면 이 추가 지역 해금을 쓸 수 있어요. 완료한 과제가 많을수록 해금할 수 있는 지역도 늘어나요.

english: I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: 지금 해금할 수 있는 지역을 보시겠어요?

english: Relics, or Trailblazer Relics to give them their full name, are powerful artefacts that grant unique abilities for the entire League!
translation: Relics(유물), 정식 이름으로는 Trailblazer Relics(트레일블레이저 유물)은 리그 내내 고유한 능력을 주는 강력한 아이템이에요!

english: There are eighteen separate Relics, split across six different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier though.
translation: 유물은 모두 열여덟 개이고, 여섯 등급으로 나뉘어 있어요. 다만 등급마다 유물은 하나만 가질 수 있어요.

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. However, the higher tiers are locked to begin with.
translation: 첫 번째 유물 등급은 누구나 쓸 수 있어요. 하지만 높은 등급은 처음엔 잠겨 있죠.

english: You can unlock these higher tiers by earning League Points. League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)를 얻으면 높은 등급을 해금할 수 있어요. 리그 포인트는 과제를 완료하면 얻어요.

english: Be warned, you'll need to choose carefully when picking a Relic. Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League.
translation: 주의하세요, 유물은 신중하게 골라야 해요. 한번 고르면 리그가 끝날 때까지 바꿀 수 없거든요.

english: Anyway, it looks like you have a Relic available for selection right now! Would you like to take a look?
translation: 아무튼, 지금 고를 수 있는 유물이 있는 것 같네요! 한번 보시겠어요?

english: Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Trailblazer Relic tiers you have available.
translation: 과제를 완료하면 새 지역을 해금할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 League Points(리그 포인트)도 얻어요. 리그 포인트가 많을수록 쓸 수 있는 Trailblazer Relic(트레일블레이저 유물) 등급도 늘어나요.

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Trailblazer Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 그리고 리그 포인트는 트레일블레이저 유물 해금 말고도 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 보상을 사는 데 쓸 수 있어요.

english: What rewards can I buy?
All sorts of things! There's some new furniture for your house, an alternate animation for your Home Teleport spell and some new stylish outfits, just to name a few.
translation: 이것저것 많아요! 집에 둘 새 가구, Home Teleport(홈 텔레포트) 주문의 새 애니메이션, 멋진 새 의상 등등이 있죠.

english: Most of the rewards can be traded with others, so if you want, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: 대부분의 보상은 다른 사람과 거래할 수 있어서, 원하면 팔아서 돈을 벌 수도 있어요. 물론 직접 간직하는 게 더 좋을 수도 있고요.

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
One thing to be aware of is that the Trailblazer rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues though.
translation: 한 가지 알아 두실 점은, 트레일블레이저 보상은 리그가 끝나야 살 수 있다는 거예요. 그래도 이전 리그의 보상은 지금도 살 수 있어요.

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 자, Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)의 보상 말고도 League Ranks(리그 등급)도 있어요.

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
At the end of the League, you will be given a League Rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: 리그가 끝나면 리그 등급을 받게 돼요. 다른 참가자와 비교해 얻은 리그 포인트 수에 따라 정해지죠.

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: 리그 포인트를 100점 이상 얻은 사람은 누구나 Bronze(청동) 등급을 받을 수 있어요. 상위 80% 참가자는 Iron(철) 등급, 상위 60%는 Steel(강철) 등급을 받아요.

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: 상위 40%는 Mithril(미스릴), 상위 20%는 Adamant(아다만트), 상위 5%는 Rune(룬) 등급을 받아요. 그리고 최고의 참가자, 상위 1% 안에 든 분들은 Dragon(드래곤) 등급을 받아요!

english: When the League ends, your rank will determine what trophy you get. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: 리그가 끝나면 등급에 따라 받을 트로피가 정해져요. 트로피는 리그에서의 성적을 상징하죠.

english: Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are given to you after the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank!
translation: 맞아요. 트로피는 리그가 끝난 뒤에 받는 아이템이에요. 리그 등급을 자랑하는 데 쓸 수 있죠!

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one!
translation: 리그 등급과 연결된 것으로 League to League rewards(리그 연계 보상)도 있어요. 이번 리그에서 얻은 등급에 따라 다음 리그에서 해금되는 보상이에요!

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: League Starter Outfits(리그 시작 의상)과 League Icons(리그 아이콘) 등을 다음 리그용으로 해금할 수 있어요. 그리고 이번 리그에서 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 넘어가요.

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: 마지막으로, 이번 리그의 과제 외에도 몇 가지 활동이 있는데, 그걸 가장 먼저 완료한 분은 제가 따로 기념해 드려요.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: 활동 목록 전체와 누가 완료했는지는 제 옆 게시판에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: Not a problem. Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: 리그에서 펫은 어떻게 되는지 알려 주실래요?

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 물론이죠! 리그 중에 운 좋게 펫을 얻으면 자동으로 보험에 들어요.

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: 그러니까 펫을 잃어버리더라도 저한테 말하면 돌려드릴게요. 보험과 되찾기 모두 무료예요!

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: 게다가 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 옮겨져요. 제가 데리고 있을 테니 찾으러 오세요!

english: Okay! Thank you.
No worries. Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 별말씀을요. 펫을 얻으면 다시 찾아오세요. 수집품을 볼 수 있어요! 그럼, 다른 걸 도와드릴까요?

english: You receive some items from the Leagues Tutor.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: 알겠어요. 리그에 대해 더 알고 싶은 게 생기면 언제든 찾아오세요. 저는 여기 있을게요.

english: Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the world you're used to.
translation: 리그마다 익숙한 세계와는 다른 고유한 규칙과 특징이 있어요.

english: Not only that, but within this League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Fragments. Fragments completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: 그뿐 아니라 이번 리그에서는 Fragments(파편)이라는 강력한 아이템을 해금할 수 있어요. 파편은 리그를 진행하는 방식을 완전히 바꿔 놓죠!

english: So even if glory and gold are not for you, you'll still find Leagues to be a whole lot of fun!
translation: 그러니 영광이나 골드에 관심이 없더라도, 리그는 정말 재미있을 거예요!

english: Well sadly you're not eligible to take part in a League right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: 안타깝게도 지금은 리그에 참가할 수 없어요. 참가할 수 있게 되면 기꺼이 도와드릴게요.

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues III - Shattered Relics.
translation: 네! 지금 리그는 Leagues III - Shattered Relics(리그 III - 산산조각 난 유물)이에요.

english: Within this League you are restricted to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, you can unlock more skills by completing tasks to earn Sage's Renown.
translation: 이번 리그에서는 Defence(방어), Fishing(낚시), Thieving(도둑질) 세 스킬만 쓸 수 있어요. 과제를 완료해 Sage's Renown(현자의 명성)을 얻으면 더 많은 스킬을 해금할 수 있어요.

english: Sage's Renown can be used to purchase access to Skills, Bosses and to Auto Complete Quests.
translation: Sage's Renown(현자의 명성)으로 스킬과 보스 이용권을 사거나 퀘스트를 자동 완료할 수 있어요.

english: You can also collect powerful artifacts known as Fragments, each Fragment provides a different buff so be sure to collect them all.
translation: Fragments(파편)이라는 강력한 아이템도 모을 수 있어요. 파편마다 다른 버프를 주니 꼭 전부 모아 보세요.

english: You can level up these Fragments to make them even stronger, you can also bring together different Fragments to activate powerful buffs known as Set Effects.
translation: 파편은 레벨을 올려 더 강하게 만들 수 있고, 서로 다른 파편을 모아 Set Effects(세트 효과)라는 강력한 버프를 발동할 수도 있어요.

english: I heard there's one that lets you swap between Magic spellbooks whenever you want!
translation: 언제든 Magic(마법) 주문서를 바꿀 수 있는 파편도 있다고 들었어요!

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 그뿐 아니라 반드시 Iron Man(아이언맨)으로 참가해야 해요. 모든 걸 혼자 힘으로 해결해야 하고 다른 참가자와 거래할 수 없다는 뜻이죠.

english: Interesting. Maybe I should take part.
I'd highly recommend it.
The Leagues Reward Shop is temporarily closed.
translation: Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)은 잠시 문을 닫았어요.

english: League Trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League Points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: 리그 트로피는 특정 리그에서 얼마나 잘했는지를 보여 줘요. 성적은 다른 모든 참가자와 비교해 얻은 리그 포인트 수로 판단해요.

english: Of course!
You have not earned any League trophies. If you want a League trophy you should participate next time a League comes around!
translation: 아직 받은 리그 트로피가 없어요. 리그 트로피를 원하시면 다음 리그가 열릴 때 참가해 보세요!

english: You receive a League trophy from the Leagues Tutor.
translation: Leagues Tutor(리그 교사)에게서 리그 트로피를 받았다.

english: You do not have enough space for all the League Trophies available to you. Come back to me when you do.
translation: 받을 수 있는 리그 트로피를 다 담을 공간이 없네요. 공간이 생기면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Ah! Looks like you have already claimed all of the League Trophies available to you.
translation: 아! 받을 수 있는 리그 트로피는 이미 전부 받으셨네요.

english: You earned 0 League points which does not qualify you for any trophy.
translation: 리그 포인트를 0점 얻으셔서 받을 수 있는 트로피가 없어요.

english: Hi there.
Hello. Who are you?
I'm the Tutor for Leagues. If you have any questions about Leagues, I can help you out.
translation: 저는 리그 교사예요. 리그에 대해 궁금한 게 있으면 제가 도와드릴게요.

english: What changes have been made for this League?
Yes, please.
Not right now.
How do tasks work?
How does the area system work?
What are Relics?
Tell me about League rewards.
Let's talk about pets.
Do I have any League items to collect?
Hello! Welcome to the Twisted League. I see you are new here.
translation: 안녕하세요! Twisted League(뒤틀린 리그)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 처음 오셨나 봐요.

english: Yes, this is my first League. Can you explain how they work?
translation: 네, 첫 리그예요. 어떻게 하는 건지 설명해 주실래요?

english: I'd be happy to!
First of all, I'm your Leagues Tutor. If you have any questions about how Leagues work, you can come to me for help.
translation: 우선, 저는 리그 교사예요. 리그가 어떻게 돌아가는지 궁금한 게 있으면 언제든 저를 찾아오세요.

english: Now, Leagues are time-limited modes that give you a new way to play the game. For this League, you are restricted to the Kourend and Kebos regions, and you play as an Iron Man.
translation: 자, 리그는 게임을 새롭게 즐길 수 있는 기간 한정 모드예요. 이번 리그에서는 Kourend(쿠렌드)와 Kebos(케보스) 지역에서만 활동할 수 있고, Iron Man(아이언맨)으로 플레이해요.

english: Let's take a look at all of the information available about this League. There is a new section in the journal tab whilst on a Leagues world. Click on the flashing quest icon to take a look.
translation: 이번 리그에 대한 정보를 전부 살펴보죠. 리그 월드에 있는 동안에는 일지 탭에 새 항목이 생겨요. 깜박이는 퀘스트 아이콘을 눌러 보세요.

english: Now that you have your journal open, click on the flashing Leagues icon.
translation: 일지를 열었으면 깜박이는 리그 아이콘을 누르세요.

english: This is the Leagues menu. Here you can view your progress through the current League. You can also open the various Leagues interfaces from here.
translation: 이게 리그 메뉴예요. 여기서 현재 리그 진행 상황을 볼 수 있어요. 여러 리그 화면도 여기서 열 수 있고요.

english: Your objective in each League is to complete tasks and earn League Points.
translation: 리그마다 목표는 과제를 완료해 League Points(리그 포인트)를 얻는 거예요.

english: Tasks are split into five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master. The harder the task, the more points awarded.
translation: 과제는 초급, 중급, 상급, 엘리트, 마스터 다섯 난이도로 나뉘어요. 어려운 과제일수록 포인트를 더 많이 줘요.

english: Let's have a look at the tasks interface now. Click on the flashing button to open it.
translation: 이제 과제 화면을 살펴보죠. 깜박이는 버튼을 눌러 열어 보세요.

english: This is the tasks interface. Here you can see all the tasks available to you in this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 이게 과제 화면이에요. 이번 리그에서 할 수 있는 모든 과제를 볼 수 있어요. 계속할 준비가 되면 화면 구석의 X를 눌러 닫으세요.

english: Earning points during the League will allow you to unlock powerful Twisted Relics. The more League Points you have, the more Relics available to you.
translation: 리그 중에 포인트를 얻으면 강력한 Twisted Relics(뒤틀린 유물)을 해금할 수 있어요. 리그 포인트가 많을수록 쓸 수 있는 유물도 늘어나요.

english: League Points are also transferred over to your main profile. There, they can be spent on rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 리그 포인트는 본 프로필로도 옮겨져요. 거기서 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)의 보상을 사는 데 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Now let's have a look at the Twisted Relics. Click on the flashing button to take a look at the Relics interface.
translation: 이제 Twisted Relics(뒤틀린 유물)을 살펴보죠. 깜박이는 버튼을 눌러 유물 화면을 열어 보세요.

english: This is the Relics interface. Here you can unlock new Twisted Relics to be used during this League. When you are ready to continue, close the interface by clicking on the cross in the corner of it.
translation: 이게 유물 화면이에요. 여기서 이번 리그 동안 쓸 새 Twisted Relics(뒤틀린 유물)을 해금할 수 있어요. 계속할 준비가 되면 화면 구석의 X를 눌러 닫으세요.

english: There are a few changes to Kourend and Kebos which you may not be used to. You can view all of these changes on the information interface.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)와 Kebos(케보스)에는 익숙하지 않을 만한 변경 사항이 몇 가지 있어요. 변경 사항은 모두 안내 화면에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: Right, I think that's everything. If you need reminding of any of this information, you can either talk to me or read the information interface.
translation: 좋아요, 이걸로 다 된 것 같네요. 이 내용을 다시 알고 싶으면 저한테 말을 걸거나 안내 화면을 읽어 보세요.

english: Before you head off though, it's time to pick your first Relic! Choose carefully though, once you've picked a Relic you can't go back and change your decision.
translation: 하지만 떠나기 전에, 첫 번째 유물을 고를 시간이에요! 신중하게 고르세요. 한번 고른 유물은 되돌려 바꿀 수 없거든요.

english: Hi there.
Hello, who are you?
I'm the Tutor for Old School Leagues.
translation: 저는 Old School Leagues(올드 스쿨 리그)의 교사예요.

english: Old School Leagues are time-limited game modes that are separate from your main profile.
translation: Old School Leagues(올드 스쿨 리그)는 본 프로필과 별개로 운영되는 기간 한정 게임 모드예요.

english: With each League, you start afresh, with a limited amount of time to progress through the game mode.
translation: 리그가 열릴 때마다 처음부터 새로 시작하고, 정해진 시간 안에 게임 모드를 진행해 나가야 해요.

english: So it's a fresh start? Why would I want that?
translation: 그러니까 새 출발이라는 거죠? 그걸 왜 하고 싶겠어요?

english: Glory, gold, and the chance to play the game in a different way!
translation: 영광, 골드, 그리고 색다른 방식으로 게임을 즐길 기회죠!

english: Each League Rank will unlock a trophy for you. These trophies can be used to show off how well you did.
translation: 리그 등급마다 트로피가 하나씩 해금돼요. 이 트로피로 얼마나 잘했는지 자랑할 수 있죠.

english: If that doesn't interest you, how about gold! When you earn League Points, they will be transferred over to your main profile.
translation: 그게 별로라면, 골드는 어때요! League Points(리그 포인트)를 얻으면 본 프로필로 옮겨져요.

english: These points can be used to buy things from the Leagues Reward Shop. You can keep these purchases for yourself or sell them on to other players!
translation: 이 포인트로 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 물건을 살 수 있어요. 산 물건은 직접 가져도 되고 다른 플레이어에게 팔아도 돼요!

english: Leagues aren't just a copy of the normal game. Every League has unique rules and features to set it aside from the game you're used to.
translation: 리그는 그냥 일반 게임을 복사한 게 아니에요. 리그마다 익숙한 게임과는 다른 고유한 규칙과 특징이 있어요.

english: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you play the game!
translation: 그뿐 아니라 리그마다 Relics(유물)이라는 강력한 아이템을 해금할 수 있어요. 유물은 게임하는 방식을 완전히 바꿔 놓죠!

english: No, The most recent League was the Twisted League. You can now claim your trophies from the Twisted League and purchase rewards using your League points.
translation: 아니요, 가장 최근 리그는 Twisted League(뒤틀린 리그)였어요. 이제 뒤틀린 리그의 트로피를 받고, 리그 포인트로 보상을 살 수 있어요.

english: League trophies are a representation of how well you did in a specific League. Performance is judged on the number of League points you earned compared to everyone else who participated.
translation: 리그 트로피는 특정 리그에서 얼마나 잘했는지를 보여 줘요. 성적은 다른 모든 참가자와 비교해 얻은 리그 포인트 수로 판단해요.

english: There are seven tiers of Trophy: Bronze, Iron, Steel, Mithril, Adamant, Rune and Dragon. Each League trophy has a logo on the front so you can tell which League it was awarded from.
translation: 트로피에는 일곱 등급이 있어요: Bronze(청동), Iron(철), Steel(강철), Mithril(미스릴), Adamant(아다만트), Rune(룬), Dragon(드래곤). 리그 트로피마다 앞면에 로고가 있어서 어느 리그에서 받은 건지 알 수 있어요.

english: What are the League point cut-offs for the Twisted League?
translation: Twisted League(뒤틀린 리그)의 리그 포인트 기준은 어떻게 되나요?

english: Bronze trophy: 10 points, Iron trophy: 80 points, Steel trophy: 510 points, Mithril trophy: 1770 points.
translation: Bronze trophy(청동 트로피): 10포인트, Iron trophy(철 트로피): 80포인트, Steel trophy(강철 트로피): 510포인트, Mithril trophy(미스릴 트로피): 1770포인트.

english: Adamant trophy: 5270 points, Rune trophy: 10820 points and the Dragon Trophy: 20830 points.
translation: Adamant trophy(아다만트 트로피): 5270포인트, Rune trophy(룬 트로피): 10820포인트, 그리고 Dragon Trophy(드래곤 트로피): 20830포인트예요.

english: You earned [number] League points which qualifies you for the all of the Twisted League trophies up to and including the Twisted [type] trophy!
translation: 리그 포인트를 [number]점 얻으셨으니, Twisted League(뒤틀린 리그) 트로피 중 뒤틀린 [type] 트로피까지 모두 받을 수 있어요!

english: Can I purchase my League rewards?
translation: 제 리그 보상을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Certainly, I have a number of unique rewards which you can purchase using points earned competing in a League. Here is what is available.
translation: 그럼요, 리그에 참가해 얻은 포인트로 살 수 있는 특별한 보상이 여럿 있어요. 지금 살 수 있는 건 이거예요.

english: I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Of course, here are the trophies you have earned.
You do not have enough space for all the League trophies you can claim. Come back to me when you have more space.
translation: 받을 수 있는 리그 트로피를 다 담을 공간이 없네요. 공간을 더 마련해서 다시 찾아오세요.

english: You have already claimed all of the League trophies which you have earned.
translation: 받으신 리그 트로피는 이미 전부 가져가셨어요.

english: How do League trophies work?
I'd like to claim my League trophies.
Maybe some other time.
Can I purchase my League rewards?
translation: 제 리그 보상을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Hello.
Can I help you?
What do you do here?
Well, I can cure plain cowhides into pieces of leather ready for crafting.
translation: 음, 저는 평범한 cowhides(소가죽)을 손질해서 공예에 바로 쓸 수 있는 leather(가죽)으로 만들어 드려요.

english: I work with ordinary, hard or dragonhide leather and also snakeskin. What would you like to know about?
translation: 저는 일반 가죽, hard leather(경화 가죽), dragonhide leather(용가죽), 그리고 snakeskin(뱀가죽)도 다뤄요. 무엇이 궁금하세요?

english: Ordinary leather.
I can work one piece of cow hide into ordinary leather. It only costs one piece of gold.
translation: cow hide(소가죽) 한 장을 일반 leather(가죽)으로 만들어 드릴 수 있어요. 단돈 1골드밖에 안 해요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 그 밖에 또 도와드릴 게 있나요?

english: Hard leather.
Hard leather is made by specially treating normal leather by wetting and drying several times.
translation: Hard leather(경화 가죽)은 일반 가죽을 특별한 방법으로 처리해서 만드는데, 적셨다 말리기를 여러 번 반복해요.

english: It's then treated with pine oils. It's harder wearing than ordinary leather.
translation: 그다음엔 소나무 기름으로 처리하죠. 일반 가죽보다 훨씬 질기고 오래가요.

english: Snake skins.
I can work one piece of snake hide into a snakeskin. It only costs 15 pieces of gold. Snakeskin armour is great for intermediate level rangers and provides more defence than hard and studded leather.
translation: snake hide(뱀 생가죽) 한 장을 snakeskin(뱀가죽)으로 만들어 드릴 수 있어요. 단돈 15골드밖에 안 해요. Snakeskin armour(뱀가죽 갑옷)은 중급 레벨 궁수에게 아주 좋고, hard leather(경화 가죽)이나 studded leather(징 박은 가죽)보다 방어력도 높아요.

english: Dragonhide leather.
Dragon leather is made from dragonhides. One piece of hide can be worked into one piece of dragon leather. It costs 20 coins each piece.
translation: Dragon leather(용가죽)은 dragonhides(용 생가죽)으로 만들어요. 생가죽 한 장으로 용가죽 한 장을 만들 수 있죠. 한 장에 20코인이에요.

english: Dragon leather is hard-wearing and has excellent flexibility. You can make strong and supple armour with this.
translation: 용가죽은 질기면서도 유연성이 뛰어나요. 이걸로 튼튼하면서도 몸에 잘 맞는 갑옷을 만들 수 있죠.

english: I'm bored of leather already.
You may be bored now, but an arrow in the backside will soon fix that!
translation: 지금은 지겨우시겠지만, 엉덩이에 화살 한 대 꽂히면 지루할 틈도 없을걸요!

english: No thanks.
Suit yourself.
I'd like you to tan something for me.
What do you do here?
Ordinary leather.
Hard leather.
Snakeskin.
Dragonhide leather.
I'm bored of leather already.
No thanks.
Hello!
May the chaos rot your soul.
Who are you?
My name is Gura.
Nice to meet you Gura, my name is [player name].
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Gura(구라). 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: Did you want something?
What have you got?
No, I mean... Nevermind.
What do you do here?
I speak the teachings of Zamorak.
So, fire and brimstone?
translation: 그러니까, 지옥불이 어쩌고 하는 설교 같은 거요?

english: Amongst other things.
Like?
Well, traveller, if you hadn't already noticed, a foul plague has beset this town. Not only that, but there is talk of a great evil stirring below...
translation: 여행자여, 아직 눈치채지 못했다면 말해 주겠소. 끔찍한 역병이 이 마을을 덮쳤소. 그뿐 아니라, 저 아래에서 거대한 악이 꿈틀대고 있다는 말도 돌고 있소...

english: I see... So is the plague contagious? Because I could be elsewhere, now you mention it.
translation: 그렇군요... 그럼 그 역병 전염돼요? 말씀을 듣고 보니 저는 딴 데 가 있어도 될 것 같아서요.

english: Well, we're taking precautions, but you should be fine. Providing you don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong, that is.
translation: 뭐, 우리가 대비하고 있으니 그대는 괜찮을 거요. 괜히 상관없는 일에 코를 들이밀지만 않는다면 말이오.

english: Keep my nose to myself, gotcha!
translation: 남의 일에 코 안 들이밀기, 알겠어요!

english: Bye!
May the flames guide you.
I'm... sure they will.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
What are you waiting here for?
That is no concern of yours, adventurer.
translation: 그건 당신이 상관할 일이 아니에요, 모험가님.

english: Thank you, Al-Kharid will forever owe you for your help. I think that if there is ever anything that needs to be done, you will be someone they can rely on.
translation: 고마워요. Al-Kharid(알 카리드)는 당신의 도움을 영원히 잊지 않을 거예요. 앞으로 해야 할 일이 생긴다면, 당신이야말로 그들이 믿고 맡길 수 있는 사람일 거예요.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 어떤 작업이 필요하세요?

english: I'd like two Wooden small tables built.
translation: Wooden small tables(작은 나무 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: Wooden bed(나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: Wooden table(나무 탁자)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
translation: Wooden cupboard(나무 찬장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like two Oak small tables built.
translation: Oak small tables(작은 참나무 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: Oak bed(참나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: Oak table(참나무 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: Oak cupboard(참나무 찬장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Teak small tables built.
translation: Teak small tables(작은 티크 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Teak bed(티크 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: Teak table(티크 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
translation: Teak cupboard(티크 찬장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany small tables built.
translation: Mahogany small tables(작은 마호가니 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Mahogany table(마호가니 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: Mahogany cupboard(마호가니 찬장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가시기 전에 차 한 잔 하실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 역시 맛있는 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
A great adventurer, from afar? How may I help with my repertoire?
translation: 먼 곳에서 오신 위대한 모험가시군요? 제 물건들로 어떻게 도와드릴까요?

english: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
! ! ! Attention ! ! !
Legends' Guild Member Approaching!
Welcome [Sir/Madam]! I hope you enjoy your time in the Legends' Guild.
translation: 환영합니다, [Sir/Madam]! Legends' Guild(전설의 길드)에서 즐거운 시간 보내시길 바랍니다.

english: I hope the quest is going well [sir/madam]
Legends Guild Member Approaching!
Do you wish to serve the balance? You'll need weapons if you do. These, I can provide.
translation: 균형을 섬기길 원하오? 그렇다면 무기가 필요할 것이오. 그건 내가 마련해 줄 수 있소.

english: Let's see what you have.
Do you make a lot of money selling weapons?
To be a Kahlith is to abandon all attachment. Both physical and emotional. I have no use for money.
translation: Kahlith(칼리스)가 된다는 것은 모든 집착을 버린다는 것이오. 물질적인 것도, 감정적인 것도. 나에게 돈은 쓸모가 없소.

english: So why don't you give out the weapons for free?
translation: 그럼 무기를 그냥 공짜로 나눠 주면 되잖아요?

english: While we care not for money, your kind still do. While a Kahlith will do anything for the balance, your kind are not so generous.
translation: 우리는 돈에 관심이 없지만, 그대의 종족은 여전히 돈을 원하오. Kahlith(칼리스)는 균형을 위해서라면 무엇이든 하겠지만, 그대의 종족은 그렇게 너그럽지 않소.

english: So you use the money to pay us for things?
translation: 그럼 그 돈으로 저희한테 물건값을 치르는 거예요?

english: Exactly. For us to serve the balance, we must trade with your people. That is what the money is for.
translation: 바로 그렇소. 우리가 균형을 섬기려면 그대의 종족과 거래해야 하오. 돈은 그걸 위한 것이오.

english: Anyway, would you like to purchase some weapons?
I'm good thanks.
Let's see what you have.
Do you make a lot of money selling weapons?
I'm good thanks.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우우?  우우우우 우우 우우우우우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우우 우우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우! 우우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데, 진짜로요: 저 엄~청 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 수 없다고들 하지만, 가끔은 그냥 은행 계좌를 열어서 제가 가진 걸 전부 쳐다보면서 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋더라고요:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 음, 우리 같은 살아 있는 부자들은 당신 같은 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 시간 낭비하고 싶지 않거든요. 저는 너~무 부자라서 이제 가 봐야 해요. 어쩌면 더 부자가 되러 가는 걸지도요.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 네, 저도 그 얘기 들었어요, 하하하!

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 언제나 맞는 말이죠. 나중에 봐요, 이상한 투명 망자 씨!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘지 않은데 저는 cooked chicken(익힌 닭고기)가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도요, 하지만 집에서 구운 파이만 한 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 그래요? 전혀 몰랐네요. 음, 저는 가 봐야겠어요. 나중에 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너희는 살아남을 기회가 없다 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
translation: 너희의 모든 기지는 우리에게 속해 있는 것이다.

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 저한테 그런 식으로 말해도 된다고 생각하지 마세요!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 제가 당신을 혼내 줄 방법을 못 찾을 거라 생각하지 마요, 유령 씨!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아뇨, 저는 평생 거기 가 본 적도 없고, 갔을 때 뭘 훔친 적은 더더욱 없어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 지금 저를 거짓말쟁이라고 하는 거예요?!?! 저는 평생 단 한 번도 뭘 훔친 적이 없어요. 제가 그렇게 도덕적으로 타락해서 남이 피땀 흘려 번

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 돈을 그 사람 주머니에서 훔쳐 갈 인간이라는 듯한 말씀, 정말 불쾌하네요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 아니면 케이크라든가. 모피라든가. 몇 번이고. 오랫동안 계속해서.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나오신다면 저도 이 문제에 대해 더 할 말 없어요. 그럼 좋은 하루 보내세요!

english: Hello. You would be Lennissa, I take it?
Who are you? Where did you hear that name? How comes it that you can see and speak to me?
translation: 그대는 누구요? 그 이름은 어디서 들었소? 어떻게 나를 보고 말할 수 있는 것이오?

english: Well, a ghost called Kharrim directed me towards you.
translation: 음, Kharrim(카림)이라는 유령이 당신한테 가 보라고 했어요.

english: So that weasel Kharrim has been blighted by this curse too?
translation: 그럼 그 족제비 같은 Kharrim(카림)도 이 저주에 걸렸단 말이오?

english: Ha, a good thing too. If anybody deserved such a fate it would be one such as him.
translation: 하, 잘됐군. 그런 운명을 맞아 마땅한 자가 있다면 바로 그자일 것이오.

english: I guess you didn't get along then?
No, evil scum such as he should never have been allowed to walk this world.
translation: 그렇소, 그런 사악한 쓰레기는 애초에 이 세상을 활보하게 두어서는 안 됐소.

english: What lies has he told you to come here? Have you come to try and kill me?
translation: 그자가 무슨 거짓말을 했기에 여기까지 온 것이오? 나를 죽이러 온 것이오?

english: Well, I'm not sure I could if I tried, but that is not why I have come to you.
translation: 음, 그러려고 해도 할 수 있을지 모르겠지만, 그것 때문에 온 건 아니에요.

english: Then speak, and speak well, for I may yet be dead, but am still a danger to those who cross me.
translation: 그렇다면 말하시오. 말을 잘 고르시오. 나는 죽은 몸이지만, 나를 거스르는 자에게는 여전히 위험한 존재이니.

english: Actually, I'm trying to work out why all of you invisible ghosts seem to have been cursed.
translation: 사실, 당신 같은 투명한 유령들이 왜 다들 저주를 받은 건지 알아내려는 중이에요.

english: I'm not sure how exactly, but the trail seems to have led me to you...
translation: 정확히 어떻게인지는 모르겠지만, 단서를 따라왔더니 당신에게 이르렀어요...

english: That makes no sense... I served Saradomin faithfully my entire life, then all of a sudden I find myself reduced to this state!
translation: 말도 안 되는 소리요... 나는 평생 충실하게 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬겼소. 그런데 갑자기 이런 꼴이 되어 버렸단 말이오!

english: Well, it seems as though that may have been the cause...
What? Explain yourself.
As I understand it, it was something to do with the Staff of Armadyl, and your refusal to tell Saradomin that it had been stolen...
translation: 제가 알기로는, Staff of Armadyl(아마딜의 지팡이)와 관련된 일이었고, 당신이 그것이 도난당했다는 사실을 Saradomin(사라도민)에게 알리지 않은 것 때문이라던데요...

english: What? But... But that is not how it happened at all!
translation: 뭐라고? 하지만... 하지만 일은 전혀 그렇게 일어나지 않았소!

english: Then please, go ahead and tell me the events of that day in your own words...
translation: 그럼 부디, 그날 있었던 일을 당신 입으로 직접 말해 주세요...

english: Let me see... I had been working as a spy for my Lord Saradomin, amongst the forces of... the Empty Lord.
translation: 어디 보자... 나는 내 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)을 위해... Empty Lord(공허의 군주)의 군대 속에서 첩자로 일하고 있었소.

english: 'The Empty Lord'? Who is that?
I will not give you his name, for to do so would give him power here.
translation: 그의 이름은 알려 줄 수 없소. 그 이름을 입에 올리는 것만으로도 이곳에서 그에게 힘을 주게 되니.

english: Let us just say that he was a fearsome deity, whose strength was greater than all the gods we knew of on this realm at the time.
translation: 그저 그가 무시무시한 신이었고, 그 힘이 당시 이 세계에서 우리가 알던 어떤 신보다도 강했다고만 해 두겠소.

english: It is probably worth mentioning that at this time we had no knowledge of the mysterious nature god Guthix.
translation: 덧붙이자면, 그 당시 우리는 신비로운 자연의 신 Guthix(구식스)에 대해 전혀 알지 못했소.

english: So he was stronger than Saradomin?
As Saradomin was, yes. As Saradomin is now? Who can say?
translation: 그때의 Saradomin(사라도민)보다는 그렇소. 지금의 사라도민보다도? 누가 알겠소?

english: I see... Please, continue.
As I say, I was working as a spy within the very camp of my Lord's enemies.
translation: 말했듯이, 나는 바로 내 주군의 적들 진영 한가운데에서 첩자로 일하고 있었소.

english: I knew that should I have been caught, I risked being killed upon the spot, but my combat skills were always formidable, and if truth be told, there was a fair amount of dissent amongst... 'his' followers anyway.
translation: 들키면 그 자리에서 죽을 수도 있다는 건 알고 있었지만, 내 전투 실력은 언제나 뛰어났고, 사실대로 말하자면 '그'의 추종자들 사이에는 어차피 불화가 꽤 많았소.

english: How do you mean 'dissent'?
Ah, to not understand this, you must have led a sheltered life...
translation: 아, 이걸 모른다니 그대는 꽤나 곱게 자란 모양이구려...

english: Let me tell you this: Evil will always breed more evil, and will never be satisfied with what it has.
translation: 이것만은 말해 주겠소. 악은 언제나 더 많은 악을 낳고, 가진 것에 결코 만족하지 않는 법이오.

english: The Empty Lord chose to ally himself with the dark creatures of this world, fully aware that their own natures would cause them to rally against his rule, and take every opportunity they could to betray him.
translation: Empty Lord(공허의 군주)는 이 세상의 어둠의 존재들과 손을 잡기로 했소. 그들의 본성상 결국 그의 통치에 맞서 들고일어나고, 기회만 있으면 그를 배신하리라는 걸 잘 알면서도 말이오.

english: This has always been the nature of evil. Perhaps he thought his power could prevent such treachery?
translation: 악의 본성은 언제나 그러했소. 어쩌면 그는 자신의 힘으로 그런 배신을 막을 수 있다고 생각했던 것일까?

english: This allowed me freedom amongst their camp, for it was always easy to point the finger of suspicion at some unsuspecting necromancer or foolish Mahjarrat if it seemed as though my activities had been discovered.
translation: 덕분에 나는 그들 진영에서 자유롭게 움직일 수 있었소. 내 활동이 들킨 것 같으면, 아무것도 모르는 necromancer(강령술사)나 어리석은 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)에게 의심의 화살을 돌리기는 언제나 쉬웠으니 말이오.

english: Similarly, should I ever be caught in the act of my sabotage, it was all too easy to bribe whoever found me or persuade them into believing it was just some minor treachery of my own, rather than my work for my
translation: 마찬가지로, 혹시 방해 공작을 하다 현장에서 들키더라도, 나를 발견한 자를 매수하거나, 이것이 그저 나 개인의 사소한 배신일 뿐이지 내 주군

english: Lord Saradomin.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)을 위한 일은 아니라고 믿게 만들기란 너무도 쉬웠소.

english: Okay... Well, that makes sense, but I don't understand what the Staff of Armadyl had to do with this...?
translation: 알겠어요... 음, 그건 이해가 되는데, 그게 Staff of Armadyl(아마딜의 지팡이)와 무슨 상관인지 모르겠어요...?

english: As I have told you, the Empty Lord was extremely powerful, but not so powerful that he could rule over the other deities of this world without opposition.
translation: 말했듯이, Empty Lord(공허의 군주)는 엄청나게 강력했지만, 이 세상의 다른 신들을 아무런 저항 없이 다스릴 만큼 강하지는 않았소.

english: Should he have made a move against any other god, then he could still have been easily brought down by the combined efforts of the others.
translation: 그가 다른 신에게 손을 뻗었다면, 다른 신들이 힘을 합쳐 여전히 손쉽게 그를 무너뜨릴 수 있었을 것이오.

english: The theft of Armadyl's staff changed this however.
translation: 하지만 Armadyl(아마딜)의 지팡이가 도난당하면서 상황이 달라졌소.

english: If he had taken possession of this god-weapon, then his power would have been so great that he could have overthrown all on this world, and made it into his own image!
translation: 그가 그 신의 무기를 손에 넣었다면, 그의 힘은 이 세상 모든 것을 뒤엎고 자신의 형상대로 바꿔 놓을 수 있을 만큼 막강해졌을 것이오!

english: I could not allow such a thing to happen!
translation: 그런 일이 일어나게 둘 수는 없었소!

english: I went immediately to my comrade Dhalak, the mage, and told him that a message had come to the lair offering this weapon for sale!
translation: 나는 곧장 내 동료인 마법사 Dhalak(달락)에게 가서, 이 무기를 팔겠다는 전갈이 소굴로 들어왔다고 알렸소!

english: I knew that as soon as my Lord Saradomin heard this, he would contact Armadyl to inform them of the theft, and the matter would have been resolved quickly and discreetly.
translation: 내 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 이 소식을 들으시면 곧바로 Armadyl(아마딜)에게 연락해 도난 사실을 알리실 것이고, 그러면 일은 신속하고 조용히 해결되리라 생각했소.

english: So you passed this information to Dhalak instead of taking it to Saradomin yourself?
translation: 그러니까 Saradomin(사라도민)에게 직접 전하지 않고 Dhalak(달락)에게 이 정보를 넘긴 거예요?

english: To my eternal shame, I indeed failed my Lord Saradomin...
translation: 영원히 씻을 수 없는 수치지만, 나는 정녕 내 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)을 저버리고 말았소...

english: I could not risk taking the message directly, for I feared my disguise had been uncovered.
translation: 내 정체가 탄로 났을까 두려워, 직접 전갈을 가져갈 위험을 무릅쓸 수 없었소.

english: Lucien particularly had been taking an unhealthy interest in my activities, and I had a gut feeling that to make any obvious moves against the Empty Lord would have been my undoing.
translation: 특히 Lucien(루시엔)이 내 활동에 지나친 관심을 보이고 있었고, Empty Lord(공허의 군주)에 맞서 눈에 띄는 행동을 하면 그것이 내 파멸이 되리라는 직감이 들었소.

english: But Dhalak was a noble man! I cannot believe that he would not have taken my message immediately to Lord Saradomin!
translation: 하지만 Dhalak(달락)은 고결한 사람이었소! 그가 내 전갈을 곧장 주군 Saradomin(사라도민)께 전하지 않았을 리가 없소!

english: Well, it seems like he didn't, but I don't know why not...
translation: 음, 그런데 전하지 않은 것 같아요. 왜 그랬는지는 모르겠지만요...

english: Please adventurer, discover what foul fate must have befallen him for him to have neglected his duty!
translation: 부탁하오, 모험가여. 그가 의무를 저버릴 만큼 어떤 끔찍한 운명이 닥쳤는지 알아내 주시오!

english: I have not much to offer as reward, but for these spare robes I wore while on assignment...
translation: 보답으로 줄 것이 많지는 않지만, 임무 중에 입던 이 여분의 로브라도 주겠소...

english: Please find him and discover why I am cursed like this!
translation: 부디 그를 찾아 내가 왜 이렇게 저주받았는지 알아내 주시오!

english: Where would I be able to find this Dhalak then?
translation: 그럼 그 Dhalak(달락)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Dhalak? I know not where, but he would try and make the most of his situation if he has been cursed, and find a place to lift his spirits!
translation: Dhalak(달락)? 어디 있는지는 모르겠소만, 그가 저주에 걸렸다면 그 처지에서도 최대한 즐기려 했을 테니, 축 처진 영혼을 한잔으로 달랠 만한 곳을 찾았을 것이오!

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
Dhalak? Well, he was always a knowlegeable mage, so if this curse has befallen him as well, I would suspect he would be researching how to free himself of it.
translation: Dhalak(달락)? 그는 언제나 박식한 마법사였으니, 그에게도 이 저주가 닥쳤다면 저주에서 벗어날 방법을 연구하고 있을 것이오.

english: I would look for a library to find him if I were you.
Dhalak? He was always a loyal follower of Saradomin... I think he would have found an altar to Saradomin so that he may pray for this curse to be lifted.
translation: Dhalak(달락)? 그는 언제나 Saradomin(사라도민)의 충실한 추종자였소... 아마 사라도민의 제단을 찾아가 이 저주가 풀리기를 기도하고 있을 것이오.

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데 솔직히 별 관심 없어요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hello Lennissa. Can you remind me where to find Dhalak?
translation: 안녕하세요, Lennissa(레니사). Dhalak(달락)을 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: Hello.
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 전에 주셨던 ghostly robes(유령 로브)를 더 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 나를 이곳에 묶어 둔 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양이오... 어느 것을 원하오?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Dhalak.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
As you approach Lenny, he takes something out of his pocket.
translation: Lenny(레니)에게 다가가자, 그가 주머니에서 무언가를 꺼낸다.

english: What'd you take out of that pocket?
Ain't a thing in my pocket...
I know there ain't. You got it in your hand...
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장에게 가시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 의심하고 있어서, 물건을 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 내게 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 얘기나 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하다면 내 문은 언제나 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 만난 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 것을 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 여기서 지체할 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 원하는 게 있던 것도 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 어떻게 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 모든 일이 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 한 것이오, [Fremennik name]?

english: How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 그렇게 좋으세요? 여기 사람들은 다들 좀 우울해 보이네요.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 한숨 쉬시는 데 방해 안 할게요. 할 일이 많아 보이시네요.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 한동안 지내다 보면 기분이 가라앉는다오. 회색에도 273가지 색조가 있다던데, 여긴 그게 전부 다 있소.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 그 농담 때문에 더 우울해졌소. 혼자 있게 해 주시오.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
translation: 그렇소, 왜 있잖소. 소작농, 천민, 짓밟힌 자들 말이오. 왕은 우리를 자기 개인 소유물처럼 다루오.

english: You should leave this place.
I keep trying to save up enough to leave, but the King keeps taxing us! We have no money left.
translation: 떠날 만큼 돈을 모으려고 계속 애쓰지만, 왕이 계속 세금을 걷어 가오! 남은 돈이 한 푼도 없소.

english: Oh dear.
Cheer up! It's not the end of the world.
translation: 기운 내세요! 세상이 끝나는 것도 아니잖아요.

english: I'd prefer that, if it meant I didn't have to talk to people as inanely happy as you.
translation: 차라리 세상이 끝났으면 좋겠소. 그러면 그대처럼 실없이 행복한 사람과 말을 섞지 않아도 될 테니.

english: Whoa! I think you need to get out more.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람들에게 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안녕하세요, 반가워요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 하나로 치는 거잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시에 참 좋은 날이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 할 게 아주 많죠! 탑들은 정말 멋진 볼거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Looking for a bit of meat?
I beg your pardon?
Meat! We've got all the good stuff here.
translation: 고기! 여기 좋은 건 다 있어.

english: Show me what you've got.
Why do you have all this meat?
Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf visitors need something to eat too.
translation: 피만 마시긴 심심하다고 고기를 곁들이는 이들도 있거든. 게다가 werewolf(늑대인간) 손님들도 먹을 게 필요하고.

english: Where does it all come from?
Look around you! There's no shortage of meat in these parts.
translation: 주위를 둘러봐! 이 동네엔 고기가 모자랄 일이 없지.

english: You know what, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 저기요, 그만 들어도 될 것 같아요.

english: Whatever you say. So, want some meat?
I'm good, thanks.
Come back if you ever want some meat!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Show me what you've got.
Why do you have all this meat?
I'm good, thanks.
Can you come and help me, [player name]? I've got a problem with some graves.
translation: [player name]님, 와서 저 좀 도와줄 수 있어요? 무덤에 문제가 좀 생겼어요.

english: Okay, I'll help with your graves.
Player is teleported to Leo's graveyard
Sorry, I'm busy.
You have to help me, [player name]! I've put the wrong coffins into these graves.
translation: 도와주셔야 해요, [player name]님! 제가 이 무덤들에 관을 잘못 넣었어요.

english: I need you to pick up the coffin from each grave, see who's inside it, and bury it in the grave with the correct gravestone.
translation: 무덤마다 coffin(관)을 꺼내서 안에 누가 있는지 확인하고, 알맞은 gravestone(묘비)가 있는 무덤에 묻어 주세요.

english: I think I've finished!
That's a good attempt, but it's just not right. Try looking in the coffins to learn who is in them, and read the gravestones to see who is supposed to be buried there.
translation: 잘 시도하셨지만, 아직 맞지 않아요. 관을 들여다보고 안에 누가 있는지 알아낸 다음, 묘비를 읽고 거기 누가 묻혀야 하는지 확인해 보세요.

english: All right, I'll give it another shot.
Wonderful! That's taken care of them. I'll take you back, and give you your reward.
translation: 훌륭해요! 이제 다 정리됐네요. 원래 계시던 곳으로 모셔다드리고 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 제가 뭘 해야 하는지 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Pick up the coffins.
Check the body inside.
Find out where they need to be buried.
Put all five coffins in the correct graves.
translation: 관 다섯 개를 모두 알맞은 무덤에 넣으세요.

english: You can store items in the mausoleum if you need more
inventory space.
I want to leave now.
In that case, I'll take you back to where I found you.
Player is teleported to back to the previous location
Welcome back!
What? But how am I still here?
translation: 네? 그런데 제가 어떻게 아직 여기 있죠?

english: You died, and now you are in a graveyard.
Where did you think you would go?
Sorry, I need help from [player name].
Hello, [player name]?
Please help me, [player name].
I need your help, [player name]!
Can I borrow you for a minute, [player name]?
translation: 잠깐 시간 좀 내줄 수 있어요, [player name]님?

english: Maybe later.
Okay, I'll help with your graves.
Sorry, I'm busy.
I think I've finished!
Remind me what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 제가 뭘 해야 하는지 다시 알려 주세요.

english: I want to leave now.
What are you doing here?
I'm blending in. Scopin' out the place.
translation: 사람들 틈에 섞여 있는 중이야. 여기 좀 살펴보고 있지.

english: Are you preparing for a heist? You're only a kid.
translation: 한탕 준비하는 거야? 넌 아직 꼬마잖아.

english: Let's just say there are some wealthy people about, with full pockets.
translation: 그냥 이 근처에 주머니 두둑한 부자들이 좀 있다고만 해 두지.

english: Any tips? I'm not having much luck myself.
translation: 뭐 요령 같은 거 있어? 난 별로 재미를 못 보고 있거든.

english: I'm quite sneaky. Every now and then I'll get their attention so their pockets aren't being so carefully watched.
translation: 난 꽤 교묘하거든. 가끔씩 사람들 시선을 끌어서, 주머니를 덜 신경 쓰게 만들지.

english: That is sneaky. I'll keep an eye out for your... distractions.
Now leave me be. I'm already distracting!
translation: 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬. 나 지금도 충분히 시선 끌고 있거든!

english: You notice an urchin distract a wealthy citizen nearby.
translation: 근처에서 부랑아가 wealthy citizen(부유한 시민)의 시선을 끄는 것이 보인다.

english: I've been robbed!
*Sobbing*
My parents are gonna be so mad!
Oh gosh!
What can I do?
translation: 내가 뭘 해 줄 수 있을까?

english: That's awful!
I'll keep you company for a moment.
Silly me! I had it in my pocket all along!
translation: 아이고, 내 정신 좀 봐! 계속 주머니에 있었네요!

english: I can't stop crying!
Wahhhh!
I've lost my parents!
I hope you're okay.
Oh you really brightened my day!
I'm so lost! Someone help!
I can't find my friends
I'm all alone!
I think I see my friends!!
No one can dance like me!
I could do this all day!
Any tips?
Who taught you to move like that?
I wish I had moves like that!
translation: 나도 저렇게 춤출 수 있으면 좋겠다!

english: I'm all danced out!
My leg! Someone please!
Gah! It hurts!
It burns like an inferno!
I think I've broken something!
Woah! My leg has healed!
That was strange.
Dialoge 1
Dialoge 2
Dialoge 3
Dialoge 4
What is this place?
This is Aleck's Hunter Emporium. Basically, it's just a shop with a fancy name; you can buy various weapons and traps here.
translation: 여긴 Aleck's Hunter Emporium(알렉의 사냥 백화점)이에요. 그냥 이름만 거창한 가게죠. 여러 가지 무기랑 덫을 살 수 있어요.

english: Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: 그럼 이 가게에서 장비를 살 수 있나요?

english: Oh, this isn't my shop; the owner is Aleck over there behind the counter.
translation: 아, 여긴 제 가게가 아니에요. 주인은 저기 계산대 뒤에 있는 Aleck(알렉)이에요.

english: I experiment with weapon designs. I'm here because I've been trying to convince people to back my research and maybe sell some of my products - like this one I'm holding - in their shops.
translation: 저는 무기 설계를 실험하고 있어요. 제 연구를 후원해 주고, 어쩌면 지금 들고 있는 이런 제품을 가게에 들여놔 줄 사람을 설득하려고 여기 와 있죠.

english: Aleck doesn't seem to be interested, though.
translation: 그런데 Aleck(알렉)은 별로 관심이 없는 것 같아요.

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: 그 crossbow(석궁)에 대해 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: It's good, isn't it? I designed it to incorporate the bones of various animals in its construction.
translation: 괜찮죠? 여러 동물의 뼈를 넣어서 만들도록 설계했어요.

english: It's a fair bit faster than an ordinary crossbow too; it'll take you far less time to reload between shots.
translation: 보통 석궁보다 꽤 빠르기도 해요. 쏠 때마다 재장전하는 시간이 훨씬 줄어들 거예요.

english: That's crazy, it'll never work!
translation: 말도 안 돼요, 그게 될 리가 없어요!

english: That's what they said about my wind-powered mouse traps, too.
translation: 제 풍력 쥐덫 때도 다들 그렇게 말했죠.

english: And did they work?
Well, they only ran into problems because people kept insisting on trying to use them indoors.
translation: 글쎄요, 사람들이 자꾸 실내에서 쓰겠다고 고집하는 바람에 문제가 생겼을 뿐이에요.

english: Anyway, I think my crossbow invention is showing a lot more promise.
translation: 어쨌든 이 석궁 발명품은 훨씬 더 가능성이 있어 보여요.

english: That sounds good. Let's trade.
Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
translation: 그 석궁에 쓰는 탄약에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Ah, I admit as a result of its... er... unique construction, it won't take just any old bolts.
translation: 아, 인정할게요. 이게... 어... 구조가 독특하다 보니 아무 볼트나 쓸 수는 없어요.

english: If you can supply the materials and a token fee, I'd be happy to make some for you.
translation: 재료랑 약간의 수수료를 주시면 기꺼이 만들어 드릴게요.

english: I need kebbit spikes, lots of 'em. Not all kebbits have spikes, mind you. You'll be wanting prickly kebbits or, even better, razor-backed kebbits to get material hard enough.
translation: kebbit(케빗) 가시가 필요해요, 아주 많이요. 참고로 모든 케빗한테 가시가 있는 건 아니에요. 충분히 단단한 재료를 얻으려면 prickly kebbit(가시 케빗)이나, 더 좋게는 razor-backed kebbit(면도날등 케빗)을 잡아야 할 거예요.

english: Can't I just make my own?
translation: 그냥 제가 직접 만들면 안 돼요?

english: Yes, I suppose you could, although you'll need a steady hand with a knife and a chisel.
translation: 네, 그럴 수도 있겠죠. 다만 칼과 끌을 다루는 손놀림이 꽤 안정적이어야 해요.

english: The bolts have an unusual diameter, but basically you'll just need to be able to carve kebbit spikes into straight shafts.
translation: 볼트 지름이 특이하긴 한데, 기본적으로 케빗 가시를 곧은 살대로 깎을 수만 있으면 돼요.

english: Meanwhile, since you're here, I can make some for you if you have the materials.
translation: 아무튼 여기 오신 김에, 재료가 있으면 제가 만들어 드릴 수도 있어요.

english: Okay, can you make ammo for me?
I'll be off now, excuse me.
Well, if you ever find yourself in need of that innovative edge, you can always find me here.
translation: 뭐, 혁신적인 한 수가 필요해지면 언제든 여기서 저를 찾으세요.

english: ... thanks.
Oh, hey, you have one of my crossbows! How's it working for you?
translation: 오, 어라, 제 석궁을 갖고 계시네요! 써 보니 어때요?

english: It's okay, thanks.
What is this place?
Can I buy some equipment from the shop then?
translation: 그럼 이 가게에서 장비를 살 수 있나요?

english: Can you tell me about your crossbow?
translation: 그 crossbow(석궁)에 대해 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: Tell me about the ammo for your crossbow.
translation: 그 석궁에 쓰는 탄약에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: I'll be off now, excuse me.
That's crazy, it'll never work!
translation: 말도 안 돼요, 그게 될 리가 없어요!

english: That sounds good. Let's trade.
Can't I just make my own?
translation: 그냥 제가 직접 만들면 안 돼요?

english: Okay, can you make ammo for me?
(1) 6 kebbit bolts
(2) 6 long kebbit bolts
It's okay, thanks.
You have done well brave adventurer, but I would test your mettle now. You may arrange the fight with Larxus at your leisure.
translation: 용감한 모험가여, 훌륭히 해냈소. 허나 이제 그대의 기개를 시험해 보고 싶소. 준비가 되면 Larxus(락서스)를 통해 대결을 잡으시오.

english: Adventurer, you have defeated me in battle! For this, I congratulate you. Please accept my cape as a sign of your accomplishment.
translation: 모험가여, 그대가 전투에서 나를 꺾었구려! 이를 축하하오. 그대의 업적을 기리는 증표로 내 망토를 받아 주시오.

english: Hello!
Can I have another sword?
translation: 검 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Jeffery gives you another sword.
Who are you?
I'm Jeffery, the taskmaster for the Wilderness Achievement Diary.
translation: 저는 Jeffery(제프리), Wilderness Achievement Diary(황야 업적 일지)의 과제 감독관이에요.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Wilderness it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 특정 업적을 기록해 두는 데 도움이 되는 일지예요. Wilderness(황야)에서는 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 발견하는 데 도움이 될 거예요. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이 보상을 줄 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: 제 업적 일지에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Wilderness, you can speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
translation: Wilderness(황야)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료하면, 매일 Mage Arena(마법사 경기장)의 Lundail(룬다일)에게 말을 걸어 무료 룬 40개를 받을 수 있고, 황야 lever(레버)로 Edgeville(에지빌)이나 Ardougne(아르둔)으로 순간이동할 수 있어요.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 중급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

translation: 초급 보상에 더해, Mandrith(맨드리스)가 Resource Area(자원 구역) 입장료를 20% 할인해 주고, Ents(엔트)를 더 빨리 베고, 깊은 Wilderness(황야) 던전의 지름길을 이용할 수 있어요. 또한 ecumenical key(범교파 열쇠)를

english: keys at once and receive 80 runes a day from Lundail. Finally, you can now access the lairs of Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion, three fearsome Wilderness bosses.
translation: 한 번에 4개까지 가질 수 있고 Lundail(룬다일)에게서 하루에 룬 80개를 받아요. 마지막으로, 무시무시한 황야 보스 셋인 Artio(아르티오), Spindel(스핀델), Calvar'ion(칼바리온)의 소굴에 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the sword can teleport you to the Fountain of Rune once per day, you'll get 50% more lava shards when grinding scales and even cheaper access to the Resource Area.
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, 검으로 하루에 한 번 Fountain of Rune(룬의 분수)로 순간이동할 수 있고, 비늘을 갈 때 lava shards(용암 파편)을 50% 더 얻고, Resource Area(자원 구역) 입장료도 더 싸져요.

translation: ecumenical key(범교파 열쇠)를 5개까지 가질 수 있고, Lava Dragon Isle(용암 드래곤 섬)으로 가는 지름길을 쓸 수 있으며, Lundail(룬다일)이 매일 무료 룬 120개를 줘요. 또한 Wilderness(황야)에 생기는 Wine of Zamorak(자모락의 포도주)를 텔레키네틱 그랩으로 집으면

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Wilderness so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Wilderness(황야)의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면, 저한테 와서 말을 걸어 보상을 받으세요.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!
translation: Wilderness Achievement Diary(황야 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
Yes please!
You need at least two inventory spaces, make some space and come back.
translation: 소지품 칸이 적어도 두 칸은 필요해요. 공간을 비우고 다시 오세요.

english: This sword is a symbol of your exploration of the Wilderness. Speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 40 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
translation: 이 검은 당신이 Wilderness(황야)를 탐험했다는 상징이에요. 매일 Mage Arena(마법사 경기장)의 Lundail(룬다일)에게 말을 걸어 무료 룬 40개를 받을 수 있고, 황야 lever(레버)로 Edgeville(에지빌)이나 Ardougne(아르둔)으로 순간이동할 수 있어요.

english: Wow, thanks!
I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!
translation: Wilderness Achievement Diary(황야 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

translation: ecumenical key(범교파 열쇠)를 4개까지 가질 수 있고 Lundail(룬다일)에게서 하루에 룬 80개를 받아요.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Wilderness Achievement Diary!
translation: Wilderness Achievement Diary(황야 업적 일지)의 상급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. It can now teleport you to the Fountain of Rune once per day, you'll get 50% more lava shards when grinding scales and even cheaper access to the Resource Area.
translation: Wilderness Sword(황야 검)을 업그레이드해 드렸어요. 이제 하루에 한 번 Fountain of Rune(룬의 분수)로 순간이동할 수 있고, 비늘을 갈 때 lava shards(용암 파편)을 50% 더 얻고, Resource Area(자원 구역) 입장료도 더 싸져요.

translation: 이제 ecumenical key(범교파 열쇠)를 5개까지 가질 수 있고, Lundail(룬다일)이 매일 무료 룬 120개를 줘요. 또한 Wilderness(황야)에 생기는 Wine of Zamorak(자모락의 포도주)를 텔레키네틱 그랩으로 집으면 은행 쪽지 형태로 얻고, 이동할 Obelisk(오벨리스크)를

translation: Wilderness Achievement Diary(황야 업적 일지)의 엘리트 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Wilderness! Here's your reward!
translation: 그렇네요, 잘했어요! Wilderness(황야)의 과제를 전부 완료하셨군요! 여기 보상이에요!

english: I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. Access to the Resource Area is now free and the sword will now give you unlimited teleports to the Fountain of Rune. All dragon bone drops in the Wilderness are now
translation: Wilderness Sword(황야 검)을 업그레이드해 드렸어요. 이제 Resource Area(자원 구역) 입장이 무료이고 검으로 Fountain of Rune(룬의 분수)에 무제한 순간이동할 수 있어요. 황야에서 떨어지는 모든 dragon bones(용 뼈)가 이제

english: noted and Lundail will give you 200 free runes per day and the rate at which you catch Dark Crabs has been increased.
translation: 은행 쪽지로 나오고, Lundail(룬다일)이 하루에 무료 룬 200개를 주며, Dark Crabs(다크 크랩)을 잡는 확률도 올라갔어요.

english: Can I have another sword?
translation: 검 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 제 업적 일지에 대해 질문이 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀었을 거다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 날 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너같이 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞을 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 넌 분명 멋진 발을 가졌을 거야.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 참 음산한 날이군... 날이 이럴 때 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구라도 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 여기서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 무우우척 배고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석처럼 보이는데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 뱀파이어가 되지 않게 구해 주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 certificate(증명서)를 받으세요. 죄송하지만 보상으로 드릴 수 있는 건 이것뿐이에요.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 저를 원래대로 돌려 주셔서 고마워요. 힘드셨을 거예요. 전 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Welcome to the Keldagrim library, human traveller!
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 도서관에 오신 걸 환영해요, 인간 여행자님!

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: 도서관에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Why, certainly, it is one of my favourite subjects!
translation: 그럼요, 제가 제일 좋아하는 주제 중 하나인걸요!

english: I am Hugi, you see, I am the chief librarian here. Hugi, my parents named me that, it means 'personification of thought' in the ancient dwarvish tongue.
translation: 저는 Hugi(후기)예요, 여기 수석 사서죠. 후기, 부모님이 지어 주신 이름인데 고대 드워프어로 '생각의 의인화'라는 뜻이에요.

english: Quite like the name myself.
translation: 저도 이 이름이 꽤 마음에 들어요.

english: The books in this library have been collected for many centuries now, through various generous donations.
translation: 이 도서관의 책들은 여러 너그러운 기부를 통해 수 세기에 걸쳐 모은 거예요.

english: You'll find books dating from many different eras as well, such as the Era of Kings, the Rise of the Consortium and the Era of Prosperity, our current era.
translation: Era of Kings(왕의 시대), Rise of the Consortium(컨소시엄의 부흥), 그리고 지금 시대인 Era of Prosperity(번영의 시대)처럼 여러 시대에 걸친 책들도 찾을 수 있을 거예요.

english: How do these eras correspond with the Ages of the world?
translation: 이 시대들은 세계의 Ages(시대) 구분과 어떻게 맞물리나요?

english: Oh, they are quite different, and most of them take place in the Fourth Age.
translation: 아, 꽤 달라요. 그리고 대부분은 Fourth Age(제4시대)에 해당하죠.

english: Since we dwarves hid underground for a long time to sit out the wars that raged above the ground our history books differ slightly from those written by humans.
translation: 우리 드워프는 지상에서 벌어진 전쟁을 피해 오랫동안 땅속에 숨어 지냈기 때문에, 우리 역사책은 인간이 쓴 것과 조금 달라요.

english: Thanks for the information!
What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 뚫을 수 없는 바위에 대해 뭘 알고 계세요?

english: You're confusing me, what rock exactly are you talking about?
translation: 헷갈리네요, 정확히 어떤 바위 얘기를 하는 거예요?

english: The big one in the mines south of the city. Dondakan's big rock.
translation: 도시 남쪽 광산에 있는 큰 바위요. Dondakan(돈다칸)의 큰 바위요.

english: I see, I see.
I heard there was a demon inside there that you banished.
translation: 그 안에 있던 악마를 당신이 추방했다고 들었어요.

english: Yes, what exactly does that mean anyway?
translation: 네, 그런데 그게 정확히 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: There are some demons that we cannot see properly as mortals. They also cannot be fought with normal weapons.
translation: 어떤 악마들은 필멸자인 우리 눈에 제대로 보이지 않아요. 평범한 무기로는 싸울 수도 없고요.

english: But sometimes these creatures manifest themselves in a solid form in our world. Their avatar.
translation: 하지만 가끔 이런 존재들이 우리 세계에 단단한 형체로 모습을 드러내요. 그게 바로 그들의 화신이죠.

english: When you defeat an avatar, you defeat the actual demon behind it. But they don't die, they are banished to where they came from originally.
translation: 화신을 물리치면 그 뒤에 있는 진짜 악마를 물리치는 거예요. 하지만 죽지는 않고, 원래 왔던 곳으로 추방되죠.

english: Does that mean I will have to deal with this demon again some time?
translation: 그럼 언젠가 이 악마를 또 상대해야 한다는 뜻인가요?

english: Doubtful. He will grow stronger and stronger over time, but that's a process that will take a thousand years at least.
translation: 그럴 것 같진 않아요. 시간이 지나면서 점점 더 강해지겠지만, 그러려면 적어도 천 년은 걸리거든요.

english: Even dwarves don't live so long.
No, we won't see him again and the mines are safe to dig for gold now. Of course, that might lead to other problems eventually...
translation: 아뇨, 우리가 그를 다시 볼 일은 없을 거고, 이제 광산에서 마음 놓고 금을 캘 수 있어요. 물론 그게 결국 다른 문제로 이어질 수도 있겠지만요...

english: Can you tell me more about the library?
translation: 도서관에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: What do you know about impenetrable rocks?
translation: 뚫을 수 없는 바위에 대해 뭘 알고 계세요?

english: Greetings warrior, how can I fill your stomach today?
translation: 어서 오세요, 전사님. 오늘은 무엇으로 배를 채워 드릴까요?

english: With food preferably.
Come try my lovely pizza or maybe some fish!
translation: 맛있는 피자나 생선 한번 드셔 보세요!

english: Stew to fill the belly, on sale here!
translation: 배를 든든히 채워 줄 Stew(스튜), 여기서 팔아요!

english: Potatoes are filling and healthy too!
Move into position lads! eh? Who are you and what do you want?
translation: 제군들, 위치로! 응? 넌 누구고 원하는 게 뭐지?

english: Who are you then?
Lieutenant Shepbur, commanding officer of the new Armoured Tortoise Regiment.
translation: Lieutenant Shepbur(셉버 중위), 신설 기갑 거북 연대의 지휘관이다.

english: There's only two tortoises here, that's hardly a regiment.
translation: 여기 거북은 두 마리밖에 없는데, 연대라고 하기엔 좀 그렇네요.

english: This is just the beginning! Gnome breeders and trainers are already working to expand the number of units. Soon we'll have hundreds of these beauties, nay thousands! And they will not only carry mages and
translation: 이건 시작일 뿐이다! 노움 사육사와 조련사들이 벌써 부대 수를 늘리려고 애쓰고 있지. 곧 이런 멋진 녀석들이 수백, 아니 수천 마리가 될 거다! 그리고 이 녀석들은 마법사와

english: archers but other fiendish weapons of destruction of gnome devising. An army of giant tortoises will march upon this battlefield and rain the fire of our wrath upon all our enemies! Nothing will be able to stop us!
translation: 궁수뿐 아니라 노움이 고안한 다른 극악한 파괴 병기까지 실어 나를 거다. 거대 거북 군대가 이 전장으로 진군해 모든 적 위에 분노의 불을 비처럼 쏟아부을 것이다! 그 무엇도 우릴 막지 못한다!

english: Oooookayy...... I'll leave you to it then....
translation: 아아...... 네에...... 그럼 하던 일 계속하세요....

english: *hic* G'day! Do ya... ... well, do ya need any help with yer trident? *buuurrrp*
translation: *딸꾹* 안녕! 너... ... 그러니까, trident(삼지창) 손봐 줄까? *꺼어억*

english: Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
Why?! What time *hic* is it?
Hmm, I've no idea.
I can drink to that!
Who are you?
What!? Why I'm the infamous pirate Lieve McCracken! You've not heard of me?
translation: 뭐!? 내가 바로 그 악명 높은 해적 Lieve McCracken(리브 맥크래컨)이다! 나 몰라?

english: Hmm, can't say I have.
I'm wanted in several *hic* kingdoms - murder, armed robbery and even *hic* flag desecration!
translation: 난 여러 *딸꾹* 왕국에서 수배 중이라고. 살인, 무장 강도, 심지어 *딸꾹* 깃발 모독까지!

english: Shouldn't you be in hiding?
I'm sorry, but *hic* do ya see anyone here?
I guess you could call this hiding. If you're some famous pirate, where's you ship?
translation: 뭐, 이것도 숨어 있는 거라고 할 수는 있겠네요. 그렇게 유명한 해적이면 배는 어디 있어요?

english: *hic* My last expedition didn't end too well for my boat... or crew *hic*.
translation: *딸꾹* 지난 항해가 내 배한테는... 선원들한테도 별로 좋게 안 끝났거든 *딸꾹*.

english: So, what's in the cave?
The fruits o' my labour... and some waterfiends, those were a surprise *hic* to be sure, but a welcome one.
translation: 내 노력의 열매... 그리고 waterfiend(워터핀드) 몇 마리. 그건 확실히 *딸꾹* 뜻밖이었지만, 반가운 뜻밖이었지.

english: Umm, fruits?
Oh, not *hic* actual fruits, silly! A relative o' mine wanted a cave full o' Krakens, so here *hic* I am.
translation: 아, 진짜 *딸꾹* 열매 말고, 바보야! 친척 하나가 Kraken(크라켄)으로 가득한 동굴을 원해서, 이렇게 *딸꾹* 여기 있는 거지.

english: And why are you so drunk?
Well, the Krakens destroyed m' ship, killed m' crew, the rum it's... all I 'ave left.
translation: 그게, Kraken(크라켄)들이 내 배를 부수고 선원들을 죽였어. 럼주... 그게 나한테 남은 전부야.

english: Sorry about that, so... Can I kill some Krakens?
translation: 안됐네요, 그럼... Kraken(크라켄)을 좀 잡아도 돼요?

english: If you've been assigned some by a slayer master, I don't see *hic* why not.
translation: slayer master(슬레이어 마스터)한테 배정받았으면, *딸꾹* 안 될 거 없지.

english: And if I havn't been?
Then ya can leave m' Krakens *hic* alone.
Umm... ok then.
Let's talk about tridents.
If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. But I wants payin' fer the job.
translation: trident(삼지창)을 가져오면 강화해 주지. 2,500회가 아니라 20,000회나 충전해 둘 수 있게 될 거야. 근데 수고비는 받아야겠어.

english: Give me 10 kraken tentacles first. I'll hold onto 'em for ya. Then ya can bring me a trident to enhance, an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: 먼저 kraken tentacles(크라켄 촉수) 10개를 줘. 내가 맡아 둘게. 그다음 강화할 trident(삼지창)을 가져오면, 작업해 주지.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me one tentacle so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: trident(삼지창)을 가져오면 강화해 주지. 2,500회가 아니라 20,000회나 충전해 둘 수 있게 될 거야. 지금까지 tentacle(촉수)는 하나 가져왔는데, 작업하려면 10개는 있어야 해.

english: Just pass me 9 more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: tentacles(촉수) 9개만 더 주고, 네 trident(삼지창)을 주면 작업해 주지.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: trident(삼지창)을 가져오면 강화해 주지. 2,500회가 아니라 20,000회나 충전해 둘 수 있게 될 거야. 지금까지 tentacles(촉수)를 [number]개 가져왔는데, 작업하려면 10개는 있어야 해.

english: Just pass me [number] more tentacles, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: tentacles(촉수) [number]개만 더 주고, 네 trident(삼지창)을 주면 작업해 주지.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me 9 tentacles so far, but I'll want 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: trident(삼지창)을 가져오면 강화해 주지. 2,500회가 아니라 20,000회나 충전해 둘 수 있게 될 거야. 지금까지 tentacles(촉수)를 9개 가져왔는데, 작업하려면 10개는 있어야 해.

english: Just pass me one more tentacle, then give me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
translation: tentacle(촉수) 하나만 더 주고, 네 trident(삼지창)을 주면 작업해 주지.

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me [number] tentacles; I'll use up 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: trident(삼지창)을 가져오면 강화해 주지. 2,500회가 아니라 20,000회나 충전해 둘 수 있게 될 거야. 지금까지 tentacles(촉수)를 [number]개 가져왔으니, 그중 10개를 써서 작업할게.

english: Just pass me yer trident an' I'll get to work for ya.
I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
Wow, so original.
Oi, I'm Lieve McCracken and I say leave m' Kraken alone!
translation: 어이, 난 Lieve McCracken(리브 맥크래컨)이다. 내 Kraken(크라켄)은 내버려 두라고, 리브 마이 크라켄!

english: Lieve McCracken wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.
translation: Lieve McCracken(리브 맥크래컨)은 네가 Slayer(슬레이어) 과제만 하길 바란다.

english: Oi, I'm Lieve, and I say leave it!
translation: 어이, 난 리브다. 리브 잇, 그건 내버려 두라고!

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. Just hand 'em to me when ye've got 'em.
translation: tridents(삼지창)을 강화해 주기 전에 tentacles(촉수) 10개를 가져와야 해. 생기면 그냥 나한테 건네.

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me one.
translation: tridents(삼지창)을 강화해 주기 전에 tentacles(촉수) 10개를 가져와야 해. 지금까지 하나 가져왔어.

english: Ya gotta bring me 10 tentacles before I'll enhance yer tridents for ya. So far ya brought me [number].
translation: tridents(삼지창)을 강화해 주기 전에 tentacles(촉수) 10개를 가져와야 해. 지금까지 [number]개 가져왔어.

english: That trident's already been enhanced, ya ninny!
translation: 그 trident(삼지창)은 이미 강화됐잖아, 이 멍청아!

english: I see ya got a tentacle there. Do ya want me to hold onto it for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
translation: tentacle(촉수)를 갖고 있네. 내가 맡아 줄까? 10개 줄 때마다 trident(삼지창) 하나를 강화해 주지.

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it.
translation: 기억해, 돌려주진 않아. 일단 tentacle(촉수)를 주면 내가 갖는 거야.

english: Remember, I won't give 'em back. Once ya gives me a tentacle, I keep it. Ya already gave me [number].
translation: 기억해, 돌려주진 않아. 일단 tentacle(촉수)를 주면 내가 갖는 거야. 넌 이미 [number]개 줬어.

english: Thanks. I've got one tentacle stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 고마워. 이제 tentacle(촉수) 하나를 맡아 두고 있어. 10개를 가져오면 trident(삼지창)을 건네줘, 강화해 줄게.

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 고마워. 이제 tentacles(촉수) [number]개를 맡아 두고 있어. 10개를 가져오면 trident(삼지창)을 건네줘, 강화해 줄게.

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. For every 10, ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 고마워. 이제 tentacles(촉수) [number]개를 맡아 두고 있어. 10개마다 trident(삼지창)을 하나씩 건네주면 강화해 줄게.

english: No, I think I'll hold onto it myself.
I see ya got [number] tentacles there. Do ya want me to hold onto 'em for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
translation: tentacles(촉수)를 [number]개 갖고 있네. 내가 맡아 줄까? 10개 줄 때마다 trident(삼지창) 하나를 강화해 주지.

english: No, I think I'll hold onto them myself.
translation: 아뇨, 그것들은 그냥 제가 갖고 있을게요.

english: Ugh - what's that? It's got a whip stuck in it! I don't want that! Take it away!
translation: 윽, 그게 뭐야? 채찍이 박혀 있잖아! 그딴 거 필요 없어! 치워!

english: No thanks.
Bit early to be drinking, isn't it?
Who are you?
So, what's in the cave?
Let's talk about tridents.
I'll be, heh, leaving you now...
Give it to her.
Do not give it to her.
Give them to her.
Do not give them to her.
So why are you fighting over that obelisk anyway? Just looks like a bit of old rock to me.
translation: 그래서 너희는 왜 그 obelisk(오벨리스크)를 두고 싸우는 거야? 내가 보기엔 그냥 낡은 돌덩이인데.

english: Puny human! You wouldn't understand.
translation: 하찮은 인간! 넌 이해 못 한다.

english: Yeah, I'm the puny one.
Feel the power of creation!
I will crush you into the dirt!
You will be created anew!
Don't you get hot standing around pools of lava all day?
translation: 하루 종일 용암 웅덩이 옆에 서 있으면 덥지 않아?

english: I care not for equable temperature... only destruction!
translation: 적당한 온도 따윈 관심 없다... 오직 파괴뿐!

english: Each to their own, I suppose...
Face destruction!
I will destroy you!
Meet your destruction!
Hey Lil' Zik.
Stop.
Calling.
Me.
Little!
Never!
You know... you're not like other spiders.
You know I hate it when you say that... please leave me alone.
translation: 내가 그 말 싫어하는 거 알잖아... 제발 날 내버려 둬.

english: But I earned you fair and square at the Theatre of Blood! You're mine to keep.
translation: 하지만 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)에서 정정당당하게 얻었잖아! 넌 내 거야.

english: Incy wincy Verzik climbed up the water spout...
Down came the rain and washed poor Verzik out...
Out came the Vampyre to put an end to this at once. Humans deserve only one fate!
translation: 해님 대신 Vampyre(뱀파이어)가 나와 당장 끝장을 내 주마. 인간에게 걸맞은 운명은 단 하나뿐!

english: Wow, calm down. It's just a nursery rhyme.
I'm not in the mood.
Hi, I'm here for my reward!
Not again...
I'll get you!
This is the end of you!
Today, you die in THIS Theatre.
translation: 오늘, 넌 바로 이 극장에서 죽는다.

english: Have you seen my brother?
I'm not sure, what did he look like?
He was a kind boy, with a bright smile...
Hmm... Can't say I have I'm afraid.
translation: 흠... 미안하지만 본 적 없는 것 같아.

english: Oh... I'd very much like to see him again.
translation: 아... 오빠를 정말 다시 보고 싶어요.

english: Thank you for freeing me...
Freeing you? I didn't know you were trapped.
translation: 풀어 줬다고? 갇혀 있는 줄은 몰랐는데.

english: The vampyres... they tricked me...
Oh, you're welcome then!
You'll suffer a terrible fate!
You will never leave THIS Theatre again.
translation: 다시는 이 극장을 떠나지 못할 거예요.

english: Maaasteeer?
I suppose I am your master now, I hadn't thought about it.
translation: 이제 내가 네 주인인가 보네. 그건 생각 못 해 봤는데.

english: Kill maasteer...
No don't do that!
Do you smell that?
Hnrgh?
*Sniffs* What are you made of Lil'Bloat?
translation: *킁킁* Lil'Bloat(꼬마 블로트), 너 뭘로 만들어진 거야?

english: Cccorpsssee...
That would explain the smell...
Hello Lil' Bloat.
...Hhhh-.
Are you trying to talk?
...Hhhhuu-
Are you trying to say Hello? Come on you can do it!
translation: '반가워'라고 하려는 거야? 힘내, 할 수 있어!

english: ...Hhhuun-
...Hhuunnggrryy.
Oh, of course...
Brrrrr!
Hrrrrrnnngh!
Hungry....
How are you doing little guy?
Chitter-chitter?
You seem happy to be free of the Theatre.
Chitter-chitter!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello my angry little monster.
Grrrrruff!
You don't mean that, you're just grumpy.
translation: 진심 아니잖아, 그냥 심술 난 거지.

english: Grrrr...
That's a good girl.
Would you like a treat?
Grruff?
Oh, you don't eat normal food, I'm afraid I don't have any adventurers to feed you.
