translation: 아, 넌 보통 음식은 안 먹지. 미안하지만 너한테 줄 모험가가 없네.

english: Grrrrrr...
I'm sorry! Please don't send me to the shadow realm!
translation: 미안해! 제발 shadow realm(그림자 영역)으로 보내지 마!

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
We're not in the Theatre anymore, so no poisoning anyone, got that?
translation: 이제 극장 밖이니까 아무한테도 독 쓰면 안 돼, 알았지?

english: Scraaa?
I mean it, no spitting poison at people or on the floor.
translation: 진짜야, 사람한테든 바닥에든 독 뱉지 마.

english: Scraaa....
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You okay there, Lil'viathan? You look at little worse for wear.
translation: 괜찮아, Lil'viathan(릴바이어선)? 좀 상태가 안 좋아 보이는데.

english: **wheeez**
I think you have a smoking problem.
Hello, Lil'viathan.
ROAAAAARRR!
SCREEEEEEE!
HSSSSSSSSS!
Good talk.
Hello there. Welcome to the Grand Library.
translation: 안녕하세요. Grand Library(대도서관)에 오신 걸 환영해요.

english: Hmm. I thought it was bigger.
Oh it is. While we've opened up the city to other races, we've decided that most of the library will remain a place for elves only.
translation: 아, 실제로 더 커요. 도시를 다른 종족에게도 개방하긴 했지만, 도서관 대부분은 엘프만 들어갈 수 있는 곳으로 남겨 두기로 했거든요.

english: That said, we still want visitors to get a taste of what the library has to offer. For that reason, we've opened up this small section of it.
translation: 그래도 방문객들이 도서관의 매력을 조금이나마 맛볼 수 있도록 이 작은 구역을 개방했어요.

english: Feel free to have a read through the books here. Now that the city is open to visitors, we've had lots of new additions from far and wide.
translation: 여기 있는 책은 마음껏 읽어 보세요. 도시가 방문객에게 열린 뒤로 멀리서도 가까이서도 새 책이 많이 들어왔답니다.

english: Sounds great, I'll take a look.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀었을 거다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 날 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너같이 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞을 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 넌 분명 멋진 발을 가졌을 거야.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 참 음산한 날이군... 날이 이럴 때 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구라도 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 여기서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 무우우척 배고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석처럼 보이는데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
Hello.
Greetings. No I'm not.
Are you lost?
Possibly.
Hang on, did you just answer my question before I asked it?
translation: 잠깐, 방금 제가 묻기도 전에 대답하신 거예요?

english: Absolutely not!
Are you a little... mad?
Uh..... hi... didn't see you there. Can.... I help?
translation: 어..... 안녕... 하세요... 못 봤어요. 뭘.... 도와드릴까요?

english: Umm... do you sell potions?
Erm... yes. When I'm not drinking them.
translation: 어... 네. 제가 마시고 있지 않을 때는요.

english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
Of course...
That's a pretty wall hanging.
Do you think so? I made it myself.
Really? Is that why there's all this cloth and dye around?
translation: 정말요? 그래서 여기 천이랑 염료가 잔뜩 있는 거예요?

english: Yes, it's a hobby of mine when I'm.... relaxing.
translation: 네, 제가.... 쉴 때 하는 취미예요.

english: Bye!
Have fun and come back soon!
Pink bananas... mmmmmm.
Demons are a Ghoul's best Friend.
It's not an optical illusion, it just looks like one.
translation: 착시가 아니에요, 그냥 착시처럼 보일 뿐이에요.

english: Don't look back, they might be gaining on you.
translation: 뒤돌아보지 마세요, 그들이 따라잡고 있을지도 몰라요.

english: If you don't care where you are, then you ain't lost.
translation: 어디 있든 상관없다면, 길을 잃은 게 아니죠.

english: Madness takes its toll. Please have exact change.
translation: 광기에는 통행료가 붙어요. 잔돈은 딱 맞춰 주세요.

english: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
That's a pretty wall hanging.
Bye!
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람들한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시에 정말 멋진 날이죠, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Welcome, are you looking to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: 어서 오세요. Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩) 게임에 참가하시려고요?

english: Tell me more.
It's simple. Anyone looking to participate enters the relevant waiting area. Once the waiting area has enough people, they are taken to the arena.
translation: 간단해요. 참가하려는 사람은 해당 대기 구역에 들어가면 돼요. 대기 구역에 사람이 충분히 모이면 경기장으로 이동하게 되죠.

english: Arena?
Indeed. We have set up two arenas on another plane. When a game starts, we pick one at random. Once everyone arrives in the arena, the fight for survival begins.
translation: 맞아요. 다른 차원에 경기장 두 곳을 마련해 뒀어요. 게임이 시작되면 그중 한 곳을 무작위로 골라요. 모두가 경기장에 도착하면 생존을 건 싸움이 시작되죠.

english: Now, there's a few important things to be aware of. While in an arena, your physical and mental abilities will be boosted. Also, praying to the gods will not cost you any precious energies.
translation: 자, 알아 둬야 할 중요한 점이 몇 가지 있어요. 경기장 안에서는 신체 능력과 정신 능력이 강화돼요. 그리고 신들에게 기도를 올려도 소중한 기운이 전혀 소모되지 않아요.

english: After a game has started, lethal fog will soon start filling the arena. This forces contenders to a designated safe zone and ensures no one escapes the fighting.
translation: 게임이 시작되면 곧 치명적인 안개가 경기장을 채우기 시작해요. 그래서 참가자들은 지정된 안전 구역으로 몰리게 되고, 아무도 싸움에서 빠져나갈 수 없죠.

english: Be aware, you can't take any of your own belongings into the game. Instead, you can use only what you find in the arena, including anything we give you on arrival.
translation: 주의하세요, 자기 소지품은 하나도 게임에 가져갈 수 없어요. 대신 경기장에서 찾은 것과 도착할 때 저희가 드리는 것만 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Regarding what you are given on arrival, you have a few options to pick from. Use my supply chest to configure your load-outs for the different battle styles.
translation: 도착할 때 받는 물품은 몇 가지 중에서 고를 수 있어요. 제 supply chest(보급 상자)에서 전투 방식별 장비 구성을 설정하세요.

english: Remember, this is a solo competition! Anyone attempting to form teams for an unfair advantage will be banished from further participation.
translation: 명심하세요, 이건 개인전이에요! 부당한 이득을 노리고 팀을 짜려는 사람은 앞으로 참가가 금지돼요.

english: Now that you know more, would you like to take part in a game of Last Man Standing?
translation: 이제 더 잘 아시게 됐으니, Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩) 게임에 참가하시겠어요?

english: Not right now.
No problem, come back if you happen to change your mind.
translation: 괜찮아요, 혹시 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.

english: I'd like to play.
Which mode would you like to play?
You do not have enough money in your coffer.
I'm afraid you can't take part in Last Man Standing on this world.
translation: 죄송하지만 이 월드에서는 Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩)에 참가할 수 없어요.

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
A casual game is starting!
Come on, we need another competitive participant!
translation: 자, 경쟁 모드 참가자가 한 명 더 필요해요!

english: Come on, we need [2-24] more competitive participants!
translation: 자, 경쟁 모드 참가자가 [2-24]명 더 필요해요!

english: Come on, we need another High Stakes participant!
translation: 자, 고액 모드 참가자가 한 명 더 필요해요!

english: Come on, we need [2-24] more High Stakes participants!
translation: 자, 고액 모드 참가자가 [2-24]명 더 필요해요!

english: Tell me more.
I'd like to play.
Not right now.
High Stakes (500,000 coins)
Competitive (free entry)
Casual
Cancel
Hello, visitor!
Hello. What are you up to?
Ah, I was about to collect some yak's milk to make yak cheese.
translation: 아, yak(야크) 젖을 짜서 야크 치즈를 만들려던 참이에요.

english: Eughr! Though I am curious. Can I try some?
translation: 으웩! 그래도 궁금하긴 하네요. 좀 먹어 봐도 될까요?

english: Sorry, no. The last outlander who ate my cheese was ill for a month.
translation: 미안하지만 안 돼요. 지난번에 제 치즈를 먹은 외지인은 한 달 동안 앓아누웠거든요.

english: So why don't you get ill as well?
Well, we eat yak milk products every day, from when we're born. So I suppose we're used to it. Anyway I should stop yakking - haha - and get on with my work.
translation: 음, 우린 태어날 때부터 매일 야크 젖으로 만든 걸 먹으니까요. 그래서 익숙해진 것 같아요. 아무튼 이제 그만 야크 떨고 - 하하 - 일하러 가야겠어요.

english: I'm glad to see that puns are common everywhere in Gielinor; even here.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)는 어디를 가나 말장난이 흔하다니 반갑네요. 여기서도요.

english: I need your help with this!
Thank you, well done!
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 보상을 받았어요: [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: Hello there. You look lost, are you okay?
translation: 안녕하세요. 길을 잃은 것 같은데, 괜찮아요?

english: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
Ahh... the Stronghold of Security. It's down there.
translation: 아... Stronghold of Security(보안의 요새) 말이군요. 저 아래에 있어요.

english: Litara point's on the hole in the ground that looks like you could squeeze through.
translation: Litara(리타라)가 몸을 비집고 들어갈 수 있을 것 같은 땅속 구멍을 가리킨다.

english: Looks kind of... deep and dark.
Yeah... tell that to my brother, he still hasn't come back.
translation: 그러게요... 우리 오빠한테 그렇게 말해 줘요, 아직도 안 돌아왔거든요.

english: Your brother?
He's an explorer too. When the miner fell down that hole he'd made and came back babbling about doors, questions and treasure, my brother went to explore. No-one has seen him since.
translation: 오빠도 당신처럼 탐험가예요. 광부가 자기가 판 저 구멍에 빠졌다가 돌아와서 문이며 질문이며 보물이며 횡설수설하자, 오빠가 탐험하러 내려갔어요. 그 뒤로 아무도 오빠를 못 봤어요.

english: Oh... that's not good.
Lots of people have been down there, but none of them have seen him, Let me know if you do, will you?
translation: 많은 사람들이 저 아래에 다녀왔지만, 오빠를 본 사람은 아무도 없어요. 혹시 보면 알려 줄래요?

english: I'll certainly keep my eyes open.
I'm fine, just passing through.
I travelled to the bottom of the stronghold, and I emerge victorious!
translation: 요새 맨 밑바닥까지 갔다가 승리를 거두고 돌아왔어요!

english: Well done! You didn't happen to find my brother?
translation: 잘했어요! 혹시 우리 오빠는 못 찾았어요?

english: About that...
I sense bad news. It's okay, he's been gone so long. I believe I've moved on.
translation: 나쁜 소식인 것 같네요. 괜찮아요, 오빠가 떠난 지 너무 오래됐으니까요. 이제 마음을 정리한 것 같아요.

english: Well, at least he died doing what he loved.
True, I will raise a drink for him tonight, he was a good man, even if he was a pacifist.
translation: 맞아요, 오늘 밤 오빠를 위해 한잔할게요. 좋은 사람이었어요, 평화주의자이긴 했지만요.

english: As will I. See you around, Litara.
Goodbye, [player name].
I am glad the challenges of the stronghold have been overcome; it feels like my brother has somehow been avenged.
translation: 요새의 시련들이 극복돼서 기뻐요. 어쩐지 오빠의 원수를 갚은 것 같은 기분이에요.

english: I'm looking for a stronghold or something...
I'm fine, just passing through.
Hello!
Greetings, human.
Who are you?
I'm Lithil. Haven't you heard of me?
translation: 난 Lithil(리실)이야. 내 얘기 못 들어 봤어?

english: Can't say I have...
...Oh, well that's no good.
Should I? Did I miss some glorious feat of yours?
translation: 들어 봤어야 하나요? 제가 당신의 무슨 영광스러운 업적이라도 놓쳤나요?

english: You must run in all the wrong circles. It's fine, I won't hold it against you.
translation: 넌 노는 물이 영 틀렸나 보네. 괜찮아, 그걸로 뭐라 하진 않을게.

english: You're a demon! Usually I'm kill-
Yes?
Nothing... You're right, wrong circles and all that.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요... 맞아요, 노는 물이 틀렸다느니 뭐 그런 거죠.

english: Why are you here?
Me? Can't a demon have a look around without all the questions?
translation: 나? 악마는 꼬치꼬치 캐묻는 사람 없이 구경도 못 해?

english: Alright! I heard there were other demons in Morytania, other than that oaf, Mazchna. I've come looking for them.
translation: 알았어! Morytania(모리타니아)에 그 멍청이 Mazchna(마즈크나) 말고도 다른 악마들이 있다고 들었거든. 그래서 찾으러 왔어.

english: Not a fan of the slayer master?
translation: 슬레이어 마스터를 별로 안 좋아하나 봐요?

english: If he truly is as great as he says, he'd fight me.
translation: 그 녀석이 정말 자기 말처럼 대단하다면 나랑 싸웠겠지.

english: He didn't want to prove himself?
Ugh, of course not. The fool says he won't fight a woman. That demon thinks he's a pillar of chivalry.
translation: 으, 당연히 아니지. 그 바보는 여자랑은 안 싸운대. 그 악마는 자기가 무슨 기사도의 귀감이라도 되는 줄 알아.

english: That is a little suspicious.
Yes. Anyway, to fully answer your initial question, I found demons here to the north and some lesser demons to the east.
translation: 그렇지. 아무튼 처음 질문에 제대로 답하자면, 여기 북쪽에서 악마들을 찾았고 동쪽에서는 lesser demon(하급 악마)들도 찾았어.

english: What are they doing here?

Demons tend to stay where they were summoned. You see, once they're done eating the stupid wizard that thought it could control a demon, they're pretty much stuck until someone else decides to summon them.
translation: 악마는 소환된 곳에 머무르는 경향이 있어. 그러니까, 악마를 부릴 수 있다고 착각한 멍청한 마법사를 다 먹어 치우고 나면, 누가 또 소환할 때까지 거기 꼼짝없이 갇히는 거지.

english: Summoning, aye? Sounds like a dangerous skill to practise.
translation: 소환이라, 그래요? 연마하기엔 위험한 스킬 같네요.

english: Be even warier of the imps. They'll steal the boots from your feet if you give 'em the chance.
translation: imp(임프)들은 더 조심해. 기회만 주면 네 발에서 장화까지 벗겨 갈 놈들이니까.

english: I don't see how that's worse than being eaten, but thanks, I'll keep an eye out.
translation: 그게 잡아먹히는 것보다 어떻게 더 나쁜지 모르겠지만, 고마워요. 조심할게요.

english: Bye!
See you 'round, human.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
You eat dreams right?
Well... not exact-
What do dreams taste like?
I don't eat dre-
I bet they taste like strawberries! I love strawberries!
translation: 분명 딸기 맛일 거야! 나 딸기 진짜 좋아해!

english: If you're a nightmare, would a male version of you be a nighthorse?
translation: 네가 나이트'메어'(밤의 암말)라면, 수컷 버전은 나이트'호스'(밤의 수말)야?

english: What's a horse?
I have no idea.
What's up b?
Bzz.
I see.
Face me!
Face your nightmare!
There are no sweet dreams here!
So what's got you then?
You inspect the body...
A few cuts and scrapes... No stab wound... Poison perhaps?
translation: 베이고 긁힌 상처 몇 군데... 찔린 상처는 없고... 혹시 독인가?

english: Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
Who are you?
I'm Lleidr, a simple forest dweller.
It's nice to meet you Lleidr, I'm [player name].
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Lleidr(레이드르) 씨. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: Great.
What do you do here?
Currently, I'm fishing.
Anything else?
Avoid idle chit-chat.
Alright, I get the hint.
That's nice to hear, see you around.
...Bye.
Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
You look like a [man/woman] that could use an overly expensive crown. Finest clothes around! Want to take a look?
translation: 터무니없이 비싼 왕관 하나쯤 필요해 보이는 [man/woman]분이시네요. 이 근방 최고의 옷이에요! 한번 보실래요?

english: Yes, please.
No thanks.
Your loss, I suppose.
Yes, please.
No thanks.
Can I interest you in any herbal equipment? Any supplies, perhaps?
translation: 약초 장비에 관심 있으세요? 보급품은 어떠세요?

english: Let's see what you've got.
No thanks.
Well whenever you're looking to mix a potion or two, I've got what you need!
translation: 물약 한두 개 섞고 싶을 때면 언제든 오세요, 필요한 건 다 있으니까요!

english: Let's see what you've got.
No thanks.
Hello.
Lardi dee, lardi da.
Are you alright?
Hee hee, lardi da, lardi dee.(The gnome appears to be singing.)
translation: 히히, 랄라 다, 랄라 디.(노움이 노래를 부르고 있는 것 같다.)

english: Hello little man.
Little man stronger than big man. Hee hee, lardi dee, lardi da.
translation: 꼬마 아저씨가 큰 아저씨보다 힘이 세. 히히, 랄라 디, 랄라 다.

english: Hi.
Must save the orbs and kill the Khazard warlord. That will be fun, hee hee.
translation: 오브들을 구하고 Khazard warlord(카자드 군벌)을 죽여야 해. 재밌겠다, 히히.

english: Hello gnome.
Soon we're gonna have the sacred ceremony and boy am I going to party. Lock up your daughters. Hee hee.
translation: 곧 신성한 의식이 열리면 나 완전 신나게 놀 거야. 딸 가진 집은 문단속 잘하라고. 히히.

english: You're the best!
Thanks.
Well I'm better. Hee hee.
Hello, can I help you?
Let's trade.
Where am I?
This is the marketplace of Hosidius. To the north west there's my sister's pub, and in the south is my grandfather's fruit farm. Do you need to buy anything while you're here?
translation: 여긴 Hosidius(호시디우스) 시장이에요. 북서쪽에는 제 여동생의 술집이 있고, 남쪽에는 할아버지의 과일 농장이 있어요. 여기 계시는 동안 살 거 있으세요?

english: No, I'm okay.
Hey! You're that thief! Get away from my stall.
translation: 야! 너 그 도둑이지! 내 노점에서 떨어져.

english: Let's trade.
Where am I?
No, I'm okay.
Hello. What are you doing here?
I'm studying the Invasion of the Wintertodt.
Tell me more about the Wintertodt.
The Wintertodt is a fiercely cold being, capable of freezing entire areas with its mere presence. We do not know what exactly the Wintertodt is, nor where it came from.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)는 존재만으로도 지역 전체를 얼려 버릴 수 있는 지독하게 차가운 존재예요. 윈터토트가 정확히 무엇인지, 어디서 왔는지는 아무도 몰라요.

english: When the Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all of Kourend would be lost. Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 처음 공격해 왔을 때, Kourend(쿠렌드) 전체를 잃을까 봐 다들 두려워했죠. 다행히 Order of the Sacred Flame(신성한 불꽃 교단)과 Dinh the Master Smith(명장 대장장이 딘)이 그것을 막아 냈어요.

english: How did they stop the Wintertodt?
Dinh was a great smith and engineer. He uncovered the power of the Bruma tree. Using bark from the tree and various metal compounds, Dinh forged the doors of the prison that hold the Wintertodt.
translation: Dinh(딘)은 위대한 대장장이이자 기술자였어요. 그는 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)의 힘을 밝혀냈죠. 그 나무의 껍질과 여러 금속 화합물을 이용해, 딘은 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 가두는 감옥의 문을 벼려 냈어요.

english: In addition, the Order of the Sacred Flame utilised the Bruma tree in firemaking. They heated the environment to subdue Wintertodt.
translation: 게다가 Order of the Sacred Flame(신성한 불꽃 교단)은 Bruma tree(브루마 나무)를 불 피우기에 활용했어요. 주변을 데워 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 진압했죠.

english: Tell me more about the invasion.
More than 137 decades ago, seemingly from nowhere, the Wintertodt began terrorising the lands north of Kourend, freezing everything within its path.
translation: 1,370년도 더 전에, 아무런 조짐도 없이 Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 Kourend(쿠렌드) 북쪽 땅을 공포에 빠뜨리기 시작했어요. 지나는 길의 모든 것을 얼려 버렸죠.

english: After five decades of this terror, the people of Kourend were able to quell the beast, containing it in an icy prison.
translation: 50년 동안 이어진 공포 끝에, Kourend(쿠렌드) 사람들은 그 괴물을 진압해 얼음 감옥에 가둘 수 있었어요.

english: The Wintertodt remained subdued until very recently, when it began to threaten Kourend once more.
translation: Wintertodt(윈터토트)는 아주 최근까지 잠잠했는데, 그러다 다시 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 위협하기 시작했어요.

english: Fortunately, the Order of the Sacred Flame is able to contain the Wintertodt and prevent another attack.
translation: 다행히 Order of the Sacred Flame(신성한 불꽃 교단)이 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 억누르고 또 다른 공격을 막을 수 있어요.

english: Goodbye.
Tell me more about the Wintertodt.
How did they stop the Wintertodt?
Tell me more about the invasion.
Goodbye.
I'm going to stop looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 이제 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)는 그만 찾을래요.

english: As you wish adventurer.
You will no longer have a chance to receive temple, sun and moon pages from creatures in the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: 이제 Forthos Dungeon(포르토스 던전)의 생물들에게서 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)를 얻을 수 없어요.

english: Now shhhh!
I'm going to start looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 이제 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)를 찾아볼래요.

english: You will now have a chance to receive temple, sun and moon pages from creatures in the Forthos Dungeon.
translation: 이제 Forthos Dungeon(포르토스 던전)의 생물들에게서 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)를 얻을 수 있어요.

english: Shhhh!
Tell me about the Library.
What do you do here?
Do you help people find books?
Can you stop shushing me?
Do you do anything useful at all?
What is wrong with you?
What is the point in you being here?
How can I get a job like yours?
translation: 어떻게 하면 당신 같은 일자리를 얻을 수 있나요?

english: You're an utterly useless person.
HOW ABOUT I SHOUT REALLY LOUD THEN?
translation: 그럼 내가 엄청 크게 소리 지르면 어때요?!

english: Sorry.
That's better.
You show Logosia the tome.
I have not seen this before. Your donation to the library is appreciated.
translation: 처음 보는 책이네요. 도서관에 기증해 주셔서 감사해요.

english: You can have this tome which I discovered aswell.
You hand Logosia the tome.
You can have these tomes which I discovered aswell.
You hand Logosia the tomes.
Again, your donation to the library is appreciated
translation: 다시 한번, 도서관에 기증해 주셔서 감사해요

english: Your contributions to the library have been noticed. We would like to reward you for your assistance.
translation: 도서관에 대한 당신의 공헌이 인정받았어요. 도와주신 데 보답하고 싶어요.

english: You receive an experience lamp as a reward.
If you find any spare pages for these books I would be willing to give you 1,000 gold for each one. Duplicate sources of information are always useful.
translation: 이 책들의 여분 페이지를 찾으면 한 장당 1,000골드를 드릴게요. 같은 정보라도 출처가 여럿이면 언제나 유용하거든요.

english: I'll keep an eye out.
Enough talk now, Shhhh!
Here you go.
I'm going to stop looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 이제 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)는 그만 찾을래요.

english: I'm going to start looking for temple, sun and moon pages.
translation: 이제 temple, sun and moon pages(사원·태양·달 페이지)를 찾아볼래요.

english: Something else.
Tell me about the Library.
What do you do here?
Do you help people find books?
Can you stop shushing me?
Do you do anything useful at all?
What is wrong with you?
What is the point in you being here?
How can I get a job like yours?
translation: 어떻게 하면 당신 같은 일자리를 얻을 수 있나요?

english: You're an utterly useless person.
HOW ABOUT I SHOUT REALLY LOUD THEN.
translation: 그럼 내가 엄청 크게 소리 지르면 어때요?

english: Sorry.
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 운송망)의 단골 고객이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello there.
Don't talk to me! I don't have time for the likes of you!
translation: 말 걸지 마! 너 같은 녀석 상대할 시간 없어!

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Lunar Diplomacy quest.
translation: Lunar Diplomacy(루나 외교) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 요구 사항을 모두 충족하지 못했다.

english: Hey! Don't call me outerlander! I'm known as the mighty [Fremennik name]!
translation: 이봐요! 저를 외지인이라고 부르지 마요! 저는 위대한 [Fremennik name](이)라고 불린다고요!

english: Can't say I've heard of you. So they let your sort into the clan nowadays? Wow. Things have really changed since I've been gone...
translation: 들어 본 적 없는데. 요즘은 너 같은 부류도 부족에 끼워 주나? 와. 내가 떠나 있는 동안 정말 많이 변했네...

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
Yes, I suppose that's true... I have been gone such a long time...
translation: 그래, 그건 맞는 말이지... 정말 오랫동안 떠나 있었으니까...

english: (shows previous options)
You've been away from these parts a while?
Oh, you haven't heard of the infamous Lokar, scourge of the northern seas?
translation: 오, 북쪽 바다의 재앙, 악명 높은 Lokar(로카르)를 못 들어 봤단 말이야?

english: Erm... no... That's you then, is it?
Forgotten already? Tch! I have no regrets about why I left!
translation: 벌써 잊었다고? 쳇! 내가 떠난 이유엔 후회 따윈 없어!

english: Why did you leave?
As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...
translation: 젊었을 때, Fremennik(프레메닉)식 삶은 나한테 너무 느리다는 걸 깨달았지...

english: Oh, sure, every so often we got to go on big raiding parties, looting and pillaging the weaker islands around here for food and profit, but...
translation: 아, 물론 가끔은 큰 약탈대를 꾸려서 이 근처 약한 섬들을 털고 식량이랑 돈을 챙기긴 했지. 하지만...

english: Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.
translation: 글쎄, 얼마 지나니까 내가 기다리는 건 그것뿐이더라고.

english: Growing crops, milking cows, catching and cooking food, the day to day activities of our life...
translation: 작물 키우고, 소젖 짜고, 먹을 거 잡아서 요리하고, 그런 우리 일상생활 말이야...

english: THEY'RE SO BORING!
No, I knew what I wanted to do, and that was attack innocent people going about their daily business, steal all their money, then spend it on wine, women and song!
translation: 아니, 난 내가 뭘 하고 싶은지 알았어. 바로 제 할 일 하는 무고한 사람들을 습격해서 돈을 몽땅 털고, 그 돈을 술과 여자와 노래에 쓰는 거였지!

english: Oh.... Kaaaaay....
So I ran away from Rellekka to become a PIRATE! It's way more fun. Plus you get to see the world!
translation: 그래서 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 도망쳐 해적이 됐지! 훨씬 재밌어. 게다가 세상 구경도 하고!

english: Was the world good then? Only, you seem to have returned to Rellekka after all.
translation: 그래서 세상은 좋았어요? 근데 결국 Rellekka(렐레카)로 돌아오신 것 같은데요.

english: Yes, I have returned here, but that's only because we're short on supplies.
translation: 그래, 여기 돌아오긴 했지만, 그건 보급품이 모자라서일 뿐이야.

english: I see. So where are you and your scurvy sea-dogs headed to next? Arrr shiver-me timbers!
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 당신과 썩어 빠진 바다 개들은 다음엔 어디로 가나요? 아르르, 갑판이 흔들린다!

english: You're trying my patience...
Sorry, got caught up in the moment.
Indeed. Well, the rest of the group are at Lunar Isle at the moment. It's where the Moon Clan live.
translation: 그래. 아무튼, 나머지 일행은 지금 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에 있어. Moon Clan(달 부족)이 사는 곳이지.

english: The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...
translation: Moon Clan(달 부족)... 들어 본 것 같아요...

english: I'd be surprised if you hadn't, they're the Fremenniks' most hated enemy!
translation: 못 들어 봤으면 놀랐을 거야. Fremennik(프레메닉)이 제일 증오하는 적이거든!

english: They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!
translation: 수백 년 동안 서로 전쟁 중이라고!

english: Hmmm. Actually, that might be a problem for you then.
translation: 흐음. 사실 그럼 너한텐 문제가 될 수도 있겠는데.

english: A problem?
Yeah, they're a really powerful race of mages. They'd read your mind and see that you're a Fremennik straight away, then probably turn you inside out and feed you to the birds.
translation: 그래, 걔들은 정말 강력한 마법사 종족이거든. 네 마음을 읽어서 네가 Fremennik(프레메닉)이란 걸 단번에 알아챌 거고, 아마 널 뒤집어 까서 새 모이로 줘 버리겠지.

english: Cosmic.
But you went there okay?
Yeah, but I think the Fremenniks are a bunch of losers. They probably picked up on that.
translation: 그래, 근데 난 Fremennik(프레메닉) 놈들이 패배자 무리라고 생각하거든. 걔들이 그걸 알아챘나 봐.

english: Look, I know a way you'll be able to travel there without, you know, getting killed and that, if you fancy a trip!
translation: 저기, 네가 거기 가도, 그러니까, 죽거나 뭐 그런 일 없이 갈 수 있는 방법을 알고 있어. 여행할 마음 있으면 말이야!

english: Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!
translation: 좋죠, 제 내장 상태가 어떤지 늘 궁금했거든요!

english: That's the spirit!
Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.
translation: 자, 네가 할 일은 Brundt the Chieftain(족장 브룬트)한테 가서 Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)을 받아 오는 거야.

english: A Seal of Passage? What's that?
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)요? 그게 뭔데요?

english: Well, it shows that you're a diplomat for the Fremennik, so you'll have immunity from being killed and stuff.
translation: 음, 네가 Fremennik(프레메닉)의 외교관이라는 걸 보여 주는 거야. 그러니까 죽임당하지 않는 면책 특권 같은 게 생기지.

english: It's an ancient tradition not to attack anyone bearing a Seal of Passage, because they're probably on a diplomatic mission. Or well connected with powerful allies. Either way, killing them is usually a bad idea.
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)을 지닌 사람은 공격하지 않는 게 오랜 전통이야. 아마 외교 임무 중이거나, 아니면 강력한 동맹이랑 줄이 닿아 있을 테니까. 어느 쪽이든, 그런 사람을 죽이는 건 대개 좋은 생각이 아니지.

english: So I have to try and bring peace to two warring nations who have been fighting for centuries?!?!
translation: 그러니까 제가 수백 년 동안 싸워 온 두 나라 사이에 평화를 가져와야 한다는 거예요?!?!

english: What? I never said you had to bother trying to do that, you just have to pretend like you might.
translation: 뭐? 굳이 그러려고 애쓰라고는 안 했어. 그냥 그럴 수도 있는 척만 하면 돼.

english: No skin off my nose if those losers want to get slaughtered by the Moon Clan, just more stuff for me to loot when they're all dead.
translation: 그 패배자들이 Moon Clan(달 부족)한테 학살당하든 말든 내 알 바 아냐. 다 죽으면 내가 털어 갈 게 더 많아질 뿐이지.

english: Well I will try. I am the mighty [Fremennik name] after all!
translation: 그래도 해 볼게요. 어쨌든 위대한 [Fremennik name], 바로 저니까요!

english: Yes....
So I just have to go talk to Brundt the Chieftain and tell him I want a Seal of Passage?
translation: 그러니까 Brundt the Chieftain(족장 브룬트)한테 가서 Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)을 달라고 말하기만 하면 되는 거죠?

english: That's it? Because in my experience simple tasks like that always seem to take longer than I expect...
translation: 그게 다예요? 제 경험상 그런 간단한 일은 늘 예상보다 오래 걸리더라고요...

english: Yeah, just go over and talk to the chief loser. You might have to tell him some rubbish he wants to hear, but that's it.
translation: 그래, 그냥 가서 그 패배자 대장이랑 얘기해. 걔가 듣고 싶어 하는 헛소리를 좀 해 줘야 할 수도 있지만, 그게 다야.

english: Come back here when you got it, my supplies are loaded and I'm good to head back to our ship.
translation: 받으면 여기로 돌아와. 내 보급품은 다 실었으니 언제든 우리 배로 돌아갈 수 있어.

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
No thanks, I'd like to live.
Oh, so you're a loser like the rest of the Fremenniks then? See ya around, loser.
translation: 아, 그러니까 너도 다른 Fremennik(프레메닉) 놈들처럼 패배자구나? 잘 가라, 패배자.

english: Well, 'bye then.
You won't make many friends on Lunar Isle without your Seal of Passage.
translation: Seal of Passage(통행의 인장) 없이는 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 친구를 많이 못 사귈 거야.

english: That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: 괜찮아요, 그냥 Pirates' Cove(해적의 만)에 가는 거예요.

english: Player is transported to Pirates' cove
Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
Hi Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?
translation: 안녕하세요 Lokar(로카르), 당신 배로 다시 데려다줄 수 있어요?

english: Sheesh, make your mind up [pal/lady], I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 에휴, 마음 좀 정해, [pal/lady]. 난 택시가 아니라고!

english: Actually, I've changed my mind. Again. I don't want to go.
translation: 사실 마음이 바뀌었어요. 또요. 안 갈래요.

english: You are possibly the most indecisive person I have ever met...
translation: 넌 아마 내가 만나 본 사람 중에 제일 우유부단할 거야...

english: Hello again Lokar.
Hi again [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you?
translation: 또 왔네, [Fremennik name]! 뭘 해 줄까?

english: Do I still need the Seal of Passage?
translation: 아직 Seal of Passage(통행의 인장)이 필요한가요?

english: Yeah, why?
I lost it.
Silly you. You'll have to go back to Brundt the Chieftain to get another before you can go on to Lunar Isle.
translation: 바보 같긴. Lunar Isle(루나 섬)으로 가기 전에 Brundt the Chieftain(족장 브룬트)한테 돌아가서 하나 더 받아 와야 해.

english: Can you take me back to Rellekka please?
Hey, if you want to go back to loserville with all the losers, who am I to stop you?
translation: 이봐, 패배자들이랑 패배자 마을로 돌아가고 싶다면 내가 무슨 수로 말리겠어?

english: Player is transported to Rellekka
Nothing thanks! I just saw you here and thought I'd say hello!
translation: 아무것도 아니에요! 그냥 여기 계신 게 보여서 인사하려고요!

english: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [Fremennik name]!
translation: 이야, 처음 만났을 때부터 너 괜찮은 녀석 같았어, [Fremennik name]!

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
You've been away from these parts a while?
Why did you leave?
Yes.
No.
'Bye then.
That's fine, I'm just going to Pirates' Cove.
translation: 괜찮아요, 그냥 Pirates' Cove(해적의 만)에 가는 거예요.

english: Oh, I'd better go back and get it.
Go now.
Don't go.
Can you take me back to Rellekka?
Nothing thanks.
Greetings human.
Hello, who are you?
Lokraa quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: 나는 Lokraa quo Sihar(로크라 쿠오 시하르)요. Kahlith(칼리스)의 신비술사 중 하나지. 그대는 균형을 섬기러 왔소?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)과 이야기하시오. 그녀가 그대를 이끌어 줄 것이오.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 안타깝구려. 그대는 죽음을 가져오는 자이니, 균형에 크게 쓰일 수 있을 텐데.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기하시오. 그가 길을 보여 줄 것이오.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Arrr, matey!
I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)라고? 그 녀석은 밖에 있지. 볼에 바람 맞는 게 좋다나.

english: Thanks.
Why are you called Longbow Ben?
Arrr, that's a strange yarn.
I was to be marooned, ye see. A scurvy troublemaker had taken my ship, and he put me ashore on a little island.
translation: 난 무인도에 버려질 참이었어. 썩어 빠진 말썽꾼 놈이 내 배를 빼앗고는 날 작은 섬에 내려놨지.

english: Gosh, how did you escape?
Arrr, ye see, he made one mistake! Before he sailed away, he gave me a bow and one arrow so that I wouldn't have to die slowly.
translation: 아르르, 그 녀석은 실수를 하나 했거든! 떠나기 전에, 내가 천천히 죽지 않도록 활 하나랑 화살 하나를 줬지.

english: So I shot him and took my ship back.
translation: 그래서 그놈을 쏴 버리고 내 배를 되찾았지.

english: Right...
Have you got any quests I could do?
Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Or Redbeard Frank, he's often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking them for quests.
translation: 없어. 하지만 이 근처 소식은 바텐더가 거의 다 듣지. 아니면 Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)가 묻힌 보물 얘기를 자주 하더군. 퀘스트는 그 사람들한테 물어보라고.

english: Nay, but Redbeard Frank has often spoken of buried treasure. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 없어. 하지만 Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)가 묻힌 보물 얘기를 자주 하더군. 그 녀석한테 퀘스트를 물어보라고.

english: Nay, but the barkeep hears most of the news around here. Perhaps ye should be asking him for a quest.
translation: 없어. 하지만 이 근처 소식은 바텐더가 거의 다 듣지. 그 사람한테 퀘스트를 물어보라고.

english: Nay, I've nothing for ye to do. But I hear there's an old landlubber in Draynor Village who's always a-looking for a lively [lad/lass] to do him a favour.
translation: 없어, 너한테 맡길 일은 없다. 하지만 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 늙은 뭍사람이 하나 있는데, 늘 부탁 들어줄 팔팔한 [lad/lass] 하나를 찾는다더군.

english: Arrr, matey!
Yo ho ho!
So are you pirates?
Aye laddie, that we are.
Aye, that we be.
Nay, always ye say it wrong! Tis 'we are', not 'we be'.
translation: 아니지, 넌 늘 틀리게 말해! '해적이다'라고 해야지, '해적이여'가 아니라!

english: I be a pirate, not a scurvy schoolmaster!
translation: 난 해적이여, 썩어 빠진 훈장 선생이 아니라!

english: Ye be a fool, and a disgrace to piracy.
Now ye be saying 'be' too!
Arrr! Tis thy fault.
I think I'll leave you two to sort it out.
translation: 두 분이 알아서 해결하시도록 전 이만 가 볼게요.

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Redbeard Frank(붉은 수염 프랭크)를 찾고 있어요.

english: Why are you called Longbow Ben?
Have you got any quests I could do?
Hey, outerlander. You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 이봐, 외지인. 거긴 못 들어가. 무대 뒤는 재능 있는 사람만이야.

english: Get lost, outerlander. Performers only past this point.
translation: 꺼져, 외지인. 여기부턴 공연자만 들어갈 수 있어.

english: But I am a performer!
Oh, really? So where's your instrument?
translation: 오, 그래? 그럼 악기는 어디 있는데?

english: Um... I'm an acapella bard?
Oh, really? You won't mind singing me a quick song then.
translation: 오, 그래? 그럼 노래 한 곡 짧게 불러 줘도 상관없겠네.

english: Tie me chompy bird down, Rantz Tie me chompy bird down! Me stickers don't get no quicker, So tie me chompy bird down!
translation: 내 chompy bird(촘피 새)를 묶어 줘, Rantz(랜츠) 내 촘피 새를 묶어 줘! 내 화살은 더 빨라지질 않으니, 그러니 촘피 새를 묶어 줘!

english: (continues below)
Murphy row the boat ashore... We are siiiiinking...
translation: Murphy(머피), 배를 저어 뭍으로... 우린 가라아아앉는 중...

english: My old man's a miner, Spends all day mining ore, He wears a dragon ammy, And lives in Falador - Oi!
translation: 우리 아버진 광부라네, 하루 종일 광석을 캐지, 드래곤 아뮬렛을 걸고, Falador(팔라도르)에 산다네 - 어이!

english: Elvarg the magic dragon... Lives by the sea... He spends all his days eating folk, And dies occasionally...
translation: 마법의 용 Elvarg(엘바르그)... 바닷가에 산다네... 날마다 사람들을 잡아먹고, 가끔 죽는다네...

english: That was a pile of tosh. Get lost, outerlander. You're a bard like I'm a goblin. Do I look stupid to you?
translation: 형편없는 노래였어. 꺼져, 외지인. 네가 음유시인이면 난 goblin(고블린)이다. 내가 바보로 보여?

english: Well, actually...
I said, get lost.
You have an instrument now, huh? Go on through the door.
Yeah, you're good to go through. Olaf tells me you're some kind of outerlander bard here on tour. I doubt you're worse than Olaf is.
translation: 그래, 들어가도 돼. Olaf(올라프) 말로는 네가 순회공연 중인 외지인 음유시인이라던데. 설마 올라프보다 못하진 않겠지.

english: You can't go through there. Talent only, backstage.
translation: 거긴 못 들어가. 무대 뒤는 재능 있는 사람만이야.

english: But I'm a Bard!
No you're not. I saw your performance. I was paid well to keep you from ever setting foot on stage here again.
translation: 아니, 아니잖아. 네 공연 봤어. 다시는 네가 여기 무대에 발도 못 들이게 하라고 돈 두둑이 받았다고.

english: Tie Me Chompy Bird Down
Murphy Row The Boat Ashore
My Old Man's A Miner
Elvarg The Magic Dragon
Hello there.
Hello, Longramble. How goes the hunt for the edge of the world?
translation: 안녕하세요, Longramble(롱램블). 세상의 끝을 찾는 일은 잘돼 가요?

english: Truth be told, I've found myself getting a bit side- tracked. The potential discovery of Arposandra is quite an exciting one!
translation: 사실을 말하자면, 요즘 좀 딴 길로 새 버렸어요. Arposandra(아르포산드라)를 발견할지도 모른다니, 정말 신나는 일이거든요!

english: And also quite dangerous.
Yes, that's why I've not dared go inside again. It's much safer out here. Slightly less smelly as well.
translation: 맞아요, 그래서 다시 들어갈 엄두를 못 내고 있어요. 여기 바깥이 훨씬 안전하거든요. 냄새도 살짝 덜 나고요.

english: Slightly being the key word there.
Hello there. How goes the hunt for Arposandra?
translation: 안녕하세요. Arposandra(아르포산드라)를 찾는 일은 잘돼 가요?

english: I think I've found an entrance to the city, but it's too well defended. There's all these traps, and some talking terrorbird guards!
translation: 도시로 들어가는 입구를 찾은 것 같은데, 방비가 너무 삼엄해요. 함정이 잔뜩 있고, 말하는 terrorbird(테러버드) 경비병들도 있어요!

english: Talking terrorbirds? There must be some strange magic being practised in there. What do you plan to do?
translation: 말하는 테러버드요? 저 안에서 뭔가 기묘한 마법이 쓰이고 있는 게 틀림없어요. 어떻게 할 생각이에요?

english: I don't know. I think I've hit a dead end for now.
translation: 모르겠어요. 지금으로선 막다른 길에 다다른 것 같아요.

english: That's a shame. Still, you've made a big discovery. It will be quite the tale to tell... assuming anyone believes a story about talking terrorbirds, that is.
translation: 아쉽네요. 그래도 대단한 발견을 했잖아요. 두고두고 이야깃거리가 될 거예요... 말하는 테러버드 이야기를 누가 믿어 준다면 말이죠.

english: What do you want?
What are you guarding?
This path leads to the Doors of Dinh. You should be careful if you wish to travel any further.
translation: 이 길은 Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)으로 이어집니다. 더 가실 생각이라면 조심하십시오.

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No-one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it came out of the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
translation: 그 문은 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 막아 두기 위한 겁니다. 그게 정말 무엇인지는 아무도 모르지만, 수백 년 전 북쪽 황무지에서 나타나 왕국을 공포에 떨게 했습니다.

english: The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smither, to imprison the Wintertodt.
translation: 그 문은 뛰어난 대장장이 Dinh(딘)이 윈터토트를 가두려고 만든 것입니다.

english: Now we keep a watch on the pass, so that the armies can be summoned if the Wintertodt ever escapes.
translation: 그래서 지금 저희가 고개를 감시하고 있습니다. 윈터토트가 탈출하면 즉시 군대를 소집할 수 있도록 말입니다.

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
Who are you?
I'm the duty look-out on the northern pass. It's the worst assignment there is.
translation: 저는 북쪽 고개의 당번 망꾼입니다. 이보다 더 고약한 보직은 없습니다.

english: As if the cold weren't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus magi always look down their noses at the Shayzien armies, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
translation: 추위만으로도 고역인데, 콧대 높은 Arceuus(아르세우스) 마법사들은 저희가 화려한 마법 대신 근육과 강철을 쓴다는 이유만으로 늘 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 군을 깔봅니다.

english: I'll leave you alone now.
What are you guarding?
Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Okay, thanks for the warning.
Who are you?
I'll leave you alone now.
You! You're the one that lost me my tithes. Get out before I have you killed!
translation: 너! 내 십일조를 잃게 만든 놈이로군. 죽여 버리라고 명령하기 전에 썩 꺼져라!

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병을 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가라!

english: You there. Who are you?
[Vampyre Name]
Tell me, [player vampyre name], what blood tastes the best?
translation: 말해 봐라, [player vampyre name]. 어떤 피가 가장 맛있지?

english: Err... Human?
You misunderstand me, I mean what kind of human?
One with a face?
What? I mean, yes. But what else?
translation: 뭐? 아니, 그렇긴 하지. 하지만 그것 말고는?

english: I don't know... What's the actual answer?
Love. Blood tastes best when it comes from one who loves.
translation: 사랑이다. 피는 사랑하는 자에게서 나올 때 가장 맛있지.

english: Too many around here treat their tithes with discontentment. When they do, they miss out on the full potential blood has to offer.
translation: 이곳의 많은 자들이 자기 십일조를 박하게 대하지. 그러니 피가 줄 수 있는 진정한 맛을 놓치는 거다.

english: Treat your tithes with respect instead. They will come to love you, and their blood becomes so much better as a result.
translation: 대신 네 십일조를 존중으로 대해라. 그러면 그들이 너를 사랑하게 되고, 그 덕에 피 맛이 훨씬 좋아진다.

english: I see. I'll keep that in mind.
Baxtorian.
[player name].
How are things?
The city is flourishing, largely thanks to you. There's still some mistrust for the Iorwerth clan, but overall I'd say it's been over a thousand years since our people were doing this well.
translation: 도시가 번영하고 있소. 대부분 그대 덕분이지. Iorwerth(이오르워스) 씨족을 향한 불신이 아직 남아 있긴 하나, 전반적으로 보면 우리 백성이 이토록 잘 지낸 것은 천 년도 더 된 일이오.

english: That's great to hear. What about you though?
I still mourn Glarial every day, until the end of time a part of me will be missing, never to be replaced.
translation: 나는 여전히 매일 Glarial(글라리알)을 애도하오. 세상이 끝날 때까지 내 일부는 비어 있을 것이고, 결코 채워지지 않겠지.

english: But I know now that I can't let that impact the elves here. Many of them never even knew their former queen. My grief is mine alone, they need not bear it.
translation: 하지만 이제는 그 슬픔이 이곳 엘프들에게 영향을 주어선 안 된다는 걸 아오. 그들 중 다수는 옛 여왕을 알지도 못하오. 내 슬픔은 나만의 것이니, 그들이 짊어질 필요는 없소.

english: To them, I'm trying my best to be a leader they deserve, to correct the mistakes of the past. Lord Iorwerth believed we were nothing without Seren. We need to prove that we have a future with her gone.
translation: 그들에게 걸맞은 지도자가 되고, 과거의 잘못을 바로잡으려 최선을 다하고 있소. Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)은 Seren(세렌) 없이는 우리가 아무것도 아니라고 믿었지. 우리는 그녀가 떠난 뒤에도 미래가 있음을 증명해야 하오.

english: Thankfully I have the other elders to help this time. Ruling is not as hard when you share out the responsiblities.
translation: 다행히 이번에는 다른 원로들이 돕고 있소. 책임을 나누니 다스리는 일도 그리 어렵지 않구려.

english: Well I'm glad to hear things are going well.
And we are glad to have you here with us. None of this would have been possible without you.
translation: 우리도 그대가 함께해 주어 기쁘오. 그대가 없었다면 이 모든 것은 불가능했을 것이오.

english: Are you alright?
You may speak.
Oh, yes yes, I'm fine.
You look a little beat up.
These scratches? Don't worry, just a disagreement with a thorn bush.
translation: 이 긁힌 자국이요? 걱정 마세요, 가시덤불이랑 좀 다퉜을 뿐이에요.

english: Sure...
Is there something you wanted, bloodbag?
Just looking around.
Well, I'd prefer you did it elsewhere, Crombwick is busy entertaining his guests.
translation: 그럼 딴 데 가서 둘러봐. Crombwick(크롬윅)은 손님 접대로 바쁘거든.

english: Strange bunch of guests...
Hello.
What want you, with the Lord of the Kinshra? Speak!
Erm, nothing actually.
Then begone knave, before I have my Knights put you to the sword!
translation: 그렇다면 썩 물러가라, 이 무뢰한아. 내 기사들이 너를 칼로 베기 전에!

english: Greetings [player name].
Hey Iestin. So they made you the new Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 안녕하세요, Iestin(이에스틴). 그럼 당신이 새로운 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)이 된 거예요?

english: Indeed. Apart from Morvran, I am the closest living relative of the previous Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 그렇소. Morvran(모르브란)을 제외하면, 내가 선대 이오르워스 경의 가장 가까운 혈육이오.

english: Did Morvran not want the role?
No. That's probably for the best though. Morvran was very close to my predecessor. It would have made many uncomfortable if he had taken on the role.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 그게 최선이었을 것이오. Morvran(모르브란)은 내 전임자와 매우 가까웠소. 그가 그 자리를 맡았다면 많은 이들이 불편해했을 것이오.

english: How have things been since the city was reformed?
The others still hold a lot of mistrust for our clan. It will take a long time for those rifts to be repaired. We are on the right path though.
translation: 다른 이들은 여전히 우리 씨족을 크게 불신하고 있소. 그 골이 메워지려면 오랜 시간이 걸릴 것이오. 그래도 우리는 올바른 길을 가고 있소.

english: That's good to hear. All the best.
Likewise.
Good day [player name]. Have you come to hear the song of the elves?
translation: 안녕하시오, [player name]. 엘프의 노래를 들으러 왔소?

english: What do you mean?
Do you not hear it? The sounds of a city in harmony. It is the song of the elves, the story of our people.
translation: 들리지 않소? 조화를 이룬 도시의 소리 말이오. 그것이 엘프의 노래, 우리 백성의 이야기라오.

english: The last few verses were dark and quiet, but now our city is restored, we find ourselves singing a new verse, one of joy and light.
translation: 지난 몇 소절은 어둡고 고요했으나, 이제 도시가 되살아나 우리는 새로운 소절을 부르고 있소. 기쁨과 빛의 소절을.

english: I see. I guess I've never been the type to reflect on that sort of thing.
translation: 그렇군요. 저는 그런 걸 곰곰이 생각해 보는 성격은 아니었나 봐요.

english: More of a fighter? We have a song for that too. If you wish to sing it, head to the Gauntlet and put yourself to the test.
translation: 싸움 쪽이 더 맞는 사람이오? 그런 이를 위한 노래도 있소. 그 노래를 부르고 싶다면 Gauntlet(건틀릿)으로 가서 스스로를 시험해 보시오.

english: I might just give it a shot. Thanks.
Hello.
Hello there.
Tell me about yourself.
I am Kandur Hosidius and I am the lord of Hosidius, the city of farmers and chefs. I live here with my wife, Elena, and my two sons, Artur and Pandur.
translation: 나는 Kandur Hosidius(칸두르 호시디우스)요. 농부와 요리사의 도시 Hosidius(호시디우스)의 영주지. 이곳에서 아내 Elena(엘레나), 그리고 두 아들 Artur(아르투르), Pandur(판두르)와 함께 살고 있소.

english: My family and I have a peaceful existence here. That's mainly because I care not for the politics of the other houses. I instead devote my time to more meaningful pursuits.
translation: 우리 가족은 이곳에서 평화롭게 지내고 있소. 그건 주로 내가 다른 가문들의 정치에 관심을 두지 않기 때문이오. 대신 더 의미 있는 일에 시간을 쏟고 있지.

english: Such as?
Ensuring that Kourend is well fed. We may live in gentle times now but who knows how long it will be that way. Sooner or later another war or long winter will hit us. History has proven that.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)가 굶주리지 않게 하는 일이오. 지금은 평온한 시절이지만 그게 얼마나 갈지는 아무도 모르오. 머지않아 또 다른 전쟁이나 긴 겨울이 닥칠 것이오. 역사가 그걸 증명해 왔지.

english: Anything else I can help you with?
Tell me about Hosidius.
Hosidius is home to the farmers and chefs of Kourend. We are the main food supplier to the kingdom and we ensure that her people are fed.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스)는 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 농부와 요리사들의 터전이오. 우리는 왕국의 주된 식량 공급처로서, 왕국 백성이 굶지 않게 하고 있소.

english: We also own more land than the other Kourend houses. We need the extra space for all of our crops.
translation: 또한 우리는 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 다른 가문들보다 땅을 더 많이 소유하고 있소. 그 많은 작물을 기르려면 넓은 땅이 필요하니까.

english: Do the other houses not get annoyed at how much land you have?
translation: 다른 가문들이 그렇게 넓은 땅을 가진 걸 못마땅해하지 않나요?

english: Sometimes. They know it is necessary though. There was once a time when the land was shared equally. But then the great famine came, and Kourend did not have the food to last through it.
translation: 가끔은 그렇소. 그래도 필요하다는 건 그들도 알고 있지. 한때는 땅을 똑같이 나눠 가지던 시절이 있었소. 그러다 대기근이 닥쳤고, Kourend(쿠렌드)에는 그것을 버틸 식량이 없었소.

english: After that, more space was given to Hosidius. We've had the most land ever since.
translation: 그 뒤로 Hosidius(호시디우스)에 더 많은 땅이 주어졌소. 그때부터 줄곧 우리가 가장 넓은 땅을 가져왔지.

english: Tell me about your plans.
Plans? My only plan is to keep providing food to this kingdom.
translation: 계획이라? 내 계획은 오직 이 왕국에 계속 식량을 공급하는 것뿐이오.

english: But what of the Royal Accord of Twill? You must have kept it for a reason.
translation: 하지만 Royal Accord of Twill(트윌 왕실 협정)은요? 그걸 가지고 있는 데는 이유가 있을 텐데요.

english: I did. The Accord has the potential to be a powerful weapon, for words cut deeper than a blade ever can. However, I have no need to use this weapon, not unless the other houses give me reason to.
translation: 그렇소. 말은 어떤 칼날보다 깊이 베는 법이니, 협정은 강력한 무기가 될 수 있소. 하지만 다른 가문들이 빌미를 주지 않는 한, 나는 이 무기를 쓸 생각이 없소.

english: Goodbye.
Until next time.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Hosidius.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Good day!
Isn't it just!
What brings you down here?
This and that... But mostly, I'm looking for a good place to mobilise my army.
translation: 이런저런 일로... 하지만 무엇보다도 내 군대를 집결시킬 좋은 장소를 찾고 있네.

english: That's awfully specific, you sure this is a good place for it?
translation: 꽤 구체적이네요. 여기가 정말 그러기에 좋은 곳이에요?

english: I don't see why not!
I'm not sure there's enough land, to be honest.
Tish tosh! I'm importing sand from Al Kharid, there'll be a base camp here in no time, do not fret!
translation: 허튼소리! Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 모래를 들여오고 있으니, 금세 여기에 기지가 세워질 걸세. 걱정 말게!

english: Oh. Okay then.
The tithes are growing weak. That werewolf needs to do a better job of keeping them fed.
translation: 십일조들이 약해지고 있군. 그 werewolf(늑대인간) 녀석, 먹이를 더 제대로 먹여야겠어.

english: What do you feed them?
There's no shortage of corpses around here. The dead can still have some uses.
translation: 이 근방엔 시체가 넘쳐나지. 죽은 것도 쓸모가 있는 법이야.

english: You're feeding them corpses? No wonder they're becoming weak. That meat must have all sorts of problems.
translation: 시체를 먹인다고요? 약해지는 게 당연하죠. 그 고기에는 온갖 문제가 있을 텐데요.

english: What else would you have me feed them? If I give them nicer food, I'm wasting more money than if I were to just kill them and buy some more.
translation: 그럼 뭘 먹이란 거냐? 더 좋은 음식을 주느니, 차라리 죽이고 새로 사는 게 돈이 덜 들어.

english: I... I suppose.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병을 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가라!

english: Hello.
Hello there young one. Interested in getting your hands dirty?
translation: 반갑네, 젊은이. 손을 좀 더럽혀 볼 생각 있나?

english: Err... maybe?
Ah don't worry, it's nothing sinister. We leave that kind of thing to clan Iorwerth. I speak in a more literal sense, of the ground beneath us and the trees over us.
translation: 아, 걱정 말게. 음흉한 일은 아니니까. 그런 건 Iorwerth(이오르워스) 씨족에게 맡겨 두지. 난 말 그대로의 뜻으로 한 말일세. 우리 발밑의 땅과 머리 위의 나무 말이야.

english: Oh, I see. So it's your clan that looks after the plants of the city?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그럼 도시의 식물을 돌보는 게 당신 씨족이에요?

english: Indeed. We maintain the farms and manage the trees. The produce we grow goes to the Meilyr clan to feed the city and the wood we provide is used by the Ithell clan in construction.
translation: 그렇다네. 우리는 농장을 관리하고 나무를 가꾸지. 우리가 기른 작물은 Meilyr(메일리르) 씨족에게 가서 도시 사람들을 먹이고, 우리가 대는 목재는 Ithell(이셀) 씨족이 건축에 쓴다네.

english: Feel free to join us. Our farming patches are open to you, as is our sawmill.
translation: 언제든 함께하게. 우리 농사 밭도, 제재소도 자네에게 열려 있네.

english: Awesome, thank you.
How goes it, friend?
I stole the Ring of Charos from Fenkenstrain.
translation: 제가 Fenkenstrain(펜켄스트레인)에게서 Ring of Charos(카로스의 반지)를 훔쳤어요.

english: I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide it. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.
translation: 그자가 반지를 숨기려고 Tower(탑)으로 올라가는 걸 보았소. 상관없소. 곧 werewolf(늑대인간)들이 그자를 찾아올 테고, 그자의 실험도 영원히 끝날 것이오.

english: Do you want the ring back? It is yours after all.
No, you keep it, my friend. Werewolves hunger for the scent of live flesh - I have no need for the ring. I have my castle back, if not my soul.
translation: 아니, 그대가 가지시오, 친구. 늑대인간들은 살아 있는 살덩이의 냄새에 굶주려 있소. 내겐 반지가 필요 없소. 영혼은 되찾지 못했어도 성은 되찾았으니.

english: Hello.
Tell me about yourself.
Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the ruler of Shayzien and the commander-in-chief of the Shayzien Army.
translation: 시민이여, 그대는 지금 Lord Shiro Shayzien(시로 샤이지엔 경)과 이야기하고 있소. 나는 Shayzien(샤이지엔)의 통치자이자 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 총사령관이오.

english: How long have you held this position?
translation: 그 자리에 오른 지 얼마나 됐어요?

english: Since my father passed away four years ago. He was a good man who took the defence of Kourend very seriously. I have been working hard to continue his legacy.
translation: 4년 전 부친께서 세상을 떠나신 이후로 줄곧이오. 그분은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 방어를 매우 중시하신 훌륭한 분이셨소. 나는 그분의 유산을 잇기 위해 힘써 왔소.

english: Anything else I can help you with citizen?
Tell me about Shayzien.
Most citizens of Shayzien are part of the Shayzien Army in some form or other. We are responsible for defending Kourend against external and internal threats.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 시민 대부분은 어떤 형태로든 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)에 속해 있소. 우리는 안팎의 위협으로부터 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 지키는 책임을 맡고 있소.

english: What are the current threats against Kourend?
Externally, we have recently beingdealing with increased lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: 외부적으로는 최근 lizardman(리자드맨)의 활동이 늘어 대응하고 있소. 또 혹시 무슨 수를 쓸지 몰라 남쪽의 Varlamore(바를라모어)도 예의 주시하고 있지.

english: Internally, we have seen a rise in gang crime across the kingdom. It seems to be especially prevalent in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 내부적으로는 왕국 전역에서 갱단 범죄가 늘고 있소. 특히 Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에서 기승을 부리는 듯하오.

english: How do you tackle these issues?
By doing what we do best citizen. There's no threat that can't be defeated by a Shayzien soldier with a sword in their hand.
translation: 우리가 가장 잘하는 방식으로 하오, 시민. 검을 쥔 Shayzien(샤이지엔) 병사가 물리치지 못할 위협은 없소.

english: Tell me about your plans.
Our war plans? I'm afraid most of that is confidential.
translation: 우리의 전쟁 계획 말이오? 유감이지만 대부분 기밀이오.

english: What I can tell you is that our main focus right now is the lizardman threat. We've moved a great number of troops into the Kebos Lowlands to combat the issue.
translation: 말해 줄 수 있는 건, 지금 우리의 주된 관심사가 lizardman(리자드맨)의 위협이라는 것이오. 이 문제에 맞서기 위해 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대)로 많은 병력을 옮겼소.

english: Is that going well?
Absolutely, we've pushed the lizardmen back to the point where we're finally able to allow citizens such as yourself into the region.
translation: 물론이오. lizardmen(리자드맨)을 밀어낸 덕에 마침내 그대 같은 시민들도 그 지역에 들어갈 수 있게 되었소.

english: Apart from the lizardman, we are also preparing to support the King in the hunt for his father's killer. Once we know who they are, they will face the full might of the Shayzien Army.
translation: lizardman(리자드맨) 외에도, 우리는 국왕 폐하께서 부친을 시해한 자를 찾으시는 일을 지원할 준비를 하고 있소. 그자가 누구인지 밝혀지는 순간, Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 모든 힘을 마주하게 될 것이오.

english: Goodbye.
Farewell citizen.
Can't talk right now citizen. I'm very busy.
translation: 지금은 이야기할 수 없소, 시민. 몹시 바쁘오.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Shayzien.
Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Good day friend.
Tell me about yourself.
I am Trobin Arceuus, lord of Arceuus. It's a position I've held for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 나는 Trobin Arceuus(트로빈 아르세우스), 아르세우스의 영주요. Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천) 이래로 천 년 동안 이 자리를 지켜 왔소.

english: That's a long time. I guess you've seen quite a bit.
Indeed. I've been present at some of the most notable moments in Kourend's history.
translation: 그렇소. Kourend(쿠렌드) 역사에서 가장 주목할 만한 순간 몇몇을 직접 지켜보았지.

english: I was there when King Agata IV was deposed, I was there when Kharedst the Builder opened Kourend Castle and I was there when Emperor Imafore was executed.
translation: King Agata IV(아가타 4세 왕)이 폐위될 때도, Kharedst the Builder(건축가 카레드스트)가 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)을 열 때도, Emperor Imafore(이마포어 황제)가 처형될 때도 나는 그 자리에 있었소.

english: I tend to keep out of public affairs these days though. My presence is often more of a distraction than a benefit. It also means I can focus on my work in peace.
translation: 하지만 요즘은 공적인 일에서 물러나 있는 편이오. 내가 나서면 도움이 되기보다 주의만 흐트러뜨릴 때가 많거든. 덕분에 내 일에도 조용히 집중할 수 있고.

english: Your work?
The freeing of souls. There are many souls that find themselves trapped here after death. My people and I do our best to release them.
translation: 영혼을 해방하는 일이오. 죽은 뒤 이곳에 갇혀 버리는 영혼이 많소. 나와 우리 백성은 그들을 풀어 주려 최선을 다하고 있소.

english: Tell me about Arceuus.

If you find something magical in Kourend, chances are it came from Arceuus. Our people have lived for a thousand years. The knowledge we've gained in that time has resulted in many a magical discovery.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 마법과 관련된 무언가를 발견한다면, 십중팔구 Arceuus(아르세우스)에서 나온 것이오. 우리 백성은 천 년을 살아왔소. 그동안 쌓은 지식으로 수많은 마법적 발견을 이루었지.

english: Most of our discoveries start with the Dark Altar. It is the source of our immortality and our people dedicate their lives to studying it.
translation: 우리 발견의 대부분은 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에서 시작되오. 그것은 우리 불멸의 근원이며, 우리 백성은 평생을 바쳐 그것을 연구하오.

english: Our people also serves an important role in the wider world. We work to free trapped souls so that they may pass on to the next world. It is a crucial task that the Dark Altar helps us to perform.
translation: 우리 백성은 더 넓은 세상에서도 중요한 역할을 맡고 있소. 갇힌 영혼들이 다음 세상으로 넘어갈 수 있도록 풀어 주는 일이지. 이 중대한 임무를 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)이 돕고 있소.

english: Was the Dark Altar always here?
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)은 처음부터 여기 있었나요?

english: Impossible to say. The Dark Altar has been mentioned in records dating back to the earliest days of Kourend. Before then, who knows.
translation: 알 수 없소. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)은 Kourend(쿠렌드) 초창기의 기록에도 언급되어 있소. 그 이전은 누가 알겠소.

english: You weren't around back then?
No. The Ascent of Arceuus didn't occur until after Xeric's Age of Strife, hundreds of years after Kourend was formed.
translation: 그렇소. Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천)은 Kourend(쿠렌드)가 세워지고 수백 년이 지난 뒤, Xeric(제릭)의 Age of Strife(투쟁의 시대) 이후에야 일어났소.

english: Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: It was a thousand years ago, during the time of King Byrne II. I went to my people and shared the secrets of immortality with them.
translation: 천 년 전, King Byrne II(번 2세 왕) 시절의 일이오. 나는 백성들에게 가서 불멸의 비밀을 나누었소.

english: Not all of them accepted this gift of course, as was their right. Those that did, were granted new bodies to house their souls. These bodies are sustained by the Dark Altar.
translation: 물론 모두가 이 선물을 받아들인 것은 아니오. 그건 그들의 권리였지. 받아들인 이들은 영혼을 담을 새로운 몸을 얻었소. 그 몸은 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)이 유지하고 있소.

english: It wasn't you that discovered this secret though was it?
translation: 그 비밀을 발견한 건 당신이 아니었죠?

english: No. It was granted to us by the Tasakaal. They are ancient beings, ones that make us seem like mere children.
translation: 그렇소. Tasakaal(타사칼)이 우리에게 내려 준 것이오. 그들은 고대의 존재로, 그들 앞에서 우리는 어린아이에 불과하오.

english: Their age and experience have granted them knowledge over life and death that we can only dream of.
translation: 오랜 세월과 경험 덕에, 그들은 우리로서는 꿈도 못 꿀 삶과 죽음의 지식을 지니고 있소.

english: The Tasakaal don't like you very much. They called you a liar and claimed you misused the knowledge.
translation: Tasakaal(타사칼)은 당신을 별로 좋아하지 않던데요. 당신을 거짓말쟁이라 부르면서, 그 지식을 악용했다고 하더군요.

english: The events that led to the Ascent of Arceuus are more complicated than even the Tasakaal know. But that is a story for another day.
translation: Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천)에 이르기까지의 일은 Tasakaal(타사칼)이 아는 것보다도 훨씬 복잡하오. 하지만 그건 다음에 이야기하기로 하지.

english: Tell me about your plans.
I had one of my people recover the remains of that device. The one that was absorbing the Dark Altars power.
translation: 내 백성 중 하나를 시켜 그 장치의 잔해를 회수했소. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘을 흡수하던 그 장치 말이오.

english: We're performing tests to see if we can learn more about it. We haven't made any meaningful progress yet though.
translation: 그것에 대해 더 알아낼 수 있을지 실험하고 있소. 다만 아직 이렇다 할 진전은 없소.

english: Once we've learnt more about it, we'll be in a better position to determine our next move.
translation: 그것에 대해 더 알게 되면, 다음 행보를 정하기도 한결 수월해질 것이오.

english: I admit, the idea of someone sabotaging the Altar is more than a bit concerning. I hope we can make some progress soon.
translation: 솔직히 누군가 Altar(제단)을 훼손하려 했다는 건 꽤나 우려스러운 일이오. 곧 진전이 있기를 바라오.

english: Now that we know Xamphur was responsible for the device that was absorbing power from the Dark Altar, we're hoping we can use it to help locate him.
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘을 흡수하던 장치의 배후가 Xamphur(잠푸르)였다는 걸 알았으니, 그것을 이용해 그자의 위치를 찾을 수 있기를 기대하고 있소.

english: Alas, so far we've had no luck. We're also scanning for energy that matches what we observed during that earthquake he caused, but again, nothing has been discovered so far.
translation: 아쉽게도 아직까지는 성과가 없소. 그자가 일으킨 지진 때 관측한 것과 일치하는 에너지도 탐색하고 있지만, 역시 아직 아무것도 발견되지 않았소.

english: It seems this work will take time. I assure you though, we will find him and his master.
translation: 이 일은 시간이 걸릴 듯하오. 하지만 장담하건대, 우리는 그자와 그자의 주인을 반드시 찾아낼 것이오.

english: What about that Pyromancer?
We've begun an investigation into their order, but we have little to go on. Hopefully we find a good lead soon.
translation: 그들의 교단에 대한 조사를 시작했지만, 단서가 거의 없소. 곧 좋은 실마리를 찾기를 바라오.

english: Well just let me know if you need my help.
I will, thank you.
Goodbye.
Farewell.
Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about Arceuus.
Tell me about the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: Ascent of Arceuus(아르세우스의 승천)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about your plans.
Goodbye.
Hello! I'm Lorelai. Welcome to the Warriors' Guild basement!
translation: 안녕하세요! 전 Lorelai(로렐라이)예요. Warriors' Guild(전사 길드) 지하에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: What are you doing down here?
I'm training this group of special Cyclopes to be stronger and more powerful for Kamfreena.
translation: Kamfreena(캄프리나)를 위해 이 특별한 Cyclopes(사이클롭스) 무리를 더 강하고 힘세게 훈련시키고 있어요.

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
They have a chance of dropping a new, more powerful defender. Kamfreena doesn't want just anyone getting their hands on one so she moved them down here and tasked me with training them.
translation: 이 녀석들은 더 강력한 새 defender(디펜더)를 떨어뜨릴 확률이 있거든요. Kamfreena(캄프리나)는 아무나 그걸 손에 넣는 걸 원치 않아서, 이 녀석들을 이 아래로 옮기고 저한테 훈련을 맡겼어요.

english: With a punishing routine of combat, fighting and the odd death!
translation: 전투, 싸움, 그리고 가끔은 죽음까지 곁들인 혹독한 훈련으로요!

english: So, you just let them fight each other and hope they get stronger?
translation: 그러니까, 그냥 서로 싸우게 두고 강해지길 바라는 거예요?

english: Of course not, that would just be cruel! Kamfreena and I only allow the most worthy of adventurers to fight these cyclopes.
translation: 당연히 아니죠, 그건 너무 잔인하잖아요! Kamfreena(캄프리나)와 저는 가장 자격 있는 모험가들만 이 cyclopes(사이클롭스)와 싸우게 해요.

english: I am a mighty adventurer! Can I fight them?
translation: 저는 강력한 모험가예요! 제가 싸워도 돼요?

english: You'll need to display your skills as a Warrior before I can allow you to enter the room.
translation: 방에 들어가게 해 드리려면 먼저 Warrior(전사)로서의 실력을 보여 주셔야 해요.

english: How can I do that?
Bring me a Rune Defender and I shall unlock the door for you, this shows me you have dedicated enough time to fighting the Cyclops upstairs.
translation: Rune Defender(룬 디펜더)를 가져오시면 문을 열어 드릴게요. 그러면 위층에서 Cyclops(사이클롭스)와 충분히 오래 싸웠다는 증거가 되니까요.

english: I have a Rune Defender here, please let me in!
translation: 여기 Rune Defender(룬 디펜더)가 있어요, 들여보내 주세요!

english: And the Wise Old Man is my Dad... come back when you have the Rune Defender!
translation: 네, 그럼 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)은 우리 아빠고요... Rune Defender(룬 디펜더)를 가지고 다시 오세요!

english: Very well, I've unlocked the door but you'll still need 100 tokens from upstairs before you can enter as well as 10 for every minute you want to stay inside. Have fun in there!
translation: 좋아요, 문은 열어 드렸지만 들어가시려면 위층에서 얻은 token(토큰) 100개가 필요하고, 안에 머무르는 1분마다 10개씩 더 필요해요. 즐거운 시간 보내세요!

english: Yes, you have already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 네, 이미 저한테 실력을 증명하셨으니 문은 열려 있어요.

english: Bye!
See you around.
I see you have a worthy defender! I'll release some cyclops to help you get an upgrade. They are quite mean and strong though...
translation: 훌륭한 defender(디펜더)를 가지고 계시네요! 업그레이드를 얻으실 수 있게 cyclops(사이클롭스)를 좀 풀어 드릴게요. 그런데 꽤 사납고 힘이 세요...

english: You've already proved yourself to me, the door is unlocked.
translation: 이미 저한테 실력을 증명하셨으니 문은 열려 있어요.

english: Congratulations you've found a Dragon defender! You're welcome to go back inside and try to get more.
translation: 축하해요, Dragon defender(드래곤 디펜더)를 얻으셨네요! 원하시면 다시 들어가서 더 얻어 보셔도 돼요.

english: Your time is up, please make your way to the exit.
translation: 시간이 다 됐어요, 출구로 나가 주세요.

english: Next time, please leave as soon as your time is up.
translation: 다음부터는 시간이 다 되면 바로 나와 주세요.

english: You must keep your attack skillcape or max cape equipped to stay in the area.
translation: 이 구역에 머무르려면 attack skillcape(공격 스킬 망토)나 max cape(맥스 망토)를 계속 착용하고 있어야 해요.

english: May I claim my tokens please?
You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [number] token[s]!
Thanks!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 아쉽지만 아직 얻으신 token(토큰)이 없어요. 길드 곳곳의 활동을 해 보시면 얻을 수 있어요.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
Ahh I see you've met Rory. As a young Cyclops he's not ready for combat yet so he keeps me company.
translation: 아, Rory(로리)를 만나셨군요. 아직 어린 Cyclops(사이클롭스)라 싸울 준비가 안 돼서 제 곁에 있어 줘요.

english: What's special about these Cyclopes?
How exactly are you training them?
Can I fight them?
I have a Rune Defender here.
Bye!
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지 않아요, 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 탐험할 새 대륙이 통째로 있다니... 정말 굉장한 시대에

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있다는 얘길 엿들었어요. 조심하세요!

english: Hey, wanna buy some armour?
What have you got?
I provide items to help you keep your legs!
translation: 네 다리를 지켜 줄 물건을 팔지!

english: No, thank you.
This is just what I needed for my special secret... err... I've said too much! Take this and get out of here quickly!
translation: 이게 바로 내 특별한 비밀... 어... 말이 너무 많았군! 이거 받고 얼른 꺼져!

english: Hi! I have this money off voucher!
So I see! Unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday! Nevermind.
translation: 그렇군! 근데 안타깝게도 어제 만료됐네! 뭐, 어쩔 수 없지.

english: But I only just got it!
I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
translation: 미안하지만, 내가 해 줄 수 있는 게 없어.

english: Goodbye.
What have you got?
No, thank you.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 살인 사건을 해결하는 데 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: Hello again. How are you?
What's that? How do I chew? With my teeth of course. You humans are odd.
translation: 뭐라고요? 잘 씹으시냐고요? 당연히 이로 씹죠. 인간들은 참 이상하다니까요.

english: No, no I said HOW ARE YOU?
translation: 아니, 아니요. 잘! 지! 내! 시! 냐! 고! 요!

english: No need to shout, I'm not deaf. I'm good thank you.
translation: 소리 지를 필요 없어요, 귀 안 먹었어요. 잘 지내요, 고마워요.

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 저기, 드릴 게 있는데 넣을 공간이 없으시네요!

english: Welcome to Lowe's Archery Emporium. Do you want to see my wares?
translation: Lowe's Archery Emporium(로우의 궁술 상점)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 제 물건 좀 보시겠어요?

english: I have this voucher for completing the combat Adventure Path, it says to come talk to you about claiming my Adventure Path reward.
translation: 전투 Adventure Path(모험 경로)를 완료해서 받은 쿠폰이 있는데요, 모험 경로 보상을 받으려면 당신한테 말하라고 적혀 있어요.

english: I will be able to give you your reward when you have some space for it.
translation: 공간이 좀 생기면 보상을 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Why yes, here are some high-quality iron arrows.
translation: 그럼요, 여기 고품질 iron arrows(철 화살)을 드릴게요.

english: I do have more rewards for you, but you need to be on a members world for me to give you the reward. Maybe there is something else I can help you with.
translation: 보상이 더 있긴 한데, 드리려면 멤버 월드에 계셔야 해요. 혹시 다른 걸로 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: Since you are a member, I'll also give you extra arrows and one of my finest bows.
translation: 멤버시니까 화살을 더 드리고, 제 최고급 활도 하나 드릴게요.

english: I sell a variety of range equipment in my shop if you wanted to take a look.
translation: 제 상점에서 다양한 원거리 장비를 팔고 있으니 한번 둘러보세요.

english: Is there anything else I can do for you?
I do have more rewards for you, but you need some free space for me to give you the rewards.
translation: 보상이 더 있긴 한데, 드리려면 빈 공간이 좀 필요해요.

english: Can I help you with anything else?
Why yes, here is one of my finest bows and some high- quality iron arrows.
translation: 그럼요, 여기 제 최고급 활 하나와 고품질 iron arrows(철 화살)예요.

english: No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 아뇨, 저는 가까이서 두들겨 패는 게 좋아요.

english: Humph, philistine.
Here you go!
Yes, please.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
translation: 아뇨, 저는 가까이서 두들겨 패는 게 좋아요.

english: Watch where you're going, young whippersnapper!
translation: 어딜 보고 다니는 게냐, 이 까불이 녀석아!

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 전 아무 데도 안 가고 있었는데요...

english: Well then go away from here!
What's a whippersnapper?
It's a whip. Which snaps. Like me. Now leave!
I am Lubufu - the only fisherman who knows the secret of the Karambwan!
translation: 난 Lubufu(루부푸)다. Karambwan(카람브완)의 비밀을 아는 유일한 어부지!

english: What's a Karambwan?
What a foolish question! Now leave!
I said go away!
Ok, I'm going...
You deceived me you confoundering dolt! Because of you, my entire business is ruined! Get out of my sight!
translation: 날 속였구나, 이 지독한 얼간이 같으니! 너 때문에 내 장사가 다 망했어! 내 눈앞에서 사라져!

english: I wasn't going anywhere...
translation: 전 아무 데도 안 가고 있었는데요...

english: What's a whippersnapper?
Who are you?
Hello there.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: 안녕하세요. 도둑질하기 딱 좋은 날이죠, 안 그래요?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: 그런 것 같네요. 저한테서 훔칠 생각만 아니라면요.

english: *whistle*
I could do with some information on houses.
I'd better get going.
I thought I killed you?!
Ha! Ha! Ha!
You can not kill me human!
translation: 네놈은 날 죽일 수 없다, 인간!

english: I've lost the pendant you gave me.
Have another, it will remind you of my power!
translation: 하나 더 가져가라. 내 힘을 상기시켜 줄 것이다!

english: Hi! I'm Lucy. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: 안녕하세요! 전 Lucy(루시)예요. Party Room(파티 룸)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: One beer please Lucy!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! That's two gold please.
I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! As part of the birthday bash, you get your first 2 beers free!
translation: 바로 나갑니다, [sir/ma'am]! 생일 파티 기념으로 처음 두 잔은 공짜예요!

english: Lucy has given you a beer.
You have 1 free beer left from either me or Megan!
translation: 저나 Megan(메건)한테서 받을 수 있는 공짜 맥주가 1잔 남았어요!

english: That's your last free beer [username]!
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm cutting down maple trees for their wood. It's a living.
translation: 단풍나무를 베어 목재를 얻고 있습니다. 그걸로 먹고살지요.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 왕국 백성들이 저를 얼마나 지지하는지 알려 줄래요?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 창고가 가득 찼습니다, 전하. Advisor Ghrim(고문 그림)에게 말씀하셔서 저희가 모은 것을 받아 가십시오.

english: Thanks!
Hello?
Moooooo.
Hey, I know you can talk!
translation: 이봐요, 말할 줄 아는 거 다 알아요!

english: Moooo.
Stop ignoring me!
Look, mate. Leave me alone!
translation: 이봐, 친구. 날 좀 내버려 둬!

english: You talked! You talked!
I think I'll have some beef tonight.
I lost that amulet you gave me.
Not to worry. I found it again.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 제가 다시 찾아 뒀어요.

english: However, you'll need to make space for it before I can give it to you.
translation: 그런데 제가 드리기 전에 그걸 넣을 자리를 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Thanks. I'll try not to lose it this time.
Any time.
Greetings, adventurer. I am Phileas, the Lumbridge Guide. I am here to give information and directions to new players. Is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 반가워요, 모험가님. 저는 Lumbridge Guide(럼브리지 안내원) Phileas(필리어스)예요. 새로 온 플레이어들에게 정보와 길 안내를 해 드리고 있죠. 뭐 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: Where can I find a quest to go on?
translation: 할 만한 퀘스트는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: I'm afraid I can't think of any more quests for you. Don't worry though, there'll be plenty more out there. You'll just need to find them.
translation: 안타깝지만 더 이상 알려 드릴 퀘스트가 떠오르지 않네요. 그래도 걱정 마세요. 세상엔 아직 퀘스트가 잔뜩 있을 거예요. 직접 찾아내기만 하면 돼요.

english: Is there anything else you need help with?
Yes please.
No thank you.
Well, I've heard my friend the cook is in need of a spot of help. He'll be in the kitchen of this here castle. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
translation: 음, 제 친구 요리사가 도움이 좀 필요하다고 들었어요. 이 성의 부엌에 있을 거예요. 말을 걸어 보면 할 일을 알려 줄 거예요.

english: Well, I heard that Father Aereck could use a hand. You'll find him in the church just here. Talk to him and he'll give you the details.
translation: 음, Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)님이 일손이 필요하다고 들었어요. 바로 여기 교회에 계실 거예요. 말을 걸어 보면 자세한 내용을 알려 주실 거예요.

english: Well, I heard that a chap called Veos needs help finding some treasure. Last I heard, he was looking for assistance in the pub just north of here. Talk to him and see if you can help.
translation: 음, Veos(베오스)라는 친구가 보물 찾는 걸 도와줄 사람을 구한다고 들었어요. 마지막으로 듣기로는 여기서 바로 북쪽에 있는 술집에서 도와줄 사람을 찾고 있었대요. 말을 걸어서 도와줄 수 있는지 알아보세요.

english: Well, I heard that Farmer Fred could use some help. You'll find him on the farm just north of here. Talk to him and see if he needs a hand.
translation: 음, Farmer Fred(농부 프레드)가 도움이 필요하다고 들었어요. 여기서 바로 북쪽에 있는 농장에 있을 거예요. 말을 걸어서 일손이 필요한지 알아보세요.

english: Well, I heard there was some commotion in the swamp to the south. Might be worth looking into.
translation: 음, 남쪽 늪에서 뭔가 소동이 있었다고 들었어요. 알아볼 만할 거예요.

english: Well, I believe the Duke of Lumbridge requires an errand running for him. You can find him upstairs in the castle. Just talk to him to get the details.
translation: 음, Duke of Lumbridge(럼브리지 공작)님이 심부름할 사람을 찾으신다고 들었어요. 성 위층에 계세요. 말씀을 나눠 보면 자세한 내용을 알려 주실 거예요.

english: I heard you were already helping the cook. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 요리사를 돕고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I heard you were already helping Father Aereck. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)님을 돕고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I heard you were already helping Veos. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 Veos(베오스)를 돕고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I heard you were already helping Farmer Fred. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 Farmer Fred(농부 프레드)를 돕고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I heard you were already investigating the issue in the swamp. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 늪에서 일어난 일을 조사하고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I heard you were already helping the Duke. Are you sure you need another quest?
translation: 이미 Duke(공작)님을 돕고 계신다고 들었는데요. 정말 퀘스트가 더 필요하세요?

english: I want another quest.
I’m not too sure what to do.
Well if you need a reminder, try having a look at your quest journal.
translation: 음, 잊어버리셨다면 퀘스트 일지를 한번 확인해 보세요.

english: Actually, I’m fine.
Actually, I'm fine.
What monsters should I fight?
It's going to be tough fighting monsters without a weapon. I suggest you find one of those first.
translation: 무기 없이 몬스터와 싸우기는 힘들 거예요. 먼저 무기부터 하나 구하시길 권해요.

english: How can I get a weapon?
Well you can either make them, find them or buy them.
translation: 음, 직접 만들거나, 찾아내거나, 사면 돼요.

english: Where can I find a weapon?

If you visit the combat tutors south of the general store they may be able to help you with that. Failing that there are a few cheap weapons lying around in the world. For example, you can get an iron dagger if you
translation: 잡화점 남쪽에 있는 전투 교사들을 찾아가면 도와줄지도 몰라요. 그게 안 되면 세상 곳곳에 싸구려 무기가 몇 개 굴러다녀요. 예를 들어

english: cross the bridge and look in the little hut where some goblins live. If it's not there it probably means someone else has taken it. If you wait a while a new one should appear. As you explore you may find other weapons,
translation: 다리를 건너 goblin(고블린)들이 사는 작은 오두막을 뒤져 보면 iron dagger(철 단검)을 구할 수 있어요. 없다면 아마 다른 사람이 가져간 거예요. 좀 기다리면 새로 생길 거예요. 돌아다니다 보면 다른 무기도

english: too.
I'd like to know about something else.
Well, what would you like to know?
How do I make a weapon?
You already have a reasonable Smithing level, so I think you know that already.
translation: 이미 Smithing(대장일) 레벨이 꽤 되시니까 그건 벌써 알고 계실 것 같네요.

english: The Smithing skill allows you to make armour and weapons. Talk to the boy who smelts metal in the furnace, I'm sure he can help.
translation: Smithing(대장일) 스킬로 갑옷과 무기를 만들 수 있어요. furnace(용광로)에서 금속을 제련하는 소년에게 말을 걸어 보세요. 분명 도와줄 거예요.

english: Where can I smith?
You will find a helpful Smithing tutor in the west of Varrock - that's north of here. Follow the path across the river and head north.
translation: Varrock(바록) 서쪽에 친절한 Smithing tutor(대장일 교사)가 있어요. 여기서 북쪽이에요. 길을 따라 강을 건넌 다음 북쪽으로 가세요.

english: I suggest you go and mine some ore; find the Mining symbol - with the guide symbol near it - in the swamp south of here. The Mining guide there can teach you how to mine ore.
translation: 먼저 가서 광석을 좀 캐 보세요. 여기 남쪽 늪에서 Mining(채광) 상징과 그 옆의 안내원 상징을 찾아보세요. 거기 있는 채광 안내원이 광석 캐는 법을 가르쳐 줄 거예요.

english: Where can I buy a weapon?

You can get a weapon free from the combat tutors if they think you need it. Failing that, the nearest shop that would sell you something of that nature is Bob's Brilliant Axes in this very town. If you want a bigger
translation: 전투 교사들이 필요하다고 생각하면 무기를 공짜로 줄 거예요. 그게 안 되면 그런 물건을 파는 가장 가까운 가게는 바로 이 마을에 있는 Bob's Brilliant Axes(밥의 멋진 도끼)예요. 더 다양한 물건을

english: choice I suggest you head to one of the big cities. If you follow the road east over the bridge and then head north you will eventually reach Varrock, where you can buy all manner of things. You can use the world map
translation: 원하시면 큰 도시로 가 보세요. 동쪽 길을 따라 다리를 건넌 다음 북쪽으로 가면 결국 Varrock(바록)에 닿는데, 거기선 온갖 물건을 살 수 있어요. 길을 찾을 땐 세계 지도를

english: to help you find your way.
Could I get a staff like yours?
translation: 저도 그런 지팡이를 가질 수 있을까요?

english: There is no other staff like this in all the land. It's a very important staff. It shows who holds the job as the Lumbridge Guide, and that's me.
translation: 이런 지팡이는 온 세상에 이것 하나뿐이에요. 아주 중요한 지팡이죠. 누가 Lumbridge Guide(럼브리지 안내원)을 맡고 있는지 보여 주는 물건인데, 그게 바로 저예요.

english: Yes, but what should I fight once I have got a weapon?
translation: 네, 그런데 무기를 구하면 뭘 상대해야 해요?

english: There's lots of beasts to fight in the woods around here, especially to the west. There are certainly some goblins and spiders that are pests and could do with being cleared out. There's also a chicken farm or two up the
translation: 이 근처 숲에는 싸울 만한 짐승이 많아요. 특히 서쪽에요. goblin(고블린)과 거미는 확실히 골칫거리라 좀 소탕해 주면 좋겠어요. 길을 따라 조금만 가면 닭 농장도 한두 군데 있는데

english: road for some fairly easy pickings. Non-player characters usually appear as yellow dots on your minimap, although there are some that you won't be able to fight, such as myself. A monster's combat level is
translation: 꽤 쉬운 사냥감이에요. NPC는 보통 미니맵에 노란 점으로 표시되지만, 저처럼 싸울 수 없는 NPC도 있어요. 몬스터의 전투 레벨은

english: shown next to their 'Attack' option. If that level is coloured green it means the monster is weaker than you. If it is red, it means that the monster is tougher than you.
translation: 'Attack(공격)' 선택지 옆에 표시돼요. 레벨이 초록색이면 그 몬스터가 당신보다 약하다는 뜻이고, 빨간색이면 당신보다 강하다는 뜻이에요.

english: Remember, you will do better if you have better armour and weapons and it's always worth carrying a bit of food to heal yourself.
translation: 기억하세요, 좋은 갑옷과 무기가 있으면 더 잘 싸울 수 있고, 체력을 회복할 음식을 조금 챙겨 다니는 것도 언제나 도움이 돼요.

english: Where can I get food to heal myself?
There are many different foods in the game such as cabbage, fish, meat and many more. Which do you wish to hear about?
translation: 게임에는 cabbage(양배추), 물고기, 고기 등 여러 가지 음식이 있어요. 어떤 걸 알려 드릴까요?

english: How do I get cabbages?
There is a field a little distance to the north of here packed full of cabbages which are there for the picking.
translation: 여기서 조금 북쪽에 양배추가 가득한 밭이 있는데, 마음껏 뽑아 가도 돼요.

english: You could also farm your own cabbages; there's a Farming patch just south of Falador.
translation: 양배추를 직접 기를 수도 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 바로 남쪽에 Farming patch(농사 밭)이 있거든요.

english: No thank you.
How do I fish?
I am confused. You are already an experienced fisher. You should know the answer to that already.
translation: 이상하네요. 이미 노련한 어부이시잖아요. 그건 벌써 알고 계셔야죠.

english: Fishing spots require different levels and equipment to use. To start Fishing, you'll want to talk to the Fishing tutor who can be found in the swamps south of here. He will also give you a small fishing net if you don't
translation: 낚시터마다 필요한 레벨과 장비가 달라요. Fishing(낚시)를 시작하려면 여기 남쪽 늪에 있는 Fishing tutor(낚시 교사)와 이야기해 보세요. 아직 small fishing net(작은 낚시 그물)이

english: own one already.
Where could I find one of those?

You can get them from a Fishing shop or our Fishing Tutor south of here in the swamp. There is a Fishing shop in Port Sarim; you can find it on the world map. Port Sarim is some way to the west of here, beyond
