I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: Oak table(참나무 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak shelf built.
translation: Oak shelf(참나무 선반)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: Oak cupboard(참나무 찬장)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.

translation: Oak small tables(작은 참나무 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

translation: Teak bed(티크 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

translation: Teak small tables(작은 티크 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

translation: Mahogany table(마호가니 식탁)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

translation: Mahogany shelf(마호가니 선반)을 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany small tables built.
translation: Mahogany small tables(작은 마호가니 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하시겠어요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 맛있는 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?
translation: Group of Advanced Gardeners(고급 정원사 모임)의 회원이세요?

english: Why, yes I am. Why do you ask?
Martin has asked me to investigate why all the crops are failing.
translation: Martin(마틴) 씨가 작물이 다 시드는 이유를 조사해 달라고 하셨거든요.

english: No, I'm afraid I don't know anything about that.
translation: 아뇨, 미안하지만 그 일에 대해선 아는 게 없어요.

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
I might - which patch were you thinking of?
translation: 그럴 수도 있죠. 어느 밭을 생각하고 계세요?

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭엔 씨앗을 하나도 안 심으셨잖아요. 뭐라도 심으면 돌봐 드릴지도 몰라요.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 이미 다 자랐어요! 저보고 뭘 어떻게 하라는 건지 모르겠네요!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 그 밭은 죽었어요. 이제 와서 제가 손쓰기엔 너무 늦었어요.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!.
translation: 그 밭은 병들었어요. 저한테 맡기기 전에 먼저 치료부터 하셔야죠!.

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 무슨 말씀이신지 모르겠네요. 그 밭은 이미 제가 돌봐 드리고 있잖아요.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
I want 2 buckets of compost for that.
translation: 그 대가로 buckets of compost(퇴비 양동이) 2개는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want one sack of potatoes for that.
translation: 그 대가로 sack of potatoes(감자 자루) 하나는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want one sack of onions for that.
translation: 그 대가로 sack of onions(양파 자루) 하나는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want 2 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 그 대가로 sacks of cabbages(양배추 자루) 2개는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want 10 jute fibers for that.
translation: 그 대가로 jute fibers(황마 섬유) 10개는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want one basket of apples for that.
translation: 그 대가로 basket of apples(사과 바구니) 하나는 주셔야 해요.

english: I want 10 curry leaves for that.
translation: 그 대가로 curry leaves(커리 잎) 10장은 주셔야 해요.

english: I want 5 jangerberries for that.
I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
translation: 미안하지만 지금은 그걸 하나도 안 갖고 있어요.

english: Well I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 그럼 저도 공짜로 시간 낭비할 순 없죠.

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 좋아요, [sir/madam]. 저한테 맡겨 두세요. 그 밭은 제가 꼭 잘 키워 드릴게요.

english: No, that's too much.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 덤불이나 나무의 병을 고치는 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 것뿐이에요. 다른 작물이라면 그냥 plant-cure(식물 치료제)를 뿌리겠어요.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 먼저 흙을 담은 plantpot(화분)에서 sapling(묘목)으로 키운 다음, tree patch(나무 밭)으로 옮겨 심어서 다 자랄 때까지 키워야 해요.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 채소 자루에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 열 개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 넣을 순 없어요.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어요. 상점은 텃밭 근처에 있고요.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 키울 수 있어요. 거긴 땅이 유난히 축축해서 독버섯 키우기에 딱이거든요.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 보통 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만 만드는 데 돈이 더 들어요. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든요. 아이템을 보여 주시면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 드릴게요.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 키우는 특별한 밭이 있어요. 아마 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처 어딘가일 거예요. 그 동네 땅은 좀 '부정한' 땅이거든요.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 compost(퇴비)를 주면 작물이 병에 걸릴 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라, 수확할 작물도 더 많아져요.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 과일나무를 키우고 싶으시면 몇 군데 가 보세요. Catherby(캐서비), Brimhaven(브림헤이븐), Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새), Farming Guild(농사 길드)에 전부 과일나무 밭이 있어요.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 plantpot(화분)을 채울 수 있어요.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일 빚는 데 좋아요. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다던데, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 그런 걸로 유명했다는 소문을 들었어요. 물론 거기 사람들이 다 죽기 전 얘기지만요.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 계속 물을 줘야 해요. 제 조언을 무시하셨다간 머지않아 죽어 버린 농사 밭을 떠안게 될 거예요.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 과일 바구니에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 다섯 개까지 담을 수 있어요. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없어요.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭을 갈퀴질하고 나온 weeds(잡초)를 그냥 버리지 마세요. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만드세요.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 이런 Farming(농사) 구역은 여기 말고도 다섯 군데가 더 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단타에라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역이에요.

english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 이런 Farming(농사) 구역은 여기 말고도 다섯 군데가 더 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단타에라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역, 그리고 Oswallt(오스왈트)의

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 자루나 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶으시면 Falador(팔라도르)의 농사 상점 근처에 있는 loom(베틀)을 쓰셔야 해요. 물론 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman](이)라면 말이에요.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: plantpot(화분)을 전부 사실 필요는 없어요. pottery wheel(도자기 물레)에서 직접 만들 수도 있거든요. 물론 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman](이)라면 말이에요.

english: Can you sell me something?
That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 제가 팔 물건이 있느냐에 따라 다르죠. 뭘 찾고 계세요?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: plant cure(식물 치료제) 말이죠? 제가 쓰려고 따로 챙겨 둔 게 좀 있을 거예요. 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 식물 치료제를 25코인에 팔게요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: bucket of compost(퇴비 한 양동이) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 35코인에 팔게요.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: rake(갈퀴) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔게요.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 음, plant pot(화분) 하나쯤은 내드릴 수 있겠지만, 40코인은 받아야겠어요.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: watering can(물뿌리개) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 25코인에 팔게요.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔게요.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: seed dibber(씨앗 구멍 막대) 말이죠? 남는 게 하나 있을 거예요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔게요.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 됐어요, 제가 필요한 건 하나도 없네요.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 사실, 그건 못 들고 다닐 것 같아요.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 괜찮아요, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 살 수 있어요.

english: I'll come back another time.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!

Okay, it's a deal.

english: I'll come back another time.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 와, Hero(영웅)님이시잖아요! 대단해요, 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 상대하신 거예요? 마을도 정말 근사해졌어요, 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm a little ill. My wife looks after me though. I help as much as I'm able, but as you can see, I'm bed ridden. Hopefully I'll get better soon.
translation: 제가 몸이 좀 안 좋아요. 아내가 저를 돌봐 주고 있죠. 할 수 있는 만큼은 돕지만, 보시다시피 침대에서 일어나질 못해요. 곧 나아지면 좋겠어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요, 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyre(뱀파이어)들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 근근이 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 시설도 갖춰서 정말 큰 도움이 되고 있고, 다들 정말 고마워하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만,

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 아마 대부분의 사람들이 보기에도 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게. 자격을 갖춘 모양이군. 우리 일을 도우러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게! 자네가 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 세 개를 얼마 전에 모두 통과한 그 학생이지? 우리 일을 도우러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 우선 장비부터 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 도구 선반에 있지. 지구과학 시험에서 배운 걸 떠올려 보게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 부츠를 착용한 채로,

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔)을 갖고 있어야 하네.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 정말로 도와줄 생각이라면, 출토품 손질을 좀 해 주게. 거의 다 끝났고 마무리만 섬세하게 하면 되네. 인부들이 가져다 놓는 더미에서 출토품을 하나 집어 들고, 저쪽에 빈 탁자가 있으니

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 거기서 손질하면 되네. 흥미로운 게 나오면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 우리가 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 흥미롭군...그래...그래...흐음.... 마법이 걸려 있는 것 같네.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 오, 그냥 해롭지 않은 순간이동 주문인 것 같네. 고고학을 하지 않을 때는 마법을 조금 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있네. 그 시절에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍구먼.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠...여러 정황으로 보아 여기서 동쪽 어딘가인 것 같은데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠네. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었을지도 모르지. 좀 더 자세히 살펴보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고 fire runes(화염 룬) 다섯 개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 한 개로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거네요.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 그래, 바로 그걸세. 잘했네, 젊은이. 도와줘서 고맙네.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 손질했는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 오, 이런! 정말 멋진 발견일세! 내 생각이 맞다면, 이걸로 Dig Site(발굴지) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠네.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여기 보게, 도시 이름도 새겨져 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! 분명 Saradominist(사라도민파)가 점령하던 시기일 걸세. 정말 훌륭한 발견이로군. 이걸 가져가서 45번 display case(진열장)에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 45번 display case(진열장)에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 전에도 하나 보여 줬잖나. 그때 것이 상태가 더 좋았지. 저기 진열장에 있네. 이건 구석에 있는 출토품 crate(나무 상자)에 넣어 두게.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 동전을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이건 아주 흥미롭군...그러면서도 헷갈리는구먼. 이 동전을 보면 우리가 발굴지에서 파고 있는 도시, Saranthium(사란시움)에는 훨씬, 훨씬 이전에 Zamorak(자모락)의 추종자들이 살았다는 뜻이 되네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 그 시절 이 도시는 Senntisten(센티스텐)이라고 불렸지.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견일세. Saradominist(사라도민파)가 차지하기 전에 Zarosian(자로스파) 추종자들이 살았다는 증거는 이미 있지만, Zamorakian(자모락파) 세력도 어떤 전투 중에 이곳을 썼던 것으로 보이니 말이야.

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 어쨌든 이걸로 이 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 Zamorak(자모락)을 따르다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르게 된 시기를 대략 알 수 있겠네. 44번 display case(진열장)에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 44번 display case(진열장)에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 부서질 것 같은 오래된 decoration(장식)을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아아... 제단 장식품 같군. 흠, 그래...생김새를 보니 초기 Saradominist(사라도민파) 신도들이 만든 것일세. 꽤 깨지기 쉽기도 하고. 37번 display case(진열장)에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 37번 display case(진열장)에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 아주 오래된 decoration(장식)을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않나? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이군. 틀림없이 Saradominist(사라도민파) 도시 시절 것일세. 36번 display case(진열장)에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 36번 display case(진열장)에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 pottery(도자기) 조각을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 아아... 오! 흠...그래...보아하니 Zaros(자로스) 숭배자들이 만든 것이군. 모양이 아름다워. 22번 display case(진열장)에 잘 어울리겠네. 이 조각은 이 도시에

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: Saradominist(사라도민파)보다 Zarosian(자로스파)가 먼저 살았다는 우리 증거를 더 탄탄하게 해 주네.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? pottery(도자기)는 22번 display case(진열장)에 넣었나?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오는 거라 중요하지 않네. 전시품에도 이미 몇 개 있고. 문 근처에 있는 출토품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 상자 안에 이미 뭐가 들어 있으면, 수고한 대가로 가져가도 좋네.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 흥미로운 발견이군... 자, 보답으로 이걸 주겠네.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병이라... 그동안 몇 개나 나왔는지 셀 수도 없구먼... 온전한 건 하나뿐인데 그건 이미 진열장에 있네. 문 근처에 있는 출토품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
translation: 애초에 가진 적도 없는 것 같은데, [lad/lass]!

english: No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Cheryl where is our crate? We can't leave without our luggage!
translation: Cheryl(셰릴), 우리 crate(나무 상자) 어디 있어? 짐 없이는 못 떠난다고!

english: You pet the dog...
He rolls over a little bit so you can pet his belly.
translation: 개가 살짝 몸을 굴려 배를 쓰다듬게 해 준다.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
Gumbo!
Frogspawn gumbo!
Nice chewy frogspawn gumbo!
Get your frogspawn gumbo!
Fresh frogspawn gumbo!
Hello, human. Something you need?
What are you doing up here?
Why, I'm ensuring everyone stays well fed and hydrated, of course! Fighting monsters is hard work, as I'm sure you know.
translation: 아니, 당연히 다들 배부르게 먹고 물도 잘 마시게 챙기고 있죠! 괴물이랑 싸우는 건 힘든 일이잖아요. 당신도 잘 알겠지만요.

english: Say, when was the last time you drank some water?
translation: 그런데, 마지막으로 물 마신 게 언제예요?

english: Uh, I suppose I am a bit thirsty...
translation: 어, 조금 목마른 것 같기도 하네요...

english: Off you go and refresh yourself! Don't want you collapsing in front of the Hueycoatl now, do we?
translation: 어서 가서 목 좀 축이고 와요! Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀) 앞에서 쓰러지면 안 되잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: Oh, thank you! I'll make good use of this most versatile, nutritious and delicious ingredient!
translation: 어머, 고마워요! 이렇게 쓰임새 많고 영양 많고 맛있는 재료를 잘 써 볼게요!

english: Take a look at this.
Is this a joke, human?
What? No! I-
We were warned not to trust your kind, and I can see why.
translation: 당신네 종족은 믿지 말라고 하더니, 왜 그런지 알겠네요.

english: What a horrible thing to do to someone.
translation: 남한테 어떻게 이런 끔찍한 짓을 해요.

english: I didn't mean anyth-
And to mar the egg in the first place?! I'm shaken to my core!
translation: 게다가 애초에 알을 망가뜨리다니?! 정말 충격이에요!

english: I found it like this!
translation: 원래 이렇게 생긴 걸 주운 거라고요!

english: The dwarf is too busy cooking and grumbling to hear you.
translation: 드워프는 요리하랴 투덜대랴 바빠서 당신 말을 듣지 못한다.

english: Weird, isn't it? Definitely not what I would consider gourmet cooking, but to each their own...
translation: 이상하죠? 제 기준으론 절대 고급 요리라고 할 수 없지만, 뭐 사람마다 취향이 있으니까요...

english: Hello, Marla!
Hello! Something you need?
Why, I'm ensuring everyone stays well fed and hydrated, of course! Fighting monsters is hard work, as I'm sure you know.
translation: 아니, 당연히 다들 배부르게 먹고 물도 잘 마시게 챙기고 있죠! 괴물이랑 싸우는 건 힘든 일이잖아요. 당신도 잘 알겠지만요.

english: Say, when was the last time you drank some water?
translation: 그런데, 마지막으로 물 마신 게 언제예요?

english: Off you go and refresh yourself! Don't want you collapsing in front of the Hueycoatl now, do we?
translation: 어서 가서 목 좀 축이고 와요! Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀) 앞에서 쓰러지면 안 되잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: I have a request from the guard over there.
translation: 저기 있는 경비병이 부탁한 게 있어요.

english: And you are?
[player name]!
Well, [player name], what is Viero's request?
translation: 그래요, [player name] 님, Viero(비에로)가 뭘 부탁했는데요?

english: He wants to try sunlight antelope cooked with redberries.
translation: redberries(레드베리)를 곁들인 sunlight antelope(햇빛 영양) 요리를 먹어 보고 싶대요.

english: He wants what?! The altitude must be sending him loopy!
translation: 뭘 먹고 싶다고요?! 고산병 때문에 정신이 오락가락하나 봐요!

english: Ah well, he works hard and this is a rough post so I'll indulge him.
translation: 뭐, 열심히 일하는 데다 여기 근무가 고되니까 들어주죠.

english: I'll need a nice piece of raw sunlight antelope and some redberries to create the dish. Return when you have the ingredients.
translation: 요리하려면 질 좋은 raw sunlight antelope(날 햇빛 영양) 고기 한 덩이랑 redberries(레드베리)가 좀 필요해요. 재료를 구하면 다시 와요.

english: I have all the ingredients here.
Okay, let's see...
Perhaps it would work best as a berry marinade...
translation: 베리 마리네이드로 하는 게 제일 좋으려나...

english: Or maybe a delicate jus...
Marla concentrates intently as she works with the ingredients.
translation: Marla(말라)가 재료를 다루며 온 정신을 집중한다.

english: That should do it... I think. It smells pretty good, but I'm not convinced. See what Viero thinks.
translation: 이 정도면 될 거예요... 아마도요. 냄새는 꽤 좋은데, 확신은 안 서네요. Viero(비에로)가 어떻게 생각하는지 들어 봐요.

english: No, never mind.
Hello, [player name]! Looking for something to eat?
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님! 먹을 거 찾아요?

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Suit yourself.
Viero thought the redberry antelope was 'interesting and complex'.
translation: Viero(비에로)가 redberry antelope(레드베리 영양) 요리가 '흥미롭고 복합적'이래요.

english: Hah! That's certainly one way to put it!
translation: 하! 그렇게 돌려 말할 수도 있겠네요!

english: What are you doing up here?
I have a request from the guard over there.
translation: 저기 있는 경비병이 부탁한 게 있어요.

english: No, never mind.
I need another redberry antelope.
translation: redberry antelope(레드베리 영양) 요리 하나 더 필요해요.

english: I'm fine, thanks.
Viero thought the redberry antelope was 'interesting and complex'.
translation: Viero(비에로)가 redberry antelope(레드베리 영양) 요리가 '흥미롭고 복합적'이래요.

english: Hello there!
He doesn't seem too interested in talking to you.
translation: 당신과 별로 이야기하고 싶지 않은 모양이다.

english: Hey there. Would you happen to be Marley?
I could be. Depends on who's asking? If you're with the Varrock City Guard, I had nothing to do with the robbery at the museum. I don't even know what I'd do with some Wizard robes.
translation: 그럴 수도 있고요. 누가 묻느냐에 달렸죠? Varrock(바록) 도시 경비대에서 나왔다면, 박물관 도난 사건이랑 저는 아무 상관 없어요. Wizard robes(마법사 로브)를 손에 넣어 봤자 뭘 하겠어요.

english: Uhm, no? What robbery? Wizard robes?
translation: 음, 아닌데요? 무슨 도난 사건이요? 마법사 로브요?

english: Robbery? Sorry [sir/miss], first I've heard of a robbery.
translation: 도난 사건이요? 죄송하지만 [sir/miss], 도난 사건 얘기는 처음 듣는데요.

english: Look, I'm not here with the city guard, Willow sent me to find you. She needs your help.
translation: 저기요, 저는 도시 경비대에서 온 게 아니에요. Willow(윌로)가 당신을 찾아오라고 보냈어요. 당신 도움이 필요하대요.

english: Willow? Hmm... I'm afraid I don't recall a Willow.
translation: Willow(윌로)요? 흠... 그런 이름은 기억이 안 나는데요.

english: Are you sure? She said you were old pals.
Nope, I'm sure. Only Willow I know of is a type of tree.
translation: 네, 확실해요. 제가 아는 Willow(윌로)라곤 나무 이름 willow(버드나무)뿐인걸요.

english: But, then again, my memory is a bit hazy, due to how hungry I am.
translation: 하지만 또 모르죠, 배가 너무 고파서 기억이 좀 흐릿하거든요.

english: You're too hungry... to remember your friend?
translation: 배가 너무 고파서... 친구도 기억이 안 난다고요?

english: Yep... been a while since I had a nice hot meal.
translation: 네... 따끈한 밥 한 끼 제대로 먹어 본 지가 꽤 됐네요.

english: *Sighs*... would you like me to get you something to eat, to help jog your memory?
translation: *한숨*... 기억 좀 돌아오게 먹을 거라도 갖다드릴까요?

english: Oh what a kind offer! I couldn't say no.
translation: 오, 이렇게 친절할 수가! 거절할 수가 없네요.

english: Fine, I'll be back in a...
Woah woah woah, hold your horses there friend! I can't just eat anything. I have very specific dietary requirements.
translation: 워워워, 잠깐만요, 친구! 아무거나 먹을 순 없어요. 제가 식성이 아주 까다롭거든요.

english: Don't be like that! I don't want nothing fancy, just a Steak sandwich from the Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock.
translation: 그런 표정 짓지 마요! 거창한 거 바라는 거 아니에요. Varrock(바록)에 있는 Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관)의 Steak sandwich(스테이크 샌드위치) 하나면 돼요.

english: Why don't you go and get one then?
translation: 그럼 직접 가서 사 오시지 그래요?

english: Slight problem there, friend. I've been barred and the chef won't make me another one. Something about stealing from punters. I can't remember...
translation: 그게 좀 곤란해요, 친구. 출입 금지를 당해서 요리사가 다시는 안 만들어 준대요. 손님들 물건을 훔쳤다나 뭐라나. 기억이 안 나네요...

english: *Sighs*... Fine. If I go get you this sandwich, will you help Willow?
translation: *한숨*... 알았어요. 제가 샌드위치를 가져오면 Willow(윌로)를 도와주실 거죠?

english: Of course! Oh, by the way, don't bother with the bartender. Just talk to the chef. Trust me.
translation: 물론이죠! 아, 그리고 바텐더한테는 말 걸 필요 없어요. 요리사한테 바로 가요. 제 말 믿어요.

english: Alright. I'll be back momentarily with your sandwich.
Have you got the sandwich yet?
I'm still working on it. Where did you say you got them from?
The Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock. They have the best cook around!
translation: Varrock(바록)에 있는 Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관)이요. 거기 요리사가 최고라니까요!

english: I'll go speak to them, then.
So I spoke with the Chef.
Excellent! So you have my sandwich? Pass it over.
translation: 잘됐네요! 그럼 샌드위치 가져왔어요? 이리 줘요.

english: Well, slight issue there... He said he'll never make you another sandwich again.
translation: 음, 그게 좀 문제가 있어요... 다시는 당신한테 샌드위치를 안 만들어 주겠대요.

english: Oh... bit of an overreaction, in my opinion.
translation: 아... 제가 보기엔 좀 과민 반응인데요.

english: But he did give me the recipe to make them.
Well what are you waiting for? Go and make one then!
translation: 그럼 뭘 꾸물대요? 얼른 가서 하나 만들어 와요!

english: Hey Marley. I've managed to get your Steak sandwich.
translation: Marley(말리) 씨, Steak sandwich(스테이크 샌드위치) 구해 왔어요.

english: Ah, just in time for my afternoon snack. Pass it over.
translation: 아, 딱 오후 간식 시간에 맞춰 왔네요. 이리 줘요.

english: You give the steak sandwich to Marley.
Marley eats the steak sandwich.
Aaah... not quite as good as the usual, but it hit the spot.
translation: 아아... 평소 먹던 것만은 못하지만, 그럭저럭 배는 채웠네요.

english: Are you finally done?
Yes [sir/miss] I am. I'll honour my side of the deal and head off to find Willow.
translation: 네, [sir/miss], 다 먹었어요. 약속은 지켜야죠. Willow(윌로)를 찾으러 가 볼게요.

english: Finally! You can find her on the west side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 드디어! Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 서쪽에 가면 만날 수 있어요.

english: Excellent! I'll be on my way then.
Screen fades to black and Marley disappears.
Marley is certainly an interesting character. Hopefully the next team member is more respectable.
translation: Marley(말리)는 확실히 별난 사람이야. 다음 팀원은 좀 더 점잖은 사람이면 좋겠는데.

english: Hello again Marley.
Ah, my new favourite chef. Have you got another sandwich for me?
translation: 아, 제 새 단골 요리사님이시네. 샌드위치 또 가져왔어요?

english: No!
Woah! Alright there, calm down. Was only a joke.
I don't find being your errand [boy/girl] very funny.
translation: 당신 심부름꾼[boy/girl] 노릇 하는 건 하나도 안 웃기거든요.

english: You need to lighten up a little, my friend.
That's everyone gathered. Interesting company for an archaeologist to keep...
translation: 이제 다 모였네요. 고고학자치곤 어울리는 사람들이 참 특이하네요...

english: *Shrugs* How many archaeologists do you actually know?
translation: *어깨를 으쓱* 너 아는 고고학자가 몇 명이나 되는데?

english: Well I-
Exactly. So who are you to judge? Anyway, we're all here and ready to break in... Um, I mean excavate... the entrance.
translation: 거봐. 그러니 네가 뭘 판단해? 어쨌든 다 모였으니 입구를 털... 아니, 발굴할 준비는 끝났어.

english: Are you ready? Who knows what's inside the ruins?
translation: 준비됐어? 저 폐허 안에 뭐가 있을지 누가 알겠어?

english: I'm ready as I'll ever be. Let's head in.
Fade into the cutscene of Willow setting the plan in motion.
translation: Willow(윌로)가 계획을 실행에 옮기는 컷신으로 전환된다.

english: Right, that's everyone gathered. Thank you, [player name], for all your help.
translation: 좋아, 다 모였네. [player name], 이것저것 도와줘서 고마워.

english: Oh it was no pro...
Okay everyone, we've wasted enough time. Let's crack this door open. Burntof, you're up!
translation: 자, 다들, 시간 낭비는 충분히 했어. 이 문을 열어 보자고. Burntof(번토프), 네 차례야!

english: Try not to blow the entire mountain up this time...
translation: 이번엔 산을 통째로 날려 버리지 말고...

english: Yesh ma'am, let'sh get this rock out the way.
translation: 예이, 대장니임, 이 바위 싹 치워 버리쟈구.

english: Burntof walks up to the door and plants his explosive and fade out.
translation: Burntof(번토프)가 문으로 걸어가 폭약을 설치하고 화면이 어두워진다.

english: Jusht got to plashe thish here...
... little bit of dyn-*hic*-amite here...
... and there we go!
Now we light the fushe!
Fade in to the explosive about to go off and everyone running away.
translation: 폭약이 터지기 직전, 모두가 도망치는 장면으로 전환된다.

english: What are you doin' standin' there?!
What do you mean?
Everyone'sh ran for cover [lad/lass]. You'd best do the shame.
translation: 다들 숨었쟈나, [lad/lass]. 너도 얼른 숨는 게 좋을 거여.

english: Wait, what?!
Clock'sh ticking [lad/lass]!
There are explosions at the door. Fade out.
Fade in to a broken door blocked with debris
translation: 잔해로 막힌 부서진 문이 보이며 화면이 밝아진다

english: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!
That was a tad too explosive I think.
My ears are still ringing!
Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?
translation: 징징대지 말어, 일은 했쟈너, 안 그려?

english: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.
translation: 맞는 말이야, 바위는 부서졌으니까. Checkal(체칼), 네 차례야.

english: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
Checkal picks up and removes all of the debris. Fade out.
translation: Checkal(체칼)이 잔해를 모두 들어 치운다. 화면이 어두워진다.

english: Checkal sets to work clearing out the rubble...
Fade in.
The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.
translation: 작업이 끝났습니다, Willow(윌로) 님. 너무 오래 걸렸다면 죄송합니다.

english: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.
translation: 미안해할 거 없어, Checkal(체칼). 그 근육을 어디엔가는 써먹어야지.

english: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.
translation: 좋아, Marley(말리), 들어가. 뭐 찾으면 알려 주고.

english: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].
translation: 그래요, 들어갑니다. 행운을 빌어 줘요, [player name].

english: Try not to die...
Fade out, then in to the inside of the dungeon to Marley disarming traps.
translation: 화면이 어두워졌다가, Marley(말리)가 던전 안에서 함정을 해체하는 장면으로 밝아진다.

english: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.
translation: 자, 날 위해 어떤 깜짝 선물을 숨겨 놨는지 한번 볼까.

english: Hmm...
That would have been nasty.
Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
translation: 이게 다야? 여긴 좀 더 단단히 지켜지고 있을 줄 알았는데.

english: Now to disarm it...
Maybe this will work?
That got it!
Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
Fade out, then in to everyone inside of the dungeon.
translation: 화면이 어두워졌다가, 모두가 던전 안에 있는 장면으로 밝아진다.

english: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
translation: 와, 여기 정말 굉장하네요. 이런 곳이 숨겨져 있었다니 믿을 수가 없어요.

english: I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.
You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.
translation: 감탄스러워? 여긴 먼지랑 떨어진 돌덩이밖에 없는데.

english: Yaaa*hic*aawn
You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?
translation: 신나지 않으세요? 고고학자니까 이런 발견에 엄청 들뜰 줄 알았는데요?

english: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!
translation: 들떠? 뭐가 신나는데? 금이나 다이아몬드, 희귀한 보석, 잃어버린 보물 더미 같은 건 하나도 안 보이잖아!

english: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!
translation: 그래도 돈이 전부는 아니잖아요? 우리가 어쩌면 오래전에 잊힌 고대 문명의 폐허를 발견한 걸지도 모른다고요!

english: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.
translation: 당연히 돈이 전부지. 처음부터 끝까지 돈 때문이었어, 이 바보야.

english: I don't understand...
Burntof walks over to the undisturbed golem.
translation: Burntof(번토프)가 가만히 서 있는 golem(골렘) 쪽으로 걸어간다.

english: Theshe markings look familiar...
translation: 이 표식, 어디서 본 것 같은디...

english: We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.
translation: 우린 고고학자 팀이 아니야, 이 멍청아. 다음 한탕을 노리는 도굴꾼들이지.

english: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.
translation: 그러니까 지금까지 남의 보물을 찾으려고 이 폐허에 쳐들어가는 데 저를 이용한 거군요.

english: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].
translation: 그래, 그리고 넌 놀랄 만큼 쉽게 넘어왔지. 인정할게, 넌 정말 큰 도움이 됐어, [player name].

english: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.
translation: 하지만 안타깝게도 네 쓸모는 여기까지야. 널 그냥 보내 줄 순 없거든.

english: Why not?
Burntof walks away from the undisturbed golem to a different wall.
translation: Burntof(번토프)가 가만히 서 있는 골렘에게서 떨어져 다른 벽으로 걸어간다.

english: I've sheen thish before...
I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.
translation: 네가 당국에 달려가서 우리 패거리 얘기를 꼰지를 위험을 감수할 순 없어. 우린 Gielinor(길리노르)의 큰 도시 여러 곳에서 수배 중이거든.

english: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
translation: 안됐지만 넌 여기서 끝이야, [player name]. 이 폐허가 곧 네 무덤이 될 테니까.

english: Burntof walks into the centre yellow-marked stone trap.
translation: Burntof(번토프)가 노란 표시가 된 가운데 돌 함정 위로 걸어 들어간다.

english: *hic* Woops...
What was that noise?
Uh... it wasn't me!
The dungeon begins to quake, with rocks falling from the ceiling.
translation: 던전이 흔들리기 시작하고, 천장에서 돌이 떨어진다.

english: Whats happening?!
It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
The golem stands up.
Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!
translation: 맙소사, Zamorak(자모락)이시여! 저게 대체 뭐야?! Checkal(체칼), 처치해!

english: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.
translation: 저는 힘쓰는 사람이지, 싸우는 사람이 아닙니다.

english: I think we should get out of here, Willow!
You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
translation: 맞는 말이야, Marley(말리). Burntof(번토프), 우리 간다!

english: Fade out.
I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
translation: 저렇게 빨리 도망치다니 믿을 수가 없네. 이건 내가 처리해야겠어.

english: I need a little bit more time to prepare.
Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.
Wow, the desert really suits you Marley.
translation: 와, 사막이 정말 잘 어울리네요, Marley(말리) 씨.

english: [player name] my old pal! How are you doing?
translation: [player name], 내 오랜 친구! 잘 지냈어요?

english: Better now I don't have to deal with you. Enjoying life in the desert?
translation: 당신 상대 안 해도 되니까 이제 좀 살 만해요. 사막 생활은 즐거우세요?

english: Not really. I'm not suited to such harsh climates. No steak sandwiches here either...
translation: 별로요. 이렇게 험한 기후는 저랑 안 맞아요. 여긴 스테이크 샌드위치도 없고요...

english: Oh what a shame! Poor Marley's going to starve as he doesn't have anyone to make his sandwiches... So sad.
translation: 아이고 저런, 안됐네요! 불쌍한 Marley(말리) 씨, 샌드위치 만들어 줄 사람이 없어서 굶게 생겼네... 참 슬프다.

english: Tsssss...
Yes
No
Hello there.
Aye? Who's that, what do you want?
Who are you?
Marten.
Oh, straight to the point.
I got betta' things to do than waste my time talkin' to you.
translation: 너랑 노닥거리는 거보다 할 일이 쌔고 쌨거든.

english: You're rather rude aren't you?
Fine, wanna know more 'bout canoes?
translation: 알았다, 카누에 대해 더 알고 싶냐?

english: No thanks, not from you at least.
Then get out of here and stop botherin' me.
Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hahaha! Sorry mate, you'll not be able to make any canoes outta that tree there. You'll need to get a bit more skilled at the craft of Woodcuttin'.
translation: 하하하! 미안하다 친구, 너론 저기 저 나무로 카누 하나도 못 만들어. Woodcutting(벌목) 솜씨를 좀 더 길러야겠는걸.

english: But once you get a bit betta', you'll be able to make a canoe and ride the river.
translation: 그래도 실력이 좀 늘면 카누를 만들어서 강을 타고 다닐 수 있을 거다.

english: It's not 'ard mate, you just gotta chop that tree o'er there down.
translation: 어렵지 않어, 친구. 저기 저 나무를 베어 넘기기만 하면 돼.

english: Then cut it down into a canoe. So simple a gobbo could do it.
translation: 그다음에 깎아서 카누로 만들면 끝이야. 고블린도 할 수 있을 만큼 쉽지.

english: But you got no chance of turning it into a beautiful canoe.
translation: 근데 넌 그걸 멋진 카누로 만들 가망은 없어.

english: Why's that?
I can tell by lookin' at ya! You ain't a woodcutter, most you'd be able to do is sail to the next stop on a log.
translation: 척 보면 알지! 넌 나무꾼이 아니야. 기껏해야 통나무 타고 다음 정거장까지 가는 게 고작일걸.

english: Hmm, s'pose you could make a decent canoe with your skills. you'll be able to make a dugout, I reckons.
translation: 흠, 네 실력이면 그럭저럭 쓸 만한 카누는 만들겠구먼. dugout(통나무배) 정도는 만들 수 있을 거다, 아마.

english: How far will I be able to go in a dugout canoe?
translation: dugout canoe(통나무배)로는 얼마나 멀리 갈 수 있어요?

english: Err, probably about two stops before it sinks on ya.
translation: 어, 아마 두 정거장쯤 가면 가라앉을걸.

english: Could that take me back to Lumbridge?
Pah, I don't think so. You'll be lucky to make it past Varrock.
translation: 흥, 어림도 없지. Varrock(바록)만 지나가도 운 좋은 거다.

english: Well bless me axe, you're almost as good a woodchopper as meself! You'll have no issue craftin' the best of the best, the waka canoe.
translation: 이야, 내 도끼에 맹세코, 너 나무꾼 솜씨가 나랑 맞먹겠는데! 최고 중의 최고, waka canoe(와카 카누)도 문제없이 만들겠어.

english: One of those beauties can take you up further in the Wilderness. Beautiful place that.
translation: 그 녀석이면 Wilderness(황야) 깊숙이까지 갈 수 있지. 거 좋은 데야.

english: Great, thank you.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: 안녕하세요, Elena(엘레나)라는 여자분이 여기 머문다고 들었어요.

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: 네, 여기 머물렀어요. 그런데 일주일쯤 전에 돌아갈 채비를 하다가, 끝내 떠나지 못했어요.

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: 제 딸 Milli(밀리)가 서쪽 담벼락 근처에서 놀다가, 시커먼 사람들이 튀어나와서 그분을 붙잡아 가는 걸 봤대요. Milli(밀리)는 위층에 있으니 이야기해 보고 싶으면 올라가 보세요.

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
Not yet...
I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: 행운을 빌게요. 그분이 저희한테 정말 많이 베풀어 주셨거든요.

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
translation: 다행이네요. 저희를 정말 많이 도와주셨던 분이라서요.

english: Good day friend.
What's all this about?
Ah, hello and welcome. I'm Martin Holt, leader of Kourend's Royal Society. This is our little protest against the Kourend Council.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, 환영합니다. 저는 Martin Holt(마틴 홀트), Kourend(쿠렌드) 왕립 학회의 대표예요. 이건 쿠렌드 의회에 맞서는 저희의 작은 시위랍니다.

english: Pleased to meet you. I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?
translation: 만나서 반가워요. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 그런데 의회가 뭐가 문제인데요?

english: Now there's a question! I have a better one. What's right with the Council?
translation: 좋은 질문이네요! 그런데 더 좋은 질문이 있죠. 의회가 잘하는 게 뭐가 있나요?

english: I bet you didn't know that the Council was originally only temporary. After the last King died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
translation: 의회가 원래는 임시 기구였다는 거, 모르셨죠? 선왕이 돌아가신 뒤, 그분의 따님이 성년이 될 때까지만 다스리기로 되어 있었어요.

english: However, according to the Council, the King's daughter went mad. Such a wonderful convenience for them of course. With her out of the picture, the Council became permanent.
translation: 그런데 의회 말로는 왕의 따님이 미쳐 버렸대요. 그들한테는 참 편리하게도 말이죠. 따님이 물러나자 의회는 영구 기구가 되어 버렸어요.

english: Interesting. What else don't you like about the Council?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 의회의 또 어떤 점이 마음에 안 드세요?

english: Democracy! That's meant to be the big thing for the Council. Funny thing is, although they're meant to be elected by the people, the same four people have won every single election. Little odd, no?
translation: 민주주의요! 그게 의회의 큰 자랑거리죠. 그런데 웃긴 건, 국민이 뽑는다는 의원들인데 매번 선거마다 똑같은 네 사람이 당선됐다는 거예요. 좀 이상하지 않아요?

english: That is a bit suspicious, I suppose.
Indeed it is. So, do you want to join our protest?
Not right now. But thanks for the information.
translation: 지금은 괜찮아요. 그래도 알려 주셔서 고마워요.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the A Kingdom Divided quest.
translation: A Kingdom Divided(분열된 왕국) 퀘스트를 시작할 조건을 모두 갖추지 못했습니다.

english: Good to see you friend.
Hello Martin. Now here's somewhere I wouldn't have expected to find you.
translation: 안녕하세요, Martin(마틴) 씨. 여기서 뵐 줄은 생각도 못 했네요.

english: Indeed. I never thought I'd be back here.
translation: 그러게요. 저도 다시 여기 오게 될 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: So why are you here?
We won! The Council are out, and we have what Kourend really needed. We have a king!
translation: 우리가 이겼어요! 의회는 물러났고, 쿠렌드에 정말 필요했던 걸 얻었죠. 왕이 생겼어요!

english: Of course, King Artur ended up taking the throne from his father a little faster than anyone expected, so he needs plenty of guidance. That's where I come in!
translation: 물론 King Artur(아르투르 왕)이 예상보다 좀 빨리 아버지에게서 왕위를 물려받는 바람에, 조언이 많이 필요하죠. 그게 바로 제 역할이에요!

english: So you're helping to advise the King?
translation: 그럼 왕께 조언을 드리고 계신 거예요?

english: Exactly! When the people voted on Rose's Accord, they voted for the Hosidius family to become the new royal family. From a technical standpoint that means they voted for King Artur.
translation: 바로 그거예요! 사람들이 Rose's Accord(로즈 협정)에 투표했을 때, Hosidius(호시디우스) 가문을 새 왕가로 뽑았죠. 엄밀히 따지면 King Artur(아르투르 왕)을 뽑은 셈이에요.

english: But in reality it was his father they expected to rule.
translation: 하지만 실제로 사람들이 왕이 될 거라 기대한 건 그분의 아버지였죠.

english: Precisely. My job is to advise King Artur and ensure his actions have a positive impact on the people that he now rules.
translation: 맞아요. 제 일은 King Artur(아르투르 왕)께 조언을 드리고, 그분의 결정이 이제 그분이 다스리는 백성에게 좋은 영향을 주도록 하는 거예요.

english: And how's that going?
Not too bad. While he lacks experience, the King has a good heart. He wants to do the right thing, and he has the support needed to do it.
translation: 나쁘지 않아요. 경험은 부족하지만, 왕은 마음씨가 착하세요. 옳은 일을 하고 싶어 하시고, 그럴 수 있게 받쳐 주는 사람들도 있고요.

english: Mind you, he could do with listening to his mother less. She's always whispering things in his ear. She forgets that he's the one in charge, not her.
translation: 다만 어머님 말씀은 좀 덜 들으셨으면 좋겠어요. 늘 귓가에 이것저것 속삭이시거든요. 다스리는 건 아드님이지 본인이 아니라는 걸 잊으시나 봐요.

english: Still, I'm sure he just needs time to adjust. I have no doubt that under King Artur, Kourend will prosper like never before.
translation: 그래도 적응할 시간이 필요할 뿐일 거예요. King Artur(아르투르 왕) 아래에서 쿠렌드가 그 어느 때보다 번영할 거라고 믿어 의심치 않아요.

english: I'm sure you're right. See you around Martin.
translation: 분명 그러실 거예요. 또 봬요, Martin(마틴) 씨.

english: Until next time.
Only a king can right the wrongs of the Council! And only you can make that happen!
translation: 오직 왕만이 의회의 잘못을 바로잡을 수 있습니다! 그리고 그걸 이룰 수 있는 건 바로 여러분입니다!

english: How long will you keep your eyes closed? Their corruption surrounds you!
translation: 언제까지 눈을 감고 계실 겁니까? 그들의 부패가 여러분을 둘러싸고 있습니다!

english: This kingdom will never be safe while the Council rule!
translation: 의회가 다스리는 한 이 왕국은 결코 안전하지 않습니다!

english: You deserve the truth! They won't give it to you!
translation: 여러분은 진실을 알 자격이 있습니다! 그들은 결코 진실을 알려 주지 않을 겁니다!

english: The Council have wronged you! It's time to make things right!
translation: 의회는 여러분을 배신했습니다! 이제 바로잡을 때입니다!

english: Together, we can bring an end to the treachery of the Council!
translation: 함께라면 의회의 배신을 끝낼 수 있습니다!

english: The Council care only for themselves! It's time for a ruler who cares for you!
translation: 의회는 자기들만 생각합니다! 이제 여러분을 생각하는 통치자가 필요합니다!

english: Kourend is a kingdom! A kingdom needs a king, not a council!
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드)는 왕국입니다! 왕국에 필요한 건 의회가 아니라 왕입니다!

english: Democracy? What democracy? It's all a façade!
translation: 민주주의? 무슨 민주주의 말입니까? 다 겉치레일 뿐입니다!

english: People of Kourend, you have been lied to!
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드) 시민 여러분, 여러분은 속아 왔습니다!

english: You know it's sometimes funny how things work out, I lose some gold but find an item, or I lose an item and find some gold... no-one ever knows what's gone where ya know.
translation: 있잖아, 세상일 돌아가는 게 가끔 웃기단 말이지. 골드를 잃으면 물건을 줍고, 물건을 잃으면 골드를 줍고... 뭐가 어디로 갔는지는 아무도 모른다니까.

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Thieving skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 미안하다, 친구. Thieving(도둑질) 스킬을 최소 50까지 올려 오면 도와줄 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: Sorry, mate. Train up your Agility skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 미안하다, 친구. Agility(민첩) 스킬을 최소 50까지 올려 오면 도와줄 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 그 망토에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이지! 스킬 망토는 성취의 상징이야. 스킬을 통달해서 레벨 99에 오른 사람만 손에 넣을 수 있고, 그 효과도 누릴 수 있지.

english: The Cape of Thieving provides a nice boost to your chances of pickpocketing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Cape of Thieving(도둑질 망토)를 두르면 소매치기 성공률이 꽤 올라가. 또 도와줄 거 있어?

english: No thank you.
Okay... I'll be going now.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
translation: 그럴 리가 있나? 다시 확인해 봐!

english: Spot on!
Yeah I know what you mean, found anything recently?
translation: 그래, 무슨 말인지 알지. 요즘 뭐 건진 거 있어?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 그 망토에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Have you found anything recently?
No thank you.
Okay... I'll be going now.
What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Farming, isn't it incredible? It's a symbol of my ability as the finest farmer in the land and wearing it increases my herb yield!
translation: 이건 Skillcape of Farming(농사 스킬 망토)예요. 멋지지 않아요? 이 땅 최고의 농부라는 실력의 상징이고, 입고 있으면 약초 수확량도 늘어나요!

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Farming from you?
translation: Skillcape of Farming(농사 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Of course, fellow farmer. If you wear this cape you'll receive increased yields from your herbs. That'll be 99000 coins.
translation: 물론이죠, 동료 농부 양반. 이 망토를 입으면 약초 수확량이 늘어나요. 가격은 99000코인이에요.

english: I'm not paying that.
No skin off my teeth, but if you change your mind, the price will still be the same.
translation: 저야 손해 볼 거 없죠. 그래도 마음이 바뀌면 오세요. 가격은 그대로일 테니까요.

english: Sure, not many people own one.
translation: 좋아요, 이걸 가진 사람은 많지 않으니까요.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 지금 가진 돈이 모자라네요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 스킬 망토는 전부 무료 두건이 함께 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 그런 거죠. 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: That's true; us Master Farmers are a unique breed.
translation: 맞아요. 우리 Master Farmers(농사 달인)은 아주 특별한 부류죠.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 맞는 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Martin hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Martin(마틴)이 스킬 망토용 두건을 하나 더 건넨다.

english: Hello.
I can't chat right now, I have too many things to worry about.
translation: 지금은 얘기할 여유가 없어요. 걱정거리가 너무 많아서요.

english: You do not meet the requirements to start the Fairytale I - Growing Pains quest.
translation: Fairytale I - Growing Pains(동화 I - 성장통) 퀘스트를 시작할 조건을 갖추지 못했습니다.

english: Anything I can help with?
I certainly could do with some help.
translation: 안 그래도 도움이 꼭 필요하던 참이에요.

english: So tell me about your problems.
It all seemed to start about a month ago. I grow roses, you know?
translation: 모든 게 한 달쯤 전에 시작된 것 같아요. 제가 장미를 키우거든요, 아시죠?

english: Um, you seem to be getting side-tracked already.
translation: 음, 벌써 이야기가 딴 데로 새는 것 같은데요.

english: What? Oh sorry.
As I was saying about a month ago I noticed that the yield on my prize rose bushes had dropped slightly. I immediately suspected Crown Gall, a disease that can be fatal to a Mister Lincoln.
translation: 아까 말하던 대로, 한 달쯤 전에 제 자랑거리인 장미 덤불의 수확량이 조금 줄어든 걸 알아챘어요. 곧바로 Crown Gall(근두암종병)을 의심했죠. Mister Lincoln(미스터 링컨)에게는 치명적일 수도 있는 병이거든요.

english: You're not making much sense. Who's Mister Lincoln?
translation: 무슨 말인지 잘 모르겠어요. Mister Lincoln(미스터 링컨)이 누군데요?

english: Sorry, Mister Lincoln's are the variety of roses that I specialise in. None of the plants showed any other symptoms of the disease though. Then I noticed a reduced yield occurring in most of my other crops too.
translation: 미안해요, Mister Lincoln(미스터 링컨)은 제가 전문으로 키우는 장미 품종이에요. 그런데 다른 증상은 어느 식물에서도 안 보였어요. 그러다 다른 작물 대부분도 수확량이 줄어드는 걸 알게 됐죠.

english: I spoke to other gardeners that I know, and they had all noticed similar problems.
translation: 아는 다른 정원사들한테 물어봤더니, 다들 비슷한 문제를 겪고 있더라고요.

english: Vegetable patches are growing fewer vegetables, bushes are producing fewer berries and everything that is planted seems to be more prone to disease!
translation: 채소밭에선 채소가 덜 나고, 덤불엔 열매가 덜 열리고, 심는 것마다 병에 더 잘 걸리는 것 같아요!

english: You've done some farming, haven't you noticed a decrease in the amount of produce you are getting lately?
translation: 당신도 농사 좀 지어 봤죠? 요즘 수확량이 줄어든 거 못 느꼈어요?

english: Now that I think about it, you're right!
I know I am. Depressing isn't it?
No, can't say that I have.
translation: 아뇨, 딱히 그런 건 못 느꼈어요.

english: That's not very observant of you.
So what do you want me to do?
I'd like you to find out what is causing this terrible problem and to try and rectify whatever the problem is.
translation: 이 끔찍한 문제의 원인이 뭔지 알아내서, 뭐가 됐든 바로잡아 줬으면 해요.

english: Do you have any ideas where I should start?
translation: 어디서부터 시작하면 좋을지 짐작 가는 데 있어요?

english: If I were you I would start by speaking to some of the other gardeners.
translation: 저라면 다른 정원사들과 이야기해 보는 것부터 시작하겠어요.

english: This doesn't sound like something I can help with. Good luck.
translation: 제가 도울 수 있는 일은 아닌 것 같네요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
I'm not sure if I can, but I guess I have to try.
translation: 할 수 있을지 모르겠지만, 해 봐야겠죠.

english: What is the banner for?
That banner is the emblem of the Group of Advanced Gardeners. We're a loosely affiliated group of gardeners that are united in our concern for declining vegetable production.
translation: 저 깃발은 Group of Advanced Gardeners(고급 정원사 모임)의 문장이에요. 채소 생산량 감소를 걱정하는 마음으로 뭉친, 느슨한 정원사 모임이죠.

english: Err, of course you are.
Say, you're a brave adventurer, would you be interested in trying to get to the root of our woes? There would be a cash reward if you could help us.
translation: 그러고 보니 당신은 용감한 모험가잖아요. 우리 고민의 뿌리를 캐 보는 데 관심 없어요? 도와주면 현금으로 보상해 드릴게요.

english: Of course I'll help.
I'm so glad to hear it.
You don't look it.
Sorry, what was that?
Oh, nothing. Don't worry about it.
translation: 아, 아무것도 아니에요. 신경 쓰지 마세요.

english: Sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 미안하지만 전 더 중요한 일이 있어요.

english: Oh. Oh dear. Oh well, if there's nothing I can do to make you change your mind...
translation: 아. 저런. 뭐, 마음을 바꿀 방법이 없다면야...

english: No, nothing. My mind is made up.
Well come back and chat to me if you change it.
translation: 그럼 마음이 바뀌면 다시 와서 얘기해요.

english: Have you spoken to any other members of the Gardening Group yet?
translation: Gardening Group(정원사 모임)의 다른 회원들과는 이야기해 봤어요?

english: No, I haven't had a chance yet.
Well please hurry, otherwise I won't be able to make enough produce to feed my 13 children soon.
translation: 그럼 서둘러 줘요. 안 그러면 곧 우리 애들 열세 명 먹일 작물도 못 거두게 생겼어요.

english: I have spoken to one of your members and they reckon that it's the lack of rain that we've had recently.
translation: 회원 한 분과 이야기해 봤는데, 요즘 비가 안 와서 그런 거라던데요.

english: I'm afraid that can't be the problem. It never rains on the farming patches, that's why we have to water the crops.
translation: 유감이지만 그건 원인일 수가 없어요. 농사 밭에는 원래 비가 안 와요. 그래서 우리가 작물에 물을 주는 거고요.

english: Oh yeah. I hadn't thought of that.
translation: 아, 그렇네요. 그 생각은 못 했어요.

english: Go chat to some other group members. Maybe somebody has a different idea.
translation: 다른 회원들하고도 얘기해 봐요. 누군가 다른 생각을 갖고 있을지도 모르니까요.

english: Hello again, [player]. How are you getting on with solving the Gardening Group's problems?
translation: 다시 왔군요, [player]. Gardening Group(정원사 모임)의 문제는 잘 해결되고 있어요?

english: (Same as above, the player goes through what the gardeners have told them.)
translation: (위와 같이, 플레이어가 정원사들에게 들은 이야기를 차례로 전한다.)

english: To be honest I'm worried about the sort of person you let join your organisation.
translation: 솔직히 당신네 모임에 어떤 사람들을 받아 주는 건지 걱정되네요.

english: Why is that?
I've heard theories ranging from climate change to fairies from your members.
translation: 회원들한테서 기후 변화부터 요정까지 별별 이론을 다 들었거든요.

english: Hmm, that's an interesting idea. Now that I think about it that does make some sense. Yes, maybe you should talk to a fairy about it.
translation: 흠, 흥미로운 생각이네요. 생각해 보니 꽤 말이 되는 것 같기도 해요. 그래요, 요정한테 물어보는 게 좋겠어요.

english: O-kay! You're the boss, any idea which flower I should look under to find a fairy?
translation: 오-케이! 당신이 대장이니까요. 요정을 찾으려면 어느 꽃 밑을 들춰 봐야 할지 짐작 가는 거라도 있어요?

english: No, sorry, but I did hear that there were some adventurers with a similar problem in the swamps near Lumbridge. Just don't mention my name if you talk to them, they're trying to keep it a secret, but everybody
translation: 아뇨, 미안해요. 그런데 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 근처 늪에 비슷한 문제를 겪은 모험가들이 있다고 들었어요. 그 사람들과 얘기하더라도 제 이름은 꺼내지 마세요. 다들 비밀로 하려고 하거든요. 그런데 사실

english: actually knows what they're up to.
translation: 그 사람들이 뭘 꾸미는지는 다들 알아요.

english: Yes, I've spoken to them before.
translation: 네, 그 사람들이랑은 전에 얘기해 봤어요.

english: Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast or we will all go out of business.
translation: 다시 왔군요, [player]. 작물은 여전히 시들고 있어요. 빨리 어떻게 좀 해 줘요. 안 그러면 우리 다 망하게 생겼어요.

english: Don't worry, I'm working on it.
Please hurry. Things are getting dire!
translation: 서둘러 줘요. 상황이 점점 심각해지고 있어요!

english: I've solved your problems! I've returned the Fairy Queen's magical essence!
translation: 문제를 해결했어요! Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)의 마법 정수를 되찾아 줬어요!

english: What are you talking about?

The Fairy Queen was in an enchanted sleep, because the Tanglefoot had taken the secateurs that contained her magic. I fought and killed it the Tanglefoot and have given the Godfather the Fairy Queen's secateurs. She'll
translation: Tanglefoot(탱글풋)이 여왕의 마력이 담긴 전지가위를 가져가는 바람에 Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)이 마법의 잠에 빠져 있었어요. 제가 탱글풋과 싸워서 해치우고, Godfather(대부)에게 요정 여왕의 전지가위를 건넸어요. 이제 여왕이

english: wake up now and everything will get back to normal.
translation: 깨어나면 모든 게 원래대로 돌아올 거예요.

english: I'm glad to hear it, but if you don't mind I'll go and plant some seeds now and wait until they grow before I give you the reward that I promised.
translation: 그렇다니 다행이네요. 그래도 괜찮다면 지금 씨앗을 좀 심고, 그게 자라는 걸 본 다음에 약속한 보상을 드릴게요.

english: I guess it does sound rather far-fetched. Ok, I'll come back and see you after your crops have had a chance to grow.
translation: 좀 황당하게 들리긴 하겠네요. 좋아요, 작물이 자랄 시간이 좀 지나면 다시 올게요.

english: Great! I'll see you soon then.
So, have your vegetables grown yet?
Stop being so impatient, [player]. They'll grow in their own good time - come back later.
translation: 그렇게 보채지 좀 마요, [player]. 때가 되면 알아서 자라요. 나중에 다시 와요.

english: Hello Martin, you must be the slowest gardener in the world! I don't suppose those crops have grown yet?
translation: 안녕하세요, Martin(마틴). 세상에서 제일 느린 정원사시네요! 작물은 아직 안 자랐겠죠?

english: Well, you've got a nerve showing up around here again!
translation: 흥, 뻔뻔하게도 여기 또 얼굴을 내미는군요!

english: What? What are you talking about?
You told me that you'd solved the problems of the Gardening Group's members, well I've planted loads of seeds since then and there's no doubt that even more plants are dying!
translation: 정원사 모임 회원들 문제를 해결했다면서요. 그 뒤로 씨앗을 잔뜩 심었는데, 오히려 죽어 가는 식물이 더 늘어난 게 확실하다고요!

english: But I gave Fairy Queen's secateurs back to Godfather, things should be growing again.
translation: 하지만 전 Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)의 전지가위를 Godfather(대부)에게 돌려줬다고요. 이제 다시 자라야 정상인데요.

english: Yeah, sure, whatever. You know, I didn't believe you when you told me a story about 'the fairies' in the first place. You'd just better solve this problem, when people get hungry, they get angry and when you're the
translation: 네, 네, 그러시겠죠. 사실 처음에 '요정' 얘기를 할 때부터 안 믿었어요. 이 문제나 확실히 해결하는 게 좋을 거예요. 사람들은 배가 고프면 화가 나는 법이고, 다 괜찮아질 거라고 큰소리친

english: person who said that everything would be all right, so you're the person who they'll get angry with!
translation: 사람이 당신이니, 그 화살은 전부 당신한테 갈 테니까요!

english: I suppose I'd better go and see what the problem is then.
translation: 그럼 무엇이 문제인지 가서 알아보는 게 좋겠네요.

english: I've done enough for you, sort it out yourself!
translation: 할 만큼 해 드렸잖아요. 나머지는 직접 해결하세요!

english: Hello again, [player]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast, the food reserves are starting to fail. People will start to realise that there is an imminent food crisis soon!
translation: 다시 왔군요, [player]. 작물은 여전히 시들고 있어요. 빨리 어떻게 좀 해 줘요. 식량 비축분이 바닥나기 시작했어요. 곧 식량 위기가 코앞이라는 걸 사람들도 깨닫게 될 거예요!

english: Okay, this time I've really solved your problems! I've woken up the Fairy Queen!
translation: 좋아요, 이번엔 정말로 문제를 해결했어요! Fairy Queen(요정 여왕)을 깨웠다고요!

english: Hmm, right. You'll forgive me if I reserve judgement on this until I actually have some crops grow.
translation: 흠, 그래요. 실제로 작물이 자라는 걸 볼 때까지는 판단을 미뤄도 이해해 주시겠죠.

english: Of course. The problem was the Godfather, he wanted to take control of Zanaris himself, so he didn't give Fairy Nuff the Queen's secateurs!
translation: 물론이죠. 문제는 Godfather(대부)였어요. 자기가 Zanaris(자나리스)를 손에 넣으려고 Fairy Nuff(요정 너프)에게 여왕의 전지가위를 안 넘겼던 거예요!

english: Godfather...Fairy Nuff...the Queen, I don't know what you're talking about and I don't care. I just want my crops to start growing again. Come back and claim your reward once they've had a chance to grow.
translation: 대부... 요정 너프... 여왕... 무슨 소린지도 모르겠고 관심도 없어요. 난 그냥 작물이 다시 자랐으면 좋겠어요. 작물이 자랄 시간이 좀 지나면 보상 받으러 와요.

english: Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: 이런 젠장, 이봐, 남의 주머니에서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: You're the thief who stole from me!
Guards, guards!
Ask about the Skillcape of Farming.
translation: Skillcape of Farming(농사 스킬 망토)에 대해 묻는다.

english: Skillcape
I'm not paying that!
Sure, not many people own one.
translation: 좋아요, 이걸 가진 사람은 많지 않으니까요.

english: Hood
Ask about the quest.
Anything I can help with?
Now that I think about it, you're right!
No, can't say that I have.
translation: 아뇨, 딱히 그런 건 못 느꼈어요.

english: Yes.
No.
Oh dear. I hope you can sort them out by yourself.
What is the banner for?
Of course I'll help.
Sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 미안하지만 전 더 중요한 일이 있어요.

english: Hi.
Hello! What can I do for you today?
Who are you?
I'm Marwolaeth, bringer of prophecy.
It's nice to meet you Marwolaeth, I'm [player name].
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Marwolaeth(마르월라이스). 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
translation: 저도 만나서 정말 반갑답니다, [player name] 님.

english: What do you do here?
I'm the local wisdom, my dreams are those of prophecy. Would you care for a reading?
translation: 저는 이 마을의 지혜를 맡고 있지요. 제 꿈은 곧 예언이랍니다. 점을 한번 봐 드릴까요?

english: Yes, tell me of my future...
I see a blinding light! A fire so big the heavens can see it; all those who look upon the great flame struggle to look away.
translation: 눈부신 빛이 보입니다! 하늘마저 볼 수 있을 만큼 거대한 불길이요. 그 거대한 불꽃을 바라보는 이들은 모두 좀처럼 눈을 떼지 못하는군요.

english: I see a darkness so thick, light fails to escape it - A shadow world where up is down and right is wrong.
translation: 빛조차 빠져나오지 못할 만큼 짙은 어둠이 보입니다. 위가 아래이고 옳음이 그름인 그림자 세계가요.

english: I see peace and prosperity - The air is filled with wonderous bird song and the scent of earth and river.
translation: 평화와 번영이 보입니다. 하늘엔 경이로운 새소리가 가득하고, 흙과 강의 내음이 퍼지는군요.

english: What's that supposed to mean?
It isn't my place to derive meaning. Allow my foretelling to guide your future but do not rely upon it happening all by itself. We are the arbiters of our own destiny.
translation: 뜻을 풀어내는 건 제 몫이 아니랍니다. 제 예언이 당신의 미래를 이끌게 하되, 저절로 이루어지리라 믿고 기대지는 마세요. 운명을 정하는 건 우리 자신이니까요.

english: That's really quite vague, do you just say this to everyone?
translation: 너무 막연한데요. 혹시 아무한테나 이렇게 말하는 거 아니에요?

english: It's your choice to believe, not mine.
translation: 믿고 말고는 당신이 정할 일이지, 제가 정할 일이 아니랍니다.

english: Oh, alright... Thanks, I suppose.
You're most welcome, [player name].
Was there anything else you wanted?
Hmm, no thanks...
Are you sure?
I'd prefer to stay ignorant... Who knows what that knowledge could do to a person...
translation: 차라리 모르는 채로 있을래요... 그런 걸 알면 사람이 어떻게 될지 누가 알겠어요...

english: A blissful existence may be the correct path.
translation: 모르는 것이 축복인 삶이 올바른 길일지도 모르지요.

english: Can you tell me about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: I can! This is the quaint town of Gwenith. All those who have been granted access to the great crystal city of Prifddinas are welcome here.
translation: 물론이지요! 이곳은 아담한 마을 Gwenith(그웨니스)랍니다. 위대한 크리스탈 도시 Prifddinas(프리프디나스)에 들어갈 자격을 얻은 분이라면 누구든 이곳에서 환영받지요.

english: What's with that creepy mountain?
Ah... It is expected for an outsider like yourself to notice the mountain wonder how we exist in its shadow.
translation: 아... 당신 같은 외지인이라면 저 산을 보고, 우리가 어떻게 그 그늘 아래에서 살아가는지 궁금해하는 게 당연하지요.

english: We leave the mountain alone and it lets us live peacefully, out of sight of any passing boats.
translation: 우리가 산을 건드리지 않으면, 그것도 우리를 평화롭게 살게 해 준답니다. 지나가는 배들 눈에 띄지 않게요.

english: It? The mountain is conscious?
Of course! At the very top of the mountain sits a ruin. Whatever calamity happened there; their ghosts remain.
translation: 물론이지요! 산 꼭대기에는 폐허가 있답니다. 그곳에 어떤 재앙이 닥쳤든, 그들의 유령은 아직 남아 있어요.

english: G-g-ghosts?!
Yes. Explore at your own peril, [player name]. There are those who have looked for answers from these mynydd spirits. They never return.
translation: 그래요. 탐험은 각자 위험을 감수하셔야 해요, [player name] 님. 이 mynydd(머니드)의 영혼들에게서 답을 구하려던 이들이 있었지요. 그들은 결코 돌아오지 않았답니다.

english: That doesn't necessarily mean they died... They may have found the meaning that they desired and have gone elsewhere.
translation: 그렇다고 꼭 죽었다는 건 아니잖아요... 원하던 의미를 찾고 다른 곳으로 떠났을 수도 있죠.

english: Elsewhere? Indeed... As I said, [player name], explore at your own peril. Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 다른 곳이라... 그렇겠지요... 말씀드렸듯이, [player name] 님, 탐험은 각자 위험을 감수하셔야 해요. 또 원하시는 게 있나요?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Yes, tell me of my future...
Hmm, no thanks...
Can you tell me about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Bye!
Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
translation: 아, 아, 아, 아니요... 저리 가세요...

english: Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost(잭 프로스트)가 우리 빵집에 쳐들어와서 우릴 여기 가둬 버렸어요. 생산을 망치지 못하게 막으려 했더니 성질을 부리더라고요.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: 밖에서 제빵사 한 분을 만났는데, 여러분이 곤경에 처했다고 하던데요.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: 오, Remy(레미)가 아직 살아 있구나! Jack(잭)이 Icelord(아이스로드) 먹이로 줘 버린 줄 알았어요.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
translation: 열쇠는 어디 있어요? 문이 잠긴 것 같은데요.

english: I thought you had it, Mary.
translation: 네가 갖고 있는 줄 알았어, Mary(메리).

english: Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: 나야말로 네가 갖고 있는 줄 알았지, Paul(폴).

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: 내가 갖고 있었으면 벌써 문을 열었겠지?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
translation: 나도 갖고 있었으면 벌써 문을 열었겠지!

english: Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: 잘됐네, 이제 평생 너랑 여기 갇혀 살게 생겼어.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: 워워, 진정하세요! 안에 없으면 밖에 있겠죠. 제가 찾아볼게요.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)가 우리에 들어가려는 당신을 보고 입김을 뿜어 뒤로 날려 버린다.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: 그래요, 서둘러요. 일정을 다시 맞춰야 하거든요.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 그게 문제예요. 열쇠가 Icelord(아이스로드)랑 같이 우리 안에 있거든요.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)가 저기 있는 한 열쇠를 꺼낼 방법이 없어요.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 여기도 없고 뒷방에도 없으면, Icelord(아이스로드)가 있는 우리 안에 있을 거예요.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 텔레키네틱 그랩으로 가져와 볼 수 있겠어요?

english: That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: 그건 안 될 거예요. Icelord(아이스로드)의 마력이 방해할 테니까요.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: 흠... Icelord(아이스로드)로부터 몸을 지킬 방법이 필요하겠어요.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: 혹시 여기 Anti-Icelord Shield(안티 아이스로드 방패) 같은 거 굴러다니진 않겠죠?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: 하지만 기막힌 생각이 있어요. Gingerbread(진저브레드)를 쓰는 거예요!

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack(잭)이 우릴 가두기 전에, Icelord(아이스로드)로 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)에 아이싱을 입히는 걸 봤어요. 노움들이 입김을 아주 잘 흡수하더라고요.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)의 입김을 흡수할 만큼 큰 Gingerbread Gnome(진저브레드 노움)을 만들어야 해요.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: 평소 요리법은 계피 하나, 생강 하나, 밀가루 하나, 달걀 하나예요. 그걸 왼쪽에 보이는 저 큰 기계에 넣죠.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: 재료를 하나씩 더 넣어 가면서 맞는 조합을 찾아보면 어때요? 재료마다 세 배로 넣으면 될지도 몰라요.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: 정말 말도 안 되는 생각인데, 다른 방법이 없으니 어쩔 수 없죠....

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: 잘됐어요! 이제 어서 문 열어 줘요.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
There you go, unlocked without an issue.
Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: 와, 그걸 이렇게 빨리 해내다니! 우리 도움 하나 없이요.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: 정말 대단하네요. 몸을 지키려고 거대한 진저브레드를 만들 생각을 다 하다니, 이런 우연이 다 있네요.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ...저도요. 당신이 틀림없이 아이싱이 돼 버릴 줄 알았거든요.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 잘 풀렸잖아요? 덕분에 다시 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 만들 수 있게 됐고요.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: 정말 무모했어, Paul(폴). 그래도 네 말이 맞아, 결국 잘 풀렸으니까.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...알겠어요. Santa(산타)한테 가서 빵집이 다시 돌아간다는 좋은 소식을 전해야겠네요.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 어쩌면 Jack(잭)이 그걸로 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)에 아이싱을 입힌 게 꽤 괜찮은 생각이었을지도 몰라.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: 당신이 만든 거대한 진저브레드를 Santa(산타)에게 가져가서 보여 줘요. 그럼 우리가 다시 일을 시작했다는 걸 알 거예요.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: 자, 이제 가 주세요. 다시 생산에 들어가야 하거든요.

english: Hello there. Is this your home?
It is. What brings you here?
I'm just looking around.
Well you won't find anything too exciting here I'm afraid. Just farming.
translation: 글쎄요, 여기선 그렇게 신나는 건 못 찾을 거예요. 그냥 농사짓는 곳이라서요.

english: Well you have fun with it.
Well I have to say that mounted head looks awful.
translation: 그나저나 저 걸어 둔 머리는 정말 흉측하네요.

english: Sorry.
Not to worry. If it keeps Gordon happy, so be it. Anyway, thank you for keeping our farm safe. With the beast dealt with, I've been able to get back to tanning again.
translation: 괜찮아요. Gordon(고든)이 좋다면 그걸로 됐죠. 아무튼 우리 농장을 지켜 줘서 고마워요. 야수를 처리해 준 덕에 다시 무두질을 시작할 수 있게 됐어요.

english: Could you tan something for me?
translation: 뭘 좀 무두질해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Of course.
Happy to have helped. All the best.
Good to see you again! Anything I can do for you?
translation: 다시 만나서 반가워요! 뭐 도와드릴 거 있어요?

english: I'm good.
Could you tan something for me?
translation: 뭘 좀 무두질해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Happy to have helped. All the best.
I'm good.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 살인 사건 해결을 도와줘서 정말 고마워요.

english: Ah! Welcome, newcomer. I am the Master Chef, Lev. It is here that I will teach you how to cook food truly fit for a king.
translation: 아! 어서 오게, 신참. 나는 Master Chef(요리장) Lev(레브)일세. 여기서 자네에게 왕의 식탁에 올려도 손색없는 요리를 가르쳐 주지.

english: I already know how to cook. Brynna taught me just now.
translation: 요리는 이미 할 줄 알아요. 방금 Brynna(브리나)한테 배웠거든요.

english: Hahahahahaha! You call THAT cooking? Some shrimp on an open log fire? Oh, no, no, no. I am going to teach you the fine art of cooking bread.
translation: 하하하하하하! 그걸 요리라고 부르나? 모닥불에 shrimp(새우) 몇 마리 구운 걸? 오, 아니, 아니, 아니지. 내가 자네에게 빵 굽는 고귀한 기술을 가르쳐 주겠네.

english: Time for you to learn the fine art of cooking bread.
translation: 이제 빵 굽는 고귀한 기술을 배울 시간일세.

english: Do you need something?
Tell me about making dough again.
translation: 반죽 만드는 법 다시 알려 주세요.

english: It's quite simple. Just use a pot of flour on a bucket of water, or vice versa, and you'll make dough. You can fill a bucket with water at any sink.
translation: 아주 간단하네. pot of flour(밀가루 단지)를 bucket of water(물 양동이)에 쓰거나, 그 반대로 하면 dough(반죽)이 되지. 양동이에 물은 어느 개수대에서나 채울 수 있네.

english: Do you need anything else?
Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: range(레인지) 요리에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: The range is the only place you can cook a lot of the more complex foods in Gielinor. To cook on a range, all you need to do is click on it. You'll need to make sure you have the required items in your inventory though.
translation: range(레인지)는 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 복잡한 요리 대부분을 할 수 있는 유일한 곳이지. 레인지에서 요리하려면 그냥 클릭하면 되네. 물론 필요한 재료는 소지품에 챙겨 둬야 하고.

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me about making dough again.
translation: 반죽 만드는 법 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about range cooking again.
translation: range(레인지) 요리에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Nothing thanks.
Hello, and welcome to the Crafting Guild. Accomplished crafters from all over the land come here to use our top notch workshops.
translation: 안녕하세요, Crafting Guild(공예 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 온 땅의 솜씨 좋은 장인들이 우리 최고급 작업장을 쓰러 이곳을 찾지요.

english: Hey, what is that cape you're wearing? I don't recognise it.
translation: 저기, 입고 계신 그 망토는 뭐예요? 처음 보는 건데요.

english: This? This is a Skillcape of Crafting. It is a symbol of my ability as master of the Crafting Guild and it provides unlimited teleports here.
translation: 이거요? 이건 Skillcape of Crafting(공예 스킬 망토)입니다. Crafting Guild(공예 길드)의 수장다운 실력의 상징이고, 이곳으로 무제한 순간이동할 수 있게 해 주지요.

english: If you should ever achieve level 99 Crafting come and talk to me and we'll see if we can sort you out with one.
translation: 언젠가 Crafting(공예) 레벨 99를 달성하면 저를 찾아오세요. 하나 마련해 드릴 수 있을지 보지요.

english: Are you the person I need to talk to about buying a Skillcape of Crafting?
translation: Skillcape of Crafting(공예 스킬 망토)를 사려면 당신과 이야기하면 되나요?

english: I certainly am, and I can see that you are definitely talented enough to own one! The cape has a built-in teleport back to us at the guild too!
translation: 그렇습니다. 보아하니 하나 가질 만한 실력이 충분하시군요! 이 망토에는 우리 길드로 돌아오는 순간이동 기능도 들어 있답니다!

english: Unfortunately, being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for 99000 gold.
translation: 다만 워낙 귀한 물건이라 값도 그만큼 비쌉니다. 유감이지만 99000골드를 받아야겠습니다.

english: 99000 gold! Are you mad?
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 물론 제정신입니다. 이렇게 귀한 물건을 살 기회를 반길 모험가는 얼마든지 있지요. 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 찾아오세요.

english: That's fine.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 지금 가진 돈이 모자라네요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 스킬 망토는 전부 무료 두건이 함께 딸려 나옵니다. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이지요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 그런 겁니다. 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주셔야 합니다.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭합니다! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 입으십시오, 친구여.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 맞는 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Where's your brown apron? You can't come in here unless you're wearing one.
translation: brown apron(갈색 앞치마)는 어디 있습니까? 그걸 입지 않으면 여기 들어올 수 없습니다.

english: Err... I haven't got one.
Welcome to the Guild of Master Craftsmen.
translation: Guild of Master Craftsmen(장인 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Yeah?
Hello.
Whassup?
So... are you here to give crafting tips?
translation: 그래서... 공예 팁 좀 알려 주러 오신 거예요?

english: Dude, do I look like I wanna talk to you?
translation: 야, 내가 너랑 얘기하고 싶어 하는 걸로 보이냐?

english: I suppose not.
Right on!
Yes.
No.
Skillcape
99000 gold! Are you mad?
That's fine.
Hood
Cor blimey mate, what are ye doing in me pockets?
translation: 이런 젠장, 이봐, 남의 주머니에서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Stuns the player, dealing 3 damage.
Hello there. How's it going?
Well the work is going well, so I'm very good, thank you.
translation: 일이 잘 풀리고 있어서 아주 좋아요, 고마워요.

english: Not too bad thanks.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Nilsal! I'm pretty good, thank you. It's always nice to be out in the sun.
translation: Nilsal(닐살)! 꽤 잘 지내요, 고마워요. 햇볕 아래 나와 있는 건 언제나 좋죠.

english: Hello there! Nice weather we've been having. Perfect for a day outdoors!
translation: 안녕하세요! 요즘 날씨가 참 좋죠. 바깥에서 하루 보내기 딱이에요!

english: Hey newbie! I'm the Master Navigator - let's teach you how to get around.
translation: 어이, 신입! 나는 Master Navigator(항해 달인)예요. 길 찾는 법을 알려 줄게요.

english: I can already walk around...
translation: 걷는 건 이미 할 줄 아는데요...

english: Ha. You've worked your way around to me, but this island is bigger than you think! I will show you by teaching you how to use the world map. First things first, you will need to open your world map.
translation: 하. 여기까진 용케 찾아왔지만, 이 섬은 생각보다 넓어요! 세계 지도 쓰는 법을 가르쳐 주면서 보여 줄게요. 우선, 세계 지도부터 열어 봐요.

english: You can find this in the top right side of the screen, look for the flashing globe icon.
translation: 화면 오른쪽 위에 있어요. 깜빡이는 지구본 아이콘을 찾아봐요.

english: Well done, you have found your world map.
The world map can show where you are in the world, as well as where other places are. You can find where you are by looking for the yellow X icon.
translation: 세계 지도에서는 지금 내가 세상 어디에 있는지, 다른 곳들은 어디 있는지 볼 수 있어요. 노란 X 아이콘을 찾으면 지금 위치를 알 수 있죠.

english: You may have noticed all the icons on the map, these icons have a meaning behind each one. You can find out what the icon means by looking at the map key.
translation: 지도 위에 아이콘이 잔뜩 있는 거 봤죠? 아이콘마다 다 의미가 있어요. 지도 범례를 보면 아이콘이 뭘 뜻하는지 알 수 있어요.

english: To open or close the map key you will have to click the scroll looking icon in the bottom left part of the map.
translation: 지도 범례를 열거나 닫으려면 지도 왼쪽 아래에 있는 두루마리 모양 아이콘을 클릭하면 돼요.

english: Once opened, you will see a list of all the different icons on the map, as well as some text next to the icon telling you what the icon is. You can click on an icon in the key.
translation: 열면 지도에 있는 온갖 아이콘 목록이 보이고, 아이콘 옆에 그게 뭔지 알려 주는 글도 있어요. 범례에 있는 아이콘을 클릭할 수도 있어요.

english: Every icon that is the same as the one you just selected, will start to flash.
translation: 방금 고른 것과 같은 아이콘이 전부 깜빡이기 시작할 거예요.

english: Lastly, next to the key you will see there is a search bar. You can click on the search bar and type in a location. You can then press enter and the map will move to the specified location.
