translation: 마지막으로, 범례 옆에 검색창이 있어요. 검색창을 클릭하고 장소 이름을 입력한 다음 Enter를 누르면 지도가 그 장소로 이동해요.

english: Now you know the basics of the world map, I am going to task you with making your way to the Quest Guide. You can find him just north of here. Go out the door to the west and follow the path.
translation: 이제 세계 지도 기본은 다 알았으니, Quest Guide(퀘스트 안내원)한테 찾아가는 걸 과제로 줄게요. 여기서 바로 북쪽에 있어요. 서쪽 문으로 나가서 길을 따라가요.

english: Remember that your world map is just a larger version of your mininmap, with the difference that you can click on your minimap to navigate around. You will also see icons on your minimap as well, just like the world map.
translation: 세계 지도는 미니맵을 크게 키운 거나 마찬가지예요. 다른 점은 미니맵은 클릭해서 이동할 수 있다는 거죠. 미니맵에도 세계 지도처럼 아이콘이 표시돼요.

english: Thanks for the lesson, I'll go find the Quest Guide now.
translation: 가르쳐 주셔서 고마워요. 이제 Quest Guide(퀘스트 안내원)을 찾아갈게요.

english: Hey newbie, can I help you at all?
translation: 어이, 신입. 뭐 도와줄 거 있어요?

english: Tell me about the world map again.
translation: 세계 지도에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Why do you have a meat cleaver?
translation: 왜 고기 써는 칼을 들고 있어요?

english: *Sigh*
That's kind of a sore subject. But if you must know, I used to be a chef here on the island.
translation: 그건 좀 아픈 얘긴데요. 꼭 알아야겠다면 말해 주죠. 예전엔 이 섬에서 요리사였어요.

english: But people thought that learning how to cook bread after cooking shrimp was useless. So now I teach players how to navigate the world instead.
translation: 그런데 새우 굽는 법 배운 다음에 빵 굽는 법 배우는 건 쓸데없다고들 하더라고요. 그래서 이제는 대신 세상을 누비는 법을 가르치고 있죠.

english: Is there anything else you would like to grill me on?
translation: 또 나를 들들 볶을 질문이라도 있어요?

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 아뇨, 이제 다음으로 넘어갈 준비 됐어요!

english: Get moving then.
Tell me about the world map again.
translation: 세계 지도에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Why do you have a meat cleaver?
translation: 왜 고기 써는 칼을 들고 있어요?

english: Nope, I'm ready to move on!
translation: 아뇨, 이제 다음으로 넘어갈 준비 됐어요!

english: Hello, I'm afraid only the top fishers are allowed to use our premier fishing facilities.
translation: 안녕하세요. 미안하지만 우리 최고급 낚시 시설은 정상급 어부만 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Hello, welcome to the fishing guild.  Please feel free to make use of any of our facilities.
translation: 안녕하세요, 낚시 길드에 온 걸 환영해요. 어떤 시설이든 마음껏 쓰세요.

english: Can you tell me about that skillcape you're wearing?
translation: 입고 계신 그 스킬 망토에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'm happy to, my friend. This beautiful cape was presented to me in recognition of my skills and experience as a fisherman and I was asked to be the head of this guild at the same time.
translation: 기꺼이요, 친구. 이 멋진 망토는 어부로서의 실력과 경험을 인정받아 받은 거예요. 그때 이 길드를 이끌어 달라는 부탁도 함께 받았죠.

english: As the best fisherman in the guild it is my duty to control who has access to the guild and to say who can buy similar skillcapes and the cape can even teleport you right inside the guild.
translation: 길드 최고의 어부로서 누가 길드에 들어올 수 있는지, 누가 이런 스킬 망토를 살 수 있는지 정하는 게 제 임무예요. 이 망토로 길드 안으로 곧장 순간이동할 수도 있답니다.

english: I'm happy to say that being such a fine fisher yourself, I'm happy to offer you the opportunity to purchase a fine skillcape just like this one, it can even teleport you right inside the guild. Are you interested? It would cost
translation: 당신도 이렇게 훌륭한 어부이니, 기쁜 마음으로 이것과 똑같은 멋진 스킬 망토를 살 기회를 드릴게요. 길드 안으로 곧장 순간이동할 수도 있어요. 관심 있어요? 가격은

english: 99000 coins.
Yes, please.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝지만 모든 스킬 망토에는 무료 두건이 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사의 일환이거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알죠? 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 와야 해요.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 자부심을 갖고 그 망토를 입어요, 친구.

english: No, thanks.
Okay, suit yourself.
Yes
No
Yes.
No.
Hello.
Well met! Are you interested in hearing about the art of smithing?
translation: 반갑구먼! 대장일의 기술에 대해 들어 볼 생각 있수?

english: How can I train my smithing?
To be able to smith anything, you're going to need one of these beauties.
translation: 뭐든 두들겨 만들려면 이 녀석이 꼭 하나 있어야 하우.

english: I see you already have a hammer. Nice one.
translation: 보아하니 망치는 벌써 갖고 있구먼. 잘했수.

english: You're going to need to get your hand on some metal bars. You could do this by mining your own ores and smelting them at a furnace.
translation: 그다음엔 금속 주괴를 좀 손에 넣어야 하우. 직접 광석을 캐서 furnace(용광로)에서 제련하면 되지.

english: There is a furnace located in Lumbridge, just north of the castle opposite the general store.
translation: Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 용광로가 하나 있수. 성 바로 북쪽, general store(잡화점) 맞은편이지.

english: If you are looking for some ore, there is a mine east of Varrock. There you can find some copper and tin ore. Don't forget to bring a pickaxe.
translation: 광석을 찾는다면 Varrock(바록) 동쪽에 광산이 있수. 거기서 copper(구리)와 tin ore(주석 광석)을 캘 수 있지. pickaxe(곡괭이) 챙기는 거 잊지 말고.

english: When you have your bars, bring them to an anvil to open the smithing interface. If the item name is in black, this means you do not have the level to smith the item.
translation: 주괴가 생기면 anvil(모루)로 가져가서 대장일 창을 여시우. 아이템 이름이 검은색이면 그걸 만들 레벨이 안 된다는 뜻이우.

english: If the item name is in white, this means you do have the level to smith the item. You will see the bars required to smith the item underneath the name of the item.
translation: 아이템 이름이 흰색이면 그걸 만들 레벨이 된다는 뜻이우. 아이템 이름 아래에 그걸 만드는 데 필요한 주괴 수가 나오지.

english: If the number of bars is in orange, this means you do not have enough bars to smith the item. If it is in green, this means you have enough bars for the item.
translation: 주괴 수가 주황색이면 그 아이템을 만들 주괴가 모자란다는 뜻이고, 초록색이면 주괴가 충분하다는 뜻이우.

english: Thanks for the advice.
Is there anything else you would like to know?
You might find it beneficial to keep a nice stack of bars in your bank before you start smithing. Unless you like to jump from task to task of course.
translation: 대장일을 시작하기 전에 은행에 주괴를 넉넉히 쌓아 두면 쓸모가 있을 거요. 물론 이 일 저 일 옮겨 다니는 게 좋다면야 상관없지만.

english: If you want to smith something that you may not have the level for, you could try gaining some temporary knowledge in smithing from a boost.
translation: 아직 레벨이 모자란 걸 만들고 싶으면, 부스트로 대장일 지식을 잠깐 끌어올려 보는 것도 방법이우.

english: You can buy a Dwarven stout at the Rising Sun Inn in Falador.
translation: Dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트)는 Falador(팔라도르)의 Rising Sun Inn(떠오르는 태양 여관)에서 살 수 있수.

english: If you are looking for a quest, you should talk to the squire in the courtyard of the white knight's castle. He is looking for a bit of help with something. I would recommend you be a little experienced with combat
translation: 퀘스트를 찾는다면 white knight's castle(백기사의 성) 안뜰에 있는 종자한테 말을 걸어 보시우. 그 친구가 뭔가 도움이 좀 필요하다더군. 다만 전투 경험은 조금 있는 게

english: though.
Cor blimey, I don't think there is anything I can teach you, but I'll do my best.
translation: 이런 세상에, 내가 가르쳐 줄 게 있을까 싶지만 최선을 다해 보지.

english: As you get better you'll find you will be able to smith Mithril and eventually Adamantite and even Runite. This can be very lucrative but very expensive on the coal front.
translation: 실력이 늘면 Mithril(미스릴)을, 나중엔 Adamantite(아다만타이트)에 Runite(루나이트)까지 만들 수 있게 될 거요. 돈벌이는 꽤 쏠쏠하지만 석탄이 엄청나게 들지.

english: It may be worth you stockpiling coal for a while before attempting these difficult metals or even sticking to good old reliable iron by the bucket load.
translation: 이런 까다로운 금속에 손대기 전에 석탄을 한동안 모아 두거나, 아예 믿음직한 iron(철)을 양동이째로 두들기는 것도 괜찮을 거요.

english: If you want to stop yourself from failing to smith iron, I suggest purchasing some rings of forging. Be aware that they will break after a certain number of bars are smelted.
translation: 철 제련에 실패하기 싫으면 rings of forging(단조의 반지)를 좀 사 두길 권하우. 다만 주괴를 일정 개수 제련하면 깨진다는 건 알아 두시우.

english: If you want to save on coal, you could try smithing your bars over at the Blast Furnace in Keldagrim.
translation: 석탄을 아끼고 싶으면 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 Blast Furnace(대형 용광로)에서 주괴를 만들어 보시우.

english: If you are looking for something more interesting to smith, you could talk to Otto Godblessed about smithing hastae.
translation: 좀 더 색다른 걸 만들어 보고 싶다면 Otto Godblessed(오토 갓블레스드)한테 hastae(하스타) 만드는 법을 물어보시우.

english: Though he may ask you to complete some tasks for him. You can find him south of the barbarian outpost and west of the whirlpool.
translation: 다만 그 양반이 일을 몇 가지 시킬지도 모르우. 야만인 전초기지 남쪽, 소용돌이 서쪽에 가면 만날 수 있수.

english: What kind of things can I smith?
There are many things you can make, from weapons to your good old fashioned armour.
translation: 만들 수 있는 건 많수. 무기부터 옛날식 튼튼한 갑옷까지.

english: Weapons are the cheapest to smith. They range from a measly one bar, all the way to three bars.
translation: 무기는 만드는 데 제일 싸게 먹히우. 고작 주괴 한 개부터 세 개까지 들지.

english: Armour can be the costliest item to smith, the cost of each item ranges from a measly one bar all the way up to a whopping five bars.
translation: 갑옷은 제일 비싸게 먹힐 수 있수. 아이템마다 고작 주괴 한 개부터 무려 다섯 개까지 들지.

english: Some weapons and armour, such as darts, will require you to have gained knowledge on how to smith them. This is due to the complex nature of the weapon.
translation: 다트 같은 일부 무기와 갑옷은 만드는 법을 먼저 배워야 하우. 무기 구조가 복잡해서 그렇지.

english: You might find that other items don't require conventional bars you would gather. Some may require you to piece blades back together or even infuse a crystal into a piece of armour.
translation: 어떤 아이템은 흔히 모으는 주괴가 필요 없을 수도 있수. 부러진 칼날을 다시 이어 붙이거나, 갑옷에 크리스탈을 주입해야 하는 것도 있지.

english: Is there anything else you want to know?
Not right now, thank you.
Well, just come back any time you want to know anything!
translation: 그럼 뭐든 알고 싶으면 언제든 다시 오시우!

english: How can I train my smithing?
What kind of things can I smith?
Not right now, thank you.
Hello. Are you Josef's replacement?
Yes, I suppose I am.
It just goes to show how little Denath values us.
translation: Denath(데나스)가 우리를 얼마나 하찮게 여기는지 딱 보이네요.

english: What do you mean?
Denath told us we would learn the secrets of demonic magic, but all we've done is memorize one incantation. And now he replaces poor Josef with the next person who comes along!
translation: Denath(데나스)는 악마 마법의 비밀을 알려 주겠다고 했는데, 우리가 한 거라곤 주문 하나 외운 게 전부예요. 그런데 이젠 가엾은 Josef(조셉) 자리에 지나가던 아무나를 앉히잖아요!

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: demonic sigil mould(악마 인장 거푸집) 갖고 있어요?

english: No, I think Jennifer has it.
Do you know what happened to Josef?
Shh! Listen, Denath doesn't know this...
translation: 쉿! 잘 들어요, Denath(데나스)는 이걸 몰라요...

english: When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.
translation: 우리가 처음 합류했을 때 Denath(데나스)는 악마 마법의 비밀을 전부 가르쳐 주겠다고 했어요. 그런데 아직도 아는 게 하나도 없어요.

english: The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.
translation: 다른 사람들은 인장이랑 달달 외운 주문 하나로 자기들이 엄청 사악한 줄 알아요. 하지만 Josef(조셉)과 저는 더 알고 싶었어요. 그게 어떻게 작동하는지 말이에요.

english: Josef was more curious than me. Last night, he secretly read a book that Denath was keeping from us. He didn't know I was awake, but I saw what happened.
translation: Josef(조셉)은 저보다 호기심이 더 많았어요. 어젯밤 그는 Denath(데나스)가 우리한테 숨기던 책을 몰래 읽었어요. 제가 깨어 있는 줄 몰랐지만, 저는 무슨 일이 있었는지 봤어요.

english: I saw him read it, and then his face turned white, and he took the book and ran through the portal.
translation: 그가 책을 읽더니 얼굴이 하얗게 질려서는, 책을 들고 포털로 뛰어 들어갔어요.

english: But Denath was waking up, and when he saw Josef was gone he went through the portal to look for him. A bit later Denath returned, without Josef or the book.
translation: 그런데 Denath(데나스)가 깨어나서 Josef(조셉)이 없어진 걸 보고 찾으러 포털로 들어갔어요. 잠시 뒤에 Denath(데나스)가 돌아왔는데, Josef(조셉)도 책도 없었어요.

english: Josef didn't have money for the magic carpet, and he can't have got far in the desert at night with that heavy book.
translation: Josef(조셉)은 magic carpet(마법 양탄자) 탈 돈도 없었고, 그 무거운 책을 들고 밤에 사막에서 멀리 가지도 못했을 거예요.

english: Josef must have hidden the book somewhere in the ruins, before Denath followed him. If you could find it, we'd know what it was that frightened him. We'd know what Denath is really up to!
translation: Josef(조셉)은 Denath(데나스)가 쫓아오기 전에 폐허 어딘가에 책을 숨겼을 거예요. 그걸 찾아 주시면 그가 뭘 보고 겁에 질렸는지 알 수 있을 거예요. Denath(데나스)가 진짜 무슨 꿍꿍이인지도요!

english: Did you find that book?
I really want to know what's in it. I think Denath is hiding something from us, but we won't know what unless we read that book!
translation: 안에 뭐가 있는지 정말 알고 싶어요. Denath(데나스)가 우리한테 뭔가 숨기고 있는 것 같은데, 그 책을 읽기 전엔 알 수가 없어요!

english: Yes. The golem saw Josef hide it in one of the broken kilns in the city.
translation: 네. golem(골렘)이 Josef(조셉)이 도시의 부서진 가마 중 하나에 그걸 숨기는 걸 봤대요.

english: Did the golem see what happened to Josef?
translation: 골렘이 Josef(조셉)한테 무슨 일이 있었는지도 봤대요?

english: It said Denath killed him.
Oh no!
I knew Denath was a dark wizard but I didn't think he'd kill one of his disciples.
translation: Denath(데나스)가 dark wizard(어둠의 마법사)인 건 알았지만, 제자를 죽이기까지 할 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Let me look at the book then.
I don't understand. What's in here that Denath thought was worth killing over? Josef must have worked something out - but what?
translation: 이해가 안 돼요. 여기 뭐가 있길래 Denath(데나스)가 사람을 죽일 만하다고 생각한 걸까요? Josef(조셉)이 뭔가 알아낸 게 분명한데, 대체 뭘까요?

english: But look at the incantation in the book. The words are in the reverse order to the order that Denath taught us.
translation: 그런데 책에 있는 주문 좀 보세요. 단어 순서가 Denath(데나스)가 가르쳐 준 순서랑 정반대예요.

english: The incantation in the book is backwards?
More likely the book has the correct incantation and the one Denath taught us was backwards. But what does that mean?
translation: 그보다는 책에 있는 게 올바른 주문이고, Denath(데나스)가 가르쳐 준 게 거꾸로였을 가능성이 더 커요. 그런데 그게 무슨 뜻일까요?

english: Player, I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith-Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: Player, 이 의식이 마음에 안 들어요. Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)가 우리 소원을 다 들어줄 것 같지 않아요. 우리를 전부 죽일 것 같아요. 그렇다고 막으려 하면 Denath(데나스)가 Josef(조셉)처럼 저도 죽일 거예요!

english: Don't worry. I'm here to kill the demon!
translation: 걱정 마세요. 전 그 악마를 죽이러 왔어요!

english: This is the demon-slaying sword Silverlight, the only weapon that can kill Agrith-Naar!
translation: 이건 악마를 베는 검 Silverlight(실버라이트)예요. Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 죽일 수 있는 유일한 무기죠!

english: Thank goodness! I think Denath is nearly ready for the ritual. We must prepare!
translation: 다행이다! Denath(데나스)가 의식 준비를 거의 다 끝낸 것 같아요. 우리도 대비해야 해요!

english: Oh my gods!
He disappeared!
Where'd he go?
Of course! How could we be so stupid?
What happened?
What do you get when you perform a summoning ritual backwards?
translation: 소환 의식을 거꾸로 하면 뭐가 되겠어요?

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've just helped him return to his own dimension!
translation: Denath(데나스)가 처음부터 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)였어요! 우리가 방금 그를 원래 차원으로 돌려보내 준 거예요!

english: What was that?!
Look! The portal's closing!
I'm getting out of here!
No, don't leave!
Who knows what Denath could do now?
translation: 이제 Denath(데나스)가 무슨 짓을 할지 누가 알아요?

english: We've got to perform the ritual again so you can kill Agrith-Naar. But we need eight people!
translation: 의식을 다시 해서 당신이 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 죽이게 해야 해요. 그런데 여덟 명이 필요해요!

english: Quick, Player, you've got to get those three to come back! And you'd better take Denath's sigil and find one more person to help.
translation: 빨리요, Player, 저 세 사람을 다시 데려와야 해요! 그리고 Denath(데나스)의 인장을 가져가서 도와줄 사람을 한 명 더 찾는 게 좋겠어요.

english: We've got to perform the ritual again, forwards this time, so you can kill Agrith-Naar. I'll prepare for it here while you find four more people.
translation: 의식을 다시 해야 해요. 이번엔 순서대로요. 그래야 당신이 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 죽일 수 있어요. 당신이 네 명을 더 찾는 동안 저는 여기서 준비할게요.

english: I don't understand what happened!
Denath must have been Agrith-Naar all along!
Ellemar's book said that Agrith-Naar can only use his powerful magics from the demon plane.
translation: Ellemar(엘레마르)의 책에 따르면 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)는 악마계에서만 강력한 마법을 쓸 수 있대요.

english: Ellemar must have trapped him in human form to stop him using his magics. That must be what the last pages of the book said.
translation: Ellemar(엘레마르)가 마법을 못 쓰게 하려고 그를 인간의 몸에 가둬 둔 게 틀림없어요. 책의 마지막 페이지들에 그 얘기가 쓰여 있었을 거예요.

english: So the reason he assembled us was to send him back to his own plane, where he would be much more powerful! That's why the ritual was backwards!
translation: 그러니까 그가 우리를 모은 건 자기를 원래 차원으로 돌려보내기 위해서였어요. 거기서는 훨씬 더 강해지니까요! 그래서 의식이 거꾸로였던 거예요!

english: He's already started to close the portal to trap us. Who knows what else he could do?
translation: 벌써 우리를 가두려고 포털을 닫기 시작했어요. 또 무슨 짓을 할지 누가 알겠어요?

english: But if we can perform the ritual forwards then you can kill him using Silverlight and end his evil magics once and for all!
translation: 하지만 의식을 순서대로 하면 당신이 Silverlight(실버라이트)로 그를 죽이고, 그 사악한 마법을 영원히 끝낼 수 있어요!

english: Okay!
Hurry!
We've got eight people now. Are you ready to summon Agrith-Naar and slay him?
translation: 이제 여덟 명이 모였어요. Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)를 소환해서 처치할 준비 됐어요?

english: No.
Do hurry! We haven't got much time!
Yes.
*gulp*  Okay, here we go...
Yes, I suppose I am.
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: demonic sigil mould(악마 인장 거푸집) 갖고 있어요?

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
Not yet.
I don't understand what happened!
Okay.
No.
Yes.
Hello there.
Greetings. Can I help you at all?
Do you have any quests I could do?
A quest? What a strange notion. Do you normally go around asking complete strangers for quests?
translation: 퀘스트요? 참 별난 발상이군요. 평소에도 생판 모르는 사람한테 퀘스트를 달라고 하고 다니십니까?

english: Er, yes, now you come to mention it.
translation: 어, 네. 말씀을 듣고 보니 그러네요.

english: Oh, ok then. Well, no, I don't; sorry.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 음, 아뇨, 없습니다. 미안합니다.

english: What is this place?
A good question; straight and to the point.
My name is Matthias, I am a falconer, and this is where I train my birds.
translation: 제 이름은 Matthias(마티아스), 매 조련사입니다. 이곳은 제가 새들을 훈련시키는 곳이지요.

english: That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: 재미있겠네요. 저도 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: Training falcons is a lot of work and I doubt you're up to the task. However, I suppose I could let you try hunting with one.
translation: 매 조련은 손이 많이 가는 일이라 당신이 감당할 수 있을지 의문이군요. 그래도 매 한 마리로 사냥을 해 보게 해 드릴 수는 있겠습니다.

english: I have some tamer birds that I occasionally lend to rich noblemen who consider it a sufficiently refined sport for their tastes, and you look like the kind who might appreciate a good hunt.
translation: 가끔 부유한 귀족분들께 빌려 드리는 비교적 순한 새들이 있습니다. 그분들 취향에 맞을 만큼 고상한 스포츠라 여기시더군요. 당신도 좋은 사냥을 즐길 줄 아는 분처럼 보이고요.

english: I'd have to request a small fee, mind you; how does 500 gold pieces sound?
I'm afraid I don't have that much with me.
Ok, that seems reasonable.
Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you put away your weapons and gloves before we start.
translation: 좋습니다. 다만 두 손이 다 자유로워야 합니다. 시작하기 전에 무기와 장갑을 넣어 두시길 권합니다.

english: Good, however you really need both hands free. I'd suggest that you take off some of that kit you're wearing before we start.
translation: 좋습니다. 다만 두 손이 다 자유로워야 합니다. 시작하기 전에 걸치고 계신 장비를 좀 벗어 두시길 권합니다.

english: The falconer gives you a large leather glove and brings one of the smaller birds over to land on it.
translation: 매 조련사가 커다란 가죽 장갑을 건네주고, 작은 새 한 마리를 데려와 그 위에 앉힌다.

english: Don't worry; I'll keep an eye on you to make sure you don't upset it too much.
translation: 걱정 마십시오. 당신이 새를 너무 성가시게 하지 않도록 제가 지켜보고 있겠습니다.

english: I'm not interested then, thanks.
Well, you're welcome to come back if you change your mind.
translation: 뭐, 마음이 바뀌면 언제든 다시 오십시오.

english: Absolutely, are you ready?
I am!
That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
Fair enough; it does require a great deal of patience and skill, so I can understand if you might feel intimidated.
translation: 그럴 만도 하지요. 인내와 기술이 대단히 많이 필요한 일이니, 겁이 나실 수도 있다는 건 이해합니다.

english: What's this falconry thing all about then?
translation: 그 매 사냥이란 게 대체 뭔가요?

english: Well, some people see it as a sport, although such a term does not really convey the amount of patience and dedication required to be proficient at the task.
translation: 음, 스포츠라고 보는 사람도 있지만, 그런 말로는 이 일에 능숙해지는 데 필요한 인내와 헌신을 제대로 담아낼 수 없지요.

english: Putting it simply, it is the training and use of birds of prey in hunting quarry.
translation: 간단히 말하자면, 맹금류를 훈련시켜 사냥감을 잡는 데 쓰는 것입니다.

english: So it's like keeping a pet then?
translation: 그럼 애완동물을 키우는 것 같은 건가요?

english: Not exactly, no. Such a bird can never really be considered tame in the same way that a dog can.
translation: 꼭 그렇지는 않습니다. 이런 새는 개처럼 길들여졌다고 볼 수가 없지요.

english: They can be trained to associate people or places with food though, and, as such, a good falconer can get a trained bird to do as he wishes.
translation: 하지만 사람이나 장소를 먹이와 연관 짓도록 훈련시킬 수는 있습니다. 그래서 훌륭한 매 조련사라면 훈련된 새를 뜻대로 부릴 수 있지요.

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 당신 새로 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: Could I invest in your setup here?
If you'd like to put money forward for training more falcons, be my guest!
translation: 매를 더 훈련시키는 데 돈을 대고 싶으시다면, 얼마든지요!

english: Would I get any benefit from this?
I suppose I could let you use my falcons for free if you stump up enough cash. How does 500,000 coins sound?
translation: 돈을 넉넉히 내 주신다면 제 매들을 무료로 쓰게 해 드릴 수 있겠군요. 500,000코인이면 어떻습니까?

english: Ah, I don't have that much on me right now.
Hmm, that seems a little steep. I'll think on it.
translation: 음, 좀 비싼 것 같네요. 생각해 볼게요.

english: I appreciate that you want to invest more, but I really don't need it right now!
translation: 더 투자하고 싶어 하시는 건 고맙습니다만, 지금은 정말 필요 없습니다!

english: Hello again.
Ah, you're back. How are you getting along with [him/her] then?
translation: 아, 돌아오셨군요. 그래, [him/her]하고는 잘 지내고 있습니까?

english: It's certainly harder than it looks.
Sorry, but I was talking to the falcon, not you. But yes it is; have you had enough yet?
translation: 미안하지만 방금 그건 매한테 한 말이었습니다. 하지만 그렇지요, 어렵습니다. 이제 충분히 해 보셨습니까?

english: Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
translation: 사실, 조금만 더 해 보고 싶어요.

english: Ok then, just come talk to me when you're done.
translation: 알겠습니다. 다 하시면 저한테 와서 말씀하십시오.

english: I think I'll leave it for now.
You give the falcon and glove back to Matthias.
Do you have any quests I could do?
What is this place?
That sounds like fun; could I have a go?
translation: 재미있겠네요. 저도 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: Ok, that seems reasonable.
I'm not interested then, thanks.
That doesn't sound like my sort of thing.
What's this falconry thing all about then?
translation: 그 매 사냥이란 게 대체 뭔가요?

english: Could I have a go with your bird?
translation: 당신 새로 한번 해 봐도 될까요?

english: Could I invest in your setup here?
Yes
No
Actually, I'd like to keep trying a little longer.
translation: 사실, 조금만 더 해 보고 싶어요.

english: I think I'll leave it for now.
Hello.
Hmm, yes... Hello!
...Are you busy?
Oh umm, no and yes. I'm forever observing, you see.
translation: 아, 음, 아니기도 하고 그렇기도 해요. 저는 늘 관찰 중이거든요.

english: Observing what?
Oh, erm, birds! Yes, those feathery little flittery things.
translation: 아, 어, 새요! 네, 그 깃털 달린 쪼그맣고 파닥파닥하는 것들이요.

english: Yes, I know what a bird is.
Do you though? The subtleties between different species of birds is quite incredible, you see-
translation: 정말 그럴까요? 새 종마다 미묘한 차이가 얼마나 놀라운지 아세요? 그러니까-

english: But how could I attract them? Y'know, so I could observe them a little closer.
translation: 그런데 새들을 어떻게 꾈 수 있죠? 그러니까, 좀 더 가까이서 관찰할 수 있게요.

english: Ah yes, well, of course! I've travelled around this island and found the best spots for bird watching. I placed a ring of stones at these locations!
translation: 아, 그럼요, 물론이죠! 제가 이 섬을 돌아다니면서 새 관찰하기 제일 좋은 장소들을 찾아냈어요. 그 자리마다 ring of stones(돌의 고리)를 놓아 뒀죠!

english: So those would be the best locations to place my traps...
translation: 그러니까 거기가 덫 놓기 제일 좋은 장소겠네요...

english: Traps?! Preposterous! These fine exotic Birds are to be watched and not harmed in any way!
translation: 덫이요?! 말도 안 돼요! 이 멋진 이국의 새들은 보기만 해야지 절대로 해쳐선 안 돼요!

english: Did I say traps? Oh, I meant, umm, feeding them! Yes! I could feed them.
translation: 제가 덫이라고 했나요? 아, 그러니까, 음, 먹이 주기요! 네! 먹이를 줄 수 있겠다고요.

english: You should not interfere with the birds, just watch, no feeding them anything! Not even seeds!
translation: 새들한테 간섭하면 안 돼요. 그냥 보기만 해요. 먹이도 아무것도 주지 마세요! 씨앗도요!

english: Seeds you say...
You seem a little, twitchy...
Yes, well, perhaps a bit! There are new exotic birds everywhere on this island! I guess I'm getting a little over-excited.
translation: 네, 뭐, 조금 그럴지도요! 이 섬엔 어딜 가나 새로운 이국의 새들이 있거든요! 제가 좀 흥분했나 봐요.

english: Yeah, there sure are a lot of birds... For now.
It's my fathers fault entirely, constantly talking about falconry...
translation: 이게 다 아버지 탓이에요. 맨날 매 사냥 얘기만 하시니...

english: Your father is a hunter? Does he know anything about hunting birds?
translation: 아버지가 사냥꾼이세요? 새 사냥에 대해서도 좀 아세요?

english: Umm, well of course, falcons ARE hunting birds, they mostly catch varying types of kebbits, it's rather mundane.
translation: 음, 뭐 당연하죠. 매가 바로 사냥하는 새니까요. 매는 주로 여러 종류의 kebbits(케빗)을 잡는데, 꽤 따분해요.

english: And mice?
Hmmm...
Goodbye.
...Oh, you're still here. What was that? Oh yes, bye for now!
translation: ...아, 아직 계셨네요. 뭐라고요? 아 그렇지, 그럼 다음에 봬요!

english: Observing what?
You seem a little, twitchy...
Goodbye.
I am proud that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle. I thank you on behalf of all my kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 선조의 투구가 전장에서 쓰이게 되다니 자랑스럽네. 내 모든 동족을 대신해 자네에게 감사하네, [Fremennik name].

english: I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
translation: 이런 투구를 주셔서 다시 한번 감사드려요.

english: Have you got any more of those helms?
What, the priceless heirloom that I gave to you as a sign of my trust and gratitude?
translation: 뭐라, 내가 신뢰와 감사의 표시로 자네에게 준 그 값을 매길 수 없는 가보 말인가?

english: Err yes, that one. I may have mislaid it.
translation: 어, 네, 그거요. 어디 잃어버린 것 같아서요.

english: It's a good job I have alert and loyal men who notice when such a precious item is left laying around, and who pick it up.
translation: 그런 귀한 물건이 아무 데나 굴러다니면 알아채고 주워 오는 눈 밝고 충직한 부하들이 있어 다행이군.

english: I'm afraid I'm going to have to charge you a 50,000 coin handling cost.
Well, yes, I do. But I'm going to have to charge you 50,000 coins - these are precious, you know!
translation: 음, 그래, 있네. 하지만 50,000코인은 받아야겠어. 귀한 물건이란 말일세!

english: Very well, I accept.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 그만한 돈은 없을 것 같아요, 죄송해요.

english: Well, come back when you can.
You have done well, [player name]!
I thank you again for presenting me with such a helm.
translation: 이런 투구를 주셔서 다시 한번 감사드려요.

english: Have you got any more of those helms?
Very well, I accept.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 그만한 돈은 없을 것 같아요, 죄송해요.

english: Those children are nothing but trouble - if I did not watch them all the time, Seren knows what trouble they would get in to!
translation: 저 애들은 정말 말썽꾸러기라니까요. 제가 늘 지켜보지 않으면 무슨 사고를 칠지 Seren(세렌)께서나 아실 거예요!

english: They look old enough to look after themselves.
translation: 혼자 알아서 할 만한 나이로 보이는데요.

english: They are only 34 and 38, far too young to be left unsupervised.
translation: 겨우 서른넷, 서른여덟인걸요. 그냥 내버려 두기엔 너무 어려요.

english: Only!?! How old does that make you?
translation: 겨우요!?! 그럼 당신은 대체 몇 살이에요?

english: Has no one told you it is rude to ask a lady her age?
translation: 숙녀에게 나이를 묻는 건 실례라고 아무도 안 가르쳐 줬나요?

english: Sorry, I wasn't thinking. Anyway... I'd better stop distracting you.
translation: 죄송해요, 생각이 짧았어요. 아무튼... 더 방해하지 않을게요.

english: Okay, See you some other time.
I can't thank you enough for what you did. My children might be dead if not for you.
translation: 당신이 해 준 일은 아무리 감사해도 모자라요. 당신이 아니었으면 우리 애들은 죽었을지도 몰라요.

english: It's not a problem.
You're a hero and all of us here know it. Again, thank you.
translation: 당신은 영웅이에요. 여기 있는 우리 모두가 알고 있어요. 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: Here, have this.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
What do you think you're doing?
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 당신 사실 꽤 강한데, Zanaris(자나리스)에 있는 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 임무를 받는 게 낫지 않겠수?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 아, 그럼 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 좋구먼, 아주 잘하고 있수. 새 임무는 [task monster]을(를) [amount]마리 처치하는 거요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌우! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 오시우.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [task monster] 사냥 중이구먼. [amount]마리 남았수. 임무를 끝내면 다시 오시우.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신한테 안 맞는 것 같구먼. 취소해 드릴까? 임무 연속 기록은 지워지지 않수.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 알겠수, 임무는 취소된 걸로 하겠수. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있수.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있나요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 여러 가지 있수.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 수 있수.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠수. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하고 있으니, 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요. 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요. 전 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠수. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 거요.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 마법으로 당신과 얘기하고 있어요.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
I need another assignment.
No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 아, 그럼 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있나요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요. 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요. 전 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Well done on releasing me. Would you like to try another maze?
translation: 나를 풀어 주다니 훌륭합니다. 다른 미로에도 도전해 보시겠습니까?

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Very well. Talk to me if you want to move onto the next maze, or you can return to the entrance hall through the portal.
translation: 알겠습니다. 다음 미로로 넘어가고 싶으시면 저에게 말씀하십시오. 아니면 포털을 통해 입구 홀로 돌아가실 수 있습니다.

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Nice weather we're having today!
Hello [player name], fine day today!
Please leave me alone, a parrot stole my banana.
translation: 저 좀 내버려 둬요. 앵무새가 제 바나나를 훔쳐 갔다고요.

english: Are you me? Am I you?
Leave me alone... Me...
You've got an outrageous accent, you silly thing!
How dare you! You know you're so ugly!
translation: 감히! 너 진짜 못생긴 거 알지!

english: Call that an attack? Try this on for size!
translation: 그걸 공격이라고 해? 이거나 맛 좀 봐라!

english: Stop hitting yourself, stop hitting yourself!
translation: 왜 자꾸 네가 널 때려? 자기 자신 좀 그만 때리라고!

english: Oooo. Get you! Strong words from such a weed!
translation: 오오, 잘났어 정말! 그런 약골 주제에 말은 세게 하네!

english: If I'm a weed what does that make you?
Hey! That's my line!
Do I look bothered?
You do know those clothes make you look fat!
translation: 그 옷 입으니까 뚱뚱해 보이는 거 알지!

english: Hello!
'ello sail her!
Who are you?
I glamorous weather girl. I get weather numbers to learn how weather work.
translation: 나 화려한 날씨 아가씨. 나 날씨 숫자 모아서 날씨 어떻게 되는지 배움.

english: An unusual aspiration for a troll.
I like weather since I got my name. My first food gave me shiny weather number getter.
translation: 나 이름 생긴 다음부터 날씨 좋아함. 내 첫 음식이 반짝반짝 날씨 숫자 모으개 줬음.

english: Can I help you with collecting weather data?
You already get me weather number here. Was very tasty!
translation: 너 벌써 여기서 나한테 날씨 숫자 갖다줌. 아주 맛있었음!

english: Goodbye!
Bye sail her!
Numbers so tasty. Weather here must be really good!
translation: 숫자 너무 맛있음. 여기 날씨 진짜 좋은가 봄!

english: Troll scientists really do operate on a higher level don't they?
translation: 트롤 과학자들은 정말 차원이 다른 수준에서 일하네요, 그렇죠?

english: Soon I be smart enough to speak to rocks!
translation: 곧 나 바위랑 말할 만큼 똑똑해짐!

english: Who are you?
Can I help you with collecting weather data?
Goodbye!
Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
Who are you?
I'm Meddwl, a simple forest dweller.
translation: 저는 Meddwl(메드울), 숲에 사는 평범한 사람이에요.

english: It's nice to meet you Meddwl, I'm [player name].
And it's great to meet you, [player name].
What do you do here?
I'm new here, I recently left my home of Gwenith.
translation: 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐어요. 얼마 전에 고향 Gwenith(그웨니스)를 떠나왔거든요.

english: How come?
Gwenith may be in the forest, it is not part of the forest. I desired to be closer to nature.
translation: Gwenith(그웨니스)는 숲속에 있긴 해도 숲의 일부는 아니에요. 저는 자연에 더 가까이 있고 싶었어요.

english: A lovely idea, how's it going?
It's a harder living without the protection of four walls and a roof, but the peace is a wonderful thing to behold. Just listen...
translation: 벽 네 개와 지붕의 보호 없이 사는 건 더 힘들지만, 이 평화로움은 정말 경이로워요. 잘 들어 보세요...

english: Isn't it lovely?
It is! I feel almost lighter.
translation: 정말요! 몸이 좀 가벼워진 것 같아요.

english: That's your demons flittering away, taken by the cool breeze of nature.
translation: 마음속 악마들이 시원한 자연의 바람에 실려 훨훨 날아가는 거예요.

english: Any who, was there anything else you wanted?
Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
So what do you do?
I breed Terrorbirds.
Why are they called Terrorbirds?
Well, they're supposed to look terrifying but I think they are rather cute.
translation: 음, 무시무시하게 생겨야 한다는데, 제 눈엔 꽤 귀여워 보여요.

english: I'm sure they are cute, unless they are biting your arm off.
Oh they'd never do that - unless I tell them to, of course.
translation: 에이, 그럴 리가요 - 물론 제가 시키면 얘기가 다르지만요.

english: I'd better stay on your good side then!
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 알맞은 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같아요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만 내놓을 수 있어요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Dalila
translation: Dalila(달릴라)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) 건넨다.

english: Ah, just in time for a break. Thank you.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number] 크레딧을 모았어요. 노움 음식을 [number]개 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받아 오세요. 더 이상 필요 없는 배달 상자는 버린다.

english: Hi! I'm Megan. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: 안녕하세요! 전 Megan(메건)이에요. Party Room(파티 룸)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: One beer please Megan!
Coming right up [sir/ma'am]! That's two gold please.
I'm sorry but I don't have enough money!
Can you dance, Megan?
Can I dance?!
CAN I dance?!!
Dance with me Megan!
The player and Megan simultaneously dance and cheer, then end in a bow.
translation: 플레이어와 Megan(메건)이 함께 춤추며 환호하다가 인사로 마무리한다.

english: Do you have any news?
Not at the moment. I've heard that the known world is expanding as new places are discovered.
translation: 지금은 별로 없어요. 새로운 곳들이 발견되면서 알려진 세상이 넓어지고 있다고 들었어요.

english: These are exciting times indeed!
One beer please Megan!
Can you dance, Megan?
Do you have any news?
Hello?
The spirit looks at you for a moment, before you suddenly hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: 영혼이 잠시 당신을 바라보더니, 갑자기 머릿속에 목소리가 울려 퍼진다.

english: Curious... It has been a long time since I've spoken to another. The last time was when my body still had form. Tell me, stranger, what brings you to my tomb?
translation: 기이하군... 다른 이와 말을 나눈 지 참으로 오래되었소. 마지막은 내 몸에 아직 형체가 있던 때였지. 말해 보시오, 낯선 이여. 무슨 일로 내 무덤에 왔소?

english: I was looking for some scabarites.
Ah, yes. The fallen remnants of my once great sect. You will find plenty of them here. Why do you seek them?
translation: 아, 그렇군. 한때 위대했던 내 교단의 타락한 잔재들이오. 이곳에 얼마든지 있소. 어째서 그들을 찾는 것이오?

english: Do you know of Amascut, the Devourer?
All too well.
There's an old tomb south of here. Amascut has been excavating the entrance, and the scabarites have been helping her. She's looking for something inside, but I don't know what.
translation: 여기 남쪽에 오래된 무덤이 있어요. Amascut(아마스컷)이 그 입구를 파헤치고 있고, 스카바라이트들이 그녀를 돕고 있어요. 안에서 뭔가를 찾고 있는데, 그게 뭔지는 몰라요.

english: I see. If you are an enemy of the Devourer and her corrupt scabarites, then you are a friend to me. I am Mehhar, and I can help you.
translation: 그렇군. 그대가 포식자와 그 타락한 스카바라이트들의 적이라면, 그대는 나의 벗이오. 나는 Mehhar(메하르), 그대를 도울 수 있소.

english: You can help? Do you know of this tomb?
translation: 도와주실 수 있다고요? 그 무덤에 대해 아세요?

english: Even when I still lived, the desert hid many secrets. Now, centuries later, it hides even more. Of all those secrets, few are greater than the ones hidden in that tomb.
translation: 내가 살아 있을 때에도 사막은 많은 비밀을 품고 있었소. 수 세기가 흐른 지금은 더 많은 것을 감추고 있지. 그 모든 비밀 중에서도, 그 무덤에 숨겨진 것만큼 큰 비밀은 드물다오.

english: Whose tomb is it?
It is the resting place of my father, Osmumten. He was once Pharaoh of these lands. My destiny was to succeed him, but the usurpers saw an end to that.
translation: 내 아버지 Osmumten(오스뭄텐)의 안식처요. 아버지는 한때 이 땅의 파라오였소. 내 운명은 아버지의 뒤를 잇는 것이었으나, 찬탈자들이 그것을 끝내 버렸지.

english: And what are the secrets in his tomb?
translation: 그럼 그 무덤에 있는 비밀은 뭔가요?

english: Being a Pharaoh offers many luxuries, both in life and in death. Many strive only for these luxuries. They forget that being a Pharaoh also comes with responsibility.
translation: 파라오가 되면 삶에서도 죽음에서도 많은 호사를 누리오. 많은 이들이 오직 그 호사만을 좇지. 파라오에게는 책임 또한 따른다는 것을 잊고 말이오.

english: My father had a responsibility greater than most. At the time of his rule, our people were locked in a great war. To hold back the Ruinous Powers, our gods granted us immensely powerful weapons.
translation: 내 아버지의 책임은 누구보다 무거웠소. 아버지가 다스리던 시절, 우리 백성은 거대한 전쟁에 휘말려 있었지. Ruinous Powers(파멸의 힘)을 막아 내도록 우리 신들께서 엄청난 힘을 지닌 무기들을 내려 주셨소.

english: When the war was over, my father was tasked with hiding those weapons, lest they fall into nefarious hands. Two of them were buried with him. They will be what the Devourer seeks.
translation: 전쟁이 끝나자, 아버지는 그 무기들이 사악한 자들의 손에 들어가지 않도록 숨기는 임무를 맡았소. 그중 둘이 아버지와 함께 묻혔지. 포식자가 찾는 것은 바로 그것이오.

english: What are these weapons?
I trust you are aware of what the Devourer desires?
translation: 포식자가 무엇을 원하는지는 그대도 알고 있으리라 믿소.

english: Souls?
Yes. When the war ended and the Devourer rose from the ashes, she did so with only one goal. She will not stop until every soul, living or dead, has been destroyed.
translation: 그렇소. 전쟁이 끝나고 포식자가 잿더미에서 일어났을 때, 그녀에게는 오직 하나의 목표뿐이었소. 산 자든 죽은 자든, 모든 영혼이 파괴될 때까지 그녀는 멈추지 않을 것이오.

english: And these weapons can help her?
Many would call the Devourer a god, but they speak only half truths. She is a demi-goddess of limited power, and does not possess the means to devour souls on a mass scale.
translation: 많은 이들이 포식자를 신이라 부르지만, 그것은 반쪽짜리 진실일 뿐이오. 그녀는 힘이 제한된 반신이며, 영혼을 대규모로 집어삼킬 수단을 지니고 있지 않소.

english: The weapons in my father's tomb can be used to drain a being of divine energy and transfer that energy to another. If used correctly, they would grant the Devourer true godhood.
translation: 내 아버지의 무덤에 있는 무기들은 어떤 존재에게서 신성한 힘을 빼앗아 다른 이에게 옮길 수 있소. 제대로 쓰인다면, 포식자는 진정한 신이 될 것이오.

english: Then I need to get into that tomb and stop her.
translation: 그럼 그 무덤에 들어가서 그녀를 막아야겠네요.

english: Before you leave, I ask that you remember your original purpose here.
translation: 떠나기 전에, 그대가 이곳에 온 본래 목적을 기억해 주길 바라오.

english: The scabarites?
Yes. They have made their home here in my tomb, disturbing my rest. From the chamber above, the High Priest of Scabaras commands them.
translation: 그렇소. 그들은 내 무덤에 둥지를 틀고 나의 안식을 어지럽히고 있소. 위쪽 방에서 High Priest of Scabaras(스카바라스의 대사제)가 그들을 부리고 있지.

english: He believes he does so in the name of Scabaras. He does not realise that he is actually a puppet of the Devourer.
translation: 그는 Scabaras(스카바라스)의 이름으로 그리한다고 믿고 있소. 자신이 실은 포식자의 꼭두각시라는 것을 깨닫지 못한 채 말이오.

english: Free him of her control, and the Devourer will be without a powerful resource. It will also allow me to rest once more.
translation: 그를 그녀의 지배에서 풀어 주시오. 그러면 포식자는 강력한 수족을 잃게 될 것이오. 나 또한 다시 안식을 얻을 수 있을 것이고.

english: He might also know more about what Amascut is planning. I did free a guard from Amascut's control through combat. I could try that again.
translation: 그라면 Amascut(아마스컷)이 무슨 계획을 꾸미는지 더 알고 있을지도 몰라요. 전에 싸워서 아마스컷의 지배에서 경비병 하나를 풀어 준 적이 있어요. 그 방법을 다시 써 볼 수도 있겠네요.

english: When the Devourer first emerged, Icthlarin himself taught us an incantation to free an individual from her control. I would suggest you use it, rather than risking harm to the High Priest.
translation: 포식자가 처음 나타났을 때, Icthlarin(익스라린)께서 친히 그녀의 지배에서 사람을 풀어 주는 주문을 가르쳐 주셨소. 대사제를 다치게 할 위험을 무릅쓰기보다는 그 주문을 쓰길 권하오.

english: Ah, that seems wise. What's this incantation?
translation: 아, 그게 현명하겠네요. 그 주문이 뭔데요?

english: 'Majaan, Manand, Almuk.' Be warned, while it will work on those she has hypnotised, it will have no effect on her corrupted akhs. They are sadly beyond saving.
translation: 'Majaan, Manand, Almuk(마잔, 마난드, 알무크).' 경고하건대, 그녀에게 최면당한 자들에게는 통하겠지만 그녀 손에 타락한 akh(아크)들에게는 아무 효과가 없소. 안타깝게도 그들은 구할 길이 없다오.

english: I see. Thank you, Mehhar.
You will find a key to the upper chamber in an urn to the back of this room. Now go, with the blessing of Scabaras.
translation: 이 방 안쪽의 항아리에서 위쪽 방으로 가는 열쇠를 찾을 수 있을 것이오. 이제 가시오, Scabaras(스카바라스)의 축복과 함께.

english: Tell me more about yourself.
In life I was Mehhar, son of Osmumten. To me, my death was mere moments ago. To you on the other hand, I am surely considered ancient.
translation: 생전에 나는 Osmumten(오스뭄텐)의 아들 Mehhar(메하르)였소. 내게는 죽음이 불과 얼마 전의 일이오. 하지만 그대에게 나는 분명 아득히 오래된 존재로 여겨지겠지.

english: How ancient?
I sense that the gods have long since departed this world, but when I lived, they still walked among us.
translation: 신들이 이 세상을 떠난 지 오래되었음이 느껴지오. 하지만 내가 살던 때에는 신들이 아직 우리 가운데를 거닐었소.

english: And your father, Osmumten? You said he was the Pharaoh. What happened?
translation: 그럼 아버지 Osmumten(오스뭄텐)은요? 파라오였다고 하셨잖아요. 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요?

english: My father ruled during the great war. While the war was eventually won, many considered the cost too great. My father led us with the support of the gods, yet he was the one people blamed.
translation: 아버지는 거대한 전쟁 동안 나라를 다스렸소. 결국 전쟁에서 이겼지만, 많은 이들이 그 대가가 너무 컸다고 여겼지. 아버지는 신들의 지원을 받아 우리를 이끌었으나, 사람들이 탓한 것은 아버지였소.

english: So they killed him?
Him, and the rest of my family. I would have died as well, were it not for the bravery of my father's servants. They gave their lives, so that I might live.
translation: 아버지와 나머지 가족 모두를 말이오. 아버지의 하인들이 용감하게 나서지 않았다면 나 역시 죽었을 것이오. 그들은 내가 살 수 있도록 목숨을 바쳤소.

english: And then you came here?
To Ullek? Yes. I found solace here with a group dedicated to Scabaras. In time, I became their leader, and the Sect of Scabaras was formed.
translation: Ullek(울렉)으로 말이오? 그렇소. 나는 이곳에서 Scabaras(스카바라스)를 섬기는 무리에게서 위안을 얻었소. 시간이 흘러 내가 그들의 지도자가 되었고, Sect of Scabaras(스카바라스 교단)이 세워졌지.

english: There's not much left of Ullek now, or the sect.
translation: 지금은 Ullek(울렉)도, 교단도 별로 남은 게 없어요.

english: That is no surprise. Such is the fate of all things. Still, while the sect would have eventually decayed, it was the Devourer's corruption that quickened its demise.
translation: 놀랄 일도 아니오. 모든 것이 그렇게 되는 법이니. 그래도, 교단이 언젠가는 쇠퇴했겠지만 그 몰락을 앞당긴 것은 포식자의 타락이었소.

english: I'm sorry.
Don't be. You have a chance to free the High Priest of Scabaras. If you do, the sect may yet be reborn.
translation: 그럴 것 없소. 그대에게는 High Priest of Scabaras(스카바라스의 대사제)를 풀어 줄 기회가 있소. 그리된다면, 교단이 다시 태어날 수도 있을 것이오.

english: What do you know about Amascut?
The one you call Amascut died long ago. In her place, the Devourer was born.
translation: 그대가 Amascut(아마스컷)이라 부르는 자는 오래전에 죽었소. 그 자리에서 포식자가 태어났지.

english: How did it happen?
Only Icthlarin himself knows the true answer to that question.
translation: 그 질문의 진정한 답은 오직 Icthlarin(익스라린)께서만 아시오.

english: Okay... but you must have some idea?
translation: 그렇군요... 하지만 짐작 가는 건 있으시잖아요?

english: During the great war, our forces were decimated by the servants of the Ruinous Powers. To turn the tide, Icthlarin and Amascut sought powerful allies to aid us.
translation: 거대한 전쟁 동안, 우리 군대는 Ruinous Powers(파멸의 힘)의 하수인들에게 처참히 무너졌소. 전세를 뒤집기 위해 Icthlarin(익스라린)과 Amascut(아마스컷)은 우리를 도울 강력한 동맹을 찾아 나섰지.

english: They found them far from here, in a place beyond this world. A powerful race of faceless ones. They became Icthlarin's Stern Judges.
translation: 그들은 이곳에서 먼 곳, 이 세상 너머에서 동맹을 찾았소. 얼굴 없는 자들이라는 강대한 종족이었지. 그들이 Icthlarin(익스라린)의 Stern Judges(엄정한 심판관)이 되었소.

english: What's that got to do with Amascut?
Upon her return, Amascut vanished. She played no further part in the war. Only when the fighting was over did she reappear, but it wasn't really her at all.
translation: 돌아온 뒤 Amascut(아마스컷)은 자취를 감추었소. 그 뒤로 전쟁에는 전혀 관여하지 않았지. 싸움이 끝나고 나서야 다시 나타났는데, 그것은 사실 그녀가 전혀 아니었소.

english: So you think it had something to do with the Stern Judges?
translation: 그럼 그게 Stern Judges(엄정한 심판관)과 관련이 있다고 생각하세요?

english: It seems highly likely.
Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: 말씀하신 전쟁에 대해 더 얘기해 주세요.

english: It started during the rule of my grandmother. An ever-expanding empire to the north set their sights on our lands. War soon broke out.
translation: 전쟁은 내 할머니께서 다스리던 시절에 시작되었소. 북쪽에서 끝없이 세력을 넓히던 제국이 우리 땅을 노렸지. 곧 전쟁이 터졌소.

english: The armies of the Ruinous Powers were far stronger than our own. That was until Icthlarin's Stern Judges joined the fray. Thanks to them, the war was seemingly won.
translation: Ruinous Powers(파멸의 힘)의 군대는 우리보다 훨씬 강했소. Icthlarin(익스라린)의 Stern Judges(엄정한 심판관)이 싸움에 뛰어들기 전까지는 말이오. 그들 덕분에 전쟁은 이긴 것처럼 보였지.

english: It wasn't really though, was it?
No. Among the Stern Judges, there was a serpent. After my father became Pharaoh, this serpent convinced the others to abandon us.
translation: 그렇소. Stern Judges(엄정한 심판관) 가운데 뱀 같은 자가 하나 있었소. 아버지가 파라오가 된 뒤, 그 뱀이 다른 이들을 꾀어 우리를 저버리게 했지.

english: They joined the enemy?
They did. We were powerless against a force of that might. Nothing could stop their advance.
translation: 그랬소. 그만한 힘 앞에서 우리는 무력했소. 그 무엇도 그들의 진격을 막을 수 없었지.

english: So how did the war end?
It was Tumeken himself. He sacrificed himself to annihilate the enemy. The cost was great, but the war was won.
translation: Tumeken(투메켄)께서 친히 나서셨소. 그분은 스스로를 희생해 적을 섬멸하셨지. 대가는 컸지만, 전쟁은 승리로 끝났소.

english: So Tumeken died?
That's a matter of perspective. I died long ago, and yet we are still having this conversation.
translation: 보기 나름이오. 나도 오래전에 죽었지만, 우리는 이렇게 대화를 나누고 있지 않소.

english: That doesn't really answer my question.
translation: 그건 제 질문에 대한 답이 아닌 것 같은데요.

english: While Tumeken himself may be gone, he lives on through his four avatars. While they walk among us, Tumeken will always be at our side.
translation: Tumeken(투메켄)께서 떠나셨다 해도, 그분은 네 화신을 통해 살아 계시오. 그들이 우리 가운데를 거니는 한, 투메켄께서는 언제나 우리 곁에 계실 것이오.

english: I'd better get going.
Scabaras be with you.
Hello, Mehhar.
I sense that the Devourer's corruption has been lessened. I trust you were successful?
translation: 포식자의 타락이 약해진 것이 느껴지오. 성공한 것이라 믿어도 되겠소?

english: The High Priest is free.
You have my thanks.
Does this mean you can rest now?
translation: 그럼 이제 쉬실 수 있는 건가요?

english: That was my hope, but while the High Priest is free, many scabarites have been lost to the Devourer. As you will have seen, they have descended on my tomb, hoping to reclaim it.
translation: 그러길 바랐소만, 대사제는 풀려났어도 많은 스카바라이트들이 포식자에게 넘어가 버렸소. 그대도 보았겠지만, 그들이 내 무덤을 되찾으려고 몰려들었다오.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: Continue your fight against the Devourer. Only with her defeat, will we finally find freedom.
translation: 포식자와 계속 맞서 싸워 주시오. 그녀를 물리쳐야만 우리가 마침내 자유를 찾을 수 있소.

english: Welcome back, adventurer.
Tell me more about yourself.
What do you know about Amascut?
Tell me more about the war you mentioned.
translation: 말씀하신 전쟁에 대해 더 얘기해 주세요.

english: I'd better get going.
It can't be that hard can it?
I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
translation: 어떻게 되든, 오늘이 제 마지막 피의 십일조 날이 되겠네요.

english: I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
translation: 난 Theatre(피의 극장)에서 살아남을 거야! Serafina(세라피나)처럼!

english: Soon I will be free!
I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
translation: 여기 온 게 실수였다는 생각이 들기 시작했어요.

english: Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
translation: 얘기할 시간 없어요. 마음의 준비를 해야 해서요.

english: What? What's wrong?
Nothing, I just need to ask a couple of questions.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 몇 가지 물어보려고요.

english: Oh, hello. How's everything?
Not too bad thanks, but I wanted to ask a question.
translation: 그럭저럭 괜찮아요, 고마워요. 그런데 물어볼 게 있어서요.

english: Hello?
Hello, I wonder if I could ask some questions.
Hey, don't sneak up on me like that!
Sorry, didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to ask a question.
translation: 죄송해요, 놀라게 하려던 건 아니었어요. 그냥 물어볼 게 있었어요.

english: Well, I guess so.
What do you do here?
I'm barely surviving...
When I'm not being drained of blood, the vyrewatch force me to repair the walls.
translation: 피를 뽑히지 않을 때는 vyrewatch(바이어워치)가 억지로 성벽을 고치게 시켜요.

english: When I'm not being drained of blood I'm fixing up the ghetto.
translation: 피를 뽑히지 않을 때는 빈민가를 손보고 있어요.

english: I just try to make a living the best way I can. You haven't got some food have you?
translation: 그냥 할 수 있는 한 어떻게든 먹고살려고 해요. 혹시 먹을 거 좀 없어요?

english: Like everyone else, I just survive here. Just try to keep alive till after the next blood tithe. That's when they feed us.
translation: 다른 사람들처럼 저도 그냥 여기서 버티고 있어요. 다음 피의 십일조가 끝날 때까지 살아 있으려고 애쓰는 거죠. 그때 먹을 걸 주거든요.

english: Why do you wanna know?
Just curious, that's all.
I dunno. I don't know if I can trust you...
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Well, you're in sector [one/two/three/four/five/six], but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 음, 여기는 [one/two/three/four/five/six] 구역이에요. 그 밖에 다른 도움을 바란 거라면 정말 미안해요. 저 하나 건사하기도 벅차거든요.

english: Life's so very hard here. Before too long they'll be wanting to have another blood tithing and then I'll feel just awful again.
translation: 여기 사는 건 정말 너무 힘들어요. 머지않아 또 피의 십일조를 거두려 할 테고, 그럼 전 또 끔찍하게 몸이 안 좋아지겠죠.

english: What's a blood tithing?
You must be new here, else you'd know for sure. It's where we have to give a blood tithe to the vampyres. They do it on a weekly basis, a different sector each week so they don't kill us all off.
translation: 여기 처음 왔나 보네요, 아니면 모를 리가 없거든요. vampyres(뱀파이어)에게 피의 십일조를 바쳐야 하는 거예요. 매주 하는데, 우리를 몽땅 죽이지 않으려고 매주 다른 구역에서 거둬 가요.

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
It's probably best not to talk about that, friend.
translation: 그 얘긴 안 하는 게 좋을 거예요, 친구.

english: I need to make contact with them. Please don't worry - I'm on their side.
translation: 그들과 연락해야 해요. 걱정 마세요 - 전 그들 편이에요.

english: As are we all, but I really can't talk about them. It's not a subject easily broached here.
translation: 우리 모두 그렇죠. 하지만 그들 얘기는 정말 못 해요. 여기선 쉽게 꺼낼 수 있는 얘기가 아니거든요.

english: The Myreque are gone. Do not speak of them, it will do you no good.
translation: Myreque(미레크)는 사라졌어요. 그들 얘기는 하지 마세요, 좋을 게 하나도 없어요.

english: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
Yep, that's where we are at the moment. This place, Meiyerditch, is just one large ghetto.
translation: 네, 지금 우리가 있는 곳이 거기예요. 이곳 Meiyerditch(메이어디치)는 그냥 하나의 커다란 빈민가예요.

english: The city is sectioned off so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill us all off in one go.
translation: 도시는 구역별로 나뉘어 있어서 vampyres(뱀파이어)가 돌아가며 피의 십일조를 거둬 가요. 그래야 우리를 한 번에 다 죽이지 않으니까요.

english: What do you know about the vampyres?

They're monsters, I know that much. I've never known anything else, but I have a feeling it might be nice to not have to live in fear the whole time. Worrying if I'm going to make the next blood tithe quota.
translation: 그놈들은 괴물이에요, 그건 확실히 알아요. 다른 삶은 겪어 본 적이 없지만, 늘 두려움 속에 살지 않아도 된다면 좋을 것 같다는 생각이 들어요. 다음 피의 십일조 할당량을 채울 수 있을지 걱정하지 않아도 되고요.

english: I know that the juveniles are the lowest form of the vampyres. Apparently they were human once, converted by the vampyres.
translation: juveniles(주버나일)이 vampyres(뱀파이어) 중에서 가장 하급이라는 건 알아요. 원래는 인간이었는데 뱀파이어들이 바꿔 놓았대요.

english: Then you have juvinates. They're initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to get some powers.
translation: 그다음엔 juvinates(주비네이트)가 있어요. 훈련을 좀 받고 힘을 얻기 시작한, 입문을 마친 주버나일들이에요.

english: After that you have the vyres. They're nasty... really nasty.
translation: 그 위로는 vyres(바이어)가 있어요. 그놈들은 끔찍해요... 정말 끔찍하죠.

english: What do you know about Drakan?
Drakan? Which one: Ranis or Vanescula?
translation: Drakan(드라칸)이요? 어느 쪽이요, Ranis(라니스)요, 아니면 Vanescula(바네스쿨라)요?

english: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.
translation: 음, 제 말은 우두머리 Drakan(드라칸)이요. 그러니까, Morytania(모리타니아)의 지배자 말이에요.

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Ranis or Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: 흠, 그는 몇 년째 모습을 보이지 않았어요. 가끔 Ranis(라니스)나 Vanescula(바네스쿨라)가 날아다니는 걸 봤다는 사람들은 있는데, 그리 자주는 아니에요.

english: Vanescula?
Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.
translation: 흠, 그는 몇 년째 모습을 보이지 않았어요. 가끔 Vanescula(바네스쿨라)가 날아다니는 걸 봤다는 사람들은 있는데, 그리 자주는 아니에요.

english: No one had seen anything of him for years, they say he's back now though. We shouldn't talk of him any more though, the vyrewatch might not like it.
translation: 몇 년 동안 아무도 그를 보지 못했는데, 이제 돌아왔다고들 해요. 그래도 그 얘긴 더 하지 말아요, vyrewatch(바이어워치)가 싫어할지도 몰라요.

english: What is there to do around here?
To do? Around here? Survive! Eke out an existence and just live for another day, that's it really.
translation: 할 거요? 여기서요? 살아남는 거죠! 어떻게든 연명하면서 하루하루 버티는 거, 그게 다예요.

english: The juvinates organise work crews to mine the daeyalt, fix the walls, the castles and so on. If we refuse to do the work, they put us on double tithes and you can't do that for long before you dry up.
translation: juvinates(주비네이트)가 작업반을 짜서 daeyalt(데이얄트)를 캐고, 성벽이랑 성 같은 걸 고치게 해요. 일을 거부하면 십일조를 두 배로 물리는데, 그러면 얼마 못 가서 바싹 말라 버려요.

english: If you want to escape, there's only one way. Anyone who survives in the theatre gets to leave. It's pointless though. No one survives.
translation: 여길 벗어나고 싶다면 방법은 하나뿐이에요. theatre(피의 극장)에서 살아남는 사람은 누구든 떠날 수 있어요. 그래 봤자 소용없지만요. 아무도 살아남지 못하거든요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: It's very nice of you to offer, my friend, but I shouldn't expect that you could do anything. The vampyres are just too powerful to overcome.
translation: 그렇게 말해 줘서 정말 고마워요, 친구. 하지만 당신이 뭘 할 수 있을 거라곤 생각 안 해요. vampyres(뱀파이어)는 맞서 이기기엔 너무 강하거든요.

english: They say this place once had a Saradominist Queen. Even she could not withstand the vampyres. Anyone who has challenged their power in the past has come undone.
translation: 예전에 이곳에 Saradominist(사라도민파) 여왕이 있었대요. 그 여왕조차 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 버텨 내지 못했어요. 지금까지 그놈들의 힘에 도전한 사람은 모두 몰락했어요.

english: Okay, thanks.
What're you doin' in here? You don't belong here! Go back to where you came from, 'fore the vyrewatch sees ya.
translation: 여기서 뭐 하는 거야? 넌 여기 있을 사람이 아니야! vyrewatch(바이어워치)한테 들키기 전에 원래 있던 데로 돌아가!

english: Hello.
Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
translation: 아... 죄송해요, 저흰 귀족분들과 말하면 안 돼요.

english: What do you do here?
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
- More questions -
Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?
What do you know about the vampyres?
What do you know about Drakan?
What is there to do around here?
Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 제가 도울 수 있는 일이 있을까요?

english: Okay, thanks.
- Initial questions -
Hello there.
Oh, hello, you must be new here.
translation: 오, 안녕. 여기 처음 왔나 보군.

english: Where are we?
What, you can't tell from your surroundings that you're in a mine? You must have been hit hard on the head to not notice that.
translation: 뭐, 주변을 보고도 광산인 줄 모르겠어? 머리를 세게 얻어맞기라도 했나 보네, 그걸 못 알아보다니.

english: What do you do here?

We're miners, perhaps that might give you a clue! We're forced to mine for those stinking vyres. Once we've filled the cart, they sometimes let us go back to Meiyerditch, but then we get tithed. Don't know if I
translation: 우린 광부야, 이 정도면 감이 좀 오지! 그 역겨운 vyres(바이어) 놈들 때문에 억지로 광석을 캐고 있어. 수레를 다 채우면 가끔 Meiyerditch(메이어디치)로 돌려보내 주는데, 그러면 또 십일조로 피를 뽑혀. 난 여기가 나은지

english: prefer it in here or out there!
Do you have a spare pick?
Sure, got one here you can use.
The miner hands you a rustic-looking pickaxe.
How do you get out of here?
They can't keep you in here forever because they have to tithe you, so once you've filled the cart, they let you go. Takes about fifteen loads to get the cart filled.
translation: 십일조를 거둬야 하니까 영원히 여기 가둬 둘 수는 없거든. 그래서 수레를 다 채우면 내보내 줘. 수레를 채우려면 열다섯 번쯤 실어 날라야 해.

english: What is it that you're mining?

We're mining for daeyalt. Don't rightly know what it does - we don't ask too many questions - but I've been doing it since I was a kid. The carts keep getting filled, and they keep going along the tracks. Goes to some
translation: daeyalt(데이얄트)를 캐고 있어. 그게 어디에 쓰이는지는 잘 몰라 - 우린 질문을 많이 안 하거든 - 그래도 난 어릴 때부터 이 일을 해 왔어. 수레는 계속 채워지고, 선로를 따라 계속 굴러가. 어떤

english: huge refinery place, it does - massive, like another city under the earth.
translation: 거대한 정제소 같은 데로 간대 - 어마어마하게 커서 땅속에 도시가 하나 더 있는 것 같다더라.

english: What? Have you seen this place?
Not myself, like, but other people I know of have seen it and they wouldn't lie!
translation: 내가 직접 본 건 아니고, 내가 아는 다른 사람들이 봤는데 그 사람들은 거짓말할 사람들이 아니야!

english: You two shut up and get back to work!
translation: 너희 둘, 입 다물고 일이나 해!

english: Okay, thanks.
Hello.
Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
translation: 아... 미안합니다, 우린 귀족분들과 말하면 안 돼서요.

english: I feel so weak I could faint.
translation: 너무 기운이 없어서 쓰러질 것 같아.

english: I'm sick of this place.
I hate those Vyres.
Work work work, that's all I ever do.
translation: 일, 일, 일, 맨날 일만 하네.

english: I can't think strait, I'm so tired.
Ohh, my arms.
Ohh, my back.
I'm rich in experience, poor in wealth.
I'm so tired, I could sleep standing up.
translation: 너무 피곤해서 서서도 잘 수 있겠어.

english: What I wouldn't give for a good night's rest.
translation: 하룻밤 푹 잘 수만 있다면 뭐든 내주겠어.

english: Where are we?
What do you do here?
Do you have a spare pick?
How do you get out of here?
What is it that you're mining?
Okay, thanks.
Good to see you safe friend.
Why wouldn't I be safe?
The Vyrewatch are getting more ferocious by the day. You're doing well if you can get from one side of Meiyerditch to the other without getting attacked!
translation: Vyrewatch(바이어워치)가 날이 갈수록 사나워지고 있어요. 공격받지 않고 Meiyerditch(메이어디치)의 이쪽 끝에서 저쪽 끝까지 갈 수 있다면 정말 잘하고 있는 거예요!

english: Hello there.
Hi. Welcome to the general store. How might I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요. 잡화점에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: What can you sell me?
I have a question...
About magic of course.
Sorry?
I said about magic of course. You know, in response to your question.
translation: 당연히 마법 덕분이라고 했어요. 그러니까, 당신 질문에 대한 대답으로요.

english: But I didn't ask anything yet.
translation: 하지만 전 아직 아무것도 안 물어봤는데요.

english: Yes, but you were thinking of asking me how I was floating.
translation: 그렇죠, 하지만 제가 어떻게 떠 있는지 물어보려고 생각하고 있었잖아요.

english: That's true!
How could you possibly know that?
Don't you realise we can read your mind.
translation: 우리가 당신 마음을 읽을 수 있다는 거 몰랐어요?

english: Oh, of course. How do you manage to do that?
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 그건 어떻게 하는 거예요?

english: It's quite simple, everyone has a resonance that is responded to by the moon. This resonance changes depending on what we are thinking. You can tune yourself in to listen to this resonance with practice - it's
translation: 아주 간단해요. 모든 사람에게는 달이 반응하는 공명이 있어요. 이 공명은 무슨 생각을 하느냐에 따라 달라지죠. 연습하면 이 공명에 귀를 기울일 수 있게 자신을 맞출 수 있어요 - 그건

english: a life long quest for the members of the Moon Clan, but its especially easy to read with outsiders like yourself, as you are far louder and unguarded.
translation: Moon Clan(달 부족) 사람들에게는 평생에 걸친 과제지만, 당신 같은 외부인의 공명은 특히 읽기 쉬워요. 훨씬 시끄럽고 무방비하거든요.

english: I see. I best be careful with what I think of then.
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 무슨 생각을 하는지 조심해야겠네요.

english: That's disgusting!
Sorry.
I'm good thanks, bye.
What can you sell me?
I have a question...
I'm good thanks, bye.
Greetings adventurer, I am the Melee combat tutor. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 반갑네, 모험가. 나는 Melee combat tutor(근접 전투 교사)일세. 내가 도와줄 일이라도 있나?

english: Tell me about melee combat.
Well adventurer, the first thing you will need is a sword and a shield appropriate for your level.
translation: 그래, 모험가. 우선 자네 레벨에 맞는 검과 방패가 필요하네.

english: Make sure to equip your sword and shield. Click on them in your inventory, they will disappear from your inventory and move to your worn items. You can see your worn items in the worn items tab here.
translation: 검과 방패를 꼭 장착하게. 소지품에서 클릭하면 소지품에서 사라지고 착용 장비로 옮겨 가지. 착용 장비는 여기 착용 장비 탭에서 볼 수 있네.

english: When you are wielding your sword you will then be able to see the correct options in the combat interface.
translation: 검을 장착하고 나면 전투 인터페이스에서 알맞은 선택지를 볼 수 있을 걸세.

english: There are four different melee styles. Accurate, aggressive, defensive and controlled. Not all weapons will have all four styles though.
translation: 근접 전투 방식은 네 가지가 있네. 정확, 공격적, 방어적, 균형이지. 다만 모든 무기가 네 가지 방식을 다 갖고 있는 건 아닐세.

english: Interesting, what does each style do?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 각 방식은 어떤 효과가 있나요?

english: Well I am glad you asked. The accurate style will give you experience points in your Attack skill, you will also find you will deal damage more frequently as a result of being, well, more accurate.
translation: 물어봐 줘서 기쁘군. 정확 방식은 Attack(공격) 스킬 경험치를 주네. 그리고 말 그대로 더 정확해지니 피해를 더 자주 입히게 될 걸세.

english: Next we have the aggressive style. This style will give you experience points in your Strength skill. When using this style you will notice that your attacks will hit a little harder.
translation: 다음은 공격적 방식일세. 이 방식은 Strength(힘) 스킬 경험치를 주지. 이 방식을 쓰면 공격이 조금 더 세게 들어가는 걸 느낄 걸세.

english: Now for the defensive style, this style will give you experience points in your Defensive skill. When using this style you will notice that you get hit less often.
translation: 이제 방어적 방식인데, 이 방식은 Defence(방어) 스킬 경험치를 주네. 이 방식을 쓰면 공격을 덜 자주 맞는 걸 느낄 걸세.

english: Finally, we have the controlled style. This style will give you the same amount of experience as the other styles would but shared across all three of the combat skills.
translation: 마지막으로 균형 방식이 있네. 이 방식은 다른 방식과 같은 양의 경험치를 주지만, 세 가지 전투 스킬 모두에 나눠서 준다네.

english: If you were using the training sword for example, there are four different attack types. Stab, lunge, slash and block.
translation: 예를 들어 training sword(훈련용 검)을 쓴다면 공격 유형이 네 가지 있네. 찌르기, 돌진, 베기, 막기일세.

english: Each type uses one of the attack styles. Stab uses accurate, lunge and slash use aggressive and block uses defensive.
translation: 각 유형은 공격 방식 중 하나를 쓰네. 찌르기는 정확, 돌진과 베기는 공격적, 막기는 방어적 방식이지.

english: To find out which style an attack type uses, hover your mouse cursor over the style button.
translation: 어떤 공격 유형이 어떤 방식을 쓰는지 알고 싶으면 방식 버튼 위에 마우스 커서를 올려 보게.

english: If you need some more advice, you should talk to Adventurer Jon about Adventure paths. He may even have a handy starter kit you can use.
translation: 조언이 더 필요하면 Adventurer Jon(모험가 존)에게 Adventure paths(모험 경로)에 대해 물어보게. 쓸 만한 초보자용 장비 꾸러미를 줄지도 모르네.

english: Is there anything else you would like to know?
What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: 만약 좀 더... 사람 같은 상대와 싸우고 싶다면요?

english: Well adventurer, there are a few places you might be able to do this.
translation: 그래, 모험가. 그럴 수 있는 곳이 몇 군데 있네.

english: You could try your luck at castle wars. Here, two teams fight each other to defend their respective flags. To win the game you will need to get the other team's flag and return it to your flag stand.
translation: castle wars(캐슬 워즈)에서 운을 시험해 보게. 거기선 두 팀이 각자의 깃발을 지키려고 맞붙지. 이기려면 상대 팀 깃발을 빼앗아 자기 팀 깃발 받침대로 가져와야 하네.

english: Capture the flag, sounds like a lot of fun.
If you are in a clan, you should gather some clan members and try out clan wars. There you can see which clan is better than the other by fighting each other in an arena.
translation: 클랜에 들어 있다면 클랜원들을 모아 clan wars(클랜 전쟁)에 나가 보게. 거기선 경기장에서 서로 싸워 어느 클랜이 더 강한지 겨룰 수 있네.

english: Both activities are safe minigame, which means if you die you will not loose any of your items. You can get to them by using the teleport option in your minigames tab.
translation: 두 활동 모두 안전한 미니게임이라, 죽어도 아이템을 하나도 잃지 않네. 미니게임 탭의 순간이동 기능을 쓰면 그곳으로 갈 수 있지.

english: There is also the wilderness. The wilderness is north of Varrock and you can fight other players there. But barein mind if you die to another player in the wilderness you will lose your stuff.
translation: wilderness(황야)도 있네. 황야는 Varrock(바록) 북쪽에 있고, 거기선 다른 플레이어와 싸울 수 있지. 하지만 명심하게. 황야에서 다른 플레이어에게 죽으면 소지품을 잃게 되네.

english: But this also means that if you kill another player you will be able to take their stuff too.
translation: 하지만 그 말은 자네가 다른 플레이어를 쓰러뜨리면 그 사람의 물건을 가져갈 수도 있다는 뜻이지.

english: Only go into the wilderness with items you are willing to lose and pay attention to the wilderness level you are in. The higher the level you go, more player will be able to attack you.
translation: 황야에는 잃어도 괜찮은 아이템만 들고 가고, 지금 있는 황야 레벨을 잘 살피게. 레벨이 높은 곳으로 갈수록 더 많은 플레이어가 자네를 공격할 수 있네.

english: You can find which player can attack you by checking your combat level.
translation: 어떤 플레이어가 자네를 공격할 수 있는지는 자네 전투 레벨을 보면 알 수 있네.

english: Minus the wilderness level from your combat level to find the lowest level that you can attack, then add the wilderness level to your combat level to find the highest level that you can attack.
translation: 자네 전투 레벨에서 황야 레벨을 빼면 공격할 수 있는 가장 낮은 레벨이, 전투 레벨에 황야 레벨을 더하면 공격할 수 있는 가장 높은 레벨이 나오네.

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use.
translation: 제가 쓸 수 있는 여러 무기 종류에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about different weapon types I can use
translation: 제가 쓸 수 있는 여러 무기 종류에 대해 알려 주세요

english: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful.
translation: 어디 보자... 단검 같은 찌르기 무기가 있고, 베기용인 검이 있고, 내려치는 힘이 뛰어난 철퇴, 강력한 전투 도끼도 있지.

english: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it!
translation: 어떻게 싸우고 싶은지에 따라 많이 달라지네. 이것저것 써 보고 자네에게 가장 잘 맞는 걸 찾게. 새 무기를 써 보는 걸 절대 두려워하지 말게. 혹시 아나, 마음에 들지도 모르지!

english: While I tried all of them for a while, I settled on this rather good sword.
translation: 나도 한동안 전부 써 봤지만, 결국 이 꽤 괜찮은 검에 정착했네.

english: You might also find that different weapon types are more accurate against different monsters.
translation: 무기 종류에 따라 상대하는 몬스터별로 명중률이 달라진다는 것도 알게 될 걸세.

english: Tell me about skillcapes
Tell me about skillcapes.
Of course. Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이지. Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 업적의 상징일세. 스킬을 통달해 99레벨에 이른 사람만 손에 넣고 그 혜택을 누릴 수 있지.

english: The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: Cape of Defence(방어 망토)는 ring of life(생명의 반지) 역할을 해서, 체력이 낮아지면 전투에서 자네를 구해 준다네.

english: I'd like a training sword and shield.
translation: training sword(훈련용 검)과 방패를 받고 싶어요.

english: You already have a training sword and shield. Save some for the other adventurers.
translation: 자네는 이미 training sword(훈련용 검)과 방패를 갖고 있지 않나. 다른 모험가들 몫도 좀 남겨 두게.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
There you go, use it well.
Goodbye.

Ah, but I can see you're already a master in the fine art of Defence. Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Skillcape of Defence, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 아, 그런데 보아하니 자네는 이미 Defence(방어)라는 훌륭한 기술의 달인이로군. 혹시 Skillcape of Defence(방어 스킬 망토)를 사서, 이 까다로운 스킬을 통달한 소수 정예에 들려고 날 찾아온 건가?

english: In recognition of your defensive abilities, when you have it equipped it will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low.
translation: 자네의 방어 실력을 인정하는 뜻으로, 이 망토를 장착하면 ring of life(생명의 반지) 역할을 해서 체력이 낮아지면 전투에서 자네를 구해 준다네.

english: May I buy a Skillcape of Defence, please?
translation: Skillcape of Defence(방어 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: You wish to join the elite defenders of this world? I'm afraid such things do not come cheaply - in fact they cost 99000 coins, to be precise!
translation: 이 세상의 정예 수호자 대열에 들고 싶다는 건가? 미안하지만 그런 건 값이 만만치 않네. 정확히 말하면 99000코인일세!

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 천만에. 이렇게 명예로운 물건을 살 기회라면 반길 모험가가 얼마든지 있네! 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 날 찾아오게.

english: I think I have the money right here, actually.
translation: 사실 지금 돈을 갖고 있는 것 같아요.

english: But, unfortunately, I was mistaken.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토는 무료 두건과 함께만 팔고 있네. 스킬 판촉 행사로 하나 사면 하나 더 주는 거지. 그러니 내가 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 두게.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭하군! 자부심을 갖고 그 망토를 두르게, 친구.

english: Tell me about melee combat.
What if I wanted to fight something a bit more... human.
translation: 만약 좀 더... 사람 같은 상대와 싸우고 싶다면요?

english: Tell me about skillcapes.
I'd like a training sword and shield.
translation: training sword(훈련용 검)과 방패를 받고 싶어요.

english: Goodbye.
Yes, please sell me a Skillcape of Defence.
translation: 네, Skillcape of Defence(방어 스킬 망토)를 팔아 주세요.

english: 99000 coins? That's much too expensive.
I think I have the money right here, actually.
translation: 사실 지금 돈을 갖고 있는 것 같아요.

english: Can you tell me about different weapon types I can use?
translation: 제가 쓸 수 있는 여러 무기 종류에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: Ssssh! I'm trying to study.
Sorry, but could...
Ssssh!
But I...
SSHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착하다니 믿기지가 않아요. 빨리 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be alive!
translation: 탐험할 대륙이 통째로 새로 생기다니... 정말 살맛 나는 시대예요!

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기에 해적이랑 도둑이 있다는 얘기를 엿들었어요. 조심하세요!

english: By the power of custard!
Feel the wrath of my feet!
Let me drink my tea in peace.
translation: 차 좀 조용히 마시게 내버려 둬.

english: Leave me alone, I need to feed my pet rock.
translation: 날 내버려 둬. 내 pet rock(애완 돌)한테 밥을 줘야 한다고.

english: I'll not get through these gates; they're too heavily boarded up!
translation: 이 대문으로는 못 지나가겠어. 판자로 너무 단단히 막혀 있잖아!

english: ...And these walls don't look very climbable at all.
translation: ...게다가 이 벽은 도저히 올라갈 수 있을 것 같지 않아.

english: That's right, clear off. You're not welcome here!
translation: 그래, 꺼져라. 여긴 네가 올 곳이 아니야!

english: Hello.
What do you want?
Nothing really, I'm new to town and wanted to get to know the locals.
translation: 딱히 없어요. 이 동네에 처음 와서 동네 사람들이랑 좀 친해지고 싶었어요.

english: I'm too busy for chitchat. Come back if you have some business to discuss with us.
translation: 잡담할 시간 없어. 우리랑 할 볼일이 생기면 다시 와.

english: Yeah, what do you want?
What is this place?
It's none of your business now get lost.
Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
translation: 금화 다섯 닢이면 제가 알 바가 될까요?

english: Don't try to fool me, you don't have five gold coins! Before you try to bribe someone, make sure you have the money effendi!
translation: 날 속이려 들지 마. 너한테 금화 다섯 닢이 없다는 거 다 알아! 누굴 매수하려면 돈부터 챙기고 오라고, 나리!

english: Guards!! Guards!
Let's see how good you are with Desert Survival techniques.
translation: 네 사막 생존 기술이 얼마나 쓸 만한지 한번 보자고.

english: You're bundled into the back of a cart and blindfolded...
translation: 당신은 수레 짐칸에 처박힌 채 눈이 가려진다...

english: Sometime later you wake up in the desert.
translation: 얼마 후 당신은 사막 한가운데서 깨어난다.

english: You won't be needing that water anymore!
translation: 그 물은 이제 필요 없을 거다!

english: The guards move off leaving you stranded in the desert.
translation: 경비병들은 떠나 버리고, 당신은 사막에 홀로 남겨진다.

english: Well, it certainly will help...-- The guard takes the five gold coins. --Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: 뭐, 확실히 도움은 되지...-- 경비병이 금화 다섯 닢을 챙긴다. --자, 그럼 뭘 알고 싶었지?

english: It's just a mining camp. Prisoners are sent here from Al-Kharid. They serve out their sentence by mining. Most prisoners will end their days here, surrounded by desert.
translation: 그냥 광산 수용소야. 죄수들이 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)에서 이리로 보내지지. 광석을 캐면서 형기를 채우는 거야. 죄수들 대부분은 사막에 둘러싸인 채 여기서 생을 마감하지.

english: So you could almost say that they got their ... 'Just Desserts'
translation: 그럼 그 사람들은 말 그대로 '사막'한 인생을 사는 셈이네요... '삭막'이 아니라 '사막'.

english: You could say that...-- There is an awkward pause --
translation: 그렇게 말할 수도 있겠지...-- 어색한 침묵이 흐른다 --

english: But it wouldn't be very funny.
When they talk about 'the silence of the desert', this must be what they mean.
Can I take a look around the place?
Not really. The Captain won't let you in the compound. He's the only one who has the key to the gate. And if you talk to him, he'll probably just order us to kill you. Unless...
translation: 안 되지. Captain(대장)은 널 수용소 안에 들이지 않을 거야. 대문 열쇠는 대장만 갖고 있거든. 게다가 대장한테 말을 걸면 아마 우리더러 널 죽이라고 명령할걸. 그게 아니라면...

english: Unless what?
Unless he has a use for you. He's been trying to track down someone called 'Al Zaba Bhasim'. You could offer to catch him and that might put you in his good books?
translation: 대장이 너를 쓸모 있다고 여긴다면 말이지. 대장은 'Al Zaba Bhasim(알 자바 바심)'이라는 놈을 계속 쫓고 있어. 네가 그놈을 잡아 오겠다고 하면 대장 눈에 들지도 모르지?

english: Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: 그 Al Zaba Bhasim(알 자바 바심)은 어디서 찾을 수 있죠?

english: Well, he could be anywhere. He's a nomadic desert dweller. However, they say that he's frequently to be found to the west in the hospitality of the tenti's.
translation: 글쎄, 어디에나 있을 수 있지. 사막을 떠도는 유목민이거든. 그래도 듣자 하니 서쪽에서 Tenti's(텐티족)의 대접을 받으며 지내는 일이 잦다더군.

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
Well, we're not really sure what their proper name is. But they live in tents so we call them the 'Tenti's'.
translation: 음, 사실 그 사람들 진짜 이름은 우리도 잘 몰라. 그냥 텐트에 사니까 '텐티족'이라고 부르는 거지.

english: Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: Al Zaba Bhasim(알 자바 바심)은 많이 강한가요?

english: Well, I'm not sure, but by all accounts, he is a slippery fellow. The Captain has been trying to capture him for years. A bit of a waste of time if you ask me. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.
translation: 글쎄, 잘은 모르지만, 다들 하는 말로는 아주 미꾸라지 같은 놈이래. Captain(대장)이 몇 년째 잡으려고 애쓰고 있지. 내가 보기엔 시간 낭비지만. 아무튼 난 가 봐야겠어. 나도 할 일이 있거든.

english: What are you guarding?
Well, if you have to know, we're making sure that no prisoners get out.-- The guard gives you a disapproving look. --And to make sure that unauthorised people don't get in.
translation: 꼭 알아야겠다면 말해 주지. 죄수들이 못 빠져나가게 지키는 거야.-- 경비병이 못마땅한 눈으로 당신을 쳐다본다. --그리고 허가 없는 놈들이 못 들어오게 하는 거고.

english: -- The guard looks around nervously. --You'd better go soon before the Captain orders us to kill you.
translation: -- 경비병이 초조하게 주위를 둘러본다. --Captain(대장)이 우리더러 널 죽이라고 명령하기 전에 얼른 가는 게 좋을 거야.

english: Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
-- The guard snorts. --*Snort* Just about anyone who talks to him.
translation: -- 경비병이 코웃음을 친다. --*흥* 대장한테 말 거는 놈은 거의 다지.

english: Unless he has a use for you, he'll probably just order us to kill you. And it's such a horrible job cleaning up the mess afterwards.
translation: 대장이 널 쓸모 있다고 여기지 않으면, 아마 우리더러 널 죽이라고 명령할 거야. 그리고 그 뒤에 치우는 게 진짜 끔찍한 일이라고.

english: Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: 무의미하게 사람 목숨을 버리는 건 말할 것도 없고요.

english: Huh? Them's your words, not mine.
translation: 응? 그건 네가 한 말이지, 난 그런 말 한 적 없어.

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.
translation: Captain(대장)을 그다지 존경하는 것 같진 않네요.

english: -- The guard looks around conspiratorially. --

Well, to be honest. We think he's not exactly as brave as he makes out. But we have to follow his orders. If someone called him a coward, or managed to trick him into a one-on-one duel many of us bet that he'd be
translation: 음, 솔직히 말하면 대장은 보이는 것만큼 용감하진 않은 것 같아. 그래도 명령은 따라야 하지. 누가 대장을 겁쟁이라고 부르거나, 꾀어서 일대일 결투를 붙이면, 우리 중 꽤 많은 놈들이 대장이

english: beaten.
And how could I trick him into a one-on-one duel?
translation: 그럼 어떻게 대장을 꾀어서 일대일 결투를 하게 만들죠?

english: Like all cowards, he likes to be made to feel important. If anyone insults him outright, he just gets us to do his dirty work. However, if he thinks he's better than you, if you compliment him, he may feel that he can defeat
translation: 겁쟁이들이 다 그렇듯, 대장도 자기가 대단한 사람인 것처럼 대접받는 걸 좋아해. 대놓고 모욕하면 그냥 우리한테 궂은일을 시키지. 하지만 자기가 너보다 낫다고 생각하게 만들면, 칭찬을 해 주면, 자기가

english: you. And if he initiated a duel, all the men agreed that they wouldn't intervene. We think he'd be slaughtered in double quick time.
translation: 널 이길 수 있다고 생각할지도 몰라. 그리고 대장이 결투를 걸면, 다들 끼어들지 않기로 했어. 우린 대장이 눈 깜짝할 새에 박살 날 거라고 봐.

english: Can I have a bet on that?
Sorry, we've already taken your bet, wouldn't want any cheating now. Anyway, I have to get back to work. See ya around...
translation: 미안, 네 내기는 이미 받아 뒀어. 속임수는 곤란하거든. 아무튼 난 일하러 가야 해. 나중에 보자고...
