english: Well, if you think you stand a chance, sure. But remember, if he gives us an order, we have to obey.
translation: 뭐, 이길 자신이 있다면 그러지. 하지만 명심해. 대장이 명령하면 우린 따라야 해.

english: I'll bet 5 gold that I win.
Huh! It looks like you're betting with money you don't have.
translation: 흥! 있지도 않은 돈으로 걸려는 것 같은데.

english: Great, I'll take that bet.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 6 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: 좋아, 네가 이기면 6골드 돌려받을 거야. 아무튼 난 가 봐야겠어. 나도 할 일이 있거든.-- 경비병이 걸어간다. --

english: I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 12 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: 좋아, 네가 이기면 12골드 돌려받을 거야. 아무튼 난 가 봐야겠어. 나도 할 일이 있거든.-- 경비병이 걸어간다. --

english: I'll bet 15 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 19 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: 좋아, 네가 이기면 19골드 돌려받을 거야. 아무튼 난 가 봐야겠어. 나도 할 일이 있거든.-- 경비병이 걸어간다. --

english: I'll bet 20 gold that I win.
Ok, if you win, you'll get 30 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walks off. --
translation: 좋아, 네가 이기면 30골드 돌려받을 거야. 아무튼 난 가 봐야겠어. 나도 할 일이 있거든.-- 경비병이 걸어간다. --

english: Okay, thanks.
Yeah, whatever!
Get lost before I chop off your head!
Perhaps five gold coins will sweeten your mood?
translation: 금화 다섯 닢이면 기분이 좀 풀리실까요?

english: Well, it certainly will help!
Now then, what did you want to know?
I'm looking for a woman called Ana, have you seen her?
translation: Ana(아나)라는 여자를 찾고 있어요. 혹시 보셨어요?

english: Hmm, well, we get a lot of people in here. But not many women though... Saw one come in last week....
translation: 흠, 글쎄, 여긴 사람이 많이 들어오거든. 그래도 여자는 별로 없지... 지난주에 한 명 들어오는 걸 봤어....

english: But I don't know if it's the woman you're looking for?
translation: 근데 그게 네가 찾는 여자인지는 모르겠다?

english: No, now get lost!
Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: 금화 다섯 닢이면 기억이 좀 나실까요?

english: This mercenary looks very fierce. Are you sure you want to attack him?
translation: 이 용병은 무척 사나워 보인다. 정말 공격하시겠습니까?

english: You decide not to fight the Mercenary.
Hey, I've come to collect my bet!
Well, I guess congratulations are in order.
Thanks!
And we'll only charge the paltry sum of... erm...
The guards starts to do some mental calculations. You can see his brow furrow and he starts to sweat profusely.
translation: 경비병이 머릿속으로 계산을 시작한다. 이마에 주름이 잡히더니 땀을 비 오듯 흘리기 시작한다.

english: Five gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 1 Gold piece! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 뒤처리 비용으로 5골드. 넌 금화 1닢을 땄어! 잘했어..! 하, 하, 하 하!-- 경비병들이 자기들끼리 킬킬거리며 걸어간다. --

english: 10 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 2 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 뒤처리 비용으로 10골드. 넌 금화 2닢을 땄어! 잘했어..! 하, 하, 하 하!-- 경비병들이 자기들끼리 킬킬거리며 걸어간다. --

english: 15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 뒤처리 비용으로 15골드. 넌 금화 4닢을 땄어! 잘했어..! 하, 하, 하 하!-- 경비병들이 자기들끼리 킬킬거리며 걸어간다. --

english: 20 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 10 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha, ha!-- The guards walk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 뒤처리 비용으로 20골드. 넌 금화 10닢을 땄어! 잘했어..! 하, 하, 하, 하!-- 경비병들이 자기들끼리 킬킬거리며 걸어간다. --

english: What is this place?
Perhaps five gold coins will make it my business?
translation: 금화 다섯 닢이면 제가 알 바가 될까요?

english: Can I take a look around the place?
Does the Captain order you to kill a lot of people?
Unless what?
Where would I find this Al Zaba Bhasim?
translation: 그 Al Zaba Bhasim(알 자바 바심)은 어디서 찾을 수 있죠?

english: The Tenti's, who are they?
Okay, thanks.
Is Al Zaba Bhasim very tough?
translation: Al Zaba Bhasim(알 자바 바심)은 많이 강한가요?

english: What are you guarding?
Not to mention the senseless waste of human life.
translation: 무의미하게 사람 목숨을 버리는 건 말할 것도 없고요.

english: It doesn't sound as if you respect your Captain much.
translation: Captain(대장)을 그다지 존경하는 것 같진 않네요.

english: Can I have a bet on that?
I'll bet 5 gold that I win.
I'll bet 10 gold that I win.
I'll bet 15 gold that I win.
I'll bet 20 gold that I win.
Perhaps these five gold coins will sweeten your mood?
translation: 이 금화 다섯 닢이면 기분이 좀 풀리실까요?

english: I'm looking for a woman called Ana, have you seen her?
translation: Ana(아나)라는 여자를 찾고 있어요. 혹시 보셨어요?

english: Perhaps five gold coins will help you remember?
translation: 금화 다섯 닢이면 기억이 좀 나실까요?

english: Yes, I can take him on!
Er, no thanks, I've had second thoughts about it.
translation: 어, 아니요, 괜찮아요. 다시 생각해 보니 아닌 것 같아요.

english: Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.
translation: 은행 증서를 건네주면 아이템으로 바꿔 보지.

english: Yes
No
What are you doing here?
We're getting ready to test our mettle in the Theatre. Most people go in alone but if we do it as a team, we should have no problem.
translation: Theatre(피의 극장)에서 실력을 시험해 보려고 준비 중이야. 대부분은 혼자 들어가지만, 우린 팀으로 가니까 문제없을 거야.

english: Well good luck with that.
Why, hello there, young'un. Did my boy Percy say you could come up here?
translation: 어머나, 젊은이. 우리 아들 Percy(퍼시)가 여기 올라와도 된다고 하던가?

english: Yes, I had to pay him to get access to this area.
translation: 네, 이 구역에 들어오려고 돈을 내야 했어요.

english: Ah, that's my Percy alright. I raised him well.
translation: 아, 역시 우리 퍼시답구먼. 내가 아주 잘 키웠지.

english: You shouldn't be up here!
I don't think you should be using that without speaking to Percy first.
translation: 퍼시한테 먼저 말하지 않고 그걸 쓰면 안 될 것 같은데.

english: Welcome to the Games Zone!
translation: Games Zone(게임 존)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: How do I play board games?
You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the Games Zone (except on a PvP or Deadman world) by using the right click option.
translation: Games Zone(게임 존) 어디에서든(PvP나 Deadman(데드맨) 월드는 제외) 우클릭 메뉴로 다른 사람에게 게임을 신청할 수 있어요.

english: Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move.
translation: 게임 종류를 고른 다음, 한 수당 제한 시간 같은 원하는 옵션을 고르면 돼요.

english: If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 상대가 신청을 받아들이면 주변 테이블 중 하나로 이동해서 고른 게임을 하게 돼요.

english: Once you have finished your game you will come back here where you can challenge again! We also have tables in a few pubs around the world!
translation: 게임이 끝나면 여기로 돌아와서 다시 신청할 수 있어요! 세계 곳곳의 몇몇 술집에도 테이블이 있답니다!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 지금은 Draughts(체커), Runelink(룬링크), Runesquares(룬스퀘어), Runeversi(룬버시)가 있어요.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves.
translation: Draughts(체커)는 표준 규칙을 따르는데, 하나만 달라요. 마흔 수 동안 말이 잡히거나 승격되지 않으면 무승부가 선언돼요.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row.
translation: 네, 룬 네 개를 한 줄로 이으면 돼요.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn.
translation: 네, 번갈아 가며 선을 하나씩 그어서 사각형을 만드는 게 목표예요. 사각형을 만들 때마다 한 번 더 할 수 있어요.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own.
translation: 네, 판 위에 상대보다 내 룬을 더 많이 올려놓는 게 목표예요. 상대 말을 내 말 사이에 가두면 그 말을 빼앗을 수 있어요.

english: Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 음료 한 잔 살 수 있을까요?

english: I'm afraid I don't sell drinks.
Thanks!
Unfortunately we do not offer board game playing on this world. Try logging onto a non-PvP or Deadman world!
translation: 아쉽지만 이 월드에서는 보드게임을 할 수 없어요. PvP나 Deadman(데드맨)이 아닌 월드로 접속해 보세요!

english: How do I play board games?
What games can I play?
Draughts?
Runelink?
Runesquares?
Runeversi?
Can I buy a drink please?
translation: 음료 한 잔 살 수 있을까요?

english: Thanks!
Hello. King Arthur has sent me on a quest for the Holy Grail. He thought you could offer some assistance.
translation: 안녕하세요. King Arthur(아서 왕)께서 Holy Grail(성배)를 찾는 퀘스트를 맡기셨어요. 당신이 도움을 줄 수 있을 거라고 하시더군요.

english: Ah yes... the Holy Grail...
That is a powerful artefact indeed. Returning it here would help Camelot a lot.
translation: 참으로 강력한 유물이지. 그걸 이곳으로 되찾아 온다면 Camelot(카멜롯)에 큰 도움이 될 걸세.

english: Due to its nature the Holy Grail is likely to reside in a holy place.
translation: 그 본질로 보아 Holy Grail(성배)는 성스러운 곳에 있을 가능성이 크네.

english: Any suggestions?
I believe there is a holy island somewhere not far away... I'm not entirely sure... I spent too long inside that crystal! Anyway, go and talk to someone over there.
translation: 이 근방 어딘가에 성스러운 섬이 있는 걸로 아네... 확실하지는 않네만... 그 크리스탈 속에 너무 오래 갇혀 있었거든! 어쨌든, 그곳에 가서 누군가와 이야기해 보게.

english: I suppose you could try speaking to Sir Galahad?
translation: Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)과 이야기해 보는 것도 좋겠군.

english: He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.
translation: 그는 다른 이들이 모두 돌아오고도 여러 해가 지나서야 그 퀘스트에서 돌아왔네. 뭔가 알고 있는 듯하지만, 그때 겪은 일은 수수께끼처럼 에둘러서만 말할 수 있다네.

english: Thank you for the advice.
Where can I find Sir Galahad?
translation: Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Galahad now lives a life of religious contemplation. He lives somewhere west of McGrubor's Wood I think.
translation: Galahad(갤러해드)는 지금 신앙 속에서 묵상하며 지내고 있네. 아마 McGrubor's Wood(맥그루버의 숲) 서쪽 어딘가에 살고 있을 걸세.

english: Oh dear, did Morgan capture you too?
Err, no. It was all part of my brilliant plan. I allowed her to capture me so I could find out where she was keeping all of you.
translation: 어, 아뇨. 이게 다 제 기막힌 계획의 일부예요. 여러분을 어디에 가둬 두었는지 알아내려고 일부러 붙잡혀 준 거라고요.

english: Eh, is that so? Very clever. Now that you've found us, what is your plan, oh brilliant leader?
translation: 허, 그런가? 아주 영리하군. 그래, 이렇게 우리를 찾았으니 이제 무슨 계획이 있나, 오 기막힌 지도자 양반?

english: Hey, why do I have to do all the thinking here? You're the brilliant wizard.
translation: 아니, 왜 머리 쓰는 건 전부 제 몫이에요? 기막힌 마법사는 당신이잖아요.

english: Well, all great plans start with knowledge. Let me bring you up to speed with the situation. What do you want to know?
translation: 뭐, 모든 위대한 계획은 앎에서 시작하는 법이지. 지금 상황을 알려 주겠네. 무엇이 알고 싶은가?

english: Where is King Arthur now? he's not in the jail cell with us.
translation: King Arthur(아서 왕)께서는 지금 어디 계세요? 우리랑 같은 감방에는 안 계시던데요.

english: As the final blow to our morale, Morgan turned Arthur into a granite statue before our very eyes. He was taken away by the Black Knights, for what purposes I know not.
translation: 우리 사기를 꺾는 마지막 일격으로, Morgan(모건)은 우리 눈앞에서 Arthur(아서)를 화강암 조각상으로 만들어 버렸네. 그 뒤 Black Knights(흑기사)들이 그를 데려갔는데, 무슨 목적인지는 나도 모르네.

english: What is the connection between Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs?
translation: Morgan Le Faye(모건 르 페이)와 Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문은 무슨 관계예요?

english: Morgan le Faye has been itching to get revenge upon Arthur and myself for some time. When she heard of the murder of old Sinclair, she learned that she was not the only one with a vendetta against Camelot.
translation: Morgan le Faye(모건 르 페이)는 오래전부터 Arthur(아서)와 나에게 복수하지 못해 안달이었지. 그러다 늙은 Sinclair(싱클레어)가 살해당했다는 소식을 듣고, Camelot(카멜롯)에 원한을 품은 자가 자기만이 아니라는 걸 알게 됐네.

english: The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They brought the services of the Black Knights from
translation: Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문 놈들은 아비가 죽은 뒤로 줄곧 그 끈적한 손으로 Camelot(카멜롯)을 움켜쥐고 싶어 했지. Morgan(모건)의 교활함에 그들의 재력이 더해지니 만만찮은 한패가 된 걸세. 그자들은

english: Lord Daquarius and overran Camelot. We were outnumbered and taken by surprise.
translation: Lord Daquarius(다쿼리어스 경)에게서 Black Knights(흑기사)들을 빌려 와 Camelot(카멜롯)을 짓밟았네. 우리는 수적으로 밀렸고, 기습까지 당했지.

english: The Sinclairs stole our home, but Morgan struck the greater blow by stealing the Holy Grail, Arthur's most prized possession.
translation: Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문은 우리 보금자리를 빼앗았지만, 더 큰 타격을 입힌 건 Morgan(모건)일세. Arthur(아서)가 가장 아끼는 보물인 Holy Grail(성배)를 훔쳐 갔으니 말이야.

english: So what's the plan of escape? Are you going to teleport us all away? Turn us into fish and swim to sea?
translation: 그래서 탈출 계획은 뭐예요? 순간이동으로 다 같이 빠져나가요? 아니면 우리를 물고기로 바꿔서 바다로 헤엄쳐 가요?

english: During the battle at Camelot, Morgan cast a spell against me which appears to have stripped me of my powers. I must admit, the loss of my magic has left me befuddled, making it difficult to create a plan.
translation: Camelot(카멜롯)에서 싸울 때 Morgan(모건)이 내게 주문을 걸었는데, 그 탓에 힘을 빼앗긴 것 같네. 솔직히 마법을 잃고 나니 머리가 멍해서 계획을 세우기가 어렵군.

english: Well, I'm sure if we put our heads together we will think of something.
translation: 뭐, 머리를 맞대면 분명 뭔가 떠오를 거예요.

english: Let's talk about a plan of escape.
Escape is only a short-term plan. We should discuss the long-term goals as well.
translation: 탈출은 단기 계획일 뿐일세. 장기 목표도 함께 논의해야 하네.

english: How will we go about reclaiming Camelot?
I think I could reclaim Camelot from the Sinclairs on my own.
translation: Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문에게서 Camelot(카멜롯)을 되찾는 건 나 혼자서도 할 수 있을 것 같네.

english: How do you plan to do that? You couldn't even defend it from them.
translation: 어떻게 하시려고요? 그 사람들한테서 지켜 내지도 못하셨잖아요.

english: They don't know I've lost my magic. Besides, I've got a few tricks up my sleeves. For all their snobberies, they're still just spoiled brats. It shouldn't be difficult, but time is of the essence. I need you to break me out
translation: 그자들은 내가 마법을 잃은 걸 모르네. 게다가 내 소매 속에는 아직 몇 가지 수가 남아 있지. 잘난 척은 해도 결국 버릇없는 애송이들일 뿐이니 어렵진 않을 걸세. 다만 시간이 촉박하네. 자네가 나를

english: of here quickly and quietly, so Morgan cannot alert them.
translation: 빨리, 그리고 조용히 여기서 꺼내 줘야 하네. 그래야 Morgan(모건)이 그자들에게 알리지 못하지.

english: So to reclaim Camelot, I need to break you out of jail quietly.
translation: 그러니까 Camelot(카멜롯)을 되찾으려면, 당신을 감옥에서 조용히 빼내야 한다는 거군요.

english: Precisely.
How do I retrieve the Holy Grail? Do you know where it is?
translation: Holy Grail(성배)는 어떻게 되찾아요? 어디 있는지 아세요?

english: Morgan always keeps things of power near her. So the grail will be somewhere in Keep Le Faye. However, it will most likely be disguised and booby-trapped. Morgan has a thing about transmogrifying.
translation: Morgan(모건)은 힘이 깃든 물건은 늘 곁에 두지. 그러니 성배는 Keep Le Faye(르 페이 성) 어딘가에 있을 걸세. 다만 십중팔구 다른 모습으로 위장되어 있고 함정도 걸려 있을 테지. Morgan(모건)은 둔갑술에 집착하는 면이 있거든.

english: The last time I was in Keep Le Faye, it was pretty well guarded. I don't think I'll be able to sneak in quietly.
translation: 지난번에 Keep Le Faye(르 페이 성)에 갔을 때 경비가 꽤 삼엄했어요. 몰래 숨어들 수는 없을 것 같아요.

english: No, that won't work. Better to break out of the jail with all of the Round Table Knights. Let them deal with the guards while you retrieve the Grail.
translation: 그래, 그건 안 되겠지. 차라리 원탁의 기사들을 모두 데리고 감옥을 빠져나가는 게 낫네. 기사들이 경비병을 상대하는 동안 자네가 성배를 되찾아 오게.

english: So, I need to break eight knights out of jail? That could be troublesome.
translation: 그러니까 기사 여덟 명을 감옥에서 빼내야 한다고요? 골치 아프겠는데요.

english: Often the most complicated things have the simplest answers. Try leaving through the door.
translation: 가장 복잡한 일일수록 답은 가장 단순한 법이지. 문으로 나가 보게.

english: But it's locked.
When has that ever stopped an intrepid adventurer such as yourself?
translation: 자네처럼 대담한 모험가가 언제 그런 걸로 멈춘 적이 있던가?

english: Assuming I can escape from this jail, how can I save King Arthur?
translation: 제가 이 감옥에서 빠져나간다 치고, King Arthur(아서 왕)은 어떻게 구하죠?

english: I believe he's been taken to the headquarters of the Black Knights. I'm afraid I'm not well travelled on that side of the world, so I don't know its exact location. However, it's trickier than just finding Arthur. You'll
translation: Black Knights(흑기사)들의 본거지로 끌려간 것 같네. 유감이지만 나는 세상 그쪽 지역은 잘 다녀 보지 않아서 정확한 위치는 모르네. 하지만 Arthur(아서)를 찾는 것보다 더 까다로운 일이 있지. 그를

english: need to free him of the spell that turned him into a granite statue.
translation: 화강암 조각상으로 만든 주문에서 풀어 줘야 한다네.

english: And how do I go about doing that?
I have no idea.
WHAT?

Let me finish. I may have no idea, but a wizard friend of mine should. His name is Wizard Cromperty, and he's very experienced in freeing people from stone since he keeps teleporting them into it. Speak to him in East
translation: 끝까지 들어 보게. 나는 모르지만, 내 마법사 친구라면 알 걸세. 이름은 Wizard Cromperty(마법사 크롬퍼티)인데, 사람을 돌 속에서 꺼내는 데는 아주 경험이 많지. 툭하면 사람을 돌 속으로 순간이동시켜 버리니까 말이야. East

english: Ardougne, he'll help you.
translation: Ardougne(동 아르둔)에서 그를 만나 보게. 자네를 도와줄 걸세.

english: Never mind.
Well done, young adventurer. You truly are a worthy knight.
translation: 잘했네, 젊은 모험가. 자네는 진정 기사라 불릴 자격이 있네.

english: You receive access to the prayers Chivalry and Piety and 20,000 XP in your Hitpoints, Strength, Attack, and Defence skills. You may also speak to Merlin to set your respawn point to Camelot.
translation: Chivalry(기사도)와 Piety(경건) 기도를 사용할 수 있게 되었으며, Hitpoints(체력), Strength(힘), Attack(공격), Defence(방어) 스킬 경험치를 20,000씩 받았습니다. Merlin(멀린)에게 말을 걸어 부활 지점을 Camelot(카멜롯)으로 설정할 수도 있습니다.

english: Hello.
Excuse me for rushing off like this, but I must get back to my workroom.
translation: 이렇게 서둘러 떠나서 미안하네만, 작업실로 돌아가 봐야 하네.

english: Thank you for the advice.
Where can I find Sir Galahad?
translation: Sir Galahad(갤러해드 경)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Tell me where King Arthur is.
translation: King Arthur(아서 왕)께서 어디 계신지 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs.
translation: Morgan Le Faye(모건 르 페이)와 Sinclair(싱클레어) 가문에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: What do we do now?
Reclaim Camelot
Retreive the Holy Grail
Save King Arthur
Never mind.
Oh, hello! Children, say hello to the surface-dweller.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요! 얘들아, 지상인 손님께 인사드리렴.

english: Haha! You look funny!
I'm sure you look just as funny to the surface-dweller!
translation: 너희도 지상인 손님 눈에는 똑같이 이상하게 보일 거야!

english: You smell!
There's no need to be rude!
I'm sorry about that, surface-dweller.
Are you really from the surface?
Yes I am.
Are you [player name]? Did you help Zanik save the city?
translation: 혹시 [player name] 맞아? Zanik(자닉)이랑 같이 도시를 구했어?

english: Just because [he's/she's] a surface-dweller, doesn't mean [he's/she's] [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: [he's/she's] 지상인이라고 해서 [he's/she's] [player name] 본인인 건 아니란다! 지상인은 아주아주 많아!

english: Actually I am [player name].
[Player name]? Really?
Zanik told me about you! I'm so pleased to meet you!
translation: Zanik(자닉)한테 이야기 많이 들었어요! 만나서 정말 반가워요!

english: Shan't!
Well don't blame me if he doesn't want to talk to you either!
translation: 그럼 저분이 너랑 말하기 싫다고 하셔도 선생님 탓하지 마!

english: Sorry about that.
I don't think I should just do that with no reasoning... perhaps they are going to try something sneaky. Then I can kick to my heart's content.
translation: 아무 이유도 없이 그럴 수는 없지... 혹시 뭔가 꿍꿍이를 꾸미려는 걸지도 몰라. 그럼 그때 마음껏 걷어차 주면 되겠지.

english: Noo don't put that in there!
translation: 안 돼, 그거 거기 넣지 마!

english: I've got all the bad ones just for you!
translation: 나쁜 건 전부 너 주려고 챙겨 놨지!

english: Curse you!
How's life now the curse has been lifted?
Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 당신 덕분에 훨씬 나아졌어요. 다들 정말 감탄하고 있답니다.

english: Hello there. I have a message for you.
Hello there. I have a message for you, but you'll need to make some room for it.
translation: 안녕하세요. 전해 드릴 메시지가 있는데, 받으시려면 자리를 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Sorry, I don't have anything for you right now.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금은 전해 드릴 게 없어요.

english: [player name]?
Are you there [player name]?
[player name]? I have a message for you.
translation: [player name] 님? 전해 드릴 메시지가 있어요.

english: [player name]? You've been sent a message.
Maybe another time.
I have a letter for you. I'm told it's quite important. Please read it when you get a chance.
translation: letter(편지)를 가져왔어요. 꽤 중요한 거래요. 시간 날 때 꼭 읽어 보세요.

english: Apparently you destroyed that last letter I gave you without reading it, or something like that. The sender doesn't appreciate that sort of thing, so I've got another one for you.
translation: 지난번에 드린 letter(편지)를 읽지도 않고 없애 버리셨다던데, 뭐 그런 모양이에요. 보낸 분이 그런 걸 좋아하지 않으셔서, 한 통 더 가져왔어요.

english: Look, you can destroy that letter as many times as you want, but it won't change anything. The sender isn't the kind of individual who takes no for an answer, so for both of our sakes, please just read it.
translation: 저기요, letter(편지)를 몇 번이고 없애셔도 달라지는 건 없어요. 보낸 분은 거절을 순순히 받아들이는 분이 아니거든요. 그러니 우리 둘 다를 위해서 제발 그냥 읽어 주세요.

english: Please... don't keep doing this. You don't know who you're dealing with...
translation: 제발... 자꾸 이러지 마세요. 상대가 누군지 모르셔서 그래요...

english: Take me to your leader.
Wot?
Isn't that what you're supposed to say when you meet a new race of people?
translation: 새로운 종족을 만나면 원래 이렇게 말하는 거 아니에요?

english: Well, mate, we don't av no leader, so I ain't gonna take ya to um. We auw av eqwuw right's un stuff, yeah? But if ya wont an intro go live it up wiv da Onerimancer.
translation: 그게 말이지, 친구, 우린 대장 가튼 거 엄써. 그러니까 데려다줄 수도 엄찌. 우린 다 똑같은 권리 가튼 거 이써, 알지? 근데 소개받고 시프면 Onerimancer(꿈 점술사)한테 가서 신나게 놀아 봐.

english: OK. Is he rich and powerful?
translation: 알겠어요. 그 사람 돈 많고 힘센 남자예요?

english: No man, SHE, is dead-wise yeah? She is responsible for initiation wituals an stuff.
translation: 아니 친구, 남자가 아니라 여자, 완전 똑똑하다고, 알지? 입단 의싣 가튼 거 맡고 이써.

english: Great. Thanks. And where is she?
translation: 좋아요. 고마워요. 그럼 그분은 어디 있어요?

english: She angs out int souf east of ouw island.
Okey dokey....yeah.
Huh?
Yeah? Need something?
What do you have?
Rock. Lots of it.
What brings you here?
Rock. This here is Stonecutter Outpost. We get rock, cut it, then sell it.
translation: 돌. 여긴 Stonecutter Outpost(석공 전초기지)야. 돌을 캐서 깎은 다음 팔지.

english: So you're pretty far from home then?
translation: 그럼 고향에서 꽤 멀리 떨어져 있는 거네요?

english: What? No. We go back to Cam Torum sometimes, but this is home.
translation: 뭐? 아니. 가끔 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)에 돌아가긴 하지만, 여기가 집이야.

english: Fair enough.
Need something else?
I'm good.
Then why you keep staring? Get gone!
translation: 그럼 왜 자꾸 쳐다봐? 썩 꺼져!

english: What do you have?
What brings you here?
I'm good.
Oh... Nilsal. Unusual to see someone up here. What can I do for you?
translation: 아... Nilsal(닐살). 여기 위까지 사람이 오는 일은 드문데. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: What do you do around here?
I used to work downstairs... but I started using the lab after hours for my own projects and the supervisor found out. Now I've been assigned to rooftop duty to look after the plants.
translation: 원래는 아래층에서 일했는데요... 근무 시간이 끝난 뒤에 실험실을 제 개인 연구에 쓰다가 감독관에게 들켜 버렸어요. 그래서 지금은 옥상 담당으로 배정돼서 식물을 돌보고 있어요.

english: Do you have any tips for potion production?
Yes... Make good use of the digweed once they're ready to pick. Choose which potion you use it on wisely!
translation: 네... digweed(디그위드)는 딸 때가 되면 잘 활용하세요. 어느 물약에 쓸지는 신중하게 고르시고요!

english: Oh, and the processing tables can be sped up a bit if you use them correctly. You might need to do some experimenting to figure that out.
translation: 아, 그리고 가공 작업대는 제대로만 쓰면 속도를 조금 높일 수 있어요. 방법을 알아내려면 이것저것 실험해 봐야 할 거예요.

english: Thanks! I'd better be going now.
What do you do around here?
Do you have any tips for potion production?
Thanks! I'd better be going now.
Hello, you look worried.
My husband is serving near the Lizardman Canyon. I'm worried that something might happen to him.
translation: 남편이 Lizardman Canyon(리자드맨 협곡) 근처에서 복무하고 있어요. 혹시 무슨 일이라도 생길까 봐 걱정이에요.

english: And I lost my job last week. I need to find another one before my savings run out.
translation: 게다가 지난주에 일자리까지 잃었어요. 모아 둔 돈이 바닥나기 전에 다른 일을 구해야 해요.

english: Oh, that is bad. I'm sorry to hear that.
Well, it's a difficult time for a lot of people I guess. The war with the lizardmen never ends.
translation: 뭐, 다들 힘든 시기겠죠. lizardmen(리자드맨)과의 전쟁은 끝날 줄을 모르니까요.

english: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: vampyre(뱀파이어)가 될 뻔한 저를 구해 주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 certificate(증명서)를 받아 주세요. 죄송하지만 보답으로 드릴 수 있는 건 이것뿐이에요.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 저를 원래대로 돌려 주셔서 고마워요. 쉽지 않으셨을 텐데. 이제 그만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Hello!
Oh, hello there. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk right now. I'm rather busy. Come back some other time please.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요. 죄송하지만 지금은 이야기할 시간이 없어요. 좀 바쁘거든요. 다음에 다시 와 주세요.

english: Ok, sorry.
Thanks again for finding my pendant. I felt so lost without it.
translation: pendant(펜던트)를 찾아 주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요. 그게 없으니 마음이 너무 허전했거든요.

english: You're welcome. Goodbye.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어, Hero(영웅)님이다! 우와! 정말 대단하세요. 대체 그 두 juvinate(주비네이트)랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 어떻게 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 정말 근사해졌어요. 정말 훌륭하게 해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Mihail, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 저는 Mihail(미하일)이에요. 이 불 옆에서 몸을 녹이고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 더할 나위 없어요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일은 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 근근이 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 여행할 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 정말 요긴하고, 다들 당신께 무척 고마워하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 어이? 우리 해적 패거리에 한자리 끼고 싶은 거냐?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 화약 나르는 꼬맹이 녀석이 럼주 퍼마시고 난리 치다가 뻗어 자고 있으니, 네 자리는 넉넉하다고.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Wanna buy some clothes? Good quality, none of yer rags.
translation: 옷 좀 살래? 품질 좋은 놈들이야. 넝마 같은 건 없다고.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Then what are you doin' in my shop? Move along.
translation: 그럼 내 가게에서 뭐 하는 거야? 썩 나가.

english: Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
translation: 저 shirt(셔츠)에는 왜 구멍이 나 있어요?

english: It's to put your head through.
In the stomach? Isn't that an odd place for a neck hole?
translation: 배 쪽에요? 목 구멍치고는 위치가 좀 이상하지 않아요?

english: Oh! It seems as if I must have slipped while cleaning it and put a bit of a hole in the front.
translation: 아! 빨다가 손이 미끄러져서 앞쪽에 구멍을 좀 낸 모양이군.

english: Silly me.
What were you cleaning it with, a blood-covered scimitar?
If I say yes will you buy it?
No.
Then no, I was not cleaning it with a blood-covered scimitar.
translation: 그럼 아니야. 피 묻은 시미터로 빤 거 아니야.

english: Where do you get these clothes?
Found em.
You found a bunch of slashed up clothing, some of which has been shoddily cleaned and stitched together?
translation: 칼로 난도질당한 옷 더미를 주워서, 그중 몇 벌은 대충 빨아서 엉성하게 꿰매 붙였다고요?

english: Yes.
Look, do you want in on this or not?
Where did that pillar come from?
You wanna buy it?
Is it for sale?
Would you buy it if it was?
If it was could you sell it to me?
If I couldn't would you still give me the money?
translation: 못 판다고 해도 돈은 줄 거야?

english: Where did this pillar come from?
Dunno. There are a load of islands out this way, and a lot of them have little bits and pieces like this scattered around.
translation: 몰라. 이쪽 바다엔 섬이 잔뜩 있는데, 그중 상당수에 이런 자잘한 조각들이 여기저기 널려 있거든.

english: The way I see it, there must have been some people out here at one point, then they went away.
translation: 내가 보기엔 옛날에 여기 누가 살다가 어디론가 떠난 거야.

english: Where?
Search me.
translation: 내가 알 게 뭐야. 궁금하면 내 주머니나 털어 보든가.

english: I'd rather not.
I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Why does that shirt have a hole in it?
translation: 저 shirt(셔츠)에는 왜 구멍이 나 있어요?

english: Where did that pillar come from?
Thank you, I hope you like your present. I must be leaving now though.
translation: 고마워요. 선물 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠네요. 그럼 저는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: I must be leaving now.
Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [other player's display name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 죄송한데요, [other player's display name] 님이랑 이야기하려고 하는데 [he/she] 저를 무시하는 것 같아요.

english: Greetings [player name], I need your help.
Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 제 말 좀 들어 주세요, [player name] 님!

english: Hello, [player name], are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: [player name] 님, 이야기 좀 하고 싶어요!

english: ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: 에헴... 안녕하세요, [player name] 님, 제 말 좀 들어 주세요!

english: Maybe later.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 잡아먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 꺼져, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞을 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참하기 짝이 없는 날이야... 지금 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 못 맡아 본 냄새인데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 못 봤어? 나 배가 엄~청 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너도 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
Hello. Your parents say you saw what happened to Elena...
translation: 안녕. 부모님 말씀이 네가 Elena(엘레나)한테 무슨 일이 있었는지 봤다던데...

english: *sniff* Yes I was near the south east corner when I saw Elena walking by. I was about to run to greet her when some men jumped out. They shoved a sack over her head and dragged her into a building.
translation: *훌쩍* 네, 남동쪽 구석 근처에 있었는데 Elena(엘레나) 언니가 지나가는 게 보였어요. 인사하러 뛰어가려는데 웬 아저씨들이 튀어나와서 언니 머리에 자루를 뒤집어씌우고 어떤 건물 안으로 끌고 갔어요.

english: Which building?
It was the boarded up building with no windows in the south east corner of West Ardougne.
translation: West Ardougne(서 아르둔) 남동쪽 구석에 있는, 창문도 없이 판자로 막아 놓은 건물이었어요.

english: Have you found Elena yet?
No, I'm still looking.
I hope you find her. She was nice.
translation: 언니를 꼭 찾았으면 좋겠어요. 정말 착한 언니였거든요.

english: Yes, she's safe at home.
I hope she comes and visits sometime.
Maybe.
I hope Elena comes to visit soon.
translation: Elena(엘레나) 언니가 빨리 놀러 왔으면 좋겠어요.

english: Hello Adventurer. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. Mill Lane Mill(밀 레인 방앗간)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 도와드릴까요?

english: Who are you?
I'm Miss Millicent Miller the Miller of Mill Lane Mill. Our family have been milling flour for generations.
translation: 저는 Mill Lane Mill(밀 레인 방앗간)에서 밀을 빻는 방앗간지기, Millicent Miller(밀리센트 밀러)라고 해요. 저희 집안은 대대로 flour(밀가루)를 빻아 왔어요.

english: It's a good business to be in. People will always need flour.
translation: 좋은 사업이네요. 사람들은 언제나 밀가루가 필요하니까요.

english: How do I mill flour?
What is this place?
This is Mill Lane Mill. Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
translation: 여기는 Mill Lane Mill(밀 레인 방앗간)이에요. Gielinor(길리노르)에서 가장 좋은 flour(밀가루)를 빻는 곳이자, 대대로 Miller(밀러) 집안이 살아온 집이죠.

english: We take grain from the field nearby and mill into flour.
translation: 근처 밭에서 grain(곡물)을 가져와서 밀가루로 빻아요.

english: Making flour is pretty easy. First of all you need to get some grain. You can pick some from wheat fields. There is one just outside the Mill, but there are many others scattered across Gielinor. Feel free to pick wheat
translation: 밀가루 만드는 건 꽤 쉬워요. 우선 grain(곡물)이 좀 있어야 해요. wheat(밀) 밭에서 딸 수 있죠. 방앗간 바로 밖에도 하나 있고, Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 다른 밭도 많아요. 저희 밭에서

english: from our field! There always seems to be plenty of wheat there.
translation: 마음껏 밀을 따 가세요! 거긴 늘 밀이 넉넉하더라고요.

english: Then I bring my wheat here?
translation: 그럼 딴 wheat(밀)을 여기로 가져오면 되나요?

english: Yes, or one of the other mills in Gielinor. They all work the same way. Just take your grain to the top floor of the mill (up two ladders, there are three floors including this one) and then place some grain into the hopper.
translation: 네, 아니면 Gielinor(길리노르)의 다른 방앗간도 괜찮아요. 다 똑같은 방식이거든요. grain(곡물)을 방앗간 맨 위층으로 가져가서(ladder(사다리)를 두 번 올라가면 돼요. 이 층까지 해서 세 층이에요) hopper(호퍼)에 곡물을 넣으세요.

english: Then you need to start the grinding process by pulling the hopper lever. You can add more grain, but each time you add grain you have to pull the hopper lever again.
translation: 그다음 hopper(호퍼) lever(레버)를 당겨서 빻기 시작하면 돼요. 곡물을 더 넣어도 되지만, 넣을 때마다 호퍼 레버를 다시 당겨야 해요.

english: So where does the flour go then?
The flour appears in this room here, you'll need a pot to put the flour into. One pot will hold the flour made by one load of grain
translation: 밀가루는 바로 이 방으로 나와요. 밀가루를 담을 pot(단지)가 필요해요. 단지 하나에 곡물 한 번 넣은 만큼의 밀가루가 담겨요.

english: And that's it! You now have some pots of finely ground flour of the highest quality. Ideal for making tasty cakes or delicous bread. I'm not a cook so you'll have to ask a cook to find out how to bake things.
translation: 이게 다예요! 이제 최고급으로 곱게 빻은 밀가루 단지가 생겼어요. 맛있는 케이크나 bread(빵)을 만들기에 딱이죠. 저는 요리사가 아니라서, 굽는 방법은 요리사한테 물어보셔야 해요.

english: Great! Thanks for your help.
I'm fine, thanks.
Hello Adventurers. Welcome to Mill Lane Mill. Can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 모험가님들. Mill Lane Mill(밀 레인 방앗간)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 도와드릴까요?

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! What is this place?
translation: 저는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)의 Zanik(자닉)이에요! 여기는 어떤 곳이에요?

english: What's flour?
It's the stuff we get from milling the grain. We use it to make bread and cakes and things.
translation: 곡물을 빻으면 나오는 거예요. 그걸로 빵이랑 케이크 같은 걸 만들죠.

english: We don't have any of those things in Dorgesh-Kaan! They sound so interesting!
translation: Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)에는 그런 게 하나도 없어요! 정말 재밌을 것 같아요!

english: Who are you?
What is this place?
How do I mill flour?
I'm fine, thanks.
Do you want to buy a lamp, surface-dweller?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Suit yourself.
Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: lamp(등불)에 기름 좀 채워 주실 수 있어요?

english: You can do that yourself! Just put some swamp tar in the lamp oil still here and then use the lamp on the still.
translation: 그건 직접 하실 수 있어요! 여기 있는 lamp oil still(램프 기름 증류기)에 swamp tar(늪 타르)를 넣고, 등불을 증류기에 사용하시면 돼요.

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 도시 곳곳에 있는 등불은 어떻게 작동해요?

english: They work by our very own Dorgeshuun magic!
Sometimes they don't work very well, though. The light orbs blow and they have to be replaced.
translation: 그래도 가끔은 잘 안 될 때가 있어요. light orbs(빛 구슬)이 나가 버려서 갈아 끼워야 하거든요.

english: If you ever see a lamp that's gone out, you can fix it by replacing the light orb. You can make new light orbs out of glass, and use a piece of wire on them to add the filament.
translation: 꺼진 등불을 보면 light orb(빛 구슬)을 갈아 끼워서 고칠 수 있어요. 새 빛 구슬은 유리로 만들 수 있고, wire(철사)를 사용해서 필라멘트를 넣으면 돼요.

english: There's a machine in the south of the city that makes the wire you need.
translation: 필요한 철사를 만드는 기계가 도시 남쪽에 있어요.

english: Lamps!
Lanterns!
Tinderboxes!
Torches!
Lamp oil!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Can you fill a lamp with oil please?
translation: lamp(등불)에 기름 좀 채워 주실 수 있어요?

english: How do the lamps around the city work?
translation: 도시 곳곳에 있는 등불은 어떻게 작동해요?

english: Gah! Trolls everywhere. There's no escape!
translation: 으악! 사방에 트롤이야. 도망칠 데가 없어!

english: You could just leave the mine.
Oh, I'd never thought of that.
This place rocks!
No it doesn't, it stays perfectly still.
Bah! Be quiet, pedant.
translation: 쳇! 조용히 해, 이 말꼬리 잡는 녀석아.

english: High hoe, high hoe!
Why are you singing about farming implements at altitude?
translation: 왜 높은(하이) 데서 호미 노래를 부르는 거예요?

english: I don't know, I've never thought about it. Ask my Dad, he taught me the song.
translation: 몰라, 생각해 본 적도 없어. 우리 아빠한테 물어봐. 아빠가 가르쳐 준 노래거든.

english: How's your prospecting going?
translation: 광맥 찾는 건 잘 돼 가요?

english: Mine's going pretty well.
Mine? Mine...you get it?
Oh, I got it. That doesn't make it funny though.
translation: 네, 알아들었어요. 그렇다고 웃긴 건 아니지만요.

english: Suit yourself.
I've been here for two days straight. When I close my eyes I see rocks.
translation: 여기서 이틀 꼬박 지냈어. 눈만 감으면 바위가 보여.

english: Why would anyone stay here for so long?
translation: 대체 왜 그렇게 오래 여기 있어요?

english: I fear the outside. I fear the big light.
translation: 바깥이 무서워. 그 커다란 빛이 무서워.

english: Oh dear. Being underground for so long may have driven you mad.
translation: 이런. 너무 오래 땅속에 있다 보니 미쳐 버리셨나 봐요.

english: My back is killing me!
Could be worse, it could be the trolls killing you.
translation: 그나마 다행이죠. 트롤이 죽이는 것보단 낫잖아요.

english: How very droll.
No, troll.
Bah! I resist your attempts at jollity.
translation: 쳇! 그런 실없는 장난에는 안 넘어가.

english: Pay-dirt!
Ow!
Exchuse me... I am trying to tell my verrry good friends 'bout my uncle's bushy beard.
translation: 실레... 실례 좀 함세... 내가 지금 아주우우 좋은 친구들한테 우리 삼촌의 덥수룩한 수염 얘길 하는 중이라고.

english: Exchuse me... I am lishning to my good friend.
translation: 실레... 실례 좀 함세... 지금 내 좋은 친구 얘길 듣는 중이라고.

english: He could hardly climb a ladder without tripping.
translation: 그 양반은 사다리 하나 오를 때도 걸려 넘어지기 일쑤였지.

english: Such a long beard it reached the floor!
The beard wasn't so clean after meals.
translation: 밥 먹고 나면 수염이 영 깨끗하질 않았지.

english: His beard used to get into everyone's dinner.
translation: 그 수염이 맨날 남의 저녁밥에 들어갔다고.

english: It was like a jungle on his chin!
In the summer he didn't need clothes.
I mean, he needed to clean it more.
translation: 내 말은, 수염을 좀 더 자주 빨았어야 했다는 거야.

english: He had the bushiest beard ever!
He was the hairiest dwarf in town.
His wife could use it for a blanket.
translation: 그 양반 마누라는 그걸 이불로 써도 됐을 거야.

english: Pearls of wisdom!
Ah, tell it!
Best times ever!
Right you are.
Great days!
I'm going to be sick!
You're right.
You're so right.
Those were the days!
Not like nowadays.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Good day. What are you doing?
I'm mining coal. It's pretty tough going.
translation: coal(석탄)을 캐고 있습니다. 꽤 고된 일입니다.

english: Good luck with that.
Thank you, Your Royal Highness.
Can you tell me how the kingdom approves of me?
translation: 왕국 사람들이 저를 얼마나 지지하는지 알려 줄래요?

english: [amount]% of people approve of you.
The storerooms are full, your Highness. You should talk to Advisor Ghrim to collect what we've gathered for you.
translation: 창고가 가득 찼습니다, 전하. Advisor Ghrim(고문 그림)께 말씀하셔서 저희가 모아 둔 것을 받아 가십시오.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Miner Magnus has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Miner Magnus(광부 마그누스)가 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 주었습니다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
Spot on!
Miner Magnus has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Miner Magnus(광부 마그누스)가 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었습니다!

english: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wondering through there. You'll get yourself killed!
translation: 어이! 어딜 가려는 겐가? 저리로 들어가기 전에 나랑 먼저 얘기하게. 그러다 죽는 수가 있어!

english: Oi, get yer hands off that! It's reserved for survivors of the Colosseum.
translation: 어이, 거기서 손 떼게! 그건 Colosseum(콜로세움) 생존자 전용일세.

english: You do not have enough Glory to use that.
Hello there.
Welcome, Rookie.
What is this place?
This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
translation: 여기 말인가...? 이곳이 바로 위대한 Fortis Colosseum(포르티스 콜로세움)일세!

english: Adventurers come from near and far to test their might within these walls.
translation: 모험가들이 사방에서 찾아와 이 경기장 안에서 자기 힘을 시험하지.

english: That sounds exciting!
Indeed it is. If you are victorious in the Colosseum, the whole of Varlamore shall hear of your name.
translation: 그렇고말고. 콜로세움에서 승리하면 Varlamore(바를라모어) 전역에 자네 이름이 울려 퍼질 걸세.

english: I imagine itsquite the challenge then?
It'll put your skills to the test alright.
translation: 자네 실력을 제대로 시험하게 될 걸세.

english: How do I participate?
Just head through that tunnel behind me and we'll get the show started! Make sure you've got everything you need. Once you're in you can't leave until the end of a wave!
translation: 내 뒤에 있는 저 터널로 들어가기만 하면 쇼가 시작되네! 필요한 건 다 챙겼는지 확인하게. 일단 들어가면 웨이브가 끝날 때까지 나올 수 없으니까!

english: Come and ask if you have any other questions.
translation: 다른 궁금한 게 있으면 와서 묻게.

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: 변형 효과에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes! After all, they were my idea...
Oh...
Every time you complete a wave, I'll offer you a choice of three modifiers.
translation: 웨이브를 하나 끝낼 때마다 변형 효과 세 가지 중 하나를 고르게 해 주겠네.

english: Each modifier will increase the challenge for the rest of the run - So choose wisely!
translation: 변형 효과는 남은 도전 내내 난이도를 높이지. 그러니 신중하게 고르게!

english: Some modifiers can be offered multiple times, with the effects then growing in power!
translation: 어떤 변형 효과는 여러 번 나올 수 있는데, 그럴 때마다 효과가 더 강해진다네!

english: Thanks for the heads up!
Was there anything else?
How do I get rewarded?
Well it's a bit different to just killing monsters and picking up items, as I'm sure you're used to...
translation: 글쎄, 몬스터 잡고 아이템 줍는 식하고는 좀 다르다네. 자네야 그런 쪽에 익숙하겠지만...

english: How so?
After each wave inside the Colosseum, I'll show you the rewards you have earned, as well as what you'll earn from the next wave...
translation: 콜로세움 안에서 웨이브가 끝날 때마다, 자네가 얻은 보상과 다음 웨이브에서 얻을 보상을 보여 주겠네...

english: If you aren't confident that you can complete the next wave, you can claim your existing rewards and exit early.
translation: 다음 웨이브를 깰 자신이 없다면 지금까지의 보상을 받고 일찍 나가도 되네.

english: However, if you're confident you can beat the next wave, you can risk your whole reward pile to get even more!
translation: 하지만 다음 웨이브를 이길 자신이 있다면, 쌓인 보상 전부를 걸고 더 많이 노려 볼 수도 있지!

english: Be careful though. If you die or leave the arena before claiming your loot from me, you will lose all of the rewards you've earned.
translation: 그래도 조심하게. 나한테 전리품을 받기 전에 죽거나 경기장을 떠나면 그동안 얻은 보상을 전부 잃게 되네.

english: So I'm guessing the higher the wave, the better the rewards?
translation: 그러니까 웨이브가 높을수록 보상도 좋아진다는 거죠?

english: Oh, you're good. Exactly that!
Even better - if you manage to finish all of the waves and the final challenge, then you'll be awarded with Dizana's Quiver.
translation: 더 좋은 건, 모든 웨이브와 최종 도전까지 끝내면 Dizana's Quiver(디자나의 화살통)을 받게 된다는 거지.

english: It's a handy piece of kit that you wear on your back to store extra bolts or arrows.
translation: 등에 메고 볼트나 화살을 더 넣어 둘 수 있는 쓸모 있는 장비라네.

english: That does sound handy! Thanks for explaining all of that.
translation: 정말 쓸모 있겠네요! 전부 설명해 주셔서 고마워요.

english: Anytime, Rookie. Anything else?
What is Glory?
It's the measure of your progress inside the Colosseum.
translation: 콜로세움 안에서 자네가 얼마나 해냈는지를 나타내는 척도일세.

english: Speak to Gloria over there if you want to know the details.
translation: 자세한 걸 알고 싶으면 저기 있는 Gloria(글로리아)에게 물어보게.

english: Thanks.
What do you do around here?
I'm Minimus. It's not my real name of course, but it seems to have stuck. I started out competing here as a gladiator when I was a young'n. After that I became one of the lanistas.
translation: 나는 Minimus(미니무스)일세. 물론 본명은 아니지만, 어쩌다 보니 그렇게 굳어 버렸지. 어릴 적엔 여기서 검투사로 싸우기 시작했고, 그 뒤엔 라니스타 중 한 명이 되었네.

english: Lanistas?
The ones responsible for overseeing the selecting and training of the gladiators.
translation: 검투사를 선발하고 훈련시키는 일을 맡은 사람들이지.

english: Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honorof managing the fights themselves.
translation: 결국 왕국에서 나에게 Colosseum Master(콜로세움 관장) 자리를 맡겼지. 지금도 틈틈이 싸우긴 하지만, 이제는 시합 자체를 운영하는 영광을 누리고 있다네.

english: So are you not training like the rest of the gladiators?
translation: 그럼 다른 검투사들처럼 훈련은 안 하세요?

english: I have no need! I'm already one of the greatest fighters to grace this arena.
translation: 그럴 필요 없네! 난 이미 이 경기장을 빛낸 최고의 전사 중 하나니까.

english: Are you at a disadvantage because of your height?
No! How dare you even suggest that! Those spindly human bodies are unfit to go toe to toe with a fine dwarf like myself!
translation: 아니! 감히 그런 소리를! 그 비쩍 마른 인간 몸뚱이로는 나 같은 훌륭한 드워프와 맞붙을 깜냥이 안 되네!

english: Now, did you need anything else?
Goodbye.
Farewell, Rookie.
Welcome, [rank].
A [rank] approaches!
Let me know when you want to begin.
I have a spare Dizana's quiver (uncharged).
You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters? I could also try to convince Smol Heredit to follow you.
translation: 그걸 Sunfire splinters(태양불 파편)과 바꾸고 싶은가? 아니면 Smol Heredit(꼬마 헤레딧)이 자네를 따라가도록 설득해 볼 수도 있네.

english: But be aware, you will not get the quiver back.
translation: 하지만 명심하게, 화살통은 돌려받을 수 없네.

english: Very well, Grand Champion. Keep your trophy.
translation: 좋네, Grand Champion(그랜드 챔피언). 트로피는 간직하게.

english: It doesn't actually look like you have enough space to carry 4,000 Sunfire splinters. Come back when you have room.
translation: 보아하니 Sunfire splinters(태양불 파편) 4,000개를 들 공간이 없는 것 같군. 자리를 마련해서 다시 오게.

english: He doesn't want to go with you. Sorry.
He seems to like you. Smol heredit is yours.
translation: 자네가 마음에 드는 모양이야. Smol heredit(꼬마 헤레딧)은 이제 자네 걸세.

english: You want to offer it for some Sunfire splinters?
translation: 그걸 Sunfire splinters(태양불 파편)과 바꾸고 싶은가?

english: I'm afraid you can only offer spare uncharged versions of the quiver to me.
translation: 미안하지만, 나한테는 남는 미충전 화살통만 내놓을 수 있네.

english: Can you tell me about modifiers?
translation: 변형 효과에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: How do I get rewarded?
What is Glory?
What do you do around here?
Goodbye.
Can we talk about modifiers?
translation: 변형 효과에 대해 얘기할 수 있을까요?

english: How can I get rewards?
Yes, Trade it for 4,000 Sunfire Splinters
No, keep Dizana's quiver.
Yes, exchange Dizana's quiver for 4,000 Sunfire splinters?
translation: 네, Dizana's quiver(디자나의 화살통)을 Sunfire splinters(태양불 파편) 4,000개와 교환할까요?

english: Gamble for a Smol Heredit.
translation: Smol Heredit(꼬마 헤레딧)을 노리고 운을 시험해 볼게요.

english: Yes, gamble for a Smol Heredit?
translation: 네, Smol Heredit(꼬마 헤레딧)을 노리고 운을 시험해 볼까요?

english: No, keep it.
Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.
translation: 안녕하세요. 여기 처음 오셨나 보네요. 그럼 뭐라고 불러 드릴까요? '신입'은 너무 딱딱하잖아요. 같이 일할 거라면 이름으로 부르고 싶어요.

english: You can call me [player name].
Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
translation: 좋아요, [player name] 님. 제 이름은 Dezzick(데직)이고, 광부가 본업이에요. 채광하는 법을 알려 드릴게요.

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
translation: 채광은 아주 간단해요. pickaxe(곡괭이)만 있으면 되거든요. 이 근처 바위에는 tin(주석)과 copper(구리)가 들어 있어요. 일단 좀 캐 보는 게 어때요?

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.
translation: 이 근처 바위에는 tin(주석)과 copper(구리)가 들어 있어요. 좀 캐 보세요.

english: Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
translation: 이제 ore(광석)이 생겼으니 녹여서 bronze bar(청동 주괴)를 만들어야 해요. 저기 있는 furnace(용광로)를 쓰면 돼요.

english: I have a bronze bar. What now?
translation: bronze bar(청동 주괴)를 만들었어요. 이제 뭘 하죠?

english: Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.
translation: 주괴가 생겼으니 무기로 만들 수 있어요. 대장일을 하려면 hammer(망치)와 anvil(모루)가 필요해요. 바로 여기 모루가 몇 개 있으니 쓰세요. bronze dagger(청동 단검)을 만들 수 있는지 해 보세요.

english: See if you can use the anvil here to make a bronze dagger.
translation: 여기 있는 anvil(모루)로 bronze dagger(청동 단검)을 만들 수 있는지 해 보세요.

english: Would you like me to recap anything?
Tell me about mining again.
Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.
translation: 물론이죠. 채광하려면 pickaxe(곡괭이)가 필요해요. 곡괭이마다 채광 효율이 달라요.

english: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe, which is the most inefficient pickaxe available, but is perfect for a beginner.
translation: 아까 bronze pickaxe(청동 곡괭이)를 드렸죠. 제일 효율이 안 좋은 곡괭이지만 초보자한테는 딱이에요.

english: To mine, simply click on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
translation: pickaxe(곡괭이)를 가진 채로 광석이 든 바위를 클릭하기만 하면, 광석을 얻거나 바위가 빌 때까지 계속 캐요.

english: The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.
translation: 좋은 pickaxe(곡괭이)를 쓸수록 캐는 바위에서 광석을 더 빨리 얻을 수 있어요.

english: You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.
translation: 본토에 가면 Dwarven Mine(드워프 광산)에서 더 좋은 곡괭이를 살 수 있지만, 비쌀 수 있어요.

english: Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?
translation: 그리고 곡괭이가 좋을수록 쓰는 데 필요한 Mining(채광) 레벨도 높아져요. 더 듣고 싶은 거 있어요?

english: Tell me about smelting again.
Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.
translation: 제련은 아주 쉬워요. 원하는 금속을 만드는 데 필요한 광석을 furnace(용광로)로 가져가서, 광석을 용광로에 쓰면 금속 주괴로 제련돼요.

english: Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.
translation: 용광로는 짓고 유지하는 데 돈이 많이 들어서 세상에 그렇게 많지 않아요. 하나 찾으면 나중을 위해 위치를 기억해 두세요.

english: An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.
translation: 용광로 대신 고레벨 마법으로 광석을 제련하는 방법도 있어요.

english: As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.
translation: 어디서든 광석을 제련할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 어떤 광석이든 반드시 제련에 성공해요.

english: Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.
translation: iron(철) 같은 일부 금속에는 불순물이 있어서 일반 용광로에서는 제련하다 날아갈 수 있지만, 마법의 열로는 그렇지 않아요.

english: Anything else?
Tell me about Smithing again.
When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
translation: 작업하려는 금속의 주괴를 충분히 모으면 대장일을 시작할 준비가 된 거예요.

english: Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.
translation: 제가 드린 hammer(망치)를 챙기거나 general store(잡화점)에서 새로 사서, 근처 anvil(모루)로 가세요.

english: By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.
translation: anvil(모루)에 금속 주괴를 쓰면 지금 레벨에서 만들 수 있는 물건이 나오는 화면이 떠요.

english: It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.
translation: 꽤 간단한 스킬이에요. 저한테 그 멋진 bronze dagger(청동 단검)을 만들어 주면서 이미 알아채셨겠지만요.

english: The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.
translation: Smithing(대장일) 레벨이 높을수록 더 좋은 금속을 다룰 수 있어요. 청동부터 시작해서 실력이 늘면서 점점 올라가는 거죠.

english: Anything else?
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Tell me about Mining again.
Tell me about smelting again.
Tell me about Smithing again.
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: 채광의 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: As you're already here, have a pick so that you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: 이왕 여기 왔으니 곡괭이 하나 받으세요. 이걸로 제 주변 바위를 캐면 돼요.

english: I'd give you a pick to mine the rocks around me, but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 제 주변 바위를 캘 곡괭이를 드리고 싶은데, 소지품에 자리가 없네요.

english: As you already have a pick, you can mine the rocks around me.
translation: 이미 곡괭이가 있으니 제 주변 바위를 캐면 돼요.

english: You can tell the ore you'll get from a rock by looking at it. The colour of the rock helps, too.
translation: 바위를 살펴보면 어떤 광석이 나올지 알 수 있어요. 바위 색깔도 도움이 되고요.

english: To mine, simply click on the rock to mine it, while you've got a pickaxe with you.
translation: 곡괭이를 가지고 있을 때 바위를 클릭하기만 하면 채굴할 수 있어요.

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank. There's a bank on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: 소지품이 가득 차면 은행에 가져가세요. Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 지붕 위에 은행이 있어요.

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: 채광 기초는 이미 알아요. 팁 같은 거 있나요?

english: You can get different rocks in different places throughout the land, explore and find them.
translation: 이 땅 곳곳에서 여러 가지 바위를 찾을 수 있어요. 돌아다니며 찾아보세요.

english: You could start by traveling to the Al Kharid mine. Follow the path north and pay the 10 coins toll to go through the gate. Head north after passing through the gate and you will find the mine.
translation: 먼저 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 광산에 가 보는 건 어때요? 길을 따라 북쪽으로 가서 통행료 10코인을 내고 대문을 지나세요. 대문을 지나 북쪽으로 가면 광산이 나와요.

english: Be careful though, the scorpions in the mine will attack you.
translation: 그래도 조심하세요. 광산에 있는 전갈들이 공격해 올 거예요.

english: I could show you where Al Kharid mine is on your map if you like?
translation: 원하시면 지도에 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 광산 위치를 표시해 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: 숙련된 광부에게 해 줄 조언이 있나요?

english: Investigate the mining guild, the entrance to this is in the east of Falador down some steps. It could be most useful to you!
translation: mining guild(채광 길드)를 찾아가 보세요. 입구는 Falador(팔라도르) 동쪽에 있는 계단 아래에 있어요. 아주 유용할 거예요!

english: You might also like to check out the coal mine west of Seers' village. This will enable you to use the coal trucks.
translation: Seers' village(시어스 마을) 서쪽에 있는 석탄 광산도 가 볼 만해요. 거기선 석탄 수레를 쓸 수 있거든요.

english: Thank you, I'll remember that.
I could show you where either of the places are on your map if you like?
translation: 원하시면 두 곳 중 어디든 지도에 표시해 드릴까요?

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
translation: mining guild(채광 길드)가 어디 있는지 보여 주실래요?

english: Can you show me where the coal mine is?
translation: 석탄 광산이 어디 있는지 보여 주실래요?

english: I could show you where the mining guild is on your map if you like?
translation: 원하시면 지도에 mining guild(채광 길드) 위치를 표시해 드릴까요?

english: Oh yes, if you haven't already, speak to Doric who can be found around the anvils north of Falador. I'm sure he can help you out.
translation: 아, 그리고 아직 안 만나 봤다면 Falador(팔라도르) 북쪽 모루 근처에 있는 Doric(도릭)과 이야기해 보세요. 분명 도움이 될 거예요.

english: You could investigate the Dig Site east of Varrock, I'm sure you'll find something rewarding there.
translation: Varrock(바록) 동쪽에 있는 Dig Site(발굴지)를 조사해 보세요. 분명 보람 있는 걸 찾을 거예요.

english: Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: 여러 가지 바위와 곡괭이에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Ok then.. here goes....
You can make all sorts of things from clay, if you have the crafting skill. Rune Essence is used for magic to cast spells.
translation: crafting(공예) 스킬이 있으면 clay(점토)로 온갖 걸 만들 수 있어요. Rune Essence(룬 정수)는 마법 주문을 거는 데 쓰여요.

english: Goodbye.
I'm giving Zanik here a tour of Lumbridge.
I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Pleased to meet you!
Hello there, Zanik! You look like you know your iron from your silver!
translation: 안녕하세요, Zanik(자닉)! 철이랑 은 정도는 척척 구분할 줄 아는 분 같네요!

english: Of course I do! I've mined lots of iron and silver in the Dorgeshuun mines!
translation: 당연하죠! Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 광산에서 철이랑 은을 잔뜩 캤는걸요!

english: You don't look like you need any help, then. What about you, [player name]?
translation: 그럼 도움은 필요 없겠네요. [player name] 님은 어때요?

english: Can you teach me the basics of mining please?
translation: 채광의 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: I already know about the basics of mining, got any tips?
translation: 채광 기초는 이미 알아요. 팁 같은 거 있나요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Any advice for an advanced miner?
translation: 숙련된 광부에게 해 줄 조언이 있나요?

english: Can you show me where the mining guild is?
translation: mining guild(채광 길드)가 어디 있는지 보여 주실래요?

english: Can you show me where the coal mine is?
translation: 석탄 광산이 어디 있는지 보여 주실래요?

english: Are there any mining related quests?
Tell me about different rocks and picks.
translation: 여러 가지 바위와 곡괭이에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Rocks and Ores.
Clay and Rune Essence.
Teach me about mining.
Teach me about different rocks.
translation: 여러 가지 바위에 대해 가르쳐 주세요.

english: Copper and Tin.
Iron and Coal.
More...
Silver and Gold.
Mithril, Adamantite and Runite.
Back...
Pickaxes.
Bronze, Iron and Steel.
Goodbye.
Oh look, a human!
A human? Can we eat it?
No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!
translation: 아니, 이 돌대가리야! 인간은 우리 친구라고!

english: Hello, excuse me...
Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.
translation: 친구라고까지 할 수 있을지는 모르겠다... 물론 적도 아니지만.

english: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.
Excuse me, I just want to-
Nothing's worse than a troll.
Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-
translation: 곡괭이 날이 무뎌진 걸 하필 그 순간에 알아차리는 것만 빼면 말이야, 막-

english: Excuse me!!!
Why, hello, yes, what is it?
I er... well, who are you?
I'm Derni.
I'm Dernu.
And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?
translation: 그리고 저는 Miodvetnir(미오드베트니르)예요. 얘들은 제 형제들이고요. 그쪽은 누구신가요?

english: My name is Player.
Pleased to meet you, Player!
I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!
translation: 이야, 이 아래서 인군을 보는 일은 흔치 않은데요!

english: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!
translation: 인간이야, 이 쇠대가리야! 좀 똑바로 들어!

english: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?
translation: 그럼, 드워프분들께 몇 가지 물어봐도 될까요?

english: Of course, we love answering questions!
translation: 물론이죠, 우린 질문에 답하는 걸 좋아해요!

english: We're very good at answering questions!
translation: 질문에 대답하는 건 아주 자신 있어요!

english: Fire away!
Hello again, Player!
Are you lost down here?
Or were you just stopping by for a chat?
translation: 아니면 그냥 수다 떨러 들른 거예요?

english: Just stopping by for a chat.
What's down this river?
Oh, you don't know?
[He/She] doesn't know?
[He/She] doesn't know!
Can't you just tell me?
It is our glorious city!
The grand city of the dwarves!
Sparkling jewel of the mountain!
Keldagrim, our home!
Can you take me there?
Oh no, we can't do that.
We're far too busy.
You have to keep busy, you see.
Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.
translation: 항상 바쁘게 지내라, 우리 아버지께서 늘 하시던 말씀이죠.

english: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.
translation: 게다가 요즘 도시에서 이상한 일들이 좀 있었어요.

english: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!
translation: 그 얘긴 [him/her]한테 하지 마! [his/her] 일도 아니잖아!

english: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.
translation: [he/she]가 도시에 가고 싶다면 알려 주는 게 공평하지.

english: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.
translation: 아 맞다, 지난번에 있었던 그 자그마한 사건도 얼마 전에야 겨우 뒷정리가 끝났대요.

english: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!
translation: 그러니 혹시라도 도시에 가게 되면 조심해요! 이상한 일이 생길지도 몰라요!

english: Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 곳 있어요?

english: Fish?
Fish?
What are fish?
No fish around here.
Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?
translation: 가만, 당신 Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언) 아니에요?

english: That must be why you were talking about fish then...
But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.
translation: 하지만 여기 이 물은 말이죠, 위에서 똑똑 떨어져 내려오는 거예요.

english: Molten snow, you see.
Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.
translation: 아, 물속에 사는 작고 꿈틀거리는 녀석들이야.

english: But they're not all small! Some can be large!
translation: 근데 다 작은 건 아니야! 큰 것도 있어!

english: And they don't breathe air.
But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!
translation: 그래도 [player name]한테 물어보면 전부 알려 줄걸! 어쨌든 [he's/she's] Fishing Champion(낚시 챔피언)이니까!

english: Maybe later...
What are these mines used for?
What does it look like they're used for?
Isn't it obvious?
For mining of course!
These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
translation: 사실 이 광산들은 채굴 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 8대 회사 중 한 곳의 영역이에요.

english: Mining companies? Where are they at then?
translation: 채굴 회사요? 그럼 그 회사들은 어디 있어요?

english: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.
First floor of the palace.
No need to give [him/her] directions.
We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.
translation: 우린 물건을 전부 배로 도시까지 실어 나르거든요.

english: Since the mine carts don't come here.
But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.
translation: 그래도 강이 도시까지 곧장 이어지니까 이것도 똑같이 편해요.

english: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
translation: 광산 아래에 있는 이 바위 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.
translation: 부서지지 않는 것 같아요. 이유를 알아야 해요.

english: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?
That big unbreakable rock?
That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!
translation: [he/she]가 방금 그렇게 말했잖아? 좀 똑바로 들어!

english: Yes, yes, that's the one.
Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.
translation: 아, 아쉽지만 거긴 못 지나갈 거예요.

english: It's unbreakable, you see.
Dondakan's been there for...
How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?
translation: 거기 있은 지 얼마나 됐지, Miotvednir(미오드베트니르)?

english: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!
That's some dedication!
But look at what it got him.
translation: 근데 그래서 얻은 게 뭔지 봐.

english: Nothing, that's what.
Never mind.
What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?
translation: 어떤 재료라야 그 바위를 깰 수 있을까요? 그 있잖아요, 뚫을 수 없다는 그 바위요.

english: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?
translation: 글쎄요... rune pickaxe(룬 곡괭이)는 써 봤어요?

english: An adamantite tool?
What about a bronze pickaxe?
A bronze pickaxe??
What good would that do?
Well, you never know...
Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?
translation: 그런 건 제일 먼저 해 봤을 거라는 생각 안 들어?

english: Hey, it was just a suggestion!
Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?
translation: Rolad(롤라드)라는 사람 아세요? 드워프 학자 같은 사람인데요?

english: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.
translation: 미안하지만, 들어 본 적 없는 이름이네요.

english: Oh yes, I know Rolad!
Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!
translation: 어휴, 인간 좀 그만 놀려, Dernu(더누)!

english: Do you know where he is right now?
No idea, why?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 저를 대포로 쏘아 보내려고 해요!

english: Oh dear!
How awful!
That's terrible!
He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.
translation: 제가 정말로 그 바위를 뚫고 날아가서 반대편에 착지할 거라고 생각하나 봐요.

english: That sounds a bit daft.
How would that work?
I think you're going to hurt your head.
Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸) 영감이 드디어 정신이 나갔나 보네요.

english: He was always obsessed with that rock.
translation: 그 영감은 늘 그 바위에 집착했죠.

english: And gold.
Right, and gold.
Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있어요?

english: An evil demon, you say?
I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.
translation: 저라면 사악한 악마랑 마주치면 도망칠 거예요.

english: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!
Well, what would you do then?
I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.
translation: 몰라, 사악한 악마는 만나 본 적이 없어.

english: I once met a good demon though.
translation: 그래도 착한 악마는 한 번 만난 적 있지.

english: Oh yes, what did he say?
translation: 오, 그래? 그 악마가 뭐라고 했어?

english: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.
translation: 퍼즐 상자 하나를 주고는 다시 가 버렸어.

english: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.
translation: 너 그때 dwarven stout(드워프 스타우트)를 너무 많이 마셨던 거 아냐?

english: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?
translation: 그럴 수도, 그럴 수도 있지. 하지만 누가 알겠어?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
That's amazing!
That's fantastic!
What rock was that again?
Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!
translation: 한 번이라도 좀 똑바로 들어, Dernu(더누)! Dondakan(돈다칸)의 바위잖아!

english: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?
translation: 정말 대단하네요, Player. 어떻게 해낸 거예요?

english: Well, you see, I just-
What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 당연히 [his/her/their] 엄청난 힘으로 해냈지!

english: Or vast magical skills!
No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?
translation: 아니, 당신은 레인저 쪽이죠, 안 그래요, Player?

english: Actually, I-
Anyway, this calls for a celebration.
Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.
Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.
translation: 물론 오늘 밤에. 지금 말고. 지금은 근무 중이니까.

english: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.
translation: 그래... 그리고 그 바위가 깨졌으니 여기 오가는 사람도 곧 늘어날 거야.

english: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!
The company is going to be rich!
Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.
translation: 이 인간 앞에서 회사 일 얘기는 하지 마, Dernu(더누).

english: Right. Let's get back to work.
Anything else you wanted, Player?
I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.
translation: 이 조각상 일로 도움이 좀 필요해요... 정확히는 King Alvis(알비스 왕)의 조각상이요.

english: Oh yes, what's the problem then?
It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?
translation: 그거 쓰러졌잖아, 기억 안 나? 조각이 우리 머리 위로 떨어질 뻔했잖아?

english: A terrible noise it made too!
This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.
translation: 조각가가 저한테 물건을 잔뜩 찾아오라고 해서요.

english: Items eh?
We love items.
Can't get enough of them.
Well, can you he-
translation: 저, 그럼 좀 도와주실 수 있-

english: I got this puzzle box once, you know.
translation: 저 예전에 퍼즐 상자를 받은 적이 있거든요.

english: Oh, not that story again.
You have told that story before, Dernu.
Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
translation: 그럼 됐어. 듣기 싫으면 입 다물게.

english: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.
translation: 음, 이제 조각가는 머리만 만들면 돼요. 그런데 그러려면 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 도움을 받아야 해요.

english: The Consortium, you say?
You're going to talk to the Consortium?
My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?
translation: 와, 드워프 세계에서 출세 좀 하시는데요?

english: What do you need us for then?
We are but simple dwarves.
Especially you, Dernu.
Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.
translation: 자자, Derni(더니), 그런 말은 할 필요 없잖아.

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: What, really?
Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?
translation: 당연히 정말이지! 안 그러면 Player 쪽에서 그런 말을 했겠어? [he/she/they]는 그럴 사람이 아니야!

english: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?
translation: 그리고 Blasidar(블라시다르)가 조각상 작업하는 거 못 봤어?

english: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.
translation: 아 맞다, 꽤 오랫동안 밖에서 일하더라.

english: That must have been a huge task.
Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.
He truly is a master builder.
We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.
translation: 우리 모두 그 성실함과 헌신을 본받아야 해.

english: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?
translation: 말 나온 김에, 우리도 다시 일하러 가야 하지 않아?

english: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?
translation: 맞는 말이야. 또 필요한 거 있어요, Player?

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 이 술 취한 드워프에 대해 아세요...?

english: Drunken dwarf?
Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!
In fact we know plenty!
There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.
translation: 그런데 진짜 짜증 나는 드워프가 하나 있는데요, 가끔 아무 이유 없이 저한테 돌을 던져요.

english: Yeah, tell me about it.
The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.
translation: 제가 말하는 건 그 사람 친척인데, Keldagrim(켈다그림) 북동쪽에 살아요. 그 사람 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Ah yes, him.
Such a sad case, poor fellow.
Who is he?
Don't you know anything?
Now now, there's no reason to get angry.
I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.
translation: 그건 그렇네. 음, 케밥 얘기를 많이 하는 술 취한 드워프예요.

english: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.
And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.
translation: 그리고 듣자 하니 아까 제가 말한 그 드워프의 친척이래요.

english: I hope that helped, Player?
I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 잊을 수 없는 이야기를 들려 드릴게요!

english: A tale!
We love tales!
We live for tales!
Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...
translation: 그러니까, 예전에 광산에서 내 spanner(스패너)를 잃어버렸을 때 말인데...

english: Player wants to tell a tale!
But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.
translation: 근데 내 스패너 얘기는... 진짜 재밌는 얘기라고.

english: I think we've heard it before.
It was pretty forgettable.
Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?
translation: 저기요, 제 이야기 들을 거예요, 말 거예요?

english: Happy to.
Would love to hear it.
As long as it's better than my spanner story.
So, what's your tale like?
Ah, I errrr...
I seem to have forgotten.
Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.
translation: 그럼 그것도 금방 잊어버릴 만한 이야기였나 보네요.

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 이제 가 봐야겠어요, 얘기 나눠 줘서 고마워요.

english: No problem!
Glad to be of service!
Come back any time!
What's down this river?
Any good spots to fish around here?
translation: 이 근처에 낚시하기 좋은 곳 있어요?

english: What are these mines used for?
Can you help me with this rock?
translation: 이 바위 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: What material would break that rock?
translation: 어떤 재료라야 그 바위를 깰 수 있을까요?

english: Do you know anyone named Rolad?
Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!
translation: Dondakan(돈다칸)이 저를 대포로 쏘아 보내려고 해요!

english: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?
translation: 사악한 악마를 물리치는 요령 같은 거 있어요?

english: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
I need some help with this statue...
translation: 이 조각상 일로 도움이 좀 필요해요...

english: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
translation: [company name] 측을 위해 조각상을 다시 세웠어요!

english: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
translation: 이 술 취한 드워프에 대해 아세요...?

english: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
translation: 잊을 수 없는 이야기를 들려 드릴게요!

english: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.
translation: 이제 가 봐야겠어요, 얘기 나눠 줘서 고마워요.

english: Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 단골 고객이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Hello, human. Can I help you?
What is this place?
This is the principal station of the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Once it's running, our people will be able to travel rapidly all across the city.
translation: 여기는 Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 중앙역이에요. 운행이 시작되면 우리 동족들이 도시 곳곳을 빠르게 오갈 수 있게 되죠.

english: Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 광차 좀 태워 주실 수 있어요?

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first. Free up some inventory space if you're interested.
translation: 이 네트워크는 Lovakengj(로바켕기) 시민 전용이지만, 먼저 저를 도와준다면 이용하게 해 줄게요. 관심 있으면 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 오세요.

english: The network is for the citizens of Lovakengj only, though I'll let you use it if you help me first.
translation: 이 네트워크는 Lovakengj(로바켕기) 시민 전용이지만, 먼저 저를 도와준다면 이용하게 해 줄게요.

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
The workers at the other stations got incorrect versions of the control scrolls, so they can't operate the minecarts. Please take these updated scrolls to them.
translation: 다른 역 직원들이 잘못된 버전의 제어 두루마리를 받아서 광차를 운행할 수가 없어요. 이 새 두루마리를 그 사람들한테 갖다주세요.

english: That's one scroll each for the Arceuus station, the Shayzien station, the Hosidius station, the Piscarilius station and the Quidamortem station.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 역, Shayzien(샤이지엔) 역, Hosidius(호시디우스) 역, Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) 역, Quidamortem(퀴다모르템) 역에 하나씩이에요.

english: Where do I need to go?
The Arceuus station is just next to the Arceuus Library, in the north of the city.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 역은 도시 북쪽, Arceuus Library(아르세우스 도서관) 바로 옆에 있어요.

english: The Shayzien station is east of the Shayzien Encampment.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 역은 Shayzien Encampment(샤이지엔 야영지) 동쪽에 있어요.

english: The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild.
translation: Hosidius(호시디우스) 역은 Woodcutting Guild(벌목 길드) 북쪽에 있어요.

english: The Piscarilius station is south of the city, next to a small mine.
translation: Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) 역은 도시 남쪽, 작은 광산 옆에 있어요.

english: The Quidamortem station is at the peak of the mountain, deep in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: Quidamortem(퀴다모르템) 역은 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대) 깊숙한 곳, 산꼭대기에 있어요.

english: Can I go for a ride now?
No, you haven't unlocked any of the other stations yet.
translation: 아뇨, 아직 다른 역을 하나도 개방하지 않았어요.

english: Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: 광차 탈 때마다 돈을 내야 하나요?

english: Hmmm... We normally charge 50 coins per ride. For 100,000 coins, you'll never have to pay again.
translation: 흐음... 보통은 한 번 탈 때마다 50코인을 받아요. 100,000코인을 내면 다시는 낼 필요가 없죠.

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
Take it or leave it, human! You may enjoy being about to ride our carts without having to carry coins every time.
translation: 싫으면 관두세요, 인간! 탈 때마다 코인을 챙길 필요 없이 광차를 탈 수 있으면 꽤 좋을 텐데요.

english: I'd rather not, thanks.
Can I do anything else for you, human?
I'll get on with it.
I'm not interested.
Some of my stations still require control scrolls.
translation: 아직 제어 두루마리가 필요한 역이 남아 있어요.

english: Have you got any more scrolls?
Yes, but you don't have room in your inventory.
Here you go, human.
No thanks, I don't want it back.
Thanks for delivering those control scrolls, human. What can I do for you today?
translation: 제어 두루마리를 전해 줘서 고마워요, 인간. 오늘은 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What is this place?
Can I ride your minecart?
translation: 광차 좀 태워 주실 수 있어요?

english: Alright, what do you need me to do?
Where do I need to go?
Can I go for a ride now?
Do I have to pay every time I use the carts?
translation: 광차 탈 때마다 돈을 내야 하나요?

english: 100,000 coins is a rip-off!
Okay, I'll pay.
I'd rather not, thanks.
I'll get on with it.
I'm not interested.
Have you got any more scrolls?
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시에 정말 멋진 날이 찾아왔네요, 그쵸?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 여기서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만해요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 여기서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
You are excused. And you are welcome.
translation: 실례는 괜찮소. 그리고 고맙다니 천만의 말씀이오.

english: Excuse me...er...thanks.
We are the Order of the Dagon'hai.
translation: 우리는 Order of the Dagon'hai(다곤하이 교단)이오.

english: Who are you?
Through my magic, I can see a short way into the future.
translation: 나는 마법으로 미래를 조금 내다볼 수 있소.

english: How do you seem to know what I'm going to say? ...Er...oh.
translation: 제가 무슨 말을 할지 어떻게 아시는 거예요? ...어... 아.

english: These are the Tunnels of Chaos.
What is...uh...aha! I'm not going to ask that. So you got it wrong!
translation: 여긴 뭐... 어... 아하! 그건 안 물어볼 거예요. 그러니까 틀리셨네요!

english: Indeed. You are very clever.
So I won!
Yes.
So, what is this place?
I mean...Argh! How do you do that?
translation: 아니, 그러니까... 으악! 어떻게 그러시는 거예요?

english: I can tell that your mind is not suited to the paradoxicalities of precognition.
translation: 그대의 정신은 예지의 역설성을 감당하기에 적합하지 않은 듯하구려.

english: My what does what now?
You get confused very easily.
I knew that.
Of course you did. Speak to one of my order here. They will be able to explain in a manner more suited to your understanding.
translation: 물론 그랬겠지. 여기 있는 우리 교단원 중 하나와 이야기해 보시오. 그대가 이해하기 쉬운 방식으로 설명해 줄 것이오.

english: You are welcome, [player name]. There is a bed around here if you wish.
translation: 천만에, [player name]. 원한다면 이 근처에 침대가 있으니 쓰시오.

english: Thanks. My name's [player name], by the w...uh...okay, I think I need to lie down.
translation: 고마워요. 그런데 제 이름은 [player name]... 어... 네, 아무래도 좀 누워야겠어요.

english: Oooh, my dear, have you heard the news?
Ok, tell me about the news.
It's terrible, absolutely terrible! Those poor people!
translation: 끔찍해요, 정말 끔찍하다니까요! 그 불쌍한 사람들!

english: Ok, yeah.
And who'd have ever thought such a sweet old gentleman would do such a thing?
translation: 그렇게 다정한 노신사가 그런 짓을 할 줄 누가 알았겠어요?

english: Are we talking about the bank robbery?
Oh yes, my dear. It was terrible! TERRIBLE!
But tell me - have you been around here before, or are you new to these parts?
translation: 그런데 말해 봐요. 이 근처에 와 본 적 있어요, 아니면 여기 처음이에요?

english: I'm quite new.
translation: 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐어요.

english: Aah, perhaps you missed the excitement. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?
translation: 아, 그럼 그 소동을 놓쳤겠네요. 이 집에 사는 그 노인 말이에요. 그 사람 알아요?

english: Well, I know of him.
When he first moved here, he didn't bring much. From the window you could see he just had some old furniture and a few dusty ornaments.
translation: 처음 이사 왔을 때는 가져온 게 별로 없었어요. 창문으로 보면 낡은 가구 몇 개랑 먼지 쌓인 장식품 몇 개뿐이었다고요.

english: Here, look at this picture:
Also he always seemed so poor. When I went round to collect donations for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund, he couldn't spare them a penny!
translation: 게다가 늘 그렇게 가난해 보였어요. 내가 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 복원 기금 모금하러 갔을 때도 한 푼도 못 내놓더라니까요!

english: So he's redecorated?
Well, just you look in there now!
translation: 글쎄, 지금 저 안을 한번 봐요!

english: You see? It's full of jewellery and decorations! And all those expensive things appeared just after the bank got robbed.
translation: 봤죠? 장신구랑 장식품이 가득하잖아요! 그 비싼 물건들이 전부 은행이 털린 직후에 나타났다고요.

english: He changed his hat too - he used to wear a scruffy old black thing, but suddenly he was wearing that party hat!
translation: 모자도 바꿨어요. 예전엔 꾀죄죄한 낡은 검은 모자를 쓰고 다니더니, 갑자기 저 파티 모자를 쓰고 나왔지 뭐예요!

english: So that's why you're telling people he was the bank robber?
translation: 그래서 사람들한테 그분이 은행 강도라고 말하고 다니시는 거예요?

english: Oooh, my dear, I'm SURE of it! I went upstairs in his house once, while he was out walking, and do you know what I found?
translation: 어머, 자기, 난 확신해요! 그 사람이 산책 나간 사이에 그 집 위층에 한번 올라가 봤는데, 내가 뭘 찾았는지 알아요?

english: A sign saying 'Trespassers will be prosecuted'?
No, it was a telescope! It was pointing right at the bank! He was spying on the bankers, planning the big robbery!
translation: 아니요, 망원경이었어요! 은행 쪽을 똑바로 가리키고 있었다고요! 은행원들을 몰래 지켜보면서 대형 강도 계획을 세운 거예요!

english: I bet if you go and look through it now, you'll find it's pointing somewhere different now he's finished with the bank.
translation: 장담하는데, 지금 가서 들여다보면 다른 데를 가리키고 있을걸요. 은행 일은 다 끝났으니까요.

english: I'd like to go now.
Oh, really? Well, do keep an eye on him - I just KNOW he's planning something...
translation: 어머, 정말요? 그럼 그 사람 잘 지켜봐요. 분명 뭔가 꾸미고 있다니까요...

english: I've been around here for ages.
translation: 저는 여기 온 지 한참 됐어요.

english: Ah, so you'd have seen the changes here. It's that old man in this house here. Do you know him?
