translation: 아, 그럼 여기 바뀐 걸 봤겠네요. 이 집에 사는 그 노인 말이에요. 그 사람 알아요?

english: I've had enough of talking to you.
Maybe another time, my dear.
Who are you?

I, my dear, am a concerned citizen of Draynor Village. Ever since the Council allowed those farmers to set up their stalls here, we've had a constant flow of thieves and murderers through our fair village, and I decided
translation: 나는 말이죠, 자기, Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)을 걱정하는 시민이에요. 의회가 농부들한테 여기 노점을 차리게 허락한 뒤로 우리 아름다운 마을에 도둑이며 살인자들이 끊임없이 드나들었어요. 그래서 나는 결심했죠.

english: that someone HAD to stand up and keep an eye on the situation.
translation: 누군가는 나서서 이 상황을 지켜봐야 한다고요.

english: I also do voluntary work for the Draynor Manor Restoration Fund. We're campaigning to have Draynor Manor turned into a museum before the wet- rot destroys it completely.
translation: Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 복원 기금 봉사 활동도 하고 있어요. 저택이 습기에 썩어 완전히 무너지기 전에 박물관으로 만들자는 운동을 벌이고 있죠.

english: Right...
I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.
translation: 당신이랑은 말 안 해요, 이 고약한 아줌마.

english: Oooh.
Oooh! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 어머! 자기한테 알려 줄 새 소식이 있어요.

english: Ok, tell me about the news.
I'm quite new.
translation: 여기 온 지 얼마 안 됐어요.

english: I've been around here for ages.
translation: 저는 여기 온 지 한참 됐어요.

english: I've had enough of talking to you.
Who are you?
I'm not talking to you, you horrible woman.
translation: 당신이랑은 말 안 해요, 이 고약한 아줌마.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕하세요, 안녕, 반가워요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 한 번으로 치는 거예요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시의 오늘 하루, 참 멋지지 않아요?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처엔 뭘 할 게 있어요?

english: Nothing.
MMMGHGHGGMH!!!
What's going on ARRGH!
Arrgh! Human! Scary! Go away!
Do you seek guidance, traveller?
Sure, gimme your best advice.
translation: 그럼요, 최고의 조언 좀 해 주세요.

english: *sigh*
You flesh-temples always assume you can receive guidance merely by asking someone for it. But in this land there is a power that can teach us far more than any mere teacher could.
translation: 자네 같은 육신의 사원들은 늘 누군가에게 청하기만 하면 인도를 받을 수 있다고 여기지. 하지만 이 땅에는 그 어떤 스승보다 훨씬 많은 것을 가르쳐 줄 힘이 있다네.

english: I speak of the Dark Altar. For generations our wisest scholars have studied it, yet still it has capacities beyond our comprehension.
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)을 말하는 걸세. 수 세대에 걸쳐 우리의 가장 현명한 학자들이 연구했지만, 그 제단에는 아직도 우리의 이해를 넘어서는 힘이 있지.

english: The Dark Altar can distort the dimensions, warping the fabric of reality as you perceive it, and even bridging the gap between life and death.
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)은 차원을 비틀어 자네가 인식하는 현실의 구조를 뒤틀 수 있고, 삶과 죽음 사이의 틈마저 이어 줄 수 있다네.

english: But you are still a flesh-temple; you require a corporeal body to house your soul, and you perform disgusting bodily functions to maintain it.
translation: 하지만 자네는 아직 육신의 사원일세. 영혼을 담을 물질적인 몸이 필요하고, 그 몸을 유지하려고 역겨운 생리 활동을 하지.

english: We of Arceuus have learnt, through the power of the Dark Altar, to move beyond the need for such a flesh- temple to house our souls.
translation: 우리 Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들은 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘으로 영혼을 담을 육신의 사원 따위는 필요 없는 경지에 이르렀다네.

english: In the crypt below us, we freed our souls from the flesh-temples that had imprisoned them, and we took the form you see now.
translation: 우리 아래의 지하 묘지에서 우리는 영혼을 가두고 있던 육신의 사원으로부터 영혼을 해방했고, 지금 자네가 보는 모습이 되었지.

english: Perhaps, if you allow the Dark Altar to work on your mind, one day you too will be able to ascend to our higher form.
translation: 자네도 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)이 자네의 정신에 작용하도록 맡긴다면, 언젠가 우리처럼 더 높은 형태로 올라설 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: Thank you for explaining that.
I fear you are far from comprehending it. Now, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 자네는 그걸 이해하려면 아직 한참 멀었을 걸세. 그래, 내가 자네에게 해 줄 일이 있나?

english: No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 저는 몸이 있는 게 좋아요. 재밌거든요.

english: How disgusting - a flesh-temple that worships itself. Now, do you want anything?
translation: 역겹군. 제 몸을 숭배하는 육신의 사원이라니. 그래, 뭐 원하는 거라도 있나?

english: What god do you worship?
You sound like the Saradominist peasants from Hosidius, always assuming they must serve one god above all others.
translation: 자네 말은 Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Saradomin(사라도민) 추종자 농민들 같군. 늘 다른 모든 신보다 한 신을 섬겨야 한다고 여기지.

english: While the gods are useful for tedious matters such as granting prayers during combat, we of Arceuus have long moved beyond the need to pay them homage.
translation: 신들은 전투 중에 기도를 들어주는 것 같은 지루한 일에야 쓸모가 있지만, 우리 Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들은 오래전에 그들에게 경배할 필요를 넘어섰다네.

english: This is a place of meditation, where a novice may contemplate the mysteries of the Dark Altar - without venturing too close to its power.
translation: 이곳은 명상의 장소일세. 초심자가 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘에 너무 가까이 가지 않고도 그 신비를 묵상할 수 있는 곳이지.

english: Saradomin is popular with many uneducated citizens of Kourend, but you may use our church to worship any god you prefer. That would be an ecumenical matter.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 배우지 못한 시민들에게 인기가 많지만, 자네는 우리 교회에서 어떤 신이든 원하는 신을 섬겨도 좋네. 그건 교회 일치에 관한 문제일 테니.

english: Now, do you require anything of me?
No, I'm fine.
Sure, gimme your best advice.
translation: 그럼요, 최고의 조언 좀 해 주세요.

english: Thank you for explaining that.
No thanks, I like having a body. It's fun.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 저는 몸이 있는 게 좋아요. 재밌거든요.

english: What god do you worship?
No, I'm fine.
Erm, what are you?
Who are you.
I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you.
You misunderstand. Your question should've been 'who are you?', not 'what are you?'. The latter is significantly more offensive.
translation: 잘못 알아들었군. '뭐예요?'가 아니라 '누구세요?'라고 물었어야 했다는 말일세. '뭐예요'라는 쪽이 훨씬 더 무례하다네.

english: Oh... erm.... I didn't mean to offend.
translation: 아... 어.... 기분 상하게 하려던 건 아니었어요.

english: I see. Well I am Mofina, a citizen of Arceuus.
Nice to meet you Mofina. Erm...
Yes?
Where exactly are you from, Mofina? I haven't heard of Arceuus and I haven't seen anyone else who is dressed like you around here.
translation: 모피나, 정확히 어디서 오셨어요? Arceuus(아르세우스)라는 곳은 들어 본 적이 없고, 이 근처에서 당신처럼 차려입은 사람도 본 적이 없어요.

english: You are learning. That question is significantly less offensive.
translation: 배우고 있군. 그 질문은 훨씬 덜 무례하네.

english: Arceuus is one of five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, found on the continent to the west.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스)는 서쪽 대륙에 있는 Kingdom of Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드 왕국)의 다섯 도시 중 하나일세.

english: Okay, and how can I get to Kourend?
I believe Veos, one of your portmasters in Port Sarim, can help assist in such matters.
translation: 자네들의 항구 관리인 중 하나인 Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 Veos(베오스)가 그런 일을 도와줄 수 있을 걸세.

english: I never expected to see one of your kind outside of Kourend. I guess the Duke invited you to the party for the same reason he invited the others?
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드) 밖에서 당신 같은 종족을 보게 될 줄은 몰랐어요. 공작님이 다른 사람들을 초대한 것과 같은 이유로 당신도 파티에 초대하신 거죠?

english: We... never expected to see any of your kind from across the sea either, but yes, you would be correct. The Duke did ask for a representative from Kourend and I was selected to attend.
translation: 우리도... 바다 건너에서 자네 같은 종족을 보게 될 줄은 몰랐네. 하지만 그래, 자네 말이 맞네. 공작께서 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 대표를 청하셨고, 내가 뽑혀 참석하게 되었지.

english: Sorry, that came across a little ruder than I intended. I just wasn't entirely sure what term to use for citizens of Arceuus.
translation: 죄송해요, 생각보다 좀 무례하게 들렸네요. Arceuus(아르세우스) 시민을 뭐라고 불러야 할지 잘 몰랐을 뿐이에요.

english: Citizens of Arceuus would have been fine.
Now if you excuse me, this conversation is... tiring. Being away from the Dark Altar has taken a greater toll on me than I expected.
translation: 이제 실례하겠네. 이 대화는... 피곤하군. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)에서 떨어져 있는 것이 생각보다 훨씬 큰 부담이 되는구먼.

english: I hope you still enjoy the party!
Why, what brings you to my house, young [man/lady]?
translation: 아이고, 젊은 [man/lady], 우리 집엔 무슨 일로 왔니?

english: Who are you?
Me? Well, let's see... I live here. So I suppose I'm your host, as long as you're in my house.
translation: 나? 글쎄, 어디 보자... 나는 여기 살지. 그러니 네가 우리 집에 있는 동안은 내가 집주인인 셈이구나.

english: I used to work down at the beach, running the charcoal furnaces, but I've handed all that business to my son now. He's a good boy.
translation: 예전엔 해변에서 숯가마를 돌렸는데, 이제 그 일은 다 아들한테 넘겨줬단다. 착한 녀석이지.

english: Anyway, retiring isn't too bad. There's plenty of warmth from the lava pits, and my boy helps me carry my shopping from Munty's shop. I'll be alright.
translation: 아무튼 은퇴 생활도 나쁘지 않아. 용암 구덩이 덕에 늘 따뜻하고, 우리 아들이 Munty(먼티)네 가게에서 장 본 걸 들어다 주거든. 난 괜찮을 거야.

english: But you've never told me what you're doing in my house, young [man/lady]. Don't think I've forgotten!
translation: 그런데 젊은 [man/lady], 우리 집에서 뭘 하는지 아직 말 안 했잖니. 내가 잊어버린 줄 알면 오산이다!

english: Have you got anything to trade?
Oh, are you a door-to-door [salesman/saleswoman]? My boy said I shouldn't let people like you into the house, and to call the guards if you bothered me.
translation: 어머, 방문 판매하는 [salesman/saleswoman]이니? 우리 아들이 너 같은 사람은 집에 들이지 말고, 귀찮게 굴면 경비병을 부르라고 했단다.

english: That won't be necessary.
So why are you in my house anyway?
translation: 그래서 우리 집엔 대체 왜 온 거니?

english: I'm just wandering around.
Be a dear and just wander off now.
translation: 그럼 착한 아이답게 이제 다른 데 가서 돌아다니렴.

english: Who are you?
Have you got anything to trade?
I'm just wandering around.
Human scare all da fishies!
I smack you good!
Da boom-boom kill all da fishies!
Tasty human!
Smash stupid human!
I get you!
Human hit me on the head!
Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
translation: 바보 물고기! 쪼끄만 팔이랑 쪼끄만 다리 달린 게 꼬마 Mogre(모그레) 같다!

english: Swim along silly round head fishy!
translation: 동글머리 바보 물고기, 저리 헤엄쳐 가라!

english: Dont let dem big skippies eat you!
Hey! Nung says no fishies...
translation: 야! Nung(눙)이 물고기 안 된다 했다...

english: I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.
Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.
translation: 음... Nung(눙)이 괜찮다 했으면, 그럼 가라.

english: The player enters the crab pen
Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기) 광차 네트워크의 단골손님이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: 미안하지만 인간, Lovakengj(로바켕기) 광차 네트워크는 이용할 수 없어요. 궁금한 게 있으면 로바켕기 남쪽 은행 옆 중앙역에 있는 Miriam(미리암)에게 물어보세요.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: 미안하지만 인간, Lovakengj(로바켕기) 광차 네트워크는 로바켕기 시민만 이용할 수 있어요.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
translation: 당신에게 줄 control scroll(제어 두루마리)를 가져왔어요.

english: Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: 고마워요, 인간. 이제 당신도 제 광차를 타도 괜찮겠네요. 자, 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: control scroll(제어 두루마리)를 가져다줘서 다시 한번 고마워요. 오늘 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 그건 이미 하나 받았어요.

english: Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
Wait! Do you know what you're doing here?
translation: 잠깐만요! 여기서 뭘 해야 하는지 알아요?

english: Yes, I know, I've been here before.
translation: 네, 알아요. 전에 와 본 적 있어요.

english: Well good luck then!
Erm, no I don't actually.
Well, come on over and I'll fill you in on what happened.
translation: 그럼 이리 와요. 무슨 일이 있었는지 알려 줄게요.

english: Thanks for coming!
What's the problem then?
It's my evil twin sister! She's been galavanting around Gielinor committing crimes and now I'm getting the blame!
translation: 제 사악한 쌍둥이 언니 때문이에요! Gielinor(길리노르)를 쏘다니면서 범죄를 저지르는데, 그 누명을 제가 다 쓰고 있다고요!

english: Well what's all this got to do with me then?
I'm glad you asked!
Through that door is a room with a cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: 저 문 너머에 방이 하나 있는데, 거기엔 우리랑 거대한 기계 집게를 움직이는 제어판이 있어요.

english: I lured my sister into the room so I could imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: 집게로 우리에 가두려고 언니를 그 방으로 꾀어 들였어요. 문제는 언니가 무고한 민간인 몇 명을 같이 몰고 들어갔다는 거죠.

english: So what do you need me to do?
I need you to go next door and use the claw to catch my sister.
translation: 옆방으로 가서 집게로 제 언니를 잡아 주세요.

english: Once she's in prison, she won't be causing me anymore bother!
translation: 감옥에 갇히고 나면 더는 저를 귀찮게 하지 못할 거예요!

english: Sounds easy enough to me.
Fabulous! Now take a good long look at me because the door will be locked behind you. My twin looks exactly like me, even her clothes!
translation: 좋아요! 이제 제 모습을 잘 봐 두세요. 들어가면 등 뒤로 문이 잠기거든요. 언니는 저랑 똑같이 생겼어요, 옷까지도요!

english: One more thing to make your life difficult; the magic powering the claw is running low so you'll only have two attempts to catch her.
translation: 일을 더 어렵게 만드는 게 하나 더 있어요. 집게를 움직이는 마력이 바닥나고 있어서 언니를 잡을 기회는 두 번뿐이에요.

english: I'll do my best then!
By the way, would you like me to run through the controls for you, or do you think you'll manage?
translation: 그나저나 조작법을 알려 드릴까요, 아니면 혼자 할 수 있겠어요?

english: Yes please. I mean, it's always best to be prepared, right?
translation: 네, 부탁해요. 언제나 준비해 두는 게 제일이잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: Ok, when you turn the machine on you'll see the glowing mark on the floor where the claw is currently aiming, and you'll see a lever and button on the right hand side of your screen.
translation: 좋아요. 기계를 켜면 집게가 지금 겨누고 있는 바닥에 빛나는 표시가 보이고, 화면 오른쪽에 레버와 버튼이 보일 거예요.

english: To move the claw's current location, click on the direction you want it to move in, as indicated on the right hand panel.
translation: 집게 위치를 옮기려면 오른쪽 패널에 표시된 방향 중 움직이고 싶은 쪽을 클릭하세요.

english: You'll know which way the claw will go as the lever will point that way to show you.
translation: 레버가 그쪽을 가리키니까 집게가 어느 쪽으로 갈지 알 수 있을 거예요.

english: When you see someone on top of the glowing mark, then hit the button on the right hand panel, as this will send the claw down to pick them up.
translation: 누군가 빛나는 표시 위에 올라서면 오른쪽 패널의 버튼을 누르세요. 그러면 집게가 내려가서 그 사람을 집어 올릴 거예요.

english: Do be careful and make sure that there is someone on the mark, and not just walking past it.
translation: 그냥 지나가는 게 아니라 누군가 표시 위에 서 있는지 꼭 조심해서 확인하세요.

english: Oh, and make sure that the person is my sister, so you don't end up catching a random civilian.
translation: 아, 그리고 그 사람이 꼭 제 언니인지 확인하세요. 엉뚱한 민간인을 잡으면 안 되니까요.

english: Does that help?
Yes, that covers everything. Thanks!
Good luck!
No, thanks. I should be able to work it out.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 제가 알아서 해 볼게요.

english: I want to leave.
Fine. And there I was thinking you'd help.
The player is teleported back to their initial location
What do I have to do again?
One more time then.
Through that door is a room with cage and a control panel that operates a giant mechanical claw.
translation: 저 문 너머에 방이 하나 있는데, 거기엔 우리랑 거대한 기계 집게를 움직이는 제어판이 있어요.

english: I lured my sister into the room so I can imprison her in the cage by using the claw. The problem is my sister managed to herd some innocent civilians in there with her.
translation: 집게로 우리에 가두려고 언니를 그 방으로 꾀어 들였어요. 문제는 언니가 무고한 민간인 몇 명을 같이 몰고 들어갔다는 거죠.

english: Once she's in prison she wont be causing me anymore bother!
translation: 감옥에 갇히고 나면 더는 저를 귀찮게 하지 못할 거예요!

english: You need to finish grabbing my twin before you come back through!
translation: 돌아오기 전에 제 쌍둥이 언니부터 잡으셔야 해요!

english: Okay.
But I want to leave.
You need to use the control panel to use the claw!
Well, you tried your best I suppose. Come next door and talk to me.
translation: 음, 그래도 최선은 다했겠죠. 옆방으로 와서 저랑 얘기해요.

english: Err, sorry. I seem to have messed it up a little.
translation: 어, 죄송해요. 좀 망친 것 같아요.

english: Such incompetence! I should never have asked a baboon like you to do a complex task like this!
translation: 이렇게 무능할 수가! 당신 같은 개코원숭이한테 이런 복잡한 일을 맡기는 게 아니었어요!

english: Get out of my sight!
Well done! You managed to catch my sister!
Come next door and talk to me.
Well, I've managed to get her into the cage.
Fantastic! For so many years I've had to put up with her and now she's locked up for good.
translation: 정말 멋져요! 몇 년 동안이나 언니를 참고 살았는데, 이제 영원히 갇혀 버렸네요.

english: Thank you for all your help. Take this as a reward.
translation: 도와줘서 정말 고마워요. 보상으로 이걸 받으세요.

english: Player is teleported back to their initial location
Yes, I know.
Erm, no I don't actually.
I want to leave.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Okay.
But I want to leave.
Who's a good doggy!
Woof!
Thbbbbt!
Whine!
Woof woof!
You give the dog a nice piece of meat. It gobbles it up.
translation: 개에게 맛있는 고기 한 점을 준다. 개가 덥석 먹어 치운다.

english: Grrrr!
That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: 그건 역겹다. 불쌍한 개한테 그런 걸 줄 수는 없다!

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
translation: 개는 그것에 관심이 없는 것 같다.

english: Greetings traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 저 좀 치료해 주실 수 있어요? 다쳤어요.

english: Ok.
Sorry, no.
Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 여기 좀 외진 곳에 지어진 거 아니에요?

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: 사실 저희는 그게 좋아요! 방해를 덜 받거든요. 그런데도 안식과 치유를 찾아오는 여행자가 꽤 많답니다!

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 수도원 안쪽으로 더 들어가려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley about that. He's usually to be found walking the halls of the monastery.
translation: 그건 Abbot Langley(랭글리 수도원장)님께 말씀드려야 해요. 보통 수도원 복도를 거닐고 계시죠.

english: Only members of our order can go up there. You'll need to talk to Abbot Langley if you want to explore the monastery further.
translation: 저 위로는 저희 수도회 사람만 올라갈 수 있어요. 수도원을 더 둘러보고 싶으면 Abbot Langley(랭글리 수도원장)님께 말씀드리세요.

english: What are you doing here?
We offer sanctuary to those seeking the guidance of Saradomin.
translation: 저희는 Saradomin(사라도민)의 인도를 구하는 이들에게 안식처를 내어 드리고 있어요.

english: What if I want guidance from another god?
If Saradomin's not good enough for you, those otherworldly freaks from Arceuus are probably your kind of people.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)으로 성에 안 찬다면, Arceuus(아르세우스)의 그 괴상한 저세상 족속들이 딱 당신 취향이겠네요.

english: They're always looking for hidden knowledge about souls and spirits, when any sensible person would just trust in Saradomin.
translation: 그 사람들은 늘 영혼이니 정령이니 하는 숨겨진 지식을 찾아다니죠. 분별 있는 사람이라면 그냥 사라도민을 믿을 텐데 말이에요.

english: I see.
Thanks.
Peace brother
*yawn*
Can't wait for the party!
Party!
Woop!
Yeah!
Let's boogie!
Oh baby!
GO!
Get down!
Feel the rhythm!
Dance!
Oh my!
Watch me go!
You go!
*hic* What a party! Wow!
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 저 좀 치료해 주실 수 있어요? 다쳤어요.

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: 여기 좀 외진 곳에 지어진 거 아니에요?

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: 수도원 안쪽으로 더 들어가려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: What are you doing here?
What if I want guidance from another god?
Thanks.
Pray for salvation!
Protect our home!
Save our monastery!
Say no to Oziach!
Spook, don't spend!
We're the only Monk robe spawn in the world!
translation: 세상에 Monk robe(수도복)이 나오는 곳은 우리뿐이라고요!

english: Hello! What is going on here?
We're protesting of course!
Yes, I can see that. What are you protesting about?
translation: 네, 그건 보이네요. 뭘 반대하는 시위인데요?

english: Our home! It's under attack! We must save it!
translation: 우리 집이요! 공격받고 있어요! 우리가 지켜야 해요!

english: Under attack?!
Under attack by Oziach! He's trying to buy it!
translation: Oziach(오지아크)한테 공격받고 있어요! 그자가 우리 집을 사려고 해요!

english: Buy it? Buy the entire monastery?
Yes! He's trying to buy our home, we need to stop him!
translation: 네! 우리 집을 사려고 하니까 막아야 해요!

english: Will you help us?
Of course I will help!
The player starts the 2021 Halloween event.
Thank you! Maybe we still have a chance!
You should talk to Brother Jered at the monastery. He's organising everything from there.
translation: 수도원에 계신 Brother Jered(제레드 수사)님께 가 보세요. 거기서 모든 일을 총괄하고 계세요.

english: His office is on the ground floor, north-west corner.
I'll head over there right away!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
Oh, okay, well I need to get back to protesting.
translation: 아, 그래요. 그럼 저는 다시 시위하러 가야겠어요.

english: If you change your mind, we'll be here.
translation: 마음이 바뀌면 오세요. 저희는 여기 있을 테니까요.

english: Hello! How are the protests going?
Slowly, but surely. We're holding on!
Have you spoken to Brother Jered yet?
Not yet, I'm heading there now.
Good! His office is on the ground floor of the monastery, north-west corner. Be quick, I don't know how long we have!
translation: 좋아요! 그분 사무실은 수도원 1층 북서쪽 구석이에요. 서둘러 주세요, 시간이 얼마나 남았는지 모르겠어요!

english: Hi there!
Hello! I saw your friend heading up towards the monastery. She was carrying some kitchen equipment!
translation: 안녕하세요! 당신 친구가 수도원 쪽으로 올라가는 걸 봤어요. 주방 도구를 들고 가더라고요!

english: Hello!
Hi! Thank you for agreeing to help us, we've been protesting for ages!
translation: 안녕하세요! 도와주신다고 해서 고마워요. 저희가 시위를 한참이나 해 왔거든요!

english: Of course I will help!
I'd like to, but I'm a bit busy right now.
Excuse me... Oh, wait, I thought you were someone else.
translation: 실례합니다... 아, 잠깐, 다른 사람인 줄 알았어요.

english: No problem. Have a good day!
And yourself.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Devious Minds quest.
translation: Devious Minds(교활한 자들) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 요구 사항을 모두 충족하지 못했습니다.

english: I knew you would save us! Bless you, my child!
translation: 당신이 우릴 구해 줄 줄 알았어요! 축복받으소서, 젊은이여!

english: Thanks! Just stay indoors while those zombies are still prowling around.
translation: 고마워요! 그 좀비들이 아직 돌아다니고 있으니 실내에만 계세요.

english: May Saradomin's light shine upon you!
Tell him to save it for when I manage to defeat those zombies!
translation: 그 말은 제가 그 좀비들을 해치울 때까지 아껴 두라고 전해 주세요!

english: Saradomin smile upon you! You've saved us all!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)께서 당신에게 미소 지으시길! 당신이 우리 모두를 구했어요!

english: All in a day's work, brother.
translation: 이 정도야 늘 하는 일이죠, 형제님.

english: Your name will forever be listed amongst the virtuous!
translation: 당신의 이름은 영원히 덕 있는 자들 사이에 새겨질 거예요!

english: I'll remember that the next time I go drinking...
translation: 다음에 술 마시러 갈 때 그 말 기억해 둘게요...

english: Why are all of you standing around here?
None of your business. Get lost.
Have you found the tree with the leprechaun yet?
No, we've looked for ages but haven't... Hey! Wait a minute! How did you know about that?
translation: 아니, 한참 찾아봤는데 아직... 어이! 잠깐만! 그걸 네가 어떻게 알아?

english: Thanks for the information!
...You tricked me. I'm not talking to you anymore.
translation: ...날 속였군. 너랑은 이제 말 안 해.

english: I already told you. I'm not talking to you anymore.
translation: 이미 말했잖아. 너랑은 이제 말 안 한다고.

english: Do you seek passage to holy Entrana? If so, you must leave your weaponry and armour behind. This is Saradomin's will.
translation: 성스러운 Entrana(엔트라나)로 건너가길 원하십니까? 그렇다면 무기와 갑옷은 모두 두고 가셔야 합니다. 이것은 Saradomin(사라도민)의 뜻입니다.

english: No, not right now.
Very well.
Yes, okay, I'm ready to go.
Very well. One moment please.
The monk quickly searches you.
[I'm sorry, sir,/I'm sorry, madam,/I'm sorry,] but no weapons or armour may be worn on Entrana. This rule even forbids items dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: [I'm sorry, sir,/I'm sorry, madam,/I'm sorry,] 하지만 Entrana(엔트라나)에서는 어떤 무기나 갑옷도 착용할 수 없습니다. 이 규칙은 Saradomin(사라도민)께 바쳐진 물품도 예외가 아닙니다.

english: NO WEAPONS OR ARMOUR are permitted on holy Entrana AT ALL. We will not allow you to travel there in breach of mighty Saradomin's edict.
translation: 성스러운 Entrana(엔트라나)에는 무기도 갑옷도 절대로 허용되지 않습니다. 위대하신 Saradomin(사라도민)의 칙령을 어기고 그곳에 가도록 둘 수는 없습니다.

english: Do not try and deceive us again. Come back when you have laid down your Zamorakian instruments of death.
translation: 다시는 저희를 속이려 하지 마십시오. 그 Zamorak(자모락)의 살상 도구들을 내려놓고 다시 오십시오.

english: What's in this strange impling jar then?
translation: 이 이상한 impling jar(임플링 병)에는 뭐가 들어 있습니까?

english: I don't know. It could be anything.
translation: 모르겠어요. 뭐든 들어 있을 수 있죠.

english: Well, I will assume that 'anything' includes weapons and armour. So come back when you've got rid of them.
translation: 그렇다면 그 '뭐든'에 무기와 갑옷도 포함된다고 보겠습니다. 그러니 그것들을 처분하고 다시 오십시오.

english: What's in this strange crate then?
translation: 이 이상한 나무 상자에는 뭐가 들어 있습니까?

english: All is satisfactory. You may board the boat now.
translation: 모두 문제없습니다. 이제 배에 오르셔도 됩니다.

english: The player takes the boat to Entrana
The ship arrives at Entrana.
Do you wish to leave holy Entrana?
Yes, I'm ready to go.
Okay, let's board...
The player takes the boat back to Port Sarim
translation: 플레이어가 배를 타고 Port Sarim(포트 사림)으로 돌아간다

english: The ship arrives at Port Sarim.
Not just yet.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 찢어진 clue scroll(단서 두루마리) 조각을 건네받았다.

english: No, not right now.
Yes, okay, I'm ready to go.
Yes, I'm ready to go.
Not just yet.
So, are any of you zombies gonna break me out?
translation: 야, 좀비 중에 나 꺼내 줄 놈 없냐?

english: Ha! Mash those guards!
Oi, zombies! Care to let me out?
translation: 어이, 좀비들! 나 좀 꺼내 줄래?

english: Hey, zombies! I'm on your side!
Let me out! I'll help with your invasion!
Let me out! I'm a bad guy too!
Who's a cute little monkey?
Ukkuk oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka gonk.
translation: 우꾹 우우끼! 끼익 아카, 아아 아카 공크.

english: Who's an ugly human? Give me a banana!
What's up with you?
Stupid human! Give monkey a banana!
Sorry monkey, I don't have any bananas.
Aghhh. You're a rubbish human, get monkey a banana now.
translation: 으아아. 너 쓸모없는 인간이야, 당장 원숭이한테 banana(바나나) 가져와.

english: Ha ha! Smelly human gave monkey a banana.
translation: 하하! 냄새나는 인간이 원숭이한테 banana(바나나) 줬다.

english: Wow you're one nasty piece of work. Have you ever heard of gratitude?
translation: 와, 너 진짜 고약한 녀석이구나. 고마운 줄은 아니?

english: Hey baldy, give monkey another banana!
translation: 야 대머리, 원숭이한테 banana(바나나) 하나 더 줘!

english: Just because I'm not covered in fur doesn't make me bald, you cheeky monkey.
translation: 털이 없다고 대머리는 아니거든, 이 건방진 원숭이야.

english: Monkey wants another banana now! Give me, give me!
translation: 원숭이 지금 banana(바나나) 하나 더 원해! 줘, 줘!

english: Look I've had it with you, you little degenerate.
translation: 야, 너한테 질렸어, 이 막돼먹은 꼬맹이야.

english: I'll not give you a banana until you learn manners.
translation: 예의를 배울 때까지 banana(바나나)는 안 줄 거야.

english: Give the monkey a banana.
Don't give it a banana.
Eeekeek ookeek!
Arr! Yer messin with me monkey plunder!
translation: 아르! 내 원숭이 약탈품 건드리지 마라!

english: What?
Are ye here for...the stuff?
You know...the 'special' bananas?
No...why do you ask?
No reason. Have a nice day.
translation: 별 이유 없어. 좋은 하루 보내라.

english: Arr!
Arr!
Bored now...
Let me go, can't ye hear them? Howlin' in the dark...
translation: 보내 줘, 안 들려? 어둠 속에서 울부짖는 소리가...

english: What do you mean?
I'm not hangin' around te be killed!
The Horrors, the Horrors!
I'm not goin' back in that brewery, not fer all the Bitternuts I can carry!
translation: Bitternut(쓴 견과)를 들 수 있는 만큼 준대도 그 양조장엔 다시 안 들어가!

english: Oook! Oook!
The monkey deftly avoids your melee attack! You aren't going to score a hit in hand-to-hand combat.
translation: 원숭이가 당신의 근접 공격을 날렵하게 피한다! 맨손 격투로는 한 대도 맞히지 못할 것 같다.

english: Ook! Oook! Ook!
Oook! Oook! Oook!
Oook! Ook!
Ook! Ook!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah!
Ook!
I won't say!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook! Ook!
Oook! Ook! Ook!
Ook! Oook! Oook!
Joooogre bones! Ook!
You can't catch me!
Ook! Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ah Ah Ah!
translation: 아 아 아! 아 아 아!

english: Ook! Ook! Ah Ah AH!
Oook! Ook! Oook!
Can't hit! Can't hit!
Ook! Oook!
Ah Ah Ah! Ook!
Ook! Ook! Oook!
After years of planning, the humans are going to get what they deserve.
translation: 수년간의 계획 끝에, 드디어 인간들이 받아야 할 대가를 치르게 된다.

english: Hmm, I don't think this is quite right.
translation: 흠, 이건 좀 아닌 것 같은데.

english: I wish Kruk would do his own dirty work.
translation: Kruk(크룩)이 더러운 일은 직접 좀 하면 좋겠군.

english: This looks like a good spot.
The time of monkeys is almost upon us.
You! Get out of my way!
Hello there little monkey.
Hello big-big. Aunty told me not to talk to strangers.
translation: 안녕, 왕큰이. 이모가 낯선 사람이랑은 말하지 말랬어.

english: Oh I'm not a stranger...
You look strange to me!
Hello again little monkey.
You're strange! Go away!
I'm not a stranger...!
Then what are you?
I'm a monkey's brother!
Ook! But I don't have any brothers!
I knew your sister's mother!
translation: 난 네 자매의 엄마랑 아는 사이야!

english: But I don't have any sisters! Ook Ook!
translation: 근데 나 자매도 없는데! 우끼 우끼!

english: I'm just a monkey lover!
Aunty told me not to talk to monkey lovers! Ook!
translation: 이모가 원숭이 좋아하는 사람이랑은 말하지 말랬어! 우끼!

english: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!
translation: 허 참, 이러다 내가 원숭이 삼촌 되겠네!

english: Uh ah! You do look like my uncle!
You never said what you were!
translation: 넌 뭔지 아직 말 안 했잖아!

english: I'm a monkey's brother!
I knew your sister's mother!
translation: 난 네 자매의 엄마랑 아는 사이야!

english: I'm just a monkey lover!
Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!
translation: 허 참, 이러다 내가 원숭이 삼촌 되겠네!

english: You look a lot bigger than last time, Uncle!
translation: 저번보다 훨씬 커진 것 같아, 삼촌!

english: I've been ... eating more bananas... just like you should be!
translation: 그게... bananas(바나나)를 더 많이 먹었거든... 너도 그래야 해!

english: I'm bored.
Why are you bored?
Aunty told me to pick loads of bananas. She said if, I got bananas, she'd give me a new toy!
translation: 이모가 bananas(바나나)를 잔뜩 따 오래. 바나나를 따 오면 새 장난감을 준댔어!

english: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?
She said it would be something from the magic shop!
How many bananas did Aunty want?
How many bananas did Aunty want?
Twenty! But I can't count! It's very mean of her, isn't it Uncle?
translation: 스무 개! 근데 난 숫자를 못 세! 이모 너무 못됐지, 그치 삼촌?

english: Yes, very mean ... do you want me to get the bananas for you?
translation: 그래, 정말 못됐네... 내가 대신 bananas(바나나)를 구해다 줄까?

english: Ok! Ook Ook!
But only if you promise to let me borrow your toy...
translation: 대신 네 장난감 좀 빌려주겠다고 약속하면...

english: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?
Did you get any bananas, Uncle?
No, not yet. I'm still trying to get them.
Yes, I have some here.
That doesn't look like 20 bananas Uncle! Aunty will be so angry with me!
translation: 그건 bananas(바나나) 스무 개가 아닌 것 같은데, 삼촌! 이모가 엄청 화낼 거야!

english: Don't worry, I'll get some more.
Wow that's a lot of bananas! Are there twenty?
translation: 우아, bananas(바나나) 엄청 많다! 스무 개 맞아?

english: Yes, of course there are.
Aunty will be so happy!
Has Aunty given you the toy yet?
Yeah - it's really neat!
Can I borrow it now then?
But I only just got it!
Please?
Ok then...
How are you today?
I'm good, uncle! I'd quite like my toy back now...
translation: 좋아, 삼촌! 근데 이제 내 장난감 돌려줬으면 좋겠어...

english: I've lost that toy you gave me...
You lost it!? What am I going to play with now?
translation: 잃어버렸다고!? 그럼 난 이제 뭐 갖고 놀아?

english: I'm feeling a bit better now...
It's good to see you've cheered up then.
Yes - Aunty gave me a new toy!
That's really sweet of her!
Wow - can I borrow it?
translation: 우아 - 나 그거 빌려줄 수 있어?

english: Only if you promise to give it back...
Ok, I promise!
The monkey child gives you some kind of talisman.
translation: 원숭이 아이가 talisman(부적) 같은 것을 건넨다.

english: Actually, I don't really need it.
Hello there, uncle!
Thank you uncle - I love you!
The monkey child gives you a hug!
translation: 원숭이 아이가 당신을 꼭 안아 준다!

english: Thank you uncle, but I don't want one!
translation: 고마워 삼촌, 근데 그건 필요 없어!

english: I don't want that - it looks really scary!
I have no use for that.
How are you today?
I've lost that toy you gave me...
That's really sweet of her!
Wow - can I borrow it?
translation: 우아 - 나 그거 빌려줄 수 있어?

english: Ok, I promise!
Actually, I don't really need it.
Hello?
Hi there, is something wrong?
Oh wow you can understand me!
I happen to be proficient in many languages... anyway, what are you doing here in Varrock?
translation: 내가 여러 언어에 능통하거든... 아무튼, 여기 Varrock(바록)에서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: Well my uncle Daga's shop has been a bit slow recently, and we just got some new stock in so I decided to help and advertise a bit.
translation: 음, 우리 Daga(다가) 삼촌 가게가 요즘 장사가 좀 안 되는데, 마침 새 물건이 들어와서 홍보 좀 도와주려고.

english: What new stock's that then?
Oh just more scimitars, we got a few of there weird red ones too... dra-something...
translation: 그냥 scimitars(시미터)가 더 들어왔고, 이상하게 빨간 것도 몇 개 왔어... 드라 뭐시기...

english: Dragon?!
Yeah that's the one, are they valuable?
translation: 응, 그거 맞아. 그거 비싼 거야?

english: Um... no... not really... I'll be right back...
Oh you bought one of those dra-whatever things, I was told they're not much good.
translation: 아, 그 드라 뭐시기 하나 샀구나. 그거 별로 안 좋다던데.

english: Oh no it's excellent!
Well I'll be a monkey's nephew, I'm such a noob!
translation: 이런, 원숭이 조카 체면이 말이 아니네. 나 완전 초짜잖아!

english: Don't you think this is all a bit cruel?
What do you mean?
Keeping so many monkeys locked up in that crowded pen. I bet they dream of being back in the jungle...
translation: 저 비좁은 우리에 원숭이를 이렇게나 많이 가둬 두다니요. 분명 정글로 돌아가는 꿈을 꿀 거예요...

english: Don't you ever dream?
I ... er ... used to dream to be a Monkey Minder when I was young boy...
translation: 저... 어... 어렸을 때 Monkey Minder(원숭이 사육사)가 되는 게 꿈이었는데요...

english: And look at you now ... all grown up having achieved your dreams! Would you deny me my dreams? Would you deny a monkey its dreams?
translation: 그리고 지금 보세요... 다 자라서 꿈을 이뤘잖아요! 그런데 제 꿈을 막으실 건가요? 원숭이의 꿈을 막으실 건가요?

english: Er, look, stop wasting my time.
translation: 어, 저기요, 제 시간 그만 뺏으세요.

english: I -
Leave me alone now. Some of us have work to do.
translation: 이제 그만 혼자 있게 해 주세요. 일해야 하는 사람도 있다고요.

english: I've just thought of a way to solve your little monkey problem...
translation: 원숭이 문제를 해결할 방법이 방금 떠올랐어요...

english: Oh, what's that then?
Well, you have too many monkeys, don't you?
Yes...
Well, you could give away your monkeys to people who would look after them. You could even start with me!
translation: 그럼 원숭이들을 잘 돌봐 줄 사람들에게 나눠 주면 되잖아요. 저부터 시작해도 되고요!

english: I'm sorry, I don't think I'm allowed to do that. I've just been ordered to not let any monkeys escape.
translation: 죄송하지만 그렇게 해도 되는지 모르겠네요. 원숭이가 한 마리도 도망치지 못하게 하라는 명령을 받았거든요.

english: Hello there.
Hello, sir.
I haven't seen Monkey Minders here before...
translation: 여기서 Monkey Minder(원숭이 사육사)는 처음 보는데요...

english: Yes, you wouldn't have. We have newly been posted here.
translation: 네, 그러실 거예요. 저희는 최근에 여기 배치됐거든요.

english: But why do we need Monkey Minders?
translation: 그런데 왜 Monkey Minder(원숭이 사육사)가 필요한 거죠?

english: It's entirely necessary: just take a look at the monkeys. They've been multiplying out of control!
translation: 꼭 필요해요. 원숭이들 좀 보세요. 감당이 안 될 만큼 불어나고 있다고요!

english: Every time we turn our backs another one of them tries to break free. It's almost as if they're plotting to escape!
translation: 등만 돌리면 또 한 마리가 탈출하려고 해요. 마치 탈출 계획이라도 짜는 것 같다니까요!

english: Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
We just don't know. Perhaps it's the weather. Perhaps it's something in the food. Perhaps it's just that time of year.
translation: 저희도 모르겠어요. 날씨 탓일 수도 있고, 먹이에 뭐가 들었을 수도 있고, 그냥 그럴 철이라 그런 걸 수도 있죠.

english: Your guess is as good as ours.
What are you going to do about the monkeys?
We're going to post enough men here to be able to contain the monkeys in case they manage to escape.
translation: 원숭이들이 탈출할 경우에 대비해 막을 수 있을 만큼 충분한 인원을 여기 배치할 거예요.

english: Is that very likely?
Stranger things have happened in Ardougne.
Why do you monkeys keep trying to escape? Good thing I've caught you before you got away, you little scoundrel.
translation: 너희 원숭이들은 왜 자꾸 도망치려는 거니? 달아나기 전에 잡아서 다행이다, 이 말썽꾸러기 녀석.

english: Ook!
Let's put you back in your cage where you belong...
translation: 자, 네가 있어야 할 우리로 돌아가자...

english: Ok!
What??
Err ... Ook?
I must be imagining things ... monkeys can't talk.
translation: 내가 헛것을 봤나 보군... 원숭이가 말을 할 리가 없지.

english: Player is relocated to the monkey cage
Ook Ook!
I don't know what kind of monkey you think you are, but you're not getting anywhere near my monkeys!
translation: 네가 무슨 원숭이라고 생각하는지 모르겠지만, 내 원숭이들 근처엔 얼씬도 못 해!

english: Stop hassling me!
Be quiet, you monkey!
My word - what are you doing in there?
I ... er ... I don't know! One minute I was asleep, and the next minute I was here surrounded by monkeys!
translation: 저... 어... 저도 모르겠어요! 자고 있었는데 정신을 차려 보니 원숭이들에 둘러싸여 여기 있더라고요!

english: Well, don't worry. We'll have you out of there shortly.
Player is relocated outside the monkey cage
Thank you.
No problem.
Why have the monkeys been multiplying?
What are you going to do about the monkeys?
Try to convince the minder to let the monkeys escape...
Ask the minder for a monkey...
translation: 사육사에게 원숭이 한 마리를 달라고 한다...

english: I do not speak to outlanders.
Maybe you should speak with Rellekka's Chieftain.
Please please help us, bold adventurer!
translation: 제발, 제발 저희를 도와주세요, 용감한 모험가님!

english: What's the problem?
Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampyre! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
translation: 저희 작은 마을이 사악한 vampyre(뱀파이어) 때문에 끔찍하게 시달리고 있어요! 북쪽 저택 지하실에 사는데, 그놈을 완전히 없애 줄 사람이 필요해요!

english: Okay, I'm up for an adventure.

I think first you should seek help. I have a friend who is a retired vampyre hunter, his name is Dr. Harlow. He may be able to give you some tips. He can normally be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, he's a bit
translation: 먼저 도움을 구하는 게 좋겠어요. 은퇴한 vampyre(뱀파이어) 사냥꾼 친구가 있는데, 이름은 Dr. Harlow(할로 박사)예요. 몇 가지 조언을 해 줄 수 있을 거예요. 보통 Varrock(바록)의 Blue Moon Inn(푸른 달 여관)에 있는데, 요즘은 좀

english: of an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampyre.
translation: 술고래가 다 됐어요. 옛 친구 Morgan(모건)이 보냈다고 하세요. 제가 vampyre(뱀파이어)한테 죽는 걸 바라진 않을 거예요.

english: I'll look him up then.
No, vampyres are scary!
I don't blame you.
I have slain the foul creature!
Thank you, thank you! You will always be a hero in our village!
translation: 고마워요, 정말 고마워요! 당신은 언제까지나 우리 마을의 영웅이에요!

english: Very well done, take this.
Yes.
No.
Afternoon. I'm Morgiana, and by all means, let yourself in...
translation: 안녕하세요. 저는 Morgiana(모르지아나)예요. 뭐, 얼마든지 마음대로 들어오시죠...

english: Oh, hey! The door was open...
... Yes?
That armour looks mighty fancy!
Indeed! A family heirloom of mine, passed down from my father.
Oh? Are you from a family of famous knights?
You could say that...
What's wrong?
Oh, nothing... it's just... old memories. I'm getting old, as you can probably see. My family have all died to war. This is meant to be my retirement.
translation: 아, 아무것도 아니에요... 그냥... 옛 기억이 떠올라서요. 보시다시피 저도 나이가 들었네요. 가족은 모두 전쟁으로 세상을 떠났어요. 여긴 원래 제가 은퇴해서 지내려던 곳이에요.

english: Retirement? Then why still wear the armour? Especially with how hot it is here.
translation: 은퇴요? 그런데 왜 아직 갑옷을 입고 계세요? 여기 이렇게 더운데요.

english: I find it's best to be prepared in this region. Bandits regularly visit this fine oasis, and they ask fewer questions when they see me in armour.
translation: 이 지역에선 대비해 두는 게 최선이더군요. 이 아름다운 오아시스에 산적들이 자주 찾아오는데, 제가 갑옷을 입고 있으면 쓸데없는 질문을 덜 하거든요.

english: I see.
How's the tea here?
Hmm...
Umm...
Well... I think it's quite nice! I prefer a warm cup of Saradomin's Wisdom, a special recipe of mine.
translation: 글쎄요... 꽤 괜찮은 것 같아요! 저는 따뜻한 Saradomin's Wisdom(사라도민의 지혜) 한 잔을 더 좋아하지만요. 제 특별한 비법이죠.

english: Oh? How's it made?
Bit of a family secret. A fine blend of herbs that are quite magical.
translation: 집안의 비밀이랍니다. 꽤 신비로운 약초들을 잘 섞은 거예요.

english: Alright then. Keep your secrets.
I'd best be off.
Quite. Perhaps I'll see you around...
Ah, hello again.
That armour looks mighty fancy!
How's the tea here?
I'd best be off.
Hello Mori.
Hello there. Thank you for helping us, you are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 안녕하세요. 저희를 도와주셔서 고마워요. 당신은 Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들의 좋은 친구예요.

english: It's not a problem. What brings you here?
I come here quite often now. This is a nice quiet place for me to think and reflect. It's my way of remembering Thana.
translation: 요즘은 여기 자주 와요. 생각하고 되돌아보기 좋은 조용한 곳이거든요. 이게 제가 Thana(타나)를 기억하는 방식이에요.

english: I'll leave you in peace then.
translation: 그럼 편히 계시게 자리를 비켜 드릴게요.

english: Thank you friend.
Hello there. Did you manage to get that device hidden?
Oh yes. Got it all done with no problems at all.
translation: 네, 아무 문제 없이 다 끝냈어요.

english: Good. Hopefully Kourend will have no more issues with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 잘됐네요. 이제 Kourend(쿠렌드)가 Disciples of Yama(야마의 사도들) 때문에 골치 아플 일이 더는 없으면 좋겠어요.

english: Oh I feel much better for that super serum,  I really hate it when I'm afflicted!
translation: 아, 그 super serum(강화 혈청) 덕분에 훨씬 나아졌어요. 병에 시달리는 건 정말 싫거든요!

english: The afflicted turns into a Mort'ton local
translation: afflicted(고통받는 자)가 다시 Mort'ton(모트톤) 주민으로 돌아온다

english: Oh... thank you, you used the serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 아... 고마워요, 저한테 serum(혈청)을 써 주셨군요. 수고하셨으니 이거라도 받으세요.

english: The local gives you [reward].
Oh... thank you, you used the permanent serum on me. Here have something for your trouble.
translation: 아... 고마워요, 저한테 영구 serum(혈청)을 써 주셨군요. 수고하셨으니 이거라도 받으세요.

english: Good day to you.
Hello. What are you up to?
Ah, today is a surströmming day! The herring I buried six months ago is ready to be dug up.
translation: 아, 오늘은 surströmming(수르스트뢰밍) 먹는 날이에요! 여섯 달 전에 묻어 둔 herring(청어)를 이제 파낼 때가 됐거든요.

english: Eughr! What are you going to do with it?
Eat it, of course! It will be fermented just-right by now.
translation: 먹어야죠, 당연히! 지금쯤이면 딱 알맞게 발효됐을 거예요.

english: Fermented? You eat rotten fish?
Hmmm, tasty. I'm guessing you don't want to come round and try it?
translation: 음, 맛있죠. 저희 집에 와서 맛보고 싶진 않으시겠죠?

english: You guess correctly.
Are you the human by the name of [player name]?
Yes that's me.
Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.
translation: 좋소... 기다리고 있었소. King Lathas(라타스 왕)께서 당신이 올 거라고 전갈을 보내셨소.

english: Well look who it is! The hero of Prifddinas!
Why do I feel like you're being sarcastic?
That's likely due to the fact that I am being sarcastic.
translation: 그건 아마 내가 비꼬고 있기 때문일 거요.

english: Well you're no hero either. You blindly served Lord Iorwerth right to the very end. You're lucky the other elves pardoned you.
translation: 당신도 영웅은 아니잖아요. 끝까지 맹목적으로 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)을 섬겼으면서. 다른 엘프들이 사면해 준 걸 다행으로 아세요.

english: You seem upset by that. I served Lord Iorwerth because I didn't have a choice. The other elves realised that, hence the pardon.
translation: 그 일로 화가 난 모양이군. 내가 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)을 섬긴 건 선택의 여지가 없었기 때문이오. 다른 엘프들도 그걸 알았기에 사면해 준 거고.

english: We always have a choice.
Do we?
I did.
Yes, but you're a mercenary. You're lucky enough to be able to side with the highest bidder. Not all of us are so privileged.
translation: 그렇지, 하지만 당신은 용병이오. 가장 많이 주는 쪽에 붙을 수 있을 만큼 운이 좋지. 모두가 그런 특권을 누리는 건 아니오.

english: I was born into the Iorwerth clan, Lord Iorwerth was my uncle. Do you think I had a say in what my life would be? Do you think any of us did?
translation: 나는 Iorwerth(이오르워스) 씨족으로 태어났고, Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)은 내 숙부였소. 내 삶이 어떻게 될지 내가 정할 수 있었을 것 같소? 우리 중 누구라도 그럴 수 있었을 것 같소?

english: We served Lord Iorwerth because he was our leader. We may not have agreed with all that he did, but that didn't matter. He was in charge and we were not.
translation: 우리가 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)을 섬긴 건 그가 우리 지도자였기 때문이오. 그가 한 모든 일에 동의하진 않았을지 몰라도, 그건 중요하지 않았소. 그는 지휘하는 자였고 우리는 아니었으니.

english: Had I been born into the Cadarn clan, I'd be considered a hero right now. But I wasn't, so instead I am the villain.
translation: 내가 Cadarn(카다른) 씨족으로 태어났다면 지금쯤 영웅 대접을 받고 있겠지. 하지만 그렇지 않았기에 나는 악당이 된 거요.

english: You can make excuses, but Iestin served Lord Iorwerth and he switched sides.
translation: 변명은 얼마든지 할 수 있겠죠. 하지만 Iestin(이에스틴)도 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)을 섬겼는데 편을 바꿨잖아요.

english: He did. Iestin was brave, I respect that. His bravery has rewarded him with leadership over our clan. But bravery comes easy when you have nothing left to lose.
translation: 그랬지. Iestin(이에스틴)은 용감했고, 난 그 점을 존중하오. 그 용기 덕에 그는 우리 씨족의 지도자 자리를 얻었소. 하지만 더 잃을 게 없을 땐 용기를 내기도 쉬운 법이오.

english: But I can see I will not change your mind. That's fine, I don't need to.
translation: 하지만 당신 생각을 바꿀 수는 없겠군. 상관없소, 그럴 필요도 없으니.

english: That said, you'd do well to remember that the actions of Lord Iorwerth should not be used to judge our entire clan.
translation: 그렇긴 해도, Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)의 행동으로 우리 씨족 전체를 판단해서는 안 된다는 걸 기억해 두는 게 좋을 거요.

english: Hmm.
Stand back citizen, do not approach me.
Hello.
What are you up to?
Nothing.
I don't trust you.
You don't have to.
If I find you attempting to cross the wall I'll make sure you never return.
translation: 벽을 넘으려다 걸리면 다시는 못 돌아가게 만들어 주겠소.

english: Hmmm, how did you get over here? You're not one of this rabble. Ah well, you'll have to stay. Can't risk you going back now.
translation: 흠, 여긴 어떻게 넘어왔소? 이 오합지졸들과는 달라 보이는데. 뭐, 어쨌든 여기 남아야 하오. 이제 와서 돌려보낼 순 없으니.

english: So what's a mourner?
We're working for King Lathas of East Ardougne. He has tasked us with containing the accursed plague sweeping West Ardougne.
translation: 우리는 East Ardougne(동 아르둔)의 King Lathas(라타스 왕)을 위해 일하오. 왕께서 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)을 휩쓰는 저주받은 역병을 막으라는 임무를 내리셨소.

english: We also do our best to ease these people's suffering. We're nicknamed mourners because we spend a lot of time at plague victim funerals, no one else is allowed to risk attending.
translation: 또한 이곳 사람들의 고통을 덜어 주려 최선을 다하고 있소. mourners(애도자)라는 별명은 우리가 역병 희생자의 장례식에 자주 가기 때문에 붙었소. 다른 누구도 위험을 무릅쓰고 참석할 수 없거든.

english: It's a demanding job, and we get little thanks from the people here.
translation: 힘든 일인데, 이곳 사람들에게선 고맙다는 말도 거의 못 듣소.

english: I haven't got the plague though...
Can't risk you being a carrier. That protective clothing you have isn't regulation issue. It won't meet safety standards.
translation: 보균자일 위험이 있소. 당신이 입은 방호복은 규격품이 아니오. 안전 기준에 맞지 않을 거요.

english: I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
Ah yes, I've heard of her. A healer I believe. She must be mad coming over here voluntarily.
translation: 아, 들어 본 적 있소. 치료사였던 것 같은데. 제 발로 여기 오다니 미친 게 틀림없소.

english: I hear rumours she has probably caught the plague now. Very tragic, a stupid waste of life.
translation: 이젠 역병에 걸렸을 거라는 소문이 있소. 참 안됐소. 어리석게 목숨을 버린 셈이지.

english: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: 하지만 여기 납치된 사람이 있는 것 같아요.

english: Sounds unlikely, even kidnappers wouldn't go in there. Even if someone is in there, they're probably dead by now.
translation: 그럴 리 없소. 납치범들도 저긴 안 들어가오. 설령 누가 있다 해도 지금쯤 죽었을 거요.

english: Good Point.
I want to check anyway.
You don't have clearance to go in there.
How do I get clearance?
Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.
translation: head mourner(애도자 우두머리)에게 신청하거나, 아니면 도시 감독관 Bravek(브라베크)에게 해야 할 거요.

english: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.
I fear not a mere plague.
That's irrelevant. You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: 그건 상관없소. 당신은 저기 들어갈 허가가 없소.

english: Thanks for the warning.
I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.
translation: 거기서 떨어져 있으시오. 저 검은 십자가는 그 집에 역병이 돌았다는 표시요.

english: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.
translation: 여기 들어가도 된다는 Bravek(브라베크)의 warrant(영장)이 있어요.

english: This is highly irregular. Please wait...
You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.
translation: mourner(애도자)가 등을 돌릴 때까지 기다렸다가 건물 안으로 몰래 들어간다.

english: Hey... I've got someone here with a warrant from Bravek, what should we do?
translation: 이봐... 여기 Bravek(브라베크)의 warrant(영장)을 가진 사람이 있는데, 어떻게 하지?

english: So what's a mourner?
I haven't got the plague though...
I'm looking for a woman named Elena.
But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: 하지만 여기 납치된 사람이 있는 것 같아요.

english: I want to check anyway.
I fear not a mere plague.
Thanks for the warning.
Hello there.
Do you have a problem traveller?
No, I just wondered why you're wearing that outfit... Is it fancy dress?
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 왜 그런 옷을 입고 있는지 궁금해서요... 가장무도회 의상인가요?

english: No! It's for protection.
Protection from what?
The plague of course…
What do you want?
Who are you?
I'm a mourner. It's my job to help heal the plague victims of West Ardougne and to make sure the disease is contained.
translation: 나는 mourner(애도자)요. West Ardougne(서 아르둔)의 역병 환자들을 치료하고 병이 퍼지지 않게 막는 것이 내 일이오.

english: Very noble of you.
If you come down with any symptoms such as flu or nightmares let me know immediately.
translation: 독감이나 악몽 같은 증상이 나타나면 즉시 알려 주시오.

english: Nothing, just being polite.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 예의상 인사한 거예요.

english: Hmmm, ok then. Be on your way.
translation: 흠, 그렇군. 그럼 가던 길 가시오.

english: Are you ok?
Yes, I'm fine thanks.
Have you experienced any plague symptoms?
What are the symptoms?
First you'll come down with heavy flu, this is usually followed by horrifying nightmares.
translation: 먼저 심한 독감에 걸리고, 보통 그다음엔 끔찍한 악몽이 따라오오.

english: I used to have nightmares when I was younger.
Not like these I assure you. Soon after a thick black liquid will seep from your nose and eyes.
translation: 장담하는데 이런 악몽은 아니었을 거요. 곧이어 코와 눈에서 걸쭉한 검은 액체가 스며 나오지.

english: Yuck!
When it gets to that stage there's nothing we can do for you.
translation: 그 단계에 이르면 우리도 해 줄 수 있는 게 없소.

english: No, I feel fine.
Well if you take a turn for the worse let me know straight away.
Can you cure it then?
No... But you will have to be treated.
Treated?
We have to take measures to contain the disease. That's why you must let us know immediately if you take a turn for the worse.
translation: 병을 막으려면 조치를 취해야 하오. 그래서 상태가 나빠지면 즉시 알려야 하는 거요.

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: 아뇨. 그런데 역병이 어디서 왔는지 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: It all started when King Tyras of West Ardougne came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 모든 건 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)의 King Tyras(티라스 왕)이 이곳 서쪽 땅을 방문하고 돌아왔을 때 시작됐소.

english: Some of his men must have unknowingly caught it out there and brought it back with them
translation: 그의 부하 몇이 그곳에서 모르는 새 병에 걸려 함께 가져온 게 틀림없소

english: What are you up to with old man Edmond?
Nothing, we've just been chatting.
What about his daughter?
Oh, you know about that then?
We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
translation: 우리는 Ardougne(아르둔)에서 일어나는 일은 다 알고 있소. 역병을 막으려면 그래야 하니까.

english: Have you see his daughter recently?
I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.
translation: 역병에 걸렸겠지. 어쨌든 West Ardougne(서 아르둔) 밖으로는 못 나올 거요. 위험이 너무 크니까.

english: Been digging have we?
What do you mean?
Your hands are covered in mud.
Oh that...
Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.
translation: 이상하군. 정원 가꾸는 사람처럼은 안 보이는데.

english: Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.
translation: 아뇨, 저 정원 가꾸는 거 엄청 좋아해요! 제일 좋아하는 취미예요.

english: Can I help you?
What are you doing?
I'm guarding the border to West Ardougne. No one except we mourners can pass through.
translation: West Ardougne(서 아르둔)으로 가는 경계를 지키고 있소. 우리 애도자 말고는 아무도 지나갈 수 없소.

english: Why?
The plague of course. We can't risk cross contamination.
translation: 당연히 역병 때문이오. 교차 감염 위험을 감수할 순 없소.

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 무엇 때문에 Ardougne(아르둔)에 역병이 생긴 거예요?

english: It's all down to King Tyras of West Ardougne. It started came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 전부 West Ardougne(서 아르둔)의 King Tyras(티라스 왕) 탓이오. 그가 이곳 서쪽 땅을 방문하고 돌아온 뒤로 시작됐지.

english: Does he know how bad the situation is now?
translation: 그 왕은 지금 상황이 얼마나 심각한지 알아요?

english: If he did he wouldn't care. I believe he wants his people to suffer, he's an evil man.
translation: 안다 해도 신경도 안 쓸 거요. 내가 보기엔 백성이 고통받길 바라는 사악한 자요.

english: Isn't that treason?
He's not my king.
What are the symptoms of the plague?
The first signs are typical flu symptoms. These tend to be followed by severe nightmares, horrifying hallucinations which drive many to madness.
translation: 처음엔 흔한 독감 증상이 나타나오. 그다음엔 대개 심한 악몽과 끔찍한 환각이 이어지는데, 많은 이가 그 때문에 미쳐 버리오.

english: Sounds nasty.
It gets worse. Next the victim's blood changes into a thick black tar-like liquid, at this point they're past help.
translation: 더 심해지오. 그다음엔 환자의 피가 걸쭉한 검은 타르 같은 액체로 변하는데, 이때가 되면 손쓸 도리가 없소.

english: Their skin is cold to the touch, the victim is now brain dead. Their body however lives on driven by the virus, roaming like a zombie, spreading itself further wherever possible.
translation: 피부는 만지면 차갑고, 환자는 뇌사 상태가 되오. 하지만 몸은 바이러스에 이끌려 좀비처럼 돌아다니며 어디든 병을 퍼뜨리지.

english: I think I've heard enough.
Okay then, see you around.
Maybe…
Who are you?
Nothing, just being polite.
translation: 아무것도 아니에요. 그냥 예의상 인사한 거예요.

english: What are the symptoms?
No, I feel fine.
No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: 아뇨. 그런데 역병이 어디서 왔는지 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: What brought the plague to Ardougne?
translation: 무엇 때문에 Ardougne(아르둔)에 역병이 생긴 거예요?

english: What are the symptoms of the plague?
Okay then, see you around.
What's the device saying now?
I don't know. It's giving strange readings...
I'm not even sure it's working any more.
This is a wild goose chase! We trek halfway across the world and there's nothing down here but this bunch of useless goblins!
translation: 완전 헛수고잖아! 세상을 반 바퀴나 돌아왔는데 여기 아래엔 쓸모없는 goblins(고블린) 떼밖에 없다고!

english: I am sure my triangulation calculations indicated that the source of power was in this rough area...
translation: 내 삼각측량 계산으로는 분명 힘의 근원이 대략 이 근방에 있다고 나왔네...

english: I find it encouraging that it's pointed to somewhere where there actually are caves.
translation: 실제로 동굴이 있는 곳을 가리켰다는 점은 고무적이라고 보네.

english: This part of the world is riddled with caves! It's hard not to hit a cave around here! Are you sure you're not just picking up these goblin lanterns or something stupid?
translation: 이 동네는 온통 동굴투성이야! 여기선 동굴에 안 부딪히는 게 더 어렵다고! 그냥 goblin(고블린) 등불 같은 시시한 걸 잡아내는 거 아니야?

english: You should have more faith in my skills as a mage! I've been working on this for years-
translation: 마법사로서의 내 실력을 좀 더 믿어 주게! 이걸 수년 동안 연구해 왔단 말일세-

english: Gah! We have an eavesdropper! Buzz off, adventurer - go talk to the goblins or something.
translation: 젠장! 엿듣는 놈이 있잖아! 꺼져, 모험가. 가서 goblins(고블린)하고 수다나 떨든가.

english: Okay, I won't bother you.
That's what I like to see: a polite adventurer! Now, where was I...
translation: 그래, 그런 자세가 좋네. 예의 바른 모험가로군! 자, 어디까지 했더라...

english: What are you looking for?
None of your business!
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 저기요, 저도 그쪽 편이에요! 이 pendant(펜던트) 보이세요?

english: Where did you come from? Who sent you? I'll have you know I'm the mage's bodyguard for this job. We don't need anyone else!
translation: 너 어디서 왔어? 누가 보냈어? 분명히 말해 두는데, 이번 일에서 마법사 경호는 내 담당이야. 다른 사람은 필요 없어!

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 아무도 안 보냈어요. 그냥 제가 여기저기 코를 들이미는 걸 좋아해서요.

english: Well stick your nose somewhere else!
translation: 그럼 그 코는 딴 데 가서 들이밀어!

english: I'm sorry, but pendant or no pendant, this is a secret. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 미안하지만 펜던트가 있든 없든 이건 비밀일세. 이해하리라 믿네.

english: Lucien sent me.
He did not! If he had, I would be aware of it!
translation: 그럴 리 없네! 그랬다면 내가 알았을 걸세!

english: Don't try to lie to us! Now go away!
I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me, but perhaps I can help in some non-bodyguarding way?
translation: 그쪽이 저보다 훨씬 뛰어난 경호원이겠지만, 경호 말고 다른 쪽으로 도와드릴 수 있지 않을까요?

english: Well, we don't know how big this thing is. If we find it, I suppose we might need someone else to help us carry it.
translation: 글쎄, 이게 얼마나 큰 물건인지 우리도 모르네. 찾게 되면 옮기는 데 일손이 더 필요할 수도 있겠지.

english: So, what are we looking for?
You're not very well briefed, are you?
translation: 자네, 설명을 제대로 못 들었나 보군?

english: To be honest I'm still a bit hazy on that point too.
translation: 솔직히 나도 그 부분은 아직 좀 헷갈려.

english: *sigh*
Lucien has asked us to search for artefacts that give off a very specific type of energy. After many years of research, I think I'm finally drawing near.
translation: Lucien(루시엔)께서 아주 특정한 종류의 에너지를 내뿜는 artefacts(유물)을 찾으라고 하셨네. 수년간 연구한 끝에 마침내 가까워졌다고 생각하네.

english: You don't sound very sure.
Bah! My detection device is totally shot. I don't understand it.
translation: 흥! 내 탐지 장치가 완전히 고장 났네. 도무지 이해가 안 되는군.

english: I wouldn't hang around for now, adventurer. It could be a long while before I can get a clear reading.
translation: 당분간은 여기 머물지 않는 게 좋을 걸세, 모험가. 제대로 된 측정값을 얻으려면 한참 걸릴지도 모르니.

english: Okay, I'll be on my way.
Okay, I won't bother you.
What are you looking for?
Hey, I'm one of you guys! See this pendant?
translation: 저기요, 저도 그쪽 편이에요! 이 pendant(펜던트) 보이세요?

english: No one sent me, I'm just nosy.
translation: 아무도 안 보냈어요. 그냥 제가 여기저기 코를 들이미는 걸 좋아해서요.

english: Lucien sent me.
(Charm) I'm sure you're a much better bodyguard than me...
Euat ami! Euat chua tepat!
Uh huh...
Zema ami iknil! Zema lini euat tal miki!
translation: 제마 아미 이크닐! 제마 리니 에우앗 탈 미키!

english: If you say so...
Zema ikam!
Zema ates! Euat achi!
I'm listening, honest.
Euat tepat antil! Euat tepat kuhu! Euat rani!
translation: 에우앗 테팟 안틸! 에우앗 테팟 쿠후! 에우앗 라니!

english: That's very interesting...
Tepat!
Euat!
Ami!
Ah, it's you [player name]. You've been slacking in your studies, so it's time for an exam.
translation: 아, [player name], 자네로군. 공부를 게을리했으니 시험을 볼 시간일세.

english: There are two types of question. One type requires you to find the next object in a pattern.
translation: 문제는 두 가지 유형이 있네. 하나는 패턴에서 다음에 올 물건을 찾는 문제일세.

english: In the second type I will present you with fifteen cards and a hint. Discover three cards related to the hint, select them and confirm.
translation: 두 번째 유형에서는 카드 열다섯 장과 힌트를 하나 주겠네. 힌트와 관련된 카드 세 장을 찾아 골라서 확정하게.

english: Let's continue your exam. There are two types of question: In one question you must discover the logical object to come next in a pattern.
translation: 시험을 계속하세. 문제는 두 가지 유형이 있네. 하나는 패턴에서 논리적으로 다음에 올 물건을 찾아야 하는 문제일세.

english: Pick the object that should come next in the pattern.
translation: 패턴에서 다음에 와야 할 물건을 고르게.

english: No. No, that's not right at all. Okay, next question.
translation: 아니, 아니. 완전히 틀렸네. 좋아, 다음 문제.

english: Remember, the goal here is to find the pattern. Look for objects that would have a connection to each other.
translation: 명심하게, 이 시험의 목표는 패턴을 찾는 것일세. 서로 연관이 있을 만한 물건들을 찾아보게.

english: That's WRONG. Take your time and think about the next question.
translation: 그건 틀렸네! 천천히 생각해서 다음 문제를 풀게.

english: No, no, no... That's WRONG! Okay, next question.
translation: 아니, 아니, 아니... 틀렸단 말일세! 좋아, 다음 문제.

english: How unfortunate, you FAILED. You'd better hit the books and study up for next time.
translation: 안타깝군, 자네는 낙제일세. 다음번을 위해 책을 파고 열심히 공부하게.

english: To exit, use any of the doors in this room.
translation: 나가려면 이 방에 있는 아무 문으로나 나가게.

english: Wonderful! Keep up the good work. Next question.
translation: 훌륭하네! 계속 이렇게만 하게. 다음 문제.

english: Finally, a pupil using [his/her/their] brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 드디어 [his/her/their] 두뇌를 먹지 않고 제대로 쓰는 학생이 나왔군. 다음 문제.

english: That's correct! Next question.
WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition. You'll receive a book once you leave the classroom. It is a Book of Knowledge to further your education.
translation: 아주 잘했네! 자네는 패턴 인식 능력을 증명했네. 교실을 나가면 책을 한 권 받게 될 걸세. 자네의 학업에 보탬이 될 Book of Knowledge(지식의 책)일세.

english: WELL DONE! You've proven your aptitude for pattern recognition.
translation: 아주 잘했네! 자네는 패턴 인식 능력을 증명했네.

english: Hmm, you already appear to have a Book of Knowledge. You should read that! Still, I will reward you for your work once you leave the room.
translation: 흠, 자네는 이미 Book of Knowledge(지식의 책)을 갖고 있는 것 같군. 그걸 읽어 보게! 그래도 방을 나가면 이번 성과에 대한 보상은 주겠네.

english: Examine the hint on the right and find three objects that are related to it.
translation: 오른쪽 힌트를 살펴보고 그와 관련된 물건 세 개를 찾게.

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! What can I do for you?
translation: Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: What is this place?
This is the Emir's Arena, recently renovated with his coin. Here, you can fight for glory and prestige in individual duels and tournaments.
translation: 여긴 Emir's Arena(에미르의 경기장)예요. 최근에 에미르께서 돈을 들여 새로 단장하셨죠. 이곳에선 개인 결투와 토너먼트에서 싸워 영광과 명성을 얻을 수 있어요.

english: Where did this Arena come from?
The original building was excavated by the Varrock Museum a while ago. It dated back to the Second Age!
translation: 원래 건물은 얼마 전에 Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)이 발굴한 거예요. 무려 Second Age(제2시대)까지 거슬러 올라가는 건물이었죠!

english: When the archaeologists moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world would come here to fight!
translation: 고고학자들이 떠난 뒤에 제가 이끄는 전사 무리가 그 땅을 사서 결투용 경기장들로 바꿨어요. 세계 곳곳에서 최고의 투사들이 싸우러 이곳에 몰려들곤 했죠!

english: More recently, the Emir of Al Kharid acquired the Arena and had it renovated to the state it's in now. He's kept me on to handle day-to-day running, though.
translation: 그러다 최근에 Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 에미르께서 경기장을 사들이셔서 지금 모습으로 새로 단장하셨어요. 그래도 일상적인 운영은 계속 저한테 맡기셨죠.

english: What would the Emir want to do with a bunch of fight pits?
translation: 에미르가 싸움터 몇 개로 뭘 하려는 거죠?

english: Something about a rowdy group of match-fixers, so I heard. I think the guards would know more about it than I would.
translation: 승부 조작꾼 패거리가 소란을 피운다나 뭐라나, 그렇게 들었어요. 그 일은 저보다 경비병들이 더 잘 알 거예요.

english: How do I get a fight?
You can participate in Duels and Tournaments. These may be ranked, if you want rewards and prestige, or unranked if you're just fighting your friends for fun.
translation: 결투와 토너먼트에 참가할 수 있어요. 보상과 명성을 원한다면 랭크전으로, 그냥 친구들과 재미로 싸우는 거라면 일반전으로 하면 돼요.

english: Ranked Duels and Tournaments take place on designated worlds, with stats and items provided to you on those worlds.
translation: 랭크 결투와 토너먼트는 지정된 월드에서 열리고, 그 월드에서는 능력치와 아이템이 제공돼요.

english: Win or lose, you'll earn Reward Points for taking part in ranked Duels and Tournaments. You can trade your points here for supplies that might help in the Wilderness, or such places.
translation: 이기든 지든 랭크 결투와 토너먼트에 참가하면 보상 포인트를 얻어요. 그 포인트는 여기서 Wilderness(황야) 같은 곳에서 쓸모 있을 만한 보급품으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: Now, if you want to choose your opponents, you can have an unranked Duel or Tournament instead, just for the fun of beating them.
translation: 자, 상대를 직접 고르고 싶다면 대신 일반 결투나 토너먼트를 하면 돼요. 그저 상대를 이기는 재미로 말이죠.

english: Use the recruitment boards outside the hospital to set up your own unranked tournament, or to apply to an existing one.
translation: 병원 밖에 있는 모집 게시판을 이용하면 직접 일반 토너먼트를 열거나 이미 열린 토너먼트에 신청할 수 있어요.

english: For an unranked Duel, look around the Arena for someone you wish to fight, and challenge them...
translation: 일반 결투를 하려면 경기장을 둘러보면서 싸우고 싶은 상대를 찾아 도전하세요...

english: You'll see a 'Challenge' option when you right-click other people around the Arena. Use that to set up an unranked Duel.
translation: 경기장 주변 사람들을 우클릭하면 '결투 신청' 옵션이 보일 거예요. 그걸로 일반 결투를 시작하면 돼요.

english: On PvP Arena worlds the Arena will supply stats and items for your fight. You'll get to choose your load-out from a menu.
translation: PvP Arena(PvP 경기장) 월드에서는 경기장이 싸움에 필요한 능력치와 아이템을 제공해요. 메뉴에서 장비 구성을 고를 수 있죠.

english: On other worlds, like this one, you must bring your own items, and fight with your own stats.
translation: 이 월드 같은 그 밖의 월드에서는 아이템을 직접 가져와야 하고, 본인 능력치로 싸워야 해요.

english: I challenge you!
Ho! Ho! Ho!
What kind of fights are happening today?
Every week, we'll rotate the active build, meaning you'll have access to a different set of stats and items. This week, the active build is [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med].
translation: 매주 활성 빌드를 바꾸기 때문에 매번 다른 능력치와 아이템 구성을 쓰게 돼요. 이번 주 활성 빌드는 [Zerker/1 Def Pure/Max/Med]예요.

english: Can I see your shop?
I'll be off.
See you in the Arena!
What is this place?
Where did this Arena come from?
How do I get a fight?
What kind of fights are happening today?
Can I see your shop?
I'll be off.
I challenge you!
Who's the cutest little nightmare-spawn in all of Gielinor?
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)에서 제~일 귀여운 꼬마 나이트메어는 누구게~?

english: Is it you?!
Yes, it's you my little Muphin!
translation: 그래, 바로 너야, 우리 귀염둥이 Muphin(무핀)!

english: Stop this at once.
Can you teach me how to do that thing where you teleport around really quickly?
translation: 그 엄청 빠르게 여기저기 순간이동하는 거, 나한테도 가르쳐 줄 수 있어?

english: That requires moving between realms... Your simple form would not withstand it.
translation: 그건 차원 사이를 넘나들어야 하는 일이다... 너의 하찮은 육신으로는 견디지 못한다.

english: You'd be surprised.
You know... if you were bite-sized, I reckon you'd be quite nutritious.
translation: 있잖아... 네가 한입 크기였으면 영양가가 꽤 있었을 것 같아.

english: Do NOT eat me, human.
Bleugh!
Hisssss!
Sssssssss!
What do you do here?
Well, I tend the hardwood grove nearby, you can enter if you like and harvest some of the very fine hardwood that grows within.
translation: 음, 저는 근처의 경목 숲을 관리해요. 원하시면 들어가서 그 안에서 자라는 아주 훌륭한 경목을 베어 가셔도 돼요.

english: Apart from that I'm a simple Tai Bwo Wannai villager...I like to try and find out what's going on in the mainland and the rest of the known world.
translation: 그거 말고는 그냥 평범한 Tai Bwo Wannai(타이 보 와나이) 마을 사람이에요... 본토와 세상 다른 곳에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 알아보는 걸 좋아하죠.

english: Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 할 만한 재미있는 일이 있나요?

english: Apart from cutting back the jungle and repairing the fence, I think we've got most things covered now Bwana.
translation: 정글을 쳐내는 거랑 울타리를 고치는 것 말고는 이제 웬만한 건 다 해결된 것 같아요, 브와나.

english: Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: 이 일을 하면 뭘 받을 수 있나요?

english: Yes Bwana, you gain experience in woodcutting. In addition many members of the community will reward you with trading sticks, our local currency, for your efforts.
translation: 그럼요 브와나, woodcutting(벌목) 경험치를 얻죠. 게다가 마을 사람들 중 많은 이들이 수고에 대한 보답으로 우리 지역 화폐인 trading sticks(교역 막대)를 줄 거예요.

english: Trading sticks?
Correct Bwana, trading sticks! It's our form of local currency! Everything you do to help out in the village will give you some favour, but there's a maximum limit!
translation: 맞아요 브와나, 교역 막대! 우리 지역 화폐예요! 마을을 도우면 뭘 하든 호감도가 조금씩 오르는데, 최대치가 정해져 있어요!

english: When you've reached one hundred percent, you cannot gain any more favour, you need to cash in your favour for trading sticks before you can increase your favour again.
translation: 100퍼센트에 도달하면 더는 호감도를 얻을 수 없어요. 다시 호감도를 올리려면 먼저 호감도를 교역 막대로 바꿔야 해요.

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
translation: 교역 막대는 누구한테서 받을 수 있나요?

english: Well Bwana, there's a good ten villagers I know of who would show their appreciation for your effort. Who do you want to ask about?
translation: 음 브와나, 제가 알기로 당신의 수고를 알아줄 마을 사람이 족히 열 명은 있어요. 누구에 대해 물어보고 싶으세요?

english: Sharimika is married to Mamma Bufetta, Bwana. They live in the houses just in front of the tribal statue.
translation: Sharimika(샤리미카)는 Mamma Bufetta(맘마 부페타)와 결혼했어요, 브와나. 둘은 tribal statue(부족 조각상) 바로 앞에 있는 집에 살아요.

english: Mamma Bufetta lives with her family in the building that faces the stone statue, she lives there with her husband Sharimika and her daughter Layleen.
translation: Mamma Bufetta(맘마 부페타)는 돌 조각상을 마주 보는 건물에서 가족과 함께 살아요. 남편 Sharimika(샤리미카), 딸 Layleen(레일린)과 같이 지내죠.

english: Layleen is a young girl, the daughter of Mamma Bufetta and Sharimika, she lives with her parents.
translation: Layleen(레일린)은 Mamma Bufetta(맘마 부페타)와 Sharimika(샤리미카)의 딸인 어린 소녀예요. 부모님과 함께 살아요.

english: Karaday is a young man and his chosen profession is fishing, he follows after his father Safta Doc in that respect. You can find him usually around the center of the village, that is when he's not off fishing.
translation: Karaday(카라데이)는 젊은 남자인데 직업으로 낚시를 택했어요. 그 점에선 아버지 Safta Doc(사프타 독)의 뒤를 잇고 있죠. 낚시하러 나가 있을 때만 빼면 보통 마을 한가운데쯤에서 찾을 수 있어요.

english: Safta Doc used to be a fisherman, but he's just about retired now. He has an interesting profession which you might like to talk to him about. You'll find him usually near the building with the anvil in it.
translation: Safta Doc(사프타 독)은 예전엔 어부였는데 이제 거의 은퇴했어요. 흥미로운 일을 하고 있으니 그 얘기를 나눠 보셔도 좋을 거예요. 보통 anvil(모루)가 있는 건물 근처에 있어요.

english: It's just slightly north of the village statue.
Gabooty is a bit of a mystery, no one's sure where he came from! He's quite helpful though, you can find him in the middle of the village enclosure, to the south of Sharimika's house.
translation: Gabooty(가부티)는 좀 수수께끼 같은 사람이에요. 어디서 왔는지 아무도 몰라요! 그래도 꽤 도움이 되는 사람이에요. 마을 울타리 안 한가운데, Sharimika(샤리미카)네 집 남쪽에서 찾을 수 있어요.

english: Fanellaman was a fisherman, he's retired now, but he'll try and regale you with tales of his salty sea dog days. He's often walking up and down the western beach.
translation: Fanellaman(파넬라만)은 어부였는데 지금은 은퇴했어요. 그래도 산전수전 다 겪은 뱃사람 시절 무용담으로 당신을 즐겁게 해 주려고 할 거예요. 서쪽 해변을 자주 왔다 갔다 해요.

english: Jagbakoba is a wild hunter. He can be a bit aggressive but he'll reward anyone who helps to keep the village in good order. You'll find him to the south of the enclosure, near the fires.
translation: Jagbakoba(자그바코바)는 거친 사냥꾼이에요. 좀 공격적일 수도 있지만 마을을 잘 건사하는 데 힘을 보태는 사람에겐 보답을 해 줘요. 울타리 남쪽, 모닥불 근처에서 찾을 수 있어요.

english: Ah Rionasta! He's an enterprising man! Had a very good idea and is now much in demand, you'll find him between the blacksmith's and Timfraku's hut.
translation: 아, Rionasta(리오나스타)! 수완 좋은 사람이죠! 아주 좋은 아이디어를 떠올려서 지금은 인기가 많아요. 대장간과 Timfraku(팀프라쿠)의 오두막 사이에서 찾을 수 있어요.

english: Murcaily! That's me! Well, what do you want to know?! I look after the teak and mahogany trees and make sure that we get payment of anyone who uses the facility. And I'm usually standing just about here!
translation: Murcaily(머케일리)! 그건 저예요! 자, 뭘 알고 싶으세요?! 저는 티크와 마호가니 나무를 관리하고, 그 시설을 쓰는 사람들한테서 꼭 사용료를 받아요. 그리고 보통 딱 이 자리쯤에 서 있죠!

english: Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 이봐요, 마을 여기저기서 일하는 걸 봤어요. 우리를 위해 좋은 일을 많이 해 주셨네요. 수고하신 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: Where can I get a machete from?

You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal
translation: 일반 마체테는 Jiminua(지미누아)의 가게에서 살 수 있어요. Gabooty(가부티)는 더 좋은 마체테를 포함해 이 지역 물건을 여럿 팔고 있으니 사 보셔도 좋을 거예요. 또 Safta Doc(사프타 독)과 이야기해 보는 것도 좋아요. 그분이 내놓을 거래가

english: you'll find interesting.
Where is this jungle?
You'll find much of it to the southern end of Tai Bwo Wannai, outside of the village. Some is tougher than others so you may have difficulties cutting it back.
translation: 대부분은 Tai Bwo Wannai(타이 보 와나이) 남쪽 끝, 마을 바깥에 있어요. 다른 데보다 질긴 곳도 있어서 쳐내기 어려울 수도 있어요.

english: Beware though Bwana, those bushes can conceal a great many dangers or trophies, it could be the death... or the making of you!
translation: 그래도 조심하세요 브와나, 그 덤불 속엔 온갖 위험이나 전리품이 숨어 있을 수 있거든요. 당신을 죽음으로 몰아넣을 수도... 아니면 크게 성공시킬 수도 있죠!

english: What do you mean by that?
It means that you may find something you wish you hadn't but then discover something you never thought you could! If you find me too vague, go and have a chat with Sharimika about it!
translation: 차라리 몰랐으면 싶은 걸 발견할 수도 있지만, 생각지도 못한 걸 찾게 될 수도 있다는 뜻이에요! 제 말이 너무 모호하다면 Sharimika(샤리미카)한테 가서 물어보세요!

english: Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
This is to the South Bwana, you should see that there are sections which are rotten, but some other passers-by sometimes help out repairing it.
translation: 남쪽에 있어요, 브와나. 썩은 구간이 보일 거예요. 그래도 가끔은 지나가던 다른 사람들이 고치는 걸 도와주기도 해요.

english: You'll need some thatching spars and a machete in order to repair the fence though Bwana.
translation: 그런데 울타리를 고치려면 thatching spars(이엉 막대)와 마체테가 필요해요, 브와나.

english: Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 교역 막대는 이미 드렸고, 지금은 가진 게 더 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 보답을 좀 받아 보는 게 어때요?

english: Hey there, you wanna go in there to chop da special wood, for you my friend, it's free!
translation: 이봐요, 저 안에 들어가서 그 특별한 나무 좀 베어 보실래요? 친구, 당신한텐 공짜예요!

english: The player enters the Hardwood Grove.
Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
Fair enough, pop back if you change your mind.
What do you do here?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 이 근처에 할 만한 재미있는 일이 있나요?

english: Ask about cutting back the jungle.
Do I get anything for doing this?
translation: 이 일을 하면 뭘 받을 수 있나요?

english: Who do I get trading sticks from?
translation: 교역 막대는 누구한테서 받을 수 있나요?

english: Sharimika.
Mamma Bufetta.
Layleen.
Karaday.
-- Villager Menu 2 --
Safta Doc.
Gabooty.
Fanellaman.
Jagbakoba.
-- Villager Menu 3 --
Rionasta.
Murcaily.

* Ask another question *
-- Villager Menu 1 --
Where can I get a machete from?
Where is this jungle?
Where is the fence that needs to be repaired?
Ok, thanks.
I've been doing some work around the village.
I'll enter for free.
Nah thanks, I'll give it a miss at the moment I think.
Hello.
Hello, how can I help you?
What's in this cave?
Creatures known as ents inhabit the depths of the hills, rumour has it they reside there due to the presence of the ancient redwood trees on the hills.
translation: 언덕 깊은 곳에는 ents(엔트)라고 불리는 생명체들이 살고 있어요. 소문에 따르면 언덕에 고대 redwood(레드우드) 나무가 있어서 거기 산다고 하더군요.

english: If you're as skilled a fighter as you are a woodcutter, you may enter the caves. You should find Kai once you are inside, he can give you some more information.
translation: 벌목 실력만큼 전투 실력도 뛰어나다면 동굴에 들어가도 좋아요. 안에 들어가면 Kai(카이)를 만날 수 있을 텐데, 그가 더 자세히 알려 줄 거예요.

english: I was just passing through.
What's in the cave?
I was just passing through.
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes, or perhaps I could combine the charges on yer teleport jewellery.
translation: 아르르, 뭘 원하는 거냐? 룬 시세라면 뭐든 알려 줄 수 있고, 아니면 네 순간이동 장신구의 충전을 합쳐 줄 수도 있지.

english: What's a pirate doing here?
By my sea-blistered skin, I could ask the same of you!
translation: 바닷바람에 부르튼 내 살갗에 걸고, 그건 내가 너한테 묻고 싶은 말이다!

english: But... I'm not a pirate?
No? Then what's that smell? The smell o' someone spent too long at sea without a bath!
translation: 아니라고? 그럼 이 냄새는 뭐냐? 목욕도 안 하고 바다에 너무 오래 있었던 놈 냄새 말이다!

english: I think that's probably you.
Har har har! We've got a stern landlubber 'ere! Well, let me tell ye, I'm here for the Grand Exchange! Gonna cash in me loot!
translation: 하르 하르 하르! 깐깐한 뭍쟁이가 납셨군! 자, 말해 주지. 난 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지) 때문에 여기 왔다! 내 전리품을 몽땅 현금으로 바꿀 거다!

english: Don't you just want to sell it in a shop or trade it to someone specific?
translation: 그냥 상점에 팔거나 특정한 사람이랑 거래하면 되지 않아요?

english: By my wave-battered bones! Not when I can sell to the whole world from this very spot!
translation: 파도에 두들겨 맞은 내 뼈에 걸고! 바로 이 자리에서 온 세상에 팔 수 있는데 그럴 리가!

english: You pirates are nothing but trouble! Why, once I travelled to Lunar Isle with a bunch of your type, and spent days sailing around in circles!
translation: 당신네 해적들은 말썽만 일으켜요! 아니, 전에 당신 같은 패거리랑 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에 간 적이 있는데, 며칠 동안 빙빙 돌기만 했다고요!

english: Then ye must know me brother! Murky Pat!
translation: 그럼 내 동생을 알겠구먼! Murky Pat(머키 팻)!

english: Hmmm. Not so sure I remember him.
Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some [guy/gal] like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: 음, 그 녀석은 분명 그 배에 있었다. 그리고 너 같은 [guy/gal] 하나가 저주랑 선실 사환들 일에 휘말렸다는 얘길 그 녀석한테서 들은 기억이 나.

english: Yes! That was me!
Ye sure be a different character.
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
translation: 제 순간이동 장신구 충전을 합쳐 주세요.

english: Arrr, ye've got nothing that I can combine.
translation: 아르르, 네겐 내가 합칠 만한 게 하나도 없다.

english: Arrr, ye've nothing I can combine. Maybe ye needs to take yer stuff up to the Wilderness and charge it on the Fountain of Rune. It be more powerful than me.
translation: 아르르, 합칠 만한 게 없군. 네 물건을 들고 Wilderness(황야)로 가서 Fountain of Rune(룬의 분수)에서 충전해야 할지도 모르겠다. 그건 나보다 훨씬 강력하거든.

english: Arrr, I think ye be a bit short of inventory space.
translation: 아르르, 소지품 공간이 좀 모자란 것 같다.

english: Arr, all done.
I hear you deal in rings of forging?
translation: rings of forging(단조의 반지)를 취급한다고 들었는데요?

english: Arrrr, bring me yer ruby rings to enchant.
translation: 아르르르, 마법을 걸 ruby rings(루비 반지)를 가져와라.

english: Arrrr, but they arrre 250gp per ring.
Arrr, 250gp per ring. How many would ye like me to enchant?
translation: 아르르, 반지 하나에 250gp다. 몇 개나 마법을 걸어 주랴?

english: Arrr, be seeing ya.
Arrr, pleasure doin' business with ya.
I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: 저 가서, 어, 갑판 좀 닦아야 해요! 야르!

english: Defer your speech right there! Quit this derogatory and somewhat narrow-minded allusion that all folks of sea voyage are only concerned with washing the decks, looking after parrots and drinking rum. I'll have ye
translation: 말은 거기까지만 하시지! 뱃사람이라면 죄다 갑판 닦기, 앵무새 돌보기, 럼주 마시기에만 관심 있다는 그 경멸적이고 다소 편협한 암시를 당장 거둬라. 분명히 말해 두는데

english: know there is much more to a pirate than meets the eye.
translation: 해적에겐 겉보기보다 훨씬 많은 게 있단 말이다.

english: Aye-aye, captain!
Oh, come on! Lighten up!
Arrr, what is it that ye be wantin? I can tell ye all about the prices of runes.
translation: 아르르, 뭘 원하는 거냐? 룬 시세라면 뭐든 알려 줄 수 있지.

english: No! Me prices, they be goin' down!
translation: 안 돼! 내 가격이, 내 가격이 떨어지고 있다!

english: Arrr! Another good sale!
I'm lovin' this Grand Exchange! Arrr!
translation: 이 그랜드 익스체인지, 정말 마음에 든다! 아르르!

english: Sure be a busy place, today.
Yarrr! I'm gonna be rich, I tell ye!
translation: 야르르! 난 부자가 될 거다, 두고 봐라!

english: What's a pirate doing here?
Tell me about the prices of runes.
Combine the charges on my teleport jewellery, please.
translation: 제 순간이동 장신구 충전을 합쳐 주세요.

english: I got to go, erm, swab some decks! Yarr!
translation: 저 가서, 어, 갑판 좀 닦아야 해요! 야르!

english: I hear you deal in rings of forging?
translation: rings of forging(단조의 반지)를 취급한다고 들었는데요?

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 그게 무슨 질문이야? 그럼 넌 어때, 그... 뭐더라. 네가 먹고사는 일이 뭐든 간에, 그걸로 사는 건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭔가를 죽이거나, 사람들 부탁으로 온 세상에 물건을 배달해요.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 노움이었거든. 듣자 하니 아주 고통스러운 출산이었대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 얘기할 틈 없어. 밀항자랑 노닥거리며 땡땡이치는 걸 선장님이 보면 내 창자를 뽑아 버릴 거야.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 전 밀항자가 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 뭐든 간에 [guy/lady], 네가 누구든 상관없이 혼나는 건 나라고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적 생활이 실제로 어떤 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 글쎄, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 뜬금없는 질문을 받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 전 밀항자가 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요! Lokar(로카르)한테요! 그 사람한테 물어봐요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어 [love/pal]. 선장님한테만 들키지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕하신가, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴인데, 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 우리 배에 탄 거야?
