english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 주겠다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 정말? 내가 보기엔 Fremennik(프레메닉) 같지 않은데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그런 것 같기도 하고 아닌 것 같기도 해요. 얘기하자면 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 미안하지만 그럼 들을 시간이 없겠네! 또 보자고, 프레메닉인-듯-프레메닉-아닌 젊은 친구!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 근처에 가면 너무 추워서 말을 하면 말이 눈앞에서 공중에 얼어붙는 게 보일 정도라고!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그럴 리가. 웃기려고 과장한 거야. 그래도 엄청엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쟁이 리치 놈아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 제발 그런 식으로 말하지 마. 엄청 짜증 나거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지도 마. 그게 뭔지는 몰라도.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자가 탔다! 밀항자가 탔다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 진짜예요! 초대받았다고요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 네가 밀항자처럼 생긴 건 인정해야 할걸.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 사실 한 번도 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 월급봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있으니까.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 괜찮아. 약탈할 수 있는 grog(그로그)와 전리품은 다 우리 거고, 게다가 치과까지 포함된 의료 혜택도 완벽하거든.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 딱히 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 나을 때까지 안 놔줘.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 최고 수준의 진료에 얼마나 큰 동기가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)에는 무슨 일로 탄 거야?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아가려던 참이었는데, 배가 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그렇지, 정말 미인이지! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)는 폭풍 속에서도 햇빛 아래서도 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었어. 그리고 언제나 우릴 가려던 곳까지 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 제가 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 멋진 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Good day to you Sir.
Well hello my brave adventurer.
What are you up to?
Getting ready to go fishing of course. There's no time to waste!
translation: 당연히 고기 잡으러 나갈 준비 중이지. 낭비할 시간이 없다고!

english: I've got all the supplies I need from the shop at the end of the pier. They sell good rope, hammers and axes although their bailing buckets aren't too effective.
translation: 필요한 보급품은 부두 끝 가게에서 다 샀어. 거기 rope(밧줄), hammers(망치), axes(도끼)는 쓸 만한데 bailing buckets(물 퍼내는 양동이)는 영 시원찮더라고.

english: What fish do you catch?
I get all sorts, anything that lies on the sea bed, you never know what you're going to get until you pull up the net!
translation: 온갖 걸 다 잡지. 바다 밑바닥에 있는 건 뭐든. 그물을 끌어 올리기 전까진 뭐가 걸릴지 아무도 모른다고!

english: Your boat doesn't look too safe.
That's because it's not, the darn thing's full of holes.
translation: 안전하지 않으니까 그렇지. 망할 놈의 배가 구멍투성이거든.

english: Oh, so I suppose you can't go out for a while?
Oh no, I don't let a few holes stop an experienced sailor like me. I could sail these seas in a barrel, I'll be going out soon enough.
translation: 천만에, 나처럼 노련한 선원은 구멍 몇 개쯤으로 안 멈춰. 통 하나만 있어도 이 바다를 누빌 수 있다고. 곧 나갈 거야.

english: Could I help?
Well of course you can! I'll warn you though, the seas are merciless and without fishing experience you won't catch much.
translation: 물론이지! 그래도 경고는 해 두지. 바다는 무자비해서 낚시 경험이 없으면 별로 못 잡을 거야.

english: You need a fishing level of 15 or above to catch any fish on the trawler.
translation: trawler(트롤선)에서 물고기를 잡으려면 fishing(낚시) 레벨이 15 이상이어야 해.

english: On occasions the net rips, so you'll need some rope to repair it.
translation: 가끔 그물이 찢어지니까 고칠 rope(밧줄)이 좀 있어야 해.

english: Repairing the net is difficult in the harsh conditions so you'll find it easier with a higher crafting level.
translation: 험한 날씨에 그물을 고치는 건 어려우니까 crafting(공예) 레벨이 높을수록 수월할 거야.

english: Right...ok.
There's also a slight problem with leaks.
Leaks?!
Nothing some swamp paste won't fix...
translation: swamp paste(늪 반죽) 좀 바르면 해결 못 할 일도 아니지...

english: Swamp paste?
Also, there's the small matter of the Kraken.
You have got to be kidding me?
Occupational hazard. I usually whack it with an axe a few time and fix the damage with hammer once it's gone.
translation: 직업병 같은 거지. 보통 axe(도끼)로 몇 번 후려치고, 놈이 가고 나면 hammer(망치)로 부서진 데를 고쳐.

english: Oh, and one more thing... I hope you're a good swimmer?
translation: 아, 그리고 하나 더... 헤엄은 잘 치겠지?

english: Actually, I think I'll leave it.
Bloomin' land lovers!!!
I'll be fine, let's go.
Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler. I just need to get a few things together.
translation: 알겠어! 트롤선에서 보자고. 난 챙길 게 좀 있어서.

english: Aye aye! Meet me on board the trawler.
Oh hang on. I'm already on a fishing trip with someone. You'll have to try back in a few minutes.
translation: 아, 잠깐. 지금 다른 사람이랑 고기잡이 나가 있는 중이야. 몇 분 뒤에 다시 와.

english: How can you be here and on board the boat?!
translation: 어떻게 여기도 있고 배에도 있을 수 있어요?!

english: That's Game Magic, [lass/son].
What?!
Never mind. Just try back later OK?
translation: 신경 쓰지 마. 그냥 나중에 다시 와, 알았지?

english: What's swamp paste?
Swamp tar mixed with flour which is then heated over a fire.
translation: Swamp tar(늪 타르)를 flour(밀가루)와 섞어서 불에 데운 거야.

english: Where can I find swamp tar?
Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.
translation: 아쉽게도 swamp tar(늪 타르)는 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 아래 늪에서만 나.

english: Hello again Murphy.
Good day to you land lover. Fancy hitting the high seas again?
translation: 잘 왔네, 뭍쟁이. 또 한번 거친 바다로 나가 볼 텐가?

english: No thanks, I still feel ill from last time.
translation: 아뇨, 지난번 때문에 아직도 속이 안 좋아요.

english: Hah! ...Softy.
We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
translation: 자꾸 가라앉아요! 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: Aye aye matey! We'll soon get you ship shape!
translation: 알겠어, 친구! 금방 배를 제대로 굴리게 해 주지!

english: Ah yes, got it.
Don't say!
Also, bring a good axe and a hammer in case of Kraken attacks.
translation: 그리고 Kraken(크라켄)이 덮칠 때를 대비해서 쓸 만한 axe(도끼)랑 hammer(망치)도 챙겨 와.

english: I thought I'd heard it all!
Right so I need lots of swamp paste and plenty of rope, an axe and a hammer. Thanks Murphy!
translation: 그러니까 swamp paste(늪 반죽)을 잔뜩, rope(밧줄)도 넉넉히, 그리고 axe(도끼)랑 hammer(망치)가 필요하단 거죠. 고마워요, Murphy(머피)!

english: If all else fails use a bailing bucket or three!
translation: 정 안 되면 bailing bucket(물 퍼내는 양동이)를 하나... 아니, 셋쯤 써!

english: Yes, let's do it!
Murphy, what can you tell me about giant crabs?
translation: Murphy(머피), giant crab(거대 게)에 대해 아는 거 있어요?

english: Giant Crabs? Why, I used to haul up a few of those whenever I set my nets around Rimmington.
translation: Giant Crab(거대 게)? 예전에 Rimmington(림밍턴) 근처에 그물을 칠 때마다 몇 마리씩 건져 올리곤 했지.

english: Why the interest?
I need to get some Giant Crab Meat and Kelp. Can you tell me where I can get some?
translation: Giant Crab Meat(거대 게살)과 Kelp(켈프)가 좀 필요해요. 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Well, the only thing I can think to do is to go down there and look to see if there are any left.
translation: 글쎄, 내가 생각나는 방법은 직접 내려가서 남은 게 있는지 찾아보는 것뿐이야.

english: Go down there? What do you mean?
As in under the water!
Tell me, can you get your hands on a fishbowl?
translation: 그런데 혹시 fishbowl(어항) 구할 수 있겠어?

english: I'm sure I will be able to if I put my mind to it, why do you ask?
translation: 마음만 먹으면 구할 수 있을 거예요. 왜요?

english: Well, I know how to rig up a handy set of breathing gear that can allow you to keep air inside the fishbowl.
translation: 어항 안에 공기를 담아 둘 수 있는 쓸 만한 호흡 장비를 만들 줄 알거든.

english: You just put the barrel of air on your back, with the fishbowl over your head, and then dive over the side.
translation: 공기 통을 등에 메고 어항을 머리에 뒤집어쓴 다음 배 옆으로 뛰어들면 돼.

english: It should hold enough air to keep you alive for quite some time.
translation: 꽤 오랫동안 버틸 만큼 공기가 들어갈 거야.

english: That sounds pretty dangerous...
Not at all. I'll even weigh anchor with the chain somewhere easy to reach so you can climb out easily enough if you run into trouble.
translation: 전혀. 닻 내릴 때 사슬을 손 닿기 쉬운 데 둘 테니까, 문제가 생기면 쉽게 타고 올라오면 돼.

english: I'm still not happy about this...
Well, I can't think of any other way to check. If you come up with a better plan then feel free to tell me.
translation: 글쎄, 확인할 방법이 그것 말곤 생각이 안 나. 더 좋은 계획이 떠오르면 얼마든지 말해.

english: In the meantime I'll wait, and if you want me to take you diving I'll be ready.
translation: 그동안 난 여기서 기다릴 테니, 잠수하러 가고 싶으면 언제든 말해. 준비는 돼 있으니까.

english: By the way, why are you so interested in crabs all of a sudden?
translation: 그런데 갑자기 게에는 왜 그렇게 관심이 많은 거야?

english: I can't tell you I'm afraid. The very fabric of space and time could collapse!
translation: 미안하지만 말할 수 없어요. 시공간의 구조 자체가 무너질지도 몰라요!

english: Well, I guess some people will do anything for a bit of fresh seafood.
translation: 뭐, 신선한 해산물 좀 먹겠다고 무슨 짓이든 하는 사람들도 있는 법이지.

english: Ahoy there! All set for a dive?
I certainly am.
Great! I'll sort that fishbowl out for you.
There you go.
Are you sure this is safe?
Sure! It's as sound as my ship!
Want me to take you out now?
Well I can't take you out until you are properly geared up.
translation: 장비를 제대로 갖추기 전엔 데려갈 수 없어.

english: Ok, let's be off then.
Cutscene begins onboard the boat.
Ok, see you soon Murphy!
Good luck, I'll weigh anchor. Climb up the chain to get aboard.
translation: 행운을 빌어. 닻을 내려 둘게. 사슬을 타고 올라오면 배에 탈 수 있어.

english: Not just yet.
Ok, well I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 그래, 마음 바뀌면 난 여기 있을 테니.

english: Murphy, can I get another diving helmet?
translation: Murphy(머피), diving helmet(잠수 헬멧) 하나 더 받을 수 있어요?

english: Sure, here you go. Try not to lose this one, I'm not a very good glassblower.
translation: 그럼, 여기. 이번 건 잃어버리지 마. 내가 유리 부는 솜씨가 영 별로라서.

english: What do you mean?
Well, the bowls I make tend to shatter under pressure into razor-sharp shards of lethal, face shredding shrapnel.
translation: 그게, 내가 만든 어항은 압력을 받으면 깨지면서 얼굴을 갈기갈기 찢어 놓는 면도날 같은 치명적인 파편이 되곤 하거든.

english: Don't let it bother you, I think I know what I'm doing wrong now.
translation: 걱정하지 마. 이제 뭘 잘못하고 있었는지 알 것 같으니까.

english: Hello Murphy. Do you have a spare diving backpack?
translation: 안녕하세요, Murphy(머피). 남는 diving backpack(잠수 배낭) 있어요?

english: Sure, I have plenty after the...little incident.
translation: 그럼, 그...작은 사고 이후로 잔뜩 남았거든.

english: What 'little incident'?
Nothing to worry yourself about.
Here, have this one. Only dropped once!
translation: 자, 이거 가져가. 딱 한 번 떨어뜨린 거야!

english: Is that blood?
No, no.
Well, yes.
But seriously, what are the chances of getting a jellyfish jammed in there again?
translation: 근데 솔직히, 해파리가 또 거기 끼일 확률이 얼마나 되겠어?

english: Yes, Let's go diving.
Well let's be...
Err, how do you plan on swimming with your hands full?
translation: 어, 양손 가득 들고 어떻게 헤엄칠 생각이야?

english: Well, when you hit the water you will start swimming. If you can't free up your hands by putting everything away then you will sink like a stone.
translation: 물에 닿으면 헤엄을 치기 시작할 텐데, 짐을 다 넣어서 손을 비우지 못하면 돌처럼 가라앉을 거야.

english: All you have to do is have 2 spaces to store the items and you are good to go.
translation: 물건을 넣어 둘 칸이 2개만 있으면 바로 갈 수 있어.

english: Even if you aren't carrying a shield or weapon it's always handy to have some free space for an emergency.
translation: 방패나 무기를 안 들고 있더라도 비상시를 대비해 빈칸을 좀 남겨 두는 게 좋아.

english: See you then!
Now, do you have a gomeball on you?
Yes, I do, why do you ask?
Well you will need to leave them on the surface. They are so full of air that they will stop you diving properly.
translation: 그건 수면 위에 두고 가야 해. 공기가 꽉 차 있어서 잠수를 제대로 못 하게 되거든.

english: Right, I'll go put it in the bank.
Now, do you have a hand egg on you?
translation: 그런데 혹시 hand egg(핸드 에그) 갖고 있어?

english: You want that cat of yours to drown or something?
translation: 그 고양이를 물에 빠뜨려 죽이기라도 할 셈이야?

english: You mean you can't make them an adorable set of tiny diving gear?
translation: 고양이한테 딱 맞는 귀여운 꼬마 잠수 장비 같은 건 못 만들어 주세요?

english: No. Just...no.
I'm not taking you out for a dive with that cat following you.
translation: 그 고양이를 데리고 다니는 한 잠수하러 데려갈 수 없어.

english: I'm not a cat person, and it'd have to stay on the ship while you were down.
translation: 난 고양이를 별로 안 좋아해. 게다가 네가 물속에 있는 동안 녀석은 배에 남아 있어야 할 거고.

english: You know, I can see your cat right there.
translation: 있잖아, 네 고양이 바로 거기 보이거든.

english: I'm looking right at it. See, it's just there in your bag!
translation: 지금 똑똑히 보고 있다고. 봐, 네 가방 안에 있잖아!

english: I'm not taking you out with that cat. I'm not some sort of cat-sitter, so go and put it somewhere safe, then come back.
translation: 그 고양이랑 같이는 못 데려가. 난 고양이 돌보미가 아니니까, 가서 안전한 데 맡겨 두고 다시 와.

english: O'kay...
I still think I should get some cat-sized diving gear…
translation: 그래도 고양이 크기 잠수 장비는 하나 있어야 할 것 같은데요…

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet following you. It'll get wet.
translation: 애완동물을 데리고 다니는 한 잠수하러 데려갈 수 없어. 젖을 거라고.

english: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet in your bag. It'll get wet.
translation: 가방에 애완동물을 넣고 있는 한 잠수하러 데려갈 수 없어. 젖을 거라고.

english: We lost three diving parties that way!
translation: 그렇게 해서 잠수조를 세 팀이나 잃었다고!

english: Ok, well I'll just put my diving helmet and diving backpack on.
translation: 알겠어요, 그럼 diving helmet(잠수 헬멧)이랑 diving backpack(잠수 배낭)만 착용할게요.

english: Well that's the sort of spirit I like to see. However you are far too heavy to go diving right now.
translation: 바로 그런 기백을 보고 싶었지. 그런데 지금은 너무 무거워서 잠수할 수 없어.

english: Well, I can't take you diving if you are carrying more than 27kg worth of equipment.
translation: 장비 무게가 27kg를 넘으면 잠수하러 데려갈 수 없어.

english: We arrived at that number through trial and error, and the errors were not pretty let me assure you.
translation: 그 숫자는 시행착오 끝에 나온 건데, 착오 쪽은 정말 볼 만한 꼴이 아니었다고 장담하지.

english: So what can I do?
Well, if you pop over to a bank and leave all your heavy equipment behind then I'll take you out.
translation: 은행에 들러서 무거운 장비를 다 맡기고 오면 데려가 주지.

english: A brief cutscene plays of Murphy and the player standing on the trawler’s deck at sea.
translation: 바다 위 트롤선 갑판에 Murphy(머피)와 플레이어가 서 있는 짧은 컷신이 재생된다.

english: How did it go?
Not too bad.
Great, I'll take us back in.
The player is transported back to Port Khazard.
The ship's ready to depart.
By the way, would you like me to remind you how the trawler works once the trip starts?
translation: 그런데, 항해가 시작되면 트롤선이 어떻게 돌아가는지 다시 알려 줄까?

english: By the way, would you like me to keep reminding you how the trawler works once the trip starts?
translation: 그런데, 항해가 시작될 때마다 트롤선이 어떻게 돌아가는지 계속 알려 줄까?

english: You've got it!
No worries! Let me know if you change your mind!
The ship's at sea at the moment. This is some kind of paradox.
translation: 배는 지금 바다에 나가 있어. 이건 무슨 역설 같은 거로군.

english: Whoooahh sailor!
I've had enough, take me back.
Hah! .. the soft land lovers lost their sea legs have they?
translation: 하! .. 연약한 뭍쟁이들이 벌써 뱃멀미에 두 손 들었나?

english: ...Something like that.
We're too far out now, It'd be dangerous.
translation: 지금은 너무 멀리 나왔어. 위험할 거야.

english: I insist Murphy, take me back.
Ok, ok, I'll try, but don't say I didn't warn you…
translation: 알았어, 알았어, 해 보긴 할게. 하지만 경고 안 했다고는 하지 마…

english: Murphy attempts to sharply turn the large ship.
translation: Murphy(머피)가 커다란 배를 급하게 돌리려 한다.

english: Save yourself! We're going down!
The fishing trawler is wrecked at sea.
Okay then Murphy, just keep us afloat.
translation: 그럼 됐어요, Murphy(머피). 배가 가라앉지 않게만 해 주세요.

english: That's the attitude sailor...Aaaaar!
How you doing Murphy?
Get those fishies!
I think i'm feeling a bit sea sick!
It's a fierce sea today traveller, you best hold on tight.
translation: 오늘은 바다가 사납구먼, 여행자. 꽉 붙잡고 있어.

english: Hello there
What the...?
Don't worry, Murphy. My name's [player name] and I'm using magic to contact you!
translation: 놀라지 마세요, Murphy(머피). 저는 [player name](이)라고 하는데, 마법으로 연락하는 거예요!

english: That's so rude when you may as well just speak to me in person!
translation: 그냥 직접 와서 말해도 될 걸 이러다니 무례하기 짝이 없군!

english: Well I never! Technology these days. Beyond me. So how might I help you?
translation: 세상에 원! 요즘 기술이란. 난 도통 모르겠어. 그래서 뭘 도와줄까?

english: I was just wondering if there is anyone down there helping you out on the trawler?
translation: 혹시 거기 트롤선에서 도와주는 사람이 있나 궁금해서요.

english: The boat has just left actually! Perhaps when it comes back you can join them in another run?
translation: 배가 방금 떠났어! 배가 돌아오면 다음 항해에 끼면 어때?

english: Sounds like a plan.
There seems to be someone on-board.
translation: 지금 한 명이 타고 있는 것 같아.

english: Just one person?
Yep, just one.
Ok, maybe I'll join them.
translation: 좋아요, 저도 같이 가 볼까 봐요.

english: No, there are [number] at the moment.
The boat is just sitting waiting for someone to join. How about it?
translation: 배가 누가 타기만 기다리고 있어. 어때?

english: Maybe I'll come have a look. I'll catch you later!
Ok mate, bye!
The ship is back in port!
The ship will leave in 1 minute!
The ship will leave in [50/40/30/20/10] seconds!
The ship has just left port!
The ship will be back in [5/4/3/2/1] minute[s]!
The ship will be back in under 1 minute!
Looks like the ship’s not going after all!
The ship has sunk! I'll get another one.
translation: 배가 가라앉았어! 다른 배를 구해 올게.

english: Let’s get this net full with fishies!
Arrh! Check that net!
Doom! The Kraken is attacking!
Hurrah! The Kraken is no more!
You’ll need to start bailing soon!
translation: 곧 물을 퍼내기 시작해야 할 거야!

english: Blistering barnacles!
The water is coming in matey!
We’ll all end up in a watery grave!
Land lubbers!
It’s a fierce sea today traveller.
My mother could bail better than that!
translation: 우리 어머니도 그것보단 물을 잘 퍼내겠다!

english: Noooooo!
We’re going under!
We’re all doomed!
Mummy!
You’ll need all your strength!
translation: 있는 힘을 다 짜내야 할 거야!

english: To make it back to shore.
No fishies for you today!
Arrrgh! We’ve sunk!
Keep your head above water shipmate.
translation: 물 위로 머리 내밀고 버텨, 친구.

english: You’ll be joining Davey Jones!
What fish do you catch?
Your boat doesn't look too safe.
Could I help?
Actually, I think I'll leave it.
I'll be fine, let's go.
What's swamp paste?
No thanks, I still feel ill from last time.
translation: 아뇨, 지난번 때문에 아직도 속이 안 좋아요.

english: We keep sinking! Can you give me some advice?
translation: 자꾸 가라앉아요! 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: Yes, let's do it!
Talk about Recipe for Disaster.
translation: Recipe for Disaster(재앙의 요리법)에 대해 이야기해요.

english: Talk about something else.
Yes, Let's go diving.
Not just yet.
Go Diving.
Yes
No
I've had enough, take me back.
I insist Murphy, take me back.
Okay then Murphy, just keep us afloat.
translation: 그럼 됐어요, Murphy(머피). 배가 가라앉지 않게만 해 주세요.

english: How you doing Murphy?
Good day, Muruwoi.
Well done on retrieving the captive, visitor. Awowogei was impressed.
translation: 포로를 되찾아 오다니 잘했소, 방문객. Awowogei(아워워게이)께서 감탄하셨소.

english: Sorry, you can't come in here.
Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. I'm afraid you can't come through here - you'll need to find another way around.
translation: 안녕하세요! 죄송하지만 이야기 나눌 틈이 없어요. 이 인부용 대문을 지키는 중이거든요. 여기로는 지나가실 수 없으니 다른 길로 돌아가셔야 해요.

english: You need 153 kudos to pass through here.
Hello there! Sorry, I can't stop to talk. I'm guarding this workman's gate. As a friend of the museum, you may pass through as you wish.
translation: 안녕하세요! 죄송하지만 이야기 나눌 틈이 없어요. 이 인부용 대문을 지키는 중이거든요. 박물관의 친구시니까 원하시면 언제든 지나가셔도 돼요.

english: You're not permitted in this area.
Welcome! Would you like to go into the Dig Site archaeology cleaning area?
translation: 어서 오세요! Dig Site(발굴 현장) 고고학 세척 구역으로 들어가시겠어요?

english: No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.
Hello there. Come to see the new museum?
Yes, how do I get in?
Well, the main entrance is 'round the front. Just head west then north slightly, you can't miss it!
translation: 정문은 앞쪽으로 돌아가시면 있어요. 서쪽으로 가다가 북쪽으로 살짝 꺾으시면 돼요. 못 찾을 수가 없어요!

english: What about these doors?
They're for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site; sorry, but you can't go through.
translation: 이건 Dig Site(발굴 현장)에서 나온 유물을 나르는 인부들용이에요. 죄송하지만 지나가실 수 없어요.

english: Sorry, you can't come in here unless you've completed the Dig Site quest.
translation: 죄송하지만 Dig Site(발굴 현장) 퀘스트를 완료하지 않으셨다면 여기 들어오실 수 없어요.

english: They're primarily for the workmen bringing finds from the Dig Site, but you can go through if you want.
translation: 주로 Dig Site(발굴 현장)에서 나온 유물을 나르는 인부들용이지만, 원하시면 지나가셔도 돼요.

english: Okay, thanks.
Hold up there, workman coming through! You'll have to wait a moment; don't want to fall into that wheelbarrow!
translation: 잠깐 멈추세요, 인부 지나갑니다! 잠시만 기다려 주세요. wheelbarrow(외바퀴 수레)에 빠지고 싶진 않으시잖아요!

english: Sorry - workman's gate only.
Yes, I'll go in!
No thanks, I'll take a look around out here.
Hello there, human.
Do you have any news?
The Red Axe has departed the city recently. Ill omens.
translation: The Red Axe(레드 액스)가 최근 도시를 떠났소. 불길한 징조요.

english: How is that? Do you know anything about this?
translation: 어째서요? 이 일에 대해 뭔가 아세요?

english: No, it's just that no company has ever willingly left the Consortium before.
translation: 아니, 그저 지금껏 Consortium(컨소시엄)을 제 발로 떠난 회사가 하나도 없었을 뿐이오.

english: Companies have been forced out of the Consortium then?
translation: 그럼 Consortium(컨소시엄)에서 쫓겨난 회사들은 있었다는 거예요?

english: Oh yes. It hasn't happened for a long while now, but sometimes a company goes bankrupt. Or the value of the company becomes so low that it's relegated to being a minor company.
translation: 그렇소. 오랫동안 없던 일이지만, 가끔 회사가 파산하기도 하오. 아니면 회사 가치가 너무 떨어져서 군소 회사로 강등되기도 하고.

english: I see, thank you.
Do you have any quests?
Let me think for a moment...
No, I have nothing that I could possible want doing. Try the shops or the market instead.
translation: 아니, 딱히 맡길 만한 일은 없소. 상점이나 시장에 가 보시오.

english: See you later!
Perhaps!
Do you have any news?
Do you have any quests?
See you later!
I'll leave you to it.
I have something for you.
You're looking very shady.
I'm here for good reason, [player name].
translation: 다 이유가 있어서 여기 있는 거다, [player name].

english: How do you know my name?
You and I share a common friend.
Azzanadra?
Indeed.
Why are you here?
Ever heard of criminals returning to the scene of the crime? Thatswhy.
translation: 범죄자는 범행 현장에 돌아온다는 말 들어 봤어? 그래서지.

english: I'm not sure this one is going to return any time soon.
translation: 이번 범인은 금방 돌아올 것 같지 않은데요.

english: Well never say never, [player name]. Now be on your way.
translation: 절대라는 말은 하는 게 아니야, [player name]. 이제 갈 길 가.

english: Azzanadra offered me a ring...
And you need me to give it to you?
Pretty much.
Take good care of that. It's very poweful.
I need another ring.
Very well, but it will cost you...
translation: 좋아, 하지만 대가를 치러야 할 거야...

english: I'd best get going.
Until next time, [player name].
Hello again, [player name]. Azzanadra asked me to give you this.
translation: 또 보는군, [player name]. Azzanadra(아자나드라)가 이걸 너한테 주라더군.

english: Hello again, [player name].
Don't you get bored down here?
Not really. I like the peace and quiet. It's also a far more reasonable temperature than outside.
translation: 별로. 조용한 게 좋거든. 바깥보다 기온도 훨씬 적당하고.

english: Good points.
Azzanadra gave me a ring...
And you need me to replace it?
It'll cost you.
How much we talking?
75,000 of your finest gold coins.
Yes.
Seems I don't have enough coins...
Well off you go then.
You will need some space to hold it first.
Why are you here?
Azzanadra offered me a ring...
I need another ring.
I'd best get going.
Azzanadra gave me a ring...
No.
[player name]! Hand over the medallion!
[player name]! You have something that I want!
translation: [player name]! 네게 내가 원하는 게 있다!

english: [player name]! I want that medallion!
Sandwiches, [player name]!
Not who you expected, [player name]? Give me the medallion!
translation: 예상했던 상대가 아니라서 놀랐나, [player name]? 메달리온을 내놔!

english: You can't dismiss me, [player name]! Give me the medallion!
translation: 날 쫓아낼 순 없다, [player name]! 메달리온을 내놔!

english: Enough of this, [player name]! Give me the medallion!
Welcome home, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: 집에 온 걸 환영한다, [player name]. 자, 메달리온을 내놔!

english: Nice house, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: 집 좋구나, [player name]. 자, 메달리온을 내놔!

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Now, give me the medallion!
translation: 돌아온 걸 환영한다, [player name]. 자, 메달리온을 내놔!

english: I'm still here, [player name]! Now give me the medallion!
translation: 난 아직 여기 있다, [player name]! 자, 메달리온을 내놔!

english: Going somewhere, [player name]? We have unfinished business!
translation: 어딜 가려고, [player name]? 우리 아직 볼일이 남았다!

english: Come on! Show me a challenge!
translation: 덤벼라! 제대로 된 승부를 보여 줘!

english: That's more like it!
You can do better than that!
Now we're getting somewhere!
Is that all you have to give?!
Better! Much better!
I don't know how you lasted this long!
Yes! Show me what you've got!
Some fighter you are!
Finally, a proper challenger!
Really? Is that it?
Good! Now keep it up!
A worthy foe...
Pathetic!
Mediocre!
Disappointing!
Pitiful!
Sit down!
Hey, [player name], would you like to come and perform in a mime show?
translation: 이보게, [player name], 마임 쇼에 나와서 공연 한번 해 보지 않겠나?

english: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.
translation: 좋아요, 마임 쇼 해 보고 싶어요.

english: Player is teleported to the mime show random event.
translation: 플레이어가 마임 쇼 랜덤 이벤트로 순간이동된다.

english: You need to copy the mime's performance, then you'll be returned to where you were.
translation: mime(마임 배우)의 연기를 따라 하면 원래 있던 곳으로 돌려보내 주겠네.

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
Hey, [player name], would you like to come and solve a maze for me?
translation: 이보게, [player name], 나 대신 미로 하나 풀어 보지 않겠나?

english: Sure, I like exploring mazes.
Reach the maze centre as fast as possible. The faster you are, the better your reward.
translation: 최대한 빨리 미로 중앙에 도착하게. 빠를수록 보상이 좋아질 걸세.

english: Ah, so you are there. I hoped you would talk to me, I get so lonely. Here, have a present! I must be going now though.
translation: 아, 거기 있었구먼. 말을 걸어 주길 바랐네, 난 너무 외롭거든. 자, 선물일세! 하지만 이제 그만 가 봐야겠네.

english: Your reward is [Reward] - it has been placed on the ground.
Sorry, I'm trying to speak to someone else, but he/she/they seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 미안하네, 다른 사람에게 말을 걸려는 중인데 그 사람이 날 무시하는 것 같구먼.

english: Goodbye.
[player name]!
Hello? [player name]?
Talk to me, [player name]!
translation: 내 말 좀 들어 보게, [player name]!

english: [player name]? Are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
translation: 자네와 이야기 좀 하고 싶네, [player name]!

english: Maybe later.
I'm sorry, but you are no use to me.
Here, take this. But tell no one I was here.
translation: 자, 이걸 받게. 하지만 내가 여기 왔었다는 건 아무에게도 말하지 말게.

english: Well done! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 잘했네! 자네에게 알려 줄 새 정보가 있네.

english: Yeah, I'd love to do a mime show.
translation: 좋아요, 마임 쇼 해 보고 싶어요.

english: Sorry, I'm busy.
Sure, I like exploring mazes.
Hey. Over here.
You look like someone who can handle themselves. Are you intending to partake in the Theatre of Blood?
translation: 제 몸 하나는 지킬 줄 아는 사람으로 보이는군. Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)에 참가할 생각이오?

english: Maybe?
You're wondering what's in it for you I suppose. The citizens of Meiyerditch come here looking for freedom, but I can tell you're no citizen.
translation: 자기한테 무슨 득이 있나 궁금한 모양이군. Meiyerditch(메이어디치)의 시민들은 자유를 찾아 이곳에 오지만, 당신은 시민이 아닌 게 훤히 보이는군.

english: Don't worry, you're not the first to sneak in. The guards here turn a blind eye to that sort of thing. Outsiders generally perform better in the Theatre, so make for more interesting entertainment.
translation: 걱정 마시오, 몰래 숨어든 건 당신이 처음이 아니니. 이곳 경비병들은 그런 일에 눈을 감아 주지. 외부인들이 대체로 극장에서 더 잘 버티니, 그만큼 더 흥미로운 볼거리가 되거든.

english: Even the outsiders don't survive though. No one does. You however, might just have what it takes.
translation: 그래도 외부인들조차 살아남지 못하오. 아무도 살아남지 못하지. 하지만 당신이라면, 어쩌면 해낼지도 모르겠군.

english: Where are you going with this?
You're strong enough to survive the Theatre, but you need a reason to try. I have a little proposition for you.
translation: 당신은 극장에서 살아남을 만큼 강하지만, 도전할 이유가 필요하오. 내게 작은 제안이 하나 있소.

english: Go on...
The Theatre is owned by Lady Verzik Vitur, a vampyre noble. I represent a party that has certain... interests in Verzik.
translation: 극장의 주인은 뱀파이어 귀족인 Lady Verzik Vitur(버지크 비투르 부인)이오. 나는 버지크에게 어떤... 관심을 가진 세력을 대변하고 있소.

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would be quite the embarrassment for Verzik, something that my associates would very much appreciate.
translation: 극장에 들어가 그 안의 시련을 이겨 내시오. 그렇게만 하면 Verzik(버지크)에게는 크나큰 망신이 될 테고, 내 동료들은 그걸 무척 반길 것이오.

english: So you just need me to embarrass her? Doesn't sound too bad.
translation: 그러니까 그 여자를 망신시키기만 하면 된다는 거죠? 나쁘지 않네요.

english: Be aware, this will be no easy challenge. I doubt you'll succeed alone. However, the guards will let you enter in a group of up to five. I suggest you take advantage of this.
translation: 명심하시오, 결코 쉬운 시련이 아니오. 혼자서는 성공하기 어려울 거요. 하지만 경비병들은 최대 다섯 명까지 무리를 지어 들어가게 해 주지. 이 점을 잘 활용하길 권하오.

english: You can use the notice board to find suitable allies with whom to enter the Theatre.
translation: notice board(게시판)을 이용하면 극장에 함께 들어갈 만한 동료를 찾을 수 있소.

english: Have you any advice to help me?
Actually, I do. Verzik's magic prevents most forms of teleportation. However, there is a special crystal with the power to overcome this restriction.
translation: 사실 있소. Verzik(버지크)의 마법은 대부분의 순간이동을 막고 있소. 하지만 이 제약을 넘어설 힘을 지닌 특별한 크리스탈이 있지.

english: I have... acquired some shards of the crystal. Do not ask me how. If you take one into the Theatre, you can use it to teleport to safety in an emergency.
translation: 그 크리스탈의 조각을 몇 개... 손에 넣었소. 어떻게 구했는지는 묻지 마시오. 하나를 가지고 극장에 들어가면, 위급할 때 안전한 곳으로 순간이동할 수 있소.

english: I can sell you some of these shards if you wish.
translation: 원한다면 이 조각을 좀 팔 수도 있소.

english: Very well, I'll do my best.
I don't think so.
As you wish. Return to me if you change your mind.
translation: 좋을 대로 하시오. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오시오.

english: Any luck in the Theatre?
What am I meant to be doing again?
Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrassment to Verzik and my associates would very much appreciate it.
translation: 극장에 들어가 그 안의 시련을 이겨 내시오. 그렇게 하면 Verzik(버지크)에게 크나큰 망신을 줄 수 있고, 내 동료들도 무척 고마워할 것이오.

english: I've managed to defeat her! I survived every single one of Verzik's challenges!
translation: 그 여자를 쓰러뜨렸어요! Verzik(버지크)의 시련에서 하나도 빠짐없이 살아남았다고요!

english: Really?
No.
I suggest you don't waste my time.
translation: 내 시간을 낭비하지 않는 게 좋을 거요.

english: At the end, she even chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though, she just transformed into a bat and flew away.
translation: 마지막에는 그 여자가 직접 저를 상대하러 나왔어요. 완전히 쓰러뜨리진 못했지만요. 박쥐로 변해서 날아가 버렸거든요.

english: Impressive. Don't stop there though, return to the Theatre and embarrass her again. Keep it up and you will be rewarded.
translation: 인상적이군. 하지만 거기서 멈추지 마시오. 극장으로 돌아가 다시 그 여자를 망신시키시오. 계속 그렇게 하면 보상을 받게 될 거요.

english: You again. My master is very impressed with your work. On his behalf, allow me to reward you.
translation: 또 당신이군. 우리 주인께서 당신의 활약에 크게 감탄하셨소. 그분을 대신해 보상을 드리겠소.

english: You should be careful around here friend. If I can tell you don't belong here, they probably can as well.
translation: 이 근처에선 조심하는 게 좋을 거요, 친구. 당신이 이곳 사람이 아니란 걸 내가 알아볼 정도면, 저들도 알아볼 테니까.

english: Yes.
Have you any advice to help me?
Go and buy teleport crystals.
Enter the Theatre without any teleport crystals.
Very well, I'll do my best.
No.
Welcome adventurer, to the Hallowed Sepulchre. Are you here to claim some of the treasure within? It seems like the kind of activity one like you would appreciate.
translation: Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 온 걸 환영하오, 모험가. 이 안의 보물을 차지하러 왔소? 당신 같은 부류라면 좋아할 만한 일 같은데.

english: Treasure? What treasure? And what do you mean by 'one like me'?
translation: 보물이요? 무슨 보물이요? 그리고 '저 같은 부류'라니 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: 당신이 이 도시의 주민이 아니라는 뜻이오. 당신 같은 재능을 가진 사람이 우리에게 필요하오.

english: I mean you're not one of the inhabitants of this city... although you do smell and look like one. We could use someone of your talents.
translation: 당신이 이 도시의 주민이 아니라는 뜻이오... 냄새도 생김새도 주민 같긴 하지만. 당신 같은 재능을 가진 사람이 우리에게 필요하오.

english: Oh? I can't say I'm not interested. What do you propose?
translation: 오? 관심이 없다고는 못 하겠네요. 뭘 제안하시려는 거죠?

english: This place was built long before the city of Darkmeyer existed, back when this land was known as Hallowvale.
translation: 이곳은 Darkmeyer(다크마이어)라는 도시가 생기기 훨씬 전, 이 땅이 Hallowvale(할로베일)로 불리던 시절에 지어졌소.

english: The Sepulchre was used as a resting place for Hallowvale's loyal followers of Saradomin.
translation: 묘소는 Hallowvale(할로베일)에서 Saradomin(사라도민)을 충실히 따르던 이들의 안식처로 쓰였소.

english: Before they were driven out by the vampyres, the Saradominists used their magic to safeguard this place.
translation: 뱀파이어들에게 쫓겨나기 전, Saradominists(사라도민파)는 마법으로 이곳을 지켜 두었소.

english: Safeguard how?
The dead here were buried with the wealth they had in life. To protect these riches, the Saradominists enchanted the statues within the Sepulchre to create various defences.
translation: 이곳의 망자들은 생전에 지녔던 재물과 함께 묻혔소. 그 재물을 지키기 위해, Saradominists(사라도민파)는 묘소 안의 석상들에 마법을 걸어 여러 방어 장치를 만들었지.

english: Many have tried and failed to obtain the prizes buried here.
translation: 많은 이들이 이곳에 묻힌 보물을 손에 넣으려다 실패했소.

english: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? How should I go about doing it?
translation: 좋아요... 그러니까 저더러 이 보물을 좀 가져다 달라는 거죠? 어떻게 하면 되나요?

english: We don't care for a lot of what is kept here. We are only interested in the old currency of this land.
translation: 이곳에 보관된 것 대부분엔 관심 없소. 우리는 오직 이 땅의 옛 화폐에만 관심이 있소.

english: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of his pocket and shows it to you.
translation: 수수께끼의 이방인이 주머니에서 동전 하나를 꺼내 당신에게 보여 준다.

english: If you find any of these Hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)을 찾으면 내가 기꺼이 넘겨받겠소. 그 대가로 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소) 안에서 도움이 될 도구를 제공할 수 있소.

english: You can keep whatever else you find for yourself.
translation: 그 밖에 찾은 건 전부 가져도 좋소.

english: You should know, only the most agile of adventurers will have success down there. You'll need to use your reflexes to overcome the traps within.
translation: 알아 두시오, 그 아래에서 성공하는 건 가장 날렵한 모험가뿐이오. 안의 함정을 넘으려면 반사 신경을 발휘해야 할 거요.

english: The Sepulchre has five floors in total, each more dangerous than the last. I hope you prove competent enough to make it all the way down.
translation: 묘소는 모두 다섯 층으로 되어 있고, 아래로 갈수록 더 위험하오. 당신이 끝까지 내려갈 만큼 유능하길 바라오.

english: Do you have any information about what kind of traps I can expect?
translation: 어떤 함정이 있는지 아시는 게 있나요?

english: The statues have been enchanted to shoot fire, lightning and arrows. Some also throw swords. There are also tiles that when stepped on, will teleport you somewhere else.
translation: 석상들에는 불, 번개, 화살을 쏘는 마법이 걸려 있소. 검을 던지는 것도 있지. 밟으면 다른 곳으로 순간이동시키는 타일도 있소.

english: Sounds like the perfect challenge for me! Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 저한테 딱 맞는 도전이네요! 그 밖에 알아야 할 게 있나요?

english: Yes... It seems that there is another safeguard which prevents anyone from spending too long within the Sepulchre.
translation: 있소... 누구도 묘소 안에 너무 오래 머물지 못하게 막는 또 다른 보호 장치가 있는 듯하오.

english: You'll only have so much time before the magic within seals both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.
translation: 주어진 시간이 지나면, 안의 마법이 관과 다음 층으로 이어지는 계단을 모두 봉인해 버리오.

english: Hang on a second... If the doors to the next floor close, then how will I escape?
translation: 잠깐만요... 다음 층으로 가는 문이 닫히면, 저는 어떻게 빠져나오죠?

english: The priests who built this place had a teleportation system. The magical obelisks they used can be found at the end of each floor. These obelisks can be used to transport you back here.
translation: 이곳을 지은 사제들에게는 순간이동 체계가 있었소. 그들이 쓰던 마법의 obelisks(오벨리스크)는 각 층 끝에 있소. 이 오벨리스크로 이곳에 돌아올 수 있소.

english: However, we have found that the obelisks only respond to those they perceive to be followers of Saradomin. I'd strongly advise against wearing items of any other god.
translation: 하지만 오벨리스크는 Saradomin(사라도민)의 추종자로 여겨지는 자에게만 반응한다는 걸 알아냈소. 다른 신의 물건은 착용하지 않기를 강력히 권하오.

english: I see, but what if I'm in the middle of a floor and can't make it to an obelisk?
translation: 알겠어요. 그런데 층 한가운데에 있는데 오벨리스크까지 못 가면요?

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre. However, you may also find these of use.
translation: 신중한 모험가로군. 현명하오. 어떤 순간이동 주문이든 써서 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에서 빠져나올 수 있소. 하지만 이것들도 쓸모가 있을 거요.

english: These teleport crystals were enchanted using the magic of the obelisks. They can be used to teleport to this lobby. I can sell you more when you run out.
translation: 이 순간이동 크리스탈은 오벨리스크의 마법으로 힘을 부여한 것이오. 이걸로 이 대기실로 순간이동할 수 있소. 다 떨어지면 더 팔아 주겠소.

english: Thanks! I'll make sure to put them to good use.
Thanks for the information. I'll keep an eye out for some of those Hallowed marks.
translation: 정보 고마워요. Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)이 있는지 잘 살펴볼게요.

english: That would be... appreciated.
Tell me about yourself.
Like you, I am not from here. I represent a group who are very interested in the Hallowed marks found within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 당신처럼 나도 이곳 사람이 아니오. 나는 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소) 안에서 나오는 Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)에 큰 관심을 가진 무리를 대변하고 있소.

english: You know, I helped out a very similar individual to yourself over at the Theatre of Blood. Any connection?
translation: 그런데 말이죠, Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)에서 당신과 아주 비슷한 사람을 도와준 적이 있어요. 무슨 관계라도 있나요?

english: So you're the one who the master spoke of. I am aware of your contributions. Helping us out here will earn yourself further favour with him.
translation: 그렇다면 주인께서 말씀하신 자가 당신이로군. 당신의 공헌은 알고 있소. 이곳에서 우리를 도우면 그분께 더 큰 신임을 얻게 될 거요.

english: How do I know that's something I even want?
translation: 그게 제가 원하기나 하는 건지 어떻게 알아요?

english: That is for you to decide. I have told you all that I have to share.
translation: 그건 당신이 정할 일이오. 내가 말해 줄 수 있는 건 모두 말했소.

english: That is all you need to know.
translation: 당신이 알아야 할 건 그게 전부요.

english: All right then, keep your secrets.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)을 좀 교환하고 싶어요.

english: Of course.
Do you have any of my items?
translation: 제 물건 가지고 계신 거 있나요?

english: I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 없소. 혹시 내가 당신 물건을 갖고 있었더라도, 찾아가기 전에 당신이 죽었다면 이제는 사라졌을 거요.

english: I do have some of your items here. Try not to get hit by the traps next time.
translation: 당신 물건을 몇 개 갖고 있소. 다음엔 함정에 맞지 않도록 조심하시오.

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
Is there any way I could have private access to the Sepulchre? The other adventurers in there keep activating traps and messing up my timing.
translation: 묘소에 저 혼자만 들어갈 방법은 없나요? 안에 있는 다른 모험가들이 자꾸 함정을 작동시켜서 제 타이밍이 다 꼬여요.

english: An interesting problem. But... I suppose I could grant you private access to the Hallowed Sepulchre... for a fee.
translation: 흥미로운 문제로군. 하지만... Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 혼자 들어가게 해 줄 수는 있겠지... 대가를 받고.

english: How much?
200 Hallowed marks.
I don't have that many marks on me...
Then I'm afraid that, for now, you will have to contend with your peers activating traps for you.
translation: 그렇다면 유감이지만, 당분간은 다른 모험가들이 함정을 건드리는 걸 감수해야겠소.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, you will end up in different chambers to your peers.
translation: 좋소. 이제 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 들어가면 다른 모험가들과는 다른 방에 도착하게 될 거요.

english: Speak to me again if you like this effect rescinded.
translation: 이 효과를 취소하고 싶으면 다시 말을 거시오.

english: No thanks.
Very well. I shall be here if you change your mind.
translation: 좋소. 마음이 바뀌면 나는 여기 있겠소.

english: I'd better get going.
I see you're still alive adventurer. Do you have any Hallowed marks for me?
translation: 아직 살아 있군, 모험가. 내게 줄 Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)이 있소?

english: Tell me more about this place.
Is there anything else you need?
Can I go back to looting with other people?
translation: 다른 사람들과 다시 같이 약탈할 수 있을까요?

english: I can remove your private access for now, if you're sure.
translation: 확실하다면, 당분간 개인 입장을 해제해 줄 수 있소.

english: Very well. You should now find that when you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre, your peers will join you.
translation: 좋소. 이제 Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 들어가면 다른 모험가들도 함께하게 될 거요.

english: Speak to me again if you would like this effect restored.
translation: 이 효과를 되돌리고 싶으면 다시 말을 거시오.

english: On second thoughts, I've changed my mind.
Can I go back to looting on my own?
I can restore your private access for you, if you're sure.
translation: 확실하다면, 개인 입장을 다시 허락해 주겠소.

english: Sorry, I need to go.
I do not have anything for you. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 당신에게 줄 건 없소. 혹시 내가 당신 물건을 갖고 있었더라도, 찾아가기 전에 당신이 죽었다면 이제는 사라졌을 거요.

english: I have some of your things. You should come get them before you enter the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 당신 물건을 좀 갖고 있소. Hallowed Sepulchre(신성한 묘소)에 들어가기 전에 찾아가시오.

english: Tell me about yourself.
I'd like to trade in some Hallowed marks.
translation: Hallowed marks(신성한 표식)을 좀 교환하고 싶어요.

english: Do you have any of my items?
translation: 제 물건 가지고 계신 거 있나요?

english: I'd like to access your tool storage.
Ask about private access.
I'd better get going.
Tell me more about this place.
More options...
Previous options...
Sorry, I need to go.
What was I talking about, now?
Weren't you going to tell me about the rumour?
translation: 소문 얘기 해 준다고 하지 않았어?

english: Oh yeah, that was it!
Carry on.
It's about the new family.
That joined our horde?
The very same!
Oh my! Do tell.
I were hangin' out me washin'.
Yes...
And I looked over at-
I'm listening.
Wait, we're being watched!
We are?
Yes, a person over there.
Where?
No! Don't make eye contact.
Oh my!
They're listening to us.
A goblin folk?
Oh no! It's one of those tall people.
translation: 아이고! 그 키 큰 족속 중 하나야.

english: Bizarre creatures for sure.
Makes my skin crawl to see them.
Why?
So tall and neat.
For sure, my dear.
I hope it doesn't come to speak with us.
translation: 우리한테 말 걸러 오지 않았으면 좋겠다.

english: What a horrid thought!
Horrid indeed, my dear.
What should we do?
Let us carry on our conversation.
Let's!
So...
Yes?
Are you in need of some runes?
Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
That is not the kind of information I intend to give to a human.
translation: 그건 인간에게 알려 줄 생각이 없는 정보일세.

english: Why?
Because before the Varlamorians decided to open their lands up to visitors, Cam Torum was the sole supplier of runes to the entire region.
translation: Varlamorians(바를라모어인)이 외부인에게 땅을 개방하기 전에는, Cam Torum(캠 토룸)이 이 지역 전체에 룬을 공급하는 유일한 곳이었기 때문이지.

english: Okay... But that's not the case anymore. With the kingdom open, they can just get their runes from the mainland.
translation: 그렇군요... 하지만 이제는 그렇지 않잖아요. 왕국이 개방됐으니, 그냥 본토에서 룬을 구하면 되잖아요.

english: A fact I'm all too aware of, especially given the impact it is having on my prices.
translation: 나도 너무 잘 알고 있는 사실일세. 특히 내 가격에 미치는 영향을 생각하면 말일세.

english: Nevertheless, there is still a benefit to having a source of runes closer to home, and I do not intend to share any information on that source.
translation: 그렇다 해도, 가까운 곳에 룬 공급처가 있다는 건 여전히 이점이네. 그러니 그 공급처에 관한 정보는 조금도 나눌 생각이 없네.

english: Fair enough.
Now, are you in need of some runes?
You can trust me. I won't tell anyone else.
translation: 저를 믿으셔도 돼요. 다른 사람한텐 아무 말 안 할게요.

english: You display the typical arrogance of a human. I am a Dwarf of Cam Torum. My people have mastered Smithing and Magic in equal measure.
translation: 전형적인 인간의 오만함을 보이는군. 나는 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)의 Dwarf(드워프)일세. 우리 종족은 Smithing(대장일)과 Magic(마법)을 똑같이 통달했지.

english: That little trinket of yours may well work wonders on a lesser mind, but you will find it to be of little use here.
translation: 자네의 그 작은 장신구가 모자란 머리에는 기적을 일으킬지 몰라도, 여기서는 별 쓸모가 없을 걸세.

english: Oh...
No thanks.
Then we have nothing more to discuss.
Yes please.
Where do you get your runes from?
Fair enough.
[Charm] You can trust me. I won't tell anyone else.
translation: [Charm] 저를 믿으셔도 돼요. 다른 사람한텐 아무 말 안 할게요.

english: No thanks.
Good day, how may I help you?
What is this place?
This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 이곳은 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)의 지점입니다. 여러 마을에 지점이 있습니다.

english: And what do you do?
We will look after your items and money for you. Leave your valuables with us if you want to keep them safe.
translation: 고객님의 물건과 돈을 저희가 맡아 드립니다. 귀중품을 안전하게 보관하고 싶으시면 저희에게 맡겨 주십시오.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
What is this place?
Psst... wanna buy some weapons?
What have you got?
Well, first up there's the normal bone club and bone spear. Good, solid frog-bone, and the spear has an iron tip. Can withstand a lot of punishment, if you know what I mean!
translation: 음, 우선 평범한 bone club(뼈 곤봉)이랑 bone spear(뼈 창)이 있지. 튼튼한 개구리 뼈로 만들었고, 창에는 쇠 촉이 달렸어. 웬만큼 험하게 써도 끄떡없다고, 무슨 말인지 알지?

english: But if you're after something a bit fancier, a bit more sophisticated, there's the bone crossbow and dagger.
translation: 근데 좀 더 고급스럽고 세련된 걸 찾는다면, bone crossbow(뼈 석궁)이랑 단검도 있어.

english: These are specially good for getting your prey unawares, but you're not going to get the best out of them unless you've been taught the special technique.
translation: 이건 방심한 사냥감을 노리기에 특히 좋은데, 특별한 기술을 배우지 않으면 제 성능을 다 끌어내진 못할 거야.

english: So, you interested?
I might be.
What is this special technique?
Special aiming technique. If you hit an enemy with it their defence will get weaker so you can hit them again!
translation: 특별한 조준 기술이지. 그걸로 적을 맞히면 적의 방어력이 약해져서 다시 때리기 쉬워져!

english: Plus, if you use this technique on an enemy who isn't expecting it, you'll always hit them! Pretty good, eh?
translation: 게다가 방심한 적한테 이 기술을 쓰면 무조건 맞힌다고! 꽤 괜찮지, 응?

english: 'Course, there's only a few people who know it, so unless you can get someone to show you you won't be able to do it.
translation: 물론, 아는 사람이 몇 안 되니까 누가 보여 주지 않으면 못 쓸 거야.

english: Zanik showed me how to do it!
Good for you! So, are you interested?
No thanks.
Yeah, you stay out of trouble.
Why are you whispering?
Well, y'know, it's not the most reputable profession, is it? Selling weapons?
translation: 뭐, 그게, 그다지 떳떳한 직업은 아니잖아? 무기 장사 말이야.

english: Why not?
Well, they're used to hurt people, aren't they? That's not considered very, y'know, respectable. Even though the guards use them, and the hunters, they're still considered a bit, y'know, dirty.
translation: 뭐, 사람 다치게 하는 데 쓰는 물건이잖아? 그게, 그다지 점잖다고 여겨지진 않거든. 경비병들도 쓰고 사냥꾼들도 쓰지만, 그래도 좀, 그게, 지저분한 일로 여겨져.

english: Isn't it like that where you come from?
No, on the surface weapon-making is considered a noble profession.
translation: 아뇨, 지상에서는 무기 제작이 고귀한 직업으로 여겨져요.

english: I don't know, you surface people are strange!
What have you got?
I might be.
No thanks.
What is this special technique?
Why are you whispering?
That's a funny name you've got.
'Narf'? You think that's funny? At least I don't call myself [player name]! Where did you get a name like that?
translation: 'Narf(나프)'? 그게 웃겨? 적어도 난 [player name] 같은 이름은 안 쓰거든! 그런 이름은 대체 어디서 얻었어?

english: It seemed like a good idea at the time!
Bah!
Nice one! I have new information to share with you.
translation: 잘했어! 알려 줄 새 정보가 있어.

english: Yes?
What are you doing out here?
Sometimes I like to take a walk out to these shores and look for losers to laugh at.
translation: 가끔 이 해안까지 산책 나와서 비웃어 줄 패배자를 찾곤 하지.

english: And look, I found one!
Hahahah!
Charming.
Do you have a quest for me?
Why, yes! I do have a quest for you! I've hidden some goodies around Varlamore! Haha!
translation: 오, 그럼! 너한테 줄 퀘스트가 있지! Varlamore(바를라모어) 곳곳에 좋은 걸 좀 숨겨 놨거든! 하하!

english: Bring them all to me and I'll give you a nasty little surprise!
translation: 전부 가져오면 고약한 깜짝 선물을 줄게!

english: A treasure hunt? That's exciting! Any tips to get me started?
translation: 보물찾기요? 신나네요! 시작하는 데 도움이 될 팁 있나요?

english: No.
Oh... I guess I'll be on my way then.
translation: 아... 그럼 전 이만 가 볼게요.

english: I've found some strange tokens.
Oh, really? Show me.
You utter fool! You have failed to acquire all the tokens I desire! Now scuttle away from here, loser!
translation: 이 한심한 멍청이! 내가 원하는 토큰을 다 모으지 못했잖아! 이제 썩 꺼져, 패배자야!

english: You're not a very nice man...
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Yes, yes... This does appear to be all of them!
translation: 그래, 그래... 이거면 다 모은 것 같네!

english: Would you like to trade them for a nasty little suprise? I bet you would, wouldn't you?!
translation: 이걸 고약한 깜짝 선물로 바꿀래? 당연히 그러고 싶겠지, 안 그래?!

english: Sure, why not?
No, actually.
Oh...
What? I don't want that.
What are you doing out here?
Do you have a quest for me?
I've found some strange tokens.
Nothing. I'll be going now.
Sure, why not?
No, actually.
Hey there. Have you seen Frank?
Frank?
Yes, Frank. He's my pet bloodveld. He runs off a lot so I was wondering if you'd seen him.
translation: 응, Frank(프랭크). 내 애완 bloodveld(블러드벨드)야. 자꾸 도망가서 혹시 봤나 해서.

english: Frank doesn't seem like a very fitting name for a bloodveld.
translation: Frank(프랭크)는 bloodveld(블러드벨드)한테 별로 어울리는 이름 같지 않네요.

english: Oh, he was named after my last pet. That one wasn't a bloodveld though, that one was a human.
translation: 아, 내 지난번 애완동물 이름을 따서 지은 거야. 걔는 bloodveld(블러드벨드)가 아니라 인간이었지만.

english: You had a pet human?
Yes! A pet human called Frank.
Frank was great. He died though. Mother said it was my fault, that I didn't feed him properly. I'm not allowed pet humans now.
translation: Frank(프랭크)는 최고였어. 근데 죽었어. 엄마가 내 탓이래, 밥을 제대로 안 줘서 그렇대. 이제 애완 인간은 못 키우게 됐어.

english: It's okay though. Now I have Frank the bloodveld. He's great. I don't need to feed him. He feeds himself.
translation: 그래도 괜찮아. 이제 bloodveld(블러드벨드) Frank(프랭크)가 있으니까. 걔는 최고야. 밥 안 줘도 돼. 알아서 먹거든.

english: What a nice happy ending.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Hello there.
Hello! You must be the adventurer that helped us get out of Menaphos. Thank you.
translation: 안녕하세요! Menaphos(메나포스)에서 저희가 빠져나오게 도와준 모험가시군요. 고마워요.

english: Don't mention it.
What do you have for sale?
Take a look.
What were things like in Menaphos?
Not great. I'd just gone over there to purchase some goods from the market. When I got back to the gates, they'd been sealed shut.
translation: 별로였어요. 시장에서 물건을 좀 사려고 건너갔었거든요. 그런데 성문으로 돌아와 보니 꽉 닫혀 봉쇄돼 있더라고요.

english: So the guards wouldn't let you back?
translation: 그럼 경비병들이 돌아가게 해 주지 않았던 거예요?

english: They were still allowing citizens from Sophanem to return at that point, but I foolishly chose to stay. I was scared of catching the pox.
translation: 그때는 아직 Sophanem(소파넴) 시민들은 돌아갈 수 있었는데, 제가 어리석게도 남기로 했어요. 역병에 걸릴까 봐 무서웠거든요.

english: By the time I'd changed my mind, they'd stopped letting anyone through. Thankfully, I had some friends there with a spare bed.
translation: 마음을 바꿨을 땐 이미 아무도 통과시켜 주지 않았어요. 다행히 그곳에 남는 침대가 있는 친구들이 있었죠.

english: I guess not everyone was as lucky?
No. Many didn't have anywhere to go. Violence broke out in some parts of the city.
translation: 네. 갈 곳이 없는 사람이 많았어요. 도시 곳곳에서 폭력 사태가 벌어졌죠.

english: They quickly put a stop to it in the Imperial and Merchant quarters, but there was still some unrest in the Workers district when I was finally able to leave.
translation: Imperial(황실) 구역과 Merchant(상인) 구역에서는 금방 진압됐지만, 제가 마침내 떠날 수 있었을 때도 Workers district(노동자 구역)에는 아직 소요가 좀 남아 있었어요.

english: I'm sorry you had go through all of that. Menaphos definitely took a hard stance on the plagues.
translation: 그런 일을 다 겪으셨다니 안타까워요. Menaphos(메나포스)는 역병에 정말 강경하게 대응했네요.

english: They were brutal. They even shut off the port from the rest of the city over fears of the plague getting in that way. Many of their own citizens are still trapped there.
translation: 잔혹했어요. 역병이 그쪽으로 들어올까 봐 항구까지 도시의 나머지 지역과 차단해 버렸죠. 자기네 시민들도 아직 많이 그곳에 갇혀 있어요.

english: Anyway, let's not talk any more of this. Is there anything else I can do for you.
translation: 아무튼, 이 얘기는 그만해요. 제가 더 도와드릴 일이 있을까요?

english: I'd better get going.
Until next time.
Hello again! It's so nice to be out of Menaphos. Once again, thank you.
translation: 또 오셨네요! Menaphos(메나포스)에서 나오니 정말 좋아요. 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: What do you have for sale?
What were things like in Menaphos?
I'd better get going.
Hello.
I've lost my notes... Dufft, have you seen my notes?
translation: 메모를 잃어버렸어요... Dufft(더프트), 제 메모 못 봤어요?

english: My wife will kill me if I don't take her back a souvenir.
translation: 기념품을 안 사 가면 아내가 날 가만두지 않을 거예요.

english: I've had such a terrible headache since we arrived on this mountain.
translation: 이 산에 도착한 뒤로 두통이 너무 심해요.

english: Thank Saradomin for that mountain guide. We couldn't have made it here without him!
translation: 그 mountain guide(산악 안내원)을 보내 주신 Saradomin(사라도민)께 감사를! 그분이 없었으면 여기까지 못 왔을 거예요!

english: I can't find my rock pick!
Hello there and welcome to the Natural History exhibit of the Varrock Museum!
translation: 안녕하세요, Varrock Museum(바록 박물관)의 Natural History exhibit(자연사 전시관)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: Hello. So what is it you do here?
translation: 안녕하세요. 그런데 여기서는 무슨 일을 하세요?

english: Well, we look after all of the research in this section.
translation: 음, 이 구역의 모든 연구를 맡고 있어요.

english: When I'm not doing that, I'm teaching people like yourself about how wonderful the natural world is.
translation: 그 일을 안 할 때는 당신 같은 분들께 자연 세계가 얼마나 멋진지 가르쳐 드리고 있고요.

english: Nice. So then, I've got a few questions for you.
translation: 멋지네요. 그럼 몇 가지 여쭤볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, fire away and I'll give you an insight into the exciting world of animals.
translation: 자, 얼마든지 물어보세요. 흥미진진한 동물의 세계를 엿보게 해 드릴게요.

english: Hello again, [sir/madam], how can I help you on this fine day?
translation: 다시 오셨군요, [sir/madam]. 이 좋은 날에 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: I was hoping you could tell me about something.
translation: 뭔가에 대해 설명을 좀 들을 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Tell me about lizards.
Ahh lizards, the scaly carnivores.
If you just follow me to the display case I shall explain all about them.
translation: 진열장까지 따라오시면 도마뱀에 대해 전부 설명해 드릴게요.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the lizard display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 남학생이 있는 도마뱀 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Contrary to popular belief, even though most lizards have a yellow belly, they are not in fact cowardly. Most Gielinor lizards will not shy away from a good fight and can be very tough.
translation: 흔히들 오해하는데, 도마뱀은 대부분 배가 노래서 '겁쟁이 노랑배'라는 소리를 듣지만 사실 겁쟁이가 아니에요. Gielinor(길리노르)의 도마뱀은 대개 싸움을 피하지 않고, 아주 강인하기도 하죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a lizard...
This is due to a very thick and tough hide, made from thousands of thick scales. Most people who claim to be hunters have a very hard time trying to dispatch lizards.
translation: 이건 수천 개의 두꺼운 비늘로 이루어진 아주 두껍고 질긴 가죽 덕분이에요. 사냥꾼을 자처하는 사람들도 대부분 도마뱀을 처치하느라 무척 애를 먹죠.

english: In fact, the only people to successfully discern how to kill these tough little squamatas are the five legendary Slayer masters, although we assume they must have some kind of natural predator.
translation: 사실 이 질긴 꼬마 유린목 동물을 처치하는 법을 제대로 알아낸 건 전설적인 다섯 Slayer masters(슬레이어 마스터)뿐이에요. 물론 어떤 천적이 있긴 할 거라고 짐작하고 있지만요.

english: Interestingly enough, these scales are made from the same substance that your hair is comprised of. This substance is called keratin.
translation: 흥미롭게도 이 비늘은 당신 머리카락과 같은 물질로 이루어져 있어요. 이 물질을 케라틴이라고 하죠.

english: Lizards have a very well developed sense of vision and hearing. Some people think that some lizards have a third eye!
translation: 도마뱀은 시각과 청각이 아주 잘 발달했어요. 어떤 사람들은 일부 도마뱀에게 세 번째 눈이 있다고 생각하죠!

english: A tiny, light-sensitive, transparent structure on top of the head that helps them regulate how long they stay in the sun.
translation: 머리 위에 있는 작고 투명한, 빛에 민감한 기관인데, 햇볕을 얼마나 오래 쬘지 조절하도록 도와줘요.

english: This is vital for the cold-blooded lizards who have no means to regulate their internal temperature.
translation: 체온을 스스로 조절할 방법이 없는 냉혈동물인 도마뱀에게는 꼭 필요한 기관이에요.

english: Like many cold-blooded creatures, if they are subjected to a sudden decrease in temperature, they will become sluggish and sleepy.
translation: 다른 많은 냉혈동물처럼 도마뱀도 기온이 갑자기 떨어지면 굼뜨고 졸려해요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on lizards. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 도마뱀에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: End cutscene
Tell me about the tortoises.
Ahh tortoises, the armoured ancients.
translation: 아, 거북이라. 갑옷을 두른 고대의 존재죠.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the tortoise display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 거북 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The tortoise is a very well defended beast. It uses an armoured shell just like its aquatic cousins the terrapin and the turtle.
translation: 거북은 방어가 아주 튼튼한 동물이에요. 물에 사는 사촌인 테라핀이나 바다거북처럼 갑옷 같은 등딱지를 쓰죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a tortoise...
Tortoises can vary in size from about as long as your hand to as big as a unicorn. Most land tortoises eat nothing but plants in the wild.
translation: 거북은 손바닥만 한 크기부터 unicorn(유니콘)만 한 크기까지 다양해요. 육지 거북은 대부분 야생에서 식물만 먹고 살아요.

english: Did you know you can tell how old a tortoise is by the number of rings in its shell, just like a tree.
translation: 나무처럼 거북도 등딱지에 있는 나이테 수로 나이를 알 수 있다는 거 아셨어요?

english: Most land-based tortoises eat plants, feeding on grazing grasses, weeds, leafy greens, flowers, and cabbages.
translation: 육지에 사는 거북은 대부분 식물을 먹어요. 풀, 잡초, 잎채소, 꽃, 양배추 같은 걸 뜯어 먹죠.

english: Tortoises generally live as long as people, and some individual ones are known to have lived longer than 300 years.
translation: 거북은 대체로 사람만큼 오래 살고, 300년 넘게 산 개체도 있다고 알려져 있어요.

english: Because of this, they symbolise longevity within some cultures, such as gnomes who also breed them for battle.
translation: 그래서 어떤 문화권에서는 장수를 상징하는데, gnomes(노움)도 그렇죠. 노움은 전투용으로 거북을 기르기도 해요.

english: The oldest tortoise ever recorded was Mibbiwocket, who was presented to the King Healthorg the Great, by the famous explorer Admiral Bake, shortly after its birth.
translation: 기록상 가장 오래 산 거북은 Mibbiwocket(미비워킷)인데, 태어나자마자 유명한 탐험가 Admiral Bake(베이크 제독)이 King Healthorg the Great(위대한 헬소르그 왕)께 바쳤어요.

english: Mibbiwocket is still in the care of the gnomish royal family.
translation: Mibbiwocket(미비워킷)은 지금도 노움 왕실의 보살핌을 받고 있어요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on tortoises. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 거북에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about dragons.
Ahh dragons, the mighty hunters of the sky.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the dragon display case with a teacher and pupil.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생이 있는 드래곤 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The dragons of Gielinor are a most confusing species. Standing at approximately twelve feet tall, these imposing predators strike fear into the hearts and minds of most sane folk.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)의 드래곤은 참으로 알쏭달쏭한 종이에요. 키가 약 12피트에 달하는 이 위압적인 포식자는 제정신인 사람 대부분의 마음속에 공포를 심어 주죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a dragon...
However, if you delve a little deeper into their history and lifestyle, a few things stick out as very unusual.
translation: 하지만 드래곤의 역사와 생활 방식을 조금 더 깊이 파고들면 아주 특이한 점이 몇 가지 눈에 띄어요.

english: With most species there is a line, an ancestry if you will, whereby you can track how a creature has come to be in its present form.
translation: 대부분의 종에는 계통, 말하자면 혈통이 있어서 그 생물이 어떻게 지금의 모습이 되었는지 추적할 수 있어요.

english: For instance, you can trace the ancestry of the common house cat back to the same creature that became the sabre-toothed kyatt.
translation: 예를 들어 흔한 집고양이의 혈통을 거슬러 올라가면 sabre-toothed kyatt(검치 카이엇)이 된 것과 같은 생물에 닿게 되죠.

english: However, with the dragon, no such root ancestor can be found.
translation: 하지만 드래곤은 그런 뿌리가 되는 조상을 찾을 수가 없어요.

english: There are many forms of dragon, such as the common coloured and the metallic, or ferrous, dragon.
translation: 드래곤에는 여러 형태가 있는데, 흔한 유색 드래곤과 금속성, 즉 철질 드래곤 등이 있어요.

english: They colonise many areas of Gielinor, though most notably, sites of ancient battles and small dank caves.
translation: 드래곤은 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 자리 잡고 사는데, 특히 고대 전쟁터와 작고 눅눅한 동굴에 많아요.

english: Eating habits tend to vary, with the majority of their food being meat. However, it has also been noted that they can consume metals just as easily, with runite being thought of as a delicacy.
translation: 식성은 제각각이지만 먹이의 대부분은 고기예요. 하지만 금속도 그만큼 쉽게 먹어 치울 수 있다는 기록이 있고, runite(루나이트)는 별미로 여겨지죠.

english: Throughout history, dragons have appeared in myth and legend as fearsome adversaries and cunning creatures.
translation: 역사적으로 드래곤은 신화와 전설 속에서 무시무시한 적이자 교활한 생물로 등장해 왔어요.

english: However, modern evidence does not support this. Most young dragons are largely creatures of instinct with a strong vicious streak.
translation: 하지만 현대의 증거는 이를 뒷받침하지 않아요. 어린 드래곤은 대부분 본능대로 움직이는 생물이고, 포악한 기질이 강하죠.

english: The lifespan of the common dragon is as yet unknown, as no dragon has ever been observed dying of old age.
translation: 흔한 드래곤의 수명은 아직 알려지지 않았어요. 늙어서 죽는 드래곤이 관찰된 적이 한 번도 없거든요.

english: Although, it has been mooted that spontaneous combustion could be considered a natural cause of death for this species.
translation: 다만 이 종에게는 자연 발화를 자연사의 한 원인으로 볼 수도 있다는 의견이 나온 적은 있어요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on dragons. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 드래곤에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about the wyverns.
Ahh, wyverns. The extinct lizards.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the wyvern display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 wyvern(와이번) 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The wyverns' tale is a sad one. This now extinct species is presumed in some way to be related to the dragon.
translation: wyverns(와이번)의 이야기는 슬퍼요. 지금은 멸종한 이 종은 어떤 식으로든 드래곤과 관련이 있다고 추정돼요.

english: The natural historian poses as a wyvern...
In that they are both large flying reptiles. The wyvern stands much shorter than the adult dragon and only has two legs as opposed to the dragon's four.
translation: 둘 다 하늘을 나는 커다란 파충류라는 점에서요. wyvern(와이번)은 다 자란 드래곤보다 키가 훨씬 작고, 다리가 넷인 드래곤과 달리 다리가 둘뿐이에요.

english: Much of the evidence for wyvern behaviour comes from the reconstruction of old bones in the icy mountains of Asgarnia.
translation: wyvern(와이번)의 행동에 관한 증거는 대부분 Asgarnia(아스가르니아)의 얼음 산맥에서 오래된 뼈를 복원해 얻은 거예요.

english: One is that Asgarnia was at one time a much more temperate climate than it is now. The other is that wyverns could generate fire internally in much the same way as dragons.
translation: 하나는 Asgarnia(아스가르니아)가 한때 지금보다 훨씬 온화한 기후였다는 거예요. 다른 하나는 wyverns(와이번)이 드래곤과 거의 같은 방식으로 몸속에서 불을 만들어 낼 수 있었다는 거고요.

english: If they follow the dragon paradigm, then they would have been carnivores, feeding on cows, sheep and other livestock animals.
translation: 드래곤의 패턴을 따른다면 육식동물이었을 테고, 소나 양 같은 가축을 잡아먹었겠죠.

english: How and why the wyverns became extinct is something of a mystery. Though if you consider the theory that the climate of Asgarnia changed suddenly, then this could provide an explanation.
translation: wyverns(와이번)이 어떻게, 왜 멸종했는지는 다소 수수께끼예요. 하지만 Asgarnia(아스가르니아)의 기후가 갑자기 변했다는 이론을 생각해 보면 그걸로 설명이 될지도 몰라요.

english: There are some inconsistencies in the findings we have for the wyverns, such as the odd wear patterns of some of bones, which really could only have happened after the creature died.
translation: wyverns(와이번)에 대한 발견에는 앞뒤가 맞지 않는 점이 몇 가지 있어요. 예를 들어 일부 뼈에 남은 이상한 마모 흔적은 그 생물이 죽은 뒤에야 생길 수 있는 것이었죠.

english: Also the bones we have collected remain a little below room temperature wherever they are kept.
translation: 또 우리가 수집한 뼈는 어디에 보관하든 실온보다 조금 낮은 온도를 유지해요.

english: They have also been shown to radiate a very weak magical aura.
translation: 아주 약한 마법 기운을 내뿜는다는 사실도 밝혀졌고요.

english: I'm sure that in due time, these mysteries will be solved.
translation: 때가 되면 이 수수께끼들도 분명 풀릴 거예요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on wyverns. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 wyverns(와이번)에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: That's enough education for one day.
Nonsense! There's always room for more.
translation: 무슨 말씀을! 배움에는 끝이 없는 법이에요.

english: And remember, science isn't dull!
Tell me about snails.
Ahh snails, the gelatinous gastropods.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snail display case with a schoolboy and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 남학생과 여학생이 있는 달팽이 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Snails move like worms by squishing up and stretching out, very, very slowly. They also make a lot of slime, in order to aid moving by reducing friction.
translation: 달팽이는 지렁이처럼 몸을 오므렸다 늘였다 하면서 아주아주 느리게 움직여요. 또 마찰을 줄여 움직이기 쉽도록 점액을 많이 만들어 내죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a snail...
They also use slime for protection. For instance, snails can use their slime to crawl over razor-blades without being hurt. It also helps keep away dangerous insects like ants.
translation: 달팽이는 몸을 지키는 데도 점액을 써요. 예를 들어 점액 덕분에 면도날 위를 기어가도 다치지 않죠. 개미 같은 위험한 곤충을 쫓아내는 데도 도움이 돼요.

english: When they hide in their shells, snails secrete a special type of slime, which dries to cover the entrance of their shells like a 'trapdoor'. This is called an operculum.
translation: 껍데기 속에 숨을 때 달팽이는 특별한 점액을 분비하는데, 이게 말라서 '뚜껑 문'처럼 껍데기 입구를 막아요. 이걸 덮개(오퍼큘럼)라고 해요.

english: The snails of Morytania are the most malignant molluscs ever to have been studied.
translation: Morytania(모리타니아)의 달팽이는 지금까지 연구된 연체동물 중 가장 악랄해요.

english: They are broken down into two distinct species: achatina acidia and achatina acidia giganteus or, as they are more commonly known, the acid-spitting snail and the giant acid-spitting snail.
translation: 뚜렷이 다른 두 종으로 나뉘는데, 아카티나 아키디아와 아카티나 아키디아 기간테우스, 흔히 부르는 이름으로는 산성 침 달팽이와 거대 산성 침 달팽이예요.

english: Both of these varieties are voracious carnivores, using their mutated mouthpieces to spit a glob of powerful acid to kill their foe.
translation: 두 종 모두 탐욕스러운 육식동물로, 변이된 입을 이용해 강력한 산성 덩어리를 뱉어 적을 죽여요.

english: They then simply have to wait, whilst the digestive juices make short work of the poor creature. Then, they simply slurp up what remains.
translation: 그다음엔 소화액이 불쌍한 생물을 순식간에 녹여 버릴 때까지 그냥 기다리기만 하면 돼요. 그러고는 남은 걸 후루룩 빨아들이죠.

english: How these strange creatures came to be is still something of a mystery. The most prevalent theory suggests that they mutated, as a reaction to an 'as yet unknown' pollutant that has appeared in the swamps.
translation: 이 기이한 생물이 어떻게 생겨났는지는 아직도 다소 수수께끼예요. 가장 널리 퍼진 이론은 늪에 나타난 '아직 알려지지 않은' 오염 물질에 반응해 변이했다는 거예요.

english: The local populace has capitalised on the appearance of these strange species, using their shells to fashion a rudimentary helm that is fairly resistant to the snails acid.
translation: 지역 주민들은 이 기이한 종의 출현을 잘 활용해 왔어요. 그 껍데기로 달팽이의 산에 꽤 잘 견디는 투박한 투구를 만들어 쓰죠.

english: Other known uses of snail by-products include a tasty local delicacy and a fireproof oil.
translation: 그 밖에 알려진 달팽이 부산물의 용도로는 맛있는 지역 별미와 불에 타지 않는 기름이 있어요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snails. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 달팽이에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about monkeys.
Ahh monkeys, the simian collective.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the monkey display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolboy.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 남학생이 있는 원숭이 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: A monkey is a member of either of two known groupings of simian primates. These two known groupings are the Karamja monkeys and the 'harmless' monkeys.
translation: 원숭이는 알려진 영장류 두 무리 중 하나에 속하는 동물이에요. 그 두 무리는 Karamja(카람자) 원숭이와 '하믈레스(무해한)' 원숭이죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a monkey...
Because of their similarity to monkeys, apes such as chimpanzees and gibbons are often called monkeys by accident.
translation: 원숭이와 닮았기 때문에 침팬지나 긴팔원숭이 같은 유인원도 실수로 원숭이라고 불리는 경우가 많아요.

english: Though some natural historians don't consider them to be monkeys. Also, a few monkey species have the word 'ape' in their common name.
translation: 물론 일부 자연사학자들은 이들을 원숭이로 보지 않아요. 또 몇몇 원숭이 종은 통칭에 '유인원'이라는 말이 들어가기도 하고요.

english: The Karamja monkeys are rumoured to be fairly cunning and intelligent creatures, although rumours that they have learned human speech is anecdotal at best.
translation: Karamja(카람자) 원숭이는 꽤 교활하고 영리한 생물이라는 소문이 있지만, 사람 말을 배웠다는 소문은 기껏해야 뜬소문 수준이에요.

english: In appearance, they stand much shorter than a human and tend to move in a hunched fashion. Karamja monkeys also sport a red mohawk, though it is unknown whether this is an affectation or not.
translation: 겉모습은 사람보다 키가 훨씬 작고 구부정하게 움직이는 편이에요. Karamja(카람자) 원숭이는 빨간 모히칸 머리도 하고 있는데, 일부러 멋을 낸 건지는 알려지지 않았어요.

english: They are very fond of bananas and bitternuts, eating them in huge quantities whenever they can get their paws on them.
translation: 바나나와 비터넛을 아주 좋아해서 손에 넣을 수만 있으면 엄청나게 먹어 치워요.

english: The harmless monkeys of Mos Le'Harmless are a very similar, but in some ways entirely different, breed. They stand roughly the same size but are a lighter colour.
translation: Mos Le'Harmless(모스 르하믈레스)의 하믈레스 원숭이는 아주 비슷하면서도 어떤 면에서는 완전히 다른 품종이에요. 크기는 거의 같지만 털 색이 더 밝아요.

english: Interestingly, Karamaja monkeys have a deep dislike of seaweed, though this may stem from the actions of a number of irresponsible people.
translation: 흥미롭게도 Karamaja(카람자) 원숭이는 해초를 몹시 싫어하는데, 이건 몇몇 무책임한 사람들의 행동 때문일 수도 있어요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on monkeys. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 원숭이에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about the sea slugs.
translation: sea slugs(바다 민달팽이)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Ahh sea slugs, the cute crustaceans.
translation: 아, sea slugs(바다 민달팽이)라. 귀여운 갑각류죠.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the sea slug display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 sea slug(바다 민달팽이) 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The term 'sea slug' is something of a misnomer. Whilst these small creatures have a soft body like that of a slug, they also possess a very hard shell like a snail.
translation: 'sea slug(바다 민달팽이)'라는 이름은 다소 잘못 붙은 이름이에요. 이 작은 생물은 민달팽이처럼 몸이 말랑하지만, 달팽이처럼 아주 단단한 껍데기도 갖고 있거든요.

english: The natural historian poses as a sea slug...
translation: 자연사학자가 sea slug(바다 민달팽이) 흉내를 낸다...

english: Very little is actually known about the sea slug, as we have, as yet, been unable to procure a sample for observation and study.
translation: sea slug(바다 민달팽이)에 대해서는 실제로 알려진 게 거의 없어요. 관찰하고 연구할 표본을 아직 구하지 못했거든요.

english: For some reason all expeditions we have sent have either vanished mysteriously, or those on the expedition have sent letters back announcing their desire to leave the Museum and go on to other things.
translation: 어째선지 우리가 보낸 탐사대는 모두 감쪽같이 사라지거나, 대원들이 박물관을 그만두고 다른 일을 하고 싶다는 편지를 보내왔어요.

english: It is presumed that the species is native to the very deep waters around the eastern Ardougne coastline.
translation: 이 종은 동부 Ardougne(아르둔) 해안 주변의 아주 깊은 바다에서 자생하는 것으로 추정돼요.

english: There must be some natural resource in the area that the sea slugs are using, as the underwater habitat there is much the same around many coastal areas on Gielinor.
translation: 그 지역에는 sea slugs(바다 민달팽이)가 이용하는 어떤 천연자원이 있는 게 틀림없어요. 그곳의 수중 서식지는 Gielinor(길리노르)의 여러 해안 지역과 거의 다를 게 없거든요.

english: Through looking at similar species we have determined that the sea slug is a harmless little creature. It spends much of its life grazing on seaweed and other plant life.
translation: 비슷한 종들을 살펴본 결과, sea slug(바다 민달팽이)는 해롭지 않은 작은 생물이라는 결론을 내렸어요. 일생의 대부분을 해초와 다른 식물을 뜯어 먹으며 보내죠.

english: There are reports that these reclusive animals have two large fangs at their front, though this is assumed to be either for decorative or defensive purposes.
translation: 이 은둔형 동물의 앞쪽에 커다란 송곳니가 두 개 있다는 보고가 있지만, 장식용이거나 방어용일 거라고 추정하고 있어요.

english: If they do follow the same pattern as other similar creatures, the shell will be nigh on impervious to most attacks. The exposed soft skin may have a number of nematocysts, or stinging organs, similar to jellyfish.
translation: 다른 비슷한 생물과 같은 패턴을 따른다면 껍데기는 대부분의 공격에 거의 끄떡없을 거예요. 드러난 부드러운 피부에는 해파리처럼 자포, 즉 쏘는 기관이 여러 개 있을지도 몰라요.

english: It is typical of prey animals such as these to develop some kind of unique defence mechanism that allows them to survive.
translation: 이런 피식 동물은 살아남기 위해 어떤 독특한 방어 기제를 발달시키는 게 일반적이에요.

english: If only we could acquire one for study. I'm sure we would find this mechanism to be truly unique.
translation: 한 마리만 구해서 연구할 수 있다면 좋을 텐데요. 분명 정말 독특한 기제를 발견할 수 있을 거예요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on sea slugs. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 sea slugs(바다 민달팽이)에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about snakes.
Ahh snakes, the slithering squamata.
translation: 아, 뱀이라. 스르륵 기어 다니는 유린목이죠.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the snake display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 뱀 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Serpentes, or ophidia, is the suborder under squamata that snakes belong to, like a big family.
translation: 세르펜테스, 또는 오피디아는 뱀이 속한 유린목 아래의 아목이에요. 말하자면 큰 가족 같은 거죠.

english: The natural historian poses as a snake...
Unlike lizards, snakes have no limbs whatsoever; not that this limits them. Snakes live in or near every habitat in the world.
translation: 도마뱀과 달리 뱀에게는 팔다리가 전혀 없어요. 그렇다고 제약이 되는 건 아니지만요. 뱀은 세상의 모든 서식지나 그 근처에 살아요.

english: Found in nice tropical forests, temperate lattitudes and even in the ocean - some have adapted specialised stomach juices that they inject into their prey as venom, while others prefer to grab and crush their food.
translation: 쾌적한 열대 우림, 온대 지역, 심지어 바다에서도 발견되는데, 어떤 뱀은 특수한 소화액을 독으로 먹이에게 주입하도록 적응했고, 또 어떤 뱀은 먹이를 붙잡아 조여 죽이는 쪽을 좋아해요.

english: While others still are fast hunters who use speed and strength to overcome their prey.
translation: 또 어떤 뱀은 속도와 힘으로 먹이를 제압하는 빠른 사냥꾼이에요.

english: The sense of smell in snakes has been enhanced in an amazing way. With most animals, like you and me, tiny particles are filtered through the nose.
translation: 뱀의 후각은 놀라운 방식으로 발달했어요. 당신이나 저 같은 대부분의 동물은 작은 입자가 코를 통해 걸러지죠.

english: However, instead of using just their nose, these animals use their tongues as well. When a lizard or a snake wants to smell it's surroundings, it will wave its tongue around and pick up the particles in the air.
translation: 하지만 이 동물들은 코만 쓰는 게 아니라 혀도 써요. 도마뱀이나 뱀이 주변 냄새를 맡고 싶을 때는 혀를 날름거려 공기 중의 입자를 모아요.

english: The tongue then returns to the mouth and the tips of the tongue are pushed up against two tiny pits in the roof of the snake's mouth.
translation: 그다음 혀가 입으로 돌아가면 혀끝을 뱀의 입천장에 있는 작은 구멍 두 개에 갖다 대요.

english: Since these pits are split apart from each other, the tongue itself also has to split. This is why snakes have forked tongues.
translation: 이 구멍들이 서로 떨어져 있어서 혀도 갈라져야 해요. 그래서 뱀의 혀가 두 갈래인 거죠.

english: So the next time you see a snake sticking it's tongue out at you, remember, it's sniffing the air, not trying to bite you.
translation: 그러니 다음에 뱀이 당신에게 혀를 날름거리면 기억하세요. 물려는 게 아니라 공기 냄새를 맡는 거예요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on snakes. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 뱀에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about natural history.
Well, the field of natural history covers a wide range of sciences.
translation: 음, 자연사라는 분야는 아주 다양한 과학을 아울러요.

english: So we use biology, the study of living things, botany, the study of plants and zoology, the study of animals.
translation: 그래서 생물을 연구하는 생물학, 식물을 연구하는 식물학, 동물을 연구하는 동물학을 활용하죠.

english: Though the field is growing all the time and we're also using techniques from magic, astrology and numerology.
translation: 게다가 이 분야는 계속 넓어지고 있어서 마법, 점성술, 수비학의 기법도 쓰고 있어요.

english: A person interested in natural history is known as a naturalist.
translation: 자연사에 관심 있는 사람을 박물학자라고 해요.

english: Tell me about the terrorbirds.
Ahh terrorbirds, the fastest bird on two legs.
translation: 아, terrorbirds(테러버드)라. 두 다리로 달리는 새 중 가장 빠른 새죠.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the terrorbird display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 terrorbird(테러버드) 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Terrorbirds live in nomadic groups of between five and fifty birds that often travel together with other grazing animals.
translation: terrorbirds(테러버드)는 다섯에서 쉰 마리씩 무리 지어 떠돌아다니며, 풀을 뜯는 다른 동물들과 함께 이동할 때가 많아요.

english: The natural historian poses as a terrorbird...
They mainly feed on seeds and other plants. They also eat insects such as locusts if they can catch them.
translation: 주로 씨앗과 다른 식물을 먹어요. 메뚜기 같은 곤충도 잡을 수 있으면 먹고요.

english: They have no teeth to chew with, so they swallow pebbles that help to grind the swallowed foods in the gizzard.
translation: 씹을 이빨이 없어서 조약돌을 삼켜 모래주머니 속에서 삼킨 음식을 가는 데 써요.

english: They can go without water for a long time, exclusively living off the water in the plants. However, they enjoy water and frequently take baths when they can.
translation: 식물 속 수분만으로 살면서 오랫동안 물 없이 버틸 수 있어요. 하지만 물을 좋아해서 기회가 되면 자주 목욕을 하죠.

english: Terrorbirds are known to eat almost anything, particularly in captivity, where opportunity is increased.
translation: terrorbirds(테러버드)는 거의 뭐든 먹는다고 알려져 있는데, 특히 먹을 기회가 많은 사육 환경에서 더 그래요.

english: Terrorbirds usually weigh a little less than a small unicorn. The feathers of adult males are mostly green, with some white on the wings and tail.
translation: terrorbirds(테러버드)는 보통 작은 unicorn(유니콘)보다 조금 가벼워요. 다 자란 수컷의 깃털은 대부분 초록색이고, 날개와 꼬리에 흰색이 조금 섞여 있어요.

english: There are claws on two of the wings' fingers and their strong legs have no feathers. The bird stands on two toes, with the bigger one resembling a hoof. Its feet have no claws.
translation: 날개의 손가락 두 개에는 발톱이 있고, 튼튼한 다리에는 깃털이 없어요. 이 새는 발가락 두 개로 서는데, 그중 큰 쪽은 발굽을 닮았어요. 발에는 발톱이 없죠.

english: This is an adaptation unique to terrorbirds that appears to aid in running. Their legs are powerful enough to kill even large animals.
translation: 이건 terrorbirds(테러버드)만의 독특한 적응으로, 달리는 데 도움이 되는 것 같아요. 다리 힘이 아주 세서 큰 동물도 죽일 수 있어요.

english: The gnomes in particular, prize the terrorbird for its fast running speed, using them as mounts whenever possible.
translation: 특히 gnomes(노움)은 terrorbird(테러버드)의 빠른 달리기 속도를 높이 사서, 가능하면 탈것으로 써요.

english: There are a number of recorded incidents of people being attacked and killed. Big males can be very territorial and aggressive, and can attack and kick very powerfully with their legs.
translation: 사람이 공격당해 죽은 사건도 여러 건 기록돼 있어요. 덩치 큰 수컷은 영역 의식이 강하고 공격적일 수 있으며, 다리로 아주 세게 공격하고 걷어찰 수 있어요.

english: A terrorbird is so fast, it can easily outrun any human athlete.
translation: terrorbird(테러버드)는 아주 빨라서 어떤 인간 운동선수도 가볍게 따돌릴 수 있어요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on terrorbirds. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 terrorbirds(테러버드)에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.
