english: Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
translation: Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Ahh kalphites, the insectoid eating machines.
translation: 아, kalphites(칼파이트)라. 닥치는 대로 먹어 치우는 곤충 기계죠.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the Kalphite Queen display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕) 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The kalphites, otherwise known as the kalphiscarabeinae, are perhaps the largest species of insect on the face of Gielinor. Their queen is called kalphiscarabeinae pasha.
translation: kalphites(칼파이트), 다른 이름으로 칼피스카라바이나이는 아마 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 가장 큰 곤충 종일 거예요. 그 여왕은 칼피스카라바이나이 파샤라고 불리죠.

english: The natural historian poses as the Kalphite Queen...
translation: 자연사학자가 Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕) 흉내를 낸다...

english: Most of the early documentation and research on this fearsome predatory species was performed by the noted bug hunter Iqbar Ali-Abdula.
translation: 이 무시무시한 포식 종에 대한 초기 기록과 연구는 대부분 저명한 곤충 사냥꾼 Iqbar Ali-Abdula(이크바르 알리압둘라)가 했어요.

english: This, of course, was before he was driven insane by his research and ran off into the desert, screaming.
translation: 물론 그건 그가 연구 때문에 미쳐서 비명을 지르며 사막으로 달아나기 전의 일이에요.

english: Kalphites are related to beetles and scorpions; they are mainly green in colour. Some have remarkable antennae which can detect the slightest movement. Their carapace is composed of armoured plates called lamellae.
translation: kalphites(칼파이트)는 딱정벌레, 전갈과 가까운 친척이고 주로 초록색이에요. 일부는 아주 미세한 움직임도 감지하는 놀라운 더듬이를 갖고 있죠. 등껍질은 라멜라라고 불리는 갑옷 같은 판으로 이루어져 있어요.

english: This shell can be compressed into a ball or fanned out like leaves, in order to sense odours. The front legs are adapted for digging the enormous tunnel systems that serve as their nests.
translation: 이 껍질은 공처럼 오므리거나 나뭇잎처럼 펼칠 수 있어서 냄새를 감지하는 데 쓰여요. 앞다리는 둥지 역할을 하는 거대한 터널망을 파기 좋게 적응했어요.

english: They exist in a caste-based society, with the soft shelled larvae at the bottom, up through the workers, soldiers and finally the queen.
translation: kalphites(칼파이트)는 계급 사회를 이루어 사는데, 맨 아래에 껍질이 무른 유충이 있고, 그 위로 일꾼, 병정, 그리고 마지막으로 여왕이 있어요.

english: Voracious carnivores, a pack of adult workers can strip the flesh from a full grown camel in a matter of seconds, leaving nothing but a few bones and strips of fur for other scavengers to pick over.
translation: 탐욕스러운 육식동물이라, 다 자란 일꾼 한 무리면 다 큰 낙타의 살을 몇 초 만에 발라내고, 다른 청소 동물들이 뒤적일 뼈 몇 개와 털가죽 조각만 남길 수 있어요.

english: They typically live in large nests marked by the rock hard pillars found in hot, arid deserts, such as the one south-west of Al Kharid, which rise out of the sands like the tombs of desert pharaohs.
translation: 대개 덥고 메마른 사막에서 바위처럼 단단한 기둥으로 표시된 큰 둥지에 사는데, Al Kharid(알 카리드) 남서쪽 사막이 그 예예요. 그 기둥들은 마치 사막 파라오의 무덤처럼 모래 위로 솟아 있죠.

english: Indeed, there is some relationship between the Kalphite Queen and the desert god Scabaras, but no one is really sure what.
translation: 실제로 Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)과 사막의 신 Scabaras(스카바라스) 사이에는 어떤 관계가 있지만, 그게 뭔지 확실히 아는 사람은 아무도 없어요.

english: During the early part of the fourth age, Scabaras proclaimed himself omnipotent and outlawed worship of all other gods save him.
translation: 제4시대 초기에 Scabaras(스카바라스)는 스스로 전능하다고 선언하고, 자신을 제외한 다른 모든 신의 숭배를 금지했어요.

english: When the people eventually revolted against his repressive rule and banished Scabaras, it is said his blood washed over the scarabs and transformed them into the kalphites we know today.
translation: 결국 사람들이 그의 억압적인 통치에 맞서 들고일어나 Scabaras(스카바라스)를 추방했을 때, 그의 피가 스카라베들 위로 쏟아져 오늘날 우리가 아는 kalphites(칼파이트)로 바꿔 놓았다고 전해져요.

english: Of course, any right-minded scientist discounts these myths as mere stories, with no historical basis in fact.
translation: 물론 제정신인 과학자라면 이런 신화를 역사적 근거가 전혀 없는 그저 이야기로 치부하죠.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on kalphites. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 kalphites(칼파이트)에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about camels.
Ahh camels, the ships of the desert.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the camel display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 낙타 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: The term camel refers to either of the two known species of camelid.
translation: 낙타라는 말은 알려진 두 낙타과 종 중 하나를 가리켜요.

english: The natural historian poses as a camel...
There is the bactrian, which has two humps and can be found throughout Al Kharid. It also refers to the Ugthanki, or one-humped camel.
translation: 하나는 혹이 두 개인 쌍봉낙타로, Al Kharid(알 카리드) 곳곳에서 볼 수 있어요. 또 하나는 Ugthanki(우그탄키), 즉 단봉낙타를 가리키죠.

english: Camels are ill-tempered beasts at the best of times, requiring a great deal of time and effort to tame.
translation: 낙타는 아무리 기분 좋을 때라도 성질이 고약한 짐승이라, 길들이는 데 엄청난 시간과 노력이 들어요.

english: This would explain why used camel salesmen are in such a hurry to be rid of them.
translation: 중고 낙타 판매상들이 그렇게 서둘러 낙타를 처분하려는 것도 그래서겠죠.

english: In the wild, camels have been known to lie in wait and ambush hapless travellers, before devouring them.
translation: 야생에서 낙타는 숨어 기다리다가 불운한 여행자를 덮쳐 잡아먹는다고 알려져 있어요.

english: This is quite surprising, as most domestic camels are happy eating nothing but vegetables.
translation: 이건 꽤 놀라운 일인데, 집에서 기르는 낙타는 대부분 채소만 먹고도 잘 지내거든요.

english: Camel milk is much more nutritious than cow milk and goes well in the strong desert drink akin to tea.
translation: 낙타 젖은 소젖보다 영양가가 훨씬 높고, 차와 비슷한 진한 사막 음료에 잘 어울려요.

english: Another useful camel by-product is dung. Their dung is very dry, due to the highly efficient metabolism of the camel.
translation: 또 다른 유용한 낙타 부산물은 똥이에요. 낙타의 신진대사가 아주 효율적이라 똥이 무척 건조하죠.

english: Scientific research has also shown that chilli has a disastrous effect on a camel's digestive system, which produces toxic dung.
translation: 과학 연구에 따르면 고추는 낙타의 소화 기관에 재앙 같은 영향을 미쳐서 독성 똥을 만들어 낸다고 해요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on camels. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 낙타에 관한 짧은 강의를 마칠게요. 즐거우셨길 바라요.

english: Tell me about leeches.
Ahh leeches, the haemophagic parasites.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the leech display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 자연사학자가 선생님과 학생, 여학생이 있는 거머리 진열장 앞 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Leeches are fascinating creatures and are very similar to worms in most respects.
translation: 거머리는 매혹적인 생물이고, 대부분의 면에서 지렁이와 아주 비슷해요.

english: The natural historian poses as a leech...
They like to inhabit streams, rivers and seas, but their preference is for stagnant pools of water.
translation: 시내, 강, 바다에 사는 걸 좋아하지만, 가장 좋아하는 건 고인 물웅덩이예요.

english: One of the most common misconceptions is that all leeches feed on blood.
translation: 가장 흔한 오해 중 하나는 모든 거머리가 피를 먹는다는 거예요.

english: Most leeches are meat eaters, feeding on a variety of invertebrates such as worms, snails, insect larvae and snails.
translation: 대부분의 거머리는 육식성이라 지렁이, 달팽이, 곤충 유충, 그리고 달팽이 같은 다양한 무척추동물을 먹어요.

english: Those that do feed on blood have developed an amazing method of doing so. Firstly they latch onto the skin using a ring of tiny teeth, before injecting their prey with an anaesthetic.
translation: 피를 먹는 거머리들은 놀라운 방법을 발달시켰어요. 먼저 작은 이빨이 둥글게 난 입으로 피부에 달라붙은 다음, 먹이에게 마취제를 주입하죠.

english: Then they bite into the skin using a Y-shaped mouthpiece and introducing a chemical that stops the blood from clotting.
translation: 그런 다음 Y자 모양의 입으로 피부를 물어뜯고, 피가 굳지 않게 하는 화학 물질을 주입합니다.

english: They will then feed until they are completely full, sometimes doubling in size!
translation: 그러고는 배가 완전히 찰 때까지 피를 빠는데, 때로는 몸집이 두 배로 불어나기도 하지요!

english: Most leeches are very small, measuring no more than the length of your middle finger. An exception to these are the leeches of Morytania, which can reach the size of a dog.
translation: 거머리는 대부분 아주 작아서 가운뎃손가락 길이를 넘지 않습니다. 예외라면 Morytania(모리타니아)의 거머리인데, 이 녀석들은 개만 한 크기까지 자랄 수 있지요.

english: They are much more mobile than their smaller cousins and are able to jump rather high when attacking.
translation: 작은 사촌들보다 훨씬 날쌔고, 공격할 때는 꽤 높이 뛰어오를 수도 있습니다.

english: Quite how these leeches came to be so big is something of a mystery.
translation: 이 거머리들이 어떻게 이렇게까지 커졌는지는 아직 수수께끼입니다.

english: All we can assume is that there is some kind of environmental influence, which has governed their immense growth.
translation: 우리가 짐작할 수 있는 건, 어떤 환경적 요인이 이 엄청난 성장을 이끌었으리라는 것뿐이지요.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on leeches. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 거머리에 대한 짧은 강의를 마치겠습니다. 즐거운 시간이 되셨기를 바랍니다.

english: Tell me about moles.
Ahh moles, the mammalian mountain makers.
translation: 아아, 두더지라. 땅에 산을 쌓아 올리는 포유류 건축가들이지요.

english: The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the mole display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 natural historian(자연사학자)가 teacher and pupil(선생님과 학생), schoolgirl(여학생)이 있는 두더지 진열장 앞의 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: Now, moles are small mammals of the talpidae family. These subterranean burrowers mainly live on a diet of slugs, snails and insects.
translation: 자, 두더지는 두더지과에 속하는 작은 포유류입니다. 땅속에 굴을 파고 사는 이 동물은 주로 민달팽이, 달팽이, 곤충을 먹고 삽니다.

english: The natural historian poses as a mole...
They vary greatly in habitat and can be found in almost every part of Gielinor. Some species have even known to be aquatic!
translation: 서식지가 매우 다양해서 Gielinor(길리노르)의 거의 모든 곳에서 찾아볼 수 있습니다. 심지어 물에서 사는 종도 있다고 알려져 있지요!

english: Male moles are known as boars with the females called sows. Should you come across a group of moles, you would call them a labour.
translation: 수컷 두더지는 '보어', 암컷은 '사우'라고 부릅니다. 두더지 무리를 만나면 '레이버'라고 부르면 되지요.

english: Moles are considered to be an agricultural pest in most places, digging up the ground and leaving molehills all over the place.
translation: 두더지는 대부분의 지역에서 농사를 망치는 해충으로 여겨집니다. 땅을 파헤치고 사방에 두더지 흙더미를 남겨 놓으니까요.

english: This has been highlighted in Falador by Wyson the Gardener who, after using some Malignus Mortifer's Super Ultra Flora Growth Potion, managed to create Gielinor's only known species of giant mole.
translation: 이 문제는 Falador(팔라도르)에서 Wyson the Gardener(정원사 와이슨) 덕분에 크게 주목받았습니다. 그가 Malignus Mortifer(말리그누스 모르티퍼)의 슈퍼 울트라 식물 성장 물약을 썼다가, Gielinor(길리노르)에서 유일하게 알려진 거대 두더지 종을 만들어 내고 말았지요.

english: This fearsome beast has huge claws, wicked teeth and a penchant for shiny objects. It is a very tough animal with a thick protective hide and an ill temperament.
translation: 이 무시무시한 짐승은 거대한 발톱과 사악한 이빨을 지녔고, 반짝이는 물건을 무척 좋아합니다. 두껍고 질긴 가죽에 성질도 고약해서 상대하기 아주 힘든 동물이지요.

english: That said, they do benefit the soil by aerating and tilling it, adding to its fertility. Contrary to popular belief, moles don't eat plant roots.
translation: 그렇긴 해도 두더지는 흙에 공기를 통하게 하고 땅을 갈아 주어 비옥하게 만들어 줍니다. 그리고 흔히들 오해하지만, 두더지는 식물 뿌리를 먹지 않습니다.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on moles. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 두더지에 대한 짧은 강의를 마치겠습니다. 즐거운 시간이 되셨기를 바랍니다.

english: Tell me about penguins.
Ahh penguins, the cunning birds of the sea.
The player and the natural historian teleport to a cutscene in front of the penguin display case with a teacher and pupil and schoolgirl.
translation: 플레이어와 natural historian(자연사학자)가 teacher and pupil(선생님과 학생), schoolgirl(여학생)이 있는 펭귄 진열장 앞의 컷신으로 순간이동한다.

english: This often-maligned aquatic bird is known to be native to the ice fields of Etceteria, although they have been known to live as far as the fields of Lumbridge.
translation: 흔히 오해받는 이 바닷새는 Etceteria(에트세테리아)의 얼음 들판이 원산지로 알려져 있지만, 멀리 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 들판에서 산 적도 있다고 합니다.

english: The natural historian poses as a penguin...
These aquatic birds seem to spend the majority of their time eating and fostering their young.
translation: 이 바닷새들은 대부분의 시간을 먹고 새끼를 키우는 데 쓰는 것으로 보입니다.

english: For creatures with such small brains, they do seem to have a disproportionate capacity for forward thinking and planning. As this serves no natural purpose, scholars are divided as to how this evolved.
translation: 뇌가 그렇게 작은 생물치고는 앞일을 내다보고 계획하는 능력이 지나치게 뛰어납니다. 자연에서 아무 쓸모가 없는 능력이라, 이것이 어떻게 진화했는지를 두고 학자들의 의견이 갈리지요.

english: Their diet consists mainly of fish, squid and a small shrimp-like creature called krill. However, some have developed a taste for the mushrooms that grow around fairy rings.
translation: 주로 물고기, 오징어, 그리고 크릴이라는 작은 새우 같은 생물을 먹습니다. 그런데 일부는 fairy ring(요정의 고리) 주변에 자라는 버섯에 맛을 들이기도 했지요.

english: Penguins primarily rely on their vision while hunting. What we don't know is how penguins locate prey in the darkness, or at great depths.
translation: 펭귄은 사냥할 때 주로 시력에 의존합니다. 우리가 모르는 건, 펭귄이 어둠 속이나 아주 깊은 곳에서 어떻게 먹잇감을 찾아내느냐 하는 점이지요.

english: Some theories suggest that penguins are helped by some sort of extra sensory perception; perhaps even precognition.
translation: 어떤 이론에서는 펭귄이 일종의 초감각적 지각, 어쩌면 예지력의 도움까지 받는다고 봅니다.

english: Penguins spend a long time going without food when they are breeding. In fact, they won't even leave their nests if they can help it.
translation: 펭귄은 번식기에 오랫동안 아무것도 먹지 않고 지냅니다. 사실, 될 수만 있다면 둥지를 떠나지도 않으려 하지요.

english: Fortunately, most penguins build up a layer of fat to keep them warm and provide energy until the moult is over.
translation: 다행히 대부분의 펭귄은 지방층을 쌓아 두어서, 털갈이가 끝날 때까지 몸을 따뜻하게 지키고 에너지를 얻습니다.

english: And this concludes my short lecture on penguins. I hope you've enjoyed yourselves.
translation: 이것으로 펭귄에 대한 짧은 강의를 마치겠습니다. 즐거운 시간이 되셨기를 바랍니다.

english: Hmm, I'm afraid I don't allow pets in my lectures, the demonstrations can scare them.
translation: 흠, 죄송하지만 제 강의에는 반려동물을 데려올 수 없습니다. 시연을 보고 놀랄 수도 있거든요.

english: Tell me about lizards.
Tell me about tortoises.
Tell me about dragons.
Tell me about wyverns.
That's enough education for one day.
Tell me about snails.
Tell me about monkeys.
Tell me about sea slugs.
Tell me about snakes.
Tell me about natural history.
Tell me about terrorbirds.
Tell me about the Kalphite Queen.
translation: Kalphite Queen(칼파이트 여왕)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about camels.
Tell me about leeches.
Tell me about moles.
Tell me about penguins.
What is this place?
Speak to me again and I will rend the soul from your flesh.
translation: 한 번만 더 내게 말을 걸면 네 육신에서 영혼을 찢어발겨 주마.

english: Nobody speaks to me unless I speak to them!!!
translation: 내가 먼저 말을 걸기 전에는 아무도 내게 말하지 못한다!!!

english: I do not answer questions, mortal fool!!
translation: 나는 질문 따위에 답하지 않는다, 어리석은 필멸자여!!

english: I will answer questions when you are dead!!
translation: 네가 죽으면 그때 질문에 답해 주마!!

english: You dare to speak to me??? Have you lost your wits????
translation: 감히 내게 말을 걸어??? 정신이 나간 게냐????

english: What happened to everyone here?
translation: 여기 있던 사람들은 다 어떻게 된 거죠?

english: How do I get into the town?
Told you I'd defeat you, Necrovarus. My advice to you is to pass over to the next world yourself with everybody else.
translation: 내가 널 이길 거라고 했지, Necrovarus(네크로바루스). 충고 하나 하지. 너도 다른 모두와 함께 저세상으로 건너가 버려.

english: I should fry you for what you have done...
translation: 네가 저지른 짓을 생각하면 불태워 버려야 마땅하건만...

english: Quiet, evil priest!! If you try anything I will command you again, but this time it will be throw yourself into the Endless Void for the rest of eternity.
translation: 닥쳐, 사악한 사제 놈!! 수작을 부리면 다시 명령할 거야. 다만 이번엔 Endless Void(끝없는 공허)에 몸을 던져서 영원히 거기 있으라고 할 거다.

english: Please no! I will do whatever you say!!
translation: 제발 그것만은! 시키는 건 뭐든지 하겠습니다!!

english: What is this place?
What happened to everyone here?
translation: 여기 있던 사람들은 다 어떻게 된 거죠?

english: How do I get into the town?
Hello there! Looking to take advantage of the Mistrock mines? If so, I'm happy to buy any ores from you. I can also sell you some tools if needed.
translation: 안녕하세요! Mistrock(미스트록) 광산을 이용해 보시려고요? 그렇다면 캐 온 광석은 제가 기꺼이 사 드릴게요. 필요하면 도구도 팔 수 있고요.

english: Let's trade.
Great!
What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: Mistrock? It's a mining outpost. It was set up by Cam Torum after you humans went and had another of your wars. We lost some good mines and needed to find new ones.
translation: Mistrock(미스트록) 말인가요? 광산 전초기지예요. 당신네 인간들이 또 한바탕 전쟁을 치른 뒤에 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)이 세운 곳이죠. 그때 좋은 광산을 몇 군데 잃어서 새 광산을 찾아야 했거든요.

english: Why here?
It wasn't the first choice, but both humans and dwarves alike were pretty poor after the fighting ended, so we all had to learn lessons in how to compromise.
translation: 처음부터 여기를 고른 건 아니었어요. 그런데 싸움이 끝나고 나니 인간이고 드워프고 다들 꽤 가난해져서, 다 같이 타협하는 법을 배워야 했죠.

english: Still, it ended up not being too bad in the end. We found there was a reasonable supply of coal and iron here, along with some silver and gold.
translation: 그래도 결국엔 그리 나쁘지 않았어요. 여기서 석탄과 철이 꽤 나왔고, 은이랑 금도 조금 나왔거든요.

english: The location ended up being quite appealing for some as well. It makes for a nice change of scenery for those that appreciate that sort of thing.
translation: 위치도 어떤 사람들한테는 꽤 마음에 들었나 봐요. 그런 걸 좋아하는 사람들한테는 기분 전환하기 좋은 경치거든요.

english: So what was here before Mistrock?
translation: 그럼 Mistrock(미스트록)이 생기기 전엔 여기 뭐가 있었어요?

english: Nothing much of note. The land here was owned by the Moonrise Brewery and Winery, but they found it wasn't much good for growing grapes.
translation: 별것 없었어요. 여기 땅은 Moonrise Brewery and Winery(문라이즈 양조장) 소유였는데, 포도 키우기엔 영 좋지 않다는 걸 알게 됐죠.

english: So they were happy to give it up?
Very happy. They saw an opportunity for a new business relationship. In return for giving us the land, we now give them favourable rates on what we mine here.
translation: 아주 기꺼이요. 새로운 사업 관계를 맺을 기회로 봤거든요. 땅을 내준 대가로, 우리는 여기서 캐는 걸 그쪽에 싼값에 넘겨주고 있어요.

english: Does a winery have much need for metal?
Apparently so. I guess they use it to make and maintain all their fancy brewing and winemaking equipment.
translation: 그런가 봐요. 아마 그 화려한 양조 장비랑 와인 제조 장비를 만들고 손보는 데 쓰겠죠.

english: But anyway, enough about that. Are you interested in buying or selling some ores?
translation: 아무튼 그 얘긴 그만하고요. 광석을 사거나 팔 생각 있어요?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Well you know where I am if you change your mind.
translation: 마음 바뀌면 제가 어디 있는지 아시죠.

english: Let's trade.
What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 이곳에 대해 뭘 알려 줄 수 있나요?

english: I'm good, thanks.
Hello again, [lad/lass]. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 또 왔구먼, [lad/lass]. 내가 도와줄 일이라도 있나? 밧줄이라도 좀 사겠나?

english: Well, I was a sailor. I've not been able to get work at sea these days, though. They say I'm too old.
translation: 음, 난 선원이었다네. 요즘은 바다 일을 못 구하고 있지만. 내가 너무 늙었다는구먼.

english: Sorry, where was it you said you wanted to go?
To the island of Crandor.
Crandor?
But... It would be a chance to sail a ship once more. I'd sail anywhere if it was a chance to sail again.
translation: 하지만... 다시 배를 몰 기회이긴 하지. 다시 항해할 수만 있다면 어디든 가겠네.

english: Then again, no captain in his right mind would sail to that island...
translation: 그래도 제정신인 선장이라면 그 섬으로 배를 몰진 않을 텐데...

english: Ah, you only live once! I'll do it!
translation: 에라, 인생은 한 번뿐이지! 내가 하겠네!

english: So, where's your ship?
It's the Lady Lumbridge, in Port Sarim.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 있는 Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)호예요.

english: That old pile of junk? Last I heard, she wasn't seaworthy.
translation: 그 낡아 빠진 고물 말인가? 마지막으로 듣기론 바다에 띄울 만한 상태가 아니라던데.

english: I fixed her up!
You did? Excellent!
Just show me the map and we can get ready to go!
translation: 지도만 보여 주면 바로 떠날 준비를 하지!

english: Here you go.
Excellent! I'll meet you at the ship, then.
Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
I said I would and old Ned is a man of his word! I'll meet you on board the Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
translation: 한다고 했으면 하는 거지. 이 늙은 네드는 약속은 꼭 지키는 사람이라네! Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 Lady Lumbridge(레이디 럼브리지)호에서 만나세.

english: Ah, it's good to be on board a ship again! No matter how long I live on land, a ship will always seem better. Are you ready to depart?
translation: 아, 다시 배에 오르니 좋구먼! 뭍에서 아무리 오래 살아도 역시 배가 더 좋아 보인단 말이야. 출발할 준비 됐나?

english: Yes, let's go!
No, I'm not quite ready yet.
Well, you go do whatever you need to do. I'll wait here for you until you're ready.
translation: 그럼 볼일 다 보고 오게. 준비될 때까지 여기서 기다리고 있겠네.

english: Ah, it's good to feel the salt spray on my face once again!
translation: 아, 얼굴에 다시 짠 물보라를 맞으니 좋구먼!

english: And this is a mighty fine ship. She don't look much, but she handles like a dream.
translation: 게다가 이거 아주 훌륭한 배야. 겉보기엔 별로지만 꿈결같이 잘 나간다네.

english: How much longer until we reach Crandor?
Not long now! According to the chart, we'd be able to see Crandor if it wasn't for those clouds on the horizon.
translation: 이제 얼마 안 남았네! 해도대로라면 저 수평선의 구름만 아니면 Crandor(크랜도)가 보일 텐데.

english: Clouds surround the ship.
Looks like there's a storm coming up, cap'n. Soon we won't be able to see anything!
translation: 폭풍이 몰려오는 것 같아요, 선장님. 곧 아무것도 안 보이겠어요!

english: Oh, well. The weather had been so good up until now.
Did you see that?
See what?
I thought I saw something up above us.
translation: 머리 위로 뭔가 지나간 것 같았어요.

english: It's the dragon!
We're going to sink!
Look! Land ahead!
We're going to crash!
CRASH!
You are knocked unconscious and later awake on an ash-strewn beach.
translation: 정신을 잃었다가 나중에 재가 흩뿌려진 해변에서 깨어난다.

english: Now I see why all the other captains said I'd be mad to go near Crandor. It looks like we're stranded.
translation: 다른 선장들이 왜 Crandor(크랜도) 근처에 가는 건 미친 짓이라고 했는지 이제 알겠구먼. 아무래도 우린 오도 가도 못하게 된 것 같네.

english: Don't worry about that. I found a secret passage in the dragon's lair that leads off the island!
translation: 걱정 마세요. 드래곤 굴에서 섬 밖으로 나가는 비밀 통로를 찾았어요!

english: Oh, that's good. I'll be able to get back to Draynor somehow,
translation: 오, 잘됐구먼. 어떻게든 Draynor(드레이너)로 돌아갈 수 있겠어,

english: if I can sneak past all the skeletons and demons on this island!
translation: 이 섬에 득실대는 해골이랑 악마들 몰래 빠져나갈 수만 있다면 말이지!

english: Hello again, lad. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 또 왔구먼, 젊은이. 내가 도와줄 일이라도 있나? 밧줄이라도 좀 사겠나?

english: How did you get back from Crandor?
I got towed back by a passing friendly whale.
Anyway, would you like me to make some rope while you're here?
translation: 그건 그렇고, 온 김에 밧줄이라도 좀 만들어 주랴?

english: Can you take me back to Crandor again?
Aye, that I could. I'll meet you at the Port Sarim docks again. I'll try to steer a little better this time!
translation: 암, 그럴 수 있지. 다시 Port Sarim(포트 사림) 부두에서 만나세. 이번엔 키를 좀 더 잘 잡아 보겠네!

english: Why, hello there, [lad/lass]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: 아이고, 반갑구먼, [lad/lass]. 내 친구들은 날 네드라고 부르지. 한때는 바다 사나이였지만 이젠 다 지난 일이라네. 밧줄을 좀 만들어 주거나 팔아 줄까?

english: Yes, I would like some rope.
Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me 4 balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
translation: 그럼, 밧줄은 15코인에 팔 수 있다네. 아니면 양털 뭉치 4개를 갖다주면 만들어 줄 수도 있고. 내가 가닥을 꼬아 붙인다 이 말이여, 튼튼하게 말이지.

english: You make rope from wool?
Of course you can!
I thought you needed hemp or jute.
translation: 밧줄은 대마나 황마로 만드는 줄 알았는데요.

english: Do you want some rope or not?
You don't have enough coins to buy any rope!
Okay, please sell me some rope.
There you go, finest rope in Gielinor.
You hand Ned 15 coins. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: Ned(네드)에게 15코인을 건넨다. 네드가 밧줄 한 타래를 준다.

english: Thanks. Hmmm, do you know something? This rope has a funny smell.
translation: 고마워요. 흠, 그런데 그거 아세요? 이 밧줄에서 이상한 냄새가 나요.

english: Really?
Yes, It reminds me of...yaks. I was travelling in the Fremennik Isles recently and, do you know what? They made rope out of yak's hair.
translation: 네, 뭔가... 야크가 생각나요. 얼마 전에 Fremennik Isles(프레메닉 제도)를 여행했는데, 글쎄 거기선 야크 털로 밧줄을 만들더라고요.

english: What a coincidence?
There was a lady over there who sold wool, she said she traded rope for the wool.
translation: 거기서 양털을 파는 아주머니가 있었는데, 양털을 받고 밧줄을 내준다고 하더라고요.

english: Who would have thought it?
I don't think you make rope at all. I think you trade balls of wool for rope.
translation: 아저씨는 밧줄을 직접 만드는 게 아닌 것 같아요. 양털 뭉치를 밧줄이랑 바꾸고 계신 거죠.

english: Oh, I confess. You have found the truth. I used to make the rope myself, but my fingers aren't as nimble as they used to be and so many people wanted my rope. Demand was so high I had to find another
translation: 아이고, 자백하지. 자네가 진실을 알아냈구먼. 예전엔 직접 밧줄을 만들었는데, 손가락이 예전 같지 않은 데다 내 밧줄을 찾는 사람이 너무 많았다네. 수요가 하도 많아서 다른 데서

english: source. But I couldn't tell anyone since Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool) is a high profile brand now.
translation: 구해 올 수밖에 없었지. 그런데 Ned's Handmade Rope (100% Wool)(네드의 수제 밧줄 (양모 100%))는 이제 유명한 브랜드라 아무한테도 말할 수가 없었다네.

english: Yes, well, the wool is still pretty good, though yak hair makes fine rope. I don't suppose any harm will come of it.
translation: 음, 뭐, 양털도 여전히 꽤 좋고, 야크 털로도 좋은 밧줄이 나오니까요. 딱히 해가 될 일은 없을 것 같아요.

english: Thanks. Here take this, a free sample! Please, don't tell anyone.
translation: 고맙네. 자, 이거 받게. 무료 샘플일세! 제발 아무한테도 말하지 말게.

english: Well, it's always good to keep on the good side of a sailor. Your secret is safe with me.
translation: 뭐, 선원하고는 사이좋게 지내는 게 늘 좋죠. 비밀은 지켜 드릴게요.

english: Oh, if you're in the Isles again, tell Jofridr that her Neddie will be there soon.
translation: 아, 혹시 다시 제도에 가거든 Jofridr(요프리드르)한테 네디가 곧 보러 간다고 전해 주게.

english: I will do that!
I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 양털 뭉치가 좀 있어요. 밧줄을 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Sure I can.
You hand over 4 balls of wool. Ned gives you a coil of rope.
translation: 양털 뭉치 4개를 건넨다. Ned(네드)가 밧줄 한 타래를 준다.

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 제가 내고 싶은 것보단 좀 비싸네요.

english: Well, if you ever need rope that's the price. Sorry. An old sailor needs money for a little drop o' rum.
translation: 뭐, 밧줄이 필요하면 그게 값일세. 미안하네. 늙은 뱃사람도 럼주 한 잔 할 돈은 있어야지.

english: I will go and get some wool.
Aye, you do that. Remember, it takes 4 balls of wool to make strong rope.
translation: 암, 그러게. 잊지 말게, 튼튼한 밧줄을 만들려면 양털 뭉치가 4개 필요하다네.

english: No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
Well, old Neddy is always here if you do. Tell your friends. I can always be using the business.
translation: 뭐, 필요하면 이 늙은 네디는 늘 여기 있다네. 친구들한테도 말해 주게. 장사는 늘 환영이니까.

english: Well done!
You've been given another clue!
Good work! I have new information to share with you. Listen carefully, now!
translation: 잘했네! 자네한테 알려 줄 새 정보가 있다네. 잘 듣게!

english: A place 65 steps forward and 17 to the right needs an inspection. The weather vane up high will guide you in the right direction.
translation: 앞으로 65걸음, 오른쪽으로 17걸음 간 곳을 살펴봐야 하네. 높이 달린 풍향계가 올바른 방향을 알려 줄 걸세.

english: Under the ground lies the next clue you seek. Getting it out requires a little technique.
translation: 다음 단서는 땅 밑에 있다네. 꺼내려면 요령이 좀 필요하지.

english: You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?
Yes, I would like some rope.
No thanks, Ned. I don't need any.
Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
Yes, let's go!
No, I'm not quite ready yet.
How did you get back from Crandor?
Can you take me to Crandor again?
No thanks Ned, I don't need any.
Okay, please sell me some rope.
I have some balls of wool. Could you make me some rope?
translation: 양털 뭉치가 좀 있어요. 밧줄을 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: That's a little more than I want to pay.
translation: 제가 내고 싶은 것보단 좀 비싸네요.

english: I will go and get some wool.
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 죄송한데, 똥을 조금만 나눠 주실 수 있을까요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 영 마음에 들지 않은 것 같다.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타, 케밥으로 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 근처에 가면 손을 물어뜯길지도 몰라.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
translation: 저 낙타, 벼룩 있는 거 아니야...

english: The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 낙타가 발을 밟으려 하지만, 재빨리 발을 뺀다.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 낙타가 침을 뱉어서 황급히 뒤로 물러선다.

english: Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 먼저 눈부터 감으세요. 쳐다보고 있으면 안 할 거예요!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What was that?
Er, nothing important.
Wait, you're a human, aren't you? Have you come from outside this town?
translation: 잠깐, 당신 인간이죠? 이 마을 밖에서 왔어요?

english: Yes, I have.
Oh, how wonderful! Does that mean I can finally leave this place and see the world outside?
translation: 어머, 잘됐다! 그럼 저도 드디어 여길 떠나서 바깥세상을 볼 수 있는 거예요?

english: Wouldn't your master have to take you?
The plagues mean that my master isn't allowed to leave. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 역병 때문에 주인님은 밖으로 나갈 수가 없어요. 여긴 너무 지루하고, 저는 여행을 하고 싶어요.

english: My master has no interest in leaving. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 주인님은 떠날 생각이 전혀 없어요. 여긴 너무 지루하고, 저는 여행을 하고 싶어요.

english: Travelling's what camels do best, you know.
I don't suppose you could take me with you, could you?
translation: 혹시 저를 같이 데려가 줄 순 없겠죠?

english: How do I know you're not ill as well?
translation: 당신도 병에 걸리지 않았다는 걸 어떻게 알아요?

english: Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so I'm probably not. Will you take me with you?
translation: 글쎄요, 아직 이상한 색으로 변하진 않았으니 아마 아닐 거예요. 저 데려가 줄래요?

english: I don't really have space for a camel, sorry.
Oh well. Come back some time, and bring me news of the rest of the world.
translation: 아쉽네요. 나중에 또 와서 바깥세상 소식 좀 들려주세요.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 안 해요. 저는 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보시겠어요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 그게요, 같은 망토를 입은 사람은 실수로 공격할 일이 줄어들고, 다른 사람은 공격하기가 더 쉬워져요. 또 같은 망토를 입은 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 구별하기도 쉬워지죠. 친구나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람들과 wilderness(황야)에 나갈 때 아주 쓸모 있어요.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hello. What's your name?
I shouldn't talk to strangers.
Well, my name is [player name] and I'm pleased to meet you. So, now that I'm not a stranger anymore, what's your name?
translation: 음, 제 이름은 [player name](이)라고 하고, 만나서 반가워요. 자, 이제 낯선 사람이 아니니까 이름이 뭐예요?

english: Hmm... Nice to meet you, [player name]. I'm Neite.
translation: 흠... 만나서 반가워요, [player name] 님. 저는 Neite(네이테)예요.

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 어째서 이 근처에 고양이는 당신 하나뿐이에요?

english: Oh there's far more than just me. The others are just shy. We do also get visitors from outside the city sometimes, like that Bob. He's quite a handsome beast...
translation: 어머, 저 말고도 훨씬 많아요. 다른 애들은 수줍음을 탈 뿐이죠. 가끔 도시 밖에서 손님도 와요. 그 Bob(밥)처럼요. 꽤 잘생긴 녀석이죠...

english: Oh, I see. Romance is in the air, is it?
Well, life here in the desert can be a lonely existence, even with all my busy work... Still, to be honest, he worries me.
translation: 글쎄요, 아무리 일이 바빠도 이 사막에서의 삶은 외로울 수 있거든요... 그래도 솔직히 말하면, 그 녀석이 좀 걱정돼요.

english: In what way?
Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most family trees, but he himself has none!
translation: 음, 저는 고양이 가문의 혈통에 대해서라면 누구보다 잘 안다고 자부해요. 당연히 대부분의 가계도에 Bob(밥)이 잔뜩 등장하는데, 정작 그 자신의 가계도는 없어요!

english: What do you mean?
Nobody is sure where he came from. Not even the Sphinx knows. It's just one of those mysteries.
translation: 그 녀석이 어디서 왔는지는 아무도 몰라요. Sphinx(스핑크스)조차도요. 그냥 수수께끼 중 하나죠.

english: Interesting...
What are you doing?
I'm hunting frogs and locusts.
Why? Do they taste good?
Yuck! No, I would never debase myself to eat such filth.
translation: 윽! 아뇨, 그런 더러운 걸 먹을 만큼 체통을 버리진 않아요.

english: I see you're a cat of taste then.
I am a cat of high breeding! My family tree dates back before those of any ruler on Gielinor.
translation: 저는 고귀한 혈통의 고양이예요! 제 가계도는 Gielinor(길리노르)의 어느 통치자 가문보다도 오래됐답니다.

english: What do you do with the frogs and locusts?
What do you mean by 'do'?
Well, seeing as you're hunting them, I thought you'd eat them too.
translation: 그게, 사냥을 하니까 먹기도 하는 줄 알았어요.

english: No, no, I just hunt them, play with them for a bit and then kill them.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨. 그냥 사냥해서 잠깐 갖고 놀다가 죽이는 거예요.

english: Isn't that a little evil?
What's evil about a little destruction?
What isn't? You destroy and take away life. What good is there in that?
translation: 사악하지 않은 데가 어디 있어요? 생명을 파괴하고 빼앗잖아요. 거기에 무슨 좋은 점이 있어요?

english: Life can come from destruction too. Take a volcano. It will destroy all life that surrounds it, but it will also fertilise and enrich the surrounding earth.
translation: 생명은 파괴에서도 태어날 수 있어요. 화산을 생각해 봐요. 화산은 주변의 모든 생명을 파괴하지만, 동시에 주변 땅을 기름지고 풍요롭게 만들기도 하죠.

english: From that earth, more life will spring forth than there was in the first place.
translation: 그 땅에서는 처음보다 더 많은 생명이 솟아날 거예요.

english: How do you compare killing frogs to a volcano? A volcano has no choice about whether it explodes or not, but you do have a choice.
translation: 개구리를 죽이는 걸 어떻게 화산이랑 비교해요? 화산은 터질지 말지 선택할 수 없지만, 당신은 선택할 수 있잖아요.

english: I disagree. It's in my nature to prey on smaller life forms in the same way as it is in the volcanoes nature to explode.
translation: 동의할 수 없어요. 화산이 터지는 게 화산의 본성이듯, 작은 생명체를 사냥하는 건 제 본성이에요.

english: Don't they sometimes call the Devourer the goddess of destruction? You seem to have a lot in common with a goddess that your kind oppose.
translation: Devourer(포식자)를 파괴의 여신이라고 부르기도 하지 않아요? 당신은 고양이들이 맞서는 그 여신이랑 공통점이 많아 보이네요.

english: That is not too surprising. A long time ago, I served her. Her form has changed a lot since then, just as mine has.
translation: 그리 놀랄 일도 아니에요. 오래전에 저는 그 여신을 섬겼거든요. 그 뒤로 여신의 모습은 많이 변했죠. 제 모습이 변한 것처럼요.

english: You mean you weren't always a cat?
No, I used to be human. At the time when Amascut became the Devourer, I was one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 네, 전에는 인간이었어요. Amascut(아마스컷)이 포식자가 되었을 때, 저는 아마스컷의 대사제 중 한 명이었죠.

english: So you stopped serving her because of that change?
translation: 그럼 그 변화 때문에 섬기는 걸 그만둔 거예요?

english: Not initially. Many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. She went too far though, so we took action.
translation: 처음엔 아니었어요. 많은 사제들이 한동안 여신의 새로운 습성을 참아 냈죠. 하지만 도를 넘었기에, 우리는 행동에 나섰어요.

english: What did you do?
The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 마지막 남은 사제들이 모여 여신에게 저주를 걸었어요. 안타깝게도 여신 역시 주문을 걸어, 우리가 영원히 여신의 모습을 한 채 Gielinor(길리노르)를 떠돌게 만들었죠.

english: So she's a cat then?
She's as much of a cat as Icthlarin is a dog.
What curse did you cast upon her?
We trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 여신을 인간의 몸에 가두어 힘을 제한했어요. 또 다시는 자발적으로 숭배받지 못하도록 저주했지만, 그 저주가 약해지기 시작한 것 같아 걱정이에요.

english: So that's why she's scared of cats?
translation: 그래서 그 여신이 고양이를 무서워하는 거예요?

english: Indeed. There are fewer of us priestesses left now, but we still hold enough power to be quite the problem for her.
translation: 맞아요. 이제 남은 사제는 줄었지만, 그래도 여신에게 꽤 골칫거리가 될 만한 힘은 아직 있답니다.

english: Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
Not really. She is normally too wrapped up in preserving her immortality to be making conversation.
translation: 별로요. 그분은 보통 자신의 불멸을 지키는 데 몰두해 있어서 대화를 나눌 틈이 없거든요.

english: So you don't like her then?
translation: 그럼 그분이 별로 마음에 안 드는 거예요?

english: Nothing of the sorts. I have nothing but respect for her.
translation: 전혀 그렇지 않아요. 저는 그분을 진심으로 존경한답니다.

english: Why is that?
Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe. Her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
translation: 그게, 그분의 불멸은 우리 고양이들을 지켜 주는 데 달려 있거든요. 그분의 존재 자체가 우리를 보호하는 데 바쳐져 있죠.

english: That doesn't seem like much of a life.
True. Life shouldn't be hoarded, but lived. Of course, don't tell her I said that, otherwise I'd have to be on the lookout for a new guardian.
translation: 맞아요. 삶은 쌓아 두는 게 아니라 살아가는 거죠. 물론 제가 그렇게 말했다고 그분한테 전하면 안 돼요. 안 그러면 새 수호자를 찾아 나서야 할 테니까요.

english: Tell me about you and the Devourer.
Before she was the goddess of destruction, she was Amascut, the goddess of rebirth. Back then, I was human, and I served as one of her chief priestesses.
translation: 파괴의 여신이 되기 전, Amascut(아마스컷)은 재생의 여신이었어요. 그때 저는 인간이었고, 아마스컷의 대사제 중 한 명으로 섬겼죠.

english: When she became the Devourer, many of us tolerated her new habits for some time. After all, destruction was key to being the goddess of rebirth, so it was something we were comfortable with.
translation: 여신이 포식자가 되었을 때, 많은 사제들이 한동안 그 새로운 습성을 참아 냈어요. 어쨌든 파괴는 재생의 여신에게 핵심적인 것이었으니, 우리도 받아들일 만했거든요.

english: But she went too far?
Yes, so we took action. The last of her priestesses gathered and cursed her. Unfortunately, she also cast a spell of her own, condemning us to an eternity of walking Gielinor in her form.
translation: 네, 그래서 우리는 행동에 나섰어요. 마지막 남은 사제들이 모여 여신에게 저주를 걸었죠. 안타깝게도 여신 역시 주문을 걸어, 우리가 영원히 여신의 모습을 한 채 Gielinor(길리노르)를 떠돌게 만들었어요.

english: Our curse trapped her in a human form, limiting her power. We also cursed her to never be willing worshipped again, though I fear that curse has started to wane.
translation: 우리의 저주는 여신을 인간의 몸에 가두어 힘을 제한했어요. 또 다시는 자발적으로 숭배받지 못하도록 저주했지만, 그 저주가 약해지기 시작한 것 같아 걱정이에요.

english: I'll leave you to it.
Hello again, Neite.
Hello.
Where's Bob?
Out gallivanting. I think he's hunting noobs in the Wilderness this time. You know what he's like.
translation: 돌아다니며 노는 중이에요. 이번엔 Wilderness(황야)에서 뉴비 사냥을 하고 있을걸요. 그 녀석이 어떤지 알잖아요.

english: So, why aren't you out there with him?
I like to roam as much as the next cat, but, every so often, I do like to come home.
translation: 저도 여느 고양이만큼 돌아다니는 걸 좋아하지만, 가끔은 집에 돌아오고 싶거든요.

english: So, you and Bob haven't had an argument?
Who told you that?
Er... nobody.
He's meant to be with you. You haven't lost him have you?
translation: 그 녀석은 당신이랑 같이 있어야 하잖아요. 설마 잃어버린 건 아니죠?

english: I don't think so.
Well keep an eye on him for me.
translation: 그럼 저 대신 그 녀석 좀 잘 봐 주세요.

english: How come you're the only cat around here?
translation: 어째서 이 근처에 고양이는 당신 하나뿐이에요?

english: What are you doing?
Do you talk to the Sphinx much?
Where's Bob?
Tell me about you and the Devourer.
I'll leave you to it.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안녕하세요, 안뇽...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 하나로 치는 거예요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 참 좋죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 장관이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날에는 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Nilsal, traveller.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
Sorry, but I cannot.
Of course.
The nelta whispers a prayer and you suddenly feel a bit better.
translation: nelta(넬타)가 기도를 속삭이자 갑자기 몸이 조금 나아진 느낌이 든다.

english: So what do you do?
I am a nelta in service to Ralos.
What's a nelta?
We are the faithful servants of Ralos. We serve in a variety of roles across the Church of Ralos.
translation: 저희는 Ralos(랄로스)의 충실한 종입니다. Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회) 곳곳에서 여러 역할을 맡고 있지요.

english: So kind of like a priest?
Yes, I believe that would be the closest comparison to the Church of Saradomin, though I am no expert on their practices.
translation: 네, Church of Saradomin(사라도민 교회)와 비교하자면 그게 가장 가까울 겁니다. 물론 저는 그쪽 의식에 밝은 사람은 아닙니다만.

english: Above us mere neltas are the teoki, leaders of the key temples across the kingdom. And of course, above them you have the Teokan himself.
translation: 저희 같은 일개 넬타 위에는 왕국 곳곳의 주요 사원을 이끄는 teoki(테오키)가 계십니다. 그리고 물론 그분들 위에는 Teokan(테오칸)께서 계시지요.

english: What is this place?
This is the Teomat, home to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. The first and only time that Ralos appeared to us, he did so here on Ralos' Rise. The Teomat was built here as a result.
translation: 이곳은 Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회)와 Sect of Ranul(라눌 교단)이 함께 자리한 Teomat(테오맛)입니다. 랄로스께서 처음이자 유일하게 저희 앞에 나타나신 곳이 바로 여기 Ralos' Rise(랄로스의 언덕)였습니다. 그래서 이곳에 테오맛이 세워졌지요.

english: I'd best get going.
May the sun light your way.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
So what do you do?
What is this place?
I'd best get going.
Adventurer.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
I would suggest you seek out a member of the Church of Ralos for that sort of thing. We are more concerned with the dead than the living.
translation: 그런 일이라면 Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회) 사람을 찾아가 보십시오. 저희는 산 자보다 죽은 자를 돌보는 데 마음을 쏟습니다.

english: So what do you do?
I am a nelta of the Sect of Ranul.
translation: 저는 Sect of Ranul(라눌 교단)의 nelta(넬타)입니다.

english: What's a nelta?
Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul has neltas. For those of us dedicated to Ranul, our primary duty is to care for the dead and prepare them for their journey through the Gates of Mictl.
translation: Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회)와 Sect of Ranul(라눌 교단) 모두 넬타가 있습니다. 라눌을 섬기는 저희의 가장 중요한 임무는 죽은 자를 돌보고 Gates of Mictl(믹틀의 문)을 지나는 여정을 준비시키는 것입니다.

english: What is this place?
This is the Teomat. Both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul are based here, though given us being atop Ralos' Rise, the location holds far more importance to the Church than it does to us.
translation: 이곳은 Teomat(테오맛)입니다. Church of Ralos(랄로스 교회)와 Sect of Ranul(라눌 교단) 모두 이곳에 본거지를 두고 있지만, Ralos' Rise(랄로스의 언덕) 꼭대기에 있다 보니 이곳은 저희보다 교회 쪽에 훨씬 더 중요한 곳이지요.

english: I'd best get going.
Farewell.
Can you heal me? I'm injured.
So what do you do?
What is this place?
I'd best get going.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕하세요, 안녕, 안녕하신가요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래 봤자 전부 하나로 치는 거잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 멋진 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello! What's this then?
How can you not know? YOU MUST KNOW! It is of course the shrine!
translation: 어떻게 그걸 모를 수가 있어? 알아야 해! 당연히 성소지!

english: Okay... what is the purpose of said shrine?
translation: 알겠어요... 그래서 그 성소는 뭘 하는 곳인데요?

english: Do you not listen? It is the shrine to almighty one! BWAAAAAAAK!
translation: 내 말 안 들었어? 위대하신 분을 모시는 성소라고! 꼬꼬꼬꼬꼬꼬꼬꼭!

english: You know, you're making me worried, are you okay?
DO NOT defy him! Give him your eggs! So colourful! So beautiful!
translation: 그분을 거역하지 마! 그분께 달걀을 바쳐! 이렇게 알록달록해! 이렇게 아름다워!

english: I'm going to leave you alone now.
No, no, no! I won't get back to training. Leave me alone!
translation: 싫어, 싫어, 싫어요! 훈련하러 안 돌아갈 거예요. 날 내버려 둬요!

english: Oh, you're not the drill sergeant. Please don't tell her I'm hiding over here.
translation: 아, 훈련 교관님이 아니시네요. 제발 제가 여기 숨어 있다고 교관님한테 말하지 말아 주세요.

english: Why are you hiding?
When I was growing up, all I ever wanted to be was a fisherman. I wanted to go and live in Port Piscarilius and sail the vast oceans.
translation: 어릴 때부터 제 꿈은 오직 어부가 되는 거였어요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 가서 살면서 넓은 바다를 항해하고 싶었죠.

english: My parents though... they hate the people of Piscarilius. They said I had to become a soldier and bring honour to Shayzien.
translation: 그런데 부모님은... Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스) 사람들을 싫어하세요. 저더러 병사가 돼서 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에 명예를 안겨 드리라고 하셨죠.

english: I just can't handle it though. The training is too intense, and my heart's just not in it. That's why I'm out here. I'm not going back until the drill sergeant finishes her session.
translation: 그런데 전 도저히 못 버티겠어요. 훈련은 너무 혹독하고, 마음도 영 안 내키고요. 그래서 여기 나와 있는 거예요. 훈련 교관님 훈련이 끝날 때까지는 안 돌아갈 거예요.

english: That's awful! If I were you, I wouldn't let my dreams stay as dreams. You should go to Port Piscarilius and be the fisherman you always wanted to be!
translation: 그거 너무하네요! 저라면 꿈을 꿈으로만 남겨 두진 않을 거예요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 가서 늘 되고 싶던 어부가 되세요!

english: Besides, otherwise you're probably going to be waiting an awfully long time for that drill sergeant to be done...
translation: 게다가 안 그러면 그 훈련 교관 훈련이 끝날 때까지 엄청 오래 기다려야 할걸요...

english: I'm going to have to tell the sergeant about this.
All the other soldiers are out there doing their best to train so that they're ready to protect and serve all of Great Kourend! Yet here you are, just wandering around.
translation: 다른 병사들은 전부 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)를 지키고 섬길 준비를 하려고 최선을 다해 훈련하고 있잖아요! 그런데 당신은 여기서 어슬렁거리고만 있네요.

english: Please, please! I'll do anything. Please don't tell the sergeant! I'll be the laughing stock of the whole kingdom.
translation: 제발, 제발요! 뭐든 할게요. 교관님께 말하지 말아 주세요! 그랬다간 온 왕국의 웃음거리가 될 거예요.

english: Anything? Hmm... how about 2,147,483,647 coins?
I don't have that much! I'll give you all I can for you to keep quiet. How is one gold coin?
translation: 그렇게 많이는 없어요! 입만 다물어 주시면 드릴 수 있는 건 다 드릴게요. 1골드 코인은 어떠세요?

english: Ha! I was just kidding. You can keep your money and I'll keep your secret to myself. See you around.
translation: 하! 농담이었어요. 돈은 그냥 가지시고, 비밀은 제가 지켜 드릴게요. 또 봐요.

english: Here, solve this.
New Recruit Tony hands you a [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]!
translation: New Recruit Tony(신병 토니)가 [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]을(를) 건넸다!

english: You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 소지품에 자리 좀 비워 주세요, 드릴 게 있어요.

english: Why are you hiding?
I'm going to have to tell the sergeant about this.
AT LAST!
Fumus!
Umbra!
Cruor!
Glacies!
Fill my soul with smoke!
Let the virus flow through you!
translation: 바이러스가 네 몸을 타고 흐르게 해 주마!

english: There is...
NO ESCAPE!
Fumus, don't fail me!
Darken my shadow!
Fear the shadow!
Embrace darkness!
Umbra, don't fail me!
Flood my lungs with blood!
A siphon will solve this!
I demand a blood sacrifice!
Cruor, don't fail me!
Infuse me with the power of ice!
Contain this!
Die now, in a prison of ice!
Glacies, don't fail me!
NOW, THE POWER OF ZAROS!
Taste my wrath!
Flood my lungs with blood!
Now that just sounds plain unhealthy.
translation: 그건 그냥 대놓고 몸에 안 좋을 것 같은데.

english: You're not meant to take it literally.
Oh, fair enough.
Fill my soul with smoke!
Fumus! Umbra! Cruor! Glacies! Don't fail me!
translation: Fumus(푸무스)! Umbra(움브라)! Cruor(크루오르)! Glacies(글라시에스)! 날 실망시키지 마라!

english: Err...
Fumus? Where is Fumus?
You know they're not here, right?
But... Cruor?
Darken my shadow!
Infuse me with the power of ice!
Hey! Tell me something I don't know.
translation: 야! 내가 모르는 얘기 하나 해 줘.

english: Seasons come and go, but I will never change.
translation: 계절은 오고 가도, 나는 결코 변하지 않아.

english: What is that supposed to mean?
I am the Spirit of the Sea, not a writer. No need to overanalyse!
translation: 난 Spirit of the Sea(바다의 정령)지, 작가가 아니야. 너무 깊이 파고들 필요 없어!

english: I'm sorry, you're right. Writing with those arms can't be easy anyway.
translation: 미안, 네 말이 맞아. 하긴 그런 팔로 글 쓰기가 쉽진 않겠지.

english: Don't push it, human.
You look like a [man/lady] who knows how to dress up! How can I help ya?
translation: 멋 부릴 줄 아는 [man/lady]처럼 보이시네요! 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Can I take a look at your stocks?
translation: 가게 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Do you make any custom orders?
I do! I'm always keeping an eye out for interesting materials to work with.
translation: 하죠! 작업할 만한 흥미로운 재료가 있는지 늘 눈여겨보고 있어요.

english: Could you make something for me?
translation: 저한테 뭘 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Maybe later.
I think I'm okay.
Can I take a look at your stocks?
translation: 가게 물건 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Do you make any custom orders?
Could you make something for me?
translation: 저한테 뭘 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Maybe later.
I think I'm okay.
Sorry [madam/mister], you'll have to make it quick - I'm busy hunting these wriggly buggers!
translation: 죄송해요, [madam/mister], 용건은 짧게 해 주세요. 이 꿈틀대는 녀석들 잡느라 바쁘거든요!

english: Is there anything I can do to help?
You'll have to speak to Tynan about that, [m'lady/sir], you can find him in the fishing store just south of here.
translation: 그건 Tynan(타이넌)한테 물어보셔야 해요, [m'lady/sir]. 여기서 바로 남쪽에 있는 낚시 상점에 있어요.

english: Thanks. I'll let you get back to work.
I'll let you get back to work.
I have a question for you.
Nicholas has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Nicholas has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
I know you're down there!
translation: 거기 밑에 있는 거 다 알아!

english: Dig dig dig!
Grubblies!
Is there anything I can do to help?
I'll let you get back to work.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어머, 영웅님이시네요! 와! 정말 대단해요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 참 근사해졌어요. 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Nicoleta, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 전 Nicoleta(니콜레타)예요. 이 불가에서 몸을 녹이고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 만큼 곧 힘을 키울 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고 있고, 다들 당신한테 너무나 고마워해요. 전 영웅을 실제로 본 적도, 알고 지낸 적도 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만,

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 아마 대부분의 사람들이 보기엔 당신이 바로 영웅일 거예요! 전 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
At what age do you become venomous? Can you help me in battle?
translation: 넌 몇 살쯤 되면 독이 생겨? 전투에서 날 도와줄 수 있어?

english: Venom is pretty good at dealing damage, imagine how useful that would be.
translation: 독은 피해를 주는 데 꽤 쓸 만하잖아. 그게 얼마나 유용할지 상상해 봐.

english: You could just venom something and I can hide behind a wall and watch it die.
translation: 네가 뭔가에 독만 놓으면 난 벽 뒤에 숨어서 그게 죽는 걸 구경하면 되잖아.

english: Guess not.
I've never really thought about it before. Do I need to feed you?
translation: 예전엔 생각해 본 적이 없는데. 내가 너 밥 줘야 해?

english: You follow me around a lot and never seem to do anything, nor feed yourself, drink water, even defecate.
translation: 넌 날 계속 따라다니기만 하고 아무것도 안 하는 것 같아. 밥도 안 먹고, 물도 안 마시고, 볼일도 안 보고.

english: How are you so low maintenance? It's quite surreal.
translation: 어떻게 이렇게 손이 안 갈 수가 있지? 진짜 비현실적이야.

english: Would you like a sip of a Saradomin brew?
translation: Saradomin brew(사라도민 브루) 한 모금 마실래?

english: Well if it aint' broke...

Like seriously freak me out.
Stop staring at me.
*slap*

Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어요! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 와요.

english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [monster] 사냥 중이네요. [amount]마리 남았어요. 임무를 끝내면 다시 오세요.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신에게 맞지 않는 것 같네요. 취소해 줄까요? 연속 임무 기록은 사라지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 다양하게 팔고 있어요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기 좀 해요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 거예요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하니까, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 거예요.

Look at shop.

english: Er... Nothing...
Hey, who are you?
I'm Nigel. It is my job to tell you about Deadman mode.
translation: 전 Nigel(나이절)이에요. Deadman(데드맨) 모드에 대해 알려 드리는 게 제 일이죠.

english: I have a question about Deadman mode.
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드에 대해 궁금한 게 있어요.

english: What would you like to know?
What is Deadman mode?
Deadman mode is an incredibly dangerous survival game mode. Anyone can attack anyone, anywhere. Death comes at a huge cost and killing other players can be extremely lucrative.
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드는 엄청나게 위험한 생존 게임 모드예요. 누구든, 어디서든, 누구나 공격할 수 있죠. 죽으면 큰 대가를 치르고, 다른 플레이어를 죽이면 엄청난 이득을 볼 수 있어요.

english: Lucrative, you say?

Killing a player will earn you all of the items they had on them, plus the 10 most valuable items from their bank. The unfortunate soul will also lose half of their experience in most skills, or a quarter if they were not skulled. Regardless, it's quite the set-back.
translation: 플레이어를 죽이면 그 사람이 지니고 있던 아이템 전부에, 은행에서 가장 값비싼 아이템 10개까지 얻게 돼요. 불운한 희생자는 대부분의 스킬에서 경험치의 절반을, 해골 표시가 없었다면 4분의 1을 잃고요. 어느 쪽이든 꽤 큰 타격이죠.

english: Wow, that is brutal!
It is, but it is no simple task to kill someone in Deadman mode.
translation: 그렇죠. 하지만 Deadman(데드맨) 모드에서 누군가를 죽이는 건 결코 쉬운 일이 아니에요.

english: Very high level guards patrol every major city and bank. They will kill anyone who has a skull. Getting yourself a kill is only half the battle.
translation: 주요 도시와 은행마다 레벨이 아주 높은 경비병들이 순찰을 돌아요. 그들은 해골 표시가 있는 사람은 누구든 죽이죠. 킬을 따내는 건 싸움의 절반에 불과해요.

english: How do I play Deadman mode?
You can log into Deadman mode by selecting a Deadman mode world from the world list before you log in.
translation: 로그인하기 전에 월드 목록에서 Deadman(데드맨) 모드 월드를 고르면 데드맨 모드로 접속할 수 있어요.

english: So I don't need a new account to play Deadman mode?
translation: 그럼 Deadman(데드맨) 모드를 하려고 새 계정을 만들 필요는 없는 거예요?

english: Nope! You can use your existing account on a Deadman world, providing you have membership.
translation: 없어요! 멤버십만 있으면 지금 쓰는 계정으로 Deadman(데드맨) 월드에 들어갈 수 있어요.

english: Do my stats and items transfer over to Deadman mode?
translation: 제 능력치랑 아이템이 Deadman(데드맨) 모드로 넘어가나요?

english: No, they do not. Your Deadman mode progress is completely separate from normal Old School worlds.
translation: 아니요, 안 넘어가요. Deadman(데드맨) 모드 진행 상황은 일반 Old School(올드 스쿨) 월드와 완전히 별개예요.

english: What happens when I die in Deadman mode?
If you die to a player you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: 플레이어에게 죽으면 은행에서 가장 값비싼 아이템 묶음 10개, 몸에 지닌 아이템 전부, 그리고 보호하지 않은 스킬에서 얻은 경험치의 절반을 잃어요.

english: If you die to a monster when you have a PK skull you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank, all items that you have on your person and half of the experience you have gained in any unprotected skills.
translation: PK 해골 표시가 있는 상태로 몬스터에게 죽으면 은행에서 가장 값비싼 아이템 묶음 10개, 몸에 지닌 아이템 전부, 그리고 보호하지 않은 스킬에서 얻은 경험치의 절반을 잃어요.

english: If you die to a monster when you do not have a PK skull you will lose all of the items on your person except for the 3 most valuable. You will not lose experience or any items from your bank.
translation: PK 해골 표시가 없는 상태로 몬스터에게 죽으면 가장 값비싼 3개를 제외하고 몸에 지닌 아이템을 전부 잃어요. 경험치나 은행 아이템은 잃지 않아요.

english: What happens when I kill a player in Deadman mode?
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드에서 플레이어를 죽이면 어떻게 돼요?

english: When you kill a player you will receive any items they have on their person and you will also be given a key. You can use this key on Deadman chests found in various banks across the map. Within the chest you will
translation: 플레이어를 죽이면 그 사람이 지니고 있던 아이템을 전부 얻고, 열쇠도 하나 받게 돼요. 이 열쇠는 지도 곳곳의 은행에 있는 Deadman chest(데드맨 상자)에 쓸 수 있어요. 상자 안에는

english: find the 10 most valuable stacks of items from the bank of the player you struck down. From here you will be able to choose the items you would like to keep.
translation: 쓰러뜨린 플레이어의 은행에서 가장 값비싼 아이템 묶음 10개가 들어 있어요. 거기서 갖고 싶은 아이템을 고르면 돼요.

english: How can I protect my items in Deadman mode?
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드에서 아이템을 어떻게 지킬 수 있어요?

english: You can protect up to 10 items by placing them in your safe deposit box. Items in your safe deposit box will not be lost to a player who kills you, unlike those found in your bank. Remember that you can only place 10 single items into your safe deposit box, no stacks.
translation: 안전 보관함에 넣어 두면 아이템을 10개까지 지킬 수 있어요. 은행에 있는 아이템과 달리, 안전 보관함 속 아이템은 당신을 죽인 플레이어에게 빼앗기지 않아요. 안전 보관함에는 묶음이 아니라 낱개 아이템 10개만 넣을 수 있다는 걸 기억하세요.

english: How can I protect my stats in Deadman mode?
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드에서 능력치는 어떻게 지킬 수 있어요?

english: You can protect your levels in up to 2 combat skills and 3 non-combat skills. You can choose which by opening your items lost on death interface found in your equipment tab. Choose wisely!
translation: 전투 스킬 최대 2개와 비전투 스킬 최대 3개의 레벨을 보호할 수 있어요. 어떤 스킬을 보호할지는 장비 탭에 있는 사망 시 잃는 아이템 화면을 열어서 고르면 돼요. 신중하게 고르세요!

english: You should be warned however. If you get killed by a guard, you will lose a tenth of your experience in those skills too!
translation: 하지만 경고해 둘게요. 경비병에게 죽으면 그 스킬들도 경험치의 10분의 1을 잃어요!

english: Gelin over there also has some deals on insuring your hitpoints, speak to her to find out more about that.
translation: 저쪽에 있는 Gelin(겔린)도 체력 보험 상품을 팔고 있으니, 자세한 건 겔린한테 물어보세요.

english: What are safe zones in Deadman mode?

Safe zones are areas patrolled by very high level guards which can be found in various places across the map. The guards watch out for any player with a PK skull and will attack them if they're spotted. It is still possible to be attacked inside safe zones but the person doing the attacking will not stand a chance of making it out alive.
translation: 안전 지대는 레벨이 아주 높은 경비병들이 순찰하는 구역으로, 지도 곳곳에 있어요. 경비병들은 PK 해골 표시가 있는 플레이어를 감시하다가 발견하면 공격하죠. 안전 지대 안에서도 공격당할 수는 있지만, 공격한 사람은 살아서 빠져나갈 가망이 없어요.

english: Goodbye.
Aha, blood money, the currency of a warrior! You must be rewarded! What would you like?
translation: 아하, blood money(피 묻은 돈), 전사의 화폐로군요! 보상을 받으셔야죠! 뭘 원하세요?

english: More blood money! I commend you on your strength. What item would you like this time?
translation: 또 blood money(피 묻은 돈)군요! 당신의 힘에 경의를 표해요. 이번엔 어떤 아이템을 원하세요?

english: More blood money! Truly the blood lust is strong in you. Here, take this final item. You deserve it!
translation: 또 blood money(피 묻은 돈)군요! 정말 피에 굶주린 분이네요. 자, 이 마지막 아이템을 받으세요. 받을 자격이 충분해요!

english: More blood money! I can only commend you on your prowess. Alas, I have no more armour to give to you at this time.
translation: 또 blood money(피 묻은 돈)군요! 당신의 솜씨에는 그저 감탄할 따름이에요. 아쉽게도 지금은 더 드릴 갑옷이 없어요.

english: Bring me an imbued Zamorak, Guthix or Saradomin Cape and I'll give it a trim.
translation: imbued Zamorak, Guthix or Saradomin Cape(주입된 자모락·구식스·사라도민 망토) 중 하나를 가져오시면 장식을 달아 드릴게요.

english: I cannot teleport you in this version of Deadman.
translation: 이번 Deadman(데드맨)에서는 순간이동시켜 드릴 수 없어요.

Unlock Deadman: Armageddon cape ornaments.

english: Cancel.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴 내밀 엄두도 못 냈을 거다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 잡아먹고 와서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!

I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 저리 가, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑 얘기할 생각은 전혀 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.

translation: 아주 비참한 하루로군... 누릴 수 있을 때 누려 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...

Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무우우척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.

Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...

translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴 내밀 엄두도 못 냈을 거다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 잡아먹고 와서 그래요!

Don't talk to me again if you value your life!

english: Thank you, I hope you like your present. I must be leaving now though.
translation: 고마워요, 선물이 마음에 드셨으면 좋겠네요. 그럼 저는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Sorry, that's just not the right answer!
Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [targeted player name], but [he/she] seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 죄송하지만, 전 [targeted player name]님과 얘기하려는 중인데, [he/she]이(가) 절 무시하는 것 같아요.

english: I must be leaving now.
Greetings [player name], I need your help.
Talk to me, [player name]!
Hello, [player name], are you there?
I'd like to talk to you, [player name]!
ehem... Hello [player name], please talk to me!
translation: 에헴... 안녕하세요, [player name]님, 저랑 얘기 좀 해 주세요!

english: Maybe later.
Back away! Back away! Wait... you're human!
That's right, I'm on a quest for King Lathas. I need to find a way through these caverns.
translation: 맞아요, 전 King Lathas(라타스 왕)의 퀘스트를 수행하는 중이에요. 이 동굴을 지나갈 길을 찾아야 해요.

english: Well good luck with that. We came here as miners, completely unaware of the evil that lurked here. There's no way through, not while Iban still rules. He controls the gateway, the only way to the other side.
translation: 그래, 행운을 비네. 우린 이곳에 악이 도사리고 있는 줄은 꿈에도 모르고 광부로 여기 왔지. Iban(이반)이 다스리는 한 지나갈 길은 없네. 그자가 반대편으로 가는 유일한 길인 관문을 쥐고 있거든.

english: What gateway?
The Well of Voyage. It acts as a portal through the last section of the caverns. It's the only way into the west. Iban has corrupted it though. Now he uses it to dispose of those who displease him.
translation: Well of Voyage(항해의 우물)일세. 동굴의 마지막 구역을 지나게 해 주는 포털 역할을 하지. 서쪽으로 가는 유일한 길이야. 그런데 Iban(이반)이 그걸 타락시켰다네. 이제 그자는 거기에 자기 비위를 거스른 자들을 던져 버리지.

english: Well I'll just have to kill him then.
Good luck with that! If we knew how, we'd have slain him already.
translation: 행운을 비네! 방법만 알았어도 우리가 진작 해치웠을 걸세.

english: Seek out the witch, his guide, his only confidante. Only she knows how to rid us of Iban.
translation: 그자의 길잡이이자 유일한 측근인 마녀를 찾게. Iban(이반)을 없앨 방법은 그 여자만 알고 있네.

english: She lives on the platforms above, we dare not go there. Here, take some food to aid your journey.
translation: 마녀는 위쪽 발판에 사는데, 우린 감히 거기 갈 엄두가 안 나네. 자, 여정에 보탬이 되게 음식을 좀 가져가게.

english: Thanks. Take care.
You too.
Hello.
You're brave to come down to this place. Not many survive down here.
translation: 이런 곳까지 내려오다니 용감하군. 여기서 살아남는 사람은 많지 않네.

english: As I can see.
Don't stay too long traveller. Iban's calls will soon penetrate your delicate human mind.
translation: 너무 오래 머물지 말게, 여행자. Iban(이반)의 부름이 곧 자네의 연약한 인간 정신을 파고들 걸세.

english: You'll also become one of his minions... You must go and find the witch Kardia. She holds the secret to Iban's destruction. She lives on the platforms above.
translation: 그러면 자네도 그자의 졸개가 될 거야... 가서 마녀 Kardia(카르디아)를 찾게. Iban(이반)을 파멸시킬 비밀은 그 여자가 쥐고 있네. 위쪽 발판에 살지.

english: Niloof, I found the witch's house.
And...?
I found a strange doll.
Ah, I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.
translation: 아, 그 인형 얘기는 들은 적이 있네. 이건 흑마법이야, 여행자. 마녀가 Iban(이반)을 죽음에서 되살렸다고들 하지. 이 인형을 써서 그랬을 걸세.

english: If this doll created Iban, it can also be his end. Find out what process the witch used to revive him and reverse it. Once that's done, cast it into the Well of Voyage. Iban will be destroyed with it.
translation: 이 인형이 Iban(이반)을 만들어 냈다면, 그자의 최후도 될 수 있네. 마녀가 그자를 되살릴 때 쓴 방법을 알아내서 거꾸로 되돌리게. 그게 끝나면 그걸 Well of Voyage(항해의 우물)에 던져 넣게. 그러면 이반도 함께 사라질 걸세.

english: Where is the well?
On the platforms above. Within Iban's foul temple.
translation: 위쪽 발판에 있네. Iban(이반)의 더러운 사원 안에.

english: I found this old book by the way. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
translation: 그건 그렇고, 이 낡은 책을 찾았네. Iban(이반)이 어떻게 되살아났는지 자세히 적혀 있는 것 같아. 그자를 없애는 데 필요한 정보가 들어 있을지도 모르네.

english: Thanks Niloof.
Hi Niloof.
Traveller, thank the stars you're still around! I thought your time had come.
translation: 여행자, 아직 살아 있었다니 천만다행이군! 자네 명이 다한 줄 알았네.

english: I've still a few years in me yet. So what are you still doing down here?
translation: 아직 몇 년은 더 버틸 수 있어요. 그런데 여기서 아직 뭐 하고 계세요?

english: Well with Iban and his lot gone, we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.
translation: 음, Iban(이반)과 그 패거리가 사라지고 나니 자원이 가득한 거대한 동굴이 남았거든. 그래서 원래 여기 온 목적대로 채광이나 제대로 해 보기로 했지.

english: Well Iban and his lot are gone and Lord Iorwerth is no longer an issue. That means we've been left with a great cavern filled with resources. We thought we'd actually do what we came here for and get mining.
translation: 음, Iban(이반)과 그 패거리는 사라졌고 Lord Iorwerth(이오르워스 경)도 더는 골칫거리가 아니네. 덕분에 자원이 가득한 거대한 동굴이 남았지. 그래서 원래 여기 온 목적대로 채광이나 제대로 해 보기로 했다네.

english: Fair enough. Well you take care of yourselves.
And you.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕하세요, 안녕, 안녕하신가요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래 봤자 전부 하나로 치는 거잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 참 멋진 날이죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hi.
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Isn't it wonderful? So many books, so much knowledge to be absorbed!
translation: 정말 멋지지 않아요? 책이 이렇게나 많고, 흡수할 지식도 이렇게나 많다니!

english: You're right, it is.
Where did I see that book? It can't be far...
translation: 그 책을 어디서 봤더라? 멀리 있진 않을 텐데...

english: Uh... Hello?
I'm sure it was around here somewhere...
Okay... Maybe later...
What can I do for ya?
Got any good books to recommend?
I've always found Prifddinas' History to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Prifddinas' History(프리프디나스의 역사)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found The Journal of Randas to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 The Journal of Randas(란다스의 일지)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found Big Book of Bangs to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Big Book of Bangs(쾅쾅 폭발 대백과)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found The Great Divide to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 The Great Divide(대분열)이 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: I've always found Ode to Eternity to be fascinating!
translation: 저는 늘 Ode to Eternity(영원에 바치는 송가)가 정말 흥미롭더라고요!

english: Thanks!
Nothing.
Got any good books to recommend?
Nothing.
Ga ga?
Heeheehee!
*cough*
*gurgle*
*hic*
It still shocks me that the spirits of the river would put such a nasty curse on us for something so small.
translation: 고작 그런 사소한 일로 강의 정령들이 우리에게 그렇게 지독한 저주를 내리다니, 아직도 충격이에요.

english: Well strange are the ways of ancient beings such as them.
translation: 뭐, 그런 고대의 존재들이 하는 일은 원래 알 수 없는 법이죠.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 어떤 작업이 필요하세요?

english: I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
translation: Wooden dresser(나무 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
translation: Wooden cupboard(나무 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like a Wooden drawer built.
translation: Wooden drawer(나무 서랍장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Wooden tables built.
translation: Wooden tables(나무 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my clock fixed.
I'd like a Oak dresser built.
translation: Oak dresser(참나무 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: Oak cupboard(참나무 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak drawer built.
translation: Oak drawer(참나무 서랍장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Oak tables built.
translation: Oak tables(참나무 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak dresser built.
translation: Teak dresser(티크 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
translation: Teak cupboard(티크 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak drawer built.
translation: Teak drawer(티크 서랍장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Teak tables built.
translation: Teak tables(티크 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
translation: Mahogany dresser(마호가니 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: Mahogany cupboard(마호가니 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany drawer built.
translation: Mahogany drawer(마호가니 서랍장) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany tables built.
translation: Mahogany tables(마호가니 식탁) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하시겠어요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 맛있는 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
I have a wide variety of crafting tools on offer, care to take a look?
translation: 여러 가지 공예 도구를 팔고 있어요. 한번 구경해 보시겠어요?

english: Yes please!
No thanks.
Hey you, hands off that!
Thief! You stole from me!
Guards, guards!
Yes please!
No thanks.
Excuse me, what is this place?
What is this place? This is Soul Wars, a glorious battleground where you must fight to crush the souls of your enemies!
translation: 여기가 어떤 곳이냐고? 여긴 Soul Wars(소울 워즈), 적의 영혼을 짓밟기 위해 싸우는 영광스러운 전장이지!

english: Really? Are souls easy to crush?
Easier than you'd imagine.
I see. So how does it all work?
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 전부 어떻게 돌아가는 거예요?

english: I can give you a demonstration if you're interested?
translation: 원한다면 시범을 보여 줄 수 있는데?

english: Let's do it.
Hmm, you're not looking so great. You should cure yourself of poison before I give you the demonstration.
translation: 흠, 몰골이 영 말이 아니군. 시범을 보기 전에 독부터 치료하고 와.

english: Hmm, you don't look so good. You should cure yourself of disease before I give you the demonstration.
translation: 흠, 안색이 안 좋은데. 시범을 보기 전에 병부터 치료하고 와.

english: Hmm, it looks like you have some restricted items with you. You should put them somewhere safe before we continue. Food, potions, capes, followers and non-combat items are all restricted.
translation: 흠, 반입 금지 물품을 가지고 있는 것 같군. 계속하기 전에 안전한 곳에 맡겨 둬. 음식, 물약, 망토, 동행 펫, 비전투 아이템은 전부 반입 금지야.

english: Hmm, it looks like you're not actually ready for a demonstration right now.
translation: 흠, 보아하니 지금은 시범을 볼 준비가 안 된 것 같군.

english: You are not allowed to take part in the Soul Wars demonstration while skulled on a Deadman mode world.
translation: Deadman(데드맨) 모드 월드에서 해골 표시가 붙은 상태로는 Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 시범에 참여할 수 없어.

english: Very well. Let's get started.
Actually, I'm good.
So be it. You know where to find me if you change your mind.
translation: 마음대로 해. 생각이 바뀌면 내가 어디 있는지 알 테지.

english: Ah, you again. Are you ready for that demonstration?
translation: 아, 또 너군. 시범 볼 준비는 됐나?

english: I'll pass.
Ah, you again. If you're here to crush some souls then I'm afraid you won't be able to. I can still help with anything else you need though.
translation: 아, 또 너군. 영혼을 짓밟으러 왔다면 유감이지만 지금은 안 돼. 그래도 다른 볼일이라면 도와줄 수 있지.

english: The Soul Wars minigame is not enabled on this world. You can switch to a Soul Wars world by using the World Switcher in the Logout Menu.
translation: 이 월드에서는 Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 미니게임을 할 수 없어. 로그아웃 메뉴의 월드 전환기를 써서 소울 워즈 월드로 옮겨 가.

english: Ah, you again. Are you here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area if you want to get started.
translation: 아, 또 너군. 영혼을 짓밟으러 왔나? 시작하고 싶으면 대기 구역으로 들어가.

english: Can you tell me more about Soul Wars?
translation: Soul Wars(소울 워즈)에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well I've given you the demonstration. Best thing now is to head into a waiting area and get started. That said, you won't be able to do that at the moment.
translation: 시범은 이미 보여 줬잖아. 이제 대기 구역으로 가서 시작하는 게 제일이지. 그렇긴 해도, 지금 당장은 그럴 수 없을 거야.

english: I can give you the demonstration again if you want? I also have a book that might be useful.
translation: 원한다면 시범을 다시 보여 줄 수 있어. 도움이 될 만한 책도 하나 있고.

english: Well I've given you the demonstration. Best thing now is to head into a waiting area and get started. That said, I can give you the demonstration again if you want? I also have a book that might be useful.
translation: 시범은 이미 보여 줬잖아. 이제 대기 구역으로 가서 시작하는 게 제일이지. 그렇긴 해도, 원한다면 시범을 다시 보여 줄 수 있어. 도움이 될 만한 책도 하나 있고.

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
translation: 시범을 다시 보여 줄 수 있어요?

english: Hmm, you're not looking so great. You should cure yourself of disease before I give you the demonstration.
translation: 흠, 몰골이 영 말이 아니군. 시범을 보기 전에 병부터 치료하고 와.

english: Could I have the book?
translation: 그 책 좀 주실 수 있어요?

english: It looks like you already have one.
translation: 이미 하나 가지고 있는 것 같은데.

english: Oh, alright then.
Is there something else you need?
Of course. Here you go.
Nomad gives you a book.
Now, is there something else you need?
I'm good.
So be it.
Can we talk about rewards?
Certainly! I sell various rewards to those who have earned Zeal from Soul Wars battles.
translation: 물론이지! Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 전투에서 Zeal(열의)를 얻은 자들에게 여러 가지 보상을 팔고 있어.

english: What kinds of rewards are there?
I can offer you some of my knowledge in various skills, I can use my abilities to imbue some of your items with additional power, and I also have some items I have found on my travels.
translation: 여러 스킬에 대한 내 지식을 조금 나눠 줄 수도 있고, 내 힘으로 네 아이템 몇 개에 추가적인 힘을 주입해 줄 수도 있지. 여행하면서 찾아낸 아이템도 몇 개 있고.

english: Would you like to see?
Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well. Is there something else you need?
Can we talk about ammunition?
How are the new capes working out for you?
Just fine, thanks!
Great, now get back in there and crush some souls!
translation: 좋아, 그럼 다시 들어가서 영혼이나 짓밟고 와!

english: Yes, right away!
Not bad. But I was wondering if they could be improved any further?
translation: 나쁘지 않아요. 그런데 이걸 더 강화할 수는 없을까 해서요.

english: Well if you show me a better device I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 더 나은 장치를 보여 준다면 뭔가 손써 줄 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: How about this one?
You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again. I might be able to do something if you show me a better one, though.
translation: 이 deadchicken은 이미 보여 줬잖아. 다시 볼 필요는 없어. 더 나은 걸 보여 준다면 뭔가 해 줄 수 있을지도 모르지만.

english: Hmm, very interesting. Let's see what we can do.
translation: 흠, 아주 흥미롭군. 어디 한번 해 보자고.

english: There we go! It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 다 됐다! 완전히 똑같지는 않지만, 너한테는 충분히 쓸 만할 거야.

english: Bear in mind that the enchantment is bound to my power and so will only work for you while you are in a Soul Wars battle.
translation: 명심해. 이 마법은 내 힘에 묶여 있어서 Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 전투 중에만 효과가 있어.

english: Great! Thanks for the help!
I don't really have time to discuss the finer points of Fletching, you know.
translation: Fletching(활 제작)의 세세한 요령 따위를 논할 시간은 없다고.

english: No, not like that! You see, I helped create a device which returns my ammunition.
translation: 아뇨, 그런 게 아니라요! 사실 제가 쏜 탄약을 회수해 주는 장치를 만드는 걸 도왔거든요.

english: Really? If you could show it to me, I might be able to sort something out for you.
translation: 정말? 그걸 보여 준다면 뭔가 손써 줄 수 있을지도 모르지.

english: I don't want to talk to you.
Huh?
Yikes!
Oh boy.
Welcome to Soul Wars! Let's get started.
translation: Soul Wars(소울 워즈)에 온 걸 환영한다! 시작하지.

english: So, what's this place all about?
translation: 그래서, 여긴 대체 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: To the south you will have seen an avatar. You must fight to protect your team's avatar, and defeat the opposing team's avatar.
translation: 남쪽에서 아바타를 봤겠지. 너는 네 팀의 아바타를 지키면서 상대 팀의 아바타를 쓰러뜨려야 해.

english: Are you crazy? Have you seen the size of it?
You're here to fight, not whine.
translation: 넌 싸우러 온 거지, 징징대러 온 게 아니야.

english: But how am I supposed to take on one of those?
translation: 그런데 저런 걸 대체 어떻게 상대하라는 거예요?

english: By capturing the Soul Obelisk, which lies at the centre of the battleground, and offering it soul fragments.
translation: 전장 한가운데 있는 Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)를 점령하고, 거기에 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 바치는 거지.

english: Let's head towards the Obelisk now. I can point out some of the important landmarks on the way. Meet me to the north when you are ready to learn more.
translation: 이제 Obelisk(오벨리스크) 쪽으로 가 보자. 가는 길에 중요한 지점들을 알려 주지. 더 배울 준비가 되면 북쪽에서 만나.

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports northwards.
Hey! Where are you going?
Only the red team may enter this graveyard.
translation: 이 묘지에는 레드 팀만 들어갈 수 있어.

english: Hey! You don't need those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 이봐! 그건 필요 없어. 아직 진짜 전투가 아니라고.

english: You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: 그 불쌍한 imp(임프)를 괴롭힐 이유는 없잖아.

english: Hey! Don't attack those. You're not in a real battle yet.
translation: 이봐! 그건 공격하지 마. 아직 진짜 전투가 아니라고.

english: To continue the demonstration, come speak to me. I'm by the avatar in the south-west of the battleground.
translation: 시범을 계속하려면 나한테 와서 말을 걸어. 난 전장 남서쪽의 아바타 옆에 있다.

english: This is one of the graveyards that your team can capture.
