translation: 여기는 너희 팀이 점령할 수 있는 묘지 중 하나야.

english: For the purposes of this demonstration, however, I have kept it inactive.
translation: 하지만 이번 시범에서는 비활성 상태로 놔뒀지.

english: You might find this little area behind me useful for defending your avatar. There's one in the other team's base, too.
translation: 내 뒤에 있는 이 작은 구역은 아바타를 지킬 때 쓸모가 있을 거야. 상대 팀 기지에도 하나 있지.

english: During battle, you can gather supplies here to aid you and your teammates.
translation: 전투 중에는 여기서 너와 팀원들에게 도움이 될 보급품을 챙길 수 있어.

english: The Soul Obelisk is just a little way from here. Let's continue on; I'll meet you to the east.
translation: Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)는 여기서 조금만 가면 돼. 계속 가자고. 동쪽에서 만나지.

english: The screen fades to black and Nomad teleports eastwards.
Now, to have a chance against an avatar, you are going to need souls. Lots of souls.
translation: 자, 아바타를 상대로 승산이 있으려면 영혼이 필요해. 아주 많은 영혼이.

english: What am I going to do with souls?
The Soul Obelisk is immensely powerful and, by channelling souls into it, you can weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)는 엄청나게 강력해서, 거기에 영혼을 흘려 넣으면 적 아바타를 약화시킬 수 있지.

english: How does that work?
All I know is that it does, and that you should do it. Lots.
translation: 내가 아는 건 그게 된다는 것, 그리고 넌 그걸 해야 한다는 것뿐이야. 아주 많이.

english: So, where do I get these souls from?
You can kill the souls that inhabit the arena ruins and harvest their soul fragments.
translation: 경기장 폐허에 사는 영혼들을 죽이고 그들의 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 거둬들이면 돼.

english: For the purposes of this demonstration however, we will use my minion Zimberfizz.
translation: 하지만 이번 시범에서는 내 부하 Zimberfizz(짐버피즈)를 쓸 거다.

english: Zimberfizz! Heel!
Zimberfizz appears.
When you kill a creature in Soul Wars, they will leave a soul fragment behind, which you can use to charge the Soul Obelisk.
translation: Soul Wars(소울 워즈)에서 생물을 죽이면 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 남기는데, 그걸로 Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)를 충전할 수 있어.

english: Zimberfizz has such a soul fragment. Why don't you kill him and take it?
translation: Zimberfizz(짐버피즈)가 마침 그런 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 갖고 있지. 녀석을 죽이고 그걸 가져가는 게 어때?

english: You want me to kill him?
Yes!
Come on! Kill him already and get that soul fragment.
translation: 어서! 빨리 죽이고 그 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 챙겨.

english: Good job! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 잘했어! 이제 Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)로 가서 이 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 흘려 넣자. 바로 동쪽에 있어. 다리를 건너면 나오는 작은 섬 위에.

english: Good job! Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: 잘했어! 자, soul fragment(영혼 조각)은 챙겼겠지?

english: About that...
You've lost it? You're lucky you're not in a real battle yet!
translation: 잃어버렸다고? 아직 진짜 전투가 아니라서 운이 좋은 줄 알아!

english: Here, have this one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 자, 이거 받아. 이번엔 잘 간수해.

english: Make some space and I'll give you one. Just look after it this time.
translation: 소지품 자리를 좀 비우면 하나 주지. 이번엔 잘 간수해.

english: I'll try...
Now! Let's carry on to the Soul Obelisk and channel this soul fragment into it. It's just to the east, over a bridge and on a small island.
translation: 자! 이제 Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)로 가서 이 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 흘려 넣자. 바로 동쪽에 있어. 다리를 건너면 나오는 작은 섬 위에.

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, you've got that soul fragment, right?
translation: Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)에 도착했다. 자, soul fragment(영혼 조각)은 챙겼겠지?

english: Here we are at the Soul Obelisk. Now, to reap the full benefit of the soul fragment, you will need to first be in control of the Obelisk.
translation: Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)에 도착했다. 자, soul fragment(영혼 조각)의 효과를 제대로 보려면 먼저 Obelisk(오벨리스크)를 장악해야 해.

english: How do I do that?
Various areas of the battleground can come under your team's control. To gain control, you must have more team members than the opposing team in these areas.
translation: 전장의 여러 구역을 너희 팀이 장악할 수 있어. 장악하려면 그 구역에 상대 팀보다 더 많은 팀원이 있어야 하지.

english: If you outnumber the enemy, you will gradually take control. Let's try it out now.
translation: 적보다 수가 많으면 점점 장악하게 돼. 지금 한번 해 보자고.

english: We shall use Zimberfizz to represent an enemy team member.
translation: 적 팀원 역할은 Zimberfizz(짐버피즈)가 맡을 거다.

english: Minion! Heel!
Zimberfizz appears again.
Come on, give him a good kick.
translation: 어서, 한 방 세게 걷어차 줘.

english: I thought he was dead? Didn't we kill him earlier?
translation: 쟤 죽은 거 아니었어요? 아까 우리가 죽였잖아요?

english: Ha! He wishes! No, his service to me is far from over.
translation: 하! 그랬으면 좋겠지! 아니, 녀석이 나를 섬길 날은 아직 한참 남았어.

english: Poor little guy.
Ha! I'm sure he loves the attention, right Zimberfizz?
translation: 하! 관심받아서 좋아할걸, 안 그래, Zimberfizz(짐버피즈)?

english: Zimberfizz appears yet again.
Right, now that Zimberfizz is no longer in the Obelisk's capturable area, you outnumber the enemy! The Soul Obelisk will now begin to fall under your control.
translation: 좋아, Zimberfizz(짐버피즈)가 이제 Obelisk(오벨리스크)의 점령 구역 밖으로 나갔으니 네가 적보다 수가 많다! 이제 Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)가 네 손에 들어오기 시작할 거야.

english: Right. Now, go and charge the Obelisk with that soul fragment and see what happens.
translation: 좋아. 이제 가서 그 soul fragment(영혼 조각)으로 Obelisk(오벨리스크)를 충전하고 어떻게 되는지 봐.

english: Go on, use the soul fragment on the Obelisk.
translation: 어서, soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 Obelisk(오벨리스크)에 사용해.

english: You charge the Soul Obelisk and weaken the enemy avatar.
translation: Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)를 충전해 적 아바타를 약화시켰다.

english: Good job! Now that you have charged the Obelisk, the enemy avatar will have been weakened.
translation: 잘했어! Obelisk(오벨리스크)를 충전했으니 적 아바타는 약해졌을 거야.

english: Note the display in the top-left of the screen. See how the red avatar's strength has decreased.
translation: 화면 왼쪽 위의 표시를 봐. 레드 아바타의 힘이 줄어든 게 보이지.

english: The number shown here represents the percentage of your damage that the avatar will block.
translation: 여기 나온 숫자는 네 피해량 중 아바타가 막아 내는 비율을 뜻해.

english: So, once I've charged the Obelisk, can I just kick back and wait for the end of the game?
translation: 그럼 Obelisk(오벨리스크)를 한 번 충전하고 나면 그냥 편히 쉬면서 게임이 끝나길 기다려도 돼요?

english: Ha! I think not! I'm not about to reward those who don't put the effort in!
translation: 하! 어림없지! 노력도 안 하는 놈들한테 보상을 줄 생각은 없어!

english: Note the orange bar in the top-left of the screen. This bar represents how active you have been during the game.
translation: 화면 왼쪽 위의 주황색 막대를 봐. 이 막대는 게임 중에 네가 얼마나 활발하게 움직였는지를 나타내.

english: Over the course of the battle, the bar will slowly drain. Should the bar drain completely you will be removed from the game due to your inactivity.
translation: 전투가 진행되는 동안 막대는 천천히 줄어들어. 막대가 완전히 바닥나면 활동하지 않은 걸로 간주돼서 게임에서 쫓겨날 거야.

english: You can refill the bar by performing actions in the game, such as dealing damage or charging the Obelisk.
translation: 피해를 입히거나 Obelisk(오벨리스크)를 충전하는 것처럼 게임 안에서 행동을 하면 막대를 다시 채울 수 있어.

english: Oh well. Say, do you think the enemy avatar minds us weakening it like this?
translation: 뭐, 어쩔 수 없죠. 그런데 적 아바타는 우리가 이렇게 약화시키는 걸 싫어하지 않을까요?

english: Hmm, why don't we go find out?
translation: 흠, 직접 가서 알아보는 게 어때?

english: The screen fades to black. The player and Nomad are now by the red team's avatar area.
translation: 화면이 어두워진다. 플레이어와 Nomad(노마드)는 이제 레드 팀의 아바타 구역 옆에 있다.

english: So, here we are in the enemy base.
Is that the enemy avatar over there?
Yeah, and it looks like you made it pretty mad.
translation: 그래. 네가 꽤나 화나게 만든 모양이군.

english: What? You're the one that told me to weaken it!
Ha! Don't worry - I won't let it kill you.
translation: 하! 걱정 마. 저게 널 죽이게 두진 않을 테니.

english: Phew!
Of course, that doesn't mean I won't kill you.
translation: 물론, 그렇다고 내가 널 안 죽인다는 뜻은 아니지.

english: What did you say?
Argh!
Wooooooooooo!
What?
Woooooo! Woooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 미안하지만 난 유령 말은 못 해.

english: There we go! Much better.
Hey! You killed me.
At least it wasn't permanent! Think of it as an opportunity to learn.
translation: 적어도 영원히 죽은 건 아니잖아! 배울 기회라고 생각해.

english: How so?
The other team will be after you and any soul fragments you have collected, after all.
translation: 어쨌든 상대 팀은 너와 네가 모은 soul fragment(영혼 조각)을 노릴 테니까.

english: I needed to show you what happens when you fall in battle.
translation: 전투에서 쓰러지면 어떻게 되는지 보여 줄 필요가 있었지.

english: Did you turn me into a ghost?
Not exactly. The Soul Obelisk tried to claim your soul, as it does with all who perish in the battleground.
translation: 꼭 그렇진 않아. Soul Obelisk(영혼 오벨리스크)가 네 영혼을 거두려 한 거지. 전장에서 죽는 모든 자에게 그러듯이.

english: Only my power brought you here, and returned you to life.
translation: 오직 내 힘만이 너를 여기로 데려와 되살려 낸 거야.

english: Erm, thanks, I guess.
You're more useful to me alive... for now.
translation: 넌 살아 있는 게 나한테 더 쓸모 있으니까... 아직은.

english: Are there any other painful things to learn about this place?
translation: 여기서 배워야 할 고통스러운 건 또 없어요?

english: There is much more to this place, but you don't need to know about it yet.
translation: 이곳엔 훨씬 더 많은 게 있지만, 아직 알 필요는 없어.

english: If you want to learn more, I can give you a Soul Wars guide upon our return to the waiting area.
translation: 더 배우고 싶다면 대기 구역으로 돌아간 뒤에 Soul Wars guide(소울 워즈 안내서)를 줄 수 있어.

english: Use the large blue portal at the back of this graveyard to return to the waiting area. Why not sign up for a battle while you're there?
translation: 이 묘지 뒤쪽에 있는 커다란 파란 포털을 이용해 대기 구역으로 돌아가. 간 김에 전투에 참가 신청이라도 하는 게 어때?

english: Use the portal over there to return to the waiting area. I'll see you on the other side!
translation: 저기 있는 포털을 이용해 대기 구역으로 돌아가. 반대편에서 보자고!

english: Here we are. The waiting areas are just south of here, but you won't be able to join a battle right now.
translation: 도착했다. 대기 구역은 여기서 바로 남쪽에 있지만, 지금은 전투에 참가할 수 없을 거야.

english: Here we are. Just head south to the waiting areas if you want to join a battle.
translation: 도착했다. 전투에 참가하고 싶으면 남쪽의 대기 구역으로 가.

english: That's all well and good, but what do I get out of all of this?
translation: 다 좋은데, 이걸 해서 제가 얻는 건 뭐예요?

english: I can offer you experience in various skills, and items I have found on my travels.
translation: 여러 스킬의 경험치와, 여행하면서 찾아낸 아이템들을 줄 수 있지.

english: I have a copy of the Soul Wars guide here. It contains information that I didn't have time to cover.
translation: 여기 Soul Wars guide(소울 워즈 안내서)가 한 부 있어. 내가 미처 다루지 못한 정보가 담겨 있지.

english: You don't need to know it all to get started, but the section on burying bones could be useful.
translation: 시작하는 데 전부 알 필요는 없지만, 뼈 묻기에 관한 부분은 쓸모가 있을 거야.

english: Did you want to take it and read it in your own time?
translation: 가져가서 시간 날 때 읽어 볼 텐가?

english: Yes,please.
Hmm, it looks like you already have one.
translation: 흠, 이미 하나 가지고 있는 것 같은데.

english: Oh, alright then.
Here you go.
Thanks!
Okay, thanks.
Check out this deadchicken!
You've already shown me this deadchicken. I don't really need to see it again.
translation: 이 deadchicken은 이미 보여 줬잖아. 다시 볼 필요는 없어.

english: Fair enough.
Nomad won't consider looking at Ava's devices until you've completed Animal Magnetism
translation: Animal Magnetism(동물적 자력)을 완료하기 전에는 Nomad(노마드)가 Ava(아바)의 장치를 봐 주지 않는다.

english: Hmm, very interesting.
I was wondering if you could maybe make your capes do something similar to what this does?
translation: 혹시 당신 망토도 이거랑 비슷한 기능을 하게 만들어 줄 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Let's see what we can do.
Nomad mutters an incantation and enchants your Soul Wars capes!
translation: Nomad(노마드)가 주문을 중얼거리며 당신의 Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 망토에 마법을 건다!

english: There we go. It's not quite the same, but it should work out just fine for you.
translation: 다 됐다. 완전히 똑같지는 않지만, 너한테는 충분히 쓸 만할 거야.

english: Hmm, very interesting. This one seems more powerful than the last one you showed me.
translation: 흠, 아주 흥미롭군. 이건 지난번에 보여 준 것보다 더 강력해 보이는데.

english: That's right. I was wondering if you could maybe upgrade your capes again?
translation: 맞아요. 혹시 당신 망토를 한 번 더 강화해 줄 수 있을까 해서요.

english: The time is now! Crush their souls!
Well I'm still getting things set up right now. Once everything is ready, return to me and I'll give you a demonstration.
translation: 아직 준비하는 중이야. 모든 준비가 끝나면 다시 와. 그때 시범을 보여 주지.

english: The Soul Wars minigame will be released on the 6th January 2021.
translation: Soul Wars(소울 워즈) 미니게임은 2021년 1월 6일에 출시될 예정이다.

english: Here to crush some souls? Just head into a waiting area to the south to get started.
translation: 영혼을 짓밟으러 왔나? 시작하려면 남쪽의 대기 구역으로 들어가.

english: Let's do it.
Actually, I'm good.
I'll pass.
Can you tell me more about Soul Wars?
translation: Soul Wars(소울 워즈)에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Could you give me the demonstration again?
translation: 시범을 다시 보여 줄 수 있어요?

english: Could I have the book?
translation: 그 책 좀 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can we talk about rewards?
Can we talk about ammunition?
I'm good.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Yes, right away!
Fair enough.
Great! Thanks for the help!
I see. I'll be back later.
I don't want to talk to you.
Hello little one.
I may be small but at least I'm perfectly formed.
What's your favourite rock?
You're going tufa with that question. That's personal.
translation: 질문이 너무 돌직구잖아. 그건 사적인 거야.

english: Was just trying to make light conversation, not trying to aggregate you.
translation: 그냥 가볍게 얘기 좀 하려던 거지, 널 돌게 하려던 건 아니었어.

english: Metaphorically speaking, do you have a heart of stone?
translation: 비유적으로 말해서, 넌 돌로 된 심장을 가졌니?

english: Yes, but you're not having it.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello little other one.
Other?
Yes, don't you have a sister?
I don't want to chalk about it.
Sometimes I'm worried you'll attack me whilst my back is turned.
translation: 가끔은 내가 등 돌린 사이에 네가 날 공격할까 봐 걱정돼.

english: Are you petrified of my tuffness?
translation: 내 단단함에 겁먹고 돌처럼 굳어 버렸어?

english: Not really, but your puns are awful.
translation: 딱히. 근데 네 말장난은 진짜 끔찍해.

english: I thought they were clastic.
translation: 난 돌풍을 일으킬 명작인 줄 알았는데.

english: I feel like our relationship is slowly eroding away.
translation: 우리 관계가 서서히 풍화돼 가는 느낌이야.

english: Geode willing.
translation: 제발 그렇게 돼라. 돌이킬 수 없게.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You new here? I don't recognise you.
translation: 자네 새로 왔나? 처음 보는 얼굴이군.

english: That's right, I'm [Vampyre name].
Well, [Vampyre name], welcome to the essence mine.
translation: 그래, [Vampyre name], 정수 광산에 온 걸 환영하네.

english: Essence mine?
That's right. Here, we use the slaves to mine daeyalt essence.
translation: 그렇다네. 여기서는 노예들을 부려 daeyalt essence(데이얄트 정수)를 캐게 하지.

english: Daeyalt essence? Is that connected to daeyalt ore?
translation: 데이얄트 정수요? 그게 daeyalt ore(데이얄트 광석)과 관련이 있나요?

english: Indeed it is. Daeyalt ore is a weaker form of daeyalt essence. It still has uses, hence why we have the slaves mine it. The essence here is far more powerful though.
translation: 그렇다네. Daeyalt ore(데이얄트 광석)은 데이얄트 정수보다 약한 형태일세. 그래도 쓸모가 있어서 노예들에게 캐게 하지. 하지만 이곳의 정수는 훨씬 더 강력하다네.

english: Where did it come from?
They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 듣자 하니 예전에 바로 이 동굴에 엄청난 힘을 지닌 물건이 보관되어 있었다더군. 그 물건의 존재 때문에 데이얄트 매장층이 생겨났다고 하지.

english: I see. What is the daeyalt used for?
Its main use is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. It can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: 주된 용도는 뱀파이어화 과정의 핵심 재료일세. 다른 용도도 있지. 예를 들면 룬을 만드는 데 쓸 수도 있다네.

english: Am I allowed some?
The essence mined by the slaves is reserved. If you want some, you'll have to mine your own.
translation: 노예들이 캔 정수는 이미 용도가 정해져 있네. 원한다면 자네가 직접 캐야 할 걸세.

english: If you do choose to mine the deposits, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used.
translation: 매장층을 직접 캐기로 한다면 알아 두게. 자네가 얻을 daeyalt shards(데이얄트 파편)은 그 자체로는 쓸모가 없네. 쓰려면 정수로 변환해야 하지.

english: How do I do that?
Luckily for you, I can provide that service.
translation: 운 좋게도, 내가 그 일을 해 줄 수 있다네.

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. Normally I'd send the converted essence straight to your bank, but as you seem to carry all of your belongings yourself, I'll just give it right to you instead.
translation: 변환할 파편이 생기면 언제든 내게 가져오게. 보통은 변환한 정수를 곧장 자네 은행으로 보내 주지만, 자네는 소지품을 전부 직접 들고 다니는 것 같으니 그냥 바로 건네주겠네.

english: Whenever you have shards to convert, bring them to me. I will send the converted essence straight to your bank.
translation: 변환할 파편이 생기면 언제든 내게 가져오게. 변환한 정수는 곧장 자네 은행으로 보내 주겠네.

english: Great! Thanks for the help.
Oh, one other thing. The daeyalt almost seems to have a mind of its own. Only one deposit will be active at a time. You'll need to pay attention to which one it is.
translation: 아, 한 가지 더. 데이얄트는 마치 제 의지가 있는 것처럼 군다네. 한 번에 매장층 하나만 활성화되니, 어느 것인지 잘 살펴봐야 할 걸세.

english: I see. I'll bear that in mind.
Need something?
Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: 파편 좀 변환해 주실 수 있어요?

english: As you wish. I'll give any shards I convert straight to you. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 좋을 대로. 변환한 파편은 바로 자네에게 주겠네. 몇 개나 변환해 주길 원하나?

english: As you wish. Once I convert these shards, I will send them to your bank. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 좋을 대로. 파편을 변환하면 자네 은행으로 보내 주겠네. 몇 개나 변환해 주길 원하나?

english: No. You don't have any.
translation: 안 되네. 자네는 파편이 하나도 없잖나.

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
It comes in two forms, essence and ores. Both have their uses, but the essence is far more powerful.
translation: 데이얄트는 정수와 광석, 두 가지 형태로 나온다네. 둘 다 쓸모가 있지만 정수 쪽이 훨씬 더 강력하지.

english: And it's only found here?
Yes. They say that an object of great power was once stored in this very cave. Apparently, the presence of this object created the daeyalt deposits.
translation: 그렇다네. 듣자 하니 예전에 바로 이 동굴에 엄청난 힘을 지닌 물건이 보관되어 있었다더군. 그 물건의 존재 때문에 데이얄트 매장층이 생겨났다고 하지.

english: The main use of daeyalt is as a key component in the vampyrification process. There's other uses though. The essence can be used to create runes, for example.
translation: daeyalt(데이얄트)의 주된 용도는 뱀파이어화 과정의 핵심 재료일세. 다른 용도도 있지. 예를 들면 정수로 룬을 만들 수도 있다네.

english: And I'm allowed to mine it?
Indeed. However, you should know that the daeyalt shards you'll get are useless on their own. They'll need converting into essence to be used. That is a service I can provide.
translation: 물론일세. 하지만 알아 두게. 자네가 얻을 daeyalt shards(데이얄트 파편)은 그 자체로는 쓸모가 없네. 쓰려면 정수로 변환해야 하지. 그 일은 내가 해 줄 수 있다네.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Do you need something else?
I'm good.
You're not one of the slaves assigned to this mine! Go back to the pens before I call the guards!
translation: 자네는 이 광산에 배정된 노예가 아니잖나! 경비병을 부르기 전에 우리로 돌아가게!

english: Could you convert some shards for me?
translation: 파편 좀 변환해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Tell me about daeyalt.
I'm good.
Hello.
Quickly, tell me - is it still there?
translation: 빨리, 말해 줘요. 그게 아직 거기 있어요?

english: Is what still where?
The THING, the THING! It was just outside my house! Has it gone away yet? Or is it still lurking out there, waiting for me to go outside?
translation: 그것 말이에요, 그것! 바로 우리 집 밖에 있었다고요! 이제 사라졌어요? 아니면 아직도 밖에 숨어서 내가 나오길 기다리고 있어요?

english: I didn't see any THING out there, just a couple of guards. What did it look like?
translation: 밖에 그런 건 못 봤는데요. 경비병 몇 명뿐이었어요. 어떻게 생겼는데요?

english: Ohhhh, it was HORRIBLE! It was an enormous THING, with TEETH and EYES and... and... and THINGS!
translation: 으으으, 끔찍했어요! 어마어마하게 큰 그것이었는데, 이빨이랑 눈이랑... 그리고... 그리고... 그런 것들이 달려 있었어요!

english: Um... would you care to be more specific?
translation: 음... 좀 더 자세히 말해 줄래요?

english: I can't. I only saw it in the dark.
You only saw this THING in the dark?

I was sleeping peacefully one night, when suddenly I woke up and saw it through the window. It was LOOKING at me! I haven't dared go out since then. It's had me trapped in here for days! I've packed my
translation: 어느 날 밤 곤히 자고 있었는데, 갑자기 깨서 창문 너머로 그걸 봤어요. 그게 날 쳐다보고 있었다고요! 그 뒤로는 감히 밖에 나가지도 못했어요. 며칠째 여기 갇혀 있다고요! 도망치려고

english: bags so I can escape, but the THING's still out there waiting for me to come out! If I have to stay in here much longer I'll go mad! MAD!! MAD!!!
translation: 짐까지 다 싸 뒀는데, 그것이 아직도 밖에서 내가 나오길 기다리고 있어요! 여기 더 오래 있다간 미쳐 버릴 거예요! 미쳐! 미쳐 버릴 거라고요!!!

english: There's no THING outside. Just come out and get some fresh air before you go funny in the head.
translation: 밖에 그런 건 없어요. 머리가 이상해지기 전에 그냥 나와서 바람이나 좀 쐬세요.

english: You want me to go outside?
I think you might just have dreamed about the THING.
translation: 그냥 그것에 대한 꿈을 꾼 것 같은데요.

english: You want me to believe that it's not real?
Please come outside!
No! No! I know what you are! You're in league with the THING! It keeps sending people in here to trick me into going outside! They keep stealing from me too! GO AWAY!
translation: 안 돼! 안 돼! 당신 정체를 알아요! 당신 그것과 한패죠! 그게 자꾸 사람들을 보내서 날 속여 밖으로 끌어내려 한다고요! 게다가 다들 내 물건까지 훔쳐 가요! 꺼져요!

english: I'm not trying to trick you!
Get thee gone, trickster!
Sheesh...
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
translation: 파티 룸에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는 거야?

english: Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 지금 파티 룸에 값비싼 아이템이 있어!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
Hey wanna trade? I'll give the best deals you can find.
translation: 이봐요, 거래할래요? 어디서도 못 볼 최고의 조건으로 해 드릴게요.

english: No thanks.
How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: 어떻게 그렇게 싸게 팔 수 있어요?

english: The general stores in Asgarnia and Misthalin are heavily taxed. It really makes it hard for them to run an effective business. For some reason taxmen don't visit my store.
translation: Asgarnia(아스가르니아)랑 Misthalin(미스탈린)의 잡화점들은 세금을 엄청 뜯기거든요. 그래서 장사를 제대로 하기가 정말 힘들죠. 근데 왠지 세금 징수원들이 제 가게엔 안 오더라고요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
How can you afford to give such good deals?
translation: 어떻게 그렇게 싸게 팔 수 있어요?

english: Hi there!
Greetings, iknami. It's good to see so many who are willing to contribute to the Final Dawn. The word of the Augur has changed everything. The time to act is now.
translation: 반갑습니다, iknami(이크나미). Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 힘을 보태려는 이들이 이렇게 많다니 기쁩니다. Augur(점술사)님의 말씀이 모든 것을 바꾸어 놓았습니다. 지금이 바로 행동할 때입니다.

english: Augur?
You have not heard? She is the one who now leads the Emissaries. She has taken this once helpless collective and turned them into the ones who will guide us all to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 못 들으셨습니까? 그분께서 이제 Emissaries(사절단)을 이끌고 계십니다. 무력하던 이 모임을, 우리 모두를 Mokhaiotl(목하이오틀)에게로 인도할 자들로 바꾸어 놓으셨지요.

english: How do you know all this? You're not even a member yet.
translation: 그걸 어떻게 다 알아요? 아직 회원도 아니잖아요.

english: I was once. In my time of need, I turned to the Emissaries, but they were even more helpless than I was.
translation: 한때는 회원이었습니다. 어려울 때 사절단에 의지했지만, 그들은 저보다도 더 무력했지요.

english: Now though, she has changed everything. Now it is my duty to rejoin their ranks so that we may bring about the Final Dawn.
translation: 하지만 이제 그분께서 모든 것을 바꾸어 놓으셨습니다. 이제 다시 그들의 대열에 합류해 최후의 새벽을 불러오는 것이 제 의무입니다.

english: I see. Thanks for the information.
Hello.
Hello traveller, how's things?
Not bad thanks, yourself?
I'm good, just working hard as usual...
translation: 저도 좋아요. 늘 그렇듯 열심히 일하는 중이죠...

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon.
translation: 혹시 대포를 하나 파실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: Hmmmmmm...
I shouldn't really, but as you helped us so much, well, I could sort something out. I'll warn you though, they don't come cheap!
translation: 원래는 그러면 안 되지만, 그쪽이 우리를 많이 도와줬으니... 뭐, 어떻게든 해 볼게요. 그래도 미리 말해 두는데, 싸지는 않아요!

english: How much?
For the full setup, 750,000 coins. Or I can sell you the separate parts... but it'll cost extra!
translation: 전체 세트는 750,000코인이에요. 부품을 따로따로 팔 수도 있지만... 그러면 더 비싸요!

english: That's not cheap!
Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
Okay then, but keep it quiet... This thing's top secret!
translation: 좋아요, 대신 조용히 해 줘요... 이건 일급 기밀이니까요!

english: You give the Cannon engineer 750,000 coins...
He gives you the four parts that make the cannon, plus an ammo mould and an instruction manual.
translation: 그가 대포를 이루는 부품 네 개와 함께 ammo mould(탄환 거푸집)과 instruction manual(사용 설명서)를 건네준다.

english: There you go, you be careful with that thing.
Will do, take care mate.
Take care adventurer.
Oops, I don't have enough money.
Sorry, I can't go any lower than that.
Can I look at the separate parts please?
Of course!
Sorry, that's too much for me.
Fair enough, it's too much for most of us.
Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
Well, take care of yourself then.
Indeed I will adventurer.
I want to know more about the cannon.
There's only so much I can tell you, adventurer. We've been working on this little beauty for some time now.
translation: 말해 줄 수 있는 건 한정돼 있어요, 모험가님. 우린 이 귀여운 녀석을 꽤 오랫동안 개발해 왔거든요.

english: Is it effective?
In short bursts it's very effective, the most destructive weapon to date. The cannon automatically targets monsters close by. You just have to make the ammo and let rip.
translation: 짧게 몰아칠 때는 아주 효과적이죠. 지금까지 나온 무기 중 가장 파괴적이에요. 대포가 근처 몬스터를 자동으로 조준하니까, 탄환만 만들어서 마구 쏘면 돼요.

english: I've lost my cannon.
That's unfortunate... but don't worry, I can sort you out.
translation: 안됐네요... 그래도 걱정 마요, 내가 어떻게든 해 줄게요.

english: Keep that quiet or I'll be in real trouble!
translation: 이건 비밀로 해 줘요. 안 그러면 나 정말 큰일 나요!

english: Of course.
Oh dear, I'm only allowed to replace cannons that were stolen in action. I'm sorry, but you'll have to buy a new set.
translation: 이런, 나는 작전 중에 도둑맞은 대포만 교체해 줄 수 있어요. 미안하지만 새 세트를 사야 해요.

english: I was hoping you might sell me a cannon?
translation: 혹시 대포를 하나 파실 수 있을까요?

english: Okay, I'll take a cannon please.
Can I look at the separate parts please?
Sorry, that's too much for me.
Have you any ammo or instructions to sell?
Well, take care of yourself then.
I want to know more about the cannon.
I've lost my cannon.
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 광석을 올리면 제련해 줄게. boiler(보일러)에 불 때는 거랑 나머지 기계 돌리는 건 우리가 맡아.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 대신 파이프가 터질 때마다 용광로 수리를 도와야 해. 그냥 망치로 두들기면 돼. 보통은 그걸로 고쳐져.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 우리 일삯은 coffer(금고)에 돈을 넣어서 내야 해. 시간당 72,000코인이고, 네가 이 방에 우리랑 같이 있는 동안 계속 돈이 빠져나가.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 나랑 내 형제들은 성장에 영향을 주는 희귀한 유전 질환이 있어. 우릴 괴물 취급하기보다는, 그 덕에 우리가 기계를 다룰 수 있다는 게 얼마나 쓸모 있는지나 좀 알아주면 좋겠군.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 괜찮아, 인간. 그 얘기 꺼낸 게 네가 처음도 아니니까. 그래서, 필요한 거 있어? 나 여기서 할 일 있거든.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ... 이봐, 도움이 필요한 거야, 아니면 그냥 무례하게 굴려고 온 거야? 나 할 일 있다고.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
Hey fishy. If you's a good fishy I might sell yous bitses of skippy skin clothes.
translation: 어이 물꼬기. 너 착한 물꼬기면 눙이 스키피 껍데기 옷 쪼가리 팔지도 몰라.

english: But Nung needs time to makes them first.
translation: 근데 눙이 먼저 만들 시간 필요해.

english: Hey, silly fishy wit da round head!
Ya! What kinda fishy you's tinkin you are?
translation: 야! 너 니가 무슨 물꼬기라고 생각해?

english: I'm not any kind of fishy, err, fish.
translation: 저 물꼬기 아니에요, 어, 물고기 아니라고요.

english: Well what you doin' here if you's no a fishy?
translation: 그럼 물꼬기 아니면 여기서 뭐 해?

english: Well I'm trying to get some Giant Crab meat.
translation: Giant Crab meat(거대 게살)을 좀 구하려고요.

english: Dis fishy is a funny fishy!
Whats this fishy wanting?
You see those big crabs? I want one of those.
translation: 저 큰 게들 보이죠? 저거 하나 갖고 싶어요.

english: You's here to stealin' my big crunchy claws?
translation: 너 눙 크고 아삭한 집게발 훔치러 왔어?

english: Nung should smash your stoopid round head!
translation: 눙이 니 멍청한 둥근 머리 박살 내야겠다!

english: Always the big nettings was taking my big crunchy claws, I put them in the cages, and now you's come to get them.
translation: 맨날 큰 그물들이 눙 크고 아삭한 집게발 가져갔어. 그래서 눙이 우리에 가둬 놨는데, 이제 너 그거 가지러 왔어.

english: Swim away little fishy or I eat you till you's dead!
translation: 헤엄쳐 가, 꼬마 물꼬기. 안 그럼 눙이 너 죽을 때까지 먹는다!

english: Wait, could I buy some of the crab meat?
translation: 잠깐만요, 게살을 좀 살 수는 없을까요?

english: Silly round head fishy want to swaps big crunchy claws?
translation: 바보 둥근 머리 물꼬기가 크고 아삭한 집게발 바꾸고 싶어?

english: Naaah...you no real deal. I bet you no do Nung big favour.
translation: 안 돼애... 너 별거 아냐. 너 눙한테 큰 부탁 안 들어줄 거 같아.

english: Seriously, I need to get that meat. I'll do your big favour if you want.
translation: 진짜로요, 그 고기 꼭 필요해요. 원하시면 그 큰 부탁 들어드릴게요.

english: Hah! Silly round head fishy! If you get Nung 5 big skippy skins, den maybe Nung thinking you ok.
translation: 하! 바보 둥근 머리 물꼬기! 눙한테 큰 스키피 껍데기 5개 가져오면, 그럼 눙이 너 괜찮다고 생각할지도.

english: Big skippy skins?
Ya, da big skippies live over dere.
You need lotsa big big stones to get down dere. Den you kill da big skippies and bring da skins to Nung.
translation: 저기 내려가려면 큰 큰 돌 잔뜩 필요해. 그 담에 큰 스키피들 죽이고 껍데기 눙한테 가져와.

english: You do dis, den maybe Nung let you swaps da big crunchy claws.
translation: 이거 하면, 그럼 눙이 크고 아삭한 집게발 바꿔 줄지도.

english: Nung, I have your mudskipper hides.
What you say? Has da silly round headed fishy got da big skippy skins?
translation: 뭐라고? 바보 둥근 머리 물꼬기가 큰 스키피 껍데기 가져왔어?

english: Sigh...
Yes, I have the big skippy skins.
Silly round head fishy done good!  Gimme!
translation: 바보 둥근 머리 물꼬기 잘했다! 내놔!

english: Ya, da round head fishy does a good big favour for Nung.
translation: 응, 둥근 머리 물꼬기가 눙한테 좋은 큰 부탁 들어줬다.

english: I am thinkin you's ok enough to swaps the giant crunchy claws now.
translation: 이제 너 엄청 큰 아삭한 집게발 바꿔도 될 만큼 괜찮은 거 같아.

english: Great! How much do you want for them?
You's gotta get me somefing to make dese hides to a cloak and flippers and hat, den I lets you have all the big crunchy claws you can get.
translation: 이 껍데기로 망토랑 오리발이랑 모자 만들 거 구해 와야 돼. 그럼 니가 잡을 수 있는 만큼 크고 아삭한 집게발 다 가져도 돼.

english: But it not be easy
Well I'll do it. What do I need? An item of ancient power? Something from the deepest, darkest dungeon in the world?
translation: 좋아요, 할게요. 뭐가 필요해요? 고대의 힘이 깃든 물건? 세상에서 가장 깊고 어두운 던전에서 나온 무언가?

english: What sort of monsters will I need to fight? I'd best grab myself some potions too.
translation: 어떤 몬스터랑 싸워야 해요? 물약도 좀 챙겨 가야겠네요.

english: Will there be traps? Should I bring cakes?
translation: 함정도 있어요? 케이크도 챙겨 가야 해요?

english: Ya, it real dangerous for a fishy.
You's gotta go up to da topsies, and your gotta get a needly-thing and some wirey stuff.
translation: 너 위땅까지 올라가서, 바늘 같은 거랑 철사 같은 거 구해 와야 돼.

english: A needle.
Ya.
And bronze wire.
Ya. Tree wirey stuffs.
So, all I have to do is bring you three rolls of bronze wire and a needle, and I can have all the Giant Crabs I can kill?
translation: 그러니까, bronze wire(청동 철사) 세 뭉치랑 needle(바늘) 하나만 가져오면, 제가 잡을 수 있는 Giant Crab(거대 게)는 전부 가져도 된다는 거죠?

english: Ya, but be a sneaky round head fishy. Da topsies has not water for a little fishy like you to breathing.
translation: 응, 근데 몰래몰래 다녀, 둥근 머리 물꼬기. 위땅에는 꼬마 물꼬기가 숨 쉴 물이 없어.

english: It REAL dangerous.
Yeah, sounds it.
Nung, I have the needle and wire.
Nung thinks this is a useful fishy he finds. Gimme!
translation: 눙이 쓸모 있는 물꼬기 찾았네. 내놔!

english: Nung have all da wiry stuff and needly things he needs to make da biggestest skippy skin hat ever!
translation: 이제 눙한테 세상에서 젤젤 큰 스키피 껍데기 모자 만들 철사 거시기랑 바늘 같은 거 다 있다!

english: You's a good little fishy, you eat as many big crunchy claws as you want.
translation: 너 착한 꼬마 물꼬기야. 크고 아삭한 집게발 먹고 싶은 만큼 먹어.

english: Maybe you get big and strong like Nung!
Thanks!
Greetings and welcome to my pickaxe shop. Do you want to buy my premium quality pickaxes?
translation: 어서 오게, 내 곡괭이 가게에 온 걸 환영하네. 내 최고급 곡괭이를 사 보겠나?

english: No, thank you.
Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 그럼 여기 곡괭이가 다른 곡괭이보다 더 좋아요?

english: Of course they are! My pickaxes are made of higher grade metal than your ordinary bronze pickaxes, allowing you to mine that ore just a little bit faster than normal.
translation: 물론이지! 내 곡괭이는 자네가 쓰는 평범한 bronze pickaxe(청동 곡괭이)보다 높은 등급의 금속으로 만들어서, 광석을 평소보다 조금 더 빨리 캘 수 있다네.

english: Hi Nurmof, I found this earlier...
translation: 안녕하세요, Nurmof(누르모프) 씨. 아까 이걸 찾았는데요...

english: Oh, a dragon pickaxe! And a broken one at that. I haven't seen one of those in a while.
translation: 오, dragon pickaxe(드래곤 곡괭이)로군! 그것도 부서진 거라니. 이런 건 한동안 못 봤네.

english: Can you fix it for me? I was told you're the dwarf to see!
translation: 이거 고쳐 주실 수 있어요? 이런 일이라면 Nurmof(누르모프) 씨를 찾아가라고 들었어요!

english: I did indeed fix pickaxes in the past, many years ago. They were a lot more common back then.
translation: 예전엔 정말로 곡괭이를 고쳤다네. 아주 오래전 일이지. 그때는 부서진 곡괭이가 훨씬 흔했거든.

english: In fact, this is the first broken pickaxe I've seen in a very long time!
translation: 사실 부서진 곡괭이를 보는 건 정말 오랜만이라네!

english: Why were there so many broken pickaxes back then?
translation: 그때는 왜 부서진 곡괭이가 그렇게 많았어요?

english: Ore rocks used to be quite unstable. They would randomly explode when you were mining them.
translation: 광석 바위가 꽤 불안정했거든. 캐고 있으면 아무 때나 폭발하곤 했지.

english: That sounds terrifying!
It was. But then one day, the explosions just... stopped. As if someone flipped an off switch somewhere.
translation: 무서웠지. 그런데 어느 날, 폭발이 그냥... 멈췄어. 누가 어딘가에서 스위치를 꺼 버린 것처럼 말일세.

english: I've not seen a broken pickaxe since then!
translation: 그 뒤로 부서진 곡괭이는 본 적이 없네!

english: Will you still be able to fix mine for me?
translation: 그래도 제 건 고쳐 주실 수 있겠어요?

english: I should think so. I'll need to buy some new tools.
translation: 그럴 수 있을 걸세. 새 도구를 좀 사야겠군.

english: They're quite expensive, but they will get the job done. The pickaxe will be as good as new when I've finished with it.
translation: 꽤 비싸지만 제 몫은 할 걸세. 내가 손보고 나면 곡괭이가 새것처럼 될 거야.

english: The cost will be about...
...let me see. I need another one of these, and I can reuse that if I replace the drill bit from there...
translation: ...어디 보자. 이게 하나 더 필요하고, 저기서 드릴 날을 갈아 끼우면 저건 다시 쓸 수 있고...

english: ...hmm, and this needs a full clean, oh and I don't have one of those anymore...
translation: ...흠, 이건 싹 닦아야 하고, 아, 저건 이제 없는데...

english: ...okay! It'll cost about 2,500,000 GP, give or take a few coins. Would you like me to fix it for you?
translation: ...됐네! 대략 2,500,000 GP가 들겠군. 몇 코인 정도 오차는 있고. 내가 고쳐 주길 원하나?

english: Yes, let's do it.
Lovely! Okay, give me a moment. It may take a little while, it's a tough metal to work with.
translation: 좋아! 그럼 잠깐 기다리게. 시간이 좀 걸릴 수도 있네. 다루기 까다로운 금속이거든.

english: Nurmof goes into a nearby hidden room, and from within, you hear the sound of a hammer striking metal.
translation: Nurmof(누르모프)가 근처 숨겨진 방으로 들어가고, 안에서 망치가 금속을 내리치는 소리가 들린다.

english: ..he did say it would take a little while.
There you go, good as new, just like I said!
translation: 자, 여기 있네. 내가 말한 대로 새것 같지!

english: Thank you very much. I'll take good care of it.
Oh, I actually don't have enough coins on me! I'll come back with more.
translation: 아, 사실 지금 가진 코인이 모자라요! 더 가지고 다시 올게요.

english: I'll be here!
That's rather expensive...
It is! But you can't cheap out on quality. If a job's worth doing, do it well.
translation: 비싸지! 하지만 품질엔 돈을 아끼면 안 되는 법이야. 할 가치가 있는 일이라면 제대로 해야지.

english: I'm also the only one who can repair pickaxes these days, so you don't really have much choice!
translation: 게다가 요즘 곡괭이를 고칠 수 있는 건 나뿐이라서, 자네한텐 별 선택지가 없을 걸세!

english: Okay then, let's do it.
I'll think about it.
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Are your pickaxes better than other pickaxes, then?
translation: 그럼 여기 곡괭이가 다른 곡괭이보다 더 좋아요?

english: Yes, let's do it.
That's rather expensive...
Okay then, let's do it.
I'll think about it.
Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 환자, 사방이 환자예요! 이 병사들을 다시 일으켜 싸우게 해야 해요!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 이야기할 시간 없어요. 돌봐야 할 환자들이 있거든요.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 더는 못 버티겠어요. 환자 한 명을 돌보고 나면 바로 다른 환자가 들어와요!

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need all the help we can get to get these soldiers up and fighting again. Can you help us?
translation: 환자, 사방이 환자예요! 이 병사들을 다시 일으켜 싸우게 하려면 도움이 최대한 많이 필요해요. 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. There should be plenty of boxes around here with some in.
translation: 먼저 medpack(의료 키트)를 좀 모아 오셔야 해요. 이 근처에 의료 키트가 든 상자가 잔뜩 있을 거예요.

english: After you've got some, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 몇 개 구하셨으면, 이 근처에 lizardmen(리자드맨)과의 전투에서 다친 병사들로 가득한 천막이 여러 채 있어요.

english: Good, you have already found some medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen.
translation: 좋아요, 벌써 medpack(의료 키트)를 좀 찾으셨네요. 자, 이 근처에 lizardmen(리자드맨)과의 전투에서 다친 병사들로 가득한 천막이 여러 채 있어요.

english: If you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: 그 의료 키트로 병사들을 도와주시면 정말 큰 도움이 될 거예요.

english: The people of Shayzien will thank you.
Thank you, I will get right to it.
No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 아뇨, 죄송하지만 저는 더 중요한 할 일이 있어서요.

english: Sure, what do you need me to do?
No, I'm sorry but I've got better things to be doing.
translation: 아뇨, 죄송하지만 저는 더 중요한 할 일이 있어서요.

english: Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 환자, 사방이 환자예요! 이 병사들을 다시 일으켜 싸우게 해야 해요!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 이야기할 시간 없어요. 돌봐야 할 환자들이 있거든요.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 더는 못 버티겠어요. 환자 한 명을 돌보고 나면 바로 다른 환자가 들어와요!

english: I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: lizardmen(리자드맨)을 막을 수 있으면 좋겠어요. 더는 못 버티겠어요. 환자 한 명을 돌보고 나면 바로 다른 환자가 들어와요.

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 으악! 붕대 어디 있어요? 일을 계속해야 하니까 제발 좀 내버려 두세요.

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
Hello nurse.
I don't know how much longer I can cope here.
translation: 여기서 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있을지 모르겠어요.

english: What? Is the plague getting to you?
No, strangely enough the people here don't seem to be affected. It's just the awful living conditions that is making people ill.
translation: 아뇨, 이상하게도 여기 사람들은 역병에 걸린 것 같지 않아요. 그냥 형편없는 생활 환경 때문에 사람들이 병드는 거예요.

english: I was under the impression that everyone here was affected.
translation: 여기 사람들은 다 역병에 걸린 줄 알았어요.

english: Me too, but that doesn't seem to be the case.
translation: 저도 그랬는데, 그런 것 같진 않더라고요.

english: Hello there.
Hello my dear, how are you feeling?
I'm okay thanks.
Well in that case I'd better get back to work. Take care.
translation: 그렇다면 다시 일하러 가 봐야겠네요. 몸조심해요.

english: You too.
Patients, patients everywhere! We need to get these soldiers up and fighting again!
translation: 환자, 사방이 환자예요! 이 병사들을 다시 일으켜 싸우게 해야 해요!

english: I don't have time to chat, I have patients to attend to.
translation: 이야기할 시간 없어요. 돌봐야 할 환자들이 있거든요.

english: I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in!
translation: 더는 못 버티겠어요. 환자 한 명을 돌보고 나면 바로 다른 환자가 들어와요!

english: Please help me with this!
Well done!
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
I hope we can stop the lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: lizardmen(리자드맨)을 막을 수 있으면 좋겠어요. 더는 못 버티겠어요. 환자 한 명을 돌보고 나면 바로 다른 환자가 들어와요.

english: Argh! Where are the bandages? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 으악! 붕대 어디 있어요? 일을 계속해야 하니까 제발 좀 내버려 두세요.

english: Either help out or get out of the way!
Good day, adventurer.
Who are you?
I am Lord D'rows, leader of the Oathbreakers. Yourself?
translation: 나는 Lord D'rows(드로우스 경), Oathbreakers(맹세파기자)의 수장이오. 그대는?

english: I'm [player name]. That sounds pretty important.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 꽤 중요한 자리 같네요.

english: It is a job I do not take lightly.
So what's this oath that you're all so proud of breaking?
translation: 그래서, 다들 깨뜨린 걸 그렇게 자랑스러워하는 그 맹세가 뭔데요?

english: Pride? There is no pride in what we've done.
translation: 자랑? 우리가 한 일에 자랑 따윈 없소.

english: Which was?
We Oathbreakers were all once monks of Saradomin but have since seen that his light is false. The founder of this sanctuary had a similar story and that is why we follow in her footsteps.
translation: 우리 맹세파기자들은 모두 한때 Saradomin(사라도민)의 수도사였으나, 그의 빛이 거짓임을 깨달았소. 이 성소를 세운 이도 비슷한 사연이 있었기에, 우리는 그분의 발자취를 따르고 있소.

english: What caused your faith in Saradomin to wane?
How can order and wisdom prevail in a land where chaos and destruction reign supreme? That, and a few too many muggings during my travels. If you can't beat them, become them.
translation: 혼돈과 파괴가 판치는 땅에서 어찌 질서와 지혜가 이길 수 있겠소? 그리고 여행 중에 강도를 너무 여러 번 당한 탓도 있소. 이길 수 없다면, 그들이 되는 수밖에.

english: I see.
Was there anything else?
Why are you here?
We've been keeping an eye on Slepe lately. We could sense a darkness building as the citizens fell into their endless slumber.
translation: 우리는 요즘 Slepe(슬렙)을 지켜보고 있었소. 주민들이 끝없는 잠에 빠져들면서 어둠이 짙어지는 것이 느껴졌소.

english: Once we'd heard that the sanctuary had been broken into, we came here posthaste.
translation: 성소에 누군가 침입했다는 소식을 듣자마자 서둘러 이곳에 왔소.

english: Broken into?
Indeed. This place was sealed, only to be reopened once Mother had awoken from her deep sleep.
translation: 그렇소. 이곳은 봉인되어 있었고, Mother(어머니)께서 깊은 잠에서 깨어나셔야만 다시 열리게 되어 있었소.

english: This nightmarish creature that the siren warned us of has made a home here. That was reason enough for her to unseal the entrance.
translation: 세이렌이 경고했던 그 악몽 같은 괴물이 이곳에 둥지를 틀었소. 그 여인이 입구의 봉인을 풀기엔 그것만으로도 충분한 이유였던 게요.

english: Oh, um, whose mother? Yours?
translation: 아, 음, 누구 어머니요? 당신 어머니요?

english: Oh, not my actual mother, you fool. Phosani, the founder of this sanctuary went by the title of 'Mother' while her followers adopted the title of 'Sister'. I'm sure you've seen them around.
translation: 내 친어머니를 말하는 게 아니오, 이 어리석은 자여. 이 성소를 세운 Phosani(포사니)는 'Mother(어머니)'라는 칭호로 불렸고, 그 추종자들은 'Sister(수녀)'라는 칭호를 받았소. 그대도 그들을 보았을 것이오.

english: I have. I suspect you're quite bothered about the sudden influx of visitors?
translation: 봤어요. 갑자기 방문객이 몰려들어서 꽤 신경 쓰이시겠어요?

english: Well, yes, but that fish woman claims every warrior is needed to defeat the Nightmare and that everyone asleep here is at risk.
translation: 그렇소. 하지만 그 물고기 여인 말로는 Nightmare(나이트메어)를 물리치려면 모든 전사가 필요하고, 이곳에 잠든 이들 모두가 위험하다 하오.

english: We must be strong, adventurer. Be strong for Mother.
translation: 강해져야 하오, 모험가. 어머니를 위해 강해지시오.

english: Okay... Does this creature have treasure? That's kind of a sticking point for me.
translation: 그렇군요... 그 괴물한테 treasure(보물)은 있어요? 그게 저한테는 좀 중요한 문제라서요.

english: Treasure? This sanctuary is full of old trinkets which the hag has claimed as her own. Kill her and take them, as is the Zamorakian way.
translation: 보물? 이 성소엔 그 노파가 제 것이라 우기는 오래된 장신구가 가득하오. 그 노파를 죽이고 가져가시오. 그것이 Zamorakian(자모락파)의 방식이니.

english: Oh yes, the iron price. My specialty.
translation: 아, 그렇죠. '칼로 치르는 값'. 제 전문이에요.

english: Your friends are a quiet bunch.
They took a vow of silence. I speak for them.
translation: 그들은 침묵의 맹세를 했소. 내가 대신 말하오.

english: Oh, how come?
It is the way. When I fall, one of them will take my place as the Oath Lord.
translation: 그것이 법도요. 내가 쓰러지면 그들 중 하나가 내 자리를 이어 Oath Lord(맹세의 군주)가 될 것이오.

english: No disagreements, that must be nice.
I never claimed that they can't communicate. They know a rudimentary hand-talk to vent their frustrations with my leadership. Making decisions is easier when no one can shout at you.
translation: 그들이 소통을 못 한다고 한 적은 없소. 내 지도력에 대한 불만을 털어놓을 정도의 간단한 손짓 말은 알고 있지. 아무도 내게 소리칠 수 없으니 결정을 내리기가 수월하긴 하오.

english: Huh, I can imagine.
Bye!
Stay strong, adventurer.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Your friends are a quiet bunch.
Bye!
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Hello!
They don't seem willing to talk.
Welcome to Obli's General Store Bwana! Would you like to see my items?
translation: Obli's General Store(오블리 잡화점)에 어서 오세요, 나리! 물건 구경하시겠어요?

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with zombies.
translation: 저는 여길 떠날 거예요, 나리. 여긴 좀비가 득실거려요.

english: Yes please!
No, but thanks for the offer.
Hi, are you busy?
Me? I'm always busy.
See that man there? That's the professor. If he had his way, I think he'd never let me sleep!
translation: 저기 저 남자 보이죠? 저분이 교수님이에요. 교수님 마음대로 할 수 있으면, 아마 저를 한숨도 못 자게 하실걸요!

english: Anyway, how might I help you?
I was wondering what you do here.
Glad you ask. This is the Observatory reception.
Up on the cliff is the Observatory dome, from which you can view the heavens.
translation: 절벽 위에 천문대 돔이 있는데, 거기서 하늘을 관측할 수 있어요.

english: Usually...
What do you mean, 'usually'?
*Ahem*. Back to work, please.
I'd speak with the professor. He'll explain.
translation: 교수님께 말씀해 보세요. 설명해 주실 거예요.

english: What's that board for?
The one behind me? We use it to keep track of fallen stars and those that find them.
translation: 제 뒤에 있는 거요? 떨어진 별과 그걸 찾은 사람들을 기록하는 데 써요.

english: Fallen stars?
That's right. From time to time, stars fall from the sky and land somewhere in Gielinor.
translation: 맞아요. 가끔 별이 하늘에서 떨어져서 Gielinor(길리노르) 어딘가에 내려앉거든요.

english: Whenever one does, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 별이 떨어질 때마다 게시판에 적어 둬요. 누가 그 별을 찾으면 그 사람 이름도 적고요.

english: I see. And how do people find them?
There's a lot of amateur astronomers out there. Many of them have small telescopes in their homes. They use them to work out when a star is going to fall.
translation: 아마추어 천문학자가 많거든요. 집에 작은 망원경을 둔 사람도 많고요. 그걸로 별이 언제 떨어질지 알아내요.

english: Could I do that?
I imagine so. Just get yourself a telescope and look out for stars.
translation: 그럴 거예요. 망원경을 하나 구해서 별을 잘 살펴보세요.

english: Awesome. I might just give it a go.
Good luck. If you're interested, I hear there's a dwarf at the Mining Guild who's keen on gathering stardust. If you find some, he might be willing to trade with you.
translation: 행운을 빌어요. 관심 있으면, Mining Guild(채광 길드)에 stardust(별가루) 모으는 데 열심인 드워프가 있다던데요. 별가루를 찾으면 거래해 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Good to know. Thanks.
Oh yes. I've seen one of those before.
translation: 아, 네. 그거 전에 하나 본 적 있어요.

english: You're very lucky. They are quite rare. Anyway, whenever one falls, we make a note on the board. If someone finds it, we note their name as well.
translation: 운이 좋으시네요. 꽤 드물거든요. 아무튼, 별이 떨어질 때마다 게시판에 적어 둬요. 누가 찾으면 그 사람 이름도 적고요.

english: I'd better be off.
Just looking around, thanks.
Okay, just don't break anything. If you need any help, let me know.
translation: 알겠어요, 아무것도 부수지만 마세요. 도움이 필요하면 말씀하세요.

english: Can I have a look through that telescope?
You can. You won't see much though.
translation: 되긴 해요. 별로 보이는 건 없겠지만요.

english: And that's because?
Just talk to the professor. He'll fill you in.
translation: 교수님께 말씀해 보세요. 자세히 알려 주실 거예요.

english: Hi assistant.
Wait a minute, what's your real name?
My real name?
I only know you as the professor's assistant. What's your actual name?
translation: 전 그냥 교수님 조수로만 알고 있어서요. 실제 이름이 뭐예요?

english: Patrick.
Hi, Patrick, I'm [player name].
translation: 안녕하세요, Patrick(패트릭) 씨. 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: Well, hello again, and thanks for helping out the professor.
translation: 네, 다시 만나서 반가워요. 교수님 도와주셔서 고마워요.

english: Oh, and, believe it or not, his name is Mambo-duna- roona, but don't tell him I told you.
translation: 아, 그리고 믿기 힘들겠지만, 교수님 이름은 Mambo-duna- roona(맘보두나루나)예요. 제가 말했다고 하진 마세요.

english: You made that up!
No, honest! Anyways, you've made my life much easier. Have a drink on me!
translation: 아니에요, 진짜예요! 아무튼, 덕분에 제 일이 훨씬 편해졌어요. 한잔 쏠게요!

english: Thanks very much.
No problem. Scorpius would be proud.
Sorry?
You may want to check out the book on the table, and perhaps look around for a grave...
translation: 탁자 위에 있는 책을 살펴보시고, 무덤도 한번 찾아보세요...

english: Oh, sorry, I can't carry anything else.
translation: 아, 죄송해요, 더는 들 수가 없어요.

english: Well, then, please come back when you do.
translation: 그럼 자리가 생기면 다시 와 주세요.

english: How was the wine?
That was good stuff, *hic*! Wheresh the professher?
translation: 그거 조은 술이네요, *딸꾹*! 교슈님은 어디 계셰요?

english: The professor? He's up in the Observatory. Since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
translation: 교수님이요? Observatory(천문대)에 계세요. 다리가 무너져서, 고블린 마을 아래 던전을 지나가셔야 해요.

english: That was good stuff! Where's the professor?
Look what I have.
Good for you. As much as I want to admire your possessions, I do have work to do.
translation: 좋으시겠네요. 소지품 구경해 드리고 싶은 마음은 굴뚝같지만, 저 할 일이 있거든요.

english: Oh, right. Sorry.
What do you think of this?
I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: 쪽지 형태 말고 실제 아이템으로 보여 주시면 좋겠어요.

english: I was wondering what you do here.
What's that board for?
Can I have a look through that telescope?
I'd better be off.
Just looking around, thanks.
Wait a minute, what's your real name?
Hello.
Hi, I was...
Welcome to the magnificent wonder of the Observatory, where wonder is all around you, where the stars can be clutched from the heavens!
translation: Observatory(천문대)의 장엄한 경이로움에 오신 걸 환영해요! 사방이 경이로 가득하고, 하늘의 별도 손에 움켜쥘 수 있는 곳이죠!

english: Wow, nice intro.
Why, thanks! How might I help you?
Lost? It must have been those pesky goblins that led you astray.
translation: 길을 잃었다고요? 그 성가신 goblins(고블린)이 길을 헷갈리게 한 게 틀림없어요.

english: Head north-east to find the city of Ardougne.
I'm sure I'll find the way.
translation: 길은 제가 찾을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Thanks for all your help.
No problem at all. Come and visit again!
The professor carries on with his studies.
An Observatory?
Of course. We have a superb telescope up in the Observatory, on the hill.
translation: 물론이죠. 언덕 위 천문대에 아주 훌륭한 telescope(망원경)이 있어요.

english: A truly marvellous invention, the likes of which you'll never behold again.
translation: 정말 경이로운 발명품이죠. 다시는 그런 걸 볼 일이 없을 거예요.

english: Well, it would be if it worked.
Don't interrupt!
What? It doesn't work?
Oh, no, no, no. Don't listen to him, he's joking. Aren't you, my FAITHFUL assistant?
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨, 아니에요. 저 친구 말은 듣지 마세요, 농담하는 거예요. 그렇지, 나의 '충직한' 조수?

english: Nope, dead serious. Hasn't been working for a long time.
translation: 아뇨, 진심인데요. 고장 난 지 한참 됐어요.

english: Arghhh! Get back to work and stop sticking your nose in!
translation: 으아아악! 일이나 하고 참견 좀 그만해!

english: So, it's broken. How come?
Oh, I suppose there's no use keeping it secret. Did you see those houses outside?
translation: 아, 숨겨 봐야 소용없겠네요. 밖에 있는 집들 봤어요?

english: Up on the hill? Yes, I've seen them.
translation: 언덕 위에 있는 거요? 네, 봤어요.

english: It's a horde of goblins.
Since they moved here they have caused nothing but trouble.
translation: 그놈들이 이사 온 뒤로 말썽만 일으키고 있어요.

english: Last week, my telescope was tampered with.
translation: 지난주에는 누가 제 망원경에 손을 댔어요.

english: Now, parts need replacing before it can be used again. They've even been messing around in the dungeons under this area. Something needs to be done.
translation: 이제 부품을 갈아야 다시 쓸 수 있어요. 그놈들은 이 근처 지하 던전에서까지 난리를 피우고 있어요. 무슨 수를 써야 해요.

english: Strikes me that this visitor could help us.
translation: 보아하니 이 방문객이 도와줄 수 있을 것 같은데요.

english: Stop being so rude.
Although, he has a point. What do you say?
translation: 하지만 저 친구 말에도 일리가 있네요. 어때요?

english: What, me?
Sounds interesting, what can I do for you?
Oh, thanks so much.
I shall need some materials for the telescope, so it can be used again.
translation: 망원경을 다시 쓸 수 있게 재료가 좀 필요해요.

english: Let's start with three planks of wood for the telescope base. My assistant will help with obtaining these, won't you?
translation: 우선 망원경 받침대에 쓸 나무 판자 세 장부터 시작하죠. 제 조수가 구하는 걸 도와줄 거예요, 그렇지?

english: As if I don't have enough work to do. Seems I don't have a choice.
translation: 안 그래도 일이 산더미인데. 선택의 여지가 없나 보네요.

english: Go talk to him if you need some advice.
translation: 조언이 필요하면 저 친구한테 말을 걸어 보세요.

english: Okay, I'll be right back.
Oh, sorry, I don't have time for that.
Oh dear. I really do need some help.
If you see anyone who can help then please send them my way.
translation: 도와줄 만한 사람을 보면 저한테 보내 주세요.

english: I'm just passing through.
Fair enough. Not everyone is interested in this place, I suppose.
translation: 그렇군요. 다들 이곳에 관심이 있는 건 아니겠죠.

english: Welcome back! How can I help you today?
Can you teach me to solve treasure trail clues?
translation: treasure trail(보물찾기) 단서 푸는 법을 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Ah, I get asked about treasure trails all the time! Listen carefully and I shall tell you what I know...
translation: 아, 보물찾기는 늘 받는 질문이에요! 잘 들어요, 제가 아는 걸 알려 드리죠...

english: Lots of clues havedegreesandminuteswritten on them. These are the coordinates of the place where the treasure is buried.
translation: 단서 중에는 몇 도 몇 분 하는 숫자가 적힌 게 많아요. 그게 보물이 묻힌 장소의 좌표예요.

english: You have to walk to the correct spot, so that your coordinates are exactly the same as the values written on the clue scroll.
translation: 정확한 지점까지 직접 걸어가서, 자기 좌표가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)에 적힌 값과 똑같아지게 해야 해요.

english: To do this, you must use asextant, awatchand achartto find your own coordinates.
translation: 그러려면 sextant(육분의), watch(시계), chart(도표)를 써서 자기 좌표를 알아내야 해요.

english: Once you know the coordinates of the place where you are, you know which way you have to walk to get to the place where the treasure is!
translation: 지금 있는 곳의 좌표를 알면, 보물이 있는 곳까지 어느 쪽으로 걸어가야 하는지 알 수 있죠!

english: Riiight. So where do I get those items from?
translation: 아, 네에에. 그럼 그 물건들은 어디서 구하죠?

english: I think Murphy, the owner of the fishing trawler moored south of Ardougne, might be able to spare you a sextant. Then the nearest Clock Tower is south of Ardougne - you could probably get a watch there. I've
translation: Ardougne(아르둔) 남쪽에 정박한 저인망 어선 주인 Murphy(머피)라면 sextant(육분의)를 하나 내줄 수 있을 거예요. 그리고 가장 가까운 Clock Tower(시계탑)이 아르둔 남쪽에 있으니 거기서 watch(시계)를 구할 수 있을 거고요. 도표는

english: got plenty of charts myself, here have one.
translation: 저한테 잔뜩 있으니, 여기 하나 가져가요.

english: Thanks, I'll see you later.
You don't have enough space for the chart. Come back to me when you do.
translation: chart(도표)를 넣을 공간이 없네요. 공간이 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Um... Are you sure? I think you've got one stored somewhere.
translation: 음... 정말요? 어딘가에 하나 보관해 둔 것 같은데요.

english: I've lost my chart.
That's not a problem, I've got lots of copies.
Certainly. It's not difficult.
Welcome back.
Thanks for all your help with the telescope. What can I do for you?
translation: 망원경 일은 정말 고마웠어요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: Not right now,
but the stars may hold a secret for you.
translation: 하지만 별들이 당신을 위한 비밀을 품고 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Is it true your name is Mambo-duna-roona?
How do you know tha-
I mean, of course not, what a silly idea.
translation: 아니, 그럴 리가요. 무슨 엉뚱한 소리를.

english: Nothing, thanks.
Okay, no problem. See you again.
What do you see now?
I can see a constellation through the telescope. It looks like Scorpio.
Scorpio? Interesting. How very fitting.
What do you mean?
Scorpius, the founder of all we know relating to astronomy. There's a book about him in the reception. Perhaps you should check it out, you might learn something.
translation: Scorpius(스코르피우스), 천문학에 관한 모든 지식의 창시자죠. 접수처에 그에 관한 책이 있어요. 한번 읽어 보세요, 뭔가 배울지도 몰라요.

english: Then perhaps I shall.
What do you think of this!
Wonderful. You must be very proud to have it.
What do you think of this?
I'd rather you show me the actual item, as opposed to the note form.
translation: 쪽지 형태 말고 실제 물건을 보여 줬으면 좋겠네요.

english: Talk about the Observatory quest.
I'm totally lost.
An Observatory?
Yes.
No.
I'm just passing through.
Talk about Treasure Trails.
I've lost my chart.
How do these work again?
Do you need any more help with the telescope?
Is it true your name is Mambo-duna-roona?
Nothing, thanks.
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)는 더 이상 우리를 지켜 주지 못해요!

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: White Knights(백기사단)이 곧 이곳을 장악할 거예요!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 그래도 White Knights(백기사단)이 결국 장악할 거예요.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 공격을 준비하고 있대요!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Can I help you with something?
Well, err...who are you, and what are all these bones doing here?
translation: 음, 그러니까... 누구세요? 그리고 여기 이 뼈들은 다 뭐예요?

english: Errr...
Mumblemumble
I'm an archaeologist. I work with the museum.
translation: 나는 고고학자일세. 박물관 일을 하고 있지.

english: An archaeologist?
Yes.
Well that explains the bones...sort of...but what are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 그럼 뼈는 설명이 되네요... 어느 정도는요... 그런데 이렇게 멀리까지 나와서 뭘 하시는 거예요?

english: Mumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumble.
I'm collecting bones for the museum.
They have asked me to rig up some displays of second and third age creatures using their bones, so that people can come and...well, look at them.
translation: 박물관에서 제2시대와 제3시대 생물의 뼈로 전시물을 좀 꾸며 달라고 부탁했거든. 사람들이 와서... 음, 구경할 수 있게 말일세.

english: I need to get them into some sort of order before I begin, but I've run into a bit of a snag.
translation: 시작하기 전에 뼈를 어느 정도 정리해 둬야 하는데, 문제가 좀 생겼다네.

english: What sort of a snag?
Well, I need to have all the bones I'm going to use here, and placed into some sort of order.
translation: 음, 쓸 뼈를 전부 여기 모아서 어느 정도 순서대로 놓아 둬야 하거든.

english: However, I seem to have discovered I am a few short.
Anything I can do to help?
There is something you could do for me. I'm going to be busy...err...
translation: 자네가 해 줄 일이 하나 있긴 하네. 나는 좀 바쁠 테니까... 어...

english: Mumble
Sorting, yes, sorting these bones out ready for the museum, but I need a few more.
translation: 정리, 그래, 박물관에 보낼 이 뼈들을 정리하느라 말일세. 그런데 뼈가 몇 개 더 필요하다네.

english: Will you help me out by grabbing some?
Yes. I'll give you a hand.
You will? Excellent!
Snicker.
Where do you need me to dig?
Dig?
Oh, you must have got the wrong end of the stick.
translation: 아, 자네가 뭔가 단단히 오해했나 보군.

english: I need some fresh, whole bones to replace ones that have become damaged.
translation: 망가진 뼈를 대신할 신선하고 온전한 뼈가 필요하다네.

english: What?
Err...
Mumblemumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumblemumblemumblemumble. Mumble.
Excuse me...
Shhh!
Sorry...
Ok, got it.
Ok, here is the thing. While sorting out what bones I do have I managed to lose or damage a few. If you can get me some fresh, unbroken bones to use as replacements then I can get on with things.
translation: 좋아, 사정은 이렇다네. 가진 뼈를 정리하다가 몇 개를 잃어버리거나 망가뜨렸지 뭔가. 대신 쓸 신선하고 멀쩡한 뼈를 구해다 주면 일을 계속할 수 있다네.

english: That make things clearer?
Well, it makes some sense I suppose...
Great. If you can get me a bone from a Goblin, a Bear, a Big Frog, a Ram, a Unicorn, a Monkey, a Giant rat and a Giant Bat then I'll be able to move on with the...
translation: 잘됐군. Goblin(고블린), Bear(곰), Big Frog(큰 개구리), Ram(숫양), Unicorn(유니콘), Monkey(원숭이), Giant rat(거대 쥐), Giant Bat(거대 박쥐)의 뼈를 하나씩 구해 오면 나도 그... 일을 진행할 수 있을 걸세...

english: Displays...
So you just want me to bring you these bones and that will be that?
translation: 그러니까 이 뼈들만 가져다드리면 끝인 거죠?

english: Well, I wouldn't mind you sticking them in a pot and boiling them in vinegar first, if you don't mind.
translation: 음, 괜찮다면 먼저 단지에 넣고 식초에 삶아 주면 좋겠네.

english: There is a Wine Merchant in Draynor called Fortunato that sells the stuff you'll need.
translation: Draynor(드레이너)에 Fortunato(포르투나토)라는 Wine Merchant(포도주 상인)이 있는데, 거기서 필요한 걸 판다네.

english: You can even use my pot-boiler if you want.
translation: 원한다면 내 pot-boiler(냄비 화덕)을 써도 되네.

english: Why do I need to boil them in vinegar?
It gets them bright and sparking white.
It's an archaeologist thing.
Just put the bone in a pot of vinegar, throw some logs on the fire, put the pot in the holder and light the logs.
translation: 뼈를 pot of vinegar(식초 단지)에 넣고, 불에 logs(통나무)를 좀 던져 넣은 다음, 단지를 받침대에 올리고 통나무에 불을 붙이게.

english: It takes a while for the vinegar to evaporate, but the bone will be nice and clean in the end.
translation: 식초가 증발하려면 시간이 좀 걸리지만, 결국 뼈가 깨끗하고 보기 좋아질 걸세.

english: All right, I'll be back later.
Bye!
No.
Oh...I see.
Well, never mind me young man, I'll just stagger over here under my massive burden, and continue my thankless task.
translation: 뭐, 나는 신경 쓰지 말게, 젊은이. 이 엄청난 짐을 지고 비틀비틀 저쪽으로 가서, 아무도 알아주지 않는 일을 계속할 테니.

english: Unaided and alone...
Wow, trying a guilt trip much?
Well good luck with that!
Thanks stranger!
What a polite young man...
Well, back to work!
Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 저 웅얼거리는 소리는 어디서 나는 거예요?

english: What mumbling?
Anyway, I have enough problems of my own without dealing with a delusional adventurer.
translation: 아무튼 내 문제만으로도 골치 아픈데, 헛것을 듣는 모험가까지 상대할 여유는 없다네.

english: Sniggersnigger
Hello there!
I was just passing and I wondered if you still needed someone to help with the bones?
translation: 지나가다가 생각나서요, 아직 뼈 모으는 일 도와줄 사람이 필요하세요?

english: Have you brought me any bones?
Not at the moment. Can you just give me a run down on which bones I have left to get?
translation: 지금은 없어요. 제가 구해야 할 뼈가 뭐가 남았는지 정리해서 말씀해 주시겠어요?

english: Sure.
You still need to bring me a Goblin bone.
Goblins are relatively common. I hear there is a house full of them around Lumbridge in fact.
translation: 고블린은 비교적 흔하지. 사실 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 근처에 고블린이 바글바글한 집이 있다고 들었네.

english: You still need to bring me a Bear bone.
I heard that there are some Bears over by the Legends' Guild, near Ardougne.
translation: Ardougne(아르둔) 근처 Legends' Guild(전설의 길드) 쪽에 Bears(곰)이 좀 있다고 들었네.

english: You still need to bring me a Big Frog bone.
translation: 아직 Big Frog(큰 개구리) 뼈를 가져와야 하네.

english: This might be a little tricky as you will need to go into the Lumbridge Swamp caves. You will need a light source! Never forget your light source down there!
translation: 이건 좀 까다로울 걸세. Lumbridge Swamp(럼브리지 늪) 동굴에 들어가야 하거든. 광원이 필요할 걸세! 거기 내려갈 땐 절대 광원을 잊지 말게!

english: You still need to bring me a Ram bone.
I'm sure you will be able to find a ram wherever there are sheep.
translation: 양이 있는 곳이라면 어디서든 숫양도 찾을 수 있을 걸세.

english: You still need to bring me a Unicorn bone.
I seem to remember that there were Unicorns south of Varrock, I think they might be there still.
translation: Varrock(바록) 남쪽에 Unicorns(유니콘)이 있었던 걸로 기억하는데, 아마 아직 있을 걸세.

english: You still need to bring me a Monkey bone.
Monkeys tend to live in Jungle areas, like Karamja. I think they are pretty plentiful there if I remember correctly.
translation: Monkeys(원숭이)는 Karamja(카람자) 같은 정글 지역에 주로 살지. 내 기억이 맞다면 거기 꽤 많을 걸세.

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Rat bone.
translation: 아직 Giant Rat(거대 쥐) 뼈를 가져와야 하네.

english: If you can't find one in a sewer, then you might want to try looking in some caves.
translation: 하수도에서 못 찾겠거든 동굴을 좀 뒤져 보게.

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Bat bone.
translation: 아직 Giant Bat(거대 박쥐) 뼈를 가져와야 하네.

english: Giant bats tend to live underground, but I have heard there are a few near the Coal Pits.
translation: Giant bats(거대 박쥐)는 주로 지하에 살지만, Coal Pits(석탄 구덩이) 근처에도 몇 마리 있다고 들었네.

english: Did you get all that?
Yes. I'll get right on it.
Don't forget to boil them in vinegar first.
translation: 먼저 식초에 삶는 거 잊지 말게.

english: Just chuck some logs into the pit, put the bone in the pot of vinegar and drop it onto the pot-boiler. Then light the logs and wait for the the vinegar to boil away.
translation: 구덩이에 logs(통나무)를 좀 던져 넣고, 뼈를 pot of vinegar(식초 단지)에 넣어서 pot-boiler(냄비 화덕)에 올려놓게. 그다음 통나무에 불을 붙이고 식초가 다 졸아들 때까지 기다리면 되네.

english: Ok, I'll remember.
I have some bones for you.
Great! Let me take a look at them.
That's the last of them!
The museum will be thrilled to know I've completed the collection.
translation: 수집을 완성했다는 걸 알면 박물관이 무척 기뻐할 걸세.

english: Well I'm just glad I could help.
Well you've been a big help and no mistake.
I'm always on the lookout for fresh bones, so if you see some bring them right over.
translation: 나는 늘 신선한 뼈를 찾고 있으니, 혹시 보거든 바로 가져오게.

english: No problem, I'll be sure to bring anything you might like over if I find something.
translation: 알겠어요, 마음에 드실 만한 걸 찾으면 꼭 가져올게요.

english: I can't wait to see the displays once they are finished.
Quest complete!
Can I have a replacement helm? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: 투구를 새로 하나 받을 수 있을까요? 지난번 걸 잃어버렸어요.

english: No problem. I have plenty after all.
Thanks!
Can I have a replacement bonesack? I managed to lose the last one.
translation: bonesack(뼈 자루)를 새로 하나 받을 수 있을까요? 지난번 걸 잃어버렸어요.

english: How's the sorting going?
Oh, the 'sorting' is going very well, very well indeed.
translation: 아, '정리'는 아주 잘되고 있다네, 아주 잘.

english: I'm glad to hear it!
Can I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 이 투구를 bonesack(뼈 자루)로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

english: I don't see why not.
There you go.
Come up and see me if you want to swap back.
Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: bonesack(뼈 자루)도 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I... do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 나야... 둘 다 많이 있긴 하지. 그리 문제 될 건 없겠군.

english: Come up and see me if you lose it.
Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 그런데 그 웅얼거리는 소리는 대체 어디서 났던 거예요?

english: You must be hearing things. I think you need to have a lie down.
translation: 헛것을 들은 게지. 좀 누워서 쉬는 게 좋겠네.

english: Can I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 이 bonesack(뼈 자루)를 투구로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

english: Could I have a helm as well?
Hello.
Hello?
I found this amulet. Do you know what it is?
It doesn't look like anything I've seen in the past, I don't think I'll have a use for it.
translation: 예전에 본 어떤 것과도 닮지 않았군. 나한테는 쓸모가 없을 것 같네.

english: Ahem!
Although actually, thinking about it, I can take it off your hands if you'd like?
translation: 아니, 그런데 다시 생각해 보니, 자네가 원한다면 내가 처분해 줄 수도 있네.

english: For free? I've helped the museum enough, do you have anything I could exchange it for?
translation: 공짜로요? 박물관은 이미 충분히 도와 드렸잖아요. 바꿔 주실 만한 거 없어요?

english: I could give you 30 big bones per amulet, I've built up quite a collection recently.
translation: amulet(아뮬렛) 하나당 big bones(큰 뼈) 30개를 줄 수 있네. 요즘 꽤 많이 모아 뒀거든.

english: Here's 30 big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 여기 big bones(큰 뼈) 30개일세. 아뮬렛을 또 찾으면 다시 오게.

english: No thank you. maybeanother time.
Here's [input * 30] big bones, come back if you find another amulet.
translation: 여기 big bones(큰 뼈) [input * 30]개일세. 아뮬렛을 또 찾으면 다시 오게.

english: Anything I can do to help?
Yes
No
Well, good luck with that.
Where is that mumbling coming from?
translation: 저 웅얼거리는 소리는 어디서 나는 거예요?

english: Could I exchange this helm for the bonesack?
translation: 이 투구를 bonesack(뼈 자루)로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

english: Could I have a bonesack as well?
translation: bonesack(뼈 자루)도 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Where was that mumbling coming from anyway?
translation: 그런데 그 웅얼거리는 소리는 대체 어디서 났던 거예요?

english: Could I exchange this bonesack for the helm?
translation: 이 bonesack(뼈 자루)를 투구로 바꿀 수 있을까요?

english: Could I have a helm as well?
Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in the snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 나 Odd Stone(이상한 돌). Weiss(바이스) 남쪽 눈밭에서 찾은 이상한 돌 같은 거 때문에 이름 붙었어.

english: An odd stone thing?
Yeah, it were made of stone, and it were odd. Some weird bone-head human saw me trying to nibble it, an' he got really upset an' chased me away. He kinda scary.
translation: 응, 그거 돌로 돼 있었고, 이상했어. 웬 해골머리 인간이 나 그거 갉아 먹으려는 거 보고, 엄청 화나서 나 쫓아냈어. 그 인간 좀 무서웠어.

english: Anyway, my parents they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 아무튼, 우리 부모가 그 뒤로 나 Odd Stone(이상한 돌)이라고 이름 붙였고, 이제 우리 트롤들 거기 근처 절대 안 가. 해골머리 인간 진짜, 막, 완전 무서웠어! 그리고 아마 마법 씀.

english: Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 그 이상한 돌을 찾으러 가도 돼요?

english: No, we trolls blocked all routes to snowfields from here. Don't want scary bone-head human coming to Weiss.
translation: 안 돼, 우리 트롤들 여기서 눈밭 가는 길 다 막았어. 무서운 해골머리 인간 Weiss(바이스) 오면 싫어.

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤들이 옛날에 지었어, 더 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨난 다음에. 이제 바이스 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지냈어. 먹을 염소랑 늑대 많아. 이젠 맛 좀 질렸지만, 딴 거 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 봤어요? 그거 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들도 알아요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)은 그거 키우는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구트 뭐시기 풀? 못 들어 봤어, 몰라. 근데 채소 같은 이름이야, 그리고 Mother(어머니)는 그런 거 먹기 싫어해, 그러니까 우리 아마 안 먹을 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해, 근데 그 아저씨 엄청 크고, 그 아저씨가 대장이야, 그래서 우리 그 아저씨 말 들어.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 에, 좀 험하지만, 여기 우리 집. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)이 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 여기 더 좋게 만들 수 있대, 근데 Mother(어머니)가 관심 없어서, 이상한 버섯은 그거 못 해.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 싸움 더 잘하게 해 주는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 그 아저씨 엄청 크고, 그 아저씨가 대장이야, 그래서 우리 그 아저씨 말 들어.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
I am Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 나 Odd Stone(이상한 돌). Weiss(바이스) 남쪽 눈밭에서 찾은 이상한 돌 같은 거 때문에 이름 붙었어.

english: Anyway, my parents, they named me Odd Stone after that, and now we trolls not go anywhere near the place. Bone-head human was, like, really scary! And probably magic.
translation: 아무튼, 우리 부모가 그 뒤로 나 Odd Stone(이상한 돌)이라고 이름 붙였고, 이제 우리 트롤들 거기 근처 절대 안 가. 해골머리 인간 진짜, 막, 완전 무서웠어! 그리고 아마 마법 씀.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 이제 엄청 좋아, Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 남편 트롤이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 맛있어졌어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 험하지만, 점점 좋아지고 있어. Snowflake(눈송이)가 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으면 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그러니까 응, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이라 Weiss(바이스) 살기 좋은 곳이야. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 그 남편 트롤 좀 이상하지만, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: Who are you?
Can I go looking for the odd stone?
translation: 그 이상한 돌을 찾으러 가도 돼요?

english: Thanks, that's interesting.
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
What to buy? What to buy?
Oh, hello human.
Anything I can help you with?
Only if you can help me make a suggestion on what to buy.
translation: 뭘 살지 정하는 걸 도와줄 수 있다면요.

english: I smell a quest!
No, not really. I just need some advice on what to buy, that's all.
translation: 아뇨, 그런 건 아니에요. 그냥 뭘 살지 조언이 좀 필요할 뿐이에요.

english: You should buy some new clothes. You can't go around town wearing what you're wearing.
translation: 새 옷을 좀 사세요. 그 차림으로 시내를 돌아다닐 순 없잖아요.

english: You're right, this is a little drab. I shouldn't really go around Keldagrim-West wearing this, should I?
translation: 맞아요, 좀 칙칙하긴 하죠. 이걸 입고 Keldagrim-West(서부 켈다그림)을 돌아다니면 안 되겠죠?

english: Of course I still don't know what colour I should get. I don't want to accidentally offend the wrong company of course.
translation: 그래도 무슨 색으로 사야 할지는 여전히 모르겠어요. 괜히 엉뚱한 상회 심기를 건드리고 싶진 않거든요.

english: Never mind.
You should get yourself a big mighty warhammer.
translation: 크고 묵직한 전투 망치를 하나 장만하세요.

english: I don't think so. The warhammer shop is run by the Red Axe. I'd rather stay out of there.
translation: 그건 아닌 것 같아요. 전투 망치 가게는 Red Axe(레드 액스)가 운영하거든요. 거긴 피하고 싶어요.

english: You don't like the Red Axe?
They're all a lot of bullies if you ask me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 다 깡패 같은 놈들이에요.

english: But I thought they left the city?
translation: 하지만 그 사람들 도시를 떠난 줄 알았는데요?

english: They may have, but I still think that shopkeeper is in league with them, banners or no.
translation: 그랬을 수도 있죠. 그래도 깃발이 있든 없든, 그 가게 주인은 아직 그놈들이랑 한패인 것 같아요.

english: Get yourself a long piece of rope.
What would I do with a rope?
I don't know. I generally find a rope useful while adventuring.
translation: 글쎄요. 저는 모험할 때 밧줄이 쓸모 있더라고요.

english: I don't do a lot of adventuring to be honest.
translation: 솔직히 저는 모험을 별로 안 해요.

english: An oversized hat. In a ridiculous colour.
No one is selling hats here, that's not a very helpful suggestion at all.
translation: 여기선 아무도 모자를 안 팔아요. 그건 전혀 도움이 안 되는 제안이네요.

english: Nothing. You should buy absolutely nothing.
Now that's the best idea I've heard all day.
translation: 이야, 오늘 들은 것 중에 최고의 생각이네요.

english: I thought so! Now why don't you give me some of the money I saved you?
translation: 그렇죠! 그럼 제가 아껴 드린 돈 좀 나눠 주시는 게 어때요?

english: No, I don't think so. I think I'd rather buy something with my money after all.
translation: 아뇨, 그건 좀. 생각해 보니 그냥 제 돈으로 뭐라도 사는 게 낫겠어요.

english: New clothes.
A warhammer.
A piece of rope.
An oversized hat.
Nothing.
Well met, fellow adventurer! How can I help you?
Who are you?
How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/girl]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 이런, 제가 몹시 무례했군요, 친애하는 [chap/girl]님. 제 이름은 Odovacar(오도바카르)이며, 저 훌륭한 기업인 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)에서 일하고 있습니다.

english: If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?

As part of our ongoing service to provide you, the customer, with an absolutely world-class banking experience, we are investigating the option of opening a chain of travelling banks. These will provide you, our
translation: 고객님께 그야말로 세계 최고 수준의 은행 경험을 제공해 드리기 위한 지속적인 서비스의 일환으로, 저희는 이동식 은행 체인 개설을 검토하고 있습니다. 이 은행들은 저희의

english: esteemed customer, with the convenience of having banking facilities where they will be of optimum use to you. Such as here!
translation: 귀하신 고객님께 가장 쓸모 있는 곳에서 은행 시설을 이용하는 편리함을 제공해 드릴 것입니다. 바로 이곳처럼 말이지요!

english: Huh?
I am the first of a new generation of travelling bankers that will wander the perilous areas of the world to provide you, the valued customer, with a bank when you need it most!
translation: 저는 세상의 위험한 지역을 누비며, 소중한 고객님께 은행이 가장 필요할 때 은행을 제공해 드릴 신세대 이동식 은행원의 첫 주자입니다!

english: So I can access my bank account simply by talking to you?
translation: 그러니까 당신한테 말만 걸면 은행 계좌를 이용할 수 있다는 거예요?

english: Absolutely correct, dear [sir/lady]. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: 정확하십니다, 친애하는 [sir/lady]님. 다만 이런 사업은 간접비가 상당히 많이 드는 관계로, 계좌를 이용하실 때마다 100gp의 소액 수수료가 부과된다는 점을 미리 말씀드려야겠군요.

english: I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 지금 돈이 없는데요. 은행에서 꺼내서 내도 돼요?

english: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old [chap/girl], but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: 고객님께서 나중에 지불하실 거라 믿지 않는 건 아닙니다만, [chap/girl]님, 옛 격언에도 있듯이 '돈이 친구보다 먼저'니까요.

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 제 돈 찾는 데 돈을 낼 순 없어요!

english: I'm sorry to hear that, [sir/madam]. If you should reconsider, because I believe this service offers excellent value for money, do not hesitate to contact me.
translation: 유감입니다, [sir/madam]님. 이 서비스가 돈값을 톡톡히 한다고 믿으니, 혹시 마음이 바뀌시면 주저 없이 저를 찾아 주십시오.

english: I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to access your account. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금 수수료를 낼 돈을 갖고 계시지 않아 계좌 이용을 허락해 드릴 수 없습니다. 수수료 100골드를 준비하셔서 다시 찾아 주십시오.

english: I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I'm afraid you don't have the necessary funds with you at this time so I can't allow you to collect your items. Please come again, when you have 100 gold to cover the fee.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금 수수료를 낼 돈을 갖고 계시지 않아 물건 수령을 허락해 드릴 수 없습니다. 수수료 100골드를 준비하셔서 다시 찾아 주십시오.

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear [chap/lady]. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 이런, 제가 몹시 무례했군요, 친애하는 [chap/lady]님. 제 이름은 Odovacar(오도바카르)이며, 저 훌륭한 기업인 Bank of Gielinor(길리노르 은행)에서 일하고 있습니다.

english: My services will cost you 100 coins.
Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 여기 100코인이요. 이제 계좌 좀 열어 주세요.

english: As an Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman] you cannot use the bank.
translation: Ultimate Iron [Man/Woman](얼티밋 아이언맨)이신 고객님께서는 은행을 이용하실 수 없습니다.

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 여기 100코인이요. 이제 물건 좀 찾게 해 주세요.

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
Sorry, I don't perform that service.
Who are you?
If you work for the bank, what are you doing here?
I don't have the money. Can I get it from my bank?
translation: 지금 돈이 없는데요. 은행에서 꺼내서 내도 돼요?

english: That's preposterous! I'm not paying to withdraw my own money!
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 제 돈 찾는 데 돈을 낼 순 없어요!

english: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
Here's 100 coins. Let me access my account now.
translation: 여기 100코인이요. 이제 계좌 좀 열어 주세요.

english: Here's 100 coins. Let me collect my items now.
translation: 여기 100코인이요. 이제 물건 좀 찾게 해 주세요.

english: Dad says you can get a lift to Karamja with us if you want? But you's gives us two chompy first!
translation: 아빠가 그러는데, 너 원하면 우리랑 같이 Karamja(카람자)까지 타고 갈 수 있대? 근데 너 먼저 우리한테 chompy(촘피) 두 마리 줘야 해!

english: You's got no chompies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 너 chompies(촘피) 없어... 배배 타기 없어!

english: Player is transported west of Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: 플레이어가 Tai Bwo Wannai(타이 보 와나이) 서쪽으로 이동한다.

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at Karamja beach.
translation: 겨우 물에 뜨는 통나무배가 Karamja(카람자) 해변에 도착한다.

english: No thanks.
Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want? But you's gives us two glug-glugs herbies first!
translation: 아빠가 그러는데, 너 원하면 우리랑 돌아가는 배 타고 갈 수 있대? 근데 너 먼저 우리한테 꿀꺽꿀꺽 풀떼기 두 개 줘야 해!

english: Dad sez yous not bringin' da rummy stuff...das bad stuffsies un we get in big bads.
translation: 아빠가 그랬어, 너 그 럼주 같은 거 갖고 오면 안 된대... 그거 나쁜 거라서 우리 완전 혼나.

english: You's got no glug-glugs herbies...no boatsie trips!
translation: 너 꿀꺽꿀꺽 풀떼기 없어... 배배 타기 없어!

english: You hand over two herbs and accept a ride from Fycie and Bugs on the makeshift boat.
translation: 약초 두 개를 건네고 Fycie(파이시)와 Bugs(벅스)의 임시 배를 얻어 탄다.

english: Player is transported to eastern Feldip Hills.
translation: 플레이어가 Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕) 동쪽으로 이동한다.

english: The barely sea-worthy log arrives at the Feldip Hills.
translation: 겨우 물에 뜨는 통나무배가 Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕)에 도착한다.

english: Yes please, I'll get a lift to Karamja with you.
No thanks.
Yes please, I'll get a lift back with you.
translation: 네, 돌아갈 때 같이 타고 갈게요.
