english: Hey yous tryin' not to get da sickies else yous be da sick-un and mebe get to be a dead-un if yous be da unlucky fing.
translation: 어이 너 병 안 걸리게 조심해, 안 그럼 너 병든 놈 되고, 운 나쁘면 죽은 놈 될지도 몰라.

english: Don't worry, I know how to take care of myself.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 제 몸은 제가 챙길 줄 알아요.

english: Yeah, whats yous wants creatures?
What are you doing here?

I's is guardin' da coffins-ies- make sure no fieves nick stuff from 'em. If dey's do, dey get's bashed and shoved down da big 'ole and get deaded by da zogries in da deadies place. So yous creature be wares...ok!
translation: 나 관짝들 지켜 - 도둑놈들 거기서 물건 못 훔치게. 훔치면, 두들겨 맞고 큰 구멍 아래로 처박혀서 죽은 놈들 사는 데서 zogries(조그르)한테 죽어. 그러니 너 생물 조심해... 알았지!

english: What's going on around here?
Da Zogries comes from da deadies place - deys attacking all da jig-dancers wot do da god stuff... jiggin an all. Dem zogries gonna dead all on us wiv da sickies.
translation: Zogries(조그르)가 죽은 놈들 사는 데서 나와 - 신 섬기는 춤추는 놈들 다 공격해... 막 춤추고 그러는 놈들. 그 조그르들 병으로 우리 다 죽일 거야.

english: What are these coffins doing here?
We's grabbed da closes dead-uns to stop da zogries gettin' em..de'se dead-uns coffins got da old-uns boneses and older-stuff in 'em, Grish seys we's needs to guard 'em...I's does what Grish seys.
translation: 우리 젤 가까운 죽은 놈들 가져왔어, 조그르가 못 가져가게.. 이 죽은 놈들 관짝에 옛날 놈들 뼈랑 더 옛날 물건 들었어, Grish(그리시)가 우리 그거 지켜야 한대... 나 그리시 하라는 대로 해.

english: Are you always angry?
Me's was born angry....me's wantin' to dead many peples...is what ogries meant to do...
translation: 나 화나서 태어났어.... 나 사람 많이 죽이고 싶어... 그게 오우거가 하는 거야...

english: Sorry, I have to go.
Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.
translation: 멈춰라, 생물! 이 도시는 오우거와 그 친구들만 들어올 수 있다. 잃어버린 유물 같은 거시기로 우정의 증표를 보여 주면 지나가게 해 주지.

english: Until then, back to whence you came!
Halt! You cannot pass here.
I am a friend to ogres.
You will be my friend only with gold. Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
translation: 금이 있어야만 내 친구다. 순금 주괴를 하나 가져오면 지나가게 해 주지.

english: Creature, did you bring me the gold?
No, I don't have it.
No gold, no passage. Get out of this city!
translation: 금 없으면 통과도 없다. 이 도시에서 나가라!

english: Here it is!
It's brought it! On your way.
What are you doing here?
What's going on around here?
What are these coffins doing here?
Are you always angry?
Sorry, I have to go.
So much blood flows through these lands.
translation: 이 땅에는 참으로 많은 피가 흐르고 있습니다.

english: Where does the blood come from?
Throughout the generations, countless people of this land have perished in times of strife, with their bodies left to rot where they fell.
translation: 대대로 이 땅의 수많은 사람이 분쟁의 시기에 목숨을 잃었고, 그 시신은 쓰러진 자리에 그대로 버려져 썩어 갔습니다.

english: Some were slain by the deadly creatures that roam the land; others perished at the hands of their fellow citizens during the wars of this land.
translation: 어떤 이는 이 땅을 떠도는 치명적인 생물에게 죽임을 당했고, 또 어떤 이는 이 땅의 전쟁 중에 같은 시민의 손에 목숨을 잃었습니다.

english: Their blood flowed into the soil, pooling and percolating unseen in the dark, as the power of the Altar drew it to this sacred place to form the River.
translation: 그들의 피는 흙으로 스며들어 어둠 속에서 보이지 않게 고이고 배어들었고, Altar(제단)의 힘이 그 피를 이 신성한 곳으로 끌어와 River(강)을 이루었습니다.

english: Why are you here?
The blood is the blood of Kourend's citizens. It is fitting that we honour their memory.
translation: 이 피는 Kourend(쿠렌드) 시민들의 피입니다. 그들을 기리는 것은 마땅한 일이지요.

english: Also, it smells so good.
I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 그럼 경치 즐기시도록 저는 이만 가 볼게요.

english: I see the river foaming with much blood.
Where does the blood come from?
Why are you here?
I'll leave you to enjoy the view.
translation: 그럼 경치 즐기시도록 저는 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Hello there. So you're a bard?
I am afraid I cannot speak to outerlanders. Besides, I am busy composing an epic.
translation: 미안하지만 외지인과는 말을 나눌 수 없소. 게다가 지금은 서사시를 짓느라 바쁘오.

english: Hello? Yes? You want something, outerlander?
translation: 여보시오? 그래, 무슨 일이오? 원하는 게 있소, 외지인?

english: Are you a member of the council?
Why, indeed I am, outerlander! My talents as an exemplary musician made it difficult for them not to accept me! Why do you wish to know this?
translation: 아무렴, 그렇고말고, 외지인! 나 같은 모범적인 음악가의 재능을 보고 받아들이지 않기란 어려웠을 테지! 그건 왜 알고 싶소?

english: Well, I ask because I am currently doing the Fremennik trials so as to join your clan. I need seven of the twelve council of elders to vote for me.
translation: 그게, 지금 당신네 부족에 들어가려고 Fremennik trials(프레메닉 시험)을 치르고 있어서 여쭤봤어요. 원로회 열두 분 중 일곱 분의 표가 필요하거든요.

english: Ahhh... and you wish to earn my vote? I will gladly accept you as a Fremennik should you be able to prove yourself to have a little musical ability!
translation: 아하... 그래서 내 표를 얻고 싶다는 거로군? 그대가 음악적 재능이 조금이라도 있음을 증명한다면 기꺼이 그대를 Fremennik(프레메닉)으로 받아들이겠소!

english: So how would I do that?
Why, by playing in our longhall! All you need to do is impress the revellers there with a few verses of an epic of your own creation!
translation: 그야 우리 longhall(롱홀)에서 연주하는 것이지! 그곳에서 흥청대는 이들을 그대가 직접 지은 서사시 몇 구절로 감동시키기만 하면 된다오!

english: So what say you outerlander? Are you up for the challenge?
Sure! This certainly sounds pretty easy to accomplish - I'll have your vote in no time!
translation: 물론이죠! 꽤 쉬워 보이네요. 금방 표를 받아 낼게요!

english: That is great news outerlander! We always need more music lovers here!
translation: 반가운 소식이오, 외지인! 이곳엔 음악 애호가가 언제나 더 필요하다오!

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: 됐어요! 회의에서 시시한 표 하나 얻자고 하기엔 일이 너무 많네요! 다른 사람을 찾아볼게요.

english: So how would I go about writing this epic?
Well, first of all you are going to need an instrument. Like all true bards you are going to have to make this yourself.
translation: 우선 악기가 필요하오. 모든 진정한 음유시인이 그러하듯 그대도 직접 만들어야 하오.

english: How do I make an instrument?
Well, it is a long and drawn-out process. Just east of this village there is an unusually musical tree that can be used to make very high quality instruments.
translation: 음, 길고도 지루한 과정이라오. 이 마을 바로 동쪽에 유난히 음악적인 나무가 있는데, 그걸로 아주 질 좋은 악기를 만들 수 있소.

english: Cut a piece from it, and then carve it into a special shape that will allow you to string it. Using a knife as you would craft any other wooden object would be best for this.
translation: 거기서 한 조각을 잘라 낸 다음, 줄을 걸 수 있는 특별한 모양으로 깎으시오. 다른 나무 물건을 만들 때처럼 칼을 쓰는 게 가장 좋을 것이오.

english: Then what do I need to do?
Next you will need to string your lyre. There is a troll to the South-east who has some golden wool. I would not recommend using anything else to string your lyre with.
translation: 다음엔 lyre(리라)에 줄을 걸어야 하오. 남동쪽에 golden wool(황금 털실)을 가진 트롤이 있소. 다른 걸로 리라 줄을 거는 건 권하지 않겠소.

english: Anything else?
Well, when you have crafted your lyre you will need the blessing of the Fossegrimen to tune your lyre to perfection before you even consider a public performance.
translation: 그리고 lyre(리라)를 다 만들었다면, 사람들 앞에서 공연할 생각을 하기 전에 Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)의 축복을 받아 리라를 완벽하게 조율해야 하오.

english: Who or what is Fossegrimen?
Fossegrimen is a lake spirit that lives just a little way South-west of this village. Make her an offering of fish, and you will then be ready for your performance.
translation: Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)은 이 마을에서 남서쪽으로 조금 떨어진 곳에 사는 호수의 정령이오. 그 정령에게 물고기를 제물로 바치면 공연할 준비가 끝날 것이오.

english: Make sure you give her a suitable offering however. If the offering is found to be unworthy, then you may find yourself unable to play your lyre with any skill at all!
translation: 하지만 반드시 걸맞은 제물을 바쳐야 하오. 제물이 하찮다고 여겨지면, 리라를 조금도 제대로 연주하지 못하게 될 수도 있소!

english: So what would be a worthy offering?
A raw shark, manta ray, or sea turtle should be sufficient as an offering.
translation: raw shark(날상어), manta ray(쥐가오리), sea turtle(바다거북) 정도면 제물로 충분할 것이오.

english: Okay, what else do I need to do?
When you have crafted your lyre and been blessed by Fossegrimen, then you will finally be ready to make your performance to the revellers at the longhall.
translation: lyre(리라)를 만들고 Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)의 축복까지 받았다면, 마침내 longhall(롱홀)에서 흥청대는 이들 앞에서 공연할 준비가 된 것이오.

english: Head past the bouncers and onto the stage, and then begin to play. If all goes well, you should find the music spring to your mind and sing your own epic on the spot.
translation: 경비원들을 지나 무대에 올라 연주를 시작하시오. 모든 게 잘 풀리면 음악이 절로 떠올라, 그 자리에서 그대만의 서사시를 노래하게 될 것이오.

english: I will observe both you and the audience, and if you show enough talent, I will happily vote in your favour at the council of elders.
translation: 나는 그대와 관중을 모두 지켜볼 것이고, 그대가 충분한 재능을 보인다면 원로회에서 기꺼이 그대에게 표를 던지겠소.

english: Is that clear enough, outerlander? Would you like me to repeat anything?
translation: 이만하면 알겠소, 외지인? 다시 들려줬으면 하는 게 있소?

english: Can you remind me about making a lyre again, please Olaf?
translation: lyre(리라) 만드는 법 다시 알려 주시겠어요, Olaf(올라프)?

english: There are three parts to making the lyre; First you need to cut some special wood from the special musical tree which can be found just east of Rellekka.
translation: lyre(리라)를 만드는 데는 세 단계가 있소. 먼저 Rellekka(렐레카) 바로 동쪽에 있는 특별한 음악의 나무에서 특별한 목재를 잘라 와야 하오.

english: When you have the wood, you will need to use a knife to craft it into a Lyre. When you have an unstrung lyre, you will need to string it before you can play it.
translation: 목재를 구했으면 칼로 다듬어 Lyre(리라)로 만들어야 하오. 줄 없는 리라가 되면, 연주하기 전에 줄을 걸어야 하오.

english: I would not use anything other than the golden string of Lalli, a troll who lives in a cave just to the South-east.
translation: 나라면 남동쪽 바로 근처 동굴에 사는 트롤, Lalli(랄리)의 황금 실 말고는 아무것도 쓰지 않겠소.

english: Can you remind me about getting a blessing from Fossegrimen again?
translation: Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)에게 축복받는 법 다시 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Certainly outerlander! Fossegrimen is a lake spirit who lives in the lake just to the South-west of here. She will bless you so that you may play your lyre,
translation: 물론이오, 외지인! Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)은 여기서 바로 남서쪽 호수에 사는 호수의 정령이오. 그 정령은 그대가 리라를 연주할 수 있도록 축복해 줄 것이오,

english: if you give her a worthy offering. She will only accept raw fish, so place a raw fish on her pedestal, and she will bless you. The better the offering, the longer
translation: 걸맞은 제물을 바친다면 말이오. 그 정령은 날생선만 받으니, 받침대에 날생선을 올려놓으면 축복해 줄 것이오. 제물이 좋을수록

english: the amount of time you will be blessed for. You will not be able to perform on stage without the blessing of the Fossegrimen.
translation: 축복이 더 오래 지속되오. Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)의 축복 없이는 무대에서 공연할 수 없소.

english: (shows previous options)
Can you remind me about how to perform at the longhall again please?
translation: longhall(롱홀)에서 공연하는 법 다시 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Not a problem outerlander. When you have your lyre and have been blessed, you will be able to pass the bouncer at the stage entrance of the longhall.
translation: 문제없소, 외지인. lyre(리라)를 갖추고 축복을 받았다면, longhall(롱홀) 무대 입구의 경비원을 지나갈 수 있을 것이오.

english: He will not let you pass unless he believes you are ready to perform on stage. Simply go past him and onto the stage and use your lyre, and you will
translation: 그 경비원은 그대가 무대에 설 준비가 됐다고 믿지 않으면 들여보내 주지 않소. 경비원을 지나 무대에 올라 리라를 사용하면,

english: begin to play to entertain the revellers. If all has gone well, you will feel the music come to your mind, unbidden, as you sing an epic of your exploits.
translation: 흥청대는 이들을 즐겁게 할 연주가 시작될 것이오. 모든 게 잘 풀렸다면, 그대의 모험담을 서사시로 노래하는 동안 음악이 저절로 떠오르는 것을 느낄 것이오.

english: I will watch your performance from backstage, and also study how much the crowd likes you, and if I believe you have enough talent, then I will vote for you at the council.
translation: 나는 무대 뒤에서 그대의 공연을 지켜보며 관중이 그대를 얼마나 좋아하는지도 살필 것이오. 그대에게 충분한 재능이 있다고 판단되면 원로회에서 그대에게 표를 던지겠소.

english: No thanks, I think that's all pretty straight forward. I'll go and make my lyre now.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 꽤 간단하네요. 지금 바로 lyre(리라)를 만들러 갈게요.

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Bard's Trial!
As you finished playing you felt Fossegrimen's power leave you...
translation: 연주를 마치자 Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)의 힘이 빠져나가는 것이 느껴졌다...

english: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing!
translation: 와! 정말 굉장했소! 그대는 내가 지금껏 공연을 지켜본 음유시인 중에서도 손꼽히는 최고요!

english: You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
translation: 그대는 확실히 내 표를 얻었소! 머지않아 함께 이중창을 할 수 있길 바라오!

english: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: 그럼 원로회에서 제게 표를 주실 거라고 믿어도 될까요?

english: You have a truly poetic soul! Anyone who can compose such a beautiful epic, and then perform it so flawlessly can only bring good to our clan!
translation: 그대는 참으로 시인의 영혼을 지녔소! 그토록 아름다운 서사시를 짓고 그렇게 흠잡을 데 없이 공연할 수 있는 자라면 우리 부족에 좋은 일만 가져다줄 것이오!

english: Erm... so that's a yes, then?
Absolutely! We must collaborate together on a duet sometime, don't you think?
translation: 물론이오! 언젠가 함께 이중창을 만들어 봐야 하지 않겠소?

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: 혹시 사랑의 발라드를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아시나요?

english: Well, as official Fremennik bard, it falls within my remit to compose all music for the tribe. I am fully versed in all the various types of romantic music.
translation: 음, Fremennik(프레메닉) 공식 음유시인으로서 부족의 모든 음악을 짓는 것이 내 소임이오. 온갖 종류의 낭만적인 음악에 통달해 있다오.

english: Great! Can you write me one then?
translation: 잘됐네요! 그럼 하나 써 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well... normally I would be thrilled at the chance to show my skill as a poet in composing a seductively romantic ballad...
translation: 음... 평소 같으면 매혹적이고 낭만적인 발라드를 지어 시인으로서의 솜씨를 뽐낼 기회에 몹시 기뻐했을 테지만...

english: let me guess; here comes the 'but'.
...but unfortunately I cannot concentrate fully upon my work recently.
translation: ...하지만 안타깝게도 요즘은 일에 온전히 집중할 수가 없소.

english: Why is that then?
It is these old worn out shoes of mine... As a bard I am expected to wander the lands, singing of the glorious battles of our warriors.
translation: 이 낡아 빠진 신발 때문이오... 음유시인인 나는 이 땅을 떠돌며 우리 전사들의 영광스러운 전투를 노래해야 하는 몸이라오.

english: If you can find me a pair of sturdy boots to replace these old worn out ones of mine, I will be happy to spend the time on composing you a romantic ballad.
translation: 이 낡은 신발을 대신할 sturdy boots(튼튼한 장화) 한 켤레를 구해 준다면, 기꺼이 시간을 들여 그대에게 낭만적인 발라드를 지어 주겠소.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: 혹시 맞춤 sturdy boots(튼튼한 장화)를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아시나요?

english: I'm sorry outerlander... If I did, I would not trouble you to go and find them for me, would I?
translation: 미안하오, 외지인... 내가 알았다면 굳이 그대에게 찾아 달라고 수고를 끼치지 않았겠지, 안 그렇소?

english: Hello Olaf. Do you have a beautiful love song written for me?
translation: 안녕하세요, Olaf(올라프). 저를 위한 아름다운 사랑 노래는 써 두셨나요?

english: That depends outerlander... Do you have some new boots for me? My feet get so tired roaming the land...
translation: 그건 그대에게 달렸소, 외지인... 내게 줄 새 장화는 있소? 이 땅을 떠도느라 발이 몹시 피곤하다오...

english: As a matter of fact - I do!
Oh! Superb! Those are great! They're just what I was looking for! Here, take this song with my compliments! It is one of my finest works yet!
translation: 오! 훌륭하오! 정말 멋진 장화로군! 바로 내가 찾던 것이오! 자, 내 성의의 표시로 이 노래를 받으시오! 지금까지 지은 것 중 손꼽히는 걸작이라오!

english: So you think this song is pretty good then?
translation: 그럼 이 노래가 꽤 괜찮다고 생각하시는 거죠?

english: Ahhh.... outerlander... it is the most beautiful romantic ballad I have ever been inspired to write...
translation: 아아.... 외지인... 이것은 내가 영감을 받아 쓴 것 중 가장 아름답고 낭만적인 발라드라오...

english: Only a woman with a heart of icey stone could fail to be moved by its beauty!
translation: 얼음장 같은 돌 심장을 가진 여인이 아니고서야 이 아름다움에 마음이 움직이지 않을 리 없소!

english: Thanks! That sounds perfect!
Hello again to you [Fremennik name]. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: 다시 만나 반갑소, [Fremennik name]. 우리 음유시인끼리는 뭉쳐야 하지 않겠소?

english: About the Music Cape...
I believe you are the person to talk to if I want to get a Music Cape?
translation: Music Cape(음악 망토)를 얻으려면 당신과 이야기하면 된다던데, 맞나요?

english: That's right! If you know that then you'll also know that they cost 99000 coins.
translation: 맞소! 그걸 안다면 가격이 99000코인이라는 것도 알고 있겠지.

english: No, I hadn't heard that.
Well, they do.
Have fun with it.
I don't have that much at the moment.
Save up some more then!
Yes, I know.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
The bard hands you another hood for your cape.
translation: 음유시인이 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 건네준다.

english: Yes, but you don't know all of the music in the land.
translation: 그렇소, 하지만 그대는 이 땅의 모든 음악을 알지는 못하오.

english: Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: Basilisk Jaws(바실리스크 턱)에 얽힌 멋진 이야기를 아시나요?

english: Why do you ask?
Oh my! This must be the jaw of a legendary Basilisk Knight. There's a great song about how the Fremennik warriors of old would use these jaws to enhance their helmets.
translation: 이런! 이건 전설의 Basilisk Knight(바실리스크 기사)의 턱이 틀림없소. 옛 Fremennik(프레메닉) 전사들이 이 턱으로 투구를 강화하곤 했다는 멋진 노래가 있다오.

english: I see. I have a nice helmet that Neitiznot's Burgher gave to me. I bet it would work well with that.
translation: 그렇군요. 제게 Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)의 Burgher(촌장)이 준 좋은 투구가 있는데, 그거랑 잘 어울리겠네요.

english: I'm sure it would, [Fremennik name]. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: 분명 그럴 것이오, [Fremennik name]. 자, 그 노래를 들어 보겠소?

english: Err... I think I'll pass. Thanks for the help though.
I was wondering... Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: 그런데요... 제 lyre(리라) 연주를 다시 배울 수 있을까요?

english: Well, that is an interesting question. Let me let you into a little secret. If you make another offering to Fossegrimen you will learn a secret melody.
translation: 음, 흥미로운 질문이로군. 작은 비밀을 하나 알려 주겠소. Fossegrimen(포세그리멘)에게 다시 제물을 바치면 비밀 선율을 배우게 될 것이오.

english: What kind of melody?
It is the song of Rellekka. When you play it, it will bring you back to this town wherever you are in this world.
translation: Rellekka(렐레카)의 노래요. 그걸 연주하면 이 세상 어디에 있든 이 마을로 돌아오게 해 준다오.

english: We often go adventuring with bards for precisely this reason; No matter where we have ended up we can return safe and sound to home.
translation: 우리가 음유시인과 함께 모험을 떠나는 게 바로 그 때문이오. 어디에 다다르든 무사히 고향으로 돌아올 수 있으니 말이오.

english: Thanks Olaf!
Yes
No
Remind me about crafting a lyre
translation: lyre(리라) 만드는 법 다시 알려 주세요

english: Remind me about Fossegrimen
Remind me about playing on stage
translation: 무대 공연에 대해 다시 알려 주세요

english: I don't need a reminder
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
About the Music Cape...
Cape
No, I hadn't heard that!
Ok, I'll pay.
I'm not paying that!
Yes, I do.
Hood
Do you know any great stories about Basilisk Jaws?
translation: Basilisk Jaws(바실리스크 턱)에 얽힌 멋진 이야기를 아시나요?

english: Can I learn to play my lyre again?
translation: 제 lyre(리라) 연주를 다시 배울 수 있을까요?

english: It's mine. You can't have it, we found it!
translation: 내 거야. 넌 못 가져, 우리가 찾았어!

english: What have you found?
Not dragonstones. I like dragonstones, that's why I came here. However, I found a valuable coin instead, it speaks to me... but you can't have it! It's precious to me!
translation: dragonstones(드래곤스톤)은 아니야. 난 드래곤스톤이 좋아, 그래서 여기 온 거야. 근데 대신 귀한 코인을 찾았어, 그게 나한테 말을 해... 하지만 넌 못 가져! 나한테 소중한 거야!

english: I don't want it, I have something better.
translation: 그거 필요 없어요, 저한텐 더 좋은 게 있거든요.

english: What is it? Is it dragonstones? I like dragonstones!
Ask it for five! It looks rich!
translation: 다섯 개 달라고 해! 부자 같아 보여!

english: Five? Will it give us five?
translation: 다섯 개? 우리한테 다섯 개 줄까?

english: No. I don't have five dragonstones.
Well then we are not interested!
Yes. I have five dragonstones, tell you what, I'll trade you them for that coin you found.
translation: 네. dragonstones(드래곤스톤) 다섯 개 있어요. 이렇게 하죠, 그걸 당신이 찾은 코인이랑 바꿔 드릴게요.

english: Yes! Yes! We'll trade it for the dragonstones.
No we will not! It is too precious!
But why? I like dragonstones...
It is trying to trick us! Evil, nasty creature it is. Do not listen to it!
translation: 그게 우릴 속이려는 거야! 사악하고 고약한 놈이야, 저건. 그 말 듣지 마!

english: But it seems nice enough...
I am standing right here, you know? You really are crazy. Yes, I'll give you five! Do we have a deal or not?
translation: 저 바로 여기 서 있거든요? 정말 제정신이 아니네요. 네, 다섯 개 드릴게요! 거래할 거예요, 말 거예요?

english: Yes! Yes!
You give Olbertus a dragonstone and receive a very worn coin in return.
translation: Olbertus(올베르투스)에게 dragonstone(드래곤스톤)을 건네고 아주 닳은 코인을 받는다.

english: Thanks for helping me, I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: 도와줘서 고마워요. 머릿속 목소리에 계속 귀를 기울였다면 무슨 일이 일어났을지 모르겠어요.

english: I took that coin from the Stone Relief in the Crypt of the Moon and trapped my friend Eodan in a secret room behind the relief. Could you return the coin to the relief and set him free?
translation: 제가 Crypt of the Moon(달의 지하 묘지)의 Stone Relief(돌 부조)에서 그 코인을 떼어 가는 바람에 친구 Eodan(이오단)이 부조 뒤 비밀의 방에 갇혀 버렸어요. 코인을 부조에 돌려놓고 그 친구를 풀어 줄 수 있을까요?

english: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.
translation: 다시 생각해 보니, 그냥 제가 가질게요.

english: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: 귀한 거라니, 그냥 당신을 죽이고 빼앗아야겠네요.

english: Please! No!
This is a dangerous fight, you will lose your items on death.
Foolish decision!
I require this one alive human!
Just kidding!
You're crazy!
Thanks for killing that creature.
It appears that when I stole the coin, the creature possessed me.
translation: 제가 코인을 훔쳤을 때 그 생물이 저한테 빙의했던 것 같아요.

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
translation: 그 코인이 이제 저한테 없어서 다행이에요. 머릿속 목소리에 계속 귀를 기울였다면 무슨 일이 일어났을지 모르겠어요.

english: For some reason the coin returned to me. Here, take it before it corrupts me again!
translation: 왠지 코인이 다시 저한테 돌아왔어요. 자, 또 저를 타락시키기 전에 가져가세요!

english: I'm glad I no longer have that coin. I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen the voices in my head.
translation: 그 코인이 이제 저한테 없어서 다행이에요. 머릿속 목소리에 계속 귀를 기울였다면 무슨 일이 일어났을지 모르겠어요.

english: What have you found?
I don't want it, I have something better.
translation: 그거 필요 없어요, 저한텐 더 좋은 게 있거든요.

english: Yes, give him your dragonstones.
No, don't give him your dragonstones.
Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.
translation: 귀한 거라니, 그냥 당신을 죽이고 빼앗아야겠네요.

english: Attack Olbertus.
Just kidding.
You're crazy!
Hello again!
Hmph!
What do you do here?
Hmph! Why? What do I know? I'm just an old man; what would anyone want with an old man?
translation: 흥! 왜? 내가 뭘 안다고? 난 그냥 늙은이일 뿐이야. 누가 늙은이한테 볼일이 있겠어?

english: I'm lost... Can you help me?
Hmph! Who says I'm not lost, eh? Ever think of that, did you?
translation: 흥! 나라고 길을 안 잃었다고 누가 그래, 응? 그런 생각은 해 봤어?

english: In a rush to find out all the answers, not thinking for a second that someone else might be just as lost, if not more lost, than you! And what do you care about them, huh?
translation: 답을 다 알아내려고 서두르기만 하고, 다른 누군가도 너만큼, 아니 너보다 더 길을 잃었을지도 모른다는 생각은 눈곱만큼도 안 하지! 게다가 네가 그 사람들한테 무슨 관심이나 있어, 응?

english: Do you know about the Myreque?
Hmph! Why should I know about the Myreque, eh? What use have they ever been to me, huh? I ask you!
translation: 흥! 내가 왜 Myreque(미레크)에 대해 알아야 하는데, 응? 그놈들이 나한테 무슨 도움이 된 적이나 있어, 응? 어디 말해 봐!

english: Can you help me?
Hmph! What makes you think that I can help you, eh? Do I look like a fountain of knowledge, eh? Do I?
translation: 흥! 내가 널 도울 수 있을 거라고 왜 생각하는데, 응? 내가 지식의 샘이라도 되는 것처럼 보여, 응? 그래 보여?

english: Well, you've helped me before! You said something about symbols? To find the Myreque!
translation: 하지만 전에 도와주셨잖아요! 상징에 대해 뭐라고 하셨는데요? Myreque(미레크)를 찾으려면요!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, that's how to get to them. Follow the symbols.
translation: 흥! 그래, 물론이지. 그게 그놈들한테 가는 방법이야. 상징을 따라가.

english: Which symbols?
The symbol of the Myreque - the silver sickle!
translation: Myreque(미레크)의 상징, silver sickle(은 낫) 말이야!

english: Oh, and where would that be then?
Around and about; it should be an aid.
Okay, thanks
But they live right under your house?
translation: 하지만 그 사람들은 어르신 집 바로 밑에 살잖아요?

english: Hmph! Suppose they do. Stupid Myreque...
translation: 흥! 그렇다 치자고. 멍청한 Myreque(미레크) 놈들...

english: Well, you've helped me before! You helped me find the Myreque!
translation: 하지만 전에 도와주셨잖아요! Myreque(미레크) 찾는 걸 도와주셨잖아요!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're right below us. Hmph!
translation: 흥! 그래, 물론이지. 상징을 따라가라느니 하는 거. 하지만 이젠 소용없어, 그놈들은 바로 우리 밑에 있으니까. 흥!

english: Okay, thanks.
Hmph! Dead! That's what I know about the Myreque. You're lucky to not be dead as well. Don't talk about them any more!
translation: 흥! 죽었어! 그게 내가 Myreque(미레크)에 대해 아는 거야. 너도 안 죽은 게 다행인 줄 알아. 그놈들 얘기는 이제 꺼내지도 마!

english: Hmph! Yes of course, follow the symbols and all that. Pointless now though, they're all dead! Hmph!
translation: 흥! 그래, 물론이지. 상징을 따라가라느니 하는 거. 하지만 이젠 소용없어, 다 죽었으니까! 흥!

english: Ah! vampyre!
It's okay. It's just me.
Here, solve this.
Please make yourself some space, I have something for you.
translation: 소지품에 자리 좀 비워 둬. 줄 게 있으니까.

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 내가 보기엔 안 푼 것 같은데.

english: Well done [Player name]. Here you go.
You've obtained [another clue scroll/a casket]!
What do you do here?
I'm lost... Can you help me?
Do you know about the Myreque?
Can you help me?
Okay, thanks
Okay, thanks.
What brings you here, young [man/lady/one]?
I'm just wandering around.
Oh, that's nice. I used to wander around, back when my legs were better. So long ago.
translation: 오, 그거 좋구먼. 나도 다리가 성하던 시절엔 여기저기 쏘다니곤 했지. 참 오래전 일일세.

english: Nothing, really.
That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young [man/lady/one].
translation: 요즘 젊은이들이 그게 문제야. 그래도 우리 아들은 안 그렇다네. 착한 녀석이지, 늘 일만 하고. 그래서 통 찾아오질 않는 게야. 이제 가 보게, 젊은 [man/lady/one].

english: Marlo sent me to fix your furniture.
translation: Marlo(말로) 씨가 가구를 고쳐 드리라고 저를 보냈어요.

english: My boy Marlo sent you? Oh yes, you've come to help with my furniture. It's in a terrible state. You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture.
translation: 우리 아들 Marlo(말로)가 자네를 보냈다고? 아, 그렇지, 내 가구를 손봐 주러 왔구먼. 상태가 말이 아니라네. 우선 낡아빠진 가구부터 전부 치우는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to replace. I need a better bed too. Let me know when you've removed all the old furniture.
translation: 걸상 두 개, 탁자 두 개, 의자 하나, 그리고 썩은 카펫을 바꿔야 하네. 더 좋은 침대도 필요하고. 낡은 가구를 다 치우거든 알려 주게.

english: Ah, young [man/lady/one], how's the redecoration coming on?
translation: 아, 젊은 [man/lady/one], 집 단장은 잘돼 가나?

english: What am I supposed to be doing again?
You'll want to start by removing all the tatty old furniture. There are two stools, two tables, a chair and a rotten carpet to remove, as well as the campbed. Let me know when you've done that.
translation: 우선 낡아빠진 가구부터 전부 치우는 게 좋을 걸세. 걸상 두 개, 탁자 두 개, 의자 하나, 썩은 카펫, 그리고 야전 침대까지 치워야 하네. 다 치우거든 알려 주게.

english: I've been removing the old furniture.
You still need to remove: - A broken stool in the kitchen - A broken stool in the bedroom - A broken chair in the bedroom
translation: 아직 치울 게 남았네: - 부엌의 부서진 걸상 - 침실의 부서진 걸상 - 침실의 부서진 의자

english: - A broken table in the kitchen - The old campbed - The rotten carpet
translation: - 부엌의 부서진 탁자 - 낡은 야전 침대 - 썩은 카펫

english: I've finished removing all the old furniture.
Jolly good, young [man/lady/one]. Now, we'll need to have a talk about what you'll build for me to replace it.
translation: 아주 잘했네, 젊은 [man/lady/one]. 이제 그 자리에 뭘 새로 만들어 줄지 얘기를 좀 해 보세.

english: You see, I used to be a carpenter myself, before the arthritis got me. Such wonderful things I could build. Let me tell you about the things Construction can do for you...
translation: 실은 나도 관절염이 오기 전엔 목수였다네. 참 멋진 것들을 만들곤 했지. Construction(건설)로 자네가 할 수 있는 것들을 알려 주겠네...

english: Is this necessary? I've got a house of my own, in [city], and I've been learning about Construction for a while.
translation: 꼭 들어야 하나요? 저도 [city]에 집이 있고, Construction(건설)도 꽤 오래 배워 왔거든요.

english: A cutscene plays in which Old Man Yarlo is in a newly purchased player-owned house.
translation: Old Man Yarlo(얄로 영감)이 새로 산 플레이어 소유 집 안에 있는 장면이 나온다.

english: As a builder, in your own house, you can create your own rooms full of furniture. A house may start out very basic...
translation: 건축가로서 자기 집 안에 가구로 가득한 방을 만들 수 있다네. 처음엔 집이 아주 단출하겠지만...

english: ... but in Building Mode, you'll see what you can add to it...
translation: ... 건축 모드에 들어가면 뭘 더할 수 있는지 보일 걸세...

english: Old Man Yarlo builds a fully furnished parlour.
translation: Old Man Yarlo(얄로 영감)이 가구를 완벽히 갖춘 응접실을 짓는다.

english: ... with fancier options available as your Construction level rises.
translation: ... Construction(건설) 레벨이 오를수록 더 근사한 선택지가 생기지.

english: Old Man Yarlo removes several furniture and builds fancier ones.
translation: Old Man Yarlo(얄로 영감)이 가구 몇 개를 치우고 더 근사한 것들로 새로 짓는다.

english: You can add lots more rooms, and build their furniture too, unlocking really handy features.
translation: 방을 훨씬 더 많이 늘리고 그 방의 가구도 만들 수 있지. 그러면 정말 쓸모 있는 기능들이 열린다네.

english: The camera shifts and Old Man Yarlo is now seen in a fully furnished home fitted with the highest-level furniture.
translation: 화면이 바뀌고, Old Man Yarlo(얄로 영감)이 최고 레벨 가구로 꽉 채운 집 안에 있는 모습이 보인다.

english: For example, in a study, you could build a lectern for creating spell tablets, powerful items that can cast spells without runes. You could sell your tablets to other people too.
translation: 예를 들어 서재에 독서대를 만들면 주문 석판을 만들 수 있지. 룬 없이도 주문을 쓸 수 있는 강력한 물건일세. 석판을 다른 사람들에게 팔 수도 있고.

english: A Teleport Nexus can take you to a huge range of destinations, making your home a powerful travel hub.
translation: Teleport Nexus(텔레포트 넥서스)가 있으면 아주 다양한 곳으로 갈 수 있어서, 자네 집이 강력한 교통 중심지가 된다네.

english: Show your dedication to the gods by building an altar, where you can sacrifice bones for bonus Prayer XP.
translation: 제단을 지어 신들께 정성을 보이게. 거기에 뼈를 바치면 Prayer(기도) 경험치를 더 받을 수 있지.

english: With a regeneration pool, you can get healed quickly, before you teleport back to the action.
translation: 재생 웅덩이가 있으면 다시 싸움터로 순간이동하기 전에 금방 회복할 수 있다네.

english: The Estate Agents can redecorate your house in different styles, if you want something a bit more impressive.
translation: 좀 더 그럴듯한 집을 원하면 Estate Agents(부동산 중개인)이 자네 집을 다른 양식으로 꾸며 줄 걸세.

english: And, of course, to make your house feel truly like a home, you can fill it with adorable critters...
translation: 그리고 물론, 집을 진짜 보금자리처럼 느끼고 싶다면 귀여운 동물들로 채울 수도 있지...

english: ... and drop your guests into the monster pit beneath your throne room.
translation: ... 손님들을 왕좌실 아래 괴물 구덩이에 떨어뜨릴 수도 있고.

english: All this could be yours, if you train Construction!
translation: Construction(건설)을 수련하면 이 모든 게 자네 것이 될 수 있다네!

english: Now, I was just getting round to telling you about the furniture I want you to build for me. For a start, I'd like two new stools, two new tables and a new chair.
translation: 자, 내가 만들어 달라는 가구 얘기를 막 하려던 참이었지. 우선 새 걸상 두 개, 새 탁자 두 개, 새 의자 하나가 필요하네.

english: Some basic wooden planks and some nails should do, for those. I won't ask for anything more fancy - it'd only get stolen anyway, in this neighbourhood.
translation: 그것들은 평범한 나무 판자와 못만 있으면 될 걸세. 더 화려한 건 바라지 않네. 이 동네에선 어차피 도둑맞을 테니까.

english: I'll want a new carpet too. They can really change the atmosphere of a room, you know! You can buy cloth at the sawmill to make one.
translation: 새 카펫도 하나 있어야겠네. 카펫 하나로 방 분위기가 확 달라진다니까! 제재소에서 천을 사서 만들 수 있다네.

english: Now, for the bed, I've got something special in mind. This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 그리고 침대는 특별히 생각해 둔 게 있네. 이 마을은 꽤 눅눅해서, 습기가 침대를 타고 올라와 이불에 배는 게 싫거든. 그런데 물에 강한 나무를 찾아냈지.

english: Those abandoned crates in the kitchen were here when I moved in, and I found they contain waxwood logs. Waxwood isn't much used in carpentry, but it resists water, so I want a bed made from that.
translation: 부엌에 있는 버려진 나무 상자는 내가 이사 올 때부터 있던 건데, 안에 왁스우드 통나무가 들어 있더군. 왁스우드는 목공에 잘 안 쓰이지만 물에 강하니, 그걸로 침대를 만들어 주게.

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name - I've known his family for years.
translation: 나무 상자에서 통나무 세 개를 꺼내 제재소에 가져가게. 내 이름을 대면 거기 친구가 판자로 만들어 줄 걸세. 그 집안과는 오래 알고 지냈거든.

english: I think that's everything - two stools, two tables, a chair, a bed and a carpet. Off you trot, young [man/lady/one]. I'll be here if you have any questions.
translation: 이걸로 다 된 것 같군. 걸상 두 개, 탁자 두 개, 의자 하나, 침대 하나, 카펫 하나. 어서 가 보게, 젊은 [man/lady/one]. 궁금한 게 있으면 난 여기 있겠네.

english: You young people are always rushing around trying to optimise the fun out of life. There are other ways to enjoy the world, you know! But I'm sure you know best.
translation: 자네 같은 젊은이들은 늘 이리저리 바쁘게 뛰어다니며 인생의 재미를 효율로 다 짜내 버린다니까. 세상을 즐기는 방법은 그것 말고도 있다네! 뭐, 자네가 더 잘 알겠지만.

english: Do you need some help with the building work, young [man/lady/one]?
translation: 짓는 일에 도움이 좀 필요한가, 젊은 [man/lady/one]?

english: How do I build furniture?
Ah. Look in the place where the new furniture will go...
translation: 아. 새 가구가 놓일 자리를 잘 보게...

english: A talented builder will see a vision there of the furniture they could build. Interact with that, and you should find you can build furniture.
translation: 재능 있는 건축가라면 거기서 자기가 만들 수 있는 가구의 환영을 보게 되지. 그것과 상호작용하면 가구를 만들 수 있을 걸세.

english: You'll need a hammer and saw. I can supply those if you need them.
translation: 망치와 톱이 필요하네. 없으면 내가 줄 수 있고.

english: Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
From the sawmill! They sell nails and cloth at reasonable prices. You'd have to take your own logs there, though, to get planks, but there are plenty of trees to chop nearby.
translation: 제재소에서지! 거기서 못과 천을 적당한 값에 판다네. 판자를 얻으려면 통나무는 직접 가져가야 하지만, 근처에 벨 나무가 잔뜩 있지.

english: Watch out, though - nails can bend, if you're not careful. You should probably get some spares, just in case.
translation: 그래도 조심하게. 못은 잘못하면 휘어 버리거든. 혹시 모르니 여분을 좀 챙겨 두는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: Look on your World Map to find the sawmill.
You've got a hammer and a saw. I wouldn't be able to offer you anything else.
translation: 망치도 톱도 다 있구먼. 그 밖에 줄 수 있는 건 없네.

english: I need some tools.
Would you like a [hammer/saw]? I can spare one.
Yes please.
Yarlo gives you a [hammer/saw].
No thanks.
Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 침대에 쓸 왁스우드 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: This town's quite damp, and I don't want the moisture rising up the bed into my blankets. But I've found some wood that resists water.
translation: 이 마을은 꽤 눅눅해서, 습기가 침대를 타고 올라와 이불에 배는 게 싫거든. 그런데 물에 강한 나무를 찾아냈지.

english: You'll have to take three logs from the crate to the sawmill. The chap there will turn them into planks if you mention my name.
translation: 나무 상자에서 통나무 세 개를 꺼내 제재소에 가져가게. 내 이름을 대면 거기 친구가 판자로 만들어 줄 걸세.

english: I'll get on with it.
That's everything! Thank you so much, young [man/lady/one]. Trot off back to my boy Marlo, now. He'll have something for you.
translation: 이걸로 다 됐네! 정말 고맙네, 젊은 [man/lady/one]. 이제 우리 아들 Marlo(말로)한테 돌아가 보게. 뭔가 줄 게 있을 걸세.

english: Okay, I'll head back to Marlo.
Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. Has my boy Marlo rewarded you yet?
translation: 또 왔구먼, 젊은 [man/lady/one]. 우리 아들 Marlo(말로)가 보상은 해 주던가?

english: Not yet. I'll get round to visiting him soon.
Yes, you should do that. You've earned it.
translation: 그래, 그러게. 자네는 받을 자격이 있으니.

english: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.
translation: 또 왔구먼, 젊은 [man/lady/one]. 자네 덕에 이 작은 집이 몰라보게 달라졌어. 이젠 여기 사는 게 훨씬 행복하다네.

english: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: Construction(건설)로 할 수 있는 걸 더 알려 주세요.

english: Thank you!
I'm just wandering around.
Nothing, really.
Listen to Yarlo.
Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.
translation: Yarlo(얄로)의 강의를 건너뛴다. 원하면 나중에 다시 들려준다.

english: How do I build furniture?
Where do I get planks, nails and cloth?
I need some tools.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Tell me about the waxwood for the bed.
translation: 침대에 쓸 왁스우드 얘기를 해 주세요.

english: I'll get on with it.
That's good to hear. Goodbye now.
Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
translation: Construction(건설)로 할 수 있는 걸 더 알려 주세요.

english: I'm here about Necrovarus.
Good news - the enchantment worked!
So Necrovarus has let the ghosts go free.... You have achieved many wonderful things, my young friend.
translation: 그래서 Necrovarus(네크로바루스)가 유령들을 풀어 줬구나.... 정말 대단한 일들을 해냈구나, 젊은 친구.

english: I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Hello there, just dropping in to thank you again. It all went perfectly. Alice and her husband can communicate again.
translation: 안녕하세요, 다시 감사 인사드리러 들렀어요. 모든 게 완벽하게 됐어요. Alice(앨리스)랑 남편분이 다시 대화할 수 있게 됐어요.

english: I can't help but shed a tear about my own family. My sisters are so vile, I refuse to talk to them these days.
translation: 내 가족 생각을 하면 눈물이 나는구나. 자매들이 하도 고약해서 요즘은 말도 안 섞는단다.

english: Sorry to hear that.
Never mind; we've reunited a happy family of farmers; that's enough for me.
translation: 괜찮다; 우리가 행복한 농부 가족을 다시 이어 줬잖니. 난 그걸로 충분하단다.

english: Answer this, please.
You've been given a challenge scroll!
Well done.
You've been given a new clue!
I'm here about Necrovarus.
I'm here about the farmers east of here.
Alright?
I've been better...
What happened to your foot?
I was minding my own business in that abandoned shack for the night and suddenly I could hear...
translation: 저 버려진 오두막에서 밤에 혼자 조용히 지내고 있었는데, 갑자기 무슨 소리가 들리는 거야...

english: A g-g-g-ghost?!
No... Don't interrupt!
Where was I?
That was it... a faint sound... wind chimes...
translation: 그래, 그거였지... 희미한 소리... 풍경 소리...

english: Please don't tell me you were attacked by the wind.
What did I say about interruptions?
Sorry.

The chiming grew louder and started to sound like the knocking of bones. I was in the bed hiding under the moth-eaten sheet - ignorance is bliss, y'know? - and suddenly the sheet was pulled off of me and there was
translation: 딸랑거리는 소리가 점점 커지더니 뼈다귀 부딪치는 소리처럼 들리기 시작했어. 난 침대에서 좀먹은 이불 밑에 숨어 있었지. 모르는 게 약이라잖아? 그런데 갑자기 누가 이불을 홱 걷어 가더니 거기엔

english: a-
A skeleton!
I SAID NO INTER- Oh yes, that's correct... Skeletons. Two of the blighters.
translation: 말 끊지 말라고 했잖-- 아, 맞아, 그거야... 해골. 망할 놈이 둘이나.

english: Well, you seem to have got away in one piece!
One piece?! Do you not-
THE BONEY BLIGHTER BIT MY FOOT!
translation: 그 뼈다귀 놈이 내 발을 물었다고!

english: Sorry... You didn't leave anything behind did you? I'm a brave adventurer! I'm sure I can pry whatever it is from their malicious mitts.
translation: 죄송해요... 혹시 두고 온 건 없어요? 저는 용감한 모험가예요! 그게 뭐든 그 고약한 손아귀에서 빼내 올 수 있어요.

english: A few pots, but without my tools they won'ydo me any good.
translation: 단지 몇 개. 근데 내 도구가 없으면 그것도 쓸모없어.

english: Who are you?
Me? Just a tinker with nothing to trade.
translation: 나? 팔 물건 하나 없는 땜장이일 뿐이야.

english: What happened to your wares?
A tinker doesn't get the respect that they used to... Gah! A thief took my bag in the night, they took everything.
translation: 요즘은 땜장이를 예전만큼 대접해 주질 않아... 쳇! 밤중에 도둑놈이 내 가방을 가져갔어. 몽땅 털어 갔다고.

english: Sorry to hear you've had some bad luck of late, did you lose much?
translation: 요즘 운이 안 좋으셨나 보네요. 많이 잃으셨어요?

english: Bits and pieces, nothing too important I s'pose... An old pan flute, a dirty book and a charred skull.
translation: 이것저것, 별로 중요한 건 아니었지, 아마... 낡은 팬 플루트 하나, 더러운 책 한 권, 그리고 그을린 해골 하나.

english: Hmm.
That's all in the past now, anyway... I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: 아무튼 다 지난 일이야... 미안하지만 도와줄 수가 없네.

english: That's alright, I need no help.
Didn't someone send you for the pots?
translation: 단지 가지러 누가 보낸 거 아니었어?

english: Nope, just exploring...
Well, if anyone asks... I'm dead!
translation: 그럼 누가 묻거든... 난 죽었다고 해!

english: Bye.
Are you the tinker this entry mentions?
You show him 'Jewellery of Jubilation'.
translation: 그에게 'Jewellery of Jubilation(환희의 장신구)'을 보여 준다.

english: Oh, me? Oh my... Goodness gracious what...
translation: 어, 나? 이런... 세상에, 이게 무슨...

english: A life?
What? No...
Well, I s'pose that was me...
translation: 그래, 그게 나였던 것 같긴 하네...

english: What's so surprising?
How did you find me!? Was it you?
Was it me what? I just found this journal... I didn't write it.
translation: 제가 뭘요? 전 그냥 이 일지를 찾았을 뿐이에요... 제가 쓴 거 아니에요.

english: I remember this day... How could I forget.
Are you saying the man I sold those trinkets to was the king?!
translation: 그러니까 내가 그 장신구들을 판 사람이 왕이었다는 거야?!

english: Yeah... You didn't know?
Those were dark objects, corrupted with powerful magic. Dark magic.
translation: 그건 어둠의 물건이었어. 강력한 마법으로 오염된. 어둠의 마법으로.

english: Well, it's all in the past now. I don't think there's any reason to worry about it.
translation: 뭐, 다 지난 일이잖아요. 걱정할 이유는 없을 것 같은데요.

english: No, no, no... this ain't good. They'll find me.
translation: 아니, 아니, 아니... 이건 좋지 않아. 놈들이 날 찾아낼 거야.

english: Who will find you?
You already know too much. But you don't know my name. Good. Let's keep it that way.
translation: 넌 이미 너무 많이 알아. 그래도 내 이름은 모르지. 잘됐네. 계속 그렇게 두자고.

english: Well if I find out anything useful, I'll come let you know, alright?
translation: 그럼 쓸 만한 걸 알아내면 알려 드리러 올게요, 됐죠?

english: If you can find me.
Deal...
You hand over your [item name].
Thanks!
Wait, what?
THANKS!
No, I didn't mean for you to keep it.
Then why are you handing it to me?
Someone made me do it!
Who?
It's alright mate! We've all been there.
translation: 괜찮아, 친구! 다들 그런 적 있어.

english: Existential Crisis?
It'll pass! Anyhow, I'll be seeing you.
translation: 곧 지나갈 거야! 아무튼, 또 보자고.

english: Yeah...
I'm not sure...
I'm afraid I've nothing to trade for that.
translation: 미안하지만 그거랑 바꿔 줄 물건이 없어.

english: What happened to your foot?
Who are you?
Bye.
Someone made me do it!
I'm not sure...
Hello there.
Hello traveller, do you know what this is?
It looks like a monument.
Yes. I served in the military for 30 years. This monument always reminds me of my days in the army.
translation: 그렇다네. 난 30년 동안 군에 복무했지. 이 기념비를 보면 늘 군대 시절이 떠오른다네.

english: Oh, hello! I was just trying to discover the properties of these magical stones you call 'runes', and trying to make some devices to harness their power.
translation: 오, 안녕하세요! 당신네가 '룬'이라고 부르는 이 마법의 돌이 어떤 성질을 지녔는지 알아내고, 그 힘을 이용할 장치를 만들어 보려던 참이었어요.

english: What have you discovered?
Oh, it's terribly exciting! Let me explain...
Oldak lectures you on the construction of runes and you find yourself thinking about Runecrafting with greater clarity.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 룬의 구조에 대해 강의하자, Runecrafting(룬 제작)에 대한 생각이 한결 또렷해진다.

english: Oh, I see!
Oldak lectures you on the magical energies stored within runes and you find yourself thinking about Magic with greater clarity.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 룬에 깃든 마법 에너지에 대해 강의하자, Magic(마법)에 대한 생각이 한결 또렷해진다.

english: Oldak lapses into technical jargon and you don't understand a word.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 전문 용어를 늘어놓기 시작하고, 당신은 한마디도 알아듣지 못한다.

english: Oh... How interesting.
Oldak lectures you on the contruction of runes, but you find yourself greatly confused about Runecrafting.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 룬의 구조에 대해 강의하지만, Runecrafting(룬 제작)이 오히려 몹시 헷갈리기만 한다.

english: What?
Oldak lectures you on the magical energies stored within runes, but you find yourself greatly confused about Magic.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 룬에 깃든 마법 에너지에 대해 강의하지만, Magic(마법)이 오히려 몹시 헷갈리기만 한다.

english: What have you made?
The only thing I've been able to make so far is this. I call it the moving-over-distance sphere.
translation: 지금까지 만든 건 이것뿐이에요. 저는 '원거리 이동 구체'라고 불러요.

english: What is it?
Well, I was experimenting with these blue runes, the ones you call 'law' runes. They have a strange property of being able to move instantly from one place to another.
translation: 음, 이 파란 룬, 그러니까 당신네가 'law rune(법칙 룬)'이라고 부르는 걸로 실험하고 있었거든요. 이 룬은 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 순식간에 옮겨 가는 이상한 성질이 있어요.

english: I know; I couldn't believe it either!
I found that whenever I prepared powdered law runes in a certain way and then threw them on the ground, I would appear somewhere else in the city.
translation: law runes(법칙 룬)을 특정한 방법으로 가루 내서 땅에 던질 때마다, 제가 도시의 다른 곳에 나타나더라고요.

english: I asked Zanik to test it, and she said that wherever she was in the caves, even if she went to the surface, whenever she smashed the sphere on the ground she would appear back in the city!
translation: Zanik(자닉)한테 시험해 달라고 했더니, 동굴 어디에 있든, 심지어 지상에 올라가 있어도, 구체를 땅에 깨뜨리기만 하면 도시로 돌아왔대요!

english: I can see how it might be useful, but I wish I knew more about how it worked...
translation: 쓸모는 있을 것 같은데, 어떻게 작동하는지 좀 더 알면 좋겠어요...

english: Can I buy one?
Oh, I can make one for you if you like. You'll need to give me two law runes and a piece of molten glass.
translation: 오, 원하시면 하나 만들어 드릴게요. law runes(법칙 룬) 두 개랑 molten glass(녹은 유리) 한 덩이를 가져다주셔야 해요.

english: I'll have to go and get some then.
Goodbye
Goodbye!
Oh, er, goodbye. Now, where was I...
translation: 아, 어, 안녕히 가세요. 자, 어디까지 했더라...

english: Where do you want a sphere to?
Dorgesh-Kaan.
You'll need to get me two law runes and a piece of molten glass.
translation: law runes(법칙 룬) 두 개랑 molten glass(녹은 유리) 한 덩이를 가져다주셔야 해요.

english: I have the right materials here!
Excellent! Now, just a minute...
You're quite welcome! Now, where was I...
I have %NUMBER% law runes and %NUMBER% pieces of molten glass here!
translation: law runes(법칙 룬) %NUMBER%개랑 molten glass(녹은 유리) %NUMBER%개가 여기 있어요!

english: Excellent! I can make you %NUMBER% moving-over-distance spheres with them! How many do you want?
translation: 좋아요! 이걸로 원거리 이동 구체를 %NUMBER%개 만들어 드릴 수 있어요! 몇 개 원하세요?

english: Thank you!
Goblin Village.
The Plain of Mud
Nowhere.
Hmm...
I wonder...
That's funny...
What if I...
No, that's not right...
But that means...
Aha!
Ah! I was wrong about it all along!
translation: 아! 처음부터 내가 완전히 잘못 알고 있었어!

english: I wonder what happens if...
What have you discovered?
What have you made?
What is it?
Can I buy one?
Goodbye!
Dorgesh-Kaan.
Goblin Village.
The Plain of Mud
Nowhere.
What are you doing out here on your own?
I'm not alone! Me and my mates run these streets. You'd better watch your pockets, stranger.
translation: 혼자 아니거든! 나랑 내 패거리가 이 거리를 주름잡고 있다고. 주머니 조심하는 게 좋을걸, 낯선 양반.

english: What do you mean you run the streets?
You see those fancy houses?
I think so?
We keep a lookout to see when the owners leave and come back. Once they're out, we can break in and steal all their stuff!
translation: 우린 집주인들이 언제 나가고 언제 들어오는지 망을 봐. 집이 비면 들어가서 물건을 싹 다 훔치는 거지!

english: That sounds risky don't you think? There are guards everywhere.
No one suspects us street urchins. Hidden in plain sight, as they say.
translation: 우리 같은 거리의 꼬맹이를 의심하는 사람은 없어. 등잔 밑이 어둡다잖아.

english: I can give you some info on which houses are free if you like...
translation: 원하면 어느 집이 비었는지 정보 좀 줄 수 있는데...

english: I'm alright for now.
Suit yourself.
Hello there.
Hello. Have you met our crew leader yet?
translation: 안녕. 우리 패거리 두목은 만나 봤어?

english: I don't think I have...
Go chat to them! They should be near the bank... naturally.
translation: 가서 얘기해 봐! 은행 근처에 있을 거야... 당연하지.

english: I'll head over there soon.
Happy thieving, stranger.
I could do with some information on houses.
You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: house keys(집 열쇠) 하나도 없지? 열쇠 없이는 별로 못 갈걸. 나중에 다시 오는 게 어때?

english: I'd better get going.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: 안녕. 훔치기 딱 좋은 날씨지, 안 그래?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: 그런 것 같네. 나한테서 훔칠 생각만 아니라면.

english: *whistle*
Thanks! That sure is tasty!
Do you want some... more?
No, I'm not greedy!
Sounds good.
I'm alright for now.
I could do with some information on houses.
I'd better get going.
Would you like to trade in seeds?
No, thanks.
Where do I get rarer seeds from?
The Master Farmers usually carry a few rare seeds around with them, although I don't know if they'd want to part with them for any price to be honest.
translation: Master Farmers(숙련 농부)들이 보통 희귀한 씨앗을 몇 개씩 갖고 다녀요. 솔직히 얼마를 주든 내놓으려 할지는 모르겠지만요.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 당신이 내 물건 훔쳐 간 사람이죠!

english: Guardsguards!
Yes
No
Where do I get rarer seeds from?
I'm sorry to bother you, but could you spare me a little dung?
translation: 귀찮게 해서 미안하지만, 똥을 조금만 나눠 줄 수 있을까요?

english: The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
translation: 낙타는 그 질문이 영 달갑지 않은 모양이다.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타한테 가까이 가면 손을 물어뜯길 것 같아.

english: Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 케밥을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
Are you serious?
Oh yes. If you'd be so kind...
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
translation: 그럼 먼저 눈부터 감으세요. 보는 앞에서는 절대 안 할 거예요!

english: I hope that's what you wanted!
Ohhh yes. Lovely.
What did you say?
Er, nothing important.
Ah, a human. Do you know anything about flying?
translation: 아, 인간이군요. 하늘을 나는 것에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Flying?
Yes, flying. It's a wonderful thing. I've seen this glider fly, and it's so elegant and fast.
translation: 네, 나는 거요. 정말 멋진 일이죠. 이 글라이더가 나는 걸 봤는데, 어찌나 우아하고 빠르던지.

english: If I could fly, I wouldn't want to do anything else! I'd just fly around all day, swooping and soaring.
translation: 제가 날 수 있다면 다른 건 아무것도 안 할 거예요! 하루 종일 휙휙 내려꽂고 높이 치솟으며 날아다닐 거예요.

english: Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
translation: 둘 다 아니에요. 저는 예의 바른 사람이거든요.

english: Hee hee! What shall we talk about, human?
Where do creatures like you come from?
From eggs, of course! You can't make an olmlet without breaking an egg.
translation: 알에서 나오지, 당연히! 알을 깨지 않고는 Olmlet(올믈렛)도 오믈렛도 만들 수 없는 법이라고.

english: That's... informative. Thank you.
Hee hee! What's next, human?
You look like a dragon.
And humans look like monkeys. Badly shaved monkeys. What's your point, human?
translation: 그러는 인간은 원숭이처럼 생겼잖아. 면도를 엉망으로 한 원숭이. 그래서 뭐, 인간?

english: Are you related to dragons?
My sire was an olm. I'm an olm. I don't go around asking you about your parents' species, do I?
translation: 우리 아버지는 olm(올름)이었어. 나도 올름이고. 내가 너한테 부모님이 무슨 종족이냐고 묻고 다니진 않잖아, 안 그래?

english: ... no, I suppose you don't.
Hee hee! Let's change the subject before someone gets insulted. What shall we talk about instead, human?
translation: 히히! 누가 기분 상하기 전에 화제를 바꾸자. 대신 무슨 얘기 할까, 인간?

english: Can you tell me secrets about your home?
translation: 네 고향에 대한 비밀 좀 알려 줄래요?

english: Ooh, it was lovely. I lived in an eggshell. I was safe in there, dreaming of the life I would lead when I hatched, and the caverns I could rule.
translation: 우와, 참 좋았지. 난 알껍데기 속에서 살았어. 그 안은 안전했고, 부화하면 살게 될 삶과 내가 다스릴 동굴들을 꿈꾸고 있었지.

english: Then suddenly I felt a trembling of the ground, and my shell shattered.
translation: 그런데 갑자기 땅이 흔들리더니 내 껍데기가 산산조각 났어.

english: Through its cracks I saw the world for the first time, just in time to watch my sire die.
translation: 그 틈으로 처음 세상을 봤는데, 마침 우리 아버지가 죽는 걸 보게 됐지 뭐야.

english: It was a terrible shock for a newly hatched olmlet, but I try not to let it affect my mood. So what else shall we talk about, human?
translation: 갓 태어난 olmlet(올믈렛)한테는 엄청난 충격이었지만, 그것 때문에 기분 망치지 않으려고 해. 그래서 또 무슨 얘기 할까, 인간?

english: Maybe another time.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
What lovely teeth you have!
All the better for chomping stuff.
WOW! No chill?
Hey, itsa dog-eat-dogadile world out there!
translation: 이봐, 바깥세상은 약육강식이야. 개악어가 개악어를 잡아먹는 세상이라고!

english: Want to play fetch?
Play meat!
No, fetch... you know, I throw stick and you bring it back?
translation: 아니, 물어 오기요... 있잖아요, 내가 막대기 던지면 네가 물어 오는 거?

english: You fetch meat.
It doesn't just grow on trees you know!
Om nom nom good meat.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
You look hot.
Heat required for forge.
What are you making?
Heat.
Well, forge ahead then.
translation: 그럼 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼듯 밀어붙여 보세요.

english: What are you-
STOP!
HAMMER TIME!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Learn ye of the Judgement of the Vanguard. The form we have taken.
translation: Vanguard(뱅가드)의 심판을 알지어다. 우리가 취한 이 형상을.

english: But you're so little and cute!
Learn ye this form was not given from the grace of our Lord Xeric. He does not forgive those who choose poorly.
translation: 알지어다, 이 형상은 우리 주 Xeric(제릭)의 은총으로 받은 것이 아니니라. 그분은 그릇된 선택을 한 자를 용서치 않으신다.

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
The Dark Altar! The power it has given. Xeric, you cannot comprehend!
translation: Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)! 그것이 내린 힘이란! Xeric(제릭), 네놈은 감히 헤아리지도 못하리라!

english: Excuse me?
I will take Kourend for myself, for I am no longer the priest. I am the god!
translation: 나는 Kourend(쿠렌드)를 손에 넣으리라. 나는 더 이상 사제가 아니다. 내가 곧 신이다!

english: What have I done...
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello
Bzzzzt!
Bzzz bzzz bzz?
Buzz off human.
It's you that's following me! Maybe I should invest in a large flyswat...
translation: 따라다니는 건 너잖아요! 커다란 파리채라도 하나 장만해야 하나...

english: *slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Where do creatures like you come from?
You look like a dragon.
Can you tell me secrets about your home?
translation: 네 고향에 대한 비밀 좀 알려 줄래요?

english: Maybe another time.
Hello there.
Hello.
How are you?
Fine thanks.
You're one to talk! I paid plenty for that little encounter!
translation: 너야말로 할 말이 없을 텐데! 그 작은 충돌로 내가 치른 대가가 얼마인데!

english: One eye doesn't equal two of my best men!
translation: 눈 하나로 내 최고 부하 둘이랑 퉁칠 생각 마라!

english: We gave you plenty of chances to flee!
If I ran away from you, I'd never hear the end of it!
translation: 너한테서 도망쳤다간 평생 놀림거리가 됐을 거다!

english: Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: 그래? 그럼 Turtle Basin(거북 분지)에서 싸운 건 뭔데?

english: That wasn't fleeing! It was a tactical repositioning! Besides, you're conveniently forgetting what happened at Brimhaven!
translation: 그건 도망친 게 아니야! 전술적 재배치였다고! 게다가 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)에서 있었던 일은 편할 대로 잊어버린 모양이군!

english: A boring fight! I had better things to do.
translation: 지루한 싸움이었지! 더 할 일이 많았다고.

english: Well, we'll have to make things more entertaining next time then!
translation: 그럼 다음엔 좀 더 재미있게 해 줘야겠군!

english: I look forward to it, but for now, let's drink!
Indeed! Cheers!
Hello there. What do you want to talk about?
Hi, how are things going?

Well hopefully a lot better now that you've initiated the calm between the Moon Clan and the Fremenniks. Remember, if you want to use our Lunar Spells at any time, pray at the altar beside me and you can modify
translation: 글쎄요, 당신이 Moon Clan(달 부족)과 Fremenniks(프레메닉) 사이에 평화를 열어 준 덕분에 훨씬 나아졌길 바라요. 기억하세요, Lunar Spells(루나 주문)을 쓰고 싶을 땐 언제든 제 옆의 제단에서 기도하면

english: your knowledge!
I've misplaced my staff.
I knew you'd do that, and I used my magic to teleport it back to me.
translation: 그럴 줄 알고 마법으로 제게 순간이동시켜 뒀어요.

english: Erm, that doesn't sound too realistic. Thanks!
translation: 음, 그건 좀 말이 안 되는 것 같은데요. 고마워요!

english: Look, do you want it or not?
Sorry, yes. Yes please.
Actually, I'll have to come back when I have a space to carry one.
translation: 사실, 들고 갈 자리가 생기면 다시 와야겠어요.

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 30000 coins!
Yeah, I'll pay that!
Sorry dear, you don't have enough coins for that.
Oh, ok...
No thanks.
I've lost my Lunar [item].
Oh dear, good job I pre-empted you!
translation: 어머나, 제가 미리 대비해 둬서 다행이네요!

english: I already knew that. I got one especially.
translation: 이미 알고 있었어요. 특별히 하나 구해 뒀죠.

english: Well of course, I know that already, so I got a backup for you.
translation: 물론 이미 알고 있었죠. 그래서 예비로 하나 마련해 뒀어요.

english: I know. Good job I knew you would drop it!
translation: 알아요. 당신이 떨어뜨릴 줄 알았던 게 다행이네요!

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry it.
But it's going to cost you! It will be [number] coins!
Hello again. Seen Cyrisus recently?
As you mention it, yes. He wanted to create more astral runes.
translation: 말 나온 김에, 네. 별 룬을 더 만들고 싶어 하더군요.

english: Interesting.
He said something about fighting kalphites, whatever they are.
translation: kalphites(칼파이트)랑 싸운다는 얘기를 하던데, 그게 뭔지는 모르겠어요.

english: Sounds like his fear of combat really is a problem of the past!
translation: 전투 공포증은 정말 다 옛일이 됐나 보네요!

english: You've done well. Very well.
Hi.
Hello there. I hear that Cyrisus is no longer with us.
He died fighting for a good cause. He'll be remembered as a great hero.
translation: 좋은 대의를 위해 싸우다 죽었어요. 위대한 영웅으로 기억될 거예요.

english: I suppose the good do die young.
translation: 좋은 사람은 일찍 떠난다더니, 정말 그런가 봐요.

english: Answer this, please.
Well done.
You've [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!
translation: 획득: [been given a new clue/obtained a casket]!

english: The state of the island.
Yeah, I'll pay that!
No thanks.
Cyrisus.
Nothing.
Would you like to buy or sell any javelins?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
translation: dragon javelins(드래곤 투창) 좀 팔 수 있어요?

english: Dragon javelins? Haha, you'll be a chief advisor to the King before you ever hold a dragon javelin!
translation: 드래곤 투창이요? 하하, 드래곤 투창을 손에 쥐기 전에 왕의 수석 조언자가 먼저 되겠네요!

english: Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Could you sell me some dragon javelins?
translation: dragon javelins(드래곤 투창) 좀 팔 수 있어요?

english: How can I help you, human?
Have you any ore for me?
Here you go. That's all the ore I have for you.
translation: 여기 있어요. 당신 몫의 광석은 이게 전부예요.

english: None of the ore here is yours, sorry.
translation: 여기 있는 광석 중에 당신 건 없어요. 미안해요.

english: How do I mine in this place?
Okay, first you need dynamite. That's got three ingredients...
translation: 좋아요, 우선 dynamite(다이너마이트)가 필요해요. 재료가 세 가지 들어가죠...

english: Once you've got dynamite, use a chisel to excavate a cavity in the hard rock walls, so you can put the dynamite in, then light the fuse.
translation: dynamite(다이너마이트)를 구하면, chisel(끌)로 hard rock(단단한 바위) 벽에 cavity(구멍)을 파서 다이너마이트를 넣은 다음 fuse(도화선)에 불을 붙이세요.

english: The dynamite blows ore out of the hard rock. It's very unstable, so you don't have long to get it cleaned before it disintegrates.
translation: dynamite(다이너마이트)가 hard rock(단단한 바위)에서 광석을 떼어 내요. 광석이 아주 불안정해서, 분해되기 전에 얼른 세척해야 해요.

english: Just deposit it into the sack upstream, and my colleague will get it cleaned safely. You can collect your cleaned ore from me.
translation: 상류에 있는 sack(자루)에 넣기만 하면 제 동료가 안전하게 세척해 줄 거예요. 세척된 광석은 저한테서 받아 가면 돼요.

english: Who are you?
I work here, in the blast mine. It's a valuable source of minerals for the kingdom, so our work is very important.
translation: 저는 여기 blast mine(폭파 광산)에서 일해요. 왕국에 귀중한 광물 공급원이라서 우리 일은 아주 중요하죠.

english: What is this machine?
The ore from the blast mines is unstable, and needs washing quickly before it disintegrates, so the Lovakengj engineers invented this machine to clean it.
translation: 폭파 광산에서 나온 광석은 불안정해서 분해되기 전에 빨리 씻어야 해요. 그래서 Lovakengj(로바켕기) 기술자들이 광석을 세척하려고 이 기계를 발명했죠.

english: The design's a secret; even if someone tried to copy it, they'd never get it quite right. I bet their machine would break down all the time.
translation: 설계는 비밀이에요. 누가 따라 만들려고 해도 절대 똑같이는 못 만들 거예요. 장담하는데 그쪽 기계는 툭하면 고장 날걸요.

english: I'll be off.
Have you any ore for me?
How do I mine in this place?
Who are you?
What is this machine?
I'll be off.
I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: Crandor(크랜도) 섬으로 가는 지도 조각을 찾고 있어요.

english: The map's behind a door below, but entering is rather tough. This is what you need to know: You must use the following stuff.
translation: 지도는 아래쪽 문 너머에 있으나, 들어가기가 꽤 까다로우니라. 알아야 할 것은 이것이니: 다음 물건들을 사용해야 하느니라.

english: First, a drink used by a mage. Next, some worm string, changed to sheet. Then, a small crustacean cage. Last, a bowl that's not seen heat.
translation: 첫째, 마법사가 즐겨 마시는 술. 다음, 벌레가 자아낸 실을 천으로 바꾼 것. 그리고 작은 갑각류를 가두는 통발. 마지막으로, 불을 본 적 없는 그릇이니라.

english: (same as below)
Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
translation: 오, Oracle(예언자)시여, 그 현명한 지혜를 저에게 나눠 주시겠어요?

english: Capes are always in fashion!
The light at the end of the tunnel is the demon-infested lava pit.
translation: 터널 끝의 빛은 악마가 들끓는 용암 구덩이니라.

english: Beware the cabbage: it is both green AND leafy.
translation: 양배추를 조심하라. 그것은 초록색이면서 잎도 무성하니라.

english: They say that ham does not mix well with other kinds of meat.
translation: 햄은 다른 종류의 고기와 잘 섞이지 않는다 하더라.

english: A woodchuck does not chuck wood.
No. I'm not in the mood.
It's not you; it's me.
Too many cooks spoil the anchovy pizza.
translation: 요리사가 많으면 멸치 피자가 산으로 가느니라.

english: The God Wars are over...as long as the thing they were fighting over remains hidden.
translation: God Wars(신들의 전쟁)은 끝났느니라... 그들이 차지하려 싸웠던 그것이 숨겨져 있는 한은.

english: He who uses the power of custard mixes it with his tears.
translation: 커스터드의 힘을 쓰는 자는 그것을 제 눈물과 섞느니라.

english: Nothing like a tasty fish.
Don't judge a book by its cover - judge it on its' grammar and, punctuation.
translation: 책을 표지로 판단하지 말지어다 - 그 문법과, 맞춤뻡으로 판단 할지니라.

english: Yes, I can. But I'm not going to.
translation: 할 수는 있느니라. 하지만 하지 않을 것이니라.

english: A bird in the hand can make a tasty snack.
translation: 손안의 새 한 마리는 맛있는 간식이 될 수 있느니라.

english: Pies...they're great, aren't they?
Who guards the guardsmen?
The great snake of Guthix guards more than she knows.
translation: Guthix(구식스)의 거대한 뱀은 스스로 아는 것보다 더 많은 것을 지키고 있느니라.

english: Do not fear the dragons...fear their kin.
translation: 드래곤을 두려워 말라... 그들의 일족을 두려워하라.

english: Everyone you know will one day be dead.
translation: 네가 아는 모든 이는 언젠가 죽으리라.

english: If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around, then nobody gets Woodcutting xp.
translation: 숲에서 나무가 쓰러졌는데 주위에 아무도 없다면, 아무도 Woodcutting(벌목) 경험치를 얻지 못하느니라.

english: Sometimes you get lucky, sometimes you don't.
translation: 운이 좋을 때도 있고, 나쁠 때도 있느니라.

english: The chicken came before the egg.
Is it time to wake up? I am not sure...
When in Asgarnia, do as the Asgarnians do.
An answer is unimportant; it is the question that matters.
translation: 답은 중요하지 않느니라. 중요한 것은 질문이니라.

english: The goblins will never make up their minds on their own.
translation: 고블린들은 결코 스스로 마음을 정하지 못하리라.

english: Jas left a stone behind.
Many secrets are buried under this land.
translation: 이 땅 아래에는 많은 비밀이 묻혀 있느니라.

english: There are no crisps at the party.
Help wanted? Enquire within.
translation: 도움이 필요한가? 자세한 것은 안에 문의하라.

english: I've got a little challenge for you.
translation: 너에게 작은 도전 과제를 하나 내주마.

english: OK...
Can you answer this for me please.
The Oracle has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
That's wrong I'm afraid.
That's right, well done!
The Oracle has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Oracle(예언자)가 또 다른 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 주었습니다!

english: I've got a message for you from the Wise Old Man who lives in Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 사는 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 보낸 전갈을 가져왔어요.

english: Many do my wisdom seek; few do their own wisdom to me send!
translation: 내 지혜를 구하는 자는 많으나, 자기 지혜를 내게 보내는 자는 드물도다!

english: It doesn't look like you have space for your reward. Come back later when you do.
translation: 보상을 받을 공간이 없어 보이는구나. 공간이 생기면 다시 오너라.

english: New life from these shall perchance spring!
I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: Crandor(크랜도) 섬으로 가는 지도 조각을 찾고 있어요.

english: Can you impart your wise knowledge to me, O Oracle?
translation: 오, Oracle(예언자)시여, 그 현명한 지혜를 저에게 나눠 주시겠어요?

english: Are you here to smith? Do you want to buy some ore?
No thanks.
Well don't waste my time then!
translation: 그럼 내 시간 낭비하게 하지 말게!

english: Thanks, I'll send them to storage.
Thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
You look a bit shady, if I do say so myself.
translation: 이런 말 해도 될지 모르겠지만, 좀 수상쩍어 보이시네요.

english: Well that's the nicest thing anyone has ever said to me!
translation: 와, 지금까지 들은 말 중에 제일 기분 좋은 말인데!

english: The name's Oriana. Nice to meet ya!
Oriana shakes your hand with a strong and aggressive grip. She also tries to get inside your pockets...
translation: Oriana(오리아나)가 거칠고 공격적으로 힘을 주며 당신과 악수한다. 그러면서 당신 주머니에도 손을 넣으려 한다...

english: Hey, I saw that!
Sorry... Force of 'abit.
Right... Well I'm [player name]. What is it you do around here?
translation: 그렇군요... 음, 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 여기서 무슨 일을 하세요?

english: Well I'm the best thief to ever live, ain't I.
This place is filled to the brim with wealthy folk with lots of pricey stuff. It's all prime for the takin'.
translation: 여긴 비싼 물건 잔뜩 가진 부자들로 꽉 차 있거든. 죄다 털어 가기 딱 좋지.

english: Now what can I do for you?
Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: 이 열쇠들이 어디에 쓰는 건지 아세요?

english: Let me take a look.
Those are keys to the houses round 'ere.
Oh, so I can just waltz right in?
translation: 오, 그럼 그냥 당당하게 들어가면 되는 거예요?

english: Essentially yes! Though the keys you showed me look a bit old. I'd try to find as many as you can just in case they break.
translation: 뭐, 그렇지! 근데 보여 준 열쇠들이 좀 낡아 보이네. 부러질 수도 있으니까 최대한 많이 구해 두는 게 좋을 거야.

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: 그 부자들에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Yes I can. Some 'ave got houses full of loot, while others spend their days at the bazaar. What do you want to know?
translation: 물론이지. 집에 전리품을 가득 쌓아 둔 놈들도 있고, 하루 종일 시장에서 시간 보내는 놈들도 있어. 뭐가 알고 싶어?

english: Tell me about the houses.
Some of them round here are filled with loot for sure. They've got so many bits and bobs, trinkets and doodads, that they 'ardly ever notice they've been robbed.
translation: 이 근처 집 중엔 확실히 전리품이 가득한 데가 있어. 잡동사니며 장신구며 자질구레한 게 하도 많아서, 털린 줄도 거의 모른다니까.

english: You rob them?
Oh yes.
How do you manage that?
First we get keys for these houses, which are always conveniently under the doormat.
translation: 먼저 집 열쇠를 구하지. 열쇠는 늘 편리하게도 현관 매트 밑에 있거든.

english: Are you serious? It's that easy?
Ha... No. I was just pulling your leg.
You'll 'ave to steal the house keys from the citizens.
translation: house keys(집 열쇠)는 주민들한테서 훔쳐야 해.

english: All these wealthy folk buy and sell property like it's nothing, so they 'ave plenty of spare keys to go round.
translation: 여기 부자들은 부동산을 밥 먹듯 사고팔아서, 여분 열쇠가 남아돌거든.

english: So how do you steal them?
We pick their pockets of course. I 'ave some of my crew in the bazaar. If you fancy gettin' involved, they might help you out every now and then.
translation: 당연히 소매치기하지. 시장에 내 패거리 몇 명을 풀어 놨어. 한번 끼어 볼 생각 있으면, 걔들이 가끔 도와줄 거야.

english: Once you 'ave a key, you can break into a house. Not any ol' house though. It must be one that's ready to be robbed.
translation: 열쇠를 손에 넣으면 집에 침입할 수 있어. 근데 아무 집이나 되는 건 아냐. 털릴 준비가 된 집이어야 하지.

english: The street urchins that roam the streets keep tabs on which houses are vulnerable.
translation: 거리를 돌아다니는 부랑아들이 어느 집이 허술한지 계속 지켜보고 있어.

english: Once you know a house is vulnerable, wait for the owner to leave. Then just simply use your key to get in and steal to your heart's content!
translation: 허술한 집을 알아냈으면 주인이 나갈 때까지 기다려. 그다음 그냥 열쇠로 들어가서 마음껏 훔치면 돼!

english: But whatever you do, dont get caught!
translation: 근데 무슨 일이 있어도 잡히지만 마!

english: So... steal keys, use keys on the houses that are ready to be robbed, make buckets of cash and don't be caught?
translation: 그러니까... 열쇠를 훔치고, 털 준비가 된 집에 열쇠를 쓰고, 돈을 왕창 벌고, 잡히지 말라는 거죠?

english: That's it!
If you're not sure where to begin, chat to the urchins in my crew posted round the houses. They'll help you find the next one to plunder.
translation: 어디서부터 시작할지 모르겠으면, 집들 근처에 배치된 우리 패거리 부랑아들한테 말 걸어 봐. 다음에 털 집을 찾게 도와줄 거야.

english: Though it might come at a price.
Tell me about the bazaar.
Some of the wealthiest citizens in Varlamore shop in the bazaar and nearby. A perfect place to pick some pockets!
translation: Varlamore(바를라모어)에서 제일 부유한 시민들 몇몇이 시장이랑 그 근처에서 쇼핑을 해. 소매치기하기 딱 좋은 곳이지!

english: Surely it's not so easy though?
You'd be right about that. If it were easy to steal from 'em, they wouldn't be so rich, would they?
translation: 그건 네 말이 맞아. 그놈들 털기가 쉬웠으면 그렇게 부자일 리가 없잖아?

english: Sounds like you might have some tips?
translation: 뭔가 요령을 알고 계신 것 같은데요?

english: Some of the street urchins in my crew hang around in the bazaar and on the outskirts. They might be able to provide some sort of distraction.
translation: 우리 패거리 부랑아 몇이 시장이랑 변두리에서 어슬렁거리고 있어. 걔들이 주의를 좀 끌어 줄 수 있을 거야.

english: They do it just out of the goodness of their heart?
translation: 그냥 순수한 선의로 해 주는 거예요?

english: You're funny, [player name].
They get a cut in all the wealth we make.
translation: 걔들은 우리가 버는 돈에서 몫을 받아.

english: Can I get a cut?
Cheeky! You're lucky I don't steal from you right now!
translation: 뻔뻔하긴! 지금 당장 너한테서 안 훔치는 걸 다행으로 알아!

english: I'd better get going.
See you later.
Do you work alone?
Nah! I 'ave a network of spies and pickpockets that roam the city. You might've seen 'em?
translation: 아니! 도시를 돌아다니는 첩자랑 소매치기 조직이 있지. 본 적 있을걸?

english: Seen them? Not sure I have.
translation: 봤냐고요? 글쎄요, 본 적 없는 것 같은데요.

english: Hidden in plain sight. Perfect! Well it's all the street urchins of course. You can tell if they are part of my crew by the purple sash around their waist.
translation: 버젓이 눈앞에 숨어 있다는 거지. 완벽해! 뭐, 당연히 거리의 부랑아들 전부야. 허리에 보라색 띠를 두르고 있으면 우리 패거리야.

english: Most of them lost their parents to the Colosseum, hoping to get glory for their family. The Colosseum 'owever, had other plans...
translation: 걔들 대부분은 Colosseum(콜로세움)에서 부모를 잃었어. 가문의 영광을 얻겠다고 나섰다가 말이야. 근데 콜로세움은... 생각이 달랐지...

english: That's awful.
It really is. They had nowhere to go and no food to eat, so I offered them a home, food, and all the gold they would ever need to 'ave a good life.
translation: 정말 그래. 갈 곳도 먹을 것도 없었으니까, 내가 집이랑 음식, 그리고 평생 잘 살 만큼의 골드를 주겠다고 했지.

english: No one suspects them, which makes them perfect spies.
translation: 아무도 걔들을 의심하지 않으니까, 완벽한 첩자인 셈이야.

english: Can they help me in anyway?
translation: 그 아이들이 저를 도와줄 수도 있어요?

english: Yes they can! Some in the residential area will point out houses free to rob, and some will be in and around the bazaar, distracting the wealthy citizens.
translation: 물론이지! 주택가에 있는 애들은 털 수 있는 집을 알려 줄 거고, 시장이랑 그 주변에 있는 애들은 부자 시민들 주의를 딴 데로 돌려 줄 거야.

english: Well that's handy.
It sure is, but give them any trouble, and I'll throw you in the Colosseum myself.
translation: 그렇지. 근데 걔들 괴롭히기만 해 봐. 내가 직접 너를 콜로세움에 던져 넣을 테니까.

english: Understood.
What's your story?
Not much to tell really.
I was an orphan, much like these street urchins you see around the city. I spent my days running around scrounging for food and struggling to find somewhere to sleep.
translation: 나도 고아였어. 도시 여기저기서 보이는 저 부랑아들처럼. 먹을 걸 찾아 헤매고 잘 곳을 찾느라 허덕이며 하루하루를 보냈지.

english: Eventually, I turned to a life of crime and thievery. Turns out I'm quite good at it.
translation: 그러다 결국 범죄랑 도둑질의 길로 들어섰어. 알고 보니 내가 꽤 소질이 있더라고.

english: I took refuge in a small spot in the north east of the city. Out of sight, out of mind.
translation: 도시 북동쪽의 작은 구석에 몸을 숨겼지. 눈에서 멀어지면 마음에서도 멀어진다잖아.

english: There I met with other orphans just like me. We all wanted payback. Payback on the city for forgetting about us.
translation: 거기서 나 같은 다른 고아들을 만났어. 다들 복수를 원했지. 우리를 잊어버린 이 도시에 대한 복수 말이야.

english: I'm sure there are better places for you and your crew to find refuge outside of the city. Even outside of Varlamore.
translation: 당신과 패거리가 머물 곳이라면 도시 밖에도 더 좋은 데가 있을 텐데요. 아예 Varlamore(바를라모어) 밖으로 나가도 되고요.

english: That may be the case, [player name], but I can't in good conscience leave any of the folk here who are struggling. I swore to help anyone in need.
translation: 그럴지도 모르지, [player name]. 하지만 여기서 힘들게 사는 사람들을 두고 떠나는 건 양심상 못 하겠어. 어려운 사람은 누구든 돕겠다고 맹세했거든.

english: While the Colosseum still stands, family greed for glory will cost people. Some just their livelihoods, others their lives!
translation: Colosseum(콜로세움)이 남아 있는 한, 영광을 탐내는 가문들의 욕심 때문에 사람들이 대가를 치를 거야. 누구는 생계를, 누구는 목숨을 잃겠지!

english: So you really want to make a difference?
translation: 그러니까 정말로 세상을 바꾸고 싶은 거네요?

english: Well don't get me wrong, I still want to get filthy stinking rich as well!
translation: 아, 오해는 하지 마. 나도 썩어 넘치게 부자가 되고 싶긴 하니까!

english: Don't we all...
Managed to steal anything yet?
I have actually! I've found these valuables from some of the houses.
translation: 사실 훔쳤어요! 집 몇 군데에서 이 valuables(귀중품)을 찾았어요.

english: Want some coin for those? I'll give you a good deal... One coin a piece.
translation: 그거 돈으로 바꿔 줄까? 잘 쳐줄게... 하나에 1코인.

english: One measly coin? That hardly seems worth it.
The thing is, you won't be able to sell those yourself, making them worthless. Still, how 'bout five coins a piece?
translation: 문제는 말이야, 그건 네가 직접 팔 수가 없어서 쓸모가 없다는 거지. 그래도, 하나에 5코인은 어때?

english: That's crazy! Ever 'eard of inflation. It affects us thieves too...
translation: 미쳤구나! 인플레이션이라고 들어 봤어? 우리 도둑들한테도 영향이 있다고...

english: 30 coins. No higher.
55 coins is my final offer.
65 coins is my final offer. I've even throw in a little extra as you seem to be the talk of the town, [rank].
translation: 65코인. 이게 마지막 제안이야. 네가 이 동네에서 소문이 자자한 것 같아서 조금 더 얹어 줬어, [rank].

english: I suppose that's better than nothing.
Good. Do you want to trade them in now?
Sure thing.
There ya go! Don't spend it all at once.
translation: 자, 여기! 한 번에 다 쓰지는 마.

english: Not at the moment.
Suit yourself. What to chat 'bout something else?
How's it going, [Player name]?
You don't seem to anything to trade in to me.
translation: 나한테 바꿀 게 아무것도 없는 것 같은데.

english: Do you know what these keys are for?
translation: 이 열쇠들이 어디에 쓰는 건지 아세요?

english: Can you tell me more about these rich folk?
translation: 그 부자들에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Tell me about the houses.
Tell me about the bazaar.
I'd better get going.
Do you work alone?
What's your story?
Sure thing.
Not at the moment.
Uh, you guys aren't fairies - what are you doing here?
translation: 어, 당신들은 요정이 아니잖아요. 여기서 뭐 하는 거예요?

english: Grunt! Smelly, stinky human! Urgh! Leave us alone before we hurt you.
translation: 꾸엑! 냄새나는, 구린내 나는 인간! 으윽! 다치기 싫으면 우리 내버려 둬.

english: G'day there, mate.
Good day. Are you alright? You look a little lost.
translation: 안녕하세요. 괜찮으세요? 좀 길을 잃은 것 같아 보여서요.

english: Well, mate, to tell you the truth, I think I've come a gutser with these displays.
translation: 음, 친구, 솔직히 말하면 이 전시물들 때문에 제대로 삑사리를 낸 것 같아.

english: Come a what?
Gutser and no mistake. Me boss asked me to put together a quiz for the visitors.
translation: 삑사리지, 틀림없이. 우리 보스가 방문객들을 위한 퀴즈를 만들라고 했거든.

english: But to be deadset with you, I wasn't paying much attention to me boss over there and I've done a bit of a rush job.
translation: 근데 진짜 솔직히 말하면, 저기 있는 보스 말을 제대로 안 들어서 대충 급하게 해 버렸어.

english: You mean the natural historian?
Yep, that's the bloke. Say, mate, you do me a favour?
translation: 그래, 그 양반이야. 그런데 친구, 부탁 하나 들어줄래?

english: Perhaps. What do you need?
Well, you look like a pretty smart cobber. Could you take a look at the display plaques and give 'em a runthrough?
translation: 음, 너 꽤 똑똑한 친구 같아 보이는데. 전시 명판 좀 보고 한번 쭉 검토해 줄 수 있어?

english: Sure thing.
Bonza, mate! I reckon three questions per case should be bang to rights.
translation: 끝내주네, 친구! 진열장마다 세 문제씩이면 딱 좋을 것 같아.

english: Take a gander at each case and I'll look over your shoulder to give some advice.
translation: 진열장을 하나씩 살펴봐. 내가 어깨 너머로 보면서 조언해 줄게.

english: Will do.
No thanks. I'm too busy.
Fair dinkum mate. I'm sure I'll get someone else to help me.
translation: 알았어, 친구. 다른 사람한테 도와 달라고 하면 되지 뭐.

english: G'day there, mate. How're the display cases coming along?
translation: 어이, 친구. 진열장은 잘 돼 가?

english: I haven't had the chance to take a look yet.
No worries, mate; just have a go when you can.
translation: 걱정 마, 친구. 시간 날 때 해 봐.

english: Hmm, I don't think that's right, mate. Try again.
translation: 흠, 그건 아닌 것 같은데, 친구. 다시 해 봐.

english: Nice job, mate. That looks about right.
translation: 잘했어, 친구. 그 정도면 맞는 것 같아.

english: Bonza, mate! I think that's all of them.
translation: 끝내주네, 친구! 이걸로 다 된 것 같아.

english: Well done, mate. You finished all of the displays.
Come over and have a chat with me. I might have something for you.
translation: 이리 와서 얘기 좀 하자. 줄 게 있을지도 몰라.

english: I'm getting there. I still have a few left to do.
translation: 하고 있어요. 아직 몇 개 남았어요.

english: Bonza, mate. You're doing a great job so far.
translation: 끝내주네, 친구. 지금까지 아주 잘하고 있어.

english: Righty ho! I'll get back and finish the rest.
Good luck!
All done. I've corrected the mistakes.
translation: 다 했어요. 틀린 부분 다 고쳤어요.

english: Beaut' mate! That's the best news I've had all day.
translation: 최고야, 친구! 오늘 들은 소식 중에 제일 좋은 소식이야.

english: Glad I could help.
Right, I'll have a chat to me boss over there and let him know you've helped me out.
translation: 좋아, 저기 있는 보스한테 가서 네가 도와줬다고 얘기할게.

english: You know, with all this new information you've absorbed, I reckon you can say you're more experienced in Slaying and Hunting now.
translation: 있잖아, 이 새로운 정보를 다 흡수했으니, 이제 슬레이어랑 사냥 스킬 경험이 더 쌓였다고 해도 될 것 같아.

english: Oh, thank you very much.
No worries, mate. You take care now.
Goodbye.
Thanks for all your help, mate. Hope you enjoy the museum!
translation: 도와줘서 고마워, 친구. 박물관 즐겁게 구경해!

english: Sure thing.
No thanks I'm too busy.
Hello, can I help?
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Answer this, please.
Well done.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Yes please. What are you selling?
No thanks.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 정말 멋진 날이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 할 게 아주 많죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만해요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 정말 멋진 날이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 할 게 아주 많죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만해요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Human.
What are you doing here?
This passage leads to the lair of what your kind call the Alchemical Hydra. It is an ancient beast, the only one of its kind.
translation: 이 통로는 너희 종족이 Alchemical Hydra(연금술 히드라)라 부르는 것의 소굴로 이어지오. 고대의 짐승이자, 그 종에서 유일한 존재요.

english: I am here to protect it. For protecting it will protect the balance. I make sure that only those who have permission can fight it.
translation: 나는 그것을 지키려고 여기 있소. 그것을 지키는 것이 곧 균형을 지키는 것이니. 허락받은 자만이 그것과 싸울 수 있도록 하는 것이 내 일이오.

english: How do I get permission?
Only Konar quo Maten can grant permission to fight the Alchemical Hydra. She will rarely grant this permission when the beast needs calming.
translation: Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)만이 Alchemical Hydra(연금술 히드라)와 싸울 허락을 내릴 수 있소. 그녀는 그 짐승을 진정시켜야 할 때에만 드물게 허락을 내리오.

english: Thanks for the information.
Do you have any of my items?
I do not. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 없소. 내가 그대의 물건을 맡고 있었더라도, 찾아가기 전에 그대가 죽었다면 이제는 사라졌을 것이오.

english: I do. I suppose you want them back.
I have to go.
I don't have anything for you human. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 그대에게 줄 것은 없소, 인간. 내가 그대의 물건을 맡고 있었더라도, 찾아가기 전에 그대가 죽었다면 이제는 사라졌을 것이오.

english: Human! To attack that creature would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight it!
translation: 인간! 그 생물을 공격하는 것은 균형을 위협하는 일이오. 허락받은 자만이 그것과 싸울 수 있소!

english: I have some items of yours here human. I'd recommend you collect them before returning to the lair.
translation: 그대의 물건 몇 가지를 내가 맡고 있소, 인간. 소굴로 돌아가기 전에 찾아가길 권하오.

english: What are you doing here?
Do you have any of my items?
Thanks for the information.
I have to go.
Enter the lair and risk losing those items.
translation: 소굴에 들어가서 그 물건들을 잃을 위험을 감수할게요.

english: No - stay out.
Hi there, friend!
