Hello! You're not one of the hunters too, are you?
Oh no, but as someone that makes small soft versions of creatures, this is the place to be.
translation: 아뇨, 하지만 동물을 작고 말랑한 인형으로 만드는 사람에게는 여기가 딱이에요.

english: These books and the hunters' reports all contain lovely details about my subject matter. I might never leave!
translation: 이 책들이랑 사냥꾼들의 보고서에는 제 작업 대상에 관한 멋진 세부 사항이 가득해요. 영영 떠나지 못할지도 몰라요!

english: I'd imagine this is the place to be for materials too. These hunters seem to find everything!
translation: 재료 구하기에도 여기가 딱일 것 같네요. 이 사냥꾼들은 뭐든 다 찾아내는 것 같아요!

english: The cat is a great way to stress test some of the stitching too. He loves having something to play with!
translation: 고양이도 바느질이 튼튼한지 시험해 보기에 딱이에요. 걔는 갖고 놀 걸 정말 좋아하거든요!

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Prifddinas!
translation: 은이요! 은! Prifddinas(프리프디나스)에서 은을 사고팔기에 가장 좋은 가격이에요!

english: No thank you.
You stole from me. Talk to me when you've considered your actions!
translation: 제 물건을 훔쳤잖아요. 자기 행동을 반성하고 나서 다시 말 거세요!

english: You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 제 물건을 훔친 사람이 바로 당신이군요!

english: Guards guards!
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello, I am Osman. With what can I assist you?
You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
I am in the employ of the Emir. That is all you need to know.
translation: 저는 Emir(에미르)를 모시고 있습니다. 당신이 알아야 할 것은 그게 전부입니다.

english: I hear wild rumours about a prince.
The prince is not here. He is...away. If you can be trusted, speak to the chancellor, Hassan.
translation: 왕자님은 여기 안 계십니다. 그분은... 떠나 계십니다. 믿을 만한 분이라면, 재상인 Hassan(하산)과 이야기해 보십시오.

english: I am just being nosy.
That bothers me not. The secrets of Al-Kharid protect themselves.
translation: 저는 상관없습니다. Al-Kharid(알 카리드)의 비밀은 스스로를 지키니까요.

english: Well done. A great rescue. I will remember you if I have anything dangerous to do.
translation: 잘하셨습니다. 훌륭한 구출이었습니다. 위험한 일이 생기면 당신을 기억하겠습니다.

english: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
Hi, Osman! How are you doing?
My wounds are healing slowly but I think I'll make a full recovery.
translation: 상처가 더디게 낫고 있지만 완전히 회복할 수 있을 것 같습니다.

english: How is Maisa? Is she back in Al Kharid?
translation: Maisa(마이사)는 어때요? Al Kharid(알 카리드)로 돌아왔어요?

english: Maisa is fine. Where she is or what she's doing, I couldn't possibly tell you.
translation: Maisa(마이사)는 잘 있습니다. 그녀가 어디서 무엇을 하는지는 도저히 말씀드릴 수 없군요.

english: One piece of espionage gossip I can tell you is that I won't be returning to Sophanem or Menaphos any time soon.
translation: 첩보계 소문 하나는 말씀드릴 수 있지요. 저는 당분간 Sophanem(소파넴)이나 Menaphos(메나포스)로 돌아가지 않을 겁니다.

english: Is there anything else with which I can help you?
translation: 그 밖에 제가 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: I've heard that some of the shopkeepers have been threatened!
translation: 상인 몇 명이 협박을 받았다고 들었어요!

english: We are aware of this. The elite guard will protect them from any harm.
translation: 저희도 알고 있습니다. 정예 경비대가 어떤 위험으로부터도 그들을 지켜 줄 겁니다.

english: Glad to hear it.
Do you know anything about Keris, the dagger I recovered in the course of my last mission?
translation: 지난 임무 중에 되찾은 단검, Keris(크리스)에 대해 아는 게 있어요?

english: We discovered a stash of them in some of our investigations. As far as we have been able to determine, it was created by worshippers of Elidinis in order to smite the followers of Scabaras.
translation: 조사 중에 그것들이 숨겨진 곳을 발견했습니다. 저희가 밝혀낸 바로는, Elidinis(엘리디니스)의 신도들이 Scabaras(스카바라스)의 추종자들을 처단하려고 만든 것입니다.

english: So what is so good about them?

They are specially enchanted against both scarab creatures and kalphites...which is odd, since we thought the two races to be entirely different. Any more details you'll have to discover yourself by using it in the field.
translation: scarab(스카라브) 생물과 kalphite(칼파이트) 양쪽을 상대하도록 특별히 마법이 걸려 있습니다... 두 종족이 완전히 다르다고 생각했던 터라 묘한 일이지요. 더 자세한 건 직접 현장에서 써 보며 알아내셔야 할 겁니다.

english: Thanks.
I have some sq'irk juice for you.
Osman imparts some Thieving advice to you ([amount] Thieving experience points) as a reward for the sq'irk juice.
translation: Osman(오스만)이 sq'irk juice(스쿼크 주스)에 대한 보상으로 Thieving(도둑질) 조언을 해 준다 ([amount] 도둑질 경험치).

english: Thank you very much [player name]. If you get some more sq'irks be sure to come back.
translation: 정말 감사합니다, [player name]님. sq'irk(스쿼크)를 더 구하시면 꼭 다시 오십시오.

english: I will. It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
Where am I meant to find sq'irks?
There is a sorceress near the south-eastern edge of Al Kharid who grows them. Once upon a time, we considered each other friends.
translation: Al Kharid(알 카리드) 남동쪽 끝 근처에 그것을 기르는 sorceress(여마법사)가 있습니다. 한때는 서로 친구라고 여기던 사이였지요.

english: What happened?
We fell out, and now she won't give me any more fruit.
translation: 사이가 틀어져서, 이제 그녀가 더는 제게 열매를 주지 않습니다.

english: So all I have to do is ask her for some fruit for you?
translation: 그럼 그분한테 당신 몫으로 열매를 좀 달라고 부탁하기만 하면 되는 거예요?

english: I doubt it will be that easy. She is not renowned for her generosity and is very secretive about her garden's location.
translation: 그렇게 쉽진 않을 겁니다. 그녀는 너그럽기로 유명한 사람이 아닌 데다, 정원의 위치를 철저히 숨기고 있습니다.

english: Oh come on, it should be easy enough to find.
Her garden has remained hidden even to me - the chief spy of Al Kharid. I believe her garden must be hidden by magical means.
translation: 그녀의 정원은 저에게조차 숨겨져 있었습니다. Al Kharid(알 카리드)의 첩보 대장인 저에게도 말이지요. 분명 마법으로 숨겨 놓았을 겁니다.

english: This should be an interesting task. How many sq'irks do you want?
translation: 흥미로운 일이 되겠네요. sq'irk(스쿼크)는 몇 개나 필요하세요?

english: I'll reward you for as many as you can get your hands on, but could you please squeeze the fruit into a glass first?
translation: 구해 오시는 만큼 보상해 드리겠습니다만, 먼저 열매를 유리잔에 짜 주시겠습니까?

english: I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: sq'irk(스쿼크)에 대해 또 궁금한 게 있어요.

english: What would you like to know?
Thanks for the information.
Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
I may have mentioned that I had a falling out with the Sorceress. Well, unsurprisingly, she refuses to give me any more of her garden's produce.
translation: Sorceress(여마법사)와 사이가 틀어졌다고 말씀드렸을 겁니다. 뭐, 놀랍지도 않게 그녀는 정원의 수확물을 더는 제게 주지 않으려 합니다.

english: How should I squeeze the fruit?
Use a pestle and mortar to squeeze the sq'irks. Make sure you have an empty glass with you to collect the juice.
translation: pestle and mortar(막자와 막자사발)로 sq'irk(스쿼크)를 짜십시오. 주스를 받을 빈 유리잔도 꼭 챙기시고요.

english: Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
Of course there is. I am a generous man. I'll teach you the art of Thieving for your troubles.
translation: 물론입니다. 저는 너그러운 사람이니까요. 수고해 주신 대가로 Thieving(도둑질)의 기술을 가르쳐 드리겠습니다.

english: How much training will you give?
That depends on the quantity and ripeness of the sq'irks you put into the juice.
translation: 주스에 넣은 sq'irk(스쿼크)의 양과 익은 정도에 따라 다릅니다.

english: That sounds fair enough.
What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: 그럼 sq'irk juice(스쿼크 주스)가 뭐가 그렇게 좋은데요?

english: Ah it's sweet, sweet nectar for a thief or spy; it makes light fingers lighter, fleet feet flightier and comes in four different colours for those who are easily amused.
translation: 아, 도둑이나 첩자에게는 달콤하고도 달콤한 감로지요. 가벼운 손놀림은 더 가볍게, 날랜 발은 더 날래게 해 주고, 쉽게 즐거워하는 이들을 위해 네 가지 색깔로 나옵니다.

english: Osman starts salivating at the thought of sq'irk juice.
translation: Osman(오스만)이 sq'irk juice(스쿼크 주스) 생각에 침을 흘리기 시작한다.

english: It wouldn't have addictive properties, would it?
It only holds power over those with poor self-control, something which I have an abundance of.
translation: 자제력이 부족한 자들에게만 힘을 발휘하지요. 자제력 부족이라면... 제게 차고 넘치는 것이지만요.

english: I see.
Well done. I have new information to share with you.
translation: 잘하셨습니다. 알려 드릴 새로운 정보가 있습니다.

english: You don't seem very tough. Who are you?
I hear wild rumours about a prince.
I am just being nosy.
I'd like to talk about sq'irks.
I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
Where do I get sq'irks?
I've another question about sq'irks.
translation: sq'irk(스쿼크)에 대해 또 궁금한 게 있어요.

english: Thanks for the information.
Why can't you get the sq'irks yourself?
How should I squeeze the fruit?
Is there a reward for getting these sq'irks?
What's so good about sq'irk juice then?
translation: 그럼 sq'irk juice(스쿼크 주스)가 뭐가 그렇게 좋은데요?

english: As you approach the spirit, you hear a voice echoing in your head.
translation: 영혼에게 다가가자, 머릿속에 목소리가 울려 퍼진다.

english: You. You fought against the Devourer. Her influence here has been lessened as a result. You are to be commended for your strength.
translation: 너. 너는 Devourer(포식자)에 맞서 싸웠다. 그 결과 이곳에 미치는 그녀의 영향력이 약해졌다. 너의 힘은 칭송받아 마땅하다.

english: I take it you're Osmumten?
Once, but who I was in life means nothing. Vengeance is all that matters now. The Devourer may be gone, but my home has been corrupted. This corruption must be destroyed.
translation: 한때는 그랬지. 하지만 살아생전 내가 누구였는지는 아무 의미가 없다. 이제 중요한 것은 복수뿐. Devourer(포식자)는 사라졌을지 모르나, 내 고향은 타락했다. 이 타락은 반드시 파괴되어야 한다.

english: Can I help?
You can. Take your prize and leave, but when you are ready, return here. The Devourer's thralls will soon be back. You must fight them.
translation: 할 수 있다. 상을 받고 떠나라. 하지만 준비가 되면 이곳으로 돌아오라. Devourer(포식자)의 하수인들이 곧 돌아올 것이다. 너는 그들과 싸워야 한다.

english: I'll do what I can.
translation: 할 수 있는 만큼 해 볼게요.

english: We shall see if it is enough.
Yes.
No.
The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Your prize awaits.
translation: Devourer(포식자)의 하수인들은 돌아오겠지만, 너로 인해 약해졌다. 너의 상이 기다리고 있다.

english: You have done well, but it is time for you to leave. The Devourer's thralls will soon return.
translation: 잘했다. 하지만 이제 떠날 때다. Devourer(포식자)의 하수인들이 곧 돌아올 것이다.

english: You fought well. The Devourer's influence here has lessened, but it will soon be restored. It is time for you to leave.
translation: 잘 싸웠다. 이곳에 미치는 Devourer(포식자)의 영향력은 줄었지만, 곧 회복될 것이다. 이제 떠날 때다.

english: We are done here, but the Devourer's thralls are everywhere. They must be removed.
translation: 이곳에서의 일은 끝났다. 하지만 Devourer(포식자)의 하수인들은 어디에나 있다. 그들을 제거해야 한다.

english: The player gets relocated to the tombs' nexus.
Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 있잖아, 그 소절은 꽤 마음에 들었어...

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 좀 귀에 감기는데. 짜증 나지만. 귀에 감겨.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 야, 그 퀘스트 나도 해 봤어!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 뒷간에서 내가 낸 소리가 더 낫겠다!

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 외지인, 네 노래는 하나도 말이 안 돼!

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?
would torture us so, outerlander?
Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 정말이지, 내 평생 들어 본 소리 중에 최악이야!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 제발 그게 마지막 소절이라고 말해 줘...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 내 귀가 이토록 모욕당한 적은 처음이다!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 신이시여, 제발! 저것 좀 멈추게 해 주소서!

english: If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 죽어 가는 내 전우들의 비명이 더 듣기 좋겠다!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 그 정도 업적은 난 아침 먹기 전에 해치운다!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
translation: 네 노래는 무슨 외지인의 무기라도 되냐?

english: Welcome, traveller. Are you looking to represent one of the houses of Great Kourend?
translation: 어서 오세요, 여행자님. Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)의 가문 중 하나를 대표하고 싶으신가요?

english: Tell me more.
As you are probably aware, Great Kourend is a vast kingdom. Many adventurers choose to wear special clothing which allows them to explore swiftly and with elegance.
translation: 아시다시피 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)는 광활한 왕국이에요. 많은 모험가들이 빠르고 우아하게 탐험할 수 있게 해 주는 특별한 옷을 입곤 하죠.

english: As official tailor for Kourend, I can recolour this clothing, allowing adventurers to represent the city to which they are most loyal.
translation: 저는 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 공식 재단사로서 이 옷의 색을 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요. 그러면 모험가들이 가장 충성하는 도시를 대표할 수 있죠.

english: If you are interested, I would be more than happy to offer my tailoring services in exchange for Marks of Grace.
translation: 관심 있으시다면 Marks of Grace(기품의 징표)를 받고 기꺼이 재단 서비스를 해 드릴게요.

english: I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
translation: graceful(기품 있는) 옷의 색을 바꾸고 싶어요.

english: Fantastic, simply pass me the items of clothing you would like recoloured, and we can get started.
translation: 좋아요, 색을 바꾸고 싶은 옷을 건네주시면 바로 시작할게요.

english: Not right now.
Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
translation: 사실 그냥 옷을 좀 사고 싶었어요.

english: Oh, certainly. My assistant over there, Robyn, will be happy to help you.
translation: 아, 물론이죠. 저쪽에 있는 제 조수 Robyn(로빈)이 기꺼이 도와드릴 거예요.

english: Are you sure you want to recolour that piece of graful clothing? It will cost 15 marks of grace.
translation: 정말 그 graceful(기품 있는) 옷의 색을 바꾸시겠어요? marks of grace(기품의 징표) 15개가 들어요.

english: That seems reasonable.
Which city would you like to represent?
I want the colours you're wearing.
translation: 지금 입고 계신 색으로 해 주세요.

english: Actually, forget it.
Actually, forget it.
Sorry, you don't appear to have enough Marks of Grace. I charge 15 for my services.
translation: 죄송하지만 Marks of Grace(기품의 징표)가 부족하신 것 같네요. 제 서비스 요금은 15개예요.

english: I can remove that item's colours free of charge. Alternatively I can recolour it to represent a city of Kourend for a fee of 15 Marks of Grace.
translation: 그 아이템의 색은 무료로 없애 드릴 수 있어요. 아니면 Marks of Grace(기품의 징표) 15개를 받고 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 도시를 대표하는 색으로 바꿔 드릴 수도 있고요.

english: I'd like to remove the colours.
Are you sure you want to revert that piece of clothing? You'll have to pay again if you want it recoloured.
translation: 정말 그 옷을 원래대로 되돌리시겠어요? 다시 색을 바꾸려면 또 비용을 내셔야 해요.

english: Yes, I'm sure.
I'd like to represent a different city.
Not right now.
Tell me more.
I'd like to recolour my graceful clothing.
translation: graceful(기품 있는) 옷의 색을 바꾸고 싶어요.

english: Actually, I just wanted to buy some clothes.
translation: 사실 그냥 옷을 좀 사고 싶었어요.

english: That seems reasonable.
I want the colours you're wearing.
translation: 지금 입고 계신 색으로 해 주세요.

english: I'd like to remove the colours.
Yes, I'm sure.
I'd like to represent a different city.
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Welcome to the Miscellania food store. We've only opened recently.
translation: Miscellania(미셀라니아) 식료품점에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 문을 연 지 얼마 안 되었습니다.

english: Would you like to buy anything, your Royal Highness?
Could you show me what you have for sale?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 보여 줄 수 있어요?

english: No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 지금은 음식이 필요 없어요.

english: What's it like living down here?
The town's thriving. I'm sure it'll soon be as busy as Rellekka!
translation: 마을이 번창하고 있습니다. 곧 Rellekka(렐레카)만큼 북적이게 될 겁니다!

english: Could you show me what you have for sale?
translation: 파는 물건 좀 보여 줄 수 있어요?

english: No thank you, I don't need food just now.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 지금은 음식이 필요 없어요.

english: What's it like living down here?
'Ello there [lad/lassy]! What can I be getting you?
I'd like to order a drink, please.
Of course, what would you like?
Got anything special on tap?
translation: 통에서 바로 따라 주는 특별한 술 있어요?

english: We're always running a keg of our locally-brewed ale, Lizardkicker.
translation: 우리 가게엔 직접 빚은 에일, Lizardkicker(리저드키커)를 늘 한 통씩 열어 두고 있죠.

english: I will warn you though, its an acquired taste.
translation: 미리 말해 두는데, 익숙해져야 맛있는 술이에요.

english: What's in it?
Oh, the usual... Wheat, hops, yeast...
translation: 아, 뭐 늘 들어가는 거죠... 밀, 홉, 효모...

english: ...reptile scales...
Scales?!
Don't worry about the scales.
Was there anything else?
What is this place?
This here is the Cloak and Stagger. The finest drinking establishment in the whole of Shayzien.
translation: 여긴 Cloak and Stagger(망토와 비틀걸음)예요. Shayzien(샤이지엔) 전체에서 제일 좋은 술집이죠.

english: Isn't it the only pub in the city?
translation: 이 도시에 술집은 여기 하나뿐 아니에요?

english: Like I say, the finest in all of Shayzien!
translation: 그러니까 말했잖아요, Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 제일 좋은 술집이라고!

english: Most of our patrons are soldiers returning on leave from the frontlines. We do get a few regular folk in too though.
translation: 손님들은 대부분 최전선에서 휴가를 받아 돌아온 병사들이에요. 그래도 평범한 사람들도 좀 오긴 하죠.

english: By the way, its generally considered polite to buy a drink if you're going to stand around and chat.
translation: 그나저나, 서서 수다 떨 거면 술 한 잔 시키는 게 보통 예의예요.

english: ...With that said, is there anything else I can help you with?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Veos(베오스)가 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있다던데요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스) 부두 근처에서 어슬렁거린대요.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 문제가 생겼다더군요. 갱단들이 손을 잡았다나 뭐라나. 알아볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 아들 하나를 잃어버렸다던데요. 무사히 데려오면 Hosidius(호시디우스) 가문에서 큰돈을 줄지도 몰라요.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)가 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 통치자들이 일거리가 있다던데요. Lovakengj Assembly(로바켕기 의회)에 가면 만날 수 있어요.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 한복판에서 무슨 소동이 있었다나 봐요. 가 볼 만할지도 몰라요.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성) 밖에서 하는 시위가 슬슬 관심을 끌고 있어요. 한번 가 볼 만할 거예요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 사실 이제 가 봐야 할 것 같아요.

english: Safe travels!
I'd like to order a drink, please.
Got anything special on tap?
translation: 통에서 바로 따라 주는 특별한 술 있어요?

english: What is this place?
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Actually, I think I need to be going.
translation: 사실 이제 가 봐야 할 것 같아요.

english: Good day to you, hearty warrior! May the spirits guide you.
translation: 잘 왔네, 용맹한 전사여! 영혼들이 자네를 인도하기를.

english: Welcome back, friend of the spirits. I am humbled in your presence. You are no longer the apprentice, but the master. Seek to inspire all with your daring deeds and legendary feats.
translation: 다시 왔구먼, 영혼들의 벗이여. 자네 앞에서 나는 겸허해질 뿐일세. 자네는 더 이상 견습생이 아니라 스승일세. 대담한 행적과 전설적인 업적으로 모두에게 영감을 주게나.

english: Do you have anything for me?
I see you have free space and no way to record any information you may recover from the caverns. Please take this book as a record of your researches.
translation: 보아하니 소지품에 빈자리는 있는데 동굴에서 찾아낼 정보를 기록할 방법이 없구먼. 이 책을 받아 자네 연구를 기록하게나.

english: What kind of information are you thinking of?
Those who have previously entered the cavern have not all returned. Some of them seemed intent upon research and discovery as much as loot and daring deeds.
translation: 예전에 그 동굴에 들어간 이들이 모두 돌아온 건 아닐세. 그중 몇몇은 전리품과 대담한 행적만큼이나 연구와 발견에도 뜻을 두었던 모양이네.

english: It would be a shame if you were to recover any of their notes and be unable to record them handily. I hope the new book will give you space for such discoveries.
translation: 자네가 그들의 기록을 찾고도 제대로 적어 두지 못한다면 아까운 일이지. 새 책에 그런 발견을 담을 자리가 넉넉하길 바라네.

english: Can you help me with hastae?
Perhaps. What do you need?
Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: 이 부러진 것 같은 hasta(하스타)로 뭔가 벼려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, I can work with this, but remember, you cannot comprehend how to wield a hasta until you have learned to create one by following my teachings.
translation: 그래, 이거라면 손볼 수 있네. 하지만 명심하게. 내 가르침을 따라 하스타를 직접 만들어 보기 전까지는 하스타를 다루는 법을 깨칠 수 없다네.

english: ~ WARNING ~ You do not have the requirements to wield a hasta!
translation: ~ 경고 ~ 하스타를 장착할 조건을 갖추지 못했습니다!

english: Actually, forget it.
As you wish.
Yes, I can work with this.
Actually, forget I asked.
Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
translation: Zamorakian spears(자모락의 창)을 hastae(하스타)로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian spear into a hasta. The spirits require me to request 300,000 coins from you for this service.
translation: 그래, Zamorakian spear(자모락의 창)을 hasta(하스타)로 바꿔 줄 수 있네. 영혼들께서 이 일의 대가로 자네에게 300,000코인을 받으라 하시는군.

english: I can't afford that. Maybe another time.
Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
translation: Zamorakian hastae(자모락의 하스타)를 창으로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, I can convert a Zamorakian hasta into a spear. I do not charge for this service.
translation: 그래, Zamorakian hasta(자모락의 하스타)를 창으로 바꿔 줄 수 있네. 이 일에는 돈을 받지 않네.

english: I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: 나무를 심을 때 다시 화분을 깨부수고 싶어요.

english: Consider it done.
I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: 좀 더 차분해져서 화분을 깨부수지 않고 싶어요.

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: 계속 말씀하시는 그 영혼들에 대해 좀 더 알려 주실래요?

english: Certainly, though it is quite simple - they are the barbarians of the past who have died in the passing of the years. There are three categories which learned sages claim may describe all spirits encountered.
translation: 물론이지, 아주 간단하네. 영혼들은 세월이 흐르며 죽어 간 옛 바바리안들일세. 학식 있는 현자들 말로는, 마주치는 모든 영혼은 세 부류로 나눌 수 있다고 하지.

english: The majority are at peace, having died with their ambitions sated, even if this ambition was as simple as a glorious death. They can contact those in our world in order to spur us on to glory.
translation: 대다수는 평안하다네. 비록 그 야망이 영광스러운 죽음처럼 단순한 것이었다 해도, 뜻을 이루고 죽었기 때문이지. 그들은 우리 세상의 이들과 소통하며 우리를 영광으로 이끌어 줄 수 있네.

english: Of course, they cannot or will not contact all inhabitants of these lands, for not all are worthy.
translation: 물론 그들이 이 땅의 모든 이와 소통할 수 있거나 소통하려 하는 건 아닐세. 모두가 그럴 자격이 있는 건 아니니까.

english: So those are the spirits who give us guidance. What of the other sorts?
translation: 그러니까 그게 우리를 인도해 주는 영혼들이군요. 다른 부류는요?

english: A second category of spirit is made up of those who are not yet at peace. However, all that is needed is for their mortal remains to be laid to rest and they will join the peaceful majority.
translation: 두 번째 부류는 아직 평안을 얻지 못한 영혼들일세. 하지만 그들의 유해를 잘 안치해 주기만 하면 평안한 대다수에 합류하게 되지.

english: I can see the pyres serve this purpose. The final category is also restless?
translation: 화장 장작더미가 그런 역할을 하는 거군요. 마지막 부류도 편히 잠들지 못한 건가요?

english: Alas, there is a small minority who will never be at rest. These have been slain in moments of insanity by their brothers or by adventurers.
translation: 안타깝게도, 결코 안식을 얻지 못할 소수가 있네. 광기에 휩싸인 순간 형제들이나 모험가들 손에 죽은 이들이지.

english: They are not at rest and will attack those they blame for their tortured state. They are not known, however, for being able to determine this blame with any great accuracy, so should be considered dangerous to all.
translation: 그들은 안식을 얻지 못한 채, 자신을 이런 고통에 빠뜨렸다고 여기는 자들을 공격한다네. 하지만 누구 탓인지 정확히 가려내는 데는 영 서툰 것으로 알려져 있으니, 누구에게나 위험하다고 여겨야 하네.

english: Thank you Otto. It makes a bit more sense now.
translation: 고마워요, Otto(오토). 이제 좀 이해가 되네요.

english: I'd better get going.
I have further training for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
Wrong! Focus your thoughts.
Correct, you've completed this part of your training.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please tell me your answer.
Nope, Go check again!
Spot on!
Let's talk about my training.
Do you have anything for me?
Can you help me with hastae?
Can you forge anything from this broken-looking hasta?
translation: 이 부러진 것 같은 hasta(하스타)로 뭔가 벼려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes
No
Yes.
No.
Can you convert Zamorakian spears into hastae?
translation: Zamorakian spears(자모락의 창)을 hastae(하스타)로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can you convert Zamorakian hastae into spears?
translation: Zamorakian hastae(자모락의 하스타)를 창으로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: Actually, forget it.
I'd like to smash my pots when planting trees again.
translation: 나무를 심을 때 다시 화분을 깨부수고 싶어요.

english: I'd like to be calmer and not smash my pots.
translation: 좀 더 차분해져서 화분을 깨부수지 않고 싶어요.

english: Could you tell me more of these spirits you continually refer to?
translation: 계속 말씀하시는 그 영혼들에 대해 좀 더 알려 주실래요?

english: I'd better get going.
Please feel free to look around, just try to keep your hands off the apparatus!
translation: 마음껏 둘러보셔도 돼요. 다만 기구에는 손대지 말아 주세요!

english: What are you doing?
I'm trying to carry out very important research, but these so-called 'wizards' from the eastern lands keep meddling with my equipment.
translation: 아주 중요한 연구를 하려는 중인데, 동쪽 땅에서 온 이른바 '마법사'라는 작자들이 자꾸 제 장비를 건드려요.

english: I'll let you get back to your work.
Farewell, traveller.
How are you doing?
If you don't stop talking to me, I'll never get my slouching time for the day done.
translation: 자꾸 말 걸면 오늘 빈둥거릴 시간을 다 못 채우잖아.

english: How old are you now?
I'm old and fat if that's what you're driving at. What, are you thinking of trading me in for a younger model after all the adventuring we've done together? Is that it?
translation: 늙고 뚱뚱하다는 말이 하고 싶은 거라면, 그래 맞아. 뭐야, 같이 그렇게 모험을 다녀 놓고 나를 더 젊은 녀석으로 바꿀 생각이야? 그런 거야?

english: No nothing of the sort. I was just trying to make conversation, that's all.
translation: 아니, 전혀 그런 거 아니야. 그냥 말 좀 붙여 보려던 것뿐이야.

english: Sure, I know your game. Gonna trade me in for some death runes were ya? Eh?
translation: 그래, 네 속셈 다 알아. death runes(죽음 룬) 받고 나를 넘기려고 했지? 응?

english: What!! How do you know about that?
I would have thought you would have worked that out by now. Us cats are as wise as that sphinx.
translation: 이쯤이면 너도 눈치챘을 줄 알았는데. 우리 고양이들은 그 sphinx(스핑크스)만큼 현명하거든.

english: Where do you want to go?
I'd just like to go somewhere nice and warm.
translation: 그냥 어디 따뜻하고 좋은 데 가고 싶어.

english: What do you want to do now?
I want to have a snooze, all this talking has made me sleepy.
Gosh you're a bit dull and boring.
I suppose that's what you become once you pass your 9th birthday.
translation: 아홉 번째 생일이 지나면 다 그렇게 되는 거겠지.

english: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?
translation: 미안한데 인간, 너 지금 뭘 쓰고 있는 거야?

english: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.
translation: cat ears(고양이 귀)를 맞췄어. 냐아아아아옹장하지 않아?

english: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.
translation: 고양이가 눈 하나 깜빡이지 않고 당신의 눈을 빤히 쳐다본다.

english: Am I a joke to you?
UwU?
Why are you doing this?
I thought it'd be cute and funny.
It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.
translation: 하나도 안 그래. 당장 벗어, 인간. 나도 인간 귀 한 쌍 구해다 쓰기 전에.

english: How are you doing?
How old are you now?
Where do you want to go?
What do you want to do now?
Human. You seem to have found your way into Mistrock. What are you doing here?
translation: 인간. Mistrock(미스트록)까지 용케 찾아왔군. 여기서 뭘 하는 거지?

english: Am I not allowed to be here?
Your kind have managed to establish dominion over the vast majority of these lands. Will you not even let us have our small corner in peace?
translation: 너희 족속은 이미 이 땅 대부분을 손에 넣었잖아. 우리가 작은 구석 하나에서 조용히 사는 것조차 못 봐주겠다는 건가?

english: Is that a no?
Hmph! I can't stop you being here, but I don't have to enjoy your presence.
translation: 흥! 네가 여기 있는 걸 막을 순 없지만, 반가워할 필요도 없지.

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that?
translation: 그 생각을 바꾸려면 제가 뭘 하면 될까요?

english: No. Now if this conversation is over, I'm going to have a drink.
translation: 없어. 이제 얘기 끝났으면 난 한잔하러 간다.

english: Is there anything that I can do to change that? I've already been quite helpful over in Cam Torum.
translation: 그 생각을 바꾸려면 제가 뭘 하면 될까요? Cam Torum(캠 토룸)에서는 이미 꽤 도움이 됐는데요.

english: One act of charity will not excuse years of subjugation.
translation: 선행 한 번으로 수년간의 억압이 용서되진 않아.

english: Subjugation? That seems like a bit of an over- exaggeration.
Call it what you will. The end result is the same. Your kind prosper at the expense of ours, and you act like it's not even happening.
translation: 뭐라고 부르든 상관없어. 결과는 똑같으니까. 너희 족속은 우리를 희생시켜 번영하면서, 그런 일은 없다는 듯이 굴지.

english: I've seen Cam Torum. You don't seem to be doing too badly.
translation: Cam Torum(캠 토룸)을 봤는데요. 그렇게 형편없이 지내는 것 같진 않던데요.

english: And here you prove my point. One city! One! You see that one city and consider it somehow equal to your many.
translation: 바로 그게 내 말이 맞다는 증거야. 도시 하나! 딱 하나! 그 도시 하나를 보고는 너희의 수많은 도시와 맞먹는다고 여기다니.

english: Well what about this place?
A mere mining outpost. It hardly compares to those villas elsewhere on the island.
translation: 고작 채굴 전초기지일 뿐이야. 이 섬 다른 곳에 있는 저택들과는 비교도 안 되지.

english: Not all humans are the same though. It's not just Cam Torum. I've actually worked with your kind a few times.
translation: 그래도 인간이 다 같은 건 아니에요. Cam Torum(캠 토룸)만 그런 것도 아니고요. 저는 실제로 당신네 종족과 몇 번 함께 일한 적이 있어요.

english: Such as?
Well there was this one time when I helped the dwarves of Keldagrim with a bit of a statue issue. Another time I worked with one of the last surviving Imcando dwarves to create a blurite sword.
translation: 음, 한번은 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 드워프들이 조각상 문제로 곤란할 때 도와줬어요. 또 한번은 마지막 남은 Imcando(임칸도) 드워프 중 한 명과 함께 blurite sword(블루라이트 검)을 만들었고요.

english: Imcando?
Yes! You know about them?
Of course I know about them! The Imcando were our ancestors, but I thought they were long dead.
translation: 당연히 알지! Imcando(임칸도)는 우리 조상이야. 하지만 오래전에 사라진 줄 알았는데.

english: Not quite.
Hmph! It's still going to take more than that to get me to like you.
translation: 흥! 그래도 내가 널 좋아하게 만들려면 그걸론 어림없어.

english: Well if liking is out of the question, how about tolerate?
translation: 좋아하는 게 무리라면, 참아 주는 건 어때요?

english: Fine. Consider yourself tolerated. Now, did you actually want something?
translation: 좋아. 참아 주지. 그래서, 진짜로 원하는 게 있긴 한 거냐?

english: What do you do here?
I'm the overseer for Mistrock. I make sure everything around here is running as it should be.
translation: 난 Mistrock(미스트록)의 감독관이다. 이곳이 제대로 돌아가는지 살피는 게 내 일이지.

english: And you do that from the pub?
Am I not allowed a break from time to time?
I suppose.
Hmph!
You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
That's right. The Lovakengj dwarves were born from the Imcando and we were born from the Lovakengj. If you want to know more, find a historian.
translation: 그래. Lovakengj(로바켕기) 드워프는 Imcando(임칸도)에게서 태어났고, 우리는 로바켕기에게서 태어났지. 더 알고 싶으면 역사가를 찾아가.

english: Not really.
Then be on your way so that I can have a drink.
translation: 그럼 가던 길 가. 나 한잔 좀 하게.

english: Human. You seem to have returned. Did you want something?
translation: 인간. 또 왔군. 뭐 원하는 거라도 있나?

english: Is there anything that I can do to change your opinion on me?
translation: 저에 대한 생각을 바꾸려면 제가 뭘 하면 될까요?

english: No. Now leave me be so that I can have a drink.
translation: 없어. 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬. 한잔하게.

english: What do you do here?
You said the Imcando were your ancestors?
Not really.
Hoot! Hoot!
Marvelous!
Hello. What are you doing?
I'm the rat keeper, it's my job to look after these here rats.
translation: 난 쥐 관리인이야. 여기 이 쥐들을 돌보는 게 내 일이지.

english: You do know that there are some rats running loose?
translation: 쥐 몇 마리가 풀려서 돌아다니는 거 알고 계세요?

english: Some nibble their way out from time to time. Don't worry there's enough cats down here to sort anything that gets out.
translation: 가끔 몇 놈이 우리를 갉아서 빠져나가지. 걱정 마, 여긴 고양이가 충분히 있어서 나간 놈들은 다 처리해 줘.

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 그럼 이 rat pits(쥐 구덩이)는 어떻게 돌아가는 거예요?

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 구덩이는 덩치 큰 고양이들을 가진 사람들을 위한 곳이야.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: overgrown cat(너무 자란 고양이)하고 코인 몇 닢만 있으면, 마찬가지로 너무 자란 고양이와 여윳돈이 있는 다른 사람한테 도전할 수 있어.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 그다음엔 내기 금액을 정하지. 소문으로는 어떤 쥐잡이들은 자기 고양이와 말이 통해서 작전을 알려 준다더군.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 안 그래도 그 얘기 하려던 참이야. 도전자 둘의 고양이를 경기장 안에 넣고, 쥐 9마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이기는 거지.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 세상은 잔인한 곳이고, 구덩이도 예외는 아니지.

english: Each to their own, I say.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한테는 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 아이고, 끔찍해라. 고양이를 구할 방법은 없어요?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 당연히 있지. 조심하라고 지시해 두면, 위험하다 싶을 때 알아서 빠져나와.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
translation: 그건 네가 고양이를 얼마나 아끼느냐에 달렸지.

english: Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
translation: 음, 고양이가 죽거나 도망치면 지는 거거든.

english: So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 그러니까 오래 버틸수록 이길 확률이 높아지는 거지.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 그래도 확실한 건, 돈을 빨리 벌기도 하고 빨리 잃기도 하는 방법이라는 거지.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 금액에 한도가 있어요?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 흐음... 어디 보자. 그런 일은 한 번도 없었던 것 같은데, 20,000일 거야.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 흠, 고양이 싸움에 걸기엔 터무니없는 금액 같은데요.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 사람들이 얼마나 걸려고 드는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 아니, 지금은 안 돼. 우린 바깥사람하고는 내기를 잘 안 해.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 그래도 전 바깥사람이 아니잖아요. 지금 이 구덩이 안에 들어와 있잖아요?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 글쎄, 네가 내 신뢰를 얻을 만한 일을 하고 나면 모를까.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 아니. 평범한 마을 사람들은 우릴 싫어하고, 그래서 우리도 그 사람들이나 다른 누구든 믿지 않게 됐지.

english: Thanks for your help.
That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한테는 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 금액에 한도가 있어요?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
Aye, 'tis a fair day my friend.
I'm not your friend.
I'm surprised if you're anyone's friend with those kind of manners.
translation: 그런 버릇없는 태도로 누구 친구라도 된다면 그게 더 놀랍겠군.

english: Yes, it's a very nice day.
Aye, may the gods walk by yer side. Now leave me alone.
translation: 그래, 신들이 네 곁을 함께 걷기를. 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬.

english: Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: rune platebody(룬 판금 갑옷)을 파실 수 있나요?

english: So, how does thee know I 'ave some?
translation: 그래서, 내가 그걸 갖고 있단 건 어찌 알았지?

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
translation: Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)의 Guildmaster(길드 마스터)가 알려 줬어요.

english: Yes, I suppose he would, wouldn't he? He's always sending you fancy-pants 'heroes' up to bother me. Telling me I'll give them a quest or sommat like that.
translation: 그래, 그 양반이라면 그랬겠지, 안 그래? 맨날 너 같은 겉멋 든 '영웅'들을 보내서 날 귀찮게 한다니까. 내가 퀘스트인지 뭔지를 줄 거라고 하면서 말이야.

english: Well, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So, leave me alone.
translation: 흥, 아무한테나 내 rune platemail(룬 판금 갑옷)을 입게 할 생각은 없어. 영웅만 입을 수 있는 거야. 그러니 날 내버려 둬.

english: I am a master detective.
Well, however you found out about it, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So leave me alone.
translation: 흥, 어떻게 알아냈든 아무한테나 내 rune platemail(룬 판금 갑옷)을 입게 할 생각은 없어. 영웅만 입을 수 있는 거야. 그러니 날 내버려 둬.

english: I thought you were going to give me a quest.
*Sigh*
All right, I'll give ye a quest. I'll let you wear my rune platemail if ye...
translation: 좋아, 퀘스트를 주지. 내 rune platemail(룬 판금 갑옷)을 입게 해 주겠어, 만약 네가...

english: Slay the dragon of Crandor!
A dragon, that sounds like fun!
Hah, yes, you are a typical reckless adventurer, aren't you? Now go kill the dragon and get out of my face.
translation: 하, 그래, 넌 전형적인 무모한 모험가로군, 안 그래? 이제 가서 드래곤이나 잡고 내 눈앞에서 꺼져.

english: But how can I defeat the dragon?
Go to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. He'll help ye out if yer so keen on doing a quest. I'm not going to be handholding any adventurers.
translation: Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)의 Guildmaster(길드 마스터)를 찾아가. 그렇게 퀘스트를 하고 싶다면 그 양반이 도와줄 거야. 난 모험가들 손잡고 이끌어 줄 생각 없어.

english: I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: 제가 챔피언이긴 하지만, 아직 드래곤을 잡을 실력은 안 되는 것 같아요.

english: Yes, I can understand that. Yer a coward.
That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
Aye, I ken tell!
Have ye slayed that dragon yet?
Um... no.
Be off with ye then.
I'm not sellin' ye anything till you've slayed that dragon! Now be off wi' ye.
translation: 그 드래곤을 처치하기 전엔 아무것도 안 팔아! 썩 꺼져.

english: Yes, I have!
I have its head here.
You actually did it?
I underestimated ye, adventurer. I apologise.
Yer a true hero, and I'd be happy to sell ye rune platebodies.
translation: 넌 진정한 영웅이야. 기꺼이 rune platebodies(룬 판금 갑옷)을 팔아 주지.

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
(missing, presumably the store is opened)
Thank you.
Yer welcome.
Aye, 'tis a fair day, my mighty dragon-slaying friend.
translation: 그래, 날씨 한번 좋구먼, 드래곤을 처치한 위대한 친구.

english: Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: 이제 rune platebody(룬 판금 갑옷)을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: Melzar's Maze(멜자르의 미로) 열쇠를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: It's the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild who hands those keys out now. Go talk to him. No need to bother me if you don't need armour.
translation: 요즘은 Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)의 Guildmaster(길드 마스터)가 그 열쇠를 나눠 줘. 그 양반한테 가 봐. 갑옷이 필요한 게 아니면 날 귀찮게 할 필요 없어.

english: I see ye've got one of them anti-dragon shields there. I've got an idea about them things.
translation: 보아하니 anti-dragon shield(용 방어 방패)를 갖고 있구먼. 그 물건에 대해 생각해 둔 게 있지.

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: anti-dragon shield(용 방어 방패)에 대해 생각해 두신 게 뭔데요?

english: See, when ye uses them to fight a dragon, they absorb the fire. The shield must be storing the dragonfire, and just letting it radiate away.
translation: 봐, 그걸로 드래곤과 싸우면 방패가 불길을 흡수하잖아. 방패가 dragonfire(용의 불길)을 저장해 뒀다가 그냥 흘려보내는 게 분명해.

english: Now, if there was only a way to get the dragonfire out again...
translation: 자, dragonfire(용의 불길)을 다시 끄집어낼 방법만 있다면...

english: What use would that be?
Why, ain't it obvious? Ye could project blasts of dragonfire from yer shield!
translation: 아니, 뻔하지 않아? 네 방패에서 dragonfire(용의 불길)을 뿜어낼 수 있잖아!

english: Ye know, I think there might be a way.
What way?
I've heard legends of a thing called a 'draconic visage'. It was made by the dragonkin themselves apparently.
translation: 'draconic visage(용의 얼굴)'라는 물건에 대한 전설을 들은 적이 있어. 듣자 하니 dragonkin(드래곤킨)이 직접 만든 거라더군.

english: This 'draconic visage' had the power to channel dragonfire. Now, if I could attach the visage to the front of this shield...
translation: 이 'draconic visage(용의 얼굴)'에는 dragonfire(용의 불길)을 다루는 힘이 있었지. 자, 그 얼굴을 이 방패 앞면에 붙일 수만 있다면...

english: I will look for this draconic visage!
translation: 제가 그 draconic visage(용의 얼굴)을 찾아볼게요!

english: Good luck wi' that. They're mighty rare, so yer quest will take some time. If any monsters have them, it'll be the dragons.
translation: 행운을 빌지. 아주 귀한 물건이라 찾는 데 시간 좀 걸릴 거야. 그걸 가진 몬스터가 있다면 드래곤들일 테고.

english: Look at this visage.
Amazin'! Ye can almost feel it pulsing with draconic power!
translation: 대단하구먼! 용의 힘이 고동치는 게 느껴질 정도야!

english: Now, if ye bring me this and the anti-dragonbreath shield, I reckon I could combine them into something pretty special!
translation: 자, 이것과 anti-dragonbreath shield(용 방어 방패)를 가져오면, 둘을 합쳐서 꽤 특별한 걸 만들 수 있을 것 같아!

english: Now, if ye want me to, I could attach this to yer anti-dragonbreath shield and make something pretty special.
translation: 자, 원한다면 이걸 네 anti-dragonbreath shield(용 방어 방패)에 붙여서 꽤 특별한 걸 만들어 주지.

english: I'll charge 1,250,000 coins to construct it. What d'ye say?
Yes please!
There ye go. Now, the more dragonfire the shield absorbs, the more powerful it'll become.
translation: 자, 여기 있어. 이제 방패가 dragonfire(용의 불길)을 흡수할수록 더 강해질 거야.

english: No, thanks.
Suit yerself.
That's a bit expensive!
Yes it is. But I'm a master smith so I reckon I can charge what I like. Unless ye've got level 90 Smithing too, which I doubt!
translation: 그래, 비싸지. 하지만 난 대장장이의 달인이니 받고 싶은 만큼 받을 수 있어. 너도 Smithing(대장일) 90레벨이라면 모를까, 그럴 리 없겠지만!

english: No, I don't have level 90 Smithing.
I thought not. I'm the master smith of Misthalin! So, shall I construct the shield for you?
translation: 그럴 줄 알았지. 난 Misthalin(미스탈린) 최고의 대장장이라고! 그래서, 방패를 만들어 줄까?

english: Actually, I have got level 90 Smithing.
Oh! Well, I suppose ye don't need me for this then.
translation: 오! 그럼 이 일엔 내가 필요 없겠구먼.

english: The solving of this puzzle could be the key to your treasure.
translation: 이 퍼즐을 풀면 보물로 가는 열쇠를 얻을 수 있을 거야.

english: That isn't right, keep trying.
Well done, traveller.
I'm not your friend.
Yes, it's a very nice day.
Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: rune platebody(룬 판금 갑옷)을 파실 수 있나요?

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
translation: Champions' Guild(챔피언 길드)의 Guildmaster(길드 마스터)가 알려 줬어요.

english: I am a master detective.
I thought you were going to give me a quest.
A dragon, that sounds like fun.
I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: 제가 챔피언이긴 하지만, 아직 드래곤을 잡을 실력은 안 되는 것 같아요.

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
Can I buy a rune platebody now please?
translation: 이제 rune platebody(룬 판금 갑옷)을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Thank you.
Can I buy a rune platebody now, please?
translation: 이제 rune platebody(룬 판금 갑옷)을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have another key to Melzar's Maze?
translation: Melzar's Maze(멜자르의 미로) 열쇠를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: What's your idea about anti-dragon shields?
translation: anti-dragon shield(용 방어 방패)에 대해 생각해 두신 게 뭔데요?

english: What use would that be?
What way?
I will look for this draconic visage!
translation: 제가 그 draconic visage(용의 얼굴)을 찾아볼게요!

english: Look at this visage.
Yes, please!
No, thanks.
That's a bit expensive!
Is this place haunted?
I don't think so. Would it matter if it was?
translation: 아닐 거예요. 귀신이 나오면 문제가 되나요?

english: Maybe, it depends how haunted. I'm not a big fan of ghosts.
translation: 글쎄, 얼마나 나오느냐에 달렸지. 난 유령이라면 질색이거든.

english: Well, let's hope it's not haunted!
translation: 그럼 귀신이 안 나오길 빌어 보죠!

english: Have you thought about painting the building?
translation: 건물에 페인트칠을 할 생각은 해 보셨어요?

english: I'm thinking a nice bold red, like the dragon armour.
translation: dragon armour(드래곤 갑옷)처럼 강렬한 빨간색이 좋을 것 같은데.

english: Or maybe a green, in memory of Elvarg, a very mean dragon.
translation: 아니면 초록색도 좋겠군. 아주 지독한 드래곤이었던 Elvarg(엘바르그)를 기리는 뜻에서 말이야.

english: I think green would look great, it would match the surroundings, too!
translation: 초록색이 정말 잘 어울릴 것 같아요. 주변 풍경하고도 맞고요!

english: Could I get one of those rune platebodies?
translation: 그 rune platebodies(룬 판금 갑옷) 하나 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Well, normally you'd have to slay a dragon for me...
translation: 글쎄, 원래는 드래곤을 한 마리 잡아 와야 내가 팔아 주는 건데...

english: ...but maybe I can make an exception once I've moved in here.
translation: ...여기로 이사 오고 나면 예외로 해 줄 수도 있지.

english: As a little thank you for the help!
translation: 도와준 데 대한 작은 감사 표시로 말이야!

english: That would be great! Let's get this deal done quickly.
translation: 그럼 정말 좋죠! 어서 이 거래를 마무리해요.

english: I can't wait to complete the purchase!
It's almost done Oziach, not much longer.
translation: 거의 다 됐어요, Oziach(오지아크) 씨. 조금만 더 기다리세요.

english: Do you have any plans for it?
I have a few. I might convert the top floor into a bar!
translation: 몇 가지 있지. 꼭대기 층을 술집으로 바꿀까 해!

english: It'll be for all dragon slayers I know, there's a lot of us!
translation: 내가 아는 드래곤 슬레이어들을 위한 곳이야. 우리 같은 사람이 꽤 많거든!

english: Interesting use of such a beautiful property!
translation: 이렇게 아름다운 건물을 참 흥미롭게 쓰시네요!

english: OoooOooOoOoOoooooooo!
Ah!! Why did you do that?
That scared me!
I'm sorry! I was just pretending to be a ghost.
translation: 죄송해요! 그냥 유령 흉내를 내 본 거예요.

english: Don't do that! I don't like ghosts.
Hello Oziach.
Sorry [player name], I'm talking to the estate agent right now.
translation: 미안, [player name], 지금 부동산 중개인이랑 얘기 중이야.

english: I'm going to head back to the office.
Alright, I'll see you later. Can't wait to move in!
translation: 그래, 나중에 보자고. 빨리 이사 오고 싶군!

english: I know, it's a lovely place! See you!
translation: 그렇죠, 정말 멋진 곳이에요! 또 봬요!

english: The estate agent leaves.
Ahhh... soon to be mine.
The cutscene ends.
Oziach is alone! Seems like the perfect time to scare him.
translation: Oziach(오지아크)가 혼자 있네요! 겁주기 딱 좋은 때예요.

english: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it.
translation: 이 나무에 올라가서 병을 불기만 하면 될 거예요.

english: I see you there, what are you doing?!
translation: 거기 있는 거 다 보여, 뭐 하는 거야?!

english: Oziach caught me. I should try to be a bit faster next time.
translation: Oziach(오지아크)한테 들켰어요. 다음엔 좀 더 빨리 해야겠어요.

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about trying this again.
translation: 다시 해 보는 걸 Brother Jered(제레드 수사)님과 상의해 봐야겠어요.

english: OOOoOOOooOOooOOOOoOOOO
The player shakes the evergreen tree slightly.
What was that? A ghost?!
Hello?? Is that a ghost?
ONE ghost? Haha, ONE ghost can't spook me!
translation: 유령 '하나'? 하하, 유령 '하나'로는 날 못 놀래지!

english: The player returns to Brother Jered.
Seems like I wasn't very scary. Oziach said ONE ghost isn't enough!
translation: 별로 안 무서웠나 봐요. Oziach(오지아크)가 유령 '하나'로는 부족하대요!

english: I need to find another ghost, to scare Oziach from the trees on the other side of the path. That would work!
translation: 유령을 하나 더 찾아서 길 건너편 나무에서도 Oziach(오지아크)를 겁줘야겠어요. 그럼 통할 거예요!

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about this. Maybe he can help.
translation: 이 일은 Brother Jered(제레드 수사)님께 말씀드려 봐야겠어요. 도와주실지도 몰라요.

english: The estate agent should be back soon.
What a wonderful day!
It's quite the step up from my little humble house!
translation: 내 작고 소박한 집에 비하면 엄청난 발전이지!

english: I am slightly worried about the ghost...
Hello!
What are you doing here?
I'm buying the monastery, so I'm just having a look around.
translation: 이 수도원을 살 거라서 좀 둘러보는 중이야.

english: Did you find anything interesting?
Yes! But there is ONE ghost around. It's a little bit scary but ONE ghost isn't enough to scare me properly.
translation: 그럼! 근데 유령이 '하나' 돌아다니더라고. 좀 무섭긴 한데 유령 '하나'로는 날 제대로 겁줄 수 없지.

english: Would TWO ghosts be enough to scare you?
I don't know, maybe, depends how scary they are.
Why are you asking?
I'm just interested in ghosts, they're fascinating!
translation: 그냥 유령에 관심이 많아서요. 정말 흥미롭잖아요!

english: Hello there!
How are you?
I'm very well thank you. Very excited as I'm about to finish buying the monastery!
translation: 아주 잘 지내, 고맙군. 곧 수도원 매입이 끝나서 엄청 들떠 있지!

english: Did the ghosts not scare you off?
No, there was only ONE, so it wasn't that scary.
Only ONE ghost? I thought there were loads!
I've only found ONE. If there are more, then I might have to rethink my purchase.
translation: 난 '하나'밖에 못 봤어. 더 있다면 매입을 다시 생각해 봐야 할지도 모르겠군.

english: Interesting.
Why is that interesting?
I just thought there were lots of ghosts, but maybe there is only ONE!
translation: 그냥 유령이 많은 줄 알았는데, 어쩌면 '하나'뿐일지도 모르겠네요!

english: Hi, [player name].
What is going on here?
I'm just admiring the monastery, I'm going to purchase it!
translation: 수도원을 구경하는 중이야. 내가 사들일 거거든!

english: Are you going to live there?
Yes! I'm going to turn it into a cool house, maybe add a swimming pool.
translation: 그럼! 멋진 집으로 꾸밀 거야. 수영장도 하나 들일까 하고.

english: I see. What are the monks going to do?
I don't know, find somewhere else to live!
Was that you hiding by the tree earlier?
translation: 아까 나무 옆에 숨어 있던 거 너야?

english: Nope, wasn't me! Must have been someone else.
They looked a lot like you.
I have quite a familiar face!
I saw you by that tree earlier, what were you doing?
translation: 아까 그 나무 옆에서 널 봤어. 뭐 하고 있었던 거야?

english: I don't think that was me!
Why were you sneaking around the trees earlier?
translation: 아까 왜 나무 사이를 몰래 돌아다녔어?

english: That wasn't me, I've only just got here!
I'll keep an eye out for them though, they sound suspicious!
translation: 그래도 그 사람 잘 지켜볼게요. 수상한 사람 같네요!

english: Oziach spotted us! We'll have to try again. Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: Oziach(오지아크)한테 들켰구나! 다시 해 봐야겠어. 준비되면 말 걸어 주렴.

english: Don't be too long though, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head! I'll be here.
translation: 그래도 너무 오래 걸리진 마라, 머리에 쓴 냄비가 꽤 무겁거든! 여기 있을게.

english: The player climbs the first tree.
BANG CLANG BANG
Ghosts?! More than ONE?! Stay away from me!
Cutscene ends.
Oziach seemed pretty scared after that! Time to go to the next tree along the path.
translation: Oziach(오지아크)가 꽤 겁먹은 것 같아요! 길을 따라 다음 나무로 가 봐야겠어요.

english: The player climbs the second tree.
BONG DING CLONG
ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo
translation: 우우오오 우우우오오오 오오오우우 오오오오우우우 우우우오우오 우우우오오우우

english: Ah! How many ghosts are there??
It's working! Scaring Oziach one more time should do it!
translation: 효과가 있어요! Oziach(오지아크)를 한 번만 더 겁주면 될 거예요!

english: The player climbs the third tree.
Help! Somebody help! The ghosts are chasing me!
translation: 살려 줘! 누가 좀 살려 줘! 유령들이 쫓아온다!

english: A cutscene starts. The estate agent arrives, and approaches Oziach.
translation: 컷신이 시작된다. 부동산 중개인이 도착해 Oziach(오지아크)에게 다가간다.

english: So many ghosts... I need some help!
Oziach! Are you okay? I heard shouting!
translation: Oziach(오지아크) 씨! 괜찮으세요? 비명 소리가 들렸어요!

english: Hello! It's not going well. There are a lot of ghosts here!
translation: 왔군! 영 좋지 않아. 여기 유령이 엄청 많아!

english: That's not good at all!
Do you still want to go ahead with the purchase?
Of course! TWO ghosts is scary, but not that scary!
translation: 당연하지! 유령이 '둘'이나 있는 건 무섭지만, 그렇게까지 무섭진 않아!

english: I'll hire myself one of those slayers we see everywhere.
translation: 요즘 어디서나 보이는 슬레이어 한 명을 고용해야겠어.

english: They will help with the ghost problem!
translation: 그 사람이 유령 문제를 해결해 줄 거야!

english: Phew, that is lovely news! I thought it was all over, then.
translation: 휴, 정말 다행이네요! 이제 다 끝났나 싶었어요.

english: I'll head back to the office, meet me there shortly.
translation: 저는 사무실로 돌아갈게요. 곧 거기서 뵈어요.

english: I'll be doing the final paperwork.
We've failed. Oziach still wants to buy the monastery.
translation: 실패했구나. Oziach(오지아크)는 여전히 수도원을 사려고 해.

english: I thought TWO ghosts would be enough!
Maybe we need more ghosts? A THIRD ghost?
translation: 유령이 더 필요한 걸까? 세 번째 유령?

english: I guess so. Let's go and place another advert in the Herald.
translation: 그런가 봐요. Herald(헤럴드)에 광고를 하나 더 내러 가요.

english: Wait...
A portal opens in front of Oziach, and Death appears before him.
translation: Oziach(오지아크) 앞에 포털이 열리고, Death(죽음)이 그의 앞에 나타난다.

english: ...what is that??
It is I, Death!
Oh my...
The scariest. The immortal. The terrifying. Me!
translation: 가장 무시무시한 자. 불멸의 존재. 공포 그 자체. 바로 나다!

english: Where are [player name] and Iffie? I must prove my scariness.
translation: [player name], 그리고 Iffie(이피)는 어디 있느냐? 내 무시무시함을 증명해야 하거늘.

english: They will regret not picking me!
translation: 나를 고르지 않은 걸 후회하게 해 주마!

english: Death?!
TOO SCARY!
i'm off. You can keep the monastary!
I'm off. You can keep the monastery!
What? I don't want the monastery...?
translation: 뭐라? 난 수도원 따윈 필요 없는데...?

english: Oziach walks away from Death.
I don't want to die!
Mummmmmmmyyyy!
What a strange mortal being...
What do you want?
Oh, nothing in particular really.
Well stop distracting me then. I'm meant to be guarding this sacred statue from the temple of Marimbo.
translation: 그럼 방해하지 마. 난 Marimbo(마림보) 신전의 신성한 조각상을 지켜야 한다고.

english: Where is the temple of Marimbo?
You're not from around here are you?
Actually, I'm not. I'm a visitor from foreign lands.
translation: 사실 아니에요. 먼 이국땅에서 온 방문객이에요.

english: Very well. The temple is to the east of the village.
What is the statue of?
It's of Marimbo, you cretin!
Ah yes. How stupid of me not to see the likeness.
translation: 아, 그렇죠. 꼭 닮았는데 못 알아보다니 제가 바보네요.

english: I'll be back later.
I wouldn't count on it.
What!?
Oh, nothing.
Where is the temple of Marimbo?
What is the statue of?
I'll be back later.
Hello there, what can I do for you?
I don't know, what can you do for me?
Well, I am somewhat of an expert in the field of magical traps.
translation: 음, 저는 마법 함정 분야에서 나름 전문가입니다.

english: Magical traps? What does that have to do with the Historical Archive?
translation: 마법 함정이요? 그게 Historical Archive(역사 기록 보관소)와 무슨 상관이죠?

english: A good question. The Archive is actually part of the Tower of Magic, and was repurposed many decades ago.
translation: 좋은 질문입니다. 사실 이 보관소는 Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)의 일부였는데, 수십 년 전에 용도가 바뀌었지요.

english: Unfortunately, we don't possess full understanding of the Tower of Magic and its many enchantments, so we often discover remnants of traps.
translation: 안타깝게도 저희는 Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)과 그 수많은 마법을 완전히 이해하지 못하고 있어서, 함정의 흔적을 종종 발견하곤 합니다.

english: The task has fallen to me to investigate and study what we can of these enchantments in the hopes of understanding their magical power.
translation: 이 마법들을 최대한 조사하고 연구해 그 마력을 이해하는 일이 제게 맡겨졌습니다.

english: What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
translation: Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)이 정확히 뭔가요?

english: The Tower of Magic is a uniquely enchanted building located just west of the library, though many levels and rooms are hidden from sight.
translation: Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)은 도서관 바로 서쪽에 있는 독특한 마법이 걸린 건물입니다. 다만 수많은 층과 방이 눈에 보이지 않게 숨겨져 있지요.

english: I have dedicated my life to studying the powerful enchantments that conceal the many levels of the Tower, though it proves difficult at times.
translation: 저는 탑의 여러 층을 숨기고 있는 강력한 마법을 연구하는 데 평생을 바쳤습니다. 때로는 꽤 어려운 일이지만요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 그 밖에 또 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: Tell me about the history of the Tower.
The Tower was constructed by King Rada III. We don't know exactly when, since dates were not recorded before the Twill Accord.
translation: 탑은 King Rada III(라다 3세 왕)이 세웠습니다. 정확한 시기는 모릅니다. Twill Accord(트윌 협약) 이전에는 연도가 기록되지 않았거든요.

english: Following the rebellion of the five houses against King Rada III, the Council of Elders was formed. They used the Tower as a meeting place for the Council.
translation: 다섯 가문이 King Rada III(라다 3세 왕)에게 반란을 일으킨 뒤 Council of Elders(원로회)가 결성되었습니다. 원로회는 이 탑을 회의 장소로 썼지요.

english: Since then, it has mostly been used as a residence by the various rulers of the kingdom, with each ruler using the Tower however they saw fit.
translation: 그 뒤로는 주로 왕국의 여러 통치자들이 거처로 썼고, 통치자마다 탑을 저마다 원하는 대로 사용했습니다.

english: Eventually, after Kourend Castle was built, ownership of the Tower was passed over to Lord Arceuus.
translation: 그러다 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)이 지어진 뒤, 탑의 소유권은 Lord Arceuus(아르세우스 경)에게 넘어갔습니다.

english: This room is part of the Tower?

Indeed. During the invasion of the Wintertodt, it was feared that all of Kourend might be lost to the cold. In order to preserve the history of the kingdom, this archive was created during the fifth decade.
translation: 그렇습니다. Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 침공 당시, Kourend(쿠렌드) 전체를 추위에 잃을까 두려워했지요. 그래서 왕국의 역사를 보존하려고 5번째 10년기에 이 보관소를 만들었습니다.

english: Unfortunately, as it is a former chamber of the Tower, and we do not fully understand the magic that conceals it, we often discover strange enchantments that we believe to be old traps.
translation: 안타깝게도 이곳은 원래 탑의 방이었고, 저희는 이곳을 숨기는 마법을 완전히 이해하지 못하기 때문에, 옛 함정으로 보이는 기묘한 마법을 종종 발견합니다.

english: Just recently we lost a scholar when she accidentally activated a portal and fell through it.
translation: 얼마 전에는 한 학자가 실수로 포털을 작동시켜 그 속으로 떨어지는 바람에 실종되기도 했습니다.

english: Was she okay?
Yes, she turned up a few days later, a little confused but physically fine. It happens every now and then, but most people turn up eventually.
translation: 네, 며칠 뒤에 나타났습니다. 조금 혼란스러워했지만 몸은 멀쩡했지요. 이따금 있는 일인데, 대부분은 결국 다시 나타납니다.

english: I guess I'd better be careful then.
Just be cautious of walking into walls. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 벽 쪽으로 걸어 들어가지 않도록만 조심하십시오. 그 밖에 또 도와드릴 일이 있습니까?

english: Goodbye.
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: What do you wish to know?
I'm trying to find out more about the expedition he ordered to Mount Quidamortem.
translation: 그분이 명령한 Mount Quidamortem(퀴다모르템 산) 원정에 대해 더 알아보려고 해요.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any information on that expedition. You're probably better off talking to one of the others.
translation: 죄송하지만 그 원정에 대해서는 아는 바가 없습니다. 다른 분들께 여쭤보시는 게 나을 겁니다.

english: I could tell you about the kings' work on the Tower of Magic though.
translation: 대신 역대 왕들이 Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)에 남긴 업적에 대해서는 말씀드릴 수 있습니다.

english: Well it's either this or buying rubbish at the Grand Exchange, fire away.
translation: 뭐, 이거 아니면 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지)에서 쓰레기나 사는 거니까요. 말씀해 보세요.

english: Well it's either this or running around telling everyone I'm an Ironman.
translation: 뭐, 이거 아니면 돌아다니면서 다들한테 제가 Ironman(아이언맨)이라고 떠벌리는 거니까요. 말씀해 보세요.

english: During the time of King Shayzien VII, the Tower of Magic was the seat of power in Kourend. The king spent a lot of his time at the Tower, more than any other king.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕) 시대에는 Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)이 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 권력 중심지였습니다. 왕은 다른 어느 왕보다도 많은 시간을 탑에서 보냈지요.

english: In fact, he oversaw the construction of various new sections, most notably the prison.
translation: 실제로 그는 여러 새 구역의 건설을 감독했는데, 그중 가장 유명한 것이 감옥입니다.

english: When was this?
Well now that I think about it, it was around the same time as the expedition you were asking about. I doubt the two are connected though.
translation: 음, 생각해 보니 말씀하신 그 원정과 거의 같은 시기였군요. 두 일이 관련이 있을 것 같지는 않지만요.

english: I see. Would it be possible to visit the prison?
translation: 그렇군요. 그 감옥에 가 볼 수 있을까요?

english: Well the prison is abandoned and has been for many years so I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it.
translation: 음, 감옥은 버려진 지 오래되었으니 보여 드려도 문제는 없겠지요.

english: Be aware that the magic in that part of the tower is a bit unstable so any items left in the prison will be lost. Would you like me to teleport you there now?
translation: 다만 탑의 그 구역은 마법이 조금 불안정해서, 감옥에 남겨 둔 아이템은 사라지니 주의하십시오. 지금 그곳으로 순간이동해 드릴까요?

english: Very well, prepare yourself.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음이 바뀌시면 찾아오십시오. 저는 여기 있겠습니다.

english: What exactly is the Tower of Magic?
translation: Tower of Magic(마법의 탑)이 정확히 뭔가요?

english: Tell me about the history of the Tower
This room is part of the Tower?
Goodbye.
I don't know, what can you do for me?
I have a question about King Shayzien VII.
translation: King Shayzien VII(샤이지엔 7세 왕)에 대해 질문이 있어요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
What's going on?
Speaking would certainly help your case.
translation: 말을 해 주시면 확실히 도움이 될 텐데요.

english: Well, okay then.
Hello there.
Ohh, I know you. You're the one that helped father take the throne! Of course, now it's my brothers throne instead.
translation: 오, 너 알아. 아버지가 왕좌를 차지하도록 도와준 사람이잖아! 물론 지금은 우리 형이 그 자리를 차지했지만.

english: Which I'm guessing makes you the new Lord Hosidius? How's that going?
translation: 그럼 당신이 새 Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)가 된 거겠네요? 요즘 어때요?

english: Boring! Things were much more fun when my only job was to taste the wine and get drunk.
translation: 지루해! 와인 맛보고 취하는 게 유일한 일이던 시절이 훨씬 재밌었지.

english: You still seem to be enjoying the wine just fine.
translation: 와인은 여전히 잘 즐기고 계신 것 같은데요.

english: Yes, but now I have to do other things as well.
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 이젠 다른 일도 해야 하거든.

english: It must be very hard for you.
It is. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to have another drink.
translation: 힘들지. 자, 실례지만 난 한잔 더 하러 가야겠어.

english: Hello, who are you?
Hello, I am the panning guide. I'm here to teach you how to pan for gold.
translation: 안녕하세요, 저는 사금 채취 안내원이에요. 사금 채취하는 법을 가르쳐 드리려고 여기 있어요.

english: Excellent!
Let me explain how panning works. First you need a panning tray. Use the tray in the panning points in the water and then search your tray.
translation: 사금 채취가 어떻게 이뤄지는지 설명해 드릴게요. 먼저 panning tray(사금 채취 쟁반)이 필요해요. 물속의 사금 채취 지점에 쟁반을 쓴 다음, 쟁반을 살펴보세요.

english: If you find any gold, take it to the archaeological expert up in the museum storage facility. He will calculate its value for you.
translation: 금을 찾으면 박물관 보관소 위층에 있는 고고학 전문가에게 가져가세요. 그분이 가치를 계산해 줄 거예요.

english: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 고고학자가 쓰는 도구에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.
translation: 물론이죠! 어디 보자... rock pick(암석 망치)는 바위를 쪼개거나 흙을 긁어내는 데 써요. Education Centre(교육 센터)의 찬장에서 하나 구할 수 있어요.

english: What about sample jars?
I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!
translation: 거의 어디에나 흩어져 있을 거예요. 그래도 Education Centre(교육 센터) 어딘가의 찬장에서 하나 구할 수 있다는 건 확실해요. 암석 망치처럼요!

english: Okay, what about a specimen brush?
We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.
translation: 지금은 그게 좀 부족해요. 현장에 있는 workman(인부)한테 빌려 볼 수는 있겠지만... 순순히 내주진 않을 것 같네요.

english: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?
translation: 그럼 몰래 하나 챙겨야겠네요... 좋아요, trowel(모종삽)은요?

english: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.
translation: 아... 그건 시험에 통과해야 얻을 수 있어요! examiner(시험관)이 갖고 있어요.

english: Anything else?
If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; he's the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: 뭔가 감정이 필요하거나 잘 모르겠는 게 있으면 Terry(테리)에게 주세요. 옆방에 있는 고고학 전문가예요.

english: Ahh, ok thanks.
Thank you!
Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
translation: 고고학자가 쓰는 도구에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thank you!
Hey there.
Hi hi.
Can't talk too long. I've got to go fast.
translation: 오래 얘기 못 해. 빨리 가야 하거든.

english: Why do you need to go fast?
Fast is better.
You might go a little faster if you put down that giant clock.
translation: 그 커다란 시계를 내려놓으면 좀 더 빨리 갈 수 있을 텐데요.

english: Then how would I check the time?
That's a good point.
I don't think you'll be going anywhere at this rate. That goose hasn't moved an inch.
translation: 이 속도로는 아무 데도 못 갈 것 같은데요. 저 거위는 꿈쩍도 안 했어요.

english: Be patient [player name], geese always move and cause mischief. If not, I know what we can serve for dinner in the pub.
translation: 참아, [player name]. 거위는 언제든 움직여서 말썽을 피우거든. 안 움직이면, 펍 저녁 메뉴로 뭘 낼지 정해진 거지.

english: Oh my.
I'll leave you to it then! Good luck!
You too!
Aha! Are you here to parley?
I don't think so.
Oh, that's a shame.
Do you parley here often?
I parley everywhere! I haven't encountered a single problem I've not been able to parley my way out of.
translation: 난 어디서든 협상하지! 협상으로 빠져나오지 못한 문제는 단 하나도 없었어.

english: Really? That just works?

That's right! Whenever I run into trouble, I just shout parley! To be honest with you, I don't know the first thing about actually being a pirate. All my wealth just comes from parleying all the time.
translation: 그렇다니까! 곤란한 일이 생기면 그냥 협상! 하고 외치는 거야. 솔직히 말하면, 난 해적 노릇에 대해선 하나도 몰라. 내 재산은 전부 줄곧 협상해서 생긴 거라고.

english: I see. It really feels like that's going to go horribly wrong for you at some point.
translation: 그렇군요. 언젠가는 그게 끔찍하게 잘못될 것 같은 기분이 드는데요.

english: Nonsense! At the rate I'm going, I'm going to be the greatest pirate ever to have lived! Parley! Parley! Parley!
translation: 말도 안 돼! 이대로만 가면 난 역사상 가장 위대한 해적이 될 거야! 협상! 협상! 협상!

english: Awk! Awk! Rum's done! Rum's done!
translation: 꽥! 꽥! 럼 완성! 럼 완성!

english: Awk! More ingredients! More ingredients!
Awk! Feed the fires! Feed the fires!
Awk! Gimme a cracker!
Polly, what should we do?
Good day, good day. Come to admire the new parrot aviary have we?
translation: 안녕하세요, 안녕하세요. 새로 생긴 앵무새 사육장을 구경하러 오셨나요?

english: It's very nice.
Isn't it just?
When did you add it?
Just recently. It would have been sooner, but some wretch thought it would be amusing to replace their drinking water with vodka. The vet had to nurse them back to health for weeks!
translation: 얼마 전에요. 더 일찍 열 수 있었는데, 어떤 못된 녀석이 장난이랍시고 앵무새들 마실 물을 보드카로 바꿔 놨지 뭐예요. 수의사가 몇 주 동안 간호해서 겨우 회복시켰다니까요!

english: What do you feed them?
Well, fruit and grain mostly. I try to give them a balanced diet, but their favourite treat is pineapple chunks.
translation: 음, 주로 과일이랑 곡물이에요. 균형 잡힌 식단을 주려고 하는데, 제일 좋아하는 간식은 pineapple chunks(파인애플 덩어리)예요.

english: Hey! What are you doing with that parrot?
translation: 이봐요! 그 앵무새한테 무슨 짓을 하는 거예요?

english: Nothing.
It looks drunk! You should NEVER feed alcohol to a parrot!
translation: 취한 것 같잖아요! 앵무새한테 절대로 술을 먹이면 안 돼요!

english: Well, good thing I found it! I'll just take it to the vet for you, shall I?
translation: 그럼 제가 찾아서 다행이네요! 제가 수의사한테 데려다줄까요?

english: Oh, thank you! We're ever so busy here at the Zoo.
translation: 아이고, 고마워요! 저희 Zoo(동물원)은 정말 바쁘거든요.

english: It's very nice.
When did you add it?
What do you feed them?
Hi! I'm Party Pete. Welcome to the Party Room!
translation: 안녕하세요! 전 Party Pete(파티 피트)예요. Party Room(파티 룸)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: So what's this room for?
translation: 그럼 이 방은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: This room is for partying the night away!
How do you have a party in Gielinor?
Get a few mates round, get the beers in and have fun!
translation: 친구 몇 명 불러서 맥주 들여놓고 신나게 놀면 돼요!

english: Some players organise parties so keep an eye open!
translation: 파티를 여는 플레이어들도 있으니 잘 지켜보세요!

english: Woop! Thanks Pete!
What's the big lever over there for?
Simple. With the lever you can do some fun stuff.
translation: 간단해요. 레버로 재밌는 걸 할 수 있거든요.

english: What kind of stuff?

A balloon drop costs 1000 gold. For this you get 200 balloons dropped across the whole of the party room. You can then have fun popping the balloons! If there are items in the Party Drop Chest they will be inside
translation: 풍선 드롭은 1000골드예요. 그럼 파티 룸 전체에 풍선 200개가 떨어져요. 그러고 나서 풍선을 터뜨리며 놀면 돼요! Party Drop Chest(파티 드롭 상자)에 아이템이 있으면 그 아이템들이

english: the balloons! For 500 gold you can summon the Party Room Knights who will dance for your delight.
translation: 풍선 안에 들어 있어요! 500골드를 내면 Party Room Knights(파티 룸 기사단)을 불러서 춤추는 모습을 즐길 수 있어요.

english: Their singing isn't a delight though!
What's the gold chest for?
Any items that are in the chest will be dropped inside the balloons when you pull the lever!
translation: 레버를 당기면 상자 안에 있는 아이템이 전부 풍선 안에 담겨서 떨어져요!

english: Cool! Sounds like a fun way to do a drop party!
translation: 멋지네요! 드롭 파티를 하기에 재밌는 방법 같아요!

english: Exactly!
A word of warning though. Any items that you put into the chest can't be taken out again and it costs 1000 gold pieces for each balloon drop.
translation: 그래도 주의할 점이 있어요. 상자에 넣은 아이템은 다시 꺼낼 수 없고, 풍선 드롭은 할 때마다 1000골드가 들어요.

english: Have you always been here in Falador?

We used to be in Seers' Village, far to the west, but we had to move - the seers were complaining about the noise level, and the knights of Camelot got it into their heads that the Party Room knights were making fun of
translation: 원래는 서쪽 멀리 Seers' Village(시어스 마을)에 있었는데, 이사해야 했어요. 예언자들은 시끄럽다고 불평했고, Camelot(카멜롯)의 기사들은 파티 룸 기사단이 자기들을

english: them.
We're doing well here, though. The people of Falador are happy we're here, and we've hardly ever had the White Knights telling us to keep the noise down.
translation: 그래도 여기선 잘 지내고 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 사람들은 저희가 와서 좋아하고, White Knights(백기사단)이 조용히 하라고 한 적도 거의 없어요.

english: We're going to turn Falador into the party capital of Gielinor!
translation: 저희는 팔라도르를 Gielinor(길리노르)의 파티 수도로 만들 거예요!

english: I wanna party!
I've won the Dance Trophy at the Kandarin Ball three years in a trot!
translation: 전 Kandarin Ball(칸다린 무도회)에서 3년 연속으로 Dance Trophy(댄스 트로피)를 탔다고요!

english: Show me your moves Pete!
translation: 춤 실력 좀 보여 주세요, 피트!

english: Party Pete dances and cheers, then ends in a bow.
translation: Party Pete(파티 피트)가 춤추며 환호하더니, 인사로 마무리한다.

english: You've come to the right place!
Party Pete has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Party Pete(파티 피트)가 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 줬다!

english: So what's this room for?
translation: 그럼 이 방은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: What's the big lever over there for?
What's the gold chest for?
Have you always been here in Falador?
I wanna party!
By Ralos! Itsthe Grand Champion!
Itsreally you, isn't it? This is my best day ever!
translation: 진짜 당신이죠, 그렇죠? 오늘은 제 인생 최고의 날이에요!

english: Have you spoken to the minotaur? What's he like in real life?
translation: minotaur(미노타우로스)랑 얘기해 봤어요? 실제로는 어떤 녀석이에요?

english: You really stuck it to that Sol guy! He's not so tough now.
translation: 그 Sol(솔)이라는 녀석을 제대로 혼내 줬잖아요! 이제 별로 안 세 보이던데요.

english: Can we get a portrait together?
translation: 같이 초상화 하나 남길 수 있을까요?

english: Can you get me into the arena? They banned me after last time...
translation: 저 좀 경기장에 들여보내 줄 수 있어요? 지난번 일 이후로 출입 금지당했거든요...

english: Can I shine your boots? Maybe polish your blade?
translation: 부츠 닦아 드릴까요? 칼날도 광 내 드릴까요?

english: Can I get an autograph?
You're so dreamy.
You smell like victory.
I've been thinking, we should hang out. You'd like me if you got to know me!
translation: 생각해 봤는데요, 우리 같이 놀아요. 저를 알게 되면 분명 좋아하실 거예요!

english: Are you free this weekend? I'm free this weekend. We should hang out!
translation: 이번 주말에 시간 있어요? 저는 이번 주말에 한가해요. 우리 같이 놀아요!

english: Wowee!
Hello there! Can I sew ye somethin' tegether?
translation: 어이, 어서 와! 뭐 하나 꿰매 줄까?

english: What do you mean?
Well, ye see it works like this; I can sew yer eye patches onto yer pirate hats or pirate bandanas.
translation: 그러니까 이런 거야. 네 eye patches(안대)를 pirate hats(해적 모자)나 pirate bandanas(해적 두건)에 꿰매 붙여 줄 수 있지.

english: Just pirate bandanas mind ye, I hate the feel of snakeskin. (Shudder)
translation: pirate bandanas(해적 두건)만 된다, 알겠지? 난 뱀가죽 감촉이 질색이거든. (부르르)

english: It costs 500 gold te do it, and 600 gold te get them separated.
Ok, why does it cost more to get them separated than put together?
translation: 그런데 왜 붙이는 것보다 떼어 내는 게 더 비싸요?

english: Wear and tear on scissors.

On another note, I also sew crab claw gauntlets on to pirate hooks, highwayman masks to black cavaliers, mime masks to black berets, partyhats to glasses and monocles to top hats if ye have them with ye.
translation: 그리고 crab claw gauntlets(게 집게발 건틀릿)은 pirate hooks(해적 갈고리)에, highwayman masks(노상강도 가면)은 black cavaliers(검은 캐벌리어)에, mime masks(마임 배우 가면)은 black berets(검은 베레모)에, partyhats(파티 모자)는 glasses(안경)에, monocles(외알 안경)은 top hats(실크해트)에 꿰매 줄 수도 있어. 가지고 있다면 말이지.

english: If ye also have some flippers and suitably evil lookin' claws, I can probably put them together too.
translation: flippers(오리발)이랑 적당히 사악해 보이는 발톱도 있으면, 그것들도 아마 붙여 줄 수 있을 거야.

english: So, do ye have anything ye wants doin?
Yes please!
Sure, but remember I charge 500 coins, so if you don't have them you'll have to come back later!
translation: 좋아. 하지만 500코인 받는다는 거 잊지 마. 돈이 없으면 나중에 다시 와야 한다!

english: No.
Fair enough. See you around!
Yes
No
Oh no... what do I do?
It's all gone wrong...
What's wrong?
I'm supposed to be cooking a cake for the Cake Off but my prized tin has broken!
translation: Cake Off(케이크 대회)에 낼 케이크를 구워야 하는데, 제가 아끼는 케이크 틀이 망가져 버렸어요!

english: What's the Cake Off?
Oh, you don't know about the Great Gielinor Cake Off? It's Party Pete's newest idea!
translation: 어머, Great Gielinor Cake Off(위대한 길리노르 케이크 대회)를 모르세요? Party Pete(파티 피트)의 최신 아이디어예요!

english: He's invited representatives from across the world to have their baking skills judged.
translation: 세계 각지의 대표들을 초대해서 베이킹 실력을 심사한대요.

english: Who are you?
Oh! I'm Patty Seer, a wandering cook! I'm traveling the world learning everything I can about food.
translation: 아! 저는 Patty Seer(패티 시어), 떠돌이 요리사예요! 음식이라면 뭐든 배우려고 세계를 여행하고 있어요.

english: Your prized tin?
Yes, I use it for every cake I bake. It brings me luck.
translation: 네, 케이크를 구울 때마다 그 틀을 써요. 저한테 행운을 가져다주거든요.

english: What's happened to it?
I'm not sure how, but it's broken in two... Do you think you might be able to help me?
translation: 어쩌다 그랬는지는 모르겠는데, 두 동강이 나 버렸어요... 혹시 저 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?

english: I'm sure I can find someone to fix it!
translation: 고쳐 줄 사람을 분명 찾을 수 있을 거예요!

english: What about Bob?
Do you think he can fix it?
Yes, I'd imagine he can! Not to mention, he owes me one!
translation: 네, 아마 고칠 수 있을 거예요! 게다가 저한테 신세 진 것도 있고요!

english: Take this to him, it should cover the cost of the repair. You should be able to find him in his shop to the south.
translation: 이걸 그 사람한테 가져가세요. 수리비로 충분할 거예요. 남쪽에 있는 그 사람 가게에 가면 만날 수 있을 거예요.

english: I'm afraid I can't help you right now.
Oh... thank you for the offer but I'm not interested in that.
translation: 아... 제안은 고맙지만 그건 관심 없어요.

english: What's the Cake Off?
Who are you?
Your prized tin?
Yes
No
I don't think I can help you right now...
translation: 지금은 도와드릴 수 없을 것 같아요...

english: Is it over?
I can't hear anything? It might be?
Is someone in there?
N-n-n-no... go away...
Oh okay, fair enough.
Wait! Come back, we need your help.
Jack Frost locked us in here when he stormed into our bakery. We tried to stop him from messing up our production, but he got grumpy.
translation: Jack Frost(잭 프로스트)가 우리 빵집에 쳐들어와서 우리를 여기 가둬 버렸어요. 생산을 망치지 못하게 막으려 했더니 성질을 내더라고요.

english: I ran into one of your bakers outside, he said you were in trouble.
translation: 밖에서 제빵사 한 분을 만났는데, 두 분이 곤경에 처했다고 하더라고요.

english: Oh Remy is still alive! We thought Jack fed him to the Icelord.
translation: 오, Remy(레미)가 아직 살아 있군요! Jack(잭)이 Icelord(아이스로드)한테 먹이로 줘 버린 줄 알았어요.

english: Where's the key? The door looks locked to me.
translation: 열쇠는 어디 있어요? 문이 잠겨 있는 것 같은데요.

english: I thought you had it, Mary.
translation: 당신이 갖고 있는 줄 알았는데, Mary(메리).

english: Well I thought you had it, Paul.
translation: 나야말로 당신이 갖고 있는 줄 알았지, Paul(폴).

english: Don't you think I'd have opened the door if I had it?
translation: 내가 갖고 있었으면 벌써 문을 열지 않았겠어?

english: Don't you think I would have opened the door as well!
translation: 나도 갖고 있었으면 벌써 문을 열었겠지!

english: Great, now I'm locked in here with you for the rest of my life.
translation: 좋네, 이제 평생 당신이랑 여기 갇혀 살게 생겼어.

english: Woah calm down! If it's not in there, it must be out here. Let me look for it.
translation: 워워, 진정하세요! 안에 없으면 밖에 있겠죠. 제가 찾아볼게요.

english: RAAAAAAAAAAAWR
The Icelord sees you trying to enter their cage and blasts you backwards.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)가 우리에 들어가려는 당신을 보고 냉기를 내뿜어 뒤로 날려 버린다.

english: Ooooh that sounds like it hurt!
Are you okay dear? That sounded quite nasty.
Well, I found the key.
That's great, come on let us out then.
Yes hurry up, we need to get back on schedule.
translation: 네, 서둘러요. 일정을 다시 맞춰야 하거든요.

english: That's going to be a problem, it's in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 그게 문제예요. 열쇠가 Icelord(아이스로드)랑 같이 우리 안에 있어요.

english: I've got no way to get it with the Icelord there.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)가 저기 있으니 꺼낼 방법이 없어요.

english: Did you try telegrabbing it?
I'm stumped, I can't find the key.
You've looked around the bakery and no luck?
If it's not in here or in the back room, it must be in the cage with the Icelord.
translation: 여기에도 뒷방에도 없다면 Icelord(아이스로드)가 있는 우리 안에 있을 거예요.

english: It wouldn't be safe to go in there.
Could you try telegrabbing it?
translation: 텔레키네틱 그랩으로 가져와 볼 수 있겠어요?

english: That won't work, the Icelord's magic will interfere.
translation: 그건 안 될 거예요. Icelord(아이스로드)의 마법이 방해할 테니까요.

english: Hmm... You're going to need a way to protect yourself from the Icelord.
translation: 흠... Icelord(아이스로드)로부터 몸을 지킬 방법이 필요하겠네요.

english: Don't suppose you have an Anti-Icelord Shield lying around here then?
translation: 그럼 혹시 이 근처에 Anti-Icelord Shield(안티 아이스로드 방패) 같은 게 굴러다니진 않겠죠?

english: I don't, do you Paul?
No I don't...
But I do have a genius idea, we'll use Gingerbread!
translation: 하지만 기막힌 생각이 있어요. Gingerbread(진저브레드)를 쓰는 거예요!

english: Before Jack locked us up, I saw him using the Icelord to ice his Gingerbread Gnomes. They did a great job of absorbing his breath.
translation: Jack(잭)이 우리를 가두기 전에, Icelord(아이스로드)를 이용해서 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)에 아이싱을 입히는 걸 봤어요. 노움들이 그 녀석 입김을 아주 잘 흡수하더라고요.

english: You'll need to make a Gingerbread Gnome big enough to absorb the Icelord's breath.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)의 입김을 흡수할 만큼 커다란 Gingerbread Gnome(진저브레드 노움)을 만들어야 해요.

english: How am I going to do that?
Our usual recipe uses: one cinnamon, one ginger, one flour and one egg, we put them into that big machine you see to your left.
translation: 우리가 평소에 쓰는 요리법은 계피 하나, 생강 하나, 밀가루 하나, 달걀 하나예요. 그걸 왼쪽에 보이는 저 큰 기계에 넣죠.

english: Try using more of each ingredient till you get the right combination? Possibly tripling the amount of each ingredient might work.
translation: 맞는 조합이 나올 때까지 재료를 하나씩 늘려 보면 어때요? 재료를 각각 세 배로 넣으면 될지도 몰라요.

english: This is such a ridiculous idea, guess I have no choice....
translation: 정말 말도 안 되는 생각이지만, 별수 없겠네요....

english: Come back to us if you need some more help.
What ingredients did I need again?
You'll need ginger, cinnamon, flour and eggs. We usually only use one of each, maybe tripling the amount of each will work.
translation: 생강, 계피, 밀가루, 달걀이 필요해요. 평소엔 하나씩만 쓰는데, 각각 세 배로 넣으면 될지도 몰라요.

english: Great thanks, I'll see what I can do.
So I made the shield, now what?
Fantastic! Now you need to enter the Icelord's cage.
translation: 훌륭해요! 이제 Icelord(아이스로드)의 우리에 들어가야 해요.

english: Don't worry, I'm sure this idea will work, just make sure to equip it before you go in.
translation: 걱정 말아요, 이 생각은 분명 통할 거예요. 들어가기 전에 꼭 장착하기만 해요.

english: I found the key!
That's great! Now hurry up and open the door.
translation: 잘됐네요! 이제 어서 문을 열어 줘요.

english: You release the bakers and give back their key...
There you go, unlocked without an issue.
Wow, you managed to do that so quickly! Without any help from us.
translation: 와, 이렇게 빨리 해내다니! 우리 도움도 없이요.

english: You're very impressive, what a coincidence that you knew to make a giant piece of gingerbread to protect yourself.
translation: 정말 대단해요. 커다란 진저브레드로 몸을 지킬 생각을 다 하다니, 참 우연이네요.

english: Ha ha, yeah, it was no problem.
Well, thanks for freeing us!
I can't believe that actually worked....
...Me too, I thought you'd be turned into icing for sure.
translation: ...저도요. 당신이 틀림없이 아이싱이 될 줄 알았는데.

english: So you're telling me you weren't even sure it would!?
It worked out didn't it? We're free to continue making Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: 잘 풀렸잖아요? 이제 다시 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 만들 수 있게 됐고요.

english: That was extremely reckless, Paul, but you're right, it did work out in the end.
translation: 정말 무모했어, Paul(폴). 하지만 당신 말이 맞아. 결국 잘 풀렸으니까.

english: ...fine. I should go tell Santa the good news, the bakery is back in operation.
translation: ...알겠어요. Santa(산타)한테 빵집이 다시 돌아간다는 좋은 소식을 전하러 가야겠네요.

english: We'll be back in full production in no time!
translation: 금방 다시 정상 생산에 들어갈 거예요!

english: What do we do about the Icelord in the cage?
Maybe Jack was onto something by using it to ice the Gingerbread Gnomes.
translation: Jack(잭)이 그걸로 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)에 아이싱을 입힌 게 의외로 좋은 생각이었을지도 몰라.

english: You should take the giant piece of gingerbread you made and show it to Santa, he'll know we're back in business then.
translation: 만든 커다란 진저브레드를 Santa(산타)한테 가져가서 보여 주세요. 그러면 우리가 다시 일을 시작했다는 걸 알 거예요.

english: Alright, time for you to go, we need to get back into production.
translation: 자, 이제 가 줘요. 우린 다시 생산에 들어가야 하니까요.

english: Go away, we're busy trying to catch up.
