english: wooooo ooo woo-woo
Sneaky one! Don't touch these unless you have a Slayer task to kill them.
translation: 교활한 녀석! Slayer(슬레이어) 과제로 처치해야 하는 게 아니라면 건드리지 마세요.

english: Are you interested in buying or selling a helmet?
No, I'll pass on that.
Well, come back if you change your mind.
I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.
Now how could you know about that, I wonder? Mind you, I don't have it anymore.
translation: 그걸 어떻게 아셨을까요? 뭐, 이제는 저한테 없어요.

english: I gave it as a present to my brother Ivor when I visited our outpost northwest of Camelot.
translation: Camelot(카멜롯) 북서쪽에 있는 우리 전초기지에 갔을 때 동생 Ivor(아이버)한테 선물로 줬거든요.

english: Well, actually I hid it in his bed so it would nip him. It was a bit of a surprise gift.
translation: 음, 사실은 걔를 물라고 침대에 숨겨 둔 거였어요. 일종의 깜짝 선물이었죠.

english: I could be, yes.
No, I'll pass on that.
I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.
Hi there. How can I help you today?
What do you do here?
I'm just a fur trader. I come across from the city most days.
translation: 그냥 모피 상인이에요. 거의 매일 도시에서 건너오죠.

english: Are you a hunter too?
Oh no, that life isn't for me. I'm just a tailor.
translation: 아뇨, 그런 삶은 저랑 안 맞아요. 저는 그냥 재단사예요.

english: What's brought you out here anyway?
I'm just exploring.
Oh, enjoy yourself then!
I'm here to work with the guild.
That's exciting! I expect I'll be turning some furs into clothes for you soon then?
translation: 신나는 일이네요! 그럼 머지않아 제가 모피로 옷을 지어 드리게 되겠네요?

english: That depends on how much I manage to catch.
Do you sell anything?
Why yes I do. Here's what I have available.
translation: 그럼요, 있죠. 지금 있는 건 이거예요.

english: Can you do much with animal furs?
translation: 동물 모피로 많은 걸 만들 수 있나요?

english: Of course! Why don't you take a look?
Can you make some armour for me?
translation: 갑옷 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can you make some armour for me?
translation: 갑옷 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: A mixed hide top.
translation: mixed hide top(혼합 가죽 상의) 하나요.

english: Here you go. Enjoy it.
You don't have the required items for me to make a mixed hide top for you. You need 20,000 coins and two sunlight antelope fur.
translation: mixed hide top(혼합 가죽 상의)를 만들어 드릴 재료가 없으시네요. 20,000코인과 sunlight antelope fur(햇빛 영양 털가죽) 2개가 필요해요.

english: Some mixed hide legs.
You don't have the required items for me to make some mixed hide legs for you. You need 20,000 coins and three fox fur.
translation: mixed hide legs(혼합 가죽 하의)를 만들어 드릴 재료가 없으시네요. 20,000코인과 fox fur(여우 털가죽) 3개가 필요해요.

english: Some mixed hide boots.
You don't have the required items for me to make some mixed hide boots for you. You need 17,500 coins and one sunlight antelope fur
translation: mixed hide boots(혼합 가죽 장화)를 만들어 드릴 재료가 없으시네요. 17,500코인과 sunlight antelope fur(햇빛 영양 털가죽) 1개가 필요해요

english: A mixed hide cape.
translation: mixed hide cape(혼합 가죽 망토) 하나요.

english: You don't have the required items for me to make a mixed hide cape for you. You need 20,000 coins and one jaguar fur.
translation: mixed hide cape(혼합 가죽 망토)를 만들어 드릴 재료가 없으시네요. 20,000코인과 jaguar fur(재규어 털가죽) 1개가 필요해요.

english: Nothing.
Fair enough.
Never mind.
What do you do here?
I'm just exploring.
I'm here to work with the guild.
Do you sell anything?
Can you do much with animal furs?
translation: 동물 모피로 많은 걸 만들 수 있나요?

english: A mixed hide top.
translation: mixed hide top(혼합 가죽 상의) 하나요.

english: Some mixed hide legs.
Some mixed hide boots.
A mixed hide cape.
translation: mixed hide cape(혼합 가죽 망토) 하나요.

english: Nothing.
Never mind.
Of all the high gamble rewards I could have won, I won you...
translation: 고위험 도박 보상으로 받을 수 있는 그 많은 것 중에, 하필 너라니...

english: Keep trying, human. You'll never win that Dragon Chainbody.
translation: 계속 해 봐라, 인간. 넌 절대 Dragon Chainbody(드래곤 사슬 갑옷)을 못 얻을 거다.

english: Of all the lucky dip rewards I could have won, I won you...
translation: 행운의 뽑기 보상으로 받을 수 있는 그 많은 것 중에, 하필 너라니...

english: Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Chomp, chomp.
Blughhhh.
Urghhh!
Raaa!
Hi!
Let me at 'em!
Trolls? Schmolls!
The trolls are coming!
The trolls took my baby son!
Welcome to Burthorpe!
Thanks!
Trolls!
Hello stranger.
Go away!
Run!
Hi!
The Imperial Guard can no longer protect us!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)는 더 이상 우리를 지켜 줄 수 없어요!

english: The White Knights will soon have control!
translation: 곧 White Knights(백기사단)이 이곳을 장악할 거예요!

english: I heard about what you did, thank you!
The White Knights are still going to take over.
translation: 그래도 결국 White Knights(백기사단)이 장악할 거예요.

english: I hear the Imperial Guard are preparing an attack!
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 공격을 준비하고 있대요!

english: Thank you so much!
Surely we are safe now!
Have you come to torture me again?
What?
Oh, you may look human, but I know you're not. I've heard stories.
translation: 오, 겉모습은 사람 같지만 아니란 걸 알아요. 이야기를 들었거든요.

english: How you Mahjarrat can take on any form, and use magic to inflict pain without any weapons.
translation: 당신네 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)은 어떤 모습으로든 변할 수 있고, 무기 없이도 마법으로 고통을 줄 수 있다고요.

english: I, er... what?
I have no idea what you're talking about, but I'm just as human as you are.
translation: 무슨 말씀인지 전혀 모르겠지만, 저도 당신이랑 똑같은 사람이에요.

english: You'll never get what you want from me. I'm a soldier of Avarrocka, and will stand strong!
translation: 원하는 건 절대 얻지 못할 거예요. 나는 Avarrocka(아바로카)의 병사이니, 굳건히 버틸 겁니다!

english: Look, I'm not going to hurt you!
Besides, I am already wounded, and have been so for many years, thanks to this spell you cast on me. And hungry. So very, very hungry.
translation: 게다가 난 이미 다쳤어요. 당신이 내게 건 이 주문 탓에 몇 년째 이 상태죠. 그리고 배도 고파요. 너무, 너무 배가 고파요.

english: I've got some food you can have. It's quite tasty.
translation: 드실 만한 음식이 좀 있어요. 꽤 맛있어요.

english: Here, try this. It should fill you up.
translation: 자, 이거 드셔 보세요. 배가 든든해질 거예요.

english: Have some of this food. It's really good, I promise!
translation: 이 음식 좀 드세요. 정말 맛있어요, 진짜예요!

english: My daughter was learning to cook this when I left.
translation: 내가 떠날 때 우리 딸이 이 요리를 배우고 있었는데.

english: I haven't remembered her in so long... thank you for reminding me of her.
translation: 그 아이를 떠올린 지 너무 오래됐군요... 그 아이를 생각나게 해 줘서 고마워요.

english: A cake? There's nothing to celebrate, is there?
translation: 케이크라고요? 축하할 일도 없잖아요, 안 그래요?

english: So many years gone by. My children must have grown up and left home.
translation: 그 많은 세월이 흘렀군요. 우리 아이들도 이제 다 자라서 집을 떠났겠죠.

english: I haven't remembered them in so long... thank you for reminding me of them.
translation: 그 아이들을 떠올린 지 너무 오래됐군요... 아이들을 생각나게 해 줘서 고마워요.

english: Are you feeling better now?
Yes, thank you.
The food you gave me healed my wounds, and it also reminded me of my family; that helped me to remember who I was.
translation: 당신이 준 음식이 내 상처를 낫게 해 줬고, 가족도 떠올리게 해 줬어요. 덕분에 내가 누구였는지 기억해 낼 수 있었죠.

english: I'm afraid that I'm trapped here, but I still remember something of this floor of the temple.
translation: 안타깝게도 나는 여기 갇혀 있지만, 신전의 이 층에 대해서는 아직 조금 기억나요.

english: If you need any hints about the rooms nearby, I can give you some help.
translation: 근처 방들에 대한 힌트가 필요하면 조금 도와줄 수 있어요.

english: When we came to the temple, that fountain was frosted with ice.
translation: 우리가 신전에 왔을 때, 저 분수는 얼음으로 얼어붙어 있었어요.

english: Even chipping at it with swords or lighting fires under it didn't do anything.
translation: 검으로 깨 보거나 밑에 불을 지펴 봐도 아무 소용이 없었죠.

english: My guess is that some sort of magic is keeping it that way.
translation: 내 생각엔 무슨 마법 같은 게 그 상태로 묶어 두고 있는 것 같아요.

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
translation: 용광로가 있는 방에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: I tried to go in there, but the smoke was so thick I could barely see the furnace.
translation: 거기 들어가 보려 했는데, 연기가 너무 짙어서 용광로가 거의 안 보이더군요.

english: It may be that it's blocked, in which case you'll have to clear it out.
translation: 막혀 있는 건지도 몰라요. 그렇다면 뚫어 줘야 할 거예요.

english: A good breeze should do the trick.
translation: 바람이 시원하게 한 번 불면 해결될 거예요.

english: Tell me about the dark room.
I never went in there myself, but I peered through the door.
translation: 직접 들어가 본 적은 없지만, 문틈으로 들여다본 적은 있어요.

english: There seemed to be fires of some sort all around the room, but they were burning low.
translation: 방 곳곳에 불 같은 게 있었는데, 다들 약하게 타고 있었어요.

english: I'd imagine they've gone out by now.
It's okay, I don't need any help.
Tell me about the room with the fountain.
translation: 분수가 있는 방에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
translation: 용광로가 있는 방에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about the dark room.
It's okay, I don't need any help.
Are you hunting animals, then?
I'm exploring the region for the good of the gnome people.
translation: gnome(노움) 종족을 위해 이 지역을 탐사하고 있어요.

english: You're not tracking down huge beasts to kill - you look equipped for it.
translation: 거대한 짐승을 쫓아다니며 잡는 건 아니시고요? 장비는 그럴 것처럼 보이는데요.

english: Well, if I find anything interesting I'll try and bring it back to the King. That might include animals, I suppose. I'd rather not kill it, though - most animals are more useful alive.
translation: 음, 흥미로운 걸 찾으면 왕께 가져가 보려고요. 동물도 포함될 수 있겠죠. 그래도 죽이고 싶진 않아요. 동물은 대부분 살아 있을 때 더 쓸모가 있거든요.

english: How would you get it home, then?
Never underestimate the ingenuity of a gnome, friend.
translation: 노움의 재주를 절대 얕보지 마세요, 친구.

english: Have you found anything else interesting around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 다른 흥미로운 건 찾으셨어요?

english: I've heard strange rumours about something the locals call the Broodoo. I haven't quite worked out what they are but they seem to be some sort of undead whose ghastly fate depends on the way they were killed.
translation: 이곳 주민들이 Broodoo(브루두)라고 부르는 것에 대한 이상한 소문을 들었어요. 정체는 아직 잘 모르겠지만, 일종의 언데드인데 어떻게 죽었느냐에 따라 끔찍한 운명이 달라지는 것 같아요.

english: I think they may be sacrifice victims - but I'm not sure why they are sacrificed. Either way the locals seem to be very scared of them.
translation: 제물로 바쳐진 희생자들일지도 몰라요. 왜 제물로 바쳐지는지는 모르겠지만요. 어쨌든 주민들은 그들을 무척 두려워하는 것 같아요.

english: That's interesting. Thanks.
What does this mint cake do?
translation: 이 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 무슨 효과가 있어요?

english: Gnomish mint cake is a great source of energy for the gnome traveller. It will give you that extra bit of zip when you are running out of steam.
translation: 노움식 박하 케이크는 노움 여행자에게 훌륭한 에너지원이에요. 기운이 바닥날 때 힘을 조금 더 불어넣어 주죠.

english: Ooh, that might come in very handy. Do you have any spare?
translation: 오, 그거 아주 쓸모 있겠네요. 남는 거 있어요?

english: I need all the mint cake I have, I'm afraid.
translation: 미안하지만 가진 박하 케이크는 전부 필요해요.

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 이 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)는 무슨 효과가 있어요?

english: Ah, the seed pod of the Grand Tree is a fascinating spirit artefact. It is a very useful thing, though one must treat it with respect, since the Grand Tree has a connection with all of its parts, however distant they
translation: 아, Grand Tree(그랜드 트리)의 씨앗 꼬투리는 흥미로운 영적 유물이에요. 아주 쓸모 있는 물건이지만, 존중하며 다뤄야 해요. 그랜드 트리는 아무리 멀리 떨어져 있어도

english: may be. How do you think the Spirit Trees work?
translation: 자신의 모든 부분과 이어져 있거든요. Spirit Trees(정령 나무)가 어떻게 작동한다고 생각하세요?

english: If you launch its seeds in a far flung location, you will be helping the tree survive, so the grand tree will help a gnome glider pilot find you, using the seed burst itself (which marks the sky) and a little magic, and bring you
translation: 먼 곳에서 그 씨앗을 쏘아 올리면 나무가 살아남도록 돕는 셈이라, 그랜드 트리가 씨앗 폭발(하늘에 표시를 남기죠)와 약간의 마법으로 gnome glider(노움 글라이더) 조종사가 당신을 찾게 도와주고, 감사의 표시로 당신을

english: back home as an act of gratitude. Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: 집까지 데려다줘요. 새내기 농부라면 식물과의 유대도 전보다 조금 더 좋아질 거예요.

english: However, it takes time for a pilot to find you, and if you are in a real hurry, and I mean a real emergency, you can just squash the seed pod. The Grand Tree doesn't like this, but will pull you back
translation: 하지만 조종사가 당신을 찾는 데는 시간이 걸려요. 정말 급할 때, 그러니까 진짜 비상시라면 씨앗 꼬투리를 그냥 으깨도 돼요. 그랜드 트리는 이걸 싫어하지만, 당신을

english: home straight away. Don't do this if you need to do anything with plants straight away, though - your fingers will be considerably less green for a while after using the seed pod this way, and the journey is not
translation: 곧바로 집으로 끌어와 줄 거예요. 다만 바로 식물을 다룰 일이 있다면 이렇게 하지 마세요. 씨앗 꼬투리를 이렇게 쓰고 나면 한동안 식물 다루는 솜씨가 꽤 무뎌지고, 이동도

english: very pleasant...
Wow, that's very interesting. Thanks.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오시진 않은 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어 둔 요리로는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Penwie.
translation: Penwie(펜위)에게 배달할 [a/some] [ordered gnome food item]을(를) 건넵니다.

english: At last a taste of home!
Now that I have some proper food, I won't need this any more.
translation: 이제 제대로 된 음식이 생겼으니 이건 더 필요 없겠어요.

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful in emergencies!
translation: 자, 이 Grand Seed pods(그랜드 씨앗 꼬투리)를 받으세요. 비상시에 아주 쓸모 있어요!

english: I traded with some of the locals for this - maybe you'll find it useful.
translation: 이 지역 주민들과 거래해서 얻은 건데, 쓸모가 있을지도 몰라요.

english: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.
translation: 이걸 가져다주느라 먼 길을 오셨겠네요. 팁으로 조금 더 드릴게요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number] 크레딧을 모으셨어요. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있어요.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 꼭 받아 가세요.

english: Are you hunting animals then?
What does this mint cake do?
translation: 이 mint cake(박하 케이크)는 무슨 효과가 있어요?

english: What does this seed pod do?
translation: 이 seed pod(씨앗 꼬투리)는 무슨 효과가 있어요?

english: It seems you're missing out on some valuable experience. Would you like it?
translation: 놓치고 있는 귀한 경험치가 좀 있는 것 같네요. 받아 가시겠어요?

english: You are owed the following: [list of experience the player can claim]
translation: 받으실 경험치는 다음과 같아요: [list of experience the player can claim]

english: Yes please.
There you go.
No thanks.
Fair enough.
Hello. I've found some stuff that I think is yours. You can pay me with cash you're carrying, or I can take payments from your bank. Would you like to buy anything from me?
translation: 안녕하세요. 당신 것 같은 물건을 좀 찾아 뒀어요. 가지고 계신 현금으로 내셔도 되고, 은행에서 결제하셔도 돼요. 뭐 사 가실래요?

english: Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: 잃어버린 물건을 돌려주는데 왜 돈을 받아요?

english: You could get your stuff back elsewhere, sure. Now, maybe it'd be free, or maybe you'd have to pay someone, but you'd definitely have to go on a journey to get it back.
translation: 물론 다른 데서 물건을 되찾을 수도 있죠. 공짜일 수도 있고, 누군가한테 돈을 내야 할 수도 있지만, 되찾으러 먼 길을 가야 하는 건 확실해요.

english: So I'm earning my fee by saving you a trip. Do you want to have a look?
translation: 그러니까 그 수고를 덜어 드리는 값으로 수수료를 받는 거예요. 한번 보실래요?

english: Show me what you've found.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 제가 다른 사람한테 죽었을 때 부서지는 아이템 말인데요...

english: Oh yes, some items do break specially when you're killed by your rivals. And if you die in the deep Wilderness, they vanish altogether.
translation: 아, 네. 적수한테 죽으면 특별히 부서지는 아이템이 있죠. 그리고 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽으면 아예 사라져 버리고요.

english: Can you fix them?
For a fee, yes. Just show me the broken item.
translation: 수수료만 내시면요. 부서진 아이템을 보여 주세요.

english: Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: 황야 깊은 곳에서 사라지지 않게 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: I can lock them to you so they won't vanish on death in deep Wilderness, yes. I'll want some money for my services, though, and you'll need to bring me a Trouver Parchment.
translation: 네, 아이템을 당신에게 귀속시켜서 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽어도 사라지지 않게 할 수 있어요. 대신 수고비를 좀 받아야 하고, Trouver Parchment(트루버 양피지)도 가져오셔야 해요.

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item you want to lock.
translation: 양피지를 파는 사람은 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)에 있어요. Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩)이라는 게임을 하는 곳이죠. 양피지를 여기로 가져온 다음, 보호하고 싶은 아이템을 보여 주세요.

english: I've got the parchment.
Not bad for a human! Okay, show me the item you want to protect, and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 인간치고는 제법인데요! 좋아요, 보호하고 싶은 아이템을 보여 주시면 어떻게 해 볼게요.

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness, but I'll need a Trouver parchment.
translation: 이 아이템을 귀속시켜서 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽어도 사라지지 않게 할 수 있지만, Trouver parchment(트루버 양피지)가 필요해요.

english: You'll find her in Ferox Enclave, where people play a game called Last Man Standing. Bring the parchment here, then show me the item again.
translation: 양피지를 파는 사람은 Ferox Enclave(페록스 거주지)에 있어요. Last Man Standing(라스트 맨 스탠딩)이라는 게임을 하는 곳이죠. 양피지를 여기로 가져온 다음, 그 아이템을 다시 보여 주세요.

english: I can lock that item so that it won't vanish if you die in deep Wilderness. It'll cost you 500,000 coins and a Trouver parchment.
translation: 이 아이템을 귀속시켜서 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽어도 사라지지 않게 할 수 있어요. 500,000코인과 Trouver parchment(트루버 양피지)가 들어요.

english: I've locked that item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness. I can unlock it again, returning your parchment and 475,000 coins.
translation: 이 아이템을 당신에게 귀속시켜서 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽어도 사라지지 않게 해 뒀어요. 귀속을 다시 풀면 양피지와 475,000코인을 돌려드려요.

english: If you want me to lock an item to you so that it won't vanish if you're killed in deep Wilderness, show me the item.
translation: 아이템을 귀속시켜서 Wilderness(황야) 깊은 곳에서 죽어도 사라지지 않게 하고 싶으시면 그 아이템을 보여 주세요.

english: I have something for you. You lost your Echo boots. Would you like it back?
translation: 드릴 게 있어요. Echo boots(에코 장화)를 잃어버리셨더라고요. 돌려받으시겠어요?

english: Ah! I have something for you. You lost your banner. Would you like it back?
translation: 아! 드릴 게 있어요. 깃발을 잃어버리셨더라고요. 돌려받으시겠어요?

english: You seem lost, but luckily I know where to send you. A breach is occurring[location 1] (single). Another breach is occuring[location 2] (multi).
translation: 길을 잃으신 것 같은데, 다행히 어디로 보내 드릴지 알고 있어요. [location 1]에서 균열이 일어나고 있어요(싱글). [location 2]에서도 균열이 일어나고 있어요(멀티).

english: You have[time left]remaining. Otherwise...
Yes please.
No thanks.
Why do you charge for returning lost items?
translation: 잃어버린 물건을 돌려주는데 왜 돈을 받아요?

english: Show me what you've found.
About items that break when people kill me...
translation: 제가 다른 사람한테 죽었을 때 부서지는 아이템 말인데요...

english: Can you fix them?
Can you stop them vanishing in deep Wilderness?
translation: 황야 깊은 곳에서 사라지지 않게 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Lock item ([used item])
Cancel
Yes
No
Ooh, lovely view, dear.
Yes dear.
I hope the food's better here than it was last time.
translation: 지난번보다는 여기 음식이 좀 낫길 바라요.

english: I'm sure it will be, dear.
Sorry to disturb you, but what are you two doing here?
translation: 방해해서 죄송한데, 두 분은 여기서 뭐 하세요?

english: Perrdur and I are having a nice romantic dinner, aren't we dear?
translation: Perrdur(페르두르)랑 저는 근사하고 로맨틱한 저녁을 먹는 중이에요, 그렇죠, 여보?

english: We are celebrating the anniversary of our marriage, aren't we dear?
translation: 우리 결혼기념일을 축하하는 중이거든요, 그렇죠, 여보?

english: And we are having a very enjoyable time, aren't we dear?
translation: 그리고 아주 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있죠, 그렇죠, 여보?

english: Clearly. I'll let you two lovebirds carry on, then.
translation: 그래 보이네요. 그럼 잉꼬부부 두 분은 계속 즐기세요.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같습니다! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요합니다!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 안타깝지만 이미 만들어진 음식은 안 됩니다. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만 내놓을 수 있습니다.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Perrdur
translation: Perrdur(페르두르)에게 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 배달품을 건넸다.

english: Thank you dear, This looks as if it might be edible for a change!
translation: 고맙네, 젊은이. 이번만큼은 먹을 만해 보이는구먼!

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 크레딧이 [number]점 모였습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 받는 걸 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었습니다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받으세요. 배달 상자는 더 필요 없으니 버립니다.

english: Hey, adventurer. Do you want to buy any axes?
translation: 어이, 모험가 양반. 도끼 좀 사 갈래요?

english: Who are you?
I'm Perry, and I sell axes here. Or sometimes I buy them, if someone's offering a good deal. Anyway, do you want to trade?
translation: 난 Perry(페리)고, 여기서 도끼를 팔아요. 가끔 괜찮은 조건이면 사들이기도 하고요. 아무튼, 거래할래요?

english: Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Who are you?
Okay, let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
A cutscene shows the player being caught
And we'll move this little penguin here...and KABLOOM! Heee hee.
translation: 이 꼬마 펭귄을 여기로 옮기면... 콰광! 히히히.

english: It appears we have a visitor!
Haa haa! I am glad we installed that ant-magic security. What have we here?
translation: 하하! 마법 방지 보안 장치를 설치해 두길 잘했어. 어디 보자, 이게 뭐지?

english: What an ingenious little device. This will solve all our problems. Scientists! Come examine this; we have much work to do.
translation: 참으로 기발한 작은 장치로군. 이거면 우리 문제가 전부 해결되겠어. 과학자들! 와서 이걸 조사해라. 할 일이 산더미다.

english: What about me?
Hmm, take that human to the Ice Lords. They'll enjoy the exercise.
translation: 흠, 저 인간은 Ice Lord(아이스 로드)들에게 데려가라. 녀석들한테 좋은 운동이 되겠지.

english: You are caught.
End of cutscene
Got any sigils for me?
The Core shakes its head.
Damnit Core-al!
Let's bounce!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
I'm hungry!
How hungry?
I'm empty to the core!
Would an apple do?
What is apple?
Something where you eat the outside and throw the core away!
translation: 겉은 먹고 가운데 핵, 아니 심은 버리는 거야!

english: Blargle!
Flarg!
Rawrrr!
Who's a good rock then? Yes you are... You're such a good rock... ooga booga googa.
translation: 누가 착한 돌이게? 그래, 너지... 넌 정말 착한 돌이야... 우쭈쭈 까꿍 우르르.

english: Your rock seems a little happier.
Your pet rock ignores you. You are an exile of the Fremennik Province.
translation: 애완 돌이 당신을 무시한다. 당신은 Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)에서 추방된 몸이다.

english: Not you too!
Your pet rock continues to ignore you.
Aw...
Hey little snake!
Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this plane.
Wanna play fetch?
Submit to the almighty Zulrah.
Walkies? Or slidies...?
Zulrah's wilderness as a God will soon be demonstrated.
I give up...
*slither*
Hisssss!
Specs!
Sssssssss!
What can I do around here?
There's a list pinned up on the camp notice board, near the toilet. Have a look there for useful things you could do. I've got some rewards if you do them all!
translation: 야영지 게시판에 목록이 붙어 있어요. 화장실 근처에요. 거기서 할 만한 유용한 일들을 확인해 보세요. 전부 해내면 보상도 드릴게요!

english: I see. Thank you.
I see you've finished building the camp for us.
All in a day's work!
Thank you so much for your help! Here, take these fossils. I found them while panning! They're everywhere on this island... A quick clean up by the benches you built should help identify them.
translation: 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요! 자, 이 화석들 받으세요. 사금을 채취하다가 찾은 거예요! 이 섬에는 화석이 사방에 널려 있거든요... 직접 만드신 작업대에서 살짝 손질하면 뭔지 알아내는 데 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Thanks!
Can I talk to you for a moment about the fossils I find on this island?
translation: 이 섬에서 찾는 화석에 대해 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: Sure, would you like to talk about? Normal or rare fossils?
translation: 물론이죠, 무슨 얘기를 하고 싶으세요? 일반 화석이요, 희귀 화석이요?

english: Let's talk about rare fossils, if that's okay.
translation: 괜찮으시면 희귀 화석 얘기를 하고 싶어요.

english: Oh definitely! Did you find a new type of fossil?!
Not quite... I'd like you to stop rare fossils showing up on the island.
translation: 그건 아니고요... 섬에서 희귀 화석이 나오지 않게 해 주셨으면 해요.

english: Oh..., I can do that for you, if you really want me to.
translation: 아..., 정말 원하신다면 그렇게 해 드릴 수는 있어요.

english: Yes I'm sure.
So be it, I'll spread the word, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요. 소문을 내 둘게요. 이제 희귀 화석이 나오지 않을 거예요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Actually, I've changed my mind, I'll keep collecting them.
Oh wonderful! Rare fossils are so hard to find, I'd hate for you to miss out on one.
translation: 아, 잘됐네요! 희귀 화석은 정말 찾기 어려우니까, 하나라도 놓치시면 너무 아쉬울 거예요.

english: So you've changed your mind then? I knew you would, who can resists the hidden knowledge found in rare fossils?
translation: 그러니까 마음이 바뀌신 거죠? 그럴 줄 알았어요. 희귀 화석에 숨겨진 지식을 누가 거부할 수 있겠어요?

english: Yes I know, can you just do it for me.
translation: 네, 알아요. 그냥 그렇게 해 주시면 안 될까요.

english: If that's what you really want.
Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see rare fossils drop again.
translation: 물론 그러시겠죠! 소문을 내 둘게요. 다시 희귀 화석이 나오기 시작할 거예요.

english: Eh, nevermind.
Fine, just let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요. 진짜로 마음이 바뀌면 알려 주세요.

english: Let's talk about normal fossils, if that's okay.
translation: 괜찮으시면 일반 화석 얘기를 하고 싶어요.

english: Of course, I'm always up for an exciting discussion about fossils.
translation: 물론이죠, 화석에 관한 신나는 대화라면 언제든 환영이에요.

english: Is it possible that you could stop normal fossils being given to me on the island.
translation: 섬에서 제가 일반 화석을 받지 않게 해 주실 수 있을까요.

english: ... Why would you want that?
I've found every fossil I want and well, I'm just not interested in them anymore.
translation: 원하는 화석은 다 찾았고, 음, 이제 별로 관심이 없어서요.

english: Oh... I guess can see what I can do, Only if you're sure of course.
translation: 아... 어떻게 해 볼 수는 있을 것 같아요. 확실하시다면요.

english: Fine... I'll spread the word, you won't see fossils dropped on the island anymore... Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요... 소문을 내 둘게요. 이제 섬에서 화석이 나오지 않을 거예요... 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Really?! That's fantastic! Fossils are so much fun, you'd be missing out!
translation: 정말요?! 너무 잘됐어요! 화석이 얼마나 재밌는데요, 놓치시면 아까웠을 거예요!

english: Oh yes... I remember, you asked me to stop fossils dropping for you on the island.
translation: 아, 맞다... 기억나요. 섬에서 화석이 나오지 않게 해 달라고 하셨죠.

english: Yes, well, I need you to let them drop again.
translation: 네, 그런데 다시 나오게 해 주셨으면 해요.

english: Really? Are you sure?
Of course you are! I'll get the word out and you'll start to see fossils drop again.
translation: 물론 그러시겠죠! 소문을 내 둘게요. 다시 화석이 나오기 시작할 거예요.

english: Okay... let me know if you actually change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요... 진짜로 마음이 바뀌면 알려 주세요.

english: That has been done, rare fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 처리됐어요. 이제 희귀 화석이 나오지 않을 거예요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Excellent, you'll start to see rare fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: 좋아요, 섬에서 다시 희귀 화석이 나오기 시작할 거예요.

english: Fine, regular fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind
translation: 알겠어요. 이제 일반 화석이 나오지 않을 거예요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요

english: Great! You'll start to see fossils showing up on the island again.
translation: 좋아요! 섬에서 다시 화석이 나오기 시작할 거예요.

english: Talk about the island camp.
Talk about fossils.
Let's talk about rare ones.
Yes I'm sure.
Actually, I've changed my mind.
Nevermind
Let's talk about normal ones.
Rare.
Normal.
Oh thank goodness you released me...how long have I been stuck in that gloomy wall?
translation: 아, 풀어 줘서 정말 고마워요... 제가 그 음침한 벽에 얼마나 오래 갇혀 있었던 거죠?

english: Oh, not so long...I don't think...
I mean...that is... I'm not so sure...at all...in fact.
translation: 그러니까... 그게... 잘 모르겠네요... 전혀... 사실은요.

english: Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!
translation: 뭐, 어쨌든 전 무사하네요... 당신 덕분에요! 그 Cromperty(크롬퍼티) 미치광이 일에 끼는 건 이번이 마지막이에요... 사실 그 남자한테 할 말이 좀 있거든요!

english: Well actually, I think that some of the people at the Seers Village are worried about you. That's how I came to find you here, Phantuwti sent me.
translation: 사실, Seers Village(시어스 마을)에 있는 사람들이 걱정하고 있는 것 같아요. 그래서 여기서 당신을 찾게 된 거예요. Phantuwti(판투티)가 저를 보냈거든요.

english: Oh, right, yes, well I guess I'd better go back there and let them all know that I'm safe then..Ok, thanks...I'll be off now and once again thanks for your help.
translation: 아, 그렇군요, 네, 그럼 돌아가서 모두에게 무사하다고 알려야겠네요.. 좋아요, 고마워요... 이제 가 볼게요. 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: No problem...I'll probably see you back at the Seers Village.
translation: 별말씀을요... 아마 시어스 마을에서 또 뵙겠네요.

english: Hi there Pete.
Argh! Who be there?
Oh, it's just the adventurer, phew! Things can be scary around here, I've seen some weeeeeiiiird stuff in that cavern.
translation: 아, 그 모험가잖아, 휴! 여긴 무서운 일이 많거든. 저 동굴에서 별의별 이이이이상한 걸 다 봤다니까.

english: What is in the cavern?
Oh no, now I'm thinking about it again!*screams*
translation: 안 돼, 또 그 생각이 나잖아!*비명*

english: Okay okay, calm down! Why are you guarding it? What is the purpose of this cavern?
translation: 알았어요, 알았어요, 진정하세요! 왜 거길 지키고 있는 거예요? 이 동굴은 뭐 하는 곳이에요?

english: It's a mine. It's special but dangerous, things move around and the mine could collapse at any moment!.
translation: 광산이야. 특별하긴 한데 위험해. 안에서 이것저것 움직이고, 광산이 언제 무너질지 몰라!.

english: I'd say you'll need at least level 50 Mining to be capable.
translation: 적어도 Mining(채광) 레벨 50은 돼야 감당할 수 있을 거야.

english: I'm not quite up to scratch then...
Well sounds like I am capable then!
The main idea is to chip down the big boulders, in order to find the fragments inside. Deliver them to me and I'll show you some minin' tips to help you get better at it.
translation: 요점은 큰 바위들을 깎아 내서 안에 든 파편을 찾는 거야. 그걸 나한테 가져오면 채광 실력이 늘도록 요령 좀 알려 줄게.

english: How do I traverse the mine? Isn't it full of lava?
I have a handy supply of heat-proof water containers. I'll give them out to anyone going in with bit of water inside. They only hold so much though.
translation: 내가 내열 물통을 넉넉히 갖고 있거든. 들어가는 사람한테는 물을 조금 담아서 나눠 줘. 다만 담을 수 있는 양이 정해져 있어.

english: I reckon you could harden the lava with it! Just throw a bit of water on it. Make yourself a path, but be careful, they won't last forever.
translation: 그 물로 용암을 굳힐 수 있을 거야! 용암에 물을 조금 뿌리기만 하면 돼. 그렇게 길을 만들되, 조심해. 오래가진 않으니까.

english: Anything else?
Uh oh, there is one more thing, but it hurts. My backside has never felt the same since, one of the reasons I don't dare go in there anymore. There are some gas holes around, just feel 'em.
translation: 어어, 하나 더 있긴 한데, 이건 아파. 그 뒤로 내 엉덩이가 영 예전 같지가 않아. 내가 더는 거기 못 들어가는 이유 중 하나지. 여기저기 가스 구멍이 있으니까, 뭐, 몸으로 느껴 보면 알 거야.

english: How do I keep the mine stable?
Don't let it collapse!! It's petrifying, it will stick with you forever. The rumbles create a flashback in my mind, arghhh.
translation: 절대 무너지게 하지 마!! 간이 돌처럼 굳어 버린다니까. 평생 잊히지 않을 거야. 우르릉거리는 소리만 들어도 그때 기억이 떠올라, 으아아.

english: There are some vents and chambers in there. Do better than I did with them, you want around a 50% gas level in each chamber.
translation: 안에 환기구랑 방이 몇 개 있어. 나보다는 잘 다뤄 봐. 방마다 가스 수치를 50% 정도로 맞춰야 해.

english: There are 3 in total, we spent awhile coming up with names, such as 'Vent west of the pillar near the entrance on the left hand side', but decided A, B and C would be easier.
translation: 전부 3개야. 이름 짓느라 한참 걸렸지. '입구 근처 왼편 기둥 서쪽 환기구' 같은 거 말이야. 근데 그냥 A, B, C가 편하겠더라고.

english: Presumably, a western chamber, central chamber and eastern chamber?
translation: 그럼 서쪽 방, 가운데 방, 동쪽 방인가요?

english: Yep! That's right. Block the chamber to let gas build up, unblock 'em to let gas out. Any creatures in there will cause instability too.
translation: 맞아! 바로 그거야. 방을 막으면 가스가 차고, 열면 가스가 빠져. 안에 있는 생물들도 광산을 불안정하게 만들어.

english: Oh, also, if you have more than one rock to mine, keep them going at roughly the same pace too. Everything gets a bit wobbly if you proceed too quickly down one channel.
translation: 아, 그리고 캘 바위가 여러 개면 거의 같은 속도로 캐 나가. 한쪽만 너무 빨리 파 들어가면 전부 좀 흔들거리거든.

english: Explain the dangers for me.
It is bad, very bad in there. If you're not prepared, you will be done for. Wouldn't catch me in there.
translation: 안은 위험해, 엄청 위험해. 준비 안 하면 끝장이야. 나라면 절대 안 들어가.

english: Okay, so how do I prepare?
Look out for the Lava beasts, they'll throw projectiles at anyone they see. You'll have stalacmitesfalling on you, fire jumping out the lava towards you. Seriously, you're insane.
translation: Lava beast(용암 야수)를 조심해. 눈에 띄는 사람마다 뭘 던져 대거든. 머리 위로 종유석이 떨어지고, 용암에서 불이 튀어나와 덮쳐 오지. 진짜, 너 제정신 아니다.

english: Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
Can I go inside?
There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable.
translation: 저 아래엔 미친 것들이 있어. 네가 감당할 수 있을 것 같지 않아.

english: You need at least 50 Mining to enter the Volcanic Mine.
translation: Volcanic Mine(화산 광산)에 들어가려면 Mining(채광)이 적어도 50은 돼야 해.

english: Well luckily for you, or rather, unlucky for you, I'll let you go inside as you've definitely got the mining skills.
translation: 음, 너한테는 다행이랄까, 아니 불행이랄까, 채광 실력은 확실히 있어 보이니 들여보내 줄게.

english: I'll have to charge you though - upkeep of this place ain't cheap and cheerful. I'll need 30 Numulites for one visit or 3,000 for unlimited trips.
translation: 그래도 돈은 받아야 해. 여기 관리하는 게 싸지도 만만하지도 않거든. 한 번 들어가는 데 Numulite(누뮬라이트) 30개, 무제한은 3,000개야.

english: I don't have 30 Numulites with me unfortunately.
Thanks [player name]. That will grant you access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 고마워, [player name]. 이걸로 광산에 들어갈 수 있어. 너도 참 별난 놈이야.

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Should you leave, Pete would expect payment again.
translation: 이제 Volcanic Mine(화산 광산)에 들어갈 수 있다. 밖으로 나오면 Pete(피트)가 다시 요금을 요구할 것이다.

english: Thanks [player name]. That will grant you permanent access to the mine. You're a crazy one.
translation: 고마워, [player name]. 이걸로 광산에 영구히 들어갈 수 있어. 너도 참 별난 놈이야.

english: You can now enter the Volcanic Mine. Pete will not ask you for payment again.
translation: 이제 Volcanic Mine(화산 광산)에 들어갈 수 있다. Pete(피트)는 다시 요금을 요구하지 않을 것이다.

english: You've already paid the entrance fee too, so you can head right on in.
translation: 입장료도 이미 냈으니 바로 들어가도 돼.

english: I've got some of your stuff that you left here earlier. You'd better deal with it before trying to go into the cavern again.
translation: 아까 네가 두고 간 물건이 좀 있어. 동굴에 다시 들어가기 전에 그것부터 처리하는 게 좋을 거야.

english: Have you anything to trade?
Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 제가 광산에 두고 온 거 혹시 주우셨어요?

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. I'm not sure what you'd have been doing in there anyway, since I wouldn't expect to let you in.
translation: 미안, 줄 게 없어. 애초에 네가 거기서 뭘 했는지 모르겠네. 난 널 들여보낼 생각이 없었는데.

english: Sorry, I've got nothing for you. If I had some of your stuff earlier, but you died before collecting it, it'd be lost.
translation: 미안, 줄 게 없어. 아까 네 물건을 갖고 있었더라도, 찾아가기 전에 네가 죽었으면 없어졌을 거야.

english: I'll leave you be.
There are some crazy things down there, I don't think you're capable so I'll let you keep your Numulites.
translation: 저 아래엔 미친 것들이 있어. 네가 감당할 수 있을 것 같지 않으니 Numulite(누뮬라이트)는 그냥 갖고 있어.

english: It doesn't look like you have 30 Numulites with you unfortunately.
translation: 아쉽지만 Numulite(누뮬라이트) 30개를 안 가져온 것 같네.

english: You've already paid up! You can head right on in. Better you than me...
translation: 이미 돈 냈잖아! 바로 들어가도 돼. 내가 아니라 다행이다...

english: Sorry, I'll need paying before I can return your stuff.
translation: 미안하지만 돈을 받아야 물건을 돌려줄 수 있어.

english: Sorry [player name], you won't last a minute in there. You got to prove yourself as a capable archeologist, and be good at the minin'.
translation: 미안, [player name], 넌 거기서 1분도 못 버틸 거야. 실력 있는 고고학자라는 걸 증명해야 하고, 채광도 잘해야 해.

english: Sorry [player name] I can't let people head in mid way through a mine out session. It's not safe and will cause mine collapse!
translation: 미안, [player name], 채굴 작업이 한창일 때는 중간에 사람을 들여보낼 수 없어. 위험하고 광산이 무너질 거야!

english: Pete quickly hands you a heat-proof vessel filled with some water.
translation: Pete(피트)가 물이 담긴 내열 용기를 재빨리 건네준다.

english: The mine is currently dormant, and will awaken within the next 30 seconds.
translation: 광산이 지금은 잠잠하지만, 30초 안에 깨어날 것이다.

english: Sorry [player name], I cannot allow someone to go in there without paying first. Come see me.
translation: 미안, [player name], 돈을 안 내고는 아무도 못 들여보내. 나한테 와.

english: You should probably pick up the stuff you left in there earlier before you return. Come and see me.
translation: 돌아오기 전에 아까 안에 두고 온 물건부터 챙기는 게 좋을 거야. 나한테 와.

english: Well why am I going to reward you for that?! Might wanna contribute next time. I am not standin' out here for nothin'.
translation: 내가 그걸로 왜 보상을 줘야 하는데?! 다음엔 좀 보탬이 되라고. 나도 괜히 여기 서 있는 거 아니거든.

english: I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 채광 훈련을 조금 시켜 주고, 네가 보탠 건 기억해 둘게.

english: I'll quickly take those fragments off your hands [player name], thank you! I'll give you a bit of minin' trainin' and I'll remember the contribution you've made.
translation: 그 파편들은 내가 얼른 받아 갈게, [player name], 고마워! 채광 훈련을 조금 시켜 주고, 네가 보탠 건 기억해 둘게.

english: [player name] has started up a mine! Join [him/her] down there now!
translation: [player name] 님이 광산 작업을 시작했어! 지금 내려가서 [him/her]랑 합류해!

english: Hi Pete, I found this in one of my ore packs...
translation: 안녕하세요, Pete(피트). ore pack(광석 꾸러미)에서 이걸 찾았는데요...

english: Woah, what is that you've got there?!
It's... a pickaxe, a broken one.
That's not just any broken pickaxe, it's a dragon one! They're really rare!
translation: 그냥 부서진 곡괭이가 아니야, 드래곤 곡괭이잖아! 엄청 희귀한 거라고!

english: I have no idea how that ended up in your ore pack, but you can keep it, it's broken anyway.
translation: 그게 어쩌다 네 ore pack(광석 꾸러미)에 들어갔는지는 모르겠지만, 가져도 돼. 어차피 부서졌으니까.

english: Maybe you can find someone to help you repair it! I've heard tales that some dwarves used to fix pickaxes.
translation: 고쳐 줄 사람을 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라! 예전에 곡괭이를 고쳐 주던 드워프들이 있었다는 얘기를 들었거든.

english: One of them was called Nurmof. I think he used to reside in the Falador mines. If you're lucky, he could still be there.
translation: 그중 하나가 Nurmof(누르모프)였어. Falador(팔라도르) 광산에 살았던 것 같아. 운이 좋으면 아직 거기 있을 거야.

english: Nice one, [player name]! I'll give you twice as much water when you're starting a run.
translation: 잘했어, [player name]! 이제 작업을 시작할 때 물을 두 배로 줄게.

english: Sorry [player name], this a Deadman world. People are fighting all over the shop. No one gets in the mine here!
translation: 미안, [player name], 여긴 Deadman(데드맨) 월드야. 사방에서 싸움판이 벌어지고 있다고. 여기선 아무도 광산에 못 들어가!

english: What is in the cavern?
How do I traverse the mine?
How do I keep the mine stable?
Explain the dangers for me.
Can I go inside?
I'll leave you be.
Pay 30 Numulites for one visit.
Pay 3,000 Numulites for permanent access.
Keep your Numulites.
Have you anything to trade?
Have you picked up anything I left in the mine?
translation: 제가 광산에 두고 온 거 혹시 주우셨어요?

english: Pay the fee.
Yes, pay 150 x Numulite.
Yes, pay 150 x Numulite and don't ask me again..
translation: 네, Numulite(누뮬라이트) 150개를 낼게요. 다시 묻지 마세요..

english: No, don't pay.
Wow, didn't expect to find a scientist out here.
translation: 와, 이런 데서 과학자를 만날 줄은 몰랐네요.

english: I'm out here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?
translation: 임무 때문에 여기 있는 거예요. 내가 좋아서 이런 밑바닥 인간들 사이에 있는 줄 알아요?

english: I'm not one to judge.
What is this 'mission' you mentioned?
I'm out here to conduct research, I've been told a giant spider lurks in the heart of the Wilderness.
translation: 연구를 하러 왔어요. Wilderness(황야) 한가운데에 거대 거미가 숨어 있다고 들었거든요.

english: Her venom is priceless and it would aid me greatly in my research.
translation: 그 거미의 독은 값을 매길 수 없을 만큼 귀해서, 내 연구에 큰 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Research? What could you possibly want with a giant spider's venom?
translation: 연구요? 거대 거미 독을 대체 어디에 쓰려고요?

english: Venenatis is the last of her kind. Lots of giant spiders used to dwell deep in the mountains until the savage dwarves killed them all.
translation: Venenatis(베네나티스)는 그 종의 마지막 개체예요. 예전엔 깊은 산속에 거대 거미가 많이 살았는데, 야만적인 드워프들이 전부 죽여 버렸죠.

english: She is the last one left and I must have a sample of her venom.
translation: 남은 건 그 거미 하나뿐이고, 난 반드시 그 독을 채취해야 해요.

english: What I want with the specimen however, is none of your business!
translation: 하지만 그 표본으로 뭘 할지는 당신이 알 바 아니에요!

english: Woah sorry, didn't mean to touch a nerve. Fighting a giant spider sounds like a great idea.
translation: 워, 죄송해요. 신경을 건드릴 생각은 없었어요. 거대 거미와 싸우는 거, 좋은 생각 같네요.

english: I've tried to put it off for as long as I could, but this is the final component needed for my research.
translation: 최대한 미뤄 왔지만, 이게 내 연구에 필요한 마지막 요소예요.

english: Then what are you waiting around here for? Go out there and fight her.
translation: 그럼 여기서 뭘 기다리고 있어요? 나가서 싸우세요.

english: Are you sure you're equipped to take it down? I've had the displeasure of dealing with Venenatis, she will not go down easily.
translation: 정말 그걸 쓰러뜨릴 준비가 됐어요? 저도 Venenatis(베네나티스)를 상대해 봤는데 정말 끔찍했어요. 그렇게 쉽게 쓰러지지 않을 거예요.

english: It will not be easy, but if I can get her when she's wounded in her lair, it should be a fairer fight.
translation: 쉽지는 않겠죠. 하지만 상처 입고 둥지에 있을 때 잡으면 좀 더 해볼 만한 싸움이 될 거예요.

english: I didn't know she had a lair. I thought she just roamed the Wilderness.
translation: 둥지가 있는 줄은 몰랐어요. 그냥 황야를 돌아다니는 줄 알았거든요.

english: She only returns there to lick her wounds and rest, I need to be patient.
translation: 상처를 핥고 쉴 때만 거기로 돌아가요. 참을성 있게 기다려야죠.

english: So that explains why you're waiting here.
I would go out and fight her now, but I must admit, I am also a little scared. I've never been in a fight before.
translation: 지금 당장 나가서 싸우고 싶지만, 솔직히 좀 무섭기도 해요. 싸워 본 적이 한 번도 없거든요.

english: I'm sure you'll be alright, it's just a gigantic spider!
translation: 괜찮을 거예요, 그냥 엄청 큰 거미일 뿐인걸요!

english: Thanks for your words of confidence...
Hey. Do you know anything about this?
translation: 저기요. 이거에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어요?

english: Well, would you look at that. Most fascinating.
translation: 어머, 이것 좀 봐. 정말 흥미롭네요.

english: Could you tell me what's so fascinating?
It's a rare Zamorakian artifact. I haven't seen any quite like this one before.
translation: 희귀한 Zamorakian(자모락파) 유물이에요. 이런 건 처음 봐요.

english: If you look closely, you can see that it has a socket where you can place an item to increase its power.
translation: 자세히 보면 아이템을 끼워서 힘을 키울 수 있는 홈이 있어요.

english: Interesting! I'll be on the lookout for that.
So it's real. Magnificent.
You've seen this before?
No, but I have heard tales of the mighty Vet'Ion.
translation: 아뇨, 하지만 강대한 Vet'Ion(베티온)에 관한 이야기는 들어 봤어요.

english: It is said his skull can power a certain Zamorakian weapon.
translation: 그의 해골이 어떤 Zamorakian(자모락파) 무기에 힘을 불어넣을 수 있다고 하더군요.

english: Oh, like this skull?
Yes, like that one! That looks powerful indeed. I think that would do quite nicely.
translation: 네, 바로 그거예요! 정말 강력해 보이네요. 그거라면 딱 좋겠어요.

english: A skilled crafter can combine the two. If you wish, I could do it for you... For a price, that is.
translation: 솜씨 좋은 장인이라면 둘을 합칠 수 있어요. 원하면 내가 해 줄 수도 있고요... 물론 대가를 받고요.

english: I don't have the money for that.
Feel free to come back when you do.
There we go! All done.
No thanks.
No, I'm afraid not.
Oh. Do you know someone who might know more?
translation: 아. 더 잘 알 만한 사람을 아세요?

english: Andros Mai is a very... Devoted man. If you can see past that, he may be able to help you.
translation: Andros Mai(안드로스 마이)는 아주... 독실한 사람이에요. 그 점만 눈감을 수 있다면 도와줄지도 몰라요.

english: Thanks!
Yes! Those belong to Venenatis!
Ah, but they contain no more venom. That is disappointing.
translation: 아, 그런데 독이 하나도 남아 있지 않네요. 실망스러워요.

english: So you're saying they're useless?
To me? Yes. But maybe not to you.
translation: 나한테요? 네. 하지만 당신한테는 아닐지도 모르죠.

english: I've seen that Derse Venator guy over there handle similar items. Perhaps he knows more.
translation: 저쪽에 있는 Derse Venator(더스 베나토르)라는 남자가 비슷한 물건을 다루는 걸 봤어요. 그 사람이 더 알지도 몰라요.

english: Downstairs there's a strange looking person. I don't know what that item is, but if anyone would, I reckon she would.
translation: 아래층에 이상하게 생긴 사람이 있어요. 그 아이템이 뭔지 나는 모르지만, 아는 사람이 있다면 그 여자일 거예요.

english: I think she said her name was Madam Sikaro.
translation: 이름이 Madam Sikaro(시카로 부인)라고 했던 것 같아요.

english: You look ready for combat.
Ask about rare item.
Yes
No
Hello, what is this place?
This is Seers Village! We're an organisation of mystically gifted people with the power of foresight...we see things that have yet to come to pass.
translation: 여기는 Seers Village(시어스 마을)예요! 우리는 신비로운 예지력을 타고난 사람들의 모임이에요... 아직 일어나지 않은 일을 미리 보죠.

english: What do you do here?
A lot of our time is spent addressing everyday sorts of things, plus we meditate a lot and enhance our powers of mystical foresight.
translation: 대부분은 일상적인 일들을 처리하며 보내고, 명상도 많이 하면서 신비로운 예지력을 키워요.

english: Do you have any quests?
Unfortunately no, sorry, but if adventure is what you seek, try checking through your quest list!
translation: 아쉽지만 없어요, 미안해요. 하지만 모험을 찾고 있다면 퀘스트 목록을 한번 살펴보세요!

english: Ok, thanks.
Thank you, all I need to do is figure out how to get these logs into that vial, but that's my problem. Take this as a reward.
translation: 고마워요, 이제 이 통나무를 저 약병에 어떻게 넣을지만 알아내면 되는데, 그건 제 문제죠. 보답으로 이걸 받으세요.

english: Hello, what is this place?
What do you do here?
Do you have any quests?
Ok, thanks.
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 안녕하십니까. 은행권을 교환해 드릴까요? 은행권 한 장당 5코인만 받습니다.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Phials. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 저는 Phials(파이얼스)입니다. 은행권을 실제 물건으로 바꿔 드리지요. 바꾸실 은행권이 있으십니까?

english: No thanks.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
Good day.
Hello there. Not very often I get visitors. What brings you here?
translation: 어서 오게. 손님이 오는 일이 드문데 말이야. 무슨 일로 왔나?

english: Who are you?
The name's Phileas Rimor. I was once a soldier in the Shayzien Army but now I'm retired.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)라고 하네. 한때 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군)의 군인이었지만, 지금은 은퇴했지.

english: Do you need help with anything?
I'm fine thank you. Thanks for asking though.
translation: 난 괜찮네. 그래도 물어봐 줘서 고맙군.

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Tale of the Righteous quest.
translation: Tale of the Righteous(의인의 이야기) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 조건을 모두 갖추지 못했습니다.

english: Nothing.
Oh, okay then.
Who are you?
Do you need help with anything?
Nothing.
Hello there.
What have you brought me? I want some more toys!
translation: 뭐 가져왔어? 장난감 더 갖고 싶어!

english: I'm afraid I don't have any toys.
Toys! I want toys!
Hello youngster.
Daddy says you don't like Mr. Jones. Mr. Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
translation: 아빠가 그러는데 너 Mr. Jones(존스 아저씨) 싫어한다며. 존스 아저씨는 착해. 나한테 장난감이랑 사탕도 가져다준단 말이야.

english: Jones is a bad man, Philipe.
You're a bad [man/lady]! I don't like you!
I'll try and console myself about that disappointment somehow.
translation: 그 실망은 어떻게든 스스로 달래 볼게.

english: Hello, who are you?
Hi, I'm Phillipa! Juliet's cousin? I like to keep an eye on her, make sure that dashing young Romeo doesn't just steal away from here under our plain old noses!
translation: 안녕하세요, 저는 Phillipa(필리파)예요! Juliet(줄리엣)의 사촌이요. 전 걔를 늘 지켜보고 있어요. 저 멋쟁이 젊은 Romeo(로미오)가 우리 코앞에서 걔를 몰래 데려가 버리지 못하게요!

english: He'd do it you know... he's ever so dashing, and cavalier, in a wet blanket sort of way.
translation: 그 사람이라면 정말 그럴 수도 있다니까요... 엄청 멋있고 기사도도 넘치거든요. 뭐, 좀 김빠지는 쪽으로 말이죠.

english: Romeo? Where would I find him then?
translation: Romeo(로미오)요? 그럼 그 사람은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Well, that's a good question! Who knows where his head's at most of the time... in the clouds most likely!
translation: 음, 그거 좋은 질문이네요! 그 사람 정신이 대체로 어디 가 있는지 누가 알겠어요... 아마 구름 위에 둥둥 떠 있겠죠!

english: Hello, I seem to be getting on really well with that dashing lovely dovely, Romeo... Pity about poor Juliet... she missed out there I reckon!
translation: 안녕하세요, 저 그 멋지고 달달한 Romeo(로미오)랑 정말 잘 지내고 있는 것 같아요... 불쌍한 Juliet(줄리엣)... 걔는 기회를 놓친 것 같네요!

english: Hello
Oh, hello... Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo and I have to say, I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.
translation: 어머, 안녕하세요... Juliet(줄리엣)이 당신이 자기랑 Romeo(로미오)를 위해 해 주는 일을 다 얘기해 줬어요. 정말 고마워요. 걔도 인생에 행복이 좀 있어야죠.

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud...hysterically you might say. He always brings a tear to my eyes...tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: 그리고 Romeo(로미오)는 분명 걔를 크게 웃게 해 줄 딱 그런 광대일 거예요... 배꼽 빠지게 웃게요. 그 사람만 보면 제 눈에 눈물이 다 고인다니까요... 그 바보 같은 짓 때문에 흘리는 기쁨의 눈물이요!

english: Oh, thanks...I like to do my cupid bit.
translation: 아, 고마워요... 큐피드 노릇 좀 해 보는 거죠.

english: Oh, hello again! How was I...do you think I was convincing?
translation: 어머, 또 만났네요! 저 어땠어요... 그럴듯했던 것 같아요?

english: Oh, yes, totally!
Ohhh good! I do hope Juliet will be pleased as well! That dashing young Romeo must be beside himself with excitement! Have you told him the good news yet?
translation: 아아 다행이다! Juliet(줄리엣)도 기뻐했으면 좋겠네요! 그 멋쟁이 젊은 Romeo(로미오)는 지금쯤 신나서 어쩔 줄 모르겠죠! 그 사람한테 좋은 소식은 벌써 전했어요?

english: Not yet, but soon!
Good, good...you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 좋아요, 좋아... 운도 좋으셔라, 그 사람 표정이 어떨지 빨리 보고 싶네요!

english: Hey Phillipa, we need to do something about Juliet.
translation: 저기요 Phillipa(필리파), Juliet(줄리엣) 일로 뭔가 해야겠어요.

english: Hi [player name], good to see you again, how are you?
translation: 안녕하세요 [player name]님, 또 보니 반가워요. 잘 지냈어요?

english: Hi... I'm good thanks.
Oh that's great! Romeo and I are also doing great thanks for asking, we've been having the best time since you introduced me to him.
translation: 어머 잘됐네요! Romeo(로미오)랑 저도 아주 잘 지내고 있어요, 물어봐 줘서 고마워요. 당신이 그 사람을 소개해 준 뒤로 최고의 시간을 보내고 있다니까요.

english: I'm not here to find out how you and Romeo are getting on, I'm here to help Juliet.
translation: 당신이랑 Romeo(로미오)가 어떻게 지내는지 들으러 온 게 아니에요. Juliet(줄리엣)을 도우러 왔어요.

english: Typical, what is she upset about this time?
translation: 역시나네요, 이번엔 걔가 또 뭐 때문에 속상하대요?

english: Her father put her in charge of the birthday party this year, but she's not feeling up to it, recent events have got her feeling quite down.
translation: 아버지가 올해 생일 파티를 맡겼는데, 기운이 없대요. 요즘 있었던 일들 때문에 꽤 우울해하고 있어요.

english: Why don't you try cheering her up?
translation: 걔 기분 좀 풀어 주는 건 어때요?

english: I offered to get her one of Gertrude's cats, but she told me there's little chance of that happening.
translation: Gertrude(거트루드)네 고양이를 한 마리 구해 주겠다고 했는데, 그럴 가능성은 거의 없다고 하더라고요.

english: Hmm, why don't you try dressing up as one, you could be her emotional support human.
translation: 흠, 그럼 당신이 고양이로 분장해 보는 건 어때요? 걔의 정서 지원 인간이 되어 주는 거죠.

english: That sounds like a terrible idea...
Surely there's something less... weird... I can do instead?
Got any better ideas?
Thought not, so since she loves cats, why don't you dress up as one and dance for her.

english: Fine, I'll go have a word.
How are you getting on with your cat costume?
Still working on it, who did you say could help me with it?
translation: 아직 준비 중이에요. 누가 도와줄 수 있다고 했죠?

english: Iffie should be able to help, she runs the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: Iffie(이피)가 도와줄 수 있을 거예요. Varrock Square(바록 광장) 옆에서 옷 가게를 하고 있어요.

english: Alright Phillipa, I've got the cat ears, now what do you want me to do?
translation: 좋아요 Phillipa(필리파), cat ears(고양이 귀)를 구했어요. 이제 뭘 하면 돼요?

english: Aww, they're so adorable!
Okay, you need to go talk to Juliet and try cheer her up, do a dance for her or something, do you have any good moves?

translation: 몇 개는 알아요. 좋아요, 한번 해 볼게요.

translation: Juliet(줄리엣) 기분 풀어 줘서 고마워요. 당신 덕분에 파티를 살렸어요.

Ask about the birthday party.

You ask them!

translation: 저리 가, 이 괴짜야! 우리 바쁘거든!

At what?

translation: Jimmy Dazzler(지미 대즐러)를 어디서 찾을 수 있다고 했죠?

english: Didn't you find him in Ardougne?
He's normally in the Flying Horse Inn.
translation: 보통은 Flying Horse Inn(날개 달린 말 여관)에 있어.

translation: 내 대신 뽀뽀 한 번 해 줘!

english: I will absolutely not be doing that.
Can you tell me where I can find Hooknosed Jack?

Who 'nose' where, though!

You think our nose jokes are bad? Well...

english: Can you tell me where I can find Smokin' Joe?

Can you tell me where I can find Felkrash?
translation: Felkrash(펠크래시)는 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

[player name] has come back again.

Oh come on, stop the act. It's just not funny anymore.
translation: 아, 좀 그 연기 그만해요. 이제 하나도 안 웃겨요.

english: Ya it is.
Ha! Ha!
Ha! Ha!
Can you tell me where I would find Jimmy Dazzler?

'e is, e is. He stays in the Flying Horse dun 'e?

english: Tell 'im we said 'ello. Will ye?She then breaks out in a burst of girly giggles.
translation: 우리가 안부 전한다 캐라. 알긋제? 그러고는 소녀처럼 까르르 웃음을 터뜨린다.

english: Can you tell me where I would find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)은 어디 가면 만날 수 있어요?

english: Da big ugly's ere in Vu'rock.
translation: 그 덩치 큰 못난이는 여기 Vu'rock(바록)에 있다.

english: Da big ugly! Ha that's a good one. 'E is big n ugly though isn't e, serve him right for all the fights e get's in.
translation: 덩치 큰 못난이! 하, 그거 좋네. 근데 진짜 덩치 크고 못나긴 했제, 맨날 싸움질하고 다니니 꼴좋다.

english: Ha! I nose the truth when I 'ears it! Get it? Get it? Nose the truth?
translation: 하! 이거 '코'가 막히게 맞는 말이네! 알긋나? 알긋나? 코가 막힌다꼬!

english: Ha, ha, ha ah ha.....
You leave the sisters grime mid cackle.
translation: 당신은 한창 낄낄대는 sisters grime(그라임 자매)를 두고 자리를 뜬다.

translation: 갸는 여기저기 돌아댕기는데, 내 생각엔 Port Sarim(포트 사림)이다.

translation: 그래서... Pyromancers(화염술사)들 말이에요, 꽤 화끈한 사람들이죠?

english: We share a common goal.
Which is?
Keeping the cinders burning and preventing the long night from swallowing us all.
translation: 불씨가 꺼지지 않게 지키고, 기나긴 밤이 우리 모두를 집어삼키지 못하게 막는 것이다.

english: That sounds scary.
As long as we remain vigilant and praise the Sun, all will be well.
translation: 우리가 경계를 늦추지 않고 태양을 찬양하는 한, 모든 것이 무사할 것이다.

english: ... What are you staring at?
The great Sol Supra.
Is that me?
No mortal. The Sun, as you would say.
translation: 아니다, 필멸자여. 너희 말로 하자면 태양이다.

english: Do you worship it?
It is wonderous... If only I could be so grossly incandescent.
translation: 경이롭도다... 나도 저토록 눈부시게 타오를 수만 있다면.

english: Who's a pretty birdy?
The phoenix gives you a smouldering look.
One day I will burn so hot I'll become Sacred Ash.
translation: 언젠가 나는 뜨겁게 타올라 Sacred Ash(신성한 재)가 될 것이다.

english: Aww, but you're so rare, where would I find another?
translation: 아, 그치만 당신은 정말 귀한데, 그럼 또 어디서 찾아요?

english: Do not fret mortal, I will rise from the Sacred Ash greater than ever before.
translation: 염려 말거라, 필멸자여. 나는 Sacred Ash(신성한 재)에서 그 어느 때보다 위대하게 다시 태어날 것이다.

english: So you're immortal?
As long as the Sun in the sky gives me strength.
translation: 하늘의 태양이 내게 힘을 주는 한은 그렇다.

english: ...Sky?
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hey there. Here to do some fishing? It's a great place for it. Or are you looking to buy some fishing supplies?
translation: 어서 와요. 낚시하러 왔어요? 여기 낚시하기 아주 좋은 곳이에요. 아니면 낚시 보급품을 사러 왔어요?

english: Let's see what you're selling.
Do you get many customers out here?
Not so much out here, but I sell plenty of fish to merchants in the capital. If you buy any fish there, there's a good chance it came from me.
translation: 여기선 별로 없지만, 수도 상인들한테 물고기를 많이 팔아요. 거기서 물고기를 샀다면 제가 잡은 것일 가능성이 꽤 높을걸요.

english: So anyway, looking to buy some fishing supplies?
translation: 아무튼, 낚시 보급품 좀 사 갈래요?

english: Just passing through.
Fair enough.
Let's see what you're selling.
Do you get many customers out here?
Just passing through.
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 살인 사건을 해결하는 데 도와주셔서 정말 감사합니다.

english: Welcome to my private little wyvern area.
translation: 제 작은 개인 wyvern(와이번) 구역에 온 걸 환영해요.

english: Who are you?
I'm Pieve. My big brother Steve made this training area, but he's gone off to be a Slayer Master to replace our cousin Nieve, so this area's mine now.
translation: 전 Pieve(피브)예요. 우리 큰오빠 Steve(스티브)가 이 훈련장을 만들었는데, 사촌 Nieve(니에브) 대신 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 되겠다고 떠나 버려서 이제 여긴 제 구역이에요.

english: Why is this wyvern area private?
translation: 이 와이번 구역은 왜 개인 구역이에요?

english: My brother, Steve, carved the steps to get up here. He was jealous of our cousin, Nieve, because she'd got a huge training cave where she could boss people around. So he made this place.
translation: 우리 오빠 Steve(스티브)가 여기 올라오는 계단을 깎아 만들었어요. 사촌 Nieve(니에브)한테 사람들을 부려 먹을 수 있는 커다란 훈련 동굴이 있는 게 샘났거든요. 그래서 여길 만든 거예요.

english: So are you a Slayer Master?
No, I'm not. My brother Steve is a Slayer Master. He took over the job from our cousin Nieve. All he has to do is tell people to kill stuff - he says it's easy!
translation: 아뇨, 전 아니에요. 우리 오빠 Steve(스티브)가 슬레이어 마스터예요. 사촌 Nieve(니에브)한테서 그 일을 물려받았죠. 사람들한테 뭘 잡으라고 말만 하면 되니까 쉽대요!

english: Thanks, goodbye.
That's not your assigned Slayer target. Up here, I expect people to focus on their Slayer training.
translation: 그건 당신한테 배정된 Slayer(슬레이어) 대상이 아니에요. 여기서는 다들 슬레이어 훈련에 집중해 줬으면 해요.

english: Who are you?
Why is this wyvern area private?
translation: 이 와이번 구역은 왜 개인 구역이에요?

english: So are you a Slayer Master?
Thanks, goodbye.
Squawk!
Hello. I can convert items to banknotes, for 50 coins per item. Just hand me the items you'd like me to convert.
translation: 안녕하세요. 아이템 하나당 50코인에 은행권으로 바꿔 드려요. 바꾸고 싶은 아이템을 건네주기만 하세요.

english: Who are you?
I'm Piles. I lived in Draynor Village when I was young, where I saw three men working in the market, converting items to banknotes.
translation: 전 Piles(파일스)예요. 어릴 때 Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)에 살았는데, 거기 시장에서 아이템을 은행권으로 바꿔 주는 세 남자를 봤어요.

english: Their names were Niles, Miles and Giles. I'm trying to be like them, so I've changed my name and started this business here.
translation: 그 사람들 이름이 Niles(나일스), Miles(마일스), Giles(자일스)였죠. 저도 그 사람들처럼 되고 싶어서 이름도 바꾸고 여기서 이 장사를 시작했어요.

english: Thanks.
Here you go.
Who are you?
Thanks.
Dey got me in da belly, mees gutsies feel like had a dead dead dog dinner.
translation: 놈들이 나 배때기 때렸다, 나 뱃속 죽은 죽은 개 저녁밥 먹은 거 같다.

english: Oh, nilsal, fellow traveller. You don't see many other people out here.
translation: 오, Nilsal(닐살), 동료 여행자님. 이런 데선 다른 사람을 보기가 쉽지 않은데요.

english: Hello there! Where are you heading to?
The Proudspire of course! I'm walking the Pilgrim Path.
translation: 당연히 Proudspire(프라우드스파이어)죠! 전 Pilgrim Path(순례자의 길)을 걷고 있어요.

english: What's the Pilgrim Path?
It is a sacred pilgrimage between the Teomat and the Proudspire. I do it every year, as do many others.
translation: Teomat(테오맛)과 프라우드스파이어 사이를 잇는 신성한 순례길이에요. 저는 해마다 이 길을 걸어요. 다른 사람들도 많이 그렇고요.

english: The hardest part is the last bit: Reaching the summit of the Proudspire. Only upon touching the obelisk at the top is your journey complete.
translation: 가장 힘든 건 마지막 구간이에요. 프라우드스파이어의 꼭대기에 오르는 거죠. 꼭대기에 있는 obelisk(오벨리스크)를 만져야만 여정이 끝나요.

english: I see. Well good luck with your journey.
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 여정에 행운이 있길 바라요.

english: Thank you, traveller. May the sun light your way.
translation: 고마워요, 여행자님. 태양이 당신의 길을 비추시길.

english: Good luck with your journey.
Nilsal to you once more, fellow traveller.
Hello again! How are things going?
I'm still on route to the Proudspire, but I'm having a bit of a break to enjoy the scenery. Walking the Pilgrim Path can be long and arduous.
translation: 아직 Proudspire(프라우드스파이어)로 가는 중이지만, 잠깐 쉬면서 경치를 즐기고 있어요. Pilgrim Path(순례자의 길)을 걷는 건 길고 고된 일이거든요.

english: What's the Pilgrim Path?
Good luck with your journey.
Hello.
Hi, I'm looking for an architect?
I am indeed, fastest builder in Kourend and a dab hand at sculpture. How can I help?
translation: 제대로 찾아오셨네요. Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 제일 빠른 건축가에, 조각 솜씨도 일품이죠. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: I wondered if you would be interested in helping to build a statue.
translation: 조각상을 세우는 걸 도와주실 생각이 있나 해서요.

english: Maybe. What of?
An enormous statue of King Rada I in the centre of Kourend.
translation: Kourend(쿠렌드) 한복판에 세울 King Rada I(라다 1세 왕)의 거대한 조각상이요.

english: Oh really? Who was he then?
He was your founding ruler! Surely you know your history?
translation: 당신네 나라를 세운 통치자잖아요! 설마 자기 나라 역사도 모르는 건 아니죠?

english: Of course I do, just pulling your leg. Sounds like a great idea, though I am only good at doing arms and hands on big statues - is that of use?
translation: 당연히 알죠, 그냥 놀려 본 거예요. 좋은 생각이네요. 다만 전 큰 조각상에서 팔이랑 손 만드는 것만 잘하는데, 그래도 괜찮아요?

english: Yes it is, I can find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: 네, 좋아요. 다른 부분은 맡아 줄 사람을 따로 찾아볼게요. 현장에서 봬요!

english: Yes, yes, I'm on my way, just collecting my things! I'll be there shortly.
translation: 네, 네, 지금 가요, 연장만 챙기고요! 금방 갈게요.

english: How are we doing on the statue?
We can't start till we have someone to build all the parts.
translation: 부분들을 다 만들 사람이 모이기 전엔 시작을 못 해요.

english: I guess I have to go find some more architects then!

english: What did you do before you came here?
translation: 여기 오기 전에는 무슨 일을 하셨어요?

english: I worked in a chapel dedicated to our lord, Saradomin. My task was to light the chapel candles, but I couldn't reach them myself and I kept getting dazzled by the light whenever I tried.
translation: 저는 우리 주 Saradomin(사라도민)께 바쳐진 예배당에서 일했습니다. 예배당의 양초에 불을 붙이는 게 제 일이었는데, 손이 닿지 않는 데다 불을 붙이려 할 때마다 빛에 눈이 부셔서 도무지 할 수가 없었지요.

english: I'd call adventurers from across the world, summoning them to my chapel to do the task for me. I needed them to light the tall candles, but not the short ones.
translation: 그래서 온 세상의 모험가들을 불러 제 예배당으로 소환해서 그 일을 대신 시켰습니다. 긴 양초에만 불을 붙이고, 짧은 양초에는 붙이지 말아야 했지요.

english: However, adventurers got confused, and thought they should light the short candles as well as the tall candles, so I made them try again. And again.
translation: 그런데 모험가들이 헷갈려서는 긴 양초뿐 아니라 짧은 양초에도 불을 붙여야 한다고 생각하더군요. 그래서 다시 시켰습니다. 그리고 또다시요.

english: Eventually my chapel was closed down. They said I'd trapped adventurers there for too long. All I wanted was for them to light the tall candles without lighting the short candles!
translation: 결국 제 예배당은 문을 닫고 말았습니다. 제가 모험가들을 너무 오래 붙잡아 두었다더군요. 제가 바란 건 그저 짧은 양초는 놔두고 긴 양초에만 불을 붙이는 것뿐이었는데 말입니다!

english: Anyway, now I live here, and remember the good old days. It is nice to meet you, [player name].
translation: 아무튼 이제 저는 여기 살면서 좋았던 옛날을 추억하고 있습니다. 만나서 반갑습니다, [player name]님.

english: Goodbye.
So your name is Pete?
Yes, it is a common name. I also know of Party Pete, Parroty Pete, Postie Pete, Pirate Pete, Petrified Pete and 'Picarron' Pete. The Makeover Mage has used the name Pete too.
translation: 네, 흔한 이름이지요. 제가 아는 사람만 해도 Party Pete(파티 피트), Parroty Pete(앵무새 피트), Postie Pete(집배원 피트), Pirate Pete(해적 피트), Petrified Pete(돌이 된 피트), 그리고 'Picarron' Pete('악당' 피트)가 있습니다. Makeover Mage(변신 마법사)도 피트라는 이름을 쓴 적이 있지요.

english: Although we are not related, the shared bond of that name can be a comfort in dark times.
translation: 서로 핏줄은 아니지만, 같은 이름을 나눈 인연이 어두운 시절에는 위안이 되기도 합니다.

english: What did you do before you came here?
translation: 여기 오기 전에는 무슨 일을 하셨어요?

english: So your name is Pete?
Goodbye.
Hello!
Yo ho ho and bottle of alcopop!
translation: 요 호 호, 그리고 과일 칵테일 한 병!

english: Oooh arrh!
No wait. That's a farmer.
Good day to you my dear sir!
Arrh be off with ye!
3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 항구에서 3일 보급하고 나면 다시 먼바다로 나간다!

english: Arrh arrh!
Arrh ye scurvy sea dog!
translation: 아르르, 이 괴혈병 걸린 바다 개 같은 놈!

english: A pox on ye!
Arrh! I be in search of buried treasure!
translation: 아르르! 난 묻힌 보물을 찾고 있다!

english: Ahoy there!
Avast me hearties!
Shiver me timbers!
You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
translation: 넌 곧 Davey Jones(데이비 존스)의 궤짝 신세가 될 거다!

english: Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
Arrh!
Avast behind!
translation: 어이, 뒤에 그 커다란 엉덩이! 멈춰라!

english: I'm not that fat!
Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
All hands on deck!
Yo ho ho me hearties!
Man overboard!
Keel haul them I say!
I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: 넌 짧은 판자 끝에서 아주 긴 산책을 하게 될 거다!

english: Splice the mainbrace!
I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
Yo ho ho and a bottle of rum!
translation: 요 호 호, 그리고 럼주 한 병!

english: Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
Great blackbeard's beard!
I'm the scourge of the six seas!
Don't you mean seven seas?
Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
Hello.
Arrr?
What are you doing down here?
You can't have me treasure!
What treasure?
Where's the treasure? Who told ye about me treasure?
translation: 보물이 어디 있다고? 누가 내 보물 얘기를 하던?

english: I don't know, you said something about treasure.
Ain't no treasure down 'ere.
translation: 여기 아래엔 보물 같은 거 없다.

english: So why are you here?
Takin' a walk, gettin' some air.
translation: 산책 중이다, 바람 좀 쐬는 거지.

english: Riiiiight.
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 아르르? 우리 해적단에 한패로 들어올 테냐?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 화약 나르는 꼬마 놈이 범부 술 퍼마시고 난동 피우다 뻗어 자고 있어서, 네 자리는 넉넉하다.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
What's a landlubber like ye doin' here?
Helping Cap'n Teach shoot his way through a little blockade.
translation: Teach(티치) 선장님이 작은 봉쇄선을 대포로 뚫고 지나가는 걸 돕고 있어요.

english: Well done to ye. I'll see ye around.
Why is this place walled off?
Well [lad/lass], it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: 그게 말이다, [lad/lass], 저 너머 정글에 끔찍한 것들이 있어서다.

english: What sort of foul things?
Big 'uns, nasty 'uns. You name it, we got it.
translation: 큰 놈, 고약한 놈. 말만 해, 다 있다.

english: There be Jungle Horrors in the jungles, and Cave Horrors in the caves.
translation: 정글엔 Jungle Horrors(정글 호러)가 있고, 동굴엔 Cave Horrors(동굴 호러)가 있지.

english: Tis no place te be havin' a picnic and no mistake.
translation: 소풍 갈 만한 곳은 절대 아니다, 틀림없어.

english: Watch where yer goin'!
I was!
Then it must have been my fault and I apologise [lad/lass].
And I accept your apology. Good day.
translation: 사과는 받아 줄게요. 좋은 하루 보내세요.

english: Aye, good day te ye too.
Arr!
Arr?
Arr?
Arr!
Arr...
Arr.
Good morning!
I suppose it is. What of it?
I was just striking up a conversation.
translation: 그냥 말 좀 걸어 본 거예요.

english: Well...why would ye do a thing like that?
No reason.
What ship did ye pull in on, stranger?
The Adventurous.
That's a good ship, that it be.
Keep yer voice down [lass/lad], can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: 목소리 좀 낮춰라, [lass/lad]. 나 바쁜 거 안 보이냐?

english: First off, it's [lad/lass], and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: 첫째, [lad/lass](이)라고 해야죠. 둘째, 술 취하느라 바쁜 거 말고는 뭐가 바쁘다는 건지 하나도 모르겠는데요.

english: I can't feel me brains no more...
Wait...I recognise that smell. You've been drinking 'rum' haven't you?
translation: 잠깐... 이 냄새 알아요. '럼주' 마셨죠, 그렇죠?

english: Arr...ye shufflin' muffle burble...
I think that can be filed as a 'yes'.
Are ye here for...you know...the stuff...
translation: 너 혹시... 그거... 알잖아... '그거' 때문에 왔냐...

english: The what?
The stuff...you know...the stuff?
I'm not sure I follow you.
Aren't ye Toothless [Kevin/Lisa]?
No.
Sorry, sorry, my mistake!
Ain't ye the scurvy curr that killed my brother?
translation: 네가 내 형제를 죽인 그 비열한 똥개 아니냐?

english: Well I'm not sure.
I kill so many things on a daily basis that it all tends to blur together.
translation: 매일 죽이는 게 하도 많아서 다 뒤죽박죽이거든요.

english: Tell me, did they have any unusual features that would help me to recall them?
translation: 혹시 기억해 낼 만한 특이한 특징 같은 거 없었어요?

english: How many things de ye have te kill in a day te lose count?
translation: 하루에 대체 얼마나 죽여야 셀 수도 없게 되는 거냐?

english: I don't know, if I did I wouldn't have lost count!
translation: 모르죠, 알았으면 셀 수 없게 되지도 않았겠죠!

english: Now, about your brother...
Never mind! I never liked him that much anyway!
translation: 됐다! 어차피 그놈 그렇게 좋아하지도 않았어!

english: It's rather quiet around here for a pirate haven isn't it?
Arr, we like te keep the peace around here.
translation: 아르르, 우린 여기서 평화를 지키는 걸 좋아하거든.

english: Some of the older pirates don't like it, but Mos Le'Harmless be a hive of sense and civility.
translation: 나이 든 해적 몇몇은 싫어하지만, Mos Le'Harmless(모스 르하믈레스)는 분별과 예의가 넘치는 곳이다.

english: How nice!
Arr, that it be.
What's yer business?
I was wondering who you are.
Well, I'm one of the militia, we try and keep the rest of the pirates in line.
translation: 음, 난 민병대원이다. 다른 해적들이 선을 넘지 않게 단속하지.

english: Well, as in line as we reckon they need to be.
translation: 뭐, 우리가 보기에 필요한 만큼만 말이다.

english: So how do you decide who becomes a member of the militia?
Well, if yer ship is in need of repairs and yer in port, then yer a member, simple as that.
translation: 음, 배가 수리를 받아야 하는데 항구에 정박 중이면 민병대원이다. 간단하지.

english: See, those of us that are here for a long haul tend to want to keep things peaceful, so we keep an eye on everyone else as and when they come in.
translation: 그러니까 여기 오래 머무는 우리 같은 놈들은 평화롭게 지내고 싶어 하거든. 그래서 다른 놈들이 들어올 때마다 지켜보는 거다.

english: Given the number of skirmishes we have with customs, there is never a shortage of repairs needed.
translation: 세관 놈들이랑 하도 자주 부딪쳐서 수리할 거리가 떨어질 날이 없지.

english: Thanks, that was very informative.
Just passing through.
See to it ye keeps outs trouble, stranger.
Just looking about.
Well good luck with that, landlubber.
Adventuring!
Adventurin' eh...that sounds like customs and excise work to my ears.
translation: 모험이라... 내 귀엔 꼭 세관 일처럼 들리는데.

english: No, no, I'm a pirate, honest. I have the book and everything.
translation: 아니, 아니에요, 저 해적이에요, 진짜로요. 책이랑 다 있다고요.

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs [boy/girl]. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 지켜보고 있겠다, 세관 [boy/girl] 녀석. 한 발짝만 선을 넘어 봐라, 쾅이다.

english: They won't find enough of ye to feed a hungry sea slug.
translation: 배고픈 sea slug(바다 민달팽이) 한 마리 먹일 만큼도 안 남을 거다.

english: Just looking around. What is there to do here?
translation: 그냥 둘러보는 중이에요. 여기선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Well, if yeve got some coins in yer purse ye can head over to Joe's house of 'Rum' and get yerself drunk.
translation: 음, 주머니에 코인 좀 있으면 Joe(조)네 'Rum'(럼주) 집에 가서 진탕 취해도 되고.

english: Anything else?
Well, Smithin' Smith and Dodgy Mike have some stuff to sell, and ye can always try grabbin' some fish from Two Feet Charley if yer hungry.
translation: 음, Smithin' Smith(대장장이 스미스)랑 Dodgy Mike(수상한 마이크)가 물건을 좀 팔고, 배고프면 Two Feet Charley(두 발 찰리)한테서 물고기를 좀 얻어 볼 수도 있지.

english: Is that it?
Well, ye can head out to the brewery and have a word with Fancy Dan or San Fan. They always need a hand out there.
translation: 음, 양조장에 가서 Fancy Dan(멋쟁이 댄)이나 San Fan(산판)이랑 얘기해 봐도 된다. 거긴 늘 일손이 모자라거든.

english: Doing what?
Doin' each others heads in most of the time.
translation: 대부분은 서로 골치 아프게 하는 거지.

english: What is your business?
Nothing much, just passing through.
Well have a good day, [sir/miss].
I'm sorry, but you don't sound much like a pirate, how did you come to be here?
translation: 죄송하지만, 해적 같은 말투가 아니시네요. 어쩌다 여기 오게 됐어요?

english: I used to be a language tutor, teaching in a small school just outside of Lumbridge.
translation: 저는 원래 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 바로 외곽의 작은 학교에서 언어를 가르치던 교사였습니다.

english: However the place closed down due to ill attendance, and so I was forced to take up piracy.
translation: 그런데 학생들이 오지 않아 학교가 문을 닫는 바람에, 어쩔 수 없이 해적질에 나서게 되었지요.

english: Wasn't that a bit of a big jump in careers?
translation: 직업을 바꾼 것치곤 너무 큰 도약 아니에요?

english: Not really, I made my way through via a short stint as a lawyer.
translation: 그렇지도 않습니다. 중간에 잠깐 변호사 일을 거쳤거든요.

english: Well, that makes sense.
I must return to my duties. Have a nice day!
translation: 이제 제 일로 돌아가 봐야겠습니다. 좋은 하루 되십시오!

english: You too!
What's yours?
I asked first!
And very rudely too I might add.
Fine! Go about yer 'business'!
I will!
Whaz yer bushinessssss...ssss?
Are you drunk on duty?
I'm not drunk! I'll knock down any man as sayin' I'm been having a drinking on my duties!
translation: 나 안 취해써! 내가 근무 중에 술 마셔따고 하는 놈은 누구든 때려누필 거야!

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
translation: 꼬인 혀, 이상한 행동, 콧구멍이 녹아내릴 것 같은 지독한 냄새, 데굴데굴 구르는 충혈된 눈까지... 안 취했다면 그걸 다 설명하기 힘들 텐데요.

english: Arrr, ye got me. I just can't leave the stuff alone.
translation: 아르르, 들켰군. 그걸 도저히 끊을 수가 없어.

english: Cap'n Braindeath's Ten X With Added Cattle Medication just keeps singin' its siren song to me.
translation: Cap'n Braindeath(브레인데스 선장)의 '텐 엑스 가축 약 첨가판'이 자꾸만 나한테 세이렌의 노래를 불러 대거든.

english: Would ye care fer a drop?
No.  I would most certainly not.
Suit yerself.
None of yours.
Fair enough. Off ye go.
I'm just helping out a friend.
Which friend?
Bill Teach.
Bill hired you eh? He must have been scrapin' the barrel and no mistake.
translation: 빌이 널 고용했다고? 어지간히 사람이 없었나 보군, 틀림없어.

english: Hey! I resent that!
Hello!
Arrh I'll keel haul ye!
Pieces of eight! pieces of eight!
Oh wait that's the parrot's line.
You'll be joining Davey Jones in his locker!
translation: 넌 곧 Davey Jones(데이비 존스)의 궤짝 신세가 될 거다!

english: Batton down the hatches there's a storm a brewin!
A pox on ye!
Arrrh ye lily livered landlubber!
Arrh arrh!
Avast me hearties!
Shiver me timbers!
3 days at port for resupply then out on the high sea!
translation: 항구에서 3일 보급하고 나면 다시 먼바다로 나간다!

english: I think ye'll be taking a long walk off a short plank!
translation: 넌 짧은 판자 끝에서 아주 긴 산책을 하게 될 거다!

english: Ahoy there!
Keel haul them I say!
Splice the mainbrace!
Great blackbeard's beard!
I'm the scourge of the six seas!
Don't you mean seven seas?
I'm the scourge of the seven seas!
Good day to you my dear sir!
Man overboard!
I don't think Mr Grip will like you opening that. That's his private drinks cabinet.
translation: Grip(그립) 나리가 그거 여는 걸 좋아하지 않을 거다. 그건 나리 개인 술 진열장이거든.

english: He won't notice me having a quick look.
Stay out of my drinks cabinet!
Grip walks into the room
You find a bottle of whiskey in the cupboard.
Ok, I'll leave it.
He won't notice me having a quick look.
Ok, I'll leave it.
Ahoy!
What is this place?
Welcome to the Brimhaven Agility Arena!
translation: Brimhaven Agility Arena(브림헤이븐 민첩 경기장)에 온 걸 환영한다!

english: If ye want to know more talk to Cap'n Izzy, he found it!
translation: 더 알고 싶으면 Cap'n Izzy(이지 선장)한테 물어봐. 그 양반이 여길 찾아냈거든!

english: What do you do?
I be the Jack o' Tickets. I exchange the tickets ye collect in the Agility Arena for more stuff. Ye can obtain more agility experience or some items ye won't find anywhere else!
translation: 난 티켓지기 잭이다. 네가 Agility Arena(민첩 경기장)에서 모은 티켓을 이것저것으로 바꿔 주지. 민첩 경험치를 더 얻을 수도 있고, 다른 데선 못 구하는 물건도 얻을 수 있어!

english: Sounds good!
I'd like to trade in my tickets, please.
Aye, ye be on the right tack.
I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: I've done all the easy tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Achievement Diary(카람자 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 전부 끝냈어요.

english: Arr, ye have that, I see yer list. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward then!
translation: 아르르, 그렇군. 네 목록을 보니 알겠어. 보상을 받고 싶은 거겠지!

english: Arrr, ye'll 'ave ta come back when ye has more space in yer pack.
translation: 아르르, 네 꾸러미에 자리가 더 생기면 다시 와.

english: These 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer explorin' on the island. I'll 'ave a word with some of the seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne, so they'll take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: 여기 이 Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)은 네가 섬을 탐험했다는 증표다. Port Sarim(포트 사림)이랑 Ardougne(아르둔)으로 오가는 뱃사람들한테 말해 둘 테니, 이걸 끼고 있으면 반값에 배를 태워 줄 거다.

english: I've done all the medium tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Achievement Diary(카람자 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 전부 끝냈어요.

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded then!
translation: 아르르, 정말 그렇군. 보상을 업그레이드하고 싶은 거겠지!

english: Yes please.

The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye get a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena, an' ye can use the stepping stone in

english: Wow, thanks!
I've done all the hard tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Achievement Diary(카람자 업적 일지)의 상급 과제를 전부 끝냈어요.

english: Arr, so ye have. I s'pose ye'll be wantin' yer reward upgraded again!
translation: 아르르, 정말 그렇군. 보상을 또 업그레이드하고 싶은 거겠지!

translation: 여기 이 Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)에 걸린 마법은 네가 샅샅이 탐험했다는 증표지. 이제 이걸로 Shilo Village(실로 마을) 아래 광산까지 몇 번이고 갈 수 있고, 상인들도 전부 할인해 줄 거다. 이 lamp(등불)

english: too.
I've done all the elite tasks in my Karamja Achievement Diary.
translation: Karamja Achievement Diary(카람자 업적 일지)의 엘리트 과제를 전부 끝냈어요.

english: Arr, that be an incredible achievement, so it be! I suppose ye'll be wanting yer reward upgraded again.
translation: 아르르, 정말 대단한 업적이로군, 암! 보상을 또 업그레이드하고 싶은 거겠지.

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be the ultimate symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. Ye'll now get double TokKul from the Fight Cave, Inferno an' TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges.
translation: 여기 이 Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)에 걸린 마법은 네가 샅샅이 탐험했다는 최고의 증표다. 이제 Fight Cave(투기 동굴), Inferno(인페르노), TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges(츠하르-켓-락의 도전)에서 TokKul(토쿨)을 두 배로 받을 거다.

english: Ye'll have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use some more shortcuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free.
translation: 여기 우리 Agility Arena(민첩 경기장)에서 티켓을 두 배로 받을 기회도 생기지. Fight Cave(투기 동굴)에서 하루에 한 번 부활할 수 있고, 섬 곳곳의 지름길을 더 쓸 수 있고, 몇몇 곳은 공짜로 들어갈 수도 있다.

english: I can make the metal dragons under Brimhaven give ye bars as banknotes too, if ye likes.
translation: 원한다면 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐) 아래 금속 드래곤들이 주괴를 은행 증서로 떨구게 해 줄 수도 있어.

english: Ye can have that lamp too.
What is the Achievement Diary?
Arrr, it be a diary that tracks yer achievements on Karamja. Once ye've explored enough, I give ye some enchanted gloves, an' the people of Karamja reward ye for yer hard work.
translation: 아르르, Karamja(카람자)에서 네가 이룬 업적을 기록하는 일지다. 충분히 탐험하면 내가 마법 걸린 장갑을 주고, 카람자 사람들도 네 수고에 보답할 거다.

english: What are the rewards?
Arrr, that depends what tier ye wants to know about.
translation: 아르르, 어느 단계가 궁금하냐에 따라 다르지.

english: Ye gets a pair of special Karamja gloves. The seafarin' folk who sail to Port Sarim and Ardougne will take ye on board half price if ye be wearin' them.
translation: 특별한 Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)을 한 켤레 받는다. 이걸 끼고 있으면 Port Sarim(포트 사림)이랑 Ardougne(아르둔)으로 가는 뱃사람들이 반값에 태워 줄 거다.

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so ye gets a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena with 'em on. Ye can use the stepping stone in Shilo Village, an ye still gets the easy rewards too.
translation: 아르르, Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)을 업그레이드해 주지. 끼고 있으면 우리 Agility Arena(민첩 경기장)에서 소소한 혜택을 더 받는다. Shilo Village(실로 마을)의 stepping stone(징검돌)도 쓸 수 있고, 초급 보상도 그대로 받지.

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so they can take ye to a special mine under Shilo Village. Ye still gets the easy and medium rewards too.
translation: 아르르, Karamja gloves(카람자 장갑)을 업그레이드해서 Shilo Village(실로 마을) 아래 특별한 광산으로 데려다주게 해 주지. 초급이랑 중급 보상도 그대로 받는다.
