english: Thank you Reldo, you've been most... helpful.
translation: 고마워요, Reldo(렐도). 정말... 도움이 많이 됐네요.

english: That was a nice tale for mothers to tell their children but I don't see how this helps Bob?
translation: 엄마들이 애들한테 들려주기 좋은 이야기긴 한데, 이게 Bob(밥)한테 무슨 도움이 되는지 모르겠어.

english: Don't you think it's odd that no one knows where Bob came from?
translation: Bob(밥)이 어디서 왔는지 아무도 모른다는 게 이상하지 않아?

english: I guess, but he's just a cat... right?
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 걔는 그냥 고양이잖아... 그렇지?

english: I'd hoped you would've understood by now that there's more to cats than humans believe!
translation: 고양이란 인간들이 생각하는 것 이상의 존재라는 걸 이제쯤은 네가 알아줬으면 했는데!

english: Ok, ok! I get your point, after all I'm being dragged round Gielinor by... my cat!
translation: 알았어, 알았어! 무슨 말인지 알겠어. 어쨌든 난 지금... 내 고양이한테 끌려서 Gielinor(길리노르)를 돌아다니고 있으니까!

english: I wouldn't say dragged... let's call it a partnership!
translation: 끌려다닌다는 말은 좀 그렇고... 동업이라고 해 두자!

english: Ok!
Bob?!
Let's ask Bob!
Let's go!
Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
translation: 안녕하세요. 혹시 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: What do you need?
I'm looking for information on a Fourth Age hero. His name was Tristan and he fought alongside Robert the Strong.
translation: 제4시대 영웅에 대한 정보를 찾고 있어요. 이름은 Tristan(트리스탄)이고, Robert the Strong(힘센 로버트)와 함께 싸웠대요.

english: Ah you must mean Tristan Corvo. I can't remember anyone ever asking about him before, most prefer to hear about the bigger heroes like Arrav or Robert.
translation: 아, Tristan Corvo(트리스탄 코르보) 말씀이군요. 그에 대해 묻는 사람은 처음인 것 같네요. 다들 Arrav(아라브)나 Robert(로버트) 같은 더 유명한 영웅 이야기를 듣고 싶어 하거든요.

english: But you know about Tristan?
Oh yes. What was it you wanted to learn?
I'd like to learn about his descendants. I know they lived in this area.
translation: 그의 후손에 대해 알고 싶어요. 이 지역에 살았다는 건 알아요.

english: Well we do have census records which date back to when the city was still called Avarrocka. I'm afraid we don't have anything from before that time though.
translation: 이 도시가 아직 Avarrocka(아바로카)라고 불리던 시절까지 거슬러 올라가는 인구 조사 기록이 있어요. 아쉽게도 그 이전 기록은 없지만요.

english: Hmmm. It might still be worth a look. Where can I find this information?
translation: 흐음. 그래도 한번 볼 만하겠네요. 그 정보는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: I have a book around here somewhere with all of the details, why don't you see if you can find it. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 자세한 내용이 다 담긴 책이 이 근처 어딘가에 있어요. 한번 찾아보시겠어요? 제 기억이 맞다면 빨간 책이에요.

english: Have you found that book yet?
I have it here.
Wonderful, let's have a look.
So what does the book say?
Okay let's see... The Corvo family... Here we are! According to this there was a family by the name of Corvo living in Avarrocka for most of the Fourth Age.
translation: 자, 어디 보자... Corvo(코르보) 가문... 여기 있네요! 이 기록에 따르면 제4시대 대부분 동안 Avarrocka(아바로카)에 코르보라는 이름의 가문이 살았어요.

english: The last entry is from the year 1770 of the Fourth Age.
What happened to them?
Impossible to say for sure but it was around that time that many people left Misthalin to settle in Morytania. It's possible that the Corvo family was among them.
translation: 확실히 말하긴 어렵지만, 그 무렵 많은 사람이 Misthalin(미스탈린)을 떠나 Morytania(모리타니아)에 정착했어요. Corvo(코르보) 가문도 그중에 있었을 수 있어요.

english: I'm afraid that's all the help I can provide. Port Phasmatys is where most of the Morytania settlers wound up. Perhaps you'll find what you're looking for there.
translation: 제가 도와드릴 수 있는 건 여기까지예요. Morytania(모리타니아) 정착민 대부분은 Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)에 자리 잡았어요. 거기서 찾으시는 걸 발견할 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Okay, thanks Reldo.
I found it but then I lost it.
You lost it?
I'm sorry. I'm a terrible person.
Well you'd better find it again. These books are very valuable.
translation: 그럼 다시 찾아오시는 게 좋겠어요. 이 책들은 아주 귀한 거예요.

english: Not yet.
I know it's around here somewhere. It's red if I remember right.
translation: 이 근처 어딘가에 있는 건 확실해요. 제 기억이 맞다면 빨간 책이에요.

english: Hello.
Did you have any luck finding the Corvo family?
Port Phasmatys might be a good place to look. It's where most of the Morytania settlers wound up.
translation: Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)를 찾아보시면 좋을 거예요. Morytania(모리타니아) 정착민 대부분이 거기 자리 잡았거든요.

english: Hi Reldo, I have come to ask you to help with something.
translation: 안녕하세요 Reldo(렐도), 도움을 좀 청하러 왔어요.

english: What can I do for you [player name]?
You show Reldo your clue scroll.
translation: Reldo(렐도)에게 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 보여 준다.

english: Ah! Do you know about hot and cold clues?
translation: 아! 핫 앤 콜드 단서에 대해 아세요?

english: Yes, I do.
Well then use this strange device to feel where your destination is and dig.
translation: 그럼 이 strange device(이상한 장치)로 목적지가 어디인지 느껴 보고 땅을 파세요.

english: You should make some room for it before I can give you it.
translation: 제가 드리기 전에 공간을 좀 마련해 두세요.

english: No, I don't.
Ah, you use a strange device to tell you how far away you are from the place you need to be. When you get to your destination you dig.
translation: 아, strange device(이상한 장치)를 쓰면 가야 할 곳에서 얼마나 떨어져 있는지 알 수 있어요. 목적지에 도착하면 땅을 파면 돼요.

english: Hey Reldo, I have one of those clue scrolls again, do you have any advice?
translation: Reldo(렐도), 또 그 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)가 생겼는데, 조언해 주실 거 있어요?

english: That strange device will guide you in the same way the key did. Feel it, but be careful as it is very powerful. Good luck.
translation: 그 strange device(이상한 장치)가 열쇠가 그랬던 것처럼 길을 안내해 줄 거예요. 느껴 보세요. 하지만 아주 강력하니 조심하세요. 행운을 빌어요.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
The Wise Old Man of Draynor Village sent you this message.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을)의 Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 이 메시지를 보냈어요.

english: If the player receives coins:
If the player receives seeds:
If the player receives runes:
Do you have anything to trade?
What do you do?
What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?
translation: Imcando(임칸도) 드워프에 대해 뭘 알고 계세요?

english: Ask about the brooch.
Talk about something else.
Ask about Imcando dwarves.
Ask about Robert the Strong.
translation: Robert the Strong(힘센 로버트)에 대해 물어본다.

english: Ask about Tristan.
Yes, I do.
No, I don't.
Hello, my friend. Would you like me to show you the prices of logs?
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구. 통나무 시세를 보여 드릴까요?

english: You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 꽤 먼 길을 오신 것 같네요.

english: What gave me away?
I don't mean to be rude, but the clothing and hair, for starters.
translation: 무례하게 굴려는 건 아니지만, 우선 옷차림이랑 머리 모양이요.

english: Ah, yes. I'm from Shilo Village on Karamja, it's a style I've had since I was little.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 저는 Karamja(카람자)의 Shilo Village(실로 마을)에서 왔어요. 어릴 때부터 이 스타일이었죠.

english: Then tell me, why are you so far from home?
translation: 그럼 말해 주세요, 왜 고향에서 이렇게 멀리 와 있는 거예요?

english: This Grand Exchange! Isn't it marvellous! I've never seen anything like it in my life.
translation: 이 Grand Exchange(그랜드 익스체인지) 말이에요! 정말 놀랍지 않아요? 평생 이런 건 본 적이 없어요.

english: My people were saddened when I chose to leave home and travel here, but I hope to make some serious profit, then return to my tribe.
translation: 제가 고향을 떠나 여기로 오겠다고 했을 때 우리 부족 사람들은 슬퍼했어요. 하지만 큰돈을 벌어서 부족에게 돌아가고 싶어요.

english: So, what are you selling?
Logs! Of all kinds! That's my plan, at least. Living in the jungle as we do, my people understand exotic wood very well indeed.
translation: 통나무요! 온갖 종류로요! 적어도 계획은 그래요. 정글에 사는 만큼 우리 부족은 이국적인 나무를 아주 잘 알거든요.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Okay, nice talking to you!
Just one more offer! One more!
translation: 한 건만 더! 딱 한 건만 더!

english: Such a joy it is to be in this building.
translation: 이 건물 안에 있다니 정말 기쁘구나.

english: Yes! Yet another great deal.
translation: 좋았어! 또 한 건 대박 거래야.

english: My people shall be so proud!
Hmmm. These numbers don't quite add up.
You look like you've travelled a fair distance.
translation: 꽤 먼 길을 오신 것 같네요.

english: Okay, show me the prices of logs.
Sorry, I need to be making tracks.
Hello.
Well done, well done. Not many find their way in here.
translation: 잘했어요, 정말 잘했어요. 여기까지 길을 찾아 들어오는 사람은 많지 않아요.

english: I'm Remsai, a tree gnome. We live in this maze for our protection. Have a look around and enjoy.
translation: 저는 Remsai(렘사이), 나무 노움이에요. 우리는 몸을 지키려고 이 미로 속에 살아요. 편하게 둘러보세요.

english: Oh my, oh my!
What's wrong?
The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.
translation: 오브, 그들이 오브를 가져갔어요. 오브를 되찾아 오지 않으면 우린 끝장이에요.

english: Hello Remsai.
Hello, did you find the orb?
No, I'm afraid not.
Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 제발요, 우리가 살아남으려면 오브가 꼭 있어야 해요.

english: I have it here.
You're our saviour.
Are you ok?
Khazard's men came. Without the orb we were defenceless. They killed many and then took our last hope, the other orbs.
translation: Khazard(카자드)의 부하들이 왔어요. 오브가 없으니 우린 무방비 상태였죠. 그들은 많은 이를 죽이고 우리의 마지막 희망인 다른 오브들까지 가져가 버렸어요.

english: Now surely we're all doomed. Without them the spirit tree is useless.
translation: 이제 정말 우린 다 끝장이에요. 그것들이 없으면 spirit tree(정령 나무)는 쓸모가 없어요.

english: I've returned.
You're back, well done brave adventurer. Now the orbs are safe we can perform the ritual for the spirit tree. We can live in peace once again.
translation: 돌아오셨군요, 정말 잘하셨어요, 용감한 모험가님. 이제 오브들이 무사하니 spirit tree(정령 나무)를 위한 의식을 치를 수 있어요. 다시 평화롭게 살 수 있겠어요.

english: Hi there traveller.  You're a legend around these parts.
translation: 안녕하세요, 여행자님. 이 근방에선 당신이 전설이에요.

english: Thanks Remsai.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우우? 우우우우 우우 우우우우우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우우 우우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우! 우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 음, 확실히 말이 안 되긴 하네요.

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데, 진짜로요. 저 엄~~~청 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 순 없다고들 하지만, 가끔은 은행 계좌를 열어서 제가 가진 걸 전부 쳐다보며 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋더라고요.

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 음, 우리같이 살아 있는 부자들은 당신처럼 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 시간 낭비하고 싶지 않거든요. 전 너~~무 부자라서 이제 가 봐야 해요. 어쩌면 더 부자가 될지도 모르고요.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
translation: 네, 저도 그 얘기 들었어요, 하하하!

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 늘 맞는 말이죠. 또 봐요, 이상한 투명 망자 양반!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘진 않은데 전 익힌 닭고기가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도요, 하지만 집에서 구운 파이만 한 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 그래요? 처음 알았네요. 음, 전 이만 가 볼게요. 또 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너희는 살아남을 기회가 없다 너의 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 저한테 그런 식으로 말해도 된다고 생각하지 마요!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 제가 당신을 해칠 방법을 못 찾을 거라 생각하지 마요, 유령 양반!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아뇨, 전 평생 거기 가 본 적도 없고, 갔을 때도 절대로 아무것도 안 훔쳤어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 지금 저보고 거짓말쟁이라는 거예요?!?! 전 평생 뭘 훔친 적이 없어요. 그리고 제가 남이 피땀 흘려 번

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 돈을 주머니에서 훔쳐 갈 만큼 도덕적으로 타락한 인간이라는 듯한 말에 정말 기분 나쁘다고요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 케이크나 모피도요. 몇 번이고요. 한 번에 한참씩.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나오신다면 이 문제에 대해선 더 할 말 없네요. 그럼 안녕히 계세요!

english: Hello. You must be Rennard.
What be this? You both see me and hear me, and also know my name?
translation: 이게 뭐냐? 날 보고 내 말까지 듣는 데다, 내 이름까지 안다고?

english: Tell me what devilry brings you here, and be quick about it afore I gut you like a fish!
translation: 무슨 수작으로 여기 왔는지 냉큼 말해 봐라. 생선 배 따듯 네 배를 갈라 버리기 전에!

english: Well, apart from the fact I ain't scared of no ghost, I am here because I have spoken to Valdez.
translation: 음, 유령 따위 하나도 안 무섭다는 건 둘째 치고, 제가 여기 온 건 Valdez(발데즈)와 얘기를 나눴기 때문이에요.

english: Valdez? Who be that? Some foul necromancer?
translation: Valdez(발데즈)? 그게 누구냐? 무슨 더러운 강령술사라도 되냐?

english: No, he was a ghost I met near Glarial's tomb.
translation: 아뇨, Glarial's tomb(글라리알의 무덤) 근처에서 만난 유령이에요.

english: He seems convinced that the artefact you stole from him is responsible for him becoming cursed to be an invisible ghost.
translation: 당신이 훔쳐 간 유물 때문에 자기가 투명 유령이 되는 저주에 걸렸다고 굳게 믿고 있더라고요.

english: Seems like he might be onto something too, given the state of you.
translation: 당신 꼴을 보니 그 말이 맞을지도 모르겠네요.

english: A curse ye say... Aye, that makes sense...
translation: 저주라고 했냐... 그래, 그럼 말이 되지...

english: And there was I thinking my fate be the fault of the thieving and murdering I spent me life a-doing...
translation: 난 또 이 신세가 평생 도둑질하고 사람 죽이고 다닌 탓인 줄 알았지...

english: So it all began the day I stole that staff, ye say? Aye, that be a story I have never told another soul...
translation: 그러니까 내가 그 지팡이를 훔친 날부터 다 시작됐다 이거냐? 그래, 그건 내가 아무한테도 해 본 적 없는 이야기지...

english: Why don't you tell me what happened? I might be able to help...
translation: 무슨 일이 있었는지 얘기해 줄래요? 제가 도울 수 있을지도 몰라요...

english: Well, I was making me merry way along, having just pulled off a glorious jewellery heist from a bunch of stinking dwarves...
translation: 그러니까, 냄새나는 드워프 놈들한테서 장신구를 한 건 멋지게 털고 신나게 길을 가고 있었거든...

english: Hey, that's no way to talk about dwarves! Some of my best friends are short!
translation: 이봐요, 드워프를 그렇게 말하면 안 되죠! 제 절친 중에도 키 작은 친구들이 있다고요!

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me [lad/lass], I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: 아, 오해했구먼, [lad/lass]. 드워프 종족 전체를 싸잡아 말한 게 아냐. 마침 고약한 냄새를 풍기던 아주 특정한 드워프 무리한테서 보석 꾸러미를 훔쳤다는 것뿐이야!

english: Oh. Well I guess that's okay then. Please continue.

Well, as I headed on me merry way, hoping the foul odours that lingered in me nostrils would soon pass, I see in front of me this explorer fella, all decked out in in his fine clothing, and carrying some long package
translation: 그래서 콧구멍에 남은 고약한 냄새가 얼른 가시길 바라면서 신나게 길을 가는데, 눈앞에 웬 탐험가 녀석이 좋은 옷을 쫙 빼입고 기다란 꾸러미를 들고 가더라고.

english: bundled in rags.
So I says to meself, 'Rennard', I says, 'Rennard, why would some fella all dressed in his finery be carrying something wrapped in dirty rags?'.
translation: 그래서 내가 속으로 그랬지. 'Rennard(레너드)', 내가 그랬지, '레너드, 좋은 옷 빼입은 녀석이 왜 더러운 누더기로 싼 물건을 들고 다닐까?'

english: So I thinks to meself a little more, 'Rennard', I thinks, 'Rennard, maybe that fella has something valuable in there, and he covered it in dirty rags so it don't look so valuable'.
translation: 그래서 좀 더 생각해 봤지. 'Rennard(레너드)', 내가 생각했지, '레너드, 저 녀석 저 안에 값나가는 게 있어서 안 값나가 보이게 더러운 누더기로 싸 놓은 거 아닐까?'

english: So I coshed this fella round the back of his head with me bag of jewels, picked up his package and was on me merry way afore he comes to.
translation: 그래서 보석 자루로 그 녀석 뒤통수를 한 대 갈기고, 꾸러미를 챙겨서 녀석이 깨어나기 전에 신나게 내 갈 길을 갔지.

english: So what happened then?
Well, I makes me way to the closest tavern I knew of that catered to my sort of people...
translation: 그래서 나 같은 부류를 받아 주는 제일 가까운 선술집으로 갔지...

english: You mean thieves?
Right ye are, so I makes me way to the nearest friendly tavern, and unwraps the bundle to see what it had inside.
translation: 바로 그거야. 그래서 제일 가까운 우리 편 선술집으로 가서 꾸러미를 풀고 안에 뭐가 있나 봤지.

english: The Staff of Armadyl?
Was it? Ah, I never knew that...
Anysways, I unwraps this staff, and sees it be a god- weapon; I may be just a common thief, but I recognises a weapon not made by mortal hands when I sees one.
translation: 아무튼 그 지팡이를 풀어 보니 신의 무기더라고. 내가 그냥 흔해 빠진 도둑이긴 해도, 인간 손으로 만든 게 아닌 무기는 보면 딱 알아보거든.

english: So what did you do then?
Well, I knew such a weapon would be of great value to...
translation: 음, 그런 무기라면 엄청난 값어치가 있을 거란 걸 알았지. 바로...

english: Now that's funny. Can't remember his name, now. The powerful god, lived in the North-east. Took the Mahjarrat away from under Icthlarin's
translation: 이거 참 웃기네. 지금 그 이름이 기억이 안 나. 북동쪽에 살던 강력한 신 말이야. Icthlarin(익스라린)의 손아귀에서 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)을

english: control.
Anyway, I hired me a messenger to go off and let him know I had something I was prepared to sell that I thought he'd be interested in...
translation: 아무튼 전령을 하나 고용해서, 그 신이 관심 있어 할 만한 물건을 팔 생각이 있다고 전하라고 보냈지...

english: Now WHY can't I remember his name? Very odd that...
translation: 대체 왜 그 이름이 기억이 안 나지? 참 이상하네...

english: So you sold the staff to this god you can't remember?
translation: 그래서 기억도 안 나는 그 신한테 지팡이를 팔았다고요?

english: Well, that's the other funny thing... He never showed up, he sent some General or other instead.
translation: 음, 그게 또 웃긴 점인데... 그 신은 끝내 안 나타나고, 웬 장군인가 하는 놈을 대신 보냈더라고.

english: Hmmm... You know... Thinking back on that, I'm getting the feeling that messenger did a little doublecross of his own, and took
translation: 흠... 있잖아... 그때 일을 돌이켜 보니, 그 전령 놈이 나름대로 뒤통수를 쳐서

english: me message to the wrong fella.
translation: 내 메시지를 엉뚱한 놈한테 가져간 것 같단 말이지.

english: So what was this General's name?
His name was Zamorak. I remember thinking at the time it was odd, because the fella was a mighty powerful warrior, but was never fully trusted by...
translation: 그 녀석 이름은 Zamorak(자모락)이었어. 그때 이상하다고 생각했던 게 기억나. 그 녀석은 어마어마하게 강한 전사였는데, 한 번도 온전히 신임받지 못했거든. 바로...

english: WHY can't I remember his name???
translation: 대체 왜 그 이름이 기억이 안 나는 거야???

english: So you suspect the messenger might have taken the message to the wrong person? So you think it was an accident or deliberate?
translation: 그러니까 전령이 메시지를 엉뚱한 사람에게 가져갔을지도 모른다는 거죠? 실수였을까요, 고의였을까요?

english: Well that I can't tell ya, but if something happened to get me cursed, it's likely the messenger would know what more than me.
translation: 그건 나도 모르지. 하지만 무슨 일 때문에 내가 저주를 받은 거라면, 그 전령이 나보다 더 잘 알 거야.

english: His name was Kharrim, and if he caused me to be stuck like this, I'm gonna fillet him like a dog, ghost or no!
translation: 그 녀석 이름은 Kharrim(카림)이야. 그놈 때문에 내가 이렇게 갇혀 있는 거라면, 유령이고 뭐고 개처럼 포를 떠 버릴 테다!

english: I tell ye what, you've given me much to think about so I'd like to offer yer a gift; Here, take these, they were the gloves I stole me first cake with, they might bring yer some luck.
translation: 이봐, 덕분에 생각할 게 많아졌으니 선물을 하나 주지. 자, 이거 받아. 내가 처음으로 케이크를 훔칠 때 꼈던 장갑이야. 운이 좀 따를지도 모르지.

english: Where can I find this Kharrim then?
translation: 그럼 그 Kharrim(카림)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Kharrim the messenger... Well, he was always a devoted follower of old General Zamorak, and if I remember rightly Zamorak set up a small base in an old temple near Dareeyak...
translation: 전령 Kharrim(카림)이라... 그 녀석은 늘 그 Zamorak(자모락) 장군의 충실한 추종자였지. 내 기억이 맞다면 자모락이 Dareeyak(다레이악) 근처의 오래된 신전에 작은 기지를 세웠을 거야...

english: You might want to check around there.
Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagar to seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
translation: 전령 Kharrim(카림)이라... 마지막으로 들은 소식으로는 한몫 잡겠다고 Carrallagar(캐럴랭가)로 떠났다더군. 그 근처 어딘가를 찾아봐.

english: Kharrim the messenger... The last I'd heard of that weasel he was claiming he'd found some underground deposit of runite ore guarded by demons and dragons.
translation: 전령 Kharrim(카림)이라... 그 족제비 같은 놈에 대해 마지막으로 들은 건, 악마랑 용이 지키는 runite ore(루나이트 광석) 지하 매장지를 찾았다고 떠벌리던 거였지.

english: I suspect he was pulling some scam or other, but if you know of such a place, that might be a good place to start checking.
translation: 무슨 사기를 치고 있던 것 같긴 한데, 그런 곳을 안다면 거기서부터 찾아보는 게 좋겠어.

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데, 솔직히 별 관심은 없네요. 안녕히.

english: Hello again Rennard.
Ah, it be you again! What can I do fer ya?
Can you tell me where I can find Kharrim again?
translation: Kharrim(카림)을 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 다시 알려 줄래요?

english: Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 전에 주셨던 ghostly robes(유령 로브)를 더 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 날 여기 붙잡아 두는 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양이야... 어느 걸 원하냐?

english: Here you go.
The endless tragedy of fate... Why must you torment me so?
translation: 끝없는 운명의 비극이여... 어찌하여 나를 이리도 괴롭히는가?

english: Alright, alright, calm down, calm down. All I said was 'hello'!
translation: 알았어요, 알았어요, 진정해요, 진정. 전 그냥 '안녕'이라고 했을 뿐이라고요!

english: You can see me?
Uh... yes?
And you understand my words?
Well, most of them...
This is incredible! How can such a thing have come to pass?
translation: 놀랍구려! 어찌 이런 일이 일어날 수 있단 말이오?

english: What can I say? I'm a professional.
Hello back at you.
So what's a nice ghost like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 이렇게 멋진 유령분이 이런 데서 뭐 하세요?

english: I suppose you think that's funny?
Well... Mildly amusing I guess.
translation: 음... 살짝 웃기긴 한 것 같은데요.

english: I don't think I want to talk to you anymore.
Hello stranger. It is rare indeed that I meet one who can see my presence, let alone one who can understand my words.
translation: 안녕하시오, 낯선 이여. 내 존재를 볼 수 있는 자를 만나는 일조차 참으로 드문데, 내 말까지 알아듣는 자라니.

english: Soooo.... Is it fun being a ghost?
Does it look like fun to you?
Erm... Well, yes actually.
Then you are a fool, and I will waste no more words upon you.
translation: 그렇다면 그대는 바보요. 더는 그대에게 말을 낭비하지 않겠소.

english: What, not even 'goodbye'?
Sheesh, what a grouch. You'd think you'd have more of a sense of humour being dead and all.
translation: 쳇, 성질 하고는. 죽기까지 했으면 유머 감각이 좀 더 있을 법도 한데.

english: Mortal... Take heed of my example, and waste not your life, lest you may suffer the same fate as myself...
translation: 필멸자여... 나를 본보기 삼아 삶을 허비하지 마시오. 그렇지 않으면 그대도 나와 같은 운명을 겪게 될지니...

english: Huh? You mean someone did this to you?
translation: 네? 누가 당신을 이렇게 만들었단 말이에요?

english: You have ascertained the truth in my words...
translation: 그대가 내 말 속의 진실을 알아챘구려...

english: So who did it to you? And why?
Events of moons past, I remember not clearly...
translation: 지난 세월의 일들은 똑똑히 기억나지 않소...

english: Fine help you are then.
Hello stranger.
So.... Invisible ghost haunting the same place for thousands of years, huh?
translation: 그러니까.... 수천 년 동안 같은 곳을 떠도는 투명 유령이라 이거죠?

english: You have no idea...
Well, bad luck and all that. See ya around!
Hello.
So you're a ghost, huh?
Apparently.
In which case I only have one thing to say to you:
...what?
Guess you don't have the amulet of humanspeak, huh?
translation: amulet of humanspeak(인간 언어 아뮬렛)은 없나 보네요?

english: ...huh?
Yeah, that's right. WOO! WOOOWOOO WOO WOOOOWOO! Got no comeback for that, have you?
translation: 그래요, 바로 그거예요. 우! 우우우우 우 우우우우우! 받아칠 말이 없죠?

english: You are very strange...
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Ask about Kharrim.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
translation: ghostly robes(유령 로브)를 더 달라고 한다.

english: Hey!
Welcome to our camp, adventurer.
translation: 우리 야영지에 온 걸 환영해요, 모험가님.

english: That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
Oh, this? It's just the beginning of something, still a lot more to come.
translation: 아, 이거요? 그냥 뭔가의 시작일 뿐이에요. 아직 한참 더 남았죠.

english: Does it have a name?
I s'pose the working title is...'The Doors of Dinh'.
translation: 가제는... 'The Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)'쯤 될까요.

english: Where are you from?
We come from Varlamore... We're students of the College of Bards.
translation: 우린 Varlamore(바를라모어)에서 왔어요... College of Bards(음유시인 학교) 학생들이에요.

english: Oh...
Or did you want to know where I'm from specifically? My home was destroyed long ago by an evil saltwater deity.
translation: 아니면 제가 정확히 어디 출신인지 궁금했던 거예요? 제 고향은 오래전에 사악한 바다의 신에게 파괴당했어요.

english: Well, that's certainly a dark and tortured backstory. Say, have you slain any dragons? Wooed a beautiful princess? Sought revenge on the fiend who killed your family?
translation: 음, 꽤나 어둡고 고통스러운 과거네요. 그런데 혹시 용을 무찌른 적 있어요? 아름다운 공주에게 구애한 적은요? 가족을 죽인 악당에게 복수하려 한 적은요?

english: ...Dragons? Slain. Princesses? Wooed... but revenge, that's still brewing.
translation: ...용이요? 무찔렀죠. 공주요? 구애했죠... 하지만 복수는, 아직 무르익는 중이에요.

english: Huh, well... Fair enough.
I have to go.
See you around, adventurer.
That sounds lovely, what tune is that?
Where are you from?
I have to go.
Here lies Viktor, the goat, gone but not forgotten.
translation: 염소 Viktor(빅토르), 여기 잠들다. 떠났지만 잊히지 않으리.

english: The ground beneath the gravestone looks disturbed.
translation: 묘비 아래 땅이 파헤쳐진 것 같다.

english: Baaaaaaah! Baaaaah!
Aaah! It's a ghost goat!
Baaaaaaah!
Aww, poor goat, I don't think it meant to scare me.
translation: 아이고, 불쌍한 염소. 날 겁주려던 건 아닌 것 같네.

english: Baah?
If only I had a goat speak amulet...
You notice the ghost goat is missing one of its horns.
translation: 유령 염소의 뿔 하나가 없는 것이 보인다.

english: Hmm, one of your horns is missing...
Baaah! Baaaaah!
It seems like it wants me to help recover its lost horn...
translation: 잃어버린 뿔을 찾아 달라는 것 같은데...

english: The ghost goat seems very excited when you mention its lost horn.
translation: 잃어버린 뿔 얘기를 꺼내자 유령 염소가 몹시 흥분한 것 같다.

english: Hmm, how am I going to find this goat's horn?
translation: 흠, 이 염소 뿔을 어떻게 찾지?

english: Baaaaaah!!!
The ghost goat head butts the wall, I think he's pointing east...
translation: 유령 염소가 벽을 머리로 들이받는다. 동쪽을 가리키는 것 같다...

english: Alright then, I'll go have a look...that way...
Hey goat, where did you baa where your horn was?
translation: 염소야, 네 뿔이 어디 있다고 메에~했지?

english: Right, got it, thanks goat.
Hello my goat friend, I have brought you a gift.
Baaaah!
You show the ghost goat the horn.
Baaaah! Baaaaaaah! Baaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
I think this might be the right one.
You bury the horn with the rest of the goat skeleton.
translation: 뿔을 염소 해골의 나머지 부분과 함께 묻는다.

english: Quest complete!
Inspect the grave closer?
Viktor is resting peacefully now...
Yes.
No.
Wooooo! Ooooooh!
I can't understand a word you are saying. Maybe Father Aereck will be able to help.
translation: 무슨 말인지 하나도 모르겠어요. Father Aereck(에어렉 신부)님이라면 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: Hello ghost, how are you?
Wooo wooo wooooo!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 미안해요, 전 유령 말을 못 해요.

english: Woo woo?
Nope, still don't understand you.
WOOOOOOOOO!
Never mind.
Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
Did he really?
Woo.
My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
translation: 제 형제도 정확히 똑같은 문제가 있었어요.

english: Woo Wooooo!
Wooooo Woo woo woo!
You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
translation: 언제 그 요리법 좀 알려 줘요...

english: Wooooooo woo woooooooo.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
Wooo woooooooooooooo...
Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
Wooo wooo?
Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
Wooo woo?
Well, if you INSIST.
Wooooooooo!
Ah well, better be off now...
Bye.
Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: 보물을 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 힌트 좀 줄래요?

english: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 우우우우우우 우! 우우우우 우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우 우 우우우. 우우우우 우 우우? 우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우우!

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
Wooooooo.
Not very good actually.
What's the problem then?
Did you just understand what I said???
Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: 네, 이제 뭐가 문제인지 말해 봐요.

english: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!
translation: 와! 이건 정말 믿을 수가 없어요! 누가 다시 제 말을 알아들을 줄은 꿈에도 몰랐어요!

english: Ok, Ok, I can understand you!
But have you any idea WHY you're doomed to be a ghost?
translation: 그런데 도대체 왜 유령이 될 운명에 처했는지 짐작 가는 거라도 있어요?

english: Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.
I've been told a certain task may need to be completed so you can rest in peace.
translation: 편히 쉬려면 어떤 일을 마쳐야 할지도 모른다고 들었어요.

english: I should think it is probably because a warlock has come along and stolen my skull. If you look inside my coffin there, you'll find my corpse without a head on it.
translation: 아마 흑마법사 하나가 와서 제 해골을 훔쳐 갔기 때문일 거예요. 저기 제 관 안을 보면 머리 없는 제 시체가 있을 거예요.

english: Do you know where this warlock might be now?
translation: 그 흑마법사가 지금 어디 있는지 알아요?

english: I think it was one of the warlocks who lives in the big tower by the sea south-west from here.
translation: 여기서 남서쪽 바닷가에 있는 큰 탑에 사는 흑마법사 중 하나였던 것 같아요.

english: Ok. I will try and get the skull back for you, then you can rest in peace.
translation: 좋아요. 해골을 되찾아 올게요. 그러면 편히 쉴 수 있을 거예요.

english: Ooh, thank you. That would be such a great relief!
translation: 오, 고마워요. 그러면 정말 한시름 놓겠어요!

english: It is so dull being a ghost...
No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: 아뇨, 제가 듣기엔 헛소리하는 것 같은데요.

english: Oh that's a pity. You got my hopes up there.
Yeah, it is a pity. Sorry about that.
Hang on a second... you CAN understand me!
No I can't.
Great.
The first person I can speak to in ages...
..and they're a moron.
Yep, clever aren't I?
I'm impressed. You must be very powerful. I don't suppose you can stop me being a ghost?
translation: 대단하네요. 아주 강한 분인가 봐요. 혹시 제가 유령 신세를 면하게 해 줄 수는 없겠죠?

english: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: 네, 좋아요. 도대체 왜 유령이 됐는지 알아요?

english: Nope. I just know I can't do much of anything like this!
translation: 아뇨. 이런 상태로는 아무것도 할 수 없다는 것만 알아요!

english: No, you're scary!
..and they're an idiot.
Wow, this amulet works!
translation: 와, 이 아뮬렛 진짜 효과 있네요!

english: Oh! It's your amulet that's doing it! I did wonder. I don't suppose you can help me? I don't like being a ghost.
translation: 오! 그 아뮬렛 덕분이었군요! 어쩐지 했어요. 혹시 저 좀 도와줄 수 있어요? 유령으로 지내는 거 싫어요.

english: How are you doing finding my skull?
translation: 제 해골 찾는 건 잘돼 가요?

english: Sorry, I can't find it at the moment.
Ah well. Keep on looking.
I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in the tower south-west from here. There's a lot of levels to the tower, though. I suppose it might take a little while to find.
translation: 여기서 남서쪽에 있는 탑 어딘가에 있는 게 분명해요. 그런데 그 탑은 층이 많아서 찾는 데 시간이 좀 걸릴지도 몰라요.

english: I have found it!
Hurrah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it in my coffin there, then I'll be free!
translation: 만세! 이제 유령 신세를 면할 수 있겠어요! 저기 제 관에 넣기만 하면 전 자유예요!

english: Release! Thank you stranger...
The spirit flies into the River Lum.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
Sorry, I don't speak ghost.
translation: 미안해요, 전 유령 말을 못 해요.

english: Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
Did he really?
My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
translation: 제 형제도 정확히 똑같은 문제가 있었어요.

english: Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
translation: 언제 그 요리법 좀 알려 줘요...

english: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
Yeah, that's what I thought.
Hmm I'm not sure about that.
Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: 보물을 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 힌트 좀 줄래요?

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: 네, 이제 뭐가 문제인지 말해 봐요.

english: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: 아뇨, 제가 듣기엔 헛소리하는 것 같은데요.

english: No I can't.
Yep, clever aren't I?
Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: 네, 좋아요. 도대체 왜 유령이 됐는지 알아요?

english: No, you're scary!
Wow, this amulet works!
translation: 와, 이 아뮬렛 진짜 효과 있네요!

english: Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?
translation: 네, 좋아요. 왜 유령이 됐는지 알아요?

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young [man/woman]?
What kind of trade can you offer?
Well, we find a lot of soaked pages in our nets. If you've got something we really want, I could swap it for 25 soaked pages.
translation: 음, 그물에 soaked pages(젖은 종이)가 많이 걸려 올라오거든. 우리가 정말 원하는 물건을 갖고 있다면 젖은 종이 25장이랑 바꿔 주지.

english: What is this place?
Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young [man/woman]. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: 우리 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)이 물건을 보관하는 작은 곳일세, 젊은 [man/woman]. 예전엔 우리 배 한 척의 일등 항해사였지만, 지금은 뭍에서 창고나 지키고 있지.

english: Maybe you'd like to do a trade, though, while you're here?
translation: 그래도 온 김에 거래나 한번 해 보는 게 어떤가?

english: No.
The sailor will exchange certain reward items for 25 soaked pages each.
translation: 선원은 특정 보상 아이템을 하나당 soaked pages(젖은 종이) 25장과 바꿔 준다.

english: You don't have any [item] to exchange.
No thank you.
What kind of trade can you offer?
What is this place?
No.
Hi.
Greetings. What wisdom do you seek?
Who are you?
Me? I'm here to grant you rewards for any of the Pizazz Points you may have earned in this training arena. Like my fellow Guardians, I am part of the arena and live to ensure its safe running.
translation: 나 말인가? 자네가 이 훈련 경기장에서 얻은 Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)에 대한 보상을 주려고 여기 있다네. 동료 Guardian(수호자)들처럼 나도 이 경기장의 일부이고, 경기장이 안전하게 운영되도록 지키는 것이 내 존재 이유지.

english: I see.
Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 교환할 수 있을까요?

english: Why of course.
Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 그 밖에 살 만한 건 없나요?

english: Well, we do stock a special book that you may be interested in, which provides a comprehensive guide to this training arena. It costs 200 coins. Would you like one?
translation: 음, 자네가 관심 가질 만한 특별한 책이 있네. 이 훈련 경기장에 대한 종합 안내서지. 200 코인인데, 하나 사겠나?

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
Very good, that'll be 200 coins please!
Thank you.
Sorry, I don't have enough money.
I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 먼지 쌓인 낡은 책 같은 건 필요 없어요.

english: It's not old and it certainly isn't dusty, but suit yourself.
translation: 낡지도 않았고 먼지가 쌓이지도 않았네만, 마음대로 하게.

english: No thanks, I already have one.
Let me know if you lose it.
Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
Greetings. Have you spoken to my fellow Guardian downstairs?
translation: 반갑네. 아래층에 있는 내 동료 Guardian(수호자)와 이야기해 보았나?

english: Nope.
Well, you need to talk to him first.
Who are you?
Can I trade my Pizazz Points please?
translation: Pizazz Points(피자즈 포인트)를 교환할 수 있을까요?

english: Got anything else I can buy?
translation: 그 밖에 살 만한 건 없나요?

english: That sounds useful. Yes please.
I don't want some dusty old book.
translation: 먼지 쌓인 낡은 책 같은 건 필요 없어요.

english: Thanks, bye!
Hello.
Oh, hellow adventurer. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, 모험가님. 뭐 도와드릴 일이라도 있나요?

english: What is this place?
This is the prison of Zalcano.
Zalcano?
That's right. She's a powerful demon, one bearing an ancient curse.
translation: 맞아요. 고대의 저주를 지닌 강력한 악마죠.

english: A curse? That doesn't sound good.
Don't worry, the curse only affects her. Because of it, her entire body has been turned to stone.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 저주는 그 악마 자신에게만 영향을 미쳐요. 그 저주 때문에 온몸이 돌로 변해 버렸거든요.

english: I see. So why is she here?
translation: 그렇군요. 그런데 왜 여기 있는 거예요?

english: She came to our lands long ago, before the curse had fully taken hold. We imprisoned her here for study, so that we might learn more about her affliction.
translation: 오래전, 저주가 완전히 자리 잡기 전에 우리 땅에 찾아왔어요. 그 저주에 대해 더 알아내려고 연구 목적으로 여기 가둬 둔 거죠.

english: If you want to learn more, you should be able to find a book in the Grand Library about her.
translation: 더 알고 싶으시면 Grand Library(대도서관)에서 그 악마에 대한 책을 찾을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
What can I do here?
translation: 여기서 제가 뭘 할 수 있죠?

english: Well we could always use some help in keeping Zalcano under control.
translation: 음, Zalcano(잘카노)를 통제하는 데 일손은 언제든 환영이에요.

english: How would I do that?
Zalcano is formed completely from stone. Because of this, normal weapons won't work on her.
translation: Zalcano(잘카노)는 온몸이 돌로 이루어져 있어요. 그래서 일반 무기는 통하지 않죠.

english: That said, when she's vulnerable, you can still do some damage to her if you use a pickaxe.
translation: 그렇긴 해도, 약해졌을 때 곡괭이를 쓰면 피해를 좀 줄 수 있어요.

english: When she's vulnerable? How do I make her vulnerable?
The ore found within these caverns can be rather volatile, especially when heated. We've found that when imbued, this ore can damage her armour.
translation: 이 동굴에서 나는 광석은 꽤 불안정해요. 특히 가열하면요. 이 광석에 마력을 주입하면 그 악마의 갑옷에 피해를 줄 수 있다는 걸 알아냈어요.

english: You'll want to head on in and mine the ore from the rocks around the prison. Once you have some, you can heat it using the furnace and then imbue it using the altar.
translation: 안으로 들어가서 감옥 주변 바위에서 광석을 캐세요. 좀 모이면 용광로로 가열한 다음 제단에서 마력을 주입하면 돼요.

english: Once you've got some imbued ore, just give it a throw her way and she'll definitely feel it.
translation: 마력이 주입된 광석이 생기면 그쪽으로 던지기만 하세요. 틀림없이 효과가 있을 거예요.

english: What do I get for helping out here?
Well assuming you are successful of subdueingZalcano, she has accumulated a lot of ores and magical runes from her time as a demon.
translation: 음, Zalcano(잘카노)를 제압하는 데 성공한다면 말인데, 잘카노가 악마로 살아온 세월 동안 모아 둔 광석과 마법 룬이 잔뜩 있어요.

english: Not bad, what if I didn't want these resources? Is there anything you can give me instead?
translation: 나쁘지 않네요. 이 자원이 필요 없다면요? 대신 줄 수 있는 게 있나요?

english: Well we would always appreciate these resources, in exchange we could bestow upon you our elven knowledge for mining.
translation: 음, 우리는 그 자원을 언제든 환영해요. 그 대가로 엘프의 채광 지식을 전수해 드릴 수 있어요.

english: We wouldn't be asking for anything special though, just the common resources are what we require.
translation: 특별한 걸 바라는 건 아니에요. 흔한 자원만 있으면 돼요.

english: We won't take any resources from your successes, the resources are all your own.
translation: 당신이 거둔 성과에서 자원을 가져가지 않을게요. 자원은 모두 당신 거예요.

english: We will automatically collect the resources and bestow you with our elven mining knowledge.
translation: 우리가 자원을 자동으로 거두고 엘프의 채광 지식을 전수해 드릴게요.

english: No thanks.
What is this place?
What can I do here?
translation: 여기서 제가 뭘 할 수 있죠?

english: What do I get for helping out here?
Resource focused
XP Focused.
No thanks.
Hi.
Hey! What can I do for ya' today?
Who are you?
I'm Rhoddwr, a simple forest dweller.
It's nice to meet you Rhoddwr, I'm [player name].
translation: 만나서 반가워요, Rhoddwr(로두르). 전 [player name](이)라고 해요.

english: And it's great to meet you, [player name].
What do you do here?
I'm the leader of this small camp. We live amongst the trees, at one with the forest.
translation: 전 이 작은 야영지의 우두머리예요. 우린 나무들 사이에서 숲과 하나 되어 살아요.

english: That sounds relaxing.
That's because it is! This is where we belong, this is where we began.
translation: 실제로 그렇거든요! 여기가 우리가 속한 곳이고, 우리가 시작된 곳이에요.

english: A nice sentiment, but we can't all live off the land.
translation: 좋은 말이지만, 모두가 자연에 기대어 살 수는 없잖아요.

english: Very true! As we expand and grow, nature refuses to adjust to our ways. The only other option is to destroy it to make room for growth.
translation: 맞는 말이에요! 우리가 늘어나고 커질수록 자연은 우리 방식에 맞춰 주지 않죠. 남은 길은 성장할 자리를 만들려고 자연을 파괴하는 것뿐이에요.

english: Hopefully nature understands the necessity of it all.
translation: 자연이 그 필요성을 이해해 주면 좋겠네요.

english: History shows again and again that nature points out the folly of man.
translation: 역사는 몇 번이고 자연이 인간의 어리석음을 일깨운다는 걸 보여 줬어요.

english: Which is why we should learn from the past and avoid making such mistakes.
translation: 그러니 우리는 과거에서 배워서 그런 실수를 피해야겠죠.

english: Indeed, although some mistakes have lasting effects that cannot be undone. Is there anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 그렇죠. 하지만 어떤 실수는 되돌릴 수 없는 오랜 영향을 남겨요. 또 알고 싶은 게 있나요?

english: Bye!
Farewell, adventurer.
Who are you?
What do you do here?
Bye!
Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Have you come to hear a tale from old Ribs?
translation: 어이, 젊은 풋내기. 이 늙은 Ribs(립스)의 이야기를 들으러 왔나?

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: Barnacle Barnaby(바너클 바나비)에 대해 얘기해 줄래요?

english: He was a cruel and vicious pirate. Orchestrator of the Driftwood Massacre and unleasher of the Plague of Black Mists. He believed himself untouchable, but his arrogance was his undoing.
translation: 잔인하고 포악한 해적이었지. Driftwood Massacre(드리프트우드 학살)을 꾸미고 Plague of Black Mists(검은 안개 역병)을 퍼뜨린 장본인이었네. 자기는 누구도 건드릴 수 없다고 믿었지만, 그 오만함이 결국 몰락을 불렀지.

english: Despite the warnings of many, Barnacle Barnaby attempted to plunder the Skullhorde, but his only reward was a deadly curse. It destroyed the Crimson Kraken, condemning all on board to a watery grave.
translation: 많은 이의 경고에도 Barnacle Barnaby(바너클 바나비)는 Skullhorde(스컬호드)를 약탈하려 했지만, 돌아온 보상이라곤 치명적인 저주뿐이었네. 그 저주가 Crimson Kraken(크림슨 크라켄)호를 부숴 버렸고, 배에 탄 모두를 물속 무덤으로 보냈지.

english: And you had a map leading to the wreck of the Kraken?
translation: 그리고 당신이 Kraken(크라켄)호 난파선으로 가는 지도를 갖고 있었고요?

english: Aye! I purchased the map from Ulrich the Unfortunate, the sole survivor of the Kraken, but I had no intention of using it. I knew that no good would ever come from seeking the Kraken.
translation: 그렇다네! 그 지도는 Kraken(크라켄)호의 유일한 생존자인 Ulrich the Unfortunate(불운한 울리히)에게서 샀지만, 쓸 생각은 없었네. 크라켄호를 찾아 봐야 좋은 일은 하나도 없으리란 걸 알았거든.

english: Then why not destroy the map?
And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. I thought it better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else, but those young fools put an end to that.
translation: 그러다 Barnaby(바나비)의 유령이 노하면 어쩌고? 아니지. 지도를 꽁꽁 잠가 두는 게 낫겠다고 생각했네. 그러면 지도도 저주도 다른 누구를 해치지 못할 테니. 그런데 그 젊은 바보들이 다 망쳐 버렸지.

english: Now, we can only hope that someone puts a stop to them before it's too late. Who knows, perhaps it will be you who does so.
translation: 이제는 너무 늦기 전에 누군가 그들을 막아 주길 바랄 수밖에. 누가 아나, 어쩌면 그게 자네일지도 모르지.

english: Well, on that note, I'd best be getting off. Until next time, Ribs.
translation: 음, 그럼 전 이만 가 볼게요. 다음에 또 봬요, Ribs(립스).

english: I don't think so.
As you wish, but you would be wise to learn from your elders. My tales might one day save you from a one- way trip to see Davey Jones!
translation: 마음대로 하게. 하지만 어른에게 배우는 게 현명할 걸세. 내 이야기가 언젠가 자네를 Davey Jones(데이비 존스)에게 가는 편도 여행에서 구해 줄지도 모르니!

english: Could you tell me about Barnacle Barnaby?
translation: Barnacle Barnaby(바너클 바나비)에 대해 얘기해 줄래요?

english: I don't think so.
Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'm okay, thank you.
What can I get you?
What are you serving?
What is this place?
My pub's called The Golden Field. It's where all the local workers come to relax and unwind after a hard day. I try to keep it really nice here for them. Anyway, are you drinking?
translation: 제 술집 이름은 The Golden Field(황금 들판)예요. 이 동네 일꾼들이 힘든 하루를 마치고 와서 쉬며 긴장을 푸는 곳이죠. 그분들을 위해 늘 깔끔하게 꾸며 두려고 애쓰고 있어요. 그건 그렇고, 한잔하실래요?

english: Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Apparently Veos is looking for some help with something. He hangs around the docks of Port Piscarilius.
translation: Veos(베오스)가 뭔가 도움을 구하고 있다던데요. Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스) 부두 근처에서 서성이고 있대요.

english: They say there's trouble in Port Piscarilius. Something about gangs uniting. Might be worth looking into.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에 문제가 생겼다더군요. 갱단들이 손을 잡았다나 뭐라나. 한번 알아볼 만할지도요.

english: I hear that Lord Hosidius has misplaced one of his sons. The Hosidius family might pay a lot to see him returned safely.
translation: Lord Hosidius(호시디우스 영주)께서 아드님 하나를 잃어버리셨다던데요. 무사히 돌려보내 주면 호시디우스 가문에서 사례를 두둑이 할지도 몰라요.

english: Phileas Rimor has supposedly been looking for some assistance with something in Shayzien. Maybe worth investigating.
translation: Phileas Rimor(필리어스 리모르)가 Shayzien(샤이지엔)에서 뭔가 도와줄 사람을 찾고 있다나 봐요. 알아볼 만할지도요.

english: I hear that the rulers of Lovakengj have some work available. You'll find them in the Lovakengj Assembly.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기)의 지도자들에게 일거리가 있다고 들었어요. Lovakengj Assembly(로바켕기 의회)에 가면 만날 수 있을 거예요.

english: Apparently there's been some commotion in the middle of Arceuus. Might be worth checking out.
translation: Arceuus(아르세우스) 한가운데서 무슨 소동이 있었나 봐요. 한번 가 볼 만할지도요.

english: That protest outside Kourend Castle is starting to attract some attention. Could be worth taking a look.
translation: Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성) 앞에서 벌어지는 시위가 점점 사람들 눈길을 끌고 있어요. 한번 가 볼 만할 거예요.

english: No, it hasn't been very busy lately.
I'd better not.
I like a customer who knows when to stop.
translation: 그만 마실 때를 아는 손님이 좋더라고요.

english: What are you serving?
What is this place?
I'd better not.
Have you heard any rumours here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 소문 들은 거 있어요?

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특제 망토 하나 사 보실래요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 그게요, 같은 망토를 두른 사람은 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고, 다른 사람들은 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있게 해 줘요. 그리고 같은 망토를 두른 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 쉽게 구별할 수 있게 해 주죠. 친구들이나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람들과 wilderness(황야)에 나갈 때 아주 쓸모 있어요.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
'Allo mate! Got a job going? Only 500 coins!
translation: 어이, 친구! 일자리 있어? 딱 500코인이면 돼!

english: What can you do?
I'm a great cook, me! I used to work with a rat-catcher, I used to cook for him. There's a dozen different ways you can cook rat!
translation: 내가 요리 하난 끝내주게 하지! 예전에 쥐잡이랑 같이 일했는데, 그 양반 밥을 내가 해 줬거든. 쥐 요리하는 방법만 열두 가지가 넘는다고!

english: Tell me about your previous jobs.
translation: 예전에 했던 일 얘기 좀 해 줘요.

english: Well, city warder Bravek once threw a chair at me and yelled at me to get him a hangover cure. So I made it and I think it worked, 'cause then he threw another chair at me and that one hit!
translation: 음, 한번은 도시 감독관 Bravek(브라베크)가 나한테 의자를 집어던지면서 숙취 해소제를 가져오라고 고래고래 소리를 지르더라고. 그래서 만들어 줬지. 효과는 있었던 것 같아. 왜냐면 그다음에 의자를 하나 더 던졌는데, 그건 맞혔거든!

english: Sorry mate, but I'm not allowed to work for anyone without level 20 Construction. It's a safety 'azard!
translation: 미안하지만 친구, Construction(건설) 레벨 20이 안 되는 사람 밑에선 일 못 해. 안전상 위험하다고!

english: You already have a servant.
You need a second bedroom with a bed for your servant to sleep in.
translation: 하인이 잘 수 있게 침대가 놓인 침실이 하나 더 있어야 해.

english: You're hired... well, I don't have the money on me, but can I owe you? I'm good for it, honest.
translation: 채용할게요... 그런데 지금 돈이 없는데, 외상으로 해도 될까요? 꼭 갚을게요, 진짜로요.

english: Nice try, mate, but I don't start work without cash up front.
translation: 좋은 시도였어, 친구. 근데 난 선불 아니면 일 안 해.

english: You're hired!
Cheers, mate! Look forward to working with you!
translation: 고마워, 친구! 같이 일하는 거 기대할게!

english: What can you do?
Tell me about your previous jobs
translation: 예전에 했던 일 얘기 좀 해 줘요

english: You're hired!
Hey there, Rick.
Hello, [player name]. It's nice to see you again!
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name] 님. 다시 만나서 반가워요!

english: How are you feeling?
Better now that my head's back in place. Thanks again for helping me with that!
translation: 머리가 제자리로 돌아오니까 이제 좀 나아요. 그때 도와주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요!

english: You're very welcome. It was a night to remember, that's for sure.
Indeed. How are you finding the helm that I gave you? Does the headless illusion still work?
translation: 정말 그래요. 제가 드린 투구는 어때요? 머리 없는 환영 효과는 아직 잘 되나요?

english: Yes it does. I've been told it looks terrifying - especially when I eat or drink.
translation: 네, 잘 돼요. 보기에 꽤 무섭다더라고요. 특히 뭘 먹거나 마실 때요.

english: I can imagine!
Do you have anything to sell?
As a matter of fact, I do! I was recently doing some research on cabbages. I was able to extract their essence and combine it with a t-
translation: 마침 있죠! 최근에 양배추를 연구하고 있었거든요. 양배추의 정수를 추출해서 그걸 어떤 거랑 합-

english: You're not a very good salesman, are you? Just tell me what you're selling!
translation: 장사엔 영 소질이 없으시네요? 그냥 뭘 파는지만 말해 줘요!

english: Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Escape crystal.
translation: 아. 맞다! 특히 위험한 상황에서 빠져나갈 수 있게 해 주는 크리스탈 조각이에요. 특정한 장소에서만 작동해요. 전 이걸 Escape crystal(탈출 크리스탈)이라고 불러요.

english: Why would I want that?
Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios.
translation: 가끔 평범한 방법으로는 순간이동해서 빠져나갈 수 없는 곳에 갇힐 때가 있잖아요. 이 크리스탈은 그런 상황에서 탈출할 수 있도록 특별히 만든 거예요.

english: So, would you like to buy one? They cost 75000 gold each!
Sure - I'd like to buy a crystal.
It looks like you can't afford any Escape crystals. They cost 75000 each.
translation: Escape crystal(탈출 크리스탈)을 살 돈이 없으신 것 같네요. 하나에 75000이에요.

english: Which places can the Escape crystal teleport me out of?
translation: Escape crystal(탈출 크리스탈)로 어떤 곳에서 순간이동해 나올 수 있어요?

english: The crystals currently work in the Theatre of Blood, the Chambers of Xeric, TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges, the Inferno, Pest Control, Barbarian Assault and the Tombs of Amascut.
translation: 이 크리스탈은 현재 Theatre of Blood(피의 극장), Chambers of Xeric(제릭의 회랑), TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Challenges(츠하르-켓-락의 도전), the Inferno(인페르노), Pest Control(페스트 컨트롤), Barbarian Assault(바바리안 어설트), 그리고 Tombs of Amascut(아마스컷의 무덤)에서 작동해요.

english: No way, that's too expensive!
Well, there's a lot that goes into it to drive the price up that high. But I understand why you feel that way.
translation: 음, 가격이 그렇게까지 오를 만큼 들어가는 게 많거든요. 그래도 왜 그렇게 느끼시는지는 이해해요.

english: What are you up to now that your head is back where it belongs?
translation: 머리가 제자리를 찾았으니, 이제 뭐 하고 지내요?

english: I still study. I'm changing my field of study though. Hopefully if I don't mess up more spells, one day I can become the head wizard.
translation: 아직 공부하고 있어요. 그래도 전공은 바꾸려고요. 주문을 더 망치지만 않으면, 언젠가 수석 마법사가 될 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: I think that would suit you very well!
Goodbye, Rick.
Take care, [player name].
Hey there.
Hello.
Who are you?
My name is Rick. I'm a wizard student. I used to study magical farming, but I don't like it anymore.
translation: 제 이름은 Rick(릭)이에요. 마법사 견습생이고요. 예전엔 마법 농사를 공부했는데, 이젠 별로예요.

english: Why don't you like it anymore?
It's a bit embarassing, but... I got my head swapped with a pumpkin. Luckily an adventurer came along and helped me get it back in place.
translation: 좀 창피한 얘기지만... 제 머리가 호박이랑 뒤바뀌었거든요. 다행히 어떤 모험가가 와서 머리를 제자리로 돌려놓는 걸 도와줬어요.

english: That is indeed lucky.
Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Escape crystals.
translation: 아. 맞다! 특히 위험한 상황에서 빠져나갈 수 있게 해 주는 크리스탈 조각이에요. 특정한 장소에서만 작동해요. 전 이걸 Escape crystals(탈출 크리스탈)이라고 불러요.

english: Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specifically crafted to let you escape those scenarios.
translation: 가끔 평범한 방법으로는 순간이동해서 빠져나갈 수 없는 곳에 갇힐 때가 있잖아요. 이 크리스탈은 그런 상황에서 탈출할 수 있도록 특별히 만든 거예요.

english: The Members objects I'm selling are quite delicate. I'd feel more comfortable selling them on a member's world.
translation: 제가 파는 Members objects(멤버 전용 물건)은 꽤 약해서요. 멤버 월드에서 파는 게 더 마음이 놓여요.

english: What are you doing here?
I'm a student here at the tower. I don't know what I'll do now. Maybe I'll go home to Ardougne. Or maybe I'll pick up a new magical field to study.
translation: 전 이 탑에 다니는 학생이에요. 이제 뭘 해야 할지 모르겠어요. Ardougne(아르둔)에 있는 집으로 돌아갈 수도 있고요. 아니면 새로운 마법 분야를 공부해 볼까 해요.

english: What kinds of magical fields are we talking about?
Anything but pumpkin fields.
Goodbye.
Bye.
How are you feeling?
Talk about what Rick is doing.
Goodbye.
Do you have anything to sell?
Sure - I'd like to buy a crystal.
Which places can the Escape crystal teleport me out of?
translation: Escape crystal(탈출 크리스탈)로 어떤 곳에서 순간이동해 나올 수 있어요?

english: No way, that's too expensive!
What are you up to?
Talk about how Rick is feeling.
Who are you?

It's a bit embarrassing, but... I got my head swapped with a pumpkin. Luckily an adventurer came along and helped me get it back in place.

english: Can I buy an Escape crystal?
translation: Escape crystal(탈출 크리스탈)을 살 수 있을까요?

english: Yes! Of course.
It looks like you can't afford any crystals. They cost 75000 coins each.
translation: 크리스탈을 살 돈이 없으신 것 같네요. 하나에 75000코인이에요.

translation: Members object(멤버 전용 물건)을 살 수 있을까요?

translation: 제가 파는 크리스탈은 꽤 약해서요. 멤버 월드에서 파는 게 더 마음이 놓여요.

english: Although you cannot technically take them into the Gauntlet, if you enable the feature that teleports you if you zone out and have a crystal on you when entering, it will continue to work within.
translation: 엄밀히 말하면 Gauntlet(건틀릿) 안으로 가지고 들어갈 수는 없지만, 멍하니 있을 때 순간이동시켜 주는 기능을 켜 두고 크리스탈을 지닌 채 입장하면 안에서도 계속 작동해요.

english: Wonderful!
Which places can the Members object teleport me out of?
translation: Members object(멤버 전용 물건)으로 어떤 곳에서 순간이동해 나올 수 있어요?

Oh. Right! I have these crystal shards that will let you escape from particularly dangerous situations. They only work in certain places. I call them Members objects.
translation: 아. 맞다! 특히 위험한 상황에서 빠져나갈 수 있게 해 주는 크리스탈 조각이에요. 특정한 장소에서만 작동해요. 전 이걸 Members objects(멤버 전용 물건)이라고 불러요.

english: Sometimes you get caught in places that won't let you teleport out by normal means. These crystals are specially crafted to let you escape those scenarios. I've recently enhanced them as well!
translation: 가끔 평범한 방법으로는 순간이동해서 빠져나갈 수 없는 곳에 갇힐 때가 있잖아요. 이 크리스탈은 그런 상황에서 탈출할 수 있도록 특별히 만든 거예요. 최근엔 성능도 강화했답니다!

english: Have you ever found yourself zoning out, and come back to reality to find yourself under attack and on the brink of death? Well you can configure them to teleport you to safety if !
translation: 멍하니 있다가 정신을 차려 보니 공격을 받아 죽기 직전이었던 적 있지 않아요? 그럴 때 안전한 곳으로 순간이동하도록 설정할 수 있어요!

english: It does mean they are likely to trigger in combat, although I'm working on that. But they should let you run through a dangerous area as long as you don't stop in the middle.
translation: 그래서 전투 중에 발동될 가능성이 높긴 한데, 그건 개선하고 있어요. 그래도 중간에 멈추지만 않으면 위험한 지역을 달려서 통과할 수 있을 거예요.

english: They also now work in any place a ring of life would. Talking about rings of life, they can also act just like one if you configure them to be so.
translation: 이제 ring of life(생명의 반지)가 작동하는 곳이라면 어디서든 작동해요. 생명의 반지 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 그렇게 설정하면 생명의 반지와 똑같은 역할도 해요.
