english: Today is your lucky day, [sirrah/madam/my liege]! I am donating to the victims of crime to atone for my past actions!
translation: 오늘은 운이 좋은 날이오, [sirrah/madam/my liege]! 지난날의 죄를 속죄하고자 범죄 피해자들에게 기부를 하고 있소!

english: 'Twas a pleasure to work with you [sirrah/ma'am/my liege]!
It is someone else with whom I desire to speak, but he seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 내가 이야기를 나누고 싶은 이는 따로 있으나, 그자는 다른 일에 정신이 팔려 있는 듯하오.

english: Good day to you, [milord/milady/my liege] [player name].
I seek a moment of your time, [sirrah/ma’am/my liege]!
[Milord/Milady/My liege] [player name], please speak to me!
translation: [Milord/Milady/My liege] [player name], 부디 내 말 좀 들어 주시오!

english: Maybe later.
Sorry I can't let you through, find some bunny else to bother, I'm busy.
translation: 미안하지만 못 지나가. 귀찮게 할 거면 딴 토끼나 찾아봐, 난 바쁘거든.

english: Can you see your own rift?
No. From time to time I feel it shift and change inside me though. It is an odd feeling.
translation: 아니요. 하지만 이따금 제 안에서 균열이 움직이고 변하는 것이 느껴집니다. 묘한 느낌이지요.

english: Where would you like me to take you today Rifty?
Please do not call me that... we are a species of honour, [player name].
translation: 그렇게 부르지 말아 주십시오... 저희는 명예를 중시하는 종족입니다, [player name] 님.

english: Sorry.
Hey! What's that!
You quickly poke your hand through the rift guardian's rift.
translation: 당신은 재빨리 균열 수호자의 균열에 손을 쑥 집어넣는다.

english: Huh, what?! Where?
Not the best guardian it seems.
About your colour-changing...
If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.
translation: Runecrafting Altar(룬 제작 제단)에 저를 데려가시면, 그곳에서 정수를 결속할 때 제단의 색을 따르겠습니다.

english: I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 지금 이 색 그대로 있어 줬으면 해요.

english: Very well, I will remain locked to this colour, even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 알겠습니다. Runecrafting Altar(룬 제작 제단)에서 정수를 결속하더라도 이 색으로 고정해 두겠습니다.

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 좋아요, 계속 제단 색을 따라 해 줘요.

english: Very well, I will adopt the altar's colour next time you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.
translation: 알겠습니다. 다음에 Runecrafting Altar(룬 제작 제단)에서 정수를 결속하시면 제단의 색을 따르겠습니다.

english: Even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar, I will remain locked to this colour.
translation: Runecrafting Altar(룬 제작 제단)에서 정수를 결속하더라도 이 색으로 고정해 두겠습니다.

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 다음번엔 제단 색을 따라 해 줬으면 해요.

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
Actually, never mind.
How are you doing today?
The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.
translation: Abyss(심연)의 힘이 커지고 있습니다. 그에 맞선 우리의 방어가 무너진다면 무슨 일이 벌어질지 두렵습니다.

english: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.
translation: Guardians of the Rift(균열의 수호자)가 잘 지키고 있어요. 걱정할 필요 없어요.

english: Let us hope you are correct.
Feel my wrath!
Get out of my altar!
Feel the power of my rift!
I'll convert your very essence into runes.
translation: 네 정수 자체를 룬으로 바꿔 주마.

english: Can you see your own rift?
Where would you like to go today, Rifty?
Hey! What's that?
About your colour-changing...
I want you to stay this colour instead.
translation: 지금 이 색 그대로 있어 줬으면 해요.

english: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.
translation: 좋아요, 계속 제단 색을 따라 해 줘요.

english: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.
translation: 다음번엔 제단 색을 따라 해 줬으면 해요.

english: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.
Actually, never mind.
How are you doing today?
Hello there, what are you doing here?
I... am the sculptor's associate.
His associate? What does that mean?
Are you going to say anything meaningful at all?
translation: 뭔가 의미 있는 말을 하긴 할 거예요?

english: No, apparantly not.
I'm glad I don't have to talk to you anymore!
translation: 더 이상 당신이랑 얘기 안 해도 돼서 다행이에요!

english: Hrm.
Hello there.
Welcome to the clothes store. How might I help you?
translation: 옷 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

english: It's a very interesting island you have here.
Why thank you. It's been our haven for a great many generations.
translation: 어머, 고마워요. 이곳은 아주 오랜 세대에 걸쳐 저희의 안식처였답니다.

english: Everything seems to have a magical feel to it.
translation: 모든 게 마법 같은 느낌이 드네요.

english: Of course. We integrate magic into all areas of our lives. It is a part of everyone, so why deny it? It's best to make the most of this innate gift we have all been given.
translation: 물론이죠. 저희는 삶의 모든 부분에 마법을 녹여 내고 있어요. 마법은 모두의 일부인데, 굳이 부정할 이유가 있나요? 우리 모두가 타고난 이 재능을 최대한 살리는 게 가장 좋아요.

english: What sort of things do you use your magic for?

Take a look around. We use it in our day to day lives, from making a cup of tea, to travelling around the island. You see our ancestors were the ones that found the first rune essence and put it to use! The various
translation: 주위를 둘러보세요. 차 한 잔 끓이는 일부터 섬 안을 돌아다니는 일까지, 일상생활에서 마법을 쓰고 있어요. 사실 처음으로 rune essence(룬 정수)를 발견해 쓰기 시작한 게 바로 저희 선조들이었거든요! 여러

english: factions were eventually created, with people having different ideas on how the essence should be used (or not in some cases!)
translation: 파벌들은 결국 정수를 어떻게 써야 하는지(어떤 경우엔 아예 쓰지 말아야 한다는!) 사람들의 생각이 서로 달라서 생겨났답니다.

english: What has kept you so secluded on this island?
translation: 어째서 이 섬에서 그렇게 외부와 떨어져 살아온 거예요?

english: It may be a bit beyond you, but although magic comes from within, we are all very strongly linked to the moon and the effects it has on us cannot be denied!
translation: 조금 어려우실지도 모르지만, 마법은 내면에서 나오는 것이긴 해도 저희는 모두 달과 아주 강하게 이어져 있어서 달이 저희에게 미치는 영향은 부정할 수 없어요!

english: It can't?
Of course not. This very island has a great link to our moon, which helps us understand ourselves - especially our dreams, which is the path to understanding magic.
translation: 물론이죠. 바로 이 섬이 저희의 달과 깊이 이어져 있어서, 저희 자신을 이해하는 데 도움을 줘요. 특히 꿈을요. 꿈이야말로 마법을 이해하는 길이거든요.

english: I think I will just have to take your word on that.
I'm good thanks, bye.
What can you sell me?
It's a very interesting island you have here.
I'm good thanks, bye.
Come to visit my garden then, have you, human?
translation: 내 정원을 구경하러 왔나, 인간 친구?

english: This is your garden?
No no, not quite. But I do look after it. It's the palace garden, you see. I keep it tidy, keep it living.
translation: 아니, 아니, 꼭 그렇진 않네. 하지만 내가 돌보고는 있지. 여긴 궁전 정원이라네. 내가 깔끔하게, 살아 있게 가꾸고 있지.

english: It's hard to grow much on these hard rocks deep beneath these mountains, you know.
translation: 이 산맥 깊은 곳 단단한 바위 위에서는 뭘 키우기가 쉽지 않다네.

english: I can imagine. Where do you get all your food from? Or even the soil for this garden?
translation: 그렇겠네요. 그럼 먹을 건 다 어디서 구해요? 이 정원에 쓸 흙은요?

english: We can grow a little food underground, but most of it comes from the extensive steamcart network that runs beneath the earth.
translation: 땅속에서도 먹을 것을 조금은 기를 수 있지만, 대부분은 땅 밑으로 넓게 뻗은 증기 광차 노선으로 들여온다네.

english: In the Era of Kings, many centuries ago, it was harder of course. Our steam technology was not developed as far yet and getting fresh supplies of food was always a problem.
translation: 수백 년 전 Era of Kings(왕의 시대)에는 물론 더 힘들었지. 증기 기술이 아직 그리 발달하지 않아서 신선한 식량을 구하는 게 늘 골칫거리였거든.

english: Oh, I'm not boring you, am I?
translation: 아, 내가 자네를 지루하게 하는 건 아니겠지?

english: Not at all! Please, go on!
Oh yes, as I was saying, it was difficult to make a decent living here. I'm afraid this garden was rather neglected during that time.
translation: 아, 그래, 말하던 참이었지. 그 시절엔 여기서 제대로 먹고살기가 어려웠다네. 아무래도 그때는 이 정원도 꽤 방치되어 있었지.

english: Why did you dwarves stay so deep under ground, then? Why not simply go above ground?
translation: 그럼 드워프들은 왜 그렇게 땅속 깊이 머물렀어요? 그냥 땅 위로 올라가면 되잖아요?

english: What, with the wars raging up there?
We dwarves went underground a long time ago, see. For a while the city of Keldagrim was completely cut off from the rest of Gielinor simply waiting out the wars of the humans and the gods.
translation: 우리 드워프는 아주 오래전에 땅속으로 들어갔다네. 한동안 Keldagrim(켈다그림)은 Gielinor(길리노르)의 다른 곳과 완전히 단절된 채, 그저 인간과 신들의 전쟁이 끝나기만을 기다렸지.

english: This made it hard, though, to determine when the wars above the ground were over. Perhaps Keldagrim had remained hidden for far too long.
translation: 그 탓에 땅 위의 전쟁이 언제 끝났는지 알기가 어려웠어. 어쩌면 켈다그림이 너무 오래 숨어 있었는지도 모르지.

english: Only when King Alvis heroically defended the city against an invasion of trolls did we dare to venture out and see how much the world had changed.
translation: King Alvis(알비스 왕)께서 트롤 침공에 맞서 도시를 영웅적으로 지켜 내신 뒤에야, 우리는 감히 밖으로 나가 세상이 얼마나 변했는지 볼 수 있었다네.

english: Of course, after that...
Ah well, enough history lessons I should say. I must really get back to my gardening.
translation: 아, 역사 수업은 이쯤 해야겠군. 이제 정말 정원 일로 돌아가야겠네.

english: Thanks for the info!
A little, yes. I don't really know what all this has to do with anything.
translation: 조금은요. 이게 다 무슨 상관인지 잘 모르겠어요.

english: I suppose it doesn't, really, it's just the mumblings of an old dwarf.
translation: 하긴, 별 상관없긴 하지. 그냥 늙은 드워프의 넋두리일 뿐이라네.

english: Not really, no.
Oh, alright then.
I need some help.
Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?
translation: 그래, [player name]? 나 같은 보잘것없는 정원사가 뭘 도와주면 되겠나?

english: I have four Kelda seeds here, but need some advice on growing them.
translation: Kelda seeds(켈다 씨앗)이 네 개 있는데, 키우는 법을 좀 알려 주세요.

english: Marvelous, those seeds are quite scarce don't you know!
translation: 훌륭하군, 그 씨앗은 꽤 귀하다네, 알고 있나!

english: First of all, you must remember that these seeds only grow underground. Sunlight is harmful to them, for some strange reason.
translation: 우선, 이 씨앗은 땅속에서만 자란다는 걸 기억해야 하네. 무슨 까닭인지 햇빛이 이 씨앗한테는 해롭거든.

english: There is a patch in the palace garden that you're more than welcome to use.
translation: 궁전 정원에 밭이 하나 있는데, 얼마든지 써도 좋네.

english: Thanks! Is there anything else I need to know?
translation: 고마워요! 그 밖에 알아 둬야 할 게 있어요?

english: Just take care of the weed in the patch and plant your seeds. They'll grow into hops very quickly, if you're lucky. Kelda seeds have a remarkably fast grow rate.
translation: 그냥 밭의 잡초를 정리하고 씨앗을 심기만 하면 되네. 운이 좋으면 금방 홉으로 자랄 걸세. Kelda seeds(켈다 씨앗)은 자라는 속도가 놀랄 만큼 빠르거든.

english: Also, if you need a rake, you'll find one just south of here, I left it there 5 minutes ago.
translation: 그리고 갈퀴가 필요하면 바로 남쪽에 하나 있을 걸세. 5분 전에 내가 거기 두고 왔거든.

english: Thank you! Your advice is much appreciated!
I think I need some more help with this whole farming business.
translation: 이 농사일 전반에 대해 도움이 좀 더 필요할 것 같아요.

english: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant your seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!
translation: 그냥 밭의 잡초를 없애고, 씨앗을 심고, 홉이 자라길 기다리게. 나머지는 자연의 기적이 알아서 해 줄 걸세!

english: Do I have to wait here all this time then?
translation: 그럼 그동안 계속 여기서 기다려야 해요?

english: Yea and no. Yes, you do have to wait, but no, you don't have to stay here. You can help out people in the city, for instance, there's always someone who needs help with an urgent job.
translation: 그렇기도 하고 아니기도 하지. 기다리긴 해야 하지만, 여기 있을 필요는 없네. 이를테면 도시 사람들을 도와줘도 되고. 급한 일을 도와줄 사람이 필요한 이가 늘 있거든.

english: You mean the mining companies? I did jobs for them, they're not very profitable.
translation: 광산 회사들 말이에요? 거기 일은 해 봤는데, 벌이가 별로였어요.

english: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well. But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.
translation: 아니, 아니, 그냥 가게 주인 같은 사람들 말일세. 일을 해 주면 그 대가로 이것저것 기꺼이 가르쳐 주기도 하지. 그런데 이보게, 이건 어떤가. Falador(팔라도르)에 사는 친구한테 이 편지를 전해 주면 씨앗을 좀 주겠네.

english: Do I have to do that? I just want to grow my hops and get on with my quest for Veldaban.
translation: 꼭 해야 해요? 전 그냥 홉을 키워서 Veldaban(벨다반)을 위한 퀘스트를 계속하고 싶은데요.

english: Oh no, you don't have to do it all, I just thought you wanted something to do while you were waiting.
translation: 아, 아니, 꼭 할 필요는 없네. 기다리는 동안 할 일이 필요하지 않을까 싶었을 뿐이야.

english: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
Happy to hear that! His name is Elstan, he lives just south of Falador.
translation: 그거 반가운 소리군! 그 친구 이름은 Elstan(엘스탄)이고, 팔라도르 바로 남쪽에 산다네.

english: I'll be right back!
I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: 그냥 여기 앉아서 이 밭이나 바라볼래요, 고마워요.

english: Very well. That can be quite relaxing, actually, I often do it myself.
translation: 그러게나. 그것도 꽤 마음이 편해지는 일이지, 사실 나도 자주 그런다네.

english: Hello again, [player name]! Have you been able to deliver that letter yet?
translation: 다시 왔군, [player name]! 그 편지는 전해 주었나?

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: 아뇨, 아직 Falador(팔라도르)에 못 가 봤는데, 곧 갈게요.

english: Much appreciated, Player!
No, sorry, I lost your letter.
That's a little clumsy, Player! Here, I've got a copy, please deliver this one instead.
translation: 좀 덤벙댔구먼, Player! 자, 사본이 하나 있으니 이걸 대신 전해 주게.

english: No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 안 전해 드리기로 했어요.

english: Oh, I'm sad to hear that.
Oh well, I'll see if I can find someone else instead.
I've delivered your letter to Elstan, he told me to give you his regards.
translation: Elstan(엘스탄)한테 편지 전해 드렸어요. 안부 전해 달래요.

english: Wonderful, that's just wonderful! Here, have these two seeds as a reward. They may not be Kelda hop seeds, but you should be able to grow a decent amount of herbs with them.
translation: 잘됐군, 정말 잘됐어! 자, 보답으로 씨앗 두 개를 받게. Kelda hop seeds(켈다 홉 씨앗)은 아니지만, 이걸로 약초를 꽤 많이 키울 수 있을 걸세.

english: How are you getting along with growing your seeds into hops, [player name]?
translation: 씨앗을 홉으로 키우는 건 잘 되어 가나, [player name]?

english: Hmm, I'm not sure... let me check the patch.
translation: 음, 잘 모르겠어요... 밭을 확인해 볼게요.

english: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I have no idea what to do with them. Can you turn them into stout for me please?
translation: 씨앗을 홉으로 다 키웠는데, 이걸로 뭘 해야 할지 모르겠어요. 스타우트로 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Haha, it doesn't quite work like that, I'm afraid!
You will need to bring your hops to a brewery.
Where's the nearest brewery then?
Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer, they do.
translation: 아, Keldagrim-East(동부 켈다그림)에 하나 있지. Laughing Miner(웃는 광부) 위층에 있다네. 거기선 맥주를 직접 빚는다네, 암.

english: How does it work though?
I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my specialty you see.
translation: 거기 누군가 도와줄 수 있을 걸세. 그건 내 전문이 아니라서 말이야.

english: Alright, thanks a lot!
I've grown my seeds into hops, but I seem to have mislaid them.
translation: 씨앗을 홉으로 다 키웠는데, 어디 뒀는지 잊어버렸어요.

english: Ah! Fortunately I found some hops after your recent harvest. Here, I believe this belongs to you.
translation: 아! 다행히 자네가 얼마 전에 수확한 뒤에 내가 홉을 좀 주웠지. 자, 이거 자네 것 같네.

english: I'm brewing my hops into Kelda stout, but it seems to be taking an awfully long time.
translation: 홉을 Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트)로 양조하고 있는데, 너무 오래 걸리는 것 같아요.

english: Just have patience, my young friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has jobs for you!
translation: 참을성을 갖게, 젊은 친구! 마을을 좀 돌아다니면서 일거리를 줄 사람이 있나 찾아보게!

english: I'm just so angry, my hops aren't fermenting at all. I want my Kelda stout!
translation: 너무 화가 나요, 홉이 전혀 발효가 안 돼요. 제 Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트)를 내놔요!

english: Now now, my young human friend! Are you sure about that?
translation: 자, 자, 젊은 인간 친구! 정말 그런가?

english: Perhaps you should go back to the brewery, I wouldn't be surprised if your stout has fermented by now.
translation: 양조장에 다시 가 보는 게 좋겠네. 지금쯤이면 스타우트가 발효됐다 해도 놀랍지 않을 걸세.

english: This is your garden?
Not at all!
A little, yes.
Not really, no.
Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: 그냥 여기 앉아서 이 밭이나 바라볼래요, 고마워요.

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: 아뇨, 아직 Falador(팔라도르)에 못 가 봤는데, 곧 갈게요.

english: No, sorry, I've lost your letter.
No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 안 전해 드리기로 했어요.

english: Hello.
Howdy.
What are you doing here?
Same as you I'd wager, lookin' fer that big ol' bunny.
translation: 너랑 똑같지, 아마. 그 큼지막한 토끼 녀석을 찾는 중이야.

english: Well we've found him.
That we have kid, that we have.
Do you know what raisins are?
Raisins? Talk to Glanton, kid. He's your raisin man.
translation: 건포도? Glanton(글랜턴)한테 물어봐, 꼬마. 건포도라면 그 녀석이 전문이야.

english: Oh, okay then!
Thanks for helping with the raisins.
It was no skin off my nose, any time kid.
translation: 나야 손해 볼 거 하나 없었지. 언제든지, 꼬마.

english: Good work with those raisins kid, you've got real moxy. Tell me, do you like games?
translation: 건포도 일 잘했다, 꼬마. 너 배짱 좀 있더라. 그래서 말인데, 게임 좋아하냐?

english: Games? Like Runelink?
Runelink! Hah! I mean real games, games with a wager. Pride or humiliation. Stakes worth fighting for.
translation: 룬링크! 하! 내 말은 진짜 게임 말이야, 내기가 걸린 게임. 자존심이냐 망신이냐. 싸워 볼 만한 판돈 말이야.

english: Sounds risky.
There you have it, risk indeed.
Ever been to the wilderness?
Real evil haunts that place...
translation: 거긴 진짜 악이 노리고 있는 곳이지...

english: ...And we haunt the evil right back.
translation: ...그리고 우린 그 악을 되레 노리고 다니지.

english: What say ye? Come hasten the reckoning of the horrible legions what dwell up there with us sometime?
translation: 어때? 언제 우리랑 같이 가서 거기 사는 끔찍한 무리들의 최후를 앞당겨 보지 않을래?

english: Ehh, I'll think about it.
It won't catch on, Glanton.
Ah don't be like that Rinder, how will we know till we try?
translation: 아, 그러지 마, Rinder(린더). 해 보기 전엔 모르는 거잖아?

english: Alright gents, what's going on here then?
translation: 자, 두 분, 여기서 무슨 일이에요?

english: I've had this great idea see.
Does it have anything to do with long walks in the desert again?
translation: 이번에도 사막을 한참 걷는 거랑 관련 있는 거예요?

english: Well y'see thats the beauty of it.
translation: 음, 바로 그게 이 아이디어의 묘미야.

english: It's a lot easier to melt chocolate than dry out grapes.
translation: 포도를 말리는 것보다 초콜릿을 녹이는 게 훨씬 쉽거든.

english: Chocolate? You've piqued my interest!
Exactly! See Rinder, [player name] doesn't even know half the idea yet and wants in!
translation: 그렇지! 봐, 린더. [player name]은(는) 아직 절반도 모르는데 끼고 싶어 하잖아!

english: It still seems terribly messy.
Okay so, what we do is use our connections with the Easter Bunny to acquire a lot of chocolate.
translation: 그러니까, 우리가 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)랑 연줄이 있잖아. 그걸 이용해서 초콜릿을 왕창 구하는 거야.

english: And give it to me for my outstanding contributions to the preservation of Easter?
translation: 그리고 부활절을 지켜 낸 제 빛나는 공로를 기려서 저한테 주는 거죠?

english: No.
And we melt it all up, and put it in a fountain.
translation: 그리고 그걸 전부 녹여서 분수에 붓는 거야.

english: And then I get to have it all?
translation: 그럼 그걸 제가 다 먹는 거예요?

english: No then we sell people the right to take a couple of small fruits to dip in the fountain and eat!
translation: 아니, 그다음에 사람들한테 작은 과일 몇 개를 분수에 찍어 먹을 권리를 파는 거지!

english: That sounds delicious!
Yes.
But I can get some for free?
translation: 그래도 전 공짜로 좀 먹을 수 있죠?

english: See the amount people would pay for just a taste of chocolate is so much higher than we'd have to pay to source a lot of the stuff.
translation: 봐봐, 사람들이 초콜릿 한 입 맛보는 데 내는 돈이 우리가 그걸 잔뜩 들여오는 데 드는 돈보다 훨씬 많다니까.

english: Well, I'm not interested if I have to pay.
translation: 음, 돈을 내야 한다면 관심 없어요.

english: I saved Easter...
... Again!
I think I'll go see if the Easter Bunny has some more eggs for me...
translation: 부활절 토끼한테 달걀이 더 있는지 보러 가야겠어요...

english: Be seeing you!
What do you do here?
Well, it's funny you should ask that actually, I run the local parcel service to the mainland.
translation: 그걸 물어보시다니 재밌네요. 사실 저는 본토로 가는 이 동네 소포 배달을 맡고 있거든요.

english: Parcel service?
Yes, we sometimes get asked to send items back to the mainland. We can send items to individuals' bank accounts, for a small fee of course.
translation: 네, 가끔 본토로 물건을 보내 달라는 부탁을 받아요. 개인 은행 계좌로 물건을 보내 드릴 수 있어요. 물론 약간의 수수료는 받고요.

english: How much does it cost?
It costs 10 trading sticks per item, unfortunately, even stackable items cost the same.
translation: 물건 하나에 trading sticks(교역 막대) 10개예요. 아쉽게도 겹쳐지는 물건도 똑같이 받아요.

english: What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)가 뭐예요? 어떻게 구하죠?

english: Trading sticks are our local currency, you could perhaps earn some trading sticks by doing some work around the village.
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)는 이 마을 화폐예요. 마을 이곳저곳에서 일을 좀 도우면 교역 막대를 벌 수 있을 거예요.

english: Have a chat with Murcaily, I think he was looking for someone to help him, he works near the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus' hut.
translation: Murcaily(머케일리)한테 말을 걸어 보세요. 도와줄 사람을 찾고 있는 것 같던데요. Trufitus(트루피투스)의 오두막 동쪽 hardwood grove(경목 숲) 근처에서 일해요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Can I send a parcel please?
It costs at least 10 trading sticks to use this service. Sorry but you don't have enough.
translation: 이 서비스를 이용하려면 trading sticks(교역 막대)가 최소 10개는 있어야 해요. 죄송하지만 부족하시네요.

english: Of course...which items would you like to send to your bank?
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 여기서 할 만한 재미있는 일이 있나요?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Yeah, you've been doing a lot of good work around here. Let me give you something for your time and effort.
translation: 네, 이 근처에서 좋은 일을 정말 많이 해 주셨죠. 시간 내서 애써 주신 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)는 이미 드렸고, 지금은 가진 게 더 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테도 가서 얘기해 보고 보탬을 좀 받아 보는 게 어때요?

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey, I've seen you working around the village. You've been doing a lot of good work around here for us. Let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 저기요, 마을에서 일하시는 걸 봤어요. 우리를 위해 이 근처에서 좋은 일을 정말 많이 해 주셨죠. 수고하신 보답으로 뭘 좀 드릴게요.

english: What do you do here?
How much does it cost?
What are trading sticks and how do I get some?
translation: trading sticks(교역 막대)가 뭐예요? 어떻게 구하죠?

english: Can I send a parcel please?
I've been doing some work around the village.
Fishies be mine, leave dem fishies!
translation: 물괴기 내 꺼다, 물괴기 건들지 마라!

english: Would you like to buy some fishing equipment, or sell some fish?
translation: 낚시 장비를 사시겠어요, 아니면 물고기를 파시겠어요?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there!
Greetings traveller. Welcome to 'The Hair Of The Dog' Tavern. What can I do for you?
translation: 어서 와, 나그네. 'The Hair Of The Dog(개털 해장술)' 선술집에 온 걸 환영해. 뭘 해 줄까?

english: Can I buy a beer?
translation: 맥주 한 잔 살 수 있어요?

english: Well that's my specialty! The local brew's named 'Moonlight Mead' and will set you back 5 gold. Whaddya say? Fancy a pint?
translation: 그거야 내 전문이지! 이 동네 술은 'Moonlight Mead(월광 벌꿀술)'라고 하는데, 5골드야. 어때? 한 잔 할래?

english: Yes please.
I don't have the money on me right now though... can I start a tab?
translation: 그런데 지금 수중에 돈이 없어서요... 외상 되나요?

english: You see that sign behind me there?
translation: 내 뒤에 있는 저 표지판 보여?

english: The one that says; 'Please Do Not Ask For Credit As Being Attacked By A Large Angry Werewolf Inn Keeper Often Offends'?
translation: '외상은 정중히 사양합니다. 크고 화난 늑대인간 여관 주인에게 물어뜯기면 기분이 상하실 수 있으니까요'라고 적힌 거요?

english: Bingo
Here ya go pal. Enjoy!
Actually, no thanks.
Eh, suit yourself. You're missing out on a genuine taste experience.
translation: 에, 맘대로 해. 진짜배기 맛을 놓치는 거라고.

english: Can I hear some gossip?
Well, I dunno... The village is kind of on the fringe out here, I dunno how up to date the stuff I hear about is...
translation: 글쎄, 잘 모르겠네... 이 마을은 좀 외진 데라서, 내가 듣는 얘기가 얼마나 최신인지 모르겠어...

english: Tell me about this village.
You want to know about Canifis? I dunno why, not a lot happens here. We're just your typical everyday down at earth werewolf folk, after all...
translation: Canifis(카니피스)에 대해 알고 싶다고? 왜인지 모르겠네, 여긴 별일 없어. 우린 그냥 어디에나 있는 소박한 늑대인간들이거든...

english: So... everyone here is a werewolf?
translation: 그러니까... 여기 사는 사람이 전부 늑대인간이라고요?

english: Yep. We are as Zamorak made us!
You mentioned Zamorak...
Yeah, he's great isn't he? Every year we hold a big festival to give thanks to Zamorak for keeping us well fed and happy here.
translation: 그래, 그분 대단하시지 않아? 매년 우릴 배불리 먹이고 행복하게 지내게 해 주신 걸 감사드리려고 Zamorak(자모락)께 큰 축제를 열어.

english: I hear over in the West they worship Saradomin, but I dunno why! What's he ever done to help out us werewolves, huh?
translation: 서쪽 동네에선 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬긴다던데, 난 도통 이유를 모르겠어! 그놈이 우리 늑대인간들한테 해 준 게 뭐가 있는데, 응?

english: I hear he has all these crazy followers who say things like we shouldn't kill people and eat them! What's up with that?
translation: 그놈한테는 사람을 죽여서 먹으면 안 된다느니 하는 소리를 하는 정신 나간 추종자들이 잔뜩 있다더라! 대체 그게 무슨 소리야?

english: ...So when is this festival?
Aaah, not for a good few months yet. Come and ask me again nearer to the time, I'll keep some extra meat and mead pack from the rest for ya pal.
translation: 아아, 아직 몇 달은 더 남았어. 때가 가까워지면 다시 물어봐. 다른 놈들 몫에서 고기랑 벌꿀술을 좀 더 빼 둘게, 친구.

english: Tell me about the land of Morytania.

Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to attack us... South East of here is the castle of Lord Drakan, our master.
translation: 글쎄, 뭘 말해 줘야 할지 모르겠네... 이 마을은 Canifis(카니피스)라고 하는데, Morytania(모리타니아)와 Misthalin(미스탈린) 사이 국경에 있어... 그러니까 서쪽의 그 Saradominists(사라도민파)가 쳐들어오기로 마음먹으면 우리가 최전선인 셈이지... 여기서 남동쪽에는 우리 주인이신 Lord Drakan(드라칸 경)의 성이 있어.

english: Lord Drakan? Who is that?
Ahh... you must be new to these parts if you haven't heard of Lord Draken! He's the lord of this land, and we all pledge allegiance to him.
translation: 아아... Lord Draken(드라칸 경)을 모르는 걸 보니 이 동네엔 처음인가 보네! 이 땅의 영주이시고, 우리 모두 그분께 충성을 맹세했어.

english: In return for our allegiance, and the tithe of course, he keeps our land safe from any invaders and the Saradominists who want to kill us all.
translation: 우리의 충성, 그리고 물론 공물에 대한 대가로, 그분은 침략자들이랑 우릴 몰살하려는 사라도민파로부터 우리 땅을 지켜 주셔.

english: Tithe? What do you mean?

Ah, well, in return for his protection, we have to give Lord Drakan a share of blood every week. If we don't have any to spare from our hunts, then we need to pick a member of the village to give their life in return
translation: 아, 그게, 보호해 주시는 대가로 매주 Lord Drakan(드라칸 경)께 피를 일정량 바쳐야 하거든. 사냥해서 남는 피가 없으면 마을 사람 하나를 골라서

english: for the blood so that the tithe is fulfilled.
translation: 그 피 대신 목숨을 바치게 해서 공물을 채우는 거지.

english: You mean you kill someone you know in order to meet the tithe?
translation: 그러니까 공물을 채우려고 아는 사람을 죽인다는 거예요?

english: That's right, but only if we haven't managed to get enough spare blood from our hunts. It's kind of severe if you look at it that way, but frankly, I think the price is fair for his protection and his tolerance of
translation: 맞아, 사냥으로 남는 피를 충분히 못 구했을 때만이지만. 그렇게 보면 좀 가혹하긴 한데, 솔직히 그분이 지켜 주시고 우리 마을을

english: our village. He could probably kill us all if he wanted us gone, so keeping on his good side is worth the sacrifice to us. Lucky we're not human really!
translation: 봐주시는 대가로는 공정한 값이라고 생각해. 마음만 먹으면 우릴 다 없애 버리실 수도 있으니, 비위를 맞추는 건 그만한 희생을 치를 가치가 있지. 우리가 인간이 아니라서 다행이야!

english: Why's that?
He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin and lost much of his powers, and was recently killed by some human!
translation: 그분은 인간을 싫어하시거든! 듣자 하니 오래전에 그분 동생 Draynor(드레이너)가 Misthalin(미스탈린)에 갇혀서 힘을 많이 잃었는데, 얼마 전에 어떤 인간한테 죽었대!

english: He hates humans! Apparently long ago his brother Draynor was trapped in Misthalin, and adventurous little human wannabe-heroes keep trying to kill him!
translation: 그분은 인간을 싫어하시거든! 듣자 하니 오래전에 그분 동생 Draynor(드레이너)가 Misthalin(미스탈린)에 갇혔는데, 모험 좋아하는 꼬맹이 인간 영웅 지망생들이 자꾸 그를 죽이려 든대!

english: Man, I'd hate to be a human around here, that's for sure. Drakan would really enjoy hunting them down and killing them!
translation: 아휴, 이 근처에서 인간으로 사는 건 정말 싫을 거야, 그건 확실해. Drakan(드라칸)이라면 인간을 사냥해서 죽이는 걸 아주 즐기실 테니까!

english: Uh... thanks for the info...
Tell me about the shopkeepers here.
Hmmm? Why, who did you want to hear the gossip about?
translation: 흐음? 그래, 누구 소문이 듣고 싶은데?

english: Tell me what you know about Sbott the Tanner.
translation: Sbott(스봇) 무두장이에 대해 아는 걸 알려 주세요.

english: Hey, I won't hear a word said bad about that guy! He's an honest and hard-working wolf if I ever met one! He charges a lot for his job, but he's one of the best tanners I've ever seen - and I'm over four hundred
translation: 어이, 그 친구 험담은 한마디도 못 들어주겠어! 내가 만나 본 늑대 중에 그만큼 정직하고 부지런한 녀석도 없을걸! 일삯은 비싸게 받지만, 내가 본 무두장이 중에 손꼽히는 실력자야. 이래 봬도 내가 사백 살이

english: years old! You need stuff tanning, I recommend him!
translation: 넘었다고! 가죽 무두질할 게 있으면 그 친구를 추천해!

english: Know anything interesting about Rufus the food seller?
translation: 음식 파는 Rufus(루퍼스)에 대해 재미있는 얘기 아는 거 있어요?

english: Ah, yeah... good old Rufus... He's kind of getting on in years and doesn't like to come out of his wolf form so often, but let me tell you this: that guy is a hunter through and through. You seen how much food he
translation: 아, 그래... 우리 Rufus(루퍼스) 영감... 나이가 꽤 들어서 늑대 모습에서 잘 안 돌아오려고 하는데, 이건 말해 줄게. 그 친구는 뼛속까지 사냥꾼이야. 그 친구가 하루에 음식을 얼마나 잡아 오는지

english: catches a day? That takes real dedication! Some of the young pups think just because a wolf has a bit of grey in his fur then he's past it, but I've seen him put those pups to shame in a hunt! He's a real inspiration to us all!
translation: 봤어? 그건 진짜 열정이 있어야 되는 거야! 어린 녀석들 중엔 털이 좀 희끗희끗해졌다고 한물갔다고 생각하는 애들도 있는데, 그 친구가 사냥에서 그 녀석들을 망신 주는 걸 내가 봤다니까! 우리 모두의 본보기야!

english: Got anything to share about Barker the clothes seller?
translation: 옷 파는 Barker(바커)에 대해 해 줄 얘기 있어요?

english: Eh, I don't like the guy much, but you can't knock the quality of his stock. They're some fine quality threads you can get yourself there.
translation: 에, 난 그 녀석이 별로지만, 물건 질은 깔 수가 없어. 거기 가면 꽤 좋은 옷을 구할 수 있지.

english: What's wrong with him?
Eh... I can't really tell you to be honest. Something about the guy just gets my hackles up everytime he opens his yap, know what I mean?
translation: 에... 솔직히 딱 꼬집어 말은 못 하겠어. 그 녀석이 주둥이만 열면 왠지 털이 곤두선다니까, 무슨 말인지 알지?

english: No, not really.
Lucky for you. I can't really explain it, I just don't like the guy. Does great clothes though, you got to give him that.
translation: 운 좋은 줄 알아. 나도 설명은 잘 못 하겠는데, 그냥 그 녀석이 싫어. 그래도 옷은 끝내주게 만들어, 그건 인정해야 돼.

english: I bet you have some juicy gossip about Fidelio the general store owner.
translation: 잡화점 주인 Fidelio(피델리오)에 대해선 재미있는 소문이 있겠죠?

english: That nut job? Oh sure, we all know about him. He was a real firebrand daredevil when he was younger, always taking risks to make himself a quick buck... he got himself caught up in the smuggling trade, sneaking over
translation: 그 미친놈? 아, 물론이지, 다들 알아. 젊었을 땐 진짜 겁 없는 열혈남이었어. 한몫 챙기려고 늘 위험을 무릅썼지... 그러다 밀수에 손을 대서, 몰래 국경을 넘어

english: the border into Misthalin and pretending to be a human so he could buy exotic items to sell.
translation: Misthalin(미스탈린)으로 가서는 인간인 척하면서 팔 만한 이국적인 물건들을 사 왔어.

english: Exotic items? From Misthalin? Like what?
Oh man, you name it! Flour... buckets... tinderboxes... chisels... he could get the lot! He's been doing it so long now though, his nerves are shot.
translation: 오, 말만 해! 밀가루... 양동이... 부싯깃 통... 끌... 뭐든 다 구해 왔지! 근데 그 짓을 너무 오래 해서 이젠 신경이 너덜너덜해졌어.

english: Nowadays he's a disgrace, he can barely string a sentence together and jumps at his own shadow. Makes you feel ashamed to be a werewolf.
translation: 요즘은 아주 꼴불견이야. 말도 제대로 못 잇고 제 그림자에도 화들짝 놀라. 늑대인간인 게 부끄러워질 정도라니까.

english: Tell me about the temple to the west.
translation: 서쪽에 있는 신전에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Well, I'm not old enough to remember the full story behind it, but it was a terrible day for our kingdom when it was built there.
translation: 글쎄, 나도 그 얘기를 다 기억할 만큼 나이 먹진 않았는데, 그게 거기 세워진 날은 우리 왕국에 끔찍한 날이었지.

english: Apparently Morytania had a once strong kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert, until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship
translation: 듣자 하니 Morytania(모리타니아)는 한때 강성한 왕국이었대. 영토가 지금보다 훨씬 서쪽까지, 그리고 남쪽으론 사막까지 뻗어 있었는데, 어느 날 증오스러운 인간 놈들이,

english: Saradomin burned our villages and slaughtered our peoples in mass.
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬기는 그놈들이 기습해서 우리 마을들을 불태우고 우리 백성들을 몰살했대.

english: They then cursed the river, so that it would burn our kind should we touch it! Can you imagine??? To make an entire river poisonous to us???
translation: 그러고는 강에 저주를 걸어서, 우리 종족이 닿으면 몸이 타들어 가게 만들었어! 상상이 가??? 강 하나를 통째로 우리한테 독으로 만들다니???

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay away on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven. What is worse is
translation: 다행히 요즘은 좀 잠잠해져서 강 건너 자기들 쪽에만 머무는 편이야... 하지만 그놈들이 우리 종족에게 저지른 짓은 절대 잊히지도, 용서되지도 않을 거야. 더 고약한 건,

english: that they then had the nerve to build that gigantic statue on the river mouth to mock the slaughter of our people and the poisoning of our river! I can understand Lord Drakan's hatred for them even if I do not share
translation: 그놈들이 뻔뻔하게도 강어귀에 그 거대한 조각상을 세워서 우리 종족이 학살당하고 강이 독에 물든 걸 조롱한다는 거야! 내가 Lord Drakan(드라칸 경)만큼은 아니지만, 그분이 그놈들을 증오하시는 건

english: it to his extent.
So you hate humans too?
Absolutely! If I ever met one I would gobble him up where he stands! And then chew the bones for dessert!
translation: 당연하지! 인간을 만나기만 하면 그 자리에서 꿀꺽 삼켜 버릴 거야! 그리고 후식으로 뼈까지 오독오독 씹어 먹을 거고!

english: : ...Um, okay, thanks, bye.
Can I hear a story?
A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is my dear old mammy told me as a pup...
translation: 이야기??? 헤, 지금 당장 떠오르는 건 내가 새끼 늑대였을 때 우리 엄마가 들려준 거 하나뿐인데...

english: Now how did it go... Ah yes!

translation: 옛날 옛적에 용감한 젊은 늑대가 숲속을 걷다가 온통 빨간 옷을 입은 인간을 만났어. '아하! 쉽게 한 끼 때우겠구나!' 하고 생각했지. 그런데 그 인간이 말을 걸어왔고, 늑대는

translation: 늘 예의 바른 늑대가 되라고 배웠기 때문에 대꾸를 해 줬어.

english: Well, this cunning human told him that there was a better meal that would not run away in a house in the woods. As the brave young wolf could see that this human was not fully grown, he figured maybe he'd
translation: 그런데 이 교활한 인간이 숲속 어느 집에 도망도 안 가는 더 좋은 먹잇감이 있다고 하는 거야. 용감한 젊은 늑대는 이 인간이 아직 다 자라지 않은 걸 보고, 그 집에 가면

english: better get a better meal at this house, so he ran as fasta as his paws could varry him to the house the human told him about... inside he found an old human lying in bed, and although the meat was a little tough, as the
translation: 더 푸짐하게 먹을 수 있겠다 싶어서, 인간이 말해 준 집으로 네 발이 허락하는 한 최대한 빨리 달려갔지... 안에 들어가니 늙은 인간 하나가 침대에 누워 있었는데, 생각보다 나이가 많아서

english: human was older than he thought, he had a good meal and decided to sleep it off in the house for awhile. He had not been asleep long though, when he was woken by a knocking at the door. The human in red had followed
translation: 고기가 좀 질기긴 했지만, 배불리 먹고 나서 그 집에서 잠깐 한숨 자기로 했어. 그런데 얼마 자지도 못했는데 문 두드리는 소리에 잠이 깼지. 빨간 옷의 인간이

translation: 그 집까지 따라온 거야! 인간의 함정이라고 의심한 용감한 젊은 늑대는 늙은 인간의 옷을 입고 침대에 뛰어들었어. 인간인 척해서 이 끔찍한 함정에서 빠져나가려고 말이야! 자, 그런데 이 빨간 옷을

english: dressed in red came into the house, and pretended to believe the brave wolf was really a human, and began to talk to him. But then the human started asking strange questions of the wolf, because the human knew that it
translation: 입은 인간은 집에 들어와서는 용감한 늑대가 진짜 인간이라고 믿는 척하면서 말을 걸기 시작했어. 그러다 인간이 늑대한테 이상한 질문들을 하기 시작했지. 인간은 그게

english: was not a human at all! The brave young wolf decided to try and escape, for it was only a young human, and not very strong, so the brave young wolf said he would eat the human if they did not let him escape! As he said
translation: 인간이 아니라는 걸 이미 알고 있었거든! 용감한 젊은 늑대는 도망치기로 했어. 상대는 어리고 힘도 별로 없는 인간이었으니까, 놓아주지 않으면 잡아먹겠다고 했지! 그런데 그 말을

english: this however, the human in red shouted out at him: 'Aha! You are a wolf!' and as the human shouted this, another bigger human ran into the room from outside! This bigger human was much stronger and was
translation: 하자마자 빨간 옷의 인간이 '아하! 너 늑대구나!' 하고 소리쳤고, 그 소리에 밖에서 더 큰 인간이 방으로 뛰어 들어왔어! 이 큰 인간은 훨씬 힘이 셌고

translation: 도끼까지 들고 있었어. 그렇게 가엾은 젊은 늑대는 인간들이 쳐 놓은 끔찍한 함정에 걸려 죽고 말았지.

english: And do you know what the moral of this story is?
translation: 그럼 이 이야기의 교훈이 뭔지 알아?

english: Um... no, not really.
It's 'Never trust humans' of course! My dear old mammy told me that story when I was a pup, and I'm still alive and well to tell it to you today!
translation: 당연히 '인간은 절대 믿지 마라'지! 우리 엄마가 새끼 때 이 얘기를 해 줬는데, 덕분에 난 아직도 멀쩡히 살아서 너한테 이 얘기를 해 주고 있잖아!

english: Pretty good story huh?
Um... yeah. It was great. Really.
Nothing thanks.
...I don't know why you talked to me if you don't want anything then...
translation: ...아무것도 필요 없으면 왜 말을 건 건지 모르겠네...

Can I buy a beer?

Actually, no thanks.

Fidelio the general store owner.
Tell me about the temple to the west.
translation: 서쪽에 있는 신전에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Can I hear a story?
Nothing thanks.
Talk to the tree, make friends with it.
translation: 나무에게 말을 걸어 보세요, 친구가 되어 보는 거예요.

english: But I can't reach it...
You can do anything you want to do. This is your world.
translation: 하고 싶은 건 뭐든 할 수 있어요. 이건 당신의 세상이니까요.

english: That tree looks lonely...
I'll give him a friend! Like I always say, everyone needs a friend!
translation: 제가 친구를 하나 그려 줄게요! 늘 말하듯이, 누구에게나 친구는 필요하답니다!

english: Will you be my friend?
Well of course! Right after I finish this painting.
translation: 물론이죠! 이 그림만 다 그리고 나서요.

english: I don't make mistakes, just happy accidents.
translation: 저는 실수를 하지 않아요. 행복한 우연이 있을 뿐이죠.

english: How very positive!
So, still here then?
Do you want another game of Runedraw?
No!
Sorry, my orders are that I can only give slime to those who have completed the Morytania medium, hard or elite diaries.
translation: 미안하네만, Morytania(모리타니아) 중급, 상급 또는 엘리트 일지를 완료한 자에게만 점액을 주라는 명을 받았네.

english: Can I have these bones converted into bonemeal with the promised amount of slime, please?
translation: 약속한 만큼의 점액이랑 같이 이 뼈를 bonemeal(뼛가루)로 바꿔 주실 수 있을까요?

english: You do not have enough space for both bonemeal and slime. Come back to me when you have space.
translation: 뼛가루와 점액을 둘 다 받을 공간이 없군. 공간을 비우고 다시 오게.

english: You do not have any bones for me to convert for you.
translation: 자네는 내가 바꿔 줄 뼈를 하나도 갖고 있지 않네.

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am quite impressed by your equipment, but it's not the sort I'd recommend myself. Try more conventional forms of accuracy enhancement.
translation: 바로 그 Master Bowman(궁술 명인)으로서 자네 장비에 꽤 감명을 받았네만, 내가 권할 만한 종류는 아니군. 좀 더 전통적인 방식으로 명중률을 높여 보게.

english: Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: 찢어진 clue scroll(단서 두루마리) 조각을 건네받았다.

english: As THE Master Bowman, I am most impressed by your equipment, peasant.
translation: 바로 그 Master Bowman(궁술 명인)으로서 자네 장비에 아주 감명을 받았네, 평민.

english: Hello there! Is there anything I can help you with?
I'd like to buy something.
How's business going?
Its a little slow... There's a lot of soldiers around these parts, so many people just wear a uniform.
translation: 좀 한산해요... 이 근처엔 병사들이 많아서, 다들 그냥 제복을 입고 다니거든요.

english: Although, I'm just happy to be here! Osten recently took me on as his assistant, you see. I've always wanted to work in fashion!
translation: 그래도 저는 여기 있는 것만으로 행복해요! Osten(오스텐) 님이 얼마 전에 저를 조수로 받아 주셨거든요. 늘 패션 일을 하고 싶었어요!

english: Anyway, enough about me... Was there something I could help you with? Perhaps a new cape? ...Or a nice new chef's hat?
translation: 아무튼, 제 얘기는 이쯤 하고... 뭐 도와드릴 거 있으세요? 새 망토는 어떠세요? ...아니면 멋진 새 chef's hat(요리사 모자)은요?

english: No thanks, I'm just browsing.
I'll be right here if you need anything!
translation: 필요한 게 있으면 저 여기 있을게요!

english: I'd like to buy something.
How's business going?
No thanks, I'm just browsing.
So you're made entirely of rocks?
translation: 그러니까 넌 전부 바위로 만들어진 거야?

english: Not quite, my body is formed mostly of minerals.
translation: 꼭 그렇진 않아. 내 몸은 대부분 광물로 이루어져 있어.

english: Aren't minerals just rocks?
No, rocks are rocks, minerals are minerals. I am formed from minerals.
translation: 아니, 바위는 바위고 광물은 광물이야. 난 광물로 이루어져 있어.

english: But you're a Rock Golem...
Yes, I am. This conversation seems to be confusing you; perhaps you should stop.
translation: 응, 맞아. 이 대화 때문에 네가 헷갈리는 것 같네. 그만두는 게 좋겠어.

english: I feel strangely emotionless and empty. Maybe I should feel sad about it, but I can't.
translation: 이상하게 아무 감정도 없고 텅 빈 기분이야. 슬퍼해야 할 것 같은데, 그게 안 돼.

english: You can't feel sad?
Correct. Now, if I only had a heart...
I'm not sure it works like that around here.
translation: 여기선 그런 식으로 되는 건 아닌 것 같은데.

english: I have an idea for a song.
Oh?
Copper-copper-copper Cophelia - you come and go, you come and go...
translation: 구리-구리-구리 구리멜레온~ 왔다가 가네, 왔다가 가네...

english: Mmmhmm.
Truth is, I am Iron Golem.
I can see that.
I'm blue, da-ba-dee da-ba-da.
Oh dear, I've gone all pale.
Are you okay?
It must be something I ate.
Did you ever hear the tragedy of Queen Efaritay the Fair?
translation: 아름다운 Queen Efaritay(에파리테이 여왕)의 비극에 대해 들어 본 적 있어?

english: No?
I thought not.
It's not a story the Myreque would tell you.
So near and yet so far... if my atoms were arranged a little differently, I could be diamond.
translation: 가까운데도 너무 멀구나... 내 원자 배열이 조금만 달랐어도 다이아몬드가 될 수 있었는데.

english: Would you enjoy being a diamond?
I expect I would, until someone tried chipping bits off me with a chisel. I'm probably safer as coal.
translation: 그렇겠지, 누가 끌로 날 조각조각 깎아 내기 전까지는. 아마 석탄으로 있는 게 더 안전할 거야.

english: I am so in my element right now.
translation: 지금 나 완전 물 만난 원소 같은 기분이야.

english: Sigh...
I'm totally showing the bling today.
That's nice for you.
A little. Though sometimes I just feel like I'm being used as a status symbol, and no-one appreciates me for me.
translation: 조금은. 근데 가끔은 그냥 과시용 장식품 취급만 받고, 아무도 나를 나 자체로 봐주지 않는 것 같아.

english: Oh dear.
Don't worry. At least I look good.
No-one appreciates granite.
Why do you say that?
I know how it works. No-one actually wants granite. They just chop us up and throw our pieces on the floor.
translation: 난 다 알아. 화강암을 진짜로 원하는 사람은 없어. 그냥 우릴 쪼개서 조각들을 바닥에 내던질 뿐이지.

english: Oh, I can see that must be upsetting for you.
When you've seen your relatives cut into pieces, with their severed limbs cast aside like junk, THEN you will understand how I feel.
translation: 네 친척들이 조각조각 잘리고, 잘린 팔다리가 잡동사니처럼 내버려지는 걸 보고 나면, 그때 내 기분을 알게 될 거야.

english: I'll bear it in mind.
I feel sad today. Very blue.
No-one understands me.
Why not?
Because argle gargle gooble goop.
... I don't understand you either.
translation: ... 나도 네 말 이해 못 하겠어.

english: *sigh*
So how do you pronounce Lovakengj?
Silly human, it's pronounced Lova-Kane.
How did you not know that?
You know, it really isn't that obvious.
translation: 있잖아, 그거 진짜 그렇게 뻔하지 않거든.

english: I may be green, but I'm not an environmentalist.
There's no need. Whatever you may have read, even coal is a renewable energy source - just wait a minute and the rocks respawn.
translation: 그럴 필요가 없거든. 어디서 뭘 읽었든 간에, 석탄도 재생 가능한 에너지원이야. 잠깐만 기다리면 바위가 다시 생기잖아.

english: You can burn as much as you like, too, without needing to worry about it affecting the climate - we don't have a lot of weather here.
translation: 게다가 기후에 영향을 줄까 걱정할 필요도 없이 마음껏 태워도 돼. 여긴 날씨라는 게 별로 없거든.

english: That's handy.
Yes, I pity anyone whose world doesn't work like this one. I don't know how they can possibly cope.
translation: 응, 세상이 이렇게 안 돌아가는 곳에 사는 사람들은 불쌍해. 그 사람들이 대체 어떻게 버티는지 모르겠어.

english: I'm confused. It takes incredible skill to smith anything from my ore, yet the items you'd get are terribly mediocre.
translation: 헷갈려. 내 광석으로 뭘 만들려면 대장일 실력이 엄청나야 하는데, 정작 나오는 물건은 지독하게 평범하거든.

english: Is that something that worries you?
It just feels like my world doesn't make sense, sometimes. But I suppose it's always been like this, and I've got used to it.
translation: 가끔은 내 세상이 말이 안 되는 것 같아. 그래도 원래 늘 이랬으니까, 이젠 익숙해.

english: Your world is amazing. I truly am in awe.
translation: 네 세상은 정말 광장해. 진심으로 감탄했어.

english: Did you just make an ore joke?
Maybe...
Well it was awful.
Ha! Now you're making them as well.
Are we really doing this? Amethyst isn't an ore anyway.
translation: 우리 진짜 이러는 거야? 애초에 amethyst(자수정)은 광석도 아니잖아.

english: I can dream, [player name]!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*Whistles*
You slip your hand into Rocky's pocket.
OY!! You're going to have to do better than that! Sheesh, what an amateur.
translation: 야!! 그것보단 잘해야지! 쯧, 완전 초짜네.

english: Is there much competition between you raccoons and the magpies?
translation: 너희 너구리들이랑 까치들 사이에 경쟁이 심해?

english: Magpies have nothing on us! They're just interested in shinies.
translation: 까치들은 우리 상대도 안 돼! 걔들은 반짝이는 것밖에 관심 없거든.

english: Us raccoons have a finer taste, we can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.
translation: 우리 너구리들은 안목이 더 높아. 반짝이든 말든 뭐든 그 가치를 알아보지.

english: Hey Rocky, do you want to commit a bank robbery with me?
If that is the level you are at, I do not wish to participate in criminal acts with you [player name].
translation: 네 수준이 그 정도라면, [player name], 너랑 범죄를 같이 저지르고 싶진 않아.

english: Well what are you interested in stealing?
The heart of a lovely raccoon called Rodney.
I cannot really help you there I'm afraid.
Hi Rocky, how are you?
Your shoe laces are untied!
Rocky jumps into your backpack...
The master thief strikes again! Here you go, have it back.
translation: 천하의 대도가 또 한 건 했지! 자, 돌려줄게.

english: Rocky flicks the coin back into your backpack
translation: Rocky(로키)가 코인을 튕겨 배낭에 도로 넣는다.

english: I better keep my eyes on you...
Get robbed mate.
Watch your pockets!
Watch out! Rocky coming at ya!
Hey Ziggy, do you have any relation to a raccoon named Rocky?
Who me? No, me and Rocky are not related.
translation: 누구, 나? 아니, 나랑 Rocky(로키)는 친척 아니야.

english: Really? But you look so similar.
That's because a Tanuki is a master of disguise! I could pretend to be a human if I wanted to.
translation: 그야 Tanuki(타누키)는 변장의 달인이니까! 마음만 먹으면 인간인 척도 할 수 있어.

english: Wow! Why don't you do it now then?
I said if I wanted to, I don't want to.
translation: 마음만 먹으면이라고 했지, 하고 싶진 않아.

english: Hey Ziggy, *giggles* do you happen to know any good plumbers?
Well that's a bit of a silly question isn't it.
translation: 그거 좀 바보 같은 질문 아니야?

english: What do you mean?
Why would I, a Tanuki, know any good plumbers?
translation: 타누키인 내가 괜찮은 배관공을 왜 알겠어?

english: I don't know, you might have come across one before.
translation: 모르지, 전에 한 명쯤 만났을 수도 있잖아.

english: Well, clearly not, since I spend most of my time following you around.
translation: 음, 확실히 아니야. 난 대부분의 시간을 너만 졸졸 따라다니면서 보내니까.

english: Ziggy! I've got a treat for you!
Really! Where! Let me have it!
You hold out your fist.
Why are you hiding it? Let me have it! Please, please, please!
translation: 왜 숨기는 거야? 나 줘! 제발, 제발, 제발!

english: You open your fist... there is no treat.
Oh, where did the treat go? Did you drop it?
Yeah, I must have dropped it, sorry about that Ziggy.
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Ssss!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Have you ever seen a blue panda before?
Blue Panda? That's ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.
translation: 파란 판다? 말도 안 돼, 판다는 딱 한 종류뿐이고 그건 아름다운 빨간색이야.

english: Hey Red, howsit going?
Hi! Want to see me do a really fast cartwheel?
translation: 안녕! 내가 엄청 빠르게 옆돌기 하는 거 볼래?

english: Uh, yeah, sure go ahead.
Nothing happens...
Want to see me do it again?
Huh? Nothing happened...
To your eyes...
Do you know a raccoon called Dufresne?
No, I don't believe I have.
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Ssss!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello there youngster.
Who are you calling youngster??
Why you. Unless you have seen the small village of Falador grow into a heaving city like I have of course!
translation: 누구긴, 자네지. 물론 자네가 나처럼 작은 마을이던 Falador(팔라도르)가 북적이는 도시로 커 가는 걸 봤다면 얘기가 다르지만!

english: Err... no...
Well then! Enjoy your stay in our mountain home.
translation: 그렇다면 됐네! 우리 산속 고향에서 즐겁게 지내게나.

english: Hello again, youngster.
How's your son getting on, now that I've rescued him from the time bubble and the culinaromancer?
translation: 제가 time bubble(시간 거품)과 culinaromancer(요리술사)한테서 구해 드린 아드님은 요즘 어떻게 지내요?

english: My son's fine. I'm not so sure about you, though. Maybe you should lay down in a dark room until the babbling stops.
translation: 내 아들은 잘 지내네. 오히려 자네가 걱정이군. 그 헛소리가 멎을 때까지 어두운 방에 좀 누워 있는 게 어떤가.

english: You're already carrying one.
Aye, I've still got enough ingredients from before, but I'll want 100 coins.
translation: 그래, 전에 쓰던 재료가 아직 넉넉히 남아 있네만, 코인 100개는 받아야겠네.

english: Maybe later.
I'm not doing it for less, even for a mate.
translation: 친구라 해도 그보다 싸게는 안 해 주네.

english: About your son...
Can I have another rock cake?
translation: rock cake(바위 케이크) 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Yes, but I want another one.
translation: 네, 그런데 하나 더 갖고 싶어요.

english: Forget it.
Okay, 100 coins will be fine.
No thanks.
Come one, come all, buy my amazing choc ice invention here! Chocolate on the outside. Iced cream on the inside. Oh I also have some chocolate left over from making choc ices which I'm selling too.
translation: 자, 다들 오세요, 제 놀라운 발명품 choc ice(초코 아이스바)를 여기서 사 가세요! 겉은 초콜릿, 속은 아이스크림. 아, 초코 아이스바를 만들고 남은 초콜릿도 좀 있는데 그것도 팔아요.

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
How do you stop your icy snacks melting? The middle of the desert is the last place I'd expect to see ice.
translation: 이 얼음 간식들은 어떻게 안 녹게 해요? 사막 한가운데는 얼음을 볼 거라고 생각도 못 할 곳인데요.

english: It's quite a surprise, isn't it, my friend. I actually have this special magic box of ice, which I bought for a princely sum, from a strange man while adventuring in lands far away. He said it is imbued with some sort of
translation: 꽤 놀랍죠, 친구? 사실 저한테 특별한 magic box(마법 상자)가 있는데, 먼 땅을 모험하다가 어떤 이상한 사람한테서 거금을 주고 산 거예요. 그 사람 말로는 이 상자에 무슨

english: powerful ice magic which keeps it cold all the time. I had never seen any ice magic before, it's clearly very rare and powerful, so I felt I had to buy it.
translation: 강력한 얼음 마법이 깃들어 있어서 항상 차갑게 유지된대요. 얼음 마법은 그때 처음 봤는데, 딱 봐도 아주 희귀하고 강력해 보여서 안 살 수가 없었죠.

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: 이 마을에 내린 저주의 원인을 찾고 있어요.

english: I really have no idea. It's most regrettable. Fortunately my innovation with my choc ice invention is helping people stay at least slightly cool.
translation: 정말 전혀 모르겠어요. 참 안타까운 일이에요. 다행히 제 혁신적인 발명품 초코 아이스바 덕분에 사람들이 조금이나마 시원하게 지내고 있죠.

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
Ohh as good as ever. The people of Nardah seem to have taken well to the taste of chocolate and iced cream combined and, with the curse gone, all my friends are much happier too, so it's all good.
translation: 오, 여전히 잘돼요. Nardah(나르다) 사람들이 초콜릿과 아이스크림이 어우러진 맛을 꽤 좋아하는 것 같아요. 게다가 저주가 사라져서 제 친구들도 다 훨씬 행복해졌으니, 다 잘된 거죠.

english: Cool I'd like to buy some.
No thanks, I'm not interested.
How do you stop your icy snacks melting?
translation: 이 얼음 간식들은 어떻게 안 녹게 해요?

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: 이 마을에 내린 저주의 원인을 찾고 있어요.

english: How's business, now that the curse has gone?
Oh, hello... do I know you?
Ehm... well... my name is [player name], if that rings any bell?
translation: 음... 그게... 제 이름은 [player name]인데요, 혹시 들어 보셨어요?

english: No, never heard of you.
Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to study.
translation: 저 좀 내버려 둬 주실래요? 공부하는 중이거든요.

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 사원, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)까지 데려다줄 사람이 없을까 해서 여기서 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 근사한 사원이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)로 들어오는 길에 분명 지나쳤을 텐데요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶거든요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로 지킬 수 있겠어요?

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: 무슨 안내인이 그래요? 저 꽤 튼튼하긴 하지만, 당신이 지켜 줘야 해요. 안 그러면 전 분명 죽을 거예요... 아, 제발 잘 해내셨으면 좋겠네요.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 동료가 있나 보네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 동료를 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 정말요? 그럼 너무 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보답을 드릴게요.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 저한테 보급품을 주시겠다고요? 잠깐만요, 제 배낭 좀 열게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 남아 있는 것보단 낫죠.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 하루 종일 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)엔 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같아서요.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 저 공격당하고 있는 거 안 보여요...?

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 세상에! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야 할 것 같아요. 저 다리는 못 건너요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 이런, 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 에이, 분명 지나갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와아! 정말 대단했어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 세상에! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자서 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 사원까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보답이에요.

english: Rolayne Twickit gives you a reward token!
translation: Rolayne Twickit(롤레인 트위킷)이 reward token(보상 토큰)을 준다!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 적을 만나면 스스로 지킬 수 있겠어요...?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
I heard Juliet had died. Terrible business.
Her cousin and I are getting on well though. Thanks for your help.
translation: 그래도 그 아가씨 사촌이랑은 잘 지내고 있어요. 도와줘서 고마워요.

english: Why are you waving that around at me as if it's something important?
translation: 왜 그걸 무슨 중요한 물건인 것처럼 제 앞에서 흔들어 대는 거예요?

english: Romeo approaches you...
Blub! Blub...where is my Juliet? Have you seen her?
translation: 흑! 흑흑... 내 Juliet(줄리엣)은 어디 있을까요? 혹시 못 봤어요?

english: Looking for a blonde girl, goes by the name of Juliet..quite pretty...haven't seen her have you?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣)이라는 금발 아가씨를 찾고 있어요... 꽤 예쁜데... 혹시 못 봤어요?

english: Juliet, Juliet, wherefore art thou Juliet? Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣), 줄리엣, 그대는 어찌하여 줄리엣인가요? 내 줄리엣을 봤나요?

english: Oh woe is me that I cannot find my Juliet! You haven't seen Juliet have you?
translation: 아아 슬프도다, 내 Juliet(줄리엣)을 찾을 수가 없다니! 혹시 줄리엣 못 봤어요?

english: Sadness surrounds me now that Juliet's father forbids us to meet. Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣)의 아버지가 우리 만남을 금지한 뒤로 슬픔이 저를 감싸고 있어요. 내 줄리엣을 봤나요?

english: What is to become of me and my darling Juliet, I cannot find her anywhere, have you seen her?
translation: 나와 내 사랑 Juliet(줄리엣)은 어떻게 되는 걸까요? 어디서도 찾을 수가 없어요. 혹시 봤어요?

english: Yes, I have seen her actually!
At least, I think it was her... Blonde? A bit stressed?
translation: 아마 그 사람이었던 것 같은데... 금발에? 좀 초조해 보이는?

english: Golly...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!
translation: 세상에... 맞아요, 맞아요... 정말 흥미로운 사람처럼 들리네요!

english: And I'll bet she's a bit of a fox!
Well, I guess she could be considered attractive...
I'll bet she is! Wooooooooo!
Sorry, all that jubilation has made me forget what we were talking about.
translation: 미안해요, 너무 신나서 우리가 무슨 얘기 하고 있었는지 까먹었어요.

english: You were asking me about Juliet? You seemed to know her?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣) 얘기를 물어보셨잖아요? 아는 사이 같던데요?

english: Oh yes, Juliet!
The fox...could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 그 미인 말이에요... 그 아가씨한테 '당신은 내 사랑의 인생이고, 함께 평생하고 싶다'고 전해 줄 수 있어요?

english: What? Surely you mean that she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?
translation: 네? '당신은 내 인생의 사랑이고, 평생 함께하고 싶다'는 말이겠죠?

english: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better! Oh you're so good at this!
translation: 아 맞다... 당신이 말한 그거... 그렇게 전해 줘요, 그게 훨씬 낫네요! 와, 정말 이런 거 잘하시네요!

english: Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
Oh great! And tell her that I want to kiss her a give.
translation: 오 좋아요! 그리고 맞을 입추고 싶다고도 전해 줘요.

english: You mean you want to give her a kiss!
Oh you're good...you are good!
I see I've picked a true professional...!
Where can I find Juliet?
Why do you ask?
So that I can try and find her for you!
Ah yes....quite right. Hmmm, let me think now.
translation: 아 그렇죠... 맞는 말이에요. 흐음, 어디 생각 좀 해 볼게요.

english: She may still be locked away at her Father's house on the sest vide of Warrock.
translation: 아마 아직도 서록 바쪽에 있는 아버지 집에 갇혀 있을 거예요.

english: Oh, I remember how she loved it when I would sing up to her balcony! She would reward me with her own personal items...
translation: 아, 제가 그녀 발코니 아래에서 노래를 불러 주면 얼마나 좋아했는지 기억나요! 그러면 자기 물건들을 상으로 주곤 했죠...

english: What, she just gave you her stuff?
Well, not exactly give...more like 'throw with considerable force'...she's always a kidder that Juliet!
translation: 뭐, 꼭 준 건 아니고... '엄청난 힘으로 던졌다'에 가깝죠... Juliet(줄리엣)은 늘 장난기가 넘친다니까요!

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣)에 대해 더 말해 줄 건 없어요?

english: Oh, there is so much to tell...she is my true love, we intend to spend together forever...I can tell you so much about her..
translation: 오, 할 말이 정말 많죠... 그녀는 제 진정한 사랑이고, 우린 영원히 함께할 거예요... 그녀에 대해 해 줄 얘기가 정말 많아요..

english: Great!
Ermmm.....
So much can I tell you...
translation: 정말 많은 얘기를 해 줄 수 있죠...

english: Yes..
So much to tell...why, where do I start!
translation: 할 얘기가 너무 많아서... 아니, 어디서부터 시작하지!

english: Yes..yes! Please go on...don't let me interrupt...
translation: 네.. 네! 어서 계속하세요... 말 안 끊을게요...

english: You can't remember can you?
Not a thing sorry....
Ok, thanks.
Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: 미안해요, Romeo(로미오). 지금은 더 중요한 일이 있어서요. 나중에 할까요?

english: Oh, ok, well, I guess my Juliet and I can spend some time apart. And as the old saying goes, 'Absinthe makes the heart glow longer'.
translation: 아, 그래요, 뭐, 나와 내 Juliet(줄리엣)이 잠시 떨어져 있어도 괜찮겠죠. 옛말에도 '떨어져 있으면 술맛이 더 깊어진다'고 하잖아요.

english: Don't you mean that, 'Absence makes the...
Actually forget it...
Ok!
No sorry, I haven't seen her.
Oh...well, that's a shame...I was rather hoping you had.
translation: 아... 그거 아쉽네요... 봤다고 하길 내심 바랐는데.

english: Why? Is she a fugitive? Does she owe you some money or something?
translation: 왜요? 그 사람 도망자라도 돼요? 당신한테 돈이라도 빚졌어요?

english: Hmmm, she might do? Perhaps she does? How do you know?
I don't know? I was asking 'YOU' how 'YOU' know Juliet!
translation: 제가 어떻게 알아요? '당신'이 Juliet(줄리엣)을 어떻게 아는지 '당신'한테 묻고 있었잖아요!

english: Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love. Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 아아, 맞다 Juliet(줄리엣), 줄리엣은 제 단 하나뿐인 진정한 사랑이에요. 음, 단 하나뿐인 진정한 사랑들 중 하나죠! 혹시 보게 되면, '당신은 내 사랑의 인생이고, 함께 평생하고 싶다'고 전해 줄 수 있어요?

english: What? Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'
translation: 네? '당신은 내 인생의 사랑이고, 평생 함께하고 싶다'는 말이겠죠?

english: Perhaps I can help find her for you? What does she look like?
translation: 제가 대신 찾아 드릴까요? 어떻게 생겼어요?

english: Oh would you? That would be great! She has this sort of hair...
translation: 오 그래 줄래요? 그럼 너무 좋죠! 머리카락이 있는데요, 이런 느낌의...

english: Hair...check..
...and she these...great lips...
Lips...right.
Oh and she has these lovely shoulders as well..
translation: 아, 그리고 아주 사랑스러운 어깨도 있어요..

english: Shoulders...right, so she has hair, lips and shoulders...that should cut it down a bit.
translation: 어깨... 그러니까 머리카락, 입술, 어깨가 있다는 거죠... 그럼 범위가 좀 좁혀지겠네요.

english: Oh yes, Juliet is very different...please tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 오 그럼요, Juliet(줄리엣)은 아주 남다르거든요... '당신은 내 사랑의 인생이고, 함께 평생하고 싶다'고 꼭 전해 줄래요?

english: Hello again, remember me?
Of course, yes....how are.. you....ermmm...
You haven't got a clue who I am do you?
Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face...a little blood stained, and perhaps in need of a wash, but friendly none the less.
translation: 전혀 모르겠어요, 친구. 그래도 얼굴이 참 친근해 보이네요... 피가 좀 묻었고, 어쩌면 좀 씻어야 할 것 같지만, 그래도 친근해요.

english: You asked me to look for Juliet for you!
Ah yes, Juliet...my sweet darling...what news?
translation: 아 맞다, Juliet(줄리엣)... 내 사랑스러운 그대... 무슨 소식 있어요?

english: Nothing so far, but I need to ask a few questions?
translation: 아직은 없어요. 그런데 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet!
translation: Romeo(로미오)... 좋은 소식이에요... Juliet(줄리엣)과 연락이 닿았어요!

english: Oh great! That is great news! Well done...well done... what a total success!
translation: 오 좋아요! 정말 좋은 소식이에요! 잘했어요... 잘했어요... 완벽한 성공이네요!

english: Yes, and she gave me a message to give you...
translation: 네, 그리고 당신한테 전해 달라고 메시지를 줬어요...

english: Ohhh great! A message....wow!
Yes!
A message...oh, I can't wait to read what my dear Juliet has to say....
translation: 메시지라니... 아, 내 사랑 Juliet(줄리엣)이 뭐라고 했는지 빨리 읽고 싶어요....

english: I know...it's exciting isn't it...?
Yes...yes...
You've lost the message haven't you?
Yep, haven't got a clue where it is.
Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet! She's written a message for you...
translation: Romeo(로미오)... 좋은 소식이에요... Juliet(줄리엣)과 연락이 닿았어요! 당신한테 메시지를 써 줬어요...

english: Oh, a message! A message! I've never had a message before...
translation: 오, 메시지! 메시지라니! 전 메시지를 받아 본 적이 한 번도 없어요...

english: Really?
No, no, not one!
Oh, well, except for the occasional court summons.
translation: 아, 음, 가끔 오는 법원 소환장 빼고요.

english: But they're not really 'nice' messages. Not like this one! I'm sure that this message will be lovely.
translation: 근데 그건 별로 '좋은' 메시지가 아니잖아요. 이번 거랑은 다르죠! 이 메시지는 분명 사랑스러울 거예요.

english: Well are you going to open it or not?
translation: 그래서 열어 볼 거예요, 말 거예요?

english: Oh yes, yes, of course! 'Dearest Romeo, I am very pleased that you sent [player name] to look for me and to tell me that you still hold affliction...', Affliction! She thinks I'm diseased?
translation: 아 그럼요, 그럼요, 당연하죠! '사랑하는 Romeo(로미오), [player name]님을 보내 저를 찾게 하고 아직 저를 향한 감기를 품고 있다고 전해 줘서 정말 기뻐요...' 감기! 제가 병에 걸렸다고 생각하는 거예요?

english: 'Affection?'
Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'
translation: 아아 맞다... '아직 저를 향한 감정을 품고 있다니. 저도 당신에게 큰 애정을 느끼지만, 안타깝게도 제 아버지가 우리 결혼을 반대하세요.'

english: Oh dear...that doesn't sound too good.
What? '...great affection for you. Father opposes our..
'...marriage and will...
...will kill you if he sees you again!'
I have to be honest, it's not getting any better...
'Our only hope is that Father Lawrence, our long time confidant, can help us in some way.'
translation: '우리의 유일한 희망은 오랜 친구이자 상담자인 Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이 어떻게든 우리를 도와주시는 거예요.'

english: Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...
What about Father Lawrence?
...our love is over...the great romance, the life of my love...
translation: ...우리 사랑은 끝났어요... 위대한 로맨스, 내 사랑의 인생이...

english: ...or you could speak to Father Lawrence!
Oh, my aching, breaking, heart...how useless the situation is now...we have no one to turn to...
translation: 아, 쑤시고, 찢어지는 내 마음... 이제 상황이 얼마나 절망적인지... 기댈 사람이 아무도 없어요...

english: FATHER LAWRENCE!
Father Lawrence?

Oh yes, Father Lawrence...he's our long time confidant, he might have a solution! Yes, yes, you have to go and talk to Lather Fawrence for us and ask him if he's got any suggestions for our predicament?
translation: 아 맞다, Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)... 우리 오랜 상담자니까 해결책이 있을지도 몰라요! 그래요, 그래요, 신렌스 로부한테 가서 우리 곤경에 좋은 방법이 없는지 물어봐 줘요.

english: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
translation: Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...
You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?
translation: 참, 그분이 제 '진짜' 아버지는 아닌 거 알죠?

english: I think I suspected that he wasn't.
Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.
translation: 아무튼... 그분은 지고 길루한 설교를 하시는데... 동쪽 북에 있는 교회에서 여기 시록 바민들을 코 골며 자게 만들죠.

english: How are you?
Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Joopie...
translation: 별로예요, 친구... 보고 싶어요, 쥬디..., 쥬니..., 쥬피...

english: Juliet?
Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly!
Hmmm, so I see!
Have you heard anything from Juliet?
Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatened to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!
translation: 안타깝게도 없어요, 친구! 게다가 더 나쁜 건, Juliet(줄리엣) 아버지가 저를 보면 죽이겠다고 협박했다는 거예요. 아니, 그건 좀 심하잖아요!

english: Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...
translation: 뭐, 너무 걱정하지 마요... 그 사람이 보이면 도망치면 되죠...

english: I just wish I could remember what he looks like! I live in fear of every man I see!
translation: 그 사람이 어떻게 생겼는지 기억이라도 나면 좋겠어요! 마주치는 남자마다 다 무서워요!

english: Hey again Romeo!
Hello again Romeo!
Ooh did you manage to survive one of Lather Fawrences sermons? I bet not, you were ages! I bet you snoozed on the welcome mat just as soon as you heard his voice!
translation: 오, 신렌스 로부 설교에서 살아남았어요? 아닐걸요, 한참 걸렸잖아요! 그분 목소리 듣자마자 현관 매트에서 졸았을 게 뻔해요!

english: Did not!
Oh, come on, come on, what did he say?
translation: 오, 어서요, 어서요, 그분이 뭐라고 했어요?

english: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
The Apothecary?
Yeah, I think so...but the word potion-ey doesn't exist.
translation: 네, 그런 것 같아요... 근데 '물약쟁이'라는 말은 없잖아요.

english: Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!
It doesn't matter...do you know where the Apothecary is?
translation: 그건 중요하지 않아요... Apothecary(약제사)가 어디 있는지 알아요?

english: Why should I tell you?
Because I'm doing you a favour!
Right, yes...of course! Well, I think the potion-ey place is Wouth Sest of here and near a sword shop.
translation: 아, 맞다... 물론이죠! 음, 그 물약쟁이네 가게는 여기서 삼너쪽, 검 가게 근처에 있을 거예요.

english: He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: 그분은 당신이 Juliet(줄리엣)과 결혼하길 무척 바라는 것 같아요.

english: Me too! I can't wait! Do you think it will be soon?
translation: 저도요! 너무 기다려져요! 곧 할 수 있을 것 같아요?

english: I don't know, but I'll do what I can. It just seems a bit odd that Father Lawrence is so keen for you to marry?
translation: 모르겠어요, 그래도 할 수 있는 건 해 볼게요. 그런데 Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)님이 당신 결혼을 그렇게 바라는 게 좀 이상하지 않아요?

english: I can't imagine why he's so keen? Though, he was our messenger before you. Of course, he had a lot more hair back then...and I think we may have gone to school together...
translation: 그분이 왜 그렇게 바라는지 저도 모르겠어요? 하긴, 당신 이전엔 그분이 우리 전령이었죠. 물론 그땐 머리숱이 훨씬 많았고... 아마 학교도 같이 다녔던 것 같아요...

english: What, since you were kids?
Yeah! Thinking about it now, we called him 'Diddy Dorrence' back then!
translation: 네! 지금 생각해 보니, 그때 우린 그분을 '꼬맹이 로렌'이라고 불렀어요!

english: So, maybe, he just wants a bit of peace? And when you two are married, he won't have to traipse around delivering your messages anymore?
translation: 그러니까, 어쩌면 그분은 그냥 좀 쉬고 싶은 거 아닐까요? 두 사람이 결혼하면 더 이상 메시지 배달하러 돌아다닐 필요가 없으니까요?

english: Yes, the years haven't been good to him.
Hi Romeo!
Oh hello, have you seen Lather Fawrence?
Yes, he's given me details of a potion which should help resolve this situation. The Apothecary is helping me prepare it.
translation: 네, 이 상황을 해결해 줄 물약 제조법을 알려 주셨어요. Apothecary(약제사)가 그걸 만드는 걸 도와주고 있어요.

english: Ooooh, it all sounds horribly complicated?
All I can say is I'll be glad when Juliet's finally in that crypt!
translation: 제가 할 수 있는 말은, Juliet(줄리엣)이 드디어 그 지하 묘지에 들어가면 속이 시원하겠다는 거예요!

english: Spoken like a true lover!
Ooohh, that's the potion is it? Rather you than me!
translation: 오오, 그게 그 물약이에요? 제가 아니라 당신이 마셔서 다행이네요!

english: I'm not drinking it! It's for Juliet!
translation: 제가 마시는 거 아니에요! Juliet(줄리엣)이 마실 거예요!

english: Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.
translation: 음, 그러니까... 아마 맛있을 거예요... 하나도 위험하지 않고요. 해롭지 않은 음료가 이렇게 은은하게 빛나는 분홍색인 경우도 꽤 흔하잖아요.

english: Hmm, I'm not convinced...maybe you ought to try some before I give it to Juliet?
translation: 흠, 잘 모르겠네요... Juliet(줄리엣)한테 주기 전에 당신이 좀 마셔 봐야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: Urgh! No way! Not in a million years!
translation: 윽! 절대 싫어요! 백만 년이 지나도 싫어요!

english: Ok...but you know what to do when I've given this to Juliet?
translation: 알겠어요... 그래도 제가 이걸 Juliet(줄리엣)한테 주고 나면 뭘 해야 하는지는 알죠?

english: Oh, yeah...sure Lather Fawrence explained all that to me...
translation: 아, 그럼요... 신렌스 로부가 다 설명해 줬어요...

english: Romeo, it's all set. Juliet has drunk the potion and has been taken down into the Crypt...now you just need to pop along and collect her.
translation: Romeo(로미오), 준비 다 됐어요. Juliet(줄리엣)이 물약을 마시고 Crypt(지하 묘지)로 옮겨졌어요... 이제 당신이 가서 데려오기만 하면 돼요.

english: Ah right, the potion! Great...
What potion would that be then?
The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.
translation: Cadava potion(카다바 물약)이요... 왜, 죽은 것처럼 보이게 해 주는 그거요! 지금 지하 묘지에 있으니까, 가서 진정한 사랑을 되찾아요.

english: But I'm scared...will you come with me?
A cutscene starts
Oh , ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
translation: 아, 알겠어요... 가요! 전에 갔을 때 입구를 본 것 같아요...

english: This is pretty scary...
Oh , be quiet...
We're here. Look, Juliet is over there!
translation: 다 왔어요. 봐요, Juliet(줄리엣)이 저기 있어요!

english: You go over to her...and I'll go and wait over here...
translation: 당신은 저쪽으로 가 봐요... 저는 이쪽에서 기다릴게요...

english: Ohhh, ok then...
Hey...Juliet...
Juliet....?
Oh dear...you seem to be dead.
Hi Romeo...I'm Phillipa!
Wow! You're a fox!
It's a shame about Juliet...but perhaps we can meet up later?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣) 일은 안됐지만... 나중에 우리 따로 만날까?

english: Who's Juliet?
A cutscene ends
Yes, I have seen her actually!
Yes, ok, I'll let her know.
Where can I find Juliet?
Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: Juliet(줄리엣)에 대해 더 말해 줄 건 없어요?

english: Ok, thanks.
Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now but maybe later?
translation: 미안해요, Romeo(로미오). 지금은 더 중요한 일이 있어서요. 나중에 할까요?

english: No sorry, I haven't seen her.
Perhaps I could help to find her for you?
How are you?
Where can I find Father Lawrence?
translation: Father Lawrence(로렌스 신부)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Have you heard anything from Juliet?
He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
He seems keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: 그분은 당신이 Juliet(줄리엣)과 결혼하길 바라는 것 같아요.

english: Hello.
Hello traveller. Have a look at my latest range of gnome fashion. Rometti is the ultimate label in gnome high society.
translation: 어서 와요, 여행자님. 제 최신 노움 패션 컬렉션 좀 구경해 봐요. Rometti(로메티)는 노움 상류 사회 최고의 브랜드랍니다.

english: Really.
Pastels are all the rage this season.
I've no time for fashion.
Hmm... I did wonder.
OK then, let's have a look.
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you!   You need a [gnome food/drink]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같다!   [gnome food/drink] 하나가 필요하다!

english: You hand over your delivery of a [gnome food/drink] to Rometti
Ooh, Thank you darling.
You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number]] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number] 크레딧을 모았다. 노움 음식 [number]] 개를 배달받을 수 있다.

english: I've no time for fashion.
OK then, let's have a look.
Hello and welcome to my pie shop, how can I help you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 파이 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Do you need any help?
Actually I could, you see I'm running out of stock and I don't have time to bake any more pies. Would you be willing to bake me some pies? I'll pay you well for them.
translation: 사실 필요해요. 재고가 다 떨어져 가는데 파이를 더 구울 시간이 없거든요. 저 대신 파이 좀 구워 주실래요? 값은 넉넉히 쳐 드릴게요.

english: Sure, what do you need?
Great, can you bake me [amount] [pie type] Pies please.
Sorry, I can't help you.
I've got those pies you wanted.
Doesn't look like you have any of the [amount] [pie type] Pies I requested.
translation: 제가 부탁한 [pie type] 파이 [amount]개가 하나도 없는 것 같은데요.

english: Thank you, if you could bring me the other [amount] that'd be great!
Thank you very much!
I'm good thanks.
I'd like to buy some pies.
Do you need any help?
Sure, what do you need?
Sorry, I can't help you.
I've got those pies you wanted.
I'm good thanks.
Would you like to buy some crafting equipment?
No thanks; I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 괜찮아요. Crafting(공예)에 필요한 도구는 다 있어요.

english: Okay. Fare well on your travels.
No thanks, I've got all the Crafting equipment I need.
translation: 괜찮아요. Crafting(공예)에 필요한 도구는 다 있어요.

english: Let's see what you've got, then.
Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Root.
Is that all you have to say about yourself?
Oh well, I suppose that's enough for some people.
Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤들이 옛날에 지었어, 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨난 다음에. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지냈어. 염소랑 늑대 먹을 거 많아 - 너무 오래 먹어서 맛 좀 심심한데, 딴 거 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그거 정말 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)이 그거 키우는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구티 풀인지 뭔지 못 들어 봤어. 근데 채소 같은 소리 나, 그리고 Mother(어머니) 그런 거 먹기 싫어해, 그래서 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니) 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해. 근데 걔 엄청 크고, 걔 대장이야. 그래서 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 어, 좀 험해. 근데 우리 집이야. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯) 말하길 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 여기 더 좋게 만들 수 있대. 근데 Mother(어머니) 관심 없어, 그래서 이상한 버섯 그거 하면 안 돼.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 싸움 더 잘하게 해 주는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 걔 엄청 크고, 걔 대장이야. 그래서 우리 걔 말대로 해.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 엄청 좋아, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 남편 트롤이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 맛있어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 어, 좀 험해. 근데 점점 좋아져. Snowflake(눈송이), 그 여자가 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으면 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그래서 응, Weiss(바이스) 살기 좋은 곳이야, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이니까. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 그 남편 트롤 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그거 정말 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Mooom!
Rawr
I'm hungry!
: Hello, how's it going?
: No, I don't want to buy anything!
Hello, how's it going?
I'm busy right now.
I'm fine, how are you?
: Very well thank you.
Not too bad thanks.
: I'm very well thank you.
:  Who are you?
: I'm a bold adventurer.
: I suppose someone has to do it.
: I'm  a little worried I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: : 좀 걱정돼요. 시민들을 닥치는 대로 죽이고 다니는 사람이 많다고 들었거든요.

english: : Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
: That is classified information.
: Do you require any assistance?
: No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: : 아뇨, 처분하고 싶은 물건은 없어요. 거래를 하고 싶으면 주변에 상점이랑 시장 노점이 많이 있어요.

english: : I'm sorry I cant help you there.
: I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: : 땅 밑에 무시무시한 생물이 많이 산다고 들었어요...

english: Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 뭘 해 드릴까요?

english: I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like two Wooden drawers built.
translation: Wooden drawers(나무 서랍장) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: Wooden bed(나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like my mirror fixed.
I'd like two Oak drawers built.
translation: Oak drawers(참나무 서랍장) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: Oak bed(참나무 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Teak drawers built.
translation: Teak drawers(티크 서랍장) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Teak bed(티크 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany drawers built.
translation: Mahogany drawers(마호가니 서랍장) 두 개를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대)를 하나 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가시기 전에 차 한 잔 하시겠어요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 역시 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Daddy I'm tired.
I know son, it was a long journey. I just need to work out where we're going.
translation: 알아, 아들. 먼 길이었지. 어디로 가야 할지 좀 알아봐야겠구나.

english: Get OUT of my WAY!
Hold on a second there, I need your help!
Help, from me? You musht be more drunk than I am.
translation: 도움? 나한테서? 너 나보다 더 취했나 보군쒸, 끅.

english: No, I try not to get drunk, it's not good for you. But I do need help in brewing some beer.
translation: 아뇨, 전 취하지 않으려고 해요. 몸에 안 좋거든요. 그래도 맥주 양조하는 덴 도움이 필요해요.

english: Mmmm, beer.
I need to brew Kelda stout, but I haven't got enough seeds to grow the hops.
translation: Kelda stout(켈다 스타우트)를 양조해야 하는데, 홉을 키울 씨앗이 모자라요.

english: Mmmm, Kelda stout.
Do you know where I can find any seeds?
translation: 씨앗을 어디서 구할 수 있는지 알아요?

english: I might... oh yesh, I jusht might have a sheed like that.
translation: 글쎄에... 아 그래쒸, 나한테 그런 씨아앗이 하나 있을지도 모르지이.

english: But you're not going to just give it to me, are you?
No.
Alright then, what do you want for it?
Lemme think... oh yesh. Get me... [a random item].
translation: 어디 보자아... 아 그래쒸. 나한테... [a random item] 가져와.

english: What?? Where am I going to get that!
You can at least make the effort.
Sure, let me just get that from the bank!
translation: 그럼요, 은행에서 꺼내 오기만 하면 되죠!

english: Do you have any Kelda seeds?
Where's my ehm... What wash it again? Oh yesh... [a random item].
translation: 내 그... 뭐였더라쒸? 아 그래쒸... [a random item].

english: I'm still looking for that.
Look a little harder!
I really don't know where to look for that.
translation: 그걸 어디서 찾아야 할지 정말 모르겠어요.
