english: You humans are jusht sho thick. Alright, shtop looking for it then, get me shomething else...
translation: 인간들은 증말 쒸... 머리가 나빠아. 알았어, 그거 그만 찾고, 딴 거 가져와쒸...

english: Look, I've got it here!
Shplendid! Give that to me please!
Now how about those seeds?
Well, I've got a Kelda hop seed right here! Pashed down generation after generation in my family...
translation: 자, 여기 Kelda hop seed(켈다 홉 씨앗)이 있지! 우리 집안에서 대대로 물려 내려온 거쒸...

english: Wow, really?
Nah, I'm just kidding! Here, have the seed, you won't catch me farming in shome dirt patch anyway!
translation: 아니, 농담이야아! 자, 씨앗 가져가, 어차피 내가 흙바닥에서 농사짓는 꼴은 절대 못 볼 테니까쒸!

english: I suppose you wouldn't ever have a proper job or do some decent hard work, no.
translation: 하긴 당신은 제대로 된 직업을 갖거나 성실하게 힘든 일을 할 리가 없겠죠.

english: What wash that?
Nothing...
I'm still looking for that.
I really don't know where to look.
Good day sir. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.
translation: 안녕하십니까, 손님. 저희 최고급 Bloody Bracers(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 어떠십니까? 이 지역 특산품입니다.

english: One Bloody Bracer please.
translation: Bloody Bracer(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 주세요.

english: That will be 99 coins.
I don't have that much.
Then for now, our business is at an end.
translation: 그렇다면 지금은 거래가 끝난 것으로 하지요.

english: Here you go.
You buy a Bloody Bracer.
Enjoy.
Thanks.
I'm not paying that!
What happened to Carl?
Carl?
The old barkeep.
Oh yes, Carl!
He had to leave I'm afraid. Fear not though. I have taken over things here.
translation: 안타깝게도 떠나야 했습니다. 하지만 걱정 마십시오. 이제 이곳은 제가 맡고 있습니다.

english: And you are?
Roy is the name. Now, could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers?
translation: Roy(로이)라고 합니다. 자, 저희 최고급 Bloody Bracers(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 어떠십니까?

english: I'm not thirsty.
One Bloody Bracer please.
translation: Bloody Bracer(피 묻은 팔보호대) 한 잔 주세요.

english: Here you go.
I'm not paying that!
What happened to Carl?
I'm not thirsty.
Hi, I'm Roy jr!
Is that Roy over there then?
Nope, that's Red, we're on an adventure!
translation: 아니, 쟤는 Red(레드)야. 우리 모험 중이야!

english: Oh really? Where are you heading?
To the west, to explore the Kebos Lowlands.
I've heard it's dangerous over there...
Well, my dad has gone that way, he's a knight!
translation: 음, 우리 아빠가 그쪽으로 갔거든. 우리 아빠 기사야!

english: I hope you find him, young one. I best be off.
translation: 아빠를 꼭 찾길 바랄게요, 꼬마 친구. 저는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Something's different.
Nope, seems pretty much the same to me.
Hmm...
My favourite colour is green!
Great! How uncreative!
It's the colour of my little duck friend.
Indeed it is.
Come on... Something here has to work...
translation: 자, 어서... 여기 뭔가 통하는 게 있을 텐데...

english: Care for any assistance?
Absolutely! I can't seem to find a way into that crevice to continue my scientific endeavour. I don't suppose you could have a dig around?
translation: 물론이지! 저 틈새로 들어갈 방법을 도무지 못 찾아서 과학적 탐구를 이어 갈 수가 없다네. 자네가 혹시 좀 파 봐 줄 수 있겠나?

english: A scientific dig... Where have I heard of that before?
translation: 과학적 발굴이라... 그거 어디서 들어 본 것 같은데요?

english: Don't dwell on it too long. There are things I must learn about our world!
translation: 너무 오래 곱씹지 말게. 우리 세계에 대해 알아내야 할 것이 많으니까!

english: I found a ruby in the ground.
Wondrous! A good sign to be sure! You may keep it, while I will keep the knowledge of what may be here.
translation: 경이롭군! 틀림없이 좋은 징조야! 그건 자네가 가지게. 나는 이곳에 무엇이 있을지 알게 된 것으로 족하네.

english: Okay...
So I'm here... That's there... Then how do we get down there?
translation: 그러니까 내가 여기 있고... 저게 저기 있고... 그럼 저 아래로는 어떻게 내려가지?

english: Chatting to yourself?
Ah, hello there! I'm just pondering on the wonders of geography.
translation: 아, 안녕하신가! 지리학의 경이로움을 곰곰이 생각하던 참이었네.

english: Anything I can help you out with?
Most certainly. Perhaps you could dig around near the mouth of that nearby cave and elucidate its nature for me.
translation: 물론 있지. 저 근처 동굴 입구 주변을 파 보고 그곳이 어떤 곳인지 밝혀 주면 좋겠네.

english: Will I get anything for helping?
The feeling of satisfaction after helping a scientist in need?
translation: 곤경에 처한 과학자를 도운 뒤에 느끼는 뿌듯함 정도면 되지 않겠나?

english: Fair enough.
I found a sapphire nearby.
Outstanding! This can only be seen as a positive! I shall add the knowledge to my reserves. You may keep the gem.
translation: 훌륭하군! 이건 긍정적인 신호로밖에 볼 수 없어! 이 지식은 내 머릿속 창고에 넣어 두겠네. 보석은 자네가 가지게.

english: Alright...
Are you lost?
No, my good friend, but I am in a bit of a pickle.
translation: 아닐세, 친구. 다만 지금 좀 꽉 막힌 처지라네.

english: A pickle?
Perhaps a jam... Those bandits over there are in the way of scientific discovery!
translation: 길이 꽉 막혔다고 해야 하려나... 저기 있는 산적들이 과학적 발견의 길을 가로막고 있거든!

english: Would you like me to deal with them?
Well, I'm not averse to a little academic collaboration. I just need some proof that there's something strange here.
translation: 글쎄, 약간의 학술 협력이라면 마다하지 않겠네. 다만 여기에 뭔가 이상한 것이 있다는 증거가 좀 필요해.

english: Is there any chance you could dig near the mouth of that cave for me? Let me know if you find anything.
translation: 저 동굴 입구 근처를 좀 파 봐 줄 수 있겠나? 뭔가 찾으면 알려 주게.

english: What should I do with the bandits?
I have no qualms with you doing what you must on that front.
translation: 그쪽 일은 자네가 해야 할 일을 하더라도 난 아무 불만 없네.

english: I found an emerald in the earth.
Stupendous! Combined with the other locations, I suspect there may be more to this than meets the eye.
translation: 굉장하군! 다른 장소들과 함께 생각해 보면, 여기엔 눈에 보이는 것 이상의 무언가가 있는 것 같아.

english: Right...
Keep the gem for yourself, as payment for your assistance.
Hello.
You ssshould not be down here...
Who are you?
My name isss unimportant... I live only to ssserve my massster.
translation: 내 이름은 중요하지 않ㅅ소... 나는 오직 주인님을 ㅅ섬기기 위해 ㅅ살 뿐이오.

english: Um... Okay then.
Why are you down here?
Thisss isss where I belong... Beingsss sssuch as myssself cannot abide in the light... It is in the darknesss where we find our homesss...
translation: 이곳이 내가 있어야 할 곳이ㅅ오... 나 같은 존재는 빛 속에ㅅ서 견딜 수 없ㅅ소... 우리가 보금자리를 찾는 곳은 어둠 속이오...

english: Uh... Okay then.
Can I use your anvil?
Of courssse you may... I have very little ussse for it nowadaysss...
translation: 물론 써도 되오... 요즘은 나도 그걸 ㅅ쓸 일이 거의 없ㅅ소...

english: Uh... Thanks, I guess.
Are you an assistant to Count Draynor?
I used to have that honour...Why do you ssseek me?
translation: 한때는 그런 영광을 누렸ㅅ소... 어찌하여 나를 찾ㅅ소?

english: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?
translation: silver bar(은 주괴)를 가져오면 '제물 봉헌 단지'를 만들어 주실 수 있다고 들었는데요?

english: And where did you hear thisss?
It was from Malak in Canifis.
Ah, I sssee...Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item...It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...
translation: 아, 그렇군... 그렇ㅅ소, 그런 물건을 만드는 법은 알고 있ㅅ소... 다만 그런 걸 만들 일이 없어진 지도 벌써 여러 해가 지났지만...

english: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item, I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...
translation: 그대가 어찌하여 그런 물건을 원하는지 캐물을 생각은 없ㅅ소. 그대 같은 이가 그런 부탁을 하다니 그저 놀랐을 뿐이오...

english: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver...Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...
translation: 이 단지를 기꺼이 만들어 주겠ㅅ소. 하지만 은 주괴 하나를 가져와야 하오... 안타깝게도 나는 더는 재료를 직접 모을 수 없고, 여기에 머물러야만 하오...

english: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?
translation: silver bar(은 주괴)를 가져왔는데, 이걸로 '제물 봉헌 단지'를 만들어 주실 수 있을까요?

english: Yesss, of courssse...There you are, put it to good usssse...
translation: 그렇ㅅ소, 물론이오... 여기 있ㅅ소. 요긴하게 ㅅ쓰시오...

english: Who are you?
Why are you down here?
Can I use your anvil?
Hi!
Grrreetings frrriend! Welcome to my worrrld famous food emporrrium! All my meats are so frrresh you'd swear you killed them yourrrself!
translation: 그르르, 반가워요, 친구! 세계적으로 유명한 제 식료품점에 오신 걸 환영해요! 고기가 다 어찌나 신선한지, 직접 잡은 줄 아실 거예요!

english: Why do you only sell meats?
What? Why, what else would you want to eat? What kind of lycanthrrrope are you anyway?
translation: 뭐라고요? 아니, 그럼 뭘 먹고 싶다는 거예요? 대체 어떤 늑대인간이시길래?

english: ...A vegetarian one?
Vegetarrrian...?
Never mind.
Do you sell cooked food?
Cooked food? Who would want that? You lose all the flavourrr of the meat when you can't taste the blood!
translation: 익힌 음식? 그런 걸 누가 먹어요? 피 맛을 못 느끼면 고기의 풍미르르가 다 사라진다고요!

english: Can I buy some food?
Cerrrtainly!
Why do you only sell meats?
Do you sell cooked food?
Can I buy some food?
Hello there.
Hello. A fine day for stealing, wouldn't you say?
translation: 안녕하세요. 도둑질하기 딱 좋은 날이죠, 안 그래요?

english: I suppose so, just as long as you're not planning to steal from me.
translation: 그런 것 같네요. 저한테서 훔칠 생각만 아니라면요.

english: You don't have any house keys, do you? You won't find yourself getting very far without any. Maybe come back later?
translation: house keys(집 열쇠)가 하나도 없네요? 열쇠 없이는 별로 멀리 못 갈 거예요. 나중에 다시 오시는 게 어때요?

english: You don't have any valuables worth my time. Come back when you do!
translation: 제가 신경 쓸 만한 귀중품이 하나도 없네요. 생기면 다시 와요!

english: Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] is returning to [his/her] house. You'll have to wait a moment until we get word of the next house.
translation: [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]이(가) [his/her] 집으로 돌아오는 것 같네요. 다음 집 소식이 들어올 때까지 잠깐 기다려야겠어요.

english: I hear that [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] might be leaving [his/her] house soon.
Looks like [Caius/Lavinia/Victor] isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]이(가) 지금 집에 없는 것 같아요. 얼른 가요!

english: Already forgotten? Head over to [Caius/Lavinia/Victor]'s house.
His house is north of here.
Her house is east of here.
I'll find my own way.
I'll pass for now.
Suit yourself.
I'd better get going.
I could do with some information on houses.
Yes.
Yes please.
I'll find my own way.
Yes, don't ask me again.
No.
Ahoy there, sailor! Can't stop to talk right now, I'm afraid. You'll need to come back later.
translation: 어이, 선원! 미안하지만 지금은 얘기할 틈이 없어. 나중에 다시 와.

english: You need to complete the Pandemonium quest to fully access the Sailing skill.
translation: Sailing(항해) 스킬을 제대로 이용하려면 Pandemonium(판데모니엄) 퀘스트를 완료해야 합니다.

english: Ahoy there sailor and welcome to Storm Tempor!
translation: 어이 선원, Storm Tempor(템포르 폭풍)에 온 걸 환영해!

english: Welcome? This place doesn't look very welcoming to me.
translation: 환영이요? 제가 보기엔 별로 반가운 곳 같지 않은데요.

english: What do you mean? We've got the fresh sea breeze, the spray of the ocean water, a supply of the finest rum this side of the Unquiet ocean and one of the fiercest storms in Gielinor to contend with.
translation: 무슨 소리야? 상쾌한 바닷바람에, 튀어 오르는 바닷물 물보라에, Unquiet ocean(잠들지 않는 바다) 이쪽에서 제일 좋은 럼주가 있고, Gielinor(길리노르)에서 손꼽히게 사나운 폭풍과 맞붙을 수도 있다고.

english: What's not to love?
Yeah, it's contending with that storm that worries me.
translation: 네, 그 폭풍이랑 맞붙어야 한다는 게 걱정이에요.

english: Ye'd be right to fear the storm, it's bested many a sailor around these parts. That's what makes it so exciting though!
translation: 폭풍을 겁내는 게 맞긴 하지. 이 근방에서 숱한 선원들을 꺾었으니까. 그래도 그래서 짜릿한 거라고!

english: Us Barracudas live for the rush and we trust that our skills will save us a trip to the locker.
translation: 우리 Barracuda(바라쿠다)들은 그 짜릿함으로 사는 놈들이야. 우리 실력이면 바다 밑 저승 구경은 안 하게 될 거라 믿고 말이지.

english: I'm always up for a challenge, but what's the point? Why not take the safer route around the storm?
translation: 도전이라면 언제든 좋지만, 그게 무슨 의미가 있어요? 그냥 폭풍을 돌아가는 안전한 길로 가면 되잖아요?

english: Well you see, there's value in sailors with skills like us. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time and as them merchants say, 'time is money'.
translation: 그게 말이야, 우리 같은 실력 있는 선원은 쓸모가 있거든. 보통 사람들은 너처럼 생각하고 폭풍을 피해 가겠지만, 그러면 시간이 걸리잖아. 상인들 말마따나 '시간은 돈'이고.

english: That's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south-end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets to the Pandemonium!
translation: 그래서 우리가 나서는 거지! 상인들이 폭풍 남쪽 끝까지 배를 몰고 와서 저 아래 있는 우리 배 중 하나에 화물을 넘기면, 우리가 그걸 Pandemonium(판데모니엄)까지 확실히 날라 주는 거야!

english: Makes sense to me, what's in it for you guys?
translation: 말이 되네요. 그럼 그쪽 분들한텐 뭐가 남아요?

english: Why, the thrill of the sport! Sailing isn't just about going places, it's about mastery of the boat, the pull of the sails, the feeling of the tiller in your hand and the taste of rum in your mouth! *hic
translation: 그야 스포츠의 짜릿함이지! 항해는 그냥 어디로 가는 게 아니야. 배를 다루는 솜씨, 돛이 당기는 힘, 손에 쥔 키 손잡이의 감촉, 그리고 입안에 감도는 럼주 맛이라고! *딸꾹

english: Sailing as a sport? How does that work? What are the rules?
translation: 스포츠로서의 항해요? 그게 어떻게 돌아가요? 규칙이 뭔데요?

english: Sailing as a sport is what us Barracudas do, we have trials setup all across the sea where you can test your mettle against the clock.
translation: 스포츠 항해가 바로 우리 Barracuda(바라쿠다)가 하는 일이야. 바다 곳곳에 시련 코스를 마련해 놨는데, 거기서 시간과 싸우며 실력을 시험할 수 있지.

english: I'm in charge of this here trial, the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 여기 이 시련, Tempor Tantrum(템포 탠트럼)은 내가 맡고 있어.

english: The objective is simple: Sail south, collect a rum shipment from our boat south of Tempoross and deliver it back to this boat here.
translation: 목표는 간단해. 남쪽으로 항해해서 Tempoross(템포로스) 남쪽에 있는 우리 배에서 럼주 화물을 받아 오고, 그걸 여기 이 배로 다시 가져오면 돼.

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies aswell as they also determine your rank.
translation: 가는 동안 잃어버린 보급품도 잘 찾아봐. 그것도 등급을 정하는 데 들어가거든.

english: If you can deliver all the rum shipments and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, ye'll be awarded a barracuda rank!
translation: 주어진 시간 안에 럼주 화물을 전부 배달하고 잃어버린 보급품도 다 모으면 바라쿠다 등급을 받게 될 거야!

english: Each trial has three ranks, Swordfish, Shark or Marlin and each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 시련마다 Swordfish(황새치), Shark(상어), Marlin(청새치) 세 등급이 있고, 등급이 올라갈수록 더 어려워져.

english: For this trial you'll be asked to fetch additional rum shipments and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 이 시련에서는 등급이 올라갈수록 럼주 화물을 더 가져와야 하고 잃어버린 보급품도 더 많이 모아야 해.

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd rather warm up your hands beforehand.
translation: 앞 등급을 깨기 전에는 다음 등급에 도전할 수 없어. 미리 손을 좀 풀고 싶으면 무등급으로 해 봐도 되고.

english: That said, with your Sailing experience I'd suggest sailing elsewhere for now and coming back when you've learned a thing or two.
translation: 그렇긴 한데, 네 Sailing(항해) 경험으로는 일단 다른 데서 항해하다가 좀 배우고 나서 다시 오는 게 좋겠어.

english: Thanks for the advice, I'll bear that in mind.
Do you have any tips or tricks for me?
Sure do sailor!
First up! You're going to need a boat with at least an oak mast built in order to withstand the storm. Boats as good as a goner without that.
translation: 첫째! 폭풍을 견디려면 최소한 oak mast(참나무 돛대)를 단 배가 필요해. 그게 없으면 배는 끝장난 거나 다름없지.

english: Second! Your boat will also need to have at least an oak hull to withstand the rapids, but those that do will experience a burst of speed from travelling through them.
translation: 둘째! 급류를 견디려면 배에 최소한 oak hull(참나무 선체)도 있어야 해. 대신 그런 배는 급류를 지나가면서 속도가 확 붙지.

english: The more rapids you go through without letting your speed drop off the faster you'll go!
translation: 속도가 떨어지지 않게 급류를 많이 지나갈수록 더 빨라질 거야!

english: Third! Avoid all lightning clouds and try to move as fast as you can, even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
translation: 셋째! 번개 구름은 전부 피하고 최대한 빨리 움직여. 튼튼한 돛대가 있어도 속도가 떨어지거든.

english: Fourth! Keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aint no shipwreck salvaging, go fast or go home.
translation: 넷째! 돛을 잘 조정해서 속도를 더 끌어올려. 이건 난파선 인양이 아니야. 빨리 가든지 집에 가든지 둘 중 하나라고.

english: Finally watch out for those rocks, hitting them will kill all of your boats momentum immediately.
translation: 마지막으로 바위를 조심해. 부딪히면 배의 탄력이 그 자리에서 싹 죽어 버리거든.

english: Who are you?
Who are the Barracudas?
I'd like to attempt the Tempor Tantrum.
More options...
Would you like to try some fine Miscellanian ale, your Royal Highness?
translation: 전하, 훌륭한 Miscellanian ale(미셀라니아 에일) 한잔 맛보시겠어요?

english: Well, I say Miscellanian, but it's actually brewed on the mainland.
translation: 음, 미셀라니아 에일이라고는 했지만 사실 본토에서 빚은 거예요.

english: Would you like to try some anyway?
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
What's it like living down here?
Business is booming!
Now, if only I hadn't taken a loss with the beer I sold to those teenagers.
translation: 그 십 대 애들한테 맥주를 팔았다가 손해만 안 봤어도 좋았을 텐데요.

english: Yes, please.
No, thank you.
What's it like living down here?
Pay-dirt!
Ow!
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Here, solve this.
Runolf hands you a puzzlebox!
That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 풀린 것 같지 않습니다.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Oh, leave an old dwarf in peace will you?
translation: 아이고, 늙은 드워프 좀 가만히 내버려 두게, 응?

english: Why, what's wrong?
Ninenty years down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: 광산에서 구십 년을 일했는데 남은 게 고작 이거라네. 내 인생 전부가 헛되이 날아가 버렸어.

english: You've still got a nice house, don't you?
A crummy old house in East, that's all my life amounts to.
translation: East(동부 켈다그림)에 있는 낡아 빠진 집 한 채, 그게 내 인생의 전부라네.

english: I'll leave you alone then.
Hello again, old cheesecake! Wonderful to see you.
translation: 다시 왔구먼, 우리 치즈케이크 친구! 이렇게 보니 정말 반갑네.

english: How are the investigations going?
Thanks to you freeing me, very well! I have much more to do of course, but now I am free, I can continue where I left off.
translation: 자네가 풀어 준 덕분에 아주 잘되고 있다네! 물론 할 일이 훨씬 많지만, 이제 자유의 몸이니 하던 걸 이어서 할 수 있지.

english: That's great news!
Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 전에 주신 것 같은 투구가 또 있으세요?

english: You might be in luck, old bellybutton fluff - I have made replacements. You could have one for 60,000 coins - for the materials, you understand.
translation: 운이 좋을지도 모르겠군, 우리 배꼽 보풀 친구. 대체품을 만들어 뒀거든. 60,000코인에 하나 주겠네. 재료값이니 이해해 주게.

english: I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 그럴 형편은 안 될 것 같아요, 죄송해요.

english: No problem! Come back and see me any time, old garters.
translation: 괜찮네! 언제든 다시 찾아오게, 우리 양말 대님 친구.

english: How are the investigations going?
Have you another helmet like the one you gave me?
translation: 전에 주신 것 같은 투구가 또 있으세요?

english: Okay, that sounds fair.
I don't think I can afford that, sorry.
translation: 그럴 형편은 안 될 것 같아요, 죄송해요.

english: Hiya. Are you carrying anything valuable?
Why are you asking?
Um... It's a quiz. I'm asking everyone I meet if they're carrying anything valuable.
translation: 음... 퀴즈예요. 만나는 사람마다 귀중품을 갖고 있는지 물어보고 있거든요.

english: What would you do if I said I had loads of expensive items with me?
translation: 제가 비싼 물건을 잔뜩 갖고 있다고 하면 어떻게 할 건데요?

english: Ooh, do you? It's been ages since anyone said they'd got anything worth stealing.
translation: 오, 정말요? 훔칠 만한 걸 갖고 있다는 사람은 진짜 오랜만이에요.

english: 'Anything worth stealing'?
Um... Not that I'd dream of stealing anything!
translation: 음... 제가 뭘 훔칠 생각을 한다는 건 아니고요!

english: Well, I'll say I'm not carrying anything valuable at all.
translation: 음, 그럼 저는 귀중품을 하나도 안 갖고 있다고 할게요.

english: Oh, what a shame.
Hello!
Why won't people leave me alone?!
translation: 왜 다들 날 가만히 내버려 두질 않는 거야?!

english: Hello.!
What?!
I'm looking for the guard that was on duty at the castle last night.
translation: 어젯밤에 성에서 근무하던 경비병을 찾고 있어요.

english: Who?!
Buzz off!
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길을 아세요?

english: Why would I want to go up there? I just want to be left in peace!
translation: 내가 거길 왜 올라가? 난 그냥 조용히 살고 싶다고!

english: It used to be just humans trampling past my cave and making a racket. Now there's those blasted trolls too! Not only do they stink and argue with each other loudly but they are always fighting the humans.
translation: 예전엔 인간들만 내 동굴 앞을 쿵쿵 지나다니면서 시끄럽게 굴었지. 이젠 그 망할 트롤들까지 있어! 냄새나고 저희끼리 시끄럽게 싸우는 것도 모자라서 맨날 인간들이랑 싸워 대.

english: I just want to be left in peace!
Ah... I might be able to help you.
translation: 아... 제가 도와드릴 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: How?!
I'm trying to help the...er...humans to reclaim back Death Plateau. If you help me then at least you'd be rid of the trolls.
translation: 제가 그... 어... 인간들이 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)을 되찾는 걸 돕고 있거든요. 저를 도와주시면 적어도 트롤들은 없어질 거예요.

english: Hmph.
Let me see...
I've only been up Death Plateau once to complain about the noise but those pesky trolls started throwing rocks at me!
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)엔 시끄럽다고 따지러 딱 한 번 올라가 봤는데, 그 성가신 트롤들이 나한테 돌을 던지기 시작하더군!

english: Before the trolls came there used to be a nettlesome Sherpa that took humans exploring or something equally stupid. Perhaps he'd know another way.
translation: 트롤들이 오기 전엔 인간들을 데리고 탐험인지 뭔지 똑같이 멍청한 짓을 하던 짜증 나는 Sherpa(셰르파)가 있었지. 그 녀석이라면 다른 길을 알지도 몰라.

english: Where does this Sherpa live?
I don't know but it can't be far as he used to be around all the time!
translation: 몰라. 그래도 맨날 이 근처에 있었으니 멀진 않을 거야!

english: Nothing, sorry!
Hello.
Have you got rid of those pesky trolls yet?
translation: 그 성가신 트롤들은 아직도 못 쫓아냈어?

english: Where did you say this Sherpa was?
I dunno but he must live around here somewhere!
translation: 몰라. 그래도 이 근처 어딘가에 살 거야!

english: I'm working on it!
Grr!
They will be gone soon! The Imperial Guard will use a secret way that starts from the back of the Sherpa's hut to destroy the troll camp!
translation: 곧 없어질 거예요! Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 Sherpa(셰르파)의 오두막 뒤에서 시작되는 비밀 길로 가서 트롤 야영지를 쳐부술 거예요!

english: I shall have peace again at last!
If those pesky humans don't start trampling all over Death Plateau again that is!
translation: 그 성가신 인간들이 다시 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)을 쿵쿵 밟고 다니지만 않는다면 말이지!

english: I'm afraid there's been some trouble...
You told me you'd get rid of the trolls!
I'm sure the Imperial Guard will deal with them in due course.
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 때가 되면 분명 처리할 거예요.

english: Hmph! They'd better!
Here! Now leave me alone!
translation: 자! 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬!

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)으로 올라가는 다른 길을 아세요?

english: Nothing, sorry!
Hi!
Well. This beats doing the shopping!
translation: 와. 장 보러 가는 것보다 이게 훨씬 낫네요!

english: I wouldn't want to be the poor guy that has to clean up after the duels.
translation: 결투 끝나고 뒷정리하는 불쌍한 사람은 되고 싶지 않아요.

english: Me neither.
Hi!
What did the skeleton say before it ate?
translation: 해골이 밥 먹기 전에 뭐라고 했게요?

english: I don't know?
Bone-appetit.
Ooh. This is exciting!
Yup!
How can you make a very lively hankerchief?
translation: 손수건을 아주 신나게 만들려면 어떻게 해야 할까요?

english: Put a little boogey in it.
translation: 흥을 좀 불어넣으면 돼요. 코를 '흥!' 하고요.

english: Why did the skeleton burp?
'Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
My son just won his first duel!
Congratulations!
He ripped his opponent in half!
That's gotta hurt!
He's only 10 as well!
You gotta start 'em young!
Can't you see I'm watching the duels?
translation: 결투 보고 있는 거 안 보여요?

english: I'm sorry!
Knock knock!
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's just me!
Waaaaassssssuuuuupp?!
Hi! I'm here to watch the duels!
Me too!
My favourite fighter is Mubariz!
The guy at the information kiosk?
Yeah! He rocks!
Takes all sorts, I guess.
Hmph.
Did you know they think this place dates back to the second age?!
translation: 이곳이 Second Age(제2시대)까지 거슬러 올라간다고들 생각한다는 거 알아요?!

english: Really?
Yeah. The guy at the information kiosk was telling me.
translation: 네. 안내소에 있는 사람이 알려 줬어요.

english: Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 절대 안 돼요, 짐 싸는 대로 바로 여길 떠날 거예요!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 네, 많이 봐요. 다행히 거의 무슨 부상이든 감당할 수 있어요. Jaraah(자라)는 정말 훌륭한 외과의예요. 방식이 좀 별나긴 해도 확실히 고쳐 놓거든요.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 이런 말 하면 안 되는데, 그 사람 별명이 '도살자'예요.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Do you come here often?
The High Priestess says you're to be the sacrifice instead of me. I was so looking forward to meeting Zulrah.
translation: 대여사제님께서 저 대신 당신이 제물이 될 거라고 하셨습니다. Zulrah(줄라)를 만나기를 정말 고대했는데요.

english: Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
translation: 제가 당신 목숨을 구했다는 걸 모르시겠어요?

english: In death, the nutrients of my lowly body were destined to nourish the mighty Zulrah. I would have become one with my god.
translation: 죽음으로써 이 미천한 몸의 양분이 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)를 살찌울 운명이었습니다. 저는 제 신과 하나가 되었을 것입니다.

english: Still, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 그래도 조금 더 살게 된 것도 좋은 일이지요. 당신이 해 주신 일에 감사드립니다.

english: I'm sorry.
While I am saddened that my destiny has not been fulfilled, it is nice to live a little longer. Thank you for what you have done.
translation: 제 운명이 이루어지지 않아 슬프기는 하지만, 조금 더 살게 된 것도 좋은 일이지요. 당신이 해 주신 일에 감사드립니다.

english: I am the chosen one. Soon I shall meet Zulrah face-to- face, and my sacrifice shall fulfil the sacred contract that protects our tribe.
translation: 저는 선택받은 자입니다. 곧 Zulrah(줄라)를 직접 마주하게 될 것이며, 제 희생은 우리 부족을 지켜 주는 신성한 계약을 이행하게 될 것입니다.

english: Don't you care that you're going to die?
In death, the nutrients of my lowly body shall nourish the mighty Zulrah. I shall become one with my god.
translation: 죽음으로써 이 미천한 몸의 양분이 위대한 Zulrah(줄라)를 살찌울 것입니다. 저는 제 신과 하나가 될 것입니다.

english: Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?
translation: 제가 직접 Zulrah(줄라)와 맞서러 가도 될까요?

english: The High Priestess has chosen me. I don't know how she decides these things, but perhaps you should ask her.
translation: 대여사제님께서는 저를 택하셨습니다. 어떻게 정하시는지는 저도 모르지만, 그분께 여쭤보시는 게 좋겠습니다.

english: I'm off.
Here, solve this.
Sacrifice hands you a [light puzzle box/puzzlebox]!
That doesn't look solved to me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 풀린 것 같지 않습니다.

english: Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given [a casket/a new clue]!
Don't you understand that I've saved your life?
translation: 제가 당신 목숨을 구했다는 걸 모르시겠어요?

english: I'm sorry.
Don't you care that you're going to die?
Can I go and confront Zulrah myself?
translation: 제가 직접 Zulrah(줄라)와 맞서러 가도 될까요?

english: I'm off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안녀엉, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 정말 멋진 날이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 광경이에요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
What do you do here?
I's been making da machetes for Gabooty's shop Bwana!
translation: Gabooty(가부티)네 가게에 낼 마체테를 만들고 있어요, Bwana(브와나)!

english: If you want me to make you a machete we can do a deal if you like.
translation: 마체테를 만들어 드리길 원하시면 거래를 해 볼 수도 있어요.

english: Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
Ok Bwana, here's the deal. There are three gem bladed machete types, in order of quality and hacking proficiency, they're ordered from low to high as follows.
translation: 좋아요, Bwana(브와나). 이렇게 하죠. 보석 날 마체테는 세 종류가 있는데, 품질과 베는 성능에 따라 낮은 것부터 높은 것 순으로 이래요.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the opal machete, I need 3 opals, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 300 trading sticks please.
translation: 좋아요, Bwana(브와나). opal machete(오팔 마체테)를 주문하시려면 세공 여부와 상관없이 opal(오팔) 3개, gout plant tuber(통풍 식물 덩이줄기) 1개, trading sticks(교역 막대) 300개가 필요해요.

english: I don't have enough trading sticks, sorry.
Ok Bwana, come back when you have them.
translation: 알겠어요, Bwana(브와나). 다 모으면 다시 오세요.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Jade machete, I need 3 jades, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 600 trading sticks please.
translation: 좋아요, Bwana(브와나). Jade machete(비취 마체테)를 주문하시려면 세공 여부와 상관없이 jade(비취) 3개, gout plant tuber(통풍 식물 덩이줄기) 1개, trading sticks(교역 막대) 600개가 필요해요.

english: Ok Bwana, if you want to order the Red Topaz machete, I need 3 Red Topaz, either cut or uncut, 1 gout plant tuber and 1200 trading sticks please.
translation: 좋아요, Bwana(브와나). Red Topaz machete(붉은 토파즈 마체테)를 주문하시려면 세공 여부와 상관없이 Red Topaz(붉은 토파즈) 3개, gout plant tuber(통풍 식물 덩이줄기) 1개, trading sticks(교역 막대) 1200개가 필요해요.

english: So Bwana, do you like the look of the machetes?
Why do you need gems?
They're tougher than just metal on its own, plus it's the only such resource naturally available in this region.
translation: 그냥 금속만 쓰는 것보다 더 단단하거든요. 게다가 이 지역에서 자연적으로 구할 수 있는 그런 자원은 그것뿐이에요.

english: Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: gout plant tuber(통풍 식물 덩이줄기)는 왜 필요해요?

english: It's one of the harder to find resources which I mix with other ingredients in order to bind the ground down gem dust to the surface of the metal bladed machete.
translation: 구하기 꽤 어려운 자원 중 하나인데, 다른 재료와 섞어서 곱게 간 보석 가루를 금속 날 마체테 표면에 붙이는 데 써요.

english: You can sometimes, if you're lucky, find the plant if you hack away at the jungle around here. You'll need to find a way to dig up the tubers though, they're the important part of the plant.
translation: 운이 좋으면 이 근처 정글을 베다가 그 식물을 찾을 수도 있어요. 다만 덩이줄기를 캐낼 방법은 찾으셔야 해요. 그게 식물에서 중요한 부분이거든요.

english: Why is it so expensive?

Expensive bwana, it's quite reasonably priced if you ask me. I can make it cheaper than Gabooty charges for it, that's for sure. And after all, I have to earn a living around here as well you know, I have children to feed!
translation: 비싸다니요, bwana(브와나). 제가 보기엔 꽤 적당한 가격이에요. Gabooty(가부티)가 받는 값보다 싸게 만들어 드릴 수 있는 건 확실해요. 그리고 저도 여기서 먹고살아야 하잖아요. 먹여 살릴 애들도 있다고요!

english: Ok, thanks.
No thanks, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에 뭐 재밌는 할 거리 있어요?

english: Not that I'm aware of, just sit back and enjoy the sunshine bwana!
translation: 제가 아는 건 없어요. 그냥 편히 앉아서 햇볕이나 즐기세요, bwana(브와나)!

english: Bwana, if anyone else asks me that question today, I'll explode! Go and ask someone else!
translation: Bwana(브와나), 오늘 또 누가 그걸 물어보면 저 폭발해 버릴 거예요! 다른 사람한테 가서 물어봐요!

english: It's just village life as normal around here Bwana, always something interesting to find to occupy your time if you look hard enough.
translation: 여기는 그냥 평소 같은 마을 생활이에요, Bwana(브와나). 잘 찾아보면 시간 보낼 재밌는 거리는 늘 있어요.

english: Sorry Bwana, I'm already busy, why not go and talk to Murcaily! He's around the village somewhere.
translation: 미안해요, Bwana(브와나). 제가 지금 바빠서요. Murcaily(머케일리)한테 가서 얘기해 보는 게 어때요! 마을 어딘가에 있을 거예요.

english: Well, I think that there's some work to be done...perhaps Murcaily can help you. He usually tends to the hardwood grove to the east of Trufitus's hut.
translation: 음, 할 일이 좀 있을 것 같은데요... Murcaily(머케일리)가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라요. 그 사람은 보통 Trufitus(트루피투스)의 오두막 동쪽에 있는 경목 숲을 돌봐요.

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
I've already given you some trading sticks and I don't have any more on me at the moment. Why not go and talk to some of the other villagers and get some contributions?
translation: 교역 막대는 이미 좀 드렸고 지금은 더 가진 게 없어요. 다른 마을 사람들한테 가서 얘기해 보고 좀 보태 달라고 해 보는 게 어때요?

english: What do you do here?
Yes, I'd like to get a machete.
Opal machete.
Order the Opal machete.
Go back to machete descriptions
Jade machete.
Order the Jade machete.
Red Topaz machete.
Order the Red Topaz machete.
translation: Red Topaz machete(붉은 토파즈 마체테) 주문하기.

english: Talk to Safta-doc
Why do you need gems?
Why do you need a gout plant tuber?
translation: gout plant tuber(통풍 식물 덩이줄기)는 왜 필요해요?

english: Why is it so expensive?
Let me see the machetes again.
Ok, thanks.
No thanks, but I'd like to ask another question.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그래도 다른 걸 하나 물어보고 싶어요.

english: No thanks, I have to go.
Is there anything interesting to do here?
translation: 여기서 뭐 재밌는 할 거리 있어요?

english: I've been doing some work around the village.
Hello.
Hi, can I help you with something?
You're not from around here are you?
Why do you say that?
Well your accent for one sounds a little funny, and you seem to have a little more colour than most dwarves.
translation: 음, 우선 말투가 좀 특이하고, 다른 드워프들보다 피부색이 좀 더 짙으신 것 같아서요.

english: Living under a mountain isn't the best way to get a tan. No I'm not from around here. I was born and worked most my life in the desert.
translation: 산 밑에 살면 피부 태우기가 쉽지 않거든요. 네, 전 여기 출신이 아니에요. 사막에서 태어나서 평생 대부분을 거기서 일했죠.

english: Just even thinking of the place makes me thirsty. Now can I help you with anything?
translation: 그곳 생각만 해도 목이 마르네요. 그래서, 뭐 도와드릴 일 있어요?

english: So how do these rat pits work?
translation: 이 쥐 구덩이는 어떻게 돌아가는 거예요?

english: The Keldagrim pits cater for those with the larger variety of cats.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 구덩이는 좀 더 덩치 큰 고양이를 키우는 사람들을 위한 곳이에요.

english: If you have an overgrown cat and a couple of coins you can challenge someone else who also has an overgrown cat and some spare change.
translation: overgrown cat(너무 자란 고양이)랑 코인 몇 닢만 있으면, 마찬가지로 너무 자란 고양이와 여윳돈이 있는 다른 사람에게 도전할 수 있어요.

english: That sounds simple enough so far.
You then agree on a wager. It's rumoured that some ratcatchers can talk to their own cats and give them tactics to aid them.
translation: 그다음엔 판돈을 정해요. 소문으로는 어떤 쥐잡이들은 자기 고양이랑 대화해서 전술을 알려 줄 수 있다더군요.

english: So then how do you win the challenge?
I was just getting to that. Both the challengers' cats are placed inside the arena, and whichever kills 9 rats first wins.
translation: 마침 그 얘길 하려던 참이었어요. 두 도전자의 고양이를 경기장 안에 넣고, 쥐 9마리를 먼저 잡는 쪽이 이겨요.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
It's a cruel world and the pits are no exception.
translation: 세상이 원래 잔인한 거고, 구덩이도 예외는 아니죠.

english: Each to their own, I say.
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: I agree. Cats have been known to be killed in fights.
Oh how terrible. Is there nothing you can do to save your cat?
translation: 아이고, 끔찍해라. 고양이를 구할 방법은 없어요?

english: Of course there is, you can instruct it to be cautious, and it will leave once it feels as if it is in danger.
translation: 물론 있죠. 조심하라고 지시해 두면, 위험하다 싶을 때 알아서 빠져나와요.

english: Oh that sounds quite wise.
That depends on how you value your cat.
Sorry, I don't follow.
Well if your cat dies or it runs away you lose.
So the longer it stays in the fight the better chance you have of winning.
translation: 그러니까 싸움에 오래 버틸수록 이길 가능성이 커지는 거죠.

english: Wow that sounds like fun!
I don't know about that.
One thing I know though is that it's a quick way to make and lose money.
translation: 그래도 확실한 건, 돈을 빨리 벌고 빨리 잃는 방법이라는 거예요.

english: Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 돈에 한도가 있어요?

english: Hmmm... let me think. I don't think that's ever arisen but I think it's 20,000.
translation: 흐음... 어디 보자. 그게 문제가 된 적은 없는 것 같은데, 아마 20,000코인일 거예요.

english: Hmm, that sounds like a silly amount of money to bet on a cat fight.
translation: 흠, 고양이 싸움에 걸기엔 말도 안 되는 액수 같은데요.

english: You'd be surprised what some people would be willing to bet.
translation: 사람들이 얼마나 걸려고 하는지 알면 놀랄걸요.

english: There is a minimum bet of 100 coins too.
Can I challenge you and your cat?
No, not now, we don't really bet with outsiders.
translation: 아뇨, 지금은 안 돼요. 우린 외부인이랑은 내기를 잘 안 하거든요.

english: But I'm not an outsider, am I not inside in the pits now?
translation: 하지만 전 외부인이 아닌걸요. 지금 이렇게 구덩이 안에 들어와 있잖아요?

english: I don't know, maybe once you've done something to win over my trust.
translation: 글쎄요, 제 신뢰를 얻을 만한 일을 해 주면 모를까요.

english: Can it be bought?
What?
Your trust.
No. Regular townsfolk don't like us, which leads us to distrust them and anyone else.
translation: 아뇨. 평범한 마을 사람들은 우릴 싫어하고, 그래서 우리도 그 사람들이나 다른 누구든 믿지 않게 된 거예요.

english: That sounds vile and cruel.
One more thing...
Thanks for your help.
It sounds a little dangerous for my cat.
translation: 제 고양이한텐 좀 위험할 것 같은데요.

english: Wow that sounds like fun.
Is there a limit to how much you can bet?
translation: 걸 수 있는 돈에 한도가 있어요?

english: Can I challenge you and your cat?
Hiya.
Don't talk to me outerlander. I need to fix this longboat. Go talk to the chieftain.
translation: 말 걸지 마시오, 외지인. 나는 이 롱보트를 고쳐야 하오. 족장에게 가 보시오.

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
Nope. I'm just a sailor.
Fair enough.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 혹시 바다 건너에서 온 희귀한 꽃을 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Ah! Even the outerlanders have heard of my mysterious flower! I found it in a country far far away from here!
translation: 아! 외지인들까지 내 신비한 꽃 얘기를 들었구려! 이건 여기서 아주아주 먼 나라에서 찾은 것이오!

english: Can I buy it from you?
I'm afraid not, outerlander. There is a woman in this village whose heart I seek to capture, and I think giving her this strange flower might be my best bet with her.
translation: 안타깝지만 안 되오, 외지인. 이 마을에 내가 마음을 얻고 싶은 여인이 있는데, 이 신기한 꽃을 주는 게 그 여인의 마음을 사로잡을 가장 좋은 방법일 것 같소.

english: Maybe you could let me have the flower and do something else to impress her?
translation: 그 꽃을 저한테 주시고, 그분을 감동시킬 다른 방법을 찾아보는 건 어때요?

english: Hmm... that is not a totally stupid idea outerlander. I know she is a lover of music, and a romantic ballad might be just the thing with which to woo her.
translation: 흠... 아주 멍청한 생각은 아니구려, 외지인. 그 여인이 음악을 좋아한다는 건 알고 있소. 낭만적인 발라드라면 마음을 얻기에 딱 좋을지도 모르겠소.

english: Unfortunately I don't have a musical bone in my entire body, so someone else will have to write it for me.
translation: 안타깝게도 내 몸엔 음악적 재능이 뼈 한 조각만큼도 없으니, 다른 누군가가 대신 써 줘야 할 것이오.

english: So if I can find someone to write you a romantic ballad, you will give me your flower?
translation: 그러니까 낭만적인 발라드를 써 줄 사람을 찾아오면 꽃을 주시겠다는 거죠?

english: That sounds like a fair deal to me, outerlander.
Ask about the Merchant's trial
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: 혹시 사랑의 발라드를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Well, the only musician I know of in these parts would be that terrible bard Olaf... ask him.
translation: 글쎄, 이 근방에서 내가 아는 음악가라곤 그 형편없는 음유시인 Olaf(올라프)뿐이오... 그에게 물어보시오.

english: You'll be glad to know I have had a love song written just for you by Olaf. So can I have that flower of yours now?
translation: 기쁜 소식이에요. Olaf(올라프)한테 부탁해서 당신을 위한 사랑 노래를 받아 왔어요. 이제 그 꽃 주실 수 있죠?

english: Oh. It's by Olaf? Hmm. Well, a deal's a deal. I just hope it's better than the usual rubbish he comes up with, or my chances are worse than ever.
translation: 오. Olaf(올라프)가 쓴 거라고? 흠. 뭐, 약속은 약속이오. 그가 늘 내놓는 쓰레기보단 낫기를 바랄 뿐이오. 안 그러면 내 가망은 더 없어질 테니.

english: so tell me... who is this woman that you are trying to impress anyway?
translation: 그런데... 감동시키려는 그 여인은 대체 누구예요?

english: It's Thora, the longhall barkeep. Please don't tell her though. She's not like the rest of the Fremennik girls, she has a secret desire to see the world.
translation: longhall(롱홀)의 술집 주인 Thora(토라)요. 하지만 제발 본인에겐 말하지 마시오. 그 여인은 다른 Fremennik(프레메닉) 여인들과 달리, 남몰래 세상을 보고 싶어 한다오.

english: Being a sailor, I can really relate to that.
translation: 선원인 나로서는 그 마음을 잘 이해할 수 있소.

english: Hello. Can I get a ride on your ship?
translation: 안녕하세요. 배 좀 태워 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hello again, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. If you're ready to jump aboard, we're all ready to set sail with the tide!
translation: 다시 만났구려, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 배에 오를 준비가 됐다면, 우린 언제든 물때에 맞춰 출항할 수 있소!

english: Let's go!
You board the longship...
The ship arrives at Miscellania.
The ship arrives at Rellekka.
Actually, no.
Okay. Suit yourself.
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Let's go!
Actually, no.
Ahoy there! Ye best talk t' the Captain, she'll get ye up t' speed on the moist beastie ye'll be facin'!
translation: 어이, 거기! Captain(대장)한테 가서 얘기해 봐. 네가 상대할 축축한 괴물에 대해 대장이 다 알려 줄 거다!

english: Arr! Watch fer the Captain's orders - she'll 'ave us underway in two shakes of a marlinspike.
translation: 아르! Captain(대장) 명령 잘 들어 둬 - 대장이 눈 깜짝할 새에 배를 띄울 테니까.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Okay, but it will be better once we're back on board.
translation: 괜찮아요. 그래도 다시 배에 오르면 더 낫겠죠.

english: Not too bad, but there's still a lot that needs doing today.
translation: 나쁘진 않은데, 오늘 할 일이 아직 많아요.

english: Sorry, but I have lots of work to do before we head back out to sea.
translation: 죄송하지만 다시 바다로 나가기 전에 할 일이 산더미예요.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 푹 좀 쉬고 싶긴 한데, 그것만 빼면 괜찮아요.

english: Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안녕하세요, 안녕하신가요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘 날씨가 정말 끝내주죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 별의별 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 볼 만한 멋진 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에선 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Looking to protect yourself?
Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Be careful you don't regret it.
Let's see what you have.
No thanks.
Hello there.
We don't get many visitors here. Are you sure you wouldn't rather be somewhere else?
translation: 여긴 찾아오는 사람이 별로 없지. 정말 다른 데 가는 게 낫지 않겠어?

english: I'm happy enough here.
Fair enough.
You lost?
I don't think so.
If you say so.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Strange place for you to be then. I doubt there's much adventurer to be had here.
translation: 그럼 여긴 이상한 데 와 있는 거군. 여기선 모험할 거리가 별로 없을 텐데.

english: I wouldn't stick around if I were you. Nothing here for a tourist to be interested in.
translation: 내가 너라면 오래 안 있겠어. 여기엔 관광객이 흥미 가질 만한 게 하나도 없거든.

english: Traveller.
Welcome to the Burthorpe Games Rooms!
translation: Burthorpe Games Rooms(버소프 게임실)에 오신 걸 환영해요!

english: How do I play board games?

You can challenge someone to a game anywhere in the games rooms by using the right click option. Choose the type of game and then choose the options you want such as time per move. If you want to play a particular
translation: 게임실 어디서든 우클릭 메뉴로 다른 사람에게 게임을 신청할 수 있어요. 게임 종류를 고른 다음, 한 수당 시간 같은 원하는 옵션을 정하면 돼요. 특정

english: game there are challenge rooms dedicated to that game. In the challenge rooms you can see other players ranks by right clicking them, their skill will be displayed instead of their combat level. Once you have enough
translation: 게임을 하고 싶다면 그 게임 전용 도전실이 있어요. 도전실에서는 다른 플레이어를 우클릭해서 등급을 볼 수 있는데, 전투 레벨 대신 그 게임 실력이 표시돼요. 경험이 충분히

english: experience you will be able to use the challenge rooms on the first floor! If your opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables in the main room where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 쌓이면 2층 도전실도 이용할 수 있어요! 상대가 도전을 받아들이면 본관의 탁자 중 하나로 옮겨져서 고른 게임을 하게 돼요.

english: Once you have finished your game you will go back to the challenge room where you can challenge again!
translation: 게임이 끝나면 다시 도전실로 돌아가니까, 거기서 또 도전하면 돼요!

english: What games can I play?
Currently we offer Draughts, Runelink, Runesquares, and Runeversi.
translation: 지금은 Draughts(체커), Runelink(룬링크), Runesquares(룬스퀘어), Runeversi(룬버시)가 있어요.

english: Draughts?
Draughts uses standard rules, apart from: a draw is declared if no piece has been taken or promoted for forty moves. To play Draughts go to the challenge room in the SW corner.
translation: Draughts(체커)는 표준 규칙을 따르는데, 40수 동안 말을 잡거나 승격시키지 않으면 무승부가 선언된다는 점만 달라요. 체커를 하려면 남서쪽 구석 도전실로 가세요.

english: Runelink?
Yup, you have to get four runes in row. The challenge room for Runelink is in the SE corner.
translation: 네, 룬 네 개를 한 줄로 놓으면 돼요. 룬링크 도전실은 남동쪽 구석에 있어요.

english: Runesquares?
Yes, you take it in turns to add a line with the goal of making squares. Everytime you make a square you take another turn. The challenge room for Runesquares is in the SW corner.
translation: 네, 번갈아 가며 선을 하나씩 그어서 사각형을 만드는 게 목표예요. 사각형을 하나 만들 때마다 한 번 더 둘 수 있어요. 룬스퀘어 도전실은 남서쪽 구석에 있어요.

english: Runeversi?
Yep, the aim is to have more of your runes on the board than your opponent. You can take your opponents pieces by trapping them between your own. The challenge room for Runeversi is in the SE corner.
translation: 네, 판 위에 상대보다 자기 룬을 더 많이 남기는 게 목표예요. 상대 말을 내 말 사이에 가두면 그 말을 가져올 수 있어요. 룬버시 도전실은 남동쪽 구석에 있어요.

english: Can I buy a drink please?
Certainly miss, our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 물론이죠, 아가씨. 저희 대표 메뉴는 Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일)이고, Wizard's Mind Bomb(마법사의 마인드 밤)이랑 Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트)도 있어요.

english: Thanks!
How do I play board games?
What games can I play?
Draughts?
Runelink?
Runesquares?
Runeversi?
Can I buy a drink please?
Thanks!
Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보실래요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 이걸 입으면 같은 망토를 입은 사람을 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고, 다른 사람은 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있어요. 같은 망토를 입은 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 구별하기도 쉬워지고요. 친구나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람과 함께 황야에 나갈 때 아주 유용해요.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
Hey you, you here for a reason or do you just like hanging around?
translation: 어이, 너. 볼일이 있어서 온 거야, 아니면 그냥 어슬렁거리는 게 좋은 거야?

english: I would like to join your crew.
Well you say that now, but I wonder if you can measure up.
translation: 말이야 그렇게 하지만, 네가 쓸 만한지는 모르겠군.

english: Well, for a start off, come and see me when you don't have that thing on your head.
translation: 음, 일단 머리에 쓴 그거부터 벗고 다시 찾아와.

english: Why can't I help out while wearing this?
translation: 이걸 쓰고는 왜 도울 수 없는데요?

english: I need to know you aren't a spy for the other crew, so you'll need to wear a blue bandana.
translation: 네가 저쪽 선원들 첩자가 아니란 걸 확인해야 하거든. 그러니까 파란 반다나를 써야 해.

english: If you still want to join my crew then go deposit it in the deposit box and come back without anything on your head.
translation: 그래도 내 선원이 되고 싶으면 그걸 예치함에 맡기고, 머리에 아무것도 안 쓴 채로 돌아와.

english: Hah, think that I'm going to assign you the easy tasks eh?
translation: 하, 내가 너한테 쉬운 일만 맡길 줄 알았냐?

english: What do you mean?
Well, I can see you have some items in your inventory. If you want to join my crew you will need all of it free so you are able to work as hard as everyone else.
translation: 보아하니 소지품에 이것저것 들어 있군. 내 선원이 되려면 소지품을 전부 비워야 해. 그래야 다른 놈들만큼 열심히 일할 수 있지.

english: There is a bank deposit box next to that greasy oaf Jimmy's stall, go and use it and then come back.
translation: 저 기름기 번지르르한 멍청이 Jimmy(지미)의 노점 옆에 은행 예치함이 있어. 가서 그걸 쓰고 돌아와.

english: You seem keen enough, but I have plenty of people on my crew.
translation: 의욕은 넘쳐 보이는데, 내 선원은 이미 충분해.

english: If that idiot Dan tries to pressgang more pirates I'll be glad to even the numbers out with you though.
translation: 그래도 저 멍청한 Dan(댄)이 해적을 더 강제로 끌어모으면, 그땐 기꺼이 너로 머릿수를 맞춰 주지.

english: Ok, fair enough.
That's quite a nice cat. Is it yours?
Yes, why do you ask?
I'm a bit of a cat person myself. That's why I'll have to ask you to leave it outside.
translation: 나도 고양이를 좀 좋아하거든. 그러니까 고양이는 밖에 두고 와 달라고 해야겠어.

english: There's likely to be quite a lot of stuff going on fire in there, and I don't want to see it get hurt.
translation: 저 안에선 이것저것 불이 붙을 일이 꽤 많을 텐데, 고양이가 다치는 건 보고 싶지 않거든.

english: You cannot take your follower into the game.
translation: 따라다니는 동물은 게임에 데려갈 수 없어.

english: Heh, ok, well we'll get you sorted out. Welcome to the crew.
translation: 헤, 좋아. 그럼 준비시켜 주지. 우리 선원이 된 걸 환영해.

english: Go wait in the waiting room. I'll call you when we are ready to start.
translation: 대기실에 가서 기다려. 시작할 준비가 되면 부르지.

english: Who are you, and what is this place?
Well, well, looks like someone is fresh off the boat and no mistake!
translation: 이런, 이런. 갓 배에서 내린 풋내기가 틀림없군!

english: A little while ago we had some real problem shipping 'rum' in the island. The Braindeath crew said it had something to do with zombies and the like.
translation: 얼마 전에 섬으로 'rum'(럼주)를 들여오는 데 큰 문제가 있었어. Braindeath(브레인데스) 선원들 말로는 좀비 같은 것들과 관련이 있었다나.

english: All the pirates on the island got together and decided to make our own still, but of course things got a little out of hand, and now we have two.
translation: 그래서 섬의 해적들이 다 모여서 우리끼리 증류소를 만들기로 했는데, 물론 일이 좀 꼬이는 바람에 지금은 두 개가 됐지.

english: So with two stills you have plenty of 'rum' right?
Well we would do, if that scurvy, whelk-eating foppish dog wouldn't keep trying to burn our still to the ground!
translation: 그랬겠지, 저 괴혈병 걸린, 소라나 처먹는 멋쟁이 개자식이 자꾸 우리 증류소를 잿더미로 만들려고만 안 하면 말이야!

english: I say!
Neither of us can really corner the 'rum' market at the moment, but we are giving it our best shot.
translation: 지금은 양쪽 다 'rum'(럼주) 시장을 꽉 잡지는 못하고 있지만, 우린 최선을 다하고 있어.

english: The code of the island says that we can't attack each other, but after consulting with our fearsome pirate lawyers, we have discovered that destroying each other's property is fine.
translation: 섬의 규약상 서로 공격하면 안 되는데, 우리의 무시무시한 해적 변호사들과 상의해 본 결과 서로의 재산을 부수는 건 괜찮다는 걸 알아냈지.

english: Hence, that sniveling, hat-wearing cur keeps trying to burn down my still.
translation: 그래서 저 징징대는 모자 쓴 똥개가 자꾸 내 증류소를 태우려는 거야.

english: Of course he claims I started this whole thing, but who would trust him anyway?
translation: 물론 그놈은 내가 먼저 시작했다고 우기지만, 누가 그놈 말을 믿겠어?

english: Can I help out?
Yes, probably. I have a bunch of jobs that need doing, if you feel up to it.
translation: 그래, 아마도. 할 만하다 싶으면 맡길 일이 잔뜩 있어.

english: What would you like to know about?
How do I help you brew 'Rum'?
Well the stills we have set up are based on the ones on Braindeath island... well roughly at any rate.
translation: 음, 여기 차려 놓은 증류소는 Braindeath island(브레인데스 섬)에 있는 걸 본뜬 거야... 뭐, 대충 그렇다는 거지.

english: All you have to do is help put the ingredients into the hoppers and keep the boilers burning.
translation: 넌 호퍼에 재료 넣는 걸 돕고 보일러 불만 계속 꺼지지 않게 하면 돼.

english: If you add enough ingredients to the hoppers then you have the ability to pick up a single bottle of rum when it brews.
translation: 호퍼에 재료를 충분히 넣으면, 럼주가 다 빚어졌을 때 한 병을 가져갈 수 있어.

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle. If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 그러니까 물 양동이 5개를 호퍼에 넣으면 한 병을 가져갈 수 있어. 색물 그릇 3개를 넣어도 한 병, 그 밖의 재료는 하나만 넣어도 한 병이야.

english: This is cumulative, meaning that if you add (for example) 10 buckets of water, 3 sweetgrubs and 6 bowls of coloured water, then you have a chance to collect 7 bottles of rum for the team.
translation: 이건 누적돼. 예를 들어 물 양동이 10개, sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레) 3개, 색물 그릇 6개를 넣으면 팀을 위해 럼주 7병을 모을 기회가 생기는 거지.

english: The boilers are easy as pie to sort out. You just put some logs in, light them with a tinderbox, and then keep putting logs in until they are good and hot.
translation: 보일러는 식은 죽 먹기야. logs(통나무)를 넣고 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)으로 불을 붙인 다음, 충분히 뜨거워질 때까지 통나무를 계속 넣으면 돼.

english: Three logs should do it, but it's best to keep heaping them in just in case.
translation: 통나무 세 개면 될 거야. 그래도 혹시 모르니 계속 쌓아 넣는 게 좋아.

english: The ingredients are; Bitternuts, Scrapey Tree Bark, Sweetgrubs, Buckets of Water and some Coloured Water.
translation: 재료는 이래. Bitternuts(쓴 견과), Scrapey Tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질, Sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레), 물 양동이, 그리고 색물 약간.

english: Where can I get Bitternuts?
There are plenty of Bitternut trees inside this walled off area. The problem is that the trees are too tricky for a human to climb.
translation: 이 담장 안쪽에 Bitternut(쓴 견과) 나무가 많이 있어. 문제는 사람이 오르기엔 나무가 너무 까다롭다는 거지.

english: You will need to catch a monkey and send it up the tree to get the nut for you.
translation: 원숭이를 잡아서 나무 위로 올려 보내 열매를 따 오게 해야 해.

english: Send it up the tree? How does that work?
translation: 나무 위로 올려 보낸다고요? 그게 어떻게 되는데요?

english: Well, if you were a monkey, and some random person grabbed you, dumped some dye in your fur and shoved you up a tree, you would hurl the closest heavy object at them too.
translation: 음, 네가 원숭이인데 웬 낯선 놈이 널 붙잡아 털에 염료를 들이붓고 나무 위로 떠밀면, 너도 제일 가까운 무거운 걸 그놈한테 집어 던지겠지.

english: Wait a second, dye?
Yes, you'll need to get a bowl of coloured water and pour it on the monkey. Otherwise you won't be able to tell which team the monkey belongs too.
translation: 그래, 색물 한 그릇을 구해서 원숭이한테 부어야 해. 안 그러면 그 원숭이가 어느 팀 건지 알 수가 없거든.

english: That makes sense...I think...
Anything else?
Where can I get Scrapey tree bark...and why do I get the feeling I won't like the answer?
translation: Scrapey tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질은 어디서 구해요... 그리고 왜 대답이 마음에 안 들 것 같은 기분이 들죠?

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees. They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 이 담장 안쪽에 Scrapey tree(스크레이피 나무)가 몇 그루 있어. 크고 병든 것처럼 생긴 나무라 못 보고 지나칠 수가 없지.

english: Basically, you cut them down and then carve the bark off with a knife.
translation: 간단히 말해, 나무를 베고 knife(칼)로 껍질을 벗겨 내면 돼.

english: It's pretty simple, except the sap tends so make people feel kind off ill if they get any on themselves.
translation: 꽤 간단해. 다만 수액이 몸에 묻으면 좀 속이 안 좋아지는 경향이 있지.

english: How ill?
Don't worry, we aren't talking deadly ill or anything.
translation: 걱정 마. 죽을 만큼 아프다거나 그런 건 아니니까.

english: It's more like you'll feel quite dizzy and weak for a bit.
translation: 그냥 한동안 꽤 어지럽고 힘이 빠지는 정도야.

english: Joy...
Sweetgrubs? What are they?
Well, lacking any sluglings in the area, we add these little grubs called Sweetgrubs. If you ignore the gag- inducing aftertaste, they are quite sweet.
translation: 음, 이 근방엔 sluglings(새끼 민달팽이)가 없어서 대신 Sweetgrubs(단맛 애벌레)라는 작은 애벌레를 넣어. 구역질 나는 뒷맛만 무시하면 꽤 달달하다고.

english: How... how can you drink this stuff?
translation: 어... 어떻게 이런 걸 마실 수가 있어요?

english: Quite easily!
Pirates are renowned as being tough for a reason.
translation: 해적이 괜히 터프하기로 유명한 게 아니라고.

english: So where do I get these grubs from anyway?
Well, there are a few sweetgrub mounds inside there. We have a handful of rat meat that you can use on the mounds to draw the grubs to the surface.
translation: 음, 저 안에 sweetgrub(단맛 애벌레) 둔덕이 몇 개 있어. 쥐고기가 한 줌 있는데, 그걸 둔덕에 쓰면 애벌레가 땅 위로 기어 나와.

english: Mind your fingers though, they are voracious little things.
translation: 그래도 손가락 조심해. 아주 게걸스러운 녀석들이거든.

english: And here was me thinking that nothing could be more disgusting than Braindeath 'Rum'.
translation: Braindeath 'Rum'(브레인데스 '럼주')보다 역겨운 건 없을 줄 알았는데 말이죠.

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong [lad/lass], 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 아르, 그게 바로 네 착각이란다, [lad/lass]. 새롭게 개선된 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic(브레인데스 '럼주' 클래식)은 이제 선두 경쟁 제품보다 200% 더 역겹거든!

english: Legal disclaimer; the dangerous amount of disgustin' in new Braindeath 'Rum' Classic be too much for pregnant women, donkeys and anyone with more than seven letters in their last name.
translation: 법적 고지: 새로운 Braindeath 'Rum' Classic(브레인데스 '럼주' 클래식)의 위험한 수준의 역겨움은 임산부, 당나귀, 그리고 성이 일곱 글자를 넘는 사람에게는 너무 과할 수 있음.

english: What was that?
What was what?
Is there anything else?
How do I get...
Wait, no, that question makes me sound like I haven't a clue what I'm doing.
translation: 아니, 잠깐만요. 이 질문은 제가 뭘 하는지 전혀 모르는 사람처럼 들리겠네요.

english: Where can I get buckets in there?
There are a few lying about. Help yourself.
translation: 여기저기 몇 개 굴러다녀. 마음대로 써.

english: There is a pump in the still, so long as it's working you should have almost unlimited water.
translation: 증류소 안에 펌프가 있어. 그게 돌아가기만 하면 물은 거의 무한정 쓸 수 있을 거야.

english: Hold on, do I have to add anything disgusting and/or potential lethal to the water before I pour it in?
translation: 잠깐만요, 물을 붓기 전에 역겹거나 치명적일 수도 있는 뭔가를 섞어야 하는 건 아니죠?

english: Perish the thought!
Ok, just checking.
What sort of coloured water are we talking about here?
translation: 색물이라는 게 어떤 걸 말하는 거예요?

english: Well, the other still has an area of waste ground with a flower growing on it. If you go and grab one of the flowers and jam it in the kettle, the water will boil out the colour.
translation: 음, 저쪽 증류소에 꽃이 자라는 황무지가 있어. 거기서 꽃을 한 송이 뽑아다 주전자에 쑤셔 넣으면 끓는 물에 색이 우러나와.

english: We use the colour to keep our rum easily identifiable.
translation: 그 색으로 우리 럼주를 쉽게 알아보게 하는 거지.

english: So I just empty the kettle into the hopper, right?
translation: 그럼 주전자를 그냥 호퍼에 비우면 되는 거죠?

english: No, no, you'll need to take an empty bowl and fill it from the kettle.
translation: 아니, 아니. 빈 그릇을 가져가서 주전자 물을 담아야 해.

english: That way you can use the stuff on a monkey if you need to.
translation: 그래야 필요할 때 그걸 원숭이한테 쓸 수 있잖아.

english: Use it on a monkey...of course.
Can I ask about something else?
Ok, what else?
How do I repair the still?
Well, assuming those scurvy dogs have managed to set any of it on fire, then you'll need to tip a bucket of water on it before you can repair it.
translation: 음, 그 비열한 개자식들이 어딘가에 불을 붙이는 데 성공했다면, 고치기 전에 먼저 물 양동이를 부어야 해.

english: Then, it all comes down to what part of it was damaged.
How can I repair hoppers?
Well, assuming that they are not on fire, all you need to do is use the heavy lumber patches. They are big enough to cover most holes.
translation: 음, 불이 붙은 게 아니라면 무거운 목재 덧판을 쓰기만 하면 돼. 웬만한 구멍은 다 덮을 만큼 크거든.

english: Will I need a hammer?
No, just shove it into place and whack it until it lines up.
translation: 아니, 그냥 제자리에 밀어 넣고 딱 맞을 때까지 두들기면 돼.

english: How do I repair pipes and the pump?
Well, if you use a pipe section on the damaged part you should be able to replace it easily.
translation: 음, 망가진 부분에 pipe section(파이프 토막)을 쓰면 쉽게 갈아 끼울 수 있을 거야.

english: No, likely you'll just need to whack the old one out and slot the new one in with your hands.
translation: 아니, 아마 낡은 걸 두들겨서 빼내고 새 걸 손으로 끼워 넣기만 하면 될 거야.

english: How do I repair bridges?
Well, we have these handy bridge sections you can use to repair the bridges.
translation: 음, 다리 수리에 쓸 수 있는 편리한 다리 부품이 있어.

english: The main problem is, while a still will keep working if a bit of it is only damaged, the bridges are completely out of commission if they are even slightly damaged.
translation: 진짜 문제는 말이야, 증류소는 조금 망가져도 계속 돌아가는데, 다리는 살짝만 망가져도 완전히 못 쓰게 된다는 거야.

english: Is that going to be a problem? I mean, I can jump across I think.
translation: 그게 문제가 될까요? 그냥 뛰어서 건널 수 있을 것 같은데요.

english: Don't try that! Our lawyers tell us we aren't covered for injuries sustained while jumping over burned bridges.
translation: 그러지 마! 변호사들 말로는 불탄 다리를 뛰어넘다 다친 건 보상이 안 된대.

english: Seriously, just keep off the bridges until they are fixed.
translation: 진심이야, 다리가 고쳐질 때까지 다리엔 얼씬도 하지 마.

english: Where do I get all this stuff anyway?
translation: 그런데 이 물건들은 다 어디서 구해요?

english: We have a load of items already on a table inside the still. You can also make new ones if you grab some logs.
translation: 증류소 안 탁자에 이미 물건을 잔뜩 올려놨어. 통나무를 좀 구해 오면 새로 만들 수도 있고.

english: How does that work?
We have a work table set up in the still. If you use the logs in it you can craft up a handy replacement for part of the still.
translation: 증류소 안에 작업 탁자를 차려 놨어. 거기에 통나무를 쓰면 증류소 부품을 대신할 쓸 만한 걸 만들 수 있지.

english: Don't worry about them fitting, the things are held together by nails, replacement parts and soot by now.
translation: 맞을지는 걱정 마. 그 물건들은 이제 못이랑 교체 부품이랑 그을음으로 겨우 붙어 있는 거니까.

english: Well...how sanitary...
Ok, I think I've heard enough.
translation: 좋아요, 이 정도면 충분히 들은 것 같아요.

english: Fine. Glad I could help.
So...how would I go about sabotaging the enemy still?
translation: 그럼... 적의 증류소는 어떻게 망가뜨리면 돼요?

english: Ok, here's what you need to do.
The wood around here is really dry and flammable, so take one of the torches, light it up, and then go and attack the enemy still with it.
translation: 이 근처 나무는 바싹 말라서 불이 잘 붙어. 그러니 횃불 하나를 집어서 불을 붙인 다음, 그걸로 적의 증류소를 공격해.

english: That's it?
Most of their still is soaked in 'alcohol' and made from tinder dry wood.
translation: 저쪽 증류소는 대부분 '알코올'에 흠뻑 젖어 있고 바싹 마른 나무로 만들어졌거든.

english: Essentially, if it isn't ours, try using a torch on it and see what happens.
translation: 한마디로, 우리 게 아니면 횃불을 갖다 대 보고 어떻게 되나 봐.

english: Ok, I get you.
So what will you give me for helping out?
Hahahaha! What a mercenary attitude! You'll do fine here.
translation: 하하하하! 돈부터 밝히는 녀석이로군! 넌 여기서 잘 해낼 거야.

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: 음, 너희 팀이 럼주를 한 병 만들 때마다 piece of eight(8레알 은화)를 하나씩 주지.

english: If you manage to set something on fire then I'll toss in another, same for repairing the still.
translation: 뭔가에 불을 지르는 데 성공하면 하나 더 얹어 주고, 증류소를 고쳐도 마찬가지야.

english: What can I use these pieces of eight for?
translation: 이 pieces of eight(8레알 은화)는 어디에 쓸 수 있어요?

english: See Honest Jimmy there? He'll trade you some pretty nice stuff for them.
translation: 저기 Honest Jimmy(정직한 지미) 보이지? 그걸 주면 꽤 괜찮은 물건이랑 바꿔 줄 거야.

english: Great!
Hah!
This minigame is unavailable on this world.
translation: 이 미니게임은 이 월드에서 이용할 수 없어.

english: Sorry, I don't take anyone that can't cook.
translation: 미안하지만 요리 못하는 놈은 안 받아.

english: Why not?
Aside from anything else, if you have less than 40 Cooking, then you don't have much of an idea of health and safety when it comes to food.
translation: 다른 건 둘째 치고, Cooking(요리) 레벨이 40도 안 되면 음식 위생이랑 안전에 대해 뭘 잘 모른다는 거거든.

english: Oh yeah, Saradomin forbid that the 'rum' made from whatever is lying around gets a bit of hair in it.
translation: 아, 그렇죠. 아무거나 굴러다니는 걸로 만든 'rum'(럼주)에 털 한 가닥이라도 들어가면 큰일이죠. Saradomin(사라도민)께서 막아 주시길.

english: Anyone lookin' fer work?
Arr! Looking fer good pirates!
Come join me crew!
Don't join them, join us!
Free(ish) rum fer all!
Join the winnin' team now!
Need pirates fer brewin'!
Recruiting!
Roll up, roll up!
We have dental!
I would like to join your crew.
Who are you, and what is this place?
Brewing 'Rum'
Where can I get Bitternuts?
Where can I get Scrapey Tree Bark?
translation: Scrapey Tree(스크레이피 나무) 껍질은 어디서 구해요?

english: Where can I get Sweetgrubs?
Where can I get buckets of water?
Where can I get coloured water?
Can I ask about something else?
Repairing the Still
How do I repair Hoppers?
How do I repair Pipes and the pump?
How do I repair Bridges?
How do I get repair items
Ok, I think I've heard enough
translation: 좋아요, 이 정도면 충분히 들은 것 같아요

english: Sabotaging the Still
What will you pay me?
San Tojalon: Prepare yourself...
San Tojalon will test your mettle.
translation: San Tojalon(산 토잘론)이 그대의 기개를 시험하리라.

english: You have proved yourself of the honour.
San Tojalon: You have proved yourself of the honour.
translation: San Tojalon(산 토잘론): 그대는 명예로운 자임을 증명했노라.

english: A chunk of crystal forms mid-air and falls to the floor. You place the crystal chunk into your inventory.
translation: chunk of crystal(크리스탈 덩이) 하나가 허공에서 생겨나 바닥에 떨어진다. 크리스탈 덩이를 소지품에 넣는다.

english: You have fought the good fight this day.
Prepare yourself...
Good day to you bwana.
Can you ferry me to that island?
translation: 저 섬까지 배로 데려다줄 수 있나요?

english: Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 10,000 coins
translation: 물론이죠. 하지만 제 서비스에는 대가가 따릅니다... 10,000코인이에요.

english: I don't have that sort of money!
Then you do not belong on my island.
translation: 그럼 당신은 제 섬에 올 자격이 없네요.

english: Fine!
Bye bye bwana.
Ok, here's the ridiculous sum of money...
Never mind.
Why so much? You'd get more business if you charged less.
translation: 왜 그렇게 비싸요? 값을 내리면 손님이 더 많을 텐데요.

english: The price is to keep the island quiet, bwana. It's a great place to train, but competing with others can be a hassle and so, for a price, you train in peace!
translation: 그 값은 섬을 조용하게 지키기 위한 거예요, 브와나. 훈련하기 정말 좋은 곳이지만, 다른 사람들과 자리싸움하는 건 골치 아프잖아요. 그러니 돈만 내면 방해받지 않고 훈련할 수 있죠!

english: Most certainly, but my services come at a price... of 5,000 coins
translation: 물론이죠. 하지만 제 서비스에는 대가가 따릅니다... 5,000코인이에요.

english: You pay Sandicrahb 5,000 coins and depart for Crabclaw Isle.
translation: Sandicrahb(샌디크랩)에게 5,000코인을 내고 Crabclaw Isle(게발 섬)으로 출발한다.

english: That's too much for me.
Of course! I won't even charge you for the privilege.
Sure.
Sandicrahb transports you to Crabclaw Isle for free thanks to your completion of the Kourend & Kebos Medium diary.
translation: Kourend & Kebos Medium diary(쿠렌드 & 케보스 중급 일지)를 완료한 덕분에 Sandicrahb(샌디크랩)이 무료로 Crabclaw Isle(게발 섬)까지 데려다준다.

english: Who are you?
Why bwana, I'm Sandicrahb! I travel far over the ocean from the tropical land of Karamja.
translation: 아니 브와나, 저는 Sandicrahb(샌디크랩)이에요! 열대의 땅 Karamja(카람자)에서 바다를 건너 먼 길을 왔죠.

english: How come you're charging so much?
The gold is for a good cause, I promise bwana.
translation: 그 돈은 좋은 일에 쓰여요, 약속해요 브와나.

english: Uh huh, that's a mighty fine gold necklace you have.
translation: 흐음, 목에 건 gold necklace(금 목걸이)가 꽤 근사하네요.

english: Well bwana, of course I take a cut, but the funds keep these beaches clean and tidy, I promise!
translation: 뭐, 브와나, 물론 제 몫도 조금 떼긴 하죠. 하지만 그 돈으로 이 해변을 깨끗하고 말끔하게 유지한다니까요, 약속해요!

english: If you say so...
Good day to you too.
That's a nice boat! Would be a shame if something were to happen to it.
translation: 배가 멋지네요! 무슨 일이라도 생기면 참 아깝겠어요.

english: Made from the wood of the Fyburglars tree, strong and light weight! Perhaps if it went missing, I'd find you.
translation: Fyburglars tree(파이버글라스 나무)로 만들어서 튼튼하고 가볍답니다! 혹시 배가 없어지기라도 하면, 당신을 찾아가게 될지도 모르겠네요.

english: Perhaps.
Shall I return you to the beach?
Yes please, I'm done here.
Actually, I've not quite finished yet, I'll stay.
translation: 아니, 아직 다 못 끝냈어요. 좀 더 있을게요.

english: Very well bwana.
Can you ferry me to that island?
translation: 저 섬까지 배로 데려다줄 수 있나요?

english: Ok, here's the ridiculous sum of money...
Never mind.
Why so much? You'd get more business if you charged less.
translation: 왜 그렇게 비싸요? 값을 내리면 손님이 더 많을 텐데요.

english: That's too much for me.
Sure.
Who are you?
Good day to you too.
That's a nice boat!
Yes please, I'm done here.
Actually, I've not quite finished yet, I'll stay.
translation: 아니, 아직 다 못 끝냈어요. 좀 더 있을게요.

english: You look hungry to me. I tell you what - have a [food option] on me.
translation: 배고파 보이네. 있잖아, 이 [food option] 하나 내가 쏠게.

english: Hope that fills you up!
Hey, I didn't say you could have that!
translation: 야, 내가 그거 가져가도 된다고 한 적 없어!

english: I'd best be going - lots more sandwiches to deliver!
translation: 이만 가 봐야겠어. 배달할 샌드위치가 산더미야!

english: This is for [player name], not you.
translation: 이건 [player name] 거야, 네 거 아니라고.

english: Sandwiches, [player name]!
Did you hear me, [player name]?
Sandwich delivery for [player name]!
You think I made these just for fun?!!?
translation: 내가 이걸 그냥 재미로 만든 줄 알아?!!?

english: All types of sandwiches, [player name].
Come on [player name], I made these specially!!
translation: 어서, [player name], 너 주려고 특별히 만든 거라고!!

english: Maybe later.
Hello?
What do ya want for tea? And it better not be a baguette!
translation: 저녁으로 뭐 먹을래? 바게트라고만 해 봐라!

english: Don't ignore me, [player name]!
Why won't people talk to me?
translation: 왜 아무도 나랑 말을 안 하는 거야?

english: I'll beat you up!
Uhh, urr, a sandwich please?
Okay then, my dear! Toodle-oo!
Nice day for sand isn't it?
translation: 모래 팔기 딱 좋은 날 아니야?

english: Sand is yellow, Sand is grand, Sand puts money, In my hand!
translation: 모래는 노랗지, 모래는 멋지지, 모래는 돈을 벌어 주지, 내 손에 쥐여 주지!

english: I'm Sandy of Sandy's Sand Corp, are you in the sand business?
translation: 난 Sandy's Sand Corp(샌디 모래 주식회사)의 Sandy(샌디)다. 너도 모래 사업 하냐?

english: Errrr... no.
Then go away!
What can I do for you young 'un?
So... I've heard you druids might be able to teach me herblore...
translation: 저... 드루이드분들이 herblore(약초학)을 가르쳐 줄 수 있다고 들었는데요...

english: Herblore eh? You're probably best off talking to Kaqemeex about that; he's the best herblore teacher we currently have. I believe at the moment he's at out stone circle just North of here.
translation: Herblore(약초학)이라? 그거라면 Kaqemeex(카케멕스)와 이야기하는 게 제일 좋을 걸세. 지금 우리 중에 가장 뛰어난 약초학 선생이거든. 아마 지금은 여기서 바로 북쪽에 있는 우리 돌 원에 있을 걸세.

english: Thanks.
Actually, I don't need to speak to you.
Well, we all make mistakes sometimes.
translation: 뭐, 누구나 가끔 실수는 하는 법이지.

english: Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?
translation: 원을 되찾는 걸 도울 일이 더 있나요?

english: Have you any more work for me, to help reclaim the circle?
translation: 원을 되찾는 걸 도울 일이 더 있나요?

english: Not just yet, young 'un.
You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Eadgar's Ruse quest.
translation: Eadgar's Ruse(이드가의 계략) 퀘스트를 시작하기 위한 조건을 모두 충족하지 못했다.

english: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.
Have you any more work for me to help reclaim the stone circle?
translation: 돌 원을 되찾는 걸 도울 일이 더 있나요?

english: Ah, you've come just in time. I need a certain herb for the next part of the purification ritual...
translation: 아, 마침 잘 왔네. 정화 의식의 다음 단계에 쓸 약초가 하나 필요하다네...

english: It used to be quite common, but nowadays only the trolls know where to find it. They use it in their cooking, you see. It's a very prized ingredient.
translation: 예전엔 꽤 흔했는데, 요즘은 트롤들만 그게 어디 나는지 안다네. 트롤들이 요리에 쓰거든. 아주 귀한 재료로 치지.

english: And what exactly do you want me to do?
translation: 그래서 제가 정확히 뭘 하면 되나요?

english: Journey to the north into the land of the trolls, and find the secret of the herb the trolls call 'goutweed'.
translation: 북쪽 트롤의 땅으로 가서, 트롤들이 'goutweed(구트위드)'라고 부르는 약초의 비밀을 알아내게.

english: My friend Eadgar lives in the area, and he may be able to help you. Bring some goutweed back and I will teach you something useful.
translation: 내 친구 Eadgar(이드가)가 그 근처에 사는데, 자네를 도와줄 수 있을 걸세. goutweed(구트위드)를 좀 가져오면 쓸모 있는 걸 가르쳐 주겠네.

english: I'll do it.
Thank you, adventurer!
No thanks.
Oh well. No doubt some other adventurer will eventually come who can help me.
translation: 아, 그런가. 언젠가 나를 도와줄 다른 모험가가 오겠지.

english: Hey there, can you tell me something about this Sanfew Serum, like how do I make it, and what does it do?
translation: 저기요, 이 Sanfew Serum(샌퓨 세럼)에 대해 좀 알려 줄 수 있나요? 어떻게 만들고, 무슨 효과가 있는지요.

english: Certainly. It was after all, my creation, and mine alone. If anyone should know how to make it, it should be me!
translation: 물론이지. 어쨌거나 그건 내가, 오로지 나 혼자 만든 것이니까. 만드는 법을 아는 사람이 있다면 그건 당연히 나여야지!

english: Can't fault that logic!
Ok, essentially this potion is a mixture of a cure poison, cure disease and restore stats all rolled into one! Very handy for the adventurers with an eye on conserving inventory space.
translation: 좋아, 간단히 말해 이 물약은 해독제, 질병 치료제, 능력치 회복제를 한데 합친 거라네! 소지품 공간을 아끼려는 모험가들에게 아주 쓸모가 있지.

english: Ok, I'm sold... How do you make it?

Well, it's very easy really. You take a standard super stat restore potion. Add some ground unicorn horn. Then, add some snake weed from the island of Karamja. Finally, add some nail beast nails. You can
translation: 음, 사실 아주 쉽다네. 일반 슈퍼 능력치 회복 물약을 준비하고, 갈아 둔 unicorn horn(유니콘 뿔)을 넣게. 그다음 Karamja(카람자) 섬에서 나는 snake weed(뱀풀)을 넣고, 마지막으로 nail beast nails(손톱 괴수 손톱)을 넣으면 되네. 이 손톱은

english: only get these from the area of Morytania, specifically, if you go deep in the Mort Myre swamp.
translation: Morytania(모리타니아) 지역에서만 구할 수 있는데, 정확히는 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 깊숙한 곳에 가야 한다네.

english: How do you mean, deep into the Mort Myre swamp?
translation: Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 깊숙한 곳이라니, 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: Well, most adventurers avoid the deep Mort Myre swamp, whereas the Paterdomus trek and the Burgh de Rott trek take you through the most interesting areas. These area's often allow the quickest, but potentially
translation: 음, 대부분의 모험가는 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 깊은 곳을 피해 가지만, Paterdomus(파테르도무스) 길과 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트) 길은 가장 흥미로운 지역을 지나간다네. 이런 지역은 대개 가장 빠르지만, 자칫하면

english: more dangerous routes through Mort Myre. This is where you're likely to encounter a Nail beast.
translation: Mort Myre(모트 마이어)를 지나는 더 위험한 길이 되기도 하지. 바로 거기서 Nail beast(손톱 괴수)와 마주치기 쉽다네.

english: Are they very dangerous?

They can be pretty dangerous. They'll defend for a long time, then attack suddenly and seemingly without warning, landing three visciousattacks at once. This can be pretty lethal. However, the nail beasts themselves
translation: 꽤 위험할 수 있지. 오랫동안 방어만 하다가 아무 예고도 없이 갑자기 덤벼들어 사나운 공격을 한꺼번에 세 번이나 퍼붓는다네. 이게 꽤 치명적일 수 있지. 그런데 묘하게도 nail beast(손톱 괴수)들은

english: are curiously wounded from the Sanfew Serum itself...very bizzare,that a potion made from their claws should have such a pronounced effect on them.
translation: 바로 그 Sanfew Serum(샌퓨 세럼)에 상처를 입는다네... 참 기이하지, 자기 손톱으로 만든 물약이 자기들한테 그렇게 뚜렷한 효과를 내다니.

english: Ok, that's very helpful. Many thanks for your assistance.
translation: 좋아요, 정말 도움이 됐어요. 도와줘서 정말 고마워요.

english: Did you say you needed more goutweed?
I don't need any more goutweed for the ritual, but it's still quite difficult for me to get. If you ever come across some, bring it to me; I'll exchange it for some other herbs.
translation: 의식에 쓸 goutweed(구트위드)는 더 필요 없지만, 여전히 내가 구하기는 꽤 어렵다네. 혹시 어디서 구하게 되면 가져다주게. 다른 약초와 바꿔 주겠네.

english: Well, not right now I don't think young 'un. In fact, I need to make some more preparations myself for the ritual. Rest assured, if I need any more help I will ask you again.
translation: 글쎄, 지금은 없는 것 같네, 젊은이. 사실 나도 의식을 위해 준비할 게 좀 더 있다네. 걱정 말게, 도움이 더 필요하면 다시 부탁하겠네.

english: I've heard you druids might be able to teach me herblore.
translation: 드루이드분들이 herblore(약초학)을 가르쳐 줄 수 있다고 들었어요.

english: Ask about Sanfew Serum.
Ask general questions.
Yes.
No.
Did you say you needed more goutweed?
Good day to you, Bwana.
Can I go through that door please?
Most certainly, you have already given me lots of nice coins.
translation: 물론입니다. 이미 멋진 코인을 잔뜩 주셨으니까요.

english: Most certainly, but I must charge you the sum of 875 coins first.
I haven't got that much money with me.
I'll want 875 coins to let you enter; this is a dungeon for the more wealthy discerning adventurer. Begone with you, riff raff.
translation: 들어가시려면 875코인이 필요합니다. 이곳은 부유하고 안목 있는 모험가를 위한 던전이지요. 썩 물러가십시오, 천한 자여.

english: Okay, here's 875 coins.
Many thanks. You may now pass the door. May your death be a glorious one!
translation: 감사합니다. 이제 문을 지나가셔도 됩니다. 영광스러운 죽음을 맞으시길!

english: Why is it worth the entry cost?
translation: 왜 그만한 입장료를 낼 가치가 있죠?

english: It leads to a huge fearsome dungeon, populated by giants and strange dogs. Adventurers come from all around to explore its depths.
translation: 거대하고 무시무시한 던전으로 이어지는데, 거인들과 이상한 개들이 우글거립니다. 모험가들이 그 깊은 곳을 탐험하러 사방에서 찾아오지요.

english: I know not what lies deeper in myself, for my skills in agility and woodcutting are inadequate, but I hear tell of even greater dangers deeper in.
translation: 저 자신은 agility(민첩)과 woodcutting(벌목) 실력이 모자라 더 깊은 곳에 무엇이 있는지 모릅니다만, 안쪽으로 갈수록 훨씬 더 큰 위험이 있다고 들었습니다.

english: Can I pay you for permanent access?
I suppose so, yes. My employer will let you in for free, forever, in exchange for 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 그래도 되겠지요, 네. 제 고용주께서 1,000,000코인을 받고 영원히 무료로 들여보내 주실 겁니다.

english: I haven't got 1,000,000 coins with me.
Then perhaps you would rather pay 875 coins for one visit.
translation: 그렇다면 875코인을 내고 한 번만 들어가시는 편이 낫겠군요.

english: Okay, here's 1,000,000 coins.
Many thanks. You may now pass the door as many times as you wish, and I will not charge you again. May your death be a glorious one!
translation: 감사합니다. 이제 원하는 만큼 몇 번이고 문을 지나가셔도 되며, 다시는 요금을 받지 않겠습니다. 영광스러운 죽음을 맞으시길!

english: Never mind.
Where does this strange entrance lead?
To a huge fearsome dungeon, populated by giants and strange dogs. Adventurers come from all around to explore its depths.
translation: 거대하고 무시무시한 던전으로 이어지는데, 거인들과 이상한 개들이 우글거립니다. 모험가들이 그 깊은 곳을 탐험하러 사방에서 찾아오지요.

english: I know not what lies deeper in myself, for my skills in agility and woodcutting are inadequate.
translation: 저 자신은 agility(민첩)과 woodcutting(벌목) 실력이 모자라 더 깊은 곳에 무엇이 있는지 모릅니다.

english: I'm impressed, that tree is growing on that shed.
translation: 대단하네요, 저 나무가 헛간 위에서 자라고 있네요.

english: My employer tells me it is an uncommon sort of tree called the Fyburglars tree.
translation: 제 고용주 말씀으로는 Fyburglars tree(파이버글라스 나무)라는 흔치 않은 나무라고 합니다.

english: Good day to you too.
You have already given me lovely coins, so you may go in, and may your death be a glorious one!
translation: 이미 멋진 코인을 주셨으니 들어가셔도 됩니다. 영광스러운 죽음을 맞으시길!

english: Okay, thanks.
You have already given me lots of nice coins, you may go in.
translation: 이미 멋진 코인을 잔뜩 주셨으니 들어가셔도 됩니다.

english: You're not done yet! Do this for me!
translation: 아직 안 끝났습니다! 이걸 해 주십시오!

english: My guard dogs can do puzzles better than that!
translation: 제 경비견들도 그것보다는 퍼즐을 잘 풉니다!

english: Excellent work!
Can I go through that door please?
I haven't got that much money with me.
Can I pay you for permanent access?
Okay, here's 875 coins.
Why is it worth the entry cost?
translation: 왜 그만한 입장료를 낼 가치가 있죠?

english: Never mind.
Okay, here's 1,000,000 coins.
Where does this strange entrance lead?
I'm impressed, that tree is growing on that shed.
translation: 대단하네요, 저 나무가 헛간 위에서 자라고 있네요.

english: Good day to you too.
Yes
No
