Pay 1,000,000 coins for permanent access
Cancel
Okay, thanks.
Hello Santa, long time no see!
Ho Ho Hello [player name], it certainly has been a long time.
Quick question, why are you hanging out with a bunch of angry children?
translation: 잠깐만요, 왜 화난 아이들이랑 같이 계세요?

english: Christmas is ruined! My son, Jack Frost, has messed it all up!
translation: 크리스마스를 망쳤단다! 내 아들 Jack Frost(잭 프로스트)가 다 엉망으로 만들어 버렸어!

english: I put him in charge of this year's Christmas to learn some much needed responsibility.
translation: 녀석이 책임감 좀 배우라고 올해 크리스마스를 맡겼거든.

english: All he does is sit at home, eating my mince pies, drinking my eggnog and throwing snowballs at my elves.
translation: 그런데 하는 일이라곤 집에 앉아서 내 민스 파이나 먹고, 내 에그노그나 마시고, 내 요정들한테 눈덩이나 던지는 것뿐이야.

english: So why has that caused a problem with the Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 그게 Gingerbread Gnome(진저브레드 노움)이랑 무슨 상관이에요?

english: A major part of my job is overseeing Gingerbread Gnome production here in Varrock. I like to... ensure production is top quality... and do some taste testing from time to time.
translation: 내 일의 큰 부분이 여기 Varrock(바록)에서 진저브레드 노움 생산을 감독하는 거란다. 난 그러니까... 생산 품질이 최상인지 확인하고... 가끔 맛도 좀 보지.

english: As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
translation: 그런데 녀석이 손을 대자마자 생산이 뚝 멈춰 버렸어. 난 진저브레드 노움이 꼭 있어야 해. 내 균형 잡힌 식단의 일부거든.

english: So why don't you go help him out instead of standing around Varrock?
translation: 그럼 Varrock(바록)에 서 계시지 말고 직접 가서 도와주시면 되잖아요?

english: I'm trying a new parenting technique, he needs to learn from his mistakes.
translation: 새로운 육아법을 시도하는 중이란다. 녀석은 실수에서 배워야 해.

english: But in the mean time, could you go and have a word with him? The bakery is south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 하지만 그동안 네가 가서 녀석이랑 얘기 좀 해 주겠니? 빵집은 여기 Varrock(바록)의 Apothecary(약제사) 남쪽에 있단다.

english: Great, now this is my problem, thanks Santa.
translation: 좋네요, 이제 이게 제 문제가 됐군요. 고마워요, 산타 할아버지.

english: Have you managed to solve the problem at the Bakery yet?
In case you forgot, the bakery is just south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 혹시 잊었을까 봐 말해 주는데, 빵집은 여기 Varrock(바록)의 Apothecary(약제사) 바로 남쪽이란다.

english: I'm still working on it.
Hurry it along would you, I'm getting quite hungry.
translation: 좀 서둘러 주겠니? 배가 꽤 고프구나.

english: Hello again Santa.
Ho Ho Hello [player name], have you managed to sort out my son?
translation: 호호호, 안녕 [player name]. 내 아들 일은 해결했니?

english: Not yet, I found the bakery and it appears Jack has thrown a tantrum....
translation: 아직요. 빵집을 찾았는데 Jack(잭)이 떼를 쓰고 있는 것 같아요....

english: Oh dear, what has he done?
Well he's locked the bakers up and brought in an Icelord.
translation: 음, 제빵사들을 가둬 놓고 Icelord(아이스로드)를 데려왔어요.

english: One of the bakers managed to escape and is outside.
translation: 제빵사 한 명이 겨우 빠져나와서 밖에 있어요.

english: Where did I go wrong... Jack used to be such a happy young boy.
translation: 내가 어디서부터 잘못한 걸까... Jack(잭)은 원래 참 밝은 아이였는데.

english: Looks like I'm going to need to step in if we're going to save Christmas.
translation: 크리스마스를 구하려면 내가 나서야 할 것 같구나.

english: Great! So you're going to go and talk to him?
translation: 잘됐네요! 그럼 직접 가서 얘기하시는 거죠?

english: Ho Ho Ho, of course not [player name], I've got a better idea.
translation: 호호호, 물론 아니지 [player name]. 더 좋은 생각이 있단다.

english: Fantastic... and that is?
You're going to bring Anti-Santa to sort him out, Jack is terrified of him.
translation: 네가 Anti-Santa(안티 산타)를 데려가서 Jack(잭)을 혼내 주는 거야. 잭은 안티 산타를 무서워하거든.

english: Anti-Santa?! No way am I freeing him after all that work a few years ago.
translation: Anti-Santa(안티 산타)요?! 몇 년 전에 그 고생을 했는데 그 녀석을 풀어 준다고요? 절대 안 돼요.

english: Don't you think I know that! We have no choice I'm afraid.
translation: 나라고 그걸 모르겠니! 안타깝지만 다른 방법이 없단다.

english: I'm sure we can come up with something better than freeing him.
translation: 그 녀석을 풀어 주는 것보다 나은 방법이 분명 있을 거예요.

english: Well if you have a better idea, spit it out.
translation: 그래, 더 좋은 생각이 있으면 어디 말해 보렴.

english: Thought so, now I'm going to need you to free him from his prison in ScapeRune.
translation: 그럴 줄 알았다. 자, 이제 네가 ScapeRune(스케이프룬)의 감옥에서 그 녀석을 풀어 줘야 해.

english: How am I going to do that? Evil Bob took him away....
translation: 그걸 어떻게 해요? Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 데려갔잖아요....

english: Yes, but we don't need Evil Bob's help this time, I can teleport you into his cell.
translation: 그렇지. 하지만 이번엔 Evil Bob(사악한 밥)의 도움은 필요 없단다. 내가 그 녀석 감방으로 바로 순간이동시켜 줄 수 있거든.

english: You'll still need to convince him to help us though.
translation: 그래도 우릴 돕도록 녀석을 설득하는 건 네 몫이란다.

english: Anti-Santa? Never heard of him, sound'slike an edgy version of you.
translation: Anti-Santa(안티 산타)요? 처음 들어 보는데, 할아버지의 삐딱한 버전 같은 이름이네요.

english: He certainly has his... unique aspects to his personality.
translation: 그 녀석 성격엔 확실히... 독특한 구석이 좀 있지.

english: But he'll be very useful for scaring Jack. There aren't many things Jack's afraid of, but that giant skeleton is one of them.
translation: 하지만 Jack(잭)을 겁주는 데는 아주 쓸모가 있을 거야. 잭이 무서워하는 건 별로 없는데, 그 거대 해골이 그중 하나거든.

english: Where can I find Anti-Santa? I've never come across him in my travels.
translation: Anti-Santa(안티 산타)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요? 여행하면서 한 번도 못 봤는데요.

english: A few years ago, Evil Bob locked him away in ScapeRune.
translation: 몇 년 전에 Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 그 녀석을 ScapeRune(스케이프룬)에 가둬 버렸단다.

english: Great, I'm sure if we wait long enough, Evil Bob will appear out of nowhere....
translation: 좋네요, 오래 기다리다 보면 Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 어디선가 불쑥 나타나겠죠....

english: We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
translation: 그럴 시간 없다. Evil Bob(사악한 밥)이 그 녀석을 나한테 믿고 맡겼거든. 녀석 뒤치다꺼리에 지쳐 버렸다면서.

english: I'll teleport you right into his cell, you're going to need to convince him to help us.
translation: 내가 그 녀석 감방으로 바로 순간이동시켜 줄 테니, 네가 녀석을 설득해서 우릴 돕게 해야 해.

english: Surely he'll still be angry about last time?
translation: 지난번 일 때문에 아직도 화나 있지 않을까요?

english: Most likely, but if you tell him that I'm considering setting him free, he'll change his tune.
translation: 아마 그렇겠지. 하지만 내가 녀석을 풀어 줄까 고민 중이라고 말하면 태도가 달라질 거야.

english: Take this as well. After you've convinced him to help, you can use this to teleport both of you to the bakery.
translation: 이것도 가져가렴. 녀석을 설득한 다음 이걸 쓰면 둘 다 빵집으로 순간이동할 수 있단다.

english: You've got too much on you, come back when you've got some free space.
translation: 짐이 너무 많구나. 자리를 좀 비우고 다시 오렴.

english: Santa gives you a teleport tablet to teleport you to the bakery.
translation: Santa(산타)가 빵집으로 가는 순간이동 서판을 준다.

english: Ah [player name], you've returned, have you managed to sort out the bakery?
translation: 아, [player name], 돌아왔구나. 빵집 일은 해결했니?

english: Hello again Santa, yes I've managed to sort out the bakery and stop your son.
translation: 다시 안녕하세요, 산타 할아버지. 네, 빵집 일도 해결하고 아드님도 막았어요.

english: Ho Ho Ho, that's perfect and what of the Anti-Santa?
translation: 호호호, 완벽하구나. 그런데 Anti-Santa(안티 산타)는 어떻게 됐니?

english: Uhm... well... there was a slight problem when we returned from ScapeRune.
translation: 음... 그게... ScapeRune(스케이프룬)에서 돌아왔을 때 작은 문제가 좀 있었어요.

english: What happened?
He sort of beat up Jack then escaped when Jack fled.
translation: 그 녀석이 Jack(잭)을 좀 두들겨 패고는, 잭이 달아나자 같이 도망쳤어요.

english: Uh... that wasn't supposeto happen. Do you know where they went?
translation: 어... 그렇게 될 일이 아니었는데. 둘이 어디로 갔는지 아니?

english: I'm afraid not, Jack teleported out and Anti-Santa followed him.
translation: 아쉽지만 몰라요. Jack(잭)이 순간이동으로 빠져나가고 Anti-Santa(안티 산타)가 뒤따라갔어요.

english: That's going to come back and bite me in the future... Oh well, problem for another year I suppose, did you manage to make any Gingerbread Gnomes for me?
translation: 언젠가 그게 나한테 화로 돌아오겠구나... 뭐, 그건 내년 문제겠지. 그래서 나 줄 Gingerbread Gnome(진저브레드 노움)은 좀 만들었니?

english: I'm afraid I didn't, although I do have this giant one I used to protect myself from the Icelord, the bakers are going to use the Icelord from now on to ice their gnomes.
translation: 아쉽지만 못 만들었어요. 대신 Icelord(아이스로드)한테서 몸을 지키려고 쓴 거대한 노움이 하나 있긴 해요. 제빵사들은 앞으로 아이스로드를 써서 노움에 아이싱을 하기로 했대요.

english: Oh, that wouldn't be edible at all, Icelord saliva isn't safe to eat, you better keep that one and maybe go tell the bakers later as well.
translation: 아이고, 그건 절대 못 먹는다. 아이스로드 침은 먹으면 안전하지 않거든. 그건 네가 갖고 있고, 나중에 제빵사들한테도 꼭 말해 주렴.

english: Ho Ho Ho, well thank you for all your help this year [player name], I'm sure I'll see you again soon.
translation: 호호호, 올해 도와줘서 정말 고맙구나 [player name]. 곧 또 보게 될 거야.

english: Yeah... looking forward to it....
Why are you still here?
Ho Ho Ho, I'm still waiting for the delivery to come in!
translation: 호호호, 아직 배달이 오길 기다리는 중이란다!

english: I'll leave you to it then.
Well hello there [player name].
Hello.
What can I do for you on this fine winter day?
I was hoping to enter into your festive games!
translation: 할아버지의 축제 게임에 참가하고 싶어서 왔어요!

english: Ah, splendid! Another contender.
Now I must warn you, the games will put you to the test. They may even break you.
translation: 미리 경고하는데, 이 게임은 너를 시험에 들게 할 거다. 어쩌면 널 무너뜨릴지도 몰라.

english: Failing the games will put you on the Naughty List until the end of time.
translation: 게임에서 지면 영원히 Naughty List(나쁜 아이 명단)에 오르게 된단다.

english: Do you accept these conditions?
Uh... I guess so.
Excellent!
Santa tells you your game time.
Thanks! Can I also ask a favour?
It depends, have you been nice this year?
translation: 그건 상황에 따라 다르지. 올해 착하게 지냈니?

english: Absolutely.
Very well, I trust you. What do you desire?
translation: 좋아, 믿어 주마. 원하는 게 뭐니?

english: A Gilded Scimitar.
A Twisted Bow.
Wait no... Sorry ignore that. Instinct kicked in.
translation: 아니 잠깐만요... 죄송해요, 방금 건 잊어 주세요. 본능이 튀어나왔어요.

english: Could I get another entry time? My friend has been caught up re-homing lost kittens and would love a chance to enter the games.
translation: 입장 시간을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요? 제 친구가 길 잃은 새끼 고양이들 새집 찾아 주느라 바빴는데, 게임에 꼭 참가하고 싶어 하거든요.

english: What a delightful friend you have there. Of course.
Santa tells you Guss' game time.
translation: Santa(산타)가 Guss(거스)의 게임 시간을 알려 준다.

english: My time and my friend's time are different?
That's the rules I'm afraid, we can't have any funny business going on.
translation: 안타깝지만 그게 규칙이란다. 수상한 짓은 용납할 수 없거든.

english: Oh uh... Fair enough.
Your game time is coming up, better get ready!
translation: 곧 네 게임 시간이다. 준비하는 게 좋을 거야!

english: I'll be back in a jiffy. I just need to chat to my... friend.
translation: 금방 올게요. 제... 친구랑 잠깐 얘기 좀 하고요.

english: Before you go in, you'll need to solve a Christmas riddle...
translation: 들어가기 전에 크리스마스 수수께끼를 하나 풀어야 한단다...

english: Oh gosh.
What was that?
It's nothing sorry. Speaking to myself.
So, on to the riddle...
What do you get when you meet a vampyre in the winter?
translation: 겨울에 vampyre(뱀파이어)를 만나면 뭘 얻게 될까?

english: Killed.
A nice seafood dinner for two.
Frostbite.
Ho Ho oh no, that's not quite right... How about this one? I'm feeling kind today.
translation: 호호 이런, 그건 정답이 아니구나... 그럼 이건 어떠니? 오늘은 내가 마음이 좀 너그럽거든.

english: I am a plant seen every Christmas which people hang up above, they stand beneath me and kiss someone they love.
translation: 나는 크리스마스마다 볼 수 있는 식물, 사람들이 나를 높이 매달고, 그 아래 서서 사랑하는 이에게 입을 맞추지.

english: Mistletoe.
Wreath.
Stocking.
Gosh you really want to enter these games after failing two easy riddles?
translation: 이런, 쉬운 수수께끼를 두 개나 틀리고도 정말 이 게임에 참가하고 싶니?

english: They're gonna eat you alive in there, but best of luck!
translation: 안에서 다들 널 산 채로 잡아먹으려 들 텐데, 아무튼 행운을 빈다!

english: Ho ho happy days! Well done that's the right answer.
You may now enter into the Festive Games!
translation: 이제 Festive Games(축제 게임)에 참가할 수 있단다!

english: I'll bring you out a beer when Guss wins!
translation: Guss(거스)가 이기면 맥주 한 잔 갖다드릴게요!

english: Guss??
I mean when I win, ha ha. Slip of the tongue.
translation: 아니, 제가 이기면요, 하하. 말이 헛나왔어요.

english: Would you like to enter the games?
I'll enter soon, there's just something I need to do.
translation: 곧 참가할게요, 잠깐 할 일이 좀 있어서요.

english: I'll be here all Christmas.
translation: 난 크리스마스 내내 여기 있을 거란다.

english: Amazing job in the games [player name], you and Guss really made a great show.
translation: 게임에서 정말 대단했다, [player name]. 너랑 Guss(거스) 덕분에 아주 멋진 구경을 했구나.

english: You... saw?
I see all.
You really think I didn't see yours and Guss's little plan?
translation: 너랑 Guss(거스)의 작은 계획을 내가 못 봤을 줄 알았니?

english: I don't think I've ever seen such dedication to The Nutcracker from anyone. Guss earned it.
translation: The Nutcracker(호두까기 인형)에 그렇게 열과 성을 다하는 녀석은 처음 봤구나. Guss(거스)는 그럴 자격이 있지.

english: Guss thinks they're on the naughty list! I can't wait to tell them.
translation: Guss(거스)는 자기가 나쁜 아이 명단에 있는 줄 알아요! 빨리 말해 주고 싶네요.

english: I'm afraid that'll have to be our little secret [player name].
translation: 안타깝지만 그건 우리끼리의 작은 비밀로 해 둬야겠구나, [player name].

english: Oh crumbs.
Have a happy holidays [player name]!
Yes
No
Hello there.
Ho Ho HoMerry Xmas, [player name]! Have you been a good [boy/girl] this year?
translation: 호호호메리 크리스마스, [player name]! 올해는 착한 [boy/girl]답게 지냈니?

english: Yes I have, Santa!
Ho Ho HoThen take this present, and have a merry Xmas!
translation: 호호호그럼 이 선물을 받고, 즐거운 크리스마스 보내렴!

english: Ho Ho HoIf you lose your yo-yo, don't forget you can get a replacement from Diango in Draynor!
translation: 호호호yo-yo(요요)를 잃어버리면 Draynor(드레이너)의 Diango(디앙고)한테서 새로 받을 수 있다는 걸 잊지 말렴!

english: I lost my Yo-yo Santa...
Ho Ho HoYou've already had your Xmas present this year!
translation: 호호호넌 올해 크리스마스 선물을 이미 받았단다!

english: Ho Ho HoThen you may have another!Don't forget you can get your Yo-yo returned from Diango in Draynor!
translation: 호호호그럼 하나 더 주마!Draynor(드레이너)의 Diango(디앙고)한테서 Yo-yo(요요)를 돌려받을 수 있다는 걸 잊지 말렴!

english: Merry Xmas!
Come talk to Santa!
I love Xmas
Ho Ho Ho
Hello [player name]!
Hello.
So, you want to be on the Nice List huh?
translation: 그래서, Nice List(착한 아이 명단)에 오르고 싶다는 거죠?

english: If that's what it takes to get into that pub, absolutely.
translation: 그래야 저 술집에 들어갈 수 있다면, 물론이죠.

english: That's the spirit.
So let me tell you about the first game.
translation: 그럼 첫 번째 게임에 대해 알려 드릴게요.

english: There are other non-player ch... I mean competitors in here, who will also be trying to offload their coal.
translation: 여기엔 다른 논플레이어 캐... 아니, 다른 참가자들도 있는데, 그들도 자기 석탄을 떠넘기려고 할 거예요.

english: Simply pick up the coal and hand it out to your opponents to eliminate them.
translation: 석탄을 주워서 상대에게 건네주면 그 상대를 탈락시킬 수 있어요.

english: The large piles contain 40 pieces of coal. The small piles contain 20 pieces of coal.
translation: 큰 더미에는 석탄이 40개, 작은 더미에는 20개 들어 있어요.

english: Be careful not to carry too much or you might get caught out and eliminated.
translation: 너무 많이 들고 다니지 않게 조심하세요. 걸려서 탈락할 수도 있으니까요.

english: Are you ready to start the first game?
translation: 첫 번째 게임을 시작할 준비가 됐나요?

english: Yes.
I think I want to take a look around first.
Fair enough, I'll be waiting!
Congrats on winning the game! You've done a smashing job!
translation: 게임 우승 축하해요! 정말 멋지게 해냈어요!

english: Come and speak to me when you're ready to advance to the next game.
translation: 다음 게임으로 넘어갈 준비가 되면 저한테 말을 걸어 주세요.

english: A riddle.
Their body is round, with a carrot for a nose. They love to be cold, from their head to their toes.
translation: 몸은 동글동글, 코는 당근. 머리부터 발끝까지 차가운 게 좋대요.

english: Reindeer.
Snow angel.
Witch.
That's not quite right, I'm afraid.
Snowman?
Brilliant! On to the next challenge!
Amazing job in my game [player name].
Thanks!
Do you enjoy being a host in these games?
translation: 이 게임 진행자 하는 거 재밌어요?

english: It's jolly good fun. Part of me wishes I could join in.
translation: 아주 신나요. 저도 끼고 싶은 마음이 좀 있을 정도로요.

english: Do you get anything for being a host?
translation: 진행자를 하면 뭐 받는 게 있어요?

english: A free pass onto the Nice List!
translation: Nice List(착한 아이 명단) 무료 등재권이요!

english: Plus I'm very judgemental so the job is quite fitting.
translation: 게다가 제가 남을 판단하기를 아주 좋아해서, 이 일이 꽤 잘 맞아요.

english: What's your story?
Well, before all this I was a Judge in a very prestigious court.
translation: 음, 이 일을 하기 전엔 아주 명망 있는 법정의 판사였어요.

english: That's very fitting.
Indeed.
I loved all the opportunities to help people in Gielinor.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르)의 사람들을 도울 수 있는 기회가 정말 좋았어요.

english: Alas, that was a long time ago. I've since passed away.
translation: 아쉽게도 아주 오래전 일이에요. 저는 그 뒤로 세상을 떠났거든요.

english: Wait, you're dead?
Oh we all are here! Santa gave us the opportunity to stay here in this sanctuary.
translation: 어머, 여기 있는 사람은 다 그래요! Santa(산타)께서 이 안식처에 머물 기회를 주셨죠.

english: But you don't look particularly ghostly, or zombie-like?
translation: 그런데 딱히 유령이나 좀비처럼 보이지는 않는데요?

english: That's just the thing, while we are in here we can keep our mortal body with Santa's magic.
translation: 바로 그거예요. 여기 있는 동안은 산타의 마법 덕분에 살아 있을 때의 몸을 유지할 수 있거든요.

english: Amazing, but also kind of scary at the same time.
translation: 놀랍네요. 근데 동시에 좀 무섭기도 해요.

english: Where did you think the ghosts of Christmas past, present and future go?
translation: 과거, 현재, 미래의 크리스마스 유령들이 어디로 간다고 생각했어요?

english: To the pub of course!
Do you happen to know if I'm on the Naughty List or Nice List?
translation: 혹시 제가 Naughty List(나쁜 아이 명단)에 있는지 Nice List(착한 아이 명단)에 있는지 아세요?

english: Let me see...
The scribe twists round to look on her back.
translation: 서기가 몸을 비틀어 자기 등을 들여다본다.

english: Looks like you are on the...
Naughty List... That's unfortunate.
translation: Naughty List(나쁜 아이 명단)에 있네요... 안됐어요.

english: Nice List! Congratulations.
translation: Nice List(착한 아이 명단)에 있네요! 축하해요.

english: Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
No.
Snowman.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
translation: 축제 게임 진행자 하는 거 재밌어요?

english: Am I on the nice list?
Happy Holidays!
Welcome, human, to the Quality Weapons Shop! Can I interest you in a purchase?
translation: 어서 오시오, 인간이여. Quality Weapons Shop(고급 무기 상점)에 온 걸 환영하오! 뭐 하나 사 보겠소?

english: Yes, I'm looking for some weapons.
No thanks.
Yes, I'm looking for some weapons.
No thanks.
For Saradomin!
Hey there, what's this all about?
Our Lord Saradomin needs your help!
translation: 우리 주 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 그대의 도움을 필요로 하십니다!

english: Oh great, what is it this time?
You're needed at Castle Wars, our forces are weakening and we need you as reinforcements.
translation: Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)에서 그대가 필요합니다. 우리 군세가 약해지고 있어 그대를 지원군으로 보내야 합니다.

english: Sure, I'll play some Castle Wars.
Praise Saradomin, I'll send you there right away!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)을 찬양하라! 즉시 그곳으로 보내 드리겠습니다!

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting room. See the chat for details.
translation: 일부 아이템 때문에 Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈) 대기실에 들어갈 수 없습니다. 자세한 내용은 채팅을 확인하십시오.

english: Hmm, I'm alright actually, I don't want to play Castle Wars right now.
translation: 음, 사실 괜찮아요. 지금은 캐슬 워즈를 하고 싶지 않아요.

english: I urge you to reconsider, before it's too late.
translation: 너무 늦기 전에 다시 생각해 보시길 간곡히 권합니다.

english: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: 죄송하지만 이 월드에서는 Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)를 할 수 없습니다. 공식 월드인 334 월드로 가 보십시오.

english: Fight for the greater good today!
translation: 오늘, 더 큰 선을 위해 싸우십시오!

english: Fight for Saradomin today!
The light of Saradomin is fading, he needs your help!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 빛이 꺼져 가고 있습니다. 그분께는 그대의 도움이 필요합니다!

english: Zamorak is a false god who is a stain on this world, Saradomin will guide you forward.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)은 이 세상의 오점인 거짓 신입니다. Saradomin(사라도민)께서 그대를 앞으로 이끄실 것입니다.

english: Yes.
No.
Hello. How can I help you?
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
Can you tell me how to use the loom?
translation: loom(베틀) 쓰는 법 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: Well, it's actually my loom, but I don't mind you using it, if you like. You can use it to weave sacks and baskets in which you can put vegetables and fruit.
translation: 음, 사실 제 베틀이긴 한데, 쓰고 싶으시면 써도 괜찮아요. 채소랑 과일을 담을 자루랑 바구니를 짤 수 있어요.

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
Well, the best sacks are made with jute fibres; you can grow jute yourself in a hops patch. I'd say about 4 jute fibres should be enough to weave a sack.
translation: 음, 제일 좋은 자루는 jute fibres(황마 섬유)로 만들어요. 황마는 hops patch(홉 밭)에서 직접 키울 수 있어요. 자루 하나 짜는 데 황마 섬유 4개 정도면 충분할 거예요.

english: Thank you, that's very kind.
What do I need to weave baskets?

Well, the best baskets are made with young branches cut from a willow tree. You'll need a very young willow tree; otherwise, the branches will have grown too thick to be able to weave. I suggest growing your own.
translation: 음, 제일 좋은 바구니는 willow tree(버드나무)에서 자른 어린 가지로 만들어요. 아주 어린 버드나무여야 해요. 안 그러면 가지가 너무 굵어져서 엮을 수가 없거든요. 직접 키우시는 걸 추천해요.

english: You can cut the branches with a standard pair of secateurs. You will probably need about 6 willow branches to weave a complete basket.
translation: 가지는 평범한 secateurs(전지가위)로 자르면 돼요. 바구니 하나를 다 짜려면 버드나무 가지가 6개쯤 필요할 거예요.

english: I'm okay, thank you.
I've come about the bounty.
Oh thank Saradomin! It's about time someone responded, something needs to be done!
translation: 오, Saradomin(사라도민)께 감사를! 드디어 누가 와 주셨네요. 이대로 둘 순 없다고요!

english: Can you explain what happened?
Of course. I was making my monthly delivery to The Sheared Ram in Lumbridge, heading east near the Draynor Village crossroads.
translation: 물론이죠. Lumbridge(럼브리지)에 있는 The Sheared Ram(털 깎인 숫양)에 한 달에 한 번 하는 배달을 가던 길이었어요. Draynor Village(드레이너 마을) 갈림길 근처에서 동쪽으로 가고 있었죠.

english: Suddenly, out of the trees came a hulking monster! It chased me for a short distance, but luckily Rosie managed to spook it enough to give me a headstart.
translation: 그런데 갑자기 나무들 사이에서 덩치 큰 괴물이 튀어나온 거예요! 잠깐 쫓아왔는데, 다행히 Rosie(로지)가 겁을 줘서 먼저 도망칠 틈이 생겼어요.

english: Sounds like it must have given you quite the scare!
It certainly did. I even lost my cart full of farm produce!
translation: 그러게 말이에요. 농산물을 가득 실은 수레까지 잃어버렸다니까요!

english: What did this monster look like?
I didn't get a very good look at it I'm afraid. It was getting dark and as soon as I saw it charging at me, I ran.
translation: 안타깝지만 제대로 보진 못했어요. 날이 어두워지고 있었고, 그게 저한테 달려드는 걸 보자마자 도망쳤거든요.

english: I can still hear the sound, though. A horrible grunting... squealing...
translation: 그래도 그 소리는 아직도 귀에 생생해요. 끔찍하게 꿀꿀대고... 꽥꽥대는...

english: Is there anything else you wanted?
Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: 그놈을 찾을 만한 단서 같은 거 있을까요?

english: Tips...? You're supposed to be the professional monster slayer!
Although, I suppose a good place to start would be checking the area I was attacked. See if you can find the remains of my cart.
translation: 그래도 제가 습격당한 곳부터 살펴보는 게 좋겠네요. 제 수레 잔해가 남아 있는지 찾아보세요.

english: Ok, yes that could work.
Whereabouts were you attacked again?
I remember being somewhere near the crossroads, north of Draynor Village.
translation: Draynor Village(드레이너 마을) 북쪽 갈림길 근처 어디쯤이었던 걸로 기억해요.

english: Sorry that I'm not much help. It happened so fast, the whole thing is a bit of a blur.
translation: 별로 도움이 못 돼서 미안해요. 너무 순식간이라 전부 다 흐릿해요.

english: That's okay. Crossroads north of Draynor... At least I have somewhere to start.
translation: 괜찮아요. Draynor(드레이너) 북쪽 갈림길이라... 적어도 어디서 시작할지는 알겠네요.

english: You mentioned that Rosie spooked the monster. Who's that?
translation: Rosie(로지)가 괴물한테 겁을 줬다고 하셨죠. 그게 누구예요?

english: Oh, that'll be our lady over there by the fire. She's such a good dog, always accompanies me on deliveries.
translation: 아, 저기 불 옆에 있는 우리 아가씨예요. 정말 착한 개예요. 배달 갈 때마다 늘 같이 다니죠.

english: You can pet her if you like. She's very friendly.
translation: 원하시면 쓰다듬어 주셔도 돼요. 아주 순하거든요.

english: I think that'll be all for now.
translation: 지금은 이 정도면 될 것 같아요.

english: Excellent! Best of luck to you, I'll be waiting right here with your reward.
translation: 좋아요! 행운을 빌어요. 보상을 들고 여기서 기다리고 있을게요.

english: That monster certainly won't be troubling you from now on.
translation: 이제 그 괴물이 더는 귀찮게 하지 않을 거예요.

english: Oh that's fantastic news! I'm so relie-
translation: 어머, 정말 좋은 소식이네요! 정말 다행이에-

english: Wait, how do I know you're not just saying that to get the bounty?
translation: 잠깐만요, 현상금 받으려고 그냥 하는 말이 아니라는 걸 어떻게 알죠?

english: How about this as proof?
You pull the foot out of your backpack and show it to Sarah.
translation: 배낭에서 발을 꺼내 Sarah(사라)에게 보여 준다.

english: Eugh! Yes, that certainly looks about right!
Indeed, the smell is... something quite special.
I'll probably just give it to the dog.
I'm glad you made it back. Some strange woman in a hood came asking about the job shortly after you left. I didn't really want her back in here.
translation: 무사히 돌아오셔서 다행이에요. 당신이 떠나고 얼마 안 돼서 웬 후드 쓴 이상한 여자가 와서 이 일에 대해 묻더라고요. 다시는 여기 안 왔으면 좋겠어요.

english: Anyway, thank you so much! Here's your reward.
Sarah hands you a heavy pouch of 5,000 coins.
Perhaps I should speak with Spria and tell her that the monster's been dealt with.
You've been given another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you tell me how to use the loom?
translation: loom(베틀) 쓰는 법 좀 알려 주실래요?

english: What do I need to weave sacks?
What do I need to weave baskets?
Thank you, that's very kind.
I'm okay, thank you.
Talk about the bounty.
What did the monster look like?
Any tips on finding this thing?
translation: 그놈을 찾을 만한 단서 같은 거 있을까요?

english: Whereabouts were you attacked again?
You mentioned Rosie. Who's that?
I think that'll be all for now.
translation: 지금은 이 정도면 될 것 같아요.

english: Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 어떤 작업이 필요하세요?

english: I'd like a Wooden table built.
translation: Wooden table(나무 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden bed built.
translation: Wooden bed(나무 침대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden dresser built.
translation: Wooden dresser(나무 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Wooden small table built.
translation: Wooden small table(나무 작은 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like my range fixed.
I'd like a Wooden shelf built.
translation: Wooden shelf(나무 선반) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak table built.
translation: Oak table(참나무 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak bed built.
translation: Oak bed(참나무 침대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak dresser built.
translation: Oak dresser(참나무 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak small table built.
translation: Oak small table(참나무 작은 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Oak shelf built.
translation: Oak shelf(참나무 선반) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak table built.
translation: Teak table(티크 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak bed built.
translation: Teak bed(티크 침대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak dresser built.
translation: Teak dresser(티크 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak small table built.
translation: Teak small table(티크 작은 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Teak shelf built.
translation: Teak shelf(티크 선반) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany table built.
translation: Mahogany table(마호가니 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany bed built.
translation: Mahogany bed(마호가니 침대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany dresser built.
translation: Mahogany dresser(마호가니 화장대) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany small table built.
translation: Mahogany small table(마호가니 작은 탁자) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany shelf built.
translation: Mahogany shelf(마호가니 선반) 하나를 만들어 주세요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가기 전에 차 한 잔 하시겠어요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 맛있는 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
I can't find my husband, we got seperated as we disembarked the ship.
translation: 남편을 못 찾겠어요. 배에서 내리다가 헤어졌거든요.

english: What do you want, mortal?
I'm not sure - what can you offer?
translation: 잘 모르겠어요 - 뭘 해 주실 수 있는데요?

english: Not much, I'm dead.
Fair enough.
You're the one who stopped Necrovarus. Our people are forever grateful to you, even if we don't always show it.
translation: 네가 Necrovarus(네크로바루스)를 막은 자로구나. 늘 티를 내진 않지만, 우리 백성은 영원히 네게 감사하고 있다.

english: Hello.
Are you Sarah Corvo?
That's me. Not many people interested in visiting me these days. What brings you here?
translation: 맞아요. 요즘은 절 찾아오는 사람이 별로 없는데. 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: I'm on the hunt for the piece of a key. It was once in the possession of your ancestor, Tristan Corvo.
translation: 열쇠 조각을 찾고 있어요. 한때 당신 조상인 Tristan Corvo(트리스탄 코르보)가 갖고 있던 거예요.

english: I see. I'm afraid I can't help you. The key is gone.
translation: 그렇군요. 미안하지만 도와드릴 수가 없어요. 그 열쇠는 사라졌거든요.

english: Gone?

Yes gone. When my father passed the key down to me he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys I buried it out in the swamps to stop them from getting it.
translation: 네, 사라졌어요. 아버지가 그 열쇠를 물려주시면서 무슨 일이 있어도 안전하게 지키라고 하셨죠. vampyres(뱀파이어)들이 Port Phasmatys(포트 파스마티스)에 왔을 때, 그놈들 손에 들어가지 않게 늪지에 묻어 버렸어요.

english: But how do I get it back?
You don't. The key is gone and it's safer that way. I never liked looking after that lump of metal anyway.
translation: 못 찾아요. 열쇠는 사라졌고, 그게 더 안전해요. 어차피 그 금속 덩어리를 지키는 게 늘 싫었거든요.

english: Metal?
Yes, a strange red metal.
Hmm. I think I might know just the scientist to help me out with this. Time for me to visit Draynor Manor.
translation: 흠. 이 일을 도와줄 딱 맞는 과학자를 알 것 같아요. Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택)에 가 봐야겠네요.

english: What was that?
Oh nothing. I'd best be off, thank you for your time.
translation: 아, 아무것도 아니에요. 이만 가 볼게요. 시간 내 주셔서 고마워요.

english: Hello.
You again. You're not still after that key are you?
translation: 또 당신이군요. 설마 아직도 그 열쇠를 찾는 건 아니죠?

english: Nope, just stopping by to say hello.
Well that was great. See you later.
This gnome lady appears to be singing ... to her toads.
translation: 이 노움 아주머니는... 두꺼비들에게 노래를 불러 주고 있는 것 같다.

english: La La La, toadies in their holeys! ..Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
translation: 랄랄라, 구멍 속 두꺼비들아! ..어머 안녕하세요, 미처 못 봤네요.

english: Hello, Whatdo you do here?
I look after the toads and worms. They are very useful in gnome cooking, don't you know.
translation: 두꺼비랑 벌레를 돌보고 있어요. 노움 요리에 아주 쓸모가 많거든요, 아시잖아요.

english: Does singing to the toads help them grow?
translation: 두꺼비한테 노래를 불러 주면 잘 자라나요?

english: Don't be silly, I just sing to pass the time while looking after them!
translation: 별소리를 다 하시네요. 돌보는 동안 심심해서 부르는 것뿐이에요!

english: Of course...
Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾으셨지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않으신 것 같네요! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요해요!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미안하지만 미리 만들어 둔 요리는 안 돼요. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 얼로프트)의 손님께는 손수 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울리거든요.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Sarble
translation: 주문받은 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]을(를) Sarble(사블)에게 건넨다

english: Thank you kindly, you might want to grab some toads and worms while you are here.
translation: 정말 고마워요. 온 김에 두꺼비랑 벌레도 좀 챙겨 가세요.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰 크레딧이 [number]점 있습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰 받아 가는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었어요! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가서 주문을 새로 받으세요. 더는 필요 없으니 배달 상자를 버린다.

english: Welcome to my store, human! Are you interested in buying anything?
translation: 어서 오세요, 인간 손님! 뭐 사실 거 있으세요?

english: Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
No thanks.
Yes, I'm looking for some armour.
No thanks.
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
translation: 외지인과는 말할 수 없소! Brundt(브룬트) 족장에게 가 보시오!

english: You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
translation: 그들이 당신을 너무 경계하고 있어서 훔칠 만큼 가까이 다가갈 수 없다.

english: Do you know any council members?
I know that I am one.
Great! Can you vote for me at the council of elders for me to become a Fremennik?
translation: 잘됐네요! 제가 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 될 수 있게 장로 의회에서 찬성표를 던져 주실래요?

english: Sure. On one condition.
(sigh) What condition?
Actually there is no condition! I don't want to vote for you! You seem too gullible to be a Fremennik!
translation: 사실 조건 따윈 없소! 그대에게 표를 줄 생각이 없으니까! Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되기엔 너무 잘 속는 것 같구려!

english: It's kind of mean to trick me like that...
What do I care? I am a Fremennik and you are just some stupid outerlander! You stupid outerlander!
translation: 내 알 바 아니오! 나는 Fremennik(프레메닉)이고 그대는 그저 멍청한 외지인일 뿐이오! 멍청한 외지인 같으니!

english: Hello.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 다시 만나 반갑소, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 오늘은 내게 무엇이 필요하오? 언제든 내 도움을 믿어도 좋소!

english: Nothing thanks. I just fancied a chat.
translation: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 그냥 얘기 좀 하고 싶었어요.

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
translation: 내 도움이 필요하다면 내 문은 언제나 열려 있소, [Fremennik name].

english: [Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
translation: [Fremennik name]... 마지막으로 만난 지 너무 오래되었구려!

english: Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 돌아온 것을 환영하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. 여기서 그대를 보는 건 언제나 기쁜 일이오!

english: My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 미안하오, [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! 지금은 그대와 여기서 머뭇거릴 시간이 없소!

english: That's okay, I didn't really want anything.
translation: 괜찮아요, 딱히 볼일이 있었던 건 아니에요.

english: How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
translation: 어떻게 지내시오, [Fremennik name]? 오늘도 모든 일이 순조롭길 바라오!

english: I'm fine, thanks, how are you?
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
No, not really.
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어찌 내 물건을 훔칠 수 있소, [Fremennik name]?

english: You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 어째서 내 물건을 훔치려 한 것이오, [Fremennik name]?

english: How are you today?
**sigh**
That good? Everyone around here seems a little depressed.
translation: 그렇게 좋아요? 여기 사람들은 다들 좀 우울해 보이네요.

english: And not particularly talkative.
I'll leave you to your sighing. It looks like you have plenty to do.
translation: 계속 한숨 쉬시게 두고 갈게요. 할 일이 많아 보이네요.

english: It's a bit grey round here, isn't it?
It gets you down after a while, you know. There are 273 shades of grey, you know, and we have them all.
translation: 한참 지나면 기분이 가라앉소. 회색에도 273가지 색조가 있는데, 여기엔 그게 다 있다오.

english: That's grey-t.
That attempt at humour merely made me more depressed. Leave me alone.
translation: 그 어설픈 농담 때문에 더 우울해졌소. 날 좀 내버려 두시오.

english: How's the King treating you then?
Like serfs.
Serf?
Yes, you know - peons, plebs, the downtrodden. He treats us like his own personal possessions.
