Can I help you?
Do you have any quests for me?
I hear the Duke has a task for an adventurer. Otherwise, if you want to make yourself useful, there are always evil monsters to slay.
translation: Duke(공작)께서 모험가에게 맡길 일이 있다고 들었어요. 그게 아니더라도 쓸모 있는 사람이 되고 싶다면, 처치할 사악한 괴물은 언제나 있죠.

english: Okay, I might just do that.
Who are you?
I'm the Duke's advisor.
Can you give me any advice then?
translation: 그럼 저한테 조언 좀 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: I only advise the Duke. But if you want to make yourself useful, there are evil goblins to slay on the other side of the river.
translation: 저는 Duke(공작)께만 조언해요. 하지만 쓸모 있는 사람이 되고 싶다면, 강 건너편에 처치할 사악한 고블린들이 있어요.

english: Do you have any quests for me?
Who are you?
Hiya.
Hello outerlander. By the laws of our tribe, I am afraid I may not speak to you without the express permission of the chieftain.
translation: 어서 오시오, 외지인. 우리 부족의 법에 따라, 족장의 명시적인 허락 없이는 당신과 이야기할 수 없소.

english: Hello there!
Hello outerlander.
Are you a member of the council?
That I am outerlander; it is a position that brings my family and I pride.
translation: 그렇소, 외지인. 나와 내 가족에게 자랑이 되는 자리지.

english: I was wondering if I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
You wish to become a Fremennik? I may be persuaded to swing my vote to your favour, but you will first need to do a little task for me.
translation: Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되고 싶다는 거요? 설득만 잘하면 내 표를 당신 쪽으로 던질 수도 있겠지만, 먼저 나를 위해 작은 일을 하나 해 줘야 하오.

english: How did I know it wouldn't be that simple for your vote?
translation: 당신 표가 그렇게 쉽게 얻어지진 않을 줄 알았다니까요.

english: Calm yourself outerlander. It is but a small task really... I simply require a flower.
translation: 진정하시오, 외지인. 정말 작은 일이오... 꽃 한 송이만 있으면 되오.

english: A flower? What's the catch?
The catch? Well... it is not just any flower. Someone in this town has an extremely rare flower from a far off land that they picked up on their travels.
translation: 조건? 글쎄... 그냥 아무 꽃이 아니오. 이 마을의 누군가가 여행 중에 먼 나라에서 구해 온 아주 희귀한 꽃을 갖고 있소.

english: I would like you to demonstrate your merchanting skills to me, by persuading them to part with it, and then give it to me for my vote.
translation: 당신의 장사 수완을 보여 주시오. 그 사람을 설득해 꽃을 손에 넣은 다음, 내 표와 맞바꿔 나에게 주면 되오.

english: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...
translation: 음... 그렇게 어려울 것 같진 않네요...

english: Excellent! You will obtain this rare flower for me then?
translation: 훌륭하오! 그럼 그 희귀한 꽃을 구해 주겠소?

english: Okay. I don't think this will be too difficult. Any suggestions on where to start looking for this flower?
translation: 좋아요. 그렇게 어렵진 않을 것 같아요. 그 꽃을 어디서부터 찾아보면 좋을지 조언해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Ah, well outerlander, if I knew where to start looking I would simply do it myself!
translation: 아, 글쎄, 외지인. 어디서부터 찾아야 할지 알았다면 내가 직접 했을 거요!

english: No help at ALL?
translation: 정말 아무 도움도 안 주실 거예요?

english: We are a very insular clan, so I would not expect you to have to leave this town to find whatever you need.
translation: 우리는 아주 폐쇄적인 부족이라, 필요한 걸 찾으려고 이 마을을 떠날 필요는 없을 거요.

english: You know what? No. This all sounds like a lot of hassle to me, and frankly I just can't be bothered with it right now.
translation: 있잖아요? 됐어요. 너무 번거로운 일 같고, 솔직히 지금은 신경 쓸 여유가 없어요.

english: I'll go get someone else to vote for me.
As you wish outerlander. If you change your mind, come and see me again; I am very interested in getting my hands on that flower.
translation: 원하는 대로 하시오, 외지인. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오시오. 나는 그 꽃을 꼭 손에 넣고 싶으니.

english: So... how goes it outerlander? Did you manage to obtain my flower for me yet? Or do you lack the necessary merchanting skills?
translation: 그래... 어떻게 되어 가오, 외지인? 내 꽃은 구했소? 아니면 장사 수완이 부족한 거요?

english: I'm still working on it... Do you have any suggestion where to start looking for it?
translation: 아직 찾고 있어요... 어디서부터 찾아보면 좋을지 조언 좀 해 주실래요?

english: I suggest you ask around the other Fremennik in the town. A good merchant will find exactly what their customer needs somewhere.
translation: 마을의 다른 Fremennik(프레메닉)에게 물어보시오. 훌륭한 상인이라면 손님이 원하는 걸 어디선가 정확히 찾아내는 법이오.

english: Here's that flower you wanted.
Incredible! Your merchanting skills might even match my own! I have no choice but to recommend you to the council of elders!
translation: 놀랍군! 당신의 장사 수완은 나와 맞먹을지도 모르겠소! 원로회에 당신을 추천하지 않을 수가 없구려!

english: Hello again outerlander! I am amazed once more at your apparent skill at merchanting!
translation: 다시 만났구려, 외지인! 당신의 장사 솜씨에 또 한 번 감탄했소!

english: So I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 그럼 원로회에서 당신 표를 기대해도 되는 거죠?

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your merchanting skills will be a real boon to the Fremennik.
translation: 물론이오, 외지인. 당신의 장사 수완은 Fremennik(프레메닉)에게 큰 도움이 될 거요.

english: Greetings again brother [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you this day?
translation: 다시 반갑소, 형제 [Fremennik name]! 오늘은 무엇을 도와주면 되겠소?

english: Can I see your wares?
Certainly, [Fremennik name].
Nothing thanks.
Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [Fremennik name]. You are always welcome here!
translation: 언제든 원할 때 들르시오, [Fremennik name]. 당신은 언제나 환영이오!

english: Yes
No
Can I see your wares?
Nothing thanks.
We didn't mean it to go wrong, you know...
Hello there.
Ha Ha! Hello!
Who are you?
I'm Sigurd the Great and Brainy.
Why do they call you the Great and Brainy?
Because I invented the Log Canoe!
Log Canoe?
Yeash! Me and my cousins were having a great party by the river when we decided to have a game of 'Smack The Tree'
translation: 그래쉬! 나랑 사촌들이 강가에서 신나게 파티를 하다가 '나무 패기' 게임을 하기로 했지

english: Smack the Tree?
It's a game were you take it in turnsh shmacking a tree. First one to uproot the tree winsh!
translation: 돌아가면서 나무를 쌔리는 게임이야. 나무를 먼저 뿌리째 뽑는 놈이 이기는 거쥐!

english: Anyway, I won the game with a flying tackle. The tree came loose and down the river bank I went, still holding the tree.
translation: 아무튼, 내가 몸을 날린 태클로 게임에서 이겼지. 나무가 뽑히면서 나도 나무를 끌어안은 채 강둑 아래로 굴러떨어졌어.

english: I woke up a few hours later and found myself several miles down river. And thatsh how I invented the log canoe!
translation: 몇 시간 뒤에 깨어 보니 강 하류로 몇 마일이나 떠내려와 있더라고. 그렇게 해서 내가 통나무 카누를 발명한 거쥐!

english: So you invented the 'Log Canoe' by falling into a river hugging a tree?
translation: 그러니까 나무를 끌어안고 강에 빠져서 'Log Canoe(통나무 카누)'를 발명했다는 거예요?

english: Well I refined the design from the original you know!
translation: 뭐, 원래 거에서 디자인을 개량하긴 했다고!

english: I cut all the branches off to make it more comfortable. I could tell you how to if you like?
translation: 더 편하라고 가지를 다 쳐냈지. 원하면 만드는 법을 알려 줄까?

english: No thanks, not right now.
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 음, 넌 카누를 만들 실력이 없어 보이는데.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 카누를 만들 수 있게 되면 강을 따라 훨씬 빨리 다닐 수 있지!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 정말 간단해. 저기 강둑에 있는 나무로 가서 베어 넘기기만 하면 돼.

english: Then take your axe to it and shape it how you like!
translation: 그다음에 도끼로 원하는 대로 다듬으면 끝이야!

english: You can make a log canoe like mine! It'll get you 1 stop down the river.
translation: 나처럼 통나무 카누를 만들 수 있겠어! 그걸 타면 강 하류로 한 정거장 갈 수 있지.

english: There's some snooty fella down near the Champions Guild who reckons his canoes are better than mine. He's never said it to my face though.
translation: Champions Guild(챔피언 길드) 근처에 거만한 녀석이 하나 있는데, 자기 카누가 내 것보다 낫다고 떠들더라고. 내 앞에서 대놓고 말한 적은 없지만.

english: You could make a Dugout canoe with your woodcutting skill, but I don't see why you would want to.
translation: 네 woodcutting(벌목) 실력이면 Dugout canoe(마상이 카누)를 만들 수 있겠는데, 왜 그걸 만들고 싶은지는 모르겠다.

english: Well, you're pretty handy with an axe!
translation: 오, 도끼 좀 쓸 줄 아는구먼!

english: You could make Stable Dugout canoes, like that snooty fella Tarquin.
translation: 그 거만한 녀석 Tarquin(타퀸)처럼 Stable Dugout canoes(튼튼한 마상이 카누)를 만들 수 있겠어.

english: He reckons his canoes are better than mine. He's never said it to my face though.
translation: 그 녀석은 자기 카누가 내 것보다 낫다고 떠들어. 내 앞에서 대놓고 말한 적은 없지만.

english: You look like you know your way around a tree, you can make a Waka canoe.
translation: 나무 좀 다룰 줄 아는 것 같은데, Waka canoe(와카 카누)를 만들 수 있겠어.

english: What's a Waka?
I've only ever seen Hari using them. People say he's found a way to canoe the river underground and into the Wilderness
translation: Hari(하리)가 쓰는 것만 봤어. 사람들 말로는 그 친구가 강을 따라 지하로 해서 Wilderness(황야)까지 카누를 타고 가는 길을 찾았대

english: Hari hangs around up near Edgeville
translation: Hari(하리)는 저 위쪽 Edgeville(에지빌) 근처에서 어슬렁거려

english: He's a nice bloke.
Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 카누 타기에 대해 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Hello there.
Can't you see that I'm busy here?
Oh. Sorry, you don't look very busy.
translation: 아. 죄송해요, 별로 바빠 보이지 않아서요.

english: Don't look busy? I've got a lot of important work to do here.
translation: 안 바빠 보인다고? 여기서 할 중요한 일이 산더미야.

english: Really? What do you do?
That doesn't concern you. What are you doing here anyway?
translation: 네가 알 바 아니야. 그런데 넌 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: I'm not actually sure.
Hmph! Well I can tell you what you ARE doing.
translation: 흥! 그럼 네가 지금 뭘 하고 있는지는 내가 알려 주지.

english: What's that?
Wasting my time! Now go away! If you must speak to someone, speak to one of the other monks around here!
translation: 내 시간을 낭비하고 있는 거지! 이제 꺼져! 꼭 누구랑 얘기해야겠으면 여기 있는 다른 수도사들한테나 가!

english: I'm on an important quest!
Really...
Yes! Do you want to know what my quest is?
translation: 네! 제 퀘스트가 뭔지 알고 싶어요?

english: Let me see...you helped out a trader who in turn asked you to deliver something for him, and then you had to journey to some palace to see someone and they said thanks by sending you somewhere else.
translation: 어디 보자... 어떤 상인을 도와줬더니 그 상인이 뭘 좀 배달해 달라고 했고, 그다음엔 무슨 궁전까지 가서 누굴 만났더니 그 사람이 고맙다면서 또 다른 데로 보냈겠지.

english: Uhh...
So, now you've ended up down here, bothering me?
translation: 그래서 결국 여기까지 와서 날 귀찮게 하는 거고?

english: Uh, yes, that's about right.
Lucky me...
Sorry about that. I'll leave you alone, then.
None of your business!
Of course it isn't, but you were the one who came here bothering me! So, unless you want something, be off with you!
translation: 당연히 네 말대로 상관할 일은 아니지. 하지만 날 귀찮게 하러 온 건 너잖아! 그러니 볼일 없으면 썩 꺼져!

english: I am looking for something.
And what are you looking for exactly?
The Chaos Altar, I think.
Hmph! Well, it's just a bit further down. Now, if you don't mind, I'm very busy here!
translation: 흥! 그건 조금만 더 내려가면 있어. 이제 괜찮다면, 난 아주 바쁘거든!

english: I'm the leader of the Dagon'hai. Bow before me!
translation: 나는 Dagon'hai(다곤하이)의 지도자다. 내 앞에 무릎 꿇어라!

english: You? Leader of the Dagon'hai? Hah! I've never heard of such rubbish! You call yourself a mage?
translation: 네가? Dagon'hai(다곤하이)의 지도자? 하! 그런 헛소리는 처음 듣는군! 그러고도 네가 마법사라고?

english: I'm a very powerful mage!
Really?
Yes! Be afraid! Be very afraid! Ha ha ha!
I see. Well then, let's see how you handle this!
translation: 알겠어. 그럼 이것도 한번 감당해 보시지!

english: The player either dances, headbangs or jumps for joy
translation: 플레이어가 춤을 추거나, 헤드뱅잉을 하거나, 기뻐서 펄쩍 뛴다

english: Argh! I can't stop [dancing/headbanging/jumping]!
Hah! I knew you were no mage! Let that be a lesson to you! Now, please leave.
translation: 하! 마법사가 아닐 줄 알았지! 이걸로 교훈 좀 얻으라고! 이제 제발 좀 가.

english: Argh!
So! You are a good mage! You deflected my spell.
translation: 이런! 제법 실력 있는 마법사로군! 내 주문을 튕겨 내다니.

english: Hah! Yes. I told you so! Now, I have work to be done.
translation: 하! 그렇다. 내가 말했잖나! 이제 나는 할 일이 있다.

english: Of course. Goodbye!
No, you're right. I'm not a mage.
I didn't think so! Now go away. As I said, I'm very busy!
translation: 그럴 줄 알았어! 이제 가. 말했잖아, 난 아주 바쁘다고!

english: Hello.
Oh, it's you again. What are you doing here?
translation: 아, 또 너야? 여기서 뭐 하는 거야?

english: I'm not actually sure.
I'm on an important quest!
None of your business!
I am looking for something.
I'm the leader of the Dagon'hai. Bow before me!
translation: 나는 Dagon'hai(다곤하이)의 지도자다. 내 앞에 무릎 꿇어라!

english: I'm a very powerful mage!
No, you're right. I'm not a mage.
You! Time for some questions.
translation: 당신! 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be serving the will of Ralos.
translation: 사람들이 저를 잘못 보고 있다는 걸 늘 알고 있었습니다. 제가 더 높은 목적을 위해 쓰일 거라는 것도요. 그게 무엇인지는 상관없었습니다. 그렇게 함으로써 Ralos(랄로스)의 뜻을 받들 수 있다는 것만이 중요했지요.

english: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be granted a place in Mictl.
translation: 사람들이 저를 잘못 보고 있다는 걸 늘 알고 있었습니다. 제가 더 높은 목적을 위해 쓰일 거라는 것도요. 그게 무엇인지는 상관없었습니다. 그렇게 함으로써 Mictl(믹틀)에 자리를 얻을 수 있다는 것만이 중요했지요.

english: Who do you worship?
I have served Ralos my whole life. I am his humble servant. It was he who guided me here so that I may serve his will.
translation: 저는 평생 Ralos(랄로스)를 섬겨 왔습니다. 저는 그분의 비천한 종입니다. 그분의 뜻을 받들도록 저를 이곳으로 이끄신 것도 그분이십니다.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 말해 줘요.

english: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world so that he and Ranul can build a new one.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)은 끝이자 시작입니다. Ralos(랄로스)께서 성스러운 불로 이 세상을 멸하시고, 그분과 Ranul(라눌)께서 새로운 세상을 세우실 때입니다.

english: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)은 끝이자 시작입니다. Ralos(랄로스)께서 성스러운 불로 이 세상을 멸하시는 때입니다. 그 후 그분과 Ranul(라눌)께서 우리를 Mictl(믹틀)로 인도하실 겁니다.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 말해 줘요.

english: Nilsal. Looking to buy some fine silks?
translation: Nilsal(닐살)이에요. 질 좋은 비단 좀 사 가실래요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
You're missing out, but suit yourself.
translation: 손해 보시는 거예요. 뭐, 마음대로 하세요.

english: You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!
translation: 내 물건 훔쳐 간 게 당신이군요! 경비병! 경비병!

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.
translation: 전 비단을 사요. 비단을 팔고 싶으면 언제든 여기로 가져오세요.

english: Hello. I have some fine silk from far away to sell to you.
translation: 안녕하세요. 먼 곳에서 온 질 좋은 비단을 팔고 싶은데요.

english: Ah I may be interested in that. What sort of price were you looking at per piece of silk?
translation: 아, 그거라면 관심이 있겠네요. 비단 한 필에 얼마를 생각하고 계세요?

english: 20 coins.
Ok suits me.
80 coins.
80 coins? That's a bit steep! How about 40 coins?
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
Done.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
You'll never get that much for it. I'll be generous and give you 50 for it.
translation: 그 값은 절대 못 받아요. 인심 써서 50 드리죠.

english: Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
You drive a hard bargain, but I guess that will have to do.
translation: 흥정이 세시네요. 그래도 뭐, 그렇게 해야겠죠.

english: 200 coins.
Don't be ridiculous! That is far too much. You insult me with that price.
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 너무 비싸잖아요. 그런 값을 부르다니 모욕적이네요.

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 내 물건을 훔쳐 간 게 바로 당신이군요!

english: Guards guards!
20 coins.
80 coins.
Ok, 40 sounds good.
50, and that's my final price.
No, that is not enough.
120 coins.
Ok, I guess 50 will do.
I'll give it to you for 60.
200 coins.
Do you want to buy any fine silks?
How much are they?
3 gp.
No. That's too much for me.
2 gp and that's as low as I'll go.
translation: 2 gp. 더 이상은 못 깎아 드려요.

english: I'm not selling it for any less. You'll probably go and sell it in Varrock for a profit, anyway.
translation: 그보다 싸게는 안 팔아요. 어차피 Varrock(바록)에 가져가서 이윤 남기고 팔 거잖아요.

english: 2 gp sounds good.
Oh dear. I don't have enough money.
Well, come back when you do have some money!
No, really. I don't want it.
Okay, but that's the best price you're going to get.
translation: 알겠어요. 하지만 그보다 좋은 값은 어디서도 못 받을 거예요.

english: Okay, that sounds good.
No. Silk doesn't suit me.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon(아반 피츠하몬)이라는 남자를 찾고 있어요.

english: Can't say as I've seen him... I'm sure if he's been to Al-Kharid recently someone around here will have though.
translation: 본 적은 없는 것 같네요... 최근에 Al-Kharid(알 카리드)에 왔었다면 여기 누군가는 봤을 거예요.

english: How much are they?
No. That's too much for me.
2 gp sounds good.
No, really. I don't want it.
Okay, that sounds good.
No. Silk doesn't suit me.
I'm in search of a man named Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: Avan Fitzharmon(아반 피츠하몬)이라는 남자를 찾고 있어요.

english: Silver! Silver! Best prices for buying and selling in all Kandarin!
translation: 은이요, 은! Kandarin(칸다린)에서 제일 좋은 값에 사고팔아요!

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Are you Erin?
That I am. What do you want? You realise I'm working here.
translation: 맞아요. 무슨 일이죠? 저 지금 일하는 중이거든요.

english: This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?
translation: 오래 걸리진 않을 거예요. 증조할아버지에 대해 좀 여쭤보고 싶어서요. 전초기지에 사셨던 분이요.

english: What's it to you?
I'm doing some research for a man called Jorral. Apparently the King is going to make the outpost into his very own alchemists' lab.
translation: Jorral(조랄)이라는 분을 위해 조사를 하고 있어요. 듣자 하니 왕이 전초기지를 자기 전용 연금술사 실험실로 만들 거래요.

english: That can only cause chaos! Well, my great Grandfather lived and died there according to my mother, but even she knows very little about him.
translation: 그럼 난리가 날 게 뻔해요! 음, 어머니 말로는 증조할아버지가 거기서 살다 돌아가셨대요. 그런데 어머니도 그분에 대해서는 아는 게 거의 없어요.

english: I see.
The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.
translation: 제가 가진 그분 물건이라곤 열쇠 하나뿐이에요. 이상한 열쇠인데, 들고 돌아다니면 저절로 온도가 바뀌어요. 그런데 어디에 쓰는 건지는 저도 몰라요.

english: No idea at all?
Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.
translation: 글쎄요, 문 열쇠치고는 너무 작으니까 아마 그분 소지품이 든 상자 같은 걸 여는 거겠죠. 그분 물건을 좀 찾아보면 그 속에서 단서를 발견할지도 몰라요.

english: It's better than nothing. Will you lend it to me then?
translation: 없는 것보단 낫네요. 그럼 그거 빌려주실래요?

english: Why not. I can't use it anyway. Try feeling its change in temperature as you walk around.
translation: 그러죠 뭐. 어차피 전 못 쓰니까요. 돌아다니면서 온도가 어떻게 바뀌는지 느껴 보세요.

english: Wait, look how much you're carrying! You can't carry this too.
translation: 잠깐, 짐이 그렇게 많아서야! 이것까지는 못 들어요.

english: I haven't found anything yet.
Keep trying. Have you noticed that the key changes temperature as you walk around?
translation: 계속 찾아보세요. 돌아다니면 열쇠 온도가 바뀌는 거 눈치챘어요?

english: I'll see what I can find once I take it off my key ring.
translation: 열쇠고리에서 빼고 나면 뭘 찾을 수 있는지 볼게요.

english: That's kind of hard because I lost the key.
translation: 그게 좀 어려운 게, 열쇠를 잃어버렸거든요.

english: Liar. You stored it somewhere, didn't you!
I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it! Take it and don't lose it.
translation: 그 말 할 줄 알았어요. 방금 제가 찾았거든요! 가져가세요. 이번엔 잃어버리지 말고요.

english: I found a chest, but I lost it and any contents it had.
translation: 상자를 찾았는데, 안에 든 것까지 몽땅 잃어버렸어요.

english: Well I suggest you go back to where you found it.
translation: 그럼 찾았던 곳으로 다시 가 보세요.

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it!
translation: 그 말 할 줄 알았어요. 방금 제가 찾았거든요!

english: I found a chest
I wonder what is inside.
Would you like to see the journal I have found?
Let's have a look.
Erin reads the journal.
Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.
translation: 아주 흥미롭네요. 전초기지에 있는 Jorral(조랄)에게 보여 주는 게 좋겠어요.

english: I was just about to. Do you want the key back?
translation: 안 그래도 그러려던 참이에요. 열쇠는 돌려드릴까요?

english: Keep it, it may come in handy.
Hello again.
Hello, I hope Jorral was pleased with that Journal.
translation: 안녕하세요. Jorral(조랄)이 그 Journal(일지)를 마음에 들어 했으면 좋겠네요.

english: I'm sure it's been a valuable find.
What I came to ask was: I lost that key you gave me.
translation: 제가 여쭤보려던 건요, 주셨던 열쇠를 잃어버렸어요.

english: Oh dear, luckily I found it, but it'll cost you 500gp as I know it's valuable.
translation: 저런, 다행히 제가 찾았어요. 그런데 귀한 물건인 걸 아니까 500gp는 받아야겠어요.

english: You don't have enough money, sorry.
You don't have the space to carry it! Empty some space in your inventory.
translation: 들고 갈 자리가 없네요! 소지품을 좀 비우세요.

english: Thank you, enjoy!
No thanks.
You know you can use that enchanted key you have on your keyring all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 열쇠고리에 있는 그 enchanted key(마법이 걸린 열쇠), Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 쓸 수 있다는 거 알죠? 뭘 찾게 될지 누가 알겠어요?

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you've got stored? You can use it all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 보관해 둔 그 enchanted key(마법이 걸린 열쇠) 있잖아요? Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 쓸 수 있어요. 뭘 찾게 될지 누가 알겠어요?

english: You know you can use that enchanted key you have all over Gielinor. Who knows what you might find?
translation: 가지고 있는 그 enchanted key(마법이 걸린 열쇠), Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 쓸 수 있다는 거 알죠? 뭘 찾게 될지 누가 알겠어요?

english: Oh, You know that key you gave me?
Yes?
It dissolved!
Really? I suppose it served its purpose.
translation: 정말요? 제 할 일은 다 했나 보네요.

english: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 새 세금에 대해 알려 드리러 왔어요.

english: New taxes? What are you on about?
The king has called for a tax on luxury items. Your stall is included.
translation: 왕께서 사치품에 세금을 매기라고 하셨어요. 당신 노점도 포함이에요.

english: Well that is unacceptable! I will have to increase my prices. I've produced silver for the king himself before but don't expect me to do that again!
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 값을 올릴 수밖에 없겠네요. 전에 왕한테 직접 은 제품을 만들어 바친 적도 있는데, 다시는 그럴 거라고 기대하지 마세요!

english: As you wish, but you'll still need to pay. Your first instalment will be collected soon.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 그래도 세금은 내셔야 해요. 첫 납부금은 곧 걷으러 올 거예요.

english: The king wouldn't send a mourner to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: 왕이 이런 걸 전하라고 mourner(애도자)를 보낼 리가 없잖아요. 썩 꺼져요!

english: The king wouldn't send a citizen to tell me this. Clear off!
translation: 왕이 이런 걸 전하라고 시민을 보낼 리가 없잖아요. 썩 꺼져요!

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Ask about the outpost.
No thanks.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 새 세금에 대해 알려 드리러 왔어요.

english: Hello there, are you interested in buying one of my special capes?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 특별한 망토 하나 사 보실래요?

english: What's so special about your capes?

Ahh well they make it less likely that you'll accidently attack anyone wearing the same cape as you and easier to attack everyone else. They also make it easier to distinguish people who're wearing the same cape as you
translation: 아, 그게요, 같은 망토를 두른 사람은 실수로 공격할 일이 줄고 나머지는 더 쉽게 공격할 수 있게 해 줘요. 또 같은 망토를 두른 사람을

english: from everyone else. They're very useful when out in the wilderness with friends or anyone else you don't want to harm.
translation: 다른 사람들과 더 쉽게 구별할 수 있게 해 주고요. 친구나 해치고 싶지 않은 사람들과 wilderness(황야)에 나갈 때 아주 유용해요.

english: So would you like to buy one?
No thanks.
What's so special about your capes?
Yes please!
No thanks.
I can't believe we've finally arrived, I can't wait to explore!
translation: 드디어 도착했다니 믿기지 않아요. 얼른 탐험하고 싶어요!

english: So much to see, I don't know where to start!
translation: 볼 게 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작해야 할지 모르겠어요!

english: A whole new continent to explore... what a time to be
translation: 탐험할 완전히 새로운 대륙이라니... 정말 살맛 나는

english: Are you the tour guide?
Nope, I'm just as lost as you.
I overheard someone mention there are pirates and thieves here, be careful!
translation: 여기 해적이랑 도둑이 있다고 누가 그러는 걸 들었어요. 조심하세요!

english: Hello.
G'day, mate. I'm Simon - Simon Templeton. Who are you?
translation: 안녕, 친구. 난 Simon(사이먼), Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴)이야. 넌 누구야?

english: I'm [player name]. What are you doing all the way out here?
translation: 전 [player name](이)라고 해요. 이런 외딴 데서 뭐 하세요?

english: I've been contracted to retrieve artefacts from the top of this magnificent pyramid.
translation: 이 멋진 피라미드 꼭대기에서 유물을 가져오기로 계약했지.

english: So, why are you down here and not up there then?
translation: 그럼 왜 저 위가 아니라 여기 아래에 계세요?

english: Well, it's me back - an old injury I picked up in Sophanem has come back to haunt me. I was working for the Museum of Varrock, and the gold I had been given wasn't enough to pay for the carpet rides, let
translation: 그게, 허리 때문이야. Sophanem(소파넴)에서 얻은 옛날 부상이 도져서 말이지. 그땐 Museum of Varrock(바록 박물관) 일을 하고 있었는데, 받은 돈으로는 카펫 탈 값도 안 됐어. 쓸 만한

english: alone any decent equipment. But that was a long time ago... I can't even lift a chisel right now. There's no way I can climb all the way up there.
translation: 장비는 말할 것도 없고. 하지만 그건 오래전 일이고... 지금은 끌조차 못 들어. 저기 꼭대기까지 올라가는 건 어림도 없지.

english: How on earth did you get down the cliff face, then?
That's what set off the injury. I was fine before I scrabbled down that pesky slope. I think it will be a while before I can climb back up again; I must be getting old.
translation: 그게 부상이 도진 원인이야. 그 망할 비탈을 허겁지겁 내려오기 전까진 멀쩡했거든. 다시 올라가려면 한참 걸릴 것 같아. 나도 늙었나 봐.

english: Hang on a second... You look like you're pretty agile and up for a challenge. How about you retrieve it for me?
translation: 잠깐만... 너 꽤 날렵해 보이고 도전도 마다하지 않을 것 같은데. 네가 대신 가져다주는 건 어때?

english: I'll tell you what, I'll give you 10000 coins for every artefact you get for me.
translation: 이렇게 하자. 유물 하나 가져올 때마다 10000코인씩 줄게.

english: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 제가 할 수 있는 만큼 해 볼게요.

english: Good on ya, mate!
Hello, Simon.
G'day, [player name].
How's it going?
Not bad, mate, not bad at all. Got any artefacts for me?
translation: 나쁘지 않아, 친구. 전혀 나쁘지 않지. 나 줄 유물 좀 있어?

english: No, I haven't.
Try harder, mate! It won't be long till some other critter turns up and snatches them out from under your eyes.
translation: 더 열심히 해 봐, 친구! 곧 다른 놈이 나타나서 네 눈앞에서 낚아채 갈 거라고.

english: I will, goodbye.
Bye, cobber.
Ripper! Thanks a bundle, mate! Thanks to you I can fulfill me contract. You're a true blue! The boss will be pleased.
translation: 끝내준다! 정말 고마워, 친구! 네 덕분에 계약을 지킬 수 있겠어. 넌 진짜배기야! 보스가 좋아하겠어.

english: Glad I was able to help... but who is your boss? I thought you worked for the museum?
translation: 도움이 됐다니 다행이에요... 그런데 보스가 누구예요? 박물관에서 일하시는 줄 알았는데요?

english: Mind your own bizzo, mate. But if you get any more, you know where I am!
translation: 네 일이나 신경 써, 친구. 그래도 더 구하면 내가 어디 있는지 알지?

english: I have one, but I want to keep it for now.
translation: 하나 있긴 한데, 당분간은 갖고 있을래요.

english: Careful, mate, people might come looking for a thing like that!
translation: 조심해, 친구. 그런 물건이면 찾으러 오는 사람이 있을지도 몰라!

english: Thanks for the advice, but I'll hang onto it for now.
translation: 충고 고마워요. 그래도 당분간은 제가 갖고 있을게요.

english: I have some, but I want to keep them for now.
translation: 몇 개 있긴 한데, 당분간은 갖고 있을래요.

english: G'day, mate. Got any new pyramid artefacts for me?
translation: 어이, 친구. 나 줄 새 피라미드 유물 좀 있어?

english: Well, keep my offer in mind if you do find one.
translation: 그래, 혹시 하나 찾으면 내 제안 잊지 마.

english: I will. Goodbye, Simon.
Bye, mate.
I have some interesting artefacts I'd like you to look at.
translation: 한번 봐 주셨으면 하는 흥미로운 유물이 있어요.

english: Bonzer! Let's have a Butcher's mate.
translation: 끝내주네! 어디 한번 구경 좀 해 보자고, 친구.

english: Do you want to flog the lot of 'em?
Yes, show me the money.
Fair Dinkum mate, Bonzer doing business with you mate.
translation: 좋았어, 친구. 너랑 거래해서 아주 끝내줬어.

english: You sellin' me this gold coloured stick thing. Looks fake to me.I'll give you 100 gold for it.
translation: 이 금색 막대기 같은 걸 나한테 팔겠다고? 내 눈엔 가짜 같은데. 100골드 쳐줄게.

english: What! This is a genuine pharaoh's sceptre - made out of solid gold and finely jewelled with precious gems by the finest craftsmen in the area.
translation: 뭐라고요! 이건 진짜 pharaoh's sceptre(파라오의 셉터)예요. 순금으로 만들고 이 지역 최고의 장인들이 귀한 보석을 정교하게 박아 넣은 거라고요.

english: Strewth! I can tell a pile of croc when I hear it! You've got the patter mate, but I'm no mug. That's a fake.
translation: 이런 젠장! 허풍인지 아닌지는 들으면 딱 알아! 말발은 좋다만, 난 호구가 아니야. 그건 가짜야.

english: It has magical powers!
Oh, magical powers ... yeah, yeah, yeah.  Heard it all before mate. I'll give you a 100 gold, or some 'magic beans'. Take it or leave it.
translation: 아, 마법의 힘... 그래, 그래, 그래. 그런 말 다 들어 봤어, 친구. 100골드 아니면 '마법의 콩' 좀 줄게. 싫으면 말고.

english: I don't think so! I'll find someone who'll give me what it's worth.
translation: 어림없어요! 제값 쳐줄 사람을 찾아볼 거예요.

english: Suit yerself.. You wanna sell the other artefacts you have?
translation: 맘대로 해.. 갖고 있는 다른 유물은 팔래?

english: Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.
Nah, I've changed my mind.
No, let me think about it.
No probs mate. Just give me the items you want to sell and we can do them one by one.
translation: 문제없어, 친구. 팔고 싶은 물건을 주면 하나씩 처리해 주지.

english: You wanna sell that mate?
Cheers mate!
No, I think I'll keep it.
That's a nice looking artefact you got there mate. Gimme a chat and lemme explain what these are all about first!
translation: 멋진 유물을 갖고 있네, 친구. 먼저 나랑 얘기 좀 하자고. 이게 다 뭔지 설명해 줄 테니까!

english: Oh, magical powers ... yeah, yeah, yeah. Heard it all before mate. I'll give you a 100 gold, or some 'magic beans'. Take it or leave it.
translation: 아, 마법의 힘... 그래, 그래, 그래. 그런 말 다 들어 봤어, 친구. 100골드 아니면 '마법의 콩' 좀 줄게. 싫으면 말고.

english: Suit yerself..
Sell it.
Keep it.
Sell them.
Keep them.
Yes, show me the money.
Yes, as long as I get a decent price for them.
Nah, I've changed my mind.
No, let me think about it.
No, I think I'll keep it.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어머, 영웅님이시네요! 와! 정말 대단해요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우셨어요? 마을도 정말 예뻐졌어요. 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Simona, I'm trying to stay warm by this fire.
translation: 전 Simona(시모나)예요. 이 불 옆에서 몸을 녹이고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어 살면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 곧 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강에 있는 신전까지 갈 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고, 다들 정말 고마워하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분 사람들이 보기엔 당신이 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Augh! Your sins! They BLIND me!
translation: 으악! 네 죄악이! 눈이 멀 것 같아!

english: I'm looking for the Sin Seer.
Are you another one of those 'holier than thou' fools wanting to redeem themselves?
translation: 너도 속죄하겠다고 찾아오는 '고결한 척하는' 바보 중 하나냐?

english: Uh, no actually, I'm trying to join a really evil guy's team.
translation: 어, 아뇨. 사실 엄청 사악한 사람의 편에 들어가려고 해요.

english: Really? Finally, something worthwhile.
translation: 정말? 드디어 쓸 만한 게 왔네.

english: It was fun messing with those devotees the first few times but, after a while, condemning people to an eternity of damnation gets a bit dull.
translation: 처음 몇 번은 그 신도들 놀려 먹는 게 재밌었는데, 시간이 지나니까 사람들을 영원한 저주에 빠뜨리는 것도 좀 지겹더라고.

english: So, whom are you trying to hook up with? Dark priest? Warlord? Penguin?
translation: 그래서, 누구랑 손잡으려고? 어둠의 사제? 군벌? Penguin(펭귄)?

english: Uh, I want to prove to General Khazard I'm trustworthy.
translation: 어, General Khazard(카자드 장군)한테 제가 믿을 만하다는 걸 증명하고 싶어요.

english: Oh, that old fart? Is he still around? Humph. I dunno if I can be bothered.
translation: 아, 그 늙다리 영감? 아직도 살아 있어? 흥. 굳이 해 줘야 하나 모르겠네.

english: What if I pay you for the trouble - would you then? I can't imagine you make much money, seeing people's sins and all.
translation: 수고비를 드리면 해 주실래요? 사람들 죄를 보는 일로는 돈도 별로 못 버실 것 같은데요.

english: Oh, there's money in it. I just don't get invited to many parties.
translation: 아, 돈벌이는 돼. 그냥 파티에 초대를 잘 못 받을 뿐이지.

english: You got me all excited about evil plots, and now it's just a matter of trust. I really can't be bothered to strain myself on that account.
translation: 사악한 음모 얘기로 잔뜩 기대하게 해 놓고, 고작 믿을 만한지 아닌지 문제라니. 그런 일로 애쓸 마음은 정말 안 생기네.

english: Fine, you don't actually have to see my sins, just pronounce me to be trustworthy. I'll pay you and be on my way.
translation: 좋아요. 제 죄를 실제로 보실 필요는 없어요. 그냥 믿을 만하다고만 선언해 주세요. 돈 드리고 제 갈 길 갈게요.

english: He'll know it's a lie. But I do need the cash, so I'll do it. Gimme 40 gold coins and you'll be as trustworthy as a newborn.
translation: 그 사람은 거짓말인 걸 알 거야. 그래도 돈이 필요하니까 해 주지. 40골드 내면 갓난아기만큼 믿을 만하게 만들어 줄게.

english: Here's the money.
Fine. I declare you trustworthy, if you consider bribing a seer a trustworthy transaction.
translation: 좋아. 너를 믿을 만한 자로 선언한다. 예언자에게 뇌물 주는 걸 믿을 만한 거래라고 친다면 말이지.

english: Give this note to Khazard, it will prove you have been to see me.
translation: 이 쪽지를 Khazard(카자드)한테 줘. 나를 만났다는 증거가 될 거야.

english: PLEASE! I want to know what he's up to.
translation: 제발요! 그가 뭘 꾸미는지 알고 싶어요.

english: Ooooh, you're going to learn of his plans and stab him in the back?
translation: 오오, 그 녀석 계획을 알아내서 뒤통수를 치려고?

english: Absolutely.
Fine, give me 40 gold coins and I'll take a look at your sins.
translation: 좋아, 40골드 내면 네 죄를 한번 봐 주지.

english: You have done many great deeds...but many terrible deeds. Sometimes you do them by accident, but are still sins. No, I would not trust you to walk my dog.
translation: 넌 위대한 일도 많이 했지만... 끔찍한 짓도 많이 했어. 가끔은 실수로 저지른 거지만, 그래도 죄는 죄야. 아니, 너한텐 내 개 산책도 못 맡기겠어.

english: Whatcha lookin' at chicken legs? Don't you have a General you should speak to?
translation: 뭘 봐, 이 닭다리 같은 놈아? 가서 얘기할 장군이 있지 않냐?

english: I lost the note.
You already have one. Get on with you!
translation: 이미 하나 갖고 있잖아. 썩 가 봐!

english: Here ya go. Take more care of it this time.
translation: 자, 여기. 이번엔 좀 잘 챙겨.

english: Bribe
Here's the money.
Never mind.
Plead
Yes, I should get to that.
BARK
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게. 자격이 있는 것 같군. 우리를 도와주러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게! 자네가 얼마 전에 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 세 개를 모두 통과한 그 학생이지? 우리를 도와주러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 어서 오게, [sir/madam]. 우리 일을 좀 거들어 주러 왔나?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 먼저 장비부터 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 공구 선반에 있지. Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험에서 배운 걸 활용하게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 부츠를 착용하고, 다음 도구들도

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: 챙겨야 하네: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔).

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 정말로 우리를 돕고 싶다면 발굴품 손질을 좀 해 주게. 대부분 끝났고 마무리 손질만 조금 남았네. 인부들이 가져오는 더미에서 발굴품을 하나 가져가게. 그러면 저쪽에 남는 탁자가 있으니

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 거기서 손질하면 되네. 흥미로운 걸 찾으면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 흥미롭군... 그래... 그래... 흐음.... 마법이 걸려 있는 것 같네.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 아, 그냥 해롭지 않은 순간이동 주문인 것 같네. 고고학 일을 안 할 때는 마법을 좀 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 더 만드는 법을 가르쳐 주지. 그 옛날에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍군.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠... 모든 정황상 여기서 동쪽 어딘가인 것 같은데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠군. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었을지도 모르지. 좀 더 자세히 살펴보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고 fire runes(불 룬) 다섯 개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 한 개로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거죠.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 닦았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 이럴 수가! 정말 멋진 발견이야! 내 생각이 맞다면, 이걸로 Dig Site(발굴 현장) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠네.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여기 보게, 도시 이름도 적혀 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! Saradominist(사라도민파) 점령기의 것이 틀림없네. 정말 멋진 발견이야. 가져가서 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 다시 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 전에 이미 하나 보여 줬잖나. 그건 상태가 더 좋았지. 저기 진열장에 있네. 이건 구석에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣으면 되네.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 아주 오래된 동전을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이거 정말 흥미롭군... 동시에 혼란스럽기도 하고. 이 동전이 뜻하는 건, 우리가 Digsite(발굴 현장)에서 발굴 중인 도시 Saranthium(사란시움)에 사실 훨씬 더 이전에 Zamorak(자모락) 추종자들이 살았다는 거라네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 그 당시 이 도시는 Senntisten(센티스텐)이라고 불렸지.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견이네. Saradominists(사라도민파)가 차지하기 전에 Zarosian(자로스파) 추종자들이 살았다는 증거는 이미 있지만, Zamorakian(자모락파) 세력도 어떤 전투

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 중에 이곳을 사용했던 것 같군. 어쨌든 이걸로 이 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 Zamorak(자모락)을 따르다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르게 된 시기를 대략 알 수 있네. display case(진열장) 44번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 다시 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 display case(진열장) 44번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 이 바스러질 듯한 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아... 제단 장식 같군. 흠, 그래... 보아하니 초기 Saradominist(사라도민파) 신자들의 것이야. 꽤 섬세하기도 하고. display case(진열장) 37번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 다시 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 display case(진열장) 37번에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 이 아주 오래된 장식을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않나? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이군. 틀림없이 Saradominist(사라도민파) 도시의 것이야. display case(진열장) 36번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 다시 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 display case(진열장) 36번에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 도자기 조각을 찾았어요. 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 아... 오! 흠... 그래... 보아하니 Zaros(자로스) 신자들이 만든 거군. 모양이 아름다워. display case(진열장) 22번에 잘 어울리겠네. 이 조각은 이 도시를

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: Saradominists(사라도민파)보다 먼저 Zarosians(자로스파)가 점령했다는 우리 증거를 뒷받침해 주네.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 다시 왔나? pottery(도자기)는 display case(진열장) 22번에 넣었나?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오지. 중요한 건 아니네. 전시품에도 이미 몇 개 있고. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 상자에 이미 뭔가 들어 있으면 수고의 대가로 마음껏 가져가게.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 흥미로운 발견이군... 자, 보답으로 이걸 주지.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병이라... 몇 개나 찾았는지 셀 수도 없네... 완전히 멀쩡한 건 이미 진열장에 있는 하나뿐이고. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Who are you?
My name iz Vlad. I come from far avay, vere the sun iz not so bright.
translation: 내 이름은 Vlad(블라드)라오. 해가 그리 밝지 않은 머언 곳에서 왔쏘.

english: You're a vampyre aren't you?
Just because I can't stand ze smell ov garlic und I don't like bright sunlight doesn't necessarily mean I'm ein vampyre!
translation: 마늘 냄쌔를 못 견디고 밝은 햇빛을 싫어한다고 해서 꼭 내가 뱀파이어라는 뜻은 아니오!

english: Is it nice there?
It is vonderful! Ze beautiful und ze nights are long!
translation: 아주 멋찐 곳이오! 아름답고, 밤이 길다오!

english: So... you like fishing?
My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I  am stressed I tend to get ein little...
translation: 의사가 마음을 편히 하는 취미를 가지라고 했쏘. 스트레스를 받으면 내가 쪼금...

english: ..thirsty.
If you get thirsty you should drink something.
translation: 목이 마르면 뭘 좀 마시면 되잖아요.

english: I tsink I may do zat soon...
Well, good luck with the fishing.
Luck haz notsing to do vith it it iz all in ze technique.
translation: 운은 아무 상관 업쏘. 다 기술이오.

english: I think you will find that is my spot.
Can't you go to another spot?
I like this place. I like to savour the aroma coming from these pipes.
translation: 나는 이 자리가 좋소. 이 파이프에서 풍기는 냄새를 음미하는 걸 좋아하오.

english: Arghh! WHAT is that GHASTLY smell??? I think I will mover over here instead...
translation: 으악! 이 끔찍한 냄새는 대체 뭐요??? 저쪽으로 옮겨야겠소...

english: Uurrggh! Get zat horrible tsing avay from me! How do people like to eat zat stuff? I can't stand even to be near it for tsen zeconds!
translation: 우웩! 그 끔찍한 걸 치워 주씨오! 사람들은 대체 어떻게 그런 걸 먹는 거요? 난 열 초도 곁에 못 있겠쏘!

english: Umm... sorry
Who are you?
You're a vampyre aren't you?
Is it nice there?
So you like fishing?
So... you like fishing?
If you get thirsty you should drink something.
translation: 목이 마르면 뭘 좀 마시면 되잖아요.

english: Well, good luck with the fishing.
Hello Sir Amik.
Hello, friend!
Well [player name], now that you are a White Knight, I expect you should be out there hunting Black Knights for us!
translation: 자, [player name] 님, 이제 White Knight(백기사)가 되셨으니 밖에 나가 우리를 위해 Black Knights(흑기사)를 사냥하셔야겠지요!

english: Sadly we are not as rich as we once were, and there are many White Knights who foolishly lose their combat equipment.
translation: 안타깝게도 우리는 예전만큼 부유하지 않은 데다, 어리석게도 전투 장비를 잃어버리는 White Knights(백기사)가 많습니다.

english: We do not think it fair to make a profit from our brethren, so we will sell you equipment at cost, and rebuy it at the same cost, but we will only sell equipment to those we consider responsible enough to
translation: 우리 형제들에게서 이익을 남기는 건 공정하지 않다고 생각하기에, 장비를 원가에 팔고 같은 값에 되사 드립니다. 다만 장비는 책임감 있게 그것을

english: wield it correctly.
translation: 제대로 다룰 수 있다고 여기는 이에게만 판매합니다.

english: By killing Black Knights, you will increase your reputation with us, by killing White Knights we will obviously think less of you.
translation: Black Knights(흑기사)를 처치하면 우리에게서 얻는 평판이 오르고, White Knights(백기사)를 처치하면 당연히 우리는 당신을 낮게 보게 됩니다.

english: You can check your White Knight reputation level by looking at your quest journal for the Wanted! Quest, or Sir Vyvin will let you know what level you are at when you go to purchase equipment.
translation: White Knight(백기사) 평판 레벨은 Wanted!(현상수배!) 퀘스트의 퀘스트 일지에서 확인할 수 있고, 장비를 사러 가면 Sir Vyvin(바이빈 경)이 당신의 레벨을 알려 줄 겁니다.

english: Sir Vyvin can be found in Falador Castle, and he will sell you any equipment appropriate to your reputation level.
translation: Sir Vyvin(바이빈 경)은 Falador Castle(팔라도르 성)에 있으며, 평판 레벨에 맞는 장비라면 무엇이든 팔 겁니다.

english: Have fun, and go kill some Black Knights for me!
translation: 즐겁게 지내시고, 나 대신 Black Knights(흑기사)를 좀 처치해 주십시오!

english: Okay Amik, thanks for explaining!
translation: 알겠어요, Amik(아믹) 님. 설명해 주셔서 고마워요!

english: Okay, bye!
Okay, 'bye then Amik!
Can you explain the White Knight honour system again?
translation: White Knight(백기사) 명예 제도를 다시 설명해 주실 수 있나요?

english: May I help you?
I'm really just looking for a quest...
Fortune favours us both then adventurer. I suggest you go and speak to King Arthur.
translation: 그렇다면 우리 둘 다 운이 좋구려, 모험가여. King Arthur(아서 왕)을 찾아가 말씀드려 보시오.

english: Merlin's in a crystal. Little help?
translation: Merlin(멀린)이 크리스탈 속에 갇혔어요. 좀 도와주실래요?

english: That is what we were hoping for from you, adventurer!
translation: 그게 바로 우리가 그대에게 바라던 바요, 모험가여!

english: Hmmm. Well, ok, thanks anyway.
I don't suppose you have any idea how to break into Mordred's fort do you?
translation: 혹시 Mordred(모드레드)의 요새에 쳐들어갈 방법을 아시는 건 아니죠?

english: I am afraid not. Would that we could! Mordred and his cronies have been thorns in our side for far too long already!
translation: 안타깝게도 모르오. 할 수만 있다면 얼마나 좋겠소! Mordred(모드레드)와 그 일당은 너무도 오랫동안 우리의 눈엣가시였소!

english: Ok. Thanks. See you later!
Take care adventurer, Mordred is an evil and powerful foe.
translation: 조심하시오, 모험가여. Mordred(모드레드)는 사악하고 강력한 적이오.

english: Know anything about Excalibur?
Um... it's a really good sword?
translation: 음... 아주 좋은 검이라는 것 정도?

english: Know where I can find it?
Nope, sorry.
All Knights of the Round thank you for your assistance in this trying time for us.
translation: Knights of the Round(원탁의 기사) 모두가 이 힘겨운 시기에 그대가 베푼 도움에 감사하고 있소.

english: You are looking for the Grail now adventurer?
translation: 이제 Grail(성배)를 찾고 있는 것이오, 모험가여?

english: Absolutely.
The best of luck to you! Make the name of Camelot proud, and bring it back to us.
translation: 행운을 비오! Camelot(카멜롯)의 이름을 빛내고, 성배를 우리에게 가져와 주시오.

english: How did you let a bunch of Black Knights get the better of you? I thought you guys were the toughest knights around.
translation: 어쩌다 Black Knights(흑기사) 무리한테 당하신 거예요? 기사님들이 이 근방에서 제일 강한 줄 알았는데요.

english: We are true knights who fight for honour. Those Black Knights didn't fight fair, so we were unprepared. Most unchivalrous of them.
translation: 우리는 명예를 위해 싸우는 진정한 기사요. 그 Black Knights(흑기사)가 비겁하게 싸우는 바람에 미처 대비하지 못했던 것이오. 참으로 기사답지 못한 놈들이오.

english: If we break out of this cell, do you reckon you can take on the Black Knights in the keep?
translation: 이 감방에서 나가면 성채에 있는 Black Knights(흑기사)를 상대하실 수 있겠어요?

english: You just let me at them. We'll see how they like surprise attacks.
translation: 나만 그놈들 앞에 세워 주시오. 기습당하는 기분이 어떤지 그놈들도 한번 맛보게 해 주겠소.

english: How are you going to get all of us out of here?
translation: 우리 모두를 어떻게 여기서 빼낼 생각이오?

english: I'm not sure yet. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 아직 잘 모르겠어요. 주머니에 쓸 만한 물건 같은 거 있으세요?

english: Thanks.
I already gave you everything I had in my pockets.
translation: 주머니에 있던 건 이미 다 그대에게 주었소.

english: Let me out! Let me out, I say!
translation: 꺼내 주시오! 어서 꺼내 달란 말이오!

english: Give me an R. Give me an O. Give me a U..
translation: 다 같이 외쳐요! R! O! U!..

english: In the amount of time it will take you to spell out Round Table Knights, you could have found the Grail.
translation: Round Table Knights(원탁의 기사)를 한 글자씩 다 외칠 시간이면 Grail(성배)를 찾고도 남았겠소.

english: What am I supposed to do with that?
Thank you for your assistance in our time of need.
translation: 우리가 곤경에 처했을 때 도와주어 고맙소.

english: You're welcome.
Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: 안녕하세요, 성기사님. 이 아래에서 다른 사람을 만날 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?
translation: 우리 역시 그렇소, 여행자여. 이토록 불경한 곳에서 무엇을 하고 있소?

english: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.
translation: King Lathas(라타스 왕)의 명령으로 이 동굴을 안전하게 지나갈 길을 찾고 있어요.

english: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.
translation: 아, 국왕께서 우리에게도 같은 임무를 맡기셨소. 안타깝게도 조금 더 가면 Iban(이반)의 거대한 문이 있소. 온갖 방법을 다 써 봤지만 들어갈 수가 없었소.

english: Anyway, you've done well to get this far traveller. Here eat...
translation: 어쨌든 여기까지 온 것만 해도 대단하오, 여행자여. 자, 이걸 드시오...

english: Great, thanks a lot.
Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: 또 만났구려, 여행자여. 이곳을 떠나는 게 좋겠소. 여기 일은 우리에게 맡기시오.

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
Good day to you [sir/madam]!
Good day.
Know you of any quests sir knight?
The king is the man to talk to if you want a quest.
translation: 퀘스트를 원한다면 국왕 폐하께 말씀드려 보시오.

english: I think you've done the main quest we were on right now...
translation: 우리가 지금 맡고 있던 중요한 퀘스트는 그대가 이미 끝낸 것 같소...

english: Good day.
Know you of any quests sir knight?
Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: 안녕하세요, 성기사님. 이 아래에서 다른 사람을 만날 줄은 몰랐어요.

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
Good morrow [madam/sirrah]!
Morning. Know where an adventurer has to go to find a quest around here?
translation: 안녕하세요. 모험가가 퀘스트를 찾으려면 이 근처에서 어디로 가야 하는지 아세요?

english: An adventurer eh? There is no service finer than serving the bountiful King Arthur, and I happen to know there's an important quest to fulfill.
translation: 모험가라고? 너그러우신 King Arthur(아서 왕) 폐하를 섬기는 것보다 훌륭한 일은 없소. 마침 해내야 할 중요한 퀘스트가 있다는 것도 알고 있소.

english: Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 기사여! Merlin(멀린)이 다시 자유를 되찾도록 도와주어 정말 고맙소!

english: We owe you a great debt for freeing us from that dungeon.
translation: 그 지하 감옥에서 우리를 구해 주었으니 그대에게 큰 빚을 졌소.

english: Awww, shucks. It was nothing.
A valiant effort!
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Greetings! I am Sir Lancelot, the greatest Knight in the land! What do you want?
translation: 반갑소! 나는 이 땅에서 가장 위대한 기사, Sir Lancelot(랜슬롯 경)이오! 무슨 용무요?

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
I have every right to be proud of myself.
translation: 나는 나 자신을 자랑스러워할 자격이 충분하오.

english: My prowess in battle is world renowned!
translation: 전장에서의 내 무용은 온 세상에 널리 알려져 있소!

english: I seek a quest!
Leave questing to the professionals.
Such as myself.
Sir Knight! Many thanks for your assistance in restoring Merlin to his former freedom!
translation: 기사여! Merlin(멀린)이 다시 자유를 되찾도록 도와주어 정말 고맙소!

english: Humph. You are indeed a better knight than I first suspected.
translation: 흠. 그대는 내가 처음 생각했던 것보다 확실히 나은 기사로군.

english: Gee, it was nothing saving you all from the clutches of Morgan Le Faye and freeing your King.
translation: 에이, Morgan Le Faye(모건 르 페이)의 손아귀에서 기사님들을 전부 구하고 국왕 폐하까지 풀어 드린 건 별것 아니었어요.

english: You're a little full of yourself aren't you?
I seek a quest!
AH-HA HA HA! You can NEVER defeat ME! I am blessed by Saradomin himself! NO BLADE MAY DEFEAT ME!
translation: 아-하하하! 넌 절대로 날 이길 수 없다! 난 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 친히 축복하신 몸이다! 그 어떤 칼날도 날 쓰러뜨릴 수 없다!

english: No blade may defeat me!
translation: 그 어떤 칼날도 날 쓰러뜨릴 수 없다!

english: Hello there adventurer.
I'm looking for a quest...
Talk to the King then adventurer. He is always looking for men of bravery to aid him in his actions.
translation: 그렇다면 국왕 폐하께 말씀드려 보시오, 모험가여. 폐하께서는 늘 일을 도울 용감한 이들을 찾고 계시오.

english: Congratulations on freeing Merlin!
That was a grand adventure. I can see why you make it your profession.
translation: 정말 굉장한 모험이었소. 그대가 왜 그 일을 업으로 삼는지 알겠구려.

english: I think you should stick to being a knight.
translation: 기사님은 그냥 기사 일을 계속하시는 게 좋겠어요.

english: Hello there adventurer, what do you want of me?
translation: 어서 오시오, 모험가여. 내게 무슨 볼일이오?

english: I'd like some advice on finding a quest.
translation: 퀘스트를 찾는 데 조언을 좀 얻고 싶어요.

english: I do not know of any myself... but it would perhaps be worth your while asking the King if he has any tasks for you.
translation: 나 자신은 아는 것이 없소... 하지만 국왕 폐하께 그대에게 맡길 일이 있는지 여쭤보는 것도 좋을 것이오.

english: After your help freeing Merlin, my help is the least I can offer as a man of honour.
translation: Merlin(멀린)을 풀어 주는 데 도움을 받았으니, 명예를 아는 사람으로서 도움을 주는 것은 당연한 일이오.

english: Nothing right now, but I'll bear it in mind. Thanks.
I was glad to get my revenge on those knights in the keep. They were no match for us.
translation: 성채에 있던 그 기사들에게 복수할 수 있어서 기뻤소. 그놈들은 우리의 상대가 되지 못했소.

english: Makes you wonder how they kidnapped you in the first place.
translation: 그럼 애초에 어떻게 납치를 당하셨는지 궁금해지네요.

english: Greetings adventurer and welcome to the museum!
translation: 어서 오세요, 모험가님. 박물관에 오신 걸 환영합니다!

english: The museum has been constructed thanks to the efforts of adventurers across Gielinor, feel free to explore this floor or one below at your leisure.
translation: 이 박물관은 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳의 모험가들이 애써 준 덕분에 세워졌어요. 이 층이나 아래층을 마음껏 둘러보세요.

english: Can you tell me about this museum?
Certainly.
This museum was built as a monument to Gielinor and contains exhibits which showcase the wonders of the world brought to light by adventurers such as yourself.
translation: 이 박물관은 Gielinor(길리노르)를 기리는 기념물로 지어졌고, 모험가님 같은 분들이 세상에 알린 경이로운 것들을 보여 주는 전시품이 있어요.

english: This floor was built some time ago but due to popular demand and some recent contributions the floor below has also been opened up for display.
translation: 이 층은 꽤 오래전에 지어졌지만, 많은 분의 요청과 최근의 기부 덕분에 아래층도 전시 공간으로 열게 됐어요.

english: While we no longer require any contributions we'll happily take any unwanted excess that you may have.
translation: 이제 더 기부를 받을 필요는 없지만, 필요 없는 남는 물건이 있다면 기꺼이 받을게요.

english: I'd like to contribute towards the museum.
Hmm, it appears you don't have anything on you to contribute. Come back if you do.
translation: 흠, 지금 기부할 만한 물건을 갖고 계시지 않네요. 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Could you tell me the current progress towards finishing the museum?
translation: 박물관이 완성되기까지 지금 진행 상황이 어떤지 알려 주실래요?

english: The museum is finished! Feel free to enter if you have the time.
translation: 박물관이 완성됐어요! 시간이 되시면 마음껏 들어가 보세요.

english: Feel free to explore this floor at your leisure while the floor below is under construction.
translation: 아래층은 공사 중이니, 그동안 이 층을 마음껏 둘러보세요.

english: This floor was built some time ago and is not as accurate as it once was.
translation: 이 층은 꽤 오래전에 지어져서 지금은 예전만큼 정확하지 않아요.

english: Now, due to popular demand, the knights of Falador have decided to expand upon the displays to ensure that it includes all discoveries which have been made in recent years.
translation: 그래서 많은 분의 요청에 따라 Falador(팔라도르)의 기사들이 최근 몇 년간 이루어진 발견을 모두 담도록 전시를 확장하기로 했어요.

english: Unfortunately we lack the man power to acquire all of the resources required to build the displays.
translation: 안타깝게도 전시물을 만드는 데 필요한 자원을 전부 구할 일손이 부족해요.

english: We'd appreciate it if you could donate any materials you find on your adventures.
translation: 모험하시다가 재료를 발견하시면 기부해 주시면 감사하겠어요.

english: I'd be happy to help. I'll keep an eye out for any useful materials.
translation: 기꺼이 도울게요. 쓸 만한 재료가 있는지 눈여겨볼게요.

english: The knights of Falador appreciate your support.
I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
I understand, you adventurers are busy folk. If you change your mind make sure to let me know.
translation: 알겠어요, 모험가분들은 바쁘시니까요. 마음이 바뀌시면 꼭 말씀해 주세요.

english: Marvelous! What would you like to contribute?
You make a contribution to the museum expansion.
We appreciate your contribution. Do make sure to come back once the museum has been expanded and check out the exhibits!
translation: 기부해 주셔서 감사해요. 박물관이 확장되면 꼭 다시 오셔서 전시품을 구경해 주세요!

english: Of course. Here's the progress made so far.
Ask about the museum.
Hand-in materials.
Check Progress.
I'd be happy to help.
I'll pass, I don't have time to help.
Greetings to the court of King Arthur!
translation: King Arthur(아서 왕)의 궁정에 온 것을 환영하오!

english: Hello. I'm looking for a quest. Who should I talk to?
translation: 안녕하세요. 퀘스트를 찾고 있는데, 누구에게 말하면 될까요?

english: King Arthur will let you know. I believe he has a quest at the moment.
translation: King Arthur(아서 왕) 폐하께서 알려 주실 것이오. 지금 맡길 퀘스트가 있으신 것 같소.

english: You are a very talented Knight indeed to have freed Merlin so quickly. You have all of our gratitude.
translation: 그토록 빨리 Merlin(멀린)을 풀어 주다니 그대는 참으로 재능 있는 기사요. 우리 모두 그대에게 감사하고 있소.

english: I am proud to have you as a member of the Round Table.
translation: 그대를 Round Table(원탁)의 일원으로 맞게 되어 자랑스럽소.

english: Thank you.
You missed all the excitement!
I got here and agreed to take over duties as king here, then before my eyes the most miraculous changes occured here... grass and trees were growing outside before our very eyes!
translation: 내가 이곳에 와서 왕의 직무를 맡기로 하자마자, 눈앞에서 참으로 기적 같은 변화가 일어났소... 바로 우리 눈앞에서 바깥에 풀과 나무가 자라나기 시작한 것이오!

english: Thank you very much for showing me the way home.
translation: 집으로 돌아오는 길을 알려 주어 정말 고맙소.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please tell me your answer.
Nope, Go check again!
Spot on!
Hello. I've heard you stopped the demon, well done.
translation: 안녕하신가. 자네가 그 악마를 막았다고 들었네. 잘했네.

english: Yes, that's right.
A good job well done then.
Thank you.
Yes, although I'm afraid I've lost Silverlight.
translation: 네, 그런데 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 잃어버린 것 같아요.

english: Yes, news of your carelessness is almost as widespread as knowledge of your victory. Fortunately for you, Silverlight has come back into my possession.
translation: 그래, 자네의 승리만큼이나 자네의 부주의함도 널리 소문이 났다네. 다행히도 Silverlight(실버라이트)는 다시 내 손에 들어왔지.

english: Phew, that's a relief.
Is there any chance of me borrowing it again?
I'm not going to give it away that easily again, it's far too important to be treated so disrespectfully. Especially now its powers have increased after your fight with Agrith-Naar!
translation: 이번에는 그렇게 쉽게 내주지 않을 걸세. 그렇게 함부로 다뤄도 될 만큼 하찮은 물건이 아니야. 특히 자네가 Agrith-Naar(아그리스나르)와 싸운 뒤로 그 힘이 더 커졌으니 말일세!

english: If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 1000 gold pieces. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: Silverlight(실버라이트)를 다시 쓰고 싶다면 1000골드를 내게. 그래야 좀 더 잘 간수하겠지.

english: No way, it's not worth that much.
translation: 말도 안 돼요, 그만한 가치는 없어요.

english: Ok, I'll pay.
May you make good use of it.
But I don't have that much money.
You don't even have enough free space to carry it. Stop wasingmy time!
translation: 그걸 넣을 빈자리조차 없지 않나. 내 시간 낭비하게 하지 말게!

english: Hello, who are you?
I am a mighty adventurer, who are you?
I am Sir Prysin. A bold and famous knight of the realm.
translation: 나는 Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)일세. 이 왕국의 용맹하고 이름 높은 기사지.

english: I was hoping you could tell me.
Well I've never met you before.
translation: 글쎄, 난 자네를 만난 적이 없네만.

english: Aris said I should come and talk to you.
Aris? Is she still alive? I remember her from when I was pretty young. Well what do you need to talk to me about?
translation: Aris(아리스)? 그 사람이 아직 살아 있나? 내가 꽤 어렸을 때 알던 사람인데. 그래, 나와 무슨 얘기를 하고 싶은 겐가?

english: I need to find Silverlight.
What do you need to find that for?
I need it to fight Delrith.
Delrith? I thought the world was rid of him, thanks to my great-grandfather.
translation: Delrith(델리스)? 내 증조부님 덕분에 세상에서 그놈이 사라진 줄 알았는데.

english: Well Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: 그런데 Aris(아리스)의 수정 구슬은 그렇게 생각하지 않는 것 같아요.

english: Well if the ball says so, I'd better help you.
The problem is getting Silverlight.
You mean you don't have it?
Oh I do have it, but it is so powerful that the king made me put it in a special box which needs three different keys to open it. That way it won't fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 아, 내게 있긴 있네. 하지만 너무 강력한 물건이라 국왕께서 서로 다른 열쇠 세 개가 있어야 열리는 특별한 상자에 넣어 두라고 하셨지. 그래야 엉뚱한 자의 손에 들어가지 않을 테니까.

english: So give me the keys!
Um, well, it's not so easy.
I kept one of the keys. I gave the other two to other people for safe keeping.
translation: 열쇠 하나는 내가 가지고 있고, 나머지 두 개는 다른 사람들에게 맡겨 두었네.

english: One I gave to Rovin, the captain of the palace guard.
I gave the other to the wizard Traiborn.
Can you give me your key?
Well there's a problem there as well.
I managed to drop the key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen. It is just inside and I can't reach it.
translation: 궁전 부엌 바로 바깥에 있는 배수구에 열쇠를 빠뜨리고 말았네. 바로 안쪽에 있는데 손이 닿지 않아.

english: So what does the drain connect to?
translation: 그럼 그 배수구는 어디로 이어져 있어요?

english: It is the drain for the drainpipe running from the sink in the kitchen down to the palace sewers.
translation: 부엌 개수대에서 궁전 하수도로 내려가는 배수관에 연결된 배수구일세.

english: Well I'd better go key hunting.
Ok, goodbye.
Where can I find Captain Rovin?
translation: Captain Rovin(로빈 대장)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Captain Rovin lives at the top of the guards' quarters in the north-west wing of this palace.
translation: Captain Rovin(로빈 대장)은 이 궁전 북서쪽 별관에 있는 경비대 숙소 꼭대기 층에 산다네.

english: Where does the wizard live?
Wizard Traiborn?
He is one of the wizards who lives in the tower on the little island just off the south coast. I believe his quarters are on the first floor of the tower.
translation: 남쪽 해안 바로 앞 작은 섬에 있는 탑에 사는 마법사 중 한 명일세. 그 친구 방은 탑 2층에 있을 걸세.

english: And why is this a problem?
He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: 그놈이 돌아왔고, 안타깝게도 제가 상대해야 해요.

english: You don't look up to much. I suppose Silverlight may be good enough to carry you through though.
translation: 자네는 별로 대단해 보이지 않는군. 그래도 Silverlight(실버라이트)가 있으면 어떻게든 해낼 수 있겠지.

english: Yes she is still alive. She lives right outside the castle!
translation: 네, 아직 살아 계세요. 성 바로 바깥에 사세요!

english: Oh, is that the same Aris? I would have thought she would have died by now. She was pretty old when I was a lad.
translation: 아, 그 Aris(아리스)가 맞나? 지금쯤이면 세상을 떠났을 줄 알았는데. 내가 어렸을 때도 꽤 나이가 많았거든.

english: Anyway, what can I do for you?
translation: 아무튼, 내가 무엇을 해 주면 되겠나?

english: So how are you doing with getting the keys?
I haven't found any of them yet.
Can you remind me where all the keys were again?
translation: 열쇠가 다 어디 있었는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: I'm still looking.
Ok, tell me when you've got them all.
I've got the key from Captain Rovin and the one that you dropped down the drain.
translation: Captain Rovin(로빈 대장)의 열쇠와 당신이 배수구에 빠뜨린 열쇠를 구했어요.

english: I've got all three keys!
Excellent! Now I can give you Silverlight.
translation: 훌륭하네! 이제 자네에게 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 줄 수 있겠군.

english: That sword belonged to my great-grandfather. Make sure you treat it with respect!
translation: 그 검은 내 증조부님의 것이었네. 반드시 소중히 다루게!

english: Now go kill that demon!
translation: 자, 이제 가서 그 악마를 처치하게!

english: Have you sorted that demon out yet?
Not yet. And I, um, lost Silverlight.
translation: 아직이요. 그리고 저, 음, Silverlight(실버라이트)를 잃어버렸어요.

english: Yes, I know, someone returned it to me. Take better care of it this time.
translation: 그래, 알고 있네. 누가 내게 돌려주었지. 이번엔 좀 더 잘 간수하게.

english: Where did all these zombies come from?
translation: 이 좀비들은 다 어디서 온 겐가?

english: It's an invasion by Zemouregal.
The gods preserve us!
Don't worry, I'm working on a plan to get rid of them.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 놈들을 없앨 계획을 세우고 있어요.

english: We're doomed!
You've come to the right place, well done!
Yes, that's right.
Yes, although I'm afraid I've lost Silverlight.
translation: 네, 그런데 Silverlight(실버라이트)를 잃어버린 것 같아요.

english: Phew, that's a relief.
Is there any chance of me borrowing it again?
No way, it's not worth that much.
translation: 말도 안 돼요, 그만한 가치는 없어요.

english: Ok, I'll pay.
I am a mighty adventurer. Who are you?
I'm not sure, I was hoping you could tell me.
translation: 잘 모르겠어요, 당신이 알려 주실 줄 알았는데요.

english: Aris said I should come and talk to you.
I need to find Silverlight.
Well, Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: 그런데 Aris(아리스)의 수정 구슬은 그렇게 생각하지 않는 것 같아요.

english: So give me the keys!
Can you give me your key?
So what does the drain lead to?
Where can I find Captain Rovin?
translation: Captain Rovin(로빈 대장)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Where does the wizard live?
Well I'd better go key hunting.
And why is this a problem?
He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: 그놈이 돌아왔고, 안타깝게도 제가 상대해야 해요.

english: Yes, she is still alive.
Can you remind me where all the keys were again?
translation: 열쇠가 다 어디 있었는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: I'm still looking.
Hello!
Can I have another shield?
translation: 방패를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Sir Rebral gives you another shield.
translation: Sir Rebral(레브랄 경)이 방패를 하나 더 건네준다.

english: Who are you?
I'm Sir Rebral of the White Knights and taskmaster for the Falador Achievement Diary.
translation: 전 White Knights(백기사)의 일원인 Sir Rebral(레브랄 경)이고, Falador Achievement Diary(팔라도르 업적 일지) 담당자예요.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In Falador and the surrounding area it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록해 두는 데 도움이 되는 일지예요. Falador(팔라도르)와 그 주변 지역에서는 꽤 유용한 것들을 발견하는 데 도움이 될 거예요. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이

english: reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 옆 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different shields of Falador, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
translation: 음, Falador(팔라도르) 방패는 네 종류가 있고, 네 가지 난이도에 각각 대응해요. 각 방패는 이전 단계의 보상을 모두 포함하고 추가 혜택도 있어요... 어느 단계의 보상에 대해

english: know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 쉬움 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Falador, the shield can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
translation: Falador(팔라도르)의 쉬움 과제를 모두 완료하면, 방패로 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 4분의 1만큼 회복할 수 있고, Burthorpe(버소프)에서 Chaos temple(혼돈의 신전)으로 가는 지름길을 이용할 수 있어요.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 보통 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, the shield can restore half of your prayer points once per day and provides a 10% experience boost at Falador farm. You'll get an increased chance of finding a clue scroll from a Guard
translation: 쉬움 보상에 더해, 방패로 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 절반 회복할 수 있고 Falador(팔라도르) 농장에서 경험치를 10% 더 얻어요. Guard(경비병)에게서 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 얻을 확률이 오르고

english: and can access a shortcut within the Motherlode Mine
translation: Motherlode Mine(마더로드 광산) 안의 지름길도 이용할 수 있어요

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 어려움 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the shield will restore all of your prayer points once per day, you can access a bank deposit box at the crafting guild and a shortcut to the Heroes' Guild fountain. The Giant
translation: 쉬움과 보통 혜택에 더해, 방패가 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 모두 회복해 주고, crafting guild(공예 길드)에서 bank deposit box(은행 예치함)을 이용할 수 있으며 Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드) 분수로 가는 지름길도 이용할 수 있어요.

english: mole becomes much easier to locate and it will drop noted skins and claws.
translation: Giant mole(거대 두더지)를 훨씬 쉽게 찾을 수 있게 되고, 가죽과 발톱을 노트 상태로 떨어뜨려요.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 엘리트 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, the tree patch in Falador park will never become diseased and the shield will restore all of your prayer points twice per day in addition to an increased chance at higher level
translation: 이전 단계의 보상에 더해, Falador park(팔라도르 공원)의 tree patch(나무 밭)이 절대 병들지 않고, 방패가 하루에 두 번 기도 점수를 모두 회복해 줘요. 게다가 Pay-dirt(광석 흙)을 세척할 때

english: ores from cleaning Pay-dirt.
translation: 더 높은 레벨의 광석이 나올 확률도 올라가요.

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Falador area so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Falador(팔라도르) 지역의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면, 저한테 와서 말을 걸어 보상을 받으세요.

english: Bye!
See you later.
I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Falador Achievement Diary!
translation: Falador Achievement Diary(팔라도르 업적 일지)의 쉬움 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
Yes please!
This shield is a symbol of your exploration of Falador. It can restore one quarter of your prayer points once per day and you can now access a shortcut to the Chaos temple from Burthorpe.
translation: 이 방패는 Falador(팔라도르) 탐험의 상징이에요. 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 4분의 1만큼 회복할 수 있고, 이제 Burthorpe(버소프)에서 Chaos temple(혼돈의 신전)으로 가는 지름길을 이용할 수 있어요.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your shield, come back to me to reclaim it.
translation: 방패를 잃어버리면 언제든 저한테 와서 다시 받아 가세요.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador achievement diary(팔라도르 업적 일지)의 보통 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. It can restore half of your prayer points once per day and provides a 10% experience boost at Falador farm. You've got an increased chance of finding a clue scroll
translation: Falador shield(팔라도르 방패)를 강화해 드렸어요. 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 절반 회복할 수 있고 Falador(팔라도르) 농장에서 경험치를 10% 더 얻어요. 또 Guard(경비병)에게서 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 얻을 확률이 오르고

english: from a Guard and can access a shortcut within the Motherlode Mine.
translation: Motherlode Mine(마더로드 광산) 안의 지름길도 이용할 수 있어요.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador achievement diary(팔라도르 업적 일지)의 어려움 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. It will restore all of your prayer points once per day, you can now access a bank deposit box at the crafting guild and a shortcut to the Heroes' Guild fountain. The Giant
translation: Falador shield(팔라도르 방패)를 강화해 드렸어요. 하루에 한 번 기도 점수를 모두 회복해 주고, 이제 crafting guild(공예 길드)에서 bank deposit box(은행 예치함)을 이용할 수 있으며 Heroes' Guild(영웅의 길드) 분수로 가는 지름길도 이용할 수 있어요.

english: mole should now be easier to locate and it will drop noted skins and claws.
translation: 이제 Giant mole(거대 두더지)를 더 쉽게 찾을 수 있고, 가죽과 발톱을 노트 상태로 떨어뜨릴 거예요.

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Falador achievement diary!
translation: Falador achievement diary(팔라도르 업적 일지)의 엘리트 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in Falador! Here's your reward!
translation: 그렇네요, 잘하셨어요! Falador(팔라도르)의 과제를 전부 완료하셨어요! 여기 보상이에요!

english: I've upgraded your Falador shield for you. The tree patch in Falador park will now never become diseased and the shield will restore all of your prayer points twice per day in addition to an increased chance at
translation: Falador shield(팔라도르 방패)를 강화해 드렸어요. 이제 Falador park(팔라도르 공원)의 tree patch(나무 밭)은 절대 병들지 않고, 방패가 하루에 두 번 기도 점수를 모두 회복해 줘요. 게다가

english: higher level ores from cleaning Pay-dirt.
translation: Pay-dirt(광석 흙)을 세척할 때 더 높은 레벨의 광석이 나올 확률도 올라가요.

english: Can I have another shield?
translation: 방패를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Hmm? What's that, young [man/woman]? What can I do for you?
translation: 흠? 무슨 일인가, 젊은 [man/woman]? 내가 뭘 해 주면 되겠나?

english: I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 글쎄요, 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있는데요?

english: Hmm, well, mmm, do you have a family crest? I keep track of every Gielinor family, you know, so I might be able to find yours.
translation: 흠, 그러니까, 음, 자네 가문 문장이 있나? 나는 Gielinor(길리노르)의 모든 가문을 기록하고 있다네. 그러니 자네 가문 것도 찾아 줄 수 있을지 모르지.

english: I'm also something of an, mmm, a painter. If you've met any important persons or visited any nice places I could paint them for you.
translation: 나는, 음, 화가이기도 하다네. 자네가 중요한 인물을 만났거나 멋진 곳에 가 봤다면 그걸 그려 줄 수 있지.

english: Can you see if I have a family crest?
translation: 제 가문 문장이 있는지 봐 주실 수 있나요?

english: What is your name?
[player name].
Mmm, [player name], let me see...
According to my records, your crest is [current family crest].
translation: 내 기록에 따르면 자네 가문의 문장은 [current family crest] 문장이로군.

english: Mmm, very well. Changing your crest will cost 5,000 coins.
I'll have to go get some.
Ah yes, the shield that you helped to retrieve. You have certainly earned the right to wear its symbol.
translation: 아, 그렇지, 자네가 되찾는 걸 도운 그 방패로군. 자네는 그 문장을 달 자격이 충분하네.

english: Ah, splendid, splendid. There is no better symbol than that of our fair land!
translation: 아, 훌륭하네, 훌륭해. 우리의 아름다운 땅의 문장보다 나은 건 없지!

english: Hmm, have you ever even met the Dorgeshuun? I don't think you should wear their symbol until you have made contact with that lost tribe.
translation: 흠, 자네 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)을 만나 보기라도 했나? 그 잃어버린 부족과 접촉하기 전까지는 그들의 문장을 달지 않는 게 좋겠네.

english: Ah yes, our new neighbours under Lumbridge. I hear you were the one who made contact with then, jolly good.
translation: 아, 그렇지, Lumbridge(럼브리지) 아래에 사는 우리 새 이웃들 말이군. 그들과 처음 접촉한 게 자네라고 들었네. 아주 잘했어.

english: I see you are a mighty dragon-slayer! You have certainly earned the right to wear a dragon symbol.
translation: 보아하니 자네는 위대한 드래곤 사냥꾼이로군! 드래곤 문장을 달 자격이 충분하네.

english: Hmm, mmm, yes, everyone likes pretty fairies.
translation: 흠, 음, 그래, 예쁜 요정은 누구나 좋아하지.

english: You do not seem to be very devoted to any god. I will not let you have a divine symbol unless you have level 70 prayer.
translation: 자네는 어떤 신에게도 그리 헌신하는 것 같지 않군. Prayer(기도) 레벨이 70은 돼야 신성한 문장을 내주겠네.

english: Guthix, god of balance! I'm a Saradominist myself, you know, but we all find meaning in our way, what?
translation: 균형의 신 Guthix(구식스)로군! 나야 Saradomin(사라도민) 신자지만, 다들 저마다의 방식으로 의미를 찾는 법 아니겠나?

english: Hmm, I'm not sure I like that HAM group, their beliefs are a little extreme for me. But if that's what you want.
translation: 흠, 그 HAM 단체는 썩 마음에 들지 않네. 내겐 그들의 신념이 좀 과격하거든. 하지만 자네가 원한다면야.

english: A horse? I know people talk about them, but I'm not at all sure they ever existed. I don't think I could let you use one as your symbol unless you can fetch me some kind of model of one.
translation: 말이라고? 사람들이 말 얘기를 하긴 하지만, 정말 존재했는지는 전혀 모르겠네. 말 모형 같은 거라도 구해 오지 않는 한 말을 문장으로 쓰게 해 줄 수는 없겠어.

english: A Jungle Ogre, eh? Odd beast, very odd.
translation: Jungle Ogre(정글 오우거)라, 그래? 이상한 짐승이지, 아주 이상해.

english: Our neighbours in the west? Very good, very good.
translation: 서쪽 이웃 말인가? 아주 좋네, 아주 좋아.

english: Ah, the fair land of Lumbridge and Varrock.
You wish to represent yourself by a moneybag? I think to make that meaningful I should increase the price to 500,000 coins. Do you agree?
translation: 돈주머니로 자네를 나타내고 싶다고? 그걸 의미 있게 하려면 가격을 500,000코인으로 올려야겠네. 동의하나?

english: All right.
But I'll have to go and fetch the money.
No way!
Well we can't have just any pauper using a money-bag as a symbol, can we? You'll have to choose a different symbol.
translation: 아무 빈털터리나 돈주머니를 문장으로 쓰게 둘 순 없지 않나? 다른 문장을 고르게.

english: Ah, the great god Saradomin! May he smile on your house as you adorn it with his symbol!
translation: 아, 위대한 신 Saradomin(사라도민)이시여! 그분의 문장으로 꾸민 자네 집에 그분께서 미소 지어 주시길!

english: A symbol of death? You do not seem like a killer to me; perhaps some other symbol would suit you better.
translation: 죽음의 상징이라고? 자네는 살인자처럼 보이지 않는데. 다른 문장이 더 어울릴 것 같군.

english: Of... of course you can have a skull symbol, sir/madam!
translation: 무, 물론이지요! 해골 문장을 쓰셔도 되고말고요!

english: Ah, Varrock, a fine city!
The god of Chaos? It is a terrible thing to worship that evil being. But if that is what you wish...
translation: 혼돈의 신 말인가? 그런 사악한 존재를 숭배하다니 끔찍한 일이네. 하지만 자네가 그걸 원한다면야...

english: Thanks!
You're welcome, my [boy/girl].
Can I buy a painting?
Would you like a portrait or an, mmm, a landscape? Or a map, maybe?
translation: 초상화가 좋겠나, 아니면, 음, 풍경화? 그것도 아니면 지도는 어떤가?

english: A portrait please.
Mmm, well, there are a few portraits I can paint. I can only let you have one if you've got some connection with that person though. Who would you like?
translation: 음, 그러니까, 내가 그릴 수 있는 초상화가 몇 가지 있네. 다만 그 인물과 어떤 인연이 있어야만 내줄 수 있지. 누구를 원하나?

english: That will be, mmm, 1000 coins please.
I don't have that much money on me.
There you go.
No thanks.
Well, mmm, maybe some other time, mmm?
translation: 그래, 음, 다음에 또 보세, 응?

english: A landscape please.
Mmm, well, I can paint a few places. Where have you had your adventures?
translation: 음, 그러니까, 몇몇 장소는 그릴 수 있네. 자네는 어디서 모험을 했나?

english: That will be, mmm, 2000 coins please.
A map please.
Mmm, yes, ah, I have painted maps of the known world on several different sizes of parchment.  Which size would you like?
translation: 음, 그래, 아, 알려진 세계의 지도를 여러 크기의 양피지에 그려 두었네. 어떤 크기로 하겠나?

english: Nothing thanks.
Mmm, well, see you some other time maybe.
I don't know, what can you do for me?
translation: 글쎄요, 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있는데요?

english: Can you see if I have a family crest?
translation: 제 가문 문장이 있는지 봐 주실 수 있나요?

english: I don't like that crest. Can I have a different one?
translation: 그 문장은 마음에 안 들어요. 다른 걸로 바꿀 수 있을까요?
