Be safe, traveller.
What's with the mask?
Tell me more about the Sisterhood.
What's going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: What happened to the tattooed man?
Bye!
Hey! What do you think you're doing? Leave my tea alone!
translation: 야! 지금 뭐 하는 짓이야? 내 차 건드리지 마!

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing? Don't go casting that kind of spell anywhere near my tea!  Leave my tea alone you telegrabbing fiend!
translation: 야! 지금 뭐 하는 짓이야? 내 차 근처에서 그런 주문 쓰지 마! 내 차 건드리지 말라고, 이 텔레그랩 쓰는 악당 놈아!

english: Oh, so you're back then, come to gloat have you?
translation: 오, 다시 왔구나. 비웃으러 온 거냐?

english: Nope, I've just come to ask you a couple of questions.
translation: 아니, 몇 가지 물어보러 왔을 뿐이야.

english: How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
Haven't I already explained this to you once before?
translation: 전에 한 번 설명해 주지 않았나?

english: Humour me!

Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again. The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's
translation: 좋아, 비슷한 주문이 전에도 걸린 적이 있는데, 그렇게 생겨난 생물을 처리하는 유일한 방법은 그 지역을 봉쇄하고 다시는 들어가지 않는 거야. 언데드 생물은 보통 어떤 질병을 옮기니까

english: best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
translation: 원거리 무기로 멀리서 공격하는 게 제일 좋아.

english: Normal missiles like arrows and darts do very little damage to them because they're designed to destroy internal organs. This is a waste of time with undead creatures like undead ogres.
translation: 화살이나 다트 같은 평범한 투사체는 그놈들한테 피해를 거의 못 줘. 내장을 파괴하도록 만들어진 거라서 말이지. 언데드 오우거 같은 언데드 생물한테는 시간 낭비야.

english: Yeah, clearly so what should we use?
translation: 그래, 그건 당연하지. 그럼 뭘 써야 하는데?

english: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature.
translation: 내 연구에 따르면 끝이 납작한 화살이 고안된 것 같더군. 'Brutal arrow(브루탈 화살)'라고 하는 거야. 그 생물한테 엄청난 분쇄 피해를 입히지.

english: You can make them by using larger arrows, I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
translation: 더 큰 화살로 만들 수 있어. Ogre(오우거) 사냥꾼 몇몇이 만드는 것 같더군. 다만 화살촉을 다는 대신, 화살대 끝에 큰 못을 망치로 박아 넣는 거야.

english: How do I get rid of the disease?
Haven't I already explained this disease thing to you once before?
translation: 그 질병 얘기도 전에 한 번 설명해 주지 않았나?

english: Just tell me again or else I'll turn you back into an ogre!
translation: 그냥 다시 말해, 안 그러면 너를 도로 오우거로 만들어 버릴 거야!

english: No...noo...please, I'll tell you.
My research shows that two jungle based herbs can be used, one is found near river tributaries and looks like a vine, the other is found in caves and grows on the wall.
translation: 내 연구에 따르면 정글에서 나는 약초 두 가지를 쓸 수 있어. 하나는 강 지류 근처에서 자라고 덩굴처럼 생겼고, 다른 하나는 동굴 벽에 붙어 자라.

english: It's quite well camouflaged so it's unlikely that you'll find it.
translation: 위장이 꽤 잘 돼 있어서 네가 찾아낼 가능성은 낮을 거야.

english: We'll see about that!
Sorry, I have to go.
How do I get rid of the undead ogres?
How do I get rid of the disease?
Sorry, I have to go.
Krrrrsssss
Krrrrsssss
Are you all right? You seem a little...incoherent.
Inc'hearnt? Inc'herant! You...you...with yer fancy book- lernin' words. You'd be more than inc'herant if youd seen...
translation: 두서? 두서업다고! 너...너...그 잘난 먹물 냄새 나는 유식한 말이나 써 가면서. 너도 봤더라면 두서고 뭐고 없었을 거다... 바로...

english: (Dramatic pause)
THEM!
I'm sure I would as well.
I'm going over here to talk to non-crazy people now.
translation: 저는 저쪽 가서 안 미친 사람들이랑 얘기할게요.

english: Yeah? Yeah? Well when THEY come floppin' into your house and eat your furniture you'll be sorry!
translation: 그래? 그래? 흥, 그놈들이 네 집에 퍼덕퍼덕 들어와서 가구를 먹어 치우면 후회할 거다!

english: Who are
(Dramatic pause)
THEY?
They! Those bloodthirsty, flesh-tearing devils! They are the reason I'm out here every day hurlin' bottles into the sea!
translation: 그놈들! 피에 굶주려 살을 찢어발기는 악마들! 내가 날마다 여기 나와서 바다에 병을 던지는 게 다 그놈들 때문이야!

english: They are the reason I've lost everything, except the horrifying memory of what THEY look like...
translation: 내가 모든 걸 잃은 것도 그놈들 때문이지. 남은 건 그놈들이 어떻게 생겼는지에 대한 끔찍한 기억뿐이야...

english: And what do THEY look like?
Mudskippers!
Mudskippers?
Aye, Mudskippers! Those ferocious, ravening, evil, beady-eyed terrors of the deep!
translation: 그래, Mudskippers(말뚝망둥어)! 그 사납고, 굶주리고, 사악하고, 눈알 번득이는 심해의 공포들!

english: I...see...
I was ambushed by them way back, see. They got the drop on me...I can't remember where, somewhere around here though.
translation: 옛날에 그놈들한테 기습을 당했지. 그놈들이 날 덮쳤어...어딘지는 기억이 안 나는데, 이 근처 어딘가였어.

english: These would be the mudskippers, right?
Aye! The mudskippers! Huge they were! Ten feet of glistening, muddy flesh floppin' towards me with white foam flying from their gnashing fangs!
translation: 그래! 말뚝망둥어! 엄청 컸지! 10피트나 되는 번들번들하고 진흙투성이인 살덩이가 이빨을 갈며 하얀 거품을 흩날리면서 나한테 퍼덕퍼덕 다가왔어!

english: I fought them up and down the beach, with the tide rising and more of them leaping towards me with cutlasses drawn!
translation: 해변 위아래로 그놈들이랑 싸웠지. 밀물은 차오르고, 더 많은 놈들이 커틀러스를 뽑아 들고 나한테 덤벼들었다고!

english: This is fascinating, but I have to be...
Shut yer' word-hole and listen! I can't remember all the details, as I'm sure they must have hit me quite hard, but the last thing I remember before it all went black...
translation: 그 말구멍 닥치고 들어! 그놈들한테 머리를 꽤 세게 맞았는지 자세한 건 다 기억이 안 나지만, 눈앞이 깜깜해지기 전에 마지막으로 기억나는 건...

english: ...was one of those devils rearing over me, its eyes glowin' red with the fires of hell!
translation: ...그 악마 같은 놈 하나가 내 위로 몸을 치켜세우는데, 그 눈이 지옥불처럼 시뻘겋게 빛나던 모습이야!

english: Fires of hell...right. I believe you.
No you don't! You think I'm crazy, like all the rest! Well, if I'm crazy, how did I get these?
translation: 아니, 안 믿잖아! 너도 다른 놈들처럼 내가 미쳤다고 생각하지! 흥, 내가 미쳤다면 이건 어떻게 생겼겠어?

english: Get what?
Skippy shows you what appears to be massive bite scars on his legs. You're no expert, but they look like... giant mudskipper bites!
translation: Skippy(스키피)가 다리에 난 거대한 물린 흉터처럼 보이는 것을 보여 준다. 전문가는 아니지만, 이건 마치... 거대 말뚝망둥어한테 물린 자국 같다!

english: Giant mudskipper bites! Where did you get those?
translation: 거대 말뚝망둥어한테 물린 자국이잖아요! 그거 어디서 생긴 거예요?

english: I can't remember... I've been drinking to forget the horror, and all I seem to have forgotten is where it all happened...
translation: 기억이 안 나... 그 공포를 잊으려고 술을 마셔 왔는데, 정작 잊어버린 건 그 일이 어디서 일어났는지뿐이야...

english: Hmmm...I suppose if I sober you up you may well start to recall.
translation: 흠...술을 깨워 드리면 기억이 날지도 모르겠네요.

english: You'll have a job. I've been drinking this for a week.
translation: 쉽지 않을걸. 이걸 일주일째 마시고 있거든.

english: 'Captain Braindeath's Extra Strength Rum/Drain Cleaner. Now 50% more debilitating'?
translation: 'Captain Braindeath(브레인데스 선장)의 특급 독한 럼주/배수구 세정제. 이제 몸을 망가뜨리는 효과 50% 증가'?

english: It's the extra sheep tranquilizers that gives it that added kick!
translation: 양 진정제를 듬뿍 넣어서 그렇게 화끈한 거야!

english: Stay here and I'll be right back. Try not to move. Or go near any open flames.
translation: 여기 계세요, 금방 돌아올게요. 움직이지 마시고요. 불 근처에도 가지 마세요.

english: You know, I could shock him out of it if I could find some cold water...
translation: 그러고 보니, 찬물을 좀 구하면 충격을 줘서 정신 차리게 할 수 있겠어...

english: Hey, Skippy.
Hey you!
How do I annoy the Mogres again?
Go south to Mudskipper Point and lob a Fishing Explosive into the sea. You can grab them from the Slayer masters.
translation: 남쪽 Mudskipper Point(말뚝망둥어 곶)으로 가서 바다에 Fishing Explosive(낚시용 폭약)을 던져. 폭약은 슬레이어 마스터들한테서 구할 수 있어.

english: Thanks! So, what are you going to do now?
translation: 고마워요! 그럼 이제 뭐 하실 거예요?

english: Well, I was planning on continuing my hobby of wandering up and down this bit of coastline, bellowing random threats and throwing bottles.
translation: 글쎄, 이 해안을 위아래로 어슬렁거리면서 아무한테나 고함치고 병 던지는 취미를 계속할까 하는데.

english: And you?
I was planning on wandering up and down the landscape, bugging people to see if they had mindblowingly dangerous quests for me to undertake.
translation: 저는 온 세상을 돌아다니면서 사람들한테 엄청나게 위험한 퀘스트가 없냐고 귀찮게 굴어 볼까 해요.

english: Well, good luck with that!
You too!
Weirdo...
Loony...
I think he's sober enough. And I don't want to use another bucket of water.
translation: 이 정도면 술이 깬 것 같아. 그리고 bucket of water(물 양동이)를 또 쓰고 싶지는 않아.

english: Thanks! Now I have two right boots!
translation: 고마워! 이제 오른쪽 장화가 두 짝이네!

english: Do you wanna skip the Tutorial?
Send me to the mainland now.
Right on. I'll read you the official messages first, then send you on your way. Ahem...
translation: 좋았어. 공식 안내문부터 읽어 주고 보내 줄게. 에헴...

english: I am now going to teleport you to Kourend Castle where your journey in the Twisted League will begin. Once you arrive, the Leagues Tutor will fill you in on how the Twisted League works. Good luck!
translation: 지금부터 당신을 Kourend Castle(쿠렌드 성)으로 순간이동시켜 드립니다. 그곳에서 Twisted League(뒤틀린 리그)의 여정이 시작됩니다. 도착하면 Leagues Tutor(리그 교사)가 뒤틀린 리그의 진행 방식을 알려 드릴 것입니다. 행운을 빕니다!

english: Prepare yourself!
Who are you?
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington.
translation: 내 이름은 Skippy(스키피)야. 평소엔 Rimmington(림밍턴) 근처에 살지.

english: Although I guess you won't be able to get to Rimmington on this League world...
translation: 근데 이 리그 월드에서는 림밍턴에 못 가겠구나...

english: Just lately the Council wants to let people skip the Tutorial, so - ha ha ha - they dump the job on Skippy. Bah!
translation: 요즘 의회에서 사람들이 튜토리얼을 건너뛸 수 있게 해 주고 싶다는데, 그래서 - 하하하 - 그 일을 스키피한테 떠넘겼지 뭐야. 쳇!

english: So, anyway, do you want to skip the Tutorial?
Can I decide later?
Sure. You'll find me all over this island. Ask me again any time you like.
translation: 그럼. 이 섬 여기저기서 날 찾을 수 있을 거야. 언제든 다시 물어봐.

english: I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
Good choice. Let me know if you change your mind.
When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled, or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
translation: 본토에 도착하면 당신은 Deadman(데드맨)이 됩니다. 해골 표시가 뜬 상태로 죽거나 다른 데드맨에게 죽으면 은행에 있는 가장 값비싼 아이템을 잃게 됩니다.

english: To help you get started, you'll have 12 hours of immunity before anyone can attack you. Speak to the Doomsayer in Lumbridge to waive your immunity and get on with the killing!
translation: 시작을 돕기 위해, 누구도 당신을 공격할 수 없는 12시간의 면역 시간이 주어집니다. 면역을 포기하고 바로 사냥에 나서고 싶다면 Lumbridge(럼브리지)의 Doomsayer(파멸의 예언자)에게 말을 거십시오!

english: For more information, speak to Nigel in the Lumbridge graveyard. You may choose where to begin - where would you like to start?
translation: 자세한 내용은 럼브리지 묘지에 있는 Nigel(나이절)에게 물어보십시오. 시작할 장소를 고를 수 있습니다. 어디에서 시작하시겠습니까?

english: You are teleported to your preferred starting location
My name's Skippy. Normally I live down by Rimmington. You should come and see me when you're passing.
translation: 내 이름은 Skippy(스키피)야. 평소엔 Rimmington(림밍턴) 근처에 살지. 지나갈 일 있으면 들러.

english: I'm sure I would as well.
Who are (Dramatic pause) THEY?
Send me to the mainland now.
Who are you?
Can I decide later?
I'll stay here for the Tutorial.
Lumbridge
Varrock
Falador
East Ardougne
Gnome Stronghold
:Gar mulno ful taglo!
I do not thinke thou understand the depths of the darkness you have unleashed upon the world. To dub it in such a scintillant manner is offensive to mine being.
translation: 그대가 이 세상에 풀어놓은 어둠의 깊이를 그대는 헤아리지 못하는 듯하구나. 그토록 반짝이는 이름으로 부르다니, 나의 존재에 대한 모욕이로다.

english: So why are you following me around?
Dark forces of which ye know nought have deemed that this is my geas.
translation: 그대가 알지 못하는 어둠의 힘이 이것을 나의 업(業)으로 정하였느니라.

english: Your goose?
*Sighs* Nae. But thine is well and truly cooked.
translation: *한숨* 아니니라. 허나 머지않아 업혀 나가게 될 자는 그대로다.

english: I am spawned of darkness. I am filled with darkness. I am darkness incarnate and to darkness I will return.
translation: 나는 어둠에서 태어났노라. 나는 어둠으로 가득 찼노라. 나는 어둠의 화신이며, 어둠으로 돌아가리라.

english: Sounds pretty... dark.
Knowest thou not of the cursed place? Knowest thou not about the future yet to befall your puny race?
translation: 저주받은 곳을 알지 못하느냐? 그대의 하찮은 종족에게 닥칠 미래를 알지 못하느냐?

english: Oh yes, I've heard that before.
translation: 아, 네, 그 얘기는 전에도 들었어요.

english: Then it is good that ye can laugh in the face of the end.
translation: 종말 앞에서도 웃을 수 있다니 다행이로구나.

english: The end has a face? Which end?
translation: 종말에도 앞이 있어요? 그럼 뒤끝도 있겠네요?

english: *Sighs* The darkness giveth, and the darkness taketh.
Nothing. Ye are already tainted in my sight by the acts of light. However there may be some hope for you if you continue to aid the darkness.
translation: 아무것도 없노라. 그대는 이미 빛의 행위로 내 눈에 더럽혀졌느니라. 허나 계속 어둠을 돕는다면 그대에게도 희망이 있을지 모르겠구나.

english: I do have a lantern around here somewhere.
translation: 어디 랜턴이 하나 있었던 것 같은데요.

english: Do not bring that foul and repellant thing near mine self.
translation: 그 더럽고 역겨운 것을 내 곁에 가져오지 말라.

english: A book of darkness? I don't usually read, but that seems like a good book!
translation: book of darkness(어둠의 책)? 나는 원래 책을 읽지 않지만, 그건 좋은 책 같구나!

english: I told thee to keep thy filthy light away from me!
translation: 그 더러운 빛을 내게서 치우라 일렀거늘!

english: Darkness take ye.
Rest in darkness.
Let the darkness come forth.
You look cute.
Where did you come from?
What can you do for me?
translation: 저한테 뭘 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Hello.
Good day.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello!
Sorry. I can't sell weapons to outerlanders. Wouldn't be right. Against our beliefs.
translation: 미안하다. 외지인에게는 무기를 못 판다. 옳지 않은 일이지. 우리 신념에 어긋난다.

english: Only Fremenniks may purchase weapons and armour here.
translation: 여기서 무기와 갑옷을 살 수 있는 건 Fremennik(프레메닉)뿐이다.

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
No. Weapons are my speciality. Not politics.
translation: 아니. 내 전문은 무기다. 정치가 아니라.

english: Okay, thanks.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: 혹시 정교하게 균형 잡힌 맞춤 활시위를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Aye, I have a few in stock. What would an outerlander be wanting with equipment like that?
translation: 그래, 몇 개 갖고 있지. 외지인이 그런 물건을 뭐에 쓰려고?

english: It's for Sigli. It needs to be weighted precisely to suit his hunting bow.
translation: Sigli(시글리) 씨에게 줄 거예요. 그분 사냥용 활에 딱 맞게 무게를 정확히 맞춰야 하거든요.

english: For Sigli eh? Well, I made his bow in the first place, so I'll be able to select the right string for you... just one small problem.
translation: 시글리 거라고? 그래, 애초에 그 활을 만든 게 나니까 맞는 시위를 골라 줄 수는 있지... 다만 작은 문제가 하나 있다.

english: What's that?
This string you'll be wanting... Very rare. Take a lot of time to recreate. Not sure you have the cash for it.
translation: 네가 원하는 이 시위 말이다... 아주 귀하다. 다시 만들려면 시간이 오래 걸리지. 네가 그만한 돈이 있을지 모르겠군.

english: Then maybe you'll accept something else...?
translation: 그럼 다른 걸로 받아 주실 수는 없을까요...?

english: Heh. Good thinking outerlander. Well, it's true, there is more to life than just making money. Making weapons is good money, but it's not why I do it.
translation: 헤. 머리가 좀 돌아가는군, 외지인. 뭐, 사실 인생엔 돈 버는 것보다 중요한 게 있지. 무기 만들기는 돈벌이가 되지만, 내가 그래서 하는 건 아니다.

english: I'll tell you what. I heard a rumour that one of the fishermen down by the docks caught some weird looking fish as they were fishing the other day.
translation: 이렇게 하자. 부두 쪽 어부 하나가 며칠 전에 낚시하다가 이상하게 생긴 물고기를 낚았다는 소문을 들었다.

english: From what I hear this fish is unique. Nobody's ever seen its like before. This intrigues me. I'd like to have it for myself. Make a good trophy.
translation: 듣자 하니 세상에 하나뿐인 물고기라더군. 그런 걸 본 사람이 아무도 없다고. 흥미가 동한다. 내가 갖고 싶다. 근사한 장식품이 되겠지.

english: You get me that fish, I give you the bowstring. What do you say? We got a deal?
translation: 그 물고기를 가져오면 활시위를 주지. 어떠냐? 거래하겠나?

english: Sounds good to me.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: 혹시 아주 희귀한 이국적인 물고기를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: What? There's another one?
Er... no, it's the one for you that I'm looking for...
translation: 어... 아니요, 당신에게 드릴 바로 그 물고기를 찾고 있는 거예요...

english: Ah. I see. I already told you. Some guy down by the docks was bragging. Best ask there, I reckon.
translation: 아. 그렇군. 이미 말했잖나. 부두 쪽에서 어떤 녀석이 자랑하고 다녔다고. 거기 가서 물어보는 게 좋을 거다.

english: Hi there. I got your fish, so can I have that bowstring for Sigli now?
translation: 안녕하세요. 물고기를 구해 왔는데, 이제 시글리 씨 활시위를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Ohh... That's a nice fish. Very pleased. Here. Take the bowstring. You fulfilled agreement. only fair I do same. Good work outerlander.
translation: 오오... 좋은 물고기로군. 아주 마음에 든다. 자. 활시위 받아라. 너는 약속을 지켰다. 나도 똑같이 하는 게 공평하지. 잘했다, 외지인.

english: Thanks!
So about this bowstring... was it hard to make or something?
translation: 그런데 이 활시위요... 만들기 어려운 건가요?

english: Not hard. Just a trick to it. Takes skill to learn, but when learnt, easy. Sigli will be happy. Finest bowstring on continent. Will suit his needs perfectly.
translation: 어렵진 않다. 요령이 있을 뿐. 배우는 데는 기술이 필요하지만, 익히고 나면 쉽다. 시글리가 기뻐할 거다. 대륙 최고의 활시위니까. 그 녀석에게 딱 맞을 거다.

english: Hello again [Fremennik name]. Come to see what's for sale?
translation: 다시 왔군, [Fremennik name]. 뭘 파는지 보러 왔나?

english: Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Oh, hello again. Want to buy some weapons?
translation: 아, 또 오셨네요. 무기 좀 사시겠어요?

english: I'll have a look.
Not right now.
I'll have a look.
Not right now...
I think I'll give the Skullball Course a go.
translation: Skullball Course(해골공 코스)에 한번 도전해 볼게요.

english: What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
The skullball comes out of one of these four spawnholes. Just kick the ball through the middle of each goal, through the skeleton's feet.
translation: 해골공은 이 네 개의 출현 구멍 중 하나에서 나온다. 각 골대 한가운데, 해골의 두 발 사이로 공을 차 넣으면 된다.

english: There are 10 goals, which you must complete in order, and one final goal.
translation: 골대는 10개고, 순서대로 통과해야 한다. 그리고 마지막 골대가 하나 더 있지.

english: An arrow will point to your ball, just in case lots of people are using the course at the same time as yourself.
translation: 코스를 너와 동시에 쓰는 자가 많을 수도 있으니, 화살표가 네 공을 가리켜 줄 거다.

english: The better your time, the more agillity XP you will be awarded. The timer starts when you score your first goal.
translation: 기록이 좋을수록 민첩 경험치를 더 많이 받는다. 타이머는 첫 골을 넣을 때 시작된다.

english: I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 공을 잃어버린 것 같은데, 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: No problem, here's another one. You'll have to start from the beginning again, but the timer will be restarted too.
translation: 문제없지, 여기 하나 더 있다. 처음부터 다시 해야 하지만 타이머도 다시 시작될 거다.

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
Oh dear, such a defeatist.
Grrr - you don't belong in here, human!
translation: 크르르, 넌 여기 올 자격이 없다, 인간!

english: I would like to do the skullball course.
What are the instructions for the skullball course?
What are the instructions for using the skullball course?
I seem to have lost my ball - can I have another one?
translation: 공을 잃어버린 것 같은데, 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I give up, I can't do it - take my ball away.
You have truly gifted paws!
I've never seen anything like it!
You need a few more skullball lessons.
Keep it up!
Don't give up the day job!
Look at [her/him] go!
Pathetic!
What - a - goal !!!
That was just plain lucky.
[He/She] shoots - [He/She] scores!!!!!
Humans play skullball worse than puppies!
The human's scored!
Eyup. They call me Skully. I run this Wilderness Loot Chest. What can I do for you?
translation: 어이. 다들 날 Skully(스컬리)라고 부르지. 이 Wilderness(황야) Loot Chest(전리품 상자)를 운영하고 있어. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: Well, you know how when you kill someone all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly?
translation: 그러니까, 누굴 죽이면 그 녀석 물건이 전부 바닥에 한 무더기로 쏟아져서 재빨리 다 줍기가 엄청 힘들잖아?

english: Actually, I've never killed anyone else.
translation: 사실 저는 다른 사람을 죽여 본 적이 없는데요.

english: ...Oh. Well, when you do, all of their stuff just ends up in a pile on the floor and it's really hard to pick it all up quickly.
translation: ...아. 뭐, 죽이게 되면 말이야, 그 녀석 물건이 전부 바닥에 한 무더기로 쏟아져서 재빨리 다 줍기가 엄청 힘들거든.

english: Yeah?
So, I made an enchantment that teleports the loot to another dimension instead!
translation: 그래서 내가 전리품을 대신 다른 차원으로 순간이동시키는 마법을 만들었지!

english: How does that help?
Well, instead of getting a pile of rubbish, you get a single key. You just take the key to this chest and BAM! There's your loot!
translation: 음, 쓰레기 더미 대신 열쇠 하나만 받는 거야. 그 열쇠를 이 상자에 가져오기만 하면 짠! 전리품이 나오는 거지!

english: So the loot is safe in this other dimension?
translation: 그럼 전리품은 그 다른 차원에 안전하게 있는 건가요?

english: Eh, seems like it. As long as they've had the key, I've never had anyone unable to get the stuff back out. Though if you lose the key, you can't get the stuff out.
translation: 어, 그런 것 같아. 열쇠만 있으면 물건을 못 꺼낸 사람은 아직 한 명도 없었어. 다만 열쇠를 잃어버리면 물건은 못 꺼내.

english: Oh, and be careful running about with too many keys on you. Other people will know you've got them, and I'm not gonna stop them opening the chest!
translation: 아, 그리고 열쇠를 너무 많이 들고 돌아다니지 않게 조심해. 다른 사람들도 네가 열쇠를 가진 걸 알 테고, 난 그 녀석들이 상자를 여는 걸 막아 주지 않을 거거든!

english: So if I kill someone and take their keys, I can use them myself?
translation: 그럼 제가 누굴 죽이고 그 사람 열쇠를 빼앗으면, 제가 직접 쓸 수 있다는 거예요?

english: ...Eh, if you wanna think about it that way, sure.
I got nothing better to do, so I'll keep track of the value of the stuff you unlock.
translation: 딱히 할 일도 없으니까, 네가 열어 본 물건 가치는 내가 기록해 둘게.

english: And anything you don't want, you can have the chest destroy it.
translation: 그리고 필요 없는 건 상자더러 없애 달라고 하면 돼.

english: Except the food. I'll eat that instead.
translation: 음식만 빼고. 그건 내가 대신 먹을 거야.

english: Now, if you want your own keys instead of relying on the misfortune of others, I can put the enchantment on you as well, but it's gonna cost ya.
translation: 그런데 남의 불운에 기대지 말고 네 열쇠를 직접 얻고 싶다면, 너한테도 그 마법을 걸어 줄 수 있어. 대신 돈이 좀 들 거야.

english: Can I have access to the chest?
So, if you have keys from someone else, you're more than welcome to put them in the chest and see what comes out.
translation: 그러니까, 다른 사람한테서 얻은 열쇠가 있으면 얼마든지 상자에 넣고 뭐가 나오는지 봐도 돼.

english: If you want the enchantment that makes the keys, I'm afraid it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 열쇠를 만들어 주는 마법을 원한다면, 미안하지만 100만 코인이 들어.

english: Sure, I'll pay for that.
Are you sure? 1 million is a lot of coins, and you won't get them back!
Hmm... I don't think you have enough money on you there, mate.
translation: 흠... 지금 가진 돈으로는 모자라는 것 같은데, 친구.

english: Ok, let me just... and a bit of... and we're done! You'll now get loot keys whenever you kill someone in the Wilderness. Talk to me again if you have any questions.
translation: 좋아, 잠깐만... 여기에 조금... 끝났다! 이제 Wilderness(황야)에서 누굴 죽일 때마다 loot key(전리품 열쇠)를 얻게 될 거야. 궁금한 게 있으면 다시 말 걸어.

english: Fair enough mate, talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: 알았어, 친구. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 말 걸어.

english: Not right now, thanks.
Fair enough mate, want to talk about something else?
How much?!
1 million coins.
Why do you charge so much?!
Runes. People don't wanna deliver across the Wilderness, and I'm in no shape to go to them, so I have to pay through the nose.
translation: 룬 때문이지. 다들 황야를 가로질러 배달하려 하질 않고, 난 직접 가지러 갈 몸 상태도 아니니까 바가지를 쓸 수밖에 없어.

english: I make maybe a couple hundred coins of profit, which at least lets me buy a few beers.
translation: 남는 건 고작 몇백 코인 정도인데, 그래도 맥주 몇 잔은 사 마실 수 있지.

english: Why is the beer so cheap if it's so expensive to get deliveries out here?
translation: 여기까지 배달받는 게 그렇게 비싼데, 맥주는 왜 그렇게 싸요?

english: The barman makes it himself with whatever scraps he can get his hands on.
translation: 술집 주인이 손에 넣을 수 있는 찌꺼기로 직접 빚거든.

english: You'd think it'd turn out horrible, but compared to every other 2 coin beer out there, it's not half bad.
translation: 맛이 끔찍할 것 같지? 그런데 다른 2코인짜리 맥주들이랑 비교하면 꽤 괜찮아.

english: But enough about beer. If you want access to the loot keys, it's gonna cost you 1 million coins.
translation: 아무튼 맥주 얘기는 그만하고. 전리품 열쇠를 쓰고 싶으면 100만 코인이 들어.

english: Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 이 전리품 열쇠가 작동하는 방식을 바꿀 수 있나요?

english: Well, I can turn the enchantment that creates the loot keys on and off for you. Won't cost you anything to turn it back on again, either.
translation: 음, 전리품 열쇠를 만드는 마법을 켜거나 끌 수 있어. 다시 켜는 데는 돈도 안 들어.

english: If you'd like it so stuff like food and potions stay out of the keys so you can use them yourself, I can do that too.
translation: 음식이나 물약 같은 건 열쇠에 안 들어가게 해서 네가 직접 쓸 수 있게 하고 싶다면, 그것도 해 줄 수 있어.

english: And if you like the feeling of picking up valuables, I can make it so that anything above a certain value hits the floor as well.
translation: 그리고 귀중품 줍는 기분을 좋아한다면, 일정 가치 이상인 건 바닥에 떨어지게 해 줄 수도 있지.

english: Ok, whenever you kill someone else now, their items will go to the floor like normal. Just remember, they could have loot keys on them, and they'll still go to your inventory!
translation: 좋아, 이제 다른 사람을 죽이면 그 녀석 아이템은 평소처럼 바닥에 떨어질 거야. 다만 기억해 둬, 그 녀석이 전리품 열쇠를 갖고 있을 수도 있고, 그건 여전히 네 소지품으로 들어와!

english: Ok, you'll now get loot keys when you kill another person in the Wilderness.
translation: 좋아, 이제 Wilderness(황야)에서 다른 사람을 죽이면 전리품 열쇠를 얻게 될 거야.

english: Ok, food and potions will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 좋아, 이제 음식과 물약은 전리품 열쇠에 담기지 않고 바닥에 떨어질 거야.

english: Ok, food and potions will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 좋아, 이제 음식과 물약은 전리품 열쇠로 보내질 거야.

english: Ok, valuable items will now be dropped to the floor instead of stored in a loot key.
translation: 좋아, 이제 귀중한 아이템은 전리품 열쇠에 담기지 않고 바닥에 떨어질 거야.

english: Ok, valuable items will now be sent to your loot keys.
translation: 좋아, 이제 귀중한 아이템은 전리품 열쇠로 보내질 거야.

english: Currently, if you were to have valuable items drop to the floor, they'd need to be worth at least [number]gp. What do you want to change that value to?
translation: 지금은 귀중한 아이템을 바닥에 떨어지게 하려면 최소 [number]gp의 가치가 있어야 해. 그 값을 얼마로 바꿀래?

english: Hmph. Yeah, real funny, wise guy.
translation: 흥. 그래, 아주 웃기는군, 건방진 녀석.

english: Ok, now items worth at least [entered amount]gp will drop to the floor.
translation: 좋아, 이제 최소 [entered amount]gp 가치의 아이템은 바닥에 떨어질 거야.

english: How much loot have I claimed?
Well, seeing as you haven't claimed a key yet, I reckon you've claimed a total of 0gp worth of loot.
translation: 음, 아직 열쇠를 하나도 안 열었으니까, 받은 전리품은 총 0gp어치인 것 같은데.

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 열쇠 1개를 열었고, 전리품 가치는 약 [number]gp야. 아직 값나가는 걸 없애는 건 못 봤어.

english: You've claimed 1 key, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 열쇠 1개를 열었고, 전리품 가치는 약 [number]gp야. 그리고 값나가는 건 전부 없앴지.

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. I haven't seen you destroy anything of value yet, though.
translation: 열쇠 [number]개를 열었고, 전리품 가치는 약 [number]gp야. 아직 값나가는 걸 없애는 건 못 봤어.

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp. You've destroyed [number]gp worth of it.
translation: 열쇠 [number]개를 열었고, 전리품 가치는 약 [number]gp야. 그중 [number]gp어치는 없앴고.

english: You've claimed [number] keys, containing loot worth about [number]gp, and you destroyed everything of value.
translation: 열쇠 [number]개를 열었고, 전리품 가치는 약 [number]gp야. 그리고 값나가는 건 전부 없앴지.

english: Who are you, exactly?
Ah, used to be an adventurer like you, I guess. Used to roam the world, killing monsters for a living. 'Cept then, I discovered the Wilderness.
translation: 아, 아마 예전엔 너 같은 모험가였지. 세상을 떠돌면서 몬스터를 잡아 먹고살았어. 그러다 Wilderness(황야)를 알게 됐지.

english: Used to take on anyone and everyone who stood in me way, and made myself a small fortune doing it too.
translation: 내 앞을 막는 놈은 누구든 상대했고, 그걸로 꽤 한몫 챙기기도 했지.

english: It's how I got the name, used to go anywhere and everywhere with a skull over my head!
translation: 이 이름도 그래서 얻은 거야. 어딜 가든 머리 위에 해골을 달고 다녔거든!

english: So how'd you end up like... this?
Ah, you live a life feeding on others, eventually something higher up the food chain finds you.
translation: 아, 남을 잡아먹으며 살다 보면, 결국 먹이사슬 더 위에 있는 놈이 널 찾아오는 법이지.

english: I used to have a hidden outpost out near the Bone Yard, somewhere to keep my stuff in an emergency. One day all I come back to is a smouldering pile of rubble.
translation: 예전에 Bone Yard(뼈 묘지) 근처에 숨겨 둔 전초기지가 있었어. 급할 때 물건을 맡겨 두는 곳이었지. 그런데 어느 날 돌아와 보니 연기 나는 잔해 더미만 남아 있더라고.

english: Next thing I know, someone's snuck up behind me and has put a spear through my back.
translation: 그다음 순간, 누가 뒤로 몰래 다가와서 내 등에 창을 꽂았지.

english: And you survived?!
Always carry a ring of life, friend! Never know when you'll need it.
translation: ring of life(생명의 반지)는 항상 챙겨, 친구! 언제 필요할지 모르니까.

english: Still, the damage was done. Everything I ever owned up in smoke, and even though the wound's fully healed, I can still feel that spear in my back to this day.
translation: 그래도 피해는 이미 입은 뒤였지. 내 전 재산이 연기처럼 사라졌고, 상처는 다 나았는데도 지금까지 등에 그 창이 느껴져.

english: Thankfully, Ferox was kind enough to take me in, and I managed to repurpose some of my old storage magic for adventurers like you.
translation: 다행히 Ferox(페록스)가 친절하게 날 받아 줬고, 내 옛 보관 마법을 너 같은 모험가들을 위해 고쳐 쓸 수 있었지.

english: But why come back to the Wilderness?
What, go lifea normal life behind a shop counter so I can pedalswamp paste for a living instead? I'll pass!
translation: 뭐, 상점 계산대 뒤에서 평범하게 살면서 swamp paste(늪 반죽)이나 팔아 먹고살라고? 사양할게!

english: Anyhow, enough about me. What can I do for you?
translation: 아무튼 내 얘기는 그만하고. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: Goodbye.
I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 필요한 거 있으면 난 여기 있을게.

english: Don't waste my time trying to change settings on a thing you haven't bought yet!
translation: 아직 사지도 않은 걸로 설정 바꾸겠다고 내 시간 낭비하게 하지 마!

english: I know you Iron people are weird about taking other people's stuff, so if you just wanna have the chest destroy it all, that's fine by me.
translation: 너희 아이언맨들이 남의 물건 가져가는 걸 꺼리는 건 알아. 그러니 상자더러 전부 없애 달라고 해도 난 상관없어.

english: Except the food. I'm eating that instead.
translation: 음식만 빼고. 그건 내가 먹을 거야.

english: Sorry mate, can't run the Loot Chest on a Deadman World.
translation: 미안해 친구, Deadman(데드맨) 월드에서는 Loot Chest(전리품 상자)를 운영할 수 없어.

english: How does the chest work?
Can I have access to the chest?
Sure, I'll pay for that.
Yes, pay 1 million coins!
No, I've changed my mind!
Not right now, thanks.
How much?!
Can I change how these loot keys work?
translation: 이 전리품 열쇠가 작동하는 방식을 바꿀 수 있나요?

english: Turn loot keys off
Turn loot keys on
Drop food to floor
Send food to loot key
Drop valuables to floor
Send valuables to loot key
Change valuable item threshold
How much loot have I claimed?
Who are you, exactly?
Goodbye.
Hello.
Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!
translation: 먹고 있어... 계속 날 먹고 있어! 안에서부터 날 파먹고 있다고! 제발 그것들 좀 멈춰 줘! 지금도 내 안에서 꿈틀거리는 게 느껴져... 제발 멈춰 줘!

english: Hi.
Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.
translation: 피, 피... 다 돌아가기엔 피가 늘 모자라. 팔을 이렇게 들어 올리면 피가 전부 몸속으로 다시 쏟아져 들어가거든.

english: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?
translation: 피가 내 팔 안으로 돌아가는 걸 잊지 말아야 할 텐데. 다리는 묻지도 마... 다리엔 피가 얼마나 필요하려나?

english: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!
translation: 피는 중요해. 우리의 헌신을 증명하려면 매일 Zamorak(자모락)께 바쳐야 하니까. 피가 떨어지지 않기만을 바랄 뿐이야!

english: Hello, are you okay?
Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.
translation: 오, 그래, 넌 아주 훌륭하구나. 발그레한 뺨에 윤기 나는 머리카락.

english: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...
translation: 어디 보자, 감자 조금, 양배추 조금... 마늘은 반 쪽 정도...

english: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?
translation: 그래, 넌 아주 훌륭한 수프가 될 것 같아. 괜찮지?

english: Actually I do.
You're welcome to have some with me of course...
translation: 물론 너도 나랑 같이 좀 먹어도 돼...

english: Hello there.
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: 므와르르 픈ㄴ츠. 그쁘 등 스크트 델프?

english: Pardon?
Kjp lar falut: Gbpp dng sktd delp?
translation: 크즈프 라르 팔루트: 그쁘 등 스크트 델프?

english: Sorry, I don't under..
Mwaarrr fnnntchh. Gbpp dng sktd delp? GBPP DNG SKTD DELP!
translation: 므와르르 픈ㄴ츠. 그쁘 등 스크트 델프? 그쁘 등 스크트 델프!

english: Hello...
Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...
translation: 마을 사람들을 죽여, 모조리 불태워... 한 놈도 남김없이! 아무것도 살아남지 못하게... 살이 타는 달콤한 냄새만 남게...

english: You're ill!
What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...
translation: 뭐라고? 그 냄새를 한 번도 맡아 본 적이 없다고? 뭐, 길들여야 아는 맛이라고 해 두지...

english: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.
translation: 위험해, 사방이 위험해! 하지만 사람에게서도 짐승에게서도 아니야! 이건 네 안에 있는 위험이야.

english: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.
translation: 그걸 끄집어내, 기르고, 아껴 줘. 다친 새를 쓰다듬듯이 쓰다듬어... 그리고 그게 네 존재 자체를 집어삼키기 전에 목 졸라 죽여. 내가 경고 안 했다고는 하지 마.

english: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
translation: 저게 뭐지... 내 눈앞에 보이는 것이 단검인가? 어찌하여 내가 포악한 운명의 돌팔매와 화살을 견뎌야 한단 말인가.

english: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.
translation: 인간이란 무엇이냐, 이 먼지의 정수가 아니더냐? 그러니 잘 자거라, 다정한 왕자여. 나머지는 침묵이로다.

english: Hello. Are you here for my black dragons?
translation: 안녕하세요. 제 블랙 드래곤 때문에 오셨나요?

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 네, 그걸 잡으라는 Slayer(슬레이어) 임무를 받았어요.

english: Fair enough. Do what you have to do.
translation: 그렇다면 어쩔 수 없죠. 해야 할 일을 하세요.

english: They're not my Slayer target.
Oh, good. In that case you're welcome to go and admire them, but don't get any ideas about killing them.
translation: 아, 다행이네요. 그렇다면 얼마든지 가서 구경하셔도 되지만, 잡을 생각은 하지 마세요.

english: Why are you here asking about that?
Because I like my black dragons, and I had to work hard to get access to their lair, and I don't want people using them for training without a reason.
translation: 저는 제 black dragon(블랙 드래곤)들을 좋아하고, 이 둥지에 들어올 권한을 얻으려고 고생을 많이 했거든요. 그래서 사람들이 이유도 없이 수련용으로 쓰는 건 싫어요.

english: So if one of the Slayer Masters sent you to slay black dragons, that's fine, but otherwise you should go and train elsewhere.
translation: 그러니까 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 중 누군가가 블랙 드래곤을 처치하라고 보낸 거라면 괜찮지만, 그게 아니라면 다른 곳에서 수련하세요.

english: I'd rather people didn't train on my dragons at all, but I've got a distant cousin who's a Slayer Master, so I've got to support the family business.
translation: 사실 아무도 제 드래곤으로 수련하지 않았으면 좋겠지만, 먼 친척 중에 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 있어서 집안 사업을 도와야 하거든요.

english: Excuse me, I've got to go.
Hey, go and train somewhere else! I'm not having people mess with my dragons unless a Slayer Master's told them to do it.
translation: 이봐요, 다른 데 가서 수련하세요! Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 시킨 게 아니면 아무도 제 드래곤을 건드리게 두지 않을 거예요.

english: I have a Slayer assignment to kill those, yes.
translation: 네, 그걸 잡으라는 Slayer(슬레이어) 임무를 받았어요.

english: They're not my Slayer target.
Why are you here asking about that?
Excuse me, I've got to go.
Ah don' talk to humans! Yous wanna talk, talk to da boss!
translation: 인간이랑은 말 안 혀! 말하고 싶으믄 두목한테 하라고!

english: He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 끝내주는 비트를 연주하느라 바빠서 잠시 멈춰 이야기할 틈도 없다.

english: Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 스킬 망토에 대해 좀 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 물론이죠. 스킬 망토는 한 스킬에서 레벨 99에 도달하면 살 수 있어요. 그 스킬의 능력치를 올려 줄 뿐 아니라, 꽤 멋진 감정 표현도 할 수 있답니다!

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Cape of Strength(힘 망토)는 저희 길드로 무제한 순간이동도 할 수 있게 해 줘요. 또 알고 싶은 게 있나요?

english: What can I do here?
Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 아아, 포환던지기는 힘을 시험하기에 아주 좋고 보상도 꽤 쏠쏠하죠. 다만 제대로 해야 해요. 먼저 손에 고운 가루를 좀 묻히는 게 좋을 거예요. 그립이 더 좋아지거든요.

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 저는 개인적으로 ground ashes(빻은 재)를 좋아해요. 곱고 보드라운 가루가 돼서 그립이 정말 좋아지거든요.

english: Ok, what else?
Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 간단히 말하면, 저 안에 들어가서 손에 거치적거리는 게 아무것도 없는지 확인하고, 포환을 집어서 던지면 돼요.... 기술에 따라 꽤 멀리 던질 수도 있어요.

english: What was your best?
Ahh that would be telling...
That's a big axe!
Yes indeed it is. Have to be mighty strong to wield it too.
translation: 그렇고말고요. 이걸 휘두르려면 엄청나게 힘이 세야 하죠.

english: But you don't look that strong!
translation: 그런데 그렇게 힘이 세 보이지는 않는데요!

english: Maybe, maybe not, but I still had to beat a Barbarian to get it. Mind you, usually they don't part with them. This was an unusual circumstance.
translation: 그럴 수도, 아닐 수도 있죠. 하지만 이걸 얻으려고 Barbarian(야만인)을 이겨야 했어요. 사실 그들은 보통 도끼를 남에게 내주지 않아요. 이번엔 특별한 경우였죠.

english: Oh?
I bet him he couldn't catch a squirrel whilst still holding his axe but that I could... and that if I won I'd get his axe.
translation: 그 사람은 도끼를 든 채로는 다람쥐를 못 잡겠지만 저는 잡을 수 있다고 내기를 걸었죠... 제가 이기면 그 도끼를 받기로 하고요.

english: What happened?

He went running after the squirrel... nearly caught it too... it shot up a tree and he tried to climb up it, only got a bit tangled up with his axe cause he couldn't hang on to it at the same time... he fell out of the tree and it
translation: 그 사람은 다람쥐를 쫓아 달려갔고... 거의 잡을 뻔했죠... 다람쥐가 나무 위로 쏜살같이 올라가자 따라 올라가려 했는데, 도끼를 붙잡은 채로는 나무에 매달릴 수가 없어서 도끼에 좀 엉켜 버렸어요... 결국 나무에서 떨어졌고, 그다음은

english: was my turn....

I simply went and chopped the tree down with this big old axe, still holding it. The squirrel was so petrified it simply jumped straight out of the tree onto me, I won the axe and let the poor creature go!
translation: 저는 그냥 이 커다란 도끼를 든 채로 가서 나무를 베어 넘겼어요. 다람쥐가 너무 겁에 질려서 나무에서 곧장 제게로 뛰어내렸죠. 저는 도끼를 얻었고, 그 불쌍한 녀석은 놓아줬어요!

english: I sense a moral in there somewhere.
Aye indeed. Brawn isn't all you need to wield a big axe, brains are required too!
translation: 그렇고말고요. 큰 도끼를 휘두르는 데는 근육만으로는 부족해요. 머리도 필요하죠!

english: May I claim my tokens please?
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 아쉽지만 아직 토큰을 하나도 얻지 않으셨어요. 길드 곳곳에 있는 활동에 참여해서 토큰을 모아 보세요.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
translation: 알겠어요, 뭘 할 수 있는지 둘러볼게요.

english: You don't have space to carry them.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
Bye!
Be well, warrior [player name].
Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 아, 그런데 보아하니 이미 더할 나위 없이 강해지셨군요! 혹시 Cape of Strength(힘 망토)를 사서, 이 까다로운 스킬을 정복한 소수 정예에 합류하려고 오신 건가요?

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 그 업적을 추가로 기리는 의미로, Cape of Strength(힘 망토)는 저희 길드로 순간이동도 시켜 준답니다.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 제 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 소지품에 공간이 부족하신 것 같네요. 공간이 생기면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Skillcape of Strength(힘 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 흠, 그래요, 확실히 충분히 강해 보이시네요. 99000골드 코인입니다.

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 천만에요. 이런 명예로운 물건을 살 기회를 탐내는 모험가는 많으니까요! 마음이 바뀌면 여기서 저를 찾으세요.

english: Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 지금 가진 돈이 부족해요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 아쉽게도 모든 스킬 망토는 무료 두건과 한 세트로만 드리고 있어요. 스킬 판촉 행사의 일부거든요. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 아시죠? 그러니 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 입으세요, 친구.

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: 스킬 망토에 대해 좀 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: What can I do here?
That's a big axe!
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Skillcape of Strength(힘 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Skillcape
Hood
Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Sure.
Hello.
Hello.
Not very talkative are you?
Nope.
I'll be off then.
Yup.
The blue fish leap northwards at dawn..
Oranges are not the only fruit.
The cabbages bloom in the spring.
My cows produce milk in the evening.
translation: 우리 집 소들은 저녁에 우유를 낸다.

english: I bought an aardvark from Ardougne market.
Yellow balloons are heavier in boxes.
translation: 노란 풍선은 상자 속에서 더 무겁다.

english: ...err...sprockets wangle burps in the forked flan.
You have no idea what you are talking about do you?
translation: 무슨 말을 하는지 전혀 모르는군, 그렇지?

english: No, not really.
It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
(continues with "Oranges are not the only fruit")
Free stuff please.
Ah, Operative Budgie. Welcome to the island.
translation: 아, 잉꼬 요원. 섬에 온 걸 환영한다.

english: Budgie? That's not my name, you can call me-
translation: 잉꼬요? 그건 제 이름이 아닌데요, 저는-

english: Shh!
No names! Names are unnecessary. Loose lives cost tongues.
translation: 이름은 안 돼! 이름은 불필요하다. 목숨이 가벼우면 입이 날아간다.

english: Shouldn't that be...never mind. So Mr Hemli-
translation: 그거 거꾸로 말한 거 아니에요...? 아니, 됐어요. 그래서 헴리그-

english: Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!
Sorry, no names. I forgot.
Call me Operative Nighthawk.
How come you get the cool name, and I get called Budgie? Can't I be called Operative Panther? Yeah I like that, panthers are cool. Rarrrr!
translation: 왜 당신은 멋진 이름이고 저는 잉꼬예요? 저도 흑표범 요원으로 불리면 안 돼요? 그래요, 그게 좋겠어요. 흑표범은 멋지잖아요. 크아앙!

english: This is not a democracy, Operative! Panther already exists and he's working on a mission in Al Kharid. It's my way or the highway.
translation: 여긴 민주주의가 아니다, 요원! 흑표범은 이미 있고, 지금 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 임무 수행 중이다. 내 방식이 싫으면 떠나라.

english: Fine, whatever, I don't care anyway.
To business. Here are the details of your operation. You will infiltrate Burgher Burowgar's hall, deep undercover as a travelling entertainer. Burgher Burowgar and his men are known to relax in the
translation: 본론으로 들어가지. 이번 작전의 세부 사항이다. 너는 떠돌이 광대로 깊이 위장해 Burgher Burowgar(버로우가 촌장)의 홀에 잠입한다. 버로우가 촌장과 그 부하들은

english: presence of a jester - and a few barrels of beer. To get the information required from the court of Burgher Burowgar you must entertain him.
translation: jester(광대) 하나와 맥주 몇 통만 있으면 긴장을 푸는 것으로 알려져 있다. 버로우가 촌장의 궁정에서 필요한 정보를 얻으려면 그를 즐겁게 해 줘야 한다.

english: While you are obeying the Burgher's instructions you should listen in on the conversations of his council and make note of what they discuss.
translation: 촌장의 지시를 따르는 동안 그의 의회가 나누는 대화를 엿듣고, 무엇을 논의하는지 기록해 둬라.

english: When you return I shall ask you a few questions about what you have learned.
translation: 돌아오면 네가 알아낸 것에 대해 몇 가지 질문을 하겠다.

english: Very well.
You must wear all four pieces of the jester costume without anything in your hands, as the Burgher's guards will search you thoroughly.
translation: 광대 의상 네 가지를 모두 착용하고 손에는 아무것도 들지 마라. 촌장의 경비병들이 몸을 샅샅이 수색할 테니까.

english: Are you ready to begin?
I am ready.
Not dressed like that you're not! You'd better get the rest of your kit, or empty your hands if you have anything in them.
translation: 그 차림으로는 안 된다! 나머지 장비를 챙겨 오든가, 손에 뭔가 들고 있다면 비워라.

english: I just need to visit the bank.
Hurry back; we must know what Neitiznot's ruler is planning.
translation: 서둘러 돌아와라. Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)의 통치자가 무슨 계획을 꾸미는지 알아내야 한다.

english: I shall return soon.
Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
translation: 색깔 없는 초록 생각들이 맹렬하게 잠잔다.

english: Have you infiltrated the Burgher's leisure quarters?
Not yet. I'll do that now.
Shhh. Go away. I'm not allowed to talk to you.
translation: 쉿. 저리 가. 너와 이야기하면 안 된다.

english: Fine, whatever ...
The blue fish leap northwards at dawn.
It rains frogs during the Winter in Neitiznot.
Free stuff please.
I am ready.
I just need to visit the bank.
Colourless green ideas sleep furiously.
translation: 색깔 없는 초록 생각들이 맹렬하게 잠잔다.

english: Hi there.
Hey, ids me matesh!
Sorry, have we met?
Yeah! you wazsh wiv me in dat pub overy by hill!
translation: 그럼! 너 나랑 저 언덕 옆에 술집에 있었자나아!

english: I have no idea what you're going on about.
translation: 무슨 말씀을 하시는 건지 전혀 모르겠어요.

english: Glad yeeash remembers.
Doh ray meeee laa doh faaa!
translation: 도 레 미이이 라 도 파아아!

english: La la la! Do di dum dii!
translation: 랄 랄 라! 두 디 둠 디이!

english: Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: 누군가 저를 Salve(살브) 강의 신전, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)까지 안내해 주길 바라면서 여기서 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 웅장한 신전이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)로 들어오는 길에 분명 지나쳤을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶어요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로 몸을 지킬 수 있으세요?

english: What sort of guide are you? I'm pretty healthy, but you'll have to protect me else I'll be sure to die... Oh, I do hope you can manage that.
translation: 무슨 안내인이 그래요? 제가 꽤 건강하긴 하지만, 당신이 지켜 주지 않으면 전 틀림없이 죽을 거예요... 아, 잘 해내 주시면 좋겠네요.

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 동료가 있군요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 동료를 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 오, 정말요? 그럼 너무 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 좀 주시려고요? 잠깐만요, 제 배낭 좀 열게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 남아 있는 것보단 나아요.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 이렇게 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)에 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같아서요.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
translation: 저 공격당하고 있는 거 안 보여요...?

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요. 저 다리는 못 건너요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 이거 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 지나갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와! 정말 대단했어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자서 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 신전까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보상이에요.

english: Smiddi Ryak gives you a reward token!
translation: Smiddi Ryak(스미디 리악)이 reward token(보상 토큰)을 줍니다!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 적을 만나면 스스로 몸을 지킬 수 있으세요...?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello!
Arr? Be ye wantin' te go on account with our gang o' fillibusters?
translation: 어이? 우리 해적 패거리에 한 식구로 끼고 싶은 게냐?

english: The powder monkey be takin' a caulk after gettin' rowdy on bumboo, so there be plenty of room for ye.
translation: 화약 나르는 꼬맹이가 럼주 퍼마시고 난동 부리다 뻗어 자고 있으니, 자리는 넉넉하다고.

english: Riiiiight...
I'll just be over here if you need me.
Yer standin' in me light stranger. Can I sell ye somethin' that'll make ye move?
translation: 내 불빛을 가리고 서 있구먼, 이방인. 뭘 팔아야 비켜 주겠냐?

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
I doubt it.
Then move on stranger.
That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
Cutlasses! Think yer a pirate now [lad/lass]?
translation: 커틀러스라! 이제 해적이라도 된 줄 아는 게냐, [lad/lass]?

english: Well, yes.
Well, I have some cutlasses.
I have Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass. Well, a load of them to be honest.
translation: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass(놋쇠손 해리의 커틀러스)가 있지. 솔직히 말하면 아주 잔뜩 있어.

english: Then there's Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass. Lovely blade that.
translation: 그리고 Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass(불운한 젠킨스의 행운의 커틀러스)도 있다. 아주 멋진 칼이지.

english: I've also got Gentleman Mallard's Rapier. Not a cutlass I know, but the finest blade ever wielded by a privateer.
translation: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier(신사 맬러드의 레이피어)도 있다. 커틀러스가 아닌 건 알지만, 사략 해적이 휘두른 칼 중에 최고의 명검이지.

english: Now, which would ye like to hear about?
translation: 자, 어느 칼 얘기를 들어 보겠냐?

english: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
translation: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass(놋쇠손 해리의 커틀러스)요.

english: A good choice!
Ye may end up meeting Brass Hand Harry if ye hang around long enough.
translation: 여기 오래 머물다 보면 Brass Hand Harry(놋쇠손 해리)를 만나게 될지도 모르지.

english: He lost his left arm to a canister round, but that didn't stop him much.
translation: 그 친구는 산탄 포격에 왼팔을 잃었는데, 그래도 별로 개의치 않았지.

english: Then he lost his right hand at the wrist fightin' the excise men off the coast of Karamja.
translation: 그러다 Karamja(카람자) 앞바다에서 세관 놈들이랑 싸우다가 오른손 손목까지 잃었어.

english: Not bein' the sort to lie about mopin', he asked me to make him a cutlass with a brass gauntlet fixed to the handle, and rig it up with a load of straps so he could keep fightin'.
translation: 주저앉아 신세 한탄이나 할 위인이 아니라서, 나한테 손잡이에 놋쇠 건틀릿을 단 커틀러스를 만들어 달라더군. 계속 싸울 수 있게 끈을 잔뜩 달아서 말이야.

english: He's a great man is Harry, but he keeps snappin' the straps while he's at sea, so he sells the cutlasses back to me in exchange for a new one.
translation: Harry(해리)는 대단한 사내지만, 바다에 나가면 자꾸 끈을 끊어 먹어서, 쓰던 커틀러스를 나한테 되팔고 새 걸로 바꿔 간다고.

english: It's quite a good blade, but the big, brass gauntlet is what makes it worthwhile. It's big enough to fit over even a real gauntlet, so ye get extra protection to yer sword hand.
translation: 칼도 꽤 괜찮지만, 진짜 값어치는 커다란 놋쇠 건틀릿에 있지. 진짜 건틀릿 위에도 낄 수 있을 만큼 커서, 칼 쥐는 손을 더 단단히 지켜 준다고.

english: I can sell ye one fer 1040 coins.
Interested?
Yes.
Smart [lad/lass]! Come and see me when ye have the coins fer it.
Here ye go. I've got a load of these left over if ye need more.
translation: 자, 받아라. 더 필요하면 남는 게 잔뜩 있다.

english: No.
Well I'll still be here if ye change yer mind.
translation: 뭐, 마음 바뀌면 난 여기 있을 테니.

english: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
translation: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass(불운한 젠킨스의 행운의 커틀러스)요.

english: Arr, tis a sad tale to this sword.
translation: 아르르, 이 칼에는 슬픈 사연이 있지.

english: Jenkins was the lookout on the Jonah, a cursed vessel if there ever was one.
translation: Jenkins(젠킨스)는 Jonah(요나호)의 망꾼이었다. 저주받은 배가 있다면 바로 그 배였지.

english: One day his ship were attacked by another group of pirates durin' a fierce storm. One of their bowmen took a shot at the Cap'n of the vessel, but it were deflected off his compass and hit Jenkins in the back.
translation: 어느 날 거센 폭풍 속에서 그 배가 다른 해적 무리한테 습격을 당했어. 놈들 궁수 하나가 선장을 노리고 쐈는데, 화살이 선장 나침반에 맞고 튕겨 나가서 Jenkins(젠킨스) 등에 꽂혔지.

english: How unlucky!
That weren't the worst of it [lad/lass]. He survived the fight, and the ship's surgeon was trying to get the arrow out when...
translation: 그게 최악이 아니었다, [lad/lass]. 그 친구는 싸움에서 살아남았고, 배의 의사가 화살을 빼내려던 참이었는데...

english: Are ye familiar with the spell bones to bananas?
translation: 혹시 bones to bananas(본즈 투 바나나스)라는 주문 아냐?

english: Yes, why?
Well, due to a blow to the head he took in the fight, the surgeon cast that spell, thinking it was some sort of new healing spell.
translation: 그게, 싸움 중에 머리를 한 대 맞은 그 의사가 그 주문을 무슨 새로운 치료 주문인 줄 알고 걸어 버린 거야.

english: And he did so while touching Jenkins' ribs.
translation: 그것도 Jenkins(젠킨스)의 갈비뼈에 손을 댄 채로 말이지.

english: And that killed him?
No [lad/lass]!
See, he survived, his bones turned to bananas, as a huge storm blew up and the crew debated what to do with him.
translation: 그게, 그 친구는 살아남았어. 뼈는 바나나가 됐지만. 그때 거대한 폭풍이 몰아쳤고, 선원들은 그를 어떻게 할지 옥신각신했지.

english: But you see, the storm was actually the tail end of a hurricane that had swept the nearby jungle islands, and when it approached the ship it petered out, droppin' all manner of strange things onto the deck and into the
translation: 그런데 그 폭풍이 사실 근처 정글 섬들을 휩쓸고 온 허리케인의 끝자락이었거든. 배에 다가오면서 잦아들더니, 온갖 기묘한 것들을 갑판과

english: ocean.
The worst part was when the ship was bombarded with ravenous, hunger-crazed monkeys, the majority of which landed on Jenkins as he lay recoverin'.
translation: 최악은 굶주려 미쳐 버린 원숭이 떼가 배에 쏟아진 거였어. 그 대부분이 누워서 회복 중이던 Jenkins(젠킨스) 위로 떨어졌지.

english: See, what happened next, after the monkeys had had their way with him was...
translation: 그게 말이야, 원숭이들이 그 친구를 실컷 헤집어 놓은 다음에 벌어진 일이...

english: Look, I don't want to hear any more. Why would I want to buy his cutlass?
translation: 저기요, 더 듣고 싶지 않아요. 제가 왜 그 사람 커틀러스를 사야 하는데요?

english: Well, after the poor man passed on...
translation: 뭐, 그 불쌍한 친구가 세상을 떠난 뒤에...

english: In a final, terrifying, mashed potato coated tragedy...
translation: 으깬 감자 범벅이 된, 끔찍한 마지막 비극 속에서...

english: His shipmates found his cutlass was completely untouched.
translation: 동료 선원들이 보니 그 친구 커틀러스만은 멀쩡하더란 말이지.

english: See, having been exposed to all the bad luck that Jenkins went through, the thing is unlikely to ever see anything that bad again.
translation: 그러니까, Jenkins(젠킨스)가 겪은 온갖 불운을 다 함께 겪었으니, 이 칼한테 그보다 더 나쁜 일은 다시는 일어날 리가 없다는 거야.

english: Hence, it must be lucky.
Ye can have it fer 2560 coins.
Here ye go. I hope it brings you luck.
Gentleman Mallard's Rapier.
Well, I'll tell ye the story, but it'll take a great deal of convincin' for me to sell you this rapier.
translation: 뭐, 이야기는 해 주마. 하지만 이 레이피어를 팔게 하려면 날 꽤나 설득해야 할 거다.

english: See, gentleman Mallard is a legend in these parts. His family had been rich, shipping all sorts of goods up and down the coast.
translation: 그러니까, Gentleman Mallard(신사 맬러드)는 이 근방의 전설이지. 그 집안은 부자였어. 해안을 오르내리며 온갖 물건을 실어 나르던 해운 가문이었지.

english: Then their rivals got together and had their ships sunk, one after the other, and his business partners were all either bought off or had...accidents.
translation: 그러다 경쟁자들이 작당해서 그 집 배들을 하나씩 침몰시켰고, 사업 동료들은 죄다 매수되거나... 사고를 당했지.

english: With no money and only one ship left, he took to the life of a pirate, but no brigand was he.
translation: 돈도 없고 배도 한 척만 남자 그는 해적의 길로 들어섰지만, 결코 날강도는 아니었어.

english: He took only from those men that had brought about his downfall, was fair with his men, and generous with his loot.
translation: 자기를 몰락시킨 놈들한테서만 빼앗았고, 부하들한테는 공정했고, 전리품은 후하게 나눠 줬지.

english: Why, this island would have been wiped out by the shakes if he hadn't turned over his stash to buy medicine.
translation: 아, 그가 숨겨 둔 재물을 내놓아 약을 사 오지 않았으면 이 섬은 열병으로 싹 쓸려 나갔을 거다.

english: One day his ship was attacked by a huge sea creature that swept the decks of men with its tentacles.
translation: 어느 날 그의 배가 거대한 바다 괴물한테 습격당했어. 놈이 촉수로 갑판의 선원들을 쓸어 버렸지.

english: The crew took to the lifeboats, and the last they saw of him the gentleman was stabbin' at the thing as it hauled the ship under the water.
translation: 선원들은 구명정으로 달아났는데, 그들이 마지막으로 본 건 그 괴물이 배를 물속으로 끌어당기는 동안 놈을 찌르고 있던 신사의 모습이었지.

english: A week later about ten foot of tentacle washed up on the beach, with his rapier embedded in it to the hilt.
translation: 일주일 뒤 열 자쯤 되는 촉수 하나가 해변으로 떠밀려 왔는데, 그의 레이피어가 손잡이까지 깊숙이 박혀 있었어.

english: I took it, cleaned it up, and I've been lookin' after it ever since.
translation: 내가 그걸 가져와서 깨끗이 닦았고, 그 뒤로 쭉 간수해 왔지.

english: I can't let it go for less than 25600 coins, and even then that's a bargain.
Ye think ye have what it takes to wield it?
translation: 네가 이걸 휘두를 깜냥이 된다고 생각하냐?

english: I hope yer worthy enough to wield this, stranger. I'd hate te think Gentleman Mallard would be disappointed in me fer sellin' it to ye.
translation: 이걸 휘두를 자격이 있길 바란다, 이방인. 이걸 너한테 팔았다고 Gentleman Mallard(신사 맬러드)가 날 실망스럽게 여긴다면 견딜 수가 없을 테니.

english: Probably, let's see what you have.
I doubt it.
That depends on if you have any cutlasses.
Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass.
translation: Brass Hand Harry's Cutlass(놋쇠손 해리의 커틀러스)요.

english: Yes.
No.
Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass.
translation: Unlucky Jenkins' Lucky Cutlass(불운한 젠킨스의 행운의 커틀러스)요.

english: Gentleman Mallard's Rapier
Can you teach me the basics of smelting please?
translation: 제련의 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: You'll need to have mined some ore to smelt first. Go see the mining tutor to the south if you're not sure how to do this.
translation: 제련하려면 먼저 광석을 캐 와야 해요. 방법을 잘 모르겠으면 남쪽에 있는 mining tutor(채광 교사)를 찾아가 보세요.

english: I see you have some ore with you to smelt, so let's get started.
translation: 제련할 광석을 가져오셨네요. 그럼 시작해 볼까요.

english: Click on the furnace to bring up a menu of metal bars you can try to make from your ore.
translation: 용광로를 클릭하면 광석으로 만들 수 있는 금속 주괴 메뉴가 나와요.

english: When you have a full inventory, take it to the bank, you can find it on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge.
translation: 소지품이 가득 차면 은행에 가져가세요. 은행은 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 지붕 위에 있어요.

english: If you have a hammer with you, you can smith the bronze bars into equipment on the anvil outside.
translation: 망치를 가지고 있다면 바깥에 있는 모루에서 청동 주괴로 장비를 만들 수 있어요.

english: I'm afraid the weather over the years has rusted it down, so it can only be used to work bronze.
translation: 아쉽게도 오랜 세월 비바람에 녹이 슬어서 청동만 다룰 수 있어요.

english: Alternatively you can run up to Varrock. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city, he can help you smith better gear.
translation: 아니면 Varrock(바록)까지 달려가도 돼요. 도시 서쪽에 계신 제 스승님, Smithing Tutor(대장일 교사)를 찾아보세요. 더 좋은 장비를 만드는 법을 도와주실 거예요.

english: I already know about the basics of smelting, got any tips?
translation: 제련 기초는 이미 알아요. 팁 있어요?

english: I find it useful to stockpile my ore before smelting it in one go, or even do it on the way to the bank in such places as Al Kharid or Falador. But you can do it anyway you want, one load at a time is fine too!
translation: 저는 광석을 모아 두었다가 한 번에 제련하거나, Al Kharid(알 카리드)나 Falador(팔라도르) 같은 곳에서 은행 가는 길에 제련하는 게 편하더라고요. 그래도 원하는 대로 하시면 돼요. 한 번에 한 짐씩 해도 괜찮아요!

english: Not too much can go wrong with smelting.
translation: 제련할 때는 크게 잘못될 일이 별로 없어요.

english: You will lose some iron when smelting that ore, but a Ring of Forging or the Superheat Item spell will soon solve that.
translation: 철광석을 제련할 때는 철이 좀 날아가지만, Ring of Forging(단조의 반지)나 Superheat Item(슈퍼히트 아이템) 주문이 있으면 금방 해결돼요.

english: You should also investigate Keldagrim, the dwarven city, you may find better places to smelt your ore with friends.
translation: 드워프의 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림)도 둘러보세요. 친구들과 함께 광석을 제련하기 좋은 곳을 찾을 수도 있어요.

english: What do I do after smelting the ore?
Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. Go to Varrock, that's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
translation: 아, 대장일을 배워야죠. Varrock(바록)으로 가세요. 제 스승님인 Smithing Tutor(대장일 교사)가 거기서 일하고 계세요. 대장일을 가르쳐 달라고 부탁해 보세요.

english: Smelt some ore and store it in the bank. Grab a hammer from the general store before you go too!
translation: 광석을 제련해서 은행에 넣어 두세요. 떠나기 전에 잡화점에서 망치도 하나 챙기시고요!

english: Are you here to make juniper charcoal?
Tell me about juniper charcoal.
translation: juniper charcoal(노간주나무 숯)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: They use it in the blast mine, out near Lovakengj. It's powerful stuff, more volatile than the regular charcoal you get elsewhere.
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기) 근처 발파 광산에서 써요. 아주 센 물건이라, 다른 데서 구하는 보통 숯보다 훨씬 폭발성이 강해요.

english: To make juniper charcoal, put some juniper logs in my furnaces, then set them alight. I'll keep an eye on it for a fee of 600 coins.
translation: juniper charcoal(노간주나무 숯)을 만들려면 제 용광로에 juniper logs(노간주나무 통나무)를 넣고 불을 붙이세요. 600코인을 내시면 제가 지켜봐 드릴게요.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Juniper charcoal is my trade, always has been, ever since my mum taught me. She's retired now, and returned to Lovakengj - that's where we're from.
translation: 노간주나무 숯 만드는 게 제 일이에요. 엄마한테 배운 뒤로 쭉 그랬죠. 엄마는 이제 은퇴하시고 Lovakengj(로바켕기)로 돌아가셨어요. 저희 고향이 거기거든요.

english: I just live out here in the Hosidius farmlands because it's handy for the juniper trees.
translation: 저는 노간주나무가 가까워서 Hosidius(호시디우스) 농지에 나와 살고 있어요.

english: What can you do for me?
translation: 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: For a small fee, I watch the charcoal furnace so that you can make charcoal here. Also, I do a great back- rub, if you're ever in the mood.
translation: 약간의 수수료를 받고 charcoal furnace(숯 용광로)를 지켜봐 드려요. 그러니까 여기서 숯을 만들 수 있죠. 그리고 제가 등 마사지도 끝내주게 해요. 혹시 받고 싶으시면요.

english: Have you got a spare tinderbox?
Yup, but I'll keep it for someone who needs it.
translation: 네, 그런데 정말 필요한 사람 주려고 아껴 두고 있어요.

english: Yup, but you can't hold it.
translation: 네, 그런데 들고 갈 자리가 없으시네요.

english: Sure, you can have it.
I'll be off.
Tell me about juniper charcoal.
translation: juniper charcoal(노간주나무 숯)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about yourself.
What can you do for me?
translation: 저한테 뭘 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Have you got a spare tinderbox?
I'll be off.
Are you safe to keep as a pet?
Yes, human.
So where's the fire?
I don't have a fire.
No smoke without fire!
Please stop, human.
So you don't cause lung disease?
translation: 그럼 폐병 같은 건 안 옮겨요?

english: We're safe if you don't inhale.
Good to know.
So you don't leave soot everywhere?
translation: 그럼 그을음을 여기저기 묻히고 다니진 않아요?

english: Would you defecate on the floor like a camel? Neither would I. So no, I do not leave soot everywhere.
translation: 너는 낙타처럼 바닥에 볼일을 보나? 나도 안 그런다. 그러니 아니다, 나는 그을음을 여기저기 묻히고 다니지 않는다.

english: That's nice of you.
Never mind.
Your kind comes in three different sizes?
Four, actually.
Wow. Whoever created you wasn't very creative. You're just resized versions of one another!
translation: 와. 당신들을 만든 존재는 창의력이 별로였나 봐요. 그냥 서로 크기만 바꾼 거잖아요!

english: Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
*slap*
Skrrr!
Kssss!
Hissss!
So where's the fire?
So you don't cause lung disease?
translation: 그럼 폐병 같은 건 안 옮겨요?

english: So you don't leave soot everywhere?
translation: 그럼 그을음을 여기저기 묻히고 다니진 않아요?

english: Never mind.
Hello!
Hello?
Hey!
Smokin' Joe ignores you.
Hi! What are you doing?
Isn't it obvious?
No, not really.
Bluaaghhaha! Ahem. Sorry.
I'm trying to smoke these pesky rats out. Ahem-hem-hem.
translation: 이 성가신 쥐 놈들을 연기로 몰아내려는 중일세. 크흠흠흠.

english: Are you alright?
I'll - ugh - I'll be fine, youngin'. My lungs just aren't up for ratcatchin' like they used to be.
translation: 괜- 쿨럭- 괜찮을 걸세, 젊은이. 내 폐가 예전처럼 쥐잡이를 버텨 내질 못해서 그래.

english: Bluaaghhaha!
Ratcatching, you say?
I could help you. I'm young-ish and my lungs are doing fine so far.
translation: 제가 도와드릴 수 있어요. 저는 그럭저럭 젊고, 폐도 아직 멀쩡하거든요.

english: That's-
Bluaaaghhaha!
-kind of you, youngin'.
What's up with your lungs anyway?
translation: 그런데 폐는 왜 그렇게 되신 거예요?

english: Years of blowin' smoke into rat holes, youngin'.
translation: 오랜 세월 쥐구멍에 연기를 불어넣다 보니 그렇게 됐지, 젊은이.

english: Oh dear. Speaking of rats...
You offered to help me out.
That's right! Me and my cat have been learning from the best of the best.
translation: 맞아요! 저랑 제 고양이는 최고 중의 최고들한테 배웠거든요.

english: The Sisters Grime, Jimmy Dazzler, Hooknosed Jack...
translation: The Sisters Grime(그라임 자매), Jimmy Dazzler(지미 대즐러), Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)...

english: Blimey, that's my old crew! How are they all?
translation: 이런, 내 옛 동료들이잖나! 다들 잘 지내던가?

english: Better now that I've helped them out, I think.
translation: 제가 도와드려서 이제 좀 나아졌을 거예요.

english: Now, how should I get rid of these rats?
translation: 자, 이 쥐들은 어떻게 없애면 돼요?

english: That's sim-
bluaaghhaha...
simple. Take this pot, light the contents, and blow the smoke into the hole.
translation: -단하네. 이 단지를 가져가서 안에 든 것에 불을 붙이고, 연기를 구멍에 불어넣게.

english: Er... this pot specifically?
Aye, this pot. What's wrong with it?
It's a bit... phlegmy...
You'd better make your own then. A-hem-hem.
translation: 그럼 자네가 직접 만드는 게 낫겠군. 크흠흠.

english: Just take a simple pot and stick some ordinary garden weeds in it. Then light the pot and use it on a rat hole.
translation: 평범한 단지에 흔한 정원 잡초를 좀 꽂아 넣게. 그런 다음 단지에 불을 붙여서 쥐구멍에 쓰면 되네.

english: Great. I'll get to it.
Have you got that job done yet, youngin'?
No, not yet.
How's your cough?
Aheeh - hoo.
Better with you helpin' me out, youngin'.
Say, when the job's done, how about I show you to the Rat Pits here in Keldagrim?
translation: 그런데 말이야, 일이 끝나면 내가 여기 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 Rat Pits(쥐 구덩이)를 구경시켜 주는 건 어떤가?

english: That seems a fair deal. But I'd appreciate any pointers you could give me.
translation: 공평한 거래네요. 그래도 조언을 좀 해 주시면 고맙겠어요.

english: An extra pair of eyes or set of claws can often come in handy.
translation: 눈 한 쌍이나 발톱 한 벌이 더 있으면 쓸모가 있을 때가 많지.

english: Do you have any more straightforward hints?
Bluaaaghhaha! Hurk-!
Never mind, I'll figure it out!
I got the rats.
Well good - ahem - good show.
I'd better show you our rat pits here in Keldagrim.
translation: 그럼 여기 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 쥐 구덩이를 보여 줘야겠군.

english: Great stuff. Let's go.
They're nice, but the ones they have in Port Sarim are even better.
translation: 여기도 괜찮지만, Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 있는 건 더 좋다네.

english: They have rat pits in Port Sarim?
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)에도 쥐 구덩이가 있어요?

english: Oh yes! It's the best place to train your wily cat.
translation: 그렇다마다! wily cat(영리한 고양이)를 훈련시키기엔 최고의 장소지.

english: Wily cats?
Well, I suppose there's no harm tellin' you.
translation: 뭐, 자네한테 말해 줘도 해 될 건 없겠지.

english: A-hem!
Look for 'The Face' in Port Sarim. She'll show you.
translation: Port Sarim(포트 사림)에서 'The Face(얼굴)'를 찾아보게. 그 아가씨가 알려 줄 걸세.

english: So where are the Keldagrim rat pits then?
translation: 그럼 Keldagrim(켈다그림)의 쥐 구덩이는 어디 있어요?

english: Down the stairs to the basement of the 'Laughing Miner'. Get yourself a drink, too, you've earned it.
translation: 'Laughing Miner(웃는 광부)' 지하로 내려가는 계단 아래일세. 가서 한잔하게나. 자넨 그럴 자격이 있어.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Phingspet and Grimesquit?
translation: Phingspet(핑스펫)이랑 Grimesquit(그라임스킷)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Ah, the sisters Grime, as strange a pair as you're ever likely to meet.
translation: 아, 그라임 자매 말이군. 자네가 평생 만나 볼 사람 중에 그만큼 괴상한 한 쌍도 없을 걸세.

english: You'll find them in the sewers of Varrock.
Can you tell me where I could find Jimmy Dazzler?
translation: Jimmy Dazzler(지미 대즐러)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Ah, young Jimmy, he must be a made man by now.
translation: 아, 젊은 Jimmy(지미) 말이군. 지금쯤이면 한자리하고 있겠지.

english: I remember when he was a lad...
Do you remember where to find him, too?
Hrmph! His old waterin' hole was the Flying Horse in Ardougne.
translation: 흠! 그 녀석이 단골로 드나들던 술집은 Ardougne(아르둔)의 Flying Horse(날개 달린 말)였지.

english: Can you tell me where I could find Hooknosed Jack?
translation: Hooknosed Jack(매부리코 잭)은 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: That old brawler? Is he still knockin' about?
translation: 그 늙은 싸움꾼 말인가? 아직도 돌아다니고 있나?

english: Well, your best bet would be somewhere on the east side of Varrock. It's rough around there though, be careful.
translation: 글쎄, Varrock(바록) 동쪽 어딘가가 제일 확률이 높을 걸세. 그쪽은 험한 동네니 조심하게.

english: Can you tell me where I could find 'The Face'?
You'll find her in Port Sarim.
Can you tell me where I could find Felkrash?
Ah, the boss herself. You'll probably find her in the Port Sarim rat pits.
translation: 아, 두목 말이군. 아마 Port Sarim(포트 사림) 쥐 구덩이에 있을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me more about the pits?
Here take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 자, 이거 받게. 쓸모가 있을 걸세.

english: What do you want to know?
Do you have any pointers for me and my cat?
translation: 저랑 제 고양이한테 해 줄 조언 있어요?

english: You should wear an Amulet of Catspeak. It will allow you to organise tactics with your cat.
translation: Amulet of Catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 차게. 그걸 차면 고양이와 작전을 짤 수 있지.

english: What would be the best tactic to adopt then?
Well, that depends on your outlook, whether you're ready to risk your cat's life or not and how defensive or aggressive you want your cat to be.
translation: 글쎄, 자네 생각에 달렸지. 고양이 목숨을 걸 각오가 돼 있는지, 고양이가 얼마나 방어적이길, 또는 공격적이길 바라는지 말일세.

english: I will not risk my cat's life.
translation: 제 고양이 목숨을 걸 순 없어요.

english: Well if that's the case then you're left with two choices.
You can adopt an ultra defensive strategy, which increases your cat's hitpoints and defence but causes it to flee sooner.
translation: 초방어 전략을 쓸 수 있네. 고양이의 체력과 방어가 올라가지만 더 일찍 도망치게 되지.

english: Or you can adopt a less defensive strategy, which will allow your cat to stay in the pit for longer.
translation: 아니면 덜 방어적인 전략을 쓸 수도 있네. 그러면 고양이가 구덩이에서 더 오래 버틸 수 있지.

english: I think I would adopt a very defensive strategy
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Just take care of yourself, cat.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이한테 이렇게 말하게. '그냥 몸조심해, 고양아.'

english: Thanks for your help.
Do you have any other questions about the pits?
No thanks.
I think I would adopt a less defensive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Stay in for as long as you can.'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이한테 이렇게 말하게. '최대한 오래 버텨.'

english: I am willing to risk my cat, if it increases my chances of victory.
translation: 이길 확률이 올라간다면 고양이를 위험에 빠뜨릴 각오가 돼 있어요.

english: In that case you are left with two choices.
You could go for all out attack which will boost your cat's attack and strength, but weaken it.
translation: 전면 공격을 택하면 고양이의 공격과 힘이 올라가지만, 대신 맷집은 약해지지.

english: Or, go for a less aggressive stance, which will increase your cat's strength and attack to a lesser degree, but carries no defensive penalties.
translation: 아니면 덜 공격적인 자세를 택하게. 고양이의 힘과 공격이 덜 오르는 대신, 방어 불이익은 없다네.

english: I think I would adopt a very aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'Go berserk!'
I think I would adopt a less aggressive strategy.
In that case you should tell your cat: 'No guts, no glory!'
translation: 그렇다면 고양이한테 이렇게 말하게. '용기 없인 영광도 없다!'

english: What benefits does my cat get from training in the pits?
translation: 구덩이에서 훈련하면 제 고양이한테 어떤 이득이 있어요?

english: It depends on what kind of cat you have.
translation: 자네 고양이가 어떤 종류냐에 따라 다르지.

english: In the Keldagrim pits, your cat will grow wiser by gaining more experience.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림) 구덩이에서는 고양이가 경험치를 더 쌓아서 더 영리해진다네.

english: It was as if they had ranged across the actions of a thousand species and taken them for their own.

english: For nearly two thousand years they dreamed in a creative mania without antecedent.
translation: 이천 년 가까이, 그들은 유례없는 창조의 광기 속에서 꿈을 꾸었다.

english: They looked into the eyes and minds of other species and with their own intellect superseded them.
translation: 그들은 다른 종의 눈과 정신을 들여다보았고, 자신들의 지성으로 그들을 넘어섰다.

english: They destroyed many, coopted others, and in the space between necessity and carelessness, left some to grow as untended as any species could in the wake of their ubiquity.

english: They swarmed across the continents and oceans of a Gielinor they called their own, and shattered it into a billion imbricate worlds.
translation: 그들은 자기 것이라 부르던 Gielinor(길리노르)의 대륙과 대양을 가로질러 떼 지어 퍼져 나갔고, 그것을 겹겹이 포개진 수십억 개의 세계로 산산조각 냈다.

english: And they were, by the twisted jungles of their slaughterhouses, ruthless and aloof beyond measure.
translation: 그리고 그들은, 그 도살장들의 뒤틀린 정글로 보건대, 헤아릴 수 없을 만큼 무자비하고 냉담했다.

english: The worst of us.

english: We rest upon their shoulders.
translation: 우리는 그들의 어깨 위에 기대어 있다.

english: The world has grown older, senescent.

translation: 우리는 침팬지이고, 고릴라이고, 오랑우탄이며, 개코원숭이이자 그 이상이다.

english: We are, whether we like it or not, the blood legatees of humanity.
translation: 좋든 싫든, 우리는 인류의 피를 이은 상속자다.

english: We are the children of men, but our mistakes will not be their mistakes.
translation: 우리는 인간의 자손이지만, 우리의 실수는 그들의 실수가 되지 않으리라.

english: We are telling a story.
We are telling a story of life, of what it means to live together in this universe, with vastly different modes of being, of seeing, of knowing.
translation: 삶의 이야기를, 서로 전혀 다른 존재 방식과 보는 방식과 아는 방식을 지닌 채 이 우주에서 함께 산다는 것이 무엇을 뜻하는지에 대한 이야기를.

english: Of sharing our own internal worlds with each other and making the universe we live in better for it. The empathy of a mind speaking to another mind, a vastly different mind, and yet each understanding each.
translation: 각자의 내면 세계를 서로 나누고 그로써 우리가 사는 우주를 더 낫게 만드는 이야기를. 한 정신이 다른 정신에게, 전혀 다른 정신에게 말을 건네고, 그럼에도 서로가 서로를 이해하는 공감의 이야기를.

english: And if not, if the barriers seem too great, then striving to overcome them.
translation: 그리고 그렇지 못하다면, 장벽이 너무 높아 보인다면, 그것을 넘어서려 애쓰는 이야기를.

english: Sorrow in what humanity did to this world, in the horrors they unleashed, in their cataclysm of despair, in the tens of thousands of species that will never walk or swim or fly again.
translation: 인류가 이 세상에 저지른 일에 대한, 그들이 풀어놓은 공포에 대한, 그들이 일으킨 절망의 대재앙에 대한, 다시는 걷지도 헤엄치지도 날지도 못할 수만 종에 대한 슬픔을.

english: Extinctions abounded in their wake, and yet look now at this sunbright land, at the joys we have brought to it, to have bound the chaotic climate to our will.
translation: 그들이 지나간 자리에는 멸종이 넘쳐났다. 그러나 이제 이 햇빛 찬란한 땅을, 우리가 이곳에 가져온 기쁨을, 혼돈의 기후를 우리 뜻대로 길들인 것을 보라.

english: To have thought deeply of the future of this world, a sense of respect, of shared reverence for it and all who live within it.
translation: 이 세상의 미래를 깊이 고민했다는 것을, 이 세상과 그 안에 사는 모든 존재를 향한 존중과 함께 나누는 경외심을.
