Well, there's not much to tell really.
I used to take part in great big snowball tournaments around Gielinor.
translation: 예전엔 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에서 열리는 커다란 눈싸움 대회에 나가곤 했어요.

english: I won every single one.
I was unstoppable.
Some might say there was snow stopping you.
translation: 그야말로 눈에 뵈는 게 없으셨겠네요. 사방이 눈이었을 테니까요.

english: Oh dear...
I was an awful person back then... Didn't make time for anyone. It was all about winning.
translation: 그땐 정말 끔찍한 사람이었어요... 누구한테도 시간을 내주지 않았죠. 오로지 이기는 것뿐이었어요.

english: I missed my pet rock's first birthday, what kind of person does that?
translation: pet rock(애완 돌)의 첫 생일도 놓쳤다니까요. 세상에 어떤 사람이 그래요?

english: I was a monster...
The last thing I remember before getting this gig with Santa was me trying to help someone.
translation: Santa(산타)한테 이 일을 받기 전에 마지막으로 기억나는 건, 누군가를 도우려 했던 거예요.

english: Apparently I tried to save some Gnome children from a catastrophic avalanche to the north.
translation: 듣자 하니 북쪽에서 일어난 끔찍한 눈사태에서 Gnome(노움) 아이들을 구하려고 했대요.

english: Next thing I knew, I was talking to Santa and he asked me to come to The Nutcracker.
translation: 정신을 차려 보니 Santa(산타)랑 얘기하고 있었는데, 산타가 저더러 The Nutcracker(호두까기)로 와 달라고 하더라고요.

english: Wow, so now you're on your journey to be a better person?
translation: 우와, 그래서 이제 더 나은 사람이 되는 여정 중인 거군요?

english: Yup, though I do get thorough enjoyment watching people being pelted with snowballs.
translation: 네, 그래도 사람들이 눈뭉치 세례를 맞는 걸 구경하는 건 아주 즐겁지만요.

english: Happy Holidays!
You too [player name].
Dodge the attack.
Let the ball hit you.
Do you enjoy being a festive game host?
What's your story?
Happy Holidays!
Thank you for getting our herb patches to work. Now Boulder can grow goutweed for my people, and they are very happy.
translation: 우리 약초밭이 제대로 돌아가게 해 주셔서 고마워요. 이제 Boulder(바위)가 우리 백성을 위해 goutweed(구트위드)를 기를 수 있게 돼서, 다들 무척 기뻐하고 있어요.

english: Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 그 책 한 권 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Yes, I have another copy for you.
Thanks.
How are you two doing?
Snowflake an' My Arm very happy. Maybe new herbie patch not da only place where new life gonna be growin' soon!
translation: Snowflake(눈송이)랑 My Arm(마이 암) 아주 행복! 어쩌면 새 약초밭만 새 생명 자라는 데 아닐지도 몰라!

english: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, dear! But the town is thriving; my people are much happier now they are no longer terrified of Father.
translation: 너무 앞서가지 말아요, 여보! 그래도 마을은 번창하고 있어요. 이제 아버지를 두려워하지 않아도 되니 우리 백성도 훨씬 행복해졌고요.

english: Dem trolls likin' da goutweed too!
That's nice.
Can you note my basalt for me?
translation: 제 basalt(현무암)을 은행권으로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: You aren't carrying any basalt.
I'll be off.
You will always be welcome back.
Here, solve this.
My Arm hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: My Arm(마이 암)이 퍼즐 상자를 건넨다!

english: That doesn't look solved to me.
Well done [player name]. Here you go.
You've been given a [new clue/casket]!
Can I have another copy of that book?
translation: 그 책 한 권 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: How are you two doing?
Can you note this basalt for me?
translation: 이 basalt(현무암)을 은행권으로 바꿔 주실 수 있어요?

english: I'll be off.
Kuani! Someone's come to visit the birds!
I've spotted you working hard to help the guild. How would you like a basic quetzal whistle blueprint to help you get back here in the future?
translation: 길드를 위해 열심히 일하시는 걸 봤어요. 나중에 여기로 돌아오기 편하도록 basic quetzal whistle blueprint(기본 케찰 호루라기 설계도)를 하나 드릴까요?

english: I'd love one!
You'll need to use the blueprint to craft a whistle from a willow log. Make sure it works for you. There's no standard size whistle nowadays.
translation: 그 설계도를 보고 willow log(버드나무 통나무)로 호루라기를 만드시면 돼요. 본인한테 잘 맞는지 꼭 확인하세요. 요즘은 호루라기에 표준 크기라는 게 없거든요.

english: When you want to charge your whistle, be sure to bring some of those lovely meats you're gathering up here for the birds. If they eat well you'll get a lot more use out of them!
translation: 호루라기를 충전하고 싶을 땐, 여기서 모으고 계신 그 맛있는 고기를 새들 몫으로 꼭 가져오세요. 새들이 잘 먹으면 호루라기를 훨씬 더 많이 쓸 수 있을 거예요!

english: Not right now, thanks.
Who are you?
I'm Pitri, though most of the others call me birdbrain.
translation: 저는 Pitri(피트리)예요. 다른 사람들은 대부분 저를 새대가리라고 부르지만요.

english: On account of the...?
The birds, yes. I just feel so at home amongst them... Though I am more partial to cooked food than the raw stuff they get.
translation: 네, 새 때문이죠. 새들 사이에 있으면 그렇게 마음이 편하더라고요... 그래도 새들이 먹는 날것보다는 익힌 음식이 더 좋지만요.

english: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 새에 대해 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Absolutely! Like many in Varlamore, we here at the guild use quetzals to help us move people and reports throughout the entire network of transport nodes.
translation: 물론이죠! Varlamore(바를라모어)의 많은 곳들처럼, 저희 길드도 quetzal(케찰)을 이용해 이동 거점 네트워크 곳곳으로 사람과 보고서를 실어 나르고 있어요.

english: We also have these handy quetzal whistles that allow us to call for one to take us back to the guild. They're pretty magical and work at very long ranges.
translation: 그리고 길드로 돌아갈 때 케찰을 불러 주는 편리한 quetzal whistle(케찰 호루라기)도 있어요. 꽤 신기한 물건이라 아주 먼 거리에서도 통하죠.

english: Could I get my hands on one of those whistles?
translation: 저도 그 호루라기를 하나 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Once you've become more settled in with us at the guild, absolutely.
translation: 저희 길드에 좀 더 자리를 잡으시면, 물론이죠.

english: Sure! I have a blueprint set aside for you to grab when you're ready.
translation: 그럼요! 준비되시면 가져가시라고 설계도를 하나 따로 챙겨 뒀어요.

english: So how do you motivate the birds?
Food, mostly. They're big fans of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them. I'm worried they may be waiting to eat us, quite honestly!
translation: 주로 먹이죠. 사냥꾼들이 가져오는 날고기를 아주 좋아하거든요. 솔직히 말하면, 새들이 우리를 잡아먹을 날만 기다리는 건 아닌지 걱정돼요!

english: Well, they're certainly big enough to try.
translation: 하긴, 그러고도 남을 만큼 크긴 하네요.

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 제 호루라기 충전해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Doesn't look like you've got anything I can feed to the birds here. You'll want to get some of the raw meats that the hunters bring back with them.
translation: 새들한테 먹일 만한 걸 안 갖고 계신 것 같네요. 사냥꾼들이 가져오는 날고기를 좀 구해 오세요.

english: Sure thing!
Looks like the birds are all full for now. Make them work a bit before feeding them again!
translation: 새들이 지금은 다 배부른 것 같네요. 다시 먹이기 전에 일 좀 시키세요!

english: There you go. Some whistle charges for you!
How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 호루라기를 더 얻으려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: I can produce another blueprint for you, for a small cost.
translation: 약간의 비용만 내시면 설계도를 하나 더 만들어 드릴 수 있어요.

english: What sort of small cost?
500 coins. These blueprints are my art, and before you say anything, 'exposure' is the last thing I want out here in the savannah.
translation: 500코인이요. 이 설계도는 제 작품이에요. 그리고 뭐라 하시기 전에 말해 두는데, '노출 효과'로 갚겠다는 건 사절이에요. 이 사바나 땡볕 아래선 노출이라면 이미 질리도록 하고 있거든요.

english: Here you go, one whistle blueprint.
I'd better be off.
Odd. You don't seem to have a whistle I can recharge.
translation: 이상하네요. 충전할 호루라기를 갖고 계시지 않은 것 같은데요.

english: Please solve this for me. I have other things to be thinking about.
translation: 이것 좀 풀어 주세요. 저는 생각할 일이 따로 많거든요.

english: Sorry but you haven't solved the puzzle yet.
Thanks [player name]!
Yes.
No.
Who are you?
Can you teach me about the birds?
translation: 새에 대해 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Can you recharge my whistle?
translation: 제 호루라기 충전해 주실 수 있어요?

english: How do I get my hands on more whistles?
translation: 호루라기를 더 얻으려면 어떻게 해야 해요?

english: I'd better be off.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너만큼 못생겼으면 감히 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀었을 거야!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 잡아먹고 와서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 나한테 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 저리 가, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 얘기할 생각 없어.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참한 날이야... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에선 처음 맡아 보는 냄새인데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무-우-척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛을 제대로 아는 녀석처럼 보이는구나.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이 사이에 누가 좀 끼어서...

english: By Ralos, we finally have a worthy challenger.
translation: Ralos(랄로스)께 맹세코, 드디어 쓸 만한 도전자가 나타났군.

english: You've torn through multiple waves of combatants and you're still standing. I'm almost impressed.
translation: 수많은 투사들을 연달아 헤치고도 아직 서 있다니. 하마터면 감탄할 뻔했다.

english: Now let's see how you handle a real foe...
translation: 이제 진짜 적을 어떻게 상대하는지 보자...

english: Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat...
You're back so soon? A lesser combatant would've retired in shame after the show you put on last time...
translation: 벌써 돌아왔나? 지난번 그런 꼴을 보였으면 하찮은 투사는 부끄러워서 은퇴했을 텐데...

english: But you're clearly different. Let's see what you have this time...
translation: 하지만 넌 확실히 다르군. 이번엔 무엇을 보여 줄지 보자...

english: What is it they say? Third time's the charm? Let's see if that's true.
translation: 뭐라고들 하더라? 삼세번이면 된다던가? 정말 그런지 보자.

english: To arms!
You might be an incapable fighter, but at least you're persistent. Shall we?
translation: 무능한 투사일지는 몰라도 끈기 하나는 있군. 시작해 볼까?

english: Let's start by testing your footwork.
Not bad. Let's try something else...
translation: 나쁘지 않군. 다른 걸 해 보자...

english: Impressive. Let's see how you handle this...
You can't win!
Ralos guides my hand!
LET'S END THIS!
Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer.
translation: Sol Heredit(솔 헤레딧)은 당신의 성급한 기도를 달갑게 여기지 않는다.

english: I'LL BREAK YOURBACK!
I'LL CRUSH YOURBODY!
I'LL TWIST YOURHANDSOFF!
I'LL BREAK YOURLEGS!
I'LL CUT YOURFEETOFF!
Sol Heredit grabs hold of your [body part/item] and deals massive damage!
translation: Sol Heredit(솔 헤레딧)이 당신의 [body part/item]을(를) 움켜쥐고 막대한 피해를 입힌다!

english: You defended the wrong body part!
You successfully defend your [body part] from Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: Sol Heredit(솔 헤레딧)의 잡기 공격으로부터 [body part]을(를) 지켜 냈다!

english: You perfectly parry Sol Heredit's grapple!
translation: Sol Heredit(솔 헤레딧)의 잡기 공격을 완벽하게 받아쳤다!

english: Your light shines... brightly...
A worthy... opponent...
Ralos has smiled upon you...
My compliments, champion...
How disappointing...
I knew you weren't the one.
You had me excited for a moment.
Your lack of coordination is concerning.
Your light shines no more.
Maybe next time...
Pathetic, really...
I was just getting into my rhythm...
Hello.
Hello.
Are you in charge of this squad?
Yes. We're guarding this entrance against demonic excursions.
translation: 그렇습니다. 악마들의 침입에 대비해 이 입구를 지키고 있습니다.

english: How's that going?
Not super well, I'm afraid. It's a nerve wracking post, and it's taking its toll on my soldiers.
translation: 유감스럽게도 썩 좋지는 않습니다. 신경이 곤두서는 초소라, 병사들이 많이 지쳐 가고 있습니다.

english: Can I do anything to help?
Not in any official capacity. Making any sort of move might spark a chain reaction.
translation: 공식적으로는 없습니다. 섣불리 움직였다가는 연쇄 반응을 일으킬 수도 있으니까요.

english: But unofficially...
It would be good to know what's going on down there. If you can handle yourself, and you can keep an eye on the demons, you might be able to help.
translation: 저 아래에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 알 수 있다면 좋겠습니다. 스스로를 지킬 수 있고 악마들을 지켜볼 수 있다면, 도움이 될지도 모르겠군요.

english: We just need to know if it looks like they're preparing for anything. But if you do this, you're on your own. If anything happens, I won't be able to send help.
translation: 놈들이 무언가를 준비하는 것처럼 보이는지만 알면 됩니다. 하지만 이 일을 맡는다면 전적으로 혼자입니다. 무슨 일이 생겨도 지원을 보내 드릴 수 없습니다.

english: Understood. Well, if I see anything suspicious, I'll be sure to casually mention it.
translation: 알겠어요. 그럼 수상한 걸 보게 되면 지나가는 말로 슬쩍 말씀드릴게요.

english: Thank you.
What wrong with your soldiers?
Some of them are afraid, others impatient. That's the biggest problem actually. They're all having different reactions. It's making it difficult to work as a unit.
translation: 겁에 질린 자도 있고, 조급해하는 자도 있습니다. 사실 그게 가장 큰 문제입니다. 다들 반응이 제각각이라 하나의 부대로 움직이기가 어렵습니다.

english: Do they usually have this problem?
No, they're good soldiers. I suspect it has something to do with those cultists and their little chats.
translation: 아닙니다, 다들 훌륭한 병사들입니다. 아무래도 그 광신도들과 놈들이 자꾸 걸어오는 잡담 나부랭이와 관련이 있는 것 같습니다.

english: Not that we can do much about that. We can't afford to initiate hostilities. There's a lot at stake, and I'm honestly not sure we could handle a direct confrontation.
translation: 그렇다고 저희가 할 수 있는 일도 별로 없습니다. 먼저 적대 행위를 시작할 여유는 없으니까요. 걸린 게 많은 데다, 솔직히 정면 충돌을 감당할 수 있을지도 잘 모르겠습니다.

english: That does sound like a difficult situation to be in.
Goodbye.
Goodbye.
Can I do anything to help?
What's wrong with your soldiers?
Goodbye.
Hello.
What are you doing here?
Not a lot.
That's a big chasm you're standing by.
translation: 엄청 큰 협곡 옆에 서 계시네요.

english: Yep.
What did you think of the coronation?
Pretty good.
That's a nice looking axe. Is it heavy?
Thanks. Not really.
Interested in doing any trading?
I've got everything I need.
I have vital information pertaining to the cult of Yama.
translation: Yama(야마) 교단에 관한 중요한 정보가 있어요.

english: You should speak to the lieutenant.
That's it!
What?
Why don't you want to talk to me!
translation: 왜 저랑 얘기를 안 하려는 거예요!

english: I'm confused.
I've been trying to make conversation with you and I feel like I'm getting nowhere.
translation: 계속 말을 걸어 보는데 대화가 하나도 안 되는 것 같단 말이에요.

english: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you feel that way. I'm not a very chatty person.
translation: 미안해요. 그렇게 느끼게 하려던 건 아니었어요. 제가 말수가 별로 없는 사람이라서요.

english: Your feelings are valid, and you deserve to be heard. That said, it might be good to examine your reaction.
translation: 그렇게 느끼는 건 당연하고, 당신 이야기는 존중받아야 해요. 그렇긴 해도, 방금 보인 반응은 한번 돌아보는 게 좋을 것 같아요.

english: Thank you. What do you mean?
Would you agree that people aren't under any obligation to talk to anyone else?
translation: 사람은 누구에게도 꼭 말을 걸어 줄 의무는 없다는 데 동의하세요?

english: I suppose so.
With us, it was just a misunderstanding. With somebody else, you might have been pushing a boundary.
translation: 우리 사이에선 그냥 오해였어요. 하지만 다른 사람이었다면 선을 넘은 걸 수도 있어요.

english: It risks coming off as having a bit of a 'main character' complex.
translation: 자칫하면 '주인공 병'이 좀 있는 사람처럼 보일 수 있거든요.

english: That's a fair point. Thank you for explaining it in that way.
translation: 일리 있는 말이네요. 그렇게 설명해 줘서 고마워요.

english: No problem. Have a good day, friend.
Goodbye.
Hello. Everything well?
Hello. Yes, thank you.
What are you doing here?
That's a big chasm you're standing by.
translation: 엄청 큰 협곡 옆에 서 계시네요.

english: What did you think of the coronation?
That's a nice looking axe. Is it heavy?
Interested in doing any trading?
More options...
I have vital information pertaining to the cult of Yama.
translation: Yama(야마) 교단에 관한 중요한 정보가 있어요.

english: Previous options...
Hi!
Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.
translation: Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.(실례. 개 문제로 사람을 좀 만나러 가야 해서.)

english: Errare humanum est.
Die dulci freure.
Carpe Diem!
Te audire non possum. Musa sapientum fixa est in aure.
translation: Te audire non possum. Musa sapientum fixa est in aure.(안 들려. 귀에 바나나가 꽂혀 있거든.)

english: Furnulum pani nolo.
Fac ut gaudeam.
translation: Fac ut gaudeam.(어디 한번 해 봐라.)

english: Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant!
translation: Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant!(야만인들이 네 개인 공간을 침범하길!)

english: Quantum materiae materietur marmota monax si marmota monax materiam possit materiari?
translation: Quantum materiae materietur marmota monax si marmota monax materiam possit materiari?(나무 던지는 마멋이 나무를 던진다면 나무를 얼마나 던질까?)

english: Sona si Latine loqueris.
translation: Sona si Latine loqueris.(라틴어 할 줄 알면 경적을 울려라.)

english: Raptus Regaliter
Nemo dat quod non habet.
translation: Nemo dat quod non habet.(없는 건 아무도 못 주는 법이지.)

english: Ne auderis delere orbem rigidum meum!
translation: Ne auderis delere orbem rigidum meum!(감히 내 하드 디스크를 지울 생각 마라!)

english: Da mihi sis bubulae frustum assae, solana tuberosa in modo gallico fricta, ac quassum lactatum coagulatum crassum.
translation: Da mihi sis bubulae frustum assae, solana tuberosa in modo gallico fricta, ac quassum lactatum coagulatum crassum.(구운 소고기 한 덩이, 프랑스식 감자튀김, 걸쭉한 밀크셰이크 하나 줘.)

english: Cogito ergo sum.
translation: Cogito ergo sum.(나는 생각한다, 고로 존재한다.)

english: Vacca foeda.
Di! Ecce hora! Uxor mea me necabit!
translation: Di! Ecce hora! Uxor mea me necabit!(맙소사! 시간 좀 봐! 마누라한테 죽었다!)

english: Latine loqui coactus sum.
translation: Latine loqui coactus sum.(라틴어로만 말해야 하는 신세라고.)

english: Cave ne ante ullas catapultas ambules.
translation: Cave ne ante ullas catapultas ambules.(투석기 앞으로는 절대 지나가지 마라.)

english: Fac ut vivas!
Noli me vocare, ego te vocabo.
translation: Noli me vocare, ego te vocabo.(연락하지 마, 내가 연락할 테니.)

english: Meliora cogito.
translation: Meliora cogito.(더 나은 걸 생각 중이야.)

english: Braccae tuae aperiuntur.
Vescere bracis meis.
Corripe cervisiam!
What?!
Huh?!
Er...
OK...
Are you insulting me in Latin?
Yes!
Hmm...
Hello.
I've been posted here to guard this chasm.
And how's that going?
Not great. There's constant bursts of hot air, demon roars and strange lights coming from inside.
translation: 별로예요. 안에서 뜨거운 바람이 계속 뿜어져 나오고, 악마들 울부짖는 소리에 이상한 빛까지 새어 나와요.

english: And then there's the cultists. They just climb out like it's normal to be down there. Try to talk to you like it's business as usual.
translation: 게다가 광신도들도 있고요. 저 아래 있는 게 당연하다는 듯이 그냥 기어 올라와요. 아무 일 없다는 듯이 말을 걸려고 하고요.

english: That does sound stressful.
How long are you posted here?
Indefinitely. We don't know what the cult is up to and we don't want to be caught unprepared.
translation: 기약 없어요. 교단이 무슨 꿍꿍이인지 모르니, 대비 없이 당하고 싶진 않거든요.

english: Have you considered quitting?
No. I signed up to to protect Kourend, even if that means standing outside of a demon nest. Besides, it's not like any demons have come out of it yet.
translation: 아뇨. Kourend(쿠렌드)를 지키려고 입대했으니까요, 그게 악마 소굴 앞에 서 있는 일이라 해도요. 게다가 아직 거기서 나온 악마도 없잖아요.

english: Well, good luck.
Thanks.
What do you want? Are you with those cultists?
What? No.
Good. I've had enough of their games.
Games? What do you mean?
They start off polite, but before you know it, they're trying to get you to agree to something.
translation: 처음엔 예의 바르게 나오다가, 정신 차려 보면 뭔가에 동의하게 만들려고 들지.

english: They're not fooling me though. The next one that crosses me is going to regret it!
translation: 하지만 난 안 속아. 다음에 나한테 걸리는 놈은 후회하게 될 거다!

english: About the cultists... What sort of things do they ask you to agree to?
translation: 광신도들 말인데요... 어떤 걸 동의하라고 하던가요?

english: Usually they want you to follow them somewhere private. Some of the bolder ones try to get you to join them inside the chasm.
translation: 대개는 으슥한 데로 따라오라고 하지. 좀 대담한 놈들은 협곡 안으로 같이 들어가자고까지 하고.

english: If it were up to me, we'd launch a sortie right now. See how they like it if we come down on our own terms.
translation: 내 마음대로 할 수 있다면 당장 출격할 거야. 우리가 원하는 방식으로 쳐들어가면 놈들이 어떻게 나오나 보자고.

english: Aren't you worried about the demons?
You sound like the lieutenant.
You sound eager to fight.
translation: 싸우고 싶어 안달이 난 것 같네요.

english: I am. If you ask me we should be out fighting lizardmen. That means we need to go on the offensive and wrap this chasm business up.
translation: 그래. 나한테 묻는다면, 우린 밖에서 lizardmen(리자드맨)이랑 싸우고 있어야 해. 그러려면 먼저 공세로 나가서 이 협곡 문제를 끝내야 하고.

english: I take it the rest of your squad aren't as keen.
translation: 분대의 다른 분들은 그렇게 열성적이지 않은가 보네요.

english: You'd be right. The lieutenant is too cautious and the rest are too timid. The way some of them speak you'd think they had demon families.
translation: 잘 봤어. 중위님은 너무 신중하고, 나머지는 너무 겁이 많아. 몇몇 놈들 말하는 걸 들어 보면 집에 악마 가족이라도 있는 줄 알겠다니까.

english: If you see any cultists lurking around, let me know.
translation: 광신도가 어슬렁거리는 게 보이면 나한테 알려 줘.

english: You look comfortable.
I might as well be if we're going to continue this performance.
translation: 이 연극을 계속할 거라면 차라리 편하게 있는 게 낫죠.

english: What do you mean?
There are no demons coming out of this chasm. If there were, we wouldn't last long.
translation: 이 협곡에서 나오는 악마는 없어요. 만약 나온다면, 우린 오래 못 버틸 거고요.

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
Demons don't die the same way we do. We could hold back a few of them, but not an endless stream.
translation: 악마는 우리처럼 쉽게 죽지 않아요. 몇 마리쯤은 막을 수 있겠지만, 끝없이 몰려오는 건 무리예요.

english: You seem to know a lot about them.
translation: 악마에 대해 잘 아시는 것 같네요.

english: I do, which means I know that guarding the chasm is a pointless endeavour. Not that the lieutenant cares what I think.
translation: 알죠. 그래서 협곡을 지키는 게 부질없는 짓이라는 것도 알아요. 중위님은 제 생각 따위 신경도 안 쓰시지만요.

english: Launching an attack into the chasm would also be pointless. That leaves us with only one other option.
translation: 협곡 안으로 공격해 들어가는 것도 부질없긴 마찬가지고요. 그러면 남는 선택지는 하나뿐이죠.

english: Fleeing?
No. We should talk to them. Try to reach an understanding.
translation: 아뇨. 그들과 대화를 해야 해요. 서로 이해하는 지점을 찾아보는 거죠.

english: Somehow I don't think negotiating with demons will end well.
translation: 왠지 악마랑 협상해서 좋게 끝날 것 같지는 않은데요.

english: If you have a better idea, go ahead.
translation: 더 좋은 생각이 있으면 말해 보세요.

english: Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 이 일에 너무 침착하신 거 아니에요?

english: No. If they wanted to, Yama and his demons could overrun this little squad.
translation: 아뇨. 마음만 먹으면 Yama(야마)와 그의 악마들은 이 작은 분대쯤 순식간에 쓸어버릴 수 있어요.

english: The fact they haven't means they're probably not interested in doing so. As a matter of fact, they seem quite polite.
translation: 그러지 않았다는 건 아마 그럴 생각이 없다는 뜻이겠죠. 사실, 꽤 예의 바른 것 같기도 하고요.

english: You've spoken to them?
I didn't say that, But there's evidence to suggest that Yama and his cult can be reasoned with.
translation: 그렇다고는 안 했어요. 하지만 Yama(야마)와 그 교단이 말이 통하는 상대라는 증거는 있어요.

english: If Lord Shayzien is interested in diffusing the threat, he should consider trying to reach an agreement with them.
translation: Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 경)께서 위협을 누그러뜨릴 생각이 있으시다면, 그들과 합의를 시도해 보는 것도 고려하셔야 해요.

english: I've met Lord Shayzien. He doesn't seem like the type to compromise.
translation: Lord Shayzien(샤이지엔 경)을 만나 봤는데요. 타협할 분 같지는 않던데요.

english: You've met Lord Shiro Shayzien?
translation: Lord Shiro Shayzien(시로 샤이지엔 경)을 만나 보셨다고요?

english: Yes, I've met the leaders of all of the houses. Even King Artur Hosidius himself.
translation: 네, 모든 가문의 수장들을 다 만나 봤어요. King Artur Hosidius(아르투르 호시디우스 왕)까지도요.

english: Interesting. You're quite the worldly fellow. Perhaps King Hosidius would make a more level headed negotiator. Maybe you could talk to him?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 꽤 세상 물정에 밝은 분이시군요. 어쩌면 King Hosidius(호시디우스 왕)이 더 냉철한 협상가일지도 모르겠어요. 그분께 말씀 좀 해 주실 수 있을까요?

english: I imagine he's quite busy at the moment.
How long are you posted here?
Have you considered quitting?
Well, good luck.
About the cultists...
You sound eager to fight.
translation: 싸우고 싶어 안달이 난 것 같네요.

english: You think the demons would overrun you?
Aren't you a bit too calm about this?
translation: 이 일에 너무 침착하신 거 아니에요?

english: Are you here to fight the lizardmen? Be careful - they're fierce!
translation: lizardmen(리자드맨)이랑 싸우러 오셨어요? 조심하세요, 아주 사납거든요!

english: Tell me about the lizardmen.
The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien Army have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
translation: lizardmen(리자드맨)은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 골칫거리예요. 역사는 잘 모르지만, Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)는 아무도 기억 못 할 만큼 오래전부터 그놈들과 싸워 왔어요.

english: They can be aggressive, and they've got something nasty in their bite that can make you pretty ill.
translation: 공격적일 때가 많고, 이빨에 뭔가 고약한 게 있어서 물리면 꽤 심하게 앓을 수 있어요.

english: Why are you up here instead of fighting?
translation: 왜 싸우지 않고 여기 올라와 계세요?

english: I got a bite from a lizardman. I'm all cured, but I'm not going down there again until I feel stronger, otherwise I'll be no use in the fight.
translation: lizardman(리자드맨)한테 물렸거든요. 다 낫긴 했는데, 몸이 더 튼튼해졌다 싶을 때까진 다시 안 내려가려고요. 안 그러면 싸움에 아무 도움도 안 될 테니까요.

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: 제가 벌써 몇 마리나 처치했는지 아세요?

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed [COUNT] lizardmen since they began tracking your kills. [COUNT] were lizardman shamans.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 기록에 따르면, 처치 기록을 집계하기 시작한 이후로 lizardmen(리자드맨)을 [COUNT]마리 처치하셨어요. 그중 [COUNT]마리는 lizardman shaman(리자드맨 주술사)이었고요.

english: Thanks for the warning.
I see no adventurers in the canyon to the east.
I see no adventurers in the canyon to the west.
Tell me about the lizardmen.
Why are you up here instead of fighting?
translation: 왜 싸우지 않고 여기 올라와 계세요?

english: Do you know how many I've killed already?
translation: 제가 벌써 몇 마리나 처치했는지 아세요?

english: Thanks for the warning.
Hello, are you interested in our agility training courses?
translation: 안녕하세요, 저희 민첩 훈련 코스에 관심 있으세요?

english: Yes, is it difficult?
Nothing is difficult for a Shayzien soldier. If you do the training every day, you can be as good as us.
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 병사에게 어려운 건 없어요. 매일 훈련하면 당신도 저희만큼 잘할 수 있을 거예요.

english: No thanks.
Fair enough. Feel free to give it a go if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요. 마음이 바뀌면 언제든 한번 해 보세요.

english: Hi, I've seen your moves on the agility course, well done!
translation: 안녕하세요, 민첩 코스에서 움직이는 거 봤어요. 잘하시던데요!

english: Do you want to know more about how you've been doing?
translation: 지금까지 기록이 어떤지 더 알고 싶으세요?

english: Yes please.
You've not completed any laps of our basic agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 아직 기초 민첩 코스를 한 바퀴도 완주하지 않으셨네요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: You've completed 1 lap of our basic agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 기초 민첩 코스를 1바퀴 완주하셨고, 랩 타임은 [time]이에요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: You've completed [number] laps of our basic agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 기초 민첩 코스를 [number]바퀴 완주하셨고, 최고 기록은 [time]이에요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: You've not completed any laps of our advanced agility course yet. There's been [number] completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 아직 고급 민첩 코스를 한 바퀴도 완주하지 않으셨네요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: You've completed 1 lap of our advanced agility course with a lap time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 고급 민첩 코스를 1바퀴 완주하셨고, 랩 타임은 [time]이에요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: You've completed [number] laps of our advanced course with a best time of [time]. There's been [number] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 고급 코스를 [number]바퀴 완주하셨고, 최고 기록은 [time]이에요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [number]회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: Yes, is it difficult?
No thanks.
Yes please.
Shayzien Basic Course.
Shayzien Advanced Course:
Not often you see a couple of soldiers out for a drink.
translation: 병사 둘이 같이 술 마시러 나온 건 흔히 보는 광경이 아닌데요.

english: We've just finished our first duties in the Lizardman Canyon. A few drinks at the Cloak and Stagger to celebrate is always traditional.
translation: Lizardman Canyon(리자드맨 협곡)에서 첫 임무를 막 마쳤거든요. 축하하려고 Cloak and Stagger(망토와 비틀걸음)에서 몇 잔 하는 게 전통이에요.

english: Sounds like you earned it. Enjoy!
translation: 그럴 자격이 충분하시네요. 즐거운 시간 보내세요!

english: Don't expect me to deal with the likes of you.
translation: 당신 같은 사람은 상대 안 해요.

english: You do not have enough Shayzien favour. Current favour: [current favour in %] - Required: 60.0%
translation: Shayzien(샤이지엔) 호감도가 부족해요. 현재 호감도: [current favour in %] - 필요: 60.0%

english: If you're planning on fighting me for a set of my armour, I'm afraid I'm not interested. The combat XP from fighting you isn't worthwhile. Get a Defence level of 20 first.
translation: 내 갑옷 세트를 노리고 덤비려는 거라면, 미안하지만 관심 없어요. 당신이랑 싸워 봤자 얻는 전투 경험치가 별로거든요. 먼저 Defence(방어) 레벨부터 20으로 올리고 오세요.

english: Hello. Do you fancy a fight? It's just a bit of fun, so I can practice melee combat. I'll give you a piece of my armour if you win.
translation: 안녕하세요. 한판 붙어 볼래요? 그냥 재미로 하는 거예요, 근접 전투 연습 좀 하려고요. 이기면 내 갑옷 한 부위를 드릴게요.

english: Okay, I reckon I can take you. Did you just say you wanted to practice melee combat in particular?

english: ...I can, but I'm not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak... A-am I dead?

english: ...I can. Are you a ghost?
I'm no ghost! I'm a spirit, I'm injecting my thoughts into your head.
translation: 유령이라니 당치 않네! 나는 영혼일세. 자네 머릿속에 내 생각을 불어넣고 있는 걸세.

english: Oh, that's... interesting. Also rather disturbing...
translation: 아, 그거... 흥미롭네요. 좀 소름 끼치기도 하고요...

english: Try not to think about it.
Could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 제 셉터에 마력을 불어넣어 주실 수 있나요?

english: Of course I can... But first, you must show me whatever treasure lies within that cradle and make sure that your account is safe.
translation: 물론 할 수 있지... 하지만 먼저 저 요람 안에 있는 보물이 무엇이든 내게 보여 주고, 자네 계정이 안전한지 확인해야 하네.

english: Is my account safe?
To make sure your account is secured, please turn on the authenticator. Simply visit the support link on the oldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: 계정을 확실히 보호하려면 인증기를 켜 두게. oldschool.runescape.com 웹사이트의 고객 지원 링크에 가 보기만 하면 되네.

english: Oh, that sounds like a great idea, I'll go do that.
translation: 오, 좋은 생각이네요. 가서 해 볼게요.

english: It seems you have the authenticator set up, that's perfect! Now just show me the treasure.
translation: 인증기를 설정해 두었구먼, 완벽하네! 이제 보물만 보여 주게.

english: Is this the treasure?
Oh marvellous! If only I had corporeal form I'd be able to wear them, but alas...
translation: 오, 훌륭하군! 내게 육신만 있었다면 신어 볼 수 있었을 텐데, 아아...

english: So could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 그럼 제 셉터에 마력을 불어넣어 주실 수 있나요?

english: It seems your account isn't as secure as it could be, I'm afraid I can't imbue your sceptre.
translation: 자네 계정이 충분히 안전하지 않은 것 같군. 미안하지만 셉터에 마력을 불어넣어 줄 수는 없네.

english: Oh.
Of course, of course! In fact if you have more than one I'll imbue all of them!
translation: 물론, 물론이지! 사실 하나보다 많이 갖고 있다면 전부 다 불어넣어 주겠네!

english: There you go, now that I've imbued all of your sceptres, once they run out of charges they will no longer break and they can be charged with any piece of the sceptre you find.
translation: 자, 됐네. 자네 셉터에 전부 마력을 불어넣었으니, 이제 충전이 다 떨어져도 부서지지 않고, 찾아낸 셉터 조각 아무거나로 충전할 수 있을 걸세.

english: Thank you very much! How many charges does each piece give?
translation: 정말 감사해요! 조각 하나당 충전이 몇 번씩 되나요?

english: Most of them give 3, although the left skull gives 5. Each completed tier of the Varrock achievement diary will get you one extra charge per piece and allow your sceptre to hold 4 more charges.
translation: 대부분은 3회지만, 왼쪽 해골은 5회일세. Varrock(바록) 업적 일지를 한 단계 완료할 때마다 조각당 충전이 1회씩 늘어나고, 셉터에 담을 수 있는 충전도 4회씩 늘어난다네.

english: You can use a chisel to break a sceptre piece into fragments, then use those to charge the sceptre instead. More flexible if you ask me.
translation: 끌로 셉터 조각을 쪼개 파편으로 만든 다음, 그걸로 셉터를 충전해도 되네. 내 생각엔 그쪽이 더 유연하지.

english: Finally, be warned that if you disable your authenticator, the imbue on the sceptre will be removed.
translation: 마지막으로 경고하자면, 인증기를 끄면 셉터에 불어넣은 마력이 사라질 걸세.

english: Fantastic! It's best I keep my authenticator activated then. Good byeSolztun!
translation: 좋아요! 그럼 인증기는 계속 켜 두는 게 좋겠네요. 안녕히 계세요, Solztun(솔츠툰)!

english: Stay safe, adventurer.
Who are you?
As I said, I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer! I came to explore this place, but unfortunately I died long before I made it to the treasure.
translation: 말했듯이 나는 Solztun(솔츠툰), 가장 위대한 야만인 탐험가일세! 이곳을 탐험하러 왔다가, 안타깝게도 보물에 닿기 한참 전에 죽고 말았지.

english: Nobody came to help?!
Oh no, they had no idea I was hurt, I guess they assumed I'd found the treasure and made a new life for myself.
translation: 아, 아무도 오지 않았지. 내가 다친 줄 아무도 몰랐으니까. 아마 내가 보물을 찾아서 새 삶을 시작했으려니 했을 걸세.

english: Were you not a fan of the barbarian life style?
translation: 야만인의 생활 방식이 마음에 안 드셨나요?

english: It was all death and pillaging, I prefer the finer things in life, like exploration and discovery!
translation: 온통 죽음과 약탈뿐이었지. 나는 탐험과 발견 같은 인생의 고상한 것들이 더 좋네!

english: Ah, I too enjoy those.
Why are you here?
I came for treasure!
Oh right, you were looking for what's in that cradle?
translation: 아, 맞다. 저 요람 안에 든 걸 찾고 계셨죠?

english: Yes, but alas, I'm dead.
I guess I could show you... for a price.
translation: 제가 보여 드릴 수도 있는데... 대가를 주신다면요.

english: Hmm... I don't have much to offer, but if you happen upon a skull sceptre, I could make it stronger.
translation: 흠... 내가 줄 수 있는 건 별로 없지만, 혹시 skull sceptre(해골 셉터)를 손에 넣는다면 그걸 더 강하게 만들어 줄 수 있네.

english: Stronger you say... In what way?
Currently the sceptre is fragile, it breaks once all charges have been used. Show me the treasure and I could imbue it so it can be recharged with any sceptre piece.
translation: 지금 그 셉터는 약해서, 충전을 다 쓰면 부서지고 말지. 보물을 보여 주면 마력을 불어넣어 어떤 셉터 조각으로든 다시 충전할 수 있게 해 주겠네.

english: You, my dead friend, have a deal!
Bye!
No, that's not it.
But I didn't show you anything.
I sense that you don't have the treasure.
Could you imbue my sceptre?
translation: 제 셉터에 마력을 불어넣어 주실 수 있나요?

english: Is my account safe?
Is this the treasure?
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Hmm... You're not my usual kind of customer, but I reckon I can still make this work. What will it be? Haircut or a shave?
translation: 흠... 평소 오는 손님 타입은 아니지만, 그래도 어떻게든 해 볼 수 있을 것 같네요. 뭘로 하시겠어요? 이발이요, 면도요?

english: I'd like a haircut please.
Then let's get to it.
I'd like a shave please.
I'm good, thanks.
Suit yourself.
I'd like a haircut please.
I'd like a shave please.
I'm good, thanks.
Sorry, I can't chat while I'm on duty. I have to keep alert.
translation: 죄송하지만 근무 중이라 이야기할 수 없어요. 경계를 늦추면 안 되거든요.

english: How can I help you?
What are you doing down here?
We're here to guard the bank and make sure no one tries anything.
translation: 은행을 지키면서 아무도 수상한 짓을 못 하게 감시하고 있어요.

english: Do you have a tinderbox?
I have one I could sell you for 50 coins.
I'll take it.
Actually, I don't seem to have enough money on me.
Sorry, that's too expensive.
No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
I do, but I'd like to hold on to it for now.
translation: 있긴 한데, 당분간은 제가 갖고 있고 싶어요.

english: That's okay; I've one with me anyway.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어차피 저도 하나 갖고 있거든요.

english: Do you have a torch?
I'll sell you an unlit one for 200 coins.
translation: 불 안 붙인 걸로 하나, 200코인에 팔게요.

english: How come you're not spotty?
Ah, the pox. We weren't here when the outbreak took place. We were out of town trying to catch an antiques thief called Simon Templeton. We've only just got back.
translation: 아, 그 역병 말이군요. 역병이 돌 때 저희는 여기 없었어요. Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴)이라는 골동품 도둑을 잡으러 마을 밖에 나가 있었거든요. 이제 막 돌아왔어요.

english: Aren't you afraid you'll fall ill as well?
translation: 당신도 병에 걸릴까 봐 걱정되지 않으세요?

english: The only reason we've been let back into the city is because the High Priest believes the pox isn't contagious.
translation: 저희가 다시 도시에 들어올 수 있었던 건 High Priest(대사제)님께서 이 역병이 전염되지 않는다고 믿으시기 때문이에요.

english: Besides, Sophanem is my home. It will take a lot more than the threat of a few spots to keep me away.
translation: 게다가 Sophanem(소파넴)은 제 고향이에요. 반점 좀 생길까 봐 겁나서 떠나 있을 제가 아니죠.

english: You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 도와주실 건 없어요. 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Be careful down there!
What are you doing down here?
Do you have a tinderbox?
I'll take it.
Sorry, that's too expensive.
Do you have a torch?
How come you're not spotty?
You can't. I'd better go.
translation: 도와주실 건 없어요. 이만 가 볼게요.

english: Hello.
You! You're the reason I'm in here.
translation: 너! 내가 여기 갇힌 건 다 너 때문이야.

english: Yeah... Sorry about that. This is what happens when you make poor life choices though.
translation: 그래... 그건 미안하게 됐네. 근데 인생을 잘못 살면 이렇게 되는 거야.

english: I hope you enjoy this moment, it won't last.
translation: 이 순간을 실컷 즐겨 둬. 오래가지 않을 테니까.

english: Soon he will descend on this miserable lands and everything you know will be ash!
translation: 곧 그분께서 이 비참한 땅에 강림하시면, 네가 아는 모든 게 잿더미가 될 거야!

english: Well that just sounds great. See you later.
Who are you and what do you want?
None of your business!
I go where I like and do what I like.
translation: 전 가고 싶은 데 가고, 하고 싶은 걸 해요.

english: Not in my house. Be gone!
translation: 내 집에서는 안 된다. 썩 꺼져라!

english: Be gone, intruder!
I'm here to kill you!
I think not!
Can I have some sq'irks please?
What do you want them for?
Someone asked me to bring them some.
Who?
Osman.
In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with him recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: 그렇다면 미안하지만 안 되겠구나. 최근에 그자와 사이가 틀어져서 그의 부탁은 들어주고 싶지 않거든.

english: Selim.
In that case I'm sorry, but you can't. I have had a falling out with his master recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: 그렇다면 미안하지만 안 되겠구나. 최근에 그자의 주인과 사이가 틀어져서 그의 부탁은 들어주고 싶지 않거든.

english: I'm just passing by.
None of your business!
I'm here to kill you!
Can I have some sq'irks please?
I'm just passing by.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어, 영웅님이다! 와! 정말 대단하세요. 대체 어떻게 juvinate(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요. 큰일을 해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Not that it makes much difference but my name's Sorin. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 별로 중요한 건 아니지만 제 이름은 Sorin(소린)이에요. 여기 있는 다른 생존자들처럼 저도 그냥 근근이 하루하루 버티고 있어요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 정말 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어를 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 언젠가 힘을 길러서 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고, 다들 당신에게 무척 고마워하고 있어요. 영웅을 직접 보거나 알고 지낸 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들 눈에도 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
I hate this job. All the other staff are so happy all the time. It depresses me.
translation: 이 일 너무 싫어요. 다른 직원들은 늘 행복해 보여요. 그래서 우울해요.

english: Why don't you get a new job?
translation: 다른 일을 구해 보는 건 어때요?

english: I can't find any other work. I wanted to be a Gnomeball player but I wasn't big enough.
translation: 다른 일자리를 못 구하겠어요. Gnomeball(노움볼) 선수가 되고 싶었는데 덩치가 작아서 안 됐어요.

english: That's a shame. I'd better let you get on with your work.
OK, whatever.
Aren't you going to wish me a nice day?
translation: 좋은 하루 보내라는 인사는 안 해 주세요?

english: Have a day. It can be nice if you can be bothered. I know I can't.
translation: 하루 보내세요. 애써 볼 마음만 있으면 좋은 하루가 될 수도 있겠죠. 전 그럴 마음이 없지만요.

english: ... nice.
Good day.
I have no interest in speaking with you. You should bring your cat to me again. The two of us have much to discuss.
translation: 자네와는 이야기할 생각이 없네. 자네 고양이를 다시 데려오게. 우리 둘은 나눌 이야기가 많으니.

english: The Sphinx ignores you.
Ah, how interesting... a cat. Come here to me, kitty.
translation: 아, 흥미롭군... 고양이로구나. 이리 오너라, 아가야.

english: Meow.
Your cat and the Sphinx converse in a yeowling language for a short time.
translation: 당신의 고양이와 Sphinx(스핑크스)가 잠시 야옹거리는 말로 대화를 나눈다.

english: Do you think that you'll be able to communicate with me at a deeper level because you're wearing that amulet of catspeak?
translation: amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 걸었다고 해서 나와 더 깊이 소통할 수 있으리라 생각하는 겐가?

english: Er, yes?
How very foolish.
So, what do you need human?
What do you need human?
Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: Menaphites(메나파이트)의 신들에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: If you wish to know about the lesser gods, you should speak with Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods. I suppose I could spare a moment or two to tell you about the main four though.
translation: 하급 신들에 대해 알고 싶다면 Temple of the Lesser Gods(하급 신들의 신전)에 있는 Jex(젝스)와 이야기해 보게. 주신 넷에 대해서라면 잠깐 시간을 내어 이야기해 줄 수도 있네.

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
Tumeken is the god of light and husband to Elidinis. He is the leading god of the Menaphite Pantheon.
translation: Tumeken(투메켄)은 빛의 신이며 Elidinis(엘리디니스)의 남편일세. 메나파이트 만신전의 으뜸가는 신이지.

english: People don't seem to talk about him much. I'd have thought being the leading god would make him more popular.
translation: 사람들이 그 신에 대해서는 별로 이야기하지 않는 것 같아요. 으뜸가는 신이라면 더 인기가 많을 줄 알았는데.

english: A common saying about Tumeken is that you see him wherever you look, but never actually notice him.
translation: Tumeken(투메켄)에 대해 흔히 하는 말이 있지. 어디를 보든 그가 보이지만, 정작 아무도 그를 알아채지 못한다고.

english: Okay... And what kind of god is he? The desert is a harsh place, so does that make him harsh as well?
translation: 그렇군요... 그럼 어떤 신이에요? 사막은 혹독한 곳인데, 그 신도 혹독한가요?

english: In some ways. You humans sometimes say that 'you have to be cruel to be kind'. That seems a fitting way to describe Tumeken.
translation: 어떤 면에서는 그렇지. 자네들 인간은 가끔 '사랑하기에 매를 든다'고 하지 않나. 그 말이 Tumeken(투메켄)을 잘 설명해 주네.

english: So he's harsh, but for good reasons?
translation: 그러니까 혹독하지만, 좋은 이유 때문이라는 거죠?

english: Indeed.
Tell me about Elidinis.
Elidinis is the goddess of fertility. The River Elid is named in her honour, for it brings life to the whole region.
translation: Elidinis(엘리디니스)는 풍요의 여신일세. River Elid(엘리드 강)은 그 여신을 기려 이름 붙여졌지. 그 강이 이 지역 전체에 생명을 가져다주니 말일세.

english: There are some who even believe the river to be Elidinis herself.
translation: 그 강이 곧 Elidinis(엘리디니스) 자신이라고 믿는 이들도 있네.

english: That's an interesting take. I guess being a bringer of life makes her quite popular?
translation: 흥미로운 해석이네요. 생명을 가져다주는 신이니 꽤 인기가 많겠죠?

english: More so than many others in the pantheon, but not as much as she once was.
translation: 만신전의 다른 많은 신들보다는 그렇지만, 예전만큼은 아닐세.

english: Why not?
Humans are fickle. Perhaps they grew bored of her?
translation: 인간은 변덕스럽지. 그 여신에게 싫증이 났는지도 모르지 않나?

english: That sounds unlikely.
Well if you're after the human take on things, you'd be better off asking a human.
translation: 인간의 생각이 궁금하다면 인간에게 묻는 편이 나을 걸세.

english: Tell me about Icthlarin.
Icthlarin is the god of the dead. He is the son of Tumeken and Elidinis, and brother to the Devourer. As this is the city of the dead, he's quite popular here.
translation: Icthlarin(익스라린)은 죽은 자의 신일세. Tumeken(투메켄)과 Elidinis(엘리디니스)의 아들이며, Devourer(포식자)와는 남매 사이지. 이곳은 죽은 자의 도시이니 여기서는 꽤 인기가 많네.

english: So are you a follower of Icthlarin?
Nothing of the sort. I have no interest in the gods or their followers. Instead, Icthlarin and I have an understanding.
translation: 전혀 그렇지 않네. 나는 신들에게도, 그 추종자들에게도 관심이 없어. 다만 Icthlarin(익스라린)과 나는 서로 합의한 바가 있지.

english: Cats play a significant role when it comes to guarding the dead from the Devourer. As such, they are great allies to Icthlarin.
translation: 고양이는 죽은 자를 Devourer(포식자)로부터 지키는 데 중요한 역할을 하네. 그러니 Icthlarin(익스라린)에게는 훌륭한 동맹이지.

english: As a thank you for looking after them, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 고양이들을 돌봐 준 보답으로 Icthlarin(익스라린)이 내게 영원한 생명을 내려 주었네.

english: Tell me about the Devourer.
I'd have thought you'd be more than familiar with her by now.
translation: 자네라면 지금쯤 그 여신을 누구보다 잘 알고 있을 줄 알았네만.

english: I'm interested in hearing your take.
Very well. The Devourer is the goddess of destruction. As such, she is commonly considered an evil goddess, but this is an oversimplification.
translation: 좋네. Devourer(포식자)는 파괴의 여신일세. 그래서 흔히 사악한 여신으로 여겨지지만, 그건 지나친 단순화일세.

english: How so?
Not everything that destroys is evil. Destruction is often a necessity.
translation: 파괴하는 것이 모두 악한 건 아닐세. 파괴는 종종 꼭 필요한 일이지.

english: Isn't that also an oversimplification? Amascut is doing far more than just destroying. She's a murderer!
translation: 그것도 지나친 단순화 아닌가요? Amascut(아마스컷)은 그저 파괴만 하는 게 아니에요. 그 여신은 살인자라고요!

english: Is causing death enough to make one evil? Icthlarin is the god of the dead. By your argument, surely he is the most evil of them all.
translation: 죽음을 불러오는 것만으로 악하다고 할 수 있겠나? Icthlarin(익스라린)은 죽은 자의 신일세. 자네 논리대로라면 그야말로 가장 사악한 신이겠지.

english: Icthlarin doesn't actually kill people though. He just looks after those that have died.
translation: 하지만 Icthlarin(익스라린)은 실제로 사람을 죽이지는 않잖아요. 죽은 사람들을 돌볼 뿐이죠.

english: You clearly know little of Icthlarin and his past. Are you aware of the Mahjarrat? They once served Icthlarin, before they left him for Zamorak.
translation: 자네는 Icthlarin(익스라린)과 그의 과거를 잘 모르는군. Mahjarrat(마하자랏)을 아나? 그들은 한때 Icthlarin(익스라린)을 섬기다가 그를 떠나 Zamorak(자모락)에게 갔지.

english: Or was it the Empty Lord they left him for... I forget.
translation: 아니, 그들이 찾아간 게 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)였던가... 잊어버렸군.

english: Regardless, they are a race that have regularly associated themselves with gods considered evil. Interesting company for one such as Icthlarin to keep.
translation: 어쨌든 그들은 사악하다고 여겨지는 신들과 줄곧 어울려 온 종족일세. Icthlarin(익스라린) 같은 신이 곁에 두기에는 참 흥미로운 무리지.

english: How does that make Amascut good though?
translation: 그렇다고 해서 Amascut(아마스컷)이 선하다는 건 아니잖아요?

english: I never said it did. I'm just saying that things are often not as straightforward as they seem, especially when it comes to Icthlarin and the Devourer.
translation: 그렇다고 말한 적은 없네. 그저 세상일이란 보이는 것만큼 단순하지 않은 경우가 많다는 걸세. 특히 Icthlarin(익스라린)과 Devourer(포식자)에 관해서라면 더더욱.

english: If you say so...
Let's talk about something else.
Very well. What do you want to dicuss?
Nothing. I should go.
Do you have a spare amulet of catspeak?
translation: amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛) 남는 거 있으세요?

english: Well, I suppose I do. Seeing as you're such a good guardian of cats, I'll give you one. Be careful with it, though.
translation: 음, 있긴 하지. 자네가 고양이들을 그리 잘 지켜 주니, 하나 주겠네. 다만 조심해서 다루게.

english: The Sphinx hands you an amulet of catspeak.
translation: Sphinx(스핑크스)가 당신에게 amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛)을 건넨다.

english: Paw-don me, I have something to show mew.
Human, you make a mockery of my kin.
Come on, don't be such a sour puss.
You should leave, before I deliver retribution for your actions.
translation: 그 행동에 대한 응징을 내리기 전에 떠나는 게 좋을 걸세.

english: Can you tell me about the gods of the Menaphites?
translation: Menaphites(메나파이트)의 신들에 대해 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Tell me about Tumeken.
Tell me about Elidinis.
Tell me about Icthlarin.
Tell me about the Devourer.
Let's talk about something else.
Nothing. I should go.
Do you have a spare amulet of catspeak?
translation: amulet of catspeak(고양이 언어 아뮬렛) 남는 거 있으세요?

english: Show the Sphinx your cat ears.
translation: Sphinx(스핑크스)에게 cat ears(고양이 귀)를 보여 준다.

english: Talk about something else.
A little bit of spice makes everything taste nice! Come and get it here!
translation: 향신료 조금이면 뭐든 맛있어져요! 여기 와서 사 가세요!

english: Let's trade.
I'll pass.
Your loss.
You're the one who stole from me! Guards! Guards!

translation: 아니, 내 이름은 Memmis(멤미스)인데, 다들 스파이크라고 불러.

english: Why do they call you Spike?
No idea. Maybe it's because I sell things with spikes. So, want a mace?
translation: 몰라. 스파이크 달린 물건을 팔아서 그런가? 그래서, 철퇴 살래?

Wrong answer. You'll be back.
Maybe...
Spike's Spikes?
I'm good.
Hello.
I was wondering if you could answer a few questions?
Sorry, I'm quite busy preparing to face Tempoross. Captain Pudi by the dock can answer any questions you might have.
translation: 미안해요, Tempoross(템포로스)와 맞설 준비로 꽤 바빠서요. 부두에 있는 Captain Pudi(푸디 선장)님이 궁금한 걸 다 알려 주실 거예요.

english: Okay, thanks.

translation: 이 힘든 시기에 알 하나 드실래요?

translation: 음... 아뇨, 그 damp egg(축축한 알)은 사양할게요...

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 그럼 다른 데 가서 알을 나눠 줄게요.

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
Hello there.
Uh... What are you doing?
Oh sorry, I was somewhere else entirely!
translation: 아, 미안해요. 완전히 딴생각을 하고 있었어요!

english: I'm just watching the debris wash up at the shore here.
translation: 그냥 여기 해안에 잔해가 밀려오는 걸 보고 있었어요.

english: It's sort of mesmerising...
Does anything useful wash up?
Oh, yes! All sorts of things get washed up by the storms. Aside from the usual materials, I've seen some interesting trinkets including odd looking books and fish preservation barrels.
translation: 아, 그럼요! 폭풍이 온갖 것들을 쓸어 오거든요. 흔한 재료 말고도 이상하게 생긴 책이나 생선 보존용 통 같은 흥미로운 물건들도 봤어요.

english: If you help in the fight against Tempoross, the Captain's said you can help yourself to anything that washes up.
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)와의 싸움을 도와주면 밀려오는 건 뭐든 가져가도 된다고 선장님이 그러셨어요.

english: I'll keep an eye out, thank you!
Any time...
His voice trails off as he stares back out to sea.
translation: 그는 말끝을 흐리며 다시 바다를 바라본다.

english: Do you have a spare fishing net I could have?
translation: 남는 낚시 그물 하나 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Without turning his head, the man holds up a fishing net.
translation: 남자는 고개도 돌리지 않은 채 낚시 그물을 들어 보인다.

english: Thanks...
Without turning his head, the man shakes his finger at you. Maybe because you already have a net.
translation: 남자는 고개도 돌리지 않은 채 손가락을 까딱인다. 이미 그물을 갖고 있어서인 듯하다.

english: Goodbye.
A net may be of use to you. Speak to me if you need one.
translation: 그물이 쓸모 있을지도 몰라요. 필요하면 저한테 말해요.

english: Uh... What are you doing?
Do you have a spare fishing net I could have?
translation: 남는 낚시 그물 하나 얻을 수 있을까요?

english: Goodbye.
Who treads upon my grave?
I have come to seek a blessing.
I see you have the unholy symbol of our Lord. It is blessed with the Lord Zamorak's power.
translation: 우리 주군의 unholy symbol(불경한 상징)을 지니고 있구려. 그것은 주군 Zamorak(자모락)의 권능으로 축복받았소.

english: Come to me when your faith weakens.
I see you have the unholy symbol of our Lord. I will bless it for you.
translation: 우리 주군의 unholy symbol(불경한 상징)을 지니고 있구려. 내가 축복해 주겠소.

english: The ghost mutters in a strange voice.
The unholy symbol throbs with power.
The symbol of our Lord has been blessed with power!
My master calls.
No blessings will be given to those who have no symbol of our Lord's love.
translation: 주군의 사랑을 증명하는 상징이 없는 자에게는 축복을 내리지 않소.

english: I need another mould for the unholy symbol.
translation: unholy symbol(불경한 상징)을 만들 거푸집이 하나 더 필요해요.

english: To lose an object is easy to replace. To lose the affections of our Lord is impossible to forgive.
translation: 물건을 잃는 것은 쉬이 메울 수 있으나, 주군의 총애를 잃는 것은 결코 용서받을 수 없소.

english: The ghost hands you another mould.
One you already have, another is not needed.
translation: 이미 하나 지니고 있으니, 또 필요하지는 않소.

english: Leave me be.
I have come to kill you.
The might of mortals, to me, is as the dust to the sea.
translation: 필멸자의 힘 따위, 내게는 바다 앞의 먼지와 같소.

english: I seek your wisdom.
Indeed, I feel you have beheld the far places in the heavens.
translation: 과연, 그대는 하늘 저 먼 곳을 보고 온 듯하구려.

english: My Lord instructs me to help you.
Here is a mould to make a token for our Lord; a mould for the unholy symbol of Zamorak.
translation: 여기 우리 주군께 바칠 징표를 만들 거푸집이 있소. unholy symbol of Zamorak(자모락의 불경한 상징)의 거푸집이오.

english: The ghost gives you a casting mould.
I have come to seek a blessing.
I need another unholy symbol mould.
translation: unholy symbol(불경한 상징) 거푸집이 하나 더 필요해요.

english: I have come to kill you.
I seek your wisdom.
You friend of gnome people, you friend of mine. Would you like me to take you somewhere?
translation: 자네는 노움들의 친구, 곧 나의 친구일세. 어디로 데려다주겠나?

english: No thanks, old tree.
Where can I go?
You can travel to the trees which are related to me.
translation: 나와 이어진 나무들이 있는 곳으로 갈 수 있다네.

english: You're already here.
Travel to that area is restricted.
You need a Farming level of at least 85 to teleport there.
translation: 그곳으로 순간이동하려면 Farming(농사) 레벨이 최소 85는 되어야 하네.

english: None of my brethren are in your house.
translation: 자네 집에는 내 형제가 하나도 없네.

english: None of my brethren are at that location.
Hello gnome friend. Where would you like to go?
translation: 반갑네, 노움의 친구여. 어디로 가고 싶은가?

english: Ah! A challenge for you.
What?
I need to test your mental strength before you can proceed.
translation: 더 나아가기 전에 자네의 정신력을 시험해야겠네.

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Go check again!
I am most impressed!
No thanks, old tree.
Where can I go?
You must be in building mode to try rotating the tree.
The player digs.
What are you doing?
Err... I thought I'd turn you around a bit.
translation: 어... 방향을 좀 돌려 볼까 해서요.

english: Turn... Turn me around? Are you uprooting me?!
translation: 도, 돌린다고? 날 뿌리째 뽑겠다는 건가?!

english: Err... Yes, well, I need to in order to-
translation: 어... 네, 그러니까, 그래야 돌릴 수가-

english: What reason could you possibly have to rotate me?!
translation: 대체 무슨 이유로 날 돌리겠다는 건가?!

english: I thought you might look nicer facing the other way.
translation: 반대쪽을 보고 있으면 더 보기 좋을 것 같아서요.

english: Look... Nicer?! I'm a living being!
translation: 보기... 좋다고?! 나는 살아 있는 존재일세!

english: Argh! My connection to the Anima Mundi! The pain!
translation: 으악! Anima Mundi(아니마 문디)와의 연결이! 고통스럽네!

english: This is unconscionable! I am not an object! I am a sentient creature with hopes and dreams!
translation: 이건 도저히 용납할 수 없네! 나는 물건이 아닐세! 희망과 꿈을 지닌, 지각 있는 생명체란 말일세!

english: All done. See, that wasn't so bad.
The pain... I can feel parts of me fading away... oh Guthix...
translation: 고통이... 내 일부가 사라져 가는 게 느껴지네... 오, Guthix(구식스)여...

english: Oh please no... Not again...
translation: 오, 제발 그만... 또 이럴 수는 없네...

english: Clockwise.
Anti-clockwise.
180 degrees.
That smells nice!
Mmm, yes. Some hunters caught it earlier today.
translation: 음, 그렇죠. 사냥꾼들이 아까 잡아 온 거예요.

english: Can I have some?
Oh, it's not cooked yet. But they sell frogburgers in the market!
translation: 아, 아직 안 익었어요. 그래도 시장에서 frogburger(개구리 버거)를 팔아요!

translation: 이사 온 지 얼마 안 돼서 아직 짐을 풀고 있어요. 나중에 다시 와 줄래요?

english: 'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 당신 사실 엄청 강한데, 정말 Zanaris(자나리스)에 있는 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 임무를 받지 않아도 괜찮겠어요?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
translation: 아, 그럼 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

english: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신한테 안 맞는 것 같아요. 취소해 줄까요? 임무 연속 기록은 사라지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소됐어요. 원할 때 새 임무를 받으면 돼요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 받을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 다양해요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 마세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 임무는 받지 않을 거예요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

translation: 알겠어요. 계속 당신의 전투 레벨을 확인할게요.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨은 그만 확인하세요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠어요. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 거예요.

english: About Turael...
It's nothing personal, but I'd prefer not to discuss what happened with my father.
translation: 당신한테 감정이 있어서 그러는 건 아니지만, 아버지와 있었던 일은 얘기하고 싶지 않아요.

english: Of course. Sorry for bringing it up.

translation: 아, 그럼 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테 가서 얘기해 볼게요.

Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨은 그만 확인하세요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: About Turael...
Er... Nothing...
Hello friend! Many thanks for all of your help! Vyvin never even realised it was a different sword, and I still have my job!
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구! 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요! Vyvin(바이빈) 경은 검이 바뀐 줄도 전혀 모르셨고, 저도 일자리를 지켰어요!

english: I'm glad the new sword worked out alright.
OK, here you go.
I have a question for you.
Squire Asrol has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Squire Asrol(종자 아스롤)이 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Squire Asrol has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Squire Asrol(종자 아스롤)이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: Greetings, brave knight!
Hello. What's through that door?
translation: 안녕하세요. 저 문 너머엔 뭐가 있어요?

english: That door leads to the training ground for the Knights of the Round Table.
translation: 저 문은 Knights of the Round Table(원탁의 기사단)의 훈련장으로 통합니다.

english: Can I go in there?
Of course, my lord. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: 물론입니다, 나리. 하지만 먼저 규칙을 알려 드려야 합니다. 지금 들으시겠습니까?

english: Yes please.
The training ground is a melee combat area only. Merlin has cast a spell over the grounds to prevent anyone using Prayer, Ranged or Magic.
translation: 훈련장에서는 근접 전투만 할 수 있습니다. Merlin(멀린)께서 훈련장 전체에 주문을 걸어 누구도 Prayer(기도), Ranged(원거리), Magic(마법)을 쓰지 못하게 하셨습니다.

english: Upon entering the grounds, you will fight each of the Round Table Knights in turn. Each knight is more skilled than the last, but all have different attack styles that can be exploited. There are eight knights in all, and
translation: 훈련장에 들어가시면 원탁의 기사들과 차례로 한 명씩 싸우게 됩니다. 기사는 뒤로 갈수록 강해지지만, 저마다 공격 방식이 달라 파고들 약점이 있습니다. 기사는 모두 여덟 명이며,

english: each will do damage not only to your hitpoints, but also your combat stats. If you should die in the grounds, Merlin will teleport you back here. You will not lose any of your items.
translation: 하나같이 체력뿐 아니라 전투 스탯에도 피해를 입힙니다. 훈련장에서 쓰러지시면 Merlin(멀린)께서 이곳으로 순간이동시켜 드립니다. 아이템은 하나도 잃지 않으십니다.

english: If you feel you cannot complete the battle, you may exit the training grounds. However, if you exit or die, you will have to start over with the first knight the next time you enter.
translation: 싸움을 끝낼 수 없겠다 싶으시면 훈련장에서 나가셔도 됩니다. 다만 나가시거나 쓰러지시면, 다음에 들어오실 때 첫 번째 기사부터 다시 시작하셔야 합니다.

english: If you are a great warrior and defeat Sir Lancelot, mightiest of all knights, you will receive great rewards. Two new prayers will become available to you and your respawn point will be set to Camelot, as well as 20,000
translation: 위대한 전사로서 기사 중 가장 강한 Sir Lancelot(랜슬롯 경)을 쓰러뜨리신다면 큰 보상을 받으실 겁니다. 새로운 기도 두 가지를 쓸 수 있게 되고, 리스폰 지점이 Camelot(카멜롯)으로 정해지며, 각 전투 스탯에 20,000

english: XP in to each of your combat stats.
If you do not want your respawn set to Camelot, Merlin can change it for you.
translation: 리스폰 지점이 Camelot(카멜롯)으로 정해지는 것을 원치 않으시면 Merlin(멀린)께서 바꿔 주실 수 있습니다.

english: Would you like me to repeat any of that for you?
translation: 방금 말씀드린 것 중 다시 들으실 부분이 있으십니까?

english: Tell me about the training ground.
Only melee combat is allowed within the training grounds. Merlin will prevent the use of Prayer, Ranged and Magic.
translation: 훈련장 안에서는 근접 전투만 허용됩니다. Merlin(멀린)께서 Prayer(기도), Ranged(원거리), Magic(마법)을 쓰지 못하게 막으십니다.

english: Why?
These grounds are for only the best knights of the land. It is not just testing your combat ability, but your honour and your chivalry. You must face your enemy head on, honourably and bravely.
translation: 이 훈련장은 이 땅에서 가장 뛰어난 기사들만을 위한 곳입니다. 전투 실력뿐 아니라 명예와 기사도까지 시험하는 곳이지요. 적과 정면으로, 명예롭고 용감하게 맞서셔야 합니다.

english: Be watchful of your stats, as the Knights can do damage to your combat stats as well as your hitpoints.
translation: 스탯을 잘 살피십시오. 기사들은 체력뿐 아니라 전투 스탯에도 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.

english: Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds.
translation: 훈련장에서 죽거나 나가는 것에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: As these are only training grounds, we keep our knights safe. If you should die, you will be teleported back to here and all of your items will be safe.
translation: 이곳은 어디까지나 훈련장이므로 저희는 기사님들을 안전하게 지킵니다. 쓰러지시면 이곳으로 순간이동되며, 아이템도 모두 안전합니다.

english: However, leaving the training grounds, in anyway, will mean you will have to start from the beginning the next time you enter. These grounds do not favour cowards.
translation: 하지만 어떤 방법으로든 훈련장을 떠나시면, 다음에 들어오실 때 처음부터 다시 시작하셔야 합니다. 이 훈련장은 겁쟁이를 반기지 않습니다.

english: I have to start again? What do you mean?
translation: 처음부터 다시 해야 한다고요? 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: You fight each knight of the Round Table, starting with Sir Bedivere and finishing with Sir Lancelot. Leaving means you will have to begin fighting Sir Bedivere again and work your way back up.
translation: 원탁의 기사들과 한 명씩 싸우시는데, Sir Bedivere(베디비어 경)으로 시작해 Sir Lancelot(랜슬롯 경)으로 끝납니다. 떠나시면 다시 베디비어 경부터 싸워 올라오셔야 합니다.

english: What if I log out during the fights?
If you log out during a fight, upon logging back in you will fight the knight you were fighting when you logged out.
translation: 싸우시던 중에 로그아웃하시면, 다시 로그인하셨을 때 로그아웃 당시 싸우던 기사와 이어서 싸우시게 됩니다.

english: Tell me about the rewards.

King Arthur believes in rewarding his knights for their chivalry. Having proven yourself in combat against his knights, and in your services rendered to Camelot, you will be rewarded with two new prayers, and a new
translation: King Arthur(아서 왕)께서는 기사도를 보인 기사에게 보상을 내려야 한다고 믿으십니다. 전하의 기사들과 싸워 실력을 증명하시고 Camelot(카멜롯)에 공을 세우셨으니, 새로운 기도 두 가지와 새로운

english: respawn at Camelot, as well as 20,000 XP in to each of your combat stats.
translation: Camelot(카멜롯) 리스폰 지점, 그리고 각 전투 스탯에 20,000 XP씩을 보상으로 받으시게 됩니다.

english: What do the new prayers do?
Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lord. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: 아, 인내는 기사의 미덕이지요, 나리. 훈련장에서 싸워 보상을 얻으시면 아시게 될 겁니다!

english: Then tell me about the respawn - how will it work?

Ah, Merlin has offered, as a reward for your help, to let yourrespawn in the safety of Camelot, should you befall misfortune elsewhere in the world. Should you wish to change your respawn back to Lumbridge, simply
translation: 아, 나리께서 도와주신 보답으로 Merlin(멀린)께서, 세상 어딘가에서 불운을 당하시더라도 안전한 Camelot(카멜롯)에서 되살아나실 수 있게 해 주시겠다고 하셨습니다. 리스폰 지점을 다시 Lumbridge(럼브리지)로 바꾸고 싶으시면

english: speak to Merlin.
No, thank you.
Congratulations on succeeding in the Knight Waves, my lord.
translation: Knight Waves(나이트 웨이브)를 해내신 것을 축하드립니다, 나리.

english: Thank you. Can I go back inside?
I'm afraid not, my lord. Once you have won, you cannot re-enter.
translation: 안타깝지만 안 됩니다, 나리. 한 번 승리하시면 다시 들어오실 수 없습니다.

english: Yes please.
Tell me about the training ground
Tell me about dying or leaving the grounds
translation: 훈련장에서 죽거나 나가는 것에 대해 알려 주세요

english: Tell me about the rewards
No, thank you.
Hello there. How's it going?
Busy, busy, busy.
Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 푹 좀 쉬고 싶긴 한데, 그것 말곤 괜찮아요.

english: What do you want?
I'm Vicks, squire to Sir Culler Flife. He's away on a surveillance mission to Burthorpe, so he sent me down here to do some cleaning.
translation: 전 Sir Culler Flife(컬러 플라이프 경)의 종자, Vicks(빅스)예요. 경께서는 Burthorpe(버소프)로 감시 임무를 떠나시면서, 저더러는 여기 내려가서 청소나 하라고 하셨죠.

english: Don't tell the knights, but I'm just not in the mood for it! I've served for years, and worked really hard, but they're not even thinking of making me a knight.
translation: 기사님들한텐 비밀인데요, 영 할 기분이 안 나요! 몇 년 동안 모시면서 정말 열심히 일했는데, 절 기사로 만들어 줄 생각은 아예 없으시다니까요.

english: I don't know what the problem is. At my last review, I heard the examiner muttering something about my name, but I've no idea what he meant by that.
translation: 뭐가 문제인지 모르겠어요. 지난번 심사 때 심사관이 제 이름에 대해 뭐라고 중얼거리는 걸 들었는데, 무슨 뜻인지 전혀 모르겠더라고요.

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission.
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대) 놈들을 감시하고 계세요. 그놈들은 믿을 수가 없거든요. 그래도 경의 임무에 대해선 말하면 안 되는데.

english: Tell me about this place.
This place? It's the castle crypt. The greatest White Knights are buried here, after a lifetime in the service of Saradomin. At least, that's how it used to be.
translation: 여기요? 성의 지하 묘지예요. 평생 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬긴 가장 위대한 White Knights(백기사)들이 여기 묻혀요. 적어도 예전엔 그랬죠.

english: When I was a new recruit, they brought me here and told me that if I served Saradomin faithfully, and with distinction, maybe I'd earn the honour of burial in this place too.
translation: 제가 갓 들어온 신병이었을 때, 여기 데려와서는 Saradomin(사라도민)을 충실하게, 그리고 훌륭하게 섬기면 저도 이곳에 묻히는 영광을 얻을지 모른다고 했어요.

english: But if you think about it, that's never going to happen - there just isn't space for more tombs! Anyway, my plan is to avoid dying, and maybe marry one of the barmaids when I retire.
translation: 그런데 생각해 보면 그럴 일은 절대 없어요. 무덤을 더 만들 공간이 없거든요! 아무튼 제 계획은 안 죽고 버티다가, 은퇴하면 술집 여종업원이랑 결혼하는 거예요.

english: What's with the glowing portal thing?
translation: 저 빛나는 차원문 같은 건 뭐예요?

english: It's because of something the Temple Knights have, called the Gaze of Saradomin. They get the option of being brought to Falador when they die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: Temple Knights(템플 기사단)이 가진 Gaze of Saradomin(사라도민의 시선)이라는 것 때문이에요. 그분들은 죽으면 Falador(팔라도르)로 옮겨지는 걸 선택할 수 있어서, Death(죽음)이 이 근처에 늘 머물러 있어야 하거든요.

english: That portal takes you to Death's own realm. He's got portals in all the places where people go when they die - Lumbridge, Edgeville and the rest. I hate it - the thing's terrifying!
translation: 저 차원문을 지나면 Death(죽음)의 영역으로 가요. 사람들이 죽어서 가게 되는 곳마다 차원문을 두고 있대요. Lumbridge(럼브리지), Edgeville(에지빌) 같은 곳들 말이에요. 전 저게 정말 싫어요. 너무 무섭다고요!

english: I'll leave you alone.
Can I help you, [sir/madam]?
You don't seem to be cleaning much.
translation: 청소는 별로 안 하시는 것 같은데요.

english: What's your master doing in Burthorpe?
translation: 모시는 기사분은 Burthorpe(버소프)에서 뭘 하고 계세요?

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard, [sir/madam]. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission, even with a knight such as yourself.
translation: Imperial Guard(제국 근위대) 놈들을 감시하고 계세요, [sir/madam]. 그놈들은 믿을 수가 없거든요. 그래도 경의 임무에 대해선 말하면 안 돼요. 기사님 같은 분께라도요.

english: It's because of the Gaze of Saradomin. You Temple Knights get the option of being brought to Falador when you die, so Death has to maintain a presence in the area.
translation: Gaze of Saradomin(사라도민의 시선) 때문이에요. 기사님 같은 Temple Knights(템플 기사단) 분들은 죽으면 Falador(팔라도르)로 옮겨지는 걸 선택할 수 있어서, Death(죽음)이 이 근처에 늘 머물러 있어야 하거든요.

english: Who are you and what are you doing?
You don't seem to be cleaning much.
translation: 청소는 별로 안 하시는 것 같은데요.

english: What's your master doing in Burthorpe?
translation: 모시는 기사분은 Burthorpe(버소프)에서 뭘 하고 계세요?

english: Tell me about this place.
What's with the glowing portal thing?
translation: 저 빛나는 차원문 같은 건 뭐예요?

english: I'll leave you alone.
Hi, how can I help you?
I'm fine thanks.
What do you have for sale?
I'm fine thanks.
Who are you?
I'm a Squire for the Void Knights.
The who?
The Void Knights, they are great warriors of balance who do Guthix's work here in Gielinor.
translation: Void Knights(보이드 기사단)요. 이곳 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 Guthix(구식스)의 뜻을 받드는 위대한 균형의 전사들이죠.

english: Wow, can I join?
Entry is strictly invite only, however we do need help continuing Guthix's work.
translation: 입단은 철저히 초대로만 이루어져요. 하지만 Guthix(구식스)의 일을 이어 가는 데 도움이 필요하긴 해요.

english: Good luck with that.
What kind of work?
Ah well you see we try to keep Gielinor as Guthix intended, it's very challenging. Actually we've been having some problems recently, maybe you could help us?
translation: 아, 그게요, 저희는 Gielinor(길리노르)를 Guthix(구식스)께서 뜻하신 모습 그대로 지키려고 해요. 아주 힘든 일이죠. 사실 요즘 문제가 좀 생겼는데, 혹시 도와주실 수 있을까요?

english: Yeah ok, what's the problem?

Well the order has become quite diminished over the years, it's a very long process to learn the skills of a Void Knight. Recently there have been breaches into our realm from somewhere else, and strange creatures
translation: 음, 기사단은 세월이 흐르면서 규모가 많이 줄었어요. Void Knight(보이드 기사)의 기술을 익히려면 아주 오랜 시간이 걸리거든요. 그런데 최근 어딘가에서 저희 영역으로 틈이 뚫려서, 이상한 생물들이

english: have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: 쏟아져 들어오고 있어요. 그대로 둘 수는 없죠. 도와주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: How can I help?
We send launchers from our outpost to the nearby islands. If you go and wait in the lander there that'd really help.
translation: 저희는 전초기지에서 근처 섬들로 상륙정을 보내요. 거기 상륙정에 가서 기다려 주시면 정말 큰 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Sorry, but I can't.
I'd rather not, sorry.
What's 'Gielinor'?
It is the name that Guthix gave to this world, so we honour him with its use.
translation: Guthix(구식스)께서 이 세계에 붙여 주신 이름이에요. 그래서 저희는 그 이름을 쓰며 그분을 기리죠.

english: Uh huh, sure.
Where does this ship go?
To the Void Knight outpost. It's a small island just off Karamja.
translation: Void Knight(보이드 기사) 전초기지로 가요. Karamja(카람자) 바로 앞바다에 있는 작은 섬이에요.

english: That's nice.
I'd like to go to your outpost.
Certainly, right this way.
The ship arrives at the Void Knight outpost.
translation: 배가 Void Knight(보이드 기사) 전초기지에 도착했다.

english: I'd like to go back to Port Sarim please.
Ok, but please come back soon and help us.
translation: 알겠어요. 하지만 꼭 다시 와서 도와주세요.

english: The ship arrives at Port Sarim.
What is this place?
This is our outpost. From here we send launches out to the nearby islands to beat back the invaders.
translation: 여기는 저희 전초기지예요. 여기서 근처 섬들로 상륙정을 보내 침략자들을 물리치죠.

english: What invaders?
Recently there have been breaches into our realm from somewhere else, and strange creatures have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: 최근 어딘가에서 저희 영역으로 틈이 뚫려서, 이상한 생물들이 쏟아져 들어오고 있어요. 그대로 둘 수는 없죠. 도와주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: Sorry, you'll need to speak to one of the Knights about that. I'm just a humble squire with years of training still to undergo!
translation: 죄송하지만 그건 기사님들께 여쭤보셔야 해요. 저는 아직 몇 년이나 수련을 더 받아야 하는 보잘것없는 종자일 뿐이거든요!

english: Alright, good luck with that.
You must defend the Void Knight while the portals are unsummoned. The ritual takes twenty minutes though, so you can help out by destroying them yourselves! Now GO GO GO!
translation: 포털이 소환 해제되는 동안 Void Knight(보이드 기사)를 지켜야 해요. 그런데 의식이 이십 분이나 걸리니까, 여러분이 직접 포털을 부수면 큰 도움이 돼요! 자, 어서어서 가요!

english: Be quick, we're under attack!
What's going on?

This island is being invaded by outsiders and the Void Knight over there is using a ritual to unsummon their portals. We must defend the Void Knight at all costs, however if you get an opening you can destroy the
translation: 이 섬이 외부 침략자들에게 공격받고 있어요. 저기 있는 Void Knight(보이드 기사)가 의식을 치러 놈들의 포털을 소환 해제하는 중이에요. 무슨 일이 있어도 보이드 기사를 지켜야 해요. 그래도 틈이 보이면 직접

english: portals yourself.
How do I repair things?

There are trees on the island. You'll need to chop them down for logs and use a hammer to repair the defences. Be careful though, the trees here don't grow back very fast so your resources are limited!
translation: 섬에 나무가 있어요. 나무를 베어 통나무를 얻고 망치로 방어 시설을 수리하면 돼요. 그래도 조심하세요. 여기 나무는 금방 다시 자라지 않아서 자원이 한정돼 있거든요!

english: I want to leave.
Away you go then, the lander will take you back.
translation: 그럼 가세요. 상륙정이 다시 데려다줄 거예요.

english: The player is taken back to the Void Knights' Outpost.
translation: 플레이어가 Void Knights' Outpost(보이드 기사단 전초기지)로 돌아갔다.

english: I'd better get back to it then.
Who are you?
Wow, can I join?
What kind of work?
Good luck with that.
Yeah ok, what's the problem?
How can I help?
Sorry, but I can't.
What's 'Gielinor'?
I'd rather not, sorry.
Uh huh, sure.
Where does this ship go?
I'd like to go to your outpost.
That's nice.
I'd like to go back to Port Sarim please.
What is this place?
What invaders?
Can you exchange my Commendation points for training?
translation: 제 Commendation points(공훈 포인트)를 훈련으로 바꿔 줄 수 있나요?

english: What's going on?
How do I repair things?
I want to leave.
I'd better get back to it then.
Hi, how can I help you?
Who are you?
I'm a Squire for the Void Knights.
The who?
The Void Knights, they are great warriors of balance who do Guthix's work here in Gielinor.
translation: Void Knights(보이드 기사단)요. 이곳 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 Guthix(구식스)의 뜻을 받드는 위대한 균형의 전사들이죠.

english: Wow, can I join?
Entry is strictly invite only, however we do need help continuing Guthix's work.
translation: 입단은 철저히 초대로만 이루어져요. 하지만 Guthix(구식스)의 일을 이어 가는 데 도움이 필요하긴 해요.

english: Good luck with that.
What kind of work?
Ah well you see we try to keep Gielinor as Guthix intended, it's very challenging. Actually we've been having some problems recently, maybe you could help us?
translation: 아, 그게요, 저희는 Gielinor(길리노르)를 Guthix(구식스)께서 뜻하신 모습 그대로 지키려고 해요. 아주 힘든 일이죠. 사실 요즘 문제가 좀 생겼는데, 혹시 도와주실 수 있을까요?

english: Yeah ok, what's the problem?

Well the order has become quite diminished over the years, it's a very long process to learn the skills of a Void Knight. Recently there have been breaches into our realm from somewhere else, and strange creatures
translation: 음, 기사단은 세월이 흐르면서 규모가 많이 줄었어요. Void Knight(보이드 기사)의 기술을 익히려면 아주 오랜 시간이 걸리거든요. 그런데 최근 어딘가에서 저희 영역으로 틈이 뚫려서, 이상한 생물들이

english: have been pouring through. We can't let that happen, and we'd be very grateful if you'd help us.
translation: 쏟아져 들어오고 있어요. 그대로 둘 수는 없죠. 도와주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

english: How can I help?
We send launchers from our outpost to the nearby islands. If you go and wait in the lander there that'd really help.
translation: 저희는 전초기지에서 근처 섬들로 상륙정을 보내요. 거기 상륙정에 가서 기다려 주시면 정말 큰 도움이 될 거예요.

english: Sorry, but I can't.
I'd rather not, sorry.
What's 'Gielinor'?
It is the name that Guthix gave to this world, so we honour him with its use.
translation: Guthix(구식스)께서 이 세계에 붙여 주신 이름이에요. 그래서 저희는 그 이름을 쓰며 그분을 기리죠.

english: Uh huh, sure.
What's going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: This is where we launch our landers to combat the invasion of the nearby islands. You'll see three landers - one for novice, intermediate and veteran adventurers. Each has a different difficulty, but they therefore offer
translation: 여기서 근처 섬들을 노리는 침공에 맞서 상륙정을 출발시켜요. 상륙정은 세 대인데, 각각 초보자, 중급자, 숙련자 모험가용이에요. 난이도가 저마다 다르지만, 그만큼

english: varying rewards.
And this lander is...?
The intermediate.
So how do they work?

Simple. We send a lander out every few minutes, however we need at least 5 volunteers or it's a suicide mission. The lander can only hold a maximum of 25 people though, so we do send them out early if they get
translation: 간단해요. 몇 분마다 상륙정을 하나씩 보내는데, 지원자가 최소 5명은 있어야 해요. 아니면 자살 임무나 다름없거든요. 다만 상륙정에는 최대 25명까지만 탈 수 있어서, 자리가

english: full. If you'd be willing to help us then just wait in the lander and we'll launch it as soon as it's ready. However you will need a combat level of 70 to use this lander.
translation: 다 차면 일찍 보내기도 해요. 도와주실 생각이 있으면 상륙정에서 기다리기만 하세요. 준비되는 대로 바로 출발시킬게요. 단, 이 상륙정을 이용하려면 전투 레벨이 70은 돼야 해요.

We're about to launch!

Wow, can I join?

Good luck with that.

english: I'm fine thanks.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
Who are you?
Not much to say. Came to Weiss with other trolls when we got kicked out of caves further south, but I was just young troll then.
translation: 별로 할 말 없어. 남쪽 더 먼 동굴에서 쫓겨났을 때 다른 트롤들이랑 Weiss(바이스) 왔어. 근데 그때 나 어린 트롤이었어.

english: Mostly been enjoying living round Weiss, 'cos wildlife is interesting here.
translation: 거의 Weiss(바이스) 사는 거 즐기면서 지냈어. 여기 야생동물 재밌으니까.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 몇 년 전에 남쪽 더 먼 동굴에서 쫓겨나고 트롤들이 지었어. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 좋아. 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 남편 트롤이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 좋아졌어.

english: Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 에, 좀 거칠어. 근데 점점 나아지는 중. Snowflake(눈송이)가 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으면 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그러니까 응, 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이라 Weiss(바이스) 살기 좋은 곳. 트롤들 다 눈송이 좋아해. 그 남편 트롤 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: I'll be off.
Who are you?
Tell me about this place.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
So what kind of spider are you...?
The hive cluster is under attack!
Erm, I think the attack is over. I have already killed your queen.
translation: 음, 공격은 끝난 것 같은데. 너희 여왕은 내가 이미 처치했거든.

english: Then we should spawn more overlords!
Don't you dare!
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Thank you for all your help in solving the murder.
translation: 살인 사건을 해결하는 데 여러모로 도와주셔서 고마워요.

english: Hello bold adventurer.
Are these your trucks?
Yes, I use them to transport coal over the river. I will let other people use them too, I'm a nice person like that...
translation: 네, 이걸로 강 건너편까지 석탄을 실어 나르죠. 다른 사람들도 쓰게 해 준답니다. 제가 원래 그렇게 친절한 사람이거든요...

english: Just put coal in a truck and I'll move it down to my depot over the river.
translation: 광차에 석탄을 넣어 두기만 하세요. 그럼 강 건너 제 창고까지 옮겨 드릴게요.

english: Hello Mr. Stankers.
Would you like a poison chalice?
translation: poison chalice(독이 든 술잔) 한 잔 드릴래요?

english: Yes please.
What's a poison chalice?
It's an exciting drink I've invented. I don't know what it tastes like, I haven't tried it myself.
translation: 제가 발명한 짜릿한 음료예요. 무슨 맛인지는 몰라요. 저도 아직 안 마셔 봤거든요.

english: No thank you.
Are these your trucks?
Hello Mr. Stankers.
Yes please.
What's a poison chalice?
No thank you.
Welcome to my private little wyvern area.
translation: 내 작은 개인 와이번 구역에 온 걸 환영해.

english: Who are you?
I'm Steve. You may have heard of my big cousin Nieve - she's one of the Slayer Masters. She's the famous one in the family. But Nieve's not here - this area's mine
translation: 난 Steve(스티브)야. 내 사촌 누나 Nieve(니에브)는 들어 봤을 거야. Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 중 하나지. 우리 집안에서 유명한 건 걔야. 하지만 니에브는 여기 없어. 이 구역은 내 거야.

english: Why is this wyvern area private?
translation: 이 와이번 구역은 왜 개인 구역이에요?

english: Because I say so! My cousin Nieve thinks she's so great because she's got a big cave where she can boss people around. So I carved some steps out of the ice, and made myself a training area here.
translation: 내가 그렇다니까! 내 사촌 Nieve(니에브)는 사람들을 부려 먹을 수 있는 커다란 동굴이 있다고 잘난 척하거든. 그래서 나도 얼음을 깎아서 계단을 만들고, 여기 내 수련장을 차렸지.

english: So are you a Slayer Master?
No, I'm not. My cousin Nieve is a Slayer Master. There's nothing special about her, you know. All she does is tell people to kill stuff. That's Slayer Masters for you.
translation: 아니, 난 아니야. 내 사촌 Nieve(니에브)가 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)지. 걔가 뭐 특별한 것도 없어. 그냥 사람들한테 뭘 죽이라고 시키는 게 다야. 슬레이어 마스터들이 원래 그렇지.

english: Thanks, goodbye.
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 좋아, 아주 잘하고 있어. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리 처치야.
