english: You're still hunting [monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [monster] 사냥 중이잖아. [amount]마리 남았어. 임무 끝내고 다시 와.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그건 너한테 맞는 임무가 아닌 것 같은데. 취소해 줄까? 임무 연속 기록은 지워지지 않아.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 알았어, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받으면 돼.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상도 꽤 있고, Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 여러 가지 팔고 있어.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기 좀 해요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 네 전투 레벨과 상관없이 우리 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 줄 수 있어.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 좋아, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 임무를 정할 때 네 전투 레벨을 고려할 거야. 그러니 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거야.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)들이 임무를 정할 때 네 전투 레벨을 고려할 거야. 그러니 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거야.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
translation: 알았어, 계속 네 전투 레벨을 확인할게.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 제 전투 레벨 확인하지 마세요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알았어, 이제부터 모든 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 네 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에서 아무 임무나 줄 거야.

english: I see you're the new Slayer Master here.
Yes, Nieve used to be the local Slayer Master - she's my cousin. She's gone off somewhere now, so I'm taking over.
translation: 그래, 원래는 Nieve(니에브)가 이 지역 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)였어. 내 사촌이야. 걔가 어디론가 떠나서 이제 내가 맡고 있지.

english: How sad for you.
Yes, Nieve used to be the local Slayer Master - she was my cousin. We weren't particularly close, but I came here straight away to take over the job.
translation: 그래, 원래는 Nieve(니에브)가 이 지역 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)였어. 내 사촌이었지. 딱히 친하진 않았지만, 그 일을 이어받으려고 곧장 달려왔어.

english: I'd hoped I'd receive a shield like Nieve's when I took over her job, but I've not been given one so far. I guess the perks of the job aren't what they used to be.
translation: Nieve(니에브)의 일을 이어받으면 걔 거 같은 방패를 받을 줄 알았는데, 아직 하나도 못 받았어. 요즘은 이 일의 혜택도 예전 같지 않나 봐.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: [player name](이)라고 해요. 마법으로 당신과 대화하고 있어요.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
I love farming, but I need some help!
translation: 난 농사가 정말 좋은데, 도움이 좀 필요해!

english: Steve has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
Is there? I don't think so, try again.
translation: 그래? 아닌 것 같은데. 다시 해 봐.

english: I believe you're right!
Steve has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
translation: Steve(스티브)가 당신에게 [another clue scroll/a casket] 하나를 주었다!

english: You're not sure they can help you with this.
translation: 이 사람이 이 일을 도와줄 수 있을지 모르겠다.

english: Who are you?
Why is this wyvern area private?
translation: 이 와이번 구역은 왜 개인 구역이에요?

english: So are you a Slayer Master?
Thanks, goodbye.
I need another assignment.
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기 좀 해요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 제 전투 레벨 확인하지 마세요. 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: I see you're the new Slayer Master here.
Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Do you want to buy any stone for building? Or gold leaf?
translation: 건축용 돌 좀 사실래요? 아니면 gold leaf(금박)는요?

english: No thanks.
What kind of stone do you sell?
A few kinds. Limestone, of course. Here in Keldagrim we're surrounded by the stuff so I can practically give it away! You'll be able to build some kinds of furniture out of that.
translation: 몇 가지 있어요. 당연히 limestone(석회암)이 있죠. 여기 Keldagrim(켈다그림)은 사방이 그거라서 거의 공짜로 드릴 수 있을 정도예요! 그걸로 몇 가지 가구를 만들 수 있어요.

english: Marble is much better, of course, but it costs a lot for me to get hold of it. You can make some beautiful pieces of furniture out of that.
translation: 물론 대리석이 훨씬 좋지만, 구하는 데 돈이 많이 들어요. 그걸로는 아름다운 가구를 만들 수 있죠.

english: I also sell gold leaf, which can be used to decorate furniture made of marble or mahogany.
translation: gold leaf(금박)도 팔아요. 대리석이나 마호가니로 만든 가구를 장식하는 데 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Then for the very special furniture I sell these magic stones. Only the most skilled builders can work them, but they can create a few amazing pieces of furniture with them.
translation: 그리고 아주 특별한 가구를 위해 이 magic stones(마법석)도 팔아요. 가장 숙련된 건축가만 다룰 수 있지만, 그걸로 정말 놀라운 가구 몇 점을 만들 수 있죠.

english: So, do you want to buy anything?
Yes please
No thanks
What kind of stone do you sell?
Hello there.
Hello. What can I do for you?
I'm not sure. Do you have anything for sale?
I'm afraid not. All the recent chaos has caused a lot of supply issues. It will be a long time before things are properly back to normal.
translation: 안타깝지만 없어요. 최근 혼란 때문에 물자 공급에 문제가 많이 생겼거든요. 제대로 정상으로 돌아오려면 한참 걸릴 거예요.

english: Oh, that's a shame. Never mind then.
Pst, wanna hear a secret?
Sure!
They're not normal!
No thanks.
Strange Old Man, I was wondering if I could ask a favour of you.
translation: Strange Old Man(이상한 노인) 씨, 부탁 하나 드려도 될까요?

english: Currently when I'm trying to go plundering the catacombs here, my mind is plagued by several inconvenient warnings about the dangers below.
translation: 요즘 여기 지하 묘지를 털러 가려고 하면, 아래의 위험을 알리는 성가신 경고들이 여러 개 머릿속에 떠올라서 괴로워요.

english: I was wondering, do you know of a way to condense these warnings into a single condensed one?
translation: 혹시 이 경고들을 하나로 합치는 방법을 아세요?

english: AAAAAAAAARRRRRRGGGGGHHHHHHHH?
Wow, you'll have that arranged for me? Thanks a lot, Strange Old Man!
translation: 와, 그렇게 해 주시는 거예요? 정말 고마워요, 이상한 노인 씨!

english: Strange Old Man, thanks for having those mental warnings I was having condensed into a single one, but I miss having them seperated.
translation: Strange Old Man(이상한 노인) 씨, 머릿속 경고들을 하나로 합쳐 주셔서 고맙긴 한데, 따로따로 뜨던 게 그리워요.

english: Is there any chance you'd be willing to change it back for me?
translation: 혹시 다시 원래대로 바꿔 주실 수 있을까요?

english: Knock knock.
Who's there?
A big scary monster HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
Okay...
I'll leave you to it then...
AAAAAAAAARRRRRRGGGGGHHHHHHHH!
What's wrong?
What? I didn't ask for a book!
translation: 뭐? 난 책 달라고 한 적 없어!

english: Dig, dig, dig.
It's time.
Time for what?
Time to dig. To dig, dig, dig. But no normal dig. We now have new purpose!
translation: 팔 때야. 파고, 파고, 또 파는 거지. 하지만 평범하게 파는 게 아니야. 이제 새 목적이 생겼거든!

english: What do you mean? What purpose?
The brothers six! Dutiful servants of Saradomin... At least, that's what they'd tell you! Ha! Not so. Not so.
translation: 여섯 형제! Saradomin(사라도민)의 충실한 종들... 적어도 놈들은 그렇게 말하겠지! 하! 아니야. 아니고말고.

english: They made a pact you see! Strength in life for servitude in death.
translation: 놈들은 계약을 맺었어, 알겠어? 살아서는 힘을, 죽어서는 섬김을.

english: Servitude?
Yes! They guard it for him! That was their purpose, but that time is up now. He wants it back! You can get it! You can dig!
translation: 그래! 놈들은 그분을 위해 그걸 지키고 있어! 그게 놈들의 목적이었지만, 이제 그 시간은 끝났어. 그분이 그걸 돌려받길 원해! 네가 가져올 수 있어! 네가 팔 수 있어!

english: You want me to bring you something?
The icon! He needs it now! You must dig, dig dig. Slay the brothers six! It's okay, it won't hurt them... much. The icon will be in the chest!
translation: icon(성상)! 그분이 지금 그걸 필요로 해! 넌 파야 해, 파고 또 파! 여섯 형제를 처치해! 괜찮아, 놈들은 아프지 않을 거야... 별로는. 성상은 chest(상자) 안에 있을 거야!

english: Right... So you want me to go and kill the six brothers and bring you back an icon?
translation: 그러니까... 저보고 여섯 형제를 죽이고 성상을 가져오라는 거죠?

english: Yes! Do this! Do this! Maybe little prize for you if you do. But first you must dig! Dig, dig, dig!
translation: 그래! 해! 해! 해 주면 작은 상을 줄지도 몰라. 하지만 먼저 파야 해! 파라, 파라, 파라!

english: Can you tell me more about the brothers?
translation: 형제들에 대해 좀 더 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: The brothers? His faithful servants! Book tell you more! Take it! I don't even want it!
translation: 형제들? 그분의 충실한 종들! 책이 더 알려 줄 거야! 가져가! 난 그거 필요도 없어!

english: The brothers? His faithful servants! Book tell you more! Read it! Read it!
translation: 형제들? 그분의 충실한 종들! 책이 더 알려 줄 거야! 읽어! 읽어 보라고!

english: I wanted to ask you about warnings.
translation: 경고에 대해 여쭤보고 싶은 게 있어요.

english: Yes?
I was wondering, do you know of a way to condense these warnings into a single one?
translation: 혹시 이 경고들을 하나로 합치는 방법을 아세요?

english: Thanks for having those mental warnings I was having condensed into a single one, but I miss having them seperated.
translation: 머릿속 경고들을 하나로 합쳐 주셔서 고맙긴 한데, 따로따로 뜨던 게 그리워요.

english: I'm guessing that was a yes? In that case, thanks.
translation: 지금 그게 된다는 뜻이죠? 그럼 고마워요.

english: I'll be back soon.
Icon?
I don't have it yet.
Slow! No slow! Only fast! Fast dig! Dig, dig, dig!
translation: 느려! 느리면 안 돼! 빨리만! 빨리 파! 파라, 파라, 파라!

english: Okay, I'll be back soon.
Yes, I have it here.
At last! Quick! Give it!
You did it! Now for me.
It's all little bits now.
What? But why? I thought you needed it!
Yes! Needed it for him, but not to keep! His friend asked him to protect it, but he made a new plan, a better plan!
translation: 그래! 그분을 위해 필요했지만, 간직하려던 건 아니야! 그분의 친구가 그걸 지켜 달라고 부탁했지만, 그분은 새 계획을 세웠어. 더 나은 계획을!

english: What are you on about?
The old plan is gone. We're not doing it that way. His friend won't be happy, but it was for the best!
translation: 옛 계획은 끝났어. 그런 식으로는 안 할 거야. 그분의 친구는 언짢겠지만, 이게 최선이었어!

english: Now we're doing it his way...
translation: 이제 우린 그분의 방식대로 할 거야...

english: Anyway, job well done! Still more digging though. Always dig. Dig, dig, dig!
translation: 어쨌든, 수고했어! 그래도 팔 건 아직 더 있어. 언제나 파야지. 파라, 파라, 파라!

english: Oh, and don't forget your prize! He made it very clear you had to have a prize!
translation: 아, 상 받는 거 잊지 마! 그분이 너한테 꼭 상을 주라고 신신당부했거든!

english: Thanks... I guess.
Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Try again!
translation: 그럴 리가 있나? 다시 해 봐!

english: Spot on!
Sure!
No thanks.
Ask about tunnel warnings.
I'll leave you to it then...
What's wrong?
Can you tell me more about the brothers?
translation: 형제들에 대해 좀 더 말해 줄 수 있어요?

english: I wanted to ask you about warnings.
translation: 경고에 대해 여쭤보고 싶은 게 있어요.

english: I'll be back soon.
Okay, I'll be back soon.
Tell me about the Mimic.
Yes, I'd like to get Mimic challenges.
No, I don't think I want that.
What are you?
I don't think I want that.
I don't want Mimic challenges anymore.
No, I want to keep getting mimic challenges.
If you die in here, your items can be retrieved from the Strange Casket in Watson's house, for a fee of 90,000 coins. Anything else you leave in here will be lost permanently.
translation: 이곳에서 죽으면 Watson(왓슨)의 집에 있는 Strange Casket(이상한 함)에서 90,000코인을 내고 아이템을 되찾을 수 있다. 그 밖에 이곳에 남겨 둔 물건은 영영 사라진다.

english: Tell me about the Mimic.
Yes, I'd like to get Mimic challenges.
No, I don't think I want that.
What are you?
I don't think I want that.
I don't want Mimic challenges anymore.
No, I want to keep getting mimic challenges.
Fight the Mimic
Come back later
Hand over the Diamond of Smoke, or suffer!
translation: Diamond of Smoke(연기의 다이아몬드)를 내놔라, 안 그러면 고통받을 거다!

english: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of Blood!
translation: 넌 그 Diamond of Blood(피의 다이아몬드)를 가질 자격이 없다!

english: That Ice Diamond is mine, thief!
translation: 그 Ice Diamond(얼음 다이아몬드)는 내 거다, 이 도둑아!

english: The Diamond of Shadow is not yours to take!
translation: Diamond of Shadow(그림자의 다이아몬드)는 네가 가져갈 물건이 아니다!

english: Hello friend. What can I do for you?
Oh, sorry. I thought you were someone else.
translation: 아, 죄송해요. 다른 사람인 줄 알았어요.

english: Who did you think I was?
I thought you were that dirty murderer Vanstrom.
translation: 그 더러운 살인자 Vanstrom(밴스트롬)인 줄 알았어요.

english: Woah! It sounds like you've got a score to settle!
translation: 와! 단단히 갚아 줄 원한이 있는 모양이군!

english: I definitely have!
I think we've been through this before, haven't we?
translation: 우리 전에도 이 얘기 했던 것 같은데, 아닌가?

english: Thbbbbt!
Whine!
Who's a good doggy!
Woof!
Woof woof!
You give the dog some nice bones.
It happily gnaws on them.
You give the dog a nice piece of meat.
translation: 개에게 맛있는 고기 한 점을 줬다.

english: It gobbles it up.
You give the dog some mystery meat.
It seem to love it, but somthing feels wrong about all of this
translation: 개는 아주 좋아하는 것 같지만, 왠지 이 모든 게 잘못된 느낌이다.

english: Grrrr!
That's disgusting - you can't give it to the poor dog!
translation: 역겹다. 불쌍한 개한테 그런 걸 줄 순 없다!

english: The dog doesn't seem interested in that.
translation: 개는 그것에 관심이 없는 것 같다.

english: Bark!
He doesn't approve of your ears.
translation: 개가 당신의 귀를 마음에 들어 하지 않는다.

english: Grrr!
Sss!
Woof
Sss!
SSSS!
You pet the dog...
Hey there!
Did you see the way I distracted that guy? Man, I'm one smooth operator!
translation: 내가 그 아저씨 정신 팔게 한 거 봤어? 와, 나 진짜 수완 좋지 않아?

english: You did good, kid.
So where's my money?
What money?
Don't play stupid with me, I'm better at it. Where's my money?
translation: 바보인 척하지 마. 그건 내가 더 잘하거든. 내 돈 어딨어?

english: Oh, that money! I don't think you deserve it!
translation: 아, 그 돈! 넌 받을 자격 없는 것 같은데!

english: Liar, thief!
How observant of you!
Give me my money!
Make me!
You'll be sorry!
Thief! Thief!
Shut up! Don't cause any more trouble or you'll regret it.
translation: 닥쳐! 더 이상 말썽 일으키면 후회하게 될 거다.

english: Give me double and I'll be quiet!
Okay, here you go - you thief.
translation: 알았어, 자, 여기 있다. 이 도둑놈아.

english: Okay, let's do it again.
I think I need to try a different tactic. Sorry, kid!
Well do you need any information then?
No thanks, I think I have a fair idea of what is going on in the town now.
translation: 아니, 됐어. 이제 마을에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 대충 알 것 같아.

english: What money?
Here you go, thanks.
Hello.
H-hi.
Who are you?
Me? I'm Wonny. Just a lonely werewolf keeping to himself. I mean no twouble.
translation: 저요? 전 워니예요. 그냥 혼자 조용히 지내는 외오운 늑대인간이에요. 말썽 부일 생각은 없어요.

english: You sound awfully afraid for a werewolf...
I know... My fwiend dared me to come down here. Said I wasn't bwave enough. He was wight...
translation: 알아요... 친구가 여기 내여와 보라고 부추겼어요. 제가 그엏게 용감하지 않다면서요. 걔 말이 맞았어요...

english: But, you're a werewolf?
Yes, I'm a cowardly dog, alwight! My fwiends call me Stwong Wonny as a joke. It isn't weally funny though.
translation: 네, 전 겁쟁이 개예요, 됐죠! 친구들은 저를 농담으오 '힘센 워니'아고 불어요. 별오 웃기지도 않은데.

english: Couldn't you turn into a wolf if you're scared?
Well, that's the thing.
I can't twust myself. I have a hunger that I stwuggle to contwol once twansformed.
translation: 제 자신을 믿을 수가 없어요. 일단 변신하면 억누르기 힘든 굶주임이 생기거든요.

english: Huh, I wasn't aware werewolves had a conscience.
translation: 흠, 늑대인간한테 양심이 있는 줄은 몰랐네요.

english: Well that's pwetty wude. I twy to be an upstanding citizen... Only a little killing! And only if they deserve it.
translation: 그거 꽤 무예하시네요. 전 바른 시민이 되여고 노역한다고요... 아주 조금만 죽여요! 그어고 죽어도 싼 사람만요.

english: Oh, don't worry, I'm a massive hypocrite.
translation: 아, 걱정 마요, 저야말로 엄청난 위선자거든요.

english: Why are you here?
I only planned to look awound, but I got all lost and found myself face to face with a demon. I wan and wan and stopped here for a dwink but it's too dirty.
translation: 그냥 좀 둘어보여고 했는데, 길을 잃어서 악마랑 딱 마주쳤지 뭐예요. 막 달이고 또 달여서 여기서 뭐 좀 마시여고 멈췄는데 물이 너무 더어워요.

english: Not the demon woman back yonder? I suppose she looks pretty vicious, but she seems alright.
translation: 저 뒤에 있는 악마 여자 말이에요? 꽤 사나워 보이긴 하는데, 괜찮은 사람 같던데요.

english: I know her type. One of them hangs out near Canifis and he's always boasting about being the only demon in Mowytania as the others all wan away.
translation: 저도 그런 부유 알아요. 그중 하나가 Canifis(카니피스) 근처에 사는데, 다른 악마들은 다 도망가서 Mowytania(모이타니아)에 악마는 자기뿐이아고 맨날 자앙해요.

english: Well, I'm sure she's harmless. If you go back that way you should see a group of men in red cloaks. Head past them and you're back in the cave that will lead you to the surface.
translation: 뭐, 분명 해롭진 않을 거예요. 그쪽으로 돌아가면 붉은 망토를 입은 남자들이 보일 거예요. 그들을 지나가면 지상으로 이어지는 동굴로 돌아갈 수 있어요.

english: Thanks for the diwections, I'll west here a little longer though.
translation: 길 알여 줘서 고마워요. 그래도 여기서 좀 더 쉬다 갈게요.

english: Alright, good luck!
Bye!
Wait, don't go!
I've places to be...
Oh, okay then.
Who are you?
Why are you here?
Bye!
Oh, hi again. News of your find has spread fast; you are quite famous around here now.
translation: 아, 또 만났네요. 당신이 발견한 소식이 금세 퍼져서, 이제 이 근처에선 꽤 유명인이에요.

english: Hey it's the great explorer! Thanks a lot for the help earlier!
translation: 어, 위대한 탐험가님이다! 아까 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요!

english: Hello there.
Hi there! Thanks again. Hey, maybe I'll be asking you for help next time. It seems you are something of an expert now!
translation: 안녕하세요! 다시 한번 고마워요. 그러고 보니 다음엔 제가 도움을 청할지도 모르겠어요. 이제 완전 전문가가 되신 것 같네요!

english: Can I help you today?
Can I go for a ride?
Minecart rides are 20 coins.
Of course.
I'm fine, thanks.
As a loyal customer of the Lovakengj Minecart Network, you're entitled to this.
translation: Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)의 단골손님이시니, 이걸 받으실 자격이 있어요.

english: Now, can I help you today?
You're already here, human.
Sorry, human, you can't use the Lovakengj Minecart Network. Speak to Miriam, at the main station by the southern Lovakengj bank, if you've got any questions.
translation: 미안하지만, 인간, Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)는 이용할 수 없어요. 궁금한 게 있으면 로바켕기 남쪽 은행 옆 중앙역에 있는 Miriam(미리암)에게 물어보세요.

english: Sorry, human, the Lovakengj Minecart Network is for citizens of Lovakengj only.
translation: 미안하지만, 인간, Lovakengj Minecart Network(로바켕기 광차 네트워크)는 로바켕기 시민만 이용할 수 있어요.

english: I've got this control scroll for you.
Thanks, human. I guess it's okay for you to ride my carts after all. So, can I help you?
translation: 고마워요, 인간. 이제 내 광차를 타도 괜찮을 것 같네요. 그래서, 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Thanks again for bringing me that control scroll. Can I help you today?
translation: control scroll(제어 두루마리)를 가져다줘서 다시 한번 고마워요. 오늘 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: No thanks, you've already given me one of those.
Can I go for a ride?
I'm fine, thanks.
What is it, human? I'm working.
translation: 무슨 일이죠, 인간? 나 일하는 중이에요.

english: How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 광석을 conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 올려놓으면 제련돼요. 보일러에 불을 때고 나머지 기계 장치를 돌리는 건 우리가 해 줄게요.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 그래도 파이프가 터질 때마다 furnace(용광로) 수리는 도와줘야 해요. 그냥 망치로 두들기면 돼요. 보통은 그걸로 고쳐지거든요.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 우리 서비스 비용은 coffer(금고)에 돈을 넣어서 내야 해요. 시간당 72,000코인이고, 우리랑 이 방에 있는 동안 계속 돈이 빠져나가요.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 나랑 형제들은 성장에 영향을 주는 희귀한 유전 질환이 있어요. 우릴 괴물 취급하기보다는, 우리가 기계 장치를 다룰 수 있다는 게 얼마나 쓸모 있는지 알아줬으면 좋겠네요.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 괜찮아요, 인간. 그런 말 한 게 당신이 처음은 아니니까. 자, 뭐 필요한 거 있어요? 나 여기서 할 일이 있거든요.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ... 이봐요, 뭐 도와줄 일이 있는 거예요, 아니면 그냥 무례하게 굴려고 온 거예요? 나 할 일 있어요.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
Shhh! I'm waiting for the show!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 있잖아, 난 그 구절 꽤 마음에 들었어...

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 좀 귀에 꽂히는데. 짜증 나지만. 귀에 꽂혀.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 어, 그 퀘스트 나도 해 봤는데!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
translation: 내가 뒷간에서 낸 소리가 더 낫겠다!

english: Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 네 노래는 하나도 말이 안 돼, 외지인!

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
I have met cows more musical than you!
When do you get to the good parts?
would torture us so, outerlander?
Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 정말이지, 내 평생 들어 본 소리 중에 최악이다!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 제발 그게 마지막 구절이라고 해 줘...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 내 귀가 이토록 모욕당한 적은 없었다!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 신들이시여, 제발! 저것 좀 멈춰 주소서!

english: If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 죽어 가는 내 전우들의 비명이 더 듣기 좋겠다!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 그런 건 난 아침 먹기 전에 다 해!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
Look who it is!
Hello again. How are things going?
Amazing! We get paid to eat all day, and our payment is more food. Life has never been better!
translation: 최고예요! 하루 종일 먹기만 하면 돈을 받는데, 그 돈이 또 음식이에요. 이렇게 좋을 수가 없어요!

english: Too right, Gary! This is much better than being on strike!
translation: 그러게 말이야, Gary(개리)! 파업하던 때보다 훨씬 낫지!

english: Glad to hear it.
Can you leave me alone please? I'm trying to get a bit of rest.
translation: 저 좀 내버려 둘래요? 좀 쉬려고 하거든요.

english: Sorry, I'm busy!
I want some bread!
Yes dad.
I'll be right back.
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A loaf of bread please.
Thanks.
Cheers.
I need more bread!
I need some silver ore!
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A piece of silver please.
Only one piece of silver? I need more!
translation: 은을 겨우 한 조각? 더 필요하다!

english: I need some new clothes!
What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
Some silk please.
These clothes are awful, get me some others!
translation: 이 옷은 형편없구나, 다른 걸로 가져와라!

english: My chisel's gone blunt, buy me one!
translation: 내 끌이 무뎌졌다, 하나 사 와라!

english: What's your father want now?
What'll it be, son?
A chisel please.
This chisel's rubbish, get me another!
translation: 이 끌은 쓰레기구나, 다른 걸로 가져와라!

english: Hello there.
I've not seen your face before. Given they let you come down here, I'm assuming you've been allowed to join the Alchemical Society?
translation: 처음 보는 얼굴이네요. 여기까지 내려오게 해 줬다면 Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)에 가입이 허락됐다는 뜻이겠죠?

english: That's right!
Well in that case, just through there is the lab we use to produce potions for the kingdom. However, before you head in and get started, there's a couple of things to note.
translation: 그렇다면, 바로 저쪽이 우리가 왕국에 공급할 물약을 만드는 실험실이에요. 하지만 들어가서 일을 시작하기 전에 알아 둘 게 몇 가지 있어요.

english: First, I can see you're not from around here, so I'll point out that Varlamorian Alchemy is a little different from the Druidic Herblore that you'll be familiar with.
translation: 우선, 보아하니 이 지역 사람이 아닌 것 같으니 말해 두죠. Varlamorian Alchemy(바를라모어 연금술)은 당신에게 익숙한 Druidic Herblore(드루이드 약초학)와는 조금 달라요.

english: How so?
We discovered that the majority of herbs in the world can be broken down into three alchemical reagents: Mox, Aga and Lye.
translation: 우리는 세상 약초 대부분이 세 가지 연금 시약, 즉 Mox(목스), Aga(아가), Lye(라이)로 분해될 수 있다는 걸 알아냈어요.

english: When mixed in the correct way, these three components produce drastically different results. As such, in the lab you will be using these components to create various potions.
translation: 이 세 성분을 제대로 섞으면 완전히 다른 결과물이 나와요. 그래서 실험실에서는 이 성분들로 여러 가지 물약을 만들게 될 거예요.

english: What potions do I need to make?
That depends. We get orders in from across the kingdom. You'll need to keep an eye out for what potions are currently desired and ensure you're making the right ones.
translation: 그건 그때그때 달라요. 왕국 곳곳에서 주문이 들어오거든요. 지금 어떤 물약이 필요한지 잘 살펴보고 맞는 걸 만들고 있는지 확인해야 해요.

english: Let's do that run through.
Very well... Listen closely.
The scene cuts to each part of the laboratory as they are discussed
translation: 설명에 따라 실험실 곳곳이 차례로 비친다

english: Start by breaking down herbs or unfinished potions over at theRefiner. This will give you your reagents:Mox,Aga, andLyepaste. The type you get will depend on the quality of what you put in.
translation: 먼저 Refiner(정제기)에서 약초나 미완성 물약을 분해하세요. 그러면 시약인 Mox(목스), Aga(아가), Lye(라이) 반죽이 나와요. 어떤 종류가 나올지는 넣은 재료의 품질에 따라 달라요.

english: Insert the paste into theHopperand it will become available to use in theMixer.
translation: 반죽을 Hopper(호퍼)에 넣으면 Mixer(혼합기)에서 쓸 수 있게 돼요.

english: From here, you'll need to pull theMixer Leversto create the right combination of reagents.
translation: 그다음엔 Mixer Levers(혼합기 레버)를 당겨서 시약을 알맞게 조합해야 해요.

english: But how do I know what the combinations are?
translation: 그런데 조합법은 어떻게 알 수 있죠?

english: I see you've already found our book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: 벌써 우리 lab notes(실험 노트)를 찾았군요. 거기에 우리 제품들의 제조법이 나와 있어요.

english: Have a look on the bookshelf for a book of lab notes. That'll give you the formulas for our various products.
translation: 책장에서 lab notes(실험 노트)를 찾아보세요. 거기에 우리 제품들의 제조법이 나와 있어요.

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. You can work on just one or them, or multiple. It's up to you.
translation: 무엇을 만들어야 하는지는 주문 목록을 확인하면 돼요. 주문은 항상 세 개 중에서 고를 수 있어요. 하나만 해도 되고 여러 개를 해도 돼요. 당신 마음이에요.

english: Just be aware that demand shifts fast here. Every time you fulfil one or more orders, a new set will come through.
translation: 다만 여기는 수요가 빨리 바뀐다는 걸 알아 두세요. 주문을 하나 이상 처리할 때마다 새 주문들이 들어와요.

english: Now, once you have set your desired combination of reagents, collect the unfinished mixture from theMixingVessel. This will then need to be processed on one of the three tables to finish it off.
translation: 자, 원하는 시약 조합을 맞췄으면 Mixing Vessel(혼합 용기)에서 미완성 혼합물을 꺼내세요. 그걸 세 작업대 중 하나에서 가공해야 완성돼요.

english: TheAlembicwillCrystalisethe mixture.
TheAgitatorwillHomogenisethe mixture.
And finally, theRetortwillConcentratethe mixture.
After processing, place the finished mixture on theConveyor Beltand move on to the next order.
translation: 가공이 끝나면 완성된 혼합물을 Conveyor Belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 올리고 다음 주문으로 넘어가면 돼요.

english: What if I get an order wrong, or am unable to fulfil any of the orders?
translation: 주문을 잘못 처리하거나, 어떤 주문도 처리하지 못하면 어떻게 돼요?

english: We always have need for spares, so fulfilling an incorrect order will still grant you a small reward and will refresh the orders.
translation: 여분은 늘 필요하니까 틀린 주문을 납품해도 작은 보상은 받고 주문도 새로 바뀌어요.

english: One final thing to mention... We have someDigweedgrowing in the lab.
translation: 마지막으로 하나 더... 실험실에 Digweed(디그위드)를 좀 기르고 있어요.

english: These rare herbs will occasionally come into maturity for a short period of time. Harvest them while you can!
translation: 이 희귀한 약초는 가끔 짧은 시간 동안만 다 자라요. 그럴 때 놓치지 말고 수확하세요!

english: Mixing some into your product will increase its potency and grant you bonus rewards.
translation: 제품에 조금 섞으면 효능이 높아지고 추가 보상도 받을 수 있어요.

english: Bonus rewards?

That's right. As you produce potions, you'll find yourself collecting three types ofResin. The types obtained depend on what reagents are used, with the quantities being determined by the complexity of the
translation: 맞아요. 물약을 만들다 보면 세 가지 Resin(레진)을 모으게 될 거예요. 어떤 종류를 얻을지는 사용한 시약에 따라 다르고, 양은

english: potion.
Potions usingDigweedwill reward additionalResin, as will handing in multiple potions in one go.
translation: Digweed(디그위드)를 넣은 물약은 Resin(레진)을 더 주고, 물약을 한 번에 여러 개 납품해도 더 받아요.

english: Got it! So, refine herbs, deposit into the hopper, mix some products, process them, and then throw them on the conveyor. Seems easy enough!
translation: 알겠어요! 그러니까 약초를 정제하고, 호퍼에 넣고, 제품을 섞고, 가공한 다음 컨베이어에 올리면 되는 거죠. 쉬워 보이네요!

english: I'm sure I can work it out.
Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음대로 해요. 생각이 바뀌면 난 여기 있을 테니까요.

english: What is it?
Can you explain how to make potions?
Can I have some rewards?
As you wish.
Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)에 대해 더 알려 주실래요?

english: Can't imagine there's much to tell beyond what you already know. We exist to bring about advancements in Herblore, but in truth, a lot of what we produce doesn't directly contribute to that.
translation: 이미 아는 것 말고는 딱히 말할 게 없을 것 같은데요. 우리는 Herblore(약초학)을 발전시키려고 존재하지만, 사실 우리가 만드는 것 대부분은 거기에 직접 보탬이 되진 않아요.

english: Instead, many of the potions we make here are simply to sell. Doing so is what provides the funding we need to further our true goals.
translation: 여기서 만드는 물약 상당수는 그냥 팔기 위한 거예요. 그렇게 해서 우리의 진짜 목표를 이어 가는 데 필요한 자금을 마련하죠.

english: Makes sense. So how did the society first get established?
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 학회는 처음에 어떻게 세워졌어요?

english: For a long time, it was just a couple of us operating out of a makeshift lab we'd built in my garden. Our big break came when the Moonrise Brewery and Winery learnt about us.
translation: 오랫동안 우리 몇 명이 내 정원에 지은 임시 실험실에서 일했을 뿐이에요. 큰 전환점은 Moonrise Brewery and Winery(문라이즈 양조장)이 우리를 알게 됐을 때였죠.

english: They provided us with some initial funding to properly get things going, but more importantly, they provided this lab space. This was actually one of their old wine cellars before we moved in.
translation: 그쪽에서 제대로 시작할 수 있게 초기 자금을 대 줬는데, 더 중요한 건 이 실험실 공간을 내줬다는 거예요. 우리가 들어오기 전엔 여기가 그쪽의 오래된 포도주 저장고였어요.

english: Why were they so interested in your work?
translation: 그 사람들은 왜 그렇게 당신들 연구에 관심이 많았던 거예요?

english: They never properly said why, just that they were very keen to see us grow. Maybe they're hoping our work can help them create new beers and wines.
translation: 이유를 제대로 말해 준 적은 없어요. 그저 우리가 크게 성장하길 무척 바란다고만 했죠. 어쩌면 우리 연구로 새로운 맥주나 포도주를 만들 수 있길 기대하는지도 모르고요.

english: I see. I suppose that makes sense.
Nothing, I'll be going now.
Hey! I haven't given you permission to do that!
translation: 이봐요! 그렇게 해도 된다고 허락한 적 없어요!

english: To know what needs making, you'll need to check the order list. There will always be three orders to choose from. Demand shifts fast here so every time you fulfil an order, a new set will come through.
translation: 무엇을 만들어야 하는지는 주문 목록을 확인하면 돼요. 주문은 항상 세 개 중에서 고를 수 있어요. 여기는 수요가 빨리 바뀌어서 주문을 처리할 때마다 새 주문들이 들어와요.

english: Let's do that run through.
I'm sure I can work it out.
Can you explain how to make potions?
Can I have some rewards?
Can you tell me more about the Alchemical Society?
translation: Alchemical Society(연금술 학회)에 대해 더 알려 주실래요?

english: Nothing, I'll be going now.
Veldaban told me about your involvement in the rebuilding of the statue. Congratulations.
translation: Veldaban(벨다반)에게서 조각상 재건에 힘써 주었다는 이야기를 들었소. 축하하오.

english: Thank you!
Who are you?
I am Bisi. I am the Supreme Commander of the Black Guard.
translation: 나는 Bisi(비시)요. Black Guard(검은 경비대)의 Supreme Commander(최고 사령관)이지.

english: I thought Veldaban was in command?
Only of our regiment in Keldagrim, and a most honourable position it is as well.
translation: 그건 Keldagrim(켈다그림)에 있는 우리 연대에 한해서요. 그 또한 매우 명예로운 자리지.

english: But the Black Guard has many regiments across the dwarven realm. All the Commanders of those regiments report to me.
translation: 하지만 Black Guard(검은 경비대)에는 드워프 왕국 곳곳에 많은 연대가 있소. 그 연대들의 사령관은 모두 내게 보고하지.

english: Oh yes, I helped Commander Lawgof once, in his fight against the goblins.
translation: 아, 맞다. 전에 Commander Lawgof(로고프 사령관)이 고블린들과 싸울 때 도와드린 적이 있어요.

english: That's good to hear.
What news have you?
Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Purple Pewter?
translation: 그대가 Purple Pewter(퍼플 퓨터)를 위해 조각상 재건을 도운 것 말이오?

english: Well, I heard that you helped Veldaban's father in the mines to the south. That's caused quite a bit of an upset in the Consortium, so I understand.
translation: 그리고 남쪽 광산에서 Veldaban(벨다반)의 아버지를 도왔다고 들었소. 그 일로 Consortium(컨소시엄)이 꽤 술렁이고 있다더군.

english: How so?
The amount of wealth that goldmine is generating might cause some distortion in the balance of power in the Consortium. But we'll see.
translation: 그 금광이 벌어들이는 부가 Consortium(컨소시엄)의 세력 균형을 흔들어 놓을지도 모르오. 하지만 두고 봐야지.

english: Apart from that there seems to be some general unrest in the city. Trouble is brewing in Keldagrim.
translation: 그 밖에도 도시 전반에 불안한 기운이 감돌고 있소. Keldagrim(켈다그림)에 문제가 싹트고 있지.

english: But I'm sure Commander Veldaban is on top of it. He's a very capable officer, and I'm starting to get too old for this sort of thing.
translation: 하지만 Commander Veldaban(벨다반 사령관)이 잘 대처하고 있으리라 믿소. 아주 유능한 장교이고, 나는 이제 이런 일을 하기엔 너무 늙어 가고 있으니.

english: I must go now.
Then I bid you farewell, human.
Who are you?
What news have you?
I must go now.
Hi!
Hi. How can I help?
Can you heal me?
Sorry, I'm not on duty.
PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
I was... looking to be healed.
No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: 절대 안 돼요, 짐만 다 싸면 바로 여기서 나갈 거예요!

english: You look healthy to me!
Of course!
Surgeon General Tafani heals you for 21 Hitpoints.
translation: Surgeon General Tafani(군의관장 타파니)가 Hitpoints(체력)을 21 회복시켜 준다.

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: 네, 많이 봐요. 다행히 웬만한 건 다 감당할 수 있어요. Jaraah(자라)는 정말 훌륭한 외과의예요. 방식이 좀 특이하긴 해도 일은 확실히 해내죠.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: 이런 말 하면 안 되지만, 그 사람 별명이 '도살자'예요.

english: That's reassuring.
Do you come here often?
I work here, so yes!
You're silly!
Can you tell me about your cape?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이죠! Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 성취의 상징이에요. 스킬을 마스터해서 레벨 99에 도달한 사람만 손에 넣고 그 혜택을 누릴 수 있죠.

english: The Cape of Hitpoints doubles the speed of your hitpoints replenishing when worn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: Cape of Hitpoints(체력 망토)를 착용하면 체력이 회복되는 속도가 두 배가 돼요. 또 도와드릴 게 있을까요?

english: Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: Skillcape of Hitpoints(체력 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Sorry, I'm under orders to not sell capes right now.
translation: 미안해요, 지금은 망토를 팔지 말라는 지시를 받았어요.

english: You cannot do that on this game world.
translation: 이 게임 월드에서는 그렇게 할 수 없습니다.

english: Why, certainly my friend. However, owning such an item makes you part of an elite group and wearing it will double the speed of your hitpoints replenishing.
translation: 물론이죠, 친구. 하지만 이런 물건을 가지면 엘리트 집단의 일원이 되고, 착용하면 체력이 회복되는 속도가 두 배가 돼요.

english: Such a privilege will cost you 99,000 coins.
Sorry, that's much too pricey.
I'm sorry you feel that way. Still if you change your mind...
translation: 그렇게 생각하신다니 아쉽네요. 그래도 마음이 바뀌면...

english: Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 좋아요, 이렇게 멋진 망토라면 그리 비싼 것도 아니죠.

english: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 안타깝게도 지금 가진 돈이 모자라요.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 모든 Skillcapes(스킬 망토)에는 후드가 공짜로 딸려 나와요. 스킬 홍보 행사거든요, 원 플러스 원 말이에요. 그러니 제가 하나 팔기 전에 소지품 공간을 좀 비워 주셔야 해요.

english: Wear this cape in good health, my friend.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 쓸 후드를 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Tafani hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: Tafani(타파니)가 스킬 망토에 쓸 후드를 하나 더 건네준다.

english: Can you heal me?
Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
Do you come here often?
Can you tell me about your cape?
Can I buy a Skillcape of Hitpoints from you?
translation: Skillcape of Hitpoints(체력 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Skillcape
Sorry, that's much too pricey.
Sure, that's not too expensive for such a magnificent cape.
translation: 좋아요, 이렇게 멋진 망토라면 그리 비싼 것도 아니죠.

english: Hood
He's too busy playing some succulent beats to stop and talk.
translation: 신나는 비트를 연주하느라 너무 바빠서 멈춰 이야기할 틈이 없다.

english: Excuse me...
What do you want? ...Oh, wait. I know! You're probably just like all the others, aren't you? After some fancy spell or potion from me, I bet!
translation: 뭘 원하나? ...아, 잠깐. 알겠군! 자네도 다른 녀석들이랑 똑같겠지? 분명 내게서 근사한 주문이나 물약이라도 얻어 가려는 거겠지!

english: What? No! At least, I don't think so. What sort of spells do you have?
translation: 네? 아니에요! 적어도 그런 것 같진 않아요. 어떤 주문이 있는데요?

english: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy- Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?
translation: 하! 그럴 줄 알았지! 자네가 원하는 건 분명 내 Aphro-Dizzy- Yak(사랑의 묘-야크) 주문이겠군! 누군가 자네한테 홀딱 반하게 만들고 싶은 거지, 응?

english: That spell sounds very interesting, but I didn't mean to disturb you!
translation: 그 주문 정말 흥미롭네요. 하지만 방해하려던 건 아니었어요!

english: Well, I see that you do have some manners. I'm glad to see that you use them.
translation: 흠, 예의는 좀 있나 보군. 예의를 차릴 줄 아니 다행일세.

english: Now, if it's all the same, I am very busy at the moment. Unless you want something specific, please come back another time.
translation: 자, 괜찮다면 난 지금 무척 바쁘네. 딱히 원하는 게 없다면 다음에 다시 오게.

english: Yes, of course. Goodbye!
Ummm...
Oh, it's you again! Well, what is it this time?
translation: 오, 또 자네로군! 그래, 이번엔 또 뭔가?

english: Do you have any jobs or quests that I could do for you?
translation: 제가 해 드릴 만한 일이나 퀘스트가 있나요?

english: Hah! There are plenty of things I need done, but something tells me you're not quite ready for them right now. Come back another time!
translation: 하! 시킬 일이야 많지. 하지만 왠지 자네는 아직 준비가 덜 된 것 같군. 다음에 다시 오게!

english: Okay.
Can't you see I'm very busy here? Be off with you!
translation: 내가 지금 무척 바쁜 게 안 보이나? 썩 물러가게!

english: Oh. Sorry.
Hello there, newcomer. My name is Brynna. My job is to teach you about the skills you can use to survive in this world.
translation: 안녕하세요, 신입. 제 이름은 Brynna(브리나)예요. 이 세계에서 살아남는 데 쓸 스킬들을 가르치는 게 제 일이에요.

english: The first skill we're going to look at is Fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 처음 살펴볼 스킬은 Fishing(낚시)이에요. 이 연못에 shrimp(새우)가 좀 있어요. 한번 잡아 봐요.

english: Hello again. First up, we're going to do some fishing. There's some shrimp in this pond here. Let's try and catch some.
translation: 또 만났네요. 먼저 낚시를 좀 해 볼 거예요. 이 연못에 shrimp(새우)가 좀 있어요. 한번 잡아 봐요.

english: Hello again. You should take a look at that menu before we continue.
translation: 또 만났네요. 계속하기 전에 그 메뉴를 한번 살펴보세요.

english: I've managed to catch some shrimp.
Excellent work. Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
translation: 아주 잘했어요. shrimp(새우)가 생겼으니 이제 요리를 해야겠죠. 그러려면 불이 필요해요. 여기서 Woodcutting(벌목)과 Firemaking(불 피우기) 스킬이 나와요.

english: Next up you need to make a fire. First, you'll need to cut down a tree to get some logs.
translation: 다음은 불을 피울 차례예요. 먼저 나무를 베서 logs(통나무)를 얻어야 해요.

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. To do that, you'll need a fire.
translation: shrimp(새우)가 생겼으니 이제 요리를 해야겠죠. 그러려면 불이 필요해요.

english: Now that you have some shrimp, you're going to want to cook them. All you need to do is use them on a fire.
translation: shrimp(새우)가 생겼으니 이제 요리를 해야겠죠. 새우를 불에 쓰기만 하면 돼요.

english: Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?
translation: 또 만났네요. 더 듣고 싶은 이야기가 있어요?

english: Tell me about my skills again.
translation: 제 스킬에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.
translation: 모든 스킬은 스킬 메뉴에 나와 있어요. 여기서 지금 레벨과 경험치가 얼마나 되는지 볼 수 있어요.

english: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small yellow popup box will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
translation: 스킬 위에 마우스를 올리면 작은 노란 팝업 상자에 지금 경험치와 다음 레벨까지 필요한 경험치가 정확히 나와요.

english: You can also click on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
translation: 스킬을 클릭하면 해당 스킬 가이드도 열 수 있어요. 스킬 가이드에서는 그 스킬로 해금되는 걸 모두 볼 수 있어요.

english: Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
Tell me about Woodcutting again.
Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and click on a nearby tree to chop away.
translation: Woodcutting(벌목)이요? 걱정 마요, 신입. 정말 쉬워요. axe(도끼)를 장착하고 근처 나무를 클릭하면 베기 시작해요.

english: As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.
translation: 본토를 탐험하다 보면 베는 데 서로 다른 Woodcutting(벌목) 레벨이 필요한 여러 종류의 나무를 보게 될 거예요.

english: Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.
translation: logs(통나무)는 불 피울 때만 쓰는 게 아니에요. 많은 궁수들이 Fletching(활 제작)이라는 스킬로 나무에서 직접 활과 화살을 만들어요.

english: Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: Firemaking(불 피우기)에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.
translation: 물론이죠, 신입. logs(통나무)가 있으면 거기에 tinderbox(부싯깃 통)을 쓰기만 하면 돼요. 성공하면 불이 붙어요.

english: You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...
translation: 바닥에 떨어져 있는 통나무에도 불을 붙일 수 있고, 불이 붙는 것들이 또 있어요...

english: A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
translation: tinderbox(부싯깃 통)은 늘 챙겨 두면 쓸모 있는 아이템이에요!

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!
translation: 아, 맞아요. Fishing(낚시)! 낚시는 여기 Gielinor(길리노르)에서 손꼽히게 인기 있는 취미예요!

english: Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!
translation: 물이 반짝이는 곳을 보면, 거기선 분명 낚시가 잘될 거예요!

english: Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.
translation: 물고기는 요리하면 정말 맛있을 뿐 아니라, 잃은 체력도 회복시켜 줘요.

english: I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!
translation: 누구나 살면서 한 번쯤은 Fishing(낚시)를 해 봤으면 좋겠어요!

english: Tell me about Cooking again.
Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.
translation: 네, 가장 기본적인 생존 기술이죠. 간단한 음식은 대부분 불에 써서 요리할 수 있어요. 좀 더 근사하게 하고 싶다면 range(레인지)에서 요리해도 돼요.

english: Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.
translation: 요리한 음식을 먹으면 잃은 체력이 회복돼요. 요리하기 어려운 음식일수록 더 많이 회복돼요.

english: Nothing thanks.
Tell me about my skills again.
translation: 제 스킬에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about Woodcutting again.
Tell me about Firemaking again.
translation: Firemaking(불 피우기)에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about Fishing again.
Tell me about Cooking again.
Nothing thanks.
You're putting me in prison?!
Hello there. What are you doing here?
That's not really any of your business, is it?
Fair enough.
This person seems far too alert for you to be able to plant anything on them.
translation: 이 사람은 너무 경계하고 있어서 몰래 뭔가를 심어 둘 수가 없을 것 같다.

english: Hello!
Is everything okay?
*mumble mumble*
I didn't catch that.
Right... Well, have a nice day.
*mumble*
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 나한테 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 거 하나도 없으니까 저리 가, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 너 앞발이 참 멋질 것 같은데.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 더없이 비참한 날이야... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 여기서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 엄~청 배고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 딱 보니 너도 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
Yessss, adventurer?
You smell funky.
As do you, adventurer.
How come you live with the lizardmen?
They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.
translation: 그들은 내 구ㅅ세주요. 그들에게 목ㅅ숨을 빚졌ㅅ소.

english: What did they save you from? Is it to do with your eye?
translation: 그들이 뭘로부터 구해 줬는데요? 그 눈과 관련 있는 거예요?

english: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now. 30? 40? I've lost count.
translation: 아, 그렇ㅅ소... 벌ㅅ써 오래전 일이오. 30년? 40년? 이젠 ㅅ세지도 못하겠ㅅ소.

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: 나는 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)의 대장, Captain Reynard Koil(레이너드 코일 대장)이었ㅅ소. 샤이지엔 ㅅ성벽에 주둔해 있었ㅅ지.

english: We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
translation: lizardmen(리자드맨)을 공격하라는 명령을 받았ㅅ소. 듣기로는 그들이 우리를 공격하고 있다고 했ㅅ지. 내가 돌격을 이끌었ㅅ소.

english: Apparently? Were they attacking?
Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
translation: 안타깝게도ㅅ... 눈에 화ㅅ살을 맞아 전투를 놓쳤ㅅ소. 깨어나 보니 여기였고, 목ㅅ숨이 위태롭다고 ㅅ생각했ㅅ지.

english: The lizardmen took you prisoner?
At first, that isss what I thought, but they tended my woundsss and fed me well.
translation: 처음엔 나도 그렇게 ㅅ생각했ㅅ소. 하지만 그들은 내 상처를 돌봐 주고 잘 먹여 주었ㅅ지.

english: I assssumed my people would come for me once they sssaw my body wasn't amongssst the dead, but they never did.
translation: 내 ㅅ시신이 죽은 자들 ㅅ사이에 없는 걸 보면 동료들이 날 찾으러 올 줄 알았ㅅ소. 하지만 끝내 오지 않았ㅅ지.

english: Would the lizardmen let you leave?
Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Army.
translation: 오, 그렇ㅅ소. 기력이 돌아오자 Shayzien Army(샤이지엔 군대)를 찾아가 이야기했ㅅ소.

english: ...And?
They thought I wasss a lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
translation: 날 리자드맨인 줄 알고 화ㅅ살을 쏘더군. 그ㅅ래서 여기로 돌아왔ㅅ소.

english: What is that you're wearing?
I found these in thisss shrine. I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.
translation: 이 성소에서 찾았ㅅ소. 오래전에 죽은 어느 ㅅ사제의 것이었겠지.

english: What would a priest be doing in this gross swamp?
translation: 사제가 이런 지저분한 늪에서 뭘 하겠어요?

english: This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
translation: 이 지저분한 늪이 내 집이오. 질문이 참 많ㅅ구려, 모험가.

english: What is the symbol on the shrine?
You do not recognissse it, adventurer? It would ssseem hissstory is written by the winnersss, for that isss the sssymbol of the Great Lord Xeric.
translation: 알아보지 못하ㅅ시오, 모험가? 역ㅅ사는 승자가 쓴다더니 정말인가 보군. 저건 Great Lord Xeric(위대한 군주 제릭)의 ㅅ상징이오.

english: Or at leassst, that isss what the lizardmen tell me...
translation: 아니면 적어도ㅅ... lizardmen(리자드맨)이 내게 그렇게 말해 주었ㅅ소...

english: Goodbye, swampy man.
Goodbye, adventurer.
Are you the 'Rey' this entry mentions?
You show him 'The Fisher's Flute'.
translation: 그에게 'The Fisher's Flute(어부의 피리)'를 보여 준다.

english: Oh, that wasss a lifetime ago... Sssuch a wonderful little one.
translation: 오, 그건 한평ㅅ생 전 일이오... 참 사랑ㅅ스러운 아이였지.

english: So you've not seen her recently?
translation: 그럼 최근엔 그 아이를 못 보셨어요?

english: Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked. Her father died and...
translation: 마지막으로 들은 바로는 정ㅅ신이 무너졌다더군. 아버지가 죽고 나서...

english: And?
Gone.
Oh, how mysterious.
You smell funky.
How come you live with the lizardmen?
What is that you're wearing?
What is the symbol on the shrine?
Goodbye, swampy man.
Ribbit
Croak
You manage to catch the toad and inflate it with swamp gas.
Come here toady!
You add the bloated toad to your inventory.
One of your bloated toads manages to escape.
translation: bloated toad(부푼 두꺼비) 하나가 도망쳐 버렸다.

english: Ribbitt!
Hissss....
The air seems too thin to stay in the toad.
translation: 공기가 너무 희박해서 두꺼비 안에 머물지 않는 것 같다.

english: Perhaps you need something thicker than air.
translation: 공기보다 더 짙은 게 필요할지도 모른다.

english: You release the toad[s] and see [it/them] hop off into the distance.
Free the fatsy toady!
Ribbet!
Croak!
Hello!
Hello outerlander. This is my home, I would be grateful if you would leave.
translation: 안녕하시오, 외지인. 여기는 내 집이오. 나가 준다면 고맙겠소.

english: Oh. Okay.
I am sorry outerlander, I will not offer you hospitality until my Chieftain has vouched for your honesty. This is our way.
translation: 미안하오, 외지인. 우리 Chieftain(족장)이 당신의 정직함을 보증하기 전까지는 대접할 수 없소. 이것이 우리의 방식이오.

english: I am trying to become a member of the Fremennik clan! The Chieftain told me that I may be able to gain your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 저는 Fremennik(프레메닉) 부족의 일원이 되려고 해요! 족장님이 원로회에서 당신의 표를 얻을 수 있을지도 모른다고 하셨어요.

english: You wish to stop being an outerlander? I can understand that! I have no reason why I would prevent you becoming a Fremennik...
translation: 외지인 신세를 벗어나고 싶다는 거요? 그 마음 이해하오! 당신이 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되는 걸 내가 막을 이유는 없소...

english: ...but you must first pass a little test for me to prove you are worthy.
translation: ...하지만 먼저 당신이 자격이 있음을 증명하는 작은 시험을 통과해야 하오.

english: What kind of test?
Well, I serve our clan as a navigator. The seas can be a fearful place when you know not where you are heading.
translation: 음, 나는 우리 부족의 항해사요. 어디로 가는지 모르는 채 나서면 바다는 무서운 곳이 될 수 있소.

english: Should something happen to me, all members of our tribe have some basic sense of direction so that they may always return safely home.
translation: 혹시 내게 무슨 일이 생기더라도 언제나 무사히 집으로 돌아올 수 있도록, 우리 부족원은 모두 기본적인 방향 감각을 갖추고 있소.

english: If you are able to demonstrate to me that you too have a good sense of direction then I will recommend you to the rest of the council of elders immediately.
translation: 당신에게도 좋은 방향 감각이 있음을 보여 준다면 즉시 원로회의 다른 이들에게 당신을 추천하겠소.

english: Well, how would I go about showing that?
translation: 음, 그걸 어떻게 보여 드리면 되죠?

english: Ah, a simple task! Below this building I have constructed a maze; should you be able to walk from one side to the other that will be proof to me.
translation: 아, 간단한 과제요! 이 건물 아래에 내가 미로를 만들어 두었소. 한쪽 끝에서 반대쪽 끝까지 걸어갈 수 있다면 그것으로 증명이 될 것이오.

english: You wish to try my challenge?
A maze? Is that all? Sure, it sounds simple enough.
translation: 미로요? 그게 다예요? 좋아요, 쉬울 것 같네요.

english: I will warn you outerlander, this maze was designed by myself, and is of the most fiendish complexity!
translation: 경고하겠소, 외지인. 이 미로는 내가 직접 설계했고, 그 복잡함이 실로 악랄하오!

english: Oh really? Watch and learn...
No thanks. I think I can get someone else to vouch for me to the council of elders, without going through a stupid maze like some lab rat.
translation: 됐어요. 무슨 실험용 쥐처럼 바보 같은 미로를 헤매지 않아도 원로회에 저를 보증해 줄 사람은 따로 찾을 수 있을 거예요.

english: Well, I am sorry you feel that way outerlander. I cannot vouch for you until you prove to me you have some skill that will benefit our clan somehow.
translation: 그렇게 생각한다니 유감이오, 외지인. 우리 부족에 어떤 식으로든 도움이 될 재주가 있다는 걸 증명하기 전에는 당신을 보증할 수 없소.

english: What exactly is a 'lab rat' anyway?
Ah, forget it.
Have you no manners outerlander? This is my home, you will show me the due respect!
translation: 예의도 없소, 외지인? 여기는 내 집이오. 마땅한 예의를 갖추시오!

english: Erm.... sorry I guess.
Man, your maze is pretty tough!
Hahahaha it is the most complex route I have ever devised! I am truly a genius at navigation! The world will remember my name!
translation: 하하하하, 내가 고안한 경로 중 가장 복잡한 것이오! 나는 진정 항해의 천재요! 세상이 내 이름을 기억할 것이오!

english: Can't I do something else for your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 원로회에서 표를 얻으려면 다른 일을 하면 안 될까요?

english: No, you cannot. It is my maze, or nothing.
translation: 안 되오. 내 미로가 아니면 아무것도 없소.

english: Decided you could not solve my labyrinth after all, did you outerlander? Too tricky for you?
translation: 결국 내 미궁을 풀 수 없겠다고 판단한 거요, 외지인? 너무 까다로웠소?

english: Yeah, it is really confusing down there...
Hahaha! Don't worry outerlander, you are not the first to fail its puzzle!
translation: 하하하! 걱정 마시오, 외지인. 그 수수께끼를 풀지 못한 게 당신이 처음은 아니니!

english: Outerlander! You have finished my maze! I am genuinely impressed!
translation: 외지인! 내 미로를 통과했구려! 진심으로 감탄했소!

english: So does that mean I can rely on your vote at the council of elders to allow me into your village?
translation: 그럼 제가 마을에 들어갈 수 있게 원로회에서 표를 주실 거라고 믿어도 되나요?

english: Of course outerlander! I am nothing if not a man of my word!
translation: 물론이오, 외지인! 나는 무엇보다 약속을 지키는 사람이오!

english: Thanks!
Greetings again outerlander! I must say, I am still impressed with the way you moved through my maze!
translation: 다시 만나 반갑소, 외지인! 말하건대, 당신이 내 미로를 빠져나간 솜씨에는 아직도 감탄하고 있소!

english: Thanks. So I can rely on your vote in my favour at the council of elders?
translation: 고마워요. 그럼 원로회에서 저한테 표를 주실 거라고 믿어도 되죠?

english: Absolutely! You will be an asset to the clan!
translation: 물론이오! 당신은 우리 부족의 보배가 될 것이오!

english: No way am I doing that maze again!
translation: 그 미로는 절대 다시 안 할 거예요!

english: Greetings outerlander.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: 혹시 심해 낚시터가 표시된 지도를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Hmmm? Why of course! As the navigator for the Fremennik I keep all of our maps secure right here.
translation: 흐음? 물론이오! Fremennik(프레메닉)의 항해사로서 우리의 모든 지도를 바로 여기에 안전하게 보관하고 있소.

english: Great! Can I have it?
Have it? Just like that? I think not outerlander. This map shows all of the prime fishing locations nearby.
translation: 가져도 되냐고? 그렇게 쉽게? 그건 안 되오, 외지인. 이 지도에는 근처의 좋은 낚시터가 모두 표시되어 있소.

english: It is very valuable to our clan. I am afraid I can not just give it away.
translation: 우리 부족에게 아주 귀중한 것이오. 미안하지만 그냥 줄 수는 없소.

english: Perhaps I can trade you something for it?
A trade? For a map of the best fishing spots in a hundred leagues? I will trade it for no less than a weather forecast from our Seer.
translation: 교환? 백 리그 안의 최고 낚시터가 담긴 지도를? 우리 Seer(예언자)의 weather forecast(일기 예보) 정도는 되어야 바꿔 주겠소.

english: As a navigator, the weather is extremely important for plotting the best course. Unfortunately the Seer is always too busy to help me with a forecast.
translation: 항해사에게 날씨는 최적의 항로를 짜는 데 무척 중요하오. 안타깝게도 예언자는 늘 너무 바빠서 내게 일기 예보를 해 주지 않소.

english: Where could I get a weather forecast from then?
translation: 그럼 일기 예보는 어디서 구할 수 있어요?

english: I just told you: from the Seer. You will need to persuade him to take the time to make a forecast somehow.
translation: 방금 말하지 않았소. 예언자에게서 말이오. 어떻게든 그가 시간을 내서 예보를 하도록 설득해야 할 것이오.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: 혹시 Fremennik Seer(프레메닉 예언자)의 일기 예보를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Uh... from the Seer perhaps?
I would like your map of fishing spots.
I have already told you outerlander; I will not exchange it for anything other than a divination on the weather from our seer himself!
translation: 이미 말했잖소, 외지인. 우리 예언자가 직접 날씨를 점친 것이 아니면 무엇과도 바꾸지 않겠소!

english: What, like this one I have here?
translation: 그러니까, 제가 지금 들고 있는 이것 같은 거요?

english: W-what...? I don't believe it! How did you...? I suppose it doesn't matter, you have my gratitude outerlander!
translation: 이, 이럴 수가...? 믿을 수 없군! 대체 어떻게...? 뭐, 상관없겠지. 정말 고맙소, 외지인!

english: With this forecast I will be able to plan a safe course for our next raiding expedition!
translation: 이 예보만 있으면 다음 약탈 원정에 안전한 항로를 짤 수 있겠소!

english: Here, outerlander; you may take my map of local fishing patterns with my gratitude!
translation: 자, 외지인. 고마움의 표시로 이 근방의 낚시터가 담긴 내 지도를 가져가시오!

english: If this map of fishing spots is so valuable, why did you give it away to me so easily?
translation: 이 낚시터 지도가 그렇게 귀중하다면서 왜 이렇게 쉽게 저한테 주신 거예요?

english: Hmmm? Well, firstly it will be of value to our entire clan, so I have lost nothing from giving it to you.
translation: 흐음? 음, 첫째로 그 지도는 우리 부족 전체에 도움이 될 테니, 당신에게 준다고 해서 내가 잃는 건 없소.

english: The other reason is of course that I have already memorised it, so I can make myself another copy whenever I want!
translation: 다른 이유는 물론, 이미 다 외워 두었으니 원할 때 언제든 하나 더 그릴 수 있다는 것이오!

english: Greetings to you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! How fare you today?
I am fine thanks Swensen. How are you doing?
translation: 잘 지내요, Swensen(스벤센). 당신은 어떻게 지내세요?

english: I am fine too!
Yes
No
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Hello Sylas.
Ah, [player name]! Good to see you again.
translation: 아, [player name] 님! 다시 만나서 반가워요.

english: How is the collection going now?
Thanks to you finding the golden goblin for me, I am the envy of the collector's group. I can't thank you enough.
translation: 당신이 golden goblin(황금 고블린)을 찾아 준 덕분에 수집가 모임에서 모두가 절 부러워해요. 정말 뭐라고 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요.

english: I think I've lost Rupert's helmet.
translation: Rupert's helmet(루퍼트의 투구)를 잃어버린 것 같아요.

english: Not to worry, [player name] Go and speak to Rupert. These items have a strange way of returning to their owners sometimes!
translation: 걱정 마세요, [player name] 님. Rupert(루퍼트)에게 가서 이야기해 보세요. 이런 물건들은 가끔 묘하게도 주인에게 돌아오곤 하거든요!

english: Ok, I will. Thanks.
No, no. Thanks for everything you've done!
translation: 아니에요, 아니에요. 그동안 해 주신 모든 일에 제가 감사하죠!

english: I'm just happy that I could help. Goodbye!
translation: 도울 수 있어서 기뻤어요. 안녕히 계세요!

english: Goodbye.
Selling Magic Beans!
You there, you look like you could use some beans!
translation: 거기 당신, 콩이 좀 필요해 보이네요!

english: All beans must go!
Buy 1 bean get a bean free!
translation: 콩 하나 사면 콩 하나 공짜!

english: Selling bags of Magic Beans!
translation: Magic Beans(마법 콩) 한 자루씩 팔아요!

english: Excuse me, human! Perhaps you shouldn't just go wandering through there without knowing what you're dealing with!
translation: 이봐, 인간! 뭘 상대하는지도 모르면서 무작정 저기로 돌아다니면 곤란할 텐데!

english: Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?
Indeed I am, human! What's on your mind?
translation: 그래, 내가 맞아, 인간! 무슨 일이지?

english: What's going on here?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: Well, the Hueycoatl has awoken.
The Huey- what?
Huey-co-at... oh, I don't have time for this! The thing you need to know is that it's dangerous and it's coiled throughout this entire mountain!
translation: 후에이-코-아... 아, 이럴 시간 없어! 네가 알아야 할 건, 그게 위험하고 이 산 전체에 똬리를 틀고 있다는 거야!

english: Do you know where it came from?
We're not sure. There are some records of our ancestors having dealings with it, but the details have been lost, assuming they were ever recorded.
translation: 확실히는 몰라. 우리 조상들이 그것과 얽혔다는 기록이 좀 있긴 한데, 자세한 내용은 사라졌어. 애초에 기록이나 됐었다면 말이지.

english: So it's old?
Does it really matter how old it is?
I suppose not. I guess I just want to get a better understanding of what this thing is.
translation: 아니겠죠. 그냥 이게 대체 뭔지 좀 더 잘 알고 싶었을 뿐이에요.

english: We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.
translation: 몇 살인지는 우리도 몰라. 엄청나게 오래됐을 수도 있고, 대대로 이어진 혈통 중 하나일 수도 있지. 그래도 다른 개체 얘기는 들어 본 적이 없으니, 어쩌면 무슨 고대 생물일지도 몰라.

english: And given that you're here, I assume it poses some sort of threat?
translation: 그리고 당신이 여기 있다는 건, 그게 어떤 위협이 된다는 뜻이겠죠?

english: Now you're getting it! While it doesn't seem to be innately aggressive, our concern is the potential risk of it tunnelling into Cam Torum.
translation: 이제야 알아듣는군! 본래 공격적인 성향은 아닌 것 같지만, 우리가 걱정하는 건 그게 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)으로 굴을 파고 들어올 위험이야.

english: Oh, and given that it does lash out from time to time, I suppose it does pose a threat to your nearby human villages. A lesser priority for us, but maybe something for you to care about.
translation: 아, 그리고 가끔 난동을 부리니까, 근처 너희 인간 마을들에도 위협이 되긴 하겠네. 우리한텐 덜 중요한 문제지만, 너한텐 신경 쓸 일일지도.

english: Anyway, for now, our only option is to keep it in check while we figure out what to do in the long term.
translation: 어쨌든 지금으로선 장기적인 대책을 찾을 때까지 그걸 억눌러 두는 수밖에 없어.

english: Unfortunately, that means recruiting all the help we can get, even from you humans...
translation: 안타깝게도 그 말은 얻을 수 있는 도움은 다 끌어모아야 한다는 거지. 너희 인간들한테서까지...

english: How can I help?
Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.
translation: 음, 우리 중 몇몇이 너희 종족을 어떻게 생각하든, 우린 얻을 수 있는 도움이 전부 필요해.

english: Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!
translation: 음, 넌 이미 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)에 쓸모 있다는 걸 증명했으니, 여기서도 도와준다면 기꺼이 받아 주지!

english: However, I'm not sure you have enough combat experience to face the Hueycoatl.
translation: 그런데 네가 Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)을 상대할 만큼 전투 경험이 있는지는 잘 모르겠어.

english: To face the Hueycoatl, it's recommended you have a combat level of 85 and a Prayer level of 43.
translation: Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)을 상대하려면 전투 레벨 85, Prayer(기도) 레벨 43을 갖추는 게 좋아.

english: We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
translation: 우린 Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)을 통제해야 해. 더 확실한 해결책을 찾을 때까지는, 전투로 지치게 만드는 수밖에 없어.

english: Don't go killing it, mind you! Not that I think you could, but such a magnificent creature doesn't deserve destruction.
translation: 단, 죽이지는 마! 네가 그럴 수 있을 것 같진 않지만, 그렇게 웅장한 생물이 파괴당해선 안 되니까.

english: Do you have any tips for surviving?
We've found our prayers can protect us from its shards, so keep an eye out for those.
translation: 우리 기도로 그것의 파편을 막을 수 있다는 걸 알아냈으니, 파편을 잘 살피라고.

english: To reach the Hueycoatl's head, you'll need to get it to move its great body out of the way. We've found we can persuade it by giving the exposed parts a helpful nudge!
translation: Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)의 머리에 닿으려면 그 거대한 몸뚱이를 비키게 만들어야 해. 드러난 부분을 좀 '도움이 되게' 쿡쿡 찔러 주면 설득이 되더라고!

english: Once you reach its head, you'll need to work with your comrades and the seer to balance your prayers and weaken the beast.
translation: 머리에 닿으면 동료들과 seer(예언자)와 함께 기도의 균형을 맞추면서 그 야수를 약화시켜야 해.

english: But I'm sure you'll figure it out!
Move the body, then attack the head while keeping prayers balanced. Got it!
translation: 몸을 움직이고, 기도 균형을 유지하면서 머리를 공격한다. 알겠어요!

english: What's on your mind, human?
Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: Are there any rewards for helping?
Ugh, you greedy humans.
The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
translation: Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)이 움직일 때 온갖 물건과 보물을 포함해 많은 것들이 밀려 나와.

english: We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
translation: 우린 그걸 최대한 모으고 있으니, 도와준 대가로 네 몫을 좀 줄 수는 있겠지.

english: That sounds good, thank you.
Goodbye.
Bye.
Remind me, what's going on here?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거예요?

english: How can I help?
Are there any rewards for helping?
Goodbye.
Hi, my name is [player name]. What's wi...
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 이름은 [player name]이에요. 무슨 일...

english: I not be in the mood t' talk, sorry. If ye need anythin', talk to Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 난 지금 얘기할 기분이 아니야, 미안하다. 뭐 필요하면 부두 쪽에 있는 Cap'ain Pudi(푸디 선장)한테 말해 봐.

english: I cannot believe that beast ruined me ship.
translation: 그 괴물 놈이 내 배를 박살 냈다니, 믿을 수가 없어.

english: What happened to your ship?
Was awful, me crew an' I were out on our fortnightly fishin' excursion. We set sail from Al Kharid t' the deep-sea fishin' spot we usually use.
translation: 끔찍했지. 나랑 선원들은 보름마다 하는 고기잡이를 나갔어. Al Kharid(알 카리드)에서 출항해서 늘 가던 심해 낚시터로 향했지.

english: Was nothin' but smooth sailin' all the way, we got t' the spot an' started fishin'.
translation: 가는 내내 순풍에 돛 단 듯 순조로웠어. 낚시터에 도착해서 고기를 잡기 시작했지.

english: Sounds like a normal day of fishing to me.
translation: 제가 듣기엔 평범한 낚시하는 날 같은데요.

english: Aye, I s'pose it was. After a few days, the crew an' I sailed further t' the Karamjan coast t' catch some sharks. More plunder from sellin' sharks.
translation: 그래, 그랬던 것 같군. 며칠 뒤에 나랑 선원들은 상어를 잡으러 Karamjan(카람자) 해안 쪽으로 더 나아갔어. 상어를 팔면 한몫 더 챙길 수 있거든.

english: While sailin', I noticed there was more debris than usual. Koanee said there must have been a storm recently.
translation: 항해하는데 잔해가 평소보다 많이 보이더라고. Koanee(코아니)가 최근에 폭풍이 지나간 게 틀림없다고 했지.

english: How did she know that?
Koanee is in charge of plottin' a course t' our destination an' watchin' the weather. I thought she was good at her job.
translation: Koanee(코아니)는 목적지까지 항로를 짜고 날씨를 살피는 담당이야. 난 그 녀석이 일을 잘하는 줄 알았지.

english: We got to our final fishin' spot an' Lauretta let down the net. Almost a whole day went by an' we still 'ad not caught any fish.
translation: 마지막 낚시터에 도착해서 Lauretta(로레타)가 그물을 내렸어. 거의 하루가 다 가도록 물고기 한 마리 안 잡히더라고.

english: In fact, I could not see any fish in the waters at all. Such a strange sight.
translation: 사실 물속에 물고기라곤 한 마리도 안 보였어. 참 희한한 광경이었지.

english: Not even bass?
Nothin'. We decided t' pack it in for the day an' I told Koanee t' leave the nets down, hoping we would catch some fish overnight.
translation: 아무것도. 그날은 그만 접기로 하고, 밤새 물고기가 좀 걸리길 바라면서 Koanee(코아니)한테 그물은 내려 두라고 했지.

english: That sounds like a bad idea. What would have happened if your net got too full or your ship started drifting and the net got caught on some rocks?
translation: 그건 나쁜 생각 같은데요. 그물이 너무 꽉 차거나, 배가 떠내려가서 그물이 바위에 걸리기라도 했으면 어쩌려고요?

english: 'Twas a risk we 'ad to take t' catch some fish.
The next day Koanee woke me up t' tell me a storm was on the horizon, so we lifted the anchor up an' adjusted our course.
translation: 다음 날 Koanee(코아니)가 날 깨우더니 수평선에 폭풍이 보인다고 하더군. 그래서 닻을 올리고 항로를 바꿨지.

english: Not sure what she was playing at with that decision, but out o' nowhere winds started t' change an' the storm was headin' in our direction, we couldn't outrun it.
translation: 그 녀석이 무슨 생각으로 그렇게 정했는지는 몰라도, 난데없이 바람이 바뀌더니 폭풍이 우리 쪽으로 몰려왔어. 도저히 따돌릴 수가 없었지.

english: 'Twas also too dangerous to anchor down, so we 'ad to weather it.
translation: 닻을 내리기도 너무 위험해서, 그냥 버텨 내는 수밖에 없었어.

english: Thick fog rolled in, giant waves crashin' against the ship's hull. So much lightnin', it felt like Saradomin was angry with us.
translation: 짙은 안개가 밀려오고, 거대한 파도가 선체를 들이받았지. 번개가 어찌나 쳐 대던지, Saradomin(사라도민)께서 우리한테 화나신 줄 알았다니까.

english: The lightnin' struck our sails, settin' them ablaze despite the 'eavy rain!
translation: 번개가 돛을 때려서, 비가 그렇게 퍼붓는데도 불이 붙어 버렸어!

english: The last thing I see is glowin' fish an' a monster in the distance with a twisted face. Next thing I know, I'm lying on the shore just south of Al Kharid with Pudi waving a kebab in me face!
translation: 마지막으로 본 건 빛나는 물고기들이랑, 저 멀리 일그러진 얼굴을 한 괴물이었어. 정신 차려 보니 Al Kharid(알 카리드) 바로 남쪽 해안에 누워 있었고, Pudi(푸디)가 내 얼굴 앞에서 케밥을 흔들고 있더라고!

english: That must have been awful. At least you and the crew survived.
translation: 정말 끔찍했겠네요. 그래도 선원분들이랑 다 살아남으셨잖아요.

english: Aye, we survived, but the same cannot be said for me poor ship! Koanee should 'o known better!
translation: 그래, 우린 살아남았지. 하지만 불쌍한 내 배는 그렇지 못했어! Koanee(코아니) 녀석은 그 정도는 알았어야지!

english: Once Pudi and the others helped us back on our feet, the Chancellor sent us 'ere t' setup shop and recruit others.
translation: Pudi(푸디)랑 다른 사람들이 우릴 다시 일으켜 세워 준 뒤에, Chancellor(재상)께서 우리를 여기로 보내 가게를 차리고 사람들을 모으라고 하셨지.

english: Not really my area of expertise, mind, but Pudi sorts most of it out!
translation: 내 전문 분야는 아니지만 말이야, 대부분은 Pudi(푸디)가 알아서 처리해!

english: Anythin' else I can help ye with?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
Always carry an 'ammer. That beast has a habit of destroyin' ships. You can fix it up by using said 'ammer.
translation: 망치는 항상 챙겨 다녀. 그 괴물 놈은 배를 부수는 버릇이 있거든. 그 망치로 배를 고칠 수 있어.

english: The Spirit Anglers' ships you fight the beast from are kitted out with everythin' ye need.
translation: 그 괴물이랑 싸울 때 타는 Spirit Anglers(영혼 낚시꾼)의 배에는 필요한 게 다 갖춰져 있어.

english: Can I help ye with anythin' else?
I found your ship's log.
Ye be stealin' me booty are ye?
No, I jus...
I be yankin' ye chain, 'tis all good. I put that 'ere book on that shelf so I may spread me tale.
translation: 농담이야, 농담. 다 괜찮아. 내 이야기를 널리 퍼뜨리려고 그 책을 내가 저 선반에 꽂아 둔 거야.

english: It was a good tale. Is it true?
Of course 'tis true! Ye can ask me all about it.
translation: 당연히 사실이지! 궁금한 건 뭐든 물어봐.

english: I have to go.
Be seein' ye.
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 이 힘든 시기에 달걀 하나 드실래요?

english: Um... no, I don't want your damp egg, thanks...
translation: 음... 아니, 네 축축한 알은 필요 없어, 고맙지만...

english: I'll take my eggs elsewhere then.
translation: 그럼 제 달걀은 다른 데 가져갈게요.

english: A damp egg? No thanks.
I'd rather not. Thanks, though.
Oh, thanks.
This is some comfort to be sure.
What happened to your ship?
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
I found your ship's log.
I have to go.
Get out of my way! Argh! I'm hunting!
Die! Die!!
Move, lest I slay not the beast but you!
translation: 비켜라. 안 그러면 짐승 대신 너를 죽인다!

english: Hello, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku.
Stranger, why you have returned?
I'm just passing through.
Using your new found poison I have been creating spears. Would you like to buy some?
translation: 네가 새로 찾은 독으로 창을 만들고 있었다. 좀 사겠나?

english: Yes.
No.
As you wish, stranger.
Yes.
No.
Busy Busy Busy.
Why are you so busy?
Aluft Aloft is a bustling new business, here in the Gnome restaurant. We're getting food orders all the time.
translation: Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)는 여기 노움 식당에서 새로 시작해 한창 잘나가는 가게예요. 음식 주문이 끊임없이 들어오고 있죠.

english: Do you have any jobs then?
If you want to get a job, talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. I'm sure he has plenty.
translation: 일자리를 원하면 Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게 말해 보세요. 그분한테 일거리가 잔뜩 있을 거예요.

english: Have a nice day.
How are you doing today?
I am Tangleroot!
Hello there pretty plant.
I am Tangleroot!
I am [player name]!
Everything is crystal clear now.
translation: 이제 모든 게 크리스탈처럼 투명하게 보이네.

english: I can't believe they made dragonfruit trees into a real thing!
translation: 용과 나무를 진짜로 만들어 내다니, 믿기지가 않아!

english: I am Tangleroot?
Nothing.
Are you related to Herbiboar now?
translation: 너 이제 Herbiboar(허비보어)랑 친척이라도 된 거야?

english: I am Tangleroot.
I should have guessed.
Nevermind.
Oh dear, you've gone all red!
It must be something you ate.
I love your new hair cut!
Tangleeeee!
Ssss!
Rrowl!
Hiss!
Grrrr
Greetings friend. I am a manufacturer of leather.
translation: 어서 오세요, 친구. 저는 가죽을 만드는 사람이에요.

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 그럼 가죽을 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: I make leather from animal hides. Bring me some cowhides and one gold coin per hide, and I'll tan them into soft leather for you.
translation: 저는 동물 가죽으로 가죽을 만들어요. cowhides(소가죽)과 가죽 한 장당 골드 코인 하나를 가져오시면 부드러운 가죽으로 무두질해 드릴게요.

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Normal leather may be quite weak, but it's very cheap - I make it from cowhides for only 1 gp per hide - and it's so easy to craft that anyone can work with it.
translation: 보통 가죽은 꽤 약할 수도 있지만, 아주 싸요. 소가죽 한 장당 1gp만 받고 만들어 드리고, 다루기도 쉬워서 누구나 가공할 수 있죠.

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3 gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much sturdier armour.
translation: 아니면 hard leather(경화 가죽)을 써 보셔도 좋아요. 가공하기는 그리 쉽지 않지만, 소가죽 한 장당 3gp만 받고 손질해 드리고, 훨씬 튼튼한 갑옷이 나와요.

english: I can also tan snake hides and dragonhides, suitable for crafting into the highest quality armour for rangers.
translation: 뱀 가죽이랑 용가죽도 무두질할 수 있어요. 궁수용 최고급 갑옷을 만들기에 딱 좋죠.

english: Thanks, I'll bear it in mind.
I see you have brought me a hide. Would you like me to tan it for you?
I see you have brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 가죽을 몇 장 가져오셨군요. 무두질해 드릴까요?

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Very well, [sir/madam], as you wish.
Er... Thanks, but no thanks!
Er... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: 어... 그건 저한테 쓸모가 없어요. 제가 만드는 물건인걸요!

english: Can I buy some leather then?
translation: 그럼 가죽을 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: Leather is rather weak stuff.
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
Not infected are you?
I don't think so.
You don't seem very sure. We don't want any infected near the children. Be off with you!
translation: 별로 확신이 없어 보이네. 애들 근처에 감염자는 얼씬도 못 하게 할 거야. 썩 꺼져!

english: Whatever it is you're selling, we ain't interested!
translation: 뭘 팔러 왔든 우린 관심 없어!

english: But I'm not...
Did you not hear me? Clear off!
Greetings human. These Hydras are not to be harmed unless you have permission. To act otherwise would be a danger to the balance.
translation: 인간이여, 반갑다. 이 Hydras(히드라)는 허가 없이 해쳐서는 안 된다. 그리하는 것은 균형을 위태롭게 하는 일이다.

english: Human! To attack these creatures would be a threat to the balance. Only those with permission may fight them!
translation: 인간이여! 이 생물들을 공격하는 것은 균형을 위협하는 일이다. 허가받은 자만이 이들과 싸울 수 있다!

english: Would you look after my crops for me?
You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 그 밭엔 씨앗이 하나도 안 심어져 있잖아요. 뭐라도 심으면 돌봐 드릴지도 몰라요.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: 그 밭은 이미 다 자랐어요! 저보고 그걸 어쩌라는 건지 모르겠네요!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: 그 밭은 죽었어요. 이제 와서 제가 손쓰기엔 너무 늦었어요.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: 그 밭은 병들었어요. 저한테 맡기기 전에 먼저 치료부터 하셔야죠!

english: I don't know what you're talking about - I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: 무슨 말씀인지 모르겠네요. 그 밭은 제가 이미 돌봐 드리고 있잖아요.

english: Oh sorry, I forgot.
If you like, but I want 4 sacks of cabbages for that.
translation: 원하신다면 그러죠. 대신 sacks of cabbages(양배추 자루) 4개를 주셔야 해요.

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of those at the moment.
Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: 흠, 저도 공짜로 시간 낭비할 생각은 없어요.

english: I'm afraid I don't have enough of those at the moment.
Okay, it's a deal.
That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 그거면 충분해요, [sir/madam]. 저한테 맡기세요. 그 밭은 제가 꼭 잘 키워 드릴게요.

english: No, that's too much.
If you like, but I want 3 baskets of tomatoes for that.
translation: 원하신다면 그러죠. 대신 baskets of tomatoes(토마토 바구니) 3개를 주셔야 해요.

english: If you like, but I want 3 baskets of strawberries for that.
translation: 원하신다면 그러죠. 대신 baskets of strawberries(딸기 바구니) 3개를 주셔야 해요.

english: If you like, but I want 6 watermelons for that.
translation: 원하신다면 그러죠. 대신 수박 6개를 주셔야 해요.

english: If you like, but I want 8 Bittercap mushrooms for that.
translation: 원하신다면 그러죠. 대신 Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯) 8개를 주셔야 해요.

english: Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: 덤불이나 나무의 병을 고치는 유일한 방법은 secateurs(전지가위)로 병든 잎을 잘라 내는 거예요. 다른 작물은 그냥 plant-cure(식물 치료제)를 뿌려 주면 돼요.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: 나무 씨앗은 흙을 담은 plantpot(화분)에서 sapling(묘목)으로 키운 다음, tree patch(나무 밭)으로 옮겨 심어야 다 자랄 때까지 계속 자라요.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: 채소 자루에는 감자, 양배추, 양파를 10개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 다만 한 자루에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없어요.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: 농사 도구는 전부 농사 상점에서 살 수 있어요. 농사 상점은 경작지 가까이에 있어요.

english: Bittercap mushrooms can only be grown in a special patch in Morytania, near the Mort Myre swamp. There the ground is especially dank and suited to growing poisonous fungii.
translation: Bittercap mushrooms(비터캡 버섯)은 Morytania(모리타니아)의 Mort Myre(모트 마이어) 늪 근처에 있는 특별한 밭에서만 키울 수 있어요. 그곳 땅은 유난히 축축해서 독버섯을 키우기에 딱 좋거든요.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비)는 일반 퇴비보다 훨씬 좋지만, 만드는 데 비용이 더 들어요. 알맞은 종류의 아이템을 썩혀야 하거든요. 아이템을 보여 주시면 슈퍼 퇴비로 만들 수 있는지 알려 드릴게요.

english: There is a special patch for growing Belladonna - I believe that it is somewhere near Draynor Manor, where the ground is a tad 'unblessed'.
translation: Belladonna(벨라돈나)를 키우는 특별한 밭이 있어요. 아마 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택) 근처 어딘가일 거예요. 그쪽 땅은 좀 '부정 탄' 곳이거든요.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: 밭에 compost(퇴비)를 주면 작물이 병들 확률이 줄어들 뿐 아니라, 수확할 작물도 더 많이 자라요.

english: If you want to grow fruit trees you could try a few places: Catherby, Brimhaven, Gnome Stronghold and the Farming Guild all have fruit tree patches.
translation: 과일나무를 키우고 싶으시면 몇 군데를 가 보세요. Catherby(캐서비), Brimhaven(브림헤이븐), Gnome Stronghold(노움 요새), Farming Guild(농사 길드)에 모두 과일나무 밭이 있어요.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)만 있으면 빈 밭 어디서든 흙을 퍼서 화분을 채울 수 있어요.

english: Hops are good for brewing ales. I believe there's a brewery up in Keldagrim somewhere, and I've heard rumours that a place called Phasmatys used to be good for that type of thing. 'Fore they all died, of course.
translation: 홉은 에일을 빚기에 좋아요. Keldagrim(켈다그림) 어딘가에 양조장이 있다고 알고 있고, Phasmatys(파스마티스)라는 곳도 예전엔 그런 걸로 유명했다는 소문을 들었어요. 물론 다들 죽기 전 얘기지만요.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: 채소, 홉, 꽃은 계속 물을 줘야 해요. 제 조언을 무시하면 머지않아 죽은 농사 밭을 갖게 될 거예요.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: 과일 바구니에는 토마토, 딸기, 사과, 바나나, 오렌지를 5개까지 넣을 수 있어요. 다만 한 바구니에 여러 종류를 섞어 담을 순 없어요.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: 밭에 갈퀴질을 하고 나온 잡초를 그냥 버리지 마세요. compost bin(퇴비통)에 넣어서 퇴비를 만드세요.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 이곳 같은 Farming(농사) 구역이 다섯 군데 더 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단태라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, 그리고 Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역이에요.
