english: There are fiveother Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 이곳 같은 Farming(농사) 구역이 다섯 군데 더 있어요. Falador(팔라도르) 근처의 Elstan(엘스탄) 구역, Catherby(캐서비) 근처의 Dantaera(단태라) 구역, Morytania(모리타니아)의 Lyra(라이라) 구역, Hosidius(호시디우스)의 Marisi(마리시) 구역, Farming Guild(농사 길드)의 Alan(앨런) 구역, 그리고

english: area in Prifddinas.
If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 자루와 바구니를 직접 만들고 싶으시면 Falador(팔라도르)의 농사 상점 근처에 있는 loom(베틀)을 써야 해요. 물론 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman]이라면 말이죠.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftsman/craftswoman], that is.
translation: 화분을 전부 사야 하는 건 아니에요. 도자기 물레에서 직접 만들 수도 있거든요. 물론 솜씨 좋은 [craftsman/craftswoman]이라면 말이죠.

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있나요?

english: That depends on whether I have it to sell. What is it that you're looking for?
translation: 그건 제가 팔 물건을 갖고 있느냐에 달렸죠. 뭘 찾으시는데요?

english: Some plant cure.
Plant cure, eh? I might have some put aside for myself. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 coins if you like.
translation: plant cure(식물 치료제)요? 제가 쓰려고 따로 챙겨 둔 게 좀 있을 거예요. 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 25코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: I don't have enough money for that, I'm afraid.
Actually, I don't think I'd be able to carry it.
translation: 사실, 그걸 들고 갈 자리가 없을 것 같아요.

english: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 아뇨, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 구할 수 있어요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A bucket of compost, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 35 coins if you like.
translation: bucket of compost(퇴비 양동이)요? 남는 게 하나 있을지도 몰라요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 35코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: A rake.
A rake, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: rake(갈퀴)요? 남는 게 하나 있을지도 몰라요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: A plant pot.
Eh, I suppose I can spare you a plant pot, but I'll want 40 coins for it.
translation: 에, plant pot(화분) 하나쯤은 내드릴 수 있겠지만, 40코인은 받아야겠어요.

english: A watering can.
A watering can, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 25 coins if you like.
translation: watering can(물뿌리개)이요? 남는 게 하나 있을지도 몰라요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 25코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: A gardening trowel.
A gardening trowel, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: gardening trowel(원예용 모종삽)이요? 남는 게 하나 있을지도 몰라요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: A seed dibber.
A seed dibber, eh? I might have one spare... tell you what, I'll sell it to you for 15 coins if you like.
translation: seed dibber(씨앗 구멍 막대)요? 남는 게 하나 있을지도 몰라요... 이렇게 하죠, 원하시면 15코인에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: Forget it, you don't have anything I need.
translation: 됐어요, 제가 필요한 건 하나도 없네요.

english: I'll come back another time.
I have a question for you.
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Would you look after my crops for me?
Okay, it's a deal.
No, that's too much.
Can you give me any farming advice?
translation: 농사에 관해 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Can you sell me something?
translation: 뭐 좀 팔아 주실 수 있나요?

english: Some plant cure.
Yes, that sounds like a fair price.
No thanks, I can get that much cheaper elsewhere.
translation: 아뇨, 다른 데서 훨씬 싸게 구할 수 있어요.

english: A bucket of compost.
A rake.
A plant pot.
(See more items)
A watering can.
A gardening trowel.
A seed dibber.
(See previous items)
Forget it.
I'll come back another time.
Ouch!
Are you alright?
I'm fine, I'm fine. Just a scratch.
If you're sure. Who are you?
Me? I'm Tarik.
That hat you're wearing doesn't look like it comes from around here?
translation: 쓰고 계신 그 모자, 이 동네 물건 같지는 않은데요?

english: It was a present. My employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
translation: 선물이에요. 고용주가 저한테 잘 어울릴 거라고 생각했나 봐요. 정말 어울리는지는 모르겠지만, 햇볕은 아주 잘 가려 줘요.

english: Who is this employer?
Simon Templeton. He's an archaeologist. I worked as an assistant for him, though I haven't seen him since the plague business started, so I work for myself now.
translation: Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴)이에요. 고고학자죠. 그분 밑에서 조수로 일했는데, 역병 소동이 시작된 뒤로는 그분을 못 봐서 지금은 혼자 일하고 있어요.

english: I see. So what have you been up to?
translation: 그렇군요. 그래서 요즘 뭐 하고 지내셨어요?

english: Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in this pyramid.
translation: Simon(사이먼)이 이 피라미드에 재물이 있을지도 모른다고 하더라고요.

english: All I've found so far are injuries though.
Interesting... What can you tell me about this pyramid?
translation: 흥미롭네요... 이 피라미드에 대해 뭘 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, I'm not sure. It's called Jalsavrah apparently. It's a strange place.
translation: 음, 잘은 몰라요. Jalsavrah(잘사브라)라고 부른다나 봐요. 이상한 곳이에요.

english: How so?
First of all, there's something odd about the doors. There's four of them, but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
translation: 우선, 문이 좀 이상해요. 문이 네 개 있는데, 그중 세 개는 텅 빈 무덤으로 이어져요.

english: The other one is guarded by something, and whatever it is, it doesn't like visitors.
translation: 나머지 하나는 뭔가가 지키고 있는데, 그게 뭐든 손님을 반기지 않아요.

english: The thing is, the doors seem to change around sometimes. It's all quite confusing.
translation: 문제는 그 문들이 가끔 자리가 바뀌는 것 같다는 거예요. 정말 헷갈리는 곳이에요.

english: What's this thing guarding one of them.
I think it might be a mummy. It's not very friendly, but it does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
translation: 미라인 것 같아요. 그다지 친절하진 않지만, 무덤 안의 방 몇 개에는 들여보내 줘요. 그래도 위험하긴 해요.

english: Well I'm not afraid of a little danger.
translation: 뭐, 저는 그 정도 위험은 무섭지 않아요.

english: Are you sure? The place is full of poisonous snakes and scarabs along with some rather nasty mummies as well. You could die in there.
translation: 정말요? 그곳엔 독사와 스카라베 떼, 게다가 꽤 고약한 미라들까지 가득해요. 그 안에서 죽을 수도 있다고요.

english: I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough. Maybe I should have taken a lockpick.
translation: 저는 방 하나까진 들어갔는데, 다음 방은 더 어려웠어요. 제 자물쇠 따기 실력이 부족했거든요. lockpick(자물쇠 따개)이라도 챙겨 갔어야 했나 봐요.

english: It all sounds like fun to me. So, is there anything valuable in there?
translation: 듣기엔 재미있을 것 같은데요. 그래서, 그 안에 값나가는 게 있어요?

english: There are lots of artefacts that you should be able to sell to a legitimate trader...
translation: 유물이 잔뜩 있는데, 합법적인 상인한테 팔 수 있을 거예요...

english: Like your friend Simon Templeton?
translation: 당신 친구 Simon Templeton(사이먼 템플턴) 같은 사람 말이죠?

english: Of course. He's as 'legitimate' as you can get.
Is there anything else of value in there?
translation: 그 안에 다른 값진 건 없어요?

english: I've heard a rumour that there is an ancient magic sceptre somewhere inside.
translation: 피라미드 안 어딘가에 고대의 마법 sceptre(셉터)가 있다는 소문을 들었어요.

english: Ah, now you've piqued my interest. What do you know about this sceptre?
translation: 아, 이제야 관심이 생기네요. 그 셉터에 대해 뭘 알고 있어요?

english: Not a lot. It's apparently made of gold and covered in jewels. It's supposed to have some magical powers as well.
translation: 별로 없어요. 금으로 만들어졌고 보석으로 뒤덮여 있다나 봐요. 마법의 힘도 있다고들 해요.

english: Magical powers? This sounds good. What are they?
I'll let you know when I find it!
Not if I find it first!
Hey! if you find it, I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
translation: 잠깐만요! 그걸 찾으면 저도 수익을 나눠 받을 자격이 있어요! 제가 아니었으면 그런 게 있는 줄도 몰랐을 거잖아요.

english: I'll think about it...
Yes, it's an odd place, isn't it?
You've been inside? Did you find anything?
Nothing of particular note...
Well if you do, I'd appreciate a share of any profits.
translation: 음, 혹시 찾으면 수익을 좀 나눠 주시면 고맙겠어요.

english: Right... I'll think about it...
Hello again.
Oh, hello. Any luck in the pyramid? I'd appreciate a cut of anything you find.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 피라미드에서 뭐 좀 건졌어요? 뭘 찾든 제 몫도 좀 떼어 주시면 고맙겠어요.

english: Right... I'll be sure to let you know if I come across anything good...
translation: 그래요... 뭔가 좋은 걸 발견하면 꼭 알려 드릴게요...

english: Great!
You show the artefact to Tarik.
Ohh... That looks nice. I'm looking forward to my cut.
Ah, yes... I'll bring it round later.
I'll be waiting...
You show the sceptre to Tarik.
Hey, look at this sceptre I found!
translation: 이것 봐요, 제가 찾은 이 셉터 좀 보세요!

english: Wow! It looks very valuable. What's my share?
translation: 우와! 엄청 값나가 보이는데요. 제 몫은 얼마예요?

english: Well given the work I had to go through to get it, I think I earned it all by myself.
translation: 글쎄요, 이걸 얻으려고 제가 한 고생을 생각하면, 전부 제가 혼자 얻어 낸 거라고 봐요.

english: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about this pyramid!
translation: 잠깐만요, 그건 불공평해요. 이 피라미드 얘기를 해 준 건 저라고요!

english: The world is a harsh place. Live and learn.
translation: 세상은 냉정한 곳이에요. 겪어 보면서 배우는 거죠.

english: Hello there.
Hello old bean. Is there something I can help you with?
translation: 안녕하신가, 이 친구. 내가 뭘 도와주면 되겠나?

english: Who are you?
My name is Tarquin Marjoribanks.
I'd be surprised if you haven't already heard of me?
translation: 자네가 아직 내 이름을 못 들어 봤다면 그게 더 놀라운 일이겠지?

english: Why would I have heard of you Mr. Marjoribanks?
translation: 제가 왜 당신을 알아야 하죠, Marjoribanks(마조리뱅크스) 씨?

english: It's pronounced 'Marchbanks'!
You should know of me because I am a member of the royal family of Misthalin!
translation: 자네가 날 알아야 하는 건 내가 Misthalin(미스탈린) 왕실의 일원이기 때문일세!

english: Are you related to King Roald?
Oh yes! Quite closely actually.
I'm his 4th cousin, once removed on his mothers side.
translation: 외가 쪽으로 십촌, 거기서 한 대 더 내려가지만 말일세.

english: Er... Okay. What are you doing here then?
translation: 어... 그렇군요. 그럼 여기서 뭘 하고 계세요?

english: I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun! Would you like to know how?
translation: 강에서 카누를 타고 있지! 엄청나게 재미있다네! 타는 법을 알고 싶은가?

english: Could you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
translation: 글쎄, 자네는 카누를 만들 만한 실력이 있어 보이지 않는군.

english: You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
translation: 일단 카누를 만들 수 있게 되면 강을 따라 훨씬 빨리 다닐 수 있다네!

english: It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 정말 아주 간단하다네. 강둑에 있는 저 나무까지 걸어가서 베어 넘기기만 하면 되지.

english: When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
translation: 그렇게 하고 나면 도끼로 통나무를 더 다듬어 카누를 만들 수 있다네.

english: My personal favourite is the Stable Dugout canoe. A finer craft you'll never see old bean!
translation: 내가 제일 좋아하는 건 Stable Dugout canoe(튼튼한 통나무배)일세. 이보다 멋진 배는 다시 못 볼 걸세, 이 친구!

english: A Stable Dugout canoe will take you pretty much the length of the Lum river.
translation: 튼튼한 통나무배라면 Lum river(럼 강)을 거의 처음부터 끝까지 갈 수 있지.

english: Of course there are other canoes.
Further up river, near the Barbarian Village, I saw some darned fool 'canoeing' on a log!
translation: 강 상류 쪽 Barbarian Village(야만인 마을) 근처에서 웬 얼간이가 통나무를 타고 '카누질'을 하는 걸 봤지 뭔가!

english: Unfortunately, you don't have the skill to create anything more than one of those logs. I dare say it will only get 1 stop down the river!
translation: 안타깝게도 자네 실력으로는 그런 통나무 이상은 만들 수 없겠군. 장담하는데 그걸로는 강 아래로 선착장 한 곳밖에 못 갈 걸세!

english: Still, I'm sure it will satisfy one such as yourself.
translation: 그래도 자네 같은 사람에게는 그거면 충분하겠지.

english: What's that supposed to mean?
Do not profane the royal house of Varrock by engaging me in further discourse you knave!
translation: 더 이상 말을 섞어 Varrock(바록) 왕가를 더럽히지 말게, 이 무례한 놈!

english: Pfft! I doubt he even knows the King!
translation: 흥! 저 사람 왕을 알기나 하는지 몰라!

english: You seem to be quite handy with an axe though!
translation: 그래도 자네 도끼 솜씨는 꽤 쓸 만해 보이는군!

english: I'm sure you can build a Dugout canoe. Not as fine as a Stable Dugout but it will carry you 2 stops on the river.
translation: 자네라면 Dugout canoe(통나무배)는 만들 수 있을 걸세. 튼튼한 통나무배만큼 훌륭하진 않지만 강에서 선착장 두 곳은 갈 수 있지.

english: I should imagine it would suit your limited means.
translation: 자네의 변변찮은 처지에는 그게 딱 맞겠군.

english: What do you mean when you say 'limited means'?
Well, you're just an itinerant adventurer!
translation: 뭐, 자네는 그저 떠돌이 모험가 아닌가!

english: What possible reason would you have for cluttering up my river with your inferior water craft!
translation: 대체 무슨 이유로 그 형편없는 배를 끌고 와서 내 강을 어지럽히려는 건가!

english: Ah! Perfect! You can make a Stable Dugout canoe! One of those will carry you to any civilised place on the river.
translation: 아! 훌륭하군! 자네는 Stable Dugout canoe(튼튼한 통나무배)를 만들 수 있겠어! 그거라면 강가의 문명화된 곳 어디든 갈 수 있지.

english: If you were of good pedigree I'd let you join my boat club. You seem to be one of those vagabond adventurers though.
translation: 자네가 좋은 가문 출신이었다면 내 보트 클럽에 들여 주었을 텐데. 보아하니 그 떠돌이 모험가 부류인 것 같군.

english: Charming!
Be off with you rogue!
Well ... erm. You seem to be able to make a Waka!
translation: 흠... 어. 자네는 Waka(와카)를 만들 수 있겠군!

english: Sounds fun, what's a Waka.
I've only ever seen one man on the river who uses a Waka. A big, fearsome looking fellow up near Edgeville.
translation: 강에서 와카를 타는 사람은 딱 한 명밖에 못 봤다네. Edgeville(에지빌) 근처 상류에 사는 덩치 크고 험악하게 생긴 사내였지.

english: People say he was born in the Wilderness and that he is looking for a route back.
translation: 사람들 말로는 그자가 Wilderness(황야)에서 태어났고 그리로 돌아갈 길을 찾고 있다더군.

english: Is that true!
How should I know? I would not consort with such a base fellow!
translation: 내가 그걸 어찌 알겠나? 그런 천한 자와는 어울리지 않는다네!

english: No thanks, not right now.
Can you teach me about canoes?
translation: 카누에 대해 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Who are you?
Yes
No
Can you teach me about Canoeing?
translation: 카누 타는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Please feel free to use the pottery wheel, I won't be using it all the time. Put your pots in the kiln when you've made one.
translation: 도자기 물레는 마음껏 쓰세요. 제가 늘 쓰는 건 아니니까요. 단지를 하나 만들면 가마에 넣으세요.

english: And make sure you tidy up after yourself!
What'you want?
Do you-
What? Speak up, I can't hear you!
Uhm... I'm just looking for some pickaxes! Do you have any?
translation: 음... 그냥 곡괭이를 좀 찾고 있어요! 있나요?

english: Do I have any pickaxes? Do I? Of course I do, this is a pickaxe shop, isn't it!
translation: 곡괭이가 있냐고? 있냐고? 당연히 있지, 여긴 곡괭이 가게잖아!

english: What? Stop mumbling!
I want a quest!
I don't have any lousy quests... I've got someone who's helping me already!
translation: 시시한 퀘스트 같은 건 없어... 날 도와주는 녀석도 이미 있고!

english: Well, I say helping... he takes his merry time to do his chores, my son does.
translation: 뭐, 돕는다고 해야 할지... 집안일을 하는 둥 마는 둥 꾸물대거든, 우리 아들 녀석이.

english: Then perhaps I can help in some way?
translation: 그럼 제가 어떻게든 도와드릴 수 있을까요?

english: Pfft, I doubt it... maybe when my son fouls up again, but not now.
translation: 흥, 글쎄... 우리 아들이 또 일을 망치면 모를까, 지금은 아니야.

english: Nothing really.
Then clear off!
Do you have any pickaxes?
Do you have any quests?
Nothing really.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래 봤자 하나로밖에 안 쳐 줘요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시는 오늘도 정말 멋진 날이네요, 그쵸?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 걸 다 할 수 있죠! 탑들은 꼭 봐야 할 멋진 볼거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보는 걸 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
Please excuse me, I'm rather busy.
Hey, I'm your contractor from Mahogany Homes, what did you want done?
translation: 안녕하세요, Mahogany Homes(마호가니 홈즈)에서 나온 시공업자예요. 어떤 작업을 원하셨죠?

english: I'd like my sink fixed.
I'd like two Wooden tables built.
translation: Wooden tables(나무 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Wooden cupboard built.
translation: Wooden cupboard(나무 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Wooden shelves built.
translation: Wooden shelves(나무 선반) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like my hat stand fixed.
I'd like two Oak tables built.
translation: Oak tables(참나무 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Oak cupboard built.
translation: Oak cupboard(참나무 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Oak shelves built.
translation: Oak shelves(참나무 선반) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Teak tables built.
translation: Teak tables(티크 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Teak cupboard built.
translation: Teak cupboard(티크 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Teak shelves built.
translation: Teak shelves(티크 선반) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany tables built.
translation: Mahogany tables(마호가니 탁자) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like a Mahogany cupboard built.
translation: Mahogany cupboard(마호가니 찬장) 하나를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I'd like two Mahogany shelves built.
translation: Mahogany shelves(마호가니 선반) 두 개를 만들어 주셨으면 해요.

english: I've finished with the work you wanted.
Thank you so much! Would you like a cup of tea before you go?
translation: 정말 고마워요! 가시기 전에 차 한 잔 하실래요?

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks, I better be off.
Aaah, nothing like a nice cupppa tea!
translation: 아아, 역시 차 한 잔만 한 게 없죠!

english: Yes, I'd love a cuppa.
No thanks.
Oh, hello. Have you got something you want preserving?
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 박제하고 싶은 거라도 있어요?

english: Yes please.
Give it to me to look at then.
translation: 그럼 한번 보게 이리 줘 봐요.

english: Not right now.
Well, you go kill things so I can stuff them, eh?
translation: 그럼 가서 뭘 좀 잡아 와요. 내가 박제할 수 있게, 응?

english: What?
If you bring me a monster head or a very big fish, I can preserve it for you so you can mount it in your house.
translation: 몬스터 머리나 아주 큰 물고기를 가져오면, 집에 걸어 둘 수 있게 박제해 줄게요.

english: I hear there are all sorts of exotic creatures in the Slayer Tower -- I'd like a chance to stuff one of them!
translation: Slayer Tower(슬레이어 탑)에 온갖 희한한 생물이 다 있다던데, 그중 하나라도 박제해 볼 기회가 있으면 좋겠어요!

english: Don't be silly, I can't preserve that!
translation: 말도 안 되는 소리 말아요, 그건 박제 못 해요!

english: Killing a chicken is hardly worth boasting about!
translation: 닭 한 마리 잡은 게 자랑할 거리는 아니잖아요!

english: That's a pretty ordinary fish, isn't it? Not really worth preserving.
translation: 아주 평범한 물고기네요, 안 그래요? 딱히 박제할 가치는 없겠어요.

english: You should have seen the one that got away!
That's a mighty fine sea bass you've caught there.
I can preserve that for you for 1,000 coins.
Maybe another time.
There you go!
No thanks.
All right, come back if you change your mind, eh?
translation: 알았어요, 마음 바뀌면 다시 와요, 응?

english: Don't point that thing at me!
I can preserve that for you for 2,500 coins.
Goodness me! That thing's more of a weapon than a fish!
I can preserve that for you for 3,500 coins.
That's quite a fearsome shark! You've done everyone a service by removing it from the sea!
translation: 정말 무시무시한 상어네요! 바다에서 이걸 없애 줬으니 모두에게 좋은 일 한 거예요!

english: I can preserve that for you for 5,000 coins.
That's a very fine crawling hand.
A cockatrice! Beautiful, isn't it? Look at the plumage!
translation: cockatrice(코카트리스)네! 아름답지 않아요? 이 깃털 좀 봐요!

english: I can preserve that for you for 2,000 coins.
My, he's a scary-looking fellow, isn't he? He'll look good on your wall!
translation: 이야, 이 녀석 생긴 게 무섭네요, 그쵸? 벽에 걸어 두면 멋지겠어요!

english: I can preserve that for you for 4,000 coins.
A kurask? Splendid! Look at those horns!
translation: kurask(쿠라스크)라니! 훌륭해요! 저 뿔 좀 봐요!

english: I can preserve that for you for 6,000 coins.
Goodness, an abyssal demon!
See how it's still glowing? I'll have to use some magic to preserve that.
translation: 아직도 빛나는 거 보여요? 이걸 박제하려면 마법을 좀 써야겠어요.

english: I can preserve that for you for 12,000 coins.
Three?! This must be a King Black Dragon!
translation: 머리가 셋?! 이건 King Black Dragon(킹 블랙 드래곤)이 틀림없어요!

english: I'll have to get out my heavy duty tools -- this skin's as tough as iron!
translation: 튼튼한 연장을 꺼내야겠네요. 이 가죽은 철처럼 질겨요!

english: I can preserve that for you for 50,000 coins.
That must be the biggest kalphite I've ever seen!
translation: 내가 본 kalphite(칼파이트) 중에 이게 제일 크네요!

english: Preserving insects is always tricky. I'll have to be careful...
That's not the most impressive head I've seen but I think I can just about manage this one.
translation: 지금까지 본 머리 중에 제일 인상적인 건 아니지만, 이 정도는 그럭저럭 해낼 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: This blue dragon smells like it's been dead for a remarkably long time. Even by my standards, it smells awful.
translation: 이 blue dragon(블루 드래곤)은 죽은 지 엄청 오래된 냄새가 나네요. 내 기준으로 봐도 냄새가 지독해요.

english: This hydra looks like it might fall to pieces soon. I'll have to be careful to preserve it properly.
translation: 이 hydra(히드라)는 곧 산산조각 날 것 같네요. 제대로 박제하려면 조심해야겠어요.

english: Yes please
Not right now
What?
No thanks
The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: 살인자가 벽장에서 나타나 책을 읽고 있던 Tayten(테이튼)을 찌른다.

english: Gurgle...
Nooooo!
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: 살인자가 문 아래로 쪽지를 밀어 넣고 벽장으로 달아난다.

english: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
Greetings! Are you in need of refreshment?
Yes please.
What are you selling?
Only the most delicious infusion of the leaves of the tea plant. Grown in the exotic regions of this world. Buy yourself a cup !
translation: 찻잎을 우려낸 최고로 맛있는 차뿐이랍니다. 이 세상의 이국적인 지방에서 기른 거예요. 한 잔 사 드세요!

english: No thanks.
Well, if you're sure. You know where to come if you do!
translation: 정 그러시다면야. 생각나면 어디로 오면 되는지 아시죠!

english: Hey! Get your hands off there!
You're the one who stole something from me!
translation: 당신이 내 물건 훔쳐 간 사람이잖아요!

english: Guardsguards!
Yes please.
What are you selling?
No thanks.
Stop pulling, we've plenty of time to see everything.
translation: 잡아당기지 마, 다 둘러볼 시간은 충분하단다.

english: Aww, but miss, it's sooo exciting.
That man over there talks funny, miss.
translation: 선생님, 저기 저 아저씨 말투가 이상해요.

english: That's because he's an art critic, dear. They have some very funny ideas.
translation: 저분은 미술 평론가라서 그렇단다, 얘야. 그런 사람들은 생각이 좀 별나거든.

english: Go away. We don't want any.
I'm a friend of Jethick's, I have come to return a book he borrowed.
translation: Jethick(제식)의 친구예요. 제식이 빌려 간 책을 돌려주러 왔어요.

english: Oh... Why didn't you say, come in then.
translation: 아... 진작 말하지 그랬어요, 그럼 들어와요.

english: Thanks, I've been missing that.
Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: 안녕하세요, Elena(엘레나)라는 여자가 여기 머물고 있다고 들었어요.

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: 네, 여기 머물렀었죠. 그런데 일주일 조금 더 전에 돌아갈 채비를 하다가, 결국 떠나지 못했어요.

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: 제 딸 Milli(밀리)가 서쪽 벽 근처에서 놀다가 그림자 같은 형체들이 뛰쳐나와 엘레나를 붙잡아 가는 걸 봤대요. 밀리와 얘기해 보고 싶으면 위층으로 가 보세요.

english: Any luck finding Elena yet?
Not yet...
I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: 행운을 빌어요. 엘레나는 우리를 많이 도와줬거든요.

english: Yes, she is safe at home now.
That's good to hear, she helped us a lot.
Good day friend.
Hello [player name]! Thanks again for your help with the dig.
translation: 안녕하세요, [player name]님! 발굴을 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요.

english: Bartak used the design of the shield you extracted to recreate a shield like it. Even though the original shield was poorly made, the design itself was a good one.
translation: Bartak(바르탁)이 당신이 꺼낸 방패의 설계를 이용해 그와 비슷한 방패를 다시 만들었어요. 원래 방패는 조잡하게 만들어졌지만, 설계 자체는 훌륭했거든요.

english: Perhaps there is some important knowledge that we have lost since the early, more war-like days of Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: 어쩌면 Dorgesh- Kaan(도르게시칸)의 초기, 더 호전적이던 시절 이후로 우리가 잃어버린 중요한 지식이 있는지도 몰라요.

english: The helmet you helped to unearth has come in useful. I used it as a visual aid when I went to talk to the children in the nursery about our history.
translation: 당신이 발굴을 도와준 투구가 쓸모 있었어요. 보육원 아이들에게 우리 역사에 대해 이야기하러 갔을 때 시각 자료로 썼거든요.

english: It's amazing that the ancient goblins' eyes were even smaller than a child's!
translation: 고대 고블린들의 눈이 아이들 눈보다도 작았다니 놀라워요!

english: Oldak examined the axe blade you dug up and found that it had a faint magical aura. It looks like the mace wasn't the only magical weapon our ancestors brought from the surface.
translation: Oldak(올닥)이 당신이 파낸 도끼날을 살펴보니 희미한 마법의 기운이 있었대요. 조상들이 지상에서 가져온 마법 무기가 철퇴만은 아니었던 것 같아요.

english: In fact, it could be that a lot of their equipment was magical. This means that either the ancient goblins were skilled magical craftsmen, or some other power was supplying them with magical equipment.
translation: 사실 그들의 장비 대부분이 마법이 깃든 것이었을 수도 있어요. 그렇다면 고대 고블린이 솜씨 좋은 마법 장인이었거나, 아니면 다른 어떤 세력이 그들에게 마법 장비를 대 주고 있었다는 뜻이죠.

english: We used the armour fragment you unearthed to reconstruct the shape of the original armour, and with it the shape of the goblin who wore the armour.
translation: 당신이 발굴한 갑옷 조각으로 원래 갑옷의 형태를 복원했고, 그걸로 그 갑옷을 입었던 고블린의 체형도 알아냈어요.

english: This told us a lot about how the goblin body shape changed from its surface form to that of the cave goblins.
translation: 덕분에 고블린의 체형이 지상에서 살던 형태에서 동굴 고블린의 형태로 어떻게 바뀌었는지 많은 걸 알게 됐어요.

english: When we examined the sword you dug up, we found that the blade is covered in tiny symbols.
translation: 당신이 파낸 검을 조사해 보니 칼날이 아주 작은 기호들로 뒤덮여 있었어요.

english: The scribe thinks he has enough of them to begin understanding the ancient goblin language, but it will take a while for him to decipher them.
translation: 서기는 고대 고블린 언어를 이해하기 시작할 만큼 기호를 충분히 모았다고 생각하지만, 해독하려면 시간이 좀 걸릴 거예요.

english: I lost the ancient goblin mace.
I know. Zanik says she found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted her to find it.
translation: 알아요. Zanik(자닉)이 도시 근처 동굴에 철퇴가 놓여 있는 걸 발견했대요. 마치 철퇴가 스스로 여기로 돌아와서 자닉이 찾아 주길 바란 것처럼요.

english: I know. We found it lying around in the caves near the city, almost as if it had made its way back here and wanted to be found.
translation: 알아요. 도시 근처 동굴에 철퇴가 놓여 있는 걸 우리가 발견했어요. 마치 철퇴가 스스로 여기로 돌아와서 누가 찾아 주길 바란 것처럼요.

english: If you want it back, I will sell it to you for 1,000 coins. That should discourage you from losing it again.
translation: 돌려받고 싶다면 1,000코인에 팔게요. 그 정도면 다시는 잃어버리지 않겠죠.

english: Okay.
But I'll have to go and get the money.
But I should free up some inventory space first.
translation: 그런데 먼저 소지품 공간을 좀 비워야겠어요.

english: Look after it well. All the goblins who have handled it say it made them feel uneasy. We want it kept safe, but we don't want it near the city.
translation: 잘 간수해요. 그걸 만져 본 고블린들은 다들 기분이 불안해졌대요. 안전하게 보관되길 바라지만, 도시 근처에 두고 싶진 않아요.

english: No way!
Suit yourself.
What have you learned about the artefacts we dug up?
translation: 우리가 파낸 유물에 대해 뭘 알아냈어요?

english: I lost the ancient goblin mace
Okay
No way
So, you're doing laundry, eh?
Yes. What is it to you?
Nice day for it.
I suppose it is.
Do you know any way to remove blood stains?
Blood stains is it... Well, the soap I use can clean almost any stain.
translation: 핏자국이라... 글쎄, 내가 쓰는 비누면 웬만한 얼룩은 다 지워지지.

english: Really?!? That sounds like just the thing I need, can I use some?
translation: 정말요?!? 딱 제가 찾던 거네요, 좀 써도 될까요?

english: No, I don't have very much soap left and I still have lots to get clean.
translation: 안 돼. 비누가 얼마 안 남았는데 빨 게 아직 잔뜩이야.

english: Alright can you tell me where I can buy some?
translation: 알겠어요, 그럼 어디서 살 수 있는지 알려 줄래요?

english: You can't... I make it to my own secret recipe.
translation: 못 사... 내 비밀 제조법으로 직접 만드는 거거든.

english: Could you be less helpful?
Like you were, taking those robes from my washing line?? So yes, if you know a way I can be less helpful just tell me. I'll try it.
translation: 네가 내 빨랫줄에서 그 로브들을 가져갈 때처럼 말이지?? 그래, 내가 더 비협조적으로 굴 방법이 있으면 말해 줘. 한번 해 볼 테니까.

english: Hi.
Greetings young one. What is it you wish to know?
What do I have to do in this room?

In this room you will see a maze within which one of my fellow Guardians has been turned to stone for the purposes of this exercise. You must move the statue using your telekinetic grab spell to the exit square at
translation: 이 방에는 미로가 있고, 그 안에서 내 동료 Guardian(수호자) 하나가 이 훈련을 위해 돌로 변해 있다네. 자네는 telekinetic grab(텔레키네틱 그랩) 주문으로 조각상을 움직여

english: the edge of the maze to bring the Guardian back to life. Simply stand on the side that you wish for the statue to travel towards and cast the spell on the statue. Once you have solved the maze, the statue will change back
translation: 미로 가장자리에 있는 출구 칸까지 옮겨서 수호자를 되살려야 하네. 조각상을 보내고 싶은 쪽에 서서 조각상에 주문을 걸기만 하면 되지. 미로를 풀면 조각상이

english: into the Guardian and he will award you with Telekinetic Pizazz Points and teleport you to the next maze. You can switch to a better view of the maze by selecting the 'Observe' option on the statue and return
translation: 다시 수호자로 돌아오고, 그가 자네에게 Telekinetic Pizazz Points(염력 피자즈 포인트)를 주고 다음 미로로 순간이동시켜 줄 걸세. 조각상의 '관찰' 옵션을 선택하면 미로를 더 잘 보이는 시점으로 바꿀 수 있고,

english: your view to normal by selecting the same option again. There is also a 'Reset' option on the statue just in case things aren't going too well.
translation: 같은 옵션을 다시 선택하면 시점이 원래대로 돌아온다네. 일이 잘 풀리지 않을 때를 대비해 조각상에는 '초기화' 옵션도 있지.

english: What are the rewards?

As well as the experience in casting magic, you will get Telekinetic Pizazz Points for each maze successfully solved and bonus points for completing five mazes in a row without returning to the entrance.
translation: 마법 시전 경험치는 물론이고, 미로를 하나 풀 때마다 염력 피자즈 포인트를 받고, 입구로 돌아가지 않고 미로 다섯 개를 연달아 풀면 보너스 포인트도 받는다네.

english: Got any tips that may help me?

Have a good look at the maze before you try to solve it because this can save you time and runes required to navigate the maze. Although you will still be getting magic experience for moving the statue incorrectly, you
translation: 미로를 풀기 전에 잘 살펴보게. 그러면 미로를 지나는 데 드는 시간과 룬을 아낄 수 있다네. 조각상을 잘못 움직여도 마법 경험치는 계속 얻겠지만,

english: won't be progressing towards collecting Telekinetic Pizazz Points. Lastly, all the mazes can be solved in ten moves or less.
translation: 염력 피자즈 포인트를 모으는 데는 진전이 없을 걸세. 끝으로, 모든 미로는 열 번 이하로 움직여서 풀 수 있다네.

english: Thanks, bye!
Use what you've learned, young one.
What do I have to do in this room?
What are the rewards?
Got any tips that may help me?
Thanks, bye!
You! Time for some questions.
translation: 당신! 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we see the birth of a new one.
translation: 물론 제 의무를 다하기 위해서죠. Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)께서는 우리가 이 세상의 종말을 이루기를 바라세요. 그래야만 새로운 세상의 탄생을 보게 될 테니까요.

english: To do my duty, of course. Ralos and Ranul wish us to bring about the end of this world. Only then will we will all unite in Mictl.
translation: 물론 제 의무를 다하기 위해서죠. Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)께서는 우리가 이 세상의 종말을 이루기를 바라세요. 그래야만 우리 모두가 Mictl(믹틀)에서 하나가 될 테니까요.

english: Who do you worship?
I worship both Ralos and Ranul equally, for in reality they are one. They have been separated for now, but soon they will rejoin once more.
translation: 저는 Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)을 똑같이 섬겨요. 실은 두 분이 하나이시니까요. 지금은 갈라져 계시지만, 곧 다시 하나가 되실 거예요.

english: Tell me about the Final Dawn.
translation: Final Dawn(최후의 새벽)에 대해 말해 줘요.

english: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, we will all play a part in forming a new one.
translation: 최후의 새벽은 우리의 운명이에요. Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)께서 우리 모두를 하나로 묶고 이 세상을 끝내시겠지만, 그 과정에서 우리 모두가 새로운 세상을 만드는 데 한몫하게 될 거예요.

english: The Final Dawn is our destiny. Ralos and Ranul will unite us all and end this world, but in doing so, they will grant us eternal life in Mictl.
translation: 최후의 새벽은 우리의 운명이에요. Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)께서 우리 모두를 하나로 묶고 이 세상을 끝내시겠지만, 그 과정에서 Mictl(믹틀)에서의 영생을 내려 주실 거예요.

english: Why did you join the Emissaries?
Who do you worship?
Tell me about the Final Dawn.
You knock on the door.
No milk today! Thank you!
Can I buy some Climbing boots?
translation: Climbing boots(등반화) 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: Sure, I'll sell you some in your size for 12 gold.
translation: 물론이죠, 당신 발에 맞는 걸로 12골드에 팔게요.

english: OK, sounds good.
I don't have the money on me.
Was there anything else?
No, thanks.
What does a Sherpa do?
We are expert guides that take adventurers, such as yourself, on mountaineering expeditions.
translation: 우리는 당신 같은 모험가들을 데리고 등반 원정을 떠나는 전문 안내인이에요.

english: How did you find out about the secret way?
I used to take adventurers up Death Plateau and further north before the trolls came. I know these mountains well.
translation: 트롤들이 오기 전에는 모험가들을 데리고 Death Plateau(죽음의 고원)과 그 북쪽까지 올라가곤 했거든요. 이 산들은 제가 잘 알아요.

english: Nice place you have here.
Thanks, I built it myself! I'm usually self sufficient but I can't earn any money with the trolls camped on Death Plateau.
translation: 고마워요, 제가 직접 지었어요! 평소엔 자급자족하는데, 트롤들이 죽음의 고원에 진을 치고 있어서 돈을 한 푼도 못 벌고 있어요.

english: Now that the Imperial Guard know about the secret way they will be able to destroy the trolls!
translation: 이제 Imperial Guard(제국 근위대)가 비밀 길을 알았으니 트롤들을 무찌를 수 있을 거예요!

english: Let us hope so traveller!
Nothing, thanks!
Can I buy some Climbing boots?
OK, sounds good.
No, thanks.
What does a Sherpa do?
How did you find out about the secret way?
Nice place you have here.
Nothing, thanks!
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 아이고, 영웅님이시네유! 우와! 정말 대단하셔유, 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우셨대유? 마을도 아주 좋아졌구먼유, 정말 큰일 하셨어유!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Teodor, I be a farmer, oh arrr....and what can I do for you?
translation: 지는 Teodor(테오도르)여유, 농사꾼이지유, 아무렴유....그래, 뭘 도와드릴까유?

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 아주 딱 좋아유, 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워유.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어유. 다들 아직 뱀파이어들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 험한 데서 근근이 먹고살고 있지유. 머지않아 Salve(살브 강)에 있는 사원까지 갈 수 있을 만큼 힘이 붙었으면 좋겠어유.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 지가 아는 한은 없어유. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설도 생겨서 아주 쓸모가 많고, 다들 영웅님께 정말 고마워하고 있어유. 지는 영웅을 실제로 본 적도 아는 사람도 없어서 비교할 데가 없지만서도,

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 아마 대부분 사람들이 보기엔 영웅님이 진짜 영웅일 거예유! 지는 영웅님을 만나서 참말로 기뻐유.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello again.Was that translation any use to Asgarnia?
translation: 다시 오셨군요. 그 번역문은 Asgarnia(아스가르니아) 씨에게 도움이 됐나요?

english: I think it was, thanks!
Hello again. I am now studying this mysterious altar and its inhabitants. The markings are strange...
translation: 다시 오셨군요. 저는 지금 이 수수께끼의 제단과 그곳에 살던 이들을 연구하고 있어요. 새겨진 표식이 참 이상하네요...

english: It refers to a god I have never heard of before, named Zaros. It must be some pagan superstition.
translation: 제가 들어 본 적도 없는 신을 가리키고 있어요. 이름이 Zaros(자로스)라네요. 무슨 이교도 미신인 게 틀림없어요.

english: That was a great find; who knows what other secrets lie buried beneath the surface of our land...
translation: 정말 대단한 발견이었어요. 우리 땅 지표면 아래에 또 어떤 비밀이 묻혀 있을지 누가 알겠어요...

english: That staff is incredible! It's the same symbol that was on that talisman you found here. Does this mean you've found out more about Zaros?
translation: 그 지팡이 정말 놀랍네요! 당신이 여기서 찾았던 그 부적에 있던 것과 같은 상징이에요. 그럼 Zaros(자로스)에 대해 더 알아냈다는 건가요?

english: I found out that he was banished, and that the people's hero was trapped in a pyramid and...
translation: 그가 추방당했고, 백성의 영웅은 피라미드에 갇혔다는 걸 알아냈어요. 그리고...

english: So you're the one who found out about that. I've heard the story from my friends in the museum. Well done on being able to wield such an impressive symbol.
translation: 그걸 알아낸 사람이 바로 당신이었군요. 박물관에 있는 친구들한테서 그 이야기를 들었어요. 그렇게 대단한 상징을 다룰 수 있게 되다니 정말 잘했어요.

english: Anyway....
What do you think of this?
Do you know what this is?
Where did you get this?
From one of the barrels at the digsite.
This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!
translation: 이건 니트로글리세린이라는 아주 위험한 액체예요. 조심해서 다루세요. 떨어뜨리면 폭발해요!

english: Can you tell me any more about this?
translation: 이것에 대해 더 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Nitroglycerin! This is a dangerous substance. This is normally mixed with other chemicals to produce a potent compound.
translation: 니트로글리세린이군요! 위험한 물질이에요. 보통 다른 화학 물질과 섞어서 강력한 혼합물을 만들 때 쓰죠.

english: Be sure not to drop it! That stuff is highly volatile...
translation: 절대 떨어뜨리지 마세요! 그건 휘발성이 아주 강하거든요...

english: Have a look at this.
Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is - it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...
translation: 정말이지, 당신은 늘 별난 물건만 찾아오네요. 이게 뭔지 알아요. 질산암모늄이라는 강한 화학 물질이에요. 이걸 왜 갖고 싶어 하는지는 영영 모르겠네요...

english: Hey, look at this.
Hmm, that looks dangerous. Handle it carefully and don't drop it!
translation: 흠, 위험해 보이네요. 조심해서 다루고 떨어뜨리지 마세요!

english: See what I have done with the compound now.
translation: 이제 그 혼합물로 뭘 만들었는지 보세요.

english: Seriously, I think you have a death wish! What on earth are you going to do with that stuff?
translation: 정말이지, 죽고 싶어서 안달이 났나 봐요! 대체 그걸로 뭘 하려는 거예요?

english: I'll find a use for it!
What do you think about this?
What have you concocted now? Just be careful when playing with chemicals!
translation: 이번엔 또 뭘 만들어 낸 거예요? 화학 물질을 갖고 놀 때는 제발 조심하세요!

english: I have these gold nuggets...
I can't do much with these nuggets yet. Come back when you have 3 and I will exchange them for you.
translation: 이 금덩이로는 아직 할 수 있는 게 별로 없어요. 3개를 모으면 다시 오세요. 바꿔 드릴게요.

english: Good – that's three; I can exchange them for normalgold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!
translation: 좋아요, 세 개네요. 이제 일반 금으로 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요. 이걸 제련하면 이익을 볼 수 있을 거예요!

english: Excellent!
I found a needle.
Hmm, yes; I wondered why this race were so well dressed! It looks like they had mastery of needlework.
translation: 흠, 그렇군요. 이 종족이 왜 그렇게 옷을 잘 차려입었나 했더니! 바느질 솜씨가 뛰어났던 모양이에요.

english: I found these...
Ew! Throw them away this instant!
Have a look at this glass.
Hey you should be careful of that. It might cut your fingers, throw it away!
translation: 저기, 그거 조심하세요. 손가락을 벨 수도 있어요. 버리세요!

english: Have a look at this arrow.
No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior – it'ssplit in half! It is not a valuable object though.
translation: 이 화살은 분명 강인한 전사가 쏜 거예요. 반으로 쪼개졌잖아요! 하지만 값진 물건은 아니에요.

english: I have no need for panning trays!
Have you searched this tray yet?
Not that I remember...
It may contain something; I don't want to get my hands dirty.
translation: 뭔가 들어 있을지도 몰라요. 저는 손을 더럽히고 싶지 않아요.

english: The expert hands the tray back to you.
Have a look at these bones.
Ah, yes – a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures...and in good condition. These are common cow bones,however; they have no archaeological value.
translation: 아, 그렇군요. 훌륭한 뼈 표본이에요... 눈에 띄는 골절도 없고... 상태도 좋네요. 하지만 흔한 소 뼈라서 고고학적 가치는 없어요.

english: I found these buttons.
Let's have a look. Ah, I think these are from the nobility, perhaps a royal servant?
translation: 어디 볼까요. 아, 이건 귀족 것 같네요. 어쩌면 왕실 하인의 것일까요?

english: I found this rock...
What a shame it's cracked; this looks like it would have been a good sample.
translation: 금이 가서 아쉽네요. 좋은 표본이 될 수 있었을 텐데.

english: Hey look at this.
Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!
translation: 오, 오래된 이빨이군요. 강대한 존재에게서 나온 것 같아요. 이 근처에 이빨 요정이 없어서 아쉽네요!

english: I found an old sword.
Oh, it's very rusty isn't it? I'm not sure this sword belongs here, it looks very out of place.
translation: 오, 녹이 잔뜩 슬었네요? 이 검은 여기 것이 아닌 것 같아요. 영 어울리지 않아 보여요.

english: Have a look at this staff.
Look at this... Interesting... This appears to belong to a cleric of some kind; certainly not a follower of Saradomin, however.
translation: 이것 좀 봐요... 흥미롭네요... 어떤 성직자의 물건 같아요. 하지만 Saradomin(사라도민)의 추종자는 확실히 아니에요.

english: I wonder if there was another civilization here before the Saradominists?
translation: Saradomin(사라도민) 신도들보다 먼저 이곳에 다른 문명이 있었던 걸까요?

english: I found some armour.
It looks like the wearer of this fought a mighty battle.
translation: 이걸 입었던 사람은 엄청난 전투를 치른 것 같네요.

english: I found some old armour.
How unusual. This armour doesn't seem to match with the other finds. Keep looking.
translation: 특이하네요. 이 갑옷은 다른 출토품들과 맞지 않는 것 같아요. 계속 찾아보세요.

english: I found some pottery pieces.
Yes, many parts are discovered. The inhabitants of these parts were great potters.
translation: 네, 여러 조각이 발견되죠. 이 지역 사람들은 빚는 솜씨가 대단했거든요.

english: You mean they were good at using potions?
No, no, silly. They were known for their skill with clay.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨, 엉뚱하긴. 점토를 다루는 솜씨로 유명했다는 거예요.

english: Have a look at this unusual item...
Let me see. This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.
translation: 어디 봐요. 이건 벨트 버클이에요. 그렇게 특이하진 않네요. 경비병의 것이었을 거예요.

english: Hmm, an interesting find; an animal skull for sure. Another student found one just like this today.
translation: 흠, 흥미로운 발견이네요. 동물 두개골이 확실해요. 오늘 다른 학생도 이것과 똑같은 걸 찾았어요.

english: Looks like an award cup for some small find. Perhaps it belongs to one of the students?
translation: 뭔가 소소한 발견을 기념하는 기념 컵 같네요. 혹시 학생 중 누군가의 것일까요?

english: Why, it looks like a teddy bear to me. Perhaps someone's lucky mascot!
translation: 이런, 제가 보기엔 곰 인형 같은데요. 누군가의 행운의 마스코트일지도요!

english: Ah yes, an old boot. Not really an ancient artefact, is it?
translation: 아, 네, 낡은 장화네요. 고대 유물이라고 하긴 어렵겠죠?

english: The expert has already seen the talisman.
There's no point in giving me this back!
I found this in a hidden cavern beneath the digsite.
translation: 발굴지 아래 숨겨진 동굴에서 이걸 찾았어요.

english: Incredible!
There is an altar down there. The place is crawling with skeletons!
translation: 그 아래에 제단이 있어요. 해골들이 우글거리고요!

english: Yuck!
This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견이에요! 우리는 지금까지 이곳에 다른 종족이 산 적이 없다고 굳게 믿고 있었거든요.

english: It seems the followers of Saradomin have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar. This whole city must have been built over it!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)의 추종자들이 Zaros(자로스) 제단의 증거를 덮어 숨기려 한 것 같아요. 이 도시 전체가 그 위에 세워진 게 틀림없어요!

english: Thanks for your help; your sharp eyes have spotted what many have missed. Here, take this gold as your reward.
translation: 도와줘서 고마워요. 당신의 날카로운 눈이 많은 사람이 놓친 걸 찾아냈어요. 자, 보상으로 이 금을 받으세요.

english: QUEST COMPLETED!
I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you.
translation: 석판은 더 필요 없어요! 하나면 충분해요, 고마워요.

english: I don't think that has any archaeological significance
translation: 그건 고고학적으로 별 의미가 없는 것 같네요

english: Ask about the Desert Treasure I quest.
translation: Desert Treasure I(사막의 보물 I) 퀘스트에 대해 물어본다.

english: Ask about the Digsite quest.
Hello there. What do you do here?
Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.
translation: 아, 그냥 이것저것 지켜보면서 불미스러운 일이 없도록 하고 있어요.

english: That's reassuring.
One day I hope it will be.
Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.
translation: 아, [player name] 님, 다시 만나서 반가워요.

english: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?
Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...
translation: 아직 없어요. 하지만 그를 찾으려고 할 수 있는 건 다 하고 있어요. 그자도 각오를 단단히 해 두는 게 좋을 거예요. 찾아내기만 하면 코피가 터지도록 한 방 먹여 줄 테니까요...

english: ... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!
translation: ... 뭐, Mahjarrat(마하자랏)한테 코라고 부를 만한 게 있다면 말이지만요!

english: Thank you for leading the Burgher's militia against the Troll King.
translation: Burgher(촌장)의 민병대를 이끌고 Troll King(트롤 왕)에 맞서 줘서 고맙네.

english: Now that the trolls are leaderless I have repaired the bridge to the central isle for you as best I can.
translation: 트롤들이 우두머리를 잃었으니, 중앙 섬으로 가는 다리를 내 힘닿는 데까지 고쳐 두었네.

english: Thanks Thakkrad. Does that mean I have access to the runite ores on that island?
translation: 고마워요, Thakkrad(타크라드). 그럼 그 섬에 있는 runite(루나이트) 광석을 캘 수 있는 건가요?

english: Yes, you should be able to mine runite there if you wish.
translation: 그렇네, 원한다면 거기서 runite(루나이트)를 캘 수 있을 걸세.

english: Cure my yak-hide, please.
I will cure yak-hide for a fee of 5 gp per hide.
translation: 야크 가죽은 한 장에 5 gp를 받고 무두질해 주겠네.

english: You have no yak-hide to cure.
You don't have enough gold to pay me!
There you go.
Bye.
Can you cure any other type of leather?
translation: 다른 종류의 가죽도 무두질할 수 있어요?

english: Other types of leather? Why would you need any other type of leather?
translation: 다른 종류의 가죽? 다른 가죽이 대체 왜 필요하단 말인가?

english: I'll take that as a no then.
Nothing, thanks.
See you later.
You won't find anyone else who can cure yak-hide.
translation: 야크 가죽을 무두질할 수 있는 사람은 나 말고는 아무도 없을 걸세.

english: Cure my yak-hide, please.
Cure all my hides.
Cure one hide.
Cure no hide.
Can you cure any other type of leather?
translation: 다른 종류의 가죽도 무두질할 수 있어요?

english: Nothing, thanks.
Hi there!
Can I have some more headgear?
translation: 머리장식을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: The 'Wedge' gives you some more headgear.
Who are you?
Call me The 'Wedge', I'm the taskmaster for the Achievement Diary here in Kandarin.
translation: The 'Wedge'(‘웨지’)라고 불러 주세요. 여기 Kandarin(칸다린)의 Achievement Diary(업적 일지) 감독관이에요.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In and around Kandarin it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록해 두도록 도와주는 일지예요. Kandarin(칸다린)과 그 주변에서 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 발견하게 도와줄 거예요. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이 보상을 줄 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement Diary.
translation: 제 Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different Kandarin headgears, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you
translation: 음, Kandarin(칸다린) 머리장식은 네 가지가 있고, 네 단계의 난이도와 하나씩 짝을 이뤄요. 각각 이전 단계와 같은 보상에 더해 추가 혜택도 있어요... 어느 단계 보상에 대해

english: like to know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in Kandarin, the headgear functions as a light source and you have a chance of receiving an extra log when cutting normal trees. You can get the flax keeper to convert 30 flax
translation: Kandarin(칸다린)의 초급 과제를 모두 마치면 머리장식을 광원으로 쓸 수 있고, 일반 나무를 벨 때 통나무를 하나 더 얻을 확률이 생겨요. 또 flax keeper(아마 관리인)에게 매일 아마 30개를

english: to bowstrings each day, coal trucks hold up to 140 coal and you'll find 5% more marks of grace on Seers' rooftop agility course.
translation: 활시위로 바꿔 달라고 할 수 있고, 석탄 수레에는 석탄을 140개까지 담을 수 있으며, Seers'(시어스) 지붕 민첩 코스에서 marks of grace(기품의 징표)를 5% 더 찾을 수 있어요.

english: Thanks!

How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in Kandarin so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Kandarin(칸다린)의 과제를 마쳐서 완료 표시가 되면, 저를 찾아와 말을 걸어 보상을 받으세요.

english: Bye!
See you around.
Can I have some more headgear?
translation: 머리장식을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 제 Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Hello cat.
~The cat glowers back at you.
Friendly aren't you?
The large cat near the stairs glowers menacingly at you as you approach the stairs.
translation: 계단에 다가가자 계단 근처에 있던 커다란 고양이가 당신을 험악하게 노려본다.

english: I think I had better stay away from the stairs for now.
translation: 당분간은 계단에서 떨어져 있는 게 좋겠어.

english: It's beautiful, isn't it?
What is?
Everything! The wonders right here in this museum, collected from all corners of the land.
translation: 전부 다요! 이 땅 곳곳에서 모아 온 이 박물관의 경이로운 물건들 말이에요.

english: I guess it is, you're right.
Matter of fact, I consider myself quite the collector. I keep a record of just about everything that I find!
translation: 사실 저는 스스로 꽤 대단한 수집가라고 생각해요. 제가 찾는 건 거의 다 기록해 두거든요!

english: Would you like one? You could keep track of your own collections.
translation: 하나 드릴까요? 당신만의 수집품을 기록해 둘 수 있을 거예요.

english: Yes, that sounds helpful!
No thanks. I think I'll pass.
I should've guessed you wouldn't understand the true beauty of a good collection!
translation: 좋은 수집품의 진정한 아름다움을 당신이 이해하지 못할 줄 알았어야 했는데!

english: There! Now you'll be able to see the true beauty of everything you collect on your adventures.
translation: 자! 이제 모험하면서 모은 모든 것의 진정한 아름다움을 볼 수 있을 거예요.

english: Thanks!
You might struggle to carry that right now.
translation: 지금은 그걸 들고 다니기 힘들 거예요.

english: Oh... I'll come back when I'm carrying a little less.
translation: 아... 짐을 좀 줄이고 다시 올게요.

english: Don't you have one lying around somewhere already?
translation: 이미 어딘가에 하나 굴러다니고 있지 않아요?

english: I think you're right!
Could you count how many uniques I've obtained in my collection?
translation: 제 수집품 중에 고유 아이템을 몇 개나 모았는지 세어 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'd love to count everything you've collected on your adventures, although you might want to take a seat this could take a while.
translation: 모험하면서 모은 걸 전부 세어 드리고 싶네요. 그런데 시간이 꽤 걸릴 테니 앉아서 기다리는 게 좋을 거예요.

english: The collector starts counting the items in your collection.
From what I can see you have collected [number] in your collection!
I see you are just starting out on your collecting adventure. I wish you luck!
translation: 이제 막 수집 모험을 시작했군요. 행운을 빌어요!

english: You've made a good start at filling your collection, keep at it!
translation: 수집품 채우기를 잘 시작했네요. 계속해 봐요!

english: You're starting to get a hang of this collecting business!
translation: 이제 이 수집이라는 일에 감을 잡아 가고 있네요!

english: You have a very respectable collection indeed, one day you'll have a better collection than me!
translation: 정말 훌륭한 수집품이에요. 언젠가는 저보다 더 나은 수집품을 갖게 될 거예요!

english: Now that's an impressive collection, I haven't seen many with a collection better than yours!
translation: 이거야말로 인상적인 수집품이네요. 당신보다 더 나은 수집품을 가진 사람은 별로 못 봤어요!

english: Colour me impressed, you've collected more items than me, I look forward to seeing your collection grow even more!
translation: 정말 감탄했어요. 저보다 더 많은 아이템을 모았네요. 수집품이 더 늘어나는 걸 보고 싶어요!

english: Wait, you finished it? You actually finished the entire collection? I never thought that was even possible!
translation: 잠깐, 다 채웠다고요? 정말로 수집품 전체를 완성한 거예요? 그게 가능하리라고는 생각도 못 했어요!

english: This... idea! The idea of something nice! Those nice little tokens!
translation: 이건... 생각! 뭔가 멋진 것에 대한 생각이에요! 그 멋지고 작은 토큰들!

english: What tokens?
Oh, er... never you mind!
I have some tokens!
Only some? Well you need more! Until you have them, I should get going...
translation: 좀밖에 없다고요? 그럼 더 필요해요! 다 모을 때까지 저는 이만 가 볼게요...

english: Oh yes, I've got this wonderful collection of tokens!
translation: 아, 그럼요. 근사한 토큰 수집품이 있어요!

english: May I see them?
Yes, here they are.
May I have them?
Yes, I suppose you can.
No.
Fine.
Yes.
No thanks.
Yes, here they are.
Yes, I suppose you can.
No.
Woah! What's going on here? There are so many bunnies!
translation: 우와! 여기 무슨 일이에요? 토끼가 엄청 많네요!

english: I don't know what happened, things happened so quickly.
translation: 저도 무슨 일인지 모르겠어요. 모든 게 순식간에 벌어졌거든요.

english: This certainly seems like a hare-y situation, where did you get them all?
translation: 이거 참 토끼고 싶어지는 상황이네요. 이 토끼들은 다 어디서 났어요?

english: I didn't, they just kept jumping out of my hat.
translation: 제가 데려온 게 아니에요. 그냥 제 모자에서 계속 튀어나왔어요.

english: What do you mean? Are you a wizard?
Wizard? No, I'm just a street magician, they call me The Disappointing Gelt. I was out here practicing my tricks and things went south quickly.
translation: 마법사요? 아뇨, 저는 그냥 거리 마술사예요. 다들 The Disappointing Gelt(실망스러운 겔트)라고 부르죠. 여기서 마술을 연습하고 있었는데 일이 순식간에 꼬여 버렸어요.

english: Don't tell me, you were trying to pull a rabbit out of your hat and you accidentally pulled out hundreds?
translation: 설마, 모자에서 토끼를 꺼내려다가 실수로 수백 마리를 꺼낸 거예요?

english: Well... yes, some old guy gave me these magical looking stones, so I thought I'd practice my act with them.
translation: 음... 네. 어떤 노인이 마법 같아 보이는 돌을 주길래, 그걸로 공연 연습을 해 보려고 했죠.

english: The magician shows you some rune stones.
You do know these are rune stones, they're used in actual magic.
translation: 이거 룬석인 거 알죠? 진짜 마법에 쓰는 거예요.

english: You're chatting rubbish... real magic doesn't exist.
translation: 헛소리 마세요... 진짜 마법 같은 건 없어요.

english: Then how did all these rabbits appear?
translation: 그럼 이 토끼들은 다 어떻게 나타난 건데요?

english: I don't know, I put the runes in my hat, said the magic words 'Rabbaradoo' and stuck my hand in and felt something fuzzy. When I pulled my hand back, I was holding a rabbit.
translation: 몰라요. 룬을 모자에 넣고, '래바라두'라고 주문을 외운 다음 손을 넣었더니 뭔가 복슬복슬한 게 만져졌어요. 손을 빼 보니 토끼를 들고 있더라고요.

english: Mind if I take a look at your hat? I think there's more to this than meets the eye.
translation: 모자 좀 봐도 될까요? 겉보기보다 뭔가 더 있는 것 같아요.

english: You take a look into the darkness of the magician's hat.
You see a glowing green portal staring back at you.
translation: 초록빛으로 빛나는 포털이 당신을 마주 보고 있다.

english: Well Gelt, I don't know how you've done it, but it looks like you've opened a portal.
translation: Gelt(겔트) 씨, 어떻게 한 건지는 모르겠지만 포털을 열어 버린 것 같아요.

english: Huh.
Please, you must help me, I beg you.
Ah, I mean, I'm pretty busy... but I suppose I can find the time to help you.
translation: 아, 그게, 제가 좀 바쁘긴 한데... 그래도 도와드릴 시간은 낼 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: You put your hand in the hat and feel the portal start to pull you in.
translation: 모자에 손을 넣자 포털이 당신을 끌어당기기 시작한다.

english: Player is teleported to The Rabbit Realm
Hello Gelt, I need to go back.
translation: Gelt(겔트) 씨, 안녕하세요. 다시 돌아가야 해요.

english: Please don't dawdle, I need you to fix this before the master of my order finds out.
translation: 제발 꾸물대지 마세요. 우리 결사의 수장님이 알아채기 전에 이걸 해결해 주셔야 해요.

english: I have returned.
Oh, please tell me you managed to do something?
translation: 오, 제발 뭔가 해냈다고 말해 주세요.

english: I'll be honest with you Gelt, it got a bit weird.
translation: 솔직히 말할게요, Gelt(겔트) 씨. 좀 이상하게 흘러갔어요.

english: What do you mean?
Somehow, you opened a portal to a dimension, very similar to ours, but run by rabbits instead of humans.
translation: 어쩐 일인지 당신이 다른 차원으로 가는 포털을 열었어요. 우리 세계랑 아주 비슷한데, 인간 대신 토끼가 다스리는 곳이에요.

english: That's incredible...
That's not even the weird bit! They live in a cult worshipping an egg, they ask it a question and whatever it says, they do.
translation: 이상한 건 그게 다가 아니에요! 그들은 알을 숭배하는 사이비 교단 속에서 살아요. 알에게 질문을 하고, 알이 뭐라고 하든 그대로 따른대요.

english: That's why they all started coming through, the Duke Rabbacio asked the egg if they should jump through and it said yes.
translation: 그래서 다들 이쪽으로 넘어오기 시작한 거예요. Duke Rabbacio(라바시오 공작)이 알에게 넘어가야 하냐고 물었더니 그렇다고 했대요.

english: What the...
It's a lot to take in, but I've managed to stop them jumping through for now, however I couldn't close the portal.
translation: 받아들이기 힘들겠지만, 일단 토끼들이 더 넘어오지 못하게 막긴 했어요. 그런데 포털은 닫지 못했어요.

english: ...am I a god?
What?
Have I managed to conjure an alternate dimension with my own hands...
translation: 제 손으로 또 다른 차원을 불러냈단 말인가...

english: Hello? Gelt?
I'm the most powerful magician that has ever lived...
translation: 내가 이 세상에 존재했던 가장 강력한 마술사로구나...

english: No, you're not Gelt, you've used magic that's existed for millennia.
translation: 아니에요, Gelt(겔트) 씨. 당신이 쓴 건 수천 년 동안 존재해 온 마법이에요.

english: You have my thanks adventurer, when I return to my order, I'll report this to our leader, Magnus.
translation: 고마워요, 모험가님. 결사로 돌아가면 우리 지도자이신 Magnus(매그너스) 님께 이 일을 보고할게요.

english: What will you do with all these rabbits?
translation: 이 토끼들은 다 어떻게 할 거예요?

english: Since you couldn't close the portal, I'll try usher them back in.
translation: 포털을 닫지 못했으니, 제가 토끼들을 다시 그 안으로 들여보내 볼게요.

english: Would you mind letting me return to Bunbridge? I feel I have some unfinished business.
translation: Bunbridge(버니브리지)로 다시 돌아가게 해 주실 수 있어요? 아직 끝내지 못한 일이 있는 것 같아요.

english: Not a problem if you wish to return just talk to me, I'll stay for a while longer.
translation: 문제없어요. 돌아가고 싶으면 저한테 말만 하세요. 저는 조금 더 여기 있을게요.

english: Feel free to keep anything you found there as well, as a thanks from me.
translation: 거기서 찾은 건 뭐든 가지셔도 돼요. 제 감사의 표시예요.

english: Thank you again for your help, do you wish to return to the Rabbit Realm?
translation: 도와주셔서 다시 한번 고마워요. Rabbit Realm(토끼 왕국)으로 돌아가시겠어요?

english: No thanks, I've had enough of rabbits for now.
So be it, I'll be contemplating my power for a little while if you change your mind.
translation: 그러세요. 마음이 바뀌면 말하세요. 저는 한동안 제 힘에 대해 깊이 생각하고 있을 테니까요.

english: Yes
No
...[player name]?
Um, yes?
Boss wants to talk to you. She's downstairs in the pits.
translation: 보스가 너랑 얘기하고 싶대. 아래층 투기장에 있어.

english: Got it!
Hello.
Oh. It's you again.
Have you spoken with the boss yet?
Yes. Actually, I wanted to ask you about the task she gave me...
translation: 네. 사실 그분이 준 일에 대해 좀 물어보고 싶었는데요...

english: Stop right there. You'll get not hints out of me.
translation: 거기까지. 나한테서 힌트는 하나도 못 얻어 낼 거야.

english: You know, you're very pretty...
Ha! That's a good one.
I hope you're better at ratcatching than lying.
translation: 거짓말 솜씨보다는 쥐잡이 솜씨가 낫길 바라.

english: That's a powerful-looking cat you have there.
translation: 거기 있는 고양이 꽤 강해 보이네요.

english: Bellemorde? Beautiful, isn't she?
Er... yes.
I've had her since she was a kitten. Felkrash trained her for me.
translation: 새끼 고양이일 때부터 키웠어. Felkrash(펠크래시)가 날 위해 훈련시켜 줬지.

english: Oh really? Does she know any cool tricks?
translation: 오, 정말요? 멋진 재주라도 부릴 줄 알아요?

english: Oh yes! There was this one time she helped Felkrash wipe out all the rats in town by -
translation: 그럼! 한번은 이 애가 Felkrash(펠크래시)를 도와서 마을의 쥐를 싹 없앴는데, 그 방법이 뭐냐면 -

english: Hiss!
Oh, I see. Nice try, [player name], but you'll have to be cleverer than that.
translation: 아, 그렇구나. 좋은 시도였어, [player name]. 하지만 그것보단 더 영리해야 할 거야.

english: Almost had it...
I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: Felkrash(펠크래시)가 그렇게 대단한 것 같진 않던데요.

english: What?
All the other ratcatchers I've met had loads of tricks to show me.
translation: 제가 만난 다른 쥐잡이들은 다들 보여 줄 재주가 잔뜩 있었거든요.

english: In comparison, Felkrash was just... disappointing.
How dare you! Felkrash is the greatest ratcatcher Gielinor's ever seen!
translation: 어떻게 감히! Felkrash(펠크래시)는 Gielinor(길리노르) 역사상 최고의 쥐잡이라고!

english: Oh yeah? What's the most impressive thing she's done then?
translation: 아, 그래요? 그럼 그분이 한 일 중에 제일 대단한 게 뭔데요?

english: I'll have you know she once killed all the rats in Port Sarim with just one attack!
translation: 잘 들어 둬. Felkrash(펠크래시)는 한번은 Port Sarim(포트 사림)의 쥐를 단 한 번의 공격으로 몽땅 없앤 적이 있다고!

english: I don't know. That just sounds like one of her stories.
translation: 글쎄요. 그냥 그분이 지어낸 이야기 같은데요.

english: It's true! I saw it happen. She used a magic flute to charm the rats into the sea!
translation: 진짜야! 내가 직접 봤다고. 마법 플루트로 쥐들을 홀려서 바다로 몰아넣었어!

english: Wait... I uh, I shouldn't have said that.
translation: 잠깐... 어, 이 말은 하지 말았어야 했는데.

english: Don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash you snitched.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 당신이 고자질했다고 Felkrash(펠크래시)한테 말하지 않을게요.

english: You'd better not!
They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?
translation: Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)에서는 뱀을 홀리던데... 쥐도 홀릴 수 있으려나?

english: Oh it's you again.
Felkrash told me of the task she set you.
translation: Felkrash(펠크래시)가 너한테 준 일에 대해 얘기해 줬어.

english: Oh, er, really?
I shouldn't have told you that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: 그 이야기를 하는 게 아니었는데. 나를 꾀어서 그걸 털어놓게 하다니, 부끄러운 줄 알아.

english: If it makes you feel better, I lie to a lot of people.
translation: 기분이 좀 나아진다면 말인데, 저는 여러 사람한테 거짓말을 해요.

english: That was an amazing performance! I've only seen one like it... as you know.
translation: 정말 놀라운 연주였어! 그런 연주는 딱 한 번밖에 못 봤어... 알다시피.

english: Don't worry, Felkrash has no idea how I figured it out.
translation: 걱정 마세요. 제가 어떻게 알아냈는지 Felkrash(펠크래시)는 전혀 몰라요.

english: And it had better stay that way!
She looks through you as if you don't exist.
translation: The Face(얼굴)은 마치 당신이 없는 사람인 양 눈길조차 주지 않는다.

english: Step away from that manhole, you've no business down there.
translation: 그 맨홀에서 떨어져. 네가 그 아래에 볼일은 없잖아.

english: Ah you, peasant. Felkrash wishes to speak with you.
translation: 아, 너, 천한 것. Felkrash(펠크래시)가 너랑 얘기하고 싶어 해.

english: 'The Face' comports herself in an air of haughtiness uncommon to those with appearances as ugly as hers.
translation: 'The Face(얼굴)'은 그토록 추한 외모를 지닌 이에게선 보기 드문 거만한 태도로 처신한다.

english: Ok, where would I find her?
You should find her below in the pits.
Oh it's you again.*She glances at you with barely disguised disdain.*
translation: 아, 또 너구나.*경멸을 거의 숨기지도 않은 채 당신을 흘끗 본다.*

english: *Aside* I wonder what her problem is?
Have you spoken with Felkrash yet?
Yes.
You notice a rather unkempt looking cat nearby. Despite its bedraggled appearance it exudes power, strength and intelligence beyond that of a normal cat.
translation: 근처에 꽤 꾀죄죄해 보이는 고양이가 보인다. 지저분한 겉모습과 달리 보통 고양이를 뛰어넘는 힘과 기운, 그리고 지능이 느껴진다.

english: That's an interesting looking cat.
Ah yes Belle. What a cat. Felkrash trained her for me shortly after she single handedly charmed all the rats of the Port and drowned them.
translation: 아, 그래, Belle(벨). 대단한 고양이지. Felkrash(펠크래시)가 혼자 힘으로 항구의 쥐를 몽땅 홀려 물에 빠뜨린 직후에 날 위해 훈련시켜 준 애야.

english: I love that story. My favourite part is how she managed to get rid of all the rats. Would you tell it to me?
translation: 저 그 이야기 정말 좋아해요. 특히 그분이 쥐를 전부 없앤 방법이 제일 마음에 들어요. 그 이야기 좀 들려주실래요?

english: I don't know, I really shouldn't.
*Aside* I'll get the story out of her, a little sweet talking should do the trick.
translation: *혼잣말* 저 이야기를 꼭 캐내야지. 살살 비위 좀 맞춰 주면 되겠지.

english: Oh please tell me, I'm sure you'd tell the story wonderfully, you have such a pretty ...
translation: 오, 제발 들려주세요. 분명 멋지게 이야기해 주실 거예요. 정말 예쁜...

english: Yes..?
*The face'sface perks up at the mention of the word pretty.*
...voice.
Oh.*And just as quickly turns sour again.*
*Aside* Dang!
... which compliments your radiant aura!
translation: ... 당신의 빛나는 분위기와도 참 잘 어울리는 목소리요!

english: *Aside* That should do the trick.
Oh you're too generous.
Do you know something, I think I'll tell you, mind you, don't tell Felkrash about this, she'd only get sore with me.
translation: 있잖아, 이야기해 줄게. 대신 Felkrash(펠크래시)한테는 절대 말하지 마. 나한테 잔뜩 화낼 테니까.

english: She's the story teller not me.
One day ......
The camera fades briefly to black and back.
And that is how she drowned the rats.
translation: 그렇게 해서 쥐들을 물에 빠뜨린 거야.

english: ..and that is how she drowned the rats.
You just about manage to stay awake through the long and turgid recital of the story.
translation: 길고 지루하기 짝이 없는 이야기를 간신히 졸지 않고 끝까지 들었다.

english: The snakecharmer of Pollnivneach from what you gathered seemed to play a critical role in the story.
translation: 들은 바로는 Pollnivneach(폴니브니치)의 뱀 부리는 사람이 이야기에서 결정적인 역할을 한 것 같다.

english: *Aside*PerhapsI should pay this snake charmer a visit.
translation: *혼잣말*아무래도 그 뱀 부리는 사람을 한번 찾아가 봐야겠어.

english: Really?
I shouldn't have told that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: 그 이야기는 하는 게 아니었는데. 나를 꾀어서 털어놓게 하다니, 부끄러운 줄 알아.

english: I promise I won't tell her you helped me.
translation: 그분께는 당신이 도와줬다고 말하지 않을게요. 약속해요.

english: I must congratulate you on your performance, I have only ever seen one other display of musicality to match, as you should know.
translation: 연주 정말 대단했어. 그만한 음악 솜씨는 전에 딱 한 번밖에 못 봤어. 너도 알겠지만.

english: Thank you, and don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash that you helped me.
translation: 고마워요. 걱정 마세요, 당신이 도와줬다고 Felkrash(펠크래시)한테 말하지 않을게요.

english: Here you go.
You've found another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
You know, you're very pretty...
That's a nice cat you have there.
I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: Felkrash(펠크래시)가 그렇게 대단한 것 같진 않던데요.

english: The Great Guardian seems to be resting. You should probably not disturb it.
translation: The Great Guardian(위대한 수호자)는 쉬고 있는 듯하다. 방해하지 않는 게 좋겠다.

english: My power level is too low. Bring me guardian stones.
translation: 내 힘이 너무 약하다. 수호석을 가져오라.

english: Thanks, adventurer. I am now fully powered up.
translation: 고맙다, 모험가여. 이제 힘이 가득 찼노라.

english: Human, I need the power of the guardian stones.
Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Thank you, brave ones.
translation: 인간들이여, 이제 균열을 닫을 힘을 얻었노라. 고맙다, 용감한 자들이여.

english: Now, for the final blow. Let the Scar be no more!
translation: 이제 마지막 일격이다. Scar(흉터)여, 영원히 사라져라!

english: Brace yourselves!
Now, I shall rest until it opens once more...
Good day to you sir.
Who are you?
I am the Lady of the Lake.
translation: 나는 Lady of the Lake(호수의 여인)이오.

english: Good day.
I seek the sword Excalibur.
Aye, I have that artefact in my possession.
translation: 그렇소, 그 유물은 내가 지니고 있소.

english: 'Tis very valuable, and not an artefact to be given away lightly.
translation: 매우 귀한 것이라, 가벼이 내어 줄 수 있는 유물이 아니오.

english: I would want to give it away only to one who is worthy and good.
translation: 자격 있고 선한 자에게만 내어 주고 싶소.

english: And how am I meant to prove that?
I shall set a test for you.
First I need you to travel to Port Sarim. Then go to the upstairs room of the jeweller's shop there.
translation: 먼저 Port Sarim(포트 사림)으로 가시오. 그런 다음 그곳 보석상의 위층 방으로 가시오.

english: Ok. That seems easy enough.
Please kind sir... my family and I are starving...
translation: 제발 부탁입니다, 나리... 저와 제 가족이 굶주리고 있어요...

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: 부디 자비를 베푸셔서 소박한 빵 한 덩이만 나눠 주실 수 없을까요?

english: Yes certainly.
You give the bread to the beggar.
Thank you very much!
The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
translation: 거지가 Lady of the Lake(호수의 여인)으로 변했다!

english: Well done. You have passed my test.
Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
No I don't have any bread with me.
Well if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 그럼 구하시거든 어디로 오면 되는지 아시죠.

english: The beggar isn't interested in talking.
Have you got any bread for me yet?
Yes, here you go.
Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: 아, 제가 착각했네요. 아직 빵이 없어요. 미안해요.

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
Hello. I am here for Excalibur. Can I have it yet?
translation: 안녕하세요. Excalibur(엑스칼리버)를 받으러 왔어요. 이제 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I don't think you are worthy enough.
translation: 그대는 아직 자격이 부족한 것 같소.

english: Come back when you are a better person.
translation: 더 나은 사람이 되거든 다시 오시오.

english: ...But you have already proved thyself to be worthy of wielding it once already. I shall return it to you if you can prove yourself to still be worthy.
translation: ...허나 그대는 이미 한 번 그것을 휘두를 자격이 있음을 증명했소. 지금도 여전히 자격이 있음을 증명한다면 돌려주겠소.

english: ...And how can I do that?
Why, by proving yourself to be above material goods.
translation: 그야, 물질적인 것에 초연함을 증명하면 되오.

english: 500 gold coins ought to do it.
Ok, here you go.
You are still worthy to wield Excalibur! And thanks for the cash! I felt like getting a new haircut!
translation: 그대는 여전히 Excalibur(엑스칼리버)를 휘두를 자격이 있소! 그리고 돈은 고맙소! 마침 머리를 새로 하고 싶던 참이었소!

english: I don't have that kind of money...
Well, come back when you do.
Who are you?
Good day.
I seek the sword Excalibur.
Yes certainly
No I don't have any bread with me.
Yes, here you go.
No, I still have none.
How dare you come near my farmhouse! Guards! Guards! Remove this human!
translation: 감히 내 농가에 가까이 오다니! 경비병! 경비병! 이 인간을 끌어내!

english: (monkey guards appear and attempt to capture the player)
Guards! Here's a human!
Hello! What's a monkey like you doing here?
translation: 어머, 안녕! 너 같은 원숭이가 여기서 뭘 하고 있니?

english: I'm just passing through actually.
Fair enough then.
What are you doing in my house?
I'm just passing through!
Well I don't give a monkey's uncle!
translation: 흥, 그러거나 말거나! 원숭이 삼촌 털끝만큼도 신경 안 쓴다고!

english: How curious? I have not seen a creature of your kind for many years. You have ventured into the Nexus human - I should warn you to be aware of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 참으로 흥미롭군. 자네 같은 종족의 생물은 오랜 세월 보지 못했네. 인간이여, 자네는 Nexus(넥서스)에 발을 들였네. Abyssal Sires(심연의 군주들)을 조심하라고 경고해 두지.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Ah... Time does not pass in the Abyss at the same rate that it does in your realm, but nevertheless I have been in this place for aeons.
translation: 아... Abyss(심연)의 시간은 자네 세계와 같은 속도로 흐르지 않네. 그렇다 해도 나는 영겁의 세월을 이곳에서 보냈지.

english: Indeed, when I was last in your realm, the armies of Zamorak were battling the other gods for control, and we sought reinforcements from any plane we could reach.
translation: 실로, 내가 마지막으로 자네 세계에 있었을 때 Zamorak(자모락)의 군대는 패권을 두고 다른 신들과 싸우고 있었네. 우리는 닿을 수 있는 모든 차원에서 지원군을 구했지.

english: That was how I came here. We broke through to the Abyss, seeking allies for our cause, but instead I ended up a prisoner in this place, unable to leave, while the God Wars continued without me.
translation: 그렇게 해서 이곳에 오게 되었네. 우리는 대의를 함께할 동맹을 찾아 Abyss(심연)을 뚫고 들어왔지만, 나는 오히려 나가지도 못하고 이곳에 갇힌 죄수가 되었고, God Wars(신들의 전쟁)은 나 없이 계속되었네.

english: What can I do here?
translation: 여기서 제가 할 수 있는 일이 있나요?

english: There is something you can do here, human. In fact it may perhaps benefit us both.
translation: 자네가 여기서 할 일이 있네, 인간. 사실 어쩌면 우리 둘 모두에게 이로울지도 모르지.

english: Bring me a spine, a claw and an axon from the Abyssal Sires, and I shall construct them into a mighty weapon for you. Yes, we shall both benefit from this.
translation: Abyssal Sires(심연의 군주들)에게서 척추, 발톱, 축삭을 하나씩 가져오게. 그러면 내가 그것들로 자네에게 강력한 무기를 만들어 주지. 그래, 우리 둘 다 이득을 보게 될 걸세.

english: Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
translation: Abyssal Sires(심연의 군주들)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: The Sires are the engineers of this living pocket universe known to you and I as the Abyss.
translation: Sires(군주들)은 자네와 내가 Abyss(심연)이라 부르는 이 살아 있는 작은 우주를 설계한 자들일세.

english: At the hands of the 'Chaos God', Zamorak, like myself, they too were cast down and imprisoned in this living tomb.
translation: '혼돈의 신' Zamorak(자모락)의 손에, 나와 마찬가지로 그들 역시 내던져져 이 살아 있는 무덤에 갇혔네.

english: They worked for centuries attempting to escape the pull of the Abyss but as food resources began to deplete they knew that their only chance for survival was to construct this Nexus.
translation: 그들은 수 세기 동안 Abyss(심연)의 인력에서 벗어나려 애썼지만, 식량이 바닥나기 시작하자 살아남을 유일한 길은 이 Nexus(넥서스)를 짓는 것뿐임을 깨달았지.

english: They absorb flesh and bone of their demon kin, weaving it into the fabric of these very walls. Here they have remained in deep stasis, asleep.
translation: 그들은 동족 악마들의 살과 뼈를 흡수해 바로 이 벽의 조직으로 엮어 넣는다네. 그리고 이곳에서 깊은 휴면 상태로 잠들어 있지.

english: If you succeed in awakening them, they will no doubt unleash their full fury upon you. Someone of your calibre should be able to deal with them though, especially with the shadows on your side...
translation: 그들을 깨우는 데 성공한다면 분명 자네에게 온 분노를 쏟아 낼 걸세. 하지만 자네 정도의 실력자라면 상대할 수 있을 테지. 특히 그림자가 자네 편이라면 말일세...

english: If you succeed in killing a Sire, you may be fortunate enough to find one of its unsired offspring among its remains. Bring the Unsired here, to the Font of Consumption.
translation: Sire(군주)를 처치하는 데 성공하면, 운이 좋을 경우 그 잔해 속에서 아직 태어나지 않은 새끼를 찾을 수도 있네. 그 Unsired(언사이어드)를 이곳 Font of Consumption(소멸의 샘)으로 가져오게.

english: By placing the Unsired into the Font, I will be able to consume its flesh and perhaps you will receive something worth having.
translation: Unsired(언사이어드)를 Font(샘)에 넣으면 내가 그 살을 먹어 치울 수 있고, 자네는 어쩌면 가질 만한 것을 받게 될 걸세.

english: I'll be off for now.
I did not ask you to bring me anything, human.
translation: 자네에게 무엇을 가져오라고 한 적은 없네, 인간.

english: Yes, human?
Have you harvested any components for me?
translation: 나를 위해 부품을 좀 거둬 왔나?

english: What's this stuff for?
I shall use the components to construct a mighty weapon for you. Rest assured, the process will be beneficial to both of us.
translation: 그 부품들로 자네에게 강력한 무기를 만들어 줄 걸세. 안심하게, 이 과정은 우리 둘 모두에게 이로울 테니.

english: No, sorry.
I still require [bludgeon component(s)] from an Abyssal Sire.
translation: 아직 Abyssal Sire(심연의 군주)에게서 얻은 [bludgeon component(s)]이(가) 필요하네.

english: You hand over the component(s) to the Overseer.
I now have all the components I require, so here is the weapon I promised you.
translation: 이제 필요한 부품이 모두 모였으니, 약속한 무기를 주겠네.

english: You have served me well, it is good to see that you humans are still as gullible as ever!
translation: 자네는 내게 큰 도움이 되었네. 자네들 인간이 여전히 잘 속아 넘어간다는 걸 확인하니 반갑군!

english: Bringing me those body parts from the Sires has now granted me enough teleportation energy to leave this living hell hole. Perhaps I will pay your realm a visit and there will be much to harvest!
translation: Sires(군주들)의 신체 부위를 가져다준 덕분에 이 살아 있는 지옥 구덩이를 떠날 만큼의 순간이동 에너지를 얻었네. 어쩌면 자네 세계에 들러 볼지도 모르지. 거둘 것이 아주 많겠군!

english: Yuck! This is disgusting. What use is this? It's unwieldly!
translation: 윽! 이거 역겨워요. 이걸 어디에 써요? 다루기도 힘들잖아요!

english: Have you not learned yet, appearances can be deceiving. You hold in your hands a living weapon whose power is rivalled by few weapons from your world, use it wisely.
translation: 아직도 모르겠나? 겉모습은 속이는 법일세. 자네 손에 든 건 살아 있는 무기로, 그 힘에 견줄 만한 무기는 자네 세계에도 몇 없네. 현명하게 쓰게.

english: Do not think that I am ungrateful for my freedom human. I will leave you this ancient tome that will instruct you in creating more of these weapons in future.
translation: 내가 자유를 얻은 것을 고마워하지 않는다고 생각하지는 말게, 인간. 앞으로 이 무기를 더 만드는 법을 알려 줄 고대의 책을 남겨 주지.

english: Just use the three components on the book, and it will do the rest. You can get spare copies here any time you need.
translation: 세 부품을 책에 사용하기만 하면 나머지는 책이 알아서 할 걸세. 여분이 필요하면 언제든 이곳에서 얻을 수 있네.

english: Thank you.
Farewell...
The Overseer teleports away.
Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: 어쩌면 이걸로 널 베어 버릴지도 모르지, 악마.

english: So be it... I will await you on the fields of blood!
translation: 좋을 대로 하게... 피의 들판에서 자네를 기다리겠네!

english: I do not require anything further from you, human.
translation: 자네에게서 더 필요한 건 없네, 인간.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Tell me about the Abyssal Sires.
translation: Abyssal Sires(심연의 군주들)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: What can I do here?
translation: 여기서 제가 할 수 있는 일이 있나요?

english: I'll be off for now.
What's this stuff for?
No, sorry.
Thank you.
Perhaps I shall use it to slay you, demon.
translation: 어쩌면 이걸로 널 베어 버릴지도 모르지, 악마.

english: Hello mortal. What do you seek?
What changes have been made for this League?
Much has happened since the last passage of the Trailblazers. This time, I have awakened the wrathful spirits of enemies across Gielinor.
translation: 지난 Trailblazer(트레일블레이저)들이 지나간 뒤로 많은 일이 있었지. 이번에는 내가 Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 있는 적들의 분노한 영혼을 깨워 두었네.

english: Each region now contains a Raging Echo boss. These bosses are more powerful versions of their original self that drop unique rewards.
translation: 이제 각 지역마다 Raging Echo(레이징 에코) 보스가 하나씩 있네. 원래 모습보다 훨씬 강해진 녀석들인데, 고유한 보상을 떨어뜨리지.

english: To help you overcome these new challenges, you may now gain power through Combat Masteries, which you can obtain access to by completing the Combat Mastery tasks.
translation: 이 새로운 시련을 이겨 내도록, 이제 Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)으로 힘을 얻을 수 있네. 전투 숙련 과제를 완료하면 쓸 수 있게 되지.

english: As before, you'll initially be restricted to the Regions of Misthalin and Karamja. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: 전과 마찬가지로 처음에는 Misthalin(미스탈린)과 Karamja(카람자) 지역에만 갈 수 있네. 하지만 진행할수록 원하는 새 지역을 해금할 수 있지.

english: Be warned though - you won't be able to unlock every area, so choose wisely.
translation: 다만 명심하게. 모든 지역을 해금할 수는 없으니 신중히 고르게.

english: You must participate as an Ironman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 자네는 Ironman(아이언맨)으로 참가해야 하네. 홀로 서야 하며 다른 참가자와 거래할 수 없다는 뜻이지.

english: And that's not all. Training skills during the League will grant you substantially more experience than you'd normally expect.
translation: 그게 다가 아닐세. 리그 동안 스킬을 수련하면 평소에 기대하던 것보다 훨씬 많은 경험치를 얻게 될 걸세.

english: These experience increases are known as passive effects, which get more generous the higher your Relic tier.
translation: 이렇게 늘어나는 경험치를 패시브 효과라 부르는데, Relic(유물) 등급이 높을수록 더 후해지지.

english: Finally, some quests have been completed for you automatically. Further quests and more will be completed as you unlock the relevant areas.
translation: 마지막으로, 몇몇 퀘스트는 자동으로 완료해 두었네. 관련 지역을 해금하면 더 많은 퀘스트와 그 밖의 것들이 완료될 걸세.

english: I think that covers the basics. Would you like to know more, [player name]?
translation: 기본은 이 정도면 된 것 같군. 더 알고 싶은가, [player name]?

english: Yes, please.
Not right now.
Is there anything else you need from me?
Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: Combat Masteries are powerful boons granted by me that enhance your combat abilities for the entire League.
translation: Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)은 내가 내려 주는 강력한 은총으로, 리그 내내 자네의 전투 능력을 높여 주지.

english: After all, it wouldn't be very interesting to ask you to defeat the enemies' raging echoes without allowing you to draw on your own.
translation: 어쨌든 적들의 레이징 에코를 쓰러뜨리라고 하면서 자네 자신의 힘은 끌어 쓰지 못하게 한다면 별로 재미가 없지 않겠나.

english: You can obtain them by completing specific combat tasks to prove yourself to me.
translation: 특정 전투 과제를 완료해 내게 자네를 증명하면 얻을 수 있네.

english: Combat Masteries are split into the three combat styles: Ranged, Melee, and Mage. To unlock each mastery, you must have unlocked the previous mastery for that style.
translation: Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)은 세 가지 전투 방식, 즉 Ranged(원거리), Melee(근접), Mage(마법)으로 나뉘네. 각 숙련을 해금하려면 그 방식의 이전 숙련을 먼저 해금해야 하지.

english: There are 6 combat masteries for each style, but only 10 mastery points can be obtained. Once you have selected a mastery there is no going back, so choose your masteries wisely.
translation: 방식마다 combat masteries(전투 숙련)이 6개씩 있지만, 얻을 수 있는 숙련 점수는 10점뿐일세. 한번 고른 숙련은 되돌릴 수 없으니 신중히 고르게.

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the Combat Masteries available to you?
translation: 자, 자네가 고를 수 있는 Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)을 살펴보겠는가?

english: Fair enough. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 그렇다면 됐네. 내게 더 필요한 것이 있는가?

english: How do tasks work?
In every League, there are a number of tasks for you to complete. Each task has a level of difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 리그마다 자네가 완료할 과제가 여럿 있네. 과제마다 난이도가 있지. 쉬움, 보통, 어려움, 엘리트, 마스터일세.

english: Completing tasks allows you to access new areas. The more tasks you complete, the more areas become available to unlock.
translation: 과제를 완료하면 새 지역에 갈 수 있네. 과제를 많이 완료할수록 해금할 수 있는 지역도 늘어나지.

english: Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 그뿐만이 아닐세. 과제를 완료하면 League Points(리그 포인트)도 얻네. 얻는 포인트는 과제 난이도에 따라 다르지.

english: What do these points do?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic of mine. These are powerful artefacts to help you in this world.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)를 일정량 모으면 내 Relic(유물)을 새로 해금할 수 있네. 이 세계에서 자네를 도와줄 강력한 유물들이지.

english: League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)로 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 보상을 살 수도 있네.

english: So how many tasks are there?
More than you'll ever be able to complete, most likely. It's up to you which ones you attempt.
translation: 아마 자네가 평생 다 끝내지 못할 만큼 많을 걸세. 어떤 걸 해 볼지는 자네 마음이네.

english: Thanks!
Now, would you like to take a look at the tasks for this League?
How does the area system work?
Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Misthalin and the island of Karamja. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
