translation: 지금 자네는 Misthalin(미스탈린) 왕국과 Karamja(카람자) 섬에만 갈 수 있네. 하지만 진행할수록 더 많은 지역을 해금할 수 있지.

english: There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: 지역은 모두 열한 곳일세. 하지만 처음 받은 두 곳을 포함해 최대 다섯 곳까지만 해금할 수 있네. 신중히 고르게.

english: I give the first two area unlocks to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks I've set.
translation: 처음 두 지역은 모두에게 내가 열어 주네. 나머지 세 곳은 내가 정해 둔 과제를 완료해 해금할 수 있지.

english: The more tasks you complete, the more areas you can unlock.
translation: 과제를 많이 완료할수록 해금할 수 있는 지역도 늘어나네.

english: I see. Thanks!
Would you like to take a look at the available areas now?
translation: 지금 해금할 수 있는 지역을 살펴보겠는가?

english: What are Relics?
Relics are powerful artefacts made by me that grant unique abilities for the entire League.
translation: Relics(유물)은 내가 만든 강력한 물건으로, 리그 내내 고유한 능력을 내려 주지.

english: You may even recognise a few from Leagues past.
translation: 지난 리그에서 본 것도 몇 개 알아볼 걸세.

english: There are 23 separate Relics, split across 8 different tiers. You can only have one Relic from each tier, however.
translation: Relics(유물)은 모두 23개이고, 8개 등급으로 나뉘어 있네. 다만 등급마다 유물은 하나만 가질 수 있지.

english: The first Relic tier is available to everyone. The others must be unlocked with League Points.
translation: 첫 번째 Relic(유물) 등급은 모두가 쓸 수 있네. 나머지는 League Points(리그 포인트)로 해금해야 하지.

english: League Points are earned by completing tasks.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)는 과제를 완료하면 얻을 수 있네.

english: Once you have selected a Relic, your choice can't be changed for the rest of the League. Make your choices carefully.
translation: 한번 Relic(유물)을 고르면 리그가 끝날 때까지 바꿀 수 없네. 신중히 고르게.

english: Would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?
Very well. Is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 좋네. 내게 더 필요한 것이 있는가?

english: Can I claim some combat achievement rewards?
translation: 전투 업적 보상을 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You do not appear to have any combat achievement rewards available to claim.
translation: 자네가 받을 수 있는 전투 업적 보상은 없는 것 같군.

english: You don't have enough room.
You don't have enough gold.
There you go. Congratulations, even if it may have been accelerated with my power, it's still a real accomplishment.
translation: 여기 있네. 축하하네. 내 힘으로 조금 앞당겨졌을지는 몰라도, 진정한 업적임에는 변함이 없지.

english: I have some more questions.
Tell me about League rewards.
As well as letting you unlock new areas, completing tasks in the League will earn you League Points. The more League Points you have, the more Relic tiers you have available.
translation: 과제를 완료하면 새 지역을 해금할 수 있을 뿐 아니라 League Points(리그 포인트)도 얻네. 리그 포인트가 많을수록 쓸 수 있는 Relic(유물) 등급도 늘어나지.

english: However, alongside allowing you to unlock Relics, League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 하지만 League Points(리그 포인트)는 Relics(유물)을 해금하는 데만 쓰이는 게 아니라, Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 보상을 사는 데도 쓸 수 있네.

english: What rewards can I buy?
Oh, all sorts of things. New cosmetic kits, an alternative Home Teleport animation, some rather stylish outfits... and much more.
translation: 오, 온갖 것이 다 있지. 새 꾸미기 키트, Home Teleport(홈 텔레포트)의 다른 애니메이션, 꽤 멋들어진 의상들... 그 밖에도 많네.

english: Many of these rewards can be traded with your fellow mortals, so if you wish, you can earn some money by selling them on. Of course, you might prefer to keep them for yourself instead.
translation: 이 보상들 가운데 상당수는 동료 필멸자들과 거래할 수 있으니, 원한다면 되팔아 돈을 벌 수도 있네. 물론 자네가 간직하는 쪽을 택할 수도 있지.

english: I see. That all sounds good to me.
You can use this shop to buy previous League rewards, too.
translation: 이 상점에서 지난 리그의 보상도 살 수 있네.

english: Alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)의 보상과 더불어, League Ranks(리그 등급)이라는 것도 있네.

english: League Ranks? How do they work?
translation: League Ranks(리그 등급)이요? 그건 어떻게 돌아가요?

english: During the League as you gain more points you will gain a League Rank. This rank can be seen in the Ranks interface.
translation: 리그 동안 포인트를 더 모을수록 League Rank(리그 등급)을 얻게 되네. 이 등급은 등급 화면에서 볼 수 있지.

english: You currently have the rank: [rank].
As you get ranks you will gain access to trophies.
translation: 등급을 얻으면 트로피를 받을 수 있게 되네.

english: Trophies?
That's right. Trophies are items that are awarded to you for competing in the League. You can use them to show off your League Rank.
translation: 그렇다네. 트로피는 리그에 참가한 대가로 주어지는 아이템일세. 자네의 League Rank(리그 등급)을 뽐내는 데 쓸 수 있지.

english: Connected to League Ranks are the League to League rewards. These are unlocked in the next League based upon the League Rank you earn in this one.
translation: League Ranks(리그 등급)과 이어진 것으로 리그 간 보상이 있네. 이번 리그에서 얻은 리그 등급에 따라 다음 리그에서 해금되는 보상이지.

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. In addition, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 다음 리그를 위해 해금할 수 있는 것으로는 리그 시작 의상과 리그 아이콘 등이 있네. 게다가 이번 리그에서 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 넘어가지.

english: Finally, on top of the tasks for this League, there are some other activities for which I will recognise the first person who completes them.
translation: 마지막으로, 이번 리그의 과제와 별도로 몇 가지 활동이 있는데, 그걸 가장 먼저 완료한 이는 내가 따로 기려 주겠네.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, by reading the board beside me.
translation: 내 옆에 있는 게시판을 읽으면 활동 전체 목록과 누가 이미 완료했는지 볼 수 있네.

english: My pleasure. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 천만에. 자, 내게 더 필요한 것이 있는가?

english: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?
translation: 리그에서 펫은 어떻게 되는지 알려 주실래요?

english: But of course. If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 물론이지. 운 좋게 리그 중에 펫을 얻으면 자동으로 보험에 들게 되네.

english: This means that if you lose it somehow you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free of charge.
translation: 어떻게든 펫을 잃어버리면 내게 말을 걸게. 다시 돌려주겠네. 보험도 되찾기도 전부 무료일세.

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. I'll take good care of it until you're ready to reclaim it.
translation: 게다가 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 넘어가네. 자네가 되찾을 준비가 될 때까지 내가 잘 돌봐 주지.

english: Okay! Thank you.
Come back to me once you have some pets and you can view your collection. Now, is there anything else you need from me?
translation: 펫을 얻으면 다시 찾아오게. 수집품을 볼 수 있을 걸세. 자, 내게 더 필요한 것이 있는가?

english: Do I have any League items to collect?
You receive some items from the Sage.
translation: the Sage(현자)에게서 아이템을 몇 개 받았다.

english: Can you help me smash vials?
translation: 약병 깨는 걸 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will now automatically smash vials.
translation: 내 모든 힘을 다하면 그 정도는 해낼 수 있지. 이제부터 약병이 자동으로 깨질 걸세.

english: With all of my power, this is something I can manage. You will no longer smash vials automatically.
translation: 내 모든 힘을 다하면 그 정도는 해낼 수 있지. 이제 약병이 자동으로 깨지지 않을 걸세.

english: Let's circle back.
I'm good, thanks.
Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything more.
translation: 좋네. 더 알고 싶은 것이 생기면 언제든 나는 여기 있겠네.

english: Oh my, that's a rare thing you've got there.
I guess you'll be wanting to trade it in for one of Gielinor's powerful weapons.
translation: 그걸 Gielinor(길리노르)의 강력한 무기 하나와 바꾸고 싶은 모양이로군.

english: Enjoy.
You cannot do that in this world, you must abide by my rules, mortal.
translation: 이 세계에서는 그럴 수 없네. 내 규칙을 따라야 하네, 필멸자여.

english: What changes have been made for this League?
Yes, please.
Not right now.
Can you tell me about Combat Masteries?
translation: Combat Masteries(전투 숙련)에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: How do tasks work?
How does the area system work?
More options...
What are Relics?
Yes.
No.
Can I claim some Combat rewards?
Could I buy a max cape off you?
translation: max cape(맥스 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: I have some more questions.
Tell me about League rewards.
Let's talk about pets.
Do I have any League items to collect?
Can you help me smash vials?
translation: 약병 깨는 걸 도와주실 수 있어요?

english: Let's circle back.
I'm good, thanks.
Previous options...
Twisted Bow
No, I've changed my mind.
Yes, I want Twisted bow
Scythe of Vitur
Yes, I want Scythe of vitur (uncharged)
translation: 네, Scythe of vitur (uncharged)(비투르의 낫 (미충전))을 원해요

english: Tumeken's shadow
Yes, I want Tumeken's shadow (uncharged)
Greetings, how may I be of service.
Who are you? What is your name?
Who am I?
I am whatever is needed of me.
translation: 나는 필요한 것이라면 무엇이든 될 수 있는 존재일세.

english: I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
translation: 나는 자연의 법칙으로는 정의되지 않는 형체, 입에 올려서는 안 될 누군가가 빚어낸 존재지.

english: I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
translation: 나는 조각가가 빚은 점토 인형일세. 굳는 것이 허락되지 않아 영원히 모양이 바뀌지. 하지만 어쩌면, 그것도 오래가지 않을지도...

english: My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
translation: 내 진짜 이름은 중요하지 않네. 하지만 나를 이렇게 불러도 좋네...

english: Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
Ah, yes.
You may call me The Sage.
Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?
translation: 어, 네... Sage(현자)님. 저희를 어디로 데려오신 거예요?

english: 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
translation: '어디'라는 건 올바른 질문일세, 친구여. 다만 자네가 익숙하게 듣던 뜻과는 조금 다를지도 모르지.

english: Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
translation: 자네가 아는 현실에는 여러 겹이 있네. 겹마다 조금씩 다르고 저마다의 규칙이 있지.

english: Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
translation: 내게 주어진 힘으로 River-Between(사이의 강)을 건너 우리를 이 겹으로 데려왔네. 바로 River of Souls(영혼의 강)일세.

english: We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!
translation: 우리는 지금 아직 펼쳐지지 않은, 자네 생애 가장 흥미진진할 공연의 무대 위에 서 있네!

english: Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?
translation: 겹이요? River-Between(사이의 강)이요? 그게 다 무슨 뜻이에요?

english: To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
translation: 지금 이 순간에도 누군가 지켜보고 있으니 여기서 전부 털어놓는 건 현명하지 못하지. 자네는 딱 한 가지만 신경 쓰면 되네.

english: Being entertaining.
That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...
translation: 그것만이 이 행사에서 살아 나갈 유일한 길일세...

english: Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!
translation: 즐거움이요? 무슨 말씀이세요? 제가 누구를 즐겁게 한다는 거예요? 수수께끼 같은 말 좀 그만하세요!

english: Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
translation: 아, [player name], 부디 용서하게. 설명하려다 오히려 자네를 더 헷갈리게 한 모양이군...

english: I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
translation: 간단히 말해 주지. 이 행사에 참가하면 자네는 계속 존재할 걸세. 참가를 거부하면 결국 파멸을 맞게 되지.

english: The choice is yours... hero.
Well, that doesn't really answer anything...
translation: 음, 그건 아무 대답도 안 되는데요...

english: Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...
translation: 걱정 말게. 자네를 위한 훨씬 원대한 계획이 아직 남아 있으니. 하지만 모든 좋은 이야기가 그렇듯, 알맞은 때와 장소를 기다려야 하지...

english: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: 다른 리그를 말씀하셨는데, 이번엔 그거랑 뭐가 달라요?

english: Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
translation: 이전의 모든 행사처럼, 지켜보는 이들이 더 즐길 수 있도록 세상의 규칙을 바꿔 두었네.

english: The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
translation: 가장 큰 변화는 지난 장의 Relics(유물)일세.

english: These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
translation: 그 힘의 물건들은 이제 사라졌네. 내가 그것들을 Fragments(파편)으로 부숴 이 세계의 이번 판본 곳곳에 흩뿌려 두었지.

english: When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.
translation: 여러 Fragments(파편)이 조화를 이루면 함께 써서 강력한 효과를 낼 수 있네.

english: Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
translation: 네, 배를 타고 올 때 그걸 깨뜨리시던 게 기억나요.

english: So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?
translation: 그러니까 Fragments(파편)을 모아야 한다는 거군요... 알겠어요. 제가 알아야 할 또 다른 이상한 규칙은 없나요?

english: I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
translation: 듣자 하니 지난 리그에서는 자네 세계의 좁은 공간에만 묶여 있었다지.

english: That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
translation: 자네는 자유롭게 세상을 누빌 수 있네. Morytania(모리타니아)에서 Kourend(쿠렌드)와 Kebos(케보스)까지, 가장 먼 곳까지 탐험할 수 있지.

english: But there's a catch.
Oh great... there's always a catch.
I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
translation: 자네의 기억 일부를 제한하고 초기화해 두었네. 그래서 이 세계의 어떤 요소들과는 상호작용할 수 없을 걸세.

english: For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
translation: 예를 들어, 자네가 쓸 수 있는 스킬은 Defence(방어), Fishing(낚시), Thieving(도둑질) 세 가지와 앞서 고른 전투 직업뿐일세.

english: In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
translation: 다른 스킬을 쓰려면 내 과제를 완료해야 하네.

english: Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
translation: 그러면 Sage's Renown(현자의 명성)을 얻게 되지. 꽤 어울리는 이름이라고 생각했네.

english: With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.
translation: 명성으로 새 스킬은 물론 보스와 퀘스트도 해금할 수 있네.

english: Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?
translation: 왜 이런 일을 하시는 거예요? 제가 모든 힘을 한꺼번에 가지면 더 '즐거울' 텐데요?

english: I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
translation: 자네에게 그 힘을 다 줄 수는 없네. 원하는 힘을 전부 가진 채로 시작하는 영웅 이야기가 어디 있겠나?

english: No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
translation: 아니지, 자네 이야기에는 좋은 리듬이 필요하네. 관객이 흥미를 느낄 만한 일종의 박자 말일세.

english: Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
translation: 천천히 시작해 차근차근 올라가게. 그리고 본디 자네 운명이었던 영웅이 되는 걸세...

english: Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
translation: 자네가 스스로를 증명하고 나면, 그때야 비로소 내 명성을 얻게 될 걸세.

english: That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
translation: 그것이 바로 좋은 볼거리를 선사하는 법일세, 친구여...

english: That's how you make a hero.
I suppose you're right...
Do you desire more information?
Go forward and continue your journey.
Remember, we are always watching...
Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: '즐거움을 주는' 요령 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
translation: 자네 이야기가 제 궤도를 벗어나지 않도록 과제를 여럿 마련해 두었네.

english: Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
translation: 과제마다 난이도가 있지. 입문, 쉬움, 보통, 어려움, 엘리트, 마스터일세.

english: The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
translation: 과제를 많이 완료할수록 해금할 수 있는 활동도 늘어나네.

english: The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
translation: 해금한 콘텐츠가 많을수록 자네 이야기도 더 흥미로워지지.

english: The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
translation: 이야기가 흥미로울수록 지켜보는 이들도 더 즐거워할 걸세.

english: What do I use these 'points' on?
Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)를 일정량 모으면 새 Fragment Slot(파편 슬롯)을 해금할 수 있네.

english: These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
translation: 슬롯이 늘면 Fragments(파편)을 더 많이 장착해 더욱 강해질 수 있지.

english: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
translation: 지금 자네는 리그 프로필로 플레이하고 있네. Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)은 기본 프로필에서만 열 수 있지.

english: You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 아무 일반 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 월드로 옮기면 기본 프로필에 접속할 수 있네. 로그아웃 메뉴의 월드 전환기로 월드를 옮길 수 있지.

english: More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
translation: 여기 머물 시간이 한정되어 있으니, 아마 자네가 다 끝내지 못할 만큼 많을 걸세.

english: With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...
translation: 고를 것이 이렇게나 많으니, 자네 이야기가 어떻게 흘러갈지는 자네가 정하게...

english: Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.
translation: 음... 이제 뭘 해야 할지 알 것 같아요.

english: Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.
translation: 아주 좋네. 자네를 이번 장으로 데려온 건 역시 옳은 선택이었군.

english: What is a Fragment?
You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
translation: 지난 행사의 Relics(유물)을 기억하겠지? 놀라운 위업을 이루게 해 준 거대한 힘의 원천 말일세.

english: Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
translation: Fragments(파편)도 비슷하네. Relics(유물)에서 만들어졌으니 그 힘이 상당 부분 남아 있지만, 훨씬 약해진 형태일세.

english: They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
translation: Fragments(파편)은 여러 가지 이점을 주네. 나무 베기를 돕는 것부터 자네를 더 무시무시한 전사로 만드는 것까지 말일세.

english: Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
translation: Fragments(파편)을 장착하면 그 힘을 얻을 수 있네.

english: You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
translation: Fragments(파편)의 레벨을 올릴 수도 있네. 그러면 '더욱' 강력해지지.

english: Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.
translation: 평소처럼 경험치를 얻으면 Fragments(파편)의 레벨이 오르고, 한층 더 쓸모 있어질 걸세.

english: How do I find these Fragments?
I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
translation: Fragments(파편)은 내가 세계 곳곳에 고르게 흩뿌려 두었네.

english: Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
translation: 몬스터를 처치하거나 특정 스킬의 경험치를 얻을 때마다 Fragment(파편)을 받을 기회가 생기네.

english: The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
translation: 몇몇 예외를 빼면 그 활동과 관련된 Fragments(파편)만 받을 수 있네.

english: I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.
translation: 자네 같은 이들이 보물 찾기를 즐긴다는 건 알고 있네. Treasure Trails(보물 찾기)와 관련된 Fragments(파편)은 어디서든 나올 수 있지.

english: What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?
translation: Fragments(파편)을 다시 맞추려고 하면 어떻게 돼요?

english: As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
translation: 말했다시피, Fragments(파편)에는 아직 Relic(유물)의 기운이 일부 남아 있네.

english: When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
translation: Fragments(파편)이 충분히 다시 모이면 온전했을 때와 같은 기운을 내뿜을 걸세.

english: For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
translation: 예를 들어, Last Recall(라스트 리콜)이 깃든 Fragments(파편) 다섯 개를 찾으면 세트를 완성해 그 Relic(유물)의 온전한 힘을 쓸 수 있네.

english: A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
Is there anything else you wish to know?
How does the content unlock system work?
In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
translation: 이번 행사에서는 처음에 자네를 Thieving(도둑질), Fishing(낚시), Defence(방어) 세 가지 스킬로 제한해 두었네.

english: You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
translation: 나무를 베거나 광석을 캐는 것 같은 간단한 일은 여전히 할 수 있지만, 경험치를 얻을 수 없으니 헛수고일세.

english: In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
translation: 그런 스킬에서 경험치를 얻으려면 내 명성을 써서 해금해야 하네.

english: You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
translation: 명성은 즐거움을 주는 것, 즉 과제를 완료하는 것으로 얻네. 얻는 명성의 양은 과제 난이도에 따라 다르지.

english: When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
translation: 유난히 강한 존재들은 싸울 수 있는 능력을 해금해야 하네. 해금 화면을 열면 잠긴 존재를 모두 볼 수 있지.

english: One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.
translation: 마지막으로 자네가 관심 가질 만한 정보 한 조각일세. 듣자 하니 지난 리그에서는 어떤 '퀘스트'들을 처음부터 끝까지 완료해야 했다지.

english: If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaatI will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
translation: 원한다면 Sage's Renown(현자의 명성)을 써서 그런 퀘스트를 건너뛰면서도 최종 보상은 받을 수 있네. 하지만 명심하게. 자네가 스스로 그 퀘스트를 끝내면 나는 아무 선물도 주지 않을 걸세.

english: You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
translation: 또한 Sage's Renown(현자의 명성)으로 퀘스트를 완료하면, 직접 끝냈을 때처럼 최종 경험치를 얻지는 못한다는 것도 알아 두게.

english: Is there anything else you wish to know.
How did I get here again?
I can retell the story, if you wish me to.
League Intro cutscene replays.
So be it.
Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
translation: 진행하면서 League Points(리그 포인트)를 얻게 되네. 그걸로 새 슬롯을 해금해 Fragments(파편)을 더 많이 장착할 수 있지.

english: However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
translation: 그리고 이 세계에서 우리의 시간이 끝나면, League Points(리그 포인트)로 Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)에서 보상을 살 수 있네.

english: Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...
translation: 물론, 참가에 대한 진짜 보상은 행사가 끝났을 때 나와 내 주인께서 자네 목숨을 살려 주는 것이겠지만...

english: Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?
translation: 이 행사에서 받을 수 있는 다른 보상은 없나요?

english: I see...
In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
translation: River of Souls(영혼의 강)에서 지내며 알게 된 것인데, 장이 끝날 때 그 붕괴가... 불완전할 때가 있더군.

english: Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
translation: 그래서 어떤 물건들은 말하자면 틈새로 빠져나가기도 하지.

english: In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
translation: 사실 내가 지난 장의 붕괴에서 자네를 구해 낸 것도 바로 그런 틈 가운데 하나를 통해서였네.

english: I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
translation: 나는 다른 세계에서 잃어버린 물건들을 모아 곁에 두고 있네. 언젠가 필요할지도 모르니 말일세.

english: I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
translation: 이번 행사에서 자네 역할을 다해 준 대가로 기꺼이 그것들을 내어 주겠네.

english: The first item is a powerful whip.
It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
translation: 수천의 길 잃은 영혼의 기운이 깃들어 있지. 그들은 쇠사슬에 묶인 채 영원히 갇혀 있네.

english: Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
translation: 채찍을 휘두를 때마다 그 안에 갇힌 희생자들의 비명이 귀를 찢는 울부짖음이 되어 터져 나오지...

english: The next item is a cannon.
It's poweeredby channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
translation: 모아들인 비전의 기운으로 움직이는데, 폭발 하나하나가 경계 차원에서 포신 안으로 순간이동해 오지.

english: Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
translation: 알려지지 않은 힘으로 파편을 쏘아 내어, 살점이고 영혼이고 가리지 않고 찢어발기네.

english: There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.
translation: 물론 다른 것들도 있네. 이 보상들은 자네 세계의 다른 이들과 자유롭게 거래해도 되고, 간직해도 되네. 나는 상관없네.

english: You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.
translation: 아무 일반 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 월드로 옮기면 기본 프로필에 접속할 수 있네. 로그아웃 메뉴의 월드 전환기로 월드를 옮길 수 있지.

english: And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
translation: 그리고 영웅이여, 조심하게. Shattered Relic(산산조각 난 유물) 보상은 리그가 끝나야 살 수 있네. 다만 지난 리그의 보상은 지금도 살 수 있지.

english: Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.
translation: 자, Leagues Reward Shop(리그 보상 상점)의 보상과 더불어, League Ranks(리그 등급)이라는 것도 있네.

english: At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
translation: 리그가 끝나면 자네는 평가를 받고 등급을 받게 되네. 다른 참가자들과 비교해 얼마나 많은 League Points(리그 포인트)를 얻었는지에 따라 정해지지.

english: Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
translation: League Points(리그 포인트)를 100점 이상 얻은 사람은 누구나 Bronze(청동) 등급을 받을 수 있네. 상위 80% 참가자는 Iron(철) 등급, 상위 60%는 Steel(강철) 등급을 받지.

english: The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
translation: 상위 40%는 Mithril(미스릴), 상위 20%는 Adamant(아다만트), 상위 5%는 Rune(룬) 등급일세. 그리고 상위 1%에 드는 최고의 참가자는 Dragon(드래곤) 등급을 받네!

english: When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
translation: 리그가 끝나면 등급에 따라 트로피를 받게 되네. 이 트로피는 리그에서 자네가 거둔 성과를 상징하지.

english: You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
translation: League Rank(리그 등급)에 따라 리그 간 보상도 받게 될 걸세.

english: League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
translation: 다음 리그를 위해 해금할 수 있는 것으로는 리그 시작 의상과 리그 아이콘 등이 있네. 또한 이번 리그에서 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 넘어가지.

english: Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
translation: 마지막으로, 특정 활동을 가장 먼저 완료한 영웅들은 내가 기려 줄 생각이네.

english: You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.
translation: 내 옆에 있는 게시판에서 활동 전체 목록과 누가 이미 완료했는지 볼 수 있네.

english: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
translation: 물론이지! 운 좋게 리그 중에 펫을 얻으면 자동으로 보험에 들게 되네.

english: This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
translation: 혹시라도 펫을 잃어버리면 내게 말을 걸게. 다시 돌려주겠네. 보험도 되찾기도 전부 무료일세!

english: Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!
translation: 게다가 얻은 펫은 모두 다음 리그로 넘어가네. 자네가 되찾으러 올 때까지 내 곁에서 기다리고 있을 걸세!

english: Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?
translation: 펫을 얻으면 다시 찾아오게. 수집품을 볼 수 있을 걸세. 더 알고 싶은 것이 있는가?

english: Do I have any items to collect?
It doesn't look like you need any League items right now. I'll be here if you ever do.
translation: 지금은 자네에게 필요한 리그 아이템이 없는 것 같군. 필요해지면 언제든 나는 여기 있겠네.

english: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
translation: 좋네. 리그에 대해 더 알고 싶은 것이 생기면 언제든 나는 여기 있겠네.

english: Who are you? What is your name?
You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?
translation: 다른 리그를 말씀하셨는데, 이번엔 그거랑 뭐가 달라요?

english: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?
translation: '즐거움을 주는' 요령 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: What are Fragments?
How does the content unlock system work?
How did I get here again?
Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?
Repeat options...
Much has changed since the world was shattered. This time, I thought I'd turn the clock back and allow you to Trailblaze once more.
translation: 세상이 산산조각 난 뒤로 많은 것이 바뀌었네. 이번에는 시계를 되돌려 자네가 다시 한번 트레일블레이저로서 길을 개척할 수 있게 해 주려 하네.

english: You must participate as an Iron Man. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 자네는 Iron Man(아이언맨)으로 참가해야 하네. 홀로 서야 하며 다른 참가자와 거래할 수 없다는 뜻이지.

english: There are ten different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you've started with. Choose wisely.
translation: 지역은 모두 열 곳이 있네. 하지만 처음 시작한 두 곳을 포함해 최대 다섯 곳까지만 해금할 수 있지. 신중하게 고르게.

english: Oh, how have you been getting on?
I've completed some more Combat Achievement tasks!
I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?
translation: 그런 것 같군. 잘했네. 중급 보상을 받으러 온 거겠지?

english: Yes please!

There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens
translation: 자, 여기 있네. 우리 고대 검 자루 중 비교적 소박한 것을 하나 주었네. 또한 중급 단서를 더 쉽게 얻을 수 있고, 보스 Slayer(슬레이어) 과제를 받을 때 제시되는 최대 수량이 늘어나고,

english: from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
translation: Warrior guild(전사 길드)에서 보너스 토큰을, Pest Control(페스트 컨트롤) 게임마다 공적 점수 2점을 추가로 받게 되네. 게다가 Barrows(배로우즈)에서 내 검 자루를 장착하면 기도 점수가 소모되지 않고,

english: your Dwarf multicannon can hold five extra cannonballs.
translation: Dwarf multicannon(드워프 멀티캐논)에 대포알을 다섯 개 더 넣을 수 있다네.

english: Thank you so much!
Can I claim any league trophies I may of earned from this league?
translation: 이번 리그에서 얻었을지도 모르는 리그 트로피를 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Would you like to look at the rewards shop?
You currently have the rank: Unranked.
I can give you [number] League [item/items] once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 소지품 공간을 좀 비우면 리그 [item/items] [number]개를 주겠네.

english: Can I claim some trophies?
A cock-a-doodle hello to you! Caw!
Excuse me?
I speak for Clarence, and he bids you good day.
translation: 저는 Clarence(클래런스)를 대변하고 있어요. 그가 당신께 인사를 전하네요.

english: Clarence?
The rooster you see before you.
translation: 지금 당신 앞에 있는 수탉 말이에요.

english: You speak for him?
I speak for him, he speaks through me, I speak through her. It is not important.
translation: 저는 그를 대변하고, 그는 저를 통해 말하고, 저는 이 여자를 통해 말하죠. 중요한 건 아니에요.

english: So I'm talking to you?
translation: 그럼 저는 당신이랑 얘기하고 있는 거예요?

english: Yes, you are talking to me.
Which me is that? You or the other one?
translation: 그 '저'가 누군데요? 당신이요, 아니면 다른 쪽이요?

english: Now I'm lost. Who am I?
You're you and I'm me.
I'm me?
This is too confusing, I'll see you later.
Who? Me?
Both of you.
Hello, I'm looking for a special egg, I don't suppose you could give me one?
translation: 안녕하세요, 특별한 알을 찾고 있는데요, 혹시 하나 주실 수 있나요?

english: A special egg? All eggs are special.
translation: 특별한 알이요? 세상에 특별하지 않은 알은 없답니다.

english: Yes I know that, but I need a particularly special egg.
translation: 네, 그건 아는데요, 특별히 더 특별한 알이 필요해요.

english: Do you have one of those?
One moment, we shall produce one.
But you're a... Rooster? And... A lady?
Rooster and lady yes this is true. But there is more than one way to make an egg.
translation: 수탉이고 숙녀인 건 맞아요. 하지만 알을 만드는 방법이 하나만 있는 건 아니죠.

english: Unfortunately I don't have space to carry around your questionable egg at the moment.
translation: 안타깝지만 지금은 그 수상한 알을 들고 다닐 공간이 없네요.

english: Suit yourself!
There you go! Produced from my pocket, you see.
Well that's a relief. Thanks.
Thanks again for the egg.
You are welcome! Cluck!
Hello again Clarence.
Oh and uh, hello your mouthiness.
translation: 아, 그리고 어, 안녕하세요, 입 전하.

english: What can two do for you?
I need another special egg.
You don't have enough space for one of my special eggs. Come back when you do.
translation: 제 특별한 알을 받을 공간이 없네요. 공간이 생기면 다시 오세요.

english: Okay then, thanks anyway.
There you go! Use it wisely!
Thanks.
Ah, hello again, special egg person.
translation: 아, 또 오셨네요, 특별한 알 손님.

english: Hello.
We, that is to say, I, have decided, that you will receive no more special eggs.
translation: 저희는, 그러니까, 제가, 결정했어요. 당신에게 더는 특별한 알을 주지 않기로요.

english: Oh, well I don't actually need any more, so that's fine.
translation: 아, 사실 더 필요 없어서 괜찮아요.

english: Oh, you aren't devastated? Tormented by this great denial of eggs?
translation: 어머, 절망하지 않으시나요? 이 엄청난 알 거절에 괴로워하지도 않고요?

english: Not really.
Curses!
And you're welcome! Cluck.
Do you want to buy any fine clothes?
Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your scythe back?
translation: 고급 옷을 좀 사시겠어요? 아니면 scythe(큰 낫)을 돌려받으시겠어요?

english: Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your bunny ears back?
translation: 고급 옷을 좀 사시겠어요? 아니면 bunny ears(토끼 귀)를 돌려받으시겠어요?

english: Do you want to buy any fine clothes? Or would you like your scythe or bunny ears back?
translation: 고급 옷을 좀 사시겠어요? 아니면 scythe(큰 낫)이나 bunny ears(토끼 귀)를 돌려받으시겠어요?

english: What have you got?
Well, I have a number of fine pieces of clothing on sale or, if you prefer, I can offer you an exclusive, total- clothing makeover?
translation: 음, 판매 중인 고급 의류가 여럿 있고요, 원하시면 특별한 전신 의상 변신 서비스도 해 드릴 수 있는데, 어떠세요?

english: Tell me more about this makeover.
translation: 그 변신 서비스에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Certainly!
Here at Thessalia's fine clothing boutique, we offer a unique service where we will totally revamp your outfit to your choosing.
translation: 이곳 Thessalia(테살리아)의 고급 의상실에서는 원하시는 대로 옷차림을 완전히 바꿔 드리는 특별한 서비스를 제공해요.

english: It's on the house, completely free! Tired of always wearing the same old outfit, day in, day out? This is the service for you!
translation: 완전 무료예요! 매일같이 똑같은 옷만 입는 데 질리셨나요? 그렇다면 바로 이 서비스예요!

english: So what do you say? Interested? We can change either your top or your legwear!
translation: 그래서 어떠세요? 관심 있으세요? 상의나 하의 중 하나를 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요!

english: Just select what style and colour you would like from this catalogue.
translation: 이 카탈로그에서 원하시는 스타일과 색을 고르기만 하세요.

english: Wow! Good choice! You're looking great!
translation: 와! 탁월한 선택이에요! 정말 멋져 보여요!

english: Totally cool! That outfit looks great!
translation: 완전 끝내줘요! 그 옷 정말 멋져요!

english: Woah! Fabulous! You look absolutely great!
Very stylish! It really suits you!
WoooOOOooo! Hot stuff!
Fantastic! You should be a model!
No, thank you.
Well, please return if you change your mind.
I have a frog token...
That entitles you to a free costume! Do you want a frog mask, a royal tunic & leggings or a royal blouse & skirt? I've also got some lamps a strange blue chap gave me.
translation: 그걸로 의상 하나를 무료로 받을 수 있어요! frog mask(개구리 가면), 왕실 튜닉과 레깅스, 왕실 블라우스와 치마 중 어떤 걸 원하세요? 이상한 파란 남자가 준 등불도 몇 개 있어요.

english: A frog mask, please!
A royal tunic & leggings, please.
A royal blouse & skirt, please.
I'll take the reward lamp, thanks.
Maybe another time.
Can I have my scythe back?
translation: 제 scythe(큰 낫)을 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: Certainly. Here you go.
Would you like to buy any clothes?
Can I have my bunny ears back?
translation: 제 bunny ears(토끼 귀)를 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: Are you able to offer any other services?
translation: 다른 서비스도 해 주실 수 있나요?

english: That depends... we mostly just sell clothes. What did you have in mind?
translation: 경우에 따라 다르죠... 주로 옷만 팔거든요. 뭘 생각하고 계신데요?

english: I'm looking for some new shoes.
Hmm... It's not something I would normally sell, but I might be able to help you out.
translation: 흠... 평소에 파는 물건은 아니지만, 도와드릴 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: It's free to change your shoes here. You can choose a colour as well as a style, since I'm also stocking boots imported from elven lands.
translation: 여기서는 신발을 무료로 바꿀 수 있어요. 엘프 땅에서 들여온 부츠도 갖춰 놓았으니 스타일뿐 아니라 색도 고르실 수 있어요.

english: Just select the model you would like from this catalogue.
translation: 이 카탈로그에서 원하시는 모델을 고르기만 하세요.

english: Are you able to give me a haircut?
Hah! Yeah, let me just go and grab my barbering equipment!
translation: 하! 네네, 그럼 이발 도구나 가지러 다녀올게요!

english: Alrighty then.
Oh, you're serious? Well, I guess I'd sillyto turn down extra business. I think I have andold pair of fabric scissors around here somewhere...
translation: 어, 진심이세요? 뭐, 손님을 더 받을 기회를 마다하는 건 바보 같은 짓이겠죠. 여기 어딘가에 낡은 원단 가위가 있을 텐데...

english: I'm interested in changing my gender.
You're in a clothes store.
Could you at least try?
translation: 그래도 한번 해 봐 주실 수 없어요?

english: Well, a friend of mine did show me a spell once. I'll see if I can remember it, but I'm making no promises...
translation: 음, 친구가 예전에 주문을 하나 보여 준 적이 있긴 해요. 기억나는지 볼게요, 장담은 못 하지만요...

english: Actually, nevermind.
I have a frog token.
That entitles you to a free costume! Do you want a frog mask or a [prince/princess] outfit?
translation: 그걸로 의상 하나를 무료로 받을 수 있어요! frog mask(개구리 가면)과 [prince/princess] 의상 중 어떤 걸 원하세요?

english: There you go!
A frog [prince/princess] outfit, please!
What have you got?
Tell me more about this makeover.
translation: 그 변신 서비스에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: I'd like to change my top please.
I'd like to change my legwear please.
I'd just like to buy some clothes.
No, thank you.
I have a frog token...
A frog mask, please!
A royal tunic & leggings, please.
A royal blouse & skirt, please.
I'll take a lamp, thanks.
Maybe another time.
Can I have my scythe back?
translation: 제 scythe(큰 낫)을 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have my bunny ears back?
translation: 제 bunny ears(토끼 귀)를 돌려받을 수 있을까요?

english: I'm looking for some new shoes.
Are you able to give me a haircut?
Change my hairstyle.
Change my facial hair.
Cancel.
I'm interested in changing my gender.
Actually, nevermind.
A frog [prince/princess] outfit, please!
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 안녕하신가. 자격이 있어 보이는군. 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 안녕하신가! 자네가 최근에 지구과학 시험 세 개를 모두 마친 그 학생이지? 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 반갑네, [sir/madam]. 우리 일을 좀 거들어 주러 왔나?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 먼저 장비부터 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 공구 선반에 있지. 지구과학 시험에서 배운 걸 활용하게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 장화를 착용하고, 또

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔)을 갖고 있어야 하네.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 정말로 우리를 돕고 싶다면 발굴품 손질을 좀 해 주게. 거의 다 된 것들이라 세밀한 마무리만 하면 되네. 인부들이 가져오는 더미에서 발굴품을 하나 집어 들고, 저쪽에 빈 탁자가 있으니

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 거기서 손질하게. 흥미로운 걸 발견하면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 오, 그냥 무해한 순간이동 주문인 것 같네. 고고학 일을 안 할 때는 마법을 좀 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 더 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있네. 그 시절에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍구먼.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠...모든 징후로 보아 우리 동쪽 어딘가인 것 같은데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠네. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었는지도 모르지. 좀 더 자세히 살펴보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고 fire rune(화염 룬) 다섯 개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 하나로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거군요.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 그렇네, 바로 그거야. 잘했네, 젊은이. 도와줘서 고맙네.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 닦았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 오호! 정말 훌륭한 발견이군! 내 생각이 맞다면 이걸로 Dig Site(발굴지) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠어.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여길 보게, 도시 이름도 적혀 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! Saradominist(사라도민파)가 점령하던 시기의 것이 틀림없어. 정말 훌륭한 발견이야. 가져가서 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 이미 하나 보여 줬잖나. 그쪽이 상태가 더 좋았지. 저기 display case(진열장)에 있네. 이건 구석에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣으면 되네.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 정말 오래된 동전을 찾았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이건 아주 흥미롭군...동시에 혼란스럽기도 하고. 이 동전은 우리가 Digsite(발굴지)에서 발굴하고 있는 도시 Saranthium(사란시움)에 사실 훨씬, 훨씬 이전부터 Zamorak(자모락)의 추종자들이 살았다는 뜻이네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 그 당시 이 도시는 Senntisten(센티스텐)이라고 불렸지.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 이건 정말 놀라운 발견이네. Saradominist(사라도민파)가 장악하기 전에 Zarosian(자로스파)가 살았다는 다른 증거는 있지만, Zamorakian(자모락파) 세력도 어떤 전투에서

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 이곳을 이용한 것 같군. 어쨌든 이걸로 이 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 Zamorak(자모락)을 따르다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 따르게 된 시기를 대략 알 수 있겠어. display case(진열장) 44번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 display case(진열장) 44번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 이 부서질 듯한 낡은 장식품을 찾았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아... 제단 장식품 같군. 흠, 그래...보아하니 초기 Saradominist(사라도민파) 신도들의 것이군. 꽤 섬세하기도 하고. display case(진열장) 37번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 display case(진열장) 37번에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 정말 오래된 장식품을 찾았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않나? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이군. 틀림없이 Saradominist(사라도민파) 도시의 것이야. display case(진열장) 36번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 display case(진열장) 36번에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 도자기 조각을 찾았는데요, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by
translation: 아... 오! 흠...그래...보아하니 Zaros(자로스) 숭배자들이 만든 것이군. 모양이 아름다워. display case(진열장) 22번에 잘 어울리겠군. 이 조각은 이 도시에

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: Saradominist(사라도민파)보다 먼저 Zarosian(자로스파)가 살았다는 우리 증거를 뒷받침해 주네.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? 도자기는 display case(진열장) 22번에 넣었나?

english: I found these old arrowheads.
Ahh, yes, we find lots of those - they're not important. We already have some in our display. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오지. 중요한 건 아니네. 전시품에도 이미 몇 개 있고. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: If there is anything already in the crate, feel free to take it as a reward for your work.
translation: 상자에 이미 뭔가 들어 있으면, 수고한 보상으로 마음껏 가져가게.

english: Oh, okay.
Take a look at this...
I found these old necklaces.
An interesting find... Here, let me offer you something in return.
translation: 흥미로운 발견이군... 자, 보답으로 뭔가 주겠네.

english: Oh! Okay.
I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병이라... 몇 개나 찾았는지 셀 수도 없네... 완전히 멀쩡한 건 이미 display case(진열장)에 하나 있지. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: Right.
Err... I seem to have lost it. Sorry.
Sounds like you never had it, [lad/lass]!
No, just here to watch.
Thank you, but I don't need that
Yes, how can I help out?
I found something interesting.
No thanks.
Another lovely day in this dung heap.
Watch yourself, I don't trust you.
The thieves down here are just small time. The real thieves are the ones who rule.
translation: 여기 도둑들은 다 좀도둑일 뿐이야. 진짜 도둑은 위에서 다스리는 놈들이지.

english: We're all liars here.
Ain't no honour down here. Never assume otherwise.
translation: 여기엔 명예 따윈 없어. 절대 착각하지 마.

english: I made a good score the other day.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 다양해요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시의 오늘 하루, 참 근사하죠, 그쵸?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 것들이요! 탑들이 정말 볼 만하답니다.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날에는 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
Nothing.
If you're looking for dynamite, you've come to the right place, human.
Who are you?
The name's Thirus Urkar. The Urkars have supplied the blast mines with the finest dynamite since they opened many ages ago.
translation: 내 이름은 Thirus Urkar(티루스 우르카르)예요. 우리 Urkar(우르카르) 가문은 아주 오래전 폭파 광산이 문을 연 이래로 최고급 다이너마이트를 공급해 왔죠.

english: Now, can I help you today?
I'd like to buy some dynamite.
Sorry, human, I'm afraid you need more of a reputation in Lovakengj before I can sell you anything.
translation: 미안하지만, 인간, 뭘 팔아 드리려면 먼저 Lovakengj(로바켕기)에서 평판을 좀 더 쌓고 와야 해요.

english: You do not have enough Lovakengj favour. Current favour: [0.0-14.9]% - Required: 15.0%
translation: Lovakengj(로바켕기) 호감도가 부족합니다. 현재 호감도: [0.0-14.9]% - 필요: 15.0%

english: No, I'm fine.
There you go, [20/40/80] free dynamite. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 자, 무료 dynamite(다이너마이트) [20/40/80]개예요. 내일 또 오세요.

english: I've already given you your free allowance for today. Come back to me tomorrow for some more.
translation: 오늘 몫은 이미 드렸어요. 내일 다시 오면 더 드리죠.

english: Who are you?
I'd like to buy some dynamite.
No, I'm fine.
Good day!
'Ello.
What stories do you bring from afar?
Between the mountains we witnessed the Chicken King invade a mountain fort full of Mount Tinmen.
translation: 산과 산 사이에서 Chicken King(닭 왕)이 Mount Tinmen(마운트 틴맨)들로 가득한 산속 요새를 침공하는 걸 봤지.

english: The Chicken King? Ok...
That was his name! CHICKEN KING! By the light, he fought valiantly.
translation: 그게 그 녀석 이름이었어! 닭 왕! 빛에 맹세코, 용감하게 싸웠지.

english: Did he win?
He screamed 'Off with their heads' while flailing around with a Halberd...
translation: '저들의 목을 쳐라!' 하고 외치면서 Halberd(할버드)를 마구 휘둘러 댔지...

english: So...
His paltry reign is sadly no more.
translation: 그 닭잘것없는 통치는 안타깝게도 막을 내렸지.

english: Any other stories?
During our journey we came upon an abandoned house, it was eerily... silent.
translation: 여행 도중에 버려진 집을 하나 발견했는데, 섬뜩할 정도로... 조용했지.

english: How... spooky.
As we entered the house we were hit by a horrendous smell - it was quite surprising.
translation: 집에 들어서자마자 끔찍한 냄새가 확 끼쳤어. 꽤 놀랐지.

english: Yuk.
The entire family was dead but there was not a single mark on them... Makes you think, what could do such a thing?
translation: 가족 전원이 죽어 있었는데 몸에 상처 하나 없었어... 대체 뭐가 그런 짓을 할 수 있었을까, 생각해 보게 되더군.

english: How unfortunate.
Such a waste... Such a pretty garden.
What?
Oh, nothing...
Not right now... ask me later.
Fair enough.
Ok... Bye.
See you around.
What stories do you bring from afar?
Any other stories?
Ok... Bye.
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
Hello there.
Hello yourself, outerlander. A little out of the way up here, aren't you?
translation: 그쪽도 안녕하세요, 외지인. 이런 외진 데까지 올라오다니, 한참 멀리 왔네요?

english: I would love to stop and chat with you, but unfortunately we have a custom that no Fremennik may speak with the outerlanders without the permission of our chieftain.
translation: 이야기를 나누고 싶지만, 아쉽게도 족장의 허락 없이는 어떤 Fremennik(프레메닉)도 외지인과 말을 섞을 수 없다는 관습이 있어요.

english: Don't take it personally. The Chieftain is stood just over there, his name is Brundt. I suggest you go and introduce yourself.
translation: 기분 나쁘게 생각하지 마세요. 족장은 바로 저기 서 있어요. 이름은 Brundt(브룬트)예요. 가서 인사해 보세요.

english: You wouldn't want to go making any enemies because you weren't aware of our customs now, would you?
translation: 우리 관습을 몰라서 적을 만들고 싶진 않잖아요, 그렇죠?

english: No, I guess not. Thanks anyway.
Not a problem, outerlander. It's always nice to see a new face in the Longhall; it happens so rarely.
translation: 별말씀을요, 외지인. Longhall(롱홀)에서 새 얼굴을 보는 건 언제나 반가워요. 아주 드문 일이거든요.

english: Only Fremenniks may buy drinks here.
translation: 이곳 술은 Fremennik(프레메닉)만 살 수 있어요.

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
I am afraid not outerlander.
Oh, okay then.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: 혹시 Longhall(롱홀) 바텐더의 legendary cocktail(전설의 칵테일)을 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: How did you hear about that?!?!?
I didn't think anybody knew about that... Well, it is true that in my younger years as a barkeep, I wandered the lands trying various alcoholic delicacies.
translation: 아무도 모르는 줄 알았는데... 뭐, 젊은 시절 바텐더로 일할 때 온갖 진귀한 술을 맛보며 세상을 떠돌아다닌 건 사실이에요.

english: Did you ever realise just how many different types of alcohol there are here in Gielinor? Lots!
translation: 여기 Gielinor(길리노르)에 술 종류가 얼마나 많은지 알아요? 엄청나요!

english: Well, anyway, I used a fusion of various drinks from all around the world to create the greatest cocktail ever made!
translation: 아무튼, 전 세계 온갖 술을 섞어서 역사상 최고의 칵테일을 만들었죠!

english: Of course, when my wanderlust was gone, and I returned back to Rellekka to serve as barkeep here, I gave all that up.
translation: 물론 방랑벽이 사라지고 Rellekka(렐레카)로 돌아와 이곳 바텐더가 된 뒤로는 다 그만뒀어요.

english: But you still remember how to make it, right?
Of course.
And you have all the ingredients here? I don't need to go chasing round the world for obscure ingredients to make it?
translation: 재료도 여기 다 있어요? 희한한 재료를 찾아서 세상을 돌아다닐 필요는 없는 거죠?

english: No, I have them all here. Why?
Can you make me your legendary cocktail then?
translation: 그럼 그 legendary cocktail(전설의 칵테일)을 만들어 주실래요?

english: I would rather not; it is a reminder of a life I left behind when I came back.
translation: 그러고 싶지 않아요. 돌아오면서 두고 온 삶을 떠올리게 하거든요.

english: Any way I could change your mind?
You need this to become a Fremennik, right? Well, you seem okay for an outerlander, it would be a shame to see you fail. You know Askeladden?
translation: Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되려면 이게 필요하죠? 뭐, 외지인치고는 괜찮아 보이니 실패하는 걸 보면 아쉽겠네요. Askeladden(아스켈라덴) 알아요?

english: That kid outside? Sure.
He is nothing but a pest. He keeps sneaking in and stealing beer. I shudder to think what he will be like when he has passed his trial of manhood,
translation: 그 애는 골칫덩이일 뿐이에요. 자꾸 몰래 들어와서 맥주를 훔쳐 가요. 그 애가 성인 시험을 통과해서

english: and is allowed in here legitimately. If you can get him to sign a contract promising that he will NEVER EVER EVER darken my doorway here again, you get the drink.
translation: 합법적으로 여기 들어올 수 있게 되면 어떨지 생각만 해도 몸서리가 쳐져요. 그 애가 다시는 절대로, 절대로, 절대로 이 문턱을 넘지 않겠다는 계약서에 서명하게 만들면 술을 만들어 줄게요.

english: Any idea how I can get him to do that?
translation: 어떻게 하면 그렇게 하게 만들 수 있을까요?

english: Knowing that little horror, he'll probably be willing to in exchange for some cash. You should go ask him yourself though.
translation: 그 꼬마 악동이라면 돈만 주면 아마 기꺼이 할 거예요. 그래도 직접 가서 물어보세요.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: 혹시 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이 Longhall(롱홀)에 들어오지 않겠다고 쓴 각서를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Well, as I say, you should talk to him about that. Knowing the little runt as I do though He'll probably do it for the cash.
translation: 글쎄요, 말했듯이 그건 그 애한테 얘기해 봐야 해요. 그래도 제가 아는 그 꼬맹이라면 아마 돈 때문에 할 거예요.

english: Hi! Can I please have one of your legendary cocktails now?
translation: 안녕하세요! 이제 legendary cocktail(전설의 칵테일) 하나 주실 수 있나요?

english: What?!?! I can't believe you... Let me look at that... Askeladden would NEVER... Gosh. It looks legitimate.
translation: 뭐라고요?!?! 믿을 수가 없네요... 어디 봐요... Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이 절대 그럴 리가... 세상에. 진짜인 것 같네요.

english: Here you go, on the house! You have made my life SO much easier! Knowing that little monster won't be bugging me in here all the time anymore!
translation: 자, 여기요, 공짜예요! 덕분에 제 삶이 훨씬 편해졌어요! 그 꼬마 괴물이 이제 더는 여기서 저를 귀찮게 하지 않을 거라니!

english: That little weasel will have to abide by this written promise that Askeladden can never ever enter the Longhall again! He can't get round this one!
translation: 그 꼬마 족제비는 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이 다시는 절대 Longhall(롱홀)에 들어올 수 없다는 이 각서를 지켜야 할 거예요! 이번엔 빠져나갈 수 없을걸요!

english: Uh... yeah... yeah, you probably won't see someone called Askeladden coming in here...
translation: 어... 네... 네, Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이라는 사람이 여기 들어오는 건 아마 못 보실 거예요...

english: (Thora takes the promise and gives the player a Legendary cocktail)
translation: (Thora(토라)가 각서를 받고 플레이어에게 Legendary cocktail(전설의 칵테일)을 준다)

english: Thanks for making me this cocktail. Why don't you make them anymore normally?
translation: 이 칵테일을 만들어 주셔서 고마워요. 평소엔 왜 안 만드세요?

english: Ah... when I gave up my travels across the world many years back, to return to my expected role as longhall barkeep, as my mother, and her mother, were before me,
translation: 아... 오래전 세상 여행을 그만두고, 제 어머니와 그 어머니가 그랬던 것처럼 Longhall(롱홀) 바텐더라는 정해진 역할로 돌아왔을 때,

english: I gave up a lot of the freedom I had found in the outside world. I know it is our custom to shun outerlanders and their ways, but I didn't find them as bad as the stories say.
translation: 바깥세상에서 찾았던 자유를 많이 포기했어요. 외지인과 그들의 방식을 멀리하는 게 우리 관습인 건 알지만, 전해지는 이야기만큼 나쁘다고는 생각하지 않았어요.

english: Sometimes I feel as though we Fremennik live in a prison that we have constructed for ourselves, and that WE are the outerlanders, out here on the edge of the world...
translation: 가끔은 우리 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 스스로 지은 감옥에 살고 있고, 이 세상 끝자락에 사는 우리야말로 외지인인 것 같다는 생각이 들어요...

english: I'm sorry, I think it is part of the job of Longhall barkeep to get philosophical about things ocassionally. I wish you all the best of luck with your trials, outerlander.
translation: 미안해요, 가끔 이런저런 일에 철학적이 되는 것도 Longhall(롱홀) 바텐더의 일인가 봐요. 시험에 행운이 함께하길 빌어요, 외지인.

english: When you have finished, perhaps you will come back here, and we can share a drink over tales of the outside world?
translation: 다 끝나면 여기 다시 와서 바깥세상 이야기를 나누며 한잔하는 게 어때요?

english: Thanks, I'd like that.
Hello again [Fremennik name]. I suppose you want a drink? Or are you going to try another scam with that terrible Askeladden again?
translation: 또 왔군요, [Fremennik name]. 한잔하려고요? 아니면 그 지독한 Askeladden(아스켈라덴)이랑 또 사기를 치려는 건가요?

english: Scam? Oh... You mean his promise not to come in here anymore?
translation: 사기요? 아... 다시는 여기 안 오겠다던 그 애 약속 말이에요?

english: Yes. Yes I do. I should never have trusted him not to come in here, even with that written promise.
translation: 네. 바로 그거요. 각서가 있다고 그 애가 여기 안 올 거라고 믿는 게 아니었어요.

english: Anyway, do you want a drink or not?
No thanks.
Okay then.
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes please
No thanks
Welcome to Blackhole, human. Can I help you?
translation: Blackhole(블랙홀)에 온 걸 환영하네, 인간. 무엇을 도와줄까?

english: Who are you?
Why, I'm Thordur. Thordur the dwarf. A long time ago, I used to run a business letting people visit my Blackhole for fun.
translation: 나 말인가, 나는 Thordur(소르두르)일세. 드워프 소르두르지. 오래전에 사람들이 재미 삼아 내 Blackhole(블랙홀)을 구경하게 해 주는 사업을 했었네.

english: The business was good, but eventually the time came for me to retire. So now I live here in Blackhole where it's more peaceful.
translation: 사업은 잘됐지만, 결국 은퇴할 때가 왔지. 그래서 지금은 더 평화로운 이곳 Blackhole(블랙홀)에서 살고 있다네.

english: What is this place?
Blackhole? Well, it's sort of like a hole, and it's generally not very well lit. I'll let you work out the rest.
translation: Blackhole(블랙홀)? 글쎄, 말하자면 구멍(홀)인데, 대체로 빛이 잘 안 들어 시커멓지(블랙). 나머지는 자네가 짐작해 보게.

english: If you're asking why it's here at all, it was a sort of prison. Bad people were locked here. But it's my home now.
translation: 여기가 왜 있느냐고 묻는 거라면, 일종의 감옥이었네. 나쁜 놈들이 여기 갇혔었지. 하지만 지금은 내 집일세.

english: How can I leave?
Just activate your Disk of Returning. It'll pop you back out to the mines.
translation: 그냥 Disk of Returning(귀환의 원반)을 작동시키게. 광산으로 바로 돌려보내 줄 걸세.

english: Why, surely you've got your Disk of Returning? I can't believe you could have lost it in here.
translation: 아니, 설마 Disk of Returning(귀환의 원반)이 없는 건가? 여기서 그걸 잃어버렸다니 믿을 수가 없군.

english: Nope, I don't have a Disk of Returning.
translation: 아뇨, Disk of Returning(귀환의 원반)이 없어요.

english: I really don't understand humans sometimes. Hold tight and I'll sort you out...
translation: 인간들은 가끔 정말 이해가 안 된단 말이야. 꽉 잡게, 내가 해결해 주지...

english: Yes, get me out now.
Thordur teleports the player to the Dwarven Mine
translation: Thordur(소르두르)가 플레이어를 Dwarven Mine(드워프 광산)으로 순간이동시킨다

english: No thanks, I'll stay here.
I'm fine, thanks.
Who are you?
What is this place?
How can I leave?
Yes, get me out now.
No thanks, I'll stay here.
I'm fine, thanks.
Hey there [player name], Do you want that shopping list now?
translation: 어, [player name] 님! 이제 그 장보기 목록 받아 갈래요?

english: It depends, what do I get out of it again?
translation: 글쎄요, 그걸 하면 제가 뭘 받는다고 했죠?

english: I've got this Death Talisman I could give you in return. You'll need it if you want to get into the altar.
translation: 대신 이 Death Talisman(죽음 부적)을 줄 수 있어요. 제단에 들어가려면 이게 필요할 거예요.

english: Ok sure thing, what do you need?
You'd better take this list, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: 이 목록을 가져가는 게 좋겠어요. 여기 있는 건 전부 필요하거든요! 가져오기만 하면 제가 받아 갈게요.

english: Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.
Hi again, how're you doing with those items we need?
translation: 또 왔네요. 우리가 부탁한 물건들은 잘 모으고 있어요?

english: I've got some of them with me.
Great, can I take everything I need?
translation: 잘됐네요. 필요한 걸 전부 가져가도 될까요?

english: Yeah sure.
Doesn't look like you do to me.
translation: 제가 보기엔 안 가지고 있는 것 같은데요.

english: Thanks, I've updated your list for you.
Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Please take this Death Talisman as a reward.
translation: 와, 우리를 위해 그걸 다 구해 줘서 정말 고마워요! 보답으로 이 Death Talisman(죽음 부적)을 받아요.

english: Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.
translation: 그 부적이 또 필요하면 언제든 찾아와요. 새 목록을 챙겨 줄게요.

english: I'd rather you didn't.
I see you've got the [item], can I have it please?
Sure, here you go!
I think I'll keep hold of it for now.
Do you have another copy of the list?
Try not to lose it this time, we need everything on it! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: 이번엔 잃어버리지 말아요. 여기 있는 건 전부 필요하거든요! 가져오기만 하면 제가 받아 갈게요.

english: Looks like you're carrying enough stuff at the moment.
translation: 지금은 짐을 꽤 많이 들고 있는 것 같네요.

english: You already have the list! Just bring them to me and I'll take them off your hands.
translation: 목록은 이미 가지고 있잖아요! 가져오기만 하면 제가 받아 갈게요.

english: What do you need all this stuff for?
Oh well, we don't get many deliveries down here, so it's supplies mostly...
translation: 아, 그게, 여긴 배달이 잘 안 와서요. 그래서 대부분 보급품이에요...

english: What about the [ticket]?
Well you see.. Umm... We don't really get much chance to.. Er.. Go out or anything... And we'd like some of the prizes some day...
translation: 그게 말이죠.. 음... 우리는 별로.. 어.. 밖에 나갈 기회가 없어서요... 그래서 언젠가 상품을 좀 타 보고 싶어서...

english: So why didn't you ask for the prizes then?
translation: 그럼 그냥 상품을 달라고 하지 그랬어요?

english: Oh no, that'd just be sad.
So why do you want the [book]?
Oh just some light reading, it's nice to catch up on current events occasionally.
translation: 아, 그냥 가볍게 읽을거리예요. 가끔은 최신 소식도 좀 알아 둬야죠.

english: Current events? But it's... Oh nevermind.
translation: 최신 소식이요? 그건 좀... 아, 됐어요.

english: How do you explain the [key]?
Ah... Um... I'm not sure how that got on the list... Can we have it anyway?
translation: 아... 음... 그게 어쩌다 목록에 들어갔는지 모르겠네요... 그래도 그냥 주면 안 될까요?

english: Right, why do I get the feeling I shouldn't?
translation: 그래요, 근데 왜 주면 안 될 것 같은 기분이 들까요?

english: Pretty please with a Blood Talisman on top?!
translation: 제발요, 네? Blood Talisman(피 부적)까지 얹어 드릴게요?!

english: A Blood Talisman?!
Oops! I meant 'Death Talisman'!
Yeah, right, all those are just 'supplies'.
translation: 네, 그러시겠죠. 저게 다 그냥 '보급품'이라는 거죠.

english: No, I'd better get looking for them.
Hello again, feel like getting us some more supplies?
translation: 또 왔네요. 보급품 좀 더 구해 줄 생각 있어요?

english: Okay sure thing, what do you need?
Here you go.
Okay sure thing, what do you need?
Hmm no thanks, I'm not interested.
I've got some of them with me.
Yeah sure.
I'd rather you didn't.
Sure, here you go!
I think I'll keep hold of it for now.
Do you have another copy of the list?
What do you need all this stuff for?
What about the [ticket]?
So why do you want the [book]?
How do you explain the [key]?
Yeah, right, all those are just 'supplies'.
translation: 네, 그러시겠죠. 저게 다 그냥 '보급품'이라는 거죠.

english: No, I'd better get looking for them.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
I hear you killed the Troll King. Thanksyou for that, however I'm afraid I can't really talk to you any more, the King would be unhappy!
translation: Troll King(트롤 왕)을 쓰러뜨렸다고 들었어요. 정말 고마워요. 하지만 이제 더는 당신과 이야기할 수 없을 것 같아요. 그랬다간 왕께서 언짢아하실 거예요!

english: Hello I am Thormac the sorcerer. I don't suppose you could be of assistance to me?
translation: 안녕하신가, 나는 마법사 Thormac(소맥)일세. 혹시 자네가 나를 좀 도와줄 수 있겠나?

english: What do you need assistance with?
I've lost my pet scorpions. They're lesser Kharid scorpions, a very rare breed.
translation: 내 애완 전갈들을 잃어버렸네. lesser Kharid scorpion(소형 카리드 전갈)이라는 아주 희귀한 품종이지.

english: I left their cage door open, now I don't know where they've gone.
translation: 전갈 우리의 문을 열어 뒀더니, 이제 어디로 갔는지 모르겠네.

english: There's three of them, and they're quick little beasties. They're all over Gielinor.
translation: 모두 세 마리인데, 아주 날쌘 녀석들이라네. Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳에 흩어져 있지.

english: So how would I go about catching them then?
Well I have a scorpion cage here which you can use to catch them in.
translation: 여기 scorpion cage(전갈 우리)가 있으니 그걸로 잡으면 되네.

english: Well you have the scorpion cage I gave you, you can catch them using that.
translation: 내가 준 scorpion cage(전갈 우리)가 있지 않나. 그걸로 잡으면 되네.

english: If you go up to the village of Seers, to the North of here, one of them will be able to tell you where the scorpions are now.
translation: 여기서 북쪽에 있는 Seers(시어스) 마을에 가 보게. 그곳 예언자 중 누군가가 전갈들이 지금 어디 있는지 알려 줄 걸세.

english: Ok, I will do it then.
I'm not interested.
Blast, I suppose I'll have to find someone else then.
I'm a little busy.
How goes your quest?
I've not caught all the scorpions yet.
Well remember to go speak to the Seers, North of here, if you need any help.
translation: 도움이 필요하면 여기서 북쪽에 있는 예언자들을 찾아가 보는 것 잊지 말게.

english: I've not brought all the scorpions with me.
Well go and fetch them then.
I have retrieved all your scorpions.
Aha, my little scorpions home at last!
translation: 오오, 내 귀여운 전갈들이 드디어 집에 돌아왔구나!

english: Thank you for rescuing my scorpions.
That's ok.
You said you'd enchant my battlestaff for me.
translation: 제 battlestaff(전투 지팡이)에 마법을 걸어 주신다고 하셨죠.

english: Yes, it'll cost you [20,000 / 30,000 / 40,000] coins for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: 그렇지. 다만 재료값으로 [20,000 / 30,000 / 40,000] 코인이 들 걸세. 어떤 지팡이에 마법을 걸고 싶은가?

english: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then.
I'm not interested.
What's in it for me?
I'm not interested then.
I'm a little busy.
That's ok.
You said you'd enchant my battlestaff for me.
translation: 제 battlestaff(전투 지팡이)에 마법을 걸어 주신다고 하셨죠.

english: Hello!
Can I have some more boots?
translation: 장화 좀 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Thorodin gives you another pair of boots.
translation: Thorodin(소로딘)이 장화 한 켤레를 더 건네준다.

english: Who are you?
Thorodin, taskmaster for the Fremennik Achievement Diary.
translation: Thorodin(소로딘)이에요. Fremennik Achievement Diary(프레메닉 업적 일지)의 과제 감독관이죠.

english: What is the Achievement Diary?

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Fremennik lands it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
translation: 특정한 업적을 기록해 두도록 도와주는 일지예요. 프레메닉 땅에서는 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 찾아내는 데 도움이 되죠. 그리고 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이 보상을 줄 거예요.

english: You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.
translation: 과제 목록은 옆 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: 제 Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Well, there are four different pairs of Fremennik sea boots, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards
translation: 음, Fremennik sea boots(프레메닉 바다 장화)는 네 종류가 있고, 각각 네 가지 난이도에 대응해요. 각 장화는 이전 단계의 보상을 모두 갖고 있고 추가 혜택도 있어요... 어느 단계의 보상에 대해

english: would you like to know more about?
Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!
translation: 초급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Fremennik Province, Peer the Seer can bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료하면, Peer the Seer(예언자 페르)가 언제든 아이템을 은행에 넣어 주고 enchanted lyre(마법이 걸린 리라)의 충전 횟수가 하나 늘어나요.

english: Thanks!
Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!
translation: 중급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your boots can teleport you to Rellekka once per day and you'll gain access a shortcut on the Miscellania docks as well as an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: 초급 보상에 더해, 장화로 하루에 한 번 Rellekka(렐레카)로 순간이동할 수 있고 Miscellania(미셀라니아) 부두의 지름길을 쓸 수 있게 되며, 백성들의 지지도도 더 빨리 올라가요.

english: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you'll be able to change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, use a shortcut to the roof of the Troll Stronghold and access two new Lunar spells.
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, 리라 순간이동 위치를 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)으로 바꿀 수 있고, Troll Stronghold(트롤 요새) 지붕으로 가는 지름길을 쓸 수 있으며, 새로운 Lunar(루나) 주문 두 개를 쓸 수 있어요.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 엘리트 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can be attuned to teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle,
translation: 이전 단계의 보상에 더해, 장화로 Rellekka(렐레카)에 무제한으로 순간이동할 수 있고, 리라를 조율해 Jatiszo(야티조)나 Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)으로 순간이동할 수 있으며, Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 seal of passage(통행의 인장)이 더 이상 필요 없고,

english: Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: Dagannoth bones(다간노스 뼈)는 지폐 형태로 떨어지며, 백성들이 당신의 왕국 운영을 이전보다 훨씬 더 빨리 지지하게 돼요.

english: Just complete the tasks in the Fremennik Province so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면, 저한테 와서 보상을 받아 가세요.

english: Bye!
See you later.
About the Dagannoth Kings...
Ah, yes. Because you've completed the elite tasks for the Fremennik Province, their bones will be noted for you.
translation: 아, 네. Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)의 엘리트 과제를 완료했으니, 그 녀석들의 뼈는 지폐 형태로 떨어져요.

english: If you'd prefer, I can change it so they will drop their bones as they normally would?
translation: 원한다면 원래대로 뼈가 그냥 떨어지도록 바꿔 줄까요?

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, they will drop their bones normally.
translation: 알겠어요. 앞으로 Dagannoth King(다간노스 왕)을 처치하면 뼈가 원래대로 떨어질 거예요.

english: Very well. If you change your mind, come talk to me again.
Ah, yes. You wanted the bones from the Dagannoth Kings to remain unnoted when you killed them.
translation: 아, 네. Dagannoth Kings(다간노스 왕)을 처치할 때 뼈가 지폐 형태가 아닌 그대로 나오길 원했죠.

english: If you'd prefer, I can change them back to being noted instead?
translation: 원한다면 다시 지폐 형태로 떨어지도록 바꿔 줄까요?

english: Very well. In future, when you kill a Dagannoth King, their bones will be noted.
translation: 알겠어요. 앞으로 Dagannoth King(다간노스 왕)을 처치하면 뼈가 지폐 형태로 떨어질 거예요.

english: Exile. You don't have many friends around here at the moment.
translation: 추방자로군요. 지금 이 근처엔 당신 편이 별로 없을 거예요.

english: How do you feel about it?
Doesn't bother me. Some people take these things more seriously than others. On that note, do you need something?
translation: 난 상관없어요. 이런 일을 남들보다 더 심각하게 받아들이는 사람들도 있는 거죠. 그건 그렇고, 뭐 필요한 거 있어요?

english: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Fremennik Achievement Diary!
translation: Fremennik Achievement Diary(프레메닉 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!
Yes please!
These boots are a symbol of your exploration of the Fremennik lands. Peer the Seer can now bank items for you at all times and your enchanted lyre can hold an extra charge.
translation: 이 장화는 당신이 프레메닉 땅을 탐험했다는 증표예요. 이제 Peer the Seer(예언자 페르)가 언제든 아이템을 은행에 넣어 주고, enchanted lyre(마법이 걸린 리라)의 충전 횟수가 하나 늘어나요.

english: Wow, thanks!
If you ever lose your boots, come back to me to reclaim them.
translation: 장화를 잃어버리면 언제든 저한테 와서 다시 받아 가세요.

english: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik achievement diary(프레메닉 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. They can now teleport you here once per day and have an increased rate of gaining approval with your subjects.
translation: Fremennik sea boots(프레메닉 바다 장화)를 강화해 뒀어요. 이제 하루에 한 번 여기로 순간이동할 수 있고, 백성들의 지지도도 더 빨리 올라가요.

english: I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik achievement diary(프레메닉 업적 일지)의 상급 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: You need to complete all of the easy and medium tasks too before I can reward you for the more difficult sets.
translation: 더 어려운 단계의 보상을 받으려면 초급과 중급 과제도 모두 완료해야 해요.

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. You can now change your lyre teleport location to Waterbirth Island, access two new Lunar spells and you'll receive extra Agility experience from the Rellekka
translation: Fremennik sea boots(프레메닉 바다 장화)를 강화해 뒀어요. 이제 리라 순간이동 위치를 Waterbirth Island(워터버스 섬)으로 바꿀 수 있고, 새로운 Lunar(루나) 주문 두 개를 쓸 수 있으며, Rellekka(렐레카)

english: rooftop course.
translation: 지붕 코스에서 Agility(민첩) 경험치를 추가로 얻게 돼요.

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Fremennik achievement diary!
translation: Fremennik achievement diary(프레메닉 업적 일지)의 엘리트 과제를 모두 완료했어요!

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Fremennik Province! Here's your reward!
translation: 그렇군요, 잘했어요! Fremennik Province(프레메닉 지방)의 과제를 전부 완료했네요! 여기 보상이에요!

english: I've upgraded your Fremennik sea boots for you. In addition to all of the previous benefits, your boots now have unlimited teleports to Rellekka, your lyre can now teleport you to Jatiszo or Neitiznot, you'll no longer
translation: Fremennik sea boots(프레메닉 바다 장화)를 강화해 뒀어요. 이전의 모든 혜택에 더해, 이제 장화로 Rellekka(렐레카)에 무제한으로 순간이동할 수 있고, 리라로 Jatiszo(야티조)나 Neitiznot(네이티즈놋)으로 순간이동할 수 있으며, Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서

english: need a seal of passage on Lunar Isle, Dagannoth bones will be dropped as notes and your subjects will approve of your kingdom management even faster than before.
translation: seal of passage(통행의 인장)이 더 이상 필요 없고, Dagannoth bones(다간노스 뼈)는 지폐 형태로 떨어지며, 백성들이 당신의 왕국 운영을 이전보다 훨씬 더 빨리 지지하게 돼요.

english: Can I have some more boots?
translation: 장화 좀 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: 제 Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
About the Dagannoth Kings...
Yes, give me unnoted bones.
translation: 네, 뼈를 지폐 형태가 아닌 그대로 주세요.

english: No, keep the bones noted.
Yes, give me noted bones.
No, keep the bones unnoted.
Good day, [sir/madam].
What are you doing down here?
We're extending the cave so more people can live in it.
translation: 더 많은 사람이 살 수 있게 동굴을 넓히고 있어요.

english: These Miscellanians aren't so bad. They appreciate the benefits of living underground.
translation: 이 Miscellanians(미셀라니아 사람들)도 꽤 괜찮아요. 지하 생활의 장점을 알아주거든요.

english: ...such as?
You don't get rained on, for example.
Of course, there are some problems, like the monsters Donal saw...
translation: 물론 문제도 좀 있죠. Donal(도널)이 봤다는 괴물 같은 거요...

english: Someone saw a monster?
Could you tell me more? The King asked me to investigate.
translation: 더 자세히 얘기해 줄 수 있어요? 왕께서 저한테 조사해 달라고 하셨거든요.

english: One of the other dwarves who was working with us saw it. His name's Donal.
translation: 우리랑 같이 일하던 다른 드워프가 봤어요. 이름은 Donal(도널)이에요.

english: He went further into the caves to plan our excavations, and a while later he came out shaking.
translation: 굴착 계획을 세우려고 동굴 안쪽으로 더 들어갔는데, 한참 뒤에 덜덜 떨면서 나왔어요.

english: He's been in the inn ever since.
translation: 그 뒤로 계속 여관에만 틀어박혀 있어요.

english: Good day.
Have you spoken to Donal?
Not yet, no.
Well, if you want to hear stories about monsters, he's the best one to ask.
translation: 음, 괴물 얘기를 듣고 싶으면 그 친구한테 묻는 게 제일이에요.

english: Not getting rained on, for example.
I have. The monster he talked about could be in the caves nearby.
translation: 얘기해 봤어요. 그 사람이 말한 괴물이 근처 동굴에 있을지도 몰라요.

english: You'd better get in there and do something about it, then.
translation: 그럼 얼른 들어가서 어떻게 좀 해 보는 게 좋겠네요.

english: It's not safe. I need to shore up the walls before I can go through.
translation: 거긴 위험해요. 들어가기 전에 벽부터 보강해야 해요.

english: Did you do anything about that monster Donal was talking about?
translation: Donal(도널)이 말하던 그 괴물은 어떻게 좀 했어요?

english: It's been taken care of.
Glad to hear it. Now we can get on with excavating.
translation: 다행이네요. 이제 굴착 작업을 계속할 수 있겠어요.

english: What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Leave me be, outerlander. I have nothing to say to the likes of you.
translation: 날 내버려 두시오, 외지인. 그대 같은 자와는 할 말이 없소.

english: Hello!
Hello yourself, outerlander. What brings you to dare speak to a mighty Fremennik warrior such as myself?
translation: 그래, 안녕하시오, 외지인. 무엇 때문에 감히 나 같은 위대한 프레메닉 전사에게 말을 거는 것이오?

english: Erm... are you a member of the council?
The Fremennik council of elders? Why, of course I am. I am recognised as one the clans mightiest warriors. What is it to you outerlander?
translation: 프레메닉 원로회 말이오? 당연히 그렇소. 나는 우리 부족에서 가장 강한 전사 중 하나로 인정받고 있소. 그게 그대와 무슨 상관이오, 외지인?

english: Well... I was wondering if you could vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: 음... 제가 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 될 수 있게 표를 던져 주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: An outerlander wishes to become a Fremennik!?!? Ha! That is priceless!
translation: 외지인이 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 되고 싶다고!?!? 하! 이거 정말 걸작이로군!

english: Well, let us say that I am not totally against this concept. As a warrior, I appreciate the value of brave and powerful warriors to our clan,
translation: 좋소, 나도 그 생각에 완전히 반대하는 건 아니라고 해 두지. 전사로서 나는 용감하고 강한 전사가 우리 부족에 얼마나 값진지 잘 알고 있소.

english: and even though you may be an outerlander, I will not hold this against you if you can prove yourself to be fierce of heart in a combat situation to me.
translation: 그러니 그대가 외지인이라 해도, 전투에서 맹렬한 용기를 내게 증명해 보인다면 그 점을 문제 삼지 않겠소.

english: So how can I prove that? You want to fight me? Come on then, bring it on! Right here, right now, buddy!
translation: 그걸 어떻게 증명하면 되는데요? 저랑 싸우고 싶어요? 그럼 덤벼 봐요! 지금 당장, 여기서요, 친구!

english: Hahahahaha! You certainly show some spirit for an outerlander!
But spirit does not always make a good warrior. It takes both skill and spirit to be so. I have a test that I give all Fremenniks on their path to be a member of the clan.
translation: 하지만 기백만으로 훌륭한 전사가 되는 건 아니오. 기술과 기백이 모두 있어야 하지. 나는 부족의 일원이 되려는 모든 프레메닉에게 내리는 시험이 있소.

english: My test will challenge both your combat prowess and your bravery equally. Should you pass it you will earn my vote at the council, and more importantly my respect for you as a warrior.
translation: 내 시험은 그대의 전투 실력과 용기를 똑같이 시험할 것이오. 통과한다면 의회에서 내 표를 얻을 것이고, 무엇보다 전사로서 내 존중을 얻게 될 것이오.

english: So what say you, outerlander? Are you prepared for the battle?
translation: 자, 어떻게 하겠소, 외지인? 싸울 준비가 되었소?

english: Am I prepared? I'll show you what combat's all about, you big sissy barbarian type guy!
translation: 제가 준비됐냐고요? 전투가 뭔지 보여 드리죠, 이 덩치만 큰 겁쟁이 야만인 아저씨!

english: Hahahahaha! I'm beginning to like you already, outerlander!
translation: 하하하하하! 벌써 그대가 마음에 들기 시작하는군, 외지인!

english: Then allow me to present you with my challenge; This ladder here will take you to a place of combat. I have placed a special warrior down there to challenge you.
translation: 그럼 내 도전을 알려 주겠소. 이 사다리를 타고 내려가면 싸움터가 나오오. 그곳에 그대와 겨룰 특별한 전사를 두었소.

english: Battle him to the death, and you will pass my challenge. If at any point you wish to leave combat, simply climb back up the ladder, to leave that place.
translation: 그와 죽을 때까지 싸우면 내 도전을 통과하게 되오. 도중에 싸움을 그만두고 싶다면 사다리를 다시 올라와 그곳을 떠나면 되오.

english: If you leave you will of course fail the test. You may retry my test in the future if you fail, but you must stay down there until the death if you wish for my vote at the council.
translation: 떠나면 물론 시험에 실패하는 것이오. 실패하더라도 나중에 다시 도전할 수 있지만, 의회에서 내 표를 원한다면 죽을 때까지 그 아래에 남아 있어야 하오.

english: You must defeat him three times to prove that you are worthy. The fourth time that you fight him will be to the death, so do not show cowardice.
translation: 자격이 있음을 증명하려면 그를 세 번 쓰러뜨려야 하오. 네 번째 싸움은 죽을 때까지 가는 싸움이니, 비겁한 모습을 보이지 마시오.

english: Is that all? It will be easy!
