No, there is one more important rule;
translation: 아니오, 중요한 규칙이 하나 더 있소.

english: You may not enter the battleground with any armour or weaponry of any kind.
translation: 싸움터에는 어떤 갑옷이나 무기도 가지고 들어갈 수 없소.

english: If you need to place your equipment into your bank account, I recommend that you speak to the seer, who knows a spell that will do that for you.
translation: 장비를 은행에 맡겨야 한다면 예언자와 이야기해 보시오. 그 일을 대신 해 주는 주문을 알고 있는 자요.

english: No thanks, I'm pretty sure that I can find someone else to vote for me.
translation: 됐어요. 저한테 표를 줄 사람은 따로 찾을 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: Hmm, not so brave after all, outerlander? Perhaps it is for the best. I doubt you have what it takes to pass my challenge.
translation: 흠, 결국 그리 용감하지는 않은 모양이군, 외지인? 차라리 잘된 일인지도 모르지. 그대에게 내 도전을 통과할 만한 깜냥이 있을지 의심스러웠으니.

english: Outerlander... do not test my patience. I do not take kindly to people wandering in here and acting as though they own the place.
translation: 외지인... 내 인내심을 시험하지 마시오. 이곳에 멋대로 들어와 주인 행세를 하는 자들은 달갑지 않으니.

english: So what do I have to do to earn your vote at the council again?
translation: 의회에서 표를 얻으려면 뭘 해야 한다고 하셨죠?

english: I will not offer my vote to anybody whose bravery in combat I do not trust completely. You must go down that ladder and fight your foe to the death.
translation: 전투에서의 용기를 완전히 믿을 수 없는 자에게는 표를 주지 않겠소. 저 사다리를 내려가 적과 죽을 때까지 싸워야 하오.

english: So, who is my opponent?
Ah, a wise question before entering combat. His name is Koschei the deathless. He is something of a mystery, even to us.
translation: 아, 싸우기 전에 던질 만한 현명한 질문이군. 그의 이름은 Koschei the deathless(불사신 코셰이)요. 우리에게조차 수수께끼 같은 자지.

english: On one of our regular raiding parties, our longship discovered a man in the frozen waters far north-east of here. We took him aboard our ship, thinking he must be dead.
translation: 늘 하던 약탈 원정 중에, 우리 배가 여기서 멀리 북동쪽의 얼어붙은 바다에서 한 남자를 발견했소. 우리는 그가 죽었으리라 생각하고 배에 건져 올렸지.

english: To our amazement he was perfectly healthy, even though he must have been in those deadly icey waters for many weeks.
translation: 놀랍게도 그는 멀쩡했소. 그 살을 에는 얼음 바다에 몇 주는 있었을 텐데도 말이오.

english: He has no memory of who he is, or how he came to be there, except for his own name: Koschei. We named him 'The Deathless' because he is seemingly unkillable!
translation: 그는 자기 이름인 Koschei(코셰이) 말고는 자신이 누구인지, 어떻게 거기 있게 되었는지 아무것도 기억하지 못하오. 도무지 죽일 수가 없는 것 같아서 우리가 '불사신'이라는 이름을 붙였소!

english: Any combat technique used against him, he learns instantly! He also apparently can heal himself from any wound at will! When he attacks, his weapon moves like a whirlwind!
translation: 그에게 쓰는 전투 기술은 무엇이든 순식간에 익혀 버리오! 게다가 어떤 상처든 마음대로 치유할 수 있는 듯하오! 그가 공격할 때면 무기가 회오리바람처럼 움직이지!

english: He can hide his combat level from his opponents at will as well! He is truly a horribly fierce opponent to face! I am only glad that he has chosen to stay here with us!
translation: 상대에게 자기 전투 레벨을 마음대로 숨길 수도 있소! 정말로 무시무시하게 사나운 상대요! 그가 우리와 함께 머물기로 한 게 그저 다행일 뿐이오!

english: The daylight makes him feel weak, so we have built him his own battleground beneath this building, where he can train his fiercesome skills without being disturbed.
translation: 햇빛을 받으면 약해진다기에, 우리는 이 건물 아래에 그만의 싸움터를 지어 주었소. 그곳에서 방해받지 않고 그 무시무시한 실력을 단련할 수 있도록 말이오.

english: But he can't REALLY be unkillable...  ...can he?
translation: 하지만 진짜로 죽일 수 없는 건 아니겠죠...  ...그렇죠?

english: Some say he cannot die, for he has hidden his heart outside of his body to be kept forever safe in a duck egg.
translation: 어떤 이들은 그가 심장을 몸 밖에 숨겨 오리 알 속에 영원히 안전하게 보관해 두었기에 죽지 않는다고 하오.

english: Others say he has been cursed by the gods to wander this land forever, never knowing any peace in his life, but only combat.
translation: 또 어떤 이들은 그가 신들의 저주를 받아, 평생 평화를 모른 채 오직 싸움만 하며 이 땅을 영원히 떠돌게 되었다고 하오.

english: Some claim that the sword he carries is the source of all his power, and if he should lose it, then exactly one minute later, he will turn back into his true form;
translation: 또 그가 지닌 검이 모든 힘의 원천이라, 그것을 잃으면 정확히 1분 뒤에 본래 모습으로 돌아간다고 주장하는 이들도 있소.

english: A weakened, lame, old man.
And what do you believe?
I believe you shouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth. He is a fearfully powerful warrior, but more importantly; He is on OUR side, not against us.
translation: 나는 굴러들어온 복을 트집 잡지 말아야 한다고 믿소. 그는 무시무시하게 강한 전사지만, 더 중요한 건 그가 우리의 적이 아니라 '우리' 편이라는 것이오.

english: He is content testing the battle skills of anyone taking their Fremennik trials of manhood, and I am content knowing that should an enemy ever invade our town,
translation: 그는 프레메닉 성인 시련을 치르는 자들의 전투 실력을 시험하는 걸로 만족하고, 나는 우리 전사들이 약탈 원정을 나가 있는 동안

english: while our warriors are out on a raiding party, Koschei will be able to hold off ANY invader long enough for us to make our return.
translation: 적이 마을을 침략하더라도 Koschei(코셰이)가 우리가 돌아올 때까지 '어떤' 침입자든 막아 낼 수 있다는 것으로 만족하오.

english: I don't really like fighting that much... Isn't there something else I can do to earn your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 전 싸우는 걸 그다지 좋아하지 않아요... 원로회에서 표를 얻을 다른 방법은 없을까요?

english: Yes of course outerlander! If you bring me five raw sardines then I will vote for you instead!
translation: 물론 있소, 외지인! raw sardines(생정어리) 다섯 마리를 가져오면 대신 그대에게 표를 주겠소!

english: REALLY?!?!?
HAHAHAHAHAHA! No, of course not! You are stupid, even by outerlander standards!
translation: 하하하하하하! 그럴 리가 있겠소! 외지인 기준으로 봐도 그대는 참 어리석군!

english: If you want my vote, you must pass my trial. It is as simple as that.
translation: 내 표를 원한다면 내 시험을 통과해야 하오. 그뿐이오.

english: Congratulations! You have completed the warrior's trial! (Koschei disappears in a puff of smoke, the player receives a Fremennik blade)
translation: 축하하오! 전사의 시험을 완수했소! (Koschei(코셰이)가 연기와 함께 사라지고, 플레이어는 Fremennik blade(프레메닉 검)을 받는다)

english: Hahaha! Well fought outerlander! Now come down from there, you have passed my trial with flying colours!
translation: 하하하! 잘 싸웠소, 외지인! 이제 거기서 내려오시오. 그대는 내 시험을 훌륭하게 통과했소!

english: But... I don't understand... I did not manage to beat Koschei...
translation: 하지만... 이해가 안 돼요... 전 Koschei(코셰이)를 이기지 못했는데요...

english: I did not say you had to, outerlander! All I asked was that you fought to the death! And you did! The death was your own!
translation: 이기라고 한 적은 없소, 외지인! 내가 요구한 건 죽을 때까지 싸우라는 것뿐이었소! 그리고 그대는 해냈지! 죽은 건 그대 자신이었지만!

english: I was not interested in how strong you are! I was interested in how BRAVE you are! You fought a superior enemy to your very last breath - THAT is bravery.
translation: 나는 그대가 얼마나 강한지는 관심 없었소! 그대가 얼마나 '용감한지'가 궁금했던 것이오! 그대는 자신보다 강한 적과 마지막 숨이 다할 때까지 싸웠소. '그것'이 바로 용기요.

english: I would be honoured to represent you to the council as worthy of being a Fremennik after watching that superb battle!
translation: 그 멋진 싸움을 보고 나니, 그대가 프레메닉이 될 자격이 있다고 의회에 기꺼이 추천하겠소!

english: So can I count on your vote at the council of elders now Thorvald?
translation: 그럼 이제 원로회에서 당신 표를 믿어도 될까요, Thorvald(소르발드)?

english: Absolutely! I watched the entire battle, and was extremely impressed with your bravery in combat!
translation: 물론이오! 싸움을 처음부터 끝까지 지켜보았는데, 그대의 용기에 크게 감명받았소!

english: I'd really rather not go back down there again, now that I have Thorvald's vote at the council of elders.
translation: 이제 Thorvald(소르발드)의 원로회 표를 얻었으니, 거기 다시 내려가고 싶진 않아요.

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: 혹시 경호원 노릇을 해 줄 용감하고 강한 전사를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Know you not who I am outerlander? There are none more brave or powerful than me amongst all the Fremennik!
translation: 내가 누군지 모르시오, 외지인? Fremennik(프레메닉) 전체를 통틀어 나보다 용감하고 강한 자는 없소!

english: However... The role of bodyguard is below me, as a noble warrior. You might as well ask me to babysit the children!
translation: 하지만... 경호원 노릇은 고귀한 전사인 나에게 어울리지 않소. 차라리 애들을 봐 달라고 하시지!

english: Is there no way you would do this for me?
There is but one way outerlander. Since I was steeled in battle, I have dreamt of earning my place at the Champions Table in the Long Hall.
translation: 딱 한 가지 방법이 있소, 외지인. 전투로 단련된 이래로, 나는 Long Hall(롱홀)의 Champions Table(챔피언의 탁자)에 자리를 얻는 것을 꿈꿔 왔소.

english: It is a tradition amongst us that the bravest and strongest are honoured with a table of champions to drink and feast all that they can in our Long Hall.
translation: 우리에겐 가장 용감하고 강한 자들이 Long Hall(롱홀)의 챔피언 탁자에서 마음껏 마시고 먹는 영예를 누리는 전통이 있소.

english: Unfortunately, there are only a fixed number of places available at the table, and these places were all filled many moons ago by others.
translation: 안타깝게도 탁자의 자리는 정해져 있고, 그 자리는 오래전에 다른 이들로 모두 채워졌소.

english: Although my worthiness is undeniable, the only way I may take my place is if one of those already there die, or give up their place to me voluntarily.
translation: 내 자격은 부정할 수 없지만, 내가 자리를 얻을 유일한 방법은 이미 앉아 있는 자 중 하나가 죽거나 스스로 자리를 내주는 것뿐이오.

english: So you want me to go kill one of them off for you? Make it look like an accident?
translation: 그러니까 저더러 그중 한 명을 처리해 달라는 거예요? 사고처럼 보이게?

english: WHAT? No, no, not at all! I am shocked you would suggest such a thing!
translation: 뭐라고? 아니, 아니, 절대 아니오! 그런 말을 하다니 충격이오!

english: If you can persuade one of the Revellers to give up their Champions' Token to you so that I might take their place, you may have my contract as a bodyguard.
translation: Revellers(술꾼들) 중 한 명을 설득해 Champions' Token(챔피언 증표)를 그대에게 넘기게 하여 내가 그 자리를 차지할 수 있게 해 준다면, 경호원 계약서를 주겠소.

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the token to allow your seat at the champions table?
translation: 혹시 챔피언 탁자에 앉을 수 있게 해 줄 증표를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 아세요?

english: You will need to persuade one of the revellers in the Long Hall to give up their token, and their place, in deference to my own worthiness somehow.
translation: Long Hall(롱홀)의 술꾼 중 한 명을 어떻게든 설득해서, 내 자격을 인정하고 증표와 자리를 양보하게 해야 하오.

english: I would like your contract to offer your services as a bodyguard.
translation: 경호원으로 일해 주겠다는 계약서를 받고 싶어요.

english: Oh you would, would you outerlander? I have already told you, I will not demean myself with such a baby sitting job until I can sit in the Longhall with pride.
translation: 오, 그러고 싶다 이거요, 외지인? 이미 말했잖소. Longhall(롱홀)에 당당히 앉을 수 있게 되기 전까지는 그런 애 보기 같은 일로 체면을 깎지 않겠다고.

english: It's a good thing I have the Champions' Token right here then, isn't it?
translation: 그럼 마침 제가 Champions' Token(챔피언 증표)를 여기 갖고 있어서 다행이네요, 그렇죠?

english: Ah... well this is a different matter. With that token I can claim my rightful place as a champion in the Long hall!
translation: 아... 그렇다면 얘기가 다르지. 그 증표만 있으면 Long hall(롱홀)에서 챔피언으로서 정당한 내 자리를 차지할 수 있소!

english: Here outerlander, I can suffer the indignity of playing babysitter if it means that I can then revel with my warrior equals in the Long Hall afterwards!
translation: 자, 외지인. 그 뒤에 Long Hall(롱홀)에서 동등한 전사들과 함께 흥겹게 즐길 수 있다면야, 아이 보는 굴욕쯤은 참을 수 있소!

english: Here outerlander, take this contract; I will fulfill it to my utmost.
translation: 자, 외지인, 이 계약서를 받으시오. 최선을 다해 이행하겠소.

english: (Thorvald takes the Champions token and gives the player Warrior's contract)
translation: (Thorvald(소르발드)가 Champions token(챔피언 증표)를 받고 플레이어에게 Warrior's contract(전사의 계약서)를 준다)

english: You didn't take much persuading to 'lower' yourself to a bodyguard.
translation: 경호원으로 '격을 낮추는' 데 설득이 별로 필요 없었네요.

english: You misunderstand, outerlander. Normally I will only battle for a noble cause, but have never been recognised as a true champion here.
translation: 오해하는군, 외지인. 평소 나는 고귀한 대의를 위해서만 싸우지만, 이곳에서 진정한 챔피언으로 인정받은 적은 한 번도 없었소.

english: With this Champion's token, I can stand alongside my warrior brethren in the Long Hall, and revel in the glories of past victories together!
translation: 이 Champion's token(챔피언 증표)가 있으면 Long Hall(롱홀)에서 전사 형제들과 나란히 서서, 지난 승리의 영광을 함께 즐길 수 있소!

english: Howdy Thorvald!
And greetings to you too. It is good to see new blood entering the Fremennik; we gain our strength by bringing new warriors into the tribe.
translation: 그대도 반갑소. Fremennik(프레메닉)에 새로운 피가 들어오는 건 좋은 일이오. 우리는 새로운 전사들을 부족에 받아들이며 힘을 얻으니.

english: Yes
No
What do I have to do again?
Who is my opponent?
Can't I do something else?
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Welcome to the Realm of Memories, [player name].
translation: Realm of Memories(기억의 영역)에 온 걸 환영해요, [player name] 님.

english: Who were you?
I am Thrander. Long ago I used to live in Varrock, converting plate armour. For example, if you'd got a plate skirt, but you preferred leggings instead, I'd convert it, free of charge.
translation: 나는 Thrander(스랜더)예요. 오래전 Varrock(바록)에 살면서 판금 갑옷을 개조해 주곤 했죠. 예를 들어 판금 치마가 있는데 다리 갑옷이 더 좋다면, 무료로 바꿔 줬어요.

english: Are you happy here?
Maybe retiring was a mistake. If the world ever wanted me again, I could come out of retirement and offer my services as before. Though people might fret about the economic impact if I did.
translation: 은퇴한 게 실수였는지도 몰라요. 세상이 다시 날 원한다면, 은퇴를 접고 예전처럼 일을 해 줄 수도 있겠죠. 그랬다간 경제에 미칠 영향을 걱정하는 사람들도 있겠지만요.

english: Thanks.
Who were you?
Are you happy here?
Thanks.
Urg!
Urg!
What is it, human? I'm working.
How do I use the furnace?
Put your ore on the conveyor belt to get it smelted. We'll stoke the boiler and operate the rest of the machinery for you.
translation: 광석을 conveyor belt(컨베이어 벨트)에 올려놓으면 제련해 준다. boiler(보일러)에 불을 때고 나머지 기계 장치를 돌리는 건 우리가 해 주지.

english: You'll have to help repair the furnace whenever a pipe blows, though. Just hit it with a hammer - that usually works.
translation: 대신 pipe(파이프)가 터질 때마다 용광로 수리는 네가 거들어야 한다. hammer(망치)로 그냥 두들겨 패면 돼. 대개 그걸로 고쳐지거든.

english: You'll have to put money in the coffer to pay for our services. We charge 72,000 coins per hour; money is deducted as long as you're in this room with us.
translation: 우리 일삯은 coffer(금고)에 돈을 넣어서 내야 한다. 한 시간에 72,000코인이고, 네가 이 방에 우리랑 같이 있는 동안 계속 빠져나간다.

english: Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
My brothers and I have a rare genetic condition affecting our growth. Rather than treating us as freaks, you might like to appreciate how useful it is that we can operate the machinery.
translation: 나랑 형제들은 성장에 영향을 주는 희귀한 유전 질환이 있다. 괴물 취급하기 전에, 덕분에 우리가 이 기계를 돌릴 수 있다는 게 얼마나 쓸모 있는 일인지나 좀 알아줬으면 좋겠군.

english: Sorry.
That's ok, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 됐다, 인간. 그 얘기 한 게 네가 처음도 아니니까. 그래서, 필요한 거라도 있나? 난 여기서 할 일이 있다.

english: Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
... look, do you want help with something, or did you just come here to be rude? I've got work to do.
translation: ...이봐, 뭘 도와 달라는 거냐, 아니면 그냥 무례하게 굴려고 온 거냐? 난 할 일이 있다고.

english: I'll let you get on with it.
How do I use the furnace?
Gosh, you're a remarkably big dwarf.
Sorry.
I'll let you get on with it.
Are you sure you're really a dwarf?
What is that cape you're wearing?
It's a Skillcape of Smithing. It shows that I'm a master blacksmith, but that's only to be expected - after all, my ancestors were the greatest blacksmiths in dwarven history.
translation: Skillcape of Smithing(대장일 스킬 망토)일세. 내가 대장장이의 달인이라는 표시지. 뭐, 당연한 일일세. 우리 조상님들이 드워프 역사상 가장 위대한 대장장이들이었으니 말이야.

english: If you ever achieve level 99 Smithing you'll be able to wear a cape like this, and receive more experience when smelting gold ore.
translation: 자네도 Smithing(대장일) 레벨 99를 달성하면 이런 망토를 입을 수 있고, gold ore(금광석)을 제련할 때 경험치도 더 받게 될 걸세.

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: Sir Vyvin(바이빈 경)의 검을 하나 더 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: You want that knight's sword again? I suppose you brought me a lovely pie, so I don't mind. I'll need a blurite ore and two iron bars, like before.
translation: 그 기사 양반 검을 또 원한다고? 자네가 맛있는 파이를 갖다준 적이 있으니 뭐, 상관없네. 전처럼 blurite ore(블루라이트 광석) 하나랑 iron bar(철 주괴) 두 개가 필요할 걸세.

english: Okay, I'll go and find that.
Would you like a redberry pie?
You see Thurgo's eyes light up.
translation: Thurgo(서고)의 눈이 반짝 빛나는 게 보인다.

english: I'd never say no to a redberry pie! We Imcando dwarves love them - they're GREAT!
translation: redberry pie(레드베리 파이)라면 마다할 리가 없지! 우리 Imcando(임칸도) 드워프들은 그걸 정말 좋아한다네. 아주 최고야!

english: You hand over the pie. Thurgo eats the pie. Thurgo pats his stomach.
translation: 파이를 건넨다. Thurgo(서고)가 파이를 먹는다. 서고가 배를 두드린다.

english: By Guthix! THAT was good pie! Anyone who makes pie like THAT has got to be alright!
translation: Guthix(구식스)께 맹세코! 이거 정말 훌륭한 파이로구먼! 이런 파이를 만드는 사람이라면 좋은 사람일 수밖에 없지!

english: Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 스킬 망토 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: What do you need, human?
Now that I am so skilled at Smithing, can I buy a Skillcape of Smithing from you?
translation: 이제 Smithing(대장일) 실력이 이만큼 늘었으니, Skillcape of Smithing(대장일 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: I reckon so; we master smiths must stick together! I'll give it to you for just 99000 coins.
translation: 그런 것 같군. 우리 대장장이 달인들끼리는 뭉쳐야지! 단돈 99000코인에 주겠네.

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
Too much money? A smith of your calibre should be able to make that amount in an hour!
translation: 너무 비싸다고? 자네 정도 솜씨의 대장장이라면 한 시간이면 그만큼은 벌 텐데!

english: Of course I'll pay you.
All Skillcapes come with a free hood. It's part of a deal: buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 모든 스킬 망토에는 두건이 공짜로 딸려 온다네. 하나 사면 하나 더 주는 거래지. 그러니 내가 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 두게.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭하군! 그 망토를 자랑스럽게 두르게, 친구.

english: I've met another Imcando dwarf.
I very much doubt that [player name]. I'm the last Imcando dwarf left in Gielinor.
translation: 그럴 리가 없네, [player name]. 내가 Gielinor(길리노르)에 남은 마지막 임칸도 드워프일세.

english: No it's true. I was accidentally helping some grave robbers unearth some treasure below Ice Mountain. Long story short, it turned out to be the ruins of Camdozaal.
translation: 아니, 진짜예요. 어쩌다 보니 도굴꾼들이 Ice Mountain(얼음 산) 아래에서 보물을 파내는 걸 도와주게 됐는데, 간단히 말하면 그게 Camdozaal(캄도잘)의 폐허였어요.

english: Camdozaal?
Yes!
I don't believe me ears! Tell me what else you know!
translation: 내 귀를 믿을 수가 없구먼! 또 아는 게 있으면 다 말해 보게!

english: Well there's not much left there really. It's just a ruin.
translation: 음, 사실 거기 남은 건 별로 없어요. 그냥 폐허예요.

english: But there's a lone Imcando dwarf keeping it alive. His name is Ramarno.
translation: 하지만 Imcando(임칸도) 드워프 한 명이 혼자서 그곳을 지키고 있어요. 이름은 Ramarno(라마르노)예요.

english: Ramarno...
He's managed to keep the city going all these years, even with his lack of vision.
translation: 앞을 잘 못 보는데도 그 오랜 세월 동안 도시를 꾸려 왔대요.

english: Thank you for bringing me this news [player name]. I'll need to make some time to see the city with my own eyes.
translation: 이 소식을 전해 줘서 고맙네, [player name]. 시간을 내서 그 도시를 내 눈으로 직접 봐야겠어.

english: What do you make of this, Thurgo?
Thurgo quickly reads the book.
Hmph, who wrote this text? It seems new.
translation: 흠, 이 글은 누가 쓴 건가? 새로 쓴 것 같은데.

english: I-
Nevermind! If you ever plan on going back to this island, I'll happily come along.
translation: 됐네! 자네가 언젠가 이 섬에 다시 갈 생각이라면 기꺼이 따라가겠네.

english: Oh... Umm... Err...
So you believe it could possibly lead to the ancient ruins of your race?
translation: 그러니까 이게 임칸도 드워프의 고대 폐허로 이어질 수도 있다고 생각하시는 거예요?

english: I'll believe it when I see it... Now begone, I've got things to do.
translation: 직접 보기 전엔 안 믿네... 자, 이제 가 보게. 난 할 일이 있어.

english: Alright, Thurgo. I'll see you later.
The Wise Old Man says he's got the information you wanted. Here's his message.
translation: Wise Old Man(현명한 노인)이 원하시던 정보를 구했대요. 여기 그분 메시지예요.

english: Ooh, thanks. I've been hoping he'd send me that information soon, although I wouldn't mind if he'd send me a pie instead!
translation: 오, 고맙네. 그 양반이 그 정보를 곧 보내 주길 기다리고 있었지. 뭐, 정보 대신 파이를 보내 줬어도 난 상관없었겠지만!

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 보상을 주고 싶은데, 자네 소지품에 자리가 없어 보이는군. 자리가 생기면 다시 오게.

english: Some guy died down in the hole just north of my house, and he dropped these herbs. Here, take them.
translation: 우리 집 바로 북쪽에 있는 구덩이에서 어떤 녀석이 죽었는데, 이 약초를 떨어뜨렸더군. 자, 받게.

english: Here's some cash for your time.
I found this while I was mining. Hope you like it.
translation: 광석 캐다가 이걸 찾았네. 마음에 들었으면 좋겠군.

english: Magic isn't really my thing. Here, take these.
translation: 마법은 내 분야가 아니라서 말이야. 자, 이거 받게.

english: Can you make me another of Sir Vyvin's swords?
translation: Sir Vyvin(바이빈 경)의 검을 하나 더 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Would you like a redberry pie?
What is that cape you're wearing?
Can we talk about skillcapes?
translation: 스킬 망토 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요?

english: Sorry, that's too much money.
Of course I'll pay you.
I've met another Imcando dwarf.
Emerald
Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: 그 멋진 뇌를 지키고 싶소? 그렇다면 내 투구가 필요할 것이오.

english: [Fremennik name]! Looking to protect that nice brain of yours? Then you'll be wanting one of my helmets.
translation: [Fremennik name]! 그 멋진 뇌를 지키고 싶소? 그렇다면 내 투구가 필요할 것이오.

english: I'll have a look.
Good choice.
I'm good.
If you're sure.
I'll have a look.
I'm good.
Greetings stranger. If you wish to browse my wares, you will need to be more favoured by the people of Arceuus.
translation: 반갑습니다, 낯선 분. 제 물건을 둘러보시려면 Arceuus(아르세우스) 사람들에게 더 신임을 얻으셔야 합니다.

english: What do you require, traveller? I deal in runes.
translation: 무엇이 필요하십니까, 여행자님? 저는 룬을 취급합니다.

english: Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Let's see what you've got.
I don't need anything.
Hello, Tiadeche.
Hello, Bwana! Would you like to buy some Karambwan?
Yes.
No.
Very well. Let me know if you change your mind.
Yes.
No.
Can I buy a ticket?
There's no need. Under our agreement with the Dorgeshuun, you get free train travel in return for services rendered.
translation: 그럴 필요 없어요. Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)과 맺은 협정에 따라, 그동안 해 주신 일의 대가로 기차를 공짜로 타실 수 있어요.

english: Can I buy a ticket?
You don't need to buy a ticket! You're [player name]! Without you, this train wouldn't exist!
translation: 표를 사실 필요 없어요! [player name] 님이시잖아요! 당신이 없었으면 이 기차는 있지도 않았을 거예요!

english: Just board the train and wait for it to travel to Keldagrim.
translation: 그냥 기차에 타서 Keldagrim(켈다그림)으로 출발할 때까지 기다리세요.

english: Hi. What are you doing out here?
Oh, just looking out at the tide...
What tide?
It's great, isn't it?
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
translation: 안녕하십니까. 은행권을 교환해 드릴까요? 은행권 한 장당 5코인만 받습니다.

english: Yes please.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
Who are you?
I am Tiles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 저는 Tiles(타일스)입니다. 은행권을 실제 물건으로 바꿔 드립니다. 바꾸실 은행권이 있으십니까?

english: No thanks.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
You poke 10 flashing pillars, right? You NOT poke other pillars, right? Okay, you go play now.
translation: 너 반짝이는 기둥 10개 찔러, 알았지? 다른 기둥 안 찔러, 알았지? 좋아, 이제 가서 놀아.

english: Err...what am I supposed to do here again?
translation: 어... 여기서 뭘 해야 한다고 했죠?

english: You gotta poke dem pillars.
What? All of them?
No, no. If you poke dem ones dat don't have a dem flashin' rings, den dats bad.
translation: 아니, 아니. 반짝반짝 고리 없는 기둥 찌르면, 그거 나빠.

english: So I have to poke the pillars that are flashing?
translation: 그러니까 반짝이는 기둥을 찔러야 한다는 거죠?

english: Yer. You do dat ten times, you get prize.
translation: 응. 그거 열 번 하면, 너 상 받아.

english: So...I'm free to go now, right?
Yer, get going. We get break now.
translation: 응, 가. 우리 이제 쉬는 시간.

english: Ok. Err...have a nice break.
Hey, how's it go...
Apples, trout. Maybe some spi... Oh sorry matey, busy getting the grub together for our next voyage. If ye need anything, talk t' Captain Pudi over by the dock.
translation: 사과, trout(송어). 향신료도 좀... 아, 미안하네 친구, 다음 항해 때 먹을 식량 챙기느라 바빠서 말이야. 필요한 게 있으면 부두 쪽에 있는 Captain Pudi(푸디 선장)한테 말해 보라고.

english: I wonder what jelly would be like with cooked eels? Maybe a pie of some sor... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: 익힌 장어에 젤리를 곁들이면 어떤 맛일까? 파이 같은 걸로 만들어 볼... 아, 어이 낯선 양반. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: Crab meat would do wonders in an admir... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: crab meat(게살)을 넣으면 제독 파이가 끝내주게... 아, 어이 낯선 양반. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: Maybe some pineapple. That could enhance the flavour of a summer pi... Oh hey there stranger. What can I do for ye?
translation: pineapple(파인애플)도 좀 넣어 볼까. 그러면 여름 파이 맛이 확 살아날지도... 아, 어이 낯선 양반. 뭘 도와줄까?

english: How was your last fishing trip?
'Twas a good and bad trip.
During the trip, I was cookin' up a nice fish pie for the crew. But then a storm 'it the ship.
translation: 항해 중에 선원들 먹이려고 맛있는 fish pie(생선 파이)를 만들고 있었거든. 그런데 폭풍이 배를 덮쳤지 뭐야.

english: Water came a spewin' through the windows and with the water came some glowing fish. It flew straight into me cooking pie.
translation: 창문으로 물이 콸콸 쏟아져 들어오는데, 그 물이랑 같이 빛나는 물고기가 들어왔어. 그게 내가 굽던 파이 속으로 곧장 날아들었지.

english: I couldn't 'elp it, I 'ad to try it... The taste was amazin'! Never 'ad anythin' like it in me life before.
translation: 참을 수가 있어야지, 먹어 볼 수밖에 없었어... 맛이 기가 막히더라고! 평생 그런 건 먹어 본 적이 없었어.

english: Maybe one day I will make that amazing pie again.
translation: 언젠가 그 끝내주는 파이를 다시 만들어 볼 거야.

english: That sounds great. If you ever do make it again, tell me the recipe so I can make it myself please.
translation: 멋지네요. 혹시 다시 만들게 되면 저도 만들 수 있게 요리법 좀 알려 주세요.

english: Me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 내 요리법은 비밀이라고. 아무한테도 안 알려 줘!

english: On with me story. after trying that amazing pie, the floor boards above fell down and the ship's wheel knocked me out.
translation: 아무튼 하던 얘기 계속하지. 그 끝내주는 파이를 먹고 나서, 위층 바닥 판자가 무너져 내리고 배 조타륜에 맞아서 정신을 잃었어.

english: I woke up in Al Kharid with the others. Pudi and some local fisherfolk helped us out and now we're 'ere. Lots o' mouths t' feed now!
translation: 깨어나 보니 다른 선원들이랑 같이 Al Kharid(알 카리드)에 있더라고. Pudi(푸디)랑 동네 어부들이 우릴 도와줘서 지금 여기 있는 거야. 이제 먹여 살릴 입이 한둘이 아니라고!

english: Anythin' else ya be needin'?
You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: 요리를 정말 좋아하시네요. 요리법 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Unfortunately for ye, me recipes are a secret and I am not sharin' 'em with anyone!
translation: 안됐지만, 내 요리법은 비밀이라고. 아무한테도 안 알려 줘!

english: Aw, please tell me! I've always wanted to try sailor food.
translation: 아, 제발 알려 주세요! 선원 음식은 꼭 한번 먹어 보고 싶었다고요.

english: Ye best become a sailor then.
Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)랑 싸울 때 쓸 만한 팁 있어요?

english: Ye should bring a harpoon t' fish for them harpoonfish. They be very effective against the beast.
translation: harpoon(작살)을 챙겨 가서 harpoonfish(작살고기)를 잡아. 그 괴물한테 아주 잘 먹히거든.

english: Ye could try cooking them too. Helps 'em shoot true.
translation: 요리해 봐도 좋아. 그러면 더 정확하게 날아가거든.

english: I have to go.
See ya around!
Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?
translation: 이 힘든 시기에 달걀 하나 드실래요?

english: A damp egg! What a tragedy!
translation: damp egg(축축한 알)잖아! 이런 비극이 있나!

english: What?
A fate most foul has befallen our eggy friend 'ere!
translation: 우리 알 친구한테 몹쓸 운명이 닥쳤구먼!

english: Wait a min-
This egg, once so full o' promise, set out on an adventure t' become somethin' more...
translation: 한때 희망으로 가득 찼던 이 알은, 더 나은 무언가가 되기 위해 모험을 떠났건만...

english: ...alas, it fell victim t' the briny depths thanks t' Tempoross. That fiend!
translation: ...아아, Tempoross(템포로스) 때문에 짠물 바다 깊은 곳의 제물이 되고 말았구나. 그 악마 같은 놈!

english: Perhaps a cake, this egg dreamt t' be? We shall never know, for a damp egg is only good as a solemn reminder of the things we've lost.
translation: 이 알은 혹시 케이크가 되는 꿈을 꿨을까? 이젠 알 길이 없지. 축축한 알은 우리가 잃은 것들을 엄숙하게 떠올리게 하는 것 말고는 아무 쓸모가 없으니까.

english: Wow. You really like eggs, don't you?
Aye, they truly are the most majestic an' versatile item in the culinary world. An inspiration t' us all!
translation: 그렇고말고. 달걀이야말로 요리 세계에서 가장 위엄 있고 쓰임새 많은 재료야. 우리 모두의 영감이라고!

english: Timallus sniffles.
There there, it'll be okay.
Thank ye, friend.
Oh a gloriously dry egg! What a gift!
translation: 오, 눈부시게 보송보송한 알이잖아! 이런 선물이 다 있나!

english: Thank ye!
You're welcome!
Would you like a salmon?
Wha' am I supposed t' do wit' a raw salmon?
translation: raw salmon(날연어)를 가지고 나더러 뭘 하라는 거야?

english: Cook and eat it, of course.
Do I look like some sort o' on demand chef t' ye.
translation: 내가 무슨 주문만 하면 요리해 주는 요리사로 보이나.

english: Fine, I'll take my salmon elsewhere then.
Would you like a freshly cooked salmon?
Aye, I be very hungry today. Skipped breakfast.
translation: 그래, 오늘 배가 엄청 고프거든. 아침을 걸렀어.

english: Thanks a lot, landlubber. I appreciate it.
translation: 정말 고마워, 뭍사람. 고맙게 잘 먹을게.

english: What do you make of this egg?
AAAHH!!
What is it?
That egg!
'Tis horrifyin'!
Just looks like an egg to me...
Cautiously, Timallus peers more closely at the egg before recoiling suddenly.
translation: Timallus(티말루스)가 조심스럽게 알을 더 가까이 들여다보다가 갑자기 움찔 물러선다.

english: Shiver me timbers!
That there egg that ye unfortunately possess 'as a spooky soul.
translation: 자네가 불행히도 갖고 있는 그 알에는 으스스한 영혼이 깃들어 있어.

english: Surely an egg doesn't have a soul-
An omen, perhaps? Is our fight against Tempoross about t' take a turn for the worse?
translation: 흉조일까? Tempoross(템포로스)와의 싸움이 더 나쁜 쪽으로 흘러가려는 걸까?

english: Perhaps it's even bigger than that...
Look, I was just given this egg as a trick while Trick- or-Treating. It's just a joke!
translation: 저기요, 이 달걀은 그냥 트릭 오어 트릿 하다가 장난으로 받은 거예요. 그냥 농담이라고요!

english: A cruel trick is what it be! I wouldn't trust whoever gave yetthat... thing!
translation: 잔인한 장난이지! 그... 물건을 준 놈은 절대 믿지 마.

english: There be shady dealings goin' on there, me friend, mark me words!
translation: 거기 뭔가 수상한 꿍꿍이가 있다고, 친구. 내 말 명심해!

english: If you say so...
How was your last fishing trip?
You really like cooking. Can you share any recipes with me?
translation: 요리를 정말 좋아하시네요. 요리법 좀 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?
translation: Tempoross(템포로스)랑 싸울 때 쓸 만한 팁 있어요?

english: I have to go.
Good Day, how can I help you?
I was just wondering what you were up to.
I work for Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service. It's a growing business you know. We get more customers every day!
translation: 저는 Aluft Aloft Gnome Food Delivery Service(알루프트 알로프트 노움 음식 배달 서비스)에서 일해요. 쑥쑥 크는 사업이랍니다. 손님이 날마다 늘고 있어요!

english: So do you have any spare jobs then?
translation: 그럼 남는 일자리 같은 거 있어요?

english: Aluft Gianne jnr. is in charge - he'll be able to help you.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어) 님이 책임자예요. 그분이 도와주실 거예요.

english: Thanks.
Have a nice day.
Heya! What can I get you?
What ales are you serving?
Well, we've got Asgarnian Ale, Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout, all for only 3 coins.
translation: 음, Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일), Wizard's Mind Bomb(마법사의 마인드 밤), Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트)가 있는데, 전부 단돈 3코인이에요.

english: One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I said 3 coins! You haven't got 3 coins!
Sorry, I'll come back another day.
Thanks, Tina.
I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주실래요?

english: I don't feel like any of those.
I've got this beer glass...
We'll buy it for a couple of coins if you're interested.
translation: 원하시면 코인 두어 개에 사 드릴게요.

english: Okay, sure.
There you go.
Thanks!
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 저는 빈 맥주잔이 좋거든요.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Ooh, we'll buy those off you if you're interested. 2 coins per glass.
translation: 오, 원하시면 저희가 사 드릴게요. 잔 하나에 2코인이에요.

english: Thanks!
Party! Party!
Something's happening in the party room!
translation: party room(파티 룸)에서 뭔가 벌어지고 있어요!

english: Everyone get to the party room!
What's happening in the party room?
translation: party room(파티 룸)에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는 거예요?

english: Someone's having a big party!
Get to the party room NOW!
translation: 지금 당장 party room(파티 룸)으로 가요!

english: Get to the party room!
Get to the party room quick!
Big value items in the party room now!
translation: 지금 party room(파티 룸)에 값진 물건들이 있어요!

english: Quick! Get to the party room!
One Asgarnian Ale, please.
translation: Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일) 한 잔 주세요.

english: I'll try the Mind Bomb.
Can I have a Dwarven Stout?
translation: Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트) 한 잔 주실래요?

english: I don't feel like any of those.
What ales are you serving?
I've got this beer glass...
Okay, sure.
No thanks, I like empty beer glasses.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 저는 빈 맥주잔이 좋거든요.

english: I've got these beer glasses...
Creeespy frogs' legs! Get your creeeespy frogs' legs! You want some crispy frogs' legs? Just 10gp.
translation: 바사아삭 개구리 다리! 바사아아삭 개구리 다리 사세요! 바삭바삭한 개구리 다리 드실래요? 단돈 10gp!

english: Yes please!
But I don't have enough money on me.
Looks like your hands are full. You'll have to free up some inventory space before I sell you anything.
translation: 손이 꽉 찼네요. 뭘 팔기 전에 소지품 칸을 좀 비워 주셔야겠어요.

english: There you go.
No thanks.
Crispy!
Creeeespy frogs' legs!
Get your crispy frogs' legs!
Frogs' legs!
Crispy frogs' legs!
Yes please.
No thanks.

translation: 안녕하세요! 저의 특별한 골동품 부티크에 어서 오세요.

english: What do you do here?

I'm a specialist at identifying rare and antique weapons, specifically swords, but I plan to branch out. If you have any old and rusty weapons that you want me to check out, just show them to me, pay me 100 Gold and
translation: 저는 희귀한 골동품 무기, 특히 검을 감정하는 전문가예요. 앞으로 분야를 넓혀 볼 생각이고요. 감정받고 싶은 오래되고 녹슨 무기가 있으면 저한테 보여 주고 100골드를 내세요. 그러면

english: I'll see if you have an antique on your hands.
translation: 손에 든 게 골동품인지 아닌지 봐 드릴게요.

english: I can also repair some antique weapons and armours, just show me the item and I'll let you know if I can repair it and for how much.
translation: 골동품 무기와 방어구 중 일부는 수리도 해 드려요. 물건을 보여 주시면 수리할 수 있는지, 비용은 얼마인지 알려 드릴게요.

english: What's involved?

Well, pay me 100 Gold and I'll see if any rusty swords that you've found are actually worth anything. Some of them might be worth some money! If it's an antique item though, I reserve the right to purchase it
translation: 음, 100골드를 내시면 찾아오신 녹슨 검이 실제로 값어치가 있는지 봐 드려요. 돈이 꽤 되는 것도 있을 수 있어요! 다만 골동품이라면, 저는 그걸

english: immediately for adding to my own personal collection. I'll give you fair price for it.
translation: 제 개인 소장품에 넣으려고 그 자리에서 사들일 권리가 있어요. 값은 공정하게 쳐 드릴게요.

english: What do I get from this?

If I can reclaim the sword with my own specialist skills, I'll return it to you in peak condition. If it's an antique, I'll just give you what I think it's worth and I generally pay quite well. However, if it's just a piece of junk, I'll
translation: 제 전문 기술로 검을 되살릴 수 있으면 최상의 상태로 돌려드려요. 골동품이라면 제가 생각하는 값을 쳐 드리는데, 대체로 꽤 후하게 드리는 편이에요. 하지만 그냥 고물이라면,

english: simply give you the bad news and get rid of the item for you.
translation: 안타까운 소식만 전해 드리고 물건은 제가 대신 처분해 드려요.

english: Ok, I'll give it a go!
Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have any swords that need to be identified.
translation: 미안해요 친구, 감정할 검을 갖고 계신 것 같지 않네요.

english: Sorry my friend, but you don't seem to have enough money to cover my fee!
translation: 미안해요 친구, 수수료를 낼 돈이 모자라신 것 같네요!

english: Which would you like to identify?
Ok, thanks.
There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, bronze sword(청동 검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze long sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, bronze long sword(청동 장검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be an iron sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, iron sword(철 검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a long sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, long sword(장검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, steel sword(강철 검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel long sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, steel long sword(강철 장검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, black sword(흑철 검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black longsword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, black longsword(흑철 장검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, mithril sword(미스릴 검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril long sword.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, mithril long sword(미스릴 장검)으로 밝혀졌어요.

english: Sorry my friend, but the item wasn't worth anything. I've disposed of it for you.
translation: 미안해요 친구, 아무 값어치도 없는 물건이었어요. 제가 처분해 드렸어요.

english: Wow! The item you gave me was a very rare antique...no real use...but hey, it's worth some money!
translation: 와! 주신 물건이 아주 희귀한 골동품이었어요... 딱히 쓸 데는 없지만... 그래도 돈은 꽤 돼요!

english: That's a fair price for the item! I'll add it to my collection!
translation: 이 물건에 딱 공정한 값이에요! 제 소장품에 넣어야겠어요!

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a bronze scimitar.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, bronze scimitar(청동 시미터)로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be an iron scimitar.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, iron scimitar(철 시미터)로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a steel scimitar.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, steel scimitar(강철 시미터)로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a black scimitar.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, black scimitar(흑철 시미터)로 밝혀졌어요.

english: There you go my friend, it turned out to be a mithril scimitar.
translation: 자 여기요 친구, mithril scimitar(미스릴 시미터)로 밝혀졌어요.

english: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide. Do you have some?
translation: Wizard Cromperty(마법사 크롬퍼티)가 iron oxide(산화철)을 좀 구해 오라고 보냈어요. 갖고 계세요?

english: As a matter of fact, I do! However, it's the last in stock and I'm not likely to get more for a while so it's highly prized amongst the wizards at the moment.
translation: 마침 있어요! 그런데 이게 마지막 재고라 한동안 더 들어올 것 같지 않아서, 요즘 마법사들 사이에서 아주 귀한 몸이에요.

english: It's not easy to get so much rust together, even if I do come across it more often than most people with cleaning these rusty swords up!
translation: 녹을 이만큼 모으기가 쉽지 않거든요. 이 녹슨 검들을 닦다 보니 남들보다는 자주 손에 넣긴 하지만요!

english: Rust? What do you mean? How much does it cost?
Yes, iron oxide is more commonly referred to as rust. As for a price, hmmm...well...let me think now...I could give it to you for the price of...
translation: 네, 산화철은 흔히 녹이라고 부르죠. 값은, 흐음... 글쎄요... 어디 보자... 이 값이면 드릴 수 있겠네요...

english: One small favour!
Groan!!!

I need a nice mattress to sleep on! I haven't had a decent night's sleep in an ice-age...could you take this stodgy mattress down to Rantz in the ogre area and ask him to fill it with prime chompy bird feathers please?
translation: 편히 잘 수 있는 좋은 매트리스가 필요해요! 빙하기 이후로 제대로 자 본 적이 없다니까요... 이 stodgy mattress(딱딱한 매트리스)를 오우거 지역에 있는 Rantz(랜츠)한테 가져가서 최상급 chompy bird(촘피 새) 깃털로 채워 달라고 부탁해 주실래요?

english: So, let me get this straight.
You want me to traipse ALL the way down past the ogre city with some flea infested mattress, to some hermit ogre, who can't shoot a chompy bird to save his life, so that you'll give me a pot of rust?
translation: 벼룩 들끓는 매트리스를 들고 오우거 도시 너머까지 그 먼 길을 터덜터덜 걸어가서, 촘피 새 한 마리 제대로 못 쏘는 은둔자 오우거한테 가라는 거죠? 그래야 녹 한 단지를 주신다고요?

english: Well, er, I wouldn't have said it quite that way...
translation: 음, 어, 저라면 그렇게까지 말하진 않았을 텐데...

english: Okay, I'll do it!
Great, many thanks indeed! Here's the mattress!
Sorry, I just don't want to do it.
Well, that's a shame, but come back and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 음, 아쉽네요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: I have the mattress!
Great! Let's have a look then.
Great! Here's the iron oxide I promised you!
translation: 좋아요! 약속한 iron oxide(산화철) 여기 있어요!

english: What do you do here?
What's involved?
What do I get from this?
Ok, I'll give it a go!
The sword
The scimitar
Ok, thanks.

english: Okay, I'll do it!
Sorry, I just don't want to do it.
I have the mattress.
Braaar! Jogres!
mmm ... Jogre bones ...
Leave me alone! Can't you see I'm a mad priest?
translation: 날 내버려 둬! 내가 미친 사제인 거 안 보여?

english: Braaar! Tinsay's the name!
Tinsay, I bring good news. Trufitus has communed with the gods -  your village is once again safe.
translation: Tinsay(틴세이), 좋은 소식을 가져왔어요. Trufitus(트루피투스)가 신들과 교감했대요. 마을은 다시 안전해요.

english: Your father requests that you return to the village.
I will return only once I have repaired the tribal statue. Bones!!
translation: tribal statue(부족 조각상)을 고치기 전엔 안 돌아가. 뼈!!

english: Where is the tribal statue?
Just near my father's hut.
But that's <col=800000>in <col=000000>the village!
I know.
So what are you doing here?
I'm ... er ... collecting materials to repair the statue with.
translation: 나는... 어... 조각상 고칠 재료를 모으는 중이야.

english: And I suppose you want me to fetch them for you?
translation: 그리고 그걸 저보고 가져다 달라는 거겠죠?

english: Good idea! Yes!
You mean you were just sitting here waiting for people to bring you things you need?
translation: 그러니까 여기 앉아서 필요한 걸 누가 갖다주기만 기다리고 있었다는 거예요?

english: Yes...
And you don't see anything wrong with that?
No...
Right ... what do you need?
Tinsay pauses and mutters to himself.
Hmm ... I think I need banana in Karamjan rum.

english: I see. And you're going to use this to repair the statue?
But of course! Bwahaha!
... I'll be back later.
Have you found my banana in Karamjan rum yet?

Yes, I have it right here.

No.

Hello, Tinsay.
Why hello there! What are you doing back here?
translation: 아이고, 안녕! 여긴 또 왜 왔어?

english: Just passing through.
Hello there; I see you're qualified. Come to help us out?
translation: 어서 오게. 자격을 갖췄구먼. 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Hello! You're that student who recently finished all three Earth Sciences exams, aren't you? Come to help us out?
translation: 오! 자네가 Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험 세 개를 얼마 전에 전부 통과한 그 학생이로군? 우리를 도우러 왔나?

english: Greetings, my dear [sir/madam]. Have you come to give us a hand?
translation: 반갑네, [sir/madam]. 우리 일손을 좀 거들러 왔나?

english: Yes, how can I help out?

Well, you'll need to get your equipment first - it's all there on the tool rack. Use what you learned from your Earth Sciences exams. You'll need to be wearing your leather gloves and boots as well as have access to
translation: 음, 우선 장비부터 챙겨야 하네. 전부 저기 도구 선반에 있지. Earth Sciences(지구과학) 시험에서 배운 걸 떠올려 보게. leather gloves(가죽 장갑)과 장화를 착용하고, 그 밖에도

english: your trowel, rock pick and specimen brush.
translation: trowel(모종삽), rock pick(암석 망치), specimen brush(표본 솔)을 갖고 있어야 하네.

english: I see you have your equipment - well done.

To really give us a hand, you could clean some finds for us. They're mostly done - just some fine work to finish off. Take a find from the pile that the workmen are bringing in, then there are spare tables over there
translation: 제대로 도와주고 싶다면 발굴품 손질을 좀 해 주게. 거의 다 끝났고 마무리 손질만 남았네. 인부들이 날라 오는 더미에서 발굴품을 하나 가져가게. 저쪽에 남는 탁자가 있으니

english: to clean them on. If you find anything interesting, let us know and we'll see if it's good enough to go on display.
translation: 거기서 손질하면 되네. 흥미로운 게 나오면 알려 주게. 전시할 만한지 살펴보겠네.

english: I found something interesting.
Oh? Let's take a look...
I found this pretty necklace.
Interesting...yes...yes...hmmm.... It looks like it's enchanted.
translation: 흥미롭군...그래...그래...흐음.... 마법이 걸려 있는 것 같네.

english: With what?

Oh, I think it's just a benign teleportation spell. I tinker in magic when I'm not doing archaeology. I can teach you how to make more necklaces like this. Amazing that they had this kind of knowledge back then.
translation: 오, 그냥 해롭지 않은 순간이동 주문인 것 같네. 고고학을 하지 않을 때는 마법을 좀 만지작거리거든. 이런 목걸이를 더 만드는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있네. 그 시절에 이런 지식이 있었다니 놀랍구먼.

english: That would be good. Where is the teleport to?
Hmm...all the indications are that it's somewhere to the east of us, but I'm not sure how far. Perhaps it was a teleport back to Saranthium. Let me just take a closer look.
translation: 흠...여러 정황으로 보아 여기서 동쪽 어딘가인 것 같은데, 얼마나 먼지는 모르겠네. 어쩌면 Saranthium(사란시움)으로 돌아가는 순간이동이었는지도 모르지. 좀 더 자세히 살펴보겠네.

english: So I just make a ruby necklace and use five fire runes and one cosmic rune to enchant it.
translation: 그러니까 ruby necklace(루비 목걸이)를 만들고, fire runes(화염 룬) 다섯 개와 cosmic rune(우주 룬) 한 개로 마법을 부여하면 되는 거네요.

english: Yes, indeed. Well done, youngster, thanks for helping us.
translation: 그렇지, 바로 그거야. 잘했네, 젊은이. 도와줘서 고맙네.

english: I've cleaned this old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 이 old coin(오래된 동전)을 손질했는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Oh my! What a wonderful find! If this is what I believe it to be, it would allow us to date the Dig Site city.
translation: 이럴 수가! 정말 대단한 발견이야! 이게 내 생각대로라면 Dig Site(발굴 현장) 도시의 연대를 알아낼 수 있겠어.

english: And look here, it has the name of the city too! Saranthium! That must be during the Saradominist occupation. This is a wonderful find. Please take it and place it in display case 45.
translation: 그리고 여길 보게, 도시 이름까지 새겨져 있군! Saranthium(사란시움)! 사라도민파가 점령하던 시기의 것이 틀림없어. 정말 훌륭한 발견일세. 이걸 가져가서 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣어 주게.

english: Right, display case 45 it is...
Back again? Have you put the old coin in display case 45 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old coin(오래된 동전)은 display case(진열장) 45번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now
You've already shown me one of those, but it was in better condition. It's in the display case over there. You can pop this one in the finds crate over in the corner.
translation: 그건 이미 하나 보여 줬잖나. 그때 것이 상태가 더 좋았지. 저기 진열장에 있네. 이건 구석에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

english: I found this really old coin - is it of any use?
translation: 정말 오래된 동전을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: What have we here?

Oh! This is very interesting...and confusing at the same time. This coin means that the city that we're excavating on the Digsite - Saranthium - was actually inhabited much, much earlier by followers of Zamorak,
translation: 오! 이거 아주 흥미롭군...그러면서도 헷갈리는구먼. 이 동전은 우리가 Digsite(발굴 현장)에서 발굴 중인 도시, Saranthium(사란시움)에 그보다 훨씬, 훨씬 이전부터 Zamorak(자모락)의 추종자들이 살았다는 뜻이네.

english: at which time, the city was known as Senntisten.
translation: 그 시절 이 도시는 Senntisten(센티스텐)이라고 불렸지.

english: This is a most remarkable discovery, as we have other evidence indicating that Zarosian followers were resident before the Saradominists took over, but it also seems that Zamorakian forces used it during a battle of some
translation: 정말 놀라운 발견일세. 사라도민파가 도시를 차지하기 전에 자로스파가 살았다는 다른 증거는 이미 있지만, 자모락 세력도 어떤 전투 중에 이곳을 썼던 것

english: sort. Still, it allows us to roughly date when the city changed from following Zaros and Zamorak to following Saradomin. Put it in display case 44.
translation: 같군. 어쨌든 이걸로 도시가 Zaros(자로스)와 자모락을 섬기다가 Saradomin(사라도민)을 섬기게 된 시기를 대강 알 수 있네. display case(진열장) 44번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 44 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient coin in display case 44 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient coin(고대 동전)은 display case(진열장) 44번에 넣었나?

english: No, I'll go do that now.
I found this crumbly old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 이 푸석푸석한 낡은 장식을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... That looks like an altar piece. Hmm, yes...from the early Saradominist worshippers by the looks of it. Quite delicate, too. Put it in display case 37.
translation: 아아... 제단 장식 같군. 흠, 그래...생김새로 보아 초기 사라도민파 신자들의 것이야. 꽤 깨지기 쉬워 보이기도 하고. display case(진열장) 37번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 37 it is!
Back again? Have you put the ancient symbol in display case 37 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? ancient symbol(고대 상징)은 display case(진열장) 37번에 넣었나?

english: I found this really old decoration - is it of any use?
translation: 정말 오래된 장식을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Wow!
That's in rather good condition, isn't it? An old altar decoration by the looks of things, from the Saradominist city no doubt. Put it in display case 36.
translation: 상태가 꽤 좋지 않나? 보아하니 오래된 제단 장식이로군. 사라도민파 도시의 것이 틀림없어. display case(진열장) 36번에 넣어 주게.

english: Case 36 it is!
Back again? Have you put the old symbol in display case 36 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? old symbol(오래된 상징)은 display case(진열장) 36번에 넣었나?

english: I found this piece of pottery - is it of any use?
translation: 이 pottery(도자기) 조각을 찾았는데, 쓸모가 있을까요?

english: Ahh... Oh! Hmm...yes...made by Zaros worshippers, by the looks of it. Beautifully-shaped. It looks as if this would go nicely in display case 22. This piece reinforces our evidence that the city was occupied by

english: Zarosians before Saradominists.
translation: 자로스파가 먼저 살았다는 우리 증거가 더 확실해지는군.

english: Case 22 it is!
Back again? Have you put the pottery in display case 22 yet?
translation: 또 왔나? pottery(도자기)는 display case(진열장) 22번에 넣었나?

translation: 아아, 그래, 그건 많이 나오지. 중요한 건 아니야. 전시품에도 이미 몇 개 있고. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

I cleaned up this old vase.
Ah, the vases... I've lost count of how many we've found of those... The only completely intact one is in the display case already. Just add it to the crate of finds over near the door.
translation: 아, 꽃병이라... 그건 몇 개나 나왔는지 셀 수도 없네... 완전히 멀쩡한 건 하나뿐인데 그건 이미 진열장에 있지. 문 근처에 있는 발굴품 상자에 넣어 두게.

You've met your nemosis.

Hey! Tell me something I don't know.
translation: 저기! 내가 모르는 얘기 하나 해 줘.

translation: 계절은 오고 가도 나는 결코 변하지 않는다.

I am the Spirit of the Sea, not a writer. No need to overanalyse!
translation: 나는 Spirit of the Sea(바다의 정령)이지 작가가 아니다. 깊이 파고들 것 없어!

english: I'm sorry, you're right. Writing with those arms can't be easy anyway.
translation: 미안, 네 말이 맞아. 어차피 그런 팔로 글 쓰기도 쉽지 않겠지.

english: Don't push it, human.
Tiny Tempor, use Splash!
Excuse me?
Never mind, it won't be very effective anyway.
You humans will forever remain a mystery to me.
translation: 너희 인간들은 영원히 이해할 수 없는 존재로구나.

english: Blub blub blub!
Splish, splash!
Stay hydrated adventurer, or else...
translation: 수분 보충 잘해라, 모험가. 안 그러면...

Let's see what you have.
I'll pass.
Very well.
Let's see what you have.
I'll pass.
Hello.
Good day, your Royal Highness.
Hello!

translation: 특정 업적을 기록해 두는 일지예요. Varrock(바록)과 그 주변 지역에서 꽤 쓸모 있는 것들을 알아내는 데 도움이 되죠. 충분히 탐험하다 보면 결국 주민들이

translation: 과제 목록은 사이드 패널에서 볼 수 있어요.

english: I have a question about my Achievement diary.
translation: Achievement diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

Thanks!

english: Battlestaves per day
Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!
translation: 상급 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to adamant and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to adamant, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff
translation: 초급과 중급 혜택에 더해, Edgeville(에지빌) 용광로를 쓸 때 아다만트까지의 광석을 10% 확률로 두 개씩 캐고, 아다만트까지의 주괴를 10% 확률로 두 개씩 제련할 수 있어요. Zaff(자프)는

translation: 하루에 Battlestaves(전투 지팡이)를 60개씩 들여놓고, Cooking guild(요리 길드)의 은행도 이용할 수 있어요.

english: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!
translation: 엘리트 보상에 대해 더 알려 주세요!

english: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, you have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to runite and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to runite, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will stock

english: How do I claim the rewards?
Just complete the tasks in the Varrock area so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
translation: 바록 지역의 과제를 완료해서 체크 표시가 되면, 저한테 와서 말을 걸어 보상을 받으세요.

english: Bye!
See you later.
Can I have another Varrock platebody?
translation: Varrock platebody(바록 판금 갑옷)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Toby gives you another Varrock platebody.
translation: Toby(토비)가 Varrock platebody(바록 판금 갑옷)을 하나 더 건네준다.

translation: Varrock Achievement Diary(바록 업적 일지)의 초급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!
