Yes please!

This armour is a symbol of your exploration of Varrock. You now have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to coal and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to steel, when using the Edgeville
translation: 이 갑옷은 바록을 탐험한 증표예요. 이제 Edgeville(에지빌) 용광로를 쓸 때 석탄까지의 광석을 10% 확률로 두 개씩 캐고, 강철까지의 주괴를 10% 확률로 두 개씩 제련할 수 있어요.

english: furnace. Zaff will stock 15 Battlestaves per day.
translation: Zaff(자프)는 하루에 Battlestaves(전투 지팡이)를 15개씩 들여놓을 거예요.

english: Wow, thanks!
I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Varrock achievement diary!
translation: Varrock achievement diary(바록 업적 일지)의 중급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Varrock armour for you. You now have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to mithril and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to mithril, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will
translation: Varrock armour(바록 갑옷)을 강화해 드렸어요. 이제 Edgeville(에지빌) 용광로를 쓸 때 미스릴까지의 광석을 10% 확률로 두 개씩 캐고, 미스릴까지의 주괴를 10% 확률로 두 개씩 제련할 수 있어요. Zaff(자프)는

english: stock 30 Battlestaves per day.
I've completed all of the hard tasks in my Varrock achievement diary!
translation: Varrock achievement diary(바록 업적 일지)의 상급 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: I've upgraded your Varrock armour for you. You now have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to adamant and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to adamant, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff
translation: Varrock armour(바록 갑옷)을 강화해 드렸어요. 이제 Edgeville(에지빌) 용광로를 쓸 때 아다만트까지의 광석을 10% 확률로 두 개씩 캐고, 아다만트까지의 주괴를 10% 확률로 두 개씩 제련할 수 있어요. Zaff(자프)는

english: will stock 60 Battlestaves per day and you can now access the bank at the Cooking guild.
translation: 하루에 Battlestaves(전투 지팡이)를 60개씩 들여놓고, 이제 Cooking guild(요리 길드)의 은행도 이용할 수 있어요.

english: I've completed all of the elite tasks in my Varrock achievement diary!
translation: Varrock achievement diary(바록 업적 일지)의 엘리트 과제를 전부 완료했어요!

english: You need to complete all of the easy, medium and hard tasks too before I can reward you for the elite task set.
translation: 엘리트 과제 보상을 드리려면 초급, 중급, 상급 과제도 전부 완료하셔야 해요.

english: I can see that, well done! You've completed all of the tasks in the Varrock area! Here's your reward!
translation: 그렇네요, 잘하셨어요! 바록 지역의 과제를 전부 완료하셨군요! 여기 보상이에요!

english: I've upgraded your Varrock armour for you. You now have a 10% chance of mining two ores at once up to runite and a 10% chance of smelting 2 bars at once up to runite, when using the Edgeville furnace. Zaff will
translation: Varrock armour(바록 갑옷)을 강화해 드렸어요. 이제 Edgeville(에지빌) 용광로를 쓸 때 루나이트까지의 광석을 10% 확률로 두 개씩 캐고, 루나이트까지의 주괴를 10% 확률로 두 개씩 제련할 수 있어요. Zaff(자프)는

english: stock 120 Battlestaves per day and the plate functions as a Prospector top.
translation: 하루에 Battlestaves(전투 지팡이)를 120개씩 들여놓고, 판금 갑옷이 Prospector top(탐광꾼 상의) 역할도 해요.

english: Who are you?
I have a question about my Achievement Diary
translation: Achievement Diary(업적 일지)에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요

english: What is the Achievement Diary?
What are the rewards?
Easy Rewards.
Medium Rewards.
Hard Rewards.
Elite Rewards.
How do I claim the rewards?
Bye!
Can I have another Varrock platebody?
translation: Varrock platebody(바록 판금 갑옷)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Looking to trade gems? You're in the right place if so.
translation: 보석을 거래하고 싶으세요? 그렇다면 제대로 찾아오셨어요.

english: Let's trade.
No thanks.
In that case, timoiva to you.
Let's trade.
No thanks.
Hello again. Can you tell me about this training area?
translation: 또 뵙네요. 이 훈련장에 대해 알려 주실래요?

english: Of course, if you enter the rift next to me, you'll find a large dungeon filled with four kinds of beasts. You will recognise them from the gauntlet in which you helped me.
translation: 물론이죠. 제 옆의 rift(균열)로 들어가면 네 종류의 짐승이 가득한 커다란 던전이 나와요. 당신이 저를 도와줬던 그 건틀릿에서 본 녀석들이라 알아볼 거예요.

english: OK, I didn't have too many problems beating them before.
translation: 좋아요, 전에 그 녀석들을 이길 때는 별로 어렵지 않았어요.

english: You might find it harder now! At least one is bound to cause you some sort of threat. Be careful! There isn't much in the way of items or treasure down there, it's purely for practicing your combat!
translation: 지금은 더 힘들지도 몰라요! 적어도 하나는 분명 꽤 위협이 될 거예요. 조심하세요! 아래에는 아이템이나 보물이 별로 없어요. 순전히 전투 연습을 위한 곳이니까요!

english: Thanks.
Hello.
Greetings. What can I do for you?
What are you doing here?
I'm conducting important business here for the Kourend Council.
translation: Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)를 위해 중요한 업무를 수행하고 있습니다.

english: Is there anything I can help you with?
There is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 도움이 좀 필요한 일이 있긴 합니다. 저는 Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)를 대표해 Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에서 벌어지는 수상한 일들을 조사하러 왔습니다.

english: What are you investigating?
Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance, but up until now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에는 여러 갱단이 자리 잡고 있습니다. 골칫거리이긴 하지만 지금까지는 처리하는 데 별 어려움이 없었지요.

english: So what's the problem?
A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time, but this one is different.
translation: 최근 Saviours of Kourend(쿠렌드의 구원자들)이라는 새 갱단이 생겼습니다. 갱단이야 늘 생겼다 사라지니 놀랄 일은 아니지만, 이번 갱단은 다릅니다.

english: How so?
The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
translation: Saviours of Kourend(쿠렌드의 구원자들)은 다른 갱단들을 계속 흡수하고 있습니다. 불과 몇 주 만에 Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 가장 큰 갱단이 되었고, 날마다 가입자가 늘고 있지요.

english: The talk amongst the people is that it's all down to their leader, a mysterious figure known only as the Queen of Thieves.
translation: 사람들 말로는 모두 그 우두머리 덕분이라더군요. Queen of Thieves(도둑들의 여왕)이라는 이름으로만 알려진 수수께끼의 인물입니다.

english: Nice name. Why doesn't the ruler of Port Piscarilius do something about this?
translation: 이름 멋지네요. 그런데 Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)의 통치자는 왜 아무 조치도 안 하는 거예요?

english: Shauna Piscarilius is the ruler of Port Piscarilius, but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.
translation: Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)의 통치자는 Shauna Piscarilius(쇼나 피스카릴리우스)인데, 자기 땅을 돌보기는커녕 그 배를 타고 쏘다니느라 바쁩니다.

english: Fair enough. So what do you need me for?
translation: 그렇군요. 그래서 제가 뭘 하면 되죠?

english: Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the Queen and capture her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently, I don't look the part.
translation: 원래 계획은 제가 갱단에 잠입해 여왕에게 접근한 뒤 붙잡는 것이었습니다. 하지만 전혀 진전이 없었지요. 듣자 하니 제가 그쪽 사람처럼 보이지 않는답니다.

english: Yeah not sure what that's all about. You clearly fit right in here.
translation: 그러게요, 왜 그런지 모르겠네요. 여기랑 완전 잘 어울리시는데.

english: Quite right. They're quite insistent though, so someone else will need to give it a go. You look like you might be just the type they're after.
translation: 그렇지요. 그런데 그들이 꽤 완강해서 다른 누군가가 나서야 합니다. 당신이라면 딱 그들이 찾는 부류처럼 보이는군요.

english: What are you trying to say?
That you look poor.
Oh...
Anyway if you're up for the task you'll need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
translation: 아무튼 이 일을 맡겠다면 Saviours of Kourend(쿠렌드의 구원자들)에 잠입해 Queen of Thieves(도둑들의 여왕)을 찾아낸 다음, 체포해서 제게 데려오십시오.

english: So are you up for it?
Absolutely.
Excellent. The Saviours of Kourend must have their headquarters somewhere nearby. You should ask around town and see if anyone knows where they are. Good luck.
translation: 훌륭합니다. Saviours of Kourend(쿠렌드의 구원자들)의 본거지는 분명 이 근처 어딘가에 있을 겁니다. 마을을 돌아다니며 그곳을 아는 사람이 있는지 물어보십시오. 행운을 빕니다.

english: Nah.
Fair enough. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠습니다. 마음이 바뀌면 저는 여기 있겠습니다.

english: What's the Kourend Council?
Although it's called a kingdom, Great Kourend hasn't actually had a king for many years. These days Kourend is a republic and it is ruled by the Kourend Council.
translation: 왕국이라고는 하지만 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에는 오랫동안 왕이 없었습니다. 요즘 쿠렌드는 공화국이고, Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)가 다스리지요.

english: The Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
translation: 의회는 시민이 4년마다 뽑는 의원 네 명으로 구성됩니다. 현재 의원은 Councillor Hughes(휴스 의원), Councillor Unkar(운카르 의원), Councillor Orson(오슨 의원), Councillor Andrews(앤드루스 의원)입니다.

english: I see. So what are you investigating?
I'm looking for a quest.
Well there is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: 도움이 좀 필요한 일이 있긴 합니다. 하지만 당신은 이 일에 적합한 사람이 아닌 것 같군요.

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here on behalf of the Kourend Council to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 도움이 좀 필요한 일이 있긴 합니다. 저는 Kourend Council(쿠렌드 의회)를 대표해 Port Piscarilius(포트 피스카릴리우스)에서 벌어지는 수상한 일들을 조사하러 왔습니다.

english: Well good luck with that.
Nothing thanks.
Very well. Until next time.
Let's talk about my quest.
Very well. How goes things?
I haven't had any luck finding the Queen of Thieves. However, I've come across this letter which you might find interesting.
translation: Queen of Thieves(도둑들의 여왕)은 아직 못 찾았어요. 그래도 흥미로워하실 만한 이 편지를 손에 넣었어요.

english: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the council immediately.
translation: 맙소사! Queen of Thieves(도둑들의 여왕)은 잊으십시오. 이 편지가 사실이라면 Councillor Hughes(휴스 의원)이 그 사악한 Disciples of Yama(야마의 사도들)과 손잡고 있다는 겁니다. 당장 의회에 보고해야겠습니다.

english: Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 잘됐네요! 그럼 보상을 받을 수 있나요?

english: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend. As I'm sure you know, there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
translation: 당신은 Kourend(쿠렌드) 사람들을 위해 큰일을 해냈습니다. 잘 아시겠지만, 일을 잘 해냈다는 만족감보다 더 큰 보상은 없지요.

english: Now be on your way. I have a lot of work to do.
translation: 이제 가 보십시오. 저는 할 일이 많습니다.

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
translation: Disciples of Yama(야마의 사도들)에 대해 뭘 알고 계세요?

english: They're a group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
translation: 무슨 악마를 숭배하는 미치광이 광신도 집단입니다. lizardmen(리자드맨)에 비하면 큰 위협은 아니지만, 그래도 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 적이지요.

english: And Councillor Hughes is helping them? That's not good.
translation: 그런데 Councillor Hughes(휴스 의원)이 그들을 돕고 있다고요? 큰일이네요.

english: Indeed. I must report this to the Council immediately.
So can I have a reward?
Hello Tomas. How's things?
Very well thank you. My work in bringing down Councillor Hughes means that I'm finally starting to get the recognition that I deserve.
translation: 아주 좋습니다, 고맙습니다. Councillor Hughes(휴스 의원)을 끌어내린 제 공로 덕분에 마침내 마땅히 받아야 할 인정을 받기 시작했지요.

english: But that was my work!
Yes, yes, very good job. I'll make sure to mention you in my acceptance speech when I'm voted in as her replacement.
translation: 네, 네, 아주 잘하셨습니다. 제가 휴스 의원의 후임으로 당선되면 수락 연설에서 꼭 당신 이야기도 하겠습니다.

english: Hello Tomas.
Oh... Hello there.
Something wrong?
I'm ruined. Everything was perfect under the Council, but now I'm right back in the dirt again.
translation: 저는 끝났습니다. 의회 아래에서는 모든 게 완벽했는데, 이제 다시 바닥으로 떨어졌습니다.

english: You were very close to the Council. You should be glad you got to keep your job at all.
translation: 의회랑 아주 가까웠잖아요. 일자리를 지킨 것만 해도 다행으로 여기셔야죠.

english: But I didn't keep my job. Now I spend every day doing boring administrative work. It's a nightmare.
translation: 하지만 일자리를 지키지 못했습니다. 이제는 매일 지루한 행정 업무나 하고 있지요. 악몽입니다.

english: Come now Tomas, it can't be all bad. Show a little enthusiasm.
translation: 에이, Tomas(토머스), 그렇게 나쁘기만 하겠어요. 조금은 힘을 내 보세요.

english: Eugh.
What are you doing here?
Anything I can help with?
Absolutely.
Nah.
What's the Kourend Council?
I'm looking for a quest.
What are you investigating?
Well good luck with that.
Nothing thanks.
Let's talk about my quest.
Great! So can I have a reward?
translation: 잘됐네요! 그럼 보상을 받을 수 있나요?

english: What do you know of the Disciples of Yama?
translation: Disciples of Yama(야마의 사도들)에 대해 뭘 알고 계세요?

english: Say, aren't you a bit tall for a dwarf?
translation: 저기, 드워프치고는 키가 좀 크지 않아요?

english: Was there anything in particular you wanted?
I'd like a quest please.
I have nothing to do for you, I'm afraid. Ask around town, though, there are always people who need some work done around here.
translation: 안됐지만 당신한테 맡길 일은 없소. 그래도 마을을 돌아다니며 물어보시오. 여긴 일손이 필요한 사람이 늘 있으니까.

english: No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 낯선 사람이랑 얘기하는 게 좋아서요.

english: Well I don't.
I'd like a quest please.
No, I just like talking to strangers.
translation: 아뇨, 그냥 낯선 사람이랑 얘기하는 게 좋아서요.

english: Hello.
So how's life as a pirate?
What kind of question is that? How's life as a... I dunno. Whatever it is that you do for a living.
translation: 뭐 그런 질문이 다 있어? 그럼 그쪽은... 뭐더라. 하여간 그쪽이 먹고사는 그 일, 그건 어떤데?

english: I'm a freelance troubleshooter.
What does that entail then?
Mostly killing things for money and delivering items around the planet for people.
translation: 주로 돈 받고 뭘 처치하거나, 사람들 부탁으로 세상 여기저기 물건을 배달하는 거죠.

english: I collect stuff.
So how's that life?
Can't complain, can't complain...
Well, there you go.
Aren't you a little short for a pirate?
My mother was a gnome. Apparently it was a very painful birth.
translation: 우리 엄마가 노움이었거든. 듣자 하니 아주 고통스러운 출산이었대.

english: More info than I wanted, thanks!
Sorry, can't stop, the Captain will have my guts for garters if he catches me slacking off talking to the stowaway.
translation: 미안, 지금은 못 멈춰. 밀항자랑 노닥거리며 땡땡이치다 선장한테 걸리면 내 창자를 뽑아 버릴 거라고.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요!

english: Yeah, whatever [guy/lady], it doesn't really matter who you are I'll get in trouble!
translation: 그래, 알았어, [guy/lady]. 네가 누구든 상관없어, 난 혼난다고!

english: You know, I've always wondered what life as a pirate actually entails.
translation: 있잖아요, 해적 생활이 실제로 어떤 건지 늘 궁금했어요.

english: Well, at the moment it mostly involves being asked random questions by a stowaway.
translation: 음, 지금은 주로 밀항자한테 이것저것 질문을 받는 일이지.

english: I'm not a stowaway! I was invited aboard! By Lokar! Ask him!
translation: 저 밀항자 아니에요! 초대받아서 탄 거라고요! Lokar(로카르)가요! 그 사람한테 물어보세요!

english: Hey, whatever [love/pal]. Just make sure the captain doesn't catch you, pirates don't like stowaways much.
translation: 그래, 알았어, [love/pal]. 그냥 선장한테만 들키지 마. 해적들은 밀항자를 별로 안 좋아하거든.

english: Ah, good day to you [milady/sirrah]! Your face is unfamiliar, did you perhaps join us aboard the ship at Lunar Isle?
translation: 아, 안녕, [milady/sirrah]! 처음 보는 얼굴인데, 혹시 Lunar Isle(루나 섬)에서 배에 탔어?

english: No, Lokar offered me a lift in Rellekka actually.
translation: 아뇨, 사실 Rellekka(렐레카)에서 Lokar(로카르)가 태워 준다고 했어요.

english: Oh, really? You don't look like a Fremennik to me!
translation: 오, 정말? 내가 보기엔 Fremennik(프레메닉) 같지 않은데!

english: Well... I kind of am, and I kind of aren't. It's a long story.
translation: 음... 그런 것 같기도 하고 아닌 것 같기도 해요. 얘기가 길어요.

english: Sorry I don't have time to hear it then! See you around young fremennik-who-is-not-really-a-fremennik!
translation: 미안, 그럼 들을 시간이 없겠다! 또 보자, 프레메닉인-듯-프레메닉-아닌 젊은이!

english: 'Bye.
Brrrr! Its cold up here!
You think this is cold? Up by Acheron it gets so cold that when you talk you see the words freeze in the air in front of you!
translation: 이게 춥다고? Acheron(아케론) 근처는 얼마나 추운지 말을 하면 말이 눈앞에서 그대로 얼어붙는 게 보인다니까!

english: REALLY?
Nah, not really. I was exaggerating for humourous effect. It is very very cold though!
translation: 아니, 그건 아니고. 웃기려고 좀 부풀린 거야. 그래도 엄청, 엄청 춥긴 해!

english: Hello to you too.
Yar! We be pirates, yar! Avast, ye scurvy land-lubbing lychee!
translation: 야르! 우린 해적이다, 야르! 멈춰라, 이 괴혈병 걸린 뭍쟁이 리치 녀석아!

english: Please don't talk like that, it is extremely irritating.
translation: 제발 그렇게 말하지 마. 진짜 짜증 나거든.

english: Also, please don't call me a lychee, whatever that may be.
translation: 그리고 날 리치라고 부르지도 마. 그게 뭔지는 모르겠지만.

english: Oh. Okay. Sorry.
ARGH! SOUND THE ALARM! STOWAWAY ON BOARD! STOWAWAY ON BOARD!
translation: 으악! 경보를 울려라! 밀항자다! 배에 밀항자가 있다!

english: No! I'm not a stowaway! Honest! I was invited here!
translation: 아니에요! 저 밀항자 아니에요! 정말이에요! 초대받아서 온 거예요!

english: Oh, sorry, my mistake then.
You must admit you do look a lot like a stowaway though.
translation: 그래도 밀항자처럼 보이긴 한다는 건 인정해야 해.

english: Why, what do they usually look like?
Erm... I've never actually met one...
translation: 어... 실제로 만나 본 적은 없어...

english: Okay then...
Hello.
So... You're a pirate, huh?
It's what it says on my pay-packet at the end of the month.
translation: 월말에 받는 급여 봉투에 그렇게 적혀 있지.

english: How's that working out for you?
Pretty good so far. All the grog and loot that we can plunder, plus full medical including dental.
translation: 지금까진 꽤 괜찮아. 약탈할 수 있는 만큼의 그로그 술과 전리품에, 치과까지 포함된 의료 혜택도 완벽하지.

english: You mean you have insurance?
Not as such. If any of us get sick we kidnap a doctor and don't let him go until we're better.
translation: 그런 건 아니고. 우리 중 누가 아프면 의사를 납치해서 우리가 나을 때까지 안 놔주는 거야.

english: You'd be surprised what an incentive for expert health care that is.
translation: 그게 최고의 진료를 끌어내는 데 얼마나 좋은 동기가 되는지 알면 놀랄걸.

english: I can imagine.
Hello there. So what brings you aboard the Lady Zay?
translation: 안녕. 그래서 Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호에는 무슨 일로 탔어?

english: Well, I was planning on visiting the Moon Clan, but I have to say your ship is very impressive.
translation: 음, Moon Clan(달 부족)을 찾아갈 생각이었는데, 이 배 정말 멋지네요.

english: Aye, she's a beauty alright! The Lady Zay has been my home for many hard months, through storm and sun, and she always gets us to here we were headed!
translation: 그럼, 끝내주는 배지! Lady Zay(레이디 제이)호는 폭풍우 칠 때나 해가 쨍쨍할 때나 고된 몇 달 동안 내 집이었고, 언제나 우리가 가려던 곳에 데려다줬지!

english: Yes, she's certainly one of the finest boats I've seen on my travels!
translation: 네, 여행하면서 본 배 중에 확실히 손꼽히게 훌륭한 배예요!

english: That she is [lad/lass], that she is.
Ah, 'tis a foine day to be sure! Were yez wantin' me to store yer tools, or maybe ye might be wantin' yer stuff back from me?
translation: 아, 참말로 좋은 날이구먼! 자네 도구를 맡기려나, 아니면 맡겨 둔 물건을 찾아가려나?

english: Why are you here in Weiss?
An' why would I not be here? Now that there be farming patches, there'll be folk needing a leprechaun to hold their stuff! So, dod ye want to be using the store?
translation: 내가 여기 없을 이유가 뭐 있나? 이제 농사 밭이 생겼으니, 물건 맡길 레프리콘이 필요한 사람들이 있을 거 아닌가! 그래서, 창고를 쓰겠나?

english: Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: Lost City(잃어버린 도시)에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to know about the Lost City. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: 아니지, Lost City(잃어버린 도시)가 궁금하면 Shamus(셰이머스)한테 물어보게. Draynor Village(드레이너 마을) 근처 어디쯤 나무 위에 산다네. 마지막으로 들은 소식으론 웬 덩치 큰 놈이 자기 나무를 베려 한다고 울부짖고 있었다더군!

english: What can you store?
We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only archaeologists use!
translation: 자네 rake(갈퀴), seed dibber(씨앗 구멍 막대), spade(삽), secateurs(전지가위), watering can(물뿌리개), trowel(모종삽)을 맡아 주지. 단, 고고학자들이나 쓰는 그 고급 모종삽은 안 되네!

english: We'll take a few buckets off yer hands too, and even yer compost, supercompost an' ultracompost! Also plant cure vials.
translation: 양동이도 몇 개 받아 주고, compost(퇴비), supercompost(슈퍼 퇴비), ultracompost(울트라 퇴비)까지 맡아 주지! plant cure(식물 치료제) 약병도 말일세.

english: Aside from that, if ye hands me yer farming produce, I can mebbe change it into banknotes for ye.
translation: 그 밖에도 자네가 수확한 농작물을 건네주면, 은행권으로 바꿔 줄 수도 있다네.

english: So... do ye want to be using the store?
What do you do with the tools you're storing? They can't possibly all fit in your pockets!
translation: 맡아 둔 도구들은 어떻게 해요? 주머니에 다 들어갈 리가 없잖아요!

english: We leprechauns have a shed where we keep 'em. It's a magic shed, so ye can get yer items back from any of us leprechauns whenever ye want. Saves ye havin' to carry loads of stuff around the country!
translation: 우리 레프리콘들한텐 그걸 보관하는 헛간이 있다네. 마법 헛간이라서, 우리 레프리콘 누구한테서든 언제든 물건을 돌려받을 수 있지. 짐을 잔뜩 짊어지고 온 나라를 돌아다닐 필요가 없다네!

english: No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 제 물건은 제가 들고 다닐게요.

english: Ye must be dafter than ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: 가는 곳마다 도구를 끌고 다니는 게 좋다니, 자네 보기보다 더 멍청하구먼!

english: Nay, I've got no banknotes to exchange for that item.
translation: 아니, 그 물건과 바꿔 줄 은행권은 없다네.

english: Nay, there's no such thing as a banknote for that.
translation: 아니, 그런 물건에 쓸 은행권 같은 건 없다네.

english: That IS a banknote!
A cabbage? Don't ye go showing me yer cabbage; this whole farm stinks of the things! Take it away and get it exchanged somewhere else.
translation: 양배추? 내 앞에서 양배추 자랑하지 말게, 이 농장 전체가 그 냄새로 진동한다고! 가져가서 딴 데서 바꾸게.

english: Ye did foine, yer'll be wanting this!
Why are you here in Weiss?
Can you tell me about the Lost City?
translation: Lost City(잃어버린 도시)에 대해 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Yes please.
What can you store?
What do you do with the tools you're storing?
No thanks, I'll keep hold of my stuff.
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 제 물건은 제가 들고 다닐게요.

english: Aye, top o' th' mornin' to ya! Are ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 그래, 좋은 아침일세! 도구 창고 일로 도움이 필요한가?

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 왜 산 위에서 일광욕을 하고 계세요?

english: We tool leprechauns work hard, that we do. An' nary a penny do we get in return. So ye cannae begrudge me mah holiday an' a wee drink or twelve!
translation: 우리 도구 레프리콘들은 열심히 일한다네, 정말이지. 그런데 그 대가로 땡전 한 푼 못 받지. 그러니 내 휴가랑 술 한 잔, 아니 열두 잔쯤은 아까워하지 말게!

english: Yes, very nice, but why are you sunbathing up a mountain? Surely a beach would be more appropriate?
translation: 네, 아주 좋네요. 그런데 왜 하필 산 위에서 일광욕을 해요? 해변이 더 어울리지 않아요?

english: Ahh, but I likes th' ruggedy mountain, ye see. Also, I ha' a terrible allergy to sand.
translation: 아, 그게 말일세, 난 험준한 산이 좋거든. 게다가 모래 알레르기가 아주 심하다네.

english: Fair enough, I suppose.
So were ye wantin' help with th' tool store?
translation: 그래서, 도구 창고 일로 도움이 필요한가?

english: Would you like to trade?
Ach! Can ye no' leave a body to ha' a little peace? Very well, I have a bit o' stuff to trade with ye. But don't be expectin' yerself any discounts.
translation: 에잇! 좀 조용히 쉬게 내버려 둘 순 없나? 알았네, 거래할 물건이 좀 있긴 하지. 하지만 할인 따윈 기대하지 말게.

english: Are you going to move that other deckchair?
An' get ambushed by that damn bird again? Nae, I'll be keeping my distance, thank ye very much!
translation: 그러다 그 망할 새한테 또 습격당하라고? 아니, 난 거리를 두겠네, 고맙지만 사양일세!

english: Plus, if ye've got a farmin' patch up 'ere, th' union boys'll want me posted nearer it.
translation: 게다가 자네가 여기 농사 밭을 갖고 있으면, 조합 놈들이 날 그 근처에 배치하려 들 걸세.

english: I'm not one of them farmin' leprechauns! I don't want yer garbage!
translation: 난 그 농사 레프리콘들이랑 달라! 네 쓰레기 따윈 필요 없어!

english: Why are you sunbathing up a mountain?
translation: 왜 산 위에서 일광욕을 하고 계세요?

english: Would you like to trade?
Are you going to move that other deckchair?
Aye? What do ye need?
Tell me about this mine.
's a sulphur mine. Ye get sulphur here. For making the dynamite, ye know? Folks use it in the blast mine. Watch the poison gas clouds, though - they'll choke ye.
translation: 유황 광산이야. 여기서 유황이 나와. dynamite(다이너마이트) 만드는 데 쓰지, 알지? 사람들이 blast mine(폭파 광산)에서 써. 근데 독가스 구름 조심해. 숨 막혀.

english: Grab yerself a pickaxe if ye wants to mine some sulphur. Make sure ye keeps yer mouth an' nose covered too.
translation: 유황 캐고 싶으면 곡괭이 하나 챙겨. 입이랑 코도 꼭 가리고.

english: What have you got to trade?
Pickaxes. For the mining. An' pots to make dynamite in.
translation: 곡괭이. 채광용. 그리고 dynamite(다이너마이트) 만들 단지.

english: Why are you called Toothy?
'Cos of my teeth.
I'll be off.
Tell me about this mine.
What have you got to trade?
Why are you called Toothy?
I'll be off.
You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
YOU ARE A TERRIBLE BARD!
Don't give up your day job outerlander!
I thought somebody was murdering a cat!
You know, I actually quite liked that verse...
translation: 있잖아, 그 소절은 꽤 마음에 들었어...

english: That's kind of catchy. Irritating. But catchy.
translation: 은근히 귀에 감기네. 짜증 나. 그래도 귀에 감겨.

english: Hey, I've done that quest too!
translation: 어, 나도 그 퀘스트 해 봤는데!

english: I have produced better sounds in the outhouse!
Your song makes no sense outerlander!
translation: 네 노래는 하나도 말이 안 돼, 외지인!

english: What kind of bard are you anyway?
I have met cows more musical than you!
translation: 너보다 음악성 있는 소도 만나 봤다!

english: When do you get to the good parts?
would torture us so, outerlander?
Truly, this is the worst sound I have ever heard!
translation: 정말이지, 내 평생 들어 본 최악의 소리다!

english: looting and drinking part?
Please tell me that was the last verse...
translation: 제발 그게 마지막 소절이라고 해 줘...

english: Please... Kill me now...
You call THAT singing?
Never before have mine ears been so offended!
translation: 내 귀가 이토록 모욕당한 적은 없었다!

english: Worst. Bard. EVER.
Please, ye gods! Make it stop!
translation: 신들이시여, 제발! 저것 좀 멈춰 주소서!

english: If you stopped singing
The screams of my dying comrades sound better!
translation: 죽어 가는 내 전우들의 비명이 더 듣기 좋겠다!

english: My grandmother could do better, and she is dead!
I do such feats before breakfast!
translation: 그 정도 업적은 난 아침 먹기 전에 해치운다!

english: Is your singing some kind of outerlander weapon?
Watch yourself, outerlander.
Good day to you, [Fremennik name].
Good day to you [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to Ungael?
Yes please.
Player is transported to Ungael
Do you have any of my items?
I do have some of your items here [Fremennik name]. Try not to lose them next time.
translation: 자네 물건이 여기 좀 있네, [Fremennik name]. 다음엔 잃어버리지 않도록 하게.

english: I'm afraid not [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 미안하지만 없네, [Fremennik name]. 내가 자네 물건을 갖고 있었더라도 자네가 찾아가기 전에 죽었다면, 이제는 사라졌을 걸세.

english: No thank you.
Well met [Fremennik name]. Do you want to return to Rellekka?
Player is transported to Rellekka
I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [Fremennik name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 미안하지만 자네에게 줄 건 없네, [Fremennik name]. 내가 자네 물건을 갖고 있었더라도 자네가 찾아가기 전에 죽었다면, 이제는 사라졌을 걸세.

english: Yes please.
Do you have any of my items?
No thank you.
Hello.
Hi there. So much to see here!
Yep, could be looking all day!
Updated any displays yet?
Yes, I just learned more about some priestly warriors and a staff of the gods.
translation: 네, 방금 성스러운 전사들이랑 신들의 지팡이에 대해 더 알게 됐어요.

english: Sounds fun, how did you do that?

Ahh, I'm big on quests me, love questing. So when I've done one, I check here with 'Historian' Minas to see if I can help the Museum out with some information. Sometimes they already know it, or don't want to know,
translation: 아, 제가 퀘스트를 엄청 좋아하거든요. 그래서 하나 끝내면 여기 'Historian' Minas(역사가 미나스)한테 와서 박물관에 알려 줄 정보가 있는지 확인해요. 이미 아는 내용이거나 알고 싶어 하지 않을 때도 있고,

english: and sometimes it earns me a reward or two.
translation: 가끔은 보상을 한두 개 받기도 해요.

english: That sounds really good. Perhaps I should do the same!
translation: 그거 정말 좋네요. 저도 그렇게 해 봐야겠어요!

english: You should, as well as everything else there is here in the Museum. Did you know they have a really fun- looking display down in the basement? I love monkeys.
translation: 그러세요, 박물관에 있는 다른 것들도 다 둘러보시고요. 지하에 정말 재밌어 보이는 전시물이 있다는 거 아세요? 전 원숭이가 정말 좋아요.

english: I'll check it out. Got to get going now, nice talking to you.
translation: 가 볼게요. 이제 가 봐야겠어요, 얘기 즐거웠어요.

english: Have a good day!
Hi there!
Hello, what are you doing here?
Oh, just taking a look at these displays. I'm a bit of a history buff.
translation: 아, 그냥 전시물 구경하고 있어요. 제가 역사를 좀 좋아하거든요.

english: Really? Tell me something I didn't know!
translation: 정말요? 제가 모르는 걸 하나 알려 주세요!

english: Well, did you know that Bob the Cat is... no, no... you'd never believe me anyway.
translation: 음, Bob the Cat(고양이 밥)이 사실은... 아니, 아니에요... 어차피 안 믿으실 거예요.

english: He's what? Tell me!
No, no. Couldn't possibly ruin the surprise.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨. 깜짝 놀랄 일을 망칠 순 없죠.

english: ARG! Tell me!
If you really want to know, go talk to Unferth in his house in Burthorpe.
translation: 정말 알고 싶으시면 Burthorpe(버소프)에 있는 Unferth(언퍼스)의 집에 가서 그분이랑 얘기해 보세요.

english: Hi!
Oh, hello. I was just looking at this display here.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 여기 이 전시물을 보고 있었어요.

english: Anything interesting?
Yes, one I just updated by talking to 'Historian' Minas. I'm a bit of a quester you see.
translation: 네, 'Historian' Minas(역사가 미나스)랑 얘기해서 방금 업데이트한 거예요. 제가 퀘스트를 좀 하거든요.

english: Okay, I'll let you get on then.
Hmm, yes. Okay. Don't forget to check out the Natural History exhibit - you could learn a lot.
translation: 음, 네. 그래요. Natural History(자연사) 전시관도 꼭 보세요. 배울 게 많을 거예요.

english: Right, bye!
Hello!
Hi, have you seen the Dig Site displays?
translation: 안녕하세요, Dig Site(발굴 현장) 전시물 보셨어요?

english: Yes, good aren't they! Have you done the quest?
Not yet.
Oh you should, it lets you get into that bit where they clean the finds, and you can join in!
translation: 꼭 해 보세요, 하고 나면 발굴품 닦는 곳에 들어가서 직접 같이 해 볼 수 있거든요!

english: Sounds fun, I should probably check it out.
Yes, I did it all.
Did you know after the quest you can get the teddy bear back by stealing it from the female student?
translation: 퀘스트 끝나고 나서 여학생한테서 곰 인형을 훔치면 다시 얻을 수 있다는 거 아세요?

english: I shall have to try that sometime.
Hmm... 3rd Age.... No, no...maybe 4th...
Hello?
Yes, that's it, just like that. Mustn't forget the map either....hmm...what else?
translation: 그래, 바로 그거야, 딱 그렇게. 지도도 잊으면 안 되고....흠...또 뭐가 있더라?

english: HELLO! Are you there?
Oh, hello there. Sorry, was a bit engrosed in updating this display. I've just been out questing and thought I'd stop off here you see. It's quite rewarding too.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 죄송해요, 이 전시물 업데이트하느라 정신이 좀 팔려 있었어요. 막 퀘스트를 하고 와서 여기 들러 볼까 했거든요. 보람도 꽤 있고요.

english: Yes, well, no need to ignore me.
translation: 네, 뭐, 그렇다고 절 무시할 것까진 없잖아요.

english: No offence intended, my dear chap. Just very interested in this history stuff, that's all.
translation: 기분 나쁘게 하려던 건 아니에요, 친구. 그냥 이런 역사 이야기에 관심이 아주 많아서 그래요.

english: Okay. Have you seen the Natural History exhibit in the basement?
translation: 그렇군요. 지하에 있는 Natural History(자연사) 전시관 보셨어요?

english: Oh, yes, marvellous isn't it! I particularly like the wyvern, very interesting considering they've never found a live specimen. And to think they could possibly have been flapping around at one time!
translation: 아, 네, 멋지지 않아요! 전 특히 wyvern(와이번)이 좋아요. 살아 있는 표본은 한 번도 발견된 적이 없다는 걸 생각하면 정말 흥미롭죠. 한때 그런 게 날아다녔을지도 모른다니!

english: A bit like the crazy gnomes and their gliders. Have you seen the model they have upstairs?
translation: 미친 gnome(노움)들이랑 그 글라이더 같네요. 위층에 있는 모형 보셨어요?

english: Yes, very intricate isn't it? Worrying to think some people risk their lives in them! You wouldn't catch me up in one. Had a chat with Jacques while I was up there, the art critic...he's a bit funny in the head.
translation: 네, 정말 정교하죠? 그런 걸 타고 목숨을 거는 사람들이 있다니 걱정돼요! 전 절대 안 탈 거예요. 위층에 있을 때 미술 평론가 Jacques(자크)랑 얘기했는데... 머리가 좀 이상하더라고요.

english: That's not very nice!
Well, he thinks he's going to get an entire portrait gallery to himself!
translation: 아니, 자기가 초상화 전시관을 통째로 혼자 차지할 거라고 생각한다니까요!

english: Who knows, the Museum just got really big and appears to have cash. They might entertain him with his very own floor - we'll see.
translation: 누가 알겠어요, 박물관이 엄청 커졌고 돈도 있어 보이던데요. 그분한테 층 하나를 통째로 내줄지도 모르죠. 두고 봐야죠.

english: I guess so. Wonder what poetry he'll come up with then! Still, I must get on with this display. See you around I hope!
translation: 그럴지도요. 그럼 무슨 시를 지어낼지 궁금하네요! 아무튼 전 이 전시물 마저 해야겠어요. 또 봐요!

english: Bye!
Rhaaaaaaa!
You cannot kill the undead, mortal!
Your soul will be forfeit for this, mortal!
translation: 이 대가로 네 영혼을 내놓게 될 것이다, 필멸자여!

english: I will return, mortal!
Hi, what ales are you serving?
Well [mister/miss], our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 네, [mister/miss], 저희 대표 메뉴는 Asgarnian Ale(아스가르니아 에일)이고, Wizard's Mind Bomb(마법사의 마인드 밤)과 Dwarven Stout(드워프 스타우트)도 있어요.

english: Would you like to buy a drink?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Ah well... so um... does the grey squirrel sing in the grove?
translation: 아 그럼... 저기 음... 회색 다람쥐가 숲속에서 노래를 하나요?

english: Huh?
Er... nevermind.
Yes, and the black cat dances in the sink.
translation: 네, 그리고 검은 고양이는 개수대에서 춤을 추죠.

english: Ah you'll be wanting the trapdoor behind the bar.
translation: 아, 그럼 바 뒤에 있는 바닥 문을 찾으시는 거군요.

english: No, squirrels can't sing.
No... of course they can't...
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Huh?
Yes, and the black cat dances in the sink.
translation: 네, 그리고 검은 고양이는 개수대에서 춤을 추죠.

english: No, squirrels can't sing.
Hey there.
Hello!
Hello there! The weather here is wonderful, isn't it?
translation: 안녕하세요! 여기 날씨 정말 좋지 않아요?

english: Hello there, or should I say nilsal?
I can't wait to visit the rest of the kingdom!
translation: 왕국의 다른 곳들도 빨리 가 보고 싶어요!

english: Isn't this place wonderful?
Hi there. Hope you're enjoying your time in Varlamore.
translation: 안녕하세요. Varlamore(바를라모어)에서 즐거운 시간 보내고 계시길 바라요.

english: Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Hello there, what do you do here?
Hi. We are in charge of this practice area.
translation: 안녕하세요. 저희는 이 연습장을 관리하고 있어요.

english: This is a practice area?
Surrounding us are four towers. Each tower contains trained archers of a different level. You'll notice it's quite a distance, so you'll need a longbow.
translation: 주위에 탑이 네 개 있어요. 탑마다 레벨이 다른 숙련된 궁수들이 있죠. 보시다시피 거리가 꽤 멀어서 longbow(긴 활)이 필요할 거예요.

english: As you're not very skilled, so I advise you to practise on the north tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 실력이 아직 부족하시니 북쪽 탑에서 연습하시길 권해요. 그게 가장 알맞은 도전이 될 거예요.

english: You seem to have some skill, so I advise you to practice on the east tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 실력이 좀 있어 보이시니 동쪽 탑에서 연습하시길 권해요. 그게 가장 알맞은 도전이 될 거예요.

english: You appear to be fairly skilled with a bow, so I advise you to practice on the south tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 활 솜씨가 꽤 좋아 보이시니 남쪽 탑에서 연습하시길 권해요. 그게 가장 알맞은 도전이 될 거예요.

english: Looks like you're very skilled, so I advise you to practice on the west tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 실력이 아주 뛰어나 보이시니 서쪽 탑에서 연습하시길 권해요. 그게 가장 알맞은 도전이 될 거예요.

english: The north tower is occupied, get them!
The east tower is occupied, get them!
The south tower is occupied, get them!
The west tower is occupied, get them!
The [north/east/south/west] tower is defeated! Hurray!
The [north/east/south/west] tower has received reinforcements, kill them quickly!
Hello. What are you doing here?
We are the tower guards - our business is our own!
translation: 우린 탑 경비병이다. 우리 일은 우리가 알아서 한다!

english: Hello citizen!
What do you do around here?
I'm a Town Crier. It's my job to let people know of any recent news. After all, there's all sorts of things happening around here.
translation: 나는 마을 포고꾼이오. 최근 소식을 사람들에게 알리는 게 내 일이지요. 아무튼 이 근방에선 온갖 일이 다 벌어지니까요.

english: I see. See you later.
Until next time.
See you later.
Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-
translation: 들으시오! 들으시오! 플레이어 모더레이터는 룬스케이프에 크나큰 도움이-

english: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?
translation: 오, 안녕하시오, 시민. 플레이어 모더레이터에 대해 알아보러 왔소? 아니면 이 땅의 법에 대해 알고 싶소?

english: Tell me about Player Moderators.
Of course. What would you like to know?
What is a Player Moderator?

Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터는 그대와 똑같은 평범한 플레이어라오. 다만 믿을 만하고 성실하게 신고해 온 사람이라는 걸 보여 줬기에, Jagex(재젝스)의 초대를 받아 게임을 감시하고

english: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.
translation: 규칙 위반을 보면 적절한 조치를 취하지요. 게임 속에서 플레이어 모더레이터를 알아보려면 채팅 화면을 보면 되오. 플레이어 모더레이터가 말하면 이름 왼쪽에 은색 왕관이 나타나거든요.

english: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!
translation: 명심하시오. 은색 왕관이 없다면 플레이어 모더레이터가 아니오!

english: Thanks!
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
What can Player Moderators do?
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터는 무슨 일을 할 수 있어요?

english: Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터, 줄여서 'P-모드'는 규칙 위반자의 채팅을 금지할 수 있고, Jagex(재젝스)는 그들의 신고를 우선 검토해 최대한 빨리 조치를 취한다오. P-모드는 플레이어 모더레이터 센터도 이용할 수 있소.

english: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.
translation: 센터에는 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 관리를 돕는 도구들이 있지요. 전용 포럼, 플레이어 모더레이터 지침, 플레이어 모더레이터 행동 강령 같은 것들이오.

english: How do I become a Player Moderator?
translation: 어떻게 하면 플레이어 모더레이터가 될 수 있어요?

english: Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:
translation: Jagex(재젝스)는 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 커뮤니티를 더 좋게 만들려고 시간과 노력을 들이는 플레이어를 뽑는다오. 플레이어 모더레이터가 될 가능성을 높이려면:

english: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.
translation: 계정을 안전하게 지키시오! 아주 중요한 일이오. 보안이 허술한 플레이어는 절대 P-모드가 될 수 없소. 자세한 내용은 보안 팁을 읽어 보시오.

english: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.
translation: 규칙을 지키시오! Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프)의 규칙은 모두에게 공정하고 즐거운 게임 환경을 만들기 위해 있는 것이오.

english: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.
translation: 정확하게 신고하시오! Jagex(재젝스)가 계정을 심사할 때는 양이 아니라 질을 본다오. 신고 지침을 따라 질 높은 신고를 하시오.

english: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.
translation: 서로에게 잘 대해 주시오! 대접받고 싶은 대로 남을 대하고, 동료 플레이어를 존중하시오.

english: What can Player Moderators not do?
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터가 할 수 없는 일은 뭐예요?

english: P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you
translation: P-모드는 그대의 계정을 정지시킬 수 없소. 위반 행위를 신고할 수 있을 뿐이지요. 그러면 Jagex(재젝스)가 받은 증거를 바탕으로 조치를 취하오. 비밀번호를 잃어버리거나 다른 플레이어에게 사기를 당해도 P-모드는 계정을

english: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are
translation: 되찾아 줄 수 없소. 그들이 할 수 있는 건 고객 지원에 가 보라고 권하는 것뿐이오. 잃어버린 아이템을 되찾아 줄 수도 없고, 게임 관리를 돕는다고 Jagex(재젝스)에게 공짜 아이템을 받지도 않소. 그들은

english: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If
translation: 순수한 선의로 커뮤니티를 돕는 플레이어들이라오! P-모드는 Jagex(재젝스) 직원이 아니어서 그대를 모더레이터로 만들어 주거나 다른 계정을 모더레이터로 추천할 수도 없소. 만약

english: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!
translation: 모더레이터가 되고 싶다면 언제든 내게 방법을 물어보시오!

english: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
At once. Take a look at my book here...
translation: 당장 알려 드리지요. 여기 내 책을 보시오...

english: Can you give me a handy tip please?
translation: 쓸 만한 팁 하나 알려 주실래요?

english: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?
translation: 대부분의 스킬에 우클릭 'Make-X' 옵션이 있어서 더 빨리 훈련할 수 있다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.
translation: 복구 질문과 답은 남이 추측하기는 어렵고 본인은 기억하기 쉽게 만드시오.

english: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!
translation: RuneScape(룬스케이프) 비밀번호를 다른 사이트에서 쓰지 마시오. 계정을 안전하게 지키시오!

english: If you think someone knows your password - change it!
translation: 누군가 비밀번호를 안다고 생각되면 당장 바꾸시오!

english: The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!
translation: 다람쥐들이! 다람쥐들이 몰려온다! 으아아, 내 머릿속에서 나가!

english: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?
translation: Lumbridge castle(럼브리지 성)의 레인지에서는 다른 레인지보다 음식을 덜 태운다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!
translation: 플레이어는 갑옷에 트림(테두리 장식)을 넣어 줄 수 없소. 흔한 사기 수법이니 속지 마시오!

english: Feeling harassed? Don't forget your ignore list can be especially useful if a player seems to be picking on you!
translation: 괴롭힘을 당하고 있소? 어떤 플레이어가 그대를 못살게 군다면 차단 목록이 특히 유용하다는 걸 잊지 마시오!

english: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!
translation: 길을 잃어 어디로 가야 할지 모르겠다면 Home Teleport(홈 텔레포트) 주문을 공짜로 쓰시오!

english: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!
translation: 누군가 규칙을 어기는 걸 보면 신고하시오!

english: Did you know? Superheat Item means you never fail to smelt ore!
translation: 알고 있었소? Superheat Item(슈퍼히트 아이템)을 쓰면 광석 제련에 절대 실패하지 않소!

english: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?
translation: Runecrafting(룬 제작) 레벨이 높으면 정수 하나로 룬을 여러 개 만들 수 있다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.
translation: 돌려받지 못해도 괜찮은 게 아니라면 아이템을 절대 빌려주지 마시오.

english: Never question a penguin.
Melee armour actually gives you disadvantages when using magic attacks. It may be better to take off your armour entirely!
translation: 근접 갑옷은 마법 공격을 할 때 오히려 불리하다오. 갑옷을 아예 벗는 편이 나을 수도 있소!

english: If the chat window is moving too quickly to report a player accurately, run to a quiet spot and review the chat at your leisure!
translation: 채팅 창이 너무 빨리 올라가서 플레이어를 정확히 신고하기 어렵다면, 조용한 곳으로 달려가서 여유롭게 채팅을 다시 확인하시오!

english: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!
translation: 두 번째 거래 창을 시간을 들여 꼼꼼히 확인하시오. 사기당하지 마시오!

english: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?
translation: 은행 PIN을 설정하면 귀중한 아이템을 안전하게 지킬 수 있다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?
translation: mithril(미스릴) 장비가 아주 가볍다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!
translation: RuneScape(룬스케이프)에 치트 따위는 없소! 그런 걸 약속하는 웹사이트에는 절대 들어가지 마시오!

english: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.
translation: Jagex(재젝스)는 절대 이메일을 보내지 않소. 우리가 보냈다는 이메일은 하나도 믿지 마시오.

english: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.
translation: 스킬이 막히면 Lumbridge(럼브리지) 교사들에게 도움과 팁을 구하시오.

english: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?
translation: 석궁을 들고도 방패를 들 수 있다는 걸 알고 있었소?

english: Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!
translation: 그대를 wilderness(황야)로 꾀어내려는 플레이어들을 조심하시오. 거기서 잃은 아이템은 돌려받을 수 없소!

english: If a player isn't sure of the rules, send them to me! I'll be happy to remind them!
translation: 규칙을 잘 모르는 플레이어가 있다면 내게 보내시오! 기꺼이 일러 주겠소!

english: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!
translation: 비밀번호는 누구에게도, 가장 친한 친구에게도 절대 알려 주지 마시오!

english: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!
translation: 마법사와 싸울 땐 조심하시오! 무거운 갑옷을 입으면 Magic(마법) 저항력이 떨어질 수 있소!

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to Rune... Oh great, a P-mod! I know all about the great job you guys do, would you like me to prove my extensive knowledge to you?!
translation: 들으시오! 들으시오! 플레이어 모더레이터는 룬스케이프에 크나큰 도움... 오, 잘됐군, P-모드 아니오! 그대들이 얼마나 훌륭한 일을 하는지 잘 알고 있소. 내 해박한 지식을 한번 증명해 보여 드릴까?!

english: Can you show me the Guidelines please?
Of course, but I can't let you keep it - I've only got a few copies!
translation: 물론이오. 하지만 가져가게 할 순 없소. 몇 부밖에 없거든요!

english: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?
Oh yes, but I can't let you keep it - I've only a few copies!
translation: 아, 있지요. 하지만 가져가게 할 순 없소. 몇 부밖에 없거든요!

english: Can you give me a moderating tip please?
Add other Player Moderators to your friends list for quick advice and moral support in-game. It does help!
translation: 다른 플레이어 모더레이터들을 친구 목록에 추가해 두면 게임 안에서 바로 조언과 정신적 응원을 받을 수 있소. 정말 도움이 된다오!

english: To avoid reporting the wrong player, add an offender to your friends list, switch your public chat to friends and then use your right-click report from there. Easy!
translation: 엉뚱한 플레이어를 신고하지 않으려면, 위반자를 친구 목록에 추가하고 공개 채팅을 친구 전용으로 바꾼 뒤 거기서 우클릭으로 신고하시오. 간단하지요!

english: Did you know that Free-to-Play P-mods CAN visit the moderator forums, by logging into the regular forums at the top right hand side of the forum screen, despite it saying Members only.
translation: 무료 플레이 P-모드도 모더레이터 포럼에 들어갈 수 있다는 걸 알고 있었소? 멤버 전용이라고 쓰여 있어도 포럼 화면 오른쪽 위에서 일반 포럼에 로그인하면 된다오.

english: Don't be tempted to report anything you didn't see, no matter how much you trust the player who is informing you.
translation: 정보를 알려 주는 플레이어를 아무리 믿더라도, 직접 보지 않은 건 신고하고 싶어도 참으시오.

english: Don't eat something messy when on a first date - it won't look good!
translation: 첫 데이트에선 지저분하게 먹는 음식을 피하시오. 보기에 좋지 않으니까요!

english: Don't forget to add the mute if needed, before selecting the report category. This cuts down on those duplicate reports for one player.
translation: 신고 분류를 고르기 전에, 필요하면 채팅 금지를 추가하는 걸 잊지 마시오. 한 플레이어에 대한 중복 신고가 줄어든다오.

english: The forums are the best place to keep abreast of any procedure changes that might not yet be included in the Player Mod guidelines!
translation: 포럼은 아직 플레이어 모드 지침에 반영되지 않은 절차 변경 사항을 따라잡기에 가장 좋은 곳이오!

english: Got players asking you to unban them or help them retrieve a stolen or hacked account? There's nothing you can do so just send them to the Customer Support Team. If they think you can help, send them to me; I'll
translation: 정지를 풀어 달라거나, 도난당하거나 해킹당한 계정을 되찾게 도와 달라는 플레이어가 있소? 그대가 할 수 있는 일은 없으니 고객 지원 팀으로 보내시오. 그대가 도울 수 있다고 우긴다면 내게 보내시오. 내가

english: put them straight!
Have the P-Mod Oracle open in a separate window when playing Old School RuneScape - that way you'll always have the most up-to-date guidelines to hand!
translation: Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프)를 할 때 P-Mod Oracle(P-모드 오라클)을 다른 창에 띄워 두시오. 그러면 언제나 최신 지침을 곁에 둘 수 있소!

english: If the chat is scrolling too fast for you to see that suspect line you want to double check, just run up a ladder or to a quieter spot to stop the chat screen scrolling. Then you can scroll back and read that
translation: 다시 확인하고 싶은 수상한 채팅이 너무 빨리 올라가 버린다면, 사다리를 올라가거나 조용한 곳으로 달려가 채팅 화면이 멈추게 하시오. 그런 다음 위로 올려서

english: suspect line and judge the situation in your own time!
translation: 그 수상한 채팅을 읽고 천천히 상황을 판단하면 되오!

english: If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date
translation: 새로 된 모드라면 게임에 접속하기 전에 지침부터 읽는 걸 잊지 마시오! P-모드를 한동안 했다면 기억도 되살리고, 놓쳤을지 모를 변경 사항도

english: with any changes you may have missed!
translation: 따라잡을 겸 다시 한번 읽어 보는 게 어떻겠소!

english: If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!
translation: P-모드에 대해 묻는 플레이어가 있다면 얼마든지 내게 보내시오. P-모드에 관한 질문이라면 내가 대신 답해 주겠소!

english: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!
translation: 게임에서 어떤 플레이어에게 괴롭힘을 당해도 마음에 담아 두지 마시오. 그 플레이어는 그대가 아니라 그대의 은색 왕관에 반응하는 것이니까요!

english: If you notice a player trying to buy something common for an extremely high price, look about and see if there's someone else selling the same item for a much lower price. Chances are they're team scamming. If so,
translation: 흔한 물건을 터무니없이 비싼 값에 사려는 플레이어가 보이면, 주위에 같은 물건을 훨씬 싸게 파는 사람이 있는지 살펴보시오. 십중팔구 짜고 치는 사기일 거요. 그렇다면

english: write their names down and send your J-mod curators a query!
translation: 그들의 이름을 적어서 담당 J-모드에게 문의를 보내시오!

english: If you see a player abusing a bug in game, there's no need to report the player, just submit a bug report via the in-game report form.
translation: 게임에서 버그를 악용하는 플레이어를 봤다면 그 플레이어를 신고할 필요는 없소. 게임 내 신고 양식으로 버그 신고만 하면 되오.

english: An important part of being a P-mod is to act as an ambassador for the game. Keeping your cool even when faced with the rudest players goes a long way towards this!
translation: P-모드의 중요한 역할 중 하나는 게임의 홍보 대사가 되는 것이오. 아무리 무례한 플레이어 앞에서도 침착함을 잃지 않는 게 큰 도움이 된다오!

english: It's always better to report in secret. Telling a player that you are about to report them rarely makes you a friend, and can often lead to a player being offensive to you!
translation: 신고는 언제나 몰래 하는 게 좋소. 신고하겠다고 말해 봤자 친구가 되긴 어렵고, 오히려 그 플레이어가 그대에게 막말을 하게 되는 경우가 많소!

english: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!
translation: 기기를 떠날 때는 반드시 게임과 포럼에서 로그아웃하시오. 남들이 기밀 정보를 보게 해선 안 되오!

english: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.
translation: 대답하면 기밀 유지에 어긋난다고 생각되는 질문에는 절대 답하지 마시오.

english: The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!
translation: P-모드 포럼은 그대의 친구요! 다른 P-모드와 이야기하고 만나기에 가장 좋은 곳이고, 쓸모 있는 조언이 가득하다오!

english: Remember, if in doubt, report without a mute! It's very frustrating not to be able to speak if you're innocent!
translation: 명심하시오, 확신이 없으면 채팅 금지 없이 신고만 하시오! 결백한데 말을 못 하게 되면 정말 답답하니까요!

english: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!
translation: 명심하시오, 불쾌한 말이 필터로 완전히 걸러졌다면 신고하거나 채팅 금지할 필요가 없소!

english: Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?
translation: 채팅 금지를 걸기 전에 다시 한번 생각하시오. 그게 정말 주변 플레이어들에게 더 큰 피해가 가는 걸 막아 주겠소?

english: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!
translation: 필요하면 Jagex(재젝스) P-모드 팀을 이용하시오. 돕기 위해 있는 사람들이오!

english: You'll be amazed how often a bit of humour can diffuse a potentially unpleasant situation, before it becomes too serious.
translation: 상황이 심각해지기 전에, 약간의 유머만으로도 불쾌해질 뻔한 분위기가 얼마나 자주 풀리는지 알면 놀랄 거요.

english: Your J-mods are there to help you. If you ever need their advice, send them a query. They are always very happy to help. Don't be afraid to use them!
translation: J-모드는 그대를 돕기 위해 있소. 조언이 필요하면 언제든 문의를 보내시오. 그들은 늘 기꺼이 도와준다오. 망설이지 말고 이용하시오!

english: Your Player Moderator identity must never be revealed on the regular Old School RuneScape forums. However, you're more than welcome to chat about all aspects of being a Player Moderator in the official
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터라는 신분은 일반 Old School RuneScape(올드 스쿨 룬스케이프) 포럼에서 절대 드러내선 안 되오. 하지만 공식

english: Player Moderator forums!
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터 포럼에서는 플레이어 모더레이터 활동의 모든 면에 대해 얼마든지 이야기해도 좋소!

english: No thanks.
You're very helpful to us Player Moderators, but what help do you give to non Player Moderators?
translation: 저희 플레이어 모더레이터들한테는 큰 도움을 주시는데, 플레이어 모더레이터가 아닌 사람들에겐 어떤 도움을 주세요?

english: Well now, let me see...
What do you do around here?
See you later.
Tell me about Player Moderators.
What is a Player Moderator?
Tell me about something else.
No thanks.
What can Player Moderators do?
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터는 무슨 일을 할 수 있어요?

english: How do I become a Player Moderator?
translation: 어떻게 하면 플레이어 모더레이터가 될 수 있어요?

english: What can Player Moderators not do?
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터가 할 수 없는 일은 뭐예요?

english: Something else.
Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
Can you give me a handy tip please?
translation: 쓸 만한 팁 하나 알려 주실래요?

english: Can you show me the Guidelines please?
Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?
Can you give me a moderating tip please?
What help do you give to non Player Moderators?
translation: 플레이어 모더레이터가 아닌 사람에겐 어떤 도움을 주세요?

english: Hello.
I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here?
translation: 지금은 얘기할 틈이 없어요. 우리가 여기서 전투를 이기려고 애쓰는 게 안 보여요?

english: Do you know the coordinates of the Khazard stronghold?
I managed to get one, although it wasn't easy.
The gnome tells you the height coordinate.
Well done.
The other two tracker gnomes should have the other coordinates if they're still alive.
translation: 나머지 추적자 노움 두 명이 아직 살아 있다면 다른 좌표를 갖고 있을 거예요.

english: OK, take care.
Hello again.
Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.
translation: 잘했어요, 적의 방어선을 무너뜨렸군요. 이번 전투는 반드시 우리가 이길 거예요.

english: How are you tracker?
Now we have the orb I'm much better. They won't stand a chance without it.
translation: 이제 오브를 되찾았으니 훨씬 나아요. 그게 없으면 놈들은 승산이 없죠.

english: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been fighting forever.
translation: 이 전투는 언제 끝날까요? 영원히 싸워 온 것만 같아요.

english: Hello.
I can't talk now. If the guards catch me I'll be dead gnome meat.
translation: 지금은 얘기할 수 없어요. 경비병한테 들키면 저는 죽은 노움 고기 신세라고요.

english: Hi there.
The battle is far from over. If you have a pure heart you will help us win.
translation: 전투는 아직 끝나려면 멀었어요. 당신이 순수한 마음을 가졌다면 우리가 이기도록 도와줄 거예요.

english: Are you OK?
They caught me spying on the stronghold. They beat and tortured me.
translation: 요새를 염탐하다 놈들한테 붙잡혔어요. 두들겨 맞고 고문도 당했죠.

english: But I didn't crack. I told them nothing. They can't break me!
translation: 하지만 굴복하지 않았어요. 아무것도 말하지 않았죠. 놈들은 절 꺾을 수 없어요!

english: I'm sorry little man.
Don't be. I have the position of the stronghold!
translation: 그럴 것 없어요. 전 요새의 위치를 알고 있거든요!

english: The gnome tells you the y coordinate.
Well done.
Now leave before they find you and all is lost.
translation: 이제 놈들이 당신을 찾아내서 모든 게 끝장나기 전에 떠나세요.

english: Hang in there.
Go!
Hello again.
Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.
translation: 잘했어요, 적의 방어선을 무너뜨렸군요. 이번 전투는 반드시 우리가 이길 거예요.

english: How are you tracker?
Now we have the orb I'm much better. Soon my comrades will come and free me.
translation: 이제 오브를 되찾았으니 훨씬 나아요. 곧 전우들이 와서 절 풀어 줄 거예요.

english: When will this battle end? I feel like I've been locked up my whole life.
translation: 이 전투는 언제 끝날까요? 평생 갇혀 지낸 것만 같아요.

english: Hello.
I can't talk now. Can't you see we're trying to win a battle here?
translation: 지금은 얘기할 틈 없어. 우리가 여기서 전투를 이기려고 애쓰는 거 안 보여?

english: Hi there.
I can't stand this war. The misery, the pain, it's driving me crazy! When will it end?
translation: 이 전쟁은 못 견디겠어. 비참함, 고통, 미쳐 버릴 것 같아! 대체 언제 끝나는 거야?

english: Are you OK?
OK? Who's OK? Not me! Hee hee!
translation: 괜찮냐고? 누가 괜찮은데? 난 아냐! 히히!

english: What's wrong?
You can't see me, no one can. Monsters, demons, they're all around me!
translation: 넌 나를 볼 수 없어, 아무도 못 봐. 괴물들, 악마들이 온통 날 둘러싸고 있어!

english: What do you mean?
They're dancing, all of them, hee hee.
translation: 다들 춤추고 있어, 하나도 빠짐없이, 히히.

english: He's clearly lost the plot.

translation: 그게, 나무 위에 올라가 있는 사람을 매일 보는 건 아니잖아요.

english: I'm trying to observe a suspect. Leave me alone!
What's this all about?
Hadn't you heard? You'd better go and talk to the other guard, the one by the bank door. He'll tell you all about it.
translation: 못 들었어요? 다른 경비병한테 가서 물어봐요. 은행 문 옆에 있는 사람 말이에요. 그 사람이 다 얘기해 줄 거예요.

english: Go on, ask him what's wrong with the bank wall. He loves when people ask him that.
translation: 어서 가서 은행 벽에 무슨 문제가 있냐고 물어봐요. 그 질문 받는 걸 아주 좋아하거든요.

english: Ok, if you say so..
This is about the bank robbery, right?
Yes, that's right. We're keeping the suspect under tight observation for the moment.
translation: 네, 맞아요. 지금은 용의자를 철저히 감시하고 있어요.

english: Can't you just... I dunno... arrest him?
I'm not meant to discuss the case. You know what confidentiality rules are like.
translation: 사건 얘기는 하면 안 돼요. 보안 규정이 어떤지 알잖아요.

english: Fair enough.
You're not being very subtle up there.
translation: 거기 위에 숨어 있는 거 다 티 나요.

english: I'd be doing a lot better if nits like you didn't come crowding around me all day!
translation: 당신 같은 멍청이들이 하루 종일 몰려와서 귀찮게 하지만 않으면 훨씬 잘 숨어 있을 거예요!

english: But your legs are hanging down!
Go away!
Please yourself!
Can I do anything to help?
That's very kind of you. I'd rather like a nice bowl of stew, if you could fetch me one. I don't get many meal breaks.
translation: 정말 친절하군요. 괜찮다면 맛있는 stew(스튜) 한 그릇 갖다주면 좋겠어요. 밥 먹을 짬이 별로 없거든요.

english: You want a bowl of stew?
If you wouldn't mind...
I'll think about it!
Yes, what do you... I say, is that stew for me?
translation: 네, 무슨... 아니, 그거 날 주려는 stew(스튜)예요?

english: Ok, take the stew!
Gosh, that's very kind of you! Here, have a few coins for your trouble...
translation: 이런, 정말 친절하네요! 자, 수고비로 코인 몇 개 받아요...

english: The guard eats the stew
The guard drops the empty bowl out of the tree!
translation: 경비병이 빈 bowl(그릇)을 나무 아래로 떨어뜨린다!

english: No, I want to keep this stew!
Fair enough. But if you change your mind, I'll probably still be here.
translation: 알겠어요. 하지만 마음이 바뀌면 와요. 아마 계속 여기 있을 테니까.

english: Here's some stew.
I think I should leave him in peace to finish his stew!
translation: stew(스튜)를 다 먹을 때까지 가만히 두는 게 좋겠어요!

english: Why the demoninikinare you waving THAT at me?
translation: 아니, 대체 왜 그딴 걸 나한테 흔들어 대는 거예요?

english: Sorry, I thought you'd like it.
Erm... No thanks! Now, if you don't mind, I'm trying to observe this suspect!
translation: 음... 사양할게요! 자, 괜찮다면 난 이 용의자를 감시해야 하거든요!

english: Sorry!
Ooooch!
Oi!
Watch what you're doing with that axe, you nit!
translation: 그 도끼 조심해서 휘둘러요, 이 멍청이 같으니!

english: You'll blow my cover! I'm meant to be hidden!
translation: 내 정체가 들통나잖아요! 난 숨어 있어야 한다고요!

english: Will you stop that?
Don't draw attention to me!
Hey - gerroff me!
Ow! That really hurt!
This is about the bank robbery, right?
You're not being very subtle up there.
translation: 거기 위에 숨어 있는 거 다 티 나요.

english: Can I do anything to help?
Ok, take the stew!
No, I want to keep this stew!
You must defeat me before touching the tree!
translation: 이 나무에 손대려면 먼저 나를 쓰러뜨려야 한다!

english: Grr ... Get out of my way...
Hello there.
Greetings, traveller. Are you interested in any throwing weapons?
translation: 반갑소, 나그네여. 투척 무기에 관심 있소?

english: Yes I am.
That is a good thing.
Not really.
No bother to me.
Yes I am.
Not really.
Ho, [Fremennik name]! The brave warrior returns!
It was a hard-fought battle, but we Fremennik prevailed!
I expect we'll be hearing songs about the 'Slayer of the Troll King' for many years to come.
translation: 앞으로 오랫동안 '트롤 왕을 쓰러뜨린 자'의 노래를 듣게 될 걸세.

english: It would be an honour to be remembered in such a way! Thanks.
Hello there.
Thanks for rescuing my mum and dad!
translation: 우리 엄마 아빠 구해 줘서 고마워!

english: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I might be a troll, but it was real uncomfortable in there!
translation: 그 얼음 덩어리에서 꺼내 줘서 다시 한번 고맙다! 내가 트롤이긴 해도, 거기 안은 진짜 불편했거든!

english: Thanks again for freeing me from that ice block! I don't know what my little snookums would have done without us!
translation: 그 얼음 덩어리에서 꺼내 줘서 다시 한번 고마워! 우리가 없었으면 우리 귀염둥이가 어떻게 됐을지 몰라!

english: Can I help you, traveller?
Why do you stand here?
This is the northernmost reach of Kourend. Beyond these cliffs you will find the Doors of Dinh and the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 이곳은 Kourend(쿠렌드)의 최북단이오. 이 절벽 너머에는 Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)과 Wintertodt(윈터토트)의 감옥이 있소.

english: The Pyromancers do what they can to keep the Wintertodt contained but I fear it will not be enough.
translation: Pyromancers(화염술사)가 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 가둬 두려고 최선을 다하고 있지만, 그것으로는 부족할까 두렵소.

english: I come here to keep watch, whenever my time permits, so that the city may be warned if the Wintertodt escapes.
translation: 나는 시간이 날 때마다 이곳에 와서 망을 보오. Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 빠져나오면 도시에 경고할 수 있도록 말이오.

english: Interesting... Thanks.
I'm fine, thanks.
What's this for?
For your troubles.
Right... Well, thanks.
Thanks.
About this circle of dead mushrooms...
You know very little of such circles, traveller. Perhaps one day we will have more to discuss. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 그대는 그런 고리에 대해 아는 게 거의 없구려, 나그네여. 언젠가 더 이야기 나눌 날이 오겠지. 자, 다른 도울 일이 있소?

english: Yes, the circle is dead. Crops die quite often, according to the Hosidius peasants. Do you wish me to reanimate it? I can, for a mere 80,000 coins.
translation: 그렇소, 그 고리는 죽었소. Hosidius(호시디우스) 농민들 말로는 작물이란 꽤 자주 죽는다더군. 내가 되살려 주길 원하오? 고작 80,000코인이면 해 주겠소.

english: I don't have the money.
In that case the circle will remain dead. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 그렇다면 그 고리는 죽은 채로 남을 것이오. 자, 다른 도울 일이 있소?

english: Okay, here's 80,000 coins.
Trossa casts a reanimation spell on the mushrooms
There, the deed is done. Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 자, 일은 끝났소. 다른 도울 일이 있소?

english: No thanks, I'm not interested.
Why do you stand here?
I'm fine, thanks.
About this circle of dead mushrooms...
Okay, here's 80,000 coins.
No thanks, I'm not interested.
Hello there.
Oh, what do you want? Can't you see I'm trying to nap?
translation: 뭐야, 무슨 일인데? 나 낮잠 자려는 거 안 보여?

english: Shouldn't you be catching rats?
translation: 너 쥐 잡아야 하는 거 아니야?

english: Oh my, no. I have humans for that.
translation: 어휴, 무슨. 그런 일 하라고 인간들이 있는 거지.

english: Meow.
Greetings.
Hello Bwana. I conclude that you have been successful. Mosol sent word that the village is clearing of zombies. You have done us all a great deed!
translation: 안녕하세요, Bwana(브와나). 성공하신 모양이군요. Mosol(모솔)이 마을에서 좀비들이 사라지고 있다는 소식을 전해 왔어요. 우리 모두를 위해 큰일을 해 주셨어요!

english: Why not go and visit him and have a look around Shilo village. You may find some interesting things there!
translation: 그를 찾아가서 Shilo village(실로 마을)을 둘러보는 건 어때요? 흥미로운 걸 발견할지도 몰라요!

english: Hello!
Hello again Bwana! Well Done again for helping to defeat Rashiliyia. Hopefully things will return to normal around here now.
translation: 다시 만나서 반가워요, Bwana(브와나)! Rashiliyia(라실리야)를 물리치는 걸 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요. 이제 이 근방도 평소대로 돌아갔으면 좋겠네요.

english: Hello Bwana!
Greetings!
I hope things are going well for you now. I have no new information since last we spoke. Needless to say, that if something does come up I will certainly get in touch directly.
translation: 요즘은 잘 지내고 계시길 바라요. 지난번 이야기 이후로 새로 알게 된 건 없어요. 말할 것도 없이, 무슨 일이 생기면 반드시 바로 연락드릴게요.

english: So how are you doing?
We walk in the light of Tumeken. Gone he may be, but his fire burns on through all who remain. For some, the fire heals. For others, it destroys. This is as it should be. It is all part of the plan.
translation: 우리는 Tumeken(투메켄)의 빛 속을 걷는다. 그는 떠났을지 모르나, 그의 불길은 남은 모든 이들을 통해 계속 타오른다. 어떤 이에게 그 불은 치유이고, 다른 이에게는 파멸이다. 그것이 마땅한 이치다. 모두 계획의 일부이니.

english: Okay... never mind.
*Brrrrrrr*
Even the tiniest grain of sand is illuminated by his light.
translation: 가장 작은 모래 한 알조차 그의 빛을 받아 빛난다.

english: His light still burns within me.
translation: 그의 빛은 아직 내 안에서 타오른다.

english: ... light... meken. Gone... fire bur...
Are you okay?
*Brrrrrrrrr* 404: *Zkxhcz*
Maybe you should get some rest?
Malfunction... ERROR... Malfunction...
We are ever faithful to the guidance of Elidinis. Her water sustains us, and brings life to the lifeless. We grow with her, and she with us. For as long as we remember her, we will never be alone.
translation: 우리는 언제나 Elidinis(엘리디니스)의 인도에 충실하다. 여신의 물이 우리를 지탱하고, 생명 없는 것에 생명을 불어넣는다. 우리는 여신과 함께 자라고, 여신도 우리와 함께 자란다. 우리가 여신을 기억하는 한, 결코 혼자가 아니리라.

english: *Brrrrrrr*
Even a single one of her tears could grow an oasis.
translation: 여신의 눈물 한 방울만으로도 오아시스가 피어날 수 있다.

english: Her river flows within me.
... faithful... guidan... dinis... water... life...
*Brrrrrrrrr* 34: *KzZhc*
Instructions... unclear... ERROR... stuck...
May shadows be your grave!
That's not a nice way to greet someone, is it?
translation: 그건 별로 좋은 인사가 아니잖아, 안 그래?

english: All will be ashes!
Has anyone ever told you that you're a bit gloomy?
translation: 너 좀 우울하다는 말 들어 본 적 없어?

english: Resisting only delays the inevitable!
translation: 저항은 피할 수 없는 일을 늦출 뿐이다!

english: Alright then.
All will be ashes.
Fight back, coward.
From one prison, to another.
What's life like as anbaboon?
Have you seen me? I look a bit dead. How about you tell me what's life like.
translation: 나 좀 봐. 좀 죽은 것처럼 생겼잖아. 사는 게 어떤지는 네가 말해 주지 그래?

english: Well, it's just life, isn't it?
translation: 뭐, 사는 게 다 그렇지 않아?

english: Well, it's just life, isn't it?
translation: 뭐, 사는 게 다 그렇지 않아?

english: Yes... That's what I said.
Yes... That's what I said.
Stop aping!
I physically cannot do that.
Then maybe the same could be said for me.
I suppose. I would really like to know your story though.
translation: 그런가. 그래도 네 이야기는 정말 듣고 싶어.

english: Now that's a different question. I am the daughter of a most powerful matriarch.
translation: 그건 또 다른 질문이네. 난 아주 강력한 여족장의 딸이야.

english: While I grew up with many siblings, she always took care of us. In fact, I've never been scared.
translation: 형제자매가 많았지만, 어머니는 늘 우리를 돌봐 주셨어. 사실 난 한 번도 겁먹어 본 적이 없어.

english: Why do you think that is?
It must be due to her motherly love and my great family.
Mhm. I'm sure... That must be it.
Hand over all the bananas, and no one will get hurt.
translation: 바나나 전부 내놔. 그럼 아무도 안 다쳐.

english: Hello, little one.
Hello?
Do you not like me?
Are you shy? Why would you follow me and not say anything?
translation: 부끄러운 거야? 왜 아무 말 없이 따라다니는 거야?

english: Do not mistake my silence for shyness. Can't we just quietly share the road together?
translation: 내 침묵을 수줍음으로 착각하지 말게. 그냥 조용히 같은 길을 함께 걸으면 안 되겠나?

english: Oh... well, yes, I suppose we can.
Bzzzzz!
Feed me.
That's quite demanding, but sure. What would you like?
translation: 꽤 막무가내네. 그래도 좋아. 뭘 먹고 싶은데?

english: I demand sustenance.
I might have some cooked lobsters somewhere... Maybe a Saradomin brew?
translation: 어딘가에 cooked lobsters(익힌 랍스터)가 좀 있을 텐데... 아니면 Saradomin brew(사라도민 브루)?

english: Food.
You really have a one-track mind, don't you?
Hungry.
Look what I have!
I'm on a diet.
You're joking aren't you?!
I only eat adventurers... Like you.
Oh... okay, as you were.
Feeeed me!
I will devour you!
Where food?
Who are you?
I'm one of the elite Slayer Masters.
translation: 난 엘리트 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터) 중 한 명이에요.

english: What's a slayer?
Oh dear, what do they teach you in school?
translation: 이런, 학교에서 대체 뭘 가르치는 거예요?

english: Well... er...

I suppose I'll have to educate you then. A slayer is someone who is trained to fight specific creatures. They know these creatures' every weakness and strength. As you can guess it makes killing them a lot easier.
translation: 그럼 내가 가르쳐 줘야겠네요. 슬레이어는 특정한 생물과 싸우도록 훈련받은 사람이에요. 그 생물들의 약점과 강점을 전부 알고 있죠. 짐작하겠지만, 그러면 놈들을 죽이기가 훨씬 쉬워져요.

english: Never heard of you...
That's because my foe never lives to tell of me. We slayers are a dangerous bunch.
translation: 내 적들은 살아남아서 내 얘기를 퍼뜨리지 못하니까요. 우리 슬레이어들은 위험한 무리라고요.

english: Wow, can you teach me?
translation: 와, 저도 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?

english: Hmmm well I'm not so sure...
Pleeeaasssse!
Oh okay then, you twisted my arm. You'll have to train against specific groups of creatures.
translation: 아, 알았어요, 졌어요 졌어. 특정한 무리의 생물들을 상대로 훈련해야 할 거예요.

english: Okay, what's first?
We'll start you off hunting [monster name], you'll need to kill [number] of them.
You'll also need this enchanted gem, it allows Slayer Masters like myself to contact you and update you on your progress. Don't worry if you lose it, you can buy another from any Slayer Master.
translation: 이 enchanted gem(마법이 걸린 보석)도 필요할 거예요. 나 같은 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터)가 당신에게 연락해서 진행 상황을 알려 줄 수 있게 해 주죠. 잃어버려도 걱정 말아요. 어느 슬레이어 마스터에게서나 새로 살 수 있으니까요.

english: Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 빌어요! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 와요.

english: Sounds useless to me.
Suit yourself.
'Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: 어서 와요, 그래 뭘 찾으러 왔어요?

english: I need another assignment.
You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?
translation: 당신은 사실 꽤 강한데, 정말 Zanaris(자나리스)의 Chaeldar(카엘다르)한테서 임무를 받지 않아도 괜찮겠어요?

english: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.
Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 훌륭해요, 아주 잘하고 있어요. 새 임무는 [task monster] [amount]마리를 처치하는 거예요.

english: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.
Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
translation: 그런데, 그건 내가 보통 주는 임무가 아닌데... 원하면 새 임무를 줄 수도 있어요.

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].
translation: 새 임무를 받으면 [task streak amount]회인 일반 임무 연속 기록이 초기화돼요. 괜찮겠어요? Wilderness(황야) 임무 연속 기록 [task streak amount]회에는 영향이 없어요.

english: No, thanks.
You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그건 당신한테 맞는 임무가 아닌 것 같네요. 취소해 줄까요? 임무 연속 기록은 지워지지 않아요.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋아요, 임무는 취소된 걸로 할게요. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있어요.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있어요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 당신이 얻을 수 있는 보상도 꽤 있고, 다양한 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 팔아요.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기해 봐요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
