Then you [TzHaar caste]!
What are you then?
Silly JalYt, I am TzHaar-Ket, one of the guardians of our city.
translation: 어리석은 JalYt(잘이트), 나는 TzHaar-Ket(츠하르-켓), 우리 도시 수호자 중 하나.

english: There are the wise TzHaar-Mej who guide us, the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food, and the skilled TzHaar-Hur who craft our homes and tools.
translation: 우리 이끄는 현명한 TzHaar-Mej(츠하르-메즈), 우리 먹을 것 사냥하는 날쌘 TzHaar-Xil(츠하르-실), 우리 집과 도구 만드는 솜씨 좋은 TzHaar-Hur(츠하르-후르) 있어.

english: Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
Well then, no problems.
No I'm not!
What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
No I'm fine thanks.
Hello JalYt-[TzHaar caste]-[player name].
Hello!
You need help little JalYt?
Not unless you can help me in The Inferno.
translation: The Inferno(인페르노)에서 도와줄 수 있는 게 아니라면 괜찮아요.

english: We dare not go there. That job is for you.
translation: 우리, 거기 감히 못 가. 그 일은 너 몫.

english: Oh... worth a try I suppose.
Why can't I go past here?
Why's that?
That's a shame.
What if I could prove I am capable?
translation: 제가 감당할 수 있다는 걸 증명하면요?

english: How about a large stack of gold?
I managed to defeat TzTok-Jad and obtain this firecape.
translation: TzTok-Jad(츠톡-자드)를 물리치고 이 firecape(화염 망토)를 얻었어요.

english: Sorry, I don't think I am capable.
translation: 죄송해요, 제가 감당할 수 있을 것 같지 않네요.

english: I'm a hardened adventurer, nothing can stop me!
translation: 저는 단련된 모험가예요, 아무것도 절 막을 수 없어요!

english: What are you guarding?
Oh well, Goodbye.
translation: 그럼 어쩔 수 없죠, 안녕히 계세요.

english: Oh well, [TzHaar caste]-[player name] over and out.
translation: 그럼 어쩔 수 없음, [TzHaar caste]-[player name] 이상 통신 끝.

english: Fair enough.
What did you call me?
What are you then?
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
No I'm not!
No I'm fine thanks.
Yes, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]?
Tell me about the Inferno.
TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in lava pools. When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: TzHaar(츠하르)는 용암 웅덩이에서 품은 알에서 태어나. 부화하면 기억 간직해. 용암으로 돌아간 선조들에게서 물려받은 기억과 지식.

english: When TzHaar hatch, some memories are lost. Those about earliest ancestors are not retained. We experiment.
translation: TzHaar(츠하르) 부화할 때 기억 일부 사라져. 가장 오래된 선조들에 대한 기억은 남지 않아. 그래서 우리 실험해.

english: This here was once our largest birthing pool. We use it for experiment. We increased the depth at which eggs are incubated. Over time, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 여기는 한때 우리 가장 큰 탄생 웅덩이였어. 실험에 써. 알 품는 깊이를 늘렸어. 시간 지나자, 새로 부화한 TzHaar(츠하르)는 잃어버린 역사의 기억 더 많이 가졌어!

english: But we kept pushing. We wanted answers, but we went too deep.
translation: 하지만 우리 계속 밀어붙였어. 답 원했지만, 너무 깊이 갔어.

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sinkhole. At the bottom we found some sort of ancient incubation chamber, from before earliest memories. We now call it the Inferno.
translation: 결국 웅덩이 무너져서 싱크홀 됐어. 바닥에서 아주 오래된 부화실 같은 것 찾았어. 가장 오래된 기억보다 더 이전 것. 우리 지금 그걸 Inferno(인페르노)라 불러.

english: We decide to experiment more. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them down there.
translation: 우리 더 실험하기로 했어. Fight Cave(투기 동굴) 생물들의 알 가져와서 저 아래에서 품었어.

english: When eggs hatched, we see that it was not good decision. They were bigger and stronger, and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 알 부화했을 때, 좋은 결정 아니었다는 걸 알았어. 더 크고 더 강했고, 우위 차지하려고 서로 싸웠어.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures, and they're not alone. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 지식 대신, 이제 위험한 생물들의 방 생겼어. 그리고 그것들만 있는 게 아니야. Inferno(인페르노)에 다른 존재 살아. 어떤 TzHaar(츠하르)보다 강한 존재.

english: We do not know where he came from. All we know is that TzKal-Zuk is hungry. Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno.
translation: 그가 어디서 왔는지 우리 몰라. 아는 건 TzKal-Zuk(츠칼-주크)가 굶주렸다는 것뿐. 기억에 굶주렸어, Inferno(인페르노) 너머의 기억에.

english: We think his goal is the city itself. Lots of TzHaar memories here for him. Luckily, he is trapped in prison down there, and we are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices.
translation: 우리 생각에 그의 목표는 이 도시 자체. 여기 그가 먹을 TzHaar(츠하르) 기억 많아. 다행히 그는 저 아래 감옥에 갇혀 있고, 우리 제물 바쳐서 그를 막고 있어.

english: We fear he can't be defeated, but maybe we can hold back his creatures and keep city safe.
translation: 그를 물리칠 수 없을까 봐 두려워. 하지만 그의 생물들 막아서 도시 지킬 수 있을지도 몰라.

english: You, a mere JalYt, showed us he can be stopped though. Thanks to you, we still have hope.
translation: 그런데 한낱 JalYt(잘이트)인 네가 그를 막을 수 있다는 걸 보여 줬어. 너 덕분에 우리 아직 희망 있어.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have chamber of dangerous creatures. It gets worse, but I don't know if I can trust JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name] with this knowledge.
translation: 지식 대신, 이제 위험한 생물들의 방 생겼어. 더 나쁜 일도 있지만, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]에게 이 지식 맡겨도 될지 모르겠어.

english: I like to think I'm pretty trustworthy. If you tell me, maybe I can help in some way.
translation: 저 꽤 믿을 만한 사람이라고 생각해요. 말해 주시면 어떻게든 도울 수 있을지도 몰라요.

english: I have one idea. If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 한 가지 생각 있어. 네 fire cape(화염 망토)를 나에게 바치면, 네 말 믿을 수 있어.

english: Okay, I'd like to sacrifice my fire cape.
translation: 좋아요, 제 fire cape(화염 망토)를 바칠게요.

english: Very well, just hand it over.
Sorry, I want to keep it for now.
Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. You can enter Inferno now.
translation: 고마워, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. 이제 Inferno(인페르노)에 들어가도 돼.

english: What should I do down there?
The creatures down there are dangerous. If you can kill some of them, it would be very helpful to TzHaar.
translation: 저 아래 생물들 위험해. 그중 몇이라도 죽여 주면 TzHaar(츠하르)에게 큰 도움 될 거야.

english: But now you can be trusted, I must also give warning. Another being lives in the Inferno, one more powerful than any TzHaar.
translation: 이제 너 믿을 수 있으니, 경고도 해야 해. Inferno(인페르노)에 다른 존재 살아. 어떤 TzHaar(츠하르)보다 강한 존재.

english: Well I definitely think I can help with that.
translation: 그건 제가 확실히 도울 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: Thank you, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
I'll need to take it off first.
I don't have a fire cape on me unfortunately.
translation: 아쉽게도 지금 fire cape(화염 망토)를 안 갖고 있어요.

english: Can I help here in some way?
I think maybe you can, but first you need to prove I can trust you.
translation: 아마 있을 거야. 하지만 먼저 내가 너 믿어도 된다는 걸 증명해야 해.

english: If you sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 네 fire cape(화염 망토)를 나에게 바치면, 네 말 믿을 수 있어.

english: Never mind.
A great power is starting to shake the cavern...
No! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. There's nothing I can do for you now, JalYt!
translation: 안 돼! TzKal-Zuk(츠칼-주크)의 감옥 무너지고 있어. 이제 내가 너 위해 해 줄 수 있는 게 없어, JalYt(잘이트)!

english: You are very impressive for a JalYt. You managed to defeat TzKal-Zuk, for now...
translation: JalYt(잘이트)치고 아주 대단해. TzKal-Zuk(츠칼-주크) 물리쳤어, 일단은...

english: Please accept this cape as a token of appreciation.
translation: 감사의 증표로 이 망토 받아 줘.

english: Wow what has happened here? That doesn't look good!
translation: 와, 여기 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요? 상황이 안 좋아 보이는데요!

english: We pushed it too far! JalYt would not understand. The memories, we needed them. Now big Inferno.
translation: 우리 너무 멀리 갔어! JalYt(잘이트)는 이해 못 해. 기억, 우리에겐 필요했어. 이제 거대한 Inferno(인페르노).

english: What is this place?
This is our birthing pool. TzHaar are born from eggs incubated in this large pool here.
translation: 여기 우리 탄생 웅덩이. TzHaar(츠하르)는 여기 이 큰 웅덩이에서 품은 알에서 태어나.

english: When hatched, we retain memories. Memories and knowledge passed on from ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 부화하면 기억 간직해. 용암으로 돌아간 선조들에게서 물려받은 기억과 지식.

english: Something doesn't seem right... There's a large opening.
What happened here?
We went too far... way too far, we need the memories. JalYt would not understand.
translation: 우리 너무 멀리 갔어... 너무너무 멀리. 우리 기억 필요해. JalYt(잘이트)는 이해 못 해.

english: Please help me to understand then.
translation: 그럼 제가 이해할 수 있게 설명해 주세요.

english: We TzHaar have special ability. When incubated in lava, a hatched TzHaar retains knowledge and memories of ancestors who returned to the lava.
translation: 우리 TzHaar(츠하르)에겐 특별한 능력 있어. 용암 속에서 품으면, 부화한 츠하르는 용암으로 돌아간 선조들의 지식과 기억 간직해.

english: Not all memories though, those about earliest ancestors were not being retained. We experiment.
translation: 하지만 모든 기억은 아니야. 가장 오래된 선조들에 대한 기억은 남지 않았어. 그래서 우리 실험해.

english: We increased the depth at which the eggs are incubated. Over time this worked, newly hatched TzHaar had more memories of lost history!
translation: 알 품는 깊이를 늘렸어. 시간 지나니 효과 있었어. 새로 부화한 TzHaar(츠하르)는 잃어버린 역사의 기억 더 많이 가졌어!

english: That sounds fantastic though, uncovering the past to determine where your species originated?
translation: 그건 오히려 굉장한 일 같은데요? 과거를 밝혀서 종족이 어디서 왔는지 알아내는 거잖아요?

english: Yes, but you JalYt do not understand, we kept pushing it. We wanted answers, but too deep we went.
translation: 그래, 하지만 너 JalYt(잘이트)는 이해 못 해. 우리 계속 밀어붙였어. 답 원했지만, 너무 깊이, 우리 갔어.

english: Eventually the pool collapsed into a sink hole, huge Inferno there. This was big ancient incubation chamber.
translation: 결국 웅덩이 무너져서 싱크홀 됐어. 거기 거대한 Inferno(인페르노). 아주 오래된 거대한 부화실이었어.

english: We decide to experiment. We take eggs from creatures in Fight Cave and incubate them.
translation: 우리 실험하기로 했어. Fight Cave(투기 동굴) 생물들의 알 가져와서 품었어.

english: We hatched eggs in there and it was not a good decision. They were so different, bigger, stronger and fought each other for dominance.
translation: 거기서 알 부화시켰는데 좋은 결정 아니었어. 너무 달랐어. 더 크고, 더 강하고, 우위 차지하려고 서로 싸웠어.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous TzHaar creatures - it gets worse but I cannot trust JalYt with this knowledge yet.
translation: 지식 대신, 이제 위험한 TzHaar(츠하르) 생물들의 감옥 생겼어 - 더 나쁜 일도 있지만 아직 JalYt(잘이트)에게 이 지식 맡길 수 없어.

english: Instead of knowledge, we now have a prison of dangerous creatures... and they're not under our control.
translation: 지식 대신, 이제 위험한 생물들의 감옥 생겼어... 그리고 그것들 우리 통제 밖에 있어.

english: One grew incredibly strong, powerful. He controls those creatures in the prison. TzKal-Zuk, as we call him...is hungry.
translation: 하나가 엄청나게 강해졌어, 강력해. 그가 감옥 속 생물들 지배해. TzKal-Zuk(츠칼-주크), 우리 그렇게 불러... 그는 굶주렸어.

english: Hungry for memories, memories beyond the Inferno, which only TzHaar in the city can provide.
translation: 기억에 굶주렸어. Inferno(인페르노) 너머의 기억, 도시의 TzHaar(츠하르)만 줄 수 있는 기억에.

english: Do you know what he's planning? What are you doing?
translation: 그가 뭘 꾸미는지 아세요? 당신들은 뭘 하고 있는데요?

english: We can only guess one day he will want to scale up into the city himself. We are keeping him at bay by offering sacrifices for him to feast on.
translation: 언젠가 그가 직접 도시까지 기어오르려 할 거라고 짐작할 뿐이야. 우리 그가 먹을 제물 바쳐서 그를 막고 있어.

english: Is there no way to take him out?
We fear not. But we hoped you, with your fancy JalYt weaponry, would be able to help hold back his creatures. You proved your commitment by sacrificing your fire cape.
translation: 없을까 봐 두려워. 하지만 네가 그 멋진 JalYt(잘이트) 무기로 그의 생물들 막는 걸 도와주길 바랐어. 넌 fire cape(화염 망토)를 바쳐서 각오를 증명했어.

english: Can I go down there?
JalYt, we need help, but this is extremely dangerous. TzHaar not strong enough to take control back.
translation: JalYt(잘이트), 우리 도움 필요해. 하지만 이건 극도로 위험해. TzHaar(츠하르)는 통제 되찾을 만큼 강하지 않아.

english: We are worried about trusting JalYt to take on this task for us.
translation: JalYt(잘이트)에게 이 일 맡기는 거, 우리 걱정돼.

english: Let me prove it.
I have one idea, if you could sacrifice your fire cape to me, I can take your word.
translation: 한 가지 생각 있어. 네 fire cape(화염 망토)를 나에게 바칠 수 있다면, 네 말 믿을 수 있어.

english: You hand over your cape to TzHaar-Ket-Keh.
Give it your best shot JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
Let me just take it off first.
You can head into The Inferno anytime. We trust you to help us JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
translation: 언제든 The Inferno(인페르노)로 들어가도 돼. 우리 너 믿어, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].

english: I'll do my best.
I have a spare infernal cape, perhaps I could offer it back to you for a littlun to take with me?
translation: 여분의 infernal cape(지옥 망토)가 있는데, 이걸 돌려드리는 대신 데려갈 꼬맹이 하나 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Maybe. Hand it over and if you make lucky TokKul toss, it can be yours JalYt.
translation: 어쩌면. 넘겨 봐. TokKul(토쿨) 던지기에서 운 좋으면, 그거 네 거야, JalYt(잘이트).

english: But do know, you do not get cape back.
translation: 하지만 알아 둬, 망토는 돌려받지 못해.

english: Luck be a TzHaar tonight. Jal-Nib-Rek is yours.
translation: 오늘 밤 행운은 TzHaar(츠하르) 편. Jal-Nib-Rek(잘-닙-렉)은 네 거야.

english: No Jal-Nib-Rek for you.
No, I want to keep my cape.
Nevermind.
Tell me about the Inferno.
Yes.
No.
Can I help here in some way?
Never mind.
What is this place?
What happened here?
Can I go down there?
No, I'd like to keep it.
Yes, I'd like to sacrifice it.
I have a spare infernal cape.
Yes, I accept that I won't get my cape back.
translation: 네, 망토를 돌려받지 못한다는 걸 받아들일게요.

english: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. The challenge awaits, if you're brave enough.
translation: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name]. 도전이 기다려, 용기 있다면.

english: Of course I'm brave enough.
Then select your challenge, JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
I'll pass.
Few can match TzHaar bravery.
JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name]. Few match your strength. Do you wish to take on the challenge again?
translation: JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name]. 네 힘 따라올 자 드물어. 도전 다시 받고 싶어?

english: Let's do it.
Then select your challenge, JalYt-[caste]-Kal-[player name].
The challenge is now beneath you? So be it.
translation: 이제 도전이 너에게 하찮아? 그렇다면 좋아.

english: JalYt-[caste]-Xo-[player name].
Nice chair.
The finest obsidian. Cost many TokKul.
Now, have you come for the challenge?
Err, what challenge?
Deep in inferno, many offspring of TzTok-Jad. More powerful though. More dangerous.
translation: 인페르노 깊은 곳, TzTok-Jad(츠톡-자드)의 자손 많아. 그런데 더 강해. 더 위험해.

english: The offspring need dealing with. A challenge for you perhaps, if you're brave enough.
translation: 그 자손들 처리해야 해. 너에게 맞는 도전일지도, 용기 있다면.

english: Failure. Maybe the challenge is not for you.
translation: 실패. 이 도전, 너에게 안 맞을지도.

english: Challenge complete. Have some TokKul. Now, a new challenge awaits.
translation: 도전 완료. TokKul(토쿨) 받아. 이제 새 도전 기다려.

english: Six challenges complete. Very impressive JalYt. Have some TokKul, and a little extra something.

translation: 그게 너야... 너 물건 잘 만들어, 아니야?

english: Well yes I suppose I am...
Then you [TzHaar caste]!
What are you then?
Foolish JalYt, I am TzHaar-Mej, one of the mystics of this city.
translation: 어리석은 JalYt(잘이트), 나 TzHaar-Mej(츠하르-메즈), 이 도시의 신비술사 중 하나.

english: What other types are there?
There are the mighty TzHaar-Ket who guard us, the swift TzHaar-Xil who hunt for our food, and the skilled TzHaar-Hur who craft our homes and tools.
translation: 우리 지키는 강한 TzHaar-Ket(츠하르-켓), 우리 먹을 것 사냥하는 날쌘 TzHaar-Xil(츠하르-실), 우리 집과 도구 만드는 솜씨 좋은 TzHaar-Hur(츠하르-후르) 있어.

english: Ah ok then.
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
Well then, no problems.
No I'm not!
What ever you say, crazy JalYt!
No I'm fine thanks.
What do you have to trade?
What did you call me?
What are you then?
What other types are there?
Ah ok then.
Thanks for explaining it.
I guess so...
No I'm not!
No I'm fine thanks.
Do you miss your people?
No.. I don't think so.
No, no, I wouldn't hurt you.
translation: 아니, 아니, 널 해치지 않을 거야.

english: Are you hungry?
Kl-Kra!
Ooookay...
Kal-Kl!
Kl-Zek!
KlEk-Tal!
KlMej-Hej!
KlJad-Rek
Kl-Kra!
Kal-Kl!
Kl-Zek!
KlEk-Tal!
KlMej-Hej!
KlJad-Rek
Nilsal.
Hello there. What brings you here?
I am the teoki responsible for the Colosseum. I am in charge of all that happens here.
translation: 저는 Colosseum(콜로세움)을 맡은 테오키입니다. 이곳에서 일어나는 모든 일을 책임지고 있습니다.

english: Hang on... The Colosseum is run by a priest?
Well much of the day-to-day running is handled by the Colosseum Master, but yes, I am the one in overall charge of this place.
translation: 일상적인 운영은 대부분 Colosseum Master(콜로세움 관장)이 맡고 있습니다만, 그렇습니다. 이곳의 총책임자는 저입니다.

english: So why is that?
This is more than just a place of spectacle. You stand in one of the holiest sites in all of Varlamore. Each drop of blood spilt here is a glorious offering to Ralos.
translation: 이곳은 단순한 구경거리의 장소가 아닙니다. 당신은 지금 Varlamore(바를라모어) 전역에서 가장 신성한 장소 중 한 곳에 서 있습니다. 이곳에서 흘린 피 한 방울 한 방울이 Ralos(랄로스)께 바치는 영광스러운 제물입니다.

english: It is these offerings that sustain him. Without them, he will not have the strength to light our way.
translation: 그분을 지탱하는 것이 바로 이 제물들입니다. 제물이 없으면 그분은 우리의 길을 밝힐 힘을 잃으실 겁니다.

english: Interesting... Thanks for the information.
Hello again.
Hey yous creature...yous did good fings gedin that glug-glugs for da sickies! All is ogries pepels are not gettin dead cos of you.
translation: 어이 너 생물...너 아픈 애덜 위해 꿀꺽꿀꺽 구해 온 거 좋은 짓 했어! 너 땜에 우리 오우거 사람덜 하나도 안 죽어.

english: What are you selling?
Me's not got no glug-glugs to sell, yous bring me da sickies glug-glug den me's open da stufsies for ya.
translation: 나 팔 꿀꺽꿀꺽 없어. 너 아픈 애덜 꿀꺽꿀꺽 갖다 주면 그때 나 물건덜 열어 줄게.

english: Me's showin' you da stufsies for yous creatures!
translation: 나 너 생물덜한테 물건덜 보여 준다!

english: Ok, thanks.
Hey, here you go! I brought you some of the potion which should cure the disease. You said that you would buy some from me.
translation: 자, 여기요! 병을 고칠 수 있는 물약을 좀 가져왔어요. 저한테서 사 주겠다고 했잖아요.

english: Yous creatures is da funny ones...yous already solds me's ones now..and us can now sell un to yous!
translation: 너 생물덜 웃긴 놈덜...너 벌써 나한테 팔았어..그래서 이제 우리가 너한테 팔 수 있어!

english: Yous creatures done da good fing...yous get many bright pretties for dis...!
translation: 너 생물덜 좋은 짓 했어...이걸로 반짝반짝 예쁜 거 많이 받아...!

english: I's gots a thinky number puzzley for yous!
translation: 나 너한테 줄 머리 쓰는 숫자 퍼즐 있어!

english: Yous gots da numbers?
I's thinks yous needs to thinks again.
translation: 나 생각엔 너 다시 생각해야 돼.

english: Dats da right answer!
Hello again.
What are you selling?
Ok, thanks.
Mmm... looks like that camel would make a nice kebab.
translation: 음... 저 낙타로 케밥을 만들면 맛있겠는데.

english: If I go near that camel, it'll probably bite my hand off.
translation: 저 낙타 근처에 갔다간 손을 물어뜯기겠어.

english: I wonder if that camel has fleas...
The camel tries to stamp on your foot, but you pull it back quickly.
translation: 낙타가 당신의 발을 밟으려 하지만, 당신은 재빨리 발을 뺀다.

english: The camel turns its head and glares at you.
The camel spits at you, and you jump back hurriedly.
translation: 낙타가 당신에게 침을 뱉고, 당신은 황급히 뒤로 물러선다.

english: Come over here, I'll bite your leg off!
translation: 이리 와 봐, 다리를 물어뜯어 주마!

english: Prepare to die, you two-legged combat wrangler!
translation: 죽을 준비나 해라, 이 두 발 달린 싸움꾼아!

english: Your mother was a jackal, and your father smelt of cactuses!
translation: 네 어미는 자칼이었고, 네 아비한테선 선인장 냄새가 났지!

english: Say, aren't you the human who got arrested here the other day, by the boat?
translation: 저기, 당신 며칠 전에 여기 배 옆에서 체포됐던 그 인간 아니에요?

english: Yes, but we cleared up the whole situation.
Right, right.
Hello there.
What... Oh, don't creep up on me like that... I thought you were a Ghast!
translation: 뭐... 아, 그렇게 몰래 다가오지 마세요... Ghast(가스트)인 줄 알았잖아요!

english: Can I go through the gate please?
Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezelssay so!
translation: 절대 안 돼요! 아무도 들여보내지 말라는 엄명을 받았어요. 너무 위험하거든요. Drezel(드레젤)의 허락 없이는 아무도 못 들어가요!

english: Where is Drezel?
Oh, he's in the temple, just go back over the bridge, down the ladder and along the hallway, you can't miss him.
translation: 아, 신전에 계세요. 다리를 다시 건너서 사다리를 내려가 복도를 따라가면 돼요. 못 찾을 리 없어요.

english: But I'm doing a quest for Drezel!
translation: 하지만 전 Drezel(드레젤)의 퀘스트를 하고 있다고요!

english: Ok, on your way then!
Yes of course my friend, you seem to be able to handle yourself with those ghasts really well.
translation: 물론이죠, 친구. 그 가스트들을 정말 잘 상대하시는 것 같네요.

english: Oh my! You're still alive!
Very well done! Here you go!
Ulizius has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
The serum it works...but it's not too fresh, make some yourself and then it might work for longer.
translation: 혈청이 효과가 있어요... 하지만 그리 신선하지 않네요. 직접 만들어 보면 더 오래 효과가 갈지도 몰라요.

english: Ah, hello again, what can I do for you now?
translation: 아, 또 오셨군요. 이번엔 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Hello there.
Hello again! Many thanks for helping us to solve the  riddle with the Shades, we can start to work now  putting all those Shade spirits to rest and get  a little bit of a reward to go along with it!
translation: 또 오셨군요! Shade(셰이드)의 수수께끼를 푸는 걸 도와줘서 정말 고마워요. 이제 셰이드 영혼들을 잠재우는 일을 시작할 수 있고, 덤으로 보상도 조금 받을 수 있겠어요!

english: Well done...I feel this serum is really working on me. I think you've cracked it my friend!  I'd like to give you something for your trouble!
translation: 잘했어요... 이 혈청이 정말 듣는 게 느껴져요. 친구, 해낸 것 같네요! 수고한 보답으로 뭔가 드리고 싶어요!

english: You've already used the permanent serum on me, you don't need to use that any more.
translation: 이미 저한테 영구 혈청을 쓰셨잖아요. 더는 안 쓰셔도 돼요.

english: You can't milk this cow, as its udders seem to have fallen off at some point.
translation: 이 소는 젖을 짤 수 없다. 언젠가 젖통이 떨어져 나간 모양이다.

english: Hello there [laddie/lass].
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
They say it's some kind of powerful fire spirit.
translation: 강력한 불의 정령 같은 거라고들 하더군.

english: Don't you mean ice?
Aye that as well.
What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind the Doors.
translation: 그게 뭐든 난 상관없네. Doors(문) 너머에 가둬 두기만 하면 되지.

english: Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: The Doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
translation: 그 Doors(문)은 Dinh(딘)이 Wintertodt(윈터토트)를 가두려고 만든 것일세. 천 년도 더 전의 일인데, 아직도 굳건히 서 있지.

english: Who was Dinh?
Dinh was the greatest smith that the world has ever seen. I am the finest smith around today and even I cannot match his abilities.
translation: Dinh(딘)은 세상에 다시없을 최고의 대장장이였네. 나도 지금 이 땅에서 가장 뛰어난 대장장이지만, 그 솜씨엔 못 미친다네.

english: Tell me about yourself.
The name's Undor. You'll struggle to find a dwarf in this land who knows more about metalwork than me.
translation: 내 이름은 Undor(운도르)일세. 이 땅에서 나보다 금속 세공을 잘 아는 드워프는 찾기 힘들 걸세.

english: One day I hope to be as good as the legendary Dinh himself.
translation: 언젠가는 전설의 Dinh(딘)만큼 뛰어난 대장장이가 되고 싶네.

english: What are you doing here?
They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
translation: 다들 문이 무너지고 있고 Wintertodt(윈터토트)가 빠져나오려 한다고 하더군. 난 그 문이 멀쩡하다는 걸 증명하러 왔네.

english: And are they?
Of course they are! They were made by Dinh himself.
I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the Doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
translation: 난 그저 상황을 지켜보러 와 있네. 이제 Doors(문)은 고쳐졌지만, 모든 게 정상으로 돌아오려면 여러 해가 걸릴 걸세.

english: Goodbye.
Until next time [laddie/lass].
Tell me about the Wintertodt.
Tell me about the Doors of Dinh.
translation: Doors of Dinh(딘의 문)에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about yourself.
Goodbye.
Hi Unferth. How are you doing?
It's just not the same without Bob around.
I'm so sorry Unferth.
Gertrude asked me if I'd like one of her new kittens. I don't think I'm ready for that yet.
translation: Gertrude(거트루드)가 새로 태어난 새끼 고양이 한 마리 데려가겠냐고 물었어요. 아직은 그럴 준비가 안 된 것 같아요.

english: Give it time. Things will get better, I promise.
translation: 시간이 필요할 거예요. 나아질 거예요, 약속해요.

english: Thanks [player name].
Your Legendary exploits are travelling the whole jungle.
translation: 당신의 전설적인 활약이 온 정글에 퍼지고 있어요.

english: Gujuo has been to see me. He told me that you have been given a sacred totem pole. It was constructed by one of my ancestors many moons ago. It is a noble prize Bwana, you have earned it. Look after it well.
translation: Gujuo(구주오)가 다녀갔어요. 당신이 신성한 토템 기둥을 받았다고 하더군요. 수많은 달이 뜨고 지기 전, 제 조상 중 한 분이 만든 것이에요. 고귀한 상이에요, Bwana(브와나). 당신은 받을 자격이 있어요. 잘 간직해 주세요.

english: Ungadulu unleashes a bolt of magical energy at you. You're knocked out of the octagram by the power of the spell.
translation: Ungadulu(웅가둘루)가 당신에게 마력의 화살을 쏜다. 주문의 위력에 당신은 팔각성 밖으로 튕겨 나간다.

english: I hope that teaches you to respect your elders!
translation: 이걸로 어른을 공경하는 법을 좀 배웠길 바라요!

english: The spell fizzles and has no effect as it passes through the flames.
translation: 주문이 불꽃을 통과하면서 힘없이 사그라들어 아무 효과가 없다.

english: You feel certain that your weapon would melt if you tried to attack through these magical flames.
translation: 이 마법의 불꽃 너머로 공격하려 했다간 무기가 녹아 버릴 것이 분명하다.

english: You missed!
The vial smashes on Ungadulu, soaking him in sacred water.
translation: 약병이 Ungadulu(웅가둘루)에게 부딪혀 깨지면서 그를 성수로 흠뻑 적신다.

english: Vile serpent, thou wilt pay for that!
translation: 비열한 뱀 같은 놈, 그 대가를 치르게 되리라!

english: ...What, what happened? Why am I all wet?
translation: ...뭐, 무슨 일이죠? 제가 왜 이렇게 젖었죠?

english: Please, just run...
The shaman seems to be fighting an inner battle.
translation: 주술사가 내면의 싸움을 벌이고 있는 듯하다.

english: The shaman's expression changes entirely.
Welcome Vacu, to eternal...
Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn...
translation: 어리석은 Vacu(바쿠)여... 이제 네놈은 나의 꼭두각시가 되리라...

english: The thing that was the shaman begins to chant...
translation: 한때 주술사였던 그것이 주문을 외기 시작한다...

english: Iles Resti Yam Darkus Spiritus Possesi Yanai...
translation: 일레스 레스티 얌 다르쿠스 스피리투스 포세시 야나이...

english: You feel a strange power coming over you...
translation: 이상한 힘이 당신을 덮쳐 오는 것이 느껴진다...

english: You feel very weak..
The thing seems to get stronger!
Run, Bwana! Stay away from here!
Just in time, the shaman wrests back control.
Thank you, Bwana! You have released me from the demon's grasp, but only for a short while! You must seek out the Book of Binding - it's hidden in these caves somewhere!.
translation: 고마워요, Bwana(브와나)! 당신 덕에 악마의 손아귀에서 풀려났지만, 잠시뿐이에요! Book of Binding(결속의 서)를 찾아야 해요. 이 동굴 어딘가에 숨겨져 있어요!.

english: There are many trials you must pass... but please, you're my only hope of escape!
translation: 통과해야 할 시련이 많을 거예요... 하지만 제발, 제가 벗어날 유일한 희망은 당신뿐이에요!

english: You open the Book of Binding in front of Ungadulu and a supernatural light emanates from the pages. Ungadulu's face twists and contorts in wild spasms.
translation: Ungadulu(웅가둘루) 앞에서 Book of Binding(결속의 서)를 펼치자 책장에서 초자연적인 빛이 뿜어져 나온다. 웅가둘루의 얼굴이 거친 경련으로 뒤틀리고 일그러진다.

english: Curse you... foul intruder... wretched Vacu! Thy meddling ways hath brought thee to thy doom!
translation: 저주받을 놈... 더러운 침입자... 비루한 Vacu(바쿠)! 네놈의 참견이 네놈을 파멸로 이끌었도다!

english: Ungadulu drops to the floor, unconscious. From his prone body rises the shape of an enormous, angry demon...
translation: Ungadulu(웅가둘루)가 의식을 잃고 바닥에 쓰러진다. 엎어진 그의 몸에서 거대하고 분노한 악마의 형상이 솟아오른다...

english: Nezikchened: Thy faith will help you little here.
translation: Nezikchened(네직체네드): 네 신앙은 여기서 별 도움이 되지 않으리라.

english: A sense of hopelessness fills your body...
At the next council meeting, I'm going to recommend that we change the guards' uniform to be red.
translation: 다음 의회 회의에서 경비병 제복을 빨간색으로 바꾸자고 건의할 생각이에요.

english: Why?
We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.
translation: 이제 지상인들이 우리 광산과 도시로 내려오잖아요. 그리고 그들은 눈이 그리 좋지 않다는 걸 기억해야 해요.

english: I worry that they can't see our guards very clearly in the dark. It is important for a guard to be seen.
translation: 어둠 속에서 그들이 우리 경비병을 잘 못 알아볼까 봐 걱정이에요. 경비병은 눈에 띄는 게 중요하잖아요.

english: You have a point. But I don't think red would be the best colour. It is the colour of blood, so it might give the wrong impression.
translation: 일리 있네요. 하지만 빨간색이 최선은 아닌 것 같아요. 피의 색이라 잘못된 인상을 줄 수도 있어요.

english: What colour do you suggest, then?
I suggest green. I have heard that the plants that grow on the surface are mostly green, so surface-dwellers might find that colour soothing.
translation: 초록색을 제안해요. 지상에서 자라는 식물은 대부분 초록색이라고 들었어요. 그러니 지상인들은 그 색을 보면 마음이 편해질지도 몰라요.

english: No, I disagree. Guards should not be soothing, they should be seen as formidable. Red will give the correct impression.
translation: 아뇨, 동의할 수 없어요. 경비병이 마음을 편하게 해 주면 안 되죠. 위압적으로 보여야 해요. 빨간색이어야 올바른 인상을 줄 거예요.

english: Oh, hello surface-dweller. We were just discussing some council business.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, 지상인. 마침 의회 일을 좀 논의하고 있었어요.

english: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
No, thank you. We don't let any one single goblin make decisions, and certainly not an outsider!
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 우린 고블린 한 명에게 결정을 맡기지 않아요. 외부인이라면 더더욱 안 되죠!

english: But we could do with an opinion. What colour do you think is best?
translation: 그래도 의견은 들어 보고 싶네요. 어떤 색이 제일 좋을 것 같아요?

english: Red.
Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.
translation: 고마워요, 지상인. 다음 회의에서 바로 그걸 건의할게요.

english: Green.
Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.
translation: 고마워요, 지상인. 다음 회의에서 바로 그걸 건의할게요.

english: I think the guards are fine as they are.
translation: 경비병들은 지금 그대로가 좋은 것 같아요.

english: Perhaps you're right. Not making any change would certainly be the easiest option!
translation: 그 말이 맞을지도 모르겠네요. 아무것도 안 바꾸는 게 확실히 제일 쉬운 방법이니까요!

english: I think I've been here before...
translation: 어째 전에도 겪어 본 일 같은데요...

english: Oh? How so?
This is a lot like a conversation I had with some goblins on the surface.
translation: 지상에서 고블린들이랑 나눴던 대화랑 아주 비슷하거든요.

english: Really? Which armour colour did they pick?
translation: 정말요? 그들은 어떤 갑옷 색을 골랐어요?

english: They ended up with the same armour colour that they started with!
translation: 결국 처음 그대로의 갑옷 색으로 끝났어요!

english: You know, I think that's probably what we'll end up doing.
translation: 있잖아요, 우리도 아마 결국 그렇게 될 것 같아요.

english: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
Red
Green
I think the guards are fine as they are
translation: 경비병들은 지금 그대로가 좋은 것 같아요

english: I think I've been here before...
translation: 어째 전에도 겪어 본 일 같은데요...

english: Oh dear...
What's the matter?
I'm worried. I think the Council is neglecting a big issue. I tried to bring it up at the last meeting, but they didn't pay attention.
translation: 걱정이에요. 의회가 큰 문제를 소홀히 하고 있는 것 같아요. 지난 회의 때 꺼내 보려 했는데 아무도 귀 기울이지 않았어요.

english: What issue?
I'm very happy for you humans to come down to the city, but what about...them?
translation: 당신네 인간들이 도시로 내려오는 건 정말 기뻐요. 하지만...그들은 어떡하죠?

english: What about who?
Them! *whispers* The G-O-D-S.
The gods?
Don't say it! What if they hear?
translation: 그 말 하지 마세요! 그들이 들으면 어떡해요?

english: Why are you scared of the gods?
Because they're so powerful, of course!
In the time of the great war, they forced all the goblin tribes to fight one another. Our ancestors weren't powerful enough to stand up to them.
translation: 대전쟁 시절, 그들은 모든 고블린 부족을 서로 싸우게 했어요. 우리 조상들은 그들에게 맞설 만큼 강하지 못했죠.

english: We've hidden down here for this long, but now the way to the surface is open, what if they find us again?
translation: 우린 이렇게 오랫동안 여기 숨어 지냈는데, 이제 지상으로 가는 길이 열렸잖아요. 그들이 우릴 다시 찾아내면 어떡하죠?

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye.
You don't need to worry!
I don't?
The God Wars are over! The gods don't intervene directly in the affairs of mortals any more.
translation: God Wars(신들의 전쟁)은 끝났어요! 신들은 이제 필멸자들의 일에 직접 개입하지 않아요.

english: Are you sure?
Yes!
I do hope you're right! I still can't help being worried, though.
translation: 당신 말이 맞으면 좋겠어요! 그래도 걱정되는 건 어쩔 수가 없네요.

english: Don't you want to worship the god of the goblins?
No! How could you even suggest that? We're not going to worship some supernatural being just because it's bigger and more powerful than us.
translation: 싫어요! 어떻게 그런 말을 할 수 있어요? 우리보다 크고 강하다는 이유만으로 초자연적인 존재를 섬기진 않을 거예요.

english: It may seem to you that we're cowardly, hiding here from the gods all this time, but I know that every Dorgeshuun would rather die than submit to the rule of any god.
translation: 이렇게 오랫동안 신들을 피해 숨어 지낸 우리가 비겁해 보일지도 모르지만, 모든 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌)은 어떤 신의 지배에 굴복하느니 차라리 죽음을 택할 거예요.

english: Why are you scared of the gods?
You don't need to worry!
Don't you want to worship the god of the goblins?
Goodbye
At the next council meeting, I'm going to recommend that we change the guards' uniform to be red.
translation: 다음 의회 회의에서 경비병 제복을 빨간색으로 바꾸자고 건의할 생각이에요.

english: Why?
We have surface-dwellers coming down into our mines and our city now, and remember that they don't have very good eyesight.
translation: 이제 지상인들이 우리 광산과 도시로 내려오잖아요. 그리고 그들은 눈이 그리 좋지 않다는 걸 기억해야 해요.

english: I worry that they can't see our guards very clearly in the dark. It is important for a guard to be seen.
translation: 어둠 속에서 그들이 우리 경비병을 잘 못 알아볼까 봐 걱정이에요. 경비병은 눈에 띄는 게 중요하잖아요.

english: You have a point. But I don't think red would be the best colour. It is the colour of blood, so it might give the wrong impression.
translation: 일리 있네요. 하지만 빨간색이 최선은 아닌 것 같아요. 피의 색이라 잘못된 인상을 줄 수도 있어요.

english: What colour do you suggest, then?
I suggest green. I have heard that the plants that grow on the surface are mostly green, so surface-dwellers might find that colour soothing.
translation: 초록색을 제안해요. 지상에서 자라는 식물은 대부분 초록색이라고 들었어요. 그러니 지상인들은 그 색을 보면 마음이 편해질지도 몰라요.

english: No, I disagree. Guards should not be soothing, they should be seen as formidable. Red will give the correct impression.
translation: 아뇨, 동의할 수 없어요. 경비병이 마음을 편하게 해 주면 안 되죠. 위압적으로 보여야 해요. 빨간색이어야 올바른 인상을 줄 거예요.

english: Oh, hello surface-dweller. We were just discussing some council business.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요, 지상인. 마침 의회 일을 좀 논의하고 있었어요.

english: Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you?
No, thank you. We don't let any one single goblin make decisions, and certainly not an outsider!
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 우린 고블린 한 명에게 결정을 맡기지 않아요. 외부인이라면 더더욱 안 되죠!

english: But we could do with an opinion. What colour do you think is best?

Thank you, surface-dweller. That's what I'll be recommending in the next meeting.

translation: 고마워요, 지상인. 다음 회의에서 바로 그걸 건의할게요.

translation: 어째 전에도 겪어 본 일 같은데요...

This is a lot like a conversation I had with some goblins on the surface.
translation: 지상에서 고블린들이랑 나눴던 대화랑 아주 비슷하거든요.

translation: 결국 처음 그대로의 갑옷 색으로 끝났어요!

translation: 있잖아요, 우리도 아마 결국 그렇게 될 것 같아요.
