english: I think I've been here before...
translation: 어째 전에도 겪어 본 일 같은데요...

english: Headman Ur-tag, I cannot stress enough how important it is that this train link be completed on time. The mining companies have taken out considerable loans...
translation: Ur-tag(우르-타그) 족장님, 이 열차 노선을 제때 완공하는 게 얼마나 중요한지는 아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않습니다. 광산 회사들이 상당한 대출을 받았단 말입니다...

english: I understand your concerns, Ambassador, but you must realise that the discoveries must change the whole schedule. To remove them too hurriedly would be a crime against knowledge.
translation: 대사님의 걱정은 이해합니다만, 이번 발견들 때문에 일정 전체가 바뀔 수밖에 없다는 걸 아셔야 합니다. 그것들을 서둘러 치워 버리는 건 지식에 대한 범죄일 겁니다.

english: What are you talking about?
It's the new underground train link being built between our city and the dwarven city of Keldagrim.
translation: 우리 도시와 드워프 도시 Keldagrim(켈다그림) 사이에 건설 중인 새 지하 열차 노선 이야기입니다.

english: It will be the pinnacle of dwarven engineering! A great leap forward from the old steam-powered minecarts! A monument to the power and ingenuity of the Consortium!
translation: 드워프 공학의 정점이 될 겁니다! 낡은 증기식 광차에서 크게 도약하는 거죠! Consortium(컨소시엄)의 힘과 독창성을 보여 주는 기념비란 말입니다!

english: And it would be finished by now, except that they found some old goblin bones they want to dig up.
translation: 진작 끝났을 텐데, 저 사람들이 오래된 고블린 뼈 몇 개를 찾아내서는 그걸 파내겠다지 뭡니까.

english: We've unearthed some very important artefacts that were buried during the Dorgeshuun Civil War. They could shed important light on our history.
translation: 우리는 Dorgeshuun(도르게슌) 내전 때 묻힌 아주 중요한 유물들을 발굴했습니다. 우리 역사의 중요한 부분을 밝혀 줄 수 있을 겁니다.

english: [player name], do you have any experience with archaeology?
I passed my archaeology exam at the Digsite!
Excellent! We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so if you could give us some help we would appreciate it.
translation: 훌륭합니다! 우리는 몇 세대 동안 큰 고고학 사업을 해 본 적이 없으니, 도와주신다면 정말 감사하겠습니다.

english: I'd love to help!
Splendid! The path to the train tunnel is in the south- west of the city.
translation: 좋습니다! 열차 터널로 가는 길은 도시 남서쪽에 있습니다.

english: Perhaps now we can get this finished quickly and get on with laying the tracks.
translation: 이제야 이걸 빨리 끝내고 선로를 깔 수 있겠군요.

english: Do your own digging!
Oh well. We will continue at our own pace.
translation: 할 수 없군요. 우리 속도대로 계속하겠습니다.

english: What can I do in the city?
translation: 이 도시에서는 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.
translation: 시장에 가 보시는 건 어떻습니까? 요즘 지상 음식이 꽤 유행이라고 하니, 거기서 뭔가 팔 수 있을지도 모릅니다.

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 도시 남쪽의 동굴에도 가 보시면 좋을 겁니다. 싸울 괴물이 많은 곳인데, Zanik(자닉)이 그놈들 머리 위로 건너가는 방법을 찾아냈다더군요!

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.
translation: 교역을 위해서, 그리고 종족 간의 우호를 다지기 위해서입니다! 분명 두 종족 모두에게 이로울 겁니다.

english: Greetings, surface-dweller. Welcome to Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 반갑습니다, 지상인이여. Dorgesh-Kaan(도르게시칸)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: What are you arguing about?
Yes.
No.
What can I do in the city?
translation: 이 도시에서는 뭘 할 수 있어요?

english: Why did you decide to open the city?
Hello there; are you interested in any of my fine daggers? Ideal for slipping under desert robes to give your enemies a nasty surprise...
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 좋은 단검들 좀 보시겠어요? 사막 로브 밑에 슬쩍 숨겼다가 적에게 고약한 기습을 선사하기에 딱이죠...

english: I'd rather help you in return for better prices.
translation: 차라리 일을 도와드릴 테니 대신 값을 좀 깎아 주세요.

english: I think it will take months for me to return to normal business. If you can wait that long, however, I may have tasks for you.
translation: 장사가 정상으로 돌아오려면 몇 달은 걸릴 것 같아요. 그래도 그만큼 기다릴 수 있다면 맡길 일이 있을지도 몰라요.

english: No thanks.
I'm looking for daggers, yes.
I'd rather help you in return for better prices.
translation: 차라리 일을 도와드릴 테니 대신 값을 좀 깎아 주세요.

english: No thanks.
A great captain is always ready to change course.
translation: 위대한 선장은 언제든 항로를 바꿀 준비가 되어 있죠.

english: Actions have consequences.
Can I have your teabag?
Can you stand me?
translation: 저 좀 견뎌 주실 수 있어요?

english: Have you found the key to the secret room?
I am the egg man, are you one of the egg men?
translation: 저는 에그맨이에요, 당신도 에그맨 중 하나인가요?

english: I believe that it is very rainy in Varrock.
translation: Varrock(바록)에는 비가 아주 많이 온다고 믿어요.

english: I have a story about that.
translation: 그거라면 제가 해 줄 얘기가 있죠.

english: I heard that the tall man fears only strong winds.
translation: 키 큰 남자는 오직 강풍만 두려워한다고 들었어요.

english: I quite fancy an onion.
In Canifis the men are known for eating much spam.
translation: Canifis(카니피스) 남자들은 스팸을 많이 먹기로 유명하대요.

english: In the end, only the three-legged will survive.
translation: 결국엔 다리가 셋 달린 자만 살아남을 거예요.

english: It is possible to commit no mistakes and still lose.
translation: 실수를 하나도 하지 않고도 질 수 있는 법이에요.

english: Loser says what.
My magic carpet is full of eels.
translation: 제 magic carpet(마법 양탄자)는 장어로 가득해요.

english: Once, I was a poor man, but then I found a party hat.
translation: 한때 저는 가난했는데, 그러다 파티 모자를 하나 주웠죠.

english: Quickly! I've got a bee sticking out of my arm!
translation: 빨리요! 제 팔에 벌이 박혀 있어요!

english: The slowest of fishermen catch the swiftest of fish.
translation: 가장 느린 어부가 가장 빠른 물고기를 잡는 법이죠.

english: *sneezes* What?
The sudden appearance of a deaf squirrel is most puzzling, comrade.
translation: 귀먹은 다람쥐가 갑자기 나타나다니 참으로 수수께끼로군요, 동지.

english: There were three goblins in a bar, which one left first?
translation: 고블린 셋이 술집에 있었는데, 누가 제일 먼저 나갔을까요?

english: Up in the north, I hear they keep milk in bags rather than buckets.
translation: 북쪽에서는 우유를 양동이가 아니라 봉지에 담아 둔다더군요.

english: Want to see me bend a spoon?
What's cheese?
Would you like to buy a pewter spoon?
What?
You have been given a [new clue/casket]!
I do not believe we have any business, Comrade.
translation: 우리 사이엔 볼일이 없는 것 같군요, 동지.

english: The puffins are up to something!
9 years my princess, forever my light.
translation: 9년 동안 나의 공주, 영원히 나의 빛.

english: Ahhhhhh, leeches!
The Ankou's are a lie.
(Breathing intensifies)
Brother, do you even lift?
Connection lost. Please wait - attempting to reestablish.
translation: 연결이 끊어졌습니다. 잠시 기다려 주십시오 - 재연결을 시도하는 중입니다.

english: Do you want ants? Because that's how you get ants.
translation: 개미 꼬이고 싶어요? 그러니까 개미가 꼬이는 거예요.

english: Don't forget to find the jade monkey.
translation: 비취 원숭이 찾는 거 잊지 마세요.

english: Fancy a holiday? I heard there was a whole other world to the west.
translation: 휴가 어때요? 서쪽에 완전히 다른 세계가 있다던데요.

english: Guys, let's lake dive!
I don't like pineapple, it has that bone in it.
translation: 파인애플은 싫어요, 그 안에 뼈가 있거든요.

english: I gave you what you needed; not what you think you needed.
translation: 저는 당신이 필요하다고 생각한 게 아니라, 정말로 필요한 걸 드렸어요.

english: I once named a duck after a girl. Big mistake, they all hated it.
translation: 한번은 오리 이름을 어떤 여자애 이름을 따서 지었어요. 큰 실수였죠, 다들 싫어하더라고요.

english: I told him not to go near that fence, and what did he do? Sheesh....
translation: 그 울타리 근처에 가지 말라고 했는데, 걔가 어떻게 했는지 알아요? 참 나....

english: I took a college course in bowling; still not any good.
translation: 대학에서 볼링 수업까지 들었는데, 여전히 못해요.

english: I'm going to get married, to the night.
I'm looking for a girl named Molly. I can't seem to find her. any assistance?
translation: Molly(몰리)라는 여자애를 찾고 있는데 도무지 못 찾겠어요. 도와주실래요?

english: Init doe. Lyk, I hope yer reward iz goodd aye?
translation: 그러게 말여. 그니깐, 보상이 조아야 될 텐데 그치?

english: Is that Deziree?
It is quite easy being green.
Mate, mate... I'm the best.
Mother's parsnips tasted like onion.
translation: 엄마가 해 준 파스닙은 양파 맛이 났어요.

english: Oranges are the fruit of the vegetable.
Some say...
There's this guy I sit next to. Makes weird faces and sounds. Kind of an odd fellow.
translation: 제 옆자리에 앉는 녀석이 있는데요. 이상한 표정을 짓고 이상한 소리를 내요. 좀 별난 친구예요.

english: This is the last night you'll spend alone.
translation: 오늘이 당신이 혼자 보내는 마지막 밤이에요.

english: Tonight we dine................quite nicely actually.
translation: 오늘 밤 우리는 만찬을 즐긴다................꽤 근사하게 말이죠.

english: Took a hair dryer to a party in my handbag. Ah, so fabulous!!
translation: 핸드백에 헤어드라이어를 넣고 파티에 갔죠. 아, 정말 끝내줘요!!

english: The curse has been removed. Word around the town is that you were the one who helped remove it.
translation: 저주가 풀렸어요. 마을에선 당신이 저주를 푸는 걸 도왔다는 소문이 돌더군요.

english: Yes that is correct. The spirits of the Elid cursed the town for throwing away a statue to Elidinis. I got it back
translation: 네, 맞아요. 마을 사람들이 Elidinis(엘리디니스)의 조각상을 내다 버려서 Elid(엘리드)의 정령들이 마을에 저주를 내렸거든요. 제가 그걸 되찾아 왔어요

english: Well we thank you. You're pretty much a local hero now.
translation: 정말 고마워요. 이제 당신은 거의 이 동네 영웅이에요.

english: All this mining is tiring work.
But you're not even mining at the moment.
translation: 근데 지금은 채광도 안 하고 계시잖아요.

english: Hey! I've been mining all day thank you very much! I'm allowed a break ain't I?
translation: 이봐! 난 하루 종일 캤다고, 알겠어? 좀 쉴 수도 있는 거 아냐?

english: Yes, I suppose.
I should think so. Anyway did you need anything?
translation: 그래야지. 아무튼 뭐 필요한 거라도 있어?

english: What are these rocks?
Rocks? They're not rocks, they're minerals!
Oh okay. What are they though?
Amethyst! We use it a lot back in Keldagrim but this is the only place we've managed to find it.
translation: Amethyst(자수정)이야! Keldagrim(켈다그림)에선 많이 쓰는데, 우리가 찾아낸 곳은 여기뿐이지.

english: What can I use it for?
We've found it's quite good for ranging ammunition, something you adventuring lot might like.
translation: 원거리 탄약으로 꽤 쓸 만하더라고. 너희 모험가 무리가 좋아할 만한 거지.

english: We use it a lot for Construction back in Keldagrim as well.
Awesome! Does that mean I can use it in my house?
translation: 멋져요! 그럼 제 집에서도 쓸 수 있다는 거예요?

english: No.
Why not?
Because I said so that's why! Even the best human builders wouldn't know how to build with this stuff.
translation: 내가 안 된다고 했으니까 안 되는 거야! 인간 중에 제일가는 건축가라도 이걸로 짓는 법은 모를걸.

english: And you're a long way off the best, believe me.
translation: 그리고 넌 제일가는 축에는 한참 못 미쳐, 내 말 믿어.

english: Awww.
No thanks.
Well be on your way then. I've got mining to do!
translation: 그럼 갈 길 가. 난 채광해야 하거든!

english: What are these rocks?
No thanks.
Hello, who are you?
Greetings human. I am Uurrak quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 반갑습니다, 인간이여. 나는 Uurrak quo Narga(우라크 쿠오 나르가), Kahlith(칼리스)의 수호자입니다. 균형을 섬기러 오셨습니까?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)과 이야기하십시오. 당신을 인도해 줄 것입니다.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 안타깝군요. 당신은 죽음을 가져오는 자이니, 균형에 큰 쓸모가 있을 텐데요.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기하십시오. 길을 알려 줄 것입니다.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Good day, Uwogo.
Get away from me, you foul commoner!
translation: 저리 꺼져라, 이 더러운 천민 놈아!

english: Hello. Shouldn't you be on guard duty?
translation: 안녕하세요. 경계 근무 서셔야 하는 거 아니에요?

english: In this state? I've had too many beer s'already, beside' s'I'm off duty.
translation: 이 꼴로? 맥주를 버얼써 너무 마셨다구, 게다가 난 비버언이야.

english: The commander 's'given me the day off.
Hi.
You know, there are so many different ways to greet people. Hello, 'ello, hello there...
translation: 있잖아요, 사람한테 인사하는 방법은 정말 많아요. 안녕, 안뇽, 안녕하세요...

english: That still only counts as one!
translation: 그래도 그건 다 하나로 치는 거잖아요!

english: Hello. How are you today?
I'm great, thank you!
Hello! What a day it is in the crystal city, huh?
translation: 안녕하세요! 크리스탈 도시의 오늘 하루, 정말 멋지죠?

english: Indeed.
What can I do for ya?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: All kinds of things! The towers are a wonderful sight to see.
translation: 온갖 게 다 있죠! 탑들은 정말 볼 만한 구경거리예요.

english: On a day like today, I'd recommend visiting the market.
translation: 오늘 같은 날엔 시장에 가 보시길 추천해요.

english: Nothing.
What do you think you're doing?
What is there to do around here?
translation: 이 근처에서 할 만한 게 뭐가 있어요?

english: Nothing.
Hello there. Want to have a look at what we're selling today?
translation: 안녕하세요. 오늘 저희가 파는 물건 한번 보실래요?

english: No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there. What are you doing here?
I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스), 그러니까 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 저를 안내해 줄 사람을 기다리고 있어요.

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.
translation: 아, Paterdomus(파테르도무스)는 Salve(살브) 강가에 있는 꽤 웅장한 사원이에요... Morytania(모리타니아)로 들어오는 길에 분명 지나치셨을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
translation: 문명 세계로 돌아가서 Misthalin(미스탈린) 땅이 어떻게 생겼는지 보고 싶어서요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있겠어요?

english: I can defend myself somewhat if we run into trouble...yes, but let's hope that we don't, eh!
translation: 문제가 생기면 어느 정도는 지킬 수 있어요... 네, 그래도 그런 일은 없길 바라야죠, 안 그래요?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 따라다니는 동물이 있네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 그 친구를 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 오, 정말요? 그럼 정말 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 작은 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Temple Trekking begins
Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 저한테 보급품을 주시려고요? 제 배낭 좀 열어 볼게요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 머무는 것보단 낫죠.

english: It's scary here...let's get going!
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
translation: 하루 종일 서서 수다 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요.

english: Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Paterdomus(파테르도무스)에 자주 가세요? 길을 잘 아시는 것 같네요.

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?
Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야 할 것 같아요. 저 다리는 못 건너요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 이거 망했네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와! 끝내줬어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 괴물 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.
translation: 사원까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보상이에요.

english: Valantay Eppel gives you a reward token!
translation: Valantay Eppel(발란테이 에펠)이 당신에게 reward token(보상 토큰)을 줍니다!

english: Where is Paterdomus?
Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?
Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있겠어요...?

english: I can take you to Paterdomus.
Ok, thanks.
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우우? 우우우우 우우 우우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우우우우우우 우우우 우우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우우! 우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데, 진짜로요: 저 엄~청 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 순 없다고들 하는 건 아는데, 가끔은 그냥 은행 계좌를 열어서 제가 가진 걸 전부 보면서 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋거든요:

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 자, 우리 살아 있는 부자들은 당신 같은 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 시간 낭비하고 싶지 않거든요. 전 너~무 부자라서 이제 가 봐야 해요. 어쩌면 더 부자가 될지도 모르고요.

english: See ya around ghosty!
Yeah, I heard about that, ha-ha-ha!
With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 그 말은 늘 맞는 것 같네요. 잘 있어요, 이상하고 투명한 죽은 양반!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘진 않은데 전 익힌 닭고기가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도 모르지만, 집에서 구운 파이를 이길 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 그래요? 전혀 몰랐네요. 음, 전 가 봐야 해요, 또 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너에게는 살아남을 기회가 없다 너의 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
translation: 너희의 모든 기지는 우리의 것이 되었다이다.

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 저한테 그런 식으로 말해도 된다고 생각하지 마세요!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 제가 당신을 해칠 방법을 못 찾을 거라 생각하지 마요, 유령 양반!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아니요, 전 평생 거기 가 본 적도 없고, 갔을 때 뭘 훔친 적은 더더욱 없어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 지금 저보고 거짓말쟁이라는 거예요?!?! 전 평생 뭘 훔친 적이 없어요. 제가 남이 힘들게 번

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 돈을 주머니에서 훔쳐 갈 만큼 도덕적으로 타락한 사람이라는 듯한 말씀에 정말 화가 나네요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 아니면 케이크라든가. 모피라든가. 몇 번이고. 아주 오랫동안.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나오신다면 이 일에 대해선 더 할 말이 없네요. 그럼 안녕히 계세요!

english: Hello.
H-hello!
So what's up?
I cannot believe it! You can see me? You understand my words?
translation: 믿을 수가 없구려! 내가 보이오? 내 말을 알아듣는단 말이오?

english: Sure can. So why are you hanging around here?
translation: 물론이죠. 그런데 왜 여기서 어슬렁거리고 계세요?

english: My tale is one of woe... No doubt you will have little interest in hearing it...
translation: 내 이야기는 비통한 사연이라오... 그대는 아마 별 관심이 없겠지...

english: Though it has been so many moons since last I had company in this endless non-life...
translation: 그래도 이 끝없는 죽음 아닌 삶 속에서 마지막으로 말동무를 만난 지가 참으로 오래되었으니...

english: Well, actually I would like to know what happened to you to turn you into an invisible ghost.
translation: 음, 사실 무슨 일이 있었길래 투명한 유령이 됐는지 알고 싶긴 해요.

english: If only so I can make sure it doesn't happen to me...
translation: 저한테도 그런 일이 안 생기게 하려고라도요...

english: My name is Valdez. I served my Lord Saradomin faithfully for many years, as an explorer of this strange land we had been brought to.
translation: 내 이름은 Valdez(발데스)라오. 나는 수년 동안 나의 주 Saradomin(사라도민)을 충실히 섬겼소. 우리가 이끌려 온 이 낯선 땅의 탐험가로서 말이오.

english: I remember the day this curse fell upon me clearly... I had just discovered a huge temple, hidden below the ground, of one of Saradomin's compatriots.
translation: 이 저주가 내게 내린 날을 똑똑히 기억하오... 나는 막 지하에 숨겨진 거대한 신전을 발견한 참이었소. Saradomin(사라도민) 님과 뜻을 함께한 신 중 한 분의 신전이었지.

english: I am unsure who had built it, or why they had left it seemingly abandoned, but inside I located a great treasure...
translation: 누가 지었는지, 왜 버려진 듯 방치되었는지는 모르겠으나, 그 안에서 나는 위대한 보물을 찾아냈소...

english: It was the godstaff of Armadyl. Oh, how I rue my choice that day!
translation: 그것은 Armadyl(아마딜)의 신성한 지팡이였소. 아, 그날의 선택이 얼마나 후회스러운지!

english: Choice?
Aye, stranger. I chose that day to take it so that my Lord Saradomin's power and prestige could be increased by its possession.
translation: 그렇소, 이방인이여. 그날 나는 나의 주 Saradomin(사라도민)의 힘과 위신을 높이고자 그것을 가져가기로 했소.

english: A god-weapon! Do you have any comprehension of the difficulty and rarity in obtaining such a thing?
translation: 신의 무기라오! 그런 것을 손에 넣기가 얼마나 어렵고 드문 일인지 짐작이나 하겠소?

english: To find such an artefact of power just lying around, it is almost incomprehensible...
translation: 그런 힘을 지닌 유물이 그냥 놓여 있다니, 거의 믿을 수 없는 일이었소...

english: So it was there in that deserted temple that I made my choice. I took the staff, and left that temple for Entrana immediately.
translation: 그리하여 그 버려진 신전에서 나는 선택을 했소. 지팡이를 챙겨 곧장 신전을 떠나 Entrana(엔트라나)로 향했지.

english: This was the cause of my cursed state.
What, you mean you gave it to Saradomin and in return he cursed you???
translation: 뭐라고요, 그걸 Saradomin(사라도민)한테 바쳤더니 그 대가로 저주를 내렸다는 거예요???

english: Seems kind of ungrateful if you ask me...
No stranger, you misunderstand completely... Firstly my gracious Lord would never treat anyone in such a manner; If he felt it was beyond my bounds as a mere mortal
translation: 아니오, 이방인이여, 완전히 오해하고 있소... 첫째로 자비로우신 나의 주께서는 결코 누구도 그런 식으로 대하지 않으시오. 한낱 필멸자인 내가

english: to hold such an artefact, he would simply have commanded me to return it to whence I had claimed it, and I being eternally loyal would have obeyed without question...
translation: 그런 유물을 지니는 것이 분수에 넘친다고 여기셨다면, 그저 원래 있던 곳에 돌려놓으라 명하셨을 것이고, 영원히 충성하는 나는 아무 의심 없이 따랐을 것이오...

english: And secondly?
And secondly, I never managed to pass the artefact on to my Lord...
translation: 그리고 둘째로, 나는 끝내 그 유물을 나의 주께 바치지 못했소...

english: The vile thief Rennard accosted me as I made my way to Entrana, and after defeating me with a sneak attack, plundered the staff from my person, and left me for dead...
translation: 비열한 도둑 Rennard(레나드)가 Entrana(엔트라나)로 가던 나를 덮쳤소. 기습으로 나를 쓰러뜨리고는 지팡이를 빼앗고, 나를 죽게 내버려 두었지...

english: I do not know what became of the staff, but I can feel in my very bones that whatever its final fate was, it is somehow related to this curse upon me...
translation: 그 지팡이가 어떻게 되었는지는 모르오. 하지만 그 최후가 어떠했든 내게 내린 이 저주와 어떻게든 관련이 있다는 걸 뼛속 깊이 느낄 수 있소...

english: Wow. Tough break.
I am sorry to bore you with my tale stranger, please allow me to compound my rudeness by asking you for one favour, small to perform?
translation: 지루한 이야기를 늘어놓아 미안하오, 이방인이여. 무례를 더해 작은 부탁 하나를 해도 되겠소?

english: Eh, I won't make any promises, but if it's nothing too annoying I guess I can help you out.
translation: 음, 약속은 못 하지만, 너무 귀찮은 일만 아니면 도와드릴 수 있을 것 같네요.

english: Many thanks stranger, this existence tortures me...
translation: 정말 고맙소, 이방인이여. 이런 존재로 살아가는 것이 고통스럽소...

english: I need you to find Rennard and if he has the staff yet reclaim it, or find out what hideous deed he performed to curse me so!
translation: Rennard(레나드)를 찾아서 그가 아직 지팡이를 가지고 있다면 되찾아 주시오. 아니면 그가 어떤 끔찍한 짓을 저질러 나를 이렇게 저주받게 했는지 알아내 주시오!

english: I have nothing I may offer you save this piece of clothing, please take it as payment...
translation: 내가 드릴 수 있는 건 이 옷 한 벌뿐이오. 부디 보수로 받아 주시오...

english: Where can I find this Rennard then?
translation: 그럼 그 Rennard(레나드)는 어디서 찾을 수 있어요?

english: Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of that vile thief, he had joined a group of bandits in an evil land to the North-east of here, where they had made their home living outside of
translation: 아, 악명 높은 Rennard(레나드)... 그 비열한 도둑에 대해 마지막으로 들은 바로는, 여기서 북동쪽의 사악한 땅에서 도적 무리에 합류했다 하오. 그들은 그곳에 터를 잡고

english: the reach of the authorities that pursued them...
translation: 자신들을 쫓는 관헌의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에서 살고 있다더군...

english: Okay, well I'll try and find him for you then.
Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of him, he had sought passage on a ship crewed by none but the most dastardly lowly pirates...
translation: 아, 악명 높은 Rennard(레나드)... 마지막으로 들은 바로는, 더없이 비열하고 천한 해적들만 타는 배에 몸을 실었다 하오...

english: I also heard that this ship had been caught in a violent storm, and stranded upon rocks, where the pirates then made their home...
translation: 또 그 배가 거센 폭풍을 만나 바위에 좌초했고, 해적들은 그곳에 터를 잡았다고 들었소...

english: Ah, the infamous Rennard... The last I had heard of that vile thief, he had joined a group of bandits in a barren land to the South-east of here, where they prey upon the unsuspecting visitors to
translation: 아, 악명 높은 Rennard(레나드)... 그 비열한 도둑에 대해 마지막으로 들은 바로는, 여기서 남동쪽의 황량한 땅에서 도적 무리에 합류했다 하오. 그들은 아무것도 모른 채

english: the desert awaiting the return of their dark master...
translation: 사막을 찾은 이들을 노리며 어둠의 주인이 돌아오기를 기다리고 있다더군...

english: Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데 딱히 관심은 없네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Thank you for hearing my tale... It has been so lonely here...
translation: 내 이야기를 들어 줘서 고맙소... 이곳은 너무나 외로웠소...

english: Can you remind me where to find the thief Rennard who caused this curse to befall you again?
translation: 이 저주를 내리게 한 도둑 Rennard(레나드)를 어디서 찾을 수 있는지 다시 알려 주실래요?

english: Of course...
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 저번에 주신 유령 로브 좀 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... how many robe tops do you want?
translation: 나를 이곳에 묶어 둔 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양이오... 로브 상의를 몇 벌 원하시오?

english: Here you go.
Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Chat about the curse.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어, 영웅님이다! 와! 정말 대단하세요, 대체 어떻게 그 주비네이트 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 너무 예뻐졌고, 정말 잘해 주셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Well met! My name's Valeria, I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: 반가워요! 제 이름은 Valeria(발레리아)예요. 이것저것 조금씩 하죠. 그냥 살아남으려고 애쓰는 거예요, 그것 말고는 할 수 있는 게 별로 없거든요.

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 아직 뱀파이어들을 피해 숨어 지내면서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 사원까지 갈 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 알기로는 없어요. 이제 기본적인 편의 시설이 생겨서 정말 유용하고, 다들 당신께 엄청 감사하고 있어요. 전 영웅을 실제로 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기에 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 전 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Hello.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!
translation: 뭐가 문제냐, 밥주머니? 구멍 송송 뚫리기 전에 썩 꺼지는 게 좋을걸!

english: Leave me alone. I'm busy.
You're not meant to be here human! Time to die!
translation: 넌 여기 있으면 안 돼, 인간! 죽을 시간이다!

english: What are you doing?
Minding my own business. You should do the same.
translation: 내 일 신경 쓰는 중이다. 너도 네 일이나 신경 써.

english: Yes?
Did you want something?
Nope.
Then why don't you get lost?
What do you want?
Nothing.
Go away then.
Hey there.
I'm not interested in making small talk.
Suit yourself.
Graahhhhhhh!
Rarrrghhhh!
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 뱀파이어가 되지 않게 구해 줘서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 증명서를 받아 주세요. 미안하지만 보상으로 드릴 수 있는 게 이것뿐이에요.

english: Ha, ha, ha, time to disappear and rejuvenate!
translation: 하, 하, 하, 사라져서 기운을 되찾을 시간이다!

english: What's through here?
Ver Sinhaza, home to the Theatre of Blood.
translation: Ver Sinhaza(베르 신하자), Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)이 있는 곳이다.

english: Can I go in?
Yes. Now leave me alone.
Can I go through here?
Yes. Now get lost.
What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!
translation: 뭐가 문제냐, 밥주머니? 구멍 송송 뚫리기 전에 썩 꺼지는 게 좋을걸!

english: Leave me alone. I'm busy.
Hey! How do I get out of here?
When you've filled the mine cart, we'll think about it.
But I've filled the mine cart.
Okay, I guess you can go then, food sack!
The player is teleported to the mine entrance, in the northwestern part of Meiyerditch
translation: 플레이어가 Meiyerditch(메이어디치) 북서쪽에 있는 광산 입구로 순간이동된다

english: I can show you the way out. Follow me.
The player is lead out to the mine entrance, in the northwestern part of Meiyerditch
translation: 플레이어가 Meiyerditch(메이어디치) 북서쪽에 있는 광산 입구로 안내된다

english: Hello. How can I help you?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes - ask a gardener.
I'm okay, thank you.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
translation: Farming(농사) 조언 좀 해 주실 수 있어요?

english: Hello. What's happening in town at the moment?
translation: 안녕하세요. 요즘 마을엔 무슨 일이 있어요?

english: These dwarves have arrived from Keldagrim - the Chancellor has asked me to look after them, but they are eating all of our food and drinking all of our booze.
translation: Keldagrim(켈다그림)에서 드워프들이 왔어요. 재상님이 그들을 돌봐 달라고 하셨는데, 우리 음식은 다 먹어 치우고 술도 다 마셔 버리고 있지 뭐예요.

english: What are the dwarves doing here?
They are organising some sort of trade agreement. I don't know what they are trading.
translation: 무슨 교역 협정을 맺는 중이래요. 뭘 거래하는지는 모르겠어요.

english: Thanks.
Hello, Vanligga!
Oh, hello [Fremennik name]. Always good to see a friend.
translation: 아, 안녕하세요 [Fremennik name] 님. 친구는 언제 봐도 반갑네요.

english: Hmmm, I suppose I can trust you, since you have done me a favour in the past. Can you keep a secret?
translation: 흐음, 예전에 제 부탁을 들어주셨으니 믿어도 될 것 같네요. 비밀 지킬 수 있어요?

english: Of course.
Well as you probably already know, all yak meat and yak products are banned on this island - orders of the King...
translation: 이미 아시겠지만, 이 섬에선 야크 고기와 야크 제품이 모두 금지돼 있어요 - 왕의 명령이죠...

english: That King has some very strange attitudes.
Well, I have a contact on the other island. Are you interested in obtaining some produce?
translation: 음, 제가 다른 섬에 연줄이 있거든요. 물건 좀 구해 보실래요?

english: No, thanks.
Well, any time you need black market yak produce, you know where to come.
translation: 뭐, 암시장 야크 물건이 필요하면 언제든 어디로 오면 되는지 아시죠.

english: Wanna buy some yak?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Need some farming supplies?
What is this place?
It's a farming supply stall. Hosidius is farming country, so it's a big business. Do you need anything now?
translation: 농사 용품 노점이에요. Hosidius(호시디우스)는 농업 지역이라 큰 사업이죠. 지금 필요한 거 있으세요?

english: What have you got?
No, I'm fine.
What is this place?
What have you got?
No, I'm fine.
'Ello, and what are you after then?
I need another assignment.
Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].
translation: 좋수, 아주 잘하고 있구먼. 새 임무는 [task monster]을(를) [amount]마리 처치하는 거요.

english: Got any tips for me?
Great, thanks!
Okay, great!
Good luck! Don't forget to come back when you need a new assignment.
translation: 행운을 비우! 새 임무가 필요하면 잊지 말고 다시 오시우.

english: You're still hunting [task monster]; you have [amount] to go. Come back when you've finished your task.
translation: 아직 [task monster] 사냥 중이구먼. [amount]마리 남았수. 임무를 끝내면 다시 오시우.

english: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.
translation: 그 임무는 당신한테 안 맞는 것 같구먼. 취소해 줄까? 임무 연속 기록은 지워지지 않수.

english: Yes, please cancel it.
Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.
translation: 좋수, 임무는 취소된 걸로 하겠수. 이제 원할 때 새 임무를 받을 수 있수.

english: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있나요?

english: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.
translation: 얻을 수 있는 보상이 꽤 많고, 파는 Slayer(슬레이어) 장비도 여러 가지 있수.

english: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 지금은 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 당신의 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 수 있수.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: That's the spirit.
In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: 알겠수. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려할 테니, 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거요.

english: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.
translation: Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 임무를 고를 때 당신의 전투 레벨을 고려하고 있으니, 너무 어려운 건 안 걸릴 거요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요. 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.
Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요. 전 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.
translation: 알겠수. 이제부터 모든 Slayer Masters(슬레이어 마스터들)이 전투 레벨과 상관없이 목록에 있는 어떤 임무든 배정할 거요.

english: Er... Nothing...
'Ello, can I help you?
Hello?
'Ello, who's that?
I'm [player name]. I'm using my magic to communicate with you.
translation: 저는 [player name](이)라고 해요. 마법으로 당신과 얘기하고 있어요.

english: Bizarre, go on, what do you want then?
Hi! My name's [player name].
Do I look like I care? To me you're just another newcomer who thinks they're ready to fight.
translation: 내가 신경 쓰는 것처럼 보이나? 나한테 넌 그냥 싸울 준비가 됐다고 착각하는 또 한 명의 신참일 뿐이다.

english: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat. Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 나는 Vannaka(바나카), 현존하는 최고의 검사다. 너에게 전투의 기본을 가르치러 왔지. 먼저 무기 드는 법부터 가르쳐 주마.

english: Let's get started by teaching you to wield a weapon.
translation: 먼저 무기 드는 법부터 가르쳐 주마.

english: Very good, but that little butter knife isn't going to protect you much. Let's get you something a bit better. Once you're properly equipped we can move on to some actual combat.
translation: 좋아. 하지만 그 조그만 버터나이프로는 널 별로 지켜 주지 못할 거다. 좀 더 나은 걸 챙겨 주지. 제대로 갖추고 나면 진짜 전투로 넘어가자.

english: Let's get you equipped.
You should check out the combat interface.
Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats.
translation: 이제 진짜 전투다! 우리 안으로 들어가서 저 rats(쥐) 중 한 마리를 처치해라.

english: I did it! I killed a giant rat!
I saw. You seem better at this than I thought. Now that you have grasped basic swordplay, let's move on.
translation: 봤다. 생각보다 꽤 하는군. 기본 검술을 익혔으니 다음으로 넘어가자.

english: Next up we have ranged attacking. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
translation: 다음은 원거리 공격이다. 이걸로 멀리서 적을 처치할 수 있지. 원거리 공격이면 우리 안에 들어가지 않고도 쥐를 공격할 수 있으니, 놈들은 반격하지 못한다.

english: Use your bow and arrows to kill one of those rats from outside the pen.
translation: bow(활)과 arrows(화살)로 우리 밖에서 쥐 한 마리를 처치해라.

english: Do you need something?
Tell me about combat stats again.
translation: 전투 능력치에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
translation: 좋다. 주요 전투 능력치는 세 가지다. Strength(힘), Defence(방어), Attack(공격).

english: Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.
translation: Strength(힘)은 한 방에 줄 수 있는 최대 피해를, Defence(방어)는 막아 낼 수 있는 피해량을, Attack(공격)은 공격의 명중률을 정한다.

english: Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.
translation: Prayer(기도), Hitpoints(체력), Magic(마법), Ranged(원거리) 같은 다른 능력치도 전투에 쓰인다. 이 능력치들은 모두 전투 레벨을 정하는 데 들어가고, 전투 레벨은 전투 화면 위쪽에 표시된다.

english: You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.
translation: 본토에 가면 어떤 아이템은 능력치에도 영향을 준다는 걸 알게 될 거다. 마시면 Strength(힘)을 올리는 것처럼 능력치를 잠시 바꿔 주는 potions(물약)도 있지.

english: You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
translation: 여러 무기와 갑옷을 쓰면 Defence(방어)와 Attack(공격) 수치도 올라간다.

english: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
translation: 상대와 싸우기 전에는 마우스를 올려서 전투 레벨이 얼마인지 보는 게 현명하다.

english: Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.
translation: 초록색 글씨면 보통 쉬운 싸움이고, 빨간색이면 아마 질 거다. 노란색은 너와 비슷한 레벨, 주황색은 조금 더 센 상대라는 뜻이다.

english: Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
translation: 일이 잘 풀릴 때도 있고 아닐 때도 있다. 반드시 이기는 싸움 같은 건 없지만, 유리한 쪽에 서 있으면 이겨서 걸어 나갈 가능성이 가장 높다.

english: Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?
translation: 자, 다시 듣고 싶은 게 또 있나?

english: Tell me about melee combat again.
translation: 근접 전투에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.
translation: 아, 내 특기지. 근접 전투, 다른 말로 밀리 전투는 상대와 가까이 붙어서 하는 모든 싸움을 말한다.

english: Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.
translation: 근접 전투는 전적으로 세 가지 기본 전투 능력치에 달려 있다. Attack(공격), Defence(방어), Strength(힘).

english: Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.
translation: 물론 갑옷과 무기의 질에도 달려 있지. 좋은 갑옷과 무기를 갖춘 고레벨 전사는 가까이서 치명적이다.

english: If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.
translation: 이 길을 가고 싶다면, 성공은 적에게 최대한 빨리, 최대한 가까이 붙는 데 달려 있다는 걸 기억해라.

english: Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.
translation: 개인적으로 나는 근접 전투라는 고귀한 기술만이 쓸 가치가 있는 유일한 전투 방식이라고 생각한다.

english: Now, did you want to hear anything else?
translation: 자, 더 듣고 싶은 거 있나?

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: 원거리 전투에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
translation: 궁수가 될 생각이냐? 뭐, 좋다. 난 별로 안 좋아하지만, 매력이 뭔지는 안다.

english: Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.
translation: 원거리 공격은 지금 가진 shortbow(짧은 활)만이 아니라 여러 무기를 쓰는 스킬이다. 창, 투척용 칼, 석궁 모두 적과 거리를 둘 때 가장 잘 쓰인다.

english: Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.
translation: 저 쥐들은 쉬운 먹잇감이었지만, 본토에서는 적이 반격하지 못하는 곳에서 쏠 수 있는 자리를 찾으면 정말 운이 좋은 거다.

english: At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.
translation: 가까운 거리에서는 궁수가 전투에서 고전하는 경우가 많다. 궁수로서 최선의 전술은 치고 빠지면서 적을 멀리 두는 거다.

english: Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.
translation: 궁수로서의 실력은 거의 전적으로 Ranged(원거리) 능력치에 달려 있다. 모든 스킬이 그렇듯 많이 훈련할수록 강해진다.

english: Anything else you wanted to know?
Tell me about the Wilderness again.
Ah yes, the Wilderness. It is a place of evil, mark my words. Many is the colleague I have lost in that foul place.
translation: 아, 그래, Wilderness(황야). 내 말 잘 들어라, 그곳은 악의 땅이다. 그 더러운 곳에서 잃은 동료가 한둘이 아니지.

english: It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!
translation: 모험과 부가 있는 곳이기도 하니, 버틸 만큼 용감하고 강하다면 한몫 단단히 챙길 거다. 말 그대로 '죽여서' 말이지!

english: It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.
translation: 또한 Gielinor(길리노르) 땅에서 플레이어끼리 마음대로 서로 공격할 수 있는 유일한 곳이라, Player Killers(플레이어 킬러), 이른바 PKers(PK러)가 많이 출몰한다.

english: There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.
translation: Wilderness(황야)는 Gielinor(길리노르)의 다른 땅과 몇 가지가 다르다. 첫째, 방금 말했듯이 다른 플레이어에게 공격받을 수 있고, 실제로 공격받을 거다.

english: For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.
translation: 그래서 황야에 다가가면 경고가 뜬다. 실수로 들어가고 싶은 곳은 아니니까.

english: Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
translation: 둘째, 황야에는 '레벨'이 여러 단계 있다. 깊이 들어갈수록 공격할 수 있는 상대의 범위가 넓어진다.

english: In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.
translation: 레벨 1 황야에서는 전투 레벨이 1 이내로 차이 나는 플레이어만 공격할 수 있고, 그들에게만 공격받는다.

english: In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.
translation: 레벨 50에서는 50레벨 이내의 어떤 플레이어든 너를 공격할 수 있고, 너도 그들을 공격할 수 있다. 지금 황야의 몇 레벨에 있는지 늘 확인해라.

english: Your current Wilderness level is shown at the bottom right of the screen. The final thing you should know about the Wilderness is being 'skulled'.
translation: 지금 황야 레벨은 화면 오른쪽 아래에 표시된다. 황야에 대해 마지막으로 알아야 할 건 '해골'이 붙는 거다.

english: If you attack another player without them having attacked first, you will gain a skull above your character's head.
translation: 상대가 먼저 공격하지 않았는데 네가 다른 플레이어를 공격하면, 캐릭터 머리 위에 해골이 생긴다.

english: What this means is that if you die while skulled, you will lose EVERYTHING that your character was carrying.
translation: 해골이 붙은 상태로 죽으면 캐릭터가 가지고 있던 걸 전부 잃는다는 뜻이다.

english: When skulled, you should try to avoid dying for the twenty minutes or so it will take for the skull to wear off.
translation: 해골이 붙었다면, 해골이 사라지는 20분쯤 동안은 죽지 않도록 조심해라.

english: If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.
translation: Wilderness(황야)를 찾고 싶다면 본토의 시작 지점에서 북쪽으로 가라. 꽤 넓어서 놓치기 어렵다.

english: If you don't wish to end up there, take notice of the warning you will receive when getting near to it.
translation: 거기 가고 싶지 않다면, 근처에 갔을 때 뜨는 경고를 잘 봐라.

english: Now, was there anything more?
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Okay then.
Here, have this.
Here, have this!
I need another assignment.
Got any tips for me?
Okay, great!
Yes, please cancel it.
No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?
translation: 저한테 줄 보상이나 거래할 물건 있나요?

english: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.
translation: 제 임무 난이도에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.

english: That's fine - I can handle any task.
translation: 괜찮아요. 어떤 임무든 감당할 수 있어요.

english: In future, please don't give anything too tough.
translation: 앞으로는 너무 어려운 건 주지 말아 주세요.

english: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.
translation: 괜찮아요. 너무 어려운 건 원하지 않아요.

english: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!
translation: 이제 전투 레벨 확인은 그만해 주세요. 전 뭐든 감당할 수 있어요!

english: Er... Nothing...
Err... Nothing...
Tell me about combat stats.
Tell me about melee combat again.
translation: 근접 전투에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about ranged combat again.
translation: 원거리 전투에 대해 다시 알려 주세요.

english: Tell me about the Wilderness.
Nope, I'm ready to move on!
Now you look like a vyre in need of some new threads.
translation: 이런, 새 옷이 좀 필요해 보이는 vyre(바이어)로군요.

english: Let's trade.
Do I?
Oh yes. And luckily for you, I have everything you could ever need. Clothes, or the materials to make them if that's more your thing. All pre-scented as well.
translation: 아, 그럼요. 운 좋게도 저한테는 필요한 건 다 있답니다. 옷도 있고, 직접 만드는 게 취향이라면 재료도 있죠. 전부 향까지 미리 입혀 뒀어요.

english: Pre-scented?
Oh don't go acting like you don't know what I mean. You've done a decent job, but behind that scent, I can tell you're just a lowly vyre.
translation: 에이, 무슨 말인지 모르는 척하지 마세요. 꽤 잘 꾸미긴 했지만, 그 향 뒤에 숨은 당신이 그저 천한 vyre(바이어)라는 게 다 느껴지거든요.

english: Fear not, I am no judge. I know that there are many like you who want a taste of upper class life. That's why all my outfits are scented. Helps you fit right in.
translation: 걱정 마세요, 전 따지지 않아요. 상류층 생활을 맛보고 싶어 하는 당신 같은 이들이 많다는 걸 아니까요. 그래서 제 옷엔 전부 향을 입혀 두죠. 감쪽같이 섞여 들 수 있게요.

english: Does it not bother you having lower class vampyres up here?
translation: 하층민 vampyres(뱀파이어)가 여기 올라오는 게 거슬리지 않으세요?

english: Me? No. As long as you've got money, I don't care who you are.
translation: 저요? 전혀요. 돈만 있다면 누구든 상관없어요.

english: Fair enough.
So, want to take a look?
I'm fine, thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음이 바뀌면 찾아오세요. 전 여기 있을게요.

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Let's trade.
Do I?
I'm fine, thanks.
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어, Hero(영웅)님이다! 와! 정말 대단하세요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요. 정말 훌륭하게 해내셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
Oh, hello, Vasile is the name and I help to keep the village clear of rat infestations. Clearly I love my work, as I bring it home with me...on a stick!
translation: 아, 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 Vasile(바실레)이고, 마을에 쥐가 들끓지 않게 하는 일을 해요. 제 일을 정말 사랑하나 봐요. 일거리를 집까지 들고 가거든요... 막대기에 꽂아서요!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 그야말로 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

english: What's happening around here?
Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

english: Is there anything I can do to help out?

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 시설도 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고 있어요. 다들 당신에게 무척 고마워해요. 전 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.
translation: 대부분의 사람들이 보기엔 당신은 영웅일 거예요! 저는 당신을 만나서 정말 기뻐요.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?
Is there anything I can do to help out?
Ok, thanks.
Boots alone do not make an Araxyte.
translation: 장화만 신는다고 Araxyte(아락사이트)가 되는 건 아니다.

english: It's a step in the right direction, proceed.
translation: 올바른 방향으로 한 걸음 내디뎠군. 계속 나아가라.

english: Go.
I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
All in good time, [player name]. We stand forever in your debt, and will certainly put in a good word for you when we pass over.
translation: 때가 되면 그럴 거예요, [player name]님. 저희는 영원히 당신께 빚을 졌어요. 저세상에 가면 꼭 당신 이야기를 좋게 해 드릴게요.

english: Can I have another Ectophial?
translation: Ectophial(엑토피알)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Really? You've already got an Ectophial.
I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: 알아요. 그래도 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Of course you can, you have helped us more than we could ever have hoped.
translation: 물론이죠. 당신은 저희가 바랄 수 있었던 것보다 훨씬 더 많이 도와주셨는걸요.

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
translation: 제가요? 알겠어요, 없던 일로 해 주세요.

english: I thought you were going to pass over to the next world.
Can I have another Ectophial?
translation: Ectophial(엑토피알)을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: I know, but can I have another one anyway?
translation: 알아요. 그래도 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Have I? Okay, forget it.
translation: 제가요? 알겠어요, 없던 일로 해 주세요.

english: It's a damn good thing I don't have arachnophobia.
We're misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.
translation: 우린 오해받고 있다고. 우리가 집에 없으면 넌 파리랑 다른 '진짜' 해충들한테 시달릴걸.

english: Thanks for that enlightening fact.
Everybody gets one.
*slap*
Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hello, who are you?
I am Veos and I've just arrived in Port Sarim from a distant land.
translation: 저는 Veos(베오스)라고 해요. 머나먼 땅에서 Port Sarim(포트 사림)에 막 도착했죠.

english: Where's that?
Across the sea, to the far west.
Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five cities. They are the cities of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius. Each city is ruled by one of the five houses of Kourend.
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)는 다섯 도시로 이루어진 장엄한 왕국이에요. Arceuus(아르세우스), Lovakengj(로바켕기), Shayzien(샤이지엔), Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스), Hosidius(호시디우스)죠. 각 도시는 쿠렌드의 다섯 가문 중 하나가 다스려요.

english: At one time, the kingdom as a whole was ruled over by a king or queen that the five houses answered to.
translation: 한때는 다섯 가문이 섬기는 왕이나 여왕이 왕국 전체를 다스렸어요.

english: However, since our last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 하지만 20년 전 마지막 왕이 세상을 떠난 뒤로는 선출된 의회가 왕국을 다스리고 있어요.

english: Where are you from?
I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend, across the sea, to the far west.
translation: 바다 건너 저 멀리 서쪽, 장엄한 왕국 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에서 왔어요.

english: That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 멋지네요. 저를 거기로 데려다줄 수 있어요?

english: Certainly! I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 물론이죠! 뱃멀미를 안 하셨으면 좋겠네요, 긴 항해거든요.

english: Unfortunately it seems that you're not quite ready to visit Great Kourend yet. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 아쉽지만 아직 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에 갈 준비가 안 되신 것 같네요. 준비가 되면 다시 오세요. 기꺼이 모셔다 드릴게요.

english: You must be a member to travel to Great Kourend.Upgrade now to unlock extra quests, weapons, bosses, and more, within Great Kourend.
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)로 가려면 멤버여야 해요. 지금 업그레이드하고 그레이트 쿠렌드에서 추가 퀘스트, 무기, 보스 등을 잠금 해제하세요.

english: I'm afraid access to Great Kourend is currently prohibited.
translation: 죄송하지만 지금은 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드) 출입이 금지돼 있어요.

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to the Great Kourend and Kebos Lowlands area in this League.
translation: 이번 리그에서 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)와 Kebos Lowlands(케보스 저지대) 지역을 잠금 해제하지 않아서 지나갈 수 없어요.

english: Good bye.
Hello Veos.
Hello there. What can I do for you?
Can you take me somewhere?
Where would you like to go?
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
As you wish, I hope you don't get seasick, it is a long voyage.
translation: 원하시는 대로 하죠. 뱃멀미를 안 하셨으면 좋겠네요, 긴 항해거든요.

english: I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
As you wish.
Nothing.
What's this old book you gave me?
translation: 저한테 주신 이 오래된 책은 뭐예요?

english: Ah that. I bought it at an auction a while back. Apparently, it belonged to the daughter of King Kharedst IV, the final king of Great Kourend.
translation: 아, 그거요. 얼마 전에 경매에서 산 거예요. 듣자 하니 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)의 마지막 왕, King Kharedst IV(카레드스트 4세 왕)의 딸이 갖고 있던 물건이래요.

english: Why did you give it to me?
I'd hoped it might have some interesting information in it. Most of the pages are missing though so I have no use for it. I thought you might be able to find something to do with it.
translation: 흥미로운 정보가 좀 있지 않을까 했거든요. 그런데 페이지가 대부분 없어져서 저한테는 쓸모가 없어요. 당신이라면 뭔가 쓸 데를 찾을 수 있을 것 같았어요.

english: Fair enough. Thanks!
These remind me of a pet I once had. Please... put them away.
translation: 이걸 보니 예전에 키우던 동물이 생각나네요. 제발... 치워 주세요.

english: Sorry, Veos. I didn't know.
Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
I once had a wolf, [player name]. His name was Copper. He was loyal. Brave... Gentle. He'd wear this beautiful crimson red collar.
translation: 저는 늑대를 키웠어요, [player name]님. 이름은 Copper(코퍼)였죠. 충직하고... 용감하고... 온순했어요. 아름다운 진홍색 목걸이를 하고 다녔죠.

english: One day, I was travelling on the mainland, nearby a tribe of Fremenniks. Not exactly a spring chicken at this point, my own wolf was pushing 19...
translation: 어느 날 본토를 여행하다가 Fremenniks(프레메닉) 부족 근처를 지나게 됐어요. 그때 이미 제 늑대도 한창때가 지나서 열아홉 살이 다 돼 가고 있었죠...

english: 19 years old? That's an incredible amount of time for a wolf to live!
translation: 열아홉 살이요? 늑대치고는 엄청나게 오래 산 거네요!

english: Indeed. Sadly, a group of feral foxes ambushed us. I fought back, along with Copper, though he took wounds that even a young wolf would struggle dealing with.
translation: 그렇죠. 그런데 안타깝게도 사나운 여우 무리가 저희를 덮쳤어요. 저는 Copper(코퍼)와 함께 맞서 싸웠지만, 그 애는 젊은 늑대라도 견디기 힘들 만큼 깊은 상처를 입었어요.

english: What did you do?
I ran, [player name]... Like a coward.
Did you ever find him?
I did not... I searched for days, but I was unable to find even his collar.
translation: 못 찾았어요... 며칠을 찾아 헤맸지만 목걸이조차 찾을 수 없었어요.

english: I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar. I'm sure I can find the fox that has it...
translation: 제가 도울게요! Copper(코퍼)의 목걸이를 찾아 볼게요. 목걸이를 가진 여우를 분명 찾을 수 있을 거예요...

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me complete again.
translation: 정말요? 저를 위해 그렇게 해 주시겠다고요? 정말 고마워요, [player name]님. 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요! 그 일 이후로 줄곧 후회로 가슴이 가득했어요... Copper(코퍼)의 작은 일부라도 되찾으면 다시 온전해질 수 있을 것 같아요.

english: I'll return when I have found Copper's collar. Take care!
How goes the hunt for Copper's collar, [player name]?
I haven't had any luck finding it yet, Veos. Where would you recommend searching?
translation: 아직 찾지 못했어요, Veos(베오스)님. 어디를 찾아보면 좋을까요?

english: I'd imagine the fox which killed Copper will likely still have the collar in their possesion. They were nearby a Fremennik town.
translation: Copper(코퍼)를 죽인 여우가 아직 목걸이를 갖고 있을 거예요. 그때 Fremennik(프레메닉) 마을 근처였어요.

english: Thanks, Veos. I'll return when I have the collar!
[Player name]... I can't thank you enough. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future, I can repay you.
translation: [Player name]님... 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요. 드릴 보상은 없지만, 이게 저한테 얼마나 큰 의미인지 알아주셨으면 해요. 언젠가 꼭 보답할게요.

english: You're more than welcome Veos, and don't worry about a reward. Losing your best friend is always hard. Hopefully that item will bring you some comfort. Take care!
translation: 천만에요, Veos(베오스)님. 보상은 신경 쓰지 마세요. 가장 친한 친구를 잃는 건 언제나 힘든 일이죠. 그 물건이 조금이나마 위로가 되면 좋겠어요. 몸조심하세요!

english: [Player name]... I can't thank you enough for what you've done for me. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future I can repay you.
translation: [Player name]님... 저를 위해 해 주신 일에 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요. 드릴 보상은 없지만, 이게 저한테 얼마나 큰 의미인지 알아주셨으면 해요. 언젠가 꼭 보답할게요.

english: I am from the magnificent kingdom of Great Kourend on the continent of Zeah, to the far west.
translation: 저 멀리 서쪽, Zeah(제아) 대륙에 있는 장엄한 왕국 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에서 왔어요.

english: Great Kourend is a magnificent kingdom comprising of five districts called Houses. The houses are ruled by the Lords of Arceuus, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Hosidius.
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)는 가문이라 불리는 다섯 구역으로 이루어진 장엄한 왕국이에요. 각 가문은 Arceuus(아르세우스), Lovakengj(로바켕기), Shayzien(샤이지엔), Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스), Hosidius(호시디우스)의 영주가 다스려요.

english: Since our last King died 20 years ago the kingdom has been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 20년 전 마지막 왕이 세상을 떠난 뒤로는 선출된 의회가 왕국을 다스리고 있어요.

english: Tell me more about Zeah.

Zeah is a huge continent far to the west of here full of new adventures and hidden treasures. Sadly, the kingdom of Great Kourend is besieged by lizard creatures and it is not possible to get out of the kingdom just yet.
translation: Zeah(제아)는 여기서 저 멀리 서쪽에 있는 거대한 대륙인데, 새로운 모험과 숨겨진 보물로 가득해요. 안타깝게도 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드) 왕국은 도마뱀 괴물들에게 포위당해서 아직은 왕국 밖으로 나갈 수 없어요.

english: Who're you? I've never seen you around these parts before.
translation: 누구세요? 이 근처에선 처음 보는 분인데요.

english: I am Veos. Port master and scout for an elite Triumvirate.
translation: 나는 Veos(베오스). 항구 관리인이자 정예 Triumvirate(삼두회)의 정찰병이다.

english: Triumvirate?
Who? Where? Why have you suddenly docked here?
translation: 누가요? 어디서요? 왜 갑자기 여기 배를 댄 거예요?

english: These are questions to which you shall not find answers, adventurer.
translation: 그건 네가 답을 찾을 수 없는 질문들이다, 모험가.

english: Then why are you here?
There are secrets in this world for which you are not ready.
translation: 이 세상엔 네가 감당할 준비가 안 된 비밀들이 있다.

english: Veos whispers...
Yo.... we, are not alone.
Where's that?
That's great, can you take me there please?
translation: 멋지네요. 저를 거기로 데려다줄 수 있어요?

english: Tell me more about Great Kourend.
translation: Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드)에 대해 더 알려 주세요.

english: Goodbye.
Can you take me somewhere?
I'd like to travel to Port Piscarilius, please.
I'd like to travel to Land's End, please.
Actually I'd like to stay here.
Nothing.
Would you feel comfortable sharing your story?
I can help! I'll search for Copper's collar.
translation: 제가 도울게요! Copper(코퍼)의 목걸이를 찾아 볼게요.

english: I'm sorry. Thank you for sharing your story.
I'll leave you be. Sorry.
Where are you from?
Tell me more about Zeah.
Good bye.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 한 명 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 나한테 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 내버려 둬, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참한 날이야... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에선 처음 맡아 보는 냄새인데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 본 적 있어? 나 배가 무-우-척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 넌 피 맛을 제대로 아는 녀석처럼 보이는구나.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이 사이에 누가 좀 끼어서...

english: You dare disturb my rest!
You dare steal from us!
Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.
translation: 뱀파이어가 되는 걸 막아 줘서 정말 고마워요. 여기, 이 certificate(증명서) 받아 줘요. 미안하지만 보상으로 드릴 수 있는 게 이것뿐이에요.

english: Thanks for changing me back, it must have been hard for you. I must be off now.
translation: 원래대로 돌려놔 줘서 고마워요. 분명 힘드셨을 거예요. 저는 이만 가 봐야겠어요.

english: Welcome to my clothes stall, can I help you with anything?
translation: 제 clothes stall(옷 노점)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
Not a lot, I'm afraid, most of what I produce goes to my sister. Her shop is in Keldagrim-West.
translation: 별로 없어요. 제가 만드는 건 대부분 여동생한테 가거든요. 여동생 가게는 Keldagrim-West(서부 켈다그림)에 있어요.

english: Well, show me what you do have then.
No, I'm just browsing.
Yes, what clothes do you have in stock?
No, I'm just browsing.
Can you please help me? I'm in a terrible spot of trouble.
translation: 저 좀 도와주실래요? 정말 큰일 났어요.

english: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
Yes yes, I suppose it is a quest. My fiance Ernest and I came upon this house.
translation: 네, 네, 퀘스트라면 퀘스트겠죠. 제 약혼자 Ernest(어니스트)랑 제가 이 집을 발견했어요.

english: Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for directions.
translation: 길을 좀 잃은 참이라 Ernest(어니스트)가 들어가서 길을 물어보겠다고 했죠.

english: That was an hour ago. That house looks spooky, can you go and see if you can find him for me?
translation: 그게 벌써 한 시간 전이에요. 저 집 으스스해 보이는데, 들어가서 그이를 찾아봐 주실래요?

english: Ok, I'll see what I can do.
Thank you, thank you. I'm very grateful.
No, I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 아뇨, 전 죽일 만한 걸 찾고 있어요.

english: Oooh, you violent person you.
Have you found my sweetheart yet?
No, not yet.
Yes, he's a chicken.
I know he's not exactly brave but I think you're being a bit harsh.
translation: 그이가 용감한 편은 아니지만, 닭이라니 좀 심한 말씀이네요.

english: No no, he's been turned into an actual chicken by a mad scientist.
translation: 아뇨, 아뇨. 미친 과학자 때문에 진짜 닭으로 변해 버렸다고요.

english: Eeeeeek!
My poor darling, why must these things happen to us.
translation: 불쌍한 내 사랑, 왜 우리한테 이런 일이 생기는 걸까요.

english: Well I'm doing my best to turn him back.
Well be quick, I'm sure being a chicken can't be good for him.
translation: 그럼 서둘러 주세요. 닭으로 지내는 게 그이한테 좋을 리 없잖아요.

english: Thank you for rescuing Ernest.
Where is he now?
Oh he went off to talk to some green warty guy. I'm sure he'll be back soon.
translation: 아, 웬 초록색 사마귀투성이 남자랑 얘기하러 갔어요. 곧 돌아올 거예요.

english: Well done.
You've obtained a [new clue/casket]!
Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.
No, I'm looking for something to kill.
translation: 아뇨, 전 죽일 만한 걸 찾고 있어요.

english: Now that was quite the show! I haven't been that entertained in a long time.
translation: 이거 참 대단한 공연이었어! 이렇게 즐거웠던 건 정말 오랜만이야.

english: Of course, you know I can't let you leave here alive. Time for your final performance...
translation: 물론, 알겠지만 너희를 살려 보낼 수는 없지. 마지막 공연을 시작할 시간이야...

english: Oh I'm going to enjoy this...
Back again for more? I admire your perseverance. Shall we begin?
translation: 또 왔어? 그 끈기는 높이 사 주지. 시작해 볼까?

english: You think you can defeat me?
translation: 너희가 날 이길 수 있을 것 같아?

english: There's nothing for you there!
Behold my true nature!
I'm not finished with you just yet!
You think this is over?!
Yes, let's begin.
No, don't start yet.
Welcome, oh great Fishing Champion! Feel free to pop by and use our tunnel any time.

translation: 내 사냥개들! 대가를 치르게 해 주마!

FINE! I'LL DEAL WITH YOU MYSELF!
Urgh... not... again...

Who is the true lord and king of the lands?
translation: 이 땅의 진정한 군주이자 왕은 누구지?

Where is he? Why hasn't he lifted your burden?
translation: 그분은 어디 있어? 왜 네 짐을 덜어 주지 않은 거야?

What is your purpose?
Not what is, what was. A great war tore this land apart and, for my failings in protecting this land, I carry the burden of its waste.
translation: 지금의 사명이 아니라, 지난날의 사명이오. 큰 전쟁이 이 땅을 갈가리 찢어 놓았고, 이 땅을 지키지 못한 죄로 나는 그 황폐함의 짐을 지고 있소.

Grrr!
Grrrr!
Grarrr!
Hey it's the Hero! Wow! You're amazing, how on earth did you manage to tackle those two juvinates and Gadderanks? And the town is lovely, you've done a great job!
translation: 어, Hero(영웅)님이다! 와! 정말 대단하세요. 대체 어떻게 그 juvinates(주비네이트) 둘이랑 Gadderanks(개더랭크스)를 해치우신 거예요? 마을도 정말 멋져졌어요. 정말 훌륭하게 해내셨어요!

english: You're more than welcome.
What do you do here?
I'm Victor, I'm just a kid, but I'll duff you in! You don't look that tough to me!
translation: 저는 Victor(빅토르)예요. 그냥 꼬마지만, 한 방 먹여 줄 수 있다고요! 별로 세 보이지도 않는데요!

english: How do you like your town?
It's just perfect, thanks so much for your efforts.
translation: 그야말로 완벽해요. 애써 주셔서 정말 고마워요.

Oh, not much really, we're all still hiding from the vampyres and eking out a living from this terrible place, hopefully soon we'll be strong enough to make the journey to the temple on the Salve.
translation: 아, 별일 없어요. 다들 여전히 vampyres(뱀파이어)를 피해 숨어서 이 끔찍한 곳에서 겨우 먹고살고 있죠. 머지않아 Salve(살브) 강가의 신전까지 갈 만큼 힘을 기를 수 있으면 좋겠어요.

Not as far as I know, we have some basic amenities now which is so very useful, we're all incredibly grateful to you. I've never really seen or known a hero before, so I have nothing to compare one to, but I suspect in
translation: 제가 아는 한은 없어요. 이제 기본적인 시설도 생겨서 정말 큰 도움이 되고 있어요. 다들 당신에게 무척 고마워해요. 전 영웅을 직접 보거나 알아 본 적이 없어서 비교할 대상은 없지만, 아마

english: most people's judgement, you would be one! I for one am very pleased to have met you.

english: Ok, thanks.
What do you do here?
How do you like your town?
What's happening around here?

translation: 지금은 좀 바빠요. 보석 장식장을 정리해야 하거든요.

english: Want any help?
Absolutely not! You stay away from my jewels.
translation: 절대 안 돼요! 제 보석 근처에는 얼씬도 하지 마세요.

english: Interested in buying a house like mine?
translation: 제 집 같은 집을 사 보는 건 어때요?

english: Not sure I've got enough coins to do that.
Silly me! I mistook you for one of us wealthy folk.
translation: 이런, 내 정신 좀 봐! 당신이 우리 같은 부자인 줄 알았지 뭐예요.

english: Well that's rude.
You'll catch on.
Hello there. Are you liking the city?
It's beautiful!
It really is.
Huh? Are you an encyclopediasalesman?
No, sir, I'm a burglar. I burgle people.
translation: 아뇨, 나리, 저는 도둑이에요. 남의 집을 털죠.

english: Hmm... I think you're an encyclopediasalesman?
Not at all. I just want to ransack the place. Honestly.
translation: 전혀 아니에요. 그냥 이 집을 싹 털고 싶을 뿐이에요. 정말로요.

english: Hmm... Alright then.
I've just spent so much money!
Good for you.
I've got something in the back of my mind telling me I should go back home.
translation: 왠지 집에 돌아가 봐야 할 것 같은 느낌이 드네요.

english: You don't say...
Lovely day for a stroll, wouldn't you say?
translation: 산책하기 딱 좋은 날이죠, 안 그래요?

english: It is!
Sorry, but I don't have time to chat. I've got important errands to run.
translation: 미안하지만 수다 떨 시간이 없어요. 중요한 볼일이 있거든요.

english: I can't talk right now. I'm busy.
Time to go check how rich I am!
translation: 내가 얼마나 부자인지 확인하러 가 볼까!

english: Lovely day for a stroll.
You are escorted out of the house as the owner has locked the door.
translation: 집주인이 문을 잠가 버려서 집 밖으로 쫓겨났다.

english: You hear someone outside spot the homeowner coming back!
translation: 밖에서 누군가 집주인이 돌아오는 걸 봤다고 외치는 소리가 들린다!

english: Now where did I put my keys...
Ah, there they are!
It smells funny in here...
There's mud all over the floor!
Something isn't right here...
How did you get in here?
Hello, land dweller.
Hello, sea dweller.
What are you doing here?
The sea has been getting quite busy all of a sudden. I surfaced to see what the fuss was about and found that lots of you seem interested in diving down to the sea floor.
translation: 요즘 갑자기 바다가 꽤 북적이더라고요. 무슨 일인가 싶어 올라와 봤더니, 다들 해저까지 잠수하는 데 관심이 많은 것 같더군요.

english: I'm offering my services as a guide, for a price. The price in this case, is knowledge!
translation: 그래서 길잡이를 해 드리려고요. 물론 대가는 받아요. 이번 대가는, 바로 지식이에요!

english: Interesting... It might be good to add some data about the depth of the sea to my charts.
translation: 흥미롭네요... 제 해도에 바다 깊이에 관한 자료를 추가하면 좋겠어요.

english: Can I dive to the sea floor with you?
I don't think you are practised enough to dive here. I don't want you getting swept away!
translation: 아직 여기서 잠수할 만큼 숙련되지 않은 것 같아요. 해류에 휩쓸려 가면 안 되잖아요!

english: You need a Sailing level of 13 to dive here.
You need to be wearing deep sea diving equipment to dive with me!
translation: 저랑 잠수하려면 심해 잠수 장비를 입고 있어야 해요!

english: I want something in return if you're going to dive with me...
translation: 저랑 잠수하려면 그 대가로 뭔가 받아야겠어요...

english: I'd like to try making some of your land food. Can you tell me the raw ingredients and tools I need to make an apple pie? Don't worry about water. I have plenty of that.
translation: 육지 음식을 한번 만들어 보고 싶어요. apple pie(사과 파이)를 만들려면 어떤 생재료랑 도구가 필요한지 알려 줄래요? 물은 걱정 마세요. 그건 넘치도록 많으니까요.

english: This puzzle has three answers and you'll need to tell me all of them.
translation: 이 문제는 답이 세 개예요. 전부 말해 줘야 해요.

english: I don't think that's right... You should try again.
translation: 그건 아닌 것 같은데요... 다시 해 보세요.

english: The mermaid, satisfied with your answer, escorts you to the bottom of the sea. You take some depth readings from your diving equipment and note down the interesting local flora and fauna.
translation: 대답에 만족한 인어가 당신을 바다 밑바닥까지 안내한다. 잠수 장비로 수심을 측정하고, 흥미로운 이 지역의 동식물을 기록한다.

english: There you go. Hope the dive got you everything you needed!
translation: 자, 됐어요. 이번 잠수로 필요한 건 다 얻었으면 좋겠네요!

english: Goodbye.
Goodbye, land dweller.
What are you doing here?
Can I dive to the sea floor with you?
Goodbye.
Hello!
Hello, human. What can I do for you?
What are you doing here?
Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.
What about the giant monster up there?
Hah! Why would I rush up there when you foolish humans are more than willing to throw yourself into its jaws?
translation: 하! 어리석은 인간들이 그 아가리에 기꺼이 몸을 던져 주는데 내가 왜 서둘러 올라가겠어요?

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: 게다가 누군가는 이 아래에서 벌어지는 일을 지켜봐야 하잖아요.

english: I suppose that's fair.
It is hungry work though, and we don't have the most interesting supplies up here.
translation: 그래도 배고픈 일이긴 해요. 여기 보급품은 그다지 흥미로운 게 없거든요.

english: Got me thinking about those sunlight antelope. Quite an interesting flavour, but I think we can do even more...
translation: 그래서 sunlight antelope(햇빛 영양) 생각이 나더라고요. 맛이 꽤 독특한데, 더 끌어올릴 수 있을 것 같단 말이죠...

english: Anyway, I shouldn't really be talking to you. Move along, please.
translation: 아무튼 원래 당신이랑 이렇게 떠들면 안 돼요. 가던 길 가세요.

translation: 오, 지금 들고 있는 거 sunlight antelope(햇빛 영양) 고기예요?

translation: 가까이 와 봐요, 부탁할 게 있어요.

translation: 우리 발밑을 파고 다니는 거대한 짐승의 아가리에 언제 죽을지 모르는 채로 여기 앉아 있다 보니 이런 생각이 들더라고요.

english: Could we combine the sweet stickiness of redberries with the strong, gamey flavour of sunlight antelope?
translation: redberries(레드베리)의 달콤 끈적한 맛이랑 sunlight antelope(햇빛 영양)의 진한 야생 고기 맛을 합쳐 보면 어떨까요?

english: What?
Don't get me wrong, Marla is cooking up some wonderful stuff considering the circumstances. I just need something a little more adventurous, you know?
translation: 오해는 말아요. 이런 상황치고는 Marla(말라)도 훌륭한 요리를 해 주고 있으니까요. 그냥 나는 좀 더 모험적인 게 먹고 싶달까, 그런 거 있잖아요.

english: I'm sure she'd be happy to experiment if you bring her some raw sunlight antelope and redberries!
translation: raw sunlight antelope(날 햇빛 영양)이랑 redberries(레드베리)를 가져다주면 Marla(말라)도 기꺼이 실험해 볼 거예요!

english: I suppose I can help out.
Wonderful, thank you! I can't wait to try this!
translation: 좋아요, 고마워요! 빨리 먹어 보고 싶네요!

english: Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.
Aren't we all? Ah well, maybe another time.
translation: 안 바쁜 사람이 어디 있겠어요? 뭐, 다음에 부탁하죠.

english: Hello! What can I do for you?
What did you want me to get you?
I'd like to try redberries combined with sunlight antelope! Marla the chef will prepare it if you take her the raw ingredients.
translation: redberries(레드베리)랑 sunlight antelope(햇빛 영양)을 같이 먹어 보고 싶어요! 날재료를 가져다주면 요리사 Marla(말라)가 만들어 줄 거예요.

english: I'll see what I can do.
Never mind.
Okay, bye!

Hmm...
...Mmmhhmm...
...Mmm.

translation: 음, 이건... 독특하고 복잡하네요. 확실히 색다른 경험이에요.

translation: 어, 보통 이런 일을 하면 보상이 있던데요.

translation: 진심이에요, 인간? 그냥 친절한 마음으로 해 줄 수는 없었어요? 여정을 즐기고, 남을 돕는 뿌듯함으로요?

translation: 내가 여기서 하는 일과 제공하는 봉사에 감사해서 도와준 게 아니었어요?

english: Or, at the least, to push the boundaries of culinary achievement?
translation: 아니면 최소한, 요리의 한계를 넓혀 보겠다는 마음이라도요?

english: I... uh... of course. Enjoy your meal.
I suppose you can have a bite if you like?
translation: 원한다면 한 입 먹어 봐도 돼요.

english: I think I'll pass, thanks.
Can I try some?
Oh. Yeah, I suppose so.

Protecting the camp from wildlife and thieves.

translation: 하! 어리석은 인간들이 그 아가리에 기꺼이 몸을 던져 주는데 내가 왜 서둘러 올라가겠어요?

english: Besides, someone needs to keep an eye on the happenings down here.
translation: 게다가 누군가는 이 아래에서 벌어지는 일을 지켜봐야 하잖아요.

english: Seriously though, [player name], do be careful up there.
translation: 농담은 그렇고, [player name]님, 저 위에선 정말 조심해요.

english: I'll try!
Would you like any more redberry antelope?
You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: 음, 이제 충분히 먹은 것 같아요. 그래도 고마워요.

english: Okay, bye!
Oh, more antelope. You know, I think I've had enough. Thanks, though.
translation: 오, 영양 고기가 또 있네요. 음, 이제 충분히 먹은 것 같아요. 그래도 고마워요.

english: Yes.
No.

What did you want me to get you?
Never mind.
Uh, usually there's a reward for doing this sort of thing.
translation: 어, 보통 이런 일을 하면 보상이 있던데요.

english: Can I try some?
Enjoy your meal.
Would you like some more redberry antelope?
Hello there.
Wooo?  Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 우우?  우우우 우우 우우우우우 우우우우우 우우우우우우 우우우 우우우우우 우우!

english: You don't say?
Woo! WOO WOOOOO WOOWOOWOO WOO WOOOOO!
translation: 우우! 우우 우우우우 우우우우우우 우우 우우우우!

english: You don't say!
Wooowoowoooooo.... Woowoowoo? Woooo, wooowoo wooowooowooo!
Well, I guess you didn't say.
translation: 음, 정말 말이 안 되긴 하네요.

english: Yeah, I don't want to brag, but seriously: I am SOOOO rich....
translation: 네, 자랑하려는 건 아닌데 진짜로요, 저 완전 부자예요....

english: Yeah, I know they say money doesn't bring you happiness, but sometimes I just like to open my bank account and look at all of the stuff I own and just think to myself:
translation: 네, 돈으로 행복을 살 순 없다고들 하죠. 그래도 가끔은 은행 계좌를 열고 제가 가진 걸 쭉 둘러보면서 혼자 이렇게 생각하는 게 좋더라고요.

english: Wow. I am soooooo rich.
Well, us rich alive people don't want to waste all day spending time with you poor dead people, because I'm just sooooo rich I have to go now, and very possibly make myself even richer.
translation: 자, 우리 부유한 산 사람들은 당신 같은 가난한 죽은 사람들이랑 하루 종일 놀아 줄 시간이 없거든요. 전 너무너무 부자라서 이만 가 봐야 해요. 아마 가서 더 부자가 되겠죠.

english: See ya around ghosty!

translation: 네, 저도 그 얘기 들었어요, 하하하!

english: With a MACKEREL? Ouch!
Well, it was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
Why, thank you very much!
I know, but what are you going to do?
Well, I guess that's always true in the long run. See you around, weird invisible dead person!
translation: 음, 길게 보면 늘 맞는 말이죠. 또 봐요, 이상한 투명 망자 양반!

english: Yeah it's not bad, but I prefer cooked chicken.
translation: 네, 나쁘진 않은데 전 익힌 닭고기가 더 좋아요.

english: Maybe, but nothing beats a home cooked pie!
translation: 그럴지도 모르지만, 집에서 구운 파이만 한 건 없죠!

english: Man, I love pie!
You don't say? I never knew that. Well, I must be going, see you around.
translation: 설마 그래요? 처음 알았네요. 음, 전 이만 가 봐야겠어요, 또 봐요.

english: We get signal!
Somebody set up us the bomb!
You have no chance to survive make your time.
translation: 너희는 살아남을 기회가 없다 너의 시간을 만들어라.

english: Woo?
All your base are belong to us.
translation: 모든 너희 기지는 우리에게 속해 있다.

english: Hey, don't think you can talk to me like that!
translation: 이봐요, 저한테 그런 식으로 말하면 안 되죠!

english: Are you threatening me?
Just because you're already dead, doesn't mean I can't find a way to hurt you ghosty!
translation: 이미 죽었다고 해서 제가 당신을 해칠 방법이 없는 건 아니라고요, 유령 양반!

english: No, I've never been there in my life and CERTAINLY didn't steal anything when I was!
translation: 아뇨, 전 평생 거기 가 본 적도 없고, 갔을 때 뭘 훔친 일도 절대 없어요!

english: Are you calling me a liar?!?! I have never stolen a thing in my life, and I resent the implication that I am the kind of morally depraved individual that would steal someone else's hard earned
translation: 절 거짓말쟁이라고 하는 거예요?!?! 전 평생 뭘 훔친 적이 없어요. 그리고 제가 남이 피땀 흘려 번

english: money from their very pockets!
translation: 돈을 그 사람 주머니에서 훔칠 만큼 도덕적으로 타락한 인간이라는 암시는 정말 불쾌하다고요!

english: Or cakes. Or fur. Repeatedly. For long periods at a time.
translation: 케이크도요. 모피도요. 몇 번이고. 아주 오랫동안요.

english: Well if you are going to take that attitude, then I have nothing further to say on the matter, and bid you good day!
translation: 그런 태도로 나온다면 저도 이 일에 대해선 더 할 말이 없네요. 그럼 이만 실례하죠!

english: So... You must be the infamous Viggora.
translation: 그래서... 당신이 그 악명 높은 Viggora(비고라)군요.

english: Hold thy tongue varlet! Speak fast, how come you to find me here, and how doth you understand mine speech?
translation: 혀를 놀리지 마라, 이 천한 놈아! 어서 고하라, 어찌 나를 여기서 찾았으며, 어찌 내 말을 알아듣느냐?

english: You want me to hold my tongue and tell you how I found you?
translation: 혀를 놀리지 말라면서, 어떻게 찾았는지 말하라는 거예요?

english: Cease thy chatter and respond to my demand!
Cease my chatter AND respond to your demand?
I warn thee knave, this curse upon me hath not improved my temper, these centuries past...
translation: 경고하노니, 이 무뢰배야. 몸에 내린 이 저주는 지난 수백 년 동안 내 성미를 조금도 누그러뜨리지 못했느니라...

english: Well, it's actually about that curse that I have come to speak to you.
translation: 음, 사실 제가 당신과 이야기하러 온 게 바로 그 저주 때문이에요.

english: Oh, be that so? Then forgive my swift anger, and speak to me of how you plan to break this curse.
translation: 오, 그러하냐? 그렇다면 내 성급한 분노를 용서하고, 이 저주를 어떻게 풀 셈인지 말해 보거라.

english: Erm... I didn't actually mention anything about breaking the curse...
translation: 어... 사실 저주를 푼다는 얘긴 한마디도 안 했는데요...

english: Then what lets you dare speak to me?
translation: 그렇다면 무엇을 믿고 감히 내게 말을 거느냐?

english: Well, I heard of your name from a mage called Dhalak, and I'm trying to find out what exactly caused the curse to befall him, and you as well apparently.
translation: 음, Dhalak(달락)이라는 마법사에게서 당신 이름을 들었어요. 그에게 저주가 내린 원인이 정확히 뭔지 알아보고 있는데, 보아하니 당신도 저주를 받았더군요.

english: Ha! So the weak-willed mage was cursed along with me?
translation: 하! 그 나약한 마법사도 나와 함께 저주를 받았단 말이냐?

english: Well now, that is an interesting turn of events... Then am I to assume that Valdez, Rennard, Kharrim and Lennissa were also cursed along with me?
translation: 허, 이것 참 흥미로운 전개로구나... 그렇다면 Valdez(발데즈), Rennard(레너드), Kharrim(카림), Lennissa(레니사)도 나와 함께 저주를 받았다고 봐야겠지?

english: ...How did you know that?
Ha ha ha! Oh, the curse cut deeper than I had previously thought!
translation: 하하하! 오, 저주가 생각보다 훨씬 깊이 파고들었구나!

english: Stranger, this news has brought me a ray of sunshine in an otherwise dreary millennium! Please, ask any question you wish!
translation: 이방인이여, 이 소식이 그렇지 않아도 음울한 천 년 세월에 한 줄기 햇살을 비춰 주었도다! 자, 무엇이든 묻고 싶은 것을 물어보거라!

english: Erm... Thanks, I think. So what exactly happened on that day you were all cursed?
translation: 어... 고맙다고 해야 하나요? 그래서 다들 저주를 받은 그날 정확히 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요?

english: I know that Valdez discovered the Staff of Armadyl, was robbed by Rennard, who then sent Kharrim to tell Zamorak of it.
translation: 제가 알기로는 Valdez(발데즈)가 Staff of Armadyl(아마딜의 지팡이)를 발견했고, Rennard(레너드)가 그걸 훔친 다음 Kharrim(카림)을 보내 Zamorak(자모락)에게 알렸어요.

english: Meanwhile Lennissa heard of the sale, and informed Dhalak who placed an enchantment upon it so that its power would be hidden.
