translation: 그사이 Lennissa(레니사)가 그 거래 소식을 듣고 Dhalak(달락)에게 알렸고, 달락은 지팡이의 힘이 감춰지도록 마법을 걸었죠.

english: I still don't know what happened with the staff to cause this curse, or what you had to do with it though...
translation: 그런데 그 지팡이 때문에 무슨 일이 생겨서 저주가 내렸는지, 당신이 거기에 어떻게 얽혔는지는 아직 모르겠어요...

english: Well stranger, rest yourself awhile, and I will recount a tale of the events of that day, for I was one of the few actually there when it happened...
translation: 그래, 이방인이여. 잠시 쉬어 가거라. 그날의 일을 이야기해 주마. 나는 그 일이 벌어졌을 때 실제로 그 자리에 있던 몇 안 되는 자 중 하나였으니...

english: When what happened?
When my Lord Zamorak first got his taste of godhood!
translation: 나의 군주 Zamorak(자모락)께서 처음으로 신성의 맛을 보셨을 때 말이다!

english: Wow. Sounds like quite the dinner party anecdote.
translation: 와. 저녁 파티에서 꺼내기 딱 좋은 일화네요.

english: You can take the snide venom out of your voice whelp, you came to me; 'twas not the other way round.
translation: 그 목소리에 담긴 빈정거림이나 거두어라, 애송이. 나를 찾아온 건 너다. 그 반대가 아니란 말이다.

english: Okay, okay. Please continue.
Well now, let us see... As you may have heard tell, my affiliation lay with General Zamorak, a mighty warrior of the Mahjarrat tribe, and my skill on the battlefield had quickly brought
translation: 자, 어디 보자... 들었을지 모르겠다만, 나는 Mahjarrat(마하자랏) 부족의 위대한 전사 Zamorak(자모락) 장군을 따랐고, 전장에서의 내 솜씨는 금세

english: me to his attention.

So pleased was he with my bloodlust that he promoted me on the battlefield once to serve in his honour guard, and let me tell you, this was a rare honour indeed, for I was the only human chosen to take such a position.
translation: 그분께서는 내 피에 굶주린 기세를 얼마나 흡족해하셨던지 전장에서 그 자리에서 나를 그분의 의장대원으로 승진시키셨지. 말해 두지만 이는 참으로 드문 영예였다. 그 자리에 뽑힌 인간은 나 하나뿐이었으니까.

english: Really?
Oh yes, the dragon riders, Mahjarrat, demons and vampyre warriors made up the bulk of the force, but I wager I was their equal in all ways of combat.
translation: 암, 그렇고말고. 드래곤 기수, Mahjarrat(마하자랏), 악마, vampyre(뱀파이어) 전사들이 병력의 대부분이었지만, 장담컨대 나는 모든 전투 방식에서 그들과 대등했다.

english: Ha, when I think of someone like Lucien struggling to lift a blade, in some ways I was even their better!
translation: 하, Lucien(루시엔) 같은 자가 칼 한 자루 들어 올리느라 쩔쩔매던 걸 생각하면, 어떤 면에서는 내가 그들보다 나았지!

english: Please continue.
Well anyway... Myself and the rest of Zamoraks honour guard were formulating stratagems in our battle-tent, when that sneaky messenger Kharrim came in offering to sell us
translation: 아무튼... 나와 Zamorak(자모락)의 나머지 의장대원들이 전투 천막에서 전략을 짜고 있을 때, 그 교활한 전령 Kharrim(카림)이 들어와 우리에게

english: the god-staff of Armadyl!
Naturally, we suspected that this was some trick by our Lord to test our loyalty...
translation: 당연히 우리는 이것이 우리의 충성을 시험하려는 군주의 계략이라고 의심했다...

english: Yes, who was your lord? Everyone has been very evasive about that...
translation: 네, 그 군주가 누구였는데요? 다들 그 얘기만 나오면 말을 돌리던데...

english: Quiet fool, all things in their course; You are disrupting my train of thought!
translation: 조용히 하라, 이 바보야. 모든 일엔 순서가 있다. 네가 내 생각의 흐름을 끊고 있지 않느냐!

english: Sorry...
Well anyway, we thought it was too good to be true, yet when we visited this scummy tavern we were amazed to discover there was no trick, no test of loyalty, no hidden trap:
translation: 아무튼, 우리는 그게 사실이라기엔 너무 좋은 얘기라고 여겼다. 그런데 그 지저분한 선술집을 찾아가 보니 놀랍게도 계략도, 충성 시험도, 숨겨진 함정도 없었다.

english: Somehow this fool had actually managed to obtain the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: 어찌 된 일인지 그 바보가 정말로 Armadyl(아마딜) 신의 지팡이를 손에 넣었던 것이다!

english: Its power was incredible, you could almost feel the energies crackling around it in the air!
translation: 그 힘은 엄청났다. 지팡이 주변 공기 속에서 기운이 탁탁 튀는 게 느껴질 정도였지!

english: So what happened then?

Well, with such a weapon, the plans we had been developing for a rebellion against our lord could finally be put into action, but we knew that we would have to act swiftly, before he heard that we had a weapon
translation: 자, 그런 무기가 있으니 우리가 군주에 맞서 꾸며 온 반란 계획을 마침내 실행에 옮길 수 있었다. 하지만 군주가 자신을 쓰러뜨릴 수 있는 무기를 우리가 가졌다는 걸 알기 전에

english: capable of defeating him, and we would have to act decisively, for even amongst our group there were still those loyal to the lord - such as that pathetic fool Azzanadra.
translation: 재빨리 움직여야 했고, 단호하게 행동해야 했다. 우리 무리 중에도 여전히 군주에게 충성하는 자가 있었으니까 - 그 한심한 바보 Azzanadra(아자나드라) 같은 놈 말이다.

english: So JUST WHO WAS this lord you speak of?
translation: 그래서 당신이 말하는 그 군주가 대체 누구였냐고요?

english: And I tell thee again, I will say when it is appropriate, now do not disrupt my tale!
translation: 다시 말하지만, 때가 되면 말해 주겠다. 그러니 내 이야기를 방해하지 마라!

english: Okay, carry on then...
So anyway, Lord Zamorak and his most trusted compatriots, namely myself, Hazeel, Drakan, Thammaron and Zemouregal made plans to overthrow our lord using the god-weapon, and by pledging
translation: 아무튼, Zamorak(자모락) 님과 가장 신임받던 동지들, 즉 나, Hazeel(헤이즐), Drakan(드라칸), Thammaron(타마론), Zemouregal(제무레갈)은 그 신의 무기로 군주를 쓰러뜨릴 계획을 세웠다. 그리고

english: allegiance to Zamorak as our master, were each to be given a large piece of land as our own in return.
translation: Zamorak(자모락)을 주인으로 섬기겠다는 충성을 맹세하는 대가로, 각자 넓은 땅을 영지로 받기로 했지.

english: We decided to move immediately, before anyone got cold feet, or any other parties could interfere in our work, and made haste towards the castle where our Lord lived.
translation: 우리는 누군가 겁을 먹거나 다른 세력이 끼어들기 전에 곧바로 움직이기로 하고, 군주가 사는 성으로 서둘러 향했다.

english: If Lucien had not been otherwise occupied, he would have probably accompanied us with his magicks, but it turned out the foolish Dhalak had made his involvement unnecessary with some spells of his own allowing us to
translation: Lucien(루시엔)이 다른 일에 매여 있지 않았다면 아마 마법으로 우리와 동행했을 테지만, 그 어리석은 Dhalak(달락)이 자기 주문으로 그럴 필요를 없애 주었다. 그 주문 덕분에

english: get close enough to the castle with the staff without the Empty Lord being able to sense its presence.
translation: Empty Lord(공허의 군주)가 지팡이의 존재를 느끼지 못한 채로 우리가 지팡이를 들고 성 가까이 다가갈 수 있었지.

english: So your lord was the one that cursed you?
translation: 그럼 당신들에게 저주를 내린 게 그 군주였어요?

english: I am coming to that... So anyway, we made our way to the castle, under the pretense that we had war plans against Saradomin and the other deities to discuss.
translation: 그 얘기를 하려던 참이다... 아무튼, 우리는 Saradomin(사라도민)과 다른 신들을 상대할 전쟁 계획을 논의하러 왔다는 핑계로 성에 들어갔다.

english: As usual, our lord was guarded well, but this was why Zamorak had brought his most trusted fighters with him.
translation: 늘 그렇듯 군주는 철통같이 경호를 받고 있었다. 하지만 바로 그 때문에 Zamorak(자모락)이 가장 믿을 만한 전사들을 데려온 것이었지.

english: While we distracted the Empty Lord with our feints and attacks, and kept his bodyguards busy, Lord Zamorak outflanked him, unsheathed the staff and plunged it into his back!
translation: 우리가 위장 공격과 공세로 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)의 주의를 끌고 그 호위병들을 붙잡아 두는 사이, Zamorak(자모락) 님께서 그의 측면으로 돌아 들어가 지팡이를 뽑아 들고 그의 등에 꽂으셨다!

english: Ah, it was a glorious sight... At that moment I was reminded for whom I fought, and why General Zamorak had earned his nickname 'the scourge' upon the battlefield...
translation: 아, 참으로 영광스러운 광경이었지... 그 순간 나는 내가 누구를 위해 싸우는지, 그리고 왜 Zamorak(자모락) 장군이 전장에서 '재앙'이라는 별명을 얻었는지 다시금 깨달았다...

english: And the next thing you know you were cursed?
translation: 그리고 정신을 차려 보니 저주를 받았다는 거예요?

english: No, it was not quite that simple... The Empty Lord turned away from our battle, eyes burning with hatred, and towards Zamorak instead. Seeing this, we all fought with extra vigour, so that
translation: 아니, 그렇게 간단하진 않았다... Empty Lord(공허의 군주)는 우리와의 싸움에서 돌아서서, 증오로 불타는 눈으로 Zamorak(자모락)을 향했다. 그걸 보고 우리 모두 더욱 힘을 내어 싸웠다.

english: General Zamorak would not face our lord alone, but we were outnumbered by many hundreds of warriors and demons, and could not reach him to assist him!
translation: Zamorak(자모락) 장군이 홀로 군주와 맞서지 않도록 말이다. 하지만 수백에 이르는 전사와 악마들에게 수적으로 밀려, 그에게 다가가 도울 수가 없었다!

english: So what then?
Why, it was the Empty Lord versus Zamorak, in single combat! And the sight of the battle will be with me forever more...
translation: 그야, Empty Lord(공허의 군주)와 Zamorak(자모락)의 일대일 대결이었지! 그 싸움의 광경은 영원히 내 기억에 남을 것이다...

english: The Empty Lord was a powerful god, stronger than any of the others awake at that time, possibly even as strong as Guthix is, and Zamorak was but a mortal: A Mahjarrat warrior all the same, with all of the
translation: Empty Lord(공허의 군주)는 강력한 신이었다. 당시 깨어 있던 어떤 신보다 강했고, 어쩌면 Guthix(구식스)만큼 강했을지도 모른다. 반면 Zamorak(자모락)은 한낱 필멸자였지. 물론 Mahjarrat(마하자랏) 전사였으니

english: strength and power that that entails, but mortal nonetheless, but to see him fight, you would not think of him as a 'mere' anything...
translation: 그에 걸맞은 힘과 권능을 모두 지녔지만, 그래도 필멸자는 필멸자였다. 하지만 그가 싸우는 모습을 보면, 그를 '한낱' 무엇이라고는 생각할 수 없었을 게다...

english: He was war itself! Flurry after flurry of blows he rained upon the Empty Lord, and the very castle walls shook and quivered with their power, but the Empty Lord would not fall!
translation: 그는 전쟁 그 자체였다! Empty Lord(공허의 군주)에게 일격 또 일격을 퍼부었고, 그 위력에 성벽마저 흔들리고 떨렸지만, 공허의 군주는 쓰러지지 않았다!

english: Even with the weapon of a god embedded in his back, he fought on, and with each blow our victory seemed less and less certain...
translation: 신의 무기가 등에 박힌 채로도 그는 계속 싸웠고, 일격이 오갈 때마다 우리의 승리는 점점 불확실해 보였다...

english: Well, then a miracle happened. Or luck. Or natural justice.
translation: 그런데, 그때 기적이 일어났다. 아니면 행운이었거나. 아니면 하늘의 뜻이었거나.

english: You can call it what you want, but as the Empty Lords hands wrapped tightly around Zamorak's throat, Lord Zamorak, kicking and screaming defiantly and radiant in his anger until the very last, plunged towards the
translation: 뭐라고 부르든 상관없다. Empty Lord(공허의 군주)의 손이 Zamorak(자모락)의 목을 단단히 움켜쥔 순간, 마지막까지 발버둥 치고 반항하듯 소리치며 분노로 빛나던 자모락 님께서

english: Empty Lord, who seemed to lose his footing slightly, and fell in such a way so that the staff plunged deeper into his body, but also impaled Lord Zamorak with it at the same time...
translation: Empty Lord(공허의 군주)에게 몸을 던지셨다. 공허의 군주는 살짝 발을 헛디딘 듯 쓰러졌고, 그 바람에 지팡이가 그 몸 더 깊숙이 박히는 동시에 Zamorak(자모락) 님까지 꿰뚫었다...

english: And then...
And then what?
And then nothing. There was a sudden flash of bright light, and then a sudden blink of cold darkness, and it was over.
translation: 그리고 아무것도 없었다. 갑자기 눈부신 빛이 번쩍이더니, 이내 차가운 어둠이 순식간에 깜빡였고, 그걸로 끝이었다.

english: Zamorak stood over the Empty Lord who was slowly... fading from existence... And as he faded, it seemed as though... It almost seemed as though Zamorak became more real,
translation: Zamorak(자모락)은 서서히... 존재가 사라져 가는 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)를 내려다보며 서 있었다... 그리고 그가 사라져 갈수록, 마치... 마치 자모락이 더 실재하게,

english: more solid than he had been before...
translation: 이전보다 더 단단한 존재가 되어 가는 것 같았다...

english: And as the Empty Lord faded from this world completely, I heard his voice, almost a whisper upon the wind, cursing all who had helped Zamorak in his victory, which as you now tell me seems to have been all who
translation: 그리고 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)가 이 세상에서 완전히 사라질 때, 나는 바람에 실린 속삭임 같은 그의 목소리를 들었다. Zamorak(자모락)의 승리를 도운 모든 자를 저주하는 목소리였지. 네 말을 들어 보니 그 대상은

english: were responsible for the staff ending up in Zamorak's hands at the castle.
translation: 지팡이가 성에서 Zamorak(자모락)의 손에 들어가기까지 관여한 모든 자였던 모양이구나.

english: As I heard it, I saw that I too was fading, just as the Empty Lord had, and I called to my brethren for their assistance, but they could no longer hear my words, nor see my form.
translation: 그 목소리를 듣는 순간, 나 역시 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)처럼 사라져 가고 있음을 깨달았다. 나는 형제들에게 도움을 청했지만, 그들은 더 이상 내 말을 듣지도, 내 모습을 보지도 못했다.

english: It was then that the other gods appeared and banished Zamorak from the world completely for daring to kill one of their kind, although as it turned out it didn't quite work out that way for them, when he returned
translation: 그때 다른 신들이 나타나, 감히 자기들 동족을 죽였다는 죄로 Zamorak(자모락)을 이 세상에서 완전히 추방했다. 하지만 결국 그들 뜻대로 되지는 않았지. 그가 돌아왔을 때는

english: stronger than ever, a god himself.
translation: 그 어느 때보다 강한, 신 그 자체가 되어 있었으니까.

english: But the god wars were another story entirely...
translation: 하지만 신들의 전쟁은 또 완전히 다른 이야기다...

english: But... I don't understand... If it was Zamorak who used the weapon, then why was it only you who were cursed?
translation: 하지만... 이해가 안 돼요... 무기를 쓴 게 Zamorak(자모락)이었다면, 왜 저주를 받은 건 당신뿐이에요?

english: And the other people who were cursed, why them? Why not the other Mahjarrat for example?
translation: 그리고 저주받은 다른 사람들은 왜 그 사람들이었죠? 예를 들어 다른 Mahjarrat(마하자랏)들은 왜 아니고요?

english: And just who was this 'Empty Lord' you keep speaking of?
translation: 그리고 당신이 계속 말하는 그 '공허의 군주'는 대체 누구예요?

english: Well, in my life I was nothing but a warrior. I had no hidden knowledge, I didn't especially care about the gods or their magics, and I certainly didn't respect them.
translation: 글쎄, 살아생전 나는 그저 전사에 불과했다. 숨겨진 지식도 없었고, 신이나 그들의 마법에는 별 관심도 없었으며, 그들을 존경하지도 않았다.

english: Now in my... I suppose this is my death. I am but a shade on the wind, unnoticed by all who pass me, until today anyway, and the only answer I can give you is that the others who were with me, the
translation: 이제 나의... 이걸 나의 죽음이라 해야겠지. 나는 바람 속의 그림자일 뿐, 오늘 전까지는 지나가는 누구의 눈에도 띄지 않았다. 내가 줄 수 있는 유일한 답은, 나와 함께 있던 다른 자들,

english: Mahjarrats and the Vampyre, they were beings of magic.
It runs through their very veins, and ebbs through their bones.
translation: 마법이 그들의 핏줄 속을 흐르고, 뼛속까지 스며들어 있지.

english: Who knows why the curse fell as it did? Perhaps as a mere human I was more susceptible to it, when they were not. Perhaps they too are cursed, but their life spans are so
translation: 저주가 왜 그렇게 내렸는지 누가 알겠느냐? 어쩌면 한낱 인간인 내가 저주에 더 취약했고, 그들은 아니었는지도 모른다. 어쩌면 그들도 저주를 받았지만, 수명이 워낙

english: long that it will be millennia before they feel it upon them. Perhaps because it did not affect them, it extended backwards through time, to the moment the staff was
translation: 길어서 그걸 느끼기까지 수천 년이 걸릴지도 모르지. 어쩌면 저주가 그들에게 듣지 않았기에 시간을 거슬러 퍼져 나가, 지팡이가

english: taken from its rightful place, and all who had known of its theft were cursed too. Perhaps there are others also cursed, who played no part in this tale, and were merely unlucky enough to be
translation: 제자리에서 사라진 순간까지 닿았고, 그 도난을 알았던 모든 자가 저주를 받았는지도 모른다. 어쩌면 이 이야기와 아무 상관도 없이, 그저 운 나쁘게

english: in the wrong place at the wrong time...
translation: 엉뚱한 때 엉뚱한 곳에 있었던 탓에 저주받은 자들이 더 있을지도 모르고...

english: I don't know. Things do not always happen for a reason, just as tales do not always end with all of the loose ends neatly tied up and all answers supplied.
translation: 나도 모른다. 모든 일에 이유가 있는 건 아니다. 모든 이야기가 실마리를 깔끔히 매듭짓고 모든 답을 내놓으며 끝나는 게 아니듯 말이다.

english: I have simply told you the events I was witness to, for I can do no more.
translation: 나는 그저 내가 목격한 일을 들려주었을 뿐이다. 그 이상은 할 수 없느니라.

english: You have cheered me no end to let me know that this curse that has afflicted me has not left me alone here, in this void between worlds.
translation: 이 저주가 나만 이 세계와 세계 사이의 공허에 홀로 남겨 둔 게 아니라는 걸 알려 주어서, 네 덕에 기분이 한없이 좋구나.

english: Perhaps I will hunt down these others who have also been cursed as I was, but I feel I must reward you for your efforts; Here, take my cloak, it is drenched in the blood of a
translation: 어쩌면 나처럼 저주받은 그 자들을 찾아 나설지도 모르겠다. 하지만 네 수고에 보답을 해야겠지. 자, 내 망토를 받거라.

english: thousand foes, and may bring you luck in battle.
translation: 천의 적이 흘린 피에 흠뻑 젖은 것이니, 전투에서 네게 행운을 가져다줄 게다.

english: So how can I break this curse?
translation: 그럼 이 저주는 어떻게 풀 수 있어요?

english: Who knows? If it was the death curse of the Empty Lord, there may be no way to break it.
translation: 누가 알겠느냐? 그것이 Empty Lord(공허의 군주)의 죽음의 저주라면, 풀 방법이 없을지도 모른다.

english: If it was not his death curse, and he is still alive but not on this world, then the only way to break it may be to bring him back here;
translation: 죽음의 저주가 아니고 그가 아직 살아 있으되 이 세상에 없는 것이라면, 저주를 풀 유일한 방법은 그를 이곳에 다시 데려오는 것일지도 모르지.

english: But I would rather stay cursed than suffer under his rule again...
translation: 하지만 그의 통치 아래서 또다시 고통받느니 차라리 저주받은 채로 있겠다...

english: But WHO was this 'Empty Lord'? WHAT was his NAME?
translation: 그런데 그 '공허의 군주'가 대체 누구였냐고요? 그 이름이 뭐였냐고요?

english: You do not know? You have not guessed yet?
He was Zaros.
Well, that's all fascinating, but I just don't particularly care. Bye-bye.
translation: 음, 다 흥미롭긴 한데 딱히 관심은 없네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hello.
Hello yourself.
I really liked your little story. Can you tell me another one?
translation: 당신이 해 준 이야기 정말 좋았어요. 다른 이야기도 해 줄 수 있어요?

english: Preferably something with a big fight and lots of explosions!
translation: 되도록이면 큰 싸움이랑 폭발이 잔뜩 나오는 걸로요!

english: ...You are a very strange young [man/woman].
Could I have more of those ghostly robes you gave me?
translation: 주셨던 그 유령 로브를 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: It seems as though the curse that keeps me here extends to my very clothing... which piece do you want?
translation: 나를 이곳에 묶어 둔 저주가 내 옷에까지 미치는 모양이구나... 어느 것을 원하느냐?

english: Here you go.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: 이봐라, 줄 것이 있는데 네 소지품에 자리가 없구나!

english: Tell me your story
Goodbye then
Talk about Viggora's story.
Ask for more ghostly robes.
What do you want, human?
Ehm, anything on offer?
Can you wield a warhammer? If not, then go away.
translation: 전투 망치를 휘두를 줄 아나? 모르면 꺼져.

english: Of course I can.
I can, but I won't.
Yeah, right.
That furnace is the property of the Red Axe! Hands off!
translation: 그 용광로는 Red Axe(레드 액스)의 소유다! 손대지 마!

english: That furnace is my property! Hands off!
translation: 그 용광로는 내 거다! 손대지 마!

english: Didn't all this belong to the Red Axe? And weren't you a member?
translation: 여기 전부 Red Axe(레드 액스) 것 아니었어요? 그리고 당신도 거기 일원 아니었어요?

english: I don't know what you're talking about.
Who do you think are, coming in here and using the property of the Red Axe!
translation: 네가 뭔데 여기 들어와서 Red Axe(레드 액스)의 물건을 쓰는 거야!

english: Who do you think are, coming in here and using my property?
translation: 네가 뭔데 여기 들어와서 내 물건을 쓰는 거야?

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to the Red Axe, not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 손대지 마! 그 벽난로는 Red Axe(레드 액스)의 것이다. 보잘것없는 건방진 인간 따위의 것이 아니라고!

english: Hands off! That fireplace belongs to me! Not some puny arrogant human!
translation: 손대지 마! 그 벽난로는 내 거다! 보잘것없는 건방진 인간 따위의 것이 아니라고!

english: Who gave you permission to use that?
Of course I can.
I can, but I won't.
I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. It will cost [amount] coins. Is that okay?
translation: Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)까지 수레를 태워 드리고 있어요, 관심 있으시면요. 요금은 [amount]코인이에요. 괜찮으세요?

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.

You hop into the cart and the driver urges the horses on. You take a taxing journey through the jungle to Brimhaven. You feel tired from the journey, but at least you didn't have to walk all that distance.
translation: 수레에 올라타자 마부가 말을 몬다. 정글을 지나 Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)까지 고된 여정을 거친다. 여정으로 피곤하지만, 적어도 그 먼 거리를 걷지 않아도 됐다.

english: Sorry, but it looks as if you don't have enough money. Come and see me when you have enough for the ride.
translation: 죄송하지만 돈이 모자라신 것 같네요. 요금만큼 모이면 다시 찾아오세요.

english: No thanks.
Okay, Bwana, let me know if you change your mind.
I am offering a cart ride to Brimhaven, if you're interested. For you, it's free.
translation: Brimhaven(브림헤이븐)까지 수레를 태워 드리고 있어요, 관심 있으시면요. 손님은 무료예요.

english: Sorry, I'm busy. I've got to get out of here! This place is swarming with zombies.
translation: 죄송해요, 지금 바빠요. 여기서 빠져나가야 해요! 여긴 좀비가 득실거린다고요.

english: Yes please, I'd like to go to Brimhaven.
No thanks.
Hello, how's it going?
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
All these newcomers - what are they up to?
translation: 새로 온 사람들이 왜 이렇게 많은지 - 다들 뭘 꾸미는 거죠?

english: What are you talking about?
Argh! Another one! No, I don't want to help with your scheme! I'm very busy!
translation: 으악! 또 한 명! 싫어요, 당신 계획 따윈 안 도울 거예요! 난 엄청 바쁘다고요!

english: Ohhh kaaay... I'll leave you to it then.
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well, thank you.
Do you wish to trade?
No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: 아뇨, 처분하고 싶은 물건은 없어요. 거래를 하고 싶으시면 주변에 상점이랑 시장 노점이 많이 있어요.

english: Argh! Don't rob me!
Sorry, I thought you were a bandit.
There are a lot of them around here...
None of your business.
Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
Not too bad, thanks.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
The desert just outside of town is full of wolves, snakes, and even wild Ugthanki. Try there.
translation: 마을 바로 밖 사막에 늑대랑 뱀, 심지어 야생 Ugthanki(우그탄키)까지 득실거려요. 거기 가 보세요.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
I'm sorry, I can't help you there.
How can I help you?
Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
I'm very well thank you.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a most noble profession.
Do you wish to trade?
I'm in search of a quest.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
Nilsal, friend. How goes it?
Do you need any help in the vineyards?
Well we could always use a spare pair of hands!
Here, fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 자, 이 통에 잘 익은 포도 네 묶음을 채워서 가져오게.

english: Got it! One barrel full of grapes coming right up.
translation: 알겠어요! 포도 가득 찬 통 하나, 금방 대령할게요.

english: Just remember, I need them to be ripe. Generally, perfectly ripe grapes are full and vibrant. They'll shine in the sunlight more than others.
translation: 꼭 기억하게, 잘 익은 걸로 따야 하네. 보통 완벽하게 익은 포도는 알이 꽉 차고 색이 선명하지. 다른 것보다 햇빛에 더 반짝일 걸세.

english: Hopefully you know what you’re doing now. Just fill this barrel with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 이제 어떻게 하는지 알겠지? 이 통에 잘 익은 포도 네 묶음을 채워서 가져오기만 하면 되네.

english: We could always use a spare pair of hands! I have a grape barrel here for you, but you don't have enough room for it at the moment. Come back once you can carry it.
translation: 일손은 늘 모자라지! 자네 몫으로 grape barrel(포도 통)을 준비해 뒀는데, 지금은 자네가 들 자리가 없군. 들 수 있을 때 다시 오게.

english: You've already got that grape barrel I gave you. Fill it with four sets of ripe grapes and bring it back to me.
translation: 내가 준 grape barrel(포도 통)은 이미 갖고 있잖나. 잘 익은 포도 네 묶음을 채워서 가져오게.

english: Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 하루 종일 밖에 서 있으면 덥지 않으세요?

english: Ah, you get used to it. Besides, I have a near-infinite supply of lukewarm grape juice to keep me hydrated!
translation: 아, 금방 익숙해지네. 게다가 수분을 채워 줄 미지근한 포도 주스가 거의 무한정 있거든!

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
One barrel o' grapes here for you, boss!
Great work! Here, keep some grapes as payment.
translation: 수고했네! 자, 품삯으로 포도를 좀 가져가게.

english: Can I have some gold instead?
No.
Oh...
Now, if you're up for it, I wouldn't say no to you filling the barrel up again.
translation: 자, 할 마음이 있다면 그 통을 다시 채워 와도 마다하지 않겠네.

english: Do you need any help in the vineyards?
Doesn't it get hot standing out here all day?
translation: 하루 종일 밖에 서 있으면 덥지 않으세요?

english: I'm good. I'll be going now.
Hello there. How's it going?
Lovely day for some wine!
I wish these grapes could pick themselves.
translation: 포도가 알아서 바구니로 들어가 주면 좋을 텐데요.

english: The grapes are in good shape for this harvest.
I'm sorry, but the vineyards need tending to.
Have you tried the wine? You won't regret it if you do!
translation: 와인 마셔 봤어요? 마셔 보면 후회 안 할 거예요!

english: Nilsal. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 10 coins for each banknote.
translation: Nilsal(닐살). 은행 지폐를 바꿔 드릴까요? 지폐 한 장당 10코인만 받아요.

english: Yes please.
Then hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
translation: 그럼 바꾸고 싶은 지폐를 저에게 주세요.

english: Who are you?
I am Virilis. I can exchange banknotes of bones for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
translation: 저는 Virilis(비릴리스)예요. 뼈 지폐를 실제 물품으로 바꿔 드리고 있어요. 바꿀 지폐 있으세요?

english: What can I do here?
I'm glad you've asked! Next to me is an old altar of Ralos, upon which you can ask for bones and wines to be blessed.
translation: 물어봐 주셔서 기뻐요! 제 옆에 오래된 Ralos(랄로스)의 제단이 있는데, 거기서 뼈와 포도주에 축복을 내려 달라고 빌 수 있어요.

english: You should beware though, Ralos won't hear your prayers if you aren't experienced enough. I wouldn't want you to get caught in the cold just waiting for nothing to happen.
translation: 그래도 조심하세요. 경험이 부족하면 랄로스께서 기도를 들어 주지 않으시거든요. 아무 일도 일어나지 않는 걸 하염없이 기다리며 추위에 떠시는 건 저도 바라지 않아요.

english: Anyway, once you've had Ralos' blessing, you can break the bones down into shards. Then, along with your blessed wine, you can take them to the libation bowl and sacrifice them in Ralos' honour!
translation: 아무튼 랄로스의 축복을 받고 나면 뼈를 부숴 파편으로 만들 수 있어요. 그다음 축복받은 포도주와 함께 libation bowl(헌주 그릇)으로 가져가서 랄로스께 바치면 돼요!

english: Libation bowl?
Yes! You'll find it inside the Teomat, near the library.
translation: 네! Teomat(테오맛) 안, 도서관 근처에 있어요.

english: I see. And what happens if I drink the blessed wine?
translation: 그렇군요. 그런데 축복받은 포도주를 마시면 어떻게 되나요?

english: The last person to try that ended up in the libation bowl. I do not recommend it.
translation: 마지막으로 그걸 시도한 사람은 결국 헌주 그릇 안에 들어가게 됐죠. 권하지 않아요.

english: Anyway, do you want any banknotes converted?
No thanks.
I'm afraid I can only exchange bank notes for real items.
translation: 죄송하지만 은행 지폐만 실제 물품으로 바꿔 드릴 수 있어요.

english: I only exchange bones that you can bless at Ralos' altar.
translation: Ralos(랄로스)의 제단에서 축복받을 수 있는 뼈만 바꿔 드려요.

english: I require 10 coins for exchanging each banknote.
translation: 지폐 한 장을 바꿀 때마다 10코인이 필요해요.

english: Your inventory is too full.
Yes please.
Who are you?
What can I do here?
No thanks.
I don't want whatever it is you're selling.
translation: 네가 뭘 팔든 난 필요 없어.

english: But I'm not selling anything.
You think I believe that? Why else would you be here?
translation: 내가 그 말을 믿을 것 같아? 그게 아니면 여기 왜 왔는데?

english: Just seeing the sights?
What sights? What's wrong with you.
translation: 구경할 게 어디 있다고? 너 어디 이상한 거 아냐?

english: Nothing...
Get out, you weirdo!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: What is it, human? Speak and begone, your presence disgusts me!
translation: 무슨 일이냐, 인간? 할 말이 있으면 하고 꺼져라. 네놈이 있는 것만으로도 역겹구나!

english: Oh, uh, I'm sorry.
Stop your muttering and get to the point!
W-Who are you?
I am the Voice of Yama.
Yama?
Yama is my master, a powerful demon of fire.
translation: Yama(야마)는 나의 주인, 강대한 불의 악마시다.

english: Why can't Yama speak for themself?
translation: 야마는 왜 직접 말하지 못하는 거죠?

english: Currently my master resides below us, building strength. Worry not, human, my master will eventually own your soul too.
translation: 지금 나의 주인께서는 우리 발밑에 머무르며 힘을 키우고 계신다. 걱정 마라, 인간. 언젠가 주인께서 네놈의 영혼도 손에 넣으실 테니.

english: I'll be leaving now.
I suspect you should.
You must complete A Kingdom Divided to access Yama's domain.
translation: Yama's domain(야마의 영역)에 들어가려면 A Kingdom Divided(분열된 왕국) 퀘스트를 완료해야 합니다.

english: The arrogant human finally arrives...
Upset that I disrupted your plans?
Disgusting. My master, the great demon Yama, wishes to speak with you.
translation: 역겹군. 나의 주인, 위대한 악마 Yama(야마)께서 너와 이야기하길 원하신다.

english: Yama wants to speak with me? How do you know that? You shouldn't even be able to talk to him.
translation: 야마가 저와 이야기하고 싶다고요? 그걸 어떻게 알죠? 당신은 그와 말도 못 나눠야 정상인데요.

english: My master wishes to have the satisfaction of explaining that to you himself. For this, I envy him. I will make do with the idiotic expression you wear presently.
translation: 그건 주인께서 직접 설명하는 즐거움을 누리고자 하신다. 그 점은 주인이 부럽군. 나는 지금 네놈이 짓고 있는 그 멍청한 표정으로 만족하마.

english: I planted the device! Your connection should be severed!
translation: 장치를 설치했다고요! 당신들의 연결은 끊어졌어야 해요!

english: Silence, human! You will make no demands of me. Proceed to my master's domain and speak with him yourself if you desire an answer.
translation: 닥쳐라, 인간! 감히 나에게 요구하지 마라. 답을 원한다면 주인님의 영역으로 가서 직접 여쭈어라.

english: Player is transported to Yama's Domain.
You enter Yama's Domain.
I think I'd rather stay here.
Weakness! Cowardice! Disgusting. Begone, human!
Proceed or begone, human. I will not bear your foul presence any longer than is necessary.
translation: 나아가든지 꺼지든지 해라, 인간. 네놈의 더러운 존재를 필요 이상으로 견딜 생각은 없다.

english: Enter Yama's domain.
Stay.
The purple, western portal shield is down!
The blue, eastern portal shield is down!
The yellow, south-eastern portal shield is down!
The red, south-western portal shield is down!
Sorry, outlander, but I have things to be doing.
translation: 미안해요, 외지인. 할 일이 좀 있어서요.

english: Hello there. Enjoying the view?
Yes I am. You have a lovely yurt.
Thanks! I exercise it regularly.
Hello again! Does my father send any word...or treasures like before?
translation: 또 만났네요! 아버지께서 무슨 소식이라도...아니면 전처럼 보물이라도 보내셨나요?

english: Not today, but if he does, you will be the first to know.
translation: 오늘은 없어요. 하지만 보내시면 제일 먼저 알려 드릴게요.

english: Volf? Son of Olaf Hradson?
Yes. Do I know you?
No, but I do know your father. He sent me with a present for you from, err...
translation: 아뇨, 하지만 아버님은 알아요. 아버님께서 당신에게 줄 선물을 들려 보내셨어요. 어, 그러니까...

english: From the Island of Obscurity.
Oh! That was fast! He only set off recently, and I was wondering how he was doing. So, where is this gift?
translation: 오! 빠르네요! 떠나신 지 얼마 안 돼서 어떻게 지내시나 궁금하던 참이었어요. 그래서, 그 선물은 어디 있죠?

english: Right here. Enjoy!
What is it?
Very valuable. Have a nice time!
translation: 아주 값진 거예요. 좋은 시간 보내세요!

english: Wait! Here, take this. I was going to have it for my lunch, but I suppose you can have it in payment.
translation: 잠깐만요! 이거 받으세요. 점심으로 먹으려던 건데, 보답으로 드릴게요.

english: Thanks! Enjoy your new...thing!
translation: 고마워요! 새로 받은... 그 물건 잘 즐기세요!

english: Hey! I'm [Vampyre name]. What's your name?
translation: 안녕하세요! 저는 [Vampyre name](이)라고 해요. 이름이 뭐예요?

english: Von van Von.
I'm sorry... What?
Did I stutter? My name is Von van Von.
translation: 내가 말을 더듬었냐? 내 이름은 폰 반 폰이라고.

english: Your name is Von van Von?
Yes.
Sorry, just to clarify. Von van Von? That's your name?
translation: 죄송한데, 확인차 묻는 거예요. 폰 반 폰? 그게 이름이라고요?

english: Yes! Is there a problem?
Well... I guess not.
Good! Now leave me alone!
translation: 좋아! 그럼 이제 날 좀 내버려 둬!

english: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Get out of my house!
But I...
But nothing! Get out!
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Hey Vorki, got any interesting dragon facts?
translation: Vorki(보르키), 재미있는 드래곤 상식 좀 있어?

english: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground dwelling.
translation: 드래곤은 날개가 있지만 좀처럼 날지 않아. 드래곤이 잡아먹는 동물들이 전부 땅에 살기 때문이야.

english: Unlike their creators, dragons have the ability to reproduce. Like most reptiles, they are oviparous. This means that they lay eggs rather than birthing live young.
translation: 드래곤은 자기를 만든 창조주와 달리 번식할 수 있어. 대부분의 파충류처럼 난생이지. 새끼를 낳는 게 아니라 알을 낳는다는 뜻이야.

english: Dragons have a very long lifespan and can live for thousands of years. With a lifespan that long, most dragons die to combat instead of age.
translation: 드래곤은 수명이 아주 길어서 수천 년을 살 수도 있어. 수명이 그렇게 길다 보니 대부분의 드래곤은 늙어서가 아니라 싸우다 죽지.

english: While very closely related, dragons and wyverns are actually different species. You can easily tell the difference between them by counting the number of legs, dragons have four while wyverns have two.
translation: 드래곤과 wyvern(와이번)은 아주 가까운 사이지만 사실 다른 종이야. 다리 개수를 세어 보면 쉽게 구별할 수 있어. 드래곤은 넷, 와이번은 둘이야.

english: Metallic dragons were created by inserting molten metal into the eggs of other dragons. Very few eggs survived this process.
translation: 금속 드래곤은 다른 드래곤의 알에 녹인 금속을 주입해서 만들어졌어. 이 과정을 버텨 낸 알은 아주 적었지.

english: The dragonkin created dragons by fusing their own lifeblood with that of a lizard. The dragonkin created other species in similar ways by using different types of reptile.
translation: dragonkin(드래곤킨)은 자기들의 생명의 피를 도마뱀의 피와 융합해서 드래곤을 만들었어. 다른 종류의 파충류를 써서 비슷한 방식으로 다른 종족도 만들어 냈지.

english: Dragons have the ability to speak. However, most dragons don't have the brain capacity to do it very well.
translation: 드래곤은 말을 할 수 있어. 하지만 대부분의 드래곤은 말을 잘할 만큼 머리가 좋지 않아.

english: Dragons share their name with dragon equipment, which was also created by the dragonkin. This equipment is fashioned out of Orikalkum.
translation: 드래곤은 dragon(드래곤) 장비와 이름이 같은데, 그 장비도 dragonkin(드래곤킨)이 만든 거야. 이 장비는 Orikalkum(오리칼쿰)으로 만들어져.

english: Although very aggressive, dragons do not typically stray from their own territory. They instead make their homes in places where there is plenty of prey to be found.
translation: 드래곤은 아주 공격적이지만 보통 자기 영역을 벗어나지 않아. 대신 먹잇감이 풍부한 곳에 보금자리를 틀지.

english: Dragons have a duct in their mouth from which they can expel various internally produced fluids. The most common of these is a fluid which ignites when it reacts with air. This is how dragons breathe fire.
translation: 드래곤의 입안에는 몸속에서 만들어 낸 여러 액체를 내뿜는 관이 있어. 가장 흔한 건 공기와 반응하면 불이 붙는 액체야. 드래곤은 이렇게 불을 뿜는 거지.

english: Grrrr!
Bleugh!
Rawrrr!
What are you drinking?
Blood!
How are you getting drunk on blood?
They keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them.
translation: 십일조로 바친 인간 몇 놈을 늘 취한 상태로 두고, 그놈들한테서 뽑아내거든.

english: How very creative.
I know right! Bloody brilliant!
Hello.
I'll have a pint please.
I don't work here.
Sure you do!
No, I really don't.
Well clear off then.
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Hello there. Who are you?
I am Vortas quo Keran. I am an artisan of the Kahlith. Have you come to serve the balance?
translation: 나는 Vortas quo Keran(보르타스 쿠오 케란)이오. Kahlith(칼리스)의 장인이지. 그대는 균형을 섬기러 왔소?

english: Yes.
Then you should speak to Konar quo Maten. She will guide you.
translation: 그렇다면 Konar quo Maten(코나르 쿠오 마텐)과 이야기하시오. 그대를 인도해 줄 것이오.

english: No.
A shame. You are a bringer of death, you could be of great use to the balance.
translation: 안타깝군. 그대는 죽음을 가져오는 자이니, 균형에 크게 쓸모가 있을 텐데.

english: I'm not sure.
Then you should speak with Xorrah quo Sihar. He will show you the way.
translation: 그렇다면 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)와 이야기해 보시오. 그가 길을 보여 줄 것이오.

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not sure.
Humans!
Destroy them! Our king must be freed!
translation: 놈들을 없애라! 우리 왕을 풀어 드려야 한다!

english: It will be done.
With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!
translation: [Fremennik name], 나를 따르라! 이 더러운 짐승들을 처치하자!

english: Hey.
Yes?
What's there to do around here?
Eat, drink and...
Sounds great! I'll be sure to try those things.
Okay...
Hey there.
Hmmm?
What are you doing?
Nothing.
Sounds fun.
It is.
What are you looking at?
You.
Why?
Why not?
I guess. It's a bit weird though.
Many would say the same about drinking blood. What do they know though?
translation: 피를 마시는 것도 이상하다고 하는 사람이 많을걸요. 그래도 그 사람들이 뭘 알겠어요?

english: Well it's their loss.
There's nothing to do in this city. Might be time to give the theatre a visit.
translation: 이 도시엔 할 게 하나도 없어. 극장에나 한번 가 볼까.

english: I hear it's all the rage.
Indeed it is. I'd recommend going yourself if you haven't been before.
translation: 그렇고말고. 아직 안 가 봤으면 너도 꼭 가 봐.

english: I've been a few times. Always worth another trip though. See you around.
translation: 몇 번 가 봤어요. 그래도 또 갈 가치는 늘 있죠. 다음에 봐요.

english: Hey. Anything interesting going on around here?
translation: 저기요. 이 근처에 재밌는 일 없어요?

english: Well rumour is that there's some plans for a new tithing project. Apparently, they're going to put the humans in boxes and drain their blood over time to be collected in batches.
translation: 글쎄, 새 십일조 사업 계획이 있다는 소문이 돌아. 인간들을 상자에 넣어 두고 시간을 두고 피를 뽑아서 한꺼번에 모은대.

english: I hear they're calling it the Tithe Farm.
That sounds... great. Although, I have heard of another Tithe Farm very far from here.
translation: 그거... 멋지네요. 그런데 여기서 아주 먼 곳에도 십일조 농장이 있다고 들었어요.

english: Ah, the one that runs it must also be a vyre of culture.
translation: 아, 거길 운영하는 자도 분명 교양 있는 바이어겠군.

english: Err... Yeah...
Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
translation: 인간! 경비병 부르기 전에 노예 우리로 돌아가!

english: Only the Theatre can free you!
translation: 오직 Theatre(극장)만이 여러분을 자유롭게 할 수 있습니다!

english: Verzik Vitur cordially invites you to the Theatre.
translation: Verzik Vitur(버지크 비투르) 님께서 여러분을 Theatre(극장)으로 정중히 초대하십니다.

english: Welcome, one and all, to the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 여러분 모두, Theatre of Blood(피의 극장)에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

english: Glory awaits those who enter the Theatre!
Prove your worth in the Theatre!
I do enjoy a day out at the Theatre.
Will you be entering the Theatre? It will be fun to watch you die.
translation: Theatre(극장)에 들어갈 거니? 네가 죽는 걸 구경하면 재밌겠구나.

english: Get lost!
Leave me alone food sack!
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬, 이 먹이 자루야!

english: Come to see this show? I bet it's going to be a good one.
translation: 공연 보러 왔니? 분명 멋진 공연이 될 거야.

english: I do enjoy a day out at the Theatre.
Will you be entering the Theatre? It will be fun to watch you die.
translation: Theatre(극장)에 들어갈 건가? 네가 죽는 걸 구경하면 재밌겠군.

english: Get lost!
Leave me alone food sack!
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬, 이 먹이 자루야!

english: Come to see this show? I bet it's going to be a good one.
translation: 공연 보러 왔나? 분명 멋진 공연이 될 거다.

english: Clear off food sack.
Hello?
Get lost, food sack!
Get out of my face, meat sack, I don't 'play' with my food.
translation: 내 눈앞에서 사라져, 고기 자루. 난 음식 가지고 '장난'치지 않거든.

english: Get about your business, meat sack, before I perforate you real good!
translation: 볼일이나 보러 가, 고기 자루. 몸에 구멍을 숭숭 뚫어 주기 전에!

english: Send me to the mines!
Very well...
Sorry.
I want a word with you!
Stand where you are!
Halt! Halt, I say!
Slurp! You look positively delicious - let me help you lose a bit of weight! Either I get a bite or you can go to the mines; which is it to be, meat sack?
translation: 쩝! 정말 맛있어 보이는군. 살 좀 빼게 도와주지! 내가 한 입 물든가 네가 광산으로 가든가. 어느 쪽으로 할 테냐, 고기 자루?

english: Hmm, you look like a tasty specimen - in fact I'm quite peckish right now. You can either go to the mines or give me a bite; what do you say?
translation: 흠, 맛있어 보이는 표본이군. 사실 지금 출출하던 참이야. 광산으로 가든가 한 입 물리든가. 어떡할래?

english: Ooh, a meat sack... I could just do with a snack. What's it to be: some time in the mines or do I get a bite?
translation: 오, 고기 자루로군... 마침 간식이 당기던 참인데. 어느 쪽이냐? 광산에서 한동안 지낼래, 아니면 내가 한 입 물까?

english: Okay, have a bite.
The Vyrewatch bites the player, draining their blood and damaging them.
translation: Vyrewatch(바이어워치)가 플레이어를 물어 피를 빨아들이고 피해를 입힌다.

english: The Vyrewatch teleports the player to the Meiyerditch mine
Hey, look over there!
Ha! I'm not falling for that! Prepare to be tithed...
translation: 하! 그런 수에 넘어갈 줄 알고! 십일조로 바쳐질 준비나 해라...

english: What? What? Where?
The player runs away a short distance while the Vyrewatch is distracted.
translation: Vyrewatch(바이어워치)가 한눈파는 사이 플레이어가 조금 떨어진 곳으로 달아난다.

english: Could you send me to the mines?
You want to go to the mines? Well that's a new one. You asked for it though...
translation: 광산에 가고 싶다고? 그건 처음 듣는 소리군. 그래도 네가 자청한 거다...

english: Let's fight, you evil bloodsucker!
Impressive. Not many of you have the spine for it, these days!
translation: 대단하군. 요즘 너희 중에 그럴 배짱이 있는 놈은 많지 않은데!

english: Hello.
Need something?
Very well.
Nope. I'm good.
Give me your best shot, you evil bloodsucker!
translation: 어디 한번 덤벼 봐라, 이 사악한 흡혈귀야!

english: Could you escort me to the mines?
Yes. I can provide you with a teleport there.
I'm good.
Send me to the mines.
Sorry.
Could you send me to the mines?
Let's fight, you evil bloodsucker!
Nope. I'm good.
Could you escort me to the mines?
I'm good.
What was I talking about, now?
Weren't you going to tell me about the rumour?
translation: 그 소문 얘기 해 주려던 거 아니었어?

english: Oh yeah, that was it!
Carry on.
It's about the new family.
That joined our horde?
The very same!
Oh my! Do tell.
I were hangin' out me washin'.
Yes...
And I looked over at-
I'm listening.
Wait, we're being watched!
We are?
Yes, a person over there.
Where?
No! Don't make eye contact.
Oh my!
They're listening to us.
A goblin folk?
Oh no! It's one of those tall people.
translation: 아니! 그 키 큰 족속 중 하나야.

english: Bizarre creatures for sure.
Makes my skin crawl to see them.
Why?
So tall and neat.
For sure, my dear.
I hope it doesn't come to speak with us.
translation: 우리한테 말 걸러 오지 않았으면 좋겠다.

english: What a horrid thought!
Horrid indeed, my dear.
What should we do?
Let us carry on our conversation.
Let's!
So...
Yes?
Die, foul demon!
Now, what was that incantation again?
[word 1]... [word 2]... [word 3]... [word 4]... [word 5]!
I am the greatest demon slayer EVER!
I probably shouldn't break into a house in full view of a guard.
translation: 경비병이 다 보는 앞에서 집에 침입하는 건 안 하는 게 좋겠어.

english: I definitely wouldn't recommend it.
Is it here? Is it there? Is it elsewhere?
translation: 여기 있나? 저기 있나? 다른 데 있나?

english: Is what where?
This gate's sister...
I didn't know gates had relations.
Oh yes. This one here - she is calm and boring. She stays here all the time. She doesn't like to move, but her sister is fidgety and refuses to stay in the same place for more than half an hour.
translation: 그럼, 있고말고. 여기 있는 이 문은 차분하고 따분해. 늘 여기 가만히 있어. 움직이는 걸 싫어하거든. 그런데 동생은 부산스러워서 한곳에 30분도 붙어 있질 않아.

english: So where is the, errr, fidgety sister at the moment?
translation: 그럼 그, 어, 부산스러운 동생은 지금 어디 있어요?

english: Oh well. I don't know what you humans call these places. Let me show you.
translation: 음, 너희 인간들이 그런 곳을 뭐라고 부르는지 모르겠어. 내가 보여 줄게.

english: Cutscene plays showing the location of the crop circle.
translation: crop circle(미스터리 서클)의 위치를 보여 주는 컷신이 재생된다.

english: Oh she's asleep at the moment. I'm sure she'll go somewhere in the next half an hour though.
translation: 아, 동생은 지금 자고 있어. 그래도 30분 안에는 분명 어딘가로 갈 거야.

english: I cannot show you this gate's sister on this world.
translation: 이 월드에서는 이 문의 자매를 보여 줄 수 없어.

english: Your teleport is blocked as you haven't unlocked access to the [region name] area.
translation: [region name] 지역 접근 권한을 해금하지 않아 순간이동이 막혔습니다.

english: Yes? Do you have business with one of the prisoners?
translation: 무슨 일이십니까? 죄수 중 누구에게 볼일이라도 있으십니까?

english: I don't think so. What are they in for?
translation: 아닌 것 같아요. 저 사람들은 무슨 죄로 들어왔어요?

english: Does it matter? They are criminals.
Are all criminals the same?
They will be if they're found guilty.
What happens if they are?
In most cases, death.
Ah, nice. Bit brutal though, right?
translation: 아, 좋네요. 좀 잔인하긴 하지만요, 그렇죠?

english: Brutal? Yes. Effective? Yes.
Fair enough.
Hello there traveller.
What are you camped here for?
We're looking for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: 우린 Zanaris(자나리스)를 찾고 있... 으악! 아니, 우린 딱히 아무 이유 없이 여기 있는 거야.

english: Who's Zanaris?
Ahahahaha! Zanaris isn't a person! It's a magical hidden city filled with treasures and rich.. uh, nothing. It's nothing.
translation: 아하하하하! 자나리스는 사람이 아니야! 숨겨진 마법의 도시인데, 보물이랑 재... 어, 아무것도 아니야. 아무것도.

english: If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Well, we don't want to tell anyone else about that, because we don't want anyone else sharing in all that glory and treasure.
translation: 글쎄, 그건 다른 누구한테도 말 안 할 거야. 그 영광과 보물을 다른 놈이랑 나눠 갖긴 싫거든.

english: Well, it looks to me like YOU don't know EITHER seeing as you're all just sat around here.
translation: 제가 보기엔 '당신들'도 '모르는' 것 같은데요. 다들 여기 그냥 앉아만 있잖아요.

english: Of course we know! We just haven't found which tree the stupid leprechaun's hiding in yet!
translation: 당연히 알지! 그 멍청한 leprechaun(레프리콘)이 어느 나무에 숨어 있는지 아직 못 찾았을 뿐이야!

english: Leprechaun?
GAH! I didn't mean to tell you that! Look, just forget I said anything okay?
translation: 으악! 그 얘긴 하려던 게 아니었는데! 이봐, 내가 한 말은 그냥 잊어버려, 알았지?

english: So a leprechaun knows where Zanaris is eh?
translation: 그러니까 레프리콘이 자나리스가 어디 있는지 안다는 거죠?

english: Ye.. uh, no. No, not at all. And even if he did - which he doesn't - he DEFINITELY ISN'T hiding in some tree around here. Nope, definitely not. Honestly.
translation: 그.. 어, 아니. 아니, 전혀 아니야. 설령 안다고 해도, 물론 모르지만, 이 근처 나무에 숨어 있는 건 절대로 아니야. 그래, 절대 아니지. 진짜야.

english: Thanks for the help!
Help? What help? I didn't help! Please don't say I did, I'll get in trouble!
translation: 도와? 뭘 도와? 난 안 도왔어! 제발 내가 도왔다고 하지 마, 나 혼난다고!

english: So let me get this straight: I need to search the trees around here for a leprechaun; and then when I find him, he will tell me where this 'Zanaris' is?
translation: 그러니까 정리하면, 이 근처 나무들을 뒤져서 레프리콘을 찾고, 찾으면 그가 '자나리스'가 어디 있는지 알려 준다는 거죠?

english: What? How did you know that? Uh... I mean, no, no you're very wrong. Very wrong, and not right at all, and I definitely didn't tell you about that at all.
translation: 뭐? 그걸 어떻게 알았어? 어... 아니, 아니, 완전히 틀렸어. 아주 틀렸고, 하나도 안 맞고, 난 그런 얘기 너한테 절대 안 했어.

english: Right... Well good luck with it.
There's no such thing!
When we've found Zanaris you'll... GAH! I mean, we're not here for any particular reason at all.
translation: 우리가 자나리스를 찾으면 넌... 으악! 아니, 우린 딱히 아무 이유 없이 여기 있는 거야.

english: What's Zanaris?
I don't think we want other people competing with us to find it. Forget I said anything.
translation: 다른 사람들이랑 경쟁하면서 찾고 싶진 않아. 내가 한 말은 잊어.

english: Oh well. Never mind.
What makes you think it's out here?
Don't you know of the legends that tell of the magical city, hidden in the swam... Uh, no, you're right, we're wasting our time here.
translation: 늪에 숨겨진 마법의 도시에 관한 전설도 모르... 어, 아니, 네 말이 맞아. 우린 여기서 시간 낭비하고 있어.

english: Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: 갈 만한 좋은 모험 아는 거 있어요?

english: Well we're on an adventure right now. Mind you, this is OUR adventure and we don't want to share it - find your own!
translation: 글쎄, 우린 지금 모험 중이야. 하지만 이건 '우리' 모험이고 나눠 줄 생각 없어. 네 모험은 네가 찾아!

english: Please tell me?
No.
Please?
No!
PLEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEASE?
NO!
I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: 좋은 모험 같은 건 하나도 못 찾은 것 같은데요!

english: Hah! Adventurers of our calibre don't just hang around in forests for fun, whelp!
translation: 하! 우리 같은 실력파 모험가들은 재미 삼아 숲에서 빈둥거리지 않아, 애송이야!

english: Oh really?
Have you found anything yet?
We're still searching for Zanaris...GAH! I mean we're not doing anything here at all.
translation: 아직 자나리스를 찾는 중이야... 으악! 아니, 우린 여기서 아무것도 안 하고 있어.

english: I haven't found it yet either.
Hey, thanks for all the information. It REALLY helped me out in finding the lost city of Zanaris and all.
translation: 저기, 정보 줘서 고마워요. 잃어버린 도시 자나리스를 찾는 데 '정말' 큰 도움이 됐어요.

english: Oh please don't say that anymore! If the rest of my party knew I'd helped you they'd probably throw me out and make me walk home by myself!
translation: 아, 제발 그 말 좀 그만해! 내가 너를 도와줬다는 걸 일행이 알면 날 쫓아내서 혼자 걸어서 집에 가게 할 거야!

english: You know.... I think I'll keep that to myself.
So anyway, what have you found out? Where is the fabled Zanaris? Is it all the legends say it is?
translation: 그래서, 뭘 알아냈어? 전설 속의 자나리스는 어디 있지? 전설에서 말하는 그대로야?

english: What are you camped out here for?
Who's Zanaris?
If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Please tell me.
Looks like you don't know either.
Yes.
No
There's no such thing.
What's Zanaris?
What makes you think it's out here?
Oh well. Never mind.
There's no such thing!
Do you know any good adventures I can go on?
translation: 갈 만한 좋은 모험 아는 거 있어요?

english: I don't think you've found a good adventure at all!
translation: 좋은 모험 같은 건 하나도 못 찾은 것 같은데요!

english: Who are you? Are you one of the new guards?
translation: 자네는 누군가? 새로 온 경비병 중 하나인가?

english: No, I'm an adventurer.
Well what are you doing here?
Looking for adventures - what else?
translation: 모험을 찾고 있죠. 달리 뭐가 있겠어요?

english: Oh my, oh my! What does it all matter in the end, anyway?
translation: 아이고, 아이고! 결국엔 다 무슨 소용이란 말인가?

english: What's the matter?
Oh dear, oh dear. Darn and drat!
We try hard to keep this town protected.
translation: 우리는 이 마을을 지키려고 무진 애를 쓰고 있네.

english: But how can we do that when the Watchtower isn't working?
translation: 하지만 Watchtower(감시탑)이 작동하지 않는데 무슨 수로 지키겠나?

english: What do you mean it isn't working?
The Watchtower over here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.
translation: 이 Watchtower(감시탑)은 마법의 힘으로 움직인다네. 오우거를 막으려고 만든 고대 주문인데, 아주 오랜 세월 동안 이 자리를 지켜 왔지.

english: The exact knowledge of the spell is lost to us now, but the essence of the spell has been infused into four powering crystals that keep the tower protected from the hordes in the Feldips.
translation: 그 주문에 대한 정확한 지식은 이제 사라졌지만, 주문의 정수는 네 개의 동력 수정에 깃들어 있다네. 그 수정들이 Feldips(펠딥)의 무리로부터 탑을 지켜 주는 걸세.

english: So how come the spell doesn't work?
translation: 그런데 주문은 왜 안 듣는 거예요?

english: The crystals! The crystals have been taken!
Taken?
Stolen!
Stolen?
Yes, yes! Do I have to repeat myself?
translation: 그래, 그렇다니까! 내가 같은 말을 몇 번이나 해야 하나?

english: Can I be of help?
Help? Oh wonderful, dear traveller!
translation: 도와준다고? 오, 이런 고마울 데가, 여행자 양반!

english: Yes I could do with an extra pair of eyes here.
translation: 그래, 여기서 눈 한 쌍이 더 있으면 좋겠군.

english: There must be some evidence of what has happened here. Perhaps you could assist me in searching for clues?
translation: 여기서 무슨 일이 있었는지 증거가 분명 남아 있을 걸세. 단서 찾는 걸 좀 도와주겠나?

english: I would be happy to.
Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stoies to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.
translation: 주변을 뒤져 보게. 이상한 걸 찾으면 여기로 가져오고. 덤불도 살펴보게나. 모험 이야기를 읽을 만큼 읽어 봐서 아는데, 단서는 늘 덤불에 걸려 있는 법이거든.

english: I will tell the guards to let you past - that way, you can just use the ladder to get in and out.
translation: 경비병들에게 자네를 들여보내라고 일러두겠네. 그러면 사다리로 그냥 드나들 수 있을 걸세.

english: I'm not interested.
That's typical, nowadays. It's left to us wizards to do all the work.
translation: 요즘은 다 그 모양이지. 결국 일은 우리 마법사들이 다 떠맡는다니까.

english: I'm not interested in your rantings.
Hmph! Suit yourself.
You wizards are always complaining.
Complaining? Complaining!
What folks these days don't realise is that if it weren't for us wizards, this entire world would be overrun with every creature you could possibly imagine. And some you couldn't even conceive of!
translation: 요즘 사람들이 모르는 게 있는데, 우리 마법사들이 없었다면 이 세상은 상상할 수 있는 온갖 생물로 뒤덮였을 걸세. 상상조차 못 할 놈들까지 말이야!

english: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
translation: 또 왔군. 쓸 만한 걸 찾았나?

english: No, sorry, nothing yet.
translation: 아뇨, 죄송해요. 아직 아무것도 못 찾았어요.

english: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...
translation: 아이고, 아이고, 분명 어딘가에 뭔가 있을 텐데...

english: Have a look at these...
Interesting, very interesting.
Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...
translation: 기다란 손톱... 회색이고... 잔뜩 씹혀 있어...

english: Of course! They belong to a skavid!
A skavid?
A servent race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!
translation: 오우거를 섬기는 하인 종족일세. 회색에 우울해 보이는 생물인데, 늘 손톱이며 이빨이며 털이 빠진다네!

english: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.
translation: 그놈들은 Feldip Hills(펠딥 언덕)의 동굴에 살지.

english: They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.
translation: 보통은 자기들끼리만 지내는데 말이야. 동굴 밖으로 나오는 건 드문 일일세.

english: What do you suggest I do?
Shall I search the caves?
It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.
translation: 동굴을 뒤져 봐야 소용없네. 적어도 아직은 말이야.

english: Why not?
They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.
translation: 동굴이 깊고 복잡하거든. 지도 같은 게 없으면 길을 찾을 수가 없을 걸세.

english: It may be that the ogres have one...
translation: 어쩌면 오우거들이 하나 갖고 있을지도 모르지...

english: And how do you know that?
Well... I don't.
You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.
translation: 두려움 없이 오우거의 도시 Gu'Tanoth(구타노스)에 들어가서, 동굴 길을 찾는 방법을 알아내야 하네.

english: That sounds scary...
Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.
translation: 그래, 오우거는 고약한 생물이지. 강인한 전사, 그것도 영리한 전사만이 그놈들을 이길 수 있네.

english: What do I need to do to get into the city?
You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.
translation: 경비병들이 자네를 들여보내게 만들 방법이 필요하겠지.

english: You could start by checking out the ogres settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.
translation: 우선 이 근처 오우거 정착지들부터 살펴보게. 부족 오우거들은 이웃을 싫어하는 경우가 많거든... 그동안 이 손톱은 내가 버려 주겠네.

english: (The fingernails are removed from your inventory)
Won't bother? Won't bother!
Perhaps this quest is too hard for you!
translation: 자네한텐 이 퀘스트가 너무 어려운 모양이군!

english: How's it going?
I am having difficulty with the tribes.
Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!
translation: 그들과 얼굴을 마주하고 이야기하되 겁먹은 티를 내지 말게. 푹 쉬고 든든히 먹고, 용감하게 싸우게나!

english: I have everything under control.
Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...
translation: 좋아, 좋아! 그럼 곧 수정을 되찾아 오리라 믿겠네...

english: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about that. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.
translation: 아이고, 저런! 그건 내가 어떻게 해 줄 수가 없네. 미안하지만 그들에게 다시 가 봐야 할 걸세.

english: An ogre called Og gave me this...
Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.
translation: 아, 오래된 오우거 조각상의 일부로군. 내가 받아 두겠네. 고칠 수만 있으면 쓸모가 있을지도 모르지.

english: (Dialogue continues)
An ogre called Grew gave me this...
Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.
translation: 아, 그 오래된 오우거 조각상의 다른 조각이로군. 이것도 받아 두겠네.

english: An ogre called Toban gave me this...
It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.
translation: 유물 조각을 전부 가져온 것 같군. 내 생각대로야. 옛 오우거 전사를 상징하는 조각상일세.

english: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
translation: 오우거와 친구가 되고 싶다면 바로 이 물건이 있어야 하지! 자, 이제 맞춰 보겠네...

english: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?
translation: 아, 전사가 돌아왔군. Gu'Tanoth(구타노스)로 들어갈 길은 찾았나?

english: I can't get past the guards.
Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.
translation: 음, 오우거들은 자기 종족이 아니면 싫어하지. 우정의 증표 같은 게 필요하네. 자네가 친구라고 믿게 속일 만한 것 말일세.

english: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.
translation: 그놈들 지능을 생각하면 그리 어렵진 않을 걸세.

english: I have lost the relic you have me.
Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
translation: 정신이 나갔나? 자네가 지금 가지고 있는 게 다 보이는데!

english: What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.
translation: 뭐라고? 유물을 잃어버렸다고? 이런 덤벙대기는! 내가 도안을 베껴 둬서 다행이로군! 이 복제품을 가져가게. 원본만큼이나 쓸 만하네.

english: The wizard gives you another statue.
I will find my way in, no problem.
Yes, I'm sure you will... Good luck!
translation: 그래, 자네라면 해낼 거라 믿네... 행운을 비네!

english: I have found the cave of ogre shaman, but I cannot touch them!
translation: ogre shaman(오우거 주술사)의 동굴을 찾았는데 그들에게 손을 댈 수가 없어요!

english: That is because of their magical powers. We must fight them with their own methods; do not speak to them! I suggest a potion...
translation: 그들의 마력 때문일세. 그들의 방식으로 맞서 싸워야 하네. 그들에게 말을 걸지 말게! 내가 물약을 하나 권하지...

english: Collect a guam leaf, add jangerberries, then mix in some ground bat bones. You must return it to me before you use it, so that I can empower it with my magic.
translation: guam leaf(구암 잎)을 구하고, jangerberries(쟁거베리)를 넣은 다음, ground bat bones(빻은 박쥐 뼈)를 섞게. 쓰기 전에 반드시 나에게 가져와야 하네. 내 마법으로 힘을 불어넣어야 하거든.

english: Be very careful how you mix it as it is extremely volatile. Mixing ingredients of this type in the wrong order can cause explosions!
translation: 섞을 때 아주 조심하게. 극도로 불안정하거든. 이런 재료는 순서를 잘못 섞으면 폭발할 수도 있네!

english: I hope you've been brushing up Herblore and Magic? I must warn you, only experienced magicians can use the potion. It is too dangerous in the hands of the unskilled.
translation: Herblore(약초학)과 Magic(마법)은 갈고닦아 두었겠지? 미리 경고하는데, 이 물약은 노련한 마법사만 쓸 수 있네. 미숙한 자의 손에 들리면 너무 위험하거든.

english: Any more news?
Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: 물약에 뭐가 필요한지 다시 알려 주시겠어요?

english: Yes indeed, let me see, what was it again...
You will need a guam leaf. That goes into the mix first.
translation: guam leaf(구암 잎)이 필요하네. 그게 제일 먼저 들어가지.

english: What is the next ingredient?
You need some jangerberries.
I have some of those.
Wonderful!
You will need to add those after the guam leaf has gone in, but before the final ingredient.
translation: 구암 잎을 넣은 다음, 마지막 재료를 넣기 전에 그걸 넣어야 하네.

english: What is the final ingredient?
The final ingredient is ground bat bones.
translation: 마지막 재료는 ground bat bones(빻은 박쥐 뼈)일세.

english: Are these ground up well enough?
Yes, those will do nicely.
When you have mixed the potion correctly, then I can empower the potion with magic and the ogre shamans can be destroyed.
translation: 물약을 제대로 섞어 오면 내가 마법으로 힘을 불어넣어 주겠네. 그러면 오우거 주술사들을 물리칠 수 있을 걸세.

english: No, I'm still working on it.
I have made the potion.
That's great news; let me infuse it with magic...
Here it is - a dangerous substance. I must remind you that this potion can only be used if your Magic level is high enough.
translation: 자, 여기 있네. 위험한 물건이지. 다시 말하지만 이 물약은 자네 Magic(마법) 레벨이 충분히 높아야만 쓸 수 있네.

english: How high is high enough?
Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.
translation: 음, Bones to Bananas(본즈 투 바나나스)나 그 이상의 주문을 쓸 수 있다면 괜찮을 걸세.

english: Hello again. Did the potion work?
I am still working to rid us of the shamans...
May you have success in your task.
You'll have to get that magic potion back from wherever you've stored it, I think.
translation: 그 마법 물약을 어디에 보관했든 다시 가져와야 할 것 같군.

english: I have another potion - will you infuse it with magic?
translation: 물약이 하나 더 있는데, 마법을 불어넣어 주시겠어요?

english: Alright, but I'd prefer it if you didn't keep asking me for this.
translation: 알겠네. 하지만 자꾸 이걸 부탁하지는 않았으면 좋겠군.

english: Dialogue continues as the first time the potion was enchanted
translation: 처음 물약에 마법을 걸었을 때와 같은 대화가 이어진다

english: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!
translation: 효과가 있었어요! 그 오우거 주술사들을 싹 쓸어버렸어요!

english: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals!
Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.
translation: 이제 방어막 발전기를 가동할 수 있고, Yanille(야닐)은 다시 오우거의 위협에서 안전해질 걸세.

english: Put the crystals on the pillars there and throw the lever to activate the system.
translation: 수정을 저기 기둥 위에 올려놓고 레버를 당겨 장치를 가동하게.

english: The system is not activated yet. Throw the switch to start it.
translation: 장치가 아직 가동되지 않았네. 스위치를 당겨서 작동시키게.

english: Marvellous! It works! The town will now be safe. Take these coins as a token of my gratitude. Also, let me improve your Magic level.
translation: 굉장하군! 작동하네! 이제 마을은 안전할 걸세. 고마움의 표시로 이 coins(코인)을 받게. 그리고 자네의 Magic(마법) 레벨도 올려 주겠네.

english: I've given you a special scroll too - it's a new spell. Read the scroll and you will be able to teleport yourself here.
translation: 특별한 두루마리도 하나 주었네. 새 주문이 담겨 있지. 그 두루마리를 읽으면 이곳으로 순간이동할 수 있을 걸세.

english: Wizard, look what I have found.
Well done, well done! You are clever; hold onto it until you have all four.
translation: 잘했네, 잘했어! 영리하군. 네 개를 다 모을 때까지 잘 갖고 있게.

english: Keep searching for the others. If you've dropped any, then you will need to go back to where you got it from.
translation: 나머지도 계속 찾아보게. 떨어뜨린 게 있다면 그걸 얻었던 곳으로 다시 가 봐야 할 걸세.

english: Greetings, friend. I trust all is well with you? Yanille is safe at last!
translation: 반갑네, 친구. 별일 없겠지? 드디어 Yanille(야닐)이 안전해졌다네!

english: I lost the scroll you gave me.
I lost the scroll you gave me.
Ho, ho, ho! A comedian to the finish! There it is, in your backpack!
translation: 허허허! 끝까지 농담이로군! 자네 배낭에 있지 않나!

english: Never mind, have another...
That's okay.
We are always in your debt; do come and visit us again.
translation: 우리는 자네에게 늘 신세를 지고 있네. 또 들러 주게나.

english: Do you have any more quests for me?
More quests? No, indeed, adventurer. You have done us a great service, already.
translation: 퀘스트가 더 있냐고? 아니, 없네, 모험가 양반. 자네는 이미 우리에게 큰 도움을 주었네.

english: What's the matter?
So how come the spell doesn't work?
translation: 그런데 주문은 왜 안 듣는 거예요?

english: Yes.
No.
I'm not interested in your rantings.
You wizards are always complaining.
What do you suggest I do?
Shall I search the caves?
So what do I do?
I won't bother then.
I am having difficulty with the tribes.
I have everything under control.
I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
I have lost the relic you have me.
I will find my way in, no problem.
Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: 물약에 뭐가 필요한지 다시 알려 주시겠어요?

english: No, I'm still working on it.
That's okay.
Do you have any more quests for me?
Gratias tibi ago!
Hello there [player name].
Who are you?
I am Watson, the master of clue scrolls. I have lived a long life here in Kourend. The lands are beautiful here.
translation: 전 Watson(왓슨)이에요. clue scroll(단서 두루마리)의 마스터죠. 여기 Kourend(쿠렌드)에서 오랜 세월을 살았어요. 이곳 땅은 참 아름다워요.

english: You're the master are you?
Ha! It is not so much due to my ego, but the fact that I give out master tier clue scrolls.
translation: 하! 제가 잘난 척하느라 그러는 게 아니라, 마스터 등급 단서 두루마리를 나눠 주니까 마스터인 거예요.

english: Interesting. Do you get many treasure hunters here in Kourend?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 여기 Kourend(쿠렌드)엔 보물 사냥꾼이 많이 오나요?

english: I have seen many, but few are good enough. I only give out my clue scrolls to the very best.
translation: 많이 봤지만, 실력이 충분한 사람은 드물어요. 제 단서 두루마리는 최고 실력자에게만 드려요.

english: Ah! I am just the adventurer you are looking for. If you hand me a clue, I'll be on my way.
translation: 아! 제가 바로 당신이 찾던 모험가예요. 단서를 하나 주시면 바로 떠날게요.

english: Not so fast [player name]. I require payment. You must bring me a clue scroll of all lower tiers.
translation: 서두르지 마세요, [player name] 님. 대가가 필요해요. 하위 등급 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나씩 전부 가져오세요.

english: I will remember which ones you have given me though. I expect you'll find that useful.
translation: 그래도 어떤 걸 주셨는지는 기억해 둘게요. 꽤 쓸모 있을 거예요.

english: Have you heard of Sherlock?
Never heard of the bloke. I haven't a clue who he is.
translation: 그런 양반은 들어 본 적도 없어요. 누군지 전혀 단서가 없네요.

english: He also claims to be the master of all clue scrolls.
translation: 그 사람도 자기가 모든 단서 두루마리의 마스터라고 하던데요.

english: As I said, I've never heard of him. If he was such a big deal, I would have heard of him...
translation: 말했잖아요, 들어 본 적 없다고요. 그렇게 대단한 사람이었으면 제가 들어 봤겠죠...

english: Something tells me you're lying! I bet you're just his underling aren't you.
translation: 왠지 거짓말하는 것 같은데요! 분명 그 사람 부하죠?

english: So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: 그래서 마스터 단서 두루마리가 대체 뭔데요?

english: Master clue scrolls are the most challenging of all clue scrolls. They will test you in ways you have not been tested before.
translation: 마스터 단서 두루마리는 모든 단서 두루마리 중에서 가장 어려워요. 지금껏 겪어 보지 못한 방식으로 당신을 시험할 거예요.

english: You will be led all over Gielinor with your strengths, your weaknesses, your mental strength and your reactions all scrutinised.
translation: Gielinor(길리노르) 곳곳을 누비게 될 거고, 당신의 강점과 약점, 정신력과 반응 속도까지 낱낱이 검증받게 될 거예요.

english: I assume there is treasure to be found?
That is for you to find out, [player name].
You need to bring me clue scroll you haven't already given me [player name].
translation: 아직 저한테 주지 않은 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 가져오셔야 해요, [player name] 님.

english: Thank you very much.
I have a master clue scroll for you, but you already have one to complete! Finish it or discard it, I don't care which.
translation: 마스터 단서 두루마리를 드릴 게 있긴 한데, 이미 풀어야 할 게 하나 있잖아요! 끝내든 버리든 하세요. 어느 쪽이든 상관없어요.

english: Nice work [player name], I've had one of each lower tier clue scroll from you.
translation: 잘하셨어요, [player name] 님. 하위 등급 단서 두루마리를 하나씩 다 받았네요.

english: What is that noticeboard for?
It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
translation: 길리노르 곳곳에 지어 둔 S.T.A.S.H 유닛을 확인할 수 있는 거예요.

english: Oh that seems really useful! It's a bit of a shame I need to come here everytime to check though.
translation: 오, 정말 유용하겠네요! 확인하려면 매번 여기까지 와야 한다는 게 좀 아쉽지만요.

english: Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
translation: 뭐, 그냥 메모 몇 장 붙은 판자일 뿐이에요. 방법이야 찾으면 있겠죠.

english: I suppose you're right, I don't suppose you have a spare one I could buy off you to save me the hassle?
translation: 그렇겠네요. 혹시 수고를 덜게 남는 걸 하나 사 갈 수는 없을까요?

english: No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
translation: 남는 건 없지만, 만드는 방법은 적어 드릴 수 있어요. 그러면 서재가 있는 집과 bolt of cloth(옷감 한 필)만 있으면 지을 수 있어요.

english: I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
translation: 공짜로 드릴 순 없어요. 500 coins(코인)도 제 경비만 겨우 충당하는 거라고요!

english: You don't have enough space for it.
Here you go.
Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
translation: 알겠어요, 그럼 계속 제 걸 쓰세요.

english: Goodbye.
You said you didn't know Sherlock!
Sure is windy today, did you hear that?
translation: 오늘 바람이 꽤 부네요. 방금 그 소리 들렸어요?

english: Sorry [player name]. That scroll is for you, not me.
translation: 미안하지만요, [player name] 님. 그 두루마리는 제 게 아니라 당신 거예요.

english: Do you want to trade that in? You'd need another copy to take your scrolls out again. But I'll swap it for some teleport scrolls if you like, so you can travel here more easily.
translation: 그걸 반납하실래요? 두루마리를 다시 꺼내려면 사본이 하나 더 필요할 거예요. 원하시면 순간이동 두루마리 몇 장으로 바꿔 드릴게요. 그러면 여기까지 오기가 더 쉬울 거예요.

english: Watson exchanges your book for [amount] scrolls.
Come again if you change your mind.
Who are you?
Have you heard of Sherlock?
So what are master clue scrolls anyway?
translation: 그래서 마스터 단서 두루마리가 대체 뭔데요?

english: I have something for you.
Hand over easy clue.
Hand over medium clue.
Hand over hard clue.
Hand over elite clue.
Hand over all clues.
What is that noticeboard for?
Goodbye.
Cancel.
Yes
No
Exchange the book for teleport scrolls
Don't exchange the book
Shall we return to Crash Island?
Yes, let's go.
As you wish.
Not yet. I'll be back later.
Yes
No
Hi Waymottin, what are you up to?
Someone has to keep an eye on Bunkwicket!
Well, try to enjoy yourself.
Ha, no chance!
Welcome to Wayne's Chains. Do you wanna buy or sell some chain mail?
translation: Wayne's Chains(웨인의 사슬 갑옷 가게)에 어서 오세요. 사슬 갑옷 사거나 파실래요?

english: No thanks.
Very well done, take this.
You've been given another clue!
You've obtained a casket!
Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello there.
Hello. How are you liking the city?
It's truly spectacular.
I'd recommend the Colosseum. Me and a few associates always wager bets on the contenders.
translation: Colosseum(콜로세움)을 추천해요. 저랑 동료 몇 명은 늘 거기 참가자들한테 내기를 걸거든요.

english: As you can tell, I'm doing quite well winning! Plenty of coin to pass around.
translation: 보시다시피 꽤 짭짤하게 따고 있죠! 나눠 줄 돈이 넘쳐 난답니다.

english: Got any spare for me?
No! We don't care for begging in the city!
translation: 안 돼요! 이 도시에선 구걸 같은 건 용납 안 해요!

english: How am I supposed to get past this?
Gah!
Did that owl statue just move?
translation: 방금 저 owl statue(부엉이 석상) 움직인 거야?

english: I can't wait until I get full graceful, then I can head back to the rooftop courses.
translation: graceful(기품 있는) 세트 다 맞추기만 해 봐라, 그럼 지붕 코스로 돌아갈 거야.

english: I wonder if the Hallowed grapple is worth it?
translation: Hallowed grapple(신성한 갈고리)가 그만한 가치가 있을까?

english: I wish I could trade Hallowed marks in for amylase crystals.
translation: Hallowed mark(신성한 표식)을 amylase crystal(아밀라아제 결정)으로 바꿀 수 있으면 좋겠다.

english: Two pieces dyed, four more to go!
translation: 두 부위 염색 완료, 네 개 남았다!

english: Well, this is definitely more difficult than training on rooftop courses.
translation: 와, 이건 확실히 지붕 코스에서 훈련하는 것보다 어렵네.

english: Greetings, stranger. How can I help you?
What is this place?
It's a cave filled with araxytes, a rare form of arachnid. I've been here researching them for some time.
translation: araxyte(아락사이트)로 가득한 동굴이에요. 희귀한 거미류죠. 꽤 오랫동안 여기서 그것들을 연구하고 있어요.

english: My niece, Nieve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 제 조카 Nieve(니에브)가 그 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 중 하나예요. 아시죠, 사람들한테 뭘 처치하러 가라고 알려 주는 사람들이요. 저는 그런 과제를 받은 사람들을 위해 이 동굴도 관리하고 있어요.

english: My nephew, Steve, is one of those Slayer Masters. You know, they tell people what to go kill. I also look after this cave for people on assignments like that.
translation: 제 조카 Steve(스티브)가 그 Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터) 중 하나예요. 아시죠, 사람들한테 뭘 처치하러 가라고 알려 주는 사람들이요. 저는 그런 과제를 받은 사람들을 위해 이 동굴도 관리하고 있어요.

english: Discovered anything interesting?
Hmm... Not really.
However, the araxytes here are rather venomous... and when I say venomous, I mean venomous.
translation: 그래도 여기 아락사이트들은 독이 꽤 강해요... 독하다고 하면, 정말 지독하게 독하다는 뜻이에요.

english: Is that really noteworthy?
Well, I didn't think so by itself, but lots of other people seem to find it very interesting.
translation: 글쎄요, 저도 그것만으론 대단하다고 생각 안 했는데, 다른 사람들은 꽤 흥미로워하더라고요.

english: For example, there were some particularly pale wanderers doing their own research in here. They didn't bother me though.
translation: 예를 들면, 유난히 창백한 방랑자들이 여기서 자기들 나름대로 조사를 하고 있었어요. 그래도 저를 귀찮게 하진 않았어요.

english: Hmm...
Goodbye.
Bye bye.
I found this Jar, I think it's full of venom.
translation: 이 단지를 찾았는데, 독이 가득 든 것 같아요.

english: Oh wow, can I see it?.
That is really fascinating. Thank you for sharing that with me.
Next I'll need to find something a little more potent to progress my research...
translation: 연구를 진척시키려면 다음엔 좀 더 강력한 걸 찾아야겠어요...

english: I'll keep my eyes open!
Did you want to see the Jar again?
No that's quite alright, I've nothing else to learn from that particular sample. I need to find something else to progress my research...
translation: 아뇨, 괜찮아요. 그 표본에서는 더 배울 게 없어요. 연구를 진척시키려면 다른 걸 찾아야 해요...

english: No problem.
Bad! Don't touch these unless you have a Slayer task to kill them.
translation: 안 돼요! 처치하라는 Slayer(슬레이어) 과제가 없으면 건드리지 마세요.

english: What is this place?
Discovered anything interesting?
Goodbye.
She likes to be tickled hehehehe.
translation: 그 애는 간지럼 태워 주는 걸 좋아해 헤헤헤헤.

english: Okay...
No thanks, I don't want any.
Pst, wanna hear a secret?
Sure!
They've got six legs... SIX!
translation: 그것들은 다리가 여섯 개야... 여섯 개!

english: No thanks.
AAAAAAAAARRRRRRGGGGGHHHHHHHH!
What's wrong?
I'll leave you to it then...
Ah! This is for you.
What?
I need answers.
AHHH HELP! What's the answer?
They like it when you scream! AHHHHHHH. That's not right!
translation: 그것들은 비명을 지르면 좋아해! 으아아아아아. 그게 아니잖아!

english: Spot on!
Sure!
No thanks.
What's wrong?
I'll leave you to it then...
Three stories... Multiple entries... Numerous butlers...
Hello! What're you doing up here?
I'm here on business. I'd suggest you not worry about it. My line of work can be rather... cutthroat.
translation: 일 때문에 왔습니다. 신경 쓰지 않으시는 게 좋을 겁니다. 제 일이 좀... 살벌하거든요.

english: I'm not sure what you're up to, but if it's got anything to do with that villa, then I think someone might've beaten you to it...
translation: 뭘 하시려는 건지는 모르겠지만, 저 별장과 관련된 거라면 누가 선수를 친 것 같은데요...

english: Then it seems I now have a gap in my schedule...
Well you enjoy it!
What a nice man.
I'm just watching and observing. I find that doing so offers plenty of... opportunities.
translation: 그저 지켜보며 관찰하는 중입니다. 그러다 보면 온갖... 기회가 보이거든요.

english: I'm just enjoying the view. I find a place like this good when you want to... elimitatedistractions.
translation: 그저 경치를 즐기는 중입니다. 이런 곳은 좋지요, 거슬리는 것들을... 제거하고 싶을 때 말입니다.

english: What can I interest you in? Need any pipes? I make very sturdy pipes.
translation: 뭐 필요한 거 있어요? 파이프 필요해요? 제가 아주 튼튼한 파이프를 만들거든요.

english: No, not really... what kind of shop is this anyway?
translation: 아뇨, 딱히... 그런데 여긴 무슨 가게예요?

english: Why, it's Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. Wemund, that's me.
translation: 아니, Wemund's Wrench Warehouse(베문드의 렌치 창고)잖아요. Wemund(베문드), 그게 바로 저예요.

english: I don't really sell just wrenches, you know, I sell anything related to the maintenance of dwarven steam machines.
translation: 사실 렌치만 파는 건 아니고요, 드워프 증기 기계 정비에 관련된 건 뭐든 팔아요.

english: Sometimes I do repair work as well. Or I send my assistant.
translation: 가끔 수리 일도 해요. 아니면 제 조수를 보내든가요.

english: Who's he then?
Oh, he's right over there... used to work in the mines to the south, poor lad. Made a bit of a mess of things I believe.
translation: 아, 바로 저기 있어요... 남쪽 광산에서 일하던 친구인데, 불쌍하게도요. 일을 좀 크게 망쳤다나 봐요.

english: So what'll it be then? Got any ship engines to repair?
translation: 그래서 뭘로 하실래요? 수리할 배 엔진이라도 있어요?

english: Thanks, but I don't think your services are required.
translation: 고맙지만 그쪽 도움은 필요 없을 것 같아요.

english: Hey!
What?
What are you doing?
Waiting.
For what?
For you to go away.
Oh... okay.
There's nothing good to drink here.
translation: 여긴 마실 만한 게 하나도 없군.

english: What's wrong with blood?
Blood's only good if there's meat to go with it.
translation: 피는 고기랑 같이 있을 때나 좋은 거야.

english: Why even come here if there's nothing for you to drink?
translation: 마실 것도 없는데 여긴 왜 오셨어요?

english: I'm here on business.
What business?
My business is none of your business. Go poke your nose somewhere else.
translation: 내 볼일은 네가 알 바 아니야. 딴 데 가서 코나 들이밀어.

english: Don't disturb me. I need to guard the tithes.
Why? Where would they even go if they escaped?
Escape? I'm not here to stop them escaping. I'm here to stop them getting stolen.
translation: 도망? 도망치는 걸 막으려는 게 아니야. 도둑맞지 않게 지키는 거지.

english: Oh...
Now take your stupid questions somewhere else. I have a job to do.
translation: 이제 그 멍청한 질문은 딴 데 가서 해. 난 할 일이 있다고.

english: You shouldn't be here, slave. Go back to your master before you get yourself killed.
translation: 여긴 네가 있을 곳이 아니다, 노예. 죽기 전에 네 주인한테 돌아가.

english: Got anything you want me to crush?
Okay, I'd like you to crush something.
Hand it to me, and I'll get to work. I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: 저한테 주시면 바로 작업할게요. 아이템 하나당 50 coins(코인)이에요.

english: What sort of things do you crush?
All kinds of things! Unicorn horns, goat horns, blue dragon scales and much more besides. Hand me your stuff, and I'll try to crush it. I charge 50 coins per item.
translation: 온갖 걸 다요! 유니콘 뿔, 염소 뿔, 블루 드래곤 비늘, 그 밖에도 많아요. 물건을 주시면 빻아 볼게요. 아이템 하나당 50 coins(코인)이에요.

english: Who are you?
I'm Wesley. I used to work on a big ship, exploring the world with my mother, but then I didn't get on very well at the fleet's training school, so I quit all that.
translation: 전 Wesley(웨슬리)예요. 예전엔 큰 배를 타고 어머니랑 세상을 탐험했는데, 함대 훈련 학교에서 잘 적응을 못 해서 다 그만뒀어요.

english: So I moved to Nardah and took up this job crushing stuff instead. It's always been a passion of mine, crushing things. I'm a lot happier now.
translation: 그래서 Nardah(나르다)로 이사 와서 대신 이렇게 빻는 일을 시작했죠. 물건 빻는 건 늘 제 낙이었거든요. 지금이 훨씬 행복해요.

english: The world is so much simpler when you're crushing. You know you just have to grind for long enough until you get the job done. It might take hours, but you just grind until you're done.
translation: 빻고 있으면 세상이 훨씬 단순해져요. 일이 끝날 때까지 꾸준히 갈기만 하면 되거든요. 몇 시간이 걸릴 수도 있지만, 끝날 때까지 그냥 계속 가는 거예요.

english: I'm not interested, thanks.
No, that's not the sort of thing I like crushing.
translation: 아뇨, 그건 제가 빻고 싶은 종류가 아니에요.

english: Sorry, I charge 50 coins per item.
Wesley puts your item[s] in his mortar and crushes it. You pay him [amount] coins.
translation: Wesley(웨슬리)가 당신의 item[s](아이템)을 막자사발에 넣고 빻는다. [amount] coins(코인)을 지불했다.

english: I'm not very good at Herblore, so you'll only get 3 shards from lava scales that I crush. You might get more if you do it yourself.
translation: 제가 Herblore(약초학)은 잘 못해서, 제가 빻은 용암 비늘에서는 조각이 3개만 나와요. 직접 하시면 더 얻으실 수도 있어요.

english: 3 shards per scale is fine.
Forget it - I'll do it myself.
Grind it!
Crush it!
The grind is real!
Griiiiiiind!
Gotta crush 'em all!
Crush crush crush!
Round and round and round we go!
Okay, I'd like you to crush something.
What sort of things do you crush?
Who are you?
I'm not interested, thanks.
3 shards per scale is fine.
Forget it - I'll do it myself.
Hello, what's a little boy like you doing down here?
translation: 안녕, 너 같은 꼬마가 이런 데서 뭐 하니?

english: I ain't no little boy. Me dad, Steve, said I was big enough to take care of these 'ere wyverns, as the pal- palint-palintililiolog- those blokes from the museum are too scared of them.
translation: 나 꼬마 아니거든. 우리 아빠 Steve(스티브)가 나도 이제 다 커서 이 와이번들을 돌볼 수 있다고 했어. 고-고생-고생무리학- 그 박물관 아저씨들은 와이번이 무서워서 벌벌 떨거든.

english: Yeah, whatever. I know how to look after myself, my entire family are slayer guardians or something like that.
translation: 그래, 뭐 어쨌든. 나도 내 앞가림은 할 줄 알아. 우리 집안은 다 슬레이어 수호자인가 뭔가 그런 거야.

english: To guard the wyverns of course.
Guard them? From what?
From people like you who just want to kill 'em.
But... that's what they're for?
They have lives too. They were created for a purpose. But whatever, you can only kill these ones if the Slayer Masters say you can.
translation: 걔네도 생명이 있다고. 다 목적이 있어서 만들어진 거야. 뭐 어쨌든, Slayer Master(슬레이어 마스터)가 허락해야만 얘네를 죽일 수 있어.

english: I'm Weve, son of Steve.
That's... an interesting name.
Well, it's kinda a family tradition you might say. Plus I'm good at looking after wyverns and fast enough to weave between their legs and not get hurt.
translation: 뭐, 집안 전통 같은 거라고 해 둘까. 게다가 난 와이번 돌보는 데 소질이 있고, 다치지 않고 걔네 다리 사이를 위브(weave)하듯 요리조리 누빌 만큼 빠르거든.

english: Ok, bye.
Hey! Leave them alone! My dad Steve will beat you up unless a Slayer Master has given you special permission.
translation: 야! 걔네 건드리지 마! 슬레이어 마스터한테 특별 허락을 받은 게 아니면 우리 아빠 Steve(스티브)가 너 혼내 줄 거야.

english: Calm down, I was just worried.
Why are you here?
Who are you?
Ok, bye.
Hi there, nice to see you! Care for a mug of beer?
translation: 어서 오세요, 반가워요! 맥주 한 잔 어때요?

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment, maybe later.
Well alright then.
Hello!
Can I interest you in a drink?
Not right now, thank you. I was wondering if you might be able to help me with something else.
translation: 지금은 괜찮아요, 고마워요. 그보다 다른 일로 좀 도와주실 수 있을까 해서요.

english: And what would that be?
Do you know the Easter Bunny?
I do! He's just over there. Lovely guy.
translation: 알죠! 바로 저쪽에 있어요. 정말 좋은 친구예요.

english: Does he seem unhappy to you?
translation: 그 친구 좀 우울해 보이지 않아요?

english: Now that you mention it, yes he does.
He was always so cheery, bouncing around like a fuzzy avatar of joy.
translation: 늘 기운이 넘쳐서, 폭신폭신한 기쁨의 화신처럼 깡충깡충 뛰어다녔는데.

english: He's been in a sorry state lately though.
Indeed, I've never seen him like this.
Have you noticed anything odd?
translation: 혹시 이상한 점 눈치채신 거 있어요?

english: Hmm... He used to drink pint after pint of carrot juice! Barely sips the stuff now though, just stares into the glass.
translation: 음... 예전엔 당근 주스를 한 잔 또 한 잔 들이켰거든요! 그런데 요즘은 거의 입도 안 대고 잔만 멍하니 쳐다봐요.

english: He used to LOVE it.
Interesting, could I try the carrot juice please?
translation: 흥미롭네요. 저도 그 당근 주스 좀 마셔 봐도 될까요?

english: Absolutely! One C.J. coming right up!
translation: 물론이죠! 당근 주스 한 잔 대령이요!

english: Euargh! That's...
Good right? I make it myself.
It's definitely an experience, how do you make it?
translation: 확실히 색다른 경험이긴 하네요. 어떻게 만드세요?

english: I put some carrots into a juice press, then add some good old-fashioned elbow grease.
translation: 당근을 juice press(착즙기)에 넣고, 옛날 방식대로 팔 힘을 듬뿍 보태죠.

english: That would explain the flavour.
Do you have any particularly nice carrots we could use to make some special juice just for the Easter Bunny?
translation: Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)만을 위한 특별한 주스를 만들 만한 좋은 당근 없을까요?

english: I think he would perhaps appreciate something different.
translation: 뭔가 색다른 걸 주면 좋아할 것 같아서요.

english: You can ask Weasel in the kitchen, he chooses which carrots get used for juice.
translation: 부엌에 있는 Weasel(위즐)한테 물어보세요. 주스에 쓸 당근은 그 사람이 골라요.

english: Be warned though, he's not much of a people person.
translation: 그런데 미리 말해 두는데, 사람을 그리 좋아하는 편은 아니에요.

english: What do you mean by that?
Oh you'll soon find out! Don't worry though, just tell him I sent you and that you're trying to help the Easter Bunny.
translation: 아, 곧 알게 될 거예요! 그래도 걱정 마세요. 제가 보냈다고, 그리고 Easter Bunny(부활절 토끼)를 도우려는 거라고만 말하면 돼요.

english: He'll give you some fantastic carrots.
Once you have them, you can use the juice press to extract their goodness!
translation: 당근을 받으면 juice press(착즙기)로 그 좋은 성분을 쫙 짜내면 돼요!

english: Alright, I'll be back soon!
Have you been to see Weasel in the kitchen about those nice carrots yet?
translation: 좋은 당근 얻으러 부엌에 있는 Weasel(위즐)한테 가 봤어요?

english: Not yet.
Well there's no need to be scared of him! Fetch some carrots and I'll let you use my juice press.
translation: 그 사람 무서워할 필요 없다니까요! 당근 가져오면 제 juice press(착즙기) 쓰게 해 줄게요.

english: I'm not scared, I just haven't gotten round to it yet.
translation: 무서운 게 아니라 아직 짬이 안 났을 뿐이에요.

english: Whatever you say.
I need more carrots..
Why? What happened?
