english: Walk northwards, past Draynor Manor. When you reach the Barbarian Village, go north-west until you find his Monastery. He'll be downstairs.
translation: 북쪽으로 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택)을 지나 걸어가게. Barbarian Village(야만인 마을)에 닿으면 북서쪽으로 가서 그의 Monastery(수도원)을 찾게. 그는 아래층에 있을 걸세.

english: I'd like to get a note up to the Oracle on Ice Mountain.
translation: Ice Mountain(얼음 산)의 Oracle(예언자)에게 쪽지를 전하고 싶네.

english: Walk northwards, past Draynor Manor. When you reach the Barbarian Village, go north-west until you see the Ice Mountain. It'll be at the top.
translation: 북쪽으로 Draynor Manor(드레이너 저택)을 지나 걸어가게. Barbarian Village(야만인 마을)에 닿으면 Ice Mountain(얼음 산)이 보일 때까지 북서쪽으로 가게. 예언자는 꼭대기에 있을 걸세.

english: Yes, you're meant to be delivering it for me!
translation: 그래, 그건 자네가 나 대신 전해 줘야 하는 걸세!

english: I asked you to deliver that for me. But I may as well take it back now.
translation: 그건 전해 달라고 부탁한 걸세. 하지만 이제 그냥 돌려받는 게 낫겠군.

english: You seem to have mislaid my letter, so here's another copy.
translation: 내 편지를 잃어버린 모양이군. 여기 한 부 더 있네.

english: Ah! Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me.
Please enter the answer to the question.
How can that be? Try again!
translation: 어찌 그럴 수가? 다시 해 보게!

english: Spot on!
Could I have some free stuff, please?
translation: 공짜로 뭐 좀 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Ok, what do you want me to do?
Thanks, maybe some other time.
I'd just like to ask you something.
Could you check my items for junk, please?
translation: 제 물건 중에 잡동사니가 있는지 봐 주시겠어요?

english: Can I get another hood for my Quest Point Cape?
translation: Quest Point Cape(퀘스트 포인트 망토)의 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can I buy a Quest Point Cape, please?
translation: Quest Point Cape(퀘스트 포인트 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

Actually, no thanks.

english: Swamp paste
Headless arrows
Bronze spear
Beer glass
Bones
Unfired pie dish
translation: Unfired pie dish(굽지 않은 파이 접시)

english: Raw rat meat
Copper ore
Pot of flour
Feather
Logs
Cooked chicken
Leather boots
Cowhide
Bow string
Cooked meat
Bronze arrows
Grain
Right, I'll see you later.
Tin ore
Cooked anchovies/cooked shrimps
Rune essence
Molten glass
Emeralds
Diamonds
Rubies
Sapphires
Red topaz
Father Aereck
High Priest (Entrana)
Reldo
Thurgo
Father Lawrence
Abbot Langley
Oracle
I don't trust shadows.
They act pretty shady...
Wow.
You can trust me, [player name].
Now, come closer... I have something to tell you...
translation: 자, 더 가까이 와... 해 줄 말이 있어...

english: Wisp starts to whisper into your ear...
Woah, woah, woah! None of that! I know what your whispers are capable of.
translation: 워워워! 그건 안 돼! 네 속삭임이 무슨 짓을 할 수 있는지 다 알거든.

english: Can you sing me a song?
If I were to do that, your mind would perish.
translation: 그랬다간 네 정신이 소멸하고 말 거야.

english: Maybe I can sing you a song instead?
I'd rather you d-
Ehem...
Let my voice lead you this waaay!
I will not lead you astraaay!
Please... No more.
Suit yourself. I'd make a great siren.
translation: 마음대로 해. 난 훌륭한 세이렌이 될 텐데.

english: Mmmhmm.
Hows it going, Wisp?
There is too much light here. It's awful.
I love it!
I miss the shadows.
The darkness here is comforting.
It is, isn't it.
One day I will return to the shadows.
Will you now...?
I can feel the power of the shadows. You shall be my servant soon enough.
translation: 그림자의 힘이 느껴져. 머지않아 넌 내 하인이 될 거야.

english: Well... that's dark.
Hi!
Welcome to Burthorpe Supplies. Your last shop before heading north into the mountains!
translation: Burthorpe Supplies(버소프 보급품)에 오신 걸 환영해요. 북쪽 산으로 떠나기 전 마지막 상점이랍니다!

english: Would you like to buy something?
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Yes, please.
No, thanks.
Hello deary. Don't worry, I'm friendly.
translation: 안녕, 얘야. 걱정 마렴, 난 해치지 않는단다.

english: You look very familiar but I can't remember chatting to you before.
translation: 무척 낯이 익으신데, 전에 얘기를 나눈 기억은 없네요.

english: Well, my sisters used to live here but folk kept on killing them. A terrible affair, it was. I knew that no one would want to kill a chatty old dear like me, though.
translation: 글쎄, 내 자매들이 여기 살았는데 사람들이 자꾸 죽여 대지 뭐냐. 참 끔찍한 일이었지. 그래도 나처럼 수다스러운 할멈을 죽이고 싶어 할 사람은 없을 거라고 생각했단다.

english: Oh, well...
We still have a problem with local louts, though. Poisoning my fish, spilling my compost all over the place and causing a nuisance for the dear count.
translation: 그래도 동네 불량배들 때문에 골치란다. 내 물고기에 독을 타고, 퇴비를 사방에 흩뿌리고, 우리 백작님께 폐를 끼치지 뭐냐.

english: I think...
I'm sure a nice young sort like you won't be any trouble, though. In any case, the Professor will soon share the secret of chickenisation with me... Not that I'd use it these days of course.
translation: 그래도 너처럼 착한 젊은이는 말썽을 안 부리겠지. 어쨌든 곧 Professor(교수)가 닭으로 바꾸는 비법을 알려 줄 거란다... 물론 요즘 같아선 그걸 쓸 생각은 없지만.

english: I have to go now.
Hello my ickle...oh, it's you. What do you want?
translation: 안녕, 우리 꼬맹... 아, 너로구나. 무슨 볼일이냐?

english: I wondered whether you had anything interesting to say.
Clearly not.
Great, you'll go far! I made some nice painted metal toys for you, snookums.
translation: 잘했다, 넌 크게 될 거야! 널 위해 예쁘게 칠한 금속 장난감을 만들었단다, 우리 아가.

english: Toys? Snookums? What are you on about, you deranged old bat?
translation: 장난감? 아가? 무슨 헛소리예요, 이 정신 나간 할망구야?

english: Oh, forget it, then. If you won't react to kindness, I'm back to luring infants into my oven. You'll have it on your conscience.
translation: 아, 그럼 됐다. 친절하게 대해 줘도 반응이 없으니, 난 다시 아기들을 꾀어 오븐에 넣어야겠구나. 그건 네 양심에 남을 거다.

english: Go to the iron mine just north-east of Rimmington and hit the bar with a plain old smithing hammer while facing north. Then take your new magnet to Ava. Poor girl, having to deal with whippersnappers like you.
translation: Rimmington(림밍턴) 바로 북동쪽 철광산에 가서, 북쪽을 바라보고 평범한 대장장이 망치로 철 주괴를 두드리렴. 그런 다음 새로 생긴 magnet(자석)을 Ava(에이바)에게 가져가거라. 가엾은 것, 너 같은 애송이를 상대해야 하다니.

english: Miaoww
Sssss! Thou art brave to wander so far into the domain of Kardia, mine mistress!
translation: 쉬이익! 내 주인 Kardia(카르디아)의 영역에 이토록 깊이 발을 들이다니, 그대는 용감하도다!

english: But soon thou shalt become a soulless servant of Lord Iban, like all who come here.
translation: 허나 그대도 곧 이곳에 온 모든 자처럼 Lord Iban(이반 군주)의 영혼 없는 하인이 되리라.

english: Glad shall mine heart be when I see thee prostrate thineself before the altars of Zamorak the Mighty.
translation: 그대가 위대한 Zamorak(자모락)의 제단 앞에 엎드리는 것을 보면 내 마음이 기쁘리라.

english: No milk for you, puss!
Hello there.
What have you got to be so cheerful about?
Well, it's another nice day.
Ha! Try worrying about how you feed a family with no job. Then tell me how nice the day is!
translation: 하! 일자리도 없이 식구들 먹여 살릴 걱정이나 해 보시오. 그러고 나서 날씨가 좋다는 소리를 하든가!

english: Okay, I guess I've caught you at a bad time. Goodbye.
translation: 알겠어요, 제가 때를 잘못 맞춘 것 같네요. 안녕히 계세요.

english: Hmm? Oh, hello there.
Are you okay? You seem a bit preoccupied.
translation: 괜찮으세요? 뭔가 다른 데 정신이 팔려 있는 것 같은데요.

english: It's nothing stranger. No need to concern yourself.
translation: 아무것도 아니오, 이방인. 신경 쓸 것 없소.

english: Spare a coin mister?
What do you need it for?
For a poor unemployed fisherman what needs to eat.
translation: 밥은 먹어야 하는 불쌍한 실직 어부한테 쓸 거요.

english: Why don't you just fish for some food?
Err... Goodbye mister.
Can you believe they did this to us?
translation: 그놈들이 우리한테 이런 짓을 했다는 게 믿어지시오?

english: Wha...
I mean, what did they think would happen?
translation: 아니, 대체 무슨 일이 생길 거라고 생각했던 거요?

english: Who...
Building that whacking great Fishing Platform just off the coast.
translation: 해안 바로 앞에 그 무지막지하게 큰 Fishing Platform(낚시 플랫폼)을 지어 놨다고.

english: Fish...
Dratted thing stole all of our trade.
translation: 그 빌어먹을 게 우리 장사를 몽땅 빼앗아 갔소.

english: Excuse...
I'm sorry, I'm too angry to speak right now. Goodbye
translation: 미안하오, 지금은 너무 화가 나서 말을 못 하겠소. 잘 가시오.

english: With our nets and gear we're faring,
On the wild and wasteful ocean,
It's there on the deep that we harvest and reap our bread,
translation: 저 깊은 바다에서 우리의 양식을 거두고 또 거두네,

english: As we hunt the bonny shoals of herring.
That's a lovely song.
Aye lad, and sing it every day we did.
'Till the Fishing Platform came and ruined everything.
translation: Fishing Platform(낚시 플랫폼)이 들어와서 모든 걸 망쳐 놓기 전까지는 말이오.

english: Oh, I'm sorry.
No need lad, it not be your fault.
translation: 그럴 것 없소, 젊은이. 당신 잘못이 아니잖소.

english: Their eyes are staring vacantly into space.
Ye mariners all, as ye pass by,
Come in and drink if you are dry,
Come spend, me lads, your money brisk,
translation: 자, 친구들아, 돈 아끼지 말고 쓰게나,

english: And pop your nose in a jug of this.
translation: 이 술 한 주전자에 코를 박아 보게.

english: You're not fooling anyone you know.
We fooled you easily enough.
Free. She is free...
What?
The mother is free.
You! You did it!
I didn't mean to!
You killed him!
It was an accide... Killed who?
Our Prince, you killed our Prince.
translation: 우리 왕자님, 당신이 우리 왕자님을 죽였잖소.

english: Oh that, yes I did.
Leave us alone.
Soon now... So soon...
The stars are almost right.
For what?
Ahh, our saviour.
Please don't remind me.
Do not worry, soon your regret will be gone.
translation: 걱정 마시오, 곧 그 후회도 사라질 테니.

english: If you think you will get to me...
All in good time.
What are you doing here?
I've heard there is a powerful magic presence in these lands, I'm gathering notes to take back with me to the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 이 땅에 강력한 마법의 기운이 있다고 들었어요. Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑)에 가져갈 기록을 모으고 있답니다.

english: What are you doing?
When we heard of a magical presence in the Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: 서쪽 땅에 마법의 기운이 있다는 소식을 듣고, Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑)에서는 조사단을 보낼 수밖에 없었죠.

english: Learned anything interesting?
Some of these texts describe a 'Dark Altar', one can only imagine what power it possesses.
translation: 여기 문헌 중 몇몇에 'Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)'라는 게 나와요. 얼마나 강한 힘을 지녔을지 상상만 할 수 있을 뿐이죠.

english: The beings here seem to have transcended beyond the corporeal realm, truly fascinating!
translation: 이곳의 존재들은 육신의 영역을 초월한 것 같아요. 정말 놀라워요!

english: A casual game will start in the next [60 - 5x] seconds!
A casual game is starting!
Why are all of you standing around here?
translation: 다들 왜 여기 서 있는 거예요?

english: Hahaha you dare talk to a mighty wizard such as myself? I bet you can't even cast windstrike yet amateur!
translation: 하하하, 감히 나 같은 위대한 마법사에게 말을 걸어? 넌 아직 windstrike(윈드 스트라이크)도 못 쓰지, 풋내기야!

english: ...You're an idiot.
Found that leprechaun yet?
Hahaha go away amateur! You're not worthy of joining our great group!
translation: 하하하, 저리 가라, 풋내기! 넌 우리 위대한 모임에 낄 자격이 없어!

english: ...right.
Hahaha you're such an amateur!
Go away and play with some cabbage amateur!
translation: 저리 가서 양배추나 갖고 놀아라, 풋내기야!

english: All's well that ends well.
I've got some questions about the search for evidence.
translation: 증거 수색에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: You'll have to speak to the Watchtower Wizard about that.
translation: 그건 Watchtower Wizard(감시탑 마법사)에게 물어보셔야 해요.

english: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.
translation: 부족 오우거들에 대해 물어볼 게 있어요.

english: Who are you? Get out of here, I don't have anything for you.
translation: 누구시죠? 여기서 나가세요. 당신한테 드릴 건 아무것도 없어요.

english: You must have completed The Hand in the Sand to use the Guild's shop.
translation: 길드 상점을 이용하려면 The Hand in the Sand(모래 속의 손)을 완료해야 해요.

english: I don't know if I can trust you with any of my supplies...
translation: 당신한테 제 물품을 맡겨도 될지 모르겠네요...

english: Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Magic Guild(마법 길드) 상점에 오신 걸 환영해요. 마법 물품을 좀 사시겠어요?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
Yes please.
No thank you.
Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a Wizard, and an inventor.
translation: 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 Cromperty(크롬퍼티)예요. 마법사이자 발명가죠.

english: There you go, [amount] free pure essence. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 여기 있어요, 무료 pure essence(순수 정수) [amount]개예요. 내일 또 오시면 더 드릴게요.

english: I've already given you your free allowance for today. Come back to me tomorrow for some more.
translation: 오늘 몫의 무료 지급분은 이미 드렸어요. 내일 다시 오시면 더 드릴게요.

english: You must be [player name]. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!
translation: 당신이 [player name] 님이군요. 제 친한 친구 Sedridor(세드리도르)한테서 얘기 들었어요. 마법사이자 발명가로서, 그 친구가 제 위대한 발명을 도와줬답니다!

english: Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
Not when you combine them it isn't! I invent MAGIC things!
translation: 둘을 합치면 하나도 안 힘들어요! 저는 마법 물건을 발명하거든요!

english: Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
Thanks for dropping by! Stop again anytime!
translation: 들러 줘서 고마워요! 언제든 또 오세요!

english: So what have you invented?
Ah! My latest invention is my patent pending teleportation block! It emits a low level magical signal, that will allow me to locate it anywhere in the world, and teleport anything
translation: 아! 제 최신 발명품은 특허 출원 중인 순간이동 블록이에요! 약한 마법 신호를 내보내서, 세상 어디에 있든 위치를 찾아낼 수 있고, 무엇이든

english: directly to it! I hope to revolutionise the entire teleportation system! Don't you think I'm great? Uh, I mean it's great?
translation: 곧장 그리로 순간이동시킬 수 있죠! 순간이동 체계 전체에 혁명을 일으키려고요! 제가 대단하지 않아요? 어, 그러니까 이게 대단하지 않아요?

english: So where is the other block?
Well... Hmm. I would guess somewhere between here and the Wizards' Tower in Misthalin. All I know is that it hasn't got there yet as the wizards there would have contacted me.
translation: 음... 글쎄요. 아마 여기와 Misthalin(미스탈린)의 Wizards' Tower(마법사의 탑) 사이 어딘가에 있을 거예요. 아는 건 아직 거기 도착하지 않았다는 것뿐이에요. 도착했으면 거기 마법사들이 연락했을 테니까요.

english: I'm using the GPDT for delivery. They assured me it would be delivered promptly.
translation: 배송은 GPDT에 맡겼어요. 신속하게 배달해 주겠다고 장담하더라고요.

english: Who are the GPDT?
The Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team. They come very highly recommended. Their motto is: 'We aim to deliver your stuff at some point after you have paid us!'
translation: Gielinor Parcel Delivery Team(길리노르 소포 배달단)이요. 평판이 아주 좋아요. 모토가 '대금을 받은 뒤 언젠가는 물건을 배달하는 것을 목표로 합니다!'래요.

english: Can I be teleported please?
By all means! I'm afraid I can't give you any specifics as to where you will come out however. Presumably wherever the other block is located.
translation: 물론이죠! 다만 어디로 나오게 될지는 자세히 말씀드릴 수가 없네요. 아마 다른 블록이 있는 곳이겠죠.

english: Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!
Okey dokey! Ready?
Hmmm.... that's odd... I can't seem to get a signal...
translation: 흐음.... 이상하네... 신호가 안 잡히는 것 같은데...

english: Oh well, never mind.
That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.
translation: 위험할 것 같은데요. 그냥 여기 있을게요.

english: As you wish.
Well done, that's very clever.
Yes it is isn't it? Forgive me for feeling a little smug, this is a major breakthrough in the field of teleportation!
translation: 그렇죠? 제가 좀 우쭐해도 이해해 주세요. 순간이동 분야에 엄청난 돌파구거든요!

english: Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 주실 수 있어요?

english: Seventior disthine molenko!
Here you go.
Your magical prowess... it is most impressive.
Claim free pure essence.
Chat.
Two jobs? That's got to be tough.
So what have you invented?
Well, I shall leave you to your inventing.
So where is the other block?
Can I be teleported please?
Who are the GPDT?
Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!
That sounds dangerous. Leave me here.
translation: 위험할 것 같은데요. 그냥 여기 있을게요.

english: Well done, that's very clever.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 주실 수 있어요?

english: Welcome to the Magicians' Guild!
translation: Magicians' Guild(마법 길드)에 오신 것을 환영합니다!

english: Hello there.
What can I do for you?
Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
That's fine with me.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 주실 수 있어요?

english: Senventior Disthine Molenko!
You need a magic level of 66. The magical energy in here is unsafe for those below that level.
translation: 마법 레벨이 66이어야 합니다. 이 안의 마법 에너지는 그보다 낮은 레벨의 사람에게는 위험합니다.

english: You need a magic level of 66 for admittance to the guild. The magical energy inside the guild is unsafe for anyone below that level. For any other business please ring for attention.
translation: 길드에 들어가려면 마법 레벨이 66이어야 합니다. 길드 안의 마법 에너지는 그보다 낮은 레벨의 사람에게는 위험합니다. 다른 용무가 있으시면 종을 울려 불러 주십시오.

english: Nothing thanks, I'm just looking around.
Can you teleport me to the Rune Essence?
translation: Rune Essence(룬 정수)로 순간이동시켜 주실 수 있어요?

english: Do you like my magic Zombies? Feel free to kill them, there's plenty more where these came from!
translation: 제 마법 Zombies(좀비) 마음에 드세요? 마음껏 잡으셔도 돼요. 얼마든지 더 있거든요!

english: I spoke to the necromancer like you suggested...
Please - let's not talk about it. Distentor and Zavistic would get very annoyed if they found I'd sent you to a necromancer.
translation: 제발요, 그 얘기는 하지 말아요. 제가 당신을 강령술사한테 보냈다는 걸 Distentor(디스텐터)와 Zavistic(자비스틱)이 알면 엄청 화낼 거예요.

english: Ok, fair enough.
You can't attack the Zombies in the room, my Zombies are for magic target practice only and should be attacked from the other side of the fence.
translation: 방 안의 Zombies(좀비)는 공격할 수 없어요. 제 좀비는 마법 표적 연습용이라서 울타리 반대편에서 공격해야 해요.

english: So you think finding those beads makes you clever, do you?
translation: 그 구슬들을 찾았다고 네가 똑똑한 줄 아나 보지?

english: Well yes, actually.
Well you'd better just watch your back, because when you least expect it I'll be there. You shouldn't go sticking your nose into other people's affairs, meddler.
translation: 그럼 뒤를 조심하는 게 좋을 거다. 네가 방심할 때 내가 거기 있을 테니까. 남의 일에 함부로 코를 들이밀면 안 되지, 이 참견쟁이야.

english: Not now, I'm trying to concentrate on a very difficult spell!
translation: 지금은 안 돼, 아주 어려운 주문에 집중하는 중이란 말이다!

english: You were nicer to me when you had that little gnome wandering around here before.
translation: 전에 그 작은 gnome(노움)이 여기 돌아다닐 때는 저한테 더 친절하셨잖아요.

english: Well he's not bothering me anymore, is he? And you don't need to bother me either!
translation: 이제 그놈은 날 귀찮게 안 하잖아, 안 그래? 그러니 너도 날 귀찮게 하지 마!

english: Hello there, can I help you?
What do you do here?
I've been studying the practice of making split-bark armour.
translation: split-bark armour(스플릿바크 갑옷) 만드는 법을 연구하고 있어요.

english: Split-bark armour, what's that?
Split-bark armour is special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: split-bark armour(스플릿바크 갑옷)은 마법사를 위한 특수 갑옷이에요. 보통 로브보다 물리 공격에 훨씬 강하죠.

english: It's actually very easy for me to make, but I've been having trouble getting hold of the pieces.
translation: 사실 저한테는 만들기가 아주 쉬운데, 재료를 구하기가 힘들어서요.

english: Well good luck with that.
Can you make me some?
translation: 저한테도 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: I'm sorry, but I can't do that right now.
I need bark from a hollow tree, and some fine cloth. Unfortunately both these items can only be found in Morytania, especially the cloth which is found in the tombs of shades.
translation: hollow tree(속이 빈 나무)에서 얻는 bark(나무껍질)과 fine cloth(고운 천)이 필요해요. 안타깝게도 둘 다 Morytania(모리타니아)에서만 구할 수 있고, 특히 천은 shades(셰이드)의 무덤에서 나와요.

english: Of course I'd happily sell you some at a discounted price if you bring me those items.
translation: 물론 그 재료들을 가져다주시면 기꺼이 할인된 가격에 팔아 드릴게요.

english: Okay, guess I'll go looking then!
Okay, how much do I need?
I need 1 piece of each for either gloves or boots, 2 pieces of each for a hat, 3 pieces of each for leggings, and 4 pieces of each for a top.
translation: 장갑이나 장화는 각각 1개씩, 모자는 각각 2개씩, 다리 갑옷은 각각 3개씩, 상의는 각각 4개씩 필요해요.

english: I'll charge you 1,000 coins for either gloves or boots, 6,000 coins for a hat, 32,000 coins for leggings, and 37,000 for a top.
translation: 장갑이나 장화는 1,000코인, 모자는 6,000코인, 다리 갑옷은 32,000코인, 상의는 37,000코인을 받을게요.

english: What's that you're wearing?
This is split-bark armour, it's special armour for mages. It's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes.
translation: 이건 split-bark armour(스플릿바크 갑옷)예요. 마법사를 위한 특수 갑옷이죠. 보통 로브보다 물리 공격에 훨씬 강해요.

english: Can you make me some armour please?
translation: 저한테 갑옷 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Certainly, what would you like me to make?
No thanks.
There you go, enjoy your new armour!
translation: 여기 있어요, 새 갑옷 잘 쓰세요!

english: You need 2 pieces of bark, 2 pieces of fine cloth and 6,000 coins for a splitbark helm.
translation: splitbark helm(스플릿바크 투구)를 만들려면 bark(나무껍질) 2개, fine cloth(고운 천) 2개, 6,000코인이 필요해요.

english: You need 4 pieces of bark, 4 pieces of fine cloth and 37,000 coins for a splitbark body.
translation: splitbark body(스플릿바크 갑옷)을 만들려면 bark(나무껍질) 4개, fine cloth(고운 천) 4개, 37,000코인이 필요해요.

english: You need 3 pieces of bark, 3 pieces of fine cloth and 32,000 coins for splitbark legs.
translation: splitbark legs(스플릿바크 다리 갑옷)을 만들려면 bark(나무껍질) 3개, fine cloth(고운 천) 3개, 32,000코인이 필요해요.

english: You need 1 piece of bark, 1 piece of fine cloth and 1,000 coins for splitbark gauntlets.
translation: splitbark gauntlets(스플릿바크 건틀릿)을 만들려면 bark(나무껍질) 1개, fine cloth(고운 천) 1개, 1,000코인이 필요해요.

english: You need 1 piece of bark, 1 piece of fine cloth and 1,000 coins for splitbark boots.
translation: splitbark boots(스플릿바크 장화)를 만들려면 bark(나무껍질) 1개, fine cloth(고운 천) 1개, 1,000코인이 필요해요.

english: What do you do here?
Split-bark armour, what's that?
Well good luck with that.
Can you make me some?
translation: 저한테도 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Okay, guess I'll go looking then!
Okay, how much do I need?
What's that you're wearing?
Can you make me some armour please?
translation: 저한테 갑옷 좀 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: If the player is on a non-members world:
No thanks.
Buy Helm
Buy Body
Buy Legs
Buy Gauntlets
Buy Boots
Give me a quest!
Give me a quest what?
Give me a quest please.
Well seeing as you asked nicely... I could do with some help.
translation: 그렇게 공손히 부탁하니 말일세... 마침 도움이 좀 필요하던 참이네.

english: The wizard Grayzag next door decided he didn't like me so he enlisted an army of hundreds of imps.
translation: 옆집 마법사 Grayzag(그레이잭)이 날 싫어하게 됐는지, 수백 마리나 되는 imps(임프) 군대를 끌어모았다네.

english: These imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.
translation: 그 임프 놈들이 내 물건을 이것저것 훔쳐 갔지. 대부분은 별로 신경 안 쓰는 것들일세. 그냥 달걀이나 실타래 같은 것들 말이야.

english: But they stole my four magical beads. There was a red one, a yellow one, a black one, and a white one.
translation: 그런데 내 마법 구슬 네 개를 훔쳐 갔다네. 빨간 것, 노란 것, 검은 것, 하얀 것 하나씩이었지.

english: These imps have now spread out all over the kingdom. Could you get my beads back for me?
translation: 그 임프들이 이제 왕국 곳곳으로 흩어져 버렸네. 내 구슬을 되찾아 주겠나?

english: Well this is a surprising turn of events!
What?
Well I just so happen to have all of those beads on me!
translation: 마침 그 구슬을 전부 갖고 있거든요!

english: Are you saying that you stole my beads all this time and I’ve been blaming these imps!?
translation: 그러니까 자네가 내내 내 구슬을 훔쳐 가 놓고 난 애꿎은 임프들 탓만 하고 있었다는 건가!?

english: No, not at all! I just found them throughout my travels and presumed somebody would need them at some point.
translation: 아니요, 절대 아니에요! 여행하다가 여기저기서 주웠는데, 언젠가 누군가 필요하겠거니 했을 뿐이에요.

english: Bah! Fine.
Give them here and I'll check that they really are MY beads, before I give you your reward. You'll like it, it's an amulet of accuracy.
translation: 이리 주게. 진짜 내 구슬이 맞는지 확인하고 나서 보상을 주겠네. 마음에 들 걸세, amulet of accuracy(정확성의 아뮬렛)라네.

english: You give four coloured beads to Wizard Mizgog.
translation: Wizard Mizgog(마법사 미즈고그)에게 색깔 구슬 네 개를 건넸다.

english: Wizard Mizgog places the four beads on the table and casts a spell on them.
translation: Wizard Mizgog(마법사 미즈고그)가 구슬 네 개를 탁자 위에 올려놓고 주문을 건다.

english: The wizard hands you an amulet.
Congratulations! Quest complete!
I'll try.
That's great, thank you.
I've better things to do than chase imps.
translation: 임프나 쫓아다니는 것보다 더 중요한 일이 있어요.

english: Well if you're not interested in the quests I have to give you, don't waste my time by asking me for them.
translation: 내가 줄 퀘스트에 관심이 없으면, 달라고 해서 내 시간 낭비하게 하지 말게.

english: Give me a quest or else!
translation: 퀘스트 내놔, 안 그러면 가만 안 둬!

english: Or else what? You'll attack me?
translation: 안 그러면 뭐? 날 공격하기라도 하겠다는 건가?

english: Hahaha!
Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
Ah now you're assuming I have one to give.
translation: 아, 이제 보니 내가 줄 퀘스트가 있다고 지레짐작하는구먼.

english: Got any more quests?
No, everything is good with the world today.
Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: 저한테 가르쳐 줄 만한 재미있는 주문 아세요?

english: I don't think so, the type of magic I study involves years of meditation and research.
translation: 없는 것 같군. 내가 연구하는 마법은 수년간의 명상과 연구가 필요하거든.

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: 그 근사한 아뮬렛 하나 더 있어요?

english: I have a few spare. I'd like one of each coloured bead again in return, though! Black, white, yellow and red.
translation: 여분이 몇 개 있지. 그 대신 색깔별 구슬을 다시 하나씩 받아야겠네! 검은색, 흰색, 노란색, 빨간색으로.

english: I have them with me! Here you go.
Thanks, Mizgog!
What are you going to do with all of these extra beads, anyway?
translation: 그런데 그 남는 구슬들은 다 어디에 쓰시려고요?

english: You don't want to know. Take care!
translation: 모르는 게 좋을 걸세. 잘 가게!

english: Maybe later.
Perhaps some other time, then.
I don't have them all on me at the moment. I'll come back when I have them!
translation: 지금은 다 갖고 있지 않아요. 다 모으면 다시 올게요!

english: Very well. See you soon!
You have done well, [player name]!
Give me a quest please.
Yes.
No.
Give me a quest or else!
translation: 퀘스트 내놔, 안 그러면 가만 안 둬!

english: Just stop messing around and give me a quest!
Got any more quests?
Do you know any interesting spells you could teach me?
translation: 저한테 가르쳐 줄 만한 재미있는 주문 아세요?

english: Have you got another one of those fancy schmancy amulets?
translation: 그 근사한 아뮬렛 하나 더 있어요?

english: I have them with me!
Maybe later.
Welcome to the Magic Guild Store. Would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Magic Guild(마법 길드) 상점에 오신 걸 환영해요. 마법 물품을 좀 사시겠어요?

english: Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 입고 계신 망토에 대해 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
translation: 물론이죠! Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 성취의 상징이에요. 스킬을 통달해 99레벨에 도달한 사람만 손에 넣고 그 효과를 누릴 수 있죠.

english: The Cape of Magic allows you to switch spellbooks five times per day. Now, would you like to buy some magic supplies?
translation: Cape of Magic(마법 망토)가 있으면 하루에 다섯 번까지 마법서를 바꿀 수 있어요. 자, 마법 물품을 좀 사시겠어요?

english: Yes please.
No thank you.
May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 제 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
Can you tell me about your cape?
translation: 입고 계신 망토에 대해 알려 주실 수 있어요?

english: I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
May I have another hood for my cape?
translation: 제 망토에 쓸 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Yes please.
Ello young thingummywut.
What's a thingummywut?
A thingummywut? Where? Where?
Those pesky thingummywuts. They get everywhere. They leave a terrible mess too.
translation: 그 성가신 뭐시기들. 아무 데나 다 기어든다니까. 지저분하게 어질러 놓기도 하고.

english: Err you just called me thingummywut.
You're a thingummywut? I've never seen one up close before. They said I was mad!
translation: 자네가 뭐시기라고? 이렇게 가까이서 본 건 처음이구먼. 다들 나더러 미쳤다고 했었지!

english: Now you are my proof! There ARE thingummywuts in this tower. Now where can I find a cage big enough to keep you?
translation: 이제 자네가 내 증거야! 이 탑에는 뭐시기가 정말 있다고. 자, 자네를 가둬 둘 만큼 큰 우리를 어디서 구한담?

english: Err I'd better be off really.
Oh ok, have a good time, and watch out for sheep! They're more cunning than they look.
translation: 오, 그래. 잘 지내게. 그리고 양 조심하고! 보기보다 훨씬 교활하거든.

english: They're right, you are mad.
That's a pity. I thought maybe they were winding me up.
translation: 그거 아쉽구먼. 다들 날 놀리는 줄로만 알았는데.

english: Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: 어떻게 생겼는지 말해 주시면 제가 박살 내 드릴게요.

english: Don't be ridiculous. No-one has ever seen one.
translation: 말도 안 되는 소리. 뭐시기를 본 사람은 아무도 없어.

english: They're invisible, or a myth, or a figment of my imagination. Can't remember which right now.
translation: 투명하거나, 전설이거나, 아니면 내 상상 속에만 있는 거지. 지금은 그게 어느 쪽이었는지 기억이 안 나네.

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: 저를 위대하고 강력한 마법사로 만들어 주세요.

english: Wizard eh? You don't want any truck with that sort. They're not to be trusted. That's what I've heard anyways.
translation: 마법사라고? 그런 족속하고는 엮이지 않는 게 좋아. 믿을 놈들이 못 되거든. 내가 듣기론 그렇다네.

english: So aren't you a wizard?
How dare you? Of course I'm a wizard. Now don't be so cheeky or I'll turn you into a frog.
translation: 이런 무례한! 당연히 나는 마법사지. 자, 건방지게 굴지 말게. 안 그러면 개구리로 만들어 버릴 테니.

english: Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: 아, 그럼 이만 말을 거는 게 좋겠네요.

english: Cheerio then. It was nice chatting to you.
I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 맡긴 열쇠를 받아야 해요.

english: Sir Prysin? Who's that? What would I want his key for?
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)? 그게 누군가? 내가 그 사람 열쇠를 뭐 하러 갖고 있겠어?

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: 그분이 할아버지가 대신 맡아 두고 계신다고 했어요.

english: That wasn't very clever of him. I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on. Go and tell him to find someone else to look after his valuables in future.
translation: 그 친구 그다지 현명하진 못했구먼. 나는 머리가 목에 안 붙어 있었으면 머리까지 잃어버렸을 사람인데. 앞으로는 다른 사람한테 귀중품을 맡기라고 전해 주게.

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
Oh that's great, if it wouldn't be too much trouble.
translation: 오, 고맙구먼. 너무 번거롭지만 않다면 말이야.

english: Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
translation: 그런데 혹시 굴러다니는 열쇠 같은 거 없으세요?

english: Now you come to mention it, yes I do have a key. It's in my special closet of valuable stuff. Now how do I get into that?
translation: 그러고 보니 있지, 열쇠가 하나 있어. 귀중품을 넣어 두는 내 특별한 벽장 안에 있지. 자, 그걸 어떻게 연다더라?

english: I sealed it using one of my magic rituals. So it would make sense that another ritual would open it again.
translation: 내 마법 의식 중 하나로 봉인해 뒀거든. 그러니 다른 의식으로 다시 열 수 있겠지.

english: He's one of the King's knights.
translation: 그분은 왕의 기사 중 한 명이에요.

english: Say, I remember one of the King's knights. He had nice shoes...
translation: 아, 왕의 기사 하나는 기억나는구먼. 근사한 신발을 신고 있었지...

english: ...and didn't like my homemade spinach rolls. Would you like a spinach roll?
translation: ...그리고 내가 직접 만든 spinach rolls(시금치 롤)을 싫어했어. 시금치 롤 하나 먹겠나?

english: Yes please.
Thank you very much.
So do you know what ritual to use?
translation: 그럼 무슨 의식을 써야 하는지 아세요?

english: Let me think a second.
Yes a simple drazier style ritual should suffice. Hmm, main problem with that is I'll need 25 sets of bones. Now where am I going to get hold of something like that?
translation: 그래, 간단한 드레이지어식 의식이면 충분할 거야. 흠, 문제는 bones(뼈)가 25개나 필요하다는 건데. 그런 걸 대체 어디서 구한담?

english: Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: 음, 그거 곤란하네요. 저는 그 열쇠가 꼭 필요한데요.

english: Ah well, sorry I couldn't be any more help.
translation: 아, 저런. 더 도와주지 못해서 미안하네.

english: I'll help get the bones for you.
Ooh that would be very good of you.
Okay, I'll speak to you when I've got some bones.
How are you doing finding bones?
I haven't got any at the moment.
Nevermind, keep working on it.
I have some bones.
Give 'em here then.
That's all of them.
I still need 24 more.
Ok, I'll keep looking.
Hurrah! That's all 25 sets of bones.
Wings of dark and colour too, Spreading in the morning dew; Locked away I have a key; Return it now, please, unto me.
translation: 어둠과 빛깔의 날개여, 아침 이슬 속에 펼쳐지네; 내가 잠가 둔 열쇠 하나; 이제 부디 내게 돌려다오.

english: Not a problem for a friend of Sir What's-his-face.
translation: 아무개 경 친구의 부탁인데 이쯤이야 문제없지.

english: I've lost the key you gave to me.
Yes I know, it was returned to me. If you want it back you're going to have to collect another 25 sets of bones.
translation: 그래, 알고 있네. 나한테 돌아왔거든. 다시 갖고 싶으면 뼈 25개를 또 모아 와야 하네.

english: Here you go!
What?
I need you to answer this for me like a good thingummywut.
translation: 착한 뭐시기답게 이 문제 좀 풀어 주게.

english: Wizard Traiborn has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: Wizard Traiborn(마법사 트레이번)이 challenge scroll(도전 두루마리)를 주었다!

english: Please give me your answer, young thingummywut!
How can that be? Go check again, silly thingummywut!
translation: 그럴 리가 있나? 다시 확인해 보게, 이 엉뚱한 뭐시기야!

english: Spot on!
Wizard Traiborn has given you another clue scroll!
translation: Wizard Traiborn(마법사 트레이번)이 clue scroll(단서 두루마리)를 하나 더 주었다!

english: What's a thingummywut?
Err you just called me a thingummywut.
Err I'd better be off really.
They're right, you are mad.
Tell me what they look like and I'll mash 'em.
translation: 어떻게 생겼는지 말해 주시면 제가 박살 내 드릴게요.

english: Teach me to be a mighty and powerful wizard.
translation: 저를 위대하고 강력한 마법사로 만들어 주세요.

english: So aren't you a wizard?
Oh I'd better stop talking to you then.
translation: 아, 그럼 이만 말을 거는 게 좋겠네요.

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: Sir Prysin(프라이신 경)이 맡긴 열쇠를 받아야 해요.

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: 그분이 할아버지가 대신 맡아 두고 계신다고 했어요.

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
translation: 그런데 혹시 굴러다니는 열쇠 같은 거 없으세요?

english: He's one of the King's knights.
translation: 그분은 왕의 기사 중 한 명이에요.

english: Yes please.
Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: 음, 그거 곤란하네요. 저는 그 열쇠가 꼭 필요한데요.

english: I'll get the bones for you.
Just tell me if you have the key.
How are things at Weiss?
Snowflake and My Arm are ruling the town together, and now I've built them a special fire, they can grow goutweed there.
translation: Snowflake(눈송이)와 My Arm(마이 암)이 함께 마을을 다스리고 있어요. 그리고 제가 특별한 불을 만들어 줬으니 이제 거기서 goutweed(구트위드)를 키울 수 있어요.

english: So My Arm taught Weiss the farming knowledge of the Stronghold trolls. Now Stronghold trolls can be given firemaking knowledge from Weiss, like I promised.
translation: 그럼 My Arm(마이 암)이 Weiss(바이스)에 Stronghold(요새) 트롤의 농사 지식을 가르쳤네. 이제 약속대로 요새 트롤도 바이스한테서 불 피우기 지식을 받을 수 있어.

english: Snowflake gave me a book containing all the information she could find from Odd Mushroom's notes.
translation: Snowflake(눈송이)가 Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)의 메모에서 찾을 수 있는 정보를 전부 담은 책을 줬어요.

english: Give it to Burntmeat. He can teach trolls what they want to know from it.
translation: 그거 Burntmeat(번트미트)한테 줘. 번트미트가 그걸로 트롤들이 알고 싶은 걸 가르쳐 줄 수 있어.

english: Hopefully Snowflake will give me another one.
translation: Snowflake(눈송이)가 한 권 더 줬으면 좋겠네요.

english: Now that My Arm has taught the Weiss trolls what he knows about farming, here's a book containing what the Weiss trolls know about firemaking.
translation: My Arm(마이 암)이 Weiss(바이스) 트롤들에게 농사에 대해 아는 걸 가르쳐 줬으니, 여기 바이스 트롤들이 불 피우기에 대해 아는 걸 담은 책이에요.

english: Odd Mushroom invented lots of clever stuff with Snowflake. Might be handy for Stronghold trolls.
translation: Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)은 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 똑똑한 걸 많이 발명했어. 요새 트롤한테 쓸모 있을지도 몰라.

english: Let Burntmeat see...
Uh...
Yeah, lotsa learnings here. Very clever stuff. We oughta reward you.
translation: 그래, 배울 거 엄청 많다. 아주 똑똑한 거. 너한테 상 줘야겠다.

english: Don't give me more burnt meat. I've been here before, and you gave me a load of burnt meat.
translation: burnt meat(탄 고기)는 더 주지 마세요. 전에 여기 왔을 때 탄 고기를 잔뜩 주셨잖아요.

english: Silly human pretends he don't like Burntmeat's lovely burnt meat! But okay, Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: 바보 인간, Burntmeat(번트미트)의 맛있는 탄 고기 싫은 척한다! 그래도 좋다, 번트미트는 이제 너한테 탄 고기 안 만든다. 절대.

english: Ever? You're never ever going to give me burnt meat again?
translation: 절대요? 다시는, 절대로 탄 고기를 안 주시는 거예요?

english: No more burnt meat from Burntmeat, ever. Wolfbone here has made reward for you instead.
translation: Burntmeat(번트미트)는 이제 탄 고기 절대 안 준다. 대신 여기 Wolfbone(늑대뼈)가 너한테 줄 상 만들었다.

english: Yes, I have learnt a lot here from my friend Burntmeat, and he has let me prepare a reward for you myself.
translation: 그래, 나는 여기서 친구 Burntmeat(번트미트)한테 많이 배웠어. 번트미트가 너한테 줄 상을 내가 직접 준비하게 해 줬지.

english: That's very kind of you.
Burntmeat got feeling you no like Burntmeat's burnt meat. Burntmeat made some for you before, an' you not seem grateful. So Burntmeat will not make any more for you. Ever.
translation: Burntmeat(번트미트)는 너 번트미트의 burnt meat(탄 고기) 안 좋아하는 느낌 든다. 번트미트가 전에 만들어 줬는데, 너 고마워 안 하는 것 같았다. 그래서 번트미트는 이제 너한테 탄 고기 안 만든다. 절대.

english: Don't give me more burnt meat.
translation: burnt meat(탄 고기)는 더 주지 마세요.

english: That's very kind of you.
Hello, how's it going?
Not too bad, but I'm a little worried about the increase of goblins these days.
translation: 그럭저럭요. 그런데 요즘 goblins(고블린)이 늘어나서 좀 걱정이에요.

english: Don't worry, I'll kill them.
How can I help you?
Do you want to trade?
No, I have nothing I wish to get rid of. If you want to do some trading, there are plenty of shops and market stalls around though.
translation: 아뇨, 처분하고 싶은 물건은 없어요. 거래를 하고 싶으면 근처에 상점이랑 시장 노점이 많으니 거기 가 보세요.

english: I'm in search of a quest.
I'm sorry I can't help you there.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
I've heard there are many fearsome creatures that dwell under the ground...
translation: 땅속에 무시무시한 생물들이 잔뜩 산다고 들었어요...

english: Get out of my way, I'm in a hurry!
I'm fine, how are you?
Very well thank you.
Hello there! Nice weather we've been having.
I'm very well thank you.
Who are you?
I'm a bold adventurer.
Ah, a very noble profession.
Do I know you? I'm in a hurry!
I think we need a new king. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: 새 왕이 필요한 것 같아요. 지금 왕은 영 별로거든요.

english: Not too bad thanks.
Are you asking for a fight?
The woman attacks the player
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
None of your business.
Do you wish to trade?
No I don't have any spare change.
translation: 아뇨, 남는 잔돈 같은 건 없어요.

english: I'm a little worried - I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: 좀 걱정돼요. 사람들이 돌아다니면서 아무 시민이나 마구 죽이고 있다고 들었거든요.

english: No, I don't want to buy anything!
That is classified information.
Have this flyer...
Yo, wassup!
I like our king, he's keeping the poor and infected away from us decent folk.
translation: 난 우리 왕이 좋아요. 가난뱅이랑 병든 사람들을 우리 같은 점잖은 사람들한테서 떼어 놓잖아요.

english: Not too bad. Glad the plague hasn't touched, the better areas of town.
translation: 그럭저럭요. 역병이 마을의 잘사는 동네까지는 번지지 않아서 다행이에요.

english: Err... yeah.
Good day.
An outsider! Can you get me out of this hell hole?
translation: 바깥사람이네요! 이 지옥 같은 곳에서 저 좀 꺼내 줄 수 있어요?

english: Sorry, that's not what I'm here to do.
translation: 미안해요, 전 그런 일 하러 온 게 아니에요.

english: Hello there.
Go away. People from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 저리 가요. 바깥사람들이 우릴 짐승처럼 가둬 놨어요. 당신한테 할 말 없어요.

english: Hello.
... whassup?
Are you alright?
... see... two of you... why there two of you?
translation: ... 보여... 너 둘... 왜 너 둘이야?

english: There's only one of me, friend.
... no, two of you... you can't count... ... maybe you drunk too much...
translation: ... 아냐, 둘이야... 너 숫자 못 세는구나... ... 술을 너무 마셨나 봐...

english: Whatever you say, friend.
... giant hairy cabbages...
Bah, those mourners... they're meant to be helping us, but I think they're doing more harm here than good. They won't even let me send a letter out to my family.
translation: 흥, 그 mourners(애도자)들 말이에요... 우릴 도와주러 왔다면서, 도움보다 해가 더 큰 것 같아요. 가족한테 편지 한 통도 못 보내게 한다니까요.

english: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
Yes, I've seen her. Very helpful person.
Not for the last few days though... I thought maybe she'd gone home.
translation: 그런데 요 며칠은 못 봤어요... 집에 돌아갔나 했죠.

english: You should stand up to them more.
translation: 그 사람들한테 좀 더 맞서야 해요.

english: Oh I'm not one to cause a fuss.
translation: 아, 전 소란 피우는 성격이 아니라서요.

english: Do you want to trade?
I'm in search of a quest.
I'm in search of enemies to kill.
Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
You should stand up to them more.
translation: 그 사람들한테 좀 더 맞서야 해요.

english: It stinks down here.
Can't you just leave me alone.
I don't trust that fish monger.
Lighting fires in an enclosed space is probably not a good idea. Oh well.
translation: 막힌 곳에서 불을 피우는 건 별로 좋은 생각이 아닐 텐데. 뭐, 어쩔 수 없죠.

english: I guess it's not all bad down here. At least we have a pub.
translation: 여기 아래도 나쁜 것만 있는 건 아니에요. 적어도 술집은 있으니까요.

english: I'll leave this place one day. You'll see.
translation: 언젠가 여길 떠나고 말 거예요. 두고 봐요.

english: Life is tough.
Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: 네, 역병 도시에서 사는 건 정말 힘들겠어요.

english: Plague? Pah, that's no excuse for the treatment we've received. It's obvious pretty quickly if someone has the plague.
translation: 역병이요? 흥, 그렇다고 우리를 이렇게 대해도 되는 건 아니죠. 누가 역병에 걸렸는지는 금방 티가 난다고요.

english: I'm thinking about making a break for it. I'm perfectly healthy, not gonna infect anyone.
translation: 탈출해 볼까 생각 중이에요. 전 멀쩡히 건강하니까 아무한테도 옮기지 않을 거예요.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
Well, ain't much either you or me can do about it.
translation: 뭐, 당신이나 나나 어떻게 할 수 있는 일도 없죠.

english: Yes, living in a plague city must be hard.
translation: 네, 역병 도시에서 사는 건 정말 힘들겠어요.

english: I'm sorry to hear that.
Hello!
Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!
translation: 안녕하세요, 친구. 저는 악을 무찌르고 놈들의 전리품을 챙기고 싶어요! 저를 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 데려가 주세요!

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 저 아래 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 됐어요?

english: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.
translation: 그런 것 같은데요? 적어도 제 마음엔 용기가 있으니 당분간은 그걸로 충분하겠죠. Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 쓸 만한 보급품을 살 수 있을 거예요.

english: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?
translation: 그런데 Morytania(모리타니아)의 vampyres(뱀파이어)는 은 말고는 아무것도 안 통한다는 거 알고 있어요?

english: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.
translation: 어... 음, 그런 얘긴 못 들어 봤지만, Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 도착하면 Saradomin(사라도민)께서 쓸 만한 무기를 마련해 주실 거라 믿어요.

english: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?
translation: 그런 놈들은 당신이 피해 가게 도와주겠죠. 어쨌든 안내인이잖아요, 아닌가요? 게다가 꽤 싸울 줄 아는 사람처럼 보이는데요. 그런 놈들이랑 싸워서 이겨 본 적 있죠? 그게 뭐 얼마나 어렵겠어요?

english: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.
translation: 사실 꽤 어려울 수 있어요. 하지만 맞는 말이에요, 제가 안내인이니까 상황은 제가 감당할 수 있을 거예요.

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 왜 가려는 거예요?

english: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
translation: 거기 가서 그 뱀파이어 놈들한테 따끔하게 한 수 가르쳐 주려고요. 그곳 사정이 끔찍하다는 얘길 들었는데, 제가 끝장을 낼 생각이에요.

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)로 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있어요?

english: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 뭐, 경험이 좀 있다고만 해 두죠. 제 몫의 적은 기꺼이 상대할 거예요. 그건 걱정 안 하셔도 돼요.

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 제가 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴게요.

english: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
translation: 흐음, 데리고 다니는 동료가 있네요. 혼자 돌아다니게 두면 이번 여정에서 길을 잃을지도 몰라요. 그 동료를 안전한 곳에 두고 나서 출발해요.

english: Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
translation: 아, 정말요? 그럼 좋죠! 목적지에 도착하면 약간의 보상을 드릴게요.

english: Burgh de Rott Ramble begins
translation: Burgh de Rott Ramble(버그 드 로트 원정) 시작

english: Ok, which route should we take?
Ok, thanks.
Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.
translation: 아, 보급품을 좀 주시려고요? 잠깐만요, 제 배낭 좀 열게요.

english: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
translation: 여긴 좀 음침하네요. 사람들이 어떻게 여기서 살죠?

english: Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에 자주 가세요? 길을 아주 잘 아시는 것 같아서요.

english: When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 언제쯤 도착해요?

english: We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
translation: 여기 서서 수다나 떨 시간 없어요. 계속 가요. 챙길 전리품이 있다고요.

english: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!
translation: 아, 이 여행 정말 싫어요. 그래도 우리 같은 모험가들한테 억지로 떠맡겨지는 호화로운 생활보다는 낫죠. 차라리 눈까지 진흙에 파묻혀서 한판 제대로 싸우는 게 훨씬 좋아요!

english: Can't you see I'm being attacked...
translation: 제가 공격받고 있는 거 안 보여요...

english: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.
Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!
translation: 이런! Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야 할 것 같아요. 저 다리는 못 건너겠어요!

english: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!
Player completes the bridge event
Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.
translation: 아이고, 큰일 났네요... 이 늪은 못 건너겠어요. Paterdomus(파테르도무스)로 돌아가야겠어요.

english: Player completes the bog event
Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
Whahay...that was great!
But we really should be heading off now.
Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!
translation: 아, 분명 건너갈 방법이 있을 거예요!

english: Player completes the river event
That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 우와! 정말 끝내줬어요! 그래도 이제 정말 출발해야 해요.

english: Wh...what are those bubbles?
This is scary!
Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
Ahhh, two tentacles!
...three tentacles!
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!
translation: 이런! 저 야수 좀 봐요! 저건 혼자서 처리하셔야겠어요!

english: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 무사히 데려다주셔서 정말 고마워요. 여기 보상이에요.

english: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?
translation: 저 아래 악과 싸울 준비는 충분히 됐어요?

english: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)에는 왜 가려는 거예요?

english: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?
translation: 가는 길에 적을 만나면 스스로를 지킬 수 있어요...?

english: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 제가 Burgh de Rott(버그 드 로트)까지 데려다 드릴게요.

english: Ok, thanks.
Hi, why do you have twigs growing out of you?
translation: 안녕하세요, 왜 몸에서 잔가지가 자라나 있어요?

english: Heehee, what a strange question, that's because I'm a Wood Dryad.
translation: 히히, 참 이상한 질문이네요. 그건 제가 Wood Dryad(숲의 드라이어드)라서 그래요.

english: Grand job, what an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: 잘했어, 정말 밉살스러운 나무였지. 다른 나무들 험담이나 퍼뜨리고 물은 혼자 다 빨아먹고 말이야.

english: As a reward, I'll let ye use me full banking services!
translation: 보상으로 이 몸의 은행 서비스를 전부 쓰게 해 주지!

english: Okay then.
What an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
translation: 정말 밉살스러운 나무였지. 다른 나무들 험담이나 퍼뜨리고 물은 혼자 다 빨아먹고 말이야.

english: Since you're here, I'll let you use me restricted banking services.
translation: 여기까지 왔으니 이 몸의 제한된 은행 서비스를 쓰게 해 주지.

english: Your items cannot be stored in the bank from here.
translation: 여기서는 아이템을 은행에 보관할 수 없어.

english: It be yer lucky day, Foresters!
I'll have to go shortly...
Well, I must be getting on now.
Open deposit box
Deposit all
Say nothing
Deposit all woodcutting resources
Yes, bank it all
Only bank woodcutting resources
No, don't bank anything
Open my bank deposit box
Can you teach me the basics of Woodcutting and Firemaking, please?
translation: 벌목이랑 불 피우기 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: I'd give you an axe to chop trees with but you don't have room in your inventory.
translation: 나무를 벨 도끼를 드리고 싶은데, 소지품에 자리가 없네요.

english: As you're already here, have an axe so that you can chop the trees around me.
translation: 이왕 오셨으니 도끼 하나 가져가세요. 제 주변 나무들을 베어 보시라고요.

english: When you see a likely looking tree, appreciate its beauty, then simply click on it to chop it down.
translation: 괜찮아 보이는 나무가 보이면, 그 아름다움을 감상한 다음 클릭해서 베어 넘기면 돼요.

english: When you have a full inventory of logs, you have a choice. You can take it to the bank, there's one on the roof of the castle in Lumbridge, or you can burn them.
translation: 소지품이 통나무로 가득 차면 선택지가 있어요. 은행에 가져갈 수도 있는데, Lumbridge(럼브리지) 성 지붕에 하나 있죠. 아니면 태워 버릴 수도 있고요.

english: Ah, you've lost your tinderbox have you? Have another!
translation: 아, 부싯깃 통을 잃어버리셨군요? 하나 더 드릴게요!

english: Click on your tinderbox, then click on one of the logs in your inventory, this will attempt to light a fire that you can use for cooking.
translation: 부싯깃 통을 클릭한 다음 소지품에 있는 통나무 하나를 클릭하면 불을 붙이려고 시도해요. 그 불로 요리를 할 수 있어요.

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
This is a Skillcape of Woodcutting, wearing one increases your chance of finding bird's nests. Only a person who has achieved the highest possible level in a skill can wear one.
translation: 이건 Skillcape of Woodcutting(벌목 스킬 망토)예요. 입고 있으면 새 둥지를 찾을 확률이 올라가요. 한 스킬에서 가능한 최고 레벨을 달성한 사람만 입을 수 있죠.

english: Choose carefully where and what you chop, you can get different trees in different places throughout the land.
translation: 어디서 무엇을 벨지 신중하게 고르세요. 이 땅 곳곳에서 저마다 다른 나무를 구할 수 있거든요.

english: Make sure you hang on to your logs, don't throw them away as you can get valuable firemaking experience from them! Look out for other things too...
translation: 통나무는 꼭 챙겨 두고 버리지 마세요. 불 피우기 경험치를 쏠쏠하게 얻을 수 있으니까요! 다른 것들도 잘 살펴보시고요...

english: Watch out for the tree spirits, they really don't like you chopping trees, they can really do some damage if you're not paying attention...
translation: 나무 정령을 조심하세요. 나무 베는 걸 정말 싫어하거든요. 방심하면 꽤 큰 피해를 입힐 수 있어요...

english: Don't forget you can always use logs for fletching experience too.
translation: 통나무로 활 제작 경험치도 얻을 수 있다는 걸 잊지 마세요.

english: Yes, you'll need lots of logs if you want to be a good fletcher. Talk to the ranging tutor for more information.
translation: 네, 훌륭한 활 제작자가 되고 싶다면 통나무가 많이 필요할 거예요. 자세한 건 원거리 교사에게 물어보세요.

english: As you get better and better you'll find that you can chop trees such as Maple and Yew! These are very good for firemaking.
translation: 실력이 점점 늘면 Maple(단풍나무)나 Yew(주목) 같은 나무도 벨 수 있게 될 거예요! 불 피우기에 아주 좋죠.

english: Of course, they're also very useful for fletching.
Also, look out for birds' nests, you never know what our feathered friends have been collecting. Jewellery and Clue scrolls maybe?
translation: 그리고 새 둥지도 잘 찾아보세요. 깃털 달린 친구들이 뭘 모아 놨을지 모르거든요. 장신구나 Clue scrolls(단서 두루마리)가 있을지도요?

english: Tell me about different trees and axes.
translation: 여러 나무와 도끼에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
translation: Hollow trees(속이 빈 나무)는 Canifis(카니피스) 동쪽의 Haunted Woods(유령의 숲)에서 찾을 수 있어요. 하지만 거머리를 조심하세요.

english: As you progress in your combat skill you will find you can wield your woodcutting axe as a weapon, it's not very effective, but it frees up a slot for another log.
translation: 전투 스킬이 늘면 벌목용 도끼를 무기로 장착할 수 있게 될 거예요. 효과가 썩 좋진 않지만, 통나무 하나를 더 넣을 칸이 생기죠.

english: Goodbye.

Wow! It's not often I meet somebody as accomplished as you in Woodcutting! Perhaps you should become the tutor, instead of me! Seeing as you're so skilled, maybe you are interested in buying a Skillcape of
translation: 와! 당신만큼 벌목에 능숙한 분은 정말 드물어요! 제가 아니라 당신이 교사가 돼야겠는데요! 그렇게 실력이 좋으시니, 혹시 Skillcape of Woodcutting(벌목 스킬 망토)를

english: Woodcutting?
No, thanks.
Ok, come back to me if you change your mind.
Yes, please.
I can't sell you one here. Try talking to me later.
translation: 여기서는 팔 수가 없어요. 나중에 다시 말 걸어 주세요.

english: Anybody who has spent as much time cutting trees as you deserves the right to own one. Wearing this cape will increase your chance of finding bird's nests. That'll be 99000 coins, please.
translation: 당신만큼 나무 베는 데 시간을 쏟은 사람이라면 하나 가질 자격이 충분해요. 이 망토를 입으면 새 둥지를 찾을 확률이 올라가요. 99000코인입니다.

english: 99000! That's too rich for me.
Well go chop down a few mahogany trees and sell the timber; then you'll be able to afford one.
translation: 그럼 mahogany(마호가니) 나무를 몇 그루 베어서 목재를 파세요. 그러면 살 수 있을 거예요.

english: No problem.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 안타깝게도 지금 가진 돈이 부족하네요.

english: Well come back and see me when you do.
Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭해요! 자부심을 갖고 그 망토를 입으세요, 친구.

english: Can you teach me the basics of Woodcutting and Firemaking, please?
translation: 벌목이랑 불 피우기 기초를 가르쳐 주실 수 있나요?

english: What is that cape you're wearing?
I already know a bit about Woodcutting and Firemaking, any tips?
translation: 벌목이랑 불 피우기는 조금 알아요. 팁 있나요?

english: Any advice for an advanced woodcutter?
Tell me about different trees and axes.
translation: 여러 나무와 도끼에 대해 알려 주세요.

english: Oak and Willow
Maple and Yew
Magic and other trees
Axes
Go back to teaching
Goodbye
No, thanks.
Yes, please
99000! That's too rich for me.
No problem.
Hello there.
Leave me alone. I have work to do.
translation: 날 좀 내버려 둬요. 할 일이 있다고요.

english: Whatever you want, the answer's no.
I don't have time to talk to you.
Please don't disturb me.
I'm busy right now.
Hello.
Hey there!
You seem rather happy for a busy labourer with a bad case of spots.
translation: 얼굴에 뾰루지가 잔뜩 난 바쁜 일꾼치고는 꽤 즐거워 보이네요.

english: Of course! These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
translation: 당연하죠! 이 뾰루지는 통나무 굴림대 이후로 나온 최고의 발명품이라고요!

english: I really don't follow.
Well thanks to these spots, the city has been under quarantine. That means there's no goods coming in or out. No goods means we don't have any work to do!
translation: 그러니까, 이 뾰루지 덕분에 도시가 격리됐잖아요. 물건이 들어오지도 나가지도 않는다는 거죠. 물건이 없으니 우리가 할 일도 없고요!

english: But aren't the spots intolerable?
translation: 그래도 뾰루지 때문에 못 견디게 괴롭지 않아요?

english: I would take a dermatological irritation over back-breaking, mind-numbing labour any day!
translation: 허리 휘고 머리가 멍해지는 노동보다는 피부 가려움증이 언제든 백배 낫죠!

english: Right... Okay then...
Hey.
What's wrong?
The High Priest has determined that these spots aren't contagious. He's opened the city up again, which means we have to go back to work.
translation: High Priest(대사제)님이 이 뾰루지는 전염되지 않는다고 판단하셨어요. 도시를 다시 열어 버리셨으니, 우린 다시 일하러 가야 해요.

english: Now that all the plagues have been cured, we've had to go back to work.
translation: 역병이 전부 치료되는 바람에 다시 일하러 가야 했어요.

english: Cheer up! Work can't be that bad.
translation: 힘내요! 일이 그렇게 나쁠 리가 있나요.

english: You have no idea...
What are you doing?
I have this acne potion that I thought might clear up your spots?
translation: 뾰루지를 없애 줄지도 모르는 여드름 물약이 있는데요?

english: What, so that I can get back to work?
So that you don't suffer needlessly?
I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun! I won't have it!
translation: 당신 같은 부류 잘 알아요. 서민의 낙을 망치려 드는 사람이죠! 그렇게는 못 둬요!

english: Look, I'm sorry. I only wanted to help you.
translation: 저기, 미안해요. 그냥 도와드리고 싶었을 뿐이에요.

english: Clear off!
No, I don't want to buy anything.
Can't stop to talk. I have work to do.
translation: 얘기할 틈 없어요. 할 일이 있어서요.

english: Hello there!
Oh, hello.
How are things going up here?
The beast still rages, but we're managing.
translation: 그 야수는 여전히 날뛰지만, 그럭저럭 버티고 있어요.

english: Plenty of treasure and materials to be found in the tunnels, at least!
translation: 그래도 터널에서 보물이랑 자재가 잔뜩 나와요!

english: What will you do with it all?
The raw materials will be used to maintain Cam Torum. As for everything else, if you help us, you're allowed a share of the treasures.
translation: 원자재는 Cam Torum(캠 토룸)을 유지하는 데 쓰여요. 나머지는, 우리를 도와주면 보물을 나눠 가질 수 있어요.

english: That's very generous, thank you.
Hello!
Hmm? Did you say something?
I said hello.
Oh, that's nice.
Are you okay?
Why wouldn't I be? I'm not the one lost in the mountain!
translation: 내가 왜 안 괜찮겠어요? 산속에서 길 잃은 건 내가 아닌데!

english: Excuse me? Who's lost in the mountain?
Karlo! Oh sweet Karlo... An inspiration to us all!
translation: Karlo(칼로)요! 오, 사랑스러운 칼로... 우리 모두의 귀감이었죠!

english: He really knew how to swing a pickaxe, but where did that get him?!
translation: 곡괭이질 하나는 정말 끝내줬는데, 그래서 결국 어떻게 됐냐고요?!

english: Trapped in the depths under all that rock and stone...
translation: 저 모든 바위와 돌 밑 깊은 곳에 갇혀 버렸죠...

english: Do you think he's still alive?
I don't know.
What I do know is that I do this for Karlo. Let's make him proud!
translation: 확실한 건, 내가 이 일을 Karlo(칼로)를 위해 한다는 거예요. 그가 자랑스러워하게 만들자고요!

english: For Karlo!
For Karlo!
Into the tunnels, quick!
Let's go!
Quickly, while it's recovering!
What's it left this time?
It's coming back!
Prepare yourselves!
Retreat!
Run!
Hi there.
Can I help you?
I don't know. Can you?
Probably not. I'm on break.
translation: 아마 못 할걸요. 저 쉬는 중이거든요.

english: Break from what?
See that big mountain outside? That's the Darkfrost. There's a nice beastie up there called the Hueycoatl.
translation: 밖에 저 큰 산 보여요? 저게 Darkfrost(다크프로스트)예요. 거기 위에 Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)이라는 아주 귀여운 녀석이 하나 있죠.

english: You humans don't seem to care that much, so as usual it's up to us to stop it making a big mess of the entire area.
translation: 당신네 인간들은 별로 신경 안 쓰는 것 같으니, 늘 그렇듯 그 녀석이 이 일대를 엉망으로 만들지 못하게 막는 건 우리 몫이에요.

english: Hello again. Still on break?
I am. Dealing with the Hueycoatl is hard work, and it's not like you humans care enough to contribute much.
translation: 네. Hueycoatl(후에이코아틀)을 상대하는 건 힘든 일인데, 당신네 인간들은 도울 만큼 신경을 쓰지도 않잖아요.

english: Well, if you're in need of help, I'm open to contributing.
translation: 도움이 필요하다면 저도 기꺼이 힘을 보탤게요.

english: You are? Oh... Fair enough then. In that case, head on up the mountain and get stuck in.
translation: 그래요? 아... 그럼 됐어요. 그렇다면 산 위로 올라가서 본격적으로 덤벼 보세요.

english: Well, I've actually been up there helping myself.
translation: 사실 저도 이미 거기 올라가서 돕고 있었어요.

english: You have? Oh... Fair enough then. I guess you've earned yourself a break as well.
translation: 그래요? 아... 그렇군요. 그럼 당신도 쉴 자격이 있겠네요.

english: Hello there. How's it going?
Sorry, but I have lots of work to do.
Not too bad, but the work is definitely tiring.
translation: 그럭저럭요. 그런데 일이 확실히 고되긴 해요.

english: Well I could do with a good rest, but fine otherwise.
translation: 푹 좀 쉬었으면 좋겠지만, 그거 말고는 괜찮아요.

english: Sorry, but I'm busy right now.
Busy, busy, busy.
Hiya.
What do you want? I've got work to do!
Can you teach me anything?
translation: 뭐 좀 가르쳐 주실 수 있어요?

english: No - I've got one lousy apprentice already, and that's quite enough hassle! Go away!
translation: 안 돼. 쓸모없는 견습생이 이미 하나 있는데, 그것만으로도 골치 아프다고! 저리 가!

english: Got another load for ya!
Great, just what my arms need!
Ohhh, time for a break.
Time I got moving...
Keep 'em coming!
Bleah
Another lot for ya!
Alright, thanks!
Off we go again!
How's it going, officers?
Another boring day.
Nothing new there.
I'm being slaughtered!
Oh, they're all dead.
Don't dawdle there!
Yeah, yeah, I'm movin' guv.
Hmm, time for a break.
You there! Over here! Let's have a little chat before you head up there!
translation: 자네! 이리 오게! 저 위로 올라가기 전에 잠깐 얘기 좀 나누세!

english: Hello.
Hello there, my short-tongued friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 반갑네, 혀 짧은 친구. 무엇을 도와줄까?

english: What are you doing here?
What do you think I'm doing here?
translation: 내가 여기서 뭘 하고 있을 것 같나?

english: I wouldn't like to guess.
How disappointing. I enjoy a good guessing game! No matter. My colleague and I are here are on a mission of preservation!
translation: 실망스럽군. 난 추측 놀이를 아주 좋아하는데! 상관없네. 내 동료와 나는 보존 임무를 수행하러 이곳에 왔다네!

english: Preservation of what?
Preservation of these magnificent colossal wyrm remains, of course! You see, we have a termite problem.
translation: 당연히 이 웅장한 colossal wyrm(거대 웜)의 유해를 보존하는 것이지! 보다시피 우리에겐 흰개미 문제가 있다네.

english: I'm beginning to see your role in all of this.
translation: 이 일에서 당신이 맡은 역할이 뭔지 알 것 같네요.

english: Indeed! And while my archaeological skills are certainly exemplary, I also bring a certain set of more unique skills to this troublesome assignment.
translation: 그렇다네! 내 고고학 실력도 물론 모범적이지만, 이 골치 아픈 임무에 좀 더 독특한 기술도 가져왔지.

english: Oh for goodness sake, he just eats the termites!
translation: 아 진짜, 저 사람은 그냥 흰개미를 먹는 거예요!

english: Ahem! I am able to dispose of the termites in ways others cannot.
translation: 에헴! 나는 남들은 못 하는 방식으로 흰개미를 처리할 수 있다네.

english: I see. So can I help your preservation efforts?
translation: 그렇군요. 그럼 제가 보존 작업을 도울 수 있을까요?

english: Why yes! It seems our scaffolding has proven to be a useful place for adventurous types to practice running and jumping in quick succession.
translation: 물론이지! 우리 비계가 모험심 강한 이들이 달리기와 연속 점프를 연습하기에 쓸모 있는 장소로 자리 잡은 모양일세.

english: Should you also wish to practice these skills, you may come across the aforementioned termites while you traverse the ropes. Simply scoop them up and bring them to me.
translation: 자네도 그런 기술을 연습하고 싶다면, 밧줄을 건너다가 앞서 말한 흰개미를 만날 수도 있을 걸세. 그냥 퍼 담아서 내게 가져오게.

english: I'll happily exchange them for some goodies I've collected during my time here! You can also keep any bone shards they may have unfortunately chipped off.
translation: 내가 여기 있는 동안 모아 둔 좋은 물건들과 기꺼이 바꿔 주겠네! 녀석들이 안타깝게도 갉아 떨어뜨린 뼛조각도 가져도 좋네.

english: Sounds simple enough!
Wonderful! To get started, just use the ladder by the wyrm's skull to climb up onto the scaffolding.
translation: 훌륭하군! 시작하려면 wyrm(웜) 두개골 옆 사다리를 타고 비계 위로 올라가게.

english: Initially the route is the same for everyone, but part way round you'll find a loftier section of scaffolding. If you're skilled, that route might be more appealing to you.
translation: 처음엔 모두 같은 경로지만, 중간쯤 가면 더 높은 비계 구간이 나올 걸세. 실력이 있다면 그 길이 더 끌릴지도 모르지.

english: That said, don't go up there unless you know what you're doing. I have work to do so I can't spend all my time patching people up when they hurt themselves!
translation: 그렇긴 하지만, 뭘 하는지 모르면 거기 올라가지 말게. 나도 할 일이 있어서 다친 사람들 치료하는 데 시간을 다 쓸 수는 없단 말일세!

english: You'll need at least 50 Agility to tackle the basic course and 62 Agility to take on the advanced course.
translation: 기본 코스에 도전하려면 Agility(민첩)이 최소 50, 고급 코스에 도전하려면 62가 필요하다네.

english: Great, thanks!
Good luck!
Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 여기서 뭐 하고 계신다고요?

english: Would you like to trade?
I certainly would!
How am I doing so far?
Which route would you like to know about?
You haven't completed any laps of the basic agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 자네는 아직 기본 민첩 코스를 한 바퀴도 완주하지 않았네. 전체 완주 횟수는 X회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 X일세.

english: You haven't completed any laps of the advanced agility course yet. There's been X global completions and the global best time is X.
translation: 자네는 아직 고급 민첩 코스를 한 바퀴도 완주하지 않았네. 전체 완주 횟수는 X회이고, 전체 최고 기록은 X일세.

english: I'd better get going.
Farewell.
Remind me, what are you doing here?
translation: 다시 알려 주세요, 여기서 뭐 하고 계신다고요?

english: Would you like to trade?
How am I doing so far?
Colossal Wyrm Basic Course.
translation: Colossal Wyrm Basic Course(거대 웜 기본 코스).

english: Colossal Wyrm Advanced Course.
translation: Colossal Wyrm Advanced Course(거대 웜 고급 코스).

english: I'd better get going.
Whut you want?
What are you in for?
Me not sure. Me pick some stuff up and take it away.
translation: 나 잘 몰라. 나 물건 좀 집어서 가져감.

english: Well, did the stuff belong to you?
Umm...no.
Well, that would be why then.
Oh, right.
Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
I believe you've got piece of a map that I need.
translation: 네가 내게 필요한 지도 조각을 갖고 있다고 들었어.

english: So? Why should I be giving it to you? What you do for Wormbrain?
translation: 그래서? 왜 나 그거 너 줘야 함? 너 Wormbrain(웜브레인) 위해 뭐 해 줌?

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: 너한테 해 줄 건 아무것도 없어. 됐어.

english: Be dat way then.
I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
translation: 살려는 줄게. 그냥 죽여 버릴 수도 있지만.

english: Ha! Me in here and you out dere. You not get map piece.
translation: 하! 나 여기 안, 너 거기 밖. 너 지도 조각 못 가짐.

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece. Say, 500 coins?
translation: 지도 조각 값을 쳐 줄 수도 있어. 500코인 어때?

english: Me not stoopid, it worth at least 10,000 coins!
translation: 나 안 멍청함, 그거 최소 10,000코인 가치 있음!

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
Fine, you not get map piece.
translation: 좋아, 너 지도 조각 못 가짐.

english: Oops, I don't have enough on me.
Comes back when you has enough.
Alright then, 10,000 coins it is.
Fank you very much! Now me can bribe da guards, hehehe.
translation: 고맙다 마니! 이제 나 경비들 뇌물 줄 수 있음, 헤헤헤.

english: Where did you get the map piece from?
We rob house of stupid wizard. She very old, not put up much fight at all. Hahaha!
translation: 우리 멍청한 마법사 집 털었음. 그 여자 엄청 늙음, 별로 안 싸웠음. 하하하!

english: Uh... Hahaha.
Her house full of pictures of a city on island and old pictures of people. Me not recognise island.
translation: 그 여자 집에 섬 위 도시 그림이랑 옛날 사람 그림 가득. 나 그 섬 모름.

english: Me find map piece. Me not know what it is, but it in locked box so me figure it important.
translation: 나 지도 조각 찾음. 뭔지 모르지만 잠긴 상자에 있어서 중요하다 생각함.

english: But, by the time me get box open, other goblins gone. Then me not run fast enough and guards catch me.
translation: 근데 나 상자 열었을 때 다른 goblins(고블린) 다 가 버림. 그리고 나 빨리 못 뛰어서 경비들한테 잡힘.

english: But now you want map piece so must be special! What you do for me to get it?
translation: 근데 이제 너 지도 조각 원함, 그러니까 특별한 거! 그거 가지려면 너 나한테 뭐 해 줄 거?

english: You have just beaten Wormbrain up. Give the poor goblin a break.
translation: 방금 Wormbrain(웜브레인)을 두들겨 팼다. 불쌍한 고블린 좀 봐주자.

english: You have already taken Wormbrain's map piece. There is no use in beating him up further.
translation: 이미 Wormbrain(웜브레인)의 지도 조각을 가져갔다. 더 때려 봤자 소용없다.

english: What are you in for?
Sorry, thought this was a zoo.
I believe you've got a piece of map that I need.
translation: 네가 내게 필요한 지도 조각을 갖고 있다고 들었어.

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: 너한테 해 줄 건 아무것도 없어. 됐어.

english: I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
translation: 살려는 줄게. 그냥 죽여 버릴 수도 있지만.

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece...
translation: 지도 조각 값을 쳐 줄 수도 있어...

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
Alright then, 10,000 it is.
Where did you get the map piece from?
Hello there friend.
Oh..what am I to do, Christmas is ruined.
What's the matter?
Christmas is ruined, my bakery is ruined, everything is ruined!
translation: 크리스마스도 망했고, 제 빵집도 망했고, 전부 다 망했어요!

english: Maybe this has something to do with Santa in Varrock Square.
translation: Varrock Square(바록 광장)에 있는 Santa(산타)랑 관련된 일인 것 같네요.

english: Adventurer! You've come at the right time. I need your help.
translation: 모험가님! 마침 잘 오셨어요. 도움이 필요해요.

english: Could this have something to do with some missing Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 혹시 사라진 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)이랑 관련된 일인가요?

english: How did you know?
Santa told me to sort it out for him, he said his son has taken over the Gingerbread Gnome production.
translation: Santa(산타)가 저한테 대신 해결해 달라고 했어요. 자기 아들이 Gingerbread Gnome(진저브레드 노움) 생산을 장악했다고 하더라고요.

english: He has been an absolute disaster, he suddenly showed up and took control of our bakery. We tried to stop him, but he locked up the two other bakers!
translation: 그 사람 완전 재앙이에요. 갑자기 나타나서 우리 빵집을 차지해 버렸어요. 막아 보려고 했지만 다른 제빵사 두 명을 가둬 버렸어요!

english: How did you manage to escape?
Well... I don't think he knows how Gingerbread Gnomes are made, he brought in an Icelord to ice the gingerbread.
translation: 그게... 그 사람은 Gingerbread Gnomes(진저브레드 노움)을 어떻게 만드는지 모르는 것 같아요. 진저브레드에 아이싱을 하겠다고 Icelord(아이스로드)를 데려왔다니까요.

english: I threw a stone at it to cause a distraction, giving me a chance to escape. After I got out, I heard Jack lock the entrance behind me.
translation: 제가 그놈한테 돌을 던져서 주의를 돌린 틈에 빠져나왔어요. 나오고 나서 Jack(잭)이 뒤에서 입구를 잠그는 소리가 들렸어요.

english: He brought in an Icelord!? I don't know how to deal with one of those.
translation: Icelord(아이스로드)를 데려왔다고요!? 그런 건 어떻게 상대해야 할지 모르겠는데요.

english: It's terrifying! I think Jack must have a few screws loose to think that was a good idea.
translation: 끔찍하다니까요! Jack(잭)이 그게 좋은 생각이라고 여긴 걸 보면 나사가 몇 개 빠진 게 틀림없어요.

english: Well, I better tell Santa, since I can't get into the bakery from here....
translation: 음, 여기서는 빵집에 들어갈 수 없으니 Santa(산타)한테 알리는 게 좋겠어요....

english: Please hurry, we need to restart production as soon as possible.
translation: 서둘러 주세요, 최대한 빨리 생산을 재개해야 해요.

english: Have you managed to free the other bakers and stop Jack Frost yet?
translation: 다른 제빵사들은 풀어 주고 Jack Frost(잭 프로스트)도 막으셨어요?

english: Not yet, I'm still working on it.
Hurry we need to get back into production, before it's too late.
translation: 서둘러 주세요, 너무 늦기 전에 생산을 다시 시작해야 해요.

english: Got a medpack? I feel terrible.
translation: medpack(의료 키트) 있어? 몸이 말이 아니야.

english: What happened to you?
Lizardman bite. There's always a fever after you've been bitten by one of those. I'm sure they don't clean their teeth.
translation: lizardman(리자드맨)한테 물렸어. 그놈들한테 물리면 꼭 열이 나더라고. 이빨을 안 닦는 게 분명해.

english: Sorry, I haven't got one.
Try looking in the storage tents outside.
translation: 밖에 있는 보급 천막을 뒤져 봐.

english: Thanks for the medpack. I'm feeling a lot better now.
translation: medpack(의료 키트) 고마워. 이제 훨씬 나아졌어.

english: While you're here, you could help the war effort by fetching medpacks for my sick comrades. There'll be some in the storage tents outside.
translation: 온 김에 아픈 전우들한테 medpack(의료 키트)를 갖다주면 전쟁에 도움이 될 거야. 밖에 있는 보급 천막에 좀 있을 거야.

english: I'll bear that in mind.
Gimme a medpack - I need my strength back.
translation: medpack(의료 키트) 내놔. 힘을 되찾아야 한다고.

english: What happened to me is nothing compared to what's gonna happen to the filthy lizardman who did it. When I'm out of here, I'm gonna find him and fix him good.
translation: 내가 당한 건 날 이렇게 만든 더러운 lizardman(리자드맨) 놈이 당할 일에 비하면 아무것도 아니야. 여기서 나가기만 하면 그놈을 찾아내서 제대로 손봐 줄 거야.

english: Cheers. When I get back on my feet, there's gonna be one sorry lizardman out there.
translation: 고마워. 내가 다시 일어나면, 저 밖에 있는 lizardman(리자드맨) 한 놈은 땅을 치고 후회하게 될 거야.

english: Those lizardmen gotta die! Ya hear me? I want them all dead! All of 'em!
translation: lizardman(리자드맨) 놈들은 다 죽어야 해! 내 말 들려? 전부 죽여 버릴 거야! 한 놈도 빠짐없이!

english: Those ruffians hit me pretty hard. Have you got a medpack?
translation: 그 깡패 놈들한테 꽤 세게 맞았어. medpack(의료 키트) 있어?

english: Gangsters. I was on patrol in the docklands, but those Piscarilius scumbags lured me into an alley and hit me with a stick.
translation: 갱단 놈들이야. 부둣가를 순찰하고 있었는데, Piscarilius(피스카릴리우스)의 쓰레기 같은 놈들이 날 골목으로 꾀어내서 몽둥이로 때렸어.

english: Thanks. Hopefully I'll be back on patrol again soon.
translation: 고마워. 곧 다시 순찰에 나갈 수 있으면 좋겠어.

english: We'll never keep on top of the crime in this kingdom at this rate. Maybe you could help deal with some gangsters while you're in Kourend.
translation: 이대로라면 이 왕국의 범죄는 절대 못 잡아. Kourend(쿠렌드)에 있는 동안 갱단 놈들 처리하는 걸 좀 도와줘도 좋고.

english: I'm alright now. Try another soldier.
translation: 난 이제 괜찮아. 다른 병사한테 가 봐.

english: Oh dearie me...
Ooo-er...
Relapse over here!
Medic!
What happened to you?
Sorry, I haven't got one.
I'll bear that in mind.
Gah! You play like a donkey, don't just sit there, get up and get the ball back!
translation: 으악! 당나귀처럼 뛰는구나, 그냥 앉아 있지 말고 일어나서 공 다시 뺏어 와!

english: Hello?
That's more like it, get in there!
Excuse me?
Oof. That's got to hurt.
You think this guy is far too engrossed in the sport to pay any attention to anything else.
translation: 이 사람은 경기에 너무 빠져 있어서 다른 건 전혀 신경 쓰지 않을 것 같다.

english: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!
translation: 손님은 찾았지만 맞는 음식을 가져오지 않은 것 같습니다! [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]이(가) 필요합니다!

english: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.
translation: 미리 만들어진 요리는 안 됩니다. Aluft Aloft(알루프트 알로프트)의 손님에게는 직접 만든 Gnome Cuisine(노움 요리)만이 어울립니다.

english: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] to Wurbel
translation: Wurbel(워블)에게 [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item] 배달을 건넸습니다.

english: Come on guys, I've got a blurberry special riding on this one. Oh my order? Thanks.
translation: 힘내라, 얘들아! 이 경기에 blurberry special(블러베리 스페셜)을 걸었다고. 아, 내 주문? 고마워.

english: You have [number] credits towards your free delivery token. You may get [number] pieces of gnome food delivered to you.
translation: 무료 배달 토큰까지 [number] 크레딧을 모았습니다. 노움 음식 [number]개를 배달받을 수 있습니다.

english: Don't forget to pick up your free delivery token from Aluft Gianne jnr.
translation: Aluft Gianne jnr.(알루프트 지안 주니어)에게서 무료 배달 토큰을 꼭 받아 가세요.

english: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
translation: 배달이 너무 늦었습니다! Aluft jnr.(알루프트 주니어)에게 돌아가 새 주문을 받으세요. 더 이상 필요 없는 배달 상자는 버렸습니다.

english: Welcome to my food store! Would you like to buy anything?
translation: 제 식료품 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요! 뭐 사실 거 있으세요?

english: Yes please.
No, thank you.
What can you recommend?
We have this really exotic fruit all the way from Karamja. It's called a banana.
translation: Karamja(카람자)에서 온 정말 이국적인 과일이 있어요. banana(바나나)라고 하죠.

english: Hmm, I think I'll try one.
Great. You might as well take a look at the rest of my wares as well.
translation: 좋아요. 온 김에 다른 물건들도 한번 둘러보세요.

english: I don't like the sound of that.
Well, it's your choice, but I do recommend them.
translation: 뭐, 선택은 손님 몫이지만 저는 정말 추천해요.

english: Is it nice and tidy round the back now?
Yes, can I work out front now?
No, I'm the one who works here.
translation: 아뇨, 여기 앞은 제가 보는 자리예요.

english: Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
Umm... No, not yet.
No, it's a complete mess.
Ah well, it'll give you something to do, won't it.
translation: 아, 뭐, 그럼 할 일이 생겨서 좋잖아요.

english: Can I buy something please?
Yes, of course.
Yes please.
No, thank you.
What can you recommend?
Hmm, I think I'll try one.
I don't like the sound of that.
Yes, can I work out front now?
Yes, are you going to pay me yet?
No, it's a complete mess
Can I buy something please?
I'm the head gardener around here. If you're looking for woad leaves, or if you need help with owt, I'm yer man.
translation: 내가 이 동네 수석 정원사라네. woad leaves(대청 잎)을 찾거나 뭐든 도움이 필요하면 나한테 말하게나.

english: Yes please, I need woad leaves.
How much are you willing to pay?
How about 5 coins?
No no, that's far too little. Woad leaves are hard to get. I used to have plenty but someone kept stealing them off me.
translation: 아니, 아니, 그건 너무 적구먼. woad leaves(대청 잎)은 구하기 힘들다네. 전엔 잔뜩 있었는데 누가 자꾸 훔쳐 갔거든.

english: How about 10 coins?
How about 15 coins?
Mmmm... okay, that sounds fair.
I don't have enough coins to buy the leaves. I'll come back later.
translation: 잎을 살 코인이 부족해요. 나중에 다시 올게요.

english: Thanks.
I'll be around if you have any more gardening needs.
translation: 정원 일로 또 필요한 게 있으면 난 이 근처에 있을 걸세.

english: How about 20 coins?
Okay, that's more than fair.
Here, have two, you're a generous person.
translation: 옜네, 두 개 가져가게. 자넨 인심이 후하구먼.

english: How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: 그럼 제가 대신 아저씨를 도와드리는 건 어때요?

english: That's a nice thing to say. I do need a hand, now you mention it. You see, there's some stupid mole digging up my lovely garden.
translation: 거참 고마운 말이구먼. 그러고 보니 일손이 좀 필요하긴 하다네. 실은 멍청한 두더지 한 마리가 내 아름다운 정원을 파헤치고 있거든.

english: A mole? Surely you've dealt with moles in the past?
translation: 두더지요? 두더지쯤은 전에도 상대해 보셨을 거 아니에요?

english: Ah, well this is no ordinary mole! He's a big'un for sure. Ya see... I'm always relied upon to make the most of this 'ere garden - the faster and bigger I can grow plants the better!
translation: 아, 이건 보통 두더지가 아니라네! 확실히 덩치가 엄청나지. 그러니까... 다들 내가 이 정원을 최대한 잘 가꾸길 기대하거든. 식물을 빨리, 크게 키울수록 좋은 거지!

english: In my quest for perfection I looked into 'Malignius- Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion'. It worked well on my plants, no doubt about it! But it had the same effect on a nearby mole. Ya can imagine the
translation: 완벽을 추구하다가 'Malignius- Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion(말리그니우스 모르티퍼의 슈퍼 울트라 식물 성장 물약)'에 손을 댔지. 내 식물엔 효과가 끝내줬다네, 틀림없이! 그런데 근처 두더지한테도 똑같은 효과가 나 버렸지 뭔가. 그 녀석이

english: havoc he causes to my patches of sunflowers! Why, if any of the other gardeners knew about this mole, I'd be looking for a new job in no time!
translation: 내 해바라기 밭을 얼마나 엉망으로 만드는지 상상이 갈 걸세! 이런, 다른 정원사들이 이 두더지 일을 알기라도 하면 난 금세 새 일자리를 찾아야 할 거야!

english: I see. What do you need me to do?
If ya are willing maybe yer wouldn't mind killing it for me? Take a spade and use it to shake up them mole hills. Be careful though, he really is big!
translation: 자네만 괜찮다면 그 녀석을 좀 처치해 주지 않겠나? spade(삽)을 가져가서 두더지 굴 흙더미를 들쑤셔 보게. 그래도 조심하게, 그놈 정말 크다네!

english: Is there anything in this for me?
Well, if yer gets any mole skin or mole claws off 'un, I'd trade 'em for bird nests if ye brings 'em here to me.
translation: 글쎄, 그놈한테서 mole skin(두더지 가죽)이나 mole claws(두더지 발톱)을 얻어서 여기 가져오면 bird nests(새 둥지)랑 바꿔 주겠네.

english: Right, I'll bear it in mind.
Sorry, but I'm not interested.
Fair enough.
If I'm not mistaken, you've got some body parts from a big mole there! I'll trade it for bird nests if ye likes. Or was ye wantin' some woad leaves instead?
translation: 내 눈이 틀리지 않았다면 자네, 거대한 두더지 부위를 갖고 있구먼! 원한다면 bird nests(새 둥지)랑 바꿔 주겠네. 아니면 woad leaves(대청 잎)이 필요했던 건가?

english: Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
Here, have this.
Yes please, I need woad leaves.
How about 5 coins?
How about 10 coins?
How about 15 coins?
How about 20 coins?
How about ME helping YOU instead?
translation: 그럼 제가 대신 아저씨를 도와드리는 건 어때요?

english: Sorry, but I'm not interested.
Okay, I will trade the mole parts.
Greetings human. Do you seek guidance?
Who are you?
I am Xorrah quo Sihar. I am one of the mystics of the Kahlith.
translation: 저는 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)입니다. Kahlith(칼리스)의 신비술사 중 한 명이지요.

english: Kahlith?
Yes. At one time we were like you, but then we met the Tasakaal. They taught us to have purpose. They taught us to serve the balance.
translation: 그렇습니다. 한때 저희도 당신들과 같았으나, Tasakaal(타사칼)을 만났습니다. 그분들은 저희에게 목적을 갖는 법을, 균형을 섬기는 법을 가르쳐 주셨습니다.

english: Our old lives were left behind. In their place, the Kahlith were born.
translation: 저희는 옛 삶을 버렸습니다. 그 자리에서 Kahlith(칼리스)가 태어났지요.

english: Tasakaal?
Our teachers. They showed us the way and taught us to serve the balance.
translation: 저희의 스승들입니다. 그분들은 저희에게 길을 보여 주시고 균형을 섬기는 법을 가르쳐 주셨습니다.

english: The balance?
For every death, there must be life. For every life, there must be a death. This is the balance.
translation: 모든 죽음에는 삶이 있어야 하고, 모든 삶에는 죽음이 있어야 합니다. 이것이 균형입니다.

english: Our purpose, as taught to us by the Tasakaal, is to keep this balance, no matter the cost.
translation: Tasakaal(타사칼)에게서 배운 저희의 목적은, 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 이 균형을 지키는 것입니다.

english: A mystic?
Yes. All Kahlith serve the balance. To do this, we take on one of four roles.
translation: 그렇습니다. 모든 Kahlith(칼리스)는 균형을 섬깁니다. 이를 위해 저희는 네 가지 역할 중 하나를 맡습니다.

english: My role is that of a mystic. I learn from the Tasakaal and then pass on their teachings.
translation: 제 역할은 신비술사입니다. Tasakaal(타사칼)에게서 배우고, 그 가르침을 전하지요.

english: That's all thanks.
What is this place?
This is our home. In your tongue, it is known as Mount Karuulm.
translation: 이곳은 저희의 고향입니다. 당신들의 말로는 Mount Karuulm(카룰름 산)이라고 하지요.

english: My tongue?
Yes. You speak the language of humans but we Kahlith have our own language.
translation: 그렇습니다. 당신은 인간의 언어를 쓰지만, 저희 Kahlith(칼리스)에게는 저희만의 언어가 있습니다.

english: In the past, we have tried to teach our language to your kind. However, despite the simplicity of our tongue, success was limited.
translation: 예전에 당신네 종족에게 저희 언어를 가르치려 한 적이 있습니다. 하지만 저희 말이 단순한데도 성과는 신통치 않았습니다.

english: We find that it is easier to just use your language when your kind are around.
translation: 그래서 당신네 종족이 곁에 있을 때는 그냥 당신들의 언어를 쓰는 편이 쉽다는 걸 알게 되었습니다.

english: Can you give an example?
Of our language?
Yes please.
Well you'll find our language is quite a simple one. Our names are a good example of how it is used.
translation: 보시면 알겠지만 저희 언어는 꽤 단순합니다. 저희 이름이 그 쓰임을 보여 주는 좋은 예지요.

english: I am Xorrah quo Sihar. The first word, 'Xorrah', is unique to me and it is how I can be identified.
translation: 저는 Xorrah quo Sihar(조라 쿠오 시하르)입니다. 첫 단어인 'Xorrah(조라)'는 저만의 것으로, 저를 가리키는 이름입니다.

english: The second word, 'quo', is a basic Kahlith word that translates to 'the' in your language.
translation: 두 번째 단어인 'quo(쿠오)'는 Kahlith(칼리스)의 기본 단어로, 당신네 말로는 이름과 칭호를 잇는 'the'에 해당합니다.

english: The final word, 'Sihar', is my title. There are four possible titles, one for each role in Kahlith society. My title translates to 'Mystic' in your tongue.
translation: 마지막 단어인 'Sihar(시하르)'는 제 칭호입니다. 칭호는 네 가지로, Kahlith(칼리스) 사회의 역할마다 하나씩 있습니다. 제 칭호는 당신네 말로 '신비술사'라는 뜻입니다.
