english: So in my language your name would be Xorrah the Mystic?
translation: 그럼 제 언어로 하면 당신 이름은 '신비술사 조라'가 되는 거네요?

english: Exactly.
Interesting. Thanks for the information.
I'm good thanks.
Who are you?
Kahlith?
Tasakaal?
The balance?
What is this place?
That's all thanks.
A mystic?
My tongue?
Can you give an example?
I'm good thanks.
Ahhh, hello there, [player name].
Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: skillcapes(스킬 망토)에 대해 좀 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: Sure. You can buy a skillcape when you reach level 99 in a skill. Apart from boosting your statistics in that skill, they can also be used to perform some pretty amazing emotes!
translation: 물론이지. 스킬 하나가 99레벨에 도달하면 스킬 망토를 살 수 있다네. 그 스킬의 능력치를 올려 줄 뿐 아니라, 꽤 멋진 감정 표현도 할 수 있지!

english: The Cape of Strength also provides you with unlimited teleports to our guild. Is there anything else you would like to know?
translation: Cape of Strength(힘 망토)는 우리 길드로 무제한 순간이동도 시켜 준다네. 또 알고 싶은 게 있나?

english: What can I do here?
Ahh, the shot put is a great test of strength and can be quite rewarding. Mind you do it properly though, you might want to dust your hands with some powdery substance first. It'll give better grip.
translation: 아아, shot put(포환던지기)는 힘을 시험하기에 아주 좋고 보상도 꽤 쏠쏠하지. 다만 제대로 해야 하네. 먼저 가루 같은 걸 손에 묻혀 두는 게 좋을 걸세. 그러면 더 단단히 잡을 수 있지.

english: I'll remember that. What should I use?
I personally prefer ground ashes, it makes a nice fine powder and gives some really good grip.
translation: 나는 개인적으로 ground ashes(빻은 재)를 좋아하네. 고운 가루가 되어서 정말 잘 잡히거든.

english: Ok, what else?
Basically you'll need to go in there, make sure you've got nothing cluttering up your hands, pick up a shot and throw it.... depending upon your technique, you can get quite long throws.
translation: 기본적으로 저 안에 들어가서, 손에 거치적거리는 게 없게 한 다음, 포환을 집어 던지면 된다네.... 기술에 따라선 꽤 멀리 던질 수도 있지.

english: What was your best?
Ahh that would be telling...
Why are you wielding a tree branch?
Well...there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-
translation: 음... 거기엔 사연이 있다네. 실은 내가 도끼를 들고 있어야 하는데-

english: Sloane's axe?
My axe. He won it because of a squirrel.
translation: 내 도끼일세. 다람쥐 때문에 그 친구가 따 갔지.

english: A squirrel?
He bet me that I couldn't catch the squirrel while still holding my axe, but that he could... Thing is, he tricked me! When it was his turn, he just chopped the tree down!
translation: 그 친구가 내기를 걸었지. 나는 도끼를 든 채로 다람쥐를 못 잡지만 자기는 잡을 수 있다고... 그런데 날 속였다네! 자기 차례가 되자 그냥 나무를 베어 넘겨 버리더군!

english: I see. That doesn't explain why you have a tree branch though.
translation: 그렇군요. 그래도 그걸로는 왜 나뭇가지를 들고 계신지 설명이 안 되는데요.

english: A barbarian warrior is bound to his axe, I cannot take up another unless my axe is ruined beyond repair. So I used part of the tree that Sloane cut down as my weapon...it also reminds me of him.
translation: 야만인 전사는 자기 도끼에 묶인 몸이라네. 도끼가 고칠 수 없을 만큼 망가지지 않는 한 다른 도끼를 들 수 없지. 그래서 Sloane(슬론)이 베어 넘긴 나무의 일부를 무기로 삼았네... 그 친구 생각도 나고 말일세.

english: He was a great warrior.
Yes, and a good friend, Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 그렇지, 좋은 친구이기도 했고. 그래도 그 친구는 자기가 이제 전사 형제들 곁에 있다는 걸 우리가 기뻐해 주길 바랄 걸세. 또 도와줄 일이 있나?

english: May I claim my tokens please?
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
translation: 안타깝지만 자넨 아직 토큰을 하나도 얻지 못했네. 길드 곳곳의 활동을 해 보면서 모아 보게.

english: Ok, I'll go see what I can find.
You don't have space to carry them.
translation: 자넨 그걸 들고 갈 공간이 없군.

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
Thanks!
Bye!
Be well, warrior [player name].
Ah, but I can see you are already as strong as is possible! Perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Strength, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
translation: 아, 그런데 자넨 이미 더할 나위 없이 강하구먼! 어쩌면 Cape of Strength(힘 망토)를 사서, 이 고된 스킬을 통달한 극소수의 정예에 들려고 날 찾아온 건가?

english: As an additional recognition of your achievement, the Cape of Strength can teleport you to our guild.
translation: 자네의 업적을 한층 더 인정하는 뜻으로, Cape of Strength(힘 망토)는 자네를 우리 길드로 순간이동시켜 줄 수 있다네.

english: May I have another hood for my cape, please?
translation: 망토에 맞는 두건을 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory, come back and see me when you do.
translation: 자네 소지품에 공간이 부족한 것 같군. 공간이 생기면 다시 찾아오게.

english: Most certainly, and free of charge!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Skillcape of Strength(힘 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Hmm, yes, you certainly look strong enough. That'll be 99000 gold coins, please.
translation: 흠, 그래, 확실히 충분히 강해 보이는군. 99000골드 코인일세.

english: Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
translation: 천만에, 그런 명예로운 물건을 사고 싶어 하는 모험가는 많다네! 마음이 바뀌면 여기로 날 찾아오게.

english: Sure.
But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.
translation: 그런데 아쉽게도 돈을 충분히 갖고 있지 않아요.

english: Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 안타깝게도 모든 Skillcapes(스킬 망토)는 두건이 무료로 딸려 나간다네. 스킬 판촉 행사의 일부거든. 하나 사면 하나 공짜, 알지? 그러니 내가 하나 팔려면 자네 소지품 공간을 좀 비워야 하네.

english: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
translation: 훌륭하군! 자부심을 갖고 그 망토를 두르게, 친구.

english: Can you tell me a bit about skillcapes?
translation: skillcapes(스킬 망토)에 대해 좀 알려 주실 수 있나요?

english: What can I do here?
Why are you wielding a tree branch?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Strength, please?
translation: Skillcape of Strength(힘 스킬 망토)를 살 수 있을까요?

english: Skillcape
Hood
Sorry, that's just too much to pay.
Sure.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너만큼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀었을 거야!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아까우면 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 꺼져, 이 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 아주 비참한 날이야, 정말이지... 끝나기 전에 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 못 봤어? 나 배가 무-지-막-지 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너, 피 맛을 제대로 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누가 좀 끼었거든...

english: Moo
Ah... [player name], welcome. I would offer you some water, but we don't get much of it down here.
translation: 아... [player name], 어서 오너라. 물이라도 대접하고 싶다만, 이 아래에서는 물이 귀하구나.

english: Thanks...
I take it you have questions.
I do, but it is important that it is you who is asking for information, not me that is offering it.
translation: 그렇다. 허나 중요한 건, 정보를 청하는 쪽은 네가 되어야 한다는 것이다. 내가 내어 주는 것이 아니라.

english: Okay... How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 알겠어요... 어떻게 아직도 추종자들과 소통하고 있는 거죠?

english: I take it you have answers.
I do, but I rarely share them umprompted.
translation: 그렇다. 허나 묻지도 않는데 내어 주는 일은 드물지.

english: Okay, how are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 좋아요, 어떻게 아직도 추종자들과 소통하고 있는 거죠?

english: Yes, a few of them actually. How are you still communicating with your followers?
translation: 네, 사실 몇 가지 있어요. 어떻게 아직도 추종자들과 소통하고 있는 거죠?

english: Why, through my voice, of course.
You know what I mean. How are you still communicating with your voice?
translation: 무슨 뜻인지 아시잖아요. 어떻게 아직도 그 목소리로 소통할 수 있냐고요.

english: The same way I always have.
But the dark nullifier... I thought it was supposed to sever your connection.
translation: 하지만 dark nullifier(어둠 무효화기)는... 당신의 연결을 끊어 놓을 거라고 생각했는데요.

english: Hmm... Yes, if anything could have done so, it would have been the power of the Dark Altar.
translation: 흠... 그래, 무언가가 그걸 해낼 수 있었다면, 그건 Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)의 힘이었겠지.

english: However, when your opponents have only one angle of approach, it makes them so predictable.
translation: 허나 상대가 다가올 길이 하나뿐이면, 그토록 뻔히 내다보이는 법이다.

english: You knew we would try to use it?
translation: 우리가 그걸 쓸 줄 알고 있었어요?

english: Yes. When I heard you would be hand delivering me a connection to the Dark Altar... Why, I was overjoyed.
translation: 그렇다. Dark Altar(어둠의 제단)과 이어진 물건을 네가 손수 내게 배달해 준다는 말을 들었을 때... 어찌나 기뻤던지.

english: But... I remember planting it! The plan went off without a hitch!
translation: 하지만... 분명히 제가 설치했던 게 기억나요! 계획은 아무 문제 없이 성공했다고요!

english: I do not doubt that you remember it that way.
translation: 네가 그렇게 기억한다는 건 의심치 않는다.

english: What did you do?!
A simple transfiguration of the mind. My disciples granted you a memory of success. A fitting payment for your gratiousservice.
translation: 정신을 살짝 변형했을 뿐이다. 내 제자들이 너에게 성공의 기억을 선사했지. 네 친절한 봉사에 걸맞은 보수였다.

english: You modified my memory?! That's only the second time someone has done that to me, and I wasn't very happy about it then either!
translation: 제 기억을 조작했다고요?! 누가 저한테 그런 짓을 한 게 이번이 두 번째인데, 그때도 전혀 기분 좋지 않았거든요!

english: Yes. And I have now answered five of your questions. I believe my generosity has been both demonstrated and exhausted.
translation: 그렇다. 그리고 이제 네 질문 다섯 개에 답해 주었다. 나의 관대함은 충분히 보여 주었고, 이제 바닥났다고 본다.

english: You call that gloating generosity? If you didn't want something from me, I wouldn't still be down here. Get to the point.
translation: 그렇게 잘난 척하는 게 관대함이에요? 저한테서 원하는 게 없었으면 저를 아직 여기 붙잡아 두지도 않았겠죠. 본론이나 말해요.

english: Hmm... Perhaps you are more astute than I thought. Very well, there is something that I want.
translation: 흠... 생각보다 눈치가 빠르구나. 좋다, 내가 원하는 것이 하나 있다.

english: Well you won't be getting it from me!
translation: 흥, 저한테서는 절대 못 얻을 거예요!

english: I am Yama. Every mortal desires something of mine. Ancient armaments? Hidden knowledge? Or perhaps a taste of revenge...
translation: 나는 Yama(야마)다. 필멸자라면 누구나 내 것을 탐내지. 고대의 무구? 숨겨진 지식? 아니면 복수의 맛이라도...

english: These things could be yours.
translation: 그 모든 것이 네 것이 될 수 있다.

english: Face me in combat. If you win, you take it all. Armaments, knowledge, revenge.
translation: 나와 겨루어라. 네가 이기면 전부 가져가라. 무구도, 지식도, 복수도.

english: And if I lose?
I take your soul. For all of eternity.
No thanks.
I see. Perhaps we could lower the stakes then.
translation: 그렇군. 그렇다면 판돈을 좀 낮춰 볼까.

english: I will face you in an inhibited form. I'll even allow you to bring an ally, provided they have entered the same contract.
translation: 힘을 억제한 모습으로 너를 상대해 주마. 같은 계약을 맺는다면 동료를 하나 데려오는 것도 허락하겠다.

english: If you win, I will give you a chance to gain some of my treasures, and of course, you will have sampled your revenge.
translation: 네가 이기면 내 보물 일부를 얻을 기회를 주겠다. 그리고 물론, 복수의 맛도 보게 되겠지.

english: When you take your final rest, I shall take your soul for a year. A drop in the ocean compared to eternity.
translation: 네가 마지막 안식에 들 때, 네 영혼을 1년 동안 가져가겠다. 영원에 비하면 바다에 떨어진 물 한 방울에 불과하지.

english: How can I know you'll keep your word?
translation: 약속을 지킬 거라고 제가 어떻게 믿죠?

english: The same way I will know you shall keep yours. A binding contract. As luck would have it, I had one of my scribes draft one up for just such an occasion.
translation: 네가 약속을 지킬 거라고 내가 믿는 것과 같은 방법으로. 구속력 있는 계약이다. 마침 운 좋게도, 바로 이런 때를 위해 서기에게 미리 한 장 작성해 두라 일렀지.

english: ...Okay.
Sign right here.
Excellent... Challenge me when you are ready, [player name]. I very much look forward to it.
translation: 훌륭하다... 준비가 되면 도전하거라, [player name]. 몹시 기대하고 있겠다.

english: I'm not sure I want to...
Of course. There is no rush. Leave, with your tail tucked between your legs. If you grow a spine and wish to fulfil your revenge, I will be waiting.
translation: 물론이지. 서두를 것 없다. 꼬리를 내리고 물러가거라. 배짱이 생겨서 복수를 이루고 싶어지거든, 기다리고 있으마.

english: You are back. Excellent. I have little time for cowards. If you are ready, I will retrieve the contract.
translation: 돌아왔구나. 훌륭하다. 겁쟁이에게 내줄 시간은 별로 없다. 준비가 되었다면 계약서를 가져오지.

english: Welcome, [player name]. Have you come to challenge me?
translation: 어서 오너라, [player name]. 내게 도전하러 왔느냐?

english: Yes. Let's do this.
Yama snaps his fingers and teleports off his throne.
Actually, I have some questions.
translation: 사실, 몇 가지 묻고 싶은 게 있어요.

english: Of course.
There's something in our contract about additional contracts... Why would I want to sign any more of them?
translation: 우리 계약서에 추가 계약에 관한 내용이 있던데요... 제가 왜 그걸 더 서명하고 싶겠어요?

english: As outlined in subsection C, if you wish for your revenge to feel more 'real', I am willing to lift some of the restrictions placed by the original contract.
translation: C항에 명시된 대로, 네 복수가 좀 더 '진짜'처럼 느껴지길 바란다면, 원래 계약에 걸어 둔 제약 일부를 풀어 줄 용의가 있다.

english: Why would I want that?
You seem to enjoy self-imposed difficulty. I thought I would indulge you.
translation: 너는 스스로 어려움을 짊어지는 걸 즐기는 것 같더구나. 그 취향을 맞춰 줄까 했지.

english: You may not, in which case you can sell them to someone with greater respect for themselves. But if you do, the option is there.
translation: 원치 않는다면, 너보다 자존심 있는 자에게 팔아 버려도 된다. 허나 원한다면, 선택지는 거기 있다.

english: And if you manage to claim victory, there is of course a reward for each contract.
translation: 그리고 승리를 거머쥔다면, 물론 계약마다 보상이 있다.

english: Okay, can I see the contracts?
translation: 알겠어요, 계약서들 좀 볼 수 있을까요?

english: No. For this, I require from you a service. My demons are... Lacking, of late. Unrefined.
translation: 안 된다. 그러려면 네가 나를 위해 일을 하나 해 줘야겠다. 내 악마들이... 요즘 부족하다. 다듬어지지 않았어.

english: They must fight, suffer and reform. If you deliver them specific ends during your 'tasks' in my domain, they may leave behind a contract.
translation: 놈들은 싸우고, 고통받고, 다시 태어나야 한다. 내 영역에서 '임무'를 하는 동안 놈들에게 특정한 최후를 안겨 준다면, 계약서를 떨어뜨릴지도 모른다.

english: And of course, if you defeat me, I may also reward you with one.
translation: 그리고 물론, 네가 나를 쓰러뜨린다면 나도 하나 상으로 줄지 모르지.

english: What kinds of 'ends'?
Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound. Each kind may award a different contract.
translation: 양손 근접 무기, 무거운 원거리 무기, 마법 주문, 특수 공격에 의한 죽음, 그리고 속박된 상태에서 쓰러뜨리는 것이다. 종류마다 다른 계약서가 나올 수 있다.

english: If you find yourself eager to obtain any contract, I will use a glyph to indicate my preferred method, which you can utilise for a better chance to receive that contract.
translation: 특정 계약서를 꼭 얻고 싶다면, 내가 선호하는 방식을 문양으로 표시해 주마. 그걸 활용하면 그 계약서를 얻을 확률이 높아질 게다.

english: What kinds of contracts can I obtain?
Were you more adept at reading you would find the details in our original contract. Otherwise, bring any you obtain to me and I shall explain then.
translation: 네가 글 읽는 데 좀 더 능숙했다면 원래 계약서에서 자세한 내용을 찾았겠지. 아니면 얻는 대로 가져오너라. 그때 설명해 주마.

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
translation: 우리 싸움에 대한 기록 같은 걸 남겨 두나요?

english: I do, I can have somebody retrieve your file. One moment.
translation: 그렇다. 누구를 시켜 네 서류를 가져오게 하지. 잠시 기다려라.

english: A mail-imp holding a scroll appears. Yama smites the imp.
translation: 두루마리를 든 우편 임프가 나타난다. Yama(야마)가 임프를 내리친다.

english: For your reading pleasure.
That's all.
No, I'd rather not.
I see. Perhaps you are just here to waste my time then? Return when you are not.
translation: 그렇군. 그렇다면 내 시간을 낭비하러 온 것이냐? 그럴 생각이 없을 때 다시 오너라.

english: Your strike lacks bite.
translation: 네 일격엔 날이 서 있지 않구나.

english: A change of pace.
Colabi, infernus
Ven, estella infernus
Colabesur infernus
Ven, umbra eclipta
Umbra, proriumpse
Umbra apprerendehe
Begone
You bore me.
Enough.
Lacking.
Pathetic.
The price is paid.
Fair is fair.
Your reward, as agreed.
A satisfying warmup. Collect your loot and let us continue.
A passing performance.
A close fight. Your nerve was well held.
translation: 아슬아슬한 싸움이었다. 배짱은 잘 버텨 냈구나.

english: A good risk, adequately rewarded.
translation: 좋은 모험이었고, 그에 걸맞은 보상을 받았구나.

english: Excellent performance. Again?
Effective, if a bit cowardly.
Risk averse, are we?
Missed the fine print, did we? Our contract forbids you from picking up stashed items.
translation: 깨알 같은 조항을 놓쳤나 보구나? 우리 계약은 숨겨 둔 물건을 줍는 걸 금하고 있다.

english: I hope you are finding the spoils from my treasury to your liking. There are plenty more for you to claim.
translation: 내 보물고의 전리품이 마음에 들었으면 좋겠구나. 네가 가져갈 것은 아직 많이 남아 있다.

english: Your victories mount. You are getting better at this.
translation: 승리가 쌓여 가는구나. 실력이 늘고 있어.

english: A victory earned. But there is room for improvement, is there not?
translation: 값진 승리다. 허나 아직 나아질 여지가 있지 않으냐?

english: Here we go again. I suppose it is entertaining watching you desperately guzzle potions, at the very least.
translation: 또 시작이로군. 적어도 네가 필사적으로 물약을 들이켜는 걸 구경하는 재미는 있지.

english: I must once again commend your strategy. Employing tactics so boring that they put your opponents to sleep is very novel.
translation: 너의 전략에 다시 한번 경의를 표하마. 상대를 잠들게 할 만큼 지루한 전술이라니, 참으로 참신하구나.

english: Back again I see. I can see how you find these bouts exhilarating, being such a feeble opponent.
translation: 또 왔구나. 너처럼 나약한 상대에게는 이런 승부가 짜릿하게 느껴지는 것도 무리는 아니지.

english: Your willingness to wager your soul continues to surprise. I suppose you think of it even less worth than I do.
translation: 네 영혼을 기꺼이 판돈으로 거는 모습은 볼 때마다 놀랍구나. 너는 그 가치를 나보다도 더 하찮게 여기나 보군.

english: : Honestly, I expected more. That it takes you as long as it does to defeat my inhibited form is rather embarrassing.
translation: 솔직히 더 기대했다. 억제된 모습의 나를 쓰러뜨리는 데 그만큼이나 오래 걸린다니, 꽤나 창피한 일이로구나.

english: You look happy with yourself. How endearing.
In any case, [player name], are you here to challenge me?
Don't let a single defeat set you back. You could have so many more.
translation: 한 번 졌다고 주저앉지 마라. 앞으로 질 일이 얼마든지 더 있을 테니.

english: My treasury remains over capacity. And here I was hoping to be relieved of some of its contents.
translation: 내 보물고는 여전히 넘쳐 나는구나. 내용물을 좀 덜어 주길 바랐건만.

english: What a shame for our last bout to have ended that way! Maybe you will do better next time.
translation: 지난 승부가 그렇게 끝나다니 안타깝구나! 다음엔 더 잘하겠지.

english: Back after being defeated so quickly? I suppose what you lack in skill you make up for with perseverance.
translation: 그렇게 빨리 지고서 또 왔느냐? 실력이 모자란 만큼 끈기로 메우는 모양이구나.

english: If you are struggling to achieve victory, I suppose avoiding defeat is the best you can do.
translation: 승리하기가 버겁다면, 패배를 피하는 게 네가 할 수 있는 최선이겠지.

english: You must be tired, having to run all the way back here.
Back for more? Well, you can always escape again I suppose.
translation: 더 하러 왔느냐? 뭐, 언제든 또 도망치면 되겠지.

english: Excellent work evading. Next time, try fighting back.
translation: 회피는 훌륭했다. 다음엔 맞서 싸워 보거라.

english: Our last bout was cut short. Perhaps the next will be more fruitful.
translation: 지난 승부는 중간에 끊겼지. 다음 승부는 좀 더 결실이 있길 바라마.

english: After all the confidence you demonstrated... still you lost your nerve. Perhaps I should have included in our contract a clause to cover your cowardly retreats.
translation: 그토록 자신만만하더니... 결국 배짱을 잃었구나. 네 비겁한 퇴각에 관한 조항을 계약에 넣었어야 했나 보군.

english: In any case, [player name], have you come to challenge me?
Why... Do my eyes deceive me? I see a glimmer of courage within you.
translation: 이런... 내 눈이 잘못된 것이냐? 네 안에서 용기의 빛이 어렴풋이 보이는구나.

english: I know what I'm doing, sign the contract.
translation: 뭘 하는지는 저도 알아요. 계약서에 서명하세요.

english: With pleasure.
The [contract name] burns up and Yama breathes a contented sigh...
translation: [contract name]이(가) 불타 사라지고 Yama(야마)가 흡족한 한숨을 내쉰다...

english: Good luck.
On second thought, I think I'll hold off.
Do not make a habit of wasting my time like this. Get out of my sight.
translation: 이런 식으로 내 시간을 낭비하는 버릇은 들이지 마라. 내 눈앞에서 꺼져라.

english: I want to know more about this contract.
translation: 이 계약에 대해 더 알고 싶어요.

english: Signing these contracts agrees us to a duel in which I am less inhibited. My powers will be greater than what you have experienced before.
translation: 이 계약서에 서명하면, 내가 덜 억제된 상태로 결투를 벌이는 데 합의하는 것이다. 내 힘은 네가 이전에 겪어 본 것보다 강할 게다.

english: Each one details unique rules and rewards, the details of which you can read on the contract itself.
translation: 계약서마다 고유한 규칙과 보상이 적혀 있다. 자세한 건 계약서 자체에서 읽을 수 있지.

english: But I'm sure you already have. Shall we?
No, I think I'd like to read over the terms again.
translation: 아뇨, 조항을 다시 한번 읽어 봐야겠어요.

english: Very well. Return when you are ready.
Er... No, I thought you'd lost this.
translation: 어... 아뇨, 이거 잃어버리신 줄 알았는데요.

english: No, that contract was allowed to come into your possession quite deliberately. And I see you have bravely decided to make use of it.
translation: 아니. 그 계약서는 아주 의도적으로 네 손에 들어가게 한 것이다. 그리고 보아하니 용감하게도 그걸 쓰기로 했구나.

english: I'm not sure I...
I see that I had missjudgedyou, [player name]. Let us sign the contract and cement that assessment.
translation: 내가 너를 잘못 보았던 모양이구나, [player name]. 계약서에 서명하고 그 평가를 확정하자꾸나.

english: No, I think it might have been somebody else that dropped it. I should really go and find them...
translation: 아뇨, 아마 다른 사람이 떨어뜨린 것 같아요. 얼른 가서 그 사람을 찾아봐야겠어요...

english: Yes, perhaps it was. Perhaps it belonged to somebody else. Somebody with a semblance of pride or self respect.
translation: 그래, 아마 그렇겠지. 아마 다른 누군가의 것이었겠지. 자존심이나 자긍심이 조금이라도 있는 누군가의.

english: If you find them, be sure to send them my way.
Ah... The humble plain pizza. Unremarkable, yet powerful. Hand me it.
translation: 아... 소박한 plain pizza(플레인 피자)로군. 평범하지만, 강력하지. 이리 다오.

english: Yes... Delicious.
You think you can deny me pizza? Double check the fine print of our contract, [player name].
translation: 내게 피자를 내주지 않을 수 있을 거라 생각했느냐? 계약서의 깨알 같은 조항을 다시 확인해 보거라, [player name].

english: What do you mean?! You can't just take my pizza!
translation: 무슨 소리예요?! 제 피자를 그냥 가져가면 어떡해요!

english: Oh but I can. As per our contract, any pizza you present to me cannot be taken back. Right here.
translation: 아니, 얼마든지 가져갈 수 있다. 계약에 따라, 네가 내게 내보인 피자는 되찾을 수 없다. 바로 여기 적혀 있지.

english: That's outrageous! You can't hold me to this!
translation: 말도 안 돼요! 이걸로 저를 묶어 둘 순 없어요!

english: Perhaps you should have expressed that opinion before signing. Indeed, perhaps if you felt that way you should not have signed at all.
translation: 그런 의견은 서명하기 전에 밝혔어야지. 아니, 그렇게 생각했다면 애초에 서명을 하지 말았어야지.

english: The meat pizza. An adequate if uninspired offering. Hand me it.
translation: meat pizza(고기 피자)로군. 참신하진 않지만 그럭저럭 괜찮은 공물이지. 이리 다오.

english: Anchovy pizza. Flavourful and bold. Hand me it.
translation: Anchovy pizza(멸치 피자)로군. 풍미 있고 대담하지. 이리 다오.

english: Pineapple pizza, topped with delicious acidic flavours and the angry tears of a thousand nay-sayers. Excellent. Hand me it.
translation: Pineapple pizza(파인애플 피자)로군. 감미로운 새콤함에, 반대파 천 명의 분노의 눈물까지 얹었지. 훌륭하다. 이리 다오.

english: Is that your favourite kind of pizza?
No. My favourite kind of pizza is the jalapeño pizza. Were it that I could enjoy its zesty heat for every meal.
translation: 아니. 내가 제일 좋아하는 피자는 할라피뇨 피자다. 그 톡 쏘는 매운맛을 끼니마다 즐길 수만 있다면 좋으련만.

english: Do not insult me. I will not eat your leftovers.
translation: 날 모욕하지 마라. 네가 먹다 남긴 걸 먹을 생각은 없다.

english: Do you think you are funny, [player name].
Not at all, Yama. Here, take it.
I'm quite alright. You can keep the evidence of your lackluster cooking ability to yourself.
translation: 괜찮다. 네 형편없는 요리 실력의 증거는 너나 간직하거라.

english: I'm afraid I can't. As per our contract, once shown to you, a full pizza cannot be taken back.
translation: 그럴 수가 없네요. 계약에 따라, 일단 당신에게 보여 준 온전한 피자는 되찾을 수 없거든요.

english: Do not test me, [player name]. I will not be eating burnt pizza today.
translation: 나를 시험하지 마라, [player name]. 오늘은 burnt pizza(탄 피자)를 먹지 않겠다.

english: Do whatever you like with it, but I cannot take it back.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 하지만 저는 도로 가져갈 수 없어요.

english: Very clever. Now get out of my sight.
translation: 꽤 영리하구나. 이제 내 눈앞에서 꺼져라.

english: You thought you could escape with your pizza? I'm afraid not, [player name].
translation: 피자를 들고 도망칠 수 있을 줄 알았느냐? 유감이지만 안 된다, [player name].

english: I'm afraid my scribes are a tad overwhelmed at the moment. Please, return with your contract soon, I would be delighted to sign once they are unblocked.
translation: 유감스럽게도 지금은 내 서기들이 일에 좀 치여 있구나. 곧 계약서를 들고 다시 오너라. 일이 풀리는 대로 기꺼이 서명해 주마.

english: Contracts will be enabled 1-2 weeks after Yama has launched.
You know why I'm here. Stop messing around.
translation: 제가 왜 여기 왔는지 아시잖아요. 장난 그만 치세요.

english: I take it you have answers.
Yes, a few of them actually.
Yes.
No.
Yes. Let's do this.
Actually, I have some questions.
translation: 사실, 몇 가지 묻고 싶은 게 있어요.

english: There's something in our contract about additional contracts...
translation: 우리 계약서에 추가 계약에 관한 내용이 있던데요...

english: Do you keep any record of our fights?
translation: 우리 싸움에 대한 기록 같은 걸 남겨 두나요?

english: That's all.
No, I'd rather not.
I know what I'm doing, sign the contract.
translation: 뭘 하는지는 저도 알아요. 계약서에 서명하세요.

english: I want to know more about this contract.
translation: 이 계약에 대해 더 알고 싶어요.

english: Er... No, I thought you'd lost this.
translation: 어... 아뇨, 이거 잃어버리신 줄 알았는데요.

english: Yes, you fool?
Excuse me?
You looked like you wanted to speak to me, you halfwit. You dullard.
translation: 나한테 말 걸고 싶은 얼굴이던데, 이 얼간이야. 이 멍청이야.

english: That's enough.
My contract stipulates that I must follow you, you insufferable ignoramus. My contract does not stipulate that I must be polite, you ignorant buffoon.
translation: 내 계약서엔 너를 따라다녀야 한다고 적혀 있지, 이 참을 수 없는 무식쟁이야. 공손해야 한다고는 안 적혀 있다고, 이 무지한 어릿광대야.

english: What have I ever done to you?
How about parading me around like a trophy, you idiot clown? How about stuffing me in your rotten backpack, you inclement cretin? How about-
translation: 나를 전리품처럼 끌고 다니는 건 어떠냐, 이 바보 광대야? 그 썩어 빠진 배낭에 나를 쑤셔 넣는 건 어떠냐, 이 고약한 천치야? 그리고 또-

english: -locking me in your house, you absolutely intolerable moron.
translation: -나를 네 집에 가둬 두는 건 어떠냐, 이 도저히 못 봐줄 머저리야.

english: Okay, I get the idea.
Good. Release me, then.
Why would I do that after all of that rudeness?
translation: 그렇게 무례하게 굴어 놓고 내가 왜 그래야 하는데?

english: Bah!
I do not have the patience for you today.
translation: 오늘은 너를 상대해 줄 인내심이 없다.

english: I just want to chat.
You want to 'chat'? It is not enough that I must stare at your backside all day, I must suffer your sorry attempts at conversation as well?
translation: '얘기'를 하고 싶다고? 온종일 네 엉덩이만 쳐다봐야 하는 것도 모자라서, 그 한심한 대화 시도까지 견뎌야 한다고?

english: Well if you're going to be rude, I'll find somebody else.
translation: 그렇게 무례하게 굴 거면, 다른 사람 찾아볼게.

english: Somebody else? Who? Introduce me to this paragon of virtue, who can tolerate the torrent of spittle you call speech. The incoherent messes you call sentences.
translation: 다른 사람? 누구? 그 미덕의 화신을 나한테 소개해 봐라. 네가 말이라고 하는 그 침 튀기는 소리를 참아 줄 수 있는 자를. 네가 문장이라고 하는 그 횡설수설을 말이야.

english: I have plenty of friends!
Oh yes, your friends. And do these friends, perhaps, live very far away? Are they perhaps too busy to meet up frequently?
translation: 아, 그래, 네 친구들. 그런데 그 친구들, 혹시 아주 멀리 사나? 혹시 너무 바빠서 자주 못 만나나?

english: Well...
The next time I am left stranded by your incompetence, which I'm sure won't take long, do us both a favour and don't reclaim me.
translation: 다음에 네 무능함 때문에 내가 버려지면, 뭐 금방 그렇게 되겠지만, 우리 둘 다를 위해서 날 다시 찾아가지 마라.

english: I could incinerate you if I wanted.
translation: 마음만 먹으면 너 따위 잿더미로 만들 수 있어.

english: I'm holding back because this house is actually habitable.
translation: 이 집이 그나마 살 만해서 참아 주는 거다.

english: Oh no.
Get your hands off of m-
Hello.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo
Hello.
How are you doing?
Meh, I don't want to talk about it.
translation: 흠, 그 얘긴 하고 싶지 않아요.

english: Oh ummm... fair enough. Goodbye.
Not too well. I miss my friend. She couldn't join us here today.
translation: 별로 좋지 않아요. 친구가 보고 싶어서요. 오늘 여기 같이 못 왔거든요.

english: Why couldn't she join you?
She had some afterlife business to take care of. Nieve's always so busy.
translation: 사후 세계에서 처리할 일이 좀 있었대요. Nieve(니에브)는 늘 바쁘거든요.

english: Nieve? I used to know a Nieve, but she died during horrible circumstances.
translation: Nieve(니에브)요? 저도 니에브라는 사람을 알았는데, 끔찍한 일을 당해서 죽었어요.

english: Really? You must be [player name]! She talks about you a lot.
translation: 정말요? 그럼 당신이 [player name]이군요! 그 애가 당신 얘기를 많이 해요.

english: Does she? I miss her. Steve is alright, but... he's not Nieve.
translation: 그래요? 보고 싶네요. Steve(스티브)도 괜찮긴 한데... Nieve(니에브)는 아니니까요.

english: Anyway, please send her my regards and let her know that I avenged her death.
translation: 아무튼, 그 친구한테 안부 전해 주시고, 제가 원수를 갚아 줬다고 꼭 알려 주세요.

english: I will.
Hello there!
Greetings Bwana! My name is Yanni and I buy and sell antiques.
translation: 안녕하세요, 브와나! 제 이름은 Yanni(야니)고, 골동품을 사고팔아요.

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
I buy antiques and other interesting items. If you have any interesting items that you might want to sell me, please let me see them and I'll offer you a fair price.
translation: 골동품이나 다른 흥미로운 물건을 사들여요. 저한테 팔고 싶은 흥미로운 물건이 있으면 보여 주세요. 공정한 값을 쳐 드릴게요.

english: Would you like me to have a look at your items and give you a quote?
translation: 제가 소지품을 한번 살펴보고 견적을 내 드릴까요?

english: Yes please!
Sorry Bwana, you have nothing I am interested in.
translation: 죄송해요, 브와나. 제가 관심 있는 물건이 하나도 없네요.

english: I'll give you 100 coins for the Bone Key...
I'll give you 100 coins for the Stone Plaque...
I'll give you 100 coins for the tattered scroll...
I'll give you 100 coins for the crumpled scroll...
I'll give you 500 coins for your locating crystal...
I'll give you 1000 coins for your 'Beads of the Dead'...
And that's the only item I am interested in. If you want to sell me that item, simply show it to me.
translation: 제가 관심 있는 건 그 물건 하나뿐이에요. 그걸 팔고 싶으시면 저한테 보여 주기만 하세요.

english: Those are the items I am interested in Bwana. If you want to sell me those items, simply show them to me.
translation: 제가 관심 있는 물건은 그것들이에요, 브와나. 팔고 싶으시면 저한테 보여 주기만 하세요.

english: Maybe some other time?
Sure thing. Have a nice day Bwana.
Do you have any interesting items for sale?
Sorry, [Sir/Madam], I have nothing that you need.
Hmm, sorry, not interested.
Fair enough, come back if you change your mind.
That's a great bone key. Here's 100 coins for it.
That's a great crumpled scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
That's a great tattered scroll. Here's 100 coins for it.
That's a great copy of Bervirius notes. Here's 100 coins for it.
translation: 훌륭한 Bervirius notes(베르비리우스 메모) 사본이네요. 100코인 드릴게요.

english: That's a great Locating Crystal. Here's 500 coins for it.
translation: 훌륭한 Locating Crystal(위치 탐지 크리스탈)이네요. 500코인 드릴게요.

english: That's a great stone-plaque. Here's 100 coins for it.
Impressive necklace there, here's 1000 coins for it.
Ah you'd like to sell this to me would you? I can offer you 5000 coins!
translation: 아, 이걸 저한테 파시겠다고요? 5000코인 드릴 수 있어요!

english: Yes, I'll sell it for 5000 coins.
Very well my friend, let me count out your reward.
Thanks!
No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
Very well my friend, come back if you change your mind.
translation: 알겠어요, 친구. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요.

english: Tell me about this antiques business.
Yes please!
Maybe some other time?
Do you have any interesting items for sale?
Hmm, sorry, not interested.
Yes, I'll sell it for 5000
No, I think I'll hold on it a while longer yet.
Fancy some pie? Mine are far better than any you'll find up on the surface.
translation: 파이 좀 드실래요? 제 파이는 지상에서 파는 그 어떤 파이보다 훨씬 맛있어요.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Fine. Enjoy your human muck then.
translation: 그러시든가요. 그럼 인간들 꿀꿀이죽이나 실컷 드세요.

english: I'll take a look.
No thanks.
Good day to you, welcome to my pickaxe shop. Are you interested in making a purchase?
translation: 안녕하세요, 제 곡괭이 가게에 오신 걸 환영해요. 뭐 사실 거 있으세요?

english: No thanks.
Suit yourself. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 마음대로 하세요. 마음이 바뀌면 전 여기 있을게요.

english: Yes please.
No thanks.
Hello.
Hello.
You don't look very well. Are you alright?
translation: 안색이 별로 안 좋아 보이네요. 괜찮으세요?

english: No, I'm dead.
Dead as in... feeling a bit under the weather?
translation: 죽었다는 게... 몸이 좀 안 좋아서 죽겠다는 뜻이에요?

english: No, dead as in I got stabbed and died.
translation: 아뇨, 칼에 찔려서 진짜로 죽었다는 뜻이에요.

english: That's awful! How are you still here? And how can you still talk?
translation: 세상에! 그런데 어떻게 아직 여기 있어요? 그리고 어떻게 아직 말을 할 수 있어요?

english: Eve brought me back from the afterlife. She's a party lion, that one.
translation: Eve(이브)가 사후 세계에서 저를 데려왔거든요. 그 사람, 파티라면 사족을 못 써요.

english: How could she bring you back from the afterlife?
translation: 그 사람이 어떻게 사후 세계에서 사람을 데려올 수 있죠?

english: I'm not sure how the magic works exactly. Only Eve knows that. All I know is that she usually does this every year.
translation: 마법이 정확히 어떻게 작동하는지는 저도 잘 몰라요. 그건 Eve(이브)만 알죠. 제가 아는 건 보통 해마다 이렇게 한다는 것뿐이에요.

english: I didn't see her around last year. Are you sure she always comes here?
translation: 작년엔 그분을 못 봤는데요. 정말 늘 여기 오는 거 맞아요?

english: She returns to the world of the living every year. That doesn't mean she has to go to Lumbridge Swamp every year.
translation: 해마다 산 자들의 세상으로 돌아오긴 해요. 그렇다고 해마다 Lumbridge Swamp(럼브리지 늪)에 와야 한다는 법은 없죠.

english: Fair enough.
What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: 사후 세계에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Not a lot. Most of it you'd have to see for yourself.
translation: 별로요. 대부분은 직접 가서 봐야 알 거예요.

english: I don't feel quite ready for that yet.
translation: 아직 그럴 준비는 안 된 것 같아요.

english: And I was going to offer you a quick way there... what a shame.
translation: 모처럼 거기 가는 지름길을 알려 드리려 했는데... 아쉽네요.

english: Whelp. I should go.
Why do you choose to come back?
While the afterlife is not that bad, I do sometimes miss some things from when I used to be alive. There's nothing quite like Eve's special brew.
translation: 사후 세계가 그렇게 나쁘진 않지만, 살아 있을 때 누리던 것들이 가끔 그립거든요. Eve(이브)의 특제 술만 한 게 없죠.

english: So you just come here for fun? Like on holiday?
translation: 그럼 그냥 놀러 오는 거예요? 휴가처럼요?

english: You could say that. I could always come back to haunt people, but that gets tedious after a while. I'd much rather enjoy my time here.
translation: 그렇다고 할 수 있죠. 언제든 돌아와서 사람들을 귀신처럼 괴롭힐 수도 있지만, 그것도 좀 하다 보면 지겨워요. 여기서 즐기는 게 훨씬 낫죠.

english: Well I'm glad you're not causing any harm by being here.
translation: 뭐, 여기 계시면서 해를 끼치지 않는다니 다행이네요.

english: The only way I'd cause harm is if someone were to interrupt my enjoying this party.
translation: 제가 해를 끼칠 일이 있다면, 누가 제 파티 즐기는 걸 방해할 때뿐이죠.

english: ... I should go.
Goodbye.
Goodbye.
What more can you tell me about the afterlife?
translation: 사후 세계에 대해 더 알려 줄 수 있어요?

english: Why do you choose to come back?
Hey, human.
Who are you?
I am Yellow Snow.
How did you get called Yellow Snow?
translation: 어쩌다 이름이 Yellow Snow(노란 눈)이 됐어요?

english: We trolls are named after the first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: 우리 트롤은 처음 먹어 보려고 한 거 따라 이름 붙어. 그리고 화장실 거의 없는 커다란 눈 나라에선, 어떤 건 좀 피할 수가 없어.

english: We dug smelly hole in prison so Mother's prisoners wouldn't go all over floor, but it not very convenient. Trolls like things convenient.
translation: 우리 감옥에 냄새나는 구멍 팠어. Mother(어머니) 포로들 바닥에 아무 데나 싸지 말라고. 근데 별로 안 편해. 트롤은 편한 거 좋아해.

english: Do you mind being asked about that?
Can't be helped. Everyone I meet, once they want to talk about me personally, it like they only got two choices of what to ask.
translation: 어쩔 수 없어. 만나는 놈마다, 나에 대해 얘기하려고 하면, 물어볼 거 딱 두 개밖에 없는 거 같아.

english: Tell me about this place.
This here is Weiss. Trolls built it years ago, after we got kicked out from caves further south. Now Weiss is our home.
translation: 여기 Weiss(바이스). 트롤이 몇 년 전에 지었어. 남쪽 동굴에서 쫓겨나고 나서. 이제 바이스가 우리 집.

english: We done pretty good here. Got lots of goat and wolf to eat - they taste kinda boring after all this time, but there not much other choice.
translation: 우리 여기서 꽤 잘 지내. 먹을 염소랑 늑대 많아. 이제 오래 먹어서 맛 좀 심심한데, 다른 거 고를 게 별로 없어.

english: Ever tried goutweed? I know trolls who love it. In fact My Arm is an expert on growing the stuff.
translation: goutweed(구트위드) 먹어 본 적 있어요? 그거 엄청 좋아하는 트롤들을 알거든요. 사실 My Arm(마이 암)은 그거 키우는 전문가예요.

english: Never heard of no gouty weed, no. But it sound like a vegetable, an' Mother not like eating those, so we probably not gonna try it.
translation: 구트위드? 구린 풀? 그런 거 들어 본 적 없어. 근데 채소 같은 소리 나. 그리고 Mother(어머니)는 채소 먹는 거 안 좋아해. 그래서 우리 아마 안 먹어 볼 거야.

english: Mother not like new ideas much, but he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 새로운 생각 별로 안 좋아해. 근데 그 녀석 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 그 녀석이 하라는 대로 해.

english: I see.
Do you like it here?
Eh, it kinda rough, but it our home. Odd Mushroom say he can make it nicer with fancy fires what he invented, but Mother not interested in that, so Odd Mushroom not allowed to do it.
translation: 음, 좀 험해. 근데 우리 집이야. Odd Mushroom(이상한 버섯)이 자기가 발명한 멋진 불로 더 좋게 만들 수 있대. 근데 Mother(어머니)가 관심 없어서, 이상한 버섯은 그거 하면 안 돼.

english: Mother only care about stuff to help him fight better. An he really big, an' he boss, so we do what he say.
translation: Mother(어머니)는 자기 더 잘 싸우게 도와주는 것만 신경 써. 그리고 그 녀석 엄청 크고, 대장이야. 그래서 우리 그 녀석이 하라는 대로 해.

english: I'll be off.
Hey, friend of Snowflake!
We trolls are named after first thing we try to eat, an' some things are kinda inevitable in a big snowy land with almost no toilets.
translation: 우리 트롤은 처음 먹어 보려고 한 거 따라 이름 붙어. 그리고 화장실 거의 없는 커다란 눈 나라에선, 어떤 건 좀 피할 수가 없어.

english: It great here, now Snowflake an' her husband troll taught us goutweed farming. Food so much better now.
translation: 여기 최고야. 이제 Snowflake(눈송이)랑 그 남편 트롤이 우리한테 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 음식 훨씬 맛있어졌어.

english: Eh, it kinda rough, but it getting better. Snowflake, she taught us goutweed farming. Goat, wolf, human all taste so much nicer with goutweed in.
translation: 음, 좀 험해. 근데 점점 나아져. Snowflake(눈송이)가 goutweed(구트위드) 농사 가르쳐 줬어. 염소, 늑대, 인간 다 구트위드 넣으니까 훨씬 맛있어.

english: So yeah, Weiss is good place to live, now Snowflake in charge. All trolls like Snowflake. Her husband troll kinda weird, but that not our problem.
translation: 그래서, Weiss(바이스) 이제 살기 좋은 곳이야. Snowflake(눈송이)가 대장이니까. 트롤 다 눈송이 좋아해. 그 남편 트롤은 좀 이상한데, 그건 우리 문제 아니야.

english: Who are you?
How did you get called Yellow Snow?
translation: 어쩌다 이름이 Yellow Snow(노란 눈)이 됐어요?

english: Do you mind being asked about that?
Tell me about this place.
Ever tried goutweed?
I see.
Do you like it here?
I'll be off.
Hello there.
Clear off! Let me drink in peace!
translation: 저리 꺼져! 술 좀 조용히 마시게 놔둬!

english: Okay then.
Hello.
Sorry, but the smithery is closed. You can use the furnace for a fee, and I can hold a coffer of gold so you don't need to pay each time.
translation: 죄송하지만 대장간은 문을 닫았어요. 수수료를 내면 furnace(용광로)를 쓸 수 있고, 제가 금고에 골드를 맡아 둘 수도 있어요. 그러면 매번 돈을 낼 필요가 없죠.

english: It's already empty.
Sorry, but the smithery is closed. But since you've completed the elite tier of the Karamja diary, I will allow you to use the furnace.
translation: 죄송하지만 대장간은 문을 닫았어요. 그래도 Karamja diary(카람자 일지)의 엘리트 단계를 완료하셨으니 furnace(용광로)를 쓰게 해 드릴게요.

english: Sorry Bwana - I charge a fee of 20 coins to use my furnace.
translation: 죄송해요, 브와나. 제 furnace(용광로)를 쓰려면 수수료 20코인을 받아요.

english: You have earned the Elite Karamja reward, so you no longer need to pay to use this furnace.
translation: Karamja(카람자) 엘리트 보상을 받으셨으니, 이제 이 용광로는 돈 안 내고 쓰셔도 돼요.

english: I'm getting out of here Bwana, the place is infested with Zombies.
translation: 전 여기서 나갈래요, 브와나. 여기 Zombies(좀비)가 득실거려요.

english: Deposit coins
Empty coffer
Cancel
Nilsal, my child. Welcome to our humble camp. Do stop and rest if you need to.
translation: Nilsal(닐살), 아이여. 우리 소박한 야영지에 온 것을 환영하네. 쉬어 가야 한다면 얼마든지 머물다 가게.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 저 좀 치료해 주실 수 있나요? 다쳤어요.

english: Sorry, but I cannot.
What brings you out here?
My companion and I are the teoki responsible for the Proudspire obelisk, one of our most precious holy sites. However, the peak of the mountain is not overly welcoming, so we keep our camp down here.
translation: 나와 내 동료는 우리의 가장 귀한 성지 가운데 하나인 Proudspire(프라우드스파이어) obelisk(오벨리스크)를 맡은 teoki(테오키)라네. 다만 산꼭대기는 그리 머물 만한 곳이 못 되어서, 이 아래에 야영지를 꾸렸지.

english: What's so important about this obelisk?

It was built by those who wandered these lands before we did. They worshipped Ralos and Ranul just as we now do. The obelisk was a site of great religious importance to them, and so it is to us as well.
translation: 우리보다 먼저 이 땅을 떠돌던 이들이 세운 것이라네. 그들도 지금의 우리처럼 Ralos(랄로스)와 Ranul(라눌)을 섬겼지. 오벨리스크는 그들에게 종교적으로 아주 중요한 장소였고, 우리에게도 마찬가지일세.

english: But what is it actually for?
That is something we sadly don't know. It is why the obelisk is especially important to those who serve Ranul. It is a reminder of the importance in ensuring knowledge is preserved.
translation: 안타깝게도 그건 우리도 모른다네. 그래서 Ranul(라눌)을 섬기는 이들에게 오벨리스크가 더욱 중요하지. 지식을 지켜 내는 일이 얼마나 중요한지 일깨워 주니 말일세.

english: I see...
I'd better be on my way.
Take care, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: 몸조심하게, 아이여. 태양이 자네의 길을 밝혀 주기를.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: 저 좀 치료해 주실 수 있나요? 다쳤어요.

english: What brings you out here?
I'd better be on my way.
Ga ga?
Heeheehee!
*cough*
*gurgle*
*hic*
I don't get it... Are you real or not?
I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
But, like... Can you feel it if I pinch you?
translation: 근데, 그러니까... 내가 꼬집으면 아프긴 해?

english: Don't you even think about it.
What actually are you? A big wolf or something?
translation: 너 정체가 뭐야? 큰 늑대 같은 거야?

english: I suppose I might look something like that.
That sounds like a no. What are you then?
A hunllef.
A what?
Nevermind.
You know, you can be a real nightmare sometimes.
translation: 너 가끔 진짜 악몽 같은 거 알아?

english: Grrrrrr!
Hoooooooooowl!
I'm a crystalline formation, made by the elves.
Don't you even think about it.
I suppose I might look something like that.
A hunllef.
Nevermind.
Grrrrrr!
Hoooooooooowl!
Hello!
I'm sorry outerlander, I cannot sell you any clothes. Our customs forbid it.
translation: 미안하지만 외지인, 당신에게는 옷을 팔 수 없어요. 우리 관습이 금하거든요.

english: Only Fremenniks may buy clothes here.
translation: 여기서는 Fremennik(프레메닉)만 옷을 살 수 있어요.

english: Only Fremenniks may change their shoes here.
translation: 여기서는 Fremennik(프레메닉)만 신발을 바꿀 수 있어요.

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
No, sorry, I'm not. Best look elsewhere outerlander.
translation: 아니요, 미안하지만 아니에요. 다른 데 가 보세요, 외지인.

english: Okay, thanks.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: 혹시 맞춤 sturdy boots(튼튼한 장화)를 어디서 구할 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Well, I don't usually have many shoes in stock here in my little clothes shop... I will be able to make you up a pair if you are really desperate though?
translation: 글쎄요, 제 작은 옷가게에는 원래 신발을 많이 두지 않아요... 그래도 정말 급하다면 한 켤레 만들어 드릴 수는 있어요.

english: They're not for me... I need them for Olaf.
Oh, that foolish bard... Why didn't he just ask me to make him some? It is his stupid pride, I believe!
translation: 아, 그 어리석은 음유시인... 왜 그냥 저한테 만들어 달라고 하지 않은 거죠? 그 쓸데없는 자존심 때문일 거예요!

english: I will tell you what I will do outerlander; I know that you must have the ear of the chieftain for him to consider you as worthy of becoming a Fremennik by trial.
translation: 이렇게 하죠, 외지인. 족장이 당신을 시험을 거쳐 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 될 자격이 있다고 여긴다면, 분명 족장의 신임을 얻었겠죠.

english: I will make you a pair of sturdy boots for Olaf if you will persuade him to reduce the sales tax placed upon all Fremennik shopkeepers. It does nothing but hurt my business now.
translation: 모든 Fremennik(프레메닉) 상인에게 매겨진 판매세를 낮추도록 족장을 설득해 준다면 Olaf(올라프)를 위해 sturdy boots(튼튼한 장화)를 한 켤레 만들어 드릴게요. 지금은 그 세금이 제 장사를 망치고 있을 뿐이에요.

english: Okay, I will see what I can do.
I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: 혹시 판매세를 낮춰 준다는 보증을 어디서 받을 수 있는지 아세요?

english: Yes I do outerlander. Only the Chieftain may permit such a thing. Talk to him.
translation: 네, 알아요, 외지인. 그런 걸 허락할 수 있는 사람은 족장뿐이에요. 족장과 이야기해 보세요.

english: Hello. Can I have those boots now? Here is a written statement from Brundt outlining future tax burdens upon Fremennik merchants and shopkeepers for the year.
translation: 안녕하세요. 이제 그 장화를 받을 수 있을까요? 여기 올해 Fremennik(프레메닉) 상인과 가게 주인들이 앞으로 낼 세금에 대해 Brundt(브룬트)가 적은 문서가 있어요.

english: Certainly! Let me have a look at what he has written here, just give me a moment...
translation: 물론이죠! 뭐라고 썼는지 좀 볼게요, 잠깐만 기다려 주세요...

english: Yes, that all appears in order. Tell Olaf to come to me next time for shoes!
translation: 네, 다 문제없어 보이네요. Olaf(올라프)에게 다음엔 신발이 필요하면 저한테 오라고 전해 주세요!

english: Hey, these shoes look pretty comfy. Think you could make me a pair like them?
translation: 와, 이 신발 꽤 편해 보이네요. 저한테도 이런 걸 한 켤레 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Maybe if you pass your trial and become a full fledged member of the Fremennik...
translation: 시험을 통과해서 정식 Fremennik(프레메닉)이 된다면 모를까요...

english: Hi. You wanted to buy some clothes? Or did you want to makeover your shoes?
translation: 안녕하세요. 옷을 사러 오셨나요? 아니면 신발을 바꾸러 오셨나요?

english: It's free to change your shoes here. You can choose a colour as well as a style, since I'm also stocking boots imported from the elven lands.
translation: 여기서 신발 바꾸는 건 무료예요. 엘프 땅에서 들여온 장화도 갖춰 두고 있어서, 모양뿐 아니라 색깔도 고를 수 있어요.

english: Just select the model you would like from this catalogue.
translation: 이 카탈로그에서 마음에 드는 모델을 고르기만 하세요.

english: Hey! They look great!
Thanks!
Nice choice!
Good call!
I think they suit you!
Neither thanks.
As you wish.
Ask about the Merchant's trial
Ask about becoming a Fremennik
I'd like to buy some clothes
I'd like to change my shoes
Neither thanks
Hey.
Can I help you?
Not really I just wanted to chat.
translation: 딱히요, 그냥 이야기나 좀 하고 싶어서요.

english: Sorry, I do not have time for idle gossip. Good day.
translation: 죄송하지만 한가하게 잡담할 시간이 없습니다. 이만 실례하겠습니다.

english: Hey, fancy having a go at our agility course?
translation: 저기요, 우리 민첩 코스에 한번 도전해 보실래요?

english: What do I need to do?
Just head up the ladder to get started. Try not to fall!
translation: 사다리를 타고 올라가서 시작하면 돼요. 떨어지지 않게 조심하세요!

english: You've not completed any laps of our agility course yet. There's been [amount] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 아직 우리 민첩 코스를 한 바퀴도 완주하지 않으셨네요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [amount]번이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: Hey, I see you've been having a go at our agility course.
translation: 아, 우리 민첩 코스에 도전하고 계셨군요.

english: Have you been spying on me?
I like to keep an eye on everyone who gives it a go. Speaking of which, want to know more about how you've been doing?
translation: 도전하는 사람은 다 지켜보는 편이거든요. 그런 김에, 지금까지 기록이 어떤지 알고 싶으세요?

english: Yes please.
You've completed [amount] laps of our agility course with a best time of [time]. There's been [amount] global completions and the global best time is [time].
translation: 우리 민첩 코스를 [amount]바퀴 완주하셨고, 최고 기록은 [time]이에요. 전체 완주 횟수는 [amount]번이고, 전체 최고 기록은 [time]이에요.

english: No thanks.
Yes please.
No thanks.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 저리 가, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 너 발이 참 멋질 것 같은데.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참한 날이야... 지금 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 못 봤어? 나 배가 무우우척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너도 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누가 좀 끼었어...

english: I've agreed to let you use the bank. What do you want today?
translation: 은행을 쓰게 해 드리기로 했죠. 오늘은 무슨 일이에요?

english: This is an odd-looking bank.
It's an odd-looking town. Those Corsairs are basically no better than pirates, you know, and the adventurers they bring in are worse. That's why I keep a cannon for protection.
translation: 이 마을부터가 이상하게 생겼죠. 그 Corsairs(코르세어)는 해적이나 다를 바 없고, 그들이 데려오는 모험가들은 더 심하다고요. 그래서 호신용으로 대포를 두고 있는 거예요.

english: Anyway, did you want something?
I want nothing.
Then you shall get it.
Bank's closed. Go away.
This is an odd-looking bank.
I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
I'd like to collect items.
I want nothing.
Would you like to buy or sell some staffs?
No, thank you.
Well, 'stick' your head in again if you change your mind.
translation: 그럼 마음 바뀌면 언제든 지팡이 '짚고' 다시 들르세요.

english: Huh, terrible pun! You just can't get the 'staff' these days!
translation: 허, 말장난 한번 끔찍하네요! 요즘 농담은 다 지팡이처럼 '뻣뻣'하다니까요!

english: Would you like to buy or sell some staffs? Or is there something else you need?
translation: 지팡이를 사거나 팔고 싶으세요? 아니면 다른 게 필요하세요?

english: Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: battlestaff(전투 지팡이) 남는 재고 있으면 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: For you, my friend, maybe. Take a look in the barrel in the corner.
translation: 친구 부탁이라면 어쩌면요. 구석에 있는 통을 한번 보세요.

english: Can I have another ring?
translation: 반지 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: There's still one in your inventory, [player name]!
Go and get the one that's in your bank, [player name]!
I would be happy to give you another ring, but I'm afraid you don't have enough inventory space for it!
translation: 반지를 하나 더 드리고 싶지만, 아쉽게도 소지품에 넣을 공간이 부족하네요!

english: Yes, of course, [player name]. Here you are. Please bear in mind that this ring has no charges left with which to summon me, however.
translation: 네, 물론이죠, [player name]님. 여기 있어요. 다만 이 반지에는 저를 부를 수 있는 충전 횟수가 남아 있지 않다는 걸 기억해 주세요.

english: Can you make me a staff?
translation: 저한테 지팡이 하나 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Make you a staff? With what?
I found this magical essence when I was out on my adventures. I'd like to attach it to a battlestaff, but I'm not sure how to do that myself.
translation: 모험하다가 이 마법 정수를 찾았어요. battlestaff(전투 지팡이)에 붙이고 싶은데, 제가 직접 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요.

english: Let me see this essence.
Interesting, very interesting. This would indeed make a very nice staff.
translation: 흥미롭군요, 아주 흥미로워요. 이거라면 정말 멋진 지팡이가 되겠어요.

english: You could make it yourself if you wanted. Just attach the essence to a battlestaff.
translation: 원한다면 직접 만들 수도 있어요. 정수를 battlestaff(전투 지팡이)에 붙이기만 하면 되거든요.

english: Nevertheless, I'm happy to do it for you if you like.
I'll attach it to a battlestaff for you if you are willing to pay me 50,000 coins. How does that sound?
translation: 50,000코인을 내신다면 battlestaff(전투 지팡이)에 붙여 드릴게요. 어떠세요?

english: Yes, please.
Thank you, here you go. I'm not sure what it does, but it feels pretty magical.
translation: 감사합니다, 여기 있어요. 무슨 효과가 있는지는 모르겠지만, 마력이 꽤 느껴지네요.

english: Thanks!
Oh, I don't have enough coins. I'll come back later.
translation: 아, 코인이 부족하네요. 나중에 다시 올게요.

english: No, thanks.
I'll be here if you change your mind.
Yes, please!
No, thank you.
Have you any extra stock of battlestaffs I can buy?
translation: battlestaff(전투 지팡이) 남는 재고 있으면 좀 살 수 있을까요?

english: Can I have another ring?
translation: 반지 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?

english: Can you make me a staff?
translation: 저한테 지팡이 하나 만들어 주실 수 있어요?

english: Yes, please. (Costs 50,000 coins and Bryophyta's essence)
translation: 네, 부탁해요. (50,000코인과 Bryophyta's essence(브리오파이타의 정수) 필요)

english: No, thanks.
Talk about something else.
Hello.
You don't look too happy.
True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.
translation: 맞아요. 요즘 이곳 사정이 그리 좋지 않거든요.

english: Any way that I can help?
Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.
translation: 어쩌면요. Nardah(나르다)의 시장 Awusah(아우사)를 찾아가 보세요. 마을 광장 동쪽에 있는 큰 집에 계세요.

english: Hi, I am trying to find the cause of the curse on your town.
translation: 안녕하세요, 이 마을에 내린 저주의 원인을 찾고 있어요.

english: Ah I see. Awusah has enlisted your help?
Yes he has.
Well, I really don't know why it might have happened. Maybe Ghaslor has some ideas. He's very wise and old and is the town's archivist. He lives in the northeast corner of town.
translation: 글쎄요, 왜 그런 일이 일어났는지 저는 정말 모르겠어요. Ghaslor(가슬로르)라면 뭔가 알지도 몰라요. 나이가 많고 아주 현명한 분인데, 마을의 기록 보관인이에요. 마을 북동쪽 구석에 살아요.

english: I heard the people of Nardah threw their statue of Elidinis away.
translation: Nardah(나르다) 사람들이 Elidinis(엘리디니스) 조각상을 내다 버렸다고 들었어요.

english: Yes that's correct. Why do you ask?
I've found out that action seems to have caused this town's curse.
translation: 그 일 때문에 이 마을에 저주가 내린 것 같다는 걸 알아냈어요.

english: Well, I guess that would be logical conclusion. I don't really know where the statue was thrown. Awusah might know.
translation: 음, 그게 논리적인 결론이겠네요. 조각상을 어디에 버렸는지는 저도 잘 몰라요. Awusah(아우사)라면 알지도 몰라요.

english: How's life now the curse has been lifted?
translation: 저주가 풀리고 나니 요즘 지내기는 어때요?

english: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
translation: 덕분에 훨씬 나아졌어요. 다들 정말 감탄하고 있어요.

english: Hi!
Hi!
Ughhhh....
I could've 'ad 'im!
Er...
I was robbed!
Right.
It was rigged I tell you!
Uh huh.
Leave me alone!
Are you alright?
NURSE!
Do I look alright?!
Yeh. The nurses here are...wonderful!
It's just a flesh wound!
Can't....go....on!
Leave me behind!
I'll leave you here, OK?
Oh. OK.
Die, human!
What brings you all the way out into the Wilderness?
translation: 황야 깊숙한 이곳까지는 무슨 일로 오셨어요?

english: The hunt.
Oh... you partake in that?
Not the hunt for other beings! The hunt for knowledge.
translation: 다른 존재를 사냥하는 게 아닙니다! 지식을 사냥하는 것이지요.

english: Knowledge? Can't say I've seen much of that around here. In case you didn't notice, it's all ruins.
translation: 지식이요? 이 근처에서 그런 건 별로 못 본 것 같은데요. 혹시 못 보셨을까 봐 말씀드리는데, 여긴 다 폐허예요.

english: Maybe for someone like you, but to us followers of Zamorak, there's relics of his mighty power everywhere.
translation: 당신 같은 사람에게는 그렇겠지요. 하지만 Zamorak(자모락)을 따르는 우리에게는 그분의 막강한 힘이 남긴 유물이 곳곳에 있습니다.

english: Isn't it a little dangerous to be looking for knowledge out here?
translation: 여기서 지식을 찾는 건 좀 위험하지 않아요?

english: That doesn't bother us. Our lord will protect us, we hunt in service of him.
translation: 우리는 개의치 않습니다. 우리 주군께서 지켜 주실 것이고, 우리는 그분을 섬기기 위해 사냥하니까요.

english: I'll leave you to it then.
You're a lot calmer than the other Zamorakian followers I've come across in the Wilderness.
translation: 황야에서 만난 다른 Zamorak(자모락) 추종자들보다 훨씬 차분하시네요.

english: We only search for answers.
Don't think you'll find much in these ruins.
translation: 이 폐허에서 뭘 많이 찾으실 것 같진 않은데요.

english: Be that as it may, it is our duty to honour our god and hunt for knowledge.
translation: 그럴지도 모르지요. 하지만 우리 신을 받들고 지식을 찾아 사냥하는 것이 우리의 의무입니다.

english: All power to the almighty Zamorak.
I take it you're with the others dressed in red.
translation: 빨간 옷 입은 다른 사람들이랑 한패이신가 보네요.

english: We are here in service of the only true god.
translation: 우리는 유일한 참된 신을 섬기기 위해 이곳에 있습니다.

english: Hey there, what's with all the shouting.
translation: 저기요, 다들 왜 그렇게 소리를 지르는 거예요?

english: Our all-powerful Lord Zamorak is looking for the strongest of champions, you hardly look like you fit that criteria.
translation: 전능하신 Zamorak(자모락) 님께서 가장 강한 용사를 찾고 계신다. 넌 그 기준에 맞아 보이지 않는군.

english: I am big and strong, what does he need new champions for?
translation: 저 크고 힘세거든요. 그분은 새 용사가 왜 필요한데요?

english: The glorious battlefield of Castle Wars, where we can smite down the weak followers of Saradomin needs new blood.
translation: 나약한 Saradomin(사라도민) 추종자들을 쳐부술 영광스러운 전장, Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)에 새 피가 필요하다.

english: That sounds neat, I'll be a champion for Zamorak.
Bring death to Saradomin in his great name.
translation: 그분의 위대한 이름으로 Saradomin(사라도민)에게 죽음을 안겨라.

english: Some items are stopping you from entering the Castle Wars waiting area. See the chat for details.
translation: 일부 아이템 때문에 Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈) 대기실에 들어갈 수 없습니다. 자세한 내용은 채팅창을 확인하세요.

english: The player is teleported to the current world's Zamorak Castle Wars lobby.
translation: 플레이어는 현재 월드의 Zamorak(자모락) Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈) 대기실로 순간이동된다.

english: He can find a champion somewhere else, I'll pass.
translation: 용사는 다른 데서 찾으시라고 하세요, 전 사양할게요.

english: Fool, you'll regret this one day.
translation: 어리석은 놈, 언젠가 후회하게 될 거다.

english: Sorry, you can't play Castle Wars on this world. Try world 334 for the official world.
translation: 죄송합니다, 이 월드에서는 Castle Wars(캐슬 워즈)를 할 수 없습니다. 공식 월드인 334 월드로 가 보세요.

english: Fight for Zamorak today!
Join the fight now.
Saradomin is weak, use your strength where it's respected!
translation: Saradomin(사라도민)은 나약하다. 네 힘을 인정받을 수 있는 곳에서 써라!

english: Your Lord Zamorak needs your help!
translation: 너의 주군 Zamorak(자모락)께서 네 도움을 필요로 하신다!

english: Yes.
No.
What do you want? We're trying to sing! Leave us alone and we won't bother you!
translation: 무슨 일이에요? 우린 노래하려는 중이라고요! 우릴 내버려 두면 우리도 귀찮게 안 할게요!

english: Where are you going? Can we come too?
translation: 어디 가세요? 우리도 같이 가도 돼요?

english: Why do you resort to violence so often?
If you should think of cutting a tree, don't do it!
We do hope we are not too annoying!
Look at that outfit! Can't you afford a decent one?
translation: 그 옷차림 좀 보세요! 제대로 된 옷 하나 살 돈도 없어요?

english: Are you going to craft cosmic runes? Can we come too?
translation: cosmic runes(우주 룬) 만들러 가세요? 우리도 같이 가도 돼요?

english: Just go about your business and ignore us!
translation: 하던 일 하시고 우린 신경 쓰지 마세요!

english: Who are you?
My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thankyou to leave immediately!
translation: 내 이름은 Zandar Horfyre(잔다르 호파이어)요. 그리고 [player name], 당신은 내 탑에 무단으로 들어왔을 뿐 아니라 내 학생들까지 공격했소! 당장 나가 주시오!

english: Ok, I was going anyway.
Good! And don't forget to close the door behind you!
translation: 좋소! 나갈 때 문 닫는 것도 잊지 마시오!

english: No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
Actually, that wasn't an invitation. I've tried being polite, now we'll do it the hard way!
translation: 사실 그건 권유가 아니었소. 좋게 말해 봤으니, 이제 험하게 해 주지!

english: The player is teleported to the Lumbridge swamp
Zamorak curse that mage!
Actually, I guess he already has!
Ok, I was going anyway.
No, I think I'll stay for a bit.
Hello, [player name]!
Hello, Zanik! What have you been up to?
translation: 안녕, Zanik(자닉)! 요즘 뭐 하고 지냈어?

english: I've been helping Oldak with his experiments!
I took his magic ball all over the caves and even to Lumbridge to test what happened when I broke it, and I always ended up back here.
translation: Oldak(올닥)의 magic ball(마법 공)을 들고 동굴 곳곳은 물론 Lumbridge(럼브리지)까지 가서 깨뜨리면 어떻게 되는지 시험해 봤는데, 늘 여기로 돌아오더라고요.

english: You might find one of those balls useful if you wanted to visit me! Perhaps you should talk to Oldak.
translation: 저를 보러 오고 싶으면 그 공이 쓸모 있을 거예요! Oldak(올닥)과 한번 이야기해 보세요.

english: The story isn't true! I had too much rum and ended up here!
translation: 그 이야기는 사실이 아니에요! 럼주를 너무 마셨다가 여기까지 온 거라고요!

english: I'm not banished, I've been ship wrecked help!
translation: 저 추방당한 거 아니에요, 난파당한 거예요, 살려 주세요!

english: Save me!
Help! I've been ship wrecked for years!
A thousand greetings, sir.
Do you want to trade?
Yes, certainly. I deal in scimitars.
Nice cloak.
Thank you.
Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: dragon scimitar(드래곤 시미터) 하나 파실 수 있어요?

english: A dragon scimitar? A DRAGON scimitar?
The banana-brained nitwits who make them would never dream of selling any to me.
translation: 그걸 만드는 바나나 머리 멍청이들은 저한테 팔 생각은 꿈에도 안 할 겁니다.

english: Seriously, you'll be a monkey's uncle before you'll ever hold a dragon scimitar.
translation: 진심으로 말씀드리는데, 손님이 드래곤 시미터를 손에 쥐느니 차라리 원숭이가 되는 게 더 빠를 겁니다.

english: Oh well, thanks anyway.
Hmmm, funny you should say that...
Perhaps you'd like to take a look at my stock?
What do you think about Ali Morrisane?
translation: Ali Morrisane(알리 모리세인)에 대해 어떻게 생각하세요?

english: He is a dangerous man.
Although he does not appear to be dangerous, he has brought several men to this town who have threatened me and several others.
translation: 위험해 보이지는 않지만, 그자가 이 마을에 데려온 사내 몇 명이 저와 다른 여러 사람을 협박했습니다.

english: One man even threatened me with a hammer, saying that when he set up his smithy, my shoddy workmanship would be revealed!
translation: 한 녀석은 심지어 망치를 들고, 자기가 대장간을 차리면 제 엉터리 솜씨가 다 드러날 거라며 저를 위협하더군요!

english: What will you do about these threats?
Oh, I am quite confident in the quality of my work...as will you be if you take a look at my wares.
translation: 아, 저는 제 물건의 품질에 꽤 자신이 있습니다... 제 물건을 보시면 손님도 그러실 겁니다.

english: Do you want to trade?
Nice cloak.
Could you sell me a dragon scimitar?
translation: dragon scimitar(드래곤 시미터) 하나 파실 수 있어요?

english: Yes please, Zeke.
Not today, thank you.
What do you think of Ali Morrisane?
Hello there! I sell plate mail bodies, are you interested?
translation: 안녕하세요! 판금 갑옷 상의를 파는데, 관심 있으세요?

english: Sorry, I'm not interested.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 새로운 세금에 대해 알려 드리러 왔어요.

english: I'm already paying my taxes though?
These are new ones. They are to help pay for the king's upcoming visit to Great Kourend.
translation: 이건 새로 생긴 세금이에요. 곧 있을 왕의 Great Kourend(그레이트 쿠렌드) 방문 비용을 대려는 거예요.

english: Well I don't see why I have to pay for that! If the king can't afford the trip, then maybe he shouldn't be going!
translation: 그걸 왜 제가 내야 하는지 모르겠네요! 왕이 여행 경비를 감당 못 하면, 애초에 가지 말아야죠!

english: It's an important diplomatic trip I'm afraid so it has to go ahead. The first payment will be collected soon.
translation: 안타깝지만 중요한 외교 방문이라 꼭 가야 해요. 첫 납부금은 곧 걷을 거예요.

english: And he's getting a mourner to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: 그런데 그 얘길 애도자한테 전하라고 시켰다고요? 어림없죠.

english: And he's getting a citizen to tell me this? Nice try.
translation: 그런데 그 얘길 시민한테 전하라고 시켰다고요? 어림없죠.

english: I'm interested.
Sorry, I'm not interested.
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.
translation: 새로운 세금에 대해 알려 드리러 왔어요.

english: Fingers!
Wall beast fingers!
Fresh wall beast fingers!
translation: 신선한 wall beast fingers(벽 괴수 핑거)!

english: Lovely wall beast fingers!
translation: 맛 좋은 wall beast fingers(벽 괴수 핑거)!

english: Tasty wall beast fingers!
translation: 맛있는 wall beast fingers(벽 괴수 핑거)!

english: FIND THE GODSWORD!
FIND THE GODSWORD!
I FOUND THE GODSWORD!
GOOD!!!!!
Find the godsword!
I sharpen my blade for Saradomin!
Smite the evildoer!
Saradomin guide my sword!
*slap*
Evildoers get ragged!
For Saradomin!
My faith pwns your faith!
translation: 내 신앙이 네 신앙 발라 버린다!

english: Wotcha guv'na!
Hey! Talk to me if you want to know anything worth knowing.
translation: 이봐! 알 만한 가치가 있는 걸 알고 싶으면 나한테 말 걸어.

english: Best talk to his highness over there, 'fore he goes gettin' upset.
translation: 저기 계신 나으리랑 먼저 얘기하쇼, 심기 불편해지시기 전에.

english: Hey Zimberfizz.
What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?
It's 'ard to say. Me master never told what it is or why he built it.
translation: 말하기 어렵수. 우리 주인님은 그게 뭔지, 왜 지었는지 한 번도 말해 준 적이 없거든.

english: Wait a second... He built it?
I saw 'im build it with me own eyes. I were the one who 'ad to carry his materials to this island!
translation: 내 두 눈으로 똑똑히 봤수. 재료를 이 섬까지 날라야 했던 게 바로 나였다니까!

english: So what is Nomad really up to?
translation: 그래서 Nomad(노마드)는 진짜 뭘 꾸미고 있는 거예요?

english: Well, me master is as secretive as they come. Af'er all my time here, I still know next to nuffin' about him.
translation: 글쎄, 우리 주인님은 비밀이 많기로는 둘째가라면 서러운 양반이라. 여기서 그렇게 오래 지냈는데도 그 양반에 대해선 아는 게 거의 없수.

english: Well, what do you know?
He's been up to summat since I've been here, but 'e had to have been an adventurer at some point. He has a massive stockpile of loot.
translation: 내가 여기 온 뒤로 줄곧 뭔가를 꾸미고 있는데, 한때는 모험가였던 게 틀림없수. 전리품을 어마어마하게 쌓아 두고 있거든.

english: He seems to know his way around some strange creatures too.
translation: 이상한 생물들에 대해서도 잘 아는 것 같던데요.

english: He does. He doesn't seem to care about that sorta stuff no more though. Since I've known 'im, he's only been obsessin' over gettin' as many people to play his game as possible.
translation: 그렇수. 근데 요즘은 그런 데엔 별 관심이 없어 보여. 내가 알고 지낸 뒤로는 자기 게임에 최대한 많은 사람을 끌어들이는 데만 매달려 있다니까.

english: Why is he so obsessed?
Lost if I know. Like I said, 'e's as secretive as they come.
translation: 낸들 아나. 말했듯이 그 양반은 비밀이 많기로는 둘째가라면 서럽다니까.

english: Tell me how you got to be here.
translation: 여기 어떻게 오게 됐는지 말해 줘요.

english: I don't really know. I just woke up one day and 'ad to obey me master's commands.
translation: 나도 잘 모르겠수. 어느 날 눈을 떠 보니 주인님 명령을 따라야 했지.

english: You just woke up here?
Aye. All I can remember before that is a glowing box and sumfin' to do with beads.
translation: 그렇수. 그 전 일은 빛나는 상자랑 구슬에 관한 뭔가밖에 기억이 안 나.

english: It sounds like Nomad is quite the hunter.
translation: Nomad(노마드)는 꽤 대단한 사냥꾼인 것 같네요.

english: What makes you say that?
I read somewhere that skilled hunters can capture imps.
translation: 솜씨 좋은 사냥꾼은 imps(임프)를 잡을 수 있다고 어디서 읽었거든요.

english: That's sad to hear. It's just so 'ard to ignore shiny beads when I see 'em.
translation: 그거 슬픈 얘기네. 반짝이는 구슬을 보면 도저히 그냥 지나칠 수가 없단 말이지.

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.
translation: 저도 꽤 실력 있는 사냥꾼인데, 어떤 사냥꾼들은 임프 잡는 걸 좋아하더라고요.

english: Really? They abuse our love of beads just to test their skills?
translation: 정말? 실력 시험하겠다고 우리 구슬 사랑을 이용해 먹는다고?

english: No need to worry, I'll give you no hassle. I'm only here to chat.
translation: 걱정 마요, 귀찮게 안 할게요. 그냥 얘기나 하러 온 거예요.

english: Phew!
I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
translation: 저도 꽤 실력 있는 사냥꾼인데, 임프 잡는 걸 정말 좋아해요.

english: Oh no!
Only joking! I couldn't resist. Now, where were we?
translation: 농담이에요! 참을 수가 없었어요. 자, 어디까지 얘기했죠?

english: See you later.
Bye!
You've got no reason to bother that poor imp.
translation: 그 불쌍한 임프를 괴롭힐 이유는 없잖아.

english: I can't really chit-chat with me Master 'round. Go see what he wants.
translation: 주인님이 계실 땐 수다 떨기가 좀 그렇수. 가서 뭘 원하시는지 들어 보쇼.

english: What exactly is the Soul Obelisk?
So what is Nomad really up to?
translation: 그래서 Nomad(노마드)는 진짜 뭘 꾸미고 있는 거예요?

english: Tell me how you got to be here.
translation: 여기 어떻게 오게 됐는지 말해 줘요.

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and some hunters like to capture imps.
translation: 저도 꽤 실력 있는 사냥꾼인데, 어떤 사냥꾼들은 임프 잡는 걸 좋아하더라고요.

english: I'm quite the hunter myself, and I love capturing imps.
translation: 저도 꽤 실력 있는 사냥꾼인데, 임프 잡는 걸 정말 좋아해요.

english: See you later.
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
translation: 내가 너처럼 못생겼으면 사람들 앞에 얼굴도 못 내밀겠다!

english: Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Strange how?
Like a human!
Oh! Er... I just ate one is why!
translation: 아! 어... 방금 하나 먹어서 그래요!

english: Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
translation: 목숨이 아깝거든 다시는 말 걸지 마!

english: Get lost!
I don't have anything to give you so leave me alone, mendicant.
translation: 너한테 줄 건 아무것도 없으니까 저리 가, 거지야.

english: Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
translation: 너 같은 한심한 고깃덩어리랑은 말 섞고 싶지 않아.

english: I bet you have wonderful paws.
translation: 너 발이 참 멋질 것 같은데.

english: A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 정말이지 비참한 날이야... 지금 실컷 즐겨 둬.

english: If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
translation: 누구 잡으면 꼭 나눠 먹겠다고 약속해.

english: I haven't smelt you around here before...
translation: 이 근처에서 네 냄새는 처음 맡아 보는데...

english: You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
translation: 이 근처에서 인간 못 봤어? 나 배가 무우우척 고프거든.

english: You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
translation: 보아하니 너도 피 맛 좀 아는 녀석 같은데.

english: Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...
translation: 잠깐만, 이빨 사이에 누가 좀 끼었어...

english: Durrrr...
Hey! Come over here!
Who? Me?
Yes, you!
Give me a moment...I can't move that fast.
translation: 잠깐만... 나 그렇게 빨리 못 움직여.

english: Why not?
I used to be a magician's assistant until the accident...
translation: 나 원래 마술사 조수였어, 그 사고가 나기 전까지는...

english: What accident?
Looook...
Braaaaains...
Zombie, it has come to my attention that you are a fool, a nitwit if you will.
translation: 좀비, 듣자 하니 너는 바보, 말하자면 얼간이라더군.

english: I propose that your head, instead of being filled with the brains you so crave, is instead filled with a mixture of crushed lemons and kelp!
translation: 내 생각에 네 머릿속은 네가 그토록 갈망하는 뇌 대신 으깬 레몬과 켈프를 섞은 걸로 꽉 차 있는 것 같아!

english: Oh noooo..I'd best take it off then...
translation: 오오 안 돼... 그럼 머리를 떼어 내는 게 낫겠네...

english: What?
Traaa laaa laaa...
Oogaboogabooga!
Aaaaaargh!
DUUUHHH
Alas!
Mwuhahahaha!
Hey, Head?
What?
How did you die?
I stuck my neck out for an old friend.
You shouldn't get so cut up about it.
Well if I keep it all bottled up I'll turn into a total head case.
translation: 글쎄, 이걸 다 속에 담아 두기만 하면 머리가 완전히 돌아 버릴 거야.

english: What is your name?
Mumblemumblemumble...
What was that?
My name is Edward Cranium.
Edd Cranium?
translation: 에드 크레이니엄? '헤드' 크레이니엄, 그러니까 머리 머리통이라고?

english: Hahahahahahahahahahaha!
Har har...
Hey Head?
What now?
Can you do any tricks?
translation: 너 재주 부릴 줄 아는 거 있어?

english: Not any more...
How come?
Because I used to be able to do a handstand for over an hour while juggling cannon balls with my feet...
translation: 예전엔 물구나무를 선 채로 발로 대포알을 저글링하면서 한 시간 넘게 버틸 수 있었으니까...

english: Wow, you were quite the entertainer.
Yep. Now I can barely roll my eyes...
translation: 그래. 이젠 눈알 굴리는 것도 겨우 해...

english: I know what you can do!
translation: 너 할 수 있는 거 하나 알아!

english: Vent...
Don't even suggest it!
Ok.
Can't I rest in peace?
translation: 나 좀 편히 잠들면 안 돼?

english: No!
Would you like a new hat?
No, but could you screw a handle into the top of my head?
translation: 아니, 그 대신 내 정수리에 손잡이 하나 박아 줄 수 있어?

english: A handle? Why?
Because currently you wave me about by my hair, and it hurts!
translation: 지금은 네가 내 머리카락을 잡고 휘두르잖아, 그거 아프다고!

english: Will you ever leave me alone?
translation: 날 좀 가만히 내버려 둘 거야?

english: Want to go scare some people?
Let's leave it for now.
All right...
We'll quit while we're ahead!
translation: 머리 하나 차이로 앞서 있을 때 그만두자고!

english: If I try really hard I might be able to will myself deader...
translation: 정말 열심히 애쓰면 좀 더 죽을 수 있을지도...

english: I have a winner for you here, Doctor! Look! It's still moving!
translation: 박사님, 딱 맞는 걸 가져왔어요! 보세요! 아직도 움직여요!

english: Nobody knows the troubles I've seen...nobody knows my sorrow...
translation: 내가 겪은 고난은 아무도 모르지... 내 슬픔은 아무도 모르지...

english: I can't use that head!
Why not?
If that thing keeps wriggling around, I'll never get the stitches straight.
translation: 그게 계속 꿈틀대면 바느질을 똑바로 할 수가 없지 않나.

english: ...And who knows what problems will come up if we have an undead head on a truly dead body.
translation: ...게다가 진짜로 죽은 시신에 언데드 머리를 붙이면 무슨 문제가 생길지 누가 알겠나.

english: Bring me another head, one that isn't still moving
translation: 다른 머리를 가져오게, 아직도 꿈틀대지 않는 걸로

english: How did you die?
What is your name?
Can you do any tricks?
translation: 너 재주 부릴 줄 아는 거 있어?

english: Want a new hat?
Want to go scare some people?
Hello! What brings you here?
I'm here to guard this ship from any scurvy dogs darin' to loot her cargo.
translation: 이 배의 짐을 털려고 덤비는 비열한 놈들로부터 배를 지키고 있는 거다.

english: How did your ship end up here?
Arr, 'tis a woeful tale.
Me hearties and I were enjoying a bit o' grog when we espied a group of landlubbers fightin' on the shore. 'Twas such an exciting battle that our navigator forgot to watch for the rocks.
translation: 동료들이랑 그로그주를 한잔하고 있는데, 해변에서 육지 놈들이 싸우는 게 보이더라고. 싸움 구경이 어찌나 재밌던지 항해사 놈이 암초 살피는 걸 잊어버렸지 뭐야.

english: Now we've run aground, as ye can see.
Where's the rest of your crew?
They're searchin' for booty at that temple to the west.
Will they return to the ship?
They best do! That scurvy lot keep fillin' their lockers with loot and sneakin' off without swappin' places!
translation: 돌아와야지! 그 비열한 놈들, 자기 사물함에 전리품만 가득 채우고는 교대도 안 해 주고 슬쩍 사라진다니까!

english: Do you really want to go to the temple? I've heard the mages there have some really annoying spells.
translation: 정말 그 신전에 가고 싶어요? 거기 마법사들은 정말 성가신 주문을 쓴다던데요.

english: Nothin' we can't handle! We've a way of stoppin' their tricksy teleports.
translation: 우리가 못 감당할 건 없지! 그놈들의 얄팍한 순간이동을 막을 방법이 있거든.

english: How can a group of mindless zombies invent a counter to magic?
translation: 생각 없는 좀비 무리가 어떻게 마법에 맞설 방법을 만들어 냈어요?

english: What we lack in brains, we make up for in gold! We found us a landlubber willin' to share their knowledge... for a price.
translation: 머리가 모자란 만큼 금으로 메우는 거지! 돈만 주면 지식을 나눠 주겠다는 육지 놈을 하나 찾았거든.

english: They wrote us down a spell on some magic scrolls. All we 'ave to do is read one, and then we're properly anchored! Those mages can't teleport us anywhere!
translation: 그놈이 마법 두루마리에 주문을 적어 줬지. 하나 읽기만 하면 단단히 고정되는 거다! 그 마법사 놈들도 우릴 어디로도 순간이동시킬 수 없지!

english: Wow, I'm actually impressed. Do you think your friends at the temple will lend me one?
translation: 와, 솔직히 감탄했어요. 신전에 있는 동료분들이 저한테도 하나 빌려줄까요?

english: Naw, they're too busy fightin' to talk to the likes of ye. Besides, we stash all our spare scrolls in these lockers for safekeepin'.
translation: 어림없지, 너 같은 놈이랑 말 섞을 틈도 없이 싸우느라 바쁘거든. 게다가 남는 두루마리는 전부 여기 사물함에 안전하게 넣어 두지.

english: Can I take a scroll from a locker, then?
translation: 그럼 사물함에서 두루마리를 하나 꺼내도 돼요?

english: Ye'll need a key for that, matey! One of the crew should 'ave one.
translation: 그러려면 열쇠가 필요하다고, 친구! 선원 중 한 놈이 갖고 있을 거다.

english: And when ye see 'em, tell 'em it's their turn to keep watch!
translation: 그리고 그놈들 보거든, 이제 자기들이 망볼 차례라고 전해 줘!

english: There be plenty o' loot in them lockers, matey. Don't expect to find a scroll right away.
translation: 저 사물함엔 전리품이 잔뜩 들어 있다고, 친구. 두루마리가 바로 나올 거란 기대는 하지 마.

english: Thanks. I'd say 'see you around', but I sort of hope I don't.
translation: 고마워요. '또 봐요'라고 하고 싶지만, 솔직히 다신 안 만났으면 좋겠네요.

english: Aye, the feelin's mutual.
Goodbye, I hope your crew comes back soon.
translation: 안녕히 계세요. 선원들이 빨리 돌아오면 좋겠네요.

english: Arr, me too matey.
Goodbye.
Bye, matey.
Arr, I've still not seen any of my crew.
translation: 아르르, 아직도 선원 놈들이 하나도 안 보이네.

english: Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: 제가 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 썼는지 알 수 있어요?

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: 그래, 네 꼴을 척 보니 아직 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 안 읽었구먼.

english: Aye, I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll.
translation: 그래, 네 꼴을 척 보니 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 읽었구먼.

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
Ye've never done it even once!
Ye've done it once, and once only.
translation: 딱 한 번, 딱 한 번 열었지.

english: Ye've done it [#] times.
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 아직 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 안 읽었고, 우리 사물함도 한 번도 안 열었구먼.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 아직 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 안 읽었고, 우리 사물함은 딱 한 번, 딱 한 번 열었구먼.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that ye haven't yet read the Teleport anchoring scroll, though ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 아직 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 안 읽었지만, 우리 사물함은 [#]번 열었구먼.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, but ye've never opened our lockers.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)는 읽었지만, 우리 사물함은 한 번도 안 열었구먼.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers once, and once only.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 읽었고, 우리 사물함은 딱 한 번, 딱 한 번 열었구먼.

english: I can tell by the cut of your jib that you've read the Teleport anchoring scroll, and ye've opened our lockers [#] times.
translation: 네 꼴을 척 보니 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 읽었고, 우리 사물함은 [#]번 열었구먼.

english: Still here?
I've not seen any of my crew yet.
translation: 아직 선원 놈들이 하나도 안 보인다.

english: I wonder why.
Where's the rest of your crew?
Do you really want to go to the temple?
Goodbye.
Oh dear, how strange.
Can you tell if I've used the Teleport anchoring scroll?
translation: 제가 Teleport anchoring scroll(순간이동 고정 두루마리)를 썼는지 알 수 있어요?

english: How many times have I opened your lockers?
I'll leave you to wait for your crew.
Arrrr! Tis yerself! Have a drink!
Errr...Arrr! I will in a sec, I've just go to, err, plunder some landlubbers...
translation: 어어... 아르르! 금방 마실게, 그 전에, 어, 육지 놈들 좀 약탈하고 와야 해서...

english: Good huntin'!
Rum, rum, we want rum!
Give us rum or give us death!
Whadda we want? Rum!
Spare us a drop, you scurvy dogs!
translation: 한 방울만 나눠 줘라, 이 비열한 놈들아!

english: Yer rum or yer brains!
When do we want it? Now!
Arr! Come back here!
Ye'll never get away!
Where d'ye think yer goin?
Give us yer rum, ye scurvy dog!
Ye'll never beat us all!
United we stagger!
Rum! Rum! Rum!
Drink!
Hi!
Welcome to the Ardougne Zoo! How can I help you?
translation: Ardougne Zoo(아르둔 동물원)에 오신 걸 환영해요! 뭘 도와드릴까요?

english: Do you have any quests for me?
Not at the moment. The explorers that come back from far away lands tell such amazing tales. Make sure you keep eyes and ears open as you may find new places to explore!
translation: 지금은 없어요. 먼 나라에서 돌아온 탐험가들이 정말 놀라운 이야기를 들려주곤 하죠. 탐험할 새로운 곳을 찾을지도 모르니 눈과 귀를 활짝 열어 두세요!

english: Ooh, I will!
Where did you get the animals from?
We get them from all over the place! The most exotic creatures have been brought back by explorers and sold to us.
translation: 온갖 곳에서 데려와요! 가장 진귀한 동물들은 탐험가들이 데려와서 저희한테 판 거예요.

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that scary looking Cyclops?!
translation: 도대체 Gielinor(길리노르) 어디서 저렇게 무섭게 생긴 Cyclops(사이클롭스)를 데려온 거예요?!

english: Yes he is scary looking!
He's from a very far away land, we couldn't find out more as the explorer who brought him back died shortly afterwards!
translation: 아주 먼 나라에서 왔는데, 데려온 탐험가가 얼마 안 가 죽어 버리는 바람에 더 자세한 건 알아내지 못했어요!

english: Before I help you, can you do something for me?
translation: 도와드리기 전에, 제 부탁 하나 들어주실래요?

english: Sure.
I need to know how many animals we have now.
translation: 지금 저희 동물이 몇 마리인지 알아야 해서요.

english: The zoo keeper has given you a challenge scroll!
Please tell me how many animals there are.
Sorry, but that doesn't sound right!
Thanks!
You've obtained a casket!
Do you have any quests for me?
Where did you get the animals from?
It's not often that we see more humans in this place.
translation: 이곳에서 저희 말고 다른 사람을 보는 일은 흔치 않은데요.

english: How did you come to be here?
General Hining sent us out in a scouting party. We got separated from the rest, and became completely lost. Soon we ran out of rations.
translation: General Hining(하이닝 장군)께서 저희를 정찰대로 보내셨어요. 그러다 본대와 떨어져서 완전히 길을 잃었죠. 곧 식량도 바닥났고요.

english: Eventually we stumbled upon this place. They saw we were starving, and allowed us to eat of their sacred eels if we vowed to serve Zulrah.
translation: 그러다 결국 이곳을 우연히 찾게 됐어요. 저희가 굶주린 걸 보고, Zulrah(줄라)를 섬기겠다고 맹세하면 신성한 장어를 먹게 해 주겠다더군요.
